照现在这样子看，看决不会有的事。
Judging by this performance, he need have no such fear.


“嗳，你太客气了！
“Please, you are far too formal!

你我何分彼此？”何桂清也很厚道，一上来就表明了不忘旧情的本心，
What is mine is yours.” He Guiqing responded generously, making it clear from the outset that he had not forgotten their old affection.

“请炕上来坐，
“Come and sit on the heated platform.

比较舒服些。”
You'll be more comfortable.”


炕几上已摆了八个高脚盆子，装着茶点水果，
Eight raised dishes of fruit and refreshments stood on its small table.

炕前一个雪白铜的火盆，发出哗哗剥剥煤炭的轻响。
In front, coals crackled softly in a gleaming copper brazier.

王有龄觉得这样的气氛，正宜于细谈叙旧，便欣然在下首落座。
Wang felt that the setting was ideal for a long conversation about the past and gladly took the less honoured seat.

何桂清还要让他上坐，他一定不肯，也就算了。
He Guiqing tried to give him the place of honour, but Wang firmly refused, and the matter was dropped.


当杨承福端来了盖碗茶，做主人的吩咐：“有客一概挡驾。
When Yang brought lidded bowls of tea, the host instructed him, “Turn away every visitor.

王老爷是我从小的‘弟兄’，
His Honour Wang and I have been like brothers since childhood.

二十年不见，我们要好好谈谈，
We haven't met for twenty years and have a great deal to discuss.

叫他们不必在外面伺候。”
Tell the others they needn't wait outside.”


“是！”
“Yes, sir.

杨承福又说，“请大人的示，晚上有饭局……”
May I ask about this evening's dinner engagement...”


“我知道，
“I know.

回头再说。”
We'll discuss it later.”


等底下人一回避，室中主客单独相处，反有不知从何说起之苦。
Once the servants had withdrawn and the two were alone, they found it difficult to know where to begin.

而且何桂清也还有些窘态。
He Guiqing still seemed somewhat embarrassed.

王有龄一看这情形，只好口不择言他说了句：
Seeing this, Wang blurted out the first words that came to him.

“二十年不见，
“Twenty years apart!

想不到大人竟直上青云，
I never imagined Your Excellency would rise so high.

‘同学少年真不贱’！
As the poem says, ‘The companions of my schooldays have become men of consequence.’

可喜可贺。”
My warmest congratulations.”


话是不甚得体，但总算开了个头，
The words were not particularly tactful, but at least they opened the conversation.

何桂清紧接着摇摇手说：
He Guiqing immediately waved a hand.

“雪轩！我们的称呼要改一改，
“Xuexuan, we must change how we address each other.

在场面上，朝廷体制所关，不得不用官称，
In public, the dignity of the court requires official titles.

私底下你叫我‘根云’好了。”
In private, call me Genyun.”


“是。”
“Very well.”

王有龄但然接受他的建议，
Wang readily accepted the suggestion.

“我倒还不知道你这个大号的由来。”
“I didn't know you had taken that name. How did you come by it?”


“是我自己取的。
“I chose it myself.

‘根云’者，‘根基于云南’，永不忘本耳。”
Genyun means ‘rooted in Yunnan’—a reminder never to forget where I began.”


原来如此！
So that was it.

王有龄心想：照他的解释，无非特意挂一块“云南人”的幌子，
Wang thought the explanation amounted to deliberately displaying a sign that said “Yunnan native.”

照此看来，他可能是“冒籍”中的举。
Perhaps He had passed the provincial examination under a false claim of local registration.

这也下去管他，
But that was none of his business.

反正能“不忘本”总是好的。
In any event, remembering one's beginnings was a good thing.


“我也听说，老太爷故世了。”何桂情又说，
“I also heard that your father had passed away,” He Guiqing continued.

“其时亦正逢先君弃养，
“It happened just when I lost my own father.

同在苫次，照礼不通吊问。”
We were both in mourning, and etiquette did not permit an exchange of condolence visits.”


他的所谓“先君”，王有龄从前管他叫“老何”。
The man he referred to as his late father was the person Wang had once called Old He.

现在当然也要改口了：
Now Wang naturally had to change his language too.

“我也失礼，
“I was remiss as well.

竟不知老太爷下世。
I didn't even know of your honoured father's passing.

说实在的，我也不知道你中举、点翰林。
To tell the truth, I didn't know you had passed the provincial examination or entered the Hanlin Academy either.

不然……“
Otherwise...”


不然早就通音问了。
Otherwise, he would long since have been in touch.

王有龄不曾说出这句话来，何桂清心里却明白：
Wang left the words unsaid, but He understood.

他已听杨承福略略提过，知道他此行是为了上京加捐，是境况似乎并不怎么好，
Yang had already briefly explained that Wang was travelling to the capital to purchase a higher qualification, and his circumstances did not appear particularly good.

随即问道：“这几年一直在浙江？”
He therefore asked, “Have you been in Zhejiang all these years?”


“是的。”王有龄答道，
“Yes,” Wang replied.

“那年在京里与先父见面，因为回福建乡试，路途遥远，当时报捐了一个盐大使，
“When I met my father in the capital that year, the journey back to Fujian for the provincial examination was so long that I purchased qualification as a salt-station superintendent instead.

分发到浙江候补，一直住在杭州。”
I was assigned to await a vacancy in Zhejiang and have lived in Hangzhou ever since.”


“混得怎么样呢？”
“How have things gone for you?”


“唉！
“Ah!

一言难尽。”
It's a long story.”

王有龄欲言又止地。
Wang hesitated.


“从小的弟兄，
“We've been brothers since childhood.

有什么话不能跟我说？”
What is there you cannot tell me?”


王有龄是年轻好面子，不好意思把窘况说与旧日的“书僮”听，
Young and proud, Wang had been ashamed to describe his poverty to his former study attendant.

此时受了何桂清的鼓励，同时又想到“人生如欢”，便觉无所碍口了。
Encouraged now by He Guiqing, and remembering his own notion that life was a play, he found he could speak freely.


“这一次我有两大奇遇，
“On this journey, I've had two extraordinary encounters.

一奇是遇着你，一奇是遇着个极慷慨的朋友。
One was with you; the other was with a remarkably generous friend.

旧雨新知，遇合不凡，是我平生一大快事……“
To meet both an old friend and a new one in such unusual circumstances is one of the great pleasures of my life...”


于是王有龄把胡雪岩赠金的经过，说了一遍。
He then told the story of Hu Xueyan's gift.

何桂清极有兴味地倾听着，等他说完，欣然笑道：
He Guiqing listened with keen interest and smiled warmly when it was over.

“我也应该感谢这位胡君，
“I too ought to thank this Mr Hu.

若非他慷慨援手，你就不会北上，我们也就无从在客途重逢了。“
Without his generous help, you would never have come north, and we could not have met again on our travels.”


“是啊！
“Exactly!

看来今年是我脱运文运的一年。”
It seems this is the year my bad luck ends and my good fortune begins.”


正说到这里，杨承福在窗外大声说道：
Just then, Yang called from outside the window.

“跟大人回话，通永台衙门派入来请大人赴席。”
“Your Excellency, the Tongzhou–Yongping circuit intendant has sent to invite you to the banquet.”


“好，我知道了。”
“Very well, I know.”

停了一下，何桂清又说：“你进来。”
After a pause, He added, “Come in.”


等杨承福到了跟前，何桂清吩咐他替王有龄备饭，又叫到客店去结帐，把行李取了来。
When Yang appeared, He told him to arrange a meal for Wang, settle his bill at the inn, and bring over his luggage.

王有龄不作一声，任他安排。
Wang said nothing and left the arrangements to his host.


于是王有龄吃了一顿北上以来最舒服的饭。
He then enjoyed the most comfortable meal he had eaten since leaving for the north.

昨天还是同桌劝酬、称兄道弟的杨承福，这时侍立在旁，执礼极恭。
Yang, who only yesterday had sat at table with him, exchanged toasts, and called him brother, now stood at his side with the utmost deference.

要说有使得他感到不舒服的地方，那就是这一点歉疚不安了。
If anything troubled Wang, it was the sense of guilt and discomfort this change produced.


饭后，杨承福为他到客店去取行李，王有龄便歪在炕上打盹。
After the meal, Yang went to fetch the luggage, and Wang reclined on the heated platform for a nap.

一觉醒来，钟打三下，恰好何桂清回到行馆，
He woke as the clock struck three, just as He Guiqing returned.

煮茗清谈，重拾中断的话头。
Over freshly brewed tea, they resumed their interrupted conversation.


说到“脱运交运”，何桂清要细问王有龄的打算。
Returning to Wang's change of fortune, He Guiqing asked about his plans in detail.

他很老实地把杨承福的策划说了出来，自己却不曾提什么要求，
Wang frankly described Yang's proposed arrangements but made no request of his own.

因为他认为这是不需要的，何桂清自会有所安排。
He thought it unnecessary: He would naturally make the appropriate provision for him.


“捐一个‘指省分发’是一定要的，
“You must certainly purchase the right to a designated province,” He Guiqing said.

不过不必指明在江苏。”
“But you needn't specify Jiangsu.”


“那么，在哪一省呢？”
“Which province, then?”


何桂清沉吟了一下忽然问道：“你知道不知道，你们浙江出了一件大案？”
After a moment's thought, He suddenly asked, “Have you heard about the major case in Zhejiang?”

话刚出口，随又用自己省悟的语气紧接着说：
Almost immediately he corrected himself.

“腥，你当然不知道，
“Of course you haven't.

这件案子发生还不久，外面的消息没有那么快！
It happened only recently, and news doesn't travel that fast.

这也暂且不提。
We'll leave that aside for now.

浙江的巡抚半年前换了人，你总该知道？”
But you do know that Zhejiang had a change of governor half a year ago?”


“是的。
“Yes.

是黄抚台。”
Governor Huang.”


“黄寿臣是我的同年，
“Huang Shouchen is an examination classmate of mine.

现在圣眷正隆重，
He is enjoying great imperial favour just now.

不过……”
However...”

何桂清略停一停说，
He paused briefly.

“你还是回浙江。”
“You should return to Zhejiang.”


语意暧昧不明，王有龄有些摸不着头脑，
The meaning was obscure, and Wang could not make it out.

定神想了一下，
He steadied his thoughts.

此一刻是机会，是关键，下可轻易放过，
This was his opportunity, the crucial moment; he must not let it slip.

无论如何跟着何桂清在一起，缓急可恃，总比分发到别省来得好！
Surely it would be better to remain near He Guiqing, on whom he could rely in any emergency, than to be sent to another province.


打定了这个主意，他便用反衬的笔法，逼进一步：
Having decided this, he pressed his point indirectly.

“如果你不愿意我到江苏，那么我就回浙江。”
“If you would rather I did not go to Jiangsu, then I shall return to Zhejiang.”


“你误会了！”何桂清很快地按口，
“You misunderstand me!” He answered at once.

“我岂有下愿意你到江苏的道理？
“Why should I not want you in Jiangsu?

老实说，我没有少年的朋友，有时觉得很寂寞，
To be frank, I have no friends from my youth around me and sometimes feel very lonely.

巴不得能有你在一起，朝夕闲话，也是一乐。
Nothing would please me more than to have you close by for a daily conversation.

我让你回浙江，是为你打算。“
I am asking you to return to Zhejiang for your own sake.”


“这我倒真是误会了。”
“Then I certainly misunderstood.”

王有龄笑道：
Wang smiled.

“不过，如何是为我打算，
“But how would it benefit me?

乞道其详。”
Please explain.”


“江苏巡抚杨文定我不熟，
“I don't know Governor Yang Wending of Jiangsu well.

而且比我早一科，算是前辈，说话不便，
He also passed one examination cycle before me, which makes him my senior and leaves me less free to speak.

就算买我的帐，也不会有好缺给你。
Even if he obliged me, he would not give you a particularly good post.

到浙江就不同了。
Zhejiang is different.

黄寿臣这个人，说句老实后，十分刻薄，
To speak frankly, Huang Shouchen is a very harsh man.

但有我的信，对你就会大不相同。”
But with a letter from me, his treatment of you would be quite another matter.”


“是！”王有龄将信将疑地答应着。
“I see,” Wang replied, only half convinced.


“索性跟你明说了吧，省得你下放心。
“I might as well explain plainly, so that you can stop worrying.

不过，”
But...”

何桂清看了看窗外说，
He glanced towards the window.

“关防严密，
“This is strictly confidential.

你千万不可泄漏出去。”
You must not breathe a word of it.”


“当然，当然。”
“Of course, of course.”


“黄寿臣是靠我们乙未同年，大家捧他。”
“Huang owes his position to the support of us yiwei examination classmates.

何桂清隔着炕几，凑过去放低了声音说，“这还在其次，
That is only part of it.” Leaning across the small table, He lowered his voice.

他现在有件案子，上头派我顺道密查。
“He is now involved in a case which the emperor has sent me to investigate secretly on my journey.

自然，他也知道我有钦差的身分，非买我的帐不可。
Naturally, he knows that I carry an imperial commission and has no choice but to oblige me.

你真正是运气好！
Your luck is remarkable.

早也不行，迟也不行，
Earlier would not have done, nor later.

刚刚就是这会儿，我的一纣信到他那里，说什么就是什么。“
At this exact moment, a letter from me will make him do whatever I ask.”


“啊！”
“Ah!”

王有龄遍体舒泰，
Wang felt relief and delight spread through him.

不由得想到“积德以遗子孙”这句话，
He could not help recalling the saying about accumulating virtue for one's descendants.

如果不是老父身前提拔何桂清，自己何来今日的机缘？
Had his late father not helped He Guiqing, how could this opportunity have come to him today?


这天晚上，何桂清又有饭局，是仓场侍郎作东。
That evening He had another engagement, this time with the granary vice-minister.

赴席归来，又吩咐备酒，与王有龄作长夜之饮。
On returning, he ordered wine and sat up drinking with Wang far into the night.

二十年悲欢离台，有着扯不断的话头，
Twenty years of joys, sorrows, separations, and reunions supplied an endless flow of conversation.

但王有龄心中还有一大疑团，却始终不好意思问出来。
Yet one great puzzle remained in Wang's mind, and he could never quite bring himself to ask about it.


这个疑团就是何桂清如何点了翰林？
How had He Guiqing entered the Hanlin Academy?

照王有龄想，他自然是捐了监生才能参加乡试，乡试中式成了举人，然后到京城会试，成进士、点翰林。
Wang assumed that he had purchased Imperial Academy status to qualify for the provincial examination, passed it to become a provincial graduate, then gone to the capital, succeeded in the metropolitan examinations, and been selected for the Hanlin.

疑问就在他不是云南人，
But he was not a Yunnan native.

怎能在云南乡试？
How had he been allowed to take the provincial examination there?

“冒籍”的事不是没有，但要花好大的力量，
False claims of local registration were not unheard of, but they required considerable influence.

这又是谁帮了他的忙呢？
Who had helped him?


他不好意思问，何桂清也不好意思说。
Wang was embarrassed to ask, and He was embarrassed to explain.

尊前娓娓，谈的都是京里官场的故事。
Over their cups, they talked instead of affairs in the capital.

何桂清讲起直宗的俭德，当今皇帝得承大位的秘辛，
He described the Daoguang emperor's frugality and the hidden story of the present emperor's succession.

全靠他“师傅”杜受田的指点，
It had depended on the guidance of his tutor, Du Shoutian.

咸丰帝在做皇子时，表现了仁慈友爱的德量，宣宗才把皇位传了给他。
While still a prince, the future Xianfeng emperor had displayed such benevolence and brotherly affection that his father chose him to inherit the throne.


“当今皇上年纪虽轻，英明果敢，颇有一番作为。”何桂清很兴奋他说，
“Although His Majesty is young, he is discerning and decisive, and determined to accomplish something,” He said enthusiastically.

“气运在转了，
“The tide is turning.

那班旗下大爷，昏庸糊涂，让皇上看透了他们，办不了大事。
He has seen through those muddle-headed banner grandees; they cannot handle important affairs.

现在汉人正在得势，不过汉人中，也要年轻有担当的，皇上才赏识。
Han Chinese officials are gaining influence now, though even among them he values only men who are young and willing to take responsibility.

所以那些琐屑龌龊的大僚，因循敷衍，一味做官，不肯做事的，纷纷告老，
The petty, unscrupulous senior officials who merely follow precedent, muddle through, and want the office without doing the work are retiring one after another.

如今朝中很有一番新气象。
There's a new spirit at court.

雪轩，时逢明主，
Xuexuan, we are fortunate to serve an enlightened ruler.

你我好自为之。“
Let us both make the most of it.”


“我怎能比你？
“How can I compare with you?

以侍郎放学政，三年任满，不是尚书，就是巡抚。
A vice-minister sent out as education commissioner—when your three-year term is over, you'll become either a minister or a governor.

真正是望尘莫及！”
I could never catch up with you.”


“你也不必气馁。
“There's no need to lose heart.

用兵之际，做地方官在‘军功’上效力，升迁也快得很。”何桂清又说，“黄寿巨人虽刻薄，不易同候，但倒是个肯做事的、
In wartime, a local official who renders military service can rise very quickly too.” He added, “Harsh as Huang Shouchen is, and difficult as he may be to serve, he does believe in getting things done.

你在他那里只要吃得来苦，他一定会提拔你。”
If you're prepared to endure hard work under him, he'll certainly promote you.”


“那自然也靠了你的面子。
“That would naturally be due to your influence too.

不过……”
But...”


看他欲言又止的神情，何桂清便很关切地问：“你有什么顾虑，
Seeing him hesitate, He asked with concern, “What troubles you?

说出来商量。”
Tell me, and we can discuss it.”


“你说黄抚台不易伺候，
“You say Governor Huang is difficult to serve.

我的脾气也不好，
My own temper isn't good either.

只怕相处不来。”
I'm afraid we may not get on.”


“这你政心。
“You needn't worry.

他的不易问候，也要看人而定。
His treatment of people depends on who they are.

有我的交情在，他决不会难为你！”
With my friendship behind you, he will certainly not make things difficult for you.”


“是的。”
“I see.”

王有龄想了想，很谨慎地问，“你说他有件案子，上头派你顺道密查，
After a moment's thought, Wang asked cautiously, “You said there was a case involving him and that the emperor had sent you to investigate it secretly.

不知是件什么案子？”
What sort of case is it?”


听他问到机密，何桂清面有难色，
At this inquiry into confidential business, He looked uncomfortable.

沉吟了一会才说，
He considered it for a while before replying.

“反正将来你总会知道，我就告诉了你也可以。
“You'll learn of it sooner or later, so I may as well tell you.

只是出于我口，入于你耳，不足为外人道。”
But it must go no farther than from my lips to your ears.”


于是他把黄宗汉富逼死椿寿，皇帝心有所疑的经过、细细说了一遍。
He then described in detail how Huang Zonghan had driven Chunshou to his death and how the emperor had become suspicious.

王有龄入耳心惊，
Wang listened with alarm.

对黄宗汉的为人，算是有了相当认识。
He now had a fair idea of the governor's character.


“这么件案子压得下去吗？”他问。
“Can a case like that really be suppressed?” he asked.


“怎么压不下去？
“Why not?

‘朝里无人莫做官’，
‘Without someone at court, do not seek office.’

只要有人，什么都好力。”
With the right connections, anything can be managed.”


“椿寿的家属呢，
“What about Chunshou's family?

岂肯善罢干休？”
Surely they won't let the matter rest.”


“你想呢？
“What do you think?

椿寿的家属当然要闹。
Of course they want to make trouble.

不过，黄寿臣在这些上的本事最大，
But Huang is exceptionally good at handling such things.

不必替他担心。”何桂清又说，“我听说椿寿夫人到巡抚衙门器闹过几次，
You needn't worry about him.” He added, “I hear that Chunshou's wife went several times to the governor's office to protest in tears.

又写了冤单派人‘京控’，
She even had a statement of grievance drawn up and sent someone to appeal in the capital.

现在都没事了，
Now everything is quiet.

这就是黄寿臣的本事，
That's Huang's ability for you.

我也不刊道他是怎么平伏下来的！”
I don't know how he managed to settle it.”


“有这样的事！
“Can such things really happen?

真是闻所未闻。”
I've never heard the like.”


“官场龌龊，无所不有。”
“There's no end to the sordid things in official life.”

何桂清轻描淡写一句撇开，
He brushed the subject aside.

“别人的事，不必去管他了。”
“There's no need for us to concern ourselves with other people's affairs.”


不管别人的闲事，自然是谈王有龄切身的利害。
Leaving others' affairs alone meant returning to Wang's own interests.

何桂清告诉他，洪杨起兵，在广西没有把它挡住，现在军人两湖，有燎原之势，
He explained that the forces of Hong Xiuquan and Yang Xiuqing had not been stopped in Guangxi and had now entered Hunan and Hubei, spreading like wildfire.

朝廷筹响甚急，捐例大开，
The court urgently needed military funds, and opportunities to purchase official qualifications had been greatly expanded.

凡是“捐备军需”的，多交部优于议叙，
Donations towards military supplies were generally referred to the Board for favourable recognition.

所以目前的机会正好，
This was therefore an excellent moment.

劝工有龄从速进京“投供”加捐，早日到浙江候补。
He urged Wang to proceed to the capital promptly, register, purchase the upgraded qualification, and return to Zhejiang to await appointment as soon as possible.


“也不忙在这几天。”王有龄笑道，
“A few days won't matter,” Wang said with a smile.

“我送你上了船再动身也不晚。”
“I can see you aboard your boat before I leave.”


“不必。”问佳清说，
“There's no need.

“我陛辞时，面奉谕旨，以现在筹办漕米海运，我在户部正管此事，命我沿途考察得失奏闻。
When I took leave of the emperor, he personally instructed me to examine the advantages and disadvantages of sea transport for the grain tax along my route and report back, since this was among my responsibilities at the Board of Revenue.

在通州，我跟仓场侍郎要好好商议，还有几天耽搁，
I need to discuss it thoroughly with the granary vice-minister here, so I shall be delayed several more days.

好在江浙密坯，将来不怕见不着面。
Jiangsu and Zhejiang are close enough; we shall have plenty of opportunities to meet.

我明人就派一个人送你进京。
Tomorrow I'll send someone to take you to the capital.

黄寿臣的信，我此刻就写。”
I'll write the letter to Huang now.”


“能有人送我进京，那太好了。
“It would be a great help to have someone accompany me.

吏部书办有许多花样，非有熟人照应不可。”
The clerks at the Board of Civil Appointments have so many tricks that a man really needs someone who knows them.”


“就是这话。
“Exactly.

我再间你一句，
Now let me ask you something else.

你回浙江之后，补上了缺怎么办？”
Once you return to Zhejiang and receive a post, what will you do?”


这话问得王有龄一愣，
Wang was taken aback.

细想一想才明白，问的依旧是“做官的本钱”。
After thinking it over, he understood: the question was still about the capital required to become an official.


一旦藩署“挂牌”，不管是实缺还是署理，马上就是现任的“大老爷”了，
Once the provincial treasury posted his appointment, whether substantive or acting, he would immediately become a serving magistrate.

公馆、轿马、衣服、跟班，一切排场要摆开来，
He would need a residence, a sedan chair and horses, suitable clothes, servants—the whole outward establishment.

加上赴任的盘缠，算起来不是一笔小数目。
Add the journey to his post, and the expense would be considerable.

而且刚到任也不能马上就出花样弄钱，
Nor could he begin devising ways to extract money the moment he arrived.

那两三十月的用度，也得另外筹措。
The expenses of the first two or three months would have to be found elsewhere.

这一点，王有龄当然盘算过，
Naturally, Wang had considered this.

点点头说：
He nodded.

“只要挂了牌，事情就好办了。”
“Once the appointment is posted, that can be managed.”


“我知道。
“I know.

候补州具只要一放了缺，自有人会来借钱与你。
As soon as an expectant magistrate receives a post, people will offer him loans.

不过，说得难听些，那笔借款就跟老鸨放给窑姐儿的押帐一样，
But, to put it bluntly, that money is like the advance a brothel keeper makes to a prostitute.

跟你到了任上，事事受他挟制，
The lender follows you to your post and holds you in his power in everything you do.

非弄得声名狼藉不可！”
You'll end up with your reputation in ruins.”


说着何桂清站起身来，走到里面卧室，再回来时，手里拿着一张银票。
He rose, went into the inner bedroom, and returned with a bank draft in his hand.


“我手头也不宽裕，只能帮你这点忙，
“I'm not very well supplied with money myself, so this is all I can do.

省着些用，也差不多银要是八百两，足足有余了！
If you're economical, it should be about enough.” The draft was for eight hundred taels—more than enough.

王有龄喜出望外，眼含泪光地答说，”大恩不言谢。
Overjoyed, his eyes shining with tears, Wang replied, “Such great kindness is beyond thanks.

不过将来也真不知何以为报？“
But I truly don't know how I shall ever repay it.”


“谈什么报不报？”
“Why talk of repayment?”

何桂清脸上是那种脱手千金，恩怨了了的得意与欣快，
On He's face was the satisfaction and relief of a man who had freely given a fortune and settled an old debt of gratitude.

“说句实话吧，这是我报答你老太爷的提携。
“To tell the truth, this is my repayment for your honoured father's help.

没有他老人家，我不能在云南中举。”
Without him, I could never have passed the provincial examination in Yunnan.”



胡雪岩
《平步青云（上）》第二章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume I — Chapter Two, concluding part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


“话虽如此，我未免受之有愧。”
“Even so, I cannot help feeling that I do not deserve it.”


“这不须如此想。
“You needn't think that way.

倒是那位在你穷途之际，慷慨援手的胡君，
But you must remember Mr Hu, who generously helped you when you had nowhere to turn.

别人非亲非故帮你的忙，
He was neither a relative nor an old family friend.

无非看你是个人才，会有一番事业，
He helped because he saw ability in you and believed you could accomplish something.

你该记着这一点！”
You should keep that in mind.”


王有龄自然深深受教。
Wang took the advice deeply to heart.

他本来就不是没有大志，连番奇遇的鼓舞，越发激起一片雄心，
He had never lacked ambition, and these successive strokes of fortune stirred it still further.

只一闭上眼，便看得前程锦绣，目迷神眩，
Whenever he closed his eyes, he saw a future of dazzling promise.

虽还未补缺，却已在享受做官的乐趣了。
Though he had not yet obtained an appointment, he was already savouring the pleasures of office.


第二天早晨起身，何桂清已写好了一封致黄宗汉的信在等他。
When he rose the next morning, He Guiqing was waiting with a letter to Huang Zonghan.

这封信不是泛泛的八行，甚至也不象一封荐信，
It was no ordinary note of introduction; indeed, it scarcely resembled a recommendation at all.

里面谈了许多知交的私话，
Much of it concerned private matters between close friends.

然后才提到王有龄，说是“总角之交，谊如昆季”，特为嘱他指捐分发浙江，以便请黄宗汉培植造就，
Only then did it mention Wang, describing him as “a friend since boyhood, as dear as a brother,” whom He had specifically advised to purchase assignment to Zhejiang so that Huang might nurture his abilities and advance his career.

照这封信的恳切结实来说，就差何桂清当面拱手拜托了。
The letter was so earnest and substantial that little was lacking except He's presence in person, hands clasped in appeal.


等看过封好，王有龄便跟何桂清要人。
After Wang had read it and it had been sealed, he asked He to provide someone to accompany him.

以他的意思，很想请杨承福做个帮手，这一点何桂清无法满足他的希望，
He very much wanted Yang Chengfu, but this was a wish his friend could not grant.

因为杨承福是他最得力的人，
Yang was his most capable assistant.

许多公事、关系只有他清楚首尾，非他人所能替代。
Many official matters and personal connections were fully understood by Yang alone; no one could replace him.


“这样吧，”杨承福建议，“叫高升跟了王老爷去，
“Why not send Gao Sheng with His Honour?” Yang suggested.

也很妥当。”
“That would work very well.”


高升也很诚实能干，他自己也愿意跟王有龄，事情就算定局。
Gao Sheng was honest and capable too, and willing to accompany Wang, so the arrangement was settled.

拜别何桂清，谢了杨承福，由高升照料着，当天就到了京里。
Wang took leave of He Guiqing, thanked Yang, and, under Gao's care, reached the capital that same day.

本来想住会馆，
He had intended to stay at the provincial guildhall.

因为本年王子恩科，明年癸丑正科，
But the current renzi year had brought a special examination, and the following guichou year would bring the regular one.

接连两年会试，落第的、新到的举人，挤得满坑满谷，
With metropolitan examinations in two successive years, unsuccessful candidates and newly arrived provincial graduates packed the place.

要找一间空房实在很难。
An empty room was almost impossible to find.

而且三有龄以监生的底子来加捐，
Moreover, Wang was seeking to upgrade a purchased qualification on the basis of his Imperial Academy status.

跟那些明年四月便可一举成名的举人在一起，相形之下，仙凡异途，也自觉难堪。
Beside provincial graduates who might win distinction in the fourth month, he felt that he belonged to a lesser world, and the comparison embarrassed him.


便索性破费些，在两河沿找了家客店住。
He therefore decided to spend a little more and take a room at an inn in Liangheyan.


天气极冷，
The weather was bitterly cold.

生了炉子还象坐在冰害里，
Even with a stove burning, the room felt like an ice cellar.

高开上街买了皮纸和面，在炉子上打了一盆浆糊。
Gao went out to buy tough paper and flour, then cooked a basin of paste on the stove.

把皮纸裁成两指宽的纸条，把窗户板壁上所有的缝隙都糊没。
Cutting the paper into strips two fingers wide, he sealed every crack in the windows and wooden partitions.

西北风进不来，炉人才能发生作用，
Once the northwest wind was shut out, the stove could do its work.

立刻满室生春，十分舒服。
The room soon felt as warm as spring.

王有龄吃过晚饭，便跟高开商量正事。
After supper, Wang discussed their business with him.


“老爷，我有个主意，
“Your Honour, I have an idea.

你看使得使不得？”离升说道，
See what you think of it,” Gao said.

“明天就是腊八，
“Tomorrow is the eighth day of the last month.

还有十几天工夫就‘封印’了。”
In little more than ten days, the government offices will seal up their official seals for the New Year.”


“啊！”一下提醒了王有龄，
“Ah!” Wang suddenly remembered.

“一‘封印’就是一个月，
“Once the seals are put away, the offices will be closed for a month.

这十几天办不成，在京里过年空等，
If we cannot finish in these ten-odd days, we'll have to spend the New Year here waiting.

那耽误的工夫就大了。”
That would mean a long delay.”


“最啊！
“Exactly.

打哪儿来说，都是件划不来的事。
Whichever way you look at it, that would be a poor bargain.

所以我在想，不如多花几个钱，尽这十几天把事情办妥，赶年里就动身回南。”
I was thinking that it might be better to spend a little extra and finish the business before the offices close, then set off south before the year ends.”


“年里就动身？
“Before the year ends?

不太急了吗？”
Wouldn't that be rather hurried?”


“我是替老爷打算。
“I'm thinking of your interests, sir.

京里如果没有什么熟人，在店里过年，也不是味儿。
If you have few friends in the capital, spending the New Year at an inn won't be much pleasure.

再说从大年初一到元宵，到哪儿也得大把花钱，
Besides, from New Year's Day to the Lantern Festival, you have to spend freely wherever you go.

真正划不来。
It really isn't worth it.

与其这个样，莫如就在路上过年。
Better to spend the holiday on the road.

再有一层，“高升凑近了他说，”
There's another point.” Gao leaned closer.

老爷最好赶在何大人之前，或者差不多的日子到浙江见黄抚合，
“It would be best to reach Zhejiang and see Governor Huang before His Excellency He arrives, or at about the same time.

何大人的信才管用。“
That's when his letter will carry weight.”


王有龄恍然大悟，觉得高升的话，实在有见识。
Wang understood at once and recognised the wisdom of Gao's advice.

黄宗汉此人既有刻薄的名声，
Huang had a reputation for harshness.

保不定在椿寿那件案子结束以后，过河拆桥，不买何桂清的帐。
Once Chunshou's case was settled, he might well discard the man who had helped him and cease to oblige He Guiqing.

如果正是何桂清到浙江查案时，有求于人，情形自然不同。
While He was in Zhejiang investigating the case, Huang would still need his goodwill, and the situation would be different.

总之，宁早勿迟，无论如何不错。
In any event, arriving sooner rather than later could only be the right course.


“我听你的话，
“I'll take your advice.

就这么办。
Let's do that.

不过，你可有路子呢？”
But do you know how to go about it?”


“路子总有的。
“There will be a way.

明天我就去找。”高升极有把握地说：
I'll start looking tomorrow,” Gao answered confidently.

“包管又便宜又好。”
“I'll see that it is done well and at a reasonable cost.”


于是王有龄欣然开了箱子，把旧捐的盐大使“部照”取了出来，
Pleased, Wang opened his trunk and took out the Board's certificate for his original purchased qualification as a salt-station superintendent.

接着磨墨伸纸开具“三代”，细陈经历，
He then ground ink, spread out paper, and prepared a statement of his ancestry for three generations and a detailed account of his background.

把文件都预备妥当，一一交代明白。又取二十两银子交给高升，作为应酬花费。
Once the documents were ready, he explained everything to Gao and gave him twenty taels for the expenses of making the necessary contacts.


从第二天起，高升开始奔走。
Gao began his rounds the next day.

起初的消息不大好，不是说时间上没有把握，就是额外需索的费用太高。
The first reports were discouraging: either completion in time could not be guaranteed, or the extra fees demanded were too high.

这样过了三四天，
Three or four days passed.

不但王有龄心里焦灼，连高升自己也有些气馁了。
Wang grew anxious, and even Gao began to lose heart.


就在放弃希望，打算着在京过年时，事情突然有了转机，
Just as they were abandoning hope and preparing to spend the New Year in the capital, matters unexpectedly changed.

吏部有个书办，家里遭了回禄之灾，还烧死了一母一子，
A clerk at the Board of Civil Appointments had suffered a fire at home in which a mother and child had died.

年近岁逼，逢此家破人亡的惨事，
With the year drawing to a close, his household was ruined.

偏偏这书办又因案下狱，
To make matters worse, he himself was in prison over a case.

雪上加霜，濒临绝境，必须求援于他的同事们。
Desperate and with nowhere else to turn, he had to appeal to his colleagues.


帮忙无非“有饯出钱，有力出力”，
Helping meant contributing money if one had it, or effort if one could.

但出钱的不过十两、八两银子，倒是出力的帮忙得大。
Financial contributions amounted to no more than eight or ten taels apiece; practical assistance proved more substantial.

年下公事特忙，
Official business was especially heavy before the New Year.

部里从司官到书办，知道各省差官，以及本人来候选捐纳，谋干前程的，都希望提前办理，
From departmental officials down to clerks, everyone knew that provincial messengers and men seeking appointments or purchasing qualifications wanted their affairs settled early.

在京里过年，赔贴盘缠，空耗辰光还不说，有些限期的公事，耽误了还有处分。
Spending the holiday in the capital meant wasted time and additional living costs; missing a deadline on official business might also bring punishment.

所以这时是留难需索，择肥而噬的好机会，
It was therefore an ideal opportunity to obstruct proceedings and extract money from those who could pay.

现在为了帮同事的忙，他们私下定了章程，出了“公价”，
To assist their unfortunate colleague, the clerks privately agreed on a standard schedule of charges.

凡是想限期办妥的公事，除了照平时的行市纳规费以外，另外看情况加送若干，
Anyone wanting business completed within a fixed time would pay the usual unofficial fees, plus an extra sum according to the circumstances.

多下的钱就归那遭祸的书办所得。
The addition would go to the stricken clerk.

对外人来说，这比自己去撞木钟，辗转托人，重重剥削要便宜得多。
For outsiders, this was much cheaper than trying their luck, seeking one intermediary after another, and being fleeced at every stage.


高升从琉璃厂的笔墨庄里得到了这个消息，
Gao heard of the arrangement at a brush-and-ink shop in Liulichang.

又去找熟人打听，果有其事，匆忙回来说与王有龄。
He checked with an acquaintance, confirmed that it was real, and hurried back to tell Wang.

就托那个熟人，代为接洽，说定了价钱，一共四百八十两银子，加捐为候补州县，分发浙江。
Through this acquaintance they negotiated a total of 480 taels to upgrade Wang's qualification to an expectant local magistracy with assignment to Zhejiang.

其中三分之二“正项”，三分之一是“杂费”，
Two-thirds represented the official payment; one-third covered miscellaneous expenses.

打成两张银票，
They obtained two bank drafts.

正项自己去缴，杂费托经手人转交，
Wang paid the official amount himself, while the intermediary delivered the other.

不过五天工夫，就把簇新的一张“部照”和称为“实收”的捐纳交银收据都拿到手了。
In only five days, Wang had both a new certificate from the Board and the official receipt for his contribution.


这件大事倒办好了，长行回南，却颇费周章。
The main business was settled, but arranging the long journey south proved troublesome.

急景调年，车船都不大愿意做此一笔买卖。
With the year almost over, carters and boatmen were reluctant to undertake it.

王有龄便又跟高升商议，
Wang consulted Gao again.

大事已妥，随时可走，也不争在这几天，
Now that everything important was done, they could leave whenever they wished; a few days made little difference.

不如过了“破五”再说。
Why not wait until after the fifth day of the New Year?

高升原是为主人打算，唯命是从，
Gao's only concern was his master's interests, and he accepted the decision.

当时使先订好了两辆大车，付了一半车价，约定开年初七、宜于长行的黄道吉日动身。
They booked two large carts, paid half the fare, and agreed to depart on the seventh day, an auspicious date for a long journey.


这时京里除了军机处，大小衙门，都已封印。
By then, every government office except the Grand Council had closed for the holiday.

满街都是匆匆忙忙的行人，有的忧容满面，四处告帮过年，有的提着灯笼，星夜讨债。
The streets were full of hurried figures: some wore anxious faces as they sought help to get through the New Year; others carried lanterns and pursued debts late into the night.

王有龄却是心定神闲，每天由高升领着，到各处去闲逛。
Wang, however, was at ease and went sightseeing with Gao every day.

他在京里也有些熟人，
He knew some people in the capital, but there were several reasons not to visit.

但一则年节下大家都忙，不便去打搅，
Everyone was busy with the holiday, and he did not wish to disturb them.

二则带的土仪不多，空手登门拜访，于礼不台，
He had few local gifts left, and arriving empty-handed would be discourteous.

三则是他自己觉得现在境况不佳，不如下见，
He also felt that his present circumstances were not impressive enough.

等将来得意了，欢然道故，才有人情酬醉之乐。
Better to wait until he had prospered; then recalling old times would bring the real pleasure of friendly hospitality.

因此，除了极少的一两家至亲，登门一揖以外，其余同乡亲友那里，一概下去。
Apart from brief calls on one or two close relatives, he visited none of his fellow provincials or other friends.


到了大年三十，会馆里的执事邀去过年，
On New Year's Eve, the guildhall stewards invited him to join their celebration.

吃完年夜饭，厅上拉开桌子，摇摊的摇摊，推牌九的推牌九，
After dinner, tables were set up in the hall for various forms of gambling, including the shaking of counters and games of pai gow.

王有龄不好此道，早早回到了西河沿客店。
Wang had no taste for these pursuits and returned early to his inn at Xiheyan.


高升是他事先放了他假的，不在客店。
He had already given Gao the evening off, so the servant was away.

伙计替他拨旺了炉人，沏了热茶，
An inn attendant stirred up the stove and made fresh tea.

枯坐无聊，又弄了酒来喝，无奈“独醉不成欢”，
Bored with sitting alone, Wang ordered some wine, but drinking by himself brought no cheer.

有心摘一朵野花，点缀佳节，想想自己已是“父母官”的身分，
He considered seeking a woman's company to enliven the festival, then remembered that he was now qualified to become a magistrate, a parent to the people.

怕让高升发觉了瞧不起。
He feared Gao would find out and think less of him.

“八大胡同”倒是近在咫尺，但“清吟小班”是有名的销金窝，
The Eight Great Lanes were close by, but their fashionable singing houses were notorious places to squander money.

这一年异遇甚多，保不定又逢一段奇缘，
After so many strange encounters that year, who knew whether another romance might await him?

那一下，五百年前的风流债还不情，岂不辜负了胡、何二人的盛情厚望？
If he became entangled in some endless debt of passion, would he not betray the generosity and hopes of both Hu and He?


在满街爆竹声中，王有龄一个人悄俏地睡下了，
Amid firecrackers sounding throughout the streets, Wang quietly went to bed alone.

却是怎么样也没有睡意。
Yet sleep would not come.


通前彻后，细思平生，有凄凉，也有欢欣，有感慨，却更多希望。
Looking back over his life, he found sadness and joy, much to reflect on, and still more to hope for.

他在想，不走何桂清那样的“正途”，已是输人一着，
By failing to take the regular examination route as He Guiqing had done, he had already fallen behind.

但也不能就此认输，
But that was no reason to admit defeat.

一个人总要能展其所长，
A man must develop his own strengths.

虽说书读得没有何桂清好，但从小跟在父亲身边，了解民生，熟悉吏治，以及吃苦耐劳，习于交接，
He might be less learned than He, yet he had grown up beside his father, observing people's livelihoods, becoming familiar with administration, learning to endure hardship, and dealing with all sorts of people.

却不是那班埋首窗下，不通世务的书生可比。
In these things, scholars buried in their books and ignorant of the world could not compare with him.

“世事洞明皆学问”，
“A thorough understanding of human affairs is itself learning.”

妄自匪薄，志气消沉，聪明才智也就灰塞萎缩了。
If he belittled himself and lost his ambition, his abilities would only wither.

于今逢到大好机会，又正当国家多事，明主求治之际，
Now a splendid opportunity had come, at a time when the country faced grave difficulties and an enlightened ruler sought effective government.

风尘俗吏的作为，亦未见得会比金马玉堂的学士逊色！
A practical official seasoned by the world might achieve as much as a scholar in the splendid halls of court.


转念到此，顿时浮起一片要做一番事业的雄心壮志。
These reflections stirred a powerful determination to accomplish something.

但以大器自期，觉得肚子里的货色还不够，不是同赋文章，而是于国计民生有关的学问。
Yet if he expected great things of himself, he needed more knowledge—not poetry and elegant essays, but learning relevant to the country's administration and the people's welfare.


因此年初一那天逛琉璃厂，别人买吃的、玩的，王有时象那些好书成癖的名士一样，只在书铺里坐。
Thus, when he visited Liulichang on New Year's Day, while others bought food and amusements, Wang remained in the bookshops like a scholar with a passion for collecting books.

王有龄此时的气度服饰，已非昔比，
His bearing and clothes were now very different from before.

掌柜的十分巴结，先拜了年，摆上果盘，然后请教姓氏、乡里、科名。
The proprietor was eager to please him: first New Year greetings, then a plate of fruit, and finally polite inquiries about his surname, home province, and examination achievements.


“敝姓王，
“My surname is Wang.

福建，
I'm from Fujian.

秋闹刚刚侥幸。”
I was fortunate enough to pass last autumn.”

王有龄的口气是自表新科举人，
He spoke as though he were a newly qualified provincial graduate.

好在“王”是大姓，便冒充了也不怕拆穿。
Wang was such a common surname that he felt safe from exposure.


“喔，喔”王老爷春风满面，本科一定‘联捷’。
“Ah, indeed! With good fortune shining in your face, Your Honour is certain to succeed again in the coming metropolitan examination.

预贺，预贺！“
My congratulations in advance!”


“ 谢谢。
“Thank you.

‘场中莫论文’，
In the examination hall, literary merit is no guarantee.

看运气罢了。”
We must leave it to luck.”


“王老爷说得好一口官话，
“Your Honour speaks excellent Mandarin.

想来随老太爷在外多年？”
You must have spent many years accompanying your father away from home.”


“是的。”
“Yes.”

王有龄心想，再盘问下去要露马脚了，
Further questions might expose him, Wang thought.

便即问道：“可有什么实用之学的好书？”
He promptly changed the subject. “Have you any good books on practical affairs?”


“怎么没有？”
“Certainly.”

那掌柜想了想，自己从书架子取了部新书来，
The proprietor considered, then took a new set of books from a shelf himself.

“这部书，不知王老爷有没有？”
“Does Your Honour already own this?”


一看是贺长龄的《皇朝经世文编》王有龄久闻其名，欣然答道：“我要一部。”
It was He Changling's Collected Essays on Statecraft under the Present Dynasty. Wang had long heard of it and replied with pleasure, “I'll take a set.”


“这部书实在好。
“An excellent work.

当今讲究实学，
Practical learning is much valued nowadays.

读熟了这部书，殿试策论一定出色。”
Master this book, and your policy essay in the palace examination is bound to be distinguished.”


“有没有‘洋务’上的书？”
“Have you any books on foreign affairs?”


“讲洋务，有部贵省林大人编的书，非看不可。”
“On that subject, there is a work compiled by His Excellency Lin of your own province that you must read.”


那是林则徐编的《四洲志》，王有龄也买了。
This was Lin Zexu's Account of the Four Continents, which Wang also bought.

书店掌柜看出王有龄所要的是些什么书，牵连不断，搬出一大堆来，
Understanding now what his customer wanted, the proprietor brought out one related work after another until a pile had accumulated.

一时也无暇细看内容，好在价钱多还公道，便来者不拒，捆载而旧。
There was no time to inspect them all closely, but the prices were generally fair, so Wang accepted them and had them bundled up to take back.


从这天起，王有龄就在客店里“闭户读书”，
From that day onward, he shut himself in his room to study.

把一部《皇朝经世文编》中，谈盐法、河务、漕运的文章，反复研读，一个字都不肯轻易放过。
He repeatedly read the essays on salt administration, river management, and grain transport in the Collected Essays on Statecraft, unwilling to pass lightly over a single word.

他对湖南安化陶文毅公陶澍的政绩，原就敬仰已久，
He had long admired the achievements of Tao Shu of Anhua, Hunan, posthumously honoured as Wenyi.

此时看了那些奏议、条陈，了解了改革盐法槽运的经过，越发向往。
Reading these memorials and proposals, and learning how the reforms of salt administration and grain transport had been carried out, deepened his admiration.

同时也有了一个心得，兴利不难，难于除弊！
He also reached a conclusion of his own: creating benefits was not the hardest task; removing abuses was.

“革路蓝缕，以启山林”，只要功夫用到了，自能生利，
To open up new ground through hardship, effort was enough to produce results.

但已生之种，为人侵渔把持，弊端丛生，
Once those benefits existed, however, people appropriated and controlled them until abuses multiplied.

要去消除，使成了侵害人的“权利”，自会遭遇到极大的反抗阻挠。
Removing the abuses then meant infringing what those people regarded as their rights, and fierce resistance was inevitable.

他看陶澍的整顿盐务，改革漕运，论办法也不过实事求是，期于允当，并没有什么了不得的地方，
Tao's methods themselves were not extraordinary. He had sought truth in the facts and aimed at workable, fair arrangements.

所可贵的是，他的除弊的决心与魄力。
What deserved admiration was his determination and courage in abolishing abuses.


这又归结到一个要点：权力。
This led to a further essential point: power.

王有龄在想：俗语说的“大丈夫不可一日无权”，话实在不错。不过这个道理要从反面来看。
The saying that a capable man cannot go a day without authority was true, Wang thought, but its meaning had to be considered from the other side.

有权在手，不能有所作为，庸庸碌碌，随波逐流，则虽未作恶，
A man who held power yet accomplished nothing, drifting along in mediocrity, might commit no direct wrongdoing.

其恶与小人相等，因为官场弊端，就是在此辈手中变得根深蒂固，积重难返的。
Still, his harm was no less than that of a villain, for it was through men like him that official abuses became deeply rooted and almost impossible to remove.


由于有用世之志，不得不留意时局，
His wish to serve the country compelled him to follow current events.

正好客店里到了一个湖北来的差官，就住在他间壁，
By chance, an official messenger from Hubei arrived at the inn and occupied the next room.

客中寂寞，携酒消夜，谈起两湖的情形，
Lonely away from home, they shared wine one evening and discussed Hunan and Hubei.

王有龄才知道洪杨军攻长沙不下，克宁乡、益阳，拥有了几千艘发船，出临资口，渡侗庭湖，占领岳州，
Wang learned that, after failing to take Changsha, the forces of Hong and Yang had captured Ningxiang and Yiyang, acquired several thousand boats, emerged at Linzikou, crossed Lake Dongting, and occupied Yuezhou.

乘胜东下，十一月陷汉阳，十二月里省城武昌也失守了！
Pressing eastward, they had taken Hanyang in the eleventh month and the provincial capital, Wuchang, in the twelfth.

巡抚常大淳、学政、藩司、臬司、提督、总兵，还有道员、知府、知县、同知，几乎全城文武，无不身亡。
Governor Chang Dachun, the education commissioner, the provincial treasurer, the judicial commissioner, the provincial military commander, the brigade commanders, and the circuit intendants, prefects, magistrates, and deputy prefects—almost all the city's civil and military officials had died.

说到悲惨之外，那差官把眼泪掉落在酒杯里。
At the most tragic passages of his account, the messenger's tears fell into his wine cup.


王有龄也为之惨然停杯。
Wang too set down his cup in sorrow.

常大淳由浙江巡抚调湖北，还不到一年，
Less than a year had passed since Chang Dachun's transfer from Zhejiang to Hubei.

他在杭州曾经见过，纯粹是个秉性仁柔的书生，
Wang had seen him in Hangzhou: a scholar of gentle and kindly temperament.

只因为在浙江巡抚往内平治过海盗，朝廷当他会用兵，调到湖北去阻遏洪杨军，
Because he had suppressed pirates while governing Zhejiang, the court had assumed that he understood warfare and sent him to Hubei to halt Hong and Yang's advance.

结果与城同亡，
He had died with the city.

说起来死得有点冤枉。
In a sense, his death was a grievous injustice.


但是，地方官守上有责，
Yet local officials were responsible for defending their territories.

而且朝廷已有旨意，派在籍大臣办理“团练”，以求自保，
The court had already ordered senior officials living in retirement to organise local militias for self-defence.

生逢乱世，哪里管得到文是文，武是武？
In a troubled age, who could insist that civil and military duties remain separate?

必须得有“上马杀贼，下马草露布”的本理，做官才能出人头地。
To distinguish himself in office, a man needed the ability to mount a horse and fight, then dismount and write the announcement of victory.

有了这层省悟，玉有龄又到琉璃厂去买了些《圣武记》之类谈征点方略、练兵筹饷的书，
Recognising this, Wang returned to Liulichang and bought works such as Records of Imperial Military Achievements, dealing with campaign strategy, troop training, and military finance.

预备利用旅途，好好看他一遍。
He intended to read them carefully on his journey.


依照约定的日子，正月初七一早，由陆路自京师动身，经长辛店一直南下，
On the appointed day, the seventh of the first month, he left the capital early by road, heading south through Changxindian.

出京除了由天津走海道以外，水陆两途在山东边境的德州文汇，
Apart from the sea route through Tianjin, the land and water routes out of the capital met at Dezhou on the Shandong border.

运河自京东来，过此偏向西南，经临清、东昌南下，
The canal approached from the east of the capital, then turned southwest through Linqing and Dongchang.

陆路自京西来，过此偏向东南，由平原、禹城、泰安、临沂，进入江苏省境，
The road came from the west and turned southeast through Pingyuan, Yucheng, Tai'an, and Linyi into Jiangsu.

到清江浦，水陆两途又文汇了。
At Qingjiangpu, the two routes met again.


王有龄陆路走了二十天，在整天颠簸的大车中，依旧于不释卷，
For twenty days on the road, Wang kept a book in his hands despite the cart's constant jolting.

到晚宿店，豆大油灯下还做笔记。
At night, in the inns, he continued taking notes beneath the tiny flame of an oil lamp.

就这样把《经世文编》、《圣武记》、《四洲志》都已看完。
In this way he finished the Collected Essays on Statecraft, Records of Imperial Military Achievements, and Account of the Four Continents.

有时车中默想，自觉内而漕、盐、兵事，外面夷情洋务，大致都已了然于胸。
Sometimes, reflecting in the cart, he felt that he now had a general grasp of grain transport, salt administration, and military affairs at home, as well as conditions abroad and relations with foreign countries.


他在路上早就打算好了。
He had already planned the next stage of his journey.

车子讲定到王家营子，
The carts were hired as far as Wangjiayingzi.

渡过黄河就是清江浦，由此再雇船沿运河直放杭州。
Across the Yellow River lay Qingjiangpu, where he would hire a boat to take him along the canal to Hangzhou.

为了印证所学，不妨趁此弃车换船的机会，在情江浦好好住几天。
To test his reading against reality, he might spend a few days there while changing from cart to boat.

这个以韩信而名闻天下的古淮阴，是南来水陆要冲的第一大码头，
This was ancient Huaiyin, famous as the home of Han Xin, and the foremost junction of land and water routes for travellers coming from the south.

江南河道总督专驻此地，
The governor-general of the southern river administration was stationed there.

河务、漕运、以及淮盐的运销，都以此此为枢纽，
River management, grain transport, and the distribution of Huai salt all centred upon the town.

能够实地考察一番，真个“胜读十年书”。
A firsthand investigation would truly be worth ten years of reading.


哪知来到王家营子，就听说太平军起兵，越发厉害。
But at Wangjiayingzi he heard that the Taiping advance was growing ever more alarming.

一到清江浦，立刻就能闻到一种风声鹤嗅的味道，
Upon reaching Qingjiangpu, he immediately sensed panic in the air.

车马络绎，负载着乱糟糟的家具杂物，
An endless stream of carts and horses carried disorderly loads of furniture and household goods.

衣冠不整，口音杂出的异乡人，不计其数，个个脸上有惊惶忧郁的神色，
Countless strangers in dishevelled clothes spoke in unfamiliar accents, every face anxious and distressed.

显而易见的，都是些从南而逃来的难民。
Plainly, they were refugees fleeing from the south.


“老爷！”高升悄悄说道，“大事不妙！
“Your Honour,” Gao said quietly, “things look bad.

我看客店怕都客满了。
I fear the inns will all be full.

带着行李去瞎闯，累赘得很。
Dragging the luggage from one to another would be a burden.

他老先在茶馆坐一坐，看好了行李，我找店，
Why don't you sit in a teahouse and watch it while I find us a room?

找妥当了再来请者爷过去。”
Once I've secured one, I'll come back for you.”


“好，好！”
“Very well.”

王有龄抬头一望，路南就是一家大茶馆，
Looking up, Wang saw a large teahouse on the south side of the street.

便说，“我就在这里等。”
“I'll wait here.”


到了茶馆，先把行李堆在一边，开发了挑侍，要找座头休息。
Inside, they stacked their luggage to one side and paid the porter, then looked for somewhere to sit.

举目四顾，乱哄哄一片，
The place was noisy and crowded.

只有当门之处一张直摆的长桌子空着。
Only a long table set lengthwise by the entrance was empty.

高升便走过去拂拂凳子上的尘土说道：“老爷请这里坐！”
Gao went over, dusted a bench, and said, “Please sit here, sir.”


他是北方人，没有在南方水路上走过，不懂其中的规矩。
He was a northerner who had never travelled the southern waterways and knew nothing of their customs.

王有龄却略微有些知道，
Wang knew a little.

那张桌子叫“马头桌子”，要漕帮里的“尤头”才有资格坐，
That was the “head table,” reserved for leaders of the grain-transport fraternity.

所以慌忙拉住高升：“这里坐不得！”
He hastily caught Gao's arm. “You can't sit there!”


“噢！”高升一愣。
“Oh!” Gao stopped in surprise.


王有龄此时无法跟他细说，同时茶博士也已赶了来招呼他与人拼桌。
There was no time for an explanation, and a tea attendant had already come to find Wang a place at another table.

高升见安顿好了，也就匆匆自去。
Once his master was settled, Gao hurried off.

王有龄喝着茶，便向同桌的人打听消息。
Over his tea, Wang asked his companions for news.


消息坏得很？
The news was dreadful.

自武昌失守，洪杨军有了大小船只一万多艘。
Since the fall of Wuchang, Hong and Yang's army had acquired more than ten thousand vessels of all sizes.

把金银财货，军械粮食，都装了上去，又用了几十万老百姓，沿着长江两岸，长驱而东。
They loaded them with gold, silver, other valuables, weapons, and provisions, and drove eastward along both banks of the Yangtze with hundreds of thousands of civilians.


就这样一直到了广济县的武穴镇，跟两江总督陆建瀛碰上了。
At Wuxue, a town in Guangji county, they encountered Lu Jianying, governor-general of Liangjiang.


湖北不归两江总督所管，
Hubei lay outside his jurisdiction.

陆建瀛是以钦差大臣的身分，出省迎敌。
He had entered the province as an imperial commissioner to meet the enemy.

绿营暮气沉沉，早已不能打仗，新招募的兵又没有多少，
The Green Standard troops were exhausted in spirit and had long since lost their ability to fight, while the newly recruited forces were few.

哪经得住洪杨军如山洪暴发般顺流直冲，以致节节败退。
They could not withstand Hong and Yang's men pouring downstream like a mountain torrent and fell back at every engagement.


这时洪杨军的水师，也由九江，过湖口、彭泽，到了安微省境。
Meanwhile, the rebels' fleet passed Jiujiang, Hukou, and Pengze and entered Anhui.

守小孤山的江苏按察使，弃防而逃，这一下省城安庆的门户洞开。
The judicial commissioner of Jiangsu, defending Xiaogushan, abandoned his position and fled, leaving the approach to Anqing, the provincial capital, wide open.

安徽巡抚蒋文庆只有两干多兵守城，
Governor Jiang Wenqing had only a little over two thousand men to defend the city.

陆建瀛兵败过境，不肯留守，直回江宁。
Lu Jianying passed through after his defeat but refused to remain and went straight back to Jiangning.

蒋文庆看看保不住，把库款、粮食、军人的一部分，侈运庐州，自己坚守危城。
Seeing little hope of holding out, Jiang transferred part of the treasury funds, provisions, and weapons to Luzhou, then stayed to defend the endangered city.

其时城里守卒已经溃散，
By then the garrison had already dispersed.

洪杨军轻而易举地破了城，蒋文庆被杀于抚署西辕门。
Hong and Yang's men took the city easily, and Jiang was killed at the western outer gate of the governor's compound.

这是十天前的事。
This had happened ten days earlier.


“十天前？”王有龄大惊问道：
“Ten days ago?” Wang exclaimed in alarm.

“那么现在‘长毛’到了什么地方了呢？”
“Where are the Long-Haired rebels now, then?”


“这可就不知道了。”那茶客摇摇头，愁容满面的，
“That I don't know.” His fellow customer shook his head, looking deeply troubled.

“芜湖大概总到了。
“They must have reached Wuhu.

说不定已到了江宁。“
Perhaps they're at Jiangning already.”


王有龄大惊失色！
Wang turned pale.

洪杨军用兵能如此神速？
Could the army have moved so fast?

他有点将信将疑。
He found it difficult to believe.

但稍为定一定心来想，亦无足奇，
But when he steadied himself and thought, it was not surprising.

这就是他在旅途中读了许多书的好处，
Here his reading on the journey served him well.

自古以来，长江以上游荆州为重镇，
Since ancient times, Jingzhou had been the strategic stronghold of the upper Yangtze.

上游一失，顺流东下，下游一定不保，
Once the upper reaches were lost, an enemy could sweep downstream, and the lower reaches could scarcely be held.

所以历史上南朝如定都金陵，必遣大将镇荆襄，保上游，
Thus, southern dynasties that made Jinling their capital always stationed able commanders in Jingzhou and Xiangyang to protect the upper river.

而荆襄有变，金陵就如俎上之肉，
If that region changed hands, Jinling was like meat on a chopping board.

此所以桓温在荆州，东晋君臣，寝食难安，而南唐李氏以上游早失，终于为宋太祖所平。
Hence the sleepless anxiety of the Eastern Jin court while Huan Wen controlled Jingzhou, and the eventual conquest of the Southern Tang by the founding Song emperor after its upper-river defences had been lost.


这一下，他对当前的形势得失，立刻便有了一个看法，
He immediately formed a judgement of the present situation.

朝中根本无知将略的人，
No one at court seemed to understand strategy.

置重兵于湖广、河南、防洪杨北上，却忽略了江南的空虚，
They had concentrated troops in Hunan, Hubei, and Henan to prevent the rebels from moving north, while overlooking the weakness of the lower Yangtze region.

这是把他们逼向东南财赋之区，
This had driven the enemy towards the southeast, the country's great source of revenue.

实在是极大的失策。
It was a grave mistake.


照这情形看，金陵迟早不保。
Jinling, it seemed, must fall sooner or later.

他想到何桂清，一颗心猛然往下一沉，
Thinking of He Guiqing, Wang's heart suddenly sank.

随即记起，问桂清不在金陵，
Then he remembered that He was not in Jinling.

抹一抹额上的汗，松口气失声自语：“还好，
Wiping the sweat from his forehead, he breathed out and murmured, “Thank goodness!

还好！”
Thank goodness!”


同桌的茶客抬起忧郁的双眼望着他，
His companions looked up at him with troubled eyes.

他才发觉自己的失态，便陪着笑说，
Realising that he had behaved oddly, he offered an apologetic smile.

“我想起一个好朋友，
“I was thinking of a good friend.

他……”王有龄忽然问道：“请问，学台衙门，可是在江阴？”
He...” Suddenly he asked, “Isn't the education commissioner's office at Jiangyin?”


“我倒不大清楚。”那人答道：
“I'm not sure,” the man replied.

“江苏的大官儿最多，真搞不清什么衙门在什么地方？”
“Jiangsu has so many high officials that I can never remember which office is where.”


“怎么搞不清。”邻桌上有人答话，
“How can you not know?” someone at the next table interjected.

“不错，江苏的大官最多，不过衙门都在好地方。”
“Jiangsu certainly has the most high officials, but all their offices are in fine places.”

他屈着手指数道：“从情江浦开始数好了，
He counted them on his fingers. “Start with Qingjiangpu.

南河总督驻清江浦，漕运总督驻淮安，
The southern river governor-general is here; the director-general of grain transport is at Huai'an.

两江总督、驻防将军、江宁藩司驻江宁，
The governor-general of Liangjiang, the garrison general, and the Jiangning provincial treasurer are at Jiangning.

江苏巡抚、江苏藩司驻苏州，学政驻江阴，两淮盐政驻扬州。”
The governor and provincial treasurer of Jiangsu are at Suzhou; the education commissioner is at Jiangyin; and the Lianghuai salt commissioner is at Yangzhou.”


果然是在江阴。
So Jiangyin it was.

王有龄心里在盘算，
Wang began planning.

由运河到了扬州，不妨沿江东去，到江阴看一看何桂清，然后再经无锡、苏州、嘉兴回杭州，
Once he reached Yangzhou by canal, he could travel east along the river to visit He Guiqing, then return to Hangzhou by way of Wuxi, Suzhou, and Jiaxing.

也还不迟。
There would still be time.


刚刚盘算停当，高升气喘吁吁地寻了来了，
He had just settled the plan when Gao returned, out of breath.

他好不容易才觅着一间房，
After great difficulty, he had found a room.

虽丢了定钱在那里，去迟了保不定又为他人所得，
Though he had left a deposit, someone else might take it if they delayed.

兵荒马乱，无处讲理，所以催着主人快走。
In the confusion of war there would be no one to whom they could appeal, so he urged his master to hurry.


于是王有龄起身付了茶钱，主仆两人走出店来，
Wang paid for the tea, and they went outside.

拦着一名挑伕，把笨重箱笼挑了一担。
They stopped a porter to carry the heavy trunks and cases on a shoulder pole.

高升背了铺盖卷，其余帽笼之类的轻便什物，便由王有龄亲手拿着，
Gao took the bedding roll on his back, while Wang himself carried the lighter things, including the hat case.

急匆匆赶到客店。
They hurried to the inn.

是一间极狭窄的小屋，而且靠近厨房，抽烟弥漫，
The room was tiny and stood beside the kitchen, where cooking smoke filled the air.

根本不宜作为客房。
It was hardly fit for a guest.

可是看到街上那些扶老携幼，彷惶不知何处可以容身的难民，王有龄便觉得这问小屋简直就是天堂了。
Yet when Wang thought of the refugees outside, supporting the old and leading children, not knowing where they could shelter, this little room seemed positively heavenly.


“你呢？”他关切地问高升，
“What about you?” he asked Gao with concern.

“也得找个铺才好。”
“You need somewhere to sleep too.”


“我就在老爷床前打地铺。
“I'll spread my bedding on the floor beside your bed.

反正雇好了船就走，
We'll leave as soon as we've hired a boat.

也不过天把的事。”
It'll only be a day or so.”


“高升！我想绕到江阴去看一看何大人。”王有龄把他的打算说了出来。
“Gao Sheng, I'd like to make a detour to Jiangyin to see His Excellency He.” Wang explained his plan.


“这个……”高升迟疑地答道：
“Well...” Gao hesitated.

“我劝老爷还是一直回杭州的好，
“I would advise going straight back to Hangzhou.

一则要早早禀到，
For one thing, you should report your arrival as soon as possible.

二则多换两次船，在平常不费事，这几天可是很大的麻烦。
For another, changing boats twice more would be easy enough in ordinary times, but it could be very troublesome now.

老爷，消息很不好，
The news is bad, sir.

万一路断了，怎么办？“
What if the route is cut off?”


高升的见识着实不低，
Gao's judgement was sound.

分发浙江的候补州县，如果归路中断，逗留在江苏，那是一辈子都补不到缺的，
An expectant magistrate assigned to Zhejiang could wait for ever without obtaining a post if he became stranded in Jiangsu.

所以王有龄一听他的放，翻然变计，
Wang changed his mind at once.

当夜商量定规，尽快雇船赶回浙江。
That evening they agreed to hire a boat and reach Zhejiang as quickly as possible.


第二天早晨一看，难民已到了许多，同时也有了确实消息，
By the next morning, many more refugees had arrived, along with definite news.

芜湖已经失守，官军水师大败，福山镇总兵阵亡，
Wuhu had fallen, the government fleet had suffered a crushing defeat, and the brigade commander of Fushan had been killed.

洪杨军正分水陆三路，进薄江宁。
Hong and Yang's forces were advancing on Jiangning in three columns by land and water.

江南的老百姓，一二百年未经兵革，恐慌万状，
The people of the lower Yangtze region, who had known no warfare for a century or two, were panic-stricken.

因而雇船也不容易，
Hiring a boat was difficult.

南面战火弥漫，船家既怕送人虎口，又怕官府抓差扣船，
With war spreading through the south, boatmen feared both taking their passengers into danger and having their vessels requisitioned by the authorities.

不管哪一样，反正遇上了就要大倒其霉。
Either could mean disaster.


奔走了一天，总算有了结果，
After a day's searching, they finally found a solution.

有一批浙江的漕船回空，可以附搭便客，论人计价，每人二十两银子，
Some Zhejiang grain boats were returning empty and could take passengers, at twenty taels a head.

这比平时贵了十倍不止，
This was more than ten times the usual fare.

事急无奈，王有龄惟有忍痛点头。
With no alternative in such urgency, Wang reluctantly agreed.


但也亏得是坐漕船，一路上“讨关”、“过坝”可得许多方便。
Still, travelling on a grain boat brought advantages at checkpoints and dams.

风向也顺，船行极快，
The wind was favourable, and they made rapid progress.

到了扬州，听说江宁已经被围，
At Yangzhou they heard that Jiangning was under siege.

城外有七八十万头裹红中的太平军，城里只有四千旗兵，一千绿营兵，
Outside its walls stood seven or eight hundred thousand Taiping soldiers with red cloths wrapped around their heads; inside were only four thousand banner troops and a thousand Green Standard soldiers.

不过明太祖兴建的江宁城，坚固有名，一时不易攻下。
The walls built by the founding Ming emperor were famously strong, however, and would not be easily breached.


如果真的有七八十万人，洪杨军能不能攻下江宁，无关大局。王有龄心里在想，
If the attackers really numbered seven or eight hundred thousand, Wang thought, whether they took Jiangning immediately was almost beside the point.

他们的兵力足够，分兵两路，一去往东，径取苏常，一支渡江而北，经营中原，
They had enough men to divide their forces: one army could advance east and seize Suzhou and Changzhou, while another crossed north of the river to establish itself on the Central Plain.

这一来江宁成了孤城，不战自下。
Jiangning would then become an isolated city and fall without a battle.

由于这个想法，王有龄对大局相当悲观，
The thought made him pessimistic about the wider situation.

中宵不寐，听着运河的水声，心潮起伏，不知如何才能挽救江南的劫运？
Lying awake at midnight, listening to the canal water, he turned over the question of how the lower Yangtze region might be saved from disaster.


就这样忧心忡仲地到了杭州。
In this troubled state of mind, he reached Hangzhou.

一上岸第一个想别的不是家，是胡雪岩，
His first thought on landing was not of home but of Hu Xueyan.

但自然没有行装未卸，便上茶馆里去寻他的道理。
Yet naturally he could not go searching the teahouses before even putting down his luggage.

而一到了家，却又有许多事要料理，
Once home, he found many things to arrange.

当务之急是寻房子搬家。
Most urgent was a move to a larger house.

原来的住处过于狭隘，且莫说排场气派，首先高升就没有地方住，
Their existing quarters were cramped; quite apart from appearances, there was nowhere for Gao to stay.

所以他在家只得坐一坐，喝了杯茶，随即带着高升去寻房屋经纪。
Wang therefore sat only long enough to drink a cup of tea before taking Gao out to find a property agent.


买卖房屋的经纪人，杭州叫做“瓦摇头”，
In Hangzhou, property brokers were nicknamed “tile-shakers.”

他们有日常聚会的地方，在一家茶馆，
They gathered daily at a particular teahouse.

各行各业都有一家茶馆作为买卖联络的集中之处。称为“茶会”。
Each trade had such a place where business contacts were made, known as its “tea meeting.”


到了茶会上，那些连“瓦”见了他们都“摇头”的经纪人，一看王有龄的服饰气派，还带着底下人，都以为是大主顾来了，
When Wang arrived, the brokers—men who supposedly made even roof tiles shake their heads—took one look at his clothes, bearing, and attendant and assumed that an important customer had appeared.

纷纷上来兜搭，问他是要买呢，还是“典”？
They crowded round to ask whether he wished to buy a house or take possession of one under a mortgage arrangement.


“我既不买，也不典。
“Neither.

想租一宅房子。而且要快，
I want to rent a house, and quickly.

最好今天就能搬进去。”
Ideally, I should like to move in today.”


“这哪里来？”大家都有些失望地笑了。
“Where would you find that?” they laughed, somewhat disappointed.


“我有。”有个人说。
“I have one,” a man said.


于是王有龄只与此人谈交易，
Wang turned to negotiate with him alone.

问了房子的格局，大小恰如所砍，再问租金，也还不贵，
The layout sounded exactly right, and the rent was reasonable.

“那就去看一看再说。”王有龄这样表示，
“Then let's go and look,” Wang said.

“看定了立刻成约，当日起租。
“If it suits me, we'll make the agreement at once and the tenancy can begin today.

我做事喜欢痛快，
I like things straightforward.

疙里疙瘩的房子我可不要。”
I don't want a house with complications attached.”


听你老人家是福建口音夹杭州口音，想必也吃了好几年西湖水，
“From your accent, I'd say you're from Fujian but have lived in Hangzhou for some years.

难道还不知道‘杭铁头’说一下二？“
Surely you know that we stubborn Hangzhou men stand by our word?”


那房子在清和坊，这一带杭州称为“上城”，
The house was in Qinghefang, in the district Hangzhou called the Upper City.

从南宋以来，就是一城精华所在，
Since the Southern Song, this had been the heart of the town.

离佑圣观巷的抚台衙门和藩司前的藩台衙门都不远，“上院”方便，
It was close to both the governor's office in Youshengguan Lane and the provincial treasury, making official visits convenient.

先就中王有龄的意。
That alone pleased Wang.

再看房子，五开间的正屋，一共两进，左右厢房，前面轿厅，后面还有一片竹林，盖着个小小的亭子，
The house itself had a main building five bays wide, two successive courtyards, side wings, a sedan-chair hall at the front, and a small pavilion in a bamboo grove behind.

虽不富丽，也下寒酸，正台王有龄现在的身分。
Neither luxurious nor shabby, it suited his present standing perfectly.


看到他的脸色，“瓦摇头”便说：“王老爷鸿运高照！
Reading his expression, the broker said, “Your Honour's luck is certainly flourishing.

原住的张老爷调升山西，
The previous tenant, Mr Zhang, was promoted and transferred to Shanxi.

昨天刚刚动身。
He left only yesterday.

这么好的房子，一天都不会空，就不定明天就租了出去，
A house like this won't stay empty even a day; it might be let tomorrow.

偏偏王老爷就是今天来看，
And you happen to come today.

真正巧极了！”
What a fortunate coincidence!”


“是啊，巧得很！”
“Yes, very fortunate!”

王有龄也觉得事事顺遂，
Wang too felt that everything was going his way.

十分高兴，“你马上去找房东，
Delighted, he said, “Find the landlord immediately.

此刻就订约起租。”
We'll sign the agreement and begin the tenancy now.”


“老爷！”高升插嘴问道：“哪一天搬进来？”
“When shall we move in, sir?” Gao asked.


“拣日不如撞日，
“No day is better than the day at hand.

今天就搬，万一来不及就是明天。”
Today, if we can; otherwise tomorrow.”


这一天是无论如何来不及了，但也有许多事要做，
Moving that day proved impossible, but there was plenty to do.

第一步先雇人来打扫房子，第二步要买动用家具，
First, men had to be hired to clean the house; then furniture and household necessities had to be bought.

为了不愿意露出暴发户的味道，王有龄特地买了半旧的红木桌椅，
Wishing to avoid the air of a man suddenly come into money, Wang deliberately chose used mahogany tables and chairs.

加上原有的一套，从云南带来的大理石的茶几、椅子，铺陈开来，显得很够气派。
Together with his existing set of marble tables and chairs brought from Yunnan, they made an impressive display.


真个“有钱好办事”，
Money did indeed make things easy.

搬到新居，不过两天工夫，诸事妥贴，厨房里厨子，上房里丫头、老妈，门房里坐着四个轿班，轿厅里停一顶簇新的蓝呢轿子。
Within two days of the move, everything was arranged: a cook in the kitchen, maids and an older woman in the private rooms, four chair-bearers waiting in the gatehouse, and a brand-new blue-cloth sedan chair in the front hall.

高升便是他的大管家。
Gao had become his chief steward.


这就该去寻胡雪岩了。
It was time to look for Hu Xueyan.

王有龄觉得现在身分虽与前不同，但不可炫濯于患难之交，
Though his position had changed, Wang felt he must not flaunt it before a friend who had stood by him in poverty.

所以这天早晨，穿了件半旧棉袍，也不带底下人，安步当车，踱到了以前每日必到的那家茶馆。
One morning he put on a worn padded robe, took no servant, and walked to the teahouse he had once visited every day.

自然遇到很多熟人，却独独不见胡雪岩。
He met many familiar faces there, but not Hu.


“小胡呢？”他问茶博士。
“Where's Young Hu?” he asked the tea attendant.


“好久没有来了。”
“He hasn't been here for a long time.”


“咦！”王有龄心里有些着急，
“Why?” Wang grew anxious.

“怎么回事？
“What's happened?

到哪里去了？”
Where has he gone?”


“不晓得。”茶博士摇摇头，
“No idea.” The attendant shook his head.

“这个人神出鬼没，
“He comes and goes like a spirit.

哪个也弄不清楚他的事。”
Nobody really knows his affairs.”


“这样……”王有龄要了张包茶叶的纸，借支笔写了自己的地址，
“Well, then...” Wang asked for a piece of tea-wrapping paper, borrowed a brush, and wrote down his address.

交给茶博士，郑重嘱咐：“如果遇见小胡，千万请他到我这里来。”
Handing it over, he said earnestly, “If you see him, please be sure to ask him to come to me.”


走出茶馆，想想不放心，
After leaving, he remained uneasy.

怕茶博士把他的话置诸脑后，特为又回进去，取块两把重的碎银子，塞到茶博士千里。
Afraid that the attendant might forget, he went back and pressed a piece of broken silver weighing about two taels into the man's hand.


“咦！咦！
“Oh!

为啥？”
What's this for?”


“我送你的。
“It's for you.

你替我寻一寻小胡，寻着了我再谢你。”
Help me find Young Hu, and I'll thank you again when you do.”


那茶博士有些发愣，
The attendant was astonished.

心想这姓王的，以前一壶茶要冲上十七八回开水，中午两个烧饼当顿饭，
This Mr Wang had once asked for his tea to be topped up seventeen or eighteen times and made a midday meal of two flatbreads.

如今随便出手就是两把银子，
Now he casually handed over two taels of silver.

想来发了财了！
He must have made money.

可是看看他的服饰又不象怎么有钱，
Yet his clothes did not suggest much wealth.

居然为了寻小胡，不惜整两银子送人，其中必有道理。
There had to be some reason why he was willing to spend two whole taels merely to find Young Hu.


“这，这……真不好意思了。”
“Well, I... this is too generous.”

茶博士问道，“不过我要请教你老人家，为啥寻小胡？”
The attendant asked, “But may I know why you're looking for him, sir?”


“要好朋友嘛！”王有龄笑笑不说下去了。
“He's a good friend.” Wang smiled and said no more.


作了这番安排，他怅惘的心情略减，
Having made these arrangements, he felt less disappointed.

相信那茶博士一天到晚与三教九流的人打交谊，眼皮宽，人头熟，
The attendant dealt all day with people from every walk of life and had a wide circle of acquaintances.

只要肯留心访查，一定可以把小胡寻着。
If he made a real effort, he would surely find Hu.

只怕小胡来访，不易找到地址，
Wang's remaining fear was that Hu might have difficulty finding the house.

所以一回家便叫人去买了一张梅红笺，大书“闽候王有龄寓”六字，贴在门上。
As soon as he returned, he sent for a sheet of plum-red paper, wrote “Residence of Wang Youling of Minhou” in large characters, and had it pasted on the gate.


这就要预备禀到、投信了。
He now had to prepare to report his arrival and deliver his letter.

未上藩署以前，他先要到按察使衙门去看一个朋友。
Before visiting the provincial treasury, he wished to see a friend at the judicial commissioner's office.

按察使通称桌司，尊称力桌台，掌管一省的刑名。
The provincial judicial commissioner, commonly called the niesi and respectfully the nietai, supervised criminal justice throughout the province.

王有龄的那个朋友就是臬司衙门的“刑名师爷”，姓俞，绍兴人。
Wang's friend, a man surnamed Yu from Shaoxing, was the office's legal adviser.

“绍兴师爷”遍布十八行省、大小衙门，所以有句“无绍不成衙”的俗语，
Shaoxing secretaries worked in government offices great and small throughout the eighteen provinces, giving rise to the saying, “No Shaoxing men, no government office.”

尤其是州县官，一成了缺，第一件大事就是延聘“刑名”、“钱谷”两幕友，
For a local magistrate in particular, the first task on receiving a post was to engage advisers for criminal justice and revenue.

请到了好手，才能一帆顺风，名利双收。
With capable men in both positions, his administration could run smoothly and bring him reputation and wealth.


王有龄的这个朋友，就是刑名好手，
Wang's friend was an outstanding legal adviser.

不但一部《大清律》倒背如流，肚子里还藏着无数的案例。
He knew the Great Qing Code backwards and carried countless precedents in his head.

向来刑名案子，有律讲律，无律讲例，
In criminal cases, one applied the statute where there was one and relied on precedent where there was none.

只要有例可援，定漱的文卷，报到刑部都不会被驳。
With a precedent to support the decision, the case papers sent to the Board of Punishments would not be rejected.

江浙桌台衙门的“俞师爷”，就是连刑部司官都知道其人的，
“Secretary Yu” of the provincial judicial offices in Jiangsu and Zhejiang was known even to officials at that Board.

等闲不会驳他经办的案子，
They rarely questioned cases he had handled.

所以历任臬司都要卑词厚币，挽留他“帮忙”。
Successive judicial commissioners therefore retained him with flattering words and generous pay.


俞师爷的叔叔曾在福建“游幕”，与王有龄也是总角之交，但平日不甚往来。
Yu's uncle had served on private official staffs in Fujian, and Yu and Wang had known each other since childhood, though they seldom met.

这天见他登门相访，料知“无事不登三宝殿”，便率直问道：“雪轩兄，何事见教？”
Seeing Wang arrive that day, Yu assumed he had come for a reason and asked directly, “Brother Xuexuan, what brings you here?”


“有两件事想跟老兄来请教。”王有龄说，
“There are two matters on which I'd like your advice,” Wang replied.

“你知道的，我本来捐了个盐大使，
“You know I had purchased qualification as a salt-station superintendent.

去年到京里走了一趟，过了班，分发本省。”
Last year I went to the capital, changed categories, and obtained assignment to this province.”


盐大使“过班”，自然是州县班子，
For a salt-station superintendent, changing categories naturally meant qualifying for a local magistracy.

俞师爷原来也捐了个八品官儿，好为祖宗三代请“诰封”，
Yu himself had purchased an eighth-rank title so that he could secure imperial honours for three generations of his ancestors.

这时见王有龄官比自己大了，便慢吞吞地拉长了绍兴腔说。“恭喜，恭喜！
Now that Wang outranked him, he drawled in his Shaoxing accent, “Congratulations!

我要喊你‘大人’了。”
I shall have to call you ‘Your Excellency.’”


“老朋友何苦取笑。”
“Why tease an old friend?

王有龄问道：“我请问，椿藩台那件案子现在怎么了？”
Tell me, what's happening with Provincial Treasurer Chunshou's case?”


“你也晓得这件案子！”俞师爷又间一句：
“So you know about that affair too!” Yu asked another question.

“你可知道黄抚台的来头？”
“Do you know who stands behind Governor Huang?”


“略略知道些。
“A little.

他的同年，在朝里势力大得很。”
His examination classmates are very powerful at court.”


“那就是了，
“Exactly.

何必再问？”
Why ask any more?”


“不过我听说京里派了钦差来查。
“But I heard that an imperial commissioner had been sent to investigate.

可有这事？”
Is that true?”


“查不查都是一样。”俞师爷说，
“It makes no difference whether there's an investigation,” Yu said.

“就是查，也是自己人来查。”
“If there is one, it'll be conducted by one of their own.”


听这口意，王有龄明白他意何所指？
Wang understood the implication.

自己不愿把跟何桂清的关系说破，那就无法深谈了。
He did not wish to reveal his connection with He Guiqing, so he could not pursue the discussion openly.

但有一点必须打听一下：“那么，那个‘自己人’到杭州来过没有？”
But there was one thing he needed to know. “Has this person of their own been to Hangzhou yet?”


“咦！”俞师爷极注意地看着他，
“Oh!” Yu looked at him closely.

“雪轩兄，你知道得不少啊！”
“You seem to know quite a lot, Brother Xuexuan.”


“哪里。
“Not at all.

原是特意来请教。”
That's why I've come to ask you.”


俞师爷沉吟了一会放低声音说：“既是老朋友，你来问我，我不能不说，
After a moment's thought, Yu lowered his voice. “Since we're old friends and you've asked, I cannot refuse to answer.

不过这一案关系抚台的前程，
But the governor's future depends on this case.

话不好乱传，得罪了抚台犯不着。
One mustn't spread stories carelessly; offending him would gain nothing.

你问的话如果与你无关，最好不必去管这闲事，
If the matter does not concern you, it's best to leave it alone.

是为明哲保身之道。”
That's the sensible way to keep yourself safe.”


听俞师爷这么说，王有龄不能没有一个确实的回答，
Wang now had to give a definite explanation.

但要“为贤者讳”，不肯直道他与何桂清的关系，
Wishing to protect the reputation of a man he respected, however, he would not state his relationship with He plainly.

只说，托人求了何桂情的一封“八行”，不知道黄宗汉会不会买帐？
He merely said that he had obtained a letter from He through an intermediary and did not know whether Huang would honour it.


“原来如此！
“So that's it!

恭喜，恭喜，
Congratulations!

一定买帐。”
He certainly will.”


“何以见得？”
“How can you be sure?”


“老实告诉你！”俞师爷说：
“I'll tell you frankly.

“何学台已经来过了。
Education Commissioner He has already been here.

隔省的学政，无缘无故怎么跑到浙江来？
Why should an education commissioner from another province suddenly come to Zhejiang?

怕引起外头的猜嫌，于黄抚台的官声不利，所以行踪极其隐秘。
His visit might arouse suspicion and harm Governor Huang's reputation, so his movements were kept extremely secret.

好在他是奉旨密查，这么做也不算不对。
Fortunately, his orders were to investigate secretly, so that was not in itself improper.

你想，何学台如此回护他的老同年，黄抚台对他的‘八行’，岂有不买帐之礼？”
Think of it: if He has gone to such lengths to protect his old examination classmate, how could Huang fail to honour a letter from him?”


“啊！”王有龄不由得笑了，
“Ah!” Wang could not help smiling.

他一直有些患得患夫之心，怕伺、黄二人的交情，并不如何往清自己所说的那么深厚，
He had been anxious, afraid that the friendship was less close than He himself claimed.

现在从旁人口中说出来，可以深信不疑了。
Now that someone else had confirmed it, he could believe it without reservation.


“再告诉你句话：
“Let me tell you something else,” Yu continued.

黄抚台奉旨查问，奏复上去，说椿寿‘因库款不敷，漕务棘手，致肝疾举发，因而自尽，并无别情’。
“When ordered to investigate, Huang reported that Chunshou, ‘distressed by the shortage of treasury funds and the difficulties of grain transport, suffered an attack of liver disease and consequently took his own life; there were no other circumstances.’

这‘并无别情’四个字，岂是随便说得的？
Can a man write those last words lightly?

只要有了‘别情’，不问‘别情’为何，皆是‘欺罔’的大罪，
If there were any other circumstances, whatever they might be, he would be guilty of deceiving the throne.

不杀头也得坐牢，
If he escaped execution, he would still go to prison.

全靠何学台替他隐瞒，
He is relying entirely on Commissioner He to conceal the truth.

你想想看，这是替他担了多大的干系？“
Just consider how much responsibility He has assumed on his behalf.”


一听这活，王有龄倒有些替何桂清担心，
This made Wang anxious for He Guiqing.

因为帮着隐瞒，便是同犯“欺罔”之罪，
Helping to conceal the truth meant sharing the guilt of deceiving the emperor.

一里事发，也是件不得了的事。
If the affair came to light, the consequences would be disastrous.


俞师爷再厉害，也猜不到他这一桩心事，
For all his shrewdness, Yu could not guess this concern.

只是为老朋友高兴，拍着他的肩说，“你快上院投信去吧！
He was simply pleased for his old friend and patted him on the shoulder. “Go and deliver the letter at once.

包你不到十天，藩司就会‘挂牌’放缺。
I guarantee the provincial treasury will post your appointment within ten days.

到那时候，我好好荐个同乡给你办刑名。”
When that happens, I'll recommend a good fellow from my home district to handle your legal work.”


“对了！”王有龄急忙拱手称谢，
“Exactly!” Wang hurriedly clasped his hands in thanks.

“这件事非仰仗老兄不可，
“I shall have to rely on you for that.

刑、钱两友，都要请老兄替我物色。”
Please find me both a legal and a revenue adviser.”


“有，有！
“Certainly.

都在我身上。
Leave it all to me.

快办正事去吧！”
Now go and attend to your business.”


于是王有龄当天就上藩署禀到，递上手本，封了四两银子的“门包”。
That same day, Wang reported to the provincial treasury, submitting his visiting card with four taels of silver wrapped as a gratuity for the gatekeepers.


候补州县无其数，
Expectant magistrates were innumerable.

除非有大来头，藩司不会单独接见，
Unless a man had powerful backing, the provincial treasurer would not receive him individually.

王有龄也知道这个规矩，不过因为照道理必应有此一举，
Wang knew this rule, but propriety required him to make the attempt.

所以听得门上从里面回出来，说声：“上头身子不舒服，改日请王老爷来谈。”随即道了劳，转身而去。
When the gatekeeper returned with the message, “His Excellency is unwell and will invite you to call another day,” Wang thanked him for his trouble and left.


蓝呢轿子由藩同前抬到佑对观巷抚台衙门，
His blue-cloth chair carried him from the treasury to the governor's office in Youshengguan Lane.

轿班一看照墙下停了好几顶绿呢大轿，不敢乱闯，远远地就停了下来，
Seeing several large green-cloth chairs beside the screen wall, the bearers dared not approach and stopped some distance away.

工有龄下了轿，跟高升交换了一个眼色，一前一后，走入大门。
Wang got out, exchanged a glance with Gao, and entered ahead of him.

抚台衙门的门上，架子特别大，
The governor's gatekeepers were particularly high-handed.

一看王有龄的“顶戴”，例知是个候补州县，
One look at Wang's hat insignia told them he was an expectant magistrate.

所以等高升从拜匣里拿出手本递去，连正眼郁不着他，喊一声，“小八子，
When Gao took his card from its case and offered it, a gatekeeper did not even look properly at him, but called, “Little Eight!

登门簿！”
Enter him in the callers' register!”


那个被呼为“小八子”的，是个眉清目秀的少年，但架子也下小，
The youth addressed as Little Eight had delicate features but no shortage of arrogance.

向高升说道，“把手本拿过来！”
“Bring the card here,” he told Gao.


在藩台衙门，手本辽往里递一递，
At the treasury, at least the card had been taken inside.

在这里连手本都是白费，
Here, even submitting it seemed pointless.

好在高升是见过世面的，
Gao, however, knew the world.

不慌不忙摸出个门包；递了给门上，
Calmly he produced a gratuity and handed it to the gatekeeper.

他接在手里掂了掂，脸色略略好看了些，问一句：“贵上尊姓？”
The man weighed it in his hand, looked slightly less forbidding, and asked, “Your master's surname?”


“敝上姓王！”高升把何桂清的信取出来：
“Wang.” Gao took out He Guiqing's letter.

“有封信，
“There is also a letter.

拜托递一递。”
Would you be so good as to deliver it?”


看在门包的分上，那门上似乎万般无奈地说：“好了，好了，
In consideration of the gratuity, the gatekeeper replied as though yielding reluctantly, “Very well, very well.

替你去跑一趟。”
I'll take it in for you.”


他懒洋洋地地站起身，顺手抓了顶红缨帽戴在头上，一直往里走去。
He rose languidly, picked up a red-tasselled hat, put it on, and went inside.

抚台衙门地方甚大，光是中间那条甬道就要走好半天，
The governor's compound was extensive; the central passage alone took a considerable time to traverse.

王有龄便耐心等着。
Wang waited patiently.

但这一等的时间实在太久了，不但他们主仆忐忑不安，连门房里的人也都诧异：
Yet the delay became so long that not only master and servant grew uneasy; even the men in the gatehouse were puzzled.

“怎么回事，
“What's happened?

刘二爷进去了这半天还不出来？”
Second Master Liu has been in there ages.”


“也许上头有别的事交代。”
“Perhaps His Excellency has other instructions for him.”


这是个合理的猜测，王有龄听在耳朵里，凉了半截，
That was a reasonable guess, but it chilled Wang's hopes.

黄宗汉根本就不理何桂清的信，更没有把自己放在眼里！
Huang must have ignored He's letter and attached no importance to him.

否则决不会把等候谒见的人，轻搁在一边，管自己去交代别的事。
Otherwise, why leave a man awaiting an audience while giving instructions about something else?


“刘二爷出来了！”高升悄悄说道。
“Second Master Liu is coming out,” Gao said quietly.


王有龄抬眼一望，便觉异样，
Wang looked up and noticed the change at once.

刘二已泅不似刚迸去时的那种一步懒似一步的神情，
Liu no longer moved with his earlier indolence.

如今是脚步匆速，而且双眼望着自己这面，仿佛有什么紧要消息急于来通知似地。
He was hurrying, his eyes fixed in their direction, as though eager to communicate important news.


这一下，他也精神一振，
Wang's spirits rose.

且迎着刘二，只见他奔到面前，先请了个安，含笑说道：“王大老爷！
He turned towards Liu, who came straight to him, made a respectful salute, and smiled. “Your Honour Wang!

请门房里坐。”
Please come and sit in the gatehouse.”


何前倔而后恭？
Why this change from arrogance to deference?

除掉王有龄主仆，门房里的，还有一直在那里的闲人，无不投以惊异的神色，
Apart from Wang and Gao, everyone in the gatehouse and all the idlers nearby looked astonished.

有些就慢慢地跟了过来，想打听一下，这位戴“水晶顶子”的七品官儿，是何来历？
Some drifted closer, hoping to learn who this seventh-rank official with a crystal hat button might be.

连抚台衙门赫赫有名的刘二爷都对他这样客气？
Even the governor's celebrated Second Master Liu was treating him with extraordinary courtesy.


等进了门房，刘二奉他上坐，倒上茶来，亲手捧过去，
Inside, Liu gave Wang the best seat, poured tea, and presented it himself.

一面间道：“王大老爷公馆在哪里？”
“Where is Your Honour's residence?” he asked.


“在清和坊。”
“In Qinghefang.”

王有龄说了地址，刘二叫人记了下来。
Wang supplied the address, and Liu had someone write it down.


“是这样，”他说，
“This is the situation,” he said.

“上头交代，说手本暂时留下，
“His Excellency asks to keep your card for now.

此刻司道都在，请王大老爷进去，只怕没有工夫细谈。
The commissioners and intendants are with him at present, and if he invited you in, he fears there would be no time for a proper conversation.

今天晚上请王大老爷过来吃个便饭，
He would like you to dine here this evening.

也不必穿公服。
There is no need for formal dress.

回头另外送帖子到公馆里去！”
An invitation will be sent to your residence shortly.”


“喔，喔！”王有龄从容答道，“抚台太客气了！”
“Oh, indeed.” Wang answered composedly, “The governor is most kind.”


“上头又说，王大老爷是同乡世交，不便照一般的规矩接见。
“He also said that you are a fellow provincial and an old family connection, and should not be received by the ordinary rules.

晚上请早些过来，
Please come early this evening.

我在这里伺候，
I shall be here.

请贵管家找刘二接贴就是了。”
Your steward need only ask for Liu Er.”


高升这时正站在门外，
Gao was standing outside the door.

听他这一说，便悄悄走了进去，
Hearing this, he quietly came in.

王有龄看见了喊道，“高升，你来见见刘二爷。”
Wang saw him and said, “Gao Sheng, come and pay your respects to Second Master Liu.”


“刘二爷！”高升请了个安。
“Second Master Liu!” Gao made a salute.


刘二回了礼。
Liu returned it.

跟班听差，客气些都称“二爷”，所以刘二不管他行几，回他一声：“高二爷！”又说，“都是自己人，
Servants were politely addressed as “Second Master” regardless of their actual place among their brothers, so he replied, “Second Master Gao!” Then he added, “We're all friends here.

有什么事只管招呼我，
If you need anything, just let me know.

不必客气！”
There's no need for ceremony.”


“是，是！
“Thank you.

将来麻烦刘二爷的地方一定很多，
I'm sure we'll have much to trouble you with in future.

请多关照。”
We shall be grateful for your help.”


这时王有龄已站起身，
Wang had risen.

刘二便喊：“看！王大老爷的轿子在那里，
Liu called out, “Where is His Honour Wang's chair?

快抬过来。”
Bring it over at once!”


他的那顶蓝呢大轿、一直停在西辕门外，
It had been waiting outside the western outer gate.

等抬到大门，王有龄才踱着八字步，走了出去，刘二哈着腰亦步亦趋地跟在后面。
Only when it reached the main entrance did Wang walk out with the measured gait of an official, Liu following close behind with a deferential bend of the body.

那些司道的从人轿班，看刘二比伺候“首县”还要巴结，无不侧目而视，窃窃私议。
The servants and bearers of the commissioners and intendants watched sideways and whispered. Liu was being more attentive than he was even to the magistrate of the provincial capital's principal county.


回家不久，果然送来一份黄宗汉的请帖，
Soon after Wang returned home, Huang's invitation arrived.

王有龄自然准时赴宴。
He naturally went at the appointed hour.

虽然刘二已预先关照，只开便衣，他却不敢把抚台的客气话当真，
Although Liu had said that ordinary clothes would suffice, Wang did not dare take the governor's politeness literally.

依旧穿公服，备手本，只不过叫高升带着衣包备用。
He wore formal robes and prepared a visiting card, merely asking Gao to bring a change of clothes.


到了扰台商门下轿，刘二已经等在那里、
Liu was waiting when his chair arrived at the governor's office.

随限把他领到西花厅，
He led Wang to the western reception room.

说一声：“王大老爷请坐，
“Please sit down, Your Honour.

等我到上面去回。”
I'll announce you.”


没有多少时候，听得靠里一座通上房的侧门外面，有人咳嗽，
Before long, a cough sounded beyond a side door leading to the private quarters.

随后便进来一个听差，一手托着银水烟袋，一手打开棉门帘，
An attendant appeared, carrying a silver water pipe in one hand and lifting the padded curtain with the other.

王有龄知道黄宗汉出来，随即站起，必恭必敬地立在下方。
Knowing that Huang was coming, Wang rose immediately and stood respectfully at the lower end of the room.


黄宗汉穿的是便衣，
Huang wore informal clothes.

驴脸狮鼻，两颊凹了下去，
He had a long face, a broad nose, and sunken cheeks.

那双眼睛顾盼之，看到什么就是死盯一眼，
As his eyes moved about, they fixed hard upon whatever they noticed.

一望而知是个极难伺候的人物。
One glance was enough to show that he would be difficult to serve.

王有龄不敢怠慢，
Wang dared not delay.

趋跄数步，迎面跪了下去，报乞请安。
