He thumped his own chest, then patted Wu's shoulder.

等阿珠送热茶进来，又拉住她的手，醉言醉语，说些疯话。
When A'zhu brought hot tea, he caught her hand and rambled drunken nonsense.

阿珠哭笑不得，只不断瞟着胡雪岩，
She did not know whether to laugh or cry and kept looking at Hu.

那眼色又似求援，又似求取谅解，好象在说：不是我轻狂，实在是拿这两个醉鬼没有法子！
Her glances seemed both a plea for help and a request for understanding: it wasn't that she welcomed this; she simply could not manage the two drunken men.

好不容易把周、吴二人弄到前面那条船上去安置，
At last they got Zhou and Wu settled aboard the leading boat.

剩下胡雪岩与张胖子，才得清清静静谈话。
Hu and Zhang could finally talk in peace.

张胖子报告了吃花酒的经过，形容尤老五是如何竭诚招待，而同、吴是如何丑态百出？把站在一旁的阿珠，听得“格格”地笑个不住。
Zhang described the evening's entertainment, You's unstinting hospitality, and the ridiculous behaviour of the two commissioners, making A'zhu, who stood nearby, laugh repeatedly.


“你什么时候回来的？”张胖子问到胡雪岩身上。
“When did you come back?” Zhang asked Hu.

“好久了。”他信口答说。
“Quite a while ago,” he answered casually.

“好久了？”
“Quite a while?”

张胖子转脸去看阿珠。
Zhang turned to look at A'zhu.

阿珠心虚，急忙溜走。
Feeling exposed, she hurried away.

这一下张胖子心里越发有数，
That confirmed his suspicions.

看着她的背影，又看着胡雪岩含笑不语的神情，他也诡秘地笑了。
He looked after her, then at Hu's silent smile, and gave a knowing smile of his own.

“你笑什么？”
“What are you smiling at?”

“我笑周委员跟吴委员。”张胖子说，
“Zhou and Wu.

“这两个人一路来都在阿珠身上打主意。
They've had their eyes on A'zhu all the way.

谁知道‘会偷嘴的猫不叫’！”
Who'd have thought it? The cat that steals a morsel makes no noise!”

“不要瞎说！”
“Don't talk nonsense!”

胡雪岩指指外面：
Hu pointed outside.

“当心她听见。”
“Mind she doesn't hear.”

“那么，你说老实话。”
“Then tell me the truth.”

张胖子把颗亮光光的头伸过去，压低了嗓子问：
Zhang leaned his shining head closer and lowered his voice.

“偷上手没有？”
“Have you succeeded?”

“没—有！”
“No!”

胡雪岩拉长了声音，
Hu drew out the word.

“哪有这回事？”
“Nothing of the sort!”

“那么你们谈了些什么呢？”
“Then what did you talk about?”

“随便谈闲天，
“Just idle conversation.

谈过就丢开，
Gone as soon as it was spoken.

哪记得这许多？”
How could I remember all of it?”

胡雪岩正一正脸色：
Hu composed his face.

“闲话少说，
“Enough gossip.

今天你跟尤老五谈了正经没有？”
Did you discuss any real business with You today?”


“对了，我正要告诉你。
“Yes, I meant to tell you.

我已经跟他说好了，明天一起出帖子，请‘三大’的档手吃饭，
We've agreed to send joint invitations tomorrow to the managers of the Big Three.

请你作陪。
We'd like you to join us for the meal.

放款的事，就在席面上谈。”
We'll discuss the loan at the table.”

“好的。”胡雪岩又说：“我还有件事，想跟你谈。
“Good.” Hu added, “There's something else I'd like to discuss with you.

不过……”
But...”

“咦！”
“Why!”

张胖子惯会大惊小怪，睁大了眼睛问：
Zhang, always ready to make a fuss, widened his eyes.

“怎么，
“What's the matter?

不说下去了？”
Why have you stopped?”

话到口边，终又咽住，
The words had reached Hu's lips, but he swallowed them.

是胡雪岩警觉到张胖子嘴快，
He had remembered how freely Zhang talked.

黄宗汉的那两万银子，如果托他去汇拨，一定会泄漏出去。
If he entrusted him with remitting Huang Zonghan's twenty thousand taels, the secret would certainly get out.

不如明天找尤老五商量，
Better to discuss it with You tomorrow.

比较靠得住。
He was more dependable.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（上）》第四章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume I — Chapter Four, concluding part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第二天一早，胡雪岩悄悄到梅家弄把王有龄接回船。
Early the next morning, Hu quietly went to Meijia Lane and brought Wang back to the boat.

这位王大老爷春风满面，步履轻快，
His Honour was radiant and light of step.

大家都道他异乡遇故，快谈竟夕，才有这份轻松的情绪，
Everyone supposed that a reunion with an old acquaintance far from home, followed by a whole night of pleasant conversation, accounted for his cheerful ease.

谁也不知道他微服私行，比起三多堂的喧闹轰饮，另有一番屋小如舟，春深似海的旖旎风光。
Nobody knew that his discreet excursion in ordinary clothes had offered pleasures quite unlike the noisy drinking at Sanduo Hall: a room as small as a boat, with spring's enchantment as deep as the sea.

这天开始要办正事了，
Serious work was to begin that day.

王有龄把周、吴两委员请了来，连胡雪岩一起，先作个商量。
Wang summoned Zhou and Wu for a preliminary discussion with Hu.

他原定这一天上午去拜客，胡雪岩主张不必亟亟。
He had intended to pay his calls that morning, but Hu thought there was no need to hurry.

“今天中午，尤老五和张胖子出面，请‘三大’的人吃饭，
“At noon, You and Zhang are entertaining the men from the Big Three.

放款的事一谈好，通裕的米，随即可以拨借。”他说：
Once the loan is settled, Tongyu can immediately advance the rice.

“雪公，索性再等一等，
Mr Xuexuan, wait a little longer.

也不会太久，一两天工夫，
It won't take much time—a day or two.

等我们自己这里办妥了再说。”
Let us put our own arrangements in order first.”

“这样好！”
“Excellent!”

周委员首先表示赞成，
Zhou was the first to agree.

“到明后天，王大人去拜这里的按察使，那就直接谈交兑漕米了，
“When you call on the judicial commissioner tomorrow or the day after, you can discuss delivery of the grain directly.

差使显得更漂亮。”
The assignment will look all the better.”

“好！
“Very well.

我听你们的主意。”王有龄欣然同意。
I'll take your advice,” Wang readily agreed.


“中午的饭局，不请周、吴两公了。”胡雪岩说第二件事，
“We won't ask you two gentlemen to the luncheon,” Hu continued.

“商人总是怕官的，
“Merchants are always nervous of officials.

有周、吴两公在座，怕‘三大’的人拘束……”
With you both present, the Big Three might feel constrained...”

“不错，不错！”周委员抢着说道，
“Quite right!” Zhou interrupted.

“你无须解释。”
“No explanation is needed.”

“不过有件大事要请周、吴两公费心，
“But there is an important matter on which we need your help.

‘民折官办’的这道手续，马上就要办一办。
The paperwork for cash payment by the taxpayer and official procurement must be dealt with at once.

公事上我不懂，
I know little of official procedure.

雪公看怎么处置？”
What do you suggest, Mr Xuexuan?”

“那要奉托两位了。”王有龄看着他们说：
“We must leave that to you two,” Wang said, looking at them.

“两位是熟手，一定错不了。
“You're experienced men and won't go wrong.

该我山面的，尽管请吩咐！
If anything requires my intervention, just tell me.”

“于是周、吴二人相视沉吟，似乎都有些茫然不知如何着手的样子。
Zhou and Wu exchanged thoughtful glances, both apparently uncertain where to begin.

胡雪岩等了一会，看他们很为难，忍不住又说了，
Hu waited a moment, then could not refrain from helping.

“我看这件事，公文上说不清楚，
“I don't think this can be explained clearly in a document.

得有一位回杭州去当面禀陈。”
One of you ought to return to Hangzhou and report in person.”

“对了！”
“Exactly!”

吴委员抚掌接口，
Wu clapped his hands.

“我也是这么想。
“That was my thought too.

当然，公文还是要的，只不过简单说一说，‘民折官办’一案，十分顺手，特饬某某人回省面禀请示云云。
Of course a document is still needed, but it can simply state that the official-procurement arrangement is proceeding favourably and that so-and-so has been specially ordered back to the provincial capital to report and seek instructions.

这样就可以了。”
That will do.”


“那好！
“Good.

两位之中，哪一位辛苦一趟？”
Which of you will undertake the journey?”

这一向，周、吴二人又迟疑了。
At this question, both hesitated again.

甫到繁华之地，不能尽兴畅游，心里十分不愿。
They had only just reached this prosperous city and were most unwilling to leave before enjoying it fully.

而且这一案的内容十分复杂，
Besides, the affair was complicated.

上面有所垂询，不能圆满解释，差使就算砸了。
If their superiors asked questions they could not answer satisfactorily, the mission would be a failure.

畏难之念一起，更不敢自告奋勇。
Once this apprehension arose, neither dared volunteer.

“怎么？”
“Well?”

王有龄有些不悦，
Wang was displeased.

“看样子只好我自己回去一趟了。”
“It seems I shall have to go back myself.”

“那没有这个道理。”周委员很惶恐他说，
“That would never do,” Zhou said in alarm.

“我去，我去！”
“I'll go.”

看周委员有了表示，吴委员倒也不好意思了，
Now that Zhou had spoken, Wu felt embarrassed too.

“自然是我去。”他说。
“Naturally, I should go,” he said.

两个人争是在争，其实谁也不愿意去，
They competed for the duty, though neither wanted it.

王有龄不愿硬派，便说，“这样吧，我们掣签！”
Unwilling to impose a choice, Wang said, “Then let us draw lots.”

“不必了！”周委员很坚决他说，
“No need!” Zhou declared firmly.

“决定我去。
“It's settled: I'll go.

吴兄文章好，留在这里帮大人料理公事。
Brother Wu writes well and should stay to help Your Honour with the documents.

我今天下午就走，尽快回来复命。”
I'll leave this afternoon and return to report as soon as possible.”


“也不必这么急。”
“There's no need for such haste.”

胡雪岩作了个诡秘的微笑，
Hu gave a knowing smile.

“今天晚上我替周老爷饯行。
“I'll give you a farewell dinner tonight.

明天动身好了。”
You can leave tomorrow.”

“雪岩兄的话不错。公事虽然紧要，也不争在这半天工夫。”吴委员也说，
“Brother Xueyan is right,” Wu agreed. “Important though the business is, half a day won't matter.

“晚上替周兄饯行，我跟雪岩兄一起作主人。”
He and I will jointly entertain Brother Zhou tonight.”

王有龄也表示从容些的好，
Wang too favoured a more leisurely departure.

并且颇有嘉勉之词，暗示将来叙功的“保案”中，一定替周委员格外说好话，作为酬庸。
He praised Zhou warmly and hinted that, when recommendations for rewards were submitted, he would speak particularly well of him.

自告奋勇的收获，可说相当丰富。
Volunteering had yielded a considerable return.


为了周委员回杭州，那个庶务却是大忙而特忙，
Zhou's return to Hangzhou kept the general affairs officer exceptionally busy.

第一要雇船，
First, a boat had to be hired.

照周委员的意思，最好坐原来的那只“无锡快”，由阿珠一路伺奉着来回。
Zhou would have preferred one of their original fast Wuxi boats, with A'zhu serving him on the outward and return journeys.

但那只船名“快”而实不快，
But these boats were fast only in name.

只宜于晚开早到，多泊少走，玩赏风景之用，
They were suited to late departures, early arrivals, frequent stops, and leisurely sightseeing.

赶路要另雇双桨奇快的“水上飞”。
For speed, he needed a different vessel, a double-oared “water flyer.”

第二件更麻烦，也是胡雪岩的建议，
The second task was more troublesome, and again Hu's idea.

杭州抚、藩、臬三大宪，加上粮道，还有各衙门有关系的文案、幕友，都应该有一份礼。
Gifts were due to the governor, treasurer, and judicial commissioner in Hangzhou, to the grain intendant, and to the relevant secretaries and advisers in their offices.

“十里夷场”，奇珍异物无数，
The foreign settlement, stretching for miles, offered countless rare and curious objects.

会选的花费不多而受者惬意，不会的，花了大价钱却不起眼，变成“俏眉眼做给瞎子看”，
A skilful buyer could please the recipient at little cost; an unskilful one might spend a fortune on something that attracted no notice, wasting his charms on a blind man.

因此，备办这十几份礼物，不是一件轻松的差使。
Choosing these dozen or more gifts was no easy assignment.

胡雪岩主意，请尤老五派个人，带着那庶务和高升，到“夷场”上外国人所开最大的一家洋行“亨达利”去采办。
Hu decided to ask You for a guide to take the general affairs officer and Gao to Hengdali, the largest foreign trading house in the settlement, to make their purchases.


这天人人有事，
Everyone had work to do that day.

王有龄和周、吴二人在船上办文稿，开节略，把此行的经过，如何繁难吃力，而又如何圆满妥帖，字斟句酌地叙了进去。
Wang, Zhou, and Wu remained aboard drafting reports and summaries, carefully weighing every word to show how difficult the assignment had been and how thoroughly and satisfactorily they had carried it out.

胡雪岩和张胖子的任务，自然更重要，
Hu and Zhang naturally had still more important duties.

中午与尤老五请“三大”的档手，在英租界的“番菜馆”赴宴谈生意。
At noon they joined You in entertaining the managers of the Big Three at a Western restaurant in the British concession, where they intended to discuss business.

结果生意不曾在番菜馆谈，
In the event, no business was discussed there.

因为照例要“叫局”，莺莺燕燕一大堆，不是谈生意的时候。
Courtesans were summoned as usual, and with so many women around, the occasion was unsuitable.

饭罢一起到城隍庙后花园钱业公所品茗，
After lunch, the party went for tea to the bankers' guildhall in the garden behind the City God Temple.

这时张胖子才提到正事。
Only then did Zhang raise the matter.

“三大”之中，大亨钱庄姓孙的档手资格最老，
Of the three banks, Daheng's manager, Sun, had the greatest seniority.

他代代表发言，首先就表示最近银根很紧，
Speaking for them all, he began by saying that money was very tight.

“局势不好，
“The outlook is poor.

有钱的人都要把现银子捏在手里，怕放了倒帐。
People with money want to keep the silver in their own hands, fearing bad debts if they lend it.

这句实在话，钱庄本来是空的。”
Frankly, a bank has little money of its own.”

这是照例有的托词，
This was the customary excuse.

银根紧的理由甚多，不妨随意编造，目的就在抬高利息。
There were endless reasons for tight money, any of which could be invented to push up the interest.

张胖子和胡雪岩都懂这个道理，
Zhang and Hu understood perfectly.

尤老五却以受过上海钱庄的气，怀有成见，
You, however, had suffered at the hands of Shanghai bankers before and was already prejudiced against them.

大为不快。
He was deeply displeased.


“我看不是银根紧，
“I doubt it's the money that's tight.

只怕是借的人招牌不硬，”
Perhaps the borrower's name isn't good enough.”

他的话有棱角，态度却极好，是半带着开玩笑的语气说的，
His words had an edge, but his manner remained amiable, almost joking.

“漕帮现在倒霉，
“Our association is down on its luck.

要是‘沙船帮’的郁老大开口，银根马上就松了。”
If Boss Yu of the sand-junk association asked, the money would loosen at once.”

尤老五说的这个人是沙船帮的巨擘，名叫郁馥山，拥有上百艘的沙船，
He meant Yu Fushan, a leading shipowner who possessed more than a hundred sand junks.

北走关东，南走闽粤，照海洋的方位，称为“北洋”、“南洋”，
They sailed north to Manchuria and south to Fujian and Guangdong, on routes known by their maritime positions as the Northern and Southern Seas.

郁馥山就以走南北洋起家，是上海县的首富。
Yu had made his fortune on those routes and become the richest man in Shanghai County.

近年因为漕米海运，更是大发利市，
The recent shift of grain shipments to the sea had brought him still greater profits.

新近在小南门造了一所巨宅，崇楼杰阁，参以西法，
Near the Little South Gate he had lately built a vast residence, with imposing towers and halls incorporating Western methods.

算是“海天旭日”、“黄浦秋涛”等等“沪城八景”以外的另一景。
It counted as another sight to be set beside Shanghai's celebrated Eight Views, such as “Sunrise over Sea and Sky” and “Autumn Waves on the Huangpu.”

沙船帮与漕帮，本来海永不犯河水，但漕运改了新章，使有了极厉害的利害冲突，
The sand-junk men and the canal association had once kept to their separate waters, but the new grain-transport arrangements had brought their interests into sharp conflict.

所以尤老五那句话斤两很重，
You's remark therefore carried considerable weight.

姓孙的有些吃不消。
Sun found it difficult to answer.

“啊，尤五哥，”姓孙的惶恐地说，“你这话，我们一个字也不敢承认。
“Brother You,” he said anxiously, “we cannot accept a single word of that.

吝户都是一样的，
All clients are treated alike.

论到交情，尤五哥的面子更加不同。
As for friendship, your standing with us is exceptional.

好了，今天就请尤五哥吩咐！“
Very well: tell us what you require today.”


象尤老五这样在江湖上有地位的，轻易说不得一句重话，
A man of You's standing could not lightly speak harshly.

刚才话中有牢骚，已不够漂亮，
The resentment in his earlier remark had already fallen short of proper grace.

此刻听姓孙的这样回答，更显得自己那句话带着要挟威胁的意味，越觉不安，
Sun's answer now made it sound positively coercive, and You was still more uneasy.

所以急忙抱拳笑道：
He hastily clasped his hands and smiled.

“言重，言重！
“You are too kind.

全靠各位帮忙。”
I rely entirely on your help.”

张胖子总归是站在同行这方面的，而且自己也有担保的责任，
Zhang ultimately stood with his fellow bankers, and he too bore responsibility for the guarantee.

心里在想，姓孙的吃不消尤老五，说到“请吩咐”的话，未免冒失！
Sun's inability to withstand You had led him rashly to offer to do whatever was asked.

如果凭一句话草草成局，以后一出麻烦，吃亏的心是钱庄，自己也会连带受累。
If a transaction were concluded on the strength of one remark and trouble arose later, the banks would suffer, and Zhang would be involved as well.

由于这样的了解，他不希望他们讲江湖义气，愿意一板一眼谈生意，不过他的话也很圆到，
He therefore preferred straightforward business negotiation to appeals to brotherhood, though he expressed himself tactfully.

“大家都是自己人，尤五哥更是好朋友，
“We're all friends here, and Brother You is a particularly good one.

没有谈不通的事，”他说，
Nothing is beyond agreement.

“ ‘三大，愿意帮忙，尤老哥一定也不会叫’三大‘吃亏。
The Big Three are willing to help, and Brother You certainly won't let them lose by it.

是不是？”
Isn't that so?”

尤老五当然听得出他话中的意思，立即接口：
You immediately understood.

“一点不错！
“Exactly.

江湖归江湖，生意归生意。
Friendship is one thing, business another.

我看这样，”
Here's my suggestion.”

他望着胡雪岩说，
He looked at Hu.

“小爷叔，这件事让张老板跟孙老板他们去谈，
“Young Uncle, let Mr Zhang discuss it with Mr Sun and the others.

应该怎么样就怎么样，我无不照办，
Whatever terms are proper, I'll accept.

我们就不必在场了。”
There's no need for us to stay.”

胡雪岩听他这一说，暗暗佩服，
Hu privately admired him.

到底是一帮的老大，做事实在漂亮。
He was indeed the leader of an association and knew how to handle things handsomely.

于是欣然答道：“对，对！
“Yes,” he readily answered.

我也正有事要跟五哥谈。”
“I have something to discuss with you as well.”

说着，两人相偕起身，向那几个钱庄朋友点一点头，到另外一张桌子去吃茶，让张胖子全权跟“三大”谈判。
They rose together, nodded to the bankers, and moved to another table, leaving Zhang full authority to negotiate.


“小爷叔！”尤老五首先表明，“借款是另外一回事，通裕垫米又是一回事，
“Young Uncle,” You began, “the loan is one matter; Tongyu's advance of rice is another.

桥归桥，路归路。
Let each stand on its own.

米，我已经叫通裕启运了，
I've already ordered Tongyu to begin shipping.

在哪里交兑，
Where is the delivery to be made?

你们要不要派人，还是统通由我代办？
Will you send someone, or shall I handle it all?

请你交代下来，我三天工夫替你们办好。”
Give me your instructions, and I'll have it done in three days.”

“好极了！
“Excellent!

五哥跟老太爷这样放交情，我现在也不必说什么！
With you and the old master showing us such friendship, there's no need for more words now.

‘路遥知马力，日久见人心‘，
A long road tests a horse's strength; time reveals a man's heart.

将来就晓得了。“胡雪岩接着又说，”在哪里交兑，等我问明白了来回报五哥。
You'll see in future.” Hu continued, “I'll find out where the rice is to be delivered and report back.

要不要另外派人，公事上我不大懂，也要回去问一问。
Whether we must send someone separately is an official detail I don't understand; I must ask about that too.

如果我好作主，当然拜托五哥，辛苦弟兄们替我办一办。
If it were mine to decide, I would naturally entrust it to you and trouble the brethren to handle it for me.”

““好的，
“Good.

就这样说定了，
Then it's settled.

我关照通裕老顾去伺候，
I'll tell Gu at Tongyu to attend upon you.

王大老爷有什么话，尽管交代他。”
His Honour Wang can give him whatever instructions are needed.”

一件有关浙江地方大吏前程的大事，就这样三言两语作了了结。
An affair upon which the careers of Zhejiang's senior officials depended was thus settled in a few words.

胡雪岩还有件要紧事要请尤老五帮忙。
Hu still had another important request.


“五哥，我还有个麻烦要靠你想办法。”
“Brother You, there's another difficulty I need your help with.”

他放低了声音说：
He lowered his voice.

“我有两万银子要汇到福建，不能叫人知道，
“I have twenty thousand taels to remit to Fujian without anyone knowing.

你有什么办法？”
Can you arrange it?”

尤老五沉吟了一会问道：
You considered.

“是现银，还是庄票？”
“Is it silver, or a bank draft?”

“自然是庄票。”
“A draft, naturally.”

“那容易得很。”尤老五很随便地说：
“Then it's very easy,” You said casually.

“你自己写封信，把庄票封在里面，
“Write a letter yourself and enclose the draft.

我找个人替你送到，拿回信回来。
I'll find someone to deliver it and bring back a reply.

你看怎么样？”
Would that suit?”

“那这样太好了。”
“That would be ideal.

胡雪岩又问：“不晓得要几天工夫？”
How long would it take?”

“不过五六天工夫。”
“Only five or six days.”

胡雪岩大为惊异：
Hu was astonished.

“这么快？”
“So quickly?”

“我托火轮船上的人去办。”
“I'll ask someone aboard a steamship to do it.”


从道光十五年起，英国第一艘“渣甸号”开到，东南沿海便有了轮船。
Steamships had appeared off the southeastern coast since the arrival of the first British vessel, the Jardine, in the fifteenth year of the Daoguang reign.

不久为了禁鸦片开仗，
Soon afterwards, the suppression of opium led to war.

道光二十一年辛丑七月，英国军队攻陷镇江，直逼江宁，
In the seventh month of the twenty-first Daoguang year, the xinchou year, British troops captured Zhenjiang and pressed towards Jiangning.

运了大炮安置在钟山，预备轰城。
They transported cannon to Zhongshan, preparing to bombard the city.

朝廷大震，决计议和，
The court was deeply alarmed and decided to negotiate peace.

派出耆英、伊里布和两江总督牛鉴为“全权大臣”，与英国公使谈和，
It appointed Qiying, Yilibu, and the Governor-General of Liangjiang, Niu Jian, as plenipotentiaries to negotiate with the British representative.

订立和约十三条，赔军费，割香港，开广州、厦门、福州、宁波、上海力通商口岸，称为“五口通商”，
A treaty of thirteen articles provided for a war indemnity, the cession of Hong Kong, and the opening of Guangzhou, Xiamen, Fuzhou, Ningbo, and Shanghai to trade: the opening of the five treaty ports.

大英公司的轮船，源源而至，
Steamships of the British company came in increasing numbers.

从上海到福州经常有班轮，但一路停靠宁波、温州，来回要半个月的工夫，
Regular vessels sailed between Shanghai and Fuzhou, but with stops at Ningbo and Wenzhou, the round trip took half a month.

何以说是只要五六天？
How could You promise five or six days?

胡雪岩越发不解。
Hu was more puzzled than ever.

“我到英国使馆去想办法，
“I'll arrange it through the British mission,” You explained.

他们有直放的轮船。”
“They have ships that sail directly.”


“噢！”
“Oh!”

是一声简单的答语，可是胡雪岩心里却是思潮起伏，
It was a simple answer, but Hu's mind was busy.

第一觉得外国人的花样厉害，
First, he was struck by the effectiveness of foreign methods.

飘洋过海，不当回事，
They thought nothing of crossing seas.

做生意就是要靠运货方便，
Business depended upon convenient transport.

别人用老式船，我用新式船，抢在人家前面运到，自然能卖得好价钱。
If others used old vessels while he used new ones, his goods could arrive first and naturally command a better price.

火轮船他也见过，靠在码头上象座仓库，装的东西一定不少，
He had seen steamships: moored at the landing, they looked like warehouses and must carry enormous quantities.

倒不妨好好想一想，
The idea deserved thought.

用轮船来运货，说不定可以发大财。
Shipping goods by steamer might make a great fortune.

其次，他发觉尤老五的路子极广，
Second, he realised how extensive You's connections were.

连外国使馆都能打得通，并且这个人做事爽快，
He could even reach the foreign mission, and he acted promptly and generously.

应该倾心结交，将来大有用处。
Hu ought to cultivate him wholeheartedly; the connection could be immensely useful.

这样一想，便放出全副本领来跟尤老五周旋，两个人谈得十分投机。
With that in mind, he employed all his skill in conversation, and they got on exceedingly well.

他把与王有龄的关系，作了适当的透露。
He disclosed an appropriate amount about his relationship with Wang.

尤老五觉得此人也够得上“侠义”二字，
You felt that this man deserved to be called chivalrous.

而且肯说到这种情形，完全是以自己人相看，
To speak so openly also showed that Hu regarded him entirely as one of his own.

因而原来奉师命接待的，这时变成自己愿意帮他的忙了。
What had begun as hospitality offered at his master's command now became a personal willingness to help.


这面谈得忘掉了时间！
At their table, conversation made them forget the time.

那面的钱庄朋友，却已有了成议，
At the other, the bankers had reached agreement.

由通裕出面来借，
Tongyu would be the borrower.

“三大”和张胖子一共贷放十万两银子，以三个月为期，到期可以转一转，
The Big Three and Zhang would together lend a hundred thousand taels for three months, with the possibility of renewal.

尤老五和胡雪岩做保，
You and Hu would act as guarantors.

却有一个条件要王有龄答应，这笔借款没有还清以前，浙江海运局在上海的公款汇划，要归三大承办，
There was, however, one condition requiring Wang's consent: until the loan was repaid, all remittances of the Zhejiang Sea Transport Bureau's public funds in Shanghai must be handled by the Big Three.

这是一种变相保证的意思。
This amounted to an indirect form of security.

“用不着跟王大老爷去说。”胡雪岩这样答复，
“There's no need to ask His Honour,” Hu answered.

“我就可以代为答应。”
“I can agree on his behalf.”

“利息呢？”尤老五问。
“And the interest?” You asked.

“利息是这样，”
“As for interest...”

张胖子回头看了看那面“三大”的人，低了声说道：
Zhang glanced back at the men from the Big Three, then lowered his voice.

“年息一分一照算。”
“The stated annual rate is eleven per cent.”

“这不算贵。”尤老五说。
“That isn't expensive,” You said.

人家是漂亮话，
It was a gracious response.

胡雪岩要结交尤老五，便接口说道：“也不算便宜！”
Wishing to strengthen his friendship with You, Hu added, “Nor is it cheap!”


张胖子很厉害，
Zhang was shrewd.

他下面还有句话，起先故意不说，
He had deliberately withheld something.

这时察言观色，不说不可，
Now, reading their expressions, he knew he must disclose it.

便故意装作埋怨的神气：“你们两位不要性急！
Pretending to reproach them, he said, “Don't be impatient, you two!

我话还没有完，
I haven't finished.

实在是这个数！”
The real figure is this.”

说着伸开食拇两指扬了扬。
He extended his thumb and forefinger.

“八厘？”胡雪岩问。
“Eight per cent?” Hu asked.

“不错，八厘。
“Exactly.

另外三厘是你们两位做保应得的好处。”
The other three percentage points are the benefit due to you two for guaranteeing the loan.”

“不要把我算在里头。”胡雪岩抢着说道，
“Leave me out,” Hu said at once.

“我的一份归五哥。”
“My share goes to Brother You.”

“小爷叔，你真够朋友！
“Young Uncle, you're a true friend.

不过我更加不可以在这上面‘戴帽子’。
But I have still less right to put a surcharge on top.

这样，”尤老五转脸问张胖子，“你的一份呢？”
Tell me, Mr Zhang,” You continued, turning to him, “where is your share?”

“我？”张胖子笑道，
“Mine?” Zhang laughed.

“我是放款的，
“I'm the lender.

与我什么相干？”
What has that to do with me?”

“话不是这么说。
“That's not the way to look at it.

张老板，我也知道，你名为老板，实在也是伙计，
I know that, although you're called the boss, you too are really an employee.

说句不客气的话，‘皇帝不差饿兵’，
To speak plainly, even the emperor doesn't send hungry soldiers on an assignment.

我要顾到你的好处。
I must consider your interests.

不过这趟是苦差使，
This has been a difficult job.

我准定借三个月，
I'll undertake to borrow for the full three months.

利息算九厘，明八暗一，
Make the interest nine per cent: eight openly, one privately.

这一厘算我们的好处，送了给你。”
Treat that extra point as our benefit, which we give to you.”

“这怎么好意思？”
“How could I accept?”

“不必客气了。”胡雪岩完全站在尤老五这面说话，
“No need for ceremony,” Hu said, entirely supporting You.

“我们什么时候成契？”
“When shall we sign the agreement?”


“明天吧！”
“Tomorrow?”

就这样说定局，
So it was settled.

约定了第二天下午仍旧这里碰面，随即分手。
They agreed to meet at the same place the following afternoon, then parted.

张胖子跟“三大”的人还有话谈，
Zhang had more to discuss with the Big Three.

胡雪岩一个人回去，把经过情形一说，
Hu returned alone and reported what had happened.

王有龄和周、吴二人，兴奋非凡，自然也把胡雪岩赞扬不绝。
Wang, Zhou, and Wu were delighted and naturally praised him without restraint.

避开闲人，胡雪岩又把汇款到福建的事，跟王有龄悄悄说了一遍。
Away from other ears, Hu quietly explained the arrangements for the Fujian remittance.

他皱着眉笑道，
Wang smiled with a crease in his brow.

“雪岩，事情这么顺利，我反倒有些担心了。”
“Xueyan, everything is going so smoothly that I'm beginning to worry.”

“担心什么？”
“About what?”

“担心会出什么意外。
“Some unexpected mishap.

凡事物极必反，
When things reach an extreme, they turn the other way.

乐极生悲。”
Too much joy brings sorrow.”

“那在于自己。”胡雪岩坦率答道：
“That depends on us,” Hu answered frankly.

“我是不大相信这一套的。
“I don't put much faith in such sayings.

有什么意外，都因为自己这个不够用的缘故。”
Unexpected trouble usually comes because this isn't working well enough.”

说着，他敲敲自己的太阳穴。
He tapped his temple.

“不错！”王有龄又说，
“True,” Wang said.

“雪岩，你的脑筋好，
“You have a good head, Xueyan.

想想看，还有什么该做而没有做的事？”
Think: is there anything we ought to have done but haven't?”

“你要写两封信，一封写给黄抚台，一封写给何学使。”
“You should write two letters: one to Governor Huang, one to Education Commissioner He.”

“对，
“Yes.

我马上动手。”
I'll begin at once.”


当夜胡雪岩跟吴委员在三多堂替周委员饯行，
That evening Hu and Wu gave Zhou a farewell dinner at Sanduo Hall.

第二趟来，虽算熟客，“长三”的规矩，也还不到“住夜厢”的时候，
On a second visit they counted as familiar patrons, but under the conventions of a changsan establishment, it was still too soon for an overnight stay.

但尤老五的朋友，情形特殊，
You's friends, however, were an exception.

周、吴二人当夜就都做了三多堂的入幕之宾。
Both commissioners were admitted that night to their hosts' inner chambers.

第二天王有龄才去拜客，
Wang did not pay his calls until the following day.

先拜地主上海知县，打听总办江浙漕米海运，已由江苏臬司调为藩司的倪良耀，是否在上海？
He first visited the local magistrate of Shanghai and asked whether Ni Liangyao, director-general of the Jiangsu and Zhejiang sea grain shipments, who had been transferred from judicial commissioner to provincial treasurer of Jiangsu, was in the city.

据说倪良耀一直不曾回苏州，公馆设在天后宫，
He learned that Ni had not returned to Suzhou and had established his residence at the Temple of the Queen of Heaven.

于是转道天后宫，用手本谒见。
Wang therefore went there and presented his official visiting card.

倪良耀是个老实人，才具却平常，
Ni was an honest man of ordinary ability.

为了漕米海运虽升了官，却搞得焦头烂额。
Sea transport had gained him a promotion but left him overwhelmed.

黄宗汉参了他一本，说他办事糊涂，而且把家眷送到杭州暂住，
Huang had impeached him for muddling his duties and sending his family to stay temporarily in Hangzhou.

所以谕旨上责备他说：“当军务倥偬之际，辄将眷属迁避邻省，致令民心惶惑，
An imperial edict rebuked him: “At a time of pressing military affairs, you summarily moved your dependants to a neighbouring province, causing alarm and uncertainty among the people.

咎实难解，
Your fault is difficult to excuse.

乃犹以绕道回籍探访老母为词，
Yet you plead that you were merely making a detour to your native district to visit your aged mother.

何居心若是巧诈？”
Why are your intentions so deceitful?”

为此，他见了王有龄大发牢骚，反把正事搁在一边。
Ni therefore greeted Wang with a torrent of complaints, pushing their official business aside.


王有龄从胡雪岩那里学到了许多圆滑的手法，
Wang had learned much tact from Hu.

听得他的牢骚，不但没有不豫之色，而且极表同情。
Instead of showing displeasure at Ni's complaints, he expressed deep sympathy.

提到家眷，他又问住处，拍胸应承，归他照料。
When the family was mentioned, he asked where they lived and confidently promised to look after them.

“你老哥如此关顾，实在感激。”倪良耀说的地真话，感激之情，溢于词色，
“I am truly grateful for your concern,” Ni said, his sincerity evident in both voice and expression.

“我也听人说起，你老哥是黄中丞面前，一等一的红人，
“I've heard that you are Governor Huang's foremost favourite.

除了敝眷要请照拂以外，黄中丞那里，也要请老哥鼎力疏通。”
Besides asking you to look after my family, I must beg your help in smoothing matters over with him.”

“不敢！不敢！”王有龄诚恳地答说，
“You are too kind,” Wang answered earnestly.

“凡有可以效劳之处，无不如命。”
“Wherever I can be of service, I shall do everything you ask.”

“唉！”
“Ah!”

倪良耀安慰之中有感慨，
Ni felt both comforted and moved.

“都象老哥这样热心明白，事情就好办了。”
“If everyone were as helpful and understanding as you, things would be easy.”

有了这句话，公事就非常顺手了。
After that, their official business went very smoothly.

提到交兑漕米余额，倪良耀表示完全听王有龄的意思，他会交代所属，格外予以方便。
When Wang mentioned delivering the outstanding grain, Ni said he would follow Wang's wishes entirely and instruct his subordinates to give him every assistance.

接着，他又大叹苦经，
Then he returned to his troubles.

说是明知道黄宗汉所奏，浙江漕米如数竟足这句话不实，他却不敢据买奏复，辩一辩真相，讲一讲道理，
He knew Huang's memorial claiming full delivery of Zhejiang's grain was untrue, yet dared not report the facts, defend his position, or argue the point.

原因是惹不起黄宗汉。
He could not afford to offend Huang.


“黄中丞这一科——道兴十五年乙未，科运如日方中，
“Governor Huang's examination cohort—the yiwei year, the fifteenth of Daoguang—is at the height of its influence.

不说别的，拿江苏来说，何学使以外，还有许中丞，都是同年。
In Jiangsu alone, besides Education Commissioner He, Governor Xu belongs to it.

京里除了彭大军机，六部几乎都有人。
In the capital, apart from Grand Councillor Peng, they have men in almost every ministry.

他老哥替我想想，我到哪里去伸冤讲理？”
Tell me, where could I go to have my grievance heard?”

“大人的劳绩，上头到底也知道的。
“Your service is known above, after all.

吃亏就是便宜，
What seems a loss may prove a gain.

大人存心厚道，后福方长。”
With your generous disposition, Your Excellency has many blessings ahead.”

倪良耀是老实人，对他这两句泛泛的慰词，亦颇感动，
Ni was a simple, honest man and was moved even by these general words of consolation.

不断拱手说道：托福，找福！
Repeatedly clasping his hands, he said, “May your kind words prove true!”

“主人并无送客之意，
He showed no intention of ending the visit.

这算是抬举，王有龄不能不知趣，主动告辞，
That was an honour Wang could not ignore by taking his leave.

便又陪着倪良耀谈了些时局和人物，
He therefore stayed to discuss the political situation and various men in public life.

从他口中，得知何桂清捐输军饷，交部优叙奖励，
From Ni he learned that He Guiqing had contributed to military funds and been referred to the appropriate board for generous recognition.

也常有奏折，建议军务部署，朱笔批示，多所奖许，
He also frequently submitted memorials suggesting military arrangements and received favourable comments in vermilion.

圣眷正隆。
Imperial favour was strong.

这些情形，在五有龄当然是极大的安慰。
Naturally, all this greatly reassured Wang.


辞出天后宫，王有龄在轿子里回想此行的种种，
Leaving the temple, Wang reflected in his chair upon the journey.

无一事不是顺利得出乎意料之外，
Everything had gone more smoothly than he could have expected.

因而心里不免困惑，一个人到底是靠本事，还是靠运气？
He found himself puzzled: did success depend upon ability or luck?

照胡雪岩的情形来说，完全是靠本事，
Hu's achievements appeared entirely due to ability.

想想自己的今天，似乎靠运气。
His own position seemed the work of luck.

这话也不对！他在想，
Yet that was not right either.

胡雪岩本事通天，如果没有自己，此刻自是依然潦倒，
However capable Hu might be, without Wang he would still be in distress.

怀才不遇的人，车载斗量，
There were countless talented men without opportunities.

看来他也要靠运至于自己呢？
Hu too depended on fortune. And what of Wang himself?

如果不是从小习于吏事，以及这一趟从京师南下，好好看了些经世之学的名著，为黄宗汉所赏识，
Had he not learned administrative affairs from childhood and studied important works on statecraft during his journey south from the capital, he would not have won Huang's appreciation.

那么即使有天大的面子，也不过派上个能够捞几个钱的差使，
Even the strongest recommendation would merely have gained him some assignment from which he could make a little money.

黄宗汉决下会把浙江漕米海运的重任，托付给自己。
Huang would never have entrusted him with the weighty task of Zhejiang's sea grain transport.

照此一说，还是要有本事。
Ability, then, was necessary after all.

有本事还要有机会，机会就是运气。
But ability needed opportunity, and opportunity was luck.

想到这里，王有龄的困惑消失了，
At that thought his confusion disappeared.

一个人要发达，也要本事，也要运气。
Success required both.

李广不侯，是有本事没有运气，
Li Guang had never become a marquis because he possessed ability without luck.

运气来了，没有本事，不过昙花一现，好景不长。
Luck without ability would bring only a fleeting flowering of success.

现在是运气来了，要好好拿本事出来，
Now that fortune had arrived, Wang must make good use of ability.

本事在胡雪岩身上，
That ability lay in Hu.

把胡雪岩收服了，他的本事就变成了自己的本事。
If he won Hu over, Hu's talents would become his own.

这样深一层去想，王有龄欣然大有领悟，原来一个人最大的本事就是能用人，
Pursuing the thought, Wang reached a gratifying insight: a man's greatest ability was knowing how to employ others.

用人又先要识人，
Before employing them, he had to recognise their worth.

眼光、手腕，两俱到家，才智之士，乐予为己所用，此人的成就便不得了了。
With judgement and skill in handling people, he could make talented men willing to serve him, and his achievements would be immense.

由于这个了解，王有龄觉得用人的方法要变一变，
He therefore felt that his methods should change.

应该恩威并用，
Kindness must be combined with authority.

特别是对胡雪岩，在感情以外，更加上权术、笼络之道，无微不至。
Particularly with Hu, affection should be reinforced by political skill and the most attentive efforts to secure his allegiance.


半个月的工夫，一切公事都办得妥妥帖帖，
Within half a month, all their official business had been satisfactorily settled.

该要回杭州了。
It was time to return to Hangzhou.

王有龄了为犒劳部属，特设盛宴，
To reward his subordinates, Wang gave a lavish banquet.

宴罢宣布：“各位这一趟都辛苦了，
Afterwards he announced, “You've all worked hard on this journey.

难得到上海来一趟好好玩两天！
We don't often come to Shanghai, so enjoy yourselves for a couple of days.

今天四月初四，
Today is the fourth day of the fourth month.

我们准定初七开船回杭州。”
We shall definitely sail for Hangzhou on the seventh.”

说完，从靴页子里取出一叠红封袋，上面标着名字，
From the inner flap of his boot he took a stack of red envelopes, each bearing a name.

每人一个，连张胖子都不例外，
Everyone received one, Zhang included.

封袋里面是一张银票，
Inside was a bank draft.

数目多寡不等，最多的是周委员那一个，一百两，最少的是那个庶务的，二十两。
The amounts varied: Zhou received the most, a hundred taels; the general affairs officer the least, twenty.

“这是‘杖头钱。”他掉了句文，’
“Money for the end of your travelling staff,” Wang said, using a literary expression.

供各位看花买醉之需。
“To provide for admiring flowers and buying wine.”

“说到“看花”那就是“缠头资”了，
Admiring flowers meant paying courtesans.

周、吴二人已经发觉。阿珠成了胡雪岩的禁脔，不便问津，
Zhou and Wu had already noticed that A'zhu was now regarded as Hu's exclusive concern and could no longer be approached.

好在三多堂各有相好，
Fortunately, each had a favourite at Sanduo Hall.

有钱有工夫，乐得去住两天。
With both money and time, they were happy to spend two days there.

“他也去逛一逛。”王有龄又对高升说，“我要到我亲戚那里去两天，放你的假吧！”高升也有一个红包，是二十两银子。
“You should go and enjoy yourself too,” Wang told Gao, whose red envelope also held twenty taels. “I'm going to stay with my relative for two days. You may take leave.”

托词到亲戚家住，
The relative was an excuse.

其实是住在梅家弄。这个秘密，始终只有胡雪岩一个人知道。
He was staying in Meijia Lane, a secret still known only to Hu.

这一天晚上，王有龄约了他在畹香的妆阁小酌，
That evening he invited Hu to a quiet drink in Wanxiang's room.

有公事以外的“要紧话”要谈。
There were “important matters” beyond official business to discuss.

半个月之中，王有龄来过四越，跟畹香已经打得火热，
In the past fortnight, Wang had visited four times, and their attachment had grown warm.

自己的身分也不再瞒她，
He no longer concealed his identity.

这天要谈的话，就是关于畹香的。
Wanxiang was the subject he wished to discuss.

把她安排好了，王有龄还要替阿珠安排。
After arranging matters for her, he also intended to make arrangements for A'zhu.


他的心思，胡雪岩猜到一半，是关于畹香的，
Hu guessed half his intention: the part concerning Wanxiang.

他心里已经有了一个主意，但觉得不宜冒失。
He already had an idea, but thought it unwise to act rashly.

先要探探畹香的口气，
First he must sound her out.

所以等一端起酒杯就说：“畹香，王大老爷要回去了。”
As soon as they raised their cups, he said, “Wanxiang, His Honour Wang is going home.”

一听这话，她的脸色马上变了，看上去眼圈发红，
Her expression changed at once and her eyes appeared to redden.

也不知她是做作还是真心？
Whether this was acting or sincere feeling was impossible to tell.

不过就算做作，也做得极象，离愁别恨，霎时间在脸上堆起，浓得化不开。
Even if acting, however, it was convincing: sorrow at their parting gathered on her face so thickly that it seemed impossible to dispel.

“哪一天动身？”她问。
“When are you leaving?”

“定了初七。”王有龄回答。
“The seventh,” Wang answered.

“这么急！”畹香失声说道。
“So soon!” she exclaimed.

“今天初四。”
“Today is the fourth.”

胡雪岩屈着手指说：
Hu counted on his fingers.

“初五、初六、还有三天的工夫，
“The fifth, the sixth—there are still three days.

也很从容了。
Plenty of time.

你有什么话，尽管跟王大老爷说，”
If you have anything to say, tell His Honour freely.”

“我！”
“I?”

畹香把头扭了过去，
She turned away.

“叫我说什么？
“What can I say?

我说了也没有用，
Saying it would be useless.

办不到的！”
It can't be done.”

“怎么呢？”
“Why?”

胡雪岩逼进一层，
Hu pressed.

“何以晓得办不到？”
“How do you know it can't?”

畹香把脸转了过来，皱着眉、闭着嘴，长长的睫毛不住眨动，是极为踌躇的样子，
She turned back, frowning, her lips closed and long eyelashes fluttering in apparent indecision.

几次欲语又休，终于只是一声微喟，摇摇头，把一双耳环晃荡个不住。
Several times she seemed about to speak, but finally only sighed and shook her head, setting her earrings swaying.


“有话尽管说呀！”王有龄拉住了她的手说，
“Say whatever you wish,” Wang urged, taking her hand.

“只要我办得到，一定如你的愿，
“If I can do it, I will.

就办不到，我也一定说理由给你听。
If I can't, I'll explain why.

不要紧，说出来商量。”
Don't worry; we can discuss it.”

“跟哪个商量？
“With whom?

只好跟皇帝老爷商量！”
Only His Majesty the Emperor!”

“皇帝老爷”的称呼，在王有龄颇有新奇之感，特别是出以吴侬软语，更觉别有意趣，
Her form of address for the emperor struck Wang as novel, especially in her soft southern accent.

便即笑道：
He smiled.

“有那么了不起，非要皇帝才能有办法？”
“Is it so momentous that only the emperor can solve it?”

“自然罗！”
“Naturally!”

畹香似乎觉得自己极有理，
She seemed entirely convinced.

“除非皇帝老爷有圣旨，让你高升到上海来做官……”
“Unless His Majesty issues an edict promoting you to an appointment in Shanghai...”

原来千回百折，不过要表明舍不得与王有龄相离这句话。
After all these turns, she merely wished to say she could not bear to be parted from him.

本主儿此时不会有所表示，敲边鼓的开口了。
Wang himself offered no answer for the moment; his helper spoke.

“畹香！”胡雪岩问道：“你是心里的话？”
“Wanxiang, do you mean that sincerely?”

“啊呀，胡老爷。”
“Oh, Mr Hu!”

畹香的神色显得很郑重，
She looked very solemn.

“是不是要我把心剜出来给你看。”
“Must I cut out my heart and show it to you?”

“我相信，我相信！”
“I believe you, I believe you!”

王有龄急忙安慰地说。
Wang hastened to reassure her.


“我也相信。”胡雪岩笑嘻嘻地接口：
“So do I,” Hu put in with a smile.

“畹香，初七你跟王大老爷一船回杭州，好不好？
“Wanxiang, why not return to Hangzhou on the same boat as His Honour on the seventh?”

““怎么不好！
“Why wouldn't I?

只怕王大老爷不肯。”
I'm only afraid he wouldn't agree.”

“千肯万肯，
“He agrees a thousand times over.

求之不得！
He could wish for nothing better!

只有三天工夫了，
There are only three days left.

你预备起来！”
Begin your preparations.”

这话连王有龄都有些诧异，
Even Wang was surprised.

为何胡雪岩这等冒失，替人硬作主纳妾？
Why was Hu so rashly deciding on another man's behalf that he should take a concubine?

但以对他发解甚深，暂且不响，静观究竟。
But knowing him well, he said nothing and watched.

王有龄尚县如此，畹香自然格外困惑，而且也有些惊惶，怕弄假成真，变得骑虎难下。
If Wang was surprised, Wanxiang was more bewildered still—and alarmed that pretence might become reality, leaving her unable to retreat.

“怎么样？
“Well?” Hu asked.

是我们当面锣，对面鼓，直接来谈，
“Shall we discuss it directly, face to face?

还是由我找三阿姨去谈？
Shall I speak to Third Aunt?

或者请尤五哥出面？
Or should Brother You intervene?”

“这是谈“身价”，
Now he was talking about the price of releasing her.

越发象真了！
It sounded more real than ever.

畹香不断眨着眼，神态尴尬，但她到底不是初出道的雏儿，
Wanxiang blinked repeatedly and looked awkward, but she was no novice.

正一正脸色，坐了下来，带些欣慰的口气答道：
Composing herself, she sat down and answered with a suggestion of gratification.

“蛮好！
“Very well.

我自家的身体，自己来谈好了。
It's my own person; I can negotiate for myself.

我先要请问王大老爷是怎么个意思？“
First, may I ask what His Honour has in mind?”


王有龄怎么说得出来？
How could Wang possibly answer?

当然是胡雪岩代答，
Naturally, Hu replied for him.

“王大老爷怎么个意思，你还不明白？”他这样反问，
“Don't you already know what he has in mind?”

而其实是一句遁词，
It was an evasion.

他最初就是使的一句诈语，目的是要试探畹香对王有龄究有几许感情？
His original proposal had been a bluff to test the depth of Wanxiang's feeling for Wang.

经此一番折冲，心中已经有数，
Their exchanges had now given him a fair idea.

这时倒是要问一问王有龄了。
It was time to discover Wang's wishes instead.

“我当然明白。”畹香接着他的话，
“Of course I know,” she answered.

“不过我不敢说出来。
“But I don't dare say it aloud.

自己想想没有那么好的福气。”
I can't imagine being so fortunate.”

这一下连王有龄也明白了，如果想把她置于侧室，恐怕未必如愿，
Now even Wang understood that, if he wished to take her as a concubine, she might not agree.

他怕谈下去会出现窘境，彼此无趣，便即宕开一句：
Fearing that further discussion would embarrass them both, he put the matter aside.

“慢慢再谈吧！
“We can talk about it later.

先吃酒。”
Let us drink first.”

这句话与胡雪岩心思正相符，
That suited Hu exactly.

他也觉得畹香的本心已够明白，这方面不须再谈，
He too thought her intentions sufficiently clear and saw no need to pursue the subject.

所以附和着说：“对啊！吃酒，吃酒。
“Yes, let's drink.

有话回头你们到枕上去谈。”
You can discuss the rest in bed later.”

畹香见此光景，知道自己落了下风。
Wanxiang knew she had lost the advantage.

看样子王有龄亦并无真心，
Apparently Wang had no serious intention either.

早知如此，落得把话说漂亮些，
Had she known, she could have made a more generous declaration.

如今变得人家在暗处，自己在亮处，
Now his position remained concealed while hers was exposed.

想趁这三天工夫敲王有龄一个竹杠，只怕办不到了。
Her hope of extracting a large sum during the remaining three days would probably come to nothing.

这都是上了胡雪岩的当！
Hu had tricked her into this.

畹香委屈在心，化作一脸幽怨，默默无言地，使得王有龄大生怜惜之心。
The grievance in her heart became a mournful expression and silence, which greatly stirred Wang's pity.


“怎么？”他轻轻抚着她的肩问：
“What is it?” he asked, gently touching her shoulder.

“一下子不高兴了？”
“Why are you suddenly unhappy?”

这一向，畹香索性哭了，
At the question, she gave herself up to tears.

“嗯哼”一声，用手绢掩着脸，飞快地后后房奔了进去，
With a sob, she covered her face with her handkerchief and hurried into the back room.

接着便是很轻的“息率、息率”的声音传了出来。
Soft weeping followed.

王有龄听得哭声，心里有些难过，自然更多的是感动，
Wang felt distressed and, still more, moved.

要想有所表示，却让胡雪岩阻止住了，
He wanted to do something, but Hu stopped him.

“不要理她！”他轻声说道，
“Leave her,” he said quietly.

“她们的眼泪不值钱，
“Their tears are easily shed.

一想起伤心的事就会哭一场，
Whenever they remember something painful, they can have a cry.

不见得是此刻受了委屈！”
It doesn't necessarily mean she's been hurt just now.”

听了他的话，王有龄爽然若失，
Wang felt suddenly bereft.

觉得他的持论过苛，只是为了表示对他信服，便点点头，坐着不动。
He thought Hu's judgement too harsh, but nodded and remained seated to show his confidence in him.


“雪公！”胡雪岩问道，“你把你的意思说给我听，我替你办。”
“Mr Xuexuan, tell me what you want, and I'll arrange it.”

“我的意思……”
“What I want...”

王有龄沉吟了好半天才说出来：
Wang paused for a long while.

“如果把她弄回家去，怕引起物议。”
“If I brought her home, I'm afraid people would talk.”

他对畹香恋恋之意，已很显然。
His attachment was plain.

胡雪岩觉得他为“官声”着想，态度是不错的，不过也不妨进一步点破：
Hu thought it right that he should consider his official reputation, but felt the point should be made more clearly.

“畹香恐怕也未见得肯到杭州去，讨回家去这一层，大可不必想它。
“Wanxiang may not want to go to Hangzhou either, so there's no need to consider bringing her into your household.

照我看，雪公以后总常有到上海来的时候，
I expect you'll often be coming to Shanghai.

不妨置作外室。
Why not keep her in a separate establishment?

春二三月，或者秋天西湖风景好的时候，把她接到杭州去住一阵子，
In the second or third month of spring, or in autumn when West Lake is at its best, you could bring her to Hangzhou for a while.

我另外替雪公安排‘小房子’。
I'd arrange a small house for you.

你看如何？”
What do you think?”

“好，好，”
“Excellent!”

王有龄深惬所怀，
This exactly suited Wang.

“就拜托你跟她谈一谈，看要花多少钱？”
“Please discuss it with her and find out what it would cost.”

“那不过每月贴她些开销。
“It would only mean contributing to her monthly expenses.

至于每趟来，另外送她钱，或是替她打道饰、做衣裳，那是你们自己的情分，
Any extra money you give her when you visit, or jewellery and clothes you have made for her, would be a matter between you two.

旁人无法过问。“这到这里，胡雪岩向里喊了声：”畹香！“
Nobody else could intervene.” Then Hu called, “Wanxiang!”


畹香慢慢走了出来，
She came out slowly.

得新匀过脂粉，但眼圈依旧是红的，
Her powder and rouge had been renewed, but her eyes were still red.

一副楚楚可怜的样子，偎坐在王有龄身旁，含颦不语。
Looking fragile and pitiful, she sat close to Wang, frowning slightly and saying nothing.

“刚才哭什么？”王有龄问道，
“What were you crying about?” he asked.

“哪个得罪你了？”
“Who offended you?”

“嗳！雪公，这话问得多余。”胡雪岩在一边接口，
“Ah, Mr Xuexuan, there's no need to ask,” Hu interposed.

“畹香的心事，你还不明白？
“Don't you understand her difficulty?

要跟你到杭州，舍不得三阿姨，
If she goes to Hangzhou with you, she can't bear to leave Third Aunt.

不跟你去，心里又不愿。
If she stays, she doesn't want to be parted from you.

左右为难，自然要伤心。
Torn between the two, she naturally feels unhappy.

畹香，我的话说对了没有？”
Am I right, Wanxiang?”

畹香不答他的话，转脸对王有龄说：
Instead of answering him, she turned to Wang.

“你看你，
“Just look at you.

枉为我们相好了一场，你还不如胡老爷明白。”
After all we've meant to each other, you understand less than Mr Hu.”

“这是旁观者清！”王有龄跟她说着话，却向胡雪岩使了个眼色。意思是要他把商量好的办法提出来。
“The bystander sees more clearly,” Wang said, while signalling to Hu to propose their arrangement.

胡雪岩微一颔首，表示会意，同时还报以眼色，请他避开。
Hu gave a slight nod, then returned a glance asking him to leave them alone.

“我有些头晕，
“I'm a little dizzy,” Wang said.

到你床上去靠一靠。”
“I'll lie down on your bed for a while.”

等王有龄歪倒在后房畹香床上，胡雪岩便跟畹香展开了谈判，
Once he had stretched out in the back room, Hu began negotiating with Wanxiang.

问她一个月要多少开销？
How much did she need each month?


“过日子是省的，
“I live quite frugally.

一个月最多二三十两银子。”
Twenty or thirty taels at most.”

“倘或王大老爷一个月帮你三十两银子，你不是就可以关起门来过清静日子了？”
“If His Honour gave you thirty taels a month, could you close your door to visitors and live quietly?”

“那是再好都没有。
“Nothing could be better.

不过……”
But...”

畹香摇摇头，不肯再说下去。
She shook her head and stopped.

“说呀！”胡雪岩问道：
“Go on,” Hu urged.

“是不是有债务？
“Do you have debts?

不妨说来听听。”
You may tell me.”

“真的，再没有比胡老爷更明白的人！”畹香答道：
“Truly, nobody is more understanding than you, Mr Hu.

“哪个不想从良？
Who wouldn't wish to leave this life?

实在有许多难处，
But there are so many difficulties.

跟别人说了，只以为狮子大开口，
If one tells other people, they think one is asking for an outrageous sum.

说出来反而伤感情，
Speaking only harms the friendship.

不如不说。“
Better to say nothing.”


听这语气，开出口来的数目不会小，
From that tone, the sum would not be small.

如果说有一万八千的债务，是不是替她还呢？
If she claimed debts of eighteen thousand taels, should they pay them?

胡雪岩也曾听闻过，有所谓“淴浴”一说，
Hu had heard of a practice called “taking a bath.”

负债累累的红倌人，抓住一个冤大头，枕边海誓山盟，非他不嫁，
A popular courtesan burdened with debts would seize upon a wealthy fool, swear eternal love beside his pillow, and declare that she would marry nobody else.

于是花巨万银子替她还债赎身，真个量珠聘去，
He would spend a fortune paying her debts and buying her release, as though purchasing a bride with pearls.

而此红倌人从了良，早则半载，晚则一年，必定不安于室，想尽花样，下堂求去，
Yet within six months, or a year at most, she would grow restless in married life and devise every means of leaving him.

原来一开始就是个骗局。
It had been a scheme from the beginning.

看畹香还不致如此。
Wanxiang did not appear quite that sort.

但依了她的要求，叫她杜门谢客。怕未见得能言行一致，
Still, even if her demands were met and she agreed to stop receiving clients, her conduct might not match her promise.

招蜂引蝶之余，说起来还是“王某某的外室”，反例坏了王有龄的名声。
If she continued attracting admirers while known as Wang's mistress, his reputation would suffer.

这不是太傻了吗？
Wouldn't that be foolish?

因此，他笑一笑说：
Hu therefore smiled.

“既然你有许多难处，自然不好勉强，
“If you have so many difficulties, naturally we can't press you.

不过你要晓得，王大老爷对你，倒确是真情一片。”
But you should know that His Honour's feeling for you is quite sincere.”

“我也知道，
“I know.

人心都是肉做的。
We all have hearts.

而况有尤五少的面子，我也不敢不巴结，
Besides, with Fifth Master You's standing to consider, I could hardly fail to do my best.

只要王大老爷在这里一天，我一定尽心伺候。”
As long as His Honour is here, I shall certainly attend to him wholeheartedly.”


“到底是见过世面的！说出话来与那些初出道的小姑娘不同。”胡雪岩这样赞她，
“You've clearly seen something of the world,” Hu praised her. “You speak differently from girls just entering the profession.

“我也算是个‘媒人’，说话要替两方面着想。
I suppose I count as a matchmaker, and must consider both sides.

畹香，我看你跟王大老爷，一年做两三次短期夫妻好了。”
Wanxiang, I think you and His Honour should be husband and wife for short periods, two or three times a year.”

她大致懂得他的意思，却故意问一句：“怎么做法？”
She broadly understood, but deliberately asked, “How would that work?”

“譬如说，王大老爷到上海来，就住在你这里，
“For example, when he comes to Shanghai, he stays here.

当然，你要脱空身子来陪他。
Naturally, you make yourself available to keep him company.

或者，高兴了，接你到杭州去烧烧香，逛逛西湖，
Or, if he wishes, he brings you to Hangzhou to offer incense and see West Lake.

不又是做了一阵短期夫妻。
Again, you'd be husband and wife for a little while.

至于平常的开销，一个月贴你二十五两银子，
For ordinary expenses, he'd contribute twenty-five taels a month.

另外总还有些点缀，多多少少，要看你自己的手腕。”
There would certainly be extras as well; how much would depend on your own skill.”

这个办法当然可以接受，
This was certainly acceptable.

“就怕一层，
“Only one thing worries me.

万一王大老爷到上海来，我正好不空。”畹香踌躇着说，
What if His Honour arrives while I'm occupied?” she asked hesitantly.

“那时候会为难。
“That would be awkward.

立了这个门口，来的都是衣食父母，
Once one sets up in this business, every visitor provides one's livelihood.

哪个也得罪不起。
I can't afford to offend any of them.

胡老爷，我这是实话，
Mr Hu, I'm speaking frankly.

你不要见气。”
Please don't be angry.”

“我就是喜欢听实话。”胡雪岩说，
“Frankness is precisely what I like.

“万一前客不让后客，也有个办法，
If an earlier guest won't make way for a later one, there's still a solution.

那时你以王太太的身分，陪王大老爷住栈房，这面只说回乡下去了。
You can stay at an inn with His Honour as Mrs Wang and tell people here that you've gone to the country.

掉这样一个枪花行不行？”
Would that manoeuvre work?”

怎么不行？
Of course it would.

畹香的难题解决，颇为高兴，娇声笑道：
Her difficulty solved, Wanxiang was delighted.

“真正的，胡老爷，你倒象是吃过我们这一行的饭，
“Really, Mr Hu, one would think you'd worked in our profession yourself.

真会掉枪花！”
You know all the tricks!”


“那我替你做‘相帮，好不好？”
“Then shall I become your male attendant?”

妓家的规矩，女仆未婚的称“大姐”，已婚的称“娘姨”，男仆则叫做“相帮”。
In a courtesan household, an unmarried female servant was called an elder sister, a married one an aunt, and a male servant an attendant.

听胡雪岩这一说，畹香才发觉自己大大失言了，
Only at his reply did Wanxiang realise her serious mistake.

哪一行的饭都好吃，说吃这一行饭，无异辱人妻女，
One could speak of working in any other trade, but to say that a man had worked in hers amounted to insulting the women of his family.

遇到脾气不好的客人，尤其是北方人，开到这样的玩笑，当时就可以翻脸，
An ill-tempered client, especially a northerner, might take immediate offence.

所以她涨得满脸通红，赶紧道歉。
She blushed deeply and hurried to apologise.

“胡老爷，大人不记小人过，
“Mr Hu, a great man overlooks a small person's fault.

我说错了话，
I spoke wrongly.

真正该打。”
I truly deserve a beating.”

她握着他的手，拼命推着揉着，不断他说，“胡老爷，你千万不能见气，
Taking his hand, she pressed and rubbed it, repeatedly saying, “You mustn't be angry.

你要如何罚我都可以，只不能生气。”
Punish me however you wish, but please don't be angry.”

声音太大，把王有龄惊动了，忍不住走出来张望，
Her voice grew loud enough to disturb Wang, who could not resist coming out to see what was happening.

只见胡雪岩微笑不语，畹香惶恐满面地在赔罪，
Hu was smiling silently while Wanxiang apologised in alarm.

越觉诧异。
Wang was more puzzled still.

等到说明经过，彼此一笑而罢。
Once the incident was explained, they all laughed and let it pass.

这时畹香的态度又不同了，
Wanxiang's manner changed again.

自觉别具身分，对王胡之间，主客之分，更加明显。
She felt that she now occupied a distinct position, and the division between Wang as host and Hu as guest became more pronounced.

王有龄当然能够感觉得到，
Wang naturally sensed it.

仿佛在自己家里那样，丝毫不觉拘束，
He felt as unrestrained as though in his own home.

因而洗杯更酌，酒兴越发好了。
They rinsed their cups, poured more wine, and drank with renewed pleasure.


“雪岩，我也要问你句话，”他兴味盎然地说，
“Xueyan, I have something to ask you too,” Wang said with lively interest.

“听说阿珠一颗心都在你身上。
“I hear A'zhu's heart is entirely yours.

到底怎么回事？”
What is going on?”

胡雪岩还未开口，畹香抢着问道：阿珠是谁？
Before Hu could answer, Wanxiang asked, “Who is A'zhu?”

““你问他自己。”
“Ask him.”

王有龄指着胡雪岩说。
Wang pointed to Hu.

“船家的一个小姑娘。”他说，
“The boatman's daughter,” Hu replied.

“我现在没有心思搞这些花样。”
“I have no mind for that sort of thing at present.”

语焉不详，未能满足畹香的好奇心，
This vague explanation did not satisfy her curiosity.

她磨着王有龄细说根由。他也就把听来的话，加油加酱地说了给她听。
She pressed Wang for the full story, and he repeated what he had heard, adding considerable embellishment.

中间有说得太离谱的，胡雪岩才补充一两句，作为纠正，
Where he strayed too far from the facts, Hu corrected him with a word or two.

小小的出入就不去管他了。
Minor discrepancies he let pass.


“这好啊！”
“Why, that's splendid!”

畹香十分好事，
Wanxiang was eager to intervene.

“胡老爷我来替你做媒，好不好？”
“Mr Hu, shall I be your matchmaker?”

此言一出，不独胡雪岩，连王有龄亦颇有匪夷所思之感，
Not only Hu but Wang found the proposal extraordinary.

“你跟人家又不认识，”他说，
“You don't even know her,” Wang said.

“这个媒怎么做法？”
“How could you arrange it?”

“不认识怕什么？”畹香答道，
“What does that matter?

“看样子，这件好事要阿珠的娘点头，才会成功，
From the sound of it, the match depends upon her mother's agreement.

而且阿珠好象也有心理，对你们爷们，她是不肯说的，
And A'zhu seems to have something on her mind that she won't tell you men.

只有我去，才能弄得清楚。”
Only if I go can we discover what it is.”

王有龄觉得她的话很有理，
Wang thought this reasonable.

点点头问：“雪岩，你看如何？
Nodding, he asked, “What do you say, Xueyan?

就让畹香来试一试吧！”
Let Wanxiang try.”

“多谢，多谢！”胡雪岩说，
“Thank you, thank you,” Hu answered.

“慢慢再看。”
“We'll see later.”


“我知道了。”
“I understand.”

畹香故意激他，
Wanxiang deliberately provoked him.

“ ‘痴心女子负心汉’，
“A devoted woman and a faithless man!

胡老爷一定不喜欢她！”
You must not care for her.”

“这你可是冤枉他了。”王有龄笑着说，
“Now you're wronging him,” Wang laughed.

“胡老爷一有空就躲在船上，
“Whenever he has a free moment, he hides away on the boat.

与阿珠有说不完的话。”
He and A'zhu never run out of things to say.”

“既如此还不接回家去？
“Then why doesn't he take her home?

莫非大太太厉害？”
Is the first wife formidable?”

“那可以另外租房子，住在外面。”
“He could rent another house and let her live separately.”

“对啊！”
“Exactly!”

畹香逼视着胡雪岩问：
Wanxiang looked directly at Hu.

“胡老爷，易求无价宝，难得有情人！”
“Priceless treasure is easier to find than a loving heart.”

“我也这么想。”
“That's what I think too.”

王有龄接着便提高了声音念道：“ ‘是前生注定事，莫错过姻缘’！”两个人一吹一唱，交替着劝他，
Wang raised his voice and recited, “What was ordained in a former life—do not let the destined marriage pass!” They urged him on in turn, each supporting the other.

他已打定了主意，但有许多话不便当着畹香说，
Hu had made up his mind, but there was much he could not say in Wanxiang's presence.

所以只是含笑摇头。
He only smiled and shook his head.

看他既不受劝，畹香也只好废然而罢。
Seeing that he would not be persuaded, she finally abandoned the attempt.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（上）》第五章（完整）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume I — the complete Chapter Five

第五章｜CHAPTER FIVE


船到杭州，王有龄回家歇得一歇，随即换了官服，去谒见抚台，
When the boats reached Hangzhou, Wang rested briefly at home, changed into official robes, and went to see the governor.

当面禀报了此行的经过，同时呈上一封信：黄宗汉老家的回信，两万两银子业经妥收。
He personally reported the journey and presented a letter from Huang's family acknowledging safe receipt of the twenty thousand taels.

这趟差使，公私两方面都办得极其漂亮，
Both the public and private aspects of the assignment had been handled handsomely.

黄宗汉异常满意。
Huang was exceedingly pleased.

“你辛苦了！
“You've worked hard.

我心里有数。”他说，
I know what you've done,” he said.

“我自有打算，
“I have plans of my own.

几天以内，就有信息。”
You'll hear something within a few days.”

“是！”
“Yes, Your Excellency.”

王有龄不敢多问，
Wang dared not inquire further.

辞出抚署，接着又去谒见藩司麟桂。
Leaving the governor's yamen, he went to call on Treasurer Lingui.

麟桂对王有龄，因为顾忌着黄宗汉难惹的缘故，本来抱的是敬鬼神而远之的态度，
Knowing how difficult Huang could be, Lingui had previously treated Wang rather like a spirit best respected from a distance.

好也罢，歹也罢，反正天塌下来有长人顶，
Whether things went well or badly, someone taller would hold up the falling sky.

自己不求有功，但求无过，凡事不生麻烦就够了。
He sought no merit, only freedom from blame and trouble.

及至看他此行办得圆通周到，而且颇懂“规矩”，已觉喜出望外，
Now Wang's tactful, thorough handling of the journey, together with his understanding of the “rules,” had exceeded Lingui's hopes.

加以有同委员替他吹嘘，越发刮目相看。
Zhou's praise made him regard Wang more highly still.

等把手本一递进去，立即使传下话来：“请王大老爷换了便衣，在签押房相见。”
As soon as the visiting card went in, a message came out: “Ask His Honour Wang to change into ordinary clothes and meet me in my private office.”

这是接待地位仿佛而交情特深的朋友的方式，
This was how one received an intimate friend of roughly equal standing.

王有龄知道，是周委员替自己说了好话的效验，而收服了周委员，又是胡雪岩的功劳。
Wang knew that Zhou's favourable account had produced the result, and that Hu deserved the credit for winning Zhou over.

想到他，再想到麟桂的优礼有加，顿时有了一个主意，要请麟桂来保荐胡雪岩。
Thinking of Hu and of Lingui's exceptional courtesy, he suddenly had an idea: he would ask Lingui to recommend Hu for advancement.


在签押房彼此以便眼相见，
They met in ordinary clothes in the private office.

旗人多礼，麟桂拉着王有龄的手，从旅途顺适问到“府上安好”，这样亲热了一番，才把他让到西屋去坐。
The Manchus were ceremonious, and Lingui took Wang's hand, asked whether the journey had gone smoothly and whether everyone at home was well, then, after these affectionate greetings, led him into the western room.

签押房是一座小院落，一明两暗三间平房，正中算是小客厅，
The office occupied a small courtyard, with a single-storey building of three rooms: an open central reception room and an enclosed room on either side.

东屋签押办公，西屋才是麟桂日常坐起之处，
Documents were signed and business conducted in the eastern room; the western was Lingui's everyday sitting room.

掀开门帘，就看见红木炕床上。摆着一副烟盘，
As the curtain lifted, Wang saw an opium tray on a rosewood couch.

一个长辫子，水蛇腰的丫头刚点起一盏明晃晃的“太谷灯”。
A maid with a long plait and slender waist had just lit a bright Taigu lamp.

“请！”麟桂指着炕床上首说。
“Please,” Lingui said, indicating the upper end of the couch.

“大人自己请吧！”
“You take it, Your Excellency.”

王有龄笑道，
Wang smiled.

“我享不来这份福！”
“I don't know how to enjoy that pleasure.”

“不会也好。”
“It's just as well that you don't.”

麟桂不说客套说。
Lingui dispensed with polite pretence.

“说实在的，这玩意儿益处少，害处多。
“In truth, the stuff does more harm than good.

不过，你不妨陪我躺一躺。”
But you can lie down and keep me company.”

这倒无妨，
That was harmless enough.

能不上瘾。躺烟盘是件很有趣的事，而能够并头隔着荧荧一火说话，交情也就会不同。
Provided one did not become addicted, conversation beside an opium tray could be entertaining, and lying head to head across the little flame could deepen a friendship.

所以王有龄欣然应诺，在下首躺了下去。
Wang readily agreed and reclined at the lower end.

那个俏伶伶的丫头，马上走过来捧住他的脚，脱下靴子，拉一张方凳把他的双足搁好，接着拿床俄国毯子为他围住下半身。
The pretty maid immediately held his feet, removed his boots, arranged a square stool beneath them, and covered his lower body with a Russian blanket.


另有个丫头已经端来了四个小小的果碟子，两把极精致的小茶壶。
Another maid brought four small dishes of fruit and two exquisite little teapots.

在烟盘上放好，随即使坐在小凳子上打烟。
Setting them beside the tray, she sat on a low stool to prepare the opium.

装好一筒，把那支镶翠的象牙烟枪往王有龄唇边送了过来。
Once a pipe was filled, she offered its jade-inlaid ivory stem to Wang's lips.

“请你们老爷抽。
“Give it to your master.

我不会。”
I don't smoke.”

麟桂当仁不让，一口气把烟抽完，拿起滚烫的茶壶喝了一口，再拈一粒松子糖塞在嘴里，
Lingui accepted without ceremony, finished the pipe in one sustained breath, drank from the hot teapot, and put a pine-nut sweet into his mouth.

然后慢慢从鼻孔喷着烟，闭上眼睛，显得飘飘欲仙似地。
Then, slowly letting smoke escape through his nostrils, he closed his eyes as though transported.

“雪轩兄！”麟桂开始谈到正事，“你这一趟，替浙江很挣了面子。
“Brother Xuexuan,” he began, turning to business, “you've done Zhejiang great credit on this journey.

公事都象老兄这么顺利，我就舒服了。”
If all official business went as smoothly as yours, I could live comfortably.”

“这也全靠大人的荫庇。”王有龄说，
“It was entirely due to Your Excellency's support.

“总要长官信任，属下才好放手去干。”
Subordinates can act freely only when their superiors trust them.”

“也要先放心，才好放手。
“One must first feel secure before allowing a free hand.

说老实话，我对你老兄再放心不过，
Frankly, I couldn't feel more secure about you.

凡事有抚台在那里抗着，你怎么说怎么好。”麟桂又说，“抚台也是很精明的人，
With the governor standing behind everything, whatever you propose is acceptable.” Lingui added, “The governor is a shrewd man too.

将心比心，一定也会照应我。”
If he puts himself in my position, he's certain to look after me.”

说了这一句，他抽第二筒，
He smoked a second pipe.

王有龄把他的话在心里琢磨了一阵，觉得他后半段话的言外之意，是要自己在伺候抚台以外，也别忘了该有他应得的一份。
Wang considered his words and concluded that the latter remark meant he must not forget Lingui's proper share while attending to the governor.

其实这话是用不着他说的，胡雪岩早就替他想到了。
In fact, there was no need to say it: Hu had already thought of that.


不过王有龄做官，已学得一个决窍，不有为外人所知的事，必须要做得密不通风，
But Wang had learned one principle of official life: anything not meant for outsiders' knowledge must be kept completely secret.

所以虽然一榻相对，只因为有个打烟的丫头在，他亦不肯有所表示。
Though they faced each other on the same couch, the presence of the maid preparing the pipe prevented him from making any sign.

“说得是。”王有龄这样答道：
“Quite so,” he answered.

“做事要遇着两种长官，
“There are two sorts of superior one hopes to serve.

最好当然是象大人这样，仁厚宽大，体恤部属，
The best is naturally someone like Your Excellency, generous, tolerant, and considerate of his subordinates.

不得已而求其次，倒宁愿在黄抚台手下，
Failing that, I would prefer Governor Huang.

虽然精明，到底好歹是非是极分明的。”
Shrewd though he is, he certainly knows merit from fault and right from wrong.”

“知道好歹是不错，
“Merit from fault, perhaps.

说‘是非分明’，只怕不见得。
Right from wrong—not necessarily.”

‘麟桂说了这话，却又后悔，”
Lingui regretted the remark as soon as he made it.

雪轩兄。“他故意说反话，”这些话，你得便不妨在抚台面前提一提。
“Brother Xuexuan,” he added with deliberate irony, “you might mention these words to the governor when you have a chance.”

“王有龄也极机警，
Wang was quick to respond.

“这可敬谢不敏了！”他笔着回答，
“That is an honour I must decline!” he said with a smile.

“我从不爱在人背后传话。
“I never care to carry tales behind people's backs.

无端生出多少是非，于人有损，于己无益，
It causes needless trouble, harms others, and benefits oneself not at all.

何苦来哉！”
Why do it?”

麟桂对他这个表示。印象深刻，心里便想：
The answer impressed Lingui deeply.

此人确是八面玲珑，
This man truly knew how to handle every situation.

可以放心。
He could be trusted.


由于心理上的戒备已彻底解除，谈话无所顾忌，兴致也就越发好了。
With his last psychological guard removed, Lingui spoke without reserve and with increasing pleasure.

你谈到京里的许多情形，六部的规矩“则例”，让王有龄长了许多见识。
He discussed conditions in the capital and the rules and precedents of the six ministries, greatly enlarging Wang's knowledge.

最后又谈到公事，
Finally he returned to official business.

“今年新漕，还要上紧。
“We must press ahead with this year's new grain.

江浙的赋额独重，而浙江实在不比江苏。
Jiangsu and Zhejiang bear exceptionally heavy tax quotas, yet Zhejiang is really no match for Jiangsu.

杭、嘉、湖哪里比得上苏、松、太？
How can Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou compare with Suzhou, Songjiang, and Taicang?

杭、嘉、湖三府又以湖州为王，偏偏湖州的公事最难办。”麟桂叹口气说：
Of our three prefectures, Huzhou is the richest, but its affairs are the hardest to manage.” He sighed.

“湖州府误漕撤任，一时竟找不着人去接手。
“The prefect of Huzhou has been dismissed for delaying the grain, and for the moment I can't find anyone to take over.

真叫人头疼！”
A real headache!”

椿寿一条命就送在湖州，麟桂对此不能不具戒心。
Chunshou had lost his life over Huzhou, so Lingui could not help being wary.

王有龄知道其中的症结，但谈下去怕谈到椿寿那一案，诸多未便，
Wang understood the difficulty, but feared that pursuing it would lead to Chunshou's case and all its awkward implications.

所以他只作倾听的样子，没有接口。
He merely listened.

“我倒有个主意！”麟桂忽然冒出来这么一句，却又沉吟不语，
“I do have an idea!” Lingui suddenly exclaimed, then fell silent.

好半天才自问自答地说：
After a long pause, he answered himself.

“不行！
“No.

办不通，
It won't work.

没有这个规矩。”
There's no precedent.”

也不知他说的什么？王有龄百思不解，可也不便去问。
Wang could not imagine what he meant, but it was not his place to ask.

就这冷场的片刻，麟桂二十四筒鸦片烟抽完，吩咐开饭。
During the ensuing silence, Lingui finished his twenty-fourth pipe and ordered dinner.

丫头退了出去传话，
The maids went out to pass on the instruction.

眼前别无他人，可以把那样东西拿出来了。
With nobody else present, Wang could produce what he had brought.


“我替大人带了个小玩意来！”王有龄一面说，
“I've brought Your Excellency a little curiosity.”

一面从贴身衣袋里取出个纸包，隔着烟灯，递了过去。
From an inner pocket he took a paper parcel and passed it across the opium lamp.

打开一看，是个极精致的皮夹子，皮质极软，
Inside was an exquisite wallet of exceptionally soft leather.

看那花纹就知道是西洋来的，
Its pattern immediately showed that it came from the West.

麟桂把玩了外表，要打开看看里面时，王有龄又开口了。
Lingui examined the outside and was about to open it when Wang spoke again.

“回头再打开吧！”
“Perhaps later.”

显然的，其中别有花样，
Plainly there was something special within.

麟桂笑一笑说声：“多谢！”随即把皮夹了揣在身上。
Lingui smiled, thanked him, and put it away.

等开饭时，托故走了出去，悄悄启视，
When dinner was served, he excused himself, slipped outside, and opened it privately.

皮夹子里是一张五千两的银票。
The wallet held a bank draft for five thousand taels.

王有龄做得极秘密，麟桂却不避他的底下人，
Wang had acted in great secrecy, but Lingui showed no concern about his servants.

走进来肃客入座，第一句就说：“受惠甚多！
Returning to invite his guest to the table, his first words were, “I am much indebted to you.

粮道那里怎么样？”
What about the grain intendant?”

“也有些点缀。”
“A little something for him too.”

“多少？”
“How much?”

“三数。”
“Three.”

这是说粮道那里送了三千两。
He meant three thousand taels.

麟桂点点头，
Lingui nodded.

又问：“送去了？”
“Delivered already?”

“还没有。”王有龄答道，
“Not yet.

“我自然要先来见了大人，再去拜他。”
Naturally, I had to call on Your Excellency before visiting him.”

“今天是来不及了，
“It's too late today.

明天早些去吧！
Go early tomorrow.

他在这上面看得很重。”
He takes these matters very seriously.”


这完全自己人关爱的口吻，
The tone was that of affectionate advice to one of his own people.

王有龄觉得麟桂对自己的态度又进了一层，
Wang felt that their relationship had advanced another step.

便以感激的声音答道：“多谢大人指点。”
“Thank you for the guidance, Your Excellency,” he answered gratefully.

“把‘大人’两个字收起来行不行？”
“Could you put away that ‘Your Excellency’?”

麟桂放下酒杯，皱着眉说，
Lingui set down his wine cup and frowned.

“俗不可耐，败人的酒兴。”
“It's unbearably commonplace and spoils the pleasure of drinking.”

王有龄微笑着答说：
Wang smiled.

“恭敬不如从命，
“Obedience is better than ceremony.

我敬称‘麟公’。
I shall call you Mr Lin, with every respect.

请干一杯！”
Let us drink a cup!”

“好，好！”
“Excellent!”

麟桂欣然引杯，随即又说：“我刚才的话还没有完。
Lingui drank gladly, then continued, “I hadn't finished what I was saying.

他可晓得粮道有个癖好？”
Do you know the grain intendant's particular passion?”

“噢。我倒不知道，
“No.

得要请教麟公。”
I must ask you to enlighten me.”

“其实这癖好，人人都有，只以此公特甚。”
“In fact, everyone shares it, but his case is exceptional.”

麟桂笑道，
Lingui smiled.

“他好的是‘男儿膝下’！”
“He loves what lies beneath a man's knees.”

王有龄愣住了，不知道他打的是什么哑谜？
Wang was baffled by the riddle.

“足下才大如海，
“Your learning is as broad as the sea.

怎么这句歇后语就把你难住了？”
Can this unfinished proverb defeat you?”

原来如此？
So that was it!

俗语说：“男儿膝下有黄金”，
The saying ran, “There is gold beneath a man's knees.”

隐下的是“黄金”二字。
The unspoken words were “there is gold.”

旗人掉书袋，有时不伦不类，
The Manchus' attempts at literary wit could sometimes be oddly contrived.

王有龄倒真的好笑了。
Wang was genuinely amused.


“所以我劝我不必送银票，
“So I advise you not to send a bank draft.

兑换了金叶子送去。”
Exchange it for gold leaf.”

麟桂是说笑话的神精，有着忍俊不禁的愉悦，
Lingui could scarcely suppress his amusement.

“听说此人每天临睡以前，以数金叶子为快，
“They say he delights in counting his gold sheets every night before bed.

否则忽忽如有所失，一夜不能安枕。”
Otherwise he feels something is missing and cannot sleep peacefully.”

“这倒是怪癖！”
“That is a curious habit.

王有龄问道，“如果出远门怎么办呢？
What happens when he travels?” Wang asked.

也带着金叶子上路？
“Does he take the gold with him?

岂非慢藏海盗？
Wouldn't that invite thieves?”

“那就不知道了。”
“That I don't know.”

讲过笑话，又谈正题，
Their joking over, they returned to business.

麟桂问起上海官场的情形，
Lingui asked about official circles in Shanghai.

王有龄把倪良耀的委屈和牢骚，以及答应照料他的眷属的话，都告诉了麟桂。
Wang told him of Ni's grievances and complaints and his own promise to look after Ni's family.

“这件事我不好说什么！”麟桂这样回答：
“I can say nothing about that,” Lingui replied.

“甚至倪某的眷属，我也不便去管。
“I can't even concern myself with Ni's family.

我知道，抚台的疑心病很重。”
I know how suspicious the governor is.”


“是的。”
“Yes.”

“所以我劝你，就是照料倪良耀的眷属，也只好偷偷摸摸，别让抚台知道。”
“So I advise you to look after them discreetly and keep it from the governor.”

麟桂放低了声音又说，
Lingui lowered his voice.

“我实在不明白，我们这位黄大人何以如此刻薄？
“I truly don't understand why our Mr Huang is so harsh.

江苏藩司与浙江巡抚何干？
What has the treasurer of Jiangsu to do with the governor of Zhejiang?

把人折腾得那个样子？
Why torment him like that?

还有件事，更不应该……”
And there's something else, even less defensible...”

麟桂说到紧要关头，忽然住口，
At the crucial point he stopped.

这自然是因为这句话关系甚重，碍着王有龄是黄宗汉的红人，还有些不放心的缘故。
Plainly the matter was important enough that Wang's status as Huang's favourite still troubled him.

了解到这一点，王有龄便不如追问，
Understanding this, Wang thought it better not to press.

举杯相敬，心里思索着如何把话题扯了开去？
He raised his cup and considered how to change the subject.

麟桂倒觉得不好意思了，
Lingui, however, felt embarrassed.

“跟你说了吧！”他说，
“I may as well tell you.

“他有件损人利己的事，
He's done something to benefit himself at another man's expense.

利己应该，损人就要看一看，
Looking after oneself is natural enough, but one ought to consider whom one harms.

伤了自己的同年，未免太不厚道。”
To injure a man from one's own examination cohort is hardly generous.”

黄宗汉是伤了哪一个同年？
Which fellow graduate had Huang injured?

他们这一科的飞黄腾达，全靠同年能和衷共济，互相照应。
Their cohort's remarkable advancement depended upon mutual support.

黄宗汉本人，不也靠大军机彭蕴章和何桂清这两个同年替他斡旋掩遮，逼死藩司椿寿一案，才得安然无事？
Had Huang himself not relied upon Grand Councillor Peng Yunzhang and He Guiqing to intercede and shield him in the case of Chunshou's forced suicide?

因此，王有龄对麟桂所说的话，有些将信将疑。
Wang therefore half doubted Lingui's story.


“前些日子有道关于江浙防务的上谕，”麟桂问道，
“There was an edict recently about the defence of Jiangsu and Zhejiang,” Lingui asked.

“不知你看到了没有？”
“Did you see it?”

“没有。”王有龄说，
“No.

“我人在上海，好久未见邸抄了。”
I was in Shanghai and haven't read the court bulletins for some time.”

“那道上谕是这么说，‘浙江巡抚黄宗汉奏陈，拨兵赴江苏，并防堵浙省情形。’
“It said: ‘Governor Huang Zonghan of Zhejiang reports the dispatch of troops to Jiangsu and arrangements for preventing an incursion into Zhejiang.’

得旨：”甚妥！
The imperial response was: ‘Excellent.

现今军务，汝若有见到之处，即行具奏。不必分彼此之见。
In the present military affairs, submit any useful observations you may have without distinguishing between the concerns of one province and another.’”

‘“听他念完这道上谕，王有龄又惊又喜，
Wang listened with surprise and delight.

派兵出省击敌，本是他的建议，
Sending troops beyond the provincial boundary to meet the enemy had been his suggestion.

原来黄宗汉竟已采纳，更想不到竟蒙天语褒奖！
Huang had adopted it—and, more unexpectedly, received imperial praise!

也因为如此，他要辩护：
He therefore felt bound to defend it.

“拨兵出省，似乎也没有什么不对。”
“There seems nothing wrong with sending troops beyond the province.”

“对呀！
“Indeed!

没有人说不对。
Nobody says there is.

只是你做浙江的官，管浙江的事好了，
But an official of Zhejiang should attend to Zhejiang's affairs.

上谕虽有‘不必分彼此之见’的话，我们自己要有分寸，不可越俎代庖。
Even if the edict says not to distinguish between provinces, we must observe proper limits and not take over another man's duties.

黄抚台却不问青红皂白，左一个折子、右一个折子，说江苏的军务，该如何如何部署，
Yet Governor Huang sends memorial after memorial, indiscriminately telling the throne how Jiangsu's military affairs should be arranged.

请问，”麟桂凑身向前，“叫你老哥，做了江苏巡抚，心里作何感想？”
Tell me,” Lingui leaned forward, “if you were governor of Jiangsu, how would you feel?”

王有龄这才明白，
Now Wang understood.

黄宗汉为了自己的“圣眷”，不为他的同年江苏巡抚许乃钊留作地，
For the sake of imperial favour, Huang was leaving no room for his fellow graduate Xu Naizhao, governor of Jiangsu.

这实在说不过去。
That was indefensible.

而且他这样搞法，似乎是企图调任江苏。
His conduct also suggested an ambition to be transferred there.

果然如此，更为不智，
If so, it was still less wise.

江苏诚然是海内膏腴之地，但一打仗就不好了。
Jiangsu was certainly one of the empire's richest regions, but war made it an undesirable posting.

遇到机会，倒要劝劝他。
If an opportunity arose, Wang ought to advise him against it.


麟桂不知他心中另有想法，见他不即开口，当他不以为然，
Unaware of these further thoughts, Lingui mistook Wang's silence for disagreement.

便但率问道：“雪轩兄。你觉得我的话如何？”
He asked frankly, “Brother Xuexuan, what do you think of what I've said?”

王有龄这才醒悟，怕引起误会，赶紧答道：
Wang came to himself and hurried to prevent a misunderstanding.

“大人存心忠厚，所持的自然是正论。
“Your Excellency's intentions are generous, and your view is naturally just.

只是我人微言轻，
Unfortunately, my position is too insignificant for my words to carry weight.

不然倒要相机规谏。”
Otherwise I would find an opportunity to advise him.”

“不必，不必！”
“No need!”

麟桂摇着手说，
Lingui waved his hands.

“这是我把你老哥当作好朋友，说的知心话。
“I'm speaking in confidence because I regard you as a good friend.

不必让第三个人知道。”
Nobody else need hear of it.”

“那当然。”
“Of course.”

王有龄郑重表示。
Wang was solemn.

“大人所说的话，我一句不敢外泄。
“I wouldn't dare repeat a word of what you've said.

不过既见于明发上谕，就是我跟抚台说了，他也不会疑心到别人头上的。”
But since the matter appears in a publicly issued edict, even if I spoke to the governor, he would have no reason to suspect anyone else.”

“那倒随你。”麟桂又说，
“That is up to you.

“许家虽是杭州巨室，与我并无干涉，
The Xu family is prominent in Hangzhou, but has no connection with me.

我也不过就事论事，说一句公道话而已。”
I'm merely judging the matter and speaking fairly.”

这个话题就此抛开，
The subject was dropped.

酒已差不多了。王有龄请主人“赏饭”，吃完随即告辞，
They had drunk enough, so Wang asked his host for rice, ate, and took his leave.

麟桂知道他行装甫卸，家里还有许多事，也不留他，
Knowing that he had only just returned and must have much to do at home, Lingui did not detain him.

亲自送到中门，尽欢而散。
He personally escorted him to the middle gate, and they parted in good spirits.


第二天又拜了一天客，凡是稍有交情的，无下有“土仪”馈赠，
Wang spent the following day making more calls, bringing gifts to everyone with whom he had even a slight acquaintance.

从上海来，所谓“土仪”实在是洋货。
Coming from Shanghai, these “local products” were in fact foreign goods.

海禁初开，
Maritime trade had only recently opened.

西洋的东西，在它本国不值钱，一到了中华，便视为奇珍，
Objects worth little in their Western countries became rare treasures in China.

哪怕一方麻纱手帕，受者无不另眼相看。
Even a linen handkerchief won unusual appreciation.

因此，这趟客拜下来，王有龄的人缘又结了不少。
The round of visits therefore gained Wang many more friends.

到晚回家，胡雪岩正在客厅里，逗着王有龄的小儿子说笑。
When he returned home that evening, Hu was in the reception room, joking with his young son.

不过一天不见，王有龄便如遇见多年不晤的知交一般，心里觉得有好些话，亟待倾吐。
They had been apart for only a day, yet Wang felt as though meeting an old friend after years of separation, with a great deal he urgently wished to say.

“你吃了饭没有？”他问。
“Have you eaten?”

“没有。”胡雪岩说，
“No.

“我原意想邀雪公到城隍山上去吃油蓑饼，现在天晚了，不行了。”
I meant to invite you up City God Hill for yousuobing cakes, but it's too late now.”

王有龄对这个提议，深感光趣，
The suggestion appealed to Wang.

“不晚！”他说，
“Not too late!

“快夏至了，白天正长，而且天也暖和，
The summer solstice is approaching, the days are long, and the weather is warm.

就晚了也不要紧。
Even if it gets late, it doesn't matter.

怎么走法？”
How shall we go?”

“总不能鸣锣喝道而去吧！”胡雪岩笑着说。
“Surely not with gongs and cries to clear the road!” Hu laughed.

王有龄也自觉好笑，
Wang was amused too.

“当然换了便衣去。”他说，
“Naturally, I'll change into ordinary clothes.

“我的意思是连轿子也不必坐，也不必带人，
I meant that we needn't even take a chair or servants.

就安步当车走了去。”
We can walk.”

“那也好。
“Good.

戴上一副墨晶眼镜，遇见熟人也可不必招呼。”
Put on dark crystal spectacles, and you needn't greet acquaintances if we meet any.”

于是王有龄换上一件宝蓝缎袍，套一件玄色贡缎背心，竹布袜、双梁鞋，
Wang changed into a sapphire-blue satin robe with a dark tribute-satin waistcoat, light cotton socks, and double-ridged shoes.

戴上墨晶大眼镜，捏了一把折扇，与胡雪岩两个人潇潇洒洒地，取道大井巷，直上城隍山。
Wearing his large dark spectacles and carrying a folding fan, he walked with Hu through Dajing Lane and straight up City God Hill, both looking at ease.


“还是我们第一次见的那地方喝茶吧！”他说，
“Let's have tea where we first met,” Wang said.

“君子不忘本，
“A gentleman doesn't forget his beginnings.

今天好好照顾他一下。”
We ought to give him some good custom today.”

这个“他”，自是指那个茶座的老板。
By “him,” he meant the proprietor of the tea place.

这是他距胡雪岩第二次来，但处境与心境与第一次有天渊之别。
This was Wang's second visit with Hu, but his circumstances and state of mind were worlds apart from the first.

一坐下来，四面眺望、神闲气静，
Once seated, he looked about calmly and contentedly.

一年不到的工夫，自是湖山不改，但他看出去仿佛改过了，
Less than a year had passed; the lake and hills were unchanged, yet to his eyes they seemed transformed.

“西子”格外绰约，青山格外妩媚。
West Lake, the beautiful Xizi, looked more graceful, and the green hills more charming.

“两位吃酒、吃茶？”
“Wine or tea, gentlemen?”

老板看他们的气派、服饰，不敢怠慢，亲自走来招呼。
Their bearing and clothes made the proprietor unwilling to neglect them, and he came himself.

“茶也要，酒也要。”
“Both.”

王有龄学着杭州腔说：
Wang imitated the Hangzhou accent.

“新茶上市了，
“The new tea is on sale.

你说说看，有点儿啥个好茶叶？”
Tell us what good leaves you have.”

“太贵重的，不敢顶备，
“I don't dare keep anything too costly in stock.

要去现买。”
I'd have to buy it specially.”

“现买就不必了。”
“No need for that.”

王有龄想了好久说：“来壶菊花。”
After thinking for a long time, Wang said, “Bring a pot of chrysanthemum tea.”

那茶座老板看王有龄有些奇怪，
The proprietor found him odd.

先问好茶叶，弄到头来喝壶菊花，
He had begun by asking for fine tea and ended with chrysanthemums.

看起来是个说大话，用小钱的角色。
Apparently he was a man of grand words and small expenditure.


不但他诧异，胡雪岩也是如此，问道：
Hu too was surprised.

“怎么喝菊花？”
“Why chrysanthemum?”

“我想了半天才想起来，
“It took me a while to remember.

去年就是喝的菊花。”
That's what I drank last year.”

这话只有胡雪岩心里明白，
Only Hu understood.

回首前尘，不免也有些感慨，不过他一向是只朝前看，不暇后顾的性情，
The recollection stirred him as well, but his nature was to look ahead, with little time for the past.

所以旋即抛开往事，管自己点菜：
He quickly set it aside and ordered the meal.

“一鸡三吃，醋鱼‘带鬓’，
“One chicken prepared three ways; vinegar fish prepared daibin.

有没有活鲫鱼，斤把重的？”
Do you have a live crucian carp, about a jin in weight?”

“我到山下去弄一条。
“I can get one from below the hill.

是不是做汤？”
For soup?”

“对，奶汤鲫鱼，
“Yes, crucian carp in milky broth.

烫两碗竹叶青，弄四个小碟子。带几张油蓑饼，先吃起来。”
Warm two bowls of Zhuyeqing, bring four small dishes and a few yousuobing cakes, and we'll begin.”

“好的，
“Certainly.

马上就来。”
They'll be here at once.”

等把茶泡了来，王有龄端杯在手，望着暗青淡紫的暮霭，
When the tea arrived, Wang held his cup and gazed at the dark blue-green and pale purple of the evening haze.

追想去年在此地的光景，忽然感情激动了。
Remembering his circumstances here the previous year, he was suddenly overcome by feeling.

“雪岩！”他用非常有劲道的声音说，“我们两个人合在一起，何事不可为？
“Xueyan,” he said with great force, “with the two of us together, what couldn't we accomplish?

真要好好干一下。”
We must really make something of it.”

“我也这么想，”胡雪岩说，
“That's my thought too.

“今天来就想跟你谈这件事。”
It's what I came to discuss with you today.”


“你说，你说！”
“Tell me!”

“我想仍旧要干老本行。”
“I still want to return to my old trade.”

“不是回信和吧？”
“Not to Xinhe, I hope?”

王有龄半开玩笑地，
Wang was half joking.

说实在话，他还真怕信和的东家把胡雪岩请了回去。
In truth, he did fear that Xinhe's proprietor might persuade Hu to return.

“我早已说过了，一不做‘回汤豆腐’，二是自己立个门户。”胡雪岩说，
“I've already said it: I won't be bean curd warmed over in the same broth, and I mean to set up for myself.

“现在因为打仗的关系，银价常常有上落，
With the war, silver prices are constantly moving.

只要眼光准，兑进兑出，两面好嫌，
With sound judgement, one can profit on both buying and selling.

机会不可惜过。”
We mustn't miss the opportunity.”

王有龄不响，
Wang said nothing.

箸下如雨，只管吃那一碟发芽豆。
His chopsticks moved incessantly over a dish of sprouted beans.

胡雪岩知道，不是他喜爱此物，而是心里有所盘算。
Hu knew it was not fondness for the dish: he was calculating.

盘算的当然是资本，
Naturally, he was thinking about capital.

其实不必他费心思，资本从哪里来？他早就筹划好了，
There was no need, for Hu had already planned where it would come from.

不过自己不便先开口而已。
But he could not conveniently say so first.

那一个终于开口了：
Wang eventually spoke.

“雪岩！”说句老买话，我现在不原意你去开钱庄。
“Xueyan, frankly, I don't want you opening a bank just now.

目前是要你帮我，帮我也等于帮你自己。
I need your help, and helping me means helping yourself.

你好不好捐个功名，到哪里跟我在一起，
Couldn't you purchase an official qualification and stay with me wherever I go?

抚台已经有话了，最近还有别样安排，
The governor has already spoken of another arrangement shortly.

大概总是再派我兼一个差，那时我越加要帮手，
Presumably he'll give me an additional assignment, and then I'll need help all the more.

你总不能看着我顾此失彼，袖手不问吧？
You can't stand aside and watch me neglect one thing while attending to another.”

““这我早就想到了。
“I've thought of that already.

开钱庄归开钱庄，帮你归帮你，
Opening a bank is one matter, helping you another.

我两样都照顾得来，
I can manage both.

你请放心好了。”
Rest assured.”

“当然，
“Of course.

你的本事我是再清楚不过，
Nobody knows your ability better than I.

不会不放心……”
Naturally I trust you...”


看到他口不应心，依旧不以为然的神情，胡雪岩便放低了声音说：
Seeing that his words did not match his continuing reluctance, Hu lowered his voice.

“雪公，你现在刚刚得意，
“You've only just begun to succeed, Mr Xuexuan.

但说句老实话，外面还不大晓得，
Frankly, people outside don't yet know much about you.

所以此刻我来开钱庄，才是机会。
That's precisely why this is the moment for me to open a bank.

等到浙江官商两方面，人人都晓得有个王大老爷，人人都晓得你我的关系，那时我出面开钱庄，外面会怎么说？
Once every official and merchant in Zhejiang knows His Honour Wang, and everyone knows our relationship, what will they say if I open one then?”

““无非说我出的本钱！
“Only that I supplied the capital.

你我的交情，不必瞒人，
There's no need to conceal our friendship.

我出本钱让你开钱庄，也普通的紧。”
My financing a bank for you would be perfectly ordinary.”

“这话不错！
“True.

不过，雪公，‘不招人妒是庸才’，
But as the saying goes, only a mediocre man never arouses envy.

可以不招妒而自己做得招妒，那就太傻了。
If we could avoid it and deliberately invite it instead, we'd be foolish.

到时候人家会说你动用公款，营商自肥，
People would say you were using public money for private profit.

有人开玩笑，告你一状，
Someone might amuse himself by filing an accusation against you.

叫我于心何安？”
How could I feel at ease then?”

这话打动了王有龄的心，
This struck home.

觉得不可不顾虑，因而有些踌躇了。
Wang felt the danger could not be ignored and hesitated.

“做事要做得不落痕迹。”
“Things must be done without leaving obvious traces.”

胡雪岩的声音越低。
Hu spoke still more quietly.

“钱庄有一项好处，代理道库、县库，
“A bank has one particular advantage: it can act for circuit and county treasuries.

公家的银子没有利息，等于白借本钱。
Public funds bear no interest, so they're effectively capital borrowed for nothing.

雪公，你迟早要放出去的，
Sooner or later you'll receive a local appointment.

等你放出去再来现开一家钱庄，代理你那个州县的公库，痕迹就太明显了。
If I open a bank then and immediately take over your treasury's business, the connection will be too obvious.

所以我要抢在这时候开。
That's why I must act now.

这一说，你懂了吧？”
Do you understand?”

“啊！”
“Ah!”

王有龄的感想不同了，
Wang saw the matter differently.

“我懂了。”
“I understand.”


“只怕你还没有完全懂得其中的奥妙。
“Perhaps not all the subtleties yet.

‘隔行如隔山’，
Different trades are separated as though by mountains.

我来讲给你听。”
Let me explain.”

胡雪岩的计划是，好歹先立起一个门户来，
Hu's plan was to establish a firm first, however modest its resources.

外面要弄得热闹，其实是虚好的，内里是空的，
Outwardly it must look busy and prosperous; inwardly it would have little substance.

等王有龄一旦放了州县，这家钱庄代理它的公库，
Once Wang was appointed to a department or county, the bank would handle its treasury business.

解省的公款，源源而来，空就变成实的的了。
Public funds being remitted to the provincial capital would flow in continuously, turning appearance into reality.

“妙！”王有龄大笑，学着杭州话说：
