“Brilliant!” Wang laughed and imitated the Hangzhou accent.

“雪岩，你真会变戏法儿！”
“Xueyan, you really know how to perform conjuring tricks!”

“戏法总是假的，
“A trick is still an illusion.

偶尔变一两套可以，变多了就不值钱了，
One or two may be useful; too many lose their value.

值钱的还是有真东西拿出来。”
What matters is eventually producing something real.”

“这倒在实实在在的话。”
“That's sound sense.”

王有龄收敛笑容，正色说道：
Wang stopped laughing and spoke seriously.

“我们商量起来，
“Let us plan it.

先说要多少资本？”
First, how much capital is needed?”


于是两个人喝着酒，商议开钱庄的计划。
Over wine, they discussed opening the bank.

主要的是筹划资本的来源，这可要先算“民折官办”的一盘帐，
The main question was the source of capital, which first required a reckoning of the official-procurement affair.

胡雪岩的记忆过人，心算又快，
Hu had an extraordinary memory and calculated rapidly in his head.

一笔笔算下来，要亏空一万四千多两银子，都记在信和的帐上。
Item by item, the account came to a deficit of more than fourteen thousand taels, all entered in Xinhe's books.

得了海运局这么一个好差使，没有弄到好处，反闹了一笔亏空，好象说不过去。
To obtain so desirable an assignment at the Sea Transport Bureau, gain nothing from it, and instead incur a deficit seemed hard to justify.

但王有龄不以为意，
Wang, however, did not mind.

这算是下的本钱，
It was an investment.

以这两个多月的成绩和各方面的关系来说，收获已多。
Judged by the achievements of the past two months and the connections established on every side, the return was already considerable.

只是有了亏空，还要筹措钱庄的本钱，他觉得有些为难。
Yet finding capital for a bank on top of this debt seemed difficult.

“本钱号称二十万，算它实收四分之一，也还要五万，
“If we announce capital of two hundred thousand taels, even a quarter actually paid in means fifty thousand.

眼前怕有些吃力！”
That may be a strain just now.”

“用不着五万。”胡雪岩说，
“We don't need fifty thousand,” Hu said.

“至多二万就行了。
“Twenty thousand at most.

眼前先要弄几千银子，好把场面撑起来。”
For the moment, we need a few thousand to establish a proper appearance.”

“几千两银子，随时都有。
“A few thousand is available at any time.

我马上拨给你。”
I'll transfer it to you at once.”

“那就行了。”胡雪岩说，
“Then we're set.

“藩台衙门那里有几万银子的差额好顿，
There's also a price-difference allowance of several tens of thousands to draw from the provincial treasury.

本来要付给通裕的，现在不妨压一压。”
It was meant for Tongyu, but we can hold it back for a while.”

“对，对！”
“Yes!”

王有龄想通了，
Wang saw the point.

“通裕已经借了十万，我们暗底下替他做了保人，
“Tongyu has borrowed a hundred thousand, and we've secretly guaranteed it.

这笔款子压一压也不是说不过去的事。”
A little delay in paying this allowance isn't unreasonable.”

“正就是这话。
“Exactly.

不过这笔款子要领下来，总要好几个月的工夫，得要走走路子。”
But drawing it from the treasury will take several months unless we work through the right connections.”


这是王有龄很明白的，
Wang understood that well.

领到公款，哪怕是十万火急的军饷，一样也要重重勒掯，
Even the most urgently needed military pay faced obstruction at every stage before release.

尤其是藩司衙门的书办，格外难惹，
The treasury clerks were particularly difficult.

“ ‘阎王好见，小鬼难当’！”他说，
“‘The King of Hell is easy to see; his little demons are hard to manage!’” he said.

“麟藩台那里，我有把握，就是下面的书办，还想不出路子。”
“I can deal with Treasurer Lin, but I don't yet see a way through the clerks below him.”

“我来！”
“Leave them to me.”

胡雪岩想说：“你去见阎王，我来挡小鬼。”
Hu was about to say, “You go and see the King of Hell; I'll deal with the demons.”

话到口边，想到“见阎王”三个字是忌讳，便不敢说俏皮话了，
Then he remembered that telling someone to see the King of Hell was an ill-omened joke.

老老实实答道：
He answered plainly instead.

“你那里备公事去催，
“Send an official document pressing for payment.

下面我来想办法，
I'll find a way among the subordinates.

大不了多花些小费就是了。
At worst, it will mean a little more in gratuities.”

“这样说停当，第二天王有龄就从海运局公款中，提了五千两银子，交结胡雪岩。
With that settled, Wang drew five thousand taels from the bureau's public funds the following day and handed it to Hu.

钱是有了，但要事情办得顺利，还得有人，
The money was available, but smooth progress required people too.

胡雪岩心里在盘算，如果光是开家钱庄，自己下手，一天到晚钉在店里，一时找不着好帮手也不碍。
If Hu were merely opening a bank and could attend to it himself all day, the lack of a good assistant would not matter for the moment.

而现在的情形是，自己要在各方面调度，不能力日常的店面生意绊住身子，
But he had to coordinate matters in many directions and could not be tied down by daily business.

这就一定要托个能干而靠得住的人来做档手。
He therefore needed a capable, trustworthy manager.


信和有两个过去的同事，倒是可造之材，不过他不愿去找他们，
Two former colleagues at Xinhe had promise, but he did not want to approach them.

因为一则是挖了张胖子手下的“好角色”，
First, he would be taking good men from Zhang.

同行的义气，个人的交情都不容出此，
Neither the obligations of the trade nor their personal friendship permitted it.

再则是自己的底细，那两个人十分清楚，
Second, they knew his background too well.

原是玩笑惯的同事，
They had joked together as equals.

一下子分成老板、伙计，自己抹不下这张脸，对方也难生敬畏之心。
Suddenly becoming employer and employees would embarrass him and make it difficult for them to regard him with proper respect.

想来想去，想出来一个人，也是同行，但没有什么交情，
After much thought, he remembered another man in the trade with whom he had little personal connection.

这个人就在情和坊一家钱庄立柜台做伙计，
He worked at the counter of a bank in Qinghefang.

胡雪岩跟他打过一次交道，觉得他头脑很清楚，仪表、口才也是庸中佼佼，
Hu had dealt with him once and found him clear-headed, with an appearance and manner of speaking well above the ordinary.

大可以物色了来。
He was worth recruiting.

这件事最好托张胖子。
Zhang would be the best person to approach him.

由此又想到一个难题，
That brought up another problem.

从在上海回杭州的船上，下决心开钱庄那一刻起，他就在考虑，这件事要不要先跟张胖子谈，还是等一切就绪，择吉开张的时候再告诉他？
Ever since deciding to open a bank on the return voyage from Shanghai, Hu had wondered whether to tell Zhang first or wait until everything was ready and an auspicious opening date selected.

其实只要认真去想一想，胡雪岩立刻便会发觉，
A moment's serious thought made the answer plain.

早告诉他不见得有好处，而迟告诉了必定有坏处，
Early disclosure might bring no benefit, but late disclosure would certainly do harm.

第一，显得不够交情，倒象是瞒着他什么，会引起他的怀疑，
It would first suggest a lack of friendship, as though he were concealing something, and invite suspicion.

在眼前来说，张胖子替他和王有龄担着许多风险，
Zhang was currently bearing substantial risks for him and Wang.

诚信不孚，会惹起不痛快。
Any loss of trust would cause trouble.

而且招兵买马开一爿钱庄，也是瞒不住人的，
Besides, gathering staff and opening a bank could not be kept secret.

等张胖子发觉了来问，就更加没意思了。
If Zhang discovered it and came to ask, the position would be more awkward still.


主意打定，特为到盐桥信和去看张胖子，
Having decided, Hu made a special visit to Xinhe at Salt Bridge.

相见欢然，
Their meeting was cordial.

在店里谈过一阵闲话，胡雪岩便说：“张先生，我有件要紧事跟你商量。”说着，望了望左右。
After chatting in the shop, he said, “Mr Zhang, I have something important to discuss,” and glanced around.

“到里头来说。”
“Come inside.”

张胖子把他引入自己的卧室，
Zhang led him to his bedroom.

房间甚小，加上张胖子新从上海洋行里买回来的一具保险箱，越发显得狭隘，
It was small, and a safe recently purchased from a foreign firm in Shanghai made it more cramped still.

两个就坐在床上谈话。
They sat on the bed.

“张先生，我决什自己弄个号子。”
“Mr Zhang, I've decided to establish a firm of my own.”

“好啊！”
“Excellent!”

张胖子说，声音中有些做作出来的高兴。
Zhang's pleasure sounded somewhat forced.

胡雪岩明白，张胖子是怕他自设钱庄，影响信和的生意，
Hu understood: he feared that Hu's bank would affect Xinhe's business.

关于海运局这方面的往来，自然要起变化了。
Its dealings with the Sea Transport Bureau were naturally likely to change.

因此他首先就作解释“你放心！
He therefore began with reassurance. “Don't worry.

‘兔子不吃窝边草’，
A rabbit doesn't eat the grass beside its own burrow.

要有这个心里，我也不会第一个就来告诉你。
If I meant to take your business, I wouldn't be telling you first.

海运局的往来，照常归信和，
The bureau's dealings will remain with Xinhe.

我另打路子。”
I'll find a different path.”

“噢！”张胖子问，
“Oh?

“你是怎么打法？”
What path?”

“这要慢慢看。
“That will emerge in time.

总而言之一句话，信和的路子，我一定让开。”
In short, whatever business Xinhe is pursuing, I'll keep clear of it.”

“好的！”
“Good.”

张胖子现在跟胡雪岩的情分关系不同了，所以不再说什么言不由衷的门面话，
Their relationship had changed, and Zhang no longer offered insincere courtesies.

很坦率地答道“作为人我相信得过。
He answered frankly. “I trust your character.

你肯让一步，我见你的情，
If you're willing to make that concession, I appreciate it.

有什么忙好帮，只要我办得到，一定尽心尽力。
Whatever help I can give, I'll give wholeheartedly.

你说！”
Tell me what you need.”


“当然要请张先生帮忙。
“Naturally, I must ask your help.

第一，开门那天，要捧捧我的场。”
First, support me on opening day.”

“那还用得着说？
“That goes without saying.

开门那天，我约同行来‘堆花’，
I'll bring fellow bankers to make a show of deposits.

多没有把握，万把两现银子，是有的。”
I can't promise a great deal, but there'll be ten thousand taels or so in silver.”

“好极！
“Excellent.

我先谢谢。”胡雪岩说，
Thank you in advance.

“第二件，我立定宗旨，信和的好手，决不来挖。
Second, I've made it a rule not to take any of Xinhe's good men.

我现在看中一个人，想请张先生从中替我拉一拉。”
I've found someone else and would like you to help bring us together.”

“哪个？你说说看！”
“Who?”

“清和坊大源，有个小朋友，好象姓刘，
“At Dayuan in Qinghefang there's a young fellow, surnamed Liu, I think.

人生得蛮‘外场’的。
A presentable man who knows how to deal with people.

我想约他出来谈一谈。
I'd like to meet him.”

““姓刘，
“Liu?

蛮‘外场’的？”
Presentable?”

张胖子皱着眉想了一会想起来了，
Zhang frowned in thought, then remembered.

“你的眼光不错！
“You have a good eye.

不过大源的老板、档手，我都很熟，所以这件事我不便出面，
But I know both Dayuan's proprietor and its manager well, so I can't intervene openly.

我寻个人替他把他约出来见面，
I'll have someone arrange a meeting.

将来谈成了，你不可说破是我替你拉拢的！”
If it works out, you mustn't reveal that I brought you together.”


“晓得，晓得。”
“I understand.”

张胖子没有说假话，
Zhang had not spoken idly.

他帮胡雪岩的忙，确是尽心尽力，当时就托人把姓刘的约好。
He did all he could to help and immediately asked someone to contact Liu.

这天晚上快到二更了，有人到胡家去敲门，
That night, close to the second watch, a visitor knocked at Hu's house.

胡雪岩提盏“油灯照”去开门，把灯提起来往来人脸上一点，
Hu took an oil lamp to the door and raised it towards the man's face.

正是那姓刘的。
It was Liu.

“胡先生，信和的张先生叫我来看你。”
“Mr Hu, Mr Zhang of Xinhe asked me to call.”

“不错，不错，
“Yes, indeed.

请里面坐。”
Come inside.”

请进客厅，胡雪岩请教名字，
Once they were in the reception room, Hu asked his full name.

姓刘的名叫刘庆生。他就称他“庆生兄”。
It was Liu Qingsheng, and Hu addressed him as “Brother Qingsheng.”

“庆生兄府上哪里？”
“Where is your family home?”

“余姚。”
“Yuyao.”

“噢，好地方，好地方。”
“Ah, a fine place!

胡雪岩很感兴趣地说，“我去过。”
I've been there,” Hu said with interest.

于是谈余姚的风物，由余姚谈到宁波，再谈回绍兴，
They discussed Yuyao's sights and customs, moved on to Ningbo, then back to Shaoxing.

海阔天空，滔滔不绝，把刘庆生弄得莫名其妙，
Hu spoke endlessly on every imaginable subject, bewildering Liu.

好几次拉回正题，动问有何见教？
Several times Liu tried to return to the purpose of the visit and asked how he could be of service.

而胡雪岩总是敷衍一句，又把话扯了开去，倒象是长夜无聊，有意找个人来听他讲《山海经》似地。
Hu always gave a brief, evasive answer and wandered off again, as though bored by the long night and wanting someone to listen to fantastic tales from the Classic of Mountains and Seas.


刘庆生的困惑越来越深，而且有些懊恼，
Liu grew increasingly puzzled and somewhat annoyed.

但他也是极坚忍的性格，
But he too had great perseverance.

胡雪岩与王有龄的一番遇台，当事人都从不跟别人谈，
Neither Hu nor Wang ever told others the story of their remarkable connection.

但张胖子了解十之五、六，闲谈之中，加油加酱地渲染着，
Zhang, however, knew half or more of it and embellished it freely in conversation.

所以同行都知道胡雪岩是个神秘莫测的“大好佬”，
Everyone in the trade therefore knew Hu as an unfathomable man of consequence.

刘庆生心里在想：“找我来，必有所为，
Liu thought, “He must have a reason for bringing me here.

倒偏要看看你说些什么？”
I mean to see what he has to say.”

就由于这一转念，他能够忍耐了。
That decision enabled him to endure.

胡雪岩就是要考验他的耐性。
Hu was testing precisely that patience.

空话说了一个钟头，刘庆生毫无愠色，
After an hour of empty talk, Liu showed no irritation.

认为满意，第一关，实在也是最难的一关，算是过去了。
Satisfied, Hu considered the first test—and in truth the hardest—passed.

这才谈到刘庆生的本行。
Only then did he turn to banking.

胡雪岩是此中好手，借闲谈作考问，出的题目都很难。
An expert himself, he disguised his examination as casual conversation and set difficult questions.

刘庆生照实回答，大都不错，
Liu answered to the best of his knowledge, mostly correctly.

第二关又算过去了。
The second test was passed as well.


“庆生兄，”他又问，“钱庄这一行，我离开得久了，
“Brother Qingsheng, I've been away from banking for some time.

不晓得现在城里的同业，一共有多少家？”
How many firms are there in the city now?”

“ ‘大同行，八家，’
“Eight large banks.

小同行，就多了，一共有三十三家。”
There are more of the smaller establishments: thirty-three altogether.”

“噢！哪三十三家？”
“Which thirty-three?”

这下才显出刘庆生的本事，
Now Liu's ability truly appeared.

从上城数到下城，以兑换银子、铜钱为主的三十三家“小同行”的牌号，
From the Upper City to the Lower, he named every one of the thirty-three smaller firms whose main business was exchanging silver and copper cash.

一口气报了出来，一个不缺。
He gave the names without a pause and missed none.

这份记性，连胡雪岩都自叹不如。
Even Hu felt his own memory inferior.


到此地步，他差不多已决定要用此人了，但是还不肯明说出来，
By now Hu had all but decided to employ him, though he would not yet say so.

“宝眷在杭州？”他问。
“Is your family in Hangzhou?”

“都在余姚。”刘庆生答。
“They're all in Yuyao.”

“怎么不接出来呢？”
“Why don't you bring them here?”

“还没有力量接家眷。”
“I can't afford it yet.”

“ 想来你已经讨亲了？”
“I take it you're married?”

“是的。”刘庆生说，
“Yes.

“伢儿都有两个了。”
I have two children.”

“府上还有些什么人？
“Who else is in your household?”

“爷娘都在堂。还有个兄弟，在蒙馆里读书。”
“Both my parents are alive, and I have a younger brother at an elementary school.”

“这样说，连你自己，一家七口，
“Then, including yourself, there are seven mouths to feed.

家累也够重了！”
That's quite a burden.”

“是啊！
“Yes.

所以不敢搬到杭州来。”刘庆生说，
That's why I don't dare bring them to Hangzhou.

“在家乡总比较好寻生路。”
It's easier to manage in our home district.”


“倘或说搬到杭州，一个月要多少开销？”胡雪岩说，
“If you did move them here, what would the monthly expenses be?” Hu asked.

“不是说过苦日子，
“I don't mean a life of hardship.

起码吃饭嘛一荤一素，穿衣嘛一绸一布，就是老婆嘛，一正一副也不算过分。”刘庆生笑道：
At least a meat dish and a vegetable dish at meals, silk as well as cotton clothes—even a wife and a concubine wouldn't be excessive.” Liu laughed.

“胡先生在说笑话了。”
“You're joking, Mr Hu.”

“就当笑话讲好了。
“Then treat it as a joke.

你说说看！”
Give me a figure.”

“照这样子说，一个月开销，十两银子怕都不够。”
“On that basis, even ten taels a month might not be enough.”

“这也不算多。”胡雪岩接着便说：“杭州城里钱庄的大同行，马上要变九家了。”
“That isn't much.” Hu continued, “Hangzhou's eight large banks are about to become nine.”

“喔！”刘庆生很注意地问：
“Oh?” Liu asked attentively.

“还有一家要开出来？”
“Another is opening?”

不错，马上要开出来。
“Yes, very soon.”

““叫啥字号，
“What's its name?

开在哪里？”
Where will it be?”

“字号还没有定，也不知道开在哪里。”
“The name hasn't been decided, nor the location.”

“这……这是怎么回事？”
“Then... what do you mean?”


胡雪岩不答他的话，
Hu ignored the question.

“庆生兄，”他问：“如果这家钱庄请你去做档手，大源肯不肯放？”
“Brother Qingsheng, if this bank asked you to be its manager, would Dayuan let you go?”

“什么？”
“What?”

刘庆生疑惑自己听错了，
Liu thought he had misheard.

“胡先生请你再说一遍。”
“Please say that again.”

这一次听清楚了，却又有些不大相信，
This time he heard clearly, but could scarcely believe it.

细看胡雪岩的脸色，不象是在开玩笑，才知道自己的运气来了。
Studying Hu's face and finding no sign of a joke, he realised that his opportunity had arrived.

“大源没有不肯放的道理。
“Dayuan would have no reason to refuse.

我在那里，感情处得不错，
I've got on well with everyone there.

倘或有这样的好机会，同事听了也高兴的。”
If such an opportunity came, my colleagues would be pleased for me.”

“那好！
“Good.

我请你，我请你做这家新开钱庄的档手。”
Then I invite you to manage this new bank.”

“是胡先生自己要开钱庄？”
“You're opening it yourself, Mr Hu?”

刘庆生略有些讶异。
Liu was slightly surprised.

“老板不是我，也好算是我，
“The proprietor isn't me, though you could say that I am.

总之，一切我都可以作主。
In any case, I have full authority.

庆生兄，你说一个月至少要十两银子的开销，一年就是一百二十两，
You say your expenses would be at least ten taels a month, or a hundred and twenty a year.

这样，我送你二百两银子一年，年底另有花红。
Here's my offer: two hundred taels a year, with a bonus at year's end.

你看如何？”
What do you think?”


这还有什么话说？
What more could he ask?

但太慷慨了，却又有些令人不信。
Yet the generosity was so great that it was difficult to believe.

胡雪岩看他的神情，猜到他心里，
Reading his expression, Hu understood.

告个便到里面取了五十两一锭的四锭银子出来，放在他面前。
He excused himself, went inside, and returned with four ingots of fifty taels each, which he set before Liu.

“这是今年四月到明年三月的，
“This is for the year from this fourth month to the third month next year.

你先关了去。”
Take it in advance.”

“不要，不要！”
“No, no!”

刘庆生激动不已，吵架似的把银子在外推，
Deeply moved, Liu pushed the silver away almost as though quarrelling.

“胡先生，你这样子待人，说实话，我听都没有听见过，
“Mr Hu, frankly, I've never even heard of anyone treating a man like this.

铜钱银子用得完，大家是一颗心，
Money can be spent, but our hearts are what matter.

胡先生你吩咐好了，
Just give me your instructions.

怎么说怎么好！”
Whatever you say, I'll do.”

他激动，胡雪岩却冷静，
While Liu was agitated, Hu remained calm.

很恳切地说：
He spoke earnestly.

“庆生兄，这二百两头，你今天一定要带回去。
“Brother Qingsheng, you must take these two hundred taels today.

钱是人的胆，
Money gives a man confidence.

你有这二百两银子在手里，心思可以定了，脑筋也就活了，
With it in your hands, your mind will be settled and your thoughts more active.

想个把主意，自然就会高明。”
Any ideas you devise will naturally be better.”

“不是这话，不是这话……”
“That isn't what I mean...”

“你不必再客气了，
“No more ceremony.

是你分内应得之财，
It's money you're properly entitled to.

客气什么？
Why refuse it?

你不肯收，我反倒不便说话了。”
If you won't accept, I'll find it difficult to speak freely.”

“好，好，
“Very well.

这先不谈。谈正经！”
Let us leave that for now and discuss the business.”


“对啊，谈正经。”胡雪岩说，
“Exactly.

“你今天回去，最好就把在大源经手的事，料理料理清楚。
When you go back today, put the affairs you've handled at Dayuan in order.

第一桩要寻店面，
Our first task is to find premises.

房子要讲究、漂亮，出脚要方便，地点一定要在上城。
The building must be handsome and well appointed, with convenient access, and it must be in the Upper City.

寻‘瓦摇头’多看几处，
Ask the property brokers to show you several places.

或买或典，
We can buy it outright or take it in pledge.

看定了来告诉我。”
Once you've chosen, tell me.”

“是的。
“Yes.

第二桩？”
The second task?”

“第二桩要寻伙计，
“Find employees.

你看中了就好了。”
Choose whomever you think suitable.”

“是。第三桩？”
“And the third?”

“以后无非装修门面，买木器之类，
“After that, it's decorating the premises, buying furniture, and so on.

都是你办，
You handle it all.

我不管。”
I won't interfere.”

刘庆生想了想答道：
Liu considered.

“我晓得了！
“I understand.

胡先生请你明天立个一千两的折子，把图章交给我，随时好支用。”
Tomorrow, please open an account with a thousand taels available and give me the seal, so I can draw funds as required.”

“不错！
“Quite right.

你替我写张条子，给信和的张先生。请他垫支一千两，立个折子。”
Write a note to Mr Zhang at Xinhe, asking him to advance a thousand taels and open the account.”

这又是考一考他的文墨。
This was another test, of his writing.

刘庆生倒也应付裕如，把条子写好，
Liu handled it easily.

胡雪岩看过不错，便画了花押，连同那二百两现银，一起让刘庆生带了回去。
Hu read the note, approved it, added his written signature mark, and sent Liu away with both the note and the two hundred taels in silver.


刘庆生是就在这一夕谈中，完全为胡雪岩降服了。
In that single evening, Hu had completely won Liu over.

他本来一个人住在店里，这夜为了有许多事要筹划，特意到客栈去投宿，找了间清静客房，
Liu normally lived alone at the bank, but with so much to plan that night, he deliberately took a quiet room at an inn.

问柜上借了副笔砚，讨两张“尺白纸”，一个人在油灯下把自己该做的事，一条一条记下来。
He borrowed brush and inkstone from the desk, asked for two sheets of plain writing paper, and sat beneath an oil lamp listing everything he must do.

等到写完，鸡都叫了。
The cocks were crowing by the time he finished.

和衣躺了一会，天亮起身，
He lay down in his clothes for a little while and rose at daybreak.

虽然睡得极少，却是人逢喜事精神爽，
Though he had slept very little, good fortune gave him energy.

提了银包，直回大源。
Taking his silver, he went straight back to Dayuan.

同事见他一夜不回来，都道他狎妓去了，纷纷拿他取笑。
His colleagues, assuming that his night away had been spent with a courtesan, teased him.

刘庆生的为人，内方外圆，
Liu was firm inwardly and accommodating in manner.

笑笑不响，动手料理自己经手的帐目，
He only smiled and began putting his accounts in order.

一把算盘打得飞快，到日中都已结算清楚。
His abacus clicked rapidly, and by noon everything was settled.

吃过午饭，说要去收帐，出店去替胡雪岩办事。
After lunch, he said he was going to collect debts and went out to attend to Hu's business.

第一件就是寻房子，这要请教“瓦摇头”。
First came the premises, for which he needed a property broker.

到了“茶会”上寻着熟人，说了自己所要的房子的格局，
At the brokers' customary teahouse meeting place, he found an acquaintance and described the layout required.

附带有个条件，要在“钱庄”附近，替他租一所小小的住屋，
He added one condition: a small residence must be rented near the bank.

刘庆生的打算是要把家眷接了来，住得离钱庄近了，随时可以到店里去照应。
He intended to bring his family to Hangzhou and live close enough to attend to the business whenever needed.

约定了听回话的时间，然后要去寻伙计，
After arranging when to hear the broker's reply, he turned to recruiting staff.

人来人往，总要有个起坐联络的地方，离开大源他得有个住处，
With people coming and going, he needed somewhere to meet them, and once he left Dayuan he would need lodging too.

好得手里有二百两银子在，
Fortunately, he had two hundred taels.

刘庆生决定去借客栈，包了一座小院子，共有三个房间。论月计算。接着到“荐头行”去挑了个老实勤快的“打杂”，当天就叫他到客栈来上工。
He rented a small courtyard of three rooms at an inn by the month, then went to an employment agency and selected an honest, industrious general servant, who began work at the inn that day.


看看天快黑了，大源的档手孙德庆，已经回家。
By dusk, Dayuan's manager, Sun Deqing, had gone home.

刘庆生办了四样很精致的水礼。 登门拜访。
Liu prepared four carefully chosen gifts of fresh provisions and called on him.

“噢！”
“Oh!”

孙德庆大惑不解，
Sun was bewildered.

“无缘无故来送礼，
“Gifts out of the blue?

这是啥缘故？”
What's the occasion?”

“我有件事，要请孙先生栽培……”
“There's something on which I must ask your help...”

“我晓得，我晓得！”孙德庆抢着道：
“I know!” Sun interrupted.

“我已经跟东家说过了，
“I've already spoken to the proprietor.

一过了节就要加你工钱。
You'll get a raise after the festival.

你何必还要破费？
Why spend money on presents?

庆生，争钱不容易，
Qingsheng, money isn't easily earned.

这份礼起码值四两银子，你两个月的工钱，
These must have cost at least four taels—two months of your wages.

何苦？”
Why do it?”

他完全弄错了！
He had completely misunderstood.

但这番好意，反使得刘庆生难以启齿，
Yet his kindness made Liu's news harder to deliver.

笑一笑答道：“看来我要替孙先生和老板赔不是了！”
Smiling, Liu said, “It seems I owe both you and the proprietor an apology.”

“怎么？”
“What?”

孙德庆一惊：
Sun was alarmed.

“你闯了什么祸？
“What trouble have you caused?

是不是吃进了倒帐？”
Taken on a bad debt?”

“不是！”
“No.”

他把随身所带的帐簿，往孙德庆面前一放“帐都结清楚了，
Liu placed the account book he had brought before him. “Everything is settled.

没有一笔帐收不到的。
There isn't a single uncollectable account.

孙先生，我要走了。”
Mr Sun, I'm leaving.”


“走到哪里去？”
“Going where?”

“说出来孙先生一定替我高兴，
“You'll be pleased for me when I tell you.

有个朋友要弄个号子，叫我去做档手。”
A friend is opening a bank and wants me as manager.”

“唷！恭喜，恭喜！”
“Congratulations!”

孙德庆换了副怀疑的面孔又说，
Then Sun looked doubtful.

“不过，你倒说说看，是怎么样一个朋友？
“But tell me: what sort of friend?

何以事先一点风声都不露？”
Why was there no hint of this beforehand?”

“我也是昨天才撞着这么个难得的机会。”刘庆生说：
“I only came upon this exceptional opportunity yesterday.

“有个人，孙先生总晓得：胡雪岩！”
You must know the man: Hu Xueyan.”

“是从前信和的那个胡雪岩？
“The Hu Xueyan formerly at Xinhe?

他是你的新东家？”
He's your new employer?”

听到“新东家”三字，可知孙德庆已经答应了，
Those words showed that Sun had accepted his departure.

刘庆生宽心大放，笑嘻嘻地答道：
Greatly relieved, Liu smiled.

“大概是的。”
“I suppose so.”

“这就不对了！
“That's not right.

东定就是东家，
An employer is an employer.

什么大概，小概？
What do you mean, ‘suppose’?

胡雪岩这个人，我也见过，
I've met Hu too.

眉毛一动，就是一计。
Every movement of his eyebrows means another scheme.

我看……”
I think...”

孙德庆终于很率直地说了出来，“有点不大靠得住！”
At last Sun said frankly, “He's not entirely dependable.”


“靠得住。”刘庆生说，
“He is dependable.

“真的靠不住，我再回来，
And if he really isn't, I'll come back.

孙先生象我的长辈一样，
You're like an elder to me, Mr Sun.

也不会笑我。”
You wouldn't laugh at me.”

这两句话很动听，孙德庆点点头：
These words pleased Sun, who nodded.

“水往低处流，人往高处爬，
“Water flows downwards, but a man seeks to rise.

你一出去就做档手，也是大源的面子，
Going straight into a manager's position does Dayuan credit too.

但愿不出笑话。
I only hope it doesn't become a laughing matter.

如果真的靠不住，你千万要当心，
If he proves unreliable, be very careful.

早早滑脚，还是回大源来。”
Leave promptly and come back to us.”

过去也有过虚设钱庄，吸进了存款，一倒了事的骗局。
There had been fraudulent banks before: empty establishments that took deposits and then collapsed.

孙德庆“千万要当心”的警告，就是怕有此一着，
That was the danger behind Sun's warning.

将来“东家”逃走，做档手的要吃官司。
If the proprietor fled, the manager would face legal proceedings.

这是决不会有的事，但说这话总是一番好意。
Nothing of the kind could happen here, Liu felt, but the warning was well meant.

刘庆生本来还想表示，等钱庄开出来，跟大源做个“联号”，
He had intended to suggest that the new bank establish an affiliation with Dayuan.

现在当然也不必送这个秋彼。
Now there was no point in offering that overture.

答应一声：“我一定听孙先生的话。”随后便告辞了。
He answered, “I shall certainly heed your advice,” and took his leave.


离了孙家，来到胡家，他把这一天的经过，扼要报告了胡雪岩。
From Sun's house he went to Hu's and briefly reported the day's activities.

听说他在客栈里包了一个院子，胡雪岩就知道他做事是放得开手的，
Hearing that he had rented a courtyard at an inn, Hu knew that he could act freely and decisively.

原来还怕他拘谨，才具不够开展，
He had previously feared that Liu might be too constrained to develop his abilities fully.

现在连这最后一层顾虑也消除了。
That last doubt now disappeared.

“好的，
“Excellent.

你尽管去做。
Go ahead.

该你做主的，尽管做主，不必问我。”
Decide anything within your authority without asking me.”

“有件事，一家要胡先生自己做主。”刘庄生问道，
“There is one thing you must decide yourself,” Liu said.

“字号不知道定了没有？
“Have you settled on the firm's name?

定了要请人去写，好做招牌。”
Once you have, we need someone to write it so the signboard can be made.”

“对，这倒是要紧的。
“Yes, that is important.

不过，我也还要去请教高明，
But I too must consult someone wiser.

明天告诉你。”
I'll tell you tomorrow.”



胡雪岩
《平步青云（上）》第六章（完整）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume I — the complete Chapter Six
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第六章｜CHAPTER SIX


他请教的不是别人，是王有龄。
The person he consulted was none other than Wang.

“题招牌我还是破题儿第一遭。”王有龄笑道，
“This is my first attempt at naming a business,” Wang laughed.

“还不知怎么题法，
“I don't even know how to begin.

有些什么讲究？”
What are the requirements?”

“第一要响亮，容易上口，
“First, it must sound impressive and be easy to say.

第二字眼要与众不同，省得跟别家搅不清楚。
Second, the characters must be distinctive, so nobody confuses it with another firm.

至于要跟钱庄有关，要吉利，那当然用不着说了。
Naturally, it must suit a bank and be auspicious.”

““好，
“Very well.

我来想想看。”
Let me think.”

他实在有些茫然，
He was rather at a loss.

随便抽了本书，想先选几个字写下来，然后再来截搭选配。
Taking a book at random, he intended to select a few characters, write them down, and then try different combinations.

书架上抽出来的那本书是《华阳国志》，
The volume he pulled from the shelf was the Chronicles of Huayang.

随手一翻，看了几行，
He opened it and read a few lines.

巧极了，现成有两个字。
By a fortunate coincidence, two characters lay ready to hand.

“这两个字怎么样？”
“What about these?”

王有龄提笔写了《华阳国志》上的两句话：“世平道治，民物阜康。”
He wrote out a passage: “The age is peaceful, the way well governed; the people and their possessions flourish in abundance and well-being.”

在“阜康”上面打了两个圈。
He circled the characters fu and kang.

“阜康，阜康！”胡雪岩念了两遍，欣然答道，“好极！
“Fukang, Fukang!” Hu repeated the name twice, then answered gladly, “Excellent!

既阜且康，
Both abundance and well-being.

就是它。”
That's the one.”


说着，他就要起身辞去，王有龄唤住他说，
As Hu rose to leave, Wang called him back.

“雪岩，我有个消息告诉你，
“Xueyan, I have news.

我要补实缺了。”
I'm to receive a regular appointment.”

“喔！
“Oh!

哪个州县？”
Which department or county?”

“现在还不晓得。
“I don't know yet.

抚院的刘二来通知我，黄抚台约我今天晚上见面，
Liu Er from the governor's office came to say that Governor Huang wishes to see me this evening.

他顺便透露的消息。
He let the news slip.

照我想，也该补我的缺了。”
I suppose it is time I received a post.”

就这时只见窗外人影闪过，脚步极其匆遽，
Just then a figure hurried past the window.

胡雪岩眼尖，告诉王有龄说：
Hu's sharp eyes recognised him.

“是吴委员。”
“It's Commissioner Wu.”

门帘掀处，伸进一张笑脸来，
The curtain lifted to reveal a smiling face.

等双脚跨进，吴委员就势便请了个安，高声说道，“替大人道喜，
As Wu stepped inside, he saluted and announced loudly, “Congratulations, Your Honour!

真正大喜！”
Wonderful news!”

“喔，喔，”王有龄愣了一下，旋即会意，
Wang paused, then understood.

吴委员跟藩署接近，必是有了放缺的消息，
Wu had connections at the provincial treasury and must have heard of the appointment.

便站起身来，连连拱手：
He stood and repeatedly clasped his hands.

“多谢，多谢！”
“Thank you!”

“我刚从藩署来，”他走近两步说，
“I've just come from the treasurer's office,” Wu said, stepping closer.

“确确实实的消息，委大人署理湖州府，”
“The news is certain: you are to act as prefect of Huzhou.”

这一说，连不十分熟悉官场情形的胡雪岩都觉得诧异，
Even Hu, who knew comparatively little of official practice, was astonished.

候补州县，“本班”的实缺不曾当过一天，忽然一跃而被委署知府，
An expectant department or county magistrate, who had not served a single day in a regular post of his own grade, was suddenly to leap to an acting prefecture?

这不是太离谱了吗？
Surely that was extraordinary.

王有龄自然更难置信，
Wang found it still harder to believe.

“这，这似乎不大对吧？”他迟疑地问。
“That... that doesn't sound quite right.”

“决不错！
“There can be no mistake!

明天就‘挂牌’。”
The appointment will be posted tomorrow.”


王有龄沉吟了一会，总觉得事有蹊跷，
Wang considered, still feeling that something was strange.

便央求吴委员再去打听究竟，一面又叫高升到刘二那里去问一问，或者倒有确实消息。
He begged Wu to inquire further and sent Gao to ask Liu Er, who might have definite information.

消息来得太突兀，却也太令人动心，
The news was both abrupt and intensely exciting.

王有龄患得患失之心大起，在海运局签押房，坐立不宁，
Torn between hope and fear, Wang could neither sit nor stand comfortably in his office.

胡雪岩便劝他说：“雪公，你沉住了气！
Hu urged him to remain calm.

照我想，就不是知府，也一定是个大县。
“Even if it isn't a prefecture, it must be a large county.

到晚上见了抚台就知道了。”
You'll know when you see the governor tonight.”

“我在想，”
“I was thinking...”

王有龄答非所问，
Wang's answer followed his own thoughts.

“那天藩台说的话，当时我没有在意，
“I paid little attention to what the treasurer said the other day.

现在看来有点道理。”
Now it seems significant.”

“麟藩台怎么说？”
“What did he say?”

“他先说湖州知府误漕撤任，找不着人去接替，
“First, that Huzhou's prefect had been dismissed for delaying the grain and that no replacement could be found.

后来说是‘有个主意’，但马上又觉得自己的主意不好，自言自语在说，什么‘办不通’、‘不行’，‘没有这个规矩’。
Then he said he had an idea, but immediately rejected it, muttering that it wouldn't work, that there was no precedent.

莫非就与刚才这个消息有关？”
Could it be connected with this news?”

“那就对了！”
“Then that explains it!”

胡雪岩拍着自己的大腿说，
Hu slapped his thigh.

“不是藩台保荐，抚台顺水推舟，就是抚台交下来，藩台乐得做人情。
“Either the treasurer recommended you and the governor agreed, or the governor proposed it and the treasurer was happy to oblige.

现在等高升回来，看刘二怎么说？
Let's hear what Liu Er tells Gao.

如果藩台刚上院见过抚台，这消息就有八成靠得住了。
If the treasurer has just been to see the governor, the news is eight-tenths certain.”

““说得有理。”
“That makes sense.”

王有龄大为欣慰。
Wang was greatly reassured.


“不过，雪公！”胡雪岩说，“湖州大户极多，
“But remember, Mr Xuexuan: Huzhou has a great many powerful households.

公事难办得很。”
Its affairs are very difficult.”

“就是这话罗！
“Exactly!

所以，雪岩，你还是要帮我，跟我一起到湖州去。
That's why you must still help me and come with me.”

这句话胡雪岩答应不下，
Hu could not agree to that.

便先宕开一句：
He put it aside for the moment.

“慢慢再商量。
“We can discuss it later.

雪公，倒是有件事，不可不防！
There's another matter we must guard against.

这里的差使怎么样？”
What happens to your assignment here?”

“这里”自是指海运局，
“Here” meant the Sea Transport Bureau.

一句话提醒了王有龄，“坐办”的差使要交卸了，亏空要弥补，经手的公事要交代清楚。
The question reminded Wang of all that handing over its executive directorship would involve: the deficit must be made good and every affair under his management explained.

后任有后任的办法，
A successor would have his own methods.

倘或海运局的公款不再存信和，关系一断，替松江漕帮借款担保这一层，就会有很大的麻烦，
If the bureau's funds ceased to be deposited with Xinhe and the relationship ended, their guarantee for the Songjiang association's loan could create serious trouble.

真个不可不防。
It was indeed a danger to consider.

“是啊！”
“Yes!”

王有龄吸着气说，
Wang drew a breath.

“这方面关系甚重，
“A great deal depends on that.

得要早早想办法，
We must act early.

我想，跟抚台老实说明白，最好仍旧让我兼这个差使。
I think I should tell the governor frankly and ask to retain the bureau as an additional duty.

就怕他说，人在湖州，省城的公事鞭长莫及，那就煞费周章了。”
But if he says I couldn't manage provincial-capital business from Huzhou, we'll be in considerable difficulty.”

“雪公，我倒要问一句，
“Then let me ask you this.

到了鱼与熊掌不可兼得的那一步，你怎样打算？”
If you reach the point where you can't have both, what will you choose?”

“我情愿不补实缺，把这里先顾住。”王有龄说，
“I'd rather decline the regular appointment and preserve our position here.

“我靠朋友帮忙，才有今天，
I owe my present standing to my friends' help.

不能留下一个累来害你和张胖子、尤老五！”
I can't leave a burden that harms you, Zhang, and You.”

“雪公！”胡雪岩深深点头，一个字，一个字他说道：
Hu nodded deeply and spoke word by word.

“有了这个念头，就不怕没有朋友。”
“With that principle, you'll never lack friends.”

经此一番交谈，王有龄彻底了解了自己的最后立场，心倒反而定了来了。
Having clarified his ultimate position, Wang felt calmer.


两个人接着便根据不同的情况，商量在见黄宗汉时，如何措同。
They discussed how he should address Huang under various circumstances.

这样谈了有半个时辰，高升首先回来复命，
After about an hour, Gao returned.

如胡雪岩所意料的，这天一早，黄宗汉待为把麟桂找了去，有所密谈，
As Hu had expected, Huang had specially summoned Lingui that morning for a private consultation.

可见得吴委员的消息，不是无因而至。
Wu's news plainly had a basis.

不久，吴委员带回来更详细的喜信，王有龄是被委署为乌程县知县，兼署湖州府知府。
Soon Wu himself brought fuller confirmation: Wang was to act as magistrate of Wucheng County and concurrently as prefect of Huzhou.

事到如今，再无可疑。
There could be no further doubt.

海运局上上下下，也都得到了消息，约齐了来向坐办贺喜，
Everyone at the bureau had heard and came together to congratulate their director.

又商量凑公份办戏酒，为王有龄开贺。
They also discussed subscribing for a feast and theatrical performance in his honour.

这大招摇了！王有龄一定不肯，
Wang thought this far too ostentatious and firmly refused.

托吴委员向大家道谢疏通，千万不可有此举动。
He asked Wu to thank them and make absolutely clear that no such celebration should be held.

扰攘半日，莫衷一是，
Half a day of commotion produced no agreement.

他也只得暂且丢下不问，准时奉召去看黄宗汉。
At last he put the matter aside and went punctually to the governor's summons.


“今年的钱粮，一定要想办法征足，
“We must find a way to collect this year's full revenue.

军费浩繁，
Military expenses are enormous.

催京饷的部文，接二连三飞到，
Ministry dispatches demanding remittances to the capital arrive one after another.

你看，还有一道上谕。”
Look—another edict.”

王有龄起身从黄宗汉手中上谕来看，
Wang rose and took the document from Huang.

只见洋洋千言，尽是有关筹饷和劝谕捐输的指示，
Its lengthy text concerned raising military funds and encouraging contributions.

最后一段说：“户部现因外省拨款，未能如期解到，奏请将俸银分别暂停一年。
The final passage read: “As provincial appropriations have failed to arrive on schedule, the Board of Revenue proposes suspending salary payments for one year, according to rank.

朕思王公大臣，俸人素优，即暂停给发，事尚可行，
We consider that princes and senior ministers have long enjoyed generous emoluments, so a temporary suspension is practicable.

其文职四品以下，武职三品以下各员，仍着户部将本看春季暂停俸银，照数补行给领。
For civil officials below the fourth rank and military officials below the third, however, let the Board pay in full the salaries withheld this spring.

并着发内库帑银五十万两，交部库收存，以备支放俸饷要需。”
Let five hundred thousand taels also be released from the privy treasury into the Board's treasury to meet essential salary and military expenditure.”

王公大臣的俸银，岂肯长此停发？
Would princes and senior ministers tolerate a prolonged interruption of their salaries?

当然要严催各省解款。
Naturally, the provinces would face relentless demands for funds.

王有龄心有警惕，今年的州县官，对于征粮一事，要看得比什么都重。
Wang took warning: this year, local officials must give revenue collection precedence over everything.

“本省的钱粮，全靠杭、嘉、湖三府，湖州尤其是命脉所在。
“Our province depends on Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou, with Huzhou its particular lifeblood,” Huang continued.

我跟麟藩台商量，非你去不可。
“Treasurer Lin and I have agreed that you must go.

时逢二百年来未有之变局，朝廷一再申谕，但求实效，不借破格用人。
In this crisis, unparalleled in two hundred years, the court has repeatedly urged practical results and exceptional appointments where necessary.

所以保你老兄署湖州府，我想不至于被驳。”
I therefore doubt it will reject my recommendation that you act as prefect.”

王有龄是早就预备好了的，
Wang was prepared.

听黄宗汉一口气说下来，语声暂停之际，赶快起身请安：
As soon as Huang paused, he rose and saluted.

“大人这样子栽培，真是叫人感激涕零，惶恐万分，
“Such favour overwhelms me with gratitude and apprehension.

不知如何报答？
I don't know how to repay it.”

““要谈报答，只要把公事办妥了就是报答。
“Handle the public business properly, and that will be repayment enough.

湖州地方，与众不同，雪轩兄，
Huzhou is unlike other places, Brother Xuexuan.

你要把全副本事拿出来。”
You must bring all your ability to bear.”

“是！”王有龄紧接着说，
“Yes.

“不过我有下情，还要大人格外体恤。”
But there is a personal difficulty for which I must ask your special consideration.”

“你说。
“Speak.

只要于公事有益，无不可通融。”
Anything that benefits the public business can be accommodated.”


“这是海运局的公事。”王有龄说，
“It concerns the Sea Transport Bureau.

“我接手还不久，
I've only recently taken charge.

这次‘民折官办’一案，其中委曲，无不在大人洞鉴之中。
Your Excellency understands every complication of the official-procurement arrangement.

如今首尾未了倘或后任不明究竟，遇事挑剔，且不说赔累的话，只往来申复解释，就极费功夫。
Matters are still unfinished. If a successor, unaware of the circumstances, objects at every turn, then even apart from possible financial liabilities, the correspondence needed to explain and justify everything would consume enormous time.

大人请想，那时我人在湖州，如何得能全副心思去对付钱粮。
With me in Huzhou, how could I devote my full attention to revenue collection?

这后顾之忧，我斗胆要请大人作主。”
I venture to ask you to remove this concern.”

“你要我如何替你作主？”黄宗汉问。
“What would you have me do?”

“请大人许我在这一案了结以后再交卸。”
“Allow me to hand over only after this affair has been concluded.”

黄宗汉沉吟了，两眼望空，似乎有所盘算。
Huang fell silent, gazing into space as though calculating.

这一个便也猜他的心思，
Wang tried to read his thoughts.

莫非这个差使已经许了别人，所以为难？
Had the post already been promised to someone else?

“答应你兼差，原无不可。”黄宗汉慢慢把视线落在他脸上，
“There is no objection in principle to your holding both duties,” Huang said slowly, bringing his eyes back to Wang.

“只是你兼顾得来吗？”
“But can you manage them?”

这一问在王有龄意料之中，随即答道：
The question was expected.

“请大人放心，一定兼顾得来。
“Rest assured, I can.

因为我部下有个人非常得力，
I have an exceptionally capable man under me.

这一次‘民折官办’，如果没有他多方联络折冲，不能这么顺利。“
Without his work in making contacts and negotiating on every side, the procurement affair could never have proceeded so smoothly.”


“喔，
“Oh?

这个人叫什么名字？
What is his name?

是什么出身？
What qualifications does he hold?

几时带来我看看。”
Bring him to see me sometime.”

“此人叫胡光墉，
“His name is Hu Guangyong.

年纪甚轻，虽是阛阓中人，实在是个奇才。
He is young, and though a man of commerce, he has extraordinary abilities.

眼前尚无功名，似乎不便来谒见大人。”
At present he holds no official or scholarly qualification, so it may not be proper for him to seek an audience.”

“那也不要紧。
“That doesn't matter.

现在有许多事要办，
There is much to be done.

只要是人才，不怕不能出头。
A talented man need not fear being overlooked.

黄宗汉问，”你说他是阛阓中人，做的什么买卖？
What business is he in?”

““他，”
“He...”

王有龄替胡雪岩吹牛，
Wang exaggerated on Hu's behalf.

“他是钱业世家，家道殷实，现在自己设了个钱庄。”
“He comes from a prosperous banking family and has now established a bank of his own.”

“钱庄？
“A bank?

好，
Good.

很好，很好！”一连说了三个“好”字，语气奇怪，
Very good indeed!” The repeated approval had a strange tone.

王有龄倒有些担心，觉得皮里阳秋，用意难测，不能不留神。
Wang feared some concealed implication and grew watchful.

“提起钱庄，我倒想起一件事来了。”黄宗汉问，
“Speaking of banks reminds me of something,” Huang continued.

“现在京朝大吏，各省督抚，纷纷捐输军饷，
“Senior officials in the capital and governors throughout the provinces are contributing to military funds.

我亦不能不勉为其难，
I too must make an effort.

想凑个一万银子出来，略尽绵薄。
I intend to assemble ten thousand taels as a modest contribution.

过几天托那姓胡的钱庄，替我汇一汇。”
In a few days, ask this Mr Hu's bank to remit it for me.”

“是！”王有龄答道：
“Certainly.

“理当效劳，
We should be honoured to serve.

请大人随时交下来就是了。”
Please send the money whenever convenient.”


一听这话，黄宗汉便端茶碗送客，
At that, Huang lifted his tea bowl, signalling the end of the audience.

对他兼领海运局的事，并无下文。
Nothing further was said about retaining the bureau.

王有龄心里不免焦急，
Wang was anxious.

不上下下，不知再用什么方法，方能讨出一句实话来？
Left suspended between possibilities, he could not see how to obtain a definite answer.

因此，他一出抚台衙门，立刻嘱咐高升去找胡雪岩。
As soon as he left, he sent Gao to find Hu.

等他刚刚到家，胡雪岩跟着也就来了，
Hu arrived just after him.

王有龄顾不得换衣服，便拉了他到书房里，关起房门，细说经过。
Without even changing his clothes, Wang took him into the study, closed the door, and recounted everything.

“现在海运局的事，悬在半空里，
“The bureau is now hanging in mid-air.

该怎么打算，竟毫无着手之处，
I don't know where to begin.

你说急人不急人？”
Isn't that maddening?

王有龄接着又说，“索性当面告诉我不行。反倒好进一步表明决心，
If he'd simply refused, I could have stated my decision.

此刻弄得进退维谷了。”
As it is, I can neither advance nor retreat.”

“不要紧，
“Never mind.

事情好办得很。”胡雪岩很随便他说，
It's very easy,” Hu said casually.

“再多花几两银子就行了。”
“A little more silver will settle it.”

“咦！”王有龄说，“我倒不相信，
“Why, I don't believe you!

你何以有些把握？
How can you be so sure?

再说，花几两银子是花多少，
And how much is ‘a little’?

怎么个花法？
How would it be spent?”

““雪公！你真正是聪明一世，懵懂一时。
“Mr Xuexuan, you're clever all your life and muddled for a moment.

‘盘口’已经开出来了，一万银子！”
He's already named his price: ten thousand taels.”

“啊！”
“Ah!”

王有龄恍然大悟，
Wang understood.

“怪不得，怪不得！”
“No wonder!”

他把当时的情形又回想了一遍，
He reconsidered the scene.

只因为自己不明其中的奥妙，说了句等他“随时交下来”，
Because he had failed to grasp the implication, he had asked Huang to send the money at his convenience.

黄宗汉一听他不识窍，立刻就端茶送客，
Hearing that he had missed the point, Huang had immediately dismissed him.

真个翻脸无情，想想也不免寒心。
The abrupt coldness was disheartening.


“闲话少说，
“No more talk.

这件事办得要快，
Act quickly.

‘药到病除’，不宜耽误！”
The right medicine cures the illness; there's no reason to delay.”

“当然，当然。”
“Certainly.”

王有龄想了想说：
Wang considered.

“明天就托信和汇一万银子到部里去。”
“Tomorrow I'll have Xinhe remit ten thousand to the ministry.”

“慢一点，
“Wait.

这一万银子交给我，
Give me that money.

我另有用处。”
I have another use for it.”

这话似乎费解，但王有龄看他不说，也就不问，
The words were puzzling, but Wang did not ask.

这是他笼络胡雪岩的方法之一，表示彻底信任，
Showing complete trust was one of his methods of securing Hu's loyalty.

所以点点头说：
He nodded.

“明天上午请你到局里来取。”
“Come to the bureau tomorrow morning to collect it.”

“不！
“No.

明天雪公一定很忙，
You'll be very busy.

我不来打搅，
I won't disturb you.

请派个人把银票给我送来，尽上午把它办好，
Send the draft to me, and I'll finish the business during the morning.

中午我们碰头。”
We'll meet at noon.”

“慢慢，我想一想。”
“Wait, let me think.”

王有龄猜度明天的情况：
Wang anticipated the next day's schedule.

“算它一早‘挂牌’，立刻就要到藩署谢委，跟着上抚台衙门……”
“Assuming the appointment is posted early, I'll immediately go to thank the treasurer, then to the governor...”

“不！”胡雪岩打断他的话，摇着手说，
“No.” Hu interrupted and waved his hand.

“雪公，抚台那里下午去。
“See the governor in the afternoon.

你从藩暑回局里，有件要紧事办，
When you return from the treasury, there's something important to do at the bureau.

把局里的人找了来，透露点意思给他们，海运局的差使不动。
Gather the staff and let them know you're retaining the directorship.

为什么呢？
Why?

是要把人心稳住，
To settle their minds.

拿钱庄来说，如果档手一调动，伙计们就会到外面去瞎讲，或者别人问到，不能不回话，
In banking, when a manager changes, the employees begin talking outside, or answer questions they cannot avoid.

这样一来，内部许多秘密，就会泄漏出来。
Many internal secrets escape that way.

我想官场也是一样，
I imagine official life is the same.

所以只要这样一说，人心定了，就不会有风言风语，是是非非。
Once people feel secure, there'll be no rumours and needless trouble.

雪公，你看可是？”
Don't you agree?”

“怎么不是？”
“Of course!”

王有龄笑道，
Wang smiled.

“我的脑筋也算很快，不过总比你慢了一步。
“My mind is quick enough, but always one step behind yours.

就这样吧，别的话明天中午碰了头再说。”
We'll do that and discuss the rest at noon.”


到了第二天十点多钟，海运局的庶务，奉命去打了一张信和的银票送来。
After ten the following morning, the bureau's general affairs officer brought a draft drawn on Xinhe.

胡雪岩随即去找刘庆生。
Hu immediately went to Liu Qingsheng.

他是这样打算，刘庆生是个可造之村，但是立柜台的伙计，一下子跳成档手，同行难免轻视，
His reasoning was this: Liu had promise, but his sudden promotion from counter clerk to manager might provoke disdain among fellow bankers.

要想办法提高他的身分，培养他的资望。
His standing and reputation must be developed.

现在替黄宗汉去办理汇款，显得来头不小，
Handling the governor's remittance would demonstrate powerful connections.

以一省来说，抚台是天宇第一号的主顾，
Within the province, the governor was the foremost possible client.

有这样的大主顾在手里，同行对刘庆生自然会刮目相看。
With such a customer, everyone would view Liu differently.

等他说明了这番意思，刘庆生高兴得不得了，但是他倒不尽是为自己高兴。
Once Hu explained, Liu was delighted—but not merely for himself.

“真正是意想不到的漂亮！”
“What an unexpectedly splendid opportunity!”

他收敛笑容说，
Then he grew serious.

“胡先生，实不相瞒，有句话，我现在可以说了。
“Mr Hu, there's something I can tell you now.

大源的孙先生，对你老人家的后台、实力，还有点将信将疑。
Mr Sun at Dayuan still doubts your backing and resources.

我心里懊恼，苦于无法分辩，
It annoyed me, but I couldn't refute him.

空口说白话，毫无用处，不如不说，
Empty words were useless, so I said nothing.

我现在到大源去办了这笔汇款，他们就晓得你老人家的手面了！”
If I arrange this remittance through Dayuan, they'll see your influence for themselves.”

“还有这一层？”
“So that's how it is?”

胡雪岩笑道，
Hu smiled.

“等招牌挂了出来，
“Wait until our signboard is up.

看我再耍点手面给他们看看。”
I'll show them a little more.”

“事不宜迟，
“Then I mustn't delay.

我此刻就去办。等下我把票据达到府上。”
I'll do it now and bring the documents to your house afterwards.”


刘庆生的身价已非昔比了，
Liu's standing had changed.

穿上盐大街估衣铺买来的绸缎袍褂，簇新的鞋袜，雇了一乘小轿，抬到大源。
He put on a silk robe and jacket bought at a second-hand clothing shop on Yanda Street, added new shoes and socks, and hired a small chair to Dayuan.

大源的伙计无不注目，以为来了个大主顾，
The employees all looked up, expecting an important customer.

等轿帘打开，一看是刘庆生，个个讶然，自也不免妒羡。
When the curtain lifted and revealed Liu, they were astonished, envious, and admiring.

刘庆主略略有些窘态，幸好他天生一张笑脸，所以大家也还不忍去挖苦他。
He felt a little awkward, but his naturally smiling face made them reluctant to mock him.

见了孙德庆，稍稍有一番寒暄，随即谈入正题：
After a few civilities with Sun, he came to business.

“我有笔款子，想托大源汇到京里，
“I have a remittance to send to the capital through Dayuan.

汇到‘日升昌’好了，
Send it to Rishengchang.

这家票号跟户部有往来，比较方便。”
That remittance house deals with the Board of Revenue, which will make things convenient.”

“多少两？”孙德庆问：
“How much?

“是捐官的银子？”
Money to purchase office?”

“不是。
“No.

黄抚台报效的军饷，纹银一万两。”
Governor Huang's contribution to military funds: ten thousand taels of standard silver.”

听说是黄抚台的款子，孙德庆的表情立刻不同了，
Sun's expression changed at once.

“咦！”他惊异而重视，“庆生，
“Why, Qingsheng!” He was surprised and impressed.

你的本事真不小，抚台的线都搭上了。”
“You've done well indeed, reaching the governor's circle.”

“我哪里有这样的本事，
“I have no such ability.

另外有人托我的。”
Someone else entrusted it to me.”

“哪个？”
“Who?”

刘庆生故意笑笑不响，让他自己去猜，
Liu merely smiled, deliberately leaving him to guess.

也知道他一定一猜便着，偏要叫他自己说出来才够味。
He knew the answer would be immediate but wanted the satisfaction of hearing Sun say it.

“莫非胡雪岩？”
“Hu Xueyan?”

“是的。”
“Yes.”

刘庆生看着他，慢慢地点一点头，好象在问：这一下你知道他了吧？
Liu looked at him and slowly nodded, as though asking whether he understood Hu now.


孙德庆有些困惑而艳羡的表情，把银票拿了出去交柜上办理汇划，随即又走了进来问道：
Puzzled and envious, Sun took the draft to the counter for processing, then returned.

“你们那家号子，招牌定了没有？”
“Have you settled on a name for your firm?”

“定了，
“Yes.

叫‘阜康’。”
Fukang.”

“阜康！”
“Fukang!”

孙德庆把身子凑了过来，很神秘地问道，“阜康有黄抚台的股子？”
Sun leaned closer and asked mysteriously, “Does Governor Huang have a share in it?”

他的想法，出人意外，刘庆生心想，
The notion surprised Liu.

这话关系甚重，
It was a serious suggestion.

说出去变成招摇，不要意出是非来，
Repeated outside, it could become a boast of official backing and cause trouble.

所以立即答道：“我不晓得，想来不会，
He answered immediately, “I don't know, but I shouldn't think so.

本省的抚台，怎么可以在本省开钱庄？”
How could a provincial governor open a bank in his own province?”

“你当然不会晓得，这个内幕……”
“Of course you wouldn't know the inside story...”

孙德庆诡秘地笑笑，不再说下去，脸上是那种保有独得之秘的矜持。
Sun smiled knowingly and said no more, wearing the reserved expression of a man possessing a private secret.

刘庆生是真的不知道，阜康有没有黄抚台的股份在内？所以无法代为辩白，
Liu really did not know whether the governor held shares and could not deny it on anyone's behalf.

但总觉得心里有些不安。
He nevertheless felt uneasy.

等把汇票打好，刘庆生离了大源，坐轿来到胡家，一面交差一面把孙德庆的猜测，据实相告。
Once the remittance draft was ready, he took a chair to Hu's house, delivered it, and honestly reported Sun's speculation.

胡雪岩得意地笑了。
Hu smiled with satisfaction.

“让他们去乱猜。
“Let them guess.

市面‘哄’得越大，阜康的生意越好做。”
The more excitement in the market, the easier Fukang's business will be.”


这一说刘庆主才放心，欣然告辞。
Reassured, Liu departed happily.

胡雪岩随即也到了海运局，只见好几乘轿子在门口。
Hu went to the bureau, where several chairs stood outside.

杭州府所治两县：钱塘、仁和，钱塘是首县。
Hangzhou's prefectural seat contained two counties, Qiantang and Renhe, with Qiantang the principal one.

县里的差役正在驱散闲人，维持交通。
Its runners were clearing onlookers and managing traffic.

胡雪岩知道贺客正多，便不走大门，从夹弄中的侧门进去，悄悄溜到签押房旁边他平日起坐的那间小屋里。
Knowing that congratulatory visitors had arrived in numbers, Hu avoided the main entrance, slipped through a side door in the lane, and quietly entered his usual small room beside the private office.

“胡老爷！”
“Mr Hu!”

伺候签押房的听差李成，笑嘻嘻地报告消息：
Li Cheng, the office attendant, smiled as he delivered the news.

“我们老爷高升了。”
“Our master has been promoted.”

“喔！
“Oh?

怎么样？”
To what?”

“补了乌程县，署理湖州府，仍旧兼局里的差使。
“Wucheng County, with acting charge of Huzhou Prefecture, while retaining his bureau duties.

我们老爷官运亨通，做下人的连带也沾了光。
Our master's official fortune is flourishing, and we servants benefit too.

胡老爷，”李成说道：“我有件事想求胡老爷。”
Mr Hu, I have a favour to ask.”

“你说，你说！”
“Go on.”

“我有个表叔，笔下很来得。
“I have an uncle who's very good with his pen.

只为吃了一场官司，光景很惨。
A lawsuit ruined him, and he's in miserable circumstances.

我想请胡老爷说说，带了到湖州去。
Could you put in a word and have him taken to Huzhou?”

“噢！”胡雪岩问道：“你那表叔笔下来得，是怎么个来得呢？”
“Good with his pen in what way?”

“写封把应酬信，都说好。
“People praise his social letters.

也会打算盘记帐，”
He can also use an abacus and keep accounts.”

胡雪岩想了想说：
Hu considered.

“我倒要先试试他看。
“I'd like to try him first.

你几时叫他来看我。”
Ask him to come and see me.”

“是！”
“Yes!”

李成很兴奋地说，
Li was excited.

“不知道胡老爷什么时候有空，我叫他来。”
“When will you be free?”


胡雪岩刚要答话，只听靴声囊囊，王有龄的影子已在窗外出现，
Before Hu could answer, footsteps sounded and Wang's figure appeared outside the window.

李成急忙迎了出去打帘子，把主人迎了进来。
Li hurried to lift the curtain.

王有龄却不回签押房，一直来到胡雪岩的那间小屋，
Instead of entering his office, Wang came directly into Hu's small room.

只见他春风满面，步属安详，气派似乎大不相同了。
His face was radiant, his pace composed, and his bearing seemed altogether altered.

“恭喜，恭喜！”
“Congratulations!”

胡雪岩含笑起身，兜头一揖。
Hu rose with a smile and bowed.

“彼此，彼此！”
“To both of us!”

王有龄拉住他的手说，
Wang took his hand.

“到我那里去谈。”
“Come and talk in my room.”

他把胡雪岩邀到签押房的套问，并坐在他歇午觉的一张小床上，
He led Hu into the inner room of his office, and they sat side by side on the small bed where he took his afternoon rest.

有着掩抑不住的兴奋，
His excitement was irrepressible.

“雪岩！”他说，“一直到今天上午见了藩台，我才能相信。
“Xueyan, I couldn't believe it until I saw the treasurer this morning.

一年工夫不到，
Less than a year!

实在想不到有今日之下的局面。
Who could have imagined my position today?

福者祸所倚，
Misfortune lurks beside good fortune.

我心里反倒有些嘀咕了。
I'm almost uneasy.”

““雪公，你千万要沉住气！
“You must remain steady.

今日之果，昨日之因，
Today's result comes from yesterday's causes.

莫想过去。只看将来。
Don't dwell on the past; look ahead.

今日之下如何，不要去管它，
Never mind your present standing.

你只想着今天我做了些什么，该做些什么就是了。“
Think only of what you've done today and what you ought to do.”


王有龄听他的话，克制着自己，把心静下来，
Taking his advice, Wang restrained himself and grew calmer.

“第一件事我要跟你商量，”他说，
“First, there's something to discuss.

“藩台催我赶快到任，
The treasurer wants me to take office quickly.

另外有人劝我，赶在五月初一接印，先有一笔现成的节敬好收，
Someone else suggests accepting the seal on the first day of the fifth month, so I can collect the festival gifts already due.

你看怎么样？”
What do you think?”

这一问，把胡雪岩问住了。
This baffled Hu.

他细想了想答道：“官场的规矩我不懂，不过人同此心，
After careful thought, he answered, “I don't know official customs, but human feelings are the same.

捡现成要看看，
Before taking a ready-made benefit, consider whether it harms anyone.

于人无损的现成好捡，
If it doesn't, well and good.

不然就是抢人家的好处，
Otherwise you're taking someone else's advantage.

要将心比心，自己设身处地，为别人想一想。”
Put yourself in his place.”

“我踌躇的就是这一层。
“That's exactly why I hesitate.

节敬只有一份，
There's only one set of festival gifts.

我得了，前任署理的就落空了……”
If I take them, the present acting magistrate loses them...”

“这就决不能要！”胡雪岩打断他的话说，
“Then you absolutely mustn't!” Hu interrupted.

“人家署理了好些日子，该当收此一份节敬，
“He's held the post for some time and deserves this payment.

不该去抢他，
You shouldn't take it away.

铜钱银子用得完，得罪一个人要想补救不大容易……”
Money can be spent, but offending someone isn't easily repaired...”

“好，你不必说了。”王有龄也打断了他的话，
“Enough,” Wang interrupted in turn.

“我决定端午以后接印。”
“I've decided to receive the seal after the Dragon Boat Festival.”

“那就对了！
“Exactly.

雪公，你鸿运当头，
Your fortune is rising.

做事千万要漂亮。”
You must handle things handsomely.”

胡雪岩一面说，一面把那张汇票交了给他。
As he spoke, Hu handed over the remittance draft.


“这是要紧的，
“This is important.

我吃了饭就上院。
I'll go to the governor after lunch.

只怕手本递进去，他没工夫见！”
But even if I send in my card, he may have no time to see me.”

王有龄很认真他说，
Wang was earnest.

“这件事非要从速有个了断不可！”
“This must be settled promptly.”

“也不一定要见你。
“He needn't necessarily see you.

‘火到猪头烂’，只要他见了汇票就好了，
Enough heat will cook the pig's head: he only needs to see the draft.

不妨先写好一封信摆着，见不着人就递信。
Write a letter beforehand and send that in if you can't get an audience.

顺便把抚台衙门节下该开销了，早早开销，
While you're there, distribute the customary festival gifts in his office early.

那就放心好了，自会有人送消息来。”
Then you can rest easy; someone will bring news.”

“不错，准定这么办。”
“Yes, that's what I'll do.”

王有龄略停一下又说：
Wang paused.

“雪岩，这一补了实缺，起码又要万把银子垫进去，
“Xueyan, taking up a regular post will mean advancing another ten thousand taels or so.

窟窿越扯越大，
The hole grows bigger and bigger.

我有点担心呢！”
I'm worried.”

“不要怕，
“Don't be.

有我！”
You have me.

胡雪岩催他，“事不宜迟，最好趁黄抚台不曾打中觉以前就去一趟。”
Don't delay—go before the governor takes his nap.”


王有龄依他的话办，
Wang followed the advice.

写好一封短简，把汇票封在里面，又备好节下该开发的赏号，一一用红封套套好，
He wrote a short letter, enclosed the draft, and prepared the festival gratuities, each in a red envelope.

一大叠揣在靴页子里，然后传轿到抚台衙门。
With a thick stack tucked inside his boot flap, he called for his chair and went to the governor's yamen.

刘二一见，赶来道喜。
Liu Er hurried over with congratulations.

王有龄今非昔比，不免要摆一摆架子，
Wang's standing had changed, and he could not resist assuming some importance.

但架了摆在脸上，赏封捏在手里，
But while dignity showed on his face, a reward was ready in his hand.

一个二十两银票的红封套塞了过去，那就架上摆得越足，刘二便越发恭敬。
Once he passed over an envelope containing a twenty-tael note, the grander his manner, the more respectful Liu became.

“王大老爷！”刘二用那种极显决心的语气说，“今天是不是要见抚台？
“Your Honour,” Liu said with great determination, “do you want to see the governor today?

要见，我一定让你老见着！
If you do, I'll make certain of it.”

““怎么呢？
“Why?

抚台极忙？”
Is he very busy?”

“是啊！
“Indeed.

不是极忙，我怎么说这话？”
Otherwise I wouldn't say so.”

刘二低声说道，
Liu lowered his voice.

“京里来了人，
“Someone has come from the capital.

在签押房里关上门谈了一上午了。
They've been behind closed doors in the private office all morning.

将军也派了‘戈什哈’来请，说有军务要商量，
The garrison general has also sent an orderly asking him over to discuss military affairs.

这一去，说不定到晚才能回来。
Once he goes, he may not return until evening.

如果王大老爷一定要见，我此刻就上去回，掉个枪花，总要让你老见着。
If you must see him, I'll announce you now and contrive something.

不过，就见了也谈不到多少时候。
But even if you get in, there won't be much time.”

““那么，抚台去拜将军之前，可有看封信的工夫？”
“Before he visits the general, would he have time to read a letter?”

“这一定有的。
“Certainly.

你老把信交给我，
Give it to me.

我伺候在旁边，一定让他拆开来看。”
I'll stay beside him and make sure he opens it.”

王有龄便把信交了给他：
Wang handed it over.

“那就拜托你了。
“Then I rely on you.

抚台有什么话，劳驾你跑一趟，给我个信。”
If the governor has any message, please come and let me know.”

“那不用说的，
“Naturally.

我自然晓得。”
I understand.”


“再托你一件事。”
“One more favour.”

王有龄把靴页子里一大把红封套掏出来交给刘二，
Wang drew the handful of red envelopes from his boot and gave them to Liu.

“节下的小意思，
“A few small festival tokens.

请你代为送一送。”
Please distribute them for me.”

这自是刘二乐于效劳的差使，
This was a duty Liu welcomed.

喏喏连声地把王有龄送上了轿。
With repeated assurances, he escorted Wang to his chair.

等回到海运局，只见大门口越发热闹，挤满了陌不相识的人。
Back at the bureau, the entrance was busier than ever, crowded with strangers.

看见大轿，都站了起来，注目致敬。
They rose respectfully at the sight of his chair.

王有龄端坐轿中，借一副墨镜遮掩，打量着那些人，
Sitting upright behind his dark spectacles, Wang examined them.

一望便知，多数是来觅差使的，
Most were plainly seeking employment.

心内不免发愁，只怕粥少僧多，应酬不列，难免得罪人。
He feared there were too many monks for too little porridge: he could not satisfy them all and would inevitably offend some.

果然，等他刚在签押房中坐定，门上立刻递进一大捧名帖和“八行”来，
Sure enough, as soon as he sat down, a great bundle of cards and letters came in.

这就是做官的苦楚了，
Here was one of the hardships of office.

一个个要应付，
Everyone had to be answered.

看来头的大小，或者亲自接谈，或者请周委员等人代见，
Depending upon the importance of the connection, he received them personally or asked Zhou and others to do so.

要想出许多力不从心的客气话来敷衍，
He had to devise countless polite phrases explaining what he could not do.

这样忙到夕阳衔山，方始告一段落，
Only when the sun touched the hills did the business briefly subside.

这才想起刘二，
Then he remembered Liu Er.

何以未见有信息送来？
Why had no message arrived?

等到上灯，依然音信杳然，王有龄有些沉不住气了！
By lamplight there was still none, and Wang grew restless.

他照胡雪岩的话做，这天上午从藩司衙门回来，立即宣布，仍旧兼着海运局坐办的差使，
Following Hu's advice, he had announced that morning, after returning from the treasury, that he would retain the bureau's directorship.

希望发生“稳定军心”的作用，
He had hoped to steady the staff.

倘或事有变卦拆穿了西洋镜，传出去为人当笑话讲，
If things changed and the pretence were exposed, the story would become a joke at his expense.

这个面子可丢不起。
He could not bear that loss of face.

正在这样嘀咕，胡雪岩来了。
As he worried, Hu arrived.

问知情形，也觉得事不可解，不过他信心未失，
Hearing the situation, he too found it puzzling, but retained his confidence.

认为虽无好信息，但也没有坏消息，
There was no good news, but no bad news either.

不必着急。
There was no need for alarm.


“就算如此，刘二也该先来告诉我一声。”
“Even so, Liu should have told me something.”

“这是刘二不知道你的用意，
“He doesn't know why you're waiting.

倘或他知道你这么着急，当然会先来说一声。”
If he understood your anxiety, he'd certainly have come.”

胡雪岩想了一下说，
Hu thought a moment.

“雪公，你不妨先回府。一面止高升把刘二请了来问一问看，
“Go home first, and send Gao to invite him over.

看黄抚台是怎么个表示？”
We can ask how the governor responded.”

“这话有理。就这么办！”
“That makes sense.”

高升这一去，又好半天没有信息。
Gao too was gone a long time without word.

王有龄在家跟胡雪岩两个人对饮坐等，
Wang and Hu drank together at home while they waited.

直等到钟打九下，才看见高升打着一盏灯笼把刘二照了进来。
Not until the clock struck nine did Gao appear with a lantern, lighting Liu's way inside.

人已到了，王有龄便从容了，先问刘二吃过饭没有？
Now that the man had arrived, Wang became composed and first asked whether he had eaten.

刘二说是早已吃过，接着便说，
Liu had eaten long before.

“高二爷来的那一刻，我正在上头回公事，
“When Second Master Gao came, I was still reporting upstairs.

交代的事很多，所以耽误了。
There were many instructions, which delayed me.

你老这封信，抚台早就看过，直到此刻才有话。”
The governor read your letter early, but only now gave me a message.”

“噢！”
“Oh?”

王有龄见他慢条斯理地，十分着急，但急也只能急在心里，表面上一点不肯摆出来。
Liu's unhurried manner made Wang impatient, though he would not show it.

“ 上头交代：请王大老爷到湖州接了印，一等有了头绪，赶快回省。
“His Excellency says: after His Honour Wang has received the seal at Huzhou and put things in order, he is to return promptly to the provincial capital.

这里的公事也很要紧！”
The business here is important too.”

“这里”当然是指海运局。
“Here” naturally meant the Sea Transport Bureau.

王有龄喜心翻倒，
Wang was overwhelmed with joy.

与胡雪岩相视而笑，尽在不言。
He and Hu exchanged a smile that needed no words.


这下刘二才恍然大悟，
Only then did Liu understand.

心里懊悔，原来他海运局的差使，直到此刻，才算定局。
Wang's retention of the bureau had not been certain until this moment. He regretted his ignorance.

早知如此，这个消息真是奇货可居，应当另有一番丑表功的说法。
Had he known, this news could have been made a valuable commodity, with a more elaborate account of his own services.

不过此刻也还不晚。
But it was not too late.

于是他立即蹲下身子来请了个安：
He immediately bent his knees in salute.

“恭喜王大老爷！
“Congratulations, Your Honour!

我晓得你老急着等信息，伺候在我们大人身边，一步不敢离开，
Knowing how anxiously you awaited news, I stayed beside our master without daring to move.

到底把好消息等到了。
At last I obtained the good word.”

““承请之至。”
“I am most grateful.”

王有龄懂他的意思，封了十两银子一个赏封，把刘二打发了走。
Wang understood and sent him away with another envelope containing ten taels.


“总算如愿以偿，各方面都可以交代了。”
“At last you've got what you wished, and everyone can be satisfied.”

胡雪岩开玩笑他说，“王大老爷！我要讨桩差使，
Hu joked, “Your Honour Wang, I have an assignment to request.

到湖州上任的船，由我替你去雇。”
Let me hire the boat for your journey to take office.”

这自然是要照顾阿珠家的生意，
Naturally, this meant giving A'zhu's family the business.

王有龄使也笑道：
Wang laughed too.

“别的差使，无有不可，
“Any other assignment is yours.

就是这桩不行。”
Only that one is out of the question.”

两人哈哈大笑，把王太太惊动了，亲自出来探问，
Their laughter drew Mrs Wang out to inquire.

这是一个因头，其实她是要来听听消息，分享这一份她丈夫大交官运的喜悦，
That was her excuse; she really wanted to hear the news and share the joy of her husband's rising fortune.

好在彼此已成通家至好，她也不避胡雪岩，
They had become intimate family friends, so she no longer avoided Hu.

坐在一起，向他谢了又谢，然后问道：“胡少爷，你怎么不捐个官？”
Sitting with them, she thanked him repeatedly, then asked, “Young Master Hu, why don't you purchase an official title?”

“对了！”
“Exactly!”

王有龄立即接口，
Wang seized on it.

“这实在是件要紧大事。
“This is important.

雪岩，你有个功名在身上，办事要方便得多。
A qualification would make your work much easier.

譬如说海动局，你如果也是个州县州子，我就可以保你当委员，替我主持一切。
At the bureau, for instance, if you held a department or county magistrate's qualification, I could recommend you as a commissioner to oversee everything for me.

事情不就好办了吗？”
Wouldn't that simplify matters?”

“话是不错。
“True.

不过老实说，我现在顶要紧的一件事，是先要把阜康办了起来。”
But my first concern is getting Fukang established.”

说着，向王太太看了一眼。
Hu glanced at Mrs Wang.

王有龄会意，有些话他当着王太太不肯说，便托故把他妻子调了开去。
Understanding that some things could not be said before her, Wang found an excuse to send her away.

“阜康要早早开张。
“Fukang must open soon,” Hu continued.

藩台衙门那几万银子，得要快领下来做本钱。
“We need those tens of thousands from the treasury as capital.

雪公，你明天再去催一催，
Press them again tomorrow.

我这里已经托了人了。”
I've already found someone to work on the matter below.”

“这好办。”王有龄说，
“That can be done.

“我现在心里乱得很，不知道该先办何事，后办何事？”
My mind is in such confusion that I don't know what to do first.”

“官场的规矩我不十分在行。
“I don't fully understand official practice.

大家慢慢商量，
Let's discuss it patiently.

尽这一夜工夫，理出个头绪来。
We have the whole night to put things in order.”

一宵细谈，该办的事，孰先孰后，一条一条都写了下来。
They talked through the night, writing down each task and its priority.

胡雪岩是忙着去筹备阜康，
Hu busied himself preparing Fukang.

王有龄的第一件大事，是要去物色幕友。
Wang's first major duty was to find private secretaries.


幕友的名堂甚多，
Private secretaries came in many varieties.

刑、钱两席以外，还有管出纳的“帐房”、写信的“书启”，以及为子弟授书的“教读”、帮忙考试的“阅卷”、征收地了的“征比”等等。
Besides the legal and revenue advisers, there were accountants handling receipts and payments, correspondence secretaries, tutors for the official's children, examination assistants who read papers, collection specialists, and others.

当然最重要的还是“刑名”和“钱谷”。
The legal and revenue posts were naturally the most important.

臬司衙门的俞师爷，是早就答应过王有龄，为他好好物色的，所以第二夭他专诚去拜访俞师爷。
Secretary Yu at the judicial commissioner's yamen had long promised to find suitable men, so Wang made a special call.

来意不道自明，
His purpose needed no explanation.

“刑名”一席，俞师爷已经替王有龄准备好了，就是他的学生。
Yu had already chosen his own pupil for the legal post.

俞师爷的这个学生，名叫秦寿门，名为学生，其实年龄与俞师爷相差无几，当然也不是初出茅庐。
This pupil, Qin Shoumen, was in fact nearly Yu's age and no novice.

大致走上幕宾这条路子，虽说“读书不成，去而学幕”，好象是末路，但却是“神仙、老虎、狗”的生涯。
The profession was sometimes dismissed as a last resort for men who failed in their studies, but a secretary's life could be that of “an immortal, a tiger, or a dog.”

名幕的声光，十分煊赫，
Celebrated secretaries enjoyed great prestige.

此辈不但律例烂熟，文笔畅达，而尤贵乎师承有自，见多识广，
They needed not only command of statutes and precedents and a fluent pen, but sound professional lineage, broad knowledge, and experience.

所以学幕的过程，十分重要。
Their training was therefore crucial.

秦寿门跟随俞师爷多年，由州县开始，历经府、道，一直学到臬司衙门，
Qin had followed Yu for years, beginning at county and department level, progressing through prefectural and circuit offices, and finally reaching the provincial judicial commission.

了解地方上整套司法的程序，以及每一级的职权范围和特性，
He understood the entire local judicial process and the powers and characteristics of every level.

是谓“能得其全”，比那仅仅于州县，或是臬司衙门的，自然高明得多。
This comprehensive experience made him superior to men trained only in a county office or only at the provincial commission.

他在十年前就已出道，馆地从来没有间断过，
He had begun independent practice ten years earlier and had never lacked employment.

前年因为父母双亡，
Two years before, both parents died.

回到原籍绍兴奔丧，接着又生了一场病，
He returned to Shaoxing for their funerals, then fell ill himself.

最近身体复元来投靠老师，
Recently recovered, he had come to his teacher for assistance.

俞师爷正好把他荐给王有龄。
Yu could now recommend him to Wang.

当时请了来彼此见面，一谈之下，相当投机，
They met and conversed agreeably.

王有龄心想，幕友除了自己来得以外，还要讲关系、通声气，否则本事虽大，事倍功半，
Wang reflected that, besides ability, secretaries needed connections and channels of communication; otherwise even great talent achieved little for the effort.

现在是俞师爷介绍的人，将来不管什么案子，由县里申详到省，俞师爷当然要尽力维持，
Since Yu had introduced Qin, he would naturally support cases submitted from the county to the province.

这就等于出一份“修金”，聘了两位幕友，
One salary would effectively secure two advisers.

岂不划算？
An excellent bargain.


于是即时下了口头聘约，彼此都很满意。
They immediately agreed upon the engagement, to mutual satisfaction.

王有龄对于另一位钱谷师爷，也是如法炮制，请藩署最出名的王师爷介绍，
Wang used the same method for the revenue post, asking the most celebrated Secretary Wang in the treasury to recommend someone.

他介绍的是他的一个名叫杨用之的师兄弟，言明在先，人是勤恳老实，本事并不怎么样了不起。
He proposed a fellow pupil, Yang Yongzhi, stating plainly that the man was diligent and honest rather than exceptionally able.

好在王有龄所重视的是借此拉上王师爷的关系，
That suited Wang, who chiefly wanted the connection with Secretary Wang.

钱谷一道，他自己也懂得很多，幕友弱一些也不要紧。
He himself knew much of revenue administration, so a less capable adviser would not matter.

回到海运局，王有龄亲自动笔准备聘书，用大红全帖，
Back at the bureau, he personally prepared the letters of engagement on large red cards.

面写“关书”二字，
The front bore the words “Letter of Engagement.”

里面写的是：“敦聘寿门秦老夫子，在署理乌程县知县兼署湖州府知府任内，办理刑名事件，月奉修金纹银七十两，到馆起修。
Inside Qin's, he wrote: “I respectfully engage Master Qin Shoumen to manage legal affairs during my tenure as acting magistrate of Wucheng County and acting prefect of Huzhou, at a monthly remuneration of seventy taels of standard silver, commencing upon arrival.

三节另奉贽敬纹银八两。
A further ceremonial gift of eight taels will be offered at each of the three major festivals.

谨订。”
This engagement is hereby confirmed.”

下面署款“教弟王有龄顿首拜。”
He signed himself humbly as Wang Youling, bowing his head.

不用官印、也不用私章，
Neither official nor private seal was used.

封入红封套内，加个签条，写的是“秦老夫子惠存”。
The card went into a red envelope labelled “For Master Qin's keeping.”

杨用之的那份关书，款式也是一样，不过修金每月只有五十两，并且写明“不另致送节敬”，这是因为钱谷师爷，在每地丁钱粮征收完毕，另有好处的缘故。
Yang's letter followed the same form, but offered fifty taels a month and expressly excluded additional festival gifts, since a revenue secretary received other benefits after each collection of land and grain taxes.


等把关书送了去，王有龄随即又下帖子请客。
After sending the letters, Wang issued dinner invitations.

幕友虽无官职，但地位与他的“东翁”相同，
Though they held no official rank, private secretaries enjoyed standing equal to that of their employer.

尤其是刑钱两席，有一定的称呼，州县称“大老爷”，所以秦寿门和杨用之，都该称为“师大老爷”。
The legal and revenue advisers in particular had a prescribed form of address: since a local magistrate was called “His Honour,” they were accorded the corresponding honour as secretarial masters.

两位“师大老爷”是分开来请的，
They were invited separately.

因为幕友最讲究札数，他们在衙里自成夭地，
Secretaries insisted upon ceremony, maintaining a domain of their own within the yamen.

长官有事，要移樽就教。
An official seeking advice went to them.

初一、十五就象衙参那样，要恭具衣冠去拜访问好。
On the first and fifteenth of each month he dressed formally to pay his respects, much as at an official audience.

岁时佳节，特为设宴奉请，
Special banquets were offered on festivals.

平时请客一定要请幕友坐首座，否则就不必奉邀。
At ordinary dinners a secretary must occupy the seat of honour or not be invited at all.

现在虽还未到馆，已要按规矩办事，
Although the two had not yet joined him, Wang must already follow the rules.

怕秦、杨二人，哪个坐首座，哪个坐次席，难于安排，所以索性分开来请，两个都是首座。
To avoid deciding which should sit first and which second, he entertained them separately, giving each the first seat.

陪客自然是胡雪岩和周、吴两委员。
Hu, Zhou, and Wu would accompany him.

第一天请的是刑名师爷秦寿门，帖子发了出去，这位贵宾专函辞射，理由是他吃长素，不便叨拢。
Qin was invited first, but declined by letter because he observed a strict vegetarian diet and did not wish to cause trouble.

这也好办，
This was easily remedied.

杭州四大丛林的素斋，无不精致万分，
The vegetarian food of Hangzhou's four great monasteries was exquisite.

雷峰塔下的净慈寺，方丈心悟是王有龄的同乡，素有往还，更加方便，
At Jingci Monastery beneath Leifeng Pagoda, the abbot Xinwu was Wang's fellow townsman and an old acquaintance.

于是另外备了个“洁治素斋候光”的请柬送出去。秦寿门复信，欣然应诺。
Wang sent a new invitation promising a carefully prepared vegetarian meal, which Qin gladly accepted.

到了那天轿子出清彼门，
On the appointed day, their chairs left through Qingbo Gate.

中“柳浪闻莺”下船，先逛西湖，后吃素斋。
They boarded a boat at “Listening to Orioles among the Willows,” toured West Lake, and then ate.

净慈的方丈心悟以半主半客的身分作陪，
Abbot Xinwu joined them as half host, half guest.

席间问起秦寿门吃长素的原因，他回答得很坦率。
Asked why he had become a lifelong vegetarian, Qin answered frankly.


“ 有老和尚在，不敢打诳语，
“With the abbot present, I dare not speak falsely.

我是忏悔宿业。”寿门说，
I am repenting past wrongdoing.

“前两年我在顺天府衙门‘作客，办一件案子，误信人言，以致’失出‘，
A few years ago, while employed at the Shuntian prefectural yamen, I mistakenly trusted someone's account and allowed a guilty man to escape his proper punishment.

虽无责任，此心耿耿不安，
Although I bore no formal responsibility, my conscience remained troubled.

不久，先父先母，双刃弃世，
Soon afterwards both my parents died.

我辞馆回乡，料理完了丧事，自己又是一场大病，九死一生。
I resigned, returned home, and arranged their funerals, then fell dangerously ill myself.

病中忏悔，倘能不死，从此长焉念佛，
During the illness I repented and vowed that, if I survived, I would henceforth abstain from meat and recite Buddhist prayers.

一点诚心，固然蒙菩萨鉴怜，
The bodhisattva evidently took pity on my sincerity.

一天好一天，
I improved day by day.

如今是我还愿的时候。”
Now I am fulfilling that vow.”

“诚则灵！”心悟不断点头，
“Sincerity brings a response,” Xinwu said, nodding repeatedly.

“种爪得瓜，种豆得豆，
“Plant melons and you reap melons; plant beans and you reap beans.

因果不可不信。”
Cause and consequence cannot be disregarded.”

“我本想从此封笔，无奈家累甚重，不得不重作冯妇。
“I intended to lay down my pen altogether, but my family obligations are heavy, and I have had to return to the profession.

公门之中，容易作孽，
It is easy to do wrong in public office.

多蒙东翁台爱，我别无所报，为东翁种些福田。”
I have nothing with which to repay my employer's kindness except to cultivate some merit on his behalf.”

“是，是！”王有龄很诚恳地答道，
“Indeed,” Wang answered earnestly.

“我所望于老夫子的，也就是如此。”
“That is exactly what I hope for.”

“公门之中也好修行。”胡雪岩安慰他说，
“One can also cultivate virtue in public service,” Hu reassured him.

“秦老夫子无心中积的德，一定不少。”
“You must have done much good without realising it.”

“这自然也有。
“Naturally, there has been some.

我们这一行，多少年来师弟相传的心法：”救生不救死‘。就是体上天好生之德。
Our professional rule, passed from master to pupil for years, is ‘Save the living, not the dead,’ in accordance with Heaven's love of life.

然而说句老实话，也是‘乐’在其中。
Though, frankly, there are rewards in that too.”

“这名话很含蓄，但在座的人无不明白，
The words were discreet, but everyone understood.

救了‘生’才有红色收入，
Saving the living brought monetary gifts.

一味替死者伸冤，除了苦主，谁来见情？
If one merely sought justice for the dead, who but the bereaved would show gratitude?

“话又说回来。干我们这一行，到底积德的多，造孽的少，
“Still, our profession does more good than harm.

不比刑官狱吏，造孽容易积德难。”
It differs from prison officials and jailers, for whom wrongdoing is easy and merit difficult.”


“这又是为什么呢？”胡雪岩很感兴味地问。
“Why is that?” Hu asked with interest.

“ 此无他，到底自己可以作主？
“Simply because we can ultimately decide for ourselves.

譬如象雪公这样的东家，自然不许我们造孽，
An employer like Mr Xuexuan would naturally forbid wrongdoing.

即使所遇非人，我们只要自己把握得定，东家也不能强人所难。
Even under the wrong man, if we hold firm, he cannot force us against our principles.

狱里就不同了，
Prison is different.

真正是晴无天日！”
There truly is no daylight there.”

“怎么呢？”
“How so?”

“一句话，非钱不行，
“In a word, nothing happens without money.

没有钱，那地方比猪圈都不如，
Without it, the place is worse than a pigsty.

有钱的，跟自己家里一样，
With it, one lives as comfortably as at home.

不但起居饮食舒服，甚至妻妾要以进去伴宿。”
Food and lodging are excellent, and even wives or concubines can come in to spend the night.”

“我也听说过。”王有龄问道，
“I've heard that too,” Wang said.

“真有这样的事？”
“Does it really happen?”

“当然有！
“Certainly.

我说个故事为诸公下酒，
Let me tell you a story to accompany your wine.

就出在我们浙江，那是道光年间的事……”
It happened here in Zhejiang, during the Daoguang reign.”


据说，道光年培有个富家子弟，犯了命案，情节甚重。
A young man from a rich family had committed a serious homicide.

由县、府、道，一直到省里，都维持“斩立决”的罪名，
County, prefectural, circuit, and provincial authorities all upheld immediate execution by beheading.

只待刑部公文下来，便要处决。
Only the Board of Punishments' authorisation remained before the sentence could be carried out.

这个富家子弟是三世单传，
He was the family's sole male heir for three generations.

所以他家上下打点，只想救出一条命来。
They spent money on every possible approach in the hope of saving him.

无奈情真罪实，遇着的又都是清官，
But the facts were clear and the officials honest.

以致钱虽花得不少，毫无作用，只都便宜了中间经手的人。
Their considerable expenditure benefited only the intermediaries.

那富家翁眼睁睁看着要绝后，百万家财，身后将为五服以外的族人所瓜分，无论如何于心不甘。
His father could not bear to see the line end and his enormous fortune eventually divided among distant clansmen beyond the prescribed degrees of mourning.

于是经人指点，备了一份重礼去请教一个以善于出奇计，外号“鬼见愁”的刑名师爷，
On someone's advice, he took a substantial gift to a legal secretary renowned for ingenious schemes, nicknamed “the Man Even Ghosts Fear.”

不得已而求于次，只想他的在狱中的儿子，能够留下一点骨血，哪怕是个女孩子也好，问那刑名师爷，可有办法？
Unable to save his son, he asked for the next best thing: could the prisoner leave a child, even a girl?

办法是有，但不能包养儿子，因为这是任何人所无能为力的。但就照“鬼见愁”的办法，已能令人满意。
There was a method, though naturally nobody could guarantee a son.

他答应可以让那富家子，多活三个月，
The secretary promised three more months of life.

在这三个月中，以重金觅得数名且男的健妇，送到狱中为富家子荐寝。
During that time, several healthy women considered likely to bear sons would be paid generously to visit the prisoner.

当然，狱中是早已打点好的出入无阻，
The jailers had already been bribed, so access was unrestricted.

每天黎明有人在监狱后门迎接，接着健妇送到家供养。
Each dawn someone would meet the women at the back gate and take them to the wealthy household, where they were maintained.

事先已讲明白，要在他家住几个月，
It was agreed beforehand that they would stay several months.

若无喜信，送一笔钱放回，有了喜信就一直住下去，直到分娩为止，那时或去或留，另有协议。
Those who did not conceive would receive money and leave; those who did would remain until the birth, with further arrangements made afterwards.


这样过了十几天，刑部的复文到了，是“钉封文书”，
Yet after only a dozen days, the ministry's reply arrived in a cord-fastened sealed dispatch.

一望便知是核准了“斩立决”。
One glance showed that it authorised immediate execution.

“慢来，慢来！”胡雪岩打断秦寿门的话问道：
“Wait!” Hu interrupted.

“不是说可以活三个月？
“Didn't you say he had three months?

何以前后一个月不到？
It hasn't even been one.”

““少安毋躁，”
“Be patient.”

秦寿门笑道，
Qin smiled.

“当然另有道理，
“There is naturally another explanation.

不然何以鬼见了都愁？”他接着又讲……
Otherwise, why would even ghosts fear the man?” He continued the story.


既称“斩立决”，等“钉封文书”一到，就得“出红差”，
An immediate-execution order required the execution party to be assembled as soon as the sealed dispatch arrived.

知县升堂，传齐三班六房和刽子手，把犯人从监狱里提了出来，
The magistrate took his seat, summoned the yamen personnel and executioner, and had the prisoner brought from jail.

当堂开拆文书。打开来一看，知县愣住了，
He opened the dispatch in court—and froze.

封套上的姓名不错，里面的文书，完全不对，姓名不对，案情不对，地方也不对，
The name on the cover was correct, but everything inside was wrong: the name, the case, the place.

应该发到贵州的，发到浙江来了。
A document meant for Guizhou had reached Zhejiang.

没有核准斩立决的文书，如何可以杀人？
Without proper authorisation, how could he execute the man?

犯人依旧送回监狱，文书退了回去。
The prisoner returned to jail and the document was sent back.

杭州到京师，再慢也不过二十天，但是要等贵州把那弄错了的文书送回刑部，
Even a slow journey from Hangzhou to the capital took no more than twenty days, but the ministry had to wait for Guizhou to return the other misdirected document.

“云贵半爿天”，
Yunnan and Guizhou seemed half a world away.

一来一往就三个月都不止，
The round trip would take more than three months.

便宜了贵州的那犯人，平白多活了几个月。
The prisoner there benefited too, unexpectedly gaining several months of life.

“这不用说，当然是在部里做了手脚？”王有龄问。
“Naturally, someone at the ministry had arranged it?” Wang asked.

“是的。”秦寿门答道，
“Yes.

“运动了一个刑部主事。
A secretary at the Board of Punishments was persuaded.

这算是疏忽，罚俸三个月，不过几十两银子，
It counted as negligence, punishable by three months' salary—only a few dozen taels.

但就这样一举手之劳的‘疏忽’，非一千银子不办。”
But this effortless act of ‘negligence’ cost a thousand taels to arrange.”

“这是好事！为人延嗣，绝大阴功，还有一千两银子进帐。”胡雪岩笑道：
“A good deed!” Hu laughed. “To preserve a family line is great hidden merit, and brings a thousand taels besides.

“何乐不为？”
Why not do it?”


“其奈坏法何？”秦寿门说，
“But what of the damage to the law?” Qin asked.

“倘或查封、抄家的文书，也是这么横生枝节，国库的损失，谁来认赔？”
“If orders for sealing property or confiscating an estate suffered similar complications, who would compensate the treasury?”

“若有其事，也算疏忽？”
“Would that count as negligence too?”

“此是何等大事，不容疏忽也不会疏忽。
“Such important matters admit no negligence, nor would it occur by accident.

国法不外乎人情，
Law cannot be separated from human motives.

所以听讼执法，只从人情上去揣摩，疑窦立见。
When hearing cases and enforcing it, examine those motives and the doubts become apparent.

譬如说某人向来精细，而某事忽然疏忽，此一疏忽又有大出入，
Suppose a habitually meticulous man suddenly makes a mistake, and the mistake makes an enormous difference.

其事便可疑了。
That is suspicious.

又譬如‘例案’，向来如此办理，
Or take a class of cases always decided one way.

而主管其事的忽然说，这么办是冤枉的，驳了下来，甚至已定谳的案子，把它翻案。
Suddenly the responsible official declares that practice unjust, rejects it, or even overturns a final judgement.

试问，这一案冤枉，以前同样的案子就不冤枉？
If this case was unjust, were the earlier identical cases not unjust too?

何以不翻？
Why not reverse them?

只从这上面去细想一想，其中出了什么鬼？不言可知。”
Consider that carefully, and the hidden interference becomes obvious.”

听这番话，足见得秦寿门是个极明白事理的人。
These remarks showed Qin's clear understanding of affairs.

王有龄当然觉得欣慰。
Wang was naturally pleased.


但刑名一道对县官的前程，关系太大，
But legal affairs mattered enormously to a magistrate's career.

老百姓对父母官的信服与否，首先也就是从刑名上看。
They were also the first basis upon which the people judged their parent-official.

只要年成好，地方富庶，钱粮的浮收及各种摊派，稍微过分些，都还能容忍，
With good harvests and a prosperous district, they might tolerate somewhat excessive additions to taxes and miscellaneous levies.

若是审理官司，有理的一方受屈，无理的一方赢了，即或是无心之失，也会招致老百生极大的不满，说起来必是“贪赃枉法”。
If the rightful party lost a lawsuit and the wrongdoer won, however, even an innocent mistake would provoke deep resentment and accusations of corruption and injustice.

所以王有龄对秦寿门看得比杨用之重，
Wang therefore valued Qin more highly than Yang.

事先跟胡雪岩说好了的，自己不便频频质疑，要他借闲谈多发问，借以考一考秦寿门的本事，
He had agreed with Hu beforehand that, since he could not repeatedly question his new adviser himself, Hu should test him through conversation.

此时便又递了个眼色过去。
He now gave another signal.

于是胡雪岩装得似懂非懂的样子，用好奇而仰慕的语气问道，“都说刑名老夫子一支笔厉害，一个字的出入，就是一家人的祸福，
Hu adopted an expression of partial understanding and asked with curious admiration, “Everyone says a legal master's pen is formidable: one altered character can determine a family's fortune.

又说‘天下文章在幕府’，
They also say the finest writing comes from secretaries' offices.

我问过人，也就不出个所以然。
I've asked about it without receiving a clear explanation.

今天遇见秦老夫子，一定可以教一教我了！”
Today you can surely enlighten me.”

又捧刑名师爷又捧他本人，这顶双料的高帽子，秦寿门戴得很舒服，
This double compliment, to his profession and himself, pleased Qin.

致且酒到半酣，谈兴正好，便矜持地笑道：
Half warmed by wine and enjoying the discussion, he smiled with restrained pride.

“读书万卷不读律，致君尧舜知何术？
“‘Read ten thousand volumes but neglect the law—how will you guide your sovereign to the virtue of Yao and Shun?’

‘所谓’天下文章，出于幕府‘，言其实用而已，
The claim about writing refers to its practical use.

至于一个字的出入，关乎一家人祸福，这话倒也不假。
As for a single character determining a family's fortune, that is true.

不过，舞文弄墨，我辈大忌。
But manipulating words is our profession's great taboo.

总之，无事不可生事，有事不可怕事。”
In short: where no trouble exists, don't create it; where trouble arises, don't fear it.”

在座的人连连点头，
Everyone nodded.

吴委员肚千里有些墨水，尤其觉得“舞文弄墨，我辈大忌”八个字，近乎见道之言，因而说道。“我也要请教！”
Wu, who had some literary education, particularly admired the warning against manipulating words and asked for an explanation.

“先说无事不可生事……”
“First, not creating trouble where none exists...” Qin began.


秦寿门讲了个故事作例证：
He gave an example.

曾有一省的巡抚与藩司不和，巡抚必欲去之而后快，
A governor disliked his provincial treasurer and wanted him removed.

苦于那藩司既清廉又能干，找不着他的错处。
Unfortunately, the treasurer was both honest and capable, leaving no fault to seize upon.

后来找到一个机会，
At last an opportunity came.

文庙丁祭，那藩司正好重伤风，行札的时候，咳个不停，
During a sacrifice at the Confucian temple, the treasurer had a severe cold and coughed continually through the ceremony.

巡抚抓住他这个错，跟幕友商量，
The governor discussed this lapse with his secretary.

那幕友顺从东家的意思，舞文弄墨，大张旗鼓，奏劾那藩司失仪不敬。
Obeying his employer's wishes, the secretary used elaborate wording to make a great affair of it, impeaching the treasurer for ceremonial misconduct and disrespect.

凡有弹劾，朝廷通常总要查了再说，
The court usually investigated before acting upon an accusation.

情节重大则由京里特派钦差，驰驿查办。
Grave cases brought a special commissioner from the capital by express relay.

类此事件，往往交“将军”或者“学政”查报。
Matters of this kind were often referred to the garrison general or provincial education commissioner.

那一省没有驻防的将军，但学政是每一省都有的，
That province had no resident garrison general, but every province had an education commissioner.

这位学政文庙丁祭也在场，知道藩司的失仪，情非得已。
He too had attended the sacrifice and knew that the treasurer's conduct was involuntary.

就算真的失仪，至多事后教训一顿，
Even if it amounted to a breach of decorum, a reprimand afterwards should have sufficed.

又何至于毛举细故，专折参劾？
Why magnify a trifle into a special memorial of impeachment?

由于这一份不满的心情，那学政不但要帮藩司的忙，还要给巡抚吃点苦头。
Resenting this, he wanted not only to help the treasurer but to make the governor suffer.

但是他不便公然指摘巡抚，让朝延疑心他有意袒护藩司，所以措词甚难。
