Yet an open criticism might lead the court to suspect partiality, making the wording difficult.

这位学政未曾中举成进士以前，原学过刑名，
Before passing the provincial and metropolitan examinations, the education commissioner had trained in legal work.

想了半天，从巡抚原奏的“亲见”二字中，欣然有悟，
After much thought, he found inspiration in the governor's claim to have “personally witnessed” the offence.

随即提笔复奏，他说他丁祭那天，虽也在场，但无法复查这一案，因为他“位列前班，理无后顾”，不知道藩司失仪了没有？
His reply said that, although present, he could not verify it: “My place was in the forward rank; propriety forbade looking behind.”

就这轻描淡写八个字，军机大臣一看便知道，是巡抚有意找藩司的麻烦，
Those unobtrusive words made the matter plain to the Grand Councillors.

因为行礼时巡抚也是跪在藩司前面，
The governor too had knelt ahead of the treasurer.

如何知道后面的藩司失仪？
How could he have seen misconduct behind him?

照此说来，是巡抚抚失仪往后面看了，才发现藩司失仪。
He must himself have broken decorum by turning round.

结果两个人都有处分。
Both officials were punished.

原被告各打五十板，自然是原告失面子，被告虽受罚，心里是痛快的。
With plaintiff and defendant treated alike, the plaintiff lost face, while the defendant, though punished, felt satisfied.


“这真是‘世不本无事，庸人自扰之’。”吴委员说，
“Truly, there was no trouble until a foolish man made it,” Wu said.

“坏在那巡抚的幕友不能痛切规劝。”
“The fault lay in the governor's secretary failing to remonstrate firmly.”

“这话说中的症结所在。”
“You've identified the essential point.”

秦寿门向王有龄看了一眼，
Qin glanced at Wang.

“我辈既蒙东家不弃，处事自有必不可摇的宗旨，
“Once an employer has honoured us with his trust, we must hold to unshakable principles.

一时依从，留下后患，自误误人，
Compliance for a moment that leaves trouble for the future harms both him and us.

千万不可。
It must never happen.

只是忠言往往逆耳，难碍有几位东家没有脾气。”
Unfortunately, loyal advice often jars upon the ear, and few employers have no temper.”

“老大子请放心！”王有龄急忙表明态度，
“Rest assured,” Wang promptly declared.

“我奉托了老替子，将来刑名方面，自然都请老夫子作主。”
“Having entrusted the post to you, I shall naturally leave legal affairs to your judgement.”

“有东翁这句话，我可以放心放手了。
“With that assurance, I can act confidently.

今天我借花献佛，先告个罪，将来要请东翁恕我专擅之罪。”
Taking advantage of this hospitality, let me apologise in advance and ask you to forgive any future appearance of overstepping my authority.”

说着他举杯相敬，
He raised his cup.

王有龄欣然接受，
Wang gladly accepted the toast.

宾主如鱼得水，在座的人亦都觉得很愉快。
Host and guest were perfectly at ease, and everyone shared their pleasure.

轰然祝饮，闹过一阵，重拾中断的话题。
After a noisy round of drinking, they returned to the interrupted subject.


“现在要谈有事不可怕事。”吴委员提高了声音说道，
“Now for not fearing trouble when it comes,” Wu said loudly.

“索性也请老夫子举例以明之。”
“Please give us an example of that too.”

秦寿门略略沉吟了一下说“有事不可怕事者，是要沉得住气，
Qin considered briefly. “It means keeping one's composure.

气稳则心定，心定则神闲，
A steady temper settles the mind; a settled mind allows clear thought.

死棋肚里才会出仙着。
Then an apparently lost position may yield an inspired move.

大致古今律法，不论如何细密，总有漏洞，
However detailed the law, ancient or modern, there are always gaps.

事理也是一样，
Reasoning is similar.

有时道理不通，大家习焉不察，也就过去了，
Sometimes an argument is unsound, but familiarity keeps everyone from noticing.

而看来不可思议之事，细想一想竟是道理极通，无可驳诘。
Something apparently inconceivable may, on examination, prove entirely reasonable and beyond refutation.

所以只要心定神闲，想得广、想得透，蹈瑕乘隙，避重就轻，大事化小，小事化无，亦并不难。
With composure, breadth, and depth of thought, one can find the opening, avoid the heavier consequence, and turn a great problem into a small one, then into none.

刚才提到‘ 钉封文书’，我就说个钉封文书的妙事。
Since we mentioned cord-fastened dispatches, let me tell you an ingenious story about one.

在座各位，“他看着王有龄问道，”想来东翁一定见过这玩意？
I suppose my employer has seen them?”

““见过。”王有龄答道，
“Yes,” Wang replied.

“原来钉封文书，用意在示机密，
“Originally their fastening signified confidentiality.

亦不光是州县处决犯人非受领钉封文书不可，访拿要犯也用钉封文书。
They were used not only for execution orders but for arresting important criminals.

久而久之，成为具文，封套上钉个‘瓣’，用细麻绳一拴，
In time the practice became a formality: a flap fixed to the cover, tied with thin hemp cord.

人人可以拆开来看，
Anyone could open it.

最机密变成最不机密，真正是始料所不及！”
The most confidential document became the least secure—an outcome surely never intended.”

“一点都不错。
“Exactly.

这件妙事，毛病就出在‘人人可以拆开来看’上面。
This story turns upon that freedom to open them.

钉封文书按驿站走，
Such dispatches travelled by post relay.

每经一县，都要加盖大印。
Each county through which they passed added its official seal.

公事过手，遇着好事的县大爷，就拆开来看一看依旧封好。
An inquisitive magistrate handling one might open it, read it, and tie it up again.

有这么一位县太爷，鸦片大瘾，
One such magistrate was a heavy opium smoker.

每天晚上在签押房里，躺在烟铺上看公事。
Every evening he read official papers while reclining beside his pipe.

这天也是拆了一封钉封文书看，迷迷糊糊，把那通文书在烟灯上饶掉了，”
One night, half dazed, he opened a dispatch and accidentally burned its contents over the opium lamp.”


这一下，那县太爷才惊醒过来，
That brought him sharply to his senses.

烧掉了钉封文书，是件不得了的事！
Destroying a confidential dispatch was an appalling offence.

急忙移樽就教，到刑名师爷那里求援。
He hurried to seek his legal secretary's help.

“封套在不在？”那刑名师爷问。
“Do you still have the cover?”

“封套还在。”
“Yes.”

“那不要紧！
“Then don't worry.

请东翁交了给我。顺便带大印来。”
Give it to me, and bring the official seal.”

县太爷照办不误，
The magistrate obeyed.

等封套取到，那刑名师爷取张白纸折好，往里一塞，拴好麻绳，盖上大印，交了回去。
The secretary folded a blank sheet, put it inside, tied the cord, stamped the seal, and handed it back.

“交驿递发下一站！”
“Send it by relay to the next station.”

“老夫子，”县太爷迟疑地问道：“这行吗？
“Will that do?” the magistrate asked hesitantly.

下一站发觉了怎么办？”
“What if the next station discovers it?”

“东家，请你自己去想。”那刑名师爷说，
“Think for yourself.

“换了你是下一县，
Suppose you're the next magistrate.

打开来一看，里头是张白纸，
You open it and find a blank sheet.

请问你怎么办？”
What would you do?”

秦寿门把那个故事讲到此处，不需再往下说，
Qin needed to go no further.

在座的人应都明白，
Everyone understood.

显然的，有人发现了是张白纸，也不敢声张，更不敢多事退回去。因为倘或如此，便先犯了窃视机密文书的过失，
Anyone finding the blank page would dare neither announce the discovery nor return it and cause trouble: that would first expose his own offence of opening a confidential document.

这与那学政的“位列前班，理无后顾”八字，有异曲同功之妙。
The reasoning resembled the education commissioner's statement that his forward position forbade looking behind.


“刑名虽是‘法家’，也要多读老庄之书，才能有些妙悟。”王有龄感叹着说，
“Though legal advisers belong to the school of law, they should also read Laozi and Zhuangzi to gain such insights,” Wang reflected.

“人不能有所蔽，有所蔽则能见秋毫，不见舆薪。
“A man must not allow his vision to be obstructed, seeing an autumn hair but missing a cartload of firewood.

世上明明有许多极浅显的道理，偏偏有人看不破，
There are so many obvious truths that people nevertheless fail to see.

这是哪里说起？”
How can one explain it?”

这番议论一发，便把话题引了开去。
The discussion moved to other matters.

闲谈到夕阳衔山，方始散席，依旧荡桨回城。
They talked until sunset, then left the table and rowed back to the city.

第二请钱谷师爷杨用之，在西湖里的一条画舫上设席，陪客依旧是胡雪岩和周、吴两委员。
The following day, Wang entertained the revenue secretary Yang Yongzhi aboard a pleasure boat on West Lake, again accompanied by Hu, Zhou, and Wu.

由于阜康钱庄创设以后，预计是要用湖州府和乌程县解省的公款，作为资本，
Fukang was expected to use Huzhou Prefecture's and Wucheng County's public remittances to the provincial treasury as capital.

这与钱谷师爷有密切的关系，因此胡雪岩对杨用之，特别笼络。
Since the revenue secretary was closely involved, Hu made a special effort to cultivate him.

杨用之赋性忠厚老实，是最容易对付的人，
Yang was straightforward and honest, and therefore easy to manage.

以胡雪岩的手腕，把他摆布得服服帖帖，颇有相见恨晚之感。
Hu soon made him wholly accommodating, with the feeling that they should have met long before.

其实胡雪岩的手腕也很简单，
In fact, the method was simple.

凡是忠厚老实的人，都喜欢别人向他请教，而他自己亦往往知无不言，言无不尽。
Straightforward men liked to be consulted and generally shared all they knew.

胡雪岩会说话，更会听话，
Hu spoke well, but listened still better.

不管那人是如何地语言无味，他能一本正经，两眼注视，仿佛听得极感兴味似地，
However dull another man's words, he could attend gravely, eyes fixed upon him, as though fascinated.

同时，他也真的是在听，紧要关头补充一两语。引申一两义，
He really did listen, adding a remark or developing a point at the crucial moment.

使得滔滔不绝者，有莫逆于心之快，自然觉得投机而成至交。
The speaker then felt deeply understood, and congenial conversation became close friendship.


杨用之的本事不怎么好，但以他的性格随和，所以交游甚广，
Yang was not exceptionally able, but his agreeable temperament had given him many acquaintances.

加以遇着胡雪岩，不知不觉地提起了谈兴，讲了许多时人的轶闻，
Hu's company drew him into an animated account of contemporary figures.

最后谈到湖州府的人物，他提起一个人叫钱江，问王有龄认不认识？
Eventually, discussing Huzhou, he mentioned Qian Jiang and asked whether Wang knew him.

“我听说过他，
“I've heard of him.

是湖州府长兴县人，
He comes from Changxing County in Huzhou Prefecture.

曾跟我们福建的林文忠公，一起遣戍伊犁，由此出名。
He became known through being exiled to Ili with our Fujian statesman Lin Wenzhong.

听说他是个奇士。
They say he's an extraordinary man.

想来林文忠公所赏识的人物，总不会错的。”
Someone appreciated by Lord Lin can't be ordinary.

王有龄问道：“怎么老夫子忽然提到这个人，
Why do you mention him?

莫非有他的新闻？”
Is there news?”

“也好说是新闻。
“You could call it news.

不过这条新闻，与各州县利害关系甚大，还不知道朝廷的主张如何？”
But it affects local officials profoundly, and we don't yet know the court's view.”

“喔，要请教。”
“Please explain.”

“这要从一位达官谈起，
“We must begin with a senior official.

雷以諴其人，东翁总知道？”
You know Lei Yixian?”

“知道。”王有龄说，
“Yes.

“此公湖北人，
A Hubei man.

以左副御史会同河道总督巡视黄河口岸。
As senior vice censor-in-chief, he joined the Director-General of River Conservancy to inspect the Yellow River's outlet.

前些日子看邸抄，说他自请讨贼，
Recently I read that he volunteered to fight the rebels.

现在募了一万人，驻军江北高邮，扼守扬州东南，
He has recruited ten thousand men, stationed them at Gaoyou north of the Yangtze, and is guarding the southeastern approach to Yangzhou.

很打了几场胜仗。”
He's won several battles.”

“是的，
“Exactly.

钱江就在他幕府里。”杨用之说，
Qian Jiang serves on his staff.

“有兵无饷，仗是打不下去的，
Troops without pay cannot fight.

朝廷的宗旨，反正只要你能募兵筹饷，自己去想办法，无不赞成的。
The court's position is that anyone able to recruit men and raise funds should devise his own means, and it will approve.

听说钱江现在为雷军划一策，在水陆要冲，设局设卡，
I hear Qian has proposed collection offices and checkpoints at important land and water routes.

凡行商经过，看他所带货物，估价抽税，大致千取其一，
Travelling merchants are assessed on the value of their goods, generally one part in a thousand.

称为‘厘捐’，
The levy is called lijin.

除了行商，当地店铺亦照此抽税。
Local shops pay on the same basis.

收入颇为可观，听说各省都有仿照的意思。
The receipts are considerable, and other provinces are reportedly considering imitation.

只是此法病商，朝廷或者不许。”
But since it harms trade, the court may refuse it.”


杨用之所谈的新闻，以及认为在创议中的“厘捐”会“病商”的见解，恰好给了王有龄一个机会，
This news, and Yang's view that the proposed lijin would harm merchants, gave Wang his opportunity.

聘用刑、钱两幕友，他跟胡雪岩曾仔细谈过，
He and Hu had discussed the two secretaries carefully.

刑名是外行，非倚托秦寿门不可，所以先要考一考他的本事。
Law was outside Wang's expertise, so he must rely upon Qin and first test his ability.

钱谷则王有龄自己就很精通，
Revenue administration was different: Wang understood it well.

但幕友的传统，向来独立办事，不喜东家干涉，
Yet secretaries traditionally worked independently and disliked interference.

平和的还表面上有所敷衍，专断的根本就置之不理，
An accommodating one might give an outwardly polite response; an autocratic one would simply ignore his employer.

所以胡雪岩设计，由他自己用感情来笼络杨用之，而王有龄则要拿点本事给他看看，
Hu's plan was therefore to win Yang's affection while Wang demonstrated enough knowledge to command respect.

这样双管齐下，让杨用之怀德畏威，把他收服，才能指挥如意。
With gratitude and apprehension working together, Yang could be brought under effective direction.

所以王有龄听了他的话，觉得不妨趁些机会，展示所学。
Wang seized the moment to display his learning.

“ ‘病商’恐未必！”他一开口就是辩驳语气，
“I'm not sure it necessarily harms trade,” he began in an argumentative tone.

“本朝的赋税制度，异于前代，
“Our dynasty's tax system differs from those of earlier times.

一遇用兵之时，必须另筹军费，
Whenever war comes, military funds must be raised separately.

以我看，开办‘厘捐’，比较起来，还不失为利多害少的好办法。”
Comparatively speaking, lijin may still offer more benefit than harm.”

这笼统一句话，是做文章的一个“帽子”，
This broad proposition served as the introduction to an essay.

王有龄既有炫耀之意，便得从头讲起。
Intent upon demonstrating his knowledge, Wang began at the beginning.

自古以来，国家岁收的主要项目，就是地了与钱粮，
From ancient times, the chief annual revenues had been land and poll taxes and grain levies.

明朗未年不断“加派”，搞得民不聊生，
Repeated additional assessments late in the Ming had made life intolerable.

庄稼人苦得要死，到最后只好弃地而逃，
Farmers suffered so greatly that they abandoned their fields and fled.

此为“流寇”猖獗，终以亡明的一大关键。
This was a major cause of the spread of roaming rebels and, ultimately, the dynasty's fall.


清兵入关，到圣祖平定三藩之乱，始得奠定国基。
After the Qing entered China, the Kangxi emperor's suppression of the Three Feudatories finally secured the dynasty's foundations.

鉴于前朝之失，颁发“永不加赋”的诏令，
Taking warning from the Ming, he issued an edict promising never to increase taxation.

此为清朝的一大仁政，亦为满族得以长主中原的一大凭借。
This was one of the dynasty's great benevolent measures and a principal reason the Manchus could long rule the central plains.

后世诸帝，对圣祖的这个诏谕，信守不坠。
Later emperors faithfully maintained it.

此外国家岁收，还有关税、盐课两项，但地丁占岁收总额的三分之二，
Customs and salt duties also supplied annual revenue, but land and poll taxes represented two-thirds of the total.

既有永不加赋的限制，则岁收就有了定额。
With an undertaking never to increase them, annual receipts were effectively fixed.

风调雨顺、刀兵不起的太平岁月，固然可以支应，
They could cover expenditure in peaceful years of favourable weather.

但一遇用兵，额外的军费负担，即无着落，
But war brought extra military costs with no provision.

倘或水旱年荒，一面要减免丁漕，一面要办赈济，收入减少，支出增加，
Drought or flood required both tax remissions and famine relief: income fell while expenditure rose.

又如何应付？
How could that be managed?

再如刀兵水旱一齐来，火上加油，两面发烧，更是件不得了的事。
If war and natural disaster coincided, both sides of the crisis intensified.


“这有两个办法弥补，一靠平时蓄积。”王有龄从容议论：
“There are two ways to meet the shortfall,” Wang continued calmly. “The first is savings accumulated in ordinary times.

“虽然天子富有四海，国家收入与宫廷收入，还是有区分的。
Though the emperor possesses all within the four seas, state revenue and palace revenue are separate.

这个制度从汉朝就很完备了，‘大司农’掌国家度支，‘少府’管天子的私财。
The distinction was already well developed under the Han: the Grand Minister of Agriculture managed public expenditure, while the Privy Treasurer managed the sovereign's private wealth.

私财有余，国币不足，国家必乱。
If the ruler has a surplus while the state lacks funds, disorder follows.

宋太祖平服十国，所得金银珍宝虽输于内府，但另行封存，称为‘封桩银’。
When the founding Song emperor subdued the Ten Kingdoms, their gold, silver, and jewels went into the palace treasury, but were separately sealed as a special reserve.

他的打算是积到相当数目，要把‘燕云十六州’买回来。
He intended to accumulate enough to buy back the Sixteen Prefectures of Yan and Yun.

可惜徽宗不肖，以内府所积，用来起‘民岳’，才有金兵入寇之事。
Unfortunately, the unworthy Huizong spent the palace reserves on the Genyue pleasure garden, after which the Jin invaded.

前明更不必说，户部穷得要命，宫内蓄积如山，到最后，白白便宜了‘流寇’。
The Ming needs no elaboration: its Board of Revenue was desperately poor while palace wealth piled high, only to fall into the rebels' hands.

本朝就不同了，
Our dynasty is different.

蓄只于国库而非内务府。”
Reserves are held in the state treasury, not the Imperial Household Department.”


接着王有龄便举了几个户部存银的数目，康熙四十八年到过五千万两，最后剩下八百万两，但雍正十三年的极力整顿，到乾隆即位时，库存到了前所未有的六千万两的巨数，以后乾隆四十六年，到过七千万两。
Wang then cited treasury balances: fifty million taels in Kangxi's forty-eighth year, falling to eight million by the end; after thirteen years of vigorous reform under Yongzheng, an unprecedented sixty million at Qianlong's accession; and seventy million in Qianlong's forty-sixth year.

但嘉庆以后就不行了，到道光朝更是每况愈下。
After Jiaqing, however, the position deteriorated, worsening further under Daoguang.

“先帝崩逝当时，户部存银八百万两，
“When the late emperor died, the Board held eight million taels.

这三年来的数目不详。
I don't know the figures for the last three years.

洪杨军兴以来，用财如流水，
Since Hong and Yang rose, money has flowed like water.

想来现在正是开国以来最穷的时候。”
I imagine the dynasty has never been poorer.”


这一番夹叙夹议的谈论，不但周、吴等人有茅塞顿开之感，就是杨用之也觉得长了一番见闻。
The mixture of narrative and analysis enlightened not only Zhou and Wu but Yang himself.

钱谷一道虽是他的专业，却只了解一隅之地的财政，朝廷大藏，十分隔膜，
Revenue was his profession, yet he knew only local finance and little of the central treasury.

现在听王有龄讲得头头是道，心里便有这样一个想法：这位东翁，莫道他是捐班出身，肚子里着实有些货色。
Hearing Wang explain it so coherently, he thought that, purchased qualification or not, his employer had considerable learning.

他想到了王有龄的出身，王有龄恰好也要谈到捐班，
At that very moment Wang turned to purchased office.

“弥补国用不足，再有一个办法是靠捐纳的收入。”他说，
“The second way to meet a public shortfall is through contributions paid for official qualifications.

“捐官的制度，起于汉朝，即所谓‘纳赀为郎’。
The system began under the Han, when money could obtain a position as a palace gentleman.

此后历代都有，但不如本朝的盛行。”
Later dynasties retained it, but none used it as extensively as ours.”

接着，王有龄便细谈清朝捐纳制度演变的经过，以及对中枢岁收的关系。
He described its development and connection with central revenue.

捐纳实缺虽由康熙为三藩之乱，筹措军费而起，
Contributions for actual appointments had begun under Kangxi to fund the war against the Three Feudatories.

但至雍正朝即成为“常例”，捐纳收入几为国家岁收的一部分，只是比例不大，平均总在百分之十五左右。
By Yongzheng's reign they had become a regular practice, their proceeds effectively part of annual revenue, though at a relatively modest average of around fifteen per cent.

捐例之滥，始于嘉庆朝，
Excessive use began under Jiaqing.

它的收入常为岁收的一半，嘉庆七年那一年，更高达岁收总额百分之八十以上。
The proceeds often equalled half the year's revenue, and in his seventh year exceeded eighty per cent.

“捐例一滥，其弊不可胜言。”王有龄泰然说道，
“Once the system is abused, its evils are beyond description,” Wang said evenly.

“我自己虽是捐班出身，但也实在叫我无法看得起捐班的。
“Though I myself entered by purchase, I can hardly respect that class of official.

只要有钱，不管什么胸无点墨的人，都可以做官。
Anyone with money, however ignorant, can obtain office.

做官既要先花本钱，那就跟做生意一样，
Having first invested capital, he treats administration like a business.

一补上实缺，先要捞回本息。
Once appointed, he must recover principal and interest.

请问吏治如何澄清得来？”
How can clean government result?”


“这也不可一概而论。”吴委员说，
“That cannot be said of everyone,” Wu objected.

“赴试登进，自是正途，
“Advancement by examination is naturally the proper path.

但‘场中莫论文’，
But examination success doesn't depend on writing alone.

要靠‘一命、二运、三风水’，所以怀才不遇的也多的是。
Fate, luck, and favourable circumstances play their part, leaving many capable men unrecognised.

捐例开了方便之门，让他们有个发挥机会，不致埋没人才，
Purchase opens a door through which they can exercise their talents instead of being buried.

也是莫大功德之事。”
That too is a great service.”

这是在暗中恭维王有龄，他当然听得懂，
The compliment to Wang was implicit and understood.

而且也不必客气，
He saw no need to disclaim it.

“象兄弟这种情形到底不多。”他说，
“Cases like mine are uncommon.

“纵有一利，奈有百害何？
Even one advantage cannot compensate for a hundred harms.

如今为了军费，越发广开已滥的捐例，搞得满街是官，
Now military expenses are widening an already overused system until the streets are full of officials.

那还成何话说！”
What sense does that make?”

“东翁见得极是。”杨用之倒是真的心悦诚服，
“Your view is entirely sound,” Yang answered, sincerely convinced.

所以不自觉其矛盾地改了论调，
Without noticing his reversal, he changed his argument.

“本朝的商税，原就不重，
“Commercial taxes in our dynasty are not heavy.

杂赋中的牙帖税、当税、牲畜税以外，买卖的商税，只有买别地货物到店发卖的‘落地税’，也就是‘坐税’。
Apart from such miscellaneous charges as brokers' licence fees, pawnshop duties, and livestock taxes, ordinary trade pays only the tax on goods brought from elsewhere for sale in local shops—the landing tax, also called the stationary tax.

至于货物经过的‘过税’，只有关税一种，
Goods in transit pay only customs duties.

如今酌增厘捐，亦不为过。”
A moderate additional lijin levy would not be excessive.”

“就是这话罗！”王有龄口中这样在说，心中却己想到厘捐是否亦可在浙江开办？
“Precisely!” Wang said, already wondering privately whether Zhejiang too might introduce it.


一场议论，算是有了结果。
The discussion had achieved its purpose.

胡雪岩换了个话题，
Hu changed the subject.

他很佩服钱江，所以这样发问：“杨老夫子可识得那位钱先生？”
Impressed by Qian Jiang, he asked whether Yang knew him.

“你是说钱江？”杨用之答道，“我们不但认识，而且还沾些亲。
“Not only do I know him; we're distantly related.

他字秋平，又字东平。
His courtesy names are Qiuping and Dongping.

祖上曾做过山东巡抚，他老太爷也在山东做过官，
An ancestor was governor of Shandong, and his father also served there.

此人从小不凡，样样聪敏，就是不喜欢做八股文章。”
He was exceptional from childhood, quick at everything except that he disliked eight-legged essays.”

“那怎么称做‘奇士’呢？”吴委员笑道，
“How else would he be an extraordinary man?” Wu laughed.

“象这样的人，必是不中绳墨，别有抱负的。”
“Someone like that must disregard conventional restraints and have ambitions of his own.”

“他还有一策，现在各省都已仿行。”
“He proposed another measure now being adopted across the provinces.”

杨用之忽然看着胡雪岩说，
Yang suddenly looked at Hu.

“雪岩兄大可一办！”
“You could make use of it yourself.”

“请问，办什么？”胡雪岩愕然相问。
“What measure?”

“也是钱东平的主意，请旨预领空白捐照，随捐随发，
“Another of Qian Dongping's ideas: obtain imperial permission to draw blank qualification certificates in advance and issue them as soon as contributions are paid.

人人称便，所以‘生意’好得很。”杨用之笑道，
Everyone finds it convenient, so ‘business’ is excellent.

“本省亦已照样进行。
This province has begun doing the same.

雪岩兄大可捐个前程。”
You could purchase a qualification.”


这话倒把胡雪岩说动了，
That appealed to Hu.

这几个月他在官场打了几个滚，深知“身分”二字的重要，倒不是为了炫耀，而是为了方便，
His recent experience in official circles had taught him the importance of standing, not for display but for convenience.

无论拜客还是客人来拜，彼此请教姓氏时，称呼照规矩来，毫无窒碍。
When making or receiving calls and exchanging names, a recognised qualification settled the proper forms of address without awkwardness.

是个“白丁”，便处处有格格不入之感，
As an untitled commoner, he felt out of place everywhere.

熟人无所谓，大家可以称兄道弟，若是陌生的官儿，称呼上不是委屈了自己，就是得罪了别人，
Friends could address one another as brothers, but with unfamiliar officials he risked either diminishing himself or offending them.

实在是一大苦事。
It was a serious difficulty.

因此，这天晚上他特地跟王有龄去商量。王有龄自然赞成：
That evening he specially consulted Wang, who naturally approved.

“我早就劝你快办了！
“I've urged you to do it for ages!

我真不知道你什么意思？一直拖着。”
I don't know why you've kept delaying.”

“都是为了没工夫，”胡雪岩说，
“No time.

“这件事麻烦得很，
The business is troublesome.

费辰光不说，还有层层挑剔需索，把人的兴致都消磨光了。
Apart from the time it takes, there are objections and demands for fees at every stage, enough to destroy anyone's enthusiasm.

象现在这样。随捐随发，一手交钱，一手取照，自然又当别论。”
Immediate issue, with money handed over and the certificate received in return, is different.”

“需索还是会有的。
“There will still be demands.

讲是讲‘随捐随发’，到底也没有那么快。
‘Immediate’ won't be quite so immediate.

不过，部照不必到部里去领，当然快得多。”
But avoiding collection from the ministry itself will certainly make it much faster.”


“于此可见，凡事总要动脑筋。
“That shows how necessary it is to think.

说到理财，到处都是财源。”
In finance, opportunities are everywhere.”

胡雪岩又得到启示：
Hu drew another lesson.

“一句话，不管是做官的对老百姓，做生意的对主顾。 你要人荷包里的钱，就要把人伺候得舒服，才肯心甘情愿掏荷包。”
“Whether an official dealing with the people or a merchant dealing with customers, if you want the money in their purses, make them comfortable enough to open those purses willingly.”

“这话有道理。”
“There's truth in that.”

王有龄深深点点，
Wang nodded thoughtfully.

“我这趟到湖州，也要想办法把老百姓‘伺候’得舒舒服服，好叫他们高高兴兴来完钱粮。”
“At Huzhou, I too must find a way to ‘serve’ the people comfortably, so they'll gladly pay their taxes.”

“其实老百姓也很好问候，
“They're easy enough to serve.

不打官腔，实事求是，老百姓自会说你是好官。”
Avoid official bluster and deal with realities; they'll call you a good official.”

胡雪岩又谈到他自己的事，
Hu returned to his own business.

“雪公，你看我捐个什么班子？”
“What qualification should I purchase?”

“州县。”王有龄毫不考虑地答说，
“Department or county magistrate,” Wang answered without hesitation.

“这件事你托杨用之好了。”
“Entrust it to Yang Yongzhi.”

胡雪岩受了他的教，第二天特地具个柬帖，把杨用之请了在馆子里小酌。
Taking his advice, Hu sent Yang a formal invitation the next day and entertained him at a restaurant.


酒过三巡，谈起正事，
After three rounds of wine, they discussed the matter.

杨用之一诺无辞，而且声叫：
Yang readily agreed and made an announcement.

“报捐向来在正项以外，另有杂费，经手的人都有好处，
“Beyond the prescribed contribution, there are always miscellaneous charges from which everyone handling the business receives a benefit.

我的一份扣除，杂费还可以打个七折。”
I'll deduct my own share and reduce the miscellaneous fees by thirty per cent.”

“这不好。
“That won't do.

君子爱财，取之有道，
A gentleman may love money, provided he acquires it properly.

该当你老夫子的，自然当仁不让。”
Whatever is due to you should be accepted without hesitation.”

“那还叫朋友吗？”
“Would that be friendship?”

杨用之摇着手说，
Yang waved his hand.

“你不必管这一层了。
“Leave that to me.

我且问你的意思，光是捐个班呢，还是要捐‘花样’？”
What I need to know is whether you want the basic qualification or additional preferences.”

捐官的花样极多，
There were many variations in purchasing office.

最起码的是捐个空头名义，凭一张部照。就算是有了身分，可以光大门楣，炫耀乡里，
The simplest was an empty title supported by a ministry certificate, conferring standing, family distinction, and local prestige.

如果要想补实缺。另有种种优先次序，补缺省份的花样。
An actual appointment required choices concerning priority and the province in which one would serve.

胡雪岩别有奥援，也不想进京到吏部报供候选。
Hu had other powerful support and no wish to travel to the capital, register with the Board of Civil Office, and await selection.

捐官不过捐个“胡老爷”的尊称，依旧开自己的钱庄，
He merely wanted the title “His Honour Hu” while continuing to run his bank.

那就无须多加花费，另捐花样了。
Additional expenditure was unnecessary.

于是胡雪岩说：“我只要有张‘部照’就可以了。
“I only need the ministry certificate.

难道真的去做官？”
Am I really going to be an official?”

“你要做官也不难，而且必是一等一的红员。
“It wouldn't be difficult, and you'd be a favourite of the first order.

不过人各有志。
But each man has his ambitions.

你明天就送银子来，
Bring the silver tomorrow.

我替你‘上兑’，尽快把捐照领下来。”
I'll pay it in and obtain the certificate as quickly as possible.”


“拜托，拜找！”胡雪岩道过谢，就不再提这事了，
Hu thanked him and said no more about the purchase.

殷殷劝酒，一面拉拢杨用之，一面向他讨教州县钱谷出入之际，有些什么“花样”？
He diligently pressed wine upon Yang, strengthening their friendship while asking what opportunities existed around local revenue receipts and expenditure.

杨用之人虽老实，而且也觉得他极够朋友，但遇到这些地方，他也不肯多说。
Honest though Yang was, and warmly as he regarded Hu, he would not say much on those matters.

好在胡雪岩机警，举一反三，依旧“偷”到不少“决窍”。
Hu's quick understanding nevertheless enabled him to infer several methods from the hints he received.

第二天他从准备开钱庄的五千两银子中，提出一笔捐官的钱来，
The next day, he took the purchase money from the five thousand taels set aside for opening the bank.

“正项”打成票子，“杂费”是现银，一起送到杨用之那里。
The official contribution was made into a draft, the miscellaneous charges supplied in silver, and both delivered to Yang.

杨用之果然不肯受好处。把杂费中他应得的一份退了回来。
True to his word, Yang returned the portion of the fees that would have been his own benefit.


这时已是四月底，
By now it was the end of the fourth month.

王有龄要打点上任，忙得不可开交。胡雪岩当然更忙，既要为王有龄参赞，又要忙自己的钱庄。
Wang was overwhelmed with preparations for taking office, and Hu was busier still, both advising him and establishing the bank.

亏得刘庆生十分得力，
Fortunately, Liu was extremely capable.

在运司河下典了一幢极体面的房子，油漆粉恻，自己督工，
He had taken a handsome building in pledge at Yunsi Hexia and personally supervised its painting and plastering.

此外做招牌、买家具、请伙计，里里外外，一手包办，
Signboards, furniture, employees—he managed everything inside and out.

每天起早落夜，累得人又黑又瘦，但人逢喜事精神爽，丝毫不以为苦。
Rising early and retiring late, he grew dark and thin with fatigue, but his delight in the opportunity made the work seem no hardship.

上任的黄道吉日挑定了，选定五月初九。
An auspicious day had been chosen for Wang to take office: the ninth of the fifth month.

这一下设宴饯行的帖子，纷纷飞到。
Invitations to farewell dinners poured in.

做事容易做官难，应酬不能不到，
Doing business was easier than being an official; social obligations could not be neglected.

王有龄时间不够，大感苦恼，
Wang was distressed by the lack of time.

等看到张胖子也来了一张请帖，就想躲懒了。
When Zhang's invitation arrived, he hoped to evade it.

“你看，”他对胡雪岩苦笑， “张胖子也来凑热闹！
“Look,” he said to Hu with a rueful smile, “Zhang has joined the crowd!

算了吧，托你替我去打个招呼，
Please explain for me.

留着他那顿酒，等我上省再叩扰。”
Let him keep his dinner until I return to the provincial capital.”

胡雪岩心想，张胖子的情分不同，利害关系，格外密切，王有龄实在不能不给他一个面子。
Hu thought their relationship with Zhang too special, their interests too closely connected, for Wang to deny him this respect.

不过排排他的帖子，一天总有两三处应酬，也实在为难。
Yet the invitations showed two or three engagements every day.

想了一下，他有了个主意：
After a moment he had an idea.

“本来我也要意思意思……”
“I had intended to offer a little hospitality myself...”

“自己弟兄，”王有龄抢着说道，“大可免了。”
“Between brothers, that can certainly be dispensed with,” Wang interrupted.

“雪公，你听我说完。”胡雪岩又说，
“Let me finish.

“本着我想把我的‘档子’让给张胖了，
I'd thought of giving Zhang my place in the schedule.

张胖子人不错，应该要买买他的帐。
He's a good man, and we should accommodate him.

现在既抽不出工夫，就这样办，让张胖子那桌酒摆在船上，雪公，你看好不好？
Since there's no time, why not serve his banquet aboard the boat?”

““我，我还不大懂你的意思。”
“I don't quite understand.”


“我是说，我和张胖子随你一起上船，送你一程，
“Zhang and I can accompany you for part of the journey.

在船上吃了张胖子的饯行酒，我们第二天再回来。”
We'll have his farewell dinner aboard and return the next day.”

“这倒不错！
“That's a good idea!

雪岩，”王有龄笑道，“其实你也不要回来了，
In fact, Xueyan,” Wang smiled, “why return at all?

索性一路送到湖州，那又多好呢？”
Come all the way to Huzhou.”

“雪公，请你体谅我，
“Please understand my position.

我等把阜康的事弄舒齐了，马上赶了来。
Once Fukang is in order, I'll come at once.

来在你也还没有到任，湖州怎么个情形，两眼漆黑，
You haven't taken office yet; we know nothing of the situation in Huzhou.

我想帮忙也帮不上。
Even if I wished to help, I couldn't begin.

再说，海运局这面也是要紧的。”
Besides, the bureau's affairs matter too.”

“对了！”王有龄矍然问道，“你的部照什么时候可以拿下来？”
“That reminds me!” Wang asked sharply, “When will your certificate arrive?”

“大概快了。”
“Soon, I expect.”

“得要催一催杨用之，赶快办妥。
“Press Yang to finish it quickly.

我已经跟麟藩台说过了，
I've already spoken to Treasurer Lin.

等你部照下来，立刻委你为海运局的押运委员。
As soon as the certificate arrives, you'll be appointed a convoy commissioner at the bureau.

这样，你才好替我照料一切。”
Then you can manage everything for me.”

“这不好！”胡雪岩说，
“That isn't the best arrangement.

“名义上应该让周委员代理坐办。
Nominally, Zhou should act as executive director.

反正他凡事会跟我商量，误不了事。
He'll consult me on everything, so nothing will suffer.

占了他的面子，暗中生出许多意见，反为不妙。”
If I take his distinction, he'll develop private grievances and things may go badly.”

想想他的话不错，王有龄也同意了。
Wang saw the reason and agreed.

不过他又说：“不管怎么样，此事总以早办妥为宜。”
“In any case, the sooner the purchase is completed, the better.”


“是的。
“Yes.

也不尽是这一桩。
It concerns more than this one matter.

等把你送上了任，我这里另外有个场面，搬个家，略略摆些排场，从头做起。”
Once you've taken up your post, I'll establish myself properly too: move house, make a little display, and begin afresh.”

“这也好！”
“Excellent!”

王有龄笑道：
Wang smiled.

“到那时候，你是阜康钱庄的胡大老爷。”
“Then you'll be His Honour Hu of Fukang Bank.”

这话虽带着调侃的意味，其实是说中了胡雪岩的心意。
Though teasing, he had expressed Hu's intention exactly.

他现在对外不大作活动，就是要等官捐到了，钱庄开张了，场面摆出来了，
Hu was limiting his public activities until he had the qualification, the bank was open, and the necessary appearance established.

示人以簇新的面目，出现了不凡的声势，做起事来才有得心应手、左右逢源之乐。
Then he could present a wholly new face and make a striking entrance, enabling him to act freely and find support on every side.


* * *出了海运局到信和。
Leaving the bureau, Hu went to Xinhe.

张胖子正要出门，看见胡雪岩便即改变了原意，
Zhang had been about to go out, but changed his plans on seeing him.

他有许多话要跟他谈，却不容易找得着他，
He had much to discuss and rarely managed to find Hu.

难得见他自己上门，不肯轻易放过这个可以长谈的机会。
Now that Hu had come of his own accord, he would not lightly surrender the opportunity for a long talk.

“雪岩，你是越来越忙，越来越阔了，
“Xueyan, you're busier and richer every day.

要寻你说两句话，比见什么大官儿都难。”
Getting a word with you is harder than seeing a great official.”

“张先生！”胡雪岩听出他的口风不大对劲，赶紧辩白：“我是穷忙，
Hu heard the wrong note and quickly explained. “Mr Zhang, I'm merely run off my feet.

哪里敢摆架子？
How could I put on airs with you?

有事你叫‘学生子’到我家里通知一声，我敢不来？”
Send an apprentice to my house, and would I dare not come?”

“言重，言重！”
“You put it too strongly!”

张胖子知道自己的话说得过分了些，也忙着自我转圜，
Zhang knew he had gone too far and hastened to repair the impression.

“自己弟兄，
“We're brothers.

说句把笑话，你不能当真。”
A joke or two shouldn't be taken seriously.”

“哪里会当真？
“Naturally not.

不过，今天是无事不登三宝殿……”接着，他肥张胖子为王有龄饯行，希望改换一个方式的话一说，张胖子欣然表示同意。
But today I have come with a purpose...” Hu explained the proposed change to Wang's farewell dinner, and Zhang readily agreed.

“雪岩，”他又说，“听说你捐了个州县班子？”
“I hear you've purchased a magistrate's qualification?”

“是的。”
“Yes.”

胡雪岩不等他再问，把这件事的来龙去脉，源源本本告诉了他。
Before another question could follow, Hu gave the full history of the decision.

如果说张胖子对他还有些芥蒂，看他这样无话不谈的态度，心里也释然了，
If Zhang still felt any resentment, this openness dispelled it.

“雪岩”，他是真的觉得高兴，“将来你得发了。
“Xueyan,” he said with genuine pleasure, “you'll rise far.

说起来是我们信和出身，我也有面子。”
And since you began at Xinhe, I'll share the credit.”


胡雪岩笑笑不答，站起身说：
Hu smiled without answering, then rose.

“刚才看你要出门，
“You were about to go out.

我不耽搁你的工夫了，
I won't detain you.

改天再谈。”
We'll talk another day.”

“喔！”张胖子突然说道：
“Oh!” Zhang suddenly said.

“老张来过了！”
“Old Zhang came by.”

“哪个老张？”
“Which Old Zhang?”

“你看你！
“Look at you!

只记得他女儿，不记得她老子。”
You remember his daughter but not her father.”

“噢……”
“Ah...”

胡雪岩笑了，
Hu smiled.

“是阿珠的爹！”
“A'zhu's father.”

“对了，
“Exactly.

也不知道老张怎么打听到我这个地方？
I don't know how he found me.

他说他刚从上海回来，听说王大老爷放了湖州府，
He'd just returned from Shanghai and heard that His Honour was appointed to Huzhou.

上任要船，无论如何要挑挑他。
He insisted that his boat be chosen for the journey.

我说我不清楚这事，要问你。
I said I knew nothing of the arrangements and he must ask you.

我把你府上的地址告诉他了。”
I gave him your address.”

我也帮不得他的忙。
“I can't help him either.

人家新官上任，自有人替他办差。
A new official has people arranging his journey.

象这种小事情我也要插手，那不给人骂死？
If I interfere even in trifles like that, everyone will curse me.”

““我不管了。”张胖子笑道：
“That's no concern of mine.” Zhang laughed.

“反正老张会去看你，
“He'll come to see you.

只要你不怕阿珠‘骂死’，你尽管回他好了。”
If you're not afraid of A'zhu cursing you, refuse him.”

“要么这样。”
“How about this?”

胡雪岩灵机一动，
Hu had a sudden idea.

“我们不是要送雪公一程，第二天回来不也要船吧？
“We're accompanying Mr Xuexuan for a stage and returning the following day. We'll need a boat too.

那就用老张的船。”
We can use Old Zhang's.”

“对，对！
“Exactly.

这样子在阿珠面上也可以交代。”
That gives you a satisfactory answer for A'zhu.”


张胖子开口阿珠，闭口阿珠，倒勾起了胡雪岩的旧情。
Zhang's constant references to A'zhu revived Hu's feelings.

想想那轻颦浅笑，一会儿悲，一会儿喜的神态，着实有些回味。
Remembering her slight frowns and smiles, her changes from sorrow to happiness, he found much to dwell upon.

因而第二天上午特意不出门，在家里开阜康开张以后，预备要去兜揽的客户名单，借此等老张上门，好订他的船。
The following morning he deliberately remained at home, drawing up a list of prospective customers for Fukang while waiting for Old Zhang so he could hire the boat.

谁知老张没有来，他老婆来了，
But it was the wife who came.

新用的一个小丫头阿香来报，说有位“张太太”要见他。
A newly engaged maid, A'xiang, announced that “Mrs Zhang” wished to see him.

骤听之下，莫名其妙，随后才想到可能是阿珠的娘，
At first Hu was puzzled; then he thought of A'zhu's mother.

从玻璃窗望出去，果然！
Looking through the glass window, he confirmed it.

张太太就张太太吧！胡雪岩心想，
Mrs Zhang, then!

她也是好人家出身，再则看阿珠的分上，就抬抬她的身分，
She too came from a good family, and for A'zhu's sake he might raise her standing a little.

于是迎出来招呼一声：“张太太！”
He went out and greeted her accordingly.

“不敢当，不敢当，胡老爷！”
“You are too kind, Mr Hu.”

说着，她把手上提着的礼物，放在一旁，裣衽为礼，
She put down her gifts and curtsied.

“老早想来给胡太太请安，一直穷忙。
“I've long wanted to pay my respects to Mrs Hu, but we've been so busy making a living.

胡太太呢！”
Where is she?”

女眷应该情请后厅相会，
A female caller should ordinarily be received in the rear hall.

但胡雪岩顾虑他妻子还不明究竟，先要向她说清楚，
But his wife did not know the circumstances, and he wanted to explain first.

所以故意把话扯了开去，
He therefore diverted the conversation.

“在里头。”
“Inside.

他指着礼物又说，“何必还要带东西来？
Why bring presents?

太客气了！”
You are too generous.”

“自己做的粗东西，不中吃，
“Only some plain things I've made, probably not fit to eat.

不过一点心意。”
A small token.”

她一面说，一面把纸包和篾篓打了开来，顿时香味扑鼻，
She opened the paper packages and woven basket, releasing a rich aroma.

那是她的拿手菜，无锡肉骨头，再有就是薰青豆、方糕和粽子，那是湖州出名的小吃。
There were her celebrated Wuxi pork ribs, smoked green beans, square cakes, and zongzi—snacks for which Huzhou was famous.

“这倒要叨扰你，
“These I must accept.

都是外面买不到的。
One can't buy their like outside.

你等等！”他很高兴地说，“我去叫内人出来。”
Wait a moment; I'll call my wife.”

胡雪岩到了后厅，把这位“张太太”的真正身分，向妻子说明白，当然不会提到阿珠，
In the rear hall he explained the visitor's true identity, naturally omitting A'zhu.

只说她也是书香人家的小姐，又说这天的来意是兜生意。
He said only that she was a daughter of a scholarly family and had come to seek business.

但既然登门拜访，总是客人，要他妻子出去敷衍一下。
But since she had called, she was a guest, and his wife should receive her.


于是胡太太跟张太太见了礼。
The women exchanged greetings.

主人看客人觉得很对劲，客人看主人格外仔细，
Mrs Hu found the visitor congenial; the visitor inspected her hostess with particular care.

彼此紧蹬着，从头看到脚，让旁观的胡雪岩觉得很刺目。
Their intent scrutiny from head to foot made Hu uncomfortable.

女眷总有女眷的一套家常，一谈就把他搁在一边了。
Soon their household conversation left him aside.

胡雪岩没有多少工夫，只好硬打断她他的话，
With little time to spare, he had to interrupt.

“张太太！”他说，“他来晚了一步，
“Mrs Zhang, you're a little late.

王大老爷到湖州一上的船早就雇好了。”
His Honour's boat to Huzhou has already been hired.”

听他们谈到正事，胡太太不必再陪客，
Now that business was being discussed, Mrs Hu need no longer remain.

站起身，说两句“宽坐”、“在这里吃便饭“之类的客套话，退了进去。
She offered the customary invitations to stay comfortably and take a simple meal, then withdrew.

“胡老爷，你好福气！
“You're fortunate, Mr Hu.

胡太太贤惠，看来脾气也好。”
Your wife is virtuous and looks good-tempered.”

阿珠的娘又钉着问：
A'zhu's mother pressed the point.

“胡太太脾气很好，是不是？”
“She has a very good temper, doesn't she?”

不谈正事谈这些不相干的话，胡雪岩不免诧异，
Hu was surprised by this irrelevant concern.

“还好！”
“Quite good.”

他点点头说，
He nodded.

“张太太，你的船，短程去不去？”
“Would your boat take a short journey?”

“怎么不去？
“Of course.

到哪里？”
Where?”

“只到临平。”胡雪岩将何以有此一行的原因告诉了她。
“Only to Linping.” He explained the reason.

“那再好都没有了。
“Nothing could be better.

请胡老爷跟张老板说一说，他也不必费事备席，
Tell Mr Zhang he needn't trouble to prepare the banquet.

就用我们船上的莱好了。”阿珠的娘说，
Use our cooking.

“鱼翅海参，王大老爷一定也吃得腻了，
His Honour must be tired of shark's fin and sea cucumber.

看我想几个清淡别致的菜，
I'll devise a few light, unusual dishes.

包管贵客赞好，主人的开销也省。
The guests will be pleased, and the hosts will spend less.”

“替我们省倒不必，
“Don't worry about saving us money.

只要菜好就是了。”
Just make the food good.”

“是的。
“Yes.

我有数。”
I understand.”


正事已经谈妥，照道理阿珠的娘可以满意告辞，
The business was settled, and she should have been able to leave contentedly.

却是坐着不走，仿佛还有话不便开口似地。
Yet she remained, apparently unable to bring up something else.

胡雪岩看出因头，却不知道她要说的什么话？
Hu noticed but could not guess what she wanted.

于是便问：“可还有什么事？”问到她，自不能不说，
“Is there anything more?” Asked directly, she had to speak.

未说之前，先往屏风后面仔细张望了一下，是唯恐有人听见的样子。
First she carefully looked behind the screen, as though afraid of being overheard.

这一来，胡雪岩就越发要倾身凝神了。
Hu leaned forward with closer attention.

“胡老爷！”她略略放低了声音说，“我们的船就停在万安桥，
“Our boat is at Wan'an Bridge, Mr Hu.

请过去坐坐！”
Please come and visit.”

这一说，胡雪岩恍然大悟，
Now he understood.

老张来也好，她来也好，不是要兜揽生意，只是为了阿珠要他去见面。
Whether her husband came or she did, the purpose was not business: A'zhu wanted to see him.

去就去，正中心怀，不过现在还不能走，
He was willing enough, but could not go immediately.

一则要防他妻子生疑心，再则一上午未曾出门，下午有许多事不料理不行。
He must avoid arousing his wife's suspicion; besides, having stayed home all morning, he had many affairs to attend to that afternoon.

“好的！”他点点头，
“Certainly.

“我下半天来。”
I'll come later today.”

“下半天啥辰光？”
“At what time?”

“今朝事情多，
“There's much to do.

总要太阳落山才有工夫。”
Probably not until sunset.”

“那么等胡老爷来吃晚饭。”
“Then we'll wait for you to dine.”

她起身告辞，又低声叮嘱一句：“早点来！”
She rose to leave, adding quietly, “Come early.”


等她一走，胡雪岩坐在原处发楞。
After she had gone, Hu sat lost in thought.

想不到阿珠如此一往情深，念念不忘，
He had not expected A'zhu's attachment to be so persistent.

看来今天一去，又有许多牵惹。
Today's visit would evidently involve further complications.

转念到此，忽生悔意，
He suddenly regretted it.

自己的前程刚刚跨开步子，正要加紧着力，
His career had only just begun to advance and needed all his effort.

哪来多余的工夫去应付这段情？
Where would he find spare time for this relationship?

悔也无益！
Regret was useless.

已经答应人家，决不能失信。
He had promised and could not break his word.

于是他又想，既然非去不可，就要搞得皆大欢喜。
Since he must go, he ought to make everyone happy.

回到自己“书房”里，打开柜子，里面还存着些上海带回来，预备王有龄送官场中人的“洋货”。
In his “study” he opened a cupboard containing foreign goods brought from Shanghai as gifts for Wang's official acquaintances.

翻了翻，巧得很，有几样带了要送黄抚台小组的“闺阁清玩”，
By coincidence, he found several elegant articles intended for Governor Huang's daughter.

回到杭州才听说黄小姐感染时气，香消玉殒了，
On returning to Hangzhou, they had learned that she had died of an epidemic illness.

要送的东西没处送，留在胡雪岩这里，
The gifts, no longer needed, had remained with Hu.

正好转赠阿珠。
They could now be given to A'zhu.


于是他把那些玩意寻块布包袱好，吃过午饭带出去，先到海运局，后到阜康新址，
He wrapped the articles in a cloth bundle and took them out after lunch, visiting the bureau first and Fukang's new premises afterwards.

只觉得油漆气味极浓，
The smell of paint was strong.

从外到里看了一遍，布置得井井有条。
From front to back, everything was orderly.

后进接待客户的那座厅，也收拾得富丽堂皇，很够气派，
The rear reception hall had been made splendid enough to impress customers.

但是，看来看去，总觉得有些美中不足。
Yet something still seemed lacking.

“庆生！”他说，“好象少了样把什么东西？”
“Qingsheng, aren't we missing something?”

“字画。”
“Paintings and calligraphy.”

“对，对，对！字画，字画！”
“Exactly!”

胡雪岩很郑重他说，
Hu was serious.

“字画这样东西，最见身分，
“Those reveal one's standing more than anything.

弄得不好，就显原形！
Get them wrong, and they expose you.

你不要弄些‘西贝货，来，叫行家笑话。”
Don't bring in fakes for connoisseurs to laugh at.”

“假货是不会的，不过名气小一点。”
“They won't be false, but the names may be less celebrated.”

“名气小也不行，
“Lesser names won't do either.

配不上‘阜康’这块招牌。
They don't match Fukang's signboard.

你倒说说看，是哪些人的字画？”
Tell me whose work you've found.”

于是刘庆生把他所觅来的字画，说了给胡雪岩听。
Liu listed the pieces.

他亦不见得内行，但书家画师名气的大小是知道的，
Hu was no expert, but knew the relative reputations.

觉得其中只有一幅杭州本地人，在籍正奉旨办团练习的戴侍郎戴熙的山水，和王梦楼的四条字，配得上阜康的招牌。
He thought only a landscape by Vice Minister Dai Xi—a Hangzhou native now organising militia at home under imperial orders—and a set of four calligraphic panels by Wang Menglou worthy of Fukang.

不过他也知道，要觅好字画，要钱或许还要面子，
Yet fine works required money and perhaps influence.

刘庆生不能把开钱庄当作开古玩铺，专门在这上面用工夫，
Liu could not devote himself to the task as though opening an antiques shop rather than a bank.

所以他反用嘉慰的语气，连声说道：
Hu therefore changed to a reassuring, appreciative tone.

“好，好！
“Good.

也差不多了。
We're nearly there.

我那里还有点路子，再去觅几样来。
I have some other connections and will find a few more things.

你事情太多，
You have too much to do.

这个客厅的陈设我来帮你的忙。”
I'll help with the reception room.”

刘庆生当然也懂得他的意思，不过他的话听来很入耳，所以并无不快之感，只说：
Liu understood, but the pleasant wording prevented resentment.

“好的！
“Very well.

客厅的陈设，我听胡先生的招呼就是了。”
I'll follow your instructions on the furnishings.”


话谈得差不多了，看看时候也差不多了，
The discussion and the day were both sufficiently advanced.

胡雪岩离了阜康，径到万安桥来赴约。
Hu left Fukang and went directly to Wan'an Bridge.

这座桥在东城，与运河起点，北新关的拱宸桥一样，高大无比，是城内第一个水路码头。
In the eastern city, it was as imposing as Gongchen Bridge at the canal's beginning near the Beixin customs station, and formed the city's principal water landing.

胡雪岩进桥弄下了轿，
Hu left his chair in the bridge lane.

只见人烟稠密，桅杆如林，
People crowded everywhere and masts rose like a forest.

一眼望去，不知哪条是张家的船？
He could not tell which boat belonged to the Zhangs.

踌躇了一会，缓步踏上石级，预备登高到桥顶去了望。
After hesitating, he slowly climbed the stone steps, intending to look out from the top.

刚走到一半，听见有人在后面高声喊道：“胡老爷，胡老爷！”
Halfway up, someone called loudly behind him, “Mr Hu!”

回身一看，是老张气喘吁吁赶了上来。
He turned to see Old Zhang hurrying up, breathless.

“你的船呢？”胡雪岩问。
“Where's your boat?”

“船不在这里。”老张答道，
“Not here.

“阿珠说这里太闹，叫伙计把船撑到城河里去了。
A'zhu thought it too noisy and told the crew to move it into the city canal.

叫我在码头上等胡老爷！”
She told me to wait for you at the landing.”



胡雪岩
《平步青云（上）》第七章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume I — Chapter Seven, first part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第七章｜CHAPTER SEVEN


这是胡雪岩第一次听见老张谈到他女儿，
This was the first time Hu had heard Old Zhang speak of his daughter.

“叫”这个如何，“叫”那个如何，口气倒象是佣人听小姐的吩咐，
She had “told” one person to do this and another to do that; his tone suggested a servant carrying out his young mistress's instructions.

不免有些诧异，但也明了阿珠在他家，真正是颗掌上明珠，
Hu was a little surprised, but he also understood that A’zhu truly was the cherished jewel of the household.

她父母是无话不听的。
Her parents did whatever she asked.

“胡老爷，”老张又说，“我备了只小划子，划了你去。
“Mr Hu,” Old Zhang continued, “I've brought a little skiff to row you over.

这里也实在太闹了，
It's much too noisy here.

连我都厌烦，
Even I find it tiresome.

城河里清静得多。”
The moat is far quieter.”

于是下桥上船，
They went down from the bridge and boarded the skiff.

向南穿过万安桥，折而往东，出了水关，就是极宽的护城河，
Heading south beneath Wan'an Bridge, they turned east and passed through the water gate into the broad moat.

一面城墙，一面菜畦，
On one side stood the city wall; on the other lay vegetable plots.

空阔无人。
The space was open and deserted.

端午将近的黄梅天，蒸闷不堪，
The Dragon Boat Festival was approaching, and the plum rains brought oppressive, steaming heat.

所以一到这地方，胡雪岩顿觉精神一爽，
As soon as they reached this place, Hu felt refreshed.

脱口赞了句：“阿珠倒真会挑地方！”
“A’zhu certainly knows how to choose a spot!” he exclaimed.

“喏！”老张指着胡雪岩身后说：
“There!” Old Zhang pointed behind him.

“我们的船停在那里。”
“That's where our boat is.”

船泊在一株柳树下面。那株杨柳极大，而且斜出临水，茂密的柳绿，覆盖了大半条船，
It lay beneath an enormous willow leaning over the water, its dense green foliage sheltering more than half the vessel.

不仔细看，还真不大容易发现。
Without looking carefully, one might easily have missed it.

胡雪岩未到那条船上，已觉心旷神怡，
Even before reaching the boat, Hu felt his heart lift.

把一脑子的海运局、钱庄之类的念头，忘了个干净。
Every thought of the Sea Transport Bureau and the bank vanished.

倒转身来，一直望着柳下的船。
He turned round and kept his eyes on the boat beneath the willow.


那条船上有也有在望，自然是阿珠。
Someone aboard was looking out too—A’zhu, naturally.

越行越近，看得越清楚，
As they approached, he could see her more clearly.

她穿一件浆洗得极挺拓的月白竹布衫，外面套一件玄色软缎的背心，
She wore a pale blue cotton blouse, washed and starched until it was crisp, with a waistcoat of soft black satin.

一根漆黑的长辫子，仍然是她改不掉的习惯，把辫梢捞地手里捻弄着。
As always, she held the end of her long black braid and twisted it between her fingers, a habit she could never break.

小船划近，船上的伙计帮忙把他扶上大船，
When the skiff drew alongside, the boat hand helped him aboard the larger vessel.

只见阿珠回和身向后梢喊道：“娘，好难请的贵客请到了！”
A’zhu turned towards the stern and called, “Mother, our distinguished guest has arrived at last! Such trouble to persuade him!”

阿珠的娘在后悄上做菜，分不开身来招呼，
Her mother was cooking at the stern and could not leave the stove to greet him.

只高声带笑地说：“阿珠，你说话要摸摸良心，
She merely called back with a laugh, “A’zhu, have a conscience!

胡老爷一请就到，
Mr Hu came the moment we asked him.

还说‘好难请’！”
How can you say he was hard to persuade?”

“也不知道哪个没有良心？”阿珠斜脱着胡雪岩，
“I wonder who has no conscience?” A’zhu glanced sideways at Hu.

“人家的船是长途，
“Other people's boats get the long journeys.

我们的船就该是短程。”
Ours is only good for short ones.”

阿珠的娘深怕她女儿得罪了“贵客”，随即用呵斥的声音说道：“说话没轻没重，
Afraid that her daughter would offend their distinguished guest, her mother immediately scolded her. “You don't know when to stop!

越说越不好了。”
Every word makes it worse.”

接着，放下锅铲，探身出来，一面在围裙上擦着双手，一面向胡雪岩含笑招呼：“胡老爷，你怎么这时候才来？
Then she put down her spatula and leaned out, wiping her hands on her apron as she smiled at Hu. “Mr Hu, what kept you so long?

阿珠一遍一遍在船头上望……”
A’zhu has been going to the bow to look for you over and over...”


这句话羞着了阿珠，
This embarrassed A’zhu.

原是白里泛红的一张脸，越发烧得如满天晚霞，
Her fair cheeks, already tinged with pink, flamed like a sunset sky.

抢着打断她的话说：“哪个一遍一遍在船头上望？
She hastily interrupted. “Who's been going to the bow over and over?

瞎说八道！”
What nonsense!”

说一完，只见长辫子一甩，扭身沿着船舷，往后舱就走。
With a flick of her long braid, she turned and walked along the gunwale towards the rear cabin.

水上女儿走惯了的，
A girl brought up on the water was accustomed to this.

看似风摆杨柳般摇摇欲坠，其实安然无事，
She seemed to sway as precariously as a willow in the wind, but was perfectly safe.

但胡雪岩大为担心，慌忙喊道“阿珠，
Hu, however, was alarmed. “A’zhu!

阿珠，
A’zhu!

你当心！
Be careful!

不要掉到河里！”
Don't fall into the river!”

阿珠没有理他，不过听他那发急乱叫的声音，心里觉得很舒服，
She ignored him, though his anxious cries pleased her.

不由得就把脚步放慢了，一步一步很规矩地走着。
Almost without realising it, she slowed down and began taking careful, orderly steps.

“胡老爷，你看！”阿珠的娘仿佛万般无奈地，
“Just look at her, Mr Hu!” her mother said with an air of complete helplessness.

“疯疯癫癫，
“Wild as a mad girl.

拿她真没法子。”
There's nothing I can do with her.”

“你也少罗嗦了！”老张这样埋怨他老婆，
“That's enough of your nagging too!” Old Zhang told his wife.

转脸又说，“胡老爷，你请舱里坐。”
Then he turned to Hu. “Please come and sit in the cabin.”


进舱就发现，这条船油漆一新，收拾得比以前更加整齐，
Inside, Hu immediately noticed fresh paint and an even tidier appearance than before.

便点点头说：“船修理过了？”
He nodded. “You've had the boat repaired?”

“老早就要修了，
“It needed doing long ago.

一直凑不出一笔整数，
We could never put together enough money.

多亏胡老爷上次照顾。”
We have your custom last time to thank.”

“以后机会还有。”胡雪岩说，
“There will be more opportunities,” Hu said.

“王大老爷放了湖州府，在杭州还有差使，
“Mr Wang has been appointed to Huzhou, but he still has duties in Hangzhou.

常来常往，
He'll often travel between the two.

总有用得着你船的时候。”
There are bound to be occasions when your boat is needed.”

“那要请胡老爷替我们留意。”
“Then we must ask you to keep us in mind.”

“本来，这种事不该我管。
“Ordinarily, arranging that sort of thing isn't my business.

不过，你的船另当别论，
But your boat is a special case.

我来想个办法。”
I'll think of something.”

胡雪岩沉吟着，想把老张的这条无锡快，当作海运局或者湖州府长期租用的“官船”，让他按月有一笔固定的收入。
He considered having the Sea Transport Bureau or the Huzhou prefecture hire Old Zhang's fast Wuxi boat on a long-term basis for official use, giving him a fixed monthly income.

沉吟未定，阿珠又出现了，打来一盆脸水。
Before he had decided, A’zhu reappeared with a basin of water.

这下提醒了老张，
This reminded Old Zhang of his duties as host.

站起身说：“胡老爷先宽宽衣，洗洗脸，吃碗菜。
He stood. “First make yourself comfortable, Mr Hu, wash your face, and have some tea.

哪天到临平，要吃些什么菜？
What dishes would you like for the journey to Linping?

等下叫阿珠的娘来跟胡老爷商量。”
I'll have A’zhu's mother come and discuss them with you presently.”


等老张一走，胡雪岩就轻松了，
Once Old Zhang had gone, Hu relaxed.

起身笑道，“阿珠，你的脾气必厉害！”
Rising with a smile, he said, “A’zhu, what a temper you have!”

“还要说人家！
“And you still criticise me!

你自己不想想，
Think of yourself.

一上了岸，把人家抛到九霄云外。
The moment you go ashore, you forget all about us.

平常不来还不要去说它，
Never mind that you don't ordinarily visit.

王大老爷到湖州上任，明明现成有船，他故意不用。
When Mr Wang goes to take up his appointment in Huzhou, there's a boat ready for him here, yet he deliberately won't use it.

你说说看，有没有这个道理？”
Tell me, is that reasonable?”

她一面说一面替胡雪岩解钮扣卸去马褂、长衫，依偎在身边，
As she spoke, she stood close beside Hu and helped unbutton and remove his outer jacket and long robe.

又是那种无限幽怨的声音，胡雪岩自然是“别有一般滋味在心头。”
Her voice was full of grievance, stirring feelings in him that he could scarcely name.

等她低头去解他腋下的那颗钮扣上，他不由得就伸头去摸她的如退光黑漆般的头发，
When she lowered her head to undo a fastening beneath his arm, he reached out to touch her hair, black and glossy as polished lacquer.

阿珠把头再往下低，避开了他的手，同时抗议：“不要动手动脚，
She ducked away from his hand and protested, “Keep your hands to yourself!

把我头发都弄毛了！”
You'll mess up my hair!”


“你的头发是自己梳的？”
“Do you comb it yourself?”

“自然罗！
“Naturally!

我自己梳，我娘替我打辫子。
I comb it, and Mother plaits it.

我们这种人，难道还有丫头、老妈子来伺候的福气？”
Do you suppose people like us are fortunate enough to have maids and serving women to wait on us?”

“也不见得没有。”胡雪岩说，
“You might be,” Hu said.

“丫头、老妈子又何足为奇？”
“There's nothing so extraordinary about having servants.”

这话一说完，阿珠立刻抬起眼来，双目流转，在他的脸上绕了一下，马上又低下头去，
At once she raised her eyes and searched his face, then looked down again.

捞起他的长衫下摆，解掉最后一个扣子，卸去外衣，然后绞一把手巾送到他手里。
Gathering the skirt of his robe, she undid the last fastening, removed the outer garment, and wrung out a towel for him.

他发现她眼中有期待的神色，
He saw expectation in her eyes.

不用说，那是希望他对她刚才所说的那句话，有个进一步的解释。
Clearly she hoped he would explain what he had just said.

但是他已悔出言轻率，便装做不解，很快地扯到别的事。
But he already regretted his rash words, so he pretended not to understand and quickly turned to something else.


这件事，足以让阿珠立刻忘掉他刚才的那句话，
The new subject was enough to make A’zhu forget his remark immediately.

他解开他带来的那个包袱，
He unwrapped the bundle he had brought.

里面是一个小小的箱子，仿照保险箱的做法。用铁皮所装，漆成墨绿色，也装有暗锁。
Inside was a small chest made in imitation of a safe, clad in sheet iron, painted dark green, and fitted with a concealed lock.

“这是什么箱子？”
“What sort of chest is that?”

“ ‘杜十娘怒沉百宝箱’的百宝箱。”
“A treasure chest, like the one in the story of Du Shiniang, who sank her treasure chest in anger.”

他把暗锁打开，
He opened the lock.

相内却只有“四宝”，一瓶香水，一个八音盒，一把日本女人插在头上当装饰的象牙细篦，一只景泰蓝嵌珠的女表。
This chest, however, contained only four treasures: a bottle of perfume, a musical box, a fine ivory comb of the kind Japanese women wore as an ornament, and a lady's watch in pearl-set cloisonné enamel.


阿珠惊多于喜，
A’zhu was more astonished than delighted.

看看这样，摸摸那样，好半天说不出话。
She looked at one thing and touched another, unable to speak for a long while.

胡雪岩先把牙篦插在她头发上，
Hu first placed the ivory comb in her hair.

接着把那只表用钥匙上足了弦，以自己的金表校准了时刻，替阿珠挂在钮扣上，
Then he wound the watch with its key, set it by his own gold watch, and hung it from one of her buttons.

再把八音盒子开足了发条，让它叮叮当当响着，
Next he wound the musical box and let its tinkling notes ring out.

最后拿起那瓶香水，
Finally he picked up the perfume.

阿珠忽然失声喊道：“不要，不要！”
A’zhu suddenly cried, “No, no!”

胡雪岩愕然：“不要什么？”
He looked surprised. “No what?”

“傻瓜！”阿珠嫣然一笑，
“Silly!” She smiled.

“不要打开来！”
“Don't open it!”

这时老张和那船伙计，为从未听过的叮叮当当的声音所招引，都在船舱外探望，要弄明白是什么东西在响？
Drawn by the unfamiliar chiming, Old Zhang and the boat hand peered into the cabin, trying to discover what was making the sound.

阿珠却不容他们看个究竟，
A’zhu gave them no chance to inspect it.

一手八音盒，一手香水，头插牙蓖，衣襟上晃荡着那只表，急忙忙走向后梢，到她娘那里“献宝”去了。
With the musical box in one hand and the perfume in the other, the ivory comb in her hair and the watch swinging from her clothes, she hurried to the stern to show her mother her treasures.


于是只听得她们母女俩赞叹说笑的声音，
Hu heard mother and daughter exclaiming, laughing, and talking.

最后是做娘的在告诫：“好好去放好。
At last the mother cautioned her: “Put them away safely.

有人的地方少拿出来，
Don't keep bringing them out when other people are about.

胡家的阿毛手脚不干净，
A'mao, the Hu girl, has light fingers.

当心她顺手牵羊。
Mind she doesn't help herself.”

““怕什么！
“What is there to fear?

我锁在‘百宝箱’里！”
I'll lock them in my treasure chest!”

“什么‘百宝箱’？”
“What treasure chest?”

“喏，”大概是阿珠在比划，
“Look,” A’zhu said, presumably indicating its size with her hands.

“这么长，这么宽，是铁的，还有暗锁，
“It's this long and this wide, made of iron, with a hidden lock.

怎么开法只有我一个人晓得，
I'm the only one who knows how to open it.

偷不走的。”
No one can steal them.”

原来是首饰箱！“阿珠的娘说：”
“Oh, a jewellery box!” her mother said.

傻丫头，人家不会连箱子一起偷？
“Silly girl, couldn't someone steal the box as well?”

““啊！”阿珠醒悟了。
“Ah!” That had not occurred to A’zhu.

接着便又重新出现在中舱，高兴之外，似乎还有些忧虑的神色。
She soon reappeared in the middle cabin, still delighted, but now looking a little anxious too.


为了知道她的忧虑想安慰她，胡雪岩招把手说：“阿珠，你过来，
Understanding her anxiety and wanting to reassure her, Hu beckoned. “A’zhu, come here.

我有话说。”
I have something to tell you.”

“你说好了！”她这样回答，
“Go ahead!” she answered.

一面打开那只百宝箱，除了头上的那把蓖以外，其余“三宝”都收入箱内。
Opening the chest, she put away the three treasures, leaving only the comb in her hair.

却把个开了盖的箱子捧在手里，凝视不休。
Yet she continued to hold the open box and gaze into it.

“你到底想不想听我的话。”
“Do you want to listen to me or not?”

“好，好！
“Yes, yes!

我听。”阿珠急忙答应，
I'm listening.”

锁好箱子，走到胡雪岩对面坐下，右手支颐，偏着头等他开口。
She hurriedly locked it and sat opposite him, her chin supported by her right hand and her head tilted as she waited for him to speak.

这又是一个极动人的姿态，胡雪岩也偏着头紧盯着她看。
He found the pose so appealing that he too tilted his head and gazed at her.

阿珠大概心里还在百宝箱里，以致视而不见。
A’zhu's thoughts were apparently still in the treasure chest: she looked at him without seeing him.


她不作声，他也不开口，
She said nothing, and neither did he.

好久，她方省悟，张皇而抱歉地问道：“你，你刚才说什么？”
Eventually she came to herself and asked in apologetic confusion, “What—what were you saying?”

“咦！”胡雪岩故意装作十分诧异地，
“Why!” Hu pretended to be astonished.

“我说了半天，你一句都没有听进去？”
“I've been talking all this time, and you haven't heard a word?”

阿珠为他一诈，歉意越发浓了，
Taken in, she became even more apologetic.

陪着笑说：“对不起！
“I'm sorry,” she said with a conciliatory smile.

我想起一桩要紧事情。”
“I suddenly remembered something important.”

“什么要紧事？”
“What was it?”

原是托词，
It had merely been an excuse.

让他钉紧了一问。得要想几句话来圆自己的谎，
Now that he pressed her, she had to find something to make her story convincing.

偏偏脑筋越紧越笨，越笨越急，
The more she strained to think, the less she could manage; the less she could manage, the more anxious she grew.

涨红了脸，好半天说不出一句话来。
Her face reddened, and for a long time she could not produce a word.

“好了，好了！”胡雪岩大为不忍，
“Never mind, never mind!” Hu could not bear to torment her.

“不便说就不说。”
“If it's private, don't tell me.”

“是啊，这桩事情不便说。”阿珠如释重负似地笑道：
“Yes, it's something private.” Relieved, she smiled.

“现在，你有什么话，请你尽管话，
“Now say whatever you wanted to say.

我一定留心听。”
I'll listen carefully.”


“我劝你，不要把你娘的话太当真！”他放低了声音说，
“My advice is not to take your mother's warning too seriously,” he said, lowering his voice.

“身外之物要看得开些……”他讲了一套“身外之物”的道理，
“Don't let possessions weigh on your mind...” He explained his view of material things.

人以役物，不可为物所役，
People should make use of possessions, not become their servants.

心受之物固然要当心被窃，
Naturally one should guard a treasured object against theft.

但为了怕被窃，不敢拿出来用，甚至时进忧虑，处处分心，这就是为物所役，
But if fear of losing it prevented one from using it, or caused constant anxiety and distraction, one had become its servant.

倒不如无此一物。
Better not to own it at all.

“所以，”他说，“你的脑筋一定要转过来。
“So,” he concluded, “you must change the way you think.

丢掉就丢掉，
If something is lost, it's lost.

没有什么了不得！
It isn't the end of the world!

不然，我送你这几样东西，倒变成害了你了。”
Otherwise my presents will have done you harm instead of good.”

他把这番道理说得很透彻，无奈阿珠大不以为然，
He had made his reasoning perfectly clear, but A’zhu strongly disagreed.

“你倒说得大方，
“How generous you sound!

‘丢掉就丢掉’！
‘If it's lost, it's lost!’

你不心疼我心疼。”
You may not mind, but I do.”

她忽有怨怼，
Suddenly her tone grew resentful.

“你这个人就是这样，
“That's just like you.

说丢掉就丢掉，
You can throw something away without a second thought.

一点情分都没有。对人对东西都一样！”
You have no feeling at all—for people or possessions!”

“你说‘对人对东西部一样’，
“You say ‘people or possessions.’

这个‘人’是哪个？”
Which person do you mean?”

“你还问得出口？”阿珠冷笑，
“You can actually ask?” She gave a bitter little laugh.

“可见得你心里早没有那个‘人’了！”
“That proves you've long since forgotten that person!”


“亏你怎么想出来了？”胡雪岩有些懊恼，
“How did you manage to think of that?” Hu was a little exasperated.

“我们在讲那几样东西，
“We were talking about those presents.

你无缘无故会扯到人上面？
Why suddenly drag people into it?

我劝你不必太看重身外之物，正是为了看重你，
I tell you not to care too much about possessions precisely because I care about you.

你连这点道理都想不明白？
Can't you understand even that?

再说，我那么忙，你娘来一叫我就来，
Besides, busy as I am, I came the moment your mother invited me.

还要怎么样呢？
What more do you want?

至于王大老爷上任要雇船，你也得替我想想，
As for hiring a boat for Mr Wang's departure, put yourself in my position.

照我在王大老爷面前的身分，好不好去管这种小事情？
Given my standing with him, would it be proper for me to interfere in such a small matter?”

““我晓得，
“I know.

都归庶务老爷管，
The general affairs officer arranges all that.

不过你提一声也不要紧啊！”
But what harm would there be in mentioning it?”

“这不就是插手去管吗？
“Wouldn't that be interfering?

你总晓得，这都有回扣的，
Surely you know there are commissions on these things.

我一管，庶务就不敢拿回扣了。
Once I intervened, the officer wouldn't dare take his commission.

别人不知道用你家的船，另有道理，
Other people wouldn't know I had a different reason for choosing your boat.

只说我想要回扣。
They'd say I wanted the commission myself.

我怎么能背这种名声？”
How could I let people think that of me?”

阿珠听了这一番话，很快地看了他一眼，把眼皮垂下去，
A’zhu gave him a quick glance, then lowered her eyes.

长长的睫毛闪动着，好久不作声。
Her long lashes fluttered, and she remained silent for some time.


那是石火电光般的一瞥，但包含着自悔、致歉、佩服、感激，以及求取谅解的许多意思在内，
The glance was brief as a flash of lightning, yet it contained regret, apology, admiration, gratitude, and a plea for understanding.

好象在说：你不说明白，我哪里知道？
It seemed to say: How could I know unless you explained?

多因为我的见识不如你，
I don't know as much as you do.

想不到其中有这么多道理。
I never imagined there were so many things to consider.

我只当你有意不用我家的船，是特意要避开我，其实你是爱莫能助。
I thought you deliberately refused our boat because you wanted to avoid me, when really you wanted to help but couldn't.

一请就来，你也不是有意避我。
You came as soon as we asked, so you weren't avoiding me either.

看来是我错怪了人！
It seems I misjudged you!

也难为你，一直逼到最后你才说破！
And you had to be pushed to the very last before you would explain.

我不对，你也不对，
I was wrong, but so were you.

你应该晓得我心里着急，
You should have known how anxious I was.

何不一来先就解释这件事？
Why didn't you explain when you first arrived?

倘或你早说明白，我怎么说那许多叫人刺心的话，
If you'd told me sooner, would I have said all those hurtful things?

也许你倒不在乎，但是你可知道我说这些话心里是如何懊悔？
Perhaps you don't mind, but do you know how bitterly I regret saying them?


女儿家的曲曲心事，胡雪岩再机警也难猜透，
However quick-witted Hu might be, he could scarcely unravel all the twists of a young woman's heart.

不过她有愧歉之意，却是看得出来的。
He could see, though, that she felt sorry.

他的性情是最不愿意做煞风景的事，所以自己先就一下撇开，摇着手说：“好了；好了，
He hated spoiling a pleasant occasion, so he dismissed the whole matter with a wave. “There, there.

话说过就算数了，
We've said our piece.

不要去东想西想。
Don't go worrying about it.

喂，我问你。”
Now, tell me something.”

最后一句声音大了些，仿佛突如其来似地，阿珠微吃一惊，抬起头来睁大了双眼看着他。
His last words were a little louder and seemed so sudden that A’zhu started and looked up with wide eyes.

“你娘今天弄了些什么菜给我吃？”
“What has your mother cooked for me today?”

“我还不晓得。”
“I don't know yet.”

“咦！”胡雪岩说，
“Really?

“这就怪了，
That's odd.

你怎么会不晓得。
How can you not know?

莫非……”
Unless...”

他本来想取笑她，说是“莫非一遍一遍在船头上望？”
He had been about to tease her: unless she had spent all her time at the bow, looking out for him.

话到口旁，警觉到这个玩笑开不得，所以缩住了口。
Just as the words reached his lips, he realised that this joke would be unwise and stopped.

话是没有说出口，脸上那诡秘的笑容却依然在。
Though he had said nothing, his mischievous smile remained.

阿珠也是极精灵的人，
A’zhu was sharp too.

顿时就逼着问：“莫非什么？”
“Unless what?” she demanded at once.

“莫非，”胡雪岩随口答道：“你在生我的气，所以懒得去问？”
“Unless,” he improvised, “you were angry with me and couldn't be bothered to ask.”

“你说这话没有良心！”她说，
“You have no conscience, saying that!”

但也并不见得生气，
Yet she did not seem angry.

却转身走了出去。
She simply turned and went out.


很快地，她又走了回来，手里多了一个托盘，里面一只盖碗，
She soon returned with a tray bearing a covered bowl.

揭开碗盖来看，是冰糖煮的新鲜莲子、湖菱和芡实，正是最时新、最珍贵的点心。
When she lifted the lid, he saw fresh lotus seeds, lake-grown water caltrops, and gorgon seeds simmered in rock sugar: the choicest and most prized delicacies of the season.

另外有两只小碟子，一黄一红，黄的是桂花酱，红的是玫瑰卤，不但香味浓郁，而且鲜艳夺目。
Two small dishes accompanied them, one yellow with osmanthus preserve, the other red with rose syrup, vividly coloured as well as richly fragrant.

“一天就替你弄这一碗点心，
“I've spent all day preparing this one bowl for you.

你还说我懒得管你，
Yet you say I can't be bothered with you!

是不是没有良心？”
Isn't that heartless?”

胡雪岩看碗中的莲子等物，剥得极其干净，粒粒完整，
Hu saw how carefully everything had been peeled, each seed perfectly whole.

这才知道她花的功夫惊人，心里倒觉得老大不过意。
Only then did he realise the astonishing amount of work she had put in, and he felt deeply apologetic.

“吃啊！”阿珠说，
“Eat!” she said.

“两样卤子随你自己调，
“Add whichever flavouring you like.

我看玫瑰卤子好。”
I think the rose syrup is better.”

“我实在舍不得吃，
“I can hardly bear to eat it.

留着闻闻看看。”
I'd like to keep it here to look at and smell.”

“咄！”阿珠笑了，
“Oh!” A’zhu laughed.

“跟伢儿一样。”
“You're just like a child.”

说着用小银匙挑了一匙玫瑰卤调在碗里，然后往他面前一推，
With a little silver spoon, she stirred a spoonful of rose syrup into the bowl and pushed it towards him.

“冷了不好吃了。”
“It won't taste as good when it's cold.”


“你自己呢？”
“What about yours?”

“我啊！
“Mine?

找自己才懒得弄呢。
I couldn't be bothered to make it for myself.

倒是我爹叨你的光，
But Father has benefited from your visit.

难得吃这么一碗细巧点心。”
He rarely gets such a delicate treat.”

“真正是细巧点心！
“A delicate treat indeed!

皇帝在宫里，也不过如此。
The emperor in his palace could have nothing finer.

对不！”胡雪岩又说，
No, wait,” Hu added.

“宫里虽然四时八节，有各地进贡的时鲜货，
“Throughout the year, at every festival, the palace receives seasonal delicacies as tribute from everywhere.

到底路远迢迢，
But they have so far to travel.

哪里一上市就有得吃？”
How could he enjoy them the moment they first appear?”

阿珠听了他的话，十分高兴，
A’zhu was delighted.

“这样说起来，你的福气比皇帝还要好？”
“Then are you saying you're luckier than the emperor?”

她拿手指刮着脸羞他：“说大话不要本钱，
She drew a finger down her cheek to shame him. “Boasting costs nothing!

世界上再没有比你脸皮厚的人！”说完，自己倒又笑了，接着扭身往后，到后梢去帮忙开饭。
No one in the world has a thicker skin than you.” Then she laughed herself, turned, and went to the stern to help serve the meal.


胡雪岩倒不是说大活，
Hu was not merely boasting.

真的自觉有南面王不易之乐，
He truly felt a happiness he would not exchange for an emperor's throne.

一人坐在爽气扑人的船窗边，吃着那碗点心，眼望着平畴绿野，心境是说不出的那种开阔轻松。
Sitting alone beside the cabin window, with fresh air flowing in, he ate his sweet dish and looked across the level fields and green countryside, his mind light and spacious beyond description.

当然，阿珠仿佛仍旧在他眼前，
A’zhu, of course, still seemed to be before his eyes.

只要想到便看得见，听得到，一颦一笑，无不可人。
Whenever he thought of her, he could see her and hear her; every frown and smile pleased him.

他开始认真考虑他与她之间的将来了。
He began seriously to consider their future together.


想不多久，思路便被打断，
Before long, his thoughts were interrupted.

阿珠来开饭了，抹桌子，摆碗筷，一面告诉他说：“四菜一汤，两个碟子，
A’zhu came to lay the meal, wiping the table and setting out bowls and chopsticks. “Four dishes and a soup, with two little plates as well.

够你吃的了。
That should be enough for you.

今天有黄花鱼，有莼菜。”
We've yellow croaker today, and water shield.”

话没有说完，阿珠的娘已端了菜来，密炙文火，新鲜荷叶粉蒸肉，卤备瓜蒸黄花鱼，炸响铃，
Before she had finished, her mother arrived with the food: a roast cooked over gentle heat, pork coated in rice meal and steamed in fresh lotus leaves, yellow croaker steamed with pickled melon, and crisp bean-curd rolls.

另外两个下酒的冷碟，虾米拌黄瓜，卤什件。
There were also two cold dishes to go with the wine, cucumber with dried shrimps and assorted braised meats.

然后自己替胡雪岩斟了杯“竹叶青”，嘴里说着客气话。
Her mother poured Hu a cup of Zhuyeqing wine, accompanying it with courteous words.

“多谢，多谢！”
“Thank you, thank you!”

胡雪岩指着桌面说：“这么许多菜，我无论如何吃不下。
He gestured at the table. “I couldn't possibly eat all this.

大家一起来！”
Everyone come and join me!”

“从没有这个规矩！”
“That would be quite against the rules!”

阿珠的娘也知道他的弦外之意，所以接着又自己把话拉回来，
But A’zhu's mother understood his unspoken meaning, and immediately softened her refusal.

“不过一个人吃闷酒也无趣，
“Still, drinking alone is no pleasure.

让阿珠敬胡老爷一杯。”
Let A’zhu offer you a cup.”

阿珠是巴不得她娘有这一句，
This was precisely what A’zhu had hoped to hear.

立刻掉转身子，去拿了一小酒杯，同时把她的那双银筷子也捏了在手里。
She turned at once to fetch a small wine cup, bringing her silver chopsticks too.


“胡老爷，到底哪天要用船？”
“Mr Hu, exactly when will you need the boat?”

“五月切七一早动身。”他说，
“We leave early on the seventh of the fifth month,” he replied.

“来去总得两天。”
“The journey there and back will take at least two days.”

“宁愿打宽些。”阿珠在旁接口，
“Better allow plenty of time,” A’zhu put in.

“两天不够的。”
“Two days won't be enough.”

“也对。”胡雪岩说，
“Quite right.

“这样，加一倍算四天好了。”
Let's double it and say four.”

“菜呢？”
“And the food?”

“随你配，随你配！”
“Choose whatever you like!”

胡雪岩是准备好了，
Hu had come prepared.

从小褂口袋里取出一张银票，递了过去，
He took a banknote from the pocket of his short jacket and handed it over.

“你先收了，
“Take this for now.

不够我再补。”
If it isn't enough, I'll make up the difference.”

阿珠的娘是识得字的，
A’zhu's mother could read.

看那银票是二十两，连忙答道：“有得多！
Seeing that it was for twenty taels, she hastily answered, “It's more than enough!

哪里用得着这许多？”
We couldn't possibly need so much.”

“端午要到了。
“The Dragon Boat Festival is nearly here.

多了你自己买点东西吃，
Buy yourselves something to eat with what's left.

节礼我就‘折干’了。”
Consider it my festival present in cash.”

阿珠的娘想了想说：“好，
She thought a moment. “Very well.

多的银子就算存在我这里。
I'll keep the balance on account for you.

好在胡老爷以后总还有坐我们船的时候。”
You're sure to use our boat again.”

说完，她就退了出去。
With that, she withdrew.


胡雪岩顾不得说话！一半也是有意如此，
Hu was too busy eating to talk, partly by design.

不喝酒先吃菜，百实在也是真正的享用，
Before touching his wine he set about the food, which he really did relish.

连着吃了好几筷鱼，才抬头笑道：“阿珠，我有个办法，
After several mouthfuls of fish, he looked up with a smile. “A’zhu, I've had an idea.

最好有这样一位丈母娘，那我的口福就好了！”
If only I had a mother-in-law like this, I should eat wonderfully well!”

表面上是笑话，暗地里是试探，
On the surface it was a joke; beneath it, a test.

遇着情分还不够的女孩子，这就是唐突，会惹得对方生气，非挨骂不可。
With a girl who was not sufficiently attached to him, such a remark would have been presumptuous and bound to provoke an angry rebuke.

但在阿珠听来，又不以为是试探，
But A’zhu did not hear it as a test.

竟是他吐露真意，作了承诺，
To her he had revealed his true feelings and made a promise.

不过阿珠眼前的羞窘虽无人得见，心里的波澜却连自己都觉得难以应付，
No one saw her embarrassment, but even she scarcely knew how to manage the turmoil inside her.

她霍地一下站起来就跑。

这不暇考虑的一个动作，等做出来了，心里却又不安，怕他误会她生了气，
Having acted without thinking, she then worried that he might suppose she was angry.

原是句托词。
It was only an excuse.

一脸的红晕，她也羞于见娘，

老夫妇没有防到隔舱有耳，说来一无顾忌，
Unaware that she could hear them through the cabin partition, they had spoken freely.

“女大不中留，
“You can't keep a grown daughter at home,” her father had said.

我看阿珠茶不思，饭不想，

好象有点……”她爹没有再说下去。

“How can you speak so disrespectfully of your own daughter?”

“I'm only telling the truth.

你说，我是不是老实话？”
Am I not?”

Her mother said nothing.

“I'm asking whether you think he has a conscience.”

无缘无故就会扯到姓胡的头上，
