这一趟到上海的客人，不是很刮皮吗？
That passenger we took to Shanghai this time was terribly stingy, wasn't he?

阿珠背后说起来，总是‘人家胡老爷不象他’，‘人家胡老爷才是好客人’，
When A’zhu spoke of him afterwards, it was always ‘Mr Hu isn't like him’ or ‘Mr Hu is what I call a good passenger.’

你听听！“
There, what do you make of that?”


“那么，你现在到底是怎么个意思呢？”
“Then what exactly do you think now?”

“我也想穿了，只要小两口感情好，做大做小也就不管它了！
“I've come to see it this way: provided the two of them care for one another, I won't worry about her being wife or concubine.

不过，”她娘换了种敬重丈夫的语气：“这总要做老子的作主。”
Still...” Her tone became respectful towards her husband. “Her father must decide.”

“也由不得我作主。
“It's hardly for me to decide either.

我老早说过，照我的意思，最好挑个老实的，一夫一妻，
I told you long ago what I'd prefer: an honest fellow, with just the one wife.

苦就苦一点。
If life were a little harder, so be it.

只是你不肯，她不愿。
But you wouldn't agree, and neither would she.

那就你们娘儿俩自己去商量好了。”
Then let the two of you settle it between yourselves.”

“女儿不是我一个人的，
“She's not my daughter alone.

你不要推出不管。”阿珠的娘说，
Don't push it all away and wash your hands of it,” her mother said.

“你也去打听打听，到底胡老爷住在哪里？
“Go and find out where Mr Hu lives.

信和的张老板一定晓得，
Manager Zhang at Xinhe must know.

你去问他！”
Ask him!”

“问到了做什么？
“And once I know?

你要去看他？”
Do you mean to visit him?”

“一则看他，二则看他太太，
“First to see him, and then to see his wife.

如果是只雌老虎，那就叫阿珠死了这条心吧！”
If she's a tigress, A’zhu must put him out of her mind.”


这是十天前的话，
That had been ten days ago.

果然寻着了“胡老爷”，而且一请就来。
They had indeed found Mr Hu, and he had come as soon as he was invited.

就不知道她娘看见了胡太太没有，
But had her mother seen Mrs Hu?

为人如何？
What sort of person was she?

阿珠心里这样在转着念头。
A’zhu turned these questions over in her mind.

唉！她自己对自己不满，
How foolish she was!

这样容易明白的事，何以好久都猜不透？
Why had she taken so long to understand something so obvious?

只要到了胡家，自然见着了胡太太，
If her mother had gone to the Hu house, she must have met Mrs Hu.

如果胡太太真个是只“雌老虎”，从娘那里先就死了心，
Had the wife really been a tigress, Mother would have abandoned the idea herself.

决不肯承揽这笔短途的生意，更不会待他这样子的殷勤亲热。
She would never have agreed to this short voyage, still less have treated him with such warmth and attention.

照此看来，娘不但见着了胡太太，而且看得胡太太十分贤惠，有气量，将来女儿嫁过去，有把握不会吃亏受气，
Clearly, then, Mother had not only met Mrs Hu but found her kind and generous enough to be sure that her daughter would suffer no ill treatment if she married into the household.

所以今天完全是象“毛脚女婿”上门一般待他。
That was why she had welcomed him today exactly as she would a prospective son-in-law making his first visit.

这不是明摆着的事，
Wasn't it plain?

为何自己思前想后一直想不通？
Why had she thought round and round without seeing it?

这下倒是想通了，但刚有些定下来的心，却越发乱了。
Now she understood, but her heart, only just beginning to settle, grew more agitated than ever.


“阿珠啊！”她听得她娘在喊，
“A’zhu!” she heard her mother call.

“来把汤端了去！”
“Come and take the soup in!”

这一叫使得阿珠大窘，
The call embarrassed her terribly.

自己摸一摸脸，简直烫手，
She touched her face: it was almost hot enough to burn her hand.

料想脸色一定红得象岸上的榴花一样，
Surely she must be as red as the pomegranate blossoms on shore.

但不答应也不得，
Yet she had to answer.

便高声先答一句：“来了！”
“Coming!” she called first.

“快来啊！
“Hurry!

汤要冷了。”
The soup will get cold.”

万般无奈，只好这样答道：“娘，你自己端一端，
Desperate, she replied, “Mother, take it yourself.

我手上不空。”
My hands are full.”

“你在做啥？”
“What are you doing?”

什么也不做，
Nothing at all.

只象一碗热汤一样，摆在那里，等自己的脸冷下来。
Like a bowl of hot soup, she was simply waiting there to cool.

她又用凉水洗了一把脸，脱去软缎背心，刚解衣钮，听得一声门响，
She washed her face again in cold water, removed her satin waistcoat, and had just begun undoing her blouse when the door opened.

吓一大跳，赶紧双手抱胸，掩住衣襟。
Startled, she quickly held the garment closed.

“走进来也不说一声！”她埋怨她娘，
“You might say something before coming in!” she complained to her mother.

“吓得我魂灵都出窍了。”
“You frightened the life out of me.”

“你也是，这时候擦什么身？”她娘催她：
“And why choose this moment to wash?” her mother urged.

“快点！你也来帮着招呼招呼。”
“Hurry up and help entertain our guest.”

这一下妙极，
How fortunate!

“手上不空”的原因也有了，脸上的颜色也遮掩了。
Now she had both an explanation for being occupied and an excuse for her flushed face.

阿珠大为得意，把手巾一丢，扣好衣钮，拿下摆抹一抹平，重新走到了前舱。
Very pleased with herself, A’zhu dropped the towel, fastened her blouse, smoothed its hem, and returned to the forward cabin.


胡雪岩已经在吃饭了，一碗刚刚吃完，
Hu had begun his rice and had just finished a bowl.

她伸手去接饭碗，他摇摇头说：“吃得太饱了！”
When she reached to take it for a refill, he shook his head. “I've eaten far too much!”

“那么你多吃点汤。
“Then have some more soup.

这碗三丝莼菜汤，是我娘的拿手菜。”
Water-shield soup with three shredded ingredients is Mother's speciality.”

“没有一样不拿手，
“Everything is her speciality.

请王大老爷那天，大致就照这个样子，再添两个炒菜，弄只汽锅鸡。”
When we entertain Mr Wang, serve much the same, with two extra stir-fried dishes and a steam-pot chicken.”

“什么叫汽锅鸡？”阿珠笑道：
“What's steam-pot chicken?” A’zhu laughed.

“江西人补碗，‘叽咕叽’！”
“Qi-gu-ji! It sounds like the cry of those Jiangxi men who mend bowls!”

胡雪岩忍不住笑了，
Hu could not help laughing.

笑停了说：“原来你也有不晓得的菜！
When he recovered, he said, “So there is a dish you don't know!

汽锅鸡是云南菜，
Steam-pot chicken comes from Yunnan.

王大老爷是福建人，生长在云南，所以喜欢云南口味。
Mr Wang's family is from Fujian, but he grew up in Yunnan, so he likes Yunnan flavours.

汽锅鸡我也是在他家头一回吃，做法我也学会了，
I first ate it at his house and learnt how to make it.

等下我再传授给你娘。”
I'll teach your mother later.”

“不要，不要，
“No, no.

你教我好了。”
Teach me.”

阿珠往后看了看，“ 不要给我娘晓得。”
A’zhu glanced towards the rear. “Don't let Mother know.”

“咦！这为啥？”
“Why ever not?”

“我娘总说我笨手笨脚，没有一样菜烧得入味的。
“Mother's always saying I'm clumsy and can't cook a single dish properly.

我现在也要学一样她不会的，只怕见都没有见过，
I want to learn something she can't make—perhaps something she's never even seen.

那就尽由得我说了。”
Then whatever I say about it will have to be right.”


“好，我教你！”胡雪岩把汽锅鸡的做法传授了她。
“Very well, I'll teach you!” Hu explained how to make steam-pot chicken.

“这并不难嘛！”
“That's not difficult!”

“本来就不难，
“It isn't.

只是那只锅不容易找，
Only the special pot is hard to find.

我送你们一个。”胡雪岩又说：“我倒要尝一尝你这个徒弟的手艺，看比我另外的一个徒弟是好是坏？”
I'll give you one.” He added, “I must taste my new pupil's cooking and see whether it's better or worse than my other pupil's.”

“另外一个徒弟是哪个？”
“Who is your other pupil?”

胡雪岩笑笔不响。
Hu smiled without answering.

阿珠也猜到了是谁，心里顿起一种异样的感觉，好象有些不舒服，但又不能不关心。
A’zhu guessed, and a strange feeling rose in her, vaguely uncomfortable but impossible to ignore.

她又想，不问下去倒显得自己有什么忌讳似地，十分不妥。
Then she thought that refusing to ask would make her seem afraid of the subject, which would be very wrong.

于是问道：“是胡太太？”
“Mrs Hu?”

“当然是她。”
“Of course.”

“胡太太的这样菜，一定做得道地？”
“Then she must make this dish just as it should be made?”

“也不见得。”胡雪岩说，
“Not necessarily,” he said.

“她不大会做菜，也不大喜欢下厨房。”
“She isn't much of a cook and doesn't particularly like the kitchen.”

“那么喜欢什么呢？”
“What does she like, then?”


胡雪岩有些猜到，她是在打听他太太的性情，
Hu began to suspect that A’zhu was sounding him out about his wife's character.

因而想到她娘那天也可能借送食物为名，特意来观望风色。
Perhaps her mother, too, had used the delivery of food as an excuse to visit and assess the situation.

如果自己的猜想不错，只怕今天就要有个了断。
If he was right, they might expect some definite settlement today.

这是个难题，
This was difficult.

在自己这方面来说，对于阿珠的态度，根本还未到可以作最后决定的时候，
He himself was nowhere near ready to make a final decision about A’zhu.

那就得想个什么好办法来搪塞，既要达到自己的目的，又要不伤阿珠的感情。
He must find a tactful way of putting them off that would achieve his purpose without hurting her feelings.


“咦！怎么了，
“What's wrong?

忽然变哑巴了？”阿珠见他久久不语，这样催问。
Have you suddenly lost your voice?” A’zhu asked when he remained silent.

“我忽然想起一桩要紧事。”胡雪岩顺口掩饰着，
“I've just remembered something important,” he said to cover his thoughts.

“刚才谈到什么地方了？”
“What were we talking about?”

阿珠倒又不关心他太太的爱好了，
A’zhu was no longer interested in his wife's preferences.

咬着嘴唇，微垂着眼，死瞪住他看。
Biting her lip, she lowered her eyes a little and stared fixedly at him.

“我要说你了，”胡雪岩笑道，
“Now it's my turn to ask,” Hu said with a smile.

“莫非你也变了哑巴？”
“Have you lost your voice too?”

“我也忽然想起一桩事，
“I've suddenly thought of something as well.

我要看你刚才说的话是真，是假？”
I want to see whether what you just said was true.”

“你以为我说有要紧事是骗你？”
“Do you think I invented that important matter?”

“不是什么骗我，
“It isn't a question of inventing it.

你在打主意要走了！”
You're trying to think how to leave!”

“你的心思真多。
“You do imagine things.

不过，”胡雪岩望着窗外，
Still...” Hu looked out of the window.

“天快黑了，这地方上岸不便，而且看样子要下雨。
“It's getting dark, landing here isn't easy, and it looks like rain.

我说句实话，你不说我倒记不起，
To tell you the truth, it hadn't occurred to me until you mentioned it.

你一说正好提醒我，我该走了。”
You've reminded me: I ought to go.”


阿珠心里十分生气，
A’zhu was angry.

明明早就想走了，还要说便宜话，
He had clearly been wanting to leave for some time, yet he had to make that clever remark.

于是转身向外，故意拉长了声音喊船伙计：“阿四，
Turning outwards, she deliberately drew out her words as she called to the boat hand. “A’si!

搭跳板，
Put out the gangplank!

送客！”
Our guest is leaving!”

“还早啊！”她娘马上应声，
“It's still early!” her mother immediately answered.

“胡老爷再坐一歇。”
“Stay a little longer, Mr Hu.”

“不要留他！
“Don't keep him!

天黑了，要下雨了，路上不好走，
It's getting dark, it's going to rain, the road will be bad.

等下滑一跤，都怪你！”
If he slips, he'll blame you!”

明明负气，偏是呖呖莺声，入耳只觉好听有趣。
Plainly she was speaking in a temper, yet her clear, birdlike voice made it sound only pleasing and amusing.

胡雪岩无论如何忍不下心来说要走，
Hu could not bring himself to insist on leaving.

笑笑答道：“我不走，
“I'm not going,” he said with a smile.

是阿珠在赶我。”
“A’zhu is driving me away.”

“阿珠又没规矩了。
“There she goes, forgetting her manners again.

胡老爷，你不要理她！
Pay no attention to her, Mr Hu.

等我收拾桌子泡茶来你吃。”
I'll clear the table and make you some tea.”


等收拾了桌子，重新泡上一碗上品龙井新茶来，天气果然变了，
By the time the table had been cleared and a fresh bowl of the finest new Longjing tea prepared, the weather had indeed changed.

船篷上滴滴答答响起了雨声。
Rain began pattering on the boat's awning.

“黄梅天，说睛就晴，
“In the plum-rain season it clears as suddenly as it clouds over.

一下工夫，天又好了。”
The weather will be fine again in a moment.”

阿珠的娘说这话的用意，胡雪岩当然知道，
Hu understood why A’zhu's mother said this.

是唯恐他要走，或者虽不走而记挂着天黑雨滑，道路泥泞，不能安心坐下来。
She feared he would leave—or, even if he stayed, that he would be too worried about darkness, rain, and muddy roads to sit at ease.

他向来不肯让人有这种悬揣不安的感觉，
He never liked to leave others in such anxious uncertainty.

心想既来之则安之，
Since he was here, he might as well settle down.

真的要走，哪怕三更半夜，天上下冰雹，总也得想出办法来脱身，
If he truly wished to leave, he would have to find a way, even at midnight in a hailstorm.

那就不如放大方些。
Better, then, to be generous about it.

于是他说，“随它下好了，
“Let it rain,” he said.

反正不好走就不好走，
“If the journey's difficult, it's difficult.

你们船上我又不是没有住过。”
It wouldn't be the first time I've slept on your boat.”

这一说，她们母女俩脸上的神色，立刻就都不同的。
Mother and daughter immediately brightened.

“是啊！”阿珠的娘的，
“Exactly!” her mother said.

“明天一早走也一样。”
“You can just as well leave first thing tomorrow.”

“不过我今天晚上实在有件要紧事。
“But I really do have important business this evening.

也罢，”他慨然说道，
Never mind,” he said expansively.

“我写封信，请你们那位伙计，替我送一送。”
“I'll write a note and ask your boat hand to deliver it.”

“好的！”
“Certainly!”

阿珠的娘要吩咐她女儿去取笔砚，谁知阿珠的心里来得快，早就在动手了。
Her mother was about to tell A’zhu to fetch the writing things, but the quick-thinking girl was already doing so.


打开柜子取出一个红木盘，文房四宝，一应俱全。
She opened a cupboard and took out a rosewood tray containing a complete set of writing materials: brush, inkstick, paper, and inkstone.

原是为客人预备的，只是久已不用，砚墨尘封，
They had been provided for passengers but had not been used for so long that the inkstone and inkstick were dusty.

阿珠抹一抹干净，随手伸出春葱样的一只指头，在自己的茶碗里蘸了几滴水珠，注入砚中，替他磨墨。
A’zhu wiped them clean, dipped a slender finger into her tea bowl, transferred a few drops to the inkstone, and began grinding ink for him.

她磨墨，他在腹中打草稿，
While she worked, he composed the note in his head.

此是胡雪岩的一短，
Writing was one of his weaknesses.

几句话想了好半天，
Even these few sentences took considerable thought.

把张信纸在桌上抹了又抹，取支笔在砚台中舐了又舐，才算想停当。
He repeatedly smoothed the paper on the table and worked the brush against the inkstone before he finally settled on the wording.

信是写给刘庆生的，请他去通知自己家里，只说：今夜因为王有龄有要紧公事，要彻夜会商，不能回家。
The note was addressed to Liu Qingsheng, asking him to tell Hu's household that urgent official business with Wang Youling required an all-night consultation and that he could not return home.

其实这么两句话，叫船伙计阿四到自己家去送个口信，反倒简便，
It would have been simpler to send A’si directly to the house with this brief message.

只是胡雪岩怕阿四去了，会泄漏自己的行踪，所以特意转这样一道手。
But Hu feared the boat hand would reveal his whereabouts, so he deliberately chose this roundabout route.

办了这件事，胡雪岩就轻松了，
With the matter settled, Hu relaxed.

但阿珠看在眼里，却又不免猜疑，胡雪岩怕是个怕老婆的人？
Watching him, A’zhu wondered whether he might be afraid of his wife.

转念又想，这正是胡雪岩的好处，
Then she reconsidered: this was one of his virtues.

换了那些浪荡子弟，自己在外面花天酒地，把太太丢在家，独守空房，哪怕提心吊胆，一夜坐等，也不会放在他心上。
A dissolute young man would go out carousing and leave his wife alone at home without caring whether she spent the whole night waiting in fear and anxiety.


“好了！”他喝着茶说，
“Now, then!” he said over his tea.

“有事，你就谈吧！”
“If there's anything you want to discuss, go ahead.”

明明有终身大事要谈，说破了，阿珠反倒不愿，
There certainly was the question of her future marriage, but his putting it so plainly made A’zhu reluctant.

“你这个人！”她说，
“Really, you!” she said.

“一定要有事谈，才留你在这里吗？”
“Must there be something to discuss before I can ask you to stay?”

“就是闲谈，总也要有件事。”
“Even idle conversation needs a subject.

胡雪岩问道，“阿珠，你在湖州住过几年？”
A’zhu, how many years have you lived in Huzhou?”

“那怎么说得出？
“How could I say?

来来去去，算不清楚了。”
We've come and gone so often that I've lost count.”

“湖州地方你总很熟是不是？”
“But you know the place well?”

“当然不会陌生。不过也不是顶熟。”
“I'm certainly no stranger to it, though I don't know it better than anyone.

阿珠又说，“你问它做什么？”
Why do you ask?”

“王大老爷放了湖州府，我总要打听打听那里的情形。”
“Now that Mr Wang is going to be prefect there, I ought to learn something about it.”

“我倒问你。”阿珠忽然然注意地，
“Then let me ask you,” she said, suddenly attentive.

“你是不是也要到湖州去做官？”
“Are you going to Huzhou to become an official too?”

这话让胡雪岩很难回答，
Hu found that difficult to answer.

想了一会答道：“湖州我是要常去的。
After thinking a moment, he said, “I shall go to Huzhou often.

不过，至多是半官半商。”
But at most I'll be half official, half merchant.”


“怎么叫‘半官半商’？
“What does ‘half official, half merchant’ mean?

又做官又做生意？”
Holding office and doing business?”

阿珠心中灵光一闪，就象黑夜里在荒野中迷路，忽然一道闪电，恰好让她辨清了方向，
A sudden inspiration flashed through A’zhu's mind, like lightning revealing the right direction to someone lost in the wilderness at night.

不由得精神大振，
Her spirits rose at once.

急急问道：“你要到湖州做啥生意？
“What business will you do in Huzhou?” she asked eagerly.

是不是开钱庄。”
“Open a bank?”

“不是开钱庄。”胡雪岩答说：
“Not a bank,” Hu replied.

“我想做丝生意。”
“I'm thinking of going into silk.”

“这就一定要到湖州去！”阿珠很高光，也很骄傲地说：
“Then you certainly must go to Huzhou!” she said with delighted pride.

“我们湖州的丝，天下第一！”
“Our Huzhou silk is the finest in the world!”

“是啊！
“Yes.

因为天下第一，所以外国人也要来买。”
That's why foreigners come to buy it too.”

阿珠说的“天下”，是照多少年来传统的定义，四海之内，就是天下。
By “the world,” A’zhu meant what people had traditionally meant for generations: the realm within the four seas.

胡雪岩到过上海，晓得了西洋的情形，
Hu had visited Shanghai and learnt something of the West.

才知道天外有天，人外有人，
He now knew that there were skies beyond his own sky and people beyond his familiar world.

所以他口中的天下，跟阿珠所想的不同。
The world he meant was therefore different from the one she imagined.


“原来你买了丝要去‘销洋庄’！”阿珠说道，
“So you mean to buy silk for the export houses!” A’zhu said.

“销洋庄的丝，一直都是广帮客人的生意。”
“That's always been the business of the Cantonese merchants.”

“别人好做，我也好做。”胡雪岩笑道：
“If others can do it, so can I.” Hu smiled.

“阿珠，看样子，你倒不外行。”
“You don't seem altogether ignorant of the trade, A’zhu.”

“当然罗，”她扬着脸，挺直了身子，显得很神气地，
“Of course not!” She lifted her face and straightened proudly.

“你想想，我是什么地方人？”
“Think where I come from!”

“那好！
“Good!

你把你们湖州出丝的情形倒讲给我听听看。”
Then tell me how silk is produced in Huzhou.”

阿珠知道，这不是闲谈，
She knew this was no longer idle talk.

胡雪岩既然要做这行生意，当然要先打听得越清楚越好，
If Hu intended to enter the trade, naturally he wanted as much precise information as possible.

她怕自己说得不够明白，甚至说错，因而把她娘也去搬请了来，一起来细谈。
Afraid she might explain badly or even get something wrong, she fetched her mother to discuss it with them in detail.


“这个，”阿珠的娘说，“我们无锡乡下也养蚕的，
“Well,” her mother began, “we raise silkworms in the countryside round Wuxi too.

不过出的多是‘肥丝’，不比湖州多是‘细丝’……”
But most of our output is what we call full silk, whereas Huzhou produces chiefly fine silk...”

“怎么叫‘肥丝’？”胡雪岩打断她的话问。
“What is full silk?” Hu interrupted.

“丝分三种，
“There are three grades.

上等茧子缫成细丝，
The best cocoons are reeled into fine silk.

上、中茧缫成肥丝，
Good and medium cocoons produce full silk.

下等茧子缫成的就是粗丝。
Poor cocoons yield coarse silk.

粗丝不能上织机，
Coarse silk can't be put on the loom.

织绸一定得用肥丝和细丝，细丝为经，肥丝为纬。”
Woven silk requires the fine and full grades: fine silk for the warp, full silk for the weft.”

这一说，胡雪岩立即就懂了细丝质地高于肥丝的道理，
Hu immediately understood why the fine grade was superior.

因为杭州的“织造衙门”，下城一带，“机坊”林立，
Near Hangzhou's Imperial Silk Weaving Office, in the lower part of the city, there were weaving workshops everywhere.

他也听人说过，一定要坚韧光亮的好丝，才能做“经”丝。
He had heard that only good silk, strong and lustrous, could serve as warp thread.


“在湖州，女孩子十一二岁就懂养蚕，
“In Huzhou, girls know how to raise silkworms by eleven or twelve.

养蚕实在辛苦，
It's hard work.

三、四月里称为‘蚕月’，
The third and fourth months are called the silkworm months.

真正是六亲不认，
People really do shut out even their closest relations.

门口贴张红纸就是‘挡箭牌’，
A sheet of red paper on the door serves as a shield against visitors.

哪怕邻舍都不往来。
They don't even see their neighbours.”

““听说还有许多禁忌，
“I've heard there are many taboos too.

是不是？”
Is that right?”

“禁忌来得个多。”阿珠的娘说，
“A great many,” A’zhu's mother replied.

“夫妇不能同房，也不能说什么风言风语，
“Husband and wife mustn't sleep together, nor must anyone use improper language.

因为‘蚕宝宝’最要干净。”
The silkworm babies demand complete purity.”

接下来，她细谈了养蚕的过程，
She went on to describe the process in detail.

由初生到成茧，经过“三眠”，大概要二十八天到四十天的工夫，
From hatching to cocooning, the worms passed through three periods of dormancy, taking roughly twenty-eight to forty days.

喂蚕有定时，深更半夜，都得起身饲食，耽误不得一刻。
They had to be fed at set times; even in the middle of the night, someone must rise to feed them without a moment's delay.

育蚕又最重温度，
Temperature was especially important.

门窗紧闭，密不通风，
Doors and windows were kept tightly shut against draughts.

如果天气骤变，觉得冷了，必须生火，
If the weather changed suddenly and the room grew cold, a fire had to be lit.

常有些养蚕人家，不知不觉间倦极而眠，以致失火成灾。
Often exhausted members of silkworm-raising households fell asleep unawares, allowing fires to break out and cause disaster.

育蚕当然要桑叶，
Of course, the worms needed mulberry leaves.

空有桑树，固然无用，蚕多桑少，也是麻烦，
Mulberry trees alone were useless, but too many worms and too few trees also caused difficulties.

有时不得不把辛苦养成一半的蚕弃置。
Sometimes people had to discard worms already halfway through their painstaking upbringing.

这是养蚕人家最痛苦的事。
Nothing was more painful to a silkworm-raising household.


这一谈，把胡雪岩记忆中的关于蚕丝的知识勾了出来，
Her account brought back what Hu already knew of silk.

便即问道，“最好的丝，是不是叫‘缉里丝’？”
“Isn't the very best called Jili silk?” he asked.

“大家都这么说。”阿珠的娘答道，
“That's what everyone says,” A’zhu's mother answered.

“那地方离南浔七里路。”
“The place is seven li from Nanxun.”

“原来是‘七里丝’，不是‘缉里丝’。”胡雪岩欣然领悟，
“So it's Qili—‘seven li’—silk, rather than Jili!” Hu exclaimed, pleased with his discovery.

“真是凡事要请教内行。”
“You really must consult those who know the trade.”

“七”与“缉”字异而音同，
The characters for “seven” and the first syllable of Jili were different, but sounded alike in their speech.

所以阿珠听得莫名其妙，在旁边笑他：“什么‘七里丝’不是‘七里丝’？
A’zhu was therefore puzzled and laughed at him. “What do you mean, ‘Qili silk, not Qili silk’?

姓胡的，不姓胡，
A man named Hu isn't named Hu?

这叫什么怪话？”
What sort of nonsense is that?”


胡雪岩笑笑不答，
Hu smiled without answering.

这时没有心里来跟她斗嘴开玩笑，
He had no inclination to exchange jokes just then.

他脑中有七八个念头在转，
Seven or eight ideas were turning in his mind.

自己静一静，略略理出了一个头绪，才重拾中断的话题。
He quietened himself, began to put them in order, and returned to the interrupted subject.

“养蚕我是明白了。
“I understand how the worms are raised now.

怎么样缫丝，丝做出来，怎么卖出去，我还不大懂。”
What I still don't quite understand is how the silk is reeled and then sold.”

于是阿珠的娘，把土法缫丝的方法讲给他听，
A’zhu's mother explained the traditional method.

用一口大锅，烧滚了水，倒一升茧下去，用根木棍子搅着，
Water was boiled in a large pot, a sheng measure of cocoons tipped in, and the contents stirred with a wooden stick.

锅上架两部小丝车，下面装一根竹管，
Two small reels stood above the pot, with a bamboo tube beneath.

等把丝头搅了出来，通过竹管，绕小车一匝，再引入地上的大丝车。
Once stirring had drawn out the filament ends, these were passed through the tube, taken once round a small reel, and led to the large reel on the ground.

抽尽了丝，蚕蛹自然出现，
As the silk was drawn off, the pupae appeared.

如果丝断了再搅，搅出丝头来，抽光了为止。
If a thread broke, one stirred again to find its end, continuing until all the silk had been reeled.

“缫丝也辛苦。”阿珠的娘的说，
“Reeling is hard work too,” she said.

“茧子不赶紧缫出丝来，里头的蛹咬破了头，茧子就没有用了。
“Unless the cocoons are reeled quickly, the creatures inside break through them and make them useless.

所以缫丝一定是一家大小动手，没日没夜赶完为止。
So the whole family, young and old, has to work day and night until it's finished.

胡老爷你想想看，站在滚烫的小锅旁边，不停手的搅，不停手的抽丝，加以蚕蛹烫死了的那股气味，
Imagine standing beside a pot of boiling water, stirring and drawing silk without stopping, with that smell from the scalded pupae.

真正是受罪。
It's real suffering.

倘或遇着茧子潮软，抽丝不容易，那就越发苦了。
If the cocoons are damp and soft and won't reel easily, it's worse still.

还有搅了半天，抽不出头的，
Some won't yield an end however long you stir.

那叫‘水茧’，
They're called water cocoons.

只好捞出来丢掉，白费心血。”
You can only fish them out and throw them away—all that work wasted.”


“苦虽苦，总也有开心的时候。”
“Hard as it is, there must be happy times too.”

“当然罗，
“Of course.

一直是苦的事情，天下没有人去做的。
Nobody in the world would do something that was nothing but misery.

到缫成丝，‘丝客人’一到镇上，那就是开心的时候到了，
Once the silk is reeled and the travelling silk buyers reach town, the happy time begins.

丝价年年在涨，
Silk prices rise every year.

新丝卖来的钱，着实可以派点用场。”
The money from the new silk really does come in useful.”

这触及到胡雪岩最需要了解的地方了。
Here was what Hu most needed to understand.

“丝客人”这个名称，他是懂的，带了大批现银到产地买丝的，称为“丝客人”，
He knew the term “travelling silk buyer”: a merchant who brought large quantities of ready silver to purchase silk where it was produced.

开丝行代为搜购新丝，从中取利的称为“丝主人”。
Those who operated local firms, gathering new silk for the buyers and making a profit in the process, were known as “silk hosts.”

每到三、四月间，钱庄放款给丝客人是一项主要的业务。
Every third and fourth month, lending to the travelling buyers was one of the banks' chief lines of business.

他在想，与其政款给丝客人去买丝，赚取拆息，何不自己做丝客人？
Why, Hu thought, should he lend them money to buy silk and collect interest, instead of becoming a buyer himself?

“我也想做做丝客人。
“I'd like to try being a silk buyer too.

不知道其中有什么诀窍？”
Are there any special tricks to it?”

“这我就不晓得了。”阿珠的娘说，
“That I couldn't tell you,” A’zhu's mother replied.

“照我想，第一总要懂得丝好坏。
“I suppose the first thing is to recognise good silk.

第二，要晓得丝的行情，
The second is to know the market.

丝价每年有上落，不过收新丝总是便宜的。“
Prices go up and down each year, but buying the new season's silk is always cheaper.”


“丝价的上落，是怎么来的呢？
“What makes the price rise and fall?

出得少，价钱就高，或者收的人多，价钱也会高。
If less silk is produced, the price goes up; or if more people want to buy it, that raises the price too.

是不是这样子？”
Is that how it works?”

“我想做生意总是这样。
“I suppose all business works that way.

不过，”阿珠的娘又说，“丝价高低，我听人说，一大半是‘做’出来的，
But,” she added, “I've heard that silk prices are mostly made by people.

都有几个大户手里。”
They're in the hands of a few big firms.”

听得这话，胡雪岩精神一振，
Hu's spirits rose.

知道丝价高低，决于大户的操纵，
So prices depended on manipulation by the large operators.

这个把戏他最在行。
That was a game he understood exceptionally well.

阿珠的娘这时越谈越起劲了，而且所谈的也正是胡雪岩想知道的，茧与丝的买卖。
A’zhu's mother was becoming increasingly animated, and she was discussing exactly what he wanted to know: the buying and selling of cocoons and silk.

“如果人手不够，或者别样缘故，卖茧子的也有。”她说，
“Some families sell their cocoons because they don't have enough hands, or for some other reason,” she said.

“收茧子的有茧行，
“Cocoon firms buy them.

要官府里领了‘牙帖’才好开。
To open one, you have to obtain a broker's licence from the authorities.

同行有‘茧业公所’，
The trade has its Cocoon Guild.

新茧上市，同行公议，哪一天开称，哪一天为止。
When the new cocoons reach the market, the members agree on the day buying begins and the day it ends.

价钱也是议好的，不准自己拾价。
They agree on the prices too; nobody may raise them independently.

不过乡下人卖茧子常要吃亏，
But country people often lose out by selling cocoons.

除非万不得已，都是卖丝。”
Unless they have no other choice, they sell silk.”


“为什么要吃亏？”
“Why do they lose out?”

“这一点你都不懂？”阿珠插嘴，
“Don't you understand even that?” A’zhu interrupted.

“茧行杀你的价，你只好卖，
“If the cocoon firm beats down your price, you have to sell.

不卖摆在那里，里头的蛹咬破了头，
Leave them unsold, and the creatures inside break through.

一文不值！”
Then they're not worth a single copper!”

“对，对！
“Yes, yes!

我也搅糊涂了。”胡雪岩又问：
I wasn't thinking.” Hu asked another question.

“那么茧子行买了茧子，怎么出手呢？”
“Once the cocoon firm has bought them, how does it sell them on?”

“ 这有两种，
“There are two ways.

一种是卖给缫丝厂，一种是自己缫了丝卖。”
It can sell them to a reeling establishment, or reel the silk itself and sell that.”

“喔，我懂了。
“Ah, I see.

你倒再说说丝行看，
Now tell me about the silk firms.

也要向部里领牙帖，
Do they also need a broker's licence from the ministry?

也有同业公所？”
And do they have a guild?”


“当然罗。
“Of course.

丝行的花样比茧行多得多，各做各的生意，
There are far more varieties of silk firm than cocoon firm, each with its own business.

大的才叫丝行，
Only the larger ones are properly called silk firms.

小的叫‘用户’，当地买，当地用，
The smaller ones are ‘users,’ buying locally for local use.

中间转手批发的叫‘划庄’。
Those that buy and resell wholesale are called ‘transfer houses.’

还有‘广行’、‘洋庄’，专门做洋鬼子的生意，
Then there are Cantonese houses and export houses, which deal exclusively with the foreign devils.

那是越发要大本钱了，
Those require even more capital.

上万‘两’的丝摆在手里，等价钱好了卖给洋鬼子，
They may hold tens of thousands of liang in silk, waiting for a good price before selling it to the foreigners.

你想想看，要压多少本钱？
Think how much capital that ties up!

洋鬼子也坏得很，
And the foreign devils are very cunning.

你抬他的价，他不说你贵，
If you ask a higher price, they don't tell you you're expensive.

表面跟你笑嘻嘻，暗夜下另外去寻路子，
They smile pleasantly while secretly looking elsewhere.

自有吃本太重，急于想脱手求现的，肯杀价卖给他。
There's always someone with too much money tied up, desperate to sell for cash and willing to take a lower price.

你还在那里老等，人家已经塌进便宜货，装上轮船运到西洋去了……”
You go on waiting while they've already bought cheap stock, put it on a steamship, and sent it to the West...”

“慢，慢来！”胡雪岩大声打断，
“Wait, wait!” Hu interrupted loudly.

“等我想一想。”
“Let me think.”


她们母女俩都不晓得他要想什么？
Neither mother nor daughter knew what he wanted to think about.

只见他皱紧眉头，偏着头，双眼望着空中，是极用心的样子，
They saw him frown, tilt his head, and stare into space in deep concentration.

他在想嫌洋鬼子的钱！
He was thinking how to make money out of the foreigners.

做生意就怕心不齐，
The great danger in business was lack of unity.

跟洋鬼子做生意，也要象茧行收茧一样，就是这个价钱，愿意就愿意，不愿意就拉倒。
Dealing with foreigners should be like the cocoon firms' buying arrangements: this was the price; take it or leave it.

那一来洋鬼子非服帖不可。
Then the foreigners would have to submit.

不过人心不同，各如其面，
But people's minds differed as much as their faces.

但也难怪，
Nor could one really blame them.

本钱不足，周转不灵，只好脱货求现，除非……
With insufficient capital and no money circulating, they had no choice but to sell for cash, unless...

他豁然贯通了！
Suddenly he saw it!

除非能把所有的“洋庄”都抓在手里。
Unless he could bring all the export houses under his influence.

当然，天下的饭，一个人是吃不完的，
Naturally, no one person could swallow every opportunity in the world.

只有联络同行，要他们跟着自己走。
He must bring his fellow merchants together and persuade them to follow his lead.


这也不难！他在想，
That would not be difficult either.

洋庄丝价卖得好，哪个不乐意？
Who would object to higher prices for export silk?

至于想脱货求现的，有两个办法，
For those who needed to sell for cash, there were two solutions.

第一，你要卖给洋鬼子，不如卖给我。
First: instead of selling to the foreigners, sell to him.

第二，你如果不肯卖给我，也不要卖给洋鬼子，
Second: if they would not sell to him, they should still refrain from selling to the foreigners.

要用多少款子，拿货色来抵押，包他将来能嫌得比现在多。
Whatever funds they needed, they could borrow against their goods; he would guarantee them a better profit later than they could make now.

这样，此人如果还一定要卖货色给洋鬼子，那必定是暗底下受人家的好处，有意自贬身价，成了吃里扒外的半吊子，
If a man still insisted on selling to the foreigners, he must be receiving secret benefits from them, deliberately lowering his own price and betraying his fellows for outsiders.

可以鼓动同行，跟他断绝往来，
Hu could rally the trade to cut off all dealings with him.

看他还狠到哪里去？
Then how far could his defiance go?

“对啊，
“That's it!

对啊！”
That's it!”

他想到得意之处，自己拍着手掌笑，仿佛痰迷心窍似地，把阿珠逗得笑弯了腰。
Carried away by his cleverness, he clapped and laughed to himself as though possessed, making A’zhu double up with laughter.

阿珠的娘，到底不同，有几分猜到，
Her mother was different: she partly guessed his thoughts.

便即笑着问道：“胡老爷是想做丝生意？”
“Are you planning to enter the silk trade, Mr Hu?” she asked with a smile.

“我要做‘丝客人’。”
“I mean to become a travelling silk buyer.”

“果不其然！”阿珠的娘得意的笑了，
“Just as I thought!” she said triumphantly.

“胡老爷要做丝生意。”
“Mr Hu means to trade in silk.”

阿珠当然更是喜心翻倒，
A’zhu, of course, was even more delighted.

不仅是为了这一来常有跟胡雪岩聚会的机会，
It was not only that she would have frequent opportunities to see him.

而且也因为自己的心愿，居然很快地就达成，所以有着近乎意外的那种惊喜。
Her own wish seemed to have come true so quickly that she felt the joyful surprise of an unexpected gift.


“不过，干娘……”胡雪岩这样叫阿珠的娘。那是杭州人习用的一种称呼，还是南宋的遗风，
“But, Auntie...” Hu addressed A’zhu's mother as ganniang, a form familiar in Hangzhou and inherited from the Southern Song.

义母叫干娘，姑母也叫干娘，凡是对年纪比自己大的妇人而自愿执后辈之礼的，都可以这样称呼。
It could mean an adoptive mother or a paternal aunt, and could be used for any older woman towards whom the speaker voluntarily assumed the respectful position of a younger relation.

因此这一叫，叫得阿珠的娘，受宠若惊。
A’zhu's mother was overwhelmed by the honour.

“不敢当，不敢当！”她连连逊谢，近乎惶恐的，
“Oh, I couldn't accept that!” she protested repeatedly, almost alarmed.

“胡老爷千万不要这样叫！”
“You mustn't call me that, Mr Hu!”

她在谦虚，阿珠却在旁边急坏了！
While her mother demurred, A’zhu grew anxious.

这一声“干娘”，在她听来就如胡雪岩跟她开那个玩笑，说要叫娘为‘丈母娘“是差不多的意思，
To her, “Auntie” meant almost the same thing as his earlier joke about calling Mother his mother-in-law.

所以表面没有什么，心一直在跳。
She appeared calm, but her heart kept racing.

她想：人家要来亲近，你偏偏不受，
He was trying to draw closer, and Mother insisted on refusing.

这算什么意思呢？
What sense did that make?

因此，胡雪岩还没有开口，她先发了话：“人家抬举你，
Before Hu could answer, she spoke. “He's honouring you.

你不要不识抬举！”
Don't be so ungracious!”

知女莫若母，
No one understands a daughter better than her mother.

胡雪岩的“干娘”，立即有所意会，她自己也觉得大可不必如此坚辞不受。
Hu's new “Auntie” immediately grasped what A’zhu meant and realised that there was no need to refuse so firmly.

不过也不便把话拉回来，
Yet she could hardly take back her words.

最好含含糊糊过去，等你再叫时不作声，
Best to let the matter pass vaguely, then make no objection when he used the name again.

那一下“干娘”就做定了。
That would settle her new position.

于是她笑着骂阿珠：“你看你，
She laughed and scolded A’zhu. “Look at you!

倒过来教训起我来了！”
Now you're the one lecturing me!”


她们母女俩的语气眼风，一五一十都看在胡雪岩眼里，此时忙着要谈正经，没有工夫理这回来，
Hu noticed every tone and glance exchanged by mother and daughter, but he was too eager to discuss serious business to attend to their meaning.

“干娘！”他说，“我做‘丝客人’，你做‘丝主人’好不好？”
“Auntie,” he said, “if I become a travelling silk buyer, how would you like to become a silk host?”

“胡老爷在说笑话了。”
“You're joking, Mr Hu.”

做“丝主人”就是开丝行，
Being a silk host meant operating a local silk firm.

阿珠的娘说，“我又不开丝行，
“I haven't got a silk firm.

哪里有丝卖给你？”
Where would I find silk to sell you?”

“不要紧！
“Never mind.

我来帮你开。”
I'll help you open one.”

“开什么？”阿珠又插嘴，
“Open what?” A’zhu broke in again.

“开丝行？”
“A silk firm?”

“对！”答得非常爽脆。
“Yes!” His answer was crisp and confident.

阿珠的娘看看他，又看看女儿，
Her mother looked from him to her daughter.

这样子不象说笑话。
He did not seem to be joking.

但如果不是笑话，却更让她困惑，
But if he was serious, that was even more puzzling.

“胡老爷，”她很谨慎地问：“你自己为什么不来开？”
“Mr Hu,” she asked cautiously, “why don't you open one yourself?”

“这话问得对了！”胡雪岩连连点头，
“That's exactly the right question!” Hu nodded repeatedly.

“为什么我自己不来开呢？
“Why don't I?

第一，我不是湖州人，做生意，老实说，总有点欺生的。
First, I'm not from Huzhou, and in business, to be frank, people do take advantage of newcomers.

第二，王大老爷在湖州府，
Second, Mr Wang will be prefect there.

我来做‘客人’不要紧，来做‘主人’，人家就要说闲话了。
If I come as a visiting buyer, that's harmless; if I become a local proprietor, people will gossip.

明明跟王大老爷无关，说起来某某丝行有知府撑腰，
Though Mr Wang has nothing to do with it, they'll say such-and-such a firm has the prefect behind it.

遭人的忌，生意就难做了。”
That breeds resentment and makes business difficult.”


这一说阿珠的娘才明白。
Now A’zhu's mother understood.

一想到自己会有个现成的“老板娘”做，笑得眼睛眯成两条缝，
At the thought of stepping straight into the role of a business proprietor, she smiled until her eyes narrowed to two slits.

“原来胡大老爷要我出出面。
“So you want me to represent the firm, Mr Hu.

不过，”她的心又一冷，
But...” Her spirits suddenly sank.

“我女人家，怎么出面？”
“How can a woman take that public role?”

“那不要紧，
“That's no difficulty.

请你们老张来出面领帖，
Have Old Zhang apply for the licence in his name.

暗底下，是你老板娘一把抓，
Behind the scenes, you'll run everything as the proprietress.

那不也一样吗？”
Won't that amount to the same thing?”

“啊唷！老板娘！”阿珠甩着辫子大笑，
“Oh my! The proprietress!” A’zhu tossed her braid and laughed.

“又是干娘，又是老板娘，
“An auntie and a proprietress!

以后我要好好巴结你了！”
I shall have to make myself very agreeable to you from now on!”

那笑声有些轻狂，以至于把她爹招引了来，
Her laughter was rather exuberant and brought her father to see what was happening.

探头一望，正好让胡雪岩发觉，随即招着手说：“来，来，老张！
As he peered in, Hu noticed him and beckoned. “Come in, Old Zhang!

正有事要跟你谈。”
There's something I want to discuss with you.”

老张是个老实人，见了胡雪岩相当拘谨，
An honest, simple man, Old Zhang was quite constrained in Hu's presence.

斜欠着身子坐在椅子上，仿佛下属对上司似地，静听吩咐。
He perched sideways on the edge of a chair, listening for instructions like a subordinate before his superior.

胡雪岩看这样子，觉得不宜于郑重的态度来谈正经，就叫阿珠说明因由。
Seeing this, Hu thought a solemn business discussion would be unsuitable and asked A’zhu to explain.


“胡老爷要挑你做老板！”阿珠用这样一句话开头，口气象是局外人，
“Mr Hu wants to make you a proprietor!” A’zhu began, in the tone of someone who had no personal interest in the matter.

接着把胡雪岩的意思，仔仔细细他说了一遍。
Then she carefully explained his proposal.

老张也是做梦都没有想到，听了妻子的话，为打听胡雪岩的信址到信和去了一趟，撞出这么一件喜事来，
Old Zhang had never dreamed that obeying his wife's instruction to visit Xinhe and inquire for Hu's address would lead to such good fortune.

不过，他也多少有些疑惑，
Yet he had doubts.

觉得事太突兀，未见得如阿珠所说的那么好。
It was all too sudden and might not be as favourable as A’zhu made it sound.

因此，他说话就有保留了，“多谢胡老爷，”他慢吞吞地，
He therefore answered cautiously. “Thank you, Mr Hu,” he said slowly.

“事情倒是件好事，
“It sounds a good opportunity.

我也有一两个丝行里的朋友，
I do have one or two friends in silk firms.

只怕我做不好。”
But I'm afraid I might not manage it properly.”

“哪个生来就会的？
“Who is born knowing everything?

老张，你听我说，
Listen, Old Zhang.

做生意第一要齐心，第二要人缘，
In business, the first thing is to work together; the second is to get on with people.

我想你人缘不坏的，
I imagine you're well liked.

只要听我话，别的我不敢说，无论如何我叫你日子比在船上过得舒服。”胡雪岩接着又说：“一个人总要想想后半世，
As long as you follow my advice, I won't promise anything else, but I'll certainly make your life more comfortable than it is on the boat.” He added, “A man must think about the latter half of his life.

弄只船飘来飘去，不是个了局！”
Drifting about in a boat for ever is no lasting arrangement.”

就这一句话，立刻打动了老张的心，
That sentence immediately touched Old Zhang.

他妻子和女儿当然更觉得动听，
His wife and daughter naturally found it even more welcome.

“胡老爷这句话，真正实在！”他妻子说，
“That's sound sense, Mr Hu!” his wife said.

“转眼五十岁的人，
“He's nearly fifty.

吃辛苦也吃不起了，
He can't go on bearing hard work for ever.

趁现在早早作个打算。
Better make plans while there's time.

我们好歹帮胡老爷把丝行开起来，叶落归根总算也有个一定的地方。”
If we can help you establish this firm, we'll at least have a fixed place to return to, like leaves falling back to their roots.”


“不是你们帮我开丝行！”
“You aren't helping me open a silk firm.

是我帮你们开丝行。“胡雪岩很郑重地，”
I'm helping you open one,” Hu said firmly.

既然你们有丝行里的朋友，那再好不过。
“And if you already have friends in the trade, so much the better.

老张，我倒先要问你，开丝行要多少本钱？
First, Old Zhang, how much capital would it take?”

““那要看丝行大小。
“That depends on the size.

一个门面，一副生财，两三百两银子现款，替客户代代手，
A shopfront, some fittings, and two or three hundred taels in ready money would let you act as an intermediary for customers.

也是丝行，
That's a silk firm.

自己买了丝囤在那里，专等客户上门，也是丝行。”
Buying silk yourself, holding it in stock, and waiting for customers to come—that's a silk firm too.”

“照这样说，有一千两银子可以开了？”
“Then a thousand taels would be enough to begin?”

“一千两银子本钱，也不算小同行了。”
“With a thousand taels, you wouldn't count as one of the smaller firms.”

“那好！”胡雪岩把视线扫过他们夫妻父女，最后落在老张脸上，
“Good!” Hu looked round at the couple and their daughter, finally fixing his gaze on Old Zhang.

“我不说送，
“I won't call it a gift.

我借一千两银子给你！
I'll lend you a thousand taels.

你开丝行，我托你买丝。
You open the firm, and I'll commission you to buy silk.

一千两银子不要利息，
There'll be no interest on the thousand.

等你赚了钱就还我。
Repay me when you've made a profit.

你看好不好？”
How does that sound?”


“那怎么不好？”老张答道：
“How could it be anything but good?” Old Zhang answered.

“不过，胡老爷，做生意有赚有蚀，
“But, Mr Hu, business can make losses as well as profits.

万一本钱蚀光了怎么办？”
What if I lose the whole capital?”

“真正是！”他妻子大为不满，
“Really!” His wife was indignant.

“生意还没有做，先说不识头的话。”
“You haven't even begun, and already you're saying unlucky things.”

“不！干娘，”胡雪岩却很欣赏老张的态度，
“No, Auntie.” Hu approved of Old Zhang's attitude.

“做生意就是要这个样子。
“That's exactly how one ought to approach business.

顾前不顾后，一门心里想赚，那种生意做不好的。
You won't succeed if you look only ahead, neglect what lies behind, and think of nothing but profit.

这样，老张，我劝你这条船不要卖，
Here is my advice, Old Zhang: don't sell this boat.

租了给人家，
Hire it out.

万一丝行‘倒灶’，你还可以靠船租过日子。
If the silk firm fails, you can still live on the rent.”

“老张怔怔地不作声，
Old Zhang stared without speaking.

他有些心不在焉，
His attention had wandered.

奇怪“胡老爷”怎么一下子叫她妻子为“干娘”？
Why had Mr Hu suddenly begun calling his wife “Auntie”?


“爹！”阿珠推着他说：
“Father!” A’zhu nudged him.

“人家在跟你说话？
“He's talking to you!

你在想啥心事？”
What are you thinking about?”

“喔，喔！”老张定定神，才把胡雪岩的话记起来，
“Oh, yes!” Old Zhang collected himself and recalled what Hu had said.

“胡老爷，”他说：“今年总来不及了！”
“Mr Hu, surely it's too late for this year.”

“怎么呢？”
“Why?”

“开丝行要领牙帖，
“A silk firm needs a broker's licence.

听说要京里发下来，
I hear it has to come from the capital.

一来一往，最快也要三个月工夫，
Sending the application and getting it back takes at least three months.

那时候收丝的辰光早过了。”
By then the silk-buying season will be long past.”

“收丝也有季节的吗？”
“Does buying silk have a season too?”

“自然罗！”阿珠的娘笑了，
“Naturally!” A’zhu's mother laughed.

“胡老爷，你连这点都不明白？”
“You don't even know that, Mr Hu?”

“隔行如隔山。
“Different trades are worlds apart.

我从来没有经手过这行生意。
I've never handled this business.

不过。”胡雪岩说，“我倒想起来了，钱庄放款给做丝生意的，总在四、五月里。”
Though,” he added, “now I remember: bank loans to silk merchants are always made in the fourth and fifth months.”

“是啊，
“Exactly.

新丝四、五月里上市，都想早早脱手，
The new silk comes on the market then, and everyone wants to sell quickly.

第一，乡下五荒六月，青黄不接的当口，都等铜钿用。
First, the lean fifth and sixth months fall between harvests, and people in the countryside are waiting for money.

第二，雪白的丝，摆在家里黄了，价钱就要打折扣，
Second, if snow-white silk lies at home until it yellows, its price falls.

也有的想摆一摆，等价钱好了再卖，也不过多等个把月。
Some people hold on for a better price, but even they wait only another month or so.

丝行生意多是一年做一季。“
Most silk firms do their year's business in a single season.”


胡雪岩听得这话踌躇了，因为他有一套算盘，
This made Hu hesitate, for he had a plan of his own.

王有龄一到湖州，公款解省，当然由他阜康代理“府库”来收支，
Once Wang arrived in Huzhou, Fukang would naturally handle the prefectural treasury's receipts and payments, including public funds to be remitted to the provincial capital.

他的打算是，在湖州收到的现银，就地买丝，运到杭州脱手变现，解交“藩库”，
Hu intended to use the silver received in Huzhou to buy silk there, ship it to Hangzhou, sell it for cash, and pay the money into the provincial treasury.

这是无本钱的生意，
It was business requiring no capital of his own.

变戏法不可让外人窥见底蕴，所以他愿意帮老张开丝行。
Outsiders must not see how this conjuring trick worked; that was why he was willing to help Old Zhang open a silk firm.

现在听说老张的丝行一时开不成功，买丝运杭州的算盘就打不通了。
Now, if the firm could not be established immediately, his plan to buy silk and ship it to Hangzhou would fail.


“有这样一个办法，”他问老张：
“What about this?” he asked Old Zhang.

“我们跟人家顶一张，或者租一张牙帖来做。
“We take over someone else's licence, or rent one.

你看行不行？”
Would that work?”

“这个办法，听倒也听人说过。
“I've heard of it being done.

就不知道要花多少钱？
But I don't know what it would cost.

就不定顶一年就要三五面两银子！”
Perhaps three or five hundred taels just for a year!”

“三五百两就三五百两。”胡雪岩说，
“Then let it be three or five hundred,” Hu said.

“小钱不去，大钱不来！
“You can't make big money without spending a little.

老张，你明天就到湖州去办这件事！”
Go to Huzhou tomorrow and arrange it!”

想到就做，何至于如此性急？
Why such haste to act the instant an idea occurred?

而且一切都还茫无头绪，
Nothing was clear yet.

到了湖州又如何着手？
How were they to begin once they reached Huzhou?

所以老张和他妻儿，都不知如何作答。
Old Zhang, his wife, and his daughter all found themselves at a loss.

“胡老爷，”还是阿珠的娘有主意，“我看这样，王大老爷上任，你索性送了去，
Again it was A’zhu's mother who produced an idea. “Mr Hu, why don't you accompany Mr Wang when he takes up his post?

一船摇到湖州就地办事，
We could row straight to Huzhou and deal with things there.

你在那里，凡事可以作主，事情就妥当了。”
With you on the spot to decide everything, it would all go smoothly.”

“妥当是妥当，却有两层难处，
“It would, but there are two difficulties.

第一，大家都知道王大老爷跟我，与众不同，
First, everyone knows how close Mr Wang and I are.

我要避嫌，不便送他上任。
I must avoid appearances that might excite suspicion, so I shouldn't accompany him to his appointment.

第二，我有家钱庄，马上要开出来，
Second, I have a bank about to open.

实在分不开身。”
I really can't get away.”

“喔，胡老爷还有家钱庄？”
“Oh, you have a bank as well?”

“是的。”胡雪岩说，
“Yes,” Hu said.

“钱庄是我出面，
“I represent it publicly.

背后有大股东。”
There are major shareholders behind me.”


这一来，阿珠的娘，越发把胡雪岩看得不同了，
A’zhu's mother regarded him with still greater respect.

她看了他丈夫一眼，转脸问胡雪岩：“那么送到临平……”
She glanced at her husband, then turned back to Hu. “Then the journey to Linping...”

“那还是照旧。”胡雪岩抢着说，
“That stands as arranged,” he quickly assured her.

“明天我打一张一千两的银票，请老张带到湖州去，
“Tomorrow I'll have a banknote made out for a thousand taels, and Old Zhang can take it to Huzhou.

一面弄牙帖，一面看房子，先把门面摆开来。
He can find a licence and look for premises at the same time, getting the shop set up first.

我总在月半左右到湖州来收丝，
I should come to buy silk around the middle of the month.

我想，这船上，老张不在也不要紧吧？”
I suppose the boat can manage without Old Zhang?”

“那要什么紧？”阿珠的娘说，
“Of course it can,” she replied.

“人手不够，临时雇个短工好了。”
“If we're short of hands, we can hire someone temporarily.”

谈到这里，便有“不由分说”之势了，
By now there was little room for objections.

老张摇了几十年的船，
Old Zhang had spent decades rowing a boat.

一下子弃舟登陆，要拿着上千两银子，单枪匹马回湖州开丝行，自有些胆怯，
Suddenly to leave it, go ashore, and set out alone for Huzhou with a thousand taels to open a silk firm naturally frightened him.

但禁不住他妻儿和胡雪岩的鼓励推动，终于也有了信心，
But under the encouragement and urging of Hu, his wife, and his daughter, he at last gained confidence.

打算着一到湖州；先寻几个丝行朋友商量。
On arriving, he would first consult a few friends in the trade.

好在自己在江湖上走了几十年，
After all, he had spent decades travelling the waterways.

纵非人情险，一望而知，人品好歹总识得的，
Even if he could not recognise every danger at a glance, he could judge whether a person's character was good or bad.

只要这一层上把握得住，就不会吃亏。
As long as he held firm to that judgement, he should not be taken advantage of.


就这样兴高采烈地谈到深夜，
They talked in high spirits until late at night.

阿珠的娘又去弄了消夜来，让胡雪岩吃过。阿珠亲手替他铺好了床，
A’zhu's mother prepared a late supper for Hu, and after he had eaten, A’zhu made up his bed herself.

道声“安置”，各自归寝。
They wished one another a good night's rest and went to their separate berths.

她心里有好些话要跟他说，但总觉得半夜三更，孤男寡女在一起，是件“大逆不道”的事，
She had much she wanted to say to him, but being alone with a man in the middle of the night seemed to her a shocking impropriety.

所以万般无奈地回到了她自己的铺上。
Reluctantly, she returned to her own bed.

这一夜船上五个人，除了伙计阿四，
Of the five people aboard that night, only A’si had nothing on his mind.

其作的都有心事在想，所想的也都是开丝行的事，而且也都把阿珠连在一起想，
The other four were all thinking about the silk firm, and all connected it in their thoughts with A’zhu.

只是各人的想法不同。
Yet each saw it differently.


最高兴的是阿珠的娘，
Her mother was the happiest.

一下子消除了她心里的两个“疙瘩”，
Two knots of worry had been undone at once.

第一个疙瘩是老张快五十岁了，
First, Old Zhang was nearly fifty.

《天雨花》、《再生缘》那些唱本儿上说起来，做官的“年将半百”，便要“告老还乡”，买田买地做“老员外”享清福，
In such ballad books as Flowers Raining from Heaven and Destined to Meet Again, an official “approaching half a century” would “retire to his native place,” buy fields and land, and enjoy a comfortable old age as a country gentleman.

而他还在摇船！
Yet her husband was still rowing a boat!

现在总算叶落归根，可以有个养老送死的“家”了。
Now at last they could return to their roots and have a home in which to grow old and die.

第二个疙瘩是为了阿珠。
Her second worry concerned A’zhu.

把她嫁给胡雪岩，千肯万肯，就怕“做小”受气，
She was entirely willing for her daughter to marry Hu, but feared that as a concubine she would suffer.

虽说胡太太看样子贤慧，但“老爷”到底只有一个，
Mrs Hu seemed kind, yet there was only one husband.

这面恩恩爱爱，那面就凄凄凉凉，
When he lavished affection on one woman, the other would be left lonely.

日久天长，一定会有气淘。
Over time, resentment was inevitable.

现在把阿珠放在湖州，又不受“大的”气，自己又照顾得到，
If A’zhu stayed in Huzhou, however, she would be free of the senior wife's temper, and her mother would be there to look after her.

哪还有比这再好的安排？
Could any arrangement be better?

她一想到此，心满意足。
The thought left her perfectly content.


阿珠是比她娘想得更加美。
A’zhu imagined an even happier prospect.

她觉得嫁到胡家，淘气还在其次，
If she entered the Hu household, domestic quarrels would be the lesser concern.

“做小”这两个字，总是委屈，
The very word “concubine” meant accepting an inferior position.

难得他情深意重，想出一条“两头大”的路子来！
How devoted and thoughtful he was to have found a way of giving each of his two households a wife of equal standing!

眼前虽未明言，照他的体贴，一定是这么个打算，
He had not said so yet, but someone so considerate must have that in mind.

他现在是先要抬举她爹的身分，做了老板，才好做他的丈人。
First he would raise her father's status, making him a proprietor fit to become his father-in-law.

将来明媒正娶，自己一样凤冠霞帔，
Then she would be married openly and properly, with a matchmaker, a phoenix crown, and a ceremonial cape.

坐了花轿来“拜堂”，
She would ride in a bridal chair and perform the wedding bows like any other bride.

人家叫起来是“胡太太”，
People would call her “Mrs Hu.”

谁也不晓得自己只是“湖州的胡太太”！
No one would know she was only “the Mrs Hu in Huzhou”!


她那里一厢情愿，另一面胡雪岩也在自度得计。
While she indulged these hopes, Hu too congratulated himself on his cleverness.

帮老张开丝行，当然也有安置阿珠的意思在内。
Helping Old Zhang establish the firm was certainly intended, in part, to provide an arrangement for A’zhu.

他也相信看相算命，不过只相信一半，一半天意，一半人事，而人定可以胜天。
He believed in physiognomy and fortune-telling, though only halfway: half was destiny, half human action, and determined human effort could overcome fate.

脱运交运的当口，走不得桃花运，这话固然不错，
It was true that one should avoid romantic entanglements when passing from one phase of fortune to another.

却要看桃花运是如何走法？
Yet surely that depended on the form the entanglement took.

如果把阿珠弄回家去，倘或大小不和，三日两头吵得天翻地覆，自己哪里还有心思来做生意？
If he brought A’zhu home and wife and concubine quarrelled every few days, turning the house upside down, how could he concentrate on business?

象现在这样，等于自己在湖州开了个丝行，阿珠和她父母会尽力照应。
Under the present arrangement, it would be as though he had opened his own silk firm in Huzhou, with A’zhu and her parents doing their utmost to manage it.

自己到了湖州，当然住在丝行里，
Naturally he would stay there when he visited.

阿珠也不算大，也不算小，是个外室，
A’zhu would be neither senior wife nor household concubine, but a woman maintained in a separate establishment.

将来看情形再说，
They could decide the future as circumstances developed.

果然丝行做得发达了，阿珠就是胡家有功之人，
If the firm prospered, she would have rendered the Hu family a real service.

那时把她接回家去，自己妻子也就不好说什么了。
When he brought her home then, his wife would have little ground for objection.

他这个念头，看起来面面俱到，事事可行，
His plan seemed to cover every angle and make everything practicable.

真正是一把“职意算盘”。
It was indeed a beautifully calculated piece of wishful thinking.


但是，他再也想不到，老张的心思却变了。
What he could never have imagined was that Old Zhang's mind had changed.

他虽是摇船出身，也不识多少字，倒是个有骨气的人。
A boatman with little education he might be, but he had self-respect.

阿珠愿意嫁胡雪岩，自己肯委屈“做小”，他妻子又极力赞成，
A’zhu wished to marry Hu and was willing to accept the lesser position; her mother strongly approved.

既然母女俩一条心，他也不反对。
Since mother and daughter were united, he would not oppose them.

照他的想法，将来阿珠到了胡家，不管是大小住在一起，还是另立门户，总归是在杭州，
He had assumed that whether the two women lived together or in separate households, A’zhu would in any case be in Hangzhou.

自己做自己的生意，眼不见为净，旁人也不会说什么闲话。
He could carry on his own business, keeping out of what did not concern him, and no one would gossip.

此刻不同了。
Now it was different.

开丝行，做老板，固然是一步登天，求之下得。
Opening a silk firm and becoming a proprietor was certainly a miraculous rise, more than he could have wished for.

但旁人不免要问：“摇船的老张，怎么会一下子做了老板？”
But people would inevitably ask, “How did Old Zhang the boatman suddenly become a proprietor?”

这话谈下去就很难听了！
And what followed would be ugly.

总不能逢人去分辩：“阿珠给胡某人做小，完全是感情，阿珠自己喜欢他。
He could hardly go about explaining to everyone: “A’zhu is becoming Hu's concubine purely because she loves him.

开丝行是胡某人自己了为做生意方便，
The silk firm is for his own business convenience.

就是没有这桩亲事，他依然要开，依然要叫我出面做现成老板！
Even without the marriage, he'd still open it and still ask me to put my name to it and become the proprietor!”

“这话就算自己能够说，别人也未见得相信。
Even if he could say all this, others might not believe him.

所以他这时打定主意，开丝行与阿珠嫁胡雪岩，这两件事决不可夹杂在一起。
He therefore resolved that opening the silk firm and A’zhu's marriage to Hu must never be mixed together.


“喂！”躺在铺上的老张，推推他妻子，低声问道：
“Listen,” Old Zhang said softly, nudging his wife as they lay in their berth.

“阿珠的事，你们变过了？”
“Have you spoken about A’zhu's future?”

“没有。”
“No.”

“那‘他’怎么叫你‘干娘’？”
“Then why does he call you ‘Auntie’?”

“这是人家客气，抬举我们。”
“He's being polite and honouring us.”

“抬举是不错。
“It is an honour.

不过‘冷粥冷饭好吃，冷言冷语难听’。”
But cold rice and cold porridge are easy to swallow; cold, cutting words are not.”

“什么冷言冷语。”他妻子很诧异地问，
“What cutting words?” his wife asked in surprise.

“哪个在嚼舌头？”
“Who's been gossiping?”

“也没有人在嚼舌头。
“No one.

是我心里在想……”
It's just something I've been thinking...”

“好了，好了！”她不耐烦地打断他的话说，
“There, that's enough!” she interrupted impatiently.

“你不要得福不知！
“Don't fail to recognise good fortune when it comes!

该想想正经，
Think about what matters.

到了湖州，寻哪几个朋友，
Which friends will you look up in Huzhou?

房子看在什么地方？”
Where will you find premises?”

老张对他妻子，七分敬爱三分怕，
Old Zhang's feelings towards his wife were seven parts affection and respect, three parts fear.

听她这语气，如果自己把心里的想法就出来，当夜就会有一场大吵，
From her tone, he knew that explaining his thoughts would provoke a serious quarrel that very night.

因而隐忍未言。
He therefore kept them to himself.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（上）》第七章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume I — Chapter Seven, concluding part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


一宵无话，
The night passed without incident.

第二天一早胡雪岩起身，阿珠服侍他漱口洗脸，
Early next morning Hu rose, and A’zhu helped him wash and rinse his mouth.

由于急着要上岸办事，连点心都顾不得吃，就起身去了。
In his haste to go ashore on business, he could not even stay for breakfast.

临走留下话，中午约在盐桥一家叫“纯号”的酒店见面，又说，如果阿珠和她娘有兴致，也一道来逛逛。
Before leaving, he arranged to meet them at midday at a tavern called Chunhao, near Yan Bridge, and said that A’zhu and her mother might come along for an outing if they liked.

母女俩的兴致自然极好。
Naturally, both were delighted.

盐桥大街多的是布店和估衣店，
Yan Bridge Street had plenty of cloth shops and shops selling second-hand clothes.

阿珠跟她娘商量：“爹要做老板了，
A’zhu consulted her mother. “Father's going to be a proprietor.

总不能再穿‘短打’，
He can't go on wearing a boatman's short jacket.

先到估衣店去买件长衫，再自己剪布来做。”
Let's buy him a long gown at a second-hand shop first, then get some cloth and make him more clothes ourselves.”

“好啊！”她娘欣然同意，
“Good!” her mother agreed happily.

“我们早点去！”
“Let's go early!”

她们母女俩高高兴兴在收拾头面，预备出门。老张一个人坐在船头上闷闷不乐，
While they cheerfully dressed their hair and prepared to go out, Old Zhang sat alone in the bow, sunk in gloom.

心里在想，中午一见了面，胡雪岩当然会把银子交过来，
When they met at noon, Hu would surely hand him the money.

只要一接上手，以后再有什么话说，就显得不够味道了。
Once he accepted it, anything he might say afterwards would come too late and look bad.

要说，说在前面，或者今天先不接银子，等商量停当了再说。
He must speak first—or decline to take the money today and wait until everything had been settled.

他要跟他妻子商量，无奈有阿珠在，不便开口，
He wanted to discuss it with his wife, but with A’zhu there he could not open his mouth.

心里踌躇无计，而一妻一女倒已经头光面滑，穿上“出客”的衣服，预备动身了。
While he hesitated helplessly, mother and daughter finished making themselves immaculate, put on their visiting clothes, and stood ready to leave.


“该走了吧！”阿珠的娘催促老张。
“Time to go!” his wife urged.

“爹！”阿珠又嫌她爹土气，“你把蓝布小衫换一换，好不好，
A’zhu, too, found fault with her father's rustic appearance. “Father, will you change that little blue cotton jacket?

寿头寿脑的，
You look such a bumpkin!

真把人的台都坍光的！”
You'll disgrace us completely.”

由于宠女儿的缘故，老张一向把她这些没规没矩的话，当作耳边风。
Old Zhang spoiled his daughter and generally let her impudent remarks pass as if he had not heard them.

但话虽不理，该有行动，
Still, even if he ignored her words, he ought to have done something.

而他望着她们母女，怔怔地好象灵魂出窍了似的，好半天不开口。
Instead he stared at the two of them as though his soul had left his body, remaining silent for a long time.

“呀！”他妻子不胜讶异地：
“Why!” his wife exclaimed in astonishment.

“怎的？”
“What's the matter?”

老张摇摇头，接着说了句：“你们娘儿俩去好了。
He shook his head, then said, “You two go.

我不去了。”
I'm staying here.”

“咦！为啥？”
“Why ever not?”

老张想了想说：“我要帮阿四把船摇回万安桥去。”
After a moment's thought, he answered, “I have to help A’si take the boat back to Wan'an Bridge.”

这是不成理由的理由，
It was no excuse at all.

阿珠和她娘的脸上，顿时象眼前的天气一样，阴睛不定了。
The expressions on mother and daughter changed as quickly as the uncertain weather outside.

“你在想什么古里古怪的心思？”阿珠娘脸板得一丝笑容都没有，眼圈都有些红了，
“What strange notions have you got into your head now?” His wife's face lost every trace of a smile, and her eyes reddened.

“生来是吃苦的命！
“You were born to toil!

好日子还没有过一天，就要‘作’了！”
You haven't enjoyed a single comfortable day yet, and already you're making trouble for yourself!”

“作”是杭州话，通常只用来骂横也不是，竖也不是，不讨人喜欢的孩子，
The Hangzhou expression she used normally described a tiresome child who was dissatisfied whichever way things went.

用来责备老张，便有“自作孽、不可活”的意思，
Applied to Old Zhang, it carried the sharper implication that he was bringing his own ruin upon himself.

话重而怨深，
Her words were harsh and her resentment deep.

他不能不做个比较明白的表示了。
He had to make his position somewhat clearer.


“你不要一门心里只想自己！”他说，
“Don't think of nobody but yourself,” he said.

“人家白花花一千两银子，不是小数目，
“A thousand taels of good silver is no trifling sum.

把它蚀光了怎么办？”
What happens if we lose it all?”

“你啊，
“You!

‘树叶儿掉下来怕打开头’，
You'd fear a falling leaf might split your head!

生意还没有做，开口闭口蚀本！
You haven't begun trading, and all you can talk about is losses.

照我这样子说，一辈子摇船好了，
If that's the way you look at it, you might as well spend your whole life rowing.

摇到七老八十，一口气不来，棺材都用不着买，
Row till you're seventy or eighty, and when you draw your last breath we needn't even buy a coffin.

往河里一推，喂鱼拉倒！
Just push you into the river and let the fish have you!”

“爹娘吵架，遇到紧要关头，阿珠总是站在她爹这面，
Whenever her parents quarrelled, A’zhu sided with her father at the critical moment.

这时便埋怨着说：“娘！
Now she protested, “Mother!

何苦说这些话？
Why say such things?

爹不肯去，让他不去好了。”
If Father doesn't want to go, let him stay.”

“对！”阿珠的娘真的生气了，
“Very well!” Her mother was truly angry.

“枉为他是一家之主。
“Some head of the family he is!

我们敬他，他不受敬，
We give him his due and he won't accept it.

随他去，
Let him please himself.

我们走！”
We're going!”

听得这负气的话，阿珠又觉得不安，
This angry declaration troubled A’zhu in turn.

想了想只好这样说：“怎么走？
After thinking for a moment, she could only ask, “How are we to get there?

路好远到那里。”
It's such a long walk.”

路不但好远，而且郊野小径，泥泞不堪，
Besides the distance, the country paths were deep in mud.

就能走进城，一又脚上的鞋袜亦已不成样子，
Even if they managed to walk into town, their shoes and stockings would be a sorry sight.

不过，这也难不倒她娘，
This did not defeat her mother, however.

高声喊道：“阿四，阿四！”
“A’si! A’si!” she shouted.

“阿四到万安桥去了。”老张说。
“A’si's gone to Wan'an Bridge,” Old Zhang answered.

亏得他接了这句口，局面才不致僵持，
Fortunately, this reply prevented a complete deadlock.

他妻子气消了些，声音却依旧很大，
His wife's anger subsided a little, though her voice remained loud.

“我们今天把话说说清楚，
“We'll have this out today.

你到底是怎么个意思？”
Just what do you mean?”


“等下再说。”老张这样回答，一面看了阿珠一眼。
“We'll talk about it later,” Old Zhang replied, with a glance at A’zhu.

这一下她们母女俩都懂了他的意思，
Both women now understood.

阿珠有些羞，有些恼，更有些焦忧，
A’zhu felt embarrassed, annoyed, and, above all, anxious.

看爹这神气，事情怕要变卦。
Judging by her father's expression, their plans might fall through.

“阿珠！
“A’zhu!

你到后面去看看，炖在炉子上的蹄筋，
Go and look at the tendons stewing on the stove.

怕要加水了。”
They may need more water.”

借这个因由把她支使了开去，夫妻俩凑在一起谈私话。
Having sent her daughter away on this pretext, his wife drew close to him for a private conversation.

老张第一句话就问：“人家姓胡的，对阿珠到底是怎么个主意？你倒说说看！”
His very first question was, “Tell me this: what exactly does that fellow Hu intend to do about A’zhu?”

“何用我说？
“Why ask me?

你还看不出来？”
Can't you see for yourself?”

“我怎么看不出？
“Of course I can.

不过昨天看得出，
Or I could yesterday.

今天看不出了。”
Today I'm not so sure.”

“这叫什么话？”
“What do you mean by that?”

“我问你，”老张想了想说，“他到底是要做丝生意，是要我们阿珠，还是两样都要？”
He considered, then asked, “Does he want to trade in silk, does he want our A’zhu, or does he want both?”

“自然两样都要。”
“Both, naturally.”

“他要两样，我只好做一样，
“He may want both, but I'll agree to only one.

他要我们阿珠，开丝行请他去请教别人，
If he wants our A’zhu, let him find someone else to run his silk firm.

要我替他做伙计来出面，娶阿珠的事就免谈。”
If he wants me to work for him and act as its proprietor, there can be no question of his marrying her.”

“这为啥？”他妻子睁大了眼问，
“Why?” she demanded, her eyes widening.

“你倒说个道理我听听看。”
“Give me one good reason.”

他的道理就是不愿意让人笑他，靠裙带上拖出一个老板来做，
His reason was that he would not let people laugh at him for becoming a proprietor through his daughter's skirts.

“一句话，”他很认真地说，“我贫虽贫，还不肯担个卖女儿的名声！”
“In a word,” he said earnestly, “poor I may be, but I won't have a name for selling my daughter!”

人人要脸，树树要皮！
Every person had a reputation to protect, just as every tree had its bark.

他妻子在想，也不能说他的话没有道理。
His wife could not say he had no grounds for his objection.

但事难两全，只好劝他委屈些。
But since they could not have everything, she could only urge him to swallow his pride a little.


“你脾气也不要这么倔，
“Don't be so stubborn.

各人自扫门前雪，
Everyone has enough to do sweeping the snow from his own doorstep.

没有哪家来管我们的闲事。”
Nobody will meddle in our affairs.”

“没有？”老张使劲摇着头，
“Nobody?” Old Zhang shook his head vigorously.

“你女人家，
“You're a woman.

难得到茶坊酒肆，听不到。
You seldom visit teahouses or taverns, so you don't hear what people say.

我外头要跑跑的，
I have to go about outside.

叫人家背后指指点点，我还好过日子？
How am I to live with people pointing at me behind my back?

好了，好了，
Enough, enough!”

“他越想越不妥，
The more he thought about it, the more intolerable it seemed.

大声说道：”我主意打定了。
He raised his voice. “I've made up my mind.

你如果一定不肯依我，我也有我的办法。
If you absolutely refuse to listen, I have a way of dealing with it.”

““什么办法？”她不安地问。
“What way?” she asked uneasily.

“丝行你去开，
“You run the silk firm.

算老板也好，算老板娘也好，
Call yourself the proprietor or the proprietor's wife, as you please.

我不管。
I shan't interfere.

我还是去做我的老本行，做一天吃一天，
I'll go back to my old trade, working each day for my daily bread.

有生意到了湖州，我来看你们娘儿两个。”
Whenever business takes me to Huzhou, I'll come and see you and our daughter.”


听他这番异想天开的话，居然说得象煞有介事，她失笑了，
He spoke of this fantastic scheme so seriously that she could not help laughing.

便故意这样问：“那么，你算是来做客人？”
“So you'll be coming as a visitor?” she asked deliberately.

“是啊！
“Yes.

做客人。”
As a visitor.”

“照这样说，你是没良心把我休掉了？”
“In that case, you've no conscience: you're casting me off?”

虽是半带玩笑，这“没良心”三个字，在老张听来就是劈脸一个耳光，
She was half joking, but the accusation struck him like a slap across the face.

顿时觉得脸上火辣辣地，极力分辩着：“怎么说我没良心？
His cheeks burned as he protested, “How can you say I've no conscience?

你不好冤枉我！”
You mustn't accuse me unjustly!”

“我没有冤枉你！
“I'm not accusing you unjustly.

如果你有良心，就算为我受委屈，好不好呢？”
If you have a conscience, can't you put up with a little humiliation for my sake?”

他不作声了，
He fell silent.

她看得出，自己真的要这么做，也可以做得到，
She could see that, if she insisted, she could have her way.

但是他嘴上不说，心里不愿，到底是夫归的情分，
But he would submit without agreeing in his heart, and they were husband and wife, after all.

何苦如此？
Why make him suffer?

想想还是要把他说得心甘情愿，
Better to persuade him to accept willingly.

这件事才算“落胃”。
Only then would the matter sit comfortably with them both.


于是她想着想着，跟她女儿想到一条路上去了，
As she thought it over, she reached the same conclusion as her daughter.

“这样行不行呢？”她说，
“Would this do?” she asked.

“你无非怕人家背后说闲话，
“All you're afraid of is gossip behind your back.

如果人家在湖州照样请过客，见过礼，算是他在湖州的一房家小，
Suppose he gives a proper wedding feast in Huzhou, observes the ceremonies, and establishes her as his wife there.

这总没有话说了吧？”
Surely there could be no objection then?”

见他妻子让步，他自然也要让步，
Since his wife had yielded a little, he must do the same.

点点头：“照这样子还差不多。”
He nodded. “That would be more like it.”

“那好了，
“Good.

我来想法子。
I'll find a way.

萝卜吃一截剥一截，眼前的要紧事先做。
Peel a radish a piece at a time as you eat it; let's deal with what's urgent first.

你换换衣裳，我们也好走了。
Change your clothes so that we can go.”

“老张换好一套出客穿的短衣，黑鞋白袜扎脚裤，上身一件直贡呢的夹袄。
Old Zhang changed into a short outfit he kept for visits: black shoes, white stockings, trousers tied at the ankles, and a lined jacket of fine woollen cloth.

正好阿四划了一只小船，买菜回来，
Just then A’si returned in a small boat with the provisions he had bought.

留他看船，老张自己把他妻儿划到盐桥上岸，
Leaving him to watch the larger vessel, Old Zhang rowed his wife and daughter to Yan Bridge himself.

从河下走上熙熙攘攘的盐桥大街。
They landed and climbed from the waterside to the crowded street.


水上生涯的人家，难得到这条肩摩毂击的大街上来，
Families who lived on the water seldom visited this busy thoroughfare, where shoulders brushed and carriage wheels almost touched.

阿珠颇有目迷五色之感，
A’zhu was dazzled by everything around her.

顾上不顾下，高一脚，低一脚地不小心踩着了一块活动的青石板，
Looking up without watching her feet, she stumbled on an uneven stretch and stepped on a loose stone slab.

泥浆迸溅，弄脏了新上身的一条雪青百褶裙，
Mud splashed up and stained the new mauve pleated skirt she was wearing.

于是失声而喊，顿时引得路人侧目而视。
Her involuntary cry made the passers-by turn to look.

“唷，唷，
“Careful, careful!

走路要当心！”
Watch where you're going!”

有个二十来岁的油头光棍，仿佛好意来扶她，趁势在她膀子捏了一把。
A sleek-haired loafer in his twenties pretended to help her, taking the opportunity to pinch her arm.

阿珠涨红了脸，
Her face flamed.

使劲把膀子一甩，用力过猛，一甩上去，正好打了他一个反手耳光，其声清脆无比。
She flung her arm away so violently that the back of her hand caught his face with a resounding slap.

“唷，
“Oh!

好凶！”
What a fierce one!”

有人吃惊，也有人发笑。
Some bystanders exclaimed in surprise; others laughed.

这一下使得被误打了的人，面子上越发下不来，
This made it still harder for the man to save face.

一手捂着脸，跳脚大骂。
Clutching his cheek, he stamped and cursed.

阿珠和她娘吓得面色发白。
A’zhu and her mother turned pale.

老张一看闯了祸，赶紧上前陪笑道歉：“对不起，对不起，
Seeing trouble, Old Zhang hurried forward, smiling apologetically. “I'm sorry, I'm sorry!

无心的！”
It was an accident!”


杭州人以掴脸为奇耻大辱，特别是让妇女打了，认为是“晦气”，
In Hangzhou a slap on the face was considered a terrible disgrace, and to be struck by a woman was thought particularly unlucky.

而那个油头光混又是杭州人所谓“撩鬼儿”的小流氓，事态使越发严重了，
The sleek-haired fellow was also one of the petty street ruffians known locally as liaoguier, which made matters worse.

立刻便有五六个同党围了上来。
Five or six companions immediately surrounded them.

其中一个一面口沫横飞地辱骂，一面劈胸一把将老张的衣服抓住，伸出拳来就要打。
One seized Old Zhang's clothing at the chest, showering him with abuse, and raised his fist.

“打不得，打不得！
“Don't hit him! Don't hit him!

有话好讲。”阿珠的娘大喊。
We can talk this over!” A’zhu's mother cried.

“讲你娘的……”一拳伸了过来，
“Talk to your bloody mother—” A fist shot out.

老张接住，
Old Zhang caught it.

下面一腿又到，老张又避开，
A kick followed, and he dodged.

他打过几个月的拳，也练过“仙人担”，抛过“石锁”，
He had trained in boxing for several months, practised with a weighted carrying pole, and tossed stone exercise weights.

两条膀子上有一两百斤力气，这五六个人还应付得了，
His arms had the strength to lift a hundred or two hundred jin, and he could have dealt with these five or six men.

不过一则是自己的理屈，再则为人忠厚，不愿打架，
But he felt that his side was in the wrong, and his honest, peaceable nature made him unwilling to fight.

所以只是躲避告饶。
He merely ducked and pleaded.

拉拉扯扯，身上已经着了两下，还是趁火打劫的，挨挨蹭蹭来轻薄阿珠，
In the scuffle he took two blows, while others used the confusion to crowd against A’zhu and molest her.

就在这她眼泪都快要掉来来的当儿，来了个救星。
She was on the verge of tears when a rescuer appeared.


“三和尚！
“Third Monk!

啥事体？”
What's going on?”

叫得出名字就好办了，那人手上的劲，立刻就松。
The fact that the newcomer knew a name made all the difference: the man immediately relaxed his grip.

阿珠的娘如逢大赦，
A’zhu's mother felt as though she had been reprieved.

赶紧抢上来说：“张老板，
She hurried forward. “Mr Zhang!

张老板，
Mr Zhang!

请你来说一句！
Please say a word for us!

本来没事……”“没事？”
There was nothing to begin with—” “Nothing?”

被打的那人也要抢着来做原告，指着阿珠说：“张老板，请你老人家评评理看，
The man who had been slapped also rushed to present his complaint, pointing at A’zhu. “Mr Zhang, you judge for yourself!

我看她要惯倒，好意扶她一把，
I thought she was about to fall and kindly tried to help her.

哪晓得她撩起一个嘴巴！
Who'd have expected her to slap me across the mouth?

端午脚边，晦气不晦气？
With the Dragon Boat Festival so close, isn't that a fine piece of bad luck?”

“张胖子肚里雪亮，自然是调戏人家，有取打之道，
Fat Zhang understood perfectly: the fellow had been pestering the girl and had brought it on himself.

而心里却有些好笑，故意问道：“阿珠，你怎么出手就打人？”
He was rather amused, however, and deliberately asked, “A’zhu, why did you hit him?”

一听他叫得出阿珠的名字，原是熟人，抓住老张的那个人，不自觉地就把手松开了。
Hearing him address her by name, the man holding Old Zhang realised that they knew one another and instinctively let go.

又羞又窘，脸色象块红布样的阿珠，这才算放了心，
A’zhu, blushing scarlet with embarrassment, felt safe at last.

得理不让人，挺起了胸说，“我也不是存心打他，
Sure of her ground, she straightened up. “I didn't mean to hit him.

是他自己不好。”
It was his own fault.”

“好了，好了！”她娘赶紧拦她，
“All right, all right!” her mother hastily intervened.

“你也少说一句。”
“You needn't say any more.”

“看我面子！
“Let it pass for my sake.

是我侄女儿。”张老板对被打的那人说，
She's my niece,” Zhang told the injured party.

“等下我请你们吃老酒。”
“I'll buy you all a drink later.”

一场看来不可开交的纠纷，就此片言而决。
A quarrel that had seemed impossible to resolve was settled in a few words.

老张夫妇向张胖子谢了又谢，
Old Zhang and his wife thanked him again and again.

阿珠心里却是连自己都辨不出的滋味，仿佛觉得扫兴，又仿佛觉得安慰，站在旁边不开口。
A’zhu stood silent beside them, unable to define her own feelings: she seemed both disappointed and reassured.

“这里不是说话之处。”张胖子说，
“This is no place to talk,” Fat Zhang said.

“你们不是约了在‘纯号’碰头？
“Aren't you meeting at Chunhao?

喏，那里就是。“
Look, there it is.”


纯号这家酒店，出名的是绍烧。
Chunhao was famous for its Shaoxing spirits.

双开间门面，一半为一座曲尺形的柜台所隔断，柜台很高，
Its shopfront was two bays wide, half the space taken up by a high, L-shaped counter.

上面放着许多直径一尺多的大瓷盘，盛着客种下酒菜，从最起码的发芽豆到时鲜海货，有十来样之多。
On this stood large porcelain dishes more than a foot across, holding a dozen or so foods to accompany a drink, from humble sprouted beans to fresh seafood in season.

这时已有好些人在吃“柜台酒”，
A number of customers were already drinking at the counter.

菜市上的小贩，盐桥河下的脚伕，早市已毕，到这里来寻些乐趣，一碗绍烧、一碟小菜，倚柜而立，吃完走路，
The market stallholders and the porters from the Yan Bridge waterfront had finished their morning's work and come to enjoy themselves: a bowl of spirits, a small dish, a brief rest leaning against the counter, and away again.

其中不少是老张的熟人，
Several knew Old Zhang.

看到他穿得整整齐齐，带着妻子女儿在一起，不免有一番问询。
Seeing him neatly dressed with his wife and daughter, they naturally had questions to ask.

等他应付完了，张胖子和两个“堂客”，已经在里面落座了。
By the time he had dealt with them, Fat Zhang and the two ladies were seated inside.

里面是雅座，
This inner room had more comfortable seating.

八仙桌子只坐了两面，阿珠和她母亲合坐一张条凳。
Only two sides of their square table were occupied, A’zhu and her mother sharing a bench.

老张来了，又占一面，留着上首的座位给胡雪岩。
Old Zhang took a third side, leaving the place of honour for Hu.

“真碰得巧！”张胖子说，
“What a lucky encounter!” Fat Zhang said.

“我也是雪岩约我在这里，
“Xueyan asked me to meet him here too.

他一早到我店里来过了，
He came to the bank first thing this morning.

现在回局里有事，等一下就来，
He's gone back to the bureau on business and will be here shortly.

我们一面吃，一面等。”于是呼酒叫菜，喝着谈着。
Let's eat while we wait.” They ordered food and wine and talked over their drinks.

“堂客”上酒店是不大有的事，阿珠又长得惹眼，
Respectable women seldom entered taverns, and A’zhu was striking enough to attract still more attention.

所以里里外外都不免要探头张望一番，
People kept craning their necks from both inside and outside.

她又局促又有些得意，但心里只盼望着胡雪岩。
She felt awkward and a little pleased, but all she really wanted was for Hu to arrive.


胡雪岩终于来了。
At last he did.

等他一入座，张胖子便谈阿珠误打了“撩鬼儿”的趣事，因为排解了这场纠纷，他显得很得意地。
As soon as he sat down, Fat Zhang related the entertaining story of her accidental blow to the street ruffian, plainly proud of having settled the dispute.

“阿珠！”胡雪岩听完了笑道：
“A’zhu!” Hu laughed when he had heard it.

“我们还不知道你这么厉害。”
“We never knew you were such a terror.”

听他的口气，当她是“雌老虎”，阿珠便红着脸分辩：“他是有心的，
Feeling that he was calling her a tigress, she flushed and protested, “He did it on purpose.

大街上动手动脚象啥样子？
What business had he putting his hands on me in the street?

我一急一甩，打到他脸上，
I panicked and flung my arm away, and it caught his face.

什么厉害不厉害？
What has that to do with being a terror?

厉害也不会让人欺侮了！”
If I were such a terror, nobody would bully me!”

胡雪岩笑笑不响。
Hu merely smiled.

张胖子听她对胡雪岩说话的态度，心里明白，两个人已到了不需客气、无话不谈的地步，
From the way she spoke to him, Fat Zhang saw that they had reached a stage where ceremony was unnecessary and nothing need go unsaid.

不妨开个玩笑。
A joke would do no harm.


“老张，”他把视线落在阿珠和她娘脸上，“什么时候请我吃喜酒？”
“Old Zhang,” he began, looking at A’zhu and her mother, “when are you inviting me to the wedding feast?”

老张无从置答，
Old Zhang had no answer.

阿珠羞得低下了头，她娘却正要拜托张胖子，随即笑滋滋地答道：“这要看张老板！”
A’zhu lowered her head in embarrassment, but her mother had been hoping to ask Fat Zhang for help and answered with a broad smile, “That depends on you, Mr Zhang!”

“咦！
“Why!

关我什么事？”
What have I to do with it?”

阿珠的娘话到口边，又改了一句：“张老板府上在哪里？
She checked the words on her lips and said instead, “Where do you live, Mr Zhang?

我做两样菜请张老板、张太太尝尝。”
I'd like to prepare a couple of dishes for you and Mrs Zhang.”

在座的人只有胡雪岩懂她的意思，是要托张胖子出来做媒，
Hu alone understood that she meant to ask Fat Zhang to act as matchmaker.

心想透过熟人来谈这件事也好，便提醒张胖子：“只怕有事情托你！”
It would be a good thing to discuss the matter through someone they knew, he thought, and prompted him: “Perhaps she has something to ask of you.”

“喔！
“Oh!

喔！”
Oh!”

张胖子会意了“我住在‘石塔儿头’到底，
Understanding at last, Fat Zhang replied, “I live right at the end of Stone Pagoda Street.

碰鼻头转弯，‘塞然弄堂’，
When you can't go any farther, turn into Sairan Lane.

坐北朝南倒数第二家。”
It's the second house from the end, facing south.”

这个地址一口气说下来，仿佛说绕口令似地，阿珠忍不住“扑哧”一声笑了出来。
Rattled off in a single breath, the address sounded so like a tongue-twister that A’zhu burst out laughing.


张胖子又逗着阿珠说了些笑话，适可而止，然后把话锋一转。
He teased her a little more, stopped before the jokes went too far, and then changed the subject.

看着胡雪岩说：“我们谈正经吧！”
Looking at Hu, he said, “Let's get down to our business.”

一听他用“我们”二字，便知湖州的丝生意，张胖子也有份。
That word “our” showed that he, too, had a share in the Huzhou silk venture.

胡雪岩已经跟他谈妥当了，
Hu had already settled matters with him.

目前先由信和在湖州的联号恒利钱店放款买丝，
For the present, Hengli Bank, Xinhe's affiliated establishment in Huzhou, would lend the money to buy silk.

除了照市拆息以外，答应将来在盈余中提两成作为张胖子个人的好处。
Besides paying interest at the prevailing market rate, Hu had promised Fat Zhang personally twenty per cent of the eventual profits.

他愿意出这样优厚的条件，一则是为了融通资金方便，其次是他自己怕照顾不到，希望张胖子能替他分劳，再有一层就是交情了，
He offered such generous terms partly to make financing easy, partly because he feared he could not supervise everything himself and hoped Zhang would share the burden, and partly out of friendship.

信和钱庄虽然做着了海运局的生意，但张胖子自己没有什么利益，
Xinhe Bank had gained the Sea Transport Bureau's business, but Fat Zhang had made nothing personally from it.

胡雪岩借这个机会“ 挑”他赚几文。
Hu was using this opportunity to give him a chance to earn something.


“老张！
“Old Zhang!

我今天有两件事交代你，
There are two things I want to settle with you today.

第一，一千两银子在这里，
First, here are the thousand taels.

你收好。”
Keep them safe.”

说着，胡雪岩取出一个毛巾包来，打开来看，
Hu produced a bundle wrapped in a towel and opened it.

里面是五百两一张的两张银票，
Inside were two banknotes for five hundred taels each.

“张老板那里出的票子，
“Mr Zhang's bank issued these.

在湖州恒利照兑。”
Hengli in Huzhou will honour them.”

“恒利在城隍庙前。”张胖子说，
“Hengli is in front of the City God Temple,” Fat Zhang added.

“老张，你在那里立个折子好了，
“Open a passbook account there, Old Zhang.

随用随提，
You can withdraw whatever you need as you need it.

方便得很。”
Very convenient.”

“是的。”老张很吃力地回答。
“Yes,” Old Zhang answered with difficulty.

“第二件，张老板荐了个朋友替你做帮手……”“噢！”老张很高兴地抢着说，
“Second, Mr Zhang has recommended someone to help you—” “Oh!” Old Zhang interrupted gladly.

“那就好！
“That's excellent!

我就怕一个人‘没脚蟹’似地，摆布不开。”
I was afraid I'd be like a crab without legs, unable to manage on my own.”


“不过，老张，有一层你一定要弄清楚。”胡雪岩看一看张胖子，很郑得地说：
“But there's one thing you must understand clearly.” Hu glanced at Fat Zhang and spoke with great seriousness.

“丝行是你开，主意要你自己拿，
“It's your silk firm, and you must make the decisions.

荐来的人给你做伙计，
The person recommended to you will be your employee.

凡事他听你，不是你听他。
He takes his orders from you, not the other way round.

这话我今天要当着张老板交代清楚。”
I want to make that clear today in Mr Zhang's presence.”

“不错，不错。”张胖子接口说道：
“Quite right, quite right,” Fat Zhang agreed.

“那个小伙子姓李，
“The young fellow's surname is Li.

是我的晚辈亲戚，人是蛮能干的，丝行生意也懂，
He's a younger relative of mine, quite capable, and he understands the silk trade.

不过年轻贪玩，
But he's young and fond of amusement.

要托你多管管他。”
I'll rely on you to keep him in order.”

老张把他们两个人的话体味了一遍，点点头说：“生意归生意，朋友归朋友，
Old Zhang considered what both men had said, then nodded. “Business is business, friendship is friendship.

我晓得了。”
I understand.”

“对啊！”胡雪岩很欣慰地说，
“Exactly!” Hu said, greatly pleased.

“老张，你说得出这一句话，生意一定会做得好。
“If you can say that, Old Zhang, you're bound to do well.

尽管放手去做！
Go ahead with confidence!

还有一句话，你一到湖州，马上就要寻个内行，眼光要好，人要靠得住，
And one more thing: as soon as you reach Huzhou, find an experienced man with a good eye whom you can trust.

薪水不妨多送，
Don't begrudge him a generous salary.

一分价钱一分货，用人也是一样的。”
You get what you pay for, and that's as true of hiring people as of anything else.”

老张受了鼓舞，大有领会，不断点头，
Encouraged, Old Zhang nodded repeatedly, understanding much that had been unclear.

“那么，这位姓李的朋友，我们什么时候见见面？”他问。
“When shall we meet this Mr Li?” he asked.

“吃完了到我店里去。”张胖子答道，

“我派人把他去叫了来见你。”
“I'll send for him to meet you.”


因为有许多正经事要办，这一顿酒草草终场，
With so much serious business to attend to, they brought the meal to a hurried end.

出了纯号，分成两拨，
Outside Chunhao the party divided.

张胖子带着老张到信和，阿珠和她娘到估衣铺去替老张办“行头”。
Fat Zhang took Old Zhang to Xinhe, while A’zhu and her mother went to a second-hand clothes shop to equip him for his new role.

剩下胡雪岩一个，
That left Hu.

阿珠总以为他一定也到信和，谁知他愿意跟她们做一路。
A’zhu had assumed that he would go to the bank too, but to her surprise he preferred to accompany the women.

这是求之不得的事，阿珠心里十分高兴，
Nothing could have pleased her more.

不过在大街上不肯跟他走在一起，
Yet she would not walk beside him in the street.

搀扶着她娘故意远远地落在后面。
Taking her mother's arm, she deliberately lagged well behind.

胡雪岩却是有心要计阿珠的好，走到一家大布庄门口，站住了脚等她们。
Hu, intent on pleasing her, stopped outside a large cloth shop to wait for them.

“这里我很熟，
“I know this place well.

包定不会吃亏。
I guarantee you won't be cheated.

要剪些什么料子，尽量挑，
Choose whatever cloth you want.

难得上街一趟，用不着委屈自己。”
You don't often come shopping, so don't stint yourselves.”

越是他这么说，她们母女俩越不青让他破费，
The more he urged them, the less willing they were to put him to expense.

略略点缀了一下，便算了事。
They selected only a few modest additions and would have stopped there.

胡雪岩要替她们多剪，
Hu wanted them to buy more.

口口声声：“干娘这块料子好”、
“Auntie, this is a lovely piece,” he kept saying.

“这块颜色阿珠可以穿”，
“That colour would suit A’zhu.”

但那母女俩无论如何不要，
But neither would agree.

为了不肯直说“舍不得你多花钱”这句话，阿珠便故意挑剔那些衣料，不是颜色不好，就是花样过时，不然就是“门面”太狭，下水会缩之类的“欲加之罪”，
Rather than say plainly that she could not bear to let him spend so much, A’zhu found fault with every fabric: the colour was wrong, the pattern old-fashioned, the width too narrow, or it would shrink in water.

味着良心胡说，把布店里的伙计，气得半天不开口。
Her baseless accusations, made against her own better judgement, left the shop assistant speechless with anger.


布店隔壁就是估衣店，
The second-hand clothes shop was next door.

到替老张买衣服，胡雪岩当仁不让了，
When it came to buying Old Zhang's clothes, Hu firmly took charge.

“这要我来作主！”他说，
“You must leave this to me,” he said.

“现在做生意不象从前了，
“Business isn't what it used to be.

打抢得越老实越好，
A man's appearance has to look thoroughly respectable.

上海的‘十里夷场’你们见过的，
You've seen Shanghai's miles of foreign settlement.

哪一行走出来不是穿得挺挺括括？
Wherever men come out from, don't they all look trim and smart?

佛要金装，人要衣装，
A Buddha needs gilding, and a man needs clothes.

你看我把老张打份起来，包他象个大老板。”
Watch me dress Old Zhang: I guarantee he'll look like a great merchant.”

听他说得头头是道，阿珠抿着嘴笑了，推一推她娘小声说道：“你也要打扮打扮，
A’zhu smiled at his persuasive speech, then nudged her mother and whispered, “You'll have to dress up too.

不然不象个老板娘！”
Otherwise you won't look like a proprietor's wife!”

真的要做老板娘了！阿珠的娘心里在想，
A proprietor's wife—she really was going to become one!

昨天还只是一句话，到底不知如何？
Only yesterday it had been so much talk, with no certainty of what would happen.

这现在可是踏踏实实再无可疑，
Now it was solid fact beyond doubt.

别样不说，那一千两银子总是真的。
Whatever else might be uncertain, those thousand taels were certainly real.

这样一想，就想得远了，
Her thoughts wandered far ahead.

只是想着怎样做老板娘和做老板娘的滋味，忘掉了自己身在何处？
Absorbed in imagining how she would conduct herself and what it would feel like, she forgot where she was.


等她惊醒过来，胡雪岩已经替老张挑了一大堆衣服，长袍短套，棉夹俱备。
By the time she came to herself, Hu had chosen a great pile of clothes for Old Zhang: long gowns, short outer jackets, padded garments, and lined ones.

胡雪岩还要替老张买件“紫羔”的皮袍子，阿珠的娘不肯，说是：“将来挣了钱做新的！”才算罢手。
He even wanted to buy a dark lambskin robe, but she stopped him. “When we've made some money, we'll have a new one made.”

结了帐，一共二十多两银子，
The bill came to more than twenty taels.

胡雪岩掏出一大把银票，拣了一张三十两的，交了过去，
Hu pulled out a large handful of banknotes, selected one for thirty taels, and paid.

找来的零头，他从阿珠手里取了手巾包过来，把它包在里面。
When the change came, he took A’zhu's handkerchief bundle and wrapped the money inside it.

“这算啥？”她故意这样问。
“What's this for?” she asked, though she knew perfectly well.

“对面就是‘戴春林’分号，”胡雪岩说：
“There's a branch of Dai Chunlin across the street.

“胭脂花粉我不会买，
I know nothing about rouge and powder.

要你自己去挑。”
You'll have to choose those yourself.”

阿珠果然去挑了许多，而且很舍得花钱，尽拣好的买，
She did choose a great many things, spending freely and buying only the best.

除了“鹅蛋粉”之类的本地货以外，还买了上海来的“水粉”、花露水、“洋肥皂”。
Besides local products such as egg-shaped powder cakes, she bought liquid face powder, scented toilet water, and foreign soap brought from Shanghai.

要用这些东西打扮出来，博得胡雪岩赞一声“好”！
She would use them to dress herself up and earn a word of praise from Hu.


* * *在老张动身到湖州的第二天，阿珠的娘弄了几样极精致的菜，起个大早，雇了顶小轿到石塔儿头去看张胖子。
The day after Old Zhang left for Huzhou, A’zhu's mother prepared several exquisite dishes, rose early, and hired a small sedan chair to take her to Fat Zhang's house on Stone Pagoda Street.

见了张太太，少不得有阵寒暄，很快地便由她所送的那四样菜上，转入正题，
After the customary greetings to Mrs Zhang, conversation soon turned from the four dishes she had brought to the purpose of her visit.

张太太在表示过意不去，张胖子却笑了，
Mrs Zhang protested at the trouble she had taken, but her husband laughed.

“ ‘十三只半鸡’，
“Thirteen and a half chickens!

着实还有得吃！”他说。
I've a good deal of eating ahead of me yet.”

据说做媒的男女两家跑，从“问名”开始到“六礼”将成，媒人至少要走十三趟。
It was said that a matchmaker had to go between the two families at least thirteen times, from the first exchange of names to the completion of the six marriage rites.

主人家每一趟都要杀鸡款待，
At every visit, the host would kill a chicken for the guest.

到“好日子”那天还有一只鸡好吃。不过新娘子要上轿，不能从容大嚼，至多只能吃半只，
