There was another chicken on the wedding day, but with the bride due to enter her sedan chair, there was no time to linger over it: at most, half could be eaten.

合起来便是十三只半，
The total was thirteen and a half.

这是贫嘴的话，久而久之便成了做媒的意思。
Originally a facetious remark, the phrase had gradually become a synonym for matchmaking.

张太太一听这话，
Mrs Zhang immediately took an interest.

便极感兴趣地问他丈夫：“我们这位阿嫂是男家还是女家？”
“Does our visitor represent the bride or the groom?” she asked.


“女家。”
“The bride.”

“喔，恭喜，恭喜！”
“Oh, congratulations, congratulations!”

张太太向客人笑着道贺，然后又问她丈夫：“那么男家呢？”
She smiled at her guest, then asked her husband, “And who is the groom?”

“你倒猜猜看！”张胖子道，
“Guess!

“你也很熟的。”于是张太太从信和钱庄几个得力而未曾成家的伙计猜起，猜到至亲好友的少年郎君，
You know him very well.” She began with the capable, unmarried employees at Xinhe and went on to the young sons of their close friends and relations.

说了七八个人，张胖子便摇了七八次头。
She offered seven or eight names, and seven or eight times Fat Zhang shook his head.

“好了，好了！
“Enough, enough!

你猜到明天天亮都猜不着的。”
You could guess till dawn tomorrow and never get it.”

他将他妻子往里面推，“闲话少说，
He steered her towards the inner rooms. “Never mind the talk.

你好到厨房里去了，
Off to the kitchen with you.

今天有好菜，我在家早早吃了中饭，再到店里，
With such good food today, I'll have an early lunch at home before going to the bank.

等下我再跟你说。”
I'll tell you later.”

一面推着，一面向他妻子使了个眼色。意思是关照她一进去便不必再出来了。
As he ushered her away, he gave her a meaningful glance, telling her not to come out again.


这就是张胖子老练圆滑之外，
This was where Fat Zhang's experience and tact showed.

因为，第一，胡雪岩跟阿珠的这头姻缘，究还不知结果如何？也不知胡雪岩是不是要瞒着家里？
First, the outcome of the proposed match between Hu and A’zhu remained uncertain, and he did not know whether Hu intended to keep it from his family.

此时需要保守秘密，
For the moment, secrecy was necessary.

他妻子最近常到胡家去作客，
His wife had lately been visiting the Hu household often.

万一不小心漏了口风，影响到他跟胡雪岩的交情，而胡雪岩现在是他最好、最要紧的一个朋友，决不能失掉的。
An inadvertent word might damage his friendship with Hu, now his closest and most important friend, whom he could not afford to lose.

其次他是为阿珠的娘设想。
Second, he was thinking of A’zhu's mother.

女儿给人作妾，谈起来不是什么光彩之事，怕她有初见面的人在座，难于启齿。
Giving one's daughter to a man as a concubine was hardly a glorious subject, and he feared she might find it difficult to discuss before someone she had only just met.

这一层意思，阿珠的娘自然了解，越觉得张胖子细心老到，自己是找对了人。
She naturally understood this consideration and felt all the more certain that she had chosen the right man: he was thoughtful and experienced.


“张老板，”她说，“我的来意，你已经晓得了。
“Mr Zhang,” she said, “you know why I've come.

这头亲事，能不能成功，全要靠你张老板费心。”
Whether this marriage can be arranged depends entirely on your kindness.”

“那何消说得？”张胖子很诚恳地答道，
“There's no need to say that,” he answered earnestly.

“雪岩是我的好朋友，
“Xueyan is a good friend of mine.

就是你们两家不托我，我也要讨这杯喜酒来吃。”
Even if neither family asked me, I'd still want to help arrange the wedding.”

“噢！”阿珠的娘异常关切地问，
“Oh!” she asked eagerly.

“胡老爷也托过你了，
“Has Mr Hu asked you too?

他怎么说？”
What did he say?”

“他没有托我。
“He hasn't asked me.

我说‘两家’的意思是，随便他们男女两家哪一家。
By ‘neither family’ I meant either side, the bride's or the groom's.

不都一样的吗？”
Isn't it all the same?”

“不一样，不一样。”阿珠的娘摇着头说，
“No, no.” She shook her head.

“胡老爷是你的好朋友，不错！
“Mr Hu is your good friend, certainly.

不过今天我来求张老板，
But I'm the one who has come to ask you today.

你张老板答应了，就是我们女家的大媒，总要帮我们阿珠说话才对。
If you agree, you're the matchmaker for our side and ought to speak up for A’zhu.

你想是不是呢？”张胖子笑了，
Don't you think so?” Fat Zhang laughed.

“阿嫂！我服你。”他说，
“My good sister, I take my hat off to you.

“到底是书香人家出身，说出话来，一下子就扎在道理上。
Your scholarly upbringing shows: the moment you speak, you go straight to the heart of the matter.

好，好，你说，
Very well, tell me what you want.

我总尽心就是了。”
I'll do all I can.”


“多谢大媒老爷！”
“Thank you, my honoured matchmaker!”

她想了想说，“我也不怕你笑话，
She paused to think. “I won't be afraid of your laughing at me.

说句老实话，我们阿珠一片心都在胡老爷身上，
To tell the truth, our A’zhu has set her whole heart on Mr Hu.

完全是感情，决不是贪图富贵。”
It's entirely a matter of affection, with no thought of wealth or position.”

“这我知道。”
“I know that.”

“大家爱亲结亲，
“Let affection bring the families together.

财礼、嫁妆都不必去谈它。
There's no need to discuss betrothal gifts or a dowry.

胡老爷看样子也喜欢我们阿珠，
Mr Hu seems fond of our A’zhu too.

想来总也不肯委屈她的。”张胖子心里有些嘀咕了，
Surely he wouldn't wish to slight her.” Fat Zhang began to feel uneasy.

既非贪图将来的富贵，又不是贪图眼前的财礼，那么所谓“不肯委屈”阿珠，要怎么样办呢？
If she sought neither future wealth nor immediate marriage gifts, what exactly did she mean by not slighting A’zhu?

“我实话直说。
“I'll speak plainly.

这名分上头……
As to her standing in the family...

要请张老板你给阿珠争一争。”
I want you to press her claim, Mr Zhang.”

这怎么争法？张胖子心想，
How was he to do that?

总不能叫胡雪岩再娶！
Surely Hu could not be expected to marry again as though he had no wife!

“莫非，”他忽然想到了，“莫非‘两头大’？”
Suddenly he understood. “Do you mean... two wives of equal standing?”

阿珠的娘反问一句：“张老板，你看这个办法行得通，行不通？”
“Mr Zhang, do you think that arrangement could be made?” she asked in return.

张胖子不愿作肯定的答复，笑一笑说：“如果换了是我，自然行得通。”
Unwilling to give a definite answer, he smiled. “If it were up to me, of course it could.”


这表示在胡雪岩就不大可能。
This implied that, with Hu, it might be difficult.

原因何在？阿珠的娘当然要打听。
Naturally she asked why.

张胖子却又说不上来，他只是怕好事不谐，预留后步。
He could offer no reason: he was merely afraid the match might fail and was leaving himself room to retreat.

其实他也不了解胡雪岩的家庭，不知道这桩好事，会有些什么障碍？
In truth, he knew too little about Hu's household to foresee the obstacles.

不过，他向她保证，一定尽力去做这头媒，不论如何，最短期间内，必有确实的答复。
Nevertheless, he promised to do his utmost and, whatever happened, to obtain a definite answer as soon as possible.

同时他也劝她要耐心，
He also urged patience.

事缓则圆，心太急反倒生出意外的障碍。
Matters settled better when allowed time; haste could create unexpected difficulties.

他说象阿珠这样的人才，好比奇货可居，
A girl like A’zhu, he said, was like a rare article whose owner could afford to wait.

最好要让胡雪岩万般难舍，自己先开口来求婚，
Best to make Hu feel he could not bear to lose her, until he proposed of his own accord.

那样事情就好办了。
Then everything would be easier.

阿珠的娘先有些失望，听到最后几句话，
Her initial disappointment faded as she heard these final words.

觉得很在道理。
They made excellent sense.

心里在想，阿珠也不可太迁就胡雪岩，
A’zhu must not be too accommodating to Hu.

这些事上面，真象做生意一样，太迁就顾客，反显得自己的“货色”不灵光似地，
In such matters it was just like business: indulge a customer too much and he began to suspect that the goods were inferior.

因而深深受教，但依旧重重拜托，
She took the lesson deeply to heart, though she still pressed Zhang to help.

能够早日谈成，早了一件心事，总是好的。
The sooner things were settled, the sooner she would have one less worry.


于是张胖子一到店里，立刻打发一个小徒弟到胡家去说，请胡雪岩这天晚上到信和来吃饭，
As soon as Fat Zhang reached the bank, he sent a young apprentice to the Hu house with an invitation to dine at Xinhe that evening.

有要紧事要谈，不论迟早，务心劳驾。
There was something important to discuss, and Hu must please come, however late.

快到天黑，张胖子备了酒菜专诚等候。
Towards dusk Zhang had food and wine prepared and waited especially for him.

直到八点钟左右，胡雪岩才到，见面连声道歉，说王有龄那里有许多公事。
Hu did not arrive until about eight, apologising repeatedly and explaining that there had been a great deal of official business at Wang's office.

“不是我的事情，是你的，
“This isn't my affair; it's yours.

这件事要一面吃酒一面谈，才有味道。”
And it's a matter that will be all the pleasanter discussed over a drink.”

张胖子肃客入座，关照他店里的人，不喊不要进来，
Zhang courteously showed him to his seat and instructed the bank's employees not to come in unless called.

然后，把杯说媒，将阿珠的娘这天早晨的来意，原原本本告诉了胡雪岩。
Then, cup in hand, he took up his duties as matchmaker and related A’zhu's mother's request in full.


“事情当然要办的，
“Of course the matter must be dealt with,” Hu said.

不过我没有想到她这么心急。”
“I hadn't expected her to be in such a hurry.”

“我也这么劝她。”
“I advised her against hurrying too.”

张胖子说到这里，忽然露出极诡秘的笑容，凑近了低声问道：“雪岩，我倒要问你句话，
Suddenly Zhang gave a knowing smile, leaned closer, and lowered his voice. “Xueyan, let me ask you something.

到底他把阿珠弄上手了没有？”
Have you and A’zhu been intimate?”

“干干净净，
“Nothing of the kind.

什么也没有。”
Nothing has happened.”

“那她娘为什么这么急？”张胖子是替他宽慰的神气，
“Then why is her mother so anxious?” Zhang looked relieved on his behalf.

“我还当生米已成熟饭，非逼你吃了下去不可呢！”
“I thought the rice was already cooked and they meant to make you eat it!”

“要吃也吃得下。
“I could eat it if I had to.

不过现在这个当口，我还不想吃，实在也是没有工夫去吃，
But just now I don't want to, and I really haven't the time.

生意刚刚起头，
My business is only getting started.

全副精神去对付还不够，
Even devoting all my energy to it scarcely seems enough.

哪里有闲心电来享艳福？”
Where am I to find the leisure for romance?”

张胖子心里明白，
Fat Zhang understood.

胡雪岩逢场作戏，寻些乐趣则可，要让他立一个门户，添上一个累，尚非其时，
Hu was willing to amuse himself as occasion offered, but the time had not come to establish another household and take on another burden.

彼此休戚相关，他当然赞成胡雪岩把精力放在生意上面，
Their fortunes were linked, so Zhang naturally preferred him to concentrate on business.

所双这时候忘掉女家的重找，反倒站在胡雪岩这面了。
Forgetting the bride's mother's solemn commission, he now took Hu's side instead.


“那么，你说，你是怎么个意思？
“Then tell me what you want to do.

我来帮你应付。”
I'll help you manage it.”

胡雪岩有些踌躇了，
Hu hesitated.

阿珠的一颦一笑，此时都映现在脑子里，实在不忍心让她失望。
A’zhu's every smile and frown came into his mind, and he could not bear to disappoint her.

“照我看，只有一个字：拖！”张胖子为他设谋。
“In my view, there's only one thing to do: delay,” Zhang advised.

“拖下去不是个了局！”胡雪岩不以为然，
“Dragging it out solves nothing,” Hu objected.

“话要把它说清楚。”
“We must make things clear.”

“怎么说法？”
“How?”

胡雪岩又踌躇了：“这话说出来，怕有人会伤心。”
Hu hesitated again. “I'm afraid someone will be hurt if I say what I think.”

那当然是指阿珠，
He meant A’zhu, of course.

“你先说来听听，是怎么句话？”张胖子说，
“Tell me first,” Zhang said.

“我是站在旁边的，事情看得比较清楚。”
“Standing outside the situation, I can see it more clearly.”

“我在想，生意归生意，感情归感情，
“I think business is business and affection is affection.

两件事不能混在一起。”
The two shouldn't be mixed.”

“对啊！”张胖子鼓掌称善，
“Exactly!” Fat Zhang applauded.

“你的脑筋真清楚。
“What a clear head you have!

不过我倒要问你，你在湖州开丝行，既然不是为了安顿阿珠，又何必找到老张？
But let me ask you this: if you aren't opening the Huzhou silk firm to provide for A’zhu, why choose Old Zhang?

他又不是内行。”
He knows nothing of the trade.”

“他虽不是内行，但是老实、勤恳，
“He may not know the trade, but he's honest and hardworking.

这就够了。”
That's enough.

胡雪岩问：“难道你我生来就会在‘铜钱眼里翻跟头’的？”
Were you and I born knowing how to turn somersaults through the hole in a copper coin?”


“这话也不错，
“True enough.

只是现在已经有感情夹在里面，事情就麻烦了。”
But now affection has got mixed up in it, and that makes things difficult.”

“麻烦虽麻烦，有感情到底也是好的。
“Difficult, perhaps, but affection is still a good thing.

有了感情，老张夫妇才会全心全意去做生意。”
It's because of that bond that Old Zhang and his wife will give their whole hearts to the business.”

“话又兜回来了。”张胖子笑说，
“And now we've come round in a circle,” Zhang laughed.

“我们在商量的，就是怎么才能够不把感情搞坏，可又不叫感情分你的心？”
“What we're discussing is how to preserve that affection without letting it distract you.”

“正就是这话，
“Precisely.

所以不宜拖。
That's why we mustn't let it drag on.

拖在那里，老张夫妇心思不定，生意哪里还做得好？
With nothing settled, how can Old Zhang and his wife concentrate on business?

而且拖到后来，因情生恨，一定搞得彼此翻脸，
And if it drags on long enough, affection will turn to resentment, and we'll surely fall out.

那又何苦？”
What would be the point?”

张胖子心想，翻来覆去都是胡雪岩一个人的话，
Fat Zhang reflected that, whichever way the argument turned, Hu had an answer.

自己脑筋也算清楚，嘴也不笨，就是说不过他，
He considered himself clear-headed and no poor speaker, yet he could not get the better of him.

倒不如听他自己拿定了主意，该怎么办怎么办，自己只听他的好了。
He might as well let Hu decide what he wanted and then do as he was told.


“张先生，”胡雪岩看他闷声不响，只管端杯夹菜，便即问道：“你是不是觉得这个媒不做成功，在阿珠的娘面上，不好交代？”
Seeing Zhang silently occupied with his cup and chopsticks, Hu asked, “Mr Zhang, do you feel that if the match doesn't come off, you won't know how to face A’zhu's mother?”

“这倒也不是。”张胖子答道：
“Not exactly,” Zhang replied.

“能够做成功了，总是件高兴的事。”
“But it would be a happy thing if it could be arranged.”

“做是一这做得成功的，
“It certainly can be arranged.

不过媒人吃十三只半鸡，没有一趟头就说成功的。”胡雪岩笑说：
But the matchmaker eats thirteen and a half chickens; nobody settles everything on the first visit.” Hu smiled.

“阿珠的娘拿手菜好得很，
“A’zhu's mother is a wonderful cook.

你一趟说成功，以后就没有好东西吃了。”张胖子也笑了，觉得胡雪岩的话，也颇有些滋味好辨，
Get it all settled at once, and you won't have any more of her good dishes.” Zhang laughed too, feeling that Hu's remark contained something worth considering.

“那么，我这样子去说，你看行不行？”他说，
“Then what if I put it this way?” he asked.

“我告诉阿珠的娘，既然是‘两头大’，不能马马虎虎，
“I'll tell her mother that, since the two wives are to have equal standing, nothing can be done carelessly.

先把八字合一合，看看有没有什么冲克？
First we'll compare the birth horoscopes for any clash.

然后再跟老太太说明白，原配太太那里也要打个招呼。
Then we'll explain matters to your mother, and your first wife must be consulted too.

这两关过去，再排日子。
Once those two obstacles are past, we can choose a date.

这一来就是年把过去了，
All that will take a year or so.

还是我说的话，一个‘拖’字。”
It still comes back to what I said: delay.”

“这一拖跟你所说的‘拖’不同。
“This delay is different from yours.

你的拖是没有一句准话，心思不定，
Yours offers no definite word and leaves everyone uncertain.

我的拖是照规矩一定要拖，
Mine follows the formalities, which necessarily take time.

就算将来不成功，譬如八字犯冲之类，那是命该如此，大家没话好说。”
Even if it fails later—because the birth horoscopes clash, for instance—that will be fate, and nobody will have grounds for complaint.”

张胖子想一想果然，
Zhang thought about it and saw the distinction.

“雪岩！”他举杯相敬，
“Xueyan!” He raised his cup in a toast.

“随便你做啥，总是先想到退步。
“Whatever you undertake, you always think first of a way to retreat.

这一点我最佩服你，
That's what I admire most about you.

也是人家放心，愿意跟你打伙的道理。”
It's why people feel secure and are willing to join you in business.”


胡雪岩笑笑不答，只这样问道：“你什么时候去回报女家？”
Hu smiled without answering, asking only, “When will you take your answer back to the bride's family?”

“我看她明天来不来？
“I'll see whether she comes tomorrow.

不来也不要紧，
If she doesn't, it won't matter.

她在后天总见得着面。”
I'm bound to see her the day after.”

后天就是王有龄荣行上任的日子，
That was the day Wang would leave to take up his new post.

胡雪岩和张胖子要坐张家的船送到临平，
Hu and Fat Zhang were to accompany him as far as Linping aboard the Zhang family's boat.

阿珠的娘得预备一桌好菜，一点空都抽不出来，
A’zhu's mother had to prepare an excellent banquet and could not spare a moment.

所以她心里虽急着想听回音，却跟张胖子的打算一样，只能等到他们上船的那天再说。
Anxious though she was for news, she could only do as Fat Zhang had planned and wait until they came aboard.


那天王有龄在运司河下船，胡雪岩和张胖子在万安桥下船，
On the appointed day, Wang boarded his vessel at the wharf by the salt administration, while Hu and Zhang embarked at Wan'an Bridge.

约在拱宸桥的北新关前相会。
They were to meet outside the Beixin customs barrier by Gongchen Bridge.

两人一到船上，只见阿珠打扮得艳光照人，笑嘻嘻地把他们迎入舱中。
As the two men stepped aboard, A’zhu, beautifully dressed and radiant, welcomed them into the cabin with a smile.

胡雪岩和张胖子都注意到她的脸色，
Both noticed her expression.

毫无忸怩不自然的神态，心里便都有数，她还不知道她娘在提亲，
There was no embarrassment or awkwardness, so they knew she had heard nothing of her mother's marriage negotiations.

胡雪岩即时对张胖子使了个眼色，示意他不必说破。
Hu immediately signalled to Zhang not to mention them.

“胡老爷，张老板！”阿珠的娘出来打招呼，
“Mr Hu, Mr Zhang!” A’zhu's mother came out to greet them.

“你们请宽坐，
“Please make yourselves comfortable.

我不陪你们。”
You'll excuse me if I can't sit with you.”

打招呼是表面文章，实际上是来观望气色，不过胡、张两人都是很深沉的人，自然不会在脸上让她看出什么来，
The greeting was merely a pretext for studying their faces, but both men were too practised to reveal anything.

张胖子只是这样回答：“你尽管去忙，
Fat Zhang simply said, “Attend to whatever you must.

回头等你闲一闲再谈。”
We'll talk when you have a moment to spare.”

有了这句话，阿珠的娘便回到船梢去忙着整治筵席，船也解缆往北面去。
Reassured by this, she went back to the stern to prepare the feast, and the boat cast off and headed north.

张胖子乘胡雪岩跟阿珠谈笑得起劲的那一刻，托辞要去看看准备了些什么菜，一溜溜到船梢上。
When Hu and A’zhu were absorbed in laughing and talking, Fat Zhang slipped aft on the pretext of seeing what dishes were being prepared.


“阿嫂，恭喜你！”张胖子轻声说着，拱拱手道贺。
“My good sister, congratulations!” he said softly, clasping his hands.

就这一句话，把阿珠的娘高兴得眉开眼笑，
That single sentence made her beam.

除却连声“多谢”以外，竟不知道说什么好。
She could only repeat her thanks, unable to think of anything else to say.

“一切照你的意思。”张胖子紧接着说，
“Everything will be as you wish,” he continued.

“不过这不比讨偏房，
“But this isn't simply taking a concubine.

要规规矩矩，按部就班来做，
It must be done properly, step by step.

你们肯马虎，我媒人也不肯。
Even if you were willing to dispense with formalities, I, as matchmaker, would not.

阿嫂，这话是不是？”
Isn't that right?”

“是啊，一点不错。
“Yes, absolutely.

张老板，请你吩咐。”
Tell me what to do, Mr Zhang.”

“那么我先讨个生辰八，
“First, then, I'll need her birth particulars.

阿珠今年十几？”
How old is A’zhu this year?”

“道光个八年戊戌生的，
“She was born in the eighteenth year of Daoguang, the wuxu year.

今年十六。”
She's sixteen this year.”

“那是属狗，
“So she was born in the Year of the Dog.

雪岩属羊，
Xueyan was born in the Year of the Sheep.

羊同狗倒可以打伙，不犯冲的。”
Sheep and Dog can get along; there's no clash there.

张胖子又问，“阿珠几月里生日？”
What month is her birthday?”


犯冲不犯冲这句话提醒了她。
This reference to a clash alerted her.

媒人讨了八字去，自然要去请教算命的，拿胡雪岩的八字合在一起来排一排，
Naturally, the matchmaker would take A’zhu's birth particulars to a fortune-teller to compare with Hu's.

倘或有何冲克，胡雪岩自己或许不在乎，但他堂上还有老亲，不能不顾忌。
If anything proved incompatible, Hu himself might not care, but with an elderly mother still living he could not disregard it.

最好预先能够把胡雪岩的八字打听清楚，自己先请人看一看，
Better to find out Hu's birth particulars first and have someone examine them privately.

如果有什么合不拢的地方，可以把阿珠生日的月份、日子、时辰改一改，叫乾坤两造合得拢。
If anything failed to agree, she could alter A’zhu's birth month, day, or hour to make the two horoscopes compatible.

这样打定了主意，她便不肯先透露了，
Having decided this, she would reveal nothing further yet.

“张老板，准定这样办！”她说，
“We'll certainly do that, Mr Zhang,” she said.

“等我回到杭州，请人写好了送到府上去。”
“When I return to Hangzhou, I'll have the particulars written out and sent to your house.”

“好，好，就这样。”
“Good, good. That's settled.”

就这样三言两语，张胖子对女家的重托，算是圆满地交了差，
In those few exchanges, Fat Zhang had satisfactorily discharged the bride's family's commission.

走回中舱，避开阿珠的视线，向胡雪岩笑一笑，表示事情办得很顺利。
He returned to the middle cabin and, out of A’zhu's sight, smiled at Hu to show that everything had gone smoothly.


于是到了北新关前，等候王有龄的官船一到，
At the Beixin barrier they waited for Wang's official boat.

讨关过闸，把王有龄和秦寿门、杨用之一起请到张家的船上，
When it arrived, they obtained clearance and passed through the lock, then invited Wang, Qin Shoumen, and Yang Yongzhi aboard the Zhang family's vessel.

一面在水波不兴的运河中，缓缓行去，一面由阿珠伺候着，开怀畅饮。
As it moved slowly over the still waters of the canal, A’zhu served them and they drank with pleasure.

因为有秦、杨两师爷在座，既不能一无顾忌，畅抒肺腑，也不便放浪形骸，大谈风月，
With the two secretaries, Qin and Yang, present, however, they could neither speak their hearts without reserve nor abandon propriety to discuss romantic adventures.

所以终席只是娓娓清谈。
The entire meal therefore passed in gentle, agreeable conversation.

这席酒从拱宸桥吃到临平，也就是从中午吃到晚上。
It lasted from Gongchen Bridge to Linping—from noon until evening.

宴罢又移到王有龄船上去品茗闲话，
Afterwards they moved to Wang's boat for tea and more talk.

到了起更时分，秦、杨二人告辞回自己的船，
At the first night watch, Qin and Yang took leave and returned to their own vessel.

张胖子跟着也走了，
Fat Zhang followed them away.

只有胡雪岩为王有龄留了下来话别。
Wang detained only Hu for a private farewell.


虽只有几个月的相聚，而且也只是一水可航，两无可达的腰隔，但王有龄的离愁无限，
They had been together for merely a few months, and only two days' journey along a navigable waterway would separate them, yet Wang felt an immense sorrow at parting.

除了感情以外，他还有着近乎孤立无倚的恐惧，
Besides affection, he felt something close to the fear of being left alone and helpless.

因为这些日子来，倚胡雪岩如左右手，已养成“一日不可无此君”的习惯了。
In recent months he had relied on Hu as on his own hands and had grown so accustomed to him that he could scarcely do without him for a day.

不过他也知道，要胡雪岩舍却自己的事业，到他衙门中去当遇事可以随时商议的客卿，不但办不到，
Yet he knew that he could not ask Hu to abandon his business and become a resident adviser at the yamen, available for consultation whenever anything arose.

就算办到了，又置秦、杨三人于何地？
Even if it were possible, where would that leave Qin and Yang?

因此，这条心他是死了，
He had therefore given up that hope.

退而求其次，唯有希望常见见面。
His next best wish was that they should meet often.

于是他问：“雪岩，你什么时候到湖州来？”
“Xueyan, when are you coming to Huzhou?” he asked.

“不会太远。”
“Before long.”

他算了算日子，
Hu calculated the days.

等阜康开了张，立即就要到湖州支看老张这方面的情形，
As soon as Fukang opened, he would go to Huzhou to see how Old Zhang was getting on.

“快则半个月，迟则月底。”他说。
“In a fortnight at the earliest; by the end of the month at the latest.”


“我倒起起来了。”王有龄说，
“That reminds me,” Wang said.

“ 前两天忙得不可开交，没有工夫问们。
“I've been so busy these last two days that I haven't had time to ask you.

你要在湖州开丝行，是怎么回事？
What's this about your opening a silk firm in Huzhou?”

““这件事，我本来想到了湖州再跟你谈。
“I meant to discuss it with you when I got there.

此刻不妨就说给你听。”他把前后经过，细细讲了一遍，包括阿珠的亲事在内。
But I may as well tell you now.” Hu explained the whole story in detail, including the proposed marriage to A’zhu.

事情相当复杂，王有龄一时还抓不着头绪，
It was rather complicated, and Wang could not immediately grasp all its threads.

只是深感兴味地说：“你搞的花样真热闹。”
Deeply interested, he merely remarked, “You certainly keep things lively.”

“雪公，热闹都从你身上来的。”
“Mr Xuexuan, all this activity comes from you.”

胡雪岩放低了声音说：“丝行当然有你一份。”
Hu lowered his voice. “Naturally, there's a share in the silk firm for you.”

“这不必，
“No need for that.

怕外面知道了，名声不好听。
If word got out, it wouldn't do my reputation any good.

反正你我之间，无事不可商量，这些话现在都不必去谈它。
There's nothing you and I can't discuss in any case; we needn't talk about these things now.

倒是杨用之那里，你得想办法下些功夫。
But you must find some way to work on Yang Yongzhi.

不然，他有他的主张，在公款的调度上，不无麻烦。”
Otherwise, with his own views, he may make it difficult to arrange the movement of public funds.”

“我早已想到了。
“I've already thought of that.

不过，我仍旧要用雪公你的名义来办。”
But again, I intend to act in your name.”

“怎么办？”王有龄问。
“How?” Wang asked.

“秦、杨两家的眷属，住在哪里，我都打听清楚了。
“I've found out where both Qin's and Yang's families live.

我会派人照应，到时候该送东西送东西，该送钱送钱，
I'll send people to look after them, providing gifts when gifts are called for and money when money is called for.

他们家里自会写信到湖州，
Their families will naturally write to Huzhou.

秦、杨两位知道了，当然会见你的情。
When Qin and Yang hear of it, they'll feel grateful to you.

那时候一切都好办了。”
Then everything will be easy.”


“对，对！”王有龄欣然嘉许，
“Yes, yes!” Wang approved delightedly.

“这样最好！
“That's the best way.

我也不必先说破，
I needn't explain beforehand.

等他们来跟我道谢时，我自会把交情卖到你身上。”
When they come to thank me, I'll make sure you get the credit.”

胡雪岩笑着说了句杭州的俗语：“花花轿儿人抬人！”
Hu smiled and quoted a Hangzhou saying: “We take turns carrying one another's flowered sedan chairs!”

“那么，”王有龄突然露出顽皮的笑容，“你什么时候让阿珠坐花轿？”
“Speaking of which,” Wang said, suddenly smiling mischievously, “when will you put A’zhu in a bridal sedan chair?”

“现在还谈不到。
“It's too soon to talk of that.

走到哪里算哪里。”
We'll take things as they come.”

“你太太知道这件事不？”
“Does your wife know?”

胡雪岩摇摇头：“最好不要让她知道。”
Hu shook his head. “I'd rather she didn't.”

“这一点我不赞成。”王有龄说，
“There I disagree,” Wang said.

“你是绝顶聪明的人，总该晓得这两句话：”糟糠之妻不下堂，贫贱之交不可忘。
“A man as clever as you should surely know those two sayings: ‘Do not turn out the wife who shared your coarse meals and hardship; do not forget the friends you made in poverty.’

‘如今虽非停妻再娶，也得跟你太太商量一下才好。
You're not dismissing your wife to marry another, but you ought to discuss the matter with her all the same.”

“胡雪岩默然，
Hu said nothing.

觉得王有龄的话，有点打官腔的味道。
He felt that Wang's words had something of an official sermon about them.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（上）》第八章（完整）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume I — the complete Chapter Eight
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第八章｜CHAPTER EIGHT


阜康钱庄开张了。
Fukang Bank opened for business.

门面装修得很象佯，柜台里四个伙计，一律簇新的洋蓝布长衫，笑脸迎人。
Its premises had been handsomely fitted out, and the four clerks behind the counter, all in brand-new gowns of imported blue cotton, greeted everyone with smiles.

刘庆生是穿绸长衫纱马褂，
Liu Qingsheng wore a silk gown and a gauze jacket.

红光满面，精神抖擞地在亲自招呼顾客。
His face glowing, he personally attended to customers with tremendous energy.

来道贺的同行和官商两界的客人，由胡雪岩亲自接待。
Hu Xueyan received the fellow bankers and guests from official and commercial circles who came to offer their congratulations.

信和的张胖子和大源的孙德庆都到了，
Fat Zhang of Xinhe and Sun Deqing of Dayuan were both there.

大家都晓得胡雪岩在抚台那里也能说得上话，难免有什么事要托他，
Everyone knew that Hu could get a hearing even with the governor, and might someday be needed to put in a word.

加以他的人缘极好，
Moreover, he was exceptionally well liked.

所以同行十分捧场，“堆花”的存款好几万，
His fellow bankers therefore gave him enthusiastic support, placing several tens of thousands of taels in goodwill deposits.

刚出炉耀眼生光的“马蹄银”、“圆丝”随意堆放在柜台里面，把过路的人看得眼睛发直。
Freshly cast horseshoe ingots and round silver ingots, dazzlingly bright, lay in casual heaps behind the counter, making passers-by stare.

中午摆酒款客，吃到下午三点多钟，方始散席。
A banquet was served at noon, and it was after three before the guests dispersed.

胡雪岩一个人静下来在盘算，
Left quietly alone, Hu considered the situation.

头一天的情形不错，不过总得扎住几个大户头，生意才会有开展。
The first day had gone well, but he must secure a few substantial accounts before the business could really develop.

第一步先要做名气，
His first step must be to build a name.

名气一响，生意才会热闹。
Once Fukang was well known, business would be brisk.


忽然间，灵光闪现，
Suddenly an idea came to him.

他把刘庆生找了来说：“你替我开张单子。”
He sent for Liu. “Make me a list.”

他随身有个小本子，上面记着只有他自己认识的符号，
He carried a small notebook filled with symbols intelligible only to himself.

里面有往来的帐目，交往的人名，还有哪位大官儿和他老太太、太大、姨太太、少爷、小姐的生日，
It contained accounts of his dealings, the names of his acquaintances, and the birthdays of important officials and their mothers, wives, concubines, sons, and daughters.

这时翻开来看了看，报出一连串户名，“福记”、“湘记”、“和记”、“慎德堂”等等。
Consulting it, he dictated a series of account names: Fuji, Xiangji, Heji, Shende Hall, and others.

刘庆生写好了问道：“是不是要立存折？”
When Liu had written them down, he asked, “Are we to open passbooks?”

“对了。”
“Exactly.

胡雪岩问道：“一共多少个？”
How many are there?”

刘庆生用笔杆点了一遍：“一共十二个。”
Liu counted them with the shaft of his brush. “Twelve altogether.”

“每个折子存银二十两。
“Put twenty taels in each.

一共二百四十两，
Two hundred and forty in all.

在我的帐上挂一笔。”
Charge it to my account.”


等刘庆生办好手续，把十二个存折送了来，胡雪岩才把其中的奥妙告诉他，
Only after Liu had completed the arrangements and brought the twelve passbooks did Hu explain the device.

那些折子的户名，都是抚台和藩台的眷属，
The names belonged to members of the governor's and provincial treasurer's households.

立了户头，垫付存款，把折子送了过去，当然就会往来。
Once accounts had been opened, deposits provided, and the passbooks presented, business would naturally follow.

“太太、小姐们的私房钱，也许有限，算不了什么生意。”胡雪岩说，
“The ladies' private savings may not amount to much,” Hu said. “They may scarcely count as business.

“可是一传出去，别人对阜康的手面，就另眼相看了。”
But once word gets about, people will see Fukang's connections in quite a different light.”

“原来如此！”刘庆生心领神会地点着头，
“So that's it!” Liu nodded in understanding.

“这些个折子，怎么样送进去？”
“How are we to get these passbooks inside?”

“问得好！”胡雪岩说，
“A good question!

“你明天拿我一张片子去看抚台衙门的门上的刘二爷，
Tomorrow, take my card to Mr Liu Er at the governor's gate.

这个‘福记’的折于是送他的，
The Fuji passbook is for him.

其余的托他代为转送。
Ask him to deliver the others.

那刘二，你不妨好好应酬他一番，
Cultivate him properly.

中午去最好，他比较清闲，
Noon is the best time to go, when he has less to do.

顺便可以约他出来吃个馆子，向他讨教讨教官场中的情形。
You might invite him out to a restaurant and ask him to explain the ways of official life.

我们这行生意，全靠熟悉官场，消息灵通。”刘庆生一叠连声答应着。
Our business depends entirely on knowing official circles and keeping well informed.” Liu agreed repeatedly.

胡雪岩让他出面去看刘二，正是信任的表示，所以刘庆生相当高兴。
Hu's decision to let him approach Liu Er was a sign of trust, and he was very pleased.


第二天中午，刘庆生依照胡雪岩的嘱咐，专诚去看刘二，
At noon the following day, Liu went expressly to call on Liu Er, as Hu had directed.

因为同姓的关系，他管刘二叫“二叔”。
Since they shared a surname, he addressed him as “Second Uncle.”

这个亲切的称呼，赢得了刘二的好感，加以看胡雪岩的面子，所以接待得很客气。
The affectionate form of address won Liu Er's goodwill; respect for Hu helped too, and the reception was most courteous.

能言善道的刘庆生，说过了一套恭维仰慕的话，谈到正事，
The eloquent young manager delivered a series of compliments and expressions of admiration before turning to business.

把“福记”那个折子取了出来，双手奉上。
He produced the Fuji passbook and presented it with both hands.

刘二打开来一看，已经记着存银二十两，很诧异地问道：“这是怎么说？”
Liu Er opened it, saw the twenty-tael deposit already entered, and asked in surprise, “What does this mean?”

“想二叔照顾阜康，特为先付一笔利息。”刘二笑了，
“We hope Second Uncle will favour Fukang with his business, so we have paid a little interest in advance.” Liu Er laughed.

“你们那位东家，想出来的花样，真正独一无二。”
“Your proprietor's ideas really are like nobody else's!”

他又踌躇着说，“这一来，我倒不能下跟阜康往来了。
Then, with a little hesitation, he added, “Now I can hardly avoid doing business with Fukang.

来，来，正好有人还了我一笔款子，
Here, someone has just repaid me a sum.

就存在你们那里。”
I'll deposit it with you.”


于是刘二掀开手边的拜盒，取出两张银票交到刘庆生手里。
He opened the visiting-card box beside him, took out two notes, and handed them to Liu.

入眼便觉有异，不同于一般票号、钱庄所出的银票，
At first glance they looked unlike the usual notes issued by remittance houses or private banks.

仔细一看，果不其然。
Closer inspection confirmed it.

那是皮纸所制的票钞，写的是满汉合壁的“户部官票”四字，
They were printed on bark-fibre paper, with the words “Board of Revenue Official Note” in both Manchu and Chinese.

中间标明：“库平足色银一百两”，
The central inscription read, “One Hundred Taels of Full-Fineness Silver, Treasury Standard Weight.”

下面又有几行字：“户部奏行官票，
Below came several lines: “These official notes are issued by the Board of Revenue with imperial sanction.

凡愿将官票兑换银钱者，与银一律。
For any person wishing to exchange official notes for silver or cash, they shall be treated on the same basis as silver.

并准按部定章程，搭交官项，
They may also be tendered as a proportion of payments due to the government, in accordance with regulations laid down by the Board.

伪造者依律治罪。”
Counterfeiters shall be punished according to law.”

刘庆生竟不知道有些官票，
Liu had not even known such official notes existed.

因而笔道：“市面上还没有见过，
“I haven't seen these in circulation,” he said with a smile.

今天我算开了眼界。”
“This is an education for me.”

“京里也是刚刚才通行。”刘二答道，
“They have only just come into use in the capital,” Liu Er replied.

“听说藩署已经派人到京里去领了，
“I hear the provincial treasury has already sent someone there to collect a supply.

不久就会在市面上流通。”
They'll soon be circulating here.”


这还不曾流通的银票，一张是一百两，一张是八十两，刘庆生便在折子上记明收下。
One of the notes was for a hundred taels and the other for eighty. Liu entered their receipt in the passbook, although they were not yet in local circulation.

接着把其余几个折子取了出来，要求刘二代递。
He then produced the remaining passbooks and asked Liu Er to deliver them.

“这好办，
“That's easily done.

都交给我好了。”
Leave them all to me.

刘二问道，“你说，还有什么吩咐？”
Now, what else can I do for you?”

“不敢当，二叔！
“You are too kind, Second Uncle.

就是这件事。”
That is all.”

“那我就不留你了，
“Then I won't keep you.

自己人说老实话，上头还有公事要回，
Between ourselves, I have official business to report upstairs.

改天再叙吧！”
We'll talk another day.”

刘庆生出了抚台衙门，先不回阜康，
Leaving the governor's office, Liu did not return directly to Fukang.

顺路到大源去看孙德庆，把那两张“户部官票”取了出来供大家赏鉴，同时想打听打听这件事的来龙去脉。
He stopped at Dayuan to see Sun Deqing, producing the two official notes for everyone to inspect and hoping to learn how the affair had come about.

“隐隐约约听见过，要发官票。
“I'd heard a vague report that official notes were to be issued.

也没有什么动静，官票居然就发了出来了，
There seemed to be no further news, and now here they are!

上头做事情好快！”
The authorities have been quick.”

“军饷紧急，
“The need for military funds is urgent.

不快不行。”另有个大源的股东说，
They have to be quick,” said another Dayuan shareholder.

“我看浙江也快通行了。”
“I expect they'll soon be circulating in Zhejiang.”

“这种官票也不晓得发多不？
“I wonder how many of these notes they intend to issue.

说是说‘愿将官票兑换银钱者，与银一律”，如果票子太多，现银不足，那就……
They say anyone wishing to exchange them for silver or cash will be treated as though holding silver, but if there are too many notes and too little actual silver, then...”

“孙德庆摇摇头不再说下去。
Sun shook his head and left the rest unsaid.


刘庆生懂他的意思，心生警惕，
Liu understood his meaning and became wary.

回到店里，看胡雪岩还在，便将去看刘二的经过，说了一遍，最后又提到“户部官票”。
Back at the bank, finding Hu still there, he described his visit to Liu Er and finally mentioned the official notes.

胡雪岩仔细看了看说：“生意越来越难做，不过越是难做，越是机会。
Hu examined them carefully. “Business grows harder every day, but the greater the difficulty, the greater the opportunity.

庆生，这官票上头，将来会有好多花样，
Qingsheng, there will be all sorts of possibilities in these notes.

你要仔细本相一相““我看，将来官票一定不值钱。”
Think them through carefully.” “I believe they'll certainly lose their value.”

胡雪岩认为他的话太武断了些，
Hu thought this too sweeping.

信用要靠大家维持，
Confidence had to be sustained by everyone.

如果官票不是滥发，章程又定得完善，市面使用，并无不便，则加上钱庄、票号的支持，官票应该可以维持一个稳定的价值，
If the notes were not issued excessively, if sound regulations were established and the notes could be used conveniently, then, with support from private banks and remittance houses, they ought to retain a stable value.

否则，流弊不堪设想。
Otherwise, the abuses that might arise were beyond imagining.

他要刘庆生去“仔细想”的，就是研究官票信用不佳时，要能会发生的各种毛病，以及如何避免，甚至如何利用这些毛病来赚钱。
What he wanted Liu to think through was the various problems that might develop if confidence in the notes weakened: how to avoid those problems, and even how to profit from them.


“你要记住一句话，”他说：
“Remember this,” he said.

“世上随便什么事，都有两面，
“Everything in the world has two sides.

这一面占了便宜，那一面就要吃亏。
When one side gains, the other loses.

做生意更是如此，
That is particularly true of business.

买卖双方，一进一出，天生是敌对的，
Buyer and seller, one taking in and the other paying out, are natural opponents.

有时候买进占便宜，有时候卖出占便宜，
Sometimes the advantage lies in buying, sometimes in selling.

会做生意的人，就是要两面占它的便宜，涨到差不多了，卖出，跌到差不多了，买进，
A capable businessman must gain both ways: sell when prices have risen far enough, buy when they have fallen far enough.

这就是两面占便宜。”
That is how you gain on both sides.”

刘庆生也是很聪明的人，只是经验差些，
Liu was intelligent; he merely lacked experience.

所以听了胡雪岩的指点，心领神会，自觉获益不浅。
He understood Hu's guidance and felt he had learned a great deal.

但如何才知道涨跌呢？
But how was one to anticipate the rises and falls?

当然要靠自己的眼光了，而这眼光又是哪里来的呢？
By one's own judgement, of course—but where did that judgement come from?

他把他的疑问提出来请教，胡雪岩的神色很欣慰，
He put the question to Hu, who looked gratified.

“你这话问得好。”他说，
“An excellent question.

“做生意怎么样的精明，十三档算盘，盘进盘出，丝毫不漏，这算不得什么！
However shrewd you are, however perfectly you work your thirteen-column abacus, counting every penny in and out without the slightest error, that isn't the great thing.

顶要紧的是眼光，
What matters most is vision.

生意做得越大，眼光越要放得远，
The larger your business, the farther you must look.

做小生意的，譬如说，今年天气热得早，看样子这个夏天会很长，早早多进些蒲扇摆在那里，
In a small business, for instance, if hot weather comes early and you think the summer will be long, you stock up on palm-leaf fans ahead of time.

这也是眼光。
That too is vision.

做大生意的眼光，一定要看大局，
But a great business requires a view of the whole situation.

你的眼光看得到一省，就能做一省的生意，
If your vision takes in a province, you can do business throughout that province.

看得到天下，就能做天下的生意，
If it takes in the empire, you can do business throughout the empire.

看得到外国，就能做外国的生意。“
If it takes in foreign countries, you can do business abroad.”


这番话在刘庆生真是闻所未闻，
Liu had never heard anything like this.

所以在衷心钦佩之外，不免也有些困惑，
Along with heartfelt admiration, he felt some bewilderment.

“那么，胡先生，我倒要请教你，”他说，“你现在是怎么样个看法呢？”
“Then may I ask, Mr Hu, what is your own view of things at present?”

“我是看到天下！”
“I look at the whole empire.”

胡雪岩说话一向轻松自如，
Hu usually spoke with easy assurance.

这时却是脸色凝重，仿佛肩上有一副重担在挑着，
Now his expression grew grave, as though he bore a heavy burden on his shoulders.

“ ‘长毛’不成大事，
“The Longhairs will achieve nothing lasting.

一定要败。
They are bound to be defeated.

不过这不是三年两年的事，
But it won't happen in two or three years.

仗有得好打，
There is a great deal of fighting still to come.

我做生意的宗旨，就是要帮官军打胜仗。”
The guiding purpose of my business is to help the imperial armies win.”

“胡先生，”刘庆生微皱着眉，语音嗫嚅：“你的话我还不大懂。”
“Mr Hu,” Liu murmured, frowning slightly, “I still don't quite understand.”

“那我就说明白些。”胡雪岩答道，
“Then I'll put it plainly.

“只要能帮官军打胜仗的生意，我都做，哪怕亏本也做，
I'll undertake any business that helps the imperial armies win, even at a loss.

你要晓得这不是亏本，是放资本下去，
You must understand that it isn't really a loss: it is capital invested.

只要官军打了胜仗，时世一太平，什么生意不好做？
Once the imperial armies win and peace returns, what business won't prosper?

到那时候，你是出过力的，
By then you will have made a contribution.

公家自会报答你，做生意处处方便。
The government will naturally repay you, and every path will be open to your business.

你想想看，
Think of it!

这还有个不发达的？”
How could you fail to rise?”

这一说，刘庆生随即想到王有龄。
Liu immediately thought of Wang Youling.

胡雪岩就是有眼光，在王有龄身上“放资本下去”，才有今天。
It was Hu's foresight in investing capital in Wang that had brought him to his present position.

于是欣然意会：“我懂了，
With delighted understanding, he said, “I see!

我懂了！”
I see!”


因为有此了解，他对“户部官票”的想法就不同了，
This understanding changed his view of the official notes.

原来是料定它会贬值，最好少碰它，
Previously he had assumed that they would depreciate and ought to be avoided as far as possible.

这时认为官票一发出来，首先要帮它站稳，
Now he believed their first need, on being issued, was help in establishing themselves.

真如胡雪岩所说的“信用要靠大家来维持”，
As Hu had said, confidence had to be sustained by everyone.

自己既能够作阜康的主，便在这一刻就下了决心，要尽力支持官票。
Since he had authority to act for Fukang, he resolved then and there to support the notes with all his strength.

过了两天，钱业公所发“知单”召集同业开会，要商量的就是官票如何发行？实际上也就是如何派销。
Two days later, the bankers' guild circulated a notice summoning its members to discuss how the official notes were to be distributed—in practice, how the obligation to take them was to be apportioned.

除了“户部官票”以外，还有钱票，
Besides the Board of Revenue silver notes, there were notes denominated in copper cash.

公所值年的执事，取来了几张样本，彼此传观，
The guild's presiding officer for the year brought samples, which passed from hand to hand.

钱票的形式跟银票差不多，
Their form resembled that of the silver notes.

平头横列四个字：“大清宝钞”，中间直行写明“准足制钱××文”，
Across the top stood “Great Qing Treasure Note”; down the centre, “Equivalent to ... Standard Copper Cash.”

两边八个字：“天下通宝，平准出入”，
At the sides were the words, “Currency throughout the realm; equal value in payment and receipt.”

下方记载：“此钞即代制钱行用，
The inscription below read, “This note shall circulate in place of standard copper cash.

并准按成交纳地丁钱粮，一切税课捐项，
It may also be used, in the prescribed proportions, to pay land and poll taxes, grain levies, and all other taxes and contributions.

京外各库，一概收解。”
All treasuries, in the capital and the provinces, shall accept and remit it.”

“现在上头交下来，二十万两银票，十万千钱票。
The presiding officer explained, “The authorities have assigned us two hundred thousand taels in silver notes and a hundred thousand strings in cash notes.

规定制钱两千抵银一两，十万千就等于五万两银子，
At the prescribed rate of two thousand cash to one tael, those hundred thousand strings equal fifty thousand taels.

一共是二十五万两。”值年的执事停了一下说：
The total is therefore two hundred and fifty thousand taels.” He paused.

“大小同行，如何派销，
“How should we apportion the distribution among the large and small banks?

请大家公议。”
Let us discuss it together.”


“部里发下来的票子，市面上不能不用。
“Since the ministry has issued these notes, the market cannot refuse to use them.

不过这要靠大家相信官票才好。顾客如果要现银，钱庄不能非给他票子不可。我看这样，“张胖子说道：”公所向藩库领了银票和钱票来，按照大小同行，平均分派，
But that depends on people trusting them,” said Fat Zhang. “If a customer wants actual silver, a bank cannot insist that he accept paper. I suggest this: let the guild collect the silver and cash notes from the provincial treasury and distribute them fairly among the banks, according to their size.

尽量去用，或者半个月，或者十天结一次帐，用掉多少，缴多少现款进去。
We shall use as many as we can, and settle every ten or fifteen days, paying in actual money for whatever we have put into circulation.

钱庄不要好处，完全白当差。
The banks will take no profit; we shall perform the service for nothing.”

“虽无好处，也不背风险，所以张胖子的办法，立刻获得了同业的赞许，纷纷附和。
Though the proposal offered no profit, it imposed no risk either, and the bankers promptly voiced their approval.

“这办不到。”值年的执事大摇其头，
The presiding officer shook his head. “That won't do.

“上头要十足缴价，
The authorities wanted full payment.

情商了好半天，才答应先缴六成，其余四成分两个月缴清。”
After lengthy negotiations, they agreed to accept sixty per cent immediately, with the remaining forty per cent paid over two months.”

这话一说，彼此面面相觑。
They looked at one another in dismay.

大家都知道，那值年的执事，素来热心维护同业的利益，
Everyone knew that the presiding officer had always defended the trade's interests zealously.

能够争到有利条件，他一定会出死力去争，
If a favourable condition could be obtained, he would fight to the utmost for it.

他争不到，别人更无办法。
What he could not secure, no one else could.

现在就只有商量如何分派了。
The only question left was how to divide the obligation.


谈到这一层，又有两派意见，
Here, too, opinion split.

大同行主张照规模大小，平均分派，小同行则要求由大同行先认，认够了就不必再分派给小同行。
The larger banks wanted an equitable allocation according to size; the smaller ones wanted the larger houses to subscribe first, so that if the total was covered, nothing need be imposed on them.

你一言，他一语，相持不下。
Argument followed argument, with no resolution.

刘庆生以后辈新进，不敢率先发言，
As a newcomer and a junior, Liu had not ventured to speak first.

等那些同业中有面子的人，都讲过了还未谈出一个结果，他觉得该自己当仁不让了。
But when all the influential men had spoken without reaching agreement, he felt he should no longer hold back.

“我倒有个看法，说出来请同行老前辈指教，”他说，
“I have a view which I should like to submit to my seniors for correction,” he said.

“缴价六成，领票十足，
“We pay sixty per cent and receive the full value in notes.

等于公家无息贷款四成，
That amounts to an interest-free government loan of forty per cent.

这把算盘也还打得过，
The calculation is not unreasonable.

再说，官票刚刚发出来，
Besides, these notes have only just been issued.

好坏虽还不晓得，不过我们总要往好的地方去想，不能往坏的地方去想。
We cannot yet know how they will turn out, but we ought to look for a good outcome rather than assume a bad one.

因为官票固然人人要用，但利害关系最密切的是我们钱庄，
Everyone will use them, certainly, but the banks have the closest interest of all.

官票信用不好，第一个倒霉的钱庄，
If confidence in the notes fails, we shall be the first to suffer.

所以钱庄要帮官票做信用。”
We must therefore help establish that confidence.”

“唷！”张胖子心直口快，惊异地接口，
“Well!” Fat Zhang interrupted with his usual frankness.

“看不出小刘倒还有这番大道理说出来！”
“Who would have expected young Liu to produce such an argument?”

“道理说得对啊！”值年的执事，大为赞赏，望着刘庆生点点头说，
“A sound argument!” The presiding officer nodded at Liu with warm approval.

“你这位小老弟，请说下去。”
“Please continue, my young friend.”


受了这番鼓励，刘庆生越发神采飞扬了：
Encouraged, Liu became still more animated.

“阜康新开，资格还浅，
“Fukang has only just opened, and our standing is still modest.

不过关乎同行的义气，决不敢退缩。
But where loyalty to our fellow bankers is concerned, we shall never hold back.

是分派也好，是认也好，阜康都无不可。”
Whether the notes are allotted or taken by voluntary subscription, Fukang is willing.”

“如果是认，阜康愿意认多少？”
“If we proceed by subscription, how much would Fukang take?”

值年的执事，看出刘庆生的态度，有意要拿他做个榜样，便故意这样问。
The presiding officer had recognised Liu's attitude and deliberately asked the question, hoping to make him an example.

刘庆生立即作了一个盘算，
Liu calculated at once.

大同行本来八家，现在加上阜康是九家，
There had been eight large banks; with Fukang there were now nine.

小同行仍旧是三十三家。
The smaller banks still numbered thirty-three.

如果照大同行一份，小同行半份的比例来派销那二十五万银子的票钞，每一份正差不多是一万西银子。
If the two hundred and fifty thousand taels were divided on the basis of one share for a large bank and half a share for a small one, each full share would be approximately ten thousand taels.

他的心算极快，而且当机立断，所以指顾之间，已有了肯定了答复：
Quick at mental arithmetic and prompt in decision, he had his answer in an instant.

“阜康愿意认销两万。”
“Fukang will undertake twenty thousand.”

“好了！”值年的执事很欣慰他说，
“Excellent!” The presiding officer was delighted.

“头难、头难，
“The beginning is the difficult part.

有人开了头就不难了。
Once someone begins, it is no longer difficult.

如果大同行都象阜康一样，就去掉十八万，
If all the large banks follow Fukang, that will account for a hundred and eighty thousand.

剩下七万，小同行分分，事情不就成功了。”
Divide the remaining seventy thousand among the smaller houses, and the business is settled.”


“好嘛！”孙德庆捧刘庆生的场，
“Very good!” Sun Deqing came to Liu's support.

“大源也认两万。”
“Dayuan will also take twenty thousand.”

捧场的还有张胖子。不过他的捧法跟孙德庆不同，
Fat Zhang supported him too, but differently.

特意用烘云托月的手法来抬高阜康的地位：
By deliberately placing his own contribution below Fukang's, he made its standing shine all the brighter.

“信和认一万五。”他大声喊着。
“Xinhe takes fifteen thousand!” he called.

于是有人认一万五，有人认一万，
Some subscribed fifteen thousand, others ten thousand.

小同行也两千、三千地纷纷认销，
The smaller banks offered two or three thousand each.

总结下来，二十五万的额子还不够分派，反要阜康和大源匀些出来。
When the figures were totalled, the two hundred and fifty thousand were not enough to satisfy the subscriptions: Fukang and Dayuan actually had to surrender part of their allocations.

那值年的执事姓秦，自己开着一家小钱庄，
The presiding officer, whose surname was Qin, ran a small bank himself.

年高德助，在同业中颇受尊敬，
An elderly man of respected character, he enjoyed considerable esteem among his fellows.

由于刘庆生的见义勇为，使得他能圆满交差，心里颇为见情。
Liu's readiness to act had enabled him to discharge his responsibility successfully, and he was grateful.

而刘庆生也确是做得很漂亮，同业都相当佩服。
The others, too, admired how handsomely Liu had acquitted himself.

因此，阜康这块招牌，在官厅、在同行，立刻就很响亮了。
Fukang's name immediately became prominent both in official circles and among the bankers.

这些情形很快地传到了胡雪岩耳朵里，深感欣慰，
News soon reached Hu, who was deeply pleased.

“庆生！”他用很坦率的语气说，“我老实跟你说，阜康新开，情形还不知道怎么样？
“Qingsheng, to tell you frankly, Fukang was so new that I couldn't know how it would turn out.

所以我不敢离开，
That is why I dared not leave.

照现在的样子、我可以放心到湖州去了。”
Now I can go to Huzhou with an easy mind.”

“我也说实话，胡先生，
“And I'll speak frankly too, Mr Hu.

不是你那天开导我，眼光要放得远，我对认销官票，还真不敢放手去做！”
If you hadn't taught me the other day to look farther ahead, I would never have dared commit myself so freely to taking those notes.”


* * *一切都安排好了，
Everything was arranged.

自然是坐张家的船，
Naturally, Hu would travel in the Zhang family's boat.

行李都已经发到了船上，只待胡雪岩一下船就走，来了个意外的消息：麟桂调任了！
His luggage had already been sent aboard, and they were waiting only for him to embark when unexpected news arrived: Lingui had been transferred.

消息是海运局的周委员特地来告诉他的，
Commissioner Zhou had come expressly from the Sea Transport Bureau to tell him.

“麟藩台的兄弟在当‘小军机’，
“Treasurer Lin's brother is a secretary to the Grand Council.

特地专人送信，
He sent a special messenger.

调署江宁藩司，上谕也快到了。
The treasurer is to act as provincial treasurer at Jiangning; the imperial edict should arrive soon.

不过，”同委员神色严重而诡秘地，“有件事，无论如何要请老兄帮忙！”
But...” Zhou's expression became grave and secretive. “There is one matter in which we must have your help.”

只要帮得上忙，胡雪岩无不尽力，
Whenever he could help, Hu spared no effort.

当时使用很恳切的语气答道：“你尽管说！”
He answered earnestly, “Tell me.”

“麟藩台私人有两万多银子的亏空，
“Treasurer Lin has a personal deficit of more than twenty thousand taels in the accounts.

这本来算不了什么，不过，黄抚台的为人，你是晓得的，
Ordinarily that would be nothing, but you know Governor Huang's character.

落不得一点把柄在把手里，
We must leave no handle in his grasp.

所以藩台的意思，想托你替他借一笔钱，先垫补了亏空再说。
The treasurer therefore hopes you can arrange a loan to cover the deficit first.

江宁的缺，比浙江好得多，
The Jiangning post is much better than Zhejiang.

等他一到了任，总在半年以内，一定可以还清。
Once he takes office, he can certainly repay the whole sum within six months.

雪岩兄，”周委员的声音越发低了。
Xueyan...” Zhou lowered his voice still further.

“这完全是因为麟藩台晓得你有肝胆，做事妥当隐秘，才肯说这话。
“He has approached you only because he knows your courage and loyalty, and how discreetly and reliably you conduct affairs.

一切都‘尽在不言中’了！”
Everything else goes without saying.”


“请问，这笔款于什么时候要用？”
“When will the money be needed?”

“总在十天以内。”
“Within ten days.”

“好的，
“Very well.

一句话。”答应得太爽快，反使得周委员将信将疑，
Consider it settled.” Hu agreed so readily that Zhou almost doubted him.

愣了一会才问出一句话：“那么，利息呢？”
After a moment's silence, he asked, “And the interest?”

胡雪岩想了一下，伸出一个指头。
Hu thought, then raised one finger.

“一分？”
“One per cent a month?”

“怎么敢要一分？
“How could I dare charge one per cent?

重利盘剥是犯王法的。”胡雪岩笑道：
Extortionate interest is against the law.” Hu laughed.

“多要了，于心不安，
“If I ask too much, my conscience troubles me.

少要了，怕麟大人以为我别有所求，
If I ask too little, His Honour may think I want some other favour.

所以只要一厘。”
So I'll ask only one-tenth of one per cent a month.”

“一厘不是要你贴利息了吗？”
“At that rate, won't you be making up the interest yourself?”

“那也不尽然。
“Not necessarily.

兵荒马乱的时候，尽有富家大户愿意把银子存在钱庄里，不要利息，只要保本的。”
In these troubled times, plenty of wealthy families are willing to leave their silver in a bank without interest, provided their principal is safe.”


“那是另一回事。”周委员很激动他说，
“That is another matter,” Zhou said, deeply moved.

“雪岩兄，象你这样够朋友的，说实话，我是第一次遇见。
“Xueyan, frankly, I have never met anyone who stands by a friend as you do.

彼此以心换心，
Let us deal openly with one another.

你也不必客气，
You need not stand on ceremony.

麟藩台的印把子，此刻还在手上，可以放两个起身炮，
Treasurer Lin still holds his seal and can fire a few parting shots before he leaves.

有什么可以帮你忙的，惠而不费，你不必客气，尽管直说。”
If there is anything he can do for you, some favour that costs him nothing, speak freely.”

说到这样的话，胡雪岩还要假撇清，就变得做作而见外了。
After such words, further professions of disinterest would seem artificial and distant.

于是他沉吟了一会答道：“眼前倒还想不起，
Hu considered briefly. “Nothing occurs to me immediately.

不过将来麟大人到了新任，江宁那方面跟浙江有公款往来，
But once His Honour takes up his new appointment, there will be public remittances between Jiangning and Zhejiang.

请麟大人格外照顾，指定交阜康汇兑，让我的生意可以做开来，那就感激不尽了。”
If he could favour Fukang by directing that we handle them, so that I might extend the business, I should be deeply grateful.”

“这是小事，
“A small matter.

我都可以拍胸捕答应你。”
I can promise you that myself.”


等周委员一走，胡雪岩立刻把刘庆生找了来，告知其事，要凑两万五千银子给麟藩台送了去。
As soon as Zhou left, Hu sent for Liu, explained the affair, and asked him to assemble twenty-five thousand taels for Treasurer Lin.

“银子是有。不过期限太长怕不行。”刘庆生说，
“The money is available, but I fear we cannot spare it for so long,” Liu said.

“销官票的一万二千，已经打了票子出去，
“We have already issued a draft for the twelve thousand due on the official notes.

存款还有限，
Deposits are still limited.

凑不出两万五。除非动用同业的‘堆花’，不过最多只能用一个月。”
We cannot make up twenty-five thousand unless we use the goodwill deposits from the other banks, and those can be used for no more than a month.”

“有一个月的期限，还怕什么？
“With a month, what is there to fear?

萝卜吃一截剥一截，
Peel the radish as you eat it, a section at a time.

‘上忙’还未了，
The first revenue collection is not over.

湖州的银粮地丁还在征，
Huzhou is still collecting silver, grain, and land and poll taxes.

十天半个月就有现款到。
Cash will arrive in ten or fifteen days.

庆生，”胡雪岩说，“我们的生意一定要做得活络，
Qingsheng, we must keep our business flexible.

移东补西不穿绷，就是本事。
The skill lies in moving funds from one place to another without letting a gap show.

你要晓得，所谓‘调度’，调就是调动，度就是预算，预算什么时候有款子进来，预先拿它调动一下，
Think of what ‘managing funds’ means: you forecast when money will come in and put it to use beforehand.

这样做生意，就比人家走在前面了。”
That is how you stay ahead of other people.”

刘庆生也懂得这个道理，不过自己不是老板，魄力方面当然差些，
Liu understood the principle, but since he was not the proprietor, his nerve was naturally less robust.

现在听胡雪岩这么说，他的胆也大了，
Hu's words emboldened him.

“既然如此，我们乐得做漂亮些。”他说，
“In that case, we may as well do it handsomely.

“早早把银子送了去。”
Let us send the silver early.”


“这话不错。
“Quite right.

你去跑一趟，
Go yourself.

以后凡是象这样的情形，都是你出面。
From now on, you will represent us whenever this sort of thing arises.

你把空白票子和书柬图章带了去，问周委员怎么开法？
Take blank drafts and the correspondence seal, and ask Commissioner Zhou how they should be made out.

票子多带几张。”
Take several drafts.”

“好的。”
“Very well.

刘庆生又问：“借据呢？”
What about the promissory note?”

“随他怎么写法。
“Let them write it as they please.

哪怕就麟藩台写个收条也可以。”
Even a simple receipt from Treasurer Lin will do.”

这样的做法，完全不台钱庄的规矩，背的风险甚大。
This was wholly contrary to banking practice and entailed considerable risk.

不过刘庆生早就看出这位老板与众不同，所以并不多说。
But Liu already knew that his proprietor was an unusual man, so he said no more.

当时带着书柬图章和好几张空白票子去看周委员，
Taking the seal and several blank drafts, he went to see Zhou.

胡雪岩也收拾收拾随身日用的什物，预备等刘庆生一回来，问清楚了经过情形，随即上船到湖州。
Hu gathered his personal necessities, intending to hear Liu's account on his return and then embark for Huzhou immediately.


这一等等了许久，
He waited a long time.

直到天黑，才看见他回店，脸上是那种打牌一吃三，大赢特赢的得意之色。
Not until dark did Liu return, wearing the triumphant expression of a card player who had collected from all three opponents and won handsomely.

一看他的神态，胡雪岩便已猜到，或有什么意外的好消息，而他此行的圆满，自更不待言。
From his face, Hu guessed that there was unexpected good news; that the mission itself had succeeded went without saying.

为了训练他的沉着，胡雪岩便用提醒他的语气说：“庆生！有话慢慢说！”
To train him in composure, Hu gave him a gentle reminder. “Qingsheng! Take your time in telling me.”

刘庆生也很机警，发觉他的语气和态度是一面镜子，照见自己不免有些飞扬浮躁，
Liu was quick enough to recognise that Hu's tone and manner were a mirror, reflecting his own exuberance and impatience.

所以惭愧地笑了一下，坐下来粑个手巾包放下，抹一抹汗，才从容开口。
With an embarrassed smile, he sat down, put aside a bundle wrapped in a handkerchief, wiped his perspiration, and began calmly.

“我见着了麟藩台，
“I saw Treasurer Lin.

十分客气。
He was exceedingly courteous.

事情已经办妥了，
Everything is settled.

由麟藩台的大少爷，出的借据，周委员的中保。”
His eldest son has signed the promissory note, with Commissioner Zhou as intermediary and guarantor.”

说着他把借据递了给胡雪岩。
He offered the document to Hu.

“我不必看！”胡雪岩摆一摆手说，
“I needn't see it.” Hu waved it aside.

“麟藩台可有什么话？”
“Did the treasurer have anything to say?”

“他说很见阜康的情。
“He said he was deeply obliged to Fukang.

又说，有两件事已经交代周委员了，
He has also given Zhou instructions on two matters.

这两件事，实在是意外之喜。”
Both are truly unexpected good fortune.”


说着，刘庆生的神色又兴奋了。这也难怪他，实在是可以令人鼓舞的好消息。
His excitement returned, understandably enough: the news was genuinely encouraging.

据周委员告诉刘庆生，钱业公所承销官票，已禀复到藩台衙门，其中对阜康踊跃认销，特加表扬。
Zhou had told him that the guild's report on taking up the official notes had reached the provincial treasury, with special praise for Fukang's enthusiastic subscription.

麟藩台因为公事圆满，相当高兴，
Lingui was pleased that the public business had been concluded so satisfactorily.

又因为阜康的关系不同，决定报部，奏请褒奖，
Moreover, because his relationship with Fukang was now different, he had decided to report to the ministry and request an imperial commendation.

刘庆生认为这在同业中是很有面子的事。
Liu thought this would bring great prestige among their fellow bankers.

“这是你的功劳。”胡雪岩说，
“That is your achievement,” Hu said.

“将来褒奖又不止面子好看，
“And a commendation would bring more than prestige.

生意上亦大有关系。
It would have a considerable effect on business.

因为这一来，连部里都晓得阜康的招牌，京里的票号，对我们就会另眼相看，
Once even the ministry knows Fukang's name, the remittance houses in the capital will regard us differently.

以后有大宗公款汇划，就吃得开了。”
We shall be well placed when large public remittances are to be handled.”

这又是深一层的看法，刘庆生记了在心里，
This was a deeper view, and Liu stored it away.

接着又说第二件事。
He then turned to the second matter.

“这件事对我们眼前的生意，大有帮助。”
“This one will help our immediate business enormously.

刘庆生忽然扯开话题问道：“胡先生，我先要请教你，什么叫‘协饷’？”
But first, Mr Hu,” he abruptly broke off to ask, “what exactly are ‘supplementary military funds’?”


这个名称刚行了不久，
The term had only recently come into use.

胡雪岩听王有龄和杨用之谈过，可以为刘庆生作很详细的解释：
Hu had heard Wang Youling and Yang Yongzhi discuss it, and could give a detailed explanation.

“户部的岁入有限，
“The Board of Revenue's annual receipts are limited.

一年应该收四千万，实际上收不到三千万，
It should collect forty million taels a year, but in fact receives fewer than thirty million.

军饷不过维持正常额数，
The military appropriation covers only the ordinary establishment.

现在一打长毛，招兵募勇，平空加了十几万兵，
Now, with the Longhairs to fight, troops and volunteer forces have been recruited, suddenly adding well over a hundred thousand men.

这笔军费哪里来？
Where is the money to come from?

照明朝的办法，凡遇到这种情形，都是在钱粮上按亩‘加派’。
Under the Ming, in such circumstances, an additional levy was imposed on every mu of taxable land.

大清朝是‘永不加赋’的，
But the Great Qing has promised ‘never to increase taxation.’

那就只有不打仗、市面比较平定的省份多出些力，想办法帮助军饷，
The only course is for provinces where there is no fighting and trade remains comparatively stable to make a greater effort and find ways to help meet military expenses.

就称为‘协饷’。
That is what ‘supplementary military funds’ means.

协饷不解部，直接解到各大营粮台。”
They are not sent to the ministry, but directly to the supply offices of the major camps.”

“这就对了。”刘庆生说：
“Then that explains it,” Liu said.

“浙江解‘江甫大营’的协饷，麟藩台已经吩咐，尽量交阜康来汇。”
“Treasurer Lin has ordered that Zhejiang's supplementary remittances to the Jiangnan Grand Camp should be handled by Fukang as far as possible.”

“那太好了！”这一下连胡雪岩都不由得喜形于色，
“Splendid!” Now even Hu could not conceal his delight.

“我正在筹划，怎么样把生意做到上海和江苏去？
“I've been considering how to extend our business to Shanghai and Jiangsu.

现在天从人愿，
Heaven has granted my wish.

妙极，
Excellent!

妙极！”
Excellent!”

“不过胡先生，这一来，湖州你一时不能去了，
“But, Mr Hu, this means you cannot leave for Huzhou just yet.

这方面我还没有做过，
I have no experience in this field.

要请你自己出马。”
You will have to handle it personally.”

“好的。
“Very well.

等我来料理，
Leave it to me.

我也要请张胖子帮忙，才能把这件事办通。”他说，
I shall need Fat Zhang's help to get it arranged.

“第一步先要打听江南大营的粮台是驻扎在苏州，还是哪里？”
First, we must find out whether the Jiangnan camp's supply office is at Suzhou or somewhere else.”


当时站起身来就想到盐侨信和，
He stood, intending to go straight to Xinhe at Yanqiao.

转念一想，
Then he reconsidered.

这么件大事，究竟还只是凭刘庆生的一句话，
An undertaking of this importance still rested solely on Liu's report.

到底款数多少，
How much money was involved?

汇费如何，
What would the remittance charges be?

暗底下还有没有别的花样？
Were there any other arrangements beneath the surface?

都还一无所知，此时便无从谈起。
He knew none of these things, and therefore had no basis for discussion.

至少要等跟周委员见了面，把生意敲定了再去求教同行，
He should at least see Zhou and secure the business before asking a fellow banker for advice.

万一下成，落个后柄在外面，对阜康的信誉大有影响。
If it came to nothing, he would have furnished others with something to talk about, damaging Fukang's credit.

于是他定定心坐了下来，
He composed himself and sat down again.

“湖州是一定要晚几天才能走了。”他说，
“Huzhou must certainly wait a few days.

“事情是件好事，不过要慎重，
This is good news, but we must be careful.

心急不得。
Impatience will not help.

而且象这样的事，一定会遭同行的妒，所以说话也要小心。”
An affair like this is also sure to arouse envy among our fellow bankers, so we must be cautious in what we say.”

这是告诫刘庆生，不可得意忘形。
It was a warning to Liu not to let success turn his head.

对刘庆生来说，恰是一大警惕，
He needed it.

从开业以来，事事顺利，刘庆生的态度，不知不觉间，总有些趾高气扬的模样。
Since opening, everything had gone smoothly, and without realising it he had acquired a rather self-important air.

这时听得胡雪岩的提醒，自己平心静气想一想，不由得脸上发热，敛眉低眼，
Hearing Hu's reminder, he reflected calmly, felt his face grow hot, and lowered his eyes.

很诚恳地答道：“胡先生说得是。”
“You are right, Mr Hu,” he answered earnestly.


看他这样的神态，胡雪岩非常满意，
Hu was very pleased by his manner.

“庆生！”他也有些激动，拍着他的肩说：
“Qingsheng!” A little moved himself, he patted the young man's shoulder.

“我们的事业还早得很呢！
“Our enterprise still has a long way to go.

刚刚才开头，
We have only just begun.

眼前这点点算不了什么。
This little success is nothing.

我就愁一天十二个时辰不够用，
My worry is that the twenty-four hours in a day are not enough.

有个好帮手，你看我将来搞出什么样一番市面？
Give me a good assistant, and you'll see what a business I can build.

我的市面要摆到京里，摆到外国，
I mean to extend it to the capital, and abroad.

人家办下到的我办得到，才算本事。
The real achievement is to do what others cannot.

你好好做，
Work hard.

有我一定有你！“
Whatever I gain, you will share.”


* * *胡雪岩不但觉得一天十二个时辰不够用，而且幻想着最好分身有术，
Hu not only felt that the hours of the day were insufficient; he wished he could divide himself in two.

眼前就有两外地方都需要他即时亲自去一趟，才能铺排得开。
At that very moment, two places required his personal and immediate presence before matters could be arranged.

一处当然是湖州，
One, of course, was Huzhou.

不但老张开丝行要他实地去看了，做个决定，
Old Zhang needed him to inspect the proposed silk firm and make a decision.

而且王有龄专人送了信来，“上忙”征起的钱粮，到底是交汇，还是使个手法就地运用？
In addition, Wang had sent a special messenger with a letter asking what should be done with the taxes collected in the first instalment: should they be remitted, or could some arrangement be made to employ them locally?

因为王有龄奉了委札，要到浙皖交界之处去视察防务，不能久待，
Wang had received orders to inspect the defences along the Zhejiang-Anhui border and could not wait long.

要他赶紧到湖州会面。
He urged Hu to come to Huzhou at once.

一处是上海。
The other place was Shanghai.

他已经跟周委员见过面，
Hu had now seen Zhou.

据说，浙江的协饷，原是解缴现银，
Zhejiang's supplementary military funds had originally been dispatched in actual silver.

但以江南大营围金陵，江北大营围扬州，水陆两路都怕不安靖，
But with the Jiangnan Grand Camp besieging Jinling and the Jiangbei Grand Camp surrounding Yangzhou, neither land nor water routes could be relied on to remain secure.

所以最近跟江南大营的粮台商议决定，或者汇解上海，或者汇解苏州，视需要随时通知。
After discussions with the Jiangnan camp's supply office, it had recently been decided to remit the money either to Shanghai or to Suzhou, with instructions sent whenever the need arose.

江南大营的粮台，现在派了委贝驻上海，要求由浙江承汇的钱庄，有个负责人跟他去协商细节。
The supply office had stationed a commissioner in Shanghai and wanted a responsible representative of the Zhejiang bank to meet him there and settle the details.

这件事刘庆生办不了，
Liu could not handle this.

就算办得了，一个到湖州，一个到上海，杭州本店没人照料也不行。
Even if he could, with one of them in Huzhou and the other in Shanghai, no one would remain to manage the Hangzhou bank.

筹思了好一会，胡雪岩叹口气对刘庆生说：“人手不够是顶苦恼的事。
After lengthy thought, Hu sighed. “Nothing is more troublesome than a shortage of people.

从今天起，他也要留意，多找好帮手。
From today, you too must watch for good assistants.

象现在这样，好比有饭吃不下，
At present it is as though food were set before us and we couldn't eat it.

你想可惜不可惜？“
Isn't that a pity?”


“吃不下怎么办？”
“What are we to do if we can't eat it?”

“那还有什么办法，
“What else can we do?

只好请人来帮着吃。
Invite someone to help us.

江南大营的协饷，”
These supplementary funds for the Jiangnan camp...”

胡雪岩沉吟了一下问道：“大源老孙为人如何？”
Hu paused. “What sort of man is old Sun at Dayuan?”

刘庆生懂得他的意思，
Liu understood.

“孙先生人是再规矩扎实都没有。
“You couldn't find a more upright and dependable man.

不过，”他说，“阜康跟信和的关系不同，
But Fukang's connection with Xinhe is a special one.

胡先生，你为何不分给信和来做？”
Why not share the business with them?”

“你不是想跟大源做联号吗？
“Didn't you want to establish an affiliation with Dayuan?

这道理很容易明白，
The principle is simple.

要想市面做得大，自然把关系拉得广。”胡雪岩说，
To enlarge our field of business, we must widen our connections.

“下次如果有别样要联手的生意，我们另外再找一定。
When another opportunity for joint business arises, we shall find yet another firm.

这样子下去，同行都跟阜康的利害相关，
If we go on that way, every bank will have an interest bound up with Fukang.

你想想看，我们的力量，会大到怎么样一个地步？”
Imagine how strong we shall become.”

胡雪岩最善于借助于他人的力量，但他总是在两利的条件下谈合作，所以他人亦乐力所用。
Hu excelled at drawing on other people's strength, but he always proposed cooperation on terms beneficial to both sides, so others gladly placed their abilities at his disposal.

大源的孙德庆就是如此，
Sun Deqing was a case in point.

对于阜康愿意与他合做承汇江南大营协饷的生意，十分感激，
He was deeply grateful that Fukang would share the Jiangnan remittance business with him.

而让他出面到上海去接头，更觉得是胡雪岩给他面子，
Being asked to represent them in Shanghai seemed a further mark of respect.

因而死心塌地支持阜康，自动表示把那一万二千两银子的“堆花”，改为同业长期政款。
He became a wholehearted supporter of Fukang and volunteered to convert his twelve-thousand-tael goodwill deposit into a long-term interbank loan.

于是阜康放给麟桂的那笔款子，一半有了着落。
Half the loan to Lingui was thus provided for.


另一半是得到了一笔意想不到的存款，
The other half was covered by an unexpected deposit.

就在胡雪岩动身到湖州的前一天，傍晚时分来了一名军官，手里提着一个很沉重的麻袋，
On the evening before Hu's departure for Huzhou, a military officer arrived carrying a very heavy sack.

指名要看“胡老板”。
He asked specifically for “Proprietor Hu.”

“请坐，请坐！”刘庆生亲自招待，奉茶敬烟，
Liu attended to him himself, offering tea and tobacco. “Please sit down.

“敝东因为要到湖州，已经上船了。
Our proprietor is leaving for Huzhou and has already gone aboard his boat.

有话跟我说，也是一样。”
You may tell me whatever you wish to say; it will be the same.”

“不！
“No.

我一定要当面跟胡老板说。
I must speak to him in person.

能不能请他回来一趟，或者我到船上去看他。”
Could he be asked to come back, or could I go to his boat?”

既然如此，没有不让他去看胡雪岩的道理，
There was no reason to prevent the meeting if he insisted.

事实上胡雪岩也还不曾上船，是刘庆生的托辞，
In fact, Hu had not yet boarded the boat; that was merely Liu's excuse.

这时候便说：“那么，我去把敝东请了来。
“Then I'll ask him to come.

请问贵姓？”
May I have your name?”

那人把姓名官衔一起报了出来：“我叫罗尚德，钱塘水师营十营千总。”
The visitor gave both name and rank. “Luo Shangde, company commander in the Tenth Battalion of the Qiantang naval force.”

“好！
“Very good.

罗老爷请坐一坐，
Please wait a moment, Mr Luo.

我马上派人去请。”
I'll send for him at once.”


等把胡雪岩从家里找了来，
Hu was fetched from his house.

动问来意，罗尚德把麻袋解开，只见里面是一堆银子，有元宝，有圆丝，还有碎银子，土花斑斓，仿佛是刚从泥上里掘出来的。
When he asked the purpose of the visit, Luo opened the sack, revealing a heap of silver: large ingots, round ingots, and broken pieces, all mottled with earth as though freshly dug from the ground.

胡雪岩不解，
Hu was puzzled.

他是不是要换成整锭的新元宝？
Did the man want it recast into whole new ingots?

那得去请教“炉房”才行。
That would require a visit to a silver-melting shop.

正在这样疑惑，罗尚德又从贴肉口袋里取出来一叠银票，放在胡雪宕面前。
While he wondered, Luo drew a bundle of notes from an inner pocket and laid them before him.

“银票是八千两。”他说，
“The notes amount to eight thousand taels,” he said.

“银子回头照秤，
“You can weigh the silver presently.

大概有三千多两。
There should be a little over three thousand.

胡老板，我要存在你这里，
Proprietor Hu, I want to deposit it here.

利息给不给无所谓。”
It doesn't matter whether you pay interest.”

“噢！”胡雪岩越发奇怪，
“Oh!” Hu was still more surprised.

看不出一个几两银子月饷的绿营军官。会有上万银子的积蓄。
Who would have imagined that a Green Standard officer, paid only a few taels a month, could have savings of more than ten thousand?

他们的钱来得不容易，出息不好少他的，
Such men did not acquire money easily; he ought not to be deprived of a proper return.

所以这样答道：“罗老爷，承篆你看得起小号，
“Mr Luo, we are honoured by your confidence in our little establishment.

我们照市行息，
We pay the current market rate.

不过先要请问，存款的期限是长是短？”
But first, may I ask whether this will be a short- or long-term deposit?”


“就是这期限难说。”
“The term is precisely what I cannot say.”

罗尚德紧皱着他那双浓密的眉毛，一只大手不断摸着络腮胡子，仿佛遇到了极大的难题。
Luo knitted his thick brows and repeatedly stroked his beard with a large hand, as though faced with a formidable problem.

“这样吧，是活期。”
“Then let it be a deposit payable on demand.”

胡雪岩谈生意，一向派头很大，
Hu was always generous in his manner of doing business.

“不论什么时候，罗老爷要用，就拿折子来取好了。”
“Whenever you need it, bring your passbook and withdraw it.”

“折子倒不要了。
“I don't need a passbook.

我相信你！”
I trust you.”

事情愈出愈奇，
The affair grew stranger by the moment.

胡雪岩不能不问了：“罗老爷，我要请教，你怎么能存一万多银子，连个存折都不要？”
Hu could not refrain from asking, “Mr Luo, how can you deposit more than ten thousand taels without even wanting a passbook?”

“要跟不要都一样。
“Having one or not makes no difference.

胡老板，我晓得你的为人，
I know what sort of man you are.

抚台衙门的刘二爷，是我同乡，
Mr Liu Er at the governor's office comes from my home district.

我听他谈过你。
I've heard him speak of you.

不过你不必跟他提起我的存款。”
But there is no need to mention my deposit to him.”

听他这几名话，胡雪岩立即使有两个感想，
Two thoughts immediately occurred to Hu.

一个感想是，罗尚德对素昧平生的他，信任的程度，比相交有年的小同乡还来行深，
First, Luo trusted him, a complete stranger, more deeply than a fellow townsman whom he had known for years.

一个感想是以罗尚德的身分、态度和这种异乎寻常的行为，这可能不是一笔生意，而是一种麻烦。
Second, considering the officer's position, manner, and extraordinary conduct, this might be less a piece of business than a source of trouble.


他是不伯麻烦的，
Hu did not fear trouble.

只觉得罗尚德的对他信任，便是阜康信誉良好的明证，因而对其人其事，都颇感兴趣。
He felt only that Luo's trust was evidence of Fukang's good credit, and became interested both in the man and in his affairs.

看春天色不早，原该招待顾客，
It was growing late, and a customer deserved hospitality.

于是用很亲切随便的语气说道：“罗老爷，看样子你也喜欢‘摆一碗’，
In a friendly, informal tone, he said, “Mr Luo, you look like a man who enjoys a bowl of wine.

我们一面吃酒一面谈，好不好？”
Shall we drink while we talk?”

这个提议，正投其所好，
The proposal suited Luo perfectly.

“要得！”罗尚德是四川人，很爽决地答应：
A Sichuan man, he agreed heartily. “Certainly!

“我不会假客气，
I won't pretend to refuse.

叨扰你！
I'll accept your hospitality.

酒要高粱，
Sorghum liquor for me.

菜不在乎，多给我辣子，越辣越好。”
The food doesn't matter, but give me plenty of chilli—the hotter the better.”

“对路了！”胡雪岩笑道：
“Then you've come to the right place!” Hu laughed.

“我有两瓶辣油，辣得喉咙会冒烟，
“I have two bottles of chilli oil so hot they make your throat smoke.

实在进不了，
I simply can't manage them.

今天遇见识家了。”说着，便喊小徒弟到“皇饭儿”去叫菜，
Today I've found a connoisseur.” He called an apprentice and sent him to Huangfan'er for dishes.

酒是现成有的，黄白俱全，整坛摆在饭厅里，
There was already plenty to drink, both rice wine and spirits, standing in whole jars in the dining room.

再有一样“辣子”，他告诉小徒弟说：“阿毛！
As for the chilli, he added, “A-Mao!

你到我家里跟胡太太说，有人送的两瓶平望辣油，找出来交给你。”
Go to my house and ask Mrs Hu to find the two bottles of Pingwang chilli oil someone gave us and send them back with you.”


等小徒弟一走，胡雪岩照规矩行事，
After the apprentice left, Hu followed proper procedure.

把刘庆生请来，先招呼两名伙计，用天平秤麻袋里的银子，当着罗尚德的面点清楚，
He called Liu and had two clerks weigh the silver on a balance and check it in Luo's presence.

连银票两共一万一千两挂零，
With the notes, it came to a little over eleven thousand taels.

胡雪岩建议，存个整数，零头由罗尚德带回，
Hu suggested depositing the round sum and letting Luo take back the remainder.

他同意了。
He agreed.

银票收拾清楚，酒菜已经送到，
By the time the money and notes had been put in order, the dishes had arrived.

拉开桌子，连刘庆生一共三个人小酌，
The table was opened out, and the three men sat down for a drink.

不一会阿毛把两瓶辣油取了来。
Soon A-Mao returned with the two bottles of chilli oil.

这种辣油是吴江附近一个平望镇的特产，能够制得把红辣椒溶比在菜油中，其辣无比，
A speciality of Pingwang, near Wujiang, it was made by incorporating red chillies into rapeseed oil and was extraordinarily hot.

胡雪岩和刘庆生都不敢领教，
Neither Hu nor Liu dared attempt it.

罗尚德却是得其所哉，大喊“过瘾”不止。
Luo, however, was entirely in his element and repeatedly cried, “Wonderful!”

“胡老板，”罗尚德开始谈他自己，“你一定没有遇到过我这样的主顾，
At last he began to speak of himself. “Proprietor Hu, you must never have encountered a customer like me.

说实活，我自己也觉得我这样做法，不免叫人起疑。”
To tell the truth, even I feel that my way of doing things is bound to arouse suspicion.”

“不是叫人起疑心。”胡雪岩纠正他的说法，
“Not suspicion,” Hu corrected him.

“叫人觉得必有一番道理在内。”
“It makes one feel there must be a particular reason.”

“对了，
“Exactly.

就是有一番道理在内。”
There is a particular reason.”


据罗尚德自己说，他是四川巴县人，
By his own account, Luo came from Ba County in Sichuan.

家境相当不坏，但从小不务正业，
His family had been comfortably placed, but from childhood he had neglected every proper occupation.

嫖赌吃着，无所不好，
Brothels, gambling, drinking—he loved them all.

是个十足的败家子，因而把高堂父母气得双双亡故。
A thorough wastrel, he had driven both parents to their graves through distress and anger.

他从小订过一门亲，
A marriage had been arranged for him while he was young.

岳家也是当地乡绅，
His prospective wife's family belonged to the local gentry.

看见罗尚德不成材，虽未提出退婚的要求，却是一直不提婚期。
Seeing how badly he had turned out, they never mentioned a wedding date, though they made no formal demand to break the engagement.

罗尚德对于娶亲倒不放在心上，
Marriage scarcely concerned Luo.

没有赌本，才是最伤脑筋的事，不时向岳家伸手告贷，
His real worry was finding money to gamble, and he repeatedly borrowed from the family.

最后一次，他那未来的岳父，托媒人来说，罗尚德前后用过兵家一万五千银子，
Finally, his prospective father-in-law sent the matchmaker with a message: Luo had taken fifteen thousand taels from them in all.

这笔帐可以不算，
That debt could be cancelled.

如果罗尚德肯把女家的庚帖退还，他另外再送一千银子，不过希望他到外县去谋生，
If he returned the girl's betrothal document, they would give him another thousand, provided he went elsewhere to earn a living.

否则会在家乡沦为乞丐，替他死去的父母丢脸。
Otherwise, he would become a beggar in his home district and disgrace his dead parents.

这对罗尚德是个刻骨铭心的刺激，
The humiliation cut Luo to the bone.

当时就当着媒人的面，撕碎了女家的庚帖，并且发誓，做牛做马，也要把那一万五千银子的债务了清。
In the matchmaker's presence, he tore the betrothal document to pieces and swore that, even if he must labour like an ox or a horse, he would repay the fifteen thousand taels.

“ ‘败子回头金不换！’”胡雪岩举杯相敬，
“A prodigal's reform is beyond the price of gold!” Hu raised his cup to him.

“罗老爷，一个人就怕不发愤。”
“Mr Luo, the only real failure is never to make the effort.”


“是啊！”罗尚德大口喝着酒说：
“Indeed!” Luo drank deeply.

“第二天我就离了重庆府，搭了条便船出川。
“The next day I left Chongqing, found a boat going downriver, and left Sichuan.

在船上心想，大话是说出去了，哪里去找这一万五千两银子？
On board, I thought: I've made my grand declaration, but where am I to find fifteen thousand taels?

到了汉口有人就说，不如去投军，
At Hankou, someone suggested joining the army.

打了胜仗有赏号，
Victories brought rewards.

若能图个出身，当上了官儿，就有空缺好吃。
If I could win promotion and become an officer, there would be vacant soldiers' places whose pay I could draw.

我心想反正是卖命了，这条命要卖得值，
I thought that if I must sell my life, I had better get a decent price.

投军最好。
The army seemed best.

正好那时候林大人招兵……”
Just then His Excellency Lin was recruiting...”

林大人是指林则徐。
He meant Lin Zexu.

道光二十年五月，英国军队，集中澳门，计划进攻广州。
In the fifth month of the twentieth year of Daoguang, British forces had concentrated at Macao, preparing to attack Guangzhou.

两广总督林则徐大治军备，
As governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi, Lin greatly strengthened the defences.

在虎门设防，两岸列炮二百余门，并有六十艘战船，同时招募新兵五千，
He fortified the Bogue, placing more than two hundred guns along its shores, with sixty warships, and recruited five thousand new soldiers.

罗尚德就是这样辗转投身水师的。
By this circuitous route Luo entered the naval service.

但是在广东他并没有打仗，
He did not, however, fight in Guangdong.

因为林则徐备战的声势甚壮，英军不敢轻犯，
Lin's preparations were so formidable that the British dared not attack directly.

以二十六艘战舰，改道攻定海，分路内犯，
With twenty-six warships they changed course for Dinghai, then advanced inland along separate routes.

浙江巡抚和提督束手无策。
Zhejiang's governor and provincial commander were helpless.

朝命两江总督伊里布为钦差大臣，赴浙江视师，福建提督余步去驰援，
The court appointed Yilibu, governor-general of Liangjiang, as imperial commissioner to inspect military affairs in Zhejiang, and ordered Fujian's provincial commander Yu to bring reinforcements.

在广州的新募水师，亦有一部分调到了浙江。
Some of the newly recruited naval troops at Guangzhou were also transferred to Zhejiang.

“我就是这么到了杭州的。”罗尚德说，
“That is how I came to Hangzhou,” Luo said.

“运气还不坏，
“My luck hasn't been bad.

十三年工夫，巴结上了一个六品官儿，也积蓄了上万银子。
In thirteen years I've worked my way up to a sixth-rank post and saved more than ten thousand taels.

胡老板，我跟你说老实话，这些银子有来得艰难的，也有来得容易的。”
I'll be honest with you, Proprietor Hu: some of that silver was hard earned, and some came easily.”


来得难难是省吃俭用，一文钱一文钱地累积，
The hard-earned part had been saved copper by copper through strict economy.

来得容易是吃空缺，分贼赃，
The easy part came from drawing the pay of unfilled places and sharing in criminals' proceeds.

不然积蓄不来一万一千银子。
Otherwise, he could never have accumulated eleven thousand taels.

绿营军官，暮气沉沉，无不是没有钱找钱，有了钱花钱，
The officers of the Green Standard were dispirited men: those without money sought it, and those who had it spent it.

只有罗尚德别具一格，
Luo alone behaved differently.

有钱就埋在地下，或者换成银票藏在身上，
Whenever he obtained silver, he buried it or exchanged it for notes to conceal on his person.

不嫖不赌不借给人。
He neither visited brothels nor gambled nor lent to others.

有人劝他合伙做贩私盐之类的生意，可以赚大钱，他亦不为所动，
Some urged him to join enterprises such as smuggling salt, where large profits could be made, but he remained unmoved.

因此，在同事之中，他被目为怪物。
His colleagues consequently regarded him as an oddity.

“他们说他们的，
“Let them say what they like.

我打我自己的主意。
I have my own plan.

我在打算，再有三年工夫，一万五千银子大概可以凑满了，
I reckon another three years should bring me up to fifteen thousand.

那时候我就要回川去了。”
Then I'll go home to Sichuan.”

“到那一无可就扬眉吐气了！”
“That will be a proud day!”

胡雪岩颇为感动，心里在想，有机会可以帮他挣几文，
Hu was moved and thought he might find some opportunity to help Luo earn a little.

但转念又想，此人抱定宗旨不做生意，
But then he remembered the man's firm refusal to engage in business.

自己的一番好意，说出口来碰个钉子可犯不上，
Why offer goodwill only to have it rejected?

因而欲言又上。
He held his tongue.


“不过胡老板，现在怕不行了。”
“But now, Proprietor Hu, I'm afraid it may not work out.”

“怎么呢？”
“Why?”

“上头有命令下来，
“Orders have arrived.

我们那一营要调到江苏去打长毛。”
Our battalion is to go to Jiangsu to fight the Longhairs.”

罗尚德的神情显得抑郁，
Luo looked depressed.

“不是我说句泄气的话，绿营兵打土匪都打不了，
“I don't wish to sound faint-hearted, but the Green Standard troops can't even defeat bandits.

打长毛怎么行？
How are they to fight the Longhairs?

这一去实在不太妙，
This expedition looks very bad.

我得打算打算。
I have to make arrangements.”

““喔！”胡雪岩很注意地问，
“Oh?” Hu asked attentively.

“怎么个打算？”
“What arrangements?”

“还不是这一万一千多银子？
“For these eleven thousand taels, of course.

我在这里无亲无眷，
I have no family here.

抚台衙门的刘二爷，人倒也还不错，可是我不能托他，
Mr Liu Er at the governor's office is a decent enough man, but I cannot entrust it to him.

他是跟着黄大人走的，
He follows His Excellency Huang.

万一黄大人调到边远省份，譬如说贵州巡抚，四川总督，或者到京里去做官，
Suppose Huang is transferred to a distant province—to become governor of Guizhou, say, or governor-general of Sichuan—or receives a post in the capital.

刘二爷自然跟了去。
Liu Er would naturally go with him.

那时候，几千里路，我怎么去找他？”
How would I find him then, thousands of li away?”

“这也说得是。
“That is true.

阜康是开在杭州不会动的，
Fukang is established in Hangzhou and will stay here.

罗老爷随时可以来提款。”
You can come to withdraw your money whenever you wish.”

“一点不错！”罗尚德很舒畅地喝了一大口酒，
“Exactly!” Luo took a long, satisfied drink.

“这一下，胡老板你懂我的意思了。”
“Now you understand me.”


“我懂，我懂！”
“I do, I do.”

胡雪岩心里盘算了一会，接下来说：“罗老爷，承蒙你看得起阜康，当我一个朋友，那么，我也很爽快，
Hu calculated briefly. “Mr Luo, since you have honoured Fukang with your confidence and treated me as a friend, I'll be equally straightforward.

你这笔款子准定作为三年定期存款，
We shall make this a three-year fixed deposit.

到时候你来取，本利一共一万五。
When you collect it, principal and interest together will amount to fifteen thousand taels.

你看好不好？”
Will that suit you?”

“这，这怎么不好？”
“How... how could it not?”

罗尚德惊喜交集，满脸的过意不去。
Surprise and delight mingled in Luo's face, along with embarrassment at receiving so much.

“不过，利息太多了。”
“But that is too much interest.”

“这也无所谓，
“That doesn't matter.

做生意有赚有蚀，要通扯算帐。
In business one gains here and loses there; the accounts must be considered as a whole.

你这笔款子与众不同，
Your deposit is different.

有交情在内。
Friendship enters into it.

你尽管放心去打仗，
Go and fight with an easy mind.

三年以后回重庆，带一万五千两银子去还帐。
Three years from now, you can take fifteen thousand taels back to Chongqing and repay your debt.

这三年，你总另外还有收入，积下来就是盘缠。
You will have other income during those three years; save it for travelling expenses.

如果成在身边不方便，你尽管汇了来，
If it is inconvenient to keep it with you, send it here.

我替你入帐，照样算利息给你。”
I'll credit your account and pay interest on it too.”

这番话听入罗尚德耳中，就好比风雪之夜，巡逻回营，濯足上床，只觉四肢百骸，无不熨帖，
Hearing this, Luo felt as a soldier might after returning from patrol on a snowy night, washing his feet, and settling into bed: every limb was comforted.

想到三年以后，携金去访旧时岳家的那一刻，
He imagined the moment, three years hence, when he would visit his former prospective in-laws with the silver.

真正是人生得意之秋，
That would truly be a triumphant season of his life.

越觉陶然。
The thought filled him with contentment.


“胡老板，怪不得刘二爷提起你来，赞不绝口，
“Proprietor Hu, no wonder Mr Liu Er cannot praise you enough.

跟你结交，实在有点味道。”
There is something very satisfying about your friendship.”

“我的宗旨就是如此！”胡雪岩笑道，
“That is my principle!” Hu laughed.

“俗语道得好：”在家靠父母，出外靠朋友‘，
“As the saying goes, at home you rely on your parents; abroad, on your friends.

我是在家亦靠朋友，所以不能不为朋友着想。
I rely on friends even at home, so I must think of their interests.

好了，事情说定局了，
Well, that is settled.

庆生，你去立个折子来。
Qingsheng, prepare a passbook.”

““不必，不必！”罗尚德乱摇着手，
“No, no!” Luo waved his hands.

“就是一句话，
“Your word is enough.

用不着什么折子，
There is no need for a passbook.

放在我身上，弄掉了反倒麻烦。”
If I carry it and lose it, it will only cause trouble.”

“不是这样说！
“That won't do.

做生意一定要照规矩来，
Business must follow proper rules.

折子还是要立，
A passbook must be opened.

你说放在身上下方便，不妨交给朋友。
If carrying it is inconvenient, leave it with a friend.”

““那我就交给你。”
“Then I'll leave it with you.”

“也好！”
“Very well.”

胡雪岩指着刘庆生说，“交给他好了。
Hu pointed to Liu. “Leave it with him.

我这位老弟，也是信义君子，
This young friend of mine is a man of honour and good faith.

说一句算一句，
His word can be relied on.

你放心。”
Set your mind at rest.”

“好极！
“Excellent!

那就重重拜托了！”
Then I entrust everything to you.”

罗尚德站起身来，恭恭敬敬作了个揖，接着告辞而去。
Luo rose, made a respectful bow, and took his leave.


等客人一走。刘庆生再也无法强持，
Once the guest had gone, Liu could contain himself no longer.

兴奋之情，溢于词色，忙不迭地要谈他心中的感觉。
Excitement shone in his face and voice as he hurried to express his feelings.

“胡先生，我门的生意，照这样子做下去，用不着半年，基础就可以打稳了。”
“Mr Hu, if business continues like this, we shall have a firm foundation within six months.”

“慢慢来！”胡雪岩的神色，依然十分沉着，
“One step at a time.” Hu remained entirely composed.

“照我的预料，罗尚德今天回去，会跟他的同事去谈这回事，
“I expect Luo will tell his colleagues about this when he returns tonight.

看样子‘兵大爷’的存款还会得来，
More deposits from our military gentlemen may follow.

不管多少，都是主顾，
Whatever the amount, they are customers.

你关照伙计们，千万要一样看待，不可厚此薄彼。
Tell the clerks to treat them all alike, without favouring one over another.

态度尤其要客气，
Courtesy is especially important.
