这些‘兵大爷’，好讲话比什么人都好讲话，难弄起来也比什么人都难弄。”
These military gentlemen can be easier to deal with than anyone, but when they become difficult, no one is more troublesome.”

“是，是！
“Yes, yes.

我晓得。”
I understand.”


于是胡雪岩当夜就上了船，
Hu went aboard that very night.

因为天气太热，特地跟阿珠的娘商量好，夜里动身，泊在拱宸桥北新关下，
Because of the heat, he had specially arranged with A’zhu's mother to set out after dark and moor below the Beixin customs station by Gongchen Bridge.

等天一亮就“讨关”，趁早风凉尽力赶一程，到日中找个风凉地方停泊，等夜里再走。
At daybreak they would clear the barrier and travel as far as possible in the cool morning, then find a shaded place to stop at noon and continue after nightfall.

这样子坐船的和摇船的，大家都舒服，
Passengers and boatmen would all be more comfortable.

所以不但阿珠和她母亲乐从，连阿四和另外雇来的一个伙计也都很高兴。
A’zhu and her mother willingly agreed, and even A-Si and the additional hired hand were pleased.


橹声欸乃中，胡雪岩和阿珠在灯下悄然相对。
With the rhythmic creak of the sculling oar around them, Hu and A’zhu sat quietly facing each other in the lamplight.

她事先用心打扮，穿着月白竹布的散脚裤和黑纺绸单衫，
She had taken special care over her appearance, wearing loose-legged trousers of pale cotton and a fitted black silk jacket.

黑白相映，十分合宜。
The contrast of black and white suited her well.

船家女儿多不缠足，平日也常赤脚；今晚她穿着一双绣花拖鞋。
Like most boatmen's daughters, she had unbound feet and often went barefoot; tonight she wore embroidered slippers.

胡雪岩注意到鞋上的绣样。
Hu noticed the embroidery.

阿珠不好意思，缩了缩脚，说：‘你不要看嘛！’
“Don't look!” she said, drawing her feet back.

他说自己是在看拖鞋，她才把鞋上的花样展示给他。
“I'm looking at your slippers. Let me see them.” Reassured, she showed them to him.

他仔细看了看，问鞋面是什么料子，
“What material are the uppers?” he asked, examining them.

又请她也替自己做一双。
“Will you make me a pair too?”


“不肯！”她笑着答了这一句，
“No!” she answered with a smile.

站起来走了进去，捧出一册很厚很大的书来。
Then she rose, went inside, and returned with a large, thick book.

翻开一看，里面压着绣花的花样和五色丝线。
Pressed between its pages were embroidery patterns and silk threads of many colours.

胡雪岩挑了个“五福捧寿”的花样，指定用白软缎来绣。
Hu chose a design of five bats surrounding the character for longevity and specified soft white satin.

“白缎子不经脏，
“White satin shows the dirt.

用蓝的好了。
Blue would be better.”

“不要紧，
“Never mind.

不会脏的。”
They won't get dirty.”

“又来骗人了！”阿珠说：
“Another story!” A’zhu said.

“天天在地上拖，怎么不会脏？”
“How could they stay clean if you drag them over the ground every day?”

“你当我真的要穿？
“Do you think I mean to wear them?

我还舍不得呢？
I couldn't bear to.

做好了摆在那里，想你的时候，拿出来看看。”
I'll put them away, and when I miss you, take them out to look at.”

一句话把阿珠说得满脸通红，但心里是高兴的，
She blushed, pleased despite her embarrassment.

窘笑着骂了句：“你的脸皮真厚！”
With an awkward little smile, she said, “You have such a thick skin!”


那份娇媚的神态，着实叫胡雪岩动情，真想一把将她搂在怀里。
Her manner moved Hu, and he wished to embrace her.

但窗开两面，前后通风，怕船梢上摇橹的阿四看见了不雅，
But the cabin windows stood open on both sides for ventilation, and A-Si might see them from the stern.

只得强自忍耐着。
He restrained himself.

阿珠也不开口，
A’zhu said nothing either.

把胡雪岩的拖鞋，当作一件正经大事，立刻就翻书找丝线，配颜色，低着着聚精会神地，忘了旁边还有人在。
Treating his slippers as a serious undertaking, she immediately searched the book for threads and matched the colours, concentrating so completely that she forgot he was beside her.

“此刻何必忙着弄这个？”胡雪岩说，
“Why work on that now?” Hu asked.

“我们谈谈。”
“Let's talk.”

“你说，
“Go on.

我在听。”
I'm listening.”

“好了，好了。”胡雪岩粑她那本书台拢，
“Enough, enough.” He closed the book.

“我讲件妙事给你听。”
“I have an interesting story for you.”


他讲的就是罗尚德的故事，添枝加叶，绘声绘影，
He told her Luo Shangde's story, embellishing it and bringing every scene to life.

阿珠把每一个字都听了进去了。
A’zhu listened to every word.

“那么，”阿珠提出疑问：“那位小姐怎么样？
“But what about the young lady?” she asked.

是不是她也嫌贫受富？
“Did she too despise poverty and admire wealth?

或者恨罗尚德不成材，不肯嫁他？
Or did she refuse to marry him because she resented his being such a wastrel?”

““这，”胡雪岩一愣，“我倒没有问他。”
Hu paused. “I didn't ask him.”

“为啥不问？”
“Why not?”

问得无理？胡雪岩有些好笑：
The question seemed unreasonable, and he was amused.

“早知道你关心那位小姐，我一定要问他。”
“Had I known you would be so concerned about the young lady, I certainly would have asked.”

“本来说该问的。
“You ought to have asked anyway.

他不讲，你也不问，好象那位小姐，根本就不是人。”
He never mentioned her, and you never asked—as though she weren't a person at all.”

阿珠撇着嘴说：“天下的男人，十个倒有九个没良心。”
She pursed her lips. “Nine men out of ten have no conscience.”

“总还有一个有良心的。”胡雪岩笑道，
“That still leaves one who has.” Hu smiled.

“我不在那九个之内。”
“I'm not among the nine.”

“也不见得。”
“I'm not so sure.”

“不见得坏。是不是？”
“Not so sure I'm bad, you mean?”

“厚皮！”她刮着脸羞他。
“Shameless!” She drew a finger down her cheek to mock him.


为此又勾起阿珠的满腹心事。
The exchange revived all A’zhu's private anxieties.

她娘把找张胖子做媒的事，都瞒着她，她脸皮嫩也不好意思去问，
Her mother had concealed the arrangements to ask Fat Zhang to act as matchmaker, and she was too shy to inquire.

只是那天“纯号”小聚，隐隐约约看出她娘有意托张胖子出面来谈这场喜事，
At their little gathering aboard Chunhao, she had vaguely perceived that her mother wanted Zhang to approach Hu about the marriage.

但到底怎么了呢？
But what had happened?

月下灯前，一个人悄悄地不知思量过多少遍，却始终猜不透其中的消息。
Alone by moonlight or lamplight, she had turned the question over countless times without discovering the answer.

眼前是个机会，但她踌躇无法出口，
Here was an opportunity, yet she hesitated.

第一是不知用怎样的话来试探？
First, she could not find the words with which to probe.

第二又怕试探的结果，完全不是那么一回事，
Second, she feared that her inquiry might reveal there was nothing in it at all.

这个打击受不起，
That disappointment would be unbearable.

反倒是象现在这样混沌一团，无论如何还有个指望在那里！
In the present confusion, at least she still had something to hope for.

一个人这样想得出了神，只见她睫毛乱闪，双眉低敛，
Absorbed in her thoughts, she lowered her brows and blinked repeatedly.

胡雪岩倒有些猜不透她的心事，
Hu could not quite guess what occupied her.

只觉得一个男人，辛苦终日，到晚来这样灯下悄然相对，实在也是一种清福。
He only felt that, after a man's hard day's work, sitting quietly opposite someone in the lamplight was a rare and peaceful pleasure.

因此，他也不肯开口说话，静静坐着，恣意饱看秀色。
He too remained silent.

这样也不知过了多少时候，阿珠终于如梦方醒似地，茫然四顾，仿佛不知身在何处？
Neither knew how much time passed before A’zhu seemed to wake from a dream and looked around, bewildered, as though unsure where she was.


看到胡雪岩诡秘的笑容，她有些不安，
Hu's secretive smile made her uneasy.

不知道自己有什么秘密被他看穿了，
Had he seen through some private thought?

因而嗔道：“贼秃嘻嘻地，鬼相！”
“What are you grinning at, you wicked creature?”

“咦！”胡雪岩笑道：
“Why!” he laughed.

“我什么地方冒犯你了？
“How have I offended you?

我又不曾开口。”
I haven't said a word.”

“我就恨你不开口！”
“That's just what I resent—you never say anything!”

这句话意思很深，
There was depth in the remark.

胡雪岩想了想问道：“你要我开口说什”我怎么晓得？
Hu considered it. “What do you want me to say?” “How should I know?

嘴生在你身上、
The mouth is yours.

有话要你自己说。
If you have something to say, say it yourself.”

““我要说的话很多，
“I have a great deal to say.

不晓得你喜欢听哪一句？”
I don't know which part you would like to hear.”

这回答很有点味道，阿珠细细咀嚼着，心情渐渐舒坦，
She savoured this answer, and her spirits gradually eased.

话很多，就表示日久天长说不完，
A great deal to say implied a long time in which to say it.

那就不必心急，慢慢儿说好了。
There was no need to hurry; they could take their time.


“我们谈谈生意。”胡雪岩问，
“Let's discuss business,” Hu said.

“你爹带回来的口信怎么说？”
“What message did your father send?”

“房子寻了两处，人也有两个，
“He has found two buildings and two men.

都要等你去看了，才好定局。”
Nothing can be settled until you inspect them.”

“房子好坏我不懂……不是房子好坏不懂，地点好坏我不晓得，
“I don't know whether a building is good or bad—or rather, I know about the building itself, but not the location.

总要靠近水陆码头才方便。
It ought to be near the land and water transport terminals.

人呢，如果两个都好就都用。”
As for the men, if both are good, we'll employ both.”

“那两个人一个姓王，一个姓黄，
“One is surnamed Wang and the other Huang.

都是蛮能干的，
Both are very capable.

可惜只能用一个。”
Unfortunately, we can only employ one.”

“为啥？”
“Why?”

“他们心里不和。”阿珠答道，
“They don't get on.

“‘一山不能容二虎，这句话，你都不知道？”
Haven't you heard that one mountain cannot hold two tigers?”

“我自然知道。”胡雪岩说：
“Of course I have.

“不会用人才怕二虎相争，
Only someone who doesn't know how to employ people fears a struggle between two tigers.

到我手里，不要说两只老虎，再多些我也要叫他服帖。”
In my hands, not merely two but any number would have to behave.”


阿珠心里在想，照他的本事，不见得是吹牛，
Given his abilities, A’zhu thought this might be no empty boast.

不过口中却故意要笑他：“说大话不要本钱！”
Still, she deliberately teased him. “Boasting costs nothing.”

“不相信你就看看好了。”
“If you don't believe me, wait and see.”

胡雪岩笑笑又说，“我就怕两只雌老虎，
He smiled. “It's two tigresses I fear.

那就没本事弄得她们服帖了。”
I couldn't make them behave.”

阿珠心想，这不用说，两只雌老虎一只是指胡太太，一只是指自己。
A’zhu thought the meaning obvious: one tigress was Mrs Hu and the other herself.

她恨不得认真辩白一声：我才不是雌老虎！最她再问一句：你太太凶不凶？
She longed to protest that she was no tigress, and then to ask whether his wife was fierce.

但这些话既不便说，也不宜装作不懂，
But she could neither say these things nor properly pretend not to understand.

她这一阵子已学得了许多人情世故，懂得跟人说话，有明的、暗的各种方法，而有时决不能开口，有时却非说不可，
Lately she had learned much about human dealings: there were open and indirect ways of speaking, times when one must remain silent, and times when one must answer.

现在就是这样，不能不说话。
This was a moment when an answer was necessary.

这句话要说得半真半伪，似懂非懂才妙，
It should be half serious, half playful, suggesting understanding without admitting too much.

所以她想了想笑道：“你这个人太厉害，也太坏，是得有雌老虎管着你才好。”
After a moment, she smiled. “You are so formidable—and so wicked—that you need a tigress to keep you in order.”


“口口声声说我坏，
“You keep calling me wicked.

到底我坏在什么地方？”
What exactly is wicked about me?”

“你啊！”阿珠指着他的鼻尖说：
“You!” She pointed at his nose.

“尽在肚子里用功夫。”
“All your work goes on inside your head.”

“你说我是‘阴世秀才’？”
“Do you mean I'm an ‘underworld scholar’?”

为人阴险，杭州人斥之为“阴世秀才”，特征是沉默寡言，喜怒不形词色，
That was the Hangzhou expression for a sly, treacherous man, whose distinguishing traits were few words and no outward sign of pleasure or anger.

这两点胡雪岩都不象，
Hu was neither silent nor expressionless.

他是个笑口常开极爽郎的人，
He was cheerful, open, and always smiling.

说他“阴世秀才”，阿珠也觉得诬入忒甚，
Even A’zhu felt the accusation would be grossly unfair.

所以摇摇头说：“这倒不是！”
She shook her head. “No, not that.”

“那么我是草包？”
“Then am I a fool?”

“这更不是。
“Certainly not.

啊！
Ah!

我想到了！”
Now I have it.”

阿珠理直气壮地，“这就是你最坏的地方，
She spoke with conviction. “That is your worst fault.

说话总是说得人左也不是，右也不是，不好接口。”
You always talk people into a corner. Whatever they say is wrong, and they don't know how to answer.”

听得这两句话，胡雪岩倒是一愣，
Hu was taken aback.

因为在他还是闻所未闻。
No one had ever told him this before.

细想一想，自己却是有这样在词令上咄咄逼人的毛病，
On reflection, he did have a habit of pressing people too hard with his verbal dexterity.

处世不大相宜，
It was not a good way to deal with others.

倒要好好改一改。
He ought to correct it.


“我说对了没有？”阿珠又问。
“Am I right?” A’zhu asked.

“一个人总有说对的时候。”胡雪岩很诚恳地问，“阿珠，你看我是不是肯认错改过的人？
“Everyone is right sometimes.” Then he asked earnestly, “A’zhu, do you think I'm willing to admit a fault and mend it?

这句话，你要老实告诉我。”
Tell me honestly.”

阿珠点点头：“你的好处，我不会抹煞你的。”
She nodded. “I won't deny your good qualities.”

“我的坏处你尽管说。
“Then tell me my faults freely.

我一定听。”
I shall listen.”

他自然而然地把手伸了过去，阿珠就让他握着，双颊渐渐泛起红晕，加上那双斜睬着的水汪汪的眼睛，平添了几分春色。
He reached for her hand, and she let him hold it, blushing.

夜深了，
It was late.

野岸寂寂，只听见“吱呀、吱呀”和“刷拉、刷拉”摇橹破水的声音，
The banks were deserted and still; only the creak of the oar and the swish of water broke the silence.

阿珠也还听得见自己的心跳，
A’zhu could hear her own heartbeat.

终于忍不住问了一句：“到湖州，你住在哪里？”
At last she could not resist asking, “Where will you stay in Huzhou?”

“我想住在王大老爷衙门里。”
“I think I'll stay at Prefect Wang's yamen.”

“嗯！”阿珠很平静他说，
“Yes,” she said quietly.

“那应该。”
“That would be proper.”


“我在想，”胡雪岩又想到了生意上面，
“I've been thinking,” Hu said, his mind returning to business.

“房子要大，前面开店，后面住家，还要多备客房，
“We need a large building: the shop in front, living quarters behind, and plenty of guest rooms.

最好附带一个小小花园，客房就在小花园里。”
Ideally, there should be a small garden, with the guest rooms opening onto it.”

“要这样讲究？”
“Must it be so elaborate?”

“越讲究越好！”胡雪岩说，
“The more comfortable, the better.

“你倒想想看，
Consider it.

丝的好坏都差下多，价钱同行公议，没有什么上落，
The quality of the silk is much the same everywhere, and prices are fixed by agreement among the trade, with little variation.

丝客人一样买丝，
A merchant can buy silk anywhere.

为什么非到你那里不可？
Why should he insist on buying from you?

这就另有讲究了，
Something else must attract him.

要给客人一上船就想到，这趟到了湖州住在张家，
We must make him think, the moment he boards his boat, ‘When I get to Huzhou, I'll stay with the Zhangs.

张家舒服，
Their house is comfortable.

住得好，吃得好，当客人自己亲人一样看待，
You sleep well, eat well, and are treated like one of the family.’

所谓‘宾至如归’。
Make a guest feel at home.

那时候你想想看，生意还跑得了？
Once you have done that, how can the business escape?”

“其实，胡雪岩所说的也是很浅的道理，但阿珠休戚相关，格外觉得亲切动听，
The principle was simple, but because A’zhu's own fortunes were involved, his words seemed particularly warm and persuasive.

脑中顿时浮现出许多“宾至如归”的景象，
Her mind filled with images of guests made to feel at home.

这些景象在平日也见过，就在她家的船上，并不觉得有什么了不起，
She had seen such scenes many times aboard her family's boat and thought nothing remarkable of them.

而此时想来，却有一种说不出的向往之情。
Now, however, they inspired a longing she could not express.


“别的不敢说，丝客人住在我们家，起码吃得会比别家舒服。”她说，语气是谦抑的。
“I can't promise anything else, but silk merchants who stay with us will at least eat better than elsewhere,” she said modestly.

“那还用得着说？
“That goes without saying.

你娘做的菜，还不把他们吃得下巴都掉了下来……”
Your mother's cooking will leave their jaws hanging...”

“你也是！”阿珠笑着抢他的话，
“Listen to you!” she interrupted with a laugh.

“什么话到了你嘴里，加油加酱，死的都能说成活的。”
“Whatever you say, you add so much sauce and seasoning that you could talk the dead back to life.”

其词有憾，其实深喜，
Her words sounded reproachful, but she was delighted.

胡雪岩适可而止，不再说恭维的话了，
Hu knew when to stop and offered no further compliments.

“阿珠，”他说，“要讲究舒服，讲究不尽，
“A’zhu, there is no end to the ways one can make people comfortable.

将来丝行开起来，外场我还可以照应你爹，里面就全告你们娘儿俩。
Once the silk firm opens, I can help your father with outside affairs, but everything within the house will depend on you and your mother.

而且里面比外场更要紧！”
The inside is even more important than the outside.”


“这我懂。”阿珠答道，
“I understand.

“不过，我又不能象在船上一样，
But it won't be like the boat.

哪晓得丝客人喜欢什么？”
How shall I know what the silk merchants want?”

“这就两样了。
“That is where the difference lies.

在船上，客人作主，怎么说怎么好。
On a boat, the guest directs things, and whatever he says goes.

住到店里来的外路客人，要你作主，
A merchant from elsewhere who stays at your premises expects you to arrange matters.

他不会说话的。”
He won't say much.”

“他说是不说，心里晓得好歹。”
“He may say nothing, but he'll know whether he's been treated well.”

“就是这话罗！”胡雪岩深深点头。
“Exactly.” Hu nodded emphatically.

这对阿珠是绝好的鼓励，因为心领神会，颇有妙悟，
Encouraged, A’zhu grasped the point.

“我只当来了一份亲眷。”她从容自若地，
“I'll simply treat him as a visiting relative,” she said with confidence.

“该当照应他的照应他。
“Attend to whatever needs attending to.

他不要人家照应的，总有他的花样在内，我们就不去管他。”
If he doesn't want our attention, he must have his own reasons, and we'll leave him alone.”

“对啊！”胡雪岩轻轻拍着桌子说，
“Precisely!” Hu tapped the table lightly.

“你懂快窍了！
“You've found the secret.

有的人不懂，
Some people don't understand.

不是不体谅客人，就是体谅得过了分，管头管脚都要管到，
Either they fail to consider their guests, or they carry consideration too far and interfere with every little thing.

反害得客人拘束，吓得下次不敢来了。”
The guest feels constrained and is afraid to return.”


阿珠是很豁达的性情，但不知怎么，跟胡雪岩说话，心思就特别多，
A’zhu was ordinarily broad-minded, but in talking to Hu she somehow became full of private interpretations.

这里便又扯到自家头上。
Once again she brought the subject back to herself.

“你这一说，我倒明白了。”她说：
“Now I understand.

“一定是我娘太亲热，
My mother must have been too friendly.

你怕管头管脚不自由，所以吓得不敢来。
You were afraid of being watched and restricted, so you stayed away.

可是与不是？”
Isn't that it?”

“你啊！”胡雪岩指一指她，不肯再说下去。
“You!” Hu pointed at her, but would say no more.

明明是有指责的话，不肯说出来，
Plainly he had a criticism in mind and was withholding it.

阿珠追问他还是不说，
She pressed him, and still he refused.

于是半真半假地，又象真的动气，又象撒娇，非要胡雪岩说不可。
Half serious and half playful, by turns angry and coaxing, she insisted on an answer.

说也不妨，胡雪岩有意跟她闹着玩，
There was no real reason not to give one; Hu simply wished to tease her.

故意漏这么一句半句去撩拨她。
He let slip a fragment here and there to provoke further questions.

阿珠不知是计，越逼越近，“问罪”问到他身边，动手动脚，恰中心意，终于让他一把抱住，在她脸上“香”了一下。
Unaware of his design, she came closer, demanding an explanation, until he caught her in an embrace and kissed her cheek.


这下阿珠才发觉自己上了当，真的有些动气了。
Only then did A’zhu realise that she had been tricked, and this time she was genuinely upset.

背着灯，也背着胡雪岩，垂着头，久久不语。
Turning her back to both Hu and the lamp, she lowered her head and remained silent for a long while.

先当她是有意如此，他故意不去理她，
At first he thought the behaviour deliberate and chose not to respond.

渐渐发觉不妙，
Gradually he sensed that something was wrong.

走过去想扳过她的身子来，她很快地一扭，用的劲道甚大。
He went over and tried to turn her towards him, but she twisted sharply away.

这就显然不是撒娇了，
This was clearly no playful sulk.

胡雪岩心中一惊，走到她正面定睛一看，越发吃惊。
Alarmed, he stepped in front of her, looked closely, and became still more disturbed.

“这，这是为啥？”他结结巴巴地问。
“What... what is it?” he stammered.

阿珠一看胡雪岩那惶恐的神色，反倒觉得于心不忍，
His frightened expression softened her.

同时也颇有安慰，看出自己在他心目中的分量汲重，
It also comforted her to see how much she mattered to him.

因而破涕而笑。当然，还有些不自然的表情。
She smiled through her tears, though some awkwardness remained.

已生戒心的胡雪岩，不敢再说笑话去招惹她，
Now cautious, Hu dared not tease her again.

依然用极关切的神色问道：“到底为啥？
With the same concern, he asked, “What is wrong?

吓我一大跳。
You gave me a terrible fright.

有什么不如意，或者我说错了什么话，尽管说啊！”
If something has upset you, or if I've said the wrong thing, tell me.”

“没有事！”
“Nothing.”

她收敛了笑容，揩揩眼泪，恢复了神态。
She composed her face, wiped her tears, and recovered herself.

由于这个小小的波折，胡雪岩变得沉默了。得却一直窥伺着她的眼波，深怕一个接应不到，又惹她不满。
The little disturbance made Hu quiet, but he continued watching her expression, afraid that a missed response might upset her again.


“时候不早了。”
“It's getting late.”

船舱外有声音，是阿珠的娘在催促，她没有进舱，
A’zhu's mother called from outside the cabin without entering.

而阿珠却深怕她有所发觉，赶紧向胡雪岩递个眼色，意思是不要说出她曾哭过。
Afraid that she might notice something, A’zhu quickly signalled Hu not to mention the tears.

“干娘！”胡雪岩一面向阿珠点头，一面迎了出去，
He nodded to her and went to meet her mother. “Auntie!

“进来坐！”
Come and sit down.”

她没有不进来的道理，
There was no reason to refuse.

坐定了问道：“胡老爷到湖州去过没有？”
Once seated, she asked, “Have you ever been to Huzhou, His Honour Hu?”

“胡老爷”三个字听来刺耳，
The formal title jarred on his ear.

他不假思索地答道：“干娘，叫我雪岩好了。”
Without thinking, he answered, “Auntie, call me Xueyan.”

这句话碰在阿珠心坎上便是一震！
The words struck A’zhu deeply.

就这句话中，名分己定，
To her, they settled the nature of their relationship.

她象吃了颗定心丸，通体舒泰。笑吟吟地望着她母亲，要着她如何回答？
As though she had swallowed a remedy for anxiety, she felt wholly reassured, and watched her mother smilingly to see how she would answer.

阿珠的娘依然谦虚，
Her mother was still modest.

“不敢当！”
“I couldn't presume.”

她也是眉开眼笑地，
Yet she too was beaming.

“我还是……”
“I had better still...”

“还是”如何呢？
Still do what?

连她自己都不知道该持何态度？
She herself did not know what attitude to take.

阿珠的警觉特高，不肯放过这个机会，
A’zhu, acutely alert, would not let the opportunity slip.

脱口说道：“还是叫雪岩！”
“Call him Xueyan!” she blurted out.

话一出口，发觉过于率真，便又补了一句：“ ‘恭敬不如从命’！”
Realising that she had been too direct, she added, “Obedience is better than ceremony.”


亏她想得出这样一句成语，
It was ingenious of her to produce the saying.

虽用得不很恰当，也算一个很有力的理由，
Though not entirely apt, it provided a forceful reason.

阿珠的娘便说：“这话也是，
Her mother said, “That is true.

我就放肆了。
Then I shall take the liberty.”

口说“放肆”，依然不直喊出来，
But though she spoke of taking the liberty, she still did not actually address him by name.

阿珠心想一不做，二不休，敲钉转脚，把事情做牢靠些，
A’zhu decided that, having begun, she must finish and fasten the matter securely.

“娘！”她说，“那么你叫一声看！”
“Mother, say it once, then.”

这反象有些捉弄人似地，
This sounded almost like mockery.

阿珠的娘微感窘迫，白了她一眼说：“要你来瞎起劲！”
Slightly embarrassed, her mother gave her a reproachful look. “Who asked you to get so excited?”

这母女俩微妙的神态，胡雪岩看得十分清楚，心里觉得好笑，
Hu saw all the subtle expressions passing between mother and daughter and was amused.

自己的话是说得胃失了些，但悔亦无用，
His own remark had been rather careless, but regret would serve no purpose.

事到如今，索性讨阿珠一个欢心。
Since matters had reached this point, he might as well please A’zhu.

于是在脸上堆足了笑容说道：“干娘，大家同一家人一样，
With a broad smile, he said, “Auntie, we're all like one family.

你早就该叫我的名字了。
You should have called me by my name long ago.

阿珠，是不是？
Isn't that right, A’zhu?”

“这一下轮到阿珠受窘了，
Now it was her turn to be embarrassed.

红着脸说，“我不晓得！
“I don't know!” she said, blushing.

我同我娘的事，不要来问我。”
“Don't ask me about matters between you and my mother.”

为了替女儿解围，阿珠的娘终于叫了声：“雪岩！你说得不错，
To rescue her daughter, her mother finally said, “Xueyan, you're right.

大家同一家人一样，
We are like one family.

以后全要靠你照应。”
We shall depend on your care in future.”


“那自然。”
“Naturally.”

胡雪岩有心要看阿珠的羞态。便又转脸问了句：“阿珠，我们是不是一家人？”
Wanting to see A’zhu blush, Hu turned to her again. “A’zhu, aren't we one family?”

“我不晓得！”
“I don't know!”

阿珠又羞又喜，也还有些恼，恼他促狭，故意叫人下不得台。
She was delighted and embarrassed, but also a little annoyed that he should mischievously put her in a position from which she could not escape gracefully.

因为如此，她便赌气不肯跟胡雪岩在一起，但他的念头比她更快，
In a fit of pique she decided to leave him, but he anticipated her.

刚一转身，便被喊住：“阿珠，不要走！
As she turned, he called, “A’zhu, don't go.

我有话谈。”
I have something to discuss.”

“我困了。
“I'm sleepy.

有话明天再说。”她这样回答，
Say it tomorrow.”

而脚步却停在原处。
Yet her feet stayed where they were.

“我说个笑话，
“I'll tell you a joke.

保管你不困。”
I guarantee it will wake you up.”

“睡也还早。”她娘也说，
“It's still early for bed,” her mother added.

“你就再坐一坐。”
“Sit a little longer.”

这一下阿珠便又回身坐了下来，
A’zhu sat down again.

看胡雪岩却不象是说笑话的神情，
Hu did not look as though he intended to tell a joke.

果然，他拍拍她的手背，作了个示意“少安毋躁”的姿势，转脸向他“干娘”说道，“我刚刚在跟阿珠谈，一样开丝行，为哈丝客人非要跟你们打交道不可？
Indeed, after patting her hand to signal patience, he turned to the woman he addressed as “Auntie.” “A’zhu and I were just discussing why, when there are so many silk firms, merchants should insist on dealing with yours.

其中有许多道理。
There are many things to consider.”

““是啊！”提到这一层，阿珠的娘大感兴趣，眼睛都发亮了，
“Indeed!” Her mother's eyes brightened with interest.

“我要听听这些道理看。”
“I should like to hear them.”

“叫阿珠讲给你听。”
“Let A’zhu explain.”

阿珠的兴趣也来了，
A’zhu's interest revived too.

细细讲了一遍，胡雪岩又加以补充，
She gave a detailed account, and Hu added points of his own.

把阿珠的娘听得津津有味，她自然也有许多连胡雪岩都未想到的意见。
Her mother listened with relish and naturally had several ideas that had not occurred even to him.


“雪岩，不是我说，你实在是能干！”
“Xueyan, I must say, you really are capable!”

她停了一下，看一看女儿，终于毅然决然他说了句：“总算是阿珠的命好，
She paused, looked at her daughter, and finally spoke with resolution. “A’zhu is fortunate.

将来一定有福享！”
She will certainly have happiness to enjoy.”

当面锣、对面鼓他说了出来，把阿珠羞得耳根子都红了，
The declaration was so direct that A’zhu blushed to the roots of her ears.

偏偏胡雪岩又似笑非笑地直盯着她看，不但看，还来摸她的手，
Hu made matters worse by looking steadily at her with an almost-smile and reaching for her hand.

这一下把她窘得坐不住了。
She could no longer remain seated.

“哪个要享他的福！”
“Who wants to enjoy his good fortune?”

她霍地站了起来，扭身就走，把条长辫子甩得几乎飞到胡雪岩脸上。
She sprang up and turned away, swinging her long braid so sharply that it almost struck his face.


“你到底要不要享我的福？”胡雪岩摸着她的脸，用低得仅仅只有他自己和阿珠才听得见的声音问。
“Do you want to share my good fortune or not?” Hu asked, touching her cheek and speaking in a voice only A’zhu could hear.

阿珠的脸就伏在他的胸脯上，但是，她听见的是自己的心跳，而且自己觉察到脸上在发烧，
Leaning against him, she could hear her own heartbeat and felt herself blushing.

幸好灯大如豆，不畏人见，所以能够从从容容他说话。
Fortunately, the dim lamplight concealed her embarrassment, allowing her to answer with composure.

“我自然要！”她说，
“Of course I do.

“你的福我不享，哪个来享。”
If I don't, who will?”

“那好。
“Very well.

总有福让你享就是了。”
There will always be good fortune for you to share.”

“我倒要问你了，”她把脸仰起来说，“我娘怎么跟你说的？”
She looked up. “Then let me ask you: what did my mother say to you?”

“什么事，
“About what?

怎么说？”
What did she say?”

“你还要问？”
“Do you need to ask?”

“当然要问。”胡雪岩振振有词他说，
“Naturally I do,” he replied with great assurance.

“事情太多，
“There are so many matters under discussion.

我晓得你指的是哪一桩？”
How can I know which you mean?”


阿珠怪胡雪岩总装糊涂，
“You are always pretending to be an innocent lamb,” A’zhu said resentfully.

说恨不得咬他一口。
“I could bite you.”

他又笑着激她，
“I play the lamb, and you boast.” Hu laughed. “If you dare, I'll admit defeat.”

她果真回应了他的挑衅，直到他喊出声才停下，
“You think I don't dare?” She took his teasing challenge seriously, until he cried out and she stopped.

并追问他服不服。
“Do you admit defeat?” she asked.

胡雪岩又以玩笑回应，
He responded with another teasing challenge.

随后行为越了界。阿珠明确反对并阻止，他便停了下来。
His subsequent behaviour crossed a boundary; she objected and resisted, and he stopped.

看到自己的拒绝得到尊重，她才放心，
Reassured that her objection had been respected, she laughed.

又笑说早知道他没安好心，
“I knew you were up to no good.

果然被自己料中了。
I was right.”


胡雪岩问她衣物的防护系法如此牢靠，自己怎样解开。
Hu asked about the secure fastening of her clothes and how she undid it.

阿珠说自有办法；
“I have my own method, of course.”

他要她示范，
“Show me.”

她刚想照办便明白了他的用意，
She almost demonstrated, then realised his purpose.

说他满肚子诡计，
“You are full of tricks.

自己不会上当。
I won't fall for that.”

胡雪岩只好笑着作罢，
Unable to deceive her, he let the matter drop with a smile.

又问是谁教她的。
“Then tell me this: who taught you?”

阿珠说是一位山东来的跑马卖艺姑娘，长得很好看。
“A girl who performed riding and acrobatic tricks. She was from Shandong and very pretty.

有一回那班人乘她家的船，
Once her troupe travelled on our boat.

姑娘同她一起住，闲谈时告诉她江湖上坏人不少，必须自己当心。
She shared my sleeping quarters, and one evening, while we were chatting, she told me that there are all kinds of bad people on the road and you must depend on your own caution.

姑娘的裤子就是这种防护做法，
Her trousers were made this way.

她便照着做了两条。
I copied them and made two pairs for myself.”

胡雪岩问她有没有跟姑娘学拳。
“Did you learn any boxing from her?”

阿珠说对方原想教她，但船上地方太小，不宜练习，所以没有学。
“No. She offered to teach me, but I thought the boat was too small. It wasn't a place to learn boxing.”

胡雪岩追问是什么拳，
“What did she mean to teach you?”

她说叫‘擒拿手’，
“Something called grappling.

有人要欺负她，就能用来保护自己。
If a man tried to harm me, I could teach him a lesson.”

胡雪岩拍着胸口说幸好没学，否则自己同她在一起就得时时小心。
“Just as well, just as well!” Hu patted his chest. “Fortunately you didn't learn it, or I should have to be on my guard every moment I was with you.”


阿珠半真半假地问，胡雪岩是否觉得她很凶。
“Do you think I'm so fierce?” A’zhu asked, half in earnest.

他让她自己说。
“What do you think yourself?”

她沉默下来，
She fell silent, uneasy.

担心他一直把自己看成难相处的人，从而影响日后的感情，
She had long suspected that Hu regarded her as difficult, and feared that this would damage their future relationship.

想让他放心，却不知怎样表达。
She wanted to reassure him, but did not know how.

胡雪岩则决定保持克制，一方面考验自己的定力，另一方面也有意让她的期待落空一次；并非要杀她的威风，而是要让她知道自己同样能够守礼。
Hu, meanwhile, decided to maintain restraint: partly to test his own self-command, and partly to frustrate her expectations for once—not to humble her, but to show that he too could observe propriety.

一番逗趣之后，他请阿珠倒茶。
After further teasing, he asked her to pour him a bowl of tea.

她说茶已经凉了，
“It's cold.”

他说凉的正好。
“Cold is just what I want.”

阿珠起身，把灯捻亮，整理好衣服，倒出冷透的龙井茶，
She rose, turned up the lamp, put her clothes in order, and poured some thoroughly cooled Longjing tea.

自己先喝了一大口，顿觉清爽平静。
Taking a deep drink herself, she felt refreshed and calmer.

她既有些难为情，也感到安慰，一时不愿转过脸去看他。
Still embarrassed, though also reassured, she hesitated to turn towards him.


胡雪岩问怎么还没把茶送来。
“What is taking so long?” Hu asked.

阿珠想了想，倒好茶，又把美孚油灯捻暗，才将茶端过去。
After a moment's thought, she poured his tea, lowered the Meifu oil lamp until its flame was no larger than a bean, and brought him the bowl.

他接过茶碗，两人又拿方才的窘迫情形相互打趣。
As he accepted it, they exchanged more teasing remarks about their earlier embarrassment.

阿珠已恢复了自信，胡雪岩也承认自己有需要克制的时候。
A’zhu answered with renewed confidence, and Hu admitted that he too had reason to exercise restraint.

她便笑他说，原来他也有不敢的时候，
“So there are things even you don't dare do,” she said mockingly.

还当他天不怕地不怕，什么坏事都做得出来。
“I thought you feared neither heaven nor earth and were capable of any wickedness.”


“这会儿有得你说嘴了！”胡雪岩又笑，
“Now you have something to taunt me with!” Hu laughed again.

笑停了说，“既然不做坏事，何苦把灯弄得这样暗？
When the laughter subsided, he said, “Since we are doing nothing wrong, why keep the lamp so dim?

去捻亮了，我们好好儿说说话。”
Turn it up, and let's have a proper talk.”

她怕捻亮了灯。为他看出脸上的窘态，
She feared that a brighter light would reveal her embarrassment.

便说：“行得正，坐得正，怕什么！”
“If one's conduct is upright, what is there to fear?”

“还有一正：睡得正！”
“And one's behaviour at bedtime must be upright too.”

“当然罗。”阿珠很骄傲他说，
“Naturally,” she said proudly.

“不到日子，你再也休想。”
“Until the appointed day, don't imagine otherwise.”

“日子？”胡雪岩故意装作不解，
“The day?” Hu deliberately pretended not to understand.

“什么日子？”
“What day?”

他装得很象，倒弄得阿珠迷迷糊糊，
He acted so convincingly that she became confused.

不知道他是真的不懂，还是有意“装羊”。
Was he truly unaware, or merely playing the innocent again?

“你不晓得拉倒！”她有些气了，
“If you don't know, never mind!” she said, somewhat angry.

“再没有见过象你这样难弄的人，
“I've never met anyone so difficult.

一会真，一会假，
One moment you're serious, the next you're pretending.

从不把真心给人看！”
You never let anyone see your true feelings.”


这话说得很重，胡雪岩不能再出以嬉皮笑脸的态度，
The accusation was serious enough that Hu could no longer answer with a grin.

然而他亦不愿接受阿珠的指责，
Yet he would not accept it either.

“你自己太傻！”他用反驳的语气说，
“You are being foolish,” he retorted.

“我的真心难道你还看不出来？
“Can't you see my true feelings already?

你要晓得，跟你在一起，为的就是寻快活，
Understand this: I spend time with you because I want to be happy.

难道要象伺候大官儿，或者谈生意一样，一本正经，半句笑话都就不得？
Must it be like waiting on a great official or discussing business—solemn throughout, without half a joke?

那样子不要说是我，只怕你也会觉得好生无趣。”
Never mind me; I think you would find that very dull yourself.”

阿珠受了一顿排揎，反倒服帖了，
The rebuke actually soothed her.

咬着嘴唇把胡雪岩的话，一句一句想过去，心里觉得很舒坦，
Biting her lip, she considered his words one by one and felt increasingly at ease.

同时也领悟出一个决窍，反正胡雪岩喜欢“装羊”，自己就以其人之道，还治其人，也跟他装就是了。
She also discovered a method of her own: if Hu liked to play the innocent, she would repay him in his own coin.

“好了，
“Very well.

我晓得你的脾气了。”她又笑道，
Now I understand your temper.” She smiled again.

“反正我也不怕你骗我，
“I'm not afraid of your deceiving me.

我的脾气你也晓得，
You know my temper too.

好说话就好说话，不好说话，看我的手段，
When I'm easy to deal with, I'm easy; when I'm not, you'll discover what I can do.

你当心点好了。
You had better be careful.”

胡雪岩笑笑不答。
Hu smiled without replying.

对付女人和对付顾客一样，他宁愿遇到一个厉害而讲理的，不愿与看来老实无用而有时无理可喻的人打交道。
Dealing with women, he thought, was like dealing with customers: he would rather face someone formidable but reasonable than someone who seemed meek and ineffectual, yet could sometimes be impossible to reason with.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（上）》第九章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume I — Chapter Nine, first part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第九章｜CHAPTER NINE


一到湖州，胡雪岩就为王有龄接到知府衙门去住，
As soon as Hu Xueyan arrived in Huzhou, Wang Youling brought him to stay at the prefectural yamen.

虽只是小别重逢，但以交情太深，彼此都有无法言喻的喜悦，
Their separation had been brief, but their friendship was so deep that both felt a joy beyond words at meeting again.

心里各有好些话，却还没有工夫深谈，
Each had much to tell the other, yet there was no time for a private conversation.

为了礼貌，也为了切身利害关系，胡雪岩先要去拜两位“师大老爷”。
Courtesy, as well as his own immediate interests, required Hu first to pay his respects to the two senior secretaries.

幕友照例有自己的小天地，秦寿门和杨用之各占一座院落，办公住家都在一起，
Private advisers customarily had a little domain of their own: Qin Shoumen and Yang Yongzhi each occupied a courtyard where they both lived and worked.

王有龄陪着他，先去拜访秦寿门，
Wang accompanied Hu to Qin’s quarters first.

欢然道故之余，向胡雪岩深深致谢。
After an affectionate exchange of news, Qin thanked Hu most earnestly.

端午节前，他有一份极丰富的节礼，包括两石白米，一担时新蔬果，还有十吊钱，送到秦家，
Before the Dragon Boat Festival, Hu had sent Qin’s household a remarkably generous present: two shi of white rice, a carrying load of fresh seasonal fruit and vegetables, and ten strings of copper cash.

秦太太已经从杭州写信告诉了秦寿门，所以这时对胡雪岩的态度，比以前更不同了。
Mrs Qin had written from Hangzhou to tell her husband, and his manner towards Hu was warmer than ever.

“我发湿气戒酒。”秦寿门说，
“I have given up wine on account of my rheumatism,” he said.

“今天要开戒了，陪雪岩兄痛饮一番。”
“Today I shall make an exception and have a proper drink with you, Brother Xueyan.”


“好极了！”王有龄接口问道，“老夫子，你看我们在哪里替雪岩接风？”
“Excellent!” Wang put in. “Master Qin, where do you think we should give Xueyan his welcoming dinner?”

以常理来说，第一天自然是他自己做东道主，
Ordinarily, Wang himself would naturally entertain his guest on the first evening.

问到这话，秦寿门便知有深意在内，
The question therefore suggested that he had something else in mind.

想了想笑道：“东翁莫说出口，
Qin considered it, then smiled. “Do not tell me, sir.

我们各自一猜，看看是不是一条路。”
Let us each write down a guess and see whether we are thinking along the same lines.”

于是秦寿门取管笔，撤张纸，背转身去，悄悄写好，
He took a brush and a sheet of paper, turned away, and wrote something down in secret.

王有龄如法炮制，
Wang did likewise.

把纸条伸开来一看，一个写着“则行”，一个写着“木易”，
When they unfolded their slips, one read “Then put into practice,” and the other “Wood and easy.”

两人哈哈大笑。
Both men burst out laughing.

“木易”是杨，“用之则行”这句成语，胡雪岩也知道，
Hu knew that the written characters for “wood” and “easy” combined to make the surname Yang; he also knew the saying in which “put to use”—Yongzhi—was followed by “then put into practice.” Both slips pointed to Yang Yongzhi.

就不明白到杨用之那里去喝酒，有何可笑。
What he could not understand was why drinking at Yang’s quarters should be so amusing.

“我来告诉你。”王有龄说，
“Let me explain,” Wang said.

“杨老夫子有极得意之事，
“Master Yang has something to be very pleased about.

到湖州不多几天，已经纳了宠了。
He had scarcely been in Huzhou a few days before he took a concubine.

这位如夫人生得宜男之相，而且贤惠能干，
The lady looks as though she will bear him sons, and she is capable and good-natured besides.

我们今天就扰他去。”
We shall descend upon him this evening.”


口说“扰他”，其实不是王有龄作东，他叫个伺候签押房的听差李成，备一桌翅席，抬一坛好酒，送到杨用之那里。
For all this talk of descending upon Yang, Wang instructed Li Cheng, the attendant who served his private office, to arrange a shark’s-fin banquet and have it delivered to Yang’s quarters with a jar of good wine.

胡雪岩却是别有用心，
Hu had a further purpose of his own.

此刻正用得着杨用之的时候，有些结纳示惠的机会，不肯放过，
Just now he needed Yang’s help and would not let slip any opportunity to cultivate the man and do him a kindness.

找个空隙，把王有龄拉到一边有话说。
Finding a moment, he drew Wang aside.

“杨老夫子纳宠，该送礼吧？”
“Surely Master Yang ought to have a present to mark his taking a concubine?”

“我送过了。”王有龄说，
“I have already given him one,” Wang replied.

“你可以免啦！”
“You need not bother.”

“礼不可废。”胡雪岩说，“而且礼不可轻。”
“The courtesy cannot be omitted,” Hu said, “and the gift must be substantial.”

王有龄略想了想，懂了他的用意，点点头说：“也好。
Wang thought for a moment, understood his intention, and nodded. “Very well.

你打算送什么？”
What do you propose to give?”

“总以实惠为主，
“Something of real value.

我想送一副金镯子，
A pair of gold bracelets, I thought.

趁早去办了来。”
I had better go and buy them at once.”

“不必这么费事，
“There is no need for all that trouble.

我那里现成有一副，你拿去用。
I have a pair ready to hand; you may use those.

不过，”王有龄放低了声音，指指里面：“可不能让他知道！”
Only”—Wang lowered his voice and pointed towards the inner room—“he must not hear of it!”

这是指秦寿门，
He meant Qin Shoumen.

胡雪岩报以领会的眼色。
Hu answered with a look of understanding.

于是王、胡二人托词换衣服，暂且告别，与秦寿门约好，准六点钟在杨用之那里会面。
They then excused themselves on the pretext of changing their clothes and arranged to meet Qin at Yang’s quarters at six precisely.


而胡雪岩五点钟就由李成引领着，到了杨用之那里。
At five, however, Li Cheng was already showing Hu into Yang’s rooms.

人逢喜事精神爽，杨用之那番红光满面，春风得意的神情，看来着实令人羡慕。
Good fortune lifts a man’s spirits, and Yang’s ruddy face and air of complete satisfaction were enough to make anyone envy him.

“啊，老兄！”
“Ah, my dear fellow!”

杨用之拉着他的手，亲热非凡，
He seized Hu’s hand with exceptional warmth.

“不敢说是‘一日思君十二时’，一静下来就会想到你，倒是一点不假。
“I cannot claim to think of you through every hour of the day and night, but whenever I have a quiet moment you do come to mind—that is perfectly true.

如何，宝号开张，营业鼎盛？”
Well, has your bank opened to a roaring trade?”

“托福，托福！”
“Very well, thanks to your good wishes.”

胡雪岩特意很仔细地看了他一眼，
Hu made a point of studying him closely.

“老夫子的气色好极了！
“You are looking splendid, Master Yang.

想来宾主都很对劲？”
I take it that you and your employer suit each other admirably?”

“那还用说。
“Need you ask?

我与雪公，真正是如鱼得水。”
With Mr Xuexuan, I am truly a fish in water.”

“对，对！”如鱼得水。“胡雪岩笑道：”
“Quite so—a fish in water!” Hu laughed.

听说老夫子另外还有鱼水之欢？“杨用之哈哈大笑，向里喊道：“锦云，锦云，你出来！”
“And I hear you have another sort of fish-and-water happiness as well?” Yang roared with laughter and called into the inner room, “Jinyun! Jinyun, come out here!”


不用说，锦云就是他的新宠。
Jinyun was, of course, his new concubine.

门帘启处，走出来一个面团团如无锡大阿福，年可二十的姑娘，
The curtain lifted, and a young woman of about twenty appeared, her face as round as one of the plump Da A’fu clay figures of Wuxi.

很腼腆的向客人笑了笑。
She gave the visitor a shy smile.

“锦云，这位就是我常跟你提你的胡老爷，
“Jinyun, this is Mr Hu, whom I am always telling you about.

见一见！”
Come and greet him.”

“啊，胡老爷！”
“Oh—Mr Hu!”

锦云把双眼睁得滚圆，将胡雪岩从上青到下，然后捡衽为礼。
Her eyes widened as she looked him up and down; then she gathered her skirts and curtsied.

“不敢当！”
“You do me too much honour.”

胡雪岩朝上作了个揖，顺势从袖子里取出一个红纸包递了给杨用之，
Hu returned her greeting with a bow and, in the same movement, took a red-paper packet from his sleeve and handed it to Yang.

“一点点薄礼，为如夫人添妆！”
“A trifling present, to add to the lady’s bridal ornaments.”

“不，不！
“No, no!

没有这个规矩。”杨用之极力推辞。
There is no such obligation.” Yang protested vigorously.

“若是嫌菲薄，老夫子就不收。
“Unless you consider it too paltry, you must accept it.

再说，这是送如嫂夫人的，与老夫子无关。”
Besides, it is for the lady, not for you.”

这一说，杨用之不能不收，
After that Yang could hardly refuse.

捏在手里，才发觉是一副镯子，却不知是金是银，
Feeling the packet, he realized that it contained a pair of bracelets, though he could not tell whether they were gold or silver.

只好再叫锦云道谢。
He asked Jinyun to thank their guest again.

“礼太菲薄，老夫子暂且不必打开，也不必说起，
“The present is so insignificant,” Hu added, “that you had better not open it just now, or mention it.

免得叫人笑话。”
I should hate to be laughed at.”

这一说杨用之也有数了，
Yang understood what that meant.

把那个红纸包拿在手里，显得为难而感激，
Holding the packet, he looked both embarrassed and grateful.

“惠我甚厚，
“You are far too generous.

真正是受之有愧！
I scarcely deserve such kindness.

我就恭敬不如从命了。”
But it would be discourteous to resist you further.”

说罢，深深一揖，把红纸包塞入衣袋。
He bowed deeply and slipped the packet into his pocket.


这番揖让折冲刚刚完毕，王有龄和秦寿门相偕到了。
They had barely concluded this exchange of bows, protests, and persuasion when Wang and Qin arrived together.

少不得又有一番以锦云作话题的调侃戏谑。然后开席，
Naturally there was more teasing, with Jinyun as its subject, before they sat down to dinner.

胡雪岩首先声明，他不算是客，仍奉王有龄首座，
Hu announced at once that he did not count as a guest and insisted that Wang take the place of honour.

而王有龄又要逊两位幕友居上席，
Wang, in turn, urged the two secretaries to sit above him.

谦让了半天，还是王有龄居首，胡雪岩其次，杨用之坐了主位，
After a lengthy exchange of courtesies, Wang finally took the first seat, Hu the next, and Yang the host’s place.

同时也叫锦云入席。
Jinyun was invited to join them.

宾主的交情都够了，不妨脱略形迹，
They were all sufficiently close to dispense with ceremony.

锦云的脾气极好，说话总是带着一团甜笑，而且温柔殷勤，
Jinyun had a delightful disposition, speaking always with a sweet smile and attending to everyone gently and thoughtfully.

所以这一席酒，吃得秦寿门醺醺大醉。
Qin drank himself thoroughly tipsy.

王有龄心想，这是个机会，
Wang saw his opportunity.

由阜康代理府库的事，他已经跟杨用之提过，此时正好让他们去深谈，
He had already mentioned to Yang the proposal that Fukang should act as agent for the prefectural treasury; now was the moment to leave the two men to discuss it in detail.

因此他起身告辞。
He rose to take his leave.

“你们谈谈吧！”他说，
“Stay and have a talk,” he said.

“我有些困了，先走一步。”
“I am rather sleepy and shall go on ahead.”


“只伯雪岩兄也困了。”
“I fear Brother Xueyan must be tired too.”

杨用之的话，出人意外，竟无留客之意，
Unexpectedly, Yang seemed to have no intention of keeping Hu.

好得下面还有表示：
Fortunately he followed this with an invitation.

“明天早晨，奉展雪岩兄来吃点心，
“May I ask you to breakfast tomorrow morning?

湖州的点心，着实讲究，
Huzhou is justly proud of its delicacies.

来试试小妾的手段。”
Come and try my concubine’s cooking.”

“好好！
“Gladly!

一定来叨扰。”
I shall certainly come.”

“东翁有兴也请过来。”杨用之又说。
“And you too, sir, if you feel inclined,” Yang added to Wang.

“谢谢！”
“Thank you.”

王有龄当然不肯来，而且也正好有事：
Wang naturally had no wish to join them, and in any case had business to attend to.

“东乡出了命案，
“There has been a killing in the eastern countryside.

我明天一早就要下乡验尸，不来了。”
I must go out early tomorrow to examine the body, so I cannot come.”

第二天一早，胡雪岩应邀赴约，
Hu kept his appointment the next morning.

锦云的手段真个不坏，
Jinyun’s cooking was indeed excellent.

有样“千张包子”煮线粉，加上平望的辣油，
One dish consisted of parcels wrapped in thin bean-curd skins, cooked with vermicelli and served with chilli oil from Pingwang.

胡雪岩在张家的船上亦未曾吃过，
Even on the Zhang family’s boat Hu had never tasted it.

连尽两器，赞不绝口。
He ate two bowls and praised it without ceasing.

吃完了泡上茶来，开始谈判。
When breakfast was over and tea had been brought, they began their discussion.


“东翁关照过了，
“My employer has given his instructions.

湖州府库跟乌程县库，都托阜康代理，一句话！”杨用之问道：“者兄在湖州可有联号，或者是将来要设分号？”
Fukang is to handle the funds of both the Huzhou prefectural treasury and the Wucheng county treasury. That is settled.” Yang continued, “Have you an affiliated bank in Huzhou, or do you intend to open a branch?”

“分号是一定要设的。
“We shall certainly open a branch.

目前托恒利代收。”
For the present, Hengli will collect the funds on our behalf.”

“恒利信用还不错。”
“Hengli’s credit is quite good.”

杨用之站起身来说，“请到我书房里来！”名为书房，闻不出一丝书卷气，
Yang rose. “Come into my study.” Though called a study, the room had nothing bookish about it.

当窗一张五斗桌，铺着蓝布，
A five-drawer desk stood at the window, covered in blue cloth.

除去笔砚，便是算盘、帐簿，
Apart from brushes and an inkstone, it held only an abacus and account books.

旁边一具极厚实的木柜，
Beside it stood a very solid wooden cupboard.

他打开来取出一只拜盒，从拜盒取出一张纸递给胡雪岩。
Yang opened this, took out a document box, and from the box produced a sheet of paper, which he handed to Hu.

“我都替老兄预备好了，
“I have everything ready for you.

填上恒利的名字，敲一个保，做个样子，就叫恒利来收款。”
Fill in Hengli’s name and obtain a guarantor’s endorsement—merely as a formality—and Hengli can come to collect the money.”


胡雪岩接过那张纸看，
Hu examined the paper.

是一张承揽代理公库的“禀帖”，
It was a formal petition to undertake the handling of public treasury funds.

此事他还是初次经手，不由得问了句：“这样子递了进来，就算数了？”
He had never dealt with such an arrangement before and could not help asking, “Once this has been submitted, is that all that is required?”

“是啊！
“Yes.

衙门里给你个批，就算数了。”
The yamen gives you its written approval, and the matter is settled.”

“那么，”胡雪岩知道，凡有公事，必有花费，所以很恳切他说：“老夫子，该当多少费用，交到哪里，请吩咐了，我好照办。”
Hu knew that official business invariably entailed expenses. “In that case, Master Yang,” he said earnestly, “please tell me how much I should pay, and to whom, so that I may make the necessary arrangements.”

“说句老实活，别人来，花上千银子，未见得能如此顺利。
“To speak frankly, another man might spend a thousand taels without finding things so easy.

老兄的事，没有话好说。
In your case, there is nothing to discuss.

不过，我为老兄设想，以后要诸事方便，书办那里不可不点缀点缀。
Still, for your own sake, if you want things to run smoothly afterwards, you must give the clerks a little something.

我为你引见一个人，
I shall introduce you to one of them.

你邀他出去吃个茶，说两句客气话，封一个数给他好了。”
Invite him out for tea, say a few civil words, and give him a packet containing this amount.”

说着，伸了一个指头。
He held up one finger.

这一个指头当然不是代表一千两，那么是十两呢，还是一百两呢？
It could hardly mean a thousand taels; did it mean ten, then, or a hundred?

想一想是宁可问清楚为妙。
Hu thought it wiser to make certain.

“好的。
“Very well.

我封一百二十两银子好了。”
I shall make it a hundred and twenty taels.”

他这样旁敲侧击他说，如果是十两，杨用之当然会纠正他。
This was an indirect way of asking: if Yang meant ten, he would naturally correct him.

“不必，不必！
“No, no!

一百两够了，
A hundred is enough.

通通在里头，
That covers everything.

你另外不必再花冤枉钱。”
There is no need to throw away any more money elsewhere.”


于是杨用之派人去找了户房一个书办来，五十多岁，衣着相当够气派。
Yang sent for a clerk from the revenue department, a man in his fifties whose clothes were decidedly impressive.

书办的官称为“书吏”，
Such men were formally known as clerical functionaries.

大小衙门基层的公务，只有书办才熟悉，这一点就是他们的“本钱”，
In yamens large and small, they alone understood the everyday workings of administration, and that knowledge was their capital.

其中的真实情况，以及关键、决窍，为不传之秘，
The true state of affairs, the crucial points, and the tricks of the business were secrets never divulged to outsiders.

所以书办虽无“世袭”的明文，但无形中父子相传，有世袭的惯例。
Although no written rule made a clerkship hereditary, in practice it passed from father to son.


府、县衙门“三班六房”，
Prefectural and county yamens had three divisions of runners and six administrative departments.

六房皆有书办，而以“刑房”的书办最神气，“户房”的书办最阔气。
All six departments employed clerks, of whom those in the criminal department put on the most imposing airs and those in the revenue department were the wealthiest.

户房书办简你“户书”，他之所以阔气，是因为额征钱粮地丁，
The latter owed their prosperity to the system for collecting land and poll taxes.

户部只问总数，不问细节，
The Board of Revenue concerned itself with the total assessed, not with the particulars.

当地谁有多少田、多少地，座落何方，等则如何？只有“户书”才一清二楚。
Who owned how much farmland, where each plot lay, and how it was graded—only the local revenue clerk knew all this exactly.

他们所凭借的就是祖传的一本秘册，称为“鱼鳞册”，
His authority rested on a secret register handed down through his family, known as a fish-scale register.

没有这本册子，天大的本事，也征不起钱粮。
Without it, a man of the greatest ability could not collect the taxes.

有了这本册子，不但公事可以顺利，户书本人也可以大发其财，
Possession of that book not only made official business possible but also enabled the clerk to grow rich.

多少年来钱粮地丁的征收，是一盘混帐，
For years the collection of taxes had been a hopeless muddle.

纳了钱粮的，未见得能收到“粮串”，不纳粮的却握有纳粮的凭证，
Those who paid did not necessarily receive receipts, while those who paid nothing might possess proof that they had paid.

反正“上头”只要征额够成数，如何张冠李戴，是不必管也无法管的。
As long as the required proportion of the assessment reached the authorities, no one above concerned himself with whose payment had been credited to whom; indeed, there was no practical way of untangling it.


因此，钱谷老夫子必得跟户书打交道。
A revenue secretary therefore had to deal with the revenue clerks.

厉害的户书可以控制钱谷老夫子，同样地，厉害的钱谷老夫子，也可以把户书治得服服帖帖。
A formidable clerk might keep the secretary under his thumb; an equally formidable secretary might bring his clerks completely to heel.

一般而论，总是和睦相处，情如家人，
Generally, however, they lived on good terms, as intimate as members of a family.

杨用之跟这个名叫郁四的户书就是这样。
That was the relationship between Yang and this clerk, whose name was Yu Si.

“老四！”杨用之用这个昵称关照：“这位是王大老爷的，也是我的好朋友，胡老爷！”
“Old Four,” Yang said familiarly, “this is Mr Hu, a close friend both of Prefect Wang and of mine.”

书办的身分本低，
A clerk’s standing was low.

郁四见这位胡老爷的来头不小，要行大礼，
Seeing what influential connections this Mr Hu possessed, Yu prepared to kneel in formal homage.

但胡雪岩的动作快，刚看他弯膝，便抢上去扶住他说：“郁四哥！幸会，幸会！”
Hu was quicker: the moment Yu bent his knees, he stepped forward and supported him. “Brother Yu! A pleasure to meet you.”

“胡老爷，这个称呼万万不敢当，
“Mr Hu, I could never presume to accept that form of address.

你叫我郁四好了。”
Please call me Yu Si.”

杨用之也觉得他不必如此谦虚，
Yang too felt that Hu need not be so modest.

便说：“你也叫他老四好了。”
“You may call him Old Four as well.”

接着又对郁四说：“老四，你请胡老爷去吃碗茶！
Then he turned to the clerk. “Old Four, take Mr Hu out for a cup of tea.

他有点小事托你。”
There is a small matter in which he would like your help.”

“好的，好的！
“Certainly, certainly!

我请胡老爷吃茶。”
I shall be delighted to offer Mr Hu some tea.”


于是他带胡雪岩上街，
Yu took him out into the street.

就在县前有家茶馆，招牌名叫“碧浪春”，规模极大，三开间的门面，
In front of the county yamen stood a very large teahouse called Bilangchun, its frontage three bays wide.

前面散座，后面是花木扶疏，另成院落的雅座，
The public tables occupied the front; behind them, amid luxuriant trees and flowers, a separate courtyard offered more secluded seating.

郁四不把他带到雅座，却在当檐正中一张竖摆的长桌子上首一坐。
Instead of taking Hu there, Yu sat at the head of a long table placed lengthways in the centre of the front hall, immediately beneath the eaves.

胡雪岩一看便懂了。
Hu understood at once.

这张茶桌，名为“马头桌子”，只有当地漕帮中的老大，才有资格朝外坐。
This was the “horse-head table,” where only a local leader of the Grain Transport Brotherhood was entitled to sit facing outwards.

胡雪岩虽是“空子”，却懂这个规矩，
Hu was not a member, but he knew the rule.

而且也明白郁四的用意，是要向大家表明，他有这样一位贵客。
He also understood Yu’s purpose: to show everyone that he was entertaining a distinguished guest.

不过，胡雪岩心里感他的情，却不宜说破，
Hu appreciated the compliment without acknowledging it in words.

“开口洋盘闭口相”，
Speaking might expose him as an outsider; silence would preserve the proper appearance.

说破了反难应付，
To explain what he understood would only make matters awkward.

只是神色间摆出来，以有郁四这样的朋友为荣。
Instead, he showed by his manner that he considered it an honour to have such a friend as Yu.


果然，郁四的威风不小，
Yu’s influence was considerable.

一坐定，便陆续有人走来，含笑致候，
No sooner had he taken his seat than people began coming over, smiling and offering their greetings.

有的叫“四哥”，有的叫“四叔”，
Some called him Fourth Brother, others Fourth Uncle.

极少几个人叫“老四”，那当然不是“同参”，就是交情够得上的平辈。
Only a very few called him Old Four; these must either have entered the brotherhood alongside him or be close friends of equal standing.

不管叫郁四什么，对胡雪岩都非常尊敬，
Whatever their form of address to Yu, all treated Hu with great respect.

郁四一一为来人引见，其中有几个人便介绍给胡雪岩，
Yu introduced his visitor to each of them and, in a few cases, made a point of telling Hu who the newcomer was.

他心里有数，这都是够分量的人物，也是自己在湖州打天下，必不可少的朋友。
Hu understood that these were people of consequence, indispensable acquaintances if he was to establish himself in Huzhou.

人来人往，络绎不绝，还有许多送来点心，摆满了一桌子。
Visitors came and went without a break; many sent over refreshments, until the table was covered.

这样子极本无法谈正事，
There was plainly no possibility of discussing business.

同时郁四觉得力大家介绍这个朋友，到这地步也就够了。
Yu, too, felt that he had done enough to make his friend known.

所以招手把茶博士喊了过来问道：“后面有地方没有？
Beckoning to a waiter, he asked, “Is there somewhere at the back?

要清静一点的。”
Somewhere quiet.”

“我去看了来回报你老人家。”
“I shall see and report back to you, sir.”

不多片刻，茶博士说是有了座位。
Before long the waiter returned to say that a table was available.

引进去一看，另有个伙计正在移去僻处一张桌上的茶具，
When they followed him inside, another attendant was removing the tea things from a table in a secluded corner.

显然的，茶博士是说了好话，要求雅座上的客人腾让了出来的，
Evidently the waiter had talked its occupants into giving it up.

这是一件小事，胡雪岩的印象却极深刻，
It was a small incident, but Hu found it deeply revealing.

郁四的“有办法”。就在这件小事上，表现得清清楚楚。
Yu’s ability to get things done could hardly have been demonstrated more clearly.


“胡老爷，你有话请说。”
“Mr Hu, please tell me what you require.”

“郁四哥！”胡雪岩又改回最早的称呼，“自己人这样叫法，显得生分了。
“Brother Yu”—Hu reverted to his original form of address—“we are friends; all this formality makes us seem strangers.

你叫我雪岩好了。”
Call me Xueyan.”

“没有这个规矩。”郁四又说，“我们先不讲这个过节，
“That would hardly be proper. But let us leave such niceties for now.

你说，有什么事要吩咐？”“是这样……”胡雪岩说明了来意。
What is it you wish me to do?” Hu explained his errand.

“那么，你有没有保呢？”
“Have you a guarantor?” Yu asked.

“我找恒利去找。”
“I shall ask Hengli to find one.”

“那不必了。”郁四说道，“你把禀帖给我，其余的你不必管了。
“There is no need. Give me the petition and leave everything else to me.

明天我把回批送到你那里！”
Tomorrow I shall bring the written approval to your quarters.”

这样痛快，连胡雪岩都不免意外，
Even Hu was surprised by such prompt assurance.

拱拱手说：“承情不尽。”
He clasped his hands in thanks. “I am deeply obliged.

他接着又说：“杨师爷原有句话交代，叫我备一个红包，意思意思。
Master Yang told me to prepare a red packet as a small token of appreciation.

现在我不敢拿出来了，
Now I dare not produce it.

拿出来，倒显得我是半吊子。”
To do so would show that I had no idea how to behave.”


郁四深深点头，对胡雪岩立即另眼相看，
Yu nodded gravely and immediately regarded Hu in a new light.

原来的敬重，是因为他是杨师爷和王大老爷的上宾，
His earlier respect had been for an honoured guest of Master Yang and Prefect Wang.

现在才发觉胡雪岩是极漂亮的外场人物。
Now he saw that Hu was himself a man who knew how to conduct himself in the wider world.

于是他在斟茶时，用茶壶和茶杯摆出一个姿势，
As he poured the tea, Yu arranged the pot and cups in a particular pattern.

这是在询问，胡雪岩是不是“门槛里的”？
This was a way of asking whether Hu was “inside the threshold”—a member of the brotherhood.

如果木然不觉，便是“空子”，否则就会照样用手势作答，
An uncomprehending response would identify an outsider; a member would answer with a corresponding gesture.

名为“茶碗阵”。
The exchange was known as a “tea-bowl formation.”

“茶碗阵”胡雪岩也会摆，只是既为“空子”，便无须乎此。
Hu knew how to make one, but since he was an outsider, he had no reason to do so.

但郁四已摆出点子来，再假装不懂，事后发觉便有“装佯吃相”之嫌。
Yet Yu had already made his signal, and to pretend not to understand might, if discovered later, look like deliberate deceit.

他在想，溜帮的规矩，原有“准充不准赖”这一条，
Hu recalled the brotherhood’s rule that a claim of membership could be accepted, but a connection must not be denied.

这个“赖”字，在此时来说，不是身在门槛中不肯承认，
In his case, denial would not mean concealing actual membership.

是自己原懂漕帮的规矩，虽为空子，而其实等于一条线上的弟兄，
He knew the brotherhood’s customs and, though technically outside it, was effectively linked to its members as a brother.

这一点关系，要交代清楚。
That relationship needed to be made clear.


于是他想了想问道：“郁四哥，我跟你打听一个人，
After a moment’s thought, he asked, “Brother Yu, there is someone I should like to ask you about.

想来你一定认识。”
I imagine you must know him.”

“喔，哪一位？”
“Who is that?”

“松江的尤五哥。”
“Brother You, the fifth, from Songjiang.”

“原来你跟尤老五是朋友？”
“So you are a friend of You Laowu?”

郁四脸有惊异之色，
Yu looked surprised.

“你们怎么称呼？”
“How do you address each other?”

我跟尤五哥就象跟你郁四哥一样，一见如故。
“Brother You and I were much as you and I are: friends from our first meeting.”

“这表明他是空子，
This made clear that Hu was an outsider.

接着又回答郁四的那一问：”
He then answered Yu’s specific question.

尤五哥客气，叫我‘爷叔’，实在不敢当。
“Brother You is too polite and calls me ‘Uncle,’ though I scarcely deserve it.

因为我跟魏老太爷认识在先，
I knew Old Master Wei first, you see.

尤五哥敬重他老人家，当我是魏老太爷的朋友，自己把自己矮了一辈，
Out of respect for the old gentleman, You treats me as his friend and places himself a generation below me.

其实跟弟兄一样。
In fact, we are like brothers.”

“这一交代，郁四完全明白，
Yu understood perfectly.

难得“空子”中有这样“落门落槛”的朋友，真是难得！“
An outsider who fitted so naturally into the brotherhood’s world was a rare find indeed.


“照这样说，大家都是自己人，
“In that case, we are all among our own people.

不过，你老是王大老爷的贵客，
Still, you are an honoured guest of Prefect Wang.

我实在高攀了。”
I fear I am claiming a friendship above my station.”

“哪有这话？”胡雪岩答道：
“Nothing of the kind,” Hu replied.

“各有各的交情，
“Each friendship stands on its own.

说句实话，我跟做官的，不大轧得拢淘。”
To tell you the truth, I do not generally get on very easily with officials.”

江湖中人，胸襟有时候很放得开，
Men of the brotherhood could be remarkably open-hearted.

看胡雪岩这样表示，郁四便想进一步交一交，
Seeing Hu’s attitude, Yu wanted to know him better.

改口称为：
He adopted a new form of address.

“胡老板，这趟到湖州来，专为办这桩公事？”
“Mr Hu, the banker—have you come to Huzhou solely on this official business?”

他指着那张禀帖问。
He pointed to the petition.

“这是一桩。”
“That is one reason.”

胡雪岩想了一下，决计跟他说实话：
Hu considered, then decided to tell him the truth.

“再想帮朋友开一家丝行，我自己也相买点丝。”
“I also want to help a friend open a silk firm, and I should like to buy some silk myself.”

他一说，郁四便已会意，
Yu understood immediately.

收了湖州府和乌程县的公款，就地运用，不失为好算盘，
To receive the public funds of Huzhou Prefecture and Wucheng County and employ them locally was a shrewd calculation.

“不过，”郁四问道：“丝的行情，你晓不晓得？”
“But do you know the silk market?” he asked.

“正要向郁四哥讨教。”
“I was hoping for your advice.”

“丝价大跌，
“Prices have fallen sharply.

买进倒正是时候，不过，要当心脱不得手。”
It is certainly a good time to buy, but you must beware of being unable to sell.”

“喔！”胡雪岩说，
“Ah,” said Hu.

“隔行如隔山，
“A different trade is like a mountain barrier.

郁四哥这两句话，我还不懂得其中的道理。”
I do not yet understand the reasoning behind those two remarks.”


“这容易明白……”
“That is easily explained.”

湖州的生丝有个大主顾，就是“江南三局”——江宁、苏州、杭州三个织造局，
Huzhou raw silk had one great customer: the Three Southern Bureaus, the imperial weaving establishments at Jiangning, Suzhou, and Hangzhou.

三局规模相仿，各有织机七八百张，每年向湖州采购的生丝，数量相当可观。
All three were of roughly equal size, each operating seven or eight hundred looms and buying a substantial quantity of Huzhou silk every year.

等洪杨战事一起，库款支继，交通不便，三局的产量已在减少，
Once the war against Hong and Yang began, treasury funds ran short and transport became difficult, reducing production at all three establishments.

江宁一失，织机少了三分之一，
With the fall of Jiangning, a third of the looms were lost.

苏州临近战区，织造局在半停顿之中，
Suzhou lay close to the fighting, and its bureau was operating only intermittently.

就算杭局不受影响，通扯计算，官方购丝的数量，也不过以前的半数。
Even if Hangzhou remained unaffected, official purchases, taken together, would amount to no more than half their former volume.

加以江宁到苏州，以及江北扬州等地，老百姓纷纷逃难，
Moreover, people from Jiangning to Suzhou, as well as from Yangzhou and other places north of the river, were fleeing the war.

果腹亦不易，如何穿绸着缎？
When they could scarcely fill their stomachs, how were they to buy silks and satins?

所以生丝滞销，价格大跌，
Raw silk consequently remained unsold and prices plunged.

进了货不易脱手，新丝泛黄，越发难卖。
Stock bought now would be difficult to dispose of; once fresh silk began to yellow, it would be harder still to sell.


“真是！”胡雪岩笑道，
“Indeed!” Hu laughed.

“我只会在铜钱眼里翻跟斗，丝方面的行情，一窃不通，
“I know how to turn somersaults through the hole in a copper coin, but of the silk market I know absolutely nothing.

多亏郁四哥指点，
I am fortunate to have your advice.

不然冒冒失失下手，‘湿手捏着干燥面’，弄不清楚了。”
Otherwise I might have rushed in and found myself like a man grasping dry flour with wet hands—in a mess I could never get clear of.”

“我也不十分内行。
“I am no great expert either.

不过这方面的朋友倒有几个可以替你找来谈谈。”
But I have a few friends in the trade whom I could bring along to talk to you.”

郁四略停一下又说，“他们不敢欺你外行。”
Yu paused, then added, “They would not dare take advantage of your inexperience.”

“那真正千金难买。”
“That is worth more than gold.”

胡雪岩拱手道谢，
Hu clasped his hands in gratitude.

“就托郁四哥替我约一约。”
“Please arrange a meeting for me.”

“自己人说话，
“Between friends, there is no need for ceremony.

我晓得你很忙，请你自己说，什么时候有空？
I know you are busy, so tell me when you are free.

我替你接风，顺便约好了他们来。”
I shall give you a welcoming dinner and invite them at the same time.”

“明天晚上吧！”
“Tomorrow evening, perhaps.

胡雪岩又说，“我想请郁四哥约两位懂‘洋庄’的朋友。”
And I should like you to ask a couple of men who understand the export trade.”


郁四心一动，
Something stirred in Yu’s mind.

“胡老板，你的心思好快！”他由衷他说，
“Mr Hu, how quickly you think!” he said with genuine admiration.

“我实在佩服。”
“I am impressed.”

“你不要夸奖我，
“Do not praise me yet.

还不知道洋庄动不动？
We still do not know whether the export trade is active.

如果动洋庄，丝价跌岂不是一个机会？
If it is, surely falling silk prices present an opportunity?

郁四哥，我们联手来做。”
Brother Yu, let us undertake this together.”

“好的！”郁四欣然答道，
“Gladly!” Yu answered with pleasure.

“我托你的福。”
“I shall profit by your good fortune.”

“哪里？是我靠你帮忙。”
“On the contrary, I shall depend on your help.”

“自己人邯不必客套了。”
“We need not exchange compliments among ourselves.”

郁四有点兴奋，
Yu was growing excited.

“要做，我们就放工手来做一票。”
“If we are going to do it, let us give ourselves room and make a substantial venture of it.”


在别人，多半会以为郁四的话，不是随口敷衍，就是故意掉枪花，
Another man might have taken Yu’s words for empty politeness or deliberate bluff.

便胡雪岩不是这么想，
Hu thought otherwise.

江湖中人讲究“牙齿当阶沿石”，牙缝中一句话，比有见证的亲笔契约还靠得住。
Men of the brotherhood prided themselves on making their word as solid as a stone doorstep: a sentence spoken through their teeth could be more reliable than a signed contract witnessed by others.

郁四的势力地位，已经表现得很清楚，
Yu had already made his power and standing quite clear.

论他的财力，即使本身并不殷实。至少能够调度得动，
As for money, even if he were not personally wealthy, he must at least be able to mobilize funds.

这样不就可以做大生意了？
Why should they not undertake a large business together?

这个大生意有两点别人所没有的长处，自己的头脑和郁四的关系，
Their venture would have two advantages that others lacked: Hu’s own judgment and Yu’s connections.

两者配合得法，可以所向无敌。
Properly combined, the two could carry all before them.


因此，胡雪岩内心也很兴奋。
Hu, too, was excited.

他把如何帮老张开丝行的事，大致说了一遍，但没有提到其中关键所在的阿珠。
He outlined his plan to help Old Zhang open a silk firm, though he said nothing of A’zhu, who was central to the whole affair.

而郁四却是知道老张，并且坐过张家的船的，
Yu already knew Zhang and had travelled on his boat.

“原来是老张！”
“Old Zhang, is it?

他说，“这个人倒是老实的。
He is an honest fellow.

他有个女儿，长得很出色。”
He has a very pretty daughter.”

既说到这上面，胡雪岩不能再没有表示，否则就不够意思了。
Now that the subject had arisen, Hu could hardly fail to respond without seeming less than frank.

但这个表示也很难，不便明说，唯有暗示，
Yet an open declaration would be awkward; he could only hint.

于是他笑一笑说：“开这个丝行，一半也是为了阿珠。”
Smiling, he said, “A’zhu is half the reason for opening this firm.”

“噢！”
“Ah!”

真所谓“光棍玲珑心”，
As the saying went, a worldly fellow had a finely perceptive heart.

郁四立刻就懂了，
Yu understood immediately.

“你眼光真不错！”
“You have an excellent eye!”

“这件事还有点小小的麻烦，将来说不定还要请郁四哥帮忙。
“There is still a small difficulty in that matter, and I may have to ask for your help later.

这且不谈。
But let us leave that for now.

郁四哥，你看这个丝行，
What do you think about the silk firm?

我们是合在一起来做，还是另设号子？
Should we run it jointly, or establish another concern?”

““也不必合开丝行，也不必另设号子。
“Neither is necessary.

老张既是你面上的人，便宜不落外方，
Since Old Zhang is one of your people, we need not let the benefit go to outsiders.

将来我们联手做洋庄，就托老张的丝行进货好了。”
When we begin our export business together, we can have his firm buy the silk for us.”

老张的丝行连招牌都还未定，已经有了一笔大生意，
Zhang’s firm did not yet even have a name, and already it had secured a substantial piece of business.

不过胡雪岩也很漂亮，
Hu, however, knew how to return a kindness.

“既然如此，将来我叫老张在盈余当中，另提一笔款子来分。”他说“这是小事。”郁四说：
“In that case, I shall ask Zhang to set aside a further share of the profits for us to divide.” “That is a small matter,” Yu replied.

“胡老板，你先照你自己的办法去做，
“Proceed as you intended, Mr Hu.

有什么办不通的地方，尽管来找我。
If you run into anything you cannot manage, come to me.

等明天晚上约了人来谈过，我们再商量我们合伙的事。”
Tomorrow evening, once we have talked to the men I invite, we can discuss our partnership.”


就这样素昧平生的一席之谈，胡雪岩找到了一个最好的合伙人。
In a single conversation with a man he had never met before, Hu had found an ideal partner.

离了碧浪春，不远就是恒利，
Not far from Bilangchun stood Hengli Bank.

那里的档手赵长生，早就接到了张胖子的信，知道胡雪岩的来头，接了进去，奉如上宾。
Its manager, Zhao Changsheng, had already received Fat Zhang’s letter and knew the standing of his visitor; he welcomed Hu as an honoured guest.

谈到本行，
Here Hu was on familiar ground.

胡雪岩可就不如谈丝行那样事事要请教别人，
He no longer had to seek instruction at every turn, as he had when discussing silk.

略略问了些营业情况，就已了然，
A few questions about the bank’s business told him all he needed to know.

恒利的生意做得很规矩，但规模不大，尚欠开展。
Hengli was conducted on sound, conventional lines, but it was small and insufficiently developed.

照自己做生意，锐意进取的宗旨来说，只怕恒利配合不上。
Judged by Hu’s own principle of pressing vigorously ahead in business, it might not be able to keep pace with him.

做生意最要紧的是，头寸调度得灵活。
Nothing mattered more than flexibility in deploying funds.

他心里在想，恒利是脚踏实地的做法，
Hengli’s approach was cautious and practical.

不可能凭自己一句话，或者一张字条，就肯多少多少先付了再说，
It was unlikely to advance whatever sum he required merely on his word or on the strength of a note.

这样子万一呼应不灵，关系甚重。
If it failed to respond when needed, the consequences could be serious.

那么，阜康代理湖州府库、乌程县库，找恒利做汇划往来的联号，是不是合适？
Was Hengli, then, the right affiliated bank to handle transfers for Fukang’s agency business with the Huzhou and Wucheng treasuries?

倒要得新考虑了。
The question required fresh consideration.


由于有此一念，他便不谈正题，而赵长生却提起来了，
With this thought in mind, Hu avoided the principal subject, but Zhao raised it himself.

“胡老板，”他说，“信和来信，说是府、县两库，由胡老板介绍我们代收代付，
“Mr Hu, Xinhe has written to say that you are introducing us to the prefectural and county treasuries to receive and disburse funds on their behalf.

承情之至。
We are most grateful.

不知道这件事，其中有什么说法，要请教。
May I ask what arrangements are involved?”

“胡雪岩心思极快，
Hu thought quickly.

这时已打定了一个于己无损，于恒利有益，而在张胖子的交情方面，足以交代得过去的折衷办法，
He had already devised a compromise that would cost him nothing, benefit Hengli, and allow him to do proper justice to his friendship with Fat Zhang.

“是这样的，”他从容不迫地答道，
“The position is this,” he answered calmly.

“本地府、县两库，王大老爷和杨师爷商量结果，委托阜康代理。
“After discussing the matter, Prefect Wang and Master Yang have entrusted the two local treasuries to Fukang.

不过阜康在湖州还没有设分号，本地的支付，我想让给宝号来办。
As we have not yet opened a branch in Huzhou, I thought I would leave the local payments to your bank.

一则是老张的交情，再则是同行的义气，
I do so partly because of my friendship with Zhang at Xinhe and partly out of regard for a fellow banker.

其中毫无说法。”
There are no conditions attached.”

所谓“毫无说法”就是不必谈什么条件，这真是白占便宜的帮忙，
That meant there would be no terms to negotiate: it was a favour from which Hengli would benefit outright.

赵长生既高兴，又感激，不断拱手说道：
Delighted and grateful, Zhao kept clasping his hands.

“多谢，多谢！”
“Thank you, thank you!”


“长生兄不妨给我个可以透支的数字，
“Brother Changsheng, give me a figure up to which you are prepared to allow an overdraft.

我跟里头一说，事情就算成功了。
Once I have spoken to the people in the yamen, the matter will be settled.

改一天，我请客，把杨师爷和户书郁老四找来，跟长生兄见见面。
Another day I shall give a dinner and invite Master Yang and the revenue clerk, Old Four Yu, to meet you.”

“府、县衙门的师爷，为了怕招摇引起物议，以致妨碍东家的“官声”，无不以在外应酬为大忌，
Secretaries in prefectural and county yamens regarded social engagements outside as something to be avoided, lest conspicuous entertaining invite criticism and damage their employers’ official reputations.

郁四在湖州的手面，赵长生亦是深有所知的，
Zhao also knew very well how influential Yu Si was in Huzhou.

现在听胡雪岩是招之即来的语气，而且对郁四用捻友知交的称呼，便越发又加了几分敬重，
Hearing Hu speak as though both men would come at a word, and refer to Yu with the familiarity of an intimate friend, he felt his respect deepen.

于是他的态度也不自觉地不同了。
His manner changed almost unconsciously.

“当然是恒利请客。
“Naturally, Hengli must give the dinner.

胡老板！”他双手放在膝上，俯身向前。用很清楚的声音问道：“我先要咱问一声，不晓得府、县两库，有多少收支？”
Mr Hu”—he placed both hands on his knees and leaned forward, speaking with great clarity—“may I first ask what volume of receipts and payments the two treasuries handle?”


“这我倒还不大清楚。
“I do not yet know precisely.

照平常来说，本地的收支虽不多，
Ordinarily the local transactions would not be very large.

不过湖州富庶，又是府、县两衙门，
Still, Huzhou is prosperous, and we are dealing with both a prefectural and a county yamen.

我想经常三五万银子的进出总有的。”
I should expect a regular turnover of thirty to fifty thousand taels.”

“那么，”赵长生想了想，带些歉意地说，“恒利资本短，
Zhao considered. “In that case,” he said, sounding apologetic, “our capital is limited.

我想备两万银子的额子，另外我给宝号备一万两的额子，
I propose to set aside a facility of twenty thousand taels, with a separate facility of ten thousand for your bank.

请胡老板给我个印鉴式样。”
Please let me have a specimen of your seal.”

“好的！”
“Certainly.”

胡雪岩原不想要他那一万银子的透支额，但谢绝好意，一定会便赵长生在心里难过，
Hu had not intended to seek a separate ten-thousand-tael overdraft facility for Fukang from Hengli, but rejecting a kindly offer would hurt Zhao’s feelings.

所以平静地又说，“至于阜康这方面跟宝号的往来，我们另外订约，都照长生兄的意思好了。”
He therefore continued without a change of tone, “As for dealings between Fukang and your bank, we can make a separate agreement, on whatever terms you think appropriate.”

“是！是！
“Yes, yes.

我听胡老板的吩咐。”
I shall follow your wishes.”

“一言为定。”
“Then that is settled.”

胡雪岩站起来说，
Hu rose.

“我告辞了。”
“I must take my leave.”

赵长生要留他吃午饭，情意甚殷，无奈胡雪岩对恒利的事，临时起了变化，急于要去安排妥帖，
Zhao pressed him warmly to stay for lunch, but Hu’s plans for Hengli had changed and he was anxious to put the new arrangements in order.

所以坚辞不肯，只说相处的日子正长，不必急在一时。
He firmly declined, saying that they would have plenty of opportunities to meet in future and need not do everything at once.

然后订下第二天上午再见面的后约，离了恒利。
Having agreed to return the following morning, he left the bank.


从恒利又回到了碧浪春，俨然常客，
He went straight back to Bilangchun, where he was already treated like a regular patron.

立刻便有好些人来招呼，
Several people came forward to greet him.

胡雪岩直言问道：“我有要紧事，要看郁四哥，
“I have urgent business with Brother Yu,” he said directly.

不晓得到哪里去寻找他呢？”
“Where might I find him?”

“有地方寻找，有地方寻找。”
“We know where he is; we know.”

有个姓钱的招呼一个后主：
A man surnamed Qian called to a young fellow.

“小和尚！
“Little Monk!

你把胡先生带到‘水晶阿七，那里去！
Take Mr Hu to Crystal A’qi’s.”

“胡雪岩道过谢，跟着小和尚出店向西，
Hu thanked him and followed Little Monk westwards out of the teahouse.

心里在想，“水晶阿七”不知道是个什么人物呢？先得弄清楚了再说。
He wondered who this Crystal A’qi could be; he had better find out beforehand.

等他一问，小和尚调皮的笑了，
At his question, Little Monk gave a mischievous smile.

“是个‘上货’！”他说，
“A first-rate piece of goods,” he said.

“郁四叔的老相好，
“Fourth Uncle Yu’s old favourite.

每天在她那里吃中饭，打中觉。”
He has lunch and takes his midday nap there every day.”

原来是个土娼，
So she was a local prostitute.

郁四哥看中的，当然是朵名花，
A woman who had caught Brother Yu’s eye must be a celebrated beauty.

“怎么叫‘水晶阿七’呢？”他又问。
“Why is she called Crystal A’qi?” Hu asked.

“水晶就是水晶。”小和尚笑道：
“Crystal means crystal.” Little Monk laughed.

“莫非胡先生连女人身上的这个花样都不知道？”
“Surely, Mr Hu, you know that particular feature a woman may have?”

一说破，胡雪岩自己也觉得好笑，
Once the allusion was explained, Hu found his own question amusing.

便不再多问，只跟着他曲曲折折进了一条长巷，
He asked no more and followed the young man through a series of turns into a long lane.

将到底时，小和尚站定了脚说：
Near its end, Little Monk stopped.

“胡先生，你自己敲门，
“You had better knock yourself, Mr Hu.

我不进去了。”
I am not going in.”


“为什么？”
“Why not?”

小和尚略有些脸红，
Little Monk blushed slightly.

“郁四叔不准我跟水晶阿七见面。”他说。
“Fourth Uncle Yu will not allow me to see Crystal A’qi.”

“原来如此！”
“I see!”

胡雪岩拱拱手说，
Hu clasped his hands.

“劳步，劳步！”
“Thank you for your trouble.”

等小和尚走远了，他才敲门，
Only when the young man was well away did he knock.

应门的是个小姑娘，等他说了来意，立刻引进。
A young maid answered the door and, on learning his business, showed him in at once.

刚刚上楼，就闻得鸦片烟的香味，
As soon as he reached the upper floor, he smelled the fragrance of opium.

揭开门帘一看，郁四正在靠云吐雾，
He lifted the curtain to find Yu lying at ease, drawing in smoke and sending it drifting out again.

大红木床的另一面，躺着一个花信年华，极其妖艳的少妇，
On the other side of the large redwood bed reclined an exceptionally alluring young woman in the full bloom of her twenties.

自然是水晶阿七了。
She could only be Crystal A’qi.

郁四因为烟枪正在嘴时，只看着他招手示意，
With the pipe at his lips, Yu merely looked at Hu and beckoned.

阿七替他捧着烟斗也不能起身，只抛过来一个媚笑。
A’qi, holding the bowl for him, could not rise either; she sent Hu a seductive smile instead.

胡雪岩不由得心中一荡，
He felt a sudden stir within him.

怪不得郁四不准小和尚上门！
No wonder Yu barred Little Monk from the house!

他在想，这个媚眼勾魂摄魄，有道行的老和尚都不能不动心，何况“小和尚”？
Those eyes could enchant even an old monk of proven spiritual discipline, let alone a “Little Monk.”


一口气把一筒烟抽完，郁四抓起小茶壶喝了口茶，急急起身问道：
Having smoked the pipeful in one draught, Yu seized a small teapot, took a mouthful, and hastily sat up.

“你怎么来的？
“How did you find your way here?

来，来，躺一躺。”
Come, come—lie down a while.”

等他说到这句话，水晶阿七已经盈盈含笑，起身相让。
Before he finished speaking, A’qi was already rising with a graceful smile to yield her place.

胡雪岩觉得不必客气，
Hu saw no reason for excessive ceremony.

便也含笑点头，撩衣上了烟榻。
Smiling and nodding in return, he gathered up his robe and climbed onto the opium couch.

“阿七！这是胡老板，贵客！”
“A’qi, this is Mr Hu, a distinguished guest.”

“郁四哥，”胡雪岩纠正他说，“你该说是好朋友！”
“Brother Yu,” Hu corrected him, “you should say a good friend.”

“对，对。
“Quite right, quite right.

是贵客也是好朋友。”
A distinguished guest and a good friend.”

于是阿七一面行礼，一面招呼，然后端张小凳子坐在床前替郁四装烟。
A’qi offered her greetings and fetched a small stool, sitting beside the bed to prepare another pipe for Yu.

“你怎么来的？”郁四又问。
“How did you find me?” Yu asked again.

“先到碧浪春，有个后生领了我来的。”
“I went to Bilangchun first, and a young fellow brought me here.”

胡雪岩特意不提小和尚的名字。
Hu deliberately omitted Little Monk’s name.

“想来还不曾吃饭？
“I suppose you have not eaten?

就在这里将就一顿。
Stay and make do with a meal here.

阿七，你去看看，添几个中吃的菜！”
A’qi, go and see about adding a few decent dishes.”


等阿七去照料开饭，胡雪岩和郁四便隔看烟勺，低声交谈，
When she had gone to attend to lunch, Hu and Yu spoke quietly across the opium lamp.

他直追来意，说要抽回禀帖，重新写过。
Hu came directly to his purpose: he wished to withdraw the petition and rewrite it.

“怎么写法？”
“What change do you want to make?”

“恒利的规模不大，
“Hengli is rather small.

我想分开来做，
I propose to divide the business.

本地的收支归恒利，汇到省里的款子，另外委托别家。”
Hengli can handle local receipts and payments, while another bank deals with funds remitted to the provincial capital.”

“你想托哪一家？”
“Which bank have you in mind?”

“这就是我要跟你商量的了。”
“That is just what I wanted to discuss with you.

胡雪岩问：“郁四哥，你有没有熟的钱庄？”
Is there a bank you know well?”

“有！”
“There is.”

郁四一面打烟，一面不知在想些什么？
Yu went on preparing his opium, apparently absorbed in thought.

好久，他才问道：“你的意思要我替你找一定？”
After a considerable pause, he asked, “You want me to choose one for you?”

“是啊！”
“Yes.”

“假使换了别人，我马上就可以告诉你，哪一家靠得住。
“If someone else had asked, I could name a reliable bank at once.

现在是你托我，话当另说，
But since it is you, we must speak differently.

做钱庄你是本行，
Banking is your own trade.

无须找我，找到我总有说法。
You have no need to consult me unless there is something more behind it.

自己人，你尽管实说，看我替你想得对不对？”
We are friends; tell me frankly, and let us see whether I have understood your needs.”


听这番话，郁四已经胸有成竹，为自己打算好了一个办法。
From this, Hu could tell that Yu had already worked out a plan for him.

这当然要开诚布公来谈，
They ought, of course, to discuss it candidly.

但以牵连着王有龄和杨用之，措词必须慎重，所以这样答道；
Yet Wang and Yang were involved, so he must choose his words with care.

“什么事瞒不过你郁四哥。
“Nothing escapes you, Brother Yu.

我跟王大老爷有一段特别的交情，杨师爷也相处得不借，
I have a special friendship with Prefect Wang and get on very well with Master Yang.

不过公事上要让你们交代得过去，
But in official matters, everything must leave you all able to account for yourselves.

决不能叫帮忙的朋友受累，
I must never let a friend suffer for helping me.

这是我在外面混，铁定不移的一个宗旨。
That is an unalterable principle of my dealings in the world.

郁四哥，你就是不是？”当然是罗！
Would you not agree?” Naturally Yu agreed.

胡雪岩说这段话的用意，一则是为王有龄和杨用之“撇清”，再则也是向眼前一见成为知交的朋友表明，他不会做出什么半吊子的事来。
Hu’s words served two purposes: to keep Wang and Yang clear of responsibility, and to assure this new friend, already so close, that he would never behave like a bungling fool.

郁四懂得这意思，所以虽未开口，却是不断点头。
Yu understood and nodded repeatedly without speaking.

“ ‘钱庄代理公库的好处，无非拿公款来调度，
“The advantage to a bank in acting for a public treasury,” Hu continued, “is simply that it can make use of the public funds.

不过这又不比大户的存款，摆着不动，尽可以放出去吃利息。
But these are unlike a wealthy client’s deposit, which may remain untouched and can safely be lent out at interest.

公款只有短期调动。
Public money can be employed only for short periods.

倘或一时无法运用，那就变成白当差了。”
If no immediate use can be found for it, one ends up working for nothing.”

“嗯，嗯！”郁四说道，
“Yes, yes,” Yu said.

“我的想法跟你差不多。
“That is much how I see it.

请再说下去。”
Go on.”


“我的意思是想在这里买丝，
“My idea was to buy silk here.

如果行情俏，一转手有顶‘帽子，好抢。
If the market were strong, a quick resale would leave a margin to be picked up.

不过现在看起来不行了，
That no longer seems possible.

而且既然跟你联手，我的做法要改一改，
Besides, now that we are joining forces, I must change my approach.

怎么改？
How?

要请教你。
That is what I want your advice on.”

““老实说，我也有家钱庄，
“To be frank, I have a bank myself.

我是三股东之一，叫我兄弟出面。
I am one of three partners, with my brother acting in my place.

本地府、县两库，我如果想代理，早就代理了，
If I had wanted it to handle the local prefectural and county treasuries, I could have arranged that long ago.

就怕外头说闲话。
I held back only because people would talk.

所以我这家钱庄，现在也不能跟你做联号，公款汇划，我决不能沾手。
For the same reason, my bank cannot now become your affiliate: I must have no hand in transferring public funds.

我在想，你何不在湖州设阜康分号？”
What I am wondering is this—why not open a Huzhou branch of Fukang?”


这原是胡雪岩换希望，但此时脚跟未稳，还谈不到，
That was precisely what Hu wanted, but he had not yet established himself locally and had thought it too early to consider.

因而踌躇着不知如何作答？
He hesitated, unsure how to answer.

“你是怕人地生疏？”
“Are you worried about being unfamiliar with the place and its people?”

郁四转过脸来，看着他问。
Yu turned to look at him as he asked.

由这个动作，见得他很认真。
The movement showed how seriously he meant the question.

胡雪岩心想，钱庄设分号不是一件说开张就开张，象摆个菜摊那么容易的事，
Opening a branch bank was not a matter of announcing that one was open for business, as though setting up a vegetable stall.

既然郁四也是内行，其间的难处，他当然想过，
Since Yu knew the trade, he must have considered the difficulties.

倒要先听听他的再说。
Hu decided to hear him out.

“地是生疏，人倒不然，
“The place is unfamiliar; the people are another matter.

别的不说，光说有你郁四哥，我还怕什么？
With you here, Brother Yu, what have I to fear?

现在我跟郁四哥还是同行，我要请教，阜康这个分号，应该如何开法？”
Now that I know we are fellow bankers, let me ask how you think this branch should be established.”

“你这个分号与众不同。
“Your branch will be different from others.

只为两年事，第一件代理公库，第二件是为了买丝方便，
It will serve only two purposes: first, handling public treasury business; second, making it convenient to buy silk.

所以样子虽要摆得够气派，人倒用得不必多，
Its premises must therefore look sufficiently impressive, but it will not need many staff.

你自己有人最好，
If you have your own people, so much the better.

不然我替你找。
Otherwise I shall find them for you.

这是第一件。”
That is the first point.”


“弟二件呢？”
“And the second?”

“第二件当然是本钱。”
“Capital, naturally.

郁四说，“你这个分号本钱要大，一万、两万说要就要。
Your branch will need access to substantial sums—ten or twenty thousand taels whenever they are required.

但不做长期放款，总不能备足了头寸空等，
Yet you will not be making long-term loans, and you cannot keep all that money sitting idle.

所以我替你想，你索性不必再从杭州调头寸过来了，
My suggestion is that you need not transfer any funds from Hangzhou.

除掉府、县公款，另外要多少，由我那里拨。”
Beyond what you receive from the prefectural and county treasuries, whatever you require can be supplied from my bank.”

这是太好了！
This was better than Hu could have hoped.

胡雪岩大喜：“承郁四哥帮忙，还有什么话说？
Delighted, he said, “With such help from you, what more could I ask?

我照同行的拆息照算。”
I shall pay the usual rate for interbank borrowing.”

“不，你不能照同行拆息。”郁四说，
“No, you must not pay that rate,” Yu replied.

“这一来你就没好处了。
“It would leave you no advantage.

我们另外定一个算法。”
We shall work out another arrangement.”

郁四所提的办法是有伸缩的，也就是提成的办法，
His proposal was flexible: the return would be shared proportionately.

如果阜康放款给客户，取息一分，郁四的钱庄，就收半分，是八厘，便取四厘。
If Fukang lent to a customer at one per cent, Yu’s bank would receive half a per cent; if the rate were eight-tenths of one per cent, it would receive four-tenths.

总而言之，两家对分。
In short, the two banks would divide the interest equally.

换句话说，阜康转一转手，便可取得一半的利益。
Fukang would earn half the return simply by passing the funds through its hands.


世上真难得有这样的好事！
Such an opportunity was rare indeed.

但细想一想，阜康也不是不劳而获，
On reflection, however, Fukang would not be earning money for nothing.

要凭关系手腕，将郁四的款子用出去，
It would have to use its connections and skill to put Yu’s funds to work.

否则他的钱再多，大钱不会生小钱，摆在那里也是“烂头寸”。
Otherwise, however much he possessed, his large sums would breed no smaller ones; money left sitting idle was still dead money.

话虽如此，无论如何还算是胡雪岩占便宜，
Even so, Hu was unquestionably getting the better of the arrangement.

所以他连连道谢，但也放了两句话下来。
He thanked Yu repeatedly, but also made a promise.

“自己人不必假客气，光棍眼里更是揉不得砂子，
“Friends need not exchange empty courtesies, and a man who knows the world will not tolerate dust in his eyes.

我老实跟郁四哥说，
I shall speak plainly.

钱庄这一行，我有十足的把握。
I have complete confidence in my ability as a banker.

我敢说一句，别人的生意一定没有我做得活。
I dare say no one else can conduct the business more flexibly.

既然郁四哥你挑我，我也一定会替郁四哥挣面子。
Since you are giving me this opportunity, I shall make certain you have reason to be proud of me.”

““你这两句话倒实惠。”郁上慢吞吞答道：
“Those two remarks are worth something,” Yu answered slowly.

“我也跟你说句老实话，
“Let me be equally frank.

我自己的这班老弟兄，‘小角色’，做什么都行，就是做生意，
My old comrades and the younger fellows under them can manage almost anything—except business.

没有象你老兄这样一等一的能干朋友，
Among them I have no friend of your exceptional ability.

就有几个门槛外头的朋友，也算是好角色，比起你来，还差一截，
I do know a few capable men outside the brotherhood, but they still fall short of you.

再说，也没有跟你这样投缘。”
Nor have I ever felt the same immediate affinity with them.”

这完全是托以腹心的表示，
This was an expression of complete confidence.

胡雪岩倒不便再作泛泛的谦逊之词的，
Conventional modesty would have been out of place.

只答了两个字：“我懂！”
Hu answered simply, “I understand.”


“你当然懂！
“Of course you do.

我这双眼睛看人也是蛮‘毒’的。”
I have a pretty sharp eye for a man myself.”

交情到此，己无须客套。
Their friendship had reached a point at which further ceremony was unnecessary.

这时水晶阿七已领着人来开饭，
A’qi now brought people in to serve lunch.

靠窗红木桌子上，摆满了一桌子的菜，
The redwood table by the window was covered with dishes.

宾主二人，相向而坐，水晶阿七打横相陪，胡雪岩戏称她为“四嫂”。
Host and guest sat facing each other, with A’qi at the side; Hu jokingly addressed her as Fourth Sister-in-Law.

“胡老板吃啥酒？”阿七指着郁四说：
“What wine will Mr Hu have?” she asked, pointing to Yu.

“他是个没火气的人，六月里都吃‘虎骨木瓜烧’。”
