“He has so little warmth in him that even in the sixth month he drinks spirits infused with tiger bone and quince.”

“今天不吃这个了。”
“Not today.”

过足了瘾的郁四，从烟榻上一跃而起，伸腿踢脚，仿佛要下场子练武一般，
His craving satisfied, Yu sprang from the opium couch and stretched and kicked his legs as though about to give a display of martial arts.

然后把两手的骨节，捏得“咯啦。咯啦”地响，耸耸肩，扭扭腰，是非常舒服的样子。
Then he cracked the joints of both hands, shrugged his shoulders, and twisted at the waist, plainly feeling wonderfully comfortable.

“说嘛！”
“Well?”

阿七催他，
A’qi prompted.

“吃啥酒？”
“What wine?”

“把那瓶外国酒瓶子装的药酒拿来。”
“Bring the medicinal wine in the foreign bottle.”

“哪一瓶？”
“Which one?”

阿七略显迟疑，
She hesitated.

“顶好的那一瓶？”
“The very best?”

“自然是顶好的那一瓶！”
“Naturally the very best!”

郁四狠狠瞪了她一眼。
Yu gave her a fierce look.

阿七这才明白，胡雪岩是郁四真正看重的一个好朋友，
Only then did she realize how highly he valued this friend.

急忙陪笑，
She hurried to smile apologetically.

“胡老板，不是我小气，
“Mr Hu, it is not that I am mean.

我不知道……”“好了，好了！”郁四拦着她说，
I did not realize—” “Enough, enough!” Yu interrupted.

“越描越黑。
“The more you explain, the worse you make it.

快拿酒来！”
Bring the wine.”


这瓶酒实在名贵。
It was indeed precious.

据郁四自己说，是照大内的秘方，配齐道地药材，用上等的汾酒泡制而成，
According to Yu, it had been made from the finest Fen spirits and authentic medicinal ingredients, following a secret prescription from the imperial palace.

光是向御医买这张方子，就花了一百两银子，一剂药配成功，也得花到二百多两。
The prescription alone had cost a hundred taels, paid to an imperial physician; a single batch of the medicine cost more than two hundred.

已经泡了三年，郁四还舍不得喝，
The wine had been steeping for three years, and Yu had still been unwilling to drink it.

“倒不是铜钿银子上的事，”他说：
“It is not a question of money,” he explained.

“有几样药材，有钱没处买。”
“Some of the ingredients cannot be bought at any price.”

“原来说过，要到五十岁生日那于打开来。”阿七笑道，
“He said he would not open it until his fiftieth birthday,” A’qi said with a smile.

“今天叨胡老板的光，我也尝一尝这瓶宝贝酒，
“Thanks to you, Mr Hu, I shall have a taste of this treasure today.

不晓得怎么好法？”
I wonder what is so wonderful about it.”

“怎么好法？
“What is wonderful?

你到了晚上就知道了！”
You will find out tonight!”

郁四说了这一句，与胡雪岩相顾而笑，
Yu and Hu exchanged a laugh.

讲到风情话，阿七即使视如常事，也不能表现得无动于衷，
A’qi might be accustomed to such suggestive banter, but she could hardly appear entirely unmoved.

白了郁四一眼，嗔道：
She rolled her eyes at Yu and scolded him.

“狗嘴里长不出象牙！”
“No ivory ever grows in a dog’s mouth!”

说笑过一阵，肃客入厅，尝那瓶名贵的药酒，
After a little more joking, they settled to sample the rare medicinal wine.

胡雪岩自然说好，郁四便要把方子抄给他。
Hu naturally pronounced it excellent, whereupon Yu offered to copy out the prescription for him.

这样应酬过了，便须重新谈入正题，
Once these courtesies were over, they needed to return to business.

事情很多，一时有无从谈起之苦，所以胡雪岩举杯沉吟着。
There was so much to discuss that Hu scarcely knew where to begin; he held his cup and considered.


郁四当他有问顾忌，
Yu mistook his silence for reserve.

便指着阿七说：“她没有别样好处，
Pointing to A’qi, he said, “She may have no other virtues, but she has two.

第一是口紧，听了什么话，从来不在外面说一句。
First, she keeps her mouth shut: whatever she hears, she never repeats a word outside.

第二是真心真肚肠，一眼就看得清清楚楚，
Second, her heart is perfectly open and sincere—you can see straight through it.

所以叫做‘水晶’。”
That is why she is called ‘Crystal.’”

说完，斜睨着阿七笑了。
He gave her a sidelong smile.

这一笑便大有狎昵之意，阿七似乎真的着恼了，
There was something unmistakably intimate in it, and A’qi seemed genuinely annoyed.

“死鬼！”她低声骂道：
“You wretch!” she muttered.

“什么水晶不水晶，
“What nonsense about crystal!

当着客人胡说八道！”
Talking such rubbish in front of a guest!”

郁四有些轻骨头，阿七越骂他越笑，
Yu had a weakness for being scolded by her; the more she reproached him, the more he laughed.

当然，她也是骂过算数，
She, for her part, was satisfied once she had said her piece.

转脸向胡雪岩和颜悦色他说：“胡老板，你不要笑话我，
Turning to Hu with a pleasant expression, she said, “Do not laugh at me, Mr Hu.

老头子一天不惹我骂两声，不得过门。”
The old fellow cannot get through a day without provoking me into scolding him.”

“原是要这样子才有趣。”胡雪岩笑着答道：
“That is what makes it enjoyable,” Hu replied with a smile.

“要是我做了郁四哥，也要你每天骂两句才舒服。”阿七笑了，笑得极甜，加上她那水银流转似的秋波，春意盎然。
“If I were Brother Yu, I too would need a scolding from you every day to feel quite comfortable.” She laughed sweetly, her eyes bright and fluid as quicksilver, full of warmth and invitation.

胡雪岩心中一荡，但立刻就有警觉，
Hu felt another stir of attraction, but caught himself at once.

江湖道上，最忌这一套，
Such conduct was among the gravest offences in the brotherhood’s world.

所以赶紧收敛心神，把视线移了开去。
He quickly composed his thoughts and looked away.


“我们先谈钱庄。”郁四迎着他的眼光问道：
“Let us begin with the bank,” Yu said, meeting his eyes.

“我那爿钱庄叫聚成，
“Mine is called Jucheng.

也在县前，离恒利不远。”
It too is in front of the county yamen, not far from Hengli.”

“郁四哥，”胡雪岩问道：“你看，我阜康分号，就在聚成挂块牌子如何？”
“Brother Yu, what would you think of my putting up a sign for the Fukang branch at Jucheng?”

“也未尝不可。不过不是好办法，
“It could be done, but it would not be a good arrangement.

第一，外面看起来，两家是一家。
First, outsiders would take the two concerns for one.

第二，你迟早要自立门户的，
Second, sooner or later you must have premises of your own.

将来分了出去，跑惯的客户会觉得不便。”
When you move, customers accustomed to coming to us will find it inconvenient.”

这两层道理胡雪岩自然都知道，
Hu knew both points perfectly well.

但他实在是缺少帮手，一个人办不了那么多事，
The difficulty was his shortage of help: one man could not attend to so many things.

打算着先“借地安营”，把阜康招牌挂了出来，看丝行生意是否顺手，再作道理。
He had intended to borrow a place to establish himself, put up Fukang’s sign, and see how the silk business developed before deciding what to do next.

现在因为郁四不以为然，只好打消了这个念头。
Since Yu disapproved, he had to abandon the idea.

“我也晓得，你一定是因为人手不够。
“I know you must be short of people,” Yu continued.

这一点，我可以帮你的忙。不过只能派人替你跑跑腿，
“I can help you there, though only by supplying men to run errands.

档手还是要你自己去寻。”
You will still have to find a manager yourself.”


“这不一定。”
“Not necessarily.”

胡雪岩把他用刘庆生的经过，说了一遍，
Hu described how he had come to employ Liu Qingsheng.

“我喜欢用年纪轻，脑筋灵活的人，
“I like young men with quick minds.

钱庄这一行不大懂，倒没有关系，我可以教他。”
It does not matter if they know little about banking; I can teach them.”

“这样的人，一时倒还想不出。”
“I cannot think of such a person offhand.”

郁四转脸问阿七，
Yu turned to A’qi.

“你倒想想看！”
“Can you think of anyone?”

“有是有一个，说出来一定不中听，
“There is one, but you would not like the suggestion.

还是不说的好。”
I had better keep quiet.”

“说说也不要紧。”
“There is no harm in mentioning him.”

“年纪轻，脑筋灵活，
“Young and quick-witted?

有一个：小和尚。”
There is Little Monk.”

这话一出口，郁四未有表示，胡雪岩先就心中一动。双眼不自觉地一抬。
Before Yu could respond, something stirred in Hu’s mind, and his eyes lifted involuntarily.

郁四是何等角色，马上就发觉了，
Yu was far too shrewd to miss it.

“怎么！”他问，
“What?” he asked.

“你晓得这个人？”
“Do you know him?”

“刚才就是他陪我来的。”胡雪岩泰然自若的回答。
“He was the one who brought me here just now,” Hu answered without losing his composure.

“咦！”阿七诧异地问：
“Oh!” A’qi asked in surprise.

“他为什么不进来呢？”
“Why did he not come in?”


从这一问中，可知郁四不准小和尚到这里来，阿七并不知道，
Her question revealed that she knew nothing of Yu’s prohibition.

如果照实回答，西洋镜拆穿，说不定他们俩便有一场饥荒好打。
If Hu answered truthfully and exposed the little secret, the two might quarrel.

就算郁四驾驭得住阿七，这样不准人上门，也不是什么漂亮的举动，
Even if Yu could keep A’qi in order, forbidding a young man to visit was hardly a creditable act.

所双胡雪岩决定替郁四隐瞒。
Hu decided to conceal it for him.

“我倒是邀他一起进来的。”胡雪岩说，
“I did invite him in,” he said.

“他在碧浪春有个朋友等着，
“But a friend was waiting for him at Bilangchun.

特地抽工夫来领我的路，领到了还要赶回去陪朋友。”
He had made time specially to show me the way and had to hurry back once he had brought me here.”

这番谎编得点水不漏，连郁四都信以为真，
The fabrication was so watertight that even Yu believed it.

看他脸色便知有如释重负之感，
His expression visibly relaxed.

“小和尚的脑筋倒是好的，”他说，
“Little Monk certainly has a good head on him,” he said.

“不过……”“什么不过！”
“Only—” “Only what?”

阿七抢着说道，
A’qi broke in.

“把小和尚荐给胡老板，再好都没有。
“Nothing could be better than recommending him to Mr Hu.

人家‘四叔，四叔’，叫得你好亲热，
He is forever calling you ‘Fourth Uncle’ so affectionately.

有机会来了，你不挑挑小角色？“
When an opportunity comes, should you not give a younger man a helping hand?”


绷在场面上，阿七说的又是冠冕堂皇的话，郁四不便峻拒，
Pressed in front of a guest, and faced with such an unimpeachable argument, Yu could hardly refuse outright.

只好转脸对胡雪岩说，
He turned to Hu.

“你先看看人再说。
“See the fellow first.

如果你合意就用，不然我另外替你找。”
If you like him, employ him; otherwise I shall find you someone else.”

其实胡雪岩对小和尚倒颇为欣赏，
Hu already thought rather well of Little Monk.

他虽不是做档手的材料。跑跑外场，一定是把好手。
He was not material for a bank manager, but he would be excellent at dealing with people outside.

不过其中有那么一段暧昧的心病是内，他不能不慎重考虑，
Still, that hidden and awkward source of jealousy required careful consideration.

所以点点头答道：
Hu nodded.

“好的！
“Very well.

等我跟他谈一谈再说。”
Let me talk to him first.”

“我也想寻你这面一个人谈一谈。”郁四突然问道，
“There is someone on your side I should like to talk to as well,” Yu said suddenly.

“老张这个人怎么样？”
“What sort of man is Old Zhang?”

“忠厚老成。”
“Honest and steady.

胡雪岩说，“做生意的本事恐怕有限。
His business ability is probably limited.

将来我们联手来做，郁四哥，你派个人来‘抓总’。”
When we join forces, you had better put in someone of your own to take overall charge.”

“不好，不好！”
“No, no!”

郁四使劲摇着头，
Yu shook his head vigorously.

“已成之局不必动，
“There is no need to upset an arrangement already made.

将来还是老张‘抓总’，下面的‘做手，我来寻。
Zhang should remain in charge; I shall find the men to work under him.

我想跟老张谈一谈，就是想看他是哪一路人，好寻个脾气相配的人给他。
I wanted to talk to him only to see what sort of fellow he was, so that I could choose someone whose temperament suited his.

现在你一说我晓得了，
Now that you have told me, I understand.

这件事等过了明天晚上再说。
We can leave that until after tomorrow evening.

此刻我们先办你钱庄的事，
For now, let us deal with your bank.

禀帖我先压下来，随时可办，不必急，
I shall hold back the petition; it can be processed at any time, so there is no hurry.

第一步你要寻人寻房子。
Your first step is to find staff and premises.

回头我陪你到’混堂‘泡一泡，
Presently I shall take you to the bathhouse for a soak.

要找什么人方便得很。”
It is an excellent place to find whoever you need.”


于是停杯吃饭，饭罢到一家名叫“沂园”的浴室去洗澡。
They put aside their cups and finished the meal, then went to a bathhouse called Yiyuan.

郁四每日必到，有固定的座位，那一排座都给他留着招待朋友。
Yu visited every day and had his own fixed place; the whole row was reserved for him to entertain friends.

一到坐定，跟在碧浪春一样，立刻有许多人上来招呼。
As at Bilangchun, people came up to greet him as soon as he sat down.

这一回郁四又不同的，不管来人身分高低，一律替胡雪岩引见，
This time he introduced everyone to Hu, whatever their standing.

应酬了好一会，才得静下来。
Only after a considerable round of greetings were they left in peace.

“小和尚这一刻在哪里？”他就这么随便看着人问，
“Where will Little Monk be just now?” he asked casually of those nearby.

“有人晓得没有？”
“Does anyone know?”

“还会在哪里？
“Where else?

自然是王家赌场。”有人回答。
At the Wang family’s gambling house, of course,” someone answered.

胡雪岩明白郁四的意思，是要找小和尚来谈，
Hu understood that Yu intended to send for the young man.

便拦阻他说。“郁四哥，慢一慢！”
“A moment, Brother Yu,” he intervened.

“怎么样？”
“What is it?”

胡雪岩想了一会问道：
Hu considered.

“不晓得他肯不行跟我到杭州去？”
“I wonder whether he would be willing to come to Hangzhou with me.”

“咦！”
“Eh?”

郁四不解，
Yu was puzzled.

“你怎么想的，要把他带到杭州去？”
“Why do you want to take him to Hangzhou?”

“我在杭州，少这么一个可以替我在外面跑跑的人。”胡雪岩这样回答。
“I need someone there to go out and attend to things for me.”

“他从没有出过湖州府一步，
“He has never set foot outside Huzhou Prefecture.

到省城里，两眼漆黑，
In the provincial capital he would be completely at sea.

有啥用处？”
What use would he be?”

胡雪岩没有防到，郁四会持反对的态度，而且说的话极在理，所以他一时无法回答，不由得愣了一愣。
Hu had not expected opposition, and Yu’s objection was so reasonable that he was momentarily at a loss.


这一愣便露了马脚，
That moment’s hesitation betrayed him.

郁四的心思也很快，
Yu’s mind worked quickly too.

把从阿七提起小和尚以后，胡雪岩所说的话，合在一起想了一下，断定其中必有不尽不实之外，
Reviewing everything Hu had said since A’qi first mentioned Little Monk, he concluded that something had been left unsaid or was not entirely true.

如果不想交这个朋友，可以置诸不问，
Had he no wish to cultivate this friendship, he could have ignored it.

现在彼此一见，要往深里结交，就不能听其自然了。
But they had taken to each other at once and intended to become close; he could not simply let the matter pass.

“小和尚这个人滑得很，”他以忠告的语气说：
“Little Monk is a very slippery fellow,” he said in a warning tone.

“你不可信他的话。”
“You must not believe everything he tells you.”

光棍“一点就透”，
A man of experience needed only a hint.

胡雪岩知道郁四已经发觉，小和尚曾有什么话，他没有告诉他。
Hu knew that Yu had detected some unreported remark by Little Monk.

有道是“光棍心多”，这一点误会不解释清楚，后果会很严重。
Worldly men were apt to be suspicious; unless he cleared up this misunderstanding, the consequences could be serious.

便是解释也很难措词，
Yet an explanation would be difficult to frame.

说不定就是一出“乌龙院”，
What if this were another Wulong Courtyard affair, a tale of betrayal like that in which Song Jiang’s woman, Yan Poxi, took a lover?

揭了开来，郁四脸上会挂不住。
Exposing it could cost Yu his dignity.

再想想不至于，
On reflection, Hu thought it unlikely.

阿七胸无城府，不象阎波惜，郁四更不会象宋江那么能忍，而小和尚似乎也不敢，
A’qi was open-hearted, unlike Yan Poxi; Yu would never be as forbearing as Song Jiang; and Little Monk hardly seemed bold enough.

果有其事，便决不肯坦率自道郁四不准他上阿七的门。
Had there been an affair, he would never have admitted so readily that Yu barred him from A’qi’s door.

不过阿七对小和尚另眼相看，那时毫无可疑的，
Still, there was no doubt that A’qi looked favourably on the young man.

趁此机会说一说，让郁四有个警觉，也不算是冒昧之事。
It would not be presumptuous to mention the matter now and put Yu on his guard.


于是他说：“郁四哥，我跟你说实话。
“Brother Yu, let me tell you frankly.

小和尚这个人，我倒很中意。
I rather like Little Monk.

不过他说你不准他上门，所以我不能在湖州用他。
But he told me you would not let him visit A’qi’s house, so I cannot employ him in Huzhou.

你我相交的日子长，
You and I have a long friendship ahead of us.

我不能弄个你讨厌的人在眼前。
I cannot put someone you dislike under your nose.

我带他到杭州就无所谓了。”
If I take him to Hangzhou, that difficulty disappears.”

这才见得胡雪岩用心之深！
Only now did Yu appreciate the depth of Hu’s consideration.

特别是当着阿七，不说破他曾有不准小和尚上门的话，
Above all, he had refrained from revealing the prohibition in front of A’qi.

郁四认为他为朋友打算，真个无微不至。
Here was a man who thought of every detail where a friend was concerned.

照此看来，他要带小和尚到杭州，多半也是为了自己，免得阿七见了这个“油头小光棍”，心里七上八落。
Seen in this light, his proposal to take Little Monk to Hangzhou was probably also for Yu’s benefit, to spare A’qi the restless thoughts that the sight of this slick young rogue might stir.

心感之下，郁四反倒觉得有劝阻他的必要：
Moved by such solicitude, Yu felt all the more obliged to dissuade him.

“不错，我有点讨厌小和尚。
“It is true that I dislike Little Monk.

不过，讨厌归讨厌，管我还是要管。
But dislike him or not, I still have to look after him.

这个人太滑，吃玩嫖赌，无一不精，
He is too slippery—an expert at eating, amusement, whoring, and gambling.

你把他带了去要受累。“
If you take him with you, he will cause you trouble.”


“吃玩嫖赌，都不要紧。”胡雪岩说：
“None of those habits matters,” Hu said.

“我只问郁四哥一句话，小和尚可曾有过吃里扒外的行为？”
“There is only one thing I want to ask you: has Little Monk ever betrayed his own people for an outsider?”

“那他不敢！
“He would not dare!

要做出这种事来，不说三刀六洞，起码湖州这个码头容不得他。”
If he did, even if he escaped the punishment of three knife-thrusts making six holes, Huzhou would certainly have no place for him.”

“即然如此，我还是带了他去。
“Then I shall take him after all.

就怕他自己不肯，
I only hope he is willing.

人，总是在熟地方好。”
People are always more comfortable where they know their surroundings.”

“没得这话！”
“That is no obstacle.”

郁四摇摇头：
Yu shook his head.

“你真的要他，他不肯也得肯。
“If you really want him, he must agree whether he likes it or not.

再说，跟了你这样的”爷叔辈子“，还有什么话说？
Besides, what more could he ask than to serve a man of your standing, one of his uncles’ generation?

我刚才的话，完全是为你着想。”
Everything I said just now was for your sake.”

“我知道，我知道。”
“I know, I know.

胡雪岩说，“我不怕他调皮。
I am not afraid of his tricks.

就算我自己驾驭不了，有你在那里，他敢不服帖？”
Even if I could not keep him in order myself, with you behind me, would he dare disobey?”

这句话恭维得恰到好处，郁四大为舒服。
The compliment was perfectly judged, and Yu felt thoroughly pleased.

再想一想，这样子“调虎离山”，而且出于阿七的推荐，轻轻易易地去了自己心中一个“痞块”，
Better still, this would lure the tiger away from its mountain and remove a persistent irritation from his heart—all on A’qi’s own recommendation.

岂非一件极痛快的事？
What could be more satisfactory?


“不过，这也不必急。”郁四从从容容他说，
“There is no hurry about this either,” Yu said at ease.

“这件事等你回省城以前办妥就可以了。
“It only needs to be settled before you return to the provincial capital.

等闲一闲，我先把小和尚找来，你跟他好好谈一谈，
When we have a quiet moment, I shall send for Little Monk and let you talk to him properly.

果真中意了，你不必跟他说什么，
If you really like him, say nothing to him yourself.

你把你的意思告诉我，带到杭州派他啥用场？等我来跟他说好了。
Tell me what you intend—what work you would give him in Hangzhou—and I shall speak to him.”

““好极，好极！”
“Excellent, excellent!”

胡雪岩要用小和尚，本就是一半为了郁四，乐得听他安排：
Hu’s wish to employ Little Monk had been half for Yu’s sake in the first place; he was happy to leave the arrangements to him.

“我就拜托郁四哥了。”
“I entrust the matter to you, then.”

到沂园来“孵混堂”，主要的就是避开阿七谈小和尚，
Their chief purpose in lingering at Yiyuan had been to discuss Little Monk away from A’qi.

既有结果，不必再“孵”，
Now that it was settled, there was no need to remain.

胡雪岩穿衣告辞，急着要跟老张去碰头。
Hu dressed and took his leave, eager to meet Old Zhang.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（上）》第九章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume I — Chapter Nine, concluding part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


“你一个人去，陌陌生生，怎么走法？”郁四把沂园的伙计喊了来说：
“How will you find your way alone in a place you don't know?” Yu called over an attendant at Yiyuan.

“你到轿行里去喊顶轿子，
“Go to the chair agency and have them send a chair.

说是我要的。”
Tell them it's for me.”

很快地，簇新的一顶轿子抬到，三个年轻力壮的轿伕，态度非常谦恭，这自然是郁四吩咐过了的缘故，
A brand-new sedan chair soon arrived, carried by three strong young men whose manner was exceptionally deferential—naturally, because Yu had sent for them.

胡雪岩说了地址，上轿就走。
Hu gave the address, got in, and set off.

张家住在城外，就在码头旁边一条小巷子里，
The Zhang family lived outside the city, in a narrow lane beside the wharf.

轿子一抬进去就塞住了，
The chair almost blocked the lane as it entered.

这条巷子，实在也难得有轿子经过，所以路人不但侧身而让，并且侧目而视，
Sedan chairs seldom came this way, so passers-by not only turned sideways to let it pass but stared at it.

其中一个就是阿珠。
Among them was A’zhu.

他没有看见，她却发现了，
Hu did not see her, but she saw him.

“喂，
“Hey!

喂！”她望着抬过门的轿子喊：
Hey!” she called as the chair went past the door.

“你们要抬到哪里去？”
“Where are you taking him?”

轿伕不理她，胡雪岩却听出是阿珠的声音，急忙拍拍扶手板，示意停轿。
The bearers ignored her, but Hu recognised her voice and hurriedly tapped the armrest to signal a halt.

“怎么到这时候才来？”一见面就是埋怨的口气，
“Why have you come so late?” she complained the instant they met.

显见得是“一家人”，让左邻右舍发觉了，会引起诧异。
Her manner was plainly that of someone addressing a member of the family, which would surprise any neighbours who noticed.

阿珠自觉失言，立刻红晕上脸，强笑道：
Realising her slip, she blushed and forced a smile.

“我们这条巷子里，难得有坐轿来的贵客！
“We rarely have distinguished guests arrive by chair in this lane!

请进来，请进来。”
Please come in.”

“你先进去。”
“You go in first.”

胡雪岩心细，看轿子停在门口，妨碍行人会挨骂，
Hu had noticed that the chair would obstruct pedestrians and invite abuse if left at the door.

所以先关照轿伕，把轿子停在巷口，然后进门。
He told the bearers to wait at the mouth of the lane, then entered.


进门就是客堂。
The front door opened straight into the reception room.

里面说话，大门外的人都听得见，自然不便，
Anyone outside could hear what was said there, making conversation awkward.

阿珠把他领到后面，
A’zhu led him to the rear.

隔着一个小小的天井，东面两问，看样子是卧室，
Across a tiny courtyard stood two rooms on the east, apparently bedrooms.

西面也是两间，一间厨房，炖肉的香味四溢，一间堆着什物。
There were two on the west as well: a kitchen, from which the smell of stewing meat spread, and a room full of miscellaneous belongings.

“只有到我房间里坐了！”阿珠有些踌躇，
“We'll have to sit in my room,” A’zhu said hesitantly.

“实在不大方便。”
“It really isn't very convenient.”

不方便是因为她父母都不在家，
The difficulty was that neither parent was home.

“到哪里去了？”胡雪岩问。
“Where have they gone?” Hu asked.

“ 还不是伺候你胡老爷！”阿珠微带怨怼地答道，
“Where else? Seeing to your needs, Mr Hu!” she answered with mild resentment.

“爹到衙门看你去了，
“Father's gone to the yamen to look for you.

娘在河滩上，看有什么新鲜鱼买一条，好等你来吃。”
Mother's at the riverbank, hoping to buy a fresh fish for your meal.”

“那么，你呢？
“And you?

你在门口等我？”
Were you waiting for me at the door?”

“哪个要等你？
“Who'd wait for you?

我在等我娘。”
I was waiting for Mother.”

“闲话少说。”胡雪岩说，
“Enough of that,” he said.

“要去通知你爹一声，
“Someone must tell your father.

不要叫他空等了。”
We can't leave him waiting for nothing.”

“不用，
“There's no need.

说好了的，等不到就回来，
We agreed he'd come back if he couldn't find you.

也快到家了。”
He should be home soon.”


说着，阿珠推开房门。
As she spoke, A’zhu pushed open her door.

屋中刚刚裱糊过，四白落地，十分明亮。
The walls had just been repapered, white all the way to the floor, making the room bright.

一张床，一张梳头桌，收拾得很洁净，桌上还有只花瓶，插着几朵荷花。
A bed and dressing table were kept scrupulously clean, and a few lotus flowers stood in a vase on the table.

“地方太小了！”阿珠不好意思地说。
“It's so small!” she said apologetically.

胡雪岩开了一句玩笑，她白了他一眼：
Hu made a teasing remark, and she gave him a reproachful glance.

“说说就没有好话了。”
“You can't speak without saying something improper.”

“来，来，坐下来再说。”
“Come, sit down and talk.”

两人坐下后，他刚要开口，阿珠像突然想起了什么，
They sat together, but just as he was about to speak, A’zhu seemed to remember something.

跳起身跑到客堂里，转了一圈又回来。
She jumped up, ran into the reception room, and returned.

“你做什么去了？”
“What did you go to do?”

“闩门。”她说，
“Bolt the door.

“大门不关上，客堂里的东西叫人偷光了都不晓得。”
If we leave it open, someone could steal everything in the reception room without our knowing.”

胡雪岩明白这只是托词，她是不想让父母突然进来，
Hu understood that this was an excuse: she did not want her parents to walk in unexpectedly.

便笑着答道：“现在你可以放心了。”
“Now you can stop worrying,” he answered with a smile.


胡雪岩有了过分亲近的举动。
Hu behaved too familiarly.

阿珠拒绝了他的一次举动后，他没有继续坚持，转而说起绣花，问她为什么不给自己绣件衣物。
When A’zhu refused one of his advances, he did not press it and turned the conversation to embroidery, asking why she had not embroidered a garment for herself.

“懒得动。”
“I can't be bothered.”

“你好好绣一个。
“Make a really fine piece.

绣好了，我有奖赏。”
When you've finished, I'll give you a reward.”

“奖赏！”阿珠笑道，
“A reward?” A’zhu laughed.

“奖什么？”
“What sort?”

“奖你一条金链条。
“A gold chain.

你看好不好？”
How would you like that?”

这怎么不好？
Naturally she liked the idea.

阿珠直望着他：“这样子讲究？”
Looking straight at him, she asked, “Something as fine as that?”

“这算得了什么？
“That's nothing.

将来有得你讲究。”
You'll have plenty of fine things in future.”

“好！一言为定。”阿珠很起劲地说，
“Very well, it's a promise!” she said eagerly.

“我好好绣一件红的。
“I'll embroider a red piece.

你看，绣什么花样？”
What pattern should I use?”

“自然是鸳鸯戏水。”
“Mandarin ducks playing in the water, of course.”

阿珠脸红了，低着头不作声。
A’zhu blushed and lowered her head without speaking.

“怎么样？”他催问，
“Well?” he urged.

“这个花样好不好？”
“Would that be a good pattern?”

她点点头，又看了他一眼。
She nodded and glanced at him again.

两人的私下相处这时被门外的两声敲门打断，接着有人喊：“阿珠，阿珠！”
Their private exchange was then interrupted by two knocks and a voice calling, “A’zhu! A’zhu!”


“我娘回来了！”
“Mother's back!”

阿珠慌忙起身，诸事不做，先照镜子，
A’zhu jumped up and looked in the mirror before doing anything else.

镜子里一张面泛桃花的脸，鬓边也有些乱，她着急他说：“都是你害人！
Seeing her flushed face and disordered hair, she said anxiously, “It's all your fault!

这样子怎么走得出去？”
How can I go out looking like this?”

“白天不做虚心事，夜半敲门心不惊！
“If you've done nothing wrong by day, a knock at midnight won't frighten you.

怕什么？
What's there to fear?

我去开门，
I'll open the door.

你把心定下来。”
Take a moment to calm down.”

胡雪岩倒真沉得住气，
Hu was indeed perfectly composed.

把长衫抹一抹，泰然自若地走了出去，开开门来，笑嘻嘻地叫了一声，“干娘！”
He smoothed his robe, walked out calmly, opened the door, and greeted her mother with a cheerful “Auntie!”

“咦！”阿珠的娘惊喜地问，
“Why!” she exclaimed, surprised and pleased.

“什么时候来的？”
“When did you arrive?”

“刚来不多一息。”
“Only a little while ago.”

“阿珠呢？”
“Where's A’zhu?”

“在后面。”
“At the back.”

胡雪岩知道阿珠红晕未退，有心救她一救，便问这样，问那样，绊住了阿珠的娘，容不得她抽身。
Knowing that A’zhu was still blushing, he tried to help her by asking one question after another, keeping her mother occupied and preventing her from going inside.


而她记挂着拎在手里的一条活鳜鱼，
Her mother, however, was worried about the live mandarin fish in her hand.

“桃花流水鳜鱼肥”，
As the verse said, “Peach blossoms drift on flowing waters, and the mandarin fish grow fat.”

春天不希罕，夏天却难得，
They were common enough in spring but hard to find in summer.

而且鳜鱼往往出水就死，
Moreover, they often died as soon as they were taken out of the water.

这却是一条活的，更为名贵，
This one was still alive, making it especially valuable.

急于想去“活杀”，偏偏胡雪岩絮絮不休，
She wanted to prepare it while it was fresh, but Hu would not stop talking.

只好找个空隙，向里大喊：“阿珠阿！”
Finding a pause at last, she called into the house, “A’zhu!”

阿珠已经心定神闲，把发鬓梳得整整齐齐的走了出来。
A’zhu emerged, calm now and with her hair neatly combed.

她娘便吩咐她去剖鱼，剖她了等她来动手，又问胡雪岩喜欢清蒸，还是红烧呢？
Her mother told her to clean the fish and leave it ready for cooking, then asked whether Hu preferred it steamed or braised in soy sauce.

“活鳜鱼不容易买到，
“A live mandarin fish is hard to come by.

自然是清蒸。”阿珠替他作了主。
Steamed, of course,” A’zhu decided for him.

胡雪岩还有许多事要办，
Hu still had much to do.

只待见老张一面，交代几句话就要走，
He had intended only to see Old Zhang, give him a few instructions, and leave.

现在看样子，这顿饭是非吃不可了！
Now it seemed he could not escape this meal.

这就索性在这里，跟老张把事情都商量好了再说。
He might as well stay and settle everything with Old Zhang.

“干娘！”他说，“吃饭是小事，
“Auntie,” he said, “the meal isn't important.

越简单越好、
The simpler the better.

等老张回来，我有许多话说。
I've a great deal to say when Old Zhang comes back.

市面要弄得很热闹，
We're going to make business lively here.

大家都有得忙，工夫不能白糟蹋！”
Everyone will be busy, and we can't waste time!”

阿珠的娘知道他是实话，
She knew he meant it.

好在她手下快，
Fortunately, she worked quickly.

好老张从县衙门回家，饭菜都已齐备，
By the time Old Zhang returned from the county yamen, the food was ready.

四个人团团坐下，边吃边谈。
The four sat round the table, eating and talking.


“一家人，我先要说句老实话。”
“We're family, so let me speak frankly.”

高踞上座的胡雪岩说：“明天一早，第一件事就是搬家！
Seated in the place of honour, Hu began, “The first thing tomorrow morning is to move house!

不管什么地方，搬了再说，
Anywhere will do for now.

这里实在太小了。”
This place is much too small.”

老张夫妇，面面相觑，
Old Zhang and his wife exchanged glances.

他们的感想一样，
Both were thinking the same thing.

搬家是件大事，
Moving was a major undertaking.

要看房子，拣黄道吉日，
They must find a house and choose an auspicious day.

家具什物虽不多，收拾起来也得两三天。
Though they had little furniture and few possessions, packing would still take two or three days.

胡雪岩一看他们的脸色就知通他们的心思，数着手指说。
Hu read their thoughts in their faces and counted off the points on his fingers.

“第一，房子明天一大早去看，
“First, look at houses early tomorrow.

象个样子就可以，
Anything reasonably presentable will do.

先租下来住了再说，
Rent it and move in.

好在自己要买房子，不过一个短局，她歹都无所谓。
Since you'll be buying a house eventually, this is only temporary, and its quality doesn't matter much.

第二，这些家具将来也用不着，
Second, you won't need this furniture later.

不如送了左邻右舍，做个人情，另外买新的。
Give it to the neighbours, earn their goodwill, and buy new things.

第三，拣日不如撞日，
Third, taking the day that comes is better than choosing one.

说搬就搬，
Once you decide to move, move!

明天一天把它都弄舒齐。”
Get everything settled tomorrow.”


“明天一天怕来不及。”阿珠的娘踌躇着说。
“I'm afraid we couldn't manage it all tomorrow,” A’zhu's mother said hesitantly.

“那就两天。”
“Then take two days.”

胡雪岩很“慷慨”地放宽了限期，但又重重地叮嘱了一句，“后天晚上，我到你们新搬的地方来吃饭。”
Hu extended the deadline with great “generosity,” but added emphatically, “The evening after tomorrow, I'll come to supper at your new house.”

“哪有这么快？”阿珠提出抗议，
“How can it be done so fast?” A’zhu protested.

“你只管你自己说得高兴，不想想人家。”
“You enjoy giving orders without thinking what they mean for other people.”

“来得及，来得及！”
“We can manage, we can!”

阿珠的娘不愿违拗胡雪岩的意思，
Her mother did not want to oppose him.

但只有一点顾虑，叫阿珠去拿皇历来看。
She had only one remaining concern and asked A’zhu to bring the almanac.

刚好，第二天、第三天都是宜于迁居的好日子，
Fortunately, both of the next two days were favourable for moving.

那就连最后一点顾虑都消除了，决定吃完晚饭，连夜去找房产经纪觅新居。
With that last anxiety removed, they decided to find a property broker that very evening after supper and begin looking for a new home.


“不要怕花钱！”
“Don't be afraid to spend money!”

胡雪岩取出一张二百两的银票，放在她面前：
Hu took out a banknote for two hundred taels and placed it before her.

“先拿这个去用。
“Use this to begin with.

我在湖州还要开钱庄，另外也还有些些生意要做，
I'm going to open a bank in Huzhou, and I've other business plans too.

只怕事情做不完，不怕没有钱用。
My worry is getting everything done, not finding money.

他们照我的话做，没有错！”
Follow my advice and you won't go wrong!”

这句话为他们带来了满怀的兴奋，但都矜持着，只睁大了眼，迷惘地看着这位“娇客”。
His words filled them with excitement, though they kept it to themselves, merely staring wide-eyed in bewilderment at this honoured prospective son-in-law.

喝了几杯的胡雪岩，回想这两无的经历，也是满心愉悦，得意非凡，
After several cups of wine, Hu was also delighted and immensely pleased with himself as he recalled the past two days.

因而谈兴大发，
He became expansive.

“说句实请，我也没有想到，今年脱运交运，会走到这样一步！”他说，
“Honestly, I never imagined that this year's change of fortune would bring me so far!

“哪个说‘福无双至’？
Who says blessings never come in pairs?

机会来起来，接二连三，
Opportunities keep arriving one after another.

推都推不开。
I couldn't turn them away if I tried.

我现在最苦的是，人手不足，
My greatest difficulty now is a shortage of people.

一个人当两个人，一天当两天，都还不够，
Even doing two men's work and fitting two days into one isn't enough.

实实在在要三头六臂才好。”
I really need three heads and six arms!”

“这就是所谓‘能者多劳’！”
“That's what they mean by ‘the capable must labour more’!”

阿珠的娘到底是大小姐出身，这样掉了一句话。
A’zhu's mother, after all, had grown up as a young lady and could produce a polished phrase.

“说到‘能’，那倒不必假客气，
“As for ability, there's no need for false modesty.

我自己晓得我的本事，
I know what I can do.

不过光是我一个人有本事也不行，
But ability alone isn't enough.

‘牡丹虽好，绿叶扶持’。
Even the finest peony needs green leaves to support it.

干娘，你说是不是？”
Isn't that so, Auntie?”

“是啊！
“Indeed.

不过你也不是‘光杆儿牡丹，，
But you aren't a peony on a bare stalk.

我们大家齐心合力，帮你来做。”
We'll all work together to help you.”


“就是这话。
“Exactly.

大家帮我来做！
Everyone must help.

再说名实话，帮我就是帮自己。”
And to speak frankly again, helping me means helping yourselves.”

胡雪岩看着老张说，
Hu looked at Old Zhang.

“县衙门的户书郁四，你总晓得？”
“You know Yu Si, the county revenue clerk?”

“晓得！”老张答道，
“Certainly,” Old Zhang answered.

“码头上就凭他一句话。”
“A word from him settles everything at the wharf.”

“那么我告诉你、郁四要眼我联手做丝生意。
“Then let me tell you: Yu is joining me in the silk business.

老张，你想想看，
Think of it, Old Zhang.

我在湖州，上有王大老爷，下有郁四，要钱有钱，要路子有路子，
In Huzhou I have Mr Wang above and Yu below, all the money and connections I need.

如果说不好好做一番市面出来，自己都对不起自己了。
If I didn't build a flourishing business with that, I'd be letting myself down.”

“老张老实，越是他这样说，越觉得不安，
Simple and honest as he was, Old Zhang grew more uneasy the more Hu said.

生意做得太大，自己才具不胜，
A business on such a scale was beyond his abilities.

所以踌躇着说：“只怕我挑不动这副担子！”
“I'm afraid the burden may be too much for me,” he said hesitantly.

“这话也是，”阿珠的娘也有些惴惴然，
“That's true,” A’zhu's mother added, also anxious.

“市面太大，他应付不来。
“He couldn't manage anything too large.

再说，郁四手下有的是人，
Besides, Yu has plenty of men.

未见得……”
He may not...”

“未见得什么？”胡雪岩抢讨她的话来说，
“May not what?” Hu interrupted.

“郁四是怎么样的人，你们总也晓得。
“You know what sort of man Yu is.

光棍做事，只要是朋友，只有拉人家一把，没有踹人家一脚的道理。
A man of standing helps his friends up; he doesn't kick them down.

他也晓得我们的交情不同，
He knows our relationship is special.

怎么好说不要老张？
How could he suggest leaving Old Zhang out?

你们老夫妇俩放心，
Set your minds at rest.

丝行开起来，你们只要把店里管好，坐在那里就有进帐。
Once the silk firm is open, all you need do is manage the shop properly, and the money will come in.

总而言之一句话，要勤、要快，
In a word, work hard and act quickly.

事情只管多做，
Do as much as you can.

做错了不要紧！有我在错不到哪里去的。”
Mistakes don't matter—with me here, you won't go far wrong.”


老张一面听，一面点头，脸上慢慢不同了，是那种有了把握的神气。
Old Zhang nodded as he listened, and his expression gradually changed into one of confidence.

等扒完一碗饭，他拿筷子指一指胡雪岩说：
When he had finished a bowl of rice, he gestured towards Hu with his chopsticks.

“你慢慢吃！
“Take your time over the meal.

我出去一趟。”
I'm going out.”

“这么晚了！”阿珠接口问道：
“At this hour?” A’zhu asked.

“到哪里去？”
“Where?”

“我去看房子。
“To look at a house.

我想起有个地方，前后两进，
I've remembered one with two courtyards, front and back.

好象大了点，不管它，
Perhaps it's rather large, but never mind.

先租下来再说。”
I'll rent it first.”

“对啊！”
“That's the spirit!”

胡雪岩大力高兴，
Hu was delighted.

“你请，你请！
“Go, go!

如果回来得快，我还好在这里等你听回音。”
If you're quick, I can wait here and hear the news.”

等老张一走，阿珠下逐客令了：
Once Old Zhang had left, A’zhu began sending Hu away too.

“我看你也早点吃完饭走吧，
“You'd better finish eating and go early.

一则你忙，
First, you're busy.

二则，你走了，我们好收拾。
Second, when you've gone, we can pack.

不然明天怎么搬？”
Otherwise, how are we to move tomorrow?”

“这倒是老实话。”她娘也这样说。
“That's plain truth,” her mother agreed.

胡雪岩深感安慰，
Hu was deeply reassured.

这一家三个人，就这一顿饭的工夫，脑筋都换过来了。
In the space of a single meal, the whole family had changed its way of thinking.

如果手下每个有都是这样子勤快，何愁生意不发达？
If everyone under him worked with such energy, how could his business fail to prosper?


到第二天，大家都忙，
Everyone was busy the next day.

老张夫妇忙着搬定，胡雪岩忙着筹划设立阜康分号，跟杨用之商量了一上午。
Old Zhang and his wife dealt with the move, while Hu planned the Fukang branch, discussing it with Yang Yongzhi throughout the morning.

到了日中，依旧到水晶阿七家去访郁四。
At noon he again called on Yu at Crystal A’qi's house.

谈完正事，谈到小和尚，
When their business was finished, the conversation turned to Little Monk.

却是阿七先提起来的，
A’qi herself raised the subject.

“胡老板，”她问，“你想把小和尚带到杭州去？”
“Mr Hu, are you thinking of taking Little Monk to Hangzhou?”

“是啊，还不知道他自己的意思怎么样？”
“Yes, though I don't yet know what he thinks of it.”

“你自然肯的。”
“He's bound to agree.

阿七又问，“我倒不懂胡老板为啥要把他带到杭州？”
But I don't understand why you want to take him there.”

这话在郁四问，不足为奇，
From Yu, the question would have been unremarkable.

出于阿七之口，就得好好想一想，
From A’qi, it required thought.

或许她已经疑心是郁四的指使，
Perhaps she already suspected that Yu had arranged it.

先得想办法替他解释这可能已有的误会。
Hu must first remove any such misunderstanding on his behalf.

“老实跟四嫂说，我看人最有把握。”他从从容容地答道：
“To be frank, Sister-in-law, I have great confidence in my judgement of people,” he answered calmly.

“小和尚人最活络，
“Little Monk is quick and adaptable.

能到大地方去历练历练，将来是一把好手。
If he gains experience in a larger place, he'll become a very capable man.

我不但要带他到杭州，还想带他到上海。”
I mean to take him not only to Hangzhou but to Shanghai as well.”

“上海十里夷场，他一去，更不得了。”
“Once he's in Shanghai's miles of foreign settlements, there'll be no holding him.”

阿七以一种做姐姐的口吻拜托：“胡老板要好好管一管他。”
Speaking like an elder sister, A’qi urged, “You must keep him under proper control.”

“是啊！”
“Certainly!”

胡雪岩趁机说道，
Hu seized the opportunity.

“郁四哥劝我，还是把小和尚放在湖州，多几个‘管头’，好叫他不敢调皮。
“Brother Yu advised me to leave him in Huzhou, where more people could keep an eye on him and stop him getting into mischief.

调皮不要紧，
Mischief doesn't worry me.

只上‘上路’，我有办法管他。”
As long as he understands how to behave, I have ways of managing him.”

这一说，阿七释然，郁四欣然，
A’qi was reassured and Yu pleased.

事实上阿七确有些疑心，让胡雪岩把小和尚带到杭州，是郁四的授意、
She had indeed suspected that Yu was sending Little Monk away through Hu.

现在才知道自己的疑心是多余的。
Now she believed her suspicions had been unnecessary.


“小和尚是我从小的邻居。”
“Little Monk has been my neighbour since childhood.”

阿七显然也想到了，自己对小和尚这么关心，须有解释，
A’qi evidently realised that her concern for him needed explaining too.

“他姐姐是我顶顶好的朋友，
“His elder sister was my closest friend.

死了好几年了。
She died several years ago.

小和尚就当我是他的姐姐，
He treats me as his sister.

他人最聪明，就是不务正业，
He's terribly clever, but he won't settle to honest work.

好赌，赌输了总来跟我要。
He loves gambling, and when he loses he always comes to me for money.

所以，”
So...”

她愤然作色，
Her expression became indignant.

“有些喜欢嚼舌头的，说我跟他怎么长，怎么短，
“Some people who love gossip make up all sorts of stories about us.

真气人！
It infuriates me!

说句难听的话，我是……
To put it bluntly, I'm a...”

““好了，好了！”
“There, there!”

郁四真怕她口没遮拦，自道“身分”，
Yu was truly afraid she would speak without restraint and name her profession.

因而赶紧拦住她说：
He hurriedly stopped her.

“ ‘只要我没嚼你的舌头就好了，旁人的闲话，管他呢？”
“As long as I'm not gossiping about you, why bother about anyone else?”

“你也敢！”
“You wouldn't dare!”

阿七戟手指着，放出泼妇的神态，但随即又笑了，笑得极其妩媚。
She pointed at him fiercely, looking for a moment like a shrew, then immediately broke into a charming smile.

胡雪岩倒是欣赏她这样爽朗的性情，
Hu admired her frank, spirited nature.

但郁四的禁脔，唯有收摄心神，视如不见。
But she was Yu's exclusive companion, so he collected himself and pretended not to notice.

转念想到小和尚，既然话已说明，便无须有所顾忌。
Returning his thoughts to Little Monk, he decided that, now the situation had been explained, there was no reason to hesitate.

此刻正在用人之际，
He urgently needed men.

应该谈定了，马上拿他来派用场。
He should settle the matter and put the fellow to work immediately.

于是他说，“郁四哥，此刻能不能跟小和尚见个面？”
“Brother Yu, could we see Little Monk now?”

“怎么不能？”
“Why not?”

郁四站起身说：
Yu rose.

“走！”
“Let's go.”


两个人又到了沂园。
They returned to Yiyuan.

郁四派人把小和尚去找了来，招呼过后，他问：“四叔寻我有话说？”
Yu sent for Little Monk, who asked after greeting them, “You wanted to speak to me, Fourth Uncle?”

郁四先不答他的话，只问：“你的赌，戒得掉戒不掉？”
Instead of answering, Yu asked, “Can you give up gambling or can't you?”

小和尚一愣，笑着说道：
Little Monk paused in surprise, then smiled.

“四叔要我戒赌？”
“You want me to stop gambling, Fourth Uncle?”

“我是为你好。
“It's for your own good.

你这样子天天滥赌，哪一天才得出头？”
If you go on gambling recklessly every day, when will you ever get anywhere?

郁四又说：“靠赌吃饭没出息，
There's no future in living by gambling.

你晓不晓得？”
Do you understand?”

小和尚不答，只看看胡雪岩，仿佛已知道郁四的意思了。
Little Monk said nothing, only glanced at Hu as though he already grasped Yu's intention.

于是郁四又问：
Yu asked another question.

“你想不想出去闯闯码头呢？”
“Would you like to go out and try your luck in a new place?”

一听这话，小和尚显得很注意，
Little Monk immediately became attentive.

而眼中看得出来，是憧憬大地方热闹，就象小孩听说能跟大人去看戏的那种神色。
His eyes showed his longing for the excitement of a larger city, like a child's at the prospect of going to the theatre with the grown-ups.


“胡老板想带你到杭州去。”郁四说道，
“Mr Hu wants to take you to Hangzhou,” Yu continued.

“我已经答应胡老板了，
“I've already agreed to Mr Hu's proposal.

要问问你自己的意思。”
Now I want to hear what you think.”

“四叔已经答应了，我不愿意也要办得到呀！”
“Since you've already promised, Fourth Uncle, I must manage it even if I don't want to!”

“小鬼！”郁四笑着骂道：
“You little rascal!” Yu laughed as he scolded him.

“我不见你这个空头人情。
“I don't need that empty show of doing me a favour.

你自己说一句，到底愿意不愿意呢？
Tell us plainly: do you want to go or not?

胡老板的脾气，不喜欢人家勉强。”
Mr Hu doesn't like people acting against their will.”

“愿意！”
“I do!”

小和尚很清楚的表示，同时向胡雪岩点点头。
Little Monk stated clearly, nodding to Hu.

“那好了。
“Then that's settled.

你现在就跟胡老板去办事，
Go and work with him now.

胡老板的事，就是我的事。”
His business is my business.”

有这句话交代，什么都在里头了。
Those words said everything necessary.

胡雪岩辞别郁四，找了个清静酒店，先要了解了解小和尚的一切。
Hu took his leave of Yu and found a quiet wine shop where he could first learn all he needed to know about Little Monk.


小和尚名叫陈世龙，
Little Monk's name was Chen Shilong.

孑然一身，身无恒业，
He had no family and no regular occupation.

学过刻字店的生意，因为没有终日伏案的耐性，所以半途而废。
He had once apprenticed in an engraver's shop but lacked the patience to sit at a bench all day and had given up halfway through.

“这样说，你认得字？”
“Then you can read?”

“认得几个。”小和尚——陈世龙说，
“A few characters,” Little Monk—Chen Shilong—replied.

“ ‘百家姓’最熟。”
“I know the Hundred Family Surnames best.”

“你说话倒有趣。”胡雪岩答道，
“You have an amusing way of talking,” Hu said.

“会不会打算盘？”
“Can you use an abacus?”

“会。不过不大精。
“Yes, though not particularly well.

我在牙行帮过忙。”
I've helped in a brokerage.”

“牙行”是最难做的一种生意，
Brokerage was among the most difficult trades.

就凭手里一把秤，要把不相识的买卖双方，撮合成交易，赚取佣金。
Armed with little more than a set of scales, a broker had to bring together buyers and sellers who had never met and earn a commission by making their transaction possible.

陈世龙在牙行帮过忙，可知能干，胡雪岩越发中意了。
Chen's experience there showed ability, and Hu liked him still better.


“听说你喜欢赌，
“I hear you're fond of gambling.

是不是？”
Is that right?”

“赚两个外快用。”陈世龙说，
“Just to make a little extra money,” Chen said.

“世界上好玩的花样多得很，
“There are plenty of enjoyable things in the world.

不一定要赌。”
Gambling isn't essential.”

“说得对！
“Quite right!

你这算是想通了。
You've thought that through.

你去过上海没有？”
Have you ever been to Shanghai?”

“没有。”
“No.”

“你去过上海就知道了。
“Once you've been, you'll understand.

光是见见世在就很好玩，
Simply seeing more of the world is enjoyable.

世界上的享，没有一样不好玩，只看你怎么样想？
There isn't a thing in life that can't be interesting; it all depends on how you look at it.

譬如说，我想跟你交朋友，
For instance, suppose I want to make friends with you.

交到了，心里很舒服，
When I've succeeded, I feel pleased.

不就很好玩吗？
Isn't that enjoyable?”

“这话是陈世龙从未听过的，
Chen had never heard such an argument.

有些不懂，却似乎又有些领悟，
He did not entirely understand it, yet seemed to glimpse its meaning.

所以只是看着他发愣。
He could only stare at Hu in wonder.


“世龙，我再问你一句话……”
“Shilong, let me ask you something else...”

看他不说下去了，陈世龙不由得奇怪，
When Hu stopped, Chen was puzzled.

刚喊得一声：“胡老板……”胡雪岩打断了他的话。
He had just begun, “Boss Hu...” when Hu interrupted him.

“你叫我胡先生。”
“Call me Mr Hu.”

这就有点收他做学生的味道在内，
There was a suggestion in this of taking him as a pupil.

陈世龙对他很服帖，便改口说道：
Chen was ready to follow his lead and changed his form of address.

“胡先生，你要问我句什么话？”
“Mr Hu, what did you want to ask?”

“我这句话，如果问得不对，你不要摆在心上，也不必跟人说起。
“If the question is improper, don't take offence, and don't repeat it to anyone.

我问你，阿七到底对你有意思没有？”
Tell me: does A’qi have feelings for you?”

“这我哪里晓得。”
“How would I know?”

“你难道看不出来？”
“Can't you tell?”

“我看不出来。
“I can't.

我只晓得我自己，
I only know my own mind.

郁四叔疑心病重，
Fourth Uncle Yu is suspicious by nature.

我哪里会对阿七动什么脑筋？”
How could I think of making advances to A’qi?

陈世龙停了一下又说：“赌输了跟她伸伸手是有的。
I do ask her for money after losing at gambling,” he added after a pause.

别的没有。”
“Nothing else.”

胡雪岩用他，别的都不在乎，唯一顾虑的就是他跟阿七的关系，
In employing Chen, Hu was unconcerned about anything except his relationship with A’qi.

这一点非弄得清清楚楚不可。
He had to make this perfectly clear.

因而又向下追问：
He pressed further.

“你动不动歪脑筋是一口事，动不动心又是一回事。
“Having designs on her is one thing; feeling attracted is another.

你说，你心里喜欢不喜欢阿七？”
Tell me, are you fond of her?”

陈世龙到底资格还嫩，不免受窘，
Chen was still inexperienced and could not help feeling embarrassed.

犹豫了一会答道：“男人总是男人嘛！”
After hesitating, he answered, “A man's a man, after all!”

这句话说很明白了，
That was plain enough.

胡雪岩对他的答复很满意，因为他说了实话。
Hu was satisfied, because it was an honest answer.

不过，接下来的却是告诫。
His next words, however, were a warning.


“你也怨不得你四叔疑心病重。
“You can't blame your Fourth Uncle for being suspicious.

有道是‘麻布筋多，光棍心多’，
As the saying goes, coarse cloth has many fibres, and a man of the world has many thoughts.

你年轻力壮，跟阿七又是从小就认识的，
You're young and strong, and you've known A’qi since childhood.

常来常往，人家自然要说闲话。”
If you're constantly visiting, naturally people will gossip.”

胡雪岩停了一下又说：“照我看，你郁四叔少不得阿七，
Hu paused, then added, “It seems to me that your Uncle Yu can't do without her.

你就做得格外漂亮些。”
You should behave with particular generosity.”

“怎么做法？”
“How?”

“从此不跟阿七见面。”
“Don't see A’qi again.”

“这做得到。
“I can do that.

我答应胡先生。”
I promise you, Mr Hu.”

陈世龙放出很豁达的神态，扬着脸说，
Chen lifted his head with an air of broad-mindedness.

“天下漂亮女人多得是！”
“There are plenty of beautiful women in the world!”

“这话说得好！”
“Well said!”

胡雪岩心想得要试一试他，
Hu decided to test him.

从身上取出来五十两一张银票，
He took out a fifty-tael banknote.

“这点钱，你先拿去用。”
“Take this for your expenses.”

陈世龙迟疑了一下，接过银票道了谢。
Chen hesitated, accepted it, and thanked him.


“再有件事，你替我去办一办，
“There's another errand I want you to do.

我在沂园等你回话。”
I'll wait at Yiyuan for your report.”

他说了老张的地方，要陈世龙去看，搬了家没有？搬在何处？
Hu gave him Old Zhang's address and told him to find out whether the family had moved and where they were now living.

陈世龙答应着走了，
Chen agreed and left.

胡雪岩也重新回到沂园，把他们谈话的情形，略略说了些给郁四听。
Hu returned to Yiyuan and gave Yu a brief account of their conversation.

很快地，陈世龙有了回话，说老张正在搬家，也说了新址所在，
Chen soon came back to report that Old Zhang was in the process of moving, and supplied the new address.

然后问道，“胡先生，今天还有什么事交代我做？”
“Is there anything else you want me to do today, Mr Hu?”

“没有了。
“Nothing.

你去做你自己的事。
Go and attend to your own affairs.

明天早晨，我在碧浪春吃茶。”
Tomorrow morning I'll be taking tea at Bilangchun.”

“那么明天一早，我到碧浪春去碰头。”
“Then I'll meet you there first thing.”

等陈世龙一走，胡雪岩才跟郁四说，给了他五十两银子，
Only after Chen had left did Hu tell Yu about the fifty taels.

“你要他戒赌，他自己也跟我说，不一定要赌。”
“You told him to stop gambling, and he told me he could do without it.

胡雪岩说，“喜欢赌的人，有钱在身上，手就会痒。
A gambler with money in his pocket gets itchy fingers.

你倒不妨派人去打听一下看。”
You might send someone to find out what he does.”

“不错！
“Quite right!

倒要看看这个小鬼，是不是口不应心？”
Let's see whether the rascal means what he says.”

于是郁四找了个人来，秘密叮嘱了几句，去打听陈世龙的影踪，约辰明天上午回话。
Yu summoned a man, gave him a few private instructions to investigate Chen's movements, and arranged for a report the next morning.


当夜郁四请了两个南浸镇上的朋友跟胡雪岩见面。
That evening Yu invited two friends from Nanxun to meet Hu.

这两个人都懂洋文，跟外国商人打过交道，
Both knew a foreign language and had dealt with foreign merchants.

谈起销洋庄的丝生意，认为应以慎重为是，
Discussing silk exports, they advised caution.

因为上海有“小刀会”活动，市面不太平静。
The Small Swords Society was active in Shanghai, and business conditions were unsettled.

将来夷场上会不会涉及，尚不可知，
No one yet knew whether the disturbances would spread to the foreign settlements.

最好看看风色再说。
It would be better to watch developments before acting.

席间胡雪岩不多开口，只是静静听着。
Hu said little during the meal and listened quietly.

当夜无话，
Nothing further happened that night.

第二天一早到碧浪春，陈世龙已经等在那里了。
When he reached Bilangchun early the next morning, Chen was already waiting.

胡雪岩心想，他光棍一条，有了五十两银子在身上，如果不是送在赌场里，一定会买两身好衣服，新鞋新帽，打扮得十分光鲜，
Hu reasoned that a young man without dependants, given fifty taels, would surely buy a couple of good outfits and new shoes and a hat, unless he had lost the money at the gambling tables.

而此刻看他，依旧是昨天那一身衣服，
Yet Chen was wearing the same clothes as yesterday.

心里便嘀咕：只怕靠不住，口不应心了！
Perhaps he could not be trusted after all; perhaps his words had not matched his intentions.

不过他口中不作声，
Hu said nothing about this, however.

只叫他到老张新搬的地方去看一看，可曾搬定？
He merely sent Chen to the Zhang family's new house to see whether they had finished moving.


接着郁四也到了，依旧在当门的“马头桌子”上一坐。同时把胡雪岩请了来，在左首第一位上坐下。
Yu arrived soon afterwards and took his usual place at the horse-head table by the entrance, inviting Hu to sit in the first seat on his left.

少不得又有一阵忙乱，
Another flurry of activity followed.

等清静下来，才见郁四昨天派去访查陈世龙行动的那个人，悄悄走了过来。
Only when things had settled down did the man sent to investigate Chen quietly approach.

“小和尚真难得！”
“Little Monk really is remarkable!”

他根本不知道胡雪岩给了陈世龙一笔钱，而陈世龙应诺戒赌的情形，所以一开口就这样说：“居然不出手。”
He knew nothing of Hu's gift or Chen's promise to give up gambling, and began, “He actually kept his hands off the stakes.”

郁四跟胡雪岩对看了一眼，彼此会意，
Yu and Hu exchanged an understanding glance.

虽然不曾出手，赌场还是去了。
Even if he had not played, he had still visited the gambling house.

“他昨天身上的钱很多，
“He had plenty of money yesterday.

不晓得什么道理？看了半天，不曾下注，后来就走了。”
I don't know why, but he watched for ages without placing a bet, then left.”

“是不是到别家赌场去了？”郁四问。
“Did he go to another gambling house?” Yu asked.

“没有，”那人答道，
“No.

“后来跟几个小弟兄去听书。
He went to hear a storyteller with a few young fellows.

听完书吃酒，吃到半夜才散，
Afterwards they drank together until midnight, then separated.

睡在家里的。”
He slept at home.”

“好！”
“Good.”

郁四点点头，
Yu nodded.

“辛苦你！
“Thank you for your trouble.

你不必跟小和尚说起。”
You needn't mention any of this to Little Monk.”

“晓得了。”
“Understood.”

等他一走，胡雪岩便笑道：
When the man had gone, Hu smiled.

“我没有料中。
“I guessed wrong.

看起来他倒是说话算话。”
It seems he does keep his word.”

“还好。”郁四也表示满意：
“Not bad,” Yu agreed with satisfaction.

“没有坍我的台。”
“He hasn't let me lose face.”


“郁四哥，我昨天晚上想了一夜，”胡雪岩说，
“Brother Yu, I thought about it all night,” Hu said.

“销洋庄的生意，还是可以做，
“We can still do the export business.

大家怕小刀会闹事，不敢做，
Everyone else is afraid of disturbances by the Small Swords and daren't trade.

我们偏偏要做，这就与众不同，变成独门生意了。”
If we do precisely what they won't, we'll stand apart and have the business to ourselves.”

“嗯！”
“Hmm.”

郁四想了想，不断颔首，
Yu considered, nodding repeatedly.

“你的想法，总比别人来得深一层。
“You always think a step further than other people.

你再说下去看。
Go on.”

““凡事就是起头难，
“The beginning is always the difficult part.

有人领头，大家就跟着来了。
Once someone leads, others follow.

做洋庄的那些人，生意不动，就得吃老本，
Those export merchants have to live on their capital while trade is idle.

心里何尝不想做？
Of course they want to do business.

只是肚子小，不敢动，
They simply lack the nerve.

现在我们想个风险不大的办法出来，让大家跟着我们走。”
Now suppose we find a way that carries little risk and have them follow us.

胡雪岩问道，“郁四哥，那时候，你想一想，我们在这一行之中，是什么地位？”
Think, Brother Yu: what position would that give us in the trade?”

“对！”
“Exactly!”

郁四拍案激赏，
Yu slapped the table in admiration.

“人家根深蒂固多少年，
“Other people have built up their standing over years.

我们只要一上手就是头儿、脑儿！
We'd become the leaders the moment we began!

这种好事情，天下哪里去找？”
Where else could you find an opportunity like that?”

“我就是这个意思。
“That's just what I mean.

‘胆大做王’！
The bold become kings!

再说，别人看来危险，照我看，风险不大。
Besides, what looks dangerous to others doesn't seem very risky to me.

第一，夷场上，人家外国人要保护他自己的人，
First, the foreigners in the settlements will protect their own people.

有大兵船停在黄浦江，
They have large warships on the Huangpu.

小刀会也要看看风色，
The Small Swords must consider the situation too.

小刀子到底比不得洋枪洋炮。”
Little knives are no match for foreign guns and cannon.”


“这话也不错。”
“That's true.”

郁四看看四周，凑过头去低声说道，
Yu glanced round, leaned towards him, and lowered his voice.

“我现在还不大清楚上海的情形，
“I don't yet know much about the situation in Shanghai.

不过照我想，小刀会里，一定有尤老五的弟兄，
But I imagine some of You Laowu's brethren must belong to the Small Swords.

不妨打听打听看。”
We could make inquiries.”

“我正就是这个意思。”胡雪岩也低声答道：
“Exactly my thought,” Hu answered quietly.

“我们也不是跟小刀会走到一条线上，
“We aren't joining forces with the Small Swords.

他们造反，我们是安分老百姓，
They're rebels; we're law-abiding citizens.

打听消息，就是要避开他们，省得走到一条线上。”
We're seeking information precisely so that we can keep clear of them and avoid becoming entangled.”

郁四深深点头：
Yu nodded deeply.

“你们闹事，我们不动，
“When they make trouble, we stay still.

他们不动，我们抢空档把货色运到上海去。”
When they're quiet, we seize the interval to send our goods to Shanghai.”

“郁四哥，”胡雪岩笑道，“不是我恭维你，你这两句话，真正是在刀口上。”
“Brother Yu,” Hu said with a smile, “this isn't flattery: those two sentences cut straight to the heart of it.”

“好了！”
“Very well.”

郁四抬起头来，从容说道，
Yu raised his head and spoke calmly again.

“回头我们到阿七那里细谈。”
“We'll discuss the details at A’qi's later.”


接着便谈到陈世龙。
They next discussed Chen Shilong.

胡雪岩的意思，看他年轻聪明，口齿伶俐，打算止他去学洋文，
Seeing that he was young, intelligent, and quick with words, Hu wanted him to learn a foreign language.

因为将来销洋庄，须直接跟洋人交往，
Export business would eventually require direct dealings with foreigners.

如果没有一个亲信的人做“ ‘通事”，请教他人传译，
Without a trusted interpreter of his own, he would have to rely on someone else to translate.

也许在语言隔阂之中，为人从中做了手脚，自己还象蒙在鼓里似地，丝毫不知，
Behind the language barrier, that person might manipulate matters without Hu ever knowing.

这关系太重大了。
Too much depended on it.

“这个主意很好。”郁四说道，
“An excellent idea,” Yu said.

“不过学洋文要精通，不是一年半载的事，
“But mastering a foreign language takes more than a few months or a year.

眼前得先寻一个人，”
You must first find someone for the immediate work.”

“我也是这么想。
“I agree.

这个人，第一，要靠得住，第二，要有本事，第三，脾气要好。
He must first be trustworthy, second capable, and third good-tempered.

就叫世龙跟他学。
Shilong can learn from him.

不晓得郁四哥有没有这样的人呢？”
Do you know anyone like that?”

“当然有。
“Certainly.

还不止一个。”
More than one.”

“好极了。”
“Excellent!”

胡雪岩很高兴的说，
Hu was delighted.

“那就请来谈谈。”
“Then invite them to talk.”

“我托人去约。
“I'll send someone to arrange it.

今天晚上或者明天中午碰头好了。”
We can meet this evening or tomorrow at noon.”


这天晚上，胡雪岩在老张的新居吃饭，座间还有陈世龙。
That evening Hu ate at Old Zhang's new house, with Chen Shilong among the company.

陈世龙跟老张也认识。平常“老张、老张”叫惯的，但这时不能不改改口，
Chen knew Old Zhang and had always called him simply “Old Zhang,” but now he had to change his manner.

他是极机警的人，
He was exceptionally alert.

两次到张家，把胡雪岩和老张的关系，看出了一半，
Two visits to the Zhang home had given him half an understanding of Hu's relationship with the family.

等看到了阿珠对胡雪岩，在眉梢眼角，无时不是关切的样子，更料中了十之八九。
Once he saw the constant concern for Hu in A’zhu's every glance and expression, he was almost certain.

既然自己叫他为“胡先生”，对老张就不能不客气些。
Since he addressed Hu as his respected teacher, he must show Old Zhang greater courtesy.

改口叫他“张老板”，阿珠的娘便成了“张太大”，而阿珠是“张小姐”。
He began calling him “Mr Zhang,” making A’zhu's mother “Mrs Zhang” and A’zhu “Miss Zhang.”

阿珠还是第一次被人叫做“小姐”，
This was the first time anyone had addressed A’zhu as a young lady.

心里有种说不出的喜悦，因而对陈世龙也便另眼相看了。
It gave her an indescribable pleasure and caused her to regard Chen with greater favour.

“世龙！”
“Shilong!”

阿珠的娘——张大太则是看在胡雪岩的分上，而且也希望这个年轻力壮的小伙子，能帮丈夫的忙，
Her mother—Mrs Zhang—was attentive for Hu's sake and also hoped that this strong young man could help her husband.

所以加意笼络：
She took special pains to win him over.

“都是一家人，
“We're all family.

你不必客气。
Don't stand on ceremony.

我这里就当你自己家里一样，
Treat this as your own home.

你每天来吃饭，有啥衣服换洗，你也拿了来，
Come here for your meals every day, and bring any clothes that need washing.

千万不要见外。”
Never feel you're imposing.”

“是啊！”胡雪岩也说，
“Quite right,” Hu added.

“这不是客气话。”
“These aren't empty courtesies.”

“我懂，我懂。”
“I understand.”

陈世龙连连点头，
Chen nodded repeatedly.

“我要客气，做事就不方便了。”
“If I stood on ceremony, it would only make working together harder.”

于是一面吃，一面谈生意。
They discussed business as they ate.

有陈世龙在座，事情就顺利了。
With Chen there, matters proceeded smoothly.

因为老张所讲的情形，他差不多都知道，可以为胡雪岩作补充，
He knew almost everything Old Zhang described and could supply Hu with additional information.

象老张所说的那两个懂丝行生意的朋友，陈世龙就指出姓黄的那个比姓王的好，
For example, of the two friends Old Zhang had mentioned as knowing the silk trade, Chen judged the man named Huang better than the man named Wang.

后者曾有欺骗东定，侵吞货款的劣迹，是老张所不知道的。
The latter had cheated an employer and misappropriated payment for goods, something Old Zhang had not known.


“世龙！”
“Shilong!”

胡雪岩对在湖州的一切安排，大致都已作了决定，
Hu had now broadly settled his arrangements in Huzhou.

“明夭我们就动手，把阜康分号和丝行开起来。
“Tomorrow we'll start getting the Fukang branch and the silk firm open.

到事情差不多了，你要替我跑一趟松江。”
When things are nearly ready, I want you to go to Songjiang for me.”

“松江？”
“Songjiang?”

陈世龙颇感意外，
Chen was surprised.

“我还没有去过。”
“I've never been there.”

“没有去过不要紧，
“That doesn't matter.

去闯一闯。”
Go and see something new.”

胡雪岩一件事没有谈定规，又谈第二件，
Before finishing one subject, Hu moved to another.

“我再问你一句话，你肯不肯学洋文？”
“Let me ask you something else: would you be willing to learn a foreign language?”

陈世龙更觉意外，
Chen was still more surprised.

“胡先生，”他嗫嚅着说，“我还弄不懂是怎么回事？”
“Mr Hu,” he faltered, “I don't yet understand what this is about.”

“那自然是要你做‘丝通事’。”阿珠接口说道。
“Naturally, he wants you to become an interpreter in the silk trade,” A’zhu put in.

“连她都懂了！”
“Even she understands!”

胡雪岩又对陈世龙说：
Hu turned back to Chen.

“将来我不止于丝生意，
“I don't intend to stop at silk.

还有别样生意也想销洋庄。
There are other goods I want to sell abroad.

你想，没有一个懂洋文的人，怎么行？”
Think: how could I manage without someone who knows a foreign language?”


陈世龙的脑筋也很快，
Chen's mind was quick too.

根据他这一句话，立刻就能力自己的将来，画出许多景象，
From that single remark, he immediately pictured many possibilities for his future.

不管丝生意还是别样生意，在上海必是他“坐庄”，凡跟洋人打交道，都是自己一手主持。
Whether the business concerned silk or other goods, he would surely be the resident representative in Shanghai, personally handling every transaction with foreigners.

南浔的那些“丝通事”，他也知道，
He knew about the silk interpreters in Nanxun.

一个个坐收佣金，附带做些洋货生意，无不大发其财。
They all collected commissions and traded in foreign goods on the side, making substantial fortunes.

起居饮食的阔绰，自然不在话下，最令人羡慕的是，有许多新奇精巧的洋货可用。
Naturally they lived and ate extravagantly, but what he envied most was their possession of so many ingenious and novel imported articles.

如果自己懂了洋文，当然也有那样的一天。
If he learnt a foreign language, his turn would come too.

转念到此，他毫不犹豫地答道：
Having reached that thought, he answered without hesitation.

“胡先生叫我学洋文，我就学。
“If you tell me to learn, Mr Hu, I will.

我一定要把它学好！”
And I'll make certain I learn it properly!”

“有志气！”
“That's ambition!”

胡雪岩把大拇指一翘，很高兴他说：
Hu raised his thumb approvingly.

“学一样东西就要这样子，
“That's the way to study anything.

不学拉倒，要学就要精。
Either leave it alone or master it.

世龙，你跟我跟长了就知道了，我不喜欢‘三脚猫’的人。”
When you've been with me longer, Shilong, you'll discover that I have no use for ‘three-legged cats.’”

一知半解叫做“三脚猫”，
A three-legged cat meant someone with only a smattering of knowledge.

年轻好胜的人，最讨厌这句话，
To a competitive young man, few descriptions were more unwelcome.

所以陈世龙立刻答道：“胡先生放心，
Chen replied at once, “Don't worry, Mr Hu.

我不会做‘三脚猫’。”
I won't be a three-legged cat.”


“我想你也不会。”胡雪岩又说，“我再问你一句话，松江有个尤五，你知道不知道？”
“I don't suppose you will.” Hu continued, “Now let me ask you this: do you know You Wu in Songjiang?”

漕帮里的大亨，陈世龙如何不知道？
How could Chen fail to know a leading figure in the Grain Transport Brotherhood?

不过照规矩，在这方面他不能跟“空子”多说，
But its rules forbade him to say much about such matters to an outsider.

即使“胡先生”这个“空子”比“门槛里”的还要“落门落槛”也不行，
Even if this outsider, Mr Hu, understood the brotherhood's ways better than many initiates, the rule still applied.

所以他只点点头作为答复。
He merely nodded.

胡雪岩却不管这些，率直问道：“你跟他的辈分怎么排？
Hu ignored these considerations and asked directly, “How do you stand in relation to him by generation?

应该叫他爷叔？”
Would you call him Uncle?”

“是的。”
“Yes.”

“尤五管我叫‘小爷叔，。”
“You Wu calls me ‘Young Uncle.’”

胡雪岩有意在陈世龙面前炫耀一番，好叫这个小伙子服帖，
Hu deliberately displayed his standing to make the young man more obedient.

“为什么呢？
“Why?

因为他老头子看得起我，
Because his old master thinks well of me.

尤五敬重他老头子，所以也敬重我。
You respects his master, so he respects me too.

他本人跟我的交情，也就象你郁四叔跟我的交情一样。
His personal friendship with me is much like your Uncle Yu's.

你说松江没有去过，
You say you've never been to Songjiang.

不要紧，
That doesn't matter.

有我的信，你尽管去，
Take my letter and go without concern.

没有人敢拿你当’洋盘‘。”
Nobody will dare treat you as a gullible newcomer.”

“我晓得，我晓得。”陈世龙一叠连声他说，显得异常兴奋。
“I understand, I understand!” Chen answered repeatedly, visibly excited.

他也真没有想到，胡雪岩这样一个“空子”，有这么大的来头！
He had never imagined that an outsider like Hu possessed such powerful connections.

顿时眼中看出来的“胡先生”，便如丈六金身的四大金刚一般高大了。
Suddenly Mr Hu seemed to tower before him like one of the great gilded guardian figures in a temple.


“现在我再告诉你，
“Now listen.

你到了松江，先到一家通裕米行去寻他们的老板，
When you reach Songjiang, go first to a rice firm called Tongyu and find its proprietor.

寻到了他自会带你去见尤五。
He'll take you to You Wu.

你把我的信当面交给他，
Give him my letter in person.

千万记住，要当面交给他本人，
Remember: hand it directly to him yourself.

这封信不能落到外人手里。”
It must not fall into anyone else's hands.”

很显然的这是封极机密的信，
Clearly it was a highly confidential letter.

陈世龙深深点着头问：
Chen nodded solemnly.

“要不要等回信？”
“Should I wait for a reply?”

“当然要。
“Of course.

回信也是紧要的，
The reply will be important too.

千万不能失落。”
You mustn't lose it.

胡雪岩又说，“或许他不会写回信，
Perhaps he won't write, though,” Hu added.

只是带回来口信，
“He may send a spoken message.

他跟你说什么，你都记住，说什么你记住什么，不要多问！”
Remember everything he says—whatever he says—and don't ask unnecessary questions.”

“也不要跟旁人说。”陈世龙这样接了一句。
“And don't tell anyone else,” Chen supplied.

“对！”
“Exactly!”

胡雪岩放心了，
Hu was reassured.

“你懂我的道理了。”
“You understand what I mean.”


陈世龙这里倒交代清楚了，但写这封信却成了难题，
The instructions to Chen were now clear enough, but writing the letter proved difficult.

胡雪岩的文墨不甚高明，
Hu's literary abilities were limited.

而这封信又要写得含蓄，表面没有破绽，暗中看得明白，
This letter had to be discreet: nothing incriminating on its face, yet its hidden meaning perfectly clear.

他没有这一份本事，只好去请教郁四。
He lacked the skill, so he consulted Yu.

郁四是衙门里的人，对于“一字入公门，九牛拔不转”这句话，特持警惕，
As a man of the yamen, Yu was particularly mindful of the saying, “Once a word enters an official office, nine oxen cannot drag it back.”

认为这样的事，不宜在信中明言，
He thought a matter like this should not be stated openly in a letter.

万一中途失落了这封信，会惹出极大的麻烦。
If the letter were lost on the way, it could cause enormous trouble.

“你我都无所谓，
“You and I would be all right.

说句老实话，上上下下都是人，总可以洗刷干净。”郁四很诚恳的说，
Frankly, we have friends at every level and could always clear ourselves,” Yu said earnestly.

“不过，你无论如何也要替王大老爷想想，
“But you must think of Mr Wang.

事情弄到他头上，就很讨厌了！”
If he were implicated, it would be extremely awkward.”

这个警告，胡雪岩十分重视，
Hu took the warning very seriously.

翻然变计，决定让陈世龙当面跟尤五去谈。
He immediately changed his plan and decided that Chen should speak to You Wu in person instead.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（上）》第十章（完整）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume I — the complete Chapter Ten
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第十章｜CHAPTER TEN


半个月以后，陈世龙原船回湖州，
Half a month later, Chen Shilong returned to Huzhou in the same boat.

没有把畹香带来，但一百两银票却已送了给畹香，
He had not brought Wanxiang, but he had given her the hundred-tael banknote.

因为她也听说王有龄放了湖州府，
She, too, had heard that Wang had been appointed prefect of Huzhou.

愿意到湖州来玩一趟，只是要晚些日子。
She was willing to come for a visit, only somewhat later.

陈世龙急于要回来复命，无法等她，
Chen was anxious to return and report, and could not wait.

“安家费”反正要送的，落得漂亮些，就先给了她。
Since the money to help her settle her affairs would have to be given anyway, he had decided to make a generous gesture and give it to her in advance.

“做得好！
“Well done!

这件事不去管它了。
We needn't concern ourselves with that now.

尤五怎么说法？”
What did You Laowu say?”

“他说他不写回信了。
“He said he wouldn't write a reply.

如果胡先生要运丝到上海，最好在七月底以前。”
If you want to ship silk to Shanghai, it would be best to do so before the end of the seventh month.”

“七月底以前？”胡雪岩很认真地追问了一句。
“Before the end of the seventh month?” Hu repeated earnestly.

“是的。
“Yes.

尤五说得很清楚，七月底以前。
He was very clear about that.

他又说，货色运过嘉兴，就是他的地段，他可以保险不出乱子。”
He also said that once the goods passed Jiaxing, they would be in his territory, and he could guarantee that nothing would go wrong.”

“嗯，嗯！”
“Hmm. I see.”

胡雪岩沉吟着，从两句简单的答语中，悟出许多道理。
Hu reflected, drawing a great deal from those two simple answers.


“胡先生！”陈世龙又说，“小刀会的情形，我倒打听出来许多。”
“Mr Hu,” Chen continued, “I also found out quite a lot about the Small Swords Society.”

“喔！”
“Oh!”

胡雪岩颇感意外，
Hu was rather surprised.

“你怎么打听到的！”
“How did you find out?”

他告诫过陈世龙，不许向尤五多问什么。
He had warned Chen not to put any further questions to You Laowu.

真怕他多嘴多舌，向不相干的人去打听，
He very much feared that the young man had been running his mouth and making inquiries among people who had no business knowing.

这语言不谨慎的毛病，必须告诫他痛改。
Such careless talk was a fault he must be firmly warned to correct.

陈世龙看出他的不满，急忙答道：
Sensing Hu's displeasure, Chen hastened to explain.

“我是在茶店里听别的茶客闲谈，留心听来的。”
“I listened carefully while other customers were talking in a teahouse.”

他听来的情形是如此：前几年上海附近，就有一股头裹红巾的人起事，
What he had heard was this: some years earlier, men wearing red headscarves had risen near Shanghai.

官府称之为“红头造反”，
The authorities called it the Redhead Rebellion.

其中的头脑叫做刘丽川，本来是广东人，
One of their leaders, Liu Lichuan, was originally from Guangdong.

在上海做生意，结交官场，跟洋商亦颇有往来。
He did business in Shanghai, cultivated official connections, and had considerable dealings with foreign merchants.


“是这样的，”他第二天悄悄对陈世龙说，
The next day, Hu had quietly explained the matter to Chen. “This is how things stand.

“我们的丝要运上海，销洋庄，
We want to send our silk to Shanghai for sale to foreign firms.

只怕小刀会闹事，
What worries me is trouble from the Small Swords Society.

碰得不巧，恰恰把货色陷在里面。
With bad luck, our goods could be caught right in the middle of it.

尤五说不定知道小刀会的内情，
You Laowu may know what is going on inside the society.

我就是想请教他一条避凶趋吉的路子。
All I want is his advice on how to avoid trouble and get through safely.

你懂了吧？”
Do you understand?”

“懂了！”
“I do.”

“那么，你倒想想看，你该怎么跟他说？”
“Then think how you should put it to him.”

陈世龙思索了一会答道：“我想这样子跟他说： ‘尤五叔，胡先生和我郁四叔，叫我问候你，请老太爷的安。
After a moment's consideration, Chen answered, “I thought I would say: ‘Uncle You, Mr Hu and my Uncle Yu have sent me to ask after you and pay their respects to the old master.

胡先生有几船丝想运上来，怕路上不平静，
Mr Hu has several boatloads of silk he would like to send up, but he is afraid the route may be unsettled.

特地叫我请示你老人家，路上有没有危险？
He has specially sent me to ask whether there is any danger.

运不运，只听你老人家一句话。’”
Whether he ships the silk or not will depend entirely on your word.’”

胡雪岩想了想，点点头说：
Hu considered, then nodded.

“好！
“Good!

就是这样子说。”
Say exactly that.”

“不过胡先生，你总要给我一封引见的信，
“But you'll have to give me a letter of introduction, Mr Hu.

不然，人家晓得我是老几？”
Otherwise, how will he know who I am?”

“那当然！
“Naturally.

不但有信，还有水礼让你带去。”
And you'll take some modest gifts as well.”

名为“水礼”，所费不货，因为数量来得多，
Modest in name only, the gifts cost a considerable sum because there were so many of them.

光是出名的“诸老大”的麻酥糖，就是两大篓，
The famous Zhu Laoda sesame sweets alone filled two great baskets.

另外吃的、穿的、用的，凡是湖州的名产，几乎一样不漏，
There were foods, clothing, and useful articles: scarcely a Huzhou speciality had been omitted.

装了一船，直放松江。
They filled a boat, which sailed straight for Songjiang.


“这张单子上是送尤五本人的，这张是送他们老太爷的，这张送通裕的朋友。
“The things on this list are for You Laowu himself; those on this one are for the old master; those on this one are for our friends at Tongyu.

还有这一张上的，
And here is another list.

你跟尤五说，请他派人带你去。”
Ask You Laowu to send someone to take you there.”

接过那张单子来看，上面写着“梅家弄畹香”五字，陈世龙便笑了。
Chen accepted it and smiled at the words “Wanxiang, Meijia Lane.”

“你不要笑！”胡雪岩说：
“Don't laugh!” Hu said.

“不是我的相好！
“She's not my sweetheart.

你也不必问是哪个的？
And you needn't ask whose she is.

见了她的面，你只问她一句话，愿意不愿意到湖州来玩一趟？
When you see her, ask just one thing: would she like to visit Huzhou?

如果她不愿意，那就算了，
If she doesn't wish to, leave it at that.

愿意，你原船带了她来。
If she does, bring her back in your boat.

喏！一百两银子，
Here are a hundred taels.

说是我送她的。”
Tell her they're from me.”

“好！
“Very well.

我晓得了。”
I understand.”

最近因为洪秀全在金陵建都，彼此有了联络，刘丽川准备大于一番。
Recently, with Hong Xiuquan having established his capital at Jinling, Liu Lichuan had made contact with him and was preparing a major undertaking.

上海的谣言甚多，
Rumours abounded in Shanghai.

有的说青浦的周立春，已经为刘丽川所联合，有的说，嘉定、太仓各地的情势都不稳，也有的说，夷场里的洋商都会支持刘丽川。
Some said Liu had already allied himself with Zhou Lichun of Qingpu; others that Jiading, Taicang, and other places were unsettled; still others that the foreign merchants in the settlement would all support him.

这些消息，虽说是谣言，对胡雪岩却极有用处。
Though only rumours, this information was extremely useful to Hu.

他现在有个新的顾虑，不知道尤五是不是也跟刘丽川有联络？
A new concern now troubled him: might You Laowu also be in touch with Liu Lichuan?

这一点关系极重，
The question mattered enormously.

他必得跟郁四去商量。
He must discuss it with Yu Si.


转述过了陈世龙的话，胡雪岩提出他的看法：
After repeating Chen's report, Hu offered his interpretation.

“尤五给我们一个期限，
“You Laowu has given us a deadline.

说是在七月底以前，可以保险，
He guarantees our safety before the end of the seventh month.

意思是不是到了八月里就会出事？”
Does that mean something will happen in the eighth?”

“当然。
“Of course.

到八月里就不敢保险了。”
Once the eighth month comes, he won't guarantee it.”

“照此说来，小刀会刘丽川要干些什么，尤五是知道的，
“Then he knows what Liu Lichuan and the Small Swords Society intend.

这样岂不是他也要‘造反，？”
Doesn't that mean he means to rebel too?”

胡雪岩初次在郁四面前表现了忧虑的神色：
For the first time before Yu, Hu looked worried.

“ ’造反，两个字，不是好玩儿的！”
“Rebellion is no joking matter!”

郁四想了好一会答道，
Yu thought for a long while.

“不会！
“No.

照刘丽川的情形，他恐怕是‘洪门’。
From what we know of Liu, he probably belongs to the Hongmen.

漕帮跟洪门，大家河水不犯井水。
The Grain Transport Brotherhood and the Hongmen keep out of each other's affairs.

再说，尤五上头还有老头子，在松江纳福，下面还有漕帮弟冗，散在各处，
Besides, You Laowu has his old master living comfortably in Songjiang and members of the brotherhood scattered everywhere under him.

就算尤五自己想这样做，牵制大多，他也不敢冒失。
Even if he wanted to act, there are too many restraints for him to risk anything rash.

不过江湖上讲究招呼打在先，
But in the brotherhoods one gives notice in advance.

刘丽川八月里或许要闹事，尤五是晓得的，
Liu may intend to cause trouble in the eighth month, and You Laowu knows it.

说跟刘丽川在一起于，照我看，决不会！
As for joining him, in my opinion, certainly not.”

“这番分析，非常老到，
This was an experienced and penetrating analysis.

胡雪岩心中的疑惧消失了，
Hu's doubts vanished.

他很兴奋他说：“既然如此，我们的机会不可错过。
“Then we mustn't miss our opportunity!” he said excitedly.

郁四哥你想，如果小刀会一闹事，上海的交通或许会断，不过夷场决不会受影响，
“Think, Brother Yu: if the Small Swords Society rises, Shanghai's transport routes may be cut, but the foreign settlement certainly won't be affected.

那时候外路的丝运不到上海，洋商的生意还是要照做，
Silk from elsewhere won't get through, yet the foreign firms will still have to trade.

丝价岂不是要大涨？”
Won't the price of silk soar?”

“话是不错。”郁四沉吟着说，
“True enough,” Yu answered thoughtfully.

“倘或安然无事，我们这一宝押得就落空了。”
“But if nothing happens, our gamble will come to nothing.”


“也不能说落空，
“You can hardly call it nothing.

货色总在那里的。”
We'll still have the goods.”

“你要做我们就做。”郁四很爽朗他说，
“If you want to do it, we'll do it,” Yu said readily.

“今天六月二十，
“Today is the twentieth of the sixth month.

还有四十天工夫，尽来得及！”
We have forty days—plenty of time!”

“郁四哥！”胡雪岩突然说道：
“Brother Yu!” Hu exclaimed.

“我又悟出一个道理。”
“I've just realised something else.”

胡雪岩认为尤五既然是好朋友，当然会替他设想，
Since You Laowu was a good friend, he would naturally consider Hu's interests.

如果尤五参与了刘丽川的计划，则起事成败在未知之数，他的自身难保，
If he had joined Liu Lichuan's scheme, the rising's outcome would be uncertain and his own safety beyond his control.

当然不肯来管此闲事，
He would hardly undertake someone else's business.

甚至很痛快他说一句“路上不敢保险”，作为一种阻止的暗示。
He might simply have said that he could not guarantee the route, indirectly warning Hu not to ship.

现在既然答应在七月底以前可以“保险”，当然是局外人，有决不会卷入漩涡的把握。
His willingness to guarantee safety before the end of the seventh month therefore showed that he was outside the affair and confident he would not be drawn into it.

这个看法，郁四完全同意，
Yu entirely agreed.

“换了我也是一样。”他说，
“I'd do the same.

“如果有那么样一件‘大事’在搅，老实说，朋友的什么闲事都顾不得管了。”
If I were involved in a great undertaking of that kind, I honestly couldn't spare a thought for a friend's incidental business.”

“再说，尤五也是懂得生意的，
“And You Laowu understands trade.

如果夷场有麻烦，丝方面洋庄或许会停顿，他也一定会告诉我。
If the settlement were in danger and foreign firms might stop buying silk, he would certainly have told me.

照这样看，我们尽可以放手去做。”
On that reasoning, we can go ahead with confidence.”

“对嘛！”郁四答道，
“Exactly.

“头寸调动归我负责，
I'll take responsibility for arranging the funds.

别样事情你来。”
You handle the rest.”

于是又作了一番细节上的研究，决定尽量买丝，赶七月二十运到上海，
They discussed the details and decided to buy as much silk as possible and have it in Shanghai by the twentieth of the seventh month.

赚了钱分三份派，胡、郁各一份，另外一份留着应酬该应酬的人，到时候再商量。
The profits would be divided into three shares: one each for Hu and Yu, and a third to be distributed among those who needed rewarding, with the details to be settled later.


离开阿七那里，胡雪岩回到大经丝行，
Leaving A'qi's house, Hu returned to the Dajing Silk Firm.

在陈世尤到上海的半个月之中，他已经把两爿号子都开了起来，
During the fortnight Chen had been away on his Shanghai journey, Hu had opened both businesses.

丝行的“部照”是花钱顶来的，未便改名，仍叫“大经”，
He had paid to take over the silk firm's ministry licence, and changing its name would have been inconvenient, so it remained Dajing.

典了一所很象样的房子。
He had also acquired the use of a very respectable house through a property pledge.

前面是一座五开间的敞厅作店面，后面一大一小两个院子，
At the front was a broad hall, five bays wide, serving as the shop; behind were two courtyards, one large and one small.

大的那个作丝客人的客房，小的那个胡雪岩住，
The larger contained rooms for visiting silk dealers, the smaller Hu's own quarters.

另外留下两间，供老张夫妇歇脚。
Two rooms were also set aside for Old Zhang and his wife when they needed to stay.

大经的档手，照阵世龙的建议，用了那个姓黄的，
On Chen's recommendation, Dajing had hired the man surnamed Huang as the manager in charge of its day-to-day business.

名黄仪，此人相当能干，
His full name was Huang Yi, and he proved quite capable.

因而老张做了“垂拱而治”的老板，
Old Zhang consequently became a proprietor who could leave the actual running of the business to others.

有事虽在一起商量，胡雪岩却常听黄仪的话。
They consulted together when something arose, but Hu generally followed Huang's advice.


“胡先生，”等听完了胡雪岩的大量购丝的宣布，黄仪说道：“五荒六月，丝本来是杀价的时候。
“Mr Hu,” Huang said after hearing the announcement that they were to buy heavily, “the lean fifth and sixth months are normally the time to bargain silk prices down.

所以我们要买丝，不能透露风声，
If we're buying, we mustn't let word get out.

消息一传出去，丝价马上就哄了起来。”
Once it does, prices will shoot up.”

“那么怎么办呢？”
“Then what should we do?”

“只有多派人到乡下，不声不响地去收。
“Send more men into the countryside and buy quietly.

只不过多费点辰光。”
It will just take a little longer.”

“就是为这点，
“Time is precisely the trouble.

事情一定要快。”
We must be quick.

胡雪岩又说，“销洋庄的货色，决不可以搭浆，
And silk for foreign firms mustn't be doctored with sizing.

应该啥样子就是啥样子。
It must be exactly what it claims to be.

这一来，我们自己先要花工夫整理过，打包、装船，
That means we must first sort and prepare it ourselves, then pack it and load it.

一个月的工夫运到上海，日子已经很紧了。”
With only a month to get it to Shanghai, we're already pressed for time.”


黄仪有些迟疑，
Huang hesitated.

照他的经验，如果红纸一贴，只要货色合格，有多少收多少，那丝价就一定会涨得很厉害，吃亏太大。
From experience he knew that, if they put up a red notice promising to buy any quantity that met their standard, prices were bound to rise sharply, leaving them badly out of pocket.

因此，他提出两个办法，
He offered two alternatives.

第一个办法，是由胡雪岩跟衙门里联络，设法催收通欠，
First, Hu could use his connections at the yamen to have all outstanding taxes pressed for collection.

税吏到门，不完不可，
Once the tax collectors appeared at the door, payment could not be avoided.

逼着有丝的人家非得卖去新丝纳官课不可。
Households with silk would be forced to sell their new silk to pay the government.

“不好，不好！”
“No, no!”

胡雪岩大摇其头，
Hu shook his head vigorously.

“这个办法太毒辣，
“That's too ruthless.

叫老百姓骂杀！那我在湖州就站不住脚了。
The people would curse me to death, and I'd never keep my footing in Huzhou.

而且，王大老爷的官声也要紧。
Besides, we must protect His Honour Wang's reputation.”

““那就是第二个办法，”黄仪又说，
“Then there's the second way,” Huang continued.

“现在织造衙门不买丝，同行生意清谈，
“The imperial weaving establishment isn't buying silk at present, and our competitors' trade is slack.

我们打听打听，哪个手里有存货，把他吃了进来。”
We can find out who has stock and buy it from them.”

“这倒可以。
“That would do.

不过货色是不是台于销洋庄，一定要弄清楚。”
But make absolutely sure their silk is suitable for the foreign market.”

于是大经丝行大忙而特忙了，
Dajing became extraordinarily busy.

一车一车的丝运进来，一封一封的银子付出去，
Cartloads of silk came in; packet after packet of silver went out.

另外又雇了好些“湖丝阿姐”来理事货色。
More women skilled in handling Huzhou silk were hired to sort and prepare it.

人手不够，张家母女俩都来帮忙，
Short of hands, they enlisted both A’zhu and her mother.

每天要到三更过后才回家，有时就住在店里。
Every day the two worked until after midnight before going home, and sometimes they stayed at the firm.

胡雪岩每天要到三处地方，县衙门、阿七家、阜康分号，
Hu had three places to visit daily: the county yamen, A'qi's house, and Fukang's branch.

所以一早出门，总要到晚才能回大经，然后发号施令，
He went out early and returned to Dajing only at night, then began issuing instructions.

忙得跟阿珠说句话的工夫都没有。
He was too busy even to exchange a word with A’zhu.


天气越来越热，事情越来越多，阿珠却丝毫不以为苦，
As the weather grew hotter and the work increased, A’zhu never complained of hardship.

唯一使她怏怏在心的是，找不到机会跟胡雪岩在一起。
Her one grievance was that she could find no opportunity to be with Hu.

转眼二十天过去，快到七月初七，
Twenty days seemed to pass in a moment, and the seventh day of the seventh month was approaching.

她早几天就下了决心，要在这个天上双星团圆的佳节，跟胡雪岩好好有番话说。
Several days beforehand she had resolved that, on this festival when the two heavenly lovers were reunited, she would have a proper conversation with him.

到了那一天，她做事特别起劲，老早就告诉“饭司务”，晚饭要迟开，
On the day itself, she worked with unusual energy and told the cook early that supper was to be served late.

原来开过晚饭，还有“夜作”，
Normally there was another spell of work after supper.

她已经跟那班“湖丝阿姐”说好了，赶一赶工，做完吃饭，可以早早回家。
She had arranged with the silk workers that they would push on, finish their tasks, and then eat, allowing them to go home early.

吃过晚饭，天刚刚黑净，
By the time supper was over, darkness had just fully fallen.

收拾一切该回家了，
Everything was put away, and it was time to leave.

阿珠跟她娘说，家里太热，要在店里“乘风凉”。
A’zhu told her mother that home was too hot and she would stay at the firm to enjoy the evening air.

这是托词，她娘知道她的用意，不肯说破，
Her mother understood the excuse but did not expose it.

只提醒她说：“一身的汗，不回家洗了澡再来？”
“After sweating all day, won't you go home for a bath and come back?” she merely asked.

洗了澡再走回来，又是一身汗，
But she would sweat again on the walk back.

“我就在这里洗了！”她说，
“I'll wash here.

“叫爱珍陪我在这里。”
Let Aizhen stay with me.”

爱珍是她家用的一个使女。
Aizhen was their maid.

等浴罢乘凉，一面望着迢迢银汉，一面在等胡雪岩。
After washing, A’zhu sat in the cool air, gazing at the distant Milky Way and waiting for Hu.

等到十点钟，爱珍都打吨了，
By ten o'clock even Aizhen was nodding.

来了个人，是陈世龙，他是五天之前，由胡雪岩派他到杭州去办事的。
Then someone arrived: Chen Shilong, whom Hu had sent to Hangzhou on business five days before.


“你什么时候到的？”
“When did you get back?”

“刚刚到。”陈世龙说，
“Just now,” Chen answered.

“我不晓得你在这里，
“I didn't know you were here.

我把东西带来了。”
I've brought the things.”

“什么东西？”
“What things?”

“吃的、用的都有，衣料、香粉、香椎、沙核桃糖、蔬菜。
“All sorts of food and household things: dress materials, face powder, torreya nuts, walnut sweets, and vegetables.

有胡先生叫我买的，有我自己买的。”
Some Mr Hu asked me to buy, and some I bought myself.”

“你自己买的什么？”
“What did you buy yourself?”

“一把檀香扇。
“A sandalwood fan.

送你的。”
For you.”

“你又要去乱花钱！”
“Spending money you shouldn't again!”

阿珠埋怨他，
A’zhu reproached him.

“买一把细蒲扇我还用得着，
“I could use a finely woven palm-leaf fan.

买什么檀香扇？
Why buy sandalwood?”

‘这是违心之论，实际上她正在想要这么一把扇子。
She was speaking against her own wishes: in fact, she had been longing for just such a fan.

陈世龙觉得无趣，
Chen felt rebuffed.

“那倒是我错了！”
“Then I've made a mistake.”

他怔怔地望着她。
He stared at her blankly.

阿珠心中歉然，但也不想再解释这件事，
A’zhu felt guilty, but did not want to explain further.

问道：“你吃过饭没有？”
“Have you eaten?” she asked.

“饭倒不想吃。
“I don't feel like a meal.

最好来碗冰凉的绿豆汤。”
What I'd really like is a bowl of chilled mung-bean soup.”

“有红枣百合汤！”
“There's red-date and lily-bulb soup.”

明明可以叫爱珍去盛来，阿珠却亲自动手，
She could easily have sent Aizhen for it, but fetched it herself.

等他狼吞虎咽吃完便又问：“要不要了？”
When he had gulped it down, she asked, “Would you like more?”

“我再吃，胡先生怕就没得吃了。”
“If I have any more, there may be none left for Mr Hu.”

“不要紧！
“It doesn't matter.

他也吃不了多少的。”
He won't eat much.”

她把自己的一份，省下来给餍陈世龙的口腹。
She gave up her own portion to satisfy Chen's appetite.

第二碗红枣百合汤吃到一半，胡雪岩回来了，陈世龙慌忙站起来招呼。
He was halfway through his second bowl when Hu returned, and hurriedly rose to greet him.


胡雪岩要跟他谈话，便顾不得阿珠，
Wanting to speak to Chen, Hu had no attention to spare for A’zhu.

一坐下来就问杭州的情形。
The moment he sat down he asked about Hangzhou.

“老刘有回信在这里！”
“Here's Old Liu's reply.”

陈世龙把刘庆生的信递了过去。
Chen handed him Liu Qingsheng's letter.

信上谈到代理湖州府、县两公库的事。
It concerned Fukang's handling of the public funds of both the Huzhou prefecture and the county.

胡雪岩在这里把公款都扯了来买丝了，而应解藩库的公款，催索甚急。
Hu had drawn all the money into his silk purchases, but the provincial treasury was pressing urgently for the sums due to it.

派陈世龙专程到杭州给刘庆主送信，就是要他解决这个难题。
Chen's special journey to Hangzhou with a letter to Liu had been intended to resolve this difficulty.

刘庆生走了刘二的路子，转托藩衙门管库的书办，答应缓期到月底，必须解清。
Through Liu Er, Liu Qingsheng had approached the clerk responsible for the treasury's accounts, who had agreed to a delay until the end of the month, when everything must be remitted in full.

“老刘说，日子过得很快，要请胡先生早点预备。
“Old Liu says time passes quickly, and asks you to make preparations early.

一面他在杭州想办法，不过有没有把握，很难说。”
He's trying to find a way in Hangzhou too, though it's hard to say whether he'll succeed.”

“他在杭州怎么样想办法呢？”
“What is he trying?”

“他没有跟我说，不过我也有点晓得。”
“He didn't tell me, but I know a little.

陈世龙说：“第一是到同行那里去商量，
First, he's consulting other banks.

有湖州的汇款，最好划到阜康来开票子……”“啊！”
If they have remittances payable in Huzhou, he'd like them transferred to Fukang, which would issue the drafts—” “What!”

胡雪岩矍然一惊，
Hu started.

“这就是他冒失了。
“That's rash of him.

杭州开出票子，在这里要照兑，
Drafts issued in Hangzhou must be honoured here.

这个办法要先告诉我，
He has to tell me before doing anything of the kind.

不然岂不是‘打回票’了？”
Otherwise, won't we end up refusing payment?”

“老刘现在还在进行，
“He's still making inquiries.

等有了眉目，自然会写信来的。”
When something definite emerges, he'll naturally write.”

陈世龙停了一下又说：“另外，他跟信和在商量，
Chen paused, then added, “He's also talking to Xinhe.

到时候这里没有款子去，请信和先垫一笔。”
If we can't send the money in time, he wants them to advance it.”

“那么你晓不晓得信和张胖子怎么说法呢？”
“Do you know what Fat Zhang at Xinhe says?”

“听说信和自己的头寸也很紧。”
“I hear their own funds are very tight.”


胡雪岩默然。心里在盘算着，
Hu fell silent and calculated.

月底的限期，决不可能再缓。
The deadline at the month's end could not possibly be extended again.

如果说小刀会真的闹事。“江南大营”一方面少了上海附近的饷源，另一方面又要派兵剿办，
If the Small Swords Society did rise, the Jiangnan Grand Camp would both lose revenue from the Shanghai area and have to send troops to suppress it.

那时候来催浙江的“饷”，一定急如星火。
Its demands on Zhejiang for military funds would then become desperately urgent.

倘或无以应付，藩司报抚台、抚台奏朝廷，追究责任，
If the province could not meet them, the treasurer would report to the governor, the governor would memorialise the throne, and responsibility would be investigated.

王有龄的干系甚重。
Wang would be gravely implicated.
