“月底以前，一定要想办法解清。”胡雪岩说，
“We must find a way to remit everything before the month's end,” Hu said.

“世龙，你替我写封信。”
“Shilong, write a letter for me.”

信仍旧是写给刘庆生的，
It was again addressed to Liu Qingsheng.

关照他预先在同行之中接头短期的借款，以八月底为期，能借好多少，立刻写信来，
He was to approach the other banks in advance for short-term loans repayable at the end of the eighth month and write immediately with the amount he could obtain.

不足之数在湖州另想办法。
Any shortfall would be raised in Huzhou.

至于由杭州阜康出票，湖州阜康照兑的汇划，暂是不必进行，等全部款子筹划妥当了再说。
As for drafts issued by Fukang in Hangzhou and payable by Fukang in Huzhou, that arrangement should be suspended until all the necessary funds had been secured.

“胡先生，”陈世龙捏着笔说，“有句话，我好不好问？”
“Mr Hu,” Chen said, holding his brush, “may I ask something?”

“你问，不要紧。”
“Go ahead.”

“我要请问胡先生，八月底到期的款子，是不是等在上海卖掉了丝来还？”
“Will the loans due at the end of the eighth month be repaid from the silk sold in Shanghai?”

“不错。”胡雪岩答道：
“Exactly.

“如果一时卖不掉，我还有个办法，在上海先做押款。
If the silk can't be sold immediately, I have another way: we can borrow against it in Shanghai.

当然，最好不要走这条路，
Naturally, I'd rather not.

这条路一走，让人家看出我们的实力不足，
Once we do that, people will see that our resources are limited.

以后再要变把戏就难了。”
It will be harder to work another trick after that.”

陈世龙对这句话，大有领悟，
Chen understood a great deal from these words.

“把戏人人会变，各有巧妙不同”，
Anyone could perform tricks, but the skill varied.

巧妙就在如何不拆穿把戏上面。
The real art lay in keeping the mechanism from being exposed.


一面想，一面写信。
He thought as he wrote.

写完又谈丝生意，
Once the letter was finished, they discussed the silk business.

现在到了快起运的时候了。胡雪岩的意思，仍旧要陈世龙押运。
Shipment was approaching, and Hu wanted Chen to escort the cargo again.

陈世龙一诺无辟。
Chen readily agreed.

接下来便谈水运的细节，一直谈到货色到上海进堆栈。
They went through the details of transport by water, right up to the goods' arrival at a Shanghai warehouse.

然后又研究在上海是不是要设号子？
Then they considered whether to establish a firm there.

话越来越多，谈到深宵，兴犹未已。
One subject led to another, and deep into the night they were still absorbed in discussion.

这一来便冷落了阿珠。
A’zhu had been left entirely out.

她先还能耐心等待，但对胡雪岩那种视如不见的态度，反感越来越浓，
At first she could wait patiently, but her resentment of Hu's seeming inability to see her grew steadily.

几次想站起身走，无奈那张藤椅象有个钩子，紧紧钩住了她的衣服。
Several times she wanted to get up and leave, yet the wicker chair seemed to have a hook that held her clothes fast.

心里不断在想：等一下非好好数落他几句不可。
She kept thinking that, when she had the chance, she would give him a proper scolding.

到钟打一点，胡雪岩伸个懒腰说，
At one o'clock Hu stretched.

“有话明天再说吧！
“We can talk tomorrow.

我实在困了。”
I'm really tired.”

“我明天一早就来。”陈世龙说，
“I'll come first thing in the morning,” Chen said.

“杭州买的东西都还在船上。”
“The things from Hangzhou are still on the boat.”

“不要紧，不要紧。
“No hurry, no hurry.

你也好好歇一歇，
Get some proper rest yourself.

明天下午来好了。”
Tomorrow afternoon will do.”

说到这里他才发现阿珠，不由得诧异：
Only then did Hu notice A’zhu.

“咦，
“Why!

你还在这里？”
Are you still here?”

阿珠真想回他一句：你到此刻才知道？可是话到嘴边，又忍了回去。
She longed to retort, “Have you only just realised?” but held back the words.

“不早了！
“It's late.

世龙正好送你回去。”
Shilong can see you home.”

这一下，她可真的忍不住了。
That was more than she could bear.

等了半天，等到“送回去”这句话，
After all her waiting, this was what she got: an offer to send her home.

难道自己在这里枯守着，就为等陈世龙来送？
Had she sat there all that time merely waiting for Chen to escort her?

她恨他一点没有把她放在心上，因而扭头就走，跌跌冲冲地，真叫“一怒而去”！
Furious that Hu had given her no thought at all, she turned and stumbled away, leaving in a true burst of anger.


胡雪岩和陈世龙都是一愣，也都是立刻发觉了她的异样，不约而同地赶了上去。
Hu and Chen both stared, then immediately recognised that something was wrong and hurried after her.

“阿珠，阿珠！”
“A’zhu! A’zhu!”

“张小姐！”
“Miss Zhang!”

两个人都在喊，阿珠把脚停下来了。
At their combined calls she stopped.

胡雪岩很机警，只对陈世龙说：“你自己走好了。”
Quick to understand, Hu merely told Chen, “You go on by yourself.”

“好！”
“Very well.”

陈世龙装得若无其事地跟阿珠道别：
Chen took leave of A’zhu as though nothing had happened.

“张小姐，明朝会！”
“Until tomorrow, Miss Zhang.”

她不能不理，也答一声：“明朝会！”
She could not ignore him and answered, “Until tomorrow.”

然后仍旧回到原来那张藤椅上坐下。
Then she returned to her wicker chair.

“天气太热！”胡雪岩跟过去，陪着笑说：
“This weather is too hot,” Hu said, following her with an apologetic smile.

“最好弄点清心去火的东西来吃。”
“The best thing would be something cooling to clear the heat.”

她以为他一定会问：为什么发这么大的脾气？那一来就好接着他的话发牢骚。
She had expected him to ask why she was so angry, which would have given her an opening for her complaints.

不想是这么一句话，一时倒叫人发不出脾气，
Instead he said this, leaving her unable to vent her temper.

只好不理他，作为报复。
She could only punish him with silence.

“喔，有红枣百合汤，
“Oh, red-date and lily-bulb soup!

好极了！”
Excellent!”

胡雪岩指着陈世龙吃剩下的那只碗说，“好不好给我也盛一碗来？
Pointing to Chen's empty bowl, he asked, “Could you fetch me a bowl too?

味道大概不错。”
It must be delicious.”

有心答他一句：吃完了！又怕这一来，真的变成反目，
She wanted to say there was none left, but feared that might turn their disagreement into a real quarrel.

结果还是去盛了来，送到胡雪岩手里。
In the end, she fetched a bowl and put it in his hands.

但心里却越发委屈，
Yet she felt more aggrieved than ever.

眼眶一热，流了两滴眼泪。
Her eyes grew hot, and two tears fell.


“这为啥？”
“What's this?”

胡雪岩不能再装糊涂，
Hu could no longer pretend not to understand.

“好端端地哭！
“Why cry when nothing's wrong?

如果是哪个得罪了你，尽管说，
If someone's offended you, tell me.

我想也没有哪个敢得罪你。”
Though I can't imagine anyone daring to do that.”

活是说得好听，却只是口惠，
Pleasant words, but words were all he offered.

实际上他不知存着什么心思？
What was he really thinking?

跟他呕气无用，
Sulking would achieve nothing.

还是要跟他好好谈一谈。
She must have a serious talk with him.

“你晓不晓得，我特为在这里等你？”她试干了眼泪问。
“Do you know that I stayed here especially to wait for you?” she asked, wiping her tears.

“啊呀！”
“Good heavens!”

胡雪岩故意装得大惊小怪的，敲敲自己的额角，
Hu made a great show of astonishment and tapped his forehead.

“我实在忙得头都昏了，
“I'm so busy I can hardly think.

居然会没有想到你在这里是等我。
Imagine my not realising you were waiting for me!

对不起，对不起！
I'm sorry, I'm sorry.”

“说着便拉过她的手来，揉着、搓着，使得阿珠啼笑皆非，弄不清自己的感觉是爱还是恨？
He took her hand and held it between his, leaving her uncertain whether to laugh or cry, love him or resent him.

最为难的还是一腔幽怨，无从细诉。
Hardest of all was that she could find no way to explain the feelings that had troubled her for so long.

她一直在想，以他的机警而善于揣摩人情，一定会知道她的心事，
She had always thought that a man so quick-witted and so good at reading people must understand what she wanted.

然则一直没有表示，无非故意装糊涂。
If he had given no sign, surely he was deliberately pretending otherwise.

但有时也会自我譬解，归出于他太忙，没有工夫来想这些。
Yet sometimes she comforted herself with the thought that he was simply too busy to consider such things.

此刻既然要正正经经来谈，首先就得弄清楚，他到底真的是忙想不到，还是想过了，有别样的打算？
Now that they were to talk seriously, she must first discover whether he truly had had no time to think or had thought about it and made other plans.

就是这一点，也很难有恰当的说法，
Even that was hard to put into words.

她一个人偏着头，只想心事，把胡雪岩的那些不相干的闲话，都当作耳边风。
She sat with her head tilted, absorbed in her thoughts, letting his irrelevant chatter pass unheard.


“咦！”
“Well?”

胡雪岩推推她问道：
Hu nudged her.

“你是哑巴，还是聋子？”
“Have you gone dumb, or deaf?”

“我不哑不聋，
“Neither.

只懒得说。
I simply don't feel like talking.

要说，也不知道从哪里说起！”
And if I did, I wouldn't know where to begin.”

语气平静，话锋却颇为严重，胡雪岩自然听得出来，
Her tone was calm, but the words were serious, as Hu naturally recognised.

他原有装些糊涂，最近更有了别样心想，所以越发小心，
He had indeed been pretending not to understand, and lately he had formed other ideas, making him all the more cautious.

只这样问道：“什么事？这样子为难！”
“What is it that's so difficult?” he asked.

“难的是我自己说不出口。”
“The difficulty is that I can't say it myself.”

这句话答得很好，
It was a good reply.

虽说含蓄，其实跟说明了一样，
Though indirect, it was as clear as an outright statement.

胡雪岩不能装糊涂了，
Hu could no longer evade it.

“喔，原来如此。
“Oh, so that's it.

说实话，你是说不出口，我是忙不过来。”他说，
To tell the truth, you can't bring yourself to say it, and I can't find the time to act.

“你当我没有想过？
Do you think I haven't considered it?

我想过十七八遍了，
I've thought it over seventeen or eighteen times.

我托张胖子跟你娘说的话，绝对算数。
I absolutely stand by what I asked Fat Zhang to tell your mother.

不过要有工夫来办。
But I need time to arrange things.

现在这样子，你自己看见、听见的。
You've seen and heard how matters are just now.

我没有想到，这一趟到湖州来，会结交郁四这个朋友，
I never expected this visit to Huzhou to bring me a friend like Yu Si.

做洋庄，开阜康分号，都是预先不曾打算到的。
Trading with foreign firms and opening Fukang's branch were both unplanned.

你刚才听见的，我杭州的头寸这么紧，
You heard just now how tight my funds are in Hangzhou.

等着我去料理，都抽不出空来。”
They need me there to put things right, yet I can't even get away.”

就这一番话，阿珠象吃了一服消痰化气的汤头，
This speech soothed A’zhu like a dose of medicine that relieved a choking pressure.

“你看你，”她不由得有了笑容，
A smile came to her face. “Look at you!

“我不过说了一句，你咭咭呱呱一大套。
I say one thing, and out comes a whole torrent.

没有人说得过你。”
Nobody can argue with you.”

“我不说又不好，说了又不好！
“It's wrong if I say nothing and wrong if I speak!

真正难伺候。
You're terribly hard to please.

好了，好了，
All right, all right.

我们谈点别的。”
Let's talk about something else.”


所谈的自然也不脱大经丝行这个范围。
Their conversation naturally remained within the affairs of the Dajing Silk Firm.

阿珠最注意的是胡雪岩的行踪，话锋中隐约表示，她也想到上海去玩一趟。
What interested A’zhu most was where Hu would be going, and she hinted that she too would like to visit Shanghai.

胡雪岩说天气太热，一动不如一静，
He replied that in such heat it was better to stay put than travel.

同时老张是一定要去的，她该留在湖州，帮着她娘照料丝行。
Besides, Old Zhang would certainly be going, and she ought to remain in Huzhou to help her mother look after the business.

这是极有道理的话，阿珠不作声了。
This was so reasonable that she said nothing.

“你看，”他忽然问道：“陈世龙这个人怎么样呢？”
“Tell me,” he suddenly asked, “what do you think of Chen Shilong?”

是哪方面怎么样呢？
In what respect?

阿珠心里想替陈世龙说几句好话，却不知道该怎么说？
She wanted to say something good about Chen, but did not know what to say.

只好笼统的答道：“蛮能干的！”
“He's very capable,” she answered broadly.

“我是说他做人，
“I mean his character.

你看是老实一路呢？还是浮滑一路呢？”
Would you call him the simple, honest sort, or the slick sort?”

老实就是无用，浮滑就是靠不住。
Simple and honest would mean useless; slick would mean untrustworthy.

阿珠觉得他的话，根本不能回答，
A’zhu felt that the question could not be answered on those terms.

便摇摇头说：
She shook her head.

“都不是！”
“Neither.”

“不老实，也不浮滑，
“Neither simple nor slick.

普普通通。
Just ordinary.

是不是呢？”
Is that it?”

“普普通通”也不是句好话，
Ordinary was hardly a compliment either.

她不愿委屈陈世龙，又答了个：“不是！”
Unwilling to do Chen an injustice, she again said, “No.”

“左也不是，右也不是。
“Not this and not that.

那么你说，陈世龙到底是怎么样一个人呢？”
Then tell me what kind of person he is.”

一半是无从回答，一半由于他那咄咄逼人的词色，阿珠有些恼羞成怒了，“我不晓得！”
Half unable to answer, half angered by his pressing manner, she snapped, “I don't know!

她的声音又快又尖，“陈世龙关我什么事？请你少来问我。”
What has Chen Shilong to do with me? Please stop asking.” Her voice was sharp and quick.


她气得脸红，呼吸急促。
Her face flushed with anger and her breathing quickened.

胡雪岩仍笑嘻嘻地看着她，让她越发不自在。
Hu kept watching her with a smile, making her still more uncomfortable.

阿珠独自生了半天闷气，
She sat fuming for some time.

察觉他的目光后，转过身去，把蒲扇拿在身前，嘴里还咕哝了一句：“贼秃嘻嘻！”
When she noticed his gaze, she turned away, held her palm-leaf fan before her, and muttered, “Smirking rogue!”

“好了，好了！
“All right, all right.

都是我不好。
It's all my fault.

天有点凉了，
The night's getting cool.

到里头来坐。”
Come and sit inside.”

这句话提醒了她，夜这么深了，
This reminded her how late it was.

到底回去不回去？
Should she go home?

要回去，就得赶紧走，而且要胡雪岩送，
If so, she must leave at once, and Hu would have to escort her.

一则街上看到了不便，再则也不愿开口向他央求。
Being seen in the street together would be awkward, and she did not want to ask him for the favour.

不走呢，似乎更不好。
Yet staying seemed worse.

虽然也在这里住过，那都是跟娘在一起，不怕旁人说闲话，
She had slept here before, but always with her mother, which left no grounds for gossip.

现在是孤男寡女，情形又不同了。
Now she and Hu would be alone, and that was different.

“真的不理我？”胡雪岩又说，
“Are you really going to ignore me?” Hu continued.

“那我就陪你在这里坐一夜。
“Then I'll sit out here with you all night.

不过受了凉，明天生病，是你自己吃苦头。”
But if you catch cold and fall ill tomorrow, you'll be the one to suffer.”

听得他温情款款，她的气也消了，
His affectionate tone softened her anger.

“没有看到过你这种人，”她说：
“I've never seen anyone like you,” she said.

“滑得象泥鳅一样！”
“You're as slippery as a loach!”


这是说他对她的态度，不可捉摸。
She meant that his attitude towards her was impossible to pin down.

胡雪岩无可辩解，却有些着急，
Hu had no answer, but he was growing impatient.

明天一早还有许多事等着自己料理，得要早早上床，去寻个好梦，
There was much to do first thing tomorrow; he needed to get to bed and enjoy a good night's sleep.

这样白耗工夫，岂不急人？
How could he help chafing at this waste of time?

想一想，只有这样暗示：“那么你坐一下，
After a moment's thought, he could only hint, “Sit here a little longer, then.

我先去抹个身。”
I'll go and sponge myself down.”

抹过身自然该上床了。
Naturally, bed would follow.

听得这话，他急她也急，便不再多作考虑，站起身来说，
Hearing his impatience, she became anxious too and, without further deliberation, stood up.

“我要回去了。”
“I'm going home.”

“回去？”
“Home?”

胡雪岩心想，这得找人来送，
That would mean finding someone to escort her.

当然是自己义不容辞，一来一去又费辰光又累，实在不想动，
Of course, he could hardly refuse to go himself, but the journey there and back would take time and tire him, and he really did not want to stir.

便功她说：
He tried to persuade her.

“何必？
“Why bother?

马马虎虎睡一会，
Get whatever sleep you can here.

天就亮了。”
It'll be daylight soon.”

阿珠犹在迟疑，一眼瞥见在打瞌睡的爱珍，顿感释然，
Still hesitating, A’zhu glanced at the dozing Aizhen and felt relieved.

有爱珍陪着，就不必怕人说闲话。
With her maid to accompany her, she need not fear gossip.


于是又说了两句闲话，各自归寝，却部不能入梦。
After a few more words they went to their separate rooms, but neither could sleep.

胡雪岩心里在想，阿珠这件事真有点进退两难，
Hu thought that the affair with A’zhu had become a real dilemma.

照她的脾气，最好成天守在一起，说说笑笑，
With her temperament, she would prefer to be together all day, laughing and talking.

如果嫁个老老实实的小伙子，一夫一妻，必定恩爱。
Married to a straightforward young man, with just the two of them, she would surely be happy.

象自己这种性情，将来难免三妻四妾，
With his own disposition, however, he would inevitably have several wives and concubines in time.

阿珠一定会吃醋，
A’zhu would be jealous.

何苦闹得鸡犬不宁？
Why invite endless domestic turmoil?

于是他又想到陈世龙。
His thoughts returned to Chen.

看样子，阿珠并不讨厌他，只是她此刻一心要做“胡家的人”，不会想到陈世龙身上。
She did not seem to dislike him; she simply had her heart set on joining the Hu household and could think of nobody else.

倘或一方面慢慢让她疏远，一方面尽量让陈世龙跟她接近，两下一凑，这头姻缘就可以成功了。
If Hu gradually let her grow distant while giving Chen every opportunity to draw close, the two movements together might produce a marriage.


这一成功，绝对是好事。
Such a marriage would be an excellent thing.

阿珠的父母，必定喜欢这个女婿，他们小夫妻也必定心满意足，
A’zhu's parents would certainly welcome the son-in-law, and the young couple would be entirely satisfied.

饮水思源，都是自己的功劳。
Remembering the source of their happiness, they would credit Hu with it all.

别的不说，起码陈世龙就会死心塌地，帮自己好好做生意。
At the very least, Chen would devote himself wholeheartedly to helping Hu's business.

打定了主意，恬然入梦。
With this settled in his mind, Hu fell peacefully asleep.

第二天一早起身，盘算了一下，这天该办的大事有两件。
Rising early the next morning, he reckoned that he had two major matters to attend to.

第一件是王有龄要晋省述职，说过要约他一起同行，
First, Wang was going to the provincial capital to report on his administration and had invited Hu to travel with him.

得去讨个回话。
Hu must obtain a definite answer about the arrangements.

第二件是跟郁四去商量，哪里设法调一笔款子，把月底应解藩库的公款应付过去。
Second, he must ask Yu where they could raise funds to cover the public money due at the provincial treasury by the month's end.


“你来得正好！”王有龄一见他便这样说：
“You've come at just the right time!” Wang said on seeing him.

“我正要找你，
“I was about to send for you.

有两件事跟你商量。
I have two things to discuss.

先说一件，要你捐钱。”
First, I want a donation from you.”

这句话没头没脑，听不明白，
This came without explanation, and Hu did not understand.

但不管是捐什么，没有推辞的道理，
Whatever the donation was for, however, there was no reason to refuse.

所以他很豪爽地答道：“雪公说好了，捐多少？
He answered generously, “Name the amount, Mr Xuexuan.

一句话。”
Just say the word.”

“是这样，我想给书院里加此‘膏火’银子，
“I want to increase the academy's study allowances.

你看如何？”
What do you think?”

寒士多靠书院月课得奖的少数银子，
Poor scholars often depended on the small awards given for the academy's monthly exercises.

名为夜来读书的“膏火”所需，实在是用来养家活口的。
Nominally these paid for lamp oil for night study; in reality they fed their families.

“这是好事！”胡雪岩也懂这些名堂，
Hu understood such arrangements. “An excellent cause!

“我赞成！
I approve.

捐二百两够不够？”
Would two hundred taels be enough?”

“你出手倒真阔！”王有龄笑道，
“You certainly give generously!” Wang laughed.

“你一共捐二百两银子。一百两书院膏火，另外一百两捐给育婴堂，让他们多置几亩田。”
“Two hundred taels in all: a hundred for the academy's allowances and a hundred for the foundling home, so that it can buy a few more mu of land.”

“好，就这样。
“Agreed.

银子缴到哪里？”
Where should I pay it?”


“这不忙。
“There's no hurry.

我谈第二件。”王有龄又说，“本县的团练，已经谈妥当了。
Now for the second matter.” Wang continued, “The county militia arrangements have been settled.

现在局势越来越紧，保境安民，耽误不得，
The situation is growing more urgent, and protecting the district and its people cannot wait.

所以我马上要到省里去一趟，说停当了，好动手。
I must go to the provincial capital at once and settle the matter there so that we can begin.

预备明天就走，
I intend to leave tomorrow.

你来不来得及？
Can you be ready?”

““明天就走哪里来得及？”
“How could I be ready tomorrow?”

胡雪岩想了想答道：
Hu considered.

“最快也得三天以后，我才能动身。”
“Three days from now is the earliest I could leave.”

“那么，你一到省就来看我。
“Then come and see me as soon as you arrive.

还有件事，解省的公款怎么样了？
And one more thing: what is happening about the money due to the province?

上面问起来，我好有句话交代。”
I must have an answer if my superiors ask.”

这是个难题。
That was difficult.

王有龄不上省，延到月底缴没有关系，
If Wang stayed in Huzhou, payment at the month's end would be acceptable.

既已上省，藩司会问：怎么不顺便报解？
But once he went to the capital, the treasurer would ask why he had not brought the money with him.

这话在王有龄很难回答，自己要替他设想。
Wang would find that hard to answer, and Hu must think for him.

“讲是讲好了，月底解清。不过雪公不能空手上省。我看这样，”胡雪岩说：
“We agreed to remit it all by the month's end, but you can't go empty-handed.

“雪公能不能缓三天，等我一起走？
Could you delay three days and travel with me?

这三天工夫当中，我有雪公凑五万现款出来。
In those three days I'll put together fifty thousand taels in cash for you.

这样子上省，面子也好看些。”
You'd arrive looking much better.”

王有龄想了一下答道，
Wang considered.

“那也好！”
“That will do.”

事情说定了，胡雪岩急于想去凑那五万现款，随即去找郁四，说明经过。
Once it was settled, Hu, eager to raise the money, went straight to Yu and explained.

彼此休戚相关，而且郁四早就拍过胸脯，头寸调度，归他负责，
Their fortunes were bound together, and Yu had already pledged to take responsibility for the funds.

所以一口答应，等临走那天，一定可以凑足。
He agreed at once: the full sum would be ready by the day they left.


于是胡雪岩回到大经，把黄仪和老张找来，
Returning to Dajing, Hu summoned Huang Yi and Old Zhang.

说三天以后就要动身。问他们货色能不能都料理好，装船同走？
He told them he would be leaving in three days and asked whether all the goods could be prepared, loaded, and sent off with him.

“来不及！”黄仪答道：
“There isn't time,” Huang answered.

“我今天一早，仔细算过了，
“I worked it out carefully this morning.

总要五天。”
We need five days.”

“今天七月初八，
“Today is the eighth of the seventh month.

加五天就是十三，
Five more days brings us to the thirteenth.

二十以前赶得到上海。”
You can still reach Shanghai before the twentieth.”

胡雪岩灵机一动，
An idea came to Hu.

“我跟王老爷已经约好，不能失信，
“I've already arranged things with His Honour Wang and can't break my word.

我们十一先走，
We'll leave on the eleventh.

你们随后来，我在杭州等。”
You follow afterwards, and I'll wait in Hangzhou.”

接着，他又对老张说，
Then he turned to Old Zhang.

“阿珠想到上海去玩一趟，
“A’zhu wants to see Shanghai.

就让她去好了。”
Let her go along.”

“好的！”老张深表同意，
“Certainly!” Old Zhang warmly agreed.

“阿珠这一向也辛苦，人都瘦了，
“She's worked hard lately and has grown thinner.

让她到上海去逛一逛。”
Let her have a look around Shanghai.”


“还有件事，”
“There's something else.”

胡雪岩忽然有个灵感，
Hu suddenly had another inspiration.

“我们要做好事！”
“We must do good works!”

黄仪和老张都一愣，不知道他何以爆出这么句话来，
Both Huang and Old Zhang stared, wondering what had prompted the announcement.

好事怎么做法？为谁做好事？
What good works, and for whom?

当然，胡雪岩会有解释：
Naturally, Hu explained.

他是从王有龄那里得来的启示，
The idea had come from Wang.

“做生意第一要市面平静，
“The first thing business needs is a peaceful market.

平静才会兴旺，
Peace brings prosperity.

我们做好事，就是求市面平静。”
Our good works will help maintain that peace.”

他喜欢引用谚语，这时又很恰当地用了一句：
Fond of proverbs, he found an apt one.

“ ‘饥寒起盗心’，
“‘Hunger and cold turn men's thoughts to theft.’

吃亏的还是有钱的人，
And who suffers? The wealthy.

所以做生意赚了钱，要做好事。
So when business makes us money, we must do some good.

今年我们要发米票、施棉衣、舍棺材。”
This year we'll distribute rice vouchers, give away padded clothes, and provide coffins for those who can't afford them.”

“原来是这些好事！”黄仪答道，
“Oh, that kind of good work,” Huang replied.

“那都是冬天，到年近岁逼才办，
“Those things are usually done in winter, towards the year's end.

时候还早。”
There's plenty of time.”

“现在热天也有好事好做，
“There are good works to do in hot weather too.

秋老虎还厉害得很，
The fierce late heat of autumn is still to come.

施茶、施药都是很实惠的好事。”
Giving out tea and medicines is useful help.”

胡雪岩最有决断，而况似此小事，所以这样嘱咐：
Hu was decisive, especially over such a small matter.

“老黄，说做就做！
“Old Huang, once we've decided, let's act.

今天就办。”
Start today.”

黄仪深知他的脾气，做事要又快又好，钱上面很舍得。
Huang knew his temperament well: work must be done quickly and properly, and money would be freely provided.

这就好办了！
That made it easy.

当天大经丝行门口便出现了一座木架子，
The same day, a wooden stand appeared outside Dajing.

上面两口可容一担水的茶缸，
On it stood two tea vats, each large enough for a full carrying load of water.

竹筒斜削，安上一个柄，当做茶杯，
Bamboo tubes, cut diagonally and fitted with handles, served as cups.

茶水中加上清火败毒的药料。
The tea contained medicinal ingredients intended to clear internal heat and counter toxins.

另外门上一张簇新的梅红笺，写的是：“本行敬送辟瘟丹、诸葛行军散，
A fresh sheet of plum-red paper on the door announced: “Biwen Pills and Zhuge Marching Powder given free by this firm.

请内洽索取。”
Please inquire within.”


这一来大经丝行就热闹了，
Dajing promptly became a busy place.

一下午就送掉了两百多瓶诸葛行军散，一百多包辟瘟丹，
In a single afternoon, more than two hundred bottles of Zhuge Marching Powder and a hundred packets of Biwen Pills were given away.

黄仪深以为患，
Huang was deeply troubled.

到晚来向胡雪岩诉苦，一则怕难以为继，二则伯讨药的人太多，影响生意。
That evening he complained to Hu that, first, they might not be able to keep it up and, second, so many people coming for medicine would interfere with trade.

“丝也收得差不多了，生意不会受大影响，
“We've nearly finished buying the silk, so business won't be much affected.

讨药的人虽多。实在也花不了多少钱。
There may be many people, but the cost is really small.

第一天人多是一定的，
Naturally, the first day draws a crowd.

过两天就好了，
It'll be better in a day or two.

讨过的人，不好意思再来讨，
People who've already received medicine will be embarrassed to ask again.

再说，药又不是铜细，越多越好。
Besides, medicine isn't copper cash: more isn't always better.

不要紧！”
Don't worry.”

“我倒有个办法。”陈世龙接口说道：
“I have an idea,” Chen put in.

“我们送的药要定制，分量不必这么多。
“We should have the medicines specially prepared, in smaller quantities per package.

包装纸上要红字印明白：”大经丝行敬送‘。
The wrappers should be printed in red: ‘Presented by the Dajing Silk Firm.’

装诸葛行军散的小瓷瓶，也要现烧，把大经丝行印上去。
The little porcelain bottles for the Marching Powder should be specially fired too, with Dajing's name on them.”

““这要大动干戈，
“That would take a great deal of arranging.

今年来不及，
It's too late this year.

只好明年再说。”
We'd have to leave it till next year.”

黄仪是不愿多找麻烦的语气。
Huang plainly did not want additional trouble.

胡雪岩当时虽无表示，事后把陈世龙找了来说：
Hu said nothing then, but afterwards called Chen aside.

“世龙，你的脑筋很好。
“Shilong, you have a good head.

说实话，施茶施药的用意，只有你懂，
To tell the truth, you're the only one who understands what I mean by giving out tea and medicines.

好事不会白做的，
Good works won't go unrewarded.

我是借此扬名，不过这话不好说出口，
I'm using them to make a name for myself, though I couldn't say so aloud.

你倒猜到了，
You guessed it.

实在聪明。”
Very clever.”


得了这番鼓励，陈世龙颇为兴奋，
Chen was excited by this encouragement.

很诚恳地答道：“我跟胡先生也学了好多东西。”
“I've learned a great deal from you too, Mr Hu,” he answered earnestly.

“慢慢来！
“Take your time.

你只要跟我跟长了，包你有出息。
Stay with me long enough, and I guarantee you'll get somewhere.

现在，我再跟你说件事。
Now there's something else.

这趟阿珠到杭州，你多照应照应她，
When A’zhu goes to Hangzhou this time, look after her.

她是伢儿脾气，喜欢热闹，
She has a child's disposition and likes company and excitement.

船上没事，你多陪陪她。”
There's nothing to do on a boat, so keep her company.”

“我晓得了！”
“I understand.”

晓得了？
Did he?

胡雪岩心想，未见得！
Hu doubted it.

话还要再点一两句。
He would need another hint or two.

“世龙！”他态度轻松地问道：“你倒说说看，我跟阿珠是怎么回事？”
“Shilong,” he asked casually, “what do you make of A’zhu and me?”

这叫陈世龙怎么说？
How could Chen answer that?

他笑一笑，露出雪白的一嘴牙齿，显得稚气可掬地。
He merely smiled, showing a row of white teeth and looking touchingly boyish.

“这有什么好碍口的？
“There's no need to feel awkward.

你尽管说。”
Say what you think.”

陈世龙逼得无法，只好说了：“胡先生不是很喜欢张小姐吗？
Pressed beyond escape, Chen answered, “Aren't you very fond of Miss Zhang?

外面都说，胡先生在湖州还要立一处公馆。”
Everyone says you're going to establish a household here in Huzhou as well.”

“对！我在湖州倒想安个家，
“Yes, I would like a home in Huzhou.

来来往往，起居饮食都方便。
Coming and going, I'd have somewhere comfortable to stay and eat.

不过，我跟阿珠是干干净净的。”
But nothing has happened between A’zhu and me.”

这前后两截话，有些接不上榫头，
The two parts of this statement did not quite fit together.

陈世龙倒愣住了，
Chen was puzzled.

“莫非胡先生另有打算？”他问。
“Do you have some other plan?”

“现在也还谈不到。
“It's too early to say.

等我下趟来再说。”
We'll see when I come again.”


“那么，”陈世龙想了想，替阿珠有些忧虑和不平，“张小姐呢？
“Then what about Miss Zhang?” Chen asked after thinking, troubled on her behalf and feeling she was being unfairly treated.

她一片心都在胡先生身上。”
“Her whole heart is set on you.”

“这我知道。
“I know.

就为这点，我只好慢慢来。
That's why I have to take things slowly.

好在，”胡雪岩又说：“我跟她规规矩矩，
Fortunately, as I said, we've behaved properly.

干干净净，不会有什么太大的麻烦。”
Nothing has happened, so there shouldn't be any great difficulty.”

照这样一说，胡雪岩是决定不要阿珠了。
This meant Hu had decided not to take A’zhu.

这为什么？
But why?

陈世龙深感诧异，
Chen was astonished.

“胡先生，有句话，我实在忍不住要问。”
“Mr Hu, there's something I simply can't help asking.”

他眨着眼说：
He blinked.

“张小姐哪一点不好？
“What's wrong with Miss Zhang?

这样的人才，说句老实话，打了灯笼都找不着的。”
To be honest, you could search with a lantern and not find another like her.”

由这两句话，可见他对阿珠十分倾倒。
Those few words showed how much he admired her.

胡雪岩心想，自己这件事做好了，而且看来一定会有圆满结局，
Hu thought his good deed would succeed and was likely to end happily.

所以相当高兴。但表面上却不露声色，
He was pleased, but showed nothing.

反而叹口气说：
Instead he sighed.

“唉！你不知道我的心。
“Ah, you don't understand my feelings.

如果阿珠不是十分人才，我倒也马马虎虎安个家，不去多伤脑筋了。
If A’zhu weren't so exceptional, I might simply establish another household and give it no further thought.

就因为阿珠是这样子打着灯笼都难找的人，我想想于心不忍。”
It's precisely because she's so rare that I can't bring myself to do it.”

“于心不忍？”
“Can't bring yourself?”

似乎越说越玄妙了，
It grew more mysterious with every word.

陈世龙率直问道，“为什么？”
Chen asked bluntly, “Why?”


“第一，虽说‘两头大’，别人看来总是个小。
“First, however much we call it two wives of equal standing, others would still see her as a concubine.

太委屈阿珠。
That would be unfair to her.

第二，我现在的情形，你看见的，各地方在跑，
Second, you see how I live, constantly moving from place to place.

把她一个人冷冷清清摆在湖州，心里过意不去。”
I couldn't bear to leave her lonely here in Huzhou.”

“胡先生！”陈世龙失声说道，
“Mr Hu!” Chen exclaimed.

“你倒真是好人。”
“You really are a good man.”

“这也不见得。
“Not necessarily.

闲话少说，
But enough of that.

世龙，”胡雪岩低声说道：“我真正拿你当自己小兄弟一样，
Shilong,” Hu lowered his voice, “I truly regard you as my own younger brother.

无话不谈。
There's nothing I wouldn't discuss with you.

你人也聪明，我的心思你都明白。
You're clever enough to understand my intentions.

刚才我跟你谈的这番话，你千万不必给阿珠和他爹娘说。
Don't repeat what I've just said to A’zhu or her parents.

好在我的意思你也知道了，该当如何应付？你自己总有数！”
Now that you know what I mean, you should know how to act.”

陈世龙恍然大悟，喜不可言。
Chen understood at last and was overjoyed.

原来这样子“推位让国”！
So Hu was stepping aside for him!

怪不得口口声声说跟阿珠“规规矩矩，干干净净”，意思是表示并非把一件湿布衫脱了给别人穿。
No wonder he kept stressing that nothing had happened between himself and A’zhu: he meant that he was not handing on some burden he had tired of carrying.

这番美意，着实可感。
This kindness deserved real gratitude.

不过他既不愿明说，自己也不必多事去道谢。
But since Hu preferred not to state it openly, Chen need not make a fuss of thanking him.

反正彼此心照就是了。
They understood one another without words.


但有一点却必须弄清楚，
One point still needed clarification.

“胡先生！”他问，“张小姐跟我谈起你，我该怎么说？”
“Mr Hu, when Miss Zhang speaks to me about you, what should I say?”

问到这话，就表示他已有所领会，
The question showed that Chen had understood.

胡雪岩答道：“你不妨有意无意多提这两点：
Hu answered, “You can casually bring up two things from time to time.

第一，我太太很凶。
First, my wife has a fierce temper.

第二，我忙，不会专守在一个地方。
Second, I'm busy and won't stay in any one place.

总而言之，言而总之一句话：你要让她慢慢把我忘记掉。”
In a word, however you put it, you must gradually help her forget me.”

“好的。”陈世龙说，
“Very well.

“我心里有数了。”
I know what to do.”

因为有些默契，胡雪岩从当天起，就尽量找机会让陈世龙跟张家接近，
With this unspoken understanding established, Hu began that very day to find every opportunity for Chen to be close to the Zhang family.

凡有传话、办事、与老张有关的，都叫他奔走联络，
Messages, errands, anything connected with Old Zhang—all went through Chen.

同时明雪岩自己以“王大老爷有公事”这么一句话作为托辞，搬到知府衙门去住，整天不见人面。
Meanwhile Hu moved into the prefectural yamen, using Wang's official business as his excuse, and stayed out of sight all day.

再下一天就是初十，
The following day was the tenth.

一直到中午，仍旧不见胡雪岩露面，阿珠的娘烦躁了，
By noon there was still no sign of him, and A’zhu's mother grew impatient.

“世龙，”她说，“你胡先生是怎么了？
“Shilong, what's come over your Mr Hu?

明天要动身了，
He's leaving tomorrow.

凡事要有个交代，
Things need to be settled.

大家总要碰碰头才好。”
Surely we should all meet before he goes.”

“胡先生实在忙！”
“He really is busy.

陈世龙说，“好在事情都交代清楚了。
Fortunately, everything has been arranged.

我们十三开船，
We sail on the thirteenth.

有什么事，到杭州再问他也不迟。”
If there's anything else, we can ask him in Hangzhou.”

话是不错，但照道理说，至少要替胡雪岩饯个行。
True enough, but surely they ought at least to give him a farewell dinner.

这件事她前两夭就在筹划了，心里在想，动身之前这顿晚饭，总要在“家里”吃，所以一直也不曾提。
She had been planning it for two days, assuming without saying so that he would eat his last evening meal at home.

现在看样子非先说好不可了。
Now it seemed she must make an explicit arrangement.

“世龙，我拜托你件事情，
“Shilong, do me a favour.

请你现在就替我劳步走一趟，跟你胡先生说，今天晚上无论如何要请好回来吃饭。”
Please go at once and tell him he must come back to dinner tonight, whatever happens.”


陈世龙自然照办不误。可是这一去到下午四点钟才回张家，
Chen naturally went, but did not return to the Zhang house until four in the afternoon.

阿珠和她娘已经悬念不已，嘀嘀咕咕半天了。
By then A’zhu and her mother had been worrying and speculating for a long time.

“怎么到这时候才回来？”阿珠大为埋怨。
“Why have you only just come back?” A’zhu demanded reproachfully.

“我心里也急呀！”陈世龙平静地回答，
“I was anxious too,” he answered calmly.

“胡先生在王大老爷签押房里谈公事，叫我等一等；
“Mr Hu was discussing official business in His Honour Wang's office and told me to wait.

一等就等了个把时辰，
I waited a couple of hours.

我怕你们等得心急，想先回来说一声。
Afraid you would be worrying, I thought I'd come back first to let you know.

刚刚抬起脚，胡先生出来了，
Just as I was leaving, he came out.

话还说不到三句，王大老爷叫听差又来请。
We'd scarcely exchanged three sentences when Wang sent an attendant to ask him back.

胡先生说马上就出来，叫我千万不要走，
Mr Hu said he'd be out immediately and told me not to leave.

哪晓得又是半个时辰。”
Who'd have thought it would take another hour?”

“这倒错怪你了！”
“Then I blamed you unfairly.”

阿珠歉意的笑笑。
A’zhu smiled apologetically.

“胡先生说，来是一定要来的，就不知道啥时候？
“He says he'll certainly come, but doesn't know when.

只怕顶早也要到七点。”
Probably seven at the earliest.”

“七点就七点。”阿珠的娘说，
“Seven it is,” her mother said.

“十二点也要等。
“We'd wait till midnight if necessary.

不过有两样菜，耽误了辰光，就不好吃了。”
Only there are two dishes that won't taste right if they're kept too long.”

“那我到丝行里去了，
“I'll go to the silk firm, then.

还有好多事在那里。”
There's plenty to do.”

“你晚上也要来吃饭。”
“You must come to dinner too.”

阿珠的娘还有些不放心，“最好到衙门里等着你胡先生一起来。”陈世龙答应着刚刚走出门，只听阿珠在后面喊道：“等等！
Still uneasy, she added, “Better go to the yamen and wait, then come back with him.” Chen agreed and had just stepped outside when A’zhu called after him, “Wait!

我跟你一起去。“
I'll come with you.”


于是两个人同行从张家走向大经丝厅，
They walked together from the Zhang house to Dajing.

陈世龙的朋友很多，一路走一路打招呼，
Chen had many friends and greeted people all along the way.

有些人就打量阿珠，他总替人很郑重的介绍：“这位是张小姐！”
Some looked curiously at A’zhu, and he invariably introduced her with great seriousness: “This is Miss Zhang.”

这样介绍了两三次，阿珠又怪他了：
After two or three such introductions, she complained again.

“不要‘小姐、小姐’的，
“Stop calling me ‘Miss’ all the time.

哪有个大小姐在街上乱跑的呢？”
What young lady of a grand family goes wandering about the streets?”

“那么叫你啥呢？”
“Then what should I call you?”

阿珠不响。
She did not answer.

“小姐”的称呼，在家里听听倒很过瘾，在人面前叫，就不大好意思了。
Being called Miss Zhang at home was quite gratifying, but hearing it before strangers embarrassed her.

但也不愿他叫自己的小名，
Yet she did not want him to use her childhood name either.

其实也没有关系，不过这样叫惯了，将来改口很困难，
There was really no harm in it, but once he became accustomed to that, changing later would be difficult.

而由“张小姐”改称“胡太太”或者“ 胡师母”，却是顺理成章的事。
From Miss Zhang to Mrs Hu, or his mentor's wife, would be a natural progression.

一想到将来的身分，她不由得有些脸上发热，
At the thought of her future position, her cheeks warmed.

怕陈世龙发觉，偷眼去觑他。
Afraid Chen might notice, she stole a glance at him.

不过他也在窥伺，
He too was watching.

视线相接，他倒不在乎，她却慌忙避了开去，脸更加红了。
Their eyes met; he was untroubled, but she hastily looked away and blushed more deeply.


心里慌乱，天气又热，迎着西晒的太阳，额上沁出好些汗珠，
Between her agitation and the heat of the westering sun, beads of sweat appeared on her forehead.

偏偏走得匆忙，忘了带手绢。
In her hurried departure she had forgotten her handkerchief.

陈世龙只要她手一动，便知道她要什么，
A movement of her hand was enough for Chen to see what she needed.

从袖子里取出自己的一方白杭纺手绢，悄悄塞了过去。
He quietly took a white Hangzhou-silk handkerchief from his sleeve and slipped it to her.

看手绢雪白，仿佛还未用过，阿珠正在需要，便也不客气了。
It looked spotless, almost unused, and as she needed it she accepted without ceremony.

擦脸时，她闻到了一股陌生的气味。
As she wiped her face, she noticed an unfamiliar scent.

她一时有些出神，心里生出一种自己也说不清的情绪。
For a moment she was lost in thoughts and feelings she could not quite explain.

她把手绢拿在手里，途中偶尔用来擦汗，一直走到大经门口才还给他。
She kept the handkerchief in her hand, occasionally using it to wipe away the sweat, and returned it only when they reached Dajing's entrance.


大经丝行里堆满了打成包的“七里丝”，
The silk firm was piled high with bales of Qili silk.

黄仪和老张正在点数算总帐。
Huang and Old Zhang were counting them and working out the total accounts.

陈世龙和阿珠去得正好，堆在后面容房里的丝，就归他们帮忙。
Chen and A’zhu arrived at just the right time to help with the silk stacked in the guest rooms at the rear.

于是阵世龙点数，阿珠记帐，
Chen counted, and A’zhu kept the record.

忙到天黑，还没有点完，阿珠提醒他说：“你该到衙门里去了！
They were still not finished at dusk when she reminded him, “You ought to go to the yamen.

点不完的，晚上再来点。”
We can count the rest tonight.”

看样子一时真个点不完了，陈世龙只得歇手，赶到知府衙门，接着胡雪岩一起到了张家。
Seeing that the work would indeed take longer, Chen stopped and hurried to the prefectural yamen, then accompanied Hu to the Zhang house.

等胡雪岩刚刚宽衣坐定，捧着一杯茶在手，老张手持一张单子，来请他看帐：
Hu had only just taken off his outer robe, sat down, and received a cup of tea when Old Zhang brought a sheet of figures.

“确数虽还没有点完，约数已经有了，大概八百五十包左右，
“We haven't finished the exact count, but we have an estimate: about eight hundred and fifty bales.

连水脚在内，每包成本，总要合成番洋二百八十块左右。”
Including freight, each bale will cost around two hundred and eighty foreign silver dollars.

他说，“这票货色，已经二十万两银子的本钱下去了。”胡雪岩便问陈世龙：“八百五十包，每包二百八十块番洋，总数该多少？”
We've already put two hundred thousand taels into this shipment.” Hu asked Chen, “Eight hundred and fifty bales at two hundred and eighty dollars each—what does that come to?”

“二十三万八。”陈世龙很快地回答。
“Two hundred and thirty-eight thousand,” Chen answered promptly.

胡雪岩等了一下：
Hu paused.

“不错！”他又问老张：“可晓得这几天洋庄的行情，有没有涨落。”
“Correct.” Then he asked Old Zhang, “Do you know whether prices paid by the foreign firms have changed these last few days?”

“没有什么变动。”
“No real change.”

“还是三百块左右。
“Still around three hundred dollars.

照这样算，每包可以赚二十，也不过一万七千五。”
That gives us twenty per bale, only seventeen thousand five hundred in all.”

“这也不少了。
“That's a considerable sum!

一笔生意就赚番洋一万七千多！”
More than seventeen thousand foreign dollars on a single deal!”


老张老实，易于满足。
Honest Old Zhang was easily satisfied.

胡雪岩觉得跟他无可深谈。
Hu felt that there was little point in discussing the matter deeply with him.

想了想，只这样说道：“反正大经的佣金是您赚的。
After a moment's thought, he merely said, “Whatever happens, Dajing's commission is yours to earn.

老张，不管怎么样，你是大经的老板，
Old Zhang, you're the proprietor of Dajing in any case.

你那条船可以卖掉了。”
You can sell that boat of yours.”

老张莫名其妙，
Old Zhang was bewildered.

不知道他何以要说这话？
Why say that?

陈世龙心里却明白，这是胡雪岩表示，将来就是不做亲戚，他仍旧要帮老张的忙。
Chen, however, understood: Hu was making clear that, even if they did not become relatives, he would continue to help Old Zhang.

如果这是他的真心话，为人倒真是厚道了！
If sincere, that was truly generous.

“船也不必卖掉，
“There's no need to sell the boat,” Old Zhang answered.

你来来去去也方便些。”
“It makes your journeys easier.”

“这也好。”
“Very well.

胡雪岩又说，“不过你自己不必再管船上的事了。
But you needn't concern yourself with the boat any longer.

应该把全副精神对付丝行。
Put all your energy into the silk firm.

可惜，世龙帮不上你的忙！”
It's a pity Shilong can't help you.”

“怎么呢？”
“Why not?”

老张有些着慌，
Old Zhang grew alarmed.

“没有世龙帮忙，你再不在湖州，我一个人怕照顾不到。
“Without him, and with you away from Huzhou, I'm afraid I can't manage alone.

黄先生，说句实话，我吃不住他。”
To tell the truth, I can't keep Mr Huang in hand.”


老张慌张，胡雪岩却泰然得很，
Old Zhang was anxious, but Hu remained perfectly calm.

这些事在他根本不算难题，
Such matters were no difficulty to him.

同时他此刻又有了新的念头，要略为想一想，所以微笑着不作答复。
Besides, a new idea had occurred to him and needed a little thought, so he merely smiled without answering.

老实的老张，只当他不以为然，
Honest Old Zhang took this for disbelief.

黄仪有些霸道的地方，是他亲身所体验到的，但说出来是在背后讲人坏话，他觉得道义有亏，
He had personally experienced Huang's domineering ways, but to describe them behind the man's back seemed disloyal.

不说，看胡雪岩的样子不相信。
Yet silence would leave Hu unconvinced.

那怎么办呢？
What could he do?

只有找个证人出来。
Find a witness.

“黄先生为人如何？世龙也知道的。”
“Shilong knows what Mr Huang is like.”

他眼望着陈世龙说：“请你说给胡先生听听。”
Looking at Chen, he said, “Please explain to Mr Hu.”

“不必！”
“No need!”

胡雪岩摇着手说：
Hu waved this aside.

“我看也看得出来。
“I can see for myself.

说句实话，这趟我到湖州来，事事圆满。就是这位仁兄，我还没有把他收服。
To be honest, everything on this visit to Huzhou has gone well except this gentleman: I haven't yet brought him into line.

你当然吃不住他，不过有人吃得住他，
Naturally, you can't control him, but someone can.

你请放心好了，
Don't worry.

反正眼前也没有什么事了，
For the moment there's nothing urgent.

等你从上海回来再说。”
We'll discuss it when you return from Shanghai.”

“那时候怎么样？”
“What will happen then?”

“那时候……”
“Then...”

他看了看陈世龙说，
Hu glanced at Chen.

“我自有极妥当的办法，包你称心如意。”
“I'll have an excellent arrangement, one that will satisfy you completely.”


他们在谈话，阿珠一面摆碗筷，一面留心在听。
While they talked, A’zhu laid out bowls and chopsticks and listened carefully.

她心里在想，最妥当的办法，就是不用黄仪，让陈世龙来帮忙。
She thought the best arrangement would be to dispense with Huang and have Chen help instead.

但是，她也听说过，胡雪岩预备让陈世龙学洋文，将来在上海“坐庄”，专管跟外国人打交道。
But she had also heard that Hu intended Chen to learn a foreign language and eventually represent the firm in Shanghai, dealing exclusively with foreigners.

这也是一项要紧的职司，胡雪岩未见得肯如此安排。
That was an important position too, and Hu might not be willing to change his plans.

那么除些以外，还有什么妥当的安排？
What other satisfactory arrangement could there be?

她的这个想法，恰好与胡雪岩相同，但他只字不提，因为时机未到。
Her idea happened to be exactly the same as Hu's, but he said nothing because the time was not yet ripe.

这时候，大家一起团团坐下吃饭，
They now sat down together to eat.

胡雪岩上坐，左首老张，右首陈世龙。
Hu occupied the place of honour, Old Zhang sat to his left, and Chen to his right.

下方是她们母女俩的位子。
The seats at the lower end were for A’zhu and her mother.

阿珠的娘还在厨房里，阿珠一坐坐在右首，恰好靠近陈世龙。
Her mother was still in the kitchen, and A’zhu took the right-hand seat, next to Chen.

“来端菜！”因为爱珍临时被遣上街买东西去了，所以阿珠的娘，高声在厨房里喊。
“Come and fetch the dishes!” her mother called from the kitchen, Aizhen having been sent out on an errand.

听这一喊，却是陈世龙先起身，
Chen was the first to rise.

阿珠便很自然地把他一位：
Quite naturally, A’zhu caught his arm.

“你坐在那里，
“Stay where you are.

我去。”
I'll go.”

陈世龙还是跟着去了，
He followed her nevertheless.

两个人同出同进，也不知道他在路上说了什么？阿珠只是在笑。
They went back and forth together, and whatever he said along the way kept making her laugh.

胡雪岩一面跟老张喝酒，一面眼角瞟过来，心里有些好笑。
Drinking with Old Zhang, Hu watched them out of the corner of his eye and was quietly amused.


吃完饭，略坐一坐，胡雪岩又要走了，说还有事要跟郁四商量。
After dinner and a short rest, Hu rose to leave again, saying he still had something to discuss with Yu.

阿珠和她娘听这一说，怏怏之意，现于颜色，
Disappointment showed on the faces of both women.

她们都似乎有许多话要跟他谈，但细想一想，却又没有一句话是紧要而非在此刻说不可的，
They seemed to have a great deal to say to him, yet on reflection neither could find a single matter so urgent that it must be raised now.

便只好放他走了。
They could only let him go.

“杭州见面了。”胡雪岩就这么一句话告别。
“We'll meet in Hangzhou,” was his entire farewell.

等走到门口，阿珠的娘赶上来喊住他问：
At the door, A’zhu's mother caught up and called him back.

“那么，啥时候再到湖州来？”
“When will you come to Huzhou again?”

“现在哪里说得定？”
“How can I say just now?”

阿珠的娘回身看了一下，
She glanced behind her.

阿珠不在旁边，
A’zhu was not nearby.

便又说道：“那件事，您放在心上。
“Keep that matter in mind.

今年要办了它。”
It must be settled this year.”

“对，对！”胡雪岩答道：
“Yes, yes,” Hu replied.

“今年年里，一定热热闹闹办喜事。
“Before this year is out, there will certainly be a splendid wedding.

那时我一定要来。
I'll definitely come for it.”

“如果是做新郎官，当然一定要来，
If he was to be the groom, of course he must come.

何消说得？
Why say so?

阿珠的娘觉得他的话奇怪，却做梦也没有想到，胡雪岩已经不是她的“女婿”了。
His words struck her as odd, but never in her dreams did she imagine that Hu was no longer her prospective son-in-law.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（上）》第十一章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume I — Chapter Eleven, first part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第十一章｜CHAPTER ELEVEN


王有龄的船到杭州，仍旧泊在万安桥。
Wang Youling’s boats reached Hangzhou and moored once more at Wan’an Bridge.

来时风光，与去时又不大相同。
His return was rather more splendid than his departure had been.

去时上任，仪制未备，不过两号官船，数面旗牌，
When he left to take up his appointment, his official establishment was not yet complete: he had only two government boats and a few flags and insignia.

这一次回省，共有五只大号官船，隶役侍应，旗帜鲜明。
Now he returned to the provincial capital with five large official boats, attendants and servants in attendance, and bright banners flying.

未到码头，仁和、钱塘两县已派了差役在岸上照应，驱散闲人，静等泊岸，
Before he reached the landing, runners sent by the counties of Renhe and Qiantang were already on shore, clearing away onlookers and waiting to receive him.

坐上大轿，径回公馆。
He stepped into a large sedan chair and went directly to his residence.

胡雪岩却不忙回家，
Hu Xueyan, however, was in no hurry to go home.

一乘小轿直接来到阜康，
A small sedan carried him straight to Fukang.

他事先并无消息，所以这一到，刘庆生颇感意外。
He had sent no advance notice, so Liu Qingsheng was rather surprised to see him.

胡雪岩原是故意如此，叫他猝不及防，才好看出刘庆生一手经理之下的阜康，是怎么个样子。
That was deliberate: by arriving unexpectedly, Hu could see how the bank was being run under Liu’s sole management.

因此，他一面谈路上和湖州的情形，一面很自然地把视线扫来扫去，
As he talked about the journey and affairs in Huzhou, he let his gaze move naturally about the shop.

店堂里的情形，大致都看清楚了，
He soon had a fair impression of everything.

伙计接待顾客，也还客气，兑换银钱的生意，也还不少，
The assistants were courteous to customers, and the exchange business in silver and copper cash was reasonably brisk.

所以对刘庆生觉得满意。
He was pleased with Liu.


“麟藩台的两万银子，已经还了五千……”
“Of the twenty thousand taels lent to Treasurer Lin, five thousand have already been repaid...”

刘庆生把这些日子以来的业务情形，作了个简略的报告。然后请胡雪岩看帐。
Liu gave a brief report of business during Hu’s absence, then invited him to examine the accounts.

“不必看了。”胡雪岩问道：
“There is no need,” Hu replied.

“帐上应该结存的现银有多少？”
“What balance of ready money should the books show?”

“总帐在这里，”
“Here is the general ledger.”

刘庆生翻看帐簿，
Liu consulted it.

说结存的现银，包括立刻可以兑现的票子，一共七万五千多银子。
Including notes that could be cashed immediately, the available balance was a little over seventy-five thousand taels.

“三天以内要付出去的有多少？”
“How much must be paid out within the next three days?”

“三万不到。”
“Less than thirty thousand.”

“明天呢？”胡雪岩又问。
“And tomorrow?”

“明天没有要付的。”
“Nothing is due tomorrow.”

“那好！”胡雪岩说，
“Good.

“我提七万银子，
I shall take seventy thousand taels.

只要用一天好了。”
I need it for only one day.”

说着拿笔写了一张提银七万两的条子，递了过去。
Hu took up a brush, wrote an order for the withdrawal, and handed it over.

他这是一个试探，要看看刘庆生的帐目与结存是不是相符？
This was a test of whether Liu’s actual holdings matched his accounts.

如果叫他拿库存出来看，显得对人不相信，所以玩了这么一记小小的花样。
To demand to see the reserves would suggest distrust, so Hu had devised this little stratagem.

等刘庆生毫不迟疑地开了保险箱，点齐七万两的客票送到他手里，
Without the slightest hesitation, Liu opened the strongbox, counted out seventy thousand taels in customers’ bank drafts, and placed them in his hands.

他又说了：“今天用出去，明天就可以收回来。
“I shall use these today and get the money back tomorrow,” Hu said.

你放心，不会耽误后天的用途。
“Do not worry; it will not interfere with the payments due the day after.

说不定用不到七万，
I may not need all seventy thousand.

我是多备些。“
I am merely allowing a margin.”


就这么片刻的工夫，他已经神不知、鬼不觉地把刘庆生的操守和才干，考察了一番。
In those few moments, without anyone suspecting it, Hu had tested both Liu’s integrity and his ability.

回家拜见了老母，正在跟妻子谈此行的成就，王有龄派人来请，
He went home to pay his respects to his mother and was telling his wife of the results of his journey when a messenger arrived from Wang.

说有要紧事商量，请他即刻到王家见面。
There was an urgent matter to discuss; would he come at once?

到得王家，已经晚上九点钟了。
It was already nine in the evening when Hu reached Wang’s house.

王有龄正在书房里踱方步，
Wang was pacing his study.

一见胡雪岩就皱着眉说：
At the sight of him, he frowned.

“搞了件意想不到的差使，
“I have been given a quite unexpected assignment.

要到新城去一趟。”
I must go to Xincheng.”

新城又称新登，是杭州府属的一县，在富阳与桐庐之间，
Xincheng, also known as Xindeng, was a county under Hangzhou Prefecture, between Fuyang and Tonglu.

那一条富春江以严子陵的钓台得名，风光明媚，是骚人墨客歌咏留连的胜区，
That stretch of the Fuchun River, famous for Yan Ziling’s fishing terrace, was a place of beautiful scenery where poets and writers loved to linger.

但新城却是个小小的山城。
Xincheng itself, however, was only a small mountain town.

湖州府署理知府，跑到那儿去干什么？
What could the acting prefect of Huzhou have to do there?

“莫非奉委审案子？”胡雪岩问。
“Have you been commissioned to try a case?” Hu asked.

“案子倒是有件案子，不是去审问。”王有龄答道：
“There is a case, but I am not being sent to hear it.

“新城有个和尚，聚众抗粮，
A monk in Xincheng has gathered people to resist the grain tax.

黄抚台要我带兵去剿办。”
Governor Huang wants me to take troops and suppress them.”


听得这话，胡雪岩大吃一惊，
Hu was greatly alarmed.

“这不是当耍的事。”
“This is no matter to trifle with.

他问，“雪公，你带过兵没有？”
Mr Xuexuan, have you ever commanded troops?”

“这倒不关紧要，
“That is not the main difficulty.

我从前随老太爷在云南任上，带亲兵抓过作乱的苗子。
When I was with my father during his appointment in Yunnan, I led his bodyguard to arrest Miao tribesmen who had rebelled.

不过这情形是不同的，
But this is a different situation.

听说新城的民风强悍得很。
I hear that the people of Xincheng are exceptionally fierce.”

“凡是山城的百姓，总以强悍的居多。新城这地方，尤其与众不同，
The inhabitants of mountain towns generally tended to be tough and combative, and Xincheng was particularly so.

那里在五代钱武肃王的时候，出过一个名人，叫做罗隐，
During the Five Dynasties, in the time of King Qian Wusu, it had produced a celebrated man named Luo Yin.

在两浙和江西，福建的民间，“罗隐秀才”的名气甚大，
Among ordinary people in the two Zhe regions, Jiangxi, and Fujian, “Scholar Luo Yin” enjoyed great fame.

据说出语成谶，言必有中，而他本人亦多奇行异事。
His words were said to foretell events without fail, and many strange deeds and stories were associated with him.

新城的民风，继承了他的那股傲岸倔强之气，所以很不容易对付。
The people of Xincheng had inherited something of his proud, stubborn spirit and were therefore far from easy to handle.


“是啊！”胡雪岩答道：
“Yes,” Hu said.

“这很麻烦。
“This is troublesome.

和尚聚众抗粮，可知是个不安分的人。
A monk who gathers a crowd to resist taxes is plainly a restless fellow.

如果带了兵去，说不定激成民变。
If you take troops there, you may provoke a popular uprising.

雪公，你要慎重。”
You must be careful.”

“我所怕的正就是这一点。
“That is precisely what I fear.

再说，一带兵去，那情形……”
Besides, once soldiers are sent in...”

王有龄大摇其头，
Wang shook his head vigorously.

“越发糟糕！”
“It will be worse still.”

这话胡雪岩懂。
Hu understood.

绿营兵丁，已到了不可救药的地步，真正是“兵不如匪”，
The Green Standard troops had deteriorated beyond remedy; the soldiers were truly worse than bandits.

一带队下去，地方老百姓行就遭殃。
Wherever a detachment was sent, the local people suffered.

想到这一天，胡雪岩觉得事有可为。
Thinking of this, Hu saw a possible way forward.

“雪公！随便什么地方，总有明事理的人。
“Mr Xuexuan, wherever you go, there are always reasonable people.

照我看。兵以不动为妙，
In my opinion, it would be best to keep the troops where they are.

你不妨单枪匹马，到新城找着地方上有声望的绅士，把利害关系说明白。
You might go to Xincheng yourself, find respected local gentlemen, and explain the consequences clearly.

此事自然能够化解。”
The trouble should then be capable of settlement.”

“话是不错。”
“That is sound advice.”

王有龄放低了声音说，
Wang lowered his voice.

“为难的是，大事化小，小事化无还不够。
“The difficulty is that reducing a large disturbance to a small one, and then making it disappear altogether, will not be enough.

上头的意思是，现在各地风声都很紧，怕刁民学样捣乱，
The authorities fear that, with unrest everywhere, other troublemakers will imitate this example.

非要严办祸首不可。”
They insist on severe punishment for the ringleaders.”

“不管是严是宽，那是第二步的事！”
“Whether to be severe or lenient is a matter for the second stage.”

“对！”
“Exactly!”

王有龄一下领悟了，
Wang understood at once.

不管怎么样，要眼前先把局势平服了下来，
Whatever else was to be done, the immediate situation must first be brought under control.

才能谈得到第二步。
Only then could they consider the next step.

他想了想，站起身来说，
He thought for a moment and rose.

“我要去拜个客，先作一番部署。”
“I must pay someone a visit and make a preliminary arrangement.”


“拜哪个？”
“Whom are you going to see?”

“魁参将。
“Commander Kui.

他原来驻防嘉兴，现在调到省城。
He was formerly stationed at Jiaxing and has now been transferred to the provincial capital.

黄抚台派他带兵跟我到新城，
Governor Huang has ordered him to lead the troops accompanying me to Xincheng.

我得跟他商量一下。”
I must discuss matters with him.”

“雪公，你预备怎么跟他说？”
“What do you intend to say?”

“我把以安抚为先的宗旨告诉他，请他听我的招呼出队，
“I shall explain that conciliation comes first and ask him to wait for my instructions before marching.

不能胡来。”
He must not act recklessly.”

“叫他不出队，怕办不到。”胡雪岩说，
“It may be difficult to keep him from marching,” Hu said.

“绿营兵一听见这种差使，都当发财的机会到了。
“Whenever Green Standard soldiers hear of such an assignment, they think their chance to make money has come.

哪里肯听你的话？”
Why should they listen to you?”

“那么照你说，该怎么办呢？”
“Then what do you suggest?”

“总要许他点好处。”
“You must offer him some advantage.

胡雪岩说，“现在不是求他出队，是求他不要出队。”
What you need from him now is not that he march, but that he refrain from marching.”

“万一安抚不下来，还是要靠他。”
“If conciliation fails, I shall still have to rely on him.”

王有龄点点头，下了个转语：
Wang nodded, then reconsidered.

“不过，你的话确是‘一针见血’，
“Still, you have put your finger on the matter.

我先许了他的好处，那就收发由心，
If I promise him a reward first, I can then move him forward or hold him back as I choose.

都听我的指挥了。”
He will obey my direction.”


当夜王有龄去拜访了魁参将，
That night Wang visited Commander Kui.

答应为他在黄抚台那里请饷，将来事情平定以后，“保案”中一定把他列为首功。
He promised to apply to Governor Huang for funds for the troops and, once the affair was settled, to place Kui first on the list recommended for rewards.

但希望他听自己的话，实在是要他听自己的指挥。
In return, he hoped Kui would listen to him—which really meant submit to his command.

魁参将见王有龄很知趣，很爽快地答应照办。
Seeing that Wang understood how things should be managed, Kui agreed readily.

由于王有龄遭遇了这么一件意外的差使，把他原来的计划都打乱了，
This unexpected assignment overturned all Wang’s original plans.

该办的事无法分身，只有胡雪岩帮他的忙。
He could not divide himself among his other duties and had to rely on Hu’s help.

首先是藩司衙门的公事要紧，
Business with the provincial treasurer’s yamen came first.

胡雪岩用他从阜康取来的客票，解入藩库，
Hu used fifty thousand taels of the customers’ drafts withdrawn from Fukang to make the payment into the provincial treasury.

把湖州带来，由郁四调来的五万银票，连同多下的两万，一起还了给刘庄生。
He then returned to Liu Qingsheng the fifty thousand taels in banknotes brought from Huzhou and supplied by Yu Si, together with the twenty thousand left from his withdrawal.

此外还有许多王有龄个人的应酬，何处该送礼，何处该送钱，
There were also many personal obligations of Wang’s to attend to: gifts to be delivered here, money to be sent there.

胡雪岩找着刘庆生帮忙，两个人整整奔走了一天，算是都办妥了。
Hu enlisted Liu’s help, and the two spent an entire day rushing about before everything was finally arranged.


“这就该忙我自己的事了。”胡雪岩把经手的事项，一一向王有龄交代过后，这样对他说，
“Now I must attend to my own affairs,” Hu said after reporting each item to Wang.

“我赤手空拳做出来的市面，现在都该要有个着落。
“I have built up this business from nothing, and it must now begin to produce results.

命脉都在这几船丝上面，
Everything depends on those boatloads of silk.

一点大意不得。”
I cannot afford the slightest carelessness.”

王有龄哑然。
Wang fell silent.

他此刻到新城，也等于赤手空拳，
He, too, would be going to Xincheng with little to rely on.

至少要有个心腹在身边，遇到疑难危急的时候，也有个人可以商量。
At the very least, he wanted a trusted man beside him, someone with whom he could discuss a difficulty or an emergency.

但胡雪岩既已做了这样的表示，而且也知道这一次的丝生意，对他的关系极大，
But Hu had made his position clear, and Wang knew how much this silk venture meant to him.

所以原想留他帮忙的话，这时候就无论如何说不出口了。
He could no longer bring himself to ask Hu to stay and help.

他的失望无奈的神色，胡雪岩自然看得出来。
Hu naturally saw his disappointment and helplessness.

心里在想：这真叫爱莫能助！
He thought, with genuine regret, that there was nothing he could do.

第一，实在抽不出空，
First, he truly had no time to spare.

第二，新城地方不熟，
Second, he knew nothing of Xincheng.

第三，带兵出队，动刀动枪的事，也真有点“吓势势”，
Third, leading troops and dealing with swords and guns was a distinctly alarming business.

还是不必多事为妙。
Better not to involve himself unnecessarily.

因为如此，他就不去打听这件事了。
He therefore asked no more about the matter.

管自己跟张胖子和刘庆生去碰头，把他到上海这个把月中，需要料理或者联络的事，都作了妥帖的安排。
Instead, he met Fat Zhang and Liu and made careful arrangements for everything that would need attention or communication during his month or so in Shanghai.

三天工夫过去，
Three days passed.

丝船到了杭州，陈世龙陪着老张到阜康来报到。
The silk boats reached Hangzhou, and Chen Shilong accompanied Old Zhang to Fukang to report their arrival.


问起路上的情形，陈世龙说一路都很顺利，
Asked about the journey, Chen said that everything had gone smoothly.

不过听到许多消息，
They had, however, heard a great deal of news.

各地聚众抗粮的纠纷，层出不穷，谣言极盛，
Disturbances involving organized resistance to grain taxes were breaking out everywhere, and rumours were rife.

都非好兆。
None of it was a good sign.

因此，他劝胡雪岩当夜就下船，第二天一早动身，早早赶到松江地界，
He urged Hu to board that very night and set off early next morning, reaching the Songjiang district as soon as possible.

有尤五“保镖”就可以放心了。
With You Laowu there to protect them, they could feel secure.

“世龙兄这话很实在。
“Brother Shilong’s advice is sound,” Liu said.

胡先生早到早好。
“The sooner Mr Hu arrives, the better.

今天晚上我做个小东，给胡先生送行。”
Let me give a modest farewell dinner tonight.”

刘庆生又面邀老张和陈世龙说：
He turned to Zhang and Chen.

“也是替你们两位送行。”
“And for you two as well.”

“既如此，你就再多请一位‘堂客’。”
“In that case, invite one more guest—a lady.”

“是，是。”
“Certainly, certainly.”

刘庆生知道胡雪岩指的是阿珠，
Liu knew that Hu meant A’zhu.

“今天夜里的月亮还很好，
“The moon will still be lovely tonight.

我请大家到西湖上去逛逛。”
I shall take everyone for an outing on West Lake.”

“一天到晚坐船也坐厌了。”胡雪岩笑道，
“One grows tired of boats after sitting in them all day,” Hu said with a smile.

“还是去逛城隍山的好。”
“Let us go to City God Hill instead.”

“就是城隍山！
“City God Hill it shall be.

主从客便。”刘庆生问老张：“令媛在船上？”
The host follows his guests’ wishes.” Liu asked Zhang, “Is your daughter on the boat?”

“是的，
“Yes.

我去接她。”
I shall fetch her.”

“何必你自己去？”胡雪岩说，
“Why go yourself?” Hu said.

“叫世龙走一趟，先接她到这里来再说。”
“Let Shilong make the trip and bring her here first.”


听得这话，陈世龙连声答应着，站起来就走。
Chen agreed at once and hurried off.

等了有个把时辰，两乘小轿，抬到门前，
About two hours later, two small sedan chairs arrived outside.

阿珠走下轿来，只见她破例着条绸裙子，
A’zhu stepped down, wearing, unusually, a silk skirt.

但盈尺莲船，露在裙幅外面。走起路来，裙幅摆动得很厉害，
Her large, unbound feet showed beneath its hem, and the skirt swayed awkwardly as she walked.

别人还不曾摇头，她自己先不好意思地笑了：
Before anyone else could shake his head, she laughed in embarrassment.

“这条断命的裙子，
“This wretched skirt!

我真正着不惯！”
I simply cannot get used to it.”

“那你何必自己跟自己过不去，找罪来受？”胡雪岩这样笑着问。
“Then why make life difficult for yourself?” Hu asked with a smile. “Why suffer needlessly?”

“喏！
“There!

都是他。”
It is all his doing.”

他是指陈世龙。阿珠一面说，一面拿手指着，眼风自然而然地瞟了过去。
She meant Chen Shilong, pointing at him and naturally glancing in his direction.

话中虽带着埋怨，脸色和声音却并无责怪之意，
Though her words sounded like a complaint, neither her voice nor her expression conveyed blame.

倒象是陈世龙怎么说，她就该怎么听似地。
It was almost as though whatever Chen said was something she ought to obey.

这微妙的神情，老张看不出来，刘庆生更是如蒙在鼓里，甚至连阿珠自己都没有觉察有什么异样，
Old Zhang did not notice this subtle change; Liu was entirely in the dark; even A’zhu herself was unaware of anything unusual.

但胡雪岩心里明白，
Hu understood, however.

向陈世龙笑了一下，没有再说下去。
He smiled at Chen and said no more.

“我们商量商量，到哪里去吃饭？”
“Let us decide where to eat,” Liu said.

刘庆生还把阿珠当做胡雪岩的心上人，特地征询她的意见：
Still regarding A’zhu as Hu’s sweetheart, he made a point of consulting her.

“ ‘皇饭儿’好不好？”
“Would Huangfan’er do?”

最好的一家本地馆子，就在城隍山脚下，
This was the finest restaurant serving local dishes, conveniently situated at the foot of City God Hill.

吃完逛山，正好顺路，自然一致同意。
They could eat and then go up the hill, so everyone agreed.

于是刘庆生作东，吃了一顿丰盛的晚饭，上城隍山去品茗纳凉。
Liu gave them a generous dinner, after which they climbed the hill to drink tea and enjoy the cool air.


这夜月明如昼，游客甚多，
The moon made the night almost as bright as day, and many people were out enjoying themselves.

树下纳凉，胡雪岩跟老张和刘庆生在谈近来的市面，阿珠和陈世龙便小声闲话。
Under the trees, Hu discussed the recent state of business with Old Zhang and Liu, while A’zhu and Chen talked quietly together.

杭州的一切，他不如她熟，所以尽是她的话，指点着山下的万家灯火，为他介绍杭州的风物。
She knew Hangzhou far better than he did, so she did most of the talking, pointing towards the myriad lights below and describing the city’s sights and customs.

到得二更将近，老张打个哈欠说：
As the second watch approached, Zhang yawned.

“回去吧！
“Time to go back.

明天一早就要动身。”
We must leave early tomorrow.”

阿珠有些恋恋不舍，但终于还是站了起来。
A’zhu was reluctant, but finally rose.

陈世龙却是一言不发，抢先下山。
Chen said nothing and hurried down the hill ahead of them.

胡雪岩心里奇怪，不知道他去干什么？这个疑团直到下山才打破，
Hu wondered what he was doing; the puzzle was solved only when they reached the bottom.

原来他是雇轿子去了。
He had gone to hire sedan chairs.

“只得两顶轿子。”陈世龙说：
“There were only two,” Chen said.

“胡先生坐一顶。”
“Mr Hu can take one.”

还有一顶呢？不用说，当然是阿珠坐。
The other was naturally for A’zhu.

胡雪岩心想，自己想是沾了她的光，
Hu thought that he was benefiting from the young man’s attentions to her.

其实可以不必，我家甚近，不妨安步当车。
There was really no need: his own house was close by, and he could comfortably walk.

阿珠父女回船的路相当远，不如让他们坐了去。
A’zhu and her father had much farther to go to reach their boat; better to let them take the chairs.

“我要托世龙帮我收拾行李，我们先走，
“I want Shilong to help me with my luggage, so we shall go on ahead.

轿子你们坐了去。”
You two take the chairs.”

胡雪岩又对刘庆生拱拱手说：
He clasped his hands to Liu.

“你也请回去吧！”
“You should go home too.”

“好的。
“Very well.

明天一早我来送行。”
I shall come early tomorrow to see you off.”


于是五个人分做三路。
The five separated into three parties.

胡雪岩把陈世龙带到家。
Hu took Chen home.

胡家大非昔比了，
The household was very different from what it had once been.

胡太太很能干，
His wife was a capable woman.

在丈夫到湖州去的一个月中，收拾得门庭焕然，还用了一个老妈子，一个打杂的男工，
During the month he had spent in Huzhou, she had transformed the appearance of the place and hired an older maid and a man to do odd jobs.

这时还都在等候“老爷”回家。
Both were still waiting for “the master” to return.

“行李都收拾好了。”打杂的男工阿福，向“老爷”交代：
“Your luggage is packed,” the manservant, A’fu, reported.

“约了两个挑夫在那里，
“I have arranged for two porters.

行李是不是今天晚上就发下船，还是明天一早挑了去。”
Should they take it down to the boat tonight or first thing tomorrow?”

胡雪岩觉得阿福很会办事，十分满意，
Hu was very pleased with his efficiency.

但他还未接口，陈世龙就先说了：
Before he could answer, however, Chen spoke.

“今天晚上下船！
“Tonight.

回头我带了挑伕去，也省得你走一趟。
I shall go with the porters presently and save you the journey.”

这样说停当，阿福立刻去找挑伕，
With that settled, A’fu went to fetch the men.

趁这片刻闲空，胡雪岩问道：“一路上，阿珠怎么样？”
Taking advantage of the brief interval, Hu asked, “How was A’zhu on the journey?”

这话让陈世龙很难回答，
Chen found this difficult to answer.

虽已取得默契，却不便自道如何向阿珠献殷勤？
They had an understanding, but he could hardly describe his attentions to her.

想了想答道：“我都照胡先生的话做。”
After a moment’s thought, he said, “I did everything as you instructed.”

“好！”胡雪岩说，
“Good.

“你就照这样子做好了。
Carry on in that way.

不过生意上也要当心。”
But you must pay attention to the business as well.”


这是警告他，不要陷溺在阿珠的巧笑娇语之中。
This was a warning not to lose himself in A’zhu’s smiles and conversation.

这言外之意，陈世龙当然懂，
Chen understood the implication.

到底年纪还轻，脸有些红了。但此刻不能装糊涂，
He was still young and blushed slightly, but this was no time to pretend ignorance.

事实上他也一直在找这样一个可以表示忠心的机会，
In fact, he had been looking for just such an opportunity to express his loyalty.

所以用极诚恳坦率的声音答道：
He answered with complete sincerity and openness.

“胡先生，你尽管请放心，
“You may be entirely at ease, Mr Hu.

江湖上我虽少跑，江湖义气总晓得的，
I have not travelled much in the world, but I understand loyalty between men.

胡先生这样子待我，我拆烂污对不起胡先生，将来在外面还要混不要混？”
After the way you have treated me, if I let you down by making a mess of things, how could I ever show my face again?”

“对！”
“Exactly.”

胡雪岩颇为嘉许，
Hu was approving.

“你能看到这一点，就见得你脑子清楚。
“The fact that you can see that shows you have a clear head.

我劝你在生意上巴结，不光是为我，是为你自己。
I urge you to work hard at the business for your own sake, not merely for mine.

你最多拆我两次烂污，
You could let me down at most twice.

第一次我原谅你，第二次对不起，要请你卷铺盖了，
The first time I would forgive you; the second, I am sorry, you would have to pack your bedding and go.

如果烂污拆碍太过，连我都收不了场，那时候该杀该剐，也是你去。
If you made such a mess that even I could not put it right, whatever punishment followed would be yours to bear.

不过你要晓得，也有人连一次烂污都不准人拆的，
But remember that some people will not forgive even one failure.

只要有这么一次，你就吃不开了。”
Let them down once, and you are finished.”

他这番话，等于定了个规约，让陈世龙清清楚楚地明白了他对待手下的态度。
This amounted to a set of rules, making clear how Hu treated those who worked for him.

不过陈世龙，绝没有半点因为可容许拆一次烂污而有恃无恐的心思，相反地，这时候暗暗下了决心，在生意上非要规规矩矩地做个样子来给胡雪岩看不可。
Far from feeling safe because one failure might be forgiven, Chen privately resolved to show Hu that he could conduct himself properly in business.

“胡先生如果没有别的吩咐，我就走了。”
“If there are no further instructions, I shall leave.

他又问：“明天一早，要不要来接？”
Shall I come to fetch you early tomorrow?”

“不必，不必！
“No, no.

我自己会去的。”
I shall find my own way.”


等陈世龙一走，胡雪岩也就睡了。
Once Chen had gone, Hu went to bed.

临别前夕，夫妇俩自然有许多话要说，
On the eve of his departure, husband and wife naturally had much to say.

谈到半夜，
They talked until midnight.

人是倦了，却不能安心入梦，
By then he was tired, but could not settle to sleep.

心绪零乱，一直在想王有龄，担心他到新城，生命有没有危险，
His thoughts were confused and kept returning to Wang: would his life be in danger at Xincheng?

公事会不会顺利？
Would the assignment go smoothly?

“怎么这时候才来？
“Why are you so late?

太阳都好高了！”
The sun is already high!”

阿珠一见胡雪岩上船，就这样埋怨地问。
A’zhu complained as soon as he stepped aboard the next morning.

“一夜没有睡着。”
“I did not sleep all night.

胡雪岩答道：“我在担心王大老爷。”
I have been worrying about Prefect Wang.”

“王大老爷怎么样？”
“What has happened to him?”

“这时候没有工夫谈。
“There is no time to explain now.

开了船再说。”
I shall tell you once we are under way.”

解缆开船，也得要些工夫，
Even casting off and getting the boat moving took some time.

胡雪岩一个人坐在船舱里喝茶，懒得开口，
Hu sat alone in the cabin, drinking tea and reluctant to speak.

自从与王有龄重逢以来，他的情绪从没有象这样恶劣过。
Since his reunion with Wang, his spirits had never been so low.

“到底啥事情？”阿珠问道：
“What is the matter?” A’zhu asked.

“这样子愁眉不展，害得大家都不开心。”
“You look so miserable that you are making everyone else unhappy.”

听这话胡雪岩感到歉然，心情便越发沉重，
Hu felt sorry at this, which only weighed on him further.

“嗐！”
“Ah!”

他突然站起身来，
He suddenly stood up.

“我今天不走了！
“I am not leaving today.

王大老爷的公事有麻烦，
Prefect Wang has a difficult official assignment.

我走了对不起朋友。
If I go, I shall be failing a friend.

阿珠，你叫他们停船。”
A’zhu, tell them to stop the boat.”


等船一停，老张和陈世龙不约而同的搭了跳板，都来到胡雪岩舱里，查问原因。
Once the boat had stopped, Old Zhang and Chen, without consulting each other, crossed the gangplank and came into Hu’s cabin to ask why.

这时候他的心情轻松了，
Hu felt lighter now.

把王有龄奉令赴新城办案的经过说了一遍，表示非跟他在一起不可。
He explained how Wang had been ordered to deal with the Xincheng affair and said that he must be at his side.

“我事情一办好，就赶了上来，
“As soon as the matter is settled, I shall catch up with you.

行李也不必卸了。”
There is no need to unload my luggage.”

“如果事情没有办完，赶不到呢？”
“What if it is not settled in time and you cannot catch us?”

陈世龙针对这个疑问作了建议：
Chen proposed an answer to his own question.

“我们在松江等你，
“We shall wait for you at Songjiang.

有尤五照应，船上的货色决不会少。”
With You Laowu looking after us, none of the cargo will go missing.”

胡雪岩觉得这办法十分妥贴，欣然同意，
Hu thought this an excellent arrangement and readily agreed.

随即单身上岸，雇了乘小轿，直接来到王家。
He went ashore alone, hired a small sedan chair, and headed straight to Wang’s house.


王有龄家高朋满座，个个都穿着官服，
Wang’s house was full of distinguished visitors, all wearing official dress.

看样子都是“州县班子”，自然是“听鼓辕门”的候补知县。
They appeared to be the usual pool of expectant magistrates—men awaiting county appointments and answering the summons at the governor’s gates.

胡雪岩自己虽也是捐班的“大老爷”，但从未穿过补褂、戴过大帽，
Although Hu himself had purchased official rank and was therefore also entitled to be addressed as an official, he had never worn an embroidered rank badge or an official hat.

与这班官儿们见面，先得一个个请教了，才好定称呼，麻烦甚大，
To meet these men would mean asking each his name and position before deciding how to address him, an exceedingly troublesome business.

所以踏人院子，不进大厅，由廊下绕列厅房一间小客厅去休息等候。
On entering the courtyard, he therefore bypassed the main hall and followed the corridor to a small side parlour, where he could rest and wait.

等听差的捧了茶来，他悄悄问道：“你家老爷在谈什么？”
When an attendant brought tea, he quietly asked, “What is your master discussing?”

“还不是新城的事！
“The Xincheng affair, what else?

听说那和尚厉害得很，
They say that monk is a terrible fellow.

把新城的县官都杀掉了。
He has even killed the county magistrate.

为此，我们太太愁得觉都睡不着。”
Our mistress is so worried that she cannot sleep.”

胡雪岩大吃一惊！
Hu was shocked.

这一来，事情越闹越大，必不能善罢干休，
The trouble was growing far more serious; it could no longer end with a simple settlement.

王有龄真是“湿手捏了干燥面”，怕一时料理不清楚了。
Wang had indeed grasped dry flour with wet hands and might not get clear of the mess for some time.

于是他侧耳静听着，
Hu listened carefully.

不久就弄清楚了，那些候补州县，奉了抚台的委札，到王有龄这里来听候差委，
Before long he understood that these officials awaiting appointments had been sent by the governor to serve under Wang’s direction.

此刻他正召集他们在会议，商量处理的办法。
Wang had called them together to discuss how to proceed.


你一言，他一言，聚讼纷坛了半天，
They argued back and forth, one speaking over another.

只听有个人说道：“现在是抗粮事小，戕宫事大，
At last Hu heard someone say, “Resistance to the grain tax is now the lesser offence; the killing of an official is the greater.

首要各犯，朝廷决不会放松。
The court will certainly not spare the principal offenders.

我看，第一步，要派兵分守要隘，
In my view, the first step is to station troops at the strategic approaches.

第二步，才谈得到是剿、是抚，还是剿抚兼施？”
Only then should we decide whether to suppress the disturbance, conciliate the people, or combine both methods.”

胡雪岩暗暗点头，
Hu nodded to himself.

只有这个人说话还有条理，
Here, at least, was someone who spoke coherently.

外面的王有龄大概也是这样的想法，只听他说：
Wang evidently thought the same.

“高明之至。
“An excellent judgment.

我还要请教鹤翁，你看是剿呢？还是抚呢？”
May I ask further, Master He: would you recommend force or conciliation?”

“先抚后剿。”那个被称做“鹤翁”的人，答得极其爽脆。
“Conciliation first, force afterwards,” the man addressed as Master He answered crisply.

“先抚后剿，先抚后剿，这四个字的宗旨，确切不移。”王有龄很快地说：
“Conciliation first, force afterwards—that principle is exactly right,” Wang said quickly.

“我索性再请教鹤翁，
“Let me pursue the point.

能就抚自然不必出队进剿，
If conciliation succeeds, there is naturally no need to send troops in.

所以能抚还是要抚。
Wherever conciliation is possible, we must attempt it.

应该如何着手？
How should we begin?

想来必有高见。
I imagine you have a proposal.”

““倒是有点看法，
“I do have a few thoughts.

说出来请王大人指教……”
Let me put them before you for your consideration...”


胡雪岩正听到紧要地方，谁知听差奉命来请，
Hu had just reached the crucial point in his listening when the attendant came to fetch him.

说是王太太吩咐，请他到里面去坐。
Mrs Wang had asked him to come into the inner rooms.

彼此的关系，已超过“通家之好”的程度，内眷不避，
The intimacy between the two households went beyond ordinary family friendship; the women did not need to keep out of his sight.

胡雪岩便到内厅去见了王太太。
He therefore went to greet her in the inner hall.

“你看，好端端在湖州，上省一趟，就派了这么件差使！”王太太愁眉苦脸地说，
“Just think—he was perfectly well in Huzhou, and one visit to the provincial capital brings him an assignment like this!” she said miserably.

“省城里谣言很多，
“There are so many rumours in the city.

都说新城这件事，跟‘长毛’是有勾结的。
They say the Xincheng trouble is connected with the Longhairs.

那地方又在山里，
The place is in the mountains too.

雪轩一去，万一陷在里面，叫天天不应，叫地地不灵，那时候怎么办？
If Xuexuan goes there and is trapped, with no one to answer his cries for help, what are we to do?”

““不要紧，不要紧！”
“Do not worry, do not worry.”

胡雪岩为了安慰她，只好硬起头皮拍胸脯，
To comfort her, Hu could only steel himself and offer a firm assurance.

“有我在！
“I am here.

我来想办法，
I shall think of something.

包你平安。”
I promise he will be safe.”

“是啊！”
“Yes!”

王太太有惊喜之色，
Her face showed both relief and surprise.

“雪轩常说，什么事都靠你。
“Xuexuan is always saying that he relies on you in everything.

你们象弟兄一样，
You are like brothers.

你总要帮帮你哥哥的忙。”
You must help your elder brother.”

“那还用说。
“Of course.

你先请放宽了心，
Set your mind at ease for now.

等他回头开完了会，我们再来商量。”
When his meeting is over, we shall discuss it.”

于是胡雪岩便大谈王有龄在湖州的情形，公事如何顺利，地方如何爱戴，
Hu then talked at length about Wang’s life in Huzhou: how smoothly his duties were proceeding, how warmly the local people regarded him.

尽是些好听的话，让王太太好忘掉新城的案子。
Everything he said was reassuring, intended to make Mrs Wang forget the Xincheng case for a while.


谈到日中要开饭了，
They talked until it was time for the midday meal.

王太太派人到外面去催请，把王有龄催了进来，
Mrs Wang sent someone to hurry her husband in.

他一见胡雪岩便问：“你怎么没有走？”
On seeing Hu, he immediately asked, “Why have you not left?”

“把你一个人先在这里，我在船上提心吊胆，
“How could I leave you here alone and sit on the boat worrying myself sick?

雪公，你想想那是什么滋味？”
Mr Xuexuan, imagine what that would feel like.”

王有龄不知道那是什么滋味，但他知道自己的感觉跟胡雪岩做朋友，实在够味得很！
Wang could not say exactly what it would feel like, but he knew how deeply satisfying it was to have Hu for a friend.

“雪岩，”他眼睛都有些润湿了，“这才是生死患难之交！
His eyes grew moist. “Xueyan, this is friendship through life and death, through hardship and danger.

说实话，一见你的面，精神就是一振。
To tell you the truth, the very sight of you lifts my spirits.

事情是很棘手，不过你来了，我倒也不怎么怕了。”
The business is terribly difficult, but now that you are here, I am not nearly so afraid.”

玉太太听他们这一番对答，对胡雪岩的看法越发不同，
Listening to them, Mrs Wang regarded Hu with still greater esteem.

而且她也跟她丈夫一样，愁怀一政，这几天以来，第一次出现了从容的神色。
Like her husband, she felt her anxieties lift; for the first time in days, she looked composed.

“有话慢慢谈，
“You can talk at leisure later.

先吃饭！”她对王有龄说，
Eat first,” she said to Wang.

“一直觉也睡不好，饭也吃不香。
“You have been unable to sleep properly or enjoy your food.

今天可以舒舒服服吃餐饭了，
Today you can have a comfortable meal.

你们弟兄俩先吃洒，
You two brothers begin with some wine.

我做个‘红糟鸡’替你们下饭。”
I shall make chicken with red rice-wine lees to go with your rice.”

王有龄欣然赞许，对胡雪岩夸耀他太太的手艺：
Wang approved delightedly and praised his wife’s cooking to Hu.

“你尝尝内人的手段！
“You must try her skill.

跟外面福州馆子里的菜，大不相同。“
It is quite different from what you get in the Fuzhou restaurants.”


于是都变得好整以暇了，
They were all at ease now.

王有龄擎着酒杯为胡雪岩细述新城一案的来龙去脉，以及眼前的处理办法。
Wine cup in hand, Wang described the origins and development of the Xincheng affair and the measures currently proposed.

果然如胡雪岩所想象的，那些奉派听候王有龄差委的候补州县中，管用的只有那个“鹤翁”。
As Hu had suspected, among all the officials assigned to serve under Wang, the only useful one was the man addressed as Master He.

“此人名叫嵇鹤龄，真正是个人才！”王有龄说，
“His name is Ji Heling, and he is truly able,” Wang said.

“足智多谋，能言善道，
“Resourceful, full of ideas, and an excellent speaker.

如果他肯帮我的忙，虽不能高枕无忧，事情已成功了一半。”
If he would help me, I could not exactly sleep without a care, but half the task would already be accomplished.”

“喔！”胡雪岩问，“他的忙怎么帮法？”
“What help do you want from him?”

“去安抚！”王有龄说，
“To go and conciliate the people.

“新城在省的绅士，我已经碰过头了，
I have already met the Xincheng gentlemen who are in the provincial capital.

那几位异口同声表示，有个得力的人到新城就地办事，事半而功倍。
They all say that an effective man working on the spot could achieve twice as much with half the effort.

本来也是，
It stands to reason.

遇到这种情形，一定是‘不入虎穴，焉得虎子’！
In a situation like this, one cannot catch a tiger’s cub without entering its lair.

无奈能干的，胆小不敢去，胆大敢去的，又多是庸才，成事不足，败事有余。
Unfortunately, the capable men are too timid to go, while most of those bold enough to venture there are mediocrities who would do more harm than good.

除非我自己去，我不能去就得找嵇鹤龄这样的人。”
Either I must go myself, or I must find someone like Ji Heling.”


“我明白了。
“I see.

嵇鹤龄不肯去的原因何在？
Why does Ji refuse?

也是胆小？”
Is he afraid too?”

“哪里？”
“Not at all.

王有龄说，“此人有谋有勇，没有把那班扰民，放在眼里。
He has both courage and judgment and thinks little of that crowd of troublemakers.

他只是不肯去……
He simply will not go...”

“不肯去的原因是他觉得不合算。
The reason was that he did not consider it worth his while.

王有龄谈嵇鹤龄的为人，吃亏在恃才做物，
Wang explained that Ji’s weakness lay in being proud of his abilities and disdainful of others.

所以虽有才干，历任大僚都不肯或者不敢用他，
Talented though he was, successive high officials had been unwilling, or afraid, to employ him.

在浙江候补了七八年，派不上几回差使，
He had spent seven or eight years in Zhejiang waiting for an appointment and had received very few assignments.

因而牢骚极多。
He was consequently full of grievances.

“他跟人家表示：”三年派不上一趟差，
“He told someone, ‘Three years can pass without my being sent on a single errand.

有了差使，好的轮不着，要送命的让我去。
When there is an assignment, the good ones never come to me; the one that may cost a man his life is mine.

我为何这么傻？
Why should I be such a fool?

老实说，都为王某某还是个肯办事、脑筋清楚的，我才说几句。
To be frank, I spoke only because this Wang fellow is willing to get things done and has a clear head.

不然，我连口都懒得开。‘“王有龄说：”今天这一会，其实毫无影响，
Otherwise I should not even have bothered opening my mouth.’” Wang continued, “Today’s meeting has achieved nothing.

我一直在动脑筋的是，设法说动嵇鹤龄，谁知劳而无功！“
All the time I was trying to think of some way to persuade Ji Heling, but my efforts came to nothing.”


“重赏之下，必有勇夫！
“A generous reward will always find a brave man.

雪公，你的条件开得不够吧？”
Perhaps you have not offered enough?”

“根本谈不上！
“We never get as far as that.

嵇鹤龄穷得你们杭州人说的‘嗒嗒嘀’，
Ji is as poor as you Hangzhou people mean when you say a man has nothing whatever.

但就是不肯哭穷，不谈钱，
Yet he refuses to plead poverty or discuss money.

你拿他有什么办法？”
What can one do?”

工有龄停了一下又说体谅的话，
Wang paused, then spoke more sympathetically.

“想想也难怪，
“On reflection, I can hardly blame him.

八月半就要到了，要付的帐还没有着落，
The Mid-Autumn Festival is almost here, and he has no means of paying the bills that fall due.

转眼秋风一起，冬天的衣服还在长生库里。
Soon the autumn winds will rise, and his winter clothes are still in the pawnshop.

听说他最近悼亡，留下一大堆孩子要照应。
I hear he has recently lost his wife and has a whole brood of children to look after.

心境既不好，又分不开身，
His spirits are low and he cannot get away.

也实在难怪他不肯帮忙。”
It is really no wonder that he will not help.”

“那就只有我去了。”胡雪岩说。
“Then I shall have to go,” Hu said.

“你我是一样的。”
“You and I are the same in this.

王有龄说：“我不能去，当然也不能让你去。”
If I cannot go, I certainly cannot send you.”

“既如此，雪公，你要我做点什么？”胡雪岩已有所领会，特意这样问一句。
Hu had begun to understand what Wang wanted, but deliberately asked, “In that case, what would you like me to do?”

“你看，雪岩，怎么想个办法，能让嵇鹤龄欣然应请，到新城去走一趟？”
“Can you think of some way, Xueyan, to make Ji Heling willingly accept the invitation and go to Xincheng?”


胡雪岩不即作答，
Hu did not answer immediately.

慢慢喝着酒盘算。
He drank slowly and considered.

这个征兆不好，
This was not a promising sign.

在王有龄的印象中，任何难题，一跟他提出来，就会有办法，没有办法也有答复，
In Wang’s experience, whenever he put a difficulty before Hu, there was always a solution—or at least a response.

一两句话，直抉症结的根源，商量下去，总能解决。
A sentence or two would strike straight at the root of the problem; further discussion would resolve it.

象这样不开口，看起来真是把他难倒了。
Such silence seemed to mean that this time Hu was truly at a loss.

难是有点难，却还不至于把胡雪岩难倒，
The problem was difficult, but by no means beyond him.

他现在所想的还不是事而是人，
At present he was considering the man rather than the task.

嵇鹤龄这样的人，胡雪岩最倾倒，有本事也还要有骨气。
Ji was precisely the sort of person Hu admired most: ability ought to be matched by backbone.

王有龄所说的“恃才傲物”四个字，里面有好多学问，
There was much to understand beneath Wang’s description of a man “proud of his talents and disdainful of others.”

傲是傲他所看不起的人，
Pride meant looking down on those one considered unworthy.

如果明明比他高明不肯承认，眼睛长在额角上，目空一切，这样的人不是“傲”是“狂”，
A man who refused to acknowledge someone manifestly superior, who set his eyes above everyone else and saw no merit anywhere, was not proud but conceited.

不但不值得佩服，而且要替他担心，因为狂下去就要疯了。
Such a man deserved not admiration but concern, for conceit carried far enough would become madness.

嵇鹤龄心里是丘壑分明的，
Ji, however, clearly had a well-ordered judgment.

只听他说王有龄“还肯办事，脑筋清楚”，他才肯有所建言，就知道他的为人。
His remark that Wang was “willing to get things done and has a clear head,” and that this was why he had offered advice, revealed his character.

这样的人，只要摸着他的脾气，很容易对付，话不投机，他睬都不睬你。
Understand his temper, and he would be easy enough to deal with; speak on the wrong terms, and he would not even acknowledge you.


“可惜事情太急，没有辰光了，
“The pity is that the business is so urgent and there is no time,” Hu said.

不然，我跟他个把月交下来，一定可以叫他听我的话。”
“Otherwise, give me a month or so to make friends with him, and I could certainly persuade him to listen to me.”

“是啊！
“Exactly.

我是不容你下水磨功夫。
I cannot give you time to work on him gradually.

难就难这日子上头。”
That is the difficulty.”

“他有没有什么好朋友？”
“Has he any close friends?”

“怎么没有？”王有龄说，
“Of course.

“也是个候补知县。会画画，好酒量，
Another man awaiting a county appointment, who paints and has an excellent capacity for wine.

此人最佩服嵇鹤龄，
He admires Ji enormously.

但虽无话不谈，却做不得他的主。
They discuss everything, but he cannot make Ji’s decisions for him.

我就是托他去疏通的。”
It was through him that I tried to arrange matters.”

“喔，‘无话不谈’？胡雪岩很注意地问。
“They discuss everything?” Hu asked with particular attention.

“是的。
“Yes.

此人姓裘，裘、酒谐音，所以外号叫‘酒糊涂’，
His surname is Qiu, which sounds rather like the word for wine, so they call him ‘Wine Muddlehead.’

其实不糊涂。
He is not actually muddleheaded.

我介绍他跟你见见面？
Shall I introduce you?”

““不忙！”
“No hurry.”


胡雪岩说了这一句，却又不开口了，
After that, Hu fell silent again.

尽白夹着王太太精心烹调的红糟鸡，大块往嘴里送。
He concentrated on the chicken Mrs Wang had so carefully prepared, putting generous pieces into his mouth.

还要腾出工夫来向她讨教做法，越发不来理会王有龄。
He even found time to ask her how it was made, paying Wang less attention than ever.

吃完饭、洗过脸，胡雪岩叼着根象牙“剔牙杖”，手里捏一把紫砂小茶壶，走来走去踱方步，
After the meal, he washed his face and began pacing about with an ivory toothpick between his lips and a small purple-clay teapot in his hand.

踱了半天，站往脚说：
At last he stopped.

“要他‘欣然’，只怕办不到！”
“To make him go willingly may be beyond me.”

等了好久的王有龄，
Wang had been waiting a long time.

听得这一说，赶紧接口：
He seized on the remark.

“不管了！
“Never mind that.

嵇鹤龄欣然也好，不高兴也好，反正只要肯去，就一定会尽心。
Willingly or unwillingly, once Ji agrees to go, he will do his utmost.

公事完了，我替他磕个头道谢都无所谓。”
When the business is over, I would willingly kneel and kowtow to thank him.”

“好，
“Very well.

我来办！
I shall arrange it.

雪公，把你的袍褂借我一套。”
Lend me a set of your official robes.”

“什么借？”
“Lend you?”

王有龄转身喊道：“太太，
Wang turned and called to his wife.

你捡一身袍褂，还有，全副的七品服色，
“Choose a robe and jacket for Xueyan, and a complete set of insignia for the seventh rank.

捡齐了叫高升送到雪岩那里去。
Have Gao Sheng take them to his house.”

““对了，顺便托高升跟我家说一声，我上海暂时不去了。”王太太答应首，自去料理。
“Yes, and ask Gao Sheng to tell my family that I am not going to Shanghai just yet.” Mrs Wang agreed and went to make the arrangements.

王有龄便问：“你忽然想起要套公服，
Wang asked, “Why have you suddenly thought of official dress?

作何用处？”
What do you need it for?”


“我要唱出戏。”
“I am going to stage a little play.

胡雪岩又说，“闲话不必提，
But let us say no more of that.

你发个帖子，晚上请‘酒糊涂’来喝酒，
Send an invitation asking Wine Muddlehead to dinner tonight.

我有事要问他。”
There is something I want to ask him.”

王有龄依言照办，立刻发了帖子，同时预备酒筵，
Wang did as requested, dispatching the invitation at once and arranging a banquet.

因为宾主一共只有三个人，菜备得不多，却特地觅了一罐十五年陈的“竹叶青”，打算让“酒糊涂”喝个痛快。
Since there would be only three of them, he ordered few dishes, but made a special effort to obtain a jar of fifteen-year-old Bamboo Leaf Green wine, intending to let his guest drink to his heart’s content.

到晚来，客人欣然应约，
The visitor accepted gladly and arrived that evening.

胡雪岩跟他请教了“台甫”，略略寒暄，随即入席。
