Hu asked his name, exchanged a few civilities, and they sat down to dinner.

姓裘的名叫丰言，名如其人，十分健谈，
His full name was Qiu Fengyan—abundant speech—and it suited him, for he was extraordinarily talkative.

谈的自然是嵇鹤龄。
Naturally, their subject was Ji Heling.

这一顿酒吃完，已经二更过后。
By the time the meal ended, the second watch had passed.

王有龄厚犒裘丰言的跟班、轿伕，并且派高升把有了六七分酒意的客人送了回去。
Wang gave generous tips to Qiu’s attendant and sedan bearers and sent Gao Sheng to escort the decidedly tipsy guest home.

然后跟胡雪岩商量如何说服嵇鹤龄？
Then he turned to Hu to discuss how Ji might be persuaded.

“雪公，”也有了酒意的胡雪岩笑道，“山人自有道理，
Hu, who had also been drinking, smiled. “This humble strategist has his own method, Mr Xuexuan.

你就不必问了。
You need not ask.

明天我得先部署部署，后天一早去拜嵇鹤龄，
Tomorrow I must make my preparations; early the following morning I shall call on Ji Heling.

必有好音。
There will be good news.

我这出戏得有个好配角，
My play requires an able supporting actor.

请你关照高升到舍间来，我用他做配角儿。
Send Gao Sheng to my house; I shall give him the part.”

““好！好！”王有龄也笑道：
“Excellent, excellent!” Wang laughed.

“我等着看你这出戏。”
“I look forward to your performance.”


第三天一早，胡雪岩穿起补子的袍褂，戴上水晶顶子的大帽，坐上轿子，由高升“执帖”，径自来拜嵇鹤龄。
On the third morning, Hu put on his official robe and jacket with their rank badge, donned a formal hat with a crystal button, and set out in a sedan chair to call on Ji. Gao Sheng accompanied him, carrying the visiting card.

他住的是租来的房子，式微的巨族，
Ji lived in rented quarters in a house belonging to a once-prominent family now in decline.

房屋破旧，但格局甚大，里面住着六、七户人家，
The building was dilapidated but spacious, with six or seven households lodged inside.

屋主连门房都租了出去，
Even the gatehouse had been let.

黯旧的粉墙上写着“陈记苏广成衣”六个大字。
On its dingy plaster wall were painted the words “Chen’s Suzhou and Guangdong Ready-Made Clothes.”

高升便上去问讯，
Gao Sheng went up to inquire.

“陈老板，请问嵇老爷可是住在这里？”
“Mr Chen, does Master Ji live here?”

“嵇老爷还是纪老爷？”姓陈的裁缝问，
“Which Ji?” the tailor asked.

嵇跟纪念不清楚，听来是一个音。
The two surnames he mentioned sounded much alike.

“嵇鹤龄嵇老爷。”
“Master Ji Heling.”

“我不晓得他们的名字。
“I do not know their personal names.

可是喜欢骂人的那位嵇老爷？”
Do you mean the Master Ji who likes scolding people?”

“这我就不晓得了。”
“That I cannot say.”

高升把一手所持的清香素烛拿给他看，
Gao Sheng showed him the incense and plain mourning candles he carried.

“刚刚死了太太的那位嵇老爷。”
“The Master Ji whose wife has just died.”

“不错，就是喜欢骂人的那个。
“That is him—the one who likes scolding.

他住在三厅东面那个院子。”
He lives in the courtyard east of the third hall.”

“多谢，多谢！”
“Thank you, thank you.”

高升向胡雪岩使个眼色，接着取根带来的纸煤，在裁缝案板上的熨斗里点燃了，
Gao Sheng gave Hu a look, then took a paper spill he had brought and lit it from the iron on the tailor’s worktable.

往里就走。
With that, he went inside.


胡雪岩穿官服，还是破题儿第一遭，
This was the first time in his life that Hu had worn official dress.

踱不来方楞折角的四方步，加以高升走得又快，他不能不紧紧跟着，
He had not mastered the measured, angular gait expected of an official, and Gao Sheng was walking so fast that he had to hurry after him.

所以顾不得官派，捞起下摆，大踏步赶了上去。
Abandoning dignity, he gathered up the hem of his robe and strode forward.

穿过大厅，沿着夹弄，走到三厅，
They crossed the main hall, followed a narrow passage, and reached the third hall.

东面一座院落，门上钉着麻，一看不错，
Mourning hemp fixed to the doorway of the eastern courtyard confirmed that they had found the right place.

高升便开始唱戏了，
Gao Sheng began his performance.

拉长了调子喊一声：“胡老爷拜！”
In a long, ringing voice he announced, “Master Hu has come to call!”

一路高唱，一路往里直闯，到了灵堂里，吹旺纸煤，先点蜡烛后燃香。
Still proclaiming the visitor’s arrival, he went straight into the mourning hall, blew his paper spill into flame, lit the candles, and then the incense.

这个突如其来的动作，把嵇家弄得莫名其妙，
This unexpected intrusion bewildered the household.

有个跟班模样的老者问道：“老哥，贵上是哪一位？”
An elderly man who looked like an attendant asked, “Sir, who is your master?”

“敝上姓胡，
“His surname is Hu.

特来拜嵇老爷！
He has come specially to call on Master Ji.

拜托你递一递帖子。”
Would you kindly present his card?”

说道，高升从拜匣里取出一张“教愚弟胡光塘拜”的名帖递了过去。
From the card box, Gao Sheng produced one bearing the formal inscription, “Your humble younger brother, Hu Guangyong, respectfully calls.”

他们在里头在打交道，胡雪岩只在院子门口等，
While the two men dealt with each other inside, Hu waited at the courtyard entrance.

过了一会，听见嵇家的跟班在说：“不敢当，不敢当！
Presently he heard the attendant saying, “We could not presume, we could not presume!

敝上说，跟胡老爷素味平生，不敢请见，
My master says he has never had the honour of meeting Master Hu and cannot venture to receive him.

连帖子亦不敢领。“
He cannot even presume to accept his card.”


这拒人于千里以外的态度，是胡雪岩早就料到了的。
Hu had expected this forbidding reception.

他的步骤是，如果投帖而获嵇鹤龄延见，自然最好，否则就还有一步棋。
His plan was simple: if his card secured an interview, so much the better; otherwise he had another move to make.

此刻便是走这步棋的时候了，
Now was the time for it.

他不慌不忙地往里走去，直入灵堂，
Unhurriedly, he walked straight into the mourning hall.

一言不发，从高升手里接过已点燃的线香，在灵前肃穆地往上一举，然后亲自去上香。
Without speaking, he took the lighted incense from Gao Sheng, raised it solemnly before the spirit tablet, and placed it in position himself.

等嵇家的跟班会过意来，连忙喊道：“真不敢当，
When Ji’s attendant understood what was happening, he hastily protested, “You do us too much honour!

真不敢当！”
Far too much!”

胡雪岩不理他，管自己恭恭敬敬地跪在拜垫上行札。
Hu ignored him and knelt reverently on the cushion to perform the mourning rites.

嵇家的跟班慌了手脚，顺手拉过一个在看热闹的、胖胖的小姑娘，把她的头一掀，硬捺着跪下。
Flustered, the attendant seized a plump little girl who had been watching and pressed her down into a kneeling position.

“快磕头回礼！”
“Quickly! Kowtow in return!”

这时把嵇家上下都惊却了，
By now the whole household had been stirred.

等胡雪岩站起身来，只见五、六个孩子，有男有女，小到三、四岁，大到十四五岁，都围在四周，用好奇的眼光，注视着这位从未见过的客人。
When Hu rose, five or six children surrounded him, boys and girls ranging from three or four to fourteen or fifteen, all gazing curiously at this stranger.

“大官！”嵇家的跟班，招呼年龄最大的那个男孩，
“Young master!” the attendant called to the eldest boy.

“来给胡老爷磕头道谢。”
“Come and kowtow to thank Master Hu.”

就这时候嵇鹤龄出现了，
At that moment Ji himself appeared.

“是哪位？”他一面掀起门帘，一面问。
“Who is it?” he asked, lifting the curtain.

“这位想来就是嵇大哥了！”
“You must be Brother Ji.”

胡雪岩兜头一揖。
Hu greeted him with a deep bow.

嵇鹤龄还了礼，冷冷地问道：“我与足下素昧平生，
Ji returned it and asked coldly, “You and I have never met.

何劳吊唁？”
Why trouble yourself to offer condolences?”


“草草不恭！
“My poor preparations are hardly respectful enough.

我是奉王太守的委托，专诚来行个礼。”
Prefect Wang asked me to come specially and pay my respects.”

胡雪岩张开两臂，看看自己身上，不好意思地笑道：
Hu spread his arms, looked down at his clothes, and smiled with apparent embarrassment.

“不瞒嵇大哥说，从捐了官以来，这套袍褂还是第一次穿。
“To tell you the truth, Brother Ji, although I purchased my rank some time ago, this is the first time I have worn these robes.

只因为初次拜访，不敢不具公服。”
Since this is my first visit, I did not dare come without formal dress.”

“言重，言重！
“You are too kind.

不知足下光降，有何见教？”
May I ask what brings you here?”

话是很客气，却不肯肃客人座，意思是立谈数语便要送客出门。
The words were courteous, but he did not invite his visitor to sit; plainly he meant to exchange a few standing remarks and send him away.

不过他虽崖岸自同，他那跟班却很懂礼数，
Though Ji held himself aloof, his attendant understood the courtesies.

端了盖碗茶来，说一声：“请坐，用茶！”
Bringing covered bowls of tea, he said, “Please sit and take some tea.”

这一下嵇鹤龄不能不尽主人的道理了。
Ji could no longer avoid doing his duty as host.

等一坐下来，胡雪岩便是一顿恭维，兼道王有龄是如何仰慕。
Once seated, Hu offered a stream of compliments and spoke of Wang’s admiration.

他的口才本就来得，这时又是刻意敷衍，
He was naturally eloquent and was now taking special pains to please.

俗语道得好：“千穿万穿，马屁不穿”，就怕拍得肉麻，
As the saying went, anything might fail to get through, but flattery never did—provided it was not offensively excessive.

因而几句恰到好处的恭维，胡雪岩就把嵇鹤龄的傲气减消了一半。
A few well-judged compliments reduced Ji’s hauteur by half.


“嵇大哥，还有点东西，王太守托我面交，完全是一点点敬意。”
“Brother Ji, there is something else Prefect Wang asked me to place in your hands—a very small token of his regard.”

说着，他从靴页子里掏出来一个信封，隔着茶几递了过去。
Hu drew an envelope from the side of his boot and passed it across the tea table.

嵇鹤龄不肯接，
Ji would not take it.

“内中何物呢？”他问。
“What is inside?”

“不是银票。”胡雪岩爽爽快快的把他心中的疑惑揭破，
“Not banknotes,” Hu said briskly, bringing the unspoken suspicion into the open.

接下来又加了一句：“几张无用的废纸。”
“Just a few useless scraps of paper.”

这句话引起了嵇鹤龄的好奇心，
This aroused Ji’s curiosity.

撕开封套一看，里面一叠借据，有向钱庄借的，有裘丰言经手为他代借的，
He tore open the envelope and found a bundle of promissory notes: some for loans from banks, others for money Qiu Fengyan had borrowed on his behalf.

上面或者盖着“注销”的戳子，或者写着“作废”二字。
Each had been stamped “Cancelled” or marked “Void.”

不是“废纸”是什么呢？
What were they now but waste paper?

“这、这、这怎么说呢？”
“What—what is the meaning of this?”

嵇鹤龄的枪法大乱，
Ji’s defences were thrown into confusion.

而尤其令他困惑的是，有人抬进来两只皮箱，
More bewildering still, two leather trunks were carried in.

他认得那是自己的东西，但不应该在这里，应该在当铺里。
He recognized them as his own, but they should not have been here; they should have been in the pawnshop.

于是嵇鹤龄急急喊他那跟在箱子后面的跟班：“张贵！
“Zhang Gui!” he called urgently to the attendant following the trunks.

怎么回事？”
“What is happening?”

上当铺的勾当，都归张贵经手，但是他也不明白是怎么回事，
Zhang Gui handled all the household’s pawnshop business, but he too did not understand the whole affair.

一出戏他不过看到前台的演出，后台的花样他看不见。
He had seen only the performance on stage, not the devices behind the scenes.


线索是裘丰言那里来的，
The information had come from Qiu Fengyan.

知道了嵇家常去求教的那家当铺就好办了。
Once Hu knew which pawnshop the Ji household habitually used, the rest was easy.

钱庄与当铺素有往来，刘庆生就认识那家当铺的徽州朝奉，
Banks and pawnshops regularly dealt with each other, and Liu knew the Huizhou appraiser at that establishment.

一说替嵇老爷赎当，自然万分欢迎。
The proposal to redeem Master Ji’s pledges was naturally most welcome.

但赎当要有当票，
Redemption, however, required the pawn tickets.

因而作了一个约定，由刘庆生将全部本息付讫，“当头”送到嵇家，凭票收货，
An arrangement was therefore made: Liu would pay the entire principal and interest, and the pledged goods would be delivered to Ji’s house and handed over against the tickets.

否则原货取回。
If the tickets were not produced, the goods would be taken back.

这是万无一失的安排，当铺里自然乐从。
It was a perfectly secure arrangement, and the pawnshop readily agreed.

因此，在胡雪岩跟嵇鹤龄打交道时，作为“配角”的高升也在“唱戏”，
Thus, while Hu was dealing with Ji, Gao Sheng was playing his supporting role.

他把张贵悄悄拉到一边，先请教了“贵姓”，然后说道：“张老哥，有点东西在门外，
He quietly drew Zhang Gui aside, asked his surname, and said, “Brother Zhang, there are a few things outside.

请你去看看。”
Please come and look.”

门外是指定时间送到的两口皮箱。
The two trunks had arrived at the appointed time.

高升告诉他，本息部已付过，只凭当票就可取回箱子。
Gao Sheng explained that principal and interest were paid; Zhang needed only to produce the tickets to recover them.

张贵跟了嵇鹤龄十几年，知道主人的脾气，
Zhang had served Ji for more than ten years and knew his temper.

但也因为跟得太久，不但感情上已泯没了主仆的界限，而且嵇鹤龄的日常家用，都由他调度，
Yet long service had also softened the division between master and servant, while the management of the household’s everyday expenses rested on Zhang.

等于是个“当家人”，
He was virtually the head of its domestic affairs.

别的都还好办，六个孩子的嘴非喂不可，
Other things might be managed somehow, but six children had to be fed.

所以对这两箱子衣服，决定自作主张把它领了下来，
He decided on his own authority to accept the two trunks of clothing.

至多受主人几句埋怨，
At worst, his master would reproach him.

实惠总是实惠。
A practical benefit was still a practical benefit.


“唉！”被请到一边，悄悄听完经过的嵇鹤龄，微顿着足叹气：
Called aside and quietly told what had happened, Ji stamped his foot lightly and sighed.

“我从来没有遇见过这种事。
“I have never encountered anything like this.

现在怎么办呢？”
What am I to do now?”

张贵不作声，
Zhang said nothing.

心里在想：有钱，把赎当的本息归还人家，
He thought: if there was money, they could repay the principal and interest to the man who had redeemed the goods.

没有钱，那就只好领受人家的好意。
If there was none, they could only accept his kindness.

不然，难道把东西丢掉？
What else could they do—throw the things away?

““好了，好了！”
“Very well, very well!”

嵇鹤龄横一横心，另作处置，挥手说道：
Ji hardened his resolve to deal with the matter in another way and waved him off.

“你不用管了。”
“Leave it to me.”

“老爷！张贵交代了一句：”本息一共是二百三十二两六钱银子。
“Sir,” Zhang added, “the principal and interest came to two hundred and thirty-two taels and six qian.”

“嵇鹤龄点点头，又去陪客，
Ji nodded and returned to his guest.

“仁兄大人，”他略带点气愤地说，“这是哪位的主意？
“My honoured friend,” he said with a trace of anger, “whose idea was this?

高明之至！”
Exceedingly clever!”

“哪里，哪里！”
“Not at all, not at all.”

胡雪岩用不安的声音说，
Hu sounded uneasy.

“无非王太守敬仰老兄，略表敬意，
“Prefect Wang admires you and wished only to show a little respect.

你不必介怀！”
Please do not take it to heart.”

“我如何能不介怀？”
“How can I do otherwise?”

嵇鹤龄把声音提得高，
Ji raised his voice.

“你们做这个圈套，硬叫我领这个情，
“You have laid a trap and forced this obligation upon me.

拒之不可，受之不甘。
I cannot refuse it, yet I have no wish to accept it.

真正是……”
It is really...”

他总算把话到口边的“岂有此理”四个字咽了回去。
He managed to swallow the words “utterly outrageous” before they escaped.


他要发脾气，也在胡雪岩意料之中，
His anger, too, was part of what Hu had anticipated.

笑嘻嘻地站起身来又作揖：
Smiling, Hu rose and bowed again.

“老兄，我领罪！
“Brother, I accept the blame.

是我出的主意，与王太守无干！
The idea was mine; Prefect Wang had nothing to do with it.

说句实话，我倒不是为老兄，是为王太守，
To speak frankly, I acted less for your sake than for his.

他深知老兄的耿介，想有所致意而不敢，
He knows your upright and independent nature and dared not offer the consideration he wished to show you.

为此愁眉不展，
It troubled him greatly.

我蒙王太守不弃，视为患难之交，不能不替他分忧，
He has been kind enough to treat me as a friend through hardship and danger; I could not fail to relieve his anxiety.

因而想了这么一条唐突大贤的计策。
That is how I came to devise this scheme, so presumptuous towards a man of your worth.

总之，是我荒唐，我跟老兄请罪！”
In short, I have behaved outrageously, and I ask your pardon.”

说到这里又是长揖到地。
He bowed deeply again.

嵇鹤龄不知道这番措词雅驯的话，是经王有龄斟酌过的“戏辙儿”，
Ji did not know that this polished speech was a carefully prepared piece of the performance, revised with Wang’s help.

只觉得他谈吐不俗，行事更不俗，
He merely felt that the stranger spoke with distinction and acted with still greater originality.

象是熟读《战国策》的，
He seemed a man who had studied the Stratagems of the Warring States.

倒不可小看了这个“铜钱眼里翻跟斗”的陌生人。
This fellow who turned somersaults through the hole in a copper coin was not to be underestimated.

于是他的态度和缓了，
Ji’s manner softened.

还了礼拉着胡雪岩的手说：
Returning the bow, he took Hu’s hand.

“来，来，我们好好谈一谈。”
“Come, let us have a proper talk.”


一看这情形，胡雪岩自觉嵇鹤龄已入掌握，
Seeing this, Hu felt that he had gained the upper hand.

不过此刻有两种不同的应付办法，
There were now two possible courses.

如果只要他就范，替工有龄作一趟新城之行，事毕即了，彼此漠不相关，那很好办，就地敷衍他一番就行了。
If all he wanted was Ji’s compliance—one journey to Xincheng for Wang, after which the affair would be finished and the two men need have nothing more to do with one another—he could easily manage it by saying what was needed on the spot.

倘或想跟他做个朋友，也是为王有龄在官场中找个得力帮手，还须好好下一番功夫。
But if he wanted a friendship, and thereby a capable ally for Wang in official life, more effort would be required.

转念之间，就有了抉择，
He made his choice almost at once.

他实在也很欣赏嵇鹤龄这样的人，
He truly admired men like Ji.

所以提了个建议，并且改了称呼，不称“老兄”称“鹤龄兄”。
Changing his form of address from the general “Brother” to the more personal “Brother Heling,” he proposed a meal.

“我看这样，”他说，“鹤龄兄，我奉屈小酌，找个清凉的地方”摆一碗‘，
“Let me invite you for a modest drink somewhere cool.

你看怎么样？
What do you say?”

“日已将午，
It was nearly noon.

对这样一位来“示惠”的客人，嵇鹤龄原就想到，应该留客便饭，
Ji had already thought that he ought to keep a visitor who had come to do him such a kindness for lunch.

只是中馈乏人，孩子又多，家里实在不方便，
But with no wife to manage the kitchen and so many children, his household was hardly convenient for entertaining.

不想胡雪岩有此提议，恰中下怀，因而欣然表示同意。
Hu’s suggestion suited him perfectly, and he gladly agreed.

“这身公服，可以不穿了！”
“I can take off this official dress now!”

胡雪岩看着身上，故意说道：
Hu deliberately looked down at himself.

“等我先回家换了衣服再来。”
“Let me go home, change, and come back.”

“那何心呢？”嵇鹤龄马上接口，
“Why trouble yourself?

“天气还热得很，
It is still very hot.

随便找件纱衫穿就行了。”接着就叫他的儿子：“大毛，把我挂在门背后的那件长衫拿来。”
Any light gauze gown will do.” Ji called to his son, “Da Mao, bring me the gown hanging behind the door.”

于是胡雪岩换了公服，芽上嵇鹤龄的一件实地纱长衫。
Hu changed into one of Ji’s fine gauze gowns.

到了这样可以“共衣”的程度，交情也就显得不同了。
Once they had reached the point of sharing clothes, their friendship plainly stood on a different footing.

两个人都没有穿马褂，一袭轻衫，潇潇洒洒的出了嵇家的院子。
Neither wore a riding jacket; lightly dressed and at ease, they left the courtyard together.


“鹤龄兄，你请先走一步，
“Brother Heling, go on a few steps.

我跟他说几句话。”
I should like a word with him.”

他是指高升，
Hu meant Gao Sheng.

胡雪岩先夸奖了他几句，然后让他回去，转告王有龄，事情一定可以成功，
He first praised his performance, then told him to return and inform Wang that success was certain.

请王有龄即刻到嵇家来拜访。
Wang should come to call on Ji immediately.

“胡老爷！”高升低声问道，“你跟嵇老爷吃酒去了，我们老爷一来，不是扑个空吗？”
“Master Hu,” Gao Sheng asked quietly, “if you and Master Ji are going out to drink, will our master not find him away?”

“ ‘孔子拜阳货’，就是要扑空。”胡雪岩点破其中的奥妙：
“Like Confucius calling on Yang Huo—that is precisely the point.” Hu explained the device.

“你们老爷来拜了，嵇老爷当然要去回拜，
“Once your master has called, Master Ji must return the visit.

这下有事不就可以长谈了吗？”
Then, if there is business to discuss, they can have a long conversation.”

“是的，
“Yes, indeed.

胡老爷的脑筋真好！”
What a mind you have, Master Hu!”

高升笑着说，
Gao Sheng smiled.

“我懂了，
“I understand.

你懂了请。”
Please go ahead.”



胡雪岩
《平步青云（上）》第十一章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume I — Chapter Eleven, concluding part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


出了大门，两个人都没有坐轿子。
Neither man took a chair when they left the house.

嵇家住在清波门，离“柳浪闻莺”不远，安步当车到了那里，在一家叫做“别有天”的馆子里落座。
Ji lived near Qingbo Gate, not far from the Willows Where Orioles Sing, so they walked there at leisure and sat down in a restaurant called Bieyoutian, “Another World.”

胡雪岩好整以暇地跟嵇鹤龄研究要什么菜，什么酒，那样子就象多年知好，常常在一起把杯小叙似的。
Hu calmly discussed the choice of dishes and wine with Ji, as though they were old friends accustomed to meeting over a cup.

“雪岩兄，”嵇鹤龄开门见山地问，“王太守真的认为新城那件案子，非我去不可？”
“Brother Xueyan,” Ji asked directly, “does Prefect Wang really believe that no one but me can handle the Xincheng case?”

“这倒不大清楚。
“I'm not quite sure.

不过前天我听他在埋怨黄抚台。”
But the day before yesterday I heard him complaining about Governor Huang.”

胡雪岩喝口酒，闲闲地又说，
Hu sipped his wine and continued casually.

“埋怨上头，派了这么多委员来，用得着的不多，
“He said the authorities had sent so many commissioners, yet few were of any use.

倒不如只派嵇某人一位，那反倒没有话说。”
Better to have sent Ji alone; then there would have been nothing to say.”

“怎么叫没有话说？”
“What did he mean, ‘nothing to say’?”

“听他的口气，是指你老兄没有话说。
“From his tone, I think he meant that you would have had no grounds to refuse.

如果委员只有你一位，他有什么借重的地方，我想你也不好推辞。
If you were the only commissioner and he needed your help, I imagine you could hardly decline.

现在有这么多人，偏偏一定说要请你去，这话他似乎不便出口。”
But with so many here, it seems awkward for him to insist on choosing you.”

“是啊！”嵇鹤龄说，
“Yes,” Ji said.

“我也知道他的难处。”
“I understand his difficulty.”


知道王有龄的难处又如何呢？
And what would he do about it?

胡雪岩心里这样在问，
Hu asked himself.

但不愿操之过急，紧钉着问，
But he did not want to press too hard or too soon.

同时他也真的不急，因为嵇鹤龄的脾气，他几乎已完全摸到，
In fact, he felt no urgency, for he had almost completely understood Ji's temperament.

只要能说动他，他比什么人的心还热。
Once persuaded, Ji would be more eager to help than anyone.

果然，嵇鹤龄接着又说：“这件事我当仁不让。
Sure enough, he continued, “This is a duty I should not shrink from.

不过，王太守得要能听我的话。”
But Prefect Wang must be willing to listen to me.”

胡雪岩也真会做做，
Hu knew how to play his part.

“到底怎么回事？
“What exactly is involved?

我还不十分清楚，
I still don't fully understand.

这是公事，我最好少说话。
It's official business, so I'd better say little.

鹤龄兄，王太守跟我关系不同，想来你总也听说过。
Brother Heling, you've doubtless heard that Prefect Wang and I are unusually close.

我们虽是初交，一见投缘，
Though you and I have only just met, we've taken to each other immediately.

说句实话，我是高攀，
Frankly, I aspire to a friendship above my station.

只要你愿意交我这个朋友，我们交下去一定是顶好的朋友。
If you're willing to accept me, I'm sure we shall become the best of friends.

为此，”
For that reason...”

他停了一下，装出毅然决然的神情，
He paused, assuming a resolute expression.

“我也不能不替你着想，
“I must consider your interests too.

交朋友不能‘治一经，损一经’，
Friendship cannot mean helping one man at another's expense.

你说是不是？”
Wouldn't you agree?”

“是的。”
“Indeed.”

嵇鹤龄深深点头、
Ji nodded deeply.

“雪岩兄，不是我恭维你、阛阓中人，象你这样有春秋战国策士味道的，还真罕见。
“Brother Xueyan, this is no empty compliment: it's rare to find a merchant with the qualities of the persuasive strategists of the Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods.”

“这两句话，胡雪岩听不懂，反正只知道是恭维的话，
Hu did not understand the reference, but knew it was praise.

谦逊总不铭的，便拱拱手答道：”
Modesty could not go wrong, so he clasped his hands.

不敢，不敢！“
“You are too kind!”


“现在我要请问，你说‘不能不替我着想’，是如何想法？”
“Now tell me: when you say you must consider my interests, what do you mean?”

“你的心太热，自告奋勇要到新城走一趟，王太守当然也有借重的意思。
“You're warm-hearted enough to volunteer for Xincheng, and Prefect Wang certainly wants your help.

不过他的想法跟我一样，总要不生危险才好，
But he thinks as I do: you must not expose yourself to danger.

如果没有万全之计，还是不去的好。
Unless there's a completely safe plan, better not to go.

倘或王太守谈到这件事，你有难处，尽管实说。
If he raises the matter and you see difficulties, speak frankly.”

“他加重语气又说：”
Hu strengthened his tone.

千万千万不能冒险。
“Above all, don't take risks.

这就是我替你着想的地方。
That's what I mean by considering your interests.”

““承情之至。”嵇鹤龄很坦然地说：
“I'm deeply obliged.” Ji answered calmly.

“这种事没有万全之计的，
“There's no completely safe plan for such a business.

全在乎事先策划周详，临事随机应变。
Everything depends on thorough preparation and the ability to adapt when the moment comes.

雪岩兄，你放心，我自保的办法，总是有的。”
Rest assured, Brother Xueyan: I do have ways of protecting myself.”


“可惜，新城是在山里，
“It's a pity Xincheng is in the mountains.

如果是水路码头我就可以保你的驾了。”
If it were a river port, I could guarantee your safety.”

“怎么呢？”嵇鹤龄问：“你跟水师营很熟？”
“Why?” Ji asked. “Are you well acquainted with the naval forces?”

“不是。”
“No.”

胡雪岩想了想，觉得不妨实说，
After a moment's thought, Hu decided he might as well be candid.

“漕帮中我有人。”
“I have friends in the Grain Transport Brotherhood.”

“那好极了！”
“Excellent!”

嵇鹤龄已极其兴奋地，
Ji became excited.

“我就想结识几个漕帮中人，
“I've been wanting to meet some of them.

烦你引见。”他接着又加了一句：“并无他意，
You must introduce me.” He added, “I have no ulterior purpose.

只是向往这些人的行径，
I'm simply interested in the way these men live.

想印证一下《游侠列传》，看看今古有何不同？”
I'd like to compare them with the Biographies of Knight-Errants and see how the present differs from the past.”

《游侠列传》是个什么玩意？
What were the Biographies of Knight-Errants?

胡雪岩不知道，
Hu had no idea.

片刻之间，倒有两次听不懂他的活，心里不免难过，
Twice in a few moments he had failed to understand Ji, and it troubled him.

读的书到底太少了。
He really had read too few books.

不过不懂他能猜，
But what he did not know he could guess.

看样子嵇鹤龄只是想结交这些朋友，
Evidently Ji merely wished to make these acquaintances.

江湖上人四海碍很，朋友越多越好，
Men of the brotherhood were expansive in their friendships; the more friends, the better.

介绍他跟郁四和尤五认识，决不嫌冒昧，
Neither Yu Si nor You Wu would think the introduction presumptuous.

所以他一口答应。
Hu agreed at once.

“鹤龄兄，”他说，“我是‘空子’，
“Brother Heling, I'm an outsider.

就这年把当中，在水路上文了两个响当当的好朋友，一个在湖州，一个在松江。
But in the past year or so I've made two splendid friends on the waterways, one in Huzhou and one in Songjiang.

等你公事完了，我也从上海回来了，那时候我们一起到湖州去玩一趟，
When your official business is finished and I've returned from Shanghai, let's visit Huzhou together.

自然是扰王太守的，
Naturally we'll impose on Prefect Wang.

我跟你介绍一个姓郁的朋友。
I'll introduce you to a friend named Yu.

照你的性情，你们一定台得来。”
With your temperament, you're certain to get on.”


“好极了！”
“Excellent!”

嵇鹤龄欣然引杯，
Ji gladly raised his cup.

干了酒又问：“你什么时候动身到上海？”
After draining it, he asked, “When do you leave for Shanghai?”

“本来前天就该走了。
“I should have left the day before yesterday.

想想不能把王太守一个人丢在这里，所以上了船又下船。”
But I couldn't abandon Prefect Wang here alone, so I got off the boat after boarding it.”

“啊！
“Ah!

这我又要浮一大白！”
That deserves another full cup!”

嵇鹤龄自己取壶斟满，一饮而尽，向胡雪岩照一照杯又说：
Ji took the wine pot, filled his cup, drank it dry, and showed it to Hu.

“现在能够象你这样急人之难。古道热肠的，不多了。”
“Few men nowadays are so quick to help a friend in trouble or so generous in the old-fashioned way.”

这句话他听懂了，
This Hu understood.

机变极快，应声答道：
His reply was immediate.

“至少还有一个，就是仁兄大人阁下。”
“There is at least one other: your most distinguished self.”

说着，胡雪岩回敬了一杯，嵇鹤龄欣然接受，
He returned the toast, which Ji happily accepted.

放下杯子，有着喜不自胜的神情，
Setting down his cup, Ji looked almost overcome with pleasure.

“雪岩兄，人生遇合，真正是佛家所说的‘因缘’两字，
“Brother Xueyan, meetings between people truly depend on what the Buddhists call yinyuan—causes and affinities.

一点都强求不来。”
You cannot force them in the least.”

“喔，原来‘姻缘’两字，是佛经上来的？”
“Oh, so yinyuan comes from Buddhist scripture?” Hu had taken the word to mean the ties that bring a marriage about.


这一说，嵇鹤龄不免诧异，
Ji was surprised.

看他吐属不凡，何以连“因缘”的出典都会不知道呢？
Hu spoke so well; how could he not know the origin of yinyuan?

但他轻视的念头，在心中一闪即没，
Yet the passing trace of condescension vanished at once.

朋友投缘了，自会有许多忠恕的想法，
When friends take to one another, charitable explanations readily follow.

他在想，胡雪岩虽是生意中人，没有读多少书，但并不俗气，
Though a merchant with little schooling, Hu was not vulgar.

而且在应酬交往中，学到了一口文雅的谈吐，居然在场面上能充得过去，
Through social intercourse he had acquired an elegant way of speaking that carried him creditably through formal occasions.

也真个难能可贵了。
That was no small achievement.

他还没有听出胡雪岩说的是“姻缘”，不是“因缘”。
Ji had not yet noticed that Hu understood a different word, also pronounced yinyuan: marriage ties rather than causes and affinities.

只接着发挥他的看法：
He simply developed his thought.

“世俗都道得一个‘缘’字，其实有因才有缘。
“People speak only of affinity, but there must be a cause before affinity can arise.

你我的性情，就是一个因，
Our temperaments are one such cause.

你晓得我吃软不吃硬，人穷志不穷的脾气，
You understood that I respond to kindness, not pressure, and that poverty hasn't destroyed my self-respect.

这样才会投缘。
That's why we get on.

所以有人说的无缘，其实是无因，
When people say they lack affinity, what they really lack is a cause for it.

彼此志趣不台，性情不投，哪里会做得成朋友？”
If their aspirations differ and their temperaments clash, how can they become friends?”

胡雪岩这才明白，他说的是因果之“因”，不是婚姻之“姻”，
Only then did Hu realise that Ji meant yin as in cause and effect, not yin as in marriage.

心里越发不是味道，但也不必掩饰。
He felt still more uncomfortable, but saw no need to conceal it.

“鹤龄兄，”他很诚恳的说，“你跟我谈书上的道理，我不是你的对手。
“Brother Heling,” he said sincerely, “when it comes to principles from books, I'm no match for you.

不过你尽管谈，
But please go on.

我听听总是有益的。”
Listening can only do me good.”


这一说，益使嵇鹤龄觉得他坦率可爱，不过也因为他这一说，反倒不便再引经据典，谈谈书上的道理了，
This made Ji like him still more for his candour, though it also left him reluctant to continue displaying quotations and book learning.

“ ‘世事洞明皆学问，人情练达即文章’，
“To understand the world is learning; to comprehend human dealings is literature.

雪岩兄，你倒也不必忒自谦。”
Brother Xueyan, there's no need to be so modest.

嵇鹤龄说，“我劝你闲下来，倒不妨读几首诗，看看山，看看水，
When you have leisure, try reading a few poems and looking at mountains and water.

这倒是涵泳性情，于你极有益处的。”
It would nourish your temperament and do you a great deal of good.”

“你这几句话是张药方子，”胡雪岩笑道：
“Those words are a prescription,” Hu said with a smile.

“可以医我的俗气。”
“They could cure my vulgarity.”

“对了！”
“Exactly!”

嵇鹤龄击节称赏，
Ji tapped in appreciation.

“你见得到此就不俗。”
“A man who sees that is no vulgar fellow.”

这一来，他的谈兴越发好了，谈兴一好酒兴也一定好，
His pleasure in conversation increased, and with it his appetite for wine.

又添了两斤竹叶青来。
They ordered another two jin of Zhuyeqing.

酒店主人也很识趣，
The proprietor, too, knew how to oblige.

从吊在湖水中的竹篓里，捞起一条三斤重的青鱼，
From a bamboo basket suspended in the lake, he took a black carp weighing three jin.

别出心裁，舍弃从南宋传下来的“醋溜”成法不用，仿照“老西儿”的吃法，做了碗解酒醒脾的醋椒鱼汤，
Instead of preparing it in the traditional vinegar style handed down from the Southern Song, he borrowed a Shanxi method and made a fish soup with vinegar and pepper, refreshing to the stomach and calculated to clear the effects of wine.

亲自捧上桌来，说明是不收钱的“敬菜”。
He brought it himself, explaining that it was a complimentary dish.

于是嵇鹤龄的饭量也好了，
Ji's appetite improved as well.

三碗“冬春米”饭下肚，摩着肚皮说：
After three bowls of dongchun rice, he rubbed his stomach.

“从内人下世以来，我还是第一次这么酒醉饭饱。”
“This is the first time since my wife died that I've eaten and drunk to such contentment.”


他这一说，倒让胡雪岩想起一件事，
The remark reminded Hu of something.

“鹤龄兄，”他问：“尊夫人故世，留下五六个儿子，
“Brother Heling, your wife left five or six children.

中馈不可无人，
Someone must manage the household.

你也该有续弦的打算！”
Surely you've considered marrying again?”

“唉！”嵇鹤龄叹口气，
“Ah!” Ji sighed.

“我何尝不作此打算？
“Of course I have.

不过，你倒想想，五六个儿女需要照料，又是不知哪一年补缺的‘灾官’，
But consider it: five or six children to look after, and a wretched expectant official who doesn't know what year he'll receive a post.

请问，略略过得去的人家，哪位小姐肯嫁我？”
What daughter of even a moderately respectable family would marry me?”

“这倒是实话。”胡雪岩说：
“That's true,” Hu replied.

“等我来替你动动脑筋！”
“Let me think about it for you.”

嵇鹤龄笑笑不答。
Ji merely smiled.

胡雪岩却真的在替他“动脑筋”，并且很快地想到了一个主意，
Hu, however, really did think, and soon had an idea.

但眼前先不说破，谈了些别的闲话，
He kept it to himself for the moment and turned to other small talk.

看着太阳已落入南北高峰之间，返照湖水，映出万点金鳞，
The sun had sunk between the Northern and Southern Peaks, scattering ten thousand golden scales across the lake.

暑气也不如日中之烈，柳下披风，醉意一消，
The heat was less fierce than at noon, and a breeze beneath the willows cleared their heads.

真个“夕阳无限好，只是近黄昏”，
Truly, “The setting sun is beautiful beyond measure, but twilight is near.”

一到黄昏，城门快要关了，
Twilight meant the city gates would soon close.

两人恋恋不舍地约了明天再见。
Reluctantly, they parted, agreeing to meet the next day.


胡雪岩直接来到王家，
Hu went straight to Wang's house.

王有龄正好送客出门，
Wang was seeing a visitor out.

一见便拉着他的手笑道：
As soon as he saw Hu, he caught his hand and laughed.

“雪岩，你的本事真大，
“Xueyan, you're astonishing!

居然能把这么个人降服了，我不能不佩服你。
To win over a man like that—I can only admire you.

我去拜过他了，封了八两银子的奠仪，
I've called on him and left eight taels as a condolence offering.

不算太菲吧！”
That wasn't too little, was it?”

“这无所谓。”胡雪岩答道，
“The amount doesn't matter,” Hu replied.

“他已经自告奋勇，
“He's already volunteered.

明天上午一定会来回拜，你就开门见山跟他谈好了。”
He'll certainly return your visit tomorrow morning, and you can speak to him directly.”

“自告奋勇？”
“Volunteered?”

王有龄愁怀尽去，大喜说道：
All Wang's worries vanished.

“好极，好极！
“Excellent!

明天晚上我请个客，把魁参将和新城县的两个绅士约了来，
I'll give a dinner tomorrow evening and invite Brigade Commander Kui and the two gentlemen from Xincheng.

好好谈一谈。
We can discuss everything properly.

你早点来！”
Come early.”

第二天下午，胡雪岩依约，在家吃完午饭就到了王家。
The next afternoon, Hu finished lunch at home and went to Wang's as arranged.

不久，嵇鹤龄也到了，
Ji soon arrived too.

他在上午已来回拜过王有龄，接受了晚宴的邀请，
He had returned Wang's call that morning and accepted the dinner invitation.

同时应约早到，好先商量出一个具体办法，
They had also agreed that he should come early so they could devise a concrete plan.

等魁参将和新城县的绅士来了，当面谈妥，立即就可以动手办事。
Once Kui and the Xincheng gentlemen arrived, they could settle it together and begin work immediately.


“鹤龄兄，”王有龄说，“早晨你来过以后，我一直在盘算，
“Brother Heling,” Wang began, “I've been considering matters ever since your visit this morning.

新城县令已为匪僧慧心戕害，现在是县丞护印。
The rebel monk Huixin has murdered the Xincheng magistrate, and the county's deputy magistrate is now holding the seal.

我想上院保老兄署理新城，
I mean to recommend you to the governor as acting magistrate.

有‘印把子’在手里，办事比较方便。
With the seal of authority in your hands, your work would be easier.

当然，这是权宜之计，
Of course, this would only be temporary.

新城地瘠民贫，
Xincheng has poor soil and impoverished inhabitants.

不好一直委屈老兄。
You shouldn't be kept in such an unrewarding post.

将来调补一等大县，我一定帮忙。”
Later I'll certainly help you transfer to a large county of the first class.”

“多谢雪公栽培！”嵇鹤龄拱拱手说，
Ji clasped his hands. “Thank you for advancing my interests, Mr Xuexuan.

“不过眼前还是用委员的名义好。
But for now I should retain the title of commissioner.

何以呢？
Why?

第一，此去要随机应变，
First, I must adapt to circumstances.

说不定我要深入虎穴，权且与那班乱民‘称兄道弟，杯酒言欢’。
I may have to enter the tiger's den and temporarily call those rebels brothers, drinking with them on friendly terms.

如果是父母官的身分，不能不存朝廷的体统，
As their magistrate, I would have to preserve the dignity of the court.

处处拘束，反而不便。
That would constrain me everywhere and make things harder.

其次，现在既是县丞护印，身处危城，能够尽心维持，
Second, the deputy magistrate is holding the seal and doing his best to sustain a city in danger.

他总也有所贪图，
He must hope to gain something for his efforts.

如果我一署理，他就落空了，
If I take the acting appointment, his hopes disappear.

即使不是心怀怨望，事事掣时，也一定鼓不起劲来干，
Even if he doesn't resent it and obstruct me at every turn, he'll certainly lose his enthusiasm.

于大事无益。“
That would do our purpose no good.”


“是，是！”
“Yes, yes!”

王有龄钦佩之忱，溢于词色，
Wang's admiration showed in both his words and expression.

“老兄这番剖析，具见卓识。
“Your analysis displays real insight.

这准定照老兄的吩咐，
We'll do exactly as you advise.

等这件事完了，老兄补实缺的事，包在我身上。
Once this affair is settled, leave your substantive appointment to me.”

““那是以后的事，
“That is for later.

眼前我要请雪公先跟上头进言，新城县丞，倘或著有劳绩，请上头不必另外派人，就让他升署知县。”
For now, please recommend to the authorities that if the deputy magistrate of Xincheng renders distinguished service, they should promote him to act as magistrate instead of sending someone else.

嵇鹤龄说，“‘重赏之下，必有勇夫’这句话，有时候很用得着。
‘A generous reward will bring forth brave men’ is sometimes a very useful principle.

如果上头肯这么答应，我到了新城，可得许多方便。”
With that promise from above, my work in Xincheng would become much easier.”

“对！
“Quite right!

这也是应该的。
And he deserves it.

危城之中，也靠他撑持，理当有此酬庸。
He's holding the place together in danger and should receive that recognition.

倘或受罪吃辛苦有分，局势平定了，别人来坐享其成，这也太不公平了。”
It would be grossly unfair to leave him all the hardship, then let another man enjoy the fruits once order is restored.”

接着，他们两人便谈到“先抚后剿”的细节。
They went on to discuss the details of attempting conciliation before resorting to force.

胡雪岩看没有他的事，也插不进话去，便悄悄退了出来，径到上房来见王太太。
Hu saw no part for himself and could contribute nothing, so he quietly withdrew and went straight to the inner rooms to see Mrs Wang.


王太太越发亲热，口口声声“兄弟，兄弟”的，简直把他当做娘家人看待了。
Mrs Wang was warmer than ever, calling him “Brother” at every turn and treating him almost as a member of her own family.

胡雪岩深知官场中人的脾气，只许他们亲热，不许别人越礼，
Hu understood official households: they might be familiar, but others must not overstep the forms.

所以仍旧按规矩称她：
He therefore continued to address her properly.

“王太太！”他说，“现在你可以不必再为雪公担心了。
“Mrs Wang, you needn't worry about Mr Xuexuan any longer.

嵇鹤龄一则是佩服雪公，再则是跟我一见如故，
Ji Heling admires him, and he and I felt like old friends at our first meeting.

肯到新城去了。”
He's agreed to go to Xincheng.”

“这都是兄弟你的功劳！”王太太很吃力地说：
“It's all your doing, Brother!” she said with difficulty.

“真正是，我不知道该怎么谢你？”
“Truly, I don't know how to thank you.”

“不必谢我！
“There's no need.

就算我出了力，以我跟雪公的情分来说，也是应该的。
Even if I have been of some help, with my friendship for Mr Xuexuan it was only right.

倒是人家嵇老爷，
Mr Ji is the one we truly owe.

打开天窗说亮话，这一趟去，真正要承他的情。”胡雪岩又说，“刚刚雪公要保他署理新城县，他一定不要，说是这一来事情反倒不好办。
To speak plainly, we must appreciate what he's doing by going there.” Hu continued, “Just now Mr Xuexuan offered to recommend him as acting magistrate, but he firmly refused, saying it would make the work harder.

王太太你想，候补候补。 就是想补个缺，
Think of it: an expectant official waits for nothing but a post.

此刻不贪功名富贵，所为何来？
Why would he put aside rank and advancement when they're offered?

无非交情二字。“
Simply for friendship.”


“这是真的。”王太太说：
“That's true,” Mrs Wang said.

“兄弟我们自己人，
“Brother, we're among ourselves.

你倒替我出个主意看，
Give me some advice.

虽说公事上头，我不能问，也插不进手去，私人的情分上他帮了你哥哥这么一个大忙，
I can't inquire into official business or interfere with it, but personally he's doing your elder brother a great service.

我总也要尽点心。
I must show some consideration too.

如果他太太在世，倒也好了，
If his wife were alive, it would be easier.

内眷往来，什么话都好说，
We women could visit, and anything could be discussed.

偏偏他太太又故世了！”
Unfortunately, she's dead.”

这就说到紧要关头上来了，
This was the crucial point.

胡雪岩三两句话把话题引到此处，正要开门见山转入正文，不想来了个人，
Hu had guided the conversation here in a few sentences and was about to state his purpose when someone arrived.

他只好把已到喉咙口的话，咽了回去。
He swallowed the words already on his tongue.

“胡老爷请用茶。
“Please have some tea, Mr Hu.

钱塘县陈大老爷送的狮子山的‘ 旗枪’还是头一回打开来吃。
It's flag-and-spear tea from Lion Hill, sent by Magistrate Chen of Qiantang. We've only just opened it.

胡老爷，你是讲究吃茶的，尝尝新！”
You're particular about tea—do try this fresh batch.”

说话的是王太太的一个心腹丫头，名叫瑞云，
The speaker was Mrs Wang's trusted maid, Ruiyun.

生得长身玉立，一张长隆脸，下巴宽了些，
Tall and graceful, she had a long face and a rather broad chin.

但照相法上说，这是所谓主贵的“地角方圆”。
In physiognomy, however, a full, well-shaped lower face was supposed to promise distinction.

看瑞云的气度，倒确是有点大家闺秀的味道，
Her bearing did indeed suggest a young woman from a good family.

语言从容，神态娴静，没有些儿轻狂。
She spoke calmly, carried herself quietly, and showed no frivolity.

尤其好的是操持家务，井井有条，等于王太太的一条右臂。
Her particular gift was household management: she kept everything in perfect order and was virtually Mrs Wang's right arm.

所以到了花信年华，依然是小姑居处，只为王太太舍不得放她出去。
Thus, though well into marriageable adulthood, she remained unmarried, simply because her mistress could not bear to let her go.


“多谢，多谢！”
“Thank you, thank you!”

胡雪岩笑嘻嘻地问道：
Hu smiled.

“瑞云，你今年几岁？”
“Ruiyun, how old are you?”

瑞云最怕人问她的年纪，提起来有点伤心，
She dreaded being asked her age; the subject hurt her.

但她到底与众不同，这时大大方方地答道：
Yet she was no ordinary woman and answered with composure.

“我今年二十二。”
“Twenty-two this year.”

其实是二十五，瞒掉了三岁。
She was actually twenty-five and had subtracted three years.

“二十二岁倒不象。”胡雪岩有意叫她开开心，
“You don't look twenty-two,” Hu said, deliberately trying to please her.

“我当你二十岁不到。”
“I thought you were under twenty.”

瑞云笑了，笑得很大方，也很妩媚，
Ruiyun smiled openly and charmingly.

只是嘴大了些、好在有雪白整齐的一嘴牙，倒也丝毫不显得难看。
Her mouth was rather large, but her even white teeth kept the smile from being unattractive in the least.

“兄弟！”
“Brother!”

王太太有些紧张，
Mrs Wang sounded anxious.

“你……”
“Are you...”

胡雪岩重重咳嗽了一声，示意她不要说下去，
Hu coughed loudly to stop her.

她要说的一句话他知道，当着瑞云诸多不便，所以阻止。
He knew what she was about to ask and thought it awkward to say before Ruiyun.

瑞云怎会看不出来？
How could Ruiyun fail to notice?

顺手取走了王太太的一只茶杯，毫不着痕迹地躲了开去。
Taking one of Mrs Wang's teacups, she unobtrusively withdrew.

这时王太太才低声问道：“兄弟，你是不是要替瑞云做媒？”
Only then did Mrs Wang ask quietly, “Brother, do you mean to find Ruiyun a husband?”


“有是有这么个想法，先要看王太太的意思。”胡雪岩老实说道：
“I do have that thought, though I must first know your wishes,” Hu answered frankly.

“我看耽误不得了！”
“I don't think it can be put off any longer.”

王太太脸一红，
Mrs Wang blushed.

“我也不瞒你，”
“I won't conceal it from you.

她说，“一则来高不成低不就，
First, the higher matches are beyond us and the lower ones won't do.

二则来，我实在也离不开她。”
Second, I really can't manage without her.”

“这是从前的话，
“That was true before.

现在不同了。”
Things are different now.”

“是的，不同。”
“Yes, different.”

王太太说是这样说，其实不过礼貌上的附和，究竟如何不同，她自己并不知道，
She was merely agreeing politely; she did not really know how things had changed.

胡雪岩看出这一点，
Hu saw this.

自恃交情深厚，觉得有为她坦率指出的必要，不然，话就谈不下去了。
Trusting in the closeness of their friendship, he thought he must explain plainly, or the conversation would go no further.

“王太太！一年多以前，雪公还不曾进京，那时府上的境况，我也有些晓得。
“Mrs Wang, a little over a year ago, before Mr Xuexuan went to the capital, I knew something of your circumstances.

多亏王太太一手调度，熬过这段苦日子，雪公才能脱运交运，
It was your management that carried the household through those hard times and allowed his fortune to turn.

当时自然少不了瑞云这样一个得力帮手……”
Naturally, then, you couldn't do without a capable helper like Ruiyun...”

“啊！”不等他的话完，王太太便抢着打断，是一脸愧歉不安的神情，
“Ah!” She interrupted before he could finish, her face full of uneasy remorse.

“兄弟，你说得不错！
“You're right, Brother!

真正亏得你提醒！”
Thank you for reminding me.”

今昔的不同，让胡雪岩提醒了。
He had made her see the difference between then and now.

做主人家的，宦途得意，扶摇直上，做下人的又如何呢？
The masters were enjoying official success and rising rapidly; what of the servants?

瑞云帮王家撑过一段苦日子，现在也该有所报答了，
Ruiyun had helped them endure hardship and deserved some reward.

再不替她的终身着想，白白耽误了青春，于心何忍呢？
How could Mrs Wang bear to neglect her future and let her youth slip away?

因此，这时候的王太太，不仅是不安，甚至于可说有些着急，最好能立刻找到一个年貌相当，有出息的人，把瑞云嫁了出去。
She was now not merely uneasy but anxious to find, immediately if possible, a promising husband of suitable age and appearance for Ruiyun.


“兄弟，你说，你要替我们瑞云做媒的是哪家？
“Tell me, Brother, whose family is it?

什么出身？
What is the man's background?

有多大年纪？
How old is he?

如果谈得拢，我要相相亲。
If the proposal seems suitable, I want to see him for myself.”

“听她这关切起劲的语气，可知祈望甚奢，
Her eager concern showed that her expectations were high.

嵇鹤龄不可能明媒正娶把瑞云当“填房”，又有六个未成年的儿女，
Ji could not take Ruiyun as a formally married successor to his late wife, and he had six children still under age.

这些情形一说，王太太立刻会摇头。
Mention either fact, and Mrs Wang would shake her head at once.

上手之初就碰个钉子，以后就能够挽回，也很吃力。
If Hu met a refusal at the outset, recovering the position would be difficult even if possible.

所以胡雪岩心里在想，第一句话说出去，就要她动心，不能驳回。
His first words must move her and leave no room for rejection.

这就要用点手腕了！
That required a little manoeuvring.

反正王太太对瑞云再关切，也比不上她对丈夫的关切，
However much she cared for Ruiyun, she cared more for her husband.

不妨就从这上面下手。
He could begin there.

于是他说：“王太太，这头亲事，跟雪公也大有关系，
“Mrs Wang, this marriage concerns Mr Xuexuan closely too.

我说成了，诸事顺利，
If I arrange it, everything will go smoothly.

说不成难免有麻烦。”
If I fail, trouble may follow.”


为他所料的，王太太一听，神态又是一变，
As he had expected, her expression changed again.

不仅关切。还有警惕，
Concern was joined by vigilance.

“兄弟，你来说，没有说不成的道理。”她这样答道，
“Brother, if you're arranging it, there's no reason it shouldn't succeed.

“你做的事都是不错的！”
Whatever you do is sound.”

这句话答得很好，
It was an excellent answer.

使胡雪岩觉得双肩的责任加重，不能不为瑞云设想，
It made Hu feel the weight of responsibility and obliged him to consider Ruiyun's interests.

因而不即回答，在心里把嵇鹤龄的各方面又考虑了一遍。
Instead of replying immediately, he reviewed Ji's qualities once more.

经过这短暂的沉默，王太太也有所领悟了，
In that brief silence, Mrs Wang understood.

“你说的那个人，是不是嵇老爷？”她率直问说。
“Is the man you mean Mr Ji?” she asked directly.

“就是他！”
“It is.”

胡雪岩也考虑停当了，
Hu had finished his deliberation.

“王太太，我要说句老实话，
“Let me speak frankly.

瑞云如果想嫁个做官的，先总只有委屈几年。”接下去他说：
If Ruiyun hopes to marry an official, she'll have to accept some disadvantages for the first few years.

“至于嵇鹤龄这个人，你想也可以想到，
As for Ji himself, you can imagine his qualities.

人品、才干都呱呱叫，
His character and ability are first-rate.

将来一定会得意。
He's certain to succeed.

瑞云嫁了他，一定有的好日子过。”
If she marries him, she will have good days ahead.”

王太太不响，盘算一会问道：“ 嵇老爷今年多大？”
Mrs Wang considered silently, then asked, “How old is he?”

“四十刚刚出头。”
“Just over forty.

胡雪岩说，“人生得后生，看来只有三十多，精神极好。”
He looks young—only in his thirties—and is full of energy.”

“脾气呢？”
“What about his temper?”

“有才干的人，总是有脾气的，不过脾气不会在家里发，
“Talented men generally have a temper, but they don't vent it at home.

在家里象只老虎，在外头象只‘煨灶猫’，这种是最没出息的人。”
A man who's a tiger in his house and a timid cat beside the stove outside it is the most hopeless kind.”

“原是！”
“Indeed!”

王太太笑道：
Mrs Wang smiled.

“只会在家里打老婆，算什么男子汉？”她紧接着又说，“提起这一层，我倒想起来了，怎么说先要瑞云‘委屈’两年，
“What sort of man can do nothing but beat his wife at home?” Then she added, “That reminds me: why did you say Ruiyun must accept disadvantages for a couple of years?

这话我不大懂。”
I don't quite understand.”


“我是说，刚进门没有什么名分。
“I mean she wouldn't have the status of principal wife when she first entered his household.

过个两三年，嵇鹤龄自然会把她‘扶正’。”
After two or three years, he would naturally elevate her to that position.”

王太太对此要考虑，考虑的不是眼前是将来，
Mrs Wang had to consider this, less for the present than for the future.

“兄弟，”她说，“你这句话倒也实在。
“Brother, you're being frank.

不过，将来嵇老爷另外娶了填房，我们瑞云不是落空了吗？”
But if Mr Ji later marries someone else to replace his wife, wouldn't Ruiyun's hopes come to nothing?”

“这可以言明在先的。”
“We can make the condition clear beforehand.”

胡雪岩拍拍胸说，
Hu tapped his chest.

“不然找我媒人说话。”
“If he fails to honour it, come to me, the matchmaker.”

“ ‘满饭好吃，满话难说’！
“A full bowl is easy to eat; a sweeping promise is hard to keep.

我样样事相信你，只有这上头，说实话，我比你见得多，
I trust you in everything, but on this matter, frankly, I've seen more than you.

做媒吃力不讨好的，多得很！
Many matchmakers labour hard and earn only blame.

不然怎么会有‘春媒酱’这句话？
Otherwise, why would people talk about pounding the matchmaker into paste?

我们两家的交情，自然不会这样子，
Naturally our two families would never behave like that towards each other.

到那时候，就只有叫瑞云委屈了！”
If it happened, Ruiyun would simply have to suffer.”

“这要看人说话。
“It depends on the man.

嵇鹤龄是个说一不二的人，
Ji's word is his bond.

除非不答应，答应了一定有信用。
He may refuse to promise, but once he agrees, he'll keep faith.

总而言之一句活，只要瑞云真的贤慧能干，嫁过去一定同偕到老。”
In short, if Ruiyun is truly capable and virtuous, they will grow old together.”


“好了，这层不去说他。”王太太又问：
“Very well, leave that aside,” Mrs Wang said.

“嵇老爷堂上有没有老亲？”
“Does Mr Ji have elderly parents?”

“堂上老亲倒没有。底下有六个小鬼！”
“No parents above him, but six little devils below!”

此是这桩亲事中最大的障碍，胡雪岩特意自己先说破，
This was the greatest obstacle to the match, and Hu deliberately raised it himself.

“不过，王太太，你放心，
“Still, don't worry.

嵇家的家教极好，
The family is well brought up.

六个伢儿都乖得很！”
All six children are very good.”

他一路在说，王太太一路摇头，
She shook her head as he spoke.

“这难了！”她说，
“That makes it difficult!

“你们男人家哪里晓得操持家务的苦楚？
What do you men know of the labour of running a household?

六个伢儿，光是穿鞋子，一年就要做到头，
With six children, making shoes alone would keep her busy all year.

将来瑞云自己再有了儿女，岂不是苦上加苦？”
If she later has children of her own, wouldn't that add hardship to hardship?”

从这里开始，胡雪岩大费唇舌，
From this point Hu spent a great many words.

他的口才超妙，一向无往不利，
His eloquence was extraordinary and had usually carried everything before it.

只有他这一刻，怎么样也不能把王太太说服。
Now, however, nothing could persuade Mrs Wang.

他恭维瑞云能干，繁难的家务，在她手里举重苦轻，
He praised Ruiyun's ability: she could make light work of the most complicated household.

又说嵇鹤龄不久就会得意，可以多用婢仆分劳。
He said Ji would soon advance and could employ more servants to share the burden.

凡此理由都敌不过王太太一句话：“瑞云苦了多年，
Every argument failed before her single answer: “Ruiyun has suffered for years.

我不能再叫她去吃苦！”
I won't send her out to suffer again!”

多说无益，
Further talk was useless.

胡雪岩慢慢自己收篷，
Hu gradually drew back.

所以事难不成，和气未伤，
Though the affair had failed, goodwill remained intact.

王太太当然感到万分歉仄，便留了一个尾巴，说是“慢慢再商量。”
Mrs Wang, deeply apologetic, left an opening: “We can discuss it again later.”


胡雪岩却等不得了，
Hu could not wait.

象这样的事，要做得爽利，才能叫人见情：
A favour of this sort had to be carried through briskly if its recipient was to feel its full value.

因此他另辟蹊径，从王有龄身上着手。
He therefore tried another route, through Wang.

不过要让他硬作主张，王太太也会不高兴，说不定会伤他们夫妻的感情，
But if Wang simply overruled his wife, she would be unhappy and their marriage might suffer.

所以胡雪岩想了一个比较缓和的办法。
Hu devised a gentler plan.

“太太！”王有龄用商量的语气说：“嵇鹤龄这一趟总算是帮了我们全家一个大忙，
“My dear,” Wang said in a consultative tone, “Ji Heling is doing our whole family a great service.

刚才在席上已经谈好了，他后天就动身到新城。
We've just settled it over dinner: he'll leave for Xincheng the day after tomorrow.

不过人家帮了我们的忙，我们也要想想人家的难处。”
Since he's helping us, we must consider his difficulties too.”

“那自然。”
“Naturally.

王太太问道，“嵇老爷眼前有啥难处，怎么帮法。”
What difficulties does he have just now, and how can we help?”

“他是父代母职。
“He's acting as both father and mother.

等一离了家，虽有个老家人，也照顾不了。
Once he leaves, the old family servant won't be able to manage everything.

我想叫瑞云去替他管几天家。”
I'd like Ruiyun to keep house for him for a few days.”

王太太笑了，
Mrs Wang smiled.

“这一定是雪岩想出来的花佯。”
“This must be one of Xueyan's devices.”

“雪岩绝顶聪明，
“He's exceptionally clever.

他想出来的花样，不会错的。”
A device of his won't go wrong.”


“我不是说他错。”王太太问：
“I'm not saying it's wrong,” she replied.

“不过其中到底是什么花样？总也得说出来，我才会明白。
“But you must explain the device before I can understand it.”

““是这样子，
“This is what he means.

雪岩的意思，一则替嵇鹤龄管几天家，让他可以无后顾之忧，
First, Ruiyun can manage Ji's household for a few days so he can leave without domestic worries.

二则让瑞云去看看情形，
Second, she can see the situation for herself.

如果觉得嵇鹤龄为人合得来，他家几个孩子也听话，瑞云认为应付得下，那就再好都没有。
If she finds him agreeable, the children obedient, and the household within her abilities, nothing could be better.

否则就作罢，从此大家不谈这件事，一点痕迹不留，
Otherwise we abandon the idea and never mention it again, leaving no trace of the proposal.

岂不甚好？”
Wouldn't that be excellent?”

“这好，这好！”
“Yes, yes!”

王太太大为点头，
Mrs Wang nodded vigorously.

“这我就没话说了。”
“I have no objection to that.”

“不过我倒要劝你。”王有龄又说，
“But let me offer some advice too,” Wang continued.

“象嵇鹤龄这样的人，凭心而论，是个人才，
“To be fair, a man like Ji has real talent.

只要脾气稍为变得圆通些，以他的仪表才具，不怕不得意。
If he becomes a little more accommodating, his bearing and ability will certainly bring success.

瑞云嫁了他，眼前或许苦一点，将来一定有福享。
Ruiyun may have some hardship at first, but later she will enjoy prosperity.

再说，彼此结成至好，再连上这门亲，你们可以常来常往，
Besides, once we're close friends and this marriage links us too, you could visit each other often.

不也蛮热闹有趣的吗？”
Wouldn't that be pleasant?”

这句话倒是把王太太说动了。
This persuaded her.

既然是讲感情，为瑞云着想以外，也要为自己想想，
Affection required some consideration for herself as well as for Ruiyun.

不管瑞云嫁人为妻还是为妾，堂客的往来，总先要看“官客”的交情，
Whether Ruiyun became wife or concubine, relations between the women would depend first on relations between the men.

地位不同，行辈不符，“老爷”们少有交往，内眷们就不容易轧得拢淘。
Differences of rank or generation, or husbands who rarely met, made it difficult for their households' women to associate comfortably.

自己老爷与嵇老爷，以后定会常在一起，
Wang and Ji would certainly see much of each other.

真正成了通家之好，那跟瑞云见面的机会，自然就会多了。
As friends whose families visited freely, they would give her ample opportunity to see Ruiyun.

因此，她欣欣然把瑞云找了来，将这件事的前后经过，和盘托出，首先也就是强调彼此可以常来常往，接着便许了她一份嫁妆，最后问她的意思如何？
She therefore happily summoned the maid and explained the entire proposal, emphasising first that they could visit often, then promising a dowry, and finally asking what she thought.


当胡雪岩和王有龄跟王太太在谈此事时，瑞云早就在“听壁脚”了，
Ruiyun had already been listening through the wall while Hu and Wang discussed the matter with their mistress.

终身大事，心里一直在盘算，
It concerned the rest of her life, and she had been considering it throughout.

她觉得这时候自以不表示态度为宜，
She felt it best not to declare herself yet.

所以这样答道：“嵇老爷替老爷去办公事，
“Mr Ji is undertaking official business for the master.

他家没有人，我自然该替他去管几天家。
With no one to manage his household, naturally I should do it for a few days.

以后的事谁晓得呢？”
Who can say what comes afterwards?”

“这话也对！”
“That's reasonable too.”

王太太是想怂恿她好好花些功夫下去，好使得嵇鹤龄倾心，但却不便明言，
Mrs Wang wanted her to make a special effort and win Ji's heart, but could not say so openly.

因而用了个激将法：
Instead she challenged her pride.

“不过，我有点担心，
“Only I'm a little worried.

他家伢儿多，家也难管，
He has so many children, and the household will be hard to manage.

将来说起来，‘管与不管一样’，这句话，就不好听了。”
It would sound very bad if people later said, ‘Her being there made no difference.’”

瑞云不响，心里冷笑，
Ruiyun said nothing, but inwardly scoffed.

怎说“管与不管一样”呢？
No difference?

明天管个样子出来看肴，
She would show them what proper management looked like tomorrow.

你就知道了。
Then they would know.


于是第二天一早，瑞云带了个衣箱，由高升陪着，一顶小轿，来到嵇家。
Early the next morning, Ruiyun took a clothes chest and travelled in a small sedan chair to Ji's house, accompanied by Gao Sheng.

嵇鹤龄已预先听胡雪岩来说过，深为领情，
Hu had already explained the arrangement to Ji, who was deeply grateful.

对瑞云自然也另眼相看，称她“瑞姑娘”，让儿女们叫她“瑞阿姨”。
He treated Ruiyun with special respect, calling her “Miss Rui” and telling his children to address her as “Aunt Rui.”

“瑞姑娘，多多费心，多多拜托！”嵇鹤龄不胜感激地说，
“Miss Rui, I'm putting you to a great deal of trouble,” he said earnestly.

“有你来帮忙，我可以放心了。
“With your help I can set my mind at rest.

这个家从今天起，就算交了给你了，
From today, I entrust this household to you.

孩子们不乖，该打该骂，
If the children misbehave, scold or punish them as necessary.

不必客气。”
Don't hesitate.”

“哪有这个道理？”瑞云浅浅地笑首，把他那个大眼睛的小女儿搂在怀里，眼角扫着那五个大的，
“How could I do such a thing?” she answered with a faint smile, drawing his youngest, large-eyed daughter into her arms while surveying the five older children.

正好三男三女，
There were exactly three boys and three girls.

老大是男的，看上去极其忠厚老实。
The eldest, a boy, looked thoroughly honest and good-natured.

老二是女孩，有十二岁左右，生得很瘦，一双眼睛却特别灵活，话也最多，
The second was a thin girl of about twelve, with unusually lively eyes and more to say than anyone else.

一望而知，不易对付。
She was plainly not easy to manage.

她心里在想，要把这个家管好，先得把这个“二小姐”收服。
To run this household well, Ruiyun thought, she must first win over this Second Miss.

“瑞姑娘！”嵇鹤龄打断了她的思路，
“Miss Rui!” Ji interrupted her thoughts.

“我把钥匙交给你。”
“Let me give you the keys.”

当家的钥匙，就好比做官的印信，
A housekeeper's keys were like an official's seal.

瑞云当仁不让，把一串沉甸甸的钥匙接了过来。
Ruiyun accepted the heavy bunch without hesitation.

接着，嵇鹤龄又唤了张贵和一个名叫小青的小丫头来，为她引见。
Ji then summoned Zhang Gui and a young maid named Xiaoqing and introduced them.

交代这一些，他站起身来要出门了。
Having explained these arrangements, he rose to go out.


“嵇老爷，”瑞云问，“是不是回家吃饭？”
“Mr Ji, will you be home for a meal?” Ruiyun asked.

“明天就要动身，今天有好些事要料理，
“I leave tomorrow, and there's much to arrange today.

中午赶不回来，晚上有个饭局。”
I can't get back for lunch, and I have a dinner engagement.”

“那么，行李要收拾？”
“Then your luggage needs packing?”

“这要麻烦你了！
“I must trouble you with that.

行李不多带。”
I won't take much.

嵇鹤龄说，“每趟出门，我都带张贵一起走，这一次不必了。
I usually bring Zhang Gui when I travel, but this time he needn't come.

要带些什么东西，张贵知道。”
He knows what I require.”

嵇鹤龄到二更天才回家，带了个客人来：胡雪岩。
Ji did not return until the second watch that evening, bringing a guest: Hu Xueyan.

一进门便觉得不同，
The moment he entered, he felt the difference.

走廊上不似平常那样黑得不堪辨识，
The passage was no longer so dark that he could scarcely see.

淡月映照，相当明亮，
Pale moonlight made it quite bright.

细看时是窗纸重新糊过了。
Looking closely, he saw that the windows had been repapered.

走到里面，只见收拾得井井有条，
Inside, everything stood in order.

乱七八糟、不该摆在客厅里的东西，都已移了开去，
All the miscellaneous objects that had cluttered the reception room had been removed.

嵇鹤龄顿有耳目清凉之感，不由得就想起太太在世的日子。
The fresh clarity of the house immediately recalled the days when his wife was alive.


“嵇老爷回来了！”
“Mr Ji is home!”

瑞云从里面迎了出来，接着又招呼了胡雪岩。
Ruiyun came from the inner rooms to greet him, then welcomed Hu.

“费心，费心！”
“You've taken such trouble!”

嵇鹤龄满面含笑的拱手道谢。
Ji smiled broadly and clasped his hands in thanks.

“如何？”胡雪岩很得意的笑道：
“Well?” Hu asked with satisfaction.

“我说这位瑞姑娘很能干吧！”
“Didn't I say Miss Rui was capable?”

“岂但能干？
“More than capable.

才德俱备。”
She has both ability and virtue.”

这完全是相亲的话了，
This was plainly the language of assessing a bride.

否则短期作客，代理家会，哪里谈得到什么“才德”？
Otherwise, why speak of “ability and virtue” in a guest temporarily managing the house?

瑞云懂他们的话，但自觉必须装得不懂。
Ruiyun understood, but felt she must pretend not to.

从从容容地指挥小青倒茶、装水烟。
Calmly she directed Xiaoqing to pour tea and prepare the water pipe.

等主客二人坐定了才说，煮了香粳米粥在那里，如果觉得饿了，随时可以开出来吃。
Only when host and guest were seated did she say that she had cooked some fragrant rice congee, ready to serve whenever they felt hungry.

嵇鹤龄未曾开口，胡雪岩先就欣然道好：
Before Ji could answer, Hu welcomed the suggestion.

“正想吃碗粥！”
“Just what I was wanting!”

于是瑞云转身出去，跟着就端了托盘进来，四个碟子，一壶嵇鹤龄吃惯了的‘玫瑰烧“，一瓦罐热粥，
Ruiyun went out and returned with a tray: four small dishes, a pot of Ji's usual rose spirit, and an earthenware pot of hot congee.

食物的味道不知如何？餐具却是异常精洁。
Whatever the food might taste like, the utensils were exceptionally clean and fine.

嵇鹤龄从太太去世，一切因陋就简，
Since his wife's death, Ji had made do with the barest arrangements.

此刻看见吃顿粥也颇象个样子，自然觉得高兴。
To see even a simple supper presented properly naturally pleased him.


“来，来！”他招呼着客人说：
“Come, come!” he urged his guest.

“这才叫‘借花献佛’，
“This truly is offering the Buddha someone else's flowers.

如果不是瑞姑娘，我简直无可待客。”
Without Miss Rui, I'd have nothing fit to serve you.”

“嵇老爷！”
“Mr Ji!”

瑞云心里也舒服，但觉得他老是说这么客气的话，却是大可不必，
Ruiyun was pleased too, though she thought his repeated courtesies unnecessary.

“你说得我都难为情了。
“You'll embarrass me.

既然来到府上，这都是我该做的事，
Since I've come here, these things are simply my duty.

只怕伺候得不周到，嵇老爷你多包涵！”
I only hope you'll forgive anything I fail to do properly.”

说着，深深看了他一眼，才低下头去盛粥。
She gave him a deep look before lowering her head to ladle the congee.

看他们这神情，胡雪岩知道好事必谐，便忍不住要开玩笑了，
From their manner, Hu knew the match would succeed and could not resist a joke.

“鹤龄兄，”他说，“你们倒真是相敬如宾！”
“Brother Heling, you really do treat each other with the respect due to honoured guests!”

“原是客人嘛！”嵇鹤龄说：
“She is a guest,” Ji replied.

“应当敬重。”
“Of course I should respect her.”

瑞云不响，她也懂胡雪岩那句话，只觉得怎么样说都不好，
The phrase also described the mutual courtesy of an exemplary married couple. Ruiyun understood Hu's meaning but could think of no suitable answer.

所以仍旧是装作不懂，悄悄退了出去。
Still pretending not to understand, she quietly withdrew.


“鹤龄兄，”目送她的背影消失，胡雪岩换了个座位，由对面而侧坐，隔着桌角。低声说道，“此刻我要跟你谈正事了。
Watching her disappear, Hu moved from the seat opposite Ji to one beside him, across the corner of the table. He lowered his voice. “Brother Heling, now for serious business.

你看如何？”
What do you think?”

这样逼着问，嵇鹤龄不无受窘之感，
Pressed so directly, Ji felt embarrassed.

笑着推托说：
He smiled and tried to postpone the matter.

“等我新城回来，再谈也不迟。”
“There'll be time to discuss it when I return from Xincheng.”

“对！
“Certainly.

本来应该这样。
Ordinarily that would be right.

不过，我等你一走，也要马上赶到上海去。
But the moment you leave, I must hurry to Shanghai.

彼此已成知交，我不瞒你，我的一家一当都在那几船丝上，
We're close friends now, so I'll be frank: everything I own is tied up in those boatloads of silk.

实在怕路上会出毛病，
I'm afraid of trouble on the journey.

这话一时也说不清楚，且不去谈它。
That's too complicated to explain now, so let it pass.

到了上海，我要看机会脱手，
Once in Shanghai, I must wait for an opportunity to sell.

说不定要两三个月才能回来，
It may be two or three months before I return.

那时你早就回到了杭州。
You'll be back in Hangzhou long before then.

你们情投意合，就等我这个媒人。
Suppose you two are fond of each other and have to wait for the matchmaker.

你们急，我也急，
You'd be anxious, and so would I.

倒不如趁现在做好了媒再走。
Better to arrange the match now, before I leave.

喜酒赶不赶得上，就无所谓了。”
Whether I make it back for the wedding feast doesn't matter.”

“阁下真是一片热肠！”
“You are kindness itself!”

嵇鹤龄敬了他一杯酒，借此沉吟，
Ji offered him a toast, using the pause to consider.

总觉得不宜操之过急，
He still felt they should not hurry.

便歉然说道：“可能再让我看一看？”
“Could you give me a little longer to observe?” he asked apologetically.


“还看什么？”
“What more is there to observe?”

胡雪岩不以为然地问他：
Hu objected.

“第一，你我的眼光，看这么个人还看不透？
“First, with your judgement and mine, can't we see what sort of person she is?

第二，如果不是你所说的‘才德俱备’，王太太又何至于当她心肝宝贝样，留到这个岁数还不放？”
Second, unless she possessed the ability and virtue you praised, would Mrs Wang have treasured her so much that she kept her unmarried until this age?”

“这倒是实话。”
“That's true.”

“再跟你说句实话，纳宠到底不比正娶，
“And frankly, taking a concubine isn't the same as marrying a principal wife.

不用想得那么多。”
There's no need for so much deliberation.”

“好了！
“Very well.

我从命就是了。”
I'll obey.”

嵇鹤龄又敬他酒，表示谢媒。
Ji offered another toast, thanking him as matchmaker.

“慢慢，
“Not so fast!

你从我的命，我的命令还没有下呢！”
You promise to obey, but I haven't given my instructions yet.

胡雪岩说：“我在王太太面前拍了胸脯来的，如果三两年以后，她没有什么错处，你就要预备送她一副‘诰封’。”
I've pledged my word to Mrs Wang: if after two or three years Ruiyun has given no cause for complaint, you must be ready to obtain an imperial patent of rank for her.”

“那自然。
“Naturally.

我也不会再续娶了，
I shan't marry another principal wife.

将来把她扶正好了。”
In due course I'll raise her to that position.”

“话是你说的。”
“Those are your own words.”

胡雪岩特意再钉一句：
Hu deliberately pressed the point.

“你将来会不会做蔡伯喈、陈世美？
“Will you turn into a Cai Bojie or a Chen Shimei and abandon her later?

这要‘言明在先’，我好有交代。”嵇鹤龄笑了，
We must settle this beforehand, so I can answer for it.” Ji laughed.

“亏你想得出！”
“What an idea!

他说，“我又不会中状元，
I'm not going to become the top examination graduate.

哪里来的‘相府招亲’？”
Where would a prime minister's offer of his daughter's hand come from?”


“我想想你也不是那种人！
“I don't believe you're that sort of man either.

那我这头媒，就算做成功了。
Then my work as matchmaker is done.

好日子你们自己去挑，
You can choose the auspicious day yourselves.

王太太当嫁女儿一样，有份嫁妆。
Mrs Wang will provide a dowry as though marrying off a daughter.

至于你的聘礼，”胡雪岩说，“有两个办法，
As for your betrothal gift, there are two ways.

你挑一个。”
Choose one.”

“这也是新鲜话。
“That's a new idea.

你说个数目，我来张罗好了，
Tell me the amount, and I'll find it.

哪里还有什么办法好挑？”
What is there to choose?”

“我做事向来与众不同。
“I always do things differently.

第一，我想以三方面的交情，你的聘礼可以免了。
First, given the friendship among all three parties, I think the gift could be waived.

第二，如果你一定要替尊宠做面子，我放笔款子给你。
Second, if you insist on doing your future companion proper honour, I'll lend you the money.

两个办法你自己挑。”
Choose for yourself.”

“我自然要给她做面子，
“Naturally I must do her honour.

而且已经很见王太太的情了，
Besides, I already owe Mrs Wang a great deal.

聘礼不可免。”
The betrothal gift cannot be omitted.”

嵇鹤龄沉吟了一会说，
Ji reflected.

“借钱容易，还起来就难了。”
“Borrowing is easy; repayment is difficult.”

“一点都不难。
“Not difficult at all.

这趟新城的差使办成功，黄抚台一定放你出去，说不定就是雪公湖州府下面的县缺。
Once you complete the Xincheng assignment, Governor Huang is certain to give you a post—perhaps a county under Mr Xuexuan's Huzhou prefecture.

那时候你还怕没有钱还帐。”
Would you still fear being unable to repay?”

嵇鹤龄通盘考虑了一下，认为这笔钱可以借，
Ji considered the matter as a whole and decided the loan was reasonable.

便点点头说：
He nodded.

“我向宝号借一千银子。
“I'll borrow a thousand taels from your bank.

利息可要照算，不然我不借。”
But charge the usual interest, or I won't take it.”


胡雪岩不响，从马褂夹袋里掏出一叠银票，拣了一张放在嵇鹤龄面前，
Without a word, Hu took a sheaf of banknotes from an inner pocket of his jacket, selected one, and laid it before Ji.

数目正是一千两。
It was for exactly a thousand taels.

“你倒真痛快！”嵇鹤龄笑道：
“You certainly act promptly!” Ji laughed.

“也真巴结！”
“And you certainly cultivate your customers!”

“我开钱庄做生意，
“I run a bank.

怎么能不巴结？
How could I do otherwise?

你把银票收好，
Put the note away safely.

如果要到我阜康立折子，找我的档手，名叫刘庆生。”
If you'd like to open an account at Fukang, ask for my chief clerk, Liu Qingsheng.”

“多谢了！
“Thank you.

我先写张借据。”
First let me write a promissory note.”

这也现成，
Hu was prepared for this too.

胡雪岩随身带着个“皮护书”，里面有空白梅红八行笺，墨盒和水笔。
He carried a leather writing wallet containing blank plum-red paper ruled in eight columns, an inkbox, and a brush.

嵇鹤龄用他那笔凝重中不失妩媚的苏字，即席写了张借据，连同银票一起交了过去。
In his calligraphy after Su Shi, dignified yet graceful, Ji wrote out the note on the spot and handed it back together with the banknote.

“这为啥？”胡雪岩指着银票，诧异地问。
“Why this?” Hu asked in surprise, pointing to the money.

“礼啊！”
“The betrothal gift!

嵇鹤龄说，“我明天一早就动身了，拜托你‘大冰老爷’，代为备个全帖，送了过去。”
I leave early tomorrow, so I must trouble you, my distinguished matchmaker, to prepare the formal card and deliver it for me.”

“这也不必这么多……”
“There's no need for so much...”

“不，不！”嵇鹤龄抢着说，
“No, no!” Ji interrupted.

“十斛量珠，我自觉已太菲薄了。”
“Even ten measures of pearls would seem a meagre gift to me.”


胡雪岩想了想说：
Hu considered.

“也好。
“Very well.

我倒再问你一声，你预备什么时候办喜事？”
Now tell me, when do you intend to hold the wedding?”

“既然事已定局，自然越快越好。
“Since it's settled, naturally the sooner the better.

不让我怕委屈了瑞云。”嵇鹤龄说：“果然如你所说的，新城之行，圆满归来，有个‘印把子’抓在手里，她不也算‘掌印夫人’了？”
Otherwise I fear Ruiyun will be left in an awkward position.” Ji continued, “If, as you say, I return successfully from Xincheng and receive a magistrate's seal, won't she be an official's lady?”

“你这样想法，我倒要劝你，”
“If that's your thinking, I must advise you...”

胡雪岩居然也掉了句文：
Hu, too, produced a literary phrase.

“少安勿躁。”
“Have patience; do not be hasty.”

“对！
“Quite right.

我听你的话。”嵇鹤龄欣然同意：
I'll follow your advice.” Ji agreed gladly.

而且也要等你回来，
“Besides, we must wait for you to return.

我叫她当筵谢媒！“
I'll have her thank the matchmaker at the feast!”


他们在大谈瑞云，先还有些顾忌，轻声相语，
At first the two men had discussed Ruiyun in lowered voices, with some restraint.

到后来声音越说越大，
As they went on, they spoke louder and louder.

瑞云想不听亦不可得，
Ruiyun could not have avoided hearing even if she had wished.

一个人悄悄坐在门背后，听得心里一阵阵发紧，有些喘不过气来，
Sitting quietly behind the door, she felt her heart tighten again and again until she almost struggled for breath.

特别是那“掌印夫人”四个字，入耳应象含了块糖在嘴里。
The words “an official's lady” were particularly sweet, like a piece of sugar in her mouth.

不过她始终觉得有些不大服贴的感觉，
Yet something continued to trouble her.

无论如何总要先探一探自己的口气！
Surely they ought at least to sound out her wishes first!

就看得那么准，把得那么稳，自作主张在商量办喜事的日子！
They seemed so certain of her, so confident of their hold, that they were already deciding the wedding date between themselves.

还说“谢媒”，
And “thank the matchmaker”!

难道一定就知道自己不会反对？
How did they know she would not object?

说啥是哈，听凭摆布。
Did they suppose she would accept whatever they said and let herself be arranged as they pleased?

正在这样盘算，听得外面嵇鹤龄在喊：“瑞姑娘！”
While she was thinking this, Ji called, “Miss Rui!”

“来了！”
“Coming!”

她答应一声，手已经摸到门帘上，忽又缩了回来，
Her hand reached the curtain, then withdrew.

摸一摸自己的脸，
She touched her face.

果然有些发烫。
It was indeed warm.

这样子走不出去。
She could hardly appear like this.

但不出去恰好告诉人她在偷听，
Yet failing to come would reveal that she had been listening.

想一想还是掀帘而出，却远远地垂手站着。
After a moment she lifted the curtain and went out, but stood some distance away with her hands at her sides.


“瑞云，”胡雪岩说道：“我要走了！”
“Ruiyun,” Hu said, “I'm leaving.”

“等我来点灯笼。”
“I'll light the lantern.”

她正好借此又避了开去。
She welcomed the excuse to withdraw again.

“不忙，不忙！
“No hurry.

我有句话问你。”
I have something to ask you.”

“是，胡老爷请说。”
“Yes, Mr Hu?”

“嵇老爷因为你替他管家，承情不尽，
“Mr Ji is deeply grateful for your management of his household.

托我在上海买点东西来送你。
He's asked me to buy you something in Shanghai.

你不必客气，
Don't be shy.

喜欢什么，跟我说！”
Tell me what you'd like.”

“不敢当。”瑞云答道：
“I couldn't accept such kindness,” she replied.

“怎么好要嵇老爷破费？”
“How could I let Mr Ji spend money on me?”

“不要客气，不要客气！”
“Don't stand on ceremony.

你自己说。
Tell me yourself.

“胡雪岩又说，”如果你不说，我买了一大堆来，跟你们嵇老爷算帐，
If you don't,” Hu added, “I'll buy a whole heap of things and charge them to your Mr Ji.

反而害他大大地破费了！“
That would cost him far more!”


瑞云心想，这位胡老爷实在厉害！
What a formidable man this Mr Hu was, Ruiyun thought.

也不知道他的话是真是假？
She could not tell whether he was serious.

真的买了一大堆用不着的东西回来，虽不是自己花钱，也会心疼。
If he really brought back a pile of useless things, she would regret the waste even though it was not her own money.

照此看来，还是自己说了为是。
Apparently it would be better to state her wishes.

不过瑞云也很会说话，
Yet Ruiyun also knew how to speak.

“胡老爷跟嵇老爷也是好朋友，
“You're Mr Ji's good friend.

不肯让嵇老爷太破费的。”
You wouldn't let him spend too much.”

她看了嵇鹤龄一眼又说：“胡老爷看着办好了。”
She glanced at Ji and added, “I'll leave it to your judgement.”

“这也是一句话，
“That's an answer too.

有你这句话，我就好办事了。
With your permission, I can act.

总而言之，包你们都满意，一个不心疼，一个不肉痛！”
In short, I'll satisfy you both: one won't feel it in the heart, and the other won't feel it in the purse.”

皮里阳秋，似嘭似谑，
There was a hidden judgement beneath the teasing.

嵇鹤龄皱眉，瑞云脸红，
Ji frowned and Ruiyun blushed.

她不想再站在那里，福一福说：
Unwilling to remain there, she curtsied.

“谢谢胡老爷跟嵇老爷！”
“Thank you, Mr Hu and Mr Ji.”

然后转身就走。
Then she turned away.

“如何？”胡雪岩很得意地说，
“Well?” Hu said triumphantly.

“处处都回护着你，
“She's protecting your interests at every turn.

刚刚进门，就是贤内助了！”
She's hardly entered the house and is already a devoted helpmate!”

嵇鹤龄撮两指按在唇上，示意禁声，接着指一指里面，轻声说道：“何苦让她受窘？”胡雪岩又笑了：
Ji pressed two fingers to his lips for silence, pointed towards the inner rooms, and asked softly, “Why embarrass her?” Hu laughed again.

“好！
“Good!

她回护你，你回护她。
She protects you, and you protect her.

看来我这头媒，做得倒真是阴功积德。”
It seems this match really will earn me merit for doing good.”

一面说，一面往外走。
Still talking, he moved towards the door.

这时瑞云已将在打盹的张贵唤醒，点好灯笼，
Ruiyun had roused the drowsing Zhang Gui and lit the lantern.

主仆两人把胡雪岩送出大门外，看他上了轿子才进去。
Master and servant accompanied Hu outside, returning only after he had entered his chair.


于是检点了行李，嵇鹤龄又嘱咐张贵，事事听“瑞姑娘”作主，小心照料门户。
Ji checked his luggage, then instructed Zhang Gui to obey Miss Rui in everything and guard the house carefully.

等男仆退出，他才问：“瑞姑娘住在哪间屋子？”
When the servant had withdrawn, he asked, “Which room are you using, Miss Rui?”

“我跟二小姐一屋……”
“I'm sharing with the Second Miss...”

“瑞姑娘！”嵇鹤龄打断她的话说，“小孩子，
“Miss Rui,” Ji interrupted, “she's only a child.

不敢当你这样的称呼。
She doesn't deserve such a formal title from you.

你叫她名字好了，
Call her by her name.

她叫丹荷……“他把他六个儿子的名字，一一告诉了她。
It's Danhe...” He told her the names of all six children.

“叫名字我也不敢。”瑞云平静地答道，
“I wouldn't presume to call them simply by name either,” Ruiyun answered calmly.

“叫官官吧！”
“I'll use guan.”

江南缙绅之家，通称子女叫“官”，或者用排行，或者用名字，
In Jiangnan gentry households, children were commonly addressed with guan, attached either to their place in the family or to part of their name.

丹荷就是“荷官”，
Danhe would thus become Heguan.

这是个不分尊卑的“官称”，嵇鹤龄便也不再“谦辞”了。
It was a customary form that implied neither superiority nor inferiority, so Ji offered no further polite objection.


“瑞姑娘，我再说一句，舍间完全奉托了！孩子们都要请你照应。”
“Let me say again, Miss Rui: I entrust the entire household to you, and all the children to your care.”

“嵇老爷你请放心，
“Set your mind at rest, Mr Ji.

府上的事都有我。”
I'll attend to everything here.”

瑞云这时对他的感觉不同了，
Ruiyun now felt differently about him.

隐隐然有终身倚靠的念头，所以对他此行的安危，不能不关心，
A vague sense that he might become her lifelong support made her concerned for his safety on this journey.

但话又不便明说，只这样问起，“嵇老爷这趟出门，不晓得哪天才能回来？”
Yet she could not say so plainly and merely asked, “When do you expect to return?”

“也不会太久，
“It shouldn't take long.

快则半个月，最多一个月工夫，
A fortnight if things go quickly, a month at most.

我相信公事一定可以办好了。”
I'm confident I can settle the business.”

“听说这趟公事很麻烦？”
“I hear it's a very troublesome affair?”

“事在人为。”
“Much depends on the man.”

嵇鹤龄说了这句成语，怕她不懂，因而又作解释：“事情要看什么人办？
Afraid she might not understand the saying, Ji explained, “It depends on who handles it.

我去了，大概可以办得下来。”
If I go, I should be able to manage.”

“如果办不下来呢？”
“And if you can't?”

办不下来就性命交关了！
If he failed, his life would be at stake.

嵇鹤龄也体谅得到她的心情，怕吓了她，不肯说实话。
But he understood her feelings and would not frighten her with the truth.

“不要紧！”他用极具信心的语气说：
“Don't worry,” he said with complete confidence.

“一定办得来。”
“I shall certainly manage it.”


瑞云的脸上，果然是宽慰的表情。
Ruiyun's face did indeed relax.

她还有许多话想问，苦于第一天见面，身分限制，难以启齿。
She had many more questions, but it was their first day together, and the limits of her position made them hard to ask.

但又舍不得走，
Yet she could not bear to leave.

就只好低头站在那里，作出伺候垂询的样子。
She stood with her head lowered, as though waiting for further instructions.

嵇鹤龄觉得气氛有些僵硬，不便于深谈，便说了句：
Ji found the atmosphere stiff and unsuitable for deeper conversation.

“你请坐！
“Please sit down.

以后见面的日子还有，
We shall have many more days together.

一拘束，就不象一家人了。”
If we're so constrained, we won't feel like one family.”

这话说得相当露骨，
The words were quite explicit.

如果照他的话坐下来，便等于承认是“一家人”了。
Sitting as he asked would amount to acknowledging that they were one family.

她心里虽异常关切嵇鹤龄，但表面上却不愿有任何倾心委身的表示，
Though she cared greatly about him, she did not want to show openly that she had given him her heart and her future.

因为一则不免羞涩，再则对他和胡雪岩还存着一丝莫名其妙的反感，有意矜持。
She was shy; besides, a trace of inexplicable resentment towards him and Hu remained, prompting deliberate reserve.

看她依旧站着，嵇鹤龄很快地又说了句：“你请坐啊！”
Seeing her still standing, Ji quickly repeated, “Do sit down.”

“不要紧！”
“I'm quite all right.”

她还是不肯依。
She still would not comply.

于是嵇鹤龄不自觉地也站了起来，
Without realising it, Ji rose too.

捧着一管水烟袋，一路捻纸捻，一路跟她说话，主要的是问她的家世，
Holding his water pipe and twisting paper spills, he talked with her, chiefly asking about her family background.

瑞云有问必答，
She answered every question.

一谈谈到三更天，方始各归寝室。
They continued until the third watch before finally going to their separate rooms.


这应该是嵇鹤龄悼亡以后，睡得最舒服的一夜，
This should have been Ji's most comfortable night since his bereavement.

因为他的床铺经瑞云彻底的整理过了，雪白的夏布帐子，抹得极干净的草席，新换的枕头衣。
Ruiyun had thoroughly put his bed in order: spotless white ramie curtains, a scrupulously wiped sleeping mat, and a fresh pillow cover.

大床后面的搁板上，收拾得整整齐齐，有茶有书，
The shelf behind the large bed was neatly arranged, with tea and books ready.

帐子外的一盏油灯，剔得极亮，如果睡不着可以看书消遣。
Outside the curtains, the oil lamp had been trimmed to burn brightly, so he could read if unable to sleep.

他睡不着，但也不曾看书，
He could not sleep, but he did not read.

双眼已有些涩倦，而神思亢奋，心里想到许多事，
His eyes were already dry and tired, while his mind remained excited and crowded with thoughts.

最要紧的一件是新城之行的估量。
Above all, he was assessing the journey to Xincheng.

最初激于胡雪岩的交情，王有龄的礼遇，挺身而出，不计后果，
At first, moved by Hu's friendship and Wang's courtesy, he had volunteered without counting the consequences.

此刻想想，不能只凭一股锐气，做了再说。
Now he saw that he could not simply act on courage and consider the rest afterwards.

到新城以后，如何下手，固非临机不可，但是成败之算，应有筹划。
What to do on arrival would necessarily depend on circumstances, but success and failure both required forethought.

身入危城，随便什么人不可能有万全之计，
No one entering a city in danger could devise an entirely safe plan.

倘或被害，身后六个儿女怎么办？
If he were killed, what would become of his six children?

当然，朝廷有抚恤，上官会周济，
Naturally there would be an allowance from the court and help from his superiors.

然而这都要看人的恩惠，
But these depended on others' generosity.

总得有个切实可靠，能够托孤的人才好。
He needed someone truly dependable to whom he could entrust the children if they were orphaned.


念头转到这里，自然就想到了胡雪岩。
This naturally brought Hu to mind.

心里不免失悔，如果早见及此，
Ji regretted not having considered it sooner.

趁今晚上就可以切切实实拜托一番，
Had he done so, he could have made a serious, explicit request that evening.

现在只好留个“遗嘱”了。
Now he could only leave something like a will.

于是他重新起身，把油灯移到桌上，展开纸笔，却又沉吟不定。
He rose again, moved the lamp to the table, and laid out paper and brush, but hesitated.

留遗嘱似乎太严重了些，
A will seemed too grave.

这对胡雪岩会是很大的一个负担。
It would place a heavy burden on Hu.

考虑了很久，忽有妙悟，自己觉得很得意。
He considered for a long while, then suddenly found an ingenious solution that pleased him greatly.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十二章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Twelve, first part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第十二章｜CHAPTER TWELVE


到新城先到富阳，走钱塘江这条水路。
To reach Xincheng, one first travelled to Fuyang by water along the Qiantang River.

等送行的王有龄一走，嵇鹤龄把胡雪岩留了下来，
Once Wang, who had come to see him off, had left, Ji asked Hu to stay a little longer.

说还有几句话要谈。
There were still a few things he wished to say.

到船舱中坐定，他从拜匣里取出一张梅红单帖，放在胡雪岩面前，
Seated in the cabin, he took a plum-red card from his visiting-card box and placed it before Hu.

上面写的是“嵇鹤龄，以字行。
It read: “Ji Heling, known by his courtesy name.

湖北罗田人，
Native of Luotian, Hubei.

嘉庆二十一年十月初四午时生。”
Born at the noon hour on the fourth day of the tenth month, in the twenty-first year of Jiaqing.”

“喔！”胡雪岩笑道：
“Oh!” Hu laughed.

“你倒真巴结，
“You certainly don't waste time.

应该我先去讨瑞云的八字来给你。
I ought to have obtained Ruiyun's birth particulars for you first.

其实，这也可以不必。
Though really, we could dispense with this.”

““不是，不是！”
“No, no!”

嵇鹤龄摇着手说，
Ji waved his hand.

“这张帖子是交给你的。
“The card is for you.

雪岩兄，我想高攀，我们拜个把子。”
Brother Xueyan, I hope you will grant me the honour of becoming my sworn brother.”

“这……”
“This...”

胡雪岩愣了一下，接着喜逐颜开地说：
Hu paused in surprise, then beamed.

“那是我高攀了！
“The honour would be mine!

不过，此刻来不及备帖子，但是也要磕个头。”
I haven't time to prepare a card now, but we must at least bow.”

“这都好办，
“That can all be arranged.

等我新城回来再行礼。”嵇鹤龄说：
We can perform the ceremony when I return from Xincheng.

“相知贵相知心。
What matters in friendship is understanding each other's hearts.

如果你不嫌弃，此刻我们就改称呼。
If you accept me, let's change our forms of address now.

你今年贵庚？”
How old are you?”


“我小得多。”
“Much younger than you.”

胡雪岩改了称呼，叫一声：
Hu adopted the new form at once.

“大哥！”
“Elder Brother!”

接着便给“大哥”磕头。
Then he knelt to bow to him.

嵇鹤龄急忙也跪下还礼，自然称他“二弟”。
Ji hastily knelt in return, naturally calling him “Second Brother.”

两人对拜了一拜，连“撮土为香”都用不着，就结成了异姓手足。
They exchanged a bow and became brothers of different surnames without even taking a pinch of earth to serve as incense.

拜罢起身，彼此肩上的感觉便都不同了，
When they rose, each felt a change in the weight on his shoulders.

嵇鹤龄是减轻而胡雪岩是加重，
Ji's had lightened; Hu's had grown heavier.

“大哥！”他说，“你尽管放心到新城去，专心一致办事，
“Elder Brother,” Hu said, “go to Xincheng with your mind at ease and devote yourself entirely to the work.

家里一点都不用记挂，
Don't spend a moment worrying about things at home.

一切都有我！”
I'll attend to everything.”

“那自然要托你。”
“Naturally I must rely on you.

嵇鹤龄又说，“不过眼前有瑞云在，也没有什么不放心的，
But with Ruiyun there now, I have little cause for anxiety.

我走了，你也赶紧动身到上海去吧！
Once I've gone, hurry to Shanghai yourself.

早去早回，我们换帖子请客。
Go early and return early, and we'll exchange cards and give a feast.”

““好的，
“Very well.

我晓得，
I understand.

一路顺风。”
A safe journey!”


胡雪岩离船登岸，坐轿进城，
Hu left the boat, went ashore, and took a chair into the city.

等王有龄到家，他接着也到了他那里，脸上是掩抑不住的笑容，
He reached Wang's house just after Wang himself, unable to suppress his smile.

王有龄夫妇都觉得奇怪，问他什么事这么高兴。
Both husband and wife wondered what had made him so happy.

“你们两位再也想下到的，
“You'd never guess!

就雪公上了岸那一刻工夫，我跟鹤龄拜成把弟兄了。”
In the few moments after Mr Xuexuan went ashore, Heling and I became sworn brothers.”

“太好了！
“Splendid!

恭喜，恭喜！”
Congratulations!”

王有龄对他妻子说：
Wang turned to his wife.

“太太，这一来我们跟鹤龄的情分也不同了。”
“My dear, this changes our relationship with Heling too.”

“真成了一家人，
“Now we really are one family.

至亲好友，原是越多越好。”
The more close relations and good friends, the better.”

“说到这一层，我倒想起来了。”
“That reminds me.”

胡雪岩从马褂口袋里摸出个红封套递向王太太。
Hu took a red envelope from his jacket pocket and offered it to Mrs Wang.

她不肯接，
She would not accept it.

“这是什么？”
“What is this?”

“瑞云的聘金……”
“Ruiyun's betrothal money...”

话没有完，王有龄先就乱喊：
Before he could finish, Wang protested loudly.

“不行，不行！
“No, no!

这怎么好收他的？
How could we take his money?

你还给他。”
Give it back.”


“慢慢，
“Wait.

你不要吵！”
Don't make such a noise!”

玉太太挥挥手说：
Mrs Wang waved a hand.

“我先要问问清楚，瑞云怎么样？
“First I want to be clear about Ruiyun.

她自己答应了没有？”
Has she agreed herself?”

“看样子是千肯万肯的了。”
“She seems willing a thousand times over.”

“哪有这么快？”
“How could it happen so quickly?”

王太太不信，
Mrs Wang was unconvinced.

“她到底怎么说的？”
“What exactly did she say?”

“这也用不着明说。”
“It hardly needs to be said outright.”

胡雪岩把昨晚上的情形讲了一遍。
Hu recounted the previous evening.

这些眉目传情，灵犀暗通的事，本来就是最好的话题，胡雪岩又有意刻画入微，
Affection conveyed in looks and unspoken understanding always made an engaging story, and he deliberately described every nuance.

所以把王有龄夫妇听得津津有味，都是微张着嘴，耸起两面唇角，随时准备放声大笑的神态。
The couple listened with relish, mouths slightly open and the corners lifted, ready to burst out laughing at any moment.

“差也差不多了。”等他讲完，王有龄点点头说。
“It seems nearly settled,” Wang said with a nod when Hu finished.

“到底不是什么‘千肯万肯’，
“Nearly isn't ‘willing a thousand times over,’” Mrs Wang replied.

总还要我来说两句，她才会松口。”
“I shall still have to say a few words before she gives her consent.”


“拜托，拜托！”
“Then I entrust it to you!”

胡雪岩拱一拱手，趁势又把红封套递了过去。
Hu clasped his hands and used the opportunity to offer the red envelope again.

王太太已经接到手里，王有龄一把夺了回来，塞回胡雪岩：
Mrs Wang had just taken it when her husband snatched it back and thrust it at Hu.

“这不能收的。”
“We can't accept this.”

“没有什么不能收。”王太太接口，
“Of course we can,” she answered.

“我们瑞云是人家聘了去的，不是不值钱白送的。
“Ruiyun is being honourably betrothed, not given away as though she were worth nothing.

兄弟，你把聘金交给我，
Brother, give me the money.

我另有用处。”
I have another use for it.”

“你有什么用处？”
“What use?”

王有龄大为不悦，几乎要跟太太吵架了。
Wang was thoroughly displeased and on the verge of quarrelling with her.

“我说给你听！”
“I'll tell you!”

王太太的声音也很大，
Her voice rose too.

“瑞云一份嫁妆归我们预备。
“We shall provide Ruiyun's dowry ourselves.

这一千两银了，我另外交给她，是她的私房钱。
These thousand taels will go to her separately, as money of her own.

请问王大老爷，可以不可以？
May I ask whether Your Honour Wang permits that?”

“王有龄的表情立刻改变了，
His expression changed at once.

歉意地笑着，却用埋怨的语气回答：
He smiled apologetically, though his reply sounded reproachful.

“太太，你何不早说？”
“My dear, why didn't you say so earlier?”

“现在说也不晚。”
“It isn't too late to say it now.”

王太太拿着红封套，得意地走了。
Mrs Wang carried off the envelope in triumph.


“雪岩！”
“Xueyan.”

王有龄略有忧色，
Wang looked a little worried.

“我们先商量一下，万一嵇鹤龄此去无功，下一步该如何？”
“We ought to discuss what comes next if Ji fails.”

“先抚后剿”的宗旨是早已定好了的，
Their principle had long been settled: conciliation first, force afterwards.

抚既不成，自然是派兵进剿，
If conciliation failed, naturally troops would be sent.

何需问得？
Why ask?

但胡雪岩了解他的内心，便不肯这么回答，只说：
But Hu understood what was troubling him and would not answer so literally.

“你不必过虑！
“Don't worry too much.

鹤龄跟我说过，无论如何，自保之策，总是有的，
Heling told me that whatever happened, he had ways to protect himself.

可见得他极有把握。
He must be very confident.

而且，人逢喜事精神爽，
Besides, happy events lift a man's spirits.

他此去没有后顾之虑，专心一致对付公事，
He has no domestic worries now and can concentrate entirely on the public business.

当然无往不利。
Of course he'll succeed.”

“听他侃侃而谈，声音中极具自信，王有龄不知不觉受了鼓舞，
Hu spoke fluently and with such assurance that Wang was unconsciously encouraged.

愁怀一放，连连点头。
His worries eased, and he nodded repeatedly.

“还有，雪公，”胡雪岩又说，
“And another thing, Mr Xuexuan.

“你正鸿运当头，
