Your fortune is at its height.

瑞云也要托你的福，她又是一副福相，
Ruiyun will share your good luck, and she has a fortunate face herself.

看起来必有帮夫运，
She looks certain to bring prosperity to her husband.

所以鹤龄一定马到成功。
Heling is bound to succeed at once.

瑞云迟早是个‘掌印夫人’！”
Sooner or later Ruiyun will be an official's lady!”

这一说，王有龄越发高兴，
Wang was still more pleased.

“不错，不错！
“Quite right!

我也觉得，这无论如何不是倒霉的时候。”
I too feel this cannot possibly be an unlucky time.

他又说：“等鹤龄功成回省，我一定力保他接归安县。
When Heling returns successfully to the provincial capital, I'll strongly recommend him for Gui'an County.

这个缺，一年起码有五万银子进帐。”
That post brings in at least fifty thousand taels a year.”


胡雪岩心想，归安县现在由王有龄兼署，
Hu reflected that Wang was currently acting magistrate of Gui'an himself.

保了嵇鹤龄，就等于从他自己荷包里挖五万银子出来。
Recommending Ji would be like taking fifty thousand taels out of his own pocket.

一时慷慨，终必失悔，却又是说不出的苦。
A moment's generosity would eventually bring regret, and regret he could not express.

朋友相交，到了这地步一定不能善始善终，
A friendship brought to that point could hardly end as well as it had begun.

倒要劝一劝他。
Hu ought to dissuade him.

“归安是一等大县，
“Gui'an is a large county of the first class.

只怕上头不肯。
The authorities might not agree.

如果碰个钉子，彼此不好，
A refusal would be awkward for both of you.

我倒有个想法。”
I have another idea.”

“噢！你说，
“Tell me!

一定是好主意。”
It's sure to be a good one.”

“你看是不是好主意？”
“See what you think.

胡雪岩说，“海运局的差使，你又兼顾不到，
You can't give proper attention to the Sea Transport Bureau as well.

何不保鹤龄接替？”
Why not recommend Heling to succeed you there?”

“啊！”
“Ah!”

王有龄恍然大悟，
Wang understood.

“对了！
“Exactly!

这才是一举数得。”
That would achieve several things at once.”

胡雪岩懂他这句话的意思，
Hu knew what he meant.

这一举数得就包括了他的便利在内，嵇鹤龄接替海运局的差使，他经手的几笔垫款、借款，料理起来就顺利了。
The benefits would include Hu's own convenience: with Ji in charge of the bureau, the advances and loans Hu had arranged would be easier to settle.


“准定这么办，”王有龄又问，
“That's what we'll do,” Wang said.

“你哪天走？”
“When are you leaving?”

“至迟后天一走要走了。”
“The day after tomorrow at the latest. I really must go.”

“那好，
“Good.

你办完了事就回来。”
Come back as soon as your business is finished.”

王有龄放低了声音说，
Wang lowered his voice.

“我托你带笔钱去。”
“I'd like you to take some money for me.”

带给谁？
For whom?

心照不宣，
Neither needed to say.

胡雪岩只问：“带多少？”
Hu asked only, “How much?”

“给她二三百两银子吧！”
“Give her two or three hundred taels.”

“知道了，
“Understood.

我替你垫付二百两，回来再算。”
I'll advance two hundred and settle with you when I return.”

于是胡雪岩回家重整行装。
Hu went home to repack.

第二天抽出工夫来，亲自上街买了好些茶食，去探望嵇鹤龄的子女，
The next day he found time to buy a variety of tea snacks himself and visit Ji's children.

只见瑞云把那六个孩子料理得干干净净，心里大为宽慰。
Seeing all six clean and well cared for by Ruiyun greatly reassured him.

他跟嵇鹤龄拜把子的事，没有跟他的儿女说，却跟瑞云说了。
He did not tell the children about his sworn brotherhood with their father, but he told Ruiyun.

正在谈着，来了位意想不到的“堂客”，是王太太。
As they talked, an unexpected lady visitor arrived: Mrs Wang.

她的来意，胡雪岩明白，
Hu understood why she had come.

他没有理由妨碍她们谈正事，便笑笑走了。
He had no reason to obstruct their serious conversation, so he smiled and left.


一到松江，仍旧在出四鳃鲈的秀野桥上岸，
On reaching Songjiang, Hu again went ashore at Xiuye Bridge, famed for its four-gilled perch.

胡雪岩没有带跟班，却有许多零零碎碎的行李，多是些杭州的土产，
He had brought no attendant, but carried many small pieces of luggage, mostly local products from Hangzhou.

但他不怕照应不了。
He had no fear of being unable to manage them.

叫船家找了轿子和挑伕来，关照到通裕米行，
He asked the boatman to fetch a chair and porters and told them to go to Tongyu Rice Firm.

那就连价钱都不用讲。
There was no need even to bargain over the price.

因为“车、船、店、脚、牙”虽然难惹，却也十分开窍，
Carters, boatmen, innkeepers, porters, and brokers might be difficult people, but they understood how the world worked.

通裕米行的后台是谁？码头上没有一个人不晓得，也没有一个人不买帐。
Everyone at the wharf knew who stood behind Tongyu, and everyone respected his influence.

到了通裕，却好遇见陈世龙在门口，一见面就说，
Chen Shilong happened to be at the door when Hu arrived.

“胡先生，我天天在盼望，
“Mr Hu, I've been waiting for you every day!

为啥到今天才到？”
Why have you only just come?”

“说来话长。”
“It's a long story.

胡雪岩问道，“尤五哥在不在松江？”
Is Brother You in Songjiang?”

“昨天晚上刚从上海回来。”
“He came back from Shanghai only last night.”

“好，
“Good.

进去再说。”
Let's go inside and talk.”


通裕的人听见声音也迎了出来，
Hearing them, Tongyu's staff came out to welcome Hu.

代为开发轿子挑伕，把他奉为上宾，同时赶紧派人去通知尤五。
They settled with the chair-bearers and porters, treated him as an honoured guest, and hurried to send word to You.

“不必，不必！”
“No need!”

明雪岩拦着他们说，
Hu stopped them.

“我去看尤五哥，跟他一起到老太爷那里请安。”
“I'll call on Brother You and go with him to pay my respects to the old master.”

说着，便检点土仪，叫陈世龙拿着跟了去。
He checked the gifts and told Chen to carry them and follow.

尤五家住得不远，不必再用轿马。
You's house was near enough to require neither chair nor horse.

陈世龙一面走，一面把到了松江以后的情形。扼要地报告，
As they walked, Chen briefly reported what had happened since their arrival in Songjiang.

人是分开来往，陈世龙住在通裕，老张住在船上，阿珠就住在尤五家。
The party was staying separately: Chen at Tongyu, Old Zhang aboard the boat, and A’zhu at You's house.

胡雪岩心里明白，尤五仍旧当阿珠是他的心上人，所以特加礼遇，
Hu understood that You still regarded her as his beloved and was therefore treating her with special courtesy.

这且不去管她，他关心的是货色。
He put her aside for the moment; his concern was the goods.

“货色进上海丝栈了。”陈世龙说道，
“The silk is in a warehouse in Shanghai,” Chen said.

“是尤五叔作的主。
“Uncle You arranged it.

堆在上海二洋径桥北大街的裕记丝栈，
It's at Yuji Silk Warehouse, on North Street by Eryangjing Bridge.

栈单在尤五叔那里，
He has the warehouse receipt.

他要交给我，我不肯收。
He offered it to me, but I wouldn't take it.

不过一张记数的单子，还在我手里。”
I do have a tally of the quantities.”

陈世龙算是机警的，栈单在人家那里，他自己留着一张计数的单子，多少算个字佯。
Chen showed some caution: while another man held the receipt, he kept a written tally as a form of evidence.

其实无用！
Yet it was really useless.

粑栈单收了下来，原是正办，
The proper course was to accept the warehouse receipt.

否则就索性大方到底。
Otherwise, he might as well show complete trust.

捏一张记数单子算是啥名堂？
What was the point of clinging to a tally?

这是陈世龙做事不够老到，也正是自己要教导他的地方，
This showed Chen's inexperience, precisely the sort of thing Hu must teach him.

但此时此地，不便多说，点点头就算了。
But the time and place were unsuitable for a lecture, so he merely nodded.


到了尤五那里，只见高朋满座，
They found You's house full of important visitors.

胡雪岩方在踌躇，尤五已迎了出来，神情显得异常亲热。
Hu was hesitating when You came out with exceptional warmth.

两个人拱拱手打过招呼，尤五拉着他的手问道：
They exchanged clasped-hand greetings, and You took his hand.

“我以为你还有几天才来。
“I thought you wouldn't arrive for several more days.

王大老爷的公事有了头绪没有？”
Has Mr Wang's official business begun to take shape?”

他怎么知道王有龄的公事？
How did he know about Wang's business?

看一看陈世龙，神态自如，
Hu glanced at Chen, whose expression was quite natural.

显然不是他告诉尤五的。
Evidently Chen had not told him.

然则消息何以如此灵通？
How, then, was You so well informed?

胡雪岩飞快地在心里转念头，同时口中答道：“有头绪了！
The question flashed through Hu's mind while he answered, “Yes.

不然我也抽不出身本。”
Otherwise I couldn't have got away.”

“好的！
“Good.

回头我们细谈。”
We'll discuss it later.”

尤五把他拉到一边，低声说道：
You drew him aside and lowered his voice.

“厅里那班‘神道’，我不替你引见了。
“I won't introduce you to those ‘divinities’ in the hall.

你懂？”
Do you understand?”

胡雪岩一想就明白，很爽脆地签了一个字：“懂！”
Hu understood after a moment's thought and answered crisply, “Yes.”

“那好。你先请到通裕去，
“Then go back to Tongyu first.

等我‘送鬼出门，马上就来。”
I'll come as soon as I've seen these ‘ghosts’ out.”

“不要紧，不要紧！
“No hurry.

我们在老太爷那里碰头好了。”
Let's meet at the old master's instead.”

“老太爷倒常提到你。
“He often speaks of you.

我派人领了你去。”
I'll send someone to take you.”

尤五又拍拍陈世龙的肩膀说：
You patted Chen's shoulder.

“这位小老弟也见过老太爷，
“This young fellow has met him too.

蛮喜欢他的。”
He's quite fond of him.”

听得这句话，陈世龙脸上象飞了金一样：
Chen's face shone as though gilded.

“那还不是看胡先生的面子。”
“Only out of regard for Mr Hu.”

他一半谦虚，一半说的也是实话。
It was partly modesty and partly the truth.


于是由尤五派了人，陪看到他老头子那里。
A man sent by You accompanied them to Old Master Wei's house.

“老太爷”已经退隐，除了有关一般的大计以外，别的事都已不问，
The old man had retired and concerned himself only with matters affecting the brotherhood as a whole.

每天空下来的工夫，都在徒子徒孙陪侍闲谈中打发。
Most of his leisure passed in conversation with disciples of various generations.

最近兴致不佳，但见了胡雪岩却是十分高兴，
He had been out of spirits lately, but Hu's arrival delighted him.

这有许多原因，最主要的一点是，他觉得胡雪岩顶对劲。
There were several reasons, the chief one being that Hu suited him perfectly.

问过安，献上土仪，老太爷叫都打了开来，
After receiving Hu's greetings and gifts, he ordered everything opened.

大部分是茶食之类的东西，
Most were tea snacks and similar delicacies.

他每佯都尝了些，不断说好。
He tried a little of each and repeatedly praised them.

这样乱过一阵，算是坐定了，老太爷吩咐：“你们都到外头坐坐！
Once the bustle had subsided and they were seated, he instructed the others, “Go outside for a while.

我跟胡先生有话说。”
I have something to discuss with Mr Hu.”

摒人密谈的事。除非是对尤五，
Usually only You was admitted to such private conversations.

现在对一位远来的“空子”也是如此，大家不免诧异。不过也没有入敢问。
To dismiss everyone for a visiting outsider surprised them, but no one dared ask why.

一屋中十来个人，都静悄悄地退了出去。
The dozen or so people in the room withdrew silently.

“雪岩！”老太爷扶着他说道，“最近我兴致很不好。
“Xueyan,” the old man said, resting a hand on him, “I've been very low lately.

兵荒马乱，着实有些担心，
With war and disorder everywhere, there's much to worry about.

老五呢，能干倒能干，运气不好，
Old Five is capable enough, but his luck is poor.

轮着他挑这副担子，一天好日子都没有过过，
Since it became his turn to bear this burden, he hasn't had a single easy day.

我做老头子的，觉得对不起他。”
As his old master, I feel I've failed him.”

“儿孙自有儿孙福！老太爷，
“The younger generation has its own good fortune!

你实在可以想开些，
You can afford to take an easier view.

船到桥门自会直，
A boat straightens as it reaches the bridge.

凭五哥在外头的面子，无往不利，
With Brother Five's standing outside, he can manage anything.

老太爷何必替小辈担心？”
Why worry so much about the younger men?”


“江湖上总还好说，
“Among men of the waterways, perhaps.

官面上事，再是朝廷的圣旨，叫他有啥法子？
But when it comes to officials—and an imperial edict at that—what can he do?

雪岩，你倒想想我们的处境！”
Xueyan, consider our position!”

胡雪岩明白，
Hu understood.

这是指漕米改为海运，漕帮有解体之危。
The transfer of grain transport to the sea route threatened the brotherhood's very existence.

这件事，他当初也想过，打算尽点心，部为接二连三地有所发展，忙得连想这件事的工夫都没有。
He had thought about this before and meant to help, but one development after another had kept him too busy even to consider it.

所以这时一听老太爷的话，内心立即泛起浓重的歉仄。
The old man's words immediately filled him with remorse.

“现在做官的人，不是我说句看不起他们的话，‘ 江西人补碗，自顾自’，
“Officials nowadays—I don't mean to disparage them—are like the Jiangxi bowl-mender in the saying: each looks after himself.

妻财子禄最要紧！
Wife, wealth, children, and salary come first!

不然，不会弄成今天这样子的局面……”
Otherwise things would never have reached this state...”

老太爷大发了一顿牢骚，说的却是实话。
The old man poured out his grievances, but there was truth in what he said.

这胡雪岩心里也很明白，是对漕米海运有所不满，或者说，不替漕帮谋善后之策有所不满。
Hu understood that his anger concerned the sea transport of grain, or rather the failure to make provision for the brotherhood afterwards.

不过他觉得这件事也不能完全怪官府，
Yet Hu felt the authorities could not bear all the blame.

但这话此时不便说，说也无益，
This was neither the moment to say so nor likely to do any good.

所以保持着沉默，要等弄清了他的意思再作道理。
He remained silent until he could discover what the old man wanted, then decide how to respond.


“现在能替朝廷和老百姓办事的人，不是我恭维你，实在只有象你老弟这样的人！”老太爷又说，
“I'm not flattering you, but the people who can actually serve the court and the common people now are men like you,” the old master continued.

“王大老爷的官声，我也有点晓得，
“I know something of Mr Wang's official reputation too.

算是明白事理，肯做事的官。
He's a reasonable man, willing to work.

为此，我有句话想跟老弟你说！”
That's why there's something I want to say to you.”

“是的，老太爷尽管吩咐，
“Please give me your instructions.

漕帮都是我的好朋友，
The brotherhood's men are all my good friends.

效得上劳的地方，我当我自己的事一样。”
Wherever I can help, I'll treat their business as my own.”

“所以我要跟你谈，
“That's why I want to speak to you.

除了你够朋友、重义气以外，还有一层，你见得事明，决不会弄错我的意思。
Besides being a good friend who values loyalty, you see things clearly and won't misunderstand me.”

老弟，”老太爷凑过头来，低声说道：
He leaned closer and lowered his voice.

“一个人总要放他条路走，
“A man must always be left a way out.

狗急跳墙，人急悬梁，
A desperate dog leaps a wall; a desperate man may hang himself.

何况我们漕帮的情形，你是晓得的，好说话很好说话，不好说话也着实难弄。
And you know our brotherhood: when we're amenable, we're very amenable; when we're not, we're hard to manage.

事情总要预先铺排，
Arrangements must be made beforehand.

等抓破了脸，再想来摆平，交关吃力，
Once relations have broken down, restoring peace is painfully difficult.

雪岩，王大老爷还兼着海运局差使，
Xueyan, Mr Wang still holds the Sea Transport Bureau appointment.

请你劝劝他，不要顾前不顾后，
Ask him not to look only at what lies ahead and forget what follows behind.

替我们漕帮弟兄也要想一想。”
He must spare a thought for our brethren too.”


这番话听得胡雪岩暗暗心惊，
Hu was inwardly alarmed.

看样子漕帮内部怨气冲天，
Resentment within the brotherhood must be running high.

一旦纸包不住火，烧开来会成燎原之势。
Once the paper could no longer contain the fire, it might spread across the plains.

局势已经够乱了，
The situation was chaotic enough already.

听说太平天国跟洪门有关，
He had heard that the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom had links with the Hongmen society.

如果再加上“安庆”一起起事，越发不得了。
If the Anqing brotherhood rose as well, matters would be still more terrible.

做生意总要市面平靖，而市面的平靖，不能光靠官府，全需大家同心协力。
Trade required peaceful conditions, and peace could not depend on the authorities alone: everyone must work together.

胡雪岩一向有此想法，
Hu had always thought so.

所以听了老太爷的话，细想一想其中的利害关系，自觉义不容辞，有替漕帮好好出番力的必要。
Considering the interests involved, he now felt duty-bound to make a serious effort for the brotherhood.

于是他很郑重地说道：“你老人家的话，也不光是顾自己，
“Your words aren't merely for your own benefit,” he said solemnly.

是为地方着想。
“You're thinking of the whole region.

一条运河，从南到北，没有什么省界好分，
The canal runs from south to north; provincial boundaries cannot divide its concerns.

只要我用得上力，一定效劳。”
Wherever I can be useful, I shall help.”

“对呀！”
“Exactly!”

老太爷拍拍他的背说，
The old man patted his back.

“所以我说你‘见得事明’，
“That's why I say you see clearly.

晓得休戚相关，不分彼此，事情就好办了。”
Once we understand that our fortunes are linked and cease dividing ourselves from others, matters become easier.”


“那么，老太爷，你请吩咐，要我回去怎么说？”
“Then tell me what I should say when I return.”

老太爷略想一想答道：
The old master thought briefly.

“第一，时世不同了，
“First, times have changed.

海运当然也有好处，不过河运也不是一点用处都没有。
Sea transport certainly has advantages, but canal transport isn't entirely useless.

请你跟王大老爷说，河运能维持还要维持。”
Ask Mr Wang to preserve it wherever possible.”

这意思是漕米不必尽改海运，
He meant that not all grain shipments need be transferred to the sea route.

要求也不算过分。
The request was not excessive.

胡雪岩点点头说：
Hu nodded.

“这应该办得到的。”
“That ought to be possible.”

“第二，”老太爷又说，“漕帮的运丁，总该有个安置的办法。
“Second, some provision must be made for the brotherhood's transport workers.

王大老爷也该替我们说说话。”
Mr Wang should speak for us on that point too.”

这更是义不容辞的事，
This was still more clearly a duty.

“一定，一定！”胡雪岩满口答应，
“Certainly!” Hu agreed readily.

“一定会说。”
“He certainly will.”

“我晓得你老弟是有肩胛的。”
“I know you can shoulder responsibility.”

老太爷拱拱手说，
The old master clasped his hands.

“做官的不大晓得底下的苦楚，
“Officials understand little of the hardships below.

难得有你老弟承上启下，可以替我们通条路子，
How fortunate that someone like you can connect those above and those below and open a path for us.

拜托，拜托！
I entrust this to you!

我替我们一帮磕头。”
I bow in thanks on behalf of our whole association.”


“老太爷这后言重了！”
“You do me too much honour!

胡雪岩又说，“不过，我倒有句话，怕不中听。”
But there's something I'd like to say, though you may not welcome it.”

“你尽管说。”
“Go ahead.”

“我在想，漕帮自己也该寻条生路，
“I think the brotherhood should seek a livelihood for itself too.

譬如‘屯田’可以整顿整顿。”
For instance, could the garrison lands be put in order?”

“老弟这话，自然在道理上。
“You're right in principle.

不过，说到‘屯田’，真正是一言难尽，
But those lands are a long story.

多少年下来，‘私卖’、‘私典’的不知道多少？
Over the years, who knows how many have been privately sold or pledged?

松江独多‘挂户田’，
Songjiang has an exceptional amount of land held under other men's registered names.

所以成了‘疲帮’。
That's why ours has become an impoverished association.”

““挂户田”这个名目，胡雪岩还是初次听到，因而老太爷替他作了一番解释。
Hu had never heard this term, so the old master explained.

“屯田”原是官产，“屯丁”领来耕种。算是皇家的佃户，
Garrison farmland had originally been public property assigned to registered cultivators, who were in effect the emperor's tenants.

因此“屯丁”便有双重负担，一是向公家完纳正赋，再是论亩出银、津贴运了，
They therefore bore a double burden: first, the regular land tax payable to the authorities; second, a silver payment per mu to subsidise the transport workers.

名为“津银”，每亩银子一分到三、四分不等。
This was called transport-support silver and ranged from one fen to three or four fen of silver per mu.

所以名为“屯田”，其实比民田的负担还要重。
Thus, despite being called garrison land, it carried heavier obligations than ordinary private farmland.

这一来就有许多弊病出现，
Many abuses followed.

一种是“丁逃地荒”，
Some cultivators fled, leaving fields untended.

一种是为土豪劣绅，或者卫所衙门的书办等类的人霸占，
Other land was seized by local bullies, unscrupulous gentry, or clerks in the garrison offices.

再有一种是私卖或者私典屯田——
Still more was privately sold or pledged.

照律法讲，以“私典军田例”，买卖双方均须治罪，
Under the law governing the unauthorised pledging of military land, both parties to such a transaction were punishable.

因此有了“挂户田”这个名目，就是买或典的人，仍旧在屯丁或运丁名下挂户，完粮纳税，成了有名无实。
Hence the practice of holding land under another's registered name: the purchaser or pledge-holder kept it entered under the original cultivator or transport worker and paid the taxes through that name, leaving the registered tenure a mere fiction.


“从雍正十三年到道光十八年，屯田清查过七次，
“Between the thirteenth year of Yongzheng and the eighteenth year of Daoguang, these lands were investigated seven times.

其中什么毛病，上头都晓得，始终整顿不出一个名堂来。
The authorities know every abuse, yet they've never managed to put things in order.”

老弟，”老太爷双手一摊，
The old man spread his hands.

“请你想想，朝廷都没法办的事，叫我们自己如何整顿？”
“Consider it: if the court can't deal with the problem, how are we to reform it ourselves?”

“我懂了！”胡雪岩说，
“I understand!” Hu said.

“屯田既成为漕帮一家，这事情反倒好办。”
“Since the land has become a burden to the brotherhood, that actually makes things easier.”

这话听来费解，还需胡雪岩补充说明。
This sounded puzzling and required explanation.

他认为田地是样“绊手绊脚的东西”，
Hu regarded land as something that could tie a man's hands and feet.

不知道多少人安土重迁，只为家乡有块田地舍不得丢下，不肯挺起胸来，去闯市面。
Countless people remained rooted in their native places, unwilling to leave a plot behind and venture boldly into business.

松江漕帮的屯田如果有好处，屯丁、运丁或者会在本乡本土，你争我夺，事情就麻烦了。
If the Songjiang brotherhood's lands offered real benefits, cultivators and transport workers might fight over them at home, making matters troublesome.

既然是个累，丢掉就丢掉，
Since they were a burden, why not let them go?

只要公家筹得了办法，改行就行，无所瞻顾争执，
Provided the authorities could devise an arrangement, the men could change occupations without hesitation or disputes over what they were leaving.

岂非反而省事？
Wouldn't that make things simpler?

““老弟，真正要佩服你！”老太爷大为感叹，
“I truly admire you!” the old master exclaimed.

“英雄出少年，
“Heroes arise among the young.

你的见解，实在高人一等。”
Your insight is far above the ordinary.”


说到这里，尤五闯了进来。
At this point You came in.

老太爷便把刚才与胡雪岩的谈话，扼要地告诉了他。
The old master briefly recounted his conversation with Hu.

尤五很仔细地听着，但这只是表示“孝顺”，
You listened very attentively, but this was chiefly a display of filial respect.

心里觉得这件事虽然重要，但有力无处使，只有听其自然，
He thought the matter important yet impossible to influence; they could only let events take their course.

至少在眼前来说是不急之务。
At least for the present, it was not urgent.

因而答了句：“我跟小爷叔慢慢商量。”就把话扯开去了。
“I'll discuss it with Young Uncle in due course,” he answered, then changed the subject.

扯的是闲话，说阿珠在他家作客，跟他家内眷如何投缘。
He spoke casually of A’zhu's stay and how well she got on with the women of his household.

胡雪岩自然要客气几句。
Hu naturally expressed his thanks.

他从话锋中听出来，尤五似乎有事要跟他老头子谈，说闲话便有碍着自己在座的意思在内，
From the turn of the conversation, he sensed that You had something to discuss with his old master and that the small talk concealed an awkwardness about Hu's presence.

因而很知趣地站起身来，说先回通裕休息，等尤五来一起吃饭，商量生意。
Taking the hint, Hu rose and said he would rest at Tongyu until You joined him for a meal and a discussion of business.

话还没有完，尤五就拉住他说：
Before he had finished, You caught his arm.

“小爷叔，你等一等。
“Wait a moment, Young Uncle.

我跟老太爷稍为说两句话，
I only need a few words with the old master.

一起走。”
Then we'll go together.”

“好的，
“Very well.

那么我在外面坐一坐。”
I'll sit outside.”

“不必！”老太爷对尤五说，
“No need,” the old master told You.

“你小爷叔不是外人，
“Your Young Uncle is no stranger.

有话不必避他。”
You needn't keep anything from him.”

“不是我避小爷叔。
“It isn't that I wish to keep it from him.

我们是无法，人家找到头上，不能把耳朵遮起来。
We have no choice: when people bring things to us, we can't stop our ears.

小爷叔不相干的人，
But he has no part in this.

何必让他也晓得？
Why make him know about it?

眼不见，心不烦，多好呢！
What he doesn't see needn't trouble him.”

““这话也是。
“That's true.

那么，雪岩，你就到外面坐一坐！”
Then sit outside for a while, Xueyan.”

老太爷提高了声音说：
The old man raised his voice.

“来个人啊！陪客人去看看我的兰花。”
“Someone come and show our guest my orchids!”


老太爷养了好几百盆“建兰”，有专人替他照料，
The old master kept several hundred pots of jianlan orchids, tended by a specialist.

就由这个人陪着胡雪岩去看兰花。一花一叶，都能谈出好些名堂来。
This man escorted Hu round them, finding much to say about every flower and leaf.

胡雪岩没有那么雅，
Hu had no such refined interest.

敷衍着混辰光，心里只在想，是什么机密而又麻烦的大事，尤五看得如此郑重？
He responded politely to pass the time, thinking only of the confidential and troublesome business You regarded so gravely.

想到尤五在他自己家所说的“送鬼出门”这句话，胡雪岩恍然了。
Then he remembered You's phrase about seeing the “ghosts” out and understood.

那班“神道”大概是“小刀会”的，不然亦必与刘丽川有关。
Those “divinities” were probably members of the Small Swords Society, or at least connected with Liu Lichuan.

一想到此，又惊又喜。
The thought both alarmed and pleased him.

惊的是这要“造反”，尤五和他老头子不要被牵涉了进去，
Alarmed him because this meant rebellion: he hoped neither You nor the old master would be drawn in.

喜的是小刀会的情形，尤五都知道，
Pleased him because You knew what the Small Swords were doing.

避凶趋吉，对自己的生意，大有益处。
Information that helped him avoid danger and seize favourable chances could greatly benefit his trade.

只要益处，不要坏处！
Benefits without harm!

他在心里说，这件事倒要跟尤五好好商量一下。
He must discuss that carefully with You.

好久，尤五才跟老太爷谈完话出来，
Only after a long while did You emerge.

于是招呼了陈世龙一起出门。
They called Chen and left together.

“小爷叔，”他问，“你是到我那里，还是到通裕？
“Young Uncle, shall we go to my house or Tongyu?

通裕比较静，谈天方便。”
Tongyu is quieter and better for talking.”

话中的意思是，到他家便可以先跟阿珠见面。
Going to You's house would mean seeing A’zhu first.

在这时来说，无此必要，
Hu felt no need for that just now.

所以毫不迟疑地答道，“到通裕好了。
“Tongyu,” he answered without hesitation.

我有好些话要跟你一个人谈。”
“I have much to discuss with you alone.”

因为有这样的暗示，所以到了通裕，只有他们两个人把杯密谈。
Taking the hint, You arranged matters so that only the two of them sat drinking and talking privately there.


“你的货色，我代为作主进丝栈。
“I took the decision to put your goods in a silk warehouse.

栈单交了给你！”尤五首先交代这件事。
Here is the receipt.” You began by settling that matter.

栈单在胡雪岩手里有许多花佯好耍，
In Hu's hands, the receipt could serve many purposes.

起码也可以作为表示实力和信用的凭证，
At the least it was evidence of his resources and credit.

因而他不必作不必要的客气，接过来放在一边。
There was no need for empty politeness: he accepted it and laid it aside.

“这家丝栈跟我也熟。
“I know the warehouse well,” You continued.

栈租特别克己。
“They're charging a specially low rate.

不过你能早脱手，还是早脱手的好，
But if you can sell early, do so.

丝摆下去会变黄，价钱上就要吃亏了。”
Silk yellows when it lies in store, and the price suffers.”

“五哥说得不错。
“You're right, Brother Five.

不过，”
But...”

胡雪岩停了一下说：
Hu paused.

“我现在又有了新主意，要跟你商量。”
“I have a new idea to discuss with you.”

“这上面我不大懂，且不管它，
“I don't understand this business particularly well, but never mind.

你先讲出来再说。”
Tell me first.”

“五哥跟洋行里很熟？”
“You know the foreign trading houses well?”

“是的。
“Yes.

是不是要我介绍洋商？”
Do you want introductions to foreign merchants?”

“还不止这一层。
“More than that.

另外。我有句话，不知道该不该问？
There's another question I'm not sure I ought to ask.

如果不该问，五哥老实不客气告诉我。
If it's improper, tell me plainly.

自己弟兄，千万不要存丝毫不好意思的心。”
We're brothers: there must be no awkwardness between us.”


“我晓得了！
“I understand.

‘光棍心多，麻布筋多’，
‘A man of the world has many thoughts, as coarse cloth has many fibres.’

有时候，我不能不顾忌。
Sometimes I can't avoid being cautious.

不过对你不同。”
But you're different.”

尤五这时对胡雪岩的看法，跟刚才又不同了，
You now thought more highly of Hu than even a little earlier.

“老头子跟我说，说你的见解，着实高明，
“The old master said your insight was exceptional.

有许多事，是江湖道上的人见不到的。”
You see things that men of our world can't.”

多谢他老人家的夸奖，
“I thank him for the compliment.

说句实话，我别的长处没有，第一自觉从未做过对不起朋友的事，第二，事情轻重出入，我极清楚。
Frankly, I claim no other virtues, but first, I've never knowingly failed a friend; second, I understand very clearly the weight and implications of a matter.

所以我那句也许不该问的话，五哥你大可放心。
So you needn't worry about this question I perhaps ought not to ask.”

“他这是一再表示不会泄密，
Hu was repeatedly assuring him that he would keep a confidence.

尤五“光棍玲珑心”，自然会意，
You's worldly intelligence understood.

心想何必等你问出来？
Why wait to be asked?

我先告诉你，不显得漂亮些吗？
Wouldn't volunteering the information be more generous?

于是他说：“你要问的，就是你今天在我那里看见的那班‘神道’？”
“You want to ask about those ‘divinities’ you saw at my house today?”

“对了。”
“Exactly.”

胡雪岩很严肃地点着头，
Hu nodded gravely.

“你是为我好，叫我‘眼不见，心不烦’。
“For my sake you wanted to spare me the trouble of knowing.

而我呢，另有生意上的打算。”
But I have a business plan in mind.”

尤五不即回答，
You did not reply immediately.

慢慢喝了口酒，夹了一块鱼干在嘴里嚼了半天，然后吐掉了渣滓说话。
He slowly drank some wine, chewed a piece of dried fish for a long while, spat out the residue, and then spoke.

“我不晓得你在生意上有什么打算。
“I don't know what your business plan is.

这件事，我老实告诉你好了，
But I'll tell you plainly about this.

小刀会就这几天要起事，
The Small Swords will rise within the next few days.

他们来请我‘入伙’，
They came to invite me to join them.

我决定随他们自己去搞。”
I've decided to let them do it on their own.”


果然是这么回事！
Just as Hu had thought!

“五哥，”胡雪岩先敬一杯酒，“你这个主意捏得好！
He first offered You a toast. “You've made the right decision, Brother Five.

跟他们一起浑水，实在犯不着。
It isn't worth entering those muddy waters with them.”

““主意是容易捏，
“Deciding is easy.

做起来不容易，
Acting on it isn't.

浑水要泼到你身上，要躲掉也蛮难的。”
When muddy water is splashed at you, it's hard to keep clear.”

这表示尤五虽未“入伙”，但也不便反对他们。
This meant that although You had not joined them, he could scarcely oppose them either.

胡雪岩了解他的难处，
Hu understood his difficulty.

不了解的是小刀会的作为，
What he did not understand was the Small Swords' potential.

“那么，五哥，我还有句话请问。”
“Then let me ask one more thing.

他说，你看那班会不会成气候？
Do you think they can become a real force?”

““这很难说。
“Hard to say.

有外国人夹在里头，事情就难弄了。”
With foreigners mixed up in it, things become complicated.”

“怎么？”
“What?”

胡雪岩一惊，
Hu was startled.

“还有外国人插手？”
“Foreigners are involved too?”

“那是刘丽川的关系。”
“That's through Liu Lichuan.”

“照这样说，夷场里是一定不会乱的？”
“Then the foreign settlements are certain to remain peaceful?”

“外国人跟刘丽川打交道，就是为了保夷场的平安。”尤五答道：
“The foreigners deal with Liu precisely to preserve order in the settlements,” You replied.

“不然我为什么要把你的丝送进夷场的丝栈？”
“Why else would I have sent your silk to a warehouse there?”

胡雪岩不作声，
Hu said nothing.

默默地把他的话细想了一遍，觉得又是一个绝好的机会到了。
He carefully considered these words and felt that another excellent opportunity had arrived.


这个好机会自然要与尤五分享，
Naturally he must share the opportunity with You.

而且事实上也不能不靠他的力量。
In fact, he could not proceed without You's influence.

因此，胡雪岩这佯说道：“五哥，照我的看法，小刀会一起事，不是三、五个月可以了事的，
“Brother Five, as I see it, once the Small Swords rise, the affair won't be over in three or five months.

丝的来路会断，洋庄价钱看好，
Silk supplies will be cut off, and export prices will strengthen.

我们可以趁此赚它一票。”
We can make a good profit.”

“我倒真想赚它一票。”尤五答说，
“I'd certainly like to,” You answered.

“帮里越来越穷，我肩上这副担子，越来越吃力。
“The association grows poorer, and the burden on my shoulders grows heavier.

就不知道怎么赚怯？
I only wish I knew how.

你说买丝囤在那里，等洋庄价钱好了再卖，这我也懂。
Buying silk, holding it, and selling when the export price rises—I understand that too.

不过，你倒说说看，本钱呢？”
But tell me, where's the capital?”

最大的困难，就是本钱。
Capital was the chief difficulty.

胡雪岩已经有了成算，但需要先打听一下尤五这方面的情形，
Hu already had a plan, but first he needed to know You's position.

“你能调多少？”
“How much can you raise?

他问，“先说个有把握的数目，代们再来商量。”
Give me a figure you're sure of, and we'll discuss it.”

“ ‘三大’的十万银子，我已经转了一期，
“I've already renewed the hundred-thousand-tael loan from the Big Three once.

不能再转了！
I can't renew it again.

眼前我先要凑这笔款子，
My immediate task is to raise the repayment.

哪里还谈得到别的？”
How could I think of anything else?”

“那么，这笔借款上，你已经凑到了多少？”
“How much have you raised towards it?”

“还只有一半。”
“Only half.”

“一半就是五万。”
“Half means fifty thousand.

胡雪岩问：“三天之内你还能调多少？”
How much more could you find within three days?”

“最多再调两万。”
“Twenty thousand at most.”

“那就是七万。
“Then that's seventy thousand.

好了，
Good.

你只管去调，
Go ahead and raise it.

‘三大’转期，归我来想办法。”
Leave the renewal with the Big Three to me.”


胡雪岩接着又问：“有件事我不大明白，
Hu went on to ask, “There's something I don't quite understand.

洋行里可能做押款？”
Do foreign trading houses lend money against goods?”

“这倒没有听说过。”
“I've never heard of it.”

“那么请五哥去打听一下。”
“Then please make inquiries, Brother Five.

胡雪岩说，“我们本钱虽少，生意还是可以做得很热闹，
Even with little capital, we can do a very lively business.

这有两个办法。”
There are two ways.”

他的两个办法是这样：第一，他预备把存在裕记丝栈的货色作抵押，向洋行借款，把“栈革”化成现银，在上海就地收货。
His first proposal was to pledge the goods in the Yuji Silk Warehouse for a loan from a foreign firm, turn the warehouse receipt into ready silver, and buy silk locally in Shanghai.

如果洋行借不到，再向钱庄去接头。
If no foreign firm would lend, he would approach the banks.

“慢慢！”尤五打断他的话说，
“Wait!” You interrupted.

“你的服筋倒动得不错，不过我就不明白，为啥不直接向钱庄做押款呢？”
“That's a clever idea, but why not go directly to a bank for the loan?”

胡雪岩笑了，略有些不好意思地说，
Hu smiled, a little sheepishly.

“五哥，我要拿那张栈单变个戏法。”
“Brother Five, I want to perform a conjuring trick with that receipt.”

他低声说道：“ ‘三大，那面的款子转期，要有个说法，
Lowering his voice, he explained, “We need a reason for asking the Big Three to renew your loan.

就说我有笔款子划给你，不过要等我的丝脱手，才能料理清楚。
We can say I have a sum to transfer to you, but can't settle it until my silk is sold.

栈单给他们瞧一瞧，货色又在丝栈里不曾动，他们自然放心。
Show them the receipt, with the goods still untouched in the warehouse, and they'll naturally feel reassured.

哪晓得我的栈单已经抵押了出去？”尤五也笑了：
How are they to know I've already pledged the receipt elsewhere?” You laughed too.

“你真厉害！
“You're formidable!

做生意哪个都弄不过你。”他说，
No one can beat you at business.

“我懂了！
I understand.

反正栈单不能流入钱庄，戏法才不会揭穿。
The receipt must stay out of banking circles if the trick is to remain hidden.

如果洋行那方面不行，只要有东西，我在私人方面亦可以商量。“
If the foreign firms won't do it, I can try private lenders, so long as there's something to pledge.”


“那就再好不过了。
“Nothing could be better.

我再说第二个办法。”
Now for the second way.”

第二办法，一直是胡雪岩的理想，丝商联合起来跟洋行打交道，然后可以制人而非制于人，
Hu had long cherished the idea of uniting silk merchants to deal with foreign trading houses, so that they could dictate terms instead of having terms dictated to them.

这个理想当然不是一蹴可就，而眼前不妨试办，
Such an ambition could not be achieved at a stroke, but they might begin on a small scale.

胡雪岩的打算是用尤五的关系和他自己的口才，说服在上海的同行——预备销洋庄的“丝客人”，彼此台作。
With You's connections and his own powers of persuasion, he meant to win the cooperation of fellow silk dealers in Shanghai whose goods were intended for export.

“这又有两个办法，
“Here again, there are two possible arrangements.

第一个，我们先付定金，或者四分之一，或者三分之一，货色就归我们，
First, we pay a deposit of a quarter or a third, and the goods are reserved for us.

等半年以后付款提货。
Six months later we pay the balance and collect them.

价钱上通扯起来，当然要比他现在就脱手来得划算，人家才会点头。”
Taking the price as a whole, the seller must of course get a better bargain than by selling now, or he won't agree.”

第二个办法是联络所有的丝客人，相约不卖，
The other arrangement was to bring all the dealers together and secure their agreement to withhold their silk from sale.

由他们去向洋人接头讲价，成交以后，抽取佣金。
Hu and You would then negotiate prices with the foreigners and take a commission on concluded deals.

胡雪岩讲得很仔细，尤五也听得很用心。耳中在听，心里在算，
Hu explained carefully, and You listened closely, calculating as he listened.

照胡雪岩的办法，十万银子就可以做五十万银子的生意，
By Hu's method, a hundred thousand taels could finance trade worth five hundred thousand.

赚来的钱对分，每人有五万银子，
If they divided the profits equally, each would receive fifty thousand.

加上已经在手里的五万，恰好可以还“三大”的借款。
Added to the fifty thousand already in You's hands, that would exactly repay his loan from the Big Three.

他不能不动心。
He could hardly remain indifferent.

“小爷叔！”他说，“你的算盘真精明，
“Young Uncle, you calculate brilliantly.

我准定跟你搭伙。
I'll certainly join you.

我们啥时候动身到上海？”
When shall we leave for Shanghai?”

“你看呢？”胡雪岩答道。
“What do you think?

“在我是越快越好。”
For me, the sooner the better.”

“最快也得明天。”
“Tomorrow at the earliest.”

“就是明天。
“Tomorrow it is.

一言为定。”
Agreed.”


谈完正事谈闲天。
Business settled, they turned to lighter talk.

尤五提到阿珠，笑着问他何时纳宠，预备送礼。
You mentioned A’zhu and asked with a smile when Hu would take her as a concubine, so that he could prepare a present.

“你弄错了！”胡雪岩答了这一句，又觉得话没有说对，
“You've misunderstood!” Hu answered, then felt that this was not quite right.

“也不是你弄错。
“No, it isn't that you've misunderstood.

实在是哪个也不晓得我的心思。
The truth is that no one knows what's in my mind.

五哥，我倒要先问你一句话，
First let me ask you something, Brother Five.

你看阿珠为人如何？
What do you think of A’zhu's character?

自己人，不必说客气话。”
We're among ourselves; there's no need for polite phrases.”

“人是好的，脾气好象很刚。
“She's a good girl, though she seems rather strong-tempered.

说句实话，这种小姐要嫁给肯闯市面的小伙子，倒是好帮手，
Frankly, a girl like that would be a fine helpmate for a young fellow willing to make his way in the world.

嫁了给你，”尤五忽然问道：“嫂夫人的脾气怎么样？”
Married to you...” You suddenly asked, “What is your wife's temper like?”

“内人的脾气，说好也不好，说坏也不坏。
“I couldn't call it good, but I couldn't call it bad either.

这也不去管她，
Never mind her.

反正跟阿珠不相干的了。”
In any case, she won't concern A’zhu.”

“小爷叔，你这话奇怪了！”尤五诧异地，
“Young Uncle, that's a strange thing to say!” You exclaimed.

“听你的口气，不预备把她讨回去。
“You sound as if you don't intend to marry the girl.

可是她跟内人无话不谈，说你已经答应她在湖州另立门户。
Yet she tells my wife everything and says you've promised to establish a separate household for her in Huzhou.

这不是两面的话对不上榫头吗？”
Those two accounts don't fit together.”

“是的。
“True.

这件事我不知道做得对不对呢？
I don't know whether I'm doing the right thing.

我说出来，五哥，你倒替我想一想。”于是他把准备移花接木，有劝阿珠嫁陈世龙的打算，细细说了给尤五听。
Let me tell you, Brother Five, and you can help me think it through.” He then explained in detail his plan to redirect A’zhu's affections and persuade her to marry Chen Shilong.


“原来如此！”尤五笑道，
“So that's it!” You said with a laugh.

“小爷叔，你不但银钱上算盘精明，做人的算盘也精明。
“Young Uncle, you're as shrewd at managing people as you are at managing money.

不错！陈世龙这位小老弟是有出息的。
Yes, young Chen Shilong has a future.

我赞成你的主意。”
I approve of your idea.”

“那好！
“Good!

我一起想找个人谈谈，不知道我的想法，是不是‘一厢情愿’？
I've wanted someone to talk it over with, to discover whether it was only wishful thinking on my part.

既然你赞成，那就准定这么做了。
Since you approve, I've decided to go ahead.”

“尤五一时高兴，随即自告奋勇：
In his enthusiasm, You immediately volunteered his services.

“这件事虽好，做起来不容易，
“It's a good idea, but it won't be easy.

她一心一意在你身上，
Her whole heart is set on you.

忽然要叫她抛掉，难得很。
Getting her to give you up all of a sudden will be very difficult.

要不要我来帮忙？”
Would you like my help?”

这是好意，胡雪岩没有拒绝的道理，
The offer was well meant; Hu had no reason to refuse.

“当然要的。”
“Of course.

他问，“就不知道怎么想法？”
But how would you go about it?”

“我不是跟你说过，她跟内人无话不谈，
“Haven't I told you she confides everything to my wife?

要不要内人来做个媒呢？”
Shall I ask my wife to act as matchmaker?”

“这再好都没有。
“That would be excellent.

不过……”胡雪岩说，“这件事急不得。”
Only...” Hu added, “this is something we mustn't rush.”

尤五一听懂了，这是变相的辞谢，
You understood at once: this was a tactful refusal.

所以点点头说：
He nodded.

“好的！
“Very well.

那么等一等再看，
We'll wait and see.

只要用得着，随时效劳。”
Whenever you need me, I'm at your service.”


“言重了！”
“You're too kind!”

胡雪岩忽然又改了主意，
Hu suddenly changed his mind again.

“我想请嫂夫人先探探她口气，
“I'd like your wife to sound her out first.

一路上觉得陈世龙怎么样？
What did she think of Chen Shilong on the journey?

如果她认为他不错，那就请嫂夫人进一步劝一劝。
If she thinks well of him, your wife could go a little further and try persuading her.

看她是何话说？”
Then we'll see what she says.”

“不是这样说法！”
“That isn't the way to put it!”

尤五摇摇头。
You shook his head.

这下，胡雪岩倒有些不大服帖了，
Hu felt somewhat unconvinced.

难道以自己对阿珠的了解，还会不知道该如何着手？
Surely, knowing A’zhu as he did, he knew how to approach her?

于是他问：“那么，该怎么说呢？”
“Then how should it be put?” he asked.

“第一步就要让她晓得，她给人做小是委屈的，
“First, she must understand that becoming anyone's concubine would be unfair to her.

第二步要让她晓得，给你做小，将来未见得舒服。”
Next, she must understand that becoming yours might not give her a comfortable life.”

想想不错，胡雪岩服帖了，
On reflection, Hu saw that he was right.

“我是当局者迷。”
“I'm too involved to see clearly.”

他拱拱手说，
He clasped his hands respectfully.

“完全拜托，
“I leave it entirely to you.

这件事我就要丢开了。”
I shall put the matter out of my mind.”

丢开了这件事，他才能专心一意去做他的丝生意，
Only when that concern was off his mind could he devote himself wholly to the silk trade.

尤五心想，此事非把它办成不可，
You thought that they simply must bring the affair to a successful conclusion.

不然会分他的心，彼此的利害，都有关系。
Otherwise it would distract Hu, and both their interests were at stake.


于是当天回家，就跟他妻子作了一番密商。
Returning home that day, You held a private consultation with his wife.

话刚说完，看见阿珠从窗外经过，
They had just finished when A’zhu passed the window.

便喊住她说：
He called her in.

“张小姐，我有句话告诉你。”
“Miss Zhang, I have something to tell you.”

阿珠自以为胡雪岩的人，所以跟他用一样的称呼，
Considering herself Hu's woman, A’zhu used his form of address.

叫一声“五哥！”接着便走了进来，挨着“五嫂”一起坐下。
“Brother Five!” she said, and entered to sit beside her Fifth Sister-in-Law.

在她面前，尤五却不叫胡雪岩为“小爷叔”，
In her presence, however, You did not refer to Hu as “Young Uncle.”

他说：“雪岩托我告诉你一声，他今天不来看你了，
“Xueyan asked me to tell you that he won't be visiting today.

因为晚上还有一件事要料理。”
He has something to attend to this evening.”

阿珠自然失望，不过心里在想：他事情多，应该原谅他。
A’zhu was naturally disappointed, but she told herself that he had many things to do and ought to be forgiven.

所以点点头，
She nodded.

“我晓得了。”
“I understand.”

“他明天动身，我跟他一起走。
“He's leaving tomorrow, and I'm going with him.

走以前，恐惶也没有工夫跟你见面。”
I'm afraid he won't have time to see you before we leave, either.”

这话就奇怪了：
This was strange.

“我们不是一起到上海吗？”
“Aren't we all going to Shanghai together?”

“不！”尤五答道：
“No,” You replied.

“他的意思，让你住在我这里。”
“He means you to stay here with us.”

“你就住在我们这里。”尤太太拉一拉她的手，接着她丈夫的话说，
“Stay here,” Mrs You added, taking her hand.

“过几天我也要到上海，
“In a few days I'm going to Shanghai too.

你跟我去，我们去玩我们的。”
You can come with me, and we'll enjoy ourselves.”

阿珠一泡泪，忍住在眼眶里。
A’zhu held back the tears welling in her eyes.

越是居停情重，越觉得胡雪岩可恶。
The kinder her hosts were, the more hateful Hu seemed.

看起来他有些变心了！
It looked as though his feelings for her were changing!


“张小姐，明天一早，我就要跟他碰头，
“Miss Zhang, I'm meeting him early tomorrow.

你有什么话要跟他说？
Is there anything you'd like me to tell him?

我替你转到。”
I'll pass it on.”

“没有！”
“No!”

阿珠因为负气，语气很硬，
A’zhu's anger made her answer sharply.

说出口来，自己觉得很不应该这样子对尤五，
As soon as she spoke, she felt it was wrong to treat You that way.

因而赶紧又用很漫柔的声音说：
She hastily softened her voice.

“谢谢你，五哥！
“Thank you, Brother Five.

我没有什么话想跟他说。”
There's nothing I want to say to him.”

“好！
“Very well.

我就把你这句话说给他听。”
I'll tell him exactly that.”

这下，阿珠又有些不安了，
Now she felt uneasy again.

她自己负气，甚至于见着胡雪岩的面，想骂他几句，但不愿旁人把她的气话传来传去。
She was angry and even wanted to scold Hu to his face, but she did not want other people carrying her angry words back and forth.

不过她也弄不懂尤五的意思，不便再有所表示，
Nor could she make out what You meant, so she could hardly say more.

只问：“我爹和陈世龙呢？
She merely asked, “What about my father and Chen Shilong?

他们是不是一起走。”
Are they leaving too?”

“当然。
“Of course.

上海有许多事情在那里，人手不够，
There's a great deal to do in Shanghai, and we're short of people.

他们怎好不去。”
How could they stay behind?”

“好的。
“All right.

那我明天到船上去看我爹。”
Then I'll go to the boat tomorrow to see my father.”

她已打定了主意，
Her mind was made up.

明天到了船上，总可以遇见胡雪岩，一定要拿点颜色给他看，
Once aboard, she would surely meet Hu, and she would teach him a lesson.

是怎样的颜色，她却还不知道，
What sort of lesson she had not yet decided.

得要慢慢去想了再说。
She would have to think it over.


“天气真热！”
“What hot weather!”

尤太太拉着她的手站了起来，
Mrs You rose, still holding her hand.

“我们到亭子里乘凉去。”
“Let's cool off in the pavilion.”

尤家后园，小有花木之胜，还有一座假山，山上一座亭子，
The You family's back garden had its share of pleasant flowers and trees, as well as an artificial hill with a pavilion on top.

题名甚怪，叫做“不买亭”，大概是取“清凤明月不费一文钱买”的意思，
Its name was odd: the Bumai, or “No Purchase,” Pavilion, presumably because a clear breeze and a bright moon cost nothing to enjoy.

但题名虽怪，亭子倒构筑得相当古朴，而且地势极好，
Oddly named though it was, the pavilion had a pleasingly simple, old-fashioned design and an excellent position.

登高远眺，绿野遥山，颇能赏心悦目。
From its height, the green fields and distant mountains made a delightful prospect.

园子的围墙不高，
The garden wall was low.

假山上望得见行人，行人只望得见亭子里的鬓丝丽影。
Those on the hill could see passers-by, while those passing below could glimpse only the women's hair and graceful silhouettes inside the pavilion.

在谨饬的人家，这座亭子是不宜女眷登临的，
In a strictly proper household, the women would not have been allowed up there.

但尤五家与众不同，
You's family was different.

女眷向不避人，而外人也不敢订尤家女眷什么主意，
Its women never hid themselves from view, and no outsider dared entertain designs on them.

所以从阿珠来了以后，几乎每天晚上都随着尤太太在“不买亭”纳凉。
Since her arrival, A’zhu had therefore gone almost every evening with Mrs You to enjoy the cool air in the Bumai Pavilion.


经常在一起的，还有尤五的一个妹妹，行七，尤家都叫她“七姑奶奶”。
They were often joined by You's younger sister, seventh among the children, whom the household called the Seventh Lady.

七站奶奶早年居孀，与翁姑不和，住在娘家，
Widowed young, she had quarrelled with her parents-in-law and returned to her own family.

三十岁左右，长得极艳，
She was about thirty and strikingly beautiful.

但坐在那里不讲话，是个绝色美人，一开口出来，会把胆小的男人吓走，
Sitting in silence, she was a woman of exceptional loveliness; once she opened her mouth, she could frighten timid men away.

因为她伉爽有须眉气概，而且江湖气极重，
She had a man's bold, forthright manner and a strong flavour of the rougher world beyond respectable society.

不独言词犀利，表情丰富，横眉瞪眼，杀气腾腾，
Her speech was sharp and her face expressive: she could lower her brows, glare, and look positively murderous.

最让男人吃不消的是，口没遮拦，骂人也是如此，
What men found hardest to bear was her utterly unguarded tongue, especially when she was abusing someone.

什么“蠢话”都说得出口，
There was no coarse expression she would not use.

所以她嫂子叫她“女张飞”。
Her sister-in-law therefore called her “the female Zhang Fei,” after the famously fierce and outspoken warrior.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十二章（中）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Twelve, middle part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


“女张飞”心肠热，跟阿珠尤其投缘，
The female Zhang Fei had a warm heart and was particularly fond of A’zhu.

一看她眉宇之间，隐现幽怨，忍不住要问：“怎么了，
Seeing the unhappiness that flickered across the girl's face, she could not help asking, “What's the matter?

有啥心事，跟我说！”
Tell me what's troubling you.”

这心事如何肯与人说？尤其是在她面前，阿珠更有顾虑。
How could A’zhu confide in anyone about this, especially her?

“没有，没有！”
“Nothing, nothing!”

她竭力装得很轻松的，
She did her best to sound carefree.

“住在你们这里，再‘笃定’不过，
“I couldn't be more comfortable here.

有啥心事？”
What could trouble me?”

“我倒不懂了。”
“There's something I don't understand.”

七姑奶奶心直口快，说话不大考虑后果，
The Seventh Lady spoke her mind without much thought for the consequences.

“你们那位胡老爷，既然来了，怎不来看你呢？”
“Since your Mr Hu has arrived, why hasn't he come to see you?”

这一问阿珠大窘，
A’zhu was deeply embarrassed.

而尤太太大为着急，赶紧拦着她说：
Alarmed, Mrs You hurried to stop her.

“你又来了！
“There you go again!

真正是莽张飞。”
A true headstrong Zhang Fei.”

“咦！
“Why?

这话有啥问不得？”
What's wrong with asking?”

尤太太也是很厉害的角色，
Mrs You was no fool either.

一看这样子，灵机一动，索性要利用“女张飞”，
Seeing how matters stood, she suddenly decided to use the female Zhang Fei to her advantage.

“唉！”她故意叹口气，
She sighed deliberately.

“家家有本难念的经，
“Every household has its own difficult scripture to recite.

我们总要相劝张家妹子体谅胡老板。”
We must try to persuade our Sister Zhang to understand Mr Hu's difficulties.”

一说“体谅”，再说“相劝”，这就见得错在胡雪岩。
To speak of understanding and persuasion implied that Hu was at fault.

阿珠还在玩味她这两句后，七姑奶奶忍不住了，
While A’zhu was still considering those words, the Seventh Lady could contain herself no longer.

拉住她的手，逼视着说道：“你明明有心事，
Taking her hand and looking straight at her, she said, “Of course something's troubling you!

有委屈嘛！
You've been badly treated.

不管再忙，说来见个面都抽不出工夫，
However busy he is, he can't spare a moment to see you?

这话除非骗鬼！
Tell that to the ghosts!

男人都是犯贱的，
Men are contemptible creatures.

想你的时候，你就是皇后娘娘，
When they want you, you're an empress.

一变了心，你给他磕头，他给你拳头。
Once they change their minds, you can kowtow to them and get a fist in return.

这种人我见得多了。”
I've seen plenty of that sort.”


“姑奶奶，姑奶奶！”
“My dear lady, my dear lady!”

尤太太仿佛告饶似地说，
Mrs You sounded almost as though she were pleading for mercy.

“你饶了我好不好？
“Will you spare me?

你这么大声小叫，算怎么回事？”
What is all this shouting about?”

“好！”
“Very well!”

七姑奶奶把声音低了下来，但说得更快更急，
The Seventh Lady lowered her voice but spoke still faster and more urgently.

一只手把着阿珠，一只手指着她嫂了：
Holding A’zhu with one hand, she pointed at her sister-in-law with the other.

“张家妹子说得再清楚都没有了，
“Sister Zhang couldn't have made it clearer.

既然答应好两处立门户，
He agreed to establish a household in each place.

早就应该办好了，为啥到现在不办？
Why hasn't it been done long ago?

索性到了松江都不肯见一面，
Now he comes to Songjiang and won't even see her.

这算是啥？”
What is that supposed to mean?”

说到这里，她转过脸来，对阿珠说：“我老早就觉得这件事不大对，替你不平，
Turning to A’zhu, she continued, “I thought there was something wrong from the beginning and felt it unfair to you.

先还怕是我想错了，
At first I wondered whether I'd misjudged him.

照现在看，果不其然是‘痴心女子负心汉’！”
Now it's plain enough: a devoted woman and a faithless man!”

“莽张飞啊莽张飞！
“Headstrong Zhang Fei, headstrong Zhang Fei!

你真正是……”
You really are...”

尤太太不说下去了。
Mrs You left the sentence unfinished.

阿珠在旁边听得心里好不舒服！但是这不舒服是由七姑奶奶，还是由胡雪岩而来。一时之间，她却弄不明白。
Listening beside them, A’zhu felt acutely uncomfortable, though she could not immediately tell whether the cause was the Seventh Lady or Hu.

反正义羞又气，觉得忸怩得很，只有悄悄将身子挪一挪，把自己的脸避到暗处，不为她们姑嫂所见。
Ashamed and angry, she shifted quietly until her face was in shadow, hidden from the two women.


她们姑嫂却偏不容她如此，
They would not allow even that.

双双转过脸来看着她，
Both turned towards her.

“张家妹子”，尤太太握住她另一只手，安慰她说：“你不要听她的话！
Taking her other hand, Mrs You comforted her. “Sister Zhang, don't listen to her.

脾气生就，开出口来就得罪人。”
That's her nature: the moment she opens her mouth, she offends someone.”

这一来，阿珠倒不能不说客气话了，
A’zhu now had to be gracious.

“七姐也是为我。”她点点头，
“Seventh Sister means well by me.

“我不会怪她的。”
I don't blame her.”

“你说话有良心！”
“That's a fair-minded thing to say!”

七姑奶奶越发义形于色，
The Seventh Lady looked still more indignant on her behalf.

“这是你终身大事，
“This concerns your whole life.

既然说破了，我们索性替你好好想一想。”她问她嫂子。“胡老板这样子，到底存着什么心思？”
Now that we've brought it into the open, let's think it through properly.” She asked Mrs You, “What exactly is Mr Hu thinking, behaving like this?”

尤太太笑道，“你问的话，十句有九句叫人没法回答。
“Nine out of ten of your questions are impossible to answer,” Mrs You replied with a smile.

不过她故意不说下去，很谨慎地看着阿珠的脸色，想知道她心里的感觉。
“Still...” She deliberately stopped and watched A’zhu carefully, trying to read her feelings.

这当然不容易看出来，
That was not easy.

因为阿珠觉得她们的关切，事属多余，所以极力保持平静，作为一种拒绝“好意”的表示。
A’zhu considered their concern unnecessary and maintained her composure as a way of refusing their kindness.


七姑奶奶不甚明白她的意思，就明白也拦不住她自己的嘴，
The Seventh Lady hardly understood this signal; even if she had, it would not have restrained her tongue.

“张家妹子”，她换了比较文静的态度，“不是我说，你一表人才，
Assuming a gentler manner, she said, “Sister Zhang, you're such a fine young woman.

何苦委屈自己？”
Why accept an inferior place?”

尤太太一听她的话，与她哥哥的意思一佯，正好借她的口来为自己表达，
Hearing her express the same view as her brother, Mrs You saw a chance to speak through her.

所以看阿珠不答，便似唱戏对口一般，有意接一句：
When A’zhu remained silent, she supplied the next line like a performer in a duet.

“怎么叫委屈自己？”
“What do you mean, an inferior place?”

“做低服小，难道不是委屈自己！”
“Bowing and scraping as a lesser wife—isn't that accepting an inferior place?”

言者无意，听者有心，
The speaker meant no particular wound, but her listener felt one.

这句话正触着阿珠的“隐痛”，要想保持平静也不可能了。
The words touched A’zhu's hidden sore, and composure became impossible.

“再说，如果太太脾气好，也还罢了，
“Besides, it might be tolerable if the wife were good-tempered.

不然做低服小，就是热面孔贴人的冷屁股。”
Otherwise, lowering yourself like that is simply pressing your warm face against someone's cold backside.”

“蠢话”又来了！
Another of her coarse expressions!

尤太太已经一再告诫过这位姑奶奶，人家是“大小姐”身份，不登大雅的话要少说，
Mrs You had repeatedly warned her that their guest was a young lady and such language must be restrained.

谁知到底还是本性难移。
Yet nature would have its way.

不过这时候要用她来做“配角”，也顾不得指责，
Just now, however, she needed the Seventh Lady as her supporting player and could not stop to scold.

只叹口气说：“唉！
She merely sighed.

正就是为此，人家胡老板为难。”
“Yes, that's precisely Mr Hu's difficulty.”

话里有话，阿珠必得问个究竟，不过用不着她费心，自有人代劳，
There was a meaning behind this that A’zhu must discover, but someone else asked for her.

“怎么？”
“What?

七姑奶奶问：“胡家那个是雌老虎？”
Is the woman at home a tigress?”

“听胡老板的意思，厉害得很！”
“From what Mr Hu says, she's very fierce.”

“那就是他不对了！
“Then he's at fault!

既然家里有个醋坛，为啥来骗我们张家妹子？”
With a jar of vinegar at home, why deceive our Sister Zhang?”

“这我倒要为胡老板说句公平话，”尤太太很认真地说，
“I must say something fair on his behalf,” Mrs You answered earnestly.

“原来是想跟他太太商量好了，再办喜事，
“He intended to settle matters with his wife before holding the wedding.

商量不通，只好打退堂鼓。
When she wouldn't agree, he had to retreat.

这也不算骗人。”
That's hardly deception.”


“什么？”阿珠失声问道，
“What?” A’zhu exclaimed.

“五嫂，你怎么知道？”
“Fifth Sister-in-Law, how do you know?”

“她五哥，”尤太太指着七姑奶奶说，“都告诉我了。
“Her brother—Brother Five—told me everything.” Mrs You indicated the Seventh Lady.

胡老板实在有难处，
“Mr Hu really does have difficulties.

话又跟你说不出口，闷在心里不是回事，只好跟好朋友谈谈。
He couldn't bring himself to tell you, but keeping them to himself was no solution either, so he spoke to a close friend.

张家妹子，你不要着急，
Don't worry, Sister Zhang.

我们慢慢想办法。”
We'll think of a way.”

想什么办法？
What way?

语意不明，而阿珠心乱如麻，也无法细想，
The meaning was unclear, and A’zhu's mind was too tangled to examine it.

此时她唯一的意愿是要跟胡雪岩当面谈一谈。
Her sole wish was to speak to Hu face to face.

“办法总有的。
“There's always a way.

对付没良心的男人，不必客气。
We needn't stand on ceremony with a heartless man.

不过，”
But...”

七姑奶奶低声向阿珠问道：
The Seventh Lady lowered her voice.

“你要说句实话，
“Tell me honestly.

你们船上来来去去，在湖州又住在一起，
You've travelled back and forth together on the boat and stayed in the same place in Huzhou.

你到底跟他……”
Have you and he ever...”

不等她说完，阿珠便又羞又急地叫了起来，
Before she could finish, A’zhu cried out in embarrassment and alarm.

“没有！”
“No!”

她的语气异常决绝，唯恐他人不信：
Afraid they might not believe her, she spoke with absolute firmness.

“绝对没有！
“Absolutely not!

我不是那种人。”
I'm not that sort of girl.”

“我晓得，我晓得。”
“I know, I know.”

七姑奶奶很欣慰地说，
The Seventh Lady sounded greatly relieved.

“没有吃他的亏，就更加好办了。”
“If he hasn't taken advantage of you, things are easier still.”

“对！”尤太太附和，
“Exactly,” Mrs You agreed.

“这件事还不算麻烦。
“This isn't such a difficult affair yet.

全在你自己身上。”
It all depends on you.”

这话又有深意了，阿珠得好好想一想，可是七姑奶奶的话实在多，不容她有细想的工夫。
Again there was a deeper meaning for A’zhu to consider, but the Seventh Lady talked too much to give her time.


“幸亏发觉得早！”她说，
“It's fortunate you found out early,” she said.

“你想想，男人十个有十一个好新鲜，
“Out of ten men, eleven want something new.

还没有上手，对你已经这个样子，等一上了手，尝过甜头，
If he's treating you like this before he's even won you over, imagine what he'll do once he's had his way.

还不是一丢了事。那时候，你就朝他哭都没有用。”
He'll cast you aside, and then even your tears will do no good.”

她已经算是措词是含蓄了，但已把男女间事似解非解的阿珠听得红晕忸怩得不知如何是好。
She considered this restrained language, but A’zhu, who understood relations between men and women only imperfectly, flushed and lowered her head, not knowing where to look.

低着头想想，“女张飞”的话虽粗鲁，却说中了她从未了解过的一面，
Coarse though the female Zhang Fei's words were, they revealed a side of the matter she had never grasped.

男人喜新厌旧，这话听人说过，只不如她来得透彻。
She had heard that men tired of the familiar and sought the new, but never had it been explained so plainly.

转念到此，想起胡雪岩几次“不规矩”，得寸进尺地到了紧要关头，总算自己还守得住，
She remembered how Hu had sometimes overstepped the bounds, pressing further and further, and how she had stood firm when it mattered.

真正是做对了！
She had been right to do so.


庆幸之念一生，就不觉得那么羞窘了，
This sense of relief eased her embarrassment.

同时也不是那么一颗心系在胡雪岩身上，丝毫不能动弹了，
Nor did her whole heart now seem bound so immovably to Hu.

她抬起脸来，掠一掠鬓发，喝了口败毒消火的“金银花茶”，
She raised her face, smoothed her hair, and sipped the honeysuckle tea intended to clear heat and toxins.

平静地问道：“五嫂，七姐，你们说替我想办法，
Calmly she asked, “Fifth Sister-in-Law, Seventh Sister, you say you'll think of a way for me.

想什么办法？”
What way?”

尤太太是等着她来问这句话的，
Mrs You had been waiting for the question.

这到了关系出入的地方，言语必须谨慎，
They had reached a crucial point, and she must choose her words carefully.

所以一面按着七姑奶奶的手，示意她不要插嘴，一面反问了一句，“这要看你自己的意思。
Pressing the Seventh Lady's hand to keep her from interrupting, she asked in return, “That depends on your own wishes.

大主意要你自己拿！
The main decision must be yours.

你说往东，替你想东的路子，
If you want to go east, we'll find a road east.

你说往西，我们来看看，往西走不走得通？”
If you want to go west, we'll see whether that road is open.”

这话阿珠明白，
A’zhu understood.

两条路，一条是仍旧跟胡雪岩，一条是过去的甜言蜜语，海誓山盟，一笔勾销。
There were two paths: continue with Hu, or wipe away all the sweet words and solemn promises of the past.

但明白归明白，一时间要她作个抉择，却是办不到的事。
Understanding them was one thing; making the choice on the spot was beyond her.


“照我来想，这种事，总要两厢情愿。
“In my view, such things require willingness on both sides.

人家既然有了这样的话，一定要勉强人家也不大好。
Since he has said this, it wouldn't be right to force him.

不说别的，起码自己的身分要顾到。”
Leaving everything else aside, you must at least preserve your own dignity.”

“真的！”
“Exactly!”

七姑奶奶终于忍不住了，
The Seventh Lady could hold back no longer.

“五嫂这话说得真正有道理。
“Fifth Sister-in-Law is absolutely right.

我们娇滴滴一朵鲜花，又不是落市的鱼鲜，怕摆不起，要硬挜给他！”
You're a delicate flower, not stale fish left on the market stall that we must force on him before it spoils!”

听这句话就象吃了芥末，阿珠一股怨气直冲到鼻子里，差点掉眼泪了。
The words struck A’zhu like mustard, sending resentment up into her nose until she nearly wept.

自己是娇滴滴的一朵鲜花，胡雪岩却当做落市的鱼鲜，阴阳怪气，爱理不理，
She was a delicate flower, yet Hu treated her like unwanted fish, behaving strangely and scarcely deigning to notice her.

想想真有点伤心，
It hurt to think of it.

不由得咬着牙说：“哪个有那么贱，一定要硬挜给他！”
Through clenched teeth she said, “Who would be so cheap as to force herself on him?”

“好了，
“Good.

你想明白了。”七姑奶奶说，
You've seen it clearly,” the Seventh Lady answered.

“老实说一句，‘两头大’已经委屈得不得了，
“To be honest, even having equal standing in two households was a terrible concession for you.

他还说有什么难处。
And still he talks of difficulties!

这种男人，真是‘谢谢一家门’了。”
A man like that can keep his whole family to himself, thank you!”


事情已一半成功，
Half the task was accomplished.

何必再骂胡雪岩，徒结冤家？
Why continue abusing Hu and merely create an enemy?

尤太太便替他解释：
Mrs You defended him.

“七妹，你的话也太过分了。
“Seventh Sister, you're going too far.

胡老板人是再好没有，
Mr Hu is as good a man as one could find.

他也是力不从心，不肯耽误张家妹子的青春，
There are things beyond his power, and he doesn't wish to waste Sister Zhang's youth.

你不要冤枉他。”
Don't misjudge him.”

七姑奶奶有样好处，勇于认错。
One virtue of the Seventh Lady was her readiness to admit an error.

听了她嫂子的话，心里在想，胡雪岩有多少机会把阿珠弄上手，而到现在她还是“原封未动”，
Hu had had many opportunities to win A’zhu, yet nothing had happened between them.

同时他给张家的好处，也真不少。
He had also done a great deal for the Zhang family.

这样的人，说起来也很难得了。
A man like that was indeed uncommon.

于是她笑着说道：
She smiled.

“想想也是，
“On reflection, you're right.

费心费力，忙了半天一场空不说，还要挨骂，
After all his trouble and effort, he gets nothing—and is scolded into the bargain.

实在也太冤枉了！”
It really is unfair.”

阿珠的一颗心，一直动荡不定，只随着她们姑嫂俩的话，浮沉摆动。
A’zhu's unsettled heart had been rising and falling with the two women's words.

这时候听了七姑奶奶的话，使又想起胡雪岩的许多好处，心里实在割舍不下，
Now she remembered all Hu's kindness and could hardly bear to give him up.

但硬话已经说出去了，
Yet her defiant words had already been spoken.

落下来的逢，再要撑起来，十分不易，
A sail once lowered was difficult to raise again.

心中萌生悔意，却又是说不出的苦，
Regret stirred within her, but she could not express the pain.

因而滚落两滴泪珠。
Two tears rolled down her cheeks.


“咦！”七姑奶奶惊诧地说，
“Why!” the Seventh Lady asked in astonishment.

“你哭点啥？”
“What are you crying for?”

“不要伤心，不要伤心！”尤太太也劝她，
“Don't be sad,” Mrs You urged.

“路差点走错，及早回头，
“You nearly took the wrong road and have turned back in time.

你应该高兴。”
You ought to be happy.”

阿珠心想，怎么高兴得起来？
How could she be happy?

七姑奶奶说胡雪岩费心费力一场空，
The Seventh Lady had said Hu's efforts had come to nothing.

自己何尝不是？
Hadn't hers too?

他的落空是他自己愿意的，自己的落空是无奈其何！
His disappointment was of his own choosing; she had no choice in hers.

夜静更深，想起从前的光景，将来的打算，一起都变了镜花水月，
In the stillness of the night, all the past happiness and future plans would become reflections in a mirror, moonlight on water.

这日子怎么过法？
How was she to live with that?

她一个人怔怔地在想心事，尤太太使趁此机会给她小姑抛了个眼色过去，意思是不必再多说了。
As A’zhu sat lost in thought, Mrs You took the opportunity to signal to her sister-in-law that enough had been said.

但七姑奶奶却不明用意：
But the Seventh Lady did not understand.

趁她起身去倒茶时，跟了过去，悄悄问道：“你有话要跟我说？”
When Mrs You rose to pour tea, she followed and asked quietly, “Have you something to tell me?”

本来无话，不过她既问到，倒也不妨跟她谈一谈，
There had been nothing, but since she asked, they might as well talk.

“话是有两句。
“A word or two.

就怕你嘴快！”尤太太说，
Only I'm afraid your tongue will run away with you.

“事情成功了一半，不过还有一半不成功，就算统统不成功。”
Half the affair is settled, but unless the other half succeeds, none of it does.”

“怎么呢？”
“What do you mean?”

“胡老板的意思是，”
“Mr Hu intends...”

尤太太朝阿珠看了一眼，把她拉到亭子外面，低声说道：
Mrs You glanced at A’zhu and drew the Seventh Lady outside the pavilion before lowering her voice.

“还要替我们这位张家妹子做媒。”
“He also wants to arrange a marriage for our Sister Zhang.”


“做给哪个？”
“To whom?”

“做给姓陈的那个后生。”
“That young fellow surnamed Chen.”

“他！”七姑奶奶惊喜地喊了起来。
“Him!” The Seventh Lady cried out in delighted surprise.

“轻点，轻点！”
“Softly, softly!”

尤太太埋怨她说，
Mrs You reproached her.

“真正是莽张飞！
“A true headstrong Zhang Fei!

一点都不晓得顾忌。”
You never consider anything.”

“这个人倒不错！”
“He's a good young man.”

七姑奶奶把声音放得极低。
The Seventh Lady dropped her voice almost to a whisper.

她的心肠热，为了阿珠，喜不自胜，
Her warm heart was overflowing with joy for A’zhu.

“对路了！
“That's the right match!

真正对路了！”
Exactly right!”

“你不要高兴！
“Don't rejoice yet.

事情还不知道怎么样呢？”
We don't know how things will turn out.”

“我来劝她，
“I'll persuade her.

一定要劝得她点头。”
I'll make her agree.

七姑奶奶说，“我听她说过，她对姓陈的蛮中意的。”
She's told me she thinks very well of him.”

“喔！”
“Oh?”

尤太太很注意地问，
Mrs You listened closely.

“她跟你怎么说呢？”
“What did she say?”

“说起来还真有趣！
“It's really funny.

她跟我说过，姓陈的能干、心好，将来要好好替他做头媒。
She told me he was capable and kind, and that she meant to find him a good wife one day.

哪知道‘养媳妇做媒，自身难保’。”
Little did she know: as the old joke goes, a girl raised as a future bride starts matchmaking, but cannot secure her own fate!”

说到这里，七姑奶奶哈哈大笑，弯腰顿足，笑得傻里傻气。
At this she burst into laughter, bending and stamping until she looked quite foolish.

这一下，连阿珠都被她逗得好笑。
Even A’zhu was amused.

“你笑啥？”
“What are you laughing at?”

“笑你！”
“You!”

七姑奶奶说了这一句，又放开了刚止往的笑声。
Her laughter, only just subsiding, broke out again.

“傻相！”
“Silly creature!”

她嫂子白了她一眼，却也忍不住笑了。
Mrs You gave her a look, but could not help laughing too.

这诡秘的神情，越使得阿珠怀疑，
Their mysterious behaviour only increased A’zhu's suspicions.

尽自追问着，她有什么事值得她们如此好笑呢？
She kept asking what she had done to amuse them so much.

尤太太长于机变，便编了一套话，支吾了过去。
Quick-witted Mrs You invented a story and put her off.


于是扯了些闲话，吃罢夜点心，时间到了午夜。
They turned to other subjects, ate a late-night snack, and found that it was already midnight.

尤太太白天操持家务，相当劳累，
Mrs You was tired from managing the household all day.

倒不是亲操井臼，尤五家的客人多，“吃闲饭”的人也不少，
She did not do the actual drudgery herself, but You Laowu entertained many guests and supported plenty of people who lived at his expense.

每天要开四、五桌饭，
Every day they fed four or five tables of people.

光是指挥底下人接待宾客，就够忙的，
Directing the servants in their reception was work enough.

这时支撑不住要上床了。
By now she could hardly stay awake.

“你们呢？”她说，
“What about you two?” she asked.

“天凉快了，
“It's cool now.

也去睡吧！”
You should go to bed too.”

“我还不困。
“I'm not sleepy yet.

想再坐一歇。”阿珠这样回答，
I'd like to sit a little longer,” A’zhu replied.

其实是有心事，上床也不能入梦。
In truth, her troubles would keep her awake even in bed.

“我也不困。”七姑奶奶说，
“I'm not sleepy either,” the Seventh Lady said.

“天气凉快了，正好多坐一歇。”
“Now that it's cool, we can enjoy sitting out.”

尤太太一想，这两个人在一起，一定还要谈到胡雪岩和陈世龙，
Mrs You reflected that, left together, they would certainly return to Hu and Chen.

她深怕七站奶奶不够沉着，操之过急，把好好的一件事弄糟，
She feared the Seventh Lady lacked the composure to proceed slowly and might ruin a promising affair through haste.

所以不放心地迟疑不定。
She hesitated uneasily.

“你回房去好了。”七姑奶奶猜到她的心事，安慰她说：
“Go to your room,” the Seventh Lady reassured her, guessing her concern.

“我们稍为再坐一坐，也要上床了。”
“We'll sit a little longer, then go to bed.”

“有啥话，明天再说。”
“Anything more can wait until tomorrow.”

尤太太特意再点她一句：
Mrs You gave her another pointed hint.

“事缓则圆，
“Things settle better when allowed time.

我常常跟你说这句话，你总不大肯听。”
I'm always telling you, but you never seem willing to listen.”

“ 晓得，晓得！
“I know, I know.

你放心。”
Don't worry.”

她们姑嫂这一番对答，明显着还有许多没有说出来的话，
This exchange plainly concealed much that had not been said.

因而等尤太太一走，随即问道：“五嫂说什么‘事缓则圆’？”
As soon as Mrs You left, A’zhu asked, “What did she mean about things settling better when allowed time?”


“还不是你的事？”
“Your affair, of course.”

七姑奶奶想了想问道：
The Seventh Lady considered.

“刚才谈了半天，你到底作何打算。
“After all our talk, what do you intend to do?

人家倒不是不要你，
It isn't that he doesn't want you.

你这样的人才，怕没人要？
A girl like you needn't fear that nobody will.

不过胡老板是到口的馒头不敢吃，你也不能硬塞到他的嘴里。”
But Mr Hu is afraid to eat the steamed bun already at his lips, and you can't force it into his mouth.”

这段话的前一半倒还动听，说到最后，阿珠又有些皱眉了，
A’zhu found the first half pleasant enough, but the ending made her frown.

“七姐，”她说，“你的譬方，总是奇奇怪怪的，叫人没法接口。”
“Seventh Sister, your comparisons are always so strange that I don't know how to answer.”

“怎么呢？
“Why?

我说的是实话。
I speak the truth.

心里这么想，嘴上这么说，
Whatever I think, I say.

一点不会有虚伪。”
There's not a scrap of pretence in me.”

“我晓得你待人诚恳。
“I know you're sincere with people.

不过……”
But...”

这该怎么说呢？
How was she to explain?

世间有许多事是只能在心里想，不能在口中说的，
Many things could be thought but not spoken.

这番道理阿珠懂，但讲不明白、
A’zhu understood this, yet could not make the principle clear.

只好付之苦笑。
She could only smile helplessly.

“不过怎么样？”七姑奶奶倒有些明白，
“But what?” The Seventh Lady began to understand.

“怪我心直口快，说话不中听？”
“You blame me for being too blunt and saying things you don't like to hear?”

这有些说对了，可是不会承认，
That was partly right, but A’zhu could not admit it.

“不是，不是！决不是怪你。”
“No, no, I don't blame you at all.

阿珠答道，“府上一家，五哥、五嫂，连你七姐待我，不能再好了。
Everyone here—Brother Five, Fifth Sister-in-Law, and you—has been as kind as possible.

既然象自己人一样，原要实话真说。”
Since we're like family, of course we should speak frankly.”


“那好！”
“Good!”

七姑奶奶又忍不住了，
Once again the Seventh Lady could not restrain herself.

“你知道我这个人的脾气，
“You know my nature.

别人的事就当我自己的事一佯，尤其是对你。
I take other people's affairs as seriously as my own, especially yours.

我们现在长话短说，
Now let's make a long story short.

胡老板这方面，你到底怎样？”
What exactly do you mean to do about Mr Hu?”

阿珠想避而不答，但办不到，
A’zhu wanted to evade the question but could not.

想了一下，只好这样推托：
After thinking, she could only offer an excuse.

“七姐，这件事是我娘做的主，
“My mother arranged this, Seventh Sister.

将来总也还要问她。”
I'll have to ask her.”

“这话就奇怪了！
“That's a strange thing to say!

你自己没有主张？”
Have you no opinion of your own?”

“父母的活，不能不听。”
“I can't disregard my parents.”

“唷！唷！
“Oh, oh!

你例真是孝顺女儿！”
What a dutiful daughter!”

语涉讽刺。 阿珠脸上有些挂不住了。
The sarcasm embarrassed A’zhu.

“七姐！”阿珠用一种情商的口吻说：“你让我想一想。
“Seventh Sister,” she appealed, “let me think.

我明天早晨再跟你谈。”
I'll talk to you tomorrow morning.”

七姑奶奶在家耳濡目染，对鉴貌辨色，也是很在行的，
From years of observing her own household, the Seventh Lady knew very well how to read an expression.

一看她这神色，再要多说，就是不知趣了。
Seeing A’zhu's face, she realised that pressing further would be tactless.

于是立刻接口答道：“你慢慢想，慢慢想！
“Take your time, take your time.

等你想停当了，要怎么样做，我一定帮你的忙。”
Once you've decided what you want, I'll certainly help.”

“谢谢七姐！”
“Thank you.”

阿珠拉着她的手说，
A’zhu took her hand.

“亏得是在你们这里，
“It's fortunate I'm staying with you.

如果是在别地方，我连可以诉诉吉的人，都没有。”
Anywhere else, I wouldn't even have someone to tell my troubles to.”


说这话，一大半是为了拉拢交清。
Much of this was intended to strengthen their friendship.

其实在这时候，她就已有了无可与言之苦，
In fact, she already felt the misery of having nobody she could confide in.

七姑奶奶的心热，热得令人烫手，
The Seventh Lady's warmth was almost hot enough to burn one's hands.

尤太太人很圆滑，看样子是为了利害关系，站在胡雪岩这边。
Mrs You was smooth and worldly, apparently taking Hu's side for reasons of interest.

此外就只有一个陈世龙了，
That left only Chen.

这个人也差不多到无话不谈的地步，但这件事跟他去谈，是不是合适，却成疑问。
They had almost reached the point where they could talk of anything, but whether she should discuss this particular matter with him was doubtful.

就算跟他谈了，他帮着胡雪岩做事，要靠他提拔，
Even if she did, he worked for Hu and depended on him for advancement.

能不能帮着自己对付胡雪岩，
Would he help her stand against him?

又成疑问。
That was doubtful too.


千回百折的心事，绕来绕去，又落到胡雪岩身上。
Her thoughts twisted and turned, always returning to Hu.

她觉得以后变化如何，犹在其次，
What might happen later was secondary.

眼前横亘胸中，怎么样也无法自我消除，而必得问一问的是：胡雪岩的变心，到底为了什么？
What weighed on her now, what she could not dismiss and must ask him, was why he had changed his heart.

因此，这夜工夫，她的心思集中在第二天如何去找胡雪岩，同时如何开口问他？
Throughout the night, therefore, she planned how to find him the next day and what to say.

这样设想着，便如跟那“没良心的人”面对面在吵架，心里又气愤，又痛快。气愤的是“他”说不出个道理，痛快的是把“他”骂了狗血喷头。
In imagination she quarrelled with that heartless man face to face, feeling both furious and satisfied: furious because he could give no reason, satisfied because she had scolded him without mercy.

等“骂”过了，她却又有警惕，
When the imaginary scolding ended, however, caution returned.

不管如何，胡雪岩对她父母来说，是个无比重要的人物！
Whatever happened, Hu was enormously important to her parents.

世界上哪里去找这样慷慨的人？
Where else could they find someone so generous?

就算他自己能忍受这顿骂，旁人也要批评她恩将仇报。
Even if he endured her abuse, other people would accuse her of repaying kindness with hostility.

这样一想，阿珠气馁了，同时也更觉得委屈了，
The thought discouraged her and made her feel still more wronged.

真正吃的是有冤无处诉的哑巴亏！
She truly had a grievance she must swallow because there was nowhere to complain.


一夜没有睡好，第二天早晨又无法再睡。
After a poor night's sleep, she could not sleep late either.

天气热，都要趁早风凉好做事，她身在客边，不能一个人睡着不起来。
In the heat, everyone took advantage of the cool early hours to work, and as a guest she could hardly remain in bed alone.

尤家倒不拿她当客人看，
The You household, however, did not stand on ceremony with her.

等她漱洗出房，厅里已摆好早饭，尤太太和七姑奶奶已端起碗在吃了。
When she had washed and come out, breakfast was on the table and both women were already eating.

道过一声“早”，七姑奶奶看着她的脸说：
After greeting her, the Seventh Lady studied her face.

“你的眼睛都凹下去了。
“Your eyes have sunk in.

一定一夜没有睡着，
You must have been awake all night.

来，吃了早饭再去睡。
Come, eat something and then go back to sleep.”

“阿珠不作声，只看着早饭发愁。
A’zhu said nothing, merely looking unhappily at the food.

松江出米，一早就吃炒饭，
Songjiang produced rice, and even breakfast was fried rice.

她的胃口不开，只想喝碗汤，吃不下饭。
She had no appetite for it and wanted only a bowl of soup.

“你们吃吧，”
“Go on without me.

他说，“我不饿！”
I'm not hungry.”

尤太太一听这话，便放下筷子，伸手到她额上摸了一下，又试试自己的额头，
Mrs You put down her chopsticks, felt A’zhu's forehead, and compared it with her own.

皱眉说道，“你有点发烧，
Frowning, she said, “You're a little feverish.

请个郎中来看一看吧！”
We'd better have a physician see you.”

“不要，不要！”
“No, no!”

阿珠自觉无病，
A’zhu felt she was not ill.

“好好的，
“I'm perfectly well.

看什么郎中？
Why call a physician?

五嫂也真想得出。”
What an idea, Fifth Sister-in-Law!”

“那么先弄点药来吃。”
“Then take a little medicine first.”

尤家成药最多。都是漕船南来北往，从京里有名的“同仁堂”、“西鹤年堂”等等有名的大药铺中，买了带回来。
The You household kept a great many prepared medicines, brought back by grain boats travelling north and south from famous shops in the capital such as Tongrentang and Xi Heniantang.

当时便用老姜、红枣煎了一块“神曲”，浓浓地服了下去。
They boiled a piece of shenqu, a medicinal ferment, with mature ginger and red dates and gave her the strong decoction.

出了些汗。觉得舒服得多，但神思倦怠、双眼涩重，
She perspired a little and felt much better, but her mind was weary, her eyes heavy and sore.

只想好好睡一觉。
All she wanted was a good sleep.


但她心里还有事放不下，
Yet something remained unsettled.

想去看看她父亲，却又怕遇见胡雪岩，
She wanted to see her father but feared meeting Hu.

夜里所想的那一套，此刻整个儿推翻了，
Everything she had planned in the night had been overturned.

她自己都不明白，怕的是什么呢？是怕跟胡雪岩翻脸，以至于为她家父母带来纠纷，还是怕自己受不住刺激？甚至是怕胡雪岩面对面为难受窘？
She could not understand what frightened her: a quarrel with Hu that might bring trouble on her parents, a shock she could not bear, or even the thought of making Hu uncomfortable face to face?

精神不好，偏偏心境又不能宁境，烦得不知如何是好呢。
Tired but unable to find peace, she was unbearably restless.

想想真懊悔有此一行！
How she regretted this journey!

不管怎么样，在自己娘身边，就算发顿脾气，哭一场，也是一种发泄。
At least beside her mother, a fit of temper or a good cry would offer some release.

现在不但没有人可为她遣愁解闷，还得强打精神，保侍一个做客人的样子，
Here there was nobody to ease her unhappiness, and she had to force herself to maintain the proper manner of a guest.

其苦不堪！
It was misery.

想想又要恨胡雪岩了！
Again she resented Hu.

是他自己跟她父亲说的，让她到上海来玩一趟。
He himself had told her father to let her visit Shanghai.

带了出来，却又这样一丢了事，这算是哪一出？
What was the meaning of bringing her along and then abandoning her?

别的都不必说，光问他这一点好了。
Leave everything else aside: she could ask him just that.

如果他说不出个究竟，便借这个题目，狠狠挖苦他几句，也出出从昨天闷到此刻的一口气。
If he could give no satisfactory answer, she would use it to mock him sharply and release some of the anger pent up since yesterday.

这样想着，精神不自觉地亢奋了，
The thought revived her without her noticing.

于是趁七姑奶奶不在场，向尤太太说道：“五嫂，我想去看看我爹。
While the Seventh Lady was absent, she told Mrs You, “Fifth Sister-in-Law, I'd like to see my father.

请你派个人陪了我去。”
Please send someone with me.”

“那现在。
“Of course.

不过你身体不大好，不去也不要紧，
But you're not well, and there's no harm in waiting.

反正我们过几天就要到上海，
We're going to Shanghai in a few days.

那时候再碰头好了。”
You can meet him then.”

“还是去一趟的好，
“I'd better go.

不然我爹会记挂我。”
Otherwise he'll worry.”

说到这个理由，尤太太不便再劝阻，
Given that reason, Mrs You could hardly dissuade her.

正在找人要陪她到老张船上，恰好陈世龙来了。
She was looking for someone to accompany A’zhu to Old Zhang's boat when Chen arrived.


“来得巧！”尤太太一本正经地向他说：
“Just in time!” Mrs You said to him solemnly.

“你好好陪了她去看她爹，
“Take good care of her on the way to her father.

拣荫凉地方走！
Keep to the shade.

她在发烧。”
She's feverish.”

两个人一前一后出了尤家，拣人家檐下，阳光晒不到的地方走。
They left one behind the other and walked beneath the eaves, out of the sun.

陈世龙照顾得很周到，三步一回首地探视，口中不断在说：“走好走好！”
Chen was most attentive, looking back every few steps and repeatedly telling her to take care.

那样子既不象兄妹，又不象夫妇，引得许多人注目。
Their manner was neither that of brother and sister nor of husband and wife, and people stared.

阿珠有些发窘，心里嗔怪：
A’zhu felt embarrassed and reproached him inwardly.

又不是黑夜，路也很好走，
It was broad daylight and an easy road.

何苦这样一路喊过去，倒象是有意要引人来看似的。
Why call out all the way as though deliberately trying to attract attention?

走出巷子，豁然开朗，临河是一条静悄悄的路。
At the end of the lane, the view opened onto a quiet riverside path.

阿珠遥望着泊在柳荫下的船，忽然停住了脚，喊一声：
Looking towards the boats moored beneath the willows, A’zhu suddenly stopped.

“喂！”
“Hey!”

陈世龙闻声回头，奇怪地问道：
Chen turned at the sound.

“你在跟哪个招呼？”
“Who are you calling?”

“这里又没有第三个人，
“There's nobody else here.

你的话问得可要发噱？”
What a ridiculous question!”

“原来是叫我。
“Oh, you mean me.

有话说？”
Have you something to say?”

“自然有话说，
“Naturally.

不然叫住你做啥。”
Why else would I stop you?”

阿珠想了想问道：
She considered.

“你有没有听见什么话？
“Have you heard anything?”

““什么话？
“What sort of thing?

听哪个说？”
From whom?”

“你是装糊涂，还是怎么？”
“Are you pretending not to understand, or what?”

阿珠有些生气了。
She was growing angry.

“喔！”
“Oh!”

陈世龙才明白，
At last Chen understood.

“你是说胡先生。
“You mean Mr Hu.

他的话很多，
He says a great deal.

不知道你问的哪一方面？”
What particular subject do you mean?”

“自然是说到我的！”
“Me, of course!”


“这倒没有！
“Nothing about that.

只说要赶到上海去接头生意，过几天再来接你，
He only said he must get to Shanghai to arrange business and would fetch you in a few days.

这当然不大对！”
That certainly isn't quite right.”

听得这句批评，阿珠心里舒服了些，
The criticism comforted her a little.

“连你都晓得他不对！”她冷笑道，
“Even you know he's in the wrong!” she said with a bitter smile.

“说好了让我到上海夫玩一趟，结果半路里放人家的生，
“He agreed to let me visit Shanghai, then left me stranded halfway.

这不是有意欺侮人！”
Isn't that deliberate ill-treatment?”

说到“欺侮”，又想起胡雪岩的无端变心，
The word brought back his inexplicable change of heart.

顿觉百脉偾张，眼眶发热，一下忍不注，
Anger surged through her; her eyes grew hot, and she could contain herself no longer.

便顿着足，且哭且说：“他是存心好了的，
Stamping her foot, she cried, “He planned it!

有意欺侮我！
He meant to hurt me!

有意把我丢在半路上！
He meant to leave me halfway!

他死没良心！”
He has no conscience!”

陈世龙有些发慌，也有些伤心。
Chen was alarmed and hurt.

从湖州一路来，他下了许多功夫，谁知她一寸芳心，仍旧在胡雪岩身上。
He had made so much effort all the way from Huzhou, yet her heart still belonged entirely to Hu.

不过转念一想，他把已馁之气又鼓了起来，
On second thoughts, however, his failing courage revived.

女人的委屈，最伯郁积在心里，朝思暮想，深刻入骨，
The worst thing was for a woman's grievance to remain pent up, brooded over day and night until it sank into her very bones.

那就不容把她的一颗心扳转来，
Then there would be no turning her heart.

象这样大哭大闹，发泄过了，心里空荡荡的，反倒易于乘虚而入。
An outburst like this would empty it of its burden, leaving room for him to enter.

因此，他默不作声，只把雪白的一方大手帕，递过去让她擦眼泪。
He therefore remained silent and merely offered a large white handkerchief for her tears.

这个小小的动作，不知怎么，在阿珠的心里居然留下了一个印象，同时也唤起了回忆，想起在湖州一起上街，他总是拿这样一方手帕，供她拭汗。
Somehow that small gesture made an impression on her and stirred a memory: when they had gone into town together in Huzhou, he had always offered just such a handkerchief to wipe away the sweat.

心无二用，
The mind could not attend to two things at once.

一想到别的地方，便不知不觉地收住了眼泪，
As her thoughts wandered, her tears unconsciously stopped.

自己觉得有些窘，也有些可怜。拿手帕擦一擦眼泪，醒一醒鼻子，往前又走。
Feeling both embarrassed and rather sorry for herself, she dried her eyes, blew her nose, and began walking again.


“慢慢！”
“Wait!”

这回是陈世龙叫住了她。
This time Chen stopped her.

等她回过身来，他又问道：“到了船上，你爹问起来，你为什么哭，该怎么说呢？”
When she turned, he asked, “What will you say when your father asks why you've been crying?”

阿珠想了想答道：
She considered.

“我不说，
“I won't say anything.

没有什么好说的。”
There's nothing to say.”

“你不说可以，你爹来问我，我不能装哑巴。”
“You may keep silent, but if he asks me, I can't pretend to be dumb.”

“你……”
“You...”

阿珠这样叮嘱，
She gave her instructions.

“你只说我想家。”
“Just say I'm homesick.”

“好了。
“Very well.

走吧！”
Let's go.”

到了船上，老张果然诧异地问起，阿珠不作声，陈世龙便照她的话回答。
On the boat, Old Zhang did indeed ask in surprise, and while A’zhu remained silent, Chen gave the answer she had supplied.

“那总是受了什么委屈，
“Then you must have been upset by something.

在别人家作客……”
Staying in another household...”

“跟人家有什么相干呢？”阿珠抢着说道：
“What has it to do with them?” A’zhu interrupted.

“尤家是再好都没有了，
“The You family couldn't be kinder.

爹不要冤枉人家。”
Don't blame them unfairly, Father.”

“那么是什么委屈呢？
“Then what's upset you?

不然不会好端端地想家。”
You wouldn't suddenly become homesick for no reason.”

“我想，”陈世龙说，“大概是胡先生不让张小姐到上海去的缘故。”
“I think,” Chen said, “perhaps it's because Mr Hu won't take Miss Zhang to Shanghai.”

“这你不要怪他。
“You mustn't blame him for that.

他跟我说过了，
He explained it to me.

一到上海，碌乱三千忙生意，
Once he gets there, he'll have a thousand business matters to attend to.

照顾你没工夫，不照顾你又不放心。
He won't have time to look after you, and he won't feel easy leaving you unattended.

等事情弄得略有些头绪了，再来接你，好好去玩两天。
When things are a little more settled, he'll fetch you and give you a proper outing for a couple of days.

这话没有啥不在道理上，
Every word of that is reasonable.

你很明白的人都想不通？”
You're a sensible girl. Can't you understand?”


阿珠一面听着，一面在心里冷笑，
A’zhu listened with an inward sneer.

听完，愤愤地说道：“他这张嘴真会说！
When he had finished, she said bitterly, “What a clever tongue he has!

骗死人，不偿命。
He could lie a man into his grave and never answer for it.

现在也只有你相信他了。”
You're the only one who still believes him.”

“怎么？”
“What?”

老张大为惊诧，
Old Zhang was astonished.

看她不答，便又转脸来问陈世龙：
When she would not answer, he turned to Chen.

“阿珠的话，什么意思？”
“What does A’zhu mean?”

陈世龙自不便实说，但光是用“不知道”来推托，也不是办法，
Chen could hardly tell him plainly, but simply pleading ignorance would not do either.

想了想，觉得最好避开，让他们父女私下去谈。
Better to withdraw and let father and daughter speak privately.

于是他说：“你问张小姐自己！”
“Ask Miss Zhang herself,” he said.

接着，走出船舱，上了跳板，在柳荫下纳凉。
Then he left the cabin, crossed the gangplank, and stood in the shade of the willows.

“阿珠！”船里的老张神色严重地问：“到底怎么回事，
“A’zhu,” Old Zhang asked gravely inside the boat, “what exactly has happened?

你倒说给我听听看。”
Tell me.”

怎么说？
How?

说人家不要我了？
Say that the man no longer wanted her?

这话似乎自己作践自己，她不肯出口。
That seemed to degrade herself, and she would not utter it.

如说胡雪岩变心了，
Say he had changed his heart?

话不够清楚，
It was too vague.

打破沙锅问到底，依然难以回答。
If her father insisted on getting to the bottom of it, she would still have no answer.

因而阿珠觉得很为难。
She was in a difficult position.

“说呀！”老张催问着。
“Tell me!” he urged.

想了半天，她答了这佯一句：“我懊悔来这一趟的！”
After thinking for a long time, she could only say, “I wish I'd never come on this journey.”


老张听不懂她的话，着急的说，
Unable to understand her, Old Zhang grew impatient.

“你爽爽快快的说好不好？
“Can't you speak plainly?

到底为了啥？”
What's it all about?”

“你不要来问我！
“Don't ask me.

你不会去问他？”
Why don't you ask him?”

这个他，自然是指胡雪岩。
Him could only mean Hu.

老张有些不安，
Old Zhang became uneasy.

“怎么？”他皱眉问道：“你们吵了架了？”
“Have you quarrelled?” he asked with a frown.

“人影子都没有看见，
“I haven't even seen him.

哪里去吵架？
How could we quarrel?”

哼，”阿珠冷笑道：
She gave a bitter little laugh.

“见了面，倒真的有场架好吵！”
“If I did see him, there certainly would be a quarrel!”

“为啥呢？
“Why?

他对你有啥不对？”
What's he done wrong?”

老张埋怨他女儿，
Old Zhang reproached his daughter.

“你的脾气也要改改，
“You must learn to control your temper.

动不动生气，自己身子吃亏！”
Always getting angry only harms your health.”

先听她爹的两句话，阿珠忍不住又要发火，但最后一句让她心软了，
His first questions almost made her flare up again, but the last sentence softened her.

到底还是亲人！
Family was family, after all.

自己有这一双爹娘，总算“八字”不错。
With parents like hers, she had been born under a fortunate star.

这佯一转念，心境不由得变为豁达，
The thought broadened her outlook.

提不起，放不下的事，此时也提得起，放得下了！
What she had been unable either to face or to let go now seemed manageable.

“没有什么大不了的！”
“It's nothing so very serious!”

她不知不觉的受了七姑奶奶的感染，挺起胸来，摆出须眉气概，高声说道，
Unconsciously infected by the Seventh Lady's manner, she drew herself up with manly defiance and spoke loudly.

“从此以后，他是他，我是我！
“From now on, he goes his way and I go mine.

我也不同他吵，
I won't even quarrel.

吵不出名堂来的，
Nothing would come of it.

他同我说话，我朝他笑笑，
When he speaks, I'll just smile.

看他到晚来睡在床上，自己摸摸良心，难过不难过？”
Let him lie in bed at night and search his conscience, and see whether he feels comfortable!”

怎么一下子决裂得如此？
Why this sudden complete break?

老张相当诧异，却还镇静，
Old Zhang was surprised but remained calm.

女儿许给胡雪岩，他原来就不大赞成，所以出现了这样的局面，他觉得也并不坏。
He had never much approved of giving her to Hu, so this development did not seem entirely bad.

不过，事情要弄清楚，
Still, he must understand it.

看阿珠的神气，可以想见胡雪岩有了很明确的表示。然而阿珠又说连“他的人影子都没有看见”，
Her manner suggested that Hu had made a definite statement, yet she said she had not even seen him.

那么，“是不是他托人带了什么话给你？”他问。
“Has he sent you a message through someone?”

“ 自然罗！
“Naturally!

不然我怎么晓得他的鬼心思？”
How else would I know what wicked thoughts he's hiding?”


“不要开口骂人！”老张训了她一句，
“Don't start abusing people,” Old Zhang rebuked her.

“不管怎么样，人家人是好的。”
“Whatever happens, he's a good man.”

“你跟娘当然都当他好人，
“Of course you and Mother think he's good.

没有他，哪里会有今天？”
Without him, where would you be today?”

这话对自己的父亲来说，是太没有礼貌了，
This was an exceptionally rude thing to say to her father.

老张又是带些狷介的性格，无法忍受说他贪图财势的指责，
Old Zhang was somewhat uncompromising in matters of principle and could not endure the accusation that he coveted wealth and influence.

所以脸色大变。
His expression changed drastically.

阿珠是顺口说得痛快，未计后果，
A’zhu had spoken for the pleasure of saying it, without considering the consequences.

抬头发现她父亲的脸，大吃一惊！
Looking up, she was startled by his face.

再想一想，才发觉自己闯了祸，
Only then did she realise what she had done.

赶紧想陪笑解释，但已晚了一步。
She hurried to smile and explain, but was too late.

“你当我卖女儿？”
“Do you think I'm selling my daughter?”

老张的声音，又冷又硬象块铁，
His voice was as cold and hard as iron.

“我不想做啥丝行老板！
“I don't want to be proprietor of any silk firm.

上海也用不着去了，
There's no need to go to Shanghai.

我们今天就回湖州。”
