On hearing the news, Wu fled to the British consulate and escaped with his life.

于是道署、县署、海关，相继被袭。
The circuit offices, county offices, and customs house were attacked in succession.

小刀会占据了小南门乔家滨、沙船帮巨擘郁馥山新起的大宅作据点。
The Small Swords men established themselves in a newly built mansion belonging to Yu Fushan, a magnate of the Sand-Boat Guild, at Qiaojiabin near the Little South Gate.

城内乱得很厉害，但“红巾”不敢入夷场一步，
The city was in great disorder, but the Red Turbans dared not set foot in the foreign settlement.

因此难民纷纷趋避，十里夷场反倒格外热闹了。
Refugees poured there for safety, making its ten-li extent busier than ever.


“官兵呢？”七姑奶奶问道，
“What about the government troops?” the Seventh Lady asked.

“难道不打一打？”
“Did they not even fight?”

“官兵少得很，
“There were very few of them.

根本不敢打，
They did not dare fight at all.

带兵官是个守备，姓李，上吊死了。”
Their commander, a garrison officer surnamed Li, hanged himself.”

“鸭屎臭！”七姑奶奶不屑地，
“Duck dung!” she said contemptuously.

“有得上吊，为啥不拚？”
“If he had the nerve to hang himself, why not fight?”

“不去管这些闲事了。”尤五嫂问，
“Let us leave these other people’s affairs alone,” Mrs You said.

“你是怎么来的？”
“How did you get here?”

“我特地来送信，口信。”
“I came specially with a message—a spoken message.”

陈世龙看了看说，“可以不可以到里面去说？”
Chen looked around. “May we go inside to discuss it?”

这自是机密信息，
The information was plainly confidential.

引入内厅，陈世龙告诉尤五嫂说，尤五特地嘱咐，如果嘉定有人来，好好敷衍，千万不可得罪。
Once they had moved into the inner hall, he told Mrs You that You Laowu had particularly instructed them to deal courteously with anyone who came from Jiading and, above all, not to give offence.

“原来是这么一句话！”七姑奶奶问道，
“So that is the message!” the Seventh Lady said.

“怎么会叫你来的呢？”
“Why did they send you?”

这话问得有理，
It was a reasonable question.

尤五手下多的是人，传这样的信息，理当派自己人，
You had plenty of men of his own; a message of this kind should have been entrusted to one of them.

何至于劳动来作客的陈世龙？
Why trouble Chen, who was a guest?


“其中有个道理，”陈世龙道，
“There is a reason,” Chen explained.

“胡先生叫我把珠小姐送回湖州，
“Mr Hu asked me to take Miss Zhu back to Huzhou.

顺便就要我带个口信。”
As I was coming this way, I was to bring the message too.”

“这……”七姑奶奶深感意外，
“But...” The Seventh Lady was greatly surprised.

“这是为啥？”
“Why is that?”

“胡先生说兵荒马乱，还是回去的好。
“Mr Hu says that with war and disorder everywhere, she would be better off at home.

张老板也是这么说。”
Mr Zhang says the same.”

“这要问问她自己。”七姑奶奶忽然又说，“这样吧，
“We must ask her.” Then she suddenly added, “Here is what we shall do.

我们已经约好一起到上海，船都备好了，
We have already arranged to go to Shanghai together, and the boat is ready.

你跟我们一起走，
Come with us.

有啥话到上海再说。“
Whatever needs discussing can be discussed when we get there.”


“好的。
“Very well.

啥时候走？”
When do we leave?”

陈世龙看着身上说，“我一身烂污，
Chen looked down at himself. “I am covered in mud.

总得先洗个澡。”
I must have a bath first.”

等陈世龙到“混堂”里去洗澡的工夫，七姑奶奶才去找到因为他们要传机密口信而回避的阿珠，
While he was at the bathhouse, the Seventh Lady sought out A’zhu, who had withdrawn to let them discuss the confidential message.

说了陈世龙此来的本意，以及她的决定，
She explained the real purpose of Chen’s journey and her own decision.

阿珠自然表示同意，但也不免奇怪，胡雪岩此刻正当用人之际，何以肯放陈世龙专程送她回湖州？
A’zhu naturally agreed, though she wondered why Hu, who must be badly in need of helpers just now, was willing to send Chen on a special journey to escort her home.

七姑奶奶很快就看出，胡雪岩是在替陈世龙安排两人相处的机会。
The Seventh Lady was shrewd enough to understand at once that Hu was making an opportunity for Chen.

阿珠对自己的前途尚无着落，陈世龙又对她倾心，而且彼此已有些好感，
A’zhu was uncertain of her future, Chen was deeply attached to her, and some affection had already grown between them.

漫长的旅程可能使两人的感情进一步发展。
A long journey together might allow their feelings to develop further.

七姑奶奶却自觉比胡雪岩更了解他们，也有把握促成这桩婚事，
Yet the Seventh Lady believed she understood the two better than Hu did and was confident that she could help bring about a suitable match.

因此自作主张，改变了他的安排。
She therefore took it upon herself to change his arrangements.


* * *舟入吴淞江，顺风顺水，一夜工夫就到了上海。
Their boat entered the Wusong River and, favoured by both wind and current, reached Shanghai after a single night.

船不敢再泊小东门，
They dared not moor at the Little East Gate this time.

在洋泾滨上岸，直接坐轿到了裕记丝栈。
Landing at Yangjingbang, they took sedan chairs directly to the Yuji Silk Warehouse.

丝栈里乱得一团糟，
The place was in chaos.

连走廊上都打着地铺，
Even the corridors were covered with makeshift bedding.

全是县城里和浦东一带逃难来的，沾亲带故，半央求、半强占地住了下来。
Refugees from the county town and the Pudong area, all connected with the household by some tie of kinship or acquaintance, had half begged and half forced their way into lodging there.

七姑奶奶也是第一次到这里来，
It was the Seventh Lady’s first visit too.

一看这情形就喊了起来：“这里怎么住法？
At the sight of the crowd, she cried, “How can anyone live here?

五哥他们住哪里？”
Where are Brother Five and the others?”

不要吵，不要吵！
“Do not worry.

有地方。
There is room.”

“陈世龙引着她和阿珠，径自走到最后，另有道黑漆石库门，虚虚掩着，
Chen led the two women straight to the back, where another black-painted, stone-framed gate stood slightly ajar.

推开一看，别有天地，三开间一楼一底，堆满了丝包。
Beyond it was quite a different world: a two-storey building three bays wide, stacked with bales of silk.

“咦！阿珠。”
“A’zhu!”

阿珠抬头一看，是她父亲正开了楼窗在喊。
She looked up and saw her father calling from an open upstairs window.

“楼下堆丝，楼上住人。”陈世龙告诉七姑奶奶说：
“The silk is downstairs; the people sleep above,” Chen explained.

“上楼再说。”
“Let us go up first.”

老张下楼把他们接到楼上，
Zhang came down to meet them and led them upstairs.

父女相见，因为有了一番变乱的缘故，所以多少有恍如隔世之感。
After the upheaval they had endured, father and daughter felt almost as though they were meeting in another lifetime.

坐定下来，七姑奶奶问道：“他们呢？”
When they were seated, the Seventh Lady asked, “Where are they?”

这是指尤五和胡雪岩。
She meant You and Hu.

“洋人请他们吃番菜，谈生意，
“Some foreigners have invited them to a Western meal to discuss business.

大概快要回来了。”
They should be back soon.”

老张又问她女儿，“我跟雪岩商量，叫世龙送你回湖州，
Zhang turned to his daughter. “Xueyan and I agreed that Shilong should take you to Huzhou.

你怎么跑到上海来了。”
Why have you come to Shanghai instead?”

“是我的主意。”七姑奶奶抢着答道，
“It was my idea,” the Seventh Lady answered quickly.

“好在也方便得很，
“It was easy enough to arrange.

闲话少说，
But let us say no more for now.

张老板，对不起你，请你楼下坐一坐，
Mr Zhang, forgive me, but would you sit downstairs for a little while?

我们要房间用一用。”
We need to use the room.”


这话真说到了阿珠心里，
This was exactly what A’zhu wanted.

自从用了那个“笨法子”，大不“方便”，她连茶都不敢多吃一口，
Since taking that “crude precaution,” she had found the restrictions most inconvenient and had scarcely dared drink any tea.

急于解除束缚，轻松一下，
She was eager to undo the fastenings and be comfortable again.

所以帮着七姑奶奶催：“爹，你先请下去，
“Father, please go down for a little while,” she urged.

快，快！”
“Quickly!”

老张莫名其妙，但女人的事也不必多问，
Zhang was puzzled, but saw no need to inquire into women’s matters.

提着旱烟袋就走，
He took his tobacco pipe and left.

陈世龙自然也要下楼，
Chen naturally had to go too.

指一指左右说：“两间房都开着，
Pointing to either side, he said, “Both rooms are open.

随便你们用哪一间。”
Use whichever you please.”

“阿龙，”七姑奶奶喊住了他，
“A’long!” The Seventh Lady called him back.

从来不晓得什么叫难为情的人，这时也不免有些忸怩，
For once, even this woman who scarcely knew the meaning of embarrassment looked a little awkward.

窘笑着说：“拜托你一件事，
She smiled sheepishly. “May I trouble you with something?

也不晓得他们这里有没有娘姨，大厨房在哪里？
I do not know whether they have a maid here, or where the main kitchen is.

替我们提一桶热水来，好不好？”
Could you bring us a bucket of hot water?”

“怎么不好？”陈世龙也很机警，
“Of course.” Chen understood quickly.

“胡先生房间有个新买的脚盆，
“There is a newly bought washbasin in Mr Hu’s room.

你们用好了。”
You may use it.”

说着，“噔、噔、噔”一直下楼。
He hurried downstairs.

“你看，”七姑奶奶低声对阿珠笑道：
“Look,” the Seventh Lady whispered teasingly to A’zhu.

“阿龙替你提洗脚水去了！”
“A’long has gone to fetch your washing water.”

阿珠无心理她的戏谑，匆匆奔进房去。
A’zhu had no attention to spare for jokes and hurried into the room.

七姑奶奶自然也跟着行动，
The Seventh Lady followed.

两个人的手脚都很快，关紧门窗，相互帮忙，在黑头里摸索着，解除了束缚。
Both worked quickly: they closed the doors and windows, helped each other in the darkness, and undid the protective stitching.

不久，楼梯声响，是陈世龙提了水上楼，一壶热水、一桶凉水，
Before long they heard Chen on the stairs, bringing a kettle of hot water and a bucket of cold.

交代明白，便待下楼。
Having explained which was which, he prepared to go down again.


“阿龙慢一点！”七姑奶奶喊道：
“A’long, wait!” the Seventh Lady called.

“黑咕隆咚的怎么办？
“What are we to do in the dark?

要替我们拿盏灯来。”
Bring us a light.”

那间房正就是他跟老张的卧室，
The room happened to be the one he shared with Old Zhang.

因而答道：“我桌上有洋蜡烛，还有包红头洋火，在我枕头下面。”
“There is a foreign candle on my table and a packet of red-headed matches under my pillow,” he answered.

“哪张床是你的？”
“Which bed is yours?”

“靠壁的那张。”
“The one against the wall.

陈世龙说“红头洋火，随便哪里一划就着，
The matches will light if you strike them anywhere.

当心烧着手。”
Be careful not to burn your hand.”

“晓得了！
“I understand.

你不要走，我还有事情要你做。”
Do not go yet; there is something else I want you to do.”


七姑奶奶摸着洋火，取一根在地板上划亮。
The Seventh Lady found the matches and struck one on the floor.

阿珠担心隔墙的缝隙让屋内失去隐私，立刻把火柴吹灭。
A’zhu immediately blew it out, concerned that the gaps in the partition might compromise their privacy.

七姑奶奶便问陈世龙在外面做什么。
The Seventh Lady called to Chen to ask what he was doing outside.

他说自己坐着等候，看她还有什么事要吩咐。
“I am sitting here, waiting to see what else you need.”

她拿他守在外面打趣，又提醒他尊重她们的隐私。
She teased him about lingering and told him to respect their privacy.

陈世龙笑笑没有回答，
He smiled without answering.

阿珠低声埋怨她不该特地提这件事，又请她别点蜡烛。
A’zhu quietly reproached her for drawing attention to the matter and asked her not to light the candle.

陈世龙听见后，觉得还是守规矩要紧，
Chen heard this and decided that proper conduct mattered more than anything else.

便大声说没有事就先下楼。
“If there is nothing more, I shall go downstairs,” he called.

七姑奶奶也觉得应当让他回避，
The Seventh Lady agreed that he should withdraw.

谢过他，
“Thank you.

并请他守着楼梯，别让旁人突然上来。
Please watch the stairs and make sure nobody comes up unexpectedly.”

有了他守候，两人可以放心。
With him guarding the staircase, they could feel secure.

七姑奶奶到胡雪岩房里取来脚盆，提水进屋；
She fetched the washbasin from Hu’s room and brought in the water.

两人洗漱后重新梳头、涂脂抹粉，换上干净衣服，
After washing, they took out their grooming things, arranged their hair, put on their cosmetics, and changed into clean clothes.

才开门出来。
Only then did they open the door.


巧得很，正好裕记丝栈的老板娘，听说有“堂客”到了，带了一个粗做娘姨和一个丫头赶来。
By coincidence, the proprietor’s wife had just heard that women guests had arrived and came over with a maid for heavy work and a younger maid.

七姑奶奶是认得她的，招呼一声“陈太太”，接着便替阿珠引见。
The Seventh Lady knew her and greeted her as Mrs Chen, then introduced A’zhu.

等娘姨在楼上替她们收拾了残局，宾主坐定寒暄，问了问路上的情形，
While the older maid put their upstairs room in order, host and guests settled down to exchange courtesies and discuss the journey.

陈太太邀她们到家去住。
Mrs Chen invited them to stay at her own house.

七姑奶奶怕拘束不肯去，
The Seventh Lady feared the restrictions of being a guest and did not wish to go.

转身跟阿珠商量，她也不愿住陈太太家，便以见了她父亲，马上就要回湖州，不必费事作推托。
When she consulted A’zhu, the girl agreed and offered the excuse that, having seen her father, she would soon return to Huzhou, so there was no need to make further arrangements.

七姑奶奶也就设词力辞，陈太太只得由她们。
The Seventh Lady added her own polite refusals, and Mrs Chen had to accept them.

坐了一会，邀客到她家吃晚饭，
After sitting a while, she invited them to dinner.

七姑奶奶答应等他们兄妹见过面，谈完正事再赴约。
The Seventh Lady agreed to come once she had seen her brother and finished their business.

于是等陈太太一走，陈世龙动手替她们设榻，
When Mrs Chen left, Chen Shilong arranged the beds for them.

老张和他搬到楼下，在丝包旁边安设床位。
He and Old Zhang moved downstairs and made sleeping places beside the bales of silk.

原来的房间里一张大床，一张小床，
Their former room contained a large bed and a small one.

七姑奶奶占大床，阿珠用小床，而这张小床，正就是陈世龙原来所睡的。
The Seventh Lady took the large bed; A’zhu had the small one, which had previously been Chen’s.


刚刚安置停当，胡雪岩和尤五回到了裕记丝栈。
The arrangements had barely been completed when Hu and You returned to the depot.

时地相异，感觉不同，胡雪岩固然神态自若，阿珠也还显得从容。
A different time and place produced different feelings: Hu was composed as ever, and A’zhu too seemed at ease.

七姑奶奶略略道了决定到上海来的缘由，随即向尤五使个眼色，示意避人密谈，
The Seventh Lady briefly explained why she had decided to come to Shanghai, then signalled to her brother that she wanted a private conversation.

尤五因为跟胡雪岩已到了共机密的程序，所以顺手把他一拉，一起来听七姑奶奶的报告。
You now shared confidential matters with Hu and drew him along to hear her report.

“嘉定的人，昨天早晨来过了……”
“The man from Jiading came yesterday morning...”

她把经过情形，细说了一遍。
She gave a detailed account.

“这样应付也好！”尤五欣慰的。
“That was a good way to handle it,” You said, relieved.

默默在一旁听着的胡雪岩，不曾想到七姑奶奶，如此能干，不免刮目相看。
Listening quietly, Hu had not expected the Seventh Lady to be so capable and regarded her with new respect.

她发觉了他的眼色，心里觉得很舒服，
She noticed his look and was pleased.

便笑着问了句：“小爷叔，你看我说错了话没有？”
“Young Uncle,” she asked with a smile, “do you think I said anything wrong?”

“当然不错！”
“Certainly not!”

胡雪岩转脸对尤五说：“这下了掉一件心事，
Hu turned to You. “That removes one worry.

我们在上海可以好好动一动脑筋。”
Now we can give proper thought to our affairs in Shanghai.”

尤五先不答他的话，向他妹子低声叮嘱：“阿七，我一时不能回去，家里实在放不下心，
Before replying to him, You spoke quietly to his sister. “A’qi, I cannot return just yet, and I am anxious about things at home.

趁这一两天，路上还不要紧，
The route should still be passable for a day or two.

你赶紧回去吧！”
You had better go back at once.”


七姑奶奶点点头，问起他们在上海的情形：“ 生意怎么样？”
She nodded, then asked about their affairs in Shanghai. “How is business?”

这活在尤五就无从置答了，
You had no ready answer.

只是微微叹口气，见得不甚顺手。
He merely sighed faintly, showing that matters were not going smoothly.

“生意蛮好！”胡雪岩却持乐观的态度，
Hu, however, remained optimistic. “Very good.

“正在谈，就要谈出结果来了。”
We are negotiating and should have a result soon.”

事实上不容易谈得出结果，
In fact, agreement would not be easy.

胡雪岩扳持不卖，洋行方面因为小刀会起事的关系，是在观望之中，
Hu was holding firm and refusing to sell, while the foreign firms were waiting to see what would happen after the Small Swords uprising.

所以最大的两项“洋庄”货色，茶和丝都变成有行无市，混沌一团。
Tea and silk, the two largest items in the export trade, still had quoted prices but scarcely any transactions; the whole market was in confusion.

尤五因为生意方面不大在行，而局势甚乱，自不免悲观，
You knew little about commerce and, with the political situation so unsettled, naturally felt pessimistic.

因而才叹气不答。
That was why he had sighed instead of answering.

“阿七，”尤五又说，“你明天就回去吧！”
“A’qi,” he repeated, “go back tomorrow.”


“晓得了！”七姑奶奶不悦，
“I know!” the Seventh Lady replied with displeasure.

“我会走的。
“I shall go.

不过张家妹子是我带到上海来的，总要把她作个交代。”
But I brought our sister Zhang to Shanghai, and I must make some arrangement for her.”

“交代她爹就是了。”
“Leave her in her father’s care.”

话是不错，但七姑奶奶一心要牵那条红线，巴不得当时就有个着落，
That was reasonable, but the Seventh Lady was intent on tying the red thread of marriage and wanted a settlement at once.

这话又似乎不宜出口，因而沉默着。
She could hardly say so openly and fell silent.

“七姐！”胡雪岩看出她的热心，安慰她说，“事情是一定会有个好好交代的，
Hu understood her enthusiasm. “Seventh Sister, there will certainly be a proper arrangement.

急也急不得。
It is no use hurrying.

我想把她先送回湖州，叫世龙送了去，
I mean to send her back to Huzhou with Shilong.

那也就算是有交代了。”
That, too, would count as making provision for her.”

“嗯，嗯。”七姑奶奶不置可否地，
“Mm, mm.” She committed herself to neither agreement nor disagreement.

然后又说：“裕记老板娘，今天请我们一起去吃夜饭，
Then she said, “The proprietor’s wife has invited us all to dinner tonight.

也该走了。”
It is time to go.”

“不行！”尤五摇头，
“We cannot,” You replied, shaking his head.

“我们今天夜里约好一个要紧人在那里。
“We have arranged to meet an important man this evening.

你们去吧！”
Go without us.”

于是乍一相见，匆匆又别。
They had scarcely met before they parted again.

尤五和胡雪岩不暇暖地，赶到一家“堂子”里去赴约会。
Without even time to warm their seats, You and Hu hurried away to keep an appointment at a courtesan house.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十四章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Fourteen, first part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第十四章｜CHAPTER FOURTEEN


要会的那个要紧人姓古，广东人，是个“通事”，
The important man they were to meet was a Cantonese interpreter named Gu.

结交的洋朋友极多，对英国人尤其熟悉，
He had many foreign friends and was particularly familiar with the British.

而在上海的英国人，自从洪秀全在江宁开国，便有许多花样。
Since Hong Xiuquan had established his kingdom at Jiangning, the British in Shanghai had been trying all manner of schemes.

他们去会那姓古的，就是要打听这些花样。
It was these schemes that Hu and You wanted to learn about.

尤五在上海的路子也很广，辗转打听到，英国洋行已经跟洪军展开贸易。
You Laowu had extensive connections in Shanghai, and through a succession of inquiries he had discovered that a British firm was already trading with Hong’s army.

曾经有两只英国兵船，从上海开到下关。
Two British warships had sailed from Shanghai to Xiaguan.

洪军起初以为是清军邀来助阵的，大起戒备。
At first the rebels had assumed that the Qing forces had invited them to help fight, and had taken elaborate precautions.

谁知英国人带了一名通事上岸，一开口就表明，此来特为通商。
But the British had brought an interpreter ashore, and his opening words made it clear that they had come expressly to trade.

商品是枪械火药，以货易货。
Their merchandise consisted of firearms and gunpowder, to be exchanged for other goods.

那家洋行，大获其利，
The firm had made a handsome profit.

而所带的通事，就是这个姓古的，名叫古应春。
The interpreter who had accompanied them was this very man, Gu Yingchun.


于是胡雪岩又有了新的主意，
This gave Hu Xueyan another idea.

他跟尤五商量，最好能够跟古应春结交，在珍宝和枪械方面都有生意好做。
He told You that they ought to make Gu’s acquaintance: there would be business to do in both precious objects and arms.

尤五对胡雪岩已到了言听计从的地步，
By now You followed Hu’s advice in everything.

便设法托人，从中介绍，前一天已在吃花酒的场面上见过面，
He arranged an introduction through a mutual acquaintance, and the previous day they had met over a banquet with courtesans.

当时约定，这天是尤五回请，全班人马，一个不缺，
It had been agreed then that You would return the hospitality today, with the entire party invited again.

其实主客只有一个古应春。
In reality, there was only one guest who mattered: Gu Yingchun.

设席的地点在宝善街怡情院。尤五是这家“长三堂子”的主政，怡情老二的恩客，所以连带胡雪宕亦有宾至如归之乐。
The dinner was to be held at Yiqing House on Baoshan Street, an establishment of the prestigious changsan class. You was a favored patron of Yiqing’s Second Miss, the woman who ran the house, so Hu too enjoyed the pleasure of being received as one of the household.

到了那里，在“大房间”落座，刚刚卸去长衫，听“相帮”在喊客到，
They had scarcely taken their seats in the main room and removed their long gowns when an attendant called out that a guest had arrived.

怡情老二亲自打开帘子，只见古应春步履轻快地踏上台阶了。
Second Miss herself lifted the curtain, revealing Gu Yingchun coming briskly up the steps.

“古大少，真真够交情。”怡情老二盈盈笑着，
“Young Master Gu, you really do honor your friends!” she said with a graceful smile.

“第一个到。”
“The very first to arrive.”

“尤五哥请客不能不早点来。”古应春又说，
“When Brother You gives a dinner, I can hardly be late,” Gu replied.

“而且是在你这里请客，更不能不早到。”
“And when he gives it at your house, I must certainly come early.”

“这是我沾尤五少的光，
“Then I owe this honor to Fifth Master You.

谢谢，谢谢！”
Thank you, thank you!”


“承情之至。”尤五也拱手致谢，
“Much obliged,” You said, clasping his hands in thanks.

接着向里一指，“要不要里头躺一会？”
Then he gestured toward the inner room. “Would you like to lie down for a while?”

“我是过足了瘾来的。不过躺一会也可以。”
“I had my fill of opium before coming, but I wouldn’t mind lying down.”

一听这话，怡情老二便喊：“点灯！”
At this, Second Miss called, “Light the lamp!”

接着把古应春的哔叽袍子接过来，引入里间。
She took Gu’s serge gown and led him inside.

里间就是怡情老二的香闺，
The inner room was her own bedchamber.

一色红木家具，却配了一张外国来的大铜床，雪白珠罗纱的帐子吊得高高地，
Its furniture was all of rosewood, except for a large imported brass bed, whose snowy gauze curtains were drawn high.

床上已设着一副极精致的鸦片烟具。
An exquisite set of opium implements had already been laid out on it.

古应春略略客气了一下，先在上首躺下，
After a token show of reluctance, Gu reclined in the place of honor.

对面的空位，尤五让胡雪岩，胡雪岩又让尤五，
You offered the opposite place to Hu, and Hu offered it back to You.

这是一番做作，
These were formalities.

胡雪岩是客，而且有话要问古应春，自然该他相陪。
Hu was the guest, and he had questions for Gu; naturally, he was the one to keep him company.


“香”过两筒烟，说过一番闲话，怡情老二要去招呼“台面”，尤五也另有客要陪，
After two pipefuls and some idle conversation, Second Miss went out to attend to the dinner, while You had other guests to entertain.

小屋间里便只剩下胡、古二人。
Hu and Gu were left alone.

胡雪岩已经看出，古应春也是个很“外场”的人物，不难对付，
Hu had already seen that Gu was a man well accustomed to society and would be easy to approach.

因而一上来便用请教的口气说：“应春兄，我总算运气不错，夷场上得有识途老马指点，
He began in the tone of one seeking guidance. “Brother Yingchun, I count myself fortunate to have found an old hand to show me the way in the foreign settlement.

以后要请你多多指教。”
I shall often have to ask your advice.”

“不敢当。”古应春笑道，
“You flatter me,” Gu said with a smile.

“尤五哥是我久已慕名的，
“I have admired Brother You’s reputation for a long time.

他对你老兄特别推重，由此可见，足下必是个好朋友，
He speaks very highly of you, which tells me that you must be a friend worth having.

我们以后要多亲近。”
We ought to see more of each other.”

“是，是！
“Indeed!

四海之内皆弟兄，
All men within the four seas are brothers.

况且海禁已开，我们自己不亲近，更难对付洋人了。”
And now that the maritime prohibitions have been lifted, it will be harder still to deal with the foreigners unless we Chinese stick together.”

“着！”古应春拿手指拍着烟盘，
“Exactly!” Gu tapped the opium tray with a finger.

“雪岩兄，你这话真通达。
“Brother Xueyan, that is a thoroughly sensible remark.

说实在的、我们中国人，就是自己弄死自己，白白便宜洋人。”
The truth is that we Chinese ruin one another and let the foreigners reap the benefit.”


这话就有意思了，
There was something in that remark.

胡雪岩心想，出言要谨慎，可以把他的话套出来。
Hu decided that, with a little care, he could draw Gu out.

“现在新兴出来‘洋务’这两个字，
“These days everyone talks about ‘foreign affairs.’

官场上凡是漂亮人物，都会‘谈洋务’，最吃香的也是‘办洋务’，
All the fashionable figures in official circles discuss foreign affairs, and managing them is the most sought-after occupation of all.

这些漂亮人物我见过不少，象应春兄你刚才这两句话，我却还是第一次听见。”
I have met plenty of those gentlemen, but this is the first time I have heard anyone say what you have just said.”

“哼！”古应春冷笑着，对胡雪岩口中的“漂亮人物”，做了个鄙夷不屑的表情。
“Hmph!” Gu gave a contemptuous smile at Hu’s mention of these fashionable figures.

“那些人是闭门造车谈洋务，
“They discuss foreign affairs shut up in their own rooms, knowing nothing of the world outside.

一种是开口就是‘夷人’，把人家看做茹毛饮血的野人，
One sort calls foreigners barbarians and treats them as savages who eat raw flesh and drink blood.

再一种是听见‘洋人’二字，就恨不得先跪下来叫一声：”洋大人‘。
The other can scarcely hear the word ‘foreigner’ without wanting to fall on his knees and cry, ‘Your Excellency!’

这样子谈洋务、办洋务，无非自取其辱。
Discussing and managing foreign affairs in that spirit brings nothing but humiliation upon ourselves.”

““这话透彻得很。”胡雪岩把话绕回原来的话头上，
“You put it very clearly,” Hu said, steering the talk back to its original point.

“过与不及，就‘自己人弄死自己人’了。”
“Both extremes end in our own people ruining one another.”

“对了！”古应春拿烟签子在烟盘上比划着说：
“Precisely!” Gu gestured over the tray with his opium pick.

“恨洋人的，事事掣肘，怕洋人的，一味讨好，
“Those who hate foreigners obstruct everything; those who fear them do nothing but curry favor.

自己互相倾轧排挤，
Meanwhile, we undermine and push out our own people.

洋人脑筋快得很，有机可乘，决不会放过。
Foreigners are quick to see an opening, and they never let one slip.

这类人尤其可恶。”
People of that sort are especially detestable.”


胡雪岩看他那愤慨的神情，知道他必是受过排挤，有感而发。
His indignation convinced Hu that he had himself been pushed aside and was speaking from experience.

“不遭人妒是庸才”，受倾轧排挤的人，大致能干的居多，
Only a mediocrity escaped envy; those who suffered from rivalry and exclusion were generally capable men.

看他说话，有条有理，见解亦颇深远，
Gu spoke coherently, and his views showed considerable foresight.

可以想见其人。
Hu felt that he could judge the man from his conversation.

于是胡雪岩心想，自己正缺少帮手，尤其是这方面的人才，
He was short of helpers, particularly of men with this kind of ability.

倘或古应春能为己所用，岂不大妙？
How useful it would be to bring Gu into his service!

这个念头，几乎在他心里一出现，就已决定，但却不宜操之过急，
The thought had scarcely occurred to him before he resolved to act on it, though he must not be too hasty.

想了想，他提出一个自信一定可以引起古应春兴趣的话题。
After a moment’s reflection, he raised a subject he felt certain would interest Gu.

“应春兄！”他矍然而起，从果碟子，抓了几粒杏仁放在嘴里大嚼，嘴唇动得起劲，说话便似乎格外显得有力，
“Brother Yingchun!” He suddenly sat up, took a few almonds from a dish and chewed vigorously, which seemed to give his words added force.

“我有点不大服气！
“There is something I cannot accept.

我们自己人弄死自己人，叫洋人占了便宜，难道就不能自己人齐心一致，从洋人手里再把便宜占回来？”
If we ruin one another and let the foreigners gain at our expense, why can’t we unite and win the advantage back?”

古应春听了他的话，只是翻眼，一要烟签子不断在烟盘戳着，
Gu looked up, poking repeatedly at the tray with his opium pick.

好久，他说，“雪岩兄，从来没有人跟我说过这话。
At length he said, “Brother Xueyan, no one has ever said that to me before.

上次开了两条兵轮到下关去卖军火，价钱已经谈好，要成交了，有个王八蛋跑来见洋人，他会说洋文，
The last time we took those two warships to Xiaguan to sell arms, the price had been settled and the bargain was almost concluded when a bastard who spoke their language came to see the foreigners.

直接告诉洋人，说洪军急需洋枪火药，多的是金银珠宝。
He told them directly that Hong’s army desperately needed guns and powder and had gold, silver and jewels in abundance.

说这句话，
That was enough.

洋人翻悔了，重新议价，涨了一倍还不止。
The foreigners went back on their word, reopened negotiations and more than doubled the price.

这就是洋人占的大便宜！
What a windfall they made!

我也一直不服气。
I have resented it ever since.

能够把洋人的便宜占回来，哪怕我没有好处也干。
If I could win that advantage back from them, I would do it even without a profit for myself.

于今照你所说，自己人要齐心一致，
But you say our own people must unite.

这句话要怎么样才能做到，
How are we to accomplish that?

我要请教。“
I should like your advice.”


“这话倒是把我问倒了。”胡雪岩说，
“Now you have put me on the spot,” Hu said.

“事情是要谈出来的，
“Things have to be worked out through discussion.

现在我还不大知道洋人的情形，说不出个所以然来。
I know too little about the foreigners yet to offer a definite answer.

不过既说齐心一致，总要有个起头。
Still, if we are to unite, we must make a beginning.

譬如说，你、我，还有尤五哥，三个人在一起，至诚相见，遇事商量，
Take you, me and Brother You: the three of us could deal with one another in complete sincerity and consult over everything.

哪个的主意好，照哪个的做，就象自己出的主意一样，
Whoever has the best idea, we follow it as readily as if it were our own.

这样子一步一步把人拉拢来，
Then we bring more people together, step by step.

洋人不跟我们打交道则已，要打，就非听我们的话不可！”
The foreigners need not deal with us, but if they do, they will have to listen to us.”

“好！”古应春也一仰身坐了起来：
“Excellent!” Gu sat up too.

“三人同心、其利断金。
“When three men are of one mind, their strength can cut through metal.

就从你、我、尤五哥起头。
Let it begin with you, me and Brother You.

我洋行里那个‘康白度’也不要做了。”
I’ll give up my job as comprador at the foreign firm.”

洋行里管事的人叫“康白度”，是洋文的译音，
Comprador was a foreign term for the man who managed a foreign firm’s business dealings.

地位又非仅仅负传译之责的通事可比。
His position stood well above that of an interpreter responsible merely for translating.

胡雪岩觉得他不须如此做法。
Hu saw no need for Gu to resign.

“应春兄，”胡雪岩首先声明：“自己人说话，不妨老实。
“Brother Yingchun, between ourselves we should speak frankly.

你洋行里的职位，仍旧要维持，
You ought to keep your position at the firm.

不然跟洋人打交道不方便、而且这一来，洋人那里的消息也隔膜了。”
Otherwise our dealings with foreigners would become inconvenient, and we would lose touch with what was happening among them.”

古应春原是不假思索，想到就说的一句话，
Gu had spoken on impulse.

即使胡雪岩不点明，他回想一下，也会改变主意的。
Even without Hu’s reminder, a moment’s reflection would have made him change his mind.

因而当然一迭连声的表示同意。
Naturally, he agreed at once and repeatedly.


“我在想，”胡雪岩踌躇满志的说，“你刚才所说的‘三人同心，其利断金’。这句话真正不假。
“I was thinking,” Hu said with satisfaction, “how true your saying is about three men of one mind cutting through metal.

我们三个人，各占一门，你是洋行方面，尤五哥是江湖上，我在官场中也还有点路子。
Each of us has his own field: you have the foreign firms, Brother You the brotherhood world, and I have a few connections in official circles.

这三方面一凑，有得混了！”
Put those three together and we ought to get somewhere!”

古应春想一想，果然！
Gu considered this and saw that it was so.

受了胡雪岩的鼓舞，他也很起劲的说，“真的，
Encouraged by Hu, he replied enthusiastically, “Indeed!

巧得很！
What a fortunate combination.

这三方面要凑在一起，说实在的，真还不大容易。
Bringing those three fields together is no easy matter.

我们明天好好谈一谈，想些也众不同的花样出来，大大做它一番市面。
Let’s have a proper talk tomorrow, think of something different from everyone else and do some business on a grand scale.”

“因为有此契合，这顿花酒，吃得十分痛快，
Their understanding made the evening’s entertainment especially enjoyable.

尤五的手面很大，请的客又都是场面上人，
You was a generous host, and his guests were all men of the world.

每人都叫了两三个局，莺莺燕燕，此去彼来，弦管嗷嘈，热闹非凡。
Each summoned two or three courtesans; the women came and went amid a clamor of strings and pipes.

吃到九点多钟，又有人“翻台”，一直闹到子夜过后，
After nine, someone ordered another round of entertainment, and the festivities continued past midnight.

才回裕记丝栈。七姑奶奶和阿珠都已累了一天，早早入梦，
When Hu and You returned to Yuji Silk Warehouse, the Seventh Lady and A’zhu, tired by the day’s events, were already asleep.

老张是一向早睡早起，
Old Zhang always went to bed and rose early.

只有陈世龙一个人，泡了一壶好茶在等他们。
Only Chen Shilong was waiting, with a pot of good tea ready for them.


“五哥，你困不困？”胡雪岩兴致勃勃的问。
“Brother You, are you sleepy?” Hu asked eagerly.

“不困。”
“Not at all.

尤五问道：“你有啥事情要谈？”
What do you want to talk about?”

“事情很多。”
“A great many things.”

胡雪岩转脸说道：“世龙，你也一起听听，
Hu turned to Chen. “Shilong, you should listen too.

我今天替你找了个读洋文的先生。”
I found you a teacher of the foreigners’ language today.”

这一说，尤五立即明白：
You understood at once.

“你是说古应春！
“You mean Gu Yingchun!

你们谈得怎么样？”
How did your talk go?”

“谈得再好都没有了……”
“It couldn’t have gone better.”

胡雪岩把他跟古应春在烟榻上的那一席对话，源源本本地说了给尤五听。
Hu recounted their conversation on the opium couch from beginning to end.

尤五比较深沉，喜怒不大形于颜色，但就算如此，也可以发现他眉目轩豁，
You was a reserved man who seldom showed his feelings, but even so, his features visibly brightened.

这几天来阴沉沉的脸色，似乎悄然消失了。
The gloom of the past few days seemed quietly to have lifted.

“你的脑筋快，”他用徐缓而郑重的声音说，
“You have a quick mind,” he said slowly and earnestly.

“倒想想看，跟他有什么事可以做联手的。”
“Think what sort of business we could do together with him.”


“眼前就有一样，不过……”胡雪岩的尾音拖得很长。
“There is one opportunity before us already, only…” Hu let the last word linger.

“咦！”尤五诧异了，“有啥为难的话，说不出口？”
“Why, what is so difficult that you can’t say it?” You asked in surprise.

“我不晓得你跟卯金刀，到底有没有交情？”
“I don’t know whether you have any friendship with ‘Mao, Metal and Knife.’”

“卯金刀”是指刘丽川，
This was a coded way of writing the surname Liu and referred to Liu Lichuan.

尤五当然明白，很快地答了句：“谈不上。”
You understood immediately. “Nothing worth mentioning.”

“我这么在想，
“Here is what I was thinking.

英国人反正做生意，
The British are in business, after all.

枪炮可以卖给太平军，当然也可以卖给官军。
If they can sell guns and cannon to the Taiping forces, they can surely sell them to the government army.

今天我在席面上听说，两江总督和江苏巡抚，郡为了卯金刀在伤脑筋，
I heard at dinner that both the governor-general of Liangjiang and the governor of Jiangsu are worrying over Liu.

奏报出去，轻描淡写，好象是地方上闹事，其实是想多派兵，一仗把他打倒。
Their reports play the affair down as a local disturbance, but in reality they mean to send in a large force and crush him in one battle.

既然如此，枪炮、火药是要紧的，
In that case, guns and powder will be essential.

我们好不好先替他们办个‘粮台’，等他们的兵一到，就好出队打仗。
Could we establish a supply office for them in advance, so that when their troops arrive they can go straight into action?

如果你认为这个办法可以，我马上到苏州去跑一趟，
If you approve, I’ll go to Suzhou at once.

江苏巡抚许乃钊是我们杭州人，
Governor Xu Naizhao of Jiangsu is a fellow Hangzhou man.

一定可以找得到路子见一见他。”
I can certainly find a way to see him.”


“主意倒是不错。
“The idea is good enough.

不过我不能做。”
But I can’t take part.”

“是因为‘圈吉’的关系？”胡雪岩问。
“Because of ‘Ji in a Box’?” Hu asked.

“圈吉”周，是指周立春，
The character ji enclosed in a frame made the surname Zhou: he meant Zhou Lichun.

尤五点点头说，“一点不错，
You nodded. “Exactly.

不过你跟他没有交情，
But you have no ties to him.

你可以做。”
You could do it.”

“那就算了。
“Then let it drop.

第一，要做，就是大家一起来，
First, whatever we do, we do together.

第二，人家也晓得我跟你的交情，
Second, people know how close we are.

如果你觉得有妨碍，我做了一样也有妨碍。”
If it would put you in a difficult position, my doing it would cause the same difficulty.”

尤五听得这话，大感快慰，
You was deeply relieved to hear this.

他心里是巴不得胡雪岩不要做，但“光棍不断财路”，
In his heart he had wanted Hu to abandon the scheme, but a man of the brotherhood did not cut off another man’s livelihood.

明明是笔好生意，自己不能叫他罢手，
It was plainly a profitable venture; he could not ask Hu to give it up.

所以那样言不由衷地说“你可以做”。
That was why he had said, against his own wishes, “You could do it.”


“我还有第二条路子，
“There is another course,” Hu continued.

浙江现在正在办团练，
“Zhejiang is organizing militia forces.

湖州由一位姓赵，名叫赵景贤的绅士出面，
In Huzhou, a gentleman named Zhao Jingxian has taken the lead.

此人极其通达能干，跟王雪公的公谊私交都不错，
He is an exceptionally capable, broad-minded man, and is on good terms with Prefect Wang both publicly and privately.

我一说就可以成功。”
A word from me should settle it.”

“那好！
“Good!

这笔军火生意，我们一起来做。”
Let’s undertake that arms business together.”

“就有一样麻烦，要尤五哥你有办法才能成功。”胡雪岩说，
“There is just one difficulty, and it will depend on you to solve it.

“英国人的兵船开不到湖州，只能在上海交货，
British warships cannot reach Huzhou, so delivery would have to be made in Shanghai.

上海运到湖州，路上怕有危险。
The journey from Shanghai to Huzhou might be dangerous.

抢掉了怎么办？”
What if the cargo were seized?”

“危险也不过上海到嘉兴这一段，
“The only dangerous stretch is between Shanghai and Jiaxing.

一进浙江境界，有官兵护送，
Once it enters Zhejiang, government troops can escort it.

哪个敢抢？
Who would dare attack it then?

至于这一段路，归我保险。”尤五又说，
As for the first stretch, I’ll guarantee its safety.

“反正我们漕帮弟兄现在都空在那里，要人要船都现成。
Our grain-transport brothers are all idle now, with men and boats ready to hand.

借此让他们赚一笔水脚，事情再好都没有了。”
Giving them a chance to earn some freight money would be the best possible arrangement.”

“这一说，在我们两个人就算定局了。
“Then as far as the two of us are concerned, it is settled.

说做就做，
Let’s get on with it.

你倒再想想看，你那面还有什么事要我做到的？”
Think again: is there anything else you need me to arrange?”

尤五仔细想了想说，“你请浙江方面，替我们这里的督粮道来封公事，说要用松江漕帮的船运军火。
You considered carefully. “Have the Zhejiang authorities send an official letter to our grain transport circuit intendant here, saying that they wish to use the Songjiang grain boats to carry arms.

这样，我对官面上就算有了交代。”
That will put my dealings with the authorities in order.”


“这一定办得到。”
“That can certainly be done.”

胡雪岩转脸对陈世龙说，“又要你辛苦跑一趟了。”
Hu turned to Chen. “I’m afraid I must send you on another journey.”

“到杭州，还是到湖州？”
“To Hangzhou or Huzhou?”

“先到杭州。
“Hangzhou first.

如果王大老爷已经回任，你就再到湖州，
If Prefect Wang has already returned to his post, go on to Huzhou.

寻着他算数。
You must find him wherever he is.

不错，”胡雪岩忽然又说，“你正好把阿珠送了回去。”
And of course,” Hu added suddenly, “you can take A’zhu home at the same time.”

“好的。
“Very well.

啥时候走？”
When do I leave?”

“最多两三天，
“Within two or three days at most.

等我在这里接好头，写了信，马上就走。”
As soon as I’ve made the arrangements here and written the letter.”


接头是跟古应春接头。
The arrangements were to be made with Gu Yingchun.

第二天在怡情老二的香闺中，三个人又见了面，
The next day the three met again in Second Miss’s bedchamber at Yiqing House.

胡雪岩说了经过，问古应春，英国人肯不肯将枪炮、火药卖给这方面？
Hu explained what they had discussed and asked whether the British would sell guns, cannon and powder to their side.

“有啥不肯？
“Why wouldn’t they?

他们是做生意，
They are businessmen.

只要价钱谈得拢，什么都卖。”
If the price is right, they will sell anything.

古应春问道，“你要些什么东西，我好去谈。”
Tell me what you want, and I can negotiate.”

这下把胡雪岩难倒了，
This stumped Hu.

“这上面我一窍不通。”他说，
“I know nothing about such things.

“只要东西好就好。”
So long as the goods are good, that is enough.”

“不光是东西好坏，
“Quality isn’t the only consideration.

还有数目多少。
There is quantity too.

总要有个约数，才好去谈，
I must have approximate figures before I can negotiate.

譬如洋枪，应该多少支？”
How many foreign guns, for instance?”

“总要一千支。”
“A thousand, surely.”

“一千支！”古应春笑道，
“A thousand!” Gu laughed.

“你当一千支是小数目？
“Do you imagine that is a small number?

我看办团练，有五百支洋枪就蛮好了。
Five hundred foreign guns would be quite a good supply for a militia force.

还有，要不要请教习？
And will you need instructors?

洋枪不是人人会放的，
Not everyone knows how to fire them.

不会用，容易坏，
In inexperienced hands they are easily damaged.

坏了怎么修，
How will you repair them?

都要事先盘算过。”
All this must be considered beforehand.”

“应春兄，”胡雪岩拱拱手说，“你比我内行得太多了。
Hu clasped his hands. “Brother Yingchun, you know far more about it than I do.

索性你来弄个‘ 说帖’，
Why don’t you draw up a memorandum yourself?

岂不爽快？”
That would settle everything.”


古应春慨然应诺，而且立刻功手。
Gu readily agreed and began at once.

怡情老二亲自照料，移过“叫条子”用的笔砚来，磨浓了墨，
Second Miss personally brought over the brush and inkstone used to write invitations to courtesans and ground a rich supply of ink.

却无纸可写，好在是草稿，不妨拿“局票”翻过来，将就着用。
There was no blank paper, but since this was only a draft, the backs of the invitation slips would serve.

于是古应春一面提笔构思，一面过鸦片烟瘾，
Gu composed with his brush while indulging his opium habit.

烟泡装上烟枪，枪嘴上接根橡皮管子，一直通到他嘴里。
The prepared pellets were put into the pipe, with a rubber tube attached to the mouthpiece and reaching his lips.

十六筒烟抽完，精神十足，
After sixteen pipefuls, he was in excellent spirits.

文不加点，洋洋洒洒地写完，递到了胡雪岩手里。
His prose flowed freely, without a correction, and he handed the finished draft to Hu.

胡雪岩自己不能动笔，看却会看，不但会看，而且目光锐利，
Hu could not compose such a document himself, but he could read it—and judge it shrewdly.

象这些“说帖”，最要紧的是简洁，
A memorandum of this kind had above all to be concise.

要几句话就能把那些大官儿说动心，才是上品。
The best would move a high official with a few sentences.

古应春的笔下很来得，但流畅有余，不免枝蔓，
Gu wrote fluently, but fluency had carried him into unnecessary elaboration.

他把洋枪、火药的好处，源源本本谈起，
He explained the merits of foreign guns and gunpowder from their beginnings.

好虽好，看来却有些吃力。
The exposition was good, but somewhat laborious to read.

胡雪岩心想，这个说帖，王有龄、赵景贤一定会看完，
Wang Youling and Zhao Jingxian would certainly finish it, Hu thought.

但递到黄宗汉手中，他有没有看完的耐心，就难说了。
Whether Huang Zonghan would have the patience was another question.


“高明之至！”胡雪岩先声色不动地把说帖递给尤五。
“Excellent!” Hu said, keeping his expression unchanged as he passed the memorandum to You.

“我不必看了。”尤五笑道，
“There’s no need for me to read it,” You said with a laugh.

“看也是白看。”
“I wouldn’t get anything out of it.”

“雪岩兄，”古应春接口问道：“我是急就章，
“Brother Xueyan,” Gu put in, “this was written in haste.

有不妥的地方你尽管说。”
If anything is unsuitable, please say so.”

“好极了！
“It is very good.

不过，应春兄，对外行不好说内行话，
Only, Brother Yingchun, you cannot talk to outsiders in the language of an expert.

说了，人家也不懂。
They won’t understand.

我看，前面这一段，有些地方要割爱。
I think you may have to sacrifice some of the opening section.”

““我懂！”古应春点点头，
“I understand.” Gu nodded.

“现在谈洋务，都是些闭门造车，自说自话蒙人的玩意。
“So much talk of foreign affairs nowadays consists of people shutting themselves away and spinning their own tales to deceive others.

那些谈枪、炮怎么样制造的道理，说句实话，也真没有几个人懂，
To be frank, very few understand the principles behind the manufacture of guns and cannon.

我可以把它删节。
I can shorten those passages.

删归删、添归添，
But cutting is one thing and adding another.

你看，哪里还可以多说两句？
Where might I usefully say more?”

““很好了。
“It is very good already.

还有些地方不说也可以。”
There are still places where you could say less.”

这显然是客气话，古应春便说：“我这个人做事，不做则已，一做一定要把它做好，
Recognizing this as politeness, Gu replied, “When I undertake something, I mean to do it properly.

何况是自己人，
Besides, we are among friends.

尽请直言。”
Please speak plainly.”

“既如此，我说出来请你斟酌，
“Then let me offer this for your consideration.

第一，说道光年间，‘英、法犯我，不幸丧师，症结所在，厥为刀矛不敌火器’，
First, you say, ‘During the Daoguang reign, Britain and France attacked us, and our forces suffered defeat; the essential cause was that swords and spears could not withstand firearms.’

这句话一针见血，不过还可以着力说两句。”
That goes straight to the point, but it could be emphasized further.”

“对！
“Yes!

我自己也有这么个想法。”
I had the same thought.”


“再有一层，应春兄，
“There is another point, Brother Yingchun.

是不是可以加这么一段……”
Could you add a passage along these lines?”

胡雪岩所建议增加的是，说英国人运到上海的洋枪、火药有限，
Hu proposed saying that the supply of British guns and powder arriving in Shanghai was limited.

卖了给官军，就没有货色再卖给洪军及各地其他人，
What was sold to government forces would no longer be available to Hong’s army or other parties elsewhere.

所以这方面多买一支，那方面就少得一支，出入之间，要以双倍计算。
Every additional gun bought by the government would therefore mean one fewer in hostile hands, a difference that should count double.

换句话说，官军花一支枪的钱，等于买了两支枪。
In other words, the government would obtain the benefit of two guns for the price of one.

“你这个算法倒很精明，无奈不合实情。
“That is a clever calculation,” Gu said, “but unfortunately it does not fit the facts.

英国人的军械，来了一批又一批，源源不绝，
British arms arrive in one shipment after another, without interruption.

不会有什么卖给这个，就不能再卖给那个的道理。”
Selling to one customer does not prevent them from selling to another.”

“是的。
“Of course.

应春兄，这种情形，我清楚，你更清楚，
I know that, and you know it better still.

不过做官的清楚，京里的皇上和军机大臣，更不会清楚。
But officials do not, and the emperor and the grand councillors in Beijing know even less.

我们只要说得动听就是。”
All we need is an argument they will like to hear.”

古应春看着尤五笑了，
Gu looked at You and smiled.

尤五的话，很爽直：“应春兄，这些花样，我的这位小爷叔最在行，
You spoke bluntly. “Brother Yingchun, my young uncle here is an expert at these devices.

你听他的，包定不错。”
Follow his advice and you won’t go wrong.”

“好！”古应春说，
“Very well,” Gu said.

“我都懂了。
“I understand.

如果没有别的话，我今天带回去，改好誊正，
If there is nothing else, I will take this home today, revise it and make a fair copy.

再连洋行里的估价单，一起开来交给你。”
I’ll bring it back with a quotation from the firm.”


“慢来！”尤五插嘴问道：
“Wait a moment,” You interrupted.

“估价单怎么开法？”
“How will the quotation be drawn up?”

“照例是二人回扣。”古应春答道：
“The usual arrangement is a twenty-percent rebate,” Gu answered.

“如果要‘戴帽子’，我亦可以去说。”
“If you want the price padded, I can discuss that too.”

听他的口气，显然不主张浮报价款的“戴帽子”。
His tone made it plain that he did not favor inflating the quoted price.

胡雪岩也觉得一方面不能叫洋人看不起，另一方面对浙江官方要建立信用，
Hu agreed. They must avoid earning the foreigners’ contempt, and they needed to establish their credit with the Zhejiang authorities.

不宜在两成回扣以外，另出花样。
They ought not to invent further devices beyond the twenty-percent rebate.

“对！”尤五很诚恳地接受，
“Quite right,” You said sincerely.

“我原是怕你们疏忽，提一句。
“I only mentioned it in case you had overlooked the matter.

既然都曾想过，那就怎么样都是不错的了。”
Since you have considered it, whatever you decide will be all right.”


“不过，”古应春接下来问：“除了洋枪，还有大炮，
“But besides guns,” Gu continued, “there are cannon.

要不要劝浙江买？”
Should we urge Zhejiang to buy those too?”

“这慢一点。
“Let that wait.

浙江有个姓龚的，会造炮……”
There is a man named Gong in Zhejiang who makes cannon.”

姓龚的福建人，名叫龚振麟，曾经做过嘉兴县的县丞，
Gong Zhenlin was a native of Fujian and had once served as deputy magistrate of Jiaxing.

道光末年就在浙江主持“炮局”。
By the closing years of the Daoguang reign, he was directing Zhejiang’s cannon works.

从明朝中叶以来，一直在仿制的“红衣大将军炮”，都用生铁翻砂，
Since the middle of the Ming dynasty, the so-called Red-Robed General cannon had been copied by casting iron in sand molds.

龚振麟却发明了铸炮铁模，著成《图说》，
Gong had devised iron molds for casting cannon and had written an illustrated account of them.

还著了一本《枢机炮架新式图说》，在铸炮技术上，颇有改良。
He had also written an Illustrated Account of a New Pivoted Gun Carriage, making significant improvements in cannon-making technology.

他的儿子名叫龚之棠，能得父传。
His son, Gong Zhitang, had learned his craft from him.

父子二人、都很得浙江大吏的重用。
Both father and son were highly valued by Zhejiang’s senior officials.

“当然，打‘群子’的土造大炮，不及西洋的‘落地开花大炮’，
“Naturally, our locally made cannon firing clusters of shot cannot match the Western guns with shells that burst on impact.

但这话不能说！
But we mustn’t say so!

一说，炮局里的人当我们要敲他的饭碗，
The men at the cannon works would think we were trying to take away their livelihood.

一定鸡蛋里挑骨头，多方挑剔，结果是连洋枪都不卖。”
They would find fault with everything, and we might end up unable to conclude even the purchase of guns.”

“雪岩兄，”古应春既感慨又佩服地，“你真正人情熟透，
“Brother Xueyan,” Gu said with mingled admiration and feeling, “you understand human affairs thoroughly.

官场里的毛病，被你说尽了。”
You have laid bare all the faults of official life.”

“官场、商场都一样！
“Business and official life are alike in that respect.

总而言之，‘同行相妒’，
People in the same trade envy one another.

彼此能够不妒，什么事都可以成功！”
If only they could put envy aside, anything could be accomplished.”


古应春和尤五，都认为他这句话说得好，因此感情亦特别融洽。
Both Gu and You thought this well said, and their feelings toward one another grew warmer still.

在怡情院中，浅斟低酌，谈了许多开展的计划，
Over leisurely drinks at Yiqing House they discussed many plans for expanding their business.

一直到午夜散席，约定第二天下午，仍旧在原处见面。
It was midnight before they parted, agreeing to meet there again the following afternoon.

古应春走了，尤五宿在怡情老二那里，
Gu left, while You stayed with Second Miss.

因为还有事要谈，所以胡雪岩就在怡情院“借干铺”。
Since there was more to discuss, Hu borrowed a bed at the house without engaging a companion.

尤五要谈的是，他这天中午，和胡雪岩分手以后，到怡情院重新见面以前，所得来的一个消息。
You had news acquired between their parting at noon and their meeting again at Yiqing House.

听说，刘丽川跟英国人联系上了。
Liu Lichuan had reportedly established contact with the British.

夷场四周，英国人预备建筑围墙、不让官军进驻，也不准官军借道，
The British intended to build a wall around the foreign settlement and allow neither government troops to be stationed inside nor government forces to pass through.

但是英国人却预备开放陈家木桥，让刘丽川能够获得军火和粮食的接济。
Yet they planned to open Chenjia Wooden Bridge so that Liu could receive supplies of arms and food.

“照这样子，上海一年半载，不会光复。
“If that is so, Shanghai won’t be recovered for another six months or a year.

我们的丝生意，是不是做得下去？
Can we carry on our silk business?

现在先要作个打算。”
We had better consider it now.”


“这倒要好好想一想。”胡雪岩提出疑问，
“We must think carefully,” Hu said.

“上海的关税，是两江的命脉，
“Shanghai’s customs revenue is the lifeblood of Liangjiang.

总不会一直让英国人张牙舞爪，
They cannot let the British have their own way indefinitely.

一定有对付的办法。”
There must be a way of dealing with them.”

“这也听说了。”尤五答道，
“I have heard something about that too,” You replied.

“两江总督怡大人怊良，因为洋人助逆，早就预备禁止内地跟夷场通商。
“Governor-General Yiliang has long been preparing to prohibit trade between the interior and the foreign settlement because the foreigners are helping the rebels.

来源一断，我们在上海还有什么发展？”
Once supplies are cut off, what prospects will we have in Shanghai?”

“这话分两方面来说，
“There are two sides to that.

来源一断，货价必高，对我们有利，
Cutting off supplies will raise prices, which helps us.

没有货色，货价再高也无用，对我们无利。”胡雪岩说，
But without goods, even the highest prices are useless to us.

“生意还是可以照常做，只要对我们不利的这方面，能够避掉。”
We can carry on business as usual if we can avoid the disadvantageous side.”

“怎么避呢？
“How can we avoid it?

就是避不掉！”
We can’t!”

有个办怯，就是走私。
There was one way: smuggling.

以尤五在水路上的势力。呼应灵活，走私亦非难事，
With You’s influence over the waterways and his responsive network, it would not be difficult.

但犯法的勾当，胡雪岩不敢做，
But Hu did not dare undertake something illegal.

而且目前事事顺利，也犯不着去干犯法的勾当。
Everything was going well at present; there was no need to break the law.

就这一转念间，他把到口的话，缩了回去。
The thought passed through his mind, and he swallowed the words before uttering them.

“小爷叔，我想只有这么样，”尤五自己提出了一个办法：
“Young Uncle, I can see only one course,” You said.

“尽量调动现款，就在上海收货，囤一段时间脱手。
“Raise as much ready cash as possible, buy goods already in Shanghai, hold them for a while and then sell.

另外除了军火以外，有啥生意好做，我们再商量。
As for other business besides arms, we can discuss that too.

顶好是我们漕帮弟兄能够一起出力的事，
Best of all would be something our grain-transport brothers could work at together.

一则大家有口苦饭吃，二则也免得游手好闲去闯祸。”
It would give everyone a hard-earned living and keep them from getting into trouble through idleness.”

胡雪岩听出尤五的话中，对漕帮生计日窘，情有隐忧，
Hu heard the concealed anxiety behind these words about the brotherhood’s worsening livelihood.

既成知己，休戚相关，应该替他分优，
They were now close friends, sharing good fortune and bad; he ought to help You bear his worries.

于是问起松江漕帮的困难，看有什么办法好想？
He asked about the difficulties facing the Songjiang brotherhood and what might be done.

这一谈就谈得深了，直到天色微明。方始归寝。
The discussion grew so absorbing that they did not go to bed until dawn.


一觉睡到近午时分，胡雪岩为怪情院一个“大姐”喊醒，说有客来。
Hu slept until nearly noon, when one of the senior female attendants at Yiqing House woke him to say that he had a visitor.

起床一看是陈世龙，递上一封信，说是王有龄专程派人送了来的。
It was Chen Shilong, bringing a letter delivered by a special messenger from Wang Youling.

启封细看，
Hu opened it and read carefully.

才知道新城县抗粮滋事案，大功已成，
The affair of the grain-tax disturbances in Xincheng had been brought to a successful conclusion.

嵇鹤龄不负所望，协同地方绅士，设计擒获首要各犯。已经解到杭州审讯法办。
Ji Heling had fulfilled their expectations: working with local gentlemen, he had devised a plan to capture the principal offenders, who had been sent to Hangzhou for trial and punishment.

报告喜讯以外，接着便谈冬漕，
After the good news came the question of the winter grain shipment.

因为上海失守，浙江的漕米海运。决定改由浏河出口。
Because Shanghai had fallen, Zhejiang’s tribute rice would now be shipped out to sea through Liuhe.

这一来便多了周折，所以必须提早一个月启运，连带也就要提早催征、
The extra complications meant starting a month early, and the collection of the grain tax would also have to be advanced.

王有龄得要赶回湖州。
Wang needed to hurry back to Huzhou.

同时又因为上海失守的缘故，浙江人心惶惶，各地团练，都在加紧办理，湖州亦不例外，
Shanghai’s fall had caused alarm throughout Zhejiang, and militia organization was being pressed forward everywhere, Huzhou included.

虽说有赵景贤主持其事，地方官守土有责，不能不问。
Although Zhao Jingxian was directing the work, the local official was responsible for the defense of his territory and could not leave it unattended.

所苦的是，海运局的差使还不能摆脱，分身乏术，
Yet Wang could not extricate himself from his duties at the Sea Transport Bureau and could not be in two places at once.

希望胡雪岩无论如何回浙江一趟，他有许多事要当面商量。
He hoped that Hu would return to Zhejiang at all costs: there were many things they needed to discuss in person.

看完信，胡雪岩又高兴、又为难，而且还有些困惑，
Hu finished the letter pleased, troubled and puzzled.

高兴的是新城建功，为难的是他亦分身乏术，困惑的是嵇鹤龄应有酬庸、却未见提起。
He was pleased by the success at Xincheng, troubled because he too had more than he could attend to, and puzzled because there was no mention of the reward Ji Heling deserved.

怎么办？
What should he do?

他定神想了想、决定回去一趟，但不能“空手而回”，
He collected his thoughts and decided to go back, but not empty-handed.

有两件事，可以光为王有龄做好。
There were two things he could first arrange for Wang.

想停当了他告诉陈世龙说：“你回去收拾行李，
Having made up his mind, he told Chen, “Go back and pack.

我们明天就走，
We leave tomorrow.

阿珠也一起走。”
A’zhu will come with us.”


接着，他匆匆漱洗，去找尤五商量，
He hurried through his washing and went to consult You.

一谈漕米由浏河出口，尤五皱着眉说：“这麻烦大了！”
At the mention of sending the tribute rice out through Liuhe, You frowned. “That will cause a great deal of trouble.”

“怎么呢？”
“Why?”

“浏河在嘉定北面……”
“Liuhe lies north of Jiading.”

“啊！”胡雪岩失声而呼，
“Ah!” Hu exclaimed.

漕米驶运到浏河，由青浦、嘉定这一条路走，是不可能了。
Sending the grain boats to Liuhe by way of Qingpu and Jiading would be impossible.

“那么，该怎么走呢？”
“Then which way can they go?”

“要兜圈子！”
“They must make a detour.”

尤五蘸青茶在桌上画出路线：“从嘉兴往北，由吴江，昆山、太仓到浏河。”
Dipping a finger in clear tea, You traced the route on the table. “North from Jiaxing, through Wujiang, Kunshan and Taicang to Liuhe.”

“这真是兜了个大圈子。”胡雪岩又问，
“That is a considerable detour.

“太仓是不是靠近嘉定？”
Is Taicang near Jiading?”

“是啊，太仓在嘉定西北，四五十里路。”
“Yes, forty or fifty li northwest of it.”

说着，他深深看了胡雪岩一眼，意思是要当心周立春劫漕米。
You gave Hu a significant look: they must beware of Zhou Lichun seizing the grain.

胡雪岩心里明白，
Hu understood.

灵机一动，笑嘻嘻地说道：“尤五哥，你的生意来了，
An idea struck him, and he smiled. “Brother You, here is business for you.

靠交情卖铜钿，
Turn your connections into money!

浙江冬漕，最后到训河那段路，归你包运好不好？”
How would you like the contract to carry Zhejiang’s winter tribute grain over the final stretch to Liuhe?”


这是顺理成章，极妙的事，
It was a natural and excellent proposal.

但尤五因为来之太易，反有天下哪有这种好事的感觉，一时竟茫然不知所答。
Yet it had come so easily that You could scarcely believe such good fortune existed; for a moment he did not know what to say.

“怎么样？”胡雪岩催促着说，
“Well?” Hu urged.

“这件事我有把握，
“I am confident about this.

完全可以作主，
I can settle it myself.

只等你一句话，事情就算定局。”
One word from you, and it is arranged.”

“不晓得‘那方面’头不买我的帐？”尤五踌躇着说。
“I don’t know whether the other side will honor my connections,” You said hesitantly.

出入关系，就在这一点上，所谓“靠交情，卖铜钿”也就是这一点，
That was the decisive point, the very basis of turning friendship into money.

胡雪岩说道：“尤五哥，别的我都可以替你出主意，
“Brother You,” Hu replied, “I can advise you on everything else.

这方面要你自己才有数，
But only you can judge that.

我不便说什么！”
I cannot speak for you.”

“是的。”尤五深深点头。
“Yes.” You nodded solemnly.

“这要我自己定主意。
“That is for me to decide.

说实话，既然答应下来，要有肩胛，
If I undertake it, I must shoulder the responsibility.

不能做连累你和王知府的荒唐事。
I cannot do anything foolish that would involve you and Prefect Wang in trouble.

这样，为求稳当，我只能暂且答应你。
To be safe, I can only agree provisionally.

好在日子也还早，
There is still time.

我托人跟‘圈吉’去打个招呼看看，
I’ll send someone to sound out our friend Zhou.

如果口气不妙，我立刻通知你，只当没有说过这回事。
If his response is unfavorable, I’ll notify you at once, and we will treat the whole proposal as though it had never been made.

你看怎么样？”
What do you think?”

“你怎么说，怎么说。
“Whatever you say.

我们假定事在必成，先商量商量怎么个办法。”于是议定浙江清船到吴江，归尤五接驳转运，到浏河海口为止。
Let us assume it will succeed and first discuss the arrangements.” They agreed that, once Zhejiang’s grain boats reached Wujiang, You would take over the cargo and carry it onward to the sea outlet at Liuhe.

因为包运要担风险，水脚自然不能照常例计算。
Since the contract involved risk, the freight rate could not follow the ordinary scale.

胡雪岩答应为他力争，多一个好一个。
Hu promised to argue for the best possible terms: every extra payment would help.


谈完了一件谈第二件，这要去找古应春、
With the first matter settled, Hu turned to the second, which required a visit to Gu.

胡雪岩估计情势，浙江当道不但一定会买洋枪，
From his assessment of the situation, the Zhejiang authorities would certainly buy foreign guns.

而且因为上海失守，人心惶惶，防务亟待加强，所以对洋枪的需要，会倍感急迫。
Indeed, the alarm caused by Shanghai’s fall and the urgent need to strengthen defenses would make their demand especially pressing.

看准了这一点，不妨双管齐下，一面带说帖回去，劝浙江当道大批购买，一面带着现货回杭州，
He could therefore proceed on two fronts: take the memorandum back and urge a large official purchase, while also bringing guns ready for use to Hangzhou.

如果团练不用洋枪，就劝王有龄买了，供他的亲军小队使用。
If the militia did not buy them, he could persuade Wang to purchase them for his personal guard detachment.

找到古应春家，只见他正衣冠整齐地，顶备到恰情院赴约。
When Hu reached Gu’s house, he found him dressed and ready for their appointment at Yiqing House.

等胡雪岩说明来意，古应春想了一下问道：“你想要买多少支？”
After hearing Hu’s purpose, Gu considered for a moment and asked, “How many do you want?”

“先买两百支。”胡雪岩说，
“Two hundred to begin with.

“我带了一万两银子在身上。”
I have ten thousand taels with me.”

“两百支，有现货。
“There are two hundred in stock.

你怎么运法？”古应春提醒他说，
How will you transport them?

“运军械，要有公事，不然关卡上一定会被扣。”
You need official papers to move arms, or they are certain to be detained at a checkpoint.”

“是的。
“Yes.

我跟尤五哥商量好了，
I have discussed it with Brother You.

由上海运到松江，不会有麻烦。
Getting them from Shanghai to Songjiang will cause no trouble.

我一到杭州。立刻就请了公事迎上来接货，
As soon as I reach Hangzhou, I’ll obtain the official documents and send to meet the shipment.

这样在日子上就不会有耽搁了。”
That will avoid any delay.”

“好！
“Good!

我此刻就陪你去看洋人，当面议价。”
I’ll take you to see the foreigner now, and we can negotiate the price in person.”

说着，古应春拉了胡雪岩就走。
He took Hu by the arm and started out.


“慢点，慢点！”胡雪岩怯意地笑着，
“Wait, wait!” Hu said with a nervous smile.

“跟洋人打交道，我还是第一回……”
“This is my first time dealing with foreigners.”

“你怕什么？”古应春打断他的话说，
“What are you afraid of?” Gu interrupted.

“洋人也是人，
“Foreigners are human too.

又不是野人生番，
They are not wild savages.

文明得很。”
They are quite civilized.”

“不是说野蛮、文明，
“I don’t mean whether they are savage or civilized.

是有些啥洋规矩？
What foreign rules of conduct should I know?

你先说给我听听，省得我出洋相。”
Tell me beforehand so I don’t make a fool of myself.”

“这一时无从谈起。”古应春说，
“There is scarcely time to explain everything.

“中国人作揖，洋人握手，握右手。
We clasp our hands and bow; they shake hands—the right hand.

到屋子里要脱帽。
Take off your hat indoors.

洋人重堂客，回头你看见洋婆子要站起来，
They show respect to women, so stand when you see a foreign lady.

那个哈德逊太太很好客，最喜欢跟中国人问长问短，
Mrs Hudson is very hospitable and likes to ask Chinese visitors all sorts of questions.

洋人的规矩是不大重男女大防的，
Their customs do not insist on a strict separation between men and women.

你不必诧异。
Don’t be surprised.”

““这倒好，”胡雪岩笑道，
“That sounds pleasant,” Hu said, laughing.

“跟我们尤家那位七姑奶奶一样。”
“Like the Seventh Lady in the You household.”

“你说谁？”
“Who do you mean?”

“不相干的笑话，
“An irrelevant joke.

你不必理我。”胡雪岩摇摇手说，
Never mind me.” Hu waved it aside.

“我们走吧！”
“Let’s go.”


于是两乘肩舆，到了泥城桥一座小洋房，
Two sedan chairs took them to a small Western house at Nicheng Bridge.

下轿投刺，被延入客厅，
They alighted, sent in their visiting cards and were shown into the drawing room.

穿蓝布大褂的听差，也不奉茶，也不敬烟，关上房门就走了。
The servant, dressed in a long blue cotton gown, offered neither tea nor tobacco; he simply closed the door and went away.

隔不多久，靠里的一道门开启，长了满脸黄胡子的哈德逊大踏步走了出来。
Before long an inner door opened, and Hudson, his face covered in a yellow beard, strode in.

胡雪岩已打定主意，亦步亦趋跟着古应春，
Hu had resolved to copy Gu exactly.

看他起身，他亦起身，看他握手，他亦握手，
When Gu rose, he rose; when Gu shook hands, he shook hands.

只有古应春跟洋人谈话时，他只能看他们脸上的表情。
But when conversation began, Hu could do nothing except watch their expressions.

表情很不好，
Those expressions were far from reassuring.

洋人只管耸肩摊手，而古应春大有恼怒之色，
The foreigner kept shrugging and spreading his hands, while Gu looked increasingly angry.

然后声音慢慢地高了，显然起了争执。
Their voices gradually rose: plainly they were arguing.

“岂有此理！”古应春转过脸来，怒气冲冲地对胡雪岩说，
“Outrageous!” Gu turned to Hu in fury.

“他明明跟我说过，贸易就是贸易，只要有钱，他什么能卖的东西都愿意卖，
“He told me clearly that business was business: if a customer had money, he would sell anything he was able to sell.

现在倒又翻悔了，
Now he goes back on it.

说跟长毛有协议，卖了给他们就不能再卖给官军。
He says he has an agreement with the Long-Haired rebels and cannot sell to government troops after selling to them.

我问他以前为什么不说，
I asked why he hadn’t said so before.

他说是他们领事最近才通知的。
He claims his consul only recently informed him of it.

又说，他们也跟中国人一样，行动要受官府约束，所以身不由主。
He says they are subject to their authorities just as we are to ours and cannot act as they please.

你说气人不气人？”
Isn’t that infuriating?”

“慢来！”胡雪岩问道：
“Wait,” Hu said.

“什么叫协议，
“What does he mean by an agreement?

是不是条约的意思？”
Something like a treaty?”

“大致就是这意思。”
“Roughly speaking, yes.”

“那就不对了，
“Then it makes no sense.

朝廷跟英国人订了商约，开五口通商，
Our government made a commercial treaty with Britain, opening five ports to trade.

反而我们不能跟他通商，朝廷讨伐的叛逆，倒能够跟他通商。
Yet we cannot trade with him, while rebels whom our government is fighting can!

这是啥道理！”
What sort of reasoning is that?”


古应春大喜，
Gu was delighted.

“不错，不错。
“Exactly!

说得真有道理！
That is a very good argument.

等我问他。”
Let me put it to him.”

于是古应春转脸跟哈德逊办交涉，
He turned back to negotiate.

胡雪岩虽然听不懂意思，却听得出语气，看得出神色，
Hu could not understand the words, but he could hear the tone and read the expressions.

古应春一派理直气壮的声音，而哈德逊似乎有些词穷了。
Gu spoke with the confidence of a man who had right on his side; Hudson seemed at a loss for an answer.

到最后只见洋人点头，古应春含笑，向胡雪岩说道：“成功了！
At last the foreigner nodded, and Gu turned to Hu with a smile. “We have done it!

他答应跟他们领事去申诉。
He has agreed to take the matter up with his consul.

看样子未必有什么协议，
I suspect there may be no agreement at all.

只因为我们的生意小，长毛的生意大，伯贪小失大而已。”
Our order is small and the rebels’ orders are large; he is merely afraid of losing the greater profit for the smaller.”

“请你告诉他，眼前我们的生意小，将来生意会很大，
“Tell him that our business is small now but will be large in the future.

眼光要放远些，
He should take the long view.

在目前留些交情，将来才有见面的余地。”
If he cultivates our friendship today, we can continue dealing with him tomorrow.”

古应春便把他的话译了过去，
Gu translated.

洋人不断颔首，同时也不断看着胡雪岩，显然是心许其言。
Hudson nodded repeatedly and kept looking at Hu, plainly approving of what he had said.

“雪岩兄，”古应春说：“他说，你的话很有意味，要交你一个朋友，
“Brother Xueyan, he finds your remarks very interesting and would like to make a friend of you.

想请你去喝杯酒。
He wants to invite you for a drink.

问你的意思怎么样？”
What do you say?”

“当然，
“Of course.

应该叙叙，
We should get better acquainted.

归我们做东好了。”
Let us be the hosts.”

“那倒不必。
“There is no need.

让他做东好了。
Let him entertain us this time.

等生意谈妥，我们再回请。”
We can return the invitation once the business is settled.”


于是，等古应春转达了接受邀请的答复，哈德逊到屋角将一条在中国犯禁的“明黄”色丝绦一拉，
When Gu conveyed their acceptance, Hudson went to a corner and pulled a silk bell cord in the bright yellow reserved for imperial use in China.

外面叮叮当当的响了起来，接着便见原来的那个听差推门而入，
A jangling sounded outside, and the servant returned.

这让胡雪岩学了个乖，洋人招呼听差，是打铃不是拉长了声音喊：“来呀！”哈德逊吩咐听差，是准备马车，亲自拉缰，把他们两人载到一家外国酒店，
Hu learned something: foreigners summoned servants by ringing a bell instead of drawing out a loud cry of “Come!” Hudson ordered the carriage, took the reins himself and drove them to a Western drinking establishment.

入门一看，胡雪岩觉得有些头晕，
As Hu entered, he felt dizzy.

四面镜子，映出无数人影、灯烛、桌椅，
Mirrors on every side multiplied the people, lamps, tables and chairs without end.

赶紧顺手扶住一张椅子，立定了脚再说。
He quickly grasped a chair and steadied himself.

“就是这里吧！”古应春喊住哈德逊，各拉一张椅子坐下来。
“Let’s sit here,” Gu called to Hudson, and each drew up a chair.

于是胡雪岩也拉开椅子坐下，
Hu sat down too.

一抬眼，恰好看见镜子中出现的丽影，
Looking up, he caught the reflection of a beautiful figure in a mirror.

转脸来望，见是个金发碧眼的美女，真正是雪肤花貌，腰如一捻，
He turned and saw a blonde, blue-eyed woman with a snow-white complexion, lovely features and a slender waist.

露出一嘴雪白的牙齿，笑着在问话。
Her smile revealed white teeth as she asked a question.

于是哈德逊嘱咐了几句，那女侍转身走了。
Hudson gave her an order, and she turned away.

胡雪岩不便盯着她的背影看，只望着镜子。
Hu could hardly stare openly after her, so he watched her in the mirror.

西洋女人见得还不多，这一望，眼睛使舍不得离开镜子，
He had seen few Western women, and now found it difficult to take his eyes from the reflection.

看到那刚健婀娜的行路姿态，不由得想起穿着“花盆底”的旗下大姑娘，一摇三摆的样子，
Her vigorous yet graceful stride reminded him of the swaying walk of young Manchu women in their flowerpot-soled shoes.

觉得各擅胜场，都比三寸金莲、走路讲究裙幅不动的汉人妇女来得中看。
Each had its own charm; both seemed more attractive to him than Han women with tiny bound feet, whose ideal was to walk without disturbing the folds of their skirts.

正在这样想着，镜中的丽影又出现了，她手托银盘，
While he was thinking this, the waitress reappeared in the mirror carrying a silver tray.

盘中一瓶颜色象竹叶青的酒，三只水晶杯，又有一瓶凉水。
On it were a bottle of liquor resembling Bamboo Leaf Green in color, three crystal glasses and a bottle of cold water.

摆设停当，哈德逊取了三块银洋，放在银盘里。
Once she had set them down, Hudson placed three silver dollars on the tray.


“这酒也不便宜。”胡雪岩说，
“This liquor isn’t cheap,” Hu remarked.

“一块银洋七钱二，
“A silver dollar is worth seven qian and two fen.

三块银洋就合到二两一钱多银子。”
Three dollars come to more than two taels and one qian.”

“是啊！运费贵。”古应春答了他一句，
“Yes, freight is expensive,” Gu replied.

帮着哈德逊倒酒，又加上凉水，然后彼此举一举杯。
He helped Hudson pour the liquor and add cold water; then they raised their glasses to one another.

“怎么？”胡雪岩问：
“What?” Hu asked.

“这就吃了？
“We drink now?

有酒无肴！”
Wine without dishes?”

“洋盘！”古应春用夷场中新近流行的谚语笑他，
“A novice in foreign ways!” Gu teased him with a new expression current in the settlement.

“洋人吃酒，没有菜的。”
“Foreigners drink without food.”

“这我倒还是第一回。”
“Well, that is a first for me.”

胡雪岩喝了一口，
Hu took a sip.

酒味倒还不坏，但加了水，觉得劲道不够，
The flavor was not bad, but diluted with water it lacked strength.

便又把杯子放下了。
He put down the glass.

“我们谈生意吧！”古应春说了一声，
“Let’s talk business,” Gu said.

跟哈德逊去交谈，然后又问胡雪岩说，“他问你货色什么时候要？”
After speaking with Hudson, he turned back. “He asks when you need the goods.”

“最多三天就要起运。”
“They must be dispatched within three days at most.”

“那价钱就不同了。”古应春说，
“Then the price will be different.

“有一批货色，他已经答应了镇江一个姓罗的长毛，
He has a shipment already promised to a rebel named Luo at Zhenjiang.

你要可以先给你，要三十两银子一支。
He can let you have it first, but it will be thirty taels a gun.

如果你肯等半个月，他另有一批货色从英国运到，只要二十两一支。
If you can wait half a month, another shipment will arrive from Britain, and those would be only twenty taels each.”

““三十两就三十两。
“Thirty it is.

货色要好。”
The goods must be good.”


古应春点点头，又跟哈德逊去说。
Gu nodded and spoke to Hudson again.

就这样由他居间口译，很快地谈妥了一切细节，两百支枪，一万发子药，总价一万一千两银子，
With him interpreting between them, they soon settled every detail: two hundred guns and ten thousand rounds of ammunition, at a total price of eleven thousand taels.

二八回扣，实收八千八百两。
After a twenty-percent rebate, the sum payable was eight thousand eight hundred.

另外由哈德逊派一名“铜匠”随货到浙江去照料，要二百两银子的酬劳。
Hudson would also send a gunsmith with the shipment to Zhejiang to attend to the weapons, for a fee of two hundred taels.

“贷款我带在身上，
“I have the money with me.

是不是此刻就交？”
Shall I pay now?”

“不必。”古应春说，
“No need,” Gu replied.

“明天到他洋行里去办手续。”
“We can complete the formalities at his firm tomorrow.”

“那就托你了。”
“Then I’ll leave it to you.”

胡雪岩取出银票，交了过去，
Hu took out his banknotes and handed them over.

“这里一万两，
“Here are ten thousand taels.

多的是你的。”
The surplus is yours.”

“用不着。”古应春急忙摇手，
“There is no need for that!” Gu hastily waved the suggestion aside.

“大家一起做，
“We are all in this together.

回扣列入公帐，
The rebate goes into our common accounts.

将来再说。”
We can settle our shares later.”

“这话也对。
“Quite right.

那么，多的一千两算存在你的手里好了。”
Then consider the remaining thousand taels a deposit you are holding for me.”


古应春点点头，指着银票又跟哈德逊去谈，只见洋人笑容满面，
Gu nodded, pointed to the notes and spoke to Hudson, whose face broke into a broad smile.

很快的说了好些话，
He said a great deal very quickly.

据古应春传译，哈德逊认为跟胡雪岩做生意，很痛快，他要额外送一支最新式的“后膛七响”，以表敬意。
According to Gu, Hudson found doing business with Hu so agreeable that he wished to present him with one of the latest breech-loading, seven-shot guns as an additional mark of esteem.

“ 请你替我说，谢谢！”胡雪岩又说，
“Please thank him for me,” Hu said.

“再请你问问他，那种什么”后膛七响‘，可以不可以卖几支给我？
“And ask whether he could sell me a few of those—what are they called?—seven-shot breech-loaders.

我要带回去送人。
I should like to take some home as gifts.”

“这有些困难，
This was less easy.

哈德逊在中国好几年，深知贪小便宜的人多，
Hudson had spent several years in China and knew how fond many people were of small favors.

留着几支好枪要用来应酬人情，不肯出售。
He was keeping a few fine guns for cultivating useful relationships and did not want to sell them.

然而最后哈德逊却又让步了，愿意匀出两支来卖给胡雪岩，价钱是每支一百五十两银子，据他说，完全是照成本出让。
In the end, however, he yielded and agreed to spare two for Hu, at one hundred and fifty taels apiece, which he said was exactly the cost price.

每支枪另配一百粒子药，也是白送。
Each would come with a hundred rounds of ammunition, also given free.


做了额外的这笔小交易，哈德逊要开一瓶香摈酒庆祝。
To celebrate this additional little transaction, Hudson proposed opening a bottle of champagne.

古应春心想，胡雪岩对那种带点酸味的淡酒，未见得会感兴趣，
Gu doubted that Hu would care for a light wine with a somewhat sour taste.

而开一瓶香摈很贵，让哈德逊破费还是小事，
Champagne was expensive, but putting Hudson to expense was the lesser concern.

回头胡雪岩端起杯子一喝，皱眉摇头，浅尝即止，那就是件很不礼貌的事，
If Hu tasted it, frowned, shook his head and refused another sip, that would be distinctly rude.

不如辞谢了的好。
Better to decline.

于是他告诉哈德逊，说胡雪岩喝不惯洋酒，不能领受他的好意，表示抱歉，
He therefore apologized on Hu’s behalf, saying that Hu was unaccustomed to foreign liquor and could not accept the kind offer.

哈德逊厦问，胡雪岩是不是不会喝酒？
Hudson asked in return whether Hu was unable to drink.

及至听说他的酒量很好时，哈德逊使表示奇怪，
On learning that he had a considerable capacity, Hudson was astonished.

说桌上那瓶酒，来自苏格兰，不但是最有名的牌子，而且窖藏甚久，
The bottle on the table came from Scotland, he said; it was not only a celebrated brand but had been aged for a long time.

为何胡雪岩不喝？
Why would Hu not drink it?

又说，他跟好些中国人有过交往，凡是会喝酒的，都欣赏苏格兰的酒，
He knew many Chinese, and all who enjoyed liquor appreciated Scotch.

何以胡雪岩独异？
What made Hu different?

接着又表示，如果胡雪岩不介意，他很想知道其中的缘故。
If Hu did not mind, he would very much like to know.

古应春想敷衍一下，就算过去。
Gu meant to give an evasive answer and let the matter pass.

倒是胡雪岩看哈德逊不断指着酒瓶和他的酒杯。滔滔不绝地在说话，
But Hu saw Hudson repeatedly indicating the bottle and his glass while talking at length.

猜到是谈杯中物，便自己先问起此事。古应春自然照实回答。
Guessing the subject, he asked about it, and Gu naturally told him the truth.

“饮食一道，萝卜、青菜，各人自爱，
“In eating and drinking, one man likes radishes and another likes greens.

好象女人一样，情人眼里出西施，
It is like women: to a lover, his beloved is as beautiful as Xi Shi.

没有什么道理好讲的。”
There is no explaining tastes.”

古应春把他这一段话译给哈德逊听，洋人大点其头，
Gu translated this, and Hudson nodded emphatically.

说饮食没有道理好讲，这就是道理。
Saying that tastes could not be explained was itself an explanation.

接着又说，外国酒种类很多，
There were many kinds of foreign liquor, he added.

胡雪岩不喜欢英国酒，也许喜欢法国的白兰地，
If Hu did not like British liquor, perhaps he would enjoy French brandy.

于是招一招手把那女侍叫了过来，指明要一种名牌的白兰地。
He beckoned to the waitress and named a particular celebrated brand.


喝这种酒又是一种杯子，矮脚敞口大肚子，
Brandy required a different glass: short-stemmed, broad-mouthed and round-bowled.

但酒例得不多，也不掺水。
Only a little was poured, without water.

哈德逊通过古应春，教胡雪岩喝这种酒的方法，
Through Gu, Hudson taught Hu how to drink it.

说要双手台捧酒杯，慢慢摇晃，等手心里的热气，传入酒中，香味自发，便益觉醇美。
He should cradle the glass in both hands and swirl it gently; as warmth from his palms entered the liquor, its fragrance would rise and its mellow flavor become more apparent.

胡雪岩如法炮制，试一试果如其言。
Hu followed these directions and found them justified.

哈德逊告诉古应春说，他终于找到了一种为胡雪岩所喜爱的酒，觉得很高兴。
Hudson told Gu how pleased he was to have found a liquor Hu enjoyed.

接着便谈白兰地的制法，由采撷葡萄到装瓶出售，讲碍非常详细。
He then described brandy-making in great detail, from harvesting grapes to bottling the finished drink.

最后指着标贴纸上的一个洋字，读出它的译名叫“可涅克”，
Finally, he pointed to a word on the label and pronounced it: “Cognac.”

说选白兰地，一定要注意这个字，
When choosing brandy, he said, one should always look for this word.

它是地名，法国出酒最好的地方。
It was a place-name, the finest liquor-producing district in France.

“我懂了！”胡雪岩对古应春说，
“I understand!” Hu told Gu.

“好比中国的黄酒一样，一定要‘绍兴’才道地。”
“Just like our yellow wine: it has to be Shaoxing to be authentic.”

“对，就是这意思。”
“Exactly.”


“现在……”
“Now…”

哈德逊接着便跟古应春说，他的洋行，刚刚取得这种法国酒的代理权，希望胡雪岩为他介绍买卖。
Hudson went on to tell Gu that his firm had just obtained the agency for this French liquor, and he hoped Hu would introduce customers.

“ 原来他是推销货色！”胡雪岩笑道，
“So he is promoting his merchandise!” Hu laughed.

“怪不得这么起劲。
“No wonder he is so enthusiastic.

不过我不懂，什么叫‘代理权’？”
But I don’t understand: what does an agency mean?”

“就是归他包卖。”古应春为他解释，
“He has the exclusive right to sell it,” Gu explained.

“这种俩在我们中华土地上，归他总经销，坐抽水子，
“He is the general distributor of this liquor in China and takes a commission on the sales.

这就叫代理权。
That is what an agency means.”

“胡雪岩立刻就懂了，
Hu understood at once.

这种坐享其成的事，完全要靠信誉，
Such a business, earning its return from arranging sales, depended entirely on reputation and credit.

牌号响，信用好，货色销得出去，货款收得进来，到时候结帐，不久分文，
A firm needed a respected name, sound credit, the ability to sell the goods and collect payment, and accounts settled punctually without a penny left owing.

人家才肯赋予代理权。
Only then would another company grant it an agency.

他心里在想，自己也大可这么做，
He thought he might very well do the same himself.

不过那是将来的事，眼前怎么样也谈不到此，所以不再往下说了。
But that was for the future, beyond any immediate prospect, so he did not pursue the subject.


酒味甚美，只是有酒无肴，胡雪岩还不习惯这样的饮酒方式，所以喝得不多，
The brandy tasted excellent, but Hu was still unused to drinking without food and took little.

但为了酬答雅意，也为了馈赠所需，他决定买五箱白兰地带回去。
To acknowledge Hudson’s hospitality, and to supply himself with gifts, he decided to buy five cases to take home.

哈德逊也很会做生意，马上又给他一个很优惠的折扣，
Hudson was a shrewd businessman too and immediately offered a generous discount.

他的目的是在推广。
His aim was to promote the product.

杭州是浙江省城，除了总督，各式各样的衙门都有，
Hangzhou was Zhejiang’s provincial capital, with every kind of government office except that of a governor-general.

又是运河起点，商业相当繁盛，
It was also the starting point of the canal and a flourishing commercial center.

这个码头在哈德逊看，是可以有所作为的，他希望得到胡雪岩的助力，能够把他所代理的各种洋货，推销到杭州。
Hudson saw considerable potential in the port and hoped Hu would help sell there the various foreign goods for which his firm held agencies.

这番意思经由古应春表达以后，胡雪岩自然欢迎，
When Gu explained this, Hu naturally welcomed the proposal.

但他跟古应春说了实话，他官商两方面，缠在手里的事情实在太多，一时无法给哈德逊任何确实的答复，
But he spoke frankly to Gu: he already had far too much official and commercial business on his hands to give Hudson a definite answer.

看这话是如何说法？
How should they put that?

“那就直接回头他！”这里的“回头”是辞谢的意思，
“Then simply turn him down.”

胡雪岩却又觉得这是个机会，弃之可惜，
Hu felt, however, that this was an opportunity too valuable to discard.

最好是拖延着，要能让哈德逊不找别人，为他保留着这个机会。
Better to delay in such a way that Hudson would keep the opportunity for him instead of approaching someone else.

脑筋一动，想到了一番话：
An idea occurred to him.

“你这样跟他说，本来我马上可以答应他，为他在杭州策划，
“Tell him this: ordinarily I could agree at once to organize matters for him in Hangzhou.

但目前局势不稳，
But conditions are unsettled.

上海到杭州的路会断，货源不继，变成白贴开销。
The route from Shanghai to Hangzhou may be cut, interrupting supplies and leaving us to pay expenses for nothing.

等局势稍微稳定下来，我马上替他动手。”
As soon as the situation becomes a little more stable, I will get to work for him.”

哈德逊认为他的看法很稳健，同意等一等再说，
Hudson thought this a prudent judgment and agreed to wait.

不过他要求胡雪岩在杭州先替他看看洋货的行情，预作准备，
Meanwhile, he asked Hu to investigate the Hangzhou market for foreign goods and make preliminary preparations.

将来有任何代理承销的机会，答应让胡雪岩优先承揽。
He promised Hu the first opportunity to take up any future agency or distribution arrangement.


生意谈到这里为止，彼此都觉得很圆满。
Their business discussions ended to everyone’s satisfaction.

古、胡二人先起身告辞，安步当车，走回怡情院。
Gu and Hu took their leave and walked back to Yiqing House.

一路走，一路谈，谈的却不是生意。
They talked on the way, but no longer about business.

胡雪岩问道：“怎么样？外国酒馆里的那个洋女人，算是啥名堂？”
“Tell me,” Hu asked, “what exactly is the position of that foreign woman in the drinking place?”

“卖酒的还有啥名堂！”古应春笑道，
“She sells liquor. What else?” Gu laughed.

“你想她卖啥？”
“What did you imagine she sold?”

胡雪岩笑笑不答，
Hu smiled without answering.

不一会却又以抱憾的声音说：“可惜我不懂洋文。
After a while he said regretfully, “It is a pity I don’t understand their language.

不然，跟她谈谈说说，一定是蛮有趣的一件事。”
Otherwise it would surely be interesting to talk with her.”

“我倒想不到，”古应春也笑了，“你会中意洋女人！”
“I wouldn’t have expected you to take a fancy to a foreign woman,” Gu said, laughing too.

“女人总是女人，
“A woman is a woman.

管她是华是洋，只要动人就好。”
Chinese or foreign makes no difference, so long as she is attractive.”

“慢慢来！”古应春说，
“Give it time,” Gu replied.

“将来你在上海住长了，总有跟洋女人落个交情的时候。”
“Once you have lived in Shanghai longer, you will have opportunities to make friends with foreign women.”



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十四章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Fourteen, concluding part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


就这样谈着夷场风月，不知不觉到了恰情院。
Talking of romance in the foreign settlement, they reached Yiqing House almost without noticing.

一进门就见相帮、娘姨、大姐聚在一起，指指点点在小声说笑，似乎遇见了什么神秘而有趣的事，
Inside the entrance, the male and female attendants and maids were gathered together, pointing and laughing quietly as though something mysterious and amusing had occurred.

胡雪岩便好奇地问道：“你们在讲啥？”
Curious, Hu asked, “What are you all talking about?”

“胡老爷，有位堂客在里面，跟二小姐谈得好亲热。”
“Mr Hu, there's a lady inside, having a very friendly conversation with the Second Miss.”

“堂客！”
“A lady!”

胡雪岩诧异：
Hu was astonished.

“堂子里只住官客，
“A courtesan house receives gentlemen.

哪来的堂客？”
Where has a lady come from?”

说着便站往了脚，
He stopped.

因为有堂客在里面，虽未“放门帘”，也不便乱闯。
With a woman visiting, it would be improper to walk straight in, even though the curtain had not been lowered.

“不要紧！胡老爷你请进去看了，就晓得了。”
“It's all right, Mr Hu. Go in and see, and you'll understand.”

古应春比胡雪岩更好奇，
Gu Yingchun was even more curious.

听得“不要紧”三字，首先就拔脚进门，
At the words “It's all right,” he stepped through the door ahead of Hu.

只觉眼前一亮，那位堂客如雪山皑皑，令人不可逼视。
His eyes were dazzled: the visitor was as radiantly fair as a snow-covered mountain, almost too brilliant to look upon.

这位丰腴丰皙、艳光照人的少妇，正是七姑奶奶。
The full-figured, fair-skinned young woman, radiant with beauty, was the Seventh Lady.

看见闯来的那个陌生男子，长身如鹤，英气勃勃，不觉心中一动，
Seeing the stranger—tall as a crane and full of spirit—she felt an involuntary stirring.

五百年风流冤家，就此在不该相遇的地方遇到了。
A pair of lovers destined for each other five hundred years before had met where they ought never to have met.


一半是不知如何招呼，一半是目炫心迷，
Neither knew quite how to greet the other, and both were dazzled and bewildered.

正当他们错愕无语，而怡情老二也觉得为难之际，
They stood in startled silence, while Yiqing's Second Miss wondered what to do.

胡雪岩跟了进来，一看亦大感意外：
Then Hu came in and was equally surprised.

“咦，七姐！
“Why, Seventh Sister!

是你。”
It's you.”

有人搭腔，事情便好办了，
With someone to begin the conversation, things became easier.

七姑奶奶向来说话粗声大气，不堪领教，
The Seventh Lady ordinarily spoke so loudly and roughly that she was difficult to endure.

这时不知是受了恰情老二一口吴侬软语的感染，还是因为有古应春这个一见便生好感的陌生男客在，心存顾忌，居然斯斯文文地喊一声：
Now, whether influenced by the Second Miss's soft Suzhou speech or restrained by the presence of a stranger who had pleased her at first sight, she spoke with remarkable gentleness.

“小爷叔，你想不到我在这里吧？”
“Young Uncle, you didn't expect to find me here, did you?”

自然想不到，
Certainly not.

胡雪岩心想，兄弟一起逛堂子的事，听说过，兄妹一起逛堂子，却是天大的新闻。
Hu had heard of brothers visiting courtesans together, but a brother and sister doing so was extraordinary news.

便点点头说：
He nodded.

“我道是哪位堂客？
“I was wondering who the lady could be.

怎么样也想不到是你。”
I'd never have thought of you.”

“请坐，请坐！”
“Please sit down, both of you!”

怡情老二看古应春和七姑奶奶偷眼相望，随即说道：“胡老爷，你来引见吧！”
Noticing Gu and the Seventh Lady stealing glances at one another, the Second Miss added, “Mr Hu, do introduce them.”

于是胡雪岩为古应春及七姑奶奶作了介绍，
Hu did so.

一个盈盈含笑，把双手放在左腰上，福了一福，
Smiling, the Seventh Lady placed both hands at her left waist and curtsied.

一个抱拳作揖说道：
Gu returned a clasped-hands bow.

“原来是七姐！
“So you are Seventh Sister!

真正伉爽不让须眉。”
Your spirit is the equal of any man's.”

七姑奶奶懂了他那句语，虽是恭维，却也有惊诧的意味在内，
She understood the compliment, but heard surprise in it too.

想想一个良家妇女，独闯娼门，说起来是有些不守妇道，
A respectable woman coming alone into a courtesan house could hardly be called proper conduct.

所以很难得地害了羞，红着脸报以微笑。
Unusually for her, she felt shy and answered with a blush and a smile.

她的笑容最甜，虽是窘笑，依然妩媚。
Her smile was exceptionally sweet; even an embarrassed one remained charming.

古应春心里在想：倒不曾料到，尤五有这样漂亮的一个妹妹！
Gu thought that he had never expected You Laowu to have such a beautiful sister.


等怡情老二招呼着坐定，胡雪岩自然要问来意，
Once the Second Miss had settled them in their seats, Hu naturally asked what had brought the Seventh Lady there.

七姑奶奶坦率相告，因为尤五一夜不曾回家，而她回松江之前还有许多话要问他，
She answered frankly: her brother had stayed out all night, and she had much to ask him before returning to Songjiang.

心里焦急，所以找上门来。
Growing anxious, she had come to find him.

“你一个人来的？”
“Did you come alone?”

“是啊！”
“Yes!”

七姑奶奶顽皮而得意地笑道，
She smiled with mischievous satisfaction.

“我那位妹子不许我来，阿龙也不肯带路，
“Our young sister wouldn't let me come, and A’long wouldn't show me the way.

我只好借故溜了出来，自己雇一顶小轿到这里。
I had to slip out on an excuse and hire a small sedan chair myself.

不曾遇着五哥，倒跟二小姐谈得好投机，”
I haven't found Brother Five, but I've had a splendid talk with the Second Miss.”

“啊呀！七姑奶奶，”
“Oh, Seventh Lady!”

怡情老二不安地笑着：
Their hostess smiled uneasily.

“真正不敢当你这么的称呼，
“Such a formal title is far too much for me.

叫我老二好了。”
Just call me Second.”

“或者叫小五嫂。”胡雪岩打着趣问：
“Or Little Fifth Sister-in-Law,” Hu teased.

“那么，人呢？”
“Well, where is he?”

这是指尤五，
He meant You Laowu.

怡情老二答道：“有朋友约了出去了。
“A friend invited him out,” the Second Miss replied.

说八点钟一定回来，请胡老爷、古老爷务必等他。”
“He said he'd certainly be back at eight and asked both of you to wait.”

“自然要等。”
“Of course we shall.”

胡雪岩问七姑奶奶，
Hu turned to the Seventh Lady.

“想来你也还没有吃饭，
“I suppose you haven't eaten either.

我们是上馆子，还是就在这里吃。”
Shall we go to a restaurant or eat here?”

“自然是在这里吃。”怡情老二急忙接口，
“Here, naturally!” the Second Miss interrupted eagerly.

“我请七姑奶奶吃便饭，请你们两位作陪客。”
“I'm inviting the Seventh Lady to a simple meal, with you two gentlemen to keep her company.”

“理当奉陪。”
“We shall be honoured to join you,” Gu replied.


古应春都答应了，胡雪岩还有什么话说？
Since Gu had accepted, what could Hu say?

七姑奶奶却是外场人物，
The Seventh Lady, however, was accustomed to dealing with people.

招招手把他叫到一边，悄悄问道：“小爷叔，这里的规矩，我不大懂。
She beckoned Hu aside and asked quietly, “Young Uncle, I don't know the customs here.

你看，这顿饭该不该吃？”
Do you think I ought to stay for this meal?”

“来都来了，还讲什么规矩？”
“Now that you've come, why worry about customs?”

七姑奶奶脸一红，
She blushed.

“本来是没有这种规矩的，
“There certainly isn't any custom of this kind.

我大着胆子乱闯。
I simply took my courage in both hands and came.

只怕叫人笑死了！”
I'm afraid people will laugh themselves to death at me.”

说着，悄伶伶一双眼睛瞟了过去。
As she spoke, her lively eyes glanced across the room.

胡雪岩顺着她的眼光看过去，恍炊大悟，
Hu followed her gaze and understood.

怪不得“女张飞”这般斯文！
No wonder the female Zhang Fei had become so refined!

当时只有一个念头，要成人之美。
His immediate impulse was to help a happy match along.

于是他轻轻一道：“七姐，你请过来，
“Seventh Sister, come over here,” he said softly.

我有句话说。
“There's something I want to tell you.”

“怡情院的那个“大房间”甚大，
The large room at Yiqing House was spacious indeed.

西面用个“多宝格”隔开，
Open display shelves divided off the western side.

他领着她到里面，在窗下红木太师椅上坐下，两人的脸都朝外，
He led her behind them, and they sat in rosewood armchairs beneath the window, both facing outwards.

透过多宝格，只见古应春和怡情老二也正谈到起劲，不会注意到他们的谈后，
Through the shelves, they could see Gu and the Second Miss deep in conversation, unlikely to notice their own talk.

于是胡雪岩才出言规劝。
Only then did Hu offer his advice.

“七姐”他用兄妹般，极恳切的声音说，“你不开口，是尊观音，
