“Seventh Sister,” he said earnestly, as a brother might, “when you say nothing, you look like the Goddess of Mercy.

开出口来，说句实话，别人吃你不消！
But once you begin to speak, people frankly find you too much.

今天总算难得，替五哥做了面子。
Today, for once, you've done Brother Five credit.

回头你自己再做忌些，那样子，人家就不会笑你了。”
Keep a little more restraint as the evening goes on, and nobody will laugh at you.”

在平日，七姑奶奶对他这话，一定不服帖，
Ordinarily, she would have resented this.

这时却是窘笑着点一点头说：
Now she merely smiled awkwardly and nodded.

“我晓得了。
“I understand.

就是这句话吗？”
Is that all?”

“就是这句话。”
“That is all.

胡雪岩说：“你是玲珑七窍心，
You're clever enough to grasp the slightest hint.

自己有数就是，何必还要我多说呢？”
Once you understand, why should I say more?”

这话有言外之意，
There was meaning beneath the words.

七姑奶奶想再问些什么，到底还不好意思出口，
She wanted to ask further, but could not quite bring herself to do so.

只很妩媚地笑着道谢：“谢谢你，小爷叔！”
With a charming smile, she simply said, “Thank you, Young Uncle.”


两人走到外面，怡情老二迎上来说：
When they emerged, the Second Miss came to meet them.

“古老爷的话不错，
“Mr Gu is right.

这里大嘈杂，
It's too noisy here.

请到我‘小房了’去吃吧！”
Let's eat at my little house.”

姑娘与恩客另营不虑人干扰的双宿双飞之处，叫做“小房子”。
A courtesan's “little house” was a separate retreat where she and a favoured patron could be together undisturbed.

抬情老二的小房子就在这条弄堂的末尾，
Hers stood at the far end of the lane.

也是尤五每个月贴开销，但尤五的朋友多，在怡情院会客比较方便，所以难得到小房子去。
You Laowu paid its monthly expenses too, but with so many friends to entertain, he found Yiqing House more convenient and seldom used the retreat.

想不到这时候倒派上了用场。
Unexpectedly, it now had a purpose.

胡雪岩自然赞成，
Hu naturally approved.

回头对七姑奶奶说道：“那是老二住家的地方，
Turning to the Seventh Lady, he said, “It's where she lives.

比较清静，
Much quieter.

走吧！”
Let's go.”

于是怡情老二关照相帮，凡有“局票”来，只说病了，不能出“堂差”，
The Second Miss instructed the male attendant that, if any invitations arrived, he must say she was ill and could not attend outside engagements.

又关照，等尤五一来，请到小房子去。
When You arrived, he was to be directed to the little house.

这一下倒提醒七姑奶奶了，
This reminded the Seventh Lady of something.

依然是把胡雪岩喊到一边，悄悄说道：“我是溜出来的。
Calling Hu aside again, she said softly, “I slipped out.

不见我的人，他们会发急。”
If they can't find me, they'll worry.”

这是指阿珠和陈世龙而言，
She meant A’zhu and Chen.

“那好办！”他说，
“That's easily managed.

“叫人去通知一声就是了。”
We'll send someone to tell them.”

当时写了个便条，说七姑奶奶与尤五在一起，到时自回，不必着急。
He wrote a note saying that the Seventh Lady was with You Laowu and would return in due course; there was no need for anxiety.

胡雪岩掏了个银角子做力钱，叫怡情院的相帮，立刻送交陈世龙。
Taking out a small silver coin as a tip, he told the attendant to deliver it to Chen immediately.


办妥了这一切，一起走到怡情老二的小房子，
With everything settled, they went to the Second Miss's little house.

是一楼一底的石库门房子，
It was a two-storey building with a stone-framed gateway.

楼下是另一家，她住楼上，布置得楚楚有致，
Another household occupied the ground floor; she lived upstairs, where everything was arranged with taste and care.

看上去是很舒服的地方。
It looked very comfortable.

刚刚坐定，怡情院里自己做的酒菜。已经送到。
They had barely sat down when the food and wine prepared at Yiqing House arrived.

怡情老二和古应春都要推七姑奶奶上座，她则一定不肯，
Both their hostess and Gu urged the Seventh Lady to take the seat of honour, but she firmly refused.

结果是古应春首座，她和胡雪岩两对面，主人未座，正好各据一方。
In the end, Gu sat at the head, she and Hu faced one another, and their hostess took the lowest place, one person on each side of the table.

款客的是红葡萄酒，古应春送的洋酒。
The drink was a foreign red grape wine, a gift from Gu.

据说那是补血的，连宫里都经常饮用。
It was said to nourish the blood and to be drunk regularly even at the imperial court.

怡情老二把它看得很珍贵，殷殷相劝。
The Second Miss prized it highly and pressed it on her guests.

七姑奶奶的酒量，也还不坏，但一心只记着胡雪岩的忠告，强持着不肯多喝，也不多说话。
The Seventh Lady could hold her liquor, but with Hu's advice firmly in mind, she made herself drink little and speak little.

席面上只听古应春在谈胡雪岩上外国酒馆的经过，七姑奶奶和怡情老二都听得只是笑。
Gu did most of the talking, recounting Hu's visit to the foreign tavern and keeping both women laughing.

古应春这天的兴致很好，谈笑风生，滔滔不绝，一直到尤五出现，话锋才被打断。
He was in excellent spirits that day, witty and fluent, and his stream of conversation continued until You Laowu appeared.


兄妹相见，都有些不自然的表情，
Brother and sister greeted each other awkwardly.

尤五的不悦，还可以想象得到，但对七姑奶奶的微现俱惮，胡雪岩却有些意外，
You's displeasure was understandable, but the slight fear in the Seventh Lady's manner surprised Hu.

在他的印象中，七姑奶奶行事任性，从不知什么叫害怕？
In his experience, she did exactly as she pleased and knew nothing of fear.

平日只见尤五有些怕她，
Usually her brother seemed somewhat afraid of her.

此刻为何她怕尤五？
Why was she afraid of him now?

这就是为了有古应春在座的缘故。胡雪岩很快的想通了，
Hu soon understood: Gu was present.

她怕她哥哥责备她几句，当着古应春下不得台。
She feared a reprimand from her brother that would embarrass her before him.

既然如此，倒要小心防护她，
Hu must protect her.

因此，他首先就替她解释不能不来的缘故。接着便谈与哈德逊会面的经过，算是让尤五忘掉了对七姑奶奶的不快。
He began by explaining why she had had to come, then recounted their meeting with Hudson, successfully diverting You from his displeasure.

自此开始，就没有工夫说笑了，
After that there was no time for jokes.

许多正事要商量，头绪纷繁，一件事没有办妥，又扯到第二件。
Many practical matters needed discussion, so entangled that they passed to a second before resolving the first.

直到午夜，还未安排停当。
By midnight, everything was still not arranged.

“怎么办呢？
“What are we to do?

我非早早赶回杭州不可。”
I must get back to Hangzhou soon.”

胡雪岩有些着急，
Hu was anxious.

“一直都觉得人不够用，此刻越觉得摆布不开。”
“I've always felt short of people, but now I can hardly manage at all.”

半天未曾开口的七七姑奶奶开口了：
The Seventh Lady, silent for a long time, spoke up.

“也没有什么摆布不开！
“There's nothing so unmanageable about it.

小爷叔你明天尽管动身，
Go tomorrow, Young Uncle.

路上没有人送，我送，
If there's nobody to escort you, I'll do it.

保你到了嘉兴，我再回松江。”
I'll see you safely to Jiaxing and then return to Songjiang.”

“这倒也是个办法！”尤五点点头，
“That would be a solution,” You said, nodding.

“好在一路上，阿七都熟。
“A’qi knows the whole route well.

就这样吧！
Let's settle it like that.

你到了杭州，赶快派世龙拿了公事到松江来接洋枪。”
Once you reach Hangzhou, send Shilong to Songjiang as quickly as possible with the official papers to collect the foreign guns.”

他们兄妹这一番对答，使得古应春大为惊奇，
Gu was astonished by the exchange.

“原来七姐是这么能干！”
“So Seventh Sister is capable of all this!”

他自愧不如以外，也为她担忧，
He felt outdone, but worried for her too.

“这条路上，这几天很不好走，
“That route has been difficult these last few days.

要当心！”
You must be careful.”

“谢谢你！”
“Thank you.”

她报以矜持的微笑，
She gave him a restrained smile.

“不要紧的。”
“It will be quite all right.”


“真的不要紧！”
“Quite all right indeed!”

到这时候，尤五总算找到机会，可以说她一句了，
At last You had found an opportunity to reprimand her.

“我们家这位姑奶奶，一个人乱闯闯惯了的。”
“Our lady here is used to rushing off anywhere by herself.”

“也不是什么乱闯。”
“I don't simply rush off anywhere.”

七姑奶奶觉得必须分辩，
She felt obliged to defend herself.

“有把握的地方我才敢去，
“I go where I'm confident of things.

摸不清路道的地方，我也不敢乱闯。
I wouldn't venture where I didn't know my way.

象这里，我就晓得是不要紧的。”
Here, for instance, I knew there was nothing to worry about.”

“对啊！”怡情老二接口说道，
“Exactly!” the Second Miss said.

“要是不嫌弃，常常请过来，
“If you don't think it beneath you, please come often.

这里就跟自己家一样。”
Treat this place as your own home.”

“听见没有，五哥！”七姑奶奶碍意地，
“Did you hear, Brother Five?” the Seventh Lady asked triumphantly.

“就跟自己家一样！”
“My own home!”

“只有一件，”古应春也凑趣说笑，
“Only one thing,” Gu added playfully.

“回去在五嫂面前瞒着点。”
“Keep it quiet before Fifth Sister-in-Law when you return.”

“这倒不碍事。
“There's no need.

我五嫂最贤慧，
She's exceedingly good-natured.

不管他这笔帐。”
She doesn't hold this sort of thing against him.”

“好了，好了！”
“Enough, enough!”

尤五看看钟说，
You looked at the clock.

“该走了。”
“It's time to go.”


于是古应春首先告辞，却悄悄拉了胡雪岩一把。
Gu was the first to take leave, quietly giving Hu a tug.

知道是有话说。胡雪岩便跟着古应春下楼出门，
Understanding that he wished to speak, Hu followed him downstairs and outside.

站定了脚笑道：“你可是要跟我打听一个人？”
Stopping, he asked with a smile, “Do you want to inquire about someone?”

“咦！”
“Why!”

古应春诧异：
Gu was surprised.

“你怎么知道？”
“How did you know?”

“你别管！
“Never mind that.

说吧，可是要问七姑奶奶？”
Tell me—is it the Seventh Lady?”

“是的。”
“Yes.

古应春说，“我听老二告诉我，她似乎居孀多年。
The Second Miss told me she has apparently been widowed for many years.

可有这话？”
Is that true?”

“有的。不过也不算多年。”
“Yes, though it hasn't been so many years.”

“倒守得住？”
“And she's managed to remain a chaste widow?”

这是指七姑奶奶守节为何守不住，
He meant her fidelity to her late husband. Why should she not have managed it?

胡雪岩觉得他的话问得好笑，而且难以回答，
Hu found the question amusing and difficult to answer.

只好半开玩笑地答道：“你何不自己去问她？”
Half joking, he replied, “Why don't you ask her yourself?”


古应春也发觉自己失言，只好报以苦笑。
Gu realised that he had said the wrong thing and could only offer a rueful smile.

就这时候看到尤五兄妹和怡情老二，已经走下楼来，
Just then, he saw You, the Seventh Lady, and the Second Miss coming downstairs.

古应春心想，明天胡雪岩就要走了，此一去又有多日暌隔，而自己有一番心事非要跟他商量不可，
Hu was leaving tomorrow and would be away for many days, yet Gu had something on his mind that he must discuss with him.

因而便向尤五说道：“五哥，你们先请。
“Brother Five, please go ahead,” he said.

我跟胡雪岩还有些事要商量。”
“Hu Xueyan and I have something to talk over.”

尤五还不曾开口，怡情老二便说：“何不请到我那里去谈？”
Before You could answer, the Second Miss said, “Why not come and talk at my place?”

这就是胡雪岩机警了，不等古应春开口，他先就搭话：
Hu was quick enough to intervene before Gu spoke.

“实在是我有点私事托应春兄，
“Actually, I have a little private business to ask Brother Yingchun about.

就在这里谈一谈好了，
We'll discuss it here.

你们先请过去，
Please go ahead.

我们马上就到。”
We'll join you shortly.”

“那么，快点来。”
“Then don't be long.

怡情老二说：“等你们来吃消夜。
We'll wait for you to have supper.”

等他们走远了，胡雪岩便问：“应春兄，是在这里谈，还是找个地方坐坐呢？
Once they were out of earshot, Hu asked, “Shall we talk here, Brother Yingchun, or find somewhere to sit?

我看你要谈的事，不是三言两语所能变得清楚的。”
I suspect this isn't something that can be settled in a few words.”

“你大概也猜到了。”
“You've probably guessed.

古应春说，“七姑奶奶的相貌、风度，很对我的劲。
The Seventh Lady's looks and manner suit me very well.

我托你做个媒。“
I'd like you to act as matchmaker.”


胡雪岩想不到他这么开门见山，就说了出来，
Hu had not expected him to come straight to the point.

一时倒有些无从答复，愣在那里，半晌无声。
For a while he could find no answer and stood silent.

“怎么样？”古应春很关切的问，
“Well?” Gu asked anxiously.

“是不是有难处？”
“Is there some difficulty?”

“有没有难处，还不知道。”
“I don't know yet whether there is.

胡雪岩说，“你总先把你的情形跟我说一说。”
First, tell me about your own circumstances.”

“对，对！
“Of course.

这是我的疏忽……”
How thoughtless of me.”

古应春说了他的家庭，
Gu described his family.

父母都在广东，
Both parents were in Guangdong.

也娶过亲，只是妻子已经过世，
He had married, but his wife was dead.

有个女儿，今年十六岁，随祖父母在乡，
His daughter, now sixteen, lived with her grandparents in their home district.

如此而已。
That was all.

“那倒好，没有什么罗嗦。”胡雪岩说：
“Then there should be little complication,” Hu said.

“七姑奶奶就因为跟她婆太太合不来，才回的娘家，
“The Seventh Lady returned to her own family because she couldn't get on with her mother-in-law.

照你府上这情形，如果不回广东，大概她也愿意。”
Given your circumstances, I imagine she might agree, provided she didn't have to return to Guangdong.”

“那……”
“But...”

古应春反倒迟疑了，
Now Gu hesitated.

“不回广东是办不到的。
“Never going back to Guangdong would be impossible.

无论如何要回去见一见家父、家母。”
Whatever happens, we must visit my father and mother.”

“那自然。
“Naturally.

我是说不回广东乡下去住，
I meant not settling in the countryside there.

你们夫妇在上海自立门户。
You and your wife would establish your own household in Shanghai.

这都是以后的事……”
Those are matters for later.”

胡雪岩沉吟着说：
Hu considered.

“看样子，七姑奶奶对你，倒也还中意。
“The Seventh Lady seems to like you too.

不过，我有句话，一定要说在前面。
But there's something I must say beforehand.”

““是，是。你说！
“Please do.

我总尽力照办。”
I'll do my best to comply.”

“不是要你什么‘照办’！是要你忍耐。
“It's patience you need, not compliance.

你晓不晓得七姑奶奶有个外号，叫做‘女张飞’！”
Do you know that the Seventh Lady has a nickname—the female Zhang Fei?”

“是不是说她脾气暴躁？”
“Do you mean she has a violent temper?”

古应春摇摇头，
Gu shook his head.

“我看倒不象‘女张飞’！”
“She doesn't seem like a female Zhang Fei to me.”


这一半是“情人眼里出西施”，一半也是七姑奶奶特意收敛，
Partly, beauty lay in the lover's eyes; partly, the Seventh Lady had deliberately restrained herself.

看样子好事可谐，但情愿还是先把话说得深些，劝他慎重的好。
A happy outcome seemed possible, but Hu preferred to speak frankly and urge caution.

“应春兄，”他说，“日子太浅，相知不深，
“Brother Yingchun, you've known each other too briefly.

好在以后见面的时候有得是，
There will be plenty of opportunities to meet.

你何不看一看再说？”
Why not observe her for a while before deciding?”

听语气是七姑奶奶有着不便说破的缺点，
His tone suggested some fault that could not conveniently be stated.

自己去看，当然最好。
Seeing for himself would of course be best.

但古应春鳏居十年，一下子动了心，有如古井重波，
But after ten years as a widower, he had suddenly been moved, like a long-still well stirred into waves.

心澜难平，急于要问个明白，
His heart would not settle, and he urgently wanted to understand.

所以接下来又说：“看归看，听归听！
“I shall observe her, but I should like to hear about her too.

你多告诉我些。”
Tell me more.”

胡雪岩不知该告诉他些什么？
Hu did not know what to tell him.

七姑奶奶的情形，他耳闻目见的很多，但不能一昧说好话，更不能一味说坏话。
He had seen and heard a good deal about the Seventh Lady, yet he could neither praise her without reserve nor speak only of her faults.

如果是寻常女子，品貌过得去，他一定尽说好话，促成美事，因为那可以断定，决不会成为怨偶。
Had she been an ordinary woman of acceptable looks and character, he would certainly have praised her to bring about a happy match, confident that the pair would not become enemies.

而七姑奶奶与众不同，
But the Seventh Lady was different.

做媒的责任甚重，真仿佛一言可兴邦，也可丧邦，
A matchmaker's responsibility was heavy: one word seemed capable of either bringing prosperity to a kingdom or destroying it.

谁能受得了她的脾气，她便一定是个贤内助，
To a man who could bear her temper, she would be an excellent helpmate.

否则，感情会搞得极坏，媒人挨骂一辈子，
Otherwise, the marriage would turn bitter, and the matchmaker would be cursed for life.

于心何安？
How could he be easy in his conscience?


“说实话，你们都是一见钟情，
“Honestly, you were both taken with each other at first sight.

瞒不过我，
You couldn't conceal it from me.

我也用不着你说，就已经想来做这个媒。
Before you said anything, I was already thinking of arranging the match.

应春兄，胡雪岩非常恳切的说，”你知道我的，我做事一向性子急，
Brother Yingchun,” Hu said with great earnestness, “you know how impatient I usually am to get things done.

但这件事，实在急不得！
But this is something that really cannot be hurried.

为啥呢？
Why?

七姑奶奶的好处，是别人没有的，她的叫人啼笑皆非的脾气，也是别人没有的，
Because the Seventh Lady has good qualities nobody else possesses, and a temperament, unlike anyone else's, that can leave you unsure whether to laugh or cry.

所以你要我说，我实在说不象。
If you ask me to describe her, I simply can't do her justice.

要你自己看，
You must see for yourself.

反正我总一定帮你的忙，做你的参赞。
I shall certainly help and advise you.

再透个信息给你，七姑奶奶的愿守不愿守，
And here's something else: whether she remains a widow is entirely her own decision.

她兄嫂都做不得她的主。
Neither her brother nor his wife can decide for her.

现在她似乎也看中你了，那你就请放心，
Now she seems to have taken a fancy to you, so you may rest assured.

好事迟早必成。
Sooner or later, the match is bound to succeed.”

“这番话对古应春是颗定心丸，而且启发甚多，
These words reassured Gu and gave him much to consider.

大致七姑奶奶是个巾帼须眉，个性极强，遇事敢当。
Evidently, the Seventh Lady had the spirit of a man, a powerful will, and the courage to take responsibility.

这样性格刚强的人，要看自己能不能驾驭得住她？
With such a strong character, the question was whether he could manage her.

驾驭得住，百炼钢化为绕指柔，闺房中仍有画盾之乐，
If he could, tempered steel might become soft enough to wind about his finger, and married life would still offer its tender pleasures, such as painting her brows.

驾驭不住，一辈子是她系在裤腰带上的裙下之囚。
If he could not, he would be her prisoner for life, tied to her apron strings.

“多谢，多谢！
“Thank you, thank you.

就你这几句话，我已受惠非浅。
Those few words have helped me greatly.

走吧！”
Let's go.”


两个人一起回到怡情院，只见七姑奶奶跟怡情老二，并坐在床边，喁喁细语，亲热得象姐妹。
They returned to Yiqing House and found the Seventh Lady and the Second Miss sitting together on the edge of the bed, talking confidentially, as intimate as sisters.

尤五显然对此感到欣慰，含笑坐在一旁，神态显得很恬静。
You was plainly gratified and sat smiling beside them, looking very peaceful.

“来了，来了！”
“Here they are!”

他站起来，兴致勃勃地：
He rose with enthusiasm.

“有人送了我一篓蟹，
“Someone sent me a basket of crabs.

刚才忘了拿到那里去吃了，
I forgot to take them over for our meal.

尝一尝！”
Come and try them.”

于是怡情老二急忙站起来招呼，
The Second Miss immediately rose to make arrangements.

七姑奶奶自己也要下手帮忙，做主人的一定不准她动手，
The Seventh Lady wanted to help, but her hostess firmly refused.

这是堂子里，七姑奶奶是客，
This was a courtesan house, and the Seventh Lady was a guest.

下手帮忙变得也成了主人，那不象话，
Helping would make her seem another hostess, which would be quite improper.

但她想不到此，最后是胡雪岩递了个眼色，她才会过意来。
This did not occur to her until Hu gave her a meaningful glance.

这使得古应春又得了个极深的印象，
Gu took a strong impression from the incident.

他觉得她只是凡事热心。所以显得有些鲁莽。
He felt that she was simply eager to help in everything and therefore seemed somewhat rash.

好在她也肯听人教导，
Fortunately, she was willing to listen to advice.

绝不是那种蛮不讲理，死不认错的泼妇。
She was certainly not one of those unreasonable shrews who would never admit a fault.

这就没有可怕了。
So, he concluded, there was nothing to fear.


摆好桌子，娘姨端出两大盘热气腾腾，加紫苏蒸的阳澄湖大蟹，
Once the table was ready, a female attendant brought two large plates of steaming Yangcheng Lake crabs, cooked with perilla.

此是文人墨客笔下的天下第一名物，阳澄湖的尤其出名。
Crabs were celebrated by men of letters as the finest delicacy under heaven, and those from Yangcheng Lake were especially renowned.

特征是“金毛紫背”，
Their distinguishing features were golden hairs and purplish backs.

通常每只八两，两只一斤，所以称为“对蟹”。
They generally weighed eight liang apiece, so that two made a jin; hence the name “pair crabs.”

七姑奶奶嗜蟹如命，但这时却很斯文，先挑了一只团脐送到尤五面前。
The Seventh Lady adored them, but now behaved with great refinement, first choosing a female crab and placing it before her brother.

“先敬客嘛！”
“Guests first!”

尤五完全是做哥哥教导弟妹的派头。
You spoke like an elder brother instructing his younger siblings.

客是两位，论客气应该是古应春，
There were two guests; courtesy plainly required her to offer it to Gu.

七姑奶奶不知不觉地又有些着急，便拿那只蟹送到胡雪岩面前。
Growing flustered despite herself, she put the crab before Hu instead.

“七姐，我们自己人。
“Seventh Sister, we're old friends.

我自己来！”
I'll help myself.”

胡雪岩有些促狭，不但话里挤对她非把那只蟹送给古应春不可，而且还用手往外推谢。
Mischievously, Hu not only used his words to press her into giving it to Gu, but pushed it away with his hand.

“那就你来！”
“Then you take it!”

七姑奶奶被逼到差不多的地步。“冲劲”就来了，大大方方地对古应春说，并且还把一小碗姜醋推到他面前。
Driven far enough, she recovered her boldness and addressed Gu openly, also placing a little bowl of ginger vinegar before him.

“谢谢！”古应春含着笑说，同时深深看了她一眼。
“Thank you,” Gu said with a smile, giving her a long look.

七姑奶奶装作不见，只拿一只蟹在手，
Pretending not to notice, she picked up another crab.

看胡雪岩已经自己动手，“便拿向她哥哥面前，然后自己也取一只，同时转眼去看怡情老二。
Seeing that Hu had already helped himself, she gave it to her brother, took one for herself, and glanced towards their hostess.


怡情老二正取了一副吃蟹的家伙出来，纯银打造，小钳小锤子的，看来十分精巧。
The Second Miss was bringing out a set of crab-eating implements: tiny pincers and hammers made entirely of silver, exquisitely fashioned.

七姑奶奶觉得好玩，取过小锤子来，一下打在蟹螯上。
Amused by them, the Seventh Lady took a little hammer and struck a claw.

在她自觉未曾用力，但那只蟹赘已被砸得甲碎肉烂，一塌糊涂了。
She felt that she had hardly used any force, yet the shell shattered and the flesh was mashed into a hopeless mess.

大家都笑，七姑奶奶也笑，
Everyone laughed, and she joined them.

“这东西不是我用的。”
“These things aren't meant for me.

她说，“还是用手方便。”
My hands are easier.”

她的那只手仿佛生来就是为剥蟹用的，
Her hands seemed made for shelling crabs.

手法熟练非凡，只用一根牙筷帮忙，须臾之间，把一只蟹吃得干干净净，
With astonishing skill and only one ivory chopstick to help her, she emptied a crab in moments.

蟹赘、蟹脚和那个“盖”拼凑在一起，看来仍旧是一只蟹。
Claws, legs, and upper shell could be fitted back together so that it still looked whole.

“这倒着实要点本事。”古应春颇为惊异，
“That certainly takes skill,” Gu said in surprise.

“我还是第一次见！”
“I've never seen it before.”

广东人的古应春，吃蟹自然没有苏锡嘉湖一带出蟹地方的人来得内行，
Coming from Guangdong, he naturally knew less about eating crabs than people from the crab-producing districts of Suzhou, Wuxi, Jiaxing, and Huzhou.

表里不分，胡嚼一气，吐了一桌子的渣滓，
He failed to distinguish shell from flesh, chewed indiscriminately, and spat debris all over the table.

七姑奶奶直性子，实在看不过去，
The forthright Seventh Lady could not bear to watch.

便打趣他说：“你真是猪八戒吃人参果。
“You're just like Zhu Bajie swallowing the ginseng fruit without tasting it.

看我来！”
Watch me!”

她取了一只蟹，依然只用一根筷子，很快地剥了一盖子的蟹肉，黄白杂陈，
Taking another crab and again using only one chopstick, she quickly filled its shell with white flesh and yellow roe.

倒上姜醋，却不是自己享用，一推推到了古应春面前。
She added ginger vinegar, then pushed the filled shell towards Gu instead of eating it herself.

这真叫古应春受宠若惊了，但也知不宜显示心中的感觉，
He was overwhelmed by her kindness, but knew better than to display his feelings.

所以只是接连说了两声：“多谢，多谢！”
He merely said, “Thank you, thank you.”


巧得很，怡情老二正好也用小钳小锤子，敲敲打打，外带嘴咬手剥，也弄了一盖子蟹肉，送给尤五。
As it happened, the Second Miss had also been working with pincers and hammer, helped by her teeth and fingers, and had filled a shell with crabmeat for You.

于是胡雪岩笑道：
Hu laughed.

“你们都有人代劳，
“You both have someone to do the work for you.

只有我没有这份福气！
I'm the only one without such good fortune.”

“古应春知道他在打趣七姑奶奶，
Gu knew he was teasing the Seventh Lady.

怕她脸上下不来，有意要把“美人之贻”这回事，看作无所谓，
Afraid she would be embarrassed, he tried to treat this gift from a beauty as nothing exceptional.

便将那蟹盖推过去说：“你来，你来！”
Pushing the shell towards Hu, he said, “Here, you have it.”

“你舍得？”
“Could you bear to part with it?”

胡雪岩抓住题目，越发要开玩笑。
Hu seized the opening for more mischief.

这话很难回答，
It was a difficult question.

要说“舍得”，马上就会惹七姑奶奶在心里骂一句：没良心！
If Gu said yes, the Seventh Lady might immediately think him ungrateful.

想了想这样答道：“在别人，自然舍不得，
After a moment, he answered, “Not for anyone else, naturally.

你老兄又当别论。”
But you are another matter.”

“承情之至。
“I'm deeply obliged.

不过，只怕你舍得，人家舍不得。”
Only, you may be willing to part with it when someone else is not.

胡雪岩说，“人家辛辛苦苦剥了给你吃的，让我吃掉了，一定会心痛！”
After all her hard work shelling it for you, she would surely be heartbroken if I ate it.”

话还不曾完，七姑奶奶发急了，
Before he finished, the Seventh Lady protested.

“小爷叔！”
“Young Uncle!”

她用笑容掩饰窘态，
She hid her embarrassment behind a smile.

“罚酒！
“You must drink a forfeit.

你的话真正说得气人。”
Your words are really exasperating.”

“是啊！”怡情老二在一旁帮腔，平她的气：
“Quite right!” the Second Miss supported her, trying to soothe her feelings.

“胡老爷话里有骨头，
“Mr Hu's words have sharp edges.

应该罚酒。”
He must drink.”

“好，好！”
“Very well, very well!”

胡雪岩原是为古应春试探，
Hu had been testing the Seventh Lady's feelings on Gu's behalf.

看七姑奶奶虽然羞窘，并无温色，觉得试探的结果，大可满意，
Seeing her embarrassed but not offended, he was thoroughly satisfied.

便欣然引杯，一饮而尽。
He gladly raised his cup and emptied it.


一直坐在那里不说话的尤五，到这时才恍然大悟，
Only now did You, who had been silent all this time, understand.

他是做哥哥的想法，觉得七姑奶奶不些放浪形骸，心里便不大舒服。
Thinking as an elder brother, he felt that the Seventh Lady was behaving too freely and became uncomfortable.

胡雪岩鉴貌辨色，看出风向不对，很知趣地把话题引了开去，
Reading his expression, Hu saw the change in the air and tactfully turned the conversation elsewhere.

同时也不肯再多作流连，
Nor did he wish to linger.

找个机会，提议散席。
At a suitable moment, he suggested ending the gathering.

时近午夜，而怡情院所在地的那条弄堂，却还热闹得很，
It was nearly midnight, but the lane outside Yiqing House was still lively.

卖熟食的小贩，往来如梭，吆喝不停，
Food hawkers passed continually, calling their wares.

弄口停着许多小轿，流苏轿帘，玻璃小窗，十分精致，
At the entrance stood numerous little sedan chairs, finely made, with tasselled curtains and small glass windows.

专做深宵寻芳倦客的生意，
They catered especially to weary late-night seekers of pleasure.

唯有这天抬着一位堂客——七姑奶奶。
On this occasion alone, one carried a lady—the Seventh Lady.

回到裕记丝栈，她第一个下轿，往后直奔，
Back at the Yuji Silk Warehouse, she was first out of her chair and hurried towards the rear.

刚上楼梯，便扯开喉咙大喊：“张家妹子，你睡了没有？”
Scarcely on the stairs, she called at the top of her voice, “Sister Zhang, are you asleep?”

阿珠还没有睡，
A’zhu was still awake.

先是不放心七姑奶奶，要为她等门，
At first she had stayed up to let the Seventh Lady in, worried about her.

后来是跟陈世龙吃零食闲谈，谈上了劲，倒把要等的人忘掉了。
Later, chatting and eating snacks with Chen, she had become so absorbed that she forgot whom she was waiting for.

这时听得楼下一喊，方始惊觉，赶紧起身迎了出去。
The call from below startled her, and she hurried out.

两人在楼涕口相遇，
They met at the head of the stairs.

只见七姑奶奶双颊如霞，眼波如水，一片春色，不觉大声而问：“你在哪里吃得这么醉醺醺地回来？”
Seeing the Seventh Lady's rosy cheeks, sparkling eyes, and exuberant glow, A’zhu exclaimed, “Where have you been drinking to come back so tipsy?”


“你看，我带了什么好东西来给你吃！”
“Look what I've brought you!”

七姑奶奶把一只细竹篮递了过去。
The Seventh Lady handed her a finely woven bamboo basket.

这时胡雪岩和尤五亦已上楼，
Hu and You had now come upstairs too.

加上阿龙和闻声起床的老张，挤得满满的一屋子，却只听得七姑奶奶一个人的声音，大讲在怡情院消磨了这一晚上的经过。
With Chen and Old Zhang, who had risen at the noise, the room was crowded, yet only the Seventh Lady's voice could be heard, recounting how she had spent the evening at Yiqing House.

在老张父女是闻所未闻的奇事，
To Old Zhang and his daughter, it was an unheard-of adventure.

就连陈世尤也觉得这位七姑奶奶胆大得惊人。
Even Chen marvelled at her audacity.

“你们吃嘛！”
“Have some!”

最后她揭开了篮盖，里面是六只阳澄湖大蟹。
At last she lifted the basket lid, revealing six large Yangcheng Lake crabs.

她粗中有细，特别周到，连姜醋都是现成带着的。
Beneath her rough manner, she was remarkably thoughtful: even the ginger vinegar was ready to hand.

一则情不可却，再则那蟹也实在诱人，
Her kindness could not be refused, and the crabs themselves were tempting.

老张父女和陈世龙，便一面剥蟹，一面听七姑奶奶谈怡情院的风光。
Old Zhang, A’zhu, and Chen began shelling them as they listened to her description of life at Yiqing House.

尤五却向胡雪岩使个眼色，两人避到里面谈心去了。
You, meanwhile, signalled to Hu, and the two withdrew into the inner room for a private conversation.


“小爷叔，”尤五皱着眉头说：“你看我这个妹子越来越不象样，
“Young Uncle,” You said with a frown, “my sister's behaviour grows more improper every day.

怎么得了？”
What are we to do?”

“不要这么说！”胡雪岩笑嘻嘻地答道，
“Don't say that!” Hu replied cheerfully.

“五哥，我要讨喜酒吃了。
“Brother Five, I shall be asking for wedding wine soon.

你晓得老古跟我怎么说？
Do you know what Gu said to me?

他要托我做媒！”
He wants me to arrange a marriage.”

尤五大为诧异，
You was astonished.

愣了好一会才问：“是想娶我们阿七。”
After a long silence, he asked, “He wants to marry our A’qi?”

“对！
“Exactly.

这才叫一见倾心。
Love at first sight!

姻缘，姻缘，真正是缘分。”
Marriage really is a matter of destiny.”

“什么缘分？”
“What destiny?”

尤五的双眉皱得更深，
You frowned still more deeply.

“说起来是在堂子里见过面，那有多难听！”
“Think how it would sound: they met in a courtesan house!”

这个回答大出胡雪岩的意料，
This response surprised Hu.

一时不知如何为他和七姑奶奶譬解？愣在那里，好半晌作声不得。
He could not immediately think how to defend Gu and the Seventh Lady, and stood speechless for some time.

“我倒不懂了，老古怎么会知道阿七此刻住在娘家？”尤五又问，
“There's something I don't understand,” You continued. “How did Gu know that A’qi is living with her own family now?

“他当阿七还是大小姐？”
Does he think she's still an unmarried young lady?”

“不”他晓得七姐居孀。
“No. He knows she's a widow.

是老二告诉他的，不对！是他跟老二打听的。
The Second Miss told him—no, he asked her.”

“接着，胡雪岩便把古应春家里的情形说了一遍。
Hu then described Gu's family circumstances.


“那么，小爷叔，你怎么回答他的呢？”
“Well, Young Uncle, what did you tell him?”

“我说，要他自己看。
“I told him to see for himself.

我看……他们有缘，
I think they are destined for each other.

这杯喜酒吃得成功的。”
We should be able to drink that wedding wine.”

尤五不以为然，大摇其头：
You shook his head emphatically.

“算了，
“Let it be.

我看不要害人！”
We shouldn't ruin a man's life.”

“你倒也不必把我们这位姑奶奶贬得太厉害！”
“There's no need to put our lady down so harshly!”

胡雪岩以不平的语气说：
Hu spoke with indignation.

“象她这样的人才，嫁给老古，照我看还是委屈的。
“With her looks and abilities, I think even marrying Gu would scarcely do her justice.

至于说她脾气不好，这话要说回来，
As for her temper, that cuts both ways.

女人家心思最怪不过，只要她自己愿意，自然会改。
A woman's mind is a strange thing: if she herself wishes to, she will naturally change.

看今天的样子，斯斯文文，大大方方，
Look at her today—refined and perfectly at ease.

可见已经在改了！”
Clearly, she's changing already.”

话虽说得动听，却无结论，
Persuasive though the words were, they led to no conclusion.

事实上婚姻大事，一时也不可能有什么结论，
A marriage could hardly be settled immediately in any case.

只有摆着再说，先料理第二天动身的事。
They must leave it for later and first arrange the following day's departure.


下船是在中午，胡雪岩“师弟”，老张父女，加上七姑奶奶一共五个人，
They went aboard at noon: Hu and his pupil, Old Zhang and his daughter, and the Seventh Lady—five in all.

除去老张，各自只可促膝密谈，未便公然表露的心事，
Apart from Old Zhang, each had private concerns that could be discussed only in close confidence, never openly.

加以路上不太平，风吹草动，需要随时当心，
Moreover, the route was unsettled, and every disturbance required vigilance.

所以就连七姑奶奶这样爱说话的人，也是保持沉默的时候居多。
Even the talkative Seventh Lady remained silent much of the time.

第二天快到松江了，胡雪岩该当作个决定，要不要七姑奶奶送到嘉兴？
As they approached Songjiang the following day, Hu had to decide whether she should escort them as far as Jiaxing.

如果认为不需要，把她留在松江，扬帆而走，至多停泊半日，将他自己和阿珠寄在尤家的行李搬上船，
If unnecessary, they could leave her in Songjiang and sail on after stopping no more than half a day to collect the luggage he and A’zhu had left with the You family.

否则，至少得在松江停一天，让七姑奶奶先打听消息，或者带个把可供奔走的人同行。
Otherwise, they must stay at least a day while she gathered news and perhaps brought along someone to run errands.

“小爷叔！”
“Young Uncle!”

等胡雪岩刚一提及，七姑奶奶便抢着说，
As soon as he raised the matter, she interrupted.

“不管我送不送你，无论如何在我们那里住一天再走。”
“Whether I escort you or not, you must stay a day at our house before leaving.”

“杭州等得很急……”
“They're waiting urgently in Hangzhou...”

“急也不急在一天，
“One day won't make all the difference.

我五嫂有话跟你说。”
Fifth Sister-in-Law has something to say to you.”

这倒奇了，
That was strange.

尤五嫂会有什么话？
What could Mrs You want to say?

就有话要说，七姑奶奶怎么会知道？
And if she did have something to say, how could the Seventh Lady know?

凡是遇到艰难，胡雪岩总要先通前彻后想一遍，等自己想不通时再发问。
Whenever faced with a difficulty, Hu tried to reason it through from beginning to end before asking questions.


他的脑筋特别快，
His mind worked exceptionally quickly.

察言辨包，觉得只有一个可能，
Watching her expression, he could see only one possibility.

“七姐，”他问，“是不是你自己有话不便说，要请五嫂来问我？”
“Seventh Sister, is there something you find awkward to say yourself and want Fifth Sister-in-Law to ask me?”

七姑奶奶笑了，带些顽皮，也有些忸怩，
She smiled, partly mischievous and partly shy.

“小爷叔，”她说：“你顶聪明。”
“Young Uncle, you are very clever.”

“既然如此，你何不直接告诉我？”
“Then why not tell me directly?”

“还是等五嫂自己来问你的好。”
“It would still be better to let her ask you herself.”

这话倒象是关于尤五夫妇的事，
That sounded as though it concerned You and his wife.

胡雪岩有些困惑，细想一想，
Puzzled, Hu considered it further.

莫非是有关怡情老二的话？
Could it be about the Second Miss?

也许七姑奶奶多事，要到她嫂子那里去“告密”，所以尤五嫂会有些话要问。
Perhaps the Seventh Lady meant to meddle and report her brother's activities, giving Mrs You questions to ask.

或者七姑奶奶倒是好心，
Or perhaps she intended kindness.

与怡情老二投缘，在她嫂子面前下说词，劝她为夫纳妾，
Having taken to the Second Miss, she might persuade her sister-in-law to let her husband take the courtesan as a concubine.

这样尤五嫂就更会有些话要问。
In that case, Mrs You would have even more to ask.

同样是问，有的话可说，有的话不可说。
Questions might be alike in form, yet some could be answered freely and others could not.

到底是怎样的一问？
What sort of inquiry awaited him?

先得把方向弄清楚，临事才不致窘迫。
He must establish its direction beforehand, or risk being caught at a disadvantage.

于是他问：“七姐，你晓不晓得五嫂要问我的话，是好事还是啥？”
“Seventh Sister, do you know whether what she wants to ask concerns something good?”

“自然是好事。”
“Naturally.”


这下胡雪岩放心了。
Hu was reassured.

船抵松江，上岸直到尤家，歇一歇脚。
At Songjiang they went ashore and directly to the You house for a rest.

他趁空去拜访了“老太爷”，在他那里吃了饭。
Taking the opportunity, Hu paid a visit to the old master and dined with him.

再到尤家，谈不到三五句话，尤五嫂起身说道：
Back at the house, he had scarcely exchanged a few words when Mrs You rose.

“小爷叔，我有件事拜托你。”
“Young Uncle, I have a favour to ask.”

是拜托胡雪岩做媒，
She wanted him to act as matchmaker.

却不是为尤五娶怡情老二进门，是替七姑奶奶促成良缘。
It was not, however, to bring the Second Miss into You's household, but to secure a happy marriage for the Seventh Lady.

尤五嫂告诉他说，当他在裕记丝浅跟尤五密谈古应春时，七姑奶奶在外屋趁老张父女和陈世龙吃蟹吃得起劲时，悄悄在“听壁脚”，
Mrs You explained that, while Hu and You had been discussing Gu privately at the Yuji Silk Warehouse, the Seventh Lady had taken advantage of the others' absorption in their crabs to listen at the wall.

古应春的意思她已经知道了，表示非古应春不嫁。
She knew Gu's intentions and had declared that she would marry nobody else.

因为听出尤五似乎不赞成这头亲事，所以特为来跟嫂子谈。
Having heard that her brother seemed opposed, she had come especially to discuss it with his wife.

听完经过，胡雪岩失笑了。
Hu laughed at himself.

笑自己误解了七姑奶奶的语气，上了自己的当，
He had misread the Seventh Lady's tone and fallen victim to his own cleverness.

如果是跟人做一笔出入甚巨的生意，也是这样子胡思乱猜，自以为是，那就非大蚀其本不可。
If he approached a major business transaction with such wild guesses and self-assurance, he would surely lose heavily.


“小爷叔，”尤五嫂问道，“阿七怎么会认识那姓古的，
“Young Uncle,” Mrs You asked, “how did A’qi come to know this Mr Gu?

好象是第一次见面，
It seems they had only just met.

在哪里？”
Where was it?”

这一问就不易回答了，尤其是对她。
That was not easy to answer, especially to her.

诚然如尤五所说的，在堂子里见的面，这话提起来难听。
As You had said, meeting in a courtesan house sounded disgraceful.

再问下去：她怎么跑到了那种地方去？那又要牵涉到怡情老二，
Her next question would be why the Seventh Lady had gone there, which would bring in the Second Miss.

尤五这样的人，在花街柳巷走走，尤五嫂自然不会干涉，
Mrs You would naturally not interfere with a man like her husband occasionally visiting the pleasure quarters.

但如说是怡情老二的恩客，在外面置了“小房子”，就难保尤五嫂会不吃醋。
But knowing that he was the Second Miss's favoured patron and maintained a separate little house might well make her jealous.

于是他说：“在裕记丝栈。
Hu therefore said, “At the Yuji Silk Warehouse.

老古现在跟五哥，跟我，三个人合伙。
Gu, Brother Five, and I are now partners.

这头亲事说起来倒也是顺理成章的事，
The marriage would be quite natural.

郎有意姐有情，
He is willing and so is she.

哪还有啥话说？
What more is there to say?

至于做媒的话，不但义不容辞，而且是所谓非我莫属。
As for arranging it, I am not only bound to help; you might say nobody else is so well placed.

不过，五嫂，我们有这样一个想法，
But, Fifth Sister-in-Law, we have an idea.

说出来你看，对不对！”
Let me put it to you and see what you think.”

“你的话没有错的，小爷叔，
“Your judgement is sound, Young Uncle.

你说。”
Tell me.”


“我们杭州说媒人‘吃十三只半鸡’，
“In Hangzhou, we say a matchmaker eats thirteen and a half chickens.

意思是说要媒人一遍遍传话，事情极慢。
It means the messages must be carried back and forth over and over, so everything takes time.

别的亲事嫌慢，这头亲事嫌快，
Other marriages seem too slow to arrange; this one is moving too fast.

我看还是慢一点的好。”
I think it would be better to proceed more slowly.”

“我懂小爷叔的意思，
“I understand.

是怕太快了，彼此都看不清楚，将来会懊悔？”
You're afraid that, if things move too quickly, neither will see the other clearly, and they may regret it later?”

“对了，就是这个意思。”
“Exactly.”

“意思是好的。
“Your intention is good.

不过，你晓得的，我们家这位姑奶奶是急性子。”
But you know how impatient our lady is.”

“这就要你劝她了。”
“Then you must persuade her.”

胡雪岩放低了声音说：
Hu lowered his voice.

“还有一层，
“There's something else.

听七姐的意思，好象有点跟五哥怄气，你不大赞成，我偏要嫁他。
From what Seventh Sister says, she seems a little determined to spite Brother Five: if he doesn't quite approve, she'll marry Gu all the more.

婚姻大事，怄气就不对了。”
Spite is no basis for such an important decision.”

尤五嫂想了想。深深点头，
Mrs You considered, then nodded deeply.

“小爷叔，你的话不错的。
“You're right, Young Uncle.

我倒没有想到。”
That hadn't occurred to me.”


胡雪岩探头望了一下，弄清楚七姑奶奶没有在“听壁脚”，才向尤五嫂说：
Hu craned his neck to make sure the Seventh Lady was not listening at the wall before continuing.

“她性急，你不能依她，
“She's impatient, but you mustn't give in.

事情拖它一拖，等五哥回来大家好好商量。
Let matters wait until Brother Five returns and you can all discuss them properly.

你就这样说好了，做媒要按规矩行事，你要先相一相亲。
Say that arranging a marriage must follow the rules, and that you first want to meet the prospective groom yourself.

这一来就半个月拖过去了。”
That should take up half a month.”

“我懂，我懂！
“I understand.

我会想办法来拖。
I'll find a way to delay things.

不过，我再问小爷叔一句话：
But let me ask one more question.

那姓古的，人到底怎么样？”
What sort of man is this Mr Gu, really?”

“你最好自己去看。”
“You had better see for yourself.”

胡雪岩这样回答，不象一个媒人的口吻，
That was hardly a matchmaker's answer.

其实他确是有了梅意。
In fact, Hu was beginning to regret his involvement.

七姑奶奶的性子太急，而且在怄气，尤五又有意见，
The Seventh Lady was too impatient and was acting partly out of defiance, while You had objections.

隐隐然使他感觉到，这件事将来会有纠纷。
Hu vaguely foresaw complications.

一片热心顿时冷了下来。
His enthusiasm suddenly cooled.

就因为如此，他要躲着七姑奶奶，所以坚辞她送到嘉兴的好意。
For that reason, he wanted to avoid the Seventh Lady and firmly declined her kind offer to escort him to Jiaxing.

第二天上船沿运河下驶，
The next day he boarded the boat and continued down the canal.

总算一路顺利，
Fortunately, the journey went smoothly.

风平浪静地进入浙江省境，从此到杭州，就不会再有什么危险了。
They entered Zhejiang without incident, and from there to Hangzhou there would be no further danger.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十五章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Fifteen, first part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第十五章｜CHAPTER FIFTEEN


放下一颗悬着的心，胡雪岩又把全副精神放在正事上。
With his anxiety relieved, Hu Xueyan once more devoted all his attention to business.

船上无事正好算帐，
There was little to do aboard the boat, so it was a good opportunity to go over his accounts.

结出总帐一看自己都有些不相信了。
When he worked out the total, he could scarcely believe it himself.

不过短短半年工夫，自己经手的款项，已有五十万两银子之多，
In barely half a year, as much as five hundred thousand taels had passed through his hands.

杭州、湖州、上海三处做生意，局面搞得确是很热闹，事情也十分顺手。
With business in Hangzhou, Huzhou, and Shanghai, he had certainly built up a lively operation, and everything was going smoothly.

但万一出了意外，牵一发动全身，
Yet if anything unexpected happened, a tug at one thread could disturb the whole fabric.

自己倒下来不说，还要牵连许多人，第一个是王有龄，第二个是张胖子，第三个是郁四，第四个是尤五。
He would not fall alone: many others would be dragged down with him—first Wang Youling, then Fat Zhang, then Yu Si, and then You Laowu.

这样转上念头，便觉得河上秋风，吹到身上格外冷了。
At this thought, the autumn wind on the river felt especially cold.

推开算盘，独对孤灯，思前想后，生出无限警惕。
Pushing aside his abacus, he sat alone before the lamp and considered everything, growing deeply cautious.

他告诉自己，不要自恃脑筋快、手腕活，毫无顾忌地把场面拉开来，
He must not rely on his quick mind and flexible methods to expand without restraint.

一个人的精力到底有限，
One man's energy was limited.

有个顾不到，就会出漏洞，而漏洞会很快地越扯越大，等到发觉，往往已不可收拾。
Anything he overlooked could open a gap that would rapidly widen; by the time he discovered it, matters might already be beyond repair.


想到这里，自然而然生出两点觉悟，
Two conclusions followed naturally.

一是节省精力，不必去多管那些无谓的闹事，
First, he must conserve his energy and stop meddling in unnecessary disputes.

二是还要多寻帮手，
Second, he must find more help.

刘庆生算是找对了。已可独当一面，
Liu Qingsheng had been a good choice and could now take charge independently.

陈世龙是块好材料，却未曾善加利用。
Chen Shilong had promise, but Hu had not yet made proper use of him.

于是他决走，趁这到杭州的一段旅程，将生意场中的各种“门槛”，好好教他一教，教会了就把上海这方面的事务都交给他。
During the remaining journey to Hangzhou, he would teach Chen the tricks and practices of business, then put him in charge of the Shanghai affairs.

但是没有让他“学生意”以前，先要为他安排亲事，
Before teaching him the trade, however, he must arrange his marriage.

那也就是连带了清了他自己跟阿珠之间的关系，从此心无牵挂，也是节省精力之道。
That would also settle Hu's own relationship with A’zhu and remove another worry: a further way of conserving his energy.

于是盘算了好一会，想定了入手的办法。
After considering the matter for some time, he decided how to begin.


第二天一早开船，
The boat set off early the next morning.

除了老张在船梢上帮同把舵以外，其余的人都没有什么事。
Apart from Old Zhang, who was helping at the helm in the stern, everyone was at leisure.

他特意叫陈世龙进舱谈话，
Hu deliberately called Chen into the cabin for a talk.

从一上船，阿珠便常在后舱。就是一起吃饭的时候，也不大交谈。
Since boarding, A’zhu had spent most of her time in the after cabin, saying little even when they ate together.

当然，陈世龙是常到后舱去找她的。
Chen, of course, often went back to see her.

胡雪岩料定他跟陈世龙在中舱谈什么，她一定会在后舱，留心静听，
Hu felt certain that she would listen carefully from there to whatever the two men said in the middle cabin.

所以他预备装作“言者无意”，其实是有心要说给她听。
He therefore meant to appear to speak casually while addressing his words to her.

“世龙！”他说，“我现在的场面是撑起来了。
“Shilong, my business has taken shape now.

不过饭是一个人吃不完的，要大家一起来动手。
But one man can't eat all the rice himself: we must all lend a hand.

我现在问问你的意思，你是想在湖州，还是想在上海？”
Tell me, would you rather be in Huzhou or Shanghai?”

陈世龙不知道他胸有成竹，有意如此发问，只当真的要他自己挑一处，
Unaware that Hu had a settled plan and was asking deliberately, Chen thought he really was being offered a choice.

上海虽然繁华，做事却无把握，
Shanghai might be prosperous, but he was unsure of himself there.

在湖州是本乡本土，而且又厮守着阿珠，
Huzhou was home, and he could stay close to A’zhu.

自然是湖州好。
Naturally he preferred Huzhou.

“我想先在湖州，把丝行弄好了再说。”
“I'd like to get the silk firm properly established in Huzhou first.”

“我晓得你要挑湖州，”
“I knew you'd choose Huzhou.”

胡雪岩背对后舱，不怕阿珠看见他的脸，
With his back to the after cabin, Hu could make a face without A’zhu seeing.

所以向陈世龙使劲挤一挤眼睛，表示下面那句话别有用心，叫他留神：
He winked emphatically at Chen, warning him that the next words had a purpose.

“你是舍不得阿珠！”
“You can't bear to leave A’zhu!”

陈世龙也很聪明，做一个不好意思的笑容，表示默认。
Chen was quick to understand and gave an embarrassed smile of acknowledgment.

一个如此说，一个如此承认，除非阿珠自己走出来明明白白说一句，不愿嫁陈世龙！那么，他们三个人之间的关系，就在这一句话中交代清楚了。
With one man making the assertion and the other accepting it, the relationship among all three was settled in that single exchange—unless A’zhu herself came out and plainly declared that she would not marry Chen Shilong.


在后舱听壁脚的阿珠，十分气恼，
Listening from the after cabin, A’zhu was furious.

心想：简直把一个人看成一包丝一样，凭你们一句话，就算交易过手了！
They were treating a person like a bale of silk: a few words between them, and the transaction was complete!

世上哪有这样自说自话的事？
How could they take everything upon themselves like that?

想归想，气归气，人还是坐在那里不动，屏声息气，细听外面，
Yet, for all her angry thoughts, she remained where she was, scarcely breathing as she listened.

胡雪岩又在说了。
Hu was speaking again.

“我的意思，丝行有你丈人、丈母娘在那里。”
“My idea is that the silk firm has your father-in-law and mother-in-law there...”

听到这里，阿珠惊异不止，
At this, A’zhu was astonished.

“丈人、丈母娘”是指谁？她自己这样在问。
Whom did he mean by “father-in-law and mother-in-law”?

细听下去，明明白白，
Listening on, she could not mistake it.

陈世龙的丈人、丈母娘，不是自己父母是哪个？
Who could Chen's parents-in-law be but her own parents?

阿珠惊疑羞愤，外带一种说不出的兴奋，
Bewilderment, shame, and resentment mingled with an excitement she could not describe.

心里乱得如万马奔腾，自己克制了又克制，才能勉强听得清外面的话。
Her thoughts raced like ten thousand horses, and only by repeatedly mastering herself could she make out what was being said.

“说起来，阿珠的娘的想法也不大对！
“To tell the truth, A’zhu's mother hasn't quite the right idea.

她以为我帮了她家的忙，她就得把女儿许配给我，作为报答。
Because I helped the family, she thinks she ought to give me her daughter in marriage as repayment.

其实桥归桥，路归路，
But those are separate matters.

我帮他们的忙，又不是在想他们的女儿。”
I didn't help them because I wanted their daughter.”

哼！假正经！
Hypocrite!

阿珠不由得在心里骂，
A’zhu cursed inwardly.

同时想起胡雪岩当初许多勾引的行径，脸上有些发烧，暗暗的又骂了句：不要脸！
Remembering the many ways Hu had once tried to win her affection, she felt her face grow warm and silently added, Shameless!


再听下去，她比较舒服了。
What followed made her feel rather better.

“讲句良心话，”胡雪岩说，“我喜欢不喜欢阿珠呢？
“In all conscience,” Hu said, “do I like A’zhu?

当然喜欢的。
Of course I do.

不过，我不肯委屈阿珠。
But I won't put her at a disadvantage.

冰清玉洁，大家小姐不见得有她那样子的品貌！
Her character is spotless, and even a young lady of a great family might not equal her in looks and qualities.

世龙，她嫁了你也是委屈的。”
Shilong, even marrying you would be beneath her.”

“我晓得。”
“I know.”

陈世龙自惭的点一点头。
Chen nodded with a sense of his own unworthiness.

“你晓得就好。”
“It's good that you know.

胡雪岩又说，“总要格外对她体贴。”陈世龙依然是那句话：
You must be especially considerate towards her.” Chen repeated the same answer.

“我晓得。”
“I know.”

口口声声顺从着，倒象真的已把人家娶到手了似的。
He kept agreeing as though he had already married her!

阿珠心里非常不服气，
A’zhu deeply resented it.

同时也有些奇怪，
She was puzzled too.

听口风好象他们早就瞒着自己，暗中做了“交易”，
From their tone, it sounded as though they had long since made a private bargain behind her back.

倒要仔仔细细先把事情弄清楚，然后再想报复的主意。
She must first discover exactly what had happened, then consider how to get her own back.

这回是陈世龙在说话：
This time Chen spoke.

“胡先生，那么，你看我这件事该怎么办？
“Mr Hu, what do you think I ought to do about the marriage?

赤手空拳，一点底子都没有。”
I have nothing—no means at all.”

“有我！”胡雪岩答得极其爽脆，
“You have me!” Hu answered readily.

“我今天一共有三头媒要做，
“I have three matches to arrange at present.

一头已经成功了，还有一头要看看再说，再有就是你这头媒。
One has already succeeded; another needs more consideration; and then there's yours.

老张那里我一说就成功，
A word from me will settle Old Zhang.

你丈母娘更不用说；最听我的话。
Your mother-in-law is easier still: she always listens to me.

阿珠最孝顺，
A’zhu is devoted to her parents.

只要跟两老说好了，不怕她不答应。”
Once they agree, we needn't fear she won't.”

原来如此，
So that was it!

阿珠心想：拿我父母来压我，
They meant to use her parents to pressure her.

所以有这样子的把握，
No wonder they were so confident.

那也太目中无人了。
They thought nothing of her at all.

于今之计，第一步先要在爹面前说好，不可轻易答应。
Her first step must be to speak to her father and prevent him from agreeing too readily.

到时候叫你干瞪眼！
Then they could stand there looking helpless!


刚想得好好地，立刻又是一愣，因为胡雪岩说破了她的心思，
She had scarcely settled this plan when she was startled again: Hu seemed to read her thoughts aloud.

“不过”，他说，“阿珠的性子最做，
“But A’zhu is extremely proud.

服软不服硬，
Kindness moves her; force doesn't.

也要防她一脚！
We must allow for that too.

就算父母之命，勉强依从，心里一千一万个不甘心，将来也不会对你怎么样好的。
Even if she obeyed her parents unwillingly, with a thousand resentments in her heart, she wouldn't treat you particularly well afterwards.

所以说到头来，两厢情愿最要紧。
In the end, what matters most is that both people should be willing.

你总要记住我这句话，阿珠服软不服硬。
Always remember what I've told you: A’zhu responds to kindness, not force.

处处依她，包你一辈子有福享。”
Give way to her in everything, and you'll have happiness all your life.”

听到这几句话，阿珠心里又酸又甜，
These words left a mixture of sweetness and pain in her heart.

同时也觉得泄了气，什么劲道都拿不出来了。
They also took the wind out of her sails: she could no longer summon any resistance.

不过总还有些不甘，不甘于如此受人摆布，同时也觉得不能就这么便宜了陈世龙。
Yet she still resented being managed in this way and felt that Chen ought not to have things so easily.

“我的打算是这样，看看年底办喜事来不来得及。
“My plan,” Hu continued, “is to see whether we can hold the wedding before the year's end.

如果来不及，就今年‘传红’，明年‘入赘’……”
If there isn't time, we can complete the formal betrothal this year and have you marry into her household next year...”

“入赘！”陈世龙大声插嘴，
“Marry into her household!” Chen interrupted loudly.

光听声音，就知道他不愿，在后舱的阿珠不由得就把心悬了起来。
His voice alone showed his reluctance, and A’zhu's heart tightened as she listened.

“又不是要你改姓张，
“You aren't being asked to change your surname to Zhang.

不过两家并作一家，
The two households will simply become one.

也不是什么失面子的事！”
There's nothing disgraceful about it.”

“不改姓就可以。”
“As long as I don't have to change my surname.”


“你不要得福不知！”
“Don't fail to appreciate your good fortune!”

胡雪岩故意这样说给阿珠听：
Hu deliberately pitched this at A’zhu.

“就算你想改性，阿珠也许看你不上眼。”
“Even if you wanted to change your surname, she might not think you good enough.”

陈世龙露着一嘴雪白的牙齿，不好意思地笑了。
Chen showed his white teeth in an embarrassed smile.

这笑容正落在壁缝中向外张望的阿珠眼中，她的感觉是得意的舒服。
Through a crack in the partition, A’zhu saw it and felt a pleasant sense of triumph.

“老婆虽好，吊在裙带上一步不离，也太没有出息了。”胡雪岩说，
“A good wife is all very well,” Hu continued, “but a man who never moves a step from her apron strings won't amount to much.

“湖州丝行有你丈人、丈母娘在，尽可以照料得了。
With your parents-in-law at the Huzhou silk firm, they can manage it perfectly well.

我希望你在上海帮我的忙，
I want you to help me in Shanghai.

跟老古把洋文学学好，将来受用无穷。”
Learn the foreign language properly from Old Gu, and it will serve you all your life.”

“好啊！”
“Gladly!”

陈世龙很兴奋地，
Chen was excited.

“古先生的洋文，说得真是呱呱叫，
“Mr Gu speaks it wonderfully well.

我一定跟他学会了它！”
I'll make sure I learn it from him.”

“这才是！”
“That's the spirit!”

胡雪岩用欣慰的声音说，
Hu sounded pleased.

“好在丝生意上有关联，常常要回湖州，
“Fortunately, the silk business will bring you back to Huzhou often.

有得你跟阿珠亲热的时候！”
You'll have plenty of time to show A’zhu your affection.”

要死！
The wretch!

阿珠一下子绯红了脸，
Her face flushed crimson.

顿时觉得坐也不是，站也不是，却又不敢弄出声响来，怕前面发觉她在偷听，
She did not know whether to sit or stand, yet dared make no sound for fear that the men would discover her eavesdropping.

于是蹑手蹑脚，掩到自己铺位上，手抚着一颗突夹在跳的心，细细去想他们所说的那些话。
She tiptoed back to her berth and, with a hand over her racing heart, carefully considered all they had said.


这一想恩得忘掉辰光，
She became so absorbed that she lost track of time.

直到老张在喊，她才警觉，
Only when Old Zhang called did she come to herself.

朝窗外望了一下，太阳当头，已经中午了。
Looking out, she saw the sun overhead: it was noon already.

“来吃饭！”
“Come and eat!

老张问道，“阿珠，你在作啥？
A’zhu, what have you been doing?

一直不见你的人？”
I haven't seen you all morning.”

“我睡着了！”
“I fell asleep!”

她自己觉得这句话答得很好，
She was pleased with that answer.

睡着了便表示根本没有听见胡雪岩和陈世龙的话，见了面就容易装糊涂了。
Being asleep meant that she could not have heard Hu and Chen talking, which would make it easier to pretend ignorance when she faced them.

她装人家也装，
They were pretending too.

在饭桌上胡雪岩和陈世龙一如平时，
At the table, both men behaved as usual.

倒是老张有许多话，
It was Old Zhang who had much to say.

因为这天下午船泊德清，就要分手，胡雪岩和陈世龙往南到杭州，老张带着女儿，原船往北回家，
The boat would stop at Deqing that afternoon, where they would part: Hu and Chen would continue south to Hangzhou, while Old Zhang took his daughter north towards home in the same boat.

自然有些事要交代交代。
Naturally, various things had to be settled.

当天下午，很早就到了德清，
They reached Deqing early that afternoon.

船一泊定，胡雪岩邀老张上岸走走。
As soon as the boat was moored, Hu invited Old Zhang ashore for a stroll.

阿珠立刻想到，他们是有关自己的话要谈，
A’zhu immediately guessed that they had something concerning her to discuss.

她上午躺在床上想心事，就已经盘算过，这件终身大事，不管怎么样，要自己回到湖州先告诉了娘，再作道理。
While lying in her berth that morning, she had decided that, whatever happened, she must first return to Huzhou and talk to her mother about this lifelong matter.

如果她爹一答应，便毫无商量的余地。
If her father agreed now, there would be no room left for discussion.

她不甘于随人摆布，因而打定主意，这一天要一直跟爹在一起，不容胡雪岩有开口的机会。
Unwilling to let others arrange everything for her, she resolved to remain beside him all day and give Hu no opportunity to speak.

那么此刻怎么办呢？
What could she do now?

唯一的办法，仍是跟着不放，
There was only one way: follow them.

胡雪岩总不见得当面锣，对面鼓，有自己在场，便好意思提做媒的话！
Surely Hu would not openly discuss matchmaking with her standing there!


于是她接口喊道：“爹，我也去！”
“Father, I'm coming too!” she called.

胡雪岩自然不要她去。
Naturally Hu did not want her along.

这容易得紧，想都不用想，便有了话，
Preventing it was easy; he did not even need to think.

“阿珠，拜托你，替我把零碎东西收拾收拾，好不好？”
“A’zhu, would you do me a favour and pack my odds and ends?”

“是啊！”老张老实，
“Yes!” Honest Old Zhang agreed.

“要掉船了，
“We're changing boats.

各人的东西该归一归。
Everyone's things need sorting out.

你不要去！”
You stay here.”

这一说，胡雪岩又有了话，
This gave Hu another opening.

“对的！”
“Exactly!

他喊道，“世龙，你也看一看，哪些东西该带到湖州送人的，跟阿珠交代清楚，
Shilong, go through the presents that are to be taken to Huzhou, and explain everything to A’zhu.

不要弄错了！”
We mustn't have any mistakes.”

说完，他跟看张扬长上岸，有意把陈世龙留在船上，好跟阿珠细诉衷曲。
With that, he strode ashore with Old Zhang, deliberately leaving Chen behind to confide his feelings to her.

阿珠心里实在有些气不过，
A’zhu could scarcely contain her indignation.

想想自己真象《西游记》的孙悟空，怎么样也翻不出胡雪岩的手掌。
She felt like Monkey in Journey to the West: however she tried, she could never escape Hu Xueyan's palm.

这份闲气，此刻自然要发在陈世龙头上了。
For the moment, Chen would naturally have to bear the brunt of her frustration.


“他们上岸去做啥？”她气鼓鼓地问。
“What have they gone ashore for?” she demanded angrily.

陈世龙本来就聪明，
Chen was naturally clever.

加以这阵子跟着胡雪岩，耳濡目染，学会了许多待人处事的诀窍。
During his time with Hu, he had also picked up many ways of handling people and situations simply by watching and listening.

这样一件有关自己一辈子的大事。当然更不敢疏忽，
In something affecting his entire future, he could hardly afford carelessness.

所以这时不忙着答阿珠的话，先抬眼看，用心想，要把她的态度弄明白了再说。
Rather than answer at once, he looked up and considered her carefully, determined to understand her attitude first.

他在想：阿珠问到这句话，就可以证明，他们上午的那一番谈话，她已经听得清清楚楚，
That question proved she had heard their whole conversation that morning.

此刻是疑心胡雪岩跟她父亲去谈她的终身。
Now she suspected that Hu had gone ashore to discuss her marriage with her father.

既然如此，上午为何不站出来说话，
If so, why had she not come forward to speak that morning?

此刻却大光其火？
Why fly into a temper now?

可见得光火是闹脾气。
Clearly, this was a fit of temper.

她的脾气他也摸透了，越顶越凶最好的应付办法是让她发不出火。
He understood that too: the more he opposed her, the fiercer she would become. The best course was to leave her nothing on which to vent her anger.

于是他赔笑答道：“这我倒不晓得。
Smiling apologetically, he said, “I really don't know.

要不要我追上去问一声？”
Shall I run after them and ask?”

“难为你！”
“How obliging of you!”

阿珠一波刚平，一波又起：
One wave subsided, and another rose.

“你们师父徒弟，一上半天，乱七八糟在讲些什么怪话？”
“And what were you and your master talking about all morning? What was all that nonsense?”

既然叫穿了，陈世龙何可否认？
With the secret out, how could he deny it?

但怎么样承认呢？
But how should he acknowledge it?

笑而不答，惹她反感，细说从头，就会把胡雪岩苦心设计。说到了她心里的那番话的效用，付之东流。
A smile without an answer would annoy her; a full account would undo the effect of Hu's carefully planned words, which had reached her heart so precisely.

左右不是，
Neither course would do.

十分为难，而阿珠看他不答，似乎又要光火了。
He was at a loss, and his silence seemed about to anger her again.


一急急出一个计较，
Urgency brought him an idea.

觉得就象筑堤防水一样，多少日子，多少人工，辛辛苦苦到了“合龙”的那一刻，
It was like building an embankment: after days of labour by many hands, the moment came to close the final breach.

非要眼明手快，把握时机不可，
Then one had to see clearly, act quickly, and seize the opportunity.

河官到了合龙的时候，如果情况紧急，往往会纵身一跳，跳在缺口里，身挡洪流。
At a critical closing, an official in charge might leap into the gap himself and use his body to resist the flood.

别人看他如此奋不顾身，深受感动，自然一起着力，得收全功。
Moved by such selfless courage, the others would put forth all their strength, and the work would succeed.

现在自己也要有那纵身一跳的勇气，大事方得成功。
Chen too must dare that leap if this great undertaking was to succeed.

想到这里，他毫不犹豫地双膝一跪，直挺挺地跪在阿珠面前说：
Without hesitation, he dropped onto both knees and knelt upright before her.

“既然你已经都听见了，也就不用我多说了。
“Since you've heard everything, I needn't say much more.

阿珠，我一条命都在你手里。”
A’zhu, my whole life is in your hands.”

阿珠不防他有此一着，
She had not expected this.

急得胸头乱跳，急的是怕人看见不象话，
Her heart raced with alarm: what if someone saw them?

便低声喝道：“怎么这副样子？
“What are you doing?” she demanded in a low voice.

快起来，快起来！”
“Get up, quickly!”

“起来也容易，
“Getting up is easy.

你说一句，我就起来！”
Say one word, and I will.”

这一句是什么？阿珠自然知道，
She knew what that word was.

但就是心里肯了，也就不出口，
But even if she agreed in her heart, she could not say it.

那便只有先吓他一吓，
She must first try frightening him.

“你越是这么赖皮，我越不说！
“The more you behave like this, the less I'll say!

起来，起来！不然，我永远不理你。”
Get up, or I'll never speak to you again.”

陈世龙是打定了主意，非要一下子有个了局不可，
Chen had resolved to settle the matter once and for all.

因而用毫无商量余地的声音说：
His voice allowed no argument.

“你不说一句，我永远跪在这里！”
“Until you say it, I'll kneel here for ever.”


“没有见过你这样的人！”阿珠恨声说道，
“I've never known anyone like you!” A’zhu said resentfully.

“你要我说什么？”
“What do you want me to say?”

“你自己晓得的。”
“You know.”

“对了！
“Exactly!

你晓得，我也晓得，
You know, and I know.

不就行了吗？”
Isn't that enough?”

听得这一句，陈世龙一颗心踏实了，
At those words, Chen's heart settled.

笑嘻嘻地问道：“真的‘行了’？”
Smiling, he asked, “Then is it really settled?”

“不要罗嗦！”
“Stop pestering!”

阿珠把脸一沉：
Her face grew stern.

“你再不起来，行了也不行！”
“If you don't get up, even what's settled will be unsettled!”

到此地步，不能再不听她的话，但陈世龙还要试探一下，
He could no longer refuse to obey, but he wanted one more test.

“起来可以，”
“I'll get up.

他说，“你拉我一把！”
Give me a hand.”

“不拉！
“I won't!

为啥要我来位你？”
Why should I pull you up?”

阿珠拿手指刮着脸羞他：
She drew a finger down her cheek to shame him.

“ ‘男儿膝下有黄金’，
“‘A man's knees are worth gold.’

就是你两个膝盖不值钱。”
Apparently yours are worth nothing.”

“就看在‘膝下有黄金’的分上，扶我一把！”
“For the sake of that gold beneath my knees, help me up!”

陈世龙一面说，一面把手一伸。
As he spoke, he held out his hand.


阿珠真不想理他，但她那只右手跟心中所想的不一致，
A’zhu truly meant to ignore him, yet her right hand seemed independent of her intentions.

莫名其妙地就伸了出去，等陈世龙拉住她的手，可就不肯放了！
Somehow it reached out, and once Chen had taken it, he would not let go.

他站起身来，一只手紧握着她的手，坐向她身旁，
Rising, he kept hold of her hand and sat beside her.

另一只手很快地伸向船窗，
His other hand reached swiftly for the window.

只听“喀喇”一响，舱中顿时漆黑，木板船窗被拉上了。
With a clatter, the wooden shutter closed, plunging the cabin into darkness.

阿珠轻声喝道：“这是干什么！”
“What are you doing?” she asked sharply but quietly.

“不干什么！
“Nothing!

只要亲亲你！”
I only want to kiss you.”

“你敢！”
“Don't you dare!”

阿珠话还没有说完，陈世龙已不顾她的反对，作出了让她不安的亲昵举动。
Before she had finished, he ignored her objection and became more intimate than she was prepared to accept.

阿珠又羞又急，心里也有些矛盾。
She felt embarrassed, anxious, and conflicted.

但舱里虽然黑漆一团，外面却是朗朗乾坤，如果让人发觉，怎么还有脸见人？因而十分不安。
Beyond the dark cabin it was still broad daylight, and the thought of being discovered made her deeply uneasy.

“放手！”她好不容易才能扭过头去，这样低声说了一句。
“Let go,” she finally managed to say, turning her head aside.

“再亲一个！”
“Just one more kiss!”

“还要？”阿珠发怒了，
“Again?” she said angrily.

“你不要弄得人怕了你！”
“Don't make me afraid of you!”

这是极严重的警告，
It was a serious warning.

陈世龙适可而止，放开了手，拉她坐了起来，
Chen stopped, released her, and helped her sit up.

温柔地问道：“要不要开窗子？”
“Shall I open the window?” he asked gently.

“自然要开的。”
“Of course.”

说着，她自己伸手去拉开了窗子，
She reached out and opened it herself.

等光亮扑了进来，她赶紧避开，缩向外面看不到的角落，理理鬓发，拉拉衣襟，闭着嘴，垂着眼，仿佛受了什么委屈似地。
As the light came in, she quickly withdrew into a corner hidden from anyone outside, smoothed her hair, straightened her clothes, and sat with closed lips and lowered eyes, looking as though she had been hurt.


“阿珠……”
“A’zhu...”

“你不要再跟我罗嗦！”她抢着说道，
“Don't pester me again!” she interrupted.

“安安分分说几句话，不然，你就替我请出去！”
“Behave yourself and talk sensibly, or kindly leave.”

陈世龙不响，
Chen said nothing.

只嘻嘻地笑着，一双眼睛一直望着阿珠，把阿珠看得既窘且恼。
He merely smiled and kept looking at her, making her both embarrassed and annoyed.

“你不要这样子盯着人看，好不好？”
“Would you stop staring at me like that?”

阿珠白了他一眼，
She gave him a reproachful glance.

“又不是不认识。”
“It's not as though you don't know me.”

“对不起！”陈世龙笑道，
“I'm sorry,” he said with a smile.

“我舍不得不看。”
“I can't bear to stop looking.”

这话说得她别有一股滋味在心头，于是语气缓和了：
The words stirred something different in her heart, and her tone softened.

“好也好在心里好了！
“You can keep your affection in your heart.

何必一定都要摆在脸上呢？
Must you display it all on your face?

你脸皮厚，不怕人笑，也要给人家想想。”
You're thick-skinned and don't mind being laughed at, but you ought to think of someone else.”

说到这话，陈世龙便把视线避开。
Chen looked away.

但立刻又拉了回来，
Almost at once, however, his gaze returned.

不见阿珠的脸，就象失落了一样什么要紧的东西，一定得找着了，才能安心。
Without sight of her face, he felt as though he had mislaid something important and could not be at ease until he found it again.


就这片刻的沉默，阿珠觉得自己的一颗心比较平伏了，
During this brief silence, A’zhu felt her heart grow calmer.

摸一摸险，也不再那么发烫，
Touching her face, she found it no longer so hot.

于是便说，“我要好好问你几句话。
“I want to ask you some serious questions,” she said.

你是不是规规矩矩的告诉我，就看你自己的良心！”
“Whether you answer honestly is a matter for your conscience.”

“好！”陈世龙斩钉截铁的回答，
“Very well!” Chen answered firmly.

“我一定凭良心。
“I'll answer in good conscience.

你说好了。”
Ask me.”

“你跟你师父，老早就谈过我的事？”
“You and your master discussed me long ago?”

“是的。老早谈过。”
“Yes, long ago.”

“怎么说法？”
“What did you say?”

“这话就难说得清楚了。”
“That's hard to explain.

陈世龙说，“话很多，不晓得从哪里说起。”
We said so much that I don't know where to begin.”

“照这样看，你们不知道打过我多少遍主意了！”
“Then heaven knows how many times you've plotted about me!”

阿珠又想起他们“私相授受”的可恶，便发怨声，“只怕让你们把我卖到外国，我都不晓得。”
Recalling the hateful way they had disposed of her privately, she complained, “You could probably sell me to a foreign country without my knowing it.”

“哪个敢打你的主意？”
“Who would dare plot against you?”

陈世龙故意装得很认真他说：
Chen assumed a solemn air.

“第一个我就不依！”
“I'd be the first to object!”


“哼！”
“Hmph!”

阿珠撇一撇嘴，
A’zhu curled her lip.

“ 你是好人，
“You're such a good man!

如果你是好人，为什么这许多日子，你一句口风都不肯透露？”
If you're so good, why haven't you let a word slip all these days?”

“不是不肯，
“It wasn't that I wouldn't.

是不敢！”
I didn't dare.”

“为啥不敢？”
“Why not?”

“怕碰你一个钉子，
“I was afraid you'd reject me outright.

以后的话就难说了。”
After that, it would be hard to say anything more.”

想想这也是实话。
On reflection, that was probably true.

但她同时也想到，自己在小姐妹淘里，被公认为厉害角色，比起胡雪岩和陈世龙来，差得就太远了，
But she also realised that, although her girl friends considered her formidable, she was no match for Hu or Chen.

如果他们真的起下什么没良心的意思，自己一定被他们摆布得走投无路。
If they really intended anything heartless, they could manoeuvre her into a position with no escape.

然则自己所倚恃的是什么呢？
What, then, could she rely on?

是陈世龙的一颗心，
Chen's heart.

能收服了他的心，自己才可以放心。
Only by winning that could she feel secure.

想到这里，觉得要恩威并用，
She must combine kindness with firmness.

体贴固然要紧，但也要立下许多“规矩”，不可迁就。
Consideration mattered, but she must also establish rules and refuse to give way.

当然，这是以后的话，
That was for the future, however.

眼前还得多打听一些关于自己的事。
For now, she must learn more about what concerned her.

“胡先生到底怎么说我？”
“What exactly did Mr Hu say about me?”

“胡先生”这个称呼，在陈世龙听来非常新鲜，
To Chen, “Mr Hu” was an entirely new form of address from her.

以前他从没有听她这样叫过。
He had never heard her call him that before.

此刻改口的意思，一面是表示与胡雪岩的关系，到此告一段落，另一方面表示“夫唱妇随”，他怎么叫，她也怎么叫。
The change suggested both that her relationship with Hu had reached its end and that she would follow her husband's lead, using the same address Chen used.

意会到这一点，陈世龙觉得非常欣慰，不由得又傻兮兮地瞪着她看。
This understanding delighted him, and once again he stared at her with a foolish smile.

这是她在胡雪岩脸上从没有见过的表情。
She had never seen such an expression on Hu's face.

那象个顽皮的大孩子的笑容，另有一种使人醉心之处，
Like the smile of a mischievous big boy, it had a charm of its own.

这时反倒是她想伸手去摸一摸他的脸了。
This time she felt like reaching out to touch his face.


突然，陈世龙问道：“你刚才说的什么？”
“What did you just ask?” Chen suddenly said.

阿珠心不在焉，被他问得一愣，
Her thoughts elsewhere, A’zhu was startled.

不过对这样的场面，她有个“倒打一耙”的法子，
But in such situations she had a way of turning the accusation back on the other person.

“你看你！”她不满他说，
“Look at you!” she complained.

“刚刚说过的话，就忘记得干干净净！
“You forget everything the moment it's said.

你哪里有一点心在人家身上？
How can you claim to care about me?”

““对不起！”
“I'm sorry!”

陈世龙赔笑致歉，
He smiled apologetically.

“我实在高兴得有些昏头了。”
“I'm so happy that I've rather lost my head.”

在这一迁延之间，阿珠已想起了自己的那句问话，便又说一遍：
During this delay, she remembered her question and repeated it.

“我是问，胡先生到底怎么说我？”
“I asked what Mr Hu said about me.”
