“You heard for yourself!

千言万误一个字：好！”
A thousand words, all meaning one thing: you're wonderful.”

这是指她“听壁脚”而言，
He was referring to her eavesdropping.

不便否认，
She could hardly deny it.

“我是说平常，
“I mean at other times.

总还有些话。”她说。
Surely he's said more than that.”


“不要去打听了。”
“Don't inquire into that any more.”

陈世龙摇一摇手，
Chen waved a hand.

“我们只谈我们的事。”
“Let's talk about ourselves.”

“对！”
“Yes!”

阿珠脱口说了这一个字，接着便问：
The word escaped her, followed by another question.

“ 他们上岸谈啥？
“What have they gone ashore to discuss?

是不是谈我？”
Me?”

“一定是的。”
“Certainly.”

“那么你刚才怎么‘装羊’，说不晓得？”
“Then why did you play innocent just now and say you didn't know?”

“刚才是刚才，现在是现在。
“Then was then, and now is now.

现在我可以不叫你阿珠了，
Now I needn't call you A’zhu.

叫你一声：太太！”
I can call you my wife!”

“咄！”阿珠红着脸说：
“Shame on you!” she said, blushing.

“不要肉麻！”
“Don't be so embarrassing.”

“想想真妙！”
“It's really extraordinary!”

陈世龙有些不胜感叹似地，
Chen sounded full of wonder.

“先叫你张小姐，以后叫你阿珠，现在叫你太太！
“First I called you Miss Zhang, then A’zhu, and now my wife.

几个月的工夫，变得这么厉害！”
So much has changed in only a few months!”

阿珠想一想，深有同感。
Thinking it over, she felt the same.

人生在世，实在奇妙之至，
Life was astonishing.

从认识胡雪岩开始一直到今天，不知经历了多多少少新奇的事？
From the time she had met Hu to this moment, how many new and strange experiences had she had?

这半年工夫，过得真有意思。
These six months had certainly been eventful.


“我在想，”陈世龙又说，“一个人全要靠运气，
“I was thinking,” Chen continued, “a person depends entirely on luck.

遇着胡先生就是我交运的日子到了。”
Meeting Mr Hu was the day my luck began.”

“也不要这么说！
“Don't put it like that!

一个人不能光靠运气，
Nobody can depend on luck alone.

运气一时，总要自己上进！”
Luck lasts only a while; you must always try to improve yourself.”

话中带着些教训的意味，陈世龙觉得有点刺耳，
There was something admonishing in her words, and Chen found them a little disagreeable.

但转念想到，这正是阿珠心里有了做成夫妻，休戚相关的想法，才会有这样的话头。
Then he reflected that she spoke this way precisely because she already thought of them as husband and wife, sharing the same fortunes.

于是他的那一丝反感，很快地消失了。
His slight resentment quickly disappeared.

他没有再作声，阿珠也不开口，
He said no more, and neither did she.

沉默并不表示彼此无话可说，
Their silence did not mean that they had nothing to say.

你看着我，我看着你，不管是他的长伺眼波，还是她的一瞥即避，无不意味深长地传达了太多的心曲。
As they looked at one another, his lingering gaze and her swiftly averted glances conveyed more than words could tell.


“天黑了！”阿珠讶然说道，
“It's dark!” A’zhu exclaimed.

“爹还不回船？”
“Why hasn't Father come back?”

“一定在镇上吃酒。
“They must be drinking in town.

有一会才得回来。”
It'll be a while yet.”

“你饿不饿？”
“Are you hungry?”

“我不饿。”
“I'm not.

陈世龙问道：“你呢？”
Are you?”

“我也不饿。
“Neither am I.

不过……”
But...”

阿珠顿住了，在想心事。
She stopped, thinking.

不饿就是不饿，
If she was not hungry, she was not hungry.

“不过”这个转语下得令人莫名其妙，
What could that “but” mean?

陈世龙忍不住追问：
Chen could not resist asking.

“不过，怎么样？”
“But what?”

“我们到外头去！”
“Let's go outside.”

阿珠站起身来，
A’zhu stood up.

“黑咕隆咚地，两个人在这里，算啥一出？”
“What sort of scene is this, the two of us sitting here in the dark?”

照陈世龙的心思，最好就在这样的黑头里，相偎相依，低声密语。
Chen would have preferred to remain close beside her in the darkness, talking softly.

但为了顺从阿珠，言不由衷地答道：“好，好！到外头点了灯等他们！”
To oblige her, however, he answered against his wishes, “Yes, let's go out, light the lamp, and wait for them.”


走到中舱，点起煤油灯一看，方桌上已摆了四个碟子，四副杯筷，一壶酒，
In the middle cabin, they lit the kerosene lamp and found four dishes, four sets of cups and chopsticks, and a pot of wine already on the square table.

也不知船家是什么时候进来过，
When had the boatman come in?

一舱之隔，竟无所知，
Only one partition away, they had known nothing about it.

令人惊讶。
It was astonishing.

再多想一想，阿珠的脸又红了，
Thinking a little further, A’zhu blushed again.

“ 你看！”她低声埋怨陈世龙，
“Look!” she reproached Chen quietly.

“我们在里头说的话，一定叫人家都听了去了。”
“They must have heard everything we said in there.”

他也明白，
He understood too.

必是船家来陈设杯盘时，听见他们在后舱密语，不肯惊动，
While laying out the meal, the boatman must have heard their private conversation in the after cabin and chosen not to disturb them.

所以摆好了这些东西，也不点灯，也不催他们吃饭，听其自然。
He had left the dishes without lighting the lamp or calling them to eat, allowing events to take their course.

看来倒是个极知趣的人。
Evidently he was a very tactful man.

“我们都是些大大方方的话，
“We said nothing we need be ashamed of.

听了去，也不要紧。”陈世龙设词宽慰，
It doesn't matter if they heard,” Chen said reassuringly.

“好在总归瞒不住他们的，再说也用不着瞒。
“They'll find out sooner or later anyway, and there's no need to hide it.

你索性毫不在乎，象七姑奶奶那样，反倒没有人拿你取笑了。”
If you simply take no notice, like the Seventh Lady, people won't tease you.”


提起七姑奶奶，阿珠既关切又好奇，而且心里还有种说不出的、不大好过的感觉，
Mention of the Seventh Lady aroused both concern and curiosity in A’zhu, along with an unpleasant feeling she could not describe.

“我倒问你，”
“Let me ask you something.

她说，“七姑奶奶口口声声叫你‘阿龙’，你心里是怎样个味道？”
How do you feel when she keeps calling you A’long?”

陈世龙还不曾想到自己，先辨出她的话中，微带酸味，心里立刻便生警惕，
Before considering his own feelings, Chen detected a trace of jealousy in the question and immediately became cautious.

“她要那么叫，我只好那么答应，
“If she chooses to call me that, I can only answer.

说实在的……”
To tell the truth...”

话到口边，陈世龙觉得有些刻薄，
The words were on his lips, but he felt they would be unkind.

摇摇手说：
He waved a hand.

“啊，啊，不谈了。”
“Oh, let's not discuss it.”

“怎么？”
“Why?”

阿珠钉紧了问：
A’zhu pressed him.

“为啥不谈？”
“Why not?”

“不相干的事，
“It's nothing to do with us.

何必谈它？”
Why talk about it?”

“说说也不要紧嘛！”
“There's no harm in talking.”

看她如此认真，陈世龙不能不答，昧着良心说道：
Seeing how intent she was, Chen had to answer, though against his conscience.

“听了实在有点肉麻！”
“Honestly, it makes me rather uncomfortable.”

阿珠微微笑了，这是对他的答复，颇为满意的表示，因而没有再问下去。
She smiled faintly, showing that the reply pleased her, and asked no more.


陈世龙有如释重负之感，
Chen felt as though a weight had been lifted.

帮阿珠点好了灯，对坐吃饭。
He helped A’zhu with the lamp, and they sat opposite each other to eat.

平日是各管各，
Ordinarily each had attended to their own needs.

即使心中有意，也不便公然献殷勤，
Even if he cared for her, he could hardly show his attentions openly.

此刻不同了，
Now things were different.

他替她盛饭、夹菜，自嘲是个“大脚”丫头“，这是他从杭州听来的，嘲笑喜欢服侍娘儿们的男人的一句俗话。
He served her rice and selected dishes for her, laughingly calling himself a “big-footed maid”—a Hangzhou expression he had heard used to mock a man who liked waiting on women.

这顿饭吃了有一个钟头，
The meal lasted an hour.

是陈世龙的话多，谈这个、谈那个，不大谈到他自己，但阿珠仍旧听得趣味盎然。
Chen talked a great deal about one thing and another, though seldom about himself, and A’zhu listened with absorbing interest.

“回来了！”突然间，陈世龙一喊，
“They're back!” he suddenly called.

阿珠回头去看，只见两盏灯笼，冉冉而来。
She turned and saw two lanterns approaching slowly.

她顿时心慌，
At once she became anxious.

不知见了她父亲和胡雪岩，持何表情？
What expression should she wear when facing her father and Hu?

当然也没有躲到后舱的道理，
Naturally, she could not hide in the after cabin.

那怎么办呢？唯有尽力装得平静，收拾收拾饭桌，等他们上了船，随机应付。
All she could do was try to look calm, clear the table, and respond as circumstances required once they came aboard.

陈世龙很快地迎了出去，帮着船家搭好跳板，扶着老张上了船，
Chen hurried out, helped the boatman lay the gangplank, and supported Old Zhang across.

又来扶胡雪岩，他趁机把陈世龙的手，重重一捏，暗示大事已经谈妥。
When he turned to help Hu, Hu squeezed his hand firmly, signalling that the great matter had been settled.


“咦！”胡雪岩一进舱就开玩笑，
“Well!” Hu began teasing as soon as he entered.

“你们两个人这一顿饭，吃了多少辰光？”
“How long have you two been eating this meal?”

“都是等你们，一直等到现在。”
“We've been waiting for you all this time.”

阿珠看他们都是满脸通红。酒气熏天，便先提出警告：
Seeing both men's red faces and smelling the wine on them, A’zhu issued a warning in advance.

“不要吃醉了，来说疯话！”
“Don't come talking nonsense because you're drunk!”

“不说，不说！”胡雪岩醉态可掬的，
“We shan't!” Hu replied with an unmistakably drunken air.

“不说疯话，
“No nonsense.

说正经话。”
Serious matters.”

“吃醉了酒，有啥正经话好说？
“What serious matters can you discuss when you've been drinking?

我替你们去泡浓浓的一壶茶来，
I'll make a strong pot of tea.

吃了去睡，顶好！”说着，她喊着船家来拾掇残肴，自己拿着瓷茶壶去沏茶。
Have some and go to sleep—that would be best.” She called the boatman to clear away the food, then took the porcelain teapot to make tea.

人在外面，心在舱中，
Though outside the cabin, her thoughts remained within it.

注意着听胡雪岩会说些什么？哪知所听到的，却是老张的声音：
She listened for what Hu would say, but heard Old Zhang's voice instead.

“世龙！”
“Shilong!”

“嗯！”陈世龙重重答应。
“Yes!” Chen answered emphatically.

就这一呼一应，把阿珠的一颗心，悬了起来，
That call and response alone made her anxious.

这只手捏着一把茶叶，那只手捏着一把汗，
One hand held a handful of tea leaves; the other was damp with nervous sweat.

不知道她父亲会说出什么来？
What would her father say?

偏偏老张又没有声音了，越发使得做女儿的惊疑不定。
Yet he fell silent again, leaving his daughter more bewildered and uneasy than ever.


“老张，”胡雪岩打破了难耐的沉默，“你跟阿珠去说，
“Old Zhang,” Hu said, breaking the unbearable silence, “you talk to A’zhu.

我来跟世龙说。”
I'll talk to Shilong.”

“好，好！
“Yes, yes!

我不晓得跟世龙说啥好？
I don't know what to say to him.

你来！”接着老张便喊：“阿珠，阿珠！”
You do it!” Then Old Zhang called, “A’zhu! A’zhu!”

听这语气，想来爹爹已经答应了！
From his tone, her father must already have agreed.

阿珠心想，这话要悄悄来说，
This was something to discuss quietly, she thought.

怎好大呼小叫地？
Why shout it out?

心里有些气，便大声答道：“我在泡茶！”
A little annoyed, she answered loudly, “I'm making tea!”

“泡好了你出来，
“Come out when you've finished.

我有话说。”
I have something to tell you.”

“有啥话你不会进来说？”
“Can't you come in and tell me?”

“我就进来。”
“I'm coming.”

老张答应着，果然走出舱外，
He left the cabin.

酒是喝得多了些，脚步有些跌跌撞撞走不稳。
He had drunk rather too much and stumbled unsteadily as he walked.


阿珠赶紧扶住了他，
A’zhu hurried to support him.

埋怨着说：“黄汤也少灌些！
“You ought to drink less of that yellow stuff!

为啥吃这许多？”
Why have you had so much?”

“我高兴啊！”老张答道，
“Because I'm happy!” Old Zhang answered.

“人生在世，就是象今天晚上这样子，才有个意思。”
“Life only seems worthwhile on an evening like this.”

兹爱之意，溢于言表，
His fatherly love showed in every word.

阿珠不但感动，而且觉得自己的福气真不坏，不过口头上当然还带着撤娇埋怨的语气。
She was moved and felt truly fortunate, though her reply naturally retained the affectionate complaining tone of a daughter accustomed to indulgence.

“一开口就是酒话！”
“Drunken talk from the first word!

她说，“从来也没有听你说过什么‘人生在世’，
I've never heard you speak of ‘life’ before.

文绉绉地，真肉麻。”
All that elegant language is embarrassing.”

说是这样说，孝顺还是很孝顺，
Despite her words, she remained devoted to him.

把她父亲扶着坐下，沏好了茶，先倒了一杯过来。
She helped him sit down, brewed the tea, and brought him the first cup.

于是老张一把拉住她，抬眼望着她说：“阿珠，你要谢谢胡老爷。”
Catching her hand and looking up, Old Zhang said, “A’zhu, you must thank Mr Hu.”

“为啥？”
“Why?”

“他替你做了一头好媒，”
“He's arranged a good match for you.”

老张放低声音说了这一句，又连连点头：
Lowering his voice to say it, he nodded repeatedly.

“这样最好，
“This is the best way.

这样最好！”
The very best.”


阿珠有些好笑，但却不便有所表示。
She found it rather funny but could hardly show it.

心里也矛盾得很，
Her feelings were contradictory.

一方面希望她父亲就此打住，不再多说，免得受窘，
On the one hand, she wanted her father to stop before he embarrassed her further.

一方面却又想听听，胡雪岩到底跟他说了些什么，
On the other, she wanted to hear exactly what Hu had told him.

老张当然还要说，
Naturally, Old Zhang went on.

“阿珠，”他一本正经地，“胡老爷做媒，我已经答应他了，
“A’zhu,” he said solemnly, “Mr Hu is the matchmaker, and I've given him my consent.

希望你们和和气气，白头偕老。”
I hope you'll live happily together and grow old side by side.”

说了半天，到底是指的谁呢？
After all this, whom did he mean?

虽明知其人，也知道她父亲不会说话，而阿珠心里仍有些着急，
Although she knew, and knew too that her father was no speaker, she still felt anxious.

总觉得要听到了“陈世龙”这个名字，才能放心。
She wanted to hear the name “Chen Shilong” before she could be at ease.

然而口中却是害羞的活：
What she said, however, was full of bashfulness.

“爹，说你说酒话，你还不肯承认。
“Father, I say you're talking drunkenly, and still you won't admit it.

好了，好了，
Enough!

不要说了。”
Don't say any more.”

“是啊！
“Yes.

你总也晓得了，我不说也不要紧，
You understand already, so it doesn't matter if I say nothing.

不过婚嫁大事，
But marriage is an important business.

总得跟你说一声。”
I ought to tell you.”

话说得颠三倒四，而且有些不着边际，
He was rambling and hardly reaching the point.

外面的胡雪岩忍不住了，大声说道：
Hu, outside, could no longer bear it.

“你们父女俩请出来吧！
“Will you two come out?

我有几句话说。”
I have a few things to say.”

“好，好！”老张也高声人道：
“Yes, yes!” Old Zhang called back.

“还是要你来说。”
“You had better say them after all.”

说完，他站起身来去拉女儿，
He rose and pulled his daughter along.

阿珠怕羞，不肯出去，却禁不住她父亲硬拉，到底还是进了中舱，
Too shy to come out willingly, she could not resist his insistence and at last entered the middle cabin.

灵活的眼珠，在陈世龙脸上绕得一绕，马上收了回来，
Her lively eyes passed briefly over Chen's face, then withdrew.

低着头站在舱门口。
She stood by the doorway with her head lowered.


“阿珠！你一向最大方，
“A’zhu, you've always been perfectly natural.

用不着难为情。”胡雪岩说：
There's no need for embarrassment,” Hu said.

“媒是我做的，你爹也答应了，陈世龙更是求之不得，
“I've arranged the match, your father has agreed, and Chen could wish for nothing better.

只等你答应一句，
We're waiting only for your consent.

我就要叫世龙给你爹磕头，先把名分定了下来。
Then I'll have him bow to your father and establish the relationship.

你大大方方说一句，到底喜欢不喜欢世龙？”
Tell us plainly: do you like Shilong or not?”

“我不晓得。”
“I don't know.”

阿珠这样回答，声音又高又快，
Her answer was loud and quick.

而且把脸偏了过去，倒有些负气似地。
She turned her face aside, looking almost resentful.

“这大概不好意思说。
“You must be too embarrassed to say.

这样，你做一个表示，
Then give us a sign.

如果不喜欢，你就走了出去，
If you don't like him, go outside.

喜欢的就坐在这里。”
If you do, sit here.”

胡雪岩真促狭！
What a tormentor Hu was!

阿珠心里在骂他，
She cursed him inwardly.

走出去自然不愿，坐在这里却又坐不住，
Naturally she did not want to leave, yet she could not bring herself to sit.

那就依然只有装傻了：
She could only continue pretending not to understand.

“我不懂你的意思。”
“I don't know what you mean.”

“说不懂就是憧！”胡雪岩笑道，
“Saying you don't understand means you do!” Hu laughed.

“好了，
“Very well.

玩笑也开过了，
We've had our joke.

我正正经经问一句话，
Now I'll ask you seriously.

你如果不好意思跟我说，就跟你爹说了来告诉我。
If you feel too shy to tell me, tell your father and let him report it.

世龙算是我的学生，所以我又是媒人，又是他的长辈，
Shilong is my pupil, so I am both the matchmaker and the elder representing him.

百年大事，不同儿戏，
Marriage is for life, no childish game.

有啥话这时说清楚了的好，
Whatever there is to say should be made clear now.

你对男家有啥要求？”
What do you require of the bridegroom's family?”

这就是胡雪岩做事老到的地方，
This showed Hu's experience.

明知这桩亲事，一方面阿珠和陈世龙两情相悦，千肯万肯，一方面自己于张家有恩，媒人的面子够大，
He knew that the couple were deeply attached and willing, and that his services to the Zhang family gave him considerable influence as matchmaker.

但仍旧要问个清楚，省得女家事后有何怨言。
Even so, he asked clearly, so that the bride's family would have no grievance afterwards.


说到这话，老张首先觉得他是多问，
Old Zhang thought the question unnecessary.

“没有，没有！”他摇着手说，
“Nothing, nothing!” he said, waving his hands.

“哪里谈得到什么要求？
“How could we make demands?

你大媒老爷怎么说，我们怎么依！”
Whatever our honoured matchmaker says, we shall follow.”

“就因为你是这么想，我不能不问。”
“It's precisely because you think that way that I must ask.”

胡雪岩转脸又说，
Hu turned again.

“阿珠，终身大事，
“A’zhu, this concerns your whole life.

千万不可难为情。
You mustn't be embarrassed.

你现在说一句，我看做不做得到？
Tell me what you want, and I'll see whether it can be done.

做不到的，我就不管这个闲事了。”
If it can't, I shall have nothing more to do with the matter.”

这是一句反逼的话。
This was a way of putting pressure on her from the opposite direction.

阿珠心想，如果真的不肯说，他来一句：“那我只好不管了！”
If she really refused to speak, he might say he would withdraw.

岂非好事落空，成了难以挽回的僵局？
Then a happy prospect could fall through, leaving a deadlock that was difficult to resolve.

这样一急，便顾不得难为情了，
Alarm overcame her shyness.

低着头，轻声说道：“我也没有啥要求，
With her head down, she said softly, “I don't ask anything.

只要他肯上进，不会变心就好了！”
I only want him to try to get ahead and never change his feelings.”

“你听见没有？世龙！”胡雪岩说，
“Did you hear that, Shilong?

“你如果不上进，好吃懒做，或者将来发达了，弄个小老婆进门，去气阿珠，那你就是存心要我媒人的好看！”
If you refuse to improve yourself and become idle and self-indulgent, or if prosperity later leads you to bring home a concubine and upset A’zhu, you'll be deliberately disgracing me as your matchmaker.”

“日久见人心，胡先生看着好了。”
“Time reveals a man's heart, Mr Hu. You shall see.”

“好，
“Good.

我相信你。”
I believe you.

胡雪岩又说，“阿珠，你放心！
A’zhu, be at ease.

有我管着他，他不敢不上进，
With me supervising him, he won't dare neglect his future.

至于变心的话，真的有这样的事，你来告诉我，
As for a change of heart, if anything like that happens, tell me.

我替你出头。”
I'll stand up for you.”

阿珠想说一句：“谢谢你！”但不好意思出口，
She wanted to thank him but felt too shy.

只看了他一眼，微点一点头，表达了感激之意。
Instead, she looked at him and nodded slightly to show her gratitude.


“好了！
“Very well!

世龙，你替你丈人磕头，
Shilong, bow to your father-in-law.

就今天改了称呼。”
You shall use the new form of address from today.”

听得这话，阿珠拔脚就走，
A’zhu hurried away at once.

老张也连连表示“不必”，但陈世龙仍旧跪倒在地，磕了个响头，笑嘻嘻叫一声：“爹爹！”
Old Zhang repeatedly protested that it was unnecessary, but Chen knelt, touched his forehead firmly to the floor, and called with a broad smile, “Father!”

“请起来，请起来！”
“Please get up!”

老张又高兴，又不安，一面笑口大开，一面手忙脚乱地来扶陈世龙。
Old Zhang was both delighted and uneasy, grinning as he clumsily tried to help him rise.

陈世龙起来又跪倒，给胡雪岩也磕了个头，
Chen stood, then knelt again to bow to Hu.

接着便受命去取了个拜盒来，
At Hu's instruction, he fetched a presentation box.

胡雪岩早有打算，在上海就备好了四样首饰：一双翡翠耳环、一副金镯子、两朵珠花、四只宝石戒指，
Hu had planned ahead and bought four kinds of jewellery in Shanghai: a pair of jadeite earrings, a pair of gold bracelets, two pearl flowers, and four gemstone rings.

算起来总要值五六百两银子，
Together they must have been worth five or six hundred taels.

作为送女家的聘札。
They were the betrothal gifts for the bride's family.

老张当然很过意下去，但也不必客气，
Old Zhang naturally felt overwhelmed, but there was no need for formal refusals.

道谢以后，高声喊道：“你来看看！
After thanking Hu, he called loudly, “Come and look!

你真好福气，
You're fortunate indeed.

你娘也不曾戴过这样好的首饰。”
Your mother has never worn jewellery as fine as this.”


躲向后舱，在缝隙中张望的阿珠，原来就激动得不得了，
Hidden in the after cabin and peering through a crack, A’zhu was already deeply moved.

一听她爹这两句，不知怎么心里一阵发麻，滚烫的眼泪一下子流得满脸，
At those words from her father, something swept through her heart, and hot tears suddenly covered her face.

同时忍不住发出哽咽的声音。
She could not suppress her sobs.

“咦！好端端地……”
“Why, what's the matter...?”

“不要去说她！”
“Don't question her.”

胡雪岩摇手打断老张的话，
Hu waved a hand, interrupting Old Zhang.

“阿珠大概是替她娘委屈。”
“She's probably feeling sorry for her mother.”

阿珠觉得这句话正碰在心坎上，
The words touched A’zhu's heart exactly.

也不知是感激亲恩还是感激胡雪岩，
Whether she felt gratitude towards her parents or towards Hu, she could not have said.

索性倒在床上，呜呜咽咽地哭个不住。
She simply lay down on her berth and wept.

心里是越哭越痛快，越器越胆大，
The more she cried, the more relieved and confident she became.

哭完了擦擦眼睛，大大方方地走了出去，
When she had finished, she wiped her eyes and walked openly into the cabin.

不过笑总还不好意思笑，绷着脸坐在那里，预备等他爹或者胡雪岩一开口，便好搭腔。
She was still too embarrassed to smile, however, and sat with a solemn face, waiting for her father or Hu to speak so that she could join in.

胡雪岩说了话：
Hu obliged.

“阿珠，你替我们泡的茶呢？”
“A’zhu, where's the tea you made us?”

“啊呀！我倒忘记了。”
“Oh dear, I'd forgotten!”

阿珠站起身来，
She rose.

“只怕已经凉了。”
“I'm afraid it's cold.”

“就是凉茶好！
“Cold tea is just what we want.

你拿来吧！”
Bring it here.”

于是阿珠去取了茶来，倒一杯结胡雪岩，再倒一杯结她父亲，
She fetched it and poured a cup for Hu, then one for her father.

还有腼腼腆腆坐在一旁，蛮象个新郎官的陈世龙。
Chen sat shyly to one side, looking very much like a bridegroom.

她迟疑了一会，终于替他倒了一杯，
After a little hesitation, she poured him a cup too.

只是不曾亲自捧给他，也没有开口，把茶杯往外移了移，示意他自己来取。
She neither carried it over nor spoke, merely pushing it towards the edge of the table to indicate that he should take it himself.


“你自己看看！
“Look for yourself.

中意不中意？”
Do you like them?”

胡雪岩把拜厘打了开来。
Hu opened the presentation box.

望着那一片珠光宝气，阿珠反倒愣住了。
Faced with the glitter of pearls and gems, A’zhu was astonished.

这是我的东西？她这样在心里自问，
Were these really hers?

仿佛有些不大能相信它是真的。
She could scarcely believe it.

“财不露白！”
“Never display your wealth!”

久历江湖的老张，还真有些害怕，
Old Zhang's long experience of the world made him genuinely uneasy.

“好好收起来，
“Put them away carefully.

到家再看。”
You can look when you get home.”

这一说，阿珠不能不听，但不免怏怏，
She had to obey, though reluctantly.

盖好拜盒，低着头轻轻说了句，“胡先生，谢谢你！”
Closing the box, she lowered her head and said softly, “Mr Hu, thank you.”

“小意思，小意思，”
“A mere trifle!”

胡雪岩笑嘻嘻地说：
Hu smiled.

“等世龙将来发达了，给你买金刚钻。”
“When Shilong prospers, he'll buy you diamonds.”

“世龙！”老张也有些激动，口齿亦变得伶俐了，“胡先生待你们这样子好，你总要切记在心里，
Old Zhang too was moved, and his words now came more readily. “Shilong, you must never forget how well Mr Hu has treated you both.

报答胡先生。”
You must repay him.”

陈世龙深深点头，
Chen nodded earnestly.

正在想找一句能够表达自己感激的话来说明，胡雪岩先开了口。
While he was trying to find words that would express his gratitude, Hu spoke first.

“老张，你这话不完全对，
“That isn't entirely right, Old Zhang.

谈不到什么报答！
There's no question of repayment.

我请你们帮我的忙，自然当你们一家人看，
I've asked you to help me, and naturally I regard you as family.

祸福同当，
We share good fortune and bad.

把生意做好了，大家都有好处。
If we run the business well, everyone benefits.

好了，”
Now...”

他向老张使个眼色，
He gave Old Zhang a meaningful glance.

“我们上床吧，
“Let's go to bed.

让阿珠和世龙替我们把东西理一理齐，明天上午好分手。”
A’zhu and Shilong can sort out our things so that we can part tomorrow morning.”


这是有意让他们能够单独相处，说几句知心话。
He deliberately gave them a chance to be alone and exchange a few heartfelt words.

陈世龙掌灯把他们送回铺位，
Chen took a lamp and saw the men to their berths.

走回来先把船窗关上，然后取了一面镜子放在桌上，
Returning, he first shut the cabin window, then placed a mirror on the table.

温柔地说道：“这些首饰，你倒戴起来看看！”
“Do try on the jewellery,” he said gently.

这是极可人意的话，
Nothing could have pleased her more.

阿珠听他的话，打开拜匣，首先把那副翡翠秋叶的耳环戴上，
She opened the box and first put on the jadeite earrings shaped like autumn leaves.

然后双腕套上金镯，又取了个红宝石戒指戴。
Then she slipped a gold bracelet onto each wrist and put on a ruby ring.

只有珠花没有办法上头，因为那是戴在发髻上的，而她一直是梳的辫子。
Only the pearl flowers could not be worn: they belonged in a woman's hair bun, and she still wore her hair in a braid.

坐在对面的陈世龙，含笑凝视，显得异常得意。
Seated opposite, Chen watched with a delighted smile.

阿珠原来就不大有小家碧玉的味道，
A’zhu had never looked particularly like a girl from a modest household.

这一戴上首饰，越觉她那张鹅蛋脸雍容华贵，
Adorned with jewellery, her oval face seemed still more gracious and distinguished.

绝不象摇船人家的女儿。
She did not look at all like a boatman's daughter.

在镜子里左顾右盼的阿珠，突然收敛了笑容，
Turning this way and that before the mirror, she suddenly stopped smiling.

慢慢摘下首饰，一件件放好。
Slowly, she removed the ornaments and put each away.

陈世龙倒有些奇怪了，
Chen was puzzled.

不憧她这意兴阑珊的表情，从何而来？
What had made her lose interest?


“你……”他很吃力地说，
“You...” he began awkwardly.

“好象有点不大高兴。”
“You don't seem very happy.”

“不是不高兴，
“It's not that I'm unhappy.

有些可惜。”
It's a pity, that's all.”

“ 什么可惜？”陈世龙急急说道，
“What's a pity?” he asked anxiously.

“难道象你这样的人，还不配戴这些东西？
“Surely you don't think a woman like you is unworthy of wearing such things?”

““不是这话！
“That isn't what I mean.

‘好女不穿嫁时衣’，
‘A capable woman doesn't keep wearing the clothes she married in.’

这些首饰，可惜不是你买给我的。”
It's a pity you didn't buy these for me.”

这句话让陈世龙震动了！
Her words struck him deeply.

心里千周百折，一遍遍在想，要如何争气，才对得起她？
His thoughts turned over and over: how could he prove himself worthy of her?

这样愣了半天，终于逼出几句答复：
After remaining lost in thought for some time, he finally forced out an answer.

“你有志气，我也有志气！
“You have ambition, and so do I.

不过，你如果不肯跟着我吃几年苦，将来想替你办这样子的首饰，是做不到的事。
But unless you're willing to share a few years of hardship with me, I shan't be able to buy you jewellery like this one day.”

““你当我吃不来苦？”阿珠答一声，
“Do you think I can't bear hardship?

“你看着好了！”
Wait and see!”

“我相信，我相信。”
“I believe you.”

陈世龙笑道，
Chen smiled.

“说实在的，我哪里肯让你吃苦？
“In truth, how could I bear to make you suffer?

照现在的样子，生意十分顺手，日子会过得很舒服。
As things are, the business is going very smoothly, and we should live comfortably.

这都是胡先生的提拔！
We owe it all to Mr Hu's help.”

““为人总不好忘本。”
“We must never forget how we began.”

阿珠终于说了一句心里的话：
At last A’zhu voiced a heartfelt thought.

“我们总要先把他的生意，处处顾到，
“Our first duty is to look after every part of his business.

才对得起人家。”
Only then shall we deserve what he's done for us.”

夜深人静，
The night was late and still.

即令是他们低声交谈，睡在铺上的胡雪岩，依然隐约可闻，
Even though they spoke quietly, Hu could just hear them from his berth.

他觉得这件事做得极好，
He felt that he had managed this affair extremely well.

不但欣慰，而且得意，于是心无挂碍，怡然入梦。
Pleased with the result and proud of himself, he fell peacefully asleep, his mind free of care.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十五章（中）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Fifteen, middle part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


* * *一到杭州，胡雪岩回家坐得一坐，立刻便到阜康，
On reaching Hangzhou, Hu Xueyan stopped briefly at home, then went straight to Fukang.

陈世龙已押了行李先在那里等候。
Chen Shilong had already brought the luggage there and was waiting.

行李虽多，尽是些送人的礼物，
There was a great deal of it, but everything was a present for someone.

由刘庆生帮着料理，一份份分配停当，派了一个“出店”陪着陈世龙一家家去分送。
With Liu Qingsheng's help, the gifts were sorted, and one of the bank's errand clerks was sent with Chen to deliver them from house to house.

胡雪岩则趁此刻工夫，听取刘庆生的报告。
Hu used the interval to hear Liu's report.

“胡先生，请你先看帐。”刘庆生捧着一叠帐簿，很郑重地说。
“Mr Hu, please examine the accounts first,” Liu said gravely, bringing a pile of ledgers.

“不忙，不忙！
“No hurry, no hurry.

你先跟我说说大概情形。”
Give me a general account first.”

“请你看了帐再说。”
“Please look at the books before we talk.”

听他如此坚持，料知帐傅中就可以看出生意好坏，
His insistence suggested that the books themselves would show how business had gone.

于是他点点头先看存款。
Hu nodded and began with the deposits.

一看不由得诧异了，
What he saw astonished him.

存户中颇多“张得标”、“李德胜”、“王占魁”、“赵虎臣”之类的名字，存银自几百到上万不等，
There were many names such as Zhang Debiao, Li Desheng, Wang Zhankui, and Zhao Huchen, with sums ranging from a few hundred to more than ten thousand taels.

而名下什九注着这么四个小字，“长期无息。”
Nine out of ten entries bore the brief annotation: “Long-term; no interest.”

“唷，唷！”胡雪岩大为惊异，
“Well, well!” Hu exclaimed.

“阜康真的要发财了！
“Fukang really is going to prosper!

怎么会有这么多的户头？”
How did we acquire so many accounts?”

“胡先生！”刘庆生矜持着说：“你再看这一笔帐。”
With restrained pride, Liu said, “Please look at this entry too.”

他翻到的一笔帐是支出，上面写着：“八月二十五日付罗尚德名下本银一万一千两。
He turned to a payment: “Twenty-fifth day of the eighth month: paid out eleven thousand taels, principal standing in Luo Shangde's name.

息免。”
Interest waived.”

“喔，
“Oh!

原来罗尚德的那笔款子，提回去了？”
So Luo has withdrawn his deposit?”

“不是！”
“No.

刘庆生说，“罗尚德阵亡了，
Luo Shangde was killed in action.

银子等于是我送还的。
In effect, I returned the money.

我不知道这件事做得对不对……”
I don't know whether I did the right thing...”


刘庆生细谈这件事的经过，
Liu explained what had happened.

是八月二十五那天，有两个军官到阜康来问，说是听闻罗尚德曾有一笔款子存在阜康，可有其事？
On the twenty-fifth of the eighth month, two officers had come to ask whether it was true that Luo had deposited money at Fukang.

又说罗尚德已经阵亡，但他在四川还有亲属，
They said he had been killed in action but still had relatives in Sichuan.

如果有这笔款子，要提出来寄回去。
If the deposit existed, they wished to withdraw it and send it home.

罗尚德的存折在刘庆生手里，
Luo's passbook was in Liu's keeping.

倘或否认其事，别无人证。
Had he denied the account's existence, there would have been no other witness.

但他不肯这样做，
But he refused to act that way.

一口承认，同时立即取出存折，验明银数，
He acknowledged it at once, produced the passbook, and verified the amount.

但他表示，不能凭他们两个人的片面之词就付这笔存款。
He made clear, however, that he could not pay out the deposit on the two men's unsupported statement.

“那么该怎么办呢？”
“What should we do, then?”

“我知道罗老爷跟抚台衙门的刘二爷是朋友，
“I know that Mr Luo was a friend of Mr Liu Er at the governor's office.

要刘二爷跟你们营官一起出面，出条子给阜廉。”刘庆生说：
Mr Liu Er and your commanding officer must jointly give Fukang written authorisation,” Liu replied.

“只要罗老爷是真的阵亡，你们各位肯担责任，阜康立刻照付。
“Provided Luo really has been killed in action and you gentlemen accept responsibility, Fukang will pay immediately.”

“于是那两个军官，当天便我了刘二爷来，公同具了领条，
The two officers brought Liu Er that same day, and a joint receipt was signed.

刘庆生立即捧出一万一千两银子，还要算利息，人家自然不肯再要。
Liu immediately produced eleven thousand taels and offered to calculate the interest as well, but they naturally refused anything more.

这样到了第二天，张得标、李德胜等等，便都上门来了。
The following day, Zhang Debiao, Li Desheng, and the others began coming to the bank.


胡雪岩听他讲完，异常满意，
Hu was exceedingly pleased by the story.

“庆生，”他说，“阜康的牌子打响了！
“Qingsheng, Fukang's reputation is made!

你做得高明之极。
You handled it brilliantly.”

““老实说，”刘庆生自己也觉得很安慰，“我是从胡先生你这里学来的窍门。
“To be honest,” Liu said, feeling much comforted himself, “I learned the method from you.

做生意诚实不欺，只要自己一颗心把得定就可以了，
To deal honestly, one need only hold firm to one's principles.

诚实不欺要叫主顾晓得，到处去讲，那得要花点心思，
But to make customers know of that honesty and speak of it everywhere requires some thought.

我总算灵机一动，把机会抓住了。”
I had a sudden idea and managed to seize the opportunity.”

“对！
“Exactly.

做生意把握机会，是第一等的学问。
Seizing opportunities is the highest art in business.

你能够做到这一点，我非常高兴。
I'm delighted that you can do it.

庆生，我现在帮手不够，
Qingsheng, I haven't enough assistants.

你还是替我享管点事，
You must take more off my hands.

以后钱庄的生意都归你。”胡雪岩说：
From now on, the bank's business is all yours to manage.

“我一切不管，都归你调度。”
I shall leave everything to your direction.”

“这……”刘庆生兴奋之余，反有恐惧不胜之感，
Alongside his excitement, Liu felt overwhelming apprehension.

“这副扭子我怕挑不下。”
“I'm afraid I may not be able to carry such a burden.”

“不要紧！
“Don't worry.

你只要多用心思，凡事想停当了去做，
Put more thought into things and work them out before acting.

就冒点风险也不要紧。
A little risk doesn't matter.

不冒风险的生意，人人会做，
Everyone can do business that involves no risk.

如问能够比头？
How could that put you ahead?

只要值得，你尽管放手去做。“
As long as it's worthwhile, go ahead boldly.”


“这话就很难说了，
“That's difficult to judge.

怎么叫值得，怎么叫不值得？
What counts as worthwhile and what doesn't?

各人看法不同。”
People see things differently.”

“人生在世，不为利，就为名。
“In life, people seek either profit or a good name.

做生意也是一样，
Business is the same.

冒险值得不值得，就看你两佯当中能不能占一样？”
Whether a risk is worth taking depends on whether you can gain one of the two.”

胡雪岩停了一下指着帐簿说，
Hu paused and pointed to the ledger.

“譬如这笔放款，
“Take this loan.

我知道此人是个米商，借了钱去做生意，
I know the borrower is a rice merchant, using the money for trade.

你就要弄弄清楚，他的米是运到什么地方？
You must establish where he's sending his rice.

运到不曾失守的地方，不要紧，
If it's going somewhere that hasn't fallen, that's all right.

运到长毛那里，这笔放款就不能做！
If it's going to the Longhairs, you mustn't lend.

为啥呢，
Why?

万一这笔帐放倒了，外面说起来是：哪个要你去帮长毛？
If the loan goes bad, people will say, ‘Who asked you to help the Longhairs?

倒帐活该！
You deserved to lose your money.’

这一来名利两失，
You lose both profit and reputation.

自然犯不着冒险。”
Naturally, that risk isn't worth taking.”

“我懂了！”刘庆生深深点头，
Liu nodded firmly. “I understand.

“凡事总要有个退步。
There must always be a way to fall back.

即使出了事，也能够在台面上说得过去。”
Even if something goes wrong, we must be able to justify ourselves openly.”

“对啊！庆生，”
“Exactly, Qingsheng!”

胡雪岩拍着他的肩说，
Hu patted his shoulder.

“你完全懂了！
“You understand completely.

我们的生意，不管是啥，都是这个宗旨，万一失手，有话好说。
Whatever business we do, that is our principle: if we fail, we must have an explanation.

这样子，别人能够原谅你，就还有从头来起的机会，
If others can forgive us, we still have a chance to begin again.

虽败不倒！”“虽败不倒！”刘庆生把这句话在心里念了好几遍，颇有领悟。
Defeated, but not destroyed!” Liu repeated the phrase inwardly several times and grasped much from it.

接着便谈了些业务扩充的计划，
They then discussed plans for expanding the business.

胡雪岩因为自己在杭州只有几天耽搁，一拖便无结果，
Since Hu could remain in Hangzhou only a few days, delay might leave matters unsettled.

所以或可或否，当时便要作出决定。
He therefore gave an immediate decision, yes or no, on each proposal.


正在从长计议时，只听有人一路喊了进来：“二弟，二弟！”
In the midst of their deliberations, someone came in calling, “Second Brother! Second Brother!”

听这称呼便知是嵇鹤龄，
The form of address could belong only to Ji Heling.

胡雪岩急忙迎了出去，
Hu hurried out to greet him.

只见他红光满面，梳一条又黑又亮的辫子，
His face glowed, and his queue was black and glossy.

身上穿一件极挺括的紫酱色线春夹袍，外面套一件黑缎“巴图鲁”坎肩，平肩一排珊瑚套扣，
He wore a crisp, lined robe of purplish-brown xianchun cloth beneath a black satin baturu waistcoat, with a row of coral fastening buttons level with the shoulders.

卷着袖子，露出雪白纺绸的袖头，
His rolled sleeves revealed snowy-white silk cuffs.

左手盘一对核桃，右手拿昔支湘妃竹镶翠的短烟袋，
In his left hand he turned a pair of walnuts; in his right he held a short pipe of spotted bamboo mounted with jade.

十足一副纨袴公子的打扮，
He looked every inch the fashionable young gentleman.

以前的那副不修边幅的名士派头，连影子都找不到了。
Not a trace remained of his former careless scholar's appearance.

“大哥！”胡雪岩笑道：
“Elder Brother!” Hu laughed.

“你年轻了十几岁，
“You look more than ten years younger.

差点都认不得了。”
I hardly recognised you.”

“都是瑞云啊！”
“It's all Ruiyun!”

嵇鹤龄有着掩抑不往的喜色，
Ji could not suppress his delight.

“打扮了几个孩子，还要打扮我。
“After dressing up the children, she insists on dressing me up too.

不作无益之事，何以遣有生之涯？
If we never did anything useless, how would we pass our allotted years?

这且不去说它。
But never mind that.

我是奉命来邀客，
I've been ordered to invite you.

瑞云叫我来说，晚上为你接风，
Ruiyun says we're to give you a welcome-home dinner tonight.

没有什么菜吃，但一定要到。”
There won't be much to eat, but you must come.”

“一定到。
“Certainly.

只是时候不会太早。”
Only I may not be very early.”

“你是要先去记雪公？”嵇鹤龄说，
“You mean to call on Mr Xuexuan first?

“那就不必了。
There's no need.

我已约了雪公，
I've invited him too.

他到舍间来会你，吃完饭，你们一起走好了。”
He'll meet you at my house, and you can leave together after dinner.”

“那好，
“Excellent.

省了我多少事。”
That saves me a great deal of trouble.”

胡雪岩笑着问道，
Hu smiled.

“瑞姑娘怎么样？”
“How is Miss Rui?”

“那是尽在不言中了。
“That goes without saying.

总而言之一句话，承情不尽。”
In a word, I'm endlessly grateful.”


“新城的案子，雪公已经写信告诉我了，说得语焉不详，
“Mr Xuexuan wrote to tell me about the Xincheng affair, but without much detail.

我在上海记挂得很。”
I've been concerned about it in Shanghai.

Has an arrangement been made for you?” Hu asked.

“是的，
“Yes.

我正要跟你详细谈。”
I was just going to tell you all about it.”

嵇鹤龄略一踌躇，
Ji hesitated.

接着又说，“话太长，
“But it's a long story.

一说开头，就无法收场了。
Once I begin, there'll be no end.

这样吧，我还要去办点事，
Let's do this: I still have an errand to run.

瑞云要我去买儿盆菊花，
Ruiyun wants me to buy a few pots of chrysanthemums.

我把轿子留在这里，回头你坐了来。
I'll leave my chair here for you to come in later.

最好早些到，雪公未来之前，我们先可以好好谈一谈。”
Try to arrive early, so that we can talk properly before Mr Xuexuan comes.”

看他春风满面，服饰华丽，此时又知道养了“轿班”，可知情况很不坏，
Seeing his cheerful expression and fine clothes, and now discovering that he maintained his own chair-bearers, Hu could tell that matters were going reasonably well.

胡雪岩先忧放心了，点点头答应，尽快赴约。
Reassured, he nodded and promised to come as soon as possible.

在阜康把几件紧要的事处置完毕，胡雪岩坐了轿子径到嵇家。
After dealing with several urgent matters at Fukang, he took the chair straight to Ji's house.

嵇鹤龄也刚回来不久，正穿着短衣在指挥花匠陈设菊花，
Ji had only recently returned and was wearing short working clothes while directing a gardener in arranging the chrysanthemums.

一见他来，便说一声：“你到里面坐，
“Go inside and sit down,” he said on seeing Hu.

我洗了手就来。”
“I'll wash my hands and join you.”

这时张贵已来肃客，看见胡雪岩异常恭敬，也格外亲热，
Zhang Gui came to receive the guest, exceptionally respectful and warmly attentive.

一面伛偻着身子引路，一面殷殷问讯，直接领到后厅，迎面遇着瑞云。
Bowing as he led the way and inquiring after Hu's well-being, he took him directly to the rear hall, where they met Ruiyun.


“二老爷！”因为胡雪岩与嵇鹤龄拜了把子，所以她这样含笑称呼，
“Second Master!” she said with a smile, using the title because Hu and Ji were sworn brothers.

略一凝视，接着又说，“清瘦了些，
After studying him briefly, she added, “You've grown a little thinner.

想来路上辛苦了！
The journey must have been tiring.

不过精神气色都还是老样子。”
But your spirits and complexion are just the same.”

“你象是发福了。”
“You seem to have filled out.”

胡雪岩笑着问，
Hu smiled.

“日子过得还称心吧！”
“Are you happy with life here?”

“托二老爷的福。”瑞云向里喊道：“荷官，领了弟弟、妹妹来见二叔！”
“Thanks to you, Second Master.” She called inside, “Heguan, bring your younger brothers and sisters to greet Second Uncle!”

“噢！”里面娇滴滴地答应一声，
“Yes!” came a sweet voice.

只见丹荷领头，带着一群小家伙，
Danhe led the little troop out.

摇摇摆摆走了来，一个个都穿得很干净，等丹荷一站定，便也都站住了。
They toddled forward in clean clothes and stopped as soon as she did.

“叫啊！二叔。”瑞云看着丹荷说。
“Greet him—Second Uncle,” Ruiyun told her.

于是丹荷先叫，她叫过了再叫弟、妹们叫。
Danhe spoke first, then instructed the others to follow.

胡雪岩一看这情形，对瑞云佩服得不得了。
Seeing this, Hu admired Ruiyun enormously.

她是用的“擒贼擒王”的手段，
She had followed the principle of catching the bandits' chief first.

不知怎么一来，把最调皮的丹荷笼络得服服帖帖！那一群小家伙便也都安分了。
Somehow, she had won over the most mischievous child, Danhe, so completely that the rest had settled down too.

“老大呢？”他问。
“Where's the eldest?” he asked.

“我送他‘附馆’去了。”嵇鹤龄进门接口，
“I've sent him to join another household's school,” Ji answered as he entered.

两个小的立刻便都扑了过去。
The two youngest immediately rushed to him.

胡雪岩心里着实羡慕嵇鹤龄，自然也深感安慰，
Hu truly envied Ji, and felt deeply comforted as well.

拉着丹荷的手问长问短，好半天不放。
He took Danhe's hand, asked her all manner of questions, and did not let go for a long time.

“好了好了！”瑞云大声说道，
“Enough, enough!” Ruiyun said loudly.

“都跟着二姐到里头去，
“Follow your second sister inside.

不要来烦你们二叔！”
Don't bother Second Uncle.”


遣走了孩子们，瑞云也告个便回到厨下。
After sending the children away, Ruiyun excused herself and returned to the kitchen.

于是嵇鹤龄跟胡雪岩谈起别后的光景。
Ji then described what had happened since they parted.

新城之行，先抚后剿的宗旨定得不错，
The policy for Xincheng—conciliation first, force afterwards if needed—had been correct.

当地士绅对嵇鹤龄革枪匹马，深入危城，都佩服他的胆气，也了解他的诚意，
The local gentry admired his courage in going alone into the endangered county town and recognised his sincerity.

因此都愿意跟他合作，设法把为首的“ 强盗和尚”意心，引诱到县自首。
They willingly cooperated, finding a way to persuade the leader, the “bandit monk” Huixin, to come to the county office and surrender.

蛇无头而不行，乌合之众，一下子散得光光。
A snake cannot move without its head: the disorganised followers scattered completely.

前后不过费了半个月的工夫。
The whole affair had taken no more than half a month.

功成回来，王有龄自然敬礼有加，万分亲热，私人先送了五百两银子，作为谢礼。
When Ji returned successful, Wang naturally treated him with special respect and warmth, offering him five hundred taels from his own purse in gratitude.

嵇鹤龄不肯收，王有龄则非送不可，
Ji refused, and Wang insisted.

“到后来简直要吵架了。”他说，
“In the end, we almost quarrelled,” Ji said.

“我想你跟他的交情不同，我跟你又是弟兄，
“Then I thought of your close friendship with him and our own brotherhood.

就看在这一层间接的渊源上，收了下来。”
On the strength of that indirect connection, I accepted.”

“你真是取与舍之间，一丝不苟。”胡雪岩点点头说，
Hu nodded. “You are scrupulous indeed about what to accept and what to decline.

“用他几个也不要紧。
There's no harm in using a little of his money.

这且不去说他，
But leave that aside.

你补缺的事呢？
What about a substantive appointment?

雪公说过，补实缺的事，包在他身上。
Mr Xuexuan said he would take responsibility for securing you a permanent post.

现在怎么样了？“
Where does that stand now?”


“这件事说起来，有点气人，”
“It's rather exasperating.”

嵇鹤龄急忙又加了一句：“不过，雪公对我是没有什么好说的，
Ji hastened to add, “Though I have nothing to complain of in Mr Xuexuan.

他保我署理归安县，黄抚台不肯，
He recommended me as acting magistrate of Gui'an, but Governor Huang refused.

又保我接海运局，他也不肯，说等‘保案’下来再说。”
Then he proposed that I take over the Sea Transport Bureau, and Huang refused that too, saying we must wait for the decision on the recommendations for reward.”

地方上一件大案子，或则兵剿，或则河工，或则如漕运由何运改为海运等等大事曲张的案子，办妥出奏，照例可以为出力人员请奖，
When a major local undertaking—suppressing disorder, repairing waterways, or changing grain transport from the canal to the sea—had been completed and reported to the throne, it was customary to recommend rewards for those who had contributed.

称为“保案”，保有“明保”、“密保”之分，
Such recommendations might be public or confidential.

自然是密保值钱。
Naturally, the confidential kind was more valuable.

“黄抚台给了我一个明保，反是雪公倒是密保……”
“Governor Huang has put me forward publicly, whereas Mr Xuexuan has received a confidential recommendation...”

“这太不公平了。”胡雪岩打断他的话说：
“That's most unfair,” Hu interrupted.

“莫非其中有鬼？”
“Could there be something underhand behind it?”

“嗨！”
“Ah!”

嵇鹤龄一拍大腿，
Ji slapped his thigh.

“真正机灵不过你！
“Nobody is sharper than you.

黄抚台手下一个文案委员，要我两千银子，
One of the governor's clerical commissioners asked me for two thousand taels.

我也不知道这两千银子是他自己，还是他替黄抚台要？
I don't know whether he wants it for himself or on Huang's behalf.

反正别说我拿不出，就拿得出来，也不能塞这个狗洞。
In any case, even if I had the money—which I don't—I wouldn't pour it down that dog's hole.”

““那么，雪公怎么说呢？”
“What does Mr Xuexuan say?”

“雪公根本不知道。
“He knows nothing of it.

我没有告诉他。”
I haven't told him.

嵇鹤龄说，“我跟他说了，他一定为我出这两千银子。
If I did, he'd certainly pay the two thousand for me.

我何必再欠他一个人情？”
Why should I put myself under yet another obligation to him?”


官场中象他这样耿介的人，已经不多了，
There were few men of such unbending integrity left in official life.

胡雪岩不由得肃然起敬。
Hu felt a deep respect for him.

但他可以这么想：自己应该跟王有龄说清楚，
Yet although Ji might take that view, Hu himself ought to explain matters to Wang.

无论如何要把海运局的差使拿下来，哪怕“塞狗洞”也只好塞了再说。
They must secure the Sea Transport Bureau post somehow, even if the money had to be poured down the dog's hole after all.

“大哥！”他说：“这件事你不必管了，
“Elder Brother, leave this alone,” he said.

雪公必有个交代，
“Mr Xuexuan will have an answer.

等我来跟他说。”
Let me speak to him.”

“其实也不必强求。”
“There's really no need to force matters.”

嵇鹤龄摇摇头，
Ji shook his head.

“官场中的炎凉世态，我真看厌了。
“I'm tired of the changing warmth and coldness of official society.

象我现在这样也很舒服，
I'm quite comfortable as I am.

等把那五百两银子花光了再说。
We can think again when the five hundred taels are spent.

反正世界上决没有饿死人的。”
Surely nobody need starve in this world.”

“你真正是名士派。”胡雪岩笑道，
“A true scholar's spirit!” Hu laughed.

“不是我说句大话，象你这样的日子，我也还供给得起，

不过你一定不肯，我也不愿意让你闲下来不做事。
But you certainly wouldn't agree, and I wouldn't want you idle either.

人生在世，不是日子过得舒服，就可以心满意足的。”
A comfortable life is not enough to satisfy a man.”

“一点不错。”嵇鹤龄深深点头，
Ji nodded deeply. “Exactly.

“我自然也有我的打算，
I have plans of my own, of course.

如果浙江混不下去，我想回湖北去办团练。”
If I can't make my way in Zhejiang, I mean to return to Hubei and organise local militia.”

“那不必！
“There's no need.

我们在浙江着实有一番市面好做，
We have ample scope here in Zhejiang.

等雪公来了，大家好好谈一谈。”
When Mr Xuexuan comes, we'll discuss it properly.”


说到曹操，曹操就到，
As the saying went, speak of Cao Cao and Cao Cao arrives.

因为已成熟客，
Wang was now a familiar visitor.

刚听得张贵来报：“王大老爷到！”王有龄已经迸门，一面走，一面在喊：“雪岩，雪岩！”
Zhang Gui had barely announced him before he came through the door, calling as he walked, “Xueyan! Xueyan!”

“雪公！”
“Mr Xuexuan!”

胡雪岩迎了出去，拱拱手招呼。
Hu went to meet him and greeted him with clasped hands.

“我天天在盼你。
“I've been waiting for you every day.

等你一来，我就有回湖州的日子了。”
Now you're here, I can finally fix a day to return to Huzhou.”

“老爷！”是瑞云在喊，她仍旧用他在家的称呼，
“Master!” Ruiyun called, still using the form of address she had used in Wang's household.

“请里面坐，
“Please come inside.

就吃酒吧！
Let's have dinner.

只怕胡老爷也饿了。”
Mr Hu must be hungry too.”

“好，好，
“Yes, yes!

吃酒，吃酒！”王有龄很高兴地说，
Let's eat and drink,” Wang replied happily.

“今天要痛痛快快吃几杯。”
“Today we must have a few good cups.”

于是延入后厅，只见已摆了一桌子的菜：
They went into the rear hall, where the table was already covered with dishes.

有瑞云的拿手菜红糟鸡，也有她别出心裁，将嵇鹤龄家乡口味的鱼杂豆腐和杭州菜的鱼头豆腐烩在一起的一品锅，烹制得浓腴非凡，
There was Ruiyun's speciality, chicken in red fermented-rice lees, and an ingenious rich hotpot combining fish offal and bean curd in the style of Ji's home region with Hangzhou's fish-head-and-bean-curd dish.

正宜于这西风落叶的黄昏食用。
It was just the thing for an evening of west wind and falling leaves.


“胡老爷送的洋酒。”
“This is the foreign liquor Mr Hu sent.”

瑞云拿着一瓶白兰地笑道，
Holding a bottle of brandy, Ruiyun smiled.

“我竟不知道怎么开法？”
“I don't even know how to open it.”

“我来，我来！”
“Give it to me.”

嵇鹤龄接过酒来，很自然把双手抚在她肩上说，
Ji took the bottle, then quite naturally laid both hands on her shoulders.

“喝这酒省事，
“This saves trouble.

不必烫。
It doesn't need warming.

你请到厨房里去吧！
Go back to the kitchen.

菜慢一点好了。
There's no hurry with the dishes.

回头你也来敬酒。
Come and drink a toast later.”

“他这样款款而言，一点都不觉得有什么不合适，瑞云却很不好意思，
He spoke with gentle affection, finding nothing improper in it, but Ruiyun was embarrassed.

微微窘笑着白了他一眼，然后低声埋怨：“你真罗嗦！”
With a shy smile and a reproachful glance, she murmured, “You do talk too much!”

王有龄向胡雪岩看了一眼，
Wang looked at Hu.

等瑞云的背影一失，忍不往哈哈大笑，
As soon as she disappeared, he burst out laughing.

“雪岩！”他说，“我现在才知道你的乐趣，
“Xueyan, now I understand your pleasure.

看天下有情人都成眷属，实在是件赏心乐事。”
To see all lovers united in marriage is a delightful thing indeed.”

“愿天下有情人终成眷属”，是西湖月老祠的对联，
The couplet at the Temple of the Old Man under the Moon by West Lake expressed the wish that all lovers should be united.

嵇鹤龄随即笑道：
Ji laughed.

“这一字改得好！
“An excellent change of one word—from wishing to seeing!

雪公有此襟怀，自然常乐。”
With that spirit, Mr Xuexuan, you will always find joy.”

都亏你们两位帮了我的大忙。
Both of you have helped me greatly.

今天先借花献佛，聊表寸心。
Today I'll borrow another's flowers to offer to the Buddha and express a little of my gratitude.”

“于是三个人先干了一杯。
The three emptied their cups.

白兰地不比绍兴酒，
Brandy was unlike Shaoxing wine.

嵇鹤龄喝得大猛了些，呛了嗓子，咳得面红脖子粗，
Ji drank too quickly, choked, and coughed until his face and neck were red.

连瑞云在厨房里都听到了，赶了出来一看，便一面问原因。一面替他捶背。
Hearing him from the kitchen, Ruiyun hurried out, asking what had happened while patting his back.

王、胡两人看在眼里又相视而笑了。
Wang and Hu exchanged another smile.


“你那位珠小姐呢？”王有龄问胡雪岩，
“And your Miss Zhu?” Wang asked Hu.

“现在是要看你的了！”
“Now it's your turn.”

“那也是件赏心乐事……”
“That too is something to be pleased about...”

“怎么？”王有龄很关切地抢着问，
“What?” Wang interrupted with concern.

“莫非好事不谐？”
“Has the match failed?”

“在阿珠仍旧是件好事，
“It's still a happy outcome for A’zhu.

这也不去谈她了。
But leave that aside.

倒是畹香，”胡雪岩说，“我在上海叫人去看过她，
As for Wanxiang, I sent someone to see her in Shanghai.

还住在梅家弄，不曾受到什么惊吓。
She's still in Meijia Lane and hasn't suffered any serious fright.

她有意思来玩一趟，
She'd like to come for a visit.

雪公，你看如何？”
What do you think?”

“看看再说吧！”
“We'll see later.”

王有龄的神色很冷淡，是不大愿意谈及此事的神情。
Wang's expression was cool; he plainly did not wish to discuss it.

嵇鹤龄本来想问畹香是何许人？看见他这样的神色，见机不言。
Ji had meant to ask who Wanxiang was, but took the hint and remained silent.

胡雪岩当然更不会再提，
Naturally, Hu did not pursue the matter either.

话题一扯，谈到他自己在上海的交游及生意。
He turned the conversation towards his own acquaintances and business in Shanghai.


此刻有两件事要谈，一件是代买的洋枪，一件是海运由浏河出口，交尤五驳运，
There were two matters to discuss: the foreign guns he had bought on Wang's behalf, and the plan for the sea-going grain shipments to leave by Liuhe, with You Laowu handling the lighterage.

后者又跟嵇鹤龄的出处有关，
The latter was connected with Ji's future employment.

胡雪岩灵机一动，认为可以当作嵇鹤哈的见解提出来，显得他在这方面也有过人的才干，
An idea came to Hu: he could present the proposal as Ji's own, demonstrating that he possessed exceptional ability in this field too.

因而决定先谈洋枪。
He therefore began with the guns.

“雪公！”他问，“湖州的团练怎么样了？”
“Mr Xuexuan, how is the Huzhou militia getting on?”

一问到此，王有龄大力兴奋，
The question delighted Wang.

“很好哇！
“Very well!

全省各地的团练，就数我湖州顺利。
Of all the militia organisations in the province, Huzhou's is proceeding most smoothly.

平心而论，都是赵景贤的功劳。”
To be fair, the credit belongs to Zhao Jingxian.”

他对嵇鹤龄说，
He turned to Ji.

“此人的才具，不逊干老兄。
“His abilities are no less than yours.

几时我介绍你跟他交个朋友。”
I must introduce you sometime.”

“我亦听说此君既贤且能，很想交这个朋友。
“I've heard that he is both worthy and capable, and have long wanted to know him.

若蒙雪公引见，真是快事！”
An introduction from you would be a great pleasure.”

说着，他陶然引杯，一仰脖子干了酒。
Contentedly, Ji raised his cup and drained it.


“雪公！”胡雪岩把话题拉丁回来，“我替你买了一批洋枪。”
“Mr Xuexuan,” Hu said, bringing the conversation back, “I've bought a consignment of foreign guns for you.”

他把整个经过说了一遍。
He described the whole transaction.

“我也要浮一大白！”
“Then I must drink a full cup too!”

王有龄极高兴地说，
Wang was delighted.

“雪岩你这件事，办得好极了！
“Xueyan, you've done splendidly.

前两天，抚台还跟我谈起，兵在精而不在多，又说欲善其事，先利其器。
Only the other day, the governor was telling me that troops must be good, not merely numerous, and that a man who means to do his work well must first sharpen his tools.

龚振麟父子，对造炮虽有经验，无奈不会造枪，
Gong Zhenlin and his son have experience in making cannon, but unfortunately they cannot make guns.

现在能够买到洋枪，对防务大有裨益。
Now that we can buy foreign guns, our defences will benefit enormously.

我明天就‘上院’去见抚台，筹个通盘的办法出来，
Tomorrow I'll call on the governor and work out a comprehensive arrangement.

洋枪多多益善。
The more foreign guns, the better.”

““那是以后的事。
“That's for later.

目前这批枪呢？”
What about this consignment?”

“这一批枪，当然是我们湖州买！
“Huzhou will buy it, naturally.

有了这批洋枪，将来的效用如何，且不去说它，起码眼前就可以激励团练的士气，关系甚重。”
Quite apart from what these guns may achieve in future, their immediate effect on the militia's morale will be important.

王有龄又说，“赵景贤知道了这个消息不知道会高兴成什么样子！”
I can hardly imagine how pleased Zhao Jingxian will be when he hears.”


“雪公！”嵇鹤龄插进来说，“既然湖州志在心得，事情就不是这么个做法。
“Mr Xuexuan,” Ji intervened, “if Huzhou is determined to obtain them, that isn't the way to proceed.

明天要防黄抚台截留这批枪，
You must guard against the governor keeping this consignment for himself.

还是暂时不说的好。”
Better say nothing for the moment.”

“那么到什么时候再说？”
“When should I tell him, then?”

“我看要用这么个步骤，”嵇鹤龄慢条斯理地答道，
“I suggest the following steps,” Ji answered deliberately.

“先跟藩司请一张洋枪的运照，
“First, obtain a transport permit for the foreign guns from the provincial treasurer.

接着了这批枪，送到湖州，
Then collect them and send them to Huzhou.

然后再跟黄抚台去说。
Only afterwards tell Governor Huang.

那时枪支已经发了下去，
By that time they'll have been distributed.

莫非黄抚台倒说，通通收了回来，给他的亲兵用？”
Surely he couldn't order every one called back for his own personal troops?”

“对，对！”王有龄说，
“Exactly, exactly!” Wang agreed.

“有你们两个人替我画策，真正是万元一失！
“With the two of you advising me, nothing can go wrong.

来，吃酒！“
Come, let's drink!”


一面喝酒，一面胡雪岩又谈买这批洋枪，还有拉拢英商，叫他们少跟洪杨打交道的好处。
Over their wine, Hu explained another advantage of buying the guns: it would draw the British merchants towards them and make them less inclined to deal with the Taiping leaders Hong and Yang.

嵇鹤龄在一旁默默地听着，心里便在为胡雪岩想着，
Ji listened silently, thinking of Hu's interests.

等他们谈话告一段落，使用提醒的语气说：
When the conversation paused, he offered a reminder.

“雪岩，这批货色的价款如何算法，你要不要先跟雪公谈一谈？”
“Xueyan, shouldn't you discuss the price of this consignment with Mr Xuexuan?”

胡雪岩还不曾开口，王有龄矍然说道：
Before Hu could answer, Wang suddenly recalled something.

“提到这一层，我倒想起来了。
“That reminds me.

团练都是官督民办，
The militia is under official supervision but organised locally.

地方上自己筹了饷，自己保管。
The locality raises its own funds and keeps charge of them.

湖州富庶，地方上也热心，团练经费很充裕。
Huzhou is wealthy, its people are enthusiastic, and the militia has ample money.

我本来想跟赵景贤说，叫他把公款存在阜康，又怕碰个软钉子，面子上下不来，所以一直不曾开口。
I had meant to ask Zhao Jingxian to deposit the public funds at Fukang, but feared a polite refusal that would embarrass me, so I never raised it.

现在好了，有了这批洋枪，是个很好的‘药引子’，
Now these guns will be just the catalyst we need.

赵景贤一定很见你的情，我就容易说话了。
Zhao will be grateful to you, and I can speak easily.

至于这一批货色的价款，说多少是多少，
As for the price, whatever you say will be accepted.

回扣当然是你的。
The rebate is yours, naturally.”

“胡雪岩此刻最感困难的，第一是人手不足，第二是头寸调不转。
Hu's greatest difficulties were a shortage of assistants and insufficient ready funds.

有了湖州团练的大笔经费存进来，如鱼得水，再妙不过。
A large deposit from the Huzhou militia would be like water to a fish: nothing could be better.

有了大生意，他就不肯贪小利了，
With substantial business in prospect, he would not chase a small profit.

“不！”他说，
“No,” he said.

“我的事需要做得漂亮。
“I want this done handsomely.

回扣或者归公，或者归景贤手下的人去分，
Let the rebate go into the public funds or be divided among Jingxian's staff.

我完全当差。”
I'll perform the service for nothing.”

“白当差也不必。”王有龄说，
“There's no need to work for nothing,” Wang replied.

“这件事你不必管了，
“Leave this to me.

我来跟赵景贤说。”
I'll speak to Zhao Jingxian.”



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十五章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Fifteen, concluding part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


要谈的两件事谈妥了一桩，
One of the two matters had been settled.

另一桩得要从嵇鹤龄身上谈起，
The other had to begin with Ji Heling.

“雪公！”他开门见山地问：“鹤龄的事怎么了？”
“Mr Xuexuan,” Hu asked directly, “what has happened about Heling?”

一提到这话，王有龄把已送到唇边的酒杯又放下，意兴阑珊地先叹了口气。
Wang lowered the glass he had almost raised to his lips and sighed dispiritedly.

“为这件事，我睡觉都不安枕。”王有龄说，
“It has been keeping me awake at night.

“我也正要等你商量。
I was waiting to discuss it with you.

抚台不知打的什么主意？
I don’t know what the governor intends.

迹近过河拆桥，
It looks very much as though he means to destroy the bridge after crossing the river.

叫我怎么对得起鹤龄兄？”
How can I face Brother Heling?”

于是他把几次为嵇鹤龄的事，跟黄宗汉去谈的经过，说了一遍，
He described his successive approaches to Huang Zonghan.

先是请求，没有确实答复，便改做保荐，
He had first made a request; when no definite answer came, he had submitted a recommendation.

保荐依旧不得要领，就只好力争，
That too had achieved nothing, so he had argued the case forcefully.

无奈至今争不出名堂来。
Still there had been no result.

“雪岩！”王有龄说到最后，又要请教他了，“你料事比别人来得准，
“Xueyan, you judge these things more accurately than anyone.

倒看看，是何道理？”
What do you make of it?”

“ ‘无鬼不死人’！”胡雪岩很坦率地说，
“There is no death without a ghost at work,” Hu said bluntly.

“其中必定有鬼。”
“There must be something underhand behind this.”

“我也想到了这一层。”
“I thought so too.

王有龄答道，“问过文案上的人，说要不要有所点缀？
I asked the men handling the correspondence whether some little inducement was needed.

文案上的人，回话很诚恳，说这件事全看抚台的意思，
They answered quite sincerely that everything depended on the governor.

他们此刻还不敢受好处，怕受了好处，事情办不成，对不起人。
They did not dare accept anything yet, for fear of taking a favor and then failing to accomplish the business.

等将来嵇某人的委札下来，自然少不得要讨他一杯喜酒吃。
Once Mr Ji’s appointment order was issued, of course, they would expect him to treat them to a celebratory drink.

雪岩，你听，这话不是说到头了吗？”
Xueyan, surely that says all there is to say?”


王、嵇两个人两样的活，摆到胡雪岩心里一辨味道，立刻就懂了。
Comparing Wang’s account with Ji’s, Hu understood at once.

两千银子是黄宗汉要，却又不肯叫王有龄出，
The two thousand taels were wanted by Huang Zonghan, who was unwilling to have Wang supply them.

所以才有这样的话，
That explained these answers.

如果是文案上要钱，管你这银子姓王姓嵇，只要成色足就行了！
If the money were merely for the correspondence staff, why would they care whether it belonged to Wang or Ji, so long as the silver was good?

懂是懂了，却不肯说破。
Hu understood, but would not reveal it.

说破了，王有龄即或花了钱，仍旧会觉得替嵇鹤龄不曾尽到心而感疚歉，
If he did, Wang would still feel guilty that he had failed to do enough for Ji, even if he paid.

在嵇鹤龄则既有那样不愿花钱买官做的表示，说破了更会成僵局。
And Ji, having declared that he would not buy an office, might bring the whole affair to an impasse.

于是他笑笑说道：
Hu therefore smiled.

“他们闹鬼，
“Let them play their ghostly tricks.

我就是专捉这路鬼的‘茅山道士’。
I am a Maoshan Taoist who specializes in catching such ghosts.

且看我的手段！
Just watch me!”

““那么，你预备如何‘捉鬼’？”王有龄问。
“And how do you intend to catch them?” Wang asked.

“天机不可泄漏。”
“Heaven’s secrets must not be disclosed.”

胡雪岩拿手一指嵇鹤龄，
Hu pointed to Ji.

“雪公，鹤龄给我的信上，谈到漕米海运，由浏河出口，
“Mr Xuexuan, in his letter Heling mentioned that the tribute rice would go out to sea through Liuhe.

因为小刀会起事，怕出乱子，出了个主意你看行不行？”
Because the Small Swords uprising might cause trouble, he suggested a plan. See what you think of it.”

听得这话，嵇鹤龄大为诧异，
Ji was astonished.

自己何尝出过什么主意？
When had he suggested any plan?

正要开口，发觉有人轻轻踢了他一脚，
He was about to speak when someone gave him a light kick.

这自然是胡雪岩递过来的暗号，嵇鹤龄便不作声了。
Recognizing Hu’s signal, he remained silent.


“什么主意？”王有龄极注意地问，
“What plan?” Wang asked attentively.

“上头正为这件事在担心，我也很头痛，
“Our superiors are worrying about it, and it is giving me a headache too.

派兵护漕，原是公事，谁知百端需索，
Escorting tribute grain is a public duty, yet the troops make demands at every turn.

绿营兵真正都该裁撤！”
The whole Green Standard Army ought to be abolished!”

“那好！这个主意用得着了。”胡雪岩不慌不忙他说道，
“Then this suggestion will be useful,” Hu said calmly.

“鹤龄晓得我跟尤五的交情，也晓得尤五的手面，
“Heling knows my friendship with You Laowu and the extent of You’s influence.

出的主意就是包给尤王驳运。
His idea is to contract the transshipment to You.

你看如何？”
What do you think?”

王有龄思索了一下，拍案称赏：
Wang considered, then struck the table in approval.

“这个主意想绝了！
“A splendid idea!

尤五是松江漕帮，说起来便宜不落外方，
You belongs to the Songjiang grain-transport brotherhood, so the benefit would not go to outsiders.

哪方面都交代得过。
It can be justified on every side.

鹤龄兄，你真正才气纵横。
Brother Heling, you truly have remarkable talent.

这样吧，请你今天就做个说帖，我明天上院面递。
Please draw up a memorandum today, and I’ll present it to the governor in person tomorrow.

如果抚台再有罗嗦，那就真正是出了鬼了！”
If he still raises objections, there really must be a ghost at work!”

“是，是！”嵇鹤龄答应是在答应，
“Certainly, certainly,” Ji replied.

不免有些面红耳热，只是借酒盖脸，一时看不出来。
His face and ears grew hot, though the wine concealed his embarrassment.

“甚好，甚好！”
“Excellent!”

王有龄举杯说道，
Wang raised his glass.

“白兰地我也喝过几回，似乎都不如今天的来得香，来得醇。”
“I have drunk brandy several times, but none seemed as fragrant or mellow as this.”

“ ‘与周公谨交，如饮醇醪’！”嵇鹤龄引了句《三国志》上的话，
“‘Friendship with Zhou Gongjin is like drinking mellow wine,’” Ji quoted from the Records of the Three Kingdoms.

端杯向王有龄一举，眼却看着胡雪岩。
He raised his glass toward Wang, but his eyes rested on Hu.

干了这一杯，王有龄说：“酒差不多了。
After they drank, Wang said, “That is enough wine.

鹤龄兄今晚上还要写说帖，
Brother Heling still has his memorandum to write tonight.

明天晚上到我那里再喝个痛快！”
Come to my house tomorrow evening, and we’ll enjoy a proper drink.”


话刚完，只听瑞云一面掀帘子走了出来，一面笑道：
As he finished, Ruiyun lifted the curtain and came out smiling.

“我还没有敬胡老爷、敬老爷呢？”
“But I haven’t yet offered a toast to Master Hu or to you, sir.”

“敬胡老爷应该，谢媒！”
“You certainly ought to toast Master Hu—to thank your matchmaker!”

瑞云原有这意思，让王有龄一说破，便不好办了，
That had indeed been her intention, but Wang’s saying it aloud made things difficult.

一手执壶、一手持杯，僵在那里有些手足无措，
With the wine pot in one hand and a cup in the other, she stood awkwardly at a loss.

幸好，这不过眨眨眼的工夫，因为嵇鹤龄很机警地替她解了围。
It lasted only a moment before Ji came cleverly to her rescue.

“还是应该先敬雪公！”他接过壶来说，
“Mr Xuexuan should be toasted first,” he said, taking the pot.

“雪岩跟我弟兄，
“Xueyan and I are brothers.

那是自己人。”
He is one of the family.”

“糟了！”王有龄笑道，
“How unfortunate!” Wang laughed.

“你们都是自己人，只剩下一个我是外人。”
“You are all family, and I’m the only outsider.”

“老爷也不要这么说，”
“You mustn’t say that, sir.”

瑞云窘意消失。依然很会应酬了，
Ruiyun recovered her composure and her skill in social conversation.

“胡老爷跟格老爷都没有拿老爷当外人看。”
“Neither Master Hu nor Master Ji regards you as an outsider.”

“对了！”
“Exactly!”

有了几分酒意的王有龄，词锋特别锐利，
A little wine had sharpened Wang’s wit.

“女心外向，
“A woman’s heart turns toward her husband.

倒是你拿我当外人看了。”
It is you who regard me as an outsider.”

“我不敢！”
“I would never dare.”

虽是戏言，瑞云却当作正经话回答，
Though he was joking, she answered seriously.

“我在老爷家十几年，
“I spent more than ten years in your household.

不敢忘记者爷、太太待我的好处。”
I could never forget your kindness and your wife’s.”

说到这样的话，王有龄就是借酒盖脸，也不好意思跟她再说笑话，
Even with wine as an excuse, Wang could hardly continue teasing after that.

规规矩矩受了她一杯酒。
He accepted her toast with proper courtesy.

接着，瑞云又敬了胡雪岩，放下杯子要走，他喊住了她，要她也敬嵇鹤龄。
She then toasted Hu and put down the cup to leave, but Hu stopped her and insisted she toast Ji as well.

这时候的瑞云可大方不起来了！
Now she could not remain at ease.

但越是不肯，胡雪岩越闹得厉害，把几个小把戏都招引了来，在门帘后面遮遮掩掩地看热闹，
The more she demurred, the more Hu teased, until several children gathered behind the curtain to peep at the fun.

特别是最调皮的丹荷，格格地笑个不住。
Danhe, the most mischievous, giggled incessantly.

嵇鹤龄借着去叱斥儿女的机会，算是替瑞云又解了围。
By turning to scold his children, Ji gave Ruiyun another opportunity to escape.


饭罢回到书房里去喝茶，又谈正经。
After dinner they returned to the study for tea and resumed their business.

王有龄问起胡雪岩说：“驳运一节，你跟尤五谈过没有？”
“Have you discussed the transshipment with You?” Wang asked Hu.

“谈是谈过，没有定局。
“We have discussed it, but nothing is settled.

因为不知道你的意思究竟如何？”
I did not know your wishes.”

“其实你就作了主也一样。”王有龄问：
“You might just as well have decided yourself.

“尤五怎么说？”
What does You say?”

“尤五还不是一句话！
“One word is enough with him.

费用好商量，不过要浙江给他们江苏督粮道一件公事。”
The cost can be negotiated; he only needs an official communication from Zhejiang to the Jiangsu grain transport circuit intendant.”

“公事现成！
“The document is easily arranged.

哪怕就是给汪苏许抚台，也不费什么事。
Even a letter to Governor Xu of Jiangsu would be no trouble.

倒是费用一层，还要有个大概数目，才好筹划。”
But we need an approximate figure for the expense before we can plan.”

“我想，”胡雪岩说，“总比请派绿营兵保护，要便宜得多。”
“I imagine it will be much cheaper than having Green Standard troops provide an escort.”

“ 那行！”
“Then that will do.”

王有龄很仔细的想了想道说：
Wang considered carefully.

“只要尤五真的能够保险，这件事就太妙了！”
“If You can truly guarantee its safety, this is an excellent arrangement.”

胡雪岩听出他的意思，是有些不放心尤五，
Hu heard the uncertainty about You.

但许多话亦不便跟他说，譬如尤五跟周立春的交情之类。
There were many things he could not conveniently explain, such as You’s friendship with Zhou Lichun.

不过既然王有龄有这话，而且又扯上嵇鹤龄，算是他的“条陈”，那么一出纸漏，于他们两个人的前程，都有妨碍，不能不重新考虑。
Yet Wang’s concern, and the fact that the proposal was now being attributed to Ji, made reconsideration necessary. If something went wrong, it would jeopardize both men’s careers.

“事情是有七分把握，不过‘不怕一万，只怕万一’，我想，”胡雪岩看着嵇鹤龄说，
“I am reasonably confident, but we must guard against the one chance in ten thousand,” Hu said, looking at Ji.

“条陈里写活动些，让黄抚台去作主。”
“Perhaps the memorial should leave some room for maneuver and let Governor Huang decide.”

“不行，不行！”
“No, no!”

王有龄摇着手说，
Wang waved his hand.

“他不肯担责任的。”
“He will not take the responsibility.”


这一下，事情变得就要重新再谈，
The whole matter seemed to require fresh discussion.

胡雪岩因为责任太重、总觉得很难有万全之计，
Hu felt the responsibility was too heavy for any plan to be entirely secure.

方在沉思之际，嵇鹤龄开了口。
While he was pondering, Ji spoke.

“此事要盘马弯弓，有一番做作。”嵇鹤龄说：
“We must first circle the horse and bend the bow—prepare the ground before acting.

“现在防务吃紧，各地方都要增添兵力，
Defense is pressing everywhere, and every locality needs more troops.

原有的兵勇尚不敷用，
The existing forces are already insufficient.

何能再抽人护送漕米？”
How could men be spared to escort the tribute rice?”

“啊，啊！”王有龄恍然大悟，
“Ah!” Wang exclaimed.

“我懂了。”
“I understand.”

“我也懂了。”胡雪岩说，
“So do I,” Hu said.

“不过这话，最好不由雪公来说。”
“But it would be better if those words did not come from you, Mr Xuexuan.”

“你是说由绿营自己来说？”
“You mean the Green Standard officers should say it themselves?”

王有龄摇摇头，
Wang shook his head.

“他们不肯说的，
“They won’t.

这是趟好差使，又舒服，又有出息，
It is a comfortable and profitable assignment.

何乐不为？”
Why would they refuse?”

“舒服却未见得，
“Not necessarily comfortable.

真的遇见小刀会，开起仗来，绿营不是他们的敌手。”
If they really encounter the Small Swords forces and have to fight, they will be no match for them.”

“无奈他们不这么想。我也不能这么说。”
“Unfortunately, they do not think so, and I cannot say it.

王有龄下了个决定：“准定由我面见抚台，相机行事。”
I’ll see the governor myself and act as circumstances require.”

“那么，”胡雪岩问道，“条陈呢？”
“What about the memorandum?”

“条陈还是今夜把它拟好，
“Have it drafted tonight all the same.

我带了去，
I’ll take it with me.

宁可备而不用，不可要用而未备。”
Better to have it ready and not need it than need it and not have it.”

“既如此，我连夜赶起来。”
“Then I’ll finish it tonight,” Ji said.

嵇鹤龄慢了一下说，“我想把雪岩留下来，一起商量，斟酌尽善。
After a pause, he added, “I should like Xueyan to stay so that we can discuss it and make it as sound as possible.

雪公看如何？”
What do you think?”

“也好！”
“Very well.”

王有龄看着胡雪岩说：
Wang looked at Hu.

“我们就明天上午碰头好了。”
“We shall meet tomorrow morning, then.”


这样说停当了，王有龄告辞回家。
With that agreed, Wang took his leave.

胡雪岩和嵇鹤龄也就毫无耽搁，立即动手，
Hu and Ji began immediately.

一个条理清楚，一个笔下来得，
One arranged the arguments clearly; the other wrote fluently.

不费什么事就已把草稿拟好，重新斟酌一遍，作成定稿，随手誊清，由胡雪岩带走。
They soon produced a draft, reconsidered it, settled the final wording and made a fair copy for Hu to take away.

第二天上午王有龄不出门，专诚在家等候胡雪岩。
The next morning Wang stayed home especially to await Hu.

一到便在书房里闭门密谈，
As soon as he arrived, they shut themselves in the study.

自从新城之乱平服，王有龄愈得黄宗汉的信任，
Since the Xincheng disturbances had been put down, Wang had gained still more of Huang’s confidence.

因而妒忌他的人也不少，办事不免多掣时的人，
That also meant more jealous rivals and more obstruction.

为此他有许多苦恼，要向胡雪岩倾吐。
He had many troubles to pour out to Hu.

“雪岩，”他说，“我现在有件大事，要跟你商量。
“Xueyan, there is an important matter I want to discuss.

听说黄抚台有调动的消息，
I hear that Governor Huang may be transferred.

如果他一走，来接他的人不知怎么样。
If he leaves, who knows what his successor will be like?

所以我颇有急流勇退之想。”
I am strongly tempted to withdraw while things are going well.”

一听这话，胡雪岩大吃一惊，急急说道：
Hu was greatly alarmed.

“雪公你怎么起了这么个念头？
“Mr Xuexuan, why should you think of that?

局面刚刚摆开，正搞得顺手，
We have only just built things up, and everything is running smoothly.

为啥要打退堂鼓。
Why retreat now?”

““一则我怕后任一来，如果彼此不甚对劲，我许多经手的事，收拾起来就会有罗嗦，
“First, if the new man and I do not get on, winding up the affairs I have handled could become troublesome.

趁黄抚台在这里，办交卸比较容易，
It would be easier to hand them over while Governor Huang is here.

二则江忠源由湖北臬司调升安徽巡抚，
Second, Jiang Zhongyuan has been promoted from judicial commissioner of Hubei to governor of Anhui.

他跟我有旧，来信问我，愿意不愿意到安徽去？
We are old acquaintances, and he has written to ask whether I would join him there.

他跟曾国藩两个，现在圣眷甚隆，
He and Zeng Guofan are both enjoying great imperial favor.

我想到他那里去也不错。”
Going to him might be a good move.”

“不然！”
“I disagree!”

胡雪岩大为摇头，
Hu shook his head vigorously.

“安徽地方你不熟悉，我也不熟悉。
“You do not know Anhui, and neither do I.

而且说句老实话，你到安徽，我不会去的，因为我去了也帮不了你的忙！”
To speak plainly, if you go there, I shall not go with you, because I could do nothing to help you there.”

“好！”
“Very well.”

王有龄点点头，
Wang nodded.

“你说到这话，我不必再多说，
“Since you put it that way, there is no more to say.

今天就写信，回谢江忠源的好意。”
I will write today to decline Jiang’s kind invitation.”


听他这样表示，胡雪岩自然感到安慰了，然而也不免觉得责任愈重，
Hu was naturally reassured, but felt his responsibility grow heavier.

想了想说：“黄抚台调动的消息，确不确？”
After reflecting, he asked, “Is the report of Governor Huang’s transfer reliable?”

“有此一说，不可不防。”
“There is such a rumor, and we must be prepared.

王有龄又说，“现在浙江各地，都有土匪滋事的情形，
Besides, disturbances by bandits are occurring throughout Zhejiang.

星星之火，可以燎原，
A spark can set the prairie ablaze.

黄抚台对这方面非常认真。
The governor takes the matter very seriously.

因为新城的案子办得不错，所以这些差使，以后怕都会落在我头上。
Because the Xincheng affair was handled well, I fear all these assignments will fall to me in future.

海运局的事又不能不拖在那里，
Meanwhile I cannot get free of the Sea Transport Bureau.

实在有点心余力绌。”
I really am beginning to lack the strength for everything.”

这就见得嵇鹤龄的事，格外重要。
This made Ji’s appointment all the more important.

说实话，王有龄比嵇鹤龄本人还急，但他在黄宗汉面前，却是有力使不上，
In truth, Wang was more anxious about it than Ji himself, but he could not exert his full influence with Huang.

因为论功行赏，王有龄走错了一着棋，或者说，这一着棋，他没有去走，
In allocating the rewards for Xincheng, Wang had made a wrong move—or rather, failed to make a move at all.

在黄宗汉，对新城一案的酬佣，是早就分配好了的，王有龄和嵇鹤龄两人，给一个密保，一个明保，
Huang had decided from the outset that Wang and Ji would receive one confidential recommendation and one open recommendation between them.

谁密谁明，他没有意见。
He had no preference as to which man received which.

当初出奏的时候，如果王有龄说一句：“嵇鹤龄出的力多，请抚台赏他一个密保。”黄宗汉也会照办。
Had Wang said when the report went forward, “Ji Heling did more of the work; please favor him with the confidential recommendation,” Huang would have agreed.

就因为少了这一句话，把自己搞成了密保，
Because Wang had failed to say this, the confidential recommendation had gone to him.

如果这时候，再力荐嵇鹤龄，仿佛投机取巧，他怕黄宗汉心里不高兴，
To press Ji’s claims again now might look opportunistic, and he feared displeasing Huang.

因而始终不敢多说。
That was why he had never dared say too much.

这一层苦衷，甚至在胡雪岩面前，都难启齿。
He could hardly confess this difficulty even to Hu.

而时间隔得愈久，那种近似“冒功”的疚歉愈深，
As time passed, his sense of guilt, almost as though he had appropriated another man’s merit, deepened.

渴望着胡雪岩能出个主意，把这件事，早早办成。
He longed for Hu to devise a way to settle the appointment quickly.

“照现在看，恐怕还不是三天两天的事。”王有龄说，
“As things stand,” Wang continued, “it will probably take more than a day or two.

“先要谈防务，让黄抚台晓得抽不出兵，
I must first discuss defense and make the governor see that no troops can be spared.

然后就让他自己来问，可还有别的好办法？
Then I must wait for him to ask whether there is another way.

那时我才能把鹤龄的条陈拿出来。
Only then can I produce Heling’s memorandum.

你想想，这是多绕弯子的事？”
Think how many turns we have to take!”


胡雪岩同意他的说法，
Hu agreed.

重新把前因后果考虑了一遍，发觉自己错了！
Reviewing the causes and consequences once more, he realized that he had been mistaken.

错在想为嵇鹤龄“显显本事”，
He had wanted Ji to display his abilities.

其实，那个条陈对嵇鹤龄能不能接海运局差使的关系不大。
But the memorandum had little bearing on whether Ji could take over the Sea Transport Bureau.

关系还在丈案那里。
The decisive point still lay with the correspondence office.

“人到猪头烂，钱到公事办”！
A pig’s head cooks when the fire is brought to it; official business proceeds when the money arrives.

怎么连这两句话都想不起？
How had he forgotten such familiar sayings?

于是他说：“雪公，我请你缓一缓，
“Mr Xuexuan, please wait a little.

快则明天，迟则后天，再去见黄抚台。”
See the governor tomorrow at the earliest, or the day after at the latest.”

“怎么呢？”
“Why?

王有龄问，“你又有什么安排？”
What are you arranging now?”

“还是那句话。”
“The same answer as before.”

胡雪岩笑道：
Hu smiled.

“天机不可泄漏。”
“Heaven’s secrets must not be disclosed.”

“好吧！
“Very well.

我也不问了，
I won’t ask.

听你的招呼好了。”
I’ll wait for your word.”

于是彼此又谈了些在上海、在杭州的情形，
They went on to talk about events in Shanghai and Hangzhou.

话太多一时说不尽，加上王太太又出来很应酬一番，谈起瑞云，越发说个没有完。
There was too much to finish at once, especially when Mrs Wang came out to entertain their guest and the subject turned to Ruiyun.

胡雪岩也索性丢开正事，聊了些闲天，
Hu put business aside for a while and joined in the conversation.

在王家吃了午饭，告辞出门，一直来到阜康替嵇鹤龄办事。
He stayed for lunch, then went straight to Fukang to attend to Ji’s affairs.


他就用本号的银票，开了两张，一张两千，一张两百，
Using his own bank’s notes, he made out two: one for two thousand taels and one for two hundred.

用个封套封好，上写“匪仪”二字，下面具名是“教愚弟嵇鹤龄”。
He sealed them in an envelope, inscribed it “A humble gift,” and signed beneath, “Your humble junior, Ji Heling.”

“庆生！拜托你走一趟，
“Qingsheng, I must ask you to make a visit.

托刘二爷代为递到文案上的陈老爷。
Have Master Liu Er pass this to Master Chen in the correspondence office.

说我还有几天忙，杂务稍为定一定，请他过来叙一叙。”
Say that I shall be busy for a few more days, but once these miscellaneous affairs are settled, I should like him to come over for a talk.”

“好的。”
“Very well.

刘庆生又问：“要不要回片？”
Should I ask for a card acknowledging receipt?”

“不必了。”
“No.

胡雪岩说，“他给你就带了回来，
If he gives you one, bring it back.

不给也不必要，
If not, there is no need to request it.

反正心到神知。”
The intention will be understood.”

刘庆生办事极快，
Liu Qingsheng was quick.

不过一个时辰，就已回店，带来抚署文案委员陈老爷的一张名片，
Within a double-hour he returned with a visiting card from Master Chen, a correspondence officer at the governor’s office.

上面有四个字：“拜领谢谢！”
On it were four characters: “Gratefully received, with thanks.”

于是胡雪岩当夜就通知王有龄，说可以去见抚台谈这件事了。
That night Hu notified Wang that he could now see the governor about the matter.

王有龄不知道他葫芦里卖的什么药？反正照他的话做决不会错，
Wang had no idea what Hu had done, but was sure that following his advice would not lead him astray.

因而下一天衣冠整肃地到了抚台衙门。
The following day he dressed formally and went to the governor’s office.

手本递了进去，刘二回出来说：
After his calling document was taken in, Liu Er returned.

“上头交代，上半天客多，
“His Excellency says he has many visitors this morning.

准定请王大爷下半天三点钟来。”
He asks that you come at three this afternoon.”

凡是上宪专约时刻会商，皆是格外看重的表示，意思是要抽出一段时间，可以从容细谈。
When a superior set aside a specific time for consultation, it was a sign of special regard: he meant to allow an unhurried discussion.

王有龄听得这话，便打道回府，到了下午再来。
Wang therefore went home and returned in the afternoon.


黄宗汉在巡抚衙门后花园的“船厅”接见，
Huang received him in the Boat Hall in the rear garden of the governor’s residence.

一到叫先换了便衣，接着便邀王有龄一起吃点心，千层糕、燕皮汤、地力糕，甜咸俱备，冷热皆有，都是他们八闽的家乡口味。
He first asked Wang to change into informal clothes, then invited him to share refreshments: layered cake, yanpi soup, water-chestnut cakes, sweet and savory dishes, hot and cold—all flavors of their native Fujian.

一面吃，一面谈，先谈时局，
As they ate, they discussed the situation.

说向荣的江南大营，每月耗饷甚巨，
Huang began with Xiang Rong’s Jiangnan Grand Camp, which consumed enormous sums every month.

公文急如星火，催索不已，
Its official demands for money arrived with the urgency of a fire alarm and never ceased.

是件很伤脑筋的事。
It was a severe headache.

“这也不该浙江一省出。”王有龄表示意见，
“Zhejiang should not have to provide everything,” Wang offered.

“需索无底，难以为继，
“The demands are endless and cannot be sustained.

大人似乎可以跟向帅商量，是不是通盘筹划，
Might you discuss an overall arrangement with Commander Xiang?

由江苏、江西、浙江三省，每月确定额数，到期报解？
Jiangsu, Jiangxi and Zhejiang could each be assigned a fixed monthly sum, to be remitted when due.

这样子，大家筹措起来也比较容易。”
That would make it easier for everyone to raise the funds.”

“你这个主意不错，
“A good suggestion.

我可以试一试。”黄宗汉又说，
I can try it,” Huang said.

“你湖州这方面，关系甚重，
“Your work in Huzhou is particularly important.

通省的饷源，主要的就靠你那里。
The province depends chiefly on that district for military funds.

我看，海运局你真有点兼顾不到了！”
I think the Sea Transport Bureau is indeed more than you can also manage.”


王有龄心里有些嘀咕，
Wang grew uneasy.

听这意思，抚台夹袋中似乎有人，
From this remark, it sounded as though the governor already had someone in mind.

倘或此时就提了出来，一个上司，一个下属，直来直往，中间没有缓冲的余地，嵇鹤龄岂不是就落空了？
If he named the man now, with superior and subordinate face to face and no room for an intermediary, would Ji not lose his chance?

这还在其次，如果换一个人来，立刻就得办移交，
Worse still, another man’s arrival would require an immediate handover.

海运局的亏空，除非能找一笔钱来补上，否则就会原形毕露，
Unless money could be found to cover the deficit at the Sea Transport Bureau, the shortage would be exposed.

那怎么得了？
That would be disastrous.

一想到此，额上便见了汗。
Sweat appeared on Wang’s forehead.

黄宗汉不知就里，随即说道：“十月小阳春，天气太热。
Unaware of the cause, Huang said, “This little spring in the tenth month is very warm.

你请升冠吧！”
Please remove your hat.”

升冠就是脱帽，是不礼貌的，
To do so in a superior’s presence was discourteous.

王有龄拿块手巾擦擦汗说：
Wang wiped his brow with a handkerchief.

“不要紧，不要紧！”
“It’s quite all right.”

这是小事，黄宗汉也不再多说，又谈公事：
Huang did not insist over a small matter and returned to business.

“那个姓嵇的，我看倒有点才气。”
“That fellow Ji seems to have some ability.”

听得这一句，王有龄顿觉心头一宽，耳目清凉，赶紧答道：
At these words Wang felt his heart lighten and his senses clear.

“大人目光如炬，
“Your Excellency has a discerning eye.

凡是真才，都逃不过大人的耳目。”
No true talent can escape your notice.”

这一声恭维，相当得体，黄宗汉瘦刮刮的脸上有了笑容，
The compliment was well judged, and Huang’s lean face broke into a smile.

“让他接你的海运局。”他用征询的语气说：
“Let him take over your work at the Sea Transport Bureau,” he said as though seeking advice.

“你看怎么样？”
“What do you think?”

“那是再适当不过。”
“Nothing could be more suitable.

王有龄乘此机会答道：“嵇鹤龄此人，论才具是一等一，
Ji Heling’s ability is of the first order.

有人说他脾气太傲，也不见得。
Some call him too proud, but I do not entirely agree.

有才气的人，总不免恃才傲物，不过所傲者，是不如他的人。
Talented men may be proud of their gifts, yet their scorn is directed at those inferior to themselves.

其实他也是颇懂好歹的，
He understands very well how he ought to behave.

大人能够重用他，我敢写包票，他一定会感恩图报，让大人称心如意。”
If Your Excellency gives him an important appointment, I guarantee that he will repay the favor and give you complete satisfaction.”

最后一句话，意在言外，不尽关乎公事妥帖。
The last words implied more than competent public service.

黄宗汉其实也不需他“写包票”，胡雪岩那张阜康的银票，比王有龄的“包票”更来得有力。
Huang did not really need Wang’s guarantee: Hu’s Fukang banknote carried greater force.

所以他点点头说：
He nodded.

“我知道！
“I know.

你就回去准备交卸吧！”
Go back and prepare to hand over.”


“是！”
“Yes, sir!”

王有龄站起身来请了一安：
Wang rose and made a formal obeisance.

“大人容我暂息仔肩，真是体恤我。”
“Your Excellency’s allowing me some relief from my burden is a great kindness.”

“不敢当，
“Not at all.

快请起来。”
Please rise.”

黄宗汉也站起来，虚抉一扶。
Huang stood too and made a gesture of assistance.

这一站起来，不再坐下，便是等待送客的表示。
Remaining on his feet signaled that he was ready to see his visitor out.

“我就告辞了。”王有龄敲钉转脸地加了一句：
“I shall take my leave,” Wang said, adding a final sentence to make the matter firm.

“我回去就将大人这番栽培的德意，告诉秩某人，叫他实心报效。”
“I will tell Mr Ji at once of Your Excellency’s gracious encouragement and ask him to serve you wholeheartedly.”

“可以，你就告诉他好了。
“You may tell him.

我马上叫人下委札。”
I will have the appointment order issued immediately.”


于是王有龄告辞回家，第一件事就是派人去请胡雪岩和嵇鹤龄。
Wang’s first act on returning home was to send for Hu and Ji.

自然是胡雪岩先到，
Naturally, Hu arrived first.

因为阜康离王家不远，而他是早就关照了王家门上的，有事到阜康招呼，所以一请就到。
Fukang was nearby, and he had already told Wang’s gate attendants to look for him there whenever needed.

“佩服，佩服！”王有龄翘看大拇指说，
“Wonderful, wonderful!” Wang said, raising his thumb.

“雪岩，你具何神通，料事如此之准？”
“Xueyan, what miraculous powers do you possess, to judge events so exactly?”

接着，他把会见黄宗汉的经过，细说了一遍。
He recounted the interview in detail.

胡雪岩也不曾料到事情是这样子的顺利，因而也有喜出望外之感，
Hu had not expected such smooth success either and was delighted.

想了想问道：“那么，条陈是怎么说法？”
After a moment he asked, “What happened about the memorandum?”

“条陈不曾上。”
“I did not present it.

王有龄答道，“一拿出来，倒显得早有成算似地。
Producing it would have made us seem to have planned everything beforehand.

大人物分两种，
There are two kinds of great men.

一种喜欢先意承志，事事先替他想到，
One likes others to anticipate his wishes and think everything through for him.

一种是喜欢用不测之威，不愿意别人知道他的心思，
The other likes to exercise an unpredictable authority and does not want anyone to know his mind.

黄抚台就是这一类人。
Governor Huang is the second kind.

我觉得等鹤龄接了事，或者谢委的时候，当面请求比较好。”
I thought it better for Heling to make the request himself after taking office, or when he goes to thank the governor for the appointment.”

“事情要快，
“It must be done quickly.

就让他谢委的时候请求吧！”
Let him raise it when he gives thanks.

胡雪岩又问，“运枪的公事……”
And the papers for transporting the guns?”

“啊！把这件事给忘记掉了。”王有龄说，
“Ah, I forgot about those.

“不要紧，我写封信就行了。”
Never mind—a letter from me will do.”

刚把信写完，嵇鹤龄到了。
He had just finished writing when Ji arrived.

王、胡二人一见他先道贺，然后略说缘由，
Wang and Hu congratulated him and briefly explained what had happened.

嵇鹤龄有点摸不清首尾，不知道是谁的力量使然？唯有向他们两个人都道了谢。
Ji could not quite grasp the sequence or tell whose influence had brought it about, so he thanked them both.

这时王家的男女佣仆也都来磕头道喜，
The male and female servants of the Wang household came to kowtow and offer congratulations.

嵇鹤龄正带着一张三十两银子的银票在身上，很大方地发了“总赏”，
Ji happened to have a thirty-tael note with him and generously gave it as a reward to be shared among them.

还有人说要给瑞云道贺，又说她福气好！
Some said Ruiyun should be congratulated too and praised her good fortune.

尤其是待嫁的两名丫头，眼看瑞三“飞上枝头作风凰”，
The two maids awaiting marriage were particularly envious of her rise from a lowly perch to the station of a phoenix.

艳羡之意，溢于词色。
Their admiration showed in every word and expression.

这就不但是嵇鹤龄，连胡雪岩也觉得很得意。
Hu felt almost as pleased as Ji himself.

这样喜气洋洋地乱过一阵，王有龄便说：“鹤龄兄，你请回去吧！
After this happy bustle, Wang said, “Brother Heling, you had better go home.

说不定已有送喜信的人到府上去了。
Messengers with congratulations may already be there.

雪岩帮着一起去招呼招呼，
Xueyan, go with him and help attend to matters.

我们晚上再谈。”
We will talk again tonight.”


叫胡雪岩去招呼，是招呼成赏，
By helping attend to matters, Wang meant seeing to the customary rewards.

这方面的“行情”他不大熟悉，少不得先要向王有龄问清楚了，
Hu did not know the going rates very well, so he first asked Wang for details.

然后顺道往阜康交代了几句话，才一起回到嵇家。
Then he stopped at Fukang to leave instructions before accompanying Ji home.

“二弟！”嵇鹤龄在轿子里把事情想通了，一到家率直问道：“可是你走了门路？”
“Second Brother,” Ji said directly when they arrived, having thought it through in the sedan chair, “did you work through someone?”

因为嵇鹤龄说过不愿买官做的话，所以胡雪岩的回答很含蓄：
Because Ji had declared that he would not buy an office, Hu answered discreetly.

“也不过托人去说过一声。”
“I merely asked someone to put in a word.”

“怎么说法？”
“What sort of word?”

“无非拜托而已。”
“Only a request for help.”

嵇鹤龄静静地想了想说：
Ji reflected in silence.

“我也不多问了，
“I won’t ask further.

反正我心里知道就是！”
I understand in my heart.”

正说到这里，刘庆生也到了嵇家，他是奉了胡雪岩的指示，送东西来的，一千两银票、五百两现银，另外一扣存折，上面还有三千五百两。
Just then Liu Qingsheng arrived, carrying what Hu had instructed him to bring: a thousand-tael banknote, five hundred taels in silver, and a passbook showing another three thousand five hundred.

“二弟！”嵇鹤龄把存折托在手里说，“我觉得沉重得很，
Holding the passbook, Ji said, “Second Brother, this weighs heavily on me.

真有点不胜负荷。”
I can scarcely bear it.”

这是说欠他的情太多了，怕还不清，
He meant that he owed more kindness than he feared he could repay.

“自己弟兄，
“We are brothers.

何必说这话？”胡雪岩答值：
Why say such things?” Hu replied.

“而且水帮船，船帮水，
“Water helps the boat, and the boat helps the water.

以后仰仗大哥的事还多。”
There will be plenty of occasions when I must depend on you.”

“这用不着说，
“That goes without saying.

你的事就是我的事。
Your business is mine.

海运局的内幕，我还不大清楚，
I do not yet know the inner workings of the Sea Transport Bureau.

要你帮我的忙，才能顶得下来。“
I shall need your help to manage it.”


刚谈到这里，只见听差引进一位客来，是抚台衙门的一名戈什哈，
Their conversation was interrupted by a servant showing in a visitor, a goshha from the governor’s office.

这是满洲话“侍奉”的意思，转用为护卫的名称，到了后来，凡是督抚左右跑腿的差官，叫做“戈什哈”，
The Manchu word originally meant attendance or service, then came to denote a guard; later it was used for the officers who ran errands for governors and governors-general.

此人戴着个金顶子，也是个八品官儿，
This man wore a gold hat finial and held the eighth rank.

但遇见候补州县七品官的嵇鹤龄，不敢以官自居，
But before Ji, an expectant magistrate of the seventh rank, he dared not stand on his own official status.

抢上来请两个安，一面口称，
He hurried forward and made two formal salutations.

“恭喜嵇大老爷！”
“Congratulations, Master Ji!”

这自是报喜信的，
He had plainly come with the good news.

嵇鹤龄连称：“不敢当！”扶起来请教：“贵姓？”
Ji modestly disclaimed the honor, helped him up and asked his surname.

“不敢！敝姓朱。
“My unworthy surname is Zhu.

抚台派我在文案上当差，
The governor assigned me to the correspondence office.

文案陈老爷特别派来跟嵇大老爷报喜。”
Master Chen sent me especially to congratulate you.”
