说着，从“护书”中，取出来一封盖着紫泥大印的委札，双手捧向嵇鹤龄。
From his document case he produced an appointment order bearing a large purple seal and offered it with both hands.

委扎不曾封口，
The envelope was unsealed.

取出来一看，不错，是接王有龄“海运局坐办”。
Ji took out the order and read it: he was indeed to succeed Wang as executive director of the Sea Transport Bureau.

嵇鹤龄顺手交了给胡雪岩，转脸向姓朱的说一声：
He passed it to Hu and turned back to Zhu.

“劳你的驾，
“Thank you for your trouble.

请坐了说话！”
Please sit down.”

“不敢！”姓朱的说：
“I would not presume.

“陈老爷交代，说先跟嵇大老爷道喜，晚上再来拜会，
Master Chen asked me to congratulate you first and to say that he will call this evening.

又交代：抚台今天身子不大爽快，
He also said the governor is not feeling quite well today.

嵇老爷今天不必谢宴，等到明天上院好了。”
You need not go to thank him for the appointment until tomorrow.”

“好，好！
“Very well.

费心你转达陈老爷，多承他关照，心感万分。
Please tell Master Chen how deeply grateful I am for his attention.

准定我今天晚上到他府上去拜访。”
I shall certainly visit his residence this evening.”

“是，”
“Yes, sir.

姓朱的又说：“请嵇大老爷赏个名片，我好回去交差。”
May I have your visiting card to report completion of my errand?”


这是早准备好的，一张名帖，一封二十两银子的红包。
This had already been prepared: a visiting card and a red envelope containing twenty taels.

刚打发了姓朱的，只见瑞云走了出来，穿一件紫缎夹袄，系一条雪青绸裙，一朵红花，
As soon as Zhu had been sent off, Ruiyun appeared in a lined purple satin jacket and a pale violet silk skirt, with a red flower in her hair.

盈盈笑道：“嵇老爷我来道喜！”
Smiling, she said, “Master Ji, I have come to congratulate you.”

“怎样！”
“What is this?”

嵇鹤龄有些意外，也有些手足无措似地，
Ji was surprised and a little flustered.

“你也来这一套，
“Must you observe these formalities too?

何必！免了，
There is no need.

免了。”
Please don’t.”

“应该的。
“It is only proper.

嵇老爷大喜！”
My warmest congratulations, Master Ji.”

说着，她手抉左腰裣在为礼，随后又喊：“荷官，带了弟弟、妹妹来替爹爹磕头。”
Resting a hand at her left waist, she made a formal curtsy, then called, “Danhe, bring your brothers and sisters to kowtow to your father.”

于是丹荷领头，一群小把戏，推推拉拉地都从门边出现，
Danhe led the children out from behind the door, pushing and jostling.

显然是瑞云早就安排好的，
Ruiyun had clearly arranged it all beforehand.

一个个都象过年的样子，穿得整整齐齐的衣服，在一长条毡条上，七跌八撞地，一面磕头，一面笑着。
Dressed as neatly as for New Year, they stumbled onto a long felt mat, laughing as they bowed.

嵇鹤龄扶住这个，抱住那个，嘴里还要应付调皮的丹荷“讨赏”，
Ji helped one up and gathered another into his arms, while trying to answer mischievous Danhe’s demands for a reward.

乱到十分，也热闹到了十分。
The confusion and merriment could hardly have been greater.

“瑞云！”嵇鹤龄等乱过一阵，这样说道：“实在要谢谢二老爷……”
When it subsided, Ji said, “Ruiyun, we really must thank Second Master.”

“是啊！”瑞云抢着按口，“不过倒不是谢谢二老爷，
“Yes,” she interjected, “but it isn’t merely thanks we owe him.

也是要跟二者爷道喜。”
We should congratulate him too.”

“同喜，同喜！
“Congratulations all round!

双喜临门，喜酒吃不完。”胡雪岩笑道，
Two joys at one door, and no end of celebratory wine!” Hu laughed.

“瑞云，都是你带来的运气。”
“Ruiyun, you brought all this good fortune.”

这句话说得瑞云心花怒放。
The compliment filled her with delight.

不自觉地就瞟了嵇鹤龄一眼，然后正一正脸色说道：
She could not help glancing at Ji, then composed her expression.

“这有好几天可以忙了。
“We shall be busy for several days.

马上就有道喜的人来，茶烟点心，都要早早预备，
Well-wishers will arrive soon, so tea, tobacco and refreshments must be prepared.

二老爷请宽坐，
Please make yourself comfortable, Second Master.

我不陪你了。”
I must leave you.”

说着又福了福，转身而去。
She curtsied again and withdrew.


大家妇女的派头，讲究稳重，行路无声，裙幅不动，才是福相，
The bearing of a woman from a great household required composure: a noiseless step and a skirt whose folds did not stir were considered signs of good fortune.

瑞云居然亦有这副风范，使得胡雪岩大感意外，
To Hu’s surprise, Ruiyun already possessed this manner.

大概婢学夫人，早就有心了，
She had probably long meant to emulate the mistress she had served.

于此见得她的志气，不由得赞了一声：“实在不错！”
Her ambition was evident, and he could not help exclaiming, “Very good indeed!”

嵇鹤龄也看到了瑞云那俨然命妇的派头，自然也很得意，
Ji too had noticed how completely she looked the part of an official’s lady, and was naturally pleased.

得意思往，想到两个月前与胡雪合初见的光景，
His thoughts wandered back to his first meeting with Hu two months before.

恍似梦寐，这是一个令人沉醉的春梦，而且一时不会醒，还有更妙的梦境在后面。
It seemed like a dream—an intoxicating spring dream from which he would not soon wake, with still more delightful scenes ahead.

无量欢喜竟化作浓重感慨，
His boundless happiness turned into deep reflection.

“提起来也真好笑！”他说，
“It is really rather amusing,” he said.

“记得我们第一天见面，我还埋怨你跟雪公做下圈套，令人拒之不可，受之不甘。
“On the day we first met, I complained that you and Mr Xuexuan had laid a trap: one I could neither refuse nor willingly accept.

谁知是这样的圈套，
Who would have thought it was a trap like this?

只怕再耿介的人，也要去钻一钻。
Even the most uncompromising man might want to walk into it.”

“提到这个回忆，胡雪岩更觉得意，
The memory made Hu still prouder.

从与王有龄认识以来，他出过许多奇奇怪怪的花样，而以“收服嵇鹤龄”最足以自豪，
Since meeting Wang, he had devised many unusual schemes, but none pleased him more than winning over Ji Heling.

因为第一，救了新城地方一场刀兵之灾，
First, it had saved Xincheng from the disaster of armed conflict.

其次，帮了王有龄一个大忙，
Second, it had greatly helped Wang.

复次，好人出出头，使得嵇鹤龄不致有怀才不遇之叹，
Third, it had allowed a worthy man to advance instead of lamenting that his talent went unrecognized.

第四，促成了一头良缘，
Fourth, it had brought about a happy match.

最后，自己交了一个亲如骨肉的好朋友。
Finally, Hu himself had gained a friend as close as flesh and blood.

一举而众善备，
One action had achieved so many good things.

自觉这个脑筋动得实在不坏。
He felt that his ingenuity had served him well.

于是他半开玩笑他说道：“我听你谈过，说汉高祖的陈平，出过多少条奇计，
Half joking, he said, “You once told me how many extraordinary schemes Chen Ping devised for Emperor Gaozu of Han.

我的奇计也很多，大小由之，
I have plenty of schemes too, for great matters and small.

大才大用，小才小用，
Great talents can be put to great use and lesser talents to lesser use.

只看对方自己怎么样。”
It all depends on the person concerned.”


“是的！嵇鹤龄说：”
“Indeed,” Ji replied.

你应该是诸侯的上客，
“You ought to be the honored adviser of a great lord.

象现在这样是委屈了。
Your present position does not do you justice.”

““那也不见得。
“Not necessarily.

事在人为！”
Things depend on human effort.”

胡雪岩跟嵇鹤龄交谈，话中不知不觉就有书卷气了，
Talking with Ji had unconsciously given Hu’s speech a literary flavor.

“俗语说得好，‘将相本无种，男儿当自强’，
“As the saying goes, generals and ministers are not born of a special breed; a man must strive for himself.

我现在虽不是诸侯的上客，帮人做到诸侯的位分，自然就是上客了。”
I may not be a great lord’s honored adviser now, but if I help someone rise to that position, I shall naturally become one.”

“这话说得好！
“Well said!

乱世本来是出人才的时候，
Troubled times bring talent forward.

征诸史书，历历可见。”
History gives us example after example.”

“书上怎么说，我不晓得。
“I don’t know what the books say.

不过，大哥，”胡雪岩的脸上，显出那种在他难得有的、古板正经的神色，“你说现在是出人才的时世，我相信！
But, Elder Brother,” Hu’s face took on a rare expression of sober seriousness, “I believe you when you say this is an age in which talent can rise.

乱世故事，不必讲资格例规，人才容易出头。
In troubled times, one need not be bound by seniority and established rules, so capable men have a better chance.

再有一层，
There is something else.

你到过上海，跟洋人打交道，就晓得了，洋人实在有洋人的长处，
If you go to Shanghai and deal with foreigners, you will see that they have real strengths.

不管你说他狡猾也好，寡情薄义也好，
Call them cunning if you like, or cold and lacking in loyalty.

有一点我们及人家不来，人家丁是丁、卯是卯，
In one respect we cannot match them: they distinguish clearly between right and wrong.

你说得对，他一定服你，自己会认错。
If you are right, they acknowledge it and admit their own mistake.

不象我们，明明晓得这件事锗了，不肯承认，仿佛认了错，就失掉了天朝大国的面子。
We may know perfectly well that we are wrong and still refuse to admit it, as though doing so would cost our great celestial empire its dignity.

象洋人那样，不会埋没你的好处，做事就有劲了，才气也容易发挥了。
When people recognize your merits as foreigners do, you have more energy for work and more chance to use your abilities.

凡是有才气的人，都是喜欢做事的，不一定为自己打算。
Talented people like to accomplish things; they are not necessarily thinking only of themselves.

所以光是高官厚禄，不见得能出人才，只出旗人对皇上自称的‘奴才’！
High office and generous pay alone may therefore produce no talent at all—only the ‘slaves’ that Bannermen call themselves before the emperor.”

““嘿！”
“Well!”

嵇鹤龄睁大了眼说：
Ji opened his eyes wide.

“想不到你能这么痛快的议论。
“I never expected such a spirited argument from you.

书，我比你多读了几句，论世故，我实在不及你。”
I may have read a few more books, but in knowledge of the world I cannot compare with you.”

“我是瞎说的。”胡雪岩谦虚着，
“I am only talking at random,” Hu said modestly.

“吃亏还在书读得少。”
“My lack of reading remains a disadvantage.”


“不然，不然！”
“Not at all, not at all.”

嵇鹤龄不断摇头，换了个后题，
Ji shook his head and changed the subject.

“我说过，我想认识几个江湖上的朋友，第一个是尤五，
“I told you that I wanted to meet some friends from the brotherhood world, You Laowu first among them.

这一回少不得要借重他了，
We shall certainly need his help now.

我想接了事，先到上海、松江走一趟，一则看看海口的情形，再则专诚去拜访尤五，
After taking up my duties, I should like to visit Shanghai and Songjiang, both to inspect conditions at the sea outlet and to call on You in person.

不晓得你能不能陪我一起走？”
Could you come with me?”

“可以，
“Yes.

我本来在上海也还有好些事要料理。
I have many things to attend to in Shanghai myself.

不过，此刻来说，言之过早。
But it is too early to settle that.

等你明天谢了委、接了事再来商量，也还不迟。”
Let us discuss it after you have thanked the governor and taken office tomorrow.”

说到这里，张贵来报，有道喜的客来了。
At this point Zhang Gui announced a visitor bearing congratulations.

这位贺客是裘丰言，
It was Qiu Fengyan.

向主人道过喜，便来跟胡雪岩招呼，将他奉若神明，
After greeting the host, he turned to Hu with almost reverential admiration.

因为裘丰言原来最佩服嵇鹤龄，
Qiu had always admired Ji above others.

而胡雪岩能使得恃才傲物的嵇鹤龄服帖，进而结为昆季，这就象如来佛收服孙悟空一般，
That Hu could win over such a proud man of talent and go on to become his sworn brother seemed like the Buddha’s subduing the Monkey King.

不能不令人倾倒。
It could not fail to inspire awe.

胡雪岩也很喜欢裘丰言，
Hu was fond of Qiu too.

此人生来心肠热、脾气好、肯吃亏，
The man was warmhearted, good-tempered and willing to take a loss.

最难得的是眼力高，识得人的长处，而且衷心敬服。
Most unusually, he could recognize the strengths of others and admire them sincerely.

同时他的趣味别具一格，
His tastes were distinctive.

说他俗，俗到不堪言状，说他雅，做两件别出心裁的事，比雅人还雅，
In some respects he was vulgar beyond description; yet he could do something so original and refined that it outdid the cultivated.

这就是嵇鹤龄能够跟他成为好朋友的一大原因。
That was one reason Ji was able to be his close friend.

至于胡雪岩的喜欢他，是喜欢他那副生气勃勃的劲道，
What Hu particularly liked was his lively spirit.

哪怕家里等米下锅，外面看来是吃饱睡足只想找乐趣的样子。
Even if his family had no rice for the cooking pot, he looked as though he had eaten well, slept soundly and wanted only to enjoy himself.


胡雪岩因材器使，马上替他想到了一桩“差使”：
Hu at once thought of a task suited to him.

“老裘，你今天就不要走了！
“Old Qiu, don’t go away today.

替主人陪陪客。”
Help our host entertain his visitors.”

“义不容辞！”裘丰言笑嘻嘻地答道：
“A duty I cannot refuse!” Qiu replied cheerfully.

“鹤龄兄春风得意，声名鹊起，
“Brother Heling is riding the spring breeze, and his reputation is soaring.

贺客必多，都归我招呼。
There will be plenty of callers; leave them all to me.

摆酒唱戏‘开贺’，我心里也有谱了，
I have plans for the celebration too—banquets and opera.

起码有十天好热闹。”
We can have at least ten days of festivities.”

“嗳，老兄，老兄！”
“Wait, my dear fellow!”

嵇鹤龄连忙拦着他说：
Ji hastily stopped him.

“你少给我出点花样，
“Spare me your schemes.

弄出暴发户的样子来！”
You’ll make me look like a man who has suddenly come into money.”

“做此官，行此礼，
“Every office has its appropriate ceremony.

哪个不是这样子热闹热闹的？”
Who doesn’t celebrate a little?”

“斯世何世？
“What times are we living in?

长毛找到黄河以北，上海又是小刀会起事，
The Long-Haired rebels have fought their way north of the Yellow River, and the Small Swords have risen in Shanghai.

我们在这里瞎起哄，给京里‘都老爷’晓得了，随便什么奏陈时政的析子上，带上一笔，吃不了还兜着走呢！”
If we make a senseless uproar here and one of the censors in Beijing hears of it, a passing mention in a memorial on public affairs could bring us more trouble than we could carry.”

“这倒也是实话。”胡雪岩一想是该当心，
“That is true,” Hu agreed, recognizing the need for caution.

“老裘，眼前不必铺张，
“Old Qiu, there is no need for extravagance now.

自己人悄悄玩一两天，有个庆贺的意思，也就够了。
A quiet day or two among friends will mark the occasion well enough.

好在至迟年底，总还有一场热闹。”
In any case, there will be another celebration by the end of the year.”

“对，对！”
“Quite right!”

裘丰言“从善如流”地连声答应，
Qiu readily accepted the better counsel.

“鹤龄兄，年底纳宠之喜，也就跟洞房花烛的‘小登科’一样。
“Brother Heling, taking a concubine at year’s end will be as joyful as marriage, which people liken to success in the examinations.

到那时候，你总不能委屈我们那位才貌双全、既贤且惠的如嫂夫人了吧？”
Surely you cannot then slight that lady of ours, so talented, beautiful, virtuous and kind?”

“这也再说。
“We shall see.

如果公事顺手，年下无事，倒不妨热闹热闹。”
If official business runs smoothly and I am free at the year’s end, a celebration would do no harm.”

“好，
“Good!

有这句话就行了。
That is all I needed to hear.

年下办喜事，自然也是我的‘总管？’。”
Naturally I shall be the master of arrangements then.”


“当然，
“Of course.

少不得要奉烦。”
We shall have to trouble you.

嵇鹤龄又问：“老裘，你现在忙不忙？”
Are you busy at present, Old Qiu?”

“你晓得的，我是无事忙。”
“You know me—busy with nothing.”

“那就忙点正经的。”
“Then be busy with something useful.”

嵇鹤龄向胡雪岩问道：
Ji turned to Hu.

“你看，请老裘来帮忙如何？”
“What do you think of asking Old Qiu to help?”

“那还有什么话说？”
“What objection could there be?”

胡雪岩忽然想到一件享，便接下来问一句：
Then a thought struck Hu.

“你请老裘在哪方面帮忙？”
“What sort of help do you have in mind?”

“自然是押运。”
“Escorting the shipments, naturally.”

“我也猜到是这方面。”
“That is what I thought.”

胡雪岩问裘丰言说：
Hu turned to Qiu.

“老裘！请你当海运局的押运委员，你肯不肯屈就？”
“Would you condescend to serve as a convoy commissioner for the Sea Transport Bureau?”

“谈不到这两个字。
“There is no question of condescending.

海船我还没有坐过，不晓得会不会晕船？
I have never been on a sea-going vessel and don’t know whether I might be seasick.

这都不去说它了，
But never mind all that.

反正你们两位说怎么，就是怎么！”
Whatever you two decide, I’ll do.”

“承情之至！”
“Much obliged!”

嵇鹤龄拱拱手，又向胡雪岩说道：“我猜你另外还有事托老裘？”
Ji clasped his hands, then said to Hu, “I suspect you have another task for Old Qiu too.”


“是啊！
“Yes.

‘烧香看和尚，一事两勾当’，
Burn incense and visit the monk—two errands accomplished in one journey.

等你那个条陈准了，先请老裘到松江跑一趟。”
Once your memorandum is approved, we can ask him to go to Songjiang first.”

“我懂了！”
“I see!

嵇鹤龄说，“你想把那批枪托老裘带了回来？”
You want him to bring back the guns.”

“对了！”
“Exactly.

胡雪岩说，“我本来想叫我那个‘学生子’去办，
I had intended to send my young pupil.

一则伯他年纪轻，不够老练，再则，‘一品者百姓’的身分，到底比不上我们裘大老爷！”
But he may be too young and inexperienced, and after all, a ‘first-rank commoner’ still cannot compare in standing with our distinguished Master Qiu.”

“好了，好了！”裘丰言用告烧的语气说，
“Enough, enough!” Qiu said in mock surrender.

“雪岩兄，你不必调侃我了。
“Brother Xueyan, stop teasing me.

说了半天是怎么回事？我还不甚明白。
You have talked for so long, and I still don’t quite understand the business.”

“于是胡雪岩把海运转驳和向英商购枪两事，说了个大概，
Hu outlined the arrangements for transferring the tribute grain and buying guns from the British.

裘丰言好热闹，爱朋友，
Qiu loved activity and friendship.

对尤五这样的人，跟嵇鹤龄一样，渴望结交，运洋枪的差使，也觉得新鲜有趣，
Like Ji, he was eager to meet a man such as You Laowu, and transporting foreign guns sounded new and interesting.

所以满口答应。
He agreed without reservation.

“不过，说句实话，此行也不是全无意外！”嵇鹤龄提出警告，
“But to speak frankly, the journey is not entirely without risk,” Ji warned.

“这年头，萑苻遍地，洋枪这样的利器，暗中颇有人眼红。
“Bandits are everywhere these days, and many secretly covet such effective weapons.

老裘，你是有名的‘酒糊涂’，
You are famous as the Wine Muddlehead, Old Qiu.

一路上要少喝。”
You must drink less on the way.”

“少喝一点可以。
“I can drink a little less.

你放心好了，
Don’t worry.

我每顿总喝到快要糊涂为止。”
At every meal I always stop just short of becoming muddled.”


嵇、胡二人都笑了。
Ji and Hu laughed.

“老裘！”胡雪岩好奇地问道，“你平生醉过没有？”
“Old Qiu,” Hu asked curiously, “have you ever been drunk in your life?”

“只醉过一趟。”
“Only once.

裘丰言说，“是我娶亲那天，特意喝醉的。”
On my wedding day, and then deliberately.”

“为什么？”胡雪岩诧异地问。
“Why?” Hu asked in surprise.

“负气！”裘丰言说，
“Out of resentment.

“我那头亲人，是先父定下的，
My late father arranged the marriage.

照我的心意，想娶东邻之女，先父说什么不许。
I wanted to marry the girl next door, but he absolutely refused.

我心里存个拙见，花轿要抬进门，我设法阻挡，洞房之中，同床异梦，是我自己的事。
I had a stubborn notion of my own: I could not stop the bridal chair from entering, but whether husband and wife shared a heart as well as a room was my affair.

所以吃喜酒的时候，同学少年起哄来灌，
At the wedding feast, my young schoolfriends made a great commotion and pressed drinks on me.

我来者不拒，已吃到了六、七分。
I refused none of them and was already six or seven parts drunk.

一进新房，我不揭新娘子的盖头，去揭酒坛子的盖头，
When I entered the bridal chamber, instead of lifting the bride’s veil, I lifted the cover of a wine jar.

吃得颓然大醉，人事不知，整整睡了一天一夜才醒。”
I drank until I collapsed unconscious and slept a whole day and night before waking.”

“该打屁股！”胡雪岩好奇地笑着，
“You deserved a beating!” Hu said, laughing with curiosity.

“新娘子必是哭了一夜？”
“The bride must have cried all night.”

“新娘子倒没有哭，
“She didn’t cry.

先母从没有看我醉过，吓得哭了！
My late mother did! She had never seen me drunk and was frightened.

你道我醉得如何？
Do you know how drunk I was?

十一月的天气，一块豆腐放在胸口，要不了多久就滚烫了。“
It was the eleventh month, yet a piece of bean curd placed on my chest became burning hot in no time.”


“好家伙！”
“Good heavens!”

胡雪岩咋舌，
Hu clicked his tongue.

“你这么喝，不把命都喝掉了？”
“You might have drunk yourself to death.”

嵇鹤龄没有听他谈过这一段，
Ji had never heard this story.

此时感兴趣的是他的新娘子，便抢着问道：“尊夫人如何？
He was more interested in the bride and quickly asked, “What did your wife do?

虽不哭，必是苦苦相劝？”
Even if she didn’t cry, she must have pleaded with you.”

“没有那话！”
“Nothing of the kind!”

裘丰言摇摇头，
Qiu shook his head.

“你们道内人如何？只怕猜到天亮也猜不着。”
“You could guess until daybreak and never imagine what she did.”

“那就不要猜了，你自己从实供来！”
“Then spare us the guessing and confess the truth.”

“内人当时叫‘伴房’的回娘家，说新姑爷好酒若命，叫她娘家送二十坛好酒来……”
“She sent the woman attending her back to her parents’ house with a message: the new son-in-law loved wine as dearly as life itself, so they should send twenty jars of good wine.”

“妙！”嵇鹤龄失声而呼，
“Wonderful!” Ji exclaimed.

“那你怎么样呢？”
“And what did you do?”

“我还有怎么样？
“What could I do?

人生难得一知己，
It is rare in life to find someone who understands you.

我好酒，她寻好酒来我吃，
I loved wine, and she found good wine for me.

你想想，我怎么能不服帖？”
How could I fail to surrender?”

嵇鹤龄跟胡雪岩都大笑，裘丰言回忆着少年的妙事，自己也笑了。
Ji and Hu laughed heartily, and Qiu laughed too at the happy absurdity of his younger days.

“说也奇怪！”他又说，“从那一天起，我对内人的看法就两样了，
“Strange to say, from that day I saw my wife differently.

原来看她胖得有些蠢，
Before, I had thought her so plump that she looked stupid.

这时候想想，杨贵妃是胖的，明朝的万贵妃也是胖的，《红楼梦》上的薛宝钗也是胖的。
Now I reflected that Imperial Consort Yang was plump, Consort Wan of the Ming was plump, and Xue Baochai in Dream of the Red Chamber was plump too.

脚是大了点，
Her feet were a little large, admittedly.

她的三寸金莲……”“慢来，慢来！”嵇鹤龄抢着问道：
Those three-inch golden lotuses of hers—” “Wait!” Ji interrupted.

“三寸金莲怎么说是大脚？”
“How can three-inch golden lotuses be large feet?”

“我的话还没有完。”裘丰言不慌不忙地答道，
“I hadn’t finished,” Qiu replied calmly.

“内人的三寸金莲是横量，跟观音大士一样。”
“My wife’s three-inch lotuses are measured across, like the feet of Guanyin herself.”

这一下，里里外外都是笑声。
Laughter erupted both inside and outside.

孩子们未见得听懂裘丰言的妙语，但极易受大人的感染，
The children might not understand his wit, but the adults’ merriment was contagious.

第一个丹荷就不曾看见他父亲与客人们这么笑不可抑过，因而颇有滑嵇之感，便忍不住笑得比什么人都厉害。
Danhe had never seen her father and his guests laugh so uncontrollably; the spectacle itself struck her as comical, and she laughed harder than anyone.

而瑞云则已内心充满了笑意，一触即发，
Ruiyun was already so full of happiness that laughter came readily.

况且裘丰言谈他那位大脚的胖太太，措词甚“绝”，她也是听得懂的。
Besides, she understood Qiu’s wonderfully pointed description of his plump, large-footed wife.


就在这一片笑声中，又有位贵客翩然而临，是王有龄，
Amid the laughter another distinguished visitor arrived: Wang Youling.

这下场面自然变得严肃了，
The atmosphere naturally became more formal.

有裘丰言在座，宾主都不便说什么涵意较深的话，
With Qiu present, neither host nor guests could speak with much hidden meaning.

一个道了贺，一个致了谢，王有龄便说：“鹤龄兄，我的移交现成，
Once congratulations and thanks had been exchanged, Wang said, “Brother Heling, everything is ready for my handover.

你随时可接，
You may take over at any time.

我看拣日不如撞日，
Rather than choose a special day, why not use the opportunity at hand?

你明天谢了委，就请移驾到局先视了事，
After thanking the governor tomorrow, come to the bureau and begin your duties.

也好让我早卸仔肩，稍松口气。”
Then I can lay down the burden and breathe a little more easily.”

“雪公！”嵇鹤龄拱拱手用歉意的声音说，“这一层实在不能从命，
“Mr Xuexuan,” Ji replied apologetically, clasping his hands, “I am afraid I cannot comply in that respect.

容我先好好跟你老请教了再接事，如何？”
Please let me first consult you properly before taking over.”

“那么，”
“Then…”

王有龄看了看裘丰言说，
Wang glanced at Qiu.

“丰言兄，一起到舍下便饭吧！”
“Brother Fengyan, will you join us for a simple dinner at my house?”

裘丰言也是熟透了人情世故的，
Qiu was thoroughly versed in social affairs.

听这话便知他们预先有约，当然有好些体己话要说，
He understood that the others had already arranged to meet and would have private matters to discuss.

自己决不能去惹厌。然而他也不肯实说这层意思，
He must not make himself unwelcome, but he would not state the reason openly.

“改天到府上叨拢，”他指指地下说，
“I’ll impose on you another day,” he said, pointing to the floor.

“鹤龄兄见委，要我为他接待贺客。
“Brother Heling has charged me with receiving his well-wishers.

我今天晚上一顿酒，就拢嵇府上的了。”
Tonight I shall impose on his household for my wine.”

这样安排也很好。
That suited everyone.

于是嵇鹤龄特地入内，关照瑞云，款待嘉宾，
Ji went inside especially to tell Ruiyun to look after their guest.

然后道声“拜托，偏劳”，与王有龄、胡雪岩一起出门。
With apologies and thanks to Qiu for his trouble, he left with Wang and Hu.


到了王家，王太太已特地从“小有天”闽菜馆叫了一桌席，为嵇鹤龄贺喜，兼为胡雪岩接风。
At Wang’s house, Mrs Wang had ordered a banquet from the Xiaoyoutian Fujian restaurant, both to congratulate Ji and to welcome Hu home.

三个人吃酒席，虽是盛馔，亦难下咽，
However sumptuous the dishes, a banquet for only three would lack the company to make it enjoyable.

因此胡雪岩出个主意，索性请些海运局的同事来赴席，
Hu therefore proposed inviting some colleagues from the Sea Transport Bureau.

一则作为王有龄酬谢他们平日帮忙，再则也为嵇鹤龄引见。
It would let Wang thank them for their usual assistance and introduce them to Ji.

临时飞笺召客，原是不甚礼貌的举动，不过都是局内同事，也就无所谓了。
Summoning guests with hurried invitations was not particularly courteous, but among colleagues it mattered little.

在等候甜这段时间，王有龄延客入书房，商谈移交。
While they waited, Wang took his visitors into the study to discuss the handover.

王有龄在海运局有亏空，
There was a deficit in the bureau’s accounts.

但历来相沿的习惯，大致前任亏空总归后任接收，作为一笔宕帐，
By long-standing custom, a successor generally inherited his predecessor’s deficit as an outstanding item.

能弥补就弥补，不能弥补就再移交给后任。
If he could cover it, he did; if not, he passed it on to his own successor.

到了移交不过去时，那就要出大乱子了。
When it could no longer be passed on, serious trouble followed.

当然前任是红是黑，后任是忠厚还是精明，以及彼此的交情，都有关系，
Much depended on the predecessor’s influence, on whether the successor was accommodating or exacting, and on their relationship.

在目前这种情况下，前后任等于一个人，自然没有话说。
Here the outgoing and incoming men were virtually one person, so no disagreement was expected.

但胡雪岩觉得这件事应该有个明确的处置，
Hu nevertheless felt that a definite arrangement was necessary.

否则就变成让嵇鹤龄受累，不仅于心不安，而且出了乱子，也就无异为自己找麻烦。
Otherwise Ji would bear the burden, which would trouble Hu’s conscience; and any eventual scandal would only make trouble for Hu himself.

“雪公！”他一开始就这样说，“现在等于做生意盘一爿店一样，
“Mr Xuexuan,” he began, “this is like taking over a shop.

亲兄弟明算帐，
Even brothers should keep clear accounts.

帐尽管宕在那里，算不能不算清楚。
The debt may remain outstanding, but its amount must be settled precisely.

该如何归清，我们再想办法，
We can then decide how to clear it.

等我上海的丝卖掉，我想就不要紧了。”
Once my Shanghai silk is sold, I think there will be no difficulty.”

听胡雪岩一说，王有龄心里有数，赶紧答道：
Wang understood at once.

“应该应该。
“Of course.

我们休戚相关，灾福相共，
We share good fortune and bad.

决不能把个烂摊子甩了给鹤龄兄就算数。”
We cannot simply dump a ruined concern on Brother Heling.”

这一说，事情就好办了，
That made matters easier.

那笔宕帐，能报销的报销，不能报销的，宕在那里，宕不过去再说，
Whatever could be accounted for as expenditure would be so accounted for; whatever could not would remain outstanding, to be reconsidered if it could no longer be carried forward.

反正有胡雪岩在，不会叫嵇鹤龄为难。
With Hu there, Ji would not be left in difficulty.

至于张胖子那里，继续维持旧有的关系，也就没有什么可说的。
Their existing relationship with Fat Zhang would continue unchanged.

嵇鹤龄一路听，一路点头，保持沉默，
Ji listened, nodding without speaking.

这是最适当的态度，
That was the appropriate attitude.

这个差使由王有龄和胡雪岩身上而来，此刻便不宜有所主张，
He owed the appointment to Wang and Hu; this was no time to advance his own demands.

等接了事，只要不伤害到他们两人，自己尽可发挥，
Once in office, he could exercise his abilities so long as he did not harm either of them.

亦无须在此时有所主张。
There was no need to assert himself now.


接着就谈到用人，这下嵇鹤龄却有话了，
When they turned to staffing, however, Ji did have something to say.

“雪公！”他问，“局里哪几位是非留不下可的？”
“Mr Xuexuan, which men at the bureau must be retained?”

王有龄懂得他的意思，
Wang understood.

“我没有什么人。”这是表示没有什么利害关系深切的私人，
“I have no personal men there,” he replied, meaning none whose interests were closely bound to his own.

“不过，有一两位平日颇为出力，
“But one or two have worked hard.

你能维持就维持，
Keep them if you can.

真的以为不行，当然也由你自己处置。”
If you really find them unsuitable, of course it is for you to decide.”

接着，王有龄说了两个可事的名字，
He named two colleagues.

嵇鹤龄都把他记了下来，表示一定设法维持。
Ji noted their names and said he would do his best to retain them.

“那么，雪公另外有没有人要安插呢？”
“Is there anyone else you would like a place found for?”

王有龄想了想说：
Wang considered.

“我有个远房侄于，最近从家乡来，
“A distant nephew has recently come from our native place.

我不想把他带到湖州，怕有人说闲话，‘官亲’太多。
I do not want to take him to Huzhou, for fear people will say there are too many official relatives about.

你如果能设法安插，那就求之不得了。”
If you could place him, I should be most grateful.”

“好！
“Certainly.

请雪公叫令侄开个履历给我。”
Please have him give me an account of his qualifications.

嵇鹤龄又说：“我跟雪岩商量好了，预备用裘丰言。
Xueyan and I have also agreed that we should like to employ Qiu Fengyan.

雪公看如何？”
What do you think?”

这是嵇鹤龄的子腕，有意表示恭敬亲切，
This was Ji’s tact: he deliberately showed respect and cordiality.

当然，王有龄即使不赞成，因为有胡雪岩的意思在内，也不会反对，
Even had Wang disapproved, he would scarcely have objected to an arrangement Hu supported.

而况事不干已，且对裘丰言的印象不坏，
In fact, it did not concern his interests, and he thought well of Qiu.

所以他连连点头：
He nodded repeatedly.

“很好，很好！”
“Very good, very good.”


“再有，”胡雪岩接着说，
“There is another matter,” Hu added.

“到松江去接洋枪，我想请老裘顺便去跑一趟，
“I should like Old Qiu to go to Songjiang and collect the foreign guns on the same journey.

请雪公再弄件公事。”
Please arrange another official document.”

“公文方便。
“The papers are easy.

不过‘酒糊涂’办这种事，会不会出纰漏？”
But will the Wine Muddlehead make a mistake on such an errand?

王有龄说，“我看最好叫你那个姓陈的后生跟了他去，
I think it would be best to send that young fellow Chen with him.

这个人年纪虽轻，人倒能干。”
He is young, but capable.”

“既然寻公看他能干，不妨在猢州给他一个什么差使。”胡雪岩毫不思索他说了这一句，
“Since you think him capable, why not give him some appointment in Huzhou?” Hu said without thinking.

想想又不对，赶紧再接一句：“当然是挂名差使。”
Then, realizing that this was not quite what he wanted, he quickly added, “A nominal appointment, of course.”

“挂名差使又何必？”
“Why a nominal one?”

“有个道理。”
“There is a reason.

胡雪岩说，“陈世龙年底要成亲了。
Chen Shilong is to marry at the end of the year.

有个差使，便算衣冠中人，男女两家的场面上都好看些。”
An appointment would put him among men entitled to official dress and make a better showing for both families.”

“这可以！”王有龄随口答道，
“That can be done,” Wang replied casually.

“女家是哪一家？”
“Whose family is the bride from?”

“新娘子就是阿珠。”
“The bride is A’zhu.”

“咦！”
“Ah!”

王有龄和嵇鹤龄不约而同的面现诧异之色，而且都非常困惑，不知这话怎么问下去？
Wang and Ji showed the same surprise and bewilderment, neither knowing how to pursue the question.

也不需他们动问，
They did not need to ask.

胡雪岩自己把那段移植蓬门清卉的经过，讲了一遍。
Hu himself related how he had arranged the future of that fresh blossom from a humble home.

王有龄和嵇鹤龄自然都极注意的在听，但两人的反应不同，
Both listened closely, but their reactions differed.

王有龄是替他惋惜，嵇鹤龄则颇为赞成，说胡雪岩这件“快举”，大有唐人侠义之风。
Wang felt regret on Hu’s behalf; Ji approved heartily, saying that this spirited act had the chivalrous generosity of a hero from a Tang tale.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十六章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Sixteen, first part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第十六章｜CHAPTER SIXTEEN


当天回家，胡雪岩叫阿福把住在附近客栈里的陈世龙去找了来，
When Hu returned home that day, he sent A’fu to fetch Chen Shilong from the nearby inn.

他是要告诉他一个好消息，到松江接枪，已经用不着他了。
He had good news for him: Chen was no longer needed to collect the guns at Songjiang.

眼前在杭州也没有什么事，可以先回湖州一趟，去见一见“丈母娘”。
There was nothing for him to do in Hangzhou just now either, so he could go back to Huzhou first and visit his “mother-in-law.”

“不必！”陈世龙说，
“There’s no need,” Chen said.

“接枪的事情，也很麻烦，
“Collecting the guns will be troublesome too.

我跟了裘老爷去好了。”
I had better go with Mr Qiu.”

“为什么呢？”
“Why?”

胡雪岩倒有些诧异，
Hu was surprised.

心想这是求之不得的“美差”，
Surely this was a delightful errand anyone would welcome.

陈世龙不该不领情。
Why should Chen refuse the kindness?

他何尝不领情，
Chen was far from ungrateful.

心里也巴不得去看一看小别数日，便如数年的阿珠，
He longed to see A’zhu; a few days apart had seemed like years.

只是为了感恩图报，自愿出力。
But he wanted to repay Hu by doing whatever work he could.

而这话他又不愿说，觉得说了便没意思了，因而沉默不答。
To explain that would take the meaning out of it, so he remained silent.

胡雪岩是察言观色，只需稍力用点心，便可以看透他的腑肺，
Hu needed only a little attention to read his expression and see into his heart.

心里暗暗欣慰，也不说破，只这样告诉他：
Secretly pleased, he did not expose the reason.

“叫你去看丈母娘是‘顺带公文一角’，
“Your visit to your mother-in-law is merely a dispatch carried on the way.

湖州我一时去不了，有好些事，要你替我去办。
I cannot go to Huzhou just yet, and there are several things you must do for me.

你不必到松江去了！”
You are not going to Songjiang.”

最后一句话，完全是长辈的口气，
The final sentence had all the authority of an elder’s command.

没有讨价还价的余地，
There was no room for bargaining.

陈世龙只好点点头。
Chen could only nod.


“第一件，你跟你郁四叔去说，如果有多余的头寸，我要用，
“First, tell your Uncle Four that, if he has spare funds, I need them.

请他汇到阜康来，期限最好长一点，
Ask him to remit them to Fukang, preferably for a fairly long term.

利息我特别加厚。
I will pay him an especially generous rate of interest.

第二件……”
Second...”

说到第二件，他沉吟了，
Hu paused.

意思是想把黄仪调开，但丝行才开始做，
He wanted to move Huang Yi elsewhere, but the silk firm had only just begun operations.

总得把这一“季”做出个起落来，净赚多少，该分多少花红，
They ought at least to finish this season and settle how much net profit had been made and what bonus Huang should receive.

有个实实惠惠的交代，则宾主尽欢而散，才是正办。
A tangible settlement that let employer and employee part happily was the proper course.

照目前这样子，仿佛有些过河拆桥，传出去于自己的名声有损。
To move him now would look like destroying the bridge after crossing it, and word of that would damage Hu’s reputation.

“世龙，”他问：“你看黄仪这个人怎么样？”
“Shilong, what do you think of Huang Yi?”

“本事是有的，不大合得来群。”陈世龙直抒观感。
“He has ability, but doesn’t get on well with others,” Chen replied frankly.

“对！
“Exactly.

你说到了他的短处。”
You’ve put your finger on his weakness.

胡雪岩说，“你丈人自己说过，‘吃不住他’，
Your father-in-law himself says he can’t manage him.

我要想个办法，把他调开，不过目前还不到时候，
I must find a way to move him elsewhere, but the time isn’t right yet.

你跟你丈人说，好歹先敷衍敷衍他，
Tell your father-in-law to get along with him as best he can for now.

到明年我自有妥当办法。”
I’ll have a suitable arrangement next year.”

“我晓得了。”
“I understand.

陈世龙又说，“郁四叔那里，最好请胡先生写封信。”
It would be best if you wrote Uncle Four a letter too.”

“信我是要写的，还有东西带去。
“I shall write, and there are things for you to take.

啊！”胡雪岩突然喊了起来，
Ah!” Hu suddenly exclaimed.

“我倒想起来了，
“That reminds me.

老黄文墨很不错，
Old Huang writes very well.

我想请他来帮忙，专门替我写写信，
I’d like him to help me by attending solely to my correspondence.

你倒探探他的口气看！
Sound him out.

送他的酬劳，一定够他用，
I’ll pay enough to meet his needs.

你看他的意思如何？写信来告诉我。”
Find out what he thinks and write to tell me.”


“这倒也不错。
“That’s a good idea too.

老黄这个人也只有胡先生能收服，
You’re the only person who can bring Old Huang round.

他做事最好自己做自己的，不跟人联手，
He works best on his own, without having to cooperate with anyone.

一定做得好。”
He would certainly do it well.”

这样商量定了，陈世龙便整整忙了两天，把胡雪岩要带到湖州送人的土仪什物，以及他自己“孝敬”丈人丈母娘的衣料与食物，向阿珠献殷勤的胭脂花粉，一起采办齐全，
With this agreed, Chen spent two full days buying the local delicacies and other gifts Hu wanted taken to Huzhou, together with cloth and food for his own offerings to his future parents-in-law, and rouge and scented face powder to please A’zhu.

再下一天就下了航船，直放湖州。
The following day he boarded a passenger boat and went straight to Huzhou.

一上岸先到大经丝行，
His first call ashore was at Dajing Silk Firm.

迎面就遇见阿珠的娘，心里没有预备，顿时搞得手足无措。
He met A’zhu’s mother coming towards him and, wholly unprepared, became awkward and flustered.

首先称呼就为难，
Even a greeting was difficult.

自然不能再叫“张太太”，但又老不出面皮喊声，“娘！”
He could hardly call her Mrs Zhang any longer, yet could not bring himself to say “Mother.”

阿珠的娘，却是又惊又喜，
She, however, was surprised and delighted.

“你怎么回来了？”
“What brings you back?

她说，“来，先坐了再说，
Come and sit down first.

你丈人也在里头。”
Your father-in-law is inside too.”

说着，她自己先转身走了进去。
She turned and went ahead.

陈世龙定定神，
Chen collected himself.

心里在想，看这样子，丈母娘对自己是中意的，
Evidently his future mother-in-law approved of him.

他唯一的顾虑，是怕阿珠的娘，觉得受胡雪岩的好处太多，不一定以这头亲事为然，或者口中不说，心里起了个疙瘩。
His one fear had been that, having received so much from Hu, she might dislike this marriage or silently harbour a grievance about it.

现在，这个疑虑似乎是多余的了。
Now that worry seemed unnecessary.


由店堂绕过屏风，走人第二进就是客帚，
Beyond the shopfront and its screen, the second courtyard led into the reception hall.

这时不是收丝的季节，空荡荡地一个客人都没有，
It was not the season for buying silk, and there was not a customer in the empty hall.

但旁边厢房却有人，是黄仪，
Huang Yi was in a side room, however.

在窗子里望见了便喊：“啊呀，新贵人上门了！”
Catching sight of Chen through the window, he called, “Why, the honoured new son-in-law has arrived!”

一路喊，一路抢了出来，笑脸迎人。
Still calling, he hurried out with a welcoming smile.

陈世龙有些发窘，站定了脚招呼一声：
Chen stopped, somewhat embarrassed.

“黄先生，你好！”
“How are you, Mr Huang?”

“你发福了！”
“You’ve filled out!”

黄仪歪着头，从上到下把陈世龙端详了一遍，
Tilting his head, Huang looked him over from head to foot.

“上海住了几个月，样子变过了！”
“A few months in Shanghai have changed your appearance.”

这一说引起了阿珠的娘的注意，
This drew the mother’s attention.

也是退后两步，直盯着陈世龙看。
She too stepped back and stared.

夷场上的衣饰总要漂亮些，又是“丈母娘看女婿”，所以她脸上的笑意越堆越浓，
Clothes from the foreign settlement were always finer; and with a mother-in-law looking at her prospective son-in-law, her smile naturally grew broader and broader.

这样就更要惹得黄仪开玩笑。
Huang could not resist more teasing.

“张太太，”他笑着说，“回去慢慢看！
“Mrs Zhang, you can study him at leisure when you get home.

新贵人脸嫩，
Our new son-in-law is shy.

看得他不好意思了。”
You’re embarrassing him.”

“晓得他脸嫩，你就少说一两句！”阿珠的娘已经在卫护女婿，这样笑着说，
Already taking his side, she laughed. “If you know he’s shy, say a little less!

“都到里头来坐！”
Come inside, both of you.”

“对！”黄仪兴味盎然地，
“Yes!” Huang said enthusiastically.

“我到里头来看你们‘见礼’。”
“I’ll come and watch you exchange the formal greetings.”

阿珠的娘心里一动，立刻有了个主意，
This gave her an idea.

她是体恤女婿，看陈世龙有点发窘，心里便想，“毛脚女婿”第一次上门，总要有个媒人，或者男女两家都熟悉的亲友陪着，彼此才不致尴尬。
A young man’s first visit to his future wife’s family ought to be made with a matchmaker or someone who knew both families, to spare everyone embarrassment.

现在陈世龙象个“没脚蟹”似地，
Chen had come like a crab without legs.

要请黄仪来帮忙，
Why not enlist Huang?

媒人照规矩是两位，
Custom required two matchmakers.

有了一个胡雪岩，另一个不是现成在眼前？
Hu was one; wasn’t the other standing ready before her?


于是她说：“黄先生，我们女家的大媒是胡先生，
“Mr Huang, Mr Hu is the matchmaker on our daughter’s side.

男家的大媒老爷，拜托了你好不好？”
Would you be so kind as to act for the bridegroom?”

“怎么不好？
“Gladly!

现成的媒人，求之不得。”
A ready-made match to arrange—what could be better?”

陈世龙也听出丈母娘意存体恤，
Chen understood her consideration.

这样安排，再好不过，
Nothing could suit him better.

便向黄仪拱手作揖：
He clasped his hands and bowed to Huang.

“黄先生，我重重拜托！”
“I entrust it to you, Mr Huang.”

“好说，好说！”
“Of course, of course!”

黄仪很高兴地，
Huang was delighted.

“那么，张太太，我要叫你亲家太太了！”
“Then, Mrs Zhang, I must greet you as our new relation by marriage.”

就这样说笑着，一起进了胡雪岩以前所住的那个院子，
Talking and laughing, they entered the courtyard Hu had formerly occupied.

老张闻声迎了出来，也有意外的惊喜，
Old Zhang came out at the sound, equally surprised and pleased.

陈世龙喊一声：“爹！”
“Father!” Chen called.

有了爹自然有娘，
With a father, there was naturally a mother too.

黄仪以媒人的身份，从中牵引，陈世龙便又替老张夫妇磕了头，正式见过礼，改了口，
Guided by Huang in his new capacity as matchmaker, Chen kowtowed to the couple, formally paid his respects and adopted his new forms of address.

把阿珠的娘笑得合不扰口。
A’zhu’s mother could scarcely stop smiling.

这时大经丝行里用的伙计，出店、烧饭司务，还有两三个缫丝的女工，都跑了来看热闹，
The firm’s clerks, outside errand man, cook and two or three women who reeled silk all came to watch.

因为陈世龙平常人缘极好，所以都替他高兴，但也多要开几句玩笑。
Chen had always been well liked, so everyone was happy for him, though most had a joke to make.

陈世龙觉得最艰难的是见丈母娘这一关，
He had considered meeting his mother-in-law the hardest ordeal.

这一关一过就不在乎，
Once through it, he no longer minded.

脸皮也厚了，随他们去说，只报以矜持的微笑。
His skin had grown thicker; he let them say what they pleased and answered only with a restrained smile.


然而另一个难关又来了，这一关不是他自己难过，是替阿珠担心，
Another ordeal now arrived, though it was A’zhu, rather than himself, for whom Chen was anxious.

说巧不巧，阿珠从家里到丝行，
By an awkward coincidence she had just come from home to the firm.

一路走进来，就看见大家想笑不笑，已在怀疑，
The half-suppressed smiles she encountered on her way in had already made her suspicious.

等踏入院子，第一眼就看见陈世龙，
As soon as she entered the courtyard, she saw Chen.

心里一慌，赶紧想溜，已来不及。
In sudden confusion she tried to slip away, but it was too late.

“阿珠！”老张在里头喊。
“A’zhu!” her father called from inside.

阿珠不理，依旧往外走，
Ignoring him, she kept going out.

有个缫丝的女工叫阿翠，生性最好事，偏偏就在她身后，堵着门不让她出去。
A silk-reeling woman named A’cui, who loved to meddle, happened to be behind her and blocked the doorway.

“走开！”她低声怒喝。
“Get out of the way!” A’zhu whispered angrily.

“你不要逃嘛！”阿翠笑道，
“Don’t run away!” A’cui laughed.

“又不是不认识。”
“It isn’t as though you don’t know him.”

于是里面也笑，外面也笑，
Laughter broke out inside and outside.

终于让阿珠夺门逃走，陈世龙才算松了一口气。
Only when A’zhu finally escaped through the door did Chen breathe freely.

阿珠的娘记挂着女儿，同时为女婿设想，料知他一颗心也早就飞了出去，
Her mother was concerned for her daughter and considerate of Chen, whose heart, she guessed, had already flown after her.

因而看一看天色，提议回家，顺便邀黄仪一起去吃晚饭。
Looking at the hour, she proposed returning home and invited Huang to supper.

黄仪大喜。
He was delighted.

他不喜欢赌钱，也不会花花草草在外头搞女人，甚至连旱烟都不抽，
He disliked gambling, did not chase women, and did not even smoke a dry pipe.

唯一的嗜好，是口腹之欲，这位“老板娘”的烹调手段，他是领教过的，
Food was his one indulgence, and he knew his employer’s wife could cook.

只是在老张父女到上海去的那些日子，只有阿珠的娘带着个使女爱珍在家，他不便上门去叨扰。
While Zhang and A’zhu were in Shanghai, she had been alone at home with her maid Aizhen, and he could hardly impose on them.

从老张回来以后，才又去吃过两次饭，家常肴馔、精洁有余，丰腆不足，未能大嚼，
Since Zhang’s return he had dined there twice, but the everyday dishes, though excellent and beautifully prepared, had not been plentiful enough for him to eat his fill.

今天又是款待“毛脚女婿”，又是请媒人，
Today they were entertaining both a prospective son-in-law on his first visit and a matchmaker.

自然有一顿称心满意的晚饭好吃了。
A satisfying dinner was assured.


“你先去！”老张对他妻子说，
“Go ahead,” Old Zhang told his wife.

“胡先生带来送人的东西，我跟世龙先料理料理，
“Shilong and I will sort out the presents Mr Hu has sent.

弄好了就回来。”
We’ll come when we’ve finished.”

“今天也晚了，
“It’s late already.

留到明天再说。”
Leave them until tomorrow.

阿珠的娘这样嘱咐：“世龙就住在店里好了，要茶要水也方便。
Shilong had better stay at the shop, where tea and water will be handy.

要住哪一问自己挑，挑好了叫他们打扫，铺盖到家里去拿。”
Let him choose whichever room he likes, have them clean it and fetch bedding from home.”

这番体贴，完全是父母之心，
Her care was entirely a parent’s.

陈世龙极其感动，但也很不安，
Chen was deeply touched, but uneasy too.

就此刻他已觉得岳家的恩情太重，不知何以报答？
Already he felt his debt to his future wife’s family was too great to repay.

加上胡雪岩的一手提拔，越有恐惧不胜之情，
Added to Hu’s efforts to advance him, it almost frightened him.

于是不由得又想到阿珠的那番激励：“ ‘好女不穿嫁时衣’，
Inevitably he remembered A’zhu’s encouragement: “A good wife doesn’t depend on the clothes she brought at marriage.

这些首饰，可惜不是你买给我的！”
It’s a pity you didn’t buy these jewels for me yourself!”

同时也记了胡雪岩对阿珠说过的那句话：“等世龙将来发达了，给你买金刚钻。”
He also remembered Hu telling her, “When Shilong prospers, he’ll buy you diamonds.”

两下凑在一起，陈世龙死心塌地了！
The two remarks together fixed his determination.

“爹！”等阿珠的娘一走，陈世龙这样对老张说：“你先陪了黄先生回去。
Once her mother had gone, he told Old Zhang, “Father, take Mr Huang home first.

我把胡先生交代的事，办完了就来。
I’ll come when I’ve finished Mr Hu’s business.

今天我仍旧回家去住，省得麻烦。”
I’ll sleep at my own place tonight to save trouble.”

“何必？”黄仪劝他：
“Why?” Huang urged.

“明天一早来料理也一样。”
“You can see to it early tomorrow.”

“不！”陈世龙固执地：
“No,” Chen insisted.

“今日事，今日毕，
“Today’s work must be finished today.

明天有明天的事，
Tomorrow has its own business.

积在一起，拖到后天，那就永远料理不清楚了！”
Let them pile up and carry over to the day after, and they’ll never be cleared.”

听这一说，已入中年的黄仪不断点头，
Huang, already middle-aged, nodded repeatedly.

“老张！”他说，“你这个女婿，人又变过了，
“Old Zhang, your son-in-law has changed again.

不但聪明勤快，而且老成扎实！
Clever and diligent, and now mature and dependable too!

真正是乘尤快婿，
An excellent match for your daughter.

恭喜，恭喜！”
Congratulations!”

老张是忠厚老实到了家的，自然更欣赏陈世龙的作风。
Thoroughly honest and conscientious himself, Zhang valued this attitude still more.

要这样，后半世才有依靠！
Here was someone he could rely on in later life.

照他的想法，当时就想下手帮忙，但既邀了黄仪回家吃饭，也不便让他空等。
He wanted to help at once, but having invited Huang to dinner, could hardly keep him waiting.

就这踌躇之间，有了个主意，正不妨趁此机会跟黄仪先谈一谈如何办喜事。
While hesitating, he saw an opportunity: they could discuss the wedding first.


陪他到家，刚一进门，里面阿珠便躲了开去，爱珍来开了门，
As they entered the house, A’zhu withdrew from sight and Aizhen came to open the door.

第一个先寻陈世龙，
Her eyes searched first for Chen.

看看不见，便失望地问了出来：“咦！姑少爷呢？”
Not seeing him, she asked in disappointment, “Where is the young son-in-law?”

骤然改口，老张倒是一愣，想一想才明白，随即答道：
The sudden change of title startled Zhang before he understood.

“在收拾东西，
“Sorting things out.

要等下才来。”
He’ll come later.”

听这一说，爱珍便急忙到厨房里去报告消息。
Aizhen hurried to the kitchen with the news.

阿珠跟她一样失望，但似乎又觉得轻松。
A’zhu was just as disappointed, though also somewhat relieved.

不过，还有个黄仪，这时一走出去，必定受窘，
Huang was still there, however; if she went out now, he would certainly embarrass her.

因而又有些上心事。
This gave her another worry.

她娘看不出她的心事，正忙得不可开交，
Her mother was too busy to notice.

要在个把钟头以内，弄出一桌象样的菜来，着实要费一番手脚。
Preparing a respectable dinner within an hour or so required considerable effort.

而且不但手脚忙，口中也不闭，一面调理咸酸，一面不厌其详地讲解，让阿珠都听得有些烦了。
Her tongue was as busy as her hands: while adjusting the seasoning, she explained every detail until A’zhu grew impatient.

“娘！”她说，“这时候哪里有工夫讲空话？”
“Mother, how have you time for idle talk now?”

“你当是空话？”
“You call it idle talk?”

做母亲的大为不悦。
Her mother was displeased.

“马上要自己做人家了，
“You’ll soon have a household of your own.

我教得你一样是一样，你还不肯学！”
Every little thing I can teach you will help, yet you won’t learn!

阿珠的娘埋怨女儿，“虽然上头没有婆婆，旁人要说闲话。
You may have no mother-in-law above you, but other people will gossip.

一把锅铲刀上没有点功夫，你想想，男人怎么会在家里耽得住？”
Without some skill with a knife and spatula, how do you expect to keep a man at home?”

话是不中听，但看娘忙成这个样子，阿珠不肯再跟她争辩，
The words were unwelcome, but seeing her mother so busy, A’zhu would not argue.

只是一向撒娇惯了的，不顶句嘴办不到，
Still, she was too accustomed to having her own way to offer no retort at all.

便笑着说道：“随你，随你！你老太太喜欢罗嗦，尽管去罗嗦好了！”
“As you please! If you enjoy lecturing, go on!” she said with a smile.

阿珠的娘，实在也没有工夫“罗嗦”了，
In fact, her mother had no time for more lecturing.

却又惦记着外面，你去听听！“她说，
Remembering the men outside, she said, “Go and listen.

“黄先生跟你爹讲些什么？”
What are Mr Huang and your father discussing?”

这句话正中下怀，
This was precisely what A’zhu wanted.

阿珠随即出了厨房，躲在窗下，用发簪在窗纸上戳出个小孔，悄悄向外窥探。
She left the kitchen, concealed herself beneath a window, pricked a little hole in the paper with her hairpin and peered through.


外面一主一宾，神态各别，
Host and guest presented different pictures.

老张正襟危坐，显得极为郑重，黄仪却是翘着着“二郎腿”，很随便的样子，
Zhang sat upright and looked extremely serious; Huang sat casually with one leg crossed over the other.

这时正是他在说话。
He was speaking.

“换个庚帖，方便得很，
“Exchanging birth cards is easy enough.

回头叫你们大小姐去买全帖来，我马上就写，
Send your young lady to buy the full set of formal sheets later, and I’ll write them at once.

男女两家，归我一手包办。
I can handle both families’ copies.

还有啥？”
What else?”

“还有，‘送日子’归男家。”
“The bridegroom’s family must send the date.”

老张停了一下又说：
Zhang paused.

“世龙预备啥时候办喜事，拜托你问他一声。”
“Please ask Shilong when he intends to hold the wedding.”

“这何必还要我问？”黄仪笑道，
“Why ask through me?” Huang laughed.

“你们翁婿这么熟的人，
“You two know each other so well.

用得着我这个现成的媒人传话？”
Do you need this matchmaker, who has had the whole affair ready-made for him, to carry messages?”

“这也是规矩。
“That is the custom too.

总要请大媒老爷……”
We must ask our honoured matchmaker...”

“老张！”黄仪突然打断他的话说，
“Old Zhang!” Huang suddenly interrupted.

“所谓六礼：纳采、问名、纳吉、纳征、请期、亲迎，只有一项，我该替女家效劳的。
“Of the six rites—sending the proposal, asking the bride’s name, announcing the auspicious divination result, presenting the betrothal gifts, requesting a date and fetching the bride—there is only one in which I ought to serve the bride’s family.

‘纳征’怎么说？”
What about the betrothal offerings?”

“六礼”二字，老张倒听见过，“纳征”他就不懂了。
Zhang had heard of the “six rites,” but the formal term Huang used for the offerings meant nothing to him.

后面的阿珠也在纳闷，
Behind the window, A’zhu was puzzled too.

听语气是不知出了什么花样？
What new complication did his tone suggest?

所以越发侧耳细听。
She listened still more closely.

“纳征就是聘礼。
“I mean the betrothal gifts.

这个上头，你们自己不好开口，我倒可以替你去问。”
You can hardly raise that question yourselves, but I can ask for you.”

“原来是聘礼，
“Oh, those!

这个已经有了。
They have already arrived.

想来你还不晓得，
You may not know.

应该请你过目。”
You ought to inspect them.”


于是老张亲自入内，小心翼翼地捧了个朱漆描金的拜盒出来，
Zhang went inside himself and carefully brought out a red lacquer presentation box decorated in gold.

打开一看，是这么四件首饰，黄仪大出意外。
The four kinds of jewellery it contained greatly surprised Huang.

“是胡先生代世龙送的。”
“Mr Hu sent them on Shilong’s behalf.”

这句话使黄仪更感意外。
This surprised him still more.

他对胡雪岩的接触不算多，但却听见过许多说他慷慨的话，
Though his dealings with Hu had been limited, he had heard many accounts of his generosity.

于今一看，果不其然。
Now he saw that they were true.

这位“东家”本性着实宽厚，
His employer was thoroughly generous by nature.

就跟他一辈子亦何妨。
Why should he not remain with such a man all his life?

“好极，好极！”
“Excellent, excellent!”

黄仪也替阿珠高兴，
Huang was happy for A’zhu too.

“将来新娘子珠围翠绕，打扮出来，格外出色。
“Decked in pearls and jade, the bride will look splendid.

我看老张，现在凡事有胡先生替世龙作主，啥事情你不必问我，
Old Zhang, since Mr Hu is arranging everything for Shilong, there’s no need to ask me about any of it.

问他好了。”
Ask him.”

这一句话，确是要言不烦，
Those few words went straight to the point.

老张爽然若失，
Zhang felt suddenly at a loss.

问了半天，原是白问，
All his questions had been wasted.

照现在这样子看，只怕陈世龙也做不得自己的主。
Apparently Chen might not be free to decide for himself either.

说不定胡雪岩已有话交代，等下倒不妨问问他。
Perhaps Hu had already given instructions; Zhang could ask Chen when he arrived.

又闲谈了好一会，
They talked idly for a while longer.

黄仪肚子饿得咕咕叫，正想开口先向主人家要些什么点心来吃，总算还好，陈世龙到了。
Huang’s stomach was rumbling, and he was about to ask his host for a snack when Chen finally came.

一路上他是想好了来的，
On the way, Chen had thought matters out.

虽说结成至亲，不过多了一重名分，
Becoming close relations merely added a new formal bond.

在岳家他仍旧应该象从前一样，
He should behave in his future wife’s home as he always had.

才显得亲切自然，而且也为自己减除了许多窘相。
That would be affectionate and natural, and would spare him much embarrassment.

所以招呼过后，一直就往厨房里走去。
After greeting the men, therefore, he headed straight for the kitchen.


一踏到后面，顶头就遇见阿珠，
At the back of the house he met A’zhu coming towards him.

双方都以猝不及防而微吃一惊，但亦随即都在心头浮现了莫可言喻的喜悦。
Both were startled by the unexpected encounter, but in the next instant an indescribable joy rose in both their hearts.

陈世龙只叫得一声：“阿珠！”便把一双眼睛瞪住在她身上不放。
Chen could only say, “A’zhu!” and fix his eyes on her.

“你有几天耽搁？”她很快地说，声音也很轻。
“How many days can you stay?” she asked quickly and softly.

不问来，先问走，便已见得她的不舍之意，
Asking about his departure before his arrival already showed how unwilling she was to part.

就这样一句平淡的话，已使得陈世龙回肠荡气，
That simple question stirred him deeply.

真想终老家乡，一辈子厮守着阿珠。
He wanted to spend the rest of his days in his native town, always beside her.

然而他也马上自谴，觉得起这种念头就是没出息，
At once he reproached himself: such thoughts showed a lack of ambition.

因而放出那种无所谓的神态说：“要看胡先生的意思，
Assuming an unconcerned manner, he answered, “That depends on Mr Hu.

他差遣我到哪里，就到哪里，
Wherever he sends me, I go.

信一来就走。”
I shall leave as soon as his letter comes.”

阿珠不响，
She said nothing.

心里有许多话要说，而此时此地不是细诉衷曲的时候，
There was much in her heart, but this was no time or place to express it.

便侧着身子努一努嘴，意思是让他到厨房里去跟她娘招呼。
Moving aside, she gestured with her lips towards the kitchen, telling him to go and greet her mother.

陈世龙会意，微笑着点一点头，
He smiled and nodded.

走过她身边时，在暗头里捏住了她的手，
As he passed her in the dim passage, he took her hand.

柔荑一握，入手心荡，倒又舍不得走了。
At its touch his heart stirred, and he could not bear to move on.

阿珠不赞成他这样的行为，只是不忍拒绝，
A’zhu did not approve of this, but could not bear to refuse him either.

倚恃母亲的宽容，就看见了也不会责备，便尽着由他握着。
Trusting that her mother would be indulgent even if she saw, she let him hold her hand.

偏偏不识相的爱珍一头冲了出来，
Just then, the tactless Aizhen came rushing out.

阿珠眼尖，夺手便走。
A’zhu saw her first, pulled her hand free and hurried away.

陈世龙也有些吃惊，搭讪着说：
Startled too, Chen tried to cover his confusion.

“爱珍，我有两样东西从上海带来送你。一样是象牙蓖箕，一样是一个五颜六色的木头，镶嵌得很好看的盒子，
“Aizhen, I’ve brought you two things from Shanghai: an ivory comb and a little box beautifully inlaid with different-coloured woods.

不晓得你喜欢不喜欢？”
I hope you’ll like them.”

“喜欢的！”
“I will!

爱珍很高兴地说，“谢谢姑少爷！”
Thank you, young son-in-law!”

“少爷”这个称呼在陈世龙已觉得很新鲜，何况是“ 姑少爷”？
Even being called “young master” was new to Chen, let alone this title.

他自己把这三个字，默默念了两遍，忽然发觉，他和张家的身分，都在无形中提高了！
Repeating it silently twice, he suddenly realised that both his standing and the Zhang family’s had risen without their noticing.

这自是受了胡雪岩的惠，
This was Hu’s gift to them.

但自己和张家的身分，是不是真的提高了呢？
Yet had their standing really risen?

这一点他却有些不大明白。
On that point he was uncertain.


这些念头如电闪一般在心头划过，一时也不暇去细思，
The thoughts flashed through him too quickly to examine.

因为人已到了厨房，
He was already in the kitchen.

先喊一声，“娘！”然后去到他丈母娘身边去看她做菜。
“Mother!” he called, then went over to watch her cook.

“厨房里脏！”阿珠的娘一面煎鱼，一面大声说道：
“It’s dirty in the kitchen!” she said loudly, busy frying a fish.

“你外头坐。”
“Go and sit outside.”

“不要紧！”
“That doesn’t matter.”

陈世龙不肯走。
Chen would not go.

这时是一条尺把长的鲫鱼，刚刚下锅，油锅正“哗哗”地响，
A crucian carp about a foot long had just gone into the pan, and the oil was hissing.

阿珠的娘全神贯注着，没有工夫跟他说话，
She was too intent on it to talk.

等下了作料，放了清汤，盖上锅盖以后，才用围裙擦一擦手，笑嘻嘻地问：“东西都料理好了？”
Only after adding the seasonings and clear stock and covering the pan did she wipe her hands on her apron and ask with a smile, “Have you sorted everything out?”

“都料理好了，
“Everything.

请出店一份份连夜去送，
I’ve asked the outside errand man to deliver the parcels tonight.

也挑他挣几个脚力钱。
It will let him earn a little in delivery fees too.

娘。”陈世龙又说，“我给你剪了两件衣服。
Mother, I also bought cloth for two outfits for you.

天气快冷了，我又替你买了个白铜手炉。”
The weather will soon be cold, so I bought you a white-copper hand-warmer as well.”

“我哪里有闲下来烘手炉的辰光？”
“When do I ever have time to sit holding a hand-warmer?

做丈母娘的说，“下次不要买，
Don’t buy anything next time.

啥也不要买，
Nothing at all.

何必去花这些钱？
Why spend money on these things?

再说，你现在也挣不到多少钱，
Besides, you don’t earn much yet.

一切总要俭朴。”
You must be economical in everything.”

话是好话，陈世龙不大听得进去。
It was good advice, though Chen did not much take it in.

不过他也了解，天下父母心都是如此。
Still, he understood that parents everywhere felt this way.

所以不答这句腔，把话题扯了开去。
Rather than answer that remark, he changed the subject.

就这样，他绕着丈母娘的身子转，谈到在上海、在松江的情形，絮絮不断地，真有那种依依膝下的意绪。
Thus he stayed close beside his mother-in-law, talking endlessly about Shanghai and Songjiang, with all the affection of a child at a parent’s knee.

阿珠的娘，一面忙着做菜，一面也兴味盎然地听他讲话，
While she cooked, she listened with keen interest.

有些事已听阿珠讲过，但再听一遍，仍然觉得有趣。
A’zhu had already told her some of the stories, but hearing them again was still a pleasure.


等厨房里整备停当，人座时又有一番谦让，
When the food was ready, there was another exchange of polite refusals over the places at table.

结果当然是黄仪上座。
Huang naturally took the seat of honour.

阿珠和她母亲，原可入席，而这天是例外，
Ordinarily A’zhu and her mother could have joined them, but that evening was an exception.

母女俩等前面吃完了，方始将残肴撤下来，叫爱珍一起坐下，将就着吃了一顿。
They waited until the men had finished, then brought back the remaining dishes and ate a makeshift meal with Aizhen.

吃完收拾，洗碗熄火，
Afterwards they cleared up, washed the dishes and put out the fire.

请事皆毕，而前面却还谈得很热闹。
Everything was done, but the talk in the front room was still lively.

老张回来多日，上海的情形他也很清楚，但一向不善同令也不喜说话，
Zhang had been back for days and knew Shanghai well enough, yet he had never been good at conversation or fond of it.

所以黄仪从他嘴里听不到什么。
Huang had learned little from him.

跟陈世龙在一起就不同了，
With Chen it was different.

他说话本有条理，记性又好，
Chen spoke clearly and remembered well.

形容十里夷场的风光，以及各式各样的人物，把个足不出里门的黄仪，听得神往不止。
His descriptions of the foreign settlement and its varied inhabitants filled Huang, who scarcely ventured outside his own neighbourhood, with longing.

这种不自觉流露的表情，不要说陈世龙，就连老张都看出来了，
His expression betrayed him so plainly that even Zhang noticed, let alone Chen.

因此当谈话告一段落时，他向黄仪说道，“上海倒是不可不去，
At a pause, Zhang said, “Shanghai is somewhere you really must see.

几时你也去走一趟？”
When will you go?”

“那一定要的。”
“I certainly shall.”

黄仪也是个不甘雌伏的人，
Huang was not a man content to remain in obscurity.

此时听了陈世龙的话，对胡雪岩有了一种新的想法，觉得跟了这个人去闯市面，是件很够劲的事，
Chen’s account had given him a new view of Hu: following such a man into the wider world of business would be exhilarating.

不过这番意思却不知如何表达，只问了声：“胡先生啥时光到湖州来？”
He did not know how to express this and merely asked when Hu would next come to Huzhou.

“他一时伯没有到湖州来的工夫。”陈世龙说，
“He probably won’t have time just yet,” Chen answered.

“上海、杭州方面的事，怕生了四只手都忙不过来。”
“With all his affairs in Shanghai and Hangzhou, even four hands wouldn’t be enough.”

“其实，我们在这里也是闲坐。”
“We’re only sitting idle here, really.”

陈世龙听出因头，当时不响。
Chen recognised an opening but said nothing then.

辞出张家时，表示要送黄仪回店，
When they left the Zhang house, he offered to walk Huang back to the firm.

那一个谈兴未央，欣然表示欢迎。
Still eager to talk, Huang gladly accepted.

于是回到大经丝行，泡了壶茶，剔亮了灯，继续再谈。
There they made tea, trimmed the lamp and resumed their conversation.

陈世龙依照胡雪岩的指示，以话套话，把黄仪所希望的“进帐”，探听清楚，
Following Hu’s instructions, Chen drew Huang out until he knew what income Huang hoped for.

然后说道：“胡先生很佩服你的文墨，
“Mr Hu admires your writing,” he then said.

他现在就少一个能够替他代代笔的人。
“He needs someone to take care of his correspondence.

胡先生经手的事，官私西面都很多，‘有些事情是不便叫第三者晓得的，
He handles a great deal of public and private business, some of which cannot be known to a third person.

只有心腹知己才可以代劳。
Only a trusted intimate can help with it.

这一个人很难找。”
Such a man is hard to find.”


“怎么样？”黄仪很注意地问，
“What?” Huang asked with close attention.

“胡先生是不是想叫我去？”
“Does Mr Hu want me to go?”

“他没有跟我说。”
“He didn’t tell me.”

陈世龙本来想说：如果你有意思，我可以写信给胡先生。
Chen had meant to add, “If you’re interested, I can write to him.”

转念一想，这样说法，即表示自己在胡雪岩面前的关系比他深，怕黄仪多心，
Then he reflected that this would suggest he stood closer to Hu than Huang did, which might make Huang suspicious.

因而改口说道：“如果胡先生有这个意思，当然直接会跟你商量的。”
Instead he said, “If Mr Hu has that in mind, naturally he will discuss it with you himself.”

“嗯，嗯！”
“Mm, mm.”

黄仪忽然想到，大经丝行的事也不坏，不必亟亟乎改弦易辙，便即答道：
It suddenly occurred to Huang that Dajing Silk Firm was a good place too; there was no need to hurry into a change.

“一动不如一静，
“Better to stay than move.

看看再说。”
We’ll wait and see.”

陈世龙一听话锋不对，知道是因为自己话太多了的缘故，心里深为澳悔。
Hearing the altered tone, Chen knew he had talked too much and deeply regretted it.

同时再也不肯多说，
He would say no more.

告辞回到自己住处。
Taking his leave, he went back to his own lodging.

多日不曾归家，灰尘积得甚厚，
Dust lay thick after his long absence.

又忙了大半夜，草草睡下，
He spent another half-night putting things right, then hastily went to bed.

这一天实在太累了，头一着枕，便已入梦。
The day had exhausted him; his head scarcely touched the pillow before he slept.

睡梦头里仿佛听得屋里有脚步声，但双眼倦涩，懒得去问。
In his dreams he seemed to hear footsteps in the room, but his eyes were too weary to open and he could not be bothered to ask.

翻个身想再寻好梦时，只觉双眼刺痛，
Turning over to seek another pleasant dream, he felt a sudden stab of light in his eyes.

用手遮着，睁眼看时，
He shaded them with a hand and looked.

但见红日满窗，阳光中一条女人的影子，
Bright sunlight filled the window, with a woman’s figure outlined against it.

急切问，辨不出是什么人？只是睡意却完全为这条俏拔的影子所驱除，
At first he could not tell who she was, but the slender silhouette drove away his sleepiness.

坐起来掀开帐门，细看，不由得诧异：
Sitting up and pulling aside the bed-curtains, he looked more closely.

“是你！”
“You!”

“是我！
“Yes, me.

你想不到吧？”
You didn’t expect me, did you?”

“真是不曾想到。”
“Certainly not.”

陈世龙不曾想到水晶阿七会突然出现。
He had never expected Crystal A’qi to appear.

梦意犹在，而又遇见梦想不到的情况，他的脑子被搅得乱七八糟，
Still half in a dream, confronted by something beyond his imagining, he was utterly confused.

茫然不知所措，只是看看窗外，又看看阿七，先要把到底是不是在做梦这个疑问，作个澄清。
He looked from her to the window and back again, first trying to establish whether he was awake at all.


“我盼望你好几天了！”阿七幽幽地说，
“I’ve been waiting for you for days,” A’qi said plaintively.

同时走了过来，由暗处到亮处站住脚，拿一双水汪汪的眼睛，在陈世龙脸上瞟来瞟去。
She came closer, stepping out of the shadow into the light, and let her liquid eyes move over his face.

这下陈世龙才把她看清楚，
Now he could see her clearly.

脂粉未施，鬓发蓬松，但不假膏沐，却越显她的“真本钱”，
She wore no powder or rouge, and her hair was loose, but the lack of grooming only revealed her natural attractions more fully.

白的雪白，黑的漆黑，
The white of her skin was snowy, the black of her hair jet-black.

一张嘴唇不知是不是上火的关系，红得象榴花。
Perhaps from excess inner heat, her lips were as red as pomegranate flowers.

身上穿一件紧身黑缎夹袄，胸前鼓蓬蓬，大概连肚兜都未带。
Her close-fitting black satin jacket swelled over her breasts; apparently she wore no bodice beneath it.

这触目惊心的一番打量，把他残余的睡意，驱除得干干净净，
This startling sight banished every remnant of sleep.

跳起身来，先把所有的窗子打开，然后大声说道：“你请外面坐！”
He sprang up, opened all the windows and said loudly, “Please sit outside.”

“为啥？”
“Why?”

“不方便！”
“It isn’t convenient.”

“怕什么！”阿七答道，
“What is there to fear?

“我们规规矩矩说话，
We’re talking properly.

又没有做啥坏事。”
We haven’t done anything wrong.”

“话不是这么说……”
“That isn’t the point...”

陈世龙心里十分着急，就无法跟她好好讲了，
In his anxiety, Chen could no longer explain patiently.

紧皱着眉，连连挥手，
Frowning, he waved his hand repeatedly.

“你最好请回去！
“You had better go home.

我这个地方你不要来。”
Don’t come here.”

这一说，阿七脸色大变，但愤怒多于羞惭，
Her face changed sharply, with more anger than shame.

同时也不能期望她能够为这么一句话气走，
Nor could he expect one remark to drive her off.

不但不走，反倒坐了下来，冷笑说道：
Instead of leaving, she sat down and sneered.

“小和尚，我晓得你已讨厌我了。”
“Little Monk, I know you’re tired of me now.”

看样子，她要撒泼。
It looked as though she meant to make a scene.

如果换了几个月以前，他倒也不在乎她，对骂就对骂，对打就对打，
A few months earlier he would not have cared: he could answer abuse with abuse and blows with blows.

如果她要哭、自己就甩手一走，
If she cried, he could simply walk away.

反正没有她占的便宜。
She would have gained nothing.

但现在情形不同了，
Now matters were different.

这中间关碍着身分，脸面，而最要紧的是嫌疑，
His standing and reputation were involved, and above all there was the danger of suspicion.

在郁四面前分辩不清楚，固然麻烦，若是风声传入阿珠耳中，更是件不得了的事，
Explaining himself to Yu Si would be troublesome enough; if word reached A’zhu, it would be disastrous.

因而只好想办法敷衍。
He must find some way to manage A’qi.


“不是讨厌你，
“It isn’t that I’m tired of you.

是不敢惹你。”陈世龙这样答道，
I dare not get involved with you,” Chen replied.

“你不想想你现在啥身分？我啥身分？”
“Think of your position now, and mine.”

“你啥身分我不晓得！
“I don’t know what your position is!

不过吃饭不要忘记种田人，
But when you eat, don’t forget the man who grew the rice.

不是我在胡老板面前替你说好话，你哪有今天？
Where would you be today if I hadn’t spoken for you to Mr Hu?

这话不是我丑表功，要你见我的情。
I’m not boasting of my services or demanding gratitude.

我不过表表心，让你晓得，
I only want you to know what is in my heart.

你老早把我抛到九霄云外，我总是时时刻刻想着你。”
You forgot me long ago, but I’ve never stopped thinking of you.”

这番话叫陈世龙无以为答，唯有报以苦笑：
Chen had no answer beyond a rueful smile.

“谢谢你！
“Thank you.

闲话少说，
But enough of that.

你有啥事情，灶王爷上天，直奏好了。”
If you have business, be like the Kitchen God going up to Heaven: make your report directly.”

“不作兴来看看你，
“Can’t I come to see you?

一定要有事才来？”
Must I have business?”

“好了，好了！”
“Enough!”

陈世龙又不耐烦了，
His patience was failing again.

“你晓得郁四叔的脾气的。
“You know Uncle Four’s temper.

而且我……”
Besides, I...”

他是要说，答应过胡雪岩，从此不跟她见面。
He had meant to say that he had promised Hu never to see her again.

但这话说出来，没意思，所以顿住了口，
But there was no point in saying that, and he stopped.

而阿七却毫不放松：
A’qi gave him no respite.

“男了汉、大丈夫，该说就说！
“Be a man and say what you have to say!

你有什么话说不出口。”
What can’t you bring yourself to tell me?”

“跟你不相干！
“Nothing that concerns you.

总而言之，你来看我，我谢谢你。
In any case, thank you for coming to see me.

现在看过了，你好走了！”
Now you’ve seen me, you can leave.”

阿七一听这话，霍地站起身来，把脚顿两顿才骂道：
At this she sprang up and stamped twice.

“你死没良心！”她咬牙切齿的，
“You heartless wretch!” she said through clenched teeth.

“我偏偏不走！”
“I won’t go!”


“你不走，我走！”
“If you won’t, I will!”

陈世龙摘下衣架上的夹袍，往身上一披，低头拔鞋，连正眼都不看她。
Chen took his lined gown from the clothes stand and slipped it on, then bent to pull on his shoes without looking at her.

“好了，好了！”
“All right, all right!”

阿七软语赔罪，
She softened her voice and tried to make peace.

“何必生这么大的气？”
“Why be so angry?”

陈世龙啼笑皆非，
He did not know whether to laugh or cry.

同时也不能再走了，
Nor could he now walk away.

因为这样要甩手一走，就会有人批评：第一欺侮女人，不算好汉，第二，说他连水晶阿七这样一个女人都应付不了。
If he did, people would say, first, that bullying a woman was unworthy of a man, and second, that he could not even cope with Crystal A’qi.

不走就得另打主意，
If he stayed, he must devise another approach.

陈世龙发过一阵脾气，
His fit of temper had passed.

此时冷静下来，觉得麻烦要找了来，推不掉就只有挺身应付，且看她说些什么？
More calmly, he reflected that trouble had sought him out: if he could not push it away, he must face it and hear what she had to say.

反正抱定宗旨，不理她，
He would hold firmly to his resolve and give her no encouragement.

等她走后，再到郁四那里和盘托出，
When she left, he would tell Yu Si everything.

原来就要去看郁四，转达胡雪岩的口信，
He had to see him anyway with Hu’s message.

正好“烧香看和尚，一事两勾当”。
As the saying went, burn incense and visit the monk—two errands accomplished together.

于是他拔上鞋子再扣衣纽，
Chen pulled on his shoes and began fastening his gown.

阿七还来帮他的忙，低着头替他扣腋下的扣子，
A’qi came to help, lowering her head to fasten the buttons beneath his arm.

露出雪白了这一段头颈，正在陈世龙眼下，
A stretch of white neck lay directly under his eyes.

他把视线移了开去，但“元宝领”中的散发出来的甜甜、暖暖的香味，却叫他躲避不了。
He turned his gaze away, but could not escape the warm, sweet scent rising from her high, ingot-shaped collar.

好在这只是片刻工夫，
Fortunately it lasted only a moment.

等把衣纽扣好，随即走到窗前一张凳子上坐下，预备好好应付麻烦。
As soon as the buttons were fastened, he sat on a stool by the window, ready to deal with the difficulty.

“我昨天刚刚到，
“I only arrived yesterday.

胡先生有好些要紧的事情，叫我替他去办。县衙门里杨师爷在等我，”
Mr Hu has several urgent matters for me to attend to, and Secretary Yang at the county yamen is waiting for me.”

陈世龙先表白一段，然后提出要求说：
Having stated his position, he made his request.

“你有话，爽爽快快说！
“Say what you have to say plainly.

我实在没有工夫陪你。”
I really haven’t time to keep you company.”


水晶阿七不即回答，
A’qi did not answer at once.

想了好一会才说：“本来有一肚皮的话，要细细的告诉你，
She thought for a good while before saying, “I had a bellyful of things to tell you, every detail of them.

所以特为起个早来。
That was why I got up specially early to come.

既然你没有工夫，要我爽爽快快地说，我就说一句：
Since you have no time, and want me to be quick and plain, I’ll ask just one thing.

三年前头，你跟我说过的那句话，
Three years ago you made me a promise.

算不算数？”
Does it still count?”

提到三年前，陈世龙就知道麻烦不小，
At the mention of three years ago, Chen knew he was in serious trouble.

那时阿七还没有跟郁四，跟陈世尤有过一段情。
Before A’qi had taken up with Yu Si, she and Chen had had a romance.

情热如火时，什么话都说出来，
When their passion burned hot, he had said all sorts of things.

陈世龙不知道她指的是哪句话？不过也可以想象得到，这句话在这时候来说，一定对自己不利。
He had no idea which promise she meant, but any promise she brought up now was sure to tell against him.

因此他先就来个“金钟罩”，概不认帐：
He therefore put on an armour of blanket denial.

“那时的话哪里好作数？”
“How can anything said then still count?”

“什么？”阿七咄咄逼人地，
“What?” she demanded fiercely.

“亏你说得出口，
“Aren’t you ashamed to say that?

说了话不算数？
Your word doesn’t count?

难道你小和尚是这种没肩胛的人？”
Is Little Monk the sort of man who refuses to take responsibility?”

“肩胛要看摆在什么地方？”陈世龙说，
“That depends on what I’m supposed to take responsibility for,” Chen said.

“我也不知道你指的是啥？
“I don’t even know what you mean.

如果说，我答应过你什么，譬如买衣料、打镯子什么的，我自然有肩胛，
If I promised to buy you cloth, say, or have bracelets made, of course I’ll stand by it.

倘或有些事情，当时做得到，现在做不到，再有肩胛的也没有办法。”
But if something was possible then and is impossible now, all the responsibility in the world won’t help.”

“你自然做得到。”阿七说道：
“Of course it’s possible.

“你倒再想想看，
Think again.

你答应过我一句什么话？”
What did you promise me?”

“我想不起，
“I can’t remember.

你说好了。”
Tell me.”

“你说过，要我跟你。
“You said you wanted me to come and live with you.

就是这句话！”
That was the promise!”


这句话却把陈世龙搞糊涂了，
This left Chen bewildered.

原来以为她只是想瞒着郁四来偷情，
He had assumed that she merely wanted a secret affair behind Yu Si’s back.

不道是这样一句话！
He had never expected this.

“那怎么行！”他脱口答道，
“How could that be?” he blurted out.

“你是郁四叔的人，
“You’re Uncle Four’s woman.

怎么谈得到此？”
How can you even speak of it?”

这是陈世龙失言，
He had made a false step.

他没有细想一想，如果她还是跟着郁四，怎么能说这话？
He had not stopped to reflect that if she were still living with Yu Si she could hardly make such a proposal.

阿七相当机警，捉住他这个漏洞，逼紧了问：
A’qi was quick enough to seize the opening.

“你是说，碍着郁老头？
“You mean Old Yu is the obstacle?

如果没有这重关碍，你当然还是有肩胛，说话一定算话！
Without that obstacle, of course you’d be a responsible man and keep your word.

是不是？
Isn’t that so?”

“话外有话，
There was something behind her words.

陈世龙再不敢造次，
Chen dared not answer rashly again.

先把她前后两句话的意思细想了一遍问道：“是不是你跟郁四叔散伙了？”
He considered her two remarks together, then asked, “Have you and Uncle Four parted company?”

“对！
“Exactly.

我跟郁老头散伙了。”
Old Yu and I have parted company.”

果有其事，
So it was true.

陈世龙不免诧异，
Chen was astonished.

照他知道，郁四是一天都离不开阿七的，
As far as he knew, Yu Si could not do without A’qi for a single day.

何以竟会散伙？
Why should they have parted?

莫非阿七做下什么不规矩的事，为郁四所不能容忍，赶出门去？
Had she behaved so badly that he could not tolerate her and had driven her out?

“你奇怪是不是？”阿七神色泰然地说，
“You’re surprised, aren’t you?” she said calmly.

“我先说一句，好叫你放心，
“Let me put your mind at rest.

我跟郁老头是好来好散的。”
Old Yu and I parted on good terms.”

这就越发不能理解了！
This was more incomprehensible still.

“是怎么回事？”
“What happened?

他说，“我有点不大相信。”
I find it rather hard to believe.”

“不要说你不相信，连我自己都不大相信。
“Never mind you—I can hardly believe it myself.

不过，这也该当你我要走到这一步，
But it must have been fated that you and I should come to this.

真正运气来了，城墙都挡不住。”
When good fortune arrives, even a city wall can’t keep it out.”

看她那种兴高采烈、一厢情愿的神气，陈世龙又好笑，又好气，
Her cheerful certainty that everything would turn out as she wished both amused and irritated Chen.

本来想拦着不让她说，但这一来马上又要吵架，她如何跟郁四散伙的经过，就听不到了。
He wanted to cut her short, but that would start another quarrel, and he would never learn how she and Yu Si had separated.

因而很沉着地听她讲完，催促着说：“你闲话少说！
He listened patiently to the end, then urged, “Never mind all that.

就讲郁四叔为啥跟你散伙好了。”
Just tell me why Uncle Four parted with you.”


“嗨！
“Ah!

提起来，真是说书先生的口头禅：”六月里冻杀一只老绵羊，说来话长！
As the storytellers say, ‘An old ram froze to death in the sixth month—a long tale lies behind it!’”

‘“说到这里，阿七的神色忽显哀伤，”
Her expression suddenly turned sorrowful.

你晓不晓得，阿虎死掉了？
“Do you know that A’hu is dead?”

“陈世龙大惊：
Chen was horrified.

“什么？
“What?

阿虎死掉了，
A’hu dead?

怎么死的？”
How did he die?”

“绞肠痧！
“A sudden intestinal illness.

可怜，
Poor fellow!

八月十四下半天得的病，一夜工夫就‘翘’掉了，
He fell ill on the afternoon of the fourteenth day of the eighth month and was gone overnight.

连个节都过不过！”
He didn’t even live to see the festival.”

陈世龙听得傻了，眼中慢慢流出两滴眼泪。
Chen sat stunned, and slowly two tears rolled from his eyes.

郁四生一子一女，
Yu Si had a daughter and one son.

阿虎就是他的独子，今年才二十二岁，去年娶的亲。
A’hu, his only boy, was just twenty-two and had married the year before.

为人忠厚，极重义气，跟陈世龙也算是要好弟兄，
Honest, kind and deeply loyal to his friends, he and Chen had been close as brothers.

尤其因为他父亲不准陈世龙上门，他似乎倒怀着歉意，所以对陈世龙格外另眼相看，
Because his father forbade Chen to visit their house, A’hu had seemed almost apologetic and had treated him with particular consideration.

三天两头不是来邀他听书、吃酒，就是来问问要不要铜钿用？
Every few days he came to invite him to a storytelling performance or out for a drink, or simply to ask whether he needed spending money.

这样一个好朋友，一别竟成永诀，
To think that when they had last parted, he had been saying farewell for ever to such a friend!

陈世龙自然要伤心。
Naturally Chen grieved.

但是，他的这两滴眼泪，在阿七看来，却别有会心，
A’qi, however, found another meaning in those two tears.

越觉得好事可成，因为这可以看出，陈世龙是有良心，重感情的。
They showed that he had a conscience and deep feelings, and made her all the more hopeful that her own wish would come true.


“你也不要难过。
“Don’t take it so hard.

死了，死了，死啦就了掉了！”
Dead is dead, and once you’re dead, it’s all over.”

阿七停一下说，
A’qi paused.

“我跟郁老头散伙，就是因为阿虎死了，才起的因头。
“It was A’hu’s death that led to my parting with Old Yu.

阿虎不死，将来他老子的家当，归他独得，哪个也不能说话，
If A’hu had lived, he alone would have inherited everything, and nobody could have said a word.

阿虎一死，又没有留下一儿半女，
But he died without leaving a child.

你想想看，
Think of it!

自然有人要动脑筋了。
Naturally somebody began to scheme.

你晓得是哪个动脑筋？”
Do you know who?”

陈世龙摇摇头，
Chen shook his head.

方在哀伤之际，懒得去想，也懒得说话。
In his grief he had no wish either to think or to talk.

“一说破，你就不会奇怪了，
“Once I tell you, you won’t be surprised.

是阿兰姐夫妇！”
Sister A’lan and her husband!”

阿兰姐是郁四的大女儿，今年快三十了，是个极厉害的角色，
A’lan was Yu Si’s eldest daughter, nearly thirty and a formidable woman.

年前，郁四跟他的同事，一个姓邢的刑房书办结了亲家。
Earlier, Yu Si had married her to the son of a colleague named Xing, a clerk in the criminal office.

老书办是世袭的行当，
The old clerks passed their occupation from father to son.

老邢去世，小邢进衙门当差，比他老了干得还出色，
When Old Xing died, Young Xing entered the yamen and proved still more capable than his father.

又可知是如何厉害的角色呢？
One could imagine what a formidable character he was too.

这对夫妇凑在一起，图谋回娘家来夺产，自是不足为奇之事。
It was hardly surprising that this pair should scheme to seize the property of her family.

陈世龙因为跟阿虎的交情，此时便想到阿虎嫂的将来，
Remembering his friendship with A’hu, Chen began to worry about the young widow’s future.

不由得愤愤说道：“阿兰姐是嫁出去的人，
“Sister A’lan has married out of the family,” he said indignantly.

她凭啥来动脑筋呢？”
“What right has she to scheme for it?”

“就是这话罗！
“Exactly!

‘嫁出去的女儿，泼出去的水’，
‘A married daughter is like water poured away.’

本来没啥脑筋好动，
There was nothing for her to get.

说来说去，是阿兰姐和她男人厉害，
But she and her husband are clever.

没事找事，脑筋动到了我头上。”
They invented a problem and turned their schemes on me.”

“怎么呢？”
“How?”

陈世龙有些想不通，
Chen could not understand.

“跟你啥相干？”
“What had it to do with you?”

“怎么不相干？
“How could it have nothing to do with me?

如果我替郁老头养个儿子，他们还有啥脑筋好动，
If I bore Old Yu a son, what could they hope to get?

所以把我看成眼中钉。
That made me a thorn in their eyes.

你懂了吧？”
Do you see?”

“懂是懂了！”陈世龙摇摇头，
“I see that,” Chen said, shaking his head.

“我就不懂郁四叔，怎么肯放你走？”
“What I don’t see is why Uncle Four was willing to let you go.”


“哼！”阿七冷笑道，
“Hmph!” A’qi sneered.

“你当郁老头是什么有良心的人？
“Do you imagine Old Yu has a conscience?

年纪一大把，‘色’得比哪个都厉害。
At his age he’s more lustful than anyone.

你道他那宝贝女儿怎么跟他说？”
Do you know what his precious daughter told him?”

“我想不出。
“I can’t imagine.

总归是郁四叔听得进去的话。”
Something he wanted to hear, no doubt.”

“自然罗！
“Of course!

说给他另外买人，又年轻、又漂亮，
She would buy him other women, young and pretty.

老色鬼还有啥听不进去。”
What was there in that for the lecherous old man to object to?”

照阿七打听来的消息是如此：阿兰姐劝她父亲，说阿七过了两三年，没有喜信，就不会有喜信了，
According to what A’qi had learned, A’lan had told her father that, since A’qi had failed to become pregnant in two or three years, she never would.

风尘出身的，“凉药”吃得多，根本不能生育。
Women from the pleasure quarters took so much ‘cooling medicine’ that they could not bear children.

没有儿子，只能在族中替阿虎嫂过继一个，偌大家产，将来白白便宜了别人。
Without a son, they would have to adopt a boy from the clan as an heir for A’hu’s widow, and all that property would eventually enrich someone else.

最好的办法，莫如买两个宜男之相的年轻女人做侍妾，
The best course was to buy two young concubines whose appearance promised sons.

必有得子之望。
Then there would surely be hope of an heir.

讲到这里，陈世龙插了一句嘴：
At this point Chen interrupted.

“什么，
“What?

还要买两个？”
Two of them?”

“是啊，
“Yes.

怕一个不保险，多弄一个。”
One might not be enough, so he must have another for insurance.”

阿七用讥嘲的口风说：
Her voice was mocking.

“有这样孝顺的女儿，做老子的，当然艳福不浅！”
“With such a dutiful daughter, a father can certainly expect plenty of female favours!”

“我懂了。
“I understand.

买这两个人，一定归阿兰姐经手，
Sister A’lan would choose and buy them, of course.

他们夫妇就从这上头一步一步踏进来，把持一切。
From there, she and her husband could move in step by step and take control of everything.

不过，”陈世龙说，“又何必把你看成眼中钉？”
But why did they have to make an enemy of you?”

“他们怕我坏她的事。
“They were afraid I’d spoil their plans.

在郁老头面前说，我会吃醋，搅得家宅不安。
They told Old Yu I’d be jealous and turn the household upside down.

最最气不过的是，”阿七咬牙切齿地说，“自己做贼，赖人做贼，
And the most infuriating thing of all,” she added through clenched teeth, “was that the thieves called someone else a thief!

说我一定会勾引了外面的野汉子，来谋他郁家的财产，
They said I’d be sure to seduce some lover outside and bring him in to steal the Yu family fortune.

小和尚你想想，这种女人，心毒不毒？”
Little Monk, tell me—could any woman be more vicious?”


话说到这里，全盘情况，皆已了解，
The whole picture was now clear.

郁四听了女儿的话，决定跟阿七散伙。
Yu Si had listened to his daughter and decided to part with A’qi.

既说“好来好散”自然有一笔钱可拿，照郁四的手面，这笔钱还不会少，没有五千，也有三千。
Since they had parted on good terms, she must have received a settlement, and, given his generous habits, it could hardly have been small: if not five thousand taels, then at least three thousand.

只不知道阿七自郁家下堂以后，是不是重张艳帜？
Chen wondered whether, after leaving Yu, she intended to return to her former profession.

不过，他心里虽然存疑，而且好奇心驱使，得问个明白，却终于不曾开口，
Curious as he was, he refrained from asking.

因为他要表示出事不干已，不闻不问的态度，好让阿七自己识趣，知难而退。
He wanted to appear wholly unconcerned, neither asking nor listening, so that she would take the hint and withdraw.

阿七却决不会如他的愿，
But A’qi had no intention of obliging him.

“现在谈到正事上头来了。”她说：
“Now we come to the real business,” she said.

“小和尚，我随郁老头唱了半出‘乌龙院’，
“Little Monk, Old Yu and I have acted out half of The Black Dragon Courtyard.

他走他的清秋大路，我也没有什么麻烦好找他的。
He can go his own open road, and I have no quarrel to pursue with him.

走的时候，总算客客气气，
We parted quite civilly.

房子是他买的，早已过户到我名下，所以该他搬出，
He bought the house, but he had already transferred it to my name, so he was the one who had to move out.

另外给了我一个他钱庄里的折子，数目是五千两，
He also gave me a passbook for five thousand taels at his bank.

只能取息，不能动本，
I can draw the interest, but not the principal.

这以后再说了，
We’ll see about that later.

是我名下的铜钿，我当然要提出来。
It’s money in my name, and naturally I mean to withdraw it.

他识相的，拉倒，
If he sees sense, well and good.

不识相我要打官司，
If not, I’ll sue.

好在王大老爷跟胡老板是好朋友……
Luckily, Prefect Wang and Mr Hu are close friends...”

““慢慢！”
“Wait!”

陈世龙当头泼她的冷水：
Chen threw cold water over this at once.

“你不要做梦！
“Don’t dream of it!

人家胡老板跟郁四叔等于弟兄一样，
Mr Hu and Uncle Four are practically brothers.

打到官司，一定帮他不帮你！”
If you sue, he’ll help him, not you.”

“那就不要他帮！”阿七答得极爽利，
“Then I don’t need his help!” she answered readily.

“我自己到堂上去告，说他那爿钱庄要‘倒灶’了，我不相信他，
“I’ll go into court myself and say his bank is about to fail and I don’t trust him.

可以不可以？”
Can I withdraw it then or can’t I?”

陈世龙为她那种自说自话的神态逗得笑了，
Her confidence that everything would happen just as she wished made Chen laugh.

“都随你！”
“Have it your own way!

他说，“你跟阿兰姐一样，都算是厉害角色！”
You and Sister A’lan are both formidable women.”


“我啥厉害？
“What’s formidable about me?

做人全靠心好！
All that matters is having a good heart.

象阿兰姐，哼，
As for A’lan—hmph!

也是到现在没有儿子，
She has no son herself yet.

将来有苦头吃。
She’ll have trouble enough in years to come.

这都不去说它了。”
But never mind all that.”

话到此处，阿七的神情变得郑重而兴奋，
A’qi grew earnest and excited.

“小和尚，从我跟郁老头分手，就有好些上门来打我的主意，
“Little Monk, since Old Yu and I parted, plenty of men have come with designs on me.

都叫我回绝掉了，
I turned them all away.

不识相的，我就爽爽快快的把他骂了出去。
If they wouldn’t take the hint, I simply cursed them out of the house.

我平日都不出门，
I hardly ever go out.

出门就是去打听你的消息。
When I do, it’s to ask for news of you.

我一直在守你，今天总算守到了。
I’ve been waiting and waiting, and today I’ve finally found you.

你先搬到我那里去住，
Move in with me first.

有话我们慢慢再说，”
We can talk everything over at leisure.”

长篇大套，自说自话完了，一只手就搭了过来，按在陈世龙肩膀上，
Having settled the matter to her own satisfaction in this long speech, she reached out and laid a hand on Chen’s shoulder.

同时一双俏伶伶的眼睛瞟着，是恨不得弄碗水来，把他一口吞了下去的神气。
Her lively eyes played over him, as though she longed for a bowl of water to wash him down whole.

陈世龙并不觉得好笑，
Chen found nothing amusing in this.

是着急，
He was alarmed.

没有想到她一厢情愿到痴的程度！
He had never imagined her wishful thinking could reach such a pitch of obsession.

照此看来，只怕她跟郁四过了两三年日子，心里是对他想了两三年，
Perhaps throughout her two or three years with Yu Si she had been thinking of Chen all the time.

牵丝攀藤这么多日子下来，要想好好摆脱是无论如何办不到的事。
If she had been winding these tendrils around him for so long, there could be no gentle way to break free.

那么怎么办呢？
What was he to do?

“说嘛！”她又催促，
“Tell me!” she urged.

“啥辰光搬？
“When will you move?

我那里通通现成，
Everything’s ready at my place.

不象你这里，一早起来，要茶要水，什么都没。
Not like here, where you get up in the morning and there’s neither tea nor water.

洗个脸都要到茶店里去。
You even have to go to a teashop to wash your face.

这种光棍打流的日子，你自己想想看，苦不苦？”
Think what a miserable life it is, drifting about as a bachelor!”

不对了！
This would never do.

就这片刻工夫，又是结结实实的一根藤缠了上来，
In those few moments another stout vine had wrapped itself around him.

这样下去，非让她捆得动弹不得不可。
At this rate she would bind him so tightly he could not move.

陈世龙心想，只有快刀一挥，才能斩断纠葛，
Only one swift cut could sever the tangle.

这在她自己受不了，但为了自保，不能不下辣手。
It would hurt her badly, but to save himself he must be ruthless.

“阿七！我骗你我天诛地灭！”他先罚个咒，让她知道决非设词推托：
“A’qi, may Heaven destroy me if I’m lying!” He began with an oath, to show that this was no excuse.

“小和尚老早有小厄姑了！”
“Little Monk already has his Little Nun!”


阿七的脸色大变，
A’qi’s face changed completely.

眼猜倒还是水汪汪的，不过象含了两泡泪水，
Her eyes were still liquid, but now they seemed full of tears.

脸上一阵青、一阵白，
Her face turned pale and ashen by turns.

摇摇头说：
She shook her head.

“我不相信！
“I don’t believe it.

是哪个？”
Who?”

“张家的阿珠。”
“A’zhu, from the Zhang family.”

“哪个张家的阿珠？”
“Which Zhang family?”

“原来摇船，现在开大经丝行的……”
“The one who used to work a boat and now runs the Dajing Silk Firm...”

“你在说啥！”
“What are you saying?”

阿七打断了他的话，显得十分困惑地，愣了好半天才说：
She broke in, utterly bewildered, and stared for a long moment before continuing.

“我还是不相信，
“I still don’t believe it.

摇船老张的女儿，不是胡老板的人吗？”
Isn’t the old boatman Zhang’s daughter Mr Hu’s woman?”

“你完全弄错了！
“You’ve got it all wrong.

人家是把阿珠当女儿看，
He treats A’zhu as a daughter.

哪里有啥别的意思？”
He never meant anything else.”

陈世龙又说，“就是这趟到上海，胡老板替我定下的亲事。
Chen went on, “He arranged the match for me on this trip to Shanghai.

聘礼都送过去，四样首饰，也是胡老板买的。
The betrothal gifts have already been sent—four kinds of jewellery, bought by Mr Hu himself.

总在今年年底，就要请大家吃喜酒。”
We’ll be inviting everyone to the wedding feast before the year is out.”

言之凿凿，不象撒谎，
He spoke with such assurance that it did not sound like a lie.

把阿七听得目瞪口呆，
A’qi was dumbfounded.

背脊上一阵阵发凉，颓然坐倒，只是喃喃地说，“有这种事情？
Chills ran down her back, and she sank into a chair, muttering, “Such a thing!

想都想不到的！”
I could never have imagined it.”

“就是罗！”
“Exactly.”

陈世龙此时如释重负，
Chen felt an enormous weight lift from him.

“就象你跟郁四叔散伙一样，
“Just like you and Uncle Four parting.

也是想都想不到的。”
Nobody could have imagined that either.”

“不过……”
“But...”

阿七霍地站了起来，仿佛犹不死心，最后还想跟阿珠争夺一番似地，
A’qi suddenly rose, as though she still refused to admit defeat and meant to make one last attempt to wrest him from A’zhu.

但是力不从心，终于气馁。
Yet she had no strength for it, and her courage failed.


“阿七！”陈世龙安慰她说，“人都是缘分。
“A’qi,” Chen said soothingly, “everything depends on fate.

我们缘分不到，没有话说。
We weren’t meant for each other, and there’s nothing to be done.

你也不要难过，
Don’t be unhappy.

象你这样的人，不怕没人要。
A woman like you need never fear that nobody will want her.

“他又说：”你的心好，好心自有好报。
You have a good heart, and a good heart gets its reward.

你请回去吧，
Go home now.

我送你回去。
I’ll see you off.”

“阿七象斗败了的公鸡似地，垂头不语，慢慢站起身来，
She hung her head like a defeated fighting cock and slowly rose without a word.

脸上浑不似初来时那种芍药带露、艳光逼人的神采，
None of the dazzling freshness of her arrival, like a peony wet with dew, remained.

气色灰暗，倒象一下子老了十年。
Her face was dull and grey; she seemed to have aged ten years in an instant.

陈世龙瞻念旧情，不能无动于衷，
Remembering their old affection, Chen could not remain unmoved.

但怜念一生，马上又感到双肩都有沉重的压力，
But as soon as pity stirred, he felt a heavy weight on each shoulder.

一只肩上是与阿珠偕老的盟约，想到在船上跪在她面前求婚所许下的诺言，
On one rested his pledge to grow old with A’zhu, the promises he had made as he knelt before her on the boat and asked her to marry him.
