一只肩膀上是胡雪岩的情分，想到他提携爱护，待自己嫡亲的子弟，亦不过如此，
On the other rested his debt to Hu Xueyan, who had encouraged and protected him as generously as if he had been his own flesh and blood.

自己何能去找这种一沾上便摆不开的麻烦，以致耗神废业，辜负了他的期望？
How could he seek out a trouble that, once entangled in it, he would never shake off, wasting his energies, neglecting his work and disappointing Hu’s hopes?

这样一转念，他的心肠便又硬了。
At this thought his heart hardened again.

对阿七的神情，视如不见，走出巷，招手喊过一顶小轿来，
Ignoring A’qi’s dejection, he went out of the alley and hailed a small sedan chair.

同时早就拈了块只多不少的碎银子在手里，
He already had a piece of silver in his hand, more than enough for the fare.

等轿子抬到，他把碎银子递了过去，交代了阿七的住处，使往旁边一站，意思是等她上轿。
When the chair arrived, he gave it to the bearers, told them her address and stood aside, waiting for her to get in.

“小和尚！”阿七这样喊了一声，欲言又止，只拿忧郁而惶惑的眼色看着他。
“Little Monk!” she said, then stopped, looking at him in melancholy bewilderment.

“你回去吧！”
“Go home.”

陈世龙觉得要有句话，哪怕是敷衍的话，也得说一句，才能叫她上轿，因而顺口又说：“有空我来看你！”
He felt that he must say something, however empty, to persuade her to enter, and added without thinking, “I’ll come and see you when I have time.”

阿七点点头，脸上有着感激的意味，移步从放倒的轿杠上跨了进去，
She nodded gratefully and stepped over the lowered poles.

回身倒退着进轿时，又是深深地一瞥，为陈世龙留下来无数幽怨。
Turning to back into the chair, she gave him one last deep look, leaving him burdened with all her unspoken sorrow.


这时太阳已经很高了，
The sun was high by now.

十月小阳春，阳光明亮，照得人有些目，陈世龙觉得有些晕淘淘，
In this brief return of spring in the tenth month, its bright light was almost dazzling, and Chen felt rather dazed.

信步踏进一爿小茶店，洗脸喝茶点心，
He wandered into a little teashop, washed his face and had tea and something to eat.

静静坐了一会，脑子才算完全清醒。
Only after sitting quietly for a while did his mind become fully clear.

想想这天该做的事，
He considered the day’s business.

第一件就是到阿虎灵前一拜，同时把胡雪岩的话交代了郁四。
First he must pay his respects before A’hu’s spirit tablet and deliver Hu’s message to Yu Si.

于是他取钱托茶博士办来一份素烛清香，往北门郁四的老家走了去。
He gave the tea attendant money to buy plain candles and incense, then walked to Yu Si’s family home near the north gate.

进门就淌眼泪，一路淌到灵前，
Tears began to flow as he entered, and continued all the way to the mourning altar.

焚烛上香，
He lit the candles and incense and bowed.

拜罢起身，只见阿兰头上簪一朵白花，手扶在一个小丫头的肩上，袅袅婷婷地走了出来。
As he rose, A’lan appeared, a white flower pinned in her hair, walking gracefully with one hand resting on a little maid’s shoulder.

一见了面少不得又是“流泪眼观流眼泪”，
At their meeting, each looked through tears at the other’s tearful face.

阿兰姐一面抹眼泪，一面为陈世龙说阿虎得病的经过。
Wiping her eyes, A’lan told him how A’hu had fallen ill.

接着又说她父亲晚年丧子，家门如何不幸，
She spoke of their family’s misfortune, and of her father losing his son in old age.

然后再谈阿七，指她不安于室，
Then she turned to A’qi, accusing her of being restless and unfaithful.

又说阿七日夜吵着要进郁家的门，
A’qi, she said, had clamoured day and night to enter the Yu family household.

不但进门，还要做阿虎嫂的婆婆，要给她磕头。
Nor was that all: she wanted to become A’hu’s widow’s mother-in-law and have the young woman kowtow to her.

“小和尚，你想想看！
“Little Monk, think!

这是做不做得到的事情？”
Was such a thing possible?

阿兰姐说，“明晓得做不列，天天又哭又闹，
She knew perfectly well it wasn’t, yet every day she cried and made scenes.

她打的是什么主意？
What was she after?

还不是一想就明白！
One moment’s thought makes it plain.

所以大家都劝爹，放她走路算了，
We all urged Father to let her go.

这件事提来鸭屎臭，
The whole affair stinks of duck dung.

你见了我爹，不必说起。
Don’t mention it when you see him.

免得他老人家心里不舒服。”
It will only upset him.”

照她说来，是阿七不对。
In her account, A’qi was to blame.

不过陈世龙也不尽相信她的话，只觉得事不关己。不必多问，
Chen did not entirely believe her, but it was no affair of his and there was no need to ask further.

所以点点头说：
He nodded.

“我晓得了。
“I understand.

四叔是不是在茶店里？”
Is Uncle Four at the teahouse?”

“是啊！”
“Yes.

阿兰说，“你昨天叫人送了胡老板的礼来，他才晓得你回来了。
When you sent over Mr Hu’s gifts yesterday, he learned you were back.

一早就要到碧浪春去等你。
He went to Bilangchun early this morning to wait for you.

你就到那里去看他吧！”
Go and see him there.”


到了碧浪春，只见郁四仍旧坐在马头桌子上，
At Bilangchun, Yu Si sat at his usual horse-head table.

人瘦了不少。
He had grown much thinner.

陈世龙叫过一声：“四叔”，相顾黯然。
Chen greeted him as “Uncle Four,” and they looked at one another sadly.

“你昨天到的？”郁四有气没力地说。
“You arrived yesterday?” Yu asked listlessly.

“是的。
“Yes.

昨天下半天到的。”说了这一句话，陈世龙忽然转到一个念头，
Yesterday afternoon.” As he said this, a thought struck Chen.

在“家门”里，他的“前人”跟郁四是“同参”，
Within their brotherhood, his initiating master had been Yu Si’s fellow initiate.

师父一死，郁四就算嫡亲的长辈，
Since the master’s death, Yu counted as his closest elder.

为了阿七不准自己上门，并不是不照应自己，
Forbidding him to visit because of A’qi did not mean that Yu had ceased to look after him.

起码胡雪岩这条路子就是从这位长辈身上来的，
At the very least, it was through this elder that he had come to know Hu Xueyan.

“家门”里讲究饮水思源，“引见”之恩不可忘。
In the brotherhood, a man must remember the spring from which he drank: the favour of an introduction must never be forgotten.

照此说来，昨天一到，应该先去看他，
He should therefore have called on Yu as soon as he arrived yesterday.

自己是走错了一步，
That had been a mistake.

尤其这天早晨，阿七又来密访，
Worse still, A’qi had paid him a secret visit this morning.

“光棍心多，麻布筋多”，
‘A crafty fellow has as many suspicions as hemp has fibres.’

如果郁四把这两件事摆在一起想一想，搞出什么误会来，那就“跳到黄河洗不清”了！
If Yu put the two things together and misunderstood, Chen could never wash himself clean, even in the Yellow River.

所以正好趁此刻先作一个不着痕迹的解释。于是他说：
Here was his chance to explain without appearing to do so.

“四叔！昨天一到，我就先要给你老人家来请安的，
“Uncle Four, the moment I arrived yesterday I meant to come and pay my respects.

哪晓得一到了老丈人那里，硬给他们留住了。”
But once I reached my father-in-law’s, they insisted on keeping me.”

这段话有两层用意，一是解释他所以昨天一到未去看郁四的原因，二是表示他已经定了亲，决不会再跟阿七搅七念三。
This served two purposes: it explained his failure to visit the previous day, and announced that he was engaged and would no longer become entangled with A’qi.

然而郁四却有些莫名其妙，
Yu, however, was bewildered.

“你说啥？”
“What are you saying?

他问“啥个老丈人？
What father-in-law?

你几时定的亲，
When did you get engaged?

怎么我不晓得？”
Why didn’t I know?”

“湖州还没有人晓得，
“Nobody in Huzhou knows yet.

是这趟胡先生作主替我定下的。”
Mr Hu arranged it for me on this trip.”

“噢！”
“Oh!”

郁四显然自这喜讯中，受到了鼓舞，
The good news visibly heartened Yu.

失神的双眼，有了闪闪的亮光，
His dull eyes began to shine.

“好极！
“Splendid!

是哪一家的姑娘？”
Whose daughter is she?”

“这话说来很长，也很有趣，
“It’s a long story, and an interesting one.

四叔万万想不到的。”
You’d never guess, Uncle Four.”

陈世龙先宕开一句：
Chen put him off for the moment.

“ 胡先生还有他自己的事情，要我跟四叔谈。”
“Mr Hu also has some business of his own for me to discuss with you.”

这话郁四明白，自然是头寸上的事，
Yu understood: naturally, it concerned funds.

于是他站起身来说：
He stood up.

“这里人来人往，
“People are always coming and going here.

静不下来。
There’s no peace.

走，到聚成去！”
Come along to Jucheng.”



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十六章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Sixteen, concluding part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


聚成钱庄中，特为给郁四预备了一个房间，他有许多衙门里的公事，都在这里处理。
Jucheng Bank kept a room especially for Yu Si, and he dealt with much of his official business there.

这天却是清闲无事，
Today, however, he was free.

陈世龙从容细谈，
Chen Shilong could talk at leisure.

先把胡雪岩在上海、杭州的情形，大致说了一遍，最后谈到他头寸的话。
He first gave a general account of Hu Xueyan's affairs in Shanghai and Hangzhou, then came to his need for funds.

郁四跟胡雪岩是有约定的，阜康代为放款，比同行拆息还便宜，照一般放款利息折半计算，当然也不需要什么担保。
Yu and Hu already had an arrangement: Fukang lent out Yu's money and paid him half the interest charged to its borrowers—a cost lower even than the interbank rate—and naturally no security was required.

郁四把聚成的档手喊了进来，
Yu called in Jucheng's manager.

一问可以调拨三万银子，便即关照，马上汇到杭州阜康。
On learning that thirty thousand taels could be made available, he instructed him to remit the money to Fukang in Hangzhou immediately.


谈完“公事”，陈世龙谈私事，把胡雪岩对阿珠的用心及处置，从头细叙。
Their business concluded, Chen turned to his private affairs and recounted, from the beginning, Hu's intentions and arrangements concerning A’zhu.

郁四觉得比听书还要有味，
Yu found it more entertaining than a storyteller's performance.

从烟榻听到饭桌上，再由饭桌听到烟榻上。
He listened on the opium couch, continued listening at the dining table, and returned to the couch for more.

听完说道：“老胡这个人，真要佩服他！
When Chen finished, he said, “You have to admire Old Hu!

做出来的事，别出心裁，真正漂亮！”
The things he does are so original, and so beautifully managed.”

“四叔，”陈世龙说，“喜事总在年底，
“Uncle Four, the wedding should be towards the end of the year.

那时候发帖子，要你老人家替我出面。”
When we send out invitations, I'll need you to represent me.”

“那当然！”
“Naturally!”

说到这里，长叹一声：
He gave a long sigh.

“你倒好了……”
“Things have turned out well for you...”

这自是触景生情，想起阿虎，
The occasion had evidently brought A’hu to mind.

陈世龙赶紧说道：“四叔，你老人家不要难过！
Chen hastened to say, “Don't grieve, Uncle Four.

阿虎不在了，还有我侍奉你老人家。”
A’hu is gone, but I'm still here to look after you.”

一听这话，郁四的眼圈红了，
Yu's eyes reddened.

也不知是伤子还是为陈世龙而感动？
Whether from grief for his son or gratitude to Chen, it was hard to tell.

但终于强自振作起来，
At last he forced himself to rally.

“小和尚！”他说，“你晓得的，我这个做四叔的，也有对不起你的地方，
“Little Monk, you know I've wronged you in some ways.

现在事情过去了，也不必多说了。
That's past, and we needn't say more.

你现在成家立业，朝正路上走去，
Now you're establishing a home and a livelihood and taking the proper road.

我高兴得很，
I'm delighted.

亲事自然我来出面，一切都是我的。
Of course I'll represent you in the marriage, and I'll take responsibility for everything.

那四样首饰，你打听打听看，老胡是花多少银子办的，
Find out how much Old Hu paid for those four kinds of jewellery.

我来还他。
I'll repay him.

有我在，这笔聘礼不好叫他出。”
With me here, he ought not to pay for your betrothal gifts.”


陈世龙自然感激。
Naturally Chen was grateful.

但他虽只跟了胡雪岩短短一段日子，因为人既聪明灵活，又是衷心受教，人情世故的阅历上，大非昔比，
Yet, brief as his time with Hu had been, his intelligence, adaptability, and wholehearted willingness to learn had greatly advanced his understanding of the world.

此时心里在想，自己是出于一番至诚，安慰长辈，而郁四居然拿自己当亲人看待，
He had sincerely meant to comfort an elder; now Yu was treating him as family.

原是好事，
That was good in itself.

但郁家迟早要闹家务，阿兰姐正在动娘家的脑筋，
But trouble would come sooner or later within Yu's household, and Sister A’lan was already scheming about her parents' property.

自己再受郁四的好处，叫别人看来，仿佛他也是乘虚而入，在打郁四的主意，
If he accepted benefits now, people might think he too was taking advantage of Yu's vulnerability.

这个嫌疑不可不避。
He must avoid that suspicion.

避嫌疑犹是小事，
Even that was a lesser concern.

眼前看样子是阿兰姐在替郁四当家，
A’lan appeared to be managing Yu's household now.

买那四样首饰也要千两银子，由郁四捧出来还给胡雪岩，阿兰姐知道了，心里先将不舒服，闲话可就多了！
The four kinds of jewellery would cost a thousand taels; if Yu paid that sum back to Hu, A’lan would be displeased as soon as she heard, and there would be no end of talk.

“怎么？”
“Well?”

郁四见他不作声，倒真有困惑了，
Yu was puzzled by his silence.

“那还有什么话说？”
“What is there to say about it?”

陈世龙已决定辞谢郁四的好意，不过这话不知如何措词？
Chen had decided to decline but could not find the words.

经他一逼，只好这样答道：“四叔！不是我不识拾举，
Pressed, he answered, “Uncle Four, it isn't that I fail to appreciate your kindness.

我是想争口气，这件事我要自己来办。
I want to prove myself and manage this myself.

为来为去也是为四叔争气，
Ultimately, that will do you credit too.

说起来，四叔可以告诉人家，小和尚是自己讨的亲，
You'll be able to tell people that Little Monk paid for his own marriage.

我要替他出聘礼，他用不着。
You offered to provide the betrothal gifts, but he didn't need it.

这不是四叔也有面子。”
Won't that give you something to be proud of?”


江湖上讲究面子，也看重“人贵自立”这句话，
In their world, standing mattered, and so did the saying that a man should support himself.

尤其是做长辈的，听他这样说，自然要嘉许，
An elder could hardly withhold approval.

“你这两句话，我听了倒高兴。
“I'm pleased to hear you say that.

不过，”
But...”

郁四又以告诫的语气说，
Yu's tone became admonitory.

“你刚刚出道，
“You're only just starting out.

不要别的本事没有学会，先学会说大话。
Don't learn to boast before you learn anything else.

那就不对了！”
That wouldn't do.”

“我是实实在在的话。
“I'm speaking honestly.

尤其是在四叔面前，说大话算哪一出？”
What would be the point of boasting, especially before you?”

“那么，我倒问你。”郁四很认真地，“你哪里来的钱讨亲？
“Then let me ask you seriously: where will you get the money to marry?

你不是说四样首饰是老胡替你买的吗？”
Didn't you say Old Hu bought the jewellery for you?”

“是啊！
“Yes.

胡先生替我垫银子买的，
Mr Hu advanced the money.

将来我分了花红可以还他。
I can repay him from my share of the profits later.

如果是四叔替我出了这笔钱，将来我说拿了来还四叔，不是要挨骂了吗？”
If you provided the money, wouldn't you scold me when I tried to pay you back?”

“那也一样。
“It's all the same.

你有了钱也可以孝敬孝敬我的！”
When you have money, you can show your respect for me too.”

“那还用说？
“Of course!

我有了钱不孝敬四叔，把哪个用？
If I don't honour you with it, whom should I spend it on?

不过眼前要请四叔，帮我做过面子争口气，
For now, though, please help me keep my pride and prove myself.

一切让我自己来。”
Let me manage everything.”

听了他的话，郁四又高兴、又困扰，
Yu was both pleased and perplexed.

高兴的是他前面那两句话，就算是米汤，心里也舒服。
The first part delighted him: even if it was flattery, it felt good.

困扰的是后面那两句话，
The second troubled him.

不管他，让他自己去料理，是帮他争气做面子，出钱替他办喜事，反倒不是！
Leaving Chen to his own devices would help him prove himself and preserve his standing; paying for his wedding would apparently do the opposite!

这成何话说。
What sort of reasoning was that?


虽不成话，却驳不倒！
Unreasonable though it sounded, Yu could not refute it.

郁四把头往后仰一仰，打量了陈世龙一番，拿签子指指点点地说：
Leaning back, he studied Chen and pointed at him with the opium needle.

“两三个月不见，我看你是变过了！
“I haven't seen you for two or three months, and you've changed!

长衫上身，倒也蛮象个‘大二先生’的样子，
In that long gown, you look quite like a senior business clerk.

说两句话，异出异样，比上头的‘官腔’还要难应付。
And the things you say are so extraordinary that they're harder to answer than an official pronouncement from above.

这都是你从老胡那里学来的？”
Did you learn all this from Old Hu?”

其词若憾，其实深喜，
He sounded regretful but was secretly delighted.

陈世龙笑笑不答，站起身来说：
Chen merely smiled, then stood.

“四叔，我还有几桩事情，等着要去接头。
“Uncle Four, I have several matters to attend to.

明天再来看你老人家。”
I'll come and see you again tomorrow.”

“明天到我家来，北门！”
“Come to my house tomorrow—the North Gate house.”

郁四特地交代明白，接着又叹口气，
Yu made the address quite clear, then sighed again.

“唉，这一阵的日子，不是人过的，
“These days have been unbearable.

今天见了你，心里好过得多。
Seeing you today has made me feel much better.

你晚上有空，最好再来一趟，
If you're free tonight, do come again.

我还有些话要告诉你，
I have more to tell you.

如果今天晚上没空，明天上午一定来，
If you can't come tonight, you must come tomorrow morning.

茶店里我这一向也少去，
I seldom go to the tea shop now.

今天是为了等你，
I went today only to wait for you.

不然我也就在家里孵孵算了，
Otherwise I'd have stayed brooding at home.

衙门里的差使，我都想辞掉。
I even think of giving up my post at the yamen.

没有意思！”
There's no point!”

说着，摇头不止。
He shook his head repeatedly.

郁四居然连世袭的差使，都不想要了，可知心境灰恶。
That Yu could contemplate abandoning even his hereditary position showed how despondent he had become.

陈世龙于心不忍，颇想再陪他坐一会，说些夷场上有趣的见闻，为他遣愁破闷，
Chen felt sorry for him and wanted to stay, entertaining him with interesting stories of the foreign settlement.

无奈这一夭，从水晶阿七来访开始，已经耽误了太多的工夫，
But the day had already been delayed too long, beginning with Crystal A’qi's visit.

不得不走，去办正事。
He had to leave and attend to business.


等一个圈子兜下来，把胡雪岩交代的事情办妥，已是近夕照黄昏，
By the time he completed his rounds and finished the tasks Hu had entrusted to him, the evening light was fading.

匆匆赶到大经丝行，只见黄仪迎着他说道：
He hurried to Dajing Silk Firm, where Huang Yi came forward to greet him.

“你丈母娘刚走，
“Your mother-in-law has just left.

把你的房间铺陈好，还等了好一歇辰光，看看你不来，只好回去。
She made up your room and waited quite a while, but when you didn't come, she had to go home.

临走千叮万嘱，一定要你到家吃饭。
Before leaving, she told me over and over to send you there for supper.

丈母娘待女婿，真正是没话说。”
Nobody could fault the way she treats her son-in-law!”

“我心里也急。”
“I've been anxious too.”

陈世龙有些不安。
Chen felt uneasy.

“实在是分不开身，
“I simply couldn't get away.

现在也还不能去，
Even now I can't go immediately.

我想先给胡先生写封信，好趁早叫航船带出。”
I want to write to Mr Hu first and send the letter on the regular boat as soon as possible.”

“晚上回来写也不迟。
“You can write when you come back tonight.

好在你今天总要住在这里。”
You're staying here anyway.”

“不！”
“No!”

陈世龙觉得住在大经，便好似“入赘”一般，
Living at Dajing seemed to Chen much like marrying into his wife's household.

有骨气的男子汉是不肯做赘婿住在岳家的，
A man with backbone would not live as a dependent son-in-law in his wife's family home.

因而很坚决地表示：“我还是住在我自己那里。”
He therefore said firmly, “I'm still staying at my own place.”

黄仪了解他的用心，点点头说：
Huang understood.

“这也随你。
“That's up to you.

不过我劝你早点到张家，
But I'd advise you to go to the Zhangs soon.

信到那里去写也一样。”
You can write the letter there just as well.”


这个建议，陈世龙接受了。
Chen accepted that suggestion.

赶到张家，正好是阿珠来开的门。
When he reached the Zhang house, A’zhu herself opened the door.

这一次不象昨天那样不好意思了，
This time she was not as embarrassed as she had been the day before.

她用微带埋怨的口吻说，“怎么到这时候才来？”
“Why have you come so late?” she asked with a trace of reproach.

“遇以好些意想不到的事。
“Several unexpected things happened.

唉！”
Ah!”

陈世龙摇摇头。
He shook his head.

“一进门就叹气，”阿珠十分关切地，“为啥？”
“Sighing as soon as you come in! Why?” She was deeply concerned.

“不是我的事。”陈世龙怕她误会，先这样说一句，好叫她放心，
“It isn't anything that's happened to me,” he said first, lest she misunderstand and worry.

“一个要好弟兄，想不到死掉了。
“A close friend has died unexpectedly.

真正天有不测风云，人有旦夕祸福。”
Truly, storms come without warning, and a person's fortune can change overnight.”

看他神情不怡，阿珠也郁郁地不开心。
His unhappy expression saddened her too.

关上大门，把他带到客堂说道：
Closing the front gate, she led him into the sitting room.

“爹吃喜酒去了。没有人陪你。
“Father has gone to a wedding feast, so there's nobody to keep you company.

要不要到厨房里来？”
Would you like to come into the kitchen?”

“要来的！”
“Certainly.

陈世龙说，“等我到厨房里去打个招呼，抽空给胡先生写信。”
I'll greet your mother there, then find a moment to write to Mr Hu.”

这个招呼一打就是好半天工夫，
The greeting took a long time.

阿珠的娘一面炒菜，一面问长问短问陈世龙这天做了些什么？
As she cooked, A’zhu's mother asked question after question about what Chen had done that day.

于是谈阿虎就谈不完，
Once they began discussing A’hu, there was no end to it.

自然水晶阿七那一段，他只字不会提的。
Naturally, he said nothing whatever about Crystal A’qi.

“好了！”阿珠等要开饭时笑道，“信也写不成了。”
“Well,” A’zhu said with a smile when the meal was ready, “you haven't managed to write your letter after all.”

“吃了饭写，
“I'll write after supper.

今天非写不可。”
It must be done today.”


这是正事，阿珠的娘把它看得很重要，
This was proper business, and A’zhu's mother regarded it as important.

吃完饭，忙着收桌子，泡上茶来，摆出笔砚，
After the meal, she hurried to clear the table, make tea, and set out brush and inkstone.

阿珠又替他铺纸磨墨，
A’zhu spread the paper and ground the ink for him.

连陈世龙自己都觉得这样子未免太郑重，
Even Chen felt that they were making too much of it.

便自嘲似地说，“不象写信，倒象给皇帝写奏折。”
“This looks less like a letter than a memorial to the emperor,” he said with a self-mocking smile.

“闲话少说，
“Less chatter!

快点写好了，送到航船上。
Finish it quickly and take it to the boat.

晚上，人家都睡了，那就得明天起个大早才赶得上。”
If they've gone to sleep, you'll have to get up very early tomorrow to catch them.”

明天有明天的事，
Tomorrow would have its own business.

陈世龙感恩图报，决心要好好巴结，守定今日事今日毕的宗旨，
Determined to repay kindness through diligent work, Chen held to the rule of finishing today's tasks today.

当时定一定心，把胡雪岩交代的事，办得如何，逐项写明。
He collected his thoughts and reported, item by item, how he had carried out Hu's instructions.

最后提到郁四，说他独子病故，而且要闹家务，精神颓唐，
At the end, he mentioned Yu: his only son's death, the threatened family troubles, and his low spirits.

当然，也提到了他的喜事。
Naturally, Chen included news of his own marriage arrangements.

写完看一看钟，已经九点敲过，
When he finished and looked at the clock, it had already struck nine.

匆匆告辞，自己送到去杭州的航船上。然后径自回家。
He hurriedly took his leave and delivered the letter himself to the boat bound for Hangzhou, then went straight home.


未曾进门就已发现了怪事，
Before he reached his door, he noticed something strange.

他屋里亮着灯，而且不止一盏灯亮。
There was light inside—and more than one lamp was burning.

陈世龙出门向来不上锁，
Chen never locked his door when he went out.

因为没有什么东西好偷，而钥匙忘记带出来，或者虽带出来而遗失反倒麻烦，
There was nothing worth stealing, and forgetting or losing a key would be a nuisance.

好在同一个大门里的邻居会替他照看，不锁更不要紧。
Besides, neighbours who shared the entrance could keep an eye on the place.

有时朋友来访，见他不在家径自推门入内坐等，事或有之，
Sometimes a visiting friend, finding him absent, would push open the door and sit down to wait.

但都在白天，
But that happened by day.

象这样的情形，还是头一回，不免令人诧异，同时也逗人的好奇心，
This was the first such occasion at night, and it surprised and intrigued him.

陈世龙心想，倒要看看是哪一个？
Who could it be?

这样转着念头，就不肯直接推门去看，蹑手蹑脚走到窗下，找个窗纸破了的洞洞，凑眼过去张望。
Instead of entering directly, he crept beneath the window and peered through a hole in the paper.

一望就知道麻烦大了。
One look told him he was in serious trouble.

里面是水晶阿七，对着一盏擦得雪亮的油灯在喝茶，两眼怔怔地望着另一张桌上的油灯，仿佛有无数心事在盘算。
Crystal A’qi sat drinking tea by a lamp polished bright, her eyes fixed on another lamp across the room, as though turning over countless worries.

看她身上穿一件紫红宁绸的小夹袄，
She wore a purplish-red, lined jacket of Ning silk.

领子上的纽扣未扣，敞得极大，一股系肚兜的金链子，隐约可见，
Its collar was unfastened and spread wide, revealing glimpses of the gold chain that held her underbodice.

这副样子让人看见了，不说“水晶阿七跟小和尚有一腿”，那才真叫有鬼！
Anyone seeing her like this would certainly say that Crystal A’qi and Little Monk were having an affair.

陈世龙十分火冒，走到房门口，提脚就踢，
Furious, Chen went to the door and raised his foot to kick it.

但就在拉起脚的刹那，心中自语，
At that instant, he checked himself.

慢来！
Wait!

看样子阿七不知安着什么心？
Who knew what she intended?

他知道她的为人，心是不坏，但吃了那碗饭，脸皮就撕破了，什么好刁泼辣的事，都做得出来。
Her heart was not bad, but her former occupation had stripped away her inhibitions, and she could be as wilful and defiant as anyone.

也许她是故意的，好说不行，存心来撩拨得自己跟她吵架，
Perhaps, having failed by persuasion, she deliberately meant to provoke a quarrel.

传到阿珠耳朵里，这饥荒有得打。
If word reached A’zhu, there would be trouble enough.

万一吵散，阿七就得其所哉了！
Should the engagement break off, A’qi would have got just what she wanted.

念头转到这里，自觉是“小人之心”，
Chen felt that this suspicion was mean-minded.

但记起黄仪常说的两句话：“害人之心不可有，防人之心不可无”，
Yet he remembered Huang's saying: never intend harm, but never fail to guard against it.

象阿七这种人不可不防，
He must be cautious with someone like A’qi.

只看眼前的情形，就是自己防不到的。
Her presence here already showed what he had failed to foresee.


想停当了，气也平了，
Once he had thought it through, his anger subsided.

伸手把门一推，
He pushed open the door.

阿七似乎猝不及防，霍地站起身来，两眼睁得极大，
Apparently taken by surprise, A’qi sprang up with wide eyes.

看见陈世龙才拍拍胸说：
Seeing Chen, she patted her chest.

“咄！
“Oh!

吓得我来！”
You frightened me!”

“你倒不说我吓一跳！”陈世龙平静地答道，
“What about the fright you gave me?” he answered calmly.

“你这样子，象不象半夜里跑出一只狐狸精来？”
“Don't you look like a fox spirit appearing in the middle of the night?”

“你骂好了！”
“Scold away!”

阿七泰然地笑着，
She smiled untroubled.

“好在我自己晓得，我不是来迷你的。”
“At least I know I haven't come to bewitch you.”

“那你来做啥？”
“Then what have you come for?”

“想想你光棍可怜，
“I thought your bachelor's life looked pitiful.

我又没啥事情好做，替你这间狗窝样的房子收拾收拾，
With nothing else to do, I came to tidy this kennel of yours.

这总不犯啥法？”
Surely there's no law against that?”

这一说，陈世龙才把视线扫了一遍。
Only then did Chen look round.

屋子里收拾得象个样子了，
The room had been put in order.

尤其使他触目的是，那张床不象自己的床，
The bed particularly caught his eye: it hardly seemed his own.

他是从来不叠被的，此刻叠好了被一看，仿佛那张床大了许多。
He never folded his bedding, and with it folded now, the bed looked much larger.

“难为你！”
“You've gone to a great deal of trouble.”

陈世龙坐了下来。
He sat down.

“刚刚泡的茶。”
“Freshly made tea.”

阿七倒了一杯茶给他，
She poured him a cup.

“廊沿上我替你炖了一锅鸭粥在那里。”
“I've a pot of duck congee simmering for you on the veranda.”

“哪里来的锅灶？”
“Where did the stove and pot come from?”

“买的。”
“I bought them.”

阿七数着手指说，
She counted on her fingers.

“风炉、茶壶、砂锅，还有炭，一共用了两千铜钱。”
“A portable stove, teapot, earthenware pot, and charcoal: two thousand copper cash altogether.”


“还替我买了啥东西，
“What else did you buy for me?

一共垫了多少？”
How much have you spent in all?”

“你要还我？”
“Do you mean to pay me back?”

“当然！”
“Naturally.

陈世龙说，“我又不跟你‘做人家’，
We aren't setting up house together.

没有要你来买的道理。”
There's no reason for you to buy these things.”

看他的神气倒还平静，但话中摸不到一丝热气，
His manner was calm, but there was no warmth in his words.

阿七心里便自怨，
A’qi reproached herself inwardly.

何苦来自讨没趣？
Why come here to be snubbed?

但一则不甘于就此一走，
Yet she could not bear simply to leave.

二则是觉得良家妇女好做，凄凉和寂寞难耐。
Living respectably was one thing; enduring desolation and loneliness was another.

秋宵冷雨，独对孤灯，把棉被咬破了都没用，
Alone beside a lamp on an autumn night of cold rain, she could bite her quilt to pieces and gain nothing.

还不如在陈世龙这里的好，
Better to stay here.

虽说他没有好脸嘴给人看，到底是两个人呀！
Chen might show her no kindness, but at least there were two of them!

这样转着念头，陈世龙就落下风了，
With this resolution, she gained the advantage.

他原来是想她自觉没趣，不如归去。
Chen had hoped that embarrassment would send her home.

谁知她虽觉没趣而不走，是他再也猜不到的，
He had never imagined that she might feel unwelcome and stay anyway.

所以谈话依旧是一句顶一句，毫不放松。
Not knowing this, he continued to meet every remark with an uncompromising rejoinder.


阿七行所无事，
A’qi went about her business.

走到廊沿下去把一锅鸭粥端了进来，放在地上，接着又奔了出去，
She brought in the pot of congee, set it on the floor, and hurried out again.

只听乒乒乓乓的响声，
Clattering sounds followed.

不知在搞些什么？陈世龙忍不住也走出去张望，这才发现廊沿转角上已安下一个小小的厨房，一张白木方桌，靠壁置着一具竹子碗橱，
Unable to imagine what she was doing, Chen went to look and discovered a little kitchen installed round the corner of the veranda: a plain wooden table and a bamboo cupboard against the wall.

“乒乒乓乓”正就是她在取碗筷弄出来的响声。
The noise came from her taking out bowls and chopsticks.

她倒是真的想打算跟自己“做人家”了。
She really seemed intent on setting up house with him!

陈世龙又好气，又好笑，却不能说什么，
He was both annoyed and amused but could say nothing.

他回身坐定，阿七已跟着走了进来，手里一个托盘，
Returning to his seat, he was followed by A’qi with a tray.

两副碗筷以外，还有两碟小菜，一碟是糟“吐瓞”，一碟是酱萝卜。
Besides two sets of bowls and chopsticks, it held two side dishes: tudie preserved in wine lees, and radish pickled in sauce.

“我不要吃！”陈世龙先来个拒人于千里之外。
“I don't want any,” he said, determined to keep her at a distance.

“你不吃我吃！”阿七答得异常爽脆。
“Then I'll eat!” she answered briskly.

她自盛了一碗鸭粥坐下来吃，
She served herself congee and sat down.

也不知是真的饿了，还是有意气他？只见她唏哩呼噜，吃得好香。
Whether she was truly hungry or meant to annoy him, she ate with noisy relish.

鸭粥熬得火候够了，香味浓郁，不断飘到他的鼻下，
The congee had simmered to perfection, and its rich aroma drifted continually towards him.

再看她挟块绷脆的酱萝卜放在嘴里，咬得“嘎吱嘎吱”地响，越使得陈世龙要咽唾沫。
Watching her bite into crisp pickled radish with an audible crunch made him swallow with longing.


想想有点不甘心，
He began to feel aggrieved.

“你这个人倒好！”他说，
“You've made yourself comfortable!

“真的当这里是你的家了？”
Do you really think this is your home?”

“有交情的嘛！”阿七毫不在乎地说，
“We're friends, aren't we?” she answered without concern.

“你到我那里，还不是一样？”
“Wouldn't you do the same at my place?”

“我是不会这样子不识相的。”
“I wouldn't be so insensitive.”

“你是说我不识相？”
“You mean I'm insensitive?”

“有一点。”
“A little.

陈世龙说，“天晚了，
It's late.

我要睡觉了。”
I want to go to bed.”

“小和尚，你气量真小！”阿七的声调幽幽地，
“Little Monk, you're terribly small-minded,” she said quietly.

“你就让我把这碗粥吃完了，再赶我走，也还不迟。”
“You could at least let me finish this bowl before driving me away.”

这话说得很够分量，
The rebuke struck home.

陈世龙大为懊悔，
Chen regretted his words.

堂堂男子汉，在江湖上辈分虽低，倒也从来没有哪个敢当面藐视过，
He was a grown man; low as his standing in their world might be, nobody had ever dared openly slight him.

不过今天“吃瘪”在她这两句话上！
Yet today her two remarks had put him completely in the wrong.

于是他要“找场”了！
He must recover his ground.

“什么气量小，气量小？
“Small-minded?

谈不到！”
That has nothing to do with it!

他说，“我是为你好，不是啥‘赶你走，！
I'm thinking of you, not driving you away.

随你喜欢到啥辰光，
Stay as long as you please.

我不在乎。
I don't mind.

不过我要少陪了。”
But you'll have to excuse me.”


说着脱下长衫，往椅背上一搭，坐到床沿上去换拖鞋。
He took off his long gown, laid it across a chair, and sat on the edge of the bed to change into slippers.

哪知早晨刚刚穿过的拖鞋，此时已不在床下，
The slippers he had worn that morning were no longer underneath it.

心知是阿七不知摆到哪里去了？
A’qi must have moved them.

懒得跟她搭话，使把鞋子一甩，身子往床上一倒。
Unwilling to speak to her, he kicked off his shoes and flung himself onto the bed.

“拖鞋在这里。”
“Your slippers are here.”

阿七从床头方凳下拖出一双拖鞋来，回身又把他的长衫挂到衣架上，接着又去收拾桌子。
She drew them from beneath a square stool at the head of the bed, then hung his gown on the clothes stand and cleared the table.

陈世龙看在眼里不响，但身子却睡不宁帖，
Chen watched in silence, but could not lie comfortably.

倒象背上长了根刺在那里似地。
He felt as though a thorn were sticking into his back.

他此时唯一的希望是，阿七早早离去，从此不来。
His only wish was that she would leave soon and never return.

“小和尚！”阿七收拾完毕，坐下来说，“我有句话要问你。”
When she had finished, she sat down. “Little Monk, there's something I want to ask you.”

不理不好意思，陈世龙只得冷冷地答道：“你说好了。”
Too embarrassed to ignore her, he answered coldly, “Go ahead.”

“说实话，我从来没有烧过这么入味的鸭粥，
“Honestly, I've never made such well-flavoured duck congee.

你吃一碗好不好？”
Won't you have a bowl?”

想不到是这么一句话！陈世龙大出意外，
He had never expected that.

“人心都是肉做的”，
Nobody's heart was made of stone.

她辛辛苦苦烧好，还要哀求别人来享用，仿佛吃她一碗鸭粥，就是帮了她什么大忙似的。
She had worked hard to prepare it, and now must beg him to enjoy it, as though eating a bowl would do her some great favour.

这叫人无论如何硬不起心肠来峻拒，
He could not bring himself to refuse harshly.

只好这样推托：“已经都收拾好了，
“You've cleared everything away.

何必再费事……”
Why go to more trouble...?”


一句话没有完，阿七已站起身来，连连说道：
Before he could finish, she was on her feet.

“不费事，不费事！”
“No trouble at all!”

说着，就走了出去。陈世龙无法阻拦。
She hurried out, and he could not stop her.

心里有着说不出的懊恼，
Chen felt an indescribable vexation with himself.

是恨自己无用，连个阿七都对付不了！
How useless he was, unable even to deal with A’qi!

于是自己跟自己赌气，一面从床上仰身坐了起来，一面心中自语：
Sitting up, he argued inwardly with his own weakness.

何必象见了一条毒蛇似地怕她？
Why fear her like a poisonous snake?

越是这样躲她，她越要缠住不放。
The more he avoided her, the more tightly she would cling.

等阿七笑嘻嘻地盛了粥来，他也不说一声“谢谢”，扶起筷子就吃，也象她一样，把酱萝卜咬得“嘎吱嘎吱”地响，
When she brought the congee with a smile, he offered no thanks, merely took his chopsticks and began to eat, crunching the radish as loudly as she had.

吃完一碗，再来一碗。
He finished one bowl, then had another.

“味道不错吧？”阿七得意地问。
“Tastes good, doesn't it?” she asked proudly.

“不见得怎么样。”
“Nothing remarkable.”

“哼！”
“Hmph!”

她撇一撇嘴，笑他言不由衷，
She curled her lip at his insincerity.

“我烧的粥是不好，不过你的胃口还不错。”
“My congee may be poor, but your appetite seems good.”

“我的胃口是不好，不过不吃你不开心。”
“My appetite is poor, but you wouldn't be happy if I didn't eat.”

陈世龙学着她的语气说。
Chen imitated her phrasing.

阿七不作声，静静地在咀嚼他这句话的滋味。
A’qi said nothing, quietly savouring his words.


“现在该论到我问句话了。”
“Now it's my turn to ask a question.”

陈世龙放下空碗说：
Chen set down his empty bowl.

“你到底要我怎么样？”
“What exactly do you want from me?”

“没有啥！
“Nothing much.

说实话，我回去也没有事，
Honestly, there's nothing for me to do at home.

一个人躺在床上想东想西，一夜到天亮都睡不着。
I lie alone in bed, thinking of everything, unable to sleep till morning.

跟你谈谈，心里好过些，
Talking to you makes me feel better.

谈到差不多辰光了，你睡你的觉，我回我的家。”
When it's time, you can go to bed and I'll go home.”

所望不奢，而且陈世龙对她的观感，跟刚进门时，已有不同，
It was a modest request, and Chen's view of her had changed since he came in.

于是点点头答应：
He nodded.

“好嘛！
“Very well.

大不了陪你坐到天亮。”
At worst, I'll sit with you till dawn.”

阿七嫣然一笑，先把碗筷收了出去，重新沏了一壶茶来，
She smiled, cleared away the bowls, and made fresh tea.

就隔着一盏剔亮了的油灯，跟陈世龙闲谈，自然是她的话多，
Across the newly brightened lamp, they chatted, though she did most of the talking.

谈郁四的待人接物，说他“还算是有良心的”，只是耳朵软，喜欢听女儿的话。
Yu Si, she said, was fairly decent in his dealings with people, but too easily influenced, especially by his daughter.

又说她本来已经死心塌地的预备跟郁四一辈子，
She had truly meant to spend her life with him.

哪知道中途出此变故？
Who could have foreseen this change?

因而便发牢骚，说大家只骂风尘中人下贱，去不知从良也不是件容易事。
People called women of her former profession low and contemptible, she complained, but knew nothing of how hard it was to leave that life.

谈到这里就不是闲话了，
At this point, the talk became serious.

“小和尚！”她说，“我今天下午去打听过了，
“Little Monk, I made inquiries this afternoon.

你跟张家的亲事不假，
Your engagement to the Zhang girl is real.

我晚了一步！
I'm a step too late.

那么，你倒替我想想，我以后的日子怎么过法？”
Then tell me, how am I to live from now on?”

看她的神情是诚恳求教，陈世龙不能推托，
Her request for advice was sincere, and Chen could not evade it.

想一想答道：“你自己总要有几句话摆出来，人家才好替你留意，
After thinking, he replied, “You must first say what you want, so that others can look for you.

譬如说，你吃不吃得苦，
Could you endure hardship?

肯不肯做小？
Would you accept being a concubine?

要怎么样的人品？
What sort of man do you want?

说清楚了，我替你去找。
Make it clear, and I'll look.

这件事说难很难，说容易很容易，
Such a matter can be very difficult or very easy.

胡老板在这两三个月中，就做了三个媒。
Mr Hu has arranged three matches in the past two or three months.

在这上面，就跟他的做生意一样，顶有办法。
He's as resourceful at it as at business.

我把你的事情托他，包你三个月之内，就有好消息。“
I'll entrust your case to him and guarantee good news within three months.”


阿七不响，只是眨眼，仿佛连她自己都弄不清楚，该“从”怎么样的一个“良人”？
A’qi merely blinked, as though she herself could not decide what sort of respectable man she should settle with.

“终身大事急不得！”陈世龙趁机劝她走路，
“Marriage can't be rushed,” Chen said, seizing the chance to encourage her departure.

“你回去好好想一想。
“Go home and think it over.

已经吃过一次亏，
You've suffered once.

不能再吃第二次。”
You mustn't suffer twice.”

语气很诚恳，阿七觉得他说得很中听，便站起身来有告辞的模样。
His earnest tone persuaded her, and she rose as though to leave.

陈世龙的动作很快，
Chen moved quickly.

把他从大经丝行带来的钉在亭柱上的一盏灯笼，取了下来，点了蜡烛，交在阿七手里。
He took down the lantern he had brought from Dajing, which hung on a nail in a post, lit its candle, and placed it in her hand.

“那么明朝会了！”
“Then I'll see you tomorrow!” she said.

“明朝会，明朗会！”
“Tomorrow, tomorrow!”

陈世龙灵机一动，下个伏笔：
An idea struck him, and he laid the groundwork.

“不过这两天你怕不容易寻得着我。”
“Though you may find it hard to catch me these next two days.”

“怎么呢？”
“Why?

阿七问道，“这样子忙法？”
Are you that busy?”

“是啊！
“Yes.

说来你不相信，连知府衙门里的公事，我都要管。”
You may not believe it, but I even have business from the prefectural yamen to attend to.”

这也没有什么不能相信，
There was nothing unbelievable about that.

阿七知道胡雪岩跟王大老爷是分不开的，
A’qi knew Hu and Prefect Wang were inseparable.

既然陈世龙是胡雪岩的亲信。附带办些知府衙门的公事，也是情理中事。
As Hu's trusted man, Chen might naturally handle some official matters as well.

好在公事总在白天，晚上亦总要回家睡觉，
But official business was done by day, and he must return home to sleep at night.

不怕寻不着他。
She need not fear being unable to find him.


陈世龙要避她的，正在晚上。
Night was precisely when Chen wanted to avoid her.

看阿七现在的样子，硬的吓不走她，软的磨不过她，
As matters stood, sternness would not frighten her away, and he could not outlast her gentle persistence.

三十六计，走为上策，
Of all strategies, retreat was best.

当然不能离开湖州，那就是两个办法，第一个是另外找房子搬家，第二个是住到大经丝行去。
He could not leave Huzhou, so there were two possibilities: find another house, or move into Dajing.

细想一想，其实只有一个办法，搬到大经丝行，
On reflection, only the second would do.

因为另外找房子搬家，别人问起来，总得有个说法，
If he found a new place, he would have to explain himself when people asked.

说是为了避阿七，则变成自己心虚，无私有弊了。
Saying he wished to avoid A’qi would look like a guilty conscience and make an innocent matter seem suspicious.

同时，阿七说不定会到大经去找，
Besides, she might call at Dajing.

自己在那里，比较好应付，
If he lived there, he could handle her more easily.

否则，阿七在那里说两句不知轻重出入的话，引起嫌疑，就跳到黄河也洗不清了。
Otherwise, a few careless words from her could arouse suspicions that even the Yellow River could not wash away.

打定了主意，安然入梦。
His mind settled, he slept peacefully.

第二天一早出门去看了几个素日有来往的小弟兄，
Early next morning he went to see several younger friends he knew well.

一顿酒吃到下午三点钟，
Their drinking lasted until three in the afternoon.

回家收拾随身衣服，带到大经丝行。
Then he went home, packed his clothes, and took them to Dajing.


“来，来！”
“Come along!”

黄仪从屋里奔了出来，招手喊道：
Huang hurried from his room, beckoning.

“今天我这个媒人有话跟你说了。”
“Your matchmaker has something to tell you today.”

邀他到房间里，一谈经过，陈世龙大出意外。
Once inside, Chen heard a wholly unexpected story.

据说郁四在这天早晨，特地到大经丝行来看老张，口称“亲家”，
That morning Yu had come to Dajing especially to see Old Zhang, addressing him as his fellow parent-in-law.

说陈世龙是他的小辈，现在当儿子一样看待，
Chen, he explained, was his junior, but he now regarded him as a son.

将来办喜事，男家归他主持，
At the wedding, Yu would head the bridegroom's family.

同时送了一千两银子的聘金。
He had also brought a thousand taels in betrothal money.

“你丈人老实，有点手足无措，不知道怎么办？
“Your father-in-law is an honest fellow and didn't know what to do.

特地来问我，
He came to ask me.

这还有啥话说？
What was there to discuss?

我叫你老丈人认了亲家。”
I told him to acknowledge the relationship.”

黄仪很高兴地说，
Huang was delighted.

“到底是占码头的人物，
“That's a man of standing for you!

做事漂亮之至，
He does things magnificently.

送了我二百两银子，算是谢媒，
He gave me two hundred taels as thanks for arranging the match.

不收他会不高兴，我也就老实，
Refusing would have offended him, so I frankly accepted.

叨你老弟的光了。
I've benefited through you, my young friend.”

“陈世龙听这一说，觉得面子十足，心里非常高兴，但不肯在脸上摆出来，怕黄仪发觉他并不知道这件事。
Chen felt greatly honoured and was very pleased, but hid it lest Huang discover that he had known nothing of the arrangement.

“这一来，日子就急得不得了。”黄仪说道：
“This makes the timing terribly tight,” Huang continued.

“你丈母娘请我去吃中饭，当面跟我说，她要替女儿办嫁妆，起码要半年工夫，
“Your mother-in-law invited me to lunch and told me she needs at least six months to prepare her daughter's dowry.

年底下来不及。
There isn't time before the year's end.

看你的意思怎么佯？
What do you think?

我们先谈好了，再跟郁四叔去说。”
Let's settle it between ourselves, then speak to Uncle Four.”


陈世龙有些不太愿意，
Chen was reluctant.

想了想问道：“不晓得阿珠怎么说？”
After some thought, he asked, “What does A’zhu say?”

“你问这话真没道理！
“What an unreasonable question!

她会怎么说，
What could she say?

难道说越早出阁越好？”
That the sooner she leaves home to marry, the better?”

想想不错，陈世龙失笑了，
Seeing the point, Chen laughed.

“这件事我做不来主。”
“I can't decide this.

他说，“要跟郁四叔、胡先生商量了再说。”
I must discuss it with Uncle Four and Mr Hu.”

“难道你自己作不得你自己的主？”
“Can't you decide your own affairs?”

黄仪拿了郁四的、吃了张家的，不能不把情况弄清楚，
Having accepted Yu's money and the Zhangs' hospitality, Huang had to understand the situation.

“说句实话，你父母双亡，
“Frankly, both your parents are dead.

人家虽帮你的忙，到底不是‘父母之命’。”
Others may help, but their wishes aren't your parents' commands.”

“父母之命，媒妁之言”这两句话，陈世龙也听到过，
Chen had heard the saying about parental commands and a matchmaker's words.

但他的这头亲事，真所谓“如人饮水，冷暖自知”，
Yet his own marriage was like water whose warmth only the drinker knew.

成家立业是一事的两面，
Establishing a home and establishing a livelihood were two sides of the same matter.

为胡雪岩想，是要提拔陈世龙，也为了他自己的事业，要觅个得力的帮手，引替陈世龙促成良缘，
Hu had arranged the match both to advance Chen and to secure an able assistant for his own enterprises.

此刻各样生意，都在着春进展之中，到什么时候，需要陈世龙出力，只有胡雪岩心里才有数，
All those ventures were now being actively developed, and only Hu knew when Chen would be needed.

倘或正要用人的时候，他在忙着办喜事，岂不耽误了生意，
If he were busy with a wedding precisely when his help was required, business would suffer.

那就不是胡雪岩的本意了。
That could not be Hu's intention.

除此以外，陈世龙还有一份感恩的心情，
Besides, Chen felt grateful.

自从跟了胡雪岩，叫他“先生”，陈世龙才知道“师父，师父”，师真如父，
Only after following Hu and calling him “sir” had he understood how a teacher could truly be like a father.

为了尊敬“胡先生”，哪怕就没有耽误生意的顾虑，他也愿意请命而行。
Out of respect, he would willingly seek Hu's approval even without any risk of disrupting business.

见他沉吟不语，黄仪明白了，陈世龙必有他的难处，
Seeing him silent in thought, Huang understood that he had difficulties.

但女家也有女家的难处，要先让陈世龙明白，
But the bride's family had difficulties too, and Chen must first understand them.

否则做媒人的两头传话，南辕北辙，就吃力而不讨好了。
Otherwise, carrying messages between two sides pulling in opposite directions would be thankless work.


“世龙，”他用劝告的语气说，“洞房花烛，一个人一生只一回，女家又是独养女儿，
“Shilong,” Huang said persuasively, “a person has only one wedding night, and she's her family's only daughter.

人家要好好预备嫁妆，因此耽误日子，我们做男家的要体谅。
If preparing her dowry delays the wedding, we on the bridegroom's side must be considerate.

大户人家的小姐，一到了十二三岁就在办嫁妆了，
Great families begin preparing a daughter's dowry when she's twelve or thirteen.

一办五、六年，不足为奇。
Taking five or six years is nothing unusual.

现在人家只要五、六个月，
Here they ask for only five or six months.

不算多。
That's not much.

你跟胡老板去说，
Tell Mr Hu.

他的人情世故熟透熟透，一定会答应。
He understands human affairs thoroughly and will certainly agree.”

“I know he's very likely to agree.

不过我不能不先跟他说一声。”
But I must tell him first.”

“Then that's settled.”

觉得还是住到这里来方便，是不是？”

An idea struck Chen.

阿七的事，不便对别人说，“媒人”这里正好说清楚，

万一将来发生误会，有个有力的见证，
If a misunderstanding arose later, he would have an influential witness.

He sighed.

“I've come to take refuge!”

Do you owe someone money?”

Naturally she was pleased.

这是为了什么？
Why would she?

费人猜疑。
It was puzzling.

Naturally, he did not want to suspect anything bad, yet could hardly call it a good sign.

He could only reassure himself that it was an isolated occurrence.

Next morning he rose clear-headed, able to think sharply and thoroughly.

觉得在湖州要找件正经事做，
He must find useful work in Huzhou.

如果湖州无事，就当赶回杭州，看胡雪岩有何差遣？
If there was none, he should return to Hangzhou and ask for Hu's instructions.

无所事事，坐享“清福”，决不是善策。
Idling in comfort was no sound policy.

Reviewing the situation, he found something he could do: investigate silk prices.

这个行情是胡雪岩所急于想知道的，他在杭州一直也在打听，
Hu urgently wanted this information and had been making inquiries in Hangzhou.

但销洋庄的丝，大部分出在湖州，在杭州打听湖州的行情，不一定准确，
But most silk intended for export came from Huzhou, and reports gathered elsewhere might be inaccurate.

闲着无事，正好替胡雪岩在这方面出点力。
With nothing else to do, Chen could help him directly.

转念一想，
Then he reconsidered.

这件事是黄仪熟悉。
Huang knew that business well.

行情如有变化，他一定会写信给胡雪岩，
If prices changed, he would surely write to Hu.

自己何必白忙？
Why duplicate the work?

倒是到县衙门里去看看那两位师爷，打听打听官场有什么消息，
Better to call on the two advisers at the county yamen and inquire about official developments.

倘或平静无事，不如回杭州去的好。
If all was quiet, he might as well return to Hangzhou.

结果是扑了个空，也可以说是碰了一鼻子的灰。
The visit came to nothing; indeed, it was a rebuff.

刑、钱两师爷的住处，关防甚严，向来不准闲杂人等乱闯，
Access to the quarters of the legal and financial advisers was strictly controlled, and casual visitors were never allowed to wander in.

陈世龙跟杨用之他们并不熟悉，
Chen did not know Yang Yongzhi and the other adviser well.

所以托听差通报进去，都挡驾不见。
When he sent his name through their attendants, both refused to receive him.

陈世龙心里很不高兴，但想想是自己冒昧，又算长了一次经验。
He was displeased, but admitted that he had been presumptuous and had learned another lesson.

回到大经，枯坐无聊，想回自己住处去看看，
Back at Dajing, he sat about bored and decided to visit his own rooms.

刚踏出门，只见行里的一个小徒弟，匆匆赶来告诉他，说黄仪叫他来通知，让陈世龙赶紧从后门避开。
He had barely stepped out when an apprentice hurried up with Huang's message: he must leave by the back door immediately.


这是阿七寻上门来了。
A’qi had come looking for him.

Curiosity made Chen unwilling to leave.

“Yes.”

Chen decided to investigate.

他的房间旁边就是楼梯，楼梯下面是堆储杂物之处，有一道门锁着，

Huang's bluntness bordered on rudeness, and Chen frowned.

Just then, a ray of light entered through the partition.

壁上本来有个洞，刚才是为黄仪的背脊所挡住了，

He had changed seats, letting the light through.

脂粉不施，只在鬓边替一朵红花。

这样打扮，在庄重中又显得很俏丽，徐娘风韵，着实迷人。

She meant to force him to appear.

以前陈世龙连跟她见面的机会都没有，怎会替她经手银钱？
Previously, Chen had scarcely been able to meet her, so how could he have handled her money?

而况郁四自己跟人合股开着聚成钱庄，

如果阿七有私房，何不存在聚成生息，要来托陈世龙代放？
If A’qi had savings, why not deposit them there for interest instead of asking Chen to lend them?

几百两银子，

When should I come to find him?”

I'd like to ask what you mean by responsibility.

If Huang meant to anger her into leaving, it was a poor plan.

因为他深知阿七的脾气，服软不服硬，

这怎么笑得出？
How could she?

阿七觉得这个人，颇为难缠。
He was proving difficult to handle.

原来这家伙不怀好意！
So that was what he wanted!

Recalling his offensiveness, she resolved to teach him a lesson.

这样一转念，便先浮起一阵报复的快意，心境开朗，
The anticipated pleasure of revenge brightened her mood.

真有烟视媚行之致。
Her lowered gaze and seductive movements were artful indeed.

黄仪心里痒得仿佛有十七八只小手在搔抓似地，
Huang felt as though seventeen or eighteen little hands were tickling his heart.

他原来的盘算，就是挺身自代，既替陈世龙解了围，自己又捡了个便宜，
His plan had been to offer himself in Chen's place, rescuing the young man and gaining an advantage for himself.

所以一上来不惜言语开罪，好叫她对陈世龙先死了心，然后用“潘驴邓小闲”的“小”字诀，来叫她化嗔为喜。
He had begun by deliberately offending her, to end her hopes of Chen, then intended to win her over through the deference prescribed in the old seducer's formula of looks, virility, wealth, humility, and leisure.

自己估量，这是着实要费一番精神的事，
He had expected this to require considerable effort.

不想收功如此之速，因有喜出望外之感。
Such swift success delighted him beyond expectation.

可有这话？”
Is that true?”

“Yes.”

阿七把眼望着别处，似乎不好意思正视黄仪，
She looked elsewhere, seemingly too shy to meet his eyes.

“Otherwise I wouldn't have come looking for him.”

“Finding him won't help now.

陈世龙得新忘旧，
Chen Shilong forgets old affections for new ones.

一片心都在张家的阿珠小姐身上。”
His whole heart is set on Miss Zhu of the Zhang family.”

听得这话，阿七的妒心又起，冷笑说道：
Jealousy stirred again.

“Hmph!

阿珠我也见过，
I've seen A’zhu.

黄毛丫头也叫‘小姐’了，
Even a mere slip of a girl gets called ‘Miss’ now.

真正气数！”
What a world!”

提起来你不开心。

“Where Old Yu used to live.

现在是我一个人。”
I'm alone there now.”
