“No wonder!

一个住是太寂寞了些。”
Living alone is too lonely.

黄仪说道，“用个小大姐陪陪你嘛！”
Why not hire a maid for company?”

“有一个。”
“I have one.

阿七答道，“笨得象牛，蠢得象猪，
As stupid as an ox and as dull as a pig.

一吃过夜饭就要打瞌盹，上了床象死人一样。”
After supper she starts dozing, and once in bed she's like a dead person.”


“这样子，夜里就寂寞了。
“Then your nights must be lonely.

也没有人来看看你？”
Doesn't anyone come to see you?”

“有哪个？
“Who would?

鬼都没有得上门。”
Not even a ghost crosses my threshold.”

“那么，”黄仪涎着脸说：“我来做‘鬼’好不好？”
“Then,” Huang asked with an ingratiating smile, “may I be the ghost?”

“这，这叫什么话？”
“What sort of talk is that?”

“你说鬼都没得上门，
“You said not even a ghost comes.

我就做‘鬼’上你的门！”
I'll be the ghost at your door!”

“啊唷！”
“Oh!”

阿七双手环抱在胸前，作出不胜战栗的样子，
Folding her arms across her chest, A’qi pretended to shudder.

“你来嘛就来！
“Come if you like!

啥叫‘做鬼上门’，
Why talk of ghosts at the door?

说得人吓兮兮地！
You make it sound frightening.”

“这副神态虽是做作，却也可喜，
Her manner was affected but charming.

而黄仪特感会心的是，她那第一句话，认为无意流露，最见真情，
Huang particularly relished her first words, taking them as an unguarded revelation of her true feelings.

只要能够上门，象她这种出身，自然不愁不能入幕。
Once he could visit her house, with a woman of her background, he felt sure of being admitted to her bed.


心里这么在想，手上就随便了，
The thought made his hands less restrained.

“不要吓，不要吓！”
“Don't be frightened.

他很自然的拉往了她的手：“说说笑笑。”
We're only joking.” He took her hand quite naturally.

阿七凝睇含笑，象是心里有什么不易为人知的高兴事在想，
She gazed at him with a smile, as though enjoying some secret thought.

突然间，将手一夺，懔然说道：“不要动手动脚！”
Suddenly she snatched her hand away and said sternly, “Keep your hands to yourself!”

说着还转脸望了一下。
As she spoke, she glanced behind her.

这在黄仪又有会心了，“动手动脚”不要紧，就怕让人看见。
Huang thought he understood again: touching was acceptable; being seen was the danger.

那容易！
That was easy to remedy.

“怎么搞的呢？
“What's going on?

叫学生子去买点心，到现在还不来？”
I sent the apprentice to buy refreshments, and he still hasn't returned!”

他这样自言自语着，奔了出去。
Muttering this, he hurried outside.

间壁的陈世龙却不免诧异，
In the adjoining space, Chen was puzzled.

不懂阿七是什么意思？
What did A’qi mean?

莫非真个孤衾难耐，有意接受黄仪的勾引？
Could loneliness truly have made her willing to accept Huang's advances?

他想仔细看一看阿七的表情，无奈她背着身子，正朝窗外在望。
He tried to study her expression, but her back was turned as she looked out of the window.

就这时候，听得黄仪的脚步声，接着是关门声和落闩声。
Then came Huang's footsteps, followed by the sound of a door closing and a bolt sliding home.

原来如此！
So that was it!

陈世龙心想，黄仪心也太急了些，
Huang was far too impatient.

这下真有场“隔壁戏”好看了。
There would certainly be a performance worth watching from next door.


“你看我这地方怎么样？”
“What do you think of my room?”

黄仪走回来笑嘻嘻地说，
Huang returned smiling.

“一门关紧，连只苍蝇都飞不进来。”
“Once the door is shut, not even a fly can get in.”

“我晓得了！”
“I understand!”

阿七慢慢点着头，伸出一只用凤仙花染红了指甲的食指，指指戳戳地说：
A’qi nodded slowly, pointing at him with an index finger whose nail was stained red with balsam.

“你好坏！”
“You're wicked!”

“坏！
“Wicked?

怎么坏法？”
How?”

“问你自己啊！”
“Ask yourself!”

“我倒不晓得。”
“I don't know.”

黄仪又拉住了她的手，涎着脸说：
He took her hand again and smiled ingratiatingly.

“你倒说给我听听。”
“Tell me.”

“何必我说？”
“Why should I?”

阿七把眼睛望着别处，
She looked away.

“说出来就没有意思了。”
“Saying it aloud would spoil it.”

“对，
“Exactly.

说出来没意思。
No need to say it.

只要心里有数就是。”
Understanding is enough.”

一面说，一面把脸凑过去闻她。
As he spoke, he leaned close and inhaled her scent.

阿七只把脸往侧面仰了仰。但一双手被他拉着，就躲也躲不远，到底让他闻到了。
She tilted her face aside, but with both hands held, she could not move far enough to avoid him.

“好香！”
“How fragrant!”

黄仪仰脸闭眼，向空嗅了两下，
Tilting back his head and closing his eyes, Huang sniffed the air twice.

同时一只手从她膀子上慢慢摸了上去。
Meanwhile, one hand began moving slowly up her arm.


他还在不胜陶醉，陈世龙却在替他担心了。
While Huang remained entranced, Chen began to worry for him.

因为阿七已经变态，眼睛渐渐睁圆，眉毛渐渐上竖，嘴巴渐渐闭紧，
A’qi's expression was changing: her eyes widened, her brows rose, and her mouth tightened.

最后扬起她那只多肉的手，使劲一掌，打在黄仪脸上。
At last she raised her fleshy hand and struck him hard across the face.

“啊！”黄仪大喊一声，
“Ah!” Huang shouted.

睁开眼来，看到阿七的脸色，才知道是怎么回事？
Opening his eyes and seeing her expression, he finally understood.

“你为什么打我？”他捂着脸问。
“Why did you hit me?” he demanded, holding his cheek.

“打你个调戏良家妇女！”阿七很沉着地说。
“For molesting a respectable woman,” she replied calmly.

“你！”黄仪象打雷似地暴喝一声，跳脚骂道：
“You!” He roared and stamped.

“你个臭婊子一声没有骂完，脸上又着了一掌，
“You filthy whore...” Before he finished, another slap struck his face.

这时才显出阿七的泼辣，
Now A’qi showed her fierce spirit.

抢步过去，从桌上拿起把剪刀扬起来，
She darted to the table, snatched up a pair of scissors, and raised them.

咬牙切齿地骂：”你嘴里再不干不净，我一剪刀扎出你的眼乌珠！
Through clenched teeth she said, “Use that filthy language again, and I'll jab out your eyes!”

“不得了！陈世龙大为着急，
Chen was alarmed.

要出人命了。
Someone might be killed!

幸好黄仪识趣，
Fortunately, Huang knew when to retreat.

窘笑着说，“何必呢！这样子认真。
With an embarrassed smile, he said, “Why take it so seriously?

早晓得你开不起玩笑，哪个孙子忘八蛋跟你罗嗦！”
If I'd known you couldn't take a joke, I'd have been a damned fool to bother you.”

“哼！”
“Hmph!”

阿七把剪刀往桌上一抛，板着脸叱斥：“走！开门。
A’qi threw the scissors onto the table and commanded with a stern face, “Go and open the door.

我要走了。”
I'm leaving.”


黄仪一言不发，乖乖地去开了门，放阿七走路。
Without a word, Huang obediently opened the door and let her go.

这一下陈世龙却受罪了，使尽吃奶的力气，才能把笑声憋住，
Now Chen suffered: it took every ounce of strength to suppress his laughter.

直到黄仪走得远了，他才掩着嘴，溜了出来，急急忙忙弄到后面的废园中，
Only after Huang had gone well away did he slip out, covering his mouth, and hurry to the neglected garden behind the building.

捧着肚子，纵声大笑。
There he clutched his stomach and laughed aloud.

如果照以前的脾气，陈世龙一定会把黄仪的这个笑话，散布出去，
In the old days, he would certainly have spread this story at Huang's expense.

自从跟了胡雪岩，学到了许多人情世故，了解这必成黄仪深讳之事，
But he had learned much about human relations from Hu and understood that Huang would desperately want to conceal it.

不但不能讲出去，最好连黄仪面前，都要装作不知其事。
Not only must he keep it to himself; he should preferably pretend ignorance even before Huang.

不然便要遭忌，
Otherwise he would earn his resentment.

俗语说的“是非只为多开口”，正指此而言。
This was precisely what the saying meant: trouble comes from talking too much.

然而难题仍未解决，
Yet his problem remained.

阿七仍旧会来，
A’qi would still come.

看她号为“水晶”，表里通明，好象胸无城府，
With a nickname like Crystal, she seemed transparent through and through, as though she had no hidden designs.

想不到撒泼放刁，也绝得很，
Yet she had proved remarkably skilful at troublesome tricks.

那条“烟熏鼠穴”之计，十分厉害，不能听其自然。
Her plan to smoke him out of his hole was formidable and could not be ignored.

这样就还是只好跟黄仪去商量。
He must consult Huang again.

他特别谨慎，怕自己脸上的神色有异，也怕黄仪的心情还未能平贴，当时便不去找他，
Taking particular care that his face betrayed nothing, and allowing time for Huang's feelings to settle, he did not seek him immediately.

一个人出后门寻朋友一起吃晚饭，回列丝行，才踱到黄仪那里“打听消息”。
He left by the back door, found a friend to dine with, and only after returning to the firm strolled over to inquire about the news.


“怎么样？”他装得若无其事地，
“Well?” he asked as though nothing had happened.

“你是怎么把她弄走的？”
“How did you get her to leave?”

“我告诉她，你跟阿珠的亲事，是我做的媒，我有责任。
“I told her I'd arranged your match with A’zhu and had a responsibility.

劝她以后不要来找你的麻烦。”
I advised her not to trouble you again.”

“她怎么说？”
“What did she say?”

“这个女人，坏得很！”黄仪恨恨地说，
“A thoroughly bad woman!” Huang said bitterly.

“她说有什么私房钱，托你替她放息。
“She claimed she'd entrusted savings to you to lend at interest.

又说，要抽回本钱，最好跟你见个面。
She wanted her principal back and thought it best to see you.

总而言之，言而总之一句话：贱货！没有男人不过门。”
In short, to put it briefly—she's a cheap creature who can't live without a man!”

听他此刻的话，想起他当时咆哮如虎，而结果如丧家之狗的神情，
Listening, Chen recalled how Huang had roared like a tiger and ended like a beaten stray.

前后映照，使得陈世龙的肚肠根痒不可当，
The contrast with his present words made laughter rise irresistibly in his belly.

差点又笑出声来。
He almost let it escape.

“事情真麻烦了！”黄仪又说，语气倒是平静了，见得他已好好想过，
“It's become a real problem,” Huang continued more calmly, showing that he had considered it.

“现在已经不是躲的事。”
“Hiding won't be enough now.”

“怎么呢？”
“Why?”

“她到大经来寻你，有我在，总可以把她挡回去。
“If she comes here, I can keep her away.

就怕她不来，到处去放谣言，说你欠了她的钱，避不见面，
The danger is that she stops coming and spreads rumours everywhere: you owe her money and refuse to see her.

逼得你非出面跟她理论不可。”
Then you'll have to appear and argue with her.”

黄仪抬眼望道，
Huang looked up.

“你想这个女人坏不坏？”
“Isn't she a bad woman?”

照阿七的为人，还不至于这么坏！
Chen did not think her character quite so bad.

不过她如缠住不放，而自己又始终避不见面，怨恨交加，
But if she persisted and he continually avoided her, resentment might build.

象她这样的女人就很难说了！
Then, with a woman like her, who could say?

因此，陈世龙吸着气，搓着手，显得颇为不安。
He drew a breath and rubbed his hands uneasily.

“好好一头亲事，不要坏在她手里！
“Don't let her ruin a good marriage,” Huang warned.

她现在逼得你没路走，世龙！
“She's leaving you nowhere to turn.

你要早点想办法。”
You must find a solution soon.”


“是啊！
“Yes.

我现在不就是在向黄先生讨教？”
Isn't that why I'm asking your advice?”

黄仪点点头，
Huang nodded.

一双眼睛突然变得深沉，沉思了好一会，才慢吞吞地开口：
His eyes suddenly grew intent, and he considered for some time before speaking slowly.

“办法是有一个。
“There is one way.

‘量小非君子，无毒不丈夫’，
‘A small-minded man is no gentleman; a man without ruthlessness is no man.’

要想一劳永逸，唯有这条路好走。”
If you want to settle it once and for all, this is the only road.”

看样子是极狠的一着，
It sounded like an exceptionally cruel measure.

陈世龙催他：“黄先生，你说，是怎么一条路？”
Chen urged him to explain. “What road, Mr Huang?”

“听说你跟县衙门的刑名师爷很熟？”
“I hear you know the county yamen's legal adviser well?”

“熟也不太熟。
“Not very well.

不过打着胡先生的旗号去，可以说得上话。”
But with Mr Hu's name behind me, I can obtain a hearing.”

“这就行了！”
“Then it's simple!”

黄仪很轻松地，
Huang sounded quite relaxed.

“阿七不是本地人，
“A’qi isn't a local.

原籍高邮。
Her native place is Gaoyou.

你去托刑名师爷弄张牌票出来，转她个‘流娼’的罪名，递解回籍，
Ask the legal adviser to get a warrant issued, have her charged as an itinerant prostitute, and send her under escort back to her home district.

滚她拉块妈妈咸鸭蛋！”
Pack her off, damn her!”


想不到是如此一计，
Chen had never expected such a plan.

实在太狠毒了一些，陈世龙心里暗暗吃惊，
It was far too vicious, and he was inwardly shocked.

原来黄仪是这么一个人！
So this was the sort of man Huang was!

以后共事，倒要好好防他。
He would have to be careful in their future dealings.

“怎么样？”
“Well?”

黄仪催问：
Huang pressed.

“我是为你设想，
“I'm thinking of you.

非如此不足以放心！”
Nothing less will make you safe.”

“是，是！
“Yes, yes.

我知道黄先生完全是为我。
I know you're doing it entirely for me.

不过，”
But...”

陈世龙亦颇多急智，把这重公案扯到了郁四身上，
Chen was quick-witted too and shifted the difficulty onto Yu.

“其中碍着郁四叔，
“There's Uncle Four to consider.

旁人不知道是我们出的花样，
People won't know we're responsible.

只当郁四叔放不过这样一个人，
They'll think he can't let this woman go.

传到江湖上，郁四叔的声名不好听。”
If that spreads through our circles, his reputation will suffer.”

“那不要紧。”
“Don't worry.”

黄仪拍着胸说，
Huang struck his chest.

“郁四叔问起来，我替你一力承当。”
“If Uncle Four asks, I'll take full responsibility.”

就表面看，黄仪这样够朋友，再不领情受教，就变成半吊子了。
On the surface, Huang was proving such a good friend that refusing his advice would make Chen seem foolishly ungrateful.

陈世龙十分机警，用欣然的语气答道：
Chen was shrewd enough to answer with apparent pleasure.

“黄先生这样子帮我的忙，还有什么说？
“With you helping me like this, what more could I ask?

我明天就去办。”
I'll attend to it tomorrow.”

这当然是敷衍，
This was merely to put him off.

陈世龙决不会照他的话去做的。
Chen had no intention of following the advice.

一个人静下来想想，原意托黄仪帮忙，谁知越帮越忙，反倒额外添了些麻烦。
Reflecting alone, he felt that he had asked Huang for help only to gain more trouble, with additional complications he had never needed.

所以心中甚为不快，早早上床睡了。
Thoroughly unhappy, he went to bed early.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十七章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Seventeen, first part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第十七章｜CHAPTER SEVENTEEN


刚睡下不久，小徒弟来敲门，送来一封夜班航船刚刚带到的信，
Chen had not been in bed long when a young apprentice knocked and brought him a letter just delivered by the night passenger boat.

信是胡雪岩寄来的，
It was from Hu Xueyan.

拆开一看，寥寥数语，只说得知郁四有伤子之痛，深为惦念，
In a few brief lines, Hu said that he had heard of Yu Si's bereavement and was deeply concerned.

特地抽空，专程到湖州来一趟，慰唁郁四，发信以后，即日下船。
He had made time for a special journey to Huzhou to offer his condolences and would take a boat the very day he sent the letter.

这一下，陈世龙的愁怀尽夫，
All Chen's worries vanished.

有胡雪岩到，凡事都不碍了。
With Hu coming, nothing need trouble him any longer.

一觉好睡，第二天一早，悄悄到码头上去等，
He slept soundly, then slipped down to the wharf early the next morning to wait.

等到十点多钟，将胡雪岩等到了。
It was after ten when Hu arrived.

泊舟下碇，搭好跳板，陈世龙先到船上，
Once the boat had anchored and the gangplank was in place, Chen went aboard.

笑嘻嘻叫过一声：“胡先生：”
“Mr Hu!” he called with a smile.

接着又说，“没有想到胡先生会来，
“I never expected you to come.

真是太好了。”
This is wonderful.”

听他这样说法，便知自己这一趟适逢其分，有什么事要自己来料理，
His manner told Hu that he had arrived at just the right moment: something needed his attention.

胡雪岩便点点头说，
He nodded.

“我是包了一只船夹的，只有三天的工夫。
“I've hired a boat for the journey, and I have only three days.

来，你坐下来，
Come, sit down.

我们先细谈一谈。”
Let's go through everything first.”


这一谈便长了，
The conversation proved a long one.

由郁四丧子谈到他的家务，由阿七谈到自己的麻烦，由自己又谈到黄仪。
From Yu's loss of his son, Chen passed to his household troubles; from A’qi to his own difficulties; and from himself to Huang Yi.

自然，也谈到郁四尽释前嫌，替自己出面办喜事，如何会亲送聘金，以及阿珠的娘要替女儿办嫁妆，婚期得延到明年。
Naturally, he also told Hu how Yu had put aside all past grievances and undertaken to arrange Chen's wedding, how Yu had formally met the bride's family and delivered the betrothal money, and how A’zhu's mother wished to prepare her daughter's dowry, which meant postponing the wedding until the following year.

结语是：“我一切都要请胡先生来作主。”
He concluded, “I must ask you to decide everything for me.”

“想不到我一走，出了这么多花样！”
“Who would have thought so many complications could arise the moment I left?”

胡雪岩紧皱着眉，想了好半天才开口：
Hu frowned deeply and considered for some time before speaking.

“你的喜事，怎么样都可以，
“Your wedding can be arranged one way or another.

慢慢再说。
We can discuss that later.

你郁四叔搞成这样子，倒有些伤脑筋了。
Your Fourth Uncle Yu's situation is more troublesome.

他的大小姐我没有见过，
I've never met his daughter.

你看她为人如何？
What do you think of her?

天性厚不厚？”
Is she naturally kind?”

“阿兰姐的精明强干，早就有名的。
“Sister A’lan has long been known for her intelligence and ability.

天性呢，”
As for her nature...”

陈世龙出语很谨慎，
Chen chose his words carefully.

“自然不会太薄，
“Surely she can't be too unkind.

郁四叔只有这么一个女儿。”
She's his only daughter.”

“现在是唯一的亲骨肉了！
“And now his only surviving child.

我想，她不会不孝顺，也不敢不孝顺。”
I don't think she would fail in her duty to him—or dare to.”

最后一句话，骤然难以索解，
The last words were not immediately clear.

细想一想，才察出这句话中的分量，
On reflection, Chen understood their weight.

如果阿兰姐敢于不孝顺老父，胡雪岩以父执的资格，一定会出来说话。
If A’lan dared to mistreat her elderly father, Hu would certainly intervene as her father's friend.

至少限度，他会劝郁四，一个沙壳子都不要给阿兰姐，
At the very least, he would advise Yu not to give her a single copper.

“嫁出的女儿泼出的水”，阿兰姐在娘家硬争是争不到财产的。
“A married daughter is water poured away”: however fiercely she fought at her parents' home, that would not secure her the property.


“胡先生，”陈世龙忽有灵感，“你何不帮郁四叔把家务料理一下子？”
“Mr Hu,” Chen said, struck by an idea, “why not help Fourth Uncle put his household affairs in order?”

胡雪岩沉吟不语，
Hu considered in silence.

显然是觉得陈世龙的提议，不无考虑的余地。
Clearly, the proposal deserved thought.

照他的性情，以及与郁四的交情来说，不能不管这桩闲事，
Given his own temperament and his friendship with Yu, he could hardly stand aside.

只是不管则已，一管就要弄得漂漂亮亮，
Yet once he intervened, he must see the whole affair properly settled.

三天的工夫来不及，就算再加一两天，未见得能料理清楚，
Three days would not be enough; even another day or two might not suffice.

而上海、杭州的事却要耽误，
Meanwhile, business in Shanghai and Hangzhou would suffer.

变成“驼子跌跟斗，两头落空”，
Like a hunchback taking a tumble, with both ends left in the air, he would fail on both fronts.

不智之至。
That would be foolish indeed.

“还有，”陈世龙又说，带些愁眉苦脸地，“阿七是个麻烦！
“And there's A’qi,” Chen added with a troubled face. “She's a nuisance.

从前我不伯她，随她怎么好了！
I wasn't afraid of her before; she could do as she pleased.

现在我不能跟她一起在烂泥塘里滚。
But now I can't go rolling in the mud with her.

胡先生，你看我该怎么办？”
What am I to do?”

这就是“混市面”的人的苦衷！
Such was the predicament of men who had made their way on the streets.

人之好善，谁不如我？
Who did not wish to better himself?

略有身价，总想力争上游，成为衣冠中人，
Once a man had acquired a little standing, he wanted to rise and become respectable.

但虽出淤泥，要想不染却甚难，
Yet emerging from the mud without a stain was difficult.

因为过去的关系，拉拉扯扯，
Old connections tugged at him.

自己爱惜羽毛不肯在烂泥塘里一起打滚，无奈别人死拉住不放，结果依旧同流合污。
He might value his good name and refuse to roll in the mire, but others clung to him and would not let go; in the end he remained involved in the same disreputable ways.

胡雪岩对这一点十分清楚，当然要替陈世龙想办法。
Hu understood this thoroughly and would naturally find a way to help Chen.

郁四的家务是个难题，陈世龙的麻烦又是一个难题，
Yu's household was one difficult problem, Chen's predicament another.

两个难题加在一起，反激出胡雪岩的灵感，
Together, the two suddenly gave Hu an idea.

站起身来说：
He stood up.

“走！
“Come.

我们上岸。”
Let's go ashore.”


看他欣然有得的神情，陈世龙知道他又要出“奇计”了，
Seeing the pleased look of discovery on Hu's face, Chen knew that another ingenious plan was forming.

便笑嘻嘻地问道：“胡先生，你一定又有啥人家想不到的主意，
“Mr Hu,” he asked with a smile, “you must have thought of something nobody else would imagine.

好不好先讲给我听听？”
Could you tell me first?”

“没有啥不好讲的。”
“There's no reason not to.

胡雪岩说，“我想叫阿七‘船并老码头’。”
I mean to have A’qi moor her boat at the old landing.”

陈世龙一愣，
Chen was startled.

再细想一想，不由得衷心钦服，
Then, thinking it through, he felt profound admiration.

郁四少不得阿七，是他早就深知的。
He had long known that Yu could not do without A’qi.

现在硬生生的拆散，完全是阿兰姐夫妇在捣鬼。
Their enforced separation was entirely the work of A’lan and her husband.

倘能破镜重圆，且不说阿七这方面，起码郁四的心情，就不会这么颓丧。
If the broken mirror could be made whole again, then, quite apart from A’qi's feelings, Yu would at least cease to be so dejected.

当然，自己的麻烦，就此烟消云散，更不在话下。
Naturally, Chen's own troubles would vanish too.

“胡先生！真正是，有时候我们看事情总不够透彻，自己不晓得什么道理？
“Mr Hu, sometimes we fail to see things clearly and can't understand why.

现在我懂了，
Now I know.

差的就是那一层纸，一个指头可以戳破的，我们就是看不到！”
There's only a sheet of paper between us and the answer, thin enough to pierce with a finger, yet we simply can't see it!”

“你不要恭维我。
“Don't flatter me.

事情成不成，还不晓得。
We don't know yet whether it will work.

等我先去探探口气。”
Let me first find out how matters stand.

胡雪岩说，“先去看你郁四叔。”
We'll go and see your Fourth Uncle.”


于是陈世龙上岸，在码头上雇了两乘轿子，一直抬到郁四家。
Chen went ashore and hired two sedan chairs at the wharf to carry them straight to Yu's house.

陈世龙先下轿，一直奔了进去，只见郁四一个人在喝闷酒，
Getting out first, he hurried inside and found Yu drinking alone in low spirits.

叫应一声，接下来说：“胡先生来了！”
He greeted him, then announced, “Mr Hu is here!”

郁四顿有惊喜之色，
Delight and surprise instantly appeared on Yu's face.

“在哪里？”他站起身问。
“Where?” he asked, rising.

“从船上下来，就到这里，
“He's come straight here from the boat.

他是专程来看四叔的。”
He made the journey especially to see you, Fourth Uncle.”

正说到这里，胡雪岩已经走进二门，
As Chen spoke, Hu had already entered the inner gate.

郁四急忙迎了上去，
Yu hurried to meet him.

执手相看，似乎都有千言万语，不知从何说起？
They clasped hands and looked at one another, each seemingly with a thousand things to say and no idea where to begin.

好半天，胡雪岩才说了句：“四哥，你不要难过！”
At last Hu said, “Brother Yu, don't grieve so.”

不说还好，
Until then Yu had held himself together.

一说正说到郁四伤心之处，眼泪簌簌地流个不住，
Those words touched the heart of his sorrow, and tears streamed down his face.

顿足哭道：“做人真没有意思！”
Stamping his foot, he cried, “There's no point in living!”

接着又哽哽咽咽，断断续续地说，不逢知己，连痛哭一场都不能够。
Between broken sobs, he went on: without a true friend, he could not even have a proper cry.

自己有多少心事，无人可诉，这份苦楚，一时也说不尽。
He had so much on his mind and nobody to tell; all his suffering could not be expressed at once.

如今交代了胡雪岩，便要辞掉衙门里的差使，找个清静地方去吃素念佛，了此余生。
Now that Hu had come, he would explain everything to him, resign his post at the yamen, and find somewhere quiet to eat vegetarian food and recite the Buddha's name for the rest of his days.

“四哥，四哥！”胡雪岩连声叫唤，“不必如此，不必如此！”
“Brother Yu, Brother Yu! There's no need for that!” Hu kept repeating.

就这样解劝着，他半搀半携地把郁四扶到里面，
With these consoling words, he half supported and half led Yu indoors.

接着阿兰姐出来拜见，
A’lan came out to greet him.

虽是初见，久已闻名，她知道这是自己父亲的一个很够分量的朋友，
Although they had never met, she had long heard his name and knew that he was an influential friend of her father's.

所以礼数甚恭，好好敷衍了一阵，接着重治酒肴，留客便饭。
She was therefore scrupulously courteous, attending to him for a while before having fresh dishes and wine prepared and asking him to stay for a simple meal.


胡雪岩在席问只听郁四诉苦，很少说话，
At the table, Hu listened to Yu's complaints and said little.

一则是要多听，二则此时也不便深谈。
He wanted to hear more, and this was not the place for a confidential discussion.

等郁四倾吐了心里的愁郁，精神显得振作了些，他才说道：“四哥，我有几句心腹话想说。”
Only after Yu had poured out his distress and begun to look somewhat revived did Hu say, “Brother Yu, there are a few things I'd like to say in confidence.”

“噢！”
“Ah!”

郁四懂了他的意思，
Yu understood.

“到我钱庄里去坐。”
“Let's go and sit at my bank.”

到了聚成钱庄，郁四那间密室里没有第三者，两人靠在烟榻上，聚首密谈，
At Jucheng Bank, with nobody else in Yu's private room, they reclined together on the opium couch and spoke quietly.

胡雪岩的第一句话是，“四哥，阿七到底是怎么回事？”
Hu's first question was, “Brother Yu, what exactly happened with A’qi?”

“唉！”郁四长叹一声，又息了好一会才说：
Yu gave a long sigh, then paused for some time.

“我不晓得从何说起？
“I don't know where to begin.

这件事……”
This affair...”

他摇摇头，又叹口气。
He shook his head and sighed again.

察言观色、这没有说完的一句话是：这件事我做错了。
From his expression and manner, Hu could complete the unfinished sentence: I was wrong.

有此表示，见得胡雪岩的那句话一针见血！
Clearly, his question had touched the sore spot.

这就用不着再迂回试探了，
There was no need for further indirect probing.

“四哥，”他开门见山地说：“我替你把阿七弄回来！”
“Brother Yu,” he said plainly, “I'll get A’qi back for you.”

一听这话，郁四仰直了头看着胡雪岩，仿佛弄不懂他的意思，当他在说笑话，
Yu raised his head and stared, as though he could not understand and thought Hu must be joking.

当然不会是笑话！
But of course he was not.

胡雪岩从不说这些笑话的，
Hu never joked about such things.

就算是笑话，他也相信胡雪岩有把笑话变成真事的手段。
Even if it were a joke, Yu believed he had the means to make it real.

要考虑的只是自己这方面。
He needed only to consider his own position.


“难处也很多……”
“There would be a great many difficulties...”

“不！”胡雪岩打断他的话说，
“No!” Hu interrupted.

“四哥，你不要管这些个。
“You needn't concern yourself with those.

你说的难处，我都知道，
I know the difficulties you mean.

第一，怕阿兰姐跟阿七不和，
First, you're afraid A’lan and A’qi won't get on.

第二，怕阿七心里有气，故意拿跷。
Second, you're afraid A’qi is still angry and will deliberately make herself difficult to please.

这些都不是难处，
Neither is a problem.

包在我身上，安排得妥妥帖帖，
Leave them to me, and I'll arrange everything properly.

只看四哥你自己。
It depends only on you.

如果你一定要唱一出《马前泼水》，那就不必再谈。
If you're determined to act out Water Spilled Before the Horse and refuse to take her back, there's nothing more to discuss.

否则，一切归我来办。
Otherwise, leave it all to me.

你倒说一句看！
Tell me what you think.”

““有你这样的好朋友，我还说什么？”
“With a friend like you, what more can I say?”

“那就行了，
“That's settled, then.

我就要你这一句话，
Your word is all I need.

你请躺一躺，
Lie here and rest.

我跟世龙说句话，马上就回来。”
I'll have a word with Shilong and come straight back.”

于是胡雪岩离榻而起，把陈世龙找到，拉至僻处，密密嘱咐了一番，
Hu rose from the couch, found Chen, and drew him aside to give him detailed instructions in private.

等陈世龙领计而去，他才回到原处。
Only after Chen had left to carry them out did Hu return.


“四哥，”他说，“我话先说在前面，
“Brother Yu, let me say this first.

谈到你的家务，只怕我言语太直，你会不会动气？”
If I speak too bluntly about your family affairs, will you be offended?”

“这叫什么话？
“What a thing to ask!

你我的交情，哪怕你就责备我不是，我也要听你的。”
With our friendship, even if you reproached me outright, I should listen.”

“既然如此，我就老实说了，
“Then I'll speak frankly.

你那位令嫒，大家都说她厉害得很，
Everyone says that daughter of yours is extremely formidable.

可有这话？”
Is it true?”

“有的。”
“Yes.”

郁四点点头，
Yu nodded.

“我也在防她。”
“I'm on my guard against her myself.”

“至亲骨肉，时时刻刻要防备，那就苦了。
“It's a miserable thing to have to guard against your own flesh and blood all the time.

打开天窗说亮话，
Let's speak openly.

人为财死，鸟为食亡，
Men die for wealth as birds die for food.

为来为去，为两个钱。
Whatever the twists and turns, it's all about money.

我劝你不如趁此机会分家。
I advise you to take this opportunity to divide the estate.

女儿也得一份，叫她不必再想东想西，
Give your daughter a share too, so that she needn't keep scheming.

岂不爽快吗？”
Wouldn't that settle things neatly?”

“嗯，嗯！”
“Yes, yes.”

郁四慢慢点头道：
Yu nodded slowly.

“这倒也是个办法。
“That is one way.

你再说，
Go on.

你总还有话。”
You must have more to say.”

“分家也有个分法。”
“There are different ways to divide an estate.

胡雪岩说，“我先要问你，你自己总也有过打算？”
First I must ask whether you've made any plans yourself.”


“我哪里有什么打算？
“What plans could I have?

阿虎一死，我的心冰凉，
When A’hu died, my heart turned to ice.

恨不得出家做和尚！
I wished I could become a monk.

他们怎么说，怎么好，
Whatever they said was good enough for me.

反正我都丢开了，随他们去搞。
I'd abandoned everything; they could do as they pleased.

不过，”
But...”

郁四顿了一顿，显得有些激动，
Yu paused, visibly moved.

“小和尚一来，听说了他的情形。我心里才高兴了些。
“When Little Monk came and I heard how he was getting on, I began to feel a little happier.

今天，你路远迢迢抽出工夫来看我，
And today you've made time to travel all this way to see me.

想想这个世界上也还有些好东西。
It makes me think there are still some good things in this world.

说句实话，到现在我才稍微有点做人的乐趣。”
To tell you the truth, only now am I beginning to find a little pleasure in being alive.”

这才真的是肺腑之言，
These were words from the heart.

胡雪岩觉得很安慰，也越觉得要替他尽心，
Hu felt comforted and all the more determined to do his utmost.

“四哥，”他说，“承蒙你看得起我，我倒不能不多事了，
“Brother Yu, since you think so well of me, I can't avoid taking a hand.

索性变得深些。
I might as well go further.

府上的事，要通盘筹划，
We must plan for the whole household.

麻烦虽多，不能怕事，
However many difficulties there are, we mustn't shrink from them.

挺一挺胸，咬一咬牙，把它一起理清楚了，
Straighten your back, grit your teeth, and let's untangle everything at once.

好不好？”
Shall we?”

“好啊！”郁四很兴奋的回答，
“Yes!” Yu answered eagerly.

他自己也盘算过家务，但越想越头痛，
He too had tried to plan for his household, but the more he thought, the worse his head ached.

始终鼓不起勇气来清理这一团乱丝，
He had never found the courage to sort out that tangled skein.

现在听胡雪岩这样说法，先就如释重负，心里好过得多。
Hu's words alone lifted a burden from him, and he already felt much better.

“那么，一样样地谈。
“Then let's take things one at a time.

我先请问，你衙门里的差使，将来怎么样处置？”
First, what do you intend to do about your post at the yamen?”


户书是世袭的差使，
The revenue clerk's post was hereditary.

因为手中有一本将全县田地业主、座落、亩数、赋额记载得明明白白的“鱼鳞册”，
In his hands was a fish-scale register, recording every landowner in the county, the location and acreage of each holding, and the tax assessed on it.

这就是世世代代吃着不穷的衣食饭碗。
This provided an inexhaustible livelihood from generation to generation.

如果阿虎不死，自然归他承袭父职，
Had A’hu lived, he would naturally have succeeded his father.

现在膝下无子，
Now Yu had no son.

即令将来有后，要把儿子教养成人，是二三十年后的事。
Even if he later had another, it would take twenty or thirty years to bring the child to manhood.

渺焉无凭，作不得那佯不切实际的打算，
Such a distant and uncertain prospect could not form the basis of a practical plan.

所以郁四曾经一度想辞差，这是绝少有的事，
That was why Yu had once considered resigning, an exceedingly rare step.

通常总是有亲子则亲子承袭，否则就收个螟蛉子，
Ordinarily, a natural son inherited the post; failing that, the clerk adopted a son.

甚至高价顶让，改姓承袭。
He might even transfer it for a high price, with the successor changing his surname before taking over.

此刻当然已不作辞差打算，但究竟应该如何处理？
Yu no longer meant to resign, but what should he do instead?

郁囚却一时不得主意。
He could not decide.

遇见胡雪岩，他就懒得去伤脑筋了，
With Hu there, he could not be bothered to rack his brains.

直截了当地摇摇头：
He simply shook his head.

“我不晓得。”
“I don't know.”

“好，
“Very well.

我再请问第二件。”胡雪岩说，“你那令媳，
My second question concerns your daughter-in-law.

你又如何替她打算？”
What arrangements do you intend to make for her?”


“这件事我最为难！”
“That is my greatest difficulty!”

郁四放下烟枪，矍然而起，
Yu put down his opium pipe and sat up abruptly.

“你想想，今年才十九岁，又没有儿子。
“Think of it: she's only nineteen, and she has no son.

怎么守法？”
How can she remain a widow?”

“她自己的意思呢？”
“What does she want herself?”

“她当然要守。”
“Naturally, she wants to remain faithful to her husband.”

“守节是越守越难。
“The longer a widow keeps that vow, the harder it becomes.

尽有守到四十出头出了毛病的！
Plenty have held out until their forties and then faltered.

四哥，我说句老实话，
Brother Yu, let me speak frankly.

我们又不是啥书香门第，
We aren't some great scholarly family.

不妨看开些，
We can afford to take a broader view.

再说，为儿子挣座贞节牌坊，还有点意思，
Besides, earning a chastity arch for a son to be proud of has some point.

没有儿子，没有希望，守不守得住，且不去说它，就算守着了一座贞节牌坊，有啥味道？”
With no son and nothing to look forward to, leave aside whether she could keep the vow: even if she won her arch, what pleasure would it give her?”

“你说得透彻。
“You put it clearly.

我主意定了，
I've made up my mind.

还是劝她嫁的好，
We'd better persuade her to remarry.

有合适的人，我把她当女儿嫁出去，好好陪嫁。
If there's a suitable man, I'll marry her off as my own daughter and give her a good dowry.

不过，”
But...”

郁四皱眉又说，
Yu frowned again.

“万一她一定要守，怎么办？”
“What if she insists on remaining a widow?”

这当然只好成全她的志向，为她在族中选一个侄儿过继为子，
Naturally, they could only respect her wishes and choose a nephew from the clan for her to adopt as a son.

然而将来又如何呢？
Yet what would happen afterwards?

有郁四在自然没有话说，
While Yu lived, there would be no difficulty.

倘或三年五载以后，郁四撒手归西，则孤儿寡妇，难保不受人欺凌。
If he died in three or five years, however, the widow and her fatherless child might well be bullied.


这些难处，胡雪岩早就替他想到了，
Hu had already considered these difficulties for him.

“凭四哥你在外头的面子，百年以后，不怕没有人照应府上。
“With your standing outside the family, Brother Yu, there will be no shortage of people to look after your household when you're gone.

不过清官难断家务事，
But even an upright magistrate finds family disputes hard to judge.

你们自己族里要出花样，外人就很难说话了。”
If your own clansmen cause trouble, outsiders can scarcely intervene.”

胡雪岩先这样把症结点明，然后才替他划策。
Having identified the heart of the problem, he explained his plan.

胡雪岩的想法，如果阿虎嫂愿意守节，应该有个在郁四身后可以朋料她的人，这个人就是未来的当家。
If A’hu's widow wished to remain unmarried, there must be someone to look after her after Yu's death: the future head of the household.

郁四得找一个年轻、能干而最要紧的是忠厚的人，收为义子，改姓为郁，
Yu should find a young, capable man who was, above all, honest and kind, adopt him as a son, and have him take the surname Yu.

不必顶他的香烟，只是继承他的世袭差使。
He need not carry on Yu's ancestral line; his role would be to inherit the hereditary post.

此人受恩所须报答于郁四的，就是将来照应阿虎嫂母子，以及阿七可能为郁四生下的小儿女。
In return for this favour, he must undertake to care for A’hu's widow and her adopted son, as well as any young children A’qi might bear Yu.

这是面面俱到的办法，郁四完全同意。
The plan covered everything, and Yu agreed entirely.

难题是这个可以“托孤”的人，不容易找，
The difficulty lay in finding someone to whom orphans could be entrusted.

在户房中，郁四虽有些得力的帮手，但不是年龄太长，早已生儿育女，不可能做人家的螟蛉，
He had able assistants in the revenue office, but some were too old, already with families of their own, and could hardly become another man's adopted son.

便是虽有本事，人品不佳，
Others had ability but lacked character.

有郁四在，不敢出什么花样，郁四一死，必定难制，
While Yu lived, they would not dare misbehave; once he died, they would surely be uncontrollable.

托以孤儿寡妇，会变成羊落虎口。
To entrust widows and orphans to them would be to put sheep into a tiger's jaws.

“世上无难事，只怕有心人，
“Nothing is impossible to a determined man.

好在这事也不急，
Fortunately, there's no hurry.

你慢慢留心好了。”
Keep your eyes open and take your time.”


忽然，郁四很兴奋地欲有所言，
Suddenly, Yu looked excited and seemed about to speak.

但刚抬起身子，便又颓然倒下，
He had scarcely raised himself, however, before sinking back dejectedly.

摇摇头自语：“不行！不行！”
“No, no,” he muttered, shaking his head.

胡雪岩倒有些困惑，
Hu was puzzled.

想想自己的办法，没有什么行不通的，随即问道：
He could see nothing impracticable in his plan.

“怎么说不行？”
“Why do you say no?”

“我倒想到一个人。”郁四慢吞吞地说：
“I've thought of someone,” Yu said slowly.

“只怕你不肯。”
“But I'm afraid you wouldn't agree.”

这一说胡雪岩才明白就里，
Now Hu understood.

“大概你是看中了世龙？”他问。
“You mean Shilong?”

“不错。”
“Exactly.

郁四说，“他是你得力的人，
He's a great help to you.

你没法放手的。”
You couldn't let him go.”

“这倒是实话。
“That's true.

不过你的事也要紧，
But your affairs matter too.

果真世龙自己愿意，我也不便反对。”
If Shilong himself really wished it, I could hardly object.”

“那再谈吧！”
“We can discuss that another time.”

郁四怕他为难，自己收篷，顾而言他，
Afraid of putting Hu in a difficult position, Yu drew back and changed the subject.

“你再说说看，我分家的事怎么样？”
“Tell me more about dividing my estate.”


“女儿原是分不着的，
“A daughter would ordinarily receive no share.

不过家私是你所挣，你愿意怎么样用，谁也管不着你。
But you've earned the property yourself, and nobody can tell you what to do with it.

我的意思，你先提出一笔来给女儿，也是你们做父女一场！”
I suggest setting aside a sum for her first, in recognition of the bond between father and daughter.”

话说得很含蓄，
Hu put this delicately.

意思是这一来可以绝了阿兰姐觊觎娘家之心，省去多少是非。
He meant that it would end A’lan's designs on her parents' property and prevent a great deal of trouble.

郁四本来当局者迷，一直以为女儿是一番孝心，
Too deeply involved to see clearly, Yu had always supposed that his daughter acted from filial devotion.

现在才有些明白，
Only now did he begin to understand.

觉得此举是必要的，所以连连点头：
Seeing the necessity, he nodded repeatedly.

“我分一百亩田，提两万现银给她。
“I'll give her a hundred mu of farmland and twenty thousand taels in ready silver.

也要把话说明白，叫他们夫妇拿良心出来。”
And I shall speak plainly: she and her husband must show some conscience.”

说到这样的活，胡雪岩不便接口，
Hu could not readily respond to such words.

停了一下说：
After a pause, he went on.

“此外你应该作三股派，
“Divide the rest into three shares.

阿虎嫂如果一定要守，自然该得一股，
If A’hu's widow insists on remaining unmarried, she naturally deserves one.

阿七将来会有儿女，也该得一股，
A’qi will have children in future, so she should have another.

另外一股留在你自己手里，慢慢再说，
Keep the third in your own hands and decide what to do with it later.

有这一股在手里，大家都会孝顺你，
While you have that share, everyone will treat you dutifully.

千万不要分光！
Whatever you do, don't give it all away!

还有一层，等分好了，一定要禀请官府立案，以绝后患。”
One more thing: once the division is settled, you must ask the authorities to put it on record, to prevent trouble later.”


“这我懂！
“I understand.

我都依你的话做。
I'll do everything you say.

现在，”
Now...”

郁四很吃力地说，
Yu spoke with difficulty.

“只怕阿七心里还在怪我。
“I'm only afraid A’qi still blames me.”

““这是免不了的。”
“That's unavoidable.”

胡雪岩有意隐瞒阿七对陈世龙的那段情，而且还说了一句假话，
Hu deliberately concealed A’qi's attachment to Chen and even told a lie.

“阿七其实还念着你的好处。
“She still remembers your kindness, really.

你就算看在我的面上，委屈些！
For my sake, put up with a little humiliation.

回头阿七要发牢骚，哪怕给你难看，四哥，你都要忍一忍。
If she complains later, or even makes you look foolish, Brother Yu, you must bear with her.”

““她是那样子的脾气，
“That's her temper.

我不跟她计较。”
I won't take it to heart.

郁四说道：“照你的意思，等下我要眼她见面，
From what you say, I'm to see her shortly.

在哪里？”
Where?”

“等世龙回来再说。
“We'll discuss that when Shilong comes back.

此刻你先过足了瘾，回头好有精神应付阿七。”
For now, satisfy your craving, so that you'll have the energy to deal with A’qi later.”

“应付”是句双关语，
“Deal with” carried a double meaning.

郁四会心一笑，听他的话，抽足了鸦片，静待好事成双。
Yu gave an understanding smile, smoked his fill of opium as advised, and waited for good things to come in pairs.

郁四也不知他葫芦里卖的什么药？
He had no idea what Hu had up his sleeve.

心里悬念而好奇，但不能不沉着处之，
Anxious and curious though he was, he must remain composed.

微微一笑，抛开阿七，问起胡雪岩自己的事。
With a faint smile, he dropped the subject of A’qi and asked about Hu's own affairs.


这就有得好谈了。
There was plenty to discuss.

胡雪岩与尤五之间的秘密，特别是关于小刀会的内幕，他在陈世龙面前都是守口如瓶，
Hu had kept his dealings with You Laowu, particularly the inside story of the Small Swords Society, strictly secret even from Chen.

而对郁四却无须隐瞒。
With Yu, however, there was no need for concealment.

并头低语，声音低到仅仅只有两个人听得见，
They put their heads together and spoke so softly that only the two of them could hear.

郁四一面打着烟泡，一面侧耳静听，
As Yu prepared the opium pellets, he listened intently.

觉得惊心动魄，对胡雪岩更加另眼相看了。
The account startled and thrilled him, and he regarded Hu with still greater respect.

“想不到你有这一番经历！”听完了他说，
“I never imagined you'd been through all this!” he said when Hu finished.

“说得我都恨不能象你这样去闯闯码头。”
“It makes me wish I could go out and try my fortune in different places, as you have.”

见他受了鼓舞，胡雪岩正好趁机劝他，
Seeing him encouraged, Hu seized the opportunity.

“四哥，这几年是一重劫运、惊天动地的日子，
“Brother Yu, these years are a time of great calamity, when the world is shaken to its foundations.

我不相信在劫难逃这句话，
I don't believe in saying that doom is inescapable.

只觉得一个人要出头，就在这个当口。
I think this is precisely the moment for a man to distinguish himself.

人生在世，吃饱穿暖，糊里糊涂过一生，到闭眼的那一刻，想想当初，说不定会懊悔到这世界上来一遭，
If he spends his life fed and clothed, muddling through without a thought, he may look back as he closes his eyes and regret ever having come into the world.

这就没啥意思了！”
What would be the point of that?”

“是啊。”
“Exactly.

郁四答道，“人死留名，豹死留皮，
A man leaves his name as a leopard leaves its skin.

总要做件把别人做不到的事，生前死后，有人提起来，翘一翘大拇指，说一声‘某人有种’，
We must do one or two things others cannot do, so that, in life and after death, people will raise a thumb at the mention of our names and say, ‘That man had courage.’

这才是不辱没爷娘！”
Then we won't have disgraced our parents.”

听这语气，胡雪岩想起从嵇鹤龄那里听来的一句成语，脱口说道：
His tone reminded Hu of a saying he had heard from Ji Heling, and he repeated it at once.

“老骥伏枥，志在千里‘，
“‘An old steed in the stable still dreams of a thousand-mile journey.’

四哥，你果有此心，眼前倒有个机会，可以做一番事业。”
Brother Yu, if that's truly your ambition, there's an opportunity before you to accomplish something.”


“噢！
“Oh?

你说。”
Tell me.”

“你们湖州办团练，
“They're organising a militia here in Huzhou.

听说赵景贤是个角色，
I hear Zhao Jingxian is a capable man.

你如果能够帮他办好了，保境安民，大家提起你来，都要翘大拇指了。”
If you help him make a success of it, protecting the district and keeping the people safe, everyone will speak of you with admiration.”

郁四不响，
Yu said nothing.

只是双眼眨得厉害，眨了半天，忽然抛下烟枪，坐起身来说：
He blinked rapidly for some time, then suddenly put down his opium pipe and sat up.

“你说得对！
“You're right!

要人要钱，我尽我的力量。
Men or money, I'll provide all I can.

不过我不便自己凑上门去。
But I can't very well go offering myself.

倒不是要他来请教我，
It isn't that I want him to come begging for my advice.

是怕人说我高攀，想挤到绅士堆里，自抬身价。”
I'm afraid people would say I was reaching above my station, trying to push my way among the gentry and raise my own standing.”

“这也不是这么说法。
“That's hardly the way to look at it.

守土之责，人人有分！”
Everyone has a duty to defend the district.”

胡雪岩略停一停说，
Hu paused briefly.

“我来安排，
“I'll arrange it.

叫王大老爷来跟赵景贤说，
I'll ask Prefect Wang to speak to Zhao Jingxian.

那样，四哥你面子上也过得去了。”
That will preserve your dignity as well.”

“好！
“Good!

你去办，
You arrange it.

我只听你的招呼就是。”
I'll wait for your word.”

说着，他下了炕床，关照聚成的人备饭，
He got down from the couch and told the bank's staff to prepare a meal.

兴致极好，迥不是以前那种垂头丧气的颓唐之态。
His spirits were excellent: the former dejection and listlessness had completely disappeared.


刚刚拿起酒杯，陈世龙赶到，
They had just raised their wine cups when Chen arrived.

冲胡雪岩点了点头，坐下来一起吃饭。
He nodded to Hu and sat down to eat with them.

郁四知道他是安排好了，只不知道他是如何安排？
Yu knew that the arrangements were complete, but not what they were.

跟阿七见了面，自己该说些什么？
When he saw A’qi, what should he say?

心里痒痒地却不便问，
He was burning to know, yet could hardly ask.

那酒就吃得似乎没啥味道。
The wine seemed to have lost its flavour.

“少喝两杯！”胡雪岩说，
“Don't drink too much,” Hu said.

“回头再吃。”
“There'll be more later.”

郁四听这话，便喝干了酒，叫人拿饭来吃。
At that, Yu drained his cup and asked for rice.

吃完，一个人坐在旁边喝茶，静候胡雪岩行动。
When he had finished eating, he sat to one side with his tea, waiting for Hu to act.

“我们走吧！”
“Let's go.”

“慢点。”
“Wait.”

郁四到底不能缄默，
Yu could no longer keep silent.

“到哪里？”
“Where?”

“到大经丝行。”
“To the Dajing Silk Firm.

胡雪岩说，“我请阿七来碰头，
I've asked A’qi to meet me there.

你躲在我后房听，
You can hide in the back room and listen.

说什么你都不必开口！
Whatever is said, don't speak.

等我一叫，你再出来。”
Come out only when I call.”

“出来以后怎么样？”
“And what am I to do then?”

“那……”胡雪岩笑道：
“Well...” Hu laughed.

“你们两个人的事，
“That's between the two of you.

我怎么知道？”
How should I know?”

这句皮里阳秋的谐语，表示接下来就是重圆破镜，复谐好事。
The teasing words concealed their meaning: the broken mirror would be made whole, and the couple reunited.

郁四听了当然兴奋，急着要走。
Naturally, Yu was excited and eager to leave.


三个人一起出了聚成钱庄，却分两路，
The three left Jucheng Bank together but went separate ways.

郁四跟胡雪岩到大经，陈世龙别有去处，
Yu accompanied Hu to Dajing; Chen had another destination.

他第一次受计所办的是“调虎离山”，
His first assignment had been to “lure the tiger away from the mountain.”

赶到老张那里，报告胡雪岩已到湖州，说跟郁四有要紧话在大经商谈，不便让黄仪知道，
He had hurried to Old Zhang and reported that Hu was in Huzhou and had important matters to discuss with Yu at Dajing, matters Huang Yi ought not to know about.

嘱咐老张夫妇，借商谈陈世龙的亲事为名，把他邀到家，把杯谈心，务必绊着他的身子。
Old Zhang and his wife were to invite Huang to their home on the pretext of discussing Chen's marriage, drink and talk with him, and make sure they kept him there.

这样做的用意，就因为阿七要到大经来，怕跟黄仪遇到，彼此不便。
The purpose was to prevent an awkward meeting between Huang and A’qi when she came to Dajing.

敲开阿七家的门，
Now Chen knocked at A’qi's door.

她是诧异多于一切，
Her chief feeling was astonishment.

瞪着一双水汪汪的眼睛，只说了句：“是你！”
Staring at him with her limpid eyes, she said only, “You!”

“是我。”陈世尤平静地说，
“Yes, me,” Chen replied calmly.

“无事不登三宝殿！”
“One doesn't visit the temple without a reason.”

“有事？
“A reason?

哼！”
Hmph!”

阿七冷笑：
She gave a cold laugh.

“你是卑鄙小人，
“You're a despicable creature.

良心叫狗吃掉了！”
The dogs have eaten your conscience!”

“怎么好端端骂人？”
“Why start abusing me out of the blue?”

“为什么不骂你！”
“Why shouldn't I?”

阿七一个指头，戳到他额上，使劲往后一揿，指甲切入肉里，立刻便是一个红印。
She thrust a finger against his forehead and pushed hard, her nail digging into his skin and leaving a red mark.

“不要动手动脚！”
“Keep your hands to yourself!

陈世龙说，“胡先生从杭州来了，
Mr Hu has come from Hangzhou.

他叫我来请你过去，
He sent me to ask you over.

有话跟你谈。”
He wants to talk to you.”

“你还想来骗人，
“Still trying to deceive me!

真正良心丧尽了。
You really have no conscience left.

你自己躲我，还不要紧。
Avoiding me yourself is one thing.

你叫黄仪来打我的主意，拿我送礼，讨他的好！”
But you sent Huang Yi to make a play for me, handing me over as a present to win his favour!”

阿七越说越气，大声骂道：“你替我滚！
Growing angrier as she spoke, she shouted, “Get out!

我不要看你。”
I don't want to see you.”


这一说，陈世龙想起那天的光景，忍不住纵声大笑。
This reminded Chen of the scene that day, and he could not help laughing aloud.

“你还笑！
“You dare laugh?

有啥好笑？”
What's so funny?”

“我笑他癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉。
“I'm laughing at a toad longing to eat swan's flesh.

差点眼睛都被戳瞎。”
He very nearly had his eyes poked out.”

“ 咦！”
“Oh!”

阿七秋波乱转，困惑地问：“难道他还好意思把这桩‘有面了’的事告诉你听？”
Her eyes moved restlessly as she asked in puzzlement, “Did he really have the nerve to tell you about that glorious achievement?”

“他怎么会告诉我？
“How could he tell me?

我在间壁楼梯下面张望，
I was watching from under the stairs next door.

亲眼看到的。”陈世龙又说，
I saw it with my own eyes.

“阿七，你想想，
Think about it, A’qi.

我怎么会捉弄你？
Why would I play a trick on you?

我们是熟人，
We're old acquaintances.

而况你又有私房钱叫我替你放息，
Besides, you've entrusted your private savings to me to put out at interest.

我捉弄了你，不怕你跟我逼债？”
If I wronged you, wouldn't I be afraid of your pressing me for the money?”

听这一说，阿七有些发窘，破颜一笑，故意这样说道：
She looked a little embarrassed, then smiled.

“对！
“Exactly!

我就赖你欠我的钱，
I'll make out that you owe me money.

不听我的话，我就去替你‘卖朝报’！”
If you don't do as I say, I'll broadcast it all over town.”

“好了，好了！”
“Enough of that.

陈世龙问：“你要不要换件衣服？
Do you want to change your clothes?

如果不换，我们此刻就走。”
If not, let's go now.”

“真的胡老板要见我？”阿七答非所问地：
“Mr Hu really wants to see me?” she asked instead of answering.

“ 他有啥话要跟我谈。”
“What does he want to say?”

“I don't know.

不过，我告诉你，他现在鸿运当头，
But I can tell you this: his luck is riding high.

照顾到哪个，哪个就有好处。
Anyone he looks after benefits.

你听我的话，跟我走！”
Take my advice and come.”

陈世龙把她打量了一番，
He looked her over.

虽是家常打扮，风韵自胜，
Even in her everyday clothes, she had an unmistakable charm.

使又说道：“这样也蛮漂亮，
“You look very pretty as you are.

不要换衣服了。”
Don't bother changing.”

阿七听他的话，
She did as he said.

嘱咐了她所用的那个爱打瞌盹的小大姐当心门户，跟着陈世龙出门，
After telling her sleepy young maid to keep an eye on the house, she went out with him.

巷口雇一顶小轿，一直抬到大经丝行。
At the end of the lane they hired a small sedan chair, which carried her straight to Dajing.


“越来越年轻了！”
“You grow younger every day!”

胡雪岩迎着她，便先灌了句米汤，接着取出一个外国货的錾银粉镜，这是特地叫陈世龙向阿珠借来的，

“没啥好东西。郁四嫂，
“It's nothing very fine, Sister-in-Law Yu.

千里鹅毛一点心，
A goose feather sent a thousand miles is a token of affection.

你将就着用。
I hope you'll find it useful.”

““多谢胡老板，
“Thank you, Mr Hu.

不过，你的称呼，不敢当。”
But I can't accept that form of address.”

“不是这话。
“Don't say that.

不管你跟郁四哥生什么闲气，我总当你郁四嫂！”
Whatever quarrel you may have with Brother Yu, I shall always regard you as Sister-in-Law Yu.”

“How could I aspire to a place in the Yu family?

胡老板，多承你抬举我，实在对不起，要叫你骂一声‘不识抬举’了！”
You do me a great honour, Mr Hu, and I'm very sorry, but you'll have to call me ungrateful for refusing it.”

听她的口风甚紧，胡雪岩不敢造次，
Finding her so guarded, Hu dared not rush matters.

一面请她落座，一面向陈世龙使个眼色，暗示他避开。
He invited her to sit and gave Chen a glance, signalling him to withdraw.

“那么，我走了！”陈世龙说，
“I'll be off, then,” Chen said.

“See you tomorrow, A’qi.”

“慢点。”胡雪岩故意问一句：“你到哪里去？
“Wait.” Hu deliberately asked, “Where are you going?

是不是阿珠在等你？”
Is A’zhu waiting for you?”

这还用思索？
There was no need to think about the answer.

当然是实实在在地答应一个：“是！”
Chen gave a firm, straightforward “Yes.”

“将来又是个怕老婆的家伙！”胡雪岩望着陈世龙的背影，轻轻说了句，
“Another man who'll be afraid of his wife!” Hu murmured as he watched Chen leave.

偷眼看阿七的脸上，是爽然若失的神情，
A sidelong glance showed a look of emptiness and loss on A’qi's face.

便知自己这番做作不错。
His little performance had worked.

要先把陈世龙的影子从她心里抹干净，再来为郁四拉拢，事情就容易了。
Once he had erased Chen's image from her heart, bringing her back to Yu would be easier.


“胡老板！”
“Mr Hu!”

阿七定定神问道，“不晓得你有啥话要跟我说？
Composing herself, A’qi asked, “What did you wish to say to me?

请吩咐！”
Please give me your instructions.”

“吩咐二字不敢当。
“I wouldn't presume to give instructions.

郁四嫂！说句实话，我这趟是专程来看郁四哥的，
Sister-in-Law Yu, the truth is that I came especially to see Brother Yu.

这么一把年纪，没有了一个独养儿子，你想想可怜不可怜？”
At his age, to lose his only son—isn't it pitiful?”

阿七在恨郁四，想答一句“可怜不足惜”！
Resenting Yu, she wanted to answer that he deserved no pity.

话到口边，觉得刻薄，便忍住了点一点头。
The words reached her lips, but she thought them too harsh and restrained herself, merely nodding.

“阿虎我没有见过，
“I never met A’hu.

他为人怎么样？”
What was he like?”

“郁家这位大少爷，凭良心说，总算是难得的好人。”
“In all fairness, that young master of the Yu family was an exceptionally good man.

阿七答道，“不比他那个姐姐，眼睛长在额头上。”
Quite unlike his sister, who has her eyes on top of her forehead.”

“是啊，我听说你跟郁家大小姐不和，
“Yes, I've heard you and the young lady don't get on.

有没有这话？”
Is that true?”

“这话，胡老板你说对了一半，
“You're only half right, Mr Hu.

是她跟我不和！”阿七愤愤地说，
She's the one who doesn't get on with me!” A’qi said angrily.

“她老子听了宝贝女儿的话，要跟我分手。
“Her father listened to his precious daughter and wanted to separate from me.

分就分，
Very well, then!

我也不在乎他！”
I don't care about him either.”

“唉！郁四哥糊涂到了极点！”
“Brother Yu has been a complete fool!”

胡雪岩摆出为她大不平的神态，责备郁四，
Hu took her side with an air of indignation.

“你跟了他，算是委屈的，
“You lowered yourself by going with him.

他怎么得福不知？
How could he fail to appreciate his good fortune?

我先当是你要跟他分手，
I thought you had wanted to leave him.

原来是他自己糊涂，
So he was the foolish one!

这我非好好说他几句不可！”
I must give him a good talking-to.”

“哪里是我要跟他分开？”阿七上当了，极力辩白，
A’qi fell into the trap and defended herself vigorously. “When did I ever want to leave him?

“我从来都没有起过这样的心思。
The thought never entered my head.

都是他自己，
It was all his own doing.

一心还想弄两个年轻的，
He still has his heart set on getting a couple of young ones.

人老心不老，不晓得在交什么墓库运！”
Old in years but young at heart—I don't know what ill-fated spell he's under!”

“好！”
“Excellent!”

胡雪岩翘着大拇指说，
Hu raised his thumb.

“郁四嫂，我倒真还看不出，你一片真心，都在郁四哥身上。”
“Sister-in-Law Yu, I never realised how completely your heart belonged to him.”

“哼，
“Hmph!

有啥用？”
What good does that do?”

阿七黯然摇头，
She shook her head despondently.

“好人做不得！
“There's no reward for being good.

叫人寒心。”
It makes one's heart turn cold.”


“那也不必。
“There's no need for that.

人，总要往宽处去想……”
One must take a broader view...”

“是啊！”阿七抢着说道，
“Exactly!” she interrupted.

“我就是这样想。
“That's what I think.

心思不要太窄，
There's no need to be narrow-minded.

难道‘死了杀猪屠，只吃带毛猪’？
If the butcher dies, must we eat pigs with their bristles on?

我说句不怕难为情的话，离了郁家，还怕找不着男人？
I'm not ashamed to say it: if I leave the Yu family, do you think I can't find another man?

到后来倒看看，究竟是他吃亏，还是我吃亏？”
We'll see in the end which of us loses by it!”

这番挟枪带棒、不成章法的话，看似豁达，其实是摆脱不掉郁四的影子，
These disjointed words, full of jabs and thrusts, seemed broad-minded but really showed that she could not shake off Yu's hold on her.

胡雪岩觉得自己的成绩不错，
Hu felt he was doing well.

把她真正的心意探清楚，便已有了一半的把握了。
Once he had discovered her true feelings, he was halfway to success.

于是他借话搭话地说：“自然是郁四哥吃亏。
Taking up her words, he said, “Naturally, Brother Yu loses.

拿眼前来说，孤苦伶仃，一夜到天亮，睁着眼睛想儿子，
Look at him now: lonely and miserable, lying awake all night thinking of his son.

那是什么味道？”
What sort of life is that?”

地不响，
She said nothing.

息了一会才说了句：“自作自受！”
After a pause, she observed, “He's brought it on himself.”

“他是自作自受。
“He has.

不过，你也一样吃亏！”
But you've lost by it too.”

“这……”
“Well...”

阿七大摇其头，
She shook her head emphatically.

“我没有啥吃亏。”
“I haven't lost anything.”


“你怎么不吃亏？”
“How can you say that?

胡雪岩问道，“你今年二十几？”
How old are you now—twenty-something?”

“我……”
“I...”

阿七迟疑了一下，老实答道，
She hesitated, then answered honestly.

“二十七。”
“Twenty-seven.”

“女人象朵花，
“A woman is like a flower.

二十三四岁，就是花到盛时，
At twenty-three or twenty-four, she's in full bloom.

一上了你现在这年纪，老得就快了。”
Once she reaches your age, she begins to age quickly.

胡雪岩说，“你想想看，你顶好的那几年，给了郁四哥，结果到头一场空，
Think of it: you gave your best years to Brother Yu and have ended up with nothing.

岂不是吃了亏了？”
Isn't that a loss?”

听他这一说，阿七发愣。
A’qi stared.

这番道理，自己从没有想过，
She had never considered the matter in this light.

现在让他一点破，越想越有理，也越想越委屈，
Now that he pointed it out, the more she thought, the more reasonable it seemed—and the more wronged she felt.

不由得就叹了口气。
She could not help sighing.

到此地步，胡雪岩不响了，
At this point, Hu fell silent.

好整以暇地取了个绿皮红心的“抢柿”慢慢削着皮，静等阿七发作。
Taking a green-skinned, red-fleshed persimmon, he leisurely peeled it and waited for her feelings to break out.

“胡老板，我想想实在冤枉！
“Mr Hu, when I think of it, I've been treated terribly unfairly.

人不是生来就下贱的，
Nobody is born degraded.

说实话，跟郁老头的时候，我真是有心从良。
To tell the truth, when I went with old Yu, I really meant to leave my trade and live respectably.

哪晓得你要做好人，人家偏偏不许你做！”
Who could have imagined that, when you want to become a decent person, others refuse to let you?”

说到这里，阿七一生委屈，似乎都集中在一起爆发开来，显得异常激动，
As she spoke, a lifetime's grievances seemed to burst out together, and she became intensely agitated.

“就是胡老板你说的，我一生顶好的几岁给了他，
“Just as you said, I gave him the best years of my life.

他听了女儿的话，硬逼我分手，
Then he listened to his daughter and forced me to leave.

他这样子没良心，那就不要怪我，
If he can be so heartless, he mustn't blame me.

我也要撕撕他的脸皮。”
I'll strip the respectability off his face.”


“噢！”胡雪岩很沉着的问：
“Oh?” Hu asked calmly.

“你怎么撕法呢？”
“How will you do that?”

“我啊，”
“I'll...”

阿七毅然决然地说了出来，
She spoke with complete determination.

“我做我的‘老行当’，我还要顶他的姓，
“I'll go back to my old trade, and I'll still use his surname.

门口挂块姓郁的牌子，叫人家好寻得着。”
I'll hang a sign with the name Yu at the door so that people can find me easily.”

这倒也厉害！
That was a formidable threat.

果然如此，郁四的台就坍了。
If she carried it out, Yu's reputation would collapse.

“阿七，”胡雪岩说，“人总不要走到绝路上去……”
“A’qi, one mustn't drive things to a point of no return...”

“是他逼得我这样子的。”阿七抢着分辩。
“He's forced me to it,” she interrupted.

“你这个念头是刚刚起的。是不是！”
“You've only just thought of this, haven't you?”

“是的。”
“Yes.”

阿七已完全在胡雪岩摆布之下，有什么，说什么：
She was now completely under Hu's influence and said whatever came into her mind.

“多亏你胡老板提醒我，想想真是一口冤气不出。”
“Thanks to your reminding me, Mr Hu, I can see what an intolerable wrong I've suffered.”

“那就变成是我挑拨是非了。
“Then I've become the one stirring up trouble.

阿七，你要替你想想。”
A’qi, spare a thought for me.”

“对不起！”
“I'm sorry!”

阿七满脸歉疚，
Her face was full of contrition.

“ 这件事我不能不这么做。
“But I have to do it.

请你胡老板体谅我！”
Please understand.”

“你无非想出口气。
“All you want is to vent your anger.

我另外替你想出气的办法，好不好？”
What if I find another way for you?”

阿七想了想答道：“那么，胡老板你先说说看！”她紧接着又声明，“这不是我主意已经改过，
She thought, then answered, “Tell me what you have in mind.” She immediately added, “That doesn't mean I've changed my mind.

说不说在你，答应不答应在我。”
Whether you speak is up to you; whether I agree is up to me.”


“当然。”
“Of course.

胡雪岩说，“不要说你那口冤气不出，
It's not only you who feels this wrong must be put right.

就是我旁边看着的人，心里也不服气。
Even as an outsider, I can't accept it.

无论如何要叫你有面子，争一口气，
Whatever happens, you must regain your dignity and vindicate yourself.

有面子就是争气，这话对不对？”
Regaining your dignity is a vindication, isn't it?”

阿七并不觉得他的话对，但也不明白错在何处？
A’qi did not think his words quite right, but could not see what was wrong with them either.

只含含糊糊地答道：“你先说来看！”
She answered vaguely, “Tell me your plan first.”

“我想叫郁四哥替你赔个罪。
“I mean to make Brother Yu apologise to you.

怎么样？”
How would that be?”

“赔罪？”阿七茫然地问道：
“Apologise?” she asked blankly.

“怎么赔法？”
“How?”

“你说要怎么赔？”
“How would you like him to?

胡雪岩说，“总不见得要‘吃讲茶’吧！”
Surely you don't want a formal settlement over tea?”

“吃讲茶”是江湖道上的规矩，有啥“难过”，当面“叫开”，
Such a tea meeting was a custom among people of the streets and waterways: any grievance was openly stated and settled face to face.

象这种家务事，从没有吃讲茶的规矩。
There was no precedent for using it in a domestic dispute like this.

但此外阿七也想不出如何叫郁四赔罪，
Yet A’qi could think of no other way to make Yu apologise.

只睁大了一双黑多白少的眼睛，望青胡雪岩发怔。
She merely stared at Hu, her wide eyes showing more black than white.

“阿七，什么赔罪不赔罪，都是假的，
“A’qi, apologies and all the rest are empty forms.

一个人的感情才是真的。
A person's feelings are what count.

只要郁四哥把真心给了你，也就差不多了！”
If Brother Yu gives you his true heart, surely that should be enough.”

阿七一方面觉得他这话不无道理，另一方面又觉得他这话或有深意。
On the one hand, she felt there was something in this; on the other, she suspected a deeper meaning.

两个念头加在一起，得要好好想一想，
The two thoughts together required careful consideration.

所以双手按在膝上，低头垂眼，
Resting her hands on her knees, she lowered her head and eyes.

只见睫毛不住闪动，
Only her lashes kept moving.

那副娴静的姿态，看起来着实动人。
Her quiet, composed posture was strikingly attractive.


她还在细细思量，胡雪岩却说得圈子兜得太远，自己都有些不耐烦，
She was still considering his words, but Hu felt that he had gone too far round the subject and was growing impatient himself.

决定揭破谜底，
He decided to reveal the answer.

略想一想，他说：“郁四嫂，其实你这口冤气也算出过了，
After a moment's thought, he said, “Sister-in-Law Yu, you've already had some satisfaction.

你刚才左一个‘没良心’，右一个‘老糊涂’，骂得狗血喷头，人家一句口也不开，
You've called him heartless one moment and an old fool the next, scolding him mercilessly, and he hasn't answered a word.

等于向你赔了罪，
That's as good as an apology.

你也可以消消气了。”
You can afford to let your anger cool.”

这一说，把阿七说莫明其妙，
A’qi was bewildered.

好半晌才说：“我是‘皇帝背后骂昏君’，
Only after a long pause did she say, “I've been like someone calling the emperor a fool behind his back.

他人又不在这里，
He isn't here.

怎么听得见？”
How could he hear?”

“哪个说不在这里？”
“Who says he isn't here?”

胡雪岩敲敲板壁：
Hu tapped the partition.

“郁四哥，你可以出来了，再来跟郁四嫂说两句好话！”
“Brother Yu, you can come out now and say a few kind words to Sister-in-Law Yu.”

“噢！”郁四应声掀帘，
“Yes!” Yu answered, lifting the curtain.

略带窘色，先叫一声：“阿七！”
Slightly embarrassed, he began, “A’qi!”

阿七这时才会过意来，
Only now did she understand.

“冤家”相见，先就有气，
At the sight of her troublesome lover, her first feeling was anger.

扭转身来就走。哪知道门外早有埋伏，
She turned to leave, only to find an ambush at the door.

陈世龙说到张家是假话，一直等在门外，
Chen's claim that he was going to the Zhangs had been false; he had been waiting outside all along.

这时笑嘻嘻地说道：“你走不得！
Smiling, he said, “You mustn't leave!

一走，郁四叔‘跪算盘’、‘顶油灯’的把戏，都看不到了。”
If you do, you'll miss Fourth Uncle kneeling on an abacus and balancing an oil lamp on his head.”

于是又是一气，
This provoked her again.

“你好！”她瞪着眼说，
“A fine fellow you are!” she said, glaring.

“你也跟他串通了来作弄我！”
“You've joined him in playing tricks on me!”

“是，是！”
“Yes, yes!”

陈世龙高拱双手，一揖到地，
Clasping his hands high, Chen bowed to the ground.

“是我错，
“I was wrong.

你不要生气。”
Don't be angry.”

这一下搞得阿七无计可施！
Now she was at a loss.

当前的局面，软硬两难，
Neither force nor persuasion would serve.

走是走不脱，理又不愿理郁四，
She could not get away, yet she refused to acknowledge Yu.

只有回转身坐了下来，把个头偏向窗外，绷紧了脸不说话。
All she could do was turn back and sit down, facing the window, her expression rigid and her lips closed.


“阿七！”郁四开口了，
“A’qi!” Yu began.

“算我不对……”
“Let's say I was wrong...”

“本来就是你不对！”
“You were wrong!”

阿七倏地转过身来抢白。
She turned sharply and cut him short.

“是，是！”
“Yes, yes!”

郁四也学陈世龙，一味迁就，
Like Chen, Yu yielded on every point.

“是我不对，
“I was wrong.

统统是我不对。
It was all my fault.

好了，事情过去了，
There, it's over now.

不必再打搅人家胡老板，
We needn't trouble Mr Hu any longer.

我们走！
Let's go.”

““走？
“Go?

走到哪里去？”
Where?”

“你说嘛！
“You tell me.

到我那里，还是到你那里？”
My place or yours?”

“到你那里？
“Your place?

哼，”
Hmph!”

阿七冷笑道，
She gave a cold laugh.

“你们郁府上是‘高门槛’，
“The Yu family has a lofty threshold.

我哪里跨得进去？”
How could I ever step over it?”

说到这样酸溜溜的话，那就只是磨工夫的事了，
Once she had reached this sort of sour remark, all that remained was a matter of time and patience.

胡雪岩向陈世龙抛个眼色，站起身说：
Hu gave Chen a glance and rose.

“好了！
“Good!

用不着我们在这里讨厌了！
There's no need for us to stay here making nuisances of ourselves.

你们先谈几句，
Have a few words together.

等下我送你们入洞房。”
Later, I'll escort you to the bridal chamber.”

“啥个洞房不洞房？”
“What bridal chamber?”

阿七也起身相拦，
A’qi stood to stop him.

“胡老板你不要走，
“Don't go, Mr Hu.

我们要把话说说清楚，
We must get things straight.

没有这样便当的事！”
It isn't as easy as that!”

“我不走！
“I'm not leaving.

我就在对面房里。”
I'll be in the room opposite.

胡雪岩说，“你们自己先谈，
Talk it over yourselves first.

谈得拢顶好，
If you agree, all the better.

谈不拢招呼我一声我就来。
If you don't, call and I'll come.

郁四嫂你放心，
Don't worry, Sister-in-Law Yu.

我帮你。”
I'm on your side.”


这个承诺又是一条无形的绳子，把阿七捆得更加动弹不得，
This promise was another invisible cord binding her more tightly.

除了依旧数落郁四“没良心”、“老糊涂”以外，只提出一个条件：要郁四从今以后，不准女儿上门。
Apart from continuing to call Yu heartless and an old fool, she put forward only one condition: he must never let his daughter enter his house again.

这如何办得到？
How could he possibly do that?

不管郁四如何软语商量，阿七只是不允。
However gently he reasoned with her, she would not give way.

于是非请胡雪岩来调停不可了。
They had to call Hu back to mediate.

听完究竟，胡雪岩笑着向郁四说：
After hearing the difficulty, Hu smiled at Yu.

“这是有意难难你。
“She's deliberately making things hard for you.

郁四嫂是讲道理的人。”
Sister-in-Law Yu is a reasonable woman.”

这个手法叫做“金钟罩”，一句话把阿七罩住，
This was the device known as the Golden Bell Shield: one sentence enclosed her completely.

人家恭维她“讲道理”，她总不能说“我不讲道理”，非要郁四父女继绝往来不可，
Having been praised for being reasonable, she could hardly declare herself unreasonable and insist that Yu sever all contact with his daughter.

因此，这时候又板着脸不响了。
So once again she sat with a stiff face and said nothing.

“我现在才晓得，郁四嫂气的不是你，”胡雪岩这样对郁四说，
“Now I understand,” Hu told Yu. “Sister-in-Law isn't angry with you.

“是气你大小姐。
She's angry with your daughter.

这也难怪郁四嫂，
And no wonder!

换了我也要气！
I'd be angry too.

想想也实在委屈，
When you consider it, she has been treated very unfairly.

照道理，当然要你有个交代，
Naturally, she wants you to put matters right.

不过说来说去一家人，
But, after all, you're one family.

难道真的要逼你不认女儿？
Could she really force you to disown your daughter?

就是你肯，郁四嫂也不肯落这样一个不贤的名声在外面。
Even if you agreed, she wouldn't want people calling her an unworthy woman.

这就是山东的俗话：”一块豆腐掉在灰堆里，弹不得了！
As they say in Shandong, a piece of tofu has fallen into a heap of ash: you can't flick it clean.

‘真正有苦说不出！
She truly has a grievance she can't express.”

“这几句话，直抉阿七心底的衷曲，
These words went straight to the feelings in A’qi's heart.

自己有些感觉，苦于说不出口，
She had sensed them herself but had been unable to put them into words.

现在听胡雪岩替她说了出来，
Now Hu had spoken for her.

那一份令人震栗的痛快，以及天底下毕竟还有个知道自己的心的知遇之感，夹杂在一起，
The relief thrilled her, mingling with gratitude that there was, after all, someone in the world who understood her.

就如一盏热醋泼在心头，
It was like a cup of hot vinegar poured over her heart.

竟抽抽噎噎地哭了起来。
She began to sob.


一路哭，一路数落，但已不是吵架，完全是诉怨。
She wept and reproached Yu as she wept, but this was no longer a quarrel: it was a pouring out of grievances.

郁四虽觉得有些尴尬，心里却是一块石头落地，
Although somewhat embarrassed, Yu felt a weight lift from his heart.

知道大事已定。
He knew the great matter was settled.

心情闲豫，应付自然从容，
With his mind at ease, he could respond calmly.

也不说话，只从袖中抽出一方手帕递了过去，让她好擦眼泪。
Saying nothing, he drew a handkerchief from his sleeve and passed it to her to dry her eyes.

擦湿了一方手帕，收住了眼泪，阿七心里感激远多于怨恨，
By the time she had soaked it and stopped crying, gratitude far outweighed resentment in her heart.

感激的是胡雪岩，
Her gratitude was towards Hu.

站起来福了福：
Rising, she made him a curtsy.

“胡老爷多谢你！
“Mr Hu, thank you!

费了你好半天的精神。”
I've taken up so much of your time and energy.”

接着转过脸去向郁四说道：
Then she turned to Yu.

“好走了，
“It's time to go.

麻烦人家胡老板好些工夫，还要赖在这里！”
We've troubled Mr Hu for ages, and still you sit here!”

“走，走！”郁四一叠连声的回答，
“Yes, yes, let's go!” Yu answered eagerly.

“我先问你，到哪里？”
“But first tell me where.”

“还到哪里？
“Where else?

自然是回家。”
Home, of course.”

“对，对！
“Yes, yes!

回家，回家！”
Home!”

郁四转身看着胡雪岩，仿佛千言万语难开日，
He turned to Hu, seemingly with a thousand things to say and unable to begin.

最后说了这样一句：“我们明天再谈。”
At last he managed, “We'll talk again tomorrow.”

一场雷雨，化作春风，
A thunderstorm had turned into a spring breeze.

胡雪岩心里异常舒畅，微微笑着，送他们出门。
Hu felt wonderfully at ease as, smiling faintly, he saw them out.

走到店堂，迎面遇着黄仪，
In the front shop they came face to face with Huang Yi.

胡雪岩和他都有意外之感，不由得便站住了脚。
Both he and Hu were surprised and stopped involuntarily.

“黄先生！”
“Mr Huang!”

阿七泰然无事，扬一扬招呼，
A’qi greeted him with perfect composure, lifting a hand.

“明朝会。”
“See you tomorrow.”

说着还回眸一笑，洋洋得意的走了。
With a smile back over her shoulder, she went away in triumph.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十七章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Seventeen, concluding part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


湖州之行，三天之内，胡雪岩替自己办了两件要紧事。
During three days in Huzhou, Hu Xueyan accomplished two important things for himself.

第一件是约妥了黄仪，随他到杭州去办笔墨。
First, he secured Huang Yi’s agreement to accompany him to Hangzhou as his secretary.

黄仪改变了心意，一则想到外面去闯闯，二则是觉得跟了胡雪岩这样的东家，十分够味，
Huang had changed his mind partly because he wanted to try his fortune elsewhere, and partly because serving an employer like Hu promised to be thoroughly satisfying.

当然也知道这位东家不会薄待，所以薪水酬劳等等，根本不谈。
He also knew that Hu would not treat him poorly, so salary and remuneration were never even discussed.

第二件是进一步赢得了郁四的友谊。
Second, Hu strengthened his friendship with Yu Si.

郁四自从跟阿七言归于好，他的颓唐老态，一扫而空，
Since making peace with A’qi, Yu had lost all his dejection and signs of age.

不再谈衙门里辞差的话，家务也不劳胡雪岩再费心，表示自己可以打点精神来料理。
He no longer spoke of resigning his post at the yamen and told Hu not to trouble himself further about his family affairs: he could now summon the energy to manage them himself.

胡雪岩要头寸周转，除了已经拨付的那一笔以外，另外又调动了五万两银子，让他带走。
As Hu needed working funds, Yu arranged another fifty thousand taels for him to take away, in addition to the sum already transferred.

“你的事就是我的事。
“Your business is mine.

为你这样的朋友，倾家荡产也值得。
For a friend like you, even losing my entire fortune would be worthwhile.

况且，我相信你一定有办法。”他这样对胡雪岩说：
Besides, I am sure you will find a way.

“你要头寸，只要早点告诉我，我一定替你调齐。”
Whenever you need funds, give me a little notice, and I will have them ready.”

有了郁四的十万银子和他的那句话，胡雪岩又是雄心万丈了。
With Yu’s hundred thousand taels and that assurance, Hu’s ambitions soared again.

他目前最困难的，就是头寸，
His greatest difficulty was liquidity.

在上海堆栈里的丝，搁煞了他的大部分本钱，
Most of his capital was tied up in the silk stored in Shanghai.

阜康钱庄的生意，做得极其热闹，已成“大同行”中的“金字招牌”之一，但唯其如此，决不能露丝毫捉襟见时的窘态，
Fukang was flourishing and had become one of the most respected names among the leading banks; for that very reason, it could not afford the slightest appearance of financial strain.

而海运局方面，正当新旧交替之际，亏空只能补，不能拉。
Meanwhile, the Sea Transport Bureau was changing hands: its deficit must be reduced, not increased.

在这青黄不接的当口，萌雪岩一度想把那批丝，杀价卖掉，
In this interval before fresh funds became available, Hu had considered selling the silk at a heavy discount.

虽仍有盈余，但已有限，费心费力的结果，变成几乎白忙一场，
There would still be a profit, but a small one, making all his effort almost unrewarded.

自是于心不甘，同时也不肯错过这个机会。
He could not reconcile himself to that, nor did he wish to abandon the opportunity.

左右为难之下，有郁四的这一臂之力，帮忙帮得大了。
Caught between these difficulties, he found Yu’s help invaluable.


“四哥！”他兴奋地说，“只要你相信我，我包你这笔款子的利息，比放给哪个都来得划算。
“Brother Yu,” he said excitedly, “if you trust me, I guarantee that the return on this money will be better than you could obtain from lending it to anyone else.

我已经看准了，这十万银子，我还要‘扑’到洋庄上去。
I have made up my mind to commit these hundred thousand taels to the foreign trade too.

前两天我在杭州得到消息，两江总督怡大人，要对洋人不客气了，
A few days ago in Hangzhou, I learned that Governor-General Yiliang intends to take a hard line with the foreigners.

这是个难得的机会，一抓住必发大财。
It is a rare opportunity, and whoever seizes it will make a fortune.

不过，机会来了，别人不晓得，我晓得，别人看不准，我看得准。
When an opportunity comes, others do not know of it, but I do; others cannot judge it clearly, but I can.

这就是人家做生意，做不过我的地方。
That is why they cannot match me in business.”

“说了半天是什么机会呢？
What opportunity did he mean?

两江总督怡良，郁四倒是晓得的，他是当权的恭亲王的老丈人，也算是皇亲国戚，
Yu knew who Yiliang was: the father-in-law of the influential Prince Gong, and therefore a relative of the imperial house.

如果有什么大举措，朝廷一定会支持他，
If he undertook any major action, the court would certainly support him.

然而对洋人是如何不客气？
But what did taking a hard line with the foreigners mean?

“莫非，”他迟疑地问，“又要跟洋人开仗？”
“Surely,” Yu asked hesitantly, “we are not going to war with them again?”

“那是不会的……”胡雪岩说，他听到的消息是，因为两件事，两江总督怡良对洋人深为不满，
“No, not that.” Hu explained that, according to his information, Yiliang was deeply displeased with the foreigners for two reasons.

第一，小刀会的刘丽川，有洋人自租界接济军火粮食，
First, foreigners were sending arms and provisions from the settlement to Liu Lichuan of the Small Swords Society.

这是“助逆”而不是“助顺”，
This was supporting rebellion instead of lawful authority.

就算实际上对刘丽川没有什么帮助，朝廷亦难容忍，而况对刘丽川确为一大助力。
The court would scarcely tolerate it even if the supplies did Liu little practical good; in fact, they were a considerable help.

第二是从上海失守以后，“夷税”也就是按值百抽五计算的关税，洋人借口虞乱影响，商务停顿，至今不肯缴纳。
Second, since Shanghai had fallen, the foreigners had refused to pay the so-called foreign tax, the customs duty levied at five percent of value. They claimed that the disturbances had brought commerce to a halt.

商务受影响自是难免，如说完全停顿，则是欺人之谈。
Trade was inevitably affected, but to say it had stopped entirely was deception.

洋商缴纳关税，全靠各国领事代为约束，
Payment of customs duties by foreign merchants depended on their consuls enforcing the obligation.

现在有意不缴，无奈其何！
If they deliberately refused, what could be done?

那就只有一个办法：不跟洋人做生意。
There was only one answer: cease trading with them.


“租界上的事，官府管不到，
“The authorities cannot control affairs inside the settlement.

再说不跟洋商做生意，难道把销洋庄的货色，抛到黄浦江里？
And even if we say we will stop trading with foreign merchants, are we to throw all our export goods into the Huangpu River?

这自然是办不到的，
Obviously not.

所以，再退一步说，只有一个办法，这个办法也很厉害，内地的丝茶两项，不准运入租界。
So there is only one practicable step left, and it is a powerful one: prohibit silk and tea from the interior from entering the settlement.

这是官府办得到的事。”
That is something the authorities can enforce.”

“我懂了！还是你原来的办法，”郁四点点头说，
“I see!” Yu nodded. “Your original plan again.

“那样子一来，丝茶两项存货的行情，一定大涨。
The price of silk and tea already held there would certainly soar.

这倒是好主意！”
A fine idea!”

“自然是好生意。”胡雪岩说，
“A fine business, certainly.

“丝我有了，而且现在也不是时候，收不到货，
I already have silk, and this is not the season to buy more.

茶叶上面，大有脑筋可动，
But there is plenty to be done with tea.

官府做事慢，
Officials move slowly.

趁告示没有出来以前，我还来得及办货。
Before the proclamation appears, I still have time to acquire stock.

此外，我还想开一爿当铺，开一家药店，阜康也想在上海设分号……”
Besides, I want to open a pawnshop and a pharmacy, and establish a Shanghai branch of Fukang.”

“老胡，”郁四打断他的话，“我说一句，怕不中听，
“Old Hu,” Yu interrupted, “I want to say something you may not like.

不过我声明在先，决不是我有啥别的心思，
But let me make it clear first: I have no ulterior motive.

无非提醒你，
It is only a reminder.

事情还是你去做，你说怎么办就怎么办。”
You will still conduct the business, and whatever you decide will be done.”

“四哥，我们的交情，你这番表白是多余的。”
“With our friendship, Brother Yu, such an explanation is unnecessary.”

话虽多余，不能不先交代，
Unnecessary though it was, it had to be made.

这就是江湖上的“过节”，
This was one of the formal observances of the brotherhood world.

其实就是郁四以下要说的话，也近乎多余，
Indeed, what Yu went on to say was almost unnecessary too.

他劝胡雪岩说，一个人本事再大，精力有限，
However capable a man might be, his energy was limited.

头绪太多，必有照顾不到的地方。
With too many undertakings, something would escape his attention.

而且他的生意，互相关联，牵一发而动全身，
Moreover, Hu’s businesses were interconnected: pull one thread and the whole fabric moved.

一垮下来，不可收拾。
A collapse could become irretrievable.

不如暂时收敛，稳扎稳打。
Better to restrain himself for the present and advance steadily.

这番话语重心长，见得郁四的关切，
The earnest advice showed Yu’s concern.

但胡雪岩自己何尝不知道？
But how could Hu be unaware of these dangers?

其间的利害关系，他远比郁四了解得更透彻，
He understood the interests involved far better than Yu did.

不过他自己足以应付得了，哪一处出了毛病，该如何急救？也曾细细策划过，
He believed he could manage them and had carefully planned emergency measures for trouble in each quarter.

有恃无恐，所以我行我素。
Confident of his resources, he intended to follow his own course.

只是郁四说到这样的话，休戚相关，虽不能听，亦不宜辩，
Yet when a friend whose fortunes were bound to his offered such advice, he ought not argue even if he could not follow it.

因而不断点头，表示接受。
He therefore nodded repeatedly, as though accepting it.


接受不是一句空话可以敷衍的，
Acceptance could not be reduced to an empty assurance.

而郁四有大批本钱投在自己名下，也得替他顾虑。
Yu had invested a large amount with him, and Hu had to consider his interests.

胡雪岩的思考向来宽阔而周密，
Hu’s thoughts were always wide-ranging and thorough.

心里在想郁四的话，可有言外之意？
Was there something behind Yu’s advice?

却是不能不问清楚的。
He must find out.

“四哥，你的话十分实在。
“Brother Yu, what you say is entirely sound.

当铺、药店，我决定死了心，暂且丢下。
I have decided to put the pawnshop and pharmacy aside for now.

不过，我要请问一句，四哥一定要跟我说实话。”
But there is something I must ask, and you must answer frankly.”

“你这话也是多余的。”郁四答道，
“That remark is unnecessary too.

“我几时跟你说过假话？”
When have I ever lied to you?”

“是的，是的，
“Of course, of course.

我晓得。”胡雪岩连连点头，
I know.” Hu nodded repeatedly.

“不过，我怕我或者有啥看不列的地方，要请四哥指点。
“But I may have overlooked something and need your guidance.

你看，我们在上海的那批丝，是不是现在脱手比较好？
Do you think we should sell our Shanghai silk now?”

““嗐！”郁四的神色和声音，大似遗憾，
“Ah!” Yu’s expression and voice showed deep regret.

“你完全弄错我的意思了！
“You have completely misunderstood me.

你当我不放心我投在你那里的本钱，
You think I am worried about the capital I have entrusted to you.

决不是！
Not at all!

我早就说过了，我相信你，
I have told you before: I trust you.

生意你去做，我不过问。”
You conduct the business; I do not interfere.”


“四哥是相信我，结果弄得‘鸭屎臭’，叫我怎么对四哥交代？”
“You trust me, Brother Yu, but if the result is a foul mess, how could I answer to you?”

“不要交代！要啥交代？
“You needn’t answer for it!

做生意有亏有蚀，
Business has losses as well as gains.

没话可说！
There is nothing to complain of.

只有‘开口自己人，独吃自己人’的才是‘鸭屎臭’，
The only foul men are those who call you one of their own and then swallow all the profit themselves.

你不是那种人。
You are not such a man.

再说一句，就算你要存心吃我，我也情愿，
I’ll say more: even if you deliberately took advantage of me, I would accept it.

这话不是我现在说，
I am not saying this only now.

你问阿七。”说着便连声喊着：“阿七，
Ask A’qi.” He called repeatedly, “A’qi!

阿七！
A’qi!

胡老板有话问你。”
Boss Hu has something to ask you.”

阿七在打点送胡雪岩的土仪，正忙得不可开支，但听说是胡雪岩有话问，还是抽出身子来了。
A’qi was extremely busy preparing local gifts for Hu to take away, but at the mention of his request she came out.

“我昨天晚上跟你谈到上海的那批丝，我是怎么跟你说的？”郁四问。
“What did I tell you last night about the silk in Shanghai?” Yu asked.

“你说，那批丝上的本钱，你只当赌铜钿输掉了。
“You said you treated the capital in it as money lost at gambling.

赚了，你不结帐，蚀了，你也睡得着觉。”
If it made a profit, you would not call for a settlement; if it made a loss, you would still sleep soundly.”

听这样一说，胡雪岩既感激，又不安，
Hu felt both grateful and uneasy.

听郁四的口气，大有把那笔本钱奉送之意，这无论如何是受之有愧的。
Yu almost seemed to intend the capital as a gift, which Hu could not accept with an easy conscience.

但此时无需急着表白，
But there was no need to protest at once.

朋友相交不在一日，
Friendship was not measured in a single day.

郁四果有此心，自己倒要争个面子，将来叫他大大地出个意外。
If that was indeed Yu’s intention, Hu would make a special effort and give him a great surprise in the future.

于是他说：“四哥你这样说，我的胆就大了。
“Brother Yu, that gives me courage,” he said.

人生难得遇着知己，
“It is rare to find a friend who understands one.

趁这时候我不好好去闯一闯，也太对不起自己了。”
If I don’t venture out while I have the chance, I shall scarcely be doing myself justice.”


在这一刻，胡雪岩又有了新的主意，
At that moment Hu had a new idea.

但决定等那批丝脱手以后，把郁四名下应得的一份，替他在上海买租界上的地皮。
Once the silk was sold, he would use Yu’s rightful share to buy land for him in the Shanghai settlement.

这是一个突如其来的念头，细细想去，
The thought came suddenly, but it bore examination.

第一，不受炮火的影响，
First, the settlement was protected from bombardment.

各地逃难到上海租界的人，一定会越来越多，市面当然要兴旺，
More and more people would flee there from troubled districts, and its commerce would flourish.

第二，朝廷对洋人不欢迎，但既然订了商约，洋人要来，不欢迎也办不到。
Second, the court might dislike foreigners, but having signed commercial treaties, it could not prevent them from coming.

“五口通商”只有上海这个码头最热闹，
Of the five treaty ports, Shanghai was the busiest.

一旦洪杨战败，逃难的人会相携还乡，但做生意的人，是不会走的。
Once Hong and Yang were defeated, refugees would return home together, but businessmen would remain.

所以，趁现在把上海租界里那些无甚入息，地价便宜的苇塘空地买下来，将来一定会大发其财。
Buying cheap, unproductive reed beds and vacant land in the settlement now would therefore bring a great fortune later.

不过，这是五年、十年以后，
That, however, lay five or ten years ahead.

如果有闲钱无甚用处，不妨买了摆在那里，
A man with idle money could buy land and leave it.

象自己现在这样，急需头寸周转，就不必去打这个主意。
A man like Hu, urgently needing working funds, ought not to consider it for himself.

“老胡！”郁四见他沉吟不语，便即问道：“你在想啥？”
“Old Hu,” Yu asked, noticing his silence, “what are you thinking about?”

“还不是动生意上的脑筋。”
“Business again.”

说了这一句，胡雪岩才想起郁四劝他的话，
Then Hu remembered Yu’s warning.

自然不宜再出花样，
He should not propose another venture now.

因而自己摇着手说：“不谈，不谈。
Waving his hand, he added, “Never mind.

是空想！”
It is only a fancy.”

“不要去多想了！
“Stop thinking so much.

我们吃酒，谈点有趣的事。”
Let’s have a drink and talk of something amusing.”


趣事甚多，
There was plenty to amuse them.

胡雪岩讲了七姑奶奶逛堂子的笑话，把阿七听得出了神。
Hu told the story of the Seventh Lady’s visit to a courtesan house, and A’qi listened spellbound.

郁四也觉得新奇，表示很想会一会这样一个“奇女子”。
Yu too found it remarkable and said he would like to meet such an extraordinary woman.

“那容易得很！”胡雪岩说，
“Easily arranged,” Hu replied.

“只要你抽得出空，我陪你走一遭，
“If you can find the time, I’ll go with you.

尤家兄妹一定也会觉得你很对劲。”
Both Brother You and his sister would certainly take to you.”

“真的，”阿七接口向郁四说，“你也该到外头走走，见见世面。
“Indeed,” A’qi urged Yu, “you ought to go out and see something of the world.

年纪一大把，乐得看开些，吃吃喝喝，四处八方去逛逛，
At your age, why not take things easily, enjoy good food and drink, and travel about?

让我也开开眼界。”
Let me broaden my horizons too.”

这番怂恿把郁四说动了心，
This tempted Yu.

平生足迹不出里门，
He had never traveled beyond his home district.

外面是怎么样的一个花花世界，只听人说，未曾目睹，到底是桩憾事，
All he knew of the colorful world outside came from other people’s stories, which was a real regret.

如果能带着阿七去走一走，会一会江湖上的朋友，也是暮年一大乐事。
Traveling with A’qi and meeting friends from the brotherhood would be a great pleasure in his later years.

只是怎么能抽得出身。
But how could he free himself?

因此，他又想到衙门里的差使，要找个替手这件大事，
He thought again of finding a replacement for his work at the yamen.

“老胡，”他毫不考虑地问了出来，“上次我跟你谈过的，想叫小和尚来当差，你可曾问过他？”
“Old Hu,” he asked without hesitation, “did you ask Little Monk about taking the post I mentioned last time?”

“还不曾问。”
“Not yet.”

胡雪岩心想，陈世龙大概不会愿意，
Hu thought Chen would probably be unwilling.

而且有阿七在，陈世龙也实在不宜过分接近郁家，
Moreover, with A’qi there, it would be unwise for Chen to become too closely involved with the Yu household.

再为自己打算，也难放手，
Hu’s own affairs would also make it hard to spare him.

所以索性再加一句：“我想不问也罢。
He therefore added, “I think there is no need to ask.

我看他十之八九不肯！”
I am almost certain he would refuse.”

“那就算了。”郁四偶惘地说，
“Then let it drop,” Yu said disconsolately.

“我另外物色。”
“I’ll look for someone else.”


这两句对答，使得阿七深为注意，
A’qi listened closely to this exchange.

在过去，如果谈到陈世龙，她立刻会插嘴来问，
In the past, she would immediately have asked questions whenever Chen was mentioned.

但自从有了那两番私晤，倾诉心曲的经历，变得“做贼心虚”，在郁四面前，处处要避嫌疑，
But since their two private meetings, when she had poured out her feelings, she had developed a guilty conscience and took care to avoid suspicion in Yu’s presence.

所以当时不敢搭腔，
She dared not join in then.

过后才找个机会，悄悄问胡雪岩是怎么回事？
Only later did she find an opportunity to ask Hu privately what it was about.

胡雪岩也正要这样一个单独相处的机会，好问她一个明白，
Hu had wanted just such a chance to question her.

因而说明其事以后，紧接着便是这样一句：“郁四嫂，我有句话，不晓得能不能问？
After explaining, he went straight on: “Sister-in-Law Yu, there is something I do not know whether I may ask.

问了伯你不高兴，不问，我心里总不安稳。
If I ask, I fear you will be displeased; if I don’t, I cannot feel at ease.

真正不知道该怎么办？”
I really do not know what to do.”

阿七是很聪明、也很爽荡的人，
A’qi was intelligent and candid.

微微红着脸说：“我晓得你要问的是啥？
Blushing slightly, she said, “I know what you want to ask.

那件事我做错了。
I was wrong about that.

不过当时并不晓得做错。
But at the time I did not know it was wrong.”

““这话怎么说？”
“What do you mean?”

胡雪岩觉得她的话，很有意味，
Hu found this interesting.

“是你跟郁四哥讲和以后，才晓得自己错了？”
“Did you realize you were wrong only after making peace with Brother Yu?”

“是的！”阿七羞涩地一笑，别具妩媚之姿，
“Yes.” She gave a shy, charming smile.

“想想还是老头子好，
“When I think it over, the old man is best after all.

样样依我，
He gives way to me in everything.

换了别人，要我样样依他，这在我，也是办不到的。”
With someone else, I would have to give way to him in everything, and I could never do that.”


胡雪岩觉得以她的脾气和出身，还有句话提出来也不算太唐突，
Given her temperament and background, Hu felt that another question would not be too presumptuous.

所以接着又问：“那么你去看世龙之前，是怎么个想法？”
“Then what were you thinking before you went to see Shilong?”

一听这话，阿七有些紧张：
A’qi grew tense.

“小和尚把我的话，都告诉你了？”
“Did Little Monk tell you everything I said?”

这下胡雪岩倒要考虑了，
Now Hu had to consider.

看阿七的神气，是不愿意让第三者晓得她的秘密，
Her expression showed that she did not want a third person to know her secret.

如果为了叫她心里好过，大可否认。
To spare her feelings, he could deny it.

只是这一来，就不会了解她对陈世龙到底是怎么一种感情？
But then he would never discover exactly what she felt for Chen.

想一想，还是要说实话。
After reflecting, he decided to tell the truth.

于是他点一点头，清清楚楚地答道：“源源本本地告诉我了。”
He nodded and said clearly, “Everything, from beginning to end.”

阿七大为忸怩，
She was deeply embarrassed.

“这个死东西！”她不满地骂，
“The wretch!” she complained.

“跟他闹着玩的，他竟当真的了！
“I was only teasing him, and he took it seriously.

真不要脸！”
How shameless!”

这是掩饰之词，
It was an excuse.

胡雪岩打破沙锅问到底，又刺她一句：
Determined to get to the bottom of it, Hu pressed her again.

“你说闹着玩，也闹得太厉害了，居然还寻上门去，
“Even if you were teasing, you went very far—actually calling on him!

如果让阿珠晓得了，吃起醋来，你岂不是造孽？”
If A’zhu had found out and become jealous, wouldn’t you have done harm?”

“那也要怪他自己不好。”阿七不肯承认自己的错处，
“Then he would have been partly to blame himself.” A’qi would not admit fault.

“无论如何香火之情总有的。
“Whatever else, there was still a bond between us.

那时候我心里一天到晚发慌，静不下来，
At that time I was anxious all day and could not settle down.

只望有个人陪我谈谈。
All I wanted was someone to talk to.

他连这一点都不肯，
He wouldn’t grant me even that.

我气不过，特为跟他罗嗦，叫他的日子也不好过！
I was angry, so I deliberately bothered him to make his life uncomfortable too.”

“说着，她得意地笑了。
She smiled with satisfaction.

这翻话照胡雪岩的判断，有十分之七可靠，
Hu judged her account about seven-tenths credible.

不可靠的是她始终不承认对陈世龙动过心！
The doubtful part was her continued refusal to admit having felt an attraction to Chen.

然而事过境迁可以不去管它，
But circumstances had changed; there was no need to pursue the past.

只谈以后好了。
They need only discuss the future.

“以后呢？”他问，
“What about now?” he asked.

“你怎么样看待陈世龙？”
“How do you regard Shilong?”

“有啥怎么样？”阿七说得很坦率，
“What is there to regard?” she answered frankly.

“我死心塌地跟了老头子，他也要讨亲了，
“I have settled my heart on the old man, and Shilong is going to marry.

还有啥话说？”
What more is there to say?”

于是胡雪岩也没话说了，
Hu had nothing further to ask.

神色轻松，大可放心。
His expression relaxed; he could be at ease.


“胡老板，”阿七出了难题给他来回答，“张家阿珠这样的人品，你怎么舍得放手？”
“Boss Hu,” A’qi said, posing a difficult question in return, “how could you let a girl like the Zhang family’s A’zhu go?”

“这话，”胡雪岩想了想答道，“说来你不会相信，
Hu considered. “If I explain, you won’t believe me.

只当我卖膏药、说大话。
You will think I am a quack selling his remedies and boasting.

不过我自己晓得，我做这件事就象我劝郁四哥把你接回来一样，是蛮得意的。
But I know for myself that I am as pleased with arranging that affair as I am with persuading Brother Yu to bring you back.”
