““得意点啥？”阿七有意报复，
“What is there to be pleased about?” she asked, deliberately retaliating.

“刚开的一朵鲜花，便宜了小和尚。
“A flower just coming into bloom, and Little Monk gets the benefit.

你倒不懊悔！”
Aren’t you sorry?”

“要说懊悔，”胡雪岩也有意跟她开玩笑，“我懊悔不该劝郁四哥把你接回来，
“If I have any regrets,” Hu replied, teasing in turn, “it is that I persuaded Brother Yu to take you back.

我自己要了你好了，
I ought to have tried for you myself.

大不了象黄仪一样，至多讨一场没趣。”阿七笑了，
At worst I would have been rebuffed like Huang Yi.” A’qi laughed.

“好样不学，学他！”
“Of all the examples you might follow, you choose his!”

接着，神色一正，
Then she grew serious.

“胡老板，我规规矩矩问你一句话。”
“Boss Hu, let me ask you a proper question.”

“好！
“Very well.

我规规矩矩听。”
I shall listen properly.”

“你太太凶不凶？”
“Is your wife fierce?”

“你问她作啥？”胡雪岩笑道：
“Why do you ask?” Hu laughed.

“是不是要替我做媒？”
“Are you going to find me a match?”

“对！
“Exactly.

不然何必问？”
Why else would I ask?”


“那么，你打说来听听，
“Then tell me about her.

是怎么样一个人？”
What sort of person is she?”

“人是比我胜过十倍，不过命也比我苦。”阿七说道，
“Ten times better than I am, though her life has been harder.

“是个小孤孀。”
She is a young widow.”

接着，阿七便夸赞这个“小孤孀”的品貌，
A’qi went on to praise the widow’s beauty and character.

胡雪岩被她说得心思有些活动了，试探着问道：“她家里怎么样？
Hu began to feel interested and asked cautiously, “What is her family situation?

守不住改嫁，夫家娘家都要答应，
If she chooses to remarry instead of remaining a widow, both her husband’s family and her own must agree.

麻烦很多。”
There could be a great deal of trouble.”

“麻烦是有一点，不过也没有料理不好的。”阿七说道，
“Some trouble, but nothing that cannot be managed.

“她夫家没有人。
There is no one in her husband’s family.

倒是娘家，有个不成材的叔叔，还有个小兄弟，
On her own side, there is a worthless uncle and a younger brother.

如果娶了她，这个小兄弟要带在身边。”
Whoever marries her must take the boy into the household too.”

“那倒也无所谓。”
“That would not matter.”

胡雪岩沉吟着，好半天不作声。
Hu pondered in silence.

“胡老板，”阿七怂恿着说，“你湖州也常要来的，
“Boss Hu,” she urged, “you often come to Huzhou.

有个门口在这里，一切方便，
Having a household here would make everything convenient.

而且，说人品真正是又漂亮、又贤惠！
And she really is both beautiful and good.

要不要看看？”
Would you like to see her?”

“那好啊！
“Certainly.

怎么个看法，
How would we arrange it?

总不是媒婆领了来吧？”
Surely not by having a matchmaker bring her round?”

“当然不能这么青。”
“Of course we cannot be so blunt.”

阿七想了想说，“这样吧，明天一早我邀她到北门天圣寺烧香，
A’qi thought for a moment. “Tomorrow morning I’ll invite her to burn incense at Tiansheng Temple by the North Gate.

你在那里等，
Wait there.

见了装作不认识我，不要打招呼。
When you see me, pretend not to know me and don’t greet me.

我也不跟她说破，
I won’t tell her the purpose either.

这样子没有顾忌，你就看得清楚了。”
With no reason for self-consciousness, you will be able to see her as she is.”

“也好！
“Very well.

准定这么办。”
Let us do that.”


到了第二天，胡雪岩找陈世龙陪着，到了北门天圣寺，
The next day Hu took Chen Shilong with him to Tiansheng Temple.

先烧香，后求签，
He first burned incense, then drew a fortune slip.

签上是这样一首诗：暮云千里乱吴峰，落叶微闻远寺钟；
It bore a poem: “Evening clouds for a thousand li blur the peaks of Wu; through falling leaves, a distant temple bell is faintly heard.

目尽长江秋草外，美人何处采芙蓉？
Beyond the autumn grass, the gaze follows the Yangtze as far as sight can reach; where does the beauty gather lotus blooms?”

胡雪岩看不懂这首诗，
Hu did not understand the verse.

只看签是“中平”，解释也不见得高明，
He saw only that the fortune was rated middling, and its explanation seemed no more illuminating.

便一笑置之，跟阵世龙寺前寺后，闲步随喜。
He dismissed it with a smile and strolled around the temple with Chen.

陈世龙却有些奇怪，
Chen was puzzled.

只听胡雪岩说要到天圣寺走走，未说是何用意？
Hu had said that he wanted to visit Tiansheng Temple but had given no reason.

他这样的一个大忙人，力何忽发雅兴，来游古刹。
Why had such a busy man suddenly developed a taste for ancient temples?

先是心里打算，他既不说，自己也不必问，但等到了天圣寺，自然明白，
At first Chen thought that, since Hu had not explained, he need not ask; once they arrived, the purpose would become clear.

这时看不出名堂，就忍不住要问了。
Now, seeing no sign of it, he could not help inquiring.

“胡先生，你是不是等什么人？还是……”
“Mr Hu, are you waiting for someone, or…”

“对！
“Exactly.

我正是等人。
I am waiting for someone.

跟你说了吧！”一说经过，陈世龙笑道：
I may as well tell you.” When Hu explained, Chen laughed.

“幄。我晓得了！”他说，
“Ah, I understand!

“一定是何家的那个小孤孀，
It must be the young widow from the He family.

不错！阿七的眼光不错，
A’qi has a good eye.

不过，这个媒做得成，做不成，就很难说了。”
Whether the match can be made is another question.”

“原来你也晓得。”胡雪岩颇有意外之感，
Hu was rather surprised. “So you know about her too.

“来，我们到那里坐一坐。”
Come, let us sit over there.”


两人在庙门口一家点心摊子上坐了下来，一面吃汤圆，一面谈何家的小孤孀。
They sat at a refreshment stall by the temple gate and talked over bowls of sweet rice dumplings.

据陈世龙说，此人颇有艳名，
According to Chen, the widow was celebrated for her beauty.

自从居孀以后，很有些人打她的主意，
Many men had been interested since her husband’s death.

但夫家还好说话，娘家有个胞叔，十分难，
His family was reasonably accommodating, but her father’s brother was extremely difficult.

所以好事一直不谐。
That was why no match had yet succeeded.

“无非是多要几两银子。”胡雪岩问，
“He can only want a little more money,” Hu said.

“有什么难的？”
“What is difficult about that?”

“那家伙嫖赌吃着，一应俱全，
“Every indulgence—women, gambling, fine food and clothes—he enjoys them all.

哪个跟他做了亲戚，三天两头上门来罗嗦，
Anyone who becomes his relative will have him at the door every few days making trouble.

就吃不消了。”
It would be intolerable.”

“这倒不必怕他。”胡雪岩又问，
“There is no need to fear him.

“她娘家姓啥？”
What was her maiden surname?”

“娘家姓刘。
“Liu.

他叔叔叫刘三才，
Her uncle is Liu Sancai.

人家把他的名字改了一个字，叫做刘不才。
People change a character of his name and call him Liu Bucai—Liu the Good-for-Nothing.

由这上头，胡先生就可以晓得他的为人了。”
That tells you what he is like.”

“总有点用处吧！”
“Surely he is useful in some way?”

“用处是有点的。
“In some ways, yes.

不过没有人敢用他。
But nobody dares employ him.

这个人太滑、太靠不住。”
He is too slippery and unreliable.”

“不管它！
“Never mind that.

你倒说来我听听，刘不才有何用处？”
Tell me what he is good at.”

“他能说会道，风花雪月，无不精通，是做篾片的好材料。”陈世龙接着又用警告的语气说，
“He is an eloquent talker, thoroughly versed in every romantic and fashionable amusement—the very material for a rich man’s hanger-on.” Chen added a warning.

“就是银钱不能经他的手。
“Only never let money pass through his hands.

说句笑话，他老子死了，如果买棺材的钱经他的手，他都会先用了再说。”胡雪岩笑了，“有这样的人？”是不甚相信的语气。
To put it as a joke, if his father died and he were given money for the coffin, he would spend it on himself first.” Hu laughed incredulously. “Can anyone be like that?”

“就有这样的人！”陈世尤特为举证：
“He is exactly like that.

“我跟他在赌场里常常碰头，诸如此类的事，见得多了。”
I often met him in gambling houses and saw plenty of such behavior.”


胡雪岩点点头，抛开陈世龙的话，管自己转念头。
Hu nodded, put Chen’s words aside and pursued his own thoughts.

他心里在想，篾片有篾片的用处，
A hanger-on had his uses.

帮闲的人，官场中叫清客，遇着纨袴子弟便叫篾片，
Among officials, such a companion was called a cultivated guest; among wealthy young idlers, he was a miepian, a strip of bamboo.

好似竹篓子一样，没有竹筐片，就拧不起空架子。
Just as a basket’s framework could not hold together without bamboo strips, a grand social establishment needed such men.

自己也要几个篾片，帮着交际应酬。
Hu too could use a few to help with entertaining and social obligations.

如果刘不才本心还不坏，只是好拆烂污，倒不妨动动脑筋，收服了他做个帮手。
If Liu Bucai was not bad at heart, merely prone to making a mess of things, it might be worth finding a way to win him over as an assistant.

“来了，来了！”陈世龙突然拉着他的衣服，轻轻说道。
“Here they are!” Chen suddenly tugged at Hu’s clothes and spoke softly.

胡雪岩定定神，抬头望去，
Hu collected himself and looked up.

这一望，心里立刻便是异样的味道。
At once he felt something unusual.

何家的小寡妇是个“黑里俏”，
The young widow was a dark-complexioned beauty.

除了皮肤以外，无可批评。
Apart from her complexion, he could find nothing to criticize.

腰肢极细，走几步路，如凤摆杨柳，
Her waist was extremely slender, and as she walked she swayed like a willow in the breeze.

却又不象风尘中人的有意做作，而是天然袅娜。
Yet there was none of the calculated display of a courtesan; her grace was natural.

她下了轿子，扶着个十一二岁的小丫头。一步一步的走过点心摊子。
Alighting from her chair, she rested a hand on a maid of eleven or twelve and walked past the stall.

胡雪岩的脸便随着她转，一直转到背脊朝陈世尤为止。
Hu’s face followed her until his back was turned to Chen.

陈世龙已会过了帐，
Chen had already paid.

悄悄的拉了他一把，两个人跟着又进了山门。
He gave Hu a quiet tug, and they followed the women through the temple gate.

阿七是早就看到了他们的，
A’qi had noticed them long before.

此时落后一步，微微转近身来摇一摇手。
Now she dropped back a step, turned slightly and made a small warning gesture with her hand.


“她什么意思？”胡雪岩问。
“What does she mean?” Hu asked.

“大概是关照不是靠得太近。”
“Probably that we should not follow too closely.”

听这一说，胡雪岩便站住了脚，尽自盯着她的背影看。
Hu stopped and stared after the widow.

从头到脚，一身玄色，头上簪一朵穿孝的白绒花，显得格外触目。
She wore black from head to foot, with a soft white mourning flower in her hair that stood out strikingly.

“胡先生，”陈世龙轻声问道：“怎么样？”
“What do you think, Mr Hu?” Chen asked softly.

“就是皮肤黑一点。”
“Only that her complexion is a little dark.”

“有名的‘黑芙蓉’嘛！”陈世龙说。
“She is famous as Black Lotus.”

“怎么叫黑芙蓉？
“Why Black Lotus?

只听说过黑牡丹。”
I have only heard of Black Peony.”

“她的名字就叫芙蓉。”
“Her name is Furong—Lotus.”

“芙蓉！”胡雪岩偏着头，皱着眉想，
“Furong!” Hu tilted his head and frowned.

“好象什么地方听说过个名字？”就这样不断念着“芙蓉、芙蓉”，皱眉苦思，到底起起来了。
“Where have I heard that name?” He repeated it, thinking hard, until at last he remembered.

“原来在这里！”他把刚才求的那张签，拿给陈世龙看。
“Here!” He showed Chen the fortune slip.

“巧了！”陈世龙极感兴趣的笑着，
“What a coincidence!” Chen laughed with interest.

“看起来是前世注定的姻缘。”
“It looks like a marriage destined in a former life.”

“不见得！
“Not necessarily.

‘美人何处采芙蓉’，是采不到的意思。”
‘Where does the beauty gather lotus blooms?’ means that the lotus cannot be gathered.”

胡雪岩摇摇头，大为快怏之意。
Hu shook his head in disappointment.

陈世龙从未见过他有这样患得患失、近乎沮丧的神情，心里有些好笑。
Chen had never seen him so anxious about gaining or losing something, almost dejected, and was secretly amused.

但随即想到，胡雪岩对芙蓉，可说是一见钟情，
Then he reflected that Hu had plainly fallen in love at first sight.

无论如何得把她“采”来供养，
Whatever happened, he must help gather this lotus for Hu.

才是报答之道。
That would be a way to repay his kindness.


“再进去看看！”胡雪岩说。
“Let us go farther in and have another look,” Hu said.

“胡先生，你一个人去好了，
“You had better go alone, Mr Hu.

她有点认识我的，见面不大方便，
She knows me a little, and meeting her might be awkward.

我先避开为妙。”
I should keep out of the way.”

等陈世龙一走，胡雪岩一个在大殿前面那只高可及人的大香炉旁边，
Once Chen left, Hu stood beside the great incense burner, as tall as a man, in front of the main hall.

七上八下想心里，
His thoughts rose and fell.

又想闯进殿去细看一看，又怕不依阿七的暗示，会把好事搞坏，
He wanted to go inside for a closer look, yet feared that disregarding A’qi’s warning would spoil the affair.

左思右想只是打不定主意，
He could not make up his mind.

自己都觉得有些好笑，几万银子上落的生意，都是当机立断，毫无悔尤，
It seemed ridiculous even to him: in transactions involving tens of thousands of taels, he decided instantly and felt no regret.

偏偏这么点事会大为作难！
Yet such a small matter left him at a loss.

辰光就这样空耗着，耗到阿七和芙蓉出殿，
Time slipped away until A’qi and Furong emerged from the hall.

他不能再没行动了，
He could not remain inactive.

“嗐！”他自己对自己不满，
“Bah!” he said to himself in annoyance.

这有什么大不了的！
What was so important?

成也罢，不成也罢，何必看得那样认真？
Whether it succeeded or failed, why take it so seriously?

这一转念，犹豫和怯意一扫而空，
The thought swept away his hesitation and timidity.

同时也把阿七的约定和暗示，都抛到九霄云外，
It also sent A’qi’s agreement and warning clean out of his mind.

踏着从容潇洒的步子迎了上去，清清朗朗地喊一声：“郁四嫂！”
With an easy, confident step he went forward and called clearly, “Sister-in-Law Yu!”


既然叫出来了，阿七不能不理，
Since he had called, A’qi had to answer.

装出略如惊喜的神态说道：“啊，胡老板，是你！
She assumed an expression of mild surprise and pleasure. “Ah, Boss Hu!

怎么有空？
How do you find the time?

来烧香，还是啥？”
Have you come to burn incense, or what?”

“偶然路过，进来逛一逛。”
“I happened to be passing and came in for a stroll.”

胡雪岩一面说，一面打量芙蓉。
As he spoke, Hu studied Furong.

她那双眼睛很活，但也很静，
Her eyes were lively yet composed.

在初见胡雪岩，视线飞快地一绕之后，一直垂着眼皮，看着地下。
On first seeing him, she had glanced swiftly at him; ever since, she had kept them lowered toward the ground.

阿七心想，一不做，二不休，既然胡雪岩自己要出头，索性彰明较著替他们拉拢，让他自己来显显本事，
A’qi decided that, since Hu had chosen to show himself, she might as well bring them together openly and let him display his own abilities.

倒省了许多心。
It would save her a great deal of trouble.

于是她说：“胡老板，我要敲你的竹杠，
“Boss Hu, I mean to take advantage of you.

好好请一请我们……”
You must give us a proper treat.”

一说到“我们”两字，芙蓉便推一推她的手埋怨：“你这个人！哪里有这样子的？”
At the word “us,” Furong nudged her hand and protested. “Really! How can you behave like that?”

“怕啥！”阿七一副理直气壮的态度，
“What is there to fear?” A’qi answered as though her conduct were perfectly justified.

“胡老板又不是外人，
“Boss Hu is no stranger.

是我们老头子的要好弟兄！”
He is my old man’s close friend.”

“正是这话。这位……”胡雪岩微笑着说：
“Exactly,” Hu said with a smile.

“这位小姐，不必见外！”
“This young lady need not stand on ceremony.”

“喔，”阿七趁机说道，“胡老板，我来引见，
“Oh, let me introduce you,” A’qi went on.

这是我的小姐妹，
“This is a young friend of mine.

娘家姓刘，夫家姓何，
Her maiden surname is Liu, and she married into the He family.

小名叫芙蓉。
Her personal name is Furong.

你叫她名字好了。”
You may call her that.”

听这番介绍，芙蓉只是皱眉，
Furong frowned at the introduction.

胡雪岩不知道她因何不满，不敢鲁莽，
Hu did not know what displeased her and dared not be rash.

“没有这个道理！
“Certainly not!

至少该尊称一声小姐。”
I must at least address her respectfully as Miss.”

说着作了个揖，“芙蓉小姐！”
He bowed. “Miss Furong.”

“不敢当。”
“You are too kind.”

芙蓉带着羞意，还了礼，接着转脸对阿七说：“我先走一步了！”
Blushing, she returned the greeting, then turned to A’qi. “I must leave you now.”


“你不要扫我的兴！”阿七一把拉住她，
“Don’t spoil my pleasure!” A’qi caught hold of her.

“我老早想到白衣庵去吃素斋，
“I have long wanted a vegetarian meal at Baiyi Nunnery.

难得今天凑巧，又有人做东道，又有人陪我。”
Today, by good fortune, I have someone to treat me and someone to keep me company.”

芙蓉不响，自是默许了。
Furong said nothing, which amounted to assent.

胡雪岩便一叠连声地说：“好，好！
Hu eagerly agreed. “Very well!

我做个小东。
Let me offer a modest meal.

不过白衣奄在哪里？在它那里吃素斋是怎么个规矩？
But where is Baiyi Nunnery, and how does one arrange to eat there?

我都不知道。”
I know nothing about it.”

“我知道！”阿七接口答说，
“I know.

“不过，胡老板，这个东道倒不是小东道！
But this will be no modest treat, Boss Hu!

白衣奄的素菜，湖州有名的，
Its vegetarian dishes are famous in Huzhou.

吃一顿斋，缘簿上总要写五两银子才够面子。
To keep up appearances, a guest must enter at least five taels in the donation book.”

““只要你吃得中意，五两银子算啥？”
“If the food pleases you, what are five taels?”

胡雪岩避开一步问道：“轿子可是在山门外？”
Hu stepped aside and asked, “Are your chairs outside the gate?”

“已经打发走了。
“We sent them away.

胡老板，拜托你到山门口去雇两顶，
Please hire two for us at the gate.

白衣庵在西门城脚下，
Baiyi Nunnery is at the foot of the city wall by the West Gate.

轿伕都知道的。“胡雪岩答应着，抢步先行，
Every bearer knows it.” Hu agreed and hurried ahead.

等阿七和芙蓉一出山门口，轿子已经倾倒轿杠在等着了。
By the time the women came out, the chairs were waiting with their shafts lowered.

但事情起了变化，
But matters had changed.

芙蓉原已默许了的，突然变卦，说她的小兄弟在发烧，
Furong, who had tacitly agreed, suddenly said that her younger brother had a fever.

甚不放心，一定要回家。
She was too worried to stay and must go home.

阿七自然不肯，无奈芙蓉的主意也很坚决。
A’qi resisted, but Furong was firm.

众目睽睽之下，不便拖拖拉拉地争持，
With so many eyes upon them, they could not argue or pull one another about.

于是胡雪岩反帮着她阿七，说不必勉强，改天还有相叙的机会。
Hu therefore helped persuade A’qi not to press her: there would be another occasion to meet.

“哪里还有相叙的机会？”等芙蓉坐上轿子回家，阿七这样埋怨胡雪岩，
Once Furong had departed in her chair, A’qi reproached him. “What other occasion?

“我关照你不要叫我，你不听！
I told you not to greet me, and you wouldn’t listen.

好好一头姻缘，让你自己搅散了！”
You have spoiled a perfectly good match yourself!”

此时此地，不宜细谈此事，
This was no place for a detailed discussion.

胡雪岩自己认错：“都怪我不好。
Hu admitted fault. “It was all my doing.

回家去说。”
Let us go home and talk.”


一回到家，说郁四到沂园“孵混堂”去了。
Back at the house, they learned that Yu had gone to spend a leisurely spell at Yiyuan Bathhouse.

好在通家之好，不避形迹，
As Hu was a close family friend, there was no need for formal reserve.

阿七便留胡雪岩吃午饭，谈芙蓉的事。
A’qi kept him to lunch and discussed Furong.

“我已经露口风给她了，
“I had already hinted at the matter to her.

虽然没有指出人来，不过你一露面，也就很清楚了。”
I didn’t name the man, but once you appeared it was obvious.

阿七又说：“她跟我的交情很够，
She and I are very close.

等我慢慢来说，一定可以成功。
If I had been allowed to work on her gradually, it would certainly have succeeded.

哪晓得你心这么急？
Who would have thought you were in such a hurry?

现在事情弄僵了！
Now things are at an impasse.”

““也不见得。”胡雪岩说，
“Not necessarily,” Hu replied.

“也许是她心里有数，所以不好意思。
“Perhaps she understood and felt embarrassed.

你不妨去探探她的口气看！”
You might sound her out.”

“当然！
“Of course.

总不能就此算数。
We cannot simply abandon it.

不过，很难！”阿七摇摇头说，
But it will be difficult.” A’qi shook her head.

“我懂她的脾气。”
“I know her temperament.”

“她的脾气怎么样？”
“What is it like?”

“她也是很爽快的人，
“She is straightforward too.

一肯就肯，说不肯就不肯。”
When she agrees, she agrees; when she refuses, she refuses.”

“我倒不相信！”
“I don’t believe it.”

胡雪岩心想，本来也还无所谓，照现在看，非要把芙蓉弄到手不可！
Hu had initially been indifferent enough, but now felt he must win Furong.

不然传出去便成了一个话柄。
Otherwise, if the story spread, it would become a subject of gossip.

不过这一趟是无论如何来不及了！
There was certainly no time on this visit.

且等年下有空，好好来动一番脑筋。
He would wait until he was free near the year’s end and give the matter serious thought.

心里存了这么个主意，便暂且抛开了芙蓉，自去知府衙门访杨、秦两位老夫子辞行，
Having settled on that, he put Furong aside for the moment and went to the prefectural yamen to call on the two secretaries, Yang and Qin, and take his leave.

准备再住一天就带着黄仪回杭州。
He intended to stay one more day and then return to Hangzhou with Huang Yi.


“来一趟不容易，
“You seldom come.

何妨多住几天。”郁四挽留他说，
Why not stay a few more days?” Yu urged.

“你不是要在上海打局面，
“You want to establish yourself in Shanghai.

我有几个南得的朋友，不可不文。”
I have several friends in Nanxun whom you ought to know.”

这一说胡雪岩心思活动了。
This interested Hu.

他一直想到南浔去一趟，因为做洋庄的丝商，南浔最多，
He had long wanted to visit Nanxun, which had more silk merchants engaged in the export trade than anywhere else.

一则应该联络一气，以便对付洋人，
They ought to build connections and act together in dealing with foreigners.

再则洋庄方面还有许多奥妙，非局外人所知，他们也不肯随便透露，
Besides, there were many intricacies of the export business that outsiders did not know and insiders would not readily disclose.

现在有郁四介绍，正好叨教。
With Yu’s introduction, he could learn from them.

于是他欣然答道：“好的！
“Very well,” he answered gladly.

我就多留两天。”
“I’ll stay another two days.”

“两天？”郁四慢吞吞地答道：
“Two days?” Yu replied slowly.

“也够了。
“That should be enough.

不过，我这两天衙门里有事，不能陪你，
But I have business at the yamen and cannot accompany you.

我另外找个人陪你去，
I’ll find someone else to go with you.

就同我去一样。”
It will be just as good as going with me.”

“好的。什么时候动身？”
“When do we leave?”

“随便你。
“Whenever you like.

明天一早动身好了。
Tomorrow morning would do.

晚上我把陪你去的人找来，你们先见一见面。”
I’ll bring your companion here tonight so that you can meet.”

那人是郁四手下的一个帮手，沉默寡言，但人头极熟，交游极广。
The man was one of Yu’s assistants, quiet and sparing of words but widely acquainted and well connected.

他姓刘，单名一个权字，
His surname was Liu and his given name Quan.

原是南浔人。南浔刘家是大族，
He was a native of Nanxun, where the Liu clan was a great family.

刘权以同族的关系，包收南得刘家的钱粮。
Through his clan connections, he had contracted to collect its taxes.

以这样的关系，陪着胡雪岩同行引路，可说是最适当的人选。
This made him an ideal companion and guide for Hu.


“你哪一天回湖州？”郁四问道，
“Which day will you return to Huzhou?” Yu asked.

“我们把它说定规！”
“Let us fix it.”

“我想两天工夫总够了。”
“I should think two days will be enough.”

“明天，后天，
“Tomorrow and the next day.

好！
Good.

你准定大后天回来，
Then be sure to return the day after that.

我有事要请个客，你一定要赶到。
I am giving a dinner for a particular occasion, and you must be there.”

““一定！”胡雪岩毫不迟疑地应承。
“Certainly,” Hu agreed without hesitation.

“那就拜托你了。”郁四向刘权说，
“Then I leave it to you,” Yu told Liu Quan.

“老刘，你晓得的，胡老板是王大老爷的好朋友。”
“Old Liu, you know that Boss Hu is Prefect Wang’s good friend.”

这是指点刘权，要把胡雪岩的这种特殊关系说出去，好增加声势，
He meant Liu to make this special relationship known and add weight to Hu’s standing.

果然，“不怕官，只怕管”，
As the saying went, people feared not officials in general but the official who had authority over them.

就因为王有龄的关系，胡雪岩在南浔的两天，极受优礼，
Through his connection with Wang, Hu received exceptional courtesy during his two days in Nanxun.

到第三天东道主还挽留，胡雪岩因为郁四有事请客，不能失约，坚辞而回。
On the third day his hosts still urged him to remain, but he could not break his promise to Yu and firmly took his leave.

早晨上船，过午到湖州，
Boarding in the morning, he reached Huzhou after noon.

陈世龙在码头迎接，告诉他说，郁四在沂园等他。
Chen met him at the landing and said that Yu was waiting at Yiyuan.

“好，
“Good.

我正要淴个浴。”
I was just wanting a bath.”

“我也晓得胡先生一定要淴浴。”
“I knew you would, Mr Hu.”

陈世龙把手里的包裹一扬，
Chen raised the bundle in his hand.

“我把胡先生的干净小褂裤、袜子都带来了。”
“I have brought your clean underclothes and socks.”

这虽是一件小事，显得陈世龙肯在自己身上用心，胡雪岩相当高兴。
It was a small matter, but it showed Chen’s thoughtful attention to him, and Hu was pleased.

一路谈着南浔的情形，走到沂园。
They walked to Yiyuan, talking of Nanxun on the way.

跟郁四见面招呼过，随即解衣磅礴，一洗征尘，顿觉满身轻快，
After greeting Yu, Hu undressed and washed away the dust of travel, feeling light and refreshed.

加以此行极其顺利，所以精神抖擞，特别显得有劲。
The success of his journey added to his spirits, and he seemed especially energetic.


谈了好些在南浔的经过，看看天色将晚，
After much talk of Nanxun, Hu noticed that evening was approaching.

胡雪岩便问：“四哥，你今天请哪个？
“Brother Yu, whom are you entertaining today?

是啥事？”
What is the occasion?”

“很客气的一位客人。”郁四说着，便向放在软榻前面的胡雪岩的那双鞋子，看了一眼。
“A guest who requires special courtesy,” Yu replied, glancing at the shoes in front of Hu’s couch.

胡雪岩是极机警的人，立刻便说：“我这双鞋子走过长路，不大干净，
Hu was quick to understand. “These shoes have traveled a long way and are rather dirty.

恐怕在生客面前，不大好看吧！”
They might not make a good impression on a guest I haven’t met.”

“自己人说老实话，是不大光鲜。
“Between ourselves, they are not very presentable.

不要紧，”郁四叫过跑堂来说，
Never mind.” Yu called an attendant.

“你到我那里去一趟，跟四奶奶说，把我新做的那件宁绸衬绒袍子，直贡呢马褂拿来。
“Go to my house and ask Fourth Mistress for my new ning-silk robe with its plush lining and my gong-cloth riding jacket.

另外再带一双新鞋子。”
Bring a pair of new shoes too.”

“何必？”胡雪岩说，“你新做的袍子怎么拿来我穿？
“Why should I wear your new robe?” Hu protested.

我的这身衣服也还有八成新，
“My clothes are still almost new.

叫他们刷刷干净，也还可以将就。
Have them brushed, and they will do.

鞋子也不必去拿，
There is no need to fetch shoes either.

回头走出去现买一双好了。”
I can buy a pair when we go out.”

郁四没有理他，挥挥手示意跑堂照办，
Yu ignored him and waved the attendant away to carry out the order.

然后才说：“你也太见外了，
Then he said, “You are standing far too much on ceremony.

套把衣服算得了什么？还要客气！”
What is a suit of clothes between friends?”

听这一说，胡雪岩还能有何表示？
Hu could hardly object further.

丢开此事，谈到他预备第二天就回杭州。
He changed the subject to his plan to return to Hangzhou the following day.

郁四还要留他，胡雪岩不肯，
Yu urged him to stay; Hu refused.

两人翻覆争执，没有结果，而跑堂的已把衣服取来了。
They argued back and forth without reaching a decision, until the attendant returned with the clothes.

“走吧！”郁四说，
“Let us go,” Yu said.

“时间不早了。
“It is getting late.

你到底哪天动身，回头再说。”
We can discuss your departure later.”


“慢点！”
“Wait.”

胡雪岩看着那双双梁缎鞋和一身新衣服，摸着脸说，“要剃个头才好，
Looking at the double-ridged satin shoes and the new clothes, Hu touched his face. “I ought to have a shave.

不知道辰光够不够？”
Is there time?”

“够，够！
“Plenty.

你尽管剃！”
Go ahead.”

于是唤了个剃头担子来，
A traveling barber was called.

胡雪岩剃头修脸，重新打过辫子，才穿上新袍新鞋，
Hu had his head and face shaved and his queue redressed before putting on the new robe and shoes.

里里外外，焕然一新，
He was transformed from head to foot.

跑堂的打趣说道：“胡老爷象个新郎官！”
The attendant joked, “Master Hu looks like a bridegroom!”

“我呢？”郁四接口问道：
“And I?” Yu asked.

“你看我象不象个‘大冰老爷’？”
“Do I look like an honored matchmaker?”

郁四也是上下簇新，喜气洋洋，很象个吃喜酒的冰人。
He too was dressed in new clothes and beaming, very much like a matchmaker attending a wedding feast.

跑堂的还不曾接口，又出现了一个衣帽鲜洁，象个贺客佯的人，
Before the attendant could answer, another man appeared in fresh clothes and a clean hat, looking like a guest come to offer congratulations.

那是陈世龙。
It was Chen Shilong.

胡雪岩不觉诧异，
Hu was surprised.

“你怎么又来了？”他问，
“Why have you come back?

“是找我有话说？”
Is there something you need to tell me?”

陈世龙笑笑不响，只看着郁四。
Chen only smiled and looked at Yu.

于是郁四说道：“我请客也有他一个。
“He is invited too,” Yu said.

走吧！“
“Let us go.”



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十八章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Eighteen, first part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第十八章｜CHAPTER EIGHTEEN


走了沂园，坐上轿子，
They left Yiyuan and entered their sedan chairs.

陈世龙吩咐了一个地名，是胡雪岩所不曾听说过的，
Chen Shilong gave the bearers a place-name Hu had never heard.

只觉得曲曲折折，穿过好儿子长巷，到了一处已近城脚，相当冷僻的地方，
After winding through several long lanes, they reached a quiet, out-of-the-way spot near the city wall.

下轿一看，是一座很整齐的石库房子，
Hu alighted before a neat stone-gated house.

黑漆双扉洞开，一直望到大厅，灯火通明，人影幢幢，
Both black lacquered doors stood open, giving a view straight through to a brightly lit hall full of moving figures.

再细看时，檐前挂着宫灯，厅内烧着红烛，
Palace lanterns hung beneath the eaves, and red candles burned inside.

似是有何喜庆的模样。
There seemed to be some celebration.

“这是哪里？”胡雪岩问。
“Where are we?” Hu asked.

“是我的房子。”
“At a house of mine,” Yu replied.

“幄！”胡雪岩灵机一动，
An idea struck Hu.

“四哥，莫非今朝是你的生日？
“Brother Yu, is it your birthday?

怎么不先告诉我！”
Why didn’t you tell me?”

郁四微笑着点点头说：“你进去看了就知道了。”
Yu smiled and nodded. “Go in and you will see.”

走到里面一看，有杨、秦两位老夫子，黄仪、老张，还有胡雪岩所认识的钱庄里的朋友，
Inside were the two secretaries, Yang and Qin, Huang Yi, Old Zhang, and friends from the banks whom Hu knew.

看见他们进来，一齐拱手，连称“恭喜”。
As they entered, everyone clasped hands and offered congratulations.

胡雪岩只当是给郁四道贺，与己无干，
Hu assumed these were meant for Yu and had nothing to do with him.

悄悄退到一边去打量这所房子的格局，心里盘算，倘或地方够宽敞，风水也不错，倒不妨跟郁四谈谈，或买或典，在湖州安个家。
He stepped quietly aside to inspect the house, thinking that, if it was spacious and favorably situated, he might discuss buying it or taking possession under a redeemable property pledge and establish a home in Huzhou.

这一打量发现了怪事，
Then he noticed something odd.

正中披了红桌围的条桌上，红烛双辉，
Two red candles shone on the central table, which was draped in red.

有喜庆是不错，但做寿该有“糕桃烛面”，供的应该是寿头寿脑的“南极仙翁”，
It was certainly a celebration, but a birthday should have cakes, longevity peaches, candles and noodles, with an image of the venerable God of Longevity.

现在不但看不到寿桃寿面，
There were no peaches or noodles.

而且供的是一幅五色缂丝的“和台二仙”。
Instead, a five-colored silk tapestry depicted the Two Immortals of Harmony.

这不是做寿，是娶亲嫁女儿的喜事。
This was a wedding celebration.

“咦！”胡雪岩摸着报脑说：
“Why!” Hu rubbed the back of his head.

“真正‘丈二金刚摸不着头’！
“This is like trying to reach the head of a twelve-foot guardian deity—I can make neither head nor tail of it!

怎么回事？”
What is going on?”


这一回引得哄堂大笑，
The room burst into laughter.

笑声中出现一位堂客，是阿珠的娘，梳得极光的头，簪着红花，身上是缎袄罗裙。
Through it came a woman: A’zhu’s mother, her hair smoothly dressed and adorned with a red flower, wearing a satin jacket and gauze skirt.

胡雪岩从未见她如此盛装过，不由得又愣住了。
Hu had never seen her so splendidly attired and stared again.

“胡先生！”阿珠的娘笑道：
“Mr Hu!” she said, smiling.

“恭喜，恭喜！”
“Congratulations!”

胡雪岩恍然大悟，
At last he understood.

回身以歉意的声音说道：“对不起，对不起！
Turning to the company, he apologized. “Forgive me!

原来各位刚才是跟我道喜。
So it was me you were congratulating.

我倒失礼了！”
How discourteous I have been!”

说着，连连拱手。这一来又引得大家发笑。
He clasped his hands repeatedly, provoking another burst of laughter.

胡雪岩倒又发觉一桩疑问，
Then a new question occurred to him.

一把拉住郁四问道：“郁四嫂呢？”
He caught Yu by the arm. “Where is Sister-in-Law Yu?”

“大概在里头陪新人。”
“Probably inside with the bride.”

“对了！”阿珠的娘笑得异常愉悦，
“Exactly!” A’zhu’s mother smiled delightedly.

“真正好人才！
“Such a fine young woman!

胡先生，你好福气，
You are fortunate, Mr Hu.

还不快来看？”
Come and see her.”

于是一拥而进，都要来看胡雪岩的新宠。
Everyone surged toward the inner rooms to look at Hu’s new concubine.

而他本人反倒脚步趑趄了，
Only Hu himself hesitated.

心想，世人有这种怪事，自己娶妾，别人都知道，就是本人被瞒在鼓里！
What a strange affair: everyone knew he was taking a concubine except the man concerned!

现在既已揭晓，总也得问问清楚，不然言语之间接不上头，岂不是处处要闹笑话。
Now that the secret was out, he must at least learn the details, or he would make a fool of himself at every turn.


于是，他落后两步，拉住陈世龙说：“到底怎么回事？你先告诉我。”
He fell back a step or two and detained Chen. “Tell me what has happened.”

“四叔都说好了，
“Uncle Four has arranged everything.

就请胡先生做现成的新郎官。”
All you need do is be the bridegroom.”

这两句话要言不烦，胡雪岩完全明白，
Those few words explained it.

今天的局面，是郁四一手的经营，
Yu had organized the whole scene.

劝自己到南得去走一趟，原是“调虎离山”，好趁这两天的辰光办喜事。
Encouraging Hu to visit Nanxun had been a stratagem to lure the tiger away from its mountain, giving Yu two days to arrange the marriage.

虽说他在湖州很够面子，时间到底太匆促，
Influential as he was in Huzhou, the time had been desperately short.

好比喝杯茶的工夫要拿生米煮成熟饭，近乎不可思议。
It was almost like cooking raw rice in the time it took to drink a cup of tea—hard to imagine.

刘不才又是个很难惹的家伙，
Liu Bucai was also difficult to deal with.

郁四能在短短两天之内，让他就范，大概威胁利诱，软硬齐来，
To bring him to terms in two days, Yu had probably used threats and inducements, persuasion and pressure together.

不知花了多少气力！
Who knew how much effort it had cost?

转念到此，胡雪岩不由得想到了“盛情可感”这句话，
Hu was deeply moved by such generosity.

钱是小事，
Money was a small matter.

难得的是他的这片心、这番力！
What was rare was the thought and effort behind it.

交朋友交到这样，实在有些味道了。
There was real savor in friendship carried to such lengths.


“嗨！”郁四回身喊道，“你怎么回事？”
“Hey! What are you doing?” Yu called back.

这一喊才让胡雪岩警省，
This brought Hu to himself.

抬眼望去，恰好看到珠翠满头的阿七，红裙红袄，浓妆艳抹，从东首一间屋里，喜气洋洋地迎了出来。
Looking up, he saw A’qi coming joyfully from a room on the east side, dressed in a red jacket and skirt, heavily made up and glittering with pearls and jade.

郁四这时候特别高兴，先拿阿七打趣，
Yu was particularly happy and began by teasing her.

“唷！”他将她上下一看：
“Well!” He looked her up and down.

“你倒象煞个新娘子！”
“You look just like the bride yourself.”

阿七不理他，冲着胡雪岩改口喊做：“胡大哥！”
Ignoring him, she addressed Hu by a new title. “Brother Hu!

她得意地问道：“你怎么谢我？”
How will you thank me?” she asked triumphantly.

“承情之至！”胡雪岩拱手说，
“I am deeply obliged.” Hu clasped his hands.

“我早晚一炉香，祝你早生贵子。”
“I shall burn incense morning and evening and pray that you soon bear a fine son.”

这是善颂善祷，阿七越发笑容满面，
This auspicious wish made her smile still more broadly.

接着便以居停主人的身分，招待宾客，一个个都应酬到，显得八面玲玫，而郁四却有些不耐烦了。
Assuming the role of hostess, she attended to every guest with easy social skill, until Yu grew impatient.

“好了，好了！”他拦着她说，
“Enough!

“办正经要紧。
The proper ceremony comes first.

请出来见礼吧！”
Bring her out to pay her respects.”

娶妾见礼，照规矩只是向主人主母磕头，
When a concubine entered a household, custom required only that she kowtow to its master and mistress.

主母不在，只有主人，
The mistress was absent, leaving Hu alone.

胡雪岩觉得此举大可不必。无奈贺客们众口一词，礼不可废，把他强按在正中太师椅上。
He thought the ceremony quite unnecessary, but the guests unanimously insisted that propriety must be observed and pressed him into the principal armchair.

然后只见东首那道门帘掀开，
The eastern curtain lifted.

阿七权充伴娘，把芙蓉扶了出来，
A’qi, acting as attendant to the bride, brought Furong out.

向上磕了个头，轻轻喊了声：“老爷！”
She bowed to the floor and softly addressed him as “Master.”

芙蓉忸怩，胡雪岩也觉得忸怩，贺客们则大为高兴，
Both Furong and Hu felt embarrassed, while the guests were delighted.

尤其是杨、秦两位老夫子，评头品足，毫无顾忌。
Secretaries Yang and Qin, in particular, appraised her appearance without restraint.

阿珠的娘便来解围，连声催促，邀客入席。
A’zhu’s mother came to the rescue by urging everyone to take their places at dinner.


喜筵只有一席，设在厅上，都是男客，
There was only one banquet table, set in the hall, and all those seated at it were men.

猜拳行令，闹到二更天方散。
Finger-guessing drinking games and other revelry continued until the second watch.

贺客告辞，只郁四和陈世龙留了下来。
The guests then took their leave, except for Yu and Chen.

“到里面去吧！”郁四说，“看看你的新居，是阿七一手料理的，不晓得中不中你的意？”说着，他拉着胡雪岩就走。
“Come inside,” Yu said, taking Hu by the arm. “See your new home. A’qi arranged it all. I hope it pleases you.”

“慢点，慢点！”胡雪岩说，“四哥，
“Wait, Brother Yu!

你这么费心，我不知道怎么说才好？
You have taken such trouble that I don’t know how to thank you.

一共替我垫了多少？”
How much have you advanced for me altogether?”

“这时候算什么帐？
“Why discuss accounts now?

明天再说。”
We can do that tomorrow.”

“好，明天再说。
“Very well.

不过，有件事我不明白。”
But there is something I don’t understand.

胡雪岩问：“她那个叔叔呢？”
What about her uncle?”

“你是说刘不才？”郁四略停一下说道，
“Liu Bucai?” Yu paused.

“你想，他怎么好意思来？”
“How could he have the face to come?”

侄女儿与人做妾，做叔叔的自不好意思来吃喜酒。
An uncle could scarcely attend a wedding feast at which his niece became a concubine.

胡雪岩心想，照此看来，刘不才倒还是一个要脸面的人。
Hu reflected that Liu evidently retained some sense of dignity.

“不过今天不来，迟早要上门的。
“He has not come today,” Yu added, “but he will appear sooner or later.

这个人有点麻烦，
He is troublesome.

明天我再跟你谈。”
I’ll tell you about him tomorrow.”

胡雪岩本想把他预备收服刘不才做个帮手的话，说给郁四听，但郁四不容他如此从容、一叠连声地催着，
Hu wanted to explain his plan to win Liu over as an assistant, but Yu would not let him linger and kept urging him onward.

便只好先丢开“叔叔”，去看他的“侄女儿”。
He had to put the uncle aside and go to see the niece.


一踏进新房，看得眼都花了，
The bridal chamber dazzled him.

触目是一片大红大绿，
Everywhere he looked were brilliant reds and greens.

裱得雪亮的房间里，家具器物，床帐衾褥，无不全新，
In the freshly papered room, the furniture, utensils, bed curtains and bedding were all new.

当然，在他感觉中，最新的是芙蓉那个人！
To Hu, of course, the newest thing of all was Furong herself.

新人正由阿珠的娘和阿七陪着吃饭，
She was eating with A’zhu’s mother and A’qi.

听见脚步声响，她先就站了起来，有些手足无措似地。
At the sound of footsteps she rose, looking rather at a loss.

胡雪岩也觉得不无僵窘之感，
Hu felt awkward too.

只连声说道：“请坐，请坐！
“Please sit.

你们吃你们的。
Go on eating.

我看看！”
I am only looking round.”

借故搭讪，看到壁上悬着一幅红绫裱的虎皮笺，
Searching for something to say, he noticed a sheet of tiger-patterned paper mounted in red silk on the wall.

是黄仪写的字，
Huang Yi had written the calligraphy.

胡雪岩腹中墨水不多，但这幅字，却能读得断句，因为是他熟悉的一首诗——签上的那首诗，
Hu had little literary learning, but could make out its phrasing because he knew the poem: it was the verse on his fortune slip.

只最后一句改了两个字，
Only two characters in the final line had changed.

原来是“美人何处采芙蓉”，
Instead of “Where does the beauty gather lotus blooms?”

黄仪却写成“美人江上采芙蓉”。
Huang had written, “Upon the river the beauty gathers lotus blooms.”

胡雪岩笑了，回头看到陈世龙，他也笑了。
Hu smiled and looked back at Chen, who smiled too.

显然的，这是他跟黄仪两个人搞的把戏。
Plainly this was a trick the two of them had devised.

别人却不明白，不知他们笑些什么？
The others did not understand their amusement.

阿七最性急，首先追问，陈世龙便将胡雪岩的如何求签，又如何因“何处”二字而失望的故事，笑着讲了一遍。
Impatient A’qi asked first, and Chen laughingly told how Hu had drawn the slip and been disappointed by the words “where does.”

大家都感觉这件事很有趣，特别是芙蓉本人，
Everyone found the story entertaining, especially Furong.

一面听，一面不断拾起头来看一看，
As she listened, she repeatedly raised her eyes to look at Hu.

每一看便如流光闪电般，那眼神在胡雪岩觉得异常明亮。
Each glance seemed to him as bright as a flash of light.

“那就没有话说了！”阿七对芙蓉说，
“Then there is no more to say!” A’qi told her.

“ 你天生该姓胡！”
“You were born to join the Hu family.”

“是啊，真正姻缘前定。”郁四也说，
“Indeed, a match ordained beforehand,” Yu agreed.

“我从没有办过这样顺利的事。”
“I have never arranged anything so smoothly.”


“话虽如此，到底是两位的成全。
“Even so, we owe it to you both,” Hu said.

借花献佛，我敬四哥四嫂一杯酒。”
“Let me borrow another’s flowers to make an offering and drink a toast to Brother Yu and his wife.”

阿珠的娘手快，听胡雪岩这一说，已把两杯酒递了过来，一杯给她，一杯给郁四。
Quick-handed A’zhu’s mother immediately brought two cups, one for A’qi and one for Yu.

“慢来，慢来！
“Wait!

不是这样。”阿七用指挥的语气说，
That is not the way,” A’qi directed.

“你们索性也坐了下来再说。”
“You had better all sit down first.”

于是阿七亲自安排席次，
She arranged the seats herself.

上首两位，胡雪岩和芙蓉，阿珠的娘和陈世龙东西相对，
Hu and Furong took the two places of honor; A’zhu’s mother and Chen faced one another on the east and west.

然后她和郁四说：“老头子，我们坐下首，做主人。”
“Old man,” A’qi told Yu, “we will sit at the lower end and act as hosts.”

大家都坐定了，只有芙蓉畏畏缩缩，仿佛怕礼节僭越，不敢跟“老爷”并坐似地，
Everyone sat except Furong, who hesitated as though afraid that sitting beside her master would overstep her rank.

胡雪岩就毫不迟疑地伸手一拉，芙蓉才红着脸坐了下来。
Hu took her hand without hesitation, and she blushed and sat.

“你们先吃交杯盏，再双双谢媒。”
“First drink the bridal cross-cup toast, then thank your matchmakers together.”

由这里开始，阿七想出花样来闹，
From this beginning A’qi devised one amusement after another.

笑声不断，她自己也醉了。
Laughter never ceased, and she herself became drunk.

胡雪岩酒吃得不少，但心里很清楚，
Hu had drunk a good deal too, but his mind was clear.

怕阿七醉后出丑，
He feared that A’qi might disgrace herself.

万一跟陈世龙说几句不三不四的话，那就是无可弥补的憾事，
If she said something improper to Chen, the damage might be irreparable.

所以不断跟阿珠的娘使眼色，要他们劝阻。
He kept signaling to A’zhu’s mother to intervene.


“好了！我们也该散散了，让新人早早安置。”阿珠的娘说到这里，
“We ought to leave and let the newlyweds retire early,” A’zhu’s mother said.

回头看了看便问：“咦！世龙呢？”
Turning round, she asked, “Why, where is Shilong?”

陈世尤见机，早已逃席溜走。
Chen had seen the danger and slipped away long before.

胡雪岩心里有些着急，怕她一追问，正好惹得阿七注意，
Hu grew anxious that pursuing the question would draw A’qi’s attention.

便赶紧乱以他语：“郁四嫂酒喝得不少，
He hurriedly changed the subject. “Sister-in-Law Yu has had quite a lot.

先抉她躺一躺吧！”
Help her lie down for a while.”

一句话未完，阿七张口就吐，狼藉满地，把簇新的洞房，搞得一塌糊涂，
Before he finished, A’qi vomited all over the floor, leaving the brand-new bridal chamber in a dreadful mess.

气得郁四连连叹气。
Yu sighed repeatedly in exasperation.

自然，胡雪岩不会介意，
Hu naturally took no offense.

芙蓉更是殷勤，忘却羞涩矜持，也顾不得一身盛装，亲自下手照料，同时指挥新用的一名女仆和她自己带来的一个小大姐，收拾残局。
Furong was even more attentive: forgetting her embarrassment and reserve, and heedless of her splendid clothes, she personally cared for A’qi while directing a newly engaged maid and the young maid she had brought with her to clean up.

等呕吐过后，阿七的酒便醒了，
Once she had been sick, A’qi sobered.

老大过意下去，连声道歉。
She was terribly ashamed and apologized over and over.

郁四又骂她“现世”，旁人再夹在中间劝解，
Yu scolded her for making an exhibition of herself, while the others intervened to soothe them.

倒显得异常热闹。
The commotion was considerable.

乱过一阵，贺客纷纷告辞，
Eventually the visitors departed.

芙蓉送到中门，胡雪岩送出大门，
Furong saw them to the inner gate, and Hu accompanied them to the street.

在郁四上轿以前，执着他的手说：“四哥，这一来你倒是给我出了一个难题。
Before Yu entered his chair, Hu took his hand. “Brother Yu, you have set me a problem.

湖州怕还要住几天了。”
I fear I shall have to stay in Huzhou a few more days.”

郁四笑笑不响，
Yu smiled without answering.

陈世龙却接上了话，“胡先生！”他说，“如果杭州有事要办，我去跑一趟。”
Chen spoke instead. “Mr Hu, if there is business in Hangzhou, I can go for you.”

“对呀！”阿珠的娘说，
“Certainly!” A’zhu’s mother agreed.

“尽管叫世龙去！”
“Send Shilong wherever he is needed.”

“等我想一想，
“Let me think.

明天再说。”
We will discuss it tomorrow.”


回进门来亲自关了大门，
Hu returned and closed the main gate himself.

走进大厅，喜烛犹在，红艳艳的光晕闪耀着，给胡雪岩带来了梦幻似的感觉。
In the hall the wedding candles still burned, their glowing red light giving everything a dreamlike air.

“真正象做梦！”他自语着，在一张新椅子上坐了下来，
“It really is like a dream,” he murmured, sitting in a new chair.

看着扶手，识得那木料，在广东名叫“酸枝”，
Looking at the armrest, he recognized the wood known in Guangdong as suanzhi rosewood.

样子也是广式，
The design was Cantonese too.

在杭州地方要觅这样一堂新家具，都不容易，何况是在湖州？
Finding a whole new suite of such furniture would be difficult even in Hangzhou, let alone Huzhou.

见得郁四花的心血，真正可感。
Yu’s painstaking care deeply moved him.

由郁四想到阿七，再想到老张和他的妻儿女婿，还有黄仪和衙门里的两位老夫子，最后想到这天的场面，
From Yu he thought of A’qi, then of Old Zhang and his wife, daughter and son-in-law-to-be, of Huang Yi and the two secretaries, and finally of the day’s gathering.

胡雪岩十分激动——
His feelings rose.

世界上实在是好人多，坏人少，
There were, after all, more good people than bad in the world.

只看今天，就可明白，
Today alone proved it.

不但成全自己的好事，而且为了让自己有一番意外的惊喜，事先还花了许多心血“调虎离山”。
They had not merely brought about his happiness; they had taken elaborate pains to send him away beforehand so that it would come as an unexpected delight.

这完全是感情，不是从利害关系生出来的势利。
This was affection, not favor calculated from advantage.

正想得出神，咀嚼得有味，听见有人轻轻喊道：“老爷！
While he sat absorbed, savoring the thought, someone called softly, “Master.”

转脸一看是芙蓉，正捧了一盏盖碗茶来，
He turned. Furong stood there holding a covered teacup.

她已卸了晚妆，唇红齿白，梳个又光又黑的新样宫署，
She had removed her evening makeup; her lips were red and her teeth white, and her glossy black hair was dressed in a new court-style bun.

这时含羞带笑地站在胡雪岩面前，那双眼中荡漾着别样深情，使得胡雪岩从心底泛起从未经验过的兴奋，
Smiling shyly before him, with a different depth of feeling in her eyes, she stirred an excitement he had never known.

咽了两口唾沫，润湿了干燥的喉咙，方能开口答话。
He swallowed twice to moisten his dry throat before he could speak.


“谢谢！”
“Thank you.”

他一只手接过茶碗，一只手捏住她的左臂。
He accepted the cup with one hand and gently held her left arm with the other.

“索性在外面坐一坐再进去吧！”芙蓉说，
“Let us sit outside a little longer before going in,” Furong said.

“我熏了一炉香在那里，气味怕还没有散尽。”
“I have burned some incense in there, but the smell from earlier may not have cleared yet.”

“郁四嫂真有趣。”
“Sister-in-Law Yu is very amusing.

胡雪岩问道：“你们是很熟的人？”
Have you known each other long?”

“认识不过两年，
“Only two years.

从她嫁了郁四爷，有一次应酬……”
After she married Master Yu, we met at a gathering.”

芙蓉笑笑不说下去了。
Furong smiled and stopped.

“怎么呢？”胡雪岩奇怪，
“What happened?

“又是闹了什么笑话？”
Another amusing incident?”

“不是闹笑话。”芙蓉语声从容地答道，
“No.” She answered calmly.

“那夭别人都不大跟她说话，想来是嫌她的出身。
“The others scarcely spoke to her that day, probably because they disapproved of her background.

我不晓得她是什么人？
I did not know who she was.

只觉得她很爽朗，跟她谈了好些时候。
I only thought her frank and lively and talked with her for a long time.

就此做成了好朋友。”
That is how we became friends.”

“原来如此！”
“I see.”

胡雪岩很欣赏芙蓉的态度，
Hu admired her attitude.

同时又想到她刚才不嫌龌龊，亲自照料呕吐狼藉的阿七的情形，庆幸自己娶了个很贤慧的妇人。
Remembering how she had cared for A’qi without shrinking from the mess, he congratulated himself on having taken such a kind and capable woman into his household.

这一转念间，胡雪岩对芙蓉的想法不同了。
His view of Furong changed.

在一个男人来说，妻妾之间的区别甚多，最主要的是“娶妻娶德，娶妾娶色”。
A man saw many distinctions between wife and concubine, the chief one expressed in the saying that a wife was chosen for virtue, a concubine for beauty.

胡雪岩看中芙蓉，也就是倾心于她的翦水双瞳，柳腰一捻，
Hu himself had been captivated by Furong’s clear eyes and slender waist.

此刻虽然矜持庄重，而那风流体态，依然能令人如灯蛾扑火般，甘死无悔。
Though she was now composed and dignified, her graceful figure could still draw a man like a moth to a flame, willing to perish without regret.

但是，光有这样的想法，胡雪岩觉得可惜，
But to think of her only that way would be a waste.

就好比他表链上所系的那个英国金洋钱一样，
It was like the British gold coin attached to his watch chain.

英镑诚然比什么外国钱都来得贵重，但拿来当作表坠，别致有趣，比它本身的价值高得多。
A sovereign was worth more than other foreign coins, but used as an unusual and attractive ornament, it had a value beyond its silver equivalent.

这样，如果只当它一个可以折算多少银子的外国钱来用，岂不是有点儿糟蹋了它？
To treat it merely as money would diminish it.

要娶芙蓉这样一个美妾，也还不算是太难的事，但有色又有德，却是可遇而不可求的事，
Finding a beautiful concubine like Furong was not so difficult; finding beauty joined with virtue was a rare good fortune that could not be commanded.

应该格外珍惜。
She deserved special care.

这样想着，他的心思又变过了，
His mood changed again.

刚才是一味兴奋，所想到的是“携手入罗帏”，
A moment before, he had been absorbed in excitement and thoughts of leading her behind the gauze bed curtains.

此刻是满足的欣悦，如对名花，如品醇酒，要慢慢的欣赏。
Now he felt a contented joy, as though contemplating a rare flower or savoring mellow wine, to be enjoyed slowly.


看他未曾说话，只是一会儿眨眼，一会儿微笑，
He said nothing, only blinking or smiling from time to time.

芙蓉很想知道，他想什么想得这么有趣？然而陌生之感，到底还浓，只有尽自己的礼法。
Furong wanted to know what gave him such pleasure, but the sense of being strangers was still strong, and she could only observe proper courtesy.

便试探育说道：“请到里面去坐吧！”
“Shall we go inside?” she ventured.

“好！
“Certainly.

你先请。”
After you.”

这样客气，越使她有拘束之感，
His politeness made her more constrained.

退后一步说：“老爷先请！
Stepping back, she said, “Please go first, Master.

我还有事。
I have things to attend to.”

“她分内之事，就是尽一个主妇的责任，
Her task was to fulfill a housewife’s responsibilities.

吹灭烛火，关上门窗，又到厨房里去，检点了一番，才回人“洞房”。
She extinguished the candles, closed the doors and windows, and checked the kitchen before returning to the bridal chamber.

胡雪岩一个人在屋里小饮，
Hu was drinking alone.

四碟小菜、一壶酒是早就预备在那里的，
Four small dishes and a pot of wine had been prepared.

把杯回想这天的经过，心里有无数急待解答的疑问，
As he raised his cup and recalled the day, countless questions pressed for answers.

所以看见她一进来就又忙忙碌碌地整理衾枕，便即说道：“芙蓉，你来！
Seeing her immediately begin arranging the bedding, he called, “Furong, come here.

我们先谈谈。”
Let us talk first.”

“嗯！好。”
“Yes, of course.”

芙蓉走了过来，拉开椅子坐下，顺手便把一碟火腿，换到他面前，接着又替他斟满了酒。
She came over and sat, moving a dish of ham within his reach and filling his cup.

他把酒杯递到她唇边，她喝了一口，
He held it to her lips; she took a sip.

又夹了一片火腿来，她也吃了。
He offered her a slice of ham, and she ate that too.


“你晓不晓得我今天闹个大笑话？”
“Do you know what a fool I made of myself today?”

这个开始很好，似乎一下子就变得很熟了，
It was a good beginning, seeming to make them familiar at once.

芙蓉以极感兴趣和关切的眼色看着他，
She looked at him with interested concern.

“怎么呢？”她问。
“How?”

“我跟郁老四一起进门，大家都说‘恭喜’，
“When I came in with Yu, everyone said ‘Congratulations.’

我莫知莫觉，只当是郁老四做生日，大家是跟他道喜，
I knew nothing and thought it was his birthday and they were congratulating him.

你想想，世界上有这种事！”
Imagine such a thing!”

芙蓉忍俊不禁，“噗”地一声笑了出来，却又赶紧抿着嘴。摆出正经样子：
Furong burst into laughter, then quickly pressed her lips together and tried to look serious.

“难道你自己事先一点都不知道？”
“Did you really know nothing beforehand?”

“一点都不知道。
“Nothing at all.

为了瞒着我，他们还特地把我弄到南浔去玩了一趟。”
To keep it from me, they even sent me on a visit to Nanxun.”

“那……”
“Then…”

芙蓉迟疑了一会，双目炯炯地看着他问，
She hesitated, looking intently at him.

“要我，不是你的意思？”
“Was taking me not your wish?”

“哪有这话！”
“How could you think that?”

胡雪岩赶紧分辩，
Hu hastened to explain.

“我是求之不得！”
“I could not have wished for anything better.”

芙蓉点点头，神色和缓了，
She nodded, and her expression softened.

“我也不曾想到。”她低着头说：
“I never expected it either,” she said with lowered eyes.

“我实在有点怕！”
“I am rather afraid.”

“怕什么？”
“Afraid of what?”

“伯我自己笨手笨脚，又不会说话，将来惹老太太、太太讨厌。”
“That I am clumsy and do not know how to speak properly, and will eventually displease the old mistress and your wife.”

“那是决不会有的事！
“That will never happen.

你千万放心好了。”
You may be completely at ease.”

得到这样的保证，芙蓉立刻绽开了笑容，
At this reassurance, she smiled immediately.

笑容很淡，但看起来却根深，
The smile was faint but seemed rooted deep.

她是那种天生具有魔力的女人，不论怎么一个淡淡的表情，受者都会得到极深的感受。
She was one of those naturally compelling women whose slightest expression made a profound impression.

“我的情形，你大概总听郁四嫂说过了。”胡雪岩问道，
“Sister-in-Law Yu has probably told you about me,” Hu said.

“她是怎么说我？”
“What did she say?”

“话很多。”
“A great deal.”

芙蓉把那许多话，凝成一句：
Furong compressed it all into one sentence.

“总之，劝我进你们胡府上的门。”
“In short, she urged me to enter your household.”

“那么你呢？
“And you?

乐意不乐意？”
Were you willing?”

这话在芙蓉似乎很难回答，
This seemed difficult to answer.

好半晌，她垂着眼说：“我夭生是这样的命！”
After a long silence, she lowered her eyes and said, “It is the fate I was born to.”

话中带着无限的凄楚，可知这句话后面隐藏着无限波折坎坷。
Her voice held infinite sadness, suggesting many hidden hardships.

胡雪岩怜惜之余，不能不问，但又怕触及她什么身世隐痛，不愿多说。
Hu felt tender concern and wanted to ask, yet feared touching some painful secret she did not wish to tell.

所以踌躇着不知如何启齿？
He hesitated, unsure how to begin.


一个念头转到她的亲属，立刻觉得有话可说了，
Thinking of her relatives gave him a way forward.

“你不是有个兄弟吗？”他问，
“Don’t you have a younger brother?

“今天怎么不见？”
Why wasn’t he here today?”

“在我叔叔那里。”
“He is with my uncle.”

芙蓉抬起头来，很郑重地，
Furong raised her head and spoke earnestly.

“我要先跟老爷说了，看老爷的意思，再来安排我兄弟。”
“I wanted to ask your wishes before making arrangements for him.”

“我不晓得你预备怎么安排？”胡雪岩说，
“What arrangements had you in mind?

“当初郁四嫂告诉过我，说你要带在身边。
Sister-in-Law Yu told me from the beginning that you wanted him with you.

这是用不着问我的，
You need not ask me.

你愿意怎么样，就怎么样，
Do as you wish.

将来教养成人，当然是我的责任！”
Raising and educating him will naturally be my responsibility.”

听到最后一句，芙蓉的不断眨动的眼中，终于滚出来两颗晶莹的泪珠，
At those last words, two bright tears rolled from her constantly blinking eyes.

咬一咬嘴唇，强止住眼泪说：
She bit her lip and forced the tears back.

“我父母在阴世，也感激的。”
“Even my parents in the next world would be grateful.”

“不要这样说！”
“Don’t say that.”

胡雪岩顺手取一块手巾递了给她，
Hu handed her a handkerchief.

“不但你兄弟，就是你叔叔，我都想拉他一把，
“I want to help not only your brother but your uncle too.

既然做了一家人，能照应一定要照应。
Now that we are one family, I must look after them if I can.

日子一长，你就晓得我的脾气了。”
In time you will learn what I am like.”

“我晓得，
“I know.

我听阿七姐说过。”芙蓉叹口气：
Sister A’qi told me.” Furong sighed.

“唉！我不知道该怎么说？”
“I don’t know what to say.”

“我也听说过，你的叔叔，外号叫做‘刘不才’，
“I have heard that your uncle is nicknamed Liu the Good-for-Nothing.

这不要紧！
That does not matter.

别人不敢用，我敢用，
Others may not dare employ him; I do.

就怕他没有本事。”说到这里，胡雪岩便急转直下地加了一句：“你家是怎么个情形，我一点都不晓得。”
My only concern is whether he has ability.” Then he abruptly added, “I know nothing of your family’s circumstances.”

芙蓉点点头：
She nodded.

“我当然要告诉你。”
“Of course I must tell you.”


刘家也是生意人家，
The Lius had been a business family too.

芙蓉的祖父开一家很大的药材店，牌号叫做“刘敬德堂”。
Furong’s grandfather owned a large medicinal-goods shop called Liu Jingde Hall.

祖父有三个儿子，
He had three sons.

老大就是芙蓉的父亲，老二早夭，老三便是刘不才。
The eldest was Furong’s father; the second had died young; the youngest was Liu Bucai.

刘不才绝顶聪明，但从小就是个纨袴，
Liu was exceptionally clever, but had been a spoiled spendthrift from childhood.

芙蓉的父亲是个极忠厚老实的人，无力管教小兄弟，
Furong’s father was an extremely honest, kindly man, unable to discipline his younger brother.

又怕亲友说他刻薄，便尽量供应刘不才挥霍。
Afraid that friends and relatives would call him harsh, he supplied money as generously as possible for Liu’s extravagance.

因此，刘敬德堂的生意虽做得很大，却并不殷实。
Thus, although Liu Jingde Hall did a large trade, the family was not solidly prosperous.

不幸地，十年前出了一个极大的变故，
Then, ten years earlier, a terrible disaster struck.

芙蓉的父亲到四川去采办药材，
Furong’s father had gone to Sichuan to buy medicinal ingredients.

舟下三峡，在新滩遇险，船碎人亡，一船的贵重药材，漂失无遗。
Sailing down through the Three Gorges, his boat was wrecked at Xintan. He died, and an entire cargo of valuable medicines was lost in the river.

刘不才赶到川中去料理后事，大少爷的脾气，处处摆阔，
Liu hurried to Sichuan to handle the aftermath, behaving everywhere like a grand young gentleman and spending lavishly.

光是雇人捞尸首，就花了好几百银子，
Hiring men to recover the body alone cost several hundred taels.

结果尸首还是没有捞到，便在当地做法事超度，又花了好些钱。
They never found it, so he held rites for the dead locally, spending still more.

“你想想，
“Think of it,” Furong said.

我三叔这样子的弄法，生意怎么做得好？
“How could the business prosper with Third Uncle behaving like that?

一年工夫不到，维护不下去了，
Within a year it could no longer be kept going.

人欠欠人清算下来，还差七千银子。
After reckoning what others owed us and what we owed them, there was still a debt of seven thousand taels.

那时我三叔的脾气还很硬，
Third Uncle was proud then.

把店给了人家，房子、生财、存货，一塌刮子折价一万，找了三千银子回来。”
He handed over the whole shop—the building, fittings and stock—at a valuation of ten thousand, receiving three thousand as the balance.”

三千银子，下到一年就让刘不才花得光光。
He spent those three thousand within another year.

于是，先是上当铺，再是卖家具什物，
Then came pawning possessions, followed by selling furniture and utensils.

当无可当、卖无可卖，就只好以贷借为生。
When nothing remained to pawn or sell, they lived by borrowing.

“救急容易救穷难”，
People could help in an emergency, but not support endless poverty.

最后连借部没处借了。
At last there was nowhere left to borrow.

谈到这里，芙蓉摇摇头，不再说下去，
Furong shook her head and stopped.

那不堪的光景，尽在不言，
The misery needed no further description.

墒雪岩想了想问：“你娘呢？”
After reflecting, Hu asked, “What about your mother?”


“娘早就死了，
“She died long ago.

我兄弟是遗腹子，我娘是难产。”芙蓉又说，
My brother was born after my father’s death, and Mother died in childbirth.

“到我十五岁那年，我三婶也让我三叔把她活活气杀！
When I was fifteen, Third Aunt too was driven to her death by my uncle’s behavior.

我也不知道我三叔哪里学来的本事？家里米缸，天天是空的，他倒是天天吃得醉醺醺回来，
I don’t know how he managed it: our rice jar was empty every day, yet every day he came home drunk.

就靠我替人绣花，养我兄弟，
I supported my brother by embroidering for other people.

想积几两银子下来，将来好叫我兄弟有书读，
I hoped to save a few taels so that he could go to school.

哪晓得？妄想！”
But that was a dream!”

“怎么是妄想？”
“Why?”

“我三叔啊！”
“Third Uncle!”

芙蓉是那种又好气，又好笑，出于绝望的豁达的神情：
Her expression mingled anger and amusement with a resignation born of despair.

“不管把钱藏在什么地方，他都能寻得着！
“Wherever I hid the money, he found it.

真正是气数。”
Fate, surely!”

胡雪岩也失笑了，
Hu could not help smiling.

“这也是一种本事。”他说，
“A kind of ability in itself.

“那样下去也不是一回事。
But it could not go on.

你怎么办呢？”
What did you do?”

“就是这话罗！
“Exactly.

我想了又想，下定决心。”
I thought and thought, then made up my mind.”

芙蓉略停一停，挺一挺胸说，
She paused and straightened herself.

“我十二岁的时候批过一张八字，说我天生偏房的命，
“When I was twelve, a fortune-teller read my birth details and said I was destined to be a secondary wife.

如果不信，一定会克夫家。
If I refused to believe it, I would bring disaster upon my husband’s family.

所以我跟我三叔说，既然命该如此，不如把我卖掉，
So I told Third Uncle: since that was my fate, he might as well sell me as a concubine.

能够弄个二三百两银子，重新干本行，开个小药店，带着我兄弟过日子，
Two or three hundred taels would let him resume the family trade, open a small medicine shop and support my brother.

将来也有个指望。
There would be some hope for the future.”


你晓得我三叔怎么说？
“Do you know what he said?”

“胡雪岩对刘不才这样的人，了如指掌，
Hu understood men like Liu perfectly.

所好的就是虚面子，
What they prized was empty dignity.

所以这样答道：“他一定不肯，怕失脸面。”
“He refused, for fear of losing face.”

“一点不错！他说，
“Exactly.

我们这样的人家，穷虽穷，底子是在的，
He said, ‘A family like ours may be poor, but its foundations remain.

那有把女儿与人做偏房的道理？
How could we give a daughter to be someone’s concubine?

别的好谈，这一点万万办不到。”芙蓉说，
Anything else can be discussed, but never that.’

“我也就是在这一点上，看出我三叔还有出息。”
That was one thing that made me feel there was still hope for him.”

前后话锋，不大相符，
Her tone did not quite accord with what she had said earlier.

胡雪岩心中不无疑问，但亦不便打断她的话去追问，
Hu had questions, but would not interrupt.

只点点头说：
He nodded.

“以后呢？”
“And afterward?”

“以后就嫁了我死去的那个。”
“Afterward I married the man who is now dead.”

芙蓉黯然说道：
Her voice darkened.

“一年多工夫，果然，八字上的话应了！”
“In little more than a year, the prediction came true.”

胡雪岩这才明白，她现在愿意做人的偏房，是“认命”。
Hu now understood: she was willing to become a concubine because she accepted what she believed to be her fate.

但是，刘不才呢？
But what about Liu?

可是依旧象从前那样，
Had he remained as stubborn as before?

郁四是用了什么手腕，才能使他就范？
What means had Yu used to bring him round?

这些情形是趁此时问芙蓉，还是明天问郁四？
Should Hu ask Furong now or Yu tomorrow?

他正在这样考虑，芙蓉却又开口了，
While he considered, Furong spoke again.

“有件事，我不甘心！”她说，
“There is one thing I cannot reconcile myself to.

“我前头那个是死在时疫上。
My first husband died of an epidemic disease.

初起并不重，
At the beginning it was not severe.

只要有点藿香正气丸，诸葛行军散这种极普通的药，就可以保得住命，
Even ordinary medicines such as Huoxiang Zhengqi Pills or Zhuge Marching Powder would have saved him.

偏偏是在船上，又是半夜里，连这些药都弄不到。
But he was on a boat, in the middle of the night, and could not obtain even those.

我常常在想，我家那爿药店如果还开着，这些药一定随处都是，
I often think that, if our shop had still been open, such medicines would have been everywhere.

他出门我一定会塞些在他衣箱里，那就不会要用的时候不凑手。
I would certainly have put some in his traveling chest before he left, and they would have been ready when needed.

应该不死偏偏死，
He ought not to have died, yet he did.

我不甘心的就是这一点！”
That is what I cannot accept.”


胡雪岩不作声。
Hu said nothing.

芙蓉的话对他是一种启发，他需要好好盘算。
Her story had given him an idea that required careful thought.

就在这默然相对之中，只听“扑”地一声，
As they sat facing each other in silence, there was a soft crack.

抬眼看时，红烛上好大的一个灯花爆了。
He looked up: a large bright tuft had burst from the red candlewick.

“时候不早了！”芙蓉柔声问道：
“It is late,” Furong asked gently.

“你恐怕累了？”
“You must be tired?”

“你也累了吧！”
“You must be too.”

胡雪岩握着她的手，又捏一捏她的手臂，
He held her hand and lightly squeezed her arm.

隔着紫缎的小夹袄，仍能清楚地感觉到，她臂上的肌肉很软，却非松弛无力，
Even through the purple satin jacket, he could feel that it was soft without being weak or slack.

便又说道：“你不瘦嘛！”
“You are not thin, after all.”

英蓉的眼珠灵活地一转，
Her eyes shifted playfully.

装作不经意地同道：“你喜欢瘦，还是喜欢胖？”
Pretending indifference, she asked, “Do you like women thin or plump?”

“不瘦也不胖，就象你这样子。”
“Neither thin nor plump—just as you are.”

芙蓉不响，但脸上是欣慰的表情，
She said nothing, but looked pleased.

“太太呢？”她问，
“What about your wife?

“瘦还是胖？”
Is she thin or plump?”

“原来跟你也差不多，生产以后就发胖了。”
“She was much like you, but grew plump after childbirth.”

胡雪岩忽然提起一句要紧话：
An important question suddenly occurred to him.

“你有孩子没有？”
“Have you any children?”

“没有！”芙蓉又说，
“No.

“算命的说，我命里该有两个儿子。”
The fortune-teller said I was destined to have two sons.”

听得这话，胡雪岩相当高兴，
This pleased Hu considerably.

捧着她的脸说，“我也会看相，
Cupping her face, he said, “I can read faces too.

让我细看一看。”
Let me have a good look.”

这样四目相视，一点腾挪闪转的余地都没有，芙蓉非常不惯，
With their eyes meeting directly and no room to evade his gaze, Furong felt deeply ill at ease.

窘笑着夺去他的手，
Smiling in embarrassment, she pulled his hands away.

“没有什么好看！”
“There is nothing to look at.”

说着，她躲了开去。
She moved aside.


“我问你的话，”胡雪岩携着她的手，并坐在床沿上说，
Taking her hand, Hu sat with her on the edge of the bed. “Tell me something.

“那天你先答应去吃素斋，
The other day you agreed to the vegetarian meal.

一出天圣寺的山门，怎么又忽然变了卦？”
Why did you change your mind as soon as we left Tiansheng Temple?”

“我有点怕！”
“I was a little afraid.”

“怕什么？”
“Of what?”

芙蓉诡秘地笑了一下，尽自摇头，不肯答话。
She gave a secretive smile and kept shaking her head, unwilling to answer.

“说呀！”胡雪岩问道，
“Tell me.

“有什么不便出口的？”
What is so difficult to say?”

迟疑了一下，她到底开了口：
After hesitating, she finally spoke.

“我怕上你的当！”
“I was afraid of being taken in by you.”

“上什么当？”胡雪岩笑道：
“Taken in how?” Hu laughed.

“莫非怕我在吃的东西里面放毒药？”
“Did you think I would put poison in the food?”

“倒不是伯你放毒药，是伯你放迷魂药！”说着，她自己笑了，随即一扭身，伏在一床白缎绣春丹凤朝阳花样的夹被上，羞得抬不起头来。
“Not poison—I was afraid you would slip me a bewitching potion!” She laughed herself, then turned and buried her face in a white satin quilt embroidered with a phoenix greeting the rising sun, too embarrassed to look up.

不管她这话是真是假，胡雪岩只觉得十分够味，
Whether or not she meant it, Hu found the answer delightful.

因而也伏身下去，吻着她的颈项头发，随后双脚一甩，把那双簇新的双梁缎鞋，甩得老远。
He bent over her, kissing her neck and hair, then kicked both feet and sent his brand-new satin shoes flying far away.


第二天早晨，他睡到钟打十点才起身，
The next morning he did not rise until the clock struck ten.

掀开帐子一看，芙蓉已经打扮得整整齐齐，正在收拾妆台。
Drawing back the bed curtains, he saw Furong already neatly dressed and tidying her dressing table.

听得帐钩响动，她回过头来，先是娇羞地一笑，然后柔声说道：“你不再睡一息？”
At the sound of the curtain hook, she turned, smiled shyly and asked softly, “Won’t you sleep a little longer?”

“不睡了！”
“No.”

胡雪岩赤着脚走下地来，
Hu stepped down barefoot.

“人逢喜事精神爽，
“A happy occasion refreshes the spirit.

还睡什么？”
Why sleep?”

“你看你！”芙蓉着急地说，
“Look at you!” she said anxiously.

“砖地上的寒气，都从脚心钻进去了，
“The chill of the brick floor will rise through your feet.

快上床去！”
Get back on the bed.”

说着，取了一件薄棉袄披在他身上，推着他在床沿上坐定，替他穿袜子、穿套裤、穿鞋，
She draped a lightly padded jacket over him, pushed him onto the bed’s edge and put on his socks, leggings and shoes.

然后又拉着他站起身来，系裤带，穿长袍。
Then she drew him to his feet, tied his waistband and helped him into his long robe.

胡雪岩从来没有这样为人伺候过，心里有种异样的感受，
Hu had never been attended to like this and felt a strange new pleasure.

“怪不得叫妾侍！“他不由得自语，”
“No wonder they call a concubine an attendant,” he murmured.

‘侍，是这么个解释！
“So that is what the word means.”

““你在说啥？”芙蓉没有听清楚他的话，仰着脸问。
She had not heard clearly and looked up. “What did you say?”

“我说我真的享福了！”胡雪岩又说，
“That I really am enjoying a fortunate life.

“我们谈谈正经！”
Now let us talk about serious matters.”


胡雪岩的“正经事”无其数，但与芙蓉佰共的只有两桩，也可以说，只有一桩，胡雪岩要安置她的一叔一弟。
Hu had countless serious matters, but only two concerned Furong—or, in a sense, only one: making provision for her uncle and brother.

“你兄弟名字叫啥？”
“What is your brother’s name?”

“我小弟是卯年生的，
“He was born in the Year of the Rabbit.

小名就叫小兔儿。”
His childhood name is Little Rabbit.”

“今天就去接了他来！
“Send for him today.

你叔叔不会不放吧？”
Your uncle won’t refuse to let him come, will he?”

胡雪岩人情透熟，君子小人的用心，无不深知，
Hu understood human motives thoroughly, those of decent men and scoundrels alike.

刘不才在此刻来说，还不能当他君子，
At present Liu could not be treated as a gentleman.

所以胡雪岩以“小人之心”去猜度，怕他会把小兔儿当作奇货，
Judging him by a less generous standard, Hu feared that he might use the boy as something valuable to bargain with.

因而有些一问。
Hence the question.

这一问还真是问对了，
It was well founded.

芙蓉顿有忧色，
Furong immediately looked worried.

“说不定！”她委委屈屈地说，
“He might.

“我跟我三叔提过。
I mentioned it to Third Uncle.

他说，刘家的骨血，不便，不便……”
He said that, as the boy was of the Liu bloodline, it would be improper—improper…”

芙蓉不知如何措词，
She did not know how to continue.

脸涨得通红，话说出来屈辱了自己，也屈辱了娘家。
Her face reddened: repeating the words would humiliate both herself and her family.

刘三才的话说得很难听，
Liu had spoken harshly.

“你说你命中注定要做偏房，自己情愿，
“You say you are destined to be a concubine and choose it yourself.

我也没话说。
I have nothing more to say.

郁四有势力，我也搞不过他。
Yu is influential, and I cannot stand against him.

不过小兔儿是我们刘家的骨血，
But Little Rabbit is of our family’s blood.

你带到姓胡的那里，算啥名堂？
What would taking him to that man Hu mean?

你自己已经低三下四了，
You have already lowered yourself.

莫非叫你兄弟再去给人家做小跟班？”
Must your brother become someone’s little servant too?”

当时自己气得要掉眼泪，但也无法去争，
She had been near tears with anger, yet could not argue.

原来打算慢慢再想办法，
She had intended to find a solution gradually.

此刻胡雪岩先提到，就不知道怎么说了！
Now Hu had raised the matter first, and she did not know how to explain.

不便什么？
Improper in what way?

胡雪岩的心思快，稍微想一想就明白，自然是名分上的事。
Hu quickly understood: it was a question of status.

那好办！他说：
That was easily settled.

“你们刘家的骨血，自然让他姓刘。
“Naturally, a child of the Liu family will retain the surname Liu.

我现在算是姐夫资格，
I am his brother-in-law now.

难道就不能管你的同胞骨肉？”
Surely I can look after your own flesh and blood?”


芙蓉怕是自己听错了，
Furong wondered whether she had heard correctly.

回想一遍，是听得清清楚楚，有“姐夫”二字，
Thinking it over, she was certain he had said “brother-in-law.”

惊喜感激之余，却仍有些不大相信，世界上没有这样的好事！
Surprise and gratitude filled her, yet she could scarcely believe that such good fortune existed.

“还有啥难处？
“What other difficulty is there?” Hu asked.

你说出来商量。”
“Tell me, and we can discuss it.”

这还有什么难处？就怕他的话靠不住！
What difficulty remained except the fear that he might not mean it?

芙蓉在要紧关头上不放松，特意问一句，
She would not let the crucial point slip.

“你说小兔儿叫你‘姐夫’？”
“You mean Little Rabbit may call you Brother-in-Law?”

“不叫我姐夫叫啥？
“What else should he call me?

难道也象你一样，叫我老爷？”
Master, as you do?”

芙蓉叫“老爷”是宫称，就是正室也如此叫法，身分的差别不显，
Furong’s use of “Master” was conventional; a principal wife used it too, so it did not openly mark a difference in status.

小兔儿就不能这么叫。
But for Little Rabbit, calling him Master would mean something different.

难得胡雪岩这等宽宏大量，体贴入微，芙蓉真个心满意足，
Hu’s generosity and delicate consideration left her completely content.

凝眸含笑，好半天说不出话来。
She gazed at him with a smile, unable to speak for a long time.

这翻衷情，让胡雪岩发觉，自己的猜测，完全对了，
Her emotion confirmed that his guess had been right.

“这一来，你叔叔该没话说了吧！”他问。
“Then your uncle should have nothing more to say?”

“当然！”芙蓉的声音很响亮，
“Certainly!” she answered brightly.

“我自己去接我小弟。”
“I will go and fetch my little brother myself.”


胡雪岩先不答她这话，只说：
Hu did not immediately answer that.

“我想跟你叔叔见个面。
“I should like to meet your uncle.

你看是我去拜会他，还是请他到我们这里来？”
Do you think I should call on him, or invite him here?”

“他怕不肯来，
“He may not come.

你暂时也不必理他。”
You need not trouble with him yet.”

芙蓉一大半是为胡雪岩打算，
She was thinking chiefly of Hu.

“我叔叔，说实在的，能避他还是避开他的好。”
“To be honest, it is best to avoid him if you can.”

“我倒问你，他对本行生意，到底怎么样？”
“Tell me, how well does he know the family trade?”

没有料到他会提起这句话，而且意义也不明显，芙蓉不知如何作答？
She had not expected the question, and its purpose was unclear.

细细想一想，才略略猜出他的意思，大概是要给她三叔荐到什么药材行去做事。
After thinking carefully, she guessed that Hu meant to recommend him for employment at a medicinal-goods firm.

论本事倒还不差，就是银钱上头，不能叫人放心，将来一走连累保人。
His skill was not poor, but he could not be trusted with money; if trouble arose, it could implicate whoever had guaranteed him.

然而人家既有这番好意，自己这面又是嫡亲的叔叔，
Yet Hu was offering help, and the man was her own uncle.

也不能说有机会不要，
She could hardly reject an opportunity for him.

左恩右想，十分为难，就越发无话可答了。
Torn between these considerations, she found it still harder to answer.

“我是说他的本事。
“I mean his ability,” Hu clarified.

对本行是不是在行？”
“Does he know the trade?”

“怎么不在行？
“How could he not?

祖传的行当，
It is the family business.

从小看也看会了。”
He could have learned it simply by watching from childhood.”

芙蓉说到这里，突生灵感，
An idea suddenly occurred to her.

“老爷，”她说，“我倒有个主意，不晓得办不办得到？”
“Master, I have a suggestion, though I don’t know whether it can be carried out.”

这个主意是这样，刘不才千里有几张家传的丸散膏丹的秘方，
Liu possessed several secret family formulas for pills, powders, ointments and medicinal preparations.

是根据明朝大内的“宫方”，加以斟酌损益而成，“刘敬德堂”的生意，一半要靠这几张方子。
They had been adapted from prescriptions used at the Ming court, and half the business of Liu Jingde Hall had depended on them.

生意“倒灶”，清算帐目时，还差七千银子，有人提议拿这几张秘方作价了清。
When the shop failed and its accounts still showed a debt of seven thousand taels, someone had proposed accepting the formulas in settlement.

刘不才却是宁愿不要店面和生财，要留着那几张方子，
Liu had preferred to give up the premises and fittings and keep them.

当时他倒是“人穷志不穷”，
Poor as he was, he had retained his ambition.

对债主表示：“刘敬德堂从我手里败掉的，自然还要从我手里恢复。
He told the creditors, “Liu Jingde Hall failed in my hands, and it must be restored in my hands.

将来‘老店新开’，这几张方子，我自己要用。”
When the old shop opens anew, I shall need these formulas myself.”


“老店新开，看来是痴心妄想！”芙蓉说道，
“Reopening it now looks like a foolish dream,” Furong said.

“小兔儿倚靠得着你，我也可以放心了。
“I can be at ease about Little Rabbit, since he can depend on you.

我三叔，照我看，除掉一样吃鸦片，没出息的事，都做绝了。
As for Third Uncle, except for smoking opium, he has committed every disreputable act I can think of.

我做侄女儿的，
But I am his niece.

不管他怎么对不起我，总没有眼看他没饭吃，不拉他一把的道理。
However badly he has treated me, I cannot watch him go hungry without helping.

不过，我也不敢请你替他想办法，害你受累，
Nor dare I ask you to find a way for him and bring trouble on you.

岂不是变成我自讨苦吃？
That would only make trouble for myself.

所以我这样在想，要劝他把那几张秘方卖掉。
So I thought of persuading him to sell the formulas.

从前有人出过七千银子，
Someone once offered seven thousand taels.

现在不晓得能不能卖到一万银子？
Might they fetch ten thousand now?

有一万银子，随他去狂嫖烂赌，总也还有几年好混，
With ten thousand, he could squander money on women and gambling and still live for several years.

倘或他倒回心向善了，拿这一万银子做做生意，真个安分守己，省吃俭用，变得可以靠得住，
Or perhaps he would reform, use it in business, behave decently, live frugally and become dependable.

那时候你也自然肯提拔他。
Then you would naturally be willing to help him.

这才真正是我们刘家祖上的阴功积德！
That would truly show the hidden merit accumulated by our ancestors.”

“听她长篇大论说这一套，胡雪岩对芙蓉越发爱中生敬，
Listening to this long explanation, Hu felt respect deepen within his affection.

因为她不但明白事理，而且秉性淳厚，
She was both sensible and naturally kind.

再从她的话中，对刘不才又多了一番认识，此人不但有本事，也还有志气，
Her words also gave him a clearer view of Liu: the man had ability and retained ambition.

人虽烂污，只要不抽鸦片，就不是无药可救。
Disreputable though he was, so long as he did not smoke opium, he was not beyond recovery.

这样转着念头，心中立刻作了个决定，他对自己的这个决定很兴奋，
Hu immediately made a decision and felt excited by it.

但一切都要等与刘不才见了面，才能定局，
But nothing could be settled until he met Liu.

此时还不宜对芙蓉细谈实话。
It was too early to tell Furong the whole truth.


“你的打算真不错。
“Your plan is excellent.

那几张秘方值不值一万银子，不去管它，
Never mind whether the formulas are worth ten thousand taels.

只要他肯拿出来，我一定可以替他卖到这个价钱。
If he is willing to part with them, I can certainly get that price for him.

这样子，”胡雪岩说，“今天下午我们一道去看你三叔。
Let us visit Third Uncle together this afternoon.

你穿了红裙子去好了！”
You may wear a red skirt.”

向来明媒正娶的正室，才有穿红裙的资格，
Traditionally, only a principal wife married through the proper ceremonies was entitled to wear red.

所以听得胡雪岩这一说，芙蓉既感激又高兴。
Furong was grateful and delighted.

虽然只有胡太太不在这里，权且僭越，但总是有面子的事。
Even if she could overstep the rule only temporarily because Mrs Hu was absent, it gave her dignity.

不过从而一想，又不免犯愁，
Then another worry arose.

天生是偏房的命，做了正室，便要克夫。这条红裙穿得穿不得？
If she was destined to be a concubine and assuming a principal wife’s position would bring harm to her husband, could she wear that red skirt?

还得要请教算命先生才能决定。
She must consult a fortune-teller before deciding.

因此，她便不谢，只含含糊糊地点一点头。
Instead of thanking him, she merely nodded vaguely.

就在这时候，阿珠的娘和阿七不约同至，而且还有不约而同的一件事，都叫人挑了食盒，送了菜和点心来。
Just then A’zhu’s mother and A’qi arrived independently, each having had the same thought: both had sent bearers carrying food boxes with dishes and refreshments.

相见之下，自然有一番取笑，
Naturally, their meeting brought teasing.

阿珠的娘还比较客气，阿七则是肆无忌惮，连房筛燕好的活都问得出来，把芙蓉搞得其窘无比。
A’zhu’s mother was comparatively restrained; A’qi had no such limits and even asked about the pleasures of the bridal chamber, embarrassing Furong terribly.

幸好又来了两个男客，一个是郁四，一个是陈世龙，这才打断了阿七的恶谑。
Fortunately, Yu and Chen soon arrived and interrupted her outrageous jokes.


一桌吃过了午饭，男客和女客分做两起，
After lunch together, the men and women separated.

芙蓉拉着阿珠的娘和阿七去请教，那条红裙穿得穿不得？胡雪岩邀了郁四在外面厅上坐，有话要谈。
Furong took A’zhu’s mother and A’qi aside to ask whether she might wear the red skirt, while Hu invited Yu into the outer hall to talk.

谈的是刘不才。
The subject was Liu Bucai.

郁四也正感到这是桩未了之事；
Yu too felt that this remained unfinished business.

游说芙蓉，是阿七建的功，何家早就表示过，愿意放她自主，自然不会留难。
A’qi had persuaded Furong, and the He family had long said she could decide for herself, so they had raised no obstacle.

刘不才那里，郁四原预备让他“开价”，只要不是太离谱，一定照办，
With Liu, Yu had intended to let him name a price and meet it unless it was absurd.

不想刘不才的话说得很硬气：
Instead, Liu had answered with unexpected pride.

“穷虽穷，还下到卖侄女儿的地步。
“Poor as I am, I have not sunk to selling my niece.

初嫁由父，再嫁由己，
A first marriage is for the father to arrange; remarriage is the woman’s own affair.

她愿意做胡家的偏房，我没话说。
If she chooses to become a concubine of the Hu family, I have nothing to say.

不过我也不想认胡家这门亲戚。”
But I do not intend to acknowledge the Hu family as my relatives.”

“这不象他平日的行为。
“That is unlike his usual behavior,” Yu said.

也不知道他打的什么主意？”郁四又说，
“I don’t know what he is planning.

“事情总要料理清楚，
We ought to settle matters cleanly.

留下个尾巴也讨厌，
Leaving a loose end is tiresome.

我正要跟你商量，还是得想个办法，送他一笔钱！”
I was about to suggest finding some way to give him money.”

“四哥，你费心得多了，
“You have taken more than enough trouble, Brother Yu.

这件事不必再劳你的神。
This need not concern you further.

芙蓉已经阳我仔细谈过，”
Furong has explained everything.”

胡雪岩笑道，
Hu smiled.

“他不想认我这门亲，我却非认他不可！”
“He may refuse to acknowledge me, but I am determined to acknowledge him.”

“怎么个认法？”陈世龙颇有童心，
“How?” Chen asked with youthful curiosity.

“刘不才难惹得很，
“Liu Bucai is very difficult.

我倒要看胡先生怎么跟他打交道？”
I should like to see how you deal with him.”

“我要请你先替我去做个开路先锋！”
“I shall ask you to go ahead and clear the way.”

于是他把芙蓉所谈的情形，扼要谈了些，又嘱咐了陈世龙几句话，让他先去探路。
Hu briefly recounted what Furong had told him, gave Chen a few instructions and sent him to sound out the ground.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第十八章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Eighteen, concluding part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


陈世龙打听到了刘不才的住处，一径就寻上门去，
Chen Shilong found out where Liu Bucai lived and went straight there.

他跟嵇鹤龄一样，也是祖了一家式微世家的余屋住，不过另外开了个门，
Like Ji Heling, Liu had rented spare rooms in the house of an old family fallen on hard times, though his quarters had a separate entrance.

敲了两下，有个眉清目秀，但十分瘦的孩子来开门，
After two knocks, a fine-featured but very thin boy opened the door.

转着乌黑的一双眼珠问道：
His dark eyes turned towards Chen.

“你找谁？”
“Who are you looking for?”

陈世龙听胡雪岩谈过，猜想他必是芙蓉的弟弟，
Remembering Hu Xueyan's account, Chen guessed that this must be Furong's brother.

随即说道：“小兔儿，你三叔呢？”
“Little Rabbit, where is your Third Uncle?”

“在里头。”
“Inside.”

等陈世龙要踏进去，他却堵着门不放，
But when Chen tried to enter, the boy blocked the doorway.

“你不要进来，
“Don't come in.

先告诉我，你姓啥？”
Tell me your name first.”

“怎么？”陈世龙答道，
“Why?

“你怕是我跟你三叔来讨债的？
Are you afraid I've come to collect a debt from your uncle?

不是，不是！
No, no!

我姓陈，
My name is Chen.

送钱来给你三叔的。
I've come to bring him money.”

“小兔儿有些将信将疑，但毕竟还是让步了。
Little Rabbit remained doubtful, but at last let him through.

陈世龙一进门就觉得香味扑鼻，不由得咽了口唾沫，
At once a delicious aroma made Chen swallow.

仔细辨一辨味道，是炖火腿的香味。
He recognised the scent of stewing ham.

“这家伙，真会享福！”
“The fellow certainly knows how to enjoy himself!”

一句话未完，看见刘不才的影子，哼着戏踱了出来，
Before he had finished, Liu appeared, strolling out and humming an operatic tune.

身上穿一件旧湖绪棉袄。下面是黑洋绉扎脚裤，两只裤脚扎得极其挺括，显得极有精神。
He wore an old padded jacket of Hu silk and black imported-crepe trousers, their ankles tied with such neat precision that he looked remarkably brisk.


“小和尚！
“Little Monk!

想不到是你。”
I didn't expect you.”

“刘三爷！待为来跟你老人家请安。”
“Third Master Liu, I've come especially to pay my respects.”

过于谦恭，反成戏谑，刘不才便骂：“去你的，
Excessive humility turned the greeting into mockery, and Liu retorted, “Away with you!

寻什么穷开心！”
Why make fun of a poor man?”

“不是这话。”陈世龙答道，
“That isn't what I mean.

“从前叫你刘不才，
I used to call you Liu Bucai.

如今不同了，
Now things are different.

你变成我的长辈，规矩不能不讲。”
You've become my elder, and I must observe the proper forms.”

“咦！”
“Well!”

刘不才眨着眼说，
Liu blinked.

“我倒没有想到，忽然爆出来的这么个晚辈！
“I never expected a younger relation to spring up so suddenly.

是怎么来的，你说来听听！
Tell me, where have you come from?”

““你跟我先生结成亲戚，
“You've become related to my teacher.

不就是我的长辈？”
Doesn't that make you my elder?”

刘不才愣了一下，换了副傲慢的神色：
Liu paused, then assumed an arrogant expression.

“我不晓得你的先生是哪个？
“I don't know who your teacher is.

反正我最近没有跟什么人结亲，
In any case, I haven't recently formed a marriage connection with anyone.

谦称奉壁，
I return the honour you offer.

蜗居也不足以容大驾，
My humble dwelling cannot accommodate your distinguished presence.

请！”
This way, please!”

说着将手向外一指，竟下了逐客令。
Pointing outside, he ordered his guest to leave.

陈世龙有些发窘，但当然不能翻脸，
Chen felt embarrassed, but could hardly quarrel.

在平时，翻脸就翻脸，也无所谓，
Ordinarily he might have done so without concern.

此刻是奉命差遣，
Today he had been sent on a mission.

不能不忍一忍，同时还得想办法让刘三才取消逐客令。
He must endure it and find some way to make Liu Sancai withdraw the dismissal.


于是他尽量装出自然的笑容，
He forced the most natural smile he could.

“刘三爷，你真不够朋友，
“Third Master Liu, you're no friend!

炖着那么好吃的东西，一个人享用，好意思？
Stewing something so delicious and keeping it all to yourself—aren't you ashamed?

莫非，”他说，“你不想在赌场里见面了？”
Or don't you expect to meet me at the gambling table again?”

提到赌场，刘三才的气焰一挫。
Mention of gambling weakened Liu's defiance.

彼此的交情虽不深，但输了就顾不到体面、曾有两三次向陈世龙伸手借过赌本，
They were not close friends, but after losing, he had forgotten his dignity and borrowed gambling money from Chen two or three times.

想起这点情分，也是话柄，他的脸板不成了。
Remembering the obligation—and the hold it gave Chen—he could no longer maintain his stern face.

“要怪你自己不知趣！
“Blame your own tactlessness!

‘哪壶水不开，偏提哪一壶’，
You always pick up the kettle that won't boil.

你晓得我讨厌我那个侄女儿，你偏要拿她来触我的心境，
You know I can't stand that niece of mine, yet you bring her up to provoke me.

叫人光火不光火？”
How could I help being angry?”

“好了，好了，
“Very well.

说过算数。
Let that be the end of it.

如果你留我吃饭，你出菜，我出酒。
If you'll keep me to dinner, you provide the food and I'll provide the drink.

小兔儿，你来！”
Little Rabbit, come here!”

陈世龙摸出块五六钱的碎银子问道：
Chen took out a scrap of silver weighing five or six qian.

“你会不会上街买东西？”
“Can you go shopping?”

“你要买什么？”刘不才问。
“What do you want to buy?” Liu asked.

“巷口那家酒店的‘绍烧，我吃过，
“I've tried the Shaoxing spirit at the shop by the lane entrance.

不坏，
It's good.

叫他们送两斤来，把酒钱带去给他。”
Ask them to send two jin and take the money.”

说着，他把银子塞到小兔儿子里，
He put the silver into the boy's hand.

“多下的送你买梨膏糖吃！”
“Keep the change for pear-syrup sweets!”

“没有要你破费的道理！”
“There's no reason for you to spend money!”

刘不才赶上来插在他跟小兔儿中间，一只手到他侄儿手里去夺银子，一只手又推陈世龙，仿佛不让他给钱似地。
Liu hurried between them, reaching with one hand for the silver and pushing Chen with the other, as though preventing payment.

这就象下馆子抢着惠帐，只拉住了别人的不管用的左手一样，完全是“障眼法”。
It was pure sleight of hand, like pretending to fight over a restaurant bill while holding only the other man's unoccupied left hand.

结果是那块碎银子到了刘不才手里，却叫小兔儿到酒店里去赊帐。
The silver ended up in Liu's possession, while Little Rabbit was sent to obtain the liquor on credit.

从这个行为上，陈世龙看透了他；
Chen saw through him.

骨头硬不到哪里去！
His backbone was not so stiff after all!

他跟芙蓉也决不会决裂。
He would never truly break with Furong either.


“来，来！”
“Come along!”

刘不才的兴致又很好了，
Liu's spirits had recovered.

把沙锅盖一揭，鼻子闻了两下，得意的笑道：
Lifting the earthenware pot's lid, he sniffed twice and smiled proudly.

“ ‘走得着，谢双脚’，
“‘Thank your feet for bringing you here.’

你的口福不坏！
You're fortunate in your food!

陈火腿全靠收拾得干净，
With aged ham, everything depends on cleaning it properly.

整整搞了一上午，才把上面的毛钳干净。”
I've spent the whole morning plucking every hair from it.”

“刘三爷！”陈世龙趁机说道，“你的陈火腿吃不光！
“Third Master Liu,” Chen seized the opening, “you'll have more aged ham than you can eat.

我今天来拉拢一桩生意。”
I've come to bring you a business opportunity.”

“生意？”
“Business?”

刘不才不信他，
Liu was unconvinced.

“怎么找到我头上？
“Why come to me?

跟我有啥生意好谈？”
What business could we discuss?”

自然有！
“There is some.

等下我再告诉你。
I'll tell you shortly.”

“等酒杯一端上手，陈世龙才道明来意，
Only when they had their cups in hand did Chen explain.

他说他有个朋友，预备在杭州开一家极大的药店，
A friend intended to open a very large medicine shop in Hangzhou.

知道“刘敬德堂”的名气，也知道刘不才是行家，特地托他来探问一下，想邀刘不才合伙。
Knowing Liu Jingde Hall's reputation and Liu's expertise, he had asked Chen to inquire whether Liu would become his partner.

“合伙？
“A partner?

怎么合法？”
On what terms?”

刘不才摇着头说，
Liu shook his head.

“别的事都好谈，这件事谈不拢，
“We can discuss anything else, but this won't work.

我哪里有股本？”
Where would I find capital?”

“你不是有几张祖传的药方子？”
“Haven't you several medicinal formulas handed down in your family?”

这话一说出口，刘不才的脸色顿时就很难看了，
Liu's expression darkened immediately.

笑容尽敛，
His smile vanished.

冷冷笑道：“原来是打我这个主意！
“So that's what you're after!

怪道，
No wonder!

我说世界上还有这样子的好人，不嫌我穷，来邀我台伙！”
I thought it strange that someone should be kind enough to overlook my poverty and invite me into partnership.”


话和神色，都让陈世龙忍不住心头火发，
His words and manner angered Chen.

“咦！”他也很不客气地回敬：
“Well!” he replied just as sharply.

“怪道叫你刘不才！
“No wonder people call you Liu Bucai!

‘狗咬吕侗宾，不识好人心’，
Like the dog that bit Lü Dongbin, you don't recognise kindness.

怎见得人家打你那几张药方的主意？
What makes you think he wants to steal your formulas?

你晓得人家是怎么说？”
Do you know what he actually proposes?”

“且慢！”
“Wait.”

刘不才的态度变得受商量了，
Liu became more amenable.

“我先问一声，想跟我合伙的是哪一个？
“First, who is this would-be partner?

是不是姓胡的？”
Is his surname Hu?”

陈世龙很机警，趁机反问一句：
Chen promptly turned the question back on him.

“你见过我那位胡先生没有？”
“Have you ever met my Mr Hu?”

“从来不曾见过。”
“Never.”

“那我告诉你，”
“Then let me tell you.”

陈世龙既不说破，也不否认，
Chen neither confirmed nor denied the identity.

“此人是个候补知县，在官场中很红，
“This man is an expectant county magistrate, very well regarded in official circles.

本人虽不出面，却有好些差使跟他有关系。
Though he doesn't appear in person, he is connected with many public appointments.

他要开药店也不光是为了做生意，
He wants a medicine shop for more than trade.

是存心济世……”
His intention is to help the world...”

“好了，好了！”刘不才不屑地，
“Enough!” Liu said scornfully.

“ ‘修合虽无人见，存心自有天知’，
“‘Though none see the compounding, Heaven knows the heart.’

药店里挂的这副对子，是啥花样，难道我还不知道？
Do you think I don't understand that couplet hanging in medicine shops?

何必到我面前来卖这种膏药？”
Why try to sell me that remedy?”

“不是我在你面前卖膏药，
“I'm not selling you anything.

人家这么告诉我，我照本宣科，
I'm merely repeating what I was told.

信不信在你！”
Believe it or not, as you please.”

“闲话少说，
“Spare me the talk.

他做生意也好，存心济世也好，与我无关。
Whether he wants profit or to help the world is nothing to me.

如说要邀我合伙，看中我那几张祖传秘方，请他趁早少打主意。”
If the partnership means getting hold of my family's secret formulas, tell him to abandon the idea.”

“你为来为去是怕方子落在人家手里，
“It all comes down to your fear of the formulas falling into someone else's hands.

你要晓得，人家并不要你的什么宝贝方子！”
You should know that he doesn't want possession of your precious recipes!”

“那……”
“Then...”

刘不才愕然，不知这话从何说起了。
Liu was astonished and could not understand.


于是陈世龙转述了合伙的办法，
Chen explained the arrangement.

刘不才的祖传秘方，当然要用，可是不要求他把方子公开，
Naturally the inherited formulas would be used, but Liu would not have to disclose them.

将来开了药店，清他以股东的身分在店里坐镇，这几张方子上的药，请他自己修合。
Once the shop opened, he would work there as a partner and compound those medicines himself.

“君臣佐使”是哪几味药？分量多少？如何炮制？只有他自己知道，
Which ingredients served as sovereign, minister, assistant, and envoy, their quantities, and the methods of preparation would be known to him alone.

何虑秘方泄漏？
Why fear the secrets leaking out?

原来人家不是来图谋自己的秘方，刘不才倒觉得刚才的态度，未免鲁莽，
Realising that nobody meant to take his formulas, Liu felt he had been rash.

因而歉意地点点头：
He nodded apologetically.

“这倒还可以谈谈！”
“That is something we could discuss.”

“我再告诉你，人家提出来的条件，合情合理，
“And the terms are reasonable.

药归你去台，价钱由人家来定，你抽成头。
You compound the medicines; he sets the prices; you receive a percentage.

你的药灵，销得好，你的成头就多，
If your medicines work and sell well, your share increases.

你的药不灵，没人要，那就对不起，请你带了你的宝贝方子卷铺盖！”
If they don't work and nobody wants them, then, I'm sorry, you take your precious formulas and pack your bags.”

“药怎么会不灵？
“How could they fail to work?

尤其是一种‘狗皮膏药，明朝的一个皇帝，靠了它才生的太子，
There's one dogskin plaster that enabled a Ming emperor to father a crown prince.

真正是无价之宝！”
It's priceless!”

“吹什么牛！”陈世龙笑道：
“What boasting!” Chen laughed.

“刘敬德堂的狗皮膏药，哪个不晓得，
“Everyone knows Liu Jingde Hall's dogskin plaster.

完全是骗人的东西！”
It's a complete fraud!”

“这你就不懂了！
“You don't understand.

老实告诉你，方于是真的，药太贵重，而合起来交关麻烦，
Honestly, the formula is genuine, but the ingredients are terribly costly and the preparation very troublesome.

只好马马虎虎，效验当然就差了。
