This is as good as giving me thirty-two thousand taels.

我不收是不识抬举，收了心里实在不安。
To refuse would be ungrateful, but to accept would leave me very uneasy.

我想这样，
Let me suggest this.

做朋友不在一日。
Friendship isn't a matter of one day.

以后无论是在一起玩，还是干啥正经，总还有合伙的机会。
Whether we play together again or undertake some proper business, we'll have other chances to be partners.

这笔钱，我存在你这里。”
I'll leave this money on deposit with you.”

说着，把那个信封放回庞二面前。
He put the envelope back before Pang.

“你……”
“You...”

庞二搔搔头皮，
Pang scratched his head.

“没有这个道理！
“That won't do!

我们一笔了一笔，
Let's settle one account at a time.

以后再说，无论一起玩，还是干啥正经，总有你一份就是了。”
Whatever we do later, gambling or business, there'll always be a share for you.”

刘不才急忙拱手：
Liu hastily clasped his hands.

“庞二哥说到这话，当我一个朋友，这就尽够了！
“If you say that and regard me as a friend, Brother Pang, that's more than enough.

来来，吃饭去！”
Come, let's eat.”

一面说，一面走了出去。
Speaking as he went, he walked out.

庞二无可奈何，只好在那个信封上写了“刘存”二字，藏入抽斗。
Pang could only write “Liu's deposit” on the envelope and put it in the drawer.


等吃了饭再赌，刘不才觉得刚才那样做法，对胡雪岩的委托来说，已经做到，
When play resumed after dinner, Liu felt that his conduct had fulfilled Hu's commission.

所以心无牵挂，全副精神摆在赌上，用“冷、准、狠”的三字诀，
With that concern removed, he gave his whole mind to gambling, following the three rules of coolness, precision, and ruthlessness.

在周五所摇的二十摊中，只下了三次注，
During Zhou's twenty rounds, he bet only three times.

看准了“老宝”打两千银子的孤丁，赢了六千，
Judging Old Treasure to be the right number, he staked two thousand taels on it alone and won six thousand.

连本带利再扑一记，变成一万八。
He put down capital and winnings together once more, and the sum became eighteen thousand.

第三记收起一万打八千，
On the third bet, he set aside ten thousand and wagered eight thousand.

如果赢了，就是两千变成三万四，除去本钱，恰好是那辞谢未受的三万二千银子。
If he won, his original two thousand would have become thirty-four thousand; after deducting the capital, the profit would exactly equal the thirty-two thousand he had declined.

结果吃掉了，周五的庄也做完了，
Instead, the stake was taken, and Zhou's turn as banker ended.

刘不才赢了八千银子。
Liu had won eight thousand taels.

以后换了推牌九，赌到天亮，没有什么进出，
They changed to pai gow and played until dawn without any substantial change in his fortunes.

而刘不才觉得三四天工夫就赢了两万银子，大可知足。
Having won twenty thousand taels in three or four days, Liu felt he had every reason to be satisfied.


伸个懒腰，离开牌桌，走到窗前把窗帘拉开，
Stretching, he left the card table and drew back a window curtain.

顿觉强光炫目，
The sudden brightness dazzled him.

闭一闭眼，再从那难得几家有的外国玻璃窗望出去，
He closed his eyes for a moment, then looked through the foreign glass, a luxury few households possessed.

不由得讶然失声：“好大的雪！”
“What a snowfall!” he exclaimed.

“真是！赌得昏天黑地，”高四也说，
“Indeed!” Gao said. “We've gambled ourselves blind to the world.

“外面下这么大的雪都不知道。”
We didn't even know it was snowing so heavily.”

“雪景倒真不坏！”
“The view is magnificent.”

刘不才望着弥望皆白的西湖说，
Liu looked over West Lake, white as far as he could see.

“庞二哥这个庄子的地势真好，真正是洞天福地。”
“Brother Pang's villa is wonderfully situated—a paradise.”

“你说好就不要走。”周五赌兴未已，
“Then don't leave,” said Zhou, whose appetite for gambling remained unsatisfied.

“多的是客房，
“There are plenty of guest rooms.

睡一觉起来，我们再盘肠大战。”
Sleep a while, and we'll return to battle.”

刘不才遇到赌是从不推辞的，
Ordinarily, Liu never refused a game.

但此时想到胡雪岩的正事，
But now he remembered Hu's business.

而他本人又早已回城，必得跟他碰个头才谈得到其他，
Hu had long since returned to the city, and he must meet him before considering anything else.

所以推说有个紧要约会，宁可回了城再来。
He therefore pleaded an important appointment: he would rather return to town and come out again.

“再来就不必了。”庞二说道，
“There's no need to come again,” Pang said.

“今天歇一天吧！
“Let's rest today.

如果有兴，倒不妨逛一逛西湖，
If you're interested, we could tour West Lake.

我派船到涌金门码头去等你们。”
I'll send a boat to wait at the Yongjin Gate wharf.”

一听这话，周五先就将脖子一缩，
Zhou drew in his neck at once.

“我可没有这个雅兴，”他说，
“I haven't that refined taste.

“不如到我那里去吃火锅，吃完再赌一场。”
Better come to my place for hotpot, then another game.”

“不行！”庞二笑道，
“No!” Pang laughed.

“我这个地方，就是赏雪最好，
“This is the best place to admire the snow.

我也学一学高人雅士，今天不想进城。”
I'll imitate the elegant scholars for once and stay out of town today.”

高四也说有事，还有几位客，都不开口，
Gao too said he had business, and several other guests said nothing.

周五的提议，就此打消。
Zhou's proposal came to nothing.

在庞家吃了丰盛的早饭，各自坐轿进城。
After a plentiful breakfast, they each took a sedan chair into the city.

刘不才不回钱庄，直接到一家招牌叫“华清池”的澡堂，
Liu went directly to a bathhouse called Huaqing Pool instead of returning to the bank.

在滚烫的“大汤”中泡了一会，躺在软榻上叫人捶着腿便睡着了。
He soaked in its scalding communal bath, then lay on a padded couch and fell asleep while an attendant pounded his legs.


这一觉睡到下午两点才醒，还不想离开澡堂子，
He did not wake until two in the afternoon and still felt no wish to leave the bathhouse.

喊来一名跑堂，到馆子里，叫菜来吃饭，同时写了张条子，吩咐送到胡雪岩家，说明行踪，请来相会。
He called an attendant to order dishes from a restaurant and, at the same time, wrote a note for delivery to Hu's house, giving his whereabouts and asking Hu to meet him.

等他说着一只十景生片火锅，喝完四两白干，正在吃饭时，胡雪岩到了，
By the time Hu arrived, Liu had been enjoying a hotpot of ten varieties of sliced raw ingredients, had drunk four liang of strong clear spirits, and was eating his rice.

一见他便很注意的说：“ 你今天的气色特别好。
Looking at him closely, Hu said, “You look particularly well today.

想来得意？”
Things must have gone your way.”

“还不错。
“Quite well.

一切都很顺利。
Everything went smoothly.

等我吃完这碗饭，再细谈。”刘不才说，
Let me finish this bowl of rice, then I'll tell you all about it.

“天气太冷，
It's bitterly cold.

你先到池子里泡一泡。”
Go and have a soak first.”

于是胡雪岩解衣入池，
Hu undressed and entered the pool.

等他回到座位，刘不才已很悠闲的在喝着茶等。
When he returned to his place, Liu was waiting at ease over his tea.

炕几上摆着个信封，看上面写着两行字：“拜烦袖致雪岩老哥。”
An envelope lay on the low table, bearing two lines of writing: “Kindly deliver by hand to my elder friend Xueyan.”


“你昨天怎么不等庞二把摊摇完，就走了？”
“Why did you leave yesterday before Pang finished his turn?” Liu asked.

“我自然要先走，
“Naturally, I had to leave early.

不然，到晚上‘叫城门’就麻烦了。”胡雪岩说，
Getting the city gate opened at night would have been troublesome.

“我开了两张票子，带在身上，
I had two notes drawn up and carried them with me.

交是交了给庞二，号子里有没有这么多存款，还不知道，
I'd handed them to Pang, but I didn't know whether the bank had enough deposits to cover them.

必得赶进城来布置好。”
I had to hurry back into town and make the arrangements.”

“亏得庞二不曾输掉，
“Fortunately, Pang didn't lose the money.

否则就麻烦了。”
Otherwise, there would have been trouble.”

刘不才这时倒有不寒而栗之感，
Liu shuddered at the thought.

“你想，我说了跟他四六成合伙，
“I'd agreed to a forty-sixty partnership.

倘或连你这十万一起输光，就是二十万。
If he had lost everything, including your hundred thousand, that would have been two hundred thousand.

我派四成，得要八万，
My forty per cent would be eighty thousand.

划个帐，找两万银子。
After offsetting the accounts, there would be only twenty thousand to give back.

十万剩了两万，
A hundred thousand reduced to twenty thousand!

险呀！
What a risk.

这种事下次做不得了。
We must never do that again.”

““你也知道做不得！”胡雪岩笑道，
“So you know it shouldn't be done!” Hu laughed.

“你在场上赌，等于我在场外赌。
“You were gambling at the table, and I was gambling outside it.

不过我这场外赌，无论输赢，都是合算的。
But my gamble would have been worthwhile whether you won or lost.”

““赢了是格外合算。
“Winning made it especially worthwhile.

你看！”
Look!”

刘不才把信封推了给他，说明经过。
Liu pushed the envelope towards him and explained what had happened.


胡雪岩这时才打开信封，
Only then did Hu open the envelope.

把他自己的两张银票收了起来，扬着庞二的那张五千两的银票说：
He put away his own two banknotes and held up Pang's note for five thousand taels.

“我当然不能要他这五千银子，
“Naturally, I can't take this five thousand.

但也不便退回。
But it would be awkward to return it.

只有一个办法，用他的名义，捐给善堂。
There's only one course: donate it to a charitable institution in his name.

昨天夜里一场大雪，起码有二三十具‘倒路尸’，
After last night's heavy snow, there must be at least twenty or thirty bodies lying in the roads.

我钱庄里已经舍了四口棺材了。”
My bank has already given four coffins.”

“ ‘做好事’应该！
“Good works are only right.

我也捐一千银子。”
I'll give a thousand taels too.”

“算了，算了！”
“No, no!”

胡雪岩不便说他有了钱，“大少爷脾气”就会发作，
Hu could hardly say that, once Liu had money, his wealthy young master's habits would return.

只这样阻止：“你要做好事，也该到湖州去做！
Instead he checked him with, “If you want to do good works, you should do them in Huzhou.

杭州有我，不劳你费心。”
Hangzhou has me; you needn't trouble yourself.”

刘不才有些发觉了，略显窘色地笑道：
Liu sensed something of his meaning and smiled a little awkwardly.

“其实我也要别人来做好事，
“In truth, I need other people to do good works for me.

自己哪里有这个资格。”
What standing have I to do them myself?”

“闲话少说。”
“Enough of that.

胡雪岩说，“这里不是说话的地方，
This isn't the place to talk.

到舍间去谈。”
Let's go to my house.”


于是两个人穿衣起身。
They dressed and got up to leave.

刘不才是第一次到胡家，想到他侄女儿，有些心事重重的模样，
This would be Liu's first visit to Hu's home, and the thought of his niece made him uneasy.

他不知道胡雪岩在湖州另立门户，胡太太是不是知道？
Did Mrs Hu know that her husband had established another household in Huzhou?

倘或知道，自己的身分不免尴尬，
If she did, Liu's position would be awkward.

因而便有畏缩之意。
He felt apprehensive.

但转念又觉得这是机会，可以看看胡太太为人如何？将来跟芙蓉是不是相处得来？
Then he reflected that this was an opportunity to see what sort of woman she was and whether she and Furong might get on in future.

就这样踌躇着，走出华清池时，脚步就懒了。
Torn between these thoughts, he lagged as they left Huaqing Pool.

胡雪岩回身一望，从他的脸色，猜到他的心里，觉得必须交代一句。
Hu looked back, read his expression, and realised that he must say something.

“三叔，”他说，“在湖州的事，见了内人，不必提起。”
“Third Uncle, when you meet my wife, there's no need to mention Huzhou.”

这句话解消了刘不才心里的一个疙瘩，脑筋就变得灵活了。
This removed one obstacle from Liu's mind, and his thoughts began to move freely again.

“那么，”他提醒他说：“你也不能叫我三叔！
“Then you mustn't call me Third Uncle either.

脱口出来，就露了马脚。”
If it slips out, you'll give yourself away.”

“不要紧。
“That doesn't matter.

倘或内人问起来，我只说我先认识你侄儿，跟着小辈叫，
If she asks, I'll say I knew your nephew first and followed the younger generation's form of address.

也是有的。”
That happens often enough.”

“算了，
“Never mind.

你叫我别样。
Call me something else.

我也不想做你的长辈，
I don't want to be your elder anyway.

宁愿做朋友。”
I'd rather be your friend.”

“是的！刘三爷。”
“Certainly, Third Master Liu.”

这是“官称”，刘不才欣然同意。
This was his formal social title, and he readily accepted it.

一起坐轿到了胡家，拜见胡雪岩的母亲和妻子，
They took sedan chairs to Hu's house and paid their respects to his mother and wife.

刘不才口称“伯母”、“大嫂”。
Liu addressed them as Auntie and Sister-in-Law.

看这位“胡大嫂”人虽精明，极顾“外场”，不是那种蛮不讲理的悍泼妇人，
He found that Mrs Hu, though shrewd, had a proper regard for social appearances and was no unreasonable shrew.

刘不才替芙蓉放了一半心。
Half his anxiety on Furong's behalf disappeared.


于是围炉把酒，胡雪岩开始谈到庞二，
Sitting round the brazier with wine, Hu began to discuss Pang.

“你晓得的，我现在顶要紧的一笔生意，是上海的丝。”
“As you know, the most important business before me is the silk in Shanghai.

他说，“我既然托了你，以后也还要共事，我不必瞒你，
Since I've entrusted this matter to you and we shall be working together, there's no need to conceal anything.

年关快到了，
The year's end is approaching.

各处的帐目要结，应该开销的要开销，
Accounts must be settled everywhere, and expenses must be met.

上海那批丝，非脱手不可。
That silk in Shanghai has to be sold.”

““嗯，嗯！”
“Yes, yes.”

刘不才生长在湖州，耳濡目染，对销洋庄的丝，自然也颇了解，
Growing up in Huzhou had naturally given Liu considerable knowledge of silk for the foreign market.

“现在价钱不错呀！
“Prices are good now.

不如早早脱手。
Better sell early.

摆到明年，丝一变黄，再加新丝上市，
If you keep it until next year, the silk will yellow, and the new crop will come on the market.

你就要吃大亏了。”
You'll lose heavily.”

“是的，
“Exactly.

眼前的价钱虽不错，不过还可以卖得好，
Prices are good now, but they could be better.

说句你不相信的话，价钱可以由我开。”
You may not believe this, but I can name my own price.”

“有这样的好事！”
“As good as that?”

刘不才真的有些不信，反问一句，
Liu was indeed doubtful.

“那你还在这里做啥？
“Then what are you doing here?

赶紧到上海去呀！”
Get to Shanghai at once!”

“对！
“Quite right.

就这几天，我一定要动身。
I must leave within the next few days.

现在只等庞二的一句话。”
I'm only waiting for Pang's word.”

这一句话就是要取得庞二的承诺，他在上海跟洋商做丝的交易，跟胡雪岩采取同样的步骤，
That word was a promise that, in selling silk to foreign merchants in Shanghai, Pang would follow the same course as Hu.

胡雪岩已经得到极机密的消息，江苏的督抚，已经联衔出奏，
Hu had received highly confidential news: Jiangsu's governor-general and governor had submitted a joint memorial.

因为在上海租界中的洋人，不断以军械粮食接济刘丽川，决定采取封锁的措施，断绝内地也洋人的贸易，迫使其转向“助顺”。
Because foreigners in the Shanghai settlement were continually supplying Liu Lichuan with arms and provisions, they had decided on a blockade, cutting off trade between the interior and the foreigners to force them to support the imperial side.

这一来，丝茶两项，来源都会断绝，
Supplies of both silk and tea would then cease.

在上海的存货，洋人一定会尽量搜购，
Foreigners would buy as much of the stock in Shanghai as possible.

只要能够“垄断”，自然可以“居奇”。
Whoever could control the supply could naturally hold it for an exceptional price.


“原来如此！”刘不才很有把握地说，
“So that's it!” Liu said confidently.

“这庞二一定会答应的，
“Pang will certainly agree.

挑他赚钱，
You're helping him make money.

何乐而不为？”
Why wouldn't he?”

“话不是这么说。”
“It isn't as simple as that.”

胡雪岩大摇其头，
Hu shook his head emphatically.

“你不要把事情看得太容易！”
“Don't take it too lightly.”

刘不才是不大肯买帐的性格，
Liu was not easily convinced.

“我倒不相信！”
“I don't believe it.

他说，“宠二没有不答应的道理。”
There's no reason for him to refuse.”

“凭交情，自然会答应。
“With enough friendship, naturally he'll agree.

交情不够就难说了。
Without it, one can't be sure.

你要晓得。第一，他跟洋人做了多年的交易，自然也有交情，
First, he's traded with foreigners for years and has friendships among them.

有时不能不迁就，
Sometimes he must accommodate them.

第二，在商场上，这有面子的关系，
Second, there's his standing in business.

说起来庞二做丝生意，要听我胡某人的指挥。
People would say Pang has to take instructions from me about his silk.

象他这样的身分，这句话怎么肯受？”
How could a man in his position accept that?”

想想果然！
On reflection, this was true.

刘不才又服帖了，笑着说道：
Liu yielded again and smiled.

“你的脑筋是与众不同。
“Your mind works differently from other people's.

这样一说，我倒还真得小心才好。”
Put like that, I really must be careful.”

“对了！
“Exactly.

话有个说法。”
There's a way of saying things.”

胡雪岩接下来便教了他一套话。
Hu then taught him how to put the proposal.


刘不才心领神会的点头，
Liu nodded with full understanding.

因为休戚相关的缘故，不免又问：“万一你倒扳价不放，洋人看看不划算，
Since their fortunes were linked, however, he could not help asking, “What if you hold firmly to your price and the foreigners decide it isn't worth their while?

做不成交易，岂非枉做恶人？
If no sale takes place, won't you have made yourself unpleasant for nothing?

而且对庞二也不好交代！”
And how would you explain it to Pang?”

“不会的！”
“That won't happen.

胡雪岩答道，“外国的丝，本来出在叫做意大利的一个国度，法兰西也有。
Foreign silk originally came from a country called Italy, and from France too.

前个六八年，这两个国度里的蚕，起了蚕瘟，蚕种死了一大半，
Six or eight years ago, a disease struck their silkworms and killed more than half their stock.

所以全要靠中国运丝去。
So they depend entirely on silk shipped from China.

原料不够，外国的丝厂、机坊都要关门，
Without enough raw material, their silk mills and weaving workshops must close.

多少人的生计在那里！
Think how many people's livelihoods depend on them!

他们非买我们的丝不可，
They have to buy our silk.

羊毛出在羊身上，水涨船高，又不亏洋丝商的本，
The wool comes from the sheep, and boats rise with the water: the foreign silk merchants won't lose their own capital.

怕什么！”
What is there to fear?”

“你连外国的行情都晓得！”
“You even know the foreign market!”

刘不才颇有闻所未闻之感，
Much of this was entirely new to Liu.

“怪不得人家的生意做不过你。”
“No wonder other people can't compete with you.”

“好了，好了！
“Enough!

你不要恭维我了。”胡雪岩笑道，
Stop flattering me,” Hu laughed.

“这些话留着跟庞二去说。”
“Save those words for Pang.”


刘不才如言受教，第二夭专诚去访庞二，
Following Hu's advice, Liu made a special call on Pang the next day.

一见面先拿他恭维一顿，说他做生意有魄力，手段厉害。接着便谈到胡雪岩愿意拥护他做个“头脑”的话。
He began by praising Pang's boldness and ability in business, then explained that Hu wished to support him as their leader.

“雪岩的意思是，洋人这几年越来越精明，越来越刁，
“Xueyan thinks the foreigners have grown shrewder and more difficult these last few years.

看准有些户头急于脱货求现，故意杀价。
They see that some dealers need to sell quickly for cash and deliberately force down prices.

一家价钱做低了，别家要想抬价不容易，
Once one firm's price falls, it's hard for the others to raise theirs.

所以，想请你出来登高一呼，号召同行，齐心来对付洋人！”
So he'd like you to give the call and bring the trade together to deal with the foreigners.”

“是啊！我也想到过，
“Yes, I've thought of that myself.

就是心不齐。
The trouble is that people won't act together.

原是为大家好，哪晓得人家倒象是求他似地。”
I mean it for everyone's benefit, but they behave as though I were begging a favour.”

庞二摇摇头，叹口气。
Pang shook his head and sighed.

“唉！我何苦舒服日子不过，要吃力不讨好，自己给自己找气来受！”
“Why should I give up a comfortable life for thankless work and invite vexation?”

“你是大少爷出身，从出娘胎，也没有受过气，
“You were born a young master and have never had to put up with an insult.

自然做不来这种仰面求人的事。
Naturally, you can't go humbly begging others.

雪岩也知道，
Xueyan understands that.

他只请你出面为头，靠你的地位号召，
He asks only that you stand at the head and lend the movement your prestige.

事情归他去做。”
He'll do the work.”

“这也不敢当！”庞二答道，
“I couldn't accept such an honour,” Pang answered.

“老胡这样捧我，实在当不起。”
“Old Hu gives me far too much credit.”

这话就要辨辨味道了，
The words needed careful interpretation.

可能是真心话，也可能是推托。
They might be sincere, or merely an excuse.

如果是推托，原因何在？
If an excuse, why?

刘不才这样想着，一面口中恭维，一面在细察庞二的脸色。
As he continued to flatter Pang, Liu studied his expression closely.

这是刘不才有阅历的地方！
Here his experience proved useful.

庞二果然是假客气的话，
Pang's modesty was indeed a pretence.

他对胡雪岩虽颇欣赏，但相知不深，
He admired Hu, but they did not know each other well.

对于胡雪岩一下子如跳龙门似地，由穷小子闯出这样的手面，其间的传奇，也听人约略谈过，
He had heard something of the remarkable story of Hu's rise, like a leap through the Dragon Gate, from a poor young fellow to a man who could operate on such a scale.

认为他实力毕竟有限，
Yet he thought Hu's real resources must still be limited.

深恐他弄什么玄虚，存着戒心。
Afraid there might be some trick behind the proposal, he remained on his guard.


说到后来，刘不才有些着急了，
As the conversation continued, Liu grew anxious.

“庞二哥，承蒙你看得起我，一见如故，
“Brother Pang, you've been kind enough to take to me as an old friend from the moment we met.

所以雪岩托我这件事，我一口答应。
That's why I immediately agreed when Xueyan asked me to undertake this.

现在你一再谦虚，似乎当我外人看待。”
Now you keep declining so modestly that you seem to regard me as an outsider.”

说到这里，发觉自己的态度，有些过分，便笑一笑说，
Realising that he had gone a little too far, he smiled.

“好了，好了！
“Never mind!

庞二哥，我不管这桩闲事了，
I won't meddle in this any longer.

我请你到‘江山船’上吃花酒去。”
Let me invite you to drink with the courtesans on a Jiangshan pleasure boat.”

最后这一转很好，
The final turn was well judged.

庞二觉得刘不才很够朋友，
Pang felt that Liu was a true friend.

自己虽存着猜疑之心，他却依旧当自己好朋友，
Though Pang had remained suspicious, Liu still treated him warmly.

这很难得。
That was rare.

就一转念之间，心便软了，觉得无论如何要有个交代，于是这样笑道：
The thought softened him, and he felt he must give some definite answer.

“老刘，你不要气急！
“Old Liu, don't be impatient.

不看僧面看佛面，你第一趟跟我谈正经事，又是为彼此的利益，
If not for the monk, then for the Buddha: this is the first time you've brought me a business proposal, and it benefits both sides.

我怎么能不买你的帐？
How could I refuse you consideration?

不过，我也说句实话，
But let me speak frankly.

象这样的事，做好了没有人感激，
If such a scheme succeeds, nobody thanks you.

做坏了，同行的闲话很多。
If it fails, the trade will have plenty to say.

中国人的脑筋比外国人好，就是私心太重，
Chinese minds are sharper than foreign ones; the trouble is excessive self-interest.

所以我不敢冒昧出头。
That's why I dare not rush to take the lead.

现在这样，我跟老胡先谈一谈再说，
Let me talk to Old Hu first.

能做我一定做，
If it can be done, I'll certainly do it.

决不会狗皮倒灶。
I won't be a tiresome obstruction.

你看好不好？”
Will that suit you?”

“哪还有不好的道理？
“How could it not?

你说，你们在哪里谈？”
Where shall you meet?”

“今天我还有一个约，没有空了，
“I've another appointment today and no time.

就明天吧。”
Tomorrow, then.

庞二又说，“你不是要请我吃花酒吗？
Didn't you offer me a courtesans' drinking party?

我们就在江山船上谈好了。”
We can talk on the Jiangshan boat.”

“一言为定。
“Agreed.

明天请你江山船上吃花酒，
Tomorrow I'll entertain you there.

我发帖子来。”
I'll send an invitation.”


“这不必了。
“No need for that.

你是用哪家的船？”
Whose boat will you use?”

庞二对此道也很熟悉，
Pang knew this world well too.

“顶好的是小金桂的船，只怕定出去了。
“Xiao Jingui's is the best, but it may already be booked.

其次就是‘何仙姑’的船。”
Next best is He Xiangu's.”

“好，不是小金桂，就是何仙姑。
“Then one of those two.

事不宜迟，
There's no time to lose.

我马上去办。
I'll arrange it now.

定好了船，还是发帖子来。”
Once I've secured the boat, I'll send an invitation all the same.”

“好，好，
“Very well.

我听你招呼。”
I'll await your word.

庞二又说，“人不宜太多，
But don't invite too many people.

略微清静些，好谈正事。”刘不才答应着告辞而去。
We want some quiet to discuss business.” Liu agreed and took his leave.

进城直接去找胡雪岩，细说了经过，
Returning to the city, he went directly to Hu and recounted the conversation.

表示佩服胡雪岩有先见之明，果然事情不那么容易，
He admired Hu's foresight: the business had indeed proved difficult.

又说他未能圆满达成任务，深感歉疚。
He also apologised deeply for failing to complete his mission satisfactorily.

“这是哪里的话！”
“What are you saying?”

胡雪岩安慰他说，
Hu reassured him.

“有这样一个结果，依我看，已经非常好了。”
“To my mind, this is already an excellent result.”

“那么，预备怎么跟他谈呢？”
“How will you approach him, then?”

“那自然要临机应变。
“Naturally, I'll adapt as we talk.

看样子，他是跟我初次共事，还不大能够相信。”
It seems he doesn't quite trust me yet, since this would be our first undertaking together.

胡雪岩又说，“这件事即使做不成功，我以后跟他合作的日子还有。
Even if this one doesn't succeed, there will be other opportunities for us to work together.

所以，三爷，倘或事情谈不拢，你不必摆在心上，好象觉得对不起我，他不够朋友。
So, Third Master, if we can't agree, don't take it to heart as though you'd failed me or he weren't a good friend.

你要一切照常，一点不在乎。
Treat everything as usual and think nothing of it.

你懂我意思不懂？
Do you understand?”

““当然懂！”
“Of course.”

刘不才深深点头，
Liu nodded earnestly.

“这个朋友是长朋友。”
“This is a friendship for the long term.”

“对了！”
“Exactly!”

胡雪岩极欣慰的，
Hu was deeply pleased.

“说这话，你是真的懂了。”
“That shows you truly understand.”


于是，刘不才告辞回去，托刘庆生派人定了小金桂的船，
Liu took his leave and asked Liu Qingsheng to send someone to book Xiao Jingui's boat.

又发帖子，
He also sent the invitations.

整整忙了一下午，才算诸事就绪。
The preparations occupied the whole afternoon.

哪知到了夜里，突然接到庞二的信，
That night, unexpectedly, a letter arrived from Pang.

说他接到家报，第二天必须赶回甫浔，花酒之约，只得辞谢，
He had received news from home and must return to Nanxun the following day, so he could no longer attend the party.

胡雪岩的事，希望即晚谈一谈，在何处见面，立等回音。
He hoped to discuss Hu's business that very evening and was waiting for an immediate reply about where they should meet.

信是由庞家的听差送来的，
The letter came by Pang's servant.

刘不才打听了一下，才知道庞二闹家务，
After a few inquiries, Liu learned that there was trouble within Pang's family.

看起来他的心境不会好，对胡雪岩的事，自然也不会感觉兴趣，谈与不谈已经无关宏旨了。
He would hardly be in good spirits or interested in Hu's affairs; whether they discussed the proposal now seemed to matter little.

不过想到“长朋友”这句话，刘不才觉得对庞二应有一番慰问之意，
But remembering their “friendship for the long term,” Liu felt he should offer some sympathy.

因此告诉庞家的听差，说他马上约了胡雪岩去拜访。
He told the servant that he would fetch Hu and call on Pang immediately.

等庞家的听差一走，刘不才接着也赶到了胡家，相见之下，说了经过，
As soon as the servant left, Liu hurried to Hu's house and explained.

胡雪岩大为皱眉，沉吟了好半晌，倏地起身，成竹在胸似地说：
Hu frowned deeply and considered for some time, then suddenly rose as though his plan were settled.

“走吧！
“Let's go.

船到桥头自然直。”
The boat will straighten itself when it reaches the bridge.”

坐轿出城，
They took chairs out of the city.

见着了庞二，胡雪岩发觉他眉宇之间，隐然有忧色，
On seeing Pang, Hu detected worry in his expression.

便不谈自己的事，只问庞二有何急事，要赶回家去？
Instead of raising his own business, he asked what urgent matter required Pang to return home.

“我叫人告到官里了！”庞二很坦率地回答，
“Someone has brought a case against me,” Pang answered frankly.

“这一趟回去，说不定要对簿公堂。”
“I may have to appear in court.”

“不幸之至。”胡雪岩问道，
“Most unfortunate.

“到底为了什么？”
What is it about?”

“ 这话说来太长，
“That's a long story.

总之，族中有人见我境遇还过得去，无理取闹。
In short, some members of my clan see that I'm fairly comfortably off and are making unreasonable trouble.

花几个钱倒不在乎，
I don't mind spending money.

这口气忍不下去。”
It's the insult I can't swallow.”


一听这话，就知道无非族人夺产，
Hu understood at once that the clansmen were after Pang's property.

事由不明，无法为他出什么主意，
Without the particulars, he could offer no specific advice.

只好这样相劝：“庞二哥，讼则终凶，
He could only urge, “Brother Pang, lawsuits end badly.

惟和为贵。”
Peace is best.”

“和也要和得下来。”
“Peace must be possible first.”

庞二摇摇头，
Pang shook his head.

“唉！
“Never mind.

不必谈了。”
Let's not discuss it.”

庞二不谈，胡雪岩却不能不谈，也不可不谈，因为他可以帮庞二的忙，
But Hu could not let the subject drop, nor should he: he could help.

“如果你愿意和，我包你和得下来。”
“If you're willing to settle, I guarantee a settlement.

胡雪岩说，“庞二哥，打官司你不必担心！
You needn't fear a lawsuit, Brother Pang.

只要理直，包赢不输，
If right is on your side, I guarantee you'll win.

不过俗话说得好：富不跟穷斗。
But the saying is sound: the rich shouldn't fight the poor.

你的官司就打赢了也没有什么意思。”
Even winning your case would bring little satisfaction.”

“啊！”
“Ah!”

庞二突然双眼发亮，
Pang's eyes suddenly brightened.

“对了，
“Of course!

你跟王大老爷是好朋友。
You're a close friend of Prefect Wang.

这个忙可以帮我。”
You can help me.”

“当然。”胡雪岩说，
“Naturally.

“我先陪你走一趟。
I'll go with you first.

你的事要紧，
Your affairs are urgent.

我上海的事只好摆着再说了。”
My business in Shanghai will have to wait.”

这是以退为进的说法，
This was a retreat intended to gain ground.

庞二被提醒了，他是阔少的作风，遇到这些地方，最拿得出决断，
Reminded of Hu's business, Pang showed the decisiveness of a wealthy young master.

“老胡！”他说，“你上海的事不要紧，
“Old Hu, don't worry about Shanghai.

都在我身上。
Leave it all to me.

你说，要我怎么样？”
Tell me what you want me to do.”


“刘三爷跟你大致已经谈过了。
“Third Master Liu has told you the general idea.

我就是想庞二哥来出面，
I'd like you to take the lead.

我劝同行齐心一致，由我陪你去跟洋人谈判。”
I'll persuade the trade to act together, then accompany you to negotiate with the foreigners.”

“我是没有空来办这件事了。”
“I won't have time to handle it myself.

庞二问道，“你在上海有多少丝？”
How much silk have you in Shanghai?”

“我有两万包。”
“Twenty thousand bales.”

“那就行了。
“Then that's enough.

我跟你加在一起，已经占到百分之七十，
Yours and mine together already account for seventy per cent.

实力尽够了。
We have ample strength.

你跟洋人会谈，
You negotiate with the foreigners.

我把我的栈单交了给你，委托你代我去做交易，
I'll hand you my warehouse receipts and authorise you to sell on my behalf.

你说怎么就怎么。
Whatever you decide goes.

这样总行了吧？”
Surely that will do?”

得到这样一个结果，胡雪岩喜出望外。
The result surpassed Hu's hopes.

有庞二的全权委托，不但对洋商的交易，可以顺利达成，而且自己的声望，立刻就会升高。
With Pang's full authority, he could not only bring the transaction with the foreign merchants to a successful conclusion but immediately raise his own standing.

但好事来得太容易，反令人有不安之感，
Yet such easily won good fortune made him uneasy.

他不敢有得意的神色，
He dared show no triumph.

“庞二哥，你这个委任重了！”他戒慎恐惧的说：
“Brother Pang, you're placing a heavy responsibility on me.

“我怕万一搞得灰头土脸，对你不好交代。”
I'm afraid that if I make a mess of it, I shan't know how to face you.”

“不会的！”
“You won't.

庞二答道：“我听老刘谈过了，
Old Liu has told me about you.

你对丝不外行。
You know the silk trade.

就请你记住一句话，‘顺风旗不要扯得太足’，
Remember just one thing: don't stretch your banner too far in a favourable wind.

自然万无一失。”
Then nothing can go wrong.”

“是的，”胡雪岩衷心受教，
“Yes,” Hu answered with sincere respect.

“我照你的话去做。
“I'll follow your advice.

价钱方面，我总还要跟你商量的，
As for the price, I shall still consult you.

不会独断独行。”
I won't decide everything on my own.”


“不必，
“No need.

你看着办好了。
Use your own judgement.

至于回扣……”
As for your commission...”

“不，不！”
“No, no!”

胡雪岩急忙摇手，
Hu hastily waved his hands.

“你这么捧我，我决不能再要回扣。
“After such support, I couldn't take a commission as well.

原是你自己可以谈的事，
You could have handled the transaction yourself.

怎么好损失回扣？
Why should you lose that amount?

我晓得你为人大方，不过你手下也有一般‘朋友’，
I know you're generous, but you have ‘friends’ working under you.

叫他们背后说你的闲后，变得我对不起你了。”
If they criticised you behind your back, I should have done you a disservice.”

听这一说，庞二越觉得胡雪岩“落门落槛”，是做生意可以倾心合作的人。
Pang felt still more strongly that Hu understood how things should be done and was a man with whom he could cooperate wholeheartedly.

别人漂亮，他更不肯马虎，
If the other man behaved handsomely, he would not be careless in return.

坚持一定要送，
He insisted on paying.

胡雪岩也作了很肯定的表示，倘或庞二一定要送，他不能不收，只是除了必要的开支以外，余数他要送庞二手下的“朋友”。
Hu was equally definite: if Pang insisted, he could not refuse, but after deducting necessary expenses, he would give the balance to Pang's “friends.”

“那随你，
“That's up to you.

我就不管了。”
I won't interfere.

庞二又说，“今天晚上我就写信通知上海，把栈单给你送去，
I'll write to Shanghai tonight and have the warehouse receipts sent to you.

送到哪里？”
Where should they go?”

“不是这么做法，
“Not that way.

只请你写封委托信给我，同时请你通知宝号的档手，说明经过。
Please just give me a letter of authorisation and notify your firm's manager of the arrangement.

栈单不必交给我。”
The receipts needn't be handed to me.”


这样做，亦无不可。
That arrangement was equally acceptable.

谈完胡雪岩的事，庞二谈他自己的事。
With Hu's business settled, they returned to Pang's.

照胡雪岩的想法，上海那方面的生意，他可以托人代办，自己该陪着庞二到湖州，去替他料理官司。
Hu thought he could entrust the Shanghai transaction to someone else and accompany Pang to Huzhou to help with the lawsuit.

刘不才也在旁边帮腔，说胡雪岩对这种徘难解纷的事，最为擅长，此行少不得他。
Liu supported him, saying that Hu excelled at resolving disputes and was indispensable to the journey.

但唯其如此，庞二反倒顾虑了。
Yet this very argument made Pang hesitate.

“老胡！有你出大力帮忙，这件事，我现在就可以放心，
“Old Hu, with your full help, I can already set my mind at rest.

至多惹几天麻烦，花几吊银子，
At worst there'll be a few troublesome days and a few strings of cash to spend.

没有什么大不了的。
Nothing very serious.

不过，我不愿意落个仗势欺人的名声。
But I don't want a reputation for using influence to bully people.

你陪了我去，好是好，就只一样不妥，
It would be good to have you with me, except for one thing.

湖州好些人都知道你跟王大老爷是知交，
Many people in Huzhou know you're a close friend of Prefect Wang.

看你出面，明明王大老爷秉公办理，别人说起来，总是我走了门路。
If you appear, they'll say I used connections even if he handles the case with complete impartiality.”

“庞二停了一下又说，“这一来不但我不愿意，对王大老爷的官声也不好。”
After a pause, Pang added, “I wouldn't like that, and it would harm his official reputation too.”

听了这番话，胡雪岩心想，谁说庞二是不懂事的纨袴，谁就是有眼无珠的草包，
Hearing this, Hu thought that anyone who called Pang an ignorant rich idler was a blind fool himself.

因而心悦诚服的答说：“庞二哥看事情，真正透彻！
With heartfelt admiration, he replied, “You see matters very clearly indeed, Brother Pang.

既然如此，我全听吩咐。”
In that case, I'll do as you wish.”

“不敢当！”
“You flatter me.

庞二说道：“我只请你切切实实的替我写封信，我也是备而不用。”
All I ask is that you write me a proper, substantial letter, to keep in reserve rather than use.”

“好的。
“Certainly.

我的信要写两封，一封给王雪公，一封给刑幕秦老夫子，
I'll write two: one to Prefect Wang and one to Secretary Qin, his legal secretary.

此人我也是有交情的，
I'm friendly with him too.

庞二哥有什么难处，尽管跟他商量。”
If you have any difficulty, consult him freely.”


“这是文的一面，
“That's the formal side.

还有武的一面。”刘不才插嘴问庞二：“郁四，你认不认识？”
There's the forceful side too.” Liu asked Pang, “Do you know Yu Si?”

“认是认得，交情不深。”
“I know him, but not well.

庞二答道：“说句实话，这些江湖朋友，我不大敢惹。”
Frankly, I don't much care to get involved with such men of the streets and waterways.”

“这个人也是‘备而不用’好了。”胡雪岩说，
“Keep him in reserve too,” Hu said.

“信我也是照写，其实不写也不要紧，
“I'll write him a letter as well, though it scarcely matters.

郁四听见是庞二哥的事，不敢不尽心。”
Once Yu hears that it's your business, Brother Pang, he won't dare spare any effort.”

这是胡雪岩拿高帽子往庞二头上戴，意思是以庞家的名望，郁四自然要巴结。
Hu was flattering him, implying that the Pang family's prestige would naturally make Yu eager to oblige.

只是恭维得不肉麻，庞二听了非常舒服，
The compliment was subtle enough to give Pang great pleasure.

心里在想，他们杭州人的俗语，“花花轿儿人抬人”，
He thought of the Hangzhou saying: people take turns carrying one another's decorated chairs.

胡雪岩越是如此说，就越要买他的面子。
The more Hu spoke like this, the more Pang ought to honour him.

“老胡，听你这一说，郁四跟你的交情一定不错。
“Old Hu, from what you say, you and Yu must be good friends.

你的朋友就是我的朋友，
Your friends are mine.

我这趟回湖州，倒要交他一交，
When I return to Huzhou, I should like to get to know him.

请你替我写介绍信。”
Please write me an introduction.”

“一句话！”
“Consider it done.”

胡雪岩起身告辞，
Hu rose to leave.

“你就要走了，总还有些事要料理，
“You're going tomorrow and must still have things to arrange.

我不耽搁你的工夫，
I won't take up your time.

明天一早，我把信送来。”
I'll bring the letters early in the morning.”

这天晚上胡雪岩备下三封极其切实的信，第二天一早带到庞二那里。
That night, Hu prepared three letters, all giving firm and practical support, and took them to Pang the next morning.

投桃报李，他交给胡雪岩的两封信也很实在，一封是委托书，一封是写给他在上海的管事的，
Returning favour for favour, Pang gave him two equally substantial letters: one was an authorisation; the other was addressed to his manager in Shanghai.

特意不封口，请胡雪岩代发，意思是让他过了目，好放心。
He had deliberately left the latter unsealed and asked Hu to send it, meaning that Hu should read it first and be reassured.

这使得胡雪岩对庞二又有深一层的了解，
This gave Hu a deeper understanding of Pang.

做事不但豪爽，而且过节上的交代，一丝不苟，十分漂亮。
He was not only generous and forthright; in attending to every detail of an arrangement, he was scrupulous and admirable.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第二十章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Twenty, first part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第二十章｜CHAPTER TWENTY


有了这封委托书，胡雪岩要好好的动脑筋了。
Now that he had the letter of authorisation, Hu Xueyan needed to think carefully.

他不断跟古应春有书信往来，上海方面的生意，是托古应春代为接头，尤五的一切情形，也是由古应春代达。
He had kept up a steady correspondence with Gu Yingchun, who handled his business contacts in Shanghai and passed on all news of You Laowu.

所以庞二这面谈成功，他第一件事，就是写信告诉古应春，
Once the agreement with Pang Er was settled, his first act was to write to Gu.

然后料理杭州这方面所经手的事务，预备在十二月初动身到上海，尽月半以前把丝卖出去，好应付公私帐目。
Then he attended to the affairs in his charge in Hangzhou, intending to leave for Shanghai early in the twelfth month and sell the silk before mid-month to meet his public and private obligations.

然后开了年，另外再推出新的计划，大干一番。
After the New Year, he would launch fresh plans and make a great effort.

不多几天，古应春的回信来了，让胡雪岩大出意外的是，洋人那方面变了卦，表示年关以前，无意买丝。
Gu's reply arrived a few days later with an unpleasant surprise: the foreign merchants had changed their minds and had no intention of buying silk before the year ended.

表面是说，他们国内来信，存货已多，可以暂停。
They claimed that letters from home reported ample stocks and advised suspending purchases.

实际上照古应春的了解，外国人也学得门槛精了，
In Gu's view, however, they had grown shrewd.

知道中国商场的规矩，三节结帐，年下归总，需要大笔头寸。
They knew the Chinese business custom of settling accounts at the three major festivals and making a final reckoning at year-end, when large sums of ready money were needed.

有意想“杀年猪”。
They meant to “slaughter the New Year pig.”

如果胡雪岩价钱不是扳得太高，则洋人为了以后的生意，也下会赶尽杀绝。
Yet if Hu did not hold out for too high a price, their interest in future dealings would keep them from driving him entirely to the wall.

“事情麻烦了！”胡雪岩跟刘不才说，
“This makes things difficult!” Hu told Liu Bucai.

“我自己要头寸在其次，
“My own need for funds is secondary.

还有许多小户，不能过关，
Many small dealers won't get through the year.

一定会倒过来恳求洋商，
They'll have to turn round and beg the foreigners.

虽然他们这点小数，不至于影响整个行情，但中国人的面子是丢掉了！”
Their small quantities won't affect the whole market, but we Chinese will lose face!”

“那就只有一个办法，”刘不才已经把胡雪岩佩服得五体投地，认为世上没有难得倒他的麻烦，所以语气非常轻松，
Liu now admired him so completely that he thought no difficulty could defeat him. His answer was therefore quite casual. “There's only one solution.

“你调一笔头寸帮小户的忙，或者买他们的货，或者做押款，
Raise some money to help the small dealers: buy their goods or lend against them.

叫他们不要上洋人的圈套，不就完了吗？”
Keep them out of the foreigners' trap, and the problem is solved.”

胡雪岩最初的计议就是如此，
That had been Hu's original plan.

难就难在缺头寸，
The difficulty was the lack of money.

所以听了他的话，唯有报以苦笑。
He could only smile bitterly.

这一下，刘不才也看出意思来了，
Liu understood.

“老胡，”他说，“我看庞二也是吃软不吃硬的脾气，
“Old Hu, I think Pang Er responds to persuasion but resists pressure.

听见洋人这样可恶，一定不服帖，
He won't swallow such behaviour from the foreigners.

你何不跟他商量一下看？
Why not discuss it with him?

他的实力雄厚，
He has ample resources.

如果愿意照这个办法做，岂不就过关了？
If he agrees to your plan, won't that see you through?”

“话是说得不错，
True enough.

但自己有许多公私帐务，一定要有个交代，
But Hu also had many public and private accounts of his own to settle.

那又如何说法？
What was he to say about those?

这非得细细地通盘筹划一番不可。
The whole matter required careful consideration.


这天晚上，胡雪岩跟刘庆生算了一夜的帐，
That night Hu and Liu Qingsheng worked over the accounts until morning.

各处应付款项，能展期的展期，能拖一拖的拖一拖，无论如何要三十万两银子才能过关。
They extended whatever payments could be extended and postponed whatever could be postponed, but still needed three hundred thousand taels to get through the year.

而应收及可以调动的款子，不到十五万，
Receivables and funds that could be mobilised amounted to less than a hundred and fifty thousand.

头寸还缺一半，更不用说替丝商小户张罗过年的现款。
Half the required sum was still missing, even before finding year-end cash for the small silk dealers.

这就到了必须向洋商屈服的时候了。
He had reached the point of having to submit to the foreign merchants.

胡雪岩想想实在于心不甘，
The thought was intolerable.

多少时间心血花在上面，就为的是要弄成“一把抓”的优势，
So much time and effort had gone into securing the advantage of a unified grip on the business.

如今有庞二的支持，优势已经出现，
With Pang's support, that advantage was finally taking shape.

但“一把抓”抓不住，仍旧输在洋商手里，
Yet he could not maintain his grip and would still lose to the foreigners.

这是从何说起？
How could this be?

一方面不甘屈服，一方面急景调年，时不我待，胡雪岩彻夜彷徨，想不出善策。
Unwilling to yield, with the year's end fast approaching and time running out, he worried through the night without finding an answer.

急得鬓边见了白发。
Anxiety brought grey hairs to his temples.

而刘庆生却又提出警告，该付的不付，面子要弄得很难看了！
Liu Qingsheng added a warning: failure to pay what was due would look very bad.

这个警告的意味，他很了解，
Hu understood what that meant.

万一传出风声，说胡某人的周转不灵，阜康的存户纷纷的提存，
If word spread that he was short of working funds, Fukang's depositors would rush to withdraw their money.

这样一“挤兑”，雪上加霜，非倒闭不可。
Such a run would make matters worse and force the bank to close.

于是他又想到刘不才的话，
He thought again of Liu Bucai's suggestion.

觉得庞二是个可共患难的人，
Pang Er seemed a man with whom one could share adversity.

与其便宜洋商，不如便宜自己人！
Better to let one of their own profit than the foreigners.

向庞二去开口，当然是件失面子的事，然而，这是同样的道理，与其丢面子丢给洋人，倒不如丢给自己人。
Asking him for help would certainly cost face, but the same principle applied: better to lose face before one of their own.

“三爷！你陪我到湖州去一趟。”他这样跟刘不才说，
“Third Master, come with me to Huzhou,” he said.

“这一趟去要看我的运气，
“This journey will depend on my luck.

如果庞二闹家务，已经顺顺利利了结，我说话也就容易了。
If Pang's family dispute has been settled smoothly, I can speak more easily.

不然，他自己都弄得‘头盔倒挂’，我怎么还开得出口？”
If his own affairs are in a muddle, how can I open my mouth?”

“好的。”
“Very well.

刘不才说，“我看我们直接赶到南浔去吧，
I think we should go straight to Nanxun.

不必先到湖州，再走回头路就耽误工夫了。
Going to Huzhou first and then doubling back would waste time.”

“胡雪岩点点头，未置可否，
Hu nodded without committing himself.

心里在盘算杭州跟上海两方面的交代，
He was considering the arrangements needed in both Hangzhou and Shanghai.

细想一想，就是三、五天的工夫也不容易抽出来，
On reflection, even three or five days were hard to spare.

年底下的商场，虽不是瞬息万变，却往往会出意外，
Business at year-end might not change every instant, but unexpected developments were frequent.

万一有何变化，自己措手不及，岂不误了大事，
If something happened while he was unprepared, it could ruin everything.

刘不才看他踌躇不决，知道他必须坐镇在杭州，因而试探着说：“雪岩，你看是不是我代你去走一趟？”
Seeing his hesitation and understanding that he must remain in charge in Hangzhou, Liu ventured, “Xueyan, why don't I go in your place?”


这倒是个办法。
That offered a solution.

刘不才的才干，办这样一件事，可以胜任。但他还有一件事不放心，
Liu had the ability to handle such a mission, but one concern remained.

“三爷！”他说，“你去了不能露出急吼吼的样子……”
“Third Master, when you arrive, you mustn't look desperate...”

“这何消说得？”刘不才抢着说，
“Surely you don't need to tell me that!” Liu interrupted.

“我不能连这一点都不懂。”
“I understand that much.”

“不是！我还有话。”胡雪岩说，
“No, there's more.

“既然不是急如星火的事，那就可以从从容容来。
If it doesn't seem desperately urgent, there will seem to be time to spare.

大少爷的脾气，你是最明白不过的，”
You know that rich young master's temper better than anyone.”

他模拟着庞二的态度说：“ ‘好了，好了，
Imitating Pang, Hu said, “‘All right, all right.

凡事有我。
Leave everything to me.

先赌一场再说。’
Let's have a game first.’

那时候你怎么样？”
What will you do then?”

刘不才想想不错，
Liu saw the point.

这一赌下来，说不定就耽误了胡雪岩的工夫，
Once they started gambling, he might delay Hu's business.

千万赌不得！
He must not play.

“我这样跟他说：我自己在杭州还有许多事，要赶回去料理，
“I'll tell him I have a great deal to attend to in Hangzhou and must hurry back.

到年三十，我赶到南浔来，陪你好好赌几场。”
On New Year's Eve I'll come to Nanxun and play as many games as he likes.”

“对！
“Exactly.

就是这么说。”胡雪岩又郑重的加了一句：“三爷，你可不能拆我的烂污！”
Say just that.” Hu added solemnly, “Third Master, you mustn't let me down!”

“你不相信我，就不要叫我去。”
“If you don't trust me, don't send me.”

说到这话，胡雪岩不能再多提一句，
After that, Hu could say no more.

当时写了信，雇了一只船，加班添人，星夜赶到南浔去会庞二，
He wrote the letter and hired a boat, adding extra hands to speed it on its way through the night to Nanxun.

约定无论事成与否，三天以后，必定回来。
They agreed that, successful or not, Liu must return in three days.


这三天自是度日如年的光景，
Those three days naturally seemed like years.

但胡雪岩决不会独坐愁城，听天由命，
But Hu would never sit helplessly with his troubles and leave everything to fate.

他要作万一的打算，
He needed a fallback.

所以依然每天一早，坐镇阜康，不断派出人去联络试探，希望能找出一条得以筹集这笔巨款的路子来。
Each morning he took his place at Fukang and kept sending people out to make contacts and test possibilities, hoping to find some means of raising the large sum.

第一天第二天都毫无结果，
The first two days produced nothing.

到了第三天，他就有些沉不住气了，
On the third he was beginning to lose his composure.

正在攒眉苦思时，嵇鹤龄到阜康钱庄来相访，
While he sat frowning in thought, Ji Heling called at the bank.

一见面便讶然说道：“雪岩，
“Xueyan!” Ji exclaimed.

几天不见，
“It's only been a few days since I saw you.

你何以清瘦如此？”
How have you grown so thin?”

异姓手足，无需掩饰，
There was no need to conceal anything from a sworn brother.

胡雪岩老实答道：“还差三十万银子，
“I'm still three hundred thousand taels short,” Hu said frankly.

怎么不急得人瘦？”
“How could I help worrying myself thin?”

听这话，嵇鹤龄大吃一惊，
Ji was shocked.

“你怎不跟我说？
“Why didn't you tell me?

那天我问你，你不是说可以‘摆平’吗？”
When I asked the other day, didn't you say you could put everything in order?”

他带些责备语气地问。
There was reproach in his voice.

“跟你说了，害你着急，何苦？”
“What good would it do to make you anxious too?”

胡雪岩改用宽慰的语气说，
Hu adopted a reassuring tone.

“只要海运局的那笔宕帐，你能给我维持住，别的也还不要紧。”
“As long as you can keep that outstanding Sea Transport Bureau account from being pressed, the rest isn't too serious.”

怎么又说不要紧？
Not serious?

显见得他是故意叫人宽心。
Plainly he was trying to put Ji at ease.

嵇鹤龄想了想问道：“你总得想办法罗！”
After thinking a moment, Ji asked, “But you must be doing something?”

“是的。”他说了遣刘不才到南浔乞援的事，
“Yes.” Hu explained Liu's mission to Nanxun.

“我给庞二的信上说，我愿意照市价卖多少包丝给他，便宜不落外方。
“In my letter, I offered to sell Pang a quantity of silk at the current market price, so the benefit would stay among ourselves.

我这样吃亏还卸面子，他应该可以帮我这个忙。”
Since I'm accepting a loss and swallowing my pride, he ought to help.”

“年底下一下子要调动三十万的头寸，不是件容易的事。”
“Raising three hundred thousand at once at the year's end is no easy matter.”

“其实，有一半也可以过关了。”
“Actually, half would see me through.”

“十五万也不是少数。”
“A hundred and fifty thousand is no small sum either.”

嵇鹤龄招招手说，
Ji beckoned.

“你来，
“Come here.

我跟你句话。”
I have something to tell you.”


到得僻处密谈，嵇鹤龄告诉他一个消息，是裘丰言谈起的，
In a secluded spot, Ji passed on news from Qiu Fengyan.

说有个洋商走了“炮局”龚振麟、龚之棠父子的路子，
A foreign merchant had approached Gong Zhenlin of the Cannon Bureau and his son Gong Zhitang.

龚家父子又走了黄抚台三姨太的路子，决定跟洋商买一万五千支洋枪，每支三十二两银子，价款先发六成，
They in turn had approached Governor Huang's third concubine, and a purchase of fifteen thousand foreign guns had been agreed at thirty-two taels apiece, with sixty per cent paid in advance.

就在这两天要立约付款了。
The contract was to be signed and the money paid within the next day or two.

听得这个消息，胡雪岩大为诧异，
Hu was astonished.

买洋枪是他的创议，
Buying foreign guns had been his own initiative.

如果试用满意，大量购置，当然是他原经手来办，
If the trial proved satisfactory and a large purchase followed, surely he, as the original agent, should handle it.

何以中途易手，变成龚家父子居间？
Why had the business changed hands, with the Gongs acting as intermediaries?

当然，这是不用说的，其中必有花佯，
Obviously there must be some trick behind it.

胡雪岩问道：“可晓得那洋商叫什么名字？”
“Do you know the merchant's name?” he asked.

“不知道。
“No.

听说是个普鲁士人。”
I hear he's Prussian.”

“那就不是哈德逊了。”
“Then it isn't Hudson.

胡雪岩说，“这笔生意，每支枪起码有十二两的虚头，
There's at least twelve taels of padding in the price of each gun.

一万五千支枪是十八万，回扣还不算。
On fifteen thousand guns, that's a hundred and eighty thousand, before counting any commission.

这样子办公事，良心未免太黑了一点。”
Their consciences must be very black to handle public business like this.”

“这不去说它了。
“Leave that aside.

我告诉你这个消息，是提醒你想一想，这笔款子，能不能在你手里过一过，
I'm telling you so that you can consider whether the money might pass through your hands.

能够办得到，岂不是眼前的难关，可以过去？”
If that could be arranged, wouldn't it solve your immediate difficulty?”

这倒是个很新鲜的意见。
It was a fresh suggestion.

胡雪岩对任何他不曾想到的主意，都有兴趣，
Hu always took an interest in an idea that had not occurred to him.

于是扳着手指数道：“一万五千乘三十二，总价四十八万银子，
Counting on his fingers, he said, “Fifteen thousand times thirty-two makes four hundred and eighty thousand taels.

先付六成就是二十八万八，
Sixty per cent in advance is two hundred and eighty-eight thousand.

弄它一升半就差不多了。”
If I could get roughly half of that, it would be about enough.”

“你跟龚家父子认识不认识？
“Do you know the Gongs?

我倒有个朋友，跟小龚很熟，可以为你先容。”
A friend of mine knows the younger Gong well and could introduce you.”

“好极了！
“Excellent!

等我想一想。
Let me think.

这条路子一定有用的。”
This avenue is bound to be useful.”


胡雪岩略为一想，就看出了这桩交易之中的不妥之处，
A little thought revealed a weakness in the transaction.

一万五千支洋枪，是一批极惹人注目的军火，
Fifteen thousand foreign guns were a consignment of arms that would attract enormous attention.

近则上海的小刀会，远则金陵的太平军，一定都会眼红，
The Small Swords Society nearby in Shanghai and the Taiping forces farther away in Jinling would certainly covet them.

如果在上海起运，不管陆路水路，中途都难免会出纰漏。
Whether sent from Shanghai by land or water, they would be vulnerable along the route.

“怎么样能把合同打听出来就好了。”胡雪岩自语似地说，
“If only we could discover what the contract says,” Hu murmured.

“我看这件事，怕有点靠不住！”
“I suspect something isn't sound here.”

“怎么靠不住，
“Not sound?

千真万确有些事。”
The information is absolutely certain.”

“我不是说没有这件事，
“I don't doubt that the transaction exists.

是说这笔生意，怕要出乱子，龚家父子会惹极大的麻烦。”接着，胡雪岩将他的顾虑，跟嵇鹤龄细谈了一遍。
I mean it may go wrong and land the Gongs in serious trouble.” He explained his concerns.

“我懂了！”嵇鹤龄说，
“I see,” Ji said.

“症结在交货的地方，
“The crucial point is where delivery takes place.

如果是在上海交货，黄抚台得派重兵护运。
If it's Shanghai, Governor Huang will have to send a strong escort.

这倒是很麻烦的事。”
That would be troublesome.”

“有了！”
“I have it!”

胡雪岩当时便把刘庆生找了来问说：
Hu summoned Liu Qingsheng.

“抚台衙门刘二爷的节敬送了没有？”
“Have we sent Second Master Liu at the governor's yamen his festival gift?”

“还早啊！”
“It's still early.”

“要提前送了。”
“Send it ahead of time.

胡雪岩说，“我记得是每节一百两，过年二百两，
I recall it's a hundred taels at each festival and two hundred at New Year.

请你另外封四百两，连例规一起送去，
Put another four hundred in a separate envelope and send both.

说我拜托他务心帮个忙！”
Tell him I have a favour to ask and beg him to take special care.”

要刘二帮忙的，就是把合同的原底子设法抄了来。
The favour was to obtain a copy of the original draft contract.

刘二看在两个红封，总计六百两银票的面上，这个忙非帮不可，
For two red envelopes containing banknotes worth six hundred taels, Liu Er could hardly refuse.

又因为龚家父子越过他这一关，以同乡内眷，经常来往的便利，直接搭上了三姨太的线，心里原就有气，
Besides, he resented the Gongs for bypassing him. As people from the same native place, their womenfolk called frequently on the governor's household, and they had used that advantage to approach the third concubine directly.

这时猜测胡雪岩的用意。大概要动脑筋打消这笔买卖，自所乐见，
Liu guessed that Hu meant to find a way to stop the purchase, a prospect he welcomed.

格外巴结，
He was particularly obliging.

当天就用五十两银子买通了黄宗汉的娈童兼值签押房的小听差，
That same day, fifty taels bought the cooperation of Huang Zonghan's young male favourite, who also served as a junior attendant in the official signing room.

把合同的底稿偷了出来，
The attendant stole out the draft.

刘二关上民门，亲自录了个副本，神不知鬼不觉地送到了胡雪岩手里。
Liu shut the door, copied it himself, and delivered the copy to Hu in complete secrecy.


合同上写的是由船运在浙江边境交货。
The contract specified delivery by boat at the Zhejiang border.

胡雪岩倒弄不明白。
Hu was puzzled.

这个名叫鲁道夫的普鲁士人，具何神通？能够安然通过上海到嘉善的这一段水路？
What remarkable powers did this Prussian, Rudolf, possess that would let him pass safely along the waterway from Shanghai to Jiashan?

倘或中途出险，不能如约交货，又将如何？
If trouble prevented delivery, what would happen?

细看合同，果然有个绝大的漏洞，
A closer reading revealed a tremendous loophole.

这笔买卖，在卖主方面自然有保人，由上海的两家钱庄承保，但保的是“交货短少”及“货样不符”，
The seller had guarantors, two Shanghai banks, but their guarantee covered only shortages in quantity and discrepancies in specifications.

又特为规定一样：“卖方将枪支自外洋运抵上海后，禀请浙江抚台衙门委派委员，即就海关眼同检验，
There was also a special clause: “After the seller has transported the guns from overseas to Shanghai, the Zhejiang governor's yamen shall be requested to appoint commissioners to inspect them jointly at the customs house.

须验得式样数目相符，始得提领交运。”
Only after the specifications and quantities have been verified as conforming may the goods be released for onward shipment.”

看起来好象公事认真，完全为了维护买方的利益，
It looked like careful administration, wholly intended to protect the buyer.

实际上是正好为卖方脱卸责任。
In reality, it provided precisely the means for the seller to escape responsibility.

“好刀笔！”
“What skilful legal drafting!”

在一起细看合约的嵇鹤龄，书生积习，不免愤慨，
Ji, studying the contract beside him, could not suppress a scholar's indignation.

“公家办事，就是如此！
“This is how public business is done!

自作聪明，反上了别人的当。”
They think themselves clever and fall into someone else's trap.”

“恐怕不是自作聪明，是故作聪明。”胡雪岩说，
“Perhaps they're pretending to be clever,” Hu replied.

“照这个合约来看，卖方只要把洋枪运到上海，在海关经过浙江的委员眼同检验，数量式样相符，卖方就已尽了责任，
“Under this contract, once the guns reach Shanghai and the Zhejiang commissioners have verified their quantity and specifications at customs, the seller has discharged his responsibility.

如果中途遇劫，那就好比当票上的条规：”天灾人祸，与典无涉。
If they're robbed on the way, it's like the rule on a pawn ticket: ‘The pawnbroker is not liable for natural or human disasters.’

‘保人是不保兵险的。
The guarantors don't cover war risks.

真的闹将开来，洋人只要说一句：在你们中国地方被抢的。
If a dispute arises, the foreigner need only say, ‘They were stolen in your country.

你们自己不能维持地方平靖，与外人什么相干？
If you can't maintain order in your own territory, what has that to do with us?’

这话驳不到，
We couldn't refute him.

还只能捏着鼻子受他的！
We'd have to hold our noses and swallow it.”

“嵇鹤龄也是才气横溢，料事极透的人，听了胡雪岩的话，连连点头，
Ji, himself exceptionally able and perceptive, nodded repeatedly.

嘴角中现出极深沉诡秘的笑容，
A deep, cryptic smile appeared at the corners of his mouth.

眼睛不断眨动，似乎别有深奥的领悟似地。
His eyes kept blinking, as though he had reached some further understanding.


“大哥！”胡雪岩问道：“你另有看法？”
“Elder Brother, have you another thought?” Hu asked.

“我是拿你的话，进一步去想。
“I'm taking your argument a step further.

也许是‘小人之心’，但是，人家未必是君子，
Perhaps it's a base suspicion, but the others may not be honourable men.

所以我的猜测也不见得不对。”
My guess needn't be wrong.”

说了半天，到底是指什么呢？
What, after all that, did he mean?

胡雪岩有些不耐，催促着说：
Hu grew impatient.

“大哥！你快说吧，
“Tell me quickly!

这件事上，也许可以生发出什么办法来，
There may be some way forward in this.

如今时间不多了，
Time is short.

我们得要快动脑筋，快动手。”
We must think and act fast.”

于是嵇鹤龄提纲挈领的只问了一句，胡雪岩就懂了，所问这一句是：
Ji needed only one question to make his point.

“这会不会是个骗局？”
“Could it be a fraud?”

如果要行骗，根据合约来说，并不是不可能：
Under the contract, fraud was certainly possible.

洋枪运到上海关，浙江所派的委员验明了数目式样，无不相符，
The guns would reach Shanghai customs, and Zhejiang's commissioners would report the quantity and specifications correct.

但交运中途，说是遇到劫盗，意外灾祸，不负责任。
During onward shipment, the seller could claim robbery, an unforeseen calamity for which he bore no responsibility.

至于是不是真的抢走了洋枪，无可究诘，
Whether the guns had actually been stolen would be impossible to establish.

那就可以造成骗局。
That opened the way to a swindle.

倘或事先有勾结，浙江的委员虚应故事，
With collusion arranged beforehand, the commissioners might merely go through the motions.

数目既不够，式样也不符，而以“相符”禀报，
Even if the quantity were short and the specifications wrong, they could report conformity.

及至被动，亦是无可究诘，
Once the goods were said to have been stolen, investigation would be equally impossible.

这个骗局就更厉害了。
That would be an even greater fraud.

“我看，”胡雪岩毕竟是商人，迟疑着问道：“这，我看他们不至于如此大胆吧？”
Hu was, after all, a businessman. Hesitantly he said, “Surely they wouldn't dare go that far?”

“哈！”嵇鹤龄冷笑，
“Ha!” Ji sneered.

“你不知官场的龌龊！
“You don't know how filthy official life is!

事实俱在，这合约中有漏洞，
Here are the facts: there's a loophole in the contract.

人之才智，谁不如我？
Why should everyone else be less intelligent than we are?

我们一看就看出来了，
We saw it at a glance.

他们经过那么多人看，
So many people have examined it.

说是不曾看出来，其谁能信？”
Who could believe none of them noticed?”

“是的。”
“Yes.”

胡雪岩点点头，转问出一句极要紧的话：
Hu nodded, then asked the essential question.

“既然我们看出来了，该怎么办？”
“Now that we've seen it, what should we do?”

嵇鹤龄笑了，
Ji smiled.

“以你的聪明，何需问我？”
“With your intelligence, why ask me?

他说，“你定策，我看我能不能帮你的忙！”
Decide on a plan, and I'll see how I can help.”

胡雪岩觉得嵇鹤龄这个人不失为君子，
Hu thought Ji remained a gentleman.

在这样异姓手足之亲，时不我待之迫，有了机会还不肯出“坏主意”，
Even with the closeness of sworn brotherhood between them and time pressing so urgently, he would not suggest an underhanded scheme when the opportunity arose.

就算很难得了。
That was rare indeed.


“办法当然很多。”胡雪岩想了想说，
“There are plenty of ways,” Hu said after a little thought.

“光棍不断财路，
“A man of the world doesn't cut off another's livelihood.

只要他们不是行骗，生意仍旧让他们去做。
If they aren't committing fraud, let them keep the business.

不过，我觉得黄抚台不作兴这样，
Still, Governor Huang shouldn't treat me this way.

我也帮过他好些忙，买洋枪又是我开的路子，
I've helped him often enough, and I opened the way to buying foreign guns.

现在叫别人去做这笔生意，想想于心不甘。”
To see someone else given the transaction now—it's hard to accept.”

嵇鹤龄听他的话一脚进、一脚出，便知道他的意思了，
Ji understood the way Hu's words advanced and retreated.

反正只要能对他眼前的难关有帮助，他也不愿多事，
So long as the matter helped him through his immediate difficulty, he did not want further trouble.

照此宗旨替他设想，觉得有跟龚家父子开个谈判的必要。
On that basis, Ji thought they ought to negotiate with the Gongs.

“请谁去谈判呢？”胡雪岩问，
“Who should negotiate?” Hu asked.

“托你的朋友？”
“Your friend?”

“不！
“No.

这件事你我先都还不便出面，
Neither of us should appear at this stage.

叫裘丰言去！”
Send Qiu Fengyan.”

“妙！妙！”
“Excellent!”

胡雪岩抚掌称善，
Hu clapped his hands.

“我们马上找他来谈。”
“Let's get him here at once.”

于是就借嵇鹤龄的地方，由瑞云设炉置酒，叫人去请裘丰言。
They used Ji's house, where Ruiyun set out a brazier and wine, and sent for Qiu.

时已深夜，天气已冷，
It was late and cold.

裘丰言黄昏时分喝得醺醺然，早已上了床，
Having drunk himself pleasantly tipsy at dusk, Qiu had long since gone to bed.

但听说嵇、胡二人请他围炉消夜，立刻披衣起床，
But the invitation to a late supper round the brazier brought him up at once.

冒着凛冽的西北风，兴冲冲地赶到嵇家。
He dressed and hurried eagerly to Ji's through the bitter north-westerly wind.

一进门他就把“寒夜客来茶当酒”这句诗改了一下，朗然而吟：“寒夜客来酒当茶！”
On entering, he altered the poetic line “On a cold night, a guest arrives; tea takes the place of wine,” and declaimed, “On a cold night, a guest arrives; wine takes the place of tea!”

不但嵇鹤龄和胡雪岩相视莞尔，
Ji and Hu exchanged smiles.

连隔室的瑞云都笑了，
Even Ruiyun in the next room laughed.

只见小丫头把门帘一掀，她一手提个酒瓶，一手提把酒壶，
A little maid lifted the door curtain, and Ruiyun appeared with a bottle in one hand and a wine pot in the other.

扬一扬笑道：“裘老爷，有的是酒，
Raising them, she said, “Mr Qiu, there's plenty!

中国酒、外国酒都有，你尽管喝！”
Chinese wine and foreign wine—drink all you please!”


“多谢如嫂夫人！”
“My thanks, Madam!”

裘丰言兜头一揖，然后接过一瓶白兰地，拔开寒头，先就嘴对嘴喝了一口。
Qiu bowed deeply, took a bottle of brandy, pulled out the stopper, and drank straight from its mouth.

这一下惹得瑞云又笑，
Ruiyun laughed again.

“裘老爷喝酒倒省事，”她说，
“Mr Qiu makes drinking so easy.

“用不着备菜！”
There's no need to prepare food!”

“这话在别处可以这么说，在府上我就不肯这么说了。”
“You might say that elsewhere, but I won't let you say it here.”

“为什么呢？”
“Why not?”

“说了是我的损失。
“Because I'd lose by it.

说句不怕人见笑的话，我这几天想吃府上的响螺跟红糟鸡，想得流涎不止。”
At the risk of being laughed at, I've spent the last few days positively drooling over the thought of your sea conch and chicken in red wine lees.”

“那真正是裘老爷的口福，
“Then you are fortunate.

今天正好有这两样东西。”
We happen to have both today.”

瑞云笑道，
She smiled.

“不过，不好意思拿出来待客，
“Only I'm ashamed to serve them to guests.

因为吃残了！”
They've already been eaten from.”

“怕什么，怕什么！
“What does that matter?

来到府上，我就象回到舍下，
Coming here is like coming home.

没有说嫌自己家里的东西吃残的。”
Nobody objects to leftovers in his own house.”

于是瑞云将现成的菜，办了一个火锅、四只碟子为他们主客三人消夜，
Using what was ready, Ruiyun prepared a hotpot and four small dishes for the three men's supper.

嵇鹤龄一面劝酒，一面为裘丰言谈那张购枪合同的毛病。
As Ji urged Qiu to drink, he explained the faults in the gun contract.

他虽未提到胡雪岩，而有了几分酒意，并且一向与胡雪岩交好的裘丰言却很替他不平。
Though he said nothing of Hu, Qiu, already a little tipsy and always friendly towards him, felt indignant on his behalf.

“是可忍，孰不可忍！
“If this can be tolerated, what cannot?

这件事非得好好评理不可。”
We must have the rights and wrongs of this properly argued!”


“少安毋躁！”
“Calm yourself.”

嵇鹤龄拉着他的手说，
Ji took his hand.

“今天请你来就是要跟你商量个打抱不平的办法。
“We invited you precisely to discuss how to put this injustice right.

毛病捉住了，但‘没有金刚钻，不揽碎瓷器’，
We've found the weakness, but you don't undertake to mend porcelain without a diamond drill.

龚家父子也不是好相与的人，
The Gongs aren't easy men to deal with.

这件事还得平心静气来谈。”
We must discuss it calmly.”

“好，好！”
“Very well!”

裘丰言喝口酒，夹块红糟鸡放在口中咀嚼着，含含糊糊他说，“有你们两位在，没有我的主意，
Qiu drank, put a piece of chicken in his mouth, and said indistinctly as he chewed, “With you two here, I've no opinion to offer.

你们商量，
You discuss it.

我喝着酒听。”
I'll drink and listen.”

嵇胡两人对看一眼，
Ji and Hu exchanged a glance.

都觉得老实人也不易对付，
Even an honest fellow could be hard to manage.

他们原先有过约定，预备一搭一档，旁敲侧击，让裘丰言自告奋勇，
They had planned to play off one another, approaching the matter indirectly until Qiu volunteered.

现在他是“唯君所命”的态度，说话就不能再绕圈子，否则便显得不够朋友，
Now that he was placing himself entirely at their disposal, further circumlocution would be unfriendly.

所以反觉得为难。
It left them in an awkward position.

当然，还是得嵇鹤龄开口，
Naturally Ji had to speak.

他想了一下看着胡雪岩说：
After a moment's thought, he looked at Hu.

“做倒有个做法，比较厉害，
“There is one rather forceful approach.

不过盘马弯弓，
But it's a matter of drawing the bow and holding the threat.

不能收立竿见影之效。”
It won't produce an immediate result.”

“不管它！
“Never mind.

你先说你的。”
Tell us.”

“我想，老裘办过一回提运洋枪的差使，也可以说是内行，
“Qiu has already handled the collection and transport of foreign guns, so he can claim experience.

不妨上他一个说帖，就说有英商接头，愿意卖枪给浙江，条件完全跟他们一佯，就是价钱便宜，每支只要二十五两银子。
He might submit a memorandum saying that a British merchant has approached him and is willing to sell guns to Zhejiang on exactly the same terms, but at only twenty-five taels apiece.

看他们怎么说？”
Let's see what they say.”

“此计大妙！”
“An excellent plan!”

说不开口的裘丰言，到底忍不住开口，
Qiu, despite his promise of silence, could not contain himself.

“有此说帖，黄抚台就不能包庇了，
“With that memorandum before him, Governor Huang couldn't shield them.

不然言官参上一本，朝廷派大员密查，
Otherwise a censor might impeach him and the court send a high official to investigate secretly.

我来出头，看他如何搪塞？”
I'd come forward then and see how he explained himself!”

“不至于到此地步。
“It won't go that far.

这个说帖一上，龚家父子一定会来找你说话，
Once the memorandum is submitted, the Gongs are certain to approach you.

那时就有得谈了。”
Then there'll be something to discuss.”

嵇鹤龄转眼看着胡雪岩说，
Ji turned to Hu.

“有好处也在年后。”
“Any benefit will come after the New Year.”

裘丰言不明用意，接口又说：“年后就年后，
Not understanding the purpose, Qiu said, “After the New Year, then!

反正不多几天就过年了。”
It's only a few days away.”

嵇鹤龄听得这话，慢慢抬眼看着胡雪岩，是征询及催促的眼色，意思是让他对裘丰言有所表白。
Ji slowly raised his eyes to Hu, questioning and prompting him to make some explanation.

胡雪岩会意，但不想说破真意，
Hu understood but did not want to reveal his real purpose.

因为这对袭丰言无用，
It would do no good with Qiu.

此人样样都好，就是办到正事，头绪不能太多，
An excellent fellow in other ways, he could not manage too many threads in serious business.

跟他说了他也许反嫌麻烦，答一句：“长话短说，
If told, he might only find it troublesome and say, “Make it short!

我记不住那么多！”
I can't remember all that.”

岂不是自己找钉子碰？
Why invite a rebuff?

因此，胡雪岩只这样说，“不管什么时候收效，这件事对老裘有益无害，
Hu therefore said only, “Whenever it produces results, this can only benefit Qiu.

我看先上了说帖再作道理。”
Let's submit it first and see.”

“那也好。”
“Very well.”

嵇鹤龄转脸问道：
Ji turned back.

“老裘，你看怎么样？”
“What do you think?”


“除却酒杯莫问我！”醉眼迷离的裘丰言，答了这样一句诗样的话，一只手又去抓酒瓶。
“Ask me nothing beyond the wine cup!” Qiu answered in something like a line of verse, his drunken eyes misty as he reached again for the bottle.

“你不能喝了！”
“No more!”

嵇鹤龄夺住他的手，
Ji caught his hand.

“要办正事就不能喝醉。
“You mustn't get drunk when there's work to do.

等办完了事，我让你带一瓶回去。”
Once it's finished, I'll give you a bottle to take home.”

裘丰言恋恋不舍的松了手，
Reluctantly Qiu let go.

瑞云在隔室很见机，立刻进来收拾残肴剩酒，
Ruiyun, alert to the situation from the next room, promptly cleared away the remaining food and wine.

另外端来一锅“烧鸭壳子”熬的粥，四样吃粥小菜。
She brought a pot of rice gruel simmered with a roast-duck carcass and four accompaniments.

裘丰言就着象牙色的“冬腌菜”，连吃三碗，
With ivory-coloured winter-pickled vegetables, Qiu ate three bowls.

“好舒服！”他摸着肚子说：
“How comfortable!” he said, rubbing his stomach.

“酒醉饭饱，该办正事了。
“Full of wine and food—now for business.

是不是拟说帖？
Are we drafting the memorandum?”

““对了！”
“Exactly.

嵇鹤龄问道：“你还能动笔不能？”
Can you still wield a brush?”

“有何不能，
“Why not?

‘太白斗酒诗百篇’，
‘A measure of wine, a hundred poems from Li Bai.’

何况平铺直叙一说帖？”
Surely I can manage one plain memorandum!”

“那好！
“Good.

你先喝着茶，抽两袋烟休息。我跟雪岩商量一下。”
Have some tea, smoke a couple of pipes, and rest while Xueyan and I discuss it.”

于是两个人移坐窗前，悄悄的商议，
They moved to the window and spoke quietly.

因为有些话不便当着裘丰言说，
Some things could not be said before Qiu.

首先就要考虑他个人的利害。
First they must consider the consequences for him personally.


“这个说帖一上，黄抚台自然把裘丰言恨得牙痒，
“Once the memorandum goes in, Governor Huang will hate Qiu.

将来或许会有吃亏的时候，
He may suffer for it later.

我们做朋友的，不能不替他想到。”
As his friends, we must consider that.”

“这当然要顾虑。
“Of course.

不过，大哥，我跟你的看法有点西洋，
But, Elder Brother, I see it a little differently.

黄抚台这个人，向来敬酒不吃吃罚酒，
Governor Huang has always responded to pressure better than courtesy.

说不定这一来反倒对老裘另眼相看。”
This might even make him regard Qiu with new respect.”

嵇鹤龄想了想说：
Ji reflected.

“这一层暂且不管，
“Leave that aside for now.

只是这个说帖，要弄得象真的一样才好。”
The memorandum must at least look genuine.”

“本来就要有这个打算。
“We must be prepared to make it genuine.

真的这笔生意能够拿过来，二十五两银子一支一定可以买得到，而且包定有钱赚。”
If we actually take over the transaction, we can certainly supply guns at twenty-five taels each and still make a profit.”

等这一点弄明白了，说帖便不难拟，
Once that was clear, drafting was easy.

移砚向灯，
They moved the inkstone towards the lamp.

他们两个人斟酌着一条一条地说，裘丰言便一条一条地写。
Ji and Hu considered each point and dictated it, and Qiu wrote each one down.

写完再从头斟酌，作成定稿，
Then they reviewed the whole and settled on a final text.

说好由裘丰言找人去分缮三份，一份送抚台，一份送藩台。
Qiu would have three fair copies made, one for the governor and one for the provincial treasurer.

这件事明天上午就得去妥。
This must be done the next morning.

“好！
“Very well.

这都归我。
Leave all that to me.

现在问下一步，说帖送了上去，黄抚台要找我，我该怎么说？”
Now, the next step: once it's submitted, what should I say if Governor Huang sends for me?”

“黄抚台不会找你！”嵇鹤龄极有把握地答道：
“He won't,” Ji replied with complete confidence.

“要找一定是龚家父子来找你。”
“It will be the Gongs who come.”

“那总也要有话说啊！”
“I still need something to say.”

“这不忙！
“There's no hurry.

他来找你，你来找我。”
When they come to you, come to me.”

“等我来找你，你的‘过年东道’就有着落了。”
“By the time I come to you, your New Year expenses will be provided for,” Hu added.

胡雪岩觉得这话不妥，因而紧接着笑道，
Feeling this was ill-judged, he immediately laughed.

“这是我说笑话，
“I'm joking.

不管怎么样，你今年过年不必发愁，
Whatever happens, don't worry about this New Year.

一切有我！”
Leave everything to me!”

“多谢，多谢！”
“Thank you, thank you!”

裘丰言满脸是笑，
Qiu beamed.

“说实话，交上你们两位朋友，我本来就不用愁。”
“To tell the truth, with friends like you two, I had no need to worry anyway.”

说到这里，裘丰言站起身来告辞，
He rose to leave.

胡雪岩亦不再留，一起离了槛家，
Hu did not detain him and left Ji's house with him.

约定第二天晚饭时分，不管消息如何，仍在嵇家碰头。
They agreed to meet there again at supper the following evening, whether there was news or not.


裘丰言感于知遇，特别实力，
Moved by their appreciation, Qiu exerted himself unusually hard.

回家以后，就不再睡，
Back home, he did not return to bed.

好在洋酒容易发散，
Fortunately, the effects of the foreign liquor wore off readily.

洗过一把脸，喝过两杯浓茶，神思便已清醒，
After washing his face and drinking two cups of strong tea, he felt clear-headed.

于是挑灯磨墨，决定把这通说帖抄好了它，一早“上院”去递。
He trimmed the lamp, rubbed the ink, and resolved to copy the memorandum properly so that he could take it to the governor's yamen first thing in the morning.

这一番折腾，把他的胖太太吵得不能安眠，
His activity disturbed his stout wife's sleep.

“死鬼！她在帐子里”娇嗔“：”
“You wretch!” she scolded affectionately from behind the bed curtains.

半夜三更，又是这么冷的天气，不死到床上来，
“In the middle of the night, in weather this cold, why don't you drag yourself to bed?

在搞啥鬼！
What are you up to?”

“你睡你的，
“Go back to sleep.

我有公事。”
I have official business.”

这真是新闻了，
This was news indeed.

裘丰言一天到晚无事忙，从未动笔办过公。事，而况又是如此深宵，说有公事，岂非奇谈！
Qiu spent his days being busy about nothing and had never put brush to paper on official work. To claim it at such an hour was extraordinary.

“你骗鬼！
“Tell that to the ghosts!

什么公事？
What official business?

一定又是搞什么‘花样’，穷开心！”胖太太又说，
You're playing some foolish trick for amusement again.

“快过年了，
New Year's nearly here.

也不动动脑筋，
Think about that!

看你年三十怎么过？”
How are you going to get through New Year's Eve?”

“就是为了年三十好过关，不能不拼老命。
“It's precisely to get through it that I'm working myself to death.

你少跟我罗嗦，
Stop bothering me.

我早早弄完了，还要上院。”
Once I finish, I still have to go to the governor's yamen.”

听说上院，就决不是搞什么“花样”，
That could hardly be a prank.

胖太太一则有些不信，二则也舍不得“老伴”一个人“拼老命”，于是从床上起身，
Half disbelieving, and unwilling to let her old companion work himself to death alone, she rose and came over.

走来一看，白折子封面写着“说帖”二字，这才相信他真的是在忙公事。
Seeing “Memorandum” on the cover of the plain folded paper, she finally believed him.

“你去睡嘛！”裘丰言搓一搓手说，
“Go to bed,” he said, rubbing his hands.

“何苦陪在这里受冻。”
“Why stand here freezing with me?”

“你在这里办公事，我一个人怎么睡得着？”
“How could I sleep alone while you're doing official work?”

听得这话，裘丰言的骨头奇轻，
Her words made him feel delightfully light.

伸手到她的脸上，将她那象泻粉似的皮肉轻轻拧了一把，然后提起笔来，埋头疾书。
He reached out and gently pinched her cheek, soft as starch paste, then took up his brush and wrote rapidly with his head bent.

他的一笔小楷，又快又好，
His small regular script was both swift and elegant.

抄完不过五更时分，
He finished by the fifth watch.

胖太太劝他先睡一会，裘丰言不肯，
His wife urged him to sleep a little, but he refused.

吃过一杯早酒，挡挡寒气，趁着酒兴，步行到了巡抚衙门，找着刘二，道明来意。
After an early cup of liquor to keep out the cold, he walked, fortified by it, to the governor's yamen, found Liu Er, and explained his errand.


由于裘丰言为人和气，所以人缘极好，
Qiu's amiability made him well liked.

刘二跟他是开玩笑惯了的，把“裘老爷”叫成：“舅老爷！”
Liu Er was accustomed to joking with him, punning on “Master Qiu” by calling him “Uncle.”

他笑着说道，“已经冬天了，
“It's winter already,” he laughed.

‘秋风’早就过去了，
“The autumn wind has long passed.

你这两个说帖没得用！”
These two memoranda of yours won't do any good!”

“难道上说帖就是想打秋风？”裘丰言答道：
“Does submitting a memorandum always mean coming to cadge money?

“今年还没有找过你的麻烦，
I haven't troubled you once this year.

这件事无论如何要帮我的忙。”
You must help me this time.”

“怎么帮法？”
“How?”

“马上送到抚台手里，不但送到，还要请他老人家马上就看。”
“Put it into the governor's hands at once—and ask him to read it at once too.”

“有这么紧要？”
“Is it that urgent?”

刘二倒怀疑了，
Liu was doubtful.

“什么事，你先跟我说一说。”
“Tell me what it's about first.”

裘丰言已听嵇鹤龄和胡雪岩谈过，知道刘二对龚家父子亦颇不满，
From Ji and Hu, Qiu knew that Liu resented the Gongs.

心想，这件事不必瞒他，
There was no need to conceal this from him.

便招一招手把他拉到僻处，悄悄说道：“我有个户头要推销洋枪，
He beckoned him aside and whispered, “I have a client who wants to sell foreign guns.

这件事成功了，回扣当然有你一份。”
If it succeeds, there'll naturally be a share of the commission for you.”

“推销洋枪！”
“Foreign guns!”

刘二细想一想，从裘丰言跟胡雪岩的关系上去猜测，就知道了是怎么回事？
Thinking it over and taking Qiu's connection with Hu into account, Liu understood.

便毫不迟疑地答道：“我有数了。
He answered without hesitation, “I see.

倘有信息送哪里？”
Where shall I send word if there's news?”

这句话把裘丰言问住了，
That stumped Qiu.

他得先想一想，是什么“信息”？
What sort of news?

如果是黄抚台的约见，则嵇鹤龄已经说过，不会有这样的情形。
If it meant a summons from Governor Huang, Ji had said none would come.

看起来，这个推断还是不确，得要预备一下。
Perhaps the prediction was uncertain after all, and he ought to prepare.

“你是说抚台会找我？”裘丰言想了想答道，
“You mean the governor might send for me?” he asked after a moment.

“你寻我不易，
“I'm hard to find.

这样吧，我下午再来一趟。”
I'll come again this afternoon.”

“也好！
“Very well.

如果有信息，而我又不在，必定留下信，
If there's news and I'm out, I'll leave a message.

否则就是没有消息，你请回好了。”
If there's none, you can go home.”

这样约定以后，裘丰言方始回家补觉，
With that settled, Qiu returned to make up his lost sleep.

一睡睡到午后两点才醒，只见胖太太递给他一封信，是胡雪岩写来的，约他下午三点在阜康钱庄见面。
He did not wake until two in the afternoon, when his wife handed him a letter from Hu asking him to come to Fukang at three.

原来说好了，晚上仍旧在嵇家相会，
They had agreed to meet at Ji's that evening.

如今提前约晤，必有缘故。
There must be a reason for the earlier appointment.

裘丰言不敢怠慢，匆匆漱洗，出门赴约。
Qiu hurriedly washed, rinsed his mouth, and went out.


一到阜康钱庄，头一个就遇见陈世龙，彼此是熟识的，
The first person he met at Fukang was Chen Shilong, an old acquaintance.

寒暄了几句，去见胡雪岩，只见他神采焕发，喜气洋洋，
After a few words of greeting, he went to Hu and found him looking radiant and delighted.

不由得诧异：“咦！
“Well!” Qiu exclaimed.

你今天象个新郎官！”
“You look like a bridegroom today!”

胡雪岩笑一笑，不理他的话，只问：“那东西递上去了？”
Hu smiled, ignored the remark, and asked only, “Has that thing been submitted?”

“昨天晚上回去……”
“When I got home last night...”

他倒也不是“丑表功”，只要说明替好朋友办事的诚意，所以把整个经过情形讲了一遍。
Qiu described the whole business, with no intention of boasting, simply to show how sincerely he had worked for his friends.

“好极！
“Excellent!

事缓则圆。
Matters settle better when we take our time.

回头你就再辛苦一趟，看看有什么信息，
Trouble yourself to go once more and see whether there's news.

打听过了，晚上我们在嵇家喝酒。”
After that, we'll drink at Ji's this evening.”

“好，好，
“Certainly.

我这就去。”
I'll go now.

裘丰言又问，“不过有件事我不明白，
But there's something I don't understand.

你特为约我此刻见面，就是问这句话？”
Did you specially ask me here now just to ask that?”

“是的！
“Yes.

我的意思，怕你说帖还不曾送出去，就摆一摆，等我到了上海，把那个普鲁士人的底细摸清楚了再说。
If you hadn't sent it in, I meant to hold it back until I'd been to Shanghai and learned more about that Prussian.

既然已送了出去，那也很好。”
Since it's already gone, that's fine too.”

这一说裘丰言更为困惑，
Qiu was more puzzled.

“怎么，一下子想到要去上海？”他问：
“Why this sudden thought of Shanghai?

“哪天动身？”
When are you leaving?”

“日子还没有定，总在这两天。
“No date is fixed, but within the next day or two.

喔，”
Oh!”

胡雪岩想起一件事，从口袋里取出一个红封袋，塞到裘丰言手里，笑着说道，
Remembering something, Hu took a red envelope from his pocket and pushed it into Qiu's hand.

“赶快回去跟你胖太太交帐，好让她早早筹划打年货！”
“Hurry home and report to your stout wife, so she can start buying for the New Year.”

裘丰言抽开封套看，是一张四百两银子的银票，
Qiu opened it and found a banknote for four hundred taels.

心里愧感交集，眼圈有些发红。
Gratitude mingled with a sense of unworthiness, and his eyes reddened.

胡雪岩不肯让他说出什么来，
Hu would not let him say anything.

推着他说：“请吧，请吧，
Gently urging him away, he said, “Off you go!

我不留你了，
I won't keep you.

回头嵇家见。”
See you at Ji's later.”


陈世龙的不速而至，在胡雪岩颇感意外，但说穿了就不希奇，是刘不才“抓差”。
Chen's unexpected arrival had surprised Hu, but the explanation was simple: Liu Bucai had pressed him into service.

到庞家的交涉，还算顺利，主要的还是靠胡雪岩自己，
Negotiations at the Pang household had gone fairly smoothly, largely because of Hu's own earlier efforts.

由于他那两封信，王有龄对庞二自然另眼相看。嘱咐刑名老夫子替他们调解争产的纠纷。
His two letters had naturally led Wang Youling to treat Pang with special consideration and instruct his legal secretary to mediate the inheritance dispute.

原告是庞二的一个远房叔叔，看见知府出面调停，知道这场这司打下去得不到便宜，
The plaintiff, a distant uncle of Pang's, saw that with the prefect intervening, continuing the lawsuit would bring him no advantage.

那时“敬酒不吃吃罚酒”，未免不智，所以愿意接受调解。
It would be foolish to reject a cup offered courteously only to drink one imposed as punishment, so he accepted mediation.

庞二早就有过表示。花几个钱不在乎，能够不打官司不上堂，
Pang had already said that he did not mind spending a little, provided he could avoid litigation and appearing in court.

心里就安逸了。
That would put his mind at rest.

因此，看了胡雪岩的信，听了刘不才的叙述，一口答应帮忙。
After reading Hu's letter and hearing Liu's explanation, he agreed at once to help.

只是年近岁逼，人又在南浔，一下子要凑一大笔现银出来，倒也有些吃力。
But with the year's end so close, and himself in Nanxun, assembling a large sum in cash immediately was difficult.

“我来想办法！
“I'll find a way.

一定可以想得出。
I certainly will!

你就不必管了，
Don't trouble yourself.

先玩一玩再说。”
Let's enjoy a game first.”

果然是胡雪岩预先猜到的情形出现了，
Exactly as Hu had predicted.

刘不才心想，如果辞谢，必惹庞二不快，说不定好事就会变卦，
Liu thought that refusal would offend Pang and might undo the good result.

但坐下来先赌一场，又耽误了胡雪岩的正事。
Yet sitting down to gamble would delay Hu's business.

灵机一动，想到个两全其美的办法。
Then he hit upon a way to satisfy both.

“庞二哥，我受人之托，要忠人之事，
“Brother Pang, I've been entrusted with something and must see it through.

本来应该赶回去，
I ought to hurry back.

不过你留我陪着你玩，我也实在舍不得走。
But since you want me to stay and play, I'm reluctant to leave too.

要玩玩个痛快，不要叫我牵肠挂肚。
Let me enjoy it properly, without something weighing on my mind.

这样，”
How about this...”

他略作沉吟之态，然后用那种事事不无可疑，非如此办不可的语气说：
He paused as though considering, then spoke as though nothing could be taken on trust and this was the only arrangement that would do.

“庞二哥，你把雪岩托你的事筹划好，我到湖州找个人回去送信！”
“Settle what Xueyan asked you to do, and I'll get someone from Huzhou to take the news back!”

“好！”庞二很爽快地答应，
“Good!” Pang agreed readily.

“你坐一下，
“Sit here.

我到帐房里去问一问看。”
I'll ask in the counting house.”

他一走，刘不才也不愿白耽误工夫，
Liu would not waste time while he was away.

立刻就写了一封信，请庞家派个人到湖州，把陈世龙找来待命。
He wrote at once and asked the Pang household to send someone to Huzhou for Chen Shilong, who was to come and await instructions.


“家里倒有点现银，过年要留着做赌本，也防着穷朋友穷亲戚来告贷，不能给老胡。”庞二说道，
“There is some silver in the house,” Pang said, “but I must keep it for New Year gambling and for poor friends and relations who come to borrow. I can't give that to Old Hu.

“我在上海有好几十万帐好收，
I have several hundred thousand owing to me in Shanghai.

划出二十五万给老胡，不过要他自己去收，
I'll assign him two hundred and fifty thousand, but he'll have to collect it himself.

有两笔帐或许收不到，
Two debts may prove uncollectable.

看他自己的本事。”
That will depend on his ability.”

“好的，好的！”
“Excellent!”

刘不才觉得有此结果，大可满足、
Liu was thoroughly satisfied.

“你帮雪岩这么一个大忙，我代表他谢谢。
“On his behalf, thank you for such a great favour.

不过，这笔款子，怎么算法，
But how is this money to be treated?

你是要货色，还是怎么样？
Do you want goods for it, or something else?

请吩咐了，我好通知雪岩照办。”
Tell me so that I can notify Xueyan.”

“要什么货色？
“What goods?

算我借给老胡的，
It's a loan.

等他把那票丝脱手了还我。”
He can repay me when he's sold that consignment of silk.”

“是！
“Yes.

那么，利息呢？”
And the interest?”

“免息！”
“None!”

“这不好意思吧……”
“Surely that's too much to ask...”

刘不才迟疑着。
Liu hesitated.

“老刘！”庞二放低了声音，“我跟你投缘，说老实话吧，
Pang lowered his voice. “Old Liu, we get on well, so I'll speak frankly.

其中有两笔帐，大概七八万银子上下，不大好收。
Two of those debts, amounting to perhaps seventy or eighty thousand, will be hard to collect.

听好老胡跟松漕帮的尤老五，交情很够，
I hear Old Hu is very close to You Laowu of the Songjiang Grain Transport Brotherhood.

这两笔帐托尤老五去收，虽不能十足回笼，七成帐是有的。
If he asks You to collect them, we should recover seventy per cent, even if we can't get it all.

能够这样，我已经承情不尽，
I'd be deeply grateful for that.

尤老五那里，我自然另有谢意，
I'll thank You separately, of course.

这都等我跟老胡见了面再谈。”
I'll discuss it all with Hu when we meet.”



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第二十章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Twenty, concluding part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


陈世龙非常巴结，
Chen Shilong was eager to oblige.

接信立刻到南浔。
The moment he received the letter, he went to Nanxun.

刘不才已经在牌九桌上了，抽不出空写信，
Liu Bucai was already at the pai gow table and could spare no time to write.

把他找到一边，连话带庞二的收帐凭证，一一交代明白，
Drawing Chen aside, he explained everything, gave him Pang Er's documents authorizing collection of the debts, and made sure he understood every detail.

陈世龙随即坐了刘不才包雇的快船，连夜赶到杭州。
Chen then took the fast boat Liu had hired and travelled through the night to Hangzhou.

胡雪岩一块石头落地。
A weight lifted from Hu Xueyan's heart.

不过事情也还相当麻烦，非得亲自到上海去一趟不可，而杭州还有杂条要料理。
Yet matters were still complicated enough to require a journey to Shanghai, while miscellaneous business in Hangzhou also needed his attention.

尤其是意外发现的买洋枪这件事，
The unexpected discovery of the foreign gun transaction was a particular concern.

搞得好是笔大生意，由此跟洋人进一步的交往，对他的丝生意也有帮助，
Properly handled, it could become a substantial piece of business, and closer dealings with the foreigners would help his silk trade.

而搞不好则会得罪了黄抚台和龚家父子，
Handled badly, it could offend Governor Huang and the Gongs.

倘或迁怒到王有龄和嵇鹤龄身上，关系甚重，
If their resentment spread to Wang Youling and Ji Heling, the consequences would be grave.

更加放不下心。
He could hardly leave it unattended.

看他左右为难，陈世龙便自告奋勇：
Seeing his dilemma, Chen volunteered.

“胡先生！”他说，“如果我能办得了，就让我去一趟好了。”
“Mr Hu, if it's something I can manage, let me make the journey.”

胡雪岩想了想，
Hu considered this.

这倒也是个办法，
It was a possible solution.

“你一个是办不了的，
“You couldn't do it alone.

要托尤五！”
You'll have to ask You Laowu.”

他断然决然的作了决定：“你先到松江，
His decision made, he continued firmly, “Go to Songjiang first.

无论如何要拖着他在一起。
Whatever happens, get him to stay with you and help.

其余的事，我托老古。”
I'll entrust the other business to Old Gu.”

于是整整谈了一晚上，指点得明明白白。
They talked throughout the evening, until Hu had made every instruction clear.

第二天一早，陈世龙就动身走了。
Chen left early the next morning.

就在这天，裘丰言所上的说帖有了反应，
That same day, Qiu Fengyan's memorandum produced a response.

一大早便有一顶蓝呢大轿，抬到裘家门口，
Early in the morning, a large sedan chair covered in blue woollen cloth arrived outside Qiu's house.

跟班在拜匣里取了张名帖，投到裘家“门上”。
An attendant took a visiting card from his card case and handed it to the doorkeeper.


看门的是早就受了嘱咐，
The doorkeeper had already been instructed.

一看帖子便回说主人出门了，其实裘丰言刚刚起身。
One glance at the card, and he replied that his master was out, although Qiu had only just risen.

客是走了，名帖却留了下来，是炮局坐办龚振麟来拜访过了。
The visitor left, but his card remained: Gong Zhenlin, executive director of the Cannon Bureau, had called.

裘丰言大为兴奋，一直赶到阜康钱庄，
Highly excited, Qiu hurried straight to Fukang Bank.

见了胡雪岩就说：“鹤龄好准的阴阳八卦！
“Heling reads the signs like a master diviner!” he told Hu.

你看，老龚果然移樽就教来了。”
“Look—the elder Gong has come to seek my counsel, just as he predicted.”

“你见了他没有？”
“Did you see him?”

“自然不见。
“Of course not.

一见便万事全休，
One meeting would have ruined everything.

他要一问，我什么也不知道，
If he had asked me anything, I wouldn't have known what to say.

真正是‘若要盘驳，性命交脱’！”
Truly, ‘Let them question me, and my life is forfeit!’”

“没有那样子不得了，
“It isn't as terrible as all that.

你别害怕。
Don't be frightened.

走，我们到鹤龄那里去。”
Come, let's go to Heling's.”

海运局年底清闲无事，嵇鹤龄在家纳福，
There was little to do at the Sea Transport Bureau at the end of the year, so Ji was enjoying a quiet time at home.

冬日晴窗之下，正在教小儿子认字号。
Seated by a sunny window on this winter day, he was teaching his little son to recognize characters.

看到裘丰言的脸色，便即笑道：
At the sight of Qiu's expression, he smiled.

“必是有消息了。”
“There must be news.”

“是啊！”
“Indeed there is!

裘丰言答道：“一路上我在嘀咕，
All the way here I've been worrying.

从来不曾干过这种‘戳空枪’的把戏，
I've never tried a bluff like this before.

不知道应付得下来不能？”
I don't know whether I can carry it off.”

他担心的是本无其事，亦无其人，
His concern was that neither the proposed transaction nor the supposed merchant behind it actually existed.

问到洋人在何处，先就难得回答。
A question about the foreigner's whereabouts would be enough to put him in difficulty.

然而在胡雪岩和嵇鹤龄策划之下，也很容易应付，
Under Hu and Ji's guidance, however, this was easy enough to manage.

细细教了他一套话。裘丰言才真的有了笑容。
They carefully coached him in what to say, and at last a real smile appeared on his face.


“我要去回拜，
“I must return his call.

得借你的轿子和贵管家一用。”
I'll need to borrow your chair and your steward.”

“不好！”嵇鹤龄未置可否，胡雪岩先就表示异议，
Ji had yet to answer when Hu objected. “No!

“那一下就露马脚了。”
That would give the game away.”

“不错，不错！
“Quite right, quite right.

不要紧，
Never mind.

我可以将就。”
I'll manage.”

裘丰言朋友也很多，
Qiu had plenty of friends himself.

另借一顶轿子，拿他的门上充跟班，将就着到炮局去回拜，
He borrowed a chair elsewhere, took his own doorkeeper along as an attendant, and thus equipped went to return the call at the Cannon Bureau.

名帖一递进去，龚振麟开中门迎接。
As soon as his card was presented, Gong Zhenlin opened the main gate to receive him.

他家就住在炮局后面，
Gong's home lay behind the bureau.

为示亲切，延入私第，先叫他儿子龚之棠来拜见，
To show his friendliness, he conducted Qiu into his private quarters and first summoned his son, Gong Zhitang, to pay his respects.

一口一个“老伯”，异常恭敬。
The young man addressed Qiu repeatedly as “Uncle” and behaved with the greatest deference.

“丰言兄，久仰你的‘酒中仙’，
“Brother Fengyan, I've long admired your fame as an immortal of the wine cup.

我也是一向贪杯，颇有佳酿，
I'm fond of a drink myself and have some excellent vintages.

今天酒逢知己，不醉无归。”
Now that two kindred drinkers have met, you mustn't leave sober.”

“一定要叨扰，未免不成话！”
“I really ought not to impose on you like this!”

“老兄说这话就见外了。”龚振麟嘱咐儿子：“你去看看裘老伯的管家在哪里？
“You're treating me as a stranger.” Gong told his son, “Go and see where Uncle Qiu's steward is.

把衣包取了来。”
Have his bundle of clothes brought in.”

“不必，不必！”裘丰言说，
“No need, no need.
