“Your wife and I have discussed it.

媳妇不是不明事理的人，
She is a reasonable woman.

我做婆婆的，自然要依从她的打算。
As her mother-in-law, naturally I should follow her plan.”

““她是怎么样打算？”
“What is her plan?”

“你先不要问。”
“Don’t ask yet.”

胡老太太笑道，
His mother smiled.

“总于你有好处就是了。”
“It will be to your benefit.”

胡雪岩猜不透她们婆媳葫芦里卖的是什么药，也就只好暂且丢开。
Unable to guess what the two women were plotting, Hu could only leave the matter for the time being.


第二天在家请过了春酒。
The next day they gave the family New Year dinner.

胡太太便带着八岁的小女儿，雇了一只专船回塘栖，
Then Mrs Hu took her younger daughter, aged eight, and hired a boat for the journey to Tangqi.

这一去只去了五天，正月十一回杭州。
She was away only five days, returning to Hangzhou on the eleventh of the first month.

他们夫妇感情本来不坏，
The couple’s relationship had always been fairly good.

虽然略有龃龋，经此小别，似乎各已忘怀，仍旧高高兴兴地有说有笑。
After this short separation, their slight disagreement seemed forgotten, and they laughed and talked happily as before.

胡雪岩打算正月十四动身，所以胡太太一到家，使得替丈夫打点行李，
Hu intended to leave on the fourteenth, so as soon as his wife returned she had to pack for him.

他个人的行李不多，
He needed little personal luggage.

多的是带到松江、上海去送人的土产，
The bulk consisted of local products to be given away in Songjiang and Shanghai.

“四杭”以外，吃的、用的，样数很不少，
Besides Hangzhou’s “four specialities,” there were many kinds of food and useful articles.

一份一份料理，着实累人。
Sorting each gift separately was tiring work.

土产都是凭折子大批取了来的，
These local goods had been obtained in bulk on account.

送礼以外，当然也留坐自用，
Naturally, some were kept for the household.

胡雪岩打开一包桂花猪油麻酥糖，
Hu opened a packet of crumbly sesame sweets made with lard and scented with osmanthus.

吃了一块不想再吃，
After one piece he wanted no more.

便喊者他的小女儿说：“荷珠，你来吃了它。”
“Hezhu,” he called to his younger daughter, “come and finish these.”

拿起酥糖咬了一口，荷珠直摇头：
She picked one up, took a bite and shook her head.

“我不要吃！”
“I don’t want it.”

“咦！
“Why?

你不是顶喜欢吃酥糖？”
Aren’t these your favourite sweets?”

“不好吃！”荷珠说，
“They don’t taste nice.

“没有湖州的好吃。”
The ones from Huzhou are better.”

“你在哪里吃的湖州酥糖？”
“Where did you have sweets from Huzhou?”

这句话其实问得多余，自然是在外婆家吃的，
The question was really unnecessary: obviously, at her grandmother’s house.

但“一滴水恰好溶入油瓶里”，
Yet it was like a drop of water falling into an oil bottle.

略懂人事的荷珠，
Hezhu was old enough to understand a little of grown-up affairs.

忽然有所顾忌，竟答不上来，涨红了脸望着他父亲，仿佛做错了什么事伯受责似地。
Suddenly she grew cautious, could not answer, and looked at her father with a flushed face, as though expecting punishment for some wrongdoing.


这一来胡雪岩疑云大起，
Hu’s suspicions rose at once.

看妻子不在旁边，便拉着荷珠的手，走到窗前，悄悄问道：“你告诉爸爸，哪里来的湖州酥糖？
Seeing that his wife was not nearby, he took Hezhu to the window and asked quietly, “Tell Papa where those Huzhou sweets came from.

我上海回来，买个洋囡囡给你。”
When I return from Shanghai, I’ll bring you a foreign doll.”

荷珠不知怎么回答？
She did not know what to say.

想了半天说：“我不晓得！”
After thinking for a long while, she answered, “I don’t know.”

做父亲的听这回答，不免生气，但也不愿吓得她哭，只说：
This annoyed him, though he did not want to frighten her into tears.

“好！
“Very well.

你不肯告诉我，随便你！
If you won’t tell me, please yourself.

等我上海回来，姐姐有新衣裳，洋囡囡，
When I return from Shanghai, your sister will have new clothes and a foreign doll.

你呢，什么没有！”
You will have nothing.”

威胁利诱之下，荷珠到底说了实话：
Between the threat and the reward, Hezhu finally told the truth.

“娘带回来的。”
“Mother brought them back.”

“娘到湖州去过了？”
“Mother went to Huzhou?”

“嗯。”
“Mm.”

荷珠委屈他说，
She sounded aggrieved.

“我也要去，娘不许！”
“I wanted to go too, but she wouldn’t let me.”

“噢！
“Oh!

去了几天？”
How many days was she away?”

“一天去，一天回来。”
“One day to go, one day to come back.”

“那么是两天。”
“Two days, then.”

胡雪岩想了想又问，
Hu thought a moment.

“你娘回来以后，跟外婆说了些什么？”
“When she came back, what did she say to Grandmother?”

“我不晓得。
“I don’t know.

我走过去要听。娘叫我走开。
I went over to listen, and she sent me away.

娘又说，不准我说，娘到湖州去过。”
She also said I mustn’t tell anyone she had been to Huzhou.”

荷珠说到这里，才感觉事态严重，
Only now did Hezhu realise how serious this was.

“爸爸，爸爸，你千万不要跟娘去说，说我告诉你，娘到湖州去过。”
“Papa, Papa, you mustn’t tell Mother that I told you she went to Huzhou.”

“不会，不会！”
“I won’t, I won’t.”

胡雪岩把她搂在怀里，
He gathered her into his arms.

“我买洋囡囡给你。”
“I’ll buy you the foreign doll.”


安抚了荷珠，胡雪岩大上心事。
Having reassured Hezhu, Hu was deeply troubled.

他妻子的湖州之行，不用说，自然是为了芙蓉，但她干了些什么，却难以揣恻，
Naturally his wife’s journey to Huzhou concerned Furong, but what she had done was hard to guess.

是去打听了一番，还是另有什么作为？
Had she merely made inquiries, or taken some other action?

照他的了解，她做事极有分寸，决不是蛮横无理的悍泼之妇可比。
He knew she had an excellent sense of measure and was nothing like a violent, unreasonable shrew.

意识到这一点，他越觉得自己不可鲁莽，
That made it all the more necessary for him to avoid rashness.

必须谋定后动，或者说，兵来将挡，水来土掩，看她是用的什么办法，再来设计破她。
He must plan before acting—or, as the saying went, meet soldiers with generals and floodwater with earth: discover her move and devise the proper answer.

只要知道了她的用意和行动，一定有办法应付，这一点胡雪岩是有信心的。
Once he knew her purpose and actions, he was confident he could deal with them.

不过他也有警惕，自己所遭遇的“对手”太强，不可造次，
But this was a powerful opponent, and he must be careful.

同时估量形势，在家里他非常不利，
At home the odds were against him.

上有老母，下有一双女儿，都站在他妻子这面，
His mother above and his two daughters below all stood on his wife’s side.

自己以一敌四，孤掌难鸣。
One against four, he could hardly prevail.

所以眼前的当务之急，是要争取优势，而这个工作只能在暗地里做，
His immediate task was therefore to gain an advantage, and he could do it only in secret.

让妻子知道了，只要稍加安抚，“地盘”就会非常稳固。
If his wife learned of it, a little reassurance from her would make her position unshakable.

于是他首先还是找到荷珠，告诫她不可将他所问的话，告诉她母亲。
First he sought Hezhu out again and warned her not to tell her mother what he had asked.

然后又找他的大女儿，十五岁的梅王。
Then he approached his elder daughter, fifteen-year-old Meiyu.

梅玉很懂人事了，
She understood a good deal of the world.

虽是她母亲的“死党”，却很崇拜父亲，因而胡雪岩跟她说话，另有一套计算，一开口就说：
Though firmly her mother’s ally, she admired her father, so he adopted a different approach.

“梅王，你跟爸爸一起到上海去，好不好？”
“Meiyu, would you like to come to Shanghai with Papa?”

这话让梅玉又惊又喜。
The proposal surprised and delighted her.

能出去开一开眼界，又听说十里夷场有数不尽的新奇花样，自然向往万分，
She longed to see something of the world, especially the foreign settlement with its countless novelties.

但离开母亲，又仿佛觉调不能令人安心，
Yet leaving her mother seemed unsettling.

所以只骨碌碌地转着一对黑眼珠，半晌答不出话来。
Her dark eyes moved to and fro, and for a while she could not answer.


“你的意思怎么样？
“What do you think?

不愿意？”
Don’t you want to go?”

“哪个说不愿意？”梅玉说，
“Who says I don’t?” Meiyu replied.

“我有点怕。”
“I’m a little afraid.”

“怕？
“Afraid?

那完了！”
Then that settles it!

胡雪岩说，“爸爸还想靠你，你先怕了！”
I was hoping to rely on you, and you are afraid already.”

“靠我！”
“Rely on me?”

梅玉大惑不解，怎么样也不能接受这话，
She was utterly bewildered.

“爸爸，你靠我什么？”
“Papa, what could you rely on me for?”

“靠你替我写写、算算。”
“To write things down and do calculations for me.”

胡雪岩郑重其事他说，
Hu sounded thoroughly serious.

“我在外面的生意做得很大，
“My business outside has grown very large.

总要有个帮手，这个帮手一定要自己人，
I need someone to help, and it must be one of our own family.

因为有些帐目，是不能让别人知道的。哪怕刘庆生刘叔叔、陈世尤陈叔叔，都不能让他们知道。
There are accounts nobody else can know about—not even Uncle Liu Qingsheng or Uncle Chen Shilong.

想来想去，只有靠你帮忙。”
I have thought it over, and you are the only person I can rely on.”

这一套鬼话，改变了梅王的心情，
This fabrication changed her feelings completely.

原来一直当目己是个文弱的女孩子，在外面百无一用，只有帮着操持家务，
Until now she had regarded herself as a frail girl, useless outside the home and fit only to help with household affairs.

现在才知道自己还肯派得上紧要用场的地方，
Suddenly she discovered that she could perform an important service.

顿觉自己变了一个“大人”，
She felt grown-up at once.

而且也不再想到母亲，自觉胆子甚大，出去闯一闯也无所谓。
She stopped thinking of her mother, became bold, and saw no harm in venturing out into the world.

但是，这只是一鼓作气，多想一想不免气馁，
But the first burst of courage faded under further reflection.

“爸爸，”她说，“我怕我算不来帐。”
“Papa, I’m afraid I won’t know how to keep the accounts.”

“那么，你帮你娘记家用帐，是怎么记的呢？”
“How do you keep the household accounts for your mother, then?”

“家用帐是家用帐。
“Those are household accounts.

爸爸的帐是上千上万的进出。”
Your money comes and goes in thousands and tens of thousands.”

“帐目不管大小，算法是一样的，
“Large or small, the method is the same.

家用帐琐琐碎碎，
Household accounts are full of little items.

我的帐只有几样东西，
Mine concern only a few things.

还比家用帐好记。”
They are easier to keep.”

梅平接受了鼓励，“雄心”又起，
Encouraged, Meiyu’s ambition rose again.

毅然决然的说：“那我就跟了爸爸去，
“Then I’ll go with you,” she declared.

不过我要把阿彩带了去。”
“But I must take A’cai.”

阿彩是专门照料她的一个丫头，
A’cai was the maid who looked after her.

胡雪岩当然答应。事情就这样说定局了。
Naturally Hu agreed, and the matter was settled.


这一来，全家大小都知道了这回事，而胡太太只当丈夫说笑话。
Soon everyone in the household knew, though Mrs Hu supposed her husband was joking.

“你要把梅玉带到上海去啊？”她问她丈夫。
“Are you taking Meiyu to Shanghai?” she asked.

“对！”胡雪岩说，
“Yes.

“女儿大了，
She is growing up.

带她出去阅历阅历。”
I want her to gain some experience.”

“阅历！”
“Experience!”

胡太太诧异之至，
His wife was astonished.

“听说夷场上的风气不好，
“They say the foreign settlement has bad ways.

有啥好阅历？
What experience is there to gain?

学了些坏样子回来，你害了她！
If she comes home with bad habits, you will have ruined her.”

“胡雪岩笑笑不作声。
Hu only smiled.

这有何可笑？
What was amusing?

女孩子学坏学好，有关终身，
A girl’s conduct affected her whole future.

不是好笑的事，
It was no laughing matter.

那自然是笑自己的话没见识！
He must be laughing at her ignorance!

胡太太倒有些不服气了。
Mrs Hu resented it.

“我的话说锗了？”她平静而固执地，
“Am I wrong?” she asked, calmly but stubbornly.

“而且听说路上不平靖，
“Besides, they say the roads are unsafe.

梅玉不要去！”
Meiyu is not to go.”

“路上不平靖，那么我呢？
“If the roads are unsafe, what about me?

你倒放心得下？”
Aren’t you worried?”

“你跟梅玉不同。”胡太太说，
“You and Meiyu are different.

“又有尤五爷照应，我自然放心。”
With Master You looking after you, naturally I feel easy.”

“那就对了，
“Exactly.

梅王跟我在一起，你还有啥不放心？”
If she is with me, what is there to worry about?”

夫妇俩的交谈，针锋相对，而且是“绵里针”，劲道暗藏着，
Their words met point against point, needles hidden in silk, with all their force concealed.

但毕竟还是胡雪岩占了上风，
Yet Hu had gained the upper hand.

胡太太争不过他，还有一着棋，拿老太太搬了出来。
Unable to defeat him in argument, his wife made one last move: she brought his mother into it.


对母亲说话，自然不能那样子一句钉一句，
With his mother he could not answer every objection so sharply.

胡雪岩依旧是对梅玉的那套说法，说要有个亲信的人替他管帐，
He returned to the story he had told Meiyu: he needed someone he could trust to keep accounts.

不过一套假话，比对梅玉说的还要详细，
This time the fabrication was more detailed.

他说有些交际应酬的帐目，没有凭证，
Some expenses for entertaining and social dealings had no receipts.

如果不是当时记下来，事后就搞不清楚。
Unless they were recorded at once, they became impossible to disentangle later.

而这些帐目，无论如何是不能让外人知道的，所以要把梅王带去帮忙。
Nobody outside the family could be allowed to know these accounts, so he needed Meiyu’s help.

说到这里，他叹口气：
Then he sighed.

“如果有男孩子，何必要带梅玉出去？
“If I had a boy, why should I have to take Meiyu?

哪怕有个亲侄儿也好了！
Even a nephew of my own would do.

苦的就是没有。
The trouble is that I have neither.”

“这是胡雪岩灵机一动的攻心之计。
This was an inspired appeal to his mother’s feelings.

胡老太太果然在想，梅玉如果是个男孩，十五岁便可以跟他父亲出去“学生意”，
She immediately began to think that, had Meiyu been a boy, at fifteen he could have gone out with his father to learn business.

有五六年下来，足可以成为你父亲的一个得力帮手，生意做得发达了，不患后继无人。
In five or six years he would be a capable assistant, and the growing enterprise would have someone to inherit it.

如今就算马上有了孩子，要到十几年以后，才能成人，
Even if a boy were born now, more than ten years must pass before he grew up.

缓不济急，
That could not meet their present need.

对胡家来说，是吃了亏了，
The Hu family had lost an opportunity.

不免有些怨儿媳妇，耽误了这十几年的大好时光。
She could not help blaming her daughter-in-law for wasting all these good years.

这一下胡太太又落了下风，胡雪岩则甚为得意，
Once again Mrs Hu was at a disadvantage, and her husband was pleased with himself.

但再想进一步打听他妻子到了湖州的情形，却是失望，
But when he tried to discover more about her visit to Huzhou, he was disappointed.

听梅玉的口气，她母亲根本没有跟她说过。
From what Meiyu said, her mother had told her nothing of it.


就在这天晚上，钱庄里派人来通知，
That evening a messenger came from the bank.

说刘不才已经从湖州回来，请胡雪岩去有话说，
Liu Bucai had returned from Huzhou and wanted Hu to come and speak with him.

可想而知的，必是关于芙蓉的事，
Obviously it concerned Furong.

否则刘不才也是熟客，何不到家来谈？
Otherwise, Liu was familiar enough with the household to call there himself.

估量到这一层，他首先就要注意他妻子的态度：
Having worked this out, Hu first watched his wife’s reaction.

“奇怪！”他试探着说：
“How strange,” he said, sounding her out.

“刘不才怎么不来？
“Why doesn’t Liu come here?

反要我去看他。”
Why must I go to him?”

“你管他呢！”胡太太夷然不以为意，
“Never mind that,” she answered with complete unconcern.

“你去了再说。”
“Go and find out.”

胡太太的沉着实在厉害了！
Her composure was formidable indeed.

等跟刘不才见了面，才知道她跟芙蓉已经见过面，
Only when Hu met Liu did he learn that she had already seen Furong.

只说她是跟胡雪岩共患难的糟糠之妻，然后留下一张五千两银票，就告辞了。
She had simply introduced herself as the wife who had shared Hu’s hardships, left a five-thousand-tael banknote and taken her leave.

“有这样的事！”胡雪岩说，
“Such a thing!” Hu exclaimed.

“我实在想不到。”
“I never imagined it.”

“谁也没有想到。”
“Nobody did.”

刘不才很尴尬的说：
Liu was embarrassed.

“芙蓉要我来问你的意思，才好作去留之计。”
“Furong sent me to ask your wishes before she decides whether to stay or go.”

于是胡雪岩又改回原来的称呼：
Hu returned to his former mode of address.

“三叔！”他说，“请你仍旧回湖州，叫芙蓉不必着急。
“Third Uncle, please go back to Huzhou and tell Furong not to worry.

我自有办法。”
I shall find a way.”

“是什么办法呢？”
“What way?”

“这一时说不清楚。”胡雪岩这样答道：
“I cannot explain just now.

“三叔，反正我一定对得起芙蓉就是了。”
Whatever happens, I shall deal honourably with her.”

这话恰好是刘不才听不进去的，
This was precisely what Liu did not want to hear.

照他的私心打算，最好胡雪岩再给个三两万银子，让芙蓉下堂，别求归宿，省得自己沾上这点不十分光彩的裙带亲。
Privately, he hoped Hu would give another twenty or thirty thousand taels, release Furong to find another home, and spare him this not altogether creditable connection through his niece.

而现在听他的口气，适得其反，
Hu’s words suggested the opposite.

刘不才虽然失望，却不便多说什么。
Disappointed, Liu could say little.


“你新年里的手气如何？”胡雪岩故作闲豫地问。
“How has your luck been over the New Year?” Hu asked, feigning leisure.

这一问，刘不才又高兴了，
This cheered Liu at once.

“实在不错！”他笑得合不拢口，
“Excellent!” he said, grinning.

“所向披靡，斩获甚丰。”
“Victorious everywhere, with rich spoils.”

大概是赢得不少。
He must have won a good deal.

胡雪岩心想，趁这时候得要规劝几句。
Hu thought this a suitable moment for advice.

“三叔！”他说，“ ‘瓦罐不离井上破，将军难免阵前亡’你见过哪个是在赌上发迹的，
“Third Uncle, the pitcher is bound to break at the well, and the general is bound to die on the battlefield. Have you ever known anyone make his way in the world through gambling?

现在你手上很有几文了，
You have a little money now.

应该做点正事。”
You ought to turn to serious work.”

“我的帐都还清了。”刘不才说，
“All my debts are paid,” Liu replied.

“还赢进一张田契，
“I even won a deed to some land.

我已经托郁四去替我过户营业。”
I have asked Yu Si to arrange the transfer and put me in possession.”

说到这里，他又感慨他说，
Then he grew reflective.

“一个人真是穷不得！
“A man really cannot afford to be poor.

手头有几个钱，别人马上不同，
Once he has a little money, people change towards him at once.

就在这几天，有好几个人来替我做媒，劝我续弦。”
In these last few days several people have offered to arrange a marriage for me, urging me to take another wife.”

“那是好事啊！”
“That would be a good thing.”

“不忙！”
“There is no hurry.”

刘不才摇摇头，
Liu shook his head.

“让我潇潇洒洒，先过几年清闲日子再说。”
“Let me enjoy a few carefree years first.”

“这就不对了！
“That is wrong.

未曾发财，先想纳福，吃苦在后头。”胡雪岩说：
Think of comfort before you have made your fortune, and hardship will come later.

“三叔，我劝你把世德堂恢复起来。”
Third Uncle, I advise you to restore Shide Hall.”

“咦！”
“What?”

刘不才诧异，
Liu was surprised.

“你不是要我帮你开庆余堂吗？”
“Weren’t you going to have me help open Hu Qingyu Hall?”

这件事几乎连胡雪岩自己都已忘记了，
Hu had almost forgotten the undertaking himself.

“自己人我说实话，
“Between ourselves, I shall tell you frankly.

这要慢慢再说了。
That must wait.

就是开起来，我也要另外请人，
Even if I open it, I shall have to find someone else.

三叔，”他说，“你的长处不在这上面。“
Third Uncle, your strengths lie elsewhere.”


一听是这样的答话，刘不才不免有些伤心，
This hurt Liu.

“雪岩，”他怨艾他说：“你看看我只会赌钱？”
“Xueyan,” he said reproachfully, “do you think gambling is all I can do?”

“不是这话，不是这话！”
“Not at all!”

胡雪岩倒觉歉然，极力安慰他说，
Hu felt apologetic and did his best to reassure him.

“你的长处我都知道，
“I know your abilities.

将来我有大大仰仗你的地方。”
There will be important matters in which I must depend on you.”

“那么眼前呢？”
“What about now?”

“眼前要看你自己的意思，
“For now, it depends on your wishes.

你的志向是把祖传的基业恢复起来，
Your ambition was to restore the family business.

所以我那样劝你，而且可以帮你的忙。”
That is why I advised it, and I can help you.”

“我的想法变过了，
“My mind has changed.

世德堂就算恢复了，也没有啥意思，
Even restoring Shide Hall would mean little.

叫我守在店里，更加办不到。
I certainly couldn’t stay behind a shop counter.

我想想，还是跟你一起去闯一闯的好。”
I think I would rather go out into the world with you.”

“那好！”胡雪岩说，
“Very well.

“你先回湖州，叫芙蓉放心，
First return to Huzhou and put Furong’s mind at rest.

关起门来过日子，什么事也不必管，
Tell her to live quietly at home and concern herself with nothing else.

等我上海回来，自有安排。
When I return from Shanghai, I shall make arrangements.

这话说到了，请你跟世龙一起赶到上海来。”
Once you have delivered that message, come to Shanghai with Shilong.”


这样说定了，各自分手。
They parted with this agreed.

胡雪岩已出钱庄，灵机一动，
Hu had already left the bank when an idea struck him.

开了张五千两的银票，带在身上，一到家，
He had a five-thousand-tael note drawn and took it home.

正好在书房里遇着他妻子，便把那张银票递了过去。
Finding his wife in the study, he handed it to her.

胡太太装作不解地问道：“这是啥？”
“What is this?” she asked, pretending not to understand.

“你白送了五千银子！
“You gave away five thousand taels for nothing.

我贴还你的私房。”胡雪岩又说，
I am replacing your private savings.

“有私房钱，放到钱庄里去生息倒不好？
Wouldn’t it be better to put your money in the bank and earn interest?

压在箱子底下，大钱不会生小钱的。”
Kept at the bottom of a chest, big money won’t breed little money.”

看他是这种态度，胡太太倒有些莫测高深了。
His manner left her unable to fathom him.

夫妇俩暗中较劲，到了这样的地步，至矣尽矣，
Their silent contest had reached its utmost limit.

胡太太自然有些不安，心想既然西洋镜已经折穿，就不如敞开来谈了。
Uneasy, she thought that, since the secret was out, they had better speak openly.

于是她先表示歉意，
She began with an apology.

“雪岩，你不要怪我事先没有跟你商量！
“Xueyan, don’t blame me for not discussing it with you first.

我也是万般无奈，
I had no choice.

为了一家大小，
I did it for the whole family.

我们苦了这么多年，你刚刚转运，千万沾染不得‘桃花’，
We suffered for so many years, and now that your fortune has only just turned, you must not become entangled in love affairs.

我这样做，是为你好。
It was for your own good.

十几年夫妻，你总晓得我的心。”
After more than ten years of marriage, you know my heart.”

她停了一下又说，
She paused.

“当然，我另外有打算的，跟娘也讲过，
“Of course, I have another plan, which I have discussed with Mother.

将来你就可以晓得了，
You will understand in time.

我不是不讲道理，乱吃醋的人。”
I am not an unreasonable woman consumed by jealousy.”


最后这几句话，让胡雪岩看穿了她妻子的用心。
Those last words revealed her purpose to Hu.

只要是小康之家，三十一过，尚乏子息，堂上老亲。便会动替儿子置妾的念头，
In any reasonably prosperous family, once a son passed thirty without a male heir, his parents began thinking of finding him a concubine.

再过五六年，依然有“后顾之忧”，则乡党宗亲都会出来“说公话”，
If another five or six years passed and the future remained uncertain, neighbours and clansmen would speak out in the name of fairness.

再悍泼的大妇，也得屈服于“不孝有三，无后为大”的“道理”之下，忍气吞声让丈夫另辟偏房。
Even the fiercest principal wife had to submit to the argument that leaving no heir was the greatest failure of filial duty, swallow her anger and let her husband take a second woman.

因此，会吃醋的人便作未雨绸缪之计，
Cleverly jealous wives therefore prepared in advance.

表面绝不露温色，而且为丈夫置妾之念，表现得非常热切，三天两头找媒婆上门，
They showed no anger and seemed positively eager to obtain a concubine, calling matchmakers in every few days.

里外串通，托词宜男之相，找来个粗脚大手，其蠢如牛的女孩子，作为丈夫金屋中的阿娇。
In collusion with them, on the pretext of selecting a woman whose appearance promised sons, they found a girl with broad feet and large hands, as stupid as an ox, to serve as the A’jiao of their husband’s golden house.

同时一进门便立下许多规矩，
As soon as she entered, they laid down countless rules.

阃令大如军令，偏房有如敌国，戒备森严，把丈夫摆布得动弹不得。
Commands within the women’s quarters were as strict as military orders; the concubine was treated like an enemy state, under such close guard that the husband could scarcely move.

胡雪岩认为他妻子就是这类厉害的角色，所以立刻表示“敬谢不敏”！
Hu considered his wife just such a formidable strategist and immediately declined the favour.

“你不必瞎打算，
“Don’t waste your plans.

我也不会领你的情。”
I shan’t thank you for them.”

他接着提到芙蓉：
Then he turned to Furong.

“你这趟到湖州去，做错了，大错特错！
“Your journey to Huzhou was a mistake—a very great mistake.

我跟你说过，是逢场作戏，认不得真，
I told you it was a passing amusement, nothing to take seriously.

以后我自有摆脱的办法。
I had my own way of extricating myself later.

现在你这一来，倒叫我为难了，
Now you have put me in a difficulty.

如果照你的想头，给个几千银子，让人家走路，说出去是我胡雪岩怕老婆！
If I follow your idea, give her a few thousand taels and send her away, everyone will say Hu Xueyan is afraid of his wife.

不要说我面子上下不来，而且人家要想，胡雪岩凡事自己做不得主，
Besides losing face, I shall make people think I cannot decide anything for myself.

你倒说人家还信任不信任我？”
Tell me, will they still trust me?”


这番道理把胡太太说得愣住了！
This argument left Mrs Hu stunned.

她虽精明，到底世面见得少，
Clever as she was, she had seen little of the world.

商场中的习惯和顾忌，哪里懂得透？
How could she fully understand the habits and anxieties of business?

只好这样辩解：“我一个人去，一个人来，
She could only protest, “I went alone and came back alone.

一共只见了一面，谈不到一盏茶的工夫，
We met once, for less time than it takes to drink a cup of tea.

真正是人不知鬼不觉，
Nobody could have known.

哪个会晓得？”
Who would find out?”

“是不是‘鬼不觉’，我不晓得，
“Whether the spirits knew, I cannot say.

若要‘人不知’，除非己莫为。
But if you don’t want people to know of something, don’t do it.

不说别的，就说我，先就晓得了。”
Never mind anyone else—I know already.”

胡雪岩故意跌足嗟叹：
Hu deliberately stamped and sighed.

“现在湖州已经在笑话我了！
“They are laughing at me in Huzhou now!

你晓得庞二怎么说？
Do you know what Pang said?

他说，做大生意就象皇帝治天下一样，
‘Running a great business is like an emperor ruling the realm.

该杀的杀，该放的放，全靠当机立断，
Execute whom you must, spare whom you should—everything depends on deciding at once.

所以切忌女人轧脚。
Above all, you must not let women hamper your steps.

胡雪岩原来要听太太的话！
Yet it turns out Hu Xueyan must obey his wife!

如果说有笔生意来了，发大财或者本钱蚀光，都在当时一句话上，
Suppose an opportunity arises and one immediate word decides between a fortune and the loss of all the capital.

而胡某人说要回去跟太太商量一下看。
Then Hu says he must go home and consult his wife.

你们说，这样子怎么合得拢淘来做大生意？”
Tell me, how can anyone join such a man in serious business?’”

这番编出来的话，把胡太太说得青一阵，红一阵，
This invented speech made her turn pale and red by turns.

心里又急又悔，好半晌说不出话来。
Anxious and remorseful, she could not speak for a long time.

“你也不要急！”胡雪岩倒过来安慰她，
Now Hu comforted her. “Don’t distress yourself.

“事情已经做错了，
What is done is done.

懊悔也无用，
Regret will not help.

眼前只有让他们去笑我，
For the moment, let them laugh.

等我上海回来再说。”
We will see when I return from Shanghai.”

越是如此，越不能让胡太太安心。
The more he spoke like this, the less reassured she felt.

夫妇之间为了妾侍，没有不吵得天翻地覆的，
Disputes between husband and wife over a concubine invariably produced a storm.

即令丈夫脾气好，也不能这样丝毫不带愠色。
Even a good-tempered husband could not show absolutely no resentment.

其中一定有什么花样！
There must be some design behind it.

同时芙蓉到底怎么样了呢，
And what had become of Furong?

是知难而退，还是恋恋不舍，
Had she withdrawn in the face of difficulty, or was she unwilling to let go?

也得从丈夫口中讨出一个确实信息来，才好处置。
Mrs Hu needed a definite answer before deciding what to do.

总而言之，事情到此地步，由暗而明，使得干干净净有个了结，
Now that the matter was out in the open, it ought to be settled cleanly.

如果听任丈夫从上海回来再办，且不说夜长梦多，
Waiting until his return from Shanghai invited further complications.

光是这许多日子他心中怀着不满，就足以使夫妇的感情起变化。
Worse still, the resentment he might nurse throughout those days could change their relationship.


想到这里，胡太太认为丈夫的生意虽然要紧，但这件事更显得紧迫，
His business was important, Mrs Hu decided, but this was more urgent.

说不得只好留了下来。
She must ask him to remain.

“你晚几天走好不好？”她问。
“Could you leave a few days later?”

真是俗语说的“开口见喉咙”，一听这话，
The moment she opened her mouth, as the saying went, he could see straight down her throat.

胡雪岩便看透底蕴，却明知故问他说：“为啥？”
He understood completely, but asked as though he did not, “Why?”

“梅玉第一趟出远门，
“It is Meiyu’s first long journey.

总要替她多做点衣服。”胡太太这样托词，
We must make her some more clothes,” she said by way of a pretext.

“晚个两三天走，也不碍吧？”
“Two or three days’ delay would not matter, would it?”

“你说不碍就不碍。”胡雪岩隐约提出警告：
“If you say it won’t matter, it won’t.” He added an indirect warning.

“不过这几天当中，你不要替我惹什么麻烦，弄得我走不成，
“But don’t cause me any trouble in those few days and make it impossible for me to leave.

那就要了我半条命锣。”
That would take half my life.”

“有啥麻烦？”
“What trouble?”

胡太太想到自己处处落下风，不免怨恨，便发牢骚似他说，“啥麻烦也难不倒你！
Resenting her constant defeats, she complained, “No trouble can defeat you.

反正各凭天良就是了。”
Let each of us act according to conscience, that is all.”

说着，眼圈便有些红了。
Her eyes reddened.

性格刚毅的女子，有此软弱的表示，最易感人，
Such weakness in a strong-minded woman is particularly moving.

胡雪岩倒觉得心里酸酸地，一伸手扶着她的肩头说：
Hu felt a pang and put a hand on her shoulder.

“十几年夫妻，你难道还不晓得我？
“After more than ten years together, don’t you know me?

你有良心，我也有良心，
You have a conscience, and so do I.

不然我们不会有今天这样的日子。”
Otherwise we would not have reached the life we have today.”

想到眼前的日子，胡太太又生警惕，也越觉得留住丈夫是个一点不错的做法，
Thinking of that life made her more watchful and more certain she was right to keep him at home.

她的做法是预备请嵇鹤龄出面来谈判，能让步一定让步。
She intended to ask Ji Heling to mediate and would concede whatever she could.

胡雪岩只知道她一定会有动作，却不知道她是打的这个主意。
Hu knew she meant to act, but not that this was her plan.

冷静地想一想，发觉到这重纠纷，主客已经易势，
Calm reflection showed him that their positions had reversed.

原来是自己怀着个鬼胎，深怕妻子进一步追究，
At first he had carried a guilty secret and dreaded further questions.

此刻变成她急自己不急，
Now she was anxious and he was not.

以逸待劳，看她使出什么招数，再来设法破它，也还不迟。
He could wait at ease, see what move she made and devise an answer in good time.


有此闲豫的心情，而且有了多出来的两三天工夫，他忽发雅兴，
In this leisurely mood, with two or three extra days at his disposal, Hu suddenly felt like an outing.

特地约嵇鹤龄和裘丰言，白天逛湖，晚上吃“皇饭儿”，吃完上城隍山去看灯。
He invited Ji Heling and Qiu Fengyan to tour the lake by day, dine at Huangfan’er and then climb City God Hill to see the lanterns.

裘丰言一诺无辞，
Qiu accepted without hesitation.

嵇鹤龄则辞了逛湖之约，来赴饭局。
Ji declined the lake excursion but came to dinner.

酒到半酣，话题落到芙蓉身上，
When the wine had warmed them, the conversation turned to Furong.

一个是异姓手足，一个是无话不谈的好朋友，
One man was his sworn brother, the other a close friend with whom he could discuss anything.

有了几分酒意的胡雪岩想起对付他妻子的手腕，自觉得意，忍不住大谈特谈。
A little tipsy, Hu recalled his handling of his wife, felt pleased with himself and could not resist talking at length.

就是这天上午，嵇鹤龄已受了胡太太之托，要来调停此事，便落得听他“自供。
That very morning Ji had been asked by Mrs Hu to mediate, so he was content to hear Hu make his own confession.

裘丰言却不知就里，
Qiu knew nothing of this.

附和着胡雪岩说：”胡大嫂果然精明，
Agreeing with Hu, he said, “Sister-in-Law Hu is indeed clever.

只怕是读过‘妒律’的。
She must have read the Code of Jealousy.”

“胡雪岩没有听懂，追问一句：
Hu had not understood.

“你说啥？”
“What did you say?”

“ ‘妒律’，妒忌之妒，律例之律！”
“The Code of Jealousy—jealousy, as in envy; code, as in statutes.”

“吃了酒又来信口开河，杜撰故事了。”嵇鹤龄笑道：
“Wine has set you inventing stories again,” Ji said with a smile.

“从未听说过有此一部律例。”
“I have never heard of such a code.”

“自然是游戏笔墨，但也不无道理。
“Naturally it is a literary jest, but not without reason.

把大妇的妒心，刻画得无微不至。”裘丰言笑道：
It depicts a principal wife’s jealous heart in the finest detail.

“天下凡想纳宠的男子，都当一读。”
Every man thinking of taking a concubine ought to read it.”

“那么，”胡雪岩很感兴趣的说，“你倒讲讲这部妒律，是怎么回事？”
Hu was interested. “Then tell us about this code.”

“分吏、户、礼、兵、刑、工，另加‘各例’、‘督捕律’等，一共八章。
“It has eight chapters: Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Punishments and Works, with Additional Regulations and the Statutes for Apprehending Offenders.

有引有判，
There are citations and judgments.

是绝妙好词。”
Admirable writing!”


“我念几条来听听！”
“Recite a few provisions for us.”

裘丰言点点头，喝了口酒，来了一个“响铃儿”在嘴里咀嚼得“嘎吱、嘎吱”的响，念念有词的默诵了一会，
Qiu nodded, drank some wine and took a crisp “ringing-bell” roll, crunching it as he silently rehearsed the words.

忽然笑道：
Then he suddenly laughed.

“想起来了，
“I remember!

你念两条你听，是兵部的军律：”凡妇见夫人妾房言语，即假借公事，突入冲散，拟坐以擅闯辕门律。
Here are two for you, from the military statutes: ‘Any wife who sees her husband enter a concubine’s room to converse and, on the pretext of household business, bursts in and breaks up their meeting shall be charged under the statute against unauthorised entry into a military headquarters.

如止挥扰，不作嗔状，引例未减，笞五十，免供。
If she merely disturbs them without showing anger, the provision for mitigation shall apply: fifty strokes of the light bamboo, with no confession required.

判曰：翡翠床前，方调鹦鹉之舌，水晶帘外，忽来狮吼之声。
The judgment states: Before the jade-green bed, the parrot’s tongue is just being coaxed to speech; beyond the crystal curtain, suddenly comes the roaring of a lion.

不徒花上晒衣，未免腹中藏剑！
This is more than hanging washing over flowers: it suggests a sword concealed in the belly.

有心心术不端，无心见识不到。
If deliberate, the intentions are improper; if unintentional, the understanding is deficient.’”

‘“这几句四六是胡雪岩听得懂的，
Hu understood these balanced phrases.

“判得好！
“A fine judgment!

‘花上晒衣’，大煞风景，”他说：
Hanging washing over flowers—what a way to spoil the scene.

“真个该打手心！”
She really deserves a beating on the palms.”


“再有一种罪名，就不轻了！”
“There is another offence whose penalty is far from light.”

裘丰言又拉长了声调念：“凡妇度与夫正值绸缨之际，忽唤妾起，嘱以他事，拟坐以‘擅调官军’律……”
Drawing out his voice, Qiu continued: “‘Any wife who judges that her husband and concubine are at a tender moment together, and suddenly calls the concubine away on another errand, shall be charged with unauthorised deployment of government troops...’”

一句话未完；胡雪岩大笑：
Before he finished, Hu burst out laughing.

“好个‘擅调官军’，
“Excellent! Unauthorised deployment of troops!

应得何罪？”
What is the punishment?”

“杖一百，发边远充军。”
“A hundred strokes of the heavy bamboo and military service on a distant frontier.”

“这未免太重。”嵇鹤龄也笑了。
“Rather severe,” Ji said, laughing too.

“你说太重，人家以为‘宥以生命，犹为宽曲’。”
“You call it severe, but the author says, ‘To spare her life is already excessive leniency.’”

襄丰言接着念判词：“酣战方深，浪子春风一度，金牌忽召，夫人号令三申，
Qiu went on with the judgment: “‘The battle is at its height, the rake enjoying a moment of spring; suddenly a golden tally recalls the troops, and the lady repeats her command three times.

既撤白登之围，讵有黄龙之望？”
Once the siege of Baideng has been lifted, what hope remains of reaching Huanglong?’”

“想想也是。”胡雪岩问道：
“There is something in that,” Hu said.

“象内人那样，不晓得犯什么‘律’？”
“What statute would a woman like my wife offend against?”

裘丰言想了想说：
Qiu considered.

“有这么一条，‘凡妇蓄妾，原非得已，乃自夸贤德，冀人赞美。拟坐现任官辄自立碑律，杖一百。徒三年’。
“There is this one: ‘Any wife who agrees to a concubine only because she has no choice, yet boasts of her virtue in hope of praise, shall be charged under the statute against an incumbent official erecting a monument to himself: one hundred strokes of the heavy bamboo and three years’ penal servitude.’

此由‘事因情近，名与实违’，
The circumstances are comparable, while the reputation contradicts the reality.

‘盗名有禁，功令宜遵’！”
‘Usurping a reputation is prohibited; the regulations must be obeyed.’”


“你不要瞎说！”
“Stop talking nonsense!”

嵇鹤龄觉得裘丰言的玩笑之谈，有碍他的调停之职，所以阻止他再说下去，
Ji felt that Qiu’s jokes were obstructing his work as mediator and prevented him from continuing.

“我那位弟妇，决不是那种人，
“My sister-in-law is nothing of the kind.

要替雪岩置妾，既非‘名与实违’，更不是‘盗各’。
Her wish to find Xueyan a concubine neither contradicts her real intentions nor usurps a reputation.

你说的妒律，全不适用。”
Your Code of Jealousy does not apply.”

裘丰言听出他的言外之意，极其见机，
Qiu caught the implication and adapted at once.

“原是不经之谈，”他说，
“It is all fanciful nonsense, of course.

“胡大嫂的贤德，不必自夸，
Sister-in-Law Hu need not boast of her goodness.

亲友无不深知。”
All her friends and relations know it.”

“家家有本难念经……”
“Every household has a difficult scripture to recite...”

“雪岩！”嵇鹤龄抢着问道：
“Xueyan!” Ji interrupted.

“你那位新宠，如今怎么样了？”
“What has become of your new favourite?”

胡雪岩当然没有骗他的道理，
Hu had no reason to deceive him.

老实答道：“好好在湖州。”
“She is living quietly in Huzhou.”

“还顶着你的姓？”
“Still under your name?”

“当然。”
“Naturally.”

胡雪岩忽然发觉嵇鹤龄的态度，与自己不尽符合，便问了一句：“大哥，你说我该怎么办？”
Suddenly realising that Ji’s attitude did not entirely agree with his own, Hu asked, “Elder Brother, what do you think I should do?”

“千言并一句，不可因此在家庭中生出意见，
“A thousand words come to one point: do not let this sow discord in your family.

否则就是大不幸。”
That would be a great misfortune.”

“对，对！”
“Exactly!”

裘丰言又在旁边帮腔，
Qiu chimed in.

“家和万事兴！
“When the family is harmonious, everything prospers.

雪岩兄鸿运当头，方兴未艾，
Brother Xueyan, your good fortune is still rising.

此时最要得内助的力。”
Now above all you need your wife’s help.”


胡雪岩把他们两人一看，笑着说道：
Hu looked from one to the other and smiled.

“双拳难敌四手，
“Two fists cannot fight four hands.

看样子我今天说不过你们了。”
It seems I shall lose the argument today.”

“老裘不是外人。我说老实话，
“Qiu is one of us, so I shall speak plainly.

我受托调停，
I have been asked to mediate.

即此可以看出弟妇的贤德。”嵇鹤龄又说：
That alone shows your wife’s good sense.

“今天上午，我也拜见了伯母，面奉慈谕，要我以长兄的资格，料理这件‘风流官司’。”
This morning I also paid my respects to your mother and received her personal instructions to settle this romantic lawsuit as your elder brother.”

“高堂之命、贤妻之托、长兄之尊，”
“Your mother’s command, your good wife’s request and your elder brother’s authority!”

裘丰言拍掌笑道：
Qiu clapped his hands and laughed.

“雪岩兄，你可真要唯命是从了。”
“Brother Xueyan, you must surely obey.”

嵇鹤龄赶紧摇手阻止，
Ji hastily waved him down.

“不是这话，不是这话！
“That is not what I mean.

大家都是为雪岩。
Everyone is acting for Xueyan’s sake.

我先问你的意思，
First I want to know his wishes.

弟妇有句话给我，只要在情理上，一定可以如你的愿。”
His wife has told me that, provided they accord with reason and propriety, she will certainly meet them.”

说到这后，胡雪岩觉得不必再玩弄什么手腕，便很率直他说道：
At this point Hu felt there was no need for further manoeuvres and spoke frankly.

“我不是什么荒唐的人，而且也还没有到可以荒唐的时候。
“I am not a dissolute man, nor have I reached a point where I can afford to be one.

没有儿子是一层，各地来去，要有个歇脚的地方，又是一层。
Having no son is one consideration; needing somewhere to rest as I travel is another.

所以我不觉得在湖州立个门户，就是对不起内人。
I therefore do not think that establishing a household in Huzhou wrongs my wife.

我是尊重她，所以不让她知道，
I kept it from her out of respect.

她偏偏要戳穿西洋镜，这出戏就很难唱得下去了。”
But she insisted on exposing the illusion, and now the play has become difficult to continue.”

“唱总要唱下去，顶了石臼也要唱。”嵇鹤龄说：
“It must continue even if you have to act with a stone mortar balanced on your head,” Ji replied.

“家庭之间和为贵，
“Harmony matters most in a family.

要和就得忍。
To achieve harmony, there must be forbearance.

弟妇算是忍耐了，
Your wife has shown it.

你呢？”
What about you?”


“我不是也在忍吗？
“Haven’t I shown it too?

凡事将就，不跟她吵，
I give way in everything and don’t quarrel with her.

也算对得起她了。”
Surely I have treated her fairly.”

“是的。我也知道。
“Yes, I know.

不过芙蓉呢？
But what about Furong?

总得有个着落才好。”
There must be some settled arrangement.”

“目前的情形，就是着落。”
“The present situation is the arrangement.”

“这就谈不下去了。”
“Then we cannot get any further.”

照此看来，胡太太提得有条件，
Evidently Mrs Hu had imposed a condition.

胡雪岩心想，莫非他妻子还是坚持要遣走芙蓉？
Was she still insisting that Furong be sent away?

果然如此，可真的是谈不下去了。
If so, there really was nothing to discuss.

就在这显现僵局之际，裘丰言说了句很公平的话：
As they reached this deadlock, Qiu made a fair remark.

“彼此都要让步。
“Both sides must yield something.

雪岩兄如果坚持目前的情形，似乎不对！”
It hardly seems right for Brother Xueyan to insist that everything remain as it is.”

“对了！
“Exactly!

我也是这话。”
That is what I mean.”

“不坚持目前的情形又如何？
“And if it doesn’t remain as it is?

莫非真的叫大家笑话我胡某人怕老婆？”
Am I really to let everyone laugh at Hu Xueyan for being afraid of his wife?”

“当然不是这样子。”嵇鹤龄说，
“Certainly not,” Ji said.

“我已经听出意思来了，
“I have understood your wife’s meaning.

弟妇的想法是，你讨小纳妾都可以，不过一定要住在一起。”
You may take a concubine, but she insists that you all live together.”

“这就不错了！”裘丰言说，
“That is reasonable,” Qiu agreed.

“胡大嫂这个意思在情理上。”
“Sister-in-Law Hu is within the bounds of propriety.”

“情理固然说得过去，无奈还有法——妒律！”
“It may satisfy reason and propriety,” Hu replied, “but there is still the law—the Code of Jealousy!”


这是没有理由的理由，照理一时倒还不容易解释说服，除非嵇鹤龄能提出保证！
This was an excuse without substance, yet not easy to answer with reasoning alone, unless Ji could offer a guarantee.

天下事什么都可保证，只有共一座江山、共一个丈夫不能保证相安无事。
Almost anything in the world could be guaranteed except peace between two rulers sharing a realm or two women sharing a husband.

嵇鹤龄为难而生烦恼，因而有点迁怒到裘丰言身上。
The difficulty vexed Ji, and he turned some of his annoyance on Qiu.

“都是你！
“It is all your doing!

信口开河，讲什么妒律，以至于授人以柄！”
Talking wildly about this Code of Jealousy and putting a weapon into his hands.”

裘丰言脾气好，受此责备不以为忤，反自引咎，
Good-tempered as ever, Qiu took no offence and accepted the blame.

自斟自饮干了一杯酒说：
Pouring himself a cup, he drained it.

“罚我，罚我！”
“A penalty for me!”

“我敬一杯！”胡雪岩笑道：
“Let me drink to you,” Hu said with a smile.

“都亏你提醒了我。”
“You did well to remind me.”

“不敢，不敢！”
“No, no!”

裘丰言这时才觉察到“授人以柄”这句话，不是笑谈，
Only now did Qiu realise that Ji’s complaint about giving Hu a weapon was no joke.

所以不愿再提，
He wanted no more of the subject.

连连摇手说道：“雪岩兄，再莫谈妒律！不然我就变成罪魁祸首了。”
Waving his hands, he said, “Brother Xueyan, no more of the Code of Jealousy, or I shall become the chief culprit.”

胡雪岩笑一笑不答，神态闲豫。
Hu merely smiled, looking entirely at ease.

嵇鹤龄觉得事有蹊跷，
Ji felt something was amiss.

异姓手足，责无旁贷，胡家的家务，也就象自己的烦恼，
As Hu’s sworn brother he could not evade responsibility; the family’s troubles were as much his concern as his own.

因而一连干了两杯酒。
He drank two cups in succession.


“大哥！”
“Elder Brother!”

胡雪岩极其机警，看出他有不悦之色，
Hu was quick to notice his displeasure.

“你不必烦心，
“Don’t trouble yourself.

没有什么大不了的事。”
It is nothing so very serious.”

“唉！你不晓得我的处境。”嵇鹤龄说，
“You don’t understand my position,” Ji sighed.

“如果你们夫妻反目，你想我以后怎么还有脸见老伯母？”
“If you and your wife fall out, how could I ever face your mother again?”

“决不会！”胡雪岩的语气很坚定，
“We shall not,” Hu said firmly.

“决不会有什么反目之事。
“There will certainly be no rupture between us.

事缓则圆，
Give a matter time and it can be settled.

不必急在一时，
There is no need to hurry.

等我从上海回来再说，如何？”“叫我有什么话说？”嵇鹤龄报以苦笑，
Shall we leave it until I return from Shanghai?” Ji answered with a rueful smile. “What can I say?

“但望你心口如一，不要对弟妇生什么意见，听她的劝。”
I only hope you mean what you say, bear your wife no resentment and listen to her advice.”

“能听一定听，
“Where I can, I certainly shall.

不能听我也不会让她咽不下气去。”
Where I cannot, I shan’t make her swallow an unbearable grievance.”

话说到这里，至矣尽矣，彼此都不再谈，
There was nothing more to say, and they dropped the subject.

饭罢看灯，深夜归去。
After dinner they went to see the lanterns and returned late.

胡雪岩只当没事人似地，依然有说有笑地，跟他妻子大谈这一天的游踪。
Hu behaved as though nothing had happened, laughing and talking with his wife about the day’s excursions.

到了第二天，瑞云来看胡太太，她是受了嵇鹤龄的委托来传话的，说胡雪岩的态度很好，事情一定有圆满结局，请胡太太放心好了。
The next day Ruiyun visited Mrs Hu with a message from Ji: Hu’s attitude had been excellent, the matter was sure to end satisfactorily, and she need not worry.

这是宽慰的话，
These were words of reassurance.

胡太太不明就里，只是看丈夫毫无芥蒂的神情，自然相信中间人的传言。
Unaware of the true state of affairs, and seeing no trace of resentment in her husband, Mrs Hu naturally believed the mediator’s message.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（中）》第二十一章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume II — Chapter Twenty-One, concluding part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


到了动身那天，胡雪岩带着一女一婢上路，
When the day of departure came, Hu Xueyan set off with his daughter and a maid.

当夜在北新关前泊舟，
That night they moored outside Beixin Customs.

父女俩灯下吃闲食说闲活，
Father and daughter sat by the lamp, eating snacks and chatting.

做父亲的刻意笼络女儿，把个梅玉宠得依依不舍，一直不肯上床。
Hu deliberately set out to win his daughter over, indulging Meiyu so thoroughly that she could not bear to leave him and kept refusing to go to bed.

“梅王”，胡雪岩认为时机已至，这样问道：“你晓不晓得爸爸的苦处？”
“Meiyu,” he asked when he judged the moment ripe, “do you know what makes life difficult for your father?”

梅玉点点头：
She nodded.

“爸爸一年到头在外头，
“You're away all year round, Father.

自然辛苦的。”
Of course you have a hard time.”

“辛苦在其次，
“The hard work is the least of it.

每到一处地方，没有人照应，是最苦的事。
The worst thing is having no one to look after me wherever I go.

不过，这一趟不会苦了，有你陪我在一起，情形不同。”
This journey will be different, though. With you beside me, I shan't suffer.”

“那……”梅玉答道，
“Then...

“以后爸爸出门，我陪你好了。”
I'll go with you whenever you travel.”

“好倒是好，只怕办不到。”胡雪岩说，
“That would be lovely, but I'm afraid it isn't possible.

“梅玉，我说句话，你会不会动气？”
Meiyu, will you be angry if I say something?”

“不会的，爸爸，
“No, Father.

你尽管说。”
Say whatever you like.”

“我是说老实话，在家是女儿好；出门是儿子好。
“To tell the truth, a daughter is best at home, but a son is best on the road.

如果你是男的，我走东走西，一定带着你走。
If you were a boy, I'd take you wherever I went.

可惜不是。
Unfortunately, you aren't.

就算我舍不得你，你舍不得我，也不能趟趟带着你走，
Even if neither of us can bear to part, I can't take you on every journey.

第一，奶奶跟娘不放心，
First, Grandmother and your mother would worry.

第二，别人会说闲话，
Second, people would gossip.

哪有个女孩子走江湖的？
Whoever heard of a girl roaming the world?

第三，你也不方便，吃不起这个辛苦。
Third, it wouldn't be convenient for you, and you couldn't bear the hardships.

所以只好偶尔一次。”
So it can only be an occasional treat.”

梅玉不作声，只拿忧愁的眼光，看着她父亲。
Meiyu said nothing, merely looking at him with troubled eyes.


“我倒问你看，
“Let me ask you this.

假使到一处地方，有人能代替你来服侍我，
Suppose there were someone in one of the places I visit who could look after me in your place.

你觉得怎么样？”
What would you think?”

梅玉不明他的意思，
Meiyu did not grasp his meaning.

只直觉的答道：“那自然好罗！”
She simply answered instinctively, “Of course that would be good!”

“乖！”
“Good girl!”

胡雪岩愉悦的拍拍她的肩，
Delighted, Hu patted her shoulder.

“真正是我的好女儿。”
“You're truly a good daughter to me.”

于是第二天胡雪岩吩咐船家，先到湖州去弯一弯，再直放松江。
Accordingly, the next day he told the boatman to make a detour to Huzhou before proceeding directly to Songjiang.

“咦，爸爸，”梅玉不解而问，“怎么忽然想到湖州去，为啥？”
“But Father,” Meiyu asked in bewilderment, “why have you suddenly decided to go to Huzhou?”

“为了你，我要到湖州去一趟。”
“It's for your sake that I must go there.”

这话越发令人困惑，
This only puzzled her more.

“为我？”
“For my sake?”

十五岁的梅玉，情窦初开，
At fifteen, Meiyu was beginning to think of love.

忽然想到，是不是要把自己“许人家”，所以到湖州去弯一弯？
Suddenly she wondered whether they were going to Huzhou because her father meant to arrange a marriage for her.

这样一想，顿觉忸怩万状，脸也红了，心也跳，话也说不清楚！
The thought made her painfully shy: her face flushed, her heart raced, and she could scarcely get her words out.

这一下轮到做父亲的感觉诧异，
Now it was her father's turn to be surprised.

回想一想自己说过的话，才知道梅玉起了误会。
Only after recalling what he had said did he realize that she had misunderstood.

这是个令人好笑的误会，但他不敢笑出来，
It was an amusing mistake, but he dared not laugh.

然而此时也不便深谈，
Nor was this the moment to explain at length.

因为梅王心神不定，不能去细想他的话，就得不到他想到的效果。
Meiyu was too unsettled to consider his words carefully, and he would not achieve the effect he wanted.


于是，他说：“是为我的事，
“It's about something of my own,” he said.

我要你替我去拿个主意。”
“I want you to help me decide.”

原来是这样！
So that was it!

自己完全弄错了，
She had been entirely mistaken.

想想有些惭愧，又有些爽然若失，心里说不出是什么味道？
She felt a little ashamed and a little disappointed, without quite knowing what to make of her feelings.

只有一点是她能抓得住的，就是深怕她父亲发觉她的误会。
One thing alone was clear: she dreaded her father's discovering her mistake.

还好！她看不出她父亲有何异样的表情，
Fortunately, she could detect nothing unusual in his expression.

一颗心放了下来，定定神问道：“爸爸，什么事要我拿主意。”
Reassured, she composed herself and asked, “What do you want me to decide, Father?”

“说来话长。
“It's a long story.

等吃过饭，我慢慢跟你细谈。”
After we've eaten, I'll tell you everything.”

饭罢睡了一个午觉，起来天倒又快黑了，
They took a nap after the meal, and by the time they woke it was almost dark again.

彤云密布，大有雪意，
Heavy clouds covered the sky, promising snow.

胡雪岩叫早早泊了船，命船家到岸上去买了一尾鲜鱼，一大块羊肉，
Hu ordered an early halt and sent the boatman ashore for a fresh fish and a large piece of mutton.

恰好有人猎获野味经过，胡雪岩买了一只雉鸡、一只野鸭。
Someone happened to pass with game from a hunt, and Hu bought a pheasant and a wild duck as well.

这顿晚饭就非常丰盛了。
Their supper was therefore sumptuous.

“今天还不错！”胡雪岩举杯在手，慢慢说道：
“Today hasn't been bad,” he said slowly, his wine cup in his hand.

“你不要以为出门都是这样子舒服！
“Don't imagine that travelling is always so comfortable.

今天是因为有你，我的兴致比较好，
I'm in better spirits today because you're here.

有时候要赶路，错过地方，荒村野岸，什么也没有，
Sometimes, when I'm in a hurry, we pass the last place where we could have stopped and find ourselves beside some deserted village or desolate bank, with nothing to be had.

就只好冲碗酱油汤吃冷饭了。”
Then I have to mix a bowl of soup from soy sauce and eat cold rice.”

父亲出门是如此苦法！
Was this how her father suffered on his travels?

梅玉心里好生疼怜，
Meiyu's heart filled with pity.

虽未说话，手中那双筷子的动作就慢了，一筷一筷拨着饭粒，却不送进口去。
She said nothing, but her chopsticks slowed, picking at the grains without carrying them to her mouth.

“你吃嘛！”
“Go on, eat!”

胡雪岩夹了一块红烧羊肉放在她碗里，
Hu placed a piece of braised mutton in her bowl.

“在家千日好，出外一时难。
“A thousand days at home are pleasant; a single hour away can be hard.

你娘不晓得我在外头的苦楚，
Your mother doesn't know what I suffer when I'm away.

你该晓得了？”
Now you understand, don't you?”

梅玉点点头，
Meiyu nodded.

她并不觉得苦，只是她父亲说苦，她也就隐隐然觉得行路难了。
She had felt no hardship herself, but since her father spoke of suffering, she too began vaguely to sense how difficult travelling could be.


“梅玉！”
“Meiyu!”

胡雪岩急转直下他说，
Hu abruptly came to the point.

“你是我的大女儿，但我当你儿子看待。
“You're my eldest daughter, but I treat you as a son.

现在我湖州有个人，要你去看看，
There's someone in Huzhou I want you to meet.

你说好，我就留下来，
If you approve of her, I'll keep her.

你说不好，我叫她走！”
If you don't, I'll tell her to leave.”

梅王一时不解所谓，
For a moment Meiyu did not understand.

转一转念头才知道所说的“有个人”是什么人？
Then she realized what sort of “someone” he meant.

她也隐隐约约听说过，父亲在湖州娶了个人，
She had heard vague reports that her father had married a woman in Huzhou.

问她母亲，母亲反叱斥她“少管闲事”，
When she asked her mother, she had only been scolded and told to mind her own business.

如今听父亲是这样子说，倒有些不大相信。
Now her father's words seemed almost unbelievable.

“真的？”
“Really?”

是问那人“人”的去留，真的凭自己一言而决？
She meant: could this woman's staying or going truly depend on a word from her?

胡雪岩懂她的意思，
Hu understood.

正色答道，“当然是真的！
“Of course,” he replied solemnly.

我跟你娘说不清楚。
“I can't make your mother understand.

只有跟你商量。”
I can only discuss it with you.”

“我……”
“I...”

梅玉不知道怎么说了，
Meiyu did not know what to say.

心里只想帮父亲的忙，却苦于无从表达，
She wanted only to help him, but could find no way to express it.

愣了一会才问：“是怎么个人？”
After staring blankly for a while, she asked, “What sort of person is she?”

“她叫芙蓉。”
“Her name is Furong.”

接着，胡雪岩便大谈芙蓉人如何好，命如何苦！使得梅玉除却芙蓉，就不会想别的念头了。
He then spoke at length of Furong's goodness and the hardships of her life, until Meiyu could think of nothing else.


谈到最后，胡雪岩问道：“梅王，你说这个人怎么样？”
When he had finished, Hu asked, “Well, Meiyu, what do you think of her?”

“这个人，”梅玉答说，
“This woman...

“爸爸，你怎么跟她认识的？”
Father, how did you come to know her?”

这其中的曲折，做父亲的就不肯细说了，
Her father was unwilling to explain all the circumstances.

“也是人家做的媒。
“Someone made the match.

说我每次到湖州，没有个歇脚的地方，没有个照料起居的人，应该立个门户，
They said that whenever I went to Huzhou, I had nowhere to rest and no one to see to my daily needs, so I ought to establish a household there.

做大生意的人，都是这样子的，
Men with large businesses all do it.

不足为奇。”胡雪岩又说，
There's nothing unusual about it.

“我看她人还不错，而且人家讲的话，也是实在情形，就接了她来住。
I thought she seemed a good person, and what they said was true, so I brought her to live there.

不过讲明在先，要等我跟我女儿谈过，等你答应了，才能算数。”
But I made one thing clear beforehand: nothing was settled until I'd spoken to my daughter and obtained your agreement.”

再一次提到这话，使梅玉有受宠若惊以及感惧不胜之感，
Hearing this again left Meiyu overwhelmed, both grateful and frightened by the honour.

“怎么说要我答应？”
“Why should you need my agreement?”

她摇摇头，
She shook her head.

“我哪里敢来管爸爸的事？”
“How would I dare interfere in your affairs?”

“你不敢管，我还非要你管不可。
“You may not dare, but I insist that you do.

为啥呢？”
Why?”

胡雪岩喝口酒，一层层往下说，
Hu sipped his wine and explained point by point.

“第一当然要告诉奶奶，
“First, of course, I must tell Grandmother.

奶奶答应了，还要你娘答应。
If she agrees, your mother must agree too.

你娘答应了，我还要问你，
And even after your mother agrees, I still want to ask you.

我不愿意家里有哪个跟她不和。
I don't want anyone in our family to be at odds with her.

你懂不懂我的意思？”
Do you understand?”

“我懂。”梅王答道，
“I do.

“面和心不和，大家都难过。”
If people seem friendly but don't feel it, everyone is unhappy.”

“就是这话罗！
“Exactly!

我为啥非要你管不可呢？
And why must you take a hand?

因为奶奶最听你的话，你娘也不能不问你的意思。
Because Grandmother listens to you more than anyone, and your mother can't ignore your opinion either.

所以将来要你从中说话，事情才会顺利。”
If you speak for us, things will go smoothly.”


梅玉从来没有为人这么重视过，
No one had ever attached such importance to Meiyu before.

自觉责无旁贷，当时答道：“爸爸这么说，我回去就先跟奶奶讲。”
She felt that the responsibility was hers alone and answered at once, “Since you say so, Father, I'll speak to Grandmother as soon as we get home.”

“你预备怎么讲法？”
“What will you tell her?”

梅玉想了想答道：
She considered.

“我说她是好人，蛮可怜的。”
“I'll say she's a good person and very unfortunate.”

“怎么好法呢？
“Good in what way?

奶奶问你，你见过没有，你怎么说？
What will you say if Grandmother asks whether you've met her?

所以我一定要带你去看了她再谈。”
That's why I must take you to see her before we discuss it further.”

到此光景，胡雪岩已有把握，女儿是自己的不叛之臣，
By now Hu was confident that his daughter was his unwavering ally.

只是父女之情是一回事，梅玉看芙蓉怎么样，又是一回事。
Yet affection for her father was one thing; what Meiyu would think of Furong was another.

所以此时他的心思，抛开了梅玉，在思索着应该怎么安排，才能让芙蓉跟梅玉一见投缘？
His thoughts therefore left Meiyu for the moment as he considered how to arrange matters so that the two would take to one another at their first meeting.


一夜过去，第二天午前就可抵达湖州，
After another night, they would reach Huzhou before noon.

事先他把在湖州的朋友和关系，如何称呼，都细细告诉了梅玉。
Beforehand, Hu carefully explained his friends and connections there and how Meiyu should address each of them.

等船泊下，先把梅玉带到郁四家暂时安顿，
Once the boat was moored, he took her to Yu Si's house to settle her there for the moment.

见了面，梅玉叫郁四为“四伯伯”，阿七是“七阿姨”。
She greeted Yu as “Fourth Uncle” and A’qi as “Auntie Seven.”

六阿姨对这些事上最聪明，
A’qi was particularly astute in such matters.

一看胡雪岩把他女儿带到她家，便知道应有顾忌，所以绝口不提芙蓉，
Seeing that Hu had brought his daughter to her house, she knew there must be something he wished to avoid, and never mentioned Furong.

只是极殷勤地招待梅玉。
Instead, she entertained Meiyu most attentively.

她的心热，又会说话，加以胡雪岩的交情深厚，因而把梅玉看得娇贵无比，刻意取悦。
Warm-hearted and eloquent, and bound to Hu by a deep friendship, she treated his daughter as someone infinitely precious and went out of her way to please her.

梅玉当然知道，人家是看谁的面子？心里使越觉得她父亲了不起了。
Meiyu naturally knew whose standing had earned her this welcome, and admired her father all the more.

“你坐一下，
“Stay here a little while.

在七阿姨家就跟自己家一样，
Auntie Seven's house is just like your own.

不用拘束。
Make yourself at home.

我先到知府衙门去一趟，马上来接你。”
I must call at the prefectural yamen first, and then I'll come straight back for you.”

胡雪岩哪里是到知府衙门去看王有龄，
But Hu did not go to see Wang Youling.

一径来得芙蓉那里，敲门相见，
He went directly to Furong's and knocked.

芙蓉自然高兴，但眉宇间掩抑不住幽怨之色。
She was delighted to see him, though she could not quite conceal the hurt in her expression.

迎入客厅，先问行李在哪里？
Ushering him into the sitting room, she first asked where his luggage was.

“在船上。”胡雪岩说，
“On the boat.

“我住一天就走，
I'm only staying a day.

特为带个人来看你。是我大女儿。”
I've brought someone especially to see you—my eldest daughter.”

“喔！”
“Oh!”

芙蓉双目灼灼地看着他问：
Furong's eyes shone as she looked at him.

“大小姐在哪里？”
“Where is the young lady?”

“在郁家，
“At the Yus'.

回头我就带她来。
I'll bring her presently.

小孩子，
She's a child.

你骗骗她！”
Coax her a little.”

这句话芙蓉懂得，“骗骗她”就是好好敷衍笼络一番，
Furong understood: he wanted her to humour the girl and win her over.

这没有什么不可以，
There was nothing difficult about that.

“我会对付。”她说，
“I can manage,” she said.

“这是小事情。”
“That's a small matter.”


什么是大事呢？
What was the great matter, then?

她认为胡雪岩的态度和打算，一定先要弄清楚。
Furong felt that Hu's attitude and intentions must first be made clear.

她三叔所转达的话，语焉不详，只说“放心”，却不知如何才能叫人放得下心？
The message her Third Uncle had conveyed was vague: he had merely told her not to worry, without saying what grounds she had for reassurance.

她首先问的就是这一点。
This was the first thing she asked.

这话不是三言两语所谈得完的，
It could not be settled in a few words.

两人携手并坐在床沿上，胡雪岩先问到他妻子寻上门来的经过。
Hand in hand, they sat beside each other on the edge of the bed, and Hu first asked what had happened when his wife came to the house.

“那天我在家做年糕，说有个胡太太来了！”芙蓉用委委屈屈的声音说，
“I was making New Year cakes when someone said a Mrs Hu had called,” Furong began in an aggrieved voice.

“一见面就说：”我家老爷叫胡雪岩。
“As soon as we met, she said, ‘My husband's name is Hu Xueyan.’

‘我一听心里就发慌。
I panicked.

这样不明不白的身分，实在不是味道。
Having no clear standing like this is really unbearable.

唉！“她叹口气，眼圈便有些红了。
Ah!” She sighed, and her eyes began to redden.

胡雪岩见此光景，颇为着急，
Hu grew anxious at the sight.

这时不是拉拉扯扯诉苦讲感情的时候，
This was no time for protracted complaints and exchanges of sentiment.

辰光不多，要扎扎实实谈办法，
Time was short; they needed practical arrangements.

但其势又不能不安慰安慰她，只好耐着心说：“你不要难过，不要难过，
Yet he had to comfort her, so he patiently said, “Don't be upset.

一切都看在我面上。
Bear it all for my sake.

你放心，
Don't worry.

我一定会安排妥贴。
I'll certainly arrange everything properly.

你先讲给我听，当时她怎么说？
First tell me what she said.”

“眨了两下眼，芙蓉又抽出一块手绢，醒了醒鼻子，
Furong blinked twice, took out a handkerchief and blew her nose.

抑制着自己的情绪谈她所遭遇的窘境：
Controlling her feelings, she described her embarrassment.

“你大太说：”上门冒昧，实在叫没法子！
“Your wife said, ‘Forgive me for coming uninvited, but I truly have no alternative.

我也晓得你是好人家的女儿，受了他的骗。
I know you're a girl from a respectable family and he's deceived you.

如今明人不必细说，
People who understand each other needn't spell everything out.

只求你可怜可怜我！
I only ask you to take pity on me.’

‘我看她的话厉害，态度倒还好，就这样回答她：“胡太太你到底啥意思，请你实说！
Her words were sharp enough, but her manner was fairly civil, so I said, ‘Mrs Hu, please tell me plainly what you mean.’

‘她听我的话，不响，从手中包里拿出一个红封套来，放在我面前，’
She said nothing, but took a red envelope from her handbag and put it before me.

这是我多年积下来的一点私房，
‘These are the little private savings I've put aside over the years.

你收了下来，我就感激不尽了。
If you'll accept them, I'll be endlessly grateful.’

‘我自然不肯收，她硬塞在我手里，
Of course I refused, but she thrust it into my hand.

又说：”雪岩一时不会来了。
Then she said, ‘Xueyan won't be coming for some time.

他有没有啥帐簿、契约之类的东西放在这里？
Has he left any account books or contracts here?

我顺便带了回去。’我说：“没有！
I can take them back with me.’ I said no.

‘她有点不大相信的样子，
She seemed doubtful.

愣了一楞说道，’我跟雪岩是患难夫妻，
After a pause she said, ‘Xueyan and I have shared hardship.

无话不谈的。
There's nothing we don't discuss.

千言并一句：大家都是女人，
To put everything in a few words: we're both women.

总要你体谅我的处境，可怜可怜我！
You must understand my position and take pity on me.

你年纪还轻，又是这样的人才，
You're still young and so good-looking.

实在犯不着做低服小。
There's really no need to accept an inferior place.’”

‘”芙蓉说到这里，略停一下，扭转脸去说：
Furong paused and turned her face away.

“我想想她的话也不错。”
“When I think about it, there's truth in what she said.”


察言观色，胡雪岩知道这句话，纵非言不由衷，也是一半牢骚，
Watching her expression and listening to her tone, Hu knew that even if she meant what she said, half of it was resentment.

便不觉得如何严重，
He therefore did not take it too seriously.

扳过她的肩来，轻轻点着她的鼻尖笑道：
Turning her by the shoulder, he lightly tapped the tip of her nose and smiled.

“你真老实无用！
“You're far too simple and helpless!

不是嫁着我这样一个人，有得苦头吃。
If you hadn't married a man like me, you'd have plenty of suffering ahead.

你说她的话不错，我倒问你，她说我不会回来了，怎么我又来了呢？
You say she was right, but answer me this: she said I wouldn't come back, so why am I here?

不但来了，我还带了女儿来。
Not only have I come, I've brought my daughter.

你说，她的话是不是大错特错？”
Doesn't that make her utterly wrong?”

“总也有些话不错的。”芙蓉答道：
“Some of what she said was right,” Furong replied.

“我实在好难，
“It's so difficult for me.

你们是患难夫妻，
You two have shared hardship as husband and wife.

我算啥？”
What am I?”

这样扯下去，交涉办不清楚了！
If they went on like this, nothing would be settled.

胡雪岩想了想，只有用快刀斩乱麻的手法，
Hu thought for a moment and decided to cut through the tangle.

“那么你倒说一句，”他问，“你到底是怎么个意思？”
“Then tell me plainly: what do you want?”

“我不是说过，
“Haven't I told you?

我好难！”
It's so difficult for me!”

这样就不必再问了，
There was no need to ask further.

“你为难，我来替你出个主意。”
“Since you're in difficulty, let me suggest a solution.”

胡雪岩故意这样问：“你看好不好？”
Deliberately, he asked, “Would you like that?”

“你说！”
“Tell me.”

“我说啊，”他这次是点点她的额头：“你仍旧跟我姓胡！”
“My suggestion”—this time he tapped her forehead—“is that you continue to bear my name, Hu.”

“也要姓得成才行呀！”
“Only if I'm allowed to!”

“怎么姓不成？
“Why shouldn't you?

胡是我的姓，
Hu is my surname.

我自己作主，
I decide who bears it.

哪个敢说一句话？”
Who dares say otherwise?”

话说到这样，芙蓉纵有千言万语，也设法再开口了。
After that, whatever else Furong might have said, she could no longer find a way to say it.

胡雪岩却还有句话，想问她一下，如果必须回杭州，与大妇合住，她的意思怎么样？
Hu had another question in mind: how would she feel if she had to return to Hangzhou and share a home with his principal wife?

但话到口边，发觉不妥，
But as it reached his lips, he saw that it would be unwise.

此时不宜节外生枝，
This was no time to introduce another complication.

先取得她的合作，一起“收服”了梅玉，才是当务之急，
The immediate task was to secure her cooperation and “conquer” Meiyu together.

其他都可以留待以后再谈。
Everything else could wait.


于是他把梅玉的性情、癖好都告诉了芙蓉。
He therefore explained Meiyu's temperament and tastes to Furong.

她一一依从，只是提出一个条件，梅玉必须认了名分，否则她不招待。
She agreed to everything, with one condition: Meiyu must acknowledge her position in the family, or she would not entertain her.

“这你放心，
“Don't worry about that.

包在我身上。”
Leave it to me.”

说完就走了。
With this assurance, he left.

回到郁四那里，只见阿珠的娘也在，
Back at Yu Si's, he found A’zhu's mother there too.

她是来串门子偶尔遇上的。
She had happened to come visiting.

梅玉跟她见过，即无陌生之感，所以反跟她谈得很起劲。
Meiyu had met her before and felt no strangeness, so she was talking to her with particular animation.

跟胡雪岩见了，自有一番寒暄。阿珠的娘要请他们父女到丝行去住，
After exchanging greetings with Hu, A’zhu's mother invited father and daughter to stay at the silk firm.

胡雪岩不肯，
He declined.

“这就不必了！”他说：
“There's no need for that.

“倒是有件事要麻烦你。
But I do have a favour to ask.

你做两样拿手菜请我女儿吃。”
Make a couple of your special dishes for my daughter.”

容易，容易！
“Easily done!

大小姐喜欢吃啥，点出来，我马上动手。
Whatever the young lady likes, she has only to name it and I'll start at once.”

“梅玉给大家一捧，乐不可支，但毕竟是十五岁的女孩子，怎么样也不肯点菜，
Meiyu was delighted by everyone's attentions, but she was still a girl of fifteen and would not be persuaded to choose.

最后是做父亲的拣女儿喜爱的，点了两样。
At last her father named two favourites for her.

两样都是炒菜，并不费事，
Both were stir-fried dishes and involved little trouble.

阿珠的娘欣然应声，又即问道：“在啥地方吃？”
A’zhu's mother agreed gladly, then asked, “Where will you be eating?”

“在芙蓉那里。”
“At Furong's.”

“炒菜要一出锅就上桌，
“Stir-fried dishes must go straight from the pan to the table.

我带材料到那里去下锅。”
I'll take the ingredients and cook them there.”

“那就多谢。
“Thank you.

我们也好走了。”
We'd better be going too.”

胡雪岩把梅平拉到僻处悄声问道：“你见了姨娘怎么叫？”
Hu drew Meiyu aside and asked quietly, “What will you call your auntie when you meet her?”


这一问把梅玉弄糊涂了，
The question bewildered Meiyu.

明明已说了是“姨娘”，还怎么叫？
He had already said “auntie”; what else was she to call her?

“不叫姨娘叫啥？”她问。
“What would I call her except Auntie?” she asked.

胡雪岩原是暗示的手法，
Hu had intended to plant the suggestion.

听得梅玉这么说，便即笑道：
At her answer, he smiled.

“我当你不肯叫她姨娘呢！”
“I thought perhaps you might refuse to call her that.”

“肯叫的！”
“I will!”

梅玉重重地点头。
Meiyu nodded emphatically.

“你姨娘脾气最好。
“Your auntie has the sweetest temper.

在湖州，我都靠她服侍，
In Huzhou, I depend on her to look after me.

这也就等于代替我服侍我，所以你见了面，最好谢谢她。
That means she looks after me in your place, so you ought to thank her when you meet.

这是做人的道理。”
That's the proper way to behave.”

“好的。”
“Yes.”

梅玉想了想，又说一句：“好的。”
Meiyu thought for a moment, then repeated, “Yes.”

于是胡雪岩放心大胆地带了女儿到芙蓉那里。
Reassured, Hu took his daughter to Furong's without further misgivings.

两乘轿子到门，就听芙蓉在喊：“抬进来，
As their two sedan chairs reached the gate, they heard Furong calling, “Bring them inside!

抬进来！”
Bring them inside!”

轿子抬进大门，厅前放下，
The chairs were carried through the gate and set down before the hall.

她走到第二乘前面，亲自揭开轿帘，
Furong went to the second and lifted the curtain herself.

梅玉已经在轿中张望过了，
Meiyu had already been peeping out.

觉得这位新姨娘就是皮肤黑了些，论相貌实在不坏，
This new auntie was a little dark-skinned, but really quite good-looking.

恍然意会，怪不得父亲这么“舍不得她”！
Suddenly she understood: no wonder her father was so unwilling to part with her!


“大小姐！”芙蓉含笑说道，“没有想到你来。”
“My dear young lady,” Furong said with a smile, “I never expected you to come.”

梅玉自然有些腼腆，
Meiyu naturally felt shy.

报以羞涩的一笑，跨出轿门，才低低叫了声：“姨娘！”
She answered with a bashful smile, stepped out of the chair and only then murmured, “Auntie.”

听得这一声，芙蓉也不好意思老实答应，
At this greeting, Furong was too embarrassed to accept the title without demur.

搀着她的手说：“来，来！到里面坐。
Taking Meiyu's hand, she said, “Come inside and sit down.

你冷不冷？”
Are you cold?”

说着便又去捏她的肩臂，
She felt the girl's shoulders and upper arms.

“穿得少了！
“You're wearing too little.

看我新做的一件丝绵袄能不能穿！”
Let's see whether you can wear my new silk-padded jacket.”

“谢谢姨娘！”
“Thank you, Auntie!”

梅玉趁机把父亲教的那句话，说了出来：
Meiyu seized the opportunity to repeat the words her father had taught her.

“平常多亏姨娘照应！”
“You've been so kind in looking after things all this time.”

话说得不够清楚，但意思可以明白，既说“平常多号姨娘照应”，则照应的一定是胡雪岩，不是此时照应梅玉。
She had not expressed herself very clearly, but her meaning could be understood: the person looked after “all this time” must be Hu, not Meiyu on this first visit.

芙蓉听得她这话，自然安慰，
Furong naturally felt comforted.

但也有感想，由女及母，认为梅玉有这样的教养，可以想见胡太太治家是一把好手。
Yet she also drew a conclusion about the mother from the daughter: a girl brought up so well suggested that Mrs Hu was an excellent mistress of her household.

因为有此想法，更不敢把梅玉当个孩子看待，
This made her still less inclined to treat Meiyu as merely a child.

领入她自己卧室，很客气地招呼，左一个“大小姐”，右一个“大小姐”，连梅玉自己都觉得有点刺耳。
She led her into her own bedroom and entertained her most courteously, addressing her as “young lady” at every turn, until even Meiyu found it grating.
