“Auntie, just call me Meiyu.”

芙蓉还待谦虚，刚刚跟了进来的胡雪岩恰好听见，
Furong was about to demur again when Hu, entering behind them, happened to hear.

难得梅玉自己松口，认为机不可失，因而接口说道：
It was a rare opening, offered by Meiyu herself, and he must not miss it.

“对了！
“Exactly!

自己亲人，
You're family.

‘小姐、小姐’的倒叫得生疏了。”
All this ‘young lady’ makes you sound like strangers.”

芙蓉接受了暗示，点点头说：
Furong took the hint and nodded.

“那么，我就老实了。
“Then I shall.

梅玉，你来，试试这件丝绵袄看！”
Meiyu, come and try this silk-padded jacket.”


拉开衣橱，芙蓉的衣服不少，取下一件葱绿缎子的新丝绵袄，
She opened her wardrobe, which held a good many clothes, and took down a new jacket of pale green satin padded with silk floss.

往梅玉身上一披，看来长了些，袖口也嫌太大，不合穿，
Laid over Meiyu's shoulders, it proved rather long, with sleeves too wide to fit her.

倒是有件玫瑰紫宁绸面子的灰鼠皮背心，恰恰合身，
A grey-squirrel-fur waistcoat faced with rose-purple Ning silk, however, fitted perfectly.

芙蓉等她穿了上去，就不肯让她脱下来了。
Once Meiyu had it on, Furong would not let her take it off.

“姨娘的好衣服，”梅玉非常高兴，但有些过意不去，
“But it's one of Auntie's good things,” Meiyu said, delighted yet uneasy about accepting it.

望着她父亲说：“我不要！”
Looking at her father, she added, “I mustn't keep it.”

“一样的。”胡雪岩很快的说：
“It makes no difference,” Hu answered promptly.

“你姨娘比你娘还要疼你！”
“Your auntie loves you even more than your mother does.”

就这一句话，把梅玉跟芙蓉拴得紧紧的，
That single remark bound them closely together.

两个人形影不离，象一双友爱的姊妹花。
They became inseparable, like two affectionate sisters.

胡雪岩宽心大放，觉得自己不必再操心了，
Hu felt entirely relieved and decided he need worry no further.

时贵如金，不肯虚耗，
His time was as precious as gold, and he would not waste it.

随即到知府衙门去看王有龄。
He immediately went to the prefectural yamen to see Wang Youling.

“你有几天耽搁？”王有龄问。
“How long can you stay?” Wang asked.

“想明天就走。”
“I was thinking of leaving tomorrow.”

“何以如此匆忙？”王有龄说，
“Why such a hurry?

“能不能多住几天？”
Couldn't you stay a few days longer?”

不来倒也罢了，来了自然有许多话谈，估量一夜也谈不完，
Had he not come, it would not have mattered; now he was here, there was naturally much to discuss, probably more than a single evening would allow.

胡雪岩便说：“我多住一天吧！”
“I'll stay one extra day,” Hu said.

接着，他把此行的目的和他的家务，细细说了一遍。
Then he explained in detail the purpose of his journey and his family affairs.


“你真厉害！”王有龄笑道：
“You really are formidable!” Wang said, laughing.

“内人最佩服尊夫人，
“My wife admires yours above all women.

在你手里就如孙行者遇着了如来佛。”
Yet in your hands she's like Sun Wukong meeting the Buddha.”

“还未可乐观。”
“It's too soon to celebrate.”

胡雪岩摇摇头：
Hu shook his head.

“孙行者还有一招，连如来佛怕也招架不住。”
“Sun Wukong still has one trick that even the Buddha might find hard to counter.”

“哪一招？”
“What trick?”

“她要将芙蓉接回去一起往。”
“She wants to bring Furong home to live with us.”

“那么，你的意思呢？”
“And what do you think?”

“我想，还是照现在这样子最好。”
“I'd rather leave things as they are.”

“走着看吧！”王有龄劝他：
“See how matters go,” Wang advised.

“真的非一起住不可的时候，你也只好将就。”
“If there really is no alternative to living together, you'll have to make the best of it.”

“我不是怕别的，
“It isn't anything else that worries me.

芙蓉太老实，决不是内人的对手，
Furong is too simple-hearted and no match for my wife.

我又常年在外，
I'm away all year round.

怕她吃亏。”
I'm afraid she'll suffer.”

王有龄想了想说：
Wang considered.

“如果只是为了这一层，我倒有个计较，
“If that's your only concern, I have an idea.

眼前且不必说，
But we needn't discuss it yet.

我问你，你跟龚家父子是怎么回事？”
Tell me, what has been going on between you and the Gongs?”


“喔，我正要跟你说。”胡雪岩先反问一句：
“Oh, I was just going to tell you.

“你必是听到了什么话！”
You must have heard something.”

“很多。不过大致都还好。”王有龄说，
“A great deal, though on the whole it's favourable.

“龚家父子虽是同乡，我并不袒护他们，
The Gongs come from my home district, but I don't take their side.

说实话也不甚投缘。
To tell the truth, we don't get on particularly well.

这父子俩手段甚辣，因此他们这一趟吃了你的亏，颇有人为之称快。”
Father and son can be ruthless, so quite a few people are pleased that you've got the better of them this time.”

胡雪岩听了这话，颇为不安。
This made Hu uneasy.

他的宗旨是不得罪人，进一步能帮人的忙一定帮。
His rule was to offend no one and, beyond that, to help anyone he could.

做生意脱不了与官场打交道，尤其是做大生意，
Business inevitably involved dealing with officials, especially business on a large scale.

只要小小一点留难，就可以影响全局，因而更不愿得罪官场。
The slightest obstruction could affect an entire undertaking, so he was particularly anxious not to antagonize officialdom.

在这方面他颇下过潜察默会的功夫，深知人言可畏，
He had spent much effort observing and studying these matters quietly and knew how dangerous gossip could be.

甲与乙原无芥蒂，但如有人传说，乙如何如何与甲不睦，结果连甲自己都胡里胡涂，真的当乙不够朋友了。
Two men might have no quarrel at all, but once someone spread stories that the second was hostile to the first, even the first might become confused and begin to think the other had failed him as a friend.

这就叫“疑心生暗鬼”。
This was what people meant by suspicion conjuring ghosts.

他自己虽常引以为警惕，遇到有人在背后道人是非。 不愿轻听，
Hu constantly reminded himself of the danger and would not readily credit malicious talk behind someone's back.

可是他无法期望别人也象他这样明智，所以这时不能不作辩白。
But he could not expect everyone else to be equally sensible, and he therefore had to explain.

“那么，雪公，你倒说，龚家父子是不是吃了我的亏？”
“Then tell me, Mr Xuexuan: do you believe I've caused the Gongs a loss?”

“我想，你不是那样的人！”
“I don't think you're that sort of man.”

“知我者雪公！”
“You understand me!”

胡雪岩略感欣慰，“龚家父子不但不曾吃亏。
Somewhat reassured, Hu continued, “They haven't lost anything through me.

而且我还帮了他的忙。”接着胡雪岩把买洋枪一案的来龙去脉，都讲了给王有龄听。
On the contrary, I've helped them.” He then told Wang the whole story of the gun purchase.


王有龄一面听，一面不断的点头，
Wang listened, nodding repeatedly.

认为胡雪岩这件事，做得面面俱到，相当采贴。
He felt that Hu had considered every side of the matter and handled it very well.

接着由洋枪谈到湖州的团练，盛赞赵景贤了不起。
From the guns they turned to Huzhou's militia, and Wang warmly praised Zhao Jingxian's abilities.

提到这上头，他相当欣慰，
This subject gave him particular satisfaction.

因为各地办团练，官绅的意见，常有扦格，唯独湖州是个例外，
Elsewhere, officials and gentry often disagreed over the organization of militia; Huzhou alone was an exception.

彼此合作无间，处事相当痛快。
Here they worked together without friction, and business could be conducted very pleasantly.

“我曾细想过，这有两个原因，
“I've thought this over carefully, and there are two reasons.

第一，赵景紧本人的功名有限，
First, Zhao's examination standing is limited.

倘或他是带过红顶子的在籍绅士，还忘不了在‘马上’的威风，隐隐然以为我必得象伺候现任一、二品大员那样去仰他的鼻息，
If he were a local gentleman who had once worn a red finial and could not forget the authority he had enjoyed in office, he might expect me to wait upon him and bow to his wishes as though he were still a serving official of the first or second rank.

那就谈不拢了。
Then we'd never agree.

其次，要归功于你，
Second, the credit belongs to you.

雪岩，不是我捧场、”
Xueyan, this is no empty praise.”

王有龄很恳切地说：
Wang spoke earnestly.

“做生意能干的也有，未见得懂公事。
“There are capable merchants, but they don't necessarily understand public affairs.

了解做官的苦衷和想法，只有你，无不精通。
You alone understand every difficulty an official faces and everything he thinks.

这又要说到洋沧了，
That brings us back to the foreign guns.

赵景贤看我能留意于此，颇为佩服，其实，他不知道是你的功劳。”
Zhao admires me for giving attention to them, but he doesn't know that the credit is yours.”

“既无功，又无劳。
“I've neither earned credit nor done any work.

象这些事，在雪公面前，我不敢说假话，
With you, Mr Xuexuan, I wouldn't pretend otherwise.

无非顺带公文一角。
All I've done is carry an official letter on a journey I was making anyway.

这趟我到上海，如果有事，我还可以代办。”
If there's anything you need in Shanghai this time, I can attend to it too.”

“我想留你多住两天，正就是为此。
“That's precisely why I wanted you to stay another couple of days.

湖州地方富庶，大家也热心，
Huzhou is prosperous, and everyone is eager to help.

团练的经费相当充足。
The militia is well funded.

我想托你办一批军装，
I'd like you to procure a consignment of military equipment.

明天交单于给你，
I'll give you the list tomorrow.

请你先访一访价。”
Please inquire about prices first.”

“这容易。
“Easily done.

我一到上海就可以办好。”
I can attend to it as soon as I reach Shanghai.”


“还有件事，这件事比较麻烦。”
“There's something else, rather more troublesome.”

王有龄放低了声音说：
Wang lowered his voice.

“ ‘江夏’有动的消息，
“There are reports that ‘Jiangxia’ may be transferred.

我得要早自为计。”
I must think ahead.”

“江夏？”
“Jiangxia?”

胡雪岩弄不明白。
Hu did not understand.

“江夏黄！”
“Huang of Jiangxia!”

这一说胡雪岩才知道是指黄宗汉。
Only then did Hu realize that he meant Huang Zonghan.

官场中好用隐语，尤其是指到大人物，
Officials liked to speak in coded references, especially when mentioning great men.

或者用地名，或者用郡名，或者用一个古人来代替，
They might substitute a place name, an ancestral commandery or the name of an ancient figure.

说破了不希奇，但肚子里墨水不多，还真不知人家说的是啥？
Once explained, these references were nothing remarkable, but without much book learning one really might have no idea whom they meant.

这一点是自己的一短。
This was a weakness of his own.

看起来虽不能“八十岁学吹鼓手”再去好好念两天书，至少也得常跟嵇鹤龄这样的人请教请教。
He could hardly start learning again at his age, like a man of eighty taking up the profession of trumpeter and drummer, but he ought at least to consult men such as Ji Heling more often.

这是附带引起的感想，暂且抛开，
This was an incidental reflection, and he put it aside.

为王有龄的前程打算，是跟自己切身利害有关的大事，
Wang's future was a matter intimately connected with his own interests.

胡雪岩不敢轻忽，很用了些心思。
He dared not treat it lightly and gave it serious thought.


“怎么？”看他久久不语，王有龄便问：
After a long silence, Wang asked, “What is it?

“你另有想法？”
Have you another idea?”

“我想先请问雪公，‘江夏’到底待你怎么样？”
“First, may I ask how ‘Jiangxia’ has treated you, Mr Xuexuan?”

“总算不错。”
“Quite well, on the whole.”

“那么是希望他留任了？”
“Then you'd like him to stay?”

“这也不然。”王有龄答道：
“Not necessarily.

“此人甚难伺候。
He's a very difficult man to serve.

如果换个人来，于我无碍，我倒巴不得他早早动身。”
If someone else could replace him without harming my position, I'd be only too glad to see him leave.”

“我懂了！”
“I understand.”

胡雪岩点点头说：
Hu nodded.

“最妙不过，何学使能调到浙江来。”
“The best thing of all would be to have Education Commissioner He transferred to Zhejiang.”

何学使是指何桂清，
He meant He Guiqing.

听他这一说，王有龄猛然一拍大腿。
At these words Wang slapped his thigh.

“真的！”他极兴奋地说：
“Of course!” he exclaimed.

“真正是‘一言惊醒梦中人’！
“You've woken the dreamer with a single word!

倒不妨问问他看。”
We might ask him.”

“不是问，是劝！”胡雪岩说，
“Urge him, rather than ask,” Hu replied.

“劝何学使趁早活动。
“Urge him to start making arrangements as soon as possible.

自然要一笔花费，
Naturally, that will cost money.

我们替他想办法。”
We'll find a way to provide it.”

这下是王有龄凝神不语了。
Now it was Wang's turn to fall silent in thought.

一面想，一面又微笑，又点头，一副欣然有得的神情，
As he considered, he smiled and nodded, plainly delighted by what he saw.

使得胡雪岩暗暗得意，能使人颠倒如此！
Hu felt secretly pleased that he could move a man so deeply.


“你的主意真不坏！
“That's an excellent idea!

我想何根云一定乐从。
I believe He Genyun would gladly agree.

第一，学政虽也是二品官儿，到底不及巡抚是方面大员，
First, although an education commissioner holds the second rank, he is still not the equal of a governor in charge of a whole province.

第二，江苏到底是危疆，
Second, Jiangsu is a dangerous province.

浙江虽不及江苏大，毕竟兵火未及，而况军务部署，已有基础，
Zhejiang may be smaller, but war has not yet reached it, and its military arrangements already have a foundation.

只要‘保境安民’四个字能够做到，前程大有可观。
If he can simply ‘defend the province and keep the people at peace’, his prospects will be splendid.

何乐不为。”
Why shouldn't he do it?”

“那一来，”胡雪岩笑着揭破他心里的话，“雪公知府‘过班’，就轻而易举了。”
“And then,” Hu said with a smile, exposing the thought behind Wang's words, “it would be easy for you to move beyond the prefectural grade.”

“当然！
“Of course!

调首府也在意中。”王有龄说、
A transfer to the prefecture containing the provincial capital would also be possible.

“这件事，最好是我自己去，不过越省为人代谋，风声太大，
I ought to go myself, but if I crossed the provincial boundary to promote another man's appointment, it would attract too much attention.

‘江夏’的气量狭，在定大不高兴，
‘Jiangxia’ is narrow-minded and would certainly be displeased.

此外，只有雪岩，
Apart from myself, there is only you.

你替我去走一趟如何？”
Would you make the journey for me?”

胡雪岩有些踌躇，
Hu hesitated.

因为时间上实在抽不出空，
He truly could not spare the time.

上海的生意急待料理，而何桂清还不知在何处，
Business in Shanghai urgently needed attention, and they did not even know where He Guiqing was.

江苏学政原驻江阴，自从太平天国一出现，江阴存身不住，流徙不定，
The Jiangsu education commissioner had originally been based at Jiangyin, but since the emergence of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom he had been unable to remain there and had moved from place to place.

同时因为道路艰难，要去找他，怕要费好些周折。
With the roads so difficult, finding him might involve a great deal of trouble.

看他面有难色，王有龄自然体谅，便改变了一个主意：
Seeing his reluctance, Wang understood and changed his proposal.

“这样吧，我亲笔写封信，
“Then I'll write a personal letter.

请你带到上海，雇专人投递如何？”
Take it to Shanghai and hire a special messenger to deliver it. How would that be?”

“这当然遵办。”胡雪岩问道：
“Certainly.

“就不知道何学使此刻驻节在哪里？”
But where is the commissioner staying at present?”

“想来应该在苏州。
“Presumably Suzhou.

你到上海再打听吧！”
Inquire when you reach Shanghai.”


这样说定了，又谈了与彼此利益有关的事，
With that settled, they discussed other matters affecting their interests.

等胡雪岩告辞时，已经深度，
It was late at night when Hu took his leave.

王有龄用他自己的轿子，派四名亲兵，持着官衔灯笼，送他回去。
Wang sent him home in his own sedan chair, accompanied by four personal guards carrying lanterns inscribed with his official title.

到家一看，芙蓉和梅玉都还未睡。
At home, Hu found Furong and Meiyu still awake.

“怎么样？”胡雪岩笑着问道，“你们在家做些什么？”
“Well,” he asked cheerfully, “what have you two been doing?”

“姨娘跟我在描花样，要做一双鞋子，孝敬奶奶。”
“Auntie and I have been tracing patterns for a pair of shoes to give Grandmother.”

“哪个做？”他问，“是你还是你姨娘？”
“Who will make them—you or your auntie?”

“我倒想跟姨娘学了做，哪里有工夫呢？”
“I'd like to learn from Auntie, but where would I find the time?”

这句话触动了胡雪岩的灵机，
This gave Hu an idea.

偷空把芙蓉找到一边，叮嘱她把梅玉留了下来，
Finding a chance to draw Furong aside, he urged her to persuade Meiyu to stay.

胡雪岩原就觉得带着梅玉，是个累赘，
He had thought all along that taking his daughter with him would be an encumbrance.

只是另有作用，不能不编一套正大光明的理由，
But he had another use for her and had been obliged to invent an entirely respectable reason for bringing her.

如今看梅玉与芙蓉投缘，便乐得改变主意。
Now that she and Furong had taken to one another, he was happy to change his plan.

“就怕她不肯，徒然碰个钉子。”
“I'm only afraid she won't agree, and I'll be rebuffed for nothing.”

“碰就碰。
“Let her refuse.

这也不是什么大不了的事。”胡雪岩说。
It isn't such a serious matter.

“你眼光要放远来！
You must look further ahead.

预备在胡家过日子，就得先拿梅玉收服，
If you mean to spend your life in the Hu family, first win Meiyu over.

她是老大，
She's the eldest.

将来帮着你说两句话，很有用的。“
A word or two from her on your behalf will be very useful in future.”


想想不错！
That was true, Furong reflected.

姑老爷姑太太是“公亲”，
Married daughters and their husbands counted as impartial family arbiters.

分家之类的家务，总是请“公亲”到场，主持公道。
When property was divided or other family affairs settled, they were invited to attend and uphold fairness.

娘家人是“私亲”，不能出场的，
A wife's own relatives were interested parties and could not take such a role.

为将来着想，这时候值得在梅玉身上下番功夫。
For the sake of the future, it was worth making an effort over Meiyu now.

于是这一夜胡雪岩孤眠独宿，
That night, therefore, Hu slept alone.

芙蓉找了梅玉一起同床，刻意笼络，
Furong took Meiyu to share her bed and deliberately set out to win her affection.

把梅玉说动了心，只要父亲答应，她愿意在芙蓉这里住些日子。
Meiyu was won over: if her father agreed, she would willingly stay there for a while.

明明是做父亲的出的主意，而提到这话，却还犹豫作态。
Though the plan had been his own, Hu affected hesitation when it was put to him.

最后算是允许了，答应从上海回来时，先到湖州来把她带回杭州。
At last he granted permission, promising to stop in Huzhou on his return from Shanghai and take her back to Hangzhou.

倘或上海逗留的日子过久，而梅玉思归时，便由陈世龙护送回去。
If he stayed too long in Shanghai and Meiyu grew homesick, Chen Shilong would escort her home.

芙蓉的事，在胡雪岩仿佛下棋，
To Hu, Furong's situation was like a game of chess.

摆了下梅玉这粒子。胜券可操，不妨暂时丢开，
With Meiyu now placed on the board, victory was assured, and he could leave the matter for the time being.

自己计算了一下，为这桩家务，耽误的工夫已多，便不肯多作勾留。
Calculating how much time these domestic affairs had already cost him, he would linger no longer.

这一天跟郁四匆匆一晤，到钱庄里看了一下，
That day he had a hurried meeting with Yu Si and looked in at the bank.

连丝行的事都无暇过问，
He had no time even to inquire about the silk firm's affairs.

当天便拿了王有龄的信。和采办军装的单子下了船，吩咐多雇水手，连夜赶路，直放松江。
Taking Wang's letter and the list of military equipment to purchase, he boarded his boat that same day, ordered extra boatmen hired and travelled through the night, straight for Songjiang.


“你来到正巧！”尤五一见面，就这样说，
“You've come at just the right moment!” You Laowu exclaimed when they met.

“丝茶两项，这几天行情大涨，
“Silk and tea prices have risen sharply these last few days.

机会好极！”
It's an excellent opportunity!”

“怎么？”胡雪岩问：
“What is it?” Hu asked.

“是不是有什么禁运的消息？”
“Is there news of a ban on shipments?”

“对呀！
“Exactly.

你看。”
Look.”

尤五从抽斗里取出一张纸来，
You took a sheet from a drawer.

上面抄着一通“折底”，是两江总督抬良的原奏，
It was a copy of a memorial submitted by Yiliang, Governor-General of Liangjiang.

大意是说小刀会“通洋”有据，
Its substance was that there was evidence of the Small Swords Society's collusion with foreigners.

唯有将福建、浙江、江西的丝茶，暂行停运到上海，
The only course was temporarily to stop shipments of silk and tea from Fujian, Zhejiang and Jiangxi to Shanghai.

使洋商夫自然之利，急望克复，方能停止对小刀会的接济。
Deprived of their natural profits, foreign merchants would become eager to see the city recaptured, and only then would they cease supplying the Small Swords Society.

“这两大都在传说，
“Everyone has been talking about it these last two days.

除此以外，还有严厉的处置。”尤五又说，
And besides that, harsher measures are coming.

“官军已经决定，非把上海克复不可。”
The government forces have decided they must recapture Shanghai.”

接着，尤五又谈了最近的战局。
You went on to describe the recent fighting.

从胡雪岩离开上海以后，江苏的绅士，便捐款募了一千“川勇”，
After Hu left Shanghai, the gentry of Jiangsu had subscribed funds to recruit a thousand Sichuan volunteers.

由四川荣县籍的派赴“江南大营”效力的刑部主事刘存厚率领，隶属于江苏按察使吉尔杭阿部下。
They were commanded by Liu Cunhou, a secretary in the Board of Punishments from Rong County in Sichuan who had been assigned to serve at the Jiangnan Grand Camp, and placed under Ji’erhang’a, Jiangsu's provincial judge.

同时太仓的举人钱鼎铭与嘉定的举人吴林，又办团练，配合官军反攻，
At the same time, two provincial examination graduates, Qian Dingming of Taicang and Wu Lin of Jiading, had organized militia to cooperate with the government counteroffensive.

所以嘉定、青浦，首先克复，宝山、南汇、川沙，也次第落入官军手中，
Jiading and Qingpu had therefore been recovered first, followed by Baoshan, Nanhui and Chuansha.

目前是由吉尔杭阿与刘存厚，合围上海县城。
Ji’erhang’a and Liu Cunhou were now jointly besieging the walled county town of Shanghai.

不过刘丽川是不是马上会失败？却在未定之天，
Whether Liu Lichuan would be defeated at once remained uncertain.

因为洋商的接济，相当有效，刘丽川有粮食、有军械弹药，守个年把，也是很可能的事。
Foreign supplies were proving effective: he had food, arms and ammunition, and might well hold out for a year or so.


“这得要好好筹划一下。”胡雪岩问，
“We'll have to plan this carefully.

“应春兄呢？”
Where is Brother Yingchun?”

“在上海。”谈到这里，尤五叹口气，欲言又止。
“In Shanghai.” You sighed and seemed about to say more, then stopped.

“五哥，怎么回事？”
“Brother Five, what's wrong?”

“唉！
“Ah!

家丑。
A family disgrace.

跟你自然不必瞒，不过这话真不知从何谈起。”
Naturally, I needn't hide it from you, but I hardly know where to begin.”

尤五是极外场的人物，说话爽利干脆，
You was a man thoroughly at home in the world, brisk and direct in speech.

有时需要婉转陈词的，也是娓娓言来，
Even when tact was required, he could always explain himself smoothly.

从来没有什么吞吐其词、难以出口的。
He had never been one to hesitate and struggle for words.

只有这时候是例外，
This occasion alone was different.

胡雪岩凝神细听，费了好半天，才算弄明白，原来是七姑奶奶私奔，在上海跟古应春住了在一起。
Hu listened intently, and only after a long time did he understand: the Seventh Lady had run away and was living with Gu Yingchun in Shanghai.

这种情形，俗语叫“轧姘头”，是极丑之事，
The common expression for this was “shacking up”, a profoundly disgraceful thing.

衣冠缙绅之家，甚至连这句俗语都不上口的，
In respectable gentry households, even the expression itself was never spoken.

那就无怪乎提到此事，忸怩万状了。
No wonder You was so embarrassed to mention it.

胡雪岩甚为诧异，诧异的不是七姑奶奶有此大胆举动，而是古应春何以如此不顾朋友的交情和自己的体面，
Hu was astonished, not at the Seventh Lady's boldness, but that Gu should disregard both his obligations to a friend and his own good name.

而更为不解的是，古应春信中连一句口风都没有露过。
Still more puzzling, Gu had not hinted at it in any of his letters.

照道理说，至交好友，而且他还是替他们拉拢，将来要做大媒的，
They were intimate friends; Hu had brought the pair together and was to act as their principal matchmaker.

古应春有什么理由，瞒着不说？
What reason could Gu have for concealing it?

这样转着念头，他不由得说了句：“老古太不对了！”
Turning this over, he could not help saying, “Old Gu has behaved very badly!”


事情已经揭明，就比较不觉得碍口，尤五答道，
Now that the matter was out, You found it easier to speak.

“江湖上要说公话，
“We must be fair to people.

这件事其实怪不得老古。
In truth, Old Gu isn't to blame.

总而言之，家门不幸，出了这么个宝贝妹子！”
It all comes down to our family's misfortune in having a sister like this!”

“喔，”胡雪岩追问着，
“Oh?

“怎么说是怪不得老古？”
Why do you say he isn't to blame?”

于是尤五又为难了，语焉不详地透露了经过。
Once again You faltered, giving an incomplete account of what had happened.

胡雪岩一半听，一半猜，仿佛是七姑奶奶到了上海，锲而不舍地钉住了古应春，
Half listening and half guessing, Hu gathered that the Seventh Lady had pursued Gu relentlessly after reaching Shanghai.

然后有一天在她所租的寓所中，留古应春喝酒，
Then one day she had kept him to drink at her rented lodgings.

不知是有意还是无意，反正古应春颓然大醉，胡里胡涂成就了“好事。”
Whether by design or accident was unclear; at any rate, Gu had become hopelessly drunk, and in his confusion they had become lovers.

“Afterwards, Old Gu knelt before me to beg forgiveness.

小爷叔。做事情要凭良心，
Little Uncle, we must act according to our consciences.

哪怕是圣人，到了那步田地，只怕也要落水。
Even a sage might have fallen in those circumstances.

我只好这样问他：”你打算怎么办呢？
All I could do was ask what he meant to do.

‘他说，他要专诚到杭州来请你出面做媒。
He said he'd go to Hangzhou especially to ask you to arrange the marriage.

这样也算是歪打正着，倒也罢了。
That would have been a good result reached by a crooked road, and I could have accepted it.

哪知道横途里岔出个程咬金，三斧头把古应春劈得招架不住。
Who could have guessed that a Cheng Yaojin would suddenly appear and leave Gu helpless under three blows of his axe?”

“How strange!”

胡雪岩疑云大起，
Hu was full of suspicion.

“是不是老古另有原配？
“Does Old Gu already have a wife?

从前跟我说的话不实在。
Wasn't he honest with me before?

果真如此，我倒要好好问他一问。”
If that's so, I must question him properly.”

“不是，不是！”尤五答道：
“No, no!

“是他们古家门里的族长，七十多岁的白胡子老头，刚好到上海来看孙子，
It's the head of the Gu clan, a white-bearded man in his seventies who happened to come to Shanghai to visit his grandson.

坏在老古太守道理，跟他去禀告这件事，
The trouble was that Gu was too punctilious and went to report the matter to him.

哪知不讲还好，
If only he'd kept quiet!

一讲了，白胡子老头大为反对，
As soon as he spoke, the old man objected fiercely.

说他们古家门里，从无再醮之妇，不准！
No woman remarrying had ever entered the Gu family, he said, and he would not allow it.

老古再三央求，托了人去说情，
Gu begged repeatedly and sent people to intercede.

一句回话：要娶可以，他要开祠堂出他的族！
There was only one answer: he could marry her if he liked, but the old man would open the ancestral hall and expel him from the clan.

这件事，现在成了僵局。”
Now the whole affair is deadlocked.”


“这些话是老古自己跟你说的？”
“Did Old Gu tell you all this himself?”

“是的。
“Yes.

不过，”尤五又说，“我托人去打听过，话不假。”
But I've had someone make inquiries, and it's true.”

“那么，七姐呢？”“唉！女心外向。”尤五叹口气说，
“Then what about Seventh Sister?” You sighed. “A woman's heart turns outwards.

“一个月在家里住不到十天，一直在上海，
She's home fewer than ten days in a month and spends all her time in Shanghai.

跟老古已经做了人家。
She and Gu have already set up house together.

不过阿七自己说，老古从来没有住在她那里过。
Yet she herself says he's never stayed at her place.

就这样子，也够我受的了！”
Even as things stand, it's more than enough for me to bear!”

“五哥”，胡雪岩便劝他，“哪个不晓得七姐是女中丈夫。
“Brother Five,” Hu said soothingly, “who doesn't know Seventh Sister is a woman with a man's courage?

她做的事，不好拿看一般妇道人家的眼光去看她的。
You can't judge what she does by the standards applied to ordinary women.

我相信人家不会笑话你，
I don't believe people will laugh at you.

你何必郁在心里？”
Why keep brooding over it?”

“话是不错，这件事总要有个了局。”
“That's true enough, but the matter must be settled somehow.”

“等我到了上海再说，
“Let's discuss it when I get to Shanghai.

总有办法好想的。”
There must be a way.”



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十二章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Twenty-Two, first part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第二十二章｜CHAPTER TWENTY-TWO


当天两个人就到了上海，住在裕记丝栈。
The two men reached Shanghai that same day and took rooms at Yuji Silk Warehouse.

古应春得信赶来相会。
Gu Yingchun hurried over when he heard they had arrived.

见了胡雪岩略有忸怩之色，他自然不会在那样的场合之下提到七姑奶奶，
He looked slightly embarrassed on seeing Hu Xueyan, who naturally would not mention the Seventh Lady in such circumstances.

先听取古应春谈上海的市面，
First he listened to Gu's account of the Shanghai market.

丝价是涨了，
Silk prices had risen.

由于庞二的支持，大家都齐心一致，待价而沽，
With Pang Er's support, everyone was holding together and waiting for a satisfactory price.

但洋人似乎也很厉害，
But the foreigners, too, seemed formidable.

千方百计，自己到内地去收丝，辗转运到上海集中放洋。
By every means they could devise, they went inland to buy silk themselves, brought it by roundabout routes to Shanghai, and assembled it for shipment overseas.

“这局面当然不会长的，第一，费事，第二，成本不轻，第三，两江总督衙门等出了告示，为了维持威信，各处关卡，自然要派兵盘查，严禁闯关。照我看，“古应春很兴奋地说，”洋人快要就范了。
“This cannot last,” Gu said excitedly. “First, it's troublesome; second, it costs a good deal; third, once the Liangjiang governor-general's yamen has issued its proclamation, it must uphold its authority. Naturally, troops will be stationed at the checkpoints to inspect shipments and prevent anyone forcing a passage. In my view, the foreigners will soon have to come to terms.

你来得正是时候。“
You've arrived at exactly the right time.”


胡雪岩听此报告，自感欣慰。
The report pleased Hu.

不过此行要办的事极多，得分缓急先后，一样一样来办。
Yet he had so much to do on this journey that he must put his business in order of urgency and attend to it item by item.

首先要打听的就是何桂清的下落。
His first question concerned He Guiqing's whereabouts.

“这就不晓得了！”古应春说，
“That I don't know,” Gu said.

“学台是要到各府各州去岁考秀才的，
“The provincial education commissioner has to visit the prefectures and departments to conduct the regular examinations of licentiates.

此刻不知道在哪里。不过总打听得到的。
I don't know where he is just now, but we can certainly find out.

这件事交给我。”
Leave that to me.”

“不光是打听，
“It isn't only finding him.

有封紧要信要专人送去。”
There's an important letter to be delivered by a special messenger.”

“这也好办。
“That can be arranged too.

你把信交给我好了。”
Give me the letter.”

这件事有了交代，第二件就得谈浙江要买洋枪的事。
With this settled, they turned to Zhejiang's gun purchase.

古应春在由接到胡雪岩的信以后，已经作过初步联络，只是那个洋人到宁波去了，还得几天才能回上海，
Since receiving Hu's letter, Gu had made preliminary inquiries, but the foreign merchant had gone to Ningbo and would not return to Shanghai for several days.

唯有暂且等待。
They could only wait.


最急要的两件事谈过，那就该谈七姑奶奶了。
The two most urgent matters discussed, it was time to speak of the Seventh Lady.

在路上，胡雪岩就已跟尤五商量好，到此辰光，须得回避，
Hu had agreed with You Laowu on the journey that You must withdraw at this point.

所以一个眼色抛过去，尤五便托词去找朋友，站起身来，准备出门。
At a glance from Hu, he rose, saying that he had a friend to see.

“五哥，”古应春说，“我替老胡接风，
“Brother Five,” Gu said, “I'm giving Hu a welcome dinner.

一起吃番菜去。”
Come and have foreign food with us.”

“番菜有啥好吃？
“What's so good about foreign food?

动刀动叉的，我也嫌麻烦，
All those knives and forks—I can't be bothered.

你们去吧！”
You go.”

目送他的背影消失，胡雪岩便笑道：
As his figure disappeared, Hu smiled.

“老古，你瞒得我好！”
“You've kept me nicely in the dark, Old Gu!”

这一说，古应春立刻不着急了，
At this, Gu became agitated.

“你是说七姐的事？
“You mean Seventh Sister?

如果我有心瞒你，就是我不够朋友。”他有些气急败坏地，
If I'd deliberately concealed it, I wouldn't deserve to be called your friend.

“如果你也不谅解我，我就没有路好走了！”
If even you won't understand me, I'll have nowhere left to turn!”

“不要急，不要急！
“Don't get excited.

你慢慢的说给我听，大家一想想办法。
Tell me slowly, and we'll think of something together.

我就不相信做不成这头媒。”
I refuse to believe I can't make this match.”

听得这两句话，古应春大感宽慰，
These words greatly reassured Gu.

“我就是怕信里说不清楚，又想你不久就要来了，所以索性不说。
“I was afraid I couldn't explain it properly in a letter, and I knew you'd be coming soon, so I decided to say nothing.

原是要等你来替我做个军师。”古应春说，
I was waiting for you to act as my strategist.

“这件事搞成这么一个地步，你不晓得我心里的着急。
You don't know how anxious I am, with the affair in this state.

真好有一比……”
It's just like...”

他咽着唾沫说不下去了。
He swallowed and could not finish.

“好比什么？”
“Like what?

胡雪岩问道：“你作个比方，我就晓得你的难处在什么地方？”
Give me an image, and I'll understand where your difficulty lies.”

“我好比‘鬼打墙’，
“Like being trapped behind a wall raised by ghosts.

不知道怎么一下，会弄成了这个样子？”
I can't understand how I suddenly found myself in this predicament.”


胡雪岩笑着说，
Hu laughed.

“酒能乱性，又碰着一向喜欢的人，
“Wine overcomes restraint, and there you were with someone you'd always liked.

生米下了锅，却又煮不成熟饭，
The raw rice has gone into the pot, yet you can't cook it into a proper meal.

实在急人！”
No wonder you're anxious!”

“对，对！”
“Exactly!”

古应春抚掌称妙，
Gu clapped his hands.

“你这个比方真好。
“A perfect comparison.

我和你说句心里的话，到了她那里，馋在眼里，饿在肚里，就是到不了嘴里，就为的是煮不成熟饭！”
To tell you honestly, when I go to her, my eyes feast and my stomach hungers, but nothing reaches my mouth—all because the rice cannot be cooked!”

“怎么？
“What?

真的从那晚以后，就跟七姐没有‘好’过？”
You really haven't been intimate with Seventh Sister since that night?”

胡雪岩想到尤五的话，说是七姑奶奶告诉过他，古应春从来没有在她那里留宿过一夜，
Hu remembered You's account: she had told her brother that Gu had never spent a night at her place.

如今又听他本人这样表示，心里不免存疑。
Now Gu himself said much the same, and Hu could not help doubting it.

男人的脾气他是知道的，
He knew men's habits.

七姑奶奶又是豪放脱略，什么都不在乎的性格，
The Seventh Lady, moreover, was bold, unconventional and careless of restraint.

既有那一夜的“好事”，何以鸳鸯未续，
After that night's happy encounter, why had the lovers not come together again?

似乎不近情理。
It hardly seemed reasonable.

彼此极熟，无话不谈，
He and Gu were close enough to discuss anything.

论及闺阁，虽伤口德，但以七姑奶奶的情形不同，也不算“唐突佳人”，
To speak of bedroom matters might be indiscreet, but given the Seventh Lady's unusual circumstances, it was hardly an affront to her.

于是胡雪岩便笑道：
He smiled.

“干柴烈火，就只烧过那么一回，
“Dry wood and a blazing fire, yet they burned only once?

这倒有点奇怪了！”
That's rather curious.”


“说破了，你就不觉得奇怪，
“Once I explain, you won't think it curious.

我是为了两层原因：
There are two reasons.

第一，既然打算明媒正娶，该当尊重七姐，
First, since I intend to marry her formally as my wife, I ought to show her respect.

那一夜就如你所说的，‘酒能乱性’，另当别论，
That night was a different matter—as you said, wine overcame restraint.

第二，婚事还有周折，后果如何，颇难逆料，
Second, the marriage still faces obstacles, and no one can predict the outcome.

倘或不成，且不说对不起七姐跟五哥，就是我自己良心上亦不安。
If it fails, I'd have wronged both her and Brother Five, quite apart from what my conscience would say.

再有那不明内情的人，一定说我始乱终弃，
People who didn't know the circumstances would accuse me of seducing and abandoning her.

洋场上好说闲话的人最多，
The foreign settlement is full of gossips.

如果我有这么一个名声落在外面，那就不知道让人说得我如何不堪了！”
With a reputation like that, who knows what a villain they'd make of me!”

此言一出，胡雪岩肃然起敬，
Hu's respect rose at these words.

“老古，”他收敛了笑容，说了句使古应春深感安慰的话：“照你这样的存心，姻缘也不会不成。时候还早，我先去看看七姐。”
His smile disappeared. “Old Gu, with intentions like yours, this marriage cannot fail. It's still early. I'll go and see Seventh Sister first.” Gu found this profoundly comforting.


古应春略一沉吟，这样答道：“那就索性到她那里去吃饭。
After a moment's thought, Gu answered, “Then let's have dinner at her place.

今天家里还有点菜。”
There's still some food at home today.”

这样的语气，显得古应春跟七姑奶奶已经象夫妇一样，只欠同圆好梦而已。
His tone made it clear that he and the Seventh Lady were already like husband and wife, lacking only the fulfilment of their shared dream.

同时也听得出他和她的感情很不坏。
Their affection was plainly strong.

一双两好，顺理成章的事，偏有那个“程咬金”来讲家法，
Here were two people perfectly suited to one another, a match that ought to follow naturally, and that meddling Cheng Yaojin had to appear, brandishing clan rules.

真正可恨！
Infuriating!

胡雪岩起了种不服气的心思，
Hu felt a surge of defiance.

当即拍胸说道：“老古，你放心！
Striking his chest, he declared, “Don't worry, Old Gu.

你们那位老族长，看我来对付他。”
Leave that old clan head to me.”

“慢来，老胡！”古应春惴惴然地说：
“Wait, Hu!” Gu said nervously.

“那是我的一位叔祖，又教先父念过书，
“He's a great-uncle of mine, and he taught my late father.

你千万不可鲁莽，
You mustn't act rashly.

你倒说说看，是如何‘对付’？”
Tell me, how do you propose to ‘deal with’ him?”

“ ‘对付，这两个字，好象不大好听。
“‘Deal with’ may sound rather unpleasant.

其实我不是想办法叫他’吃瘪‘，
I'm not trying to make him lose face.

是想办法叫他服贴。”
I'm trying to win his consent.”

“那就对了。”
“That's right.”

古应春欣然问道。
Gu brightened.

“你快说来听听，让我也好高兴高兴！”
“Tell me quickly, so I can share the pleasure.”

“此刻还不到高兴的时候，只好说是放心。
“It isn't time for pleasure yet, only reassurance.

事情要做起来看，
We must see how things work out.

办法倒有一个，不过要我先跟七姐谈了再说。”
I do have a plan, but I must speak to Seventh Sister first.”

“啥时候谈？
“When?

要不要我回避？”
Should I keep out of the way?”

“能回避最好。”
“That would be best.”

“那样这样，我陪你去了以后，我到外国伙食店去买些野味，
“Then I'll take you there and go to a foreign provision shop to buy some game.

你就在那里谈好了。”
You can talk while I'm out.”


这样约定以后，古应春便雇了一辆“亨斯美”的马车，到了棋盘街七姑奶奶的寓所。
Having agreed, Gu hired a “Hengsimei” carriage and took Hu to the Seventh Lady's lodgings in Qipan Street.

一见面，七姑奶奶喜不自胜，
She was overjoyed to see him.

“小爷叔，”她说，“昨天晚上老古去了以后，我起牙牌，算定今天有贵人到，
“Little Uncle, after Gu left last night, I cast the dominoes and divined that an honoured helper would come today.

果不其然你来了！
Sure enough, here you are!

真正救命王菩萨！”
A bodhisattva come to save my life!”

接着又瞟着古应春说：
Then she glanced at Gu.

“那是他们的姓不好！
“It's that unfortunate surname of theirs.

遇着这么一个牛脾气的老‘古’板，
We had to come up against a stubborn old Gu—a hidebound old stick!

真把我气得胃气都要发了。”
He's made me so angry my stomach's nearly acting up.”

“不要气，不要气！
“Don't be angry.

只要你肯听我的话，包你也姓古！”
So long as you'll listen to me, I guarantee you'll be called Gu yourself.”

听得这话，古应春便站起身来，依照预先商量好的步骤，托词到洋人伙食店去买野味，离座而去。
At this, Gu rose and, following their agreed plan, excused himself to buy game at the foreign provision shop.

等他一走，七姑奶奶的态度便不同了，
Once he had gone, her manner changed.

在古应春面前，她因为性子好强，表示得毫不在乎，
Her pride made her pretend indifference in front of Gu.

而此时与胡雪岩单独相处，就象真的遇见了亲叔叔似地，
Alone with Hu, however, she behaved as though she had truly found an uncle of her own.

满脸委屈、凄惶，
Her face was full of hurt and distress.

与她平常豪迈脱略的神态比较，令人不能相信是同一个人。
Compared with her usual bold, carefree manner, it scarcely seemed the same person.

“小爷叔，”她用微带哭音的声调说，“你看我，不上不下怎么办？
“Little Uncle,” she said, her voice close to tears, “what am I to do, left hanging like this?

一辈子要争气，偏偏搞出这么件争不出气的事！
All my life I've tried to hold my head high, and now I've landed myself in something I can't hold my head high about.

所以我不大回松江，
That's why I seldom go back to Songjiang.

实实在在是没脸见人。
I really can't face people.

小爷叔，你无论如何要替我想想办法。”
You must find some way to help me.”

“你不要急！
“Don't worry.

办法一定有。”胡雪岩很谨慎地问道，“事情我要弄清楚，
There must be a way.” Hu asked carefully, “But I must understand.

到底是你们感情好得分不开，还是为了争面子？”
Is it that you love each other too much to part, or that your pride is involved?”

“两样都有！”
“Both.

七姑奶奶答道，“讲到面子，总是女人吃亏。
When it comes to reputation, it's always the woman who suffers.

唉！也怪我自己不好，
Ah, I have myself to blame.

耍花枪耍得自己扎伤了自己。”
I tried a fancy trick with a spear and wounded myself.”


胡雪岩最善于听人的语气，
Hu was exceptionally good at reading a person's tone.

入耳便觉话外有话，随即问道：
At once he sensed more behind her words.

“What trick did you play?”

问到这话，她的表情非常奇怪，好笑、得意、害羞而又失悔，混杂在一起，
Her expression became extraordinary: amusement, pride, shame and regret mingled in it.

连胡雪岩那样精于鉴貌辩色的人，都猜不透她葫芦里究竟卖的什么药？
Even Hu, so practised at reading faces, could not guess what she had in mind.

“怎么？”胡雪岩故意反激一句，
“Well?” he deliberately provoked her.

“If you can't bring yourself to say it, never mind.”

“I can say it.

只怕……只怕小爷叔不相信。”
I'm only afraid... afraid you won't believe me.”

“Leave that to me.

不是我吹一句，别样本事没有，人家说话，是真是假？真到几成帐，假到什么速度，
Not to boast, but whatever else I can't do, I can tell when people speak the truth or lie, how much of the truth they tell and how far their falsehood goes.

都瞒不过我。”
None of that escapes me.”

“这我倒相信。”
“I believe that.”

七姑奶奶的表情又一变，变得诚恳了，
Her expression changed again, becoming earnest.

“这话呢，实在要跟小爷叔才能说，
“You're the only person I could tell.

连我五嫂那里，我都不肯说的。
I wouldn't even tell Fifth Sister-in-Law.

说了，她一定埋怨我，
She would be sure to blame me.

我倒先问小爷叔，外头怎么说我？”
But first, Little Uncle, what are people saying about me?”

“外头？
“People?

哪里有外头！
What people?

我只听五哥告诉过我。”
I've heard only what Brother Five told me.”

“他怎么说呢？”
“What did he say?”

“酒能乱性”之类的话，怎么说得出口？
How could Hu repeat such words as ‘wine overcomes restraint’?

胡雪岩想了想，这样答道：“五哥说，这件事不怪老古。”
After considering, he answered, “Brother Five said Gu wasn't to blame.”

话虽含蓄，七姑奶奶一听就明白，
Though discreetly phrased, the meaning was plain to her.

“Naturally, the blame is mine!

好象自轻自贱，
As though I'd made myself cheap.

天在上头，”她说“实实在在没有那回事！”
Heaven is my witness—nothing of the sort happened!”

“没有哪回事？”胡雪岩愕然。
“What didn't happen?” Hu asked in astonishment.


这一问，即令是七姑奶奶那样口没遮拦的人，也不由得脸生红晕，
Even a woman as free-spoken as the Seventh Lady blushed at that question.

她正一正脸色，敛眉低眼答道：“小爷叔是我长辈，说出来也不碍口，
Composing her face and lowering her eyes, she replied, “You're my elder, Little Uncle, so there's no harm in telling you.

到今天为止，老古没有碰过我的身子。”
To this day, Gu has never touched my body.”

“So that's it!”

胡雪岩越觉困惑，
Hu was more puzzled than ever.

“那么，‘那回事’是怎么来的呢？”
“Then where did ‘that affair’ come from?”

“是我赖老古的。”
“I made him believe he'd done it.”

“为啥？”
“Why?”

“为啥！”
“Why?”

七姑奶奶这时才扬起脸来，
Now she raised her face.

“难道连小爷叔你这样子的‘光棍玲珑心’都不懂？”
“Surely even that worldly, ingenious heart of yours can understand!”

想一想也就懂了。
A little thought made it plain.

必是七姑奶奶怕古应春变卦，故意灌醉了他，赖他有了肌肤之亲，
She must have been afraid Gu would change his mind, deliberately made him drunk, and claimed that they had been intimate.

这样古应春为了责任和良心就不得不答应娶他了。
His sense of duty and conscience would then oblige him to marry her.

这个手法是连胡雪岩都梦想不到的。
It was a stratagem Hu would never have dreamed of.

七姑奶奶的行事，与一般妇女不同，也就在这个手法上充分显现了。
How unlike other women she was showed fully in this device.

想想她真是用心良苦，而敢于如此大胆地作破釜沉舟之计，也不能不佩服！
She had gone to extraordinary lengths, and he could not help admiring the courage with which she had burned her boats.

不过，交情深厚，胡雪岩是真的当她亲妹妹看待，
Yet their friendship was close; he truly regarded her as his own younger sister.

所以佩服以外，更多的是不满，
More than admiration, he felt disapproval.

“你真真想得出！”
“What an idea to have!

他说，“不要说五嫂，我也要埋怨你！
Never mind Fifth Sister-in-Law—I blame you too.

老古是有良心的，
Gu has a conscience.

他跟我说的话，真正叫正人君子、
What he told me showed him to be a true gentleman.

万一老古没有肩胛，
But suppose he'd refused to shoulder the responsibility?

你岂不是‘鞋子没有着，先倒落个样’？
Wouldn't you have got the reputation before getting the shoes, as they say?

好好的人家，落这样一个名声在外面，
A respectable woman, with a story like that going about!

你自己不在乎，害得五哥走出去，脸上都没有光彩。
You may not care, but you've made Brother Five lose face whenever he goes out.

你倒想想看，
Think about it.

划算不划算？”
Was it worth it?”


这句话说得七姑奶奶失悔不迭，异常不安，
His words filled her with regret and agitation.

“啊哟哟！”
“Oh dear!”

她搓着手，吸着气说：
She wrung her hands and drew in her breath.

“小爷叔，你提醒我了！
“You've reminded me, Little Uncle.

我倒没有想到，会害五哥坍台！
I never thought I might make Brother Five lose face.

这！这怎么办呢？”
What... what am I to do?”

她这副着急的神态，胡雪岩从来没有见过，
Hu had never seen her so anxious.

于心大为不忍，赶紧想安慰她，但灵机一动，
He felt deeply sorry for her and was about to comfort her when another thought occurred to him.

觉得七姑奶奶天不怕，地不怕，不受人劝，
She feared neither heaven nor earth and would listen to no one.

难得有这样的机会，正好抓住了给她一个“教训”。
Here was a rare chance to teach her a lesson.

于是，他越发把脸板了起来，
He made his face sterner.

“七姐”，他的声音很平静，但也很冷峻，“不是我说一句，你做事只顾自己高兴，不想想人家。
“Seventh Sister,” he said, his voice quiet but cold, “you think only of pleasing yourself, never of other people.

象这种自毁名节的做法，坏你们尤家的名声，
By damaging your own honour like this, you damage the You family's name.

想来老太爷老太太在地下也会痛心。
Your parents must grieve for it in their graves.

你的脾气真要改改了。”
You really must change your ways.”

提到父母，七姑奶奶的良心越受责备，
Mention of her parents stung her conscience still more.

涨红了脸，盈盈欲泪，
Her face flushed; tears trembled in her eyes.

只拿求取谅解和乞援的眼色看着胡雪岩。
She could only look at him, pleading for understanding and help.

“女人总是女人！”胡雪岩换了恳切柔和的声音说：
Hu's voice softened into earnestness. “A woman is still a woman.

“女人能干要看地方，
Her ability must show in the right sphere.

男人本性上做不到的事，女人做得到，这才是真正能干。
If she can do what a man by his nature cannot, that is real ability.

如果你象男人那样子能干，只有嫁个没用的丈夫，才能显你的长处，
If you're capable in exactly the way a man is, only a useless husband will let your strengths shine.

不然，就决不会有好结果。
Otherwise, it can never end well.

为啥呢，
Why?

一个有骨气的丈夫；样样事情好忍，就是不能容忍太太在外场上扎丈夫的面子！”
A husband with spirit may put up with almost anything, but never with a wife humiliating him in public.”


七姑奶奶不响，
The Seventh Lady said nothing.

倒不是无话可说，只是觉得遇到的人总是夸她怎么能干，怎么能干，
It was not that she had no answer, but everyone she met praised her ability.

不是恭维她“女中丈夫”，就是说她比男人还管用，
They either called her a woman with a man's courage or said she was more useful than a man.

胡雪岩这话，她还是第一次听到，要好好的想一想，
This was the first time she had heard anything like Hu's words, and she needed to consider them carefully.

这一细想，就象吃橄榄那样，上口酸涩，回味弥甘，
The more she did, the more they resembled an olive: sour and astringent at first, increasingly sweet in the aftertaste.

这多少年在场面上处处占上风，但私底下作为一个女人的苦处，只有自己知道。
For years she had had the upper hand in public life, but only she knew her private suffering as a woman.

到那孤灯独对、衾寒枕单的时候，场面上“七姐、
Alone beside a solitary lamp, with cold bedding and an empty place beside her pillow, all those ringing cries of “Seventh Sister!

七姐”叫得好响的声音，一无用处，
Seventh Sister!” were useless.

心里所想的是丈夫跟孩子，
What she longed for was a husband and children.

情愿烧饭洗衣裳，吃苦也有个名堂。
She would willingly cook and wash; at least her toil would have a purpose.

“There are men and women just as heaven and earth have yin and yang, and all things have firmness and softness.

如果女人跟男人一样，那就是只阳不阴。只刚不柔，
If women were the same as men, there'd be yang without yin, firmness without softness.

还成什么世界？
What sort of world would that be?

再说，一对夫妻，都是阳刚的性子，怎么合得拢淘？
And if both husband and wife have forceful, unyielding temperaments, how can they live in harmony?

七姐，你说我的话错不错？”指名问到，七姑奶奶自然不会再沉默，应声答道：
Seventh Sister, am I right?” Directly asked, she could no longer remain silent.

“不错！
“Yes.

小爷叔的话，我还是第一次听到，
I've never heard this before.

如果早有人跟我说这话，我也不会象现在这样子的脾气。”
If someone had said it earlier, I wouldn't have developed such a temper.”

“现在改也还来得及。”胡雪岩也答得极快。
“It's still not too late to change,” Hu replied at once.

“江山好改，本性难移。”
“Mountains and rivers are easier to alter than a person's nature.”

七姑奶奶停了一下又说：
She paused.

“我试试看。”
“I'll try.”

“对！
“Good.

只要你有决心，要争口气，一定改得掉。
If you're determined and want to show what you can do, you can change.

倘或改不掉……”
If you can't...”

胡雪岩有意不说下去。
He deliberately stopped.

七姑奶奶当然要追问：“改不掉会怎么样呢？”
Naturally, she asked, “What if I can't?”

“改不掉？我说句老实话，你还是不必嫁老古的好。
“Then, honestly, you'd better not marry Gu.

嫁了他，性情也合不拢的。”
Even if you did, your temperaments wouldn't agree.”


这句话她觉得说得过分，但不便争辩，只好不答。
She thought this went too far, but could hardly argue and gave no answer.

“你不相信我的话是不是？”
“You don't believe me, do you?”

“不是不相信小爷叔的话。”七姑奶奶抢着说，
“It isn't that,” she hastened to say.

“老古也常来常住，
“Gu comes often and spends plenty of time here.

他没有说过啥！”
He's never said anything.”

“我知道。”胡雪岩平静地答说，
“I know,” Hu replied calmly.

“一则，这时候大家要客客气气，
“For one thing, you're both being polite to each other at present.

二则，男女双方，没有做夫妻跟做了夫妻以后的想法会变的！
For another, men and women think differently before and after marriage.

老古着重你的是心好，脾气豪爽。
What Gu values in you is your good heart and frank, generous spirit.

你不要把你的长处，变成短处，
Don't turn your strengths into weaknesses.

要把你的短处改过，变成长处。
Turn your weaknesses into strengths.”

“这两句话说得七姑奶奶佩服了：
This won her admiration.

“小爷叔这两句话有学问，

我要听！”
I'll listen.”

“That's right.

你肯听我的话，我自然要插手管你的事。
If you'll listen, naturally I'll concern myself with your affairs.

不然做媒人做得挨骂，何必去做？”胡雪岩接着又问：“七姐，我先问你，你肯不肯改姓？”
Otherwise, why make a match only to be cursed for it?” He continued, “First tell me, Seventh Sister: would you be willing to change your surname?”

Her eyes widened. “Change it?

“改啥姓？
To what?

为啥？”
Why?”

“It certainly wouldn't disgrace you.

喔，”
Oh!”

Has the old Gu clan head ever seen you?”

I've never met anyone from their family.”

We'll use my plan to carry you safely past him without his knowing.”


胡雪岩这一计，是让王有龄认七姑奶奶作妹妹，
Hu's plan was to have Wang Youling acknowledge the Seventh Lady as his sister.

不说是义兄妹，所以要改姓王，
They would not say that the relationship was adoptive, so she must take the surname Wang.

古应春求亲要向王家去求，女家应允亲事。也由王有龄出面付庚贴。
Gu would propose marriage to the Wang family; the bride's family would consent, and Wang himself would present the document giving her birth details.

这一来，古家的老族长看在知府大老爷的面子上，就算真的晓得了实情，也不好意思不答应，
Out of respect for a prefect, the old clan head would find it difficult to refuse even if he learned the truth.

何况既未谋面，要瞒住他也很容易。
Since he had never met her, however, deceiving him would be easy.

七姑奶奶笑得合不拢口，
The Seventh Lady could scarcely stop smiling.

“Little Uncle, you're a real Zhuge Liang!

就算古家的老头子是曹操，也是吃蹩在你千里。

不过，”
But...”

“What is Prefect Wang's position, and what is mine?

怎么高攀得上？”
How could I presume to claim such a connection?”

“这你不用管，
“Don't concern yourself with that.

包在我身上。”
Leave it to me.”

“There's also Brother Five. I don't know what he'll think.”

“为你好，五哥无有不答应的，
“If it's for your good, there's no reason for him to refuse.

这也包在我身上。”
Leave that to me too.”

七姑奶奶凝神想了一会，通前彻后思量遍，没有啥行不通的，
She considered the plan from beginning to end and could find no obstacle.

只有一点顾虑：自己象不象知府家的姑奶奶？
Only one concern remained: could she pass for the lady of a prefect's family?

这样一想，便又下了决心，
This brought a fresh resolve.

“我一定要改一改！”她说，
“I really will change,” she said.

“要象个官家小姐！”
“I must look like a daughter of an official household.”

“对！
“Exactly.

这才是真的。”
Now you're in earnest.”


就在这时候，只听辘辘马车声，自远而近，
Just then, the rumble of a carriage approached.

七姑奶奶是听惯了这声音的，说一声，
She knew the sound.

“Gu's back!”

Lifting the curtain, she looked out.

胡雪岩也站起来看，
Hu rose to look too.

只见暮霭中现出两条人影，隐约分辨得出，一个是古应春，一个是尤五。
Two figures appeared in the dusk, dimly recognizable as Gu and You.

等上楼来一看，果然不错。

这使得七姑奶奶很感动。
She was moved.

内心相当不满，

现在才知道他是如何关切！
Only now did she see how much he cared.

She became more restrained and considerate.

We must ask Brother Five about this.”

Hu explained his plan.

就算高攀上了，王大老爷不嫌弃，旁人会说闲后。”

You looked ashamed.

俗语道得好：“初出三年，天下去得，再走三年，寸步难行。
The proverb is right: ‘For your first three years abroad, you can go anywhere under heaven; after another three, you can scarcely take a step.’

If it was amusing, why not let everyone hear it?

Why tell it behind someone's back?

Evidently it concerned Gu himself.

因为解消了他多少天来，只能存之于心愿，无法跟人去研究的一个疑团。
A mystery he had carried for days, unable to discuss it with anyone, was solved.

那天五更梦醒，只见七姑奶奶穿一件小夹袄在灯下独坐，眼下隐隐泪痕，
When he had awoken towards dawn that night, he had found her sitting alone by the lamp in a light lined jacket, faint traces of tears beneath her eyes.

然后就说，什么都给他了，要他对着灯起誓，永不变心。
She had told him that she had given him everything and made him swear before the lamp never to change his heart.

他也真的觉得愧对佳人，所以唯命是从。
Feeling that he had wronged her, he had done whatever she asked.

但有时静中回想，怎么样也记不起那般“软玉温香抱满怀”的旖旎风光，更不用说真个消魂，是何滋味？
Yet sometimes, in quiet reflection, he could recall nothing of that enchanting scene—her soft, warm, fragrant body in his arms—still less the rapture itself.

人生最难得的良宵，竟这样胡里胡涂、不知不觉地度过，真比“猪八戒吃人参果”还可惜。
To have passed one of life's rarest nights so muddled and unaware seemed more regrettable than Pigsy swallowing the ginseng fruit without tasting it.

此刻才知道“猪八戒”是受了骗了。
Only now did he learn that ‘Pigsy’ had been deceived.

然而受骗比不曾受骗好！
But being deceived was better than not being deceived.

古应春非七姑奶奶不娶，主要的是为了尽责任，
Until now, his determination to marry no one but the Seventh Lady had chiefly rested on duty.

此刻却又恢复到初见时心境，“整顿全神注定卿”，是倾心爱慕，
Now his feelings returned to those of their first meeting: all his attention fixed upon her, his whole heart devoted to her.

因而又向胡雪岩深深一揖：
He bowed deeply to Hu again.

“务期玉成，越快越好！”
“You must bring this about—as quickly as possible!”

“好事多磨，
“Good things meet many obstacles.

你把心耐下来。”
Be patient.”

胡雪岩揉一揉肚子说：
Hu rubbed his stomach.

“我实在饿了。”
“I'm really hungry.”


这一说，尤五和古应春都有同感，
You and Gu felt the same.

不知道女主人在做什么费手脚的菜，一直不能开饭？
What elaborate dish was their hostess making that kept dinner so long?

正想下楼探望，只见七姑奶奶带着小大姐，端了朱漆托盘上来，
They were about to go downstairs when she appeared with the maid, carrying red lacquer trays.

一进门就笑道：“今天吃广东鱼生。
“We're having Cantonese raw fish today,” she announced with a smile.

我是第一次做，不晓得灵光不灵光？
“It's my first attempt, so I don't know whether it will work.

如果不好吃，你们骂老古，是他传授得不得法。
If it tastes bad, blame Gu for teaching me badly.”

““你是第一次做，我是第一次见。
“It's your first time making it, and my first time seeing it.

怎么个吃法？”
How does one eat it?”

胡雪岩一面说，一面走过去看，
Hu went over to look.

中间是个空的盛鱼翅的大冰盘，
In the centre was an empty large platter of the sort used for shark's fin.

另外又有十几个大大小小的盘子，盛着鱼生、榨得干干的萝卜丝、油炸过的粉丝与馓子、盐、糖、麻油、胡椒之类的作料，
Around it stood more than a dozen dishes of various sizes, holding raw fish, shredded radish squeezed quite dry, fried vermicelli, crisp fried dough strands, salt, sugar, sesame oil, pepper and other seasonings.

另有一碟切得其细如发的绿色丝子，
One dish contained green threads sliced as fine as hair.

他可看不出是什么东西了。
He could not identify them.

“是橘树叶子，当香料用的。”七姑奶奶说，
“Tangerine leaves, for flavour,” she said.

“要切得细，
“They have to be cut very fine.

费了我好大的工夫。”
It took me a great deal of work.”

这样一个豪放不拘细节的“女张飞”，能静下心来花样的细功夫，胡雪岩颇为惊异，同时也相当感动，不由得就说了声：
Hu was surprised, and rather touched, that this ‘female Zhang Fei’, so bold and indifferent to details, could settle down to such painstaking work.

“真难为你！”
“You've taken such trouble!”

“先不要恭维我，
“Don't compliment me yet.

尝了味道再说。”
Taste it first.”

于是四个人一起动手，将所有的作料都倾入大冰盘，搅拌匀了，
All four helped tip the ingredients into the large platter and mix them evenly.

胡雪岩夹一筷送入口中，果然别有风味。
Hu took a mouthful with his chopsticks and found it had a distinctive flavour.

“拿酒来！”好久不曾开口的尤五说，
“Bring the wine,” said You, who had been silent for some time.

“今天要好好敬小爷叔几杯酒。”
“We must drink Little Uncle's health properly today.”

这一顿酒，喝得极其舒畅，
It was a thoroughly happy meal.

胡雪岩成了“众矢之的”，三个人纷纷酬劝，
Hu became everyone's target as the other three urged cup after cup upon him.

喝到八分，吃了两碗鱼生及第粥，通体皆暖，
Well on the way to drunkenness, he ate two bowls of raw-fish and jidi congee and felt warm all over.

乘兴说道：“五哥，我们去走走！”
In high spirits, he said, “Brother Five, let's go out for a walk.”


“你想到哪里去？”尤五问。
“Where do you want to go?”

“走着再说。”
“We'll decide as we walk.”

他们俩站了起来，古应春亦接踵而起，
They rose, and Gu followed.

喊了声“七姐！”然后歉意地说：“老胡第一天到，
“Seventh Sister,” he said apologetically, “it's Hu's first day here.

我该陪陪他。”
I ought to keep him company.”

七姑奶奶听了胡雪岩的劝，性情变过了，这一变也不过方寸一念之间。
After listening to Hu's advice, she had changed her attitude—a change requiring no more than a turn of thought.

她以前的想法是：男人有什么了不起！
She had once told herself: What is so remarkable about men?

吃讲茶、讲斤头，没啥希奇，
Settling disputes over tea or arguing a case was nothing special.

上刀山、下油锅，照样也不会皱一皱眉。
Even a mountain of knives or a cauldron of boiling oil would not make her frown.

而现在时刻提醒自己的是：我是个女人，好人家的女儿，
Now she kept reminding herself: I am a woman, a daughter of a respectable family.

还要高攀王府上去做官家小姐，
I am to claim kinship with the Wangs and become a daughter of an official household.

总要拢出女人的样子来，不要让人家背后骂一句“强盗婆”！
I must show a woman's manner and not let people call me a bandit woman behind my back.

有了这样的想法，便觉得古应春的这句话，会让她五哥和胡雪岩误会她离不开未婚丈夫，
With such thoughts in mind, Gu's remark seemed likely to make her brother and Hu think that she could not bear to part with her future husband.

所以不但害羞，而且生嗔。
She felt both shy and annoyed.

“小爷叔来了，你理当陪他，
“Little Uncle has come, so naturally you should accompany him.

何必跟我来说？
Why tell me?

象是我管头管脚，拿你管得多么凶似地。
As though I watched your every move and kept you under such fierce control!

真正气数！”
How exasperating!”

说完，还白了他一眼。
She gave him a sidelong glare.

七姑奶奶的美，就在宜喜宜嗔，
Her charm lay in looking equally lovely pleased or displeased.

白眼也象青眼，而且讲话也台道理，
Even a hostile glance seemed affectionate, and what she said was reasonable.

所以古应春被骂了还是心悦诚服。
Gu accepted his scolding with a willing heart.


倒是胡雪岩反而拦住古应春，
It was Hu who stopped him.

他是给他们方便，
He wanted to give them time together.

料知在这事有转机，难题将可解消的时候，他们俩必有一番款款深谈，
With their affairs taking a favourable turn and their difficulties near resolution, they must have much to say to each other tenderly.

但如果这样说，即使古应春肯留下，七姑奶奶也不会答应，
But if he said so, even if Gu agreed to stay, she would refuse.

所以他只往自己这方面找理由。
He therefore found a reason of his own.

“老古，不必！
“No need, Old Gu.

我跟五哥有几句话要说，
Brother Five and I have a few things to discuss.

你不必陪我。”
You needn't accompany us.”

“那么，”古应春踌躇着问道：“你们在哪里？
“Then where will you be?” Gu asked hesitantly.

我回头来寻你们。”
“I'll come and find you later.”

“这样，”尤五向胡雪岩说，
You turned to Hu.

“我们到老二那里去坐一坐。”
“Let's go and sit with Second Miss.”


约定了地方，尤五陪着胡雪岩安步当车，到了怡情院。
Their meeting place arranged, You accompanied Hu on foot to Yiqing House.

怡情老二出堂差去了，
Second Miss had gone out to entertain at a banquet.

新用的一个娘姨阿巧姐十分能干，一面应酬着把客人引入大房间，一面派“相帮”去催怡情老二回来。
A capable newly hired house attendant, A’qiao, welcomed them, conducted them into the main room, and sent a male attendant to hurry Second Miss back.

“怎么玩法？”尤五问道，
“How shall we amuse ourselves?” You asked.

“是邀人来吃酒，还是打牌？”
“Invite people to drink, or play cards?”

“打牌不必了。”
“No need for cards.”

胡雪岩看那阿巧姐白净俏刮，
Hu found A’qiao fair, neat and pretty.

一口吴侬软语，比怡情老二说得还道地，大有好感，
Her soft Wu speech was even more authentic than Second Miss's, and he took a strong liking to her.

所以自告奋勇，
He volunteered a proposal.

“我来做个‘花头’。
“I'll provide a little excitement.

摆个‘双台’吧！”
Let's arrange a double-table party.”

“胡老爷有多少客人？”阿巧姐说：
“How many guests have you invited, Mr Hu?” A’qiao asked.

“客人少了，摆双台不象呢。”
“A double-table party won't look right with too few.”

“摆双台”不一定摆两桌，
Such a party did not necessarily require two actual tables.

她这样说是表示当客人“自己人”，替他节省，
Her remark showed that she treated him as one of the household and wanted to save him expense.

胡雪岩对花丛的规矩还不大在行，不知如何回答？
Hu was not yet familiar with the customs of courtesan society and did not know how to reply.

尤五却懂她的意思，同时料知胡雪岩一时不会有什么客人要请！
You understood her intention, and guessed that Hu had no guests ready to invite.

便老实说道：
He spoke frankly.

“阿巧姐的话不错！
“Sister A’qiao is right.

要做花头，有的是辰光。
There's plenty of time for a special entertainment.

等老二来了再说。“阿巧姐也附和着，胡雪岩只好作昙。
Let's wait until Second Miss comes.” A’qiao agreed, and Hu had to let the matter rest.

两个人在套房里，隔着一只烟盘，躺在红木炕床上闲谈着，等候怡情老二。
In the inner room, the two men reclined on a rosewood couch, an opium tray between them, talking while they waited.

“这个陈巧娘姨倒还不错。”胡雪岩说，
“This attendant A’qiao is rather good,” Hu said.

“今年快三十岁了吧？”
“She must be nearly thirty?”

“怎么样？”尤五笑道：
“Well?” You laughed.

“我替你做个媒，好不好？”
“Shall I make a match for you?”


胡雪岩笑而不答，自是默许之意，
Hu smiled without answering, giving his tacit consent.

正想开口说什么，只见门帘掀处，怡情老二翩然出现，
He was about to say something when the curtain lifted and Second Miss appeared gracefully.

见了胡雪岩少不得有一番殷勤的问讯。
Naturally, she greeted him with attentive inquiries.

接着，古应春也到了，他要抢着作东，
Gu arrived soon afterwards and insisted on playing host.

北里冶游，有套不成文的法则，作主人必在相好的地方，吃了这家到那家，名为“翻台”，
Courtesan entertainment had its unwritten rules: one entertained at the establishment of one's own favourite, and going from a feast at one house to another was called ‘turning tables’.

古应春为了生意上交际的需要，有个相熟的户头，名叫“虹影楼老七”，就在前一条弄堂“铺房间”，
For the sake of business sociability, Gu had an established acquaintance, Seventh Miss of Hongying House, whose rooms were in the next lane.

约胡雪岩先到那里吃一台酒，再翻回来在怡情院吃消夜。
He invited Hu to dine there first, then return to Yiqing House for a late supper.

“没有这个规矩。”怡情老二反对，
“That isn't the rule,” Second Miss objected.

“自然是先在这里摆酒，再翻到虹影楼去。”。胡雪岩也认为应该这样，但尤五另有打算，
“Naturally, you should dine here first and then move to Hongying House.” Hu agreed, but You had another plan.

摇手说道：
He waved his hand.

“照老古的办法。回头来吃消夜。
“Let's do as Gu suggests and come back for supper.

小爷叔不回丝栈了，
Little Uncle isn't returning to the silk warehouse.

今天晚上在你们这里‘借干铺’。
He'll borrow an empty bed here tonight.”

“既然如此，当然是先到别处吃花酒，最后回到怡情院，
In that case, it made sense to enjoy the courtesan banquet elsewhere and return to Yiqing House last.

吃完消夜，就可安歇，不必再挪动了。
After supper, Hu could rest without moving again.

所以怡情老二点头同意，
Second Miss agreed.

而且打算着陪尤五住到“小房子”去，将自己在怡情院的房间，让给胡雪岩住。
She planned to stay with You at their small separate house and leave her own rooms at Yiqing House for Hu.


于是一起到了虹影楼，
They went together to Hongying House.

进门落座，古应春就叫取纸笔写请客票。
As soon as they were seated, Gu called for paper and brush to write invitations.

胡雪岩征尘甫卸，惮于应酬之繁，便阻止他说：
Hu, scarcely recovered from his journey and reluctant to face elaborate sociability, stopped him.

“算了，算了！
“No, no.

就我们三个人玩玩吧！”
Let the three of us enjoy ourselves.”

这一来改了写局票，
Instead, Gu wrote summonses for the entertainers.

第一张是怡情老二，
The first was for Second Miss.

写完了，古应春拈笔问胡雪岩，“小爷叔，”他改了称呼，“叫哪个？
Holding his brush, he asked Hu, adopting a different form of address, “Little Uncle, whom shall we call?

是不是以前的那个眉香老四？”
Fourth Miss of Meixiang House, as before?”

“市面勿灵！”虹影楼老七接口，
“Business is poor,” Seventh Miss put in.

“眉香老四上一节就不做了。”
“Fourth Miss left the profession at the last festival.”

“这样吧，”尤五代为做主，
You decided for Hu.

向古应春说道：“你们做个‘联襟’吧，
“Why don't you two become ‘brothers-in-law’?

叫老九来陪小爷叔。”
Call Ninth Miss to keep Little Uncle company.”

“老九？”古应春说，
“Ninth Miss?” Gu said.

“老九是‘清倌人’！”
“She's a qingguan.”

虹影楼老九是只以歌艺陪客的“清倌人”。
Ninth Miss of Hongying House was a qingguan, a young performer who entertained guests through her singing.

古应春的意思是提醒尤五，胡雪岩如果叫“虹影楼老九”的局，只能欣赏她的歌艺，
Gu was reminding You that if Hu summoned her, he could only enjoy her performance.

而胡雪岩却了解尤五的用心，赶紧说道：“就是清倌人好。”
Hu, however, understood You's intention and quickly said, “A qingguan is just what I want.”

这一说，主随客意，古应春便把局票发了出去，
The host deferred to his guest and sent out the summonses.

一个在楼上，一个隔一条弄堂，不费工夫，
One performer was upstairs and the other only a lane away, so no time was lost.

所以等席面摆好，怡情老二和虹影楼老九都到了，各人跟着一名提了胡琴的“乌师”，准备清唱下酒。
By the time the table was laid, Second Miss and Ninth Miss had arrived, each accompanied by a musician carrying a huqin, ready to sing without theatrical costume as the men drank.


席面甚宽，“小姐”不必按规矩坐在客人身后，夹杂并坐，
The table was spacious enough for the women to sit among the guests instead of behind them, as custom otherwise required.

胡雪岩拉青虹影楼老九细看，
Hu drew Ninth Miss nearer for a look.

见她刘海覆额，稚气未脱，便问：
Her fringe covered her forehead, and she still had a child's air.

“你今年几岁？”
“How old are you?”

“十五。”
“Fifteen.”

胡雪岩看一看虹影楼老七，再回脸看她，
Hu looked from Seventh Miss back to her.

一个鸭蛋脸，一个圆脸，面貌神情，完全两路，因又问道：
One had an oval face, the other a round one; their looks and expressions were wholly different.

“你们是不是亲姐妹？”
“Are you actual sisters?”

问到这话，虹影楼老九笑而不答，
Ninth Miss smiled without answering.

古应春接口说道：“哪里来这么多亲姐妹？
Gu replied, “Where would so many actual sisters come from?

不过，老九的事，老七做得了主。”
But Seventh Miss can make decisions for her.”

胡雪岩懂他的意思，但并无另外安排的打算，就不接口了。
Hu understood, but had no intention of arranging anything further and let the matter drop.

“老九！”古应春就，“你唱一段什么？”
“Ninth Miss,” Gu said, “what will you sing?”

“胡老爷喜欢听啥，我就唱啥。”
“Whatever Mr Hu would like to hear.”

“唷！”
“Oh!”

胡雪岩笑道，
Hu smiled.

“看样子老九肚里的货色还不少。”
“It seems you have quite a repertoire.”

“不错！”
“Indeed.

古应春说，“女大十八变，她现在年纪还小，
Girls change greatly as they grow up, and she's still very young.

论艺，将来一定行。”
As for her art, she's certain to do well.”

“谢谢你。姐夫！”
“Thank you, Brother-in-Law.”

虹影楼老九嫣然一笑，现在两个酒窝，显得很甜。
Ninth Miss smiled, showing two dimples that made her look sweet.

“将来一定会更出色，
“She'll certainly grow more accomplished.

值得在技艺上下功夫培养。”
Her talents are worth cultivating.”

“全靠胡老爷捧场。”虹影楼老七，接着胡雪岩的话说，
“She'll depend on your support, Mr Hu,” Seventh Miss answered.

然后又轻声去问古应春，他住在哪里？
Then she quietly asked Gu where Hu was staying.


“你问这话做啥？”古应春笑道：
“Why do you ask?” Gu said with a smile.

“是不是担心胡老爷没安排好住处？”
“Are you worried that Mr Hu hasn't arranged somewhere to stay?”

“狗嘴里长不出象牙！”
“No ivory ever comes out of a dog's mouth!”

虹影楼老七，捏起粉拳在他背上捶了一下，
Seventh Miss made a little fist and tapped him on the back.

“我跟你说！”
“Let me tell you...”

说得很轻，咕咕噜噜听不清什么，
She spoke so softly that the others could not make out her murmuring.

尤五有些不耐烦，
You grew impatient.

大声说道：“有话不会到枕头上去说！
“Can't you save your private talk for the pillow?

吃酒！
Drink!

吃酒。”
Drink!”

虹影楼老七见客人发话，急忙赔笑道歉，
Seeing that a guest was displeased, Seventh Miss hastily smiled and apologized.

亲自执壶敬酒，又叫她妹妹唱了一段小调，
She took the wine pot herself to serve them and had her younger sister sing a popular tune.

这才把席面槁得热闹了起来。
Only then did the table become lively.

一曲既罢，来了张局票，交到虹影楼老九手里，她说一声：
As soon as the song ended, another summons arrived for Ninth Miss.

“对不起！
“Forgive me.

回头请过来会。“起身而去，
Please come and see me later,” she said, rising to leave.

这一下席面顿时又显得冷清清了。
The company immediately seemed subdued again.

尤五大为不满，
You was deeply displeased.

“凳子都没有坐热，就要转局。”他说，
“She hadn't even warmed her seat before moving on to another party.

“这种花酒吃得真没有味道！”
There's no pleasure in a banquet like this.”

这一说，虹影楼老七自然不安，说好话，赔不是。
Naturally uneasy, Seventh Miss tried soothing words and apologies.

尤五爱理不理，胡雪岩懒得答话，
You scarcely acknowledged her, while Hu could not be bothered to answer.

一时场面上弄得很尴尬，
The atmosphere became awkward.

虹影楼老七面子上有些下不来，便嗔怪古应春不开口帮她，是存心要她的好看。
Unable to maintain her dignity, she reproached Gu for saying nothing in her support, as though he wanted to see her humiliated.

“我不怪你，你还怪我！”
“I haven't blamed you, and now you're blaming me!”

古应春也有些光火。
Gu, too, was becoming angry.

“好了，好了！”怡情老二开口相劝，
“Now, now,” Second Miss intervened.

“都看我的薄面，
“For my sake, please.

七阿姐决不敢故意怠慢贵客的。”
Seventh Sister would never deliberately neglect honoured guests.”

一面说，一面将尤五拉了一把。
As she spoke, she tugged at You.


这个不曾开口，胡雪岩倒觉得老大过意不去，
You said nothing, but Hu felt thoroughly uncomfortable.

“都怪我！”他举杯向古、尤二人说道，
“It's all my fault,” he said, raising his cup to Gu and You.

“罚我一杯。”
“I'll drink a penalty cup.”

这罚的是什么名堂？
What was the penalty for?

古应春正想发问，胡雪岩抛过一个眼色来，暗示息事宁人，
Gu was about to ask when Hu gave him a look urging him to let the matter rest.

倒使得他越觉歉然，
This only made Gu more apologetic.

想了想，对怡情老二说道：“到你那里去吧！”
After considering, he said to Second Miss, “Let's go to your place.”

“这，怎么好意思！”
“How could I?”

怡情老二为了“小姐妹”的义气，面有难色。
She looked troubled, out of loyalty to her fellow courtesan.

“这里很好！”胡雪岩故意说道：
“We're very comfortable here,” Hu said deliberately.

“老七，请你拿块热手巾给我。”
“Seventh Miss, would you bring me a hot towel?”

等她一走，胡雪岩便劝告古应春和尤五，逢场作戏，不必认真。
Once she had gone, he advised Gu and You not to take a passing entertainment so seriously.

那两个没有表示，怡情老二却大为感动，
Neither answered, but Second Miss was deeply moved.

说他脾气好，能体谅人，不知道哪个福气的，做着这一号好客人。
He was so good-tempered and considerate, she said; what fortunate woman would have such a patron!

这一说提醒了尤五，
This reminded You of something.

把她拉到一边，附耳低语，
He drew her aside and whispered in her ear.

怡情老二一双俏眼，只瞟着胡雪岩，一面听，一面点头，
Her bright eyes kept glancing at Hu as she listened and nodded.

最后说了句：“包在我身上。”
At last she said, “Leave it to me.”

“听见没有？”尤五笑道，
“Did you hear?” You laughed.

“包在老二身上。”
“Second Miss has it in hand.”

胡雪岩会意，报以感谢的一笑，
Understanding, Hu returned a grateful smile.

古应春却不明白，但察言观色，料知是一桩有趣的事，而这桩趣事，决不会发生在虹影楼，
Gu did not understand, but their expressions suggested an amusing development, and one that certainly would not occur at Hongying House.

便站起身来说，
He rose.

“走吧！”
“Let's go.”

这一走，让虹影楼老七的面子过不去，怡情老二和胡雪岩便都相劝，
To leave like this would embarrass Seventh Miss, so both Hu and Second Miss persuaded him to stay.

总算又坐了下来，但意兴已颇阑珊。
He sat down again at last, but their pleasure was nearly spent.


勉强坐到钟敲十下，才算终席。
They endured until the clock struck ten, when the feast could finally end.

等回到怡情老二的小房子里，不曾再摆酒，
Back at Second Miss's small separate house, they served no further wine.

煮茗清谈，反倒有良朋聚首之乐。
Over tea and quiet conversation, they found instead the pleasure of good friends gathered together.

胡雪岩便讲他在湖州的遭遇，与刘不才的妙闻。
Hu told them about his experiences in Huzhou and Liu Bucai's amusing exploits.

尤五听了，只觉得有趣，古应春却是别有会心。
You simply found the stories entertaining; Gu saw a further significance.

“这位刘老兄倒是难得的人才。”
“This Mr Liu is a rare talent.

他说：“能不能叫他到上海来？”
Could he be brought to Shanghai?”

“当然可以。”
“Certainly.

胡雪岩问：“莫非你有用他之处？”
Have you a use for him?”

“对！
“Yes.

这个人是‘篦片’的好材料。”
He would make an excellent professional companion to guests.

古应春说，“十里夷场，光怪陆离，就要这样的人，才有办法。
This ten-mile foreign settlement is full of extraordinary sights; it takes just such a man to find his way about.

我想请他专门来替我们陪客，
I'd like him to do nothing but entertain our visitors.

贵家公子，纨袴子弟，还有些官场红员，都喜欢到夷场上来见识见识，
Sons of great families, pampered young gentlemen and influential officials all like to see something of the foreign settlement.

有个人能陪着他们玩，说什么话都容易了。
If someone can keep them amused, everything becomes easier to discuss.”

“这个看法与胡雪岩相近，
His view was close to Hu's own.

因而欣然同意，决定第二天就写信把刘不才找来。
Hu readily agreed and decided to write for Liu the following day.


接下来又是大谈生意，
They went on to talk business at length.

古应春的主意很多，从开戏馆到买地皮，无不讲得头头是道。
Gu had ideas for everything from opening a theatre to buying land, and explained them all persuasively.

但所有的生意，都寄托在上海一定会繁荣这个基础上，而要上海繁荣，首先要设法使上海安定。
Yet every venture rested on Shanghai's future prosperity, and prosperity first required stability.

夷场虽不受战火的影响，但有小刀会占领县城，总是肘腋之患。
Though the foreign settlement escaped the fighting, the Small Swords Society's occupation of the county town remained a danger close at hand.

同时江苏官方跟洋人在暗中较劲，阻隔商贩，夷场的市面，也要大受影响。
Meanwhile, the Jiangsu authorities were quietly contending with the foreigners and obstructing traders, which would seriously damage the settlement's market.

这样联想下来，胡雪岩便有了一个新的看法。
Following this train of thought, Hu reached a new conclusion.

“老古，”他说，“我看我那票丝，还是趁早脱手的好。”
“Old Gu, I think I'd better sell that consignment of silk soon.”

“怎么？”古应春很注意地问：
“Why?” Gu asked attentively.

“你是怎么想了想？”
“What's led you to that view?”

“我在想，禁止丝茶运到上海，这件事不会太长久的。
“The ban on sending silk and tea to Shanghai cannot last long.

搞下去两败俱伤，
If it continues, both sides will suffer.

洋人固然受窘，上海的市面也要萧条。
The foreigners will be in difficulty, certainly, but Shanghai's trade will also decline.

我们的做法，应该在从中转圜，把彼此不睦的原因拿掉，叫官场相信洋人，洋人相信官场，
We ought to mediate and remove the causes of their hostility, so that officials trust the foreigners and foreigners trust the officials.

这样子才能把上海弄热闹起来。
Only then can Shanghai flourish.

那时开戏馆也好，买地皮也好，无往不利，
At that point, whether we open a theatre or buy land, everything will prosper.

你们说，我这话对不对？”
Am I right?”


古尤二人，都深深点头，
Gu and You nodded gravely.

“小爷叔，”古应春不胜倾服地说，“你看得深了！
“Little Uncle, you've seen further,” Gu said with deep admiration.

做大生意就要这样。
“That is how to do great business.

帮官场的忙，就等于帮自己的忙。
Helping the authorities is helping ourselves.

现在督、扰两衙门，都恨英国人接济刘丽川。
At present, both the governor-general's and the governor's yamens resent the British for supplying Liu Lichuan.

这件事有点弄僵了，仿佛斗气的样子，
They've reached something of a deadlock, almost a contest of temper.

其实两方面都在懊悔，
In fact, both sides regret it.

拿中国官场来说，如果真的断了洋商的生路，起码关税就要少收。
The Chinese authorities, for instance, would at least lose customs revenue if they really cut off the foreign merchants' livelihood.

所以禁制之举，也实在叫万不得已。
The restrictions are a last resort.

如果从中有人出来调停，就此言归于好，不是办不到的事。
If someone mediated, a reconciliation would by no means be impossible.

不过说来说去是一介商人，
But when all is said and done, we're merely merchants.

洋人那里是很看得起商人的，一定说得上话，
Foreigners respect merchants, so we can certainly make ourselves heard there.

就是我们自己官场里，这条线不知怎么样搭法？”
The difficulty is how to make contact with our own officials.”

“有条路子，我看可以试试。”尤五慢吞吞的说道：“何学台那里！”
You spoke slowly. “There's one avenue we might try: Provincial Education Commissioner He.”

“对，对！”古应春说，
“Exactly!” Gu agreed.

“这条路子好！
“An excellent avenue.

何学台虽然管的是考秀才，也常常上奏折讲江苏军务的，
Though his work concerns the licentiate examinations, he often submits memorials on military affairs in Jiangsu.

我看能见他一面，一定有些好处。”
A meeting with him is sure to help.”


“要见他也容易，
“Seeing him should be easy enough.

不过请王大老爷写信引见，费些周折。”
But asking Prefect Wang for a letter of introduction will take some arranging.”

胡雪岩想了想说，
Hu considered.

“我看这样，索性你自己去一趟，当面投王大老爷的那封信，
“Then why don't you go yourself and deliver that letter from Prefect Wang in person?

不就见着了吗？”
That would gain you a meeting.”

这件事如果能做成功，古应春的声名，立刻便可大起，
If this undertaking succeeded, Gu's reputation would rise at once.

所以他颇有跃跃欲试之意，欣然接纳了胡雪岩的建议。
Eager to try, he gladly accepted the suggestion.

只是贸贸然跑了去，空谈无益，
Yet rushing off with nothing but empty talk would serve no purpose.

总得先在英国领事那里作个接触，探明意向，估量有没有谈得拢的可能，
He must first contact the British consul, ascertain his intentions and judge whether agreement was possible.

才好下手。
Only then could he act.

这一来，就不是三两天的事了。
This meant the matter would take more than two or three days.

“这封信也是要紧的。”古应春决定多吃一趟辛苦，
“The letter is urgent too,” Gu said, deciding to undertake an extra journey.

“我先去走一趟，认识了何学台，见机行事，
“I'll go first, make Commissioner He's acquaintance and act as the opportunity offers.

一方面仍旧请小爷叔写信给王大老爷，请他出一封荐函来，备而不用。”
Meanwhile, please write to Prefect Wang for a letter recommending me, so we have it ready even if we don't need it.”

“都随你。
“As you wish.

那封荐函上怎么说法，你索性起个稿子，
Why not draft the recommendation yourself?

我寄到湖州，请他抄一遍，盖印寄来，
I'll send it to Huzhou and ask him to copy it, affix his seal and return it.

岂不省事？”
Wouldn't that save trouble?”


兴致勃勃的古应春，当时便要动笔，
Full of enthusiasm, Gu was ready to take up his brush at once.

尤五看时过午夜，不愿误了胡雪岩的良宵、
You saw that it was past midnight and did not wish to spoil Hu's pleasant night.

因而劝阻，说等明天再办也不迟。
He stopped Gu, saying tomorrow would be soon enough.

接着，便跟怡情老二一起伴着胡雪岩去“借干铺”。
Then he and Second Miss accompanied Hu to his borrowed bed.

“今天实在怠慢，”古应春歉意地说，
“We've really neglected you today,” Gu said apologetically.

“虹影楼那顿酒扫兴之至。
“That dinner at Hongying House was thoroughly disappointing.

老七还要托我请你捧场，
Seventh Miss even wanted me to ask for your patronage.

真正不识相。”
She has no sense of occasion.”

“那也无所谓。”胡雪岩说，
“It doesn't matter,” Hu replied.

“反正花几个钱的事。
“It's only a matter of spending a little money.

我也要有个地方好约朋友去坐，
I need somewhere to meet friends as well.

就做了那个清倌人吧！”
I might as well become that young singer's patron.”

“算了，小爷叔！”尤五说道，
“Forget it, Little Uncle,” You said.

“我劝你象我这样子也蛮好。”
“I'd advise you to do as I do. It works very well.”

这句话古应春不甚明白，胡雪岩却懂，
Gu did not quite understand, but Hu did.

如果对阿巧姐中意，不妨也借一处小房子。
If A’qiao pleased him, he might rent a small separate house too.

湖州立了个门户已经在打饥荒了，
Establishing a household in Huzhou had already strained his funds.

何苦再惹一处麻烦？
Why bring another burden upon himself?

不过当着怡情老二，不便明言拒绝，
With Second Miss present, however, he could not refuse openly.

只好敷衍着说：
He merely put the matter off.

“再看吧！”
“We'll see.”



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十二章（中）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Twenty-Two, middle part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


到了怡情院，已经灯火阑珊，
By the time they reached Yiqing House, most of the lights had dimmed.

只有楼上前厢房还有一台酒在闹。
Only a drinking party in the front room upstairs was still making a noise.

到了怡情老二的大房间略坐一坐，
They sat briefly in Second Miss's large room.

古应春首先告辞，接着是尤五道声“明朝会”，
Gu Yingchun left first; then You Laowu said, “See you tomorrow.”

怡情老二诡秘地一笑，相偕离去。
Second Miss gave a mysterious smile and went away with him.

阿巧姐却始终不曾露面，
A’qiao had not appeared at all.

一个小大姐名叫阿翠的，替胡雪岩铺衾安枕，接着端了热水来，服侍他洗脚。
A young maid called A’cui arranged Hu's bedding, brought hot water, and helped him wash his feet.

杂事已毕，掩上房门，管自己走了。
Her work finished, she shut the door and went off.

胡雪岩有些心神不安，不知怡情老二是怎么一个安排？
Hu felt uneasy, wondering what Second Miss had arranged.

只凝神静听房门外面，
He listened intently outside.

脚步声倒有，都是由远而近再由近而远，不曾见有人推门进来，
There were footsteps, approaching and receding, but nobody opened the door.

而自鸣钟已经打了数下，
The striking clock had sounded several times.

自笑是“痴汉等老婆”，懒洋洋地上了床。
Laughing at himself as a fool waiting for a wife, he climbed languidly into bed.

这一天相当累，
The day had been tiring.

心里有事，眼皮却酸涩得很，蒙蒙胧胧地睡了去。
Though his mind was occupied, his eyelids ached, and he drifted into sleep.

也不知过了多少时候，突然发觉被中伸进一口冰冷的手来，
He did not know how much later it was when an icy hand suddenly entered the bedding.

“啊！地一声，不等他开口，又有一只冰冷的手，掩在他嘴上。
Before his startled exclamation could become a word, another cold hand covered his mouth.

胡雪岩会意，身子往里面一缩，腾出地方来容纳阿巧姐。
Understanding, he moved farther into the bed to make room for A’qiao.

她钻进被窝，牙齿冻得“格格”发抖，同时一把抱往了他，前胸紧贴着他的后背，意在取暖。
She slipped under the quilt, her teeth chattering, and clasped him, pressing her chest against his back for warmth.

“怎么冻得这样子？”胡雪岩转过脸悄悄问说。
“How did you get so cold?” he whispered, turning his head.

“前厢房断命客人，到三点钟才走。”
“Those wretched guests in the front room didn't leave until three.

阿巧姐说，“今天轮着我值夜，风又在，
It was my turn on night duty, and the wind was fierce.

冻得我来！”
I'm frozen!”

说着吸了口气，把他抱得更紧了。
She drew a breath and held him tighter.

胡雪岩好生怜惜，翻个身伸手把被掖一掖，
Filled with tenderness, Hu turned over and tucked the quilt around her.

阿巧索性把头钻在他胸前，他的一双手自然也就不老实了。
She buried her head against his chest, and his hands naturally began to wander.


一面膜索着，他一面问：“阿巧，你今年几岁？”
As he caressed her, he asked, “A’qiao, how old are you?”

“猜猜看呢？”
“Guess.”

“二十三。”
“Twenty-three.

胡雪岩说，“至多二十四。”
Twenty-four at most.”

“二十四是要来生了。”
“I'll have to wait for another life to be twenty-four.”

“那么多少呢？”
“How old, then?”

“我属羊的。”
“I was born in the Year of the Goat.”

“属羊？”
“The Goat?”

胡雪岩在多底拿起阿巧姐的纤纤五指，扳数着说，
Taking her slender fingers beneath the quilt, he counted on them.

“今年咸丰四年甲寅，
“This is the fourth year of Xianfeng, jiayin.

道光二十七年丁未，十五年乙未，
The twenty-seventh of Daoguang was dingwei, and the fifteenth was yiwei.

正好二十岁。”
That makes you exactly twenty.”

“越算越好了！”
“Your reckoning gets better and better!”

阿巧姐当然知道他是有意这样算法，但心里总是高兴的。
She knew he was doing it deliberately, but it pleased her all the same.

“阿巧，”胡雪岩做了反面文章，又做正面，
Having taken the playful approach, Hu now spoke seriously.

“你真正看不出三十二岁。”
“You really don't look thirty-two.”

“大家都说胡老爷一双眼睛厉害，
“Everyone says Master Hu has such sharp eyes.

会看不出？”
Could you really fail to see?”

“真的看不出！”
“I truly couldn't.

胡雪岩问道：“象你这样的人才，为啥不自己铺房间，要帮人家？”
A woman of your qualities—why don't you set up a room of your own instead of working for someone else?”

“吃这碗饭，三十二岁就是老太婆了！
“In this trade, thirty-two makes you an old woman.

人老珠黄不值钱，
Old age and faded looks are worth nothing.

啥人要？”
Who would want me?”

“我要，”胡雪岩不假思索的回答。
“I would,” Hu answered without thinking.

阿巧姐见多识广，当然不会拿他的话当真，接口答道：
A’qiao had seen too much of the world to take that seriously.

“既然有人要，我还要铺啥房间？”
“If someone wants me, why would I need to set up my own room?”

“这话倒也不错。”
“True enough.

胡雪岩又问：“你家里有些什么人？”
Who is there in your family?”

问到这话，近乎多余，而偏偏客人常喜欢问这句话，
It was an unnecessary question, yet one customers often asked.

阿巧姐都腻烦回答了，
She was tired of answering.

“问它作啥！”
“What do you want to know that for?

她说，“总不见得是千金小姐出身。”
I can hardly have been brought up as a young heiress.”

言语简峭，胡雪岩又多一层好感，
Her crisp reply increased his liking for her.

不由得想起了尤五的话，认真地开始考虑。
Remembering You's suggestion, he began to consider it seriously.


此时此地，忽然既不动口，又不动手，那是大为反常的事，
At such a time and in such a place, suddenly to cease both talking and touching was decidedly unusual.

阿巧狙不由得有些奇怪，伸一只手去摸在他的胸前，左一按，右一按，这使得胡雪岩也奇怪了。
Puzzled, A’qiao put a hand on his chest, pressing here and there until he too was puzzled.

“做什么？”
“What are you doing?”

“看看可能摸得出你的心事？”
“Seeing whether I can feel what's on your mind.”

“心事怎么摸得出？
“You can't feel a thought.

只能猜。
You can only guess it.

你倒猜猜我的心事看。”
Go on, guess mine.”

“我不用猜，
“I needn't guess.

我摸得出。”
I can feel it.

阿巧姐说，“你不喜欢我。”
You don't like me.”

“奇了！
“How extraordinary!

哪有这话？
What makes you say that?

你倒讲个道理给我听听。”
Give me a reason.”

“你喜欢我就会心跳。
“If you liked me, your heart would beat faster.

现在心一点不跳，
It isn't stirring at all.

是‘当伊煞介事’。”
You're merely going through the motions.”

“妙！”胡雪岩笑道，
“Wonderful!” Hu laughed.

“还有这么一套说法？
“What a theory!

不晓得你这样子摸过几个男人？”
I wonder how many men's chests you've tested like that.”

这句话说得失于检点，
It was a thoughtless remark.

阿巧姐恼怒伤心，兼而有之，慢慢抽开手，背脸向外。
Hurt and angry, she slowly withdrew her hand and turned her face away.

胡雪岩这才发觉，说了句极无趣的话，
Only then did Hu realise how unpleasantly he had spoken.

深为失悔，
He regretted it deeply.

扳她身子不动，
When he tried to turn her towards him, she would not move.

仰头去看，
He raised his head.

梳妆台上一只洋灯的残焰映照，阿巧姐两粒泪珠，晶莹可见。
By the dying flame of the foreign lamp on the dressing table, he could see two shining tears.

“生气了是不是？”
“You're angry, aren't you?”

胡雪岩尴尬地说，
he said awkwardly.

“说说笑话，
“It was a joke.

何苦当真！”
Why take it seriously?”

说着，拿手指替她拭去眼泪，顺势就亲着她的脸。
He wiped her tears with his fingers and kissed her face.

阿巧姐不作声，但也没有再作何不快的表示，
She said nothing, but showed no further displeasure.

她只是尽力为自己譬解，敷衍怡情老二和尤五的面子，好歹应付了这一夜。
She merely did her best to reason herself out of her distress and, for Second Miss's and You's sake, get through the night somehow.

胡雪岩却是由于这个言语上的波折，失去了兴趣，
The awkward exchange had dampened Hu's interest too.

同时也累得懒于说话，
He was tired and disinclined to talk.

一合上眼，便觉双目酸涩，
As soon as he closed his eyes, they ached with fatigue.

真的借了一夜“干铺”。
In the end, he really did spend the night in a “dry bed.”


到第二天一觉醒来，时已近午，
When he awoke, it was nearly noon.

侧身一望，阿巧姐自然不在，枕边却遗下一根长长的头发，
Turning over, he found A’qiao gone, as he had expected, but a long hair remained beside the pillow.

拈到手里，
He picked it up.

想起宵来的光景，倒有无端的怅惆，同时也觉得有些歉疚，
The memory of the night brought an unaccountable wistfulness and a sense of guilt.

心想阿巧姐一定很不高兴，并且也辜负了尤五和怡情老二玉成的美意。
She must be very unhappy; he had also disappointed You and Second Miss in their kindly attempt to bring them together.

这样转着念头，便打算要跟阿巧姐先谈一谈，
He decided to speak to her first.

披衣起床，咳嗽一声，
Putting on his clothes, he rose and coughed.

房门随即“呀”地推开，进来的正是阿巧姐，
The door immediately creaked open, and A’qiao herself entered.

梳一个极光极亮的头，脸却是不施脂粉的清水脸，
Her hair was dressed smooth and glossy, but her face was bare of powder or rouge.

新象牙似的皮肤，淡红的嘴唇，颊上有几点茶叶未似的雀斑，徐娘丰韵，别有动人之处。
With skin like new ivory, pale red lips, and a few freckles like specks of tea on her cheeks, she had the distinctive charm of a mature woman.

“起来了！”
“You're up.”

她说，眼睛一瞟，撮两个手指放在嘴唇，示意禁声。
She glanced at him, then put two fingers to her lips to enjoin silence.

看她这个姿态，明雪岩自然什么话都不敢说，而实在有些困惑，不知道要顾忌的是哪些话？
He dared say nothing, though he was puzzled about which words required caution.

“夜里的事，不要漏出来！”
“Don't let last night's business slip out.”

原来如此！
So that was it!

胡雪岩不知是不是因为她来相伴，不合于“长三”。的规矩，所以有所忌讳。
He wondered whether her coming to him had broken some rule of the changsan establishment.

只觉得这样子倒有偷情的趣味，越发觉得昨夜的机会可惜。
In any case, the secrecy gave the affair the flavour of a clandestine romance and made him regret the lost opportunity all the more.


要再找这样一个机会也不难。
Another opportunity would not be hard to arrange.

等小大姐打了脸水进来，阿巧姐理好了床，来替他打辫子时，胡雪岩便说：“今天晚上我仍旧要借干铺。”
Once the maid had brought washing water and A’qiao had straightened the bed and begun to braid his queue, Hu said, “Tonight I shall borrow a dry bed again.”

“随便你。”阿巧姐淡淡地应声。
“As you please,” she replied indifferently.

“还跟昨天一样。”
“Just like last night.”

“啥个一样？”
“What is to be the same?”

他不知她是真不明白，还是有意装傻？
Was she genuinely puzzled or pretending not to understand?

想了想笑道，
After a moment, he smiled.

“来摸摸我的心跳不跳？”
“Come and feel whether my heart is beating.”

阿巧姐不响，把眼垂了下去，似乎专心一致在他那条辫子上。
She lowered her eyes without answering, apparently intent on his braid.

“还在生我的气？”
“Still angry with me?”

“哪有这话？
“How could you say that?

我们什么人，敢生贵客的气？”
What are we, to dare be angry with distinguished guests?”

阿巧姐正色说道：
She spoke seriously.

“胡老爷，你千万不能说这话，
“Mr Hu, you must never say that.

传到二小姐耳朵里，一定会说我。”
If Second Miss heard, she would blame me.”

“不会，不会！”
“She won't!”

胡雪岩灵机一动，
An idea came to him.

“你能不能请一天假？”
“Could you take a day off?”

“为啥？”
“Why?”

“我带你到一个地方去玩。”
“I'd like to take you out.”

停了一会，见她不作声，便知不是不能请假的，因而又加了一句：“我来跟老二说，放你一天假。”
When she remained silent, he concluded that leave was possible and added, “I'll ask Second Miss to give you the day.”

“不！”
“No.

阿巧姐说，“我自己跟二小姐讲。
I'll ask her myself.

不过，胡老爷，你要带我到啥地方去玩？”
But where would you take me?”

“玩就是玩。看戏，吃大菜，再到外国洋行看看，有什么新样子的首饰？”
“Just out for pleasure: a play, a Western meal, then a look at a foreign shop to see what new jewellery they have.”

这一说，阿巧姐不由得露了笑容，
At that, she could not help smiling.

昨夜那一言之夫所引起的不愉快，至此才算消除。
The unhappiness caused by his thoughtless words was finally dispelled.

“胡老爷！”小大姐走了来说：“尤五少说，请胡老爷到小房子去吃中饭。”
