The maid came in. “Mr Hu, Fifth Master You asks you to lunch at his little house.”

“好。
“Very well.

我就去。”
I'll go now.”

胡雪岩暗示阿巧姐说，
Hu gave A’qiao a hint.

“我吃完饭就要走了。”
“I'll be leaving as soon as lunch is over.”


等胡雪岩一到，只见古应春也在那里，
When Hu arrived, Gu was there too.

踉尤五和怡情老二的脸上一样，都挂着愉悦的笑容，仿佛正在谈一件很有趣的事，
He, You, and Second Miss all wore delighted smiles, as though discussing something amusing.

看到胡雪岩出现，笑容更浓了，显然的，所谈的这件趣事，与他有关。
At Hu's appearance their smiles broadened: clearly he was the subject.

“昨晚我竟蒙在鼓里。”古应春迎着他说，
“I was completely in the dark last night,” Gu greeted him.

“这也算‘小登科’，
“A little wedding celebration, eh?

恭喜，恭喜！”
Congratulations!”

“怎么样？”尤五问了这一句，
“How was it?” You asked.

又说：“老二说，她在床上……”
“Second Miss says that in bed she...”

“瞎三话四！”
“Nonsense!”

怡情老二赶紧拦住，同时又给了尤五一个白眼，
Second Miss hurriedly stopped him and gave him a sidelong glare.

“胡老爷自己不知道，
“Doesn't Mr Hu know for himself?

要你来说？”
Must you tell him?”

“是啊！
“Exactly,” Gu said.

阿巧姐好在哪里，小爷叔身历其境，
“Little Uncle has experienced A’qiao's merits first-hand.

最清楚不过，
Who could know better?

何用旁人告诉他？”
He hardly needs anyone else to explain.”

古应春这一说，胡雪岩才完全懂得，急于求得补偿的心也更热了，
Only now did Hu fully understand, and his desire to make up for the lost opportunity grew stronger.

然而口中却不知道该怎么说才好？
Yet he did not know what to say.

唯有笑而不答。
He could only smile.

“先吃饭，还是先谈事？”
“Shall we eat first or discuss business?”

古应春一面问，一面从怀里掏出两张纸来。
Gu drew two sheets of paper from his clothes.

“先谈事吧！”
“Business first.”

胡雪岩望着一窗的好太阳，兴致勃勃地问：“老古，你的马车坐了来没有？”
Looking at the sunshine filling the window, Hu asked eagerly, “Did you bring your carriage, Old Gu?”

“在弄堂口。
“It's at the lane entrance.

你要到哪里去？”
Where do you want to go?”

“难得有空，又是好天气，
“Such good weather, and a rare free afternoon!

我想好好去逛半天。”
I'd like a proper outing.”

那三个人互相望了望，
The three exchanged glances.

仍旧是古应春开口动问：
Gu spoke again.

“你预备怎么逛法？
“What have you in mind?

我来替你安排。”
I'll arrange it.”

“回头再说。”
“We can discuss that later.”

胡雪岩指着他手中的纸问：
Hu pointed to the papers.

“这是什么？”
“What are those?”

“两通信稿子。
“Two draft letters.

你看吧！”一通是致王有龄的，请他出信给何桂清，介绍古应春去谒见，一通是致刘不才的，要他到上海来。
Read them.” One asked Wang Youling to write to He Guiqing, introducing Gu and securing him an audience; the other summoned Liu Bucai to Shanghai.

胡雪岩看完，仍旧交了回去，请古应春誉正发出。
Hu read them and handed them back, asking Gu to make fair copies and send them.


要谈的事，就是这些。
That completed their business.

开出饭来，
Lunch was served.

正在喝酒，阿巧姐到了，大大方方的一招手，最后向怡情老二抛了个眼色，
While they were drinking, A’qiao arrived, greeted them with an easy gesture, and finally gave Second Miss a glance.

两人走到后房会谈心。
The two went into a back room to talk privately.

“真不错！”古应春望着阿巧姐的苗条背影说，
“Very fine indeed!” Gu said, watching A’qiao's slender retreating figure.

“是扬州‘瘦马’的样子。
“She has the look of one of Yangzhou's ‘slender horses.’”

““什么‘瘦马’？
“Slender horse?

活马！”尤五笑道：
A lively horse!” You laughed.

“小爷叔，你怎么谢媒？”
“Little Uncle, how will you thank your matchmaker?”

“谢你，还是谢老二？”
“You, or Second Miss?”

“我当差应该，
“It's my duty to serve.

自然是谢老二。”
Second Miss, naturally.”

“那容易。
“Easy enough.

回头我要到洋行里去，挑点首饰，
I'm going to the foreign shop to choose jewellery.

老二一起去好了，
She should come too.

她喜欢什么，我就买什么送她。”
Whatever she likes, I'll buy her.”

“说说笑话的，
“We were joking.

何用你如此破费？
Why put you to such expense?

不过，”
Still...”

尤五向后房望了一眼，放低了声音说：
You glanced towards the back room and lowered his voice.

“你买首饰给哪个？
“Whom are you buying jewellery for?

阿巧是厉害角色，
A’qiao is a shrewd one.

你不要做‘洋盘’！”
Don't let yourself be taken for a gullible customer.”

“如果她是厉害角色，就不会当我洋盘。”
“If she's truly shrewd, she won't take me for one.”

“对！”
“Exactly!”

古应春击节称赏，
Gu applauded.

“小爷叔这句话，真是一针见血，
“That goes straight to the heart of it.

深极了。”
Very profound!”

“也好！”尤五笑着对胡雪岩说，
“Very well,” You laughed.

“你也难得做一回洋盘，
“It's rare enough for you to play the gullible customer.

就带着她去好了。
Take her along.

老二就不必了。”
Second Miss needn't go.”

“一起去，一起去！”
“Let her come too!

胡雪岩说。“打搅老二的地方很多，
I've troubled her often enough.

我本来想送她点东西，表示表示我的意思。”
I already meant to give her something as a token of appreciation.”

“回来再说吧！”尤五不置可否。
“We'll see later,” You said, committing himself neither way.


于是喝着酒谈些夷场趣事。
They drank and discussed amusing incidents in the foreign settlement.

不久，看见怡情老二和阿巧姐一前一后走了出来，一个是春风满面，一个是故作矜持，反正神色之间，都显得不平常。
Before long, Second Miss and A’qiao emerged, one beaming, the other affecting reserve, both looking noticeably different.

“都坐下来吃吧！”
“Sit down and eat.”

怡情老二坐下来当女主人，阿巧则无论如何不肯，
Second Miss took her place as hostess, but A’qiao refused.

说“没有这个规矩”，
“It isn't the rule.”

侍立在旁，递菜热酒，
She stood beside them, passing dishes and warming wine.

三个男的主客，视线都断断续续地跟着她转，倒把她看得不好意思了。
The three men's eyes kept following her until she grew embarrassed.

“二小姐！”她说，“没有事情我就转去了。”
“Second Miss, if there's nothing else, I'll go back.”

“不要走，不要走！”尤五首先就喊。
“Don't go!” You called first.

“让她走吧！”怡情老二向尤五抛过去一个眼色。
“Let her,” Second Miss said, signalling to him with a glance.

等阿巧姐走了，才便于说话，她说，
Only once A’qiao had gone could she speak freely.

阿巧姐把昨夜的事都告诉她了。
A’qiao had told her what happened the night before.

阿巧姐不知道胡雪岩是打的什么主意？
She could not understand Hu's intentions.

如果真的喜欢她，她愿意陪着一起玩，
If he really liked her, she was willing to keep him company.

倘或以为是尤五和怡情老二的面子，不能不对她敷衍敷衍，那就大可不必了。
But if he merely felt obliged, for You's and Second Miss's sake, to be agreeable to her, there was no need.


“人在这里”，尤五指着胡雪岩对怡情老二说，
“The man is here,” You said, pointing at Hu.

“你自己问他。”
“Ask him yourself.”

“胡老爷，”怡情老二笑嘻嘻地问道：“昨天夜里是怎么想了想，不愿意理她了？”
“Mr Hu,” Second Miss asked smilingly, “what made you change your mind last night and leave her alone?”

“我没有什么不愿意，
“I had no objection.

我是怕她不愿，
I was afraid she did.

心想不必勉强。”
I thought there was no need to force things.”

“怎么？”尤五大为诧异，
You was astonished. “What?

“昨夜你没有理她？
You left her alone?

真的是‘干铺’？”
It really was a dry bed?”

胡雪岩点点头说：
Hu nodded.

“这也是常事！”
“These things happen.”

“叫我就煞不住车。”
“I couldn't have put on the brakes.”

尤五看一看怡情老二说，
You glanced at Second Miss.

“我是怕她‘三礼拜、六点钟’，不然我早就动脑筋了。”
“If I weren't afraid of her ‘three weeks, six o'clock,’ I'd have made my plans long ago.”

“你不要扯到我身上！”怡情老二讥嘲地说：
“Don't drag me into it!” she retorted.

“你动得上脑筋，尽管去动。
“Make all the plans you like, if you've a chance.

阿巧姐眼界高得很，
A’qiao sets her sights high.

不见得看得上你，
She might not fancy you.

现在有胡老爷一比，你更加‘鼻头上挂盐鱼——嗅鲞’！”
Now she has Mr Hu to compare you with, you're like a man with salted fish hanging under his nose—sniff away, but forget your hopes!”

她这样一说，古应春和尤五都笑了，胡雪岩却有点不明白，
Gu and You laughed, but Hu was puzzled.

“什么叫‘三礼拜、六点钟’？”他问。
“What's ‘three weeks, six o'clock’?”

“这是夷场上兴出来的一句俗话，”古应春为他解释，
“A new saying in the settlement,” Gu explained.

“三礼拜‘廿一日’，六点钟‘酉’正，
“Three weeks give twenty-one days; six in the evening is the middle of the you hour.

合起来是个什么字？
Combine the written components for ‘twenty-one days’ with the character for you, and what character do you get?

你自己去想。”
Think it out.”

“原来是说老二会吃醋！”胡雪岩说：
“Vinegar! You mean Second Miss gets jealous.

“老二不是那种人，
She isn't that sort of woman.

再说，尤五哥也不会让老二吃醋，
Besides, Brother You wouldn't give her cause.

不然，我们在旁边的人也不服。”
The rest of us would object if he did.”

由这两句话，怡情老二对胡雪岩更有好感，
Those two remarks made Second Miss like Hu still more.

决心要促成他与阿巧姐的姻缘，便趁尤五和古应春谈他们都相识的一个熟人，谈得起劲时，招招手把胡雪岩找到一边，探问他的意思。
Determined to bring him and A’qiao together, she waited until You and Gu were absorbed in talking about a mutual acquaintance, then beckoned Hu aside to ask his intentions.


“胡老爷，你是预备长局，还是短局？”
“Mr Hu, are you thinking of a permanent arrangement or a temporary one?”

“长局如何，短局又如何？”
“What would each involve?”

“短局呢？我另外用人，
“For a temporary one, I'd employ someone else.

你借一处小房子，或者就在楼下，
You could rent a little house—or the rooms downstairs.

那家房客就要搬了，大家住在一起热闹些。
The present tenant is leaving, and we'd have company living together.

长局呢？事情比较麻烦，
A permanent arrangement would be more troublesome.

阿巧姐是有男人的，在木渎种田，
A’qiao has a husband, farming in Mudu.

不过也不要紧，
Still, that needn't matter.

包在我身上，
Leave it to me.

花个二三百两银子：就可了结。
Two or three hundred taels would settle it.

阿巧姐身上没有什么亏空，
She has no substantial debts.

胡老爷，“怡情老二很热心的说，”这件事，只要胡太太那里没有麻烦，你大可做得。
So long as Mrs Hu raises no difficulty, you could quite well do it.”

“胡雪岩一时无从回答，
Hu could not answer at once.

事情倒是好事，但窒碍甚多，必须好好打算，
It was an attractive prospect, but there were many obstacles, and he must think carefully.

但直说了怕扫了怡情老二的兴，
To say so plainly might dampen Second Miss's enthusiasm.

所以考虑了好半天这样答道：“长也好，短也好，总要成局。
After long consideration, he replied, “Permanent or temporary, I certainly want an arrangement.

你的好意，我十分领情，
I deeply appreciate your kindness.

哪一天空了，我们好好谈一谈。
When there's time, we must discuss it properly.

眼前请你放在心里好了。”
For now, please keep it in mind.”

“我晓得。”
“I understand.”

怡情老二连连点头，
She nodded repeatedly.

“这件事本来也是急不得的。
“It can't be hurried.

不过，胡老爷，我还有句话。你不要多花冤枉钱。”
But one more thing, Mr Hu: don't spend money needlessly.”

这话与尤五的忠告，如出一辙，
Her advice matched You's exactly.

可见得大家都拿他当自己人看待，
Clearly, they all regarded him as one of themselves.

这一点是胡雪岩最感到安慰的。
Nothing pleased Hu more.


因此，他的兴致越发好了，
His spirits rose still further.

“今天的天气实在不坏。”
“The weather really is fine.

他怂恿着怡情老二说，“一起出去兜兜风，痛痛快快玩它半天。”
Come out for a drive and enjoy half a day properly.”

“到哪里去呢？
“Where?

总要想好一个地方。”
We must choose somewhere first.”

这时他们说话的声音响了，古应春已经听到，
Their voices had grown louder, and Gu heard them.

便插嘴提议：“到龙华去看桃花如何？”
“How about Longhua, to see the peach blossoms?”

“龙华？”胡雪岩对上海还不熟，便即问道：
Hu did not yet know Shanghai well. “Longhua?

“那里地方安静不安静？”
Is it peaceful there?”

“怎么不安静？
“Why wouldn't it be?

离着县城还有十八里路呢！
It's eighteen li from the county town.

再说，有五哥在，怕什么。”
Besides, with Brother Five along, what is there to fear?”

“好吧！”尤五接口，
“Very well,” You said.

“你们有兴，我就保驾。”
“If you're all keen, I'll be your escort.”

这一说，大家的兴致都提了起来，
Everyone's enthusiasm mounted.

古应春亲自到弄堂口去雇好马车，怡情老二则派人去找阿巧姐来，就在她那里梳妆换衣服，
Gu went himself to the lane entrance to hire a carriage, while Second Miss sent for A’qiao to dress and change clothes at her rooms.

都是素雅的淡妆，但天然丰韵，已是出人头地，
Both women dressed with simple elegance, but their natural grace already set them above the crowd.

胡雪岩颇为得意。
Hu felt well pleased.


马车一共是两部，
There were two carriages.

古应春自己的那部亨斯美，载了胡雪岩和阿巧姐，
Gu's own hansom carried Hu and A’qiao.

出了弄堂，向南疾驰，经斜桥、高昌庙，一条官道，相当宽广。
Leaving the lane, they sped south, past Xieqiao and Gaochang Temple along a broad public road.

这个天气，都愿郊游，一路轿马纷纷，极其热闹，
The fine weather had brought everyone into the countryside, and the route was busy with chairs and horses.

但象这两部马车，敞着篷，俪影双双，招摇而过的，却不多见，
But two open carriages displaying their couples so conspicuously were an unusual sight.

因此轮声鞭影中，不断有人指指点点。
Amid rattling wheels and flashing whips, people continually pointed and commented.

阿巧姐视而不见，
A’qiao appeared not to notice.

只是稳稳地坐着，不轻言笑，怎么也看不出风尘气息。
Sitting steadily, with no ready chatter or laughter, she showed nothing of the woman of the pleasure quarters.

等望见了龙华寺的塔影，同时也望见了一道长桥。
When Longhua Temple's pagoda came into view, so did a long bridge.

这道桥也是上海的一胜，称为百步桥，长二十四丈，阔二丈有余，
This too was a Shanghai landmark: Hundred-Pace Bridge, twenty-four zhang long and over two wide.

马蹄得得，轮声辘辘，
Hooves clattered and wheels rumbled across it.

过了百步桥不远，便是龙华寺。
The temple lay a short distance beyond.

这座古刹，以一座七级浮屠著名，是上海唯一的古塔。
The ancient monastery was famous for its seven-storey pagoda, Shanghai's only old tower.

马车就在塔前停下，怡情老二和阿巧姐先忙着请香烛烧香。
The carriages stopped before it, and the women first bought incense and candles to make their offerings.

胡雪岩想起在湖州与芙蓉初见，也是在佛像之前，
Hu remembered meeting Furong before a Buddha image in Huzhou.

当时还求了一张签，“江上采芙蓉”成为姻缘前定的佳签，
The fortune he had drawn then, “Gathering lotus blooms upon the river,” had become an auspicious sign of their destined union.

此时也不妨如法炮制一番。
Why not do the same here?

不过，自己不必再求，
He need not draw one himself this time.

“阿巧姐，”他说，“你无妨求张签看。”
“Sister A’qiao, why don't you try a fortune?”

“问啥呢？”
“What should I ask?”

阿巧姐想了想说，
She considered.

“好，我来求它一张。”
“Very well, I'll draw one.”

于是烧了香求签，签条拿到她手里，不肯给胡雪岩看，
After burning incense, she drew a slip but refused to show Hu.

她不识多少字，只知道这张签，是“下下”，
She knew few written characters, yet could recognise its rating: “lowest of the low.”

当然不是好签，
It was plainly unlucky.

怕扫了胡雪岩的兴，所以不愿公开。
Afraid of spoiling his pleasure, she kept it to herself.

怡情老二也求了一张，倒是“上上”，说得妻财子禄，无一不好，
Second Miss drew one too, rated “highest of the high”: wife, wealth, children, and official advancement were all favourable.

如果是妇人求得这张签，主得贵子，
For a woman, it predicted a distinguished son.

古应春便向尤五道贺，而实际上是拿怡情老二开玩笑。
Gu congratulated You, really teasing Second Miss.

就这样说笑着，闲步桃林，随意浏览，
Talking and laughing, they strolled among the peach trees.

五个人分做两起，
The five divided into two groups.

古应春不知是有意，还是无意，引着尤五和怡情老二，越走越远，留下胡雪岩和阿巧姐在后面，正好谈话。
Whether deliberately or by chance, Gu led You and Second Miss farther and farther ahead, leaving Hu and A’qiao free to talk.


“累了吧！”
“Tired?”

胡雪岩看她双足纤纤，不免怜惜，
The sight of her delicate little feet stirred Hu's tenderness.

便指着一处茶座说：
He pointed towards some tea tables.

“喝碗茶再走！”
“Let's have tea before going on.”

白布棚子下的茶座，几乎都是官客，
Beneath the white cloth awning, almost all the customers were men.

有一两桌有女眷，也是坐在僻隐之处，而且背朝着外，不肯以面目示人。
At the one or two tables with women, the women sat out of the way, their backs turned towards the public, unwilling to display their faces.

阿巧姐却无此顾忌，
A’qiao had no such scruples.

拣了张干净桌子坐下来，正在通道旁边，
She chose a clean table beside the passage.

人来人往，无不注以一瞥，也有已走过去了，又借故回头，好再看一眼的。
Everyone passing glanced at her; some who had gone by found an excuse to turn back for a second look.

而阿巧姐是视如不见，
She took no apparent notice.

等茶博士拿了茶来要斟时，她赶紫摇手阻止：
When the waiter brought the tea and was about to pour, she stopped him.

“谢谢你，
“Thank you.

我们自己来。”
We'll do it ourselves.”

茶博士住了手，阿巧姐才用茶涮了茶碗，抽出一条来路货的雪白麻纱手绢，将杯口里外擦净，
Once he withdrew his hand, she rinsed the cups with tea, took out a spotless imported linen handkerchief, and wiped the rims inside and out.

然后斟得八分满，双手捧到胡雪岩面前，
She filled one cup four-fifths full and offered it to Hu with both hands.

到她自己喝时，也是这样一丝不苟，极讲究洁净。
She showed the same scrupulous care for cleanliness with her own.

“我在想，人生在世，实在奇妙难测。我敢说，没有一个人，今天能晓得明天的事。”胡雪岩对景生情，发了这么一段感慨，
“Life is truly strange and unpredictable,” Hu said, moved by the scene. “I'll wager nobody today can know what tomorrow will bring.”

阿巧姐目然莫名其妙，
Naturally, she could not make out his meaning.

一双俏伶伶的眼睛看着他不断眨动，示意他说下去。
Her bright eyes blinked at him, inviting him to continue.

“譬如昨天，我做梦也想不到今天会在龙华看桃花，更想不到会跟你在一起。”
“Yesterday, for instance, I never dreamed that today I'd be admiring peach blossoms at Longhua—still less with you.”

“我算啥！”阿巧姐说，
“What am I?” she replied.

“名字生得不好，
“My name is ill chosen.

说破了不值钱，
Once it's explained, there's nothing much to it.

不会有啥‘巧’事落到我头上。
No happy coincidence is likely to come my way.”

这段话令人有突兀之感，
The remark seemed abrupt.

胡雪岩细辨了辨，觉得意味深长，可能也是在试探，
Considering it, Hu detected deeper meaning, perhaps even a test.

便先不追究，
He did not pursue that yet.

只问：“你是七月初七生的？”
“Were you born on the seventh day of the seventh month?”


“不然怎么叫这个名字？”
“How else would I have got this name?”

“好！
“Good!

你的生日好记得很。
Your birthday is easy to remember.

今年我替你做生日。”
This year I'll celebrate it for you.”

“啊唷唷！”阿巧姐有些受宠若惊，
“Oh, you honour me too much!

“真正不敢当，折煞我了。”
I could never deserve it.”

“日子过来快得很，
“Time passes quickly.

桃花开过开荷花，
After peach blossoms come lotuses.

七月初七转眼就到。”
The seventh day of the seventh month will soon be here.

胡雪岩问：“那时候我接你到杭州去逛西湖、看荷花，好不好？”
Shall I take you to Hangzhou then, to enjoy West Lake and the lotuses?”

“怎么不好！”
“Of course!”

阿巧姐双眼凝望着茶碗，口中不断在吹着茶水，
She gazed into her cup, continually blowing on the tea.

茶已经不烫，可以上得口了，何需再吹？
It was already cool enough to drink.

可见碍她是在想心事。
Plainly she was thinking of something else.

当然，胡雪岩自己也知道，这话可以解释为一种暗示，有把她娶回杭州的意思，
Hu himself knew that his words could be taken as a hint that he meant to marry her and bring her to Hangzhou.

阿巧姐所想的必也是这一点。
That must be what she was considering.

自己是无心的一句话，
His remark had been unpremeditated.

如果她真有此误会，未免言之过早，
If she misunderstood it that way, he had spoken too soon.

转念到此，微生悔意，同时也更留心她的脸色和言语了。
He felt a little regret and watched her expression and words more closely.

“胡老爷这一趟有多少日子耽搁？”她问。
“How long will you be staying this time?” she asked.

“说不定，
“I can't say.

少则半个月，多则二十天，
At least half a month, twenty days at most.

一定得回杭州。”
Then I must return to Hangzhou.”

“我晓得了。
“I see.

跟胡太太说好了来的，不能误卯。”
You've agreed it with Mrs Hu and mustn't miss your roll call.”

胡雪岩笑而不答，他的笑容是经过做作的，特意要显得令人莫测高深。
He smiled without answering, deliberately making the smile inscrutable.

阿巧姐很能观察，
A’qiao was observant.

见此光景，便不再多说，只望着悠悠的塔影，慢慢地品茗，样子十分闲适。
She said no more, but gazed towards the distant pagoda and sipped her tea with a leisurely air.

胡雪岩看她的态度，倒有些不明究竟，
Her attitude puzzled him.

心里七上八下的放不下。
He felt unsettled.

但转念却又自笑，
Then he laughed at himself inwardly.

自己没有应付不了的人，也很少心浮气躁过，
There was nobody he could not handle, and he seldom lost his composure.

此刻是怎么回事？
What was the matter with him now?

这样一想，硬生生的把杂念抛开，也是抱着“偷得浮生半日闲”的心情，
He forcibly dismissed these distractions and adopted the spirit of stealing half a day of leisure from life's bustle.

品茗看花，只求自适，
He drank tea and admired the blossoms, seeking only his own contentment.

阿巧姐看他这样，当然更不便多说什么。
Seeing this, she naturally refrained from further comment.

两个人等于都在肚子里做功夫。
Both were, in effect, conducting their manoeuvres inwardly.


看看日色偏西，
The sun was sinking westward.

桃林中潋滟红霞，如火如荼，真叫“夕阳无限好，只是近黄昏”，
Among the peach trees, rippling crimson radiance blazed like fire: truly, “The setting sun is infinitely lovely, only evening is near.”

再流连不走，天一黑，路上就不好了，
If they lingered until dark, the journey would be less safe.

于是仍旧照原来的样子，坐着马车，疾驰而回。
They took their original places in the carriages and drove swiftly back.

胡雪岩兴犹未央，同时要“守信用”，
Hu's pleasure was not yet exhausted, and he meant to keep his word.

说了带阿巧姐去挑首饰，也要送怡情老二“做媒”的谢礼，
He had promised jewellery shopping for A’qiao and a matchmaker's gift for Second Miss.

一定要做到，所以特意关照古应春，先到黄浦滩禅臣洋行。
He specially asked Gu to stop first at Chanchen Trading House on the Huangpu waterfront.

尤五记起胡雪岩的话，便特别注意阿巧姐，
Remembering Hu's remark, You watched A’qiao closely.

可是拿客人当“洋盘”？
Would she treat her customer as a gullible spender?

只见她初入店内，望着成排的玻璃柜和闪闪生光的珠宝首饰，颇有目迷五色之概，但很快的恢复了常态，
On entering, she seemed dazzled by the rows of glass cases and glittering jewellery, but soon recovered.

看看古应春说道：“古大少爷，请你问问洋人，有没有男用的表链？”
“Young Master Gu, please ask the foreigner whether they have watch chains for men.”

“男人用的？”
“For men?”

“是呀！”
“Yes.”

阿巧姐笑着问，
She smiled.

“怎么了？”
“What's the matter?”

“没有什么。
“Nothing.

我只当我没有听清楚。”
I only wondered whether I'd heard correctly.”

于是古应春跟洋人一说，立刻便捧出一只皮盒子来，打开来一看，里面有十几副表链，金银粗细，各式俱备。
Gu spoke to the shopkeeper, who brought out a leather case containing more than a dozen chains, gold and silver, thick and thin.

阿巧姐伸出手去，一条一条挑，最后挑了一根十八开金的，链子一端坠着一只铸得很玲珑的小金羊。
She examined them one by one and finally chose an eighteen-carat gold chain with a delicately cast little goat hanging from one end.

“这东西不错！”胡雪岩在一旁说，
“Very nice!” Hu said.

“再挑！”
“Choose something else.”

“不挑了。”
“No more.”

阿巧姐走开两步，同时招招手把古应春邀了过去，悄悄说道：“这是我自己买的东西，
Moving a few steps away, she beckoned Gu and whispered, “I'm buying this myself.

千万不好叫胡老爷惠钞。
You mustn't let Mr Hu pay.

请你替我付一付。”
Please settle it for me.”

说着，手一伸，一张折得小小的银票，塞到了古应春手里。
She slipped a tightly folded banknote into his hand.

古应春明白了，这是阿巧姐买给她乡下的丈夫的，自然不便让胡雪岩出钱，便点点头说：
Gu thought he understood: the chain was for her husband in the country, so she naturally could not let Hu pay.

“我知道了。”胡雪岩还在坚持着，要阿巧姐再挑一两年首饰，她只是袖手不动。
“I understand.” Hu still insisted that she choose a piece or two of jewellery, but she kept her hands tucked in her sleeves.

又再三问怡情老二喜欢什么？
He repeatedly asked Second Miss what she wanted.

她却不过情，挑了一瓶法国香水。
Unable to refuse his kindness, she chose a bottle of French perfume.


“算帐吧！”
“Settle the bill.”

胡雪岩取了一百两的银票，交给古应春。
Hu handed Gu a hundred-tael note.

接到手里，古应春也不作声，到帐台上跟洋女人结了帐，
Gu took it without comment and paid the foreign woman at the counter.

上车回到怡情老二的小房子，古应春才把他的银票交了回去，
Only after they had driven back to Second Miss's little house did he return Hu's note.

“你还阿巧姐六块洋钱。”
“You owe A’qiao six foreign silver dollars.

他说，“表链子阿巧姐自己买，不叫你惠钞。”
She bought the chain herself and won't let you pay for it.”

“岂有此理。”
“That's absurd!”

“日子长了，
“There are many days ahead.

何争一时？”尤五这样说，心里也有替他们作撮合的打算了。
Why dispute this moment?” You said, now intending to help bring them together himself.

胡雪岩听得这么一说，也就一笑置之。
Hu smiled and let it pass.

在那里吃了饭，
They dined there.

怡情老二拉着尤五到一边说了几句，尤五又转达给胡雪岩：阿巧姐今天既然休息，就不想回怡情院，
Second Miss drew You aside for a few words, which he then conveyed to Hu: since A’qiao had the day off, she did not want to return to Yiqing House.

问胡雪岩的意思如何？
What did Hu think?

“那好办！”他说，
“Easy enough.

“跟我走好了。”
She can come with me.”

“要走就早走！
“Then go early.

不必在这里泡了。”
Don't linger here.”

“时候还早，”胡雪岩踌躇着说：
Hu hesitated. “It's still early.

“我们一起看戏去？”
Why don't we all go to the theatre?”

这个提议没有人接受，
Nobody accepted.

古应春说明天要动身到苏州去见何桂清投信，尤五表示倦了，不想出门。
Gu said he was leaving for Suzhou the next day to deliver the letter to He Guiqing, and You said he was tired and did not want to go out.

其实都是托同，目的是要让胡雪岩踉阿巧姐早圆好梦。
Both were making excuses to let Hu and A’qiao fulfil their hopes sooner.


这当然不宜在裕记丝栈双宿双飞。
Naturally, they could not spend the night together at Yuji Silk Warehouse.

他由于尤五的推荐，住进一家新开的“仕宦行台”大兴客栈，
On You's recommendation, Hu took rooms at the newly opened Daxing Inn, an establishment catering to travelling officials.

是个小小的跨院，一明两暗三间房。
He had a small side courtyard with three rooms, a central reception room and two private rooms.

阿巧姐认为太大了用不着，
A’qiao thought it unnecessarily large.

胡雪岩认为房间一定要多，会客才方便，
Hu replied that ample rooms made receiving visitors easier.

有时客人来访，只为说一句知心话，
Sometimes a guest came only to exchange a word in confidence.

稠人广众，大家都憋在肚子里不便说，结果高朋满座，尽是空谈，
In a crowd, everyone kept such thoughts to himself, and a gathering of distinguished friends produced nothing but empty conversation.

如果多一间空屋子作为退步，就方便得多了。
An extra room into which one could withdraw made all the difference.

“照这个样子说，胡老爷，你是预备长住？”
“Then you're planning to stay a long time, Mr Hu?”

“是啊！”
“Yes.

胡雪岩说，“丝栈里诸多不便，
The warehouse has many inconveniences.

我想在这里长住，比较舒服。”
A longer stay here would be more comfortable.”

“你不是说，”阿巧姐指出他的前言不符后语，“半个月、二十天就要回杭州吗？”
“Didn't you say you'd return to Hangzhou in half a month or twenty days?” she asked, pointing out the contradiction.

“ 不错！”胡雪岩很从容地答道，
“Quite right,” he answered calmly.

“去了马上要来的，
“But I'll soon come back.

房间留着也不要紧，不过多花几个房钱，有限的。”
Keeping the rooms costs only a little more, not much.”

阿巧姐不作声，
She said nothing.

心里在盘算，既然如此，不妨备办一些动用什物，于是喊进茶房来，有条不紊地吩咐他去买办风炉锅碗等等，吃的、用的一大堆。
Thinking that they might as well acquire some household necessities, she called the attendant and gave orderly instructions to buy a stove, pots, bowls, and a host of other things to eat and use.

胡雪岩心想，照此看来，已不用多说，
Watching, Hu thought there was no need to say more.

至少一个“短局”已经存在了。
At least a temporary arrangement was already in existence.


阿巧姐也真是“做人家”的样子，
A’qiao truly behaved as though setting up a household.

为他打开行李，将日用杂件，布置妥贴，然后铺好了床，请胡雪岩安置。
She unpacked his luggage, put the everyday articles in their places, made the bed, and invited him to retire.

等胡雪岩上床，她却不睡，
Once he was in bed, however, she did not join him.

将一盏洋灯移到窗前方桌上，背着身子，不知在做些什么？
She moved a foreign lamp to the square table by the window and sat with her back towards him, doing something he could not see.

胡雪岩等得不耐烦，便即催问：“你怎么不来睡？
Impatient, he called, “Why don't you come to bed?

我有好些话跟你说。”
I've a great deal to say to you.”

“来了，来了！”
“Coming!”

于是阿巧姐移灯到梳妆台前，洗脸卸妆，又检点了门窗，才披了一件夹袄，掀开帐子，跟胡雪岩并头睡下。
She moved the lamp to the dressing table, washed off her make-up, checked the doors and windows, and at last, wearing a lined jacket, lifted the bed curtains and lay beside him.

“你晓得我刚才在做啥？”
“Do you know what I was doing?”

“我怎么晓得？”
“How should I?”

“你看！”
“Look.”

她伸手从夹袄口袋中掏出一个金表交到胡雪岩手里。
From her jacket pocket she took a gold watch and placed it in his hand.

表是他的，却多了一条金链子，正就是她在禅臣洋行自己花钱买的那一条。
It was his own, now fitted with the gold chain she had bought with her own money at Chanchen Trading House.

“我送你的。”
“My gift to you.”

“你送我的？”
“To me?”

胡雪岩大感意外，接着浮起满怀的喜悦和感动，
Astonishment gave way to delight and gratitude.

把表链子上坠着的那只小金羊，凑近眼前，仔细观玩，才领悟她特为挑选这一条链子的深意，
Bringing the little gold goat close to his eyes, he studied it and understood her purpose.

她是属羊的，这只玲珑的小金羊，就是她的化身，怀中相伴，片刻不离，
Born in the Goat year, she had chosen this delicate animal as her own likeness, to remain close to him in his pocket, never parted for a moment.

这番深情，有如食蜜，中边皆甜。
The tenderness was like honey, sweet from edge to centre.

“喏！”
“Here.”

她又塞过来一个纸包，
She passed him a paper packet.

“大概是胡太太替你打的丝绦子，
“I expect Mrs Hu braided that silk cord for you.

好好带回去，不然胡太太问起来，设法交帐。”
Take it home carefully, or you'll have no answer if she asks.”

她猜得一点不错，
She was exactly right.

原来系表的一条黑丝绦，是胡太太亲手所织，
His wife had made the black silk cord that had held the watch.

难为她想得这么周到。
How thoughtful of A’qiao to consider it!

“这条丝绦子，龌龊是龌龊得来！”阿巧姐皱着眉说，
“It's filthy,” she said, frowning.

“本来我想拿它洗洗清爽，深怕你太太会问，是哪个洗的？就露了马脚了。
“I thought of washing it, but your wife might ask who had done it, and then the secret would be out.

男人决不会想到，拿这条丝绦子洗洗干净！”
A man would never think of washing his watch cord!”

心细如发，人情透切，胡雪岩对阿巧姐刮目相看了。
Her meticulous care and understanding of people made him regard her with new respect.


一手把玩着“小金羊”，一手轻抚着活的“白羊”，
With one hand he played with the little gold goat; with the other he gently caressed the living “white goat.”

胡雪岩才真的领略到了温柔乡中的滋味，
Only now did he fully appreciate the pleasures of tenderness.

“阿巧，”他忽然问道：“你把我当作什么人？”
“A’qiao,” he asked suddenly, “what sort of man do you take me for?”

这话的意思欠明确，
The meaning was unclear.

阿巧姐只有这样答道：“好人。”
She could only answer, “A good man.”

“是相好的好，还是好坏的好？”
“Good as in a man you're fond of, or good as opposed to bad?”

“好坏的好。”
“Good as opposed to bad.”

“那种好人我不要做。”胡雪岩说，
“I don't want to be that sort of good man.

“我是说，你把我当作你的什么人？”
I mean, what am I to you?”

这话就更难回答了，
That was harder still.

如果说是客人，则私赠表记，变作笼络客人的虚情假意，
To call him a customer would make her personal gift seem a calculated attempt to win favour.

即有此意，阿巧姐也不肯承认，
Even if that had been her intention, she would not admit it.

若说是心上人，又觉得肉麻碍口，
To call him her beloved felt embarrassingly sentimental.

想了想有个说法：
After a moment, she found a way.

“你是胡老爷，
“You're Master Hu.

我自然当你老爷！”
Naturally, I regard you as my master.”

“老爷”的意思是双关，下人称男主人为老爷，妻妾称男主人亦是老爷。
The word had two meanings: servants used it of the head of a household, and wives and concubines used it of their husband.

阿巧姐这样回答，要自己去体会，才有意味，
The charm of her answer lay in leaving him to understand it himself.

胡雪岩当然懂，但为了逗乐，有怠误解。
Of course he did, but for amusement he deliberately misunderstood.

“你骂我‘赤佬’？”
“Are you calling me a devil?”

上海话称“鬼”为“赤化”，
In Shanghai speech, a ghost was called chilao.

苏州人则对邪魔外道的鬼祟，如“五通神”之类，为了忌讳，有时亦称“老爷”，
In Suzhou, people sometimes respectfully called sinister spirits, such as the Five Powers, “masters” to avoid offending them.

意义与上海话的“赤佬”相近，所以胡雪岩这样歪缠。
The sense was close to chilao, and Hu was twisting her words accordingly.

“啥人骂你？”
“Who's calling you names?”

阿巧姐真的骂了，
Now she really scolded him.

“你自己下作，
“You're the shameless one.

好的人不要做，要做赤佬。”
You won't be a decent man; you insist on being a devil.”

“赤佬自然不想做，老爷也不必。”
“I don't want to be a devil, and I needn't be a master.”

胡雪岩涎着关脸道，“阿巧，我做你的‘姘头’好不好？”
With an ingratiating smile, he asked, “A’qiao, may I be your lover?”

“要死快哉！”
“You wicked thing!”

阿巧姐打了他一下，用道地的苏州话娇嗔着，
She struck him lightly, scolding in broad Suzhou speech.

“闲话阿要难听！”
“Must you say such improper things?”


越是如此，胡雪岩越觉得乐不可支，
The more she protested, the more Hu enjoyed himself.

调笑闲话，几乎闹了一整夜。
They teased and laughed almost the whole night.

睡到第二天上午十一点，阿巧姐才起身，胡雪岩则还在呼呼大睡。
It was eleven the next morning before A’qiao rose; Hu still slept soundly.

也不过是她刚刚漱洗好，有人来敲门，
She had scarcely finished washing when someone knocked.

开开一看，是尤五和古应春。
Opening the door, she found You and Gu.

“怎么？”尤五探头一望，脱口问道：
You peered in. “What?

“小爷叔到此刻还不起来！
Little Uncle still isn't up?

你们一夜在干什么？”
What were you two doing all night?”

阿巧姐脸一红，强笑道：
Blushing, she forced a smile.

“我是老早起来了，
“I've been up ages.

哪个晓得他这么好困？”
Who knew he'd sleep so long?”

古应春走了过来，摸一摸那只洋瓷脸盆，余温犹在，
Gu came over and touched the enamel basin, which was still warm.

笑一笑说道：
He smiled.

“对！阿巧姐老早起来了。
“Yes, Sister A’qiao has been up ages.”

“谎话拆穿，阿巧姐更窘，不过她到底经验丰富，不至于手足无措，
Exposed, she grew more embarrassed, but she was too experienced to become flustered.

依旧口中敷衍，手头张罗，把客人招待到外面坐下，然后去叫醒胡雪岩。
Still exchanging civilities, she settled the visitors in the outer room, then went to wake Hu.

睡眼惺松的胡雪岩，还恋着宵来的温馨，一伸手就拉住了她往怀里抱，
Sleepy-eyed and still relishing the night's warmth, he reached out and drew her towards him.

急得阿巧姐恨恨地骂：
She scolded him anxiously.

“人家已经在笑了，
“They're laughing already!

你脸皮厚，我可吃不消！”
You may have a thick skin, but I can't bear it.”

“谁，
“Who?

谁在笑？”
Who's laughing?”

“尤五少、古大少都来了，
“Fifth Master You and Young Master Gu.

坐在外头，
They're outside.

你快起来吧！”阿巧姐又说，“说话当心些。”
Get up quickly—and mind what you say.”

一面说，一面服侍他起床，胡雪岩只是回忆着昨夜的光景又发愣、又发笑、傻兮兮的样子，惹得阿巧姐更着急。
As she helped him dress, he kept remembering the night, staring and smiling foolishly, which only increased her anxiety.

“求求你好不好！
“Please!

越是这样，人家越会跟你开玩笑。”
The more you behave like that, the more they'll tease you.”

“怕什么！”胡雪岩说，
“What is there to fear?

“你不理他们就是了。”
Just ignore them.”

见了面还是有一番调笑，甚至可说是谑，
When they met, there was indeed more teasing, almost mockery.

尤五和古应春这一双未来的郎舅，象逼问犯人口供似地，要胡雪岩“招供”衾底风情。
You and Gu, the prospective brothers-in-law, questioned him like interrogators demanding a prisoner's confession, insisting he reveal what had passed beneath the quilt.

急得里屋的阿巧姐，暗地里大骂“杀千刀”！
In the inner room, A’qiao silently cursed the pair.

幸好胡雪岩一问三不知，只报以满脸笑容，
Fortunately, Hu answered every question with a smile and professed to know nothing.

阿巧姐总算不至于太受窘，
She was spared the worst embarrassment.

当然，对胡雪岩这样的态度是满意的，同时也对他有了深一层的认识，
Naturally, she approved, and understood him a little better.

嘴上尽管不听她的劝，做出事来，深可人意，
He might refuse her advice in words, yet his actions were deeply considerate.

是要这样的男人才靠得住。
That was the kind of man one could rely on.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十二章（下，至本章结束）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Twenty-Two, concluding part
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


“好了，好了！”胡雪岩终于开了口，
“Enough, enough!” Hu Xueyan finally said.

“再说下去，有人要板面孔了。
“Keep this up and someone will lose her temper.

我请你们吃番菜去，算是替老古饯行。
I'll take you out for a Western meal, as a farewell dinner for Gu.”

“古应春未曾应声，先看一看尤五，
Before answering, Gu Yingchun glanced at You.

两人相视一笑，又微微点头，是莫逆于心的样子，倒使得胡雪岩困惑了。
They exchanged smiles and slight nods, apparently understanding each other perfectly, which puzzled Hu.

“你们捣什么鬼？”
“What are you two plotting?”

“不与你相干。”古应春说，
“Nothing to do with you,” Gu replied.

“我今天不走，
“I'm not leaving today.

明天一早动身。”
I'll set off first thing tomorrow.”

“怎么回事？”
“What's happened?”

胡雪岩更要追问。
Hu persisted.

“跟洋人还有点事要谈。”
“I still have something to discuss with the foreigners.”

胡雪岩不甚相信，但也没有理由不相信，
Hu was not entirely convinced, but had no reason to disbelieve him.

说过抛开，重申前请，邀他们俩去吃番菜。
He let the matter drop and repeated his invitation.

“阿巧姐呢？”古应春说，
“What about Sister A’qiao?” Gu asked.

“一起去吧！”
“Come with us!”

“谢谢！”里面高声应答，
“Thank you!” came a loud reply from inside.

苏州话最重语气，阿巧姐的声音，峭而直，一听就知道是峻拒之意。
Intonation mattered greatly in Suzhou speech, and the sharp, abrupt sound of her voice made the refusal unmistakable.

胡雪岩微感不安，而尤、古二人却夷然不以为忤，
Hu felt a little uneasy, but neither You nor Gu took offence.

“阿巧姐！”
“Sister A’qiao!”

尤五也提高了声音说，
You raised his voice too.

“既然你不肯去，那么转去一趟，
“If you won't come, go back for a visit.

老二在想念你。”
Second Miss has been missing you.”

“要的，要的！”
“Yes, of course!”

这一下她的声音缓和了，
Her tone softened at once.

“我本来要转去的。”
“I meant to go back anyway.”


一面说，一面走了出来，手里捧着长袍、马褂。
As she spoke, A’qiao came out carrying Hu's long gown and riding jacket.

胡雪岩倒也会享福，只张开双手，让她替他穿好，为他一粒一粒扣纽子。
He certainly knew how to enjoy being waited on: he merely spread his arms and let her dress him and fasten every button.

然后拘出表来看了一下说：
Then he took out his watch.

“走吧，
“Let's go.

一点钟了。”
It's one o'clock.”

“咦！”
“Hello!”

古应春眼尖，
Sharp-eyed Gu had noticed something.

“这条表链，怎么到了你手里？”
“How did that watch chain come into your hands?”

这是胡雪岩最得意的事，
This was what Hu was proudest of.

向古应春使个眼色，表示回头细谈，果然，在番菜馆里，他把阿巧姐的情意，津津有味地细说了给他们两人听。
He gave Gu a look promising to tell him later, and at the restaurant he did indeed describe A’qiao's loving thoughtfulness to the two men in delighted detail.

“小爷叔！”尤五笑道，
“Little Uncle!” You laughed.

“你真要交鸿运了，
“Your good fortune is really beginning.

到处都有这种艳福。”
Everywhere you go, the women favour you.”

这一说，胡雪岩的脸色反严肃了，
Hu's expression grew serious instead.

“现在我自己都不知道怎么办了？”
“I don't know what to do myself now.

他说，“你们倒替我出个主意看。”
Give me some advice.”

尤五和古应春又相视而笑，
You and Gu exchanged another smile.

“事缀则圆！”古应春答道，
“Give a matter time and it will come right,” Gu replied.

“等我苏州回来再说，
“Let's talk when I get back from Suzhou.

如何？”
How about that?”

“你哪一天回来？”
“When will you be back?”

“现在还说不定，
“I can't say yet.

会见那些大人先生要等，
You have to wait to see those high officials.

光是投封信，见不着面，又何必我自己去？”
If I merely leave a letter without meeting anyone, why go myself?”

“这话也不错，
“True enough.

不过我希望你早点回来，”胡雪岩紧接着说，
Still, I hope you'll return soon,” Hu added quickly.

“倒不是为这件事，
“Not on account of this.

怕洋人那里有什么话，你不在这里，接不上头。”
I'm afraid that if the foreigners have something to say while you're away, we won't be able to make contact.”

“不要紧。
“Don't worry.

我托了个人在那里，
I've entrusted someone with that.

尤五哥也认识的，
Brother Five knows him too.

如果洋人那里有什么话，他会来寻尤五哥，
If there's any word from the foreigners, he'll come to find Brother Five.

不会耽误。”
Nothing will be delayed.”


话说到这里，西息已端来了“尾食”，
By this time the waiter had brought dessert.

吃罢算帐，是一桌鱼翅席的价钱，而尤五却说未曾吃饱。
When they finished, the bill came to the price of a whole shark's-fin banquet, yet You declared that he had not eaten enough.

“番菜真没有吃头，
“There's nothing satisfying about Western food.

又贵，又不好。”尤五笑道，
Expensive and no good!” he said with a laugh.

“情愿摊头上一碟生煎馒头，
“I'd rather have a plate of pan-fried buns at a street stall.

还吃得落胃些。”
At least they'd sit comfortably in my stomach.”

当然，这也不过口发怨言而已，没有再去吃一顿的道理，
This was only a complaint, of course; there was no question of eating another meal.

出了番菜馆，访友的访友，办事的办事，各自分手，约定晚上在恰情院吃花酒。
Outside the restaurant they parted, some to visit friends, others to attend to business, agreeing to meet that evening for a courtesan banquet at Yiqing House.


胡雪岩这两天的心有点野了，
Hu's thoughts had strayed from work these past two days.

正经事虽有许多，却懒得去管，
Though there was plenty of serious business to attend to, he could not be bothered with it.

仍旧回到客栈，打算静下心来，将公私杂务，好好想它一想。
He went back to the inn, intending to settle his mind and think properly through his public and private affairs.

等一走进屋，非常意外地，发现陈世龙在坐等。
The moment he entered, however, he was astonished to find Chen Shilong waiting.

“咦！你怎么来了？
“Why, what brings you here?

啥辰光到的？”
When did you arrive?”

“来了不多一会。”
“Not long ago.

陈世龙答道，“一下船先到裕记丝栈，说胡先生搬到这里来了，”
I went straight from the boat to Yuji Silk Warehouse, and they told me you'd moved here.”

“坐，坐！
“Sit down, sit down.

湖州怎么样？”
How are things in Huzhou?

胡雪岩问道，“到上海来作啥？”
What have you come to Shanghai for?”

“王大老爷叫我来的。
“Prefect Wang sent me.

有封信在这里。”
I have a letter here.”


拆开信一看，又是求援。
Hu opened it and found another appeal for help.

为了漕米改为海运，原来粮船上的旗丁水手，既无口粮，又少人约束，
Since the tribute grain had been transferred to the sea route, the transport servicemen and sailors formerly employed on the grain boats had lost their rations and were largely without supervision.

所以往往聚众闹事，甚至发生抢案，
They frequently gathered to make trouble, and there had even been robberies.

黄宗汉颇为头涌。
Huang Zonghan found the situation a serious headache.

由于王有龄在筹办海运时，对这方面曾有建议，要为旗丁水手，妥筹生计，所以黄宗汉仍旧责成他设法安抚。
During the preparations for sea transport, Wang Youling had proposed making proper arrangements for these men's livelihood, so Huang now made him responsible for finding a way to pacify them.

王有龄在信中说，如果当初照他的条陈，拨出一笔费用来办理这事，比较容易收功，
Wang wrote that success would have been relatively easy if funds had been allocated as he originally recommended.

因循未办，
Instead, the matter had been allowed to slide.

如今看形势不妙，再来安抚，显得是受了此辈的威胁挟制，事倍功半，
To offer relief now that the situation looked dangerous would seem to be yielding to their threats and pressure, doubling the effort for half the result.

十分棘手。
It was a most awkward business.

同时湖州的团练，正在密锣紧鼓地编练，
Meanwhile, the Huzhou militia was being organised and trained at a furious pace.

而江浙交界的平望、泗安两处防务，又相当重要，经常耍去察看，
The defences at Pingwang and Si’an, on the Jiangsu-Zhejiang border, were important too and required frequent inspections.

他实在无力来顾及此事。
He simply could not attend to this as well.

本来想推给嵇鹤龄，再又想到，推给了嵇鹤龄，他仍旧要求助于胡雪岩，与其如此，不如直接写信乞援。
At first he had thought of passing it to Ji Heling; then he realised that Ji would still have to seek Hu's help, so he might as well write directly.

希望胡雪岩能请尤五一起到浙江去一趟，以同为漕帮的情谊，设法排解。
He hoped Hu could invite You to accompany him to Zhejiang and use the bonds of their common brotherhood to settle the trouble.

“王大老爷叫了我去，当面跟我说，他也晓得胡先生很忙，
“Prefect Wang summoned me and told me himself that he knew how busy you were,” Chen added.

如果真的分不开身，叫我陪了尤五爷去。”
“If you really can't get away, I'm to accompany Fifth Master You.”

“这件事有点麻烦。
“This could be troublesome.

他们槽帮里面的事，外人不清楚。
Outsiders don't understand the internal affairs of their brotherhood.

尤五跟浙江漕帮的头脑，是不是有交情，还不晓得。
We don't even know whether You has any connection with its leaders in Zhejiang.

说不定不肯插手。”胡雪岩又说，“你郁四叔怎么说？”
He may refuse to get involved.” Hu added, “What did your Uncle Four say?”

“请尤五爷去排解，就是郁四叔出的主意。”
“It was Uncle Four's idea to ask Fifth Master You to mediate.”

“喔！”
“Oh!”

胡雪岩欣慰的说，
Hu was reassured.

“那就不错了。
“Then that sounds promising.

走！
Come along.

我们到恰情院去。”
Let's go to Yiqing House.”


于是一起到了怡情老二的小房子里，
They went together to Second Miss's little house.

尤五还没有回来，胡雪岩便趁此机会，向陈世龙细问湖州的情形，
You had not yet returned, and Hu used the opportunity to question Chen closely about Huzhou.

知道今年因为洋庄可能不动，时世又不好，养蚕的人家不多。
He learned that comparatively few households were raising silkworms that year: the foreign buyers might not enter the market, and the times were unsettled.

不过陈世龙又说了他的看法，认为这是一时的现象，
Chen thought this was only temporary.

如果有钱，可以放给蚕农，明年以新丝作抵，倒是一笔好生意。
Anyone with money could make a good business of lending to the silkworm farmers against the following year's new silk.

“有钱，好做的生意多得很，
“With money, there are plenty of good businesses to be done.

眼前还谈不到明年的事。”胡雪岩说，
It's too soon to discuss next year,” Hu replied.

“你这趟回去，先打听今年的行情，
“When you go back, find out about this year's market first.

湖属有多少人养蚕？
How many households in Huzhou Prefecture are raising silkworms?

大概能出多少丝？
Roughly how much silk will they produce?

打听确实了，赶紧写信来。
Get reliable figures and write to me at once.

这什事要做得秘密，
This must be done discreetly.

请人去办，
Hire people to make the inquiries.

不可省小钱。”
Don't try to save a few small coins.”


“是的。”
“Yes.”

陈世龙接着提起他的亲事，
Chen then mentioned his marriage.

说岳家已经跟他谈过，日子想挑在端午节前后，
His future in-laws had spoken to him about choosing a date around the Dragon Boat Festival.

问胡雪岩的意思怎么样？
What did Hu think?

“那时候不正是新丝上市吗？”
“Isn't that just when the new silk comes on the market?”

“我也是这么说，
“That's what I said.

生意正忙的时候办喜酒，‘又是灯笼又是会’，
Holding a wedding when business is busiest would be like having both a lantern display and a fair at once.

何必夹在一起？
Why crowd everything together?

他们说，如果不是端午前后，就要延后到秋天。”
They say that if it isn't around the festival, we'll have to wait until autumn.”

“与其延后，何不超前？”
“Why postpone it when you could bring it forward?”

胡雪岩以家长的口吻说：
Hu spoke with the authority of a family elder.

“你们早点‘圆房’倒好。”
“You'd do better to begin married life sooner.”

“阿珠的娘不肯马虎，
“A’zhu's mother won't do things carelessly.

一定要把嫁妆办好。
She insists on having the dowry ready first.

除非……”
Unless...”

陈世龙说，
Chen hesitated.

“胡先生说一句。”
“Unless you put in a word.”

“说一句还不容易，
“That's easy enough.

你早跟我说了，我早就开口了。
If you'd told me sooner, I'd have spoken sooner.

这趟你回去跟他们老夫妇说，生意要紧，家也要紧，
When you go back, tell the old couple this: business matters, but so does a home.

趁新丝上市以前让你办了喜事成了家，定定心在生意上巴结，
Let you have your wedding and set up your household before the new silk reaches the market; then you can concentrate on working hard.

岂不是两全其美？”
Wouldn't that serve both purposes?”

胡雪岩又说，“今年秋天局面会变动，
Hu went on, “Things will change this autumn.

我的场面也要扯得更大，那时人手越嫌不够，
I mean to expand my operations too, and I'll be shorter of people than ever.

一办喜事，忙上加忙，
A wedding then would add to the rush.

这把算盘打不通。”
That calculation doesn't work.”


他说一句，阿世龙应一句，
Chen assented to every point.

也不过刚刚谈完，尤五和古应春联诀而至，
They had scarcely finished when You and Gu arrived together.

跟陈世龙寒暄了一番，问起来意，
After exchanging greetings, they asked what had brought him.

陈世龙只有目视胡雪岩示意。
Chen could only look towards Hu to explain.

“尤五哥，你的麻烦来了！”
“Brother Five, here's trouble for you!”

胡雪岩将浙江漕帮不遵约束，聚众滋事的情形，以及王有龄的要求都说给他听。
Hu described the Zhejiang brotherhood's refusal to submit to discipline, the gatherings that had turned into disturbances, and Wang's request.

“事情很麻烦！”尤五说了这一句，紧接着表示：“不过上刀山我也去。”
“It's a difficult business,” You said, then added immediately, “But I'd go even if I had to climb a mountain of blades.”

“尤五爷真是够朋友。”
“Fifth Master You, you're a true friend!”

陈世龙立即表现了不胜倾眼的神态。
Chen's manner showed unbounded admiration.

在胡雪岩，觉得他这样豪爽地答应，倒不无意外之感，
Hu himself was rather surprised by this ready and generous agreement.

想到尤五去杭州，古应春去苏州，上海剩下自己一个人，与洋人言语不通，
But if You went to Hangzhou and Gu to Suzhou, he would be left alone in Shanghai, unable to speak to the foreigners.

万一有事，虽说古应春托有一个人在这里，但素昧平生，
True, Gu had someone here to help if anything happened, but Hu had never met the man.

而且有些事只有古、尤二人清楚，
Besides, there were matters only Gu and You understood.

自己还是等于孤立无助，
In effect, he would be isolated and helpless.

此事十分不妥。
That would never do.

“老古！”他当机立断他说：“上海一定要你坐镇。
He decided at once. “Gu, you must stay here to hold things together.

我跟你换一换，
Let's exchange places.

我到苏州去看何学台，你留在上海。”
I'll go to Suzhou to see Education Commissioner He, and you remain in Shanghai.”


这番变化将古应春和尤五的“密谋”完全推翻，说起来也是很扫兴的一件事，
This change overturned the two friends' “secret plot” completely, and was a considerable disappointment.

是尤五的提议，
It had been You's suggestion.

认为郁四他们在湖州为胡雪岩谋娶芙蓉这件事，确是够好朋友的味道，不妨如法炮制，
What Yu Si and the others had done in Huzhou to help Hu marry Furong had been a fine act of friendship; why should they not follow the same example?

古应春特为迟一天走，就是要等着看胡雪岩和阿巧姐的态度，
Gu had deliberately postponed his departure by a day to observe Hu and A’qiao.

如果妾有情，郎有意，古应春就预备趁去苏州之便，专诚到木渎去访阿巧姐的夫家跟娘家，拿大把银子来为他们结成连理。
If the affection was mutual, he intended to take advantage of his journey to Suzhou to visit both her husband's family and her own family at Mudu, and spend freely to bring the couple together.

刚才他们就是从怡情院来，据怡情老二说，阿巧姐不但已经点头答应，而且还提供了许多情况，指出着手进行的办法，
They had just come from Yiqing House, where Second Miss told them that A’qiao had not only agreed but supplied a great deal of information and explained how to proceed.

“火到猪头烂”，
Given enough fire, even a pig's head would cook tender.

最多花上三五百银子，就可买得阿巧姐的自由之身，
Three to five hundred taels at the very most would buy her freedom.

如今胡雪岩这一说，岂非无趣？
Now Hu's proposal had spoiled it all.


“怎么回事？”
“What's the matter?”

胡雪岩看他态度有异，追问着说：
Hu noticed their altered expressions and pressed them.

“老古，你有什么难处？”
“Gu, is there some difficulty?”

“唉！”古应春笑着叹口气，
“Ah!” Gu sighed with a smile.

“好事多磨！”
“The course of a good thing never runs smooth.”

“怎么呢？”
“What do you mean?”

“事情有缓急，”尤五抢着对古应春说，
“Some matters are more urgent than others,” You said quickly to Gu.

“你就守老营吧。
“Stay and guard the home camp.

过些日子专程跑一趟，也算不了什么。”
It won't hurt to make a special trip later.”

“那也只好如此。”
“I suppose that's what we'll have to do.”

“你们讲啥？”
“What are you talking about?”

胡雪岩大惑不解，
Hu was thoroughly puzzled.

“何妨说出来大家商量！”
“Why not tell me so we can discuss it?”

“说出来就没有味道了。”古应春摇摇头。
Gu shook his head. “If we told you, it would spoil the pleasure.”


尤五也是微笑不作声。
You too merely smiled and said nothing.

这就很明显了，
That made it plain enough.

虽不知他们葫芦里卖的什么药，但必与他跟阿巧姐有关。
Hu still did not know exactly what they were concealing, but it must concern him and A’qiao.

理解到这一点，不免又把这段倘来艳福思量了一下，
Realising this, he reconsidered the amorous good fortune that had fallen into his lap.

诚然，阿巧阻的情味，与他过去所遇到的任何女人不同，
Certainly, A’qiao had a charm unlike any woman he had known.

真可以说一句“牡丹花下死，做鬼也风流”！
One could truly say, “Die beneath the peony blossoms, and even as a ghost you remain a lover.”

但世界上天生有一种福气人，什么事都不必做，席丰履厚，
But some people were born fortunate, with wealth and comfort assured and nothing to do.

多的是闲情，专门可以消耗在阿巧姐这种尤物身上，
They had abundant leisure to spend on a captivating woman like her.

而自己不同，
He was different.

自己天生来就是做生意的，而且是做大生意的，
He had been born for business, and big business at that.

虽然也能欣赏阿巧姐的好处，并且有办法使得阿巧姐这样的人，心甘情愿随自己摆布，然而到底不是“正业”，
He could appreciate her attractions, and could make a woman like her willingly submit to his wishes, but that was not his proper occupation.

不可为她耗费工夫，更不可为她神魂颠倒，忘记了自己应该是干什么的！
He must not waste time on her, still less lose his head and forget what he was meant to be doing.

这样想着，觉得手心上都有汗了，
At this thought his palms grew damp.

内心相当不安，
He was deeply uneasy.

从到上海以来，似乎一直迷恋着阿巧姐，还不曾好好办过一件正经事。
Ever since coming to Shanghai, it seemed, he had been infatuated with A’qiao and had not properly attended to a single serious matter.

因此，他收敛笑容，
His smile vanished.

正色说道：“两位的心思，我有点猜到了。
“I can guess something of what you're thinking.

我不是味着良心说话，这不过逢场作戏，
I'm not speaking against my conscience, but this is only a passing romance.

要看机缘，总要顺乎自然，
It depends on opportunity; things must take their natural course.

不可强求。
We mustn't force them.

湖州那件事我做得有点冒失，现在还有麻烦，
I acted a little rashly in that Huzhou affair, and there's trouble still.

当然，说句狂话，什么麻烦我都不怕，但要工夫来料理，我现在少的就是工夫。”
To boast a little, I'm afraid of no trouble at all—but dealing with it takes time, and time is what I lack.”

这段话颇引起尤五的警惕，古应春的脸色也不同的，
This was a warning to You, and Gu's expression changed too.

“我们晓得了。”他说，
“We understand,” Gu said.

“听你的意思办，目前按兵不动。”
“We'll do as you wish and make no move for the present.”


“这样最好。
“That's best.

到我觉得可以办了，‘我一定拜托你们费心。”
When I feel the time is right, I'll certainly ask you both to take the trouble.”

胡雪岩忽然想到，
Then something occurred to Hu.

“五哥，你这趟正好把七姐带了去，将我们所议的那件事办一办。”
“Brother Five, why not take Seventh Sister with you this time and settle that matter we discussed?”

这件事就是请王有龄与七姑奶奶认作义兄妹。
He meant asking Wang Youling and the Seventh Lady to become sworn brother and sister.

机会倒是好机会，但事先要谈妥当，行礼要有胡雪岩在场，
It was a good opportunity, but everything ought to be settled beforehand, and Hu should be present at the ceremony.

就这样带了去，登门认亲，未免太冒昧了。
To bring her along and arrive at Wang's door asking to form the relationship would be too presumptuous.

尤五说了他的意思，古应春亦以为然，胡雪岩也就不再多说。
You explained this, Gu agreed, and Hu said no more.

但这一下倒提醒了尤五，认为这趟到杭州去，应该多备礼物结交王家，以为将来结干亲的地步，
It did remind You, however, that he ought to take plenty of gifts to Hangzhou and cultivate the Wang family, preparing the way for the future bond.

于是由此开始，商量杭州的行程，决定在第三天动身。
From this they turned to his journey and decided he would leave the day after next.

“小爷叔，你呢？”
“What about you, Little Uncle?”

“我随时可走。
“I can leave at any time.

没有事的话，我明天就动身，
If nothing comes up, I'll go tomorrow.

早去早回。”
The sooner I go, the sooner I'm back.”

“不行！”尤五说，
“No,” You said.

“这条路上，不怎么安静，
“The route isn't very peaceful.

我叫人替你打听一下，雇一只专船，派人陪了你去。”
I'll have someone make inquiries, hire a boat for your exclusive use, and send men to escort you.”

“不要紧！”
“Don't worry.”

胡雪岩因为尤五此行，琐琐碎碎的事情也很多，不愿再麻烦他，这样说道：
Knowing how many small arrangements You already had to make, Hu did not want to trouble him further.

“这条路，我不熟，老古熟，
“I don't know the route, but Gu does.

我请他帮忙，
I'll ask him to help.

你就不必管了。”
You needn't bother with it.”

“对！”古应春立即应声，
“Exactly!” Gu immediately agreed.

“这件事交给我，
“Leave it to me.

包管妥贴。”
I guarantee everything will be properly arranged.”


这样说定了，各自散去。
With this settled, they parted.

陈世龙住在裕记丝栈，胡雪岩先把他送到那里，有许多话叮嘱他，主要的是为尤五，
Chen was staying at Yuji Silk Warehouse, and Hu took him there first, giving him many instructions, chiefly about You.

他是王有龄请去排难解纷的上客，但在官面上的身分不同，
Wang had invited You as an honoured guest to resolve a difficult dispute, but his status in official society was another matter.

而且将来还要结成干亲，所以为了双方的面子，决不可叫尤五受了委屈，
Since they also hoped to form a sworn family relationship, neither side must lose face, and You must on no account be slighted.

他关照陈世龙当面将这些情形跟王有龄讲清楚。
Hu told Chen to explain all this to Wang in person.

“顶要紧的一句话，尤五爷这趟去，完全是私人面子，
“The most important point is that Fifth Master You is coming entirely as a personal favour.

所以他只是王大老爷一个人的客人，
He is Prefect Wang's guest alone.

跟浙江官面上，不必交结。
There's no need for him to form connections with other Zhejiang officials.

这一点，你要跟王大老爷说清楚，省得尤五爷受窘。”
Make that perfectly clear to the prefect, so Fifth Master You won't be put in an awkward position.”

陈世龙心领神会，诺诺连声。
Chen understood and repeatedly agreed.

等胡雪岩说完要走，陈世龙终于忍不住问了一声：
When Hu had finished and was about to leave, he could not resist a question.

“胡先生，那阿巧姐是怎么回事？”
“Mr Hu, what exactly is the situation with Sister A’qiao?”

“说来话长，
“A long story.

慢慢你就知道了。”
You'll learn in time.”

胡雪岩倒被提醒了，
The question reminded Hu of something.

“回去不必多说。”
“There's no need to talk about it when you get back.”

“知道，知道，
“Of course, of course.

我不能不晓得轻重，”
I know what should and shouldn't be said.”


回到大兴客栈，阿巧姐正在灯下理燕窝，用心专注，竟不萝发觉胡雪岩。
Back at Daxing Inn, A’qiao was cleaning bird's nest by lamplight, so absorbed that she did not notice Hu's arrival.

她已经卸了妆，解了髻，一头黑发，松松地挽成一条极粗的辫子，甩在一边，露出雪白的一段头颈。
She had removed her make-up and undone her hair, gathering its black abundance into a loose, thick braid cast to one side, which exposed a length of snow-white neck.

胡雪岩忍不住低头闻了一下。
Unable to resist, Hu bent down to breathe its scent.

这一下把阿巧姐吓碍跳了起来，脸都急白了，
She jumped up in fright, her face turning white.

看清是胡雪岩才深深透了口气，拍着胸以白眼相向。
Only when she saw who it was did she let out a long breath, patting her chest and glaring at him.

“何至于如此！”
“Surely not such a fright!”

胡雪岩歉意地笑道，
He smiled apologetically.

“早知你这么胆小，我不跟你闹着玩了。”
“If I'd known you were so timid, I wouldn't have teased you.”

“ ‘人吓人，吓煞人’！
“People can frighten each other to death!

你摸摸看！”
Feel!”

阿巧姐拉着他一只手在左胸上探试，
She took his hand and pressed it to the left side of her chest.

果然心还在跳。
Her heart was still racing.

“你胆这么小，怎么办？”胡雪岩说：
“What am I to do with someone so timid?” he asked.

“后天我要到苏州去两三天，
“I'm going to Suzhou the day after tomorrow for two or three days.

本来想留你一个人在这里住，现在看起来，你还是回怡情院吧！”
I meant to leave you here alone, but perhaps you'd better return to Yiqing House.”

答复大出胡雪岩意外，
Her answer astonished him.

“我不回去。”
“I'm not going back.”

她说，声音虽平静，但每个字都象摸得出梭角似地。
Her voice was calm, but every word had hard, unmistakable edges.

“怎么？”
“Why?

胡雪岩问道：“是啥缘故。”
What's the reason?”

“我已经算过工钱了，”
“I've already settled my wages.

阿巧姐说：“那种地方只有出来的，没有回进去的。”
Once you leave a place like that, you don't go back.”

“好志气！”
“Good for you!”

胡雪岩赞了她一句，心里却有些着急，
Hu praised her, but inwardly grew anxious.

阿巧姐决心从良，是跟定了自己了，
If she was determined to leave that life, she had committed herself to him.

这件事只有往前走，不容自己退步，
This affair could only move forward; there was no room for him to withdraw.

看来还有麻烦。
More trouble seemed likely.


“你到苏州去好了。”阿巧姐坦然他说，
“Go to Suzhou,” A’qiao said serenely.

“我一个人住在这里好了。
“I can stay here alone.

我只怕人装鬼吓我，
It's people pretending to be ghosts that frighten me.

真的鬼，我反而不怕。”
Real ghosts don't.”

“这又是你这时候说说。
“That's easy to say now.

真的有鬼出现，怕不是吓得你半死。”
If a ghost really appeared, you'd probably be half dead with fright.”

“我不相信鬼。
“I don't believe in ghosts.

总要让我见过，我才相信。”
I'll have to see one before I believe.”

“自然有人见过。”
“Some people certainly have seen them.”

胡雪岩坐在她对面，两手支颐，盯着她看，
Sitting opposite her with his chin in his hands, Hu stared at her.

“我讲两个鬼故事你听！”
“Let me tell you two ghost stories.”

“不要，不要！”
“No, no!”

阿巧姐赶紧站起身来，
She hurried to her feet.

“看你这样子瞪着人看，就怕人。
“The way you're staring is frightening enough.

吃了燕窝粥睡吧！”
Have some bird's-nest congee and go to bed.”

茶几上有一只“五更鸡”，微微的几星火，煨着一盂燕窝拣得一根毛都看不见，
On the tea table, a few embers glowed in a small “fifth-watch cock” stove beneath a bowl of bird's nest. She had picked it so thoroughly that not a single feather remained.

且不说滋补的力量如何，光是她这份细心料理，就令人觉得其味无穷了。
Whatever its nourishing virtues, the care she had taken alone made it seem infinitely delicious.

两人上了床，阿巧姐紧抱着他说：
Once they were in bed, she clasped him tightly.

“现在你可以讲鬼故事了。”
“Now you can tell me your ghost stories.”

“奇了！”胡雪岩笑着问：
“How strange!” He laughed.

“何以刚才不要听，现在要听？”
“Why didn't you want them before, but want them now?”

“现在？
“Now?

现在我不怕了！”
Now I'm not afraid!”

说完，把他搂得更紧。
She held him still closer.

这是胡雪岩所从未有过的经验，
This was a new experience for Hu.

太太是“上床”亦是“君子”，芙蓉的风情也适可而止，
His wife remained a model of propriety even in bed; Furong's amorous playfulness went only so far.

只有阿巧姐似乎每夜都是新鲜的。
With A’qiao, every night seemed fresh.

于是胡雪岩添枝加叶他讲了两个鬼故事，吓得阿巧姐在他胸前乱钻。
He embellished two ghost stories until she burrowed against his chest in alarm.

又怕听，又胆小，原是听讲鬼故事的常情，只不如她这般矛盾，
To be afraid yet unable to resist listening was common enough in those who heard ghost stories, though few were as contradictory as she.

胡雪岩也知道她有些做作，但做作得不惹人厌。
He knew she was putting it on a little, but her performance did not annoy him.


一宵缱绻，胡雪岩第二天仍旧睡到很晚才起身。
After a night of tenderness, Hu again slept late.

这天他知道尤五去杭州之前，有许多杂物要安排，古应春替他去雇船找人护送，也在忙着，
He knew You had many miscellaneous arrangements to make before leaving for Hangzhou, while Gu was busy hiring a boat and finding escorts for him.

都不会到大兴来。
Neither would visit Daxing Inn.

自己没有急事要料理，便又懒得出门，愿意在妆台边守伺阿巧姐的眼波。
With no urgent business himself, he felt too lazy to go out and preferred to linger beside A’qiao's dressing table, watching the play of her eyes.

“可有人会来吃饭？”阿巧姐说，
“Will anyone be coming to eat?” she asked.

“今天我们要开伙食了！”
“We're starting our own cooking today.”

“那有多麻烦，
“Why take all that trouble?

馆子里叫了来就是了。”
We can order from a restaurant.”

“那不象做人家。”
“That isn't keeping house.”

阿巧姐挽起一只篮子，
She picked up a basket.

“我上小菜场去，顺便雇个小大姐来。”
“I'll go to the food market and hire a maid while I'm out.”

胡雪岩实在不愿她离开，但又无法阻拦，只好怏怏然答应。
Hu did not want her to leave, but could find no reason to stop her and agreed reluctantly.

一个人在旅馆里，觉得百无聊赖，做什么都没有兴致。
Alone at the inn, he felt utterly bored, without the slightest interest in anything.

勉强把烦躁的心情按捺了下来，静坐着细想，
Forcing down his restlessness, he sat quietly and thought.

突然发觉，这是从来不曾有过的事，
Suddenly he realised that he had never felt like this before.

哪怕是王有龄到京里，他被钱庄辞退，在家赋闲的那段最倒霉的日子，也没有这样意兴阑珊过！
Even in his worst days, when Wang had gone to the capital and he had been dismissed from the bank and sat idle at home, he had never been so dispirited.

“这是什么道理？”胡雪岩喃喃自语，暗暗心惊，
“What can it mean?” he murmured, secretly alarmed.

“怎么一下子卸掉了劲道？”
“How have I suddenly lost all my drive?”


他在想，可能是自己太倦了。
Perhaps he was simply too tired.

经年奔波，遭遇过无数麻烦，精力形成透支，实在需要好好休息一下，
Years of rushing about and dealing with countless difficulties had overdrawn his reserves of energy; he really needed a good rest.

但是在这夷场上，十丈软红尘中，无法休息，
But he could not rest amid all the glitter and bustle of the foreign settlement.

最好是带着阿巧姐，借一处西湖的别墅，安安静静住上两个月，什么事不做，什么心不用，
Best of all would be to take A’qiao to a borrowed villa by West Lake and live quietly for two months, doing nothing, worrying about nothing.

闲来划划船、看看山，
They could row a boat or look at the hills at leisure.

到晚来弄条鲜鱼，中段醋溜，头尾做汤，烫一斤竹时青跟阿巧姐灯下对酌，
In the evening they could get a fresh fish, cook the middle section in vinegar sauce, make soup from the head and tail, warm a jin of Bamboo-Leaf Green wine, and drink together by lamplight.

那就是神仙生活了。
That would be a life fit for immortals.

这样不胜向往地想着，忽又自笑，
He contemplated it longingly, then suddenly laughed at himself.

事业做得大了，气局却反变得小！
His business had grown, yet his ambitions had shrunk.

刚得意的那一刻，曾经想过，要把现在住处附近的地皮都买下来，好好盖座花园，日日开宴，座客常满，大大地摆一番场面。
In his first flush of success he had thought of buying all the land around his home, building a fine garden, giving daily banquets, keeping his seats filled with guests, and making a splendid display.

如今却只愿跟阿巧姐悄悄厮守，
Now he wanted only to withdraw quietly with A’qiao.

这又是什么道理？
Why?

两件事并在一起想，很容易发觉相同之处：这些感觉，都是这几天跟阿巧姐在一起以后才有的。
Putting his loss of drive and his shrinking ambitions together, he easily saw their common source: both feelings had appeared only in these past few days with A’qiao.

有人说：温柔乡中，最容易消磨一个人的志气。
People said that a woman's tender embrace was the easiest place for a man's ambition to waste away.

这话看来有道理。
There seemed to be something in it.

想到了这个道理，接着便是警惕，由警惕又生出不服气的感觉，
Recognition brought alarm, and alarm gave way to defiance.

决定抛开阿巧姐，去想正经事。
He decided to put A’qiao out of his mind and think about serious matters.

这一想，就是一身汗！
That thought brought him out in a sweat.

正事不知有多少，不知为何都抛在脑后！
There was no end of important business, yet somehow he had forgotten it all.

这样下去，可真是危险了。
To continue like this would be dangerous indeed.


于是等阿巧姐回来，他说：“你马马虎虎弄顿饭来吃。
When A’qiao returned, he said, “Just make us something simple.

吃完了，我要出门。”
I have to go out after eating.”

“你看你！”阿巧姐笑道：
“Listen to you!” She laughed.

“阔气起来，要顿顿在馆子里叫菜，
“When you're extravagant, every meal must come from a restaurant.

小气起来，连外面去吃碗面都不肯。”
When you're stingy, you won't even go out for a bowl of noodles.”

这一下提醒了他，自己也失笑了，
This reminded him, and he laughed too.

“都是你那‘做人家’这句话害的，
“It's all because you talked about keeping house.

我总以为要在家里吃了午饭再出门。”他一面走，一面说：
I kept thinking I had to eat lunch at home before going out.” He began to walk away.

“好了，好了，
“All right, all right.

我到外面去吃。”
I'll eat outside.”

“慢点！”
“Wait!”

阿巧姐拉住他，指着篮子说：
She caught hold of him and pointed to the basket.

“我一篮子的菜怎么办？”
“What am I to do with all this food?”

“晚上来吃！”
“We'll eat it tonight.”

这句话使得她深为满意，
This pleased her greatly.

“请他们都来！”她说，
“Invite them all,” she said.

“菜多吃不完。”
“There's more than we can finish.”

“也好！
“Good.

你索性多做些，就算替尤五爷饯行。”
You might as well make a little more and give Fifth Master You a farewell dinner.”


等出得门来，却有些茫然，
Once outside, however, Hu felt at a loss.

因为他的本意，只是自己跟自己较劲，不愿沉溺在温柔乡中。
His real purpose was to struggle against himself, refusing to sink into the comforts of love.

要办的事虽多，或者还不到时候，或者要听候他人的消息，再定行止，
There was much to be done, but some matters were not yet ripe, and others depended on news from other people before he could decide his next move.

此时一事不能办，
At this moment he could do nothing.

何去何从？
Where should he go?

倒费踌躇。想一想还该先到裕记丝栈，找着了陈世龙再说。
After some hesitation, he decided to try Yuji Silk Warehouse and find Chen first.

事不凑巧，陈世龙刚刚出门，
Unfortunately, Chen had just gone out.

丝栈里的执事非常客气，一定要留胡雪岩在那里坐。奉茶奉烟，极其殷勤。
The clerk was most courteous and insisted that Hu stay, pressing tea and tobacco on him with every attention.

他情不可却而懒于应酬，便这样答道：
Hu could hardly refuse, but felt no inclination to make conversation.

“你们不必招呼我，
“Please don't trouble yourselves over me.

我喝喝茶等着，
I'll have some tea and wait.

尽管请便，不然我就不敢打搅了。”
Go about your business, or I shan't dare impose on you.”

执事的听他这样说。知道他不愿跟闲杂人等在一起，便将他引入一间小屋，那也是尤五跟人约会谈体已话的地方，
The clerk understood that he did not want to sit among miscellaneous visitors and led him into a small room where You also held private conversations.

布置不见得好，却有很精致舒服的一张藤靠椅，躺着想心事，最为合适。
The furnishings were nothing special, but there was a finely made, very comfortable reclining wicker chair, ideal for lying back and thinking.

“这里好！”他欣然说道，
“This is excellent,” Hu said happily.

“我正好在这里打个盹！”
“I can have a nap here.”

这就更明白表示出来，不愿有人搅扰了，
That made his wish not to be disturbed still clearer.

执事的连声称是，叫小徒弟把一碗现泡的盖碗茶，四个果盘子，还有一支水烟袋都挪了进来，取张方凳当茶几，
The clerk agreed at once, had a young apprentice bring in a freshly brewed covered bowl of tea, four dishes of fruit, and a water pipe, and arranged them on a square stool serving as a tea table.

安设停当，掩上门迟了出去。
Everything ready, he withdrew and closed the door.


胡雪岩躺了下来，觉得相当舒服，
Hu lay back in considerable comfort.

心一静，便觉得隔室的谈话声，历历入耳。
As his mind grew quiet, he became aware of voices in the next room, every word distinct.

留神细听，谈的是地皮生意。
Listening closely, he found they were discussing the land business.

胡雪岩亦曾有意于此，便一字不肯放过。
He too had considered entering it, and now let nothing escape him.

那两人对洋场的情况，和洋人的动向，相当清楚，
The two men knew a good deal about the foreign settlement and the foreigners' intentions.

说洋人跟中国人不同，
They said that foreigners and Chinese did things differently.

中国人的路是走出来，人多成市，自然走出一条路来，
In China, roads emerged from use: people gathered, a market formed, and naturally a track was worn.

等到预备修路，路面为两旁的市房摊贩所限制，已无法扩充。
By the time anyone planned a proper road, shops and stalls hemmed it in on both sides, leaving no room for widening.

洋人的办法不同，同先开路，
The foreigners built their roads first.

有了路便有人到，有人到便有房屋，自然市面会热闹起来。
Roads brought people, people brought houses, and trade naturally flourished.

因此中国人的市面做不大，
That was why Chinese commercial districts could not grow on the same scale.

不能不佩服洋人的规模、气魄。
One had to admire the foreigners' breadth of vision and boldness.

这番话，在胡雪岩可说闻所未闻，
Hu had never heard anything like this.

细细玩味，果然大有道理。
The more he considered it, the more sense it made.

他听王有龄谈过京城里的情形、如今才知道京城的市面与众不同，
Wang had told him about the capital, and now he understood why its commercial streets were different.

一半固然因为天子脚下，人烟稠密，
Its great population under the emperor's very feet explained only half of it.

一半就因为京城里的建制，也跟洋人一样，先开好大路，分好地段，哪里做衙门，哪里住人，哪里开店，
The other half lay in its planning, which resembled the foreigners' method: broad roads laid out first, land divided into districts, separate places assigned to government offices, homes, and shops.

开店又分出来，哪里可以开戏园茶楼，哪里可以贩牛羊驴马，
Commercial areas were further distinguished: theatres and teahouses could open here, cattle, sheep, donkeys, and horses could be sold there.

这样子的规模，自然就可观了。
Such planning naturally produced an impressive result.

“照上海滩的地形看，
“Look at Shanghai's layout,” one of the voices continued.

大马路、二马路，这样开下去。南北方面的热闹是看得到的，
“With First Road, Second Road, and more laid out on that pattern, you can see how the northern and southern districts will prosper.

其实，向西一带，更有可为，
But there's even greater promise to the west.

眼光远的，趁这时候，不管它芦荡、水田，尽量买下来，
A man with foresight should buy all he can now, whether reed marsh or paddy field.

等洋人的路一开到那里，乖乖，坐在家里发财。“
Once the foreigners' roads reach it—good heavens!—he can sit at home and grow rich.”


胡雪岩听隔室说到这里，哪还能静心躺下去？
How could Hu lie there quietly after hearing that?

但说了睡个午觉，突然告辞而去，也不大合适。
Yet he had said he wanted a nap, so abruptly taking his leave would seem odd.

因而只好按捺心情强忍着，无奈遇到这种生意经，胡雪岩就是抛不开。
He could only restrain himself and wait, though this kind of business talk was impossible for him to put out of his mind.

他对上海的地形不熟，要筹划也无从筹划去，
He did not know Shanghai's geography well enough to make plans.

这时候渴盼的，就是找到古应春，坐了他的那辆亨斯美往西一直到静安寺一带，
What he longed to do was find Gu, climb into his Hengsimei carriage, and drive west as far as the area around Jing’an Temple.

实地去看一看才符心愿。
Only an inspection on the spot would satisfy him.

幸好，不久陈世尤就回来了。
Fortunately, Chen soon returned.

于是胡雪岩向执事殷殷致谢，辞了出来。
Hu thanked the clerk warmly and left.

走到街上，第一句话就问：“世龙，你对西面一带熟不熟？”
The first thing he said in the street was, “Shilong, do you know the area to the west?”

“胡先生部不熟，我怎么会熟？”
“If you don't know it, Mr Hu, how could I?”

“不管它，
“Never mind.

我们弄部马车去兜兜风。”
Let's get a carriage and go for a drive.”

于是雇了一辆干净车，由泥城墙往西，不择路而行。
They hired a clean carriage and set off west from the mud city wall, taking whatever roads offered themselves.

七兜八转，尽是稻田水荡，胡雪岩几乎连方向都辨不清楚了“。
After turn upon turn among paddy fields and stretches of water, Hu could scarcely tell which direction they were facing.


一路漫无目的地兜风，一路他把刚才所听到的话告诉了陈世龙。
As they drove without a fixed destination, Hu told Chen what he had overheard.

原来如此！陈世龙提出了一个见解：
Now Chen understood.

“胡先生，这件事有两个做法，
“Mr Hu, there are two ways to approach this.

第一个做法恐怕办不到。”
I'm afraid the first isn't practicable.”

“你不管它，
“Never mind that.

说来看！”
Tell me.”

“第一个办法是有闲钱。
“The first requires money to spare.

反正地价便宜，譬如不赚，买了摆在那里，看哪一天地价涨了，再作道理。
Land is cheap, so even if it earns nothing, you buy it and leave it there until the price rises, then decide what to do.

依我看，为子孙打算，倒不妨这么办。
It would make sense if you were providing for future generations.

不过胡先生，你手里的钱是要活用的，所以说办不到。”
But your money has to keep working, Mr Hu, which is why I say it isn't practicable.”

陈世龙停了停又说：
He paused.

“第二个做法，一定要靠古先生，
“The second would depend on Mr Gu.

先去打听洋人准备修哪条马路，抢先一步，把附近的地皮买下来，
Find out which road the foreigners intend to build, get ahead of them, and buy the land nearby.

那一来，转眼之间，就可以发财！”
Then you could make a fortune in no time.”

“对！
“Yes!

这话对！”
That's right!”

胡雪岩拿他的话细想了一想，忽有启发，
Hu considered his suggestion, then suddenly saw something further.

“你的话也不全对。”
“Though not entirely right.

他说，“最高明的做法是，叫洋人修那条马路！”
The cleverest course is to get the foreigners to build the road you want.”

“这……”
“But...”

陈世龙想懂了他的意思。认为办不到，
Chen understood, yet thought it impossible.

“洋人岂肯听别人摆布，
“Why would the foreigners let someone else direct them?

叫他修哪条路，他就修哪条路？”
Would they build whichever road you told them to?”

“事在人为。
“It depends on what men do.

总可以想得出办法。
There must be some way.

好在这事也不急，
Fortunately, there's no hurry over this.

慢慢儿再说。”
We can think it through.”

胡雪岩做事就是这样，
That was Hu's way.

不了解情况时，为求了解，急如星火，
While he lacked information, his urgency to obtain it was like a house on fire.

等到弄清楚事实，有了方针，他就从容了。
Once he understood the facts and had a direction, he grew calm.

陈世龙知道他的脾气，说是说“慢慢儿”，决不是拖延，更不是搁置，
Chen knew that his talk of taking time meant neither delay nor abandonment.

帮着他做事，须知这一点，自己暗暗去做准备，
Anyone working for him had to understand this and quietly make preparations.

说不定哪一天，他筹划好了，拿出来的计划详详细细，立刻可以动手，
One day Hu might finish his thinking and produce a plan worked out in every detail, ready to put into effect at once.

自己没有准备，就合不上他的步子和要求了。
If Chen had made no preparations, he would be unable to match Hu's pace or meet his requirements.


“我还要多找几个人。”胡雪岩在归途中说：
“I must find some more men,” Hu said on the journey back.

“你这趟回去，随时替我留心。”
“Keep an eye out for me when you return.”

“是的。”
“Yes.”

陈世龙想了想问：“胡先生将来到底叫我做什么？
After a moment's thought, Chen asked, “What work do you intend to give me eventually?

我不想死守在湖州。”
I don't want to stay shut up in Huzhou.”

“我知道。”
“I know.

胡雪岩说，“你喜欢在外头跑，
You like travelling about.

将来不要叫苦！”
Don't complain when the time comes.”

“怎么呢？”
“Why?”

胡雪岩沉吟不答，
Hu considered without replying.

好久好久才问：“你看山西的票号，打不打得倒？”
After a long silence, he asked, “Do you think the Shanxi remittance houses can be beaten?”

“打是打不倒的！
“You can't bring them down.

人家多年信用。
They've built up credit over many years.

不过饯庄的做法如果活络些，不象票号那样墨守成规，那么，南五省的地盘，应该可以拿得到。”
But if our banks were more flexible, instead of clinging to old rules as the remittance houses do, we ought to be able to win the market in the five southern provinces.”

胡雪岩很欣赏陈世龙的态度，
Hu liked this answer.

看他的样子近乎浮滑一路，说话倒很实在，
Chen might look rather glib and superficial, but his words were sound.

因而将心里的话告诉了他。
He therefore told him what was in his mind.

“今天我好好细想了一想，
“I've thought things over properly today.

我的基础还是在钱庄上面。
Banking is still my foundation.

不过，我的做法还要改。”
But I must change how I work.

他说，“势利、势利，利与势是分不开的，
People speak of power and profit together: the two can't be separated.

有势就有利，
With power comes profit.

所以现在先不必求利，
So for now, I needn't pursue profit.

要取势。
I must gain power.”

““势？”
“Power?”

陈世龙很用心地想着，
Chen thought carefully.

“胡先生，你说的势是指势力？”
“Do you mean influence, Mr Hu?”

“不错！
“Exactly.

势力。商场的势力，官场的势力，
Influence in business and influence in official circles.

我都要。
I want both.

这两样要到了，还不够。”
Even both won't be enough.”

“还有洋场的势力！”
“And influence among the foreigners!”

陈世龙接着他的话说。
Chen completed the thought.

“好！”
“Good!”

胡雪岩很兴奋地翘起大拇指，衷心夸赞陈世龙，
Hu raised his thumb excitedly in sincere approval.

“你摸得到我的心思，就差不多了。”
“If you can see into my mind like that, you're getting there.”

“我哪里及得上胡先生？十分之一部没有。”陈世龙也很高兴，矜持他说，
Chen too was delighted, though he answered with restraint. “How could I compare with you? I'm not a tenth as good.

“不过胡先生的路子，我总还不至于不懂。”
But I do understand something of how you work.”


“你懂就好！”胡雪岩说，
“As long as you understand!” Hu replied.

“现在风气在变了！
“Times are changing.

你到底比我要轻个几岁，比较不出来，
You're a few years younger, after all; you can't compare things as I can.

从前做生意的人，让做官的看不起，真正叫看不起，
Officials used to despise merchants—truly despise them.

哪怕是杨州的大监商，捐班到道台，一遇见科举出身的，服服贴贴，唯命是从。
Even the great salt merchants of Yangzhou, who bought official rank as high as circuit intendant, would submit meekly to every order from a man who had risen through the examinations.

自从五口通商以后，看人家洋人，做生意的跟做官的，没有啥分别，大家的想法才有点不同。
Only after the five ports opened to trade, when people saw that foreign merchants and officials were treated much the same, did their ideas begin to change.

这一年把，照我看，更加不对了，做官的要靠做生意的！
In this past year or so, I'd say the position has shifted further: officials have to depend on merchants.

为啥我要洋场的势力，
Why do I want influence among the foreigners?

就因为做官的势力达不到洋场，
Because official power doesn't reach into their sphere.

这就要靠我这佯的人来穿什引线。
The authorities need men like me to make the connections.

所以有了官场的势力，再有洋场的势力，自然商场的势力就容易大了。”
Once I have influence in official circles and among the foreigners, extending my influence in business will naturally be easier.”

陈世龙一面听，一面点头，细细体味着胡雪岩的话，
Chen listened, nodding and considering each point.

悟出来许多道理。
Hu's words gave him much to understand.


就这样谈着，不知不觉又回到人烟稠密之区，
As they talked, they found themselves back among crowded streets without noticing the time.

胡雪岩这时才想起阿巧姐的话，要约尤五和古应春到家吃饭，
Only then did Hu remember A’qiao's request to invite You and Gu home for dinner.

一见时候不早，深怕他们另有约会，
It was already late, and he feared they might have other engagements.

便即赶到怡情院，谁知一个人都不见，连怡情老二亦不在那里。
He hurried to Yiqing House, but nobody was there, not even Second Miss.

人虽不遇，却留着话，
There was, however, a message.

“相帮”的告诉胡雪岩，说尤五关照：“请胡老爷等他，
The male attendant told him that You had said, “Ask Mr Hu to wait.

他准六点钟回来。”
I'll be back at six sharp.”

六点钟见了面怎么样？
And what would happen when they met at six?

如果他说另有约会，或者自己在怡情院请客，那么，
Suppose You had another engagement, or was entertaining guests at Yiqing House himself?

阿巧姐那里就不好交代了。
How could Hu explain that to A’qiao?

这样想着，便有些坐立不安的神气。
The thought made him visibly restless.

陈世龙很少看见他有过这种样子，不免诧异，当然，更多的是关切，
Chen had seldom seen him in such a state and was surprised, though still more concerned.

一问起来，才知究竟，心里好笑，
When he asked and learned the reason, he was inwardly amused.

不由得想起一句俗语：“英雄难过美人关”。
A proverb came to mind: “Even a hero finds a beauty hard to resist.”

一等一的厉害角色，在这上头，往往手足无措，一筹莫展，
Men of the highest ability often became helpless and utterly at a loss in such matters.

这便又用得着“旁观者清”这句话了。
Here another saying applied: “The onlooker sees clearly.”

“这不用为难，
“There's no difficulty.

或者我去通知一声，或者我留在这里等！”
Either I can go and let her know, or I can stay here to wait.”

“对，对！”不待他说完，胡雪岩就说，
“Yes, yes!” Hu interrupted before he had finished.

“你去一趟吧！这样告诉她：我在这里等他们，等到了就回来。
“Go and tell her I'm waiting here for them and will return as soon as they arrive.

如果客人约不来，我一定回家吃饭。”
If I can't bring the guests, I'll certainly come home for dinner myself.”


陈世龙衔命而去，只见阿巧姐很安闲的坐在那里，
Chen went on this errand and found A’qiao sitting quite at ease.

一见很客气，听陈世龙讲完，毫不在乎的说：“不要紧！
She greeted him politely, heard his message, and replied without concern, “That's all right.

没有几样菜，
There aren't many dishes.

蒸的蒸着，要炒的，等人到了再下锅。”
The steamed ones can go on steaming; I'll wait until everyone arrives before putting the others in the wok.”

看她从容不迫的样子，跟芙蓉那种宛转的神态，是不同的风味。
Her calm self-possession had a different charm from Furong's gentleness.

栋世龙心里便想：胡先生的艳福倒真不浅！
Mr Hu was certainly fortunate in love, Chen thought.

还有一样不同的，是阿巧姐的谈锋极健，
Another difference was A’qiao's remarkable fluency.

陈世龙也算很善于词令的，相形之下，自觉见绌，
Chen considered himself a good talker, but beside her he felt at a disadvantage.

而且谈到后来，忽然发觉，自知可能是失言了，
As the conversation continued, he suddenly realised that he might have said too much.

因为阿巧姐的旁敲侧击，他把胡雪岩的家庭情况，透露了许多。
Through indirect questions she had drawn a great deal from him about Hu's family.

所幸的是，不曾说出胡太太是很厉害也很能干的妇人。
Fortunately, he had not mentioned that Mrs Hu was both formidable and highly capable.

一则起了戒心，再则亦不便久坐，陈世龙便起身告辞。
Now on his guard, and feeling that he should not stay too long, he rose to leave.

阿巧姐知道他是胡雪岩的心腹，当然要加以宠络，
A’qiao knew that he was Hu's trusted man and naturally wished to win him over.

一再挽留，最后这样说道：“你是胡老爷自己人，我才不作客气，
She repeatedly urged him to stay, finally saying, “I only dispense with ceremony because you're one of Mr Hu's own people.

不然，我也不会留你。
Otherwise I wouldn't insist.

除非你不当我自己人看待。”
Unless, of course, you don't regard me as one of his own.”

说到这样的话，俨然以胡雪岩的外室自居，
She was plainly speaking as Hu's woman established in a separate household.

陈世龙已看出“胡先生”对她极其喜爱，而将来结局如何，尚在未定之天，
Chen could see how deeply Hu liked her, but the eventual outcome was still entirely uncertain.

如果坚决告辞，仿佛真的不当她“自己人”，在阿巧姐会起疑心，
If he insisted on leaving, it might indeed suggest that he refused to accept her as belonging to Hu, and arouse her suspicions.

似乎不妥，
That would be unwise.

因而改了主意：
He changed his answer.

“我还是先回去，跟胡先生说一声，
“I'd better go back and give Mr Hu your message first.

回头再一起来。”
Then we'll come together.”

“那么，”阿巧姐悦，“回头一定要来噢！”
“Well, you must be sure to come back!”

“一定，一定！”
“Certainly, certainly.”


出了大兴客栈，安步当车，
Chen left Daxing Inn and walked at an easy pace.

刚走得不多几步路，忽然听得有女人在喊：“世龙！”
He had gone only a few steps when a woman called, “Shilong!”

定睛一看，是七姑奶奶，
Looking up, he saw the Seventh Lady.

古应春亲自驾车，也发见了陈世龙，
Gu was driving the carriage himself and had also noticed him.

停下来问道：
He stopped.

“你到哪里去？”
“Where are you going?”

“我回怡情院去。”
“Back to Yiqing House.”

“不必了！”
“No need.

古应春说，“我们特为来接阿巧姐，
We've come specially to fetch Sister A’qiao.

今晚上，在我们那里聚会，
We're all gathering at our place tonight.

你也去。”
You must come too.”

于是陈世龙又折回，三个人一起又到大兴客栈，
Chen therefore turned back, and the three went into Daxing Inn together.

七姑奶奶跟阿巧姐是初见，
The Seventh Lady and A’qiao had never met.

一个守礼，一个亲热，而都健谈，
One was punctiliously polite, the other warmly affectionate; both were talkative.

所以拉着手，前朝后代，大谈渊源，
Holding hands, they ranged far and wide over all they had heard of one another.

七姑奶奶说听古应春谈过，知道她能干漂亮，
The Seventh Lady said that Gu had told her how capable and pretty A’qiao was.

阿巧姐则说听怡情老二说起，有这样一位豪爽有趣，敢到怡情院这种地方的堂客。
A’qiao replied that Second Miss had described this frank, lively lady who dared to visit a place like Yiqing House.

彼此都很投机，大有相见恨晚之意，
They took to one another at once and seemed to regret not having met sooner.

古应春却不耐烦了：
Gu, however, grew impatient.

“我的姑奶奶，谈了半天，
“My dear lady, you've talked for ages.

你倒说点正经话啦！”
Say something about why we're here!”

正经话是特地来邀客，
They had come specially to invite her.

因为胡雪岩和尤五要动身到苏杭，七姑奶奶特地在徽馆叫了一桌席，替他们饯行。
As Hu and You were about to leave for Suzhou and Hangzhou, the Seventh Lady had ordered a farewell banquet from an Anhui restaurant.

胡雪岩又要邀到大兴客栈，尝试阿巧姐的烹调手段，
Hu, meanwhile, wanted everyone at Daxing Inn to try A’qiao's cooking.

变成僵持的局面。
The result was a deadlock.

“我在想，到你这里，到我那里都一样。
“It makes no difference whether we eat at your place or mine,” the Seventh Lady said.

不过，第一，叫了席不能退掉，几两银子也可惜，
“But first, I can't cancel the banquet, and it would be a pity to waste several taels.

第二，到我那里比较方便。”
Second, my place is more convenient.

七姑奶奶又说：“天气也还不热，
The weather isn't hot yet.

就做好了菜，摆一夜也不会坏。
Even if your dishes are already cooked, they'll keep overnight.

明天我来吃！”
I'll come and eat them tomorrow!”


阿巧姐自然一诺无辞，
A’qiao naturally agreed without hesitation.

以换衣服为名，请他们在外屋坐，却把陈世龙悄悄找到一边，
Saying that she must change, she asked them to sit in the outer room, then quietly drew Chen aside.

模出四块银洋说道，“陈少爷！我拜托你一件事。
Taking out four foreign silver dollars, she said, “Young Master Chen, may I ask a favour?

第一趟上七姑奶奶的门，
It's my first visit to the Seventh Lady.

不能空手，
I can't arrive empty-handed.

托你替我办四样吃食东西，带到七姑奶奶那里去。”
Please buy four kinds of food for me and bring them to her house.”

“七姑奶奶家，我不认识。”
“I don't know where she lives.”

陈世龙转念有了主意，
Then Chen had an idea.

“不过不要紧，
“But never mind.

你交给我。”
Leave it to me.”

等她换好衣服，四个人一辆马车到了七姑奶奶门口。
Once she had changed, all four rode together to the Seventh Lady's door.

阵世龙认清了地方说：“我马上就来！”说完掉身就转，
Now that Chen knew the address, he said, “I'll be back in a moment,” and turned away.

在弄堂口就有茶食店、水果摊，
At the mouth of the lane were a confectioner's shop and a fruit stall.

买了一篓花旗橘子，一篓天津鸭梨、茶食店里买了一大盒松子糖，
He bought a basket of American oranges, a basket of Tianjin duck pears, and a large box of pine-nut candy.

还剩下两块钱，
Two dollars remained.

叫店家拿一条陈火腿下来，算一算差四角饯，陈世龙替她垫上。
He asked the shopkeeper to take down an aged ham, and when the total came to forty cents more than he had, he advanced the difference himself.

“这是阿巧姐送七姑奶奶的。”陈世龙笑道：
“These are Sister A’qiao's gifts to the Seventh Lady,” he said with a smile.

“我是小辈，今天就白吃了。”
“I'm the junior here, so today I shall eat for nothing.”


“何用客气。”七姑奶奶说，
“Why stand on ceremony?” the Seventh Lady said.

“阿巧姐，我们象自己人一样，
“Sister A’qiao, we're like family.

我跟你‘打开无窗说亮话’，我不喜欢这一套，我自己也弄不来这一套。”
I'll open the skylight and speak plainly: I don't care for all this, and I'm no good at it myself.”

“你看你，”古应春忍不住埋怨她，
Gu could not help reproaching her. “Listen to yourself.

“人家一番好意，倒落得你这么两句话。
She means well, and that's all she gets from you.

阿巧姐是晓得你的脾气的，不晓得的人，岂不是要怪你不近人情。”
Sister A’qiao knows your nature, but wouldn't anyone who didn't think you unfeeling?”

“不会，不会！”
“Not at all!”

阿巧姐抢着说道，
A’qiao put in quickly.

“我也晓得七姑奶奶不喜欢这些虚文，
“I know the Seventh Lady dislikes empty formalities.

不过，我们是弄惯了，改不过来，
But we're so used to them that we can't change.

好在陈少爷买得好，
Fortunately, Young Master Chen chose well.

都是实惠的东西，
These are all useful things.

就我不送。七姑奶奶也要花钱买的。”
Even if I hadn't brought them, she'd have to spend money buying them.”

“这倒是实话。”七姑奶奶笑嘻嘻的说，
“That's true enough,” the Seventh Lady said, smiling.

又表示歉意，“我说话一向是想到哪里，说到哪里，
Then she added apologetically, “I always say whatever comes into my head.

说错了你不要怪我。
Don't take offence if I say something wrong.”

“这两句话，别人都不觉得什么，只有陈世龙大为惊异，
Nobody else found these two sentences remarkable, but Chen was astonished.

因为她以前决无这种口吻，
She had never spoken like that before.

看来是古应春的潜移默化之功。
It seemed that Gu's quiet influence was having its effect.


正想要说一两句调侃的话，作为取笑，只听楼梯上有声音，
Chen was about to make a teasing remark when he heard footsteps on the stairs.

接着是尤五和胡雪岩一路走，一面谈着，相偕出现，
You and Hu appeared together, still talking as they walked.

略略招呼了一下，继续谈话，
They offered brief greetings and continued their conversation.

陈世龙听出来，他们去拜访了一位人物，这位人物对于调处浙江溜帮的纠纷，大有用处，
Chen gathered that they had been visiting someone who could be very useful in settling the trouble within the Zhejiang brotherhood.

现在是在商量，是不是要把这位人物一起请到杭州去。
They were now discussing whether to invite him to Hangzhou as well.

“你们有啥谈不完的话？
“Can't your conversation ever end?

回头再谈，
Talk later.

要开席了。”
Dinner's ready.”

七姑奶奶忽然又说：
Then the Seventh Lady had another thought.

“人少了欠热闹。
“There aren't enough of us to make it lively.

何不把老二也请了来。”
Why not invite Second Miss?”

“不必，不必！”
“No need, no need!”

尤五插手说道，
You waved his hands.

“她出局去了，
“She's gone out on a banquet engagement.

回头会来的。”
She'll come later.”

于是在堂屋中开席，
Dinner was served in the main room.

一张圆台面，坐了六个人，似乎嫌大。
Six people sat at a round table that seemed rather too large.

阿巧姐经不住七姑奶奶的硬作主张，与胡雪岩并居首席，
Unable to resist the Seventh Lady's insistence, A’qiao shared the place of honour with Hu.

这样官客与堂客夹杂而坐，大反惯例，而坐首席更是阿巧姐的破题儿第一遭，
Men and women sitting interspersed was a complete departure from custom, and A’qiao had never occupied the seat of honour before.

所以相当拘谨，跟胡雪岩隔得远远地。
