She was therefore rather constrained and kept well away from Hu.

酒过一巡，胡雪岩对阿巧姐说道：“你跟七姑奶奶谈了些什么？”
After the first round of wine, he asked her, “What have you and the Seventh Lady been talking about?”

“话多了。
“All sorts of things.

七姑奶奶脾气直爽，
She's so frank.

谈得真有趣。”
It was delightful.”

“那你何不常跟七姑奶奶来作伴。”
“Why don't you come and keep her company more often?”

说到这里，尤五咳嗽了一声，
You coughed.

胡雪岩才想起，他是极力主张七姑奶奶回娘家的，
Only then did Hu remember that You was urging his sister to return to her family home.

如说阿巧姐常来跟作她伴，岂不是给了她一个留在上海的借口？
Wouldn't frequent visits from A’qiao give her an excuse to stay in Shanghai?


七姑奶奶却不理会这些，
The Seventh Lady paid no attention to these considerations.

“小爷叔这话对！”
“Little Uncle is right.

她说，“你陪我到松江去住几天好不好？”
Why don't you come to Songjiang with me for a few days?”

“这很好！”
“Excellent!”

尤五微觉意外，赶紧怂恿，
You was slightly surprised and hastened to encourage the idea.

“阿巧姐，你就到那里去住几天。
“Sister A’qiao, do go and stay there.

好在来去方便，
It's easy to travel back and forth.

你想回上海，随时可以回来。”
You can return to Shanghai whenever you please.”

“打搅府上，不好意思。”说是这样说，一双俏眼只瞄着胡雪岩，
“I should feel awkward imposing on your household.” Though she said this, her bright eyes kept turning towards Hu.

要看他的态度定行止，
His attitude would determine what she did.

胡雪岩自然表示赞成，反倒是古应春有了意见。
He naturally expressed approval, but Gu had a different opinion.

“我看松江也不必去，上海也不必留，
“I don't think she need go to Songjiang or stay in Shanghai.

索性跟小爷叔到苏州去逛一趟。”
Why not simply accompany Little Uncle on a visit to Suzhou?”

“这倒也是个办法。”
“That's another possibility.”

尤五看着他们俩问：
You looked at them both.

“怎么样？”
“What do you think?”

胡雪岩实在有些委决不下，
Hu genuinely found it hard to decide.

一方面觉得有阿巧姐作伴，此行一定温馨愉快，
On one hand, A’qiao's company would make the journey warm and delightful.

一方面又觉得双宿双飞之余，更加以相携相将，越发变成敲钉转脚，铁案如山，
On the other, after sharing a bed and living together, travelling together as well would hammer in the nail and bend its point: the case would become unassailable.

只可进不可退了。
He would be able only to go forward, never retreat.

这就要看阿巧姐自己的意思。
It therefore depended on what A’qiao herself wanted.

而她对胡雪岩由误解而了解，由了解而接受抬情老二的劝告，
She had come from misunderstanding Hu to understanding him, and from understanding him to accepting Second Miss's advice.

已经下定决心，
Her mind was already made up.

不过阅人已多，世故熟透，
But she had known many people and understood the world thoroughly.

决不肯事事勉强，引起胡雪岩的忌惮敬远之心，
She would never force his hand at every turn and make him wary of her, keeping a respectful distance.

所以此时默不作声。
For the moment, she said nothing.


“怎么样？”七姑奶奶催问着，
“Well?” the Seventh Lady pressed.

“还是到松江，还是到苏州？”
“Songjiang or Suzhou?”

这一问，在阿巧姐当然只能回答到松江。
Put like that, A’qiao could naturally only answer Songjiang.

古应春在这些地方，自比七姑奶奶更机敏，便不等她开口回答，先就抢着说了句：
Gu was more perceptive in such matters than the Seventh Lady and spoke before she could reply.

“当然是到苏州。”
“Suzhou, of course.”

“到苏州就到苏州。”胡雪岩定了主意，但不能不问一问本人，
“Suzhou it is,” Hu decided, though he still had to ask the woman concerned.

“去不去？”
“Will you come?”

这就是阿巧姐能干了，
Here A’qiao showed her skill.

她不说去，也不说不去，只说：“七姑奶奶一片好意……”
She said neither yes nor no, but merely, “The Seventh Lady has been so kind...”

意思是答应了。还照顾着七姑奶奶，
She meant to accept, while still acknowledging the Seventh Lady.

虽是口头上的人情，也惹人好感。
Though only a verbal courtesy, it made a favourable impression.

“不要紧，不要紧！”七姑奶奶说，
“Never mind, never mind!” the Seventh Lady replied.

“等你苏州回来，我再来接你到松江去玩。”
“Once you're back from Suzhou, I'll come and take you to Songjiang.”

事情就这样定局了，
That settled the matter.

各人要收拾行装，早早散去，约定第二天中午在怡情老二小房中吃中饭，吃完分别上船。
Everyone had packing to do, so they broke up early, agreeing to lunch the following day in Second Miss's little house and then board their separate boats.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十三章起连续正文（之一；底本未标第二十四章）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Continuous text beginning with Chapter Twenty-Three, part one (the source supplies no Chapter Twenty-Four heading)

原著：高阳


第二十三章｜CHAPTER TWENTY-THREE


回到大兴客栈，阿巧姐一面收拾随身动用什物，一面问起胡雪岩此行的目的，
Back at Daxing Inn, A’qiao packed the things they would need and asked Hu Xueyan about the purpose of the journey.

这没有什么隐瞒的必要，
There was no reason to conceal it.

而且也深知她不是那种无知无识，不懂轻重的妇女，所以他把实话都告诉了她。
He knew, moreover, that she was no ignorant woman without judgment or a sense of what mattered, so he told her the truth.

“学台是个啥个官？”
“What sort of official is an education commissioner?”

“专管考秀才的。”
“He oversees the examinations for licentiates.”

“有没有外快？”
“Does he have any extra income?”

“这我倒不大懂了。”胡雪岩说，
“That I don't really understand.

“听说四川学台、广东学台是肥缺。
I hear that Sichuan and Guangdong are lucrative appointments.

江苏就不晓得了。
I don't know about Jiangsu.

照我想，现在兵荒马乱，好些地方连去都不能去。
But with war and disorder everywhere, there are many places he can't even visit.

地盘一小，就有外快也有限。
With his territory reduced, any extra income must be limited.”

““如果是这样子，要请何学台去谋干一个好地方的官，只怕不成功。”
“If that's so, asking Commissioner He to seek office in a good province may not work.”

“怎么呢？”
“Why?”

“要钱呀！”
“It takes money!”

阿巧姐笑一笑又说，
She smiled.

“我是不懂啥！
“Not that I understand these things.

有一次一个候补道台汪老爷在怡情院请客，大讲官场的生意经，
But once, at Yiqing House, a Mr Wang awaiting a circuit appointment gave a party and talked at length about the business side of official life.

说是京里的大老倌那里，都要送钱的。
You have to send money to the great gentlemen in the capital, he said.

钱越多，越容易升官。”
The more money, the easier promotion becomes.”

“嗯，嗯！”
“Mm, mm.”

胡雪岩被提醒了，暗地里打了主意，却不愿说破，
Reminded of this, Hu privately formed a plan, but did not explain it.

因为其中出入关系甚大，即令是对阿巧姐这样的人，也是不说的好。
Too much depended on it; even to a woman like A’qiao, it was better left unsaid.

“总还要送点礼啊！”阿巧姐又说。
“You must at least take some gifts,” she added.

“那有了，备了四色洋货。”
“I have those—four kinds of foreign goods.”

“何学台哪里人？”
“Where is Commissioner He from?”

“云南。”
“Yunnan.”

“那不如送云南东西……”
“Then wouldn't things from Yunnan be better?”

“啊，对！”
“Ah, exactly!”

胡雪岩大力赞赏：
Hu praised her warmly.

“阿巧，你的脑筋真不错。”
“A’qiao, you have a very good head.”


于是第二天一早，胡雪岩便去寻古应春，要觅云南土产，
Early the next morning, Hu went to Gu Yingchun for help in finding Yunnan specialities.

结果找着一个解铜到江苏藩司衙门的云南候补州判，
They eventually found a Yunnan official awaiting appointment as an assistant departmental magistrate, who had escorted copper to the Jiangsu provincial treasurer's yamen.

在他那里转让了四佯云南土产。这四样土产是宣威火腿、紫大头菜、鸡踪菌和咸牛肉干，
From him they obtained four local products: Xuanwei ham, purple datoucai, jizong mushrooms and dried salted beef.

可惜数量不多，但也正因为数量不多，便显得物以稀为贵了。
Unfortunately, there was not much of any of them, but their scarcity made them all the more precious.

中午在怡情老二那里吃了饭，彼此约定，互不相送。
After lunch at Second Miss's, the party agreed not to see one another off.

等古应春替他安排护送的那个人一到，胡雪岩很客气地请教了“尊姓台甫”，然后一起上船，
When the man Gu had arranged to escort Hu arrived, Hu courteously asked his name, and they boarded together.

船是小火轮拖带的一条“无锡快”，
Their vessel was a ‘Wuxi fast boat’ towed by a small steam launch.

胡雪岩带着阿巧姐住后舱，前舱止给护送的那个人住。
Hu and A’qiao occupied the aft cabin, while the forward cabin was left to their escort.


此人名叫周一鸣，湖南人，
His name was Zhou Yiming, and he came from Hunan.

原在江南水师中当哨官，因为喜欢喝酒闹事，
He had once served as a detachment officer in the Jiangnan naval force, but was fond of drinking and making trouble.

一次打伤了长官的小舅子，被责了二十军棍，开革除名。
After injuring his superior's younger brother-in-law, he had received twenty strokes of the military cane and been dismissed.

但同一鸣的酒德虽不好，为人倒极豪爽重义气，
Though badly behaved in drink, Zhou was generous and loyal to his friends.

由于在水师当差，认识的船户颇不少，所以起先是跑码头、打秋风，大家也乐予周济，
His naval service had acquainted him with many boatmen, so at first he went round the wharves seeking handouts, which people willingly gave.

有时托他带个把口信，
Sometimes they asked him to carry a message.

他倒也“食人之禄，忠人之事”，一定确确实实做到，
Having accepted their support, he faithfully discharged their business, making certain that every errand was properly done.

慢慢地有了信用，便在上海船户的“茶会”上帮忙。
Gradually he earned a reputation and began helping at the Shanghai boatmen's tea association.

各行各业的茶会，犹如同业公所，
Such associations existed in every trade and functioned much like guildhalls.

或者按头生意，或者与官场打交道，或者同业中有纠纷“吃讲茶”，都在茶会上商谈，
Whether to arrange business, deal with officials or settle disputes over tea, members discussed their affairs there.

周一鸣就成了船户茶会上的一名要角，
Zhou became an important figure in the boatmen's association.

特别是“抓船”、“派差”等等官面上硬压下来的公事，都由周一鸣出面去接头。
In particular, when officials imposed requisitions for boats or other compulsory service, he handled the negotiations.

这次也是有公事到苏州，
He had official business in Suzhou on this occasion.

古应春跟他相熟，正好把胡雪岩托了他，
Gu, who knew him, therefore entrusted Hu to his care.

连雇船带护送，都归他包办，讲好送二十两银子。
He would hire the boat and provide the escort, for an agreed twenty taels.

胡雪岩的出手大方是出名的，
Hu was famous for his generosity.

一上船就找了个红封套，装了一张三十两银子的银票，当面双手奉上。
As soon as they boarded, he put a thirty-tael note into a red envelope and presented it with both hands.

周一鸣还要客气，禁不住胡雪岩言词恳切，他千恩万谢地收了下来。
Zhou tried to decline, but Hu was so earnest that he accepted with repeated thanks.

这一路招呼得自是格外周到。
His attentions throughout the journey were naturally all the more thorough.


胡雪岩出门一向不喜欢带听差，于是周一鸣自告奋勇，到了苏州雇轿子，提行李，下客栈，都由他一手经理。
Hu never liked taking a personal attendant on his travels, so Zhou volunteered to manage everything on arrival in Suzhou: hiring chairs, carrying luggage and finding an inn.

客栈在阎门外，字号就叫“金阎”，
The inn stood outside Chang Gate and was called Jinchang.

等安置停当，周一鸣要告辞了。
Once they were settled, Zhou prepared to leave.

“胡大老爷！”因为胡雪岩是捐班候补知县，所以他这要称呼他，“我在苏州有个‘门口’，现在回去看一看。
“Your Honour”—he addressed Hu this way because Hu had purchased eligibility for appointment as a county magistrate—“I have a place here in Suzhou and shall go and look in.

明天上半天到水师衙门去投文办事，
Tomorrow morning I must deliver documents and attend to business at the naval yamen.

中午过来伺候。
I'll come to wait on you at midday.

你老看，行不行？”
Would that suit you?”

“我有个不情之请。”胡雪岩说，
“I have a rather troublesome favour to ask.

“有四件东西，一封信，想拜托你此刻就送一送。”
Four gifts and a letter—could you deliver them now?”

“是了。”周一鸣问，
“Certainly.

“送到哪里？”
Where to?”

“送给何学台。
“To Education Commissioner He.

还得先打听一下，何学台公馆在哪里？”
First we must find out where he's staying.”

“这容易，
“That's easy.

都交给我好了。”
Leave it to me.”

于是胡雪岩托金间栈的帐房，写了个手本，下注：“寓阊门外金阎栈第三进西头”，
Hu had Jinchang Inn's bookkeeper prepare a formal visiting card, with the address below: “Lodging outside Chang Gate, Jinchang Inn, west side of the third courtyard.”

连同四样云南土仪和一封王有龄的信，都交了给周一鸣。
He gave this to Zhou, together with the four Yunnan gifts and Wang Youling's letter.

信是胡雪岩密封了的，内中附着一张五千两的银票，作为王有龄送何桂清的，
Hu had sealed the letter himself, enclosing a five-thousand-tael note as a gift from Wang to He Guiqing.

这封信当然重要，所以胡雪岩特别叮嘱：
The letter was important, so he gave particular instructions.

“老周，还要麻烦你，务必跟何公馆的门上说明白，讨一张有何学台亲笔的回片。”
“Old Zhou, one more trouble: you must explain to the doorkeeper that I need an acknowledgement in Commissioner He's own hand.”

“是！”周一鸣问，
“Yes.

“今天要不要把回片送来？”
Shall I bring it back today?”

胡雪岩心想，疑人莫用，用人莫疑，
Hu reflected that one should not employ a man one distrusted, or distrust a man one employed.

而且周一鸣人既重义气，又是有来历的，
Zhou valued loyalty and had an established background.

因而很快地答道：“如果回片上只写收到，那就不必来了，
He answered at once, “If the card merely acknowledges receipt, you needn't come again.

明天再说。”
Tomorrow will do.”


等周一鸣一走，胡雪岩的迫不及待的想跟阿巧姐去观光。
Once Zhou had gone, Hu was eager to go sightseeing with A’qiao.

苏州不比上海，
Suzhou was unlike Shanghai.

虽然妇女喜欢小庙烧香，凡有出会报赛等等人声鼎沸的场面，都要去轧个热闹，但一男一女不论是出现在玄妙观，还是虎丘山塘，总是招摇过市、惹人物议的一件事，
Women there liked visiting temples to burn incense and joining the crowds at festivals and processions, but for a man and woman to appear together, whether at Xuanmiao Temple or along Shantang by Tiger Hill, was to parade themselves before the public and invite gossip.

而且阿巧姐是本乡本土，难免遇见熟人，尤须顾忌，
A’qiao was a native of the district and might meet acquaintances, which required still greater caution.

因此，她更觉为难。
She was consequently reluctant.

就在这软语相磨，未定行止之际，只见周一鸣把顶红缨帽捏在手里当扇子扇，
While they were gently arguing the point, with no decision reached, Zhou returned, holding his red-tasselled cap as a fan.

跑得满头大汗，却是笑容满面，
He had run himself into a sweat, yet his face was all smiles.

胡雪岩当是何桂清有什么话交代，赶紧迎了出去。
Thinking He had sent some instructions, Hu hurried out.

“送到了！”周一鸣说，
“Delivered!

“回贴在这里。”
Here is the reply.”

接过回贴来一看，
Hu took the card.

只见上面写着一行字：“王太守函一件，收讫。
It read, “One letter from Prefect Wang received.

外隆仪四色，敬领谢谢。”
The four generous gifts are also accepted with thanks.”

贴尾又有一行字，“敬使面致。”
A further line at the foot stated, “Your messenger has been duly thanked in person.”

“胡大老爷，真要谢谢你挑我。”周一鸣垂着手打个千说：
Zhou made a formal greeting, hands lowered. “Your Honour, I must thank you for giving me this opportunity.

“何学台出手很阔，
Commissioner He is most generous.

赏了我二十两银子。”
He gave me twenty taels.”

听这一说，胡雪岩觉得很有面子，便说：
This enhanced Hu's own standing, and he was pleased.

“很好，
“Excellent.

你收下好了。”
Keep it.”

“我特为跟你老来说一声，何学台住在苏州府学。”
“I came specially to tell you that the commissioner is staying at the Suzhou Prefectural Academy.”

“喔，
“Oh.

你见着何学台没有？”
Did you see him?”

“见是没有见着。
“No.

不过听他们二爷出来说，学台很高兴。”
But his steward came out and said he was delighted.”

高兴的是收到五千两银子，还是四色云南土产，或则两者兼而有之？胡雪岩就不知道了。
Whether He was delighted by the five thousand taels, the four Yunnan gifts, or both, Hu could not tell.

不过不管怎么样，都算是得阿巧姐的力。
In any event, he owed it to A’qiao.


因为如此，他便依从了她的意思，不勉强她一起出游。
For that reason, Hu accepted her wishes and did not press her to go out with him.

但打算一个人出去逛逛，这得先跟阿巧姐请教，
He still intended to take a walk alone, but first sought her advice.

正在谈着苏州城里的名园古刹，突然发现金阎栈的掌拒，行色匆匆，直奔了进来。
They were discussing Suzhou's famous gardens and old temples when the innkeeper hurried straight in.

“胡大老爷，胡大老爷！”掌柜说道：
“Your Honour!

“何学台来拜，
Education Commissioner He has come to call.

已经下轿了。”
He's already out of his chair.”

听这一说，胡雪岩倒有些着慌，
Hu was alarmed.

第一，没有听差“接贴”，
First, he had no attendant to receive the visiting card.

第二，自己该穿公服肃迎，时间上来不及了。
Second, he ought to put on official dress to welcome his visitor, and there was no time.

所以一时有手足无措之感。
For a moment he did not know what to do.

还是阿巧姐比较沉着，
A’qiao was more composed.

“何学台穿啥衣服来的？”她问。
“What is the commissioner wearing?”

“穿的便服。”
“Informal clothes.”

“这还好！”胡雪岩接口说道：
“That's a relief,” Hu said.

“来不及了，
“There's no time.

我也只好便服相迎。”
I shall have to receive him informally too.”

说着，他便走了出去，
He went out.

阿巧姐也赶紧将屋里刚刚倒散未曾归理的行李，略略收拾了一下，在窗口张望，只等何桂清一到，便要回避。
A’qiao hastily tidied the luggage they had unpacked but not yet put away, then watched at the window, ready to withdraw as soon as He arrived.


何桂清是走到第二进中门遇着胡雪岩的。
He Guiqing met Hu at the middle gateway of the second courtyard.

虽然穿的便衣，但跟着两名青衣小帽的听差，便能认出他的身分，
Though informally dressed, he was followed by two attendants in dark gowns and small caps, which revealed his standing.

胡雪岩却还下敢造次，
Hu nevertheless dared not take anything for granted.

站住脚一青，
He stopped for a look.

这位来客年纪与自己用仿，生得极白净的一张脸，这模样与王有龄所形容的何桂清的仪表，完全相符，
The visitor was about his own age, with an exceptionally fair, clean-cut face, exactly as Wang had described.

便知再不得错了。
There could be no mistake.

“何大人！”他迎面请个安说：
He stepped forward and made a formal bow of greeting. “Your Excellency!

“真不敢当。”
I don't deserve such an honour.”

“请起，请起！”
“Please rise, please rise.”

何桂清拱拱手说：
He returned a clasped-hands salute.

“想来足下就是雪岩兄了？”
“You must be Brother Xueyan?”

“不敢当此称呼！
“I don't deserve that form of address.

我是胡雪岩。”
I am Hu Xueyan.”

“幸会之至。”说着，何桂清又移动了脚步。于是胡雪岩引路，将何桂清引到自己屋里。
“A great pleasure to meet you.” He began walking again, and Hu led him towards his rooms.

就这几步路，做主人的转了好些念头，
In those few steps, many thoughts passed through the host's mind.

他发觉情况很尴尬，
The situation was awkward.

二品大员拜访一个初交，地点又是在客栈里，既没有象佯的堂奥可以容纳贵客，又没有听差可以供奔走之役。
An official of the second rank was calling on a new acquaintance at an inn, with neither a proper reception hall for such a guest nor servants to attend them.

这样子就很难讲官场的仪节了。
The ceremonies of official life would be difficult to observe.

索性当他自己人！
He would simply treat He as an intimate.

胡雪岩断然作了这样一个决定，首先就改了称呼，
Having decided, he first changed his form of address.

何桂清字根云，便仿照“雪公”的例，称他“云公”。
He's courtesy name was Genyun; following the familiar respectful form he used for Wang as Mr Xuexuan, Hu addressed He as Mr Genyun.

接入客座，他这样说道：“公云，礼不可废，
“Mr Genyun,” he said on bringing him into the reception area, “we mustn't neglect propriety.

请上坐，让我这个候补知县参见！”
Please take the place of honour and let this county magistrate awaiting appointment pay his respects.”

这是打的一个“过门”，
This was merely an opening flourish.

既是便服，又是这样的称呼，根本就没有以官场礼节参见的打算，
Informal dress and so familiar an address showed that he had no intention of observing full official ceremony.

何桂清是绝顶聪明的人，一听就懂，
He, a man of exceptional intelligence, understood at once.

再替他设身处地想一想，倒又佩服他这别出一格的处置，
Putting himself in Hu's place, he rather admired this unconventional solution.

因而笑道：
He smiled.

“雪岩兄，不要说杀风景的话。
“Brother Xueyan, don't spoil the occasion.

我听雪轩谈过老兄，神交已久，
I've heard Xuexuan speak of you and have long felt I knew you.

要脱略形迹才好！”
Let's dispense with formalities.”

“是！
“Certainly.

恭敬不如从命！”
Obedience is better than ceremony.”

胡雪岩一捐到地，站起身来说：
Hu made a deep bow, then straightened.

“ 请里面坐吧！”
“Please come inside.”


这才真的是脱略形迹，一见面就延入内室，
This was truly dispensing with formality: at their first meeting, Hu invited him straight into the inner room.

何桂清略一踌躇，也就走了进去。
He hesitated briefly, then entered.

一进门却又赶紧退了出来，因为看到一具闺阁中用的镜箱，还有两件女衣。
But he immediately stepped out again on seeing a woman's mirror case and two articles of female clothing.

“宝眷大此，
“Your lady is here.

不好唐突！”
I mustn't intrude.”

“不妨，不妨。”胡雪岩一面说，一面便喊：“阿巧，你出来见见何老爷。”
“Not at all, not at all.” Hu called, “A’qiao, come and meet Mr He.”

何桂清还在迟疑之际，突然眼前一亮，就不肯再退出去了，
While He was still hesitating, his eyes suddenly brightened, and he no longer wished to withdraw.

望着走几步路如风摆杨柳似的阿巧姐，向胡雪岩问道：“怎么称呼？
Watching A’qiao approach, swaying gracefully like a willow in the breeze, he asked Hu, “How should I address her?

是如嫂夫人？”
Is she your concubine?”

“不是！”胡雪岩说：
“No.

“云公叫她小名阿巧好了。”
Just call her by her own name, A’qiao.”

就这对答间，阿巧姐已经含笑叫一声：
As they spoke, she smiled and greeted him.

“何老爷！”
“Mr He.”

同时盈盈下拜。
Then she gracefully sank to her knees.

“不敢当，不敢当！
“I don't deserve this.

请起来。”
Please rise!”

男女授受不亲，不便动手去扶，到底让阿巧姐跪了一跪，
Propriety forbade physical contact between men and women, so he could not help her up and had to accept the kneeling salutation.

她站起来说一声：“何老爷请坐！”然后翩然走了出去，
She rose, invited him to sit and went lightly out.

听她在喊客栈里的伙计泡盖碗茶。
They heard her calling to the inn's waiter for tea in lidded cups.


真是当做自己人看待，何桂清也就不再拘束，
Treated genuinely as one of the household, He dropped his reserve.

坐在窗前上首一张椅子上，首先向胡雪岩道谢：
Taking the chair in the place of honour by the window, he first thanked Hu.

“多蒙专程下顾，隆仪尤其心感。
“You've honoured me with a special journey, and I'm especially touched by the gifts.

天南万里，何况烽火，
My home is so far away in the south, with war between us as well.

居然得尝家乡风味，太难得了。”
To taste its flavours here is a rare pleasure.”

“说实话，是阿巧姐的主意。”
“To tell the truth, it was A’qiao's idea.”

“可人，可人！”
“What a delightful woman!”

何桂清的视线又落在正在装果碟子的阿巧姐身上。
His eyes returned to her as she arranged dishes of snacks.

“没有好东西请何老爷吃，意思意思。”阿巧姐捧了四个果碟子走过来说，
“There's nothing very fine for you, Mr He, only a little token,” she said, bringing over four dishes.

四个果碟子是她带在路上的闲食，一碟洋糖、一碟蜜枣、一碟杭州的香榧、一碟是昆山附近的黄埭瓜子。
These were the provisions she had brought to eat on the journey: foreign sweets, candied dates, Hangzhou torreya nuts and Huangdai melon seeds from near Kunshan.

“谢谢！”
“Thank you.”

何桂清目光随着她那一双雪白的手转，
His gaze followed her pair of snowy-white hands.

蓦然警觉，这忘形的神态是失礼的，便收拢眼光，看着胡雪岩说：
Suddenly realizing that such an unguarded stare was discourteous, he drew his eyes back to Hu.

“雪岩兄是哪天到的？”
“When did you arrive, Brother Xueyan?”

“今天刚到。”
“Only today.”

“从杭州来？”
“From Hangzhou?”

“不，
“No.

到上海有几天了。”胡雪岩说，
I've been in Shanghai for several days.

“本想请个人来送信。因为久慕云公，很想见一见，所以专诚来一趟。”
I had meant to send someone with the letter, but I've long admired you and wanted to meet you, so I made the journey myself.”

“盛情可感之至。”
“I'm most grateful for your kindness.”

何桂清拱拱手，
He clasped his hands.

“不知道雪岩兄有儿日勾留？”
“How many days will you linger here?”

不说耽搁说勾留，这些文绉绉的话，胡雪岩是跟嵇鹤龄相处得有了些日子，才能听懂，
It was his time with Ji Heling that enabled Hu to understand such elegantly literary wording as ‘linger’ instead of the plain ‘stay’.

因而也用很雅饬的修辞答道：
He answered with equal refinement.

“此来专为奉谒。
“My visit is expressly to pay my respects to you.

顺道访一访灵岩、虎丘，总有三、五日盘桓。”
I shall also take the opportunity to visit Lingyan and Tiger Hill, so I expect to sojourn here for three to five days.”

“老兄真是福气人！”
“You are a fortunate man!”

何桂清指着阿巧姐说：
He indicated A’qiao.

“隽侣又携，载酒看山，不要说是这种乱世，就是承平时节，也是人生难得之事。”
“A charming companion at your side, wine aboard and hills to admire—rare pleasures in life, even in peaceful times, let alone these troubled days.”


阿巧姐听不懂他说的什么，但估量必是在说自己，而且料定是好话。
A’qiao did not understand his words, but guessed that they concerned her and were complimentary.

再看这位“何老爷”，是“白面书生”的模样，不道已经戴上了红顶子，说来有些叫人不能相信，
Looking at this Mr He, so like a fair-faced young scholar, she could scarcely believe he already wore the red button of high rank.

转念又想，“说书先生”常常讲的，落难公子中状元，放作“七省巡按”，随带上方宝剑，有恩报恩，有仇报仇，
Then she remembered the storytellers' tales: a young gentleman in distress came first in the examinations and was sent out as imperial inspector of seven provinces, carrying the sovereign's sword, rewarding kindness and avenging wrongs.

怕正就是象眼前“何老爷”这样子的人。
Such a man must look just like the Mr He before her.

心里如此七颠八倒的在想，一双勾魂摄魄的眼睛，便不住看着何桂清。
As these thoughts tumbled through her mind, her enchanting eyes kept returning to him.

那位阿巧姐眼中的“白面书生”，心里也是说不出的滋味。
The ‘fair-faced scholar’ she was watching had feelings of his own that he could not put into words.

同时不断在想：她是什么路数，
Who was she?

与胡雪岩是怎么回事？
What was her relationship with Hu?

因为如此，口中便不知道跟胡雪岩在讲些什么？
So absorbed was he in these questions that he scarcely knew what he was saying to his host.

直到阿巧姐悄悄起去，倩影消失，他才警觉，既不安、又好笑，
Only when A’qiao quietly rose and her lovely figure disappeared did he come to himself, embarrassed and amused.

想想不能再坐下去了，
He had better leave.

否则神魂颠倒，不知会有什么笑话闹出来？
If he stayed, who knew what foolishness his distraction might produce?

“我告辞！”他说，
“I must take my leave,” he said.

“今晚上奉屈小酌，
“Please honour me at a little dinner tonight.

我要好好请教。”
I have much to ask you.”

“不敢当。”
“You do me too much honour.”

“雪岩兄！”何桂清很认真地说，“我不是客套。
“Brother Xueyan, this is no empty courtesy,” He said earnestly.

雪轩跟你的交情，我是知道的，
“I know your friendship with Xuexuan.

他信中也提起，说你‘足智多谋，可共肝胆’，
In his letter he calls you ‘resourceful and worthy of complete trust’.

我有好些话，要跟老兄商议。”
There are many things I want to discuss with you.”

“既如此，我就遵命了。”
“In that case, I shall obey.”

“这才好。”何桂清欣然又说，
“Excellent.

“我不约别人，就是我们两个。
I shall invite no one else, only the two of us.

回头我具柬贴来。”
I'll send a formal invitation presently.”


于是胡雪岩将何桂清送了出门，等他上了轿，回到自己屋里，
Hu saw him out to his chair and returned to his room.

看见阿巧姐在收拾果盘，
A’qiao was clearing away the dishes.

想起她刚才跟何桂清眉来眼去的光景，心里便有些酸溜溜地，不大得劲。
Remembering the glances she and He had exchanged, Hu felt a sour touch of jealousy and discomfort.

“这位何老爷，”阿巧姐说，“看上去年纪比你还轻。”
“That Mr He looks younger than you,” she said.

“是啊！”胡雪岩说，
“Yes.

“我看他不过比你大两三岁，
I'd say he's only two or three years older than you.

正好配得上你。”
Just the right match.”

“瞎三话四！”
“What nonsense!”

阿巧姐白了他一眼。
She gave him a reproachful look.

她不再说话，胡雪岩也懒得开口，
She said no more, and Hu had no inclination to speak either.

一个人歪在床上想心思，想东想西，百无聊赖。
He lay on the bed turning one thought after another over in his mind, bored and restless.

看看天快黑下来了，外面又有掌柜的声间，急促地在喊：
Dusk was approaching when the innkeeper's hurried voice sounded outside again.

“胡大老爷，
“Your Honour!

胡大老爷！”
Your Honour!”

这声音喊得人心慌，
The cries were alarming.

赶紧一骨碌起身，迎了出去，
Hu sprang up and went out.

只见前面是掌柜，后面跟着个戴红缨帽的听差，手里夹一个“护书”，
Behind the innkeeper stood an attendant in a red-tasselled cap, carrying a document case.

见了胡雪岩，抢上两步打个千说：
He stepped forward and made a formal greeting.

“小的何福，给胡大老爷请安。
“Your servant He Fu pays his respects.

敞上特地叫小的来迎接，
My master has sent me specially to fetch you.

轿子在门口，
The chair is at the door.

请胡大老爷就动身吧！”
Please set out now.”

说着递了一份贴子上来。贴子写的是：“即夕申刻奉迓便酌。”
He presented a card: “I respectfully invite you to an informal dinner this evening at the shen hour.”

下款具名：“教愚弟何桂清谨订。”
It was signed, “Your junior and humble pupil, He Guiqing.”

“喔！好，
“Ah, good.

我就走。”
I'll come at once.”

胡雪岩回到屋里，只见阿巧姐已取了一件马褂，作势等他来穿。
Hu returned inside and found A’qiao holding a riding jacket ready for him to put on.


“留你一个人在客栈里了！”胡雪岩说了这一句，忽起试探的念头，
“I must leave you alone at the inn.” As he said this, a desire to test her suddenly occurred to him.

“等我到了那里，请何老爷派人来接你好不好？”
“When I get there, shall I ask Mr He to send someone to fetch you?”

这应该算作绝顶荒唐的念头，
The idea was absurd in the extreme.

主客初会，身分不同，离通家之好还有十万八千里，
Host and guest were newly acquainted and of different standing, far from the intimacy that allowed their families to visit freely.

就算一见如故，脱略形迹，而她是“妾身未分明”，
Even if they felt like old friends and dispensed with ceremony, A’qiao's position was still undefined.

怎能入官宦之家？
How could she enter an official household?

再迟一步而论，算是有了名分，胡家的姨太太，也得何家的内亲眷派人来接，
Even supposing she had acquired a recognized position as Hu's concubine, an invitation must come from the women of the He family.

怎么样也不能说由“何老爷”来邀堂客！
Mr He could not possibly invite a female guest himself.

因此，阿巧姐的表情应该是惊异，或者笑一笑，照苏州人的说法：“亏你想得出！”
Her answer ought therefore to have been astonishment, or a smile and the Suzhou expression, ‘What an idea to come up with!’

甚至，置之下理，表示无可与言，亦在意中。
She might even ignore it as unworthy of an answer.

而她什么都不是，只这样答说：“不好意思的！”
Instead, she merely said, “I couldn't presume.”

是怎么样的不好意思，
What kind of hesitation did that express?

就颇耐人寻味了。
It invited speculation.

胡雪岩便报以一笑，不再说下去了。
Hu smiled and pursued the matter no further.

等坐上轿子，心里还一直在研究阿巧姐的态度，
Once in the chair, he continued to examine her response.

他很冷静，就当估量一笔有暴利可图，但亦可能大蚀其本的大生意那样，不动感情，纯从利害去考虑。
Calmly, without emotion, he weighed advantage and disadvantage as though considering a business venture that might yield enormous profit or swallow its entire capital.

考虑到轿子将停，他大致已经有了主见，
By the time the chair was about to stop, he had broadly made up his mind.

暂且搁下，抖擞精神来对付这个新交的贵人。
He put the matter aside for now and rallied himself to deal with his new acquaintance of high rank.


何桂清是借住在苏州府学的西花厅，
He Guiqing was lodging in the west reception hall of the Suzhou Prefectural Academy.

厅中用屏风隔成三间，
Screens divided it into three rooms.

最外一间，当作“签押房”，接见是在第二间，书房的格局，布置得雅洁有效。
The outermost served as an office for handling documents, and he received visitors in the second, furnished as a study with tasteful simplicity.

胡雪岩到时，他正在写大字，
When Hu arrived, He was practising large calligraphy.

放下未写成的对联，欢然待客。
He laid aside an unfinished pair of couplets and welcomed his guest warmly.

但见他穿一件枣红宁绸的夹袍，外套一字襟的玄色软缎坎肩，戴一顶六角形的折帽，一种象扇子样，可以折起来，置入衣袋中的爪皮小帽，
He wore a lined robe of jujube-red Ning silk beneath a black soft-satin waistcoat with a straight fastening, and a little six-sided cap that folded like a fan and could be slipped into a pocket.

这副打扮，哪里象个考秀才的学台？倒象洋场中的纨袴.“雪岩兄！”
In this attire, he looked less like an education commissioner examining licentiates than a fashionable young man-about-town in the foreign settlement. “Brother Xueyan!”

何桂清潇洒的将手一摆，
He waved a hand with easy grace.

“你看，就你我俩，
“As you see, there are only the two of us.

无话不可谈。”
Nothing need be left unsaid.”

作此表示，非同寻常，
This was no ordinary declaration.

胡雪岩相当感动，但也格外慎重，
Hu was touched, but all the more cautious.

“云公，”他以端然的神色说，“雪公把信交给我的时候，特别叮嘱，云公如果有什么吩咐，务必照办。
“Mr Genyun, when Mr Xuexuan gave me the letter, he particularly instructed me to carry out any request you might make.

这句话，我亦不肯随便出口，因为怕力量有限办不到。
I didn't care to repeat that lightly, for fear my abilities might fall short.

如今我不妨跟云公说，即使办不到，我觉得云公一定也会体谅，
Now I can say it, because I feel certain you would understand even if I failed.

所以有话尽请吩咐。”
Please tell me freely what you wish.”

这话已经说到头了，
This was as far as such an assurance could go.

何桂清也就无所顾虑，很坦率他说：
He put aside his remaining doubts and spoke openly.

“黄寿臣是我的同年，
“Huang Shouchen passed in the same examination year as I did.

他如果不走，我不便有所表示，
While he stays, I can't make any move.

现在听说他有调动的消息，
Now I hear he may be transferred.

论资格，我接他的缺，也不算意外，所以雪轩为我设谋，倒也不妨计议计议。
By seniority, there would be nothing surprising in my succeeding him, so Xuexuan's plan for me is worth considering.

不过，费了好大的劲，所得的如果是‘鸡肋’，那就不上算了。
But after a great deal of effort, if all I get is a chicken rib, it won't be worthwhile.

你看，浙江的情形，到底怎么样？”
What exactly is the situation in Zhejiang?”

胡雪岩不懂“爵之无味，弃之可惜”的“鸡肋”作何解？
Hu did not understand the allusion to a chicken rib, tasteless to chew yet regrettable to discard.

不过整段话的意思，大致可以明白，是问浙江巡抚这个缺分的好坏。
But he understood the general question: how desirable was the governorship of Zhejiang?

“浙江当然不如江苏，
“Naturally, Zhejiang cannot compare with Jiangsu.

不过，有一点比江苏好！到底还不曾打仗。”
But in one respect it's better: there has been no fighting there yet.”

“虽未打仗，替江南大营办粮台，还有安徽的防务，也得帮忙，
“True, but it must run a supply office for the Jiangnan Grand Camp and help with Anhui's defence.

为人作嫁，颇不上算。”
Preparing a bride's trousseau for someone else is hardly worthwhile.”

“这也不见得。”胡雪岩答道，
“Not necessarily,” Hu answered.

“如果是个清闲无事的缺，只怕云公亦未必肯屈就。“
“If it were an idle, uneventful post, you might not care to accept it.”


“这倒是真话。”
“That's true.”

何桂清颇有深获我心之感，
He felt that Hu had understood him very well.

“我这个江苏学政，照承平时候来说，也就仅仅次于‘提督顺天学政’，
“In peaceful times, my appointment as education commissioner of Jiangsu would rank just below the education commissionership of Shuntian.

这是因为京畿之地，
That is because Shuntian embraces the capital.

论人才，又何尝及得上贵处江南？
In talent, how could it compare with your Jiangnan?

所以江苏学政的是否得人，关乎国家的气运，人才的消长。
Whether the right man holds Jiangsu's educational office therefore affects the fortunes of the state and the rise or decline of its talent.

谁知两百年来，我适逢其会，遇上这么个用兵的时候，
Who could have expected that, after two hundred years, I should happen to hold it at a time of war?

如今是只讲战备，不修文治，
Everyone speaks of military preparations and neglects civil learning.

加以地方沦陷的很多，我原可躲躲懒，
Much of the territory has fallen, so I could have taken things easily.

但此时不讲培育，战乱一年，人才中断，
But if we fail to cultivate scholars now, a year of war could interrupt the succession of talent.

那就是我的误国之罪了。
I should be guilty of failing the country.

所以借地科考，辗转跋涉，
I've therefore borrowed premises elsewhere to hold the examinations, travelling from place to place.

自觉也对得起皇上，对得起江苏百姓了。”
I feel I've done my duty to the emperor and the people of Jiangsu.”

胡雪岩也曾听说过，何桂清这个江苏学政做得相当起劲，
Hu had heard that He pursued his work with considerable energy.

本职以外，常有奏疏论军务，
Besides his regular duties, he often submitted memorials on military matters.

本意以为他越俎代庖，迹近多事，
Hu had thought he was interfering in others' business and almost making unnecessary trouble.

现在听他谈到“借地科考，辗转跋涉”，才知道未乔所职，
Now, hearing how he held examinations in borrowed premises and travelled about, he realized that He had not neglected his own office.

心里不觉浮起敬意。但这方面他无可赞一词，
Respect rose in him, though he knew too little of the subject to offer a word of appreciation.

唯有凝神倾听，不断点头而已。
He could only listen closely and keep nodding.

“老爷！”有个丫头走来说，“请客人入席吧。”
A maid approached. “Master, please invite your guest to the table.”

“请吧！
“Come.

真正是小酌，”何桂清说，“而且是借花献佛。”
It really is only a little dinner,” He said, “and I'm offering you flowers borrowed from yourself.”


果然，六样菜倒有四样的材料，出自胡雪岩送的那四色云南土产，
Indeed, four of the six dishes were made from Hu's four Yunnan gifts.

当中一个一品锅，
In the middle stood a covered casserole.

揭开来看，形式与众不同，中间“朝天一柱”，多出个嘴了，
When the lid was lifted, Hu saw an unusual construction: a spout rose like a pillar through its centre.

里面是一锅鸡块，汤汁极清，微带糟香，
Inside were pieces of chicken in a very clear broth, faintly fragrant with fermented grain.

不觉就在喉间咽了一口唾沫。
He swallowed involuntarily.

“这大概就是‘汽锅鸡’了。”胡雪岩说，
“This must be steam-pot chicken.

“久闻其名，还是初次见识。”
I've long heard of it, but never seen it before.”

“这鸡也就是喝点汤。
“The broth is really the point.

做法并不麻烦。难得的是家伙，
It's not difficult to make; the rare thing is the vessel.

这汽锅，我曾托人到宜兴仿制，怎么样也不合适。”何桂清说到这里，忽然问道：“雪岩兄到敝处去过没有？”
I've had people try to reproduce this steam pot at Yixing, but it never came out right.” Suddenly He asked, “Have you ever visited my part of the country?”

“没有。
“No.

不过我久慕昆明是侗夭福地，四季如春，山明水秀。”
But I've long admired Kunming as a blessed place, with spring throughout the year, beautiful hills and clear waters.

胡雪岩又说，“俗语道得好，人杰地灵，
As they say, fine land produces outstanding men.

有这样的好地方，才能出云公这样的人物。”
Only such a place could produce someone like you.”

“过奖，过奖！”何桂清说，
“You flatter me.

“你总听雪轩说过，我不是云南土著。”
Surely Xuexuan has told you I'm not a native of Yunnan?”

肯提到这一点，也就表示不讳他的身世，
His willingness to mention this showed that he did not conceal his origins.

胡雪岩转念到此，便理解到何桂清真的是拿自己当知心朋友看待。
Hu realized that He truly regarded him as a confidential friend.

不过，自己却不便透露已尽知他的底细，所以这样答道：“略知一二。
Yet it would be awkward to reveal that he already knew the whole story, so he answered, “A little.

雪公也是很佩服云公的。”
Mr Xuexuan greatly admires you too.”

“我跟他的交情不同，你跟他的交情也不同。
“My friendship with him is unusual, and so is yours.

所以今后你不要见外才好。”
You mustn't stand on ceremony with me from now on.”

“是！是！
“Certainly.

承蒙云公不弃，我敬云公亦象敬雪公一样。”
Since you're willing to accept me, I shall respect you just as I respect Mr Xuexuan.”

“敬则不敢，但愿你不分彼此。
“I don't ask for respect, only that you make no distinction between us.

来‘相见欢’，
Come, a cup to the joy of meeting.

请干了这一杯。”
Let us drain it.”


两个人都干了照杯。
They drained their cups and showed them empty.

然后低斟慢饮，继续谈浙江的情形。
Refilling their cups sparingly and drinking slowly, they continued to discuss Zhejiang.

胡雪岩认为已不需怂恿他作何打算，
Hu thought there was no need to urge any particular course upon him now.

只就浙江的吏治、民生、人情、风土，尽其所知地细细陈述。
He simply described all he knew of the province's administration, people's livelihoods, customs and local conditions.

何桂清听得很仔细，偶尔也发一两句问，问的都是地方的形势，
He Guiqing listened carefully and occasionally asked a question, always about the situation on the ground.

胡雪岩听得出来，他的兴趣是在军务上，
Hu could tell that his interest lay in military affairs.

倘或防守没有把握，他对浙江巡抚这个缺，就不见得会有兴趣。
If defence seemed uncertain, the Zhejiang governorship might not appeal to him.

谈到最后，何桂清对他的出处，作了透露：
At last He revealed something of his career plans.

“我这个学政是一定不干了。
“I certainly shan't remain education commissioner.

以后于什么，却还打不定主意。
What I'll do afterwards is still undecided.”

“官场上的花样，胡雪岩所了解的，只到府县为止，
Hu's understanding of official life extended only as far as prefectures and counties.

省里的事，还可以猜得出来。至于京官以后许多特殊的缺分，他就不懂了，
He could guess at provincial affairs, but appointments in the capital and the many special offices were beyond him.

所以对何桂清的话，无可置答。
He therefore had no answer.

“你知道，我们那一榜，道光十五年乙未，现在算是最得意了。
“You know, our examination class—the yiwei year, the fifteenth of Daoguang—is the most successful now.

这是因为当年穆相国的提拔，
That is because Grand Secretary Mu advanced us all those years ago.

穆相国你知道吧？”
You know who he is?”

“说来惭愧。我还不大清楚。”
“I'm ashamed to say I don't really.”

“这也怪你不来，
“You can hardly be blamed.

你不是我们这一路上的人……”
You aren't one of our kind of people...”


何桂清接下来更为胡雪岩“穆相国”——道光朝的权相穆彰阿。
He went on to explain: Grand Secretary Mu was Muzhang’a, the powerful minister of the Daoguang reign.

乙未科会试，是他的大主考，十五年工夫，尽是提拔门生，
As chief examiner at the metropolitan examination in the yiwei year, he had spent the next fifteen years promoting his pupils.

内而军机部院，外而巡抚藩桌，遍布要津，
They filled key posts everywhere: the Grand Council, ministries and courts at the centre, and governorships, treasurerships and judicial commissions in the provinces.

所以穆彰阿虽在当今咸丰皇帝接位的第二年垮了下来，但乙未科同榜，羽翼已经丰满，个个可以振翅高飞，
Thus, although Muzhang’a had fallen in the second year after the present Xianfeng Emperor's accession, his yiwei pupils had fully grown wings and could each fly high.

不但不受老师垮台的影响，
Their teacher's fall had not harmed them.

而且老师反因门生的力量，仅仅得了个革职的处分，
On the contrary, their influence had saved him from anything worse than dismissal.

不曾象当年“和坤跌倒”那样，搞成抄家送命的悲惨结局。
He had not suffered Heshen's fate of confiscation and death.

“所以，”何桂清话锋一转，谈到自己，“我不能轻弃机会，
“So I can't lightly throw away an opportunity,” He continued, turning to his own affairs.

动是总要动的，
“I must make a move.

现在不是承平之世，学政没有干头。
These aren't peaceful times, and there is little future in an education commissionership.

如果说想到浙江去，变成控黄寿臣的根，
If I said I wanted Zhejiang, it would amount to undermining Huang Shouchen.

同年相好，说不过去。
We're friends from the same examination class; I couldn't justify that.

叫我回去当礼部侍郎的本缺，亦实在没有意思。
Returning to my substantive post as vice-minister of rites holds no interest either.

我在想，象仓场侍郎之类的缺分，倒不妨过个渡。”
I've been thinking that a post such as granary vice-minister might serve as an intermediate step.”

“仓场侍郎”这个官称，胡雪岩倒是知道，因为与漕运有关，听王有龄和嵇鹤龄都谈过。
Hu knew that title because it concerned the grain tribute and both Wang and Ji had mentioned it.

仓场侍郎驻通州，专管漕粮的接收、存贮，下面有十一个仓监督，
The granary vice-minister was stationed at Tongzhou and supervised the receipt and storage of tribute grain, with eleven granary supervisors below him.

是个肥缺，
It was a lucrative office.

做两三年下来，外放巡抚，便有了做清官的资格，因为宦囊已丰，不必再括地皮。
After two or three years, a man could be appointed a provincial governor with the means to behave honestly: his official purse would already be full, and he need no longer squeeze the people.


胡雪岩的脑筋快，一下子想到浙江的海运，
Hu's quick mind turned at once to Zhejiang's sea transport.

从王有龄到嵇鹤龄，海运局的麻烦还很多，
From Wang to Ji, the Sea Transport Bureau had faced many difficulties.

有许多核销的帐目，要靠通州方面的帮忙，
Numerous accounts still needed Tongzhou's help to obtain approval.

如果何洼清能够去掌管其事，一切都方便了。
If He could take charge there, everything would become easier.

于是他说：“云公，你这个打算，真正不错！
“Mr Genyun, that is an excellent plan!

说到这上头，我倒有微劳可效。
On this subject, I can be of some small service.

天下的漕粮重在江浙，
The grain tribute depends chiefly on Jiangsu and Zhejiang.

浙江方面的海运，只要云公坐镇通州，说什么便是什么，
As far as Zhejiang's sea transport is concerned, once you are established at Tongzhou, your word will be law.

一定遵照云公的意思办理。
Everything will be done as you wish.”

““喔，”何桂清问：
“Oh?” He asked.

“浙江的海运，雪轩已经交卸了，
“Xuexuan has handed over Zhejiang's sea transport.

你何以有这样的握握？”
How can you be so certain?”

“雪公虽已交卸，现在的坐办嵇鹤龄，跟雪公仍旧有极深的渊源。
“He has, but the present executive director, Ji Heling, still has very close ties with him.

嵇某人是我拜把的兄弟。”
Ji is my sworn brother.”

“原来如此！”
“So that's how it is!”

何桂清欣喜中有惊异，
He was delighted and surprised.

觉得事情真有这么凑巧，倒是意想不到。
Such a fortunate connection was quite unexpected.

“至于江苏方面的海运，云公想必比我还清楚，
“As for Jiangsu's sea transport, you must know more than I do.

而且由江苏调过去，不论谁来办，必都是熟人，
And since you'll be transferring from Jiangsu, whoever handles it will be someone you know.

自然一切容易说话。”
Naturally, arrangements will be easy.

说到这里，胡雪岩作了一个结论：“总而言之，云公去干这个缺，是人地个宜。”
In short, you and the post are perfectly suited.”

“能人地相宜，就可以政通人和。”
“With the right man in the right place, administration runs smoothly and people live in harmony.”

何桂清停了一下，又说，
He paused.

“我本来只是随便起的一个念头，
“It was only a passing thought at first.

不想跟你一谈，倒谈出名堂来了。
Talking with you has given it substance.

我已写了信到京里，想进京去一趟，
I've already written to the capital and mean to go there.

‘陛见’的上谕，大概快下来了，
The imperial order summoning me to an audience should come soon.

准定设法调仓场。”
I'll definitely seek a transfer to the granaries.”


何桂清肯说到这样的话，便见得已拿胡雪岩当作无话不谈的心腹。
For He to speak so openly meant he now regarded Hu as a confidant with whom he could discuss anything.

听话的人了解，人与人之间，交情跟关系的建立与进展，全靠在这种地方有个扎实的表示。
Hu understood that friendships and connections were established and strengthened by some concrete expression of commitment at just such a moment.

这一步跨越不了，密友亦会变成泛泛之交。
Fail to take that step, and even close friends could become mere acquaintances.

因此，胡雪岩当然不会轻易放过。
He would not let this opportunity slip.

“云公！我敢说，你的打算，不能再好了。
“Mr Genyun, I can say that your plan could not be better.

事不宜迟，
There is no time to lose.

就该放手进行。
You should go ahead.

不过，有句话，我不知道说得冒昧不冒昧？
But there's something I don't know whether I may venture to say.”

““你不曾说，我怎么知道？”
“How can I know until you've said it?”

何桂情剥着指甲，眼睛望着他自己的手，是准备接受他那句“冒昧”话的神气。
He picked at his nails, looking down at his hands as though preparing to receive the presumptuous remark.

“听说藩司进一趟京，起码得花两万银子，
“I hear that a provincial treasurer's journey to the capital costs at least twenty thousand taels.

可是有这话？”
Is that true?”

“这也不能一概而论，
“One can't generalize.

中等省份够了，象江苏这样一等一的大省就不够。
For a middling province it would be enough; for a first-rank province such as Jiangsu, it wouldn't.

仅仅陛见述职够了，
It would cover merely attending an imperial audience and reporting on one's duties.

如果有公事接头，或者请款，或者报销，那‘部费’就没得底，
But if there is official business to transact—requesting funds or getting accounts approved—there is no limit to the departmental fees.

两万银子哪里够？
How could twenty thousand suffice?”

““照这样说，有所谋干，就更不够了。”
“Then it would be still less adequate if one were seeking an appointment.”

“这也要看缺分、看圣眷、看朝里有人无人而定。
“That too depends on the office, imperial favour and whether one has people at court.

象我这趟去，就花不了多少钱。”
My own journey this time won't cost very much.”

“那么，”胡雪岩敛眉正视，一个字、一个字很清楚地问：“到底要多少呢？”
Hu looked at him directly, his brows drawn, and asked with deliberate clarity, “How much, exactly?”

何桂清不即回答，
He did not reply at once.

乱眨着眼，念念有词地数着指头，
Blinking repeatedly and murmuring, he counted on his fingers.

好久才说：“若有一万五千银子，尽足敷用。”
After some time he said, “Fifteen thousand taels would be amply sufficient.”


“云公，”胡雪岩一笑，又放正了脸色，“你老知道的，我做钱庄，
Hu smiled, then became serious again. “Mr Genyun, you know I run a bank.

我们这行生意，最怕‘烂头寸’，
What we dread most in our trade is idle money.

你老这趟进京，总要用我一点才好。”
You must use some of mine for this journey.”

这一说，何桂清的表情便很复杂了，惊喜而兼困惑，仿佛还不十分懂他的话似地，
He's expression became complicated: delighted surprise mixed with uncertainty, as though he had not quite understood.

是有点不懂，
In fact, he had not.

细想一想才算弄明白，但亦不知道自己的解释对不对，
Only after reflection did he grasp the meaning, and even then he doubted his interpretation.

所以话说得不很利落。
He spoke hesitantly.

“雪岩兄，你的意思是想放一笔款子给我？”
“Brother Xueyan, do you mean you wish to lend me money?”

“是的。”胡雪岩很率直，也很清楚地回答：
“Yes.” Hu answered directly and clearly.

“我想放一万五千银子的帐给云公。
“I'd like to lend you fifteen thousand taels.

利息特别克己，
The interest would be especially modest.

因为我的头寸多，总比烂在那里好。”
I have plenty of funds, and that is better than leaving them idle.”

“期限呢？”
“And the term?”

“云公自己说。”
“Whatever you say.”

何桂清又答不上来了，
Again the commissioner had no answer.

他要好好盘算一下，却又无从算起，
He needed to calculate, but had no basis for doing so.

因为只知道仓场侍郎的缺不错，一年到底有多少进帐并不知道。
He knew the granary vice-minister's post was a good one, but not what it yielded in a year.

看他迟疑，胡雪岩便说，“我替云公出个主意，
Seeing his hesitation, Hu offered a suggestion.

在京城里，我替云公介绍一家票号，
“I'll introduce you to a remittance bank in the capital.

云公的款子都存在他那里，看情形办，钱多多还，钱少少还，期限不定，
Keep your funds there, and repay according to circumstances: more when you have more, less when you have less, with no fixed term.

你老看如何？”
How would that be?”

“好，好，
“Good, good.

就是这么办。
Let us do that.

不过我不必用那么多，
But I don't need so much.

只要一万就可以了。”
Ten thousand will be enough.”


胡雪岩知道，五千已有着落，还是自己听了阿巧姐的话，亲手封进去的银票，
Hu knew the other five thousand was already provided for: he himself had sealed the note inside the letter after listening to A’qiao.

但不便说破，
But he could not say so openly.

怎么呢？不还差五千吗？他故意这样问。
He deliberately asked, “Why? Aren't you still five thousand short?”

何桂清也不肯说破，王有龄在信中，已附了五千银子，
The commissioner likewise would not reveal that Wang's letter had enclosed five thousand.

只是这样答道：“不敷之数，我另外找人凑一凑，
He merely said, “I can ask someone else to make up the shortfall.

也就差不多了。”
That should be enough.”

胡雪岩肚子里雪亮，便点点头说：
Understanding perfectly, Hu nodded.

“那么，请云公的示，我那一万银子，送到哪里？”
“Then please tell me where I should send the ten thousand.”

这平平常常的一句话，应该是极容易回答的，而何桂清竞开不得口！
It was an ordinary question, apparently easy to answer, yet the commissioner could not speak.

因为这件事说起来未免令人觉得突兀而骤难相信。
The whole affair was so sudden as to seem scarcely believable.

一万银子不是小数，
Ten thousand taels was no small sum.

初次见面，三言两语便大把捧出来借与人，不要中，不要保，还不必讲利息和期限，
At a first meeting, after a few words, a man offered it as a loan, without an intermediary or guarantor, without even settling the interest or the term.

这不太少见？
Was that not extraordinary?

这样茫然想着，忽有领悟，
While he wondered, a thought struck him.

胡雪岩这样做法，固可解释为王有龄的交情使然，但他本人是否有所图谋呢？
Hu's conduct might be explained by his friendship with Wang, but did he also have some purpose of his own?

生意人的算盘，无论如何是精明的，
A businessman's calculations were certain to be shrewd.

还是先问一问清楚的好。
Better ask first.

“雪岩兄”，他很吃力他说，“你真的是所谓‘烂头寸’？”
“Brother Xueyan,” he said with difficulty, “is this money really idle, as you say?”

问到这话，胡雪岩觉得不必再说假话，
At this question, Hu felt there was no need to maintain the fiction.

因而这样模棱地答道：“就算头寸不烂，云公的大事，我亦不能不勉力效劳。”
He answered ambiguously, “Even if it weren't, I could hardly fail to do my utmost to help with your important affairs.”


“感激得很。
“I'm deeply grateful.

只是我受你此惠，不知何以为报？”
Only, if I accept such a favour, how am I to repay it?”

话是一句普通见情的话，但他的眼神不同，
The words were an ordinary expression of gratitude, but his eyes were different.

双目的的地望着胡雪岩，是等候回话的神态。
They fixed directly upon Hu, waiting for an answer.

这一下，玲珑剔透的胡雪岩就了然了，这句活不仅是内心感激的表示，还带着“问条件”的意味。
Hu's acute understanding caught the meaning at once: this was not merely thanks, but an inquiry about his conditions.

条件自然有，但决不能说，说了就是草包。
Naturally, there were conditions, but to state them would mark him as a fool.

同时明雪岩也觉得他的这一问，未免看轻了他自己跟王有龄的交情，所以意中微有不满。
Moreover, he felt slightly displeased that He should rate his friendship with Wang so lightly.

“大公说的是哪里的话？
“Mr Genyun, what are you saying?

我不曾读过书，不过《史记》上的《货殖列传》、《游侠列传》也听人讲过。
I've had no schooling, but I've heard people explain the ‘Biographies of the Money-Makers’ and ‘Biographies of the Knight-Errants’ in the Records of the Grand Historian.

区区万金，莫非有所企图，才肯出手？”
Must I have some ulterior purpose before I can part with a mere ten thousand taels?”

“是，是！”
“Yes, yes!”

何桂清大为不安，连连拱手：
He was greatly embarrassed and repeatedly clasped his hands.

“是我失言了。
“I've spoken wrongly.

雪岩兄，我真还想不列。
Brother Xueyan, I never expected it.

你是读书有得的人。”
You are a man who has truly profited from learning.”

胡雪岩心里好笑，自然也得意，
Hu was inwardly amused and, naturally, pleased with himself.

听嵇鹤龄讲过几个汉朝的故事，居然把翰林出身的学台大人都唬住了，
A few Han-dynasty stories heard from Ji had actually overawed an education commissioner of Hanlin background.

将来跟玉有龄、嵇鹤龄他们谈起来，倒是一件值得夸耀之事。
It would make a fine story to boast of later to Wang and Ji.

“哪里，哪里，
“Not at all.

云公这话，等于骂我。”
To say that is almost to mock me.”

他一半实话，一半谦虚的话。
It was half truth, half modesty.

而何桂清却真的刮目相看了，
But He really did regard him with fresh respect.

“怪不得雪轩佩服你。”他说，
“No wonder Xuexuan admires you.

“雪轩以前虽不得意，却也是眼高于顶的人，
Even in his unsuccessful days, he was proud and exacting.

平日月旦人物，少所许可，独独对你不同，
He praised few of the people he judged, yet he always spoke differently of you.

原来你果然不同。”
Now I see that you really are different.”


胡雪岩报以矜持谦虚的微笑，拿话题又拉回到借款上：
Hu answered with a reserved, modest smile and returned the conversation to the loan.

“我那一万银子，一到上海就可以备妥，
“I can have the ten thousand ready as soon as I reach Shanghai.

是寄了来，还是怎么样？”
Shall I send it here, or would you prefer another arrangement?”

“不必寄来。”
“There is no need to send it.”

何桂清想了想说，
He considered.

“等我进京，自然是先到上海，由海道北上，
“When I go to the capital, I'll first come to Shanghai and travel north by sea.

一则路上比较平靖，再则也看看海运的情形。
The route is more peaceful, and I can also inspect the sea transport arrangements.

到了上海，我们见面再说。
We can discuss it when we meet in Shanghai.

那时少不得还有麻烦你的地方。”
I shall probably have other troubles for you then.”

“好，好……”
“Excellent.”

胡雪岩自告奋勇：
Hu volunteered eagerly.

“云公什么时候进京，先给我一封信，
“Let me know beforehand when you are going.

在上海备公馆，定船舱都归我办差。”
I'll attend to everything in Shanghai—finding you a residence and booking your cabin.”

“ ‘办差’两个字请收回。”
“Please don't speak as though you were attending to official duties.”

何桂清又踌躇着说：
He hesitated.

“倒是有一件，
“There is one thing.

我动身至快也得端午前后，
At the earliest, I cannot leave until about the Dragon Boat Festival.

那时候，恐怕你已回杭州了。”
By then you may have returned to Hangzhou.”

“我从杭州赶回上海。”胡雪岩答得极其爽利，
“Then I'll come back to Shanghai from Hangzhou,” Hu answered readily.

“而且，我上海也有人，
“Besides, I have people in Shanghai.

一切不需云公费心。”
You needn't concern yourself with any of it.”

谈话到此，酒也够了，
By now, they had talked and drunk enough.

胡雪岩请主人“赏饭”，
Hu asked his host to favour him with rice.

吃完略坐一坐，随即起身告辞，
After the meal he sat a little longer, then took his leave.

何桂清仍旧用轿子将他送回金阊栈。阿巧姐正灯下独坐，在守候他回来。
He again sent him by chair to Jinchang Inn, where A’qiao was sitting alone by lamplight, waiting for his return.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十三章起连续正文（之二；底本未标第二十四章）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Continuous text beginning with Chapter Twenty-Three, part two (the source supplies no Chapter Twenty-Four heading)
