原著：高阳


“你吃了饭没有？”
“Have you eaten?”

“吃过。”阿巧姐说，
“Yes,” A’qiao replied.

“一直想吃陆稿荐的酱猪肉，
“I've been wanting some of Lugaojian's pork in soy sauce for ages.

今天总算到口了。”
Today I finally had it.”

说着，她服侍他卸衣洗脚，一面问起何桂清那里的情形。
As she helped him undress and wash his feet, she asked what had happened at He Guiqing's.

胡雪岩不便将那些如何进京活动调任的话告诉她，但除此以外，就没有什么可说的了，
Hu could hardly tell her about going to the capital to seek a transfer, and apart from that there was little to say.

因为何家的内眷亲属，他一个也不曾看到。
He had not seen a single member of He's family.

等上了床，阿巧姐在枕头上问他：“明天怎么样？
Once they were in bed, she asked from her pillow, “What about tomorrow?

想到哪里去？”
Where would you like to go?”

“正事都办完了。
“The business is finished.

明天哪里去逛一天？
Where shall we spend the day?

到苏州一趟，总不能说虎丘都不曾到过。”
I can't come all the way to Suzhou and say I haven't even seen Tiger Hill.”

听他这一说，阿巧姐颇有意外之感，
This surprised her.

“我原以为你的事，总得有几天，才能办完。”她说，
“I thought your business would take several days.

“这一来……”
In that case...”

“怎么呢？”
“What is it?”

胡雪岩见她欲言又止，同样地感到诧异。
Her hesitation surprised him in turn.

“我本来想回木渎去一趟。
“I'd meant to go home to Mudu.

现在看来不成功了。”
Now it seems I can't.”

“这倒无所谓。”胡雪岩问，
“That needn't matter.

“你去干什么？”
What do you want to do there?”

“ 咦，你这话问得怪！
“What an odd question!

我家在木渎，
My home's in Mudu.

到了苏州不回去，说得过去吗？”
How could I come to Suzhou and not go back?”

“喔！”
“Oh!”

胡雪岩脱口说：
Hu blurted out.

“你是去看老公？”
“You're going to see your husband?”

“说得可要难听！”
“Must you put it so unpleasantly?”

阿巧姐有些气急败坏地，
She was flustered and angry.

“我是回娘家。”
“I'm going to my parents' home.”


看她的神气，这不是假话，
From her expression, she appeared to be telling the truth.

既然如此，胡雪岩觉得倒不妨问了下去：
Hu felt he might as well ask further.

“你娘家还有什么人？”
“Who's left in your family?”

“娘老子，一个兄弟。”
“My mother and a brother.

阿巧姐又说，“我看一看他们，有点钱带到了，马上回城。”
I'll see them, take them a little money and come straight back to the city.”

“那得多少时候？”
“How long would that take?”

“一来一去，总要两天。”
“Two days for the journey there and back.”

“两天？”
“Two days?”

胡雪岩想了想说，
He considered.

“你明天就去，后天回来，
“Go tomorrow, then, and return the day after.

一回来我们就走。”
We'll leave as soon as you're back.”

“这样，”阿巧姐歉然他说，“明天不能陪你逛虎丘了。”
“Then I shan't be able to go to Tiger Hill with you tomorrow,” she said apologetically.

“这倒无所谓。
“That doesn't matter.

阿巧，”胡雪岩问道，“你跟你夫家，到底怎么回事？”
A’qiao, what exactly is the arrangement between you and your husband's family?”

“怎么回事？
“What arrangement?

只要有钱给他们，他们啥也不管。”
So long as I give them money, they don't care about anything.”

阿巧姐用这样鄙夷不屑的口吻回答。
Her tone was contemptuous.

“钱是按月带回去？”
“Do you send money every month?”

“有时一个月，有时两个月。
“Sometimes every month, sometimes every two months.

钱多多带，钱少少带，
More when I have more, less when I have less.

没有一定。
There's no fixed rule.

再也要看有没有便人。
It also depends on finding someone going that way.

常常要托人，真麻烦。”
Always having to ask people is a real nuisance.”

“与其如此，还不如一刀两断，
“Wouldn't it be better to make a clean break?

也省得托人麻烦。”
That would save you the trouble.”

阿巧姐不响，看样子是有些为难，
She said nothing and seemed troubled.

胡雪岩便在猜度她的为难是什么？
Hu wondered what the difficulty was.

“一刀两断是可以，
“A clean break is possible.

就怕他们狮子大开口。”
I'm afraid they'll demand an outrageous sum.”

“你倒说说看，大到怎样的程度？
“How outrageous?

乡下人开口来也不见大到哪里去。”
Country people can hardly ask for very much.”

“总要两千银子。”
“It would take at least two thousand taels.”


两千银子倒是狮子大开口了，
Two thousand was indeed an outrageous demand.

在上海“长三”中，娶个红倌人也不过花到这个数目，
Even marrying a celebrated courtesan from a changsan house in Shanghai would cost no more.

而阿巧姐人虽不错，身价到底不值这么多。
Fine woman though A’qiao was, her value in such a transaction did not amount to that.

如果说一句“两千就两千”，这样出手，不能博得豪阔之名，
If he simply said, “Then two thousand it shall be,” he would not win a reputation for generosity.

倒有些象洋场新流行的俗语，成了“洋盘”。
He would look like what the foreign settlement's new slang called a gullible customer.

当然，这是因为从阿巧姐情不自禁地表现出对“何老爷”有“意思”以后，胡雪岩对她的兴趣已经打了折扣之故，
Of course, he felt this way because his interest in her had diminished since she involuntarily betrayed her feelings for “Mr He.”

否则他就不会有那样做“洋盘”的感觉。
Otherwise, the thought of being made a fool of would not have arisen.

于是他淡淡地答了句：“到了上海再说吧，
“We'll discuss it when we get back to Shanghai,” he answered coolly.

手边也没有这么多银子。”
“I haven't that much money with me.”

其实他带着三千银票，
In fact, he carried three thousand taels in banknotes.

这样说是托词，
It was an excuse.

阿巧姐原不曾作此期待，因而也不觉得失望。
A’qiao had expected no such offer, however, and was not disappointed.

一宿无话，
The night passed without further incident.

第二天起身，他实践前宵枕上的许诺，催阿巧姐回木渎。
In the morning, Hu kept his promise of the night before and urged her to go to Mudu.

“丢你一个人在客栈里，真不好意思。”阿巧姐说，
“I feel bad leaving you alone at the inn.

“要么，你跟我一同去。”
Why don't you come with me?”

这算什么名堂？
What sort of arrangement would that be?

乡下风气闭塞，
Country customs were restrictive.

阿巧姐这样带个“野汉子”回家，就算她自己不在乎，胡雪岩也觉得尴尬，
Even if she did not mind bringing a lover home, Hu would feel embarrassed.

所以摇着手说：
He waved the suggestion aside.

“不要紧，不要紧！
“Never mind.

你一个人去好了。
Go on your own.

一个人在城里逛逛也很好。”
I shall enjoy looking round the city by myself.”

“那么，我明天一早就动身回来。
“Then I'll set out early tomorrow morning.

大概中午就可以到了。”说着，便托金阊栈代为雇一顶来回的轿子，
I should be back about noon.” She asked Jinchang Inn to hire a sedan chair for the return journey.

胡雪岩想想让她空手回去，自己一无表示，也不好意思，
Hu felt it would be rather shabby to let her go empty-handed without making any gesture himself.

便取了一张一百两的银票，说是送她父母买补药吃。
He took out a hundred-tael note, saying it was for her parents to buy nourishing medicines.

阿巧姐自然高兴，上轿时便越发有那种依依不舍的神情了。
Naturally delighted, she seemed still more reluctant to part when she got into the chair.


也不过是她刚走，何桂清又派人送了柬贴来，约他午间在狮子林小酌。
She had scarcely left when He Guiqing sent another invitation, this time to lunch at the Lion Grove Garden.

胡雪岩正愁无处可去，自然是欣然许诺，
Hu had been wondering where to go and gladly accepted.

给了回片，发了赏钱，坐轿进阊门，
He sent back a reply, tipped the messenger and took a sedan chair through Chang Gate.

到玄妙观里喝了一碗茶，在庙市上买了几样小件的玉器，到了近午时分，就在庙前雇一顶小轿，去赴何桂清之约。
After drinking a bowl of tea at Xuanmiao Temple and buying a few small jade objects at the temple market, he hired another small chair outside the temple shortly before noon and went to keep the appointment.

狮子林以假山出名，据说是倪云林亲手所经营，
The Lion Grove was famous for its rockery, said to have been designed by Ni Yunlin himself.

曲折高下，诡异莫测，
Its paths twisted, rose and fell in strange, unpredictable ways.

何桂清亲自引导游览，随处指点，极其殷勤。
He personally conducted Hu through it, pointing out its features with the utmost attentiveness.

一圈逛下来，去了个把钟头，走得累了，便觉得饮食格外有味，
A circuit took about an hour and left them tired enough to find the food especially good.

吃到半饱，话才多了起来。
Only after they had eaten a fair amount did conversation become lively.

这种场合，自然不宜谈官场，谈商场则何桂清是外行，于是只好谈山水、谈风月了。
Official affairs were unsuitable for such an occasion, and He knew nothing of commerce, so they talked of scenery and romantic pleasures.

有了几分酒意的何桂清，谈兴愈豪，话也更小顾忌，
With a little wine in him, He grew more expansive and less guarded.

一谈谈到家庭，他忽然说道：“雪岩兄，我有件事，要腼颜奉托。
When they reached the subject of family, he suddenly said, “Brother Xueyan, there's something I must ask, though I'm embarrassed to do so.

内人体弱多病，性情又最贤慧，
My wife is frail and often ill, and she has the most generous disposition.

常劝我置一房妾侍，可以为她分劳，照料我的饮食起居。
She frequently urges me to take a concubine who could share her burdens and attend to my meals and daily needs.

我倒也觉得有此必要，
I do see the necessity.

只是在江苏做官，纳部民为妾，大于禁例。
But as an official serving in Jiangsu, I am strictly forbidden to take a woman under my jurisdiction as a concubine.

这一次进京，沿途得要个贴身的人照料，
On this journey to the capital, I shall need someone close to look after me.

不知道你能不能替我在上海或者在杭州，物色一个？”
Could you find a suitable woman for me in Shanghai or Hangzhou?”

“这容易得很。
“Nothing could be easier.

请云公说说看，喜欢怎样的人？”
Tell me what sort of woman you like.”

“就象阿巧姐那样的，使是上选。”何桂清脱口而答。
“Someone like A’qiao would be ideal,” He answered without thinking.


胡雪岩一愣，
Hu started.

细看一看他的脸色，不象饰词巧索，心里使好过些了，
Studying He's expression, he concluded that this did not seem to be a disguised request for A’qiao herself, and felt somewhat better.

“我知道了。”他点点头，
“I understand,” he said, nodding.

“总在云公动身以前，我必有以报命。”
“Before you leave, I shall certainly have something to report.”

“拜托，拜托！”何桂清说，
“Thank you!

“回头我先送五百两银子过来。
I'll send five hundred taels over presently.

请雪岩兄在这个数目之内替我办。”
Please arrange it within that sum.”

“用不了这么多。”胡雪岩说：
“It won't cost so much.

“云公也不必送来，
Nor need you send the money.

办成了，我跟云公一起算，
Once it's settled, we'll reckon everything together.

顺便还要讨赏。”
I'll even ask for a reward.”

“言重，言重！
“You put it too strongly.

该我谢媒。”
I ought to thank my matchmaker.”

答应是答应下来了，回到金阊栈，细想一想，要找象阿巧姐这样的人，却真还不大容易。
Hu had agreed, but back at Jinchang Inn he realized that finding another woman like A’qiao would be no easy matter.

“嗐！
“Ah!

我傻了！”
How foolish I've been!”

胡雪岩突破心头的蔽境，解决了难题，却带来怅然若失的情怀。
Breaking through the obstruction in his mind, he solved the difficulty, only to be left with a sense of loss.

何必再去寻阿巧姐这样的人？阿巧姐不就在眼前？
Why seek someone like A’qiao when A’qiao herself was already there?

然而胡雪岩这一次撒手，跟放弃阿珠的感觉不大相同，
Yet letting her go felt different from giving up A’zhu.

当时移花接木将阿珠与陈世龙之间的那条红丝联系起来，不但心安理得，而且有快心惬意之感，
When he had redirected the match, joining A’zhu's red thread of marriage to Chen Shilong's, his conscience had been clear and he had felt positively pleased.

如今要将阿巧姐送入别人的怀抱，心里却是酸溜溜的，很不好受。
Now, at the thought of sending A’qiao into another man's arms, his heart was sour with unhappiness.

因此一个人徘徊又徘徊，翻来覆去的在想，
He paced back and forth, turning the matter over repeatedly.

除此以外可还有更好的办法？
Was there no better way?


这样蚁旋磨转的一直到天快黑，
His thoughts went round and round like an ant circling a millstone until it was almost dark.

听得外面有人在喊：“胡大老爷！”
Then someone called from outside, “Mr Hu!”

声音很熟，却一时想不起是谁？
The voice was familiar, though for a moment he could not place it.

出门一看，才影绰绰的辨清楚，是周一鸣。
Going out, he dimly made out Zhou Yiming.

“中午我来伺候，胡大老爷出去了？”
“When I called at noon, you were out?”

“喔，对不起，失迎！”胡雪岩答道：
“Oh, I'm sorry to have missed you.

“何学台约我逛狮子林。”
Education Commissioner He invited me to the Lion Grove.”

“姨太太也不在？”
“And the young mistress is away too?”

“她回木渎去了。”胡雪岩又补了一句：
“She's gone home to Mudu.

“那不是小妾，
She isn't my concubine, by the way.

你的称呼用不着。”
There's no need to call her that.”

这也算是碰了一个钉子，
This was something of a rebuff.

周一鸣答不上来了，没话找话说了句：“胡大老爷怎不点灯？”
Zhou could find no answer and said, merely to fill the silence, “Why haven't you lit a lamp?”

“啊！”
“Ah!”

胡雪岩这时才醒悟，
Only now did Hu notice.

自己也觉得好笑，说了一半实话：
Amused at himself, he gave half the truth.

“我大想一件心事，想得出神了。
“I've been so absorbed in something on my mind that I forgot.

老周，我们吃酒去。”
Old Zhou, let's go for a drink.”

“是！”
“Certainly.”

周一鸣赔笑说道：
Zhou smiled ingratiatingly.

“我本来就打算做个小东，请胡大老爷喝杯酒。只怕胡大老爷不肯赏脸，不敢说。”
“I'd been hoping to act as host and offer you a cup, but I was afraid you wouldn't honour me and didn't dare suggest it.”

“笑话！
“Nonsense!

啥叫不肯赏脸？
Why wouldn't I?

你说得太客气了。”
You're far too polite.”

胡雪岩很中意周一鸣，想跟他谈谈，便很恳切的说：“我扰你的。
Hu liked him and wanted to talk, so he added earnestly, “I'll be your guest.

不过，下馆子我可不去，
But I won't go to a restaurant.

不是怕你多花饯。
It isn't that I'm afraid of making you spend too much.

第一，中午油腻吃得太多，
First, I've had too much rich food at lunch.

第二，想看看苏州的小酒店是怎么个光景，跟我们杭州有什么不同。”
Second, I'd like to see what Suzhou's little taverns are like and how they differ from Hangzhou's.”

“胡大老爷这样说，我就恭敬不如从命了。
“Then I'll do as you say.

这种专门吃酒的酒店，玄妙观前多得很，
There are plenty of places devoted to drinking in front of Xuanmiao Temple.

地方很干净，可以坐一坐。
They're clean, and we could sit awhile.”

““那好，
“Good.

我们就走吧！”
Let's go.”


胡雪岩随手套上一件马褂，关照店伙计锁了门，与周一鸣雇了一辆马车进城。
Hu slipped on an outer jacket, told an inn servant to lock his door and hired a carriage with Zhou to go into the city.

玄妙观前灯火辉煌，十分热闹，
The area before Xuanmiao Temple blazed with lights and bustled with people.

江宁失守，苏州成了全省的首善之区，
Since Jiangning had fallen, Suzhou had become the province's foremost city.

文武官员，平空添了数百，
Several hundred civil and military officials had appeared almost overnight.

大多不曾带家眷，公余无处可去，
Most had not brought their families and had nowhere to go when work was done.

多集中在玄妙观前，闲逛的闲逛，买醉的买醉，市面要到二更才罢。
They congregated here, some strolling, others drinking themselves tipsy, and the market remained busy until the second watch.

酒店家家客满，
Every tavern was full.

最后在一家字号叫“元大昌”的。找到了一副临街的座头，
At last they found seats facing the street in one called Yuandachang.

两个人坐下来，要了绍兴花雕，
They sat down and ordered Shaoxing huadiao.

随即便有两三个青布衣衫，收拾得十分干净挺括的上了年纪的妇人，挽着篮来卖下酒的卤菜。
Two or three older women, neatly and cleanly dressed in blue cotton, promptly approached with baskets of braised snacks to accompany the wine.

那些鸭头和鸭翅膀，看样子很不坏，但味道不怎么样，
The duck heads and wings looked good enough, though their flavour was unremarkable.

好在胡雪岩旨在领略苏州酒店的情趣，不在口腹，倒也不甚介意。
But Hu had come to savour the atmosphere of a Suzhou tavern, not its food, and did not much mind.

等坐定了，吃过一巡酒，他放眼四顾，开始观察，
Once settled, after their first round of wine, he looked about him and began to observe.

苏州本地人雍容揖让，文文气气，一望而知，
Suzhou natives were easily recognized by their composed manners, courteous deference and scholarly air.

他们问壁一桌就是，两个都是白须老者，但一口道地的苏州话，却是其软无比，
The two men at the next table were examples: both white-bearded, both speaking the local dialect in wonderfully soft voices.

只听他们高谈阔论，也是一种乐趣。
Merely listening to their animated conversation was a pleasure.

四外烽火连天，这“元大昌”中却是酒温语软，充满了逸兴闲情，
War blazed on every side, yet Yuandachang was full of warm wine, gentle voices and leisurely enjoyment.

隔座那两位白须老者，谈的是嘉庆年问的旧话，谈砚台、谈宜兴的“供春壶”、谈竹雕，都是太平盛世、文人墨客的雅玩。
The two old men were recalling the Jiaqing years, discussing inkstones, Yixing Gongchun teapots and bamboo carvings—the elegant playthings of scholars in a peaceful, prosperous age.


“人生在世，为什么？”胡雪岩忽生感慨，
“What is a man alive for?” Hu asked, suddenly moved.

“就是吃吃喝喝过一生？”
“Simply to eat and drink his way through life?”

这句话问得周一鸣直着眼好愣，
Zhou stared blankly.

不但不能回答，甚至也无从了解他的意思。
He could not answer; he could scarcely even understand the question.

“我是说，象隔壁那两位老太爷，”胡雪岩放低了声音说：
“I mean people like those two old gentlemen,” Hu explained, lowering his voice.

“大概是靠收租过日子的乡绅。
“They're probably country gentry living on rents.

这样的人家，我们杭州也很多，
We have plenty of such families in Hangzhou.

祖上做过官，挣下一批田地，
An ancestor held office and acquired some land.

如果不是出了个败家精，安分度日，总有一两代好吃。
Unless a spendthrift appears, quiet living leaves enough to feed a generation or two.

本身也总有个把功名，
The men themselves generally have some examination standing.

好一点是进过学的秀才，不然就是二三十两银子捐来的监生，
The better ones are licentiates admitted to the schools; otherwise they've paid twenty or thirty taels for the status of an Imperial Academy student.

也算场面上的人物。
They count as people of standing too.

一年到头无事忙，白天孵茶馆，晚上‘摆一碗’，
All year round they're busy doing nothing: they sit in teahouses by day and have a bowl of wine at night.

逍遥自在到六七十岁，一口气不来，回老家见阎王，
They drift pleasantly on until sixty or seventy, then stop breathing and go home to meet the King of Hell.

说是我阳世里走过一遭了。
‘I've had my turn in the world of the living,’ they say.

问他阳世里做点啥？啥也不做！
Ask what they did there, and the answer is nothing!

象这样的人，做鬼都没有意思。
Even being a ghost would be meaningless for someone like that.”

“这番不知是自嘲，还是调侃他人的话，周一鸣倒是听懂了，
Whether he was mocking himself or teasing others was unclear, but Zhou understood this much.

此人也算是有志向的人，所以对胡雪岩的话，颇有同感，
He too had ambitions and felt considerable sympathy.

“是阿！”他说，
“Quite so.

“人生在世，总要做一番事业，才对得起父母。”
A man should accomplish something in his lifetime, if only to do right by his parents.”


有这句话，胡雪岩觉得可以跟他谈谈了，
At that, Hu felt they could talk.

“老周，”他问，“听说你在水师，也是蛮有名的人物。”
“Old Zhou, I hear you were quite a figure in the navy.”

“名是谈不到，人缘是不错。”
“I wouldn't say I had a name, but I got on well with people.”

周一鸣喝了口酒，满腹牢骚地说，
Zhou took a drink and poured out his grievance.

“从前船户都叫我‘老总’，见了客气得很，
“Boatmen used to call me ‘Officer’ and treat me with great respect.

现在都叫我老周，啥跑腿的事都要干。
Now it's ‘Old Zhou’, and I have to run every kind of errand.

想想真不是味道。”
It leaves a bitter taste.”

“你的意思，仍旧想回水师？”
“You'd like to return to the navy, then?”

“想也不行！”
“Wishing won't help.”

周一鸣摇摇头，
He shook his head.

“从前我那个长官，现在官更大了，
“My old commanding officer has risen higher still.

听了他娘的小舅子的话，把我恨得要死。
He listened to that damned brother-in-law of his and hates me like poison.

要想再回去补个名字，除非移名改姓，从小兵干起，
The only way to get back on the rolls would be to change my name and start again as a common soldier.

那要干到什么时候才得出头？
How long would it take to get anywhere?

想想只好算了。”
I can only give it up.”

“果真你要回去，我倒可以帮你的忙。”胡雪岩说，
“If you really want to go back, I could help.

“想来水师管带，官也不会大到哪里去，
A naval commander can hardly be so very high an official.

我替你请何学台写封信，你看怎么样？”
What if I asked Education Commissioner He to write a letter for you?”

“求得到何学台的信，我又不必回原地方了，
“With a letter from him, I wouldn't have to return to my old place.

何学台跟江苏巡抚许大人是同年，
He and Governor Xu of Jiangsu passed the metropolitan examination in the same year.

有何学台的信，我投到‘抚标’去当差，
I could enter the troops under the governor's direct command.

比原来的差使好得多。”
That would be far better than my old post.”

“那好！”胡雪岩说，
“Very well.

“这上头我不大懂。
I don't know much about these things.

明天我带你去见何学台，你当面跟他说。”
Tomorrow I'll take you to see the commissioner, and you can tell him yourself.”

听得这话，再想到何桂清对胡雪岩的客气，料知他们交情极深，事必有济，
Remembering how courteously He had treated Hu, Zhou concluded that they must be close friends and that success was assured.

所以他极其兴奋，连连道谢，应酬得格外殷勤了。
He was intensely excited, thanked Hu repeatedly and became still more attentive as host.


酒吃到六分，胡雪岩不想再喝，
When Hu had reached a comfortable degree of tipsiness, he wanted no more wine.

叫了两碗“双浇面”，一碗是焖得稀烂的大肉面，一碗是熏鱼面，
They ordered two bowls of noodles with a double topping between them: one came with pork braised until meltingly tender, the other with smoked fish.

两下对换，有鱼有肉，
By exchanging toppings, they each had fish and meat.

吃得酒醉饭饱，花不到五钱银子，
They ate and drank to their hearts' content for less than half a tael.

胡雪岩深为满意。
Hu was thoroughly pleased.

“钱不在多，只要会用。”他说，
“It isn't how much money you have, but how you use it.

“吃得象今天这么舒服的日子，我还不多。”
I've seldom enjoyed a meal as much as this.”

“这是因为胡大老爷晓得我做东，没有好东西吃，
“That's because you knew I was treating you and expected nothing fine.

心里先就有打算了，所以说好。”
You'd prepared yourself, so it seems good.”

“这就叫‘知足常乐’。”胡雪岩说，
“That's what they mean by ‘contentment brings lasting happiness’.

“凡事能够退一步想，就没有烦恼了。”
If you can step back a little in your thinking, there's nothing to trouble you.”

这天晚上他再想阿巧姐的去留，就是持着这种态度，
That night, he approached the question of letting A’qiao go in this same spirit.

譬如不曾遇见她，
Suppose he had never met her.

譬如她香消玉殒了，
Suppose she had died.

譬如她为豪客所夺，
Suppose some powerful patron had taken her from him.

这样每自譬一次，便将阿巧姐看得谈了些，
Each such reflection loosened his attachment a little.

最后终于下了决心，
At last he made up his mind.

自己说一声：“君子成人之美！”
“A gentleman helps others attain their happiness,” he told himself.

然后叹口气，蒙头大睡。
Then he sighed, pulled the quilt over his head and went to sleep.


第二天一早起身，周一鸣已经在等着了，
When he rose early the next morning, Zhou was already waiting.

临时客串听差，替他奔走招呼，所以阿巧姐虽不在身边，胡雪岩亦觉得并无不便。
Acting as a temporary servant, he ran about attending to Hu's needs, so that even without A’qiao Hu felt no inconvenience.

同时心里在想，自己一向为求使捷爽利，不喜欢带个听差在身边，
He had always preferred travelling without a servant for the sake of freedom and efficiency.

看来若有象同一鸣这样的人，带在身边，亦自不妨，
But a man like Zhou might be useful to have beside him.

这一趟回去，或在杭州，或在上海，倒要好好物色一个。
On his return, whether in Hangzhou or Shanghai, he ought to look carefully for someone suitable.

等他漱洗完毕，周一鸣又要请他进城去喝早茶。
After Hu had washed, Zhou invited him into the city for morning tea.

胡雪岩心里有数，便连声答道：
Understanding what was on his mind, Hu readily agreed.

“好的，好的！
“Yes, yes.

吃完早茶，我带你去见何学台，当面求他替你写信。”
Afterwards, I'll take you to the commissioner and ask him in person for a letter.”

于是进了城在“吴苑”茶店吃早茶。
They went to the Wuyuan teahouse.

苏州的茶店跟杭州的又不同，
Suzhou teahouses differed from Hangzhou's.

杭州的茶店，大都是敞厅，一视同仁，
In Hangzhou, most had open halls and treated everyone alike.

不管是缙绅先生，还是贩夫走卒，入座都是顾客，
Gentry, pedlars and labourers were all customers once seated.

苏州的茶店，分出等级，各不相淆，
In Suzhou, the different classes were separated and did not mingle.

胡雪岩好热闹，与周一鸣只在最外面那间厅上坐，一面喝茶，一面吃各式各样的点心，消磨到十点钟，
Hu enjoyed a crowd, so he and Zhou sat in the outermost hall, drinking tea and sampling the various pastries until ten.

看看是时候了，算了帐，安步当车到苏州府学去见何桂清。
Judging the time right, they paid and strolled to the prefectural school to see He Guiqing.

由于爱屋及乌的缘故，何桂清对周一鸣也很客气，再三让坐，
Out of regard for Hu, He treated Zhou courteously too, repeatedly asking him to sit.

周一鸣守着官场的规矩，只是垂手肃立，
Zhou observed official etiquette, standing respectfully with his hands at his sides.

最后却不过意，才屁股沾着椅子边，仿佛蹲着似地坐了下来。
At last he could not refuse and perched on the edge of a chair as though squatting.

看他这局促的光景，胡雪岩倒觉得于心不忍，便要言不烦他说明来意，
Hu felt sorry for his discomfort and explained their purpose briefly.

何桂清当时答道：“许大人亲自到上海督师去了。”
“Governor Xu has gone to Shanghai to direct the troops in person,” He replied.

接着转脸问胡雪岩：
Then he turned to Hu.

“现在倒有个好机会，
“There is a good opening at present, though.

是去收税，
It's tax collection.

不知道这位周君愿意不愿意屈就。”
I wonder whether Mr Zhou would consider it beneath him.”

“屈就这两个字言重了。
“You flatter him.

不知是哪一处税卡？”
At which tax station?”

“现在新创一种‘厘金’，你总晓得。”
“You've heard of the new levy called lijin?”

“这听说过。”胡雪岩答道，“到底怎么回事，却还不十分清楚。”
“I've heard of it, but I don't yet know exactly how it works.”


“是你们浙江的一个奇士的策划。
“It was devised by a remarkable man from your own Zhejiang.

此人算来是雪轩的部民，湖州府长兴人，
Indeed, he comes from Xuexuan's jurisdiction: Changxing County in Huzhou Prefecture.

名叫钱江……”
His name is Qian Jiang.”

钱江字东平，是浙江长兴的一名监生，
Qian Jiang, courtesy name Dongping, was an Imperial Academy student from Changxing.

好大言，多奇计，仿佛战国的策士一流人物。
Fond of bold talk and ingenious schemes, he resembled the wandering strategists of the Warring States.

鸦片战争一起，协办大学士吏部尚书，宗室奕经，奉旨以“杨威将军”的名义，到浙江督办军务，
When the Opium War began, Yijing, an imperial clansman who was assistant grand secretary and president of the Board of Civil Appointments, received orders to direct military affairs in Zhejiang as General Who Spreads Awe.

钱江叩辕献计，招募壮士，奇袭英军，擒其首脑。
Qian presented himself at his headquarters with a plan: recruit brave men, surprise the British and capture their leaders.

畏葸的奕经，如何敢用这样的奇计？敬谢不敏。
Timid Yijing dared not attempt such an extraordinary scheme and politely declined.

后来林则徐得罪遣戍，
Later, Lin Zexu fell into disgrace and was sent into exile.

而钱江在广州主张拒英，亦充军到伊犁，
Qian, having advocated resistance to the British in Guangzhou, was likewise sentenced to military exile in Ili.

在戍所相遇，林则徐对他深为赏识。
They met there, and Lin greatly admired him.

当林则徐遇赦进关时，设法将他洗脱了罪，带入关内，
When Lin was pardoned and allowed to return within the passes, he arranged to clear Qian's conviction and brought him back.

在京城里为他揄扬于公卿之间，声名鹊起，
In the capital, Lin praised him among the high officials, and his reputation rapidly grew.

不幸地，林则徐不久病殁，钱江顿失凭依，
Unfortunately, Lin died not long afterwards, leaving Qian without support.

于是挟策游于江淮之间，
He then travelled with his schemes through the country between the Yangtze and Huai rivers.

在扬州遇到了雷以诚。献上两策，
In Yangzhou, he met Lei Yixian and proposed two measures.

第一策是预领空白捐照，随时填发，
The first was to obtain blank certificates for purchased ranks in advance, to be filled in and issued on the spot.

第二策就是开办厘金。
The second was to introduce lijin.


穷了想富，富了想贵，人之常情，
The poor long to be rich, and the rich to be honoured: that is human nature.

所以做生意发了财的，尤其是两淮的那班盐商，最喜欢捐官，
Merchants who had made fortunes, particularly the salt merchants of the Two Huai districts, were therefore especially fond of purchasing official rank.

捐到三品道员还觉得戴蓝顶子不够威风，
Even after contributing enough to become third-rank circuit intendants, they felt a blue finial insufficiently imposing.

总想找机会，如报效军需，捐助河工，花大把银子买个“特保”，
They were always seeking opportunities—funding military supplies, for instance, or contributing to river works—to spend large sums on a special recommendation.

弄个二品顶戴的红顶子才肯罢休。
Only a second-rank red finial would satisfy them.

但是捐官的手续甚为繁复，
Yet buying rank involved complicated procedures.

吏部书办的花样百出，
Clerks at the Board of Civil Appointments had endless tricks.

往往“上兑”一两年，一张证明几品官员身分的“部照”还拿不到，
A man might remit his payment and still wait a year or two for the board's certificate establishing his rank.

这一来自然影响捐官的兴趣。
Naturally, this diminished enthusiasm.

钱江的办法就是专为想过官瘾的富商打算，一手交钱，一手交货，
Qian's scheme catered precisely to wealthy merchants eager to taste official distinction: money in one hand, goods in the other.

上了兑，立刻填发部照，
As soon as payment was made, the certificate would be completed and issued.

爽快无比。
Nothing could be more straightforward.

雷以諴认为此策极妙，便托钱江上了个奏折，细陈其事，
Lei thought the proposal excellent and had Qian submit a memorial setting it out in detail.

照他的办法，部里的书办就没有好处了，所以起初部议不准。
Since the scheme would deprive the board's clerks of their profits, the board initially rejected it.

无奈国库空虚，
But the treasury was empty.

乾嘉年间积下的上千万银子，从道光年间鸦片战争以来，以奕经、耆英、琦善以及赛尚阿等总领师干的钦差大臣，花得光光，
The more than ten million taels accumulated under Qianlong and Jiaqing had been exhausted since the Opium War in the Daoguang reign by imperial commissioners commanding armies—Yijing, Qiying, Qishan, Saishang’a and others.

现在朝廷为对付洪杨起义，“既要马儿好，又要马儿不吃草”，
Now, in confronting the uprising of Hong and Yang, the court wanted a good horse without having to feed it.

如果马儿自己觅草去吃，犹复不准，如何说得过去？
If it forbade the horse even to find its own fodder, how could that be justified?

因此，钱江的妙策，到底被批准了。
Qian's ingenious proposal was therefore approved at last.

部里领来大批的空白捐照，
Large quantities of blank certificates arrived from the board.

现款交易，而且没有层出不穷的小费，
Transactions were immediate and required none of the endless incidental fees.

既快又便宜，捐官的人，自然趋之若鹜。
Quicker and cheaper, the new arrangement naturally drew crowds of buyers.

雷以諴就靠了这笔收入，招募乡勇，才得扼守扬州、镇江一带。
With this revenue, Lei recruited local volunteers and was able to hold the Yangzhou–Zhenjiang area.

然而捐官只是一趟头的买卖，
But each sale of rank brought payment only once.

细水长流，还得另想别法，
A continuing stream required another source.

于是而有厘金。
Hence lijin.


清朝的行商税，本来只有关税一种。
Previously, the Qing had imposed only customs duties on travelling merchants.

大宗税收是钱粮地丁，因为失地太多而收额大减，
Its principal tax revenue came from the land and poll levy, but so much territory had been lost that receipts had fallen sharply.

两淮的盐税，亦因为兵火的影响，销场不旺，
War had also depressed sales in the Two Huai salt market and reduced its tax yield.

弥补之道，就靠厘金，一钱抽一厘，
Lijin was to make up the shortfall: one li collected on every qian.

看起来税额甚轻，但积少成多，为数可观。
The rate appeared slight, but small sums accumulated into a considerable amount.

最先是由雷以諴在扬州仙女庙、邵伯镇等运河码头，设卡试办，
Lei first tried it at canal wharves such as Xiannümiao and Shaobo near Yangzhou.

成效不坏，
The results were good.

朝廷因而正式降旨，命两江总督怡良、江苏巡抚许乃钊、漕运总督杨以增，在江南、江北各地试行捐厘助饷，以裕军需。
The court then formally ordered Yiliang, Governor-General of Liangjiang, Xu Naizhao, Governor of Jiangsu, and Yang Yizeng, Director-General of Grain Transport, to introduce contributions of lijin for military funds in various places north and south of the Yangtze.

听罢何桂清的陈述，胡雪岩对钱江其人，深为仰慕，颇想一见，
After hearing He's account, Hu greatly admired Qian and longed to meet him.

但这是一时办不到的事，只好丢开，先替周一鸣作打算。
That was impossible for the moment, however, so he set the thought aside and returned to Zhou's prospects.

“他是水师出身，运河、长江各码头，都是熟人。
“He served in the navy and knows people at wharves all along the canal and the Yangtze.

若得云公栽培，当差决不致误事，坍云公的台。”
If you give him this opportunity, he certainly won't neglect his duties or let you down.”

“我知道，我知道，
“I know.

看周君也是很能干的人，而况又是你的举荐，一定赏识不虚。”何桂清说，
Mr Zhou looks very capable, and with your recommendation I'm sure your confidence is justified.

“我马上写信，
I'll write at once.

请坐一坐！”
Please sit awhile.”

说罢，他退入书房，亲笔写了一封信。
He withdrew to his study and wrote the letter himself.

何洼清虽未做到封疆大吏，督抚的派头已经很足，
Though not yet a provincial ruler, he already had all the manner of a governor or governor-general.

两张八行笺，写着胡桃大的字，
His characters, as large as walnuts, filled two sheets of eight-line letter paper.

按科名先后，称雷以諴为“前辈”。
In keeping with the order of their examination success, he addressed Lei as his senior.

胡雪岩接了信代周一鸣道谢，周一鸣自己则叩头相谢。
Hu received the letter and thanked He for Zhou, who himself expressed his gratitude by kowtowing.


“你先回去吧！”胡雪岩对周一鸣说，
“Go back first,” Hu told Zhou.

“我还要陪何大人谈谈。”
“I'll stay and talk with His Excellency.”

等周一鸣一走，何桂清告诉胡雪岩一个消息，说江苏巡抚许乃钊有调动的消息，
Once Zhou had left, He told Hu that Xu Naizhao might be transferred from the governorship of Jiangsu.

“今天一早，接到京里的密信。”他说，
“A confidential letter from the capital arrived early this morning.

“我想等一等再说。”
I think I shall wait and see.”

许乃钊调动，何以他要等候？
Why should Xu's transfer make him wait?

细想一想，胡雪岩明白了，必是何桂清有接此任的可能，不妨静以观变。
After a moment, Hu understood: He must have a chance of succeeding him and wanted to observe developments.

这个主意的变化，胡雪岩觉得对自己这方面大为不利，
This change of plan would be decidedly unfavourable to Hu's side.

因而颇想劝他仍照原来的计划，先活动调任仓场侍郎，然后放到浙江去当巡抚，
He wanted to urge He to keep to the original course: first arrange a transfer as granary vice-minister, then seek appointment as governor of Zhejiang.

那一来，对王有龄，对自己，对嵇鹤龄便有左右逢源、诸事顺手之乐了。
That would make everything convenient for Wang Youling, Ji Heling and Hu himself, with helpful connections on every side.

暗中的猜测，不便明劝，
But he could not openly argue against something he had only guessed.

万一猜得不对，变成无的放矢，是件可笑的事，叫何桂清看轻了自己，
If the guess was wrong, he would be shooting at no target and make himself ridiculous in He's eyes.

而且凡事明说不如暗示，旁敲侧击的效果最好，这是胡雪岩所深知的。
Besides, Hu knew that hints and indirect approaches worked better than plain statements.

于是略想一想，有了一套说词。
After a little thought, he found his line of argument.

“江苏巡抚这个缺，从前是天下第一，现在，我看是最末等的了。”他忽然发了这样一段议论。
“The governorship of Jiangsu used to be the finest post in the empire,” he suddenly remarked. “Now I should call it the very worst.”

何桂清当然要注意，
He naturally paid attention.

“苏抚的缺分，不如以前是真的，”他说，“但亦不至于沧为末等。”
“It's true that the post is no longer what it was, but hardly that it has fallen to the bottom.”

“我是瞎说说的，跟云公请教。”
“I'm only talking at random and seeking your advice.”

胡雪岩徐徐而言，想着末等的理由，想到一条说一条：
Speaking slowly, Hu thought of reasons one at a time and offered them as they came.

“第一是大乱在江苏，
“First, the worst disorder is in Jiangsu.

地方少了，钱粮也就少了。”
Less territory means less tax revenue.”


“还好，
“Not so bad.

苏松膏腴之地，还在我们手里。”
We still hold the fertile Suzhou–Songjiang country.”

胡雪岩不便说苏松难保，
Hu could hardly say that even Suzhou and Songjiang might be lost.

“要保住，也很吃力，
“Holding it is hard enough.

刘丽川至今还在上海。
Liu Lichuan is still in Shanghai.

这且不去说它，
But leave that aside.

第二，江苏的官太多。“他说，”
Second, Jiangsu has too many officials.

浙江好的是巡抚独尊！
The advantage of Zhejiang is that the governor stands supreme.”

““啊！”
“Ah!”

何桂清深深点头，
He nodded deeply.

“你这话有道理，
“There's sense in that.

督抚同城，确是麻烦，
A governor and governor-general in the same city are indeed troublesome.

不是东风压倒西风，就是西风压倒东风。”
Either the east wind overcomes the west or the west overcomes the east.”

“巡抚要压倒总督，怕不大容易，
“It can hardly be easy for a governor to overcome a governor-general.

这也不去说它，
But leave that aside too.

第三，”胡雪岩又说：“江南大营的向大人，听说很难伺候。
Third, I've heard that General Xiang at the Jiangnan Grand Camp is difficult to serve.

云公，有这话没有？”
Is that true?”

这话当然有的。
Of course it was.

何桂清心想，江南大营的骄兵悍将，不知凡几，向茶的难侍候，犹其余事。
He reflected that the camp was full of arrogant troops and unruly commanders; Xiang Rong's difficult temper was the least of it.

于是本来想在江苏等机会，打算着能接许乃钊的遗缺的心思动摇了。
His intention of waiting in Jiangsu for a chance to succeed Xu began to waver.

看他默然不语，胡雪岩猜到了他的心思，益发动以危言：
Seeing him silent, Hu guessed what he was thinking and pressed him with a further warning.

“地方官要与城共存亡。
“A local official must live or die with his city.

我替我们杭州同乡许大人说句私话，如果能够调动一个缺，真正是‘塞翁失马，焉知非福’了。”
Speaking privately on behalf of Governor Xu, my fellow native of Hangzhou, if he could be transferred elsewhere, it might truly be a case of the frontier old man's lost horse proving a blessing in disguise.”

这句话才真的打动了何桂清，
This struck home.

他最胆小，
He was extremely timid.

虽然纸上谈兵，豪气万丈，其实最怕打仗。
However boldly he discussed warfare on paper, he was terrified of actual fighting.

看起来，江苏真的成了末等的缺，
Jiangsu did seem to have become the worst of posts.

何必自讨苦吃，
Why seek trouble?

还是进京去吧！
Better go to the capital after all.

主意打定了，却不便明说，
Having decided, he could not say so openly.

只连连点头：
He merely nodded repeatedly.

“高论极是，
“Your argument is entirely right.

佩服之至。”
I admire your insight.”


“我哪里懂什么，
“What do I know?

不过俗语道得好：”旁观者清。
But as the saying goes, a bystander sees clearly.

‘不在其位，不关得失，看事情比较清楚。
Without holding the post or having a personal stake in its gains and losses, one can see more plainly.”

““说得一点不错。”何桂清答道：
“Quite true.

“我就正要老兄这样的人，多多指点。”
I need more guidance from men like you.”

“云公这话说得太过分，真叫我脸红。”
“You flatter me so much that you make me blush.”

他趁势站了起来，
Hu took the opportunity to rise.

“我就此告辞了，顺便跟云公辞行。”
“I must leave now, and take my leave of you before my journey as well.”

“怎么？”
“What?”

何桂清顿现怅然之色，
He looked disappointed at once.

“你就这样走了？”
“Are you going already?”

“是的，
“Yes.

我预备明天一早动身回上海。”
I mean to return to Shanghai early tomorrow.”

“那么……”
“Then...”

何桂清沉吟了好半晌说：
He considered for a long while.

“我们上海见面吧！
“We'll meet in Shanghai.

那不会太久的。”
It won't be very long.”

“是！
“Certainly.

我一回上海就把款子预备好，随时等云公的招呼。”
As soon as I'm back, I'll have the money ready and wait for your instructions.”

“还有件事，
“There is also that other matter.

无论如何，奉托费心。”
I must ask you, whatever happens, to give it your attention.”

胡雪岩一愣，随即会意，
Hu was momentarily puzzled, then understood.

事实上此事已成功了一半，所以很有把握他说：
In fact, half the work was already done, and he could answer confidently.

“云公请放心，
“Don't worry.

一到上海，必有喜信。”
Once I reach Shanghai, I shall have good news.”

何桂清自然高兴。而过分的欣悦，反生感慨，
He was naturally delighted, and his excessive pleasure turned reflective.

“真想不到，这一次无端与雪岩兄结成知交。”他摇摇头说，
“To think that this visit should unexpectedly have made such close friends of us!

“人生在世，都是一个缘字，
Life is all a matter of affinity.

想想真是不可思议。”
It's truly beyond understanding.”

胡雪岩跟他的境遇，约略相似，
Hu's circumstances resembled his in some degree.

再加上王有龄，三个人天南地北，不知冥冥中是什么力量的驱使？得能聚在一起，
With Wang Youling, they were three men from distant corners of the country, brought together by some unseen force.

象七巧板一样，看似毫不相干，居然拼出一副花样，
Like the pieces of a tangram, apparently unrelated, they had combined into a pattern.

实在巧妙之至。所以对他的话，深具同感。
It was wonderfully ingenious, and Hu felt deep sympathy with He's words.

“云公，说到缘字，还有让你想不到的事。”他紧接着又说，
“Speaking of affinity, there's something else that will surprise you.

“眼前我不说破，说破了不好玩了。
I won't reveal it yet; that would spoil the pleasure.

只盼你早则节前，晚则节后，到了上海，
I only hope you'll reach Shanghai before the festival if possible, and shortly after if not.

我们再叙。”
Then we'll talk again.”

听他如此说法，何桂清便不肯多问，只说：
Hearing this, He would not press.

“好，好！
“Very well.

我们再叙。
We'll talk then.

良晤非遥，我就不送你了。”
Our next meeting is not far off, so I won't see you off on your journey.”

“不敢当，
“You needn't trouble yourself.

我也就不再来辞行了。”
Nor shall I call again to take leave.”

他站起身作揖。
Hu rose and bowed.


“你请等一等。”何桂清说完，
“Wait a moment.”

匆匆又走入书斋，好久，都不见再露面。
He hurried back into his study and did not reappear for some time.

他是亲笔在写名帖，
He was writing on visiting cards himself.

写信来不及了，只好用名帖，一共七、八张，从苏州到上海，沿路掌管一方的文武官员，都有他的名帖致意，
There was no time for letters, so he used seven or eight cards, one for each of the civil and military officials controlling the districts along the route from Suzhou to Shanghai.

致意是门面话，其实是为胡雪岩作先容。
Ostensibly, they conveyed his regards; in reality, they introduced Hu.

“你备而不用吧！”何桂清把一叠名帖交了过去，
“Keep these in reserve,” he said, handing over the little stack.

“交情深浅，都在措词上看得出来，
“The wording will tell you how close I am to each man.

该用不该用，怎么用法？你自己斟酌。”
Judge for yourself which to use, whether to use them and how.”

“有云公这几张名帖，就等于派了百把兵保护，
“These cards are as good as sending a hundred soldiers to protect me.

一路上可以睡到上海，
I can sleep all the way to Shanghai.

多谢，多谢！”
Thank you!”

“雪轩那里，我另外复信，
“I'll answer Xuexuan separately.

这里跟浙江，每天都有驿差，方便得很。
Couriers travel between here and Zhejiang every day, so it's easy enough.

我就不必麻烦你转信了。”
I needn't trouble you to carry the letter.”

何桂清一面说，一面亲自送客，
As he spoke, He accompanied his guest out.

体制所关，送到二门为止。
Official propriety allowed him to go no farther than the second gate.

等胡雪岩回到客栈，他跟着又派人送了四样路菜，一部他新刻的诗槁，另外一个沉甸甸的小木箱，
After Hu returned to the inn, He sent four dishes for the journey, a copy of his newly printed poems and a small, heavy wooden box.

打开来一看，是一只“汽锅”。
On opening it, Hu found a steam pot.

“难为你家大人想到。”
“How thoughtful of your master!”

“我家大人交代，”那个叫何福的听差说：“胡大老爷的交情，与众不同，
“My master said,” replied the attendant He Fu, “that his friendship with you is unlike any other.

叫我跟胡大老爷请示，
He told me to ask whether you need anything.

若还有事，我就在这里侍候胡大老爷上了船再回去。
If so, I'm to stay and attend to you until you've boarded your boat.”

““不必，不必！
“No need.

我有人，
I have someone.

你请回去吧，替我道谢。”
Please go back and thank him for me.”

说完，在阿巧姐的梳头匣里取了个红封套，
From A’qiao's dressing case, Hu took a red envelope.

红封套甚多，备着赏人用的，轻重不等，
There were many there, prepared for tips of varying amounts.

最重的是五两一张银票，
The largest contained a five-tael banknote.

给何福的就是这一种。
He gave He Fu one of these.


这一下，胡雪岩就只有一件事了，等阿巧姐回来。
Now Hu had only one thing left to do: wait for A’qiao.

原说午间可到，结果等到日落西山，不见芳踪，
She had said she would arrive at noon, but the sun sank without any sign of her.

反倒是周一鸣又来相伴了。
Instead, Zhou returned to keep him company.

“胡大老爷，真是多亏你栽培。
“Mr Hu, I owe you so much for helping me.

我去请教过人了，说何大人这封八行的力量很够，
I've consulted someone who says His Excellency's letter carries great weight.

一定会得个好差使。”
I'm certain to get a good post.”

他笑嘻嘻地说。
He was smiling broadly.

“那很好！”
“Excellent!”

胡雪岩也替他高兴，
Hu was pleased for him.

“你得赶快到扬州才好。
“You ought to get to Yangzhou quickly.

迟了就没有好差使了。”
Wait too long, and the good posts will be gone.”

“不碍。
“Never fear.

沿运河、长江两岸都要设卡子，
There'll be stations all along the canal and both banks of the Yangtze.

差使多得很，抢不光的。
There are too many posts for others to snap them all up.

我伺候了胡大老爷回上海，再到扬州，
I'll see you back to Shanghai first, then go to Yangzhou.

最多耽误十天的工夫，
It'll delay me ten days at most.

不要紧。”
That's nothing.”

看他意思甚诚，而且路上也还要他招呼，胡雪岩就点点头不再多说了。
He was clearly sincere, and Hu would still need his help on the journey, so he nodded and said no more.

于是又闲谈了一会，
They talked for a while.

同一鸣看胡雪岩有点心神不定的模样，但有些踌躇，
Seeing Hu restless, Zhou hesitated.

再坐下去，怕惹他的厌，如果告辞，丢下他一个人在客栈，更为不妥，
Staying might annoy him, but leaving him alone at the inn would be worse.

想了想又劝他出去喝酒散心。
After considering, he suggested going out for a drink to take his mind off things.

“谢谢，今天不行了。
“Thank you, but not today.

我得等人。”
I'm waiting for someone.”

“喔，”周一鸣知道他心神不定的由来了，“是等阿巧姐？”
“Oh—A’qiao?” Now Zhou understood his uneasiness.

“是啊！
“Yes.

她回木渎娘家去，说了中午回来的，
She went to her parents' home in Mudu and promised to return at noon.

至今人面不见，
There's still no sign of her.

不知是怎么回事？”
I don't know what's happened.”

“此刻不来，今天不会回来了。
“If she isn't here now, she won't be back today.

木渎的航船，早就到了。”
The regular passenger boat from Mudu arrived long ago.”

“不是搭的航船，
“She didn't take the regular boat.

自己雇了一只船来回。”
She hired one for the return journey.”

“那这样，”周一鸣站起身来，“我到阎门码头上去打听打听看。”
“Then I'll inquire at the Chang Gate wharves.” Zhou stood up.

“不晓得是哪一条船，怎么打听？”
“How can you inquire when we don't know which boat?”

“不要紧！
“Never mind.

我到那里，一问便知。”
Once I'm there, a question will tell me.”

“对了！
“Of course!

你码头上最熟。”胡雪岩欣然答道，
You know everyone at the wharves.

“那就拜托了。”
Thank you.”


等周一鸣走不多时，忽然有个十五六岁的小后生，由金阊栈的店伙领了来见胡雪岩，
Not long after Zhou left, an inn servant brought in a boy of fifteen or sixteen.

自道他是潘家跑上房的书僮，
He said he was a young attendant who carried messages to the inner quarters of the Pan household.

奉了他家姨太太之命，
Their mistress had sent him.

“请胡老爷过去，
“Please come over, Mr Hu.

有位堂客，要见胡老爷。”
A lady would like to see you.”

又是姨太太，又是堂客，当着店伙在那里，胡雪岩倒有些尴尬，
All this talk of mistresses and ladies, with the inn servant listening, embarrassed Hu.

怕引起误会，传出谣言去，总是烦恼，
It might cause misunderstandings and gossip—always a nuisance.

所以不跟那小后生答话，只向店伙说道：
Instead of answering the boy, he addressed the servant.

“你们这里，另外有位胡老爷吧？
“There's another Mr Hu staying here, isn't there?

他弄错了！”
He has the wrong man.”

“不错！”店伙答道，
“No mistake, sir.

“他说了胡大老爷的官印，上雪下岩，
He gave your name, Xueyan.

我才领了来了。”
That's why I brought him in.”

“那就奇怪了。”
“How strange.”

胡雪岩对那小后生说，
Hu turned to the boy.

“苏州我没有姓潘的朋友，更不认得你家姨太太。”
“I have no friend in Suzhou called Pan, and I certainly don't know your mistress.”

“原是木渎来的那位堂客要见胡老爷。”小后生说，
“It's the lady from Mudu who wants to see you.

“那位堂客是我们姨太太的要好姐妹。”
She's a close friend of our mistress.”

“原来是阿巧姐！”
“So it's A’qiao!”

胡雪岩大惑不解，
Hu was utterly puzzled.

“怎么不回客栈，到了你家？”
“Why did she go to your house instead of coming back to the inn?”

“那就不清楚了。
“I don't know.

只说请胡老爷过去见面。”
She only said to ask you to come and see her.”

胡雪岩为难了。
Hu was in a quandary.

素昧平生，应人家内眷的邀请，这算是怎么回来？
How could he accept an invitation from the womenfolk of a complete stranger?

同时阿巧姐有何理由到了潘家？而又叫自己去相会？
Why had A’qiao gone to the Pans', and why was she asking him to meet her there?

凡此都是疑窦。
Everything raised doubts.

以不去为妙。
Better not go.


话虽如此，事情却要弄清楚，
Even so, he must find out what had happened.

真假之间，首先要问阿巧姐，
To establish whether the story was true, the first thing was to ask about A’qiao.

“那位木渎来的堂客，你看见了没有？”他问。
“Have you seen this lady from Mudu?”

“见了的。”
“Yes.”

“是怎么个样子？”
“What does she look like?”

那小后生把阿巧姐的身材、容貌、服饰形容了一遍，果然不错。
The boy described her figure, features and clothes correctly.

阿巧姐在潘家这话，看来不假。
It seemed true, then, that A’qiao was at the Pan house.

有了这个了解，事情就好办了，
With that established, the next step was easy.

“好的，
“Very well.

你到外面等一下。或者去逛一逛再来，
Wait outside, or go for a walk and come back.

我要等个人回来见了面，才能跟你去。”
I must see someone I'm expecting before I can go with you.”

说着，胡雪岩随手在茶几上抓了些零钱给他，
Hu took some small change from the tea table and gave it to him.

“你去买糖吃！”
“Go and buy yourself some sweets.”

“谢谢胡老爷！”小后生问道，
“Thank you, Mr Hu.

“我歇多少时候再来？”
When should I come back?”

“歇半个时辰。”
“In an hour.”


未到半个时辰，等的人到了，
Before the hour was up, the man he was waiting for returned.

是周一鸣，
It was Zhou.

据他打听的结果，阿巧姐的那条船，早在下午三点钟，就已到达。
His inquiries showed that A’qiao's boat had arrived as early as three that afternoon.

“这有点意思了！
“This is interesting.

看起来不假。”接着，胡雪岩便将那个突如其来的邀请，说了给周一鸣听。
It seems the story is true.” Hu then told him about the unexpected invitation.

“这其中一定有道理。
“There must be a reason.

阿巧姐必有不便回来的理由，
A’qiao must have some difficulty about returning here.

胡大老爷，我陪了你去。”
I'll go with you.”

“你的话不错。不过我不想去，
“You're right, but I don't want to go.

一个人不怕一万，独怕万一。”
It's the one chance in ten thousand that a man must fear.”

胡雪岩低声说道，“人心多险，
Lowering his voice, Hu continued, “People can be treacherous.

一步错走不得。
One wrong step may ruin everything.

我平日做人，极为小心，不愿得罪人，但难免遭妒，
I'm always careful and try to offend no one, but I can't avoid jealousy.

有人暗中在算计我，亦未可知。
Someone may be plotting against me.

别样事都好分辩，
Other matters can be explained.

就是这种牵涉人家闺阁的事，最要远避。
Anything involving the women's quarters of another household is best kept far away from.

所以，我想请你替我去一趟。”
I'd like you to go for me.”

周一鸣久历江湖，各种稀奇古怪的事都经过，
Zhou had long experience of the world and had seen every kind of strange affair.

心想他是怕着了“仙人跳”，顾虑得倒也有道理。
Hu was afraid of an extortion trap involving a woman, he thought, and the concern was reasonable.

自己替他去走一趟，一样也要小心，
He too must be careful if he went in Hu's place.

当时便点点头说：
He nodded.

“我去！
“I'll go.

去了只把阿巧姐请出来，看她是何话说？”
I'll simply ask A’qiao to come out and hear what she has to say.”

“对了！
“Exactly.

你问明了立刻来告诉我。”
Find out and come straight back to tell me.”

正在谈着，那小后生已转了回来。
As they spoke, the boy returned.

胡雪岩随便找了个不能分身的理由，
Hu gave some convenient reason why he could not leave.

来人自无话说，带着周一鸣走了。
The messenger could hardly object and took Zhou away.


这一走，过了个把时辰，才见他回来，
It was some two hours before Zhou returned.

“阿巧姐的话很多，
“A’qiao had a great deal to say.

有些事，我也弄不清楚。”
There are things I don't fully understand.”

周一鸣略停一停，整理一下思绪，要言不烦地说：
He paused to collect his thoughts, then explained briefly.

“阿巧姐夫家派了人，从木渎跟了她到这里，
“Her husband's family sent someone who followed her here from Mudu.

看样子是来找麻烦。
They seem to be looking for trouble.

阿巧姐不愿回这里，就是不愿意让他们发现她落脚的地方。
She didn't come back because she didn't want them to discover where she's staying.

阿巧姐说有好些话一定要跟胡大老爷你当面谈。
She says there are many things she must discuss with you in person.

她怕跟来的人，在潘家附近守着，此刻不敢出门，
She's afraid the people following her are watching near the Pans', so she dare not leave now.

到半夜里叫我去接了她来。”
She wants me to fetch her at midnight.”

“喔！”
“Oh!”

胡雪岩深为诧异，
Hu was deeply surprised.

“据我知道，她夫家老实得很。
“As far as I know, her husband's family are very docile.

怎有此事？”
How can this be?”

这话在周一鸣无可赞一词，只这样说，
Zhou could offer no opinion.

“反正见了面就知道了。”
“You'll know when you see her.”

“慢点！”
“Wait!”

胡雪岩双目炯炯，神色凛然，
Hu's eyes flashed, and his expression became stern.

“不能去接她！
“You mustn't fetch her.

万一为人跟踪，明天告我个拐带良家妇女，这个面子我丢不起。
If someone follows and accuses me tomorrow of abducting a respectable married woman, I can't afford that disgrace.

老周，我问你，那潘家是怎么回事？”
Old Zhou, tell me about this Pan family.”

“苏州潘家有两潘，一潘是‘贵潘’，一潘是‘富潘’，
“There are two prominent Pan families in Suzhou: the ‘Noble Pans’ and the ‘Rich Pans’.

阿巧姐的那一家，是富潘的同族。
This household belongs to the same clan as the Rich Pans.

阿巧姐的小姐妹，是他家的姨太太，
A’qiao's friend is the master's concubine.

太太故世了，姨太太当家，
His principal wife has died, so the concubine runs the household.

所以能够作主，把阿巧姐留了下来往。”
That's why she can decide to let A’qiao stay.”

“潘家的男主人，叫啥？
“What's the master's name?

你晓得不晓得。”
Do you know?”

“不晓得。”
“No.”

“不晓得也不碍。”胡雪岩说，
“That doesn't matter.

“等我去拜他家男主人，当面说明经过，
I'll call on him and explain what has happened.

把阿巧姐找了出来，就当着他家男主人谈好了。
Then we can ask A’qiao to come out and talk in his presence.

不过，这一下，要委屈你了。
But this will mean asking you to accept a humble role.”

“这话周一鸣明白，是要他权且充任报帖的家人，
Zhou understood: he was to act for the moment as a servant presenting Hu's visiting card.

这也无所谓，他很爽快地答应：
He did not mind and readily agreed.

“我伺候胡大老爷去。”
“I'll attend you.”

于是雇好一顶轿子，
They hired a sedan chair.

周一鸣持着拜匣，跟随胡雪岩到了潘家。
Carrying the card case, Zhou accompanied Hu to the Pan house.

帖子一投进去，潘家的男主人莫名其妙，
When the card was brought in, the master was bewildered.

但他的姨太太心里明白，说了经过，
His concubine understood, however, and explained.

方始恍然，立刻吩咐接见。
Once he grasped the situation, he immediately ordered that the visitor be received.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十三章起连续正文（之三；底本未标第二十四章）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Continuous text beginning with Chapter Twenty-Three, part three (the source supplies no Chapter Twenty-Four heading)

“来得冒昧之至，”胡雪岩长揖问道：
“This is a most presumptuous visit,” Hu Xueyan said with a deep bow.

“还不曾请教台甫。”
“May I have the honour of your name?”

“草字叔雅。”潘叔雅说，
“My courtesy name is Shuya,” Pan replied.

“老兄的来意，我已经知道了。
“I already know why you have come.

我把人请出来，你们当面谈。”
I'll ask her to join you so that you can speak face to face.”

“是！是！
“Thank you, thank you.

承情不尽。只是深夜打搅，万分不安。”
I'm most grateful, and very sorry to disturb you so late.”

于是潘叔雅道声：“暂且失陪。”
“Excuse me for a moment.”

转身入内。
Pan Shuya turned and went inside.

趁这片刻工夫，胡雪岩将潘家的客厅，打量了一番，这才讶然发现，潘家的里外大不相同，
Hu took the opportunity to examine the reception room and was astonished by the difference between the house's exterior and interior.

大门残旧狭隘，象个破落户，客厅中的陈设却是名贵非凡，
The narrow, worn entrance suggested a family in decline, yet the furnishings were extraordinarily valuable.

光是壁上的字画，就让胡雪岩目眩不止，
The pictures and calligraphy alone dazzled him.

这面一堂屏条山水，四幅恰好就是“四王”，
A set of four landscape scrolls on one wall represented the “Four Wangs,” one apiece.

那面一堂屏条书法，四幅也恰好就是文微明的真草隶篆“四体”。
On another wall hung four calligraphic scrolls by Wen Zhengming, covering all four scripts: regular, cursive, clerical, and seal.

另有一幅中堂，顶天立地，写的是碗大的狂草，
There was also an enormous central scroll stretching from ceiling to floor, covered in wild cursive characters as big as bowls.

胡雪岩除了个“一”字，其余一字不识，
Apart from the character for “one,” Hu could not read a thing.

但这么两丈多长，七、八尺宽的一张大宣纸，就够他发半天的愣了。
But the sheer size of the sheet of xuan paper, over two zhang long and seven or eight chi wide, was enough to leave him staring.


“胡老爷，请用点心！”
“Mr Hu, please have some refreshments.”

一个穿着极整洁的蓝布大褂的听差，捧来了一只银盒，盒子凿成一朵梅花，花蒂就是把手。
A servant in an exceptionally neat blue cotton gown brought a silver box wrought in the shape of a plum blossom, its stalk forming the handle.

揭开来看，里面是五只细瓷碟子，盛着五样点心，
Beneath the lid were five fine porcelain dishes, each with a different delicacy.

红、绿、黄、黑、白俱备，颜色极艳，
Red, green, yellow, black, and white were all represented in brilliant colour.

胡雪岩只认得红的是玫瑰年糕，
Hu recognised only the red one, which he took for rose-flavoured New Year cake.

拿起银镶牙筷，拈了一块放在嘴里，
Using ivory chopsticks mounted in silver, he lifted a piece to his mouth.

滑糯香甜，其味弥甘，但却不是玫瑰的味道。
Smooth, glutinous, fragrant, and sweet, it grew more delicious as he tasted it—but the flavour was not rose.

“这是拿啥做的？”
“What is this made with?”

“是拿桃子汁在粉里蒸的。”
“Peach juice mixed into the flour and steamed.”

这在胡雪岩可说闻所未闻，只有叹一声：
Hu had never heard of such a thing.

“你们府上真讲究！”
“Your household certainly knows how to do things finely!”

听差矜持的微笑着，退后两步，悄悄侍立。
The servant smiled with restraint, stepped back two paces, and stood silently by.

胡雪岩一面进食，一面在想：等将来发了大财，总要比这潘家更讲究，
As Hu ate, he thought that when he made a great fortune, he must live even more exquisitely than the Pans.

做人才有意思。
That would make life worth living.


正在仰慕不已，胡思乱想的当儿。 听得屏风后面，有了人声，
In the midst of his admiration and wandering thoughts, he heard voices behind the screen.

抬眼看时，正是阿巧姐由个丫头陪着走了出来。
Looking up, he saw A’qiao approaching with a maid.

一见面就说：“我等你好久了。”
“I've been waiting so long for you,” she said at once.

请这面坐吧！
“Please sit over here.”

“听差十分知趣，将他们两人引到靠里的炕床上，端来了盖碗茶，随即向那丫头使个眼色，
The tactful servant led them to a couch farther inside, brought covered bowls of tea, and gave the maid a glance.

都退到了廊下。
Both withdrew to the veranda.

“怎么回事？”胡雪岩问，
“What's happened?” Hu asked.

“回一趟娘家，搞出很大的麻烦！
“One visit to your family, and all this trouble!

早知如此，倒不如我叫老周陪了你去。”
If I'd known, I'd have sent Zhou with you.”

“陪了去也没用。
“That wouldn't have helped.

事情很奇怪……”
It's very strange...”

奇的是就在阿巧姐回去的前一天，有人寻到阿巧姐的夫家，直言相告，说是受阿巧姐的委托，来谈如何了结他们这层名存实亡的夫妇关系。
The strange thing was that on the day before A’qiao returned, someone had called at her husband's home and announced openly that she had sent him to discuss ending their marriage, which now existed only in name.

如果愿意休妻另娶，可以好好送一笔钱。
If her husband was willing to divorce her and marry again, he could receive a substantial payment.

阿巧姐的丈夫很老实，不知何以为答，
Her husband was an honest, simple man and did not know what to say.

但他有个堂房哥哥，名叫小狗子，却是个喜欢搅是非的坏蛋，
But an elder cousin on his father's side, called Xiaogouzi, was a scoundrel who enjoyed stirring up trouble.

一看奇货可居，当时便表示：一切都好谈。但要阿巧姐亲自出面料理。
Seeing a valuable opportunity, he immediately said that everything could be discussed, but A’qiao must come and settle it herself.

来人一再探询口风，小狗子说是只想要个两三百银子。
The visitor repeatedly sounded him out, and Xiaogouzi said that he wanted only two or three hundred taels.

“是假话！
“A lie!

小狗子的打算，是要骗我到家，好敲人家的竹杠。
He meant to lure me home and use me to extort money from someone.

偏偏我第二天就回家，
As luck would have it, I came back the very next day.

亏得消息来得早，
Fortunately, word reached me in time.

所以小狗子来叫我，我不肯回去。
When he came to fetch me, I refused to go.

我娘也叫我早早走。”阿巧姐接着又说：
My mother told me to leave quickly too.

“哪知道小狗子带了两个地痞，弄了只船跟了下来。
Who would have thought he'd get a boat and follow me down with two local ruffians?

我一看这情形，不敢回客栈，
When I saw that, I daren't return to the inn.

同时关照船老大，不可说破是金阊栈代雇的船。
I warned the boatman not to reveal that Jinchang Inn had hired his boat for me.

上了岸，雇顶小轿，一直抬到这潘府上，
I went ashore, hired a little sedan chair, and came straight here.

还不晓得小狗子知道不知道我在这里？“
I still don't know whether Xiaogouzi knows I'm here.”


胡雪岩一面听，一面深深点头，
Hu nodded gravely as he listened.

等她说完，主意也就定了，
By the time she finished, his mind was made up.

“你做得好！”他说，
“You did the right thing.

“不要紧，
Don't worry.

我来料理。”
I'll handle it.”

“你怎么样料理？”
“How?”

“这家的姨太太，跟你的交情厚不厚？”
“Are you very close to the concubine in this house?”

“从小在一起的姐妹。‘阿巧姐答道：”
“We've been friends since we were children.

交情不厚，我也不会投到这里来了。
I wouldn't have come to her if we weren't close.”

“那好！”
“Good!”

胡雪岩欣慰地，
Hu was relieved.

“你就先住在这里。
“Then stay here for the present.

多住几日。”
Stay a few more days.”

阿巧姐大感意外，
A’qiao was surprised.

“多住几日？”
“A few more days?”

她皱眉问道：
She frowned.

“住到几时？”
“Until when?”

胡雪岩的意思，最好住到何桂清动身北上的时节。但这话此时不便说，而且一时也说不清楚。
Hu would have preferred her to remain until He Guiqing left for the north, but this was neither the moment to say so nor something he could easily explain.

再又想到，虽然阿巧姐跟人家的交情甚厚，只是当居停的，到底不是正主人，
Then he considered that, close though the women were, her hostess was not the household's principal mistress.

作客的身分也有些尴尬，
A’qiao's position as a guest was awkward too.

主客双方，都有难处，
Both sides had their difficulties.

短时勾留，还无所谓，住长了要防人说闲话。
A brief visit was harmless; a long stay might invite gossip.

“这样吧！”胡雪岩说，“见事行事。
“Let's proceed as circumstances suggest,” he said.

你在这里打搅人家，我自然有一番意思。
“If you're imposing on them here, naturally I must show my appreciation.

明天就备一笔礼来，
I'll send a gift tomorrow.

若是她家男主人好意相留，你就住下去，
If the master of the house kindly invites you to remain, stay on.

不然另想别法。”
Otherwise we'll find another way.”


“住下去倒没有什么。
“There's no difficulty about staying.

我只是问你，要住到哪一天？”阿巧姐又说，
I only want to know until what day.

“我也知道你上海事情多，最多三两天就要回去，
You've so much to do in Shanghai that you'll have to go back in two or three days at most.

莫非把我一个人撇在这里？”
Surely you don't mean to leave me here alone?”

“当然不会！”胡雪岩说，
“Of course not.

“我另有安排……”
I have other arrangements...”

“啥安排？”阿巧姐抢着问，神气极其认真。

若是别人，看她这样咄咄逼人，会觉得招架不住，胡雪岩自然不会，
Another man might have felt unable to withstand her persistent questioning, but not Hu.

“Don't be anxious.

自然是极妥当的安排。”他接着又说：“长话短说，我让你住在这里，不让你回客栈，就是不想落把柄在小狗子手里。
Naturally, the arrangements will be perfectly satisfactory.” He continued, “To put it briefly, I'm keeping you here rather than bringing you back to the inn because I don't want to give Xiaogouzi anything to use against us.

Next I'll find out who visited your husband's family.”

“Yes, you must find out.

“在船上我一直想不通，为啥要冒我的名，说我托他们去谈的？
All the way on the boat I kept wondering why they had used my name and said I'd asked them to negotiate.

Could it have been someone I know?”

这句话提醒了胡雪岩，念头象闪电一般从心里划过，
Her words struck Hu like a flash of lightning.

十有八、九是尤五和古应春搞的把戏，
Almost certainly this was You and Gu's doing.

自己曾经跟他们说过，请他们听自己的招呼行事，暂时不必插手，
He had told them to wait for his instructions and keep out of the matter for the present.

果然，不听自己的话，弄巧成拙，反惹出意外的麻烦。
They must have disregarded him, and their cleverness had backfired, producing unexpected trouble.

不过，他也知道阿巧姐此时心神不定，不宜多说，便即答道：
But he knew A’qiao was unsettled and ought not to be told too much just then.

“你不必瞎猜。
“Don't go guessing.

一切有我。
Leave everything to me.

这件事办得顺利的话也很快，
If this goes smoothly, it may be settled very quickly.

说不定明后天就可以水落石出。
Perhaps everything will be clear by tomorrow or the day after.

你先安心在这里玩几天，
Stay here a few days with an easy mind.

我把你的衣箱送过来。”
I'll send your clothes trunk over.”


“那倒不必。
“There's no need.

我跟我那小姐妹，身材相仿，她的衣服多得穿不完，
My friend and I are much the same size, and she has more clothes than she can wear.

不过，”
But...”

阿巧姐又提到那话：
A’qiao returned to her point.

“这总也要说个日子，
“You must give me a day.

到底住多少天？
How long exactly am I to stay?

我也好安心，人家问起来，我也有话好答。”
Then I can be at ease and have an answer if they ask.”

“那……”
“Well...”

胡雪岩心想，看样子到端午前后，何桂清动身的那时候，是不可能的了，
Hu saw that keeping her here until He Guiqing left, around the Dragon Boat Festival, would be impossible.

既然如此，就早些了结这事，
In that case, he should settle the matter sooner.

所以盘算了一会，很爽快地答道：“三天！
After considering briefly, he answered decisively, “Three days.

第四天我准定来接你。”
On the fourth day I'll certainly come to fetch you.”

阿巧姐很满意，却又叮嘱了一句：“你可记在心里！”
She was satisfied, but added, “Do remember!”

“不会忘忆！”
“I won't forget.”

说着，他从身上摇出一大叠银票来，捡了几张小数目的递了过去，
He took out a thick sheaf of banknotes and selected several of smaller denominations.

“这里二百两银子，你留着用。
“Here are two hundred taels for your expenses.

在人家这里作客，小钱不要省，
While you're a guest here, don't stint over small sums.

下人该当开发的，都要开发。出手也不可以小气。
Give the servants whatever gratuities are appropriate, and don't be mean about it.

懂吧？”
Understand?”

阿巧姐如何不懂？
Of course she understood.

点点头说：
She nodded.

“你放心好了，
“Don't worry.

我不会丢你的面子。”
I won't let you lose face.”


于是胡雪岩请见主人，道谢告辞，
Hu then asked to see the host, thanked him, and took his leave.

等周一鸣陪着回到金阊栈，他把他留了下来，细谈究竟。
Back at Jinchang Inn, he kept Zhou Yiming with him and explained the situation in detail.

这段经过，前因后果，相当曲折，
The story was complicated, with many twists of cause and consequence.

即令胡雪岩把不必说出的话，隐去了许多，仍旧使周一鸣听得津津有味，而且磨拳擦掌，大有跃跃欲试之意。
Even though Hu omitted much that did not need telling, Zhou listened with relish and rubbed his hands, eager to take part.

“乡下土流氓搞不出什么把戏，
“Country ruffians can't manage much.

等我打发他们走。”
Let me send them packing.”

“人都还不知道在哪里，
“We don't even know where they are.

你先别忙！”胡雪岩说，
Don't rush,” Hu said.

“我们商量好再动手。
“Let's agree on a plan before acting.

只是摆脱这两个人，事情好办，
Getting rid of those two fellows would be easy enough.

我要跟小狗子打交道。
It's Xiaogouzi I want to deal with.”

““喔！”
“Oh!”

周一鸣把心定下来，因为看样子还有许多花样，且等听了再说。
Zhou settled down to listen. Apparently, there was more to come.

“我现在又要叫小狗子晓得厉害，又要他感激。
“I want to teach Xiaogouzi a lesson and make him grateful to me as well.

你倒想个办法看。”
See if you can think of a way.”

这是个难题，胡雪岩原有借此考一考周一鸣的意思。
This was a difficult problem, and Hu had partly intended it as a test.

他好好考虑了一会，出了一个主意，
After careful thought, Zhou proposed a plan.

胡雪岩认为可行，当天就开始动手。
Hu considered it workable, and they began preparations that day.


第一步是去打听这两个人，
The first step was to locate the two men.

乡下人到底是乡下人，不脱泥土气，所以第二天一早，周一鸣很快地在潘家附近找到了。
Country people were country people, with a rustic air they could not shed, and early the next morning Zhou found them near the Pan house without much difficulty.

潘家的巷口就是一爿俗称“老虎灶”的小茶店，
At the mouth of the Pans' lane stood a little tea shop of the kind popularly called a “tiger stove.”

光顾这里的茶客，大多是附近的平民，
Its customers were mostly ordinary people from the neighbourhood.

一到先自己取了木脸盆舀水洗脸漱口，相互招呼，然后吃茶吃点心，高谈阔论，
On arriving, they took a wooden basin and scooped up water to wash their faces and rinse their mouths, greeted one another, then drank tea, ate snacks, and talked loudly.

只有坐在门口饶饼摊子后面那张桌子上，土里土气，贼头贼脑的两个茶客，不但不跟人招呼，
Only two furtive, rustic-looking customers, sitting at the table behind the flatbread stall by the entrance, greeted no one.

而且两双眼睛只盯着过往行人，特别是看见堂客，更为注意，
Their eyes followed every passer-by, paying particular attention to women.

这就相当明显了。
The signs were plain enough.

“小狗子！”周一鸣冒叫一声。
“Xiaogouzi!” Zhou called out on a guess.

小狗子哪知道“螳螂捕蝉，黄雀在后”，
Xiaogouzi had no idea that, while the mantis stalked the cicada, an oriole waited behind it.

听得声音，转脸来看，看到同一鸣含笑注视，便即问道：
He turned and found Zhou smiling at him.

“是你叫我？”
“Were you calling me?”

“是啊！
“Yes.

哪一天进城来的？”
When did you come into town?”

“昨……昨天。”
“Yester... yesterday.”

小狗子嗫嚅着说，
Xiaogouzi faltered.

“我不认识你。”
“I don't know you.”

“怎么会不认得我？”
“How can you not know me?”

周一鸣也做出困惑的神色，
Zhou looked puzzled too.

“我倒请问，你是不是家住木渎？”
“Let me ask: don't you live in Mudu?”

“是的。”
“Yes.”

“那就对了！”
“Then that's right.”

周一鸣以极有把握的声音说：
Zhou sounded utterly certain.

“你贵人多忘事，
“An important man forgets easily.

认不得我，我是不会记错的。
You may not recognise me, but I can't be mistaken.

我们上一次吃过‘讲茶’，
We once attended a dispute-settling tea meeting together.

我那朋友多亏你帮忙。”
You were a great help to my friend.”

这又是周一鸣瞎扯，
This was another fabrication.

料准象小狗子这样的人，少不得有吃讲茶、讲斤头的行径，所以放心大胆撒谎。
Zhou reckoned that a man like Xiaogouzi was bound to have taken part in such meetings and settlements, so he lied boldly.

小狗子不知是计，想了想问：
Suspecting no trick, Xiaogouzi considered.

“你的朋友是哪个？”
“Which friend?”

“姓王。”
“His surname is Wang.”

“喔，”小狗子说：
“Oh!

“想来是王胖子的朋友。
You must be Fat Wang's friend.

不错，王胖子调戏刘二寡妇，挨了耳光，是我帮他叫开的。
Yes, he got slapped for making advances to Widow Liu, and I intervened for him.

王胖子现在还好吧！”
How is he now?”

“还不错，还不错！”周一鸣顺口回答，
“Quite well, quite well,” Zhou answered readily.

“他常常提到你，说你小狗子够朋友。
“He often mentions you and says what a loyal friend you are.

来，来，我做个吃点心的小东。”说着便向烧饼摊子高声吩咐：“拿蟹壳黄、油包来！”
Come, let me treat you to a little breakfast.” He called to the stall, “Bring some crab-shell pastries and oil buns!”


“不好意思，不好意思。”小狗子一面说话，一面眼睛朝外看，
“You shouldn't trouble yourself,” Xiaogouzi said, but his eyes kept turning outside.

街上走过一个女人，后影极俏，象极了阿巧姐。
A woman was passing whose graceful figure from behind looked very much like A’qiao's.

这等于自画供状，
It was as good as writing his own confession.

周一鸣心里好笑，便根本不拿他当个对手，
Zhou laughed inwardly and ceased to regard him as any sort of opponent.

等那条俏影消失，小狗子怏怏地收拢目光，脸上并现懊恼与疑惑之色，
When the figure disappeared, Xiaogouzi reluctantly looked back, his face showing both annoyance and doubt.

Zhou went straight to the point.

“小狗子，你在等人？”
“Are you waiting for someone?”

“不是，不是！”
“No, no!”

“那个女的，”
“That woman...”

周一鸣遥遥一指，
Zhou pointed into the distance.

“后影好熟，
“Her back looks so familiar.

好象在哪里见过？”
Where have I seen her?”

小狗子怎想得到是有意逗他？
Xiaogouzi could not imagine that he was being deliberately baited.

惊喜交集地问：“你……
Surprised and delighted, he began, “You...

啊，说了半天，看我荒唐不荒唐？还没有请教你老哥尊姓？”
Ah, how foolish of me! We've been talking all this time and I haven't asked your surname.”

周一鸣因为藐视他的缘故，便懒得改姓，照实答道：
Holding him in such contempt, Zhou could not even be bothered to invent one.

“敝姓周。”
“Zhou.”

“是啊！”周一鸣说：
“Yes.

“好象木渎见过，也好象在上海见过。”
I seem to have seen her in Mudu, and perhaps in Shanghai too.”

他摇摇头：
He shook his head.

“记不得了！”
“I can't remember.”

这番做作，把小狗子骗得死心塌地，
This performance deceived Xiaogouzi completely.

当时先不忙跟周一鸣答话，向他的同伴叫了声：“老吴！”接着向外努一努嘴。
Rather than reply, he called to his companion, “Old Wu!” and jerked his chin towards the street.

那个老吴便飞奔而去，周一鸣越发匿笑不已。
Old Wu dashed off, leaving Zhou still more amused.

他又用关切的神色，提出警告：“苏州城里，不比乡下，尤其是这年把，
With an air of concern, he warned him, “Suzhou isn't the countryside, especially this past year or so.

总督、巡抚、总兵，多少红顶子大官儿在这里，
The governor-general, governor, military commander—there are any number of great officials with red hat buttons here.

你们要当心。”
You'd better be careful.”

“这……”
“Well...”

小狗子嗫嚅着，
Xiaogouzi faltered.

“不要紧的！
“It's nothing.

是熟人。”
Someone we know.”

“什么熟人？
“Who?

说刚才那个女的是熟人？”
Do you mean that woman?”

“是的。”
“Yes.”

小狗子觉得周一鸣见多识广，而且也说了相熟，便不再隐瞒：
Thinking Zhou worldly and experienced, and remembering his claim to know her too, Xiaogouzi stopped concealing the truth.

“周大哥，你说在木渎，在上海见过都不错。
“You're right about both Mudu and Shanghai.

说起名字，你恐怕晓得，
Perhaps you'll know her name.

叫阿巧！”
She's called A’qiao.”


听得这话，周一鸣又有番做作，
Zhou put on another performance.

把腰一直，脸微微向后，眼略略下垂，好半晌才说：
Straightening his back, drawing his face a little away, and lowering his eyes, he paused for some time.

“我道是哪个，
“So that's who it is!

是在长三堂子里的阿巧！
A’qiao from the high-class courtesan house.

怪不得背影好熟。”
No wonder her back looked familiar.”

“对，对！
“Yes, yes!

周大哥，你也晓得的，她在堂子里。”
Brother Zhou, you know she's at one of those houses.”

小狗子更觉需要解释，赶紧又说：
Feeling a further explanation necessary, Xiaogouzi hurried on.

“It's all her own family's fault.

她是私下从夫家逃出的，
She ran away secretly from her husband's home.

做出这种事来，害得夫家没面子，
Carrying on like that has disgraced his family.

真正气数。”
What rotten luck!”

“Why are you following her now?

想捉她回去？”
To catch her and take her back?”

“也不是捉她，
“Not catch her.

她不守妇道，
She's neglected her duties as a wife.

想劝她回去。”
We want to persuade her to return.”
