“Xiaogouzi, if I may say so, this is just like your Suzhou saying: ‘Hang a salted fish under your nose—smell it, but forget your hopes.’

‘这种人怎么劝得醒？
How can you expect to talk sense into someone like that?”

“小狗子点点头，想开口却又把话咽了回去。
Xiaogouzi nodded, opened his mouth, then swallowed his words.

周一鸣明白，这就到了要紧关头了。
Zhou knew they had reached the critical point.

他原来定的计划是，找好“班房”里一个跑腿的小伙计，托他找个同事，
His original plan had been to find a young runner from the detention quarters and have him recruit a colleague.

两个人弄条链子，弄副手铐，等自己探明了小狗子的住处，“硬装榫头”，随便安上他一个罪名，先抓到班房里，
With a chain and a pair of handcuffs, they would wait until Zhou discovered Xiaogouzi's lodging, then pin some arbitrary charge on him and haul him into custody.

然后胡雪岩拿着何桂清留经他的致长洲知县的名片去保他出来。
Hu would then use the visiting card He Guiqing had given him for the magistrate of Changzhou County to secure Xiaogouzi's release.

这就是既叫小狗子知道厉害，又要他感激的手法。
That was how they meant to frighten him and make him grateful as well.

而照现在来看，根本无需这样子大动干戈，直截了当谈判就行了。
Now it seemed there was no need for such elaborate measures: direct negotiation would suffice.

对小狗子这面，毫无疑问，周一鸣认为“搓得圆、拉得长”，要他成什么样子，就什么样子，极有把握，
Zhou had no doubt he could mould Xiaogouzi like dough, round or long, into whatever shape he wanted.

但在胡雪岩那方面不能没有顾忌，
But he had to consider Hu.

他觉得自己无论就身分、交情来说，替他办事，还没有能够到自作主张，独断独行的程度。
Neither his standing nor the closeness of their acquaintance entitled him to act independently.

自己只不过为胡雪岩奔走，他怎么说，自己怎么做，
He was merely running errands: Hu gave instructions, and he followed them.

能把他的交代完全办到，便是最圆满的事。
Carrying them out exactly was the best possible result.

不听他的话做，即使效果超过预期，依然会使得胡雪岩有“此人不可靠”的感觉，因为不听话即是不易控驭。
If he disobeyed, even an outcome better than expected could make Hu think him unreliable, because a man who would not obey was a man difficult to control.


为此，他改了主意，
For this reason, Zhou changed course.

“小狗子，各人有各人的事，
“Everyone has his own affairs, Xiaogouzi.

我也不来多问。”
I won't ask any more.”

他略停一停说，
He paused.

“今天也是凑巧，我有个机会可以发笔小财，
“It's a coincidence, but I have a chance to make a little money today.

不过这件事我自己一个人做不成，
I can't manage it alone.

正好路过看见你，想邀你做个帮手，
Passing by and seeing you, I thought I'd ask you to help.

不知道你有空没空。”
Have you any time?”

话甚突兀，小狗子一时不知如何回答？
The proposal came so abruptly that Xiaogouzi did not know how to answer.

有钱进帐的事，自然求之不得，
Of course he welcomed any chance to make money.

但第一要看他的话靠得靠不住，第二要看自己做得了做不了？
But first he must decide whether Zhou could be trusted, and second whether he could do the job.

所以先要问个清楚才能打主意。
He needed an explanation before making up his mind.

“周大哥，你挑我，我自然没话说。
“If you've chosen me, Brother Zhou, naturally I'm willing.

是怎么回事，
But what's involved?

好不好请你先说一说？”
Could you tell me first?”

“说来话长。
“It's a long story.

看你现在心神不定，我也还有点事要去办，
You're distracted at the moment, and I have something else to do.

这样，”
Let's see...”

周一鸣故意做个沉吟的神情，然后语声很急地问道：“你住在哪里，
Zhou pretended to consider, then asked urgently, “Where are you staying?

中午我来看你。”
I'll call at noon.”

“我住在阊门外一个朋友那里。”小狗子又说，
“With a friend outside Chang Gate.

“中午不见得回去。”
But I may not go back at noon.”

“那么，我们中午约在哪里碰头好了。
“Then let's arrange somewhere to meet.

我请你吃酒，
I'll invite you for a drink.

把你的朋友老吴也带来。”
Bring your friend Old Wu.”

“好的。”小狗子毫不迟疑地答道：
“Good.” Xiaogouzi agreed without hesitation.

“你约地方好了。
“You choose the place.

哪个请哪个，自己弟兄都一样的。”
We're brothers; it makes no difference who treats whom.”

“对！
“Exactly.

我们准定中午在观前街元大昌碰头。
Yuandachang on Guanqian Street, at noon sharp.

先到先等，
Whoever arrives first waits.

不见不散。”
We must meet.”

说定了，周一鸣先走，
With this settled, Zhou left first.

他很细心，没有忘了先到烧饼摊上付了点心钱。
He was careful enough not to forget to pay the stall for their breakfast.


然后匆匆奔到吴苑茶店，这是昨晚上约好了的，胡雪岩在那里等他。
He hurried to Wuyuan Tea House, where Hu was waiting by arrangement from the previous night.

“这个小狗子，两眼墨黑，
“That Xiaogouzi is completely in the dark.

啥也不懂！
He knows nothing!

居然想来寻这种外快，真正叫自不量力！”
To think he'd try making money this way—he has no idea of his own limits.”

周一鸣得意地细讲了发现小狗子的经过，然后又说：“杀鸡焉用牛刀？”
Zhou proudly described how he had found him, then added, “Why use an ox-cleaver to kill a chicken?

这种样子，胡大老爷你也犯不着费心了，
A fellow like that isn't worth your trouble.

有话跟他实说就是。
We need only tell him straight.

本来我就想跟他打开天窗说亮话的，不过是胡大老爷的事，我不敢擅专。
I'd meant to speak plainly on the spot, but since it was your business, I didn't dare take the decision myself.”

““不敢，不敢！”
“You do me too much honour.”

胡雪岩对周一鸣很满意，所以也很客气，拱着手说；
Well pleased, Hu responded with equal courtesy, clasping his hands.

“你帮我的这个忙，帮得不小。”
“You've done me a great favour.”

“哪里的话？
“Not at all.

胡大老爷，你不必说客气话。”周一鸣很恳切地答道，
No need for formalities, Mr Hu,” Zhou answered earnestly.

“该当怎么办，你尽管吩咐，我去跑。”
“Just tell me what should be done, and I'll do the legwork.”

“你的办法已经很好了。
“Your method is excellent already.

能够就在这一两天内办妥当了，说句实话，是意想不到的顺利。
To settle it within a day or two would be easier than I could have expected, to tell the truth.

你中午去赴约，约了他到我客栈里，我们一起跟他谈。
Keep your noon appointment, then bring him to my inn so we can talk together.

不过，那个姓吴的，最好把他撇开。”
It would be best to leave the man named Wu out of it.”

“这容易。
“Easy enough.

我自有法子。”
I'll find a way.”

“还有件事，很要紧。”
“There's one more thing, and it's important.”

胡雪岩略想一想说：
Hu thought briefly.

“不管它了，
“Never mind.

我自己去办，
I'll do it myself.

你就只管约了小狗子来，
Just bring Xiaogouzi.

只要约到，以下都是我的事。”
Once you've got him there, leave the rest to me.”

“只要约到”四个字，等于提醒周一鸣，小狗子可能心生疑惑，有意爽约。
Those words reminded Zhou that Xiaogouzi might grow suspicious and deliberately fail to appear.

那在胡雪岩面上就不好交代了。
Then he would have no satisfactory account to give Hu.


于是周一鸣不暇多说，匆匆出了金阊栈，
Without further talk, Zhou hurried out of Jinchang Inn.

为求快速，赁了一匹供游客逛山用的马，认镫扳鞍，跨上马背，将缰绳一带朝城里走。
To save time, he hired one of the horses used for excursions into the hills, set his foot in the stirrup, swung into the saddle, and turned it towards the city.

“喂，喂，客人，
“Hey, sir!

你到哪里？”
Where are you going?”

赁马的马伕赶紧抢着嚼环，仰脸问说。
The groom hurried to catch the bridle and looked up at him.

这些马照例有马伕带路，而马是跑熟了路的，
These horses normally went out with a groom leading the way, and knew the route thoroughly.

出行之时，一步踏一步，到归途回槽，撒开四蹄，却又不大相同。
They advanced one slow step at a time on the outward journey, but moved very differently when home and their feed troughs were in sight.

马都是上了岁数的，实在也快不到哪里去，
All were old, so none could go particularly fast.

而且除却逛山，从不进城，
They were used only for hill excursions and never entered the city.

所以马伕要那样诧异地问。
Hence the groom's astonishment.

周一鸣原晓得这些规矩，
Zhou knew the rules.

一看不能通融，便很简捷地说：“我要进城，
Seeing that no exception would be made, he said curtly, “I'm going into town.

你赁不赁？
Will you hire it to me or not?

不赁我就下来。”
If not, I'll get down.”

“做生意哪有不赁之理。
“I'm in business. Why wouldn't I?

不过……”
Only...”

周一鸣没有工夫跟他多磨，跳下马来将缰绳一丢，掉头就走。
With no time for discussion, Zhou jumped down, tossed away the reins, and turned to go.

这态度就不大好了，而那马伕也是有脾气的，
His manner was poor, and the groom had a temper too.

当时便吐一口唾沫，自言自语的骂道：“真叫气数！
Spitting on the ground, he muttered, “Rotten luck!

碰着‘老爷’哉！”
I've met a ‘master’ today.”

苏州话的“老爷”，用在这里当鬼解释，
In this use of Suzhou speech, “master” meant a ghost or devil.

周一鸣正因赁马不成，惹了一肚子气，
Zhou was already furious at failing to hire the horse.

此时怒不可遏，
Now he could contain himself no longer.

转过身来，抢上两步，戟指喝道：
Turning, he strode back two paces and pointed.

“你骂谁？”
“Who are you cursing?”

那马伕一看来势汹汹，便有惧意，
Alarmed by this menacing approach, the groom was afraid.

但“苏州人打架”的那副工架是出了名的，
Yet the elaborate preparations of Suzhou men for a fight were famous.

一面用怎么样也硬不起来的苏州话，连声警告：“耐要那哼？
In a dialect that would never sound fierce, he repeatedly demanded, “What d'you want?

耐要那哼？”一面倒退着揎拳捋袖、捞衣襟、盘辫子，仿佛要拼个你死我活似地。
What d'you want?” while backing away, baring his fists, rolling his sleeves, gathering his skirts, and winding up his queue as though preparing for a fight to the death.

苏州人又最好看热闹，顿时围了一圈人，
Suzhou people also loved a spectacle, and a ring of onlookers soon formed.

那马伕有本地人助威，声音便高了，用极快的苏州话指责周一鸣不通人性，
Encouraged by the support of his fellow townsmen, the groom raised his voice and accused Zhou of behaving unreasonably in rapid Suzhou speech.

即令是吵架，也忘不了说几句俏皮话，于是看热闹的人丛中，便有了笑声。
Even in a quarrel he remembered to add a few witticisms, which drew laughter from the crowd.

周一鸣此时处境甚窘，
Zhou was now in an awkward position.

他倒不是畏惧，而是怕闹得不可开交，误了小狗子的约会，便误了胡雪岩的要紧事，
He was not afraid, but feared becoming so entangled that he would miss Xiaogouzi and spoil Hu's important business.

心里颇为失悔，却苦干找不到一个台阶可下。
He regretted his conduct but could find no way to retreat with dignity.


幸好，有了救星，是胡雪岩，
Fortunately, help arrived in the shape of Hu.

“老周，”他从人背后挤了出来，问道，“跟他吵什么？”
Pushing through the spectators, he asked, “Zhou, why are you quarrelling with him?”

“为了赶辰光，想赁匹马进城，
“I wanted a horse to get into town quickly.

这家伙的马，要拣地方走的，
His horses are particular about where they'll go.

那就算了！
Very well!

‘买卖不成仁义在’，
Even if a bargain falls through, civility remains.

用不着骂人。
There's no need to curse me.”

““哪个骂人？”
“Who cursed you?”

马伕也抢上来分辩，却让胡雪岩止住了。
The groom hurried forward to argue, but Hu stopped him.

“ ‘相骂无好口’，
“No one speaks pleasantly in a quarrel.

谁是谁非，不必再辩。
There's no need to debate who's right.

我只问你，耽误了你的生意没有。”
I ask only this: has he cost you any business?”

“就耽误了生意，也只好我认倒霉。”
“Even if he has, I'll have to put it down to bad luck.”

“那就没话可说了。”胡雪岩说：
“Then there's nothing more to say.

“你赶快招呼你的生意去吧！”
Go and attend to your customers.”

说着，他把周一鸣一拉，掉臂而出，
Taking Zhou by the arm, Hu walked away.

也不必劝解，更不必追问，
There was no need for further soothing or questions.

两个人雇了两顶轿子抬进城，在观前下轿，重新约一约时间，准定正午在金阊栈见面，然后分手，各去干各的。
They hired two sedan chairs into the city, got out at Guanqian, fixed their meeting at Jinchang Inn for noon precisely, and separated to attend to their respective tasks.


胡雪岩本想去找“炉房”，一打听地方远得很，
Hu had intended to find a silver foundry, but inquiries showed it was too far away.

只好找钱庄，
He would have to use a bank instead.

踏进一家门面很象样的“永兴盛”，开口便问：“有没有刚出炉的‘官宝’。”
Entering Yongxingsheng, whose premises looked suitably imposing, he asked at once, “Have you any official ingots fresh from the mould?”

官宝就是五十两一个的大元宝，由藩库监视熔铸，专备解京及其他公用，所以称作“官宝”。
These were large ingots of fifty taels each, cast under the supervision of the provincial treasury for remittances to the capital and other official purposes, hence their name.

钱庄不见得有刚出炉的官宝，但可以到炉房去兑换，甚至现铸，
A bank might not have newly cast ones on hand, but could exchange for them at a foundry or even have them made.

只要顾客愿意“贴水”，无不办到。
Anything was possible if the customer would pay the premium.

永兴盛有个伙计，架子甚大，双手分开成个八字，撑在柜台上，歪着头问：“要多少？”
A clerk at Yongxingsheng, full of his own importance, braced his hands wide apart on the counter, tilted his head, and asked, “How many?”

“要二十个。”
“Twenty.”

二十个就是一千两银子，
Twenty meant a thousand taels.

那伙计拿过算盘来，滴沥搭拉打了几下，算出贴水的银数，然后说道：“要下午才有。”
The clerk pulled over an abacus, rattled through the calculation of the premium, and said, “Not until this afternoon.”

“我有急用，
“I need them urgently.

另贴车费，
I'll pay extra for transport.

拜托代办一办。”于是又说定所贴的车费，胡雪岩付出一大一小两张阜康的“即票”，
Please arrange it.” They agreed on that charge too, and Hu handed over two Fukang notes payable on demand, one large and one small.

那伙计斜睨着说：
The clerk gave them a sidelong look.

“这票子我们不收。”
“We don't accept those notes.”

“为什么？”
“Why?”

“信用靠不住。”如果说跟阜康没有往来，不知道它的虚实，不便收受，胡雪岩倒也无话可说。
“Their credit is unreliable.” Had he said they had no dealings with Fukang and could not accept its notes because they knew nothing of its position, Hu would have had no objection.

说阜康“信用靠不住”，近于诬蔑，
But to call its credit unreliable was close to slander.

他不由得气往上冲，
Anger rose in him.

伸手入怀，取出一大叠银票，其中有鼎鼎大名的京师“四大恒”，以及总号设在汉口、分号二十余处的“日升昌”的票子，
He reached inside his gown for his thick sheaf of notes, which included those of the capital's celebrated “Four Hengs” and Rishengchang, with its head office in Hankou and more than twenty branches.

预备拿到柜台上，叫他自己挑一张。
He meant to put them on the counter and let the man choose.

手已经摸到银票了，转念一想，
His hand had already touched them when he reconsidered.

不必如此，
There was no need.

便忍住了怒气问道：“宝号可出银票？”
Suppressing his anger, he asked, “Does your bank issue notes?”

“当然。”
“Of course.”

“那好。”胡雪岩问道：
“Good.

“如果是宝号的本票，自然是顶靠得住了？”
Its own notes must be perfectly reliable, then?”

“那还用说吗？
“Need you ask?

你有多少，
Bring as many as you like.

我们兑多少。”
We'll redeem them all.”

“我没有。
“I have none.

既然宝号不肯收阜康的票子，我只好到别家了。”
Since you won't accept Fukang's, I must go elsewhere.”

胡雪岩拱拱手说：
Hu clasped his hands.

“对不起，对不起！”
“My apologies.”


出了永兴盛，觉得这口气真咽不下去，
Outside Yongxingsheng, Hu found the insult hard to swallow.

最好马上就能报复，但这不是咄嗟可办的事，
He would have liked to retaliate immediately, but that could not be arranged in a moment.

只得暂且丢开，先另找一家钱号，兑换了二十个官宝，托那家钱庄派一名“出店”送到了金阊栈。
Putting it aside, he found another bank, obtained twenty official ingots, and had one of its outside clerks deliver them to Jinchang Inn.

也不过刚刚把银子堆好，周一鸣陪着小狗子到了，
The silver had scarcely been stacked when Zhou arrived with Xiaogouzi.

引见以后，胡雪岩开门见山地说：
Once they were introduced, Hu came straight to the point.

“我是阿巧姐的客人，
“I'm a patron of Sister A’qiao's.

她托我替她来说句话，
She has asked me to speak for her.

如果他夫家肯放她，她愿意出一千两银子，让她丈夫另外攀亲，还可以买几亩田，
If her husband's family will release her, she's willing to pay a thousand taels so that her husband can marry again and buy a few mu of land.

日子很可以过得去了。
He could live comfortably enough.

我听老周说，这件事有你‘轧脚’在内，
Zhou tells me you're involved in the matter.

‘皇帝不差饿兵’，
An emperor doesn't send hungry soldiers on a mission.

我替阿巧姐作主送你一百两银子。
On Sister A’qiao's behalf, I'll give you a hundred taels.

你看如何？”
What do you say?”

这番话说得很明白，而小狗子仍有突兀之感，
The proposal was plain, yet Xiaogouzi found it abrupt.

最叫他困惑的是，这个自称是王胖子的朋友、曾经一起吃过讲茶的“周大哥”，何以会把自己的底细，摸得这么清楚？
What puzzled him most was how this “Brother Zhou,” who claimed to be Fat Wang's friend and to have attended a tea settlement with him, could know so much about his affairs.

因此，看看周一鸣，又看看胡雪岩，翻着一双白多黑少的三角眼，竟无从作答。
Looking first at Zhou and then at Hu, he rolled his triangular eyes, which showed more white than black, and could find no answer.

就在他这迟疑不语之际，突然觉得眼前一亮——
As he hesitated, a flash of brightness struck him.

胡雪岩把张被单一揭，下面盖着的二十个大元宝，尽皆揭露，簇簇全新，银光闪亮，着实可爱，
Hu had pulled away a sheet, revealing twenty large ingots beneath, all brand-new and glittering with silver light: a truly lovely sight.

另外又有一堆银子，几个“中锭”，一些“元丝”，估计是百把两上下，
Beside them lay another pile, several medium-sized ingots and some pieces of refined silver, perhaps a hundred taels in all.

这不消说是，是预备送自己的谢礼。
Plainly, that was the reward intended for him.

俗语道得好：“财帛动人心”，
“Money moves the heart,” as the saying went.

胡雪岩是钱眼里不知翻过多少跟斗的，最懂得这句俗语，
Hu, who had turned countless somersaults through the eye of a coin, understood this better than anyone.

所以特地要换官宝，好来打动小狗子的心。
That was why he had gone out of his way to obtain official ingots.

这是胡雪岩熟透世故、参透人生、驾驭世人的一帖万应灵药，
Knowledge of the world, insight into human nature, and command over other men had given him this unfailing prescription.

小狗子心里也知道，阿巧姐真正成了奇货。
Xiaogouzi knew, too, that A’qiao had become a valuable commodity.

说书的常说：美人无价，
Storytellers always said a beauty was beyond price.

若是咬定牙关不放松，弄个一万八千的也容易得很，
If he held firm, eighteen thousand taels would be easy enough to get.

这区区一千两银子算得了什么？
What was a mere thousand?

无奈心里是这样想，那双眼睛却不听话，
Such were his thoughts, yet his eyes refused to obey.

盯住了叠得老高，耀眼生花的大元宝不肯放。
They would not leave the gleaming pile of ingots.

当然口中无话。
Naturally, he said nothing.

周一鸣要催他，嘴唇刚一动，让胡雪岩摇手止住了。
Zhou moved his lips to press him, but Hu stopped him with a gesture.


他很有耐心，尽让小狗子去想。
Hu was patient and let Xiaogouzi think.

银子如美色，“不见可欲，其心不乱”，
Silver was like beauty: “Let a man see nothing to desire, and his mind remains untroubled.”

或者刚看一眼，硬生生被隔开，倒也罢了，
Even if he caught a glimpse and was abruptly cut off from it, that could be endured.

就是这可望而不可即的境况之下，一定越看越动心，
But when it remained visible and just beyond his reach, each look intensified his longing.

小狗子此时的心情，就慢慢变成这个样子了。
Xiaogouzi was gradually reaching precisely that state.

“凡事不必勉强。”胡雪岩开口了，
“Nothing need be forced,” Hu said at last.

再不开口，小狗子开不得口，会成僵局，
If he did not speak, Xiaogouzi could not, and they would be deadlocked.

“你如有难处，不妨直说。”
“If there's a difficulty on your side, say so.”

“难处？”小狗子茫然地问。
“A difficulty?” Xiaogouzi asked blankly.

胡雪岩看他有点财迷心窍的模样，便象变戏法似地，拎起被单的一角，往上一抖，
Seeing how the money had bewitched him, Hu lifted a corner of the sheet and flicked it upwards like a conjuror.

被单飞展，正好又把元宝覆住。
It spread through the air and settled exactly over the ingots.

这一来，小狗子的一颗心，才又回到了腔子里。
Only then did Xiaogouzi recover his senses.

“我也晓得你老哥是在外头跑跑的，做事‘落门落槛’，所以爽爽快快跟你说。”胡雪岩说，
“I know you're a man of the world who understands how things are done,” Hu continued. “That's why I've spoken plainly.

“我是受人之托，
I'm acting for someone else.

事情成不成，在我毫无关系，
Whether it succeeds or fails makes no difference to me.

只要讨你一句回话，我就有交代了。”
I only need an answer to take back.”

银子等于已经收起来了，
The money had effectively been put away.

似乎只等自己一句话，事情便成罢论。
One word from him, it seemed, and the whole matter would be dropped.

这样一个局面，轻易放弃，总觉得“于心不忍”，
Such an opportunity was too painful to surrender lightly.

因此不译言地答了句：“我来想办法。”
“I'll find a way,” he answered involuntarily.

“这就是了。”胡雪岩接着他的话说，
“That's the spirit.

“我们都是居间的人，
We're both intermediaries.

有话尽不妨实说，有难处大家商量着办。
We can speak frankly and discuss any difficulties together.

你老哥是何办法？我要请教。”
What way do you have in mind?”

“事情我做不得主，
“I can't decide it myself.

我只有尽力去说。
I can only do my best to persuade them.

成不成，不敢包。”小狗子又说，“如果数目上有上落，应该怎么说法？
I can't guarantee success.” Xiaogouzi added, “And if there's some difference over the amount, what should I say?

要请胡老爷给我一句话，我心里好有个数。”
Please give me something to go on, Mr Hu.”


这到了讨价还价的时候，可说大事已定，
They had reached the bargaining stage, which meant the main issue was effectively settled.

胡雪岩略想一想说：
Hu considered briefly.

“我在苏州很忙，实在没有闲工夫来磨，
“I'm very busy in Suzhou and have no spare time for haggling.

这样，予人方便，自己方便，
Make things easy for others, and they're easier for you too.

如果不耽误我的工夫，我花钱买个痛快。
If you don't waste my time, I'll pay for promptness.

明天一早，能够立笔据，我自己贴四个大元宝。”
If the documents can be signed first thing tomorrow, I'll add four large ingots myself.”

“明天一早怕来不及。”
“Tomorrow morning may be too soon.”

“至迟明天中午，
“Noon tomorrow at the latest.

中午不成，这件享就免谈了。
If it can't be done by noon, there's nothing more to discuss.

一千两银子有人想用。”这话是什么意思？小狗子方在猜疑，周一鸣便桴鼓相应地说了句：“刑房的张书办，我是约了明天中午吃酒。”
Someone else has a use for a thousand taels.” As Xiaogouzi wondered what this meant, Zhou supplied the perfectly timed response: “I've invited Clerk Zhang of the criminal office to drink with me tomorrow at noon.”

两句话加在一起，表示这一千两银子，可能送给张书办，
Together, the two remarks implied that the thousand taels might go to Zhang.

送钱给刑房书办用，自然是要打官司，
Money for a clerk in the criminal office naturally meant a lawsuit.

小狗子越发心存警惕，
Xiaogouzi grew still more alert.

于是连连点头：“好的，好的。
“Yes, yes,” he said, nodding repeatedly.

我准定明天中午，把‘原主’带了来，
“I'll certainly bring the husband here by noon tomorrow.

要立笔据，我就是中人。”
I'll act as intermediary for the documents.”

“我们这方面，请老周做中人。”
“Zhou will act for our side.”

胡雪岩把那一百两银子取了来，放在小狗子面前，
Hu took the hundred taels and put them before Xiaogouzi.

“这个，你先收了。”
“Take this now.”

小狗子喜出望外，但口头还自要客气两句：
Xiaogouzi was delighted beyond expectation, though he offered the required polite objection.

“没有这个规矩！”
“That isn't the custom.”

“规矩是人立的，
“People make customs.

我的规矩一向如此，
This has always been mine.

你先把你的一百两银子拿了去，
Take your hundred taels first.

跑起腿来也有劲。”胡雪岩还附带奉送了一块簇新的绸面布里的包袱，将银子亲手包好，交了过去。
It'll give you more energy for running about.” Hu added a brand-new wrapping cloth, silk outside and cotton within, bundled up the silver himself, and handed it over.

小狗子算一算，这件事办成功了，那一千二百两银子中，明的中人钱，暗的二八回扣，还有三百两银子好进帐，
Xiaogouzi calculated that if the affair succeeded, the twelve hundred taels would yield him another three hundred through the open intermediary's fee and the concealed twenty-per-cent kickback.

平白撞出这一炷财香，也多亏周一鸣，
Such a windfall had dropped out of nowhere, and he owed it to Zhou.

所以向胡雪岩道了谢，招招手说：
After thanking Hu, he beckoned.

“周大哥，请你陪我出去。”
“Brother Zhou, please come outside with me.”


周一鸣陪他出了门，
Zhou accompanied him out.

等走回来时，手里托着两个“中锭”，笑嘻嘻地说：
When he returned, he carried two medium-sized ingots and was smiling broadly.

“这家伙倒还有良心，
“The fellow has a conscience after all.

说饮水思源，是我身上来的路子，要送二十两银子给我，
He said one should remember the source when drinking water, and since the opportunity had come through me, he wanted to give me twenty taels.

我乐得收下来，物归原主。”
I was happy to accept, so I could return them to their rightful owner.”

说着，把两锭银子摆在胡雪岩面前。
He set the ingots before Hu.

“笑话，
“Nonsense.

他送你的，
He gave them to you.

跟我啥相干？
What have they to do with me?

你收下好了！
Keep them.

明天‘写纸’，我们照买卖不动产的规矩，‘成三败二’，
Tomorrow, when the papers are signed, we'll follow the custom for property transactions: ‘three from the buyer, two from the seller.’

中人钱五厘，你们‘南北开’，
The intermediary's commission is five li, divided between the two sides.

还有三十两银子，
You'll have another thirty taels.

是你应得的好处。”
That's your rightful benefit.”

周一鸣也平白进帐了五十两银子，
Zhou had thus gained fifty taels out of nowhere.

高兴得不得了，自然也把胡雪岩奉若神明，敬重得不得了，自告奋勇，要去接阿巧姐回来。
Overjoyed, he revered Hu as though he were a god and volunteered to fetch A’qiao.

“不忙，不忙，
“No hurry.

让她在潘家住两天。”胡雪岩说：
Let her stay at the Pans' a couple of days,” Hu replied.

“我倒有两件事跟你商量。”
“There are two other matters I'd like to discuss.”

这两件事，第一件是他这天早上在永兴盛受的气要出，
The first was the insult he had suffered at Yongxingsheng that morning. He wanted redress.

问周一鸣有何妙计？
Did Zhou have a clever suggestion?

“心思好不过胡大老爷。”周一鸣答道，
“No mind is better than yours, Mr Hu.

“你老想出法子来，跑腿归我。”
You think of the plan, and I'll do the legwork.”

“法子倒有一个，我怕手段太辣。
“I do have a plan, but I'm afraid it may be too harsh.

我先讲个票号的故事你听……”
Let me tell you a story about a remittance house first.”


京师的票号，最大的四家，招牌都有个“恒”字，通称“四大恒”。
The four largest remittance houses in the capital all had the character Heng in their names and were commonly called the “Four Hengs.”

行大欺客，也欺同行，
Great businesses could bully their customers, and their competitors too.

有家异军突起的票号，字号“义源”，专发钱票，
A rising house called Yiyuan specialised in copper-cash notes.

因为做生意迁就和气，信用又好，营业蒸蒸日上。
Courteous and accommodating in its business, and sound in credit, it prospered rapidly.

而且发钱票专跟市井细民打交道，
Its notes circulated chiefly among ordinary townspeople.

这口碑一立，一传十，十传百，市面上传得很快，连官场中都晓得义源的信誉了。
Once its good name was established, word spread from one to ten and ten to a hundred, until even official circles knew its reputation.

四大恒一看这情形，同行相妒，就要想法打击义源，
Jealous of a competitor, the Four Hengs set out to damage it.

于是一面暗地里收义源所出的票子，收了去兑现，一面放出谣言，说义源快要倒闭了，
They secretly collected its notes and presented them for redemption while spreading rumours that it was about to fail.

这一来造成了挤兑的风潮。
A run followed.

哪知一连三天，义源见票即兑，连等都不用等，
Yet for three days Yiyuan redeemed every note on sight, without even making people wait.

第四天，风平浪静，义源的名气反倒越加响了。
On the fourth day calm returned, and its reputation was stronger than before.

四大恒见此光景，自然要去打听它的实力，一打听才晓得遇上了不倒的劲敌，
The Four Hengs naturally investigated its resources, only to discover an unshakable opponent.

义源有实钱四百万，
Yiyuan had four million in cash reserves.

出了一张票子，照数提一笔另行存贮，
Whenever it issued a note, it set aside the full corresponding amount in a separate reserve.

从来不发空票，所以不致受窘。
It never issued an unbacked note, so it could not be embarrassed.

这个故事一说，周一鸣就懂了，
Zhou understood the point.

“胡大老爷，”他问，“你的意思也是想收‘义源’的票子，去‘整’它一家伙？”
“Mr Hu, you mean to collect Yongxingsheng's notes and give it a lesson?”

“对了！
“Exactly.

不过我又怕象‘四大恒’跟‘义源’一样。”胡雪岩说：
But I'm afraid of repeating what happened between the Four Hengs and Yiyuan.

“你做初一，人家做初二，
One man makes a move today, and the other answers tomorrow.

弄‘义源’不倒，‘义源’来整我的阜康，岂不是自讨苦吃？”
If I fail to bring Yongxingsheng down and it turns on Fukang, wouldn't I be asking for trouble?”

“是的。这一点不可不妨。”周一鸣说，
“Yes, we must guard against that.

“等我去打听打听‘义源’的实力看。
Let me find out how strong it is.

实力不厚，不妨‘将他一军’，
If its resources are thin, we can put it in check.

不然，还得另想别法。”
Otherwise we'll need another method.”

“我就是这个意思，
“Just what I mean.

你去打听了再说。
Make inquiries first.

好在这件事不忙。
Fortunately, there's no hurry.

我讲另外一件。”
Now for the other matter.”


另一件事是要送潘叔雅一笔礼，
The other matter was a gift for Pan Shuya.

一则酬谢他暂作阿巧姐居停的情谊，再则是胡雪岩觉得象这样的人，大可做个朋友，有心想结纳。
Hu wanted both to thank him for lodging A’qiao and to cultivate his friendship, for a man like that was well worth knowing.

如果说，仅仅是还人情债，这笔礼很容易送，反正花上几十两银子，买四色礼物，情意就算到了。
If he merely wished to discharge a debt of courtesy, the gift would be easy: spend a few dozen taels on four kinds of presents, and the obligation would be met.

但要谈结纳，则必须使潘叔雅对这笔礼重视，甚至见情，
Friendship required something Pan would value, even something that would touch him.

他家大富，再贵重的礼物，也未见得放在心上。
The family was rich; no costly object was likely to impress it.

或者是杭州的土产，物稀为贵，倒也留下一个印象，无奈人在苏州，无法办到。
Local products from Hangzhou might have left an impression through their rarity, but Hu was in Suzhou and could not obtain them.

这番意思说了出来，等于又替周一鸣出了个难题，
Explaining all this posed another difficult problem for Zhou.

“送礼总要送人家求之不得的东西。”他说，
“A gift should be something the recipient wants but can't get,” Zhou said.

“潘家有钱，
“The Pans have money.

少的是面子。
What they lack is prestige.

能不能送他个面子？”
Could you give them that?”

“这话说得妙！”
“Beautifully put!”

胡雪岩抚掌称赏，
Hu clapped in approval.

“我们就动脑筋，寻个面子来送他。”
“Let's think of some distinction we can give him.”

这两句话对周一鸣是极大的鼓励，凝神眨眼，动足脑筋，果有所得，
Encouraged, Zhou concentrated, blinking as he worked his mind, and came up with an idea.

“我倒有个主意，你老看行不行？”他说，
“See what you think of this.

“何学台跟你老的交情够了，
Your friendship with Education Commissioner He is close enough.

托他出面，送潘家一个面子。”
Ask him to honour the Pan household.”

“这个主意的意思很好。”胡雪岩深深点头，
Hu nodded gravely. “The principle is excellent.

“不过，我倒想不出，这个面子怎么送法？”
But how exactly?”

“可以这样子办，你老写封信给何学台，
“You could write to him.

事情要不要说清楚，请你老自己斟酌，
Whether to explain the circumstances fully is for you to decide.

如果不愿意细说，含含糊糊也可以，
If you'd rather not, you can be vague.

就说，这趟很承潘某人帮忙，请何学台代为去拜访潘某人道谢。”周一鸣说，
Just say that Mr Pan has been a great help on this visit, and ask the commissioner to call and thank him on your behalf.

“二品大员，全副导子去拜访他，不是蛮有面子的事？”
A second-rank official paying a visit with his full ceremonial escort—wouldn't that confer considerable prestige?”

“好极，好极。
“Excellent!

这个主意高明之至，
A brilliant idea.

高明得……老周，你自己都不晓得高明在哪里？”
So brilliant, Zhou, that you don't know yourself where its brilliance lies.”

这是什么怪话？
This was a strange remark.

周一鸣大为困惑，自然也无法赞一词，只望着胡雪岩翻眼。
Zhou was thoroughly puzzled and could only stare.

胡雪岩也不作解释，还没有到可以说破的时候，
Hu offered no explanation; the time had not come to reveal his intentions.

他已经决定照官场中通行的风气，买妾以赠，安排阿巧姐做何桂清的侧室。
He had decided to follow a common practice in official circles: purchase a concubine as a gift, arranging for A’qiao to become He Guiqing's secondary wife.

这一来，阿巧姐在潘家作客，何桂清亦应见情，
Since she was staying with the Pans, He too would owe them gratitude.

所以代胡雪岩道谢，实在也就是他自己道谢。
Thanking them for Hu would really be thanking them for himself.

周一鸣的主意，隐含着这一重意义，便显得极外高明，只是他自己不明白而已。
Zhou's suggestion contained this further significance, which made it exceptionally clever, though he himself did not know it.


“准定这样子办。”
“That's certainly what we'll do.”

胡雪岩相当高兴，但也相当惋惜，
Hu was pleased, yet regretful too.

“老周，你很能干，
“Zhou, you're very capable.

可惜不能来帮我。”
It's a pity you can't come and work for me.”

周一鸣心中一动。
Zhou was stirred.

他也觉得跟胡雪岩做事，不但爽脆痛快，而且凡事都是着着占上风，十分够味，
He too felt that working for Hu was brisk and satisfying: every move seemed to give them the upper hand.

但到扬州去办厘金，大小是个官，而且出息不错，
Yet the lijin post in Yangzhou was an official appointment, however modest, with a good income.

舍弃了似乎也可惜，
It would be a pity to abandon it.

所以也只好表示抱歉：
He could only express regret.

“是啊！
“Yes.

有机会我也很想跟胡大老爷。”
If the opportunity arose, I'd very much like to serve you.”

“那都再说了。”
“We can discuss that later.”

胡雪岩欣快的站起身，
Hu rose cheerfully.

“今天我没事了，
“I've nothing more today.

到城里去逛逛。
I'll go and look round the city.

你去打听打听永兴盛的虚实，
Find out how matters really stand at Yongxingsheng.

晚上我们仍旧在元大昌碰面。”
We'll meet at Yuandachang again tonight.”

于是胡雪岩去逛了玄妙观，吃茶“听大书”，
Hu visited Xuanmiao Temple, drank tea, and listened to a long storytelling performance.

等书场散了出来，安步当车到元大昌，挑了一副好座头，一个人先自斟自饮，等候周一鸣。
When the session ended, he strolled to Yuandachang, chose a good seat, and began drinking alone while he waited.

吃完一斤花雕，周一鸣来了，脸上是诡秘的笑容。
By the time he had finished a jin of Huadiao wine, Zhou arrived, wearing a secretive smile.

胡雪岩笑道：
Hu smiled back.

“看样子，永兴盛要伤伤脑筋了。”
“It looks as though Yongxingsheng may be in for a headache.”

“说巧真巧！”周一鸣很起劲地说，
“An extraordinary coincidence!” Zhou said eagerly.

“恰好我有个熟人在永兴盛当‘出店’，
“An acquaintance of mine works there as an outside clerk.

邀出来吃了碗茶，全本‘西厢记’都在我肚里了。”
I invited him for tea, and now I have the whole ‘Romance of the Western Chamber’ in my head.”

“好极，好极！
“Excellent!

先吃酒。”
Have some wine first.”

胡雪岩亲手替他斟了碗热酒，
Hu poured him a bowl of warm wine himself.

“边吃边谈。”
“We can drink and talk.”


“永兴盛这爿店，该当整它一整，
“Yongxingsheng deserves a lesson.

来路就不正……”周一鸣从这家钱庄的来路谈起。
Its very origins are crooked...” Zhou began with the bank's history.

老板本来姓陈，节俭起家，苦了半辈子才创下这点基业，
The original owner, surnamed Chen, had built his business through thrift, enduring hardship for half his life.

不想老板做不到一年，一场伤寒，一命呜呼，
Yet he had scarcely been a proprietor for a year when a fever carried him off.

死的那年，四十刚刚出头，留下一妻一子。
He was barely into his forties and left a wife and a son.

孤儿寡妇，容易受人欺侮，
A widow and orphan were easily preyed upon.

其中有个伙计也姓陈，心计极深，
One of the clerks, also surnamed Chen, was deeply calculating.

对老板娘嘘寒送暖，无微不至，结果人财两得，
He lavished concern on the widow and attended to her every need, eventually gaining both the woman and her money.

名为永兴盛的档手，其实就是老板。
Nominally Yongxingsheng's manager, he was in fact its owner.

“真叫是一报还一报！”
“One turn deserves another!”

周一鸣大大喝口酒说，
Zhou took a long drink.

“现在这个陈老板，有个女儿，
“This present Boss Chen has a daughter.

让店里一个伙计勾搭上了，
A clerk in the bank became involved with her.

生米煮成熟饭，只好招赘到家。
By the time the raw rice was cooked, there was nothing to do but take him into the household as a son-in-law.

这伙计外号‘冲天炮’，就是得罪了你老的那个家伙。”
His nickname is ‘Skyrocket’—the fellow who offended you.”

“怪不得这么神气！
“No wonder he's so full of himself.

原来是‘钦赐黄马褂’的身分。”胡雪岩问道，“这个陈老板图谋人家孤儿寡妇，他女婿又是这样子张牙舞爪，
He has the standing of a man awarded an imperial yellow jacket.” Hu asked, “This Boss Chen schemed against a widow and orphan, and his son-in-law behaves like that.

他店里的朋友一定不服，
The other men in the bank must resent them.

这爿店怎么开得好？”
How can it prosper?”

“一点不错！”
“Exactly!”

周一鸣放下酒杯，击着桌面说，
Zhou put down his cup and struck the table.

“真正什么毛病都逃不过你老的眼睛，
“No weakness escapes you.

不是这样子，我那个朋友，怎么会‘张松献地图’来泄他的底？”
If that weren't the case, why would my friend act like Zhang Song presenting a map and reveal their secrets?”

照周一鸣所知的底细，永兴盛已经岌岌可危，
According to Zhou's information, Yongxingsheng was already in a dangerous position.

毛病出在姓陈的过于贪心，贪图重利，放了几笔帐出去，收不回来，
Chen had been too greedy, lending several sums at high interest that he could not recover.

所以周转有些不灵，
Cash flow was therefore strained.

本来就只有十万银子的本钱，票子倒开出去有二十几万。
Its capital had only ever amounted to a hundred thousand taels, yet it had issued notes for more than two hundred thousand.

永兴盛的伙计因为替死掉的陈老板不平，所以都巴不得活着的这个陈老板垮了下来。
Resenting the wrong done to the dead Boss Chen, the clerks all longed to see the living one collapse.

胡雪岩是此道中人，
Hu knew the business.

听了周一鸣的话，略一盘算，就知道要搞垮永兴盛并不难，
A brief calculation showed him that bringing Yongxingsheng down would not be difficult.

如果有五万银票去兑现，就能要它的好看，有十万银票，则非关门不可。
Present fifty thousand taels in notes, and it would suffer; present a hundred thousand, and it would have to close.

看姓陈的为人，在同行当中所得的支持，一定有限。
A man of Chen's character could expect little support from other banks.

而且同行纵讲义气，到底“救急容易，救穷难”，
Even where fellow bankers felt a duty to help, it was easy to relieve a temporary emergency and hard to cure insolvency.

永兴盛的情形，不是一时周转不灵，
Yongxingsheng's difficulties were more than a passing shortage.

垫了钱下去，收不回来，
Any money advanced would be lost.

没有人肯做这样的傻事。
Nobody would willingly be so foolish.

转念一想，
But then Hu reconsidered.

自己搞垮了永兴盛，有何好处？
What benefit would he gain by destroying it?

没有好处，只有坏处，
None—only harm.

风声传出去，说杭州阜康的胡雪岩，手段太辣，
Word would spread that Hu Xueyan of Hangzhou's Fukang Bank was ruthless.

苏州同业动了公愤，合力对付，阜康在苏州这个码头就算卖断了。
The Suzhou bankers might be outraged and unite against him, shutting Fukang out of the city for good.


“算了！”胡雪岩笑笑说道，
“Let it go,” Hu said with a smile.

“我不喜欢打落水狗，
“I don't like beating a drowning dog.

放他一马！”
We'll spare him.”

“胡大老爷，”周一鸣反倒不服气，“总要给他个教训，
Zhou, however, was dissatisfied. “Mr Hu, he ought to be taught a lesson.

而且阜康也来创创牌子。”
Besides, Fukang could make a name for itself.”

胡雪岩想了想说：
Hu considered.

“这倒可以！
“That's possible.

让我好好想一想。”
Let me think it through.”

这件事就不谈了。
They dropped the subject.

胡雪岩放宽了心思喝酒，难得有这样轻松的时候，
Hu drank with an easy mind; such moments of relaxation were rare.

不觉过量，喝到酩酊大醉，连怎么回金阊栈的都记不清楚了。
Without noticing, he drank too much and became so thoroughly drunk that he could not remember how he got back to Jinchang Inn.

到得第二天醒过来，只觉得浑身发软，
When he woke the following day, his whole body felt weak.

因而便懒得出门，在客栈里静坐休息，一个人喝着酽茶，回想前一天的一切，
Too languid to go out, he sat resting at the inn, drinking strong tea alone and reviewing the previous day's events.

觉得周一鸣有句话，倒颇有意味，
One remark of Zhou's had considerable point.

跟永兴盛斗闲气是犯不着，但阜康的招牌，要到苏州来打响了它，却是很高明的看法。
A quarrel with Yongxingsheng was not worth the trouble, but making Fukang's name in Suzhou was an excellent idea.

因为苏州已是两江的第一重镇，军需公款，各省协饷，进出甚巨，
Suzhou had become the most important centre in Liangjiang, handling immense flows of military funds and assistance remitted by other provinces.

如果阜康要想象汉口日升昌那样，遍设分号，大展身手，苏州是个一定要打的码头。
If Fukang was to spread branches everywhere and operate on a grand scale like Rishengchang of Hankou, Suzhou was a market it must enter.

打码头不外乎两种手段，
There were only two ways to establish oneself.

一是名符其实的“打”，以力服人，那是流氓“立万儿”的法子，
One was literally to fight one's way in, compelling submission by force—the method of a street ruffian making his name.

胡雪岩也可以办得到，逼垮永兴盛，叫大家知道他的厉害，
Hu could do that too: crush Yongxingsheng and let everyone see his power.

然而他不肯这样做，
But he would not.

他的铁定不变的宗旨，是杭州的一句俗语：“花花轿儿人抬人”，
His unchanging principle was the Hangzhou saying, “People lift one another as they carry a flowered bridal chair.”

这个宗旨，为他造成了今天的地位，以后自然还是奉行不渝。
That principle had brought him to his present position, and he would continue to follow it.

这样，便只有“以德服人”来打码头，
The other course was to win acceptance through goodwill.

想起“冲天炮”的脸嘴，实在可恨，但做生意绝对不可以斗气，
Remembering Skyrocket's face still filled him with disgust, but business must never become a contest of temper.

他心平气和地考虑下来，觉得永兴盛大可用来作为踏上苏州这个码头的跳板，
Considering matters calmly, he saw that Yongxingsheng might serve as a stepping-stone into Suzhou.

现在要想的是，这条跳板如何搭法？
The question was how to place it.


看样子那个陈老板不是好相与的人。
Boss Chen did not seem an easy man to deal with.

象这样的人，胡雪岩也看得多，江湖上叫做半吊子，上海人称为“蜡烛”，“不点不亮”，
Hu had seen many of his kind: half-wits, as men of the world called them, or “candles,” as the people of Shanghai said—no light until someone set a flame to them.

要收服他，必得先辣后甜，叫他苦头吃过尝甜头，那就服服帖帖了。
To bring such a man under control, one had to begin harshly and turn kind: let him taste hardship before sweetness, and he would become perfectly obedient.

照此想法，胡雪岩很快拟定了一个计划。
With this in mind, Hu quickly formed a plan.

浙江跟江苏的公款往来，他可以想法子影响的，第一是海运局方面分摊的公费，第二是湖州联防的军需款项，以及直接由湖州解缴江苏的协饷，
He could influence two streams of official payments between Zhejiang and Jiangsu: the shared expenses of the Sea Transport Bureau, and the military funds for Huzhou's joint defences, together with assistance remitted directly from Huzhou to Jiangsu.

这两部分汇到江苏的款子，都搜罗永兴盛的票子，直接解交江苏藩司和粮台，
For both streams, Yongxingsheng notes could be collected and sent straight to the Jiangsu provincial treasury and military finance office.

公款当然提现，
Public funds would naturally be redeemed in cash.

这一下等于借刀杀人，立刻就要叫永兴盛好看。
This was borrowing another man's knife, and it would immediately put Yongxingsheng in difficulties.

到了不可开支的时候，但要由阜康出面来“挺”了。
Once it could no longer meet its payments, Fukang would step forward to support it.

那时永兴盛便成为俎上之肉，怎么牢割都可以，或者维持它，或者接收了过来。
Then Yongxingsheng would be meat on the chopping board, to be cut as he pleased: he could either keep it going or take it over.

当然，这要担风险，
There were risks, of course.

永兴盛是个烂摊子，
The bank was a mess.

维持它是从井救人，接收下来可能成为不了之局。
Supporting it might be like jumping down a well to save a drowning man; taking it over might bring endless entanglements.

整个计划，这一点是成败的关键所在。
This was the point on which the whole plan would succeed or fail.

胡雪岩颇费思考，
Hu thought hard.

想来想去，只有这样做法最稳妥，就是临时见机行事，
The safest course seemed to be to judge the situation as it developed.

能管则管，
If it could be managed, he would intervene.

不能管反正有江苏官方出面去提款，自己这方面并无干系。
If not, the Jiangsu authorities would be the ones demanding payment, and his own side would have nothing to do with it.

然而这样做法，稳当是稳当，可能劳而无功，也可能损人不利己，徒然搞垮永兴盛。
Yet safe though that might be, it could leave him with nothing for his effort, or damage others without benefiting himself, merely destroying Yongxingsheng.

转念到此，觉得现在还不到决定的时候，
At this thought he realised that it was too early to decide.

这事如果真的要做，还得进一步去摸一摸永兴盛的底，到底盈亏如何，陈老板另外有多少产业，万一倒闭下来，“讲倒帐”有个几成数？
Before doing anything, he must investigate further: what were its real profits and losses, what other property did Chen own, and if the bank failed, what proportion of its debts could be recovered in a settlement?

这些情形都了解了，才能有所决定。
Only with that information could he reach a decision.


因此，等周一鸣一到，他就这样问：“你那个在水兴盛的朋友，对他们店里的底细，究意知道多少？”
When Zhou arrived, Hu asked, “How much does your friend at Yongxingsheng actually know about its affairs?”

“那就说不上来了，
“I can't say.

不过，要打听也容易，
But inquiries would be easy.

永兴盛的伙计大都跟陈老板和那个‘冲天炮’不和，
Most of the clerks are at odds with Boss Chen and Skyrocket.

只要知道底细，一定肯说。”
If they know the details, they'll certainly tell.”

“好的，
“Good.

你托你那朋友去打听。”胡雪岩说，
Ask your friend to investigate.

“事情要做得秘密。”
It must be done secretly.”

“我知道，
“I understand.

不过，这不是三两天的事。
But it will take more than two or three days.

怕你老等不及。”
I'm afraid you may not be able to wait.”

“不忙，不忙！”胡雪岩说，
“There's no hurry.

“你打听好了，写信给我就是。”
Write when you've found out.”

“是！”
“Yes.”

周一鸣停了一下又说：“我把胡大老爷的事办好了，就动身到扬州，先看看情形，
Zhou paused, then added, “Once I've finished your business, I'll go to Yangzhou and see how things are.

倘或没啥意思，我到上海来投奔你老。”
If there's nothing worthwhile there, I'll come and join you in Shanghai.”

“我也希望你到我这里来。
“I hope you will.

果真扬州没意思，我欢迎你。
If Yangzhou really doesn't suit you, you're welcome.

不过，不必勉强。”
But there's no need to force it.”

胡雪岩仍旧回到永兴盛的话头上，
Hu returned to Yongxingsheng.

“你那个朋友叫啥？”
“What's your friend's name?”

“他姓郑，叫郑品三。”
“Zheng Pinsan.”

“为人如何？”
“What sort of man is he?”

“蛮老实，也蛮能干的。”
“Very honest, and quite capable too.”

“这倒难得！
“That's rare.

老实的往往无用，能干的又以滑头居多。”
Honest men are often useless, and most capable ones are slippery.”

胡雪岩心念一动，
An idea occurred to Hu.

“既然是这样一个人，你能不能带他来见一见？”
“If he's that sort of man, could you bring him to see me?”

“当然！当然！
“Of course!

他也晓得你老的。”
He knows of you too.”

“他怎么会晓得？”
“How?”

“是我跟他说的。
“I've told him about you.

不过他也听说过，杭州阜康的东家姓胡。”周一鸣问道，
But he'd also heard that the owner of Fukang in Hangzhou was a Mr Hu.

“胡大老爷看什么时候方便，
When would be convenient?

我带他来。”
I'll bring him over.”

“你明天就要动身，
“You're leaving tomorrow.

你今天晚上带他来好了。”
Bring him tonight.”



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十三章起连续正文（之四；底本未标第二十四章）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Continuous text beginning with Chapter Twenty-Three, part four (the source supplies no Chapter Twenty-Four heading)
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


* * *小狗子果然很巴结，
* * * Xiaogouzi proved most eager to oblige.

“午炮”刚刚放过，人就来了，一共来了五个人，
The noon gun had scarcely sounded when he arrived with his party, five men in all.

三个留在院子里，带着麻袋和扁担。一个带进屋来，不用说，是阿巧姐的丈夫。
Three remained in the courtyard with sacks and carrying poles; the one he brought indoors was, plainly, A’qiao's husband.

据说他姓陈。四十岁左右，畏畏缩缩是个极老实的人，
Said to be surnamed Chen, he was about forty, a timid, thoroughly honest-looking fellow.

臃臃肿肿一件棉袄，外面罩着件簇新的毛蓝布衫，赤脚草鞋。
Over a bulky padded jacket he wore a brand-new blue cotton gown, with straw sandals on his bare feet.

进得门来，只缩在门边，脸上说不出是忸怩还是害怕。
Once inside, he shrank against the doorway, looking either embarrassed or frightened.

“请坐，请坐！”
“Sit down, please.”

胡雪岩转脸问小狗子，
Hu turned to Xiaogouzi.

“都谈好了？”
“Everything agreed?”

“谈好了。”
“Everything.”

说着，他从身上掏出来两张桑皮纸的笔据，
He took out two written agreements on mulberry-bark paper.

连“休书”都预备好了。
Even the letter of divorce was ready.

胡雪岩接过来看了一遍，
Hu read them through.

写得十分扎实，表示满意，
They were drawn up very securely, and he expressed his satisfaction.

“就这样！”
“This will do.”

他指着周一鸣说，“我们这面的中人在这里，
Pointing to Zhou Yiming, he said, “Here's the intermediary for our side.

你算是那方面的中人。
You represent the other side.

还要个‘代笔’，
We still need a scribe.

就挑金阊栈的帐房赚几个。”
Let the bookkeeper at Jinchang Inn earn a little.”

“胡大老爷，”小狗子赶紧抢着说，“代笔我们带来了。”接着便往外喊了一声：“刘先生！”
“Mr Hu,” Xiaogouzi hastened to interrupt, “we've brought our own scribe.” He called outside, “Mr Liu!”

五个人当中，只有这个“刘先生”是穿了长衫的，
Of the five men, this Mr Liu alone wore a long gown.

獐头鼠目，不似善类。
His furtive, ratlike appearance suggested no good character.


胡雪岩忽然动了疑心，
Hu suddenly grew suspicious.

然后发觉自己有一步棋，非走不可的，却忘了去走。
Then he realized that he had forgotten an indispensable move.

因此，一面敷衍着，一面把周一鸣拉到一边，悄悄说道：“有件事，我疏忽了。
Keeping up appearances, he drew Zhou aside and whispered, “I've overlooked something.

你看，这姓陈的，象不象阿巧姐的男人？”
Does this Chen fellow look like A’qiao's husband to you?”

“这怎么看得出来？”
“How could anyone tell by looking?”

“万一是冒充的，怎么办？
“Suppose he's an impostor?

钱还是小事，要闹大笑话！”
The money would be a small matter; we'd make fools of ourselves.

胡雪岩说，“我昨天忘了关照一句话，应该请他们族长到场。”
Yesterday I forgot to tell them to bring their clan head.”

“那也可以。
“That can still be done.

我跟小狗子去说。”
I'll speak to Xiaogouzi.”

“一来一往，耽误工夫也麻烦。”
“Going back and forth would waste time and cause trouble.

胡雪岩说：“只要‘验明正身’，不是冒充，他们陈家族长来不来，倒也不生关系。”
So long as we establish his identity and know he isn't an impostor, it doesn't matter whether the Chen clan head comes.”

“哪个晓得他是不是冒充？”周一鸣说，
“Who can tell whether he's an impostor?” Zhou said.

“除非请阿巧姐自己来认。”
“Unless we ask A’qiao herself to identify him.”

这倒是一语破的！
That went straight to the heart of it.

除此以外，别无善策，
There was no better way.

胡雪岩考虑了一下，断然定下了缓兵之计。
Hu considered, then resolved on a delaying manoeuvre.

于是周一鸣受命招待小狗子吃午饭，胡雪岩则以要到钱庄去兑银子作托词，出了金阊栈，坐轿直奔潘家。
Zhou was told to take Xiaogouzi to lunch, while Hu left Jinchang Inn on the pretext of going to a bank to obtain silver, and took a sedan chair straight to the Pans' house.


一张名帖，附上一个丰腴的门包，胡雪岩向潘家的门房，坦率道明来意，
With a visiting card and a generous gratuity for the doorkeeper, Hu frankly explained his purpose.

他家主人见不见都无所谓，目的是要跟阿巧姐见面。
Whether the master received him did not matter; he had come to see A’qiao.

潘叔雅是惮于世俗应酬的“大少爷”，
Pan Shuya was a young master who dreaded worldly social obligations.

听得门房的通报，乐得偷懒，便请阿巧姐径自出见。
On hearing the doorkeeper's report, he was glad of the excuse to spare himself the trouble and asked A’qiao to go out directly.

她一见胡雪岩空手上门，颇为失望，不免埋怨，
Seeing Hu arrive empty-handed, she was disappointed and could not help complaining.

“你也要替我做做人！
“You ought to help me make a proper return.

我在这里，人家客气得不得了，真正叫人不安。”
They're so kind to me here that I really feel uneasy.”

“你放心！
“Don't worry.

我已经打算好了，
I've already made plans.

一定叫你有面子。
You'll certainly have every reason to hold your head high.

现在闲话少说，
But there's no time for that now.

你马上跟我回客栈，去认一个人。”
Come back to the inn at once and identify someone.”

“认一个人！
“Identify someone?

认哪个？”
Who?”

阿巧姐眨闪着极长的睫毛，异常困惑的问。
She blinked her exceptionally long lashes, thoroughly puzzled.

“你想想看，
“Think.

还有哪个是非要你去认不可的？”
Who else could there be that only you could identify?”

这句反问，就点得很清楚了，然而阿巧姐却越感困惑，
The question made his meaning plain, yet she was more bewildered than ever.

“到底怎么回事？”
“What exactly has happened?”

她有些不悦，觉得胡雪岩办这样的大事，不该不先商量一下，
She was displeased that he should handle so important a matter without consulting her.

所以很认真的表示：“你不说清楚，我决不去。”
“Unless you explain, I won't go,” she said firmly.

胡雪岩十分见机，赔着笑说：
Hu quickly took the hint and smiled apologetically.

“你不要怪我独断独行，
“Don't blame me for acting on my own.

一则是没有机会跟你说，二则是免得你操心，
First, I had no chance to tell you; second, I wanted to spare you worry.

我是好意。”
I meant well.”

“谢谢你的好意。”
“Thank you for your good intentions.”

阿巧姐接受了他的解释，但多少还有些余憾，
She accepted his explanation, though some resentment remained.

而且发觉处境颇为尴尬，
She also found her position awkward.

“当面锣，对面鼓，你叫我怎么认法。”
“Face to face, like a gong answering a drum—how am I supposed to identify him?”

“不是，不是！”
“No, no.

用不着你照面，
You needn't face him.

你只要在壁缝里张一张，
Just look through a crack in the partition.

认清楚了人，就没你的事了。“接着，胡雪岩把如何收服了小狗子的话，扼要说了一遍。
Once you've identified him, there's nothing more for you to do.” He briefly explained how he had brought Xiaogouzi round.


“你的花样真多！”阿巧姐笑着说了这一句，
“You have so many tricks!” A’qiao said with a smile.

脸色突然转为严肃，
Then her face suddenly grew serious.

眼望着砖地，好久不作声。
She looked down at the brick floor and remained silent for a long time.

这神态使得胡雪岩有些着急，同时也有些失悔，事情真的做得欠检点了！
Hu became anxious and began to regret his lack of care.

阿巧姐与她丈夫的感情不太好，只是听了怡情老二的片面之词，
That she and her husband were on bad terms was something he had heard only from Second Miss at Yiqing House.

她本人虽也在行为上表现出来，与夫家几乎已断绝往来，但这种门户人家的话，靠不住的居多，
Her own conduct did suggest that she had almost severed relations with her husband's family, but much of what people in such establishments said was unreliable.

俗语说得好：“骗死人不偿命”。
As the saying went, they could deceive a man to death without paying with their lives.

自己竟信以为真，一本正经去办，到了紧要关头，就会变成自讨苦吃，
He had taken it all for truth and set about the matter in earnest; at the critical moment, he might merely bring trouble upon himself.

阿巧姐固在不见得有意欺骗，
A’qiao might not have meant to deceive him.

然而“家家有本难念的经”，
Still, every household had its own difficult scripture to recite.

看样子是别有衷曲，须当谅解？
She evidently had some private concern that deserved understanding.

说来说去是自己鲁莽，怪不得她。
In the end, he had been rash and could not blame her.

怪不怪她在其次，
Whether to blame her was secondary, however.

眼前的难题是，阿巧姐如果不肯点头，小狗子那面就不好交代。
If she refused her consent now, how was he to explain matters to Xiaogouzi?

跑到苏州来做这么一件荒唐事，传出去成为笑话，自己的这个面子却丢不起。
To come to Suzhou on such an absurd errand and become a laughingstock was more loss of face than he could bear.

因而急于要讨她一句实话。
He urgently needed a truthful answer.

“阿巧姐！”他神色严重地说，“到这时候，你再不能敷衍我了，
“Sister A’qiao,” he said gravely, “you can't put me off any longer.

你心里的意思，到底怎么佯，要跟我实说！”
Tell me honestly what you really want.”

“咦！”
“Why!”

阿巧姐深感诧异：
She was astonished.

“我几时说假话敷衍过你？”
“When have I ever lied to put you off?”

“那么，事情到了这地步，你象煞要打退堂鼓，是为啥？”
“Then why do you seem ready to beat a retreat, now that things have come this far?”

阿巧姐觉得好笑，
She found this amusing.

“我又不曾象县大老爷那样坐堂，
“I've never sat in court like a county magistrate.

啥叫打退堂鼓？”她这样反诘。
How can I beat the drum that closes the hearing?”


话越发不对了，
Her words sounded more troublesome still.

细辨一辨，其中有刺，
On closer examination, there was a barb in them.

意思是说，胡雪岩做这件事之先，既未告诉过她，更未征求同意，这就是“不曾坐堂”，然则又何来“退堂鼓”可言？
Before undertaking the matter, Hu had neither told her nor obtained her consent: she had never ‘opened court’, so how could she now beat the drum to close it?

胡雪岩心想，阿巧姐是厉害角色，
She was a formidable woman.

此时不宜跟她讲理，因为自己道理欠缺，讲不过她。
This was no time to reason with her, since the right was not on his side and he could not win the argument.

唯有动之以情，甚至骗一骗她再说。
He could only appeal to her feelings, even deceive her a little if necessary.

于是他先认错：
First, he admitted his fault.

“这件事怪我不好。
“I've handled this badly.

不过我一定顺你的心意，决不勉强。
But I'll certainly follow your wishes and won't force you.

现在人在那里，
The man is there now.

你先去认一认，再作道理。
Come and identify him first, and we'll decide afterwards.

人不对，不必再谈，
If he's the wrong man, there's nothing more to discuss.

人对了，看你的意思，
If he's the right one, it's entirely up to you.

你说东就东，你说西就西，我决无二话。
Whichever way you wish to go, I won't object.”

“人心到底是肉做的，
After all, a human heart was made of flesh.

听得他这样说，阿巧姐不能再迟疑了，
Hearing this, A’qiao could hesitate no longer.

其实她的迟疑，倒不是对她丈夫还有什么余情不忍割舍，
In fact, she was not reluctant because of lingering affection for her husband.

只是想到她娘家，应该让胡雪岩拿笔钱出来，替她娘养老。
She was thinking of her own family: Hu ought to provide some money to support her mother in old age.

这个条件，似乎应该在此时一并来谈，却又不知如何谈法？
This condition seemed best discussed along with the other arrangements, but she did not know how to raise it.

迟疑者在此，而胡雪岩是误会了。
That was the cause of her hesitation; Hu had misunderstood.

“那么你请坐一坐，
“Then sit down a moment.

我总要跟主人家去说一声。”她又问：“你可曾雇了轿子？”
I must tell my hosts.” She added, “Did you hire a chair?”

“这方便，
“Easily arranged.

我轿子留给你，我另雇一乘。”
I'll leave mine for you and hire another.

胡雪岩说，“到了金间栈，你从边门进来，
When you reach Jinchang Inn, come through the side entrance.

我叫人在那里等你。”
I'll have someone waiting.”


这样约定了，胡雪岩先离了潘家，
With this settled, Hu left first.

轿子是阊门附近的，坐过两回，已经熟识，
He had twice used these chair-bearers from near Chang Gate and knew them already.

等吩咐妥当，另雇一乘，赶回金阊栈，
After giving his instructions, he hired another chair and hurried back to Jinchang Inn.

再赁一间屋子，关照伙计，专门守在边门上，
There he rented an additional room and told an attendant to wait expressly at the side entrance.

等阿巧姐一到，悄悄引人，然后进来照一照面，无需开口。
When A’qiao arrived, he was to bring her in quietly, then show himself to Hu without speaking.

一切布置妥帖，胡雪岩方回到自己屋里，
Only after everything was arranged did Hu return to his own room.

坐候不久，周一鸣领着小狗子等人，吃了饭回来，
Before long, Zhou brought Xiaogouzi and the others back from lunch.

一个个脸上发红，似乎喝了不少酒。
All their faces were red; they seemed to have drunk a good deal.

彼此又作了一番寒暄，胡雪岩便海阔天空地谈苏州的风光，
After further courtesies, Hu launched into a wide-ranging account of Suzhou's scenery.

同一鸣会意，是要拖延辰光，就在一旁帮腔，
Zhou understood that he meant to gain time and joined in.

谈得极其热闹，却始终不提正事。
The conversation was lively, but never touched their business.

小狗子有些忍不住了，
Xiaogouzi could hardly bear it.

好不容易找到一个空隙，插进一句话去：“胡大老爷，我们今天还想赶回木读，
At last, finding an opening, he interjected, “Mr Hu, we still want to get back to Mudu today.

时间太迟了不方便。
It'll be inconvenient if we're too late.

现在就动手吧！”
Shall we begin?”

“喔，喔，”
“Oh, yes.

胡雪岩歉意地说：“对不起，对不起，
Forgive me,” Hu replied apologetically.

再略等一等，
“Just a little longer.

等钱庄的伙计一到，凑够了银钱，我们马上动手。
As soon as the bank's man comes and we have the full amount of silver, we'll begin.

好在只是画一个花押，
It's only a matter of putting down a mark.

快得很。”
It won't take long.”

这样一说，小狗子就又只好耐心等候，但局促不安的情状，越来越明显。
Xiaogouzi had to wait patiently again, though his uneasiness became increasingly apparent.

胡雪岩冷服旁观，心头疑云愈密，暗暗又打了第二个主意。
Watching coolly, Hu grew more suspicious and secretly devised a second plan.

正想托词把周一鸣找到一边商量，那守候的伙计出现了，
He was about to find an excuse to consult Zhou privately when the attendant appeared.

他也很机警，提着茶壶来冲茶，暗中使了一个眼色，
Showing presence of mind, the man came with a pot to replenish the tea and gave Hu a covert glance.

竟连周一鸣都不曾发觉。
Even Zhou failed to notice.


于是胡雪岩告个便，在另一层中见着阿巧姐，悄悄说道：
Hu excused himself and went to see A’qiao in another part of the inn.

“回头我引一个人出来，
“In a moment I'll bring someone out.

你细细看，不要作声。
Look carefully, but don't speak.

我马上又会回来。”
I'll come back shortly.”

叮嘱完了，仍回原处，对阿巧姐的丈夫招招手。
Returning to the others, he beckoned to the supposed husband.

那个畏畏缩缩的中年人，只是望着小狗子，用眼色在讨主意。
The shrinking middle-aged man merely looked at Xiaogouzi, seeking guidance with his eyes.

“胡大老爷，你有啥话，跟我说！”
“Mr Hu, whatever you want to say, say it to me.”

“没有啥要紧话，
“Nothing important.

不过，这句话也不便让外人听见。”
But it isn't something for outsiders to hear.”

胡雪岩又连连招手，
Hu beckoned repeatedly.

“请过来，请过来。”
“Come here, please.”

乡下人纵或不上“台盘”，但私底下说句话，何至于如此畏缩不前？
A countryman might be unused to polite society, but why be so reluctant to exchange a few private words?

所以小狗子不便再加阻挠，
Xiaogouzi could hardly obstruct him further.

那个姓陈的，也只好硬着头皮，跟了主人出去。
Chen had no choice but to steel himself and follow his host outside.

胡雪岩是何等角色？
Hu was no ordinary man.

一看这姓陈的，木头人似地只由小狗子牵线，便不待阿巧姐来“验明正身”，即已料到了七八分，
Seeing Chen as wooden as a puppet, with Xiaogouzi pulling the strings, he had already guessed most of the truth without waiting for A’qiao's identification.

因而引到外面，面对着阿巧姐所隐藏的窗户，
He led him out to face the window behind which she was concealed.

他开口第一句话问的是：“你到底姓啥？”
His first question was, “What is your actual surname?”

“我姓陈。”
“Chen.”

这句话答得极爽利，显见不假，
The answer came readily enough to be true.

于是胡雪岩又问第二句：
Hu asked his second question.

“你是阿巧姐的什么人？”
“What relation are you to A’qiao?”

这句话问得他显了原形，
This exposed him.

支支吾吾地嗫嚅着不知所云。
He stammered and muttered incoherently.

果然，
Just as I thought!

胡雪岩暗叫一声：惭愧！
Hu silently reproached himself.

若非临时灵机一动，叫小狗子骗了一千多两银子去，
Without that last-minute inspiration, Xiaogouzi would have cheated him of more than a thousand taels.

那才真是明沟里翻船，吃了亏还不能声张，声张出去，是个绝大的话柄。
He would have capsized in an open ditch—a humiliation he could not even complain of, since publicizing it would give people an irresistible story against him.


心里是又好气又好笑，脸上却是声色不动，
Inwardly both angry and amused, Hu kept his expression and voice unchanged.

反倒好言安慰。
Instead, he offered reassurance.

“老陈，小狗子玩的把戏，我都晓得，
“Old Chen, I know all about Xiaogouzi's trick.

你跟我说实话，我不难为你。
Tell me the truth and I won't make trouble for you.

回头在小狗子面前，我也不识破，免得害你为难。”
I won't expose you to him afterwards either, so you needn't be put in a difficult position.”

最后这句话，说到了这个老实人心里，
This last assurance touched the honest fellow where it mattered.

“胡大老爷，我跟你说了实话，”他很认真地问：“你真的不会告诉小狗子？”
“Mr Hu, if I tell you the truth,” he asked earnestly, “you really won't tell Xiaogouzi?”

“真的。
“Really.

你要不要我罚咒？”
Do you want me to swear an oath?”

说到这话，姓陈的放心了，当时将内幕实情，和盘托出，
Reassured, Chen revealed everything.

他是阿巧姐的堂房“大伯子”，
He was an elder cousin of A’qiao's husband.

欠了小狗子的钱，所以不得不受小狗子的挟制，让他来冒充阿巧姐的丈夫。
He owed Xiaogouzi money and had been forced to submit to him and impersonate her husband.

讲明了旧欠一笔勾销，另外送他一个大元宝。
The agreement was that his old debt would be cancelled and he would receive a large silver ingot besides.

有这样荒唐事！
What an absurd affair!

胡雪岩问道：“你不怕吃官司？”
“Aren't you afraid of being taken to court?” Hu asked.

“我也怕！”那姓陈的哭丧着脸说，
“I am,” Chen answered miserably.

“小狗子说不要紧，
“But Xiaogouzi says there's nothing to fear.

中人、代笔都是自己人，
The intermediary and the scribe are all our own people.

告到县衙门里，只说那张笔据是假的，根本没得这回事。”
If a complaint reaches the county yamen, we'll just say the document is false and nothing of the sort happened.”

“这家伙！”
The scoundrel!

胡雪岩心想，
Hu thought.

小狗子倒厉害，要让他吃点苦头，
Xiaogouzi was a shrewd one and deserved a lesson.

于是悄悄说道：“你不要怕，
He whispered, “Don't be afraid.

回头他叫你怎么做，你就怎么做，
Whatever he tells you to do afterwards, do it.

你只要咬定不曾跟我说实话，小狗子就不会怪你了。”
Just insist that you haven't told me the truth, and he won't blame you.”

脑筋简单的人，只有这样教他，
A simple-minded man needed instructions of this sort.

姓陈的倒也心领神会，连连点头，只说：
Chen understood and nodded repeatedly.

“晓得，
“I know.

晓得。”
I know.”


相借回了进去，
They went back inside one after the other.

小狗子的脸色阴晴不定，但等胡雪岩说出一句话来，他的神态马上又轻松了。
Xiaogouzi's expression shifted uncertainly, but relaxed at once when Hu spoke.

“来，来！”胡雪岩说：“我们就动手，
“Come, let's begin.

立好笔据，你们抬了银子，早早回木渎，
Draw up the documents, then take your silver and get back to Mudu early.

大家省事。”
That will save everyone trouble.”

周一鸣不知就里，
Zhou knew nothing of what had happened.

只当已经证实，姓陈的果真是阿巧姐的丈夫，得此结果，总算圆满，
He assumed that Chen's identity as A’qiao's husband had been confirmed, a satisfactory conclusion.

于是欣然安设笔砚，让小狗子把笔据铺在桌上，
Cheerfully, he set out brush and inkstone and had Xiaogouzi spread the documents on the table.

首先在中人名下画了花押，
Zhou first signed his mark as intermediary.

接着是小狗子和代笔拈起笔来画了个“十”字，
Xiaogouzi and the scribe followed, each taking the brush to draw a cross.

最后轮着姓陈的，“十”字都不会画，只好蘸了印油，盖个手印。
Last came Chen, who could not even draw a cross and had to make an inked handprint.

手续齐备，该当“过付”了，
With the formalities complete, it was time to hand over the payment.

胡雪岩说：“老周，你是中人，
Hu said, “Old Zhou, you're the intermediary.

先把笔据拿好，等付清了款子，再把笔据交给我。”
Hold the documents for now, and give them to me after the money has been paid in full.”

说着，略微使个眼色。
He gave a slight signal with his eyes.

周一鸣恍然大悟，还有花样！
Zhou understood at once: there was another move to come!

一把就将笔据抢在手里，一折两，两折四，紧紧捏住。
He snatched up the papers, folded them in half and then in quarters, and gripped them firmly.


于是胡雪岩又说：“婚姻大事，
Hu continued, “Marriage is a serious matter.

合也好，分也好，都要弄得清清楚楚，
Whether people unite or separate, everything must be clear.

现在笔据是立下了，不过男女两造，只有一造到场，
The documents are drawn up, but only one of the two parties is present.

而且就是男方，我们也是初见。”
Even the man is someone we've just met.”

他问周一鸣：
He turned to Zhou.

“老周，你是中人，万一将来有了纠葛，你怎么说？”
“As intermediary, what would you say if a dispute arose later?”

周一鸣知道他是有意作此一问，便装作很诧异地说：
Knowing the question was deliberate, Zhou pretended surprise.

“有什么纠葛？”
“What dispute could there be?”

“是啊！”
“Exactly!”

小狗子也赶紧接口，
Xiaogouzi hastened to add.

“有啥纠葛？绝不会有的。”
“There can't possibly be any dispute.”

“不然。”
“Not so.”

胡雪岩向姓陈的一指，
Hu pointed at Chen.

“我看他不大象阿巧姐的丈夫，
“He doesn't much resemble A’qiao's husband to me.

刚才私底下问了一声，他一口咬定不假。
I asked him privately just now, and he insisted he was.

这且不去说它了，
Leave that aside.

不过，这张笔据，还要有个手续，才能作数。
These documents still need one formality before they can be accepted.

我们替人办事，总要做得妥当扎实，
When we conduct affairs for others, we must make everything secure.

不然将来男婚女嫁出了麻烦，是件不得了的事。”
If trouble arises when either party remarries, it will be a serious matter.”

“对！”周一鸣帮腔：
“Quite right,” Zhou put in.

“这个中人不好做。
“It's no easy thing to act as intermediary.

假使说是钱债纠纷，大不了中人赔饯就是。
If this were merely a dispute about a debt, at worst I could repay the money.

如果人弄错了，说要陪个阿巧姐出来，怎么赔法？”
But if we've mistaken the person, how could I provide another A’qiao in compensation?”

“就是这话罗。”胡雪岩说，
“Precisely,” Hu said.

“人是货真价实的本人，还是冒充？阿巧姐不在这里，无法来认，也就不去说它，
“Whether he's the genuine man or an impostor, we can't settle without A’qiao here to identify him, so let's leave that aside too.

至少这张笔据，要能够证明它是真的。”
At least we must be able to prove that the documents are genuine.”

听说阿巧姐不在这里，小狗子大放其心，心头一宽，
Hearing that A’qiao was absent, Xiaogouzi felt greatly relieved.

脑筋也灵活了，他振振有词的说：
His mind grew more agile.

“胡大老爷的话，一点不错，
“You're quite right, Mr Hu.

要中人，要代笔，就是要证明这张笔据是真的。
That's exactly why we have intermediaries and a scribe—to prove the papers genuine.

我倒不懂，胡大老爷你还要啥见证？”
I don't understand what further witness you want.”

“有中人，有代笔是不错。”胡雪岩淡淡一笑，
Hu smiled faintly. “We have them, certainly.

“不过打开天窗说亮话，
But let's speak plainly.

万一出了纠葛，打到官司，堂上也不能只凭老周一个人的见证，
If a dispute went to court, the magistrate couldn't rely on Old Zhou's testimony alone.

我们不如到县衙门里，在‘户房’立个案，好比买田买地的‘红契，一样，请一方大印盖一盖。
Why don't we register the documents at the county yamen's revenue office and have them stamped with an official seal, like the red deeds used for buying land?

要多少花费，都归我出。”
I'll pay all the expenses.”

“好，好！”周一鸣首先赞成，
Zhou was first to approve. “Excellent!

对小狗子说：“这一来我们中人的责任都轻了。”
That will lessen our responsibility as intermediaries,” he told Xiaogouzi.


小狗子支吾着不置可否。
Xiaogouzi mumbled without agreeing or refusing.

这是突出不意的一着，
This move was utterly unexpected.

乡下人听到“县衙门”，心里存怯意，
A countryman felt apprehensive at the mere mention of the county yamen.

提到书办，就想起城隍庙里，面目狰狞的“判官”。
Its clerks brought to mind the fierce-faced judges in the City God's temple.

到了“户房”，书办如果说一声：下乡查一查再说。西洋镜就完全戳穿了。
If a clerk in the revenue office said, “We must go out to the village and investigate first,” the whole fraud would be exposed.

然而，这是极正当的做法，无论如何想不出推辞的理由。
Yet the procedure was perfectly proper, and Xiaogouzi could think of no excuse to refuse.

因此，小狗于急得满脸通红，不知如何是好？
His face reddened with anxiety.

再看到周一鸣的诡秘的笑容，以及他手里捏着的那张笔据，蓦然意会，
Then, seeing Zhou's knowing smile and the documents clenched in his hand, he suddenly understood.

银子不曾到手，自己的把柄先抓在别人手里，
Before any silver had reached him, the others had secured evidence against him.

这下要栽大跟斗了！
He was in for a terrible fall.

这一转念间，就如当头着了一棒，眼前金垦乱爆，
The thought struck like a blow on the head, sending stars before his eyes.

一急之下，便乱了枪法，伸出手去，要抢周一鸣掌握中的笔据。
In his panic he lost all sense of tactics and reached for the papers.

一抢不曾抢到，周一鸣却急出一身汗，慌忙将字据往怀里一塞，跳开两步，将双手按在胸前，大声说道：
He failed to seize them, but Zhou broke into a sweat, hastily thrust them inside his clothing, jumped back two paces and pressed both hands over his chest.

“咦，咦！
“Hey!

你这是做啥？”
What are you doing?”

小狗子一看行藏等于败露，急得脸如土色，
Realizing that he had virtually exposed himself, Xiaogouzi turned ashen.

气急败坏地指着周一鸣说：
He pointed at Zhou in agitation.

“事情太罗嗦！
“This is too much trouble!

我不来管这个闲事了。
I won't concern myself with it any more.

请你把笔据拿出来，撕掉了算了，
Take out the papers and tear them up.

只当没有这回事。”
Let it be as though none of this happened.”

周一鸣相当机警，知道自己这时候应该“做红脸”，然后好让胡雪岩出来打圆场、“讲斤头”，
Zhou was quick enough to see that he should now play the angry accuser, leaving Hu to intervene and negotiate.

于是一伸手做个推拒的姿态，同时虎起脸说：“慢慢，小狗子，
He raised a hand to rebuff Xiaogouzi, put on a fierce expression and said, “Wait.

我们把话说清楚！
Let's make this clear.

你到底是怎么回事？
What exactly are you up to?

我一片血心，拿你当个朋友，
I've treated you as a friend with all sincerity.

你不要做半吊子，害得我在胡大老爷面前，不好交代。”
Don't behave like a fool and leave me unable to account for myself to Mr Hu.”

“不是这话，不是这话！”小狗子极力分辩，
“No, no, that's not it!” Xiaogouzi protested vehemently.

“我也是好意，不过这场闲事，实在难管。
“I meant well too, but this really is a troublesome business to meddle in.

周大哥，你做做好事，把这张笔据还给我。”
Brother Zhou, do me a kindness and return the papers.”

“还给你？”
“Return them?”

周一鸣变色冷笑，
Zhou's expression changed, and he gave a cold laugh.

“哪有这洋方便！”
“Do you think it's that easy?”


这一说，小狗子把双眼睁得好大，盯着周一鸣一眼不眨，倒象以前从未认清他的面貌似地，
Xiaogouzi stared at him wide-eyed, without blinking, as though he had never truly seen his face before.

胡雪岩了解小狗子的心理，
Hu understood his feelings.

觉得周一鸣的人候还差些，翻脸不能翻得这么快。
Zhou still lacked finesse; he should not have turned hostile so abruptly.

于是赶紧站出来说话。
Hu hurried to intervene.

“有话慢慢谈。”
“Let's talk calmly.

胡雪岩对小狗子说，“白纸写黑字，要说随便可以撕掉，也是办不到的事。
Something written in black and white can't simply be torn up.

你倒说说看，事情怎么样‘罗嗦’？
Tell us what makes this so ‘troublesome’.

有啥难处，说出来大家商量。”
Explain your difficulty, and we can discuss it.”

小狗子的难处，就是难说。
Xiaogouzi's difficulty was precisely that he could not explain it.

情急之下，只好随便抓个人作挡箭牌，
In desperation he seized upon someone else as a shield.

“他是老实人，”他指着姓陈的说，“从来没有上过衙门。
Pointing at Chen, he said, “He's an honest fellow who's never been inside a yamen.

胡大老爷要他到户房去立案，他一定不肯去的，
He certainly won't agree to register the papers at the revenue office.

岂不是害我们中间人为难。
Doesn't that put us intermediaries in a difficult position?

好在银子亦不曾收，
Luckily, no money has changed hands.

大家一笔勾销，
Let's cancel everything.

本夫在这里，你们当面锣，对面鼓，重新谈过。
Here's the husband; you can discuss it face to face and begin again.

谈得好，我做个现成中人，
If you reach agreement, I'll be there to act as intermediary.

谈不好，只算我白跑一趟腿，白当一回差。”
If you don't, I've merely made a journey and run an errand for nothing.”

强同夺理，居然也说了一大套，
His argument twisted reason, but he managed quite a speech.

胡雪岩笑道：
Hu smiled.

“已经谈好了，笔据都立了，
“We've already agreed and drawn up the papers.

还谈什么。
What is there left to discuss?

如果说，不愿意到衙门里去，也不要紧，
If he doesn't wish to go to the yamen, never mind.

大不了多费点工夫，
It'll only take a little more trouble.

我们一船到木读，请你们这方面的陈家族长也做个见证，
We'll all go by boat to Mudu and ask your Chen clan head to witness the matter.

这总可以吧！”
Surely that will do?”

这一下，西洋镜还是要拆穿，但无论如何总是到了木渎以后的事，
The fraud would still be exposed, but at least not until they reached Mudu.

小狗子觉得可以先喘口气再说，
Xiaogouzi thought he could gain a little breathing space.

便硬着头皮答道：“好的！”
He braced himself and answered, “Very well.”

“那么，什么时候走？”
“Then when do we leave?”

“说走就走。随你们便。”
“Whenever you like. We can go at once.”


小狗子的态度仿佛很硬气，但另外一个老实人却没他这点点“功夫”，
Xiaogouzi sounded resolute, but the other honest fellow lacked even his small skill in pretence.

姓陈的可沉不住气了，
Chen could no longer keep calm.

拉一拉小狗子的衣服，轻声说了句：“去不得！”
He tugged at Xiaogouzi's clothes and whispered, “We can't go.”

“什么去不得？”小狗子大声叱斥，
“What do you mean, we can't?” Xiaogouzi snapped.

“怕什么！”
“What are you afraid of?”

“对啊！怕什么？”周一鸣在旁边冷冷地说，
“Yes, what?” Zhou added coldly.

“大不了吃官司就是了。”
“The worst that can happen is a lawsuit.”

这一说，姓陈的越发着急。
This made Chen more anxious still.

他已经拿实情告诉了胡雪岩，如何还能跟着小狗子去浑水？
Having already told Hu the truth, how could he continue muddling along with Xiaogouzi?

却又不便明说，人家已经知道是假冒，话说得再硬都无用。
Yet he could hardly say openly that their host knew of the impersonation and no amount of bold talk would help.

所以只是搓着手说：
He merely wrung his hands.

“我们慢慢儿再谈。”
“Let's talk it over a little more.”

胡雪岩看出他的窘迫，便见风使舵，抓住他这句话说：
Hu saw his distress and seized upon the opening.

“谈就谈。
“Then let's talk.

事体总要让它有个圆满结局。
The matter must reach a satisfactory conclusion.

你们自己去谈一谈。”
Go and discuss it among yourselves.”

有这句话，绷急的弦，就暂时放松了。
This temporarily eased the strain.

小狗子一伙，避到外面，交头接耳去商议，
Xiaogouzi and his companions withdrew to confer in whispers.

周一鸣与胡雪岩相视一笑，也走向僻处去估量情势，商量对策。
Hu and Zhou exchanged a smile and likewise sought a quiet place to assess the situation and decide their next move.


“果不其然是假冒。”胡雪岩将姓陈的所说的话，告诉了周一鸣，却又蹩眉说道：
“He is an impostor, just as we thought.” Hu told Zhou what Chen had said, then frowned.

“我看这件事怕要麻烦你了。”
“I'm afraid this will mean more trouble for you.”

“好的！”
“Gladly!”

周一鸣这两天跟胡雪岩办事，无往不利，信心大增，
After two days of unfailing success in Hu's service, Zhou's confidence had grown considerably.

所以跃跃欲试地说：“我去一趟，好歹要把它办成了。”
Eager for action, he declared, “I'll go myself and see it through, whatever it takes.”

“你也不要把事情看得太容易……”
“Don't assume it'll be easy...”

照胡雪岩的分析，小狗子出此下策，必是走正路走不通，却又不甘心舍弃这一堆白花花的大元宝，
In Hu's analysis, Xiaogouzi must have found the proper course blocked, yet could not bear to give up that pile of gleaming ingots.

因而行险以图侥幸。
He had therefore risked this inferior scheme in the hope of getting lucky.

如果这个猜测不错，则在阿巧姐夫家那面，一定有何窒碍？
If that was right, there must be some obstacle on A’qiao's husband's side.

首先要打听清楚，才好下手。
They must first discover it before acting.

“这容易。”周一鸣说，
“Easy enough,” Zhou said.

“我只要逼着小狗子好了。
“I'll put pressure on Xiaogouzi.

把柄在我们手里，
We have evidence against him.

不怕他不说实话。”
He won't dare withhold the truth.”

等到一逼实话，方知胡雪岩这一次没有料中。
Once the truth was forced out, it proved that Hu had misjudged the matter this time.

小狗子不务正业，有意想骗了这笔钱，远走高飞，
Xiaogouzi, who followed no honest occupation, had intended to obtain the money by fraud and disappear.

阿巧姐的大夫，根本不知有此事。
A’qiao's husband knew nothing of the affair.

当然，这些话是周一鸣旁敲侧击套出来的。
Of course, Zhou elicited these facts through indirect questioning.

小狗子的意思是，这桩荒唐行径，一笔勾销，
Xiaogouzi proposed that they wipe the slate clean.

他愿意陪着胡雪岩到木读，从中拉拢，重新谈判，
He would accompany Hu to Mudu, bring the parties together and reopen negotiations.

又表示绝不敢再在中间做手脚、“戴帽子”，
He promised not to manipulate matters or inflate the price for his own profit.

只巴望谈成了写纸，仍旧让他赚一份中人钱。
His only hope was that, if an agreement was reached and put in writing, he might still earn an intermediary's fee.

胡雪岩同意这样的办法，
Hu accepted.

他的处置很宽大，当时就将那张笔据销毁，委托周一鸣作代表，即时动身到木渎办事。
Generously, he destroyed the document then and there, appointed Zhou as his representative, and sent him off to Mudu at once.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十五章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Twenty-Five, Part One
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第二十五章｜CHAPTER TWENTY-FIVE


等这些人走了，阿巧姐也可以露面了。
Once the men had gone, A’qiao could come out of hiding.

萌雪岩觉得已到了一切跟她说明白的时候，
Hu Xueyan felt that the time had come to explain everything.

于是凝神想了想，开口问道，“阿巧，我替你做个媒如何？”
After a moment's concentrated thought, he asked, “A’qiao, how would you like me to find you a husband?”

他是故意用此突兀的说法，为的一开头就可以把阿巧姐的心思扭了过来。
He had deliberately chosen this abrupt opening to turn her thoughts in a new direction at once.

这不是一下子可以办得到的，
That could not be achieved so easily.

被问的人，眨着一双灵活的眼睛，在不曾想好话回答以前，先要弄清楚他这句话是什么意思。
Her lively eyes blinked as she tried to understand his meaning before deciding how to answer.

“你这句话是什么意思？”
“What do you mean?”

她摇着头，一双翠玉耳环晃荡不停，
She shook her head, setting her jade earrings swinging.

“我真不懂。”
“I really don't understand.”

“你是不是当我说笑话？”
“Do you think I'm joking?”

“我不晓得。”
“I don't know.

阿巧姐答道，“反正我领教过你了，
I've had some experience of you now.

你的花佯百出，诸葛亮都猜不透。”胡雪岩笑了：
You have so many tricks that even Zhuge Liang couldn't see through them.” Hu laughed.

“你这句话是捧我，还是骂我？”
“Is that praise or abuse?”

“也不是捧，也不是骂，
“Neither.

我说的是实话。”
It's the truth.”

“我跟你说的也是实话。”
“I'm telling you the truth too.”

胡雪岩收敛笑容，一本正经地说，
His smile vanished and he spoke with complete seriousness.

“我替你做的这个媒，包你称心如意，
“I guarantee you'll be happy with the match I arrange.

将来你也想看我一点好处，能替我说话的时候要替我说话。”
In future, remember that I've done you some good, and speak for me when you have the chance.”

这几句话说得相当率直，也相当清楚，
This was frank enough, and clear enough.

阿巧姐很快地懂了，
A’qiao understood quickly.

特别是“包你称心如意”这六个字，撞在心坎上非常舒服。
The promise that she would be happy struck a particularly pleasing chord.

然而，到底是怎样一个人呢？
But who was the man?

不用她问，胡雪岩也要说：
Hu answered before she could ask.

“这个人，你见过，
“You've met him.

就是学台何大人。”
Education Commissioner He.”

听得是这一个人，阿巧姐不由得脸就发热，一颗心跳得很厉害。
Her face grew hot and her heart beat rapidly.

她还想掩饰，要做出无动于衷的神情，无奈那双眼睛瞒不过目光如炬的胡雪岩。
She tried to conceal it and appear unmoved, but her eyes could not deceive Hu's penetrating gaze.


“怎么样？”他故意问一句：
“Well?” he asked deliberately.

“何大人真正是白面书生，官场中出名的美男子。
“Commissioner He is a true fair-faced scholar, famous in official circles for his good looks.

马上进了京，就要外放，
He'll soon go to the capital and then receive a provincial appointment.

听说大太太身子不好，
I hear his principal wife is unwell.

万一有三长两短，说不定拿你扶了正，
If anything should happen to her, he might even make you his lawful wife.

不就是坐八抬大轿的掌印夫人？”
Then wouldn't you be a great official's lady, riding in a sedan chair with eight bearers?”

这说得多有趣！
What a delightful prospect!

阿巧姐心花怒放，嘴角上不由得就绽开了笑意。
A’qiao's heart blossomed with joy, and a smile appeared at the corners of her mouth.

只是这笑容一现即逝。
It vanished almost at once.

因为阿巧姐突然警觉，事太突兀，
Suddenly on her guard, she thought the proposal too unexpected.

多半是胡雪岩有意试探，
Most likely Hu was testing her.

如果信以为真，等拆穿了，便是一个绝大的话柄。
If she believed him and the trick was exposed, she would have given him endless grounds for ridicule.

别样事可以开玩笑，这件事绝不是一个玩笑，
Other matters could be joked about; this was no joke.

太天真老实，将来就会难做人！
Being too innocent and trusting could leave her in an impossible position.

这样一转念间，不由得有愠色，
Her expression darkened.

冷笑一声，管自己退到床帐后面的夹弄中去换衣服。
With a cold little laugh, she withdrew to the narrow space behind the bed curtains to change.

胡雪岩见她态度突变，自然诧异，不过细想一想，也就懂了。
Hu was naturally surprised by the sudden alteration, but soon understood.

这也难怪她，
He could hardly blame her.

“你不相信我的话，是不是？”他平静地问，
“You don't believe me, do you?” he asked calmly.

“你说，要怎么样，你才相信？”
“Tell me what would convince you.”

这正也就是阿巧姐在自问的话。
That was precisely what A’qiao was asking herself.

只是不知有何办法，能够证明此事真假，
She could think of no way to establish whether it was true.

在此刻的态度，要表现得对此根本漠不关心，才是站稳了脚步。
For now, her safest position was to show complete indifference.

因此，她故意用不耐烦的声音答道：“不晓得。
Deliberately sounding impatient, she replied, “I don't know.

你少来跟我罗嗦。”
Stop bothering me.”

这样水都泼不进去的话锋，
Her defence admitted not even a drop of water.

倒有点叫人伤脑筋。胡雪岩踱着方步在盘算，
Hu paced slowly, considering how to reach her.

回头有句话，可以让她相信自己不是跟她开玩笑。
Later, something he said could convince her that he was serious.

反正真是真，假是假，事情总会水落石出，
Truth was truth and falsehood falsehood; the facts would emerge in time.

该说的话，此时尽不妨先说，
He might as well say what needed saying now.

她自会记在心里，到她信其为真的那一刻，这些话就会发生作用了。
She would remember, and once she believed him, his words would take effect.


于是他“自说自话”地大谈何桂清的一切，以及他预备采取的步骤，
He therefore went on “talking to himself,” describing He Guiqing's circumstances and the steps he intended to take.

最后便必然又要问到：“现在要看你的意思怎么样？”
Inevitably, he ended by asking, “Now it depends on what you think.”

阿巧姐的衣服早已换好了，故意躲在床后不出现，
A’qiao had long since finished changing, but deliberately remained seated behind the bed.

坐在那里听他说得有头有尾，活龙活现，心思倒又活动了。
His orderly, vivid account began to stir her hopes again.

只是自己的态度，依然不肯表示，
Still, she would not disclose her attitude.

而万变不离其宗的还是“装佯”二字。
Whatever course she took, the essential thing was to keep up appearances.

“什么我的意思？”
“What do I think?”

她袅袅婷婷地走了出来，一面折衣服，一面答道，
She emerged gracefully and began folding her clothes.

“我不晓得。”
“I don't know.”

胡雪岩知道再逼也无用，
Hu knew that further pressure would achieve nothing.

只有反跌一笔，倒有些效用，
Reversing his approach might be more effective.

于是装出失望的神情说道：
He assumed a disappointed expression.

“你既然不肯，那也无法。
“If you're unwilling, nothing can be done.

什么事可以勉强，这件事必得两厢情愿才行。
Other things may be forced, but this requires consent on both sides.

幸亏我在那面还没有说破，
Fortunately, I haven't spoken plainly over there yet.

不然就搞得两面不是人了。”
Otherwise I'd have offended everyone.”

一听这话，阿巧姐怕煮熟了的鸭子，就此飞掉，岂不是弄巧成拙？
A’qiao feared that the cooked duck might fly away—that her cleverness would cost her the opportunity.

但如果老实说一句“愿意”，则装了半天的腔，又是前功尽弃。
Yet honestly admitting that she was willing would undo all her elaborate pretence.

左右为难之下，急出一计，
Caught between the two, she desperately found another tactic.

尽力搜索记忆，去想七岁当童养媳开始，受婆婆虐待，冬天生冻瘃，还得用冷水洗粗布衣服，夏天在柴房里，为蚊子叮得一夜到天亮不能睡觉的苦楚，
She searched her memory for the sufferings that had begun when she became a child bride at seven: her mother-in-law's cruelty, washing coarse cotton clothes in icy water despite winter chilblains, and summer nights in the woodshed when mosquitoes kept her awake until dawn.

渐渐地心头发酸，眼眶发热，
Gradually her heart ached and her eyes grew hot.

抽抽噎噎地哭出声来。
She began to sob.


漂亮女人的眼泪威力绝大，
A pretty woman's tears possessed immense power.

胡雪岩什么都有办法，就怕这样的眼泪，
Hu had a way of dealing with almost anything, but he feared tears like these.

当时惊问：“咦，咦，怎么回事？
Alarmed, he asked, “Why, what's happened?

有啥委屈好说，
Tell me if you've been wronged.

哭点啥？”
What are you crying for?”

“我的委屈哪里去说？”
“Where can I speak of my wrongs?”

阿巧姐趁机答话，带着无穷的幽怨，
A’qiao seized the opening, filling her voice with resentment.

“象我们这样的人，还不是有钱大爷的玩儿的东西，象只猫、象笼鸟一样，

高兴了花钱买了来，玩厌了送人！
When they fancy us, they spend money to buy us; when they're tired of us, they give us away.

叫她到东，不敢到西，
Told to go east, we daren't go west.

还有啥好说？”
What is there to say?”

“你这话说得没良心。”
“That's an ungrateful thing to say!”

胡雪岩气急了，
Hu was exasperated.

“我是为你好。”
“I'm doing this for your good.”

“哪个晓得是坏是好？
“Who knows whether it's good or bad?

你倒想想看，
Think about yourself.

你做事自说自话，从来不跟人商量，还说为我好！”
You decide everything without consulting anyone, and then say it's for my good!”

这是有所指的，指的就是周一鸣去办的那件事。
She meant something specific: the business Zhou had gone to settle.

胡雪岩自觉有些理亏，只好不作声。
Hu felt himself somewhat in the wrong and could only remain silent.

沉默带来冷静，冷静才能体味，
Silence brought calm, and calm made it possible to understand.

细想一想阿巧姐的话，似逆而实顺，也可以说是似怨而实喜，
Thinking over her words, he perceived compliance beneath apparent opposition, pleasure beneath apparent resentment.

她心里已是千肯万肯了，只是不能不以退为进地做作一番。
Inwardly, she was perfectly willing; she merely had to retreat before advancing.

这是人之常情，甚至不妨看作她还有“良心”，
That was human nature, and could even be taken as proof that she still had a conscience.

如果一定要逼她说一句：愿意做何家的姨太太，不但不可能，就可能又有什么意味？
To force her to say outright that she wanted to become He's concubine was impossible—and even if it were possible, what would be the point?

想透了这一层，便不觉她的眼泪有什么了不起。
Once he understood this, her tears no longer seemed formidable.

胡雪岩心里在想，此刻必得争取她的好感，让她对自己留下一个感恩图报的想法，将来她才会在何桂清那里，处处为自己的利益着想。
What he must do now was win her affection and leave her feeling grateful, so that in future she would always consider his interests with He Guiqing.

他想起听嵇鹤龄谈过的秦始皇身世的故事，
He remembered Ji Heling telling him the story of the First Emperor's parentage.

自己倒有些象吕不韦，
He himself was rather like Lü Buwei.

不知不觉地笑了出来。
The thought brought an involuntary smile.

“别人哭，你笑！”阿巧姐还在装腔作势，白着眼，嘟着嘴说：
“I cry, and you laugh!” A’qiao continued her performance, rolling her eyes and pouting.

“男人最没有良心，
“Men have no conscience.

真正叫人看透了。”
One can see right through them.”

“对！”胡雪岩顺着她的语气说，
“Quite right,” Hu answered in the same spirit.

“我也承认这句话。
“I admit it.

不过男人也很聪明，
But men are clever too.

不大会做赶尽杀绝的事，
They seldom drive things to the point of leaving no way out.

该讲良心的时候，还是讲良心的。”
When conscience is called for, they still have one.”


阿巧姐不答，
A’qiao did not answer.

茶刚送到唇边，忽又觉得这样不是道理，
Just as she raised it to her lips, it struck her that this was not proper.

于是把那杯茶放在胡雪岩面前，自己又另倒一杯。
She placed it before Hu and poured another for herself.

“不跟你说过，
“Haven't I told you?

一个老娘，一个兄弟。”
An old mother and a younger brother.”

“兄弟几岁，干啥营生？”
“How old is he, and what does he do?”

“Eighteen.

在布店里学生意。”
He's an apprentice in a cloth shop.”

哪里谈得到此？”阿巧姐说，

“再说，讨亲也不是桩容易的事。”
Besides, marrying isn't easy.”

“也没有什玄难。
“Not so difficult, either.

阿巧，”胡雪岩说：“我另外送你一千银子，
A’qiao, I'll give you another thousand taels.

你找个妥当的钱庄去存，动息不动本，贴补家用，
Deposit it in a sound bank, use the interest to help with household expenses, and leave the principal untouched.

将来等你兄弟满师，讨亲也好，弄爿小布店也好，都在这一千银子上。
When your brother finishes his apprenticeship, it can pay for a wife or a little cloth shop of his own.”

“阿巧姐看一看他，眨着眼不响。
She looked at him, blinking without a word.

胡雪岩以为她不相信自己的话，便很大方地，取出一千两银票，塞到了她的手里。
Thinking she doubted him, Hu generously took out a thousand-tael note and pressed it into her hand.

“Do you really want to help me?”

“How could there be any doubt?” Hu laughed.

“我兄弟人很聪明，长得也不难看，
“My brother is clever, and good-looking too.

在我们镇上，是有名的漂亮小官人……”
He's famous in our town as a handsome young fellow...”

“你不用说了。”
“You needn't tell me.”

胡雪岩笑道，
Hu smiled.

“看姐姐，就晓得做兄弟的一定长得很秀气。”
“One look at the elder sister tells me the younger brother must have fine features.”

“不是娘娘腔的那种秀气，
“Not in an effeminate way.

长得又高又大，站出来蛮登样的。
He's tall and well built, and cuts quite a figure.

这也不去说他，
But never mind that.

我在想，你如果肯照应我兄弟，我叫他出来，跟了你去，
I was thinking that if you'd look after him, I could bring him out to work for you.

不比在我们那个小地方学生意来得强？
Wouldn't that be better than learning business in our little place?”

“说着，把银票退了回来。
She returned the note.

“原来如此！
“So that's it!

可以，可以。
Certainly.

我一定提拔你兄弟，只要他肯上进。
I'll help your brother advance, provided he wants to get on.

银子你还是收着，
Keep the money too.

算我送你老娘的‘棺材本’。”
Consider it my gift towards your mother's ‘coffin fund.’”

明知跟胡雪岩不用客气，但阿巧姐总觉得不便收受，于是这样说道：
Though she knew she need not stand on ceremony with Hu, A’qiao still felt uncomfortable accepting it.

“我替我娘磕个头谢谢你。
“I'll kowtow in thanks on my mother's behalf.

钱，暂时先存在你这里。”
I'll leave the money with you for the present.”

“不必！
“No.

你还是自己保管好了。”
Keep it yourself.”

阿巧姐不肯，他也不肯，
She would not take it, and he would not yield.

取过银票来，塞到她口袋里。她穿的是件缎子夹袄，
Taking the note, he slipped it into the inner pocket of her lined satin jacket.

探手入怀，温软无比，心头不免荡漾起绩思，
The soft warmth he felt as his hand reached inside stirred his desire.

倒有些失悔，
Regret returned.

这样一个人，遣之远离，实在不大舍得。
He was reluctant indeed to send such a woman far away.


因此，他一时无语，心里七上八下地，思绪极乱。
For a while Hu said nothing, his mind in confused agitation.

阿巧姐当然猜他不透，又提到他兄弟的事。
A’qiao could not guess what he was thinking and returned to her brother.

“我兄弟小名阿顺。
“His childhood name is A’shun.

你看，什么时候叫他出来？”
When should I bring him out?”

胡雪岩定定神说：“学生意是写好了‘关书’的，
Collecting himself, Hu said, “An apprenticeship is governed by a written contract.

也不能说走就走，
He can't simply leave whenever he likes.

我这里无所谓，随便什么时候来好了。”
As far as I'm concerned, any time will do.”

学生意未曾满师，中途停止，要赔饭食的银子，这一点阿巧姐也知道，
A’qiao knew that leaving before the term was complete meant repaying the cost of board.

不过有一千两银子在身上，有恃无恐，便即答道：
