But with a thousand-tael note on her, she felt secure.

“这不要紧，
“That doesn't matter.

我自会安排妥当。”
I'll arrange it properly.”

“那好。
“Good.

你写信叫他出来好了。”
Write and tell him to come.”

阿巧姐心想，除了这件事以外，还有许多话要跟家里人说，
Besides this, she had much to discuss with her family.

那就不如再回去一趟，
Better to go home again herself.

这样转念，便即问道：“你哪天走？”
“When are you leaving?” she asked.

“工夫已经耽误了。
“I've already lost time.

等老周一回城，如果你的事情已经办妥当，我明天一早就走。”
Once Zhou gets back, if your business is settled, I'll leave first thing tomorrow.”

“那，”阿巧姐怏怏然说：“那来不及了。”
“Then it's too late,” she said disappointedly.

“怎么样？”
“For what?”

“如果你还有一两天耽搁，我想回去一趟。
“If you were staying another day or two, I'd have gone home once more.

现在，当然不必说它了。”
Now there's no point discussing it.”


经此片刻工夫，胡雪岩的浮思已定，
By this time Hu's wandering desires had settled.

话已经说了出去，决无翻悔的道理。
He had given his word and could not go back on it.

既然如此，原来打算让阿巧姐仍旧住在潘家的计划，不妨更改一下。
That being so, he might alter his original plan for A’qiao to remain with the Pans.

“我是这样在想，
“This is what I think.

在外面做事，决不可受人批评。
In conducting affairs, one must give people no grounds for criticism.

从此刻起，你算是何学台的人了，
From this moment, you belong to Commissioner He's household.

我们就不便再住在一起，不然不象话。
We ought not to stay together any longer; it wouldn't look right.

我原来的意思，想让你住在潘家，现在你自己看，
I originally meant you to stay at the Pans', but now you can decide.

你住到娘家去也可以。
You may go to your mother's instead.”

“这番话在阿巧姐颇有意外之感，
This surprised her.

细想一想，又觉得胡雪岩做事，真个与众不同，心思细密，手法漂亮。
After considering it, she felt that Hu really did act unlike other men: his thinking was careful and his methods elegant.

既然他如此说，自己将来在何桂清面前也占身分，
Since he put it that way, she would have greater standing before He Guiqing later.

就无需多说什么了。
There was no need to say more.

转念又想，作此表示，显得毫无留恋，象煞没有良心，
Then it occurred to her that accepting without comment would suggest she felt no attachment, as though she truly had no conscience.

所以还是得有一句话交代，这句话很难，
She must say something, but what?

总不能说，反正还未到何家，住在一起，又有何妨？
She could hardly argue that they might continue living together since she had not yet entered He's household.

那不成了堂子里的行径？
Wouldn't that be the behaviour of a woman in a courtesan house?

就是堂子里，姑娘答应了嫁客人，马上就得“下牌子”，
Even there, once a girl agreed to marry a patron, her nameplate came down immediately.

也不能说未曾出门以前，还可以接客。
She could not claim that she might still receive customers until the day she left.

但如果不是这样说，又怎么说呢？
Yet what else could A’qiao say?

终于想到一句话来了：
At last she found something.

“一个人讲心，行得正，坐得正，怕什么？
“If one's conscience is clear and one's conduct upright, what is there to fear?

反正我们自己晓得就是了。”
We know the truth ourselves.”

“话不是这么说，
“That isn't the point.

嫌疑一定要避。”胡雪岩又说：
Any appearance of impropriety must be avoided,” Hu replied.

“我明天请老周送了你回去。
“I'll ask Zhou to take you home tomorrow.

你乡下住两天，如果觉得气闪，再回潘家，也是一样，或者，到上海来玩几天也可以。
If you grow bored after a couple of days in the country, you can return to the Pans', or even come to Shanghai for a visit.

反正在我，从现在起，就当你何家姨太太看待了！”
As far as I'm concerned, from this moment I regard you as a concubine of the He household.”

胡雪岩的这一句话，为他自己和阿巧姐之间，筑起了一道篱笆，
His words built a fence between them.

彼此都觉得该以礼自持，因而言语举止，突然变得客气了，也生疏了。
Both suddenly felt obliged to observe propriety; their speech and manner grew polite, and distant.


这样子相处，便有拘束之感，
Such restraint made their company uncomfortable.

胡雪岩便说：“你回潘家去吧，
“Go back to the Pans',” Hu said.

我送了你去。”
“I'll take you.”

“那么，你呢？”
“And what will you do?”

“我，”
“I...”

胡雪岩茫然无主，随口答道：“我在城里逛逛。”
At a loss, he answered vaguely, “I'll look round the city.”

阿巧姐很想说一句，陪着他在城里逛一逛。但想到自己的“何家姨太太”的身分，那句话便难出口，
She wanted very much to offer to walk with him, but her new position as “a concubine of the He household” made the words difficult to utter.

关切之意，无由寄托，不免踌躇。
Unable to express her concern, she hesitated.

“怎么样，
“Well?

早点走吧！”
Let's go before it gets late.”

“不忙！
“No hurry.

我再坐一息。”
I'll sit a little longer.”

枯坐无卿，少不得寻些话来说，阿巧姐便谈苏州的乡绅人家。
Sitting silently was dull, so she found something to talk about: Suzhou's gentry families.

由富潘到贵潘，由贵潘谈到“状元宰相”，
From the wealthy Pans they passed to the distinguished Pans, and from them to first-place examination graduates and chief ministers.

苏州是出大官的地方，这一扯便扯不完了。
Suzhou produced great officials in abundance; the subject could go on forever.

看看天色将晚，入夜再去打搅潘家，不大合适。胡雪岩便催阿巧姐进城，
As dusk approached, Hu felt that calling on the Pans after nightfall would be inappropriate and urged her to enter the city.

送到潘家，约定第二天再碰面，胡雪岩便不再惊动主人，径自作别而去。
He escorted her there, arranged to meet the following day, and took his leave without disturbing the host.


轿子已经打发走了，他信步闲行，
Having dismissed his chair, Hu wandered on foot.

一走走到观前，经过一家客栈，正有一乘轿子停下，
He reached Guanqian and passed an inn just as a sedan chair stopped before it.

轿中出来一个人，背影极熟，
A man got out whose back looked familiar.

定神想了想，大喜喊道：“大哥，
Hu stared for a moment, then called in delight, “Elder Brother!

大哥！”
Elder Brother!”

那人站住脚，回头一望，
The man stopped and turned.

让胡雪岩看清楚了，果然是嵇鹤龄。
Now Hu could see clearly: it was indeed Ji Heling.

“真想不到！”
“What a surprise!”

嵇鹤龄也很高兴，
Ji was equally pleased.

“竟在这里会面。
“To meet here!

你是怎么到苏州来的？”
What brings you to Suzhou?”

“我也要问这话。”胡雪岩说，
“I was going to ask you the same thing.

“大哥，你是怎么来的？”
Why are you here?”

“我来接头今年的海运。
“Making arrangements for this year's sea transport.

来了几天了。”
I've been here several days.”

“这样说，杭州漕帮出乱子的事，你还不晓得？”
“Then haven't you heard about the disturbances in the Hangzhou brotherhood?”

“我听说了。
“I have.

虽不是我的事，到底与海运有关，心里急得很，
It isn't my responsibility, but it concerns sea transport all the same, and I've been very anxious.

只是公事未了，脱不开身。”嵇鹤龄问：“你是怎么知道的呢？”
My official business isn't finished, so I can't get away.” Ji asked, “How did you hear of it?”

“这里不是说话之处，
“This is no place to talk.

你的屋子在哪里？”
Where are your rooms?”

“喔！在这里。”
“Oh, this way.”

嵇鹤龄引着胡雪岩到他的住处，也是一个小院子，
Ji led him to his quarters, which also had a small courtyard.

有人开门出来，胡雪岩一愣，没有想到是个妙年女子。
Someone came out to open the door, and Hu was taken aback to find a young woman.

“这是胡老爷！我换帖兄弟。”
“This is Mr Hu, my sworn brother.”

“胡老爷！”
“Mr Hu!”

那妙年女子，含笑肃客：
Smiling, she welcomed him.

“请里面坐。”
“Please come inside.”

胡雪岩不知如何称呼，只含含糊糊地点头示意，视线却始终不离，
Unsure how to address her, he merely nodded vaguely, though his eyes remained on her.

看她不到二十岁年纪，穿一件月白缎子夹袄，外罩一件玄缎长背心，散脚裤，天足，
She seemed not yet twenty, wearing a pale moon-white satin lined jacket beneath a long black satin waistcoat, with loose trousers and unbound feet.

背后垂着漆黑的一条长辫子，
A long, glossy black braid hung down her back.

象是青衣侍儿，但言谈举止，却是端庄稳重，又不象个丫头，
Her appearance suggested a maid in plain dress, but her speech and conduct were dignified and composed, quite unlike a servant's.

倒有些识不透她的路数。
He could not make her out.


嵇鹤龄照理应该引见，却一直不提。
Ji ought properly to have introduced her, but said nothing.

胡雪岩越发纳闷，
Hu grew more puzzled.

但当着她本人，不便动问，只好谈漕帮同事，王有龄求援的经过。
Unable to ask in her presence, he could only speak of the brotherhood's disturbances and Wang Youling's appeal for help.

“好！
“Good!

有尤五去调停，一定可以无事。”
With You to mediate, everything should be all right.”

嵇鹤龄极欣慰地说，
Ji was deeply relieved.

“这一下，我可以放心了。”
“Now I can stop worrying.

他接着又问，“那么，你是怎么到苏州来的呢？”
But what brought you to Suzhou?”

“说来话长。”
“A long story.”

胡雪岩站起身来，
Hu rose.

“大哥，走，
“Come, Elder Brother.

我们出去吃饭，一面吃，一面谈。”嵇鹤龄欣然同意，
Let's eat out and talk over dinner.” Ji readily agreed.

“不过，有件事要先作安排。”他问胡雪岩，
“But first, there's one arrangement to make.

“你搬了来与我一起住如何？”
Why don't you move here and stay with me?”

“我今天住在这里好了，行李就不必搬了。”胡雪岩说，
“I'll stay here tonight, but there's no need to move my luggage.

“本来我想明天就走，
I meant to leave tomorrow.

既然你在此，我多住一天，
Since you're here, I'll stay another day.

后天在阊门外下船，一动不如一静。”
The day after that I'll board outside Chang Gate, so it's better to leave things where they are.”

“也好。
“Very well.

我叫人替你找屋子。”
I'll have someone find you a room.”

于是唤了他那新用的跟班长庆来，叫他到柜上关照，留一间干净上房。
Ji summoned his newly engaged attendant, Changqing, and told him to ask at the inn’s desk for a clean, superior room.

胡雪岩怕周一鸣回来找不到人，所以又托长庆专程到金阊栈去说明白己的下落。
Afraid Zhou might return and be unable to find him, Hu also asked Changqing to make a special trip to Jinchang Inn and explain his whereabouts.

这样安排停当，才一起出门，
These arrangements made, they went out together.

元大昌近在咫尺，走走就到了。
Yuandachang was only a few steps away.

两个人找了个隐僻的角落坐下，把杯倾谈，胡雪岩将此行的经过，源源本本告诉了嵇鹤龄。
Choosing a secluded corner, they sat over their wine while Hu related the full story of his visit.

“你倒真象你们西湖上所供奉的月下老人！”嵇鹤龄笑道，
“You're just like the Old Man under the Moon whom people worship by your West Lake!” Ji laughed.

“尽做这些好事。”
“Always arranging happy matches.”

“这好事不得不做。
“This is one good deed I have to do.

阿巧姐的心已经变了，
A’qiao's heart has already changed.

我何苦强留？
Why should I insist on keeping her?

至于何学使那方面，我完全是‘生意经’，也可以说押宝，
As for Commissioner He, it's entirely a business calculation—placing a bet, you might say.

押中了，大家有好处。”
If I win, everyone benefits.”

嵇鹤龄懂这“大家”二字，意思是包括他和王有龄在内，因而越觉得胡雪岩这个朋友，真是交着了。
Ji understood that “everyone” included himself and Wang, and felt more strongly than ever that Hu was a friend worth having.

不过，他到底是读过几句书的人，不以为拉这种裙带关系是件很体面的事，
Yet he was a man of some learning, and did not consider obtaining influence through a woman's relationship particularly honourable.

所以不肯作何表示。
He therefore offered no comment.


“现在要讲你屋里的那个人了。”胡雪岩问：
“Now tell me about the woman in your rooms,” Hu said.

“是怎么回事？”
“What's the story?”

听这一问，嵇鹤齿笑了：
Ji smiled.

“你当是怎么回事？”他反问一句。
“What do you think it is?”

“我哪里猜得出？
“How could I guess?

你自己说吧。”
Tell me yourself.”

“是瑞云的表妹，
“She's Ruiyun's younger cousin.

原来嫁在常熟，去年居娟，
She married in Changshu and was widowed last year.

不容于翁姑，写信给瑞云，想来投靠她表姐。
Her parents-in-law wouldn't have her, so she wrote to Ruiyun asking to come and depend on her.

瑞云问我的意思，
Ruiyun asked what I thought.

你想，我莫非那么小气，养个吃闲饭的人都不肯？
Surely I'm not so mean that I begrudge feeding one idle person?

所以趁这趟到苏州来公干的机会，预备把她带到杭州。”
I took the opportunity of this official journey to Suzhou to arrange to bring her back to Hangzhou.”

“怎么？”胡雪岩不胜惋惜他说：
“What a pity!” Hu said with deep regret.

“年纪轻轻就居孀了。”
“Widowed so young.”

看他大有惜花之意，嵇鹤龄心里一动，但随即警觉，
His evident sympathy for the young woman gave Ji an idea, but he immediately checked himself.

不宜多事，
Better not meddle.

但点点头说：
He merely nodded.

“将来自然要遣嫁。
“Naturally, she'll marry again eventually.

如果你有合适的人，譬如象陈世龙那样的，拜托你留意。”
If you know a suitable man—someone like Chen Shilong, for instance—do keep her in mind.”

“好！”
“Certainly.”

胡雪岩很切实地答应，
Hu's answer was earnest.

“我一定替她找。”
“I'll find someone for her.”


这一段又揭过去了，嵇鹤龄问到时局：
That subject passed, and Ji asked about public affairs.

“上海的情形怎么样？”
“How are things in Shanghai?”

“小刀会不成气候，只是有洋人在后面。
“The Small Swords Society amounts to little by itself, but the foreigners are behind it.

看样子，上海县城，一时怕难收复。”
I'm afraid the county town won't be recovered soon.

胡雪岩说，“这种局面一长，无非便宜了洋人。”
The longer things remain as they are, the more the foreigners benefit.”

“怎么呢？”
“How?”

嵇鹤龄近来对“洋务”很关心，
Ji had lately become very interested in foreign affairs.

所以逼视着胡雪岩问，“你倒说个道理我听听。
Looking hard at Hu, he said, “Explain your reasoning.”

““第一，租界本是一片荒地，
“First, the settlement was originally waste ground.

有地无人，毫无用处，
Land without people is useless.

现在这一乱，大家都逃到夷场去避难，
Now the disorder has driven everyone to seek refuge there.

人多成市，市面一繁荣，洋人的收入就多了。
People create a market; as trade flourishes, the foreigners' revenues increase.

第二，现在两方面都想拉拢洋人，
Second, both sides want to win them over.

鹬蚌相争，渔翁得利，
While the snipe and clam struggle, the fisherman profits.

洋人乐得从中操纵。”
The foreigners are happy to manipulate matters between them.”

“怎么个操纵法？”
“In what way?”

“无非‘见人说人话，见鬼说鬼话’，
“They speak as men to men and as ghosts to ghosts.

你要想他帮忙，就得先跟他做生意。
If you want their help, you must first do business with them.

现在两江总督怡大人，决定断绝他们的货源，
Governor-General Yiliang of Liangjiang has now decided to cut off their supplies.

我看这个办法，维持不长的。”
I don't think that policy can last.”

接着胡雪岩讲了许多夷场上与洋人有关的“奇闻异事”，
Hu went on to relate many strange stories involving foreigners in the settlement.

这在嵇鹤龄是很好的下酒物。当然，也增长了许多见识，
They made excellent entertainment over wine for Ji and taught him a good deal.

他觉得胡雪岩似乎也有些偏见，
Yet he felt that Hu too had certain prejudices.

洋人虽刁，刁在道理上，
The foreigners were shrewd, but their shrewdness rested on reason.

只要占住了理，跟洋人的交涉也并不难办。
If one had reason on one's side, negotiations need not be difficult.

最怕自己疑神疑鬼，或者一定要保住“天朝大国”的虚面子，
The worst obstacles were one's own suspicions or insistence on preserving the empty prestige of the “great Celestial Empire.”

洋人要听一句切切实实的真心话，自己偏跟他推三阻囚地敷衍，
The foreigners wanted a plain, sincere statement, while one's own side kept putting them off with evasions.

那就永远谈不拢了。
Under those conditions agreement would never be possible.

不过，这番见解，究竟尚未经过印证，
These ideas, however, remained untested.

而且风气所播，最好是痛骂洋人，
Moreover, prevailing opinion favoured round abuse of foreigners.

如果说两句持平的话，一定为卫道之士斥为不明夷夏之辨，甚之加以“认贼作父”、“汉奸”等等恶名。
Anyone who offered a fair-minded word was certain to be denounced by the guardians of orthodoxy for failing to distinguish Chinese civilisation from the foreign barbarians, perhaps even accused of taking a thief for his father or being a traitor.

因此，嵇鹤龄就是对胡雪岩这样的至交，也未便径发议论。
Ji therefore hesitated to express his view openly, even to so close a friend as Hu.


话锋一转，又谈到浙江的政局。
They turned to Zhejiang's political affairs.

嵇鹤龄亦认为黄宗汉的调动，只是日子迟早而已，
Ji too thought Huang Zonghan's transfer was merely a matter of time.

最明显的迹象是，黄宗汉自己亦已在作离任的准备，
The clearest sign was Huang's own preparation for departure.

该他收的陋规好处，固然催得甚紧，不该他得的好处，亦伸长了手在捞。
He was not only pressing hard for the customary unofficial payments and benefits that fell to him, but reaching out for gains that should not have been his at all.

这都是打算随时可以卷铺盖的模样。
These were the signs of a man ready to pack his bags at any moment.

“那么，大哥，你看何学使有没有调浙江的希望？”胡雪岩很关切地问。
“Then, Elder Brother, do you think Commissioner He has a chance of going to Zhejiang?” Hu asked with concern.

“这哪里晓得？
“How could we know?

现在也不必去管他！”胡雪岩很坦率地说了他所以特感关怀的原因。
There's no need to worry about it now.” Hu frankly explained his particular interest.

在这次上海的丝生意结束以后，他虽说决定了根本的宗旨，仍然以做钱庄为主，
After this Shanghai silk business, banking would remain the foundation of his enterprises. That principle was settled.

但上海这个码头，前程似锦，也不大肯放弃。
Yet Shanghai's prospects were so brilliant that he was reluctant to abandon it.

在他的想法是，有了官场与洋场的势力，商场的势力才会大，
His idea was that influence among officials and foreigners would strengthen his influence in commerce.

如果何桂清放了浙江巡抚，以工有龄跟他过去的渊源，加上目前自己在苏州与他一见投契的关系，这官场的势力，将会无人可以匹敌，
If He Guiqing became governor of Zhejiang, Wang's old connection with him, added to Hu's own immediate rapport with him in Suzhou, would give them unrivalled official support.

要做什么生意，无论资本调度，关卡通行，亦就无往不利。
Whatever business he attempted, whether moving capital or passing checkpoints, all would go smoothly.

“所以我现在一定要想办法看准风头，好早作预备。
“That's why I must judge which way the wind is blowing and prepare early.

如果何学使放到浙江，是没有希望的事，我的场面就要收缩，抱定稳扎稳打的宗旨，
If there's no hope of He's appointment to Zhejiang, I must reduce my operations and proceed steadily, securing each step.

倘或放到浙江是靠得住的，我还有许许多多花样拿出来。”
If the appointment is reliable, I have plenty more plans to bring out.

胡雪岩又说，“不是为此，我丢下上海、杭州许多等着料理的杂务，跑到苏州来跟小狗子这种人打交道，不发疯了吗？”
Otherwise, wouldn't I be mad to leave so much business waiting in Shanghai and Hangzhou and come to Suzhou to deal with men like Xiaogouzi?”

这一说，嵇鹤龄自然要为他认真去想了。
At this, Ji naturally felt bound to consider the matter seriously.

他点点头，不即开口，喝着酒细细思量。
He nodded without answering and thought carefully over his wine.


“我想有希望的。”嵇鹤龄先提了句使胡雪岩高兴的结论，
“I think there's a chance,” Ji began with a conclusion that pleased Hu.

“现在他们乙未这一榜，声气相通，团结得很，
“Their yiwei examination class keeps in close touch and stands firmly together.

外面的几个缺，抓到了不肯轻易放手的。
Once they secure a provincial post, they don't easily let it go.

江西巡抚张帝，是他们乙未的传胪，从前穆彰阿门下的‘穆门十子’之一，
Zhang Fu, the governor of Jiangxi, headed the second class in their yiwei palace examination and was one of Muzhang’a's ‘Ten Disciples.’

今年正月里革了职，
He was dismissed in the first month of this year.

上个月马上又推出来一个他们同榜的郑敦谨，到河南去当巡抚。
Last month they promptly put forward another classmate, Zheng Dunjin, to become governor of Henan.

现在江浙两抚，都是乙未，
Both the present governors of Jiangsu and Zhejiang belong to that class.

听说江苏的许巡抚，圣眷已衰，早有调动的消息，
I hear Governor Xu in Jiangsu has lost imperial favour; there have long been reports that he'll be moved.

如果黄巡抚再一调，一下子去了两处要紧地盘，自然要作桑榆之计。
If Governor Huang goes too, they'll lose two important territories at once and naturally seek to recover elsewhere what they've lost.

照这样说起来，何学使去接浙江，大有可能。
Looked at that way, He's succession in Zhejiang is very possible.

再还有一层，此公亦愿意自己人去接。
There's another consideration: this gentleman would also like one of his own people to follow him.”

“嵇鹤龄一面说，一面拿筷子蘸着酒写了个”黄“字，
Dipping his chopstick in wine, Ji wrote the surname Huang on the table.

自然是指责宗汉。
He meant Huang Zonghan.

“何以见得？”
“What makes you think so?”

聚精会神在倾听的胡雪岩问。
Hu was listening intently.

“这就跟我接雪公的海运局，是一样的道理。”
“For the same reason that I succeeded Mr Xuexuan at the Sea Transport Bureau.”

“啊！
“Ah!

‘一语惊醒梦中人’！”
One word wakes a dreamer!”

胡雪岩恍然大悟，
Hu understood at once.

多想一想，拍案说道：
After a moment's thought, he struck the table.

“岂止有希望，
“It's more than a chance.

简直十拿九稳了。”
It's practically certain.”


他接着提出一套深一层的看法，
He went on to develop the argument further.

黄宗汉为人阴险工心计，
Huang Zonghan was calculating and devious.

目前虽红，但冤家也不少，
Though currently in favour, he had plenty of enemies.

既然在浙江巡抚任内有许多“病”，自然要顾虑到后任谁属？
With so many things amiss in his administration of Zhejiang, he must worry about who would succeed him.

“官官相护”原是走遍天下十八省所通行的惯例，
Officials protecting one another was a practice common to all eighteen provinces.

前任有什么纰漏，后任总是尽量设法弥补。
A successor generally did his best to cover his predecessor's mistakes.

有些人缘好的官儿，闹了亏空，甚至由上司责成后任替他设法清理，也是数见不鲜的事。
It was not unusual for a popular official's deficits to be cleared by his successor at a superior's instruction.

只是有两种情形例外，一种是与后任的利害发生冲突，不能不为自己打算，一种就是前后任有仇怨，恰好报复。
There were only two exceptions: where the successor's own interests conflicted with such protection, or where an old enmity offered a chance for revenge.

黄宗汉要顾虑的，前是后一种的情形。
It was the latter that Huang had to fear.

浙江巡抚虽说归闽浙总督管辖，但总督驻福州，
Though Zhejiang fell under the governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang, that official resided in Fuzhou.

浙江的巡抚是名符其实的一省最高长官，
Zhejiang's governor was in every real sense the province's highest authority.

倘或后任抓住他的什么毛病，不需跟总督商量，就可以专折参劾，
If his successor discovered a fault, he could impeach him in a direct memorial without consulting the governor-general.

连个缓冲的余地都没有。
There would be no room for anyone to soften the blow.

所以照这样子，黄宗汉必得设法找个有交情的来接他的任，而何桂清跟他的交情，是没有话可说的。
Huang therefore had to find a friend to succeed him, and his friendship with He was beyond question.

“是的！
“Yes.

我的看法也差不多。”
My view is much the same,” Ji agreed.

“但是，”胡雪岩却又提出疑问，“如果上头对何学使想重用，而江苏的许巡抚又要调动，那么，何不将何学使放到江苏，
“But if the court means to give He an important post,” Hu objected, “and Governor Xu is to leave Jiangsu, why not appoint He there?

岂不是人地相宜，
He knows the province.

顺理成章吗？”
Wouldn't that be the natural arrangement?”

“不会！这有两个道理，
“No, for two reasons.

第一，何学使在江苏常常上奏折谈军务，颇有伤及许巡抚的话，
First, He has often submitted memorials about military affairs in Jiangsu, with remarks that reflect badly on Governor Xu.

他们是同年，不能不避嫌疑，
As members of the same examination class, they must avoid any appearance of disloyalty.

所以即使上头要派他到江苏来，他怕人家说他上折谈军务，是有取而代之的心，一定也不肯就的。”
Even if the court appointed him, He would fear being accused of writing those memorials in order to replace Xu, and would certainly refuse.”

嵇鹤龄喝了一口酒又说：
Ji drank, then continued.

“其次，江苏巡抚要带兵汀仗，
“Second, the governor of Jiangsu must command troops in battle.

而且目前是军功第一，
Military merit counts for most at present.

布政使吉尔杭阿在上海打小刀会，颇为卖力，
Ji’erhang’a, the provincial treasurer, is working hard against the Small Swords in Shanghai.

照我的看法，许巡抚倘或调动，多半是吉尔杭阿接他的手。”
In my view, if Xu is transferred, Ji’erhang’a will probably succeed him.”

这一番分析下来，胡雪岩就更放心了，
This analysis reassured Hu still further.

何桂清一定会当浙江巡抚，不过日子迟早而已。
He now felt sure that He Guiqing would become governor of Zhejiang; only the timing remained uncertain.

如果来得迟，对自己不利，但对嵇鹤龄却是有帮助的，因为这一定是中间转一任仓场侍郎，
A delay would disadvantage Hu but help Ji, for it would mean He first serving a term as granary vice-minister.

将来在通州验收海运的漕米时，嵇鹤龄可以得到许多方便。
When Ji's sea-transported tribute grain was inspected at Tongzhou, he could then enjoy considerable assistance.


通过了这些，他颇有左右逢源之乐，
Having worked through all this, Hu felt that either course would benefit them.

因而酒兴和谈兴也都更好了，喝得酩酊大醉，方跟嵇鹤龄回客栈去休息。
His appetite for both wine and conversation increased, and he drank until thoroughly drunk before returning with Ji to the inn.

第二天早晨起身，问起伙计，听说嵇鹤龄一早拜客去了，留下话，中午一定回来，要胡雪岩等他。
The next morning an attendant told him that Ji had gone out early to pay calls, leaving word that he would certainly be back at noon and wanted Hu to wait.

枯坐无卿，
Sitting alone was tedious.

而且自己也还要去等周一鸣的消息，以及跟阿巧姐见面，所以决定回金阊栈。他也留下了话，说下午再来看嵇鹤龄。
Hu also needed news from Zhou and had to see A’qiao, so he decided to return to Jinchang Inn, leaving a message that he would visit Ji again that afternoon.

未出阊门，先去看阿巧姐，跟她略说经过，表示不得不多留一天，
Before going out through Chang Gate, he called on A’qiao, briefly explained what had happened, and said he must stay another day.

这对阿巧姐是好消息，
This was good news to her.

她决定立刻回木读，把她的兄弟去领来见胡雪岩。
She decided to go straight to Mudu and bring her brother to meet him.

“也好！
“Good.

索性都把它办妥当了。
We might as well settle everything.

不过你一个人是办不了的，
But you can't manage it alone.

等周一鸣回来，我叫他再辛苦一趟，陪你一起回木渎。”
When Zhou returns, I'll ask him to take the trouble of going to Mudu once more and accompany you.

胡雪岩说，“回头你也见见我那拜把子的大哥。”
You should meet my sworn elder brother too.”

于是阿巧姐又随着胡雪岩回金阊栈，随身带着一大包衣服，
A’qiao therefore went back with him to Jinchang Inn, carrying a large bundle of clothes.

其中有她的小姐妹送她的，也有这两天现做的，
Some were gifts from her friend; others had been newly made during the past two days.

潘家常年搭着案板，雇着两名女裁缝，按日计酬。
The Pans kept a cutting table set up all year and employed two seamstresses by the day.

除却三节，无日不制新衣。
Except during the three great festivals, they made new clothes every day.

近水楼台，方便得很。
Being so close to the source was wonderfully convenient.

当然，阿巧姐晓得胡雪岩的脾气，不会把人家送她的实新而名旧的衣服在他面前穿出来。
Naturally, A’qiao knew Hu's temper and would not wear before him clothes that were in fact brand-new but counted as second-hand because her friend had given them to her.

新制的衣裙，款式自不如夷场上来得新颖，但也有一样好处，就是庄重。
Her newly made garments were less fashionable than those of the foreign settlement, but they had the virtue of dignity.

她索性连头面的修饰都改过了，尽洗铅华，只梳一个极亮的头，髻上插一支碧玉簪，耳上戴一副珠环，
She changed her hair and ornaments to match, abandoning elaborate cosmetics, dressing her hair to a smooth shine, and wearing only a green jade hairpin in the bun and pearl earrings.

陌生人见人，怎么佯也察觉不出一点风尘出身的气息。
No stranger seeing her could have detected a trace of the pleasure quarters.


就在她在金阊栈刚打扮好，预备饭后随着胡雪岩去见嵇鹤龄的时候，要去看的人，却先到了。
Just as she had finished dressing at Jinchang Inn and was preparing to accompany Hu to see Ji after lunch, their intended host arrived instead.

胡雪岩引见过后，
Hu introduced them.

阿巧姐执礼极恭，使得嵇鹤龄大起好感，当着她的面，赞不绝口。
A’qiao's manner was so respectful that Ji took a strong liking to her and praised her warmly to her face.

“雪岩！”等阿巧姐退到里室时，嵇鹤龄忍不住说了，“我略知柳庄相法，
Once she had withdrawn to the inner room, he could not hold back. “Xueyan, I know a little of the Liuzhuang method of reading faces.

这个徐娘老去的佳人，着实有一段后福。”
This beauty past her first youth has considerable good fortune ahead.”

“这一说，我的做法是对了。”
“Then I'm doing the right thing.”

胡雪岩笑道：
Hu smiled.

“看她走几步路，裙幅不动，
“Watch her walk: her skirt scarcely moves.

稳重得很，倒是掌印夫人的样子。”
She's so composed, she looks like a great official's lady.”

“不然……”
“Otherwise...”

嵇鹤龄忽然停住了。
Ji stopped abruptly.

“怎么不说下去？”
“Why don't you finish?”

胡雪岩真忍不住要追问，
Hu could not resist asking.

“这个‘不然’，大有文章。”
“There's a great deal behind that ‘otherwise.’”

嵇鹤龄想了好半夭，摇摇手说：
After a long pause, Ji waved his hand.

“不谈了！
“Never mind.

说出来徒乱人意。
Saying it would only unsettle you.

反正你‘失之东隅，收之桑榆’，
In any case, what you lose at sunrise you regain at sunset.

也无所谓。”
It makes little difference.”

他引用的这句成语，胡雪岩是懂的，
Hu understood the expression.

意思是放弃了阿巧姐可惜，但也有补偿，这个补偿，自然是从何桂清身上来，
Giving up A’qiao was a pity, but there would be compensation, naturally through He Guiqing.

由于嵇鹤龄这样说法，胡雪岩也就把未来所能得的那一份补偿，看得特别认真了。
Because Ji put it that way, Hu began to take those future compensations especially seriously.

秋收全靠春耕，
The autumn harvest depended on spring cultivation.

他觉得就从此刻起，对何桂清还得重新下一番功夫，
From this moment, he felt, he must make fresh efforts with He.

想一想另外换了个话题，但仍旧是关于何桂清与阿巧姐的。
After considering, he changed the subject, though it still concerned He and A’qiao.


“大哥！”他说，“有件事正要托你。
“Elder Brother, there's something I meant to ask.

我想请你写封信。”
I'd like you to write a letter for me.”

“写给谁？”
“To whom?”

“何学使！
“Commissioner He.

这封信要写得漂亮。最好是‘四六’……”
It must be beautifully written, preferably in the four-and-six style...”

“你怎么想来的？”嵇鹤龄笑着打断他的话，
“How did you think of that?” Ji interrupted with a laugh.

“你简直是考我。
“You're setting me an examination.

骈文要找类书，
Parallel prose requires reference books.

说得干脆些，无非獭祭成章，
To put it bluntly, one assembles a composition from quotations like an otter laying out its catch.

客边何来《佩文韵府》之类的书？”
Where am I to find something like the Peiwen Treasury of Rhymes while travelling?”

这番话说得胡雪岩不懂，但大致猜得出来是为难。
Hu did not understand the explanation, but guessed that he had asked something difficult.

胡雪岩也知道对仗工整的‘四六’，不是人人会做，心里倒有些懊悔，贸然提出来，害得嵇鹤龄受窘。
He knew that not everyone could compose those elegantly balanced four- and six-character phrases, and regretted having embarrassed Ji by proposing it so casually.

“不管它了！”嵇鹤龄看出他的心思，急忙改口，
Seeing his thoughts, Ji hastened to change his tone. “Never mind.

“你的事，我也只好勉强试一试。
Since it's for you, I'll have to make an attempt.

你说吧，怎么个意思？”
Tell me what you want to say.”

胡雪岩大喜，
Hu was delighted.

“是这样，”他说，“第一，向他道谢，自然是一番仰慕的客套，
“First, thank him, naturally with the customary expressions of admiration.

第二，就说阿巧姐寄住潘家，我欠了人家的情，请他代为致谢！”
Second, explain that A’qiao is staying with the Pans, that I owe them a debt, and ask him to thank them on my behalf.”

“第三，”嵇鹤龄笑着接口，“托他照拂佳人！”
“Third,” Ji added with a smile, “ask him to take care of the lady.”

“是有这么个想法，不过我不知道怎么说法？”
“That's what I have in mind, but I don't know how to put it.”

“我会说。”嵇鹤龄极有把握地，
“I do,” Ji said confidently.

“我好好想两个典故，隐隐约约透露点意思给他。”
“I'll find a couple of allusions to hint discreetly at the meaning.”

“对！就这样。”
“Exactly.”

胡雪岩半羡慕、半感慨地说，
Hu spoke with admiration and a touch of regret.

“你们的这支笔，实实在在厉害。
“Your brush is a formidable thing.

小时候读蒙馆，记得读过两句诗：”别人怀宝剑，我有笔如刀。
At school as a boy, I remember reading two lines: ‘Others carry treasured swords; my brush is like a blade.’

‘当时心里在想，毛笔哪有宝剑厉害？
I used to wonder how a writing brush could be more powerful than a sword.

现在才知道有些笔上刻的那句话：“横扫千军’，
Now I understand the words carved on some brushes: ‘Sweep away a thousand armies.’

真正一点不错。”
They're perfectly true.”


“也不见得那么厉害！”
“Not quite so formidable.”

嵇鹤龄由此想到了胡雪岩的不足之处，
This reminded Ji of something Hu lacked.

“有句话我早想跟你说了，
“I've wanted to tell you something for a long time.

依你现在的局面，着实要好好用几个人，
With your present responsibilities, you really must make proper use of several people.

牡丹虽好，绿叶扶持，
However fine the peony, it needs green leaves to support it.

光靠你一个人，就是三头六臂，到底也有分身不过来的时候。
Relying on yourself alone, even with three heads and six arms, there will be times when you can't be everywhere.”

“这句话搔着了胡雪岩的痒处，
The remark touched exactly the point troubling Hu.

“着啊！”他拍着大腿说，
Slapping his thigh, he exclaimed, “Precisely!

“我也久已想跟大哥讨教了。
I've long meant to ask your advice.

而且也作过打算，
I've made plans too.

我想要用两个人，一个是能够替我出面应酬的，这个人有了，就是刘不才，另外一个是能够替我办笔墨的，
I want two men: one to represent me in social dealings—I have him already, Liu Bucai—and another to handle my writing.

在湖州有个人姓黄，本说要跟我一起到杭州，后来因为别样缘故，打消了此议。
There's a man surnamed Huang in Huzhou who was to come to Hangzhou with me, but other circumstances ended that plan.

我看他的本事也有限。
I don't think his abilities are very great, either.

如今我要跟大哥商量，”
What I want to discuss with you...”

他很吃力地说，
He struggled to express himself.

“这些人，我实在也还不知道怎么用法？”
“I still don't really know how to use such people.”

嵇鹤龄将胡雪岩的情况幻想了一遍，很清楚地看出来他的“毛病”，
Ji pictured Hu's circumstances and saw his difficulty clearly.

于是这样从远处说起：
He began with the broader point.

“我说句很老实的话，你少读书，不知道怎么把场面拉开来，
“To speak frankly, you've read too little to know how to expand your establishment.

有钱没有用，
Money alone is no use.

要有人，
You need people.

自己不懂不要紧，只要敬重懂的人，
It doesn't matter if you lack knowledge yourself, provided you respect those who have it.

用的人没本事不妨，
It doesn't matter if the people you employ lack ability, either.

只要肯用人的名声传出去，自会有本事好的人，投到门下。”
Once you're known to welcome men, capable ones will naturally come to your door.”

接着，嵇鹤龄由“ 千金市骨”的故事，谈到孟尝君门下的鸡鸣狗盗之徒。
From the story of paying a thousand in gold for a horse's bones, Ji went on to Lord Mengchang's retainers, the imitator of a cock's crow and the petty thief.

胡雪岩一面听，一面心潮起伏，有了极多的启示。
Hu listened with mounting excitement and found inspiration everywhere.

等嵇鹤龄谈完，他不住赞叹颇有茅塞顿开之感。
When Ji finished, he exclaimed in admiration, feeling that an obstruction in his mind had suddenly cleared.


“我懂了！”
“I understand!”

胡雪岩连连点头，
Hu nodded repeatedly.

“我这样奔波，不是一回事！
“Rushing about like this is no way to carry on.

要弄个舒舒服服的大地方，养班吃闲饭的人，
I must find a spacious, comfortable place and support a group of men with nothing particular to do.

三年不做事，不要紧，
If they do nothing for three years, never mind.

做一件事就值得养他三年。”
One useful act may be worth three years of their upkeep.”

“你真的懂了！”嵇鹤龄极其欣慰的说，
“Now you truly understand,” Ji said with deep satisfaction.

“所谓‘门客’就是这么回事。
“That's what household retainers are.

扬州的盐商，大有孟尝遗风，
The salt merchants of Yangzhou preserve much of Lord Mengchang's tradition.

你倒不妨留意。
You might take notice of them.”

“胡雪岩不答，
Hu did not answer.

心里在细细盘算，好久，他霍地站了起来：
He calculated carefully for a long time, then sprang to his feet.

“就是这样了！
“That's settled.

这一趟回去，我要换个做法。
When I return, I'm changing my methods.”

““怎么换？”
“How?”

“用人！”
“Employ people!”

胡雪岩一拍双掌说，
Hu clapped his hands.

“我坐镇老营，到不得已时才亲自出马。”
“I'll stay at headquarters and go out myself only when there's no alternative.”

“对了！
“Exactly.

要这样子你的场面才摆得开。”嵇鹤龄又说：
Only then can your establishment grow.

“我帮你做！”
I'll help you.”

“自然。”
“Naturally.

胡雪岩说，“大哥就是我的诸葛亮。”
You're my Zhuge Liang.”

“这不敢当。”嵇鹤龄笑了，然后又仿佛有些不安地，
“I don't deserve that.” Ji laughed, then seemed a little uneasy.

“你本来是开阔一路的性情，
“You're expansive by nature.

我劝你的话，你自己也要有个数，
Keep some limits in mind when following my advice.

一下子把场面扯得太大，搞到难以为继，那就不是我的本意了！”
If you suddenly spread yourself too widely and can't sustain it, that will be far from what I intended.”

“大哥放心！”
“Don't worry, Elder Brother.”

胡雪岩在这时候才有胜过嵇鹤龄的感觉，
Only now did Hu feel he had the advantage over Ji.

“只要是几十万银子以内的调动，决不会出毛病。”
“So long as we're talking about moving sums within a few hundred thousand taels, there will be no trouble.”

“只要你有把握就行了。”
“As long as you're sure.”

嵇鹤龄站起身来，
Ji rose.

“我回去了。早早替你把那封信弄出来。”
“I'll go back and write that letter for you as soon as I can.”

“不是有什么约会，或者要去拜客？”
“Have you an engagement, or calls to make?”

“都没有。”
“Neither.”

“那何不就在这里动手？”
“Then why not begin here?”



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十五章（中）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Twenty-Five, Part Two
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


正说着，阿巧姐听见了，也走出来留客，相邀便饭，
Hearing them, A’qiao came out too and urged Ji to stay for a simple meal.

这是无所谓的事，嵇鹤龄也就答应了。
There was nothing objectionable about that, and he agreed.

“不必多预备菜。”他说，
“Don't prepare too many dishes,” he said.

“我只想吃一样东西，
“There's only one thing I want.

附近有陆稿荐没有？”
Is there a Lugaojian shop nearby?”

“陆稿荐到处都有。”
“They're everywhere.

阿巧姐说，“我叫他们去买酱猪肉。”
I'll send someone for pork in soy sauce.”

“不是酱猪肉，
“Not the pork.

是煮酱肉封口的那东西。”
I want the stuff they use to seal the pot while they cook it.”

大锅煮酱猪肉，到了用文火焖的时候，为防走气泄味，用面条封住锅口，
When a great cauldron of pork was ready to simmer over a low fire, strips of noodle dough were used to seal the lid, keeping the steam and flavour in.

那东西虽能吃，却不登大雅之堂，
The dough was edible, but hardly fit for a distinguished table.

阿巧姐便笑道：
A’qiao laughed.

“这是卖给叫化子吃的呀！”
“They sell that to beggars!”

“你不管！”胡雪岩知道嵇鹤龄的脾气，这样抢着说：
“Never mind,” Hu put in, knowing Ji's ways.

“只叫人去买就是。”
“Just send someone to buy it.”

于是话题又转到陆稿荐，
The conversation turned to Lugaojian.

胡雪岩与嵇鹤龄有同样的困惑，不知道苏州卖酱肉卤味的熟食铺，何以市招都用陆稿荐，
Hu and Ji shared the same puzzle: why did all Suzhou's shops selling pork in soy sauce and other cooked meats use that name?

到底是一家主人的许多分店，还是象杭州那小泉的剪刀店一样，真的只有一家，其余都是冒牌？
Were they branches belonging to one proprietor, or like the Xiaoquan scissors shop in Hangzhou, with only one genuine establishment and all the others imitations?

““自然是冒牌的多！”阿巧姐说。
“Most are imitations, of course,” A’qiao said.

“怎么叫陆稿荐呢？
“But why Lugaojian?

这名字题得怪。”
What a curious name.

嵇鹤龄问，“其中一定有个说法。”
There must be a story behind it.”


“是的……”
“There is.”

阿巧姐一本正经的讲陆稿荐的故事，是个神话。
With perfect seriousness, A’qiao told the legend.

据说陆家祖先起初设个卖酱肉的小铺子，
An ancestor of the Lu family had begun with a little shop selling pork in soy sauce.

有个乞儿，每天必来乞讨，主人是忠厚长者，总是操刀一割，割下好大一块肉给他。
A beggar came every day, and the owner, a kindly, generous man, always took up his knife and cut him a large piece of meat.

这乞儿后来就露宿在他家檐下，
Eventually the beggar began sleeping beneath the family's eaves.

有一天忽然不见了，剩下一床破草荐。
One day he suddenly disappeared, leaving only a ragged straw mat.

废置在屋角，从无人去理它。
It lay discarded in a corner, and nobody paid it any attention.

有一次煮肉将成，这家主人发觉还须有一把猛火，才够火候。
Once, when a batch of meat was almost ready, the owner found that it needed one fierce burst of heat to finish it.

这最好是用柴草，苏州人称为“稻柴”。稻柴一时无处去觅，
The best fuel would be straw, which Suzhou people called “rice firewood”, but none could be found at the moment.

恰好拿那床破草荐派用处，
The old mat came conveniently to hand.

谁知这床草荐一烧，锅中的酱肉，香闻数里。
Who could have guessed that burning it would send the aroma of the pork drifting for several li?

生意就此做开了。
Business prospered from then on.

为了不忘本起见，便题名陆稿荐。
To remember the origin of their good fortune, they named the shop Lugaojian: Lu's Straw Mat.

“禾秆为稿。这个名字倒是通人所题。”嵇鹤龄说，
“Gao means grain stalks,” Ji observed. “A learned man must have chosen the name.

“不过我就不懂了，为什么这床草荐能叫酱肉香闻数里？”
But I still don't understand why the mat made the aroma of the pork travel for several li.”

“那自然是沾着仙气的缘故。”阿巧姐说，
“Naturally, it carried an immortal's influence.

“这个叫化子，不是真的叫化子，
That wasn't a real beggar.

是吕洞宾下凡。”
It was Lü Dongbin come down to earth.”

“原来吕仙游戏人间。”
“So Immortal Lü was amusing himself among mortals.”

“鬼话！”胡雪岩笑道，
“Nonsense!” Hu laughed.

“人发达了，总有段离奇古怪的故事，
“Whenever someone prospers, there's always a fantastic story about him.

生意做得发达了，也是如此。”
It's the same when a business succeeds.”


“能叫人编出这么个荒诞不经的故事来，也足以自豪了。
“To inspire such a wildly improbable tale would itself be something to be proud of,” Ji replied.

但愿后人提起胡雪岩，也有许多离奇的传说。”
“May future generations tell many strange stories about Hu Xueyan.”

“身后的名气我不要！”胡雪岩随口答道，
“I don't want fame after death,” Hu answered casually.

“我只要生前有名，
“I want it while I'm alive.

有一天我阜康的招牌，就象苏州陆稿荐一样，到处看得见，那就不白活一世了。”
If one day Fukang signs are as common everywhere as Lugaojian signs in Suzhou, I shan't have lived for nothing.”

“这也不是办不到的事。
“That isn't impossible.

就看你能不能立志！”
It depends on whether you can set yourself the ambition.”

嵇鹤龄勉励着换帖弟兄。
Ji was encouraging his sworn brother.

胡雪岩脱口答道：“立志在我，成事在人！”
Hu replied without thinking, “The resolve is mine; success rests with others.”

“这两句话说得好！”
“Well said!”

嵇鹤龄大为赞赏，
Ji was full of admiration.

“雪岩，你的吐属，真是大不凡了。”
“Xueyan, your words are truly extraordinary.”

“大哥，你不要捧我。”胡雪岩高兴地谦虚着。
“Don't flatter me, Elder Brother,” Hu said, pleased despite his modest reply.

“不是捧你，
“It isn't flattery.

你这两句话，确是见道之言。
Those two phrases show real understanding.

成语所说：”谋事在人，成事在天‘，
The old saying is, ‘Man makes the plans, but Heaven determines success.’

自己作不得自己的主，算得了什么好汉？
What sort of man cannot command his own fate?

象你这样就对了！先患不立志，次患不得人！
Your way is right: first beware of lacking ambition, then of lacking the right men.”

“这几句话说得胡雪岩脸发烫，
Hu's face grew hot.

觉得他的夸奖，真个受之有愧，
He felt that he did not deserve this praise.

原来的意思，亦等于“成事在天”，事情成不成，要看别人。
What he had meant was little different from leaving success to Heaven: whether things worked out depended on other people.

而嵇鹤龄却把“在人”解释为“得人”，
Ji had interpreted “rests with others” as “finding the right people”.

并非本意。然而这样解释，确比本意高明。
That had not been Hu's intention, though the interpretation was certainly wiser than his own meaning.


“仅有志向，不能识人、用人，此之谓‘志大才疏’，
“To have ambition without knowing how to recognize and employ people is what we call ‘great ambition and little ability’.

象那样的人，生来就苦恼！”嵇鹤龄停了一下又说：
Such a man is born to suffer,” Ji continued.

“不得志的时候，自觉埋没英才，满腹牢骚，
“When unsuccessful, he thinks his genius has been buried and is full of grievances.

倘或机缘凑巧，大得其发，却又更坏！”
If chance brings him a great opportunity and he rises high, things become worse.”

“这……”聚精会神在倾听的胡雪岩失声而问，“什么道理？”
Listening intently, Hu could not help exclaiming, “Why should that be?”

“这个道理，就叫‘爬得高，跌得重’！
“Because the higher he climbs, the harder he falls.

他的爬上去是靠机会，或者别的人有意把他捧了上去的，
He has risen through chance, or because someone deliberately raised him up.

捧上了台，要能守得住，也不是件容易的事。
Holding the place once he's been put there is no easy matter.

这一摔摔下来，就不送命，也跌得鼻青眼肿。
When he tumbles, even if he doesn't lose his life, he'll be badly battered.

所以这种志大才疏的人，怎么样也是苦恼！”
A man whose ambitions exceed his abilities suffers whatever happens.

嵇鹤龄又说，“嵇诸史实，有许多草莽英雄，因缘时会，成王称帝，到头来一场春梦，性命不保，
Look through history: many heroes from humble beginnings became kings and emperors when circumstance favoured them, only to wake from their brief dream and lose their lives.

说起来大都是吃了这四个字的亏。
Most came to grief through precisely that failing.”

“这番议论，胡雪岩心领神会，大有领悟，
Hu understood and learned a great deal.

每次跟嵇鹤龄长谈，总觉得深有所得，当然，也深深领受了朋友之乐，
Every long talk with Ji left him feeling enriched and deeply aware of the pleasures of friendship.

不过这份乐趣，较之与郁四、尤五，甚至王有龄在一起的感受，是大不相同的。
Yet this pleasure differed greatly from what he felt with Yu Si, You Laowu, or even Wang Youling.

“说实在，我的见识，实在在大哥之下。”他心悦诚服地说，
“To tell the truth, my understanding falls far short of yours,” he said with complete sincerity.

“为人真是不可不读书。”
“A man really ought to read.”

“ ‘世事洞明皆学问’，
“‘Understanding the world is learning too.’

光是读死书，做八股，由此飞黄腾达，倒不如一字不识，却懂人情世故的人。”
A man who rises through memorizing books and writing eight-legged essays may be worth less than an illiterate who understands people and their affairs.”

“大哥这话，又是牢骚了！”
“Now you're airing a grievance again!”

胡雪岩知道，科甲出身的官儿，看不起捐班，但捐班中有本事的，一样也看不起科甲中的书呆子。
Hu knew that officials who had passed the examinations looked down on men who had purchased rank, but able men among the latter equally despised bookish fools among the former.

“你说他牢骚，他说他老实话也可以。”
“Call it a grievance or call it the truth. Either will do.”


“我倒说句老实话，”胡雪岩忽然想起，“也是极正经的话，
“Then let me say something truthful—and entirely serious.” A thought had occurred to Hu.

大哥，你还打算不打算‘下场’？”
“Elder Brother, do you still intend to sit the examinations?”

嵇鹤龄是俗称秀才的生员，“下场”是指乡试，
Ji was a licentiate, commonly called a xiucai, so this meant the provincial examination.

他自然也打算过，
Naturally, he had considered it.

“‘下场’也不容易，”
“It isn't so easy.

他说，“辕门听鼓，闲了好多年，刚得个差使，
I waited for employment for years and have only just obtained a post.

辞掉了去赴乡试，就算侥幸了，还有会试。
If I resign to take the provincial examination, even if luck favours me, there's still the metropolitan examination.

这一笔浇裹哪里来？”
Where would the money come from?”

“这怕什么？
“Why worry about that?

都是我的事。”
Leave it all to me.”

“论你我的交情，果真我有秋风一战的雄心，少不得要累你。
“Given our friendship, if I truly had the ambition to try my fortunes in the autumn examination, I should have to trouble you.

不过，想想实在没有意思。”
But when I consider it, there seems little point.”

“何以呢？”
“Why?

胡雪岩怂恿地说，“今年甲寅，明年乙卯才是大比之年，
This year is jiayin; next year, yimao, is the year of the great examination.

有一年多的功夫，
There's more than a year to prepare.

正好用用功。”
You could study properly.”

嵇鹤龄是久绝此想了，摇摇头说：
Ji had long abandoned the idea and shook his head.

“时逢乱世，哪里都可以立功名，
“In troubled times, a man can win distinction anywhere.

何必一定要从试场去讨出身？
Why must he seek his standing in an examination hall?

越是乱世，机会越多。
The greater the disorder, the more opportunities there are.

其中的道理，我想，你一定比我还清楚。”
I imagine you understand why better than I do.”

这又是一个启示，
This was another revelation.

胡雪岩想想果然，
Hu saw that it was true.

自己做生意，都与时局有关，
All his business had been connected with the state of the country.

在太平盛世，反倒不见得会这样子顺利，
In a peaceful, prosperous age, he might not have done so well.

由此再往深处去想，自己生在太平盛世，应变的才具无从显见，
Thinking further, he realized that peace would have given his ability to adapt no occasion to show itself.

也许就庸庸碌碌地过一生，与草木同腐而已。
He might simply have led an ordinary life and rotted away like grass and trees.

感慨之下，不由得脱口说了一句：“乱世才会出人材！”
“Only troubled times bring out men of talent!” he exclaimed.

“这话倒是有人说过。”
“Others have said that too.”

嵇鹤龄有着嘉许之意，
Ji sounded approving.

“以上下五千年，人材最盛的是秦未汉初跟魏、蜀、吴三分的时候，
“In five thousand years of history, talent flourished most at the end of Qin and beginning of Han, and when Wei, Shu and Wu divided the empire.

那时候就是乱世。”
Those were troubled times.”

“如今呢？”
“And now?

胡雪岩说，“也可以说是乱世。
This too is an age of disorder.

就不知道后世来看，究竟出了多少人材？”
I wonder how many men of talent later generations will find in it.”

“不会少！
“Not a few.

只说眼前，雪岩，你不要妄自菲薄，
To speak only of the present, don't undervalue yourself, Xueyan.

象你就是难得的人材。”
You're a rare talent yourself.”


胡雪岩笑笑不作声，
Hu smiled without answering.

就这时候，阿巧姐来请用饭，
Just then A’qiao came to call them to the meal.

馆子里叫的菜，十分丰盛，另外一大盘陆稿荐的酱肉，
The dishes ordered from a restaurant were plentiful, with a large platter of Lugaojian pork besides.

自然也有那不登大雅的食物在内。
Naturally, the humble food unfit for grand tables was there too.

“你也一起来吃吧！”胡雪岩对阿巧姐说。
“Come and eat with us,” Hu told her.

“哪有这个规矩？”
“There isn't any rule permitting that.”

她笑着辞谢。
She declined with a smile.

“又没有外人。”嵇鹤龄接口说道，
“There are no outsiders here,” Ji put in.

“我跟雪岩都是第一趟到苏州，
“It's the first visit to Suzhou for both of us.

要听你谈谈风土人情。”
We want you to tell us about its people and customs.”

听得这样说，再要客套，就显得生分了。
Further ceremony would now seem unfriendly.

阿巧姐心想，反正也要照料席面，
A’qiao reflected that she would have to attend to the table in any case.

站着显得尴尬，倒不如坐了下来。
Standing would be awkward; better sit.

于是她打横作陪，一面斟酒布菜，尽主人的职司，一面跟嵇鹤龄谈家常。
She therefore took a place at the side, pouring wine and serving dishes as hostess while talking with Ji about everyday matters.

苏州女人长于口才，阿巧姐又是历练过的，
Suzhou women were skilled in conversation, and she had experience besides.

所以嵇鹤龄觉得她措词得体、声音悦耳，益生好感。
Her tactful words and pleasant voice increased Ji's liking for her.

这一来，一顿酒便喝得时候长了，喝到四点多钟，方始结束。
The meal consequently lasted a long time, ending only after four.

等嵇鹤龄一走，周一鸣跟着就到，
No sooner had Ji left than Zhou Yiming arrived.

阿巧姐的事，已经顺顺利利谈成功，
The negotiations over A’qiao's affairs had gone smoothly.

只待“过付”，便可“成交”。
Only payment remained before the transaction could be completed.

“恭喜，恭喜！”胡雪岩笑着问阿巧姐说：
“Congratulations!” Hu said to her with a smile.

“你算是脱掉束缚了。”
“You've thrown off your fetters.”

“多亏周先生费心！”
“Thank you for all your trouble, Mr Zhou.”

阿巧姐向周一鸣道了谢，接着又歉然他说：“明天只怕还要劳驾。”于是胡雪岩代为说明，要请他陪阿巧姐再回木渎去一趟，将她的弟弟领了出来。
After thanking him, she added apologetically, “I'm afraid I shall need your help again tomorrow.” Hu explained that Zhou was to accompany her to Mudu once more and bring out her younger brother.

周一鸣自然毫不迟疑地应承下来。
Naturally, he agreed without hesitation.


经过这一番细谈，又到了晚饭时分，
By the time they had discussed everything, it was supper time.

胡雪岩留下周一鸣吃饭，
Hu asked Zhou to stay and eat.

自己只喝着茶相陪，口中闲谈，心里在打主意。
He himself drank tea to keep him company, chatting while privately considering a plan.

等盘算定了，闲闲问道：“老周，我倒问你一句话，你平时有没有想过，自己发达了是怎么个样子？”
When he had made up his mind, he asked casually, “Old Zhou, have you ever imagined what your life would be like if you prospered?”

周一鸣无从回答，
Zhou had no answer ready.

“我没有想过。”他很坦率地说，
“I've never thought about it,” he replied frankly.

“混一天，算一天！”
“I get through one day at a time.”

“这样子总想过，譬如说，要做个怎么样的官，讨个怎么样的老婆？”
“Surely you've thought about what sort of official you might become, or what sort of wife you'd marry?”

“我在家乡有一个。”
“I have a wife at home.

周一鸣说，“我那女人是从小到我家来的，比我大两岁，
She came to our family as a child, and she's two years older than me.

人根贤惠，
A very good woman.

一直想接她出来，总是办不成功。”
I've always wanted to bring her here, but never managed it.”

“这总有个道理在里头。
“There must be a reason.

你说，何以办不成功？”
Why haven't you managed?”

“这还不容易明白？
“Isn't it easy enough to see?

说来说去，是个钱字。”
It all comes down to money.”

周一鸣不胜感慨地说，
Zhou spoke with deep feeling.

“这两年，一个人混一个人，替人跑腿，又不能在哪里安顿下来。
“These last two years, I've barely managed on my own, running errands for people and unable to settle anywhere.

想想不敢做那样冒失的事，”
I daren't do anything so rash.”

“那么，你要怎么个样子，才能把你女人接出来？”
“What would have to change before you could bring her?”

“现在就有希望了。”周一鸣换了副欣慰的神情，“多亏胡大老爷照应。
Zhou's expression brightened. “Now there's hope, thanks to your help.

这趟到扬州，谋好差使，如果靠得住一年有二百两银子的入息，我就要接我女人出来，让她过几天安闲日子了。
If I get a post in Yangzhou with a dependable income of two hundred taels a year, I'll send for her and let her enjoy a few peaceful days.”

““这也不算什么。”
“That isn't much.

胡雪岩说，“照我想，象你这样的人，一个月总得要有五十两银子的入息，才不委屈你。”
In my view, a man like you ought to have at least fifty taels a month to be properly valued.”

“哪有这样的好事？”
“Where could I find such good fortune?

周一鸣说，“如果哪个给我这个数，我死心塌地跟他一辈子。”
If anyone gave me that, I'd serve him faithfully for the rest of my life.”


“这话是真的？”
“Do you mean that?”

周一鸣是信口而答，此刻发现胡雪岩的神色相当认真，倒不敢随便回答了。
Zhou had spoken without thinking, but now he saw that Hu looked quite serious and dared not answer carelessly.

“我们随便谈谈。”胡雪岩放缓了语气，
“We're only chatting,” Hu said in a gentler tone.

“无所谓的。”
“There's no obligation.”

话虽如此，周一鸣却必得认真考虑，
Even so, Zhou had to consider it carefully.

看胡雪岩的神情，倒有些猜不透他的用意，只好这样答道：
He could not quite tell what Hu intended.

“若是胡大老爷要我，我自然乐意。”
“If you wanted me, sir, I'd naturally be willing.”

“不是这话，不是这话！”
“That's not what I mean.”

胡雪岩摇着手说，
Hu waved his hand.

“我用人不喜欢勉强。”
“I don't like anyone to work for me out of obligation.”

“我是真心话。
“I mean it.

跟胡大老爷做事，实在痛快，
Working for you is a real pleasure.

莫说每月五十两，有一半我就求之不得了。”
Never mind fifty taels a month—I'd be delighted with half.”

看他说得恳切，胡雪岩也就道破了本意，
Seeing his sincerity, Hu explained his intention.

他说他想用周一鸣，是这天跟嵇鹤龄畅谈以后的决定。
After that day's long conversation with Ji, he had decided to employ Zhou.

他预备论年计薪，每年送周一鸣六百两银子，年终看盈余多少，另外酌量致送红利。
He proposed an annual salary of six hundred taels, with a further bonus at year's end according to the profits.

要周一鸣仔细想过以后再答复他，
Zhou should think it over carefully before answering.

如果不愿意，仍旧想到扬州，他也谅解，因为厘金关卡上的差使，到底是“官面上的人”。
If he preferred to go to Yangzhou, Hu would understand: a post at a lijin station did, after all, make a man part of officialdom.

“哪个要做那种‘官面上的人’？
“Who wants that kind of official standing?

我也无需仔细想，
I needn't think it over.

此刻就可以告诉胡大老爷，一切都遵吩咐。”
I can tell you now: I shall do whatever you ask.”

“好！”胡雪岩欣然说道：
“Excellent!” Hu said gladly.

“这一来，我们就是自己人了。”
“From now on, you're one of our own.”


不过，在周一鸣这一来反倒拘束了，
The new relationship made Zhou more constrained rather than less.

不便再一个人在那里自斟自饮，匆匆吃完饭，
He could no longer sit there drinking by himself and hurried through his meal.

自己收拾了桌子，接着便问起阿巧姐明日的行程。
After clearing the table himself, he asked about A’qiao's journey the next day.

“我把阿巧姐托给你了。”
“I'm entrusting her to you.

胡雪岩说：“明天等立了笔据，你陪她到木渎。
Once the document has been drawn up tomorrow, accompany her to Mudu.

事情办完了，你把他兄弟带到上海来。
When everything is settled, bring her brother to Shanghai.

回头我抄上海、杭州的地址给你。”
I'll write down my addresses there and in Hangzhou for you.”

“那么，”阿巧姐听见了，走来问道：“你呢？”
Hearing this, A’qiao came over. “And what about you?”

“我看嵇大哥的意思。”
“I'll see what Elder Brother Ji wants.

胡雪岩答道：“明天再陪他一天，大概后天一早，一定要动身。
I'll spend another day with him tomorrow, and I really ought to leave early the day after.

现在有老周照应你，你落得从容，在木渎多住几天，
With Old Zhou to look after you, you can take your time and stay a few extra days in Mudu.

以后有什么事，我请老周来跟你接头。
If anything comes up afterwards, I'll send him to make arrangements with you.

总而言之，‘送佛送到西天’，
In short, once you've escorted the Buddha, you must see him all the way to the Western Paradise.

一定要把你安顿好了，我才算了掉一件大事。”
I won't consider this great business finished until you're properly settled.”

一则是当着周一鸣，阿巧姐不愿她与胡雪岩之间的“密约”，让局外人窥出端倪，
First, Zhou was present, and A’qiao did not want an outsider to glimpse the private understanding between her and Hu.

再则是这两三日中，对胡雪岩的观感，又有不同，
Second, her view of Hu had changed again during the past two or three days.

所以当时便作了表示。
She therefore made her attitude clear.

“啥个‘送佛送到西天’？
“What's all this about escorting the Buddha to the Western Paradise?

我不懂！”
I don't understand!”


不管她是真不懂，还是假不懂？反正对“送佛送到西天”这番好意，她并不领情，却是灼然可见的。
Whether she truly failed to understand or only pretended, she plainly did not welcome his well-meant promise to see everything through.

胡雪岩也发觉了，自己说话稍欠检点，所以很见机地下提此事，
Hu too realized that his words had been a little indiscreet and wisely dropped the subject.

只对周一鸣说：
He turned to Zhou.

“你早点请回吧！
“Go home early.

你自己有啥未了之事，最好早早料理清楚。
If you have any unfinished business of your own, clear it up as soon as possible.

我顺便有句话要叫你先有数，
There's something I ought to tell you now.

我做事是要‘抢’的，
In my work, we have to move quickly.

可以十天半个月没事，有起事来，说做就要做。
There may be nothing to do for ten days or a fortnight, but once something comes up, we act at once.

再说句不近情理的话，有时候让你回家说一声的工夫都没有。
To say something that may sound unreasonable, there may not even be time for you to go home and tell your family.

当然，你家里我会照应，
Naturally, I'll look after them.

天大的难处，都在我身上办妥。
Whatever difficulty arises, however great, I'll settle it.

凡是我派出去办事的人，说句文绉绉的话：决无后顾之忧。
Anyone I send out on business—to put it in a literary phrase—will have no worries about those left behind.

老周，你跟了我，这一点你一定要记在心里。”
Remember that when you work for me.”

“胡大老爷……”
“Your Honour...”

“慢点！”
“Wait!”

胡雪岩很快地打断了他的话，
Hu cut him off.

“称呼要改一改了。
“We must change how you address me.

我的这个‘大老爷’，是花银子买来的，
I bought this ‘Your Honour’ with silver.

不是真的坐堂问案的‘大老爷’。
I'm not a real magistrate presiding over cases in court.

如果是不相于的人，要这样子叫我，虽然受之有愧，不过既然有‘部照’，好歹也是个官，
If a stranger chooses to address me that way, I may feel undeserving, but I do have a board certificate and count as an official of sorts.

朝廷的体制在那里，硬要不承认，就叫却之不恭。
The court's established forms must be respected, so to insist on refusing the title would be discourteous.

做生意没有什么大老爷、二老爷的，只有大老板、二老板。
In business, we have no first or second official masters, only first or second proprietors.

不过我也不喜欢分出老板、伙计来，
Yet I don't like dividing people into employers and employees either.

我另外有两个‘朋友’，一个叫刘庆生，一个叫陈世龙，都是我的得力帮手，
I have two other ‘friends’, Liu Qingsheng and Chen Shilong, both able assistants.

他们都叫我胡先生，
They call me Mr Hu.

你也这样叫好了。
Do the same.

别的地方，我要跟你学，做生意，我说句狂话，你要跟我学，
There are other things you can teach me; but in business, if I may boast, you must learn from me.

这个‘先生’，就是你跟我学做生意的先生。”
Think of the title xiansheng, ‘Mr’, in its other sense: your teacher in business.”

“喔唷唷！”
“Oh, dear!”

阿巧姐在旁边作出蹙眉不胜，用那种苏州女人最令人心醉的发嗲的神情说：
A’qiao frowned in mock distress, with the beguiling petulance of a Suzhou woman.

“闲话多是多得来！”“话虽多，句句实用，”周一鸣正色说道，
“What a lot of words!” Zhou answered seriously. “Many words, but every one useful.

“胡先生，我就听你吩咐了。”
Mr Hu, I am ready for your instructions.”

“就这样了。
“Then it's settled.

你明天一早来。”
Come early tomorrow.”


就在周一鸣要离去的那一刻，金阊栈的伙计带进一个人来，这个人阿巧姐认得，是潘家的听差。
Just as Zhou was about to leave, an inn servant brought in someone A’qiao recognized: an attendant from the Pan household.

“他叫潘福。”阿巧姐在窗子里望见了，这样对胡雪岩说，
“That's Pan Fu,” she told Hu after seeing him through the window.

“不晓得为啥来？
“I wonder why he's come.

如果是跟我有关系的事，不要随便答应。”
If it's anything to do with me, don't agree too readily.”

说完，她将他轻轻一推。
She gave him a gentle push.

于是胡雪岩在外屋接见潘福。
Hu received the man in the outer room.

来人请安以后，从拜匣里取出一封梅红帖子，递了上来，
After paying his respects, Pan Fu took a plum-red invitation from his card case and presented it.

打开一看，是潘叔雅用“教愚弟”署名，请他吃饭，日期是第二天中午。
Pan Shuya, signing himself Hu's humble younger friend and pupil, invited him to lunch the next day.

帖子上特别加了四字，“务乞赏光”。
He had added an emphatic request: “Do please honour me by coming.”

这就很突兀了！
This was unexpected.

潘叔雅是十足的“大少爷”，对不相干的人懒于应酬，
Pan was a young master through and through, reluctant to bother with people who did not concern him.

所以胡雪岩到潘家去过几次，根本就不请见男主人。
For that reason, on his several recent visits to the house, Hu had not asked to see its master.

而此时忽然发帖请客，必有所谓，被请的人自然要问一问：所为何来？
Such a sudden invitation must have a purpose, and Hu naturally asked what it was.

“只为仰慕胡大老爷。”潘福答道：
“Nothing but admiration for you, sir,” Pan Fu replied.

“也没有请别位客，
“No other guests have been invited.

专诚请胡大老爷一个人。”
My master especially wishes to entertain you alone.”

胡雪岩实在想不到潘叔雅是何用意？但此时亦不必去想，
Hu could not imagine what Pan intended, but there was no need to puzzle over it now.

到明日赴宴，自然明白。
He would learn at lunch.

当即取了一张回帖，向潘福说明准到，先托他代为道谢。
He took a reply card, confirmed that he would attend and asked Pan Fu to convey his thanks.

“敝上又说，如果胡大老爷明日上午不出门，或者要到哪里，
“My master also asked whether you'll remain here tomorrow morning or go elsewhere.

先请吩咐，好派轿来接。”
Please let us know where to send the chair.”

“大概不出门，不过派轿来接，大可不必。”
“Probably here, but there's no need to send one.”

“一定要的。
“He insists.

敝上说，不是这样，不成敬意。”
Without it, he says, he would not be showing proper respect.”

既然如此，亦就不必客气。
In that case, further refusals were unnecessary.

等潘福告薛去后，少不得与阿巧姐研究其事，
After Pan Fu left, Hu and A’qiao discussed the invitation.

彼此的意见相同，潘叔雅下此请帖，一则说是“务乞赏光”，再则要派轿来接，必是有事重托。
They agreed that the emphatic request and the offer of a chair must mean Pan had an important favour to ask.

至于所托何事，连住在潘家好几天的阿巧姐都无从猜测。
Even A’qiao, who had stayed in the house for several days, could not guess what it was.


“不管它了！”胡雪岩说，
“Never mind,” Hu said.

“你让老周陪着你进城吧！
“Let Old Zhou accompany you into the city.

顺便先在潘家姨太太那里探探口气，明天我到了，先想法子透个信给我。”
Sound out the Pan mistress while you're there, and find some way to let me know before I meet him tomorrow.”

阿巧姐还有些恋恋不舍之意，但当着周一鸣不便多说什么，
A’qiao still seemed reluctant to leave, but could say little in Zhou's presence.

终于还是雇轿进了城。
At last she hired a chair and went into the city.

一夜无话，
The night passed without incident.

第二天清早，胡雪岩进城逛了逛，
Early the next morning, Hu went in for a stroll.

看嵇鹤龄不在客栈，亦未惊动瑞云的表妹，悄悄回到金阊栈。
Ji was out, so he returned quietly to Jinchang Inn without disturbing Ruiyun's cousin.

十一点钟刚打过，潘家所派的轿子到了。
Just after eleven, the chair from the Pans arrived.

居然是顶大轿。
It was a grand official chair.

问起来才知道潘叔雅一出生未几，他父亲就仿照扬州盐商的办法，花了两万银子，替他捐了个道员，
On inquiry, Hu learned that soon after Pan's birth, his father had followed the example of the Yangzhou salt merchants and spent twenty thousand taels to buy him the rank of circuit intendant.

三品官儿，照例可以坐绿呢大轿。
As a third-rank official, he was entitled to a large chair covered in green woollen cloth.

按规矩，还可以有“顶马”，但这份官派，潘叔雅未摆，
He could even have mounted outriders, though he had not adopted that part of the official display.

只是那顶大轿，十分讲究，三面玻璃窗，挂着彩绸的窗帷，轿檐上是彩色的缨络，轿杠包铜，擦得雪亮。
The chair itself was splendid: glass windows on three sides with coloured silk curtains, bright tassels along the eaves, and brass-covered poles polished to a shine.

轿子里盖碗、水果、闲食，还有一管水烟袋、两部闲书，一部《隔帘花影》、一部《野臾曝言》，
Inside were a covered tea bowl, fruit, snacks, a water pipe and two novels, Flower Shadows Behind the Curtain and An Old Rustic's Unvarnished Words.

如果是走长路，途中不愁寂寞，尽有得消遣。
On a long journey, there would be no lack of diversion.


胡雪岩还是第一趟坐大轿，
Hu had never ridden in such a large chair before.

看到四名轿伕抬轿的样子，不由得想起嵇鹤龄的话，嵇鹤龄讲笑话，
Watching the four bearers, he remembered one of Ji's jokes.

说四名轿伕，各有四个字的形容，
Each man, Ji said, could be described in four characters.

前面第一个昂首天外，叫做“扬眉吐气”，
The first held his head high: “head up, spirits lifted”.

第二个叫做“不敢放屁”，因为位置正在“老爷，‘前面，一放屁则”老爷“首当其冲，
The second “dared not let wind”, since he was directly in front of the gentleman, who would suffer the first blast.

后面两名轿伕，前面的一个，视线为轿子挡住，因而叫做”不辨东西“，
Of the two behind, the nearer man's view was blocked by the chair: he “couldn't tell east from west”.

最后一个亦步亦趋，只有跟着走，那就是”毫无主意“。
The last simply followed every step: “no ideas of his own”.

据说军机大臣的情形，就跟这四名轿伕一样。
The Grand Councillors were said to be much the same.

军机领袖自然“扬眉吐气”，
Their leader naturally held his head high.

奏对时，照例由他一个人发言，所以第二个叫做“不敢放屁”，
Since he alone customarily spoke during an imperial audience, the second dared not let wind.

第三个进军机不久，还摸不清楚底细，以“不辨东西”形容，亦是刻画入微，
The third was new to the council and still ignorant of its workings; not knowing east from west described him perfectly.

至于最后一个，通称“打帘子军机”，当然是“毫无主意”了。
The last, commonly called the “curtain-lifting Grand Councillor”, naturally had no ideas of his own.

由此又想到何桂清的同年，军机大臣彭蕴章，
This brought Hu's thoughts to Peng Yunzhang, He's fellow graduate and a Grand Councillor.

不知位列第几？
Where did he stand?

如果是“不敢放屁”，则又何能力何桂清说话？
If he was the one who dared not let wind, how could he speak on He's behalf?

几时有机会倒要问一问他。
Hu must ask He about it when an opportunity arose.


就这样胡思乱想着，不知不觉已到了潘家，
While his thoughts wandered in this fashion, they reached the Pan house.

轿子一直抬到大厅檐外，
The chair was carried right up to the eaves of the great hall.

才知道潘福的话靠不住，除了主人以外，另外还有两位客，一般是华服的贵公子派头。
Only then did Hu discover that Pan Fu's words were unreliable: besides the host, two other guests were present, both dressed like wealthy young gentlemen.

宾主互揖以后，主人为胡雪岩引见两位新交。
After host and guest exchanged bows, Pan made the introductions.

他猜得果然不错，
Hu had guessed correctly.

一个叫吴季重，一个叫陆芝香，
One was Wu Jizhong, the other Lu Zhixiang.

都是贵介公子，父兄皆是京官，本人是秀才。
Both came from distinguished families, with fathers and elder brothers holding posts in the capital; both were themselves licentiates.

彼此道过仰慕，潘叔雅延入花园接待。
They exchanged the customary expressions of long-standing admiration, and Pan led them into the garden.

潘家的花园甚大，但房屋显得很旧了，
It was large, but the buildings looked old.

只有一座楠木船厅是新建的，潘叔雅就在这里款客。
Only a boat-shaped pavilion of nanmu timber was new, and it was here that Pan entertained them.

男仆在厅外，
Male servants waited outside.

厅内用两个丫头伺候，苏州的丫头得一俏字，一式滚花边的竹布衫、散脚裤，束得极细的腰，梳得极光的辫子，染得极红的指甲。
Within, two maids attended them, exemplifying the prettiness of Suzhou girls: matching cotton tunics trimmed with patterned borders, loose-legged trousers, tightly drawn waists, glossy braids and nails dyed bright red.

莺声呖呖地，
Their voices were as clear as orioles'.

叫潘、吴、陆三人都是“少爷”，只称胡雪岩才是“胡老爷”！
Pan, Wu and Lu were all “Young Master”; Hu alone was “Master Hu”.

时已正午，就在船厅中开席。
At noon, the meal was served in the pavilion.

主人奉胡雪岩首座，不待他谦让，首先声明，
Pan offered Hu the seat of honour and forestalled his refusal.

客人只有胡雪岩一位，
Hu was the only guest, he explained.

吴季重和陆芝香连陪客都不是，
Wu and Lu were not even fellow guests invited to keep him company.

算是三个主人公请，有事要向胡雪岩请教。
The three were jointly his hosts, and had something to consult him about.

潘福的话是不错。
Pan Fu's words had been correct after all.


有事要托胡雪岩是他早已意料到，
Hu had already expected a request.

等酒过三巡，他先开口动问了，潘叔雅才细叙缘由。
After three rounds of wine, he asked first, and Pan explained the circumstances.

事起于阿巧姐的闲谈，
It had begun with A’qiao's conversation.

跟潘家姨太太在一起盘桓，闺中无事，她把从尤五、怡情老二以及胡雪岩本人那里听来的许多故事，作为消遣之实。
While passing idle hours with the Pan mistress in the women's quarters, she had entertained her with stories heard from You Laowu, Second Miss and Hu himself.

胡雪岩的故事本来就与众不同，加以阿巧姐口齿伶俐，渲染入微，
His adventures were unusual enough, and A’qiao's eloquence and vivid embellishments made them especially absorbing.

所以潘家姨太太深感兴趣。
The mistress was fascinated.

于是这些故事又从枕上传到了潘叔雅的耳朵里。这一下，他对胡雪岩刮目相看！
The stories then travelled by way of the pillow to Pan's ears, changing his view of Hu entirely.

纨袴子弟交朋友，从不交平淡无奇的方正君子，
Young men of privilege never chose ordinary, upright gentlemen as friends.

一定要交“有趣”的人物，或者能说会道，或者仪表出众，或者行事漂亮，
They wanted “interesting” people: brilliant talkers, striking figures or men who handled affairs with style.

照潘叔雅看，胡雪岩就是这一路人物。
Hu seemed to Pan precisely such a man.

但是最使他佩服的，却是胡雪岩的义气，
What impressed him most, however, was Hu's loyalty to his friends.

也就因为这一点，他要重托胡雪岩。
For that reason, he had an important favour to ask.

“胡大哥，”他叙入正题：“苏州从没有这么乱潮！
“Brother Hu, Suzhou has never been so unsettled.

官兵打仗，保民不足，骚扰有余，
The government troops do more to disturb the people than to protect them.

我们三个都想到上海夷场上去看看，要请胡大哥照应。”
All three of us would like to see the foreign settlement in Shanghai, and we'd like you to look after us.”

“是的。”胡雪岩平静地回答，
“Certainly,” Hu answered calmly.

心里在想，所谓照应，无非买房子之类，这是小事，
He supposed this meant such small matters as buying houses.

于是又加了一句：“好的，
“Gladly.

都在我身上。”
Leave it all to me.”

“我想这样，
“This is what I have in mind.

我有一笔现款，交给胡大哥，
I have some ready money to entrust to you.

看怎么给我用出去？”
What could you put it into?

潘叔雅说，“这笔款子数目不大，大概十二三万银子。”
It isn't a great sum—about a hundred and twenty or a hundred and thirty thousand taels.”


十二三万银子，还说数目不大，
A hundred and twenty or a hundred and thirty thousand, and he called it a small sum!

好阔的口气。
What an expansive way of talking.

胡雪岩正要开口、吴季重抢在他前面说了。
Hu was about to answer when Wu spoke first.

“我跟叔雅的情形，差不多，
“My situation is much the same as Shuya's.

有十万银子，也要请胡大哥替我费心用出去。”
I have a hundred thousand taels and would also like you to take the trouble to employ them for me.”

“我的情形，稍为不同些。”陆芝香说，
“Mine is a little different,” Lu said.

“我有一箱东西，放在苏州不放心，
“I have a chest of things I'm uneasy about leaving in Suzhou.

请胡大哥看看，是存在什么地方妥当。”
Could you advise me where to put it safely?”

“喔，”胡雪岩问道，“是一箱什么东西？”
“What sort of things?”

“是一只画箱。”
“A chest of paintings.”

“芝香家府上的收藏，是有名的。”潘叔雅说，
“The Lu family's collection is famous,” Pan explained.

“有几件精品，还是明朝留下来的。”
“Some of its finest pieces have been handed down since the Ming.”

就凭这句话，便可以想象得到那只画箱的珍贵。
That alone showed how precious the chest must be.

这一点胡雪岩却不敢轻易回答，
Hu dared not answer lightly.

只点点头说：
He merely nodded.

“我们再商量。”
“We can discuss it further.”

所谓“商量”是推托之词，
“Discuss it” was an evasion.

胡雪岩已经决定不做这种吃力不讨好的事，
He had already decided against such a thankless burden.

果然吃力不讨好，也还罢了，就怕出了什么毛病，
A thankless burden alone might be tolerable; the real danger was that something could go wrong.

古玩古画是无法照样赔偿的。
Antiques and ancient paintings could not be replaced with identical objects.

所以他作了这样一个明智的决定。
It was a prudent decision.


但陆芝香的目的，是希望在运出危城，转移到洋人所保护的夷场时，胡雪岩能保他的险，
Lu, however, wanted Hu to guarantee the paintings' safety during their removal from the endangered city to the settlement under foreign protection.

因而提到了尤五。
He therefore mentioned You Laowu.

“听说胡大哥跟漕帮的首脑，是至交？”
“I hear you are a close friend of the leaders of the grain-transport brotherhood?”

这是不能敕也不必赖的，
There was no denying this, nor any need to.

他点点头答道：“是的。
“Yes.

松江的漕帮，管事的老少两代，都很看得起我。”
Both generations of leaders in Songjiang think well of me.”

说到这里，胡雪岩很机警地想到，陆芝香说这话，自然有事要托尤五，
It occurred to Hu that Lu must want You's help.

那就落得放漂亮些，不必等他再开口，
He might as well be generous without waiting to be asked.

“如果老兄有什么事，只要力所能及，我可以代求。”
“If there's anything you need, so long as it's within my power, I can intercede.”

“是的。是要请胡大哥代求。”
“Yes, that's what I should like you to do.”

陆芝香说，“松江漕帮的势力及义地大谈特谈，反将正事搁在一边。
They went on to talk at length about the Songjiang brotherhood's influence, leaving their immediate business aside.

胡雪岩一面应酬着，一面很冷静地在观察，
As Hu maintained the conversation, he observed the three men calmly.

很快地明白了这三位“大少爷”想移居上海， 一半是逃难，一个是向往夷场的繁华。
He soon understood that their wish to move to Shanghai arose half from fear of war and half from longing for the settlement's prosperity.

照此看来，如今要替他们在上海所办的第一件事，就是替他们每一家造一所住宅。
The first thing to arrange for them there would therefore be a house for each.

这三所“住宅”的图样，很快地就已在他的脑中呈现，是洋楼， 有各种来自西洋的布置，软绵绵的“梭化”椅，大莱台，还有烧煤或者烧木柴的壁炉。
The plans quickly took shape in his mind: Western houses with all manner of imported furnishings—soft sofas, great dining tables, and fireplaces burning coal or wood.

这样想着，对于潘、吴两人的现款，胡雪岩也有了生利的办法。
This also suggested a way to make Pan's and Wu's money productive.

不过这个办法是“长线放远鹞”，要图急功近利，就根本无从谈起。
It would mean flying the kite far out on a long line; if they expected quick gains, there was nothing to discuss.

如果他们是望远了看，那就对于自己的生意，也是一大帮助，
If they took a long view, it could greatly assist his own business too.

胡雪合心想，有二十万可以长期动用的头寸，何不在上海再开一家钱庄？
With two hundred thousand taels available for a long period, why not open another bank in Shanghai?

这一转念间，才发觉自己义遇到了一个绝好的机会，
Only then did he realize what an excellent opportunity he had found.

于是仔细盘算了一会，想停当了，才找个他们谈话间的空隙，向潘叔雅说道：
He thought it through carefully, then waited for a pause in the conversation.

“我有句话想动问。”
“There's something I'd like to ask.”


“好，好。
“Of course.

你请说。”
Please do.”

“承两位看得起我，我不敢不尽心。
“You both honour me with your confidence, and I must do my best.

不过两位对这笔现款，总有个打算，
But you must have some intention for this money.

是做生意，还是放息，
Is it for trade or for lending at interest?

如果是放息，是长放，还是短放？
If the latter, for a long term or a short one?

总要先拿个大主意，我才好措手。”
I need to know your general purpose before I can act.”

潘叔雅向吴季重看了一下，以眼色征询意见。
Pan glanced at Wu, seeking his view.

“胡大哥，”吴季重只谈他自己的情形，“我也不知道该怎么办？
Wu spoke only for himself. “Brother Hu, I don't know what I should do.

只好把我的想法告诉你，
I can only tell you my thoughts.

如果要逃难，苏州的入息自然中断了，
If we have to flee, our income in Suzhou will stop.

田上的粗米收不列，
We shan't be able to collect the rent rice from our fields.

市房也不知道保得往保不住？更不用淡什么房租。
Who knows whether our shop properties will even survive, let alone yield rent?

那时候，舍间一家十八口，养命之源，都靠这笔款子。
In that case, all eighteen members of my household will depend on this money for their living.

实情如此，
That's the truth.

请你看着办。”
Please act accordingly.”

“我的情形也差不多。”潘叔雅说，
“Mine is much the same,” Pan said.

“我自己一家不过十三口，只是寒族人多，
“There are only thirteen in my own household, but a great many in my clan.

如果都逃在上海，生活不济，少不得我也要尽点心。”
If they all flee to Shanghai and cannot maintain themselves, I'll have to help.”

“我明白了！”
“I understand.

胡雪岩说：“万一苏州沦陷，不知道哪一天恢复？
If Suzhou falls, who can say when it will be recovered?

一年半载，还是三年五年，谁也不敢说。
Six months or a year, three years or five—nobody knows.

既然拿这笔款子作逃难的本钱，就得要细水长流，
Since this money must support you in exile, it must provide a steady stream.

以稳当为第一。”
Security comes first.”

“ ‘细水长流’这话，说得太好了！”吴季重很欣慰地，
“A steady stream—exactly!” Wu said with relief.

“我就是这意思。”
“That's what I mean.”

胡雪岩点点头，放下筷子，两手按在桌上，作出很郑重的姿态：
Hu nodded, laid down his chopsticks and placed both hands on the table, assuming a grave expression.

“两位给我的这个责任不轻！
“You're laying a heavy responsibility on me.

我只能勉力以赴。
I can only do my utmost.

我想应该作这么一个兼顾的打算。
I think we should make provision on several fronts.

第一，在上海夷场上，要有自己的住宅，
First, you need homes of your own in the settlement.

第二，看每个月要多少开销，提出一笔钱来放息，
Second, we should calculate your monthly expenses and set aside enough to lend at interest.

动息不动本。
Spend the interest and leave the principal intact.

住的房子有了，日常家用有了，先稳住了‘老营’，
With a house and daily expenses provided for, your home base will be secure.

就不妨放手干一番，余下的钱，或者买地皮，或者做生意。
Then we can act more freely with the remaining money, buying land or trading.

这样子做法，就朝最坏的地方去想，哪怕蚀光了，过日子依旧可以不愁，也就不伤元气。
Even at the worst, if that portion is entirely lost, your living will remain secure and your foundations unharmed.

两位看我这个打算行不行？
Would that suit you?”

““怎么不行？
“Of course!

太好了。”
Excellent.”

吴季重转脸说道：
Wu turned to Pan.

“叔雅，这位胡大哥老谋深算，
“Shuya, Brother Hu is truly a man of foresight.

真正叫人佩服。”
Admirable!”


朋友是从潘叔雅来的，听得这番赞扬，真所谓“与有荣焉”，所以他也极其得意。
Since Pan had brought Hu into their circle, this praise reflected honour on him, and he was delighted.

一高兴之下，马上唤着丫头说：“你进去跟姨太太说，铁箱里有只拜匣，
In his excitement he called to a maid, “Tell the mistress there's a card case in the iron chest.

连钥匙都拿了来。”
Bring it here with the key.”

“慢慢！”
“Wait!”

胡雪岩急忙阻止，
Hu stopped her hastily.

“你现在先不要拿什么东西给我。”
“Don't give me anything yet.”

“一样的。”播叔雅说，
“It makes no difference.

“我家里有五、六万的银票，
I have fifty or sixty thousand taels in notes at home.

先交了给胡大哥。”
I'll hand them over to you first.”

“不，不！
“No.

我们做钱庄的，第一讲究信用，第二讲究手续。
In banking, trust comes first and proper procedure second.

等谈好了办法，你们两位的款子，交到钱庄里来，我要立折子奉上，
Once we've agreed the arrangements, you can deposit your funds at the bank and receive passbooks.

利息多寡，期限长短，都要好好斟酌。
The interest and the length of the deposits must both be considered carefully.”

““也好！”
“Very well.

潘叔雅说：“那就请胡大哥吩咐。”于是胡雪岩从买地皮，造房子谈起，一直谈到做洋货生意，
Tell us what to do.” Hu began with buying land and building houses, and continued through to trade in foreign goods.

大致有了个计划。
A broad plan emerged.

购地造屋，以一万两银子为度，
The budget for buying land and building was to be limited to ten thousand taels.

其余的对半分成两份，一半是五年期的长期存款，一半是活期存款，用来作为经商的资本。
The rest would be divided equally: half in a five-year deposit and half in a demand deposit to serve as trading capital.

存放的钱庄，由胡雪岩代为介绍，
Hu would introduce them to a bank.

实际上都等于长期存款，因为用来做生意的那一半活期存款，亦要听胡雪岩的主意，
In practice, the whole amount would be available for a long term, because even the trading half, though withdrawable on demand, would be employed according to his advice.

如果他的头寸紧，某一笔生意就可以不做，
If he was short of funds, he could simply advise against a particular transaction.

翻来覆去都听他口中一句话。
Whichever way matters went, everything would depend on a word from him.


“好，
“Good.

我们就这样。”
Let's do that.”

潘叔雅问陆芝香，
Pan turned to Lu.

“你呢？
“What about you?

是怎么个主意？”
What are your plans?”

“听你们谈得热闹，我自然也要筹划筹划，
“After listening to all this lively discussion, naturally I must make plans too.

在上海大家房子造在一起，走动也方便。”
If we build our houses together in Shanghai, it will be easy to visit.”

于是你一言，我一语，都是谈的将来往在一起、朝夕过从的乐事。
One after another, they spoke of the pleasures of living close together and seeing one another every day.

胡雪岩冷眼旁观，
Hu observed coolly.

觉得这三个阔少，与庞二、高四、周五那班人，脾气又自不同，
These three wealthy gentlemen differed from Pang Er, Gao Si, Zhou Wu and their circle.

周、高等人到底自己也管过生意，比较精明，唯其比较精明，反容易对付，
Zhou, Gao and the others had at least managed businesses themselves and were comparatively shrewd—which, paradoxically, made them easier to deal with.

这三个却完全是不知稼穑艰难的大少爷，
These three had never known the difficulties of earning a living.

也许期望太高，不切实际，也许未经世途，不辨好歹，
Their hopes might be too high and unrealistic; their lack of worldly experience might leave them unable to judge good from bad.

谈的时候什么都好。
While they were talking, everything sounded excellent.

等一做出来，觉得不如理想，立刻就会有很难听的活，
Once plans were carried out and fell short of their ideals, ugly complaints might follow.

吃力而不讨好，那就太犯不着了。
Such thankless effort would hardly be worthwhile.

于是他问：“三位郁到上海去过没有？”
“Have any of you been to Shanghai?” he asked.

“我去是去过一次，那时只有四岁，什么都记不得了！”
“I went once, when I was four, and remember nothing.

潘叔雅说，“他们两位最远到过常熟。”
The farthest either of them has been is Changshu.”

“这样说，夷场是怎么个样子，你还是没有见过。”
“Then you've never really seen the settlement.”

“是啊！”
“Exactly.

潘叔雅说，“我今年四十二，
I'm forty-two now.

四岁的时候，还是嘉庆年间，
When I was four, it was still the Jiaqing reign.

哪里来的夷场？”
There was no foreign settlement then.”

“都说夷场热闹，我倒要跟三位说一句：热闹是在将来。
“People all say how lively it is, but I must tell you this: its real prosperity lies in the future.

眼前热闹的，只是一小块地方，鱼龙混杂，
Only a small area is busy now, and all sorts of people mingle there.

不宜于象你们三位，琴棋书画，文文雅雅的人住。
It isn't suitable for refined gentlemen like yourselves, with your music, chess, calligraphy and painting.

我倒想到一处，可以买一大块地皮住宅，
I have thought of a place where you could buy a large piece of land for your homes.

那里现在还象乡下，
It's still like the countryside.

将来等洋人修马路修到那里，就会变成闹中取静，住家的好地方。
Once the foreigners extend their roads that far, it will become a quiet place within a busy district, ideal for living.

不过，这是我说，
But that's only my opinion.

到底如何，要等你们自己去看了再说。”
You must see it yourselves before deciding.”


“只要你说好就好，
“If you say it's good, that's enough.

先买下来再说。”
Buy it first.”

“潘三哥的话是不错。”胡雪岩很率直的说，
“Third Brother Pan is right,” Hu replied frankly.

“不过我们是第一次联手做事，以后的日子也还长，
“But this is our first undertaking together, and we have many years ahead.

所以第一趟一定要圆满。
I want everything to go well the first time.

我现在倒有个主意，三位之中。哪位有兴，我陪着到上海先去看一看，
Here's my suggestion: if any of you would like to come, I'll accompany him to Shanghai for an inspection.

怎么样？”
How would that be?”

“这个主意好！”陆芝香很兴奋他说，
“An excellent idea!” Lu said eagerly.

“我早就想去玩一趟，只怕没有熟人，又不懂夷场规矩，会闹笑话。
“I've long wanted to visit, but I was afraid of making a fool of myself without acquaintances or any knowledge of the settlement's customs.

如今有胡大哥在，还怕什么？”
With you there, what have I to fear?”

这一说，潘、吴二人的心思也活动了，
This stirred Pan and Wu as well.

但吴季重十分孝母、又有些舍不得轻离膝下，潘叔雅则因为有一笔产业要处分，其势不能远离，
But Wu was devoted to his mother and reluctant to leave her side, while Pan had some property to dispose of and could not go far.

所以商量结果，决定还是由陆芝香一个人去。
They therefore agreed that Lu alone would make the journey.

“我们哪一天走？”他问。
“When shall we leave?” he asked.

“我想明天就动身。”
“I'd thought of setting off tomorrow.”

“唷！”
“Good heavens!”

陆芝香大为诧异：
Lu was astonished.

“那怎么来得及？”
“How could I possibly be ready?”

做生意的人出远门是常事，说走就走，
For a businessman, a long journey was commonplace; he could leave at a word.

象陆芝香这样的人、出一趟远门，是件了不得的大事，
For a man like Lu, it was a great event.

首先要挑宜于长行的黄道吉日，
First an auspicious day for travel must be chosen.

然后备办行李，打点送亲友的上仪，
Then luggage must be prepared and gifts assembled for friends and relatives.

接着是亲友排日饯别。自己到各处去辞行，
Farewell banquets would follow on successive days, with calls to take leave in between.

这样搞下去，如果十天以后走得成，还算是快的。
If he could depart within ten days, that would be quick.

胡雪岩明白这些情形，
Hu understood all this.

心想，不必跟他“讨价还价”了，
There was no point in bargaining over the date.

就算多等他两三天，亦是无济于事，而自己的这两三天的工夫，却宝贵得很，不能无渭消耗，
Even waiting another two or three days would achieve nothing, while his own time was too precious to waste.

于是这样说道：“好在我也不是急的事，
“Fortunately, there's no urgency about this particular matter.

你尽管从容，
Take your time.

定了日子，我派人专程来迎接，或是我自己再来一趟，
Once you've fixed the day, I'll send someone especially to fetch you, or come again myself.

包你平平安安舒舒服服到上海。”
I guarantee you a safe, comfortable journey to Shanghai.”

“这样就再好都没有了。”
“Nothing could be better.”

陆芝香拿皇历来挑日子，本来挑在月底，
Lu fetched an almanac and first chose a day near the end of the month.

又以端阳将届，要在家里过节，最后挑定了五月初七这个黄道吉日。
Then, remembering that the Dragon Boat Festival was approaching and that he wanted to spend it at home, he finally settled on the auspicious seventh day of the fifth lunar month.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十五章（下）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Twenty-Five, Part Three
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


谈完正事，一席盛宴，亦近尾声，
By the time they finished discussing business, the sumptuous meal was nearly over.

端上来四样“压桌菜”，只好看看，
Four substantial dishes were brought out to conclude the feast, but they could do no more than look at them.

倒是小碟子装的八样酱菜，一扫而空，
The eight little plates of pickles, however, were swept clean.

胡雪岩喝了一碗香梗米粥，抚抚肚子站起来说：
Hu Xueyan drank a bowl of fragrant rice porridge, patted his stomach, and rose.

“我要告辞了，
“I must take my leave.

大概明天动身，不再来向各位辞行，
I shall probably set off tomorrow, so I will not come round to say goodbye again.

等过了端午，我一定设法抽空，亲自来接芝香兄，
After the Dragon Boat Festival, I shall certainly try to find time to come and escort Brother Zhixiang myself.

那时候再叙吧！”
We can talk further then.”

潘叔雅还要留他多坐，吴季重和陆芝香又要请他吃晚饭。
Pan Shuya wanted him to stay a little longer, while Wu Jizhong and Lu Zhixiang both invited him to dinner.

胡雪岩觉得对这班“大少爷”，不必过于迁就，
Hu felt there was no need to indulge these wealthy young gentlemen too much.

所以一律托词拒绝，厚犒了潘家的婢仆，仍旧坐着那乘装饰华美的四人大轿出阊门。
He found excuses to decline all their invitations, tipped the Pan household’s maids and servants generously, and rode out through Chang Gate in the same splendid four-bearer sedan chair.

这时不过午后两点钟，
It was only two in the afternoon.

胡雪岩一面在轿中闭目养神，一面在心里打算，
Resting with his eyes closed, he considered his plans.

这一下午只剩下一件事，就是立阿巧姐恢复自己之身的那张笔据，
There was just one thing left to do that afternoon: have the document drawn up restoring A’qiao’s freedom.

一杯茶的工夫就可了事。
That would take no longer than a cup of tea.

余下来的工夫，都可用来陪嵇鹤龄，
He could spend the rest of his time with Ji Heling.

等下进城，不妨到慕名已久，据说还是从明朝传下来的一家“孙春阳”南货店去看看。
When he went into the city, he might also visit Sun Chunyang, the southern-goods shop he had long heard of, which was said to date from the Ming dynasty.


打算得倒是不错，不想那顶四人大轿害了他，
It was a sound enough plan, but the four-bearer chair proved his undoing.

阊门外是水陆要道，金间栈成了名符其实的“仕宦行台”，
The district outside Chang Gate was a major junction of land and water routes, and Jinchang Inn had become a veritable residence for traveling officials.

而苏州因为江宁失守，大衙门增多，所以候补的、求差的、公干的官员，平空也添了许多，
Since the fall of Jiangning, more major government offices had been established in Suzhou, bringing a corresponding increase in officials awaiting appointments, seeking commissions, or traveling on official business.

近水楼台，都喜欢住在金阊栈，
For convenience, many preferred to stay at Jinchang Inn.

看见这顶四乘大轿，自然要打听轿中是哪位达官？
The sight of the imposing sedan chair naturally set them asking what eminent official it carried.

胡雪岩性情随和，出手豪阔，金阊栈的伙计，无不巴结，
Hu’s easy manner and generous spending had won over every attendant at the inn.

于是加油添酱，为他大大吹嘘了一番，
Eager to please him, they embellished his accomplishments without restraint.

说他是浙江官场上的红人，在两江也很吃得开，
He was an influential figure in Zhejiang official circles, they said, and equally well connected in Liangjiang.

许巡抚是小同乡，何学使是至交，亲自来看过他两次。
Governor Xu came from the same locality as he did; Education Commissioner He was an intimate friend and had visited him twice in person.

总督佑大人派了戈什哈送过一桌燕菜席，
Governor-General Yi had sent a guardsman with a whole banquet of bird’s-nest dishes.

这顶四人大轿是苏州城里第一阔少，一生下来就做了道台的潘大少爷派来的。
The chair belonged to Young Master Pan, Suzhou’s richest young gentleman, who had held the rank of circuit intendant from the day he was born.

把胡雪岩形容成了一个三头六臂、呼风唤雨的“通天教主”。
They made Hu sound like the all-powerful Patriarch Tongtian, with three heads and six arms, able to command the winds and rain.

恰好潘、吴、陆三家又讲究应酬，
As it happened, the Pan, Wu, and Lu families were all punctilious about social courtesies.

送路菜的送路菜，送土仪的送土仪，派来的又都是衣冠整齐的俊仆，
They sent dishes for his journey and gifts of local produce, carried by handsome, smartly dressed servants.

这一下越显得胡雪岩交游广阔，伙计所言不虚。
This seemed to confirm both the breadth of his connections and every word the attendants had said.

于是纷纷登门拜访，套交情，拉关系，甚至还有来告帮的，
Visitors streamed in to make his acquaintance, cultivate a connection, or even beg his assistance.

把个胡雪岩搞碍昏头搭脑，应接不暇。
Hu was overwhelmed and scarcely knew which way to turn.

直到上灯时分，方始略得清静。
Only when the lamps were lit did he get a little peace.


“胡先生！”周一鸣提出警告：“你老在这里住不得了！”
“Mr Hu,” Zhou Yiming warned, “you cannot go on staying here.”

“是啊！”胡雪岩苦笑着说，
“Indeed I cannot,” Hu replied with a rueful smile.

“这不是无妄之灾？”
“Isn’t this a calamity I have done nothing to deserve?”

“潘倒不是这样说。
“I would not quite put it that way.

有人求还求不来这洋的场面，
Some people could not attract this sort of attention however hard they tried.

不过你老不喜欢这样子招摇。
It is simply that you do not care for such a display.

我看，搬进城去住吧！”
I think you should move to an inn inside the city.”

“明天就要走了。
“I am leaving tomorrow.

一动不如一静，
Better to stay put than make another change.

只我自己避开就是了。”
I need only keep out of the way myself.”

好在最要紧的一件大事，已经办妥，
Fortunately, the most important piece of business had already been settled.

于是胡雪岩带着阿巧姐的那张笔据，与周一鸣约了第二天再见，然后进城，一直去访嵇鹤龄。
Taking the document concerning A’qiao with him, Hu arranged to meet Zhou again the next day, then went into the city and straight to Ji Heling’s lodgings.

谈起这天潘叔雅的晚宴，嵇鹤龄大为惊奇，自然也替他高兴。
