Hu felt not only sympathy but admiration, and all the more strongly acknowledged his duty towards the boy.

“你的意思我懂了。”他说，
“I understand,” he said.

“你三叔虽不是败子回头金不换，也有他的道理，将来会发达的。
“Your uncle may not be a reformed prodigal worth more than gold, but he has his own ways and will prosper in time.

你不要太看轻了他。”
Don’t think too little of him.”

“我不是看轻他，
“I don’t.

他是我叔叔，一笔写不出两个刘字，
He is my uncle; our surname Liu is the same word, however you write it.

我总尊敬他的。
I always respect him.

不过……
But…”

“芙蓉忽然摇摇手，”
She suddenly waved a hand.

这也不去说他了。
“Let us leave him out of it.

我只望你拿小免儿当自己人。
I only hope you will treat Little Rabbit as one of your own.”

““当然。
“Of course.

不是自己人是啥？”胡雪岩说、
What else could he be?” Hu replied.

“闲话少说，
“Enough of that.

你倒说，你将来希望小兔儿做啥？”
Tell me what you want him to become.”

“自然是巴望他荣宗耀祖。”
“Naturally, I hope he will bring honour to his ancestors.”

“荣宗耀诅，只有做官。
“Then he must become an official.

象我这样捐来的官不希奇，
A purchased rank like mine is nothing remarkable.

要考场里真刀真枪拼出来的才值钱。”
It is the rank won by real combat in the examination hall that counts.”

胡雪岩平静他说，
Hu spoke calmly.

“只要小兔儿肯替你争气，事情也很好办，
“Provided Little Rabbit is willing to work hard and do you credit, it can be arranged.

我替你请个最好的先生教他读书。”
I shall find you the best possible teacher for him.”


为了表示不是信口敷衍，胡雪岩当时就要笔墨纸张，给王有龄写信，请他代为托“学老师”，觅一个饱学秀才“坐馆”。
To show that this was no casual promise, Hu immediately called for writing materials and began a letter to Wang Youling, asking him to approach the educational official and find a learned licentiate willing to serve as a private tutor.

当然，他也还有许多事要跟王有龄谈，
Of course, he had many other things to discuss with Wang.

文墨上的事，胡雪岩不大在行，有些话，象跟何桂清见面的经过，又非亲笔不可，
Literary composition was not his strength, and some matters, such as his meeting with He Guiqing, had to be set down in his own hand.

所以这封信写到钟敲十二下，还没有写完。
When the clock struck twelve, the letter was still unfinished.

芙蓉倒觉得老大过意不去，
Furong began to feel very apologetic.

先是当他有些负气，后来看看不象，长篇大套在写，当然是谈别的事。
At first she had thought he might be writing in a fit of pique; later, seeing the length of the letter, she realised he must be discussing other matters.

不过因头总是由小兔儿身上而起，这样慎重其事，未免令人难安。
Still, Little Rabbit had prompted it, and such solemn attention made her uneasy.

“好歇歇了！”她温柔他说，
“Do take a rest,” she said gently.

“莲子羹都煮成泥了，
“The lotus-seed soup has boiled to a paste.

吃了点心睡吧，
Have your supper and go to bed.

明天再说。”
You can finish tomorrow.”

“马上就好，马上就好。”胡雪岩头也不抬他说。
“Almost done, almost done,” Hu answered without raising his head.

说是这样说，仍旧又很费劲地写了一个钟头才罢手，
Despite his words, he laboured over the letter for another hour before putting down his brush.

他把头一张信纸，递了给芙蓉。
He handed Furong the first sheet.

芙蓉是识得字的，接过来念道：“雪公太守尊兄大人阁下，敬禀者，”念到这里笑了，
She could read, and began aloud: “‘To His Excellency the Prefect, my honoured elder brother Mr Xuexuan, I respectfully beg to report—’” She laughed.

“好罗嗦的称呼！”
“What a long-winded address!”

“你看下去。”于是芙蓉又念：“套言不叙。今有内弟刘小兔，”到这里，芙蓉又笑了，
“Read on.” She continued, “‘Dispensing with formal compliments, I have a younger brother-in-law, Liu Xiaotu—’” Again she laughed.

“你怎么把小兔儿的小名也写了上去？”
“Why have you written down Little Rabbit’s childhood name?”

“那要什么紧，
“What does it matter?

又不是官场里报履历，
This is not an official statement of his career.

我跟王大老爷通家至好，
Prefect Wang and I are intimate family friends.

就写小名也不要紧。”
A childhood name is quite all right.”

恩想也不错，
On reflection she agreed.

她便笑道：“说来说去，总说不过你。”
Smiling, she said, “However much I argue, I can never get the better of you.”

“不用你说，
“You needn’t tell me.

我自己晓得，
I know that already.

你看，”
Look here.”

他指着“内弟”二字。
He pointed to “younger brother-in-law.”

“这你总没话说了吧？”
“You can have no complaint about that, can you?”

这是不拿芙蓉视作妾媵，
He was declining to treat her as merely a concubine.

她自然感激，却不便有何表示，
Naturally she was grateful, though she could not easily express it.

只静心看下去，
She read on quietly.

见胡雪岩对聘师的要求是学问好、性情好，年纪不宜过大，如愿就聘，柬脩从优。
The tutor, Hu wrote, must be learned, good-tempered and not too old; a generous fee would be offered to anyone willing to accept.

这见得他是真为自己跟小兔儿打算，
It was clear that he was thinking seriously of her and Little Rabbit.

心头由热而酸，不知不党的滚下两滴眼泪。
Warmth rose in her heart and turned to an ache; two tears rolled down before she knew it.


“我想想又不对了！”她揩一揩眼睛说，
“Now I think perhaps this isn’t right,” she said, wiping her eyes.

“怕小兔儿福薄，当不起！
“Little Rabbit may not have enough good fortune to bear it.

再说，这样费事，我心也不安。”
Besides, all this trouble makes me uneasy.”

这话让胡雪岩没奈何了，
Hu could only feel helpless.

“算命看相，可以相信，不过一个人也不要太迷这些花样。”
“One may believe in fortune-telling and face-reading, but there is no need to become so obsessed with them.”

他搔搔头说，
He scratched his head.

“你样样都好，
“You are good in every other way.

就是这上头看不开。”
It is only here that you cannot take a broader view.”

“我看，还是先附在人家馆里的好。”
“I think he had better go on sharing another family’s tutor for the time being.”

“为啥呢？”
“Why?”

为来为去，还是为了芙蓉怕小兔儿没有那种专请一位先生来教导的福分，
Whatever form her reasoning took, it came back to the fear that Little Rabbit did not possess the good fortune needed to support having a teacher all to himself.

她最相信八字，连自己的终身，都相信是注定了偏房的命。
She placed immense faith in the eight characters of a birth horoscope, even believing that her own fate had destined her to be a concubine.

胡雪岩意会到此，便有了办法。
Once Hu understood this, he found a solution.

“我看这样，
“Then do this.

你先去替小兔儿排个八字看，到底福命如何？
First have Little Rabbit’s horoscope drawn up and see what sort of fortune he has.

若是注定要做官的，就照我的话做，
If he is destined to become an official, follow my advice.

不然就随便你。”
Otherwise, do as you please.”

“这话说得好！
“That is a good idea!

你倒提醒我了。
You have reminded me.

明天就替他去排个八字看。”
I shall have it done tomorrow.”

美蓉去找了一张红纸，
Furong found a sheet of red paper.

“劳动你把小兔儿的生辰八字写下来。”
“Please write down Little Rabbit’s birth particulars for me.”


写完小兔儿的生辰八字，也吃了消夜，上床在沈头上，
After he had written down the particulars and they had eaten their late supper, they went to bed.

芙蓉还有一桩“官司”要审，就是那方白缎绣花小包袱中，包着的一绺黑发，两片指甲。
On the pillow, Furong still had a “case” to try: the lock of black hair and the two nail clippings wrapped in embroidered white satin.

“这是哪里来的？”她说，
“Where did they come from?” she asked.

“你用不着赖，也用不着说假话。”
“There is no need to deny it or tell lies.”

“听你的口气，当我一定要赖，一定要说假活。
“From your tone, you seem certain that I shall deny it and lie.

那，我就最好不说话，
In that case I had better say nothing.

说了真话，你也一定不相信。”
Even if I tell the truth, you won’t believe me.”

“我说不过你！”
“I can’t argue with you!”

芙蓉有些着恼，
Furong was a little cross.

“你不说，那包东西我不还你。”
“If you won’t tell me, I shan’t give the packet back.”

“你尽管拿去好了，
“Keep it by all means.

不管拿它烧掉、摔掉，我决不过问。”
Burn it or throw it away; I won’t ask what you have done with it.”

“你不觉得心疼？”
“Wouldn’t that hurt you?”

“心疼点啥？”
“What is there to hurt?”

胡雪岩泰然自若地，
Hu was perfectly composed.

“你要不相信，我当面烧给你看！”“唉！”芙蓉叹口气说，
“If you don’t believe me, I’ll burn it before your eyes.” Furong sighed.

“ ‘痴心女子负心汉’，
“‘A devoted woman and a faithless man.’

我真替那个送你这些东西的人难过。”
I really feel sorry for whoever gave you those things.”

这句话却发生了意想不到的效用，
Her words had an unexpected effect.

胡雪岩大为不安，
Hu became deeply troubled.

“你说”我别样，我都不在乎，就是这一样不能承认。
“You can call me anything else and I won’t mind, but I cannot accept that.”

“他加重语气分辩，”
He defended himself emphatically.

我决不是没有良心的人，对朋友如此，对喜欢过的女人，也是如此。“
“I am certainly not a man without a conscience, either towards my friends or towards the women I have loved.”


“这样说起来，你对这个女人是喜欢过的？”
“So you did love this woman?”

“不错。”
“Yes.”

胡雪岩已经从芙蓉的语气，料准了她不会吃醋，觉得直言不妨，所以又说，
Judging from Furong’s tone, Hu felt certain she would not be jealous and saw no harm in speaking plainly.

“就是前不久，我喜欢过，现在已经一刀两断。
“It was quite recently, but now I have made a clean break.

她不知道怎么，忽然‘冷镬里爆出热栗子’，
Somehow she has suddenly made hot chestnuts pop in a cold pan.

在我决不能捡‘船并旧码头，的便宜。
I certainly cannot take advantage of returning to an old berth.

所以对这两样东西，我只当做不曾看见。”
So I shall simply treat these things as though I had never seen them.”

“你的话我弄不明白。”芙蓉问，
“I don’t understand you,” Furong said.

“她叫啥名字，啥出身？”
“What is her name, and what is her background?”

“叫阿巧姐。
“Sister A’qiao.

是堂子里的，
She comes from a pleasure house.

七姑奶奶也见过。”
The Seventh Lady has met her too.”

芙蓉深为诧异：
Furong was very surprised.

“七姑奶奶这样直爽的人，跟我无话不谈，
“The Seventh Lady is so outspoken and talks to me about everything.

怎么这件事不曾提起？”
Why has she never mentioned this?”

“你说话叫人好笑，
“What a funny thing to say.

直爽的人，就该不管说得说不得，都要乱说？”
Must an outspoken person blurt out everything, whether it ought to be said or not?”

胡雪岩提醒她：“七姑奶奶真正叫女中豪杰，
Hu cautioned her, “The Seventh Lady really is a heroine among women.

不要看她疯疯癫癫，
Do not be deceived by her wild ways.

胸中着实有点丘壑，
She has a good deal of judgement and strategy in her head.

你不要看错了她！“
Don’t misjudge her.”


“好了，好了！
“Enough, enough!

你不要把话扯开去。
Don’t change the subject.

你倒讲讲看，你们怎么样好法？”
Tell me how close you two were.”

“就是这佯子！”
“Like this!”

胡雪岩翻个身，一把抱住芙蓉。
Hu rolled over and gathered Furong into his arms.

“哼！”
“Hmph!”

芙蓉冷笑，
She gave a cold laugh.

“看你这样子，心里还是忘不掉她，
“I can see that you still cannot forget her.

拿我来做替身！”
You’re using me as her substitute.”

说着，便要从他怀抱中挣扎出来，无奈他的力气大，反而拿她抱得更紧了，
She tried to free herself, but he was stronger and held her all the tighter.

“我不是拿你做她的替身，
“I’m not using you as a substitute.

我是拿你来跟她比一比。”他说，
I’m comparing you with her,” he said.

“她的腰没有你细，皮肤没有你滑。
“Her waist isn’t as slender as yours, and her skin isn’t as smooth.

说真的，我还是喜欢你。”
To tell you the truth, I like you better.”

这两句话等于在醋罐里加了一大勺清水，酸味冲淡了，
Those words were like a great ladle of water poured into a vinegar jar: they diluted the sourness.

“少来灌米汤！”
“Stop feeding me flattery!”

她停了一下又说，“你把跟她的事，从头到尾，好好讲给我听。”
After a pause she added, “Tell me the whole story, properly, from beginning to end.”

“讲起来话长！”
“It’s a long one.”

胡雪岩从枕头下掏出表来看了一下说，
Hu took his watch from beneath the pillow and looked at it.

“两点钟了！
“Two o’clock!

再讲就要讲到天亮，
If I start now, we shall be talking till dawn.

明天再说。
Tomorrow.”

““你不讲就害我了！”
“If you won’t tell me, you’ll make me suffer.”

“这叫什么话？”
“What do you mean?”

“你不讲，害我一夜睡不着。”
“You’ll keep me awake all night.”

“好，我讲。”
“Very well, I’ll tell you.”

等把阿巧姐的故事，粗枝大叶讲完，胡雪岩又说，“这一来，你可以睡得着了，
When he had given her a rough account of A’qiao’s story, he said, “Now you can sleep.

不许再罗嗦！”
No more questions!”


“问一句话可以不可以？”
“May I ask just one?”

“可以。不过只许一句。”
“Yes, but only one.”

“照你看，”芙蓉问，“事情会不会起变化？”
“Do you think,” Furong asked, “that things might change?”

“什么变化？”
“What sort of change?”

“阿巧姐只怕不肯嫁何学台了。”
“I’m afraid A’qiao may refuse to marry Commissioner He.”

芙蓉从容分析，
Furong analysed the matter calmly.

“照你的说法，她先对你也不怎么样，
“From your account, she wasn’t especially attached to you at first.

等到见了年纪轻、人又漂亮、官又做得大的何学台，心里就有了意思。
Then she saw Commissioner He, young, handsome and highly placed, and took a fancy to him.

照规矩说，她自己也要有数，是人家何家的人了，在你面前要避嫌疑，
By rights she ought to recognise that she belongs to the He household now and avoid any appearance of impropriety with you.

怎么又在替你收拾行李的时候，私底下放了这两样‘私情表记，？
Why, then, did she secretly put these two tokens of affection into your luggage?

而且送你上了船，推三阻四，不肯下船，
And when she saw you onto the boat, she found one excuse after another not to get off.

恨不得跟你一起回来。
She plainly wanted to come back with you.

这你难道看不出来，她的心又变过了。
Can’t you see that her heart has changed again?”

““我怎么看不出来？
“Of course I can.

不理她就是了。”
I simply won’t take any notice of her.”

“你倒说得容易！
“You make it sound so easy!

可见你不懂女人的心。”
It shows how little you understand a woman’s heart.”

这一下，胡雪岩使不能不打破自己的戒约，往下追问：
Hu could no longer keep to his own limit on questions.

“女人的心怎么样？”
“Then what is a woman’s heart like?”

“男人是没良心的多，
“Most men have no conscience.

见一个，爱一个，爱一个，丢一个，
They love every woman they see, then cast aside every woman they love.

女人不同，
Women are different.

一颗心飘来飘去，不容易有着落，
A woman’s heart drifts about and rarely finds somewhere to settle.

等到一有着落，就象根绳子一样，捆得你紧紧地、再打上个死结，要解都解不开。
Once it does, it is like a rope that binds you tight and is tied in a knot you can never undo.

现在你是让她捆住了，自己还不晓得，
She has bound you already, and you don’t even know it.

说什么‘不理她就是’，
You say, ‘I simply won’t take any notice of her.’

有那么容易？
Is it that easy?

你倒试试看！”
Try it and see!”

芙蓉讪笑地又说，“真正是‘吃的灯草灰，放的轻巧屁’！”
With a mocking laugh Furong added, “You’ve eaten lamp-wick ash and now you’re passing airy wind—such weightless talk!”


这一番话把胡雪岩的瞌睡虫赶得光光的，
This drove every trace of sleep from Hu.

睁大了眼，望着帐顶，半晌做声不得。
His eyes widened as he stared at the top of the bed curtains, unable to speak for a long while.

“你说，
“Well?

我的话错不错？”
Am I right?”

“岂但不错！
“More than right.

还要谢谢你，
I ought to thank you.

亏得你提醒我。”
It’s fortunate you warned me.”

胡雪岩不安地问，“你看，该怎么办？”
Uneasily, he asked, “What do you think I should do?”

“自然是把她接了回来。”
“Naturally, bring her back here.”

这是句反话，
It was an ironic answer.

如果在平时，胡雪岩一定又会逗她拈酸吃醋，开开玩笑，此时却无这种闲逸的心情，
Ordinarily Hu would have teased her into jealousy for his own amusement, but now he had no leisure for such play.

一本正经他说：“这是决不会有的事。
He replied in complete seriousness, “That will certainly never happen.

我现在就怕对何学台没有交代，
What worries me is being unable to account for it to Commissioner He.

好好一件事，反弄得人家心里不痛快，对我生了意见，
Here is a perfectly good arrangement that might end by upsetting him and turning him against me.

说都说不明白了！
I should never be able to explain.”

“芙蓉是有心试探，
Furong had deliberately tested him.

看他这样表示，心头一块石头落地，便全心全意替他策划：
His answer lifted a weight from her heart, and she devoted herself fully to helping him devise a plan.

“你现在要抢在前面，
“You must act first.

不要等她走在你前面叫明了，
Don’t wait for her to get ahead of you and announce her refusal.

事情就会弄僵，
Then everything will be deadlocked.

人人要脸，树树要皮，
People need face just as trees need bark.

话说出口，她怎么收得回去？”
Once she has said it aloud, how can she take it back?”

“这话对！”胡雪岩说，
“That is true.

“我现在脑筋很乱，
My thoughts are all in confusion now.

不晓得怎么快法？”
I don’t know how to act quickly enough.”

“无非早早跟何学台说明，把阿巧接了回去，
“Simply tell Commissioner He at once and have him take A’qiao into his household.

生米煮成熟饭，还有啥话好说。”
Once the raw rice is cooked, what more can anyone say?”

“话是有道理。
“That makes sense.

不过官场里有样规矩你不懂，做哪个地方的官，不准娶哪个地方的女子做妾，
But there is an official rule you don’t understand: an official may not take a woman from the area he governs as a concubine.

麻烦就在这里。”
That is where the difficulty lies.”


谈到官场的规矩，芙蓉就无法置喙了。
Furong could offer no opinion on the rules of officialdom.

但即使如此，她的见解对胡雪岩仍旧是个很大的帮助。
Even so, her insight had been a great help.

第二天一早醒来，首先想到的也就是这件事，
When Hu woke early the following morning, this was the first matter on his mind.

大清早的脑筋比较清醒，
His head was clearer at that hour.

他很冷静地考虑下来，认为“生米”虽不能一下子就成“熟饭”，但米只要下了锅，就不会再有变化，
Considering it calmly, he concluded that although the raw rice could not immediately become cooked rice, once it was in the pot there would be no turning back.

于今为计，不妨托出潘叔雅做自己的代表，先向何桂清说明白，
The best course was to ask Pan Shuya to act as his representative and explain the arrangement to He Guiqing first.

事成定局，阿巧姐自会死心，
Once the matter was settled, A’qiao would resign herself to it.

这就是将“生米”下锅的办法。
That would put the raw rice in the pot.

不过，这件事还要个居问奔走的人。
Someone would still be needed to carry messages between them.

现成有个周一鸣在那里，不然还有刘不才，也是千这路差使的好材料。
Zhou Yiming was ready to hand; failing him, Liu Bucai was also well suited to that kind of errand.

好在事情一时还下会生变，不妨等周一鸣回来了再说。
Since the situation was unlikely to change immediately, Hu could wait until Zhou returned before proceeding.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十六章（下）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Twenty-Six, Part Two
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


等把这个难题想通了，胡雪岩觉得心情相当轻松，
Having thought his way through this difficulty, Hu felt considerably relieved.

盘算了一下，古应春这天一定在忙着眼洋人接头，不必去打扰他，
Gu Yingchun would certainly be busy dealing with the foreigners that day, so there was no need to disturb him.

只有找刘不才一起盘桓，
He would find Liu Bucai instead.

不妨一面出去游逛，一面看看可有合适的地皮，为潘叔雅买下来建新居。
They could stroll about together and look for a suitable piece of land to buy for Pan Shuya's new home.

想停当了才起身下床，
Only after settling this in his mind did he get out of bed.

芙蓉晨妆已毕，侍候他漱洗早餐，同时间起这天要办些什么事？
Furong had finished dressing and attended to him as he washed and ate breakfast, asking what he meant to do that day.

“等你三叔来了再谈。”胡雪岩说，
“We'll discuss it when your Third Uncle comes.

“我想带你去逛逛。”
I thought of taking you out for a look around.”

“我不去。
“I'm not going.

抛头露面象啥样子？”
What would people think of me showing myself in public?”

“那么你做点啥呢？”
“What will you do, then?”

“我还是到七姑奶奶那里去。”芙蓉答道，
“Go to the Seventh Lady again.

“跟她在一起，永远是热闹的。”
It's always lively with her.”

“就你们两个人，怎么热闹得起来？
“How lively can it be with only the two of you?

我看不如约了七姑奶奶一起去玩。”
Why not ask her to come out with us?”

“她不肯的。”芙蓉忽然问道，“你说了她什么？
“She won't.” Furong suddenly asked, “What did you say to her?

她好象有点赌气的样子，
She seems a little out of temper.

古老爷常常劝她出去走走，不要在家闷出病来，她说什么也不肯。”
Mr Gu keeps urging her to go out before staying at home makes her ill, but she refuses.”

这话胡雪岩在前一天也听见过，当时不以为意，
Hu had heard this the day before without taking it seriously.

现在听芙蓉提到，才知道七姑奶奶真的发愤了！
Now he realized that the Seventh Lady was making a determined effort.

倒是一件令人感动的事。
It was rather touching.

“我不过劝她，要象个大家闺秀的样子，
“I only advised her to behave like a lady from a distinguished family.

哪知道她这样认真。”胡雪岩说，
I never imagined she'd take it so seriously.

“赌气是决不会有的事，
She certainly isn't sulking.

她最佩服我，还有大事要我帮忙，
She admires me more than anyone, and needs my help with an important matter.

赌什么气？”
Why would she be angry?”

“这倒是真的，”
“That's true.”

芙蓉点点头，
Furong nodded.

“提起你来总是小爷叔长，小爷叔短。
“It's ‘Little Uncle’ this and ‘Little Uncle’ that whenever she speaks of you.

我看，“芙蓉笑道，”只有一个人不佩服你。
I think there's only one person who doesn't admire you.” She smiled.

““哪个？”
“Who?”

“梅玉的娘。”
“Meiyu's mother.”

昨天是为了阿巧姐生醋意，这时候又提到他妻子，
Yesterday she had been jealous over A’qiao; now she was bringing up his wife.

胡雪岩心里不免有些厌烦，所以默不作声。
Hu felt a little irritated and said nothing.

芙蓉也是很知趣的人，
Furong knew when to stop.

见他是这样的态度，便不再往下说，聊些别的闲天，等着刘不才。
Seeing his response, she dropped the subject and chatted about other things while they waited for Liu.


结果刘不才不曾来，
Liu did not come.

来了个古应春，带了由丝栈里转来的两封人，
Instead, Gu arrived with two letters forwarded from the silk warehouse.

一封是尤五的，由陈世龙代笔，
One was from You Laowu, written for him by Chen Shilong.

说杭州漕帮闹事，经过调处，已经平息。
The disturbance in the Hangzhou grain-transport brotherhood had been settled through mediation.

只是新交了好些朋友，饮宴酬醉无虚日，所以还得几天才能回上海。
But You had made many new friends, and not a day passed without a banquet or some social obligation, so it would be several days before he could return to Shanghai.

再有一封是王有龄的，这封信就长了。
The other letter, from Wang Youling, was a long one.

工有龄校到胡雪岩初到上海的信，又接到何桂清从苏州写给他的信，加上陈世龙带去的口信，
Wang had received the letter Hu wrote on first reaching Shanghai, another from He Guiqing in Suzhou, and the oral message Chen had brought.

都要在这纣信中答复，所以足足写了七张纸，认得出是他的亲笔。
Replying to all of these had taken seven sheets, unmistakably in Wang's own hand.

这样一个浙江官场中的红人及能员，每天忙得不可开交，居然能抽出工夫来写这么一封洋洋洒洒的信，就显得交情确是与众不同了。
For a man so favoured and capable in Zhejiang official circles, busy from morning to night, to find time for such an expansive letter showed how unusual their friendship was.

信上自然先提到尤五，说是“既感且愧”，
He began, naturally, with You, saying that he was “both grateful and ashamed”.

因为尤五会同郁四，将浙江漕帮的纠纷，顺顺利利地处置停当，感情已是可感，而且还承他送了许多礼物，实在受之有愧。
You and Yu Si had settled the Zhejiang brotherhood's dispute smoothly, a kindness that deserved gratitude in itself; to receive so many gifts as well made him feel unworthy.

至于认七姑奶奶作义妹一节，君子成人之美，
As for recognizing the Seventh Lady as his sworn younger sister, a gentleman should help others fulfil their wishes.

而况又是旧雨新知双重的交情，自然乐从。
With old friendships and new ones both involved, he would gladly agree.

问七姑奶奶什么时候到浙江，
When was she coming to Zhejiang?

他好派专差来迎接。
He would send a special attendant to welcome her.

“你看！”
“Look at this.”

胡雪岩将前面两张信递了给古应春，接着又往下看。
Hu handed Gu the first two sheets and read on.

下面提到何桂清，说是接到他从苏州寄会的信，才知道胡雪岩的行踪。
Wang next mentioned He: only from He's letter from Suzhou had he learned where Hu was.

何桂清认为能结识胡雪岩，是“平生一大快事”，也提到了那一万银子，
He considered meeting Hu “one of the greatest pleasures of my life” and had mentioned the ten thousand taels.

这下是王有龄来赞扬胡雪岩了，说他的处置“高明之至”，
Now it was Wang's turn to praise Hu, calling his handling of the matter “admirable in the highest degree”.

这一万两银子，请胡雪岩替他记入帐下，将来一起结算。
Hu was to charge those ten thousand taels to Wang's account, to be settled with the rest later.

此外还有许多琐碎的事，
There were many smaller matters too.

其中比较重要的是，催促裘丰言早日回杭州，
The most important was a request that Qiu Fengyan return to Hangzhou promptly.

因为现在有个“优差”的机会，他可以设法谋取，
A desirable appointment was available, and Wang could try to secure it for him.

“迟则为他人捷足先登，未免可惜。”
“It would be a pity if delay allowed someone else to get there first.”


“对了！”
“That reminds me.”

胡雪岩放下信问道，
Hu put down the letter.

“ ‘酒糊涂，住在哪里？
“Where is Wine Muddlehead staying?

他的事办得怎么样了？
How is his business going?

昨天我倒忘了问你。”
I forgot to ask yesterday.”

“都弄好了，
“It's all arranged.

就因为五哥不在这里，略上没有交代好，不敢启运。”古应春又说，
But with Brother Five away, arrangements along the route haven't been settled, so he daren't set off.

“刘三爷知道你要跟他碰头，去约他了。
Third Master Liu knew you wanted to see him and has gone to fetch him.

等一下就到。”
They'll be here shortly.”

“那这样吧，我们先去吃饭，然后到七姐那里去，
“Then let's have something to eat and go to Seventh Sister's.

留下口信请他们来。”
We can leave word for them to join us.”

“那又何必在外头吃？
“Why eat out?

还是到我们那里去。”
Come straight to our place.”

于是古应春和胡雪岩坐马车，
Gu and Hu took a carriage.

芙蓉不肯跟胡雪岩同车招摇过市，另雇一顶小轿走。
Furong refused to parade through the streets in the same carriage as Hu and hired a small sedan chair.

轿慢车快，等她到时，只见七姑奶奶正笑容满面地在跟胡雪岩商量到湖州的行程。
The chair was slower; by the time she arrived, the Seventh Lady was already discussing the journey to Huzhou with Hu, all smiles.

“怎么？”
“What?

芙蓉惊喜地问道，“你也要到湖州去？”
Are you going to Huzhou too?” Furong asked in delighted surprise.

“是啊！”七姑奶奶洋洋得意他说，
“Yes, of course.

“我哥哥在做知府，
My brother is the prefect.

我为啥不去。”
Why shouldn't I?”

这一节，也就象阿巧姐那件事一样，是无话不谈的七姑奶奶所不曾跟她谈到的少数“秘密”之一。
Like the affair of A’qiao, this was one of the few secrets the otherwise talkative Seventh Lady had kept from Furong.

不谈阿巧姐是为了怕替胡雪岩惹麻烦，
She had withheld A’qiao's story for fear of causing Hu trouble.

不谈胡雪岩屠间拉拢，认王有龄作义兄，是七姑奶奶自觉身分悬殊，不相信现任知府的王大老爷肯降尊纤贵，认此义妹。
As for Hu's efforts to arrange for Wang to become her sworn elder brother, she had felt the difference in their standing too keenly to believe that a serving prefect would condescend to accept her as his sister.

事情不成，徒落话柄，所以她不愿告诉芙蓉。
If it came to nothing, she would only expose herself to ridicule.

谁知王大老爷居然答应了，而且仿佛认此义妹，是件极可高兴的事，
Now he had actually agreed and seemed delighted at the prospect.

当然喜出望外，加以芙蓉一见投缘，不算外人，所以有那得意忘形的神态。
She was overjoyed; and since she and Furong had taken to one another at once, she felt no need to restrain her delight.

听她自己约略说明缘由，芙蓉也替她高兴，
After hearing a brief explanation, Furong was happy for her too.

We're friends; you mustn't make fun of me.

来！”
Come!”

七姑奶奶一把拉着她走，

“Help me in the kitchen.”

Gu was Cantonese and particular about food.

七姑奶奶闲着无事，也就在烹调上消磨辰光，所以家里没有客来，饭菜也很丰腆，
With little else to occupy her, the Seventh Lady had taken to passing the time in cookery, so their meals were plentiful even without guests.

厨房里早已预备得差不多了，
Most of the preparations were already made.

还有一个娘姨，一个小大姐，四个人一起动手，很快地把饭开了出来。
With an older maid and a young maid helping the two women, the food was soon on the table.

主客四人一面吃饭，一面还是谈湖州之行。
The four of them continued discussing Huzhou as they ate.

刚刚只谈了一半，胡雪岩决定亲自送七姑奶奶去，现在要谈的是动身的日期。
Their earlier conversation had gone only halfway: Hu had decided to escort the Seventh Lady himself, and now they must settle when to leave.

这是个难题，
This was difficult.

胡雪岩的事情太多，不容易抽出工夫来，
He had so much business that it was hard to spare the time.

“After the seventh of the fifth lunar month is impossible—the people from Suzhou are coming.

再等下去，天气太热，
If we wait longer, the weather will be too hot.

又不相宜。”
That won't do either.

他踌躇着说，“而且一去一来至少要半个月的工夫”小爷叔抽不出工夫，只好等秋凉以后再说。
Besides, the journey there and back will take at least a fortnight.” He hesitated. “If you can't spare the time, Little Uncle, we'll wait until the autumn cools things down.”

“七姑奶奶不愿强人所难，这样很爽快地表示了态度。
She was unwilling to impose and said so readily.

“那不行。
“No.

耽误了你们的好事。”胡雪岩又说，
That would delay your marriage.

“再者，陈世龙也要做亲了。这杯喜酒一定也要去吃的，
Besides, Chen Shilong is getting married too, and I must attend his wedding feast.

事情总有办法，
There must be a way.

等我慢慢来想。”
Let me think.”


话题中断，接下来是古应春谈他上午跟洋人见面的情形，
The subject was dropped, and Gu began describing his morning meeting with the foreigners.

谈到一半又被打断了，
Halfway through, he too was interrupted.

刘不才和裘丰言连翩而至，两个人脸上红着，是喝了酒来的，但也不妨再来几杯。
Liu Bucai and Qiu Fengyan arrived together, their faces red from drinking, though they had no objection to a few more cups.

“事情都弄好了。”裘丰言说，
“Everything is ready,” Qiu said.

“只等尤五哥来就动身。”
“As soon as Brother You comes, I'll leave.”

“他还有些日子才能回来。”胡雪岩说，
“He won't be back for some days.

“或者你先回去一趟。”
Perhaps you should go home first.”

“不必，不必！”
“No need!”

裘丰言指着刘不才说，
Qiu pointed to Liu.

“我跟刘三哥在一起，写意得很，
“I'm very comfortable with Brother Liu.

每天吃吃酒，到处逛逛，
We drink every day and go about seeing the sights.

这种逍遥自在的日子，难得遇到，
Such carefree days are rare.

尤五哥尽管慢点回来好了。”
Brother You needn't hurry back.”

“You really are Wine Muddlehead!

一则要早早交差，
First, you must complete your commission promptly.

人家等着洋枪在用，
They're waiting to use those foreign guns.

采运军火的事，哪容得你逍遥自在？
How can the transport of military supplies allow you such leisure?

真是‘急惊风遇着慢郎中’！
A patient in convulsions has found himself a leisurely doctor!

Don't miss the opportunity.”

尤五手下几个得力的人，她无不相熟，只要找到其中之一个，一切迎刃而解。

不要紧的。”

Since Hu himself could spare no time, they might as well use this opportunity to settle the matter promptly and then approach the Gu family's old clan head about the marriage.

至于尤家兄妹与王有龄之间，要有个人从中传话照料，

Hu had thought of that too: he could ask Qiu.

Qiu was naturally willing, and the Seventh Lady and Gu found the arrangement excellent.

只是一船军火，真个托付七姑奶奶保险，

Everyone but the lady herself thought that most unwise.

裘丰言不会骑马，无法同行，只得快快而罢。

说来商量。”

We'll all go to Songjiang for a visit.

现在就挑日子好走！”
Now we must choose the day.”


芙蓉取了皇历来看，
Furong consulted the almanac.

第二天就是宜于长行的好日子，
The following day was auspicious for a long journey.

时间是太局促了些，但以芙蓉在这些上头很迷信，明天不走，就得再等五天，
It left rather little time, but she was deeply superstitious about such matters: if they did not go tomorrow, they would have to wait five days.

为了迁就她，只好大家赶一赶。
To accommodate her, everyone must hurry.

“You've nothing to do.

He responded as though he had received a general's command and turned to go at once.

“Wait!”

刘不才慌不迭地站起来，

“I'll come with you.”

There are lots of things I need you to do.”

刘不才无可奈何地站定脚，转身答道：
Helplessly, Liu stopped and turned.

“你快说！
“Tell me quickly.

我有要紧事。”
I have important business.”

Tell me.”

I can't explain it in two words.”

我一下就回来，替你去买。
I'll be back in a moment and buy them for you.

夷场上市面迟，都买得到。
The settlement's shops stay open late; everything will still be available.

买不齐的，明天上午再补。”
Whatever I can't get, I'll buy tomorrow morning.”

His mysterious behaviour made Furong want to keep him there and find out why.

倒是胡雪岩看不过，阻住了芙蓉，
Hu, however, could bear it no longer and stopped her.

于是刘不才如逢皇恩大赦似地，跟着古应春匆匆走了。
Liu hurried off after Gu like a man released by an imperial pardon.


“奇怪！”芙蓉咕哝着说，

I don't think he's up to any good.”

胡雪岩笑了，

Don't flatter me.”

胡雪岩一笑出门。

等他走了不久，刘不才笑嘻嘻地走了进来，是极得意的神情，
Soon after he left, Liu came back grinning, looking very pleased with himself.

自道是赌“花会”去了，赢了二百多两银子。
He had been gambling at huahui, he announced, and had won more than two hundred taels.

什么叫“花会”，芙蓉还是第一次听见这两个字。
Furong had never heard of this “flower lottery”.

七姑奶奶却是懂的，不但懂，而且迷过，
The Seventh Lady knew it well; indeed, she had once been addicted to it.

因而便为芙蓉解释，“花会”跟广东的“白鸽票”相仿，上海设局赌花会的，亦以广东省城和潮州两地的人居多。
She explained that it resembled Guangdong's “white-pigeon lottery”, and that most people running flower lotteries in Shanghai came from the provincial capital or Chaozhou.

赌法是三十六门开一门，其中两门永远不开，所以实际上是三十四门猜一门，
One winning entry was drawn from thirty-six, though two were always excluded, leaving thirty-four possible choices.

猜中的一赔二十八。
A correct guess paid twenty-eight to one.

“这种赌不公平，
“That's unfair.

要公平就要一赔三十三，
To be fair, it should pay thirty-three to one.

一赔二十八，等于多占五门。”七姑奶奶说，
Paying twenty-eight gives them the advantage of five extra entries,” she said.

“后来我是想穿了，所以不赌。
“Eventually I saw through it and stopped.

这种赌不知道害了多少人！尤其是没有知识的女人！”
Who knows how many people it has ruined, especially ignorant women?”

“本来嘛！”芙蓉这样说，
“Exactly,” Furong agreed.

“好好的良家妇女到花会里去赌钱，象什么样子？
“What business have respectable women going to a flower lottery to gamble?

输了钱，自然吵得家宅不安。”
Naturally, losing money will throw their homes into uproar.”

“还不光是输钱，
“It's worse than losing money.

为了‘祈梦’，败坏名节的都不知道多少。”
Who knows how many have lost their honour through seeking dreams?”

“什么？”
“What?”

芙蓉大为不解，
Furong was bewildered.

“与‘祈梦’啥相干？”
“What have dreams to do with it?”


芙蓉也是迷信这些花佯的，
Furong herself believed in such superstitions.

七姑奶奶觉得正好借此讽劝，便从头讲起：
Seeing a chance to warn her, the Seventh Lady began at the beginning.

“花会的总机关叫‘总筒’，
“The central office is called the ‘main tube’.

各地方设‘筒’，也有上门来兜揽的，叫做‘航船’。
There are local ‘tubes’ everywhere, and agents who come to your door are called ‘ferryboats’.

赌法是每天早晚各开一次，称为‘早筒’、‘晚筒’。
A draw is held twice a day, morning and evening—the ‘morning tube’ and ‘evening tube’.

向例前面两筒开过的围不开，所以三十六门实际上只开三十四门。
By custom, the winners of the previous two draws are excluded, which is why only thirty-four of the thirty-six entries can win.

“三十六门是三十六个人，据说最初就是梁山泊的三十六响马巨头，
The thirty-six stand for thirty-six men, said to have been the thirty-six bandit chiefs of Liangshan Marsh originally.

但久而久之，宋江、吴用等等名字，完全改过了。
Over time, the names of Song Jiang, Wu Yong and the others were all changed.

三十六个人的身分，各个不同，另外每个人有座‘本命星’，天上飞的、陆上爬的、水中游的都有，
Each man has a different status and a ‘guardian star’, which may be something that flies in the sky, crawls on land or swims in the water.

象第二十五，名叫林太平，身分是皇帝，本命星就是一条龙。
Number twenty-five, for instance, is Lin Taiping, an emperor, whose guardian star is a dragon.

“三十四门只能挑一门，
You can choose only one of the thirty-four.

怎么挑法？
But which?

这样也好，那样也好，心里七上八下拿不定主意，那就只好祈梦了。
This seems as good as that, and you're too anxious and uncertain to decide, so you seek an answer in a dream.

梦见龙，当然押林太平，梦见黑狗，就要押第二十八罗必得。”
Dream of a dragon, and naturally you bet on Lin Taiping; dream of a black dog, and you bet on number twenty-eight, Luo Bide.”

七姑奶奶停了一下问，
She paused.

“你晓得祈梦到哪里去祈？”
“Do you know where people go to seek these dreams?”

“自然是庙里。”芙蓉答说。
“A temple, of course.”

“不是！
“No.

荒山野地的坟头上。”
A grave in some lonely wilderness.”

芙蓉大骇，
Furong was horrified.

“是晚上？”她问。
“At night?”

“当然是晚上，
“Of course.

哪有白天祈梦的？”
Who seeks such dreams in daylight?”

“晚上睡在坟头上？”
“Sleeping on a grave at night?”

芙蓉不断摇头，
Furong shook her head repeatedly.

“不吓死人！”
“Wouldn't you die of fright?”

“为了钱，胆就大了，
“Money makes people brave.

不但是坟头上，而且越是新坟越好……”
And not just any grave—the newer, the better.”

这是由于“新鬼大，故鬼小”的说法，
This followed the belief that “a new ghost is strong, an old ghost weak”.

新坟则墓中人新死不久，魂灵易聚，
The occupant of a fresh grave had died recently, so the spirit was more easily summoned.

招魂的方法是用一口空铁锅，拿锅铲空铲一阵，据说鬼魂就会闻声而至。
One scraped a spatula about in an empty iron pot, and the ghost was said to come at the sound.

然后根据梦兆去押，百不失一。
A bet based on the ensuing dream, they claimed, would never fail.


“那么，灵不灵呢？”
“Does it really work?”

“怎么会灵？”七姑奶奶说。
“How could it?” the Seventh Lady replied.

“譬如你梦见黄狗，我梦见黑狗，
“Suppose you dream of a yellow dog and I dream of a black one.

各押各的，总有一个不灵。
We each bet accordingly; at least one dream must be wrong.

各人有各人的心境，各人做各人的梦，
Everyone has a different state of mind and dreams their own dreams.

个个要灵，除非三十四门全开。
For all of them to come true, all thirty-four entries would have to win.

哪有这个道理？”
Where's the sense in that?”

“讲得透彻！”
“Perfectly explained!”

对赌之一道三折肽的刘不才，击案称赏，
Liu, whose repeated reverses had given him plenty of gambling experience, slapped the table in admiration.

“赌钱全靠算！
“Gambling depends on calculation.

‘触机’不足为据。
Sudden inspirations are no guide.”

“芙蓉也深有所思地点点头，接着又问：“那么，怎么说是败坏名节呢？”
Furong nodded thoughtfully, then asked, “But how does it destroy a woman's honour?”

“你想想，一个女人独自睡在荒郊野外，
“Think of a woman sleeping alone in the wilderness.

还有个不被人糟踏的？”
How could she escape being violated?”

“啊！”
“Oh!”

芙蓉悚然，
Furong shuddered.

“这花会说起来真是害人无穷！
“This flower lottery really does cause endless harm.

三叔，你也少去！”
Third Uncle, you should go less often too.”

“你放心，
“Don't worry.

这种赌是不会赌的人玩的。
That game is for people who don't know how to gamble.

迷不到我！
It won't catch me.

我不过喜欢赌，要会见识见识而已。”刘不才又说，
I simply enjoy gambling and wanted to see what it was like.

“今天赢了二百多两银子，不足为奇。
Winning over two hundred taels today was nothing remarkable.

遇见一桩妙事，说起来，倒着实叫我佩服。”
But I saw something extraordinary that truly earned my admiration.”

听这一说，七姑奶奶首先就高兴了，
The Seventh Lady brightened at once.

“快说，快说！”
“Tell us!”

她捧杯茶给刘不才，
She brought him a cup of tea.

“你说的妙事一定妙！”
“If you call it extraordinary, it must be.”


刘不才所讲的，是他在一处“分筒”中亲眼得见的一位人物。
Liu described someone he had seen at a local branch.

这处分筒，规模极大，赌客中颇多殷实富户，下的赌码极重，
It was a large establishment frequented by many prosperous households, and the stakes were heavy.

其中有个富孀，夫家姓梁，行四，所以都叫她“梁四太太”。
Among its customers was a rich widow whose husband's surname was Liang and who was known by her family's rank as Fourth Madam Liang.

梁四太太打花会与众不同，专打一门，这一门在三十六门中，名列十六，叫做李汉云。
Unlike others, she always bet on a single entry: number sixteen, Li Hanyun.

奇的是她专打这一门。总筒中偏偏不开这一门。
Curiously, while she persisted in backing that one, the main office never drew it.

这样一年多下来，已经输了上万的银子。
In a little over a year she had lost more than ten thousand taels.

这天下午，她照例坐轿到了那里，
That afternoon she arrived by sedan chair as usual.

因为是大户，自然殷勤接待，
Such an important customer was naturally welcomed with every attention.

一盏茶罢，分筒执事便赔笑相问：“四太太，把条子交下来吧！”
After a cup of tea, the branch's clerk asked with a courteous smile, “Fourth Madam, will you give me your slips?”

花会打那一门的那张“条子”照例是封缄的，要等总筒开出来才能揭晓。
The slip naming one's choice was customarily sealed and opened only after the main office announced the winner.

不如此则总筒可以统计每一门下注的数目，避重就轻拣注码最少的一门开。
Otherwise, the main office could total the stakes on each entry and choose the one carrying the smallest sum.

话虽如此，弊端还是有的。
Yet fraud remained possible.

梁四太太这时听执事问到，便愤愤地说：“钱输了，还是小事，
At the clerk's question, Fourth Madam Liang said angrily, “Losing money is a small matter.

我就不相信一次都不会中。
What I don't believe is that I can never win once.

我总要着一次才服气。”
I must win at least once before I'm satisfied.”

“我劝四太太换一门的好！”分筒执事说，
“I'd advise you to change your choice.

“赌上面真是有鬼的，
There's something uncanny about gambling.

不开起来一定不开。”
When a number won't come up, it simply won't.”


“今天开出来，我一定会中。
“I shall certainly win today.

你看，”
Look.”

梁四太太便从手巾包里取出一把纸条来，
She took a handful of slips from her handkerchief bundle.

“今天我打三十四门，
“I've backed all thirty-four entries.

莫非还不中？”
Surely I must win now?”

“哪有这种赌法的？”分筒执事笑道，
“What a way to gamble!” the clerk laughed.

“四太太你不想想，
“Think, Fourth Madam.

三十四门，只中一门，
Only one of the thirty-four can win.

赔了你二十八，还要输四门。
Even with twenty-eight paid back, you'll still lose four stakes.

这叫什么算盘？”
What sort of reckoning is that?”

“当然下注有多少。
“Naturally, I've staked different amounts.

开出来是我的重门，我就赢了。”梁四太太说：
If one of my heavy bets wins, I'll come out ahead.

“总要中一回，我才能死心歇手。”
I must win once before I can make up my mind to stop.”

分筒执事，听她的口风，这是最后一回来赌花会，
The clerk gathered that this would be her last visit.

平白失去这么一个大户，未免可惜。但此时亦不便相劝，
It was a pity to lose such an important customer for nothing, but he could hardly try to dissuade her now.

只拿笔来记每一门所下的注码。
He took up his brush to record the stake on each entry.

一注注写完，却只有三十三门，
When all were listed, there were only thirty-three.

梁四太太奇怪，凝神细想一想说道：
Puzzled, she thought carefully.

“下轿的时候我还数过的，
“I counted them when I got out of the chair.

是三十四张条子，
There were thirty-four slips.

大概是数弄掉了一张，
I must have dropped one.

你们替我去找一找看？”
Will you look for it?”

那分筒执事，工于心计，而且日夕从事，对于这上面的舞弊，精到极点，当时心里就打算好，这张条子就寻着了，也不能够给她。
Cunning and practised daily in every trick of the business, the clerk immediately decided that even if the slip was found, he must not give it back.

果然在门槛下面找到了，但回复梁四太太却是如此：“到处找过，
Sure enough, it lay beneath the threshold, but the report to her was, “We've looked everywhere.

没有！”
Nothing.”

“没有，就算了！
“Then never mind.

莫非偏偏就开那一门？
Surely that won't be the very entry drawn?

我想，世界上没有那么巧的事！”
I don't believe the world contains such coincidences.”

分筒一则要“统吃”梁四太太，再则怕她今日一中，明日不来，
The branch wanted both to take all her stakes and to prevent a win from putting an end to her visits.

于是便革开那一门，
They would therefore have that very entry drawn.

打开捡到的那张条子，看是第三十五门张九官，当即通知总筒，开出张九官来。
Opening the recovered slip, they found number thirty-five, Zhang Jiuguan, and immediately told the main office to draw him.


“我跟这位梁四太太前后脚到。”刘不才说，“眼看她的三十三张条子拆封，
“I arrived at almost the same time as she did,” Liu said, “and watched her thirty-three slips being opened.

第一封拆开来就是张九官……”
The very first was Zhang Jiuguan.”

七姑奶奶心急，打断他问：
Impatient, the Seventh Lady broke in.

“这是啥道理？
“How could that be?

好奇怪！”
How strange!”

“怪事还多呢！
“There are stranger things yet.

你不要心急，
Don't hurry me.

听我说！”刘不才又说：
Listen.

“拆开第二封，还是张九官。
The second was Zhang Jiuguan too.”

““第三封呢？”七姑奶奶问，
“And the third?

“莫非也是张九官？”
Surely not Zhang Jiuguan again?”

“这还用说！
“Of course!

一直拆到第三十三封，都是张九官，
All the way to the thirty-third, every one was Zhang Jiuguan.

梁四太太一共赢了一万两千多银子，
Fourth Madam Liang won more than twelve thousand taels.

一年多输下去的，一下子扳本反赢钱！”
In one stroke, she recovered everything she had lost over the past year and made a profit besides.”

这个故事的谜底揭开来，将芙蓉听得目瞪口呆，
At the revelation, Furong stared open-mouthed.

不信地说：“真想得出这种恶刻的法子？”
“Who could think of such a devilish trick?” she exclaimed incredulously.

“这梁四太太的脑筋，可以跟小爷叔比了！”七姑奶奶不胜向往他说，
“Her brains can compare with Little Uncle's!” the Seventh Lady said longingly.

“我们真想结识结识她！”
“I'd love to make her acquaintance.”

“那也容易，”刘不才说，
“Easy enough,” Liu replied.

“只要到那处分筒去几回，一定遇得见她。”
“Go to that branch a few times, and you're sure to meet her.”


“省省吧！”
“Spare yourself!”

芙蓉赶紧劝阻，
Furong intervened at once.

“这种花会，害人不浅，
“This lottery does terrible harm.

这样子猜心思，寿命都要短几年，
All that guessing at other people's schemes would shorten your life by years.

你既然已经戒掉了，
You've already given it up.

千万别去。”
Whatever you do, don't go back.”

“这话也是！”刘不才大有忏悔之意，
“That's true,” Liu said, sounding deeply repentant.

“赌这样东西，不赌心思没有趣味，
“Gambling is no fun without a battle of wits.

要赌心思，真叫‘强中自有强中手’，
Yet once you pit your wits against others, however clever you are, there's always someone cleverer.

永远不会有啥把握。
You can never be sure of anything.

想想真没意思！”
When I think about it, there's really no point.”

“照这样子说，刘三爷，你也要洗手戒赌了？”
“Does that mean you'll give up gambling too, Third Master Liu?”

“你听他的！”
“Listen to him!”

芙蓉撇撇嘴，对七姑奶奶说，“我们三叔说要戒赌，总有十七八回了。”
Furong curled her lip and told the Seventh Lady, “Third Uncle has promised to stop seventeen or eighteen times already.”

刘不才不好意思地笑了一下，
Liu smiled in embarrassment.

七姑奶奶便为他解嘲：
The Seventh Lady came to his rescue.

“虽然没有戒掉，总常常想着在戒，
“Even if he hasn't stopped, he's always thinking of stopping.

这就蛮难得的了！”
That's something to admire.”

“怎么难得？”门外有人在搭腔，
“What's admirable?” someone asked from the doorway.

大家转脸看时，是不知道什么时候溜了出去，如今又溜了回来的裘丰言。
They turned to find Qiu, who had slipped out unnoticed and now slipped back in.

于是七姑奶奶将刚刚听来的故事，又讲了一遍。
The Seventh Lady retold the story she had just heard.

裘丰言也对梁四太太赞叹不止，
Qiu too was full of admiration for Fourth Madam Liang.

这样谈到十点多钟，古应春和胡雪岩陆续归来，
Their conversation continued until after ten, when Gu and Hu returned one after the other.

船已雇好，胡雪岩所买的东西，已直接送回客栈。
The boat had been hired, and Hu's purchases sent directly to the inn.

约定第二天中午，仍在七姑奶奶那里会齐，一起下船。
They agreed to meet at the Seventh Lady's again at noon the next day and go aboard together.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十七章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Twenty-Seven, Part One
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第二十七章｜CHAPTER TWENTY-SEVEN


到了松江，船泊秀野桥下，都上了岸，先到尤家休息。
On reaching Songjiang, they moored below Xiuye Bridge and went ashore, stopping first at the You household to rest.

尤五奶奶大出意外，少不得有一番寒暄张罗。
Mrs You was greatly surprised and busied herself with greetings and arrangements.

尤家常年备着好些客户，
The family always kept plenty of guest rooms ready.

除了芙蓉是七姑奶奶早就约好，跟她一起往以外，尤五奶奶又坚邀胡、裘二人在她家下榻。
Furong had already agreed to stay with the Seventh Lady; Mrs You now insisted that Hu and Qiu stay in the house as well.

略略安顿，随即去见老太爷。
Once they had settled in, they went to see the Old Master.

因为裘丰言是生客，又是一位官儿，老太爷十分客气，
Since Qiu Fengyan was a stranger and an official, the old man observed every courtesy.

叫人取来长袍马褂，衣冠整齐，肃然陪坐。
He had his long robe and riding jacket brought out, dressed formally, and sat with them in solemn state.

这一下不但裘丰言大为不安，连胡雪岩亦颇为局促，
Qiu was deeply uncomfortable, and even Hu felt constrained.

幸好，七姑奶奶接踵而至，
Fortunately, the Seventh Lady soon followed.

有她在座，能说会道，亲切随和，才把僵硬的气氛改变过来。
Her easy, affectionate conversation dispelled the stiffness.

说过一阵闲话，七姑奶奶谈到正事，
After some small talk she came to the point.

“老太爷，”她说，“今天我有桩大事来禀告你老人家。
“Old Master, I have something very important to tell you today.

不过，有点说不出口。”
Only I find it rather hard to say.”

老太爷已经看出来，裘丰言跟她也相熟，这样，自己说话，就无需有所避忌：
He had already seen that Qiu knew her well, so there was no need to restrain his own remarks.

“真正新鲜话把戏！”他似笑非笑地说，
“Now that is something new!” he said, half smiling.

“你还有啥说不出口的话！”
“Is there anything you find hard to say?”

“老太爷也是，就看得我那样子的老脸厚皮。”
“You make me sound quite shameless.”

七姑奶奶笑着站了起来，
She rose with a laugh.

“我先进去跟老姑太太谈谈，
“I shall go in and talk to Old Aunt first.

请小爷叔代我说吧！”
Little Uncle can tell you for me.”

老姑太太是老太爷的妹妹，也七十多了，耳聋口拙，
Old Aunt was the Old Master’s sister, also over seventy, hard of hearing and slow of speech.

没有什么可谈的，
There was little to discuss with her.

七姑奶奶无非是托词避开，好让胡雪岩谈她的亲事。
The Seventh Lady merely wanted to withdraw so that Hu could speak of her marriage.

七姑奶奶的没有一个归宿，原是者太爷的一桩心事，
Her unsettled future had long weighed on the Old Master.

所以听得胡雪岩细谈了经过，十分高兴。尤其是听说王有龄以知府的身分，降尊纡贵，认出身江湖的七姑奶奶作义妹，
Hu’s detailed account delighted him, especially the news that Wang Youling, a prefect, had condescended to take a woman of her background in the brotherhood as his sworn sister.

更觉得是件有光彩的事。
He considered that a great honour.

这一切都由胡雪岩而来，饮水思源，说了许多感谢的话，
It was all Hu’s doing, and, remembering the source of these blessings, he thanked him repeatedly.

同时因为裘丰言作胡雪岩的代表，在尤家与王家之间，要由他来从中联合安排，所以老太爷又向裘丰言拜托道谢。
Since Qiu was to represent Hu and coordinate arrangements between the You and Wang families, he also entrusted the matter to Qiu and thanked him.

言出至诚，着实令人感动。
His heartfelt sincerity was deeply moving.


“老太爷，”胡雪岩最后谈到他自己的请求，“有件事，
“Old Master,” Hu said, finally turning to his own request, “there is something else.

尤五哥不在这里，要劳动你老人家替我调兵遣将了！”
Since Brother Five is away, I must trouble you to muster a few men for me.”

“噢！”老太爷一叠连声地说：
“Certainly!” the old man said eagerly.

“你吩咐，你吩咐！”等胡雪岩说明，要派两个人护送，
“Tell me what you need!” Hu explained that he wanted two men to accompany a shipment.

料想是件轻而易举的事，却不道老太爷竟沉吟不语。
He had expected this to be easily arranged, but the Old Master fell into thoughtful silence.

这就奇怪了，他忍不住要问：“老太爷，莫非有什么难处？”
Puzzled, Hu could not help asking, “Is there some difficulty?”

“是的。”
“Yes.

老太爷答道，“你老弟是自己人，裘爷也是一见如故的好友，
You are one of us, my young friend, and Mr Qiu already feels like an old acquaintance.

这件事说不巧真不巧，说巧真巧。
This is a most unfortunate coincidence—and a fortunate one too.

不巧的不去说它了，
Never mind the unfortunate part.

只说巧的是，亏得你跟我说，
The fortunate part is that you have told me.

不然，真要做出对不起朋友的事来了。”
Otherwise, I should have done a friend a very serious wrong.”

听得这话，以胡雪岩的精明老到，裘丰言的饱经世故，都察出话中大有蹊跷，
Hu’s shrewdness and Qiu’s long experience both told them that something lay behind these words.

两人面面相觑，交换了一个眼色，
They exchanged a glance.

自然还是胡雪岩开口。
Naturally it was Hu who spoke.

“老太爷既当我们是自己人，那么，是怎么的‘不巧’？何妨也说一说！”
“Since you regard us as your own people, why not tell us the unfortunate part as well?”

“不必说了！
“There is no need.

不巧的是老五不在这里，
The misfortune is that Old Five is away.

在这里就不会有这件事。”老太爷平静地问道：“裘老爷预备什么时候走？”
Had he been here, this would never have happened.” The Old Master calmly asked, “When do you intend to leave, Mr Qiu?”


“我的货色还在上海，
“My cargo is still in Shanghai.

雇船装货，总得有三、五天的工夫。
Hiring boats and loading them will take three to five days.

我听老太爷的吩咐！”
I shall follow your instructions.”

“吩咐不敢当。”老太爷说，
“I would not presume to give instructions.

“你明天就请回上海去预备。
Please go back to Shanghai tomorrow and make your preparations.

今天四月十四，
Today is the fourteenth day of the fourth month.

准备四月二十开船，
Be ready to sail on the twentieth.

我们四月十九，在上海会齐。”
We shall meet in Shanghai on the nineteenth.”

“怎么？”
“What?”

胡雪岩不解“我们”两字，
Hu did not understand his use of “we.”

“莫非……”
“Surely you do not mean…”

“是的。”
“Yes.

老太爷说，“我送了裘老爷去！”
I shall escort Mr Qiu myself.”

“那怎么敢当？”
“How could we allow that?”

裘丰言跟胡雪岩异口同声地说。
Hu and Qiu exclaimed together.

“不！”
“No!”

老太爷做了个很有力的手势，
The old man made an emphatic gesture.

“非我亲自送不可。”
“I must go in person.”

说着，嘴唇动了两下，
His lips moved as though he had more to say.

看看裘丰言，到底不曾说出口来。
He looked at Qiu, but finally left the words unspoken.

“对不起，老裘！”胡雪岩看事态严重，也就顾不得了，径自直言：
Recognising the seriousness of the situation, Hu abandoned ceremony. “Forgive me, Qiu.

“你请外面坐一坐，
Would you sit outside for a moment?

我跟老太爷说句话。”
I must have a word with the Old Master.”

“是，是！”
“Of course.”

裘丰言也会意了，赶紧起身回避。
Qiu understood and hastily rose to withdraw.

“不必！
“There is no need.

裘老爷请这里坐！”
Please stay here, Mr Qiu.”

老太爷起身又道歉：
The Old Master rose and apologised.

“实在对不起！
“I am very sorry.

我跟我们胡老弟说句‘门槛里’的话。
I must speak to our friend Hu about something within the brotherhood.

不是拿你当外人，因为有些话，说实在的，裘老爷还是不晓得的好。”
I do not mean to treat you as an outsider, but, to be frank, there are things you would be better off not knowing.”

交代了这番话，老太爷陪着胡雪岩到佛堂里去坐，这是他家最庄严、也最清静的一处地方，
With this explanation he took Hu to the family’s Buddhist shrine room, the most solemn and secluded place in the house.

胡雪岩很懂这些过节，
Hu understood such observances.

一进去立刻摆出极严肃的脸色，双手合十，先垂头低眼，默默地礼了佛，
He immediately assumed a grave expression, joined his palms, lowered his head and eyes, and silently paid reverence to the Buddha.

才悄悄在经桌的下方落座。
Only then did he quietly take a seat below the scripture table.


老太爷在他侧面坐了下来，慢慢吞吞地说道：
The Old Master sat beside him and spoke slowly.

“老弟台，我不晓得这件享有你‘轧脚’在内，
“My young friend, I did not know you had a hand in this affair.

早晓得了，事情就比较好做。
Had I known earlier, things would have been easier.

现在，好比生了疮，快要破头了，只好把脓硬挤出来！”
Now it is like a sore about to burst: there is nothing for it but to squeeze out the pus.”

胡雪岩很用心地听着，始终猜不透，裘丰言押运的这一批军火，跟他有何关系？
Hu listened closely, still unable to guess what connection the old man could have with the arms Qiu was escorting.

但有一层是很清楚的，老太爷的处境相当为难，
One thing was clear: the Old Master was in a very difficult position.

只是难在何处，却怎么佯也想不出。
Yet Hu could not imagine where the difficulty lay.

江湖上做事，讲究彼此为人着想，
Among men of their world, consideration for one another mattered above everything.

所以胡雪岩在这时候，觉得别样心思可以暂时不想，自己的态度一定得先表明。
Hu felt that all other questions could wait; first he must make his own position clear.

“老太爷，”他说，“我晓得你拿我这面的事，当自己的事一样，
“Old Master, I know you treat my concerns as your own.

既然这样子，我们就当这件事你我都有分，好好商量着办。
Let us regard this as something we are both involved in, and work out a solution together.

如果难处光是由你老一肩挑了过去，即使能够办通，我也不愿意。”
If you shoulder all the difficulty alone, I shall not accept it, even if you succeed.”

“老弟台！”老太爷伸出一只全是骨节老茧的手，捏着胡雪岩的手腕说：“我真没有白交你这个朋友。
Stretching out a hand all knuckles and calluses, the old man gripped Hu’s wrist. “My young friend, I have not been mistaken in choosing you as a friend.

我把事情说给你听。”
Let me explain.”


真如他自己所说的：“事情说巧真巧，说不巧真不巧”，
It was indeed just as he had said: an unfortunate coincidence, yet a fortunate one.

这一批军人跟他的一个“同参弟兄”有关，这个人名叫俞武成，地盘是在扬州、镇江一带。
The shipment of arms concerned one of his fellow initiates, a man named Yu Wucheng, whose territory lay around Yangzhou and Zhenjiang.

这时太平军虽已退出扬州，但仍留赖汉英扼守辰州，与清军刑部左侍郎雷正诚的水师，相持不下。
Though the Taiping forces had withdrawn from Yangzhou, they had left Lai Hanying holding Chenzhou, where he was locked in a stalemate with the Qing naval forces under Lei Yixian, left vice-minister of punishments.

太平军全力谋求打开局面，所以跟上海的洋商有交易，希望买到一批军火。
Determined to break the deadlock, the Taipings had been dealing with foreign merchants in Shanghai in the hope of buying arms.

“这件事要派洋商的不是！”老太爷说：
“The foreign merchants are to blame for this,” the Old Master said.

“浙江买的那批洋枪，原来洋商是答应卖给‘长毛’的，
“They had originally promised the rifles Zhejiang has bought to the Longhairs.

已经收了人家的定洋，约期起运，由英国兵舰运了去。
They had already taken their deposit and agreed on a shipping date, with a British warship to carry the cargo.

哪知道事情变了卦，
Then the arrangement changed.

听说替浙江方面出头交涉的人，手腕很灵活……”“老太爷，”胡雪岩很高兴地抢着说，
I hear that the man negotiating for Zhejiang was extremely resourceful…” Hu interrupted with pleasure.

“这个人不是别人，就是未来的‘七姑爷’古应春。”
“That was none other than the Seventh Lady’s future husband, Gu Yingchun.”

“噢！
“Oh!

我不晓得。
I had no idea.

老五这两个月一直在上海，消息隔绝了。
Old Five has been in Shanghai these past two months, and I have been cut off from the news.

这且不去说他，
Never mind that for now.

先说我那个同参弟兄俞武成。”
Let us return to my brother Yu Wucheng.”

俞武成跟赖汉英相熟，
Yu knew Lai Hanying well.

因而一半交情，一半重礼，赖汉英托出俞武成来，预备等这批军火从上海起运，一入内河，就要动手截留。
Appealing partly to their friendship and partly through a substantial gift, Lai had enlisted him to intercept the arms as soon as they left Shanghai and entered the inland waterways.

由于是松江漕帮的地盘，所以俞武成专程到松江来拜访他这位老师兄，很客气地打了招呼。
Since this was the territory of the Songjiang Grain Transport Brotherhood, Yu had made a special journey to call on his senior fellow initiate and courteously notify him.

“这怪我一时疏忽。”老大爷失悔地说，
“It was my own carelessness,” the Old Master said regretfully.

“我是久已不管闲事，一切都交给老五，
“I have long stopped attending to these matters and left everything to Old Five.

偏偏者五又到杭州去了。
Unfortunately, he had gone to Hangzhou.

俞武成又是当年一炷香一起磕头的弟兄！
And Wucheng is a brother who knelt with me before the same stick of incense!

五十年下来，同参的只剩了三个人，
After fifty years, only three of our fellow initiates remain.

这个交情，我不能不买。
I could not disregard that friendship.

哪晓得大水冲了龙王庙！
Who could have imagined the flood would wash into the Dragon King’s own temple?

如今说不得了，
Now there is nothing for it.

只好我说了话不算！“
I shall have to break my word.”


“那怎么可以？”胡雪岩口答道，
“How can that be right?” Hu replied.

“俞老虽是你老的同参，但是答应过他的，
“Elder Yu may be your fellow initiate, but you have given him your word.

也不能脸一抹，说是自己人的东西，不准动！
You cannot simply change your face and tell him that the goods belong to friends and must not be touched.

光棍不断财路，
A man of our world does not cut off another man’s livelihood.

我来想办法。
Let me find a way.”

““老弟台！没有叫你伤脑筋的道理。
“There is no reason for you to rack your brains over it.

我是因为当你自己人，所以拿门槛里的话告诉了你，
I have told you what lies within our doors because I regard you as one of us.

照规矩是不能说的。”老太爷又说：
Under our rules, I ought not to have spoken at all.

“我只请你做个参赞，
I ask only for your advice.

事情是我的，无论如何要掮它下去，
The responsibility is mine, and I must bear it whatever happens.

你请裘老爷放心好了。”
Tell Mr Qiu he need not worry.”

“怎么放得下心！”胡雪岩说，
“How can we stop worrying?” Hu said.

“如今只有‘按兵不动’，
“For now we must hold our position.

那批洋枪先放在那里，等跟俞老谈好了再说。”
Leave the rifles where they are until we have reached an understanding with Elder Yu.”

老太爷不答，
The Old Master did not answer.

身往后一靠，双眼望空，紧闭着嘴唇，是那全心全意在思索如何解开这难题的神气。
Leaning back, he stared into space with his lips tightly closed, utterly absorbed in finding a way out.

胡雪岩见此光景，颇为不安，心里也在打算：
Hu watched uneasily, working through the problem himself.

如果俞武成不是他的“同参弟兄”，事情就好办，
Had Yu not been the old man’s fellow initiate, matters would have been simpler.

若是这批军火，不是落到太平军手里，事情也好办。
Had the weapons not been destined for the Taipings, that too would have made things easier.

此刻既是投鼠忌器，又不能轻易松手，
But now they dared not strike at the rat for fear of breaking the precious vessel, nor could they readily let go.

槁成了软硬都难着力的局面，
Neither firmness nor persuasion offered a clear path.

连他都觉得一时真难善策。
Even Hu could think of no immediate solution.


“难！”老太爷说，
“It is difficult,” the Old Master said.

“想来想去，只有我来硬挺。”
“After turning it over and over, I can see no way but to stand firm myself.”

“硬挺不是办法。”
“That will not solve it.

胡雪岩问道，“照你老看，俞老跟那面的交情如何？”
How close do you think Elder Yu is to the people on the other side?”

“这就不清楚了。
“I do not know.

不过江湖上走走，一句话就是一句话，
But among men of our world, a promise is a promise.

他答应了人家，我又答应了他，
He has promised them, and I have promised him.

反正不管怎么样，这票东西，我不让他动手，我们弟兄的交情就算断了。”
Whatever the circumstances, if I prevent him from laying hands on this cargo, our brotherhood is at an end.”

“话不能这么说！”
“Not necessarily!”

胡雪岩脑际灵光一闪，欣然说道：
An idea flashed into Hu’s mind.

“我倒有个无办法中的办法，
“I have a way out where there seems to be none.

我想请你老派个专人，将俞老请来，有话摆在台面上说：
Send a special messenger to invite Elder Yu here, and put everything openly before him.

两面都是自己人，
Both sides are friends.

不能帮一面损一面。
You cannot help one at the other’s expense.

事情该怎么办？请俞老自己说一句。”
Ask him himself what ought to be done.”

“这叫什么办法？”
“What sort of solution is that?”

老太爷笑道：
The old man smiled.

“那不就表示：这闲事我管不下来，只好不管吗？”
“It would simply mean that I cannot manage the affair and must withdraw from it.”

“正就是这话！”
“Exactly!”

胡雪岩点点头，
Hu nodded.

“你老不肯管这闲事，俞老怨不着你。
“If you decline to intervene, he cannot blame you.

而在我们这面，就承情不尽了。
And we, on our side, shall be endlessly grateful.”

“老太爷略想一下问道：
The old man considered.

“莫非你另有法子，
“Have you some other plan?

譬如请官兵保护，跟武成硬碰硬较量个明白？”
Perhaps you mean to seek protection from government troops and settle things by force with Wucheng?”

“我哪能这么做？”胡雪岩笑道，
“How could I do that?” Hu laughed.

“我这样一做，将来还想不想在江湖上跑跑？”
“If I did, could I ever move among men of the brotherhood again?”

“那么，你是怎么办呢？”
“Then what would you do?”

“我想跟俞老谈了再说。”
“I must speak to Elder Yu first.

胡雪岩答道，“我要跟他老实说明白，这票货色，如果不是太平军那面要，我可以放手，由他那面的户头承买，我另找洋商打交道，
I shall tell him plainly that if the Taipings were not the intended buyers, I could give way, let his clients buy the cargo, and negotiate another purchase with the foreigners myself.

现在可不行，
But as things stand, I cannot.

这是请俞老不要管闲事。
I shall ask him to stay out of it.

至于那面送了怎样一笔重礼，我照送就是。”
As for the handsome gift they have given him, I shall match it.”

“听说是一万银子。”
“I hear it was ten thousand taels.”

“一万银子小事，
“Ten thousand is no great matter.

我贴也贴得起。
I can afford to bear the cost.

我看俞老也不见得看得如何之重！
I doubt Elder Yu attaches that much importance to it either.

我要劝他的是，一定不可以帮长毛。
What I must persuade him of is that he must never help the Longhairs.

为人忠逆之辨，总不可以不分明。”
A man cannot fail to distinguish loyalty from rebellion.”


听到最后一句，老太爷很注意地望着他，
At these last words the Old Master looked at him intently.

好久，才点点头说：
After a long pause he nodded.

“老弟台，你虽是空子，漕帮的来龙去脉，清清楚楚，
“Though you are an outsider, you know the origins and history of the Grain Transport Brotherhood very well.

说句实话，二百年下来，
To tell you the truth, two hundred years have passed.

现在的时世，不是翁、钱、潘三祖当年立家门的时世了。
These are no longer the times in which our three patriarchs, Weng, Qian, and Pan, founded the brotherhood.

长毛初起，我们漕帮看得两‘秀’很重。
When the Longhairs first rose, we thought highly of the two Xius, Hong Xiuquan and Yang Xiuqing.

哪晓得越来越不象话，
Who could have foreseen how disgraceful they would become?

天下还没有到手，伦常名教倒已经扫地了。
Before they had even won the empire, they had swept away all the proper bonds of human relations.

什么拜天地不敬父母，什么‘男行’、‘女行’，乌七八糟一大堆。
Worshipping Heaven and Earth while showing no respect for parents, men’s divisions and women’s divisions, and a whole tangle of other nonsense!

现在小刀会刘丽川也在拜天地了，
Now Liu Lichuan of the Small Swords Society is worshipping Heaven and Earth too.

这些情形我也看不惯。
I cannot stomach it.

所以，你如果能劝得武成回心转意，不帮长毛，这就不算在江湖道上的义气有亏缺。
So if you can persuade Wucheng to change his mind and stop helping the Longhairs, there will be no breach of the loyalty we owe one another.

不过，我不晓得你要怎么劝他？
But how do you mean to persuade him?”

““那自然见机行事。
“That must depend on the circumstances.

此刻连我自己都还不晓得该怎么说？”
At present I do not know myself what I shall say.”

谈到这里，就该马上做一件事，派人去把俞武成找来，
The next step was clear: someone must be sent to find Yu Wucheng.

老太爷不知道他此刻在何处？但漕帮的声气甚广，
The Old Master did not know where he was, but the brotherhood’s connections were extensive.

只要交代一句下去，大小码头，旦夕皆知，自会找出人来，
Once word went out, every wharf, large and small, would hear within a day, and someone would find him.

而况俞武成亦非无名小卒，找起来更容易。
Yu was no obscure figure, which made the search easier still.

只是要看他是近是远，
Only the distance was uncertain.

在近处来得快，在远处来得慢，
If he was near, he would come quickly; if far away, more slowly.

日子无法预定。
No date could be fixed.

“我晓得你心里急，不过急也无用，事情是总可以摆平的。”老太爷说，
“I know you are anxious,” the Old Master said, “but haste will not help. We can settle it in the end.

“难得相聚，
We seldom have a chance to be together.

且住两日再说。”
Stay a couple of days.”

“当然，当然。”
“Of course.

胡雪岩说，“多的日子也耽搁下来了，
I have delayed this long already.

不争在这两天。”
Another two days will make no difference.”


他是如此，裘丰言更不在乎，
Hu felt that way, and Qiu was still less concerned.

这一夜照样开怀畅饮，听老太爷谈他当年走南闯北，涉历江湖所遭遇到的奇闻异事，直到深宵不倦。
That night they drank freely as usual, listening tirelessly until late to the Old Master’s tales of strange encounters from his years roaming north and south.

谈来谈去谈到俞武成，
Eventually the conversation returned to Yu Wucheng.

“松江是‘疲帮’，他们那一帮是‘旺帮’，
“Songjiang is an impoverished branch of the brotherhood, while his is a prosperous one.

所以武成在我们这伙人当中，是花花公子，
Among our circle, Wucheng was the dandy.

嫖赌吃着，样样来，样样精。”
Women, gambling, fine food and clothes—he enjoyed them all and knew everything about them.”

老太爷不胜感慨地说，
The old man sighed.

“哪晓得快活了一辈子，老来苦！”
“Who could have imagined that after a lifetime of pleasure, he would suffer in old age?”

“这都是叫长毛害的。”胡雪岩说，
“The Longhairs are to blame,” Hu said.

“不闹长毛，他好好在杨州、镇江，
“Without their rebellion, he could have lived comfortably in Yangzhou and Zhenjiang.

何至于此？
How would he have come to this?

所以俞老跟‘他们’搞在一起，我真弄不懂！”
That is why I cannot understand his dealings with them.”

“老弟台，你见了武成，这些话要当心。
“Be careful with such remarks when you meet him.

他有样坏毛病：不肯认错！
He has one bad fault: he will never admit he is wrong.

不说还好，一说偏偏往错里走。
Leave him alone and there may be hope; tell him he is wrong and he goes still further down the wrong road.

除非他老娘说他，他不敢不听，
Only his mother can rebuke him, and then he dare not disobey.

不然，天王老子说他一句错，他都不服。”
Anyone else, even the Lord of Heaven himself, could tell him he was wrong and he would refuse to accept it.”

“这样看起来，倒是位孝子！”裘丰言说，
“Then he must be a devoted son,” Qiu observed.

“可敬之至。”
“Most admirable.”

“大家敬重他，也就是为此。”
“That is why everyone respects him.

老太爷说，“他今年六十七，到了九十岁的老娘面前，还会撒娇。
He is sixty-seven this year, yet before his ninety-year-old mother he still behaves like a child seeking her affection.

想想也真有趣。”
It is quite amusing.”

“喔！”胡雪岩问：
“Oh!” Hu asked.

“她娘还在？”
“His mother is still alive?”

“还在！”
“Indeed.”

“在镇江？还是扬州？”
“In Zhenjiang or Yangzhou?”

“不！
“Neither.

那两个地方怎么还能住？”
Who could live in those places now?

老太爷说，“搬在苏州。
She has moved to Suzhou.

去年到杭州烧香，路过松江，在我这里住了几日。”
Last year she passed through Songjiang on a pilgrimage to Hangzhou and stayed with me for a few days.”


“九十岁的老太太，还能出远门烧香。
“A lady of ninety, still traveling so far to offer incense?

倒健旺？”
She must be remarkably strong.”

“健旺得很呢！”老太爷说，
“Very strong.

“这位老太太，当年也是好角色。
In her day she was a formidable woman.

俞三叔——武成的老爹，是叫仇家害死的，
Third Uncle Yu—Wucheng’s father—was murdered by an enemy.

她带了一把水果刀找上仇家的门去，
She took a fruit knife and went to the murderer’s door.

见面就是一刀！
As soon as she saw him, she stabbed him.

出来就到衙门，
Then she went straight to the magistrate’s office.

县官倒是好官，说她替夫报仇，当堂开释。
The magistrate was a good man: he said she had avenged her husband and discharged her in court.

那时她还有四月的身孕在身，
She was four months pregnant at the time.

生下来就是武成。”
The child was Wucheng.”

“原来俞老是遗腹子！
“So Elder Yu was born after his father’s death.

怪不得孝顺。”
No wonder he is so devoted to her.”

“他也不敢不孝顺。”
“He would not dare be otherwise.

老太爷又说，“武成后来管帮，也亏得我这位俞三婶。
And it was thanks to this Third Aunt Yu of mine that he later took charge of the branch.

当时俞三叔一死，还没有儿子，
When Third Uncle died, he had no son.

帮中公议，由他家老五代管。
The members agreed that his fifth brother should manage affairs in his place.

遗腹子生下来，如果是女的，不必说，
If the unborn child proved a girl, there was nothing more to say.

是男的，到二十岁，俞老五‘推位让国’。
If a boy, then when he reached twenty, Yu the Fifth was to yield his throne and surrender his realm.

哪晓得俞老五黑心，到时候不肯让出来。
But the man proved black-hearted and refused to step aside when the time came.

又是俞三婶出面，
Once again Third Aunt Yu intervened.

告到僧运总督那里，官司打赢，
She took the case to the Director-General of Grain Transport and won.

武成才能够‘子承父业’。
Only then could Wucheng inherit his father’s position.”

““照此说来，这位老太太对外头的事情，也很明白？”
“Then this old lady understands affairs outside the home very well?”

“当然！
“Of course.

是极明白的人。”
Exceptionally well.”

“也管他们帮里的事吗？”
“Does she also manage their branch’s business?”

“早先管，这几年不大管了。”
“She used to, though not much in recent years.

老太爷又说，“早先不但管他们帮里的事，还管江湖上的闲事，
In the old days she not only managed the branch but intervened in disputes throughout our world.

提起俞三寡妇，真个是响当当的字号。”
The name of Widow Yu the Third commanded respect everywhere.”


就在这一番闲谈之中，胡雪岩已筹划好一条极妥当的计策，
During this conversation Hu had worked out an excellent plan.

不过欲行此计，少不得一个人，先要跟这个人商量好了，才好跟老太爷去谈。
To carry it out, however, he would need one person’s help, and must consult her before speaking to the Old Master.

这个人就是七姑奶奶。
That person was the Seventh Lady.

回到尤家已经深夜，不便惊动。
It was too late to disturb her when he returned to the You house.

第二天一早起身，匆匆漱洗，便唤过来伺候他的小厮，进去通知，立请七姑奶奶有要紧事商量。
Rising early the next morning, he washed hurriedly and summoned the boy attending him, asking him to go inside and tell her that he urgently needed to discuss something important.

七姑奶奶大方得很，说是请胡雪岩、裘丰言到她屋里去谈。
Entirely unselfconscious, she invited both Hu and Qiu to her rooms.

“小姐”的闺房，又有芙蓉在，裘丰言自然不便入内。
Qiu naturally hesitated to enter an unmarried lady’s quarters, especially with Furong there too.

“不要紧！
“It is quite all right,” Hu said.

我们真正是通家之好，
“We really are intimate family friends.

你一起去听听，省得回头我再说一遍。”
Come and listen, and save me having to repeat it afterwards.”

听得这话，裘丰言只好相陪。
Qiu could only accompany him.

到七姑奶奶住的那间屋子，堂屋里已经摆好了一桌早饭，
A breakfast table had already been laid in the outer room.

松江人早餐吃硬饭，裘丰言颇感新奇，
The people of Songjiang ate firm, cooked rice for breakfast, which he found novel.

不但有饭还有酒，这在他倒是得其所哉，
There was wine as well as rice, putting him entirely in his element.

欣然落座，举杯便喝了一大口。
He sat down gladly and took a great mouthful.

“老裘，你少喝点，
“Not too much, Qiu.

今天还有事！”
We have work to do today.”

“什么事？”七姑奶奶接口说道，
“What work?” the Seventh Lady asked.

“裘老爷来，没有啥款待，只有酒。
“We have little else to offer him but wine.

小爷叔，你不要拦他的高兴。
Little Uncle, do not spoil his pleasure.”

““老裘不会不高兴，我一说出来就晓得了。
“He will be pleased enough once he hears what I have to say.

七姐，我问你个人，你晓不晓得？”胡雪岩说，“俞三寡妇！”
Seventh Sister, do you know someone called Widow Yu the Third?”


“是不是俞师叔的老娘？”
“Do you mean Uncle Yu’s mother?”

“对。”
“Yes.”

“现在不叫俞三寡妇了，
“No one calls her Widow Yu the Third now.

大家都叫她三婆婆。
Everyone calls her Third Granny.

我见过的，
I have met her.

去年到松江来，说要收我做干女儿，
When she came to Songjiang last year, she wanted to take me as her sworn daughter.

后来算算辈分不对，才不提起的。”
Then we worked out the generations and found they did not fit, so nothing more was said.”

“好极了！
“Excellent!

照此说，她很喜欢你的。
Then she likes you.

七姐，你要陪我到苏州去一趟。”
Seventh Sister, you must come to Suzhou with me.”

说到这一句，裘丰言恍然大悟，
At this Qiu understood.

高兴地端起一大杯烧酒：
Delighted, he raised a large cup of spirits.

“这下我非浮一大白不可了！”
“Now I really must drink a full cup!”

七姑奶奶和芙蓉，却是莫名其妙，于是胡雪岩约略将俞武成打那票枪械的主意，以及老太爷如何为难的情形，略略谈了些。
The Seventh Lady and Furong were still bewildered, so Hu briefly explained Yu Wucheng’s designs on the rifles and the Old Master’s predicament.

这些七姑奶奶不等他了再讲下去，也就明了他们的用意了。
Before he could go further, the Seventh Lady understood his purpose.

“小爷叔，你是想搬出三婆婆来，硬压俞师叔？”
“Little Uncle, you mean to bring out Third Granny and make her put pressure on Uncle Yu?”

“是的，意思是这个道理。不过有一套做法。”胡雪岩说，
“That is the idea, but it must be done in a particular way.

“我动到这个脑筋，主要的是不让老太爷为难。
My chief purpose is to spare the Old Master embarrassment.

我想这样做，
This is my plan.

你看行不行？”
Tell me whether you think it will work.”

胡雪岩的做法是，备一笔重礼，跟裘丰言俩肃具衣冠，去拜访俞三婆婆，
Hu proposed to prepare a handsome gift, then visit Third Granny Yu with Qiu, both in formal dress.

见面道明来意，要说老太爷因为已经答应了俞武成，不便出尔反尔。
They would explain that the Old Master had already given Yu his word and could not go back on it.

万般无奈，只有来求教俞三婆婆，
With no other course open to them, they had come to ask her advice.

应该怎么办？
What ought they to do?

请她说一句。
Would she tell them?


“人心都是肉做的，
“Everyone has a human heart.

小爷叔这样子尊敬她，我再旁边敲敲边鼓，三婆婆一定肯出面干预。
With Little Uncle showing her such respect, and me putting in a word beside her, Third Granny is sure to intervene.

只要她肯说一句，俞师叔不敢不依。
If she speaks, Uncle Yu dare not disobey.

好的，我准定奉陪，
Certainly I shall go with you.

什么时候走？”
When do we leave?”

“ 我先要跟老太爷谈一谈。
“First I must discuss it with the Old Master.

请你先预备，
Please get ready.

我们说走就走。”
We shall leave at a moment’s notice.”

“我没有啥好预备的。”
“There is nothing I need to prepare.

七姑奶奶说，“倒是送三婆婆的礼，
But what about Third Granny’s present?

小爷叔你是怎么个打算？”
What have you in mind?”

这一层，胡雪岩自燃已有打算，
Hu had already considered that.

分派裘丰言去办，请他当天赶到上海，转告刘不才，采办两支吉林老山人参，另外再配三样宜乎老年人服食使用的礼物，
He assigned the task to Qiu, asking him to reach Shanghai that day and tell Liu Bucai to buy two roots of old wild mountain ginseng from Jilin, together with three other gifts suitable for an elderly person to eat or use.

由裘丰言带到苏州，
Qiu would bring them to Suzhou.

仍旧以阊门外的金阊客栈为联络聚集的地点。
Once again, Jinchang Inn outside Chang Gate would serve as their meeting place and point of contact.


于是，裘丰言跟着胡雪岩到了老太爷那里，
Qiu accompanied Hu to the Old Master’s house.

开口说到“辞行”，老太爷不解所谓，深为诧异。
When they began to take their leave, the old man was greatly surprised and did not understand.

“我想到了一个办法，可以免得你老人家在俞老面前为难。”胡雪岩说。
“I have thought of a way to spare you embarrassment with Elder Yu,” Hu explained.

“我跟老裘，好比焦赞、孟良，预备把余太君去搬请出来。
“Qiu and I shall be like Jiao Zan and Meng Liang, going to enlist the help of Old Lady Yu.

不过你老要跟我们唱出双簧。”
But you must play your part in our double act.”

这出双簧，在老太爷这面轻而易举，
The Old Master’s part was simple.

只要找了俞武成来，当面跟他说明：胡、裘二人，上门重托，他因为答应俞武成在先，已经拒绝。
Once Yu arrived, he was to tell him that Hu and Qiu had come with an urgent request, but that he had refused because he had already given Yu his word.

同时告诉他，说俞三婆婆派人来寻过，留下了话，叫他立即赶回苏州，有紧急大事要谈。
He must also say that Third Granny Yu had sent someone looking for him, leaving instructions that he return to Suzhou at once to discuss a matter of great urgency.

听胡雪岩讲完，老太爷兜头一揖：
Having heard the plan, the old man bowed deeply.

“老弟台，你这条计策，帮了我的大忙，
“My young friend, this scheme will be a tremendous help.

保全了我们白头老弟兄的交情，
You have preserved the friendship between two old, white-haired brothers.

感激之至。
I am deeply grateful.

不过虽拿余太君把他压了下去，他的难处也要替他想想，
But though Old Lady Yu can bring him to heel, we must consider his difficulties too.

这归我来办。
Leave that to me.

你们不必管了。”
You need not trouble yourselves.”

“这也没有叫老太爷劳神的道理。”
“There is no reason to burden you with that either.

胡雪岩说，“老实奉告，洋枪上是有一笔回扣的，
To be frank, there is a commission on the foreign rifles.

我们就拿这笔钱交俞老一个朋友，
We shall use it to make a friend of Elder Yu.

在苏州见着了他，我当面跟他谈，
When I meet him in Suzhou, I shall speak to him myself.

一定可以摆平。
I am sure we can settle it.

反正你老只要假装糊涂好了。”
You need only pretend to know nothing.”

“装糊涂我会。”
“That I can do.

老太爷问道：“你们啥时候动身？”
When do you leave?”

“装就要装得象。
“We must make the pretence convincing.

我们明天就走，回头也不再到你老这里来了。
We leave tomorrow and shall not call on you again before then.

怕一见俞老，反而不好。”
It would be awkward if we happened to meet Elder Yu.”

“既然这样说，我就不留你们了。
“In that case I shall not keep you.

不过，在苏州把事情说妥当了，无论如何再要到松江来往两天。”
But once everything is settled in Suzhou, you must return to Songjiang and stay a couple of days.”

“一定，一定！”
“Certainly!”


两人辞了出来，裘丰言当即动身到上海。
They took their leave, and Qiu set out for Shanghai immediately.

胡雪岩心里在想，意料不到的，又有苏州之行。
Hu reflected that an unforeseen turn of events was taking him to Suzhou yet again.

既然有此机会，阿巧姐的纠葛，应该理个清楚，
Since he had the opportunity, he ought to untangle the affair with A’qiao.

巧的是有芙蓉，大可以拿她作个挡箭牌。
Fortunately, Furong was with him and could serve very well as a shield.

因此，回到尤家，他问芙蓉：“你要不要到苏州去玩一趟？”
Back at the You house, he asked, “Would you like to visit Suzhou?”

“我懒得动，
“I cannot be bothered to move.

而况你们两三天就回来了，尤五嫂跟我也很谈得来，
Besides, you will be back in two or three days, and Fifth Sister-in-Law and I get on very well.

我就一动不如一静了。”
I might as well stay where I am.”

做女主人的，也在殷勤留客，
Their hostess also urged her to remain.

胡雪岩当着尤五嫂的面，不便多说什么，只好向七姑奶奶使个眼色。
Unable to explain in Mrs You’s presence, Hu could only give the Seventh Lady a meaningful glance.

这个眼色用意，不易了解，七姑奶奶心直，当时就说：
Its meaning was not easy to grasp, and she spoke with her usual directness.

“小爷叔，你有话尽管说，
“Little Uncle, say whatever you want.

怕啥？”
What are you afraid of?”

“七姐！”胡雪岩无可奈何，只好这样说：“你请过来，
Helpless, he could only reply, “Seventh Sister, come here a moment.

我有句话说。”一说自然明白，
I have something to tell you.” Once he explained, she understood.

七姑奶奶也认为芙蓉跟着到了苏州，阿巧姐一见，当然什么话都说不出口，
If Furong went with him and A’qiao saw her, the latter could scarcely say anything.

这是个极好的挡箭牌。
It was an excellent shield.

于是悄悄劝尤五嫂，不必强留。
She quietly persuaded Mrs You not to insist on keeping her guest.

至于芙蓉，听说有此关系，随即也改了主意，愿意跟七姑奶奶作伴到苏州。
Furong too changed her mind when she heard the reason and agreed to accompany the Seventh Lady to Suzhou.

于是连夜收拾行李，第二天一早下船，
They packed that night and boarded their boat early the next morning.

一行四众，胡雪岩和两位堂客之外，另外带了个后生，名叫阿土，
There were four in the party: Hu, the two women, and a young man named A’tu.

他曾奉了尤五的命令，到苏州去送过俞三婆婆的寿礼，所以带着他做“向导”。
He had once been sent to Suzhou by You with birthday presents for Third Granny Yu, so they took him as their guide.


到了苏州可热闹了，
Suzhou proved a lively gathering place.

在金阊栈的，有原来住在那里的周一鸣，随后来的裘丰言，还有跟了来“轧闹猛”的刘不才，
At Jinchang Inn they found Zhou Yiming, who had been staying there all along, Qiu, who had arrived afterwards, and Liu Bucai, who had come along to join in the excitement.

分住了两座院落，却都集中在胡雪岩那里，听他发号施令。
They occupied two courtyards, but everyone assembled in Hu’s rooms to receive his instructions.

“七姐！你带着阿土是第一拨，
“Seventh Sister, you and A’tu will go first.

见着三婆婆，先替我们问好，再说要去拜访她。
Give Third Granny our regards and tell her that we wish to call.

如果她问：为什么不跟着你去？你就说怕她嫌我们冒昧不见。
If she asks why we did not come with you, say we feared she might think us presumptuous and decline to see us.

然后问她，明天一早去见她，行不行？
Then ask whether we may visit early tomorrow.

她若是允了，你就派阿土回来通知。”
If she agrees, send A’tu back to tell us.”

“我晓得了。
“I understand.

小爷叔，”七姑奶奶问道，“三婆婆一定会问，为啥要去看她，
But she is certain to ask why you want to see her.

我怎么说？”
What shall I say?”

“你只说我们寻俞老寻不着，只好来见三婆婆，
“Only that we have been unable to find Elder Yu, so we must come to her.

她若问起寻俞老又是何事？你只说不晓得，不过决无恶意。”
If she asks what we want with him, say you do not know, but that we certainly mean no harm.”

“好的，我懂了。”
“Very well.”

七姑奶奶说完，立刻带着阿土离去。
She set off with A’tu at once.

“老周！你即刻上观前去一趟，替我办一身七品服色！从上到下，全套都要。
“Zhou, go to Guanqian immediately and get me a full set of seventh-rank official dress, from head to foot.”

““啊呀！”裘丰言说，
“Oh dear!” Qiu exclaimed.

“我也没有带袍褂来。”
“I have not brought my formal robes either.”

“那容易，
“Easily settled.

一共办两身。”
Get two sets.”

等周一鸣一起，胡雪岩对刘不才说，
As soon as Zhou left, Hu turned to Liu.

“三爷，如今是你的差使了！
“Third Master, now for your assignment.

你身上多带些钱，进城到花家柳巷去走走，挑个最好的地方‘开盘子’，
Take plenty of money, go into the pleasure quarters, choose the best establishment, and begin patronising it.

要做阔客！”
You must make an impression as a wealthy customer.”


“你倒好！”
“There you go!”

芙蓉先就埋怨了，
Furong complained at once.

“一到就不叫三叔干好事。”
“No sooner have we arrived than you set Third Uncle to no good.”

“好事坏事，不去说它！”刘不才问道，
“Never mind whether it is good or bad,” Liu said.

“这是为了啥？你说了，我心里好有个数。”
“Tell me what it is for, so I know what I am doing.”

“是为了过几天好请客。”
“We shall need to entertain a guest in a few days.

胡雪岩说：“听说俞武成是个‘老白相’，嫖赌吃着，式式精通，
I hear Yu Wucheng is an old hand at pleasure: women, gambling, fine food and clothes—he knows every one of them thoroughly.

等他一来，我就把他交给你了！”
Once he arrives, I shall leave him in your care.”

“这一说，倒是我来对了！
“Then I came at just the right time!

你放心，你放心，
Do not worry.

等他一来，归我招呼，
I shall look after him when he comes.

包管他服服帖帖！”
I guarantee he will be perfectly amenable.”

说完，刘不才高高兴兴地走了。
Liu went off delighted.

调兵遣将已毕，胡雪岩笑着对芙蓉和裘丰言说：
His forces deployed, Hu turned with a smile to Furong and Qiu.

“今天没有事了，
“There is nothing more to do today.

我们到哪里去逛逛？”
Where shall we go for a look round?”

“算了，算了！”裘丰言说，
“Never mind that,” Qiu said.

“等事情办妥了，再去逛也不迟。”
“There will be time enough once the business is settled.”

“咦！”胡雪岩问道：“你一向是天塌下来都不担心的人，
“Why, you never worry even if the sky falls.

这回怎么放不下心来？”
Why are you so anxious this time?”

“彼一时也，此一时也！”裘丰言说，
“Different times call for different responses.

“这件事，我通前彻后想过了，
I have thought this through from beginning to end.

不全是江湖道上的事，
It is not simply a matter of brotherhood affairs.

有长毛夹在里头，
The Longhairs are involved.

只怕俞老身不由己！”
Elder Yu may not be free to act as he wishes.”

这一说，胡雪岩矍然而起，
Hu sprang up in alarm.

“你的话对，
“You are right.

不可不妨！”
We must guard against that.”

他想了想又说，“事不宜迟，
He considered, then added, “There is no time to lose.

赶快给松江写封信回去。
We must write to Songjiang at once.

老裘，你来动笔！”
Qiu, you must write the letter.”


这是裘丰言责无旁贷的事，
This was plainly Qiu’s responsibility.

一面亲自搬出文房四宝来，一面问胡雪岩，这封信如何写法？
He brought out the writing materials himself and asked what the letter should say.

信中拜托老太爷，等俞武成到了松江，务必设法探明跟赖汉英那方面订下了怎样的约定，原来的计划是如何动手？
They asked the Old Master, once Yu reached Songjiang, to discover exactly what arrangement he had made with Lai Hanying and how the interception was originally to be carried out.

还有最要紧的一层，俞武成是不是自己在赖汉英的挟制胁迫之下，有身不由主的模样？
Most important of all, was Yu himself under Lai’s control or coercion, unable to act freely?

刚把信写完，阿土已经回到客栈，跑得气喘吁吁地说：
Just as they finished, A’tu returned to the inn, breathless from running.

“七姑奶奶叫我赶紧回来通知，三婆婆的孙子，马上要来拜会，
“The Seventh Lady sent me to tell you at once: Third Granny’s grandson is coming to call.

他是个‘总爷’。”
He is a ‘Captain.’”

绿营武官中有‘千总“、”把总“的名目，是低级武官，所以老百姓见了绿营兵丁，都尊称一声”总爷“。
The Green Standard forces had junior ranks called qianzong and bazong, and civilians accordingly addressed even ordinary soldiers as “Captain.”

胡雪岩觉得这不值得重视，
Hu attached little importance to the title.

倒是三婆婆有此礼遇的表示，自然是肯接见了，值得高兴。
What pleased him was Third Granny’s courtesy: it plainly meant she was willing to receive them.

“好的，
“Good.

我知道了。”
I understand.”

他想了一想，认为阿土在苏州已无用处，正好派他回去送信，
On reflection, A’tu was no longer needed in Suzhou and could carry the letter back.

“阿土，我烦你立刻回松江，拿这封信送给老太爷。
“A’tu, please return to Songjiang at once and deliver this to the Old Master.

你跟老太爷说，信中所谈的事，一有结果，立刻给我回信。
Tell him to reply immediately when he has an answer to the questions in it.

就劳驾你再辛苦一趟。”说着，又喊芙蓉，取出十两银子送他做盘缠。
I must trouble you to make another journey.” He then called Furong and had her give A’tu ten taels for his traveling expenses.


就这时，只见金阊栈的伙计引进一名武官来，后面还跟着四名马弁。
Just then an attendant brought in a military officer, followed by four mounted orderlies.

一看这气派，不象“总爷”、胡雪岩眼尖，赶紧向裘丰言说道：“是个水晶顶子。”
His bearing suggested more than a mere “Captain.” Sharp-eyed Hu quickly told Qiu, “He has a crystal button on his cap.”

顶戴用水晶，是五品官员，
That denoted fifth rank.

裘丰言失声说道：“啊！是守备。
“Ah, a garrison commander!” Qiu exclaimed.

糟了，
“This is awkward.

便衣接见，似乎失礼。”
Receiving him in ordinary dress seems discourteous.”

失礼也无可补救了，
It was too late to remedy the omission.

只见伙计已经高举名帖，拉长了声音唱道：“俞老爷拜！”
Holding the visiting card high, the attendant announced in a drawn-out voice, “Master Yu calls!”

裘丰言比较熟于官场仪注，拉一拉胡雪岩，掀开门帘，踱着方步，迎到外屋，
More familiar with official ceremony, Qiu tugged at Hu, lifted the curtain, and walked out with measured steps to receive their visitor in the outer room.

只见“俞老爷”带着马弁站在门外，
Master Yu and his orderlies were standing beyond the doorway.

便闪开了视线，从伙计手里接过名帖来看，
Qiu averted his gaze and took the card from the attendant.

上面写的是：“侍晚俞少武顿首拜。”
It read, “Your junior, Yu Shaowu, bows his head in greeting.”

不用说，是俞武成的儿子。
Clearly this was Yu Wucheng’s son.

“不敢当，不敢当！
“We are unworthy of the honour!

请你替我们挡俞老爷的驾，
Please ask Master Yu to wait.

身在客边，未带公服，不敢亵慢！”
Traveling away from home, we have brought no official dress and dare not receive him with such disrespect.”

伙计还未接话，俞少武已经跨了进来，
Before the attendant could answer, Yu stepped in.

两手一挥，将马蹄袖放了下来，接着便请了个安。
With a sweep of his hands he lowered his horseshoe-shaped cuffs and made the formal kneeling salutation.

虽说武职官儿品级不值钱，到底受之有愧，
Military ranks might count for little, but they still felt unworthy of receiving such respect.

所以胡雪岩和裘丰言都觉得相当尴尬。
Both Hu and Qiu were considerably embarrassed.


幸好，俞少武不叙官阶叙世谊，
Fortunately, Yu appealed to old family ties rather than official rank.

站起来口称：“两位老世叔！”他说，
Rising, he addressed them as “my honoured uncles.”

“家祖母特意命少武来请安。
“My grandmother has specifically sent me to pay her respects.

家祖母的意思，不敢劳动两位老世叔光降，
She feels she cannot presume to trouble you to visit her.

有什么吩咐，告诉少武就是了。”
If you have any instructions, please give them to me.”

“是，是！”裘丰言拱手答道：
“Certainly, certainly!” Qiu replied with clasped hands.

“世兄，诸先坐了叙说。
“My young friend, please sit and let us talk.

敝姓裘，
My surname is Qiu.

这位是雪岩兄！”
This is Brother Xueyan.”

彼此重薪又见了礼，坐定攀谈，
They exchanged fresh courtesies and sat down.

裘丰言有一番官场中请教“功名”的话头，
Qiu made the customary official inquiries about Yu’s qualifications.

这才知道，俞少武是一名武进士，授职守备，派在两江“督标”当差。
He learned that Yu had passed the highest military examination, been appointed a garrison commander, and been assigned to the Governor-General of Liangjiang’s headquarters forces.

督标中军知道他是漕帮子弟，
The commander of those forces knew that he came from the Grain Transport Brotherhood.

又见他仪容出众，言语灵便，特为报请总督，行文兵部，将他补了一名“提塘官”，
Impressed by his fine appearance and ready speech, he had specially recommended him to the governor-general, who wrote to the Board of War and secured his appointment as capital dispatch officer.

专驻京城，接理两江总督衙门的奏折呈递事宜。
Stationed in Beijing, he handled the submission of memorials from the Liangjiang governor-general’s office.

最近是请假回籍省亲，还有个把月的勾留。
He had recently taken leave to visit his family and would remain for another month or so.

“原来世兄是科甲出身！
“So you earned your rank through the examinations!

真正失敬之至。”
I have failed to show you proper respect.”

裘丰言翘一翘大拇指，
Qiu raised a thumb.

“英雄出少年。如今亦正是英雄的时势，
“Heroes arise among the young, and these are times for heroes.

前程如锦，
Your prospects are splendid.

可喜可贺。”
My congratulations!”


等到寒暄告一段落，俞少武重申来意，请示有何吩咐！
When the courtesies were over, Yu repeated the purpose of his visit and asked what they required.

这是谈到了正经上头，裘丰言使个眼色，让胡雪岩回答。
Now that they had reached the real business, Qiu gave Hu a glance, leaving him to answer.

“有件事，要请教令尊。
“There is something on which we need your father’s advice.

只为令尊行踪不定，特意来求三婆婆。”
Since his movements are uncertain, we have come to ask Third Granny.

胡雪岩说：“未尽道理，不便启齿，
We cannot properly begin without first paying our respects.

我想烦世兄回去禀告令诅母，我跟裘兄准定明天一早，登堂拜谒，
Please tell your grandmother that Qiu and I will certainly call early tomorrow.

务必请三婆婆容我们晚辈，有个申诉的机会。”
We beg her to allow us, her juniors, an opportunity to put our case.”
