Fearing that Hu might refuse to venture so far into the tiger’s den, he had also prepared an alternative venue: a private brothel in the busy part of Tongli.

内中有一双坠溷的姊妹花，妹妹叫妙珠，姐姐叫妙珍，
Two sisters who had fallen into prostitution lived there, the younger named Miaozhu and the elder Miaozhen.

是跷脚长根的禁脔。
Miaozhen was Changgen’s exclusive mistress.

她家跟朱老大家一样，开出后门，就是河埠，
Like Zhu’s house, theirs had a landing just outside the back door.

半夜里绑架落船，人不知，鬼不觉。
The captives could be bundled into a boat in the middle of the night without anyone knowing.

这消息太可惊了，但也太可疑了，
The report was astonishing, but also highly doubtful.

胡雪岩实在不能相信，
Hu could scarcely believe it.

因为这样做法，在江湖上来说，是异常“伤道”的，
Such conduct would be a grave violation of the brotherhoods’ code.

跷脚长根纠有此心，部署一定异常机密，
If Changgen intended it, his preparations must be extremely secret.

如何轻易能让周一鸣打听得到？
How could Zhou have discovered them so easily?

“我也是这么想。”听胡雪岩提出疑问以后，刘不才这样答道，
“I thought the same,” Liu replied when Hu raised the question.

“但老周说得斩钉截铁，消息万分可靠。
“But Old Zhou is adamant that the information is completely reliable.

他又说，这也是无意中遇到一个知道内幕的人，
He says he happened to meet someone who knew the inside story.

他承认事情太巧，说是你鸿运当头，才有这种逢凶化吉的机遇。”
He admits it was an extraordinary coincidence, but says your luck is running high: that is why you have this chance to escape disaster.”

“那好！
“Very well.

这一试就试出来了。
We can test it easily enough.

你说，那私门头姐妹叫什么名字？”
What did you say the sisters were called?”

“妙珍，妙珠。”
“Miaozhen and Miaozhu.”


胡雪岩点点头，四面一望，
Hu nodded and looked around.

窗前就是书桌，有副笔砚，
A writing desk stood by the window, with a brush and inkstone.

砚台尘封，墨剩了半段，拔出笔架上的笔来看，笔锋已秃，
The inkstone was covered in dust, only half an inkstick remained, and the brush he took from its rack had a worn-out point.

这都只得将就了，
They would have to make do.

他亲自倒了点茶汁在砚台中，一面磨墨，一面招手将刘不才唤到跟前，
He poured a little tea into the inkstone himself, began grinding the ink, and beckoned Liu closer.

低声说过：“你随便找张纸，替我写下来，
“Find any scrap of paper,” he said softly, “and write this for me.

写一句话好了：不在长根家，就在妙珍家。”
Just one sentence: ‘If not at Changgen’s, then at Miaozhen’s.’”

说着，他走到门外去替刘不才“望风”。
He went outside to keep watch.

急切间就是找不到纸，
In his haste Liu could find no paper.

情急智生，刘不才将一方雪白的杭纺手绢，铺在桌上，提笔写了那十个字，然后折了起来，交到胡雪岩手里，他很慎重地藏在贴肉小褂子的口袋里。
Necessity supplied an idea: he spread a snow-white Hangzhou silk handkerchief on the table, wrote the ten characters, folded it, and handed it to Hu, who carefully hid it in the pocket of his underjacket next to his skin.

这一来，胡雪岩就改了主意，
Hu now changed his plans.

托词想睡午觉，把自己关在屋子里，筹划应付可能会有的这一番意外变化，
Claiming that he wanted an afternoon nap, he shut himself in his room to consider how to meet this possible and unexpected turn of events.

刘不才则在主人的安排下，上了牌桌。
Liu meanwhile joined the gaming table arranged by their host.

到了四点多钟吃点心的时候，俞武成回来了，一来便问胡雪岩。
Shortly after four, when refreshments were being served, Yu returned and immediately asked for Hu.

他倒是真的睡着了，
By then Hu had actually fallen asleep.

为朱老大唤醒，请到水阁跟俞武成见面。
Zhu woke him and invited him to the waterside pavilion to meet Yu.


“我去看了跷脚长根，
“I have seen Changgen.

他听说你来了，很高兴，明天晚上替你接风，详谈一切。”俞武成说，
He was delighted to hear you had come, and wants to give you a welcoming dinner tomorrow evening, when you can discuss everything in detail,” Yu said.

“我把你的话都告诉了他，
“I told him all you said.

他也很体谅，藩库已不比从前，
He quite understands that the provincial treasury is not what it once was.

一个月的恩饷，对弟兄也总算有了交代。”
A month’s gratuity will at least give the men something to show for it.”

俞武成说得很起劲，胡雪岩却显得相当冷淡，
Yu spoke enthusiastically, but Hu was noticeably cool.

平静地问道：“他预备请我在哪里吃饭？”
He asked calmly, “Where does he intend to give me dinner?”

“主随客便！”俞武成说，
“Wherever suits the guest.

“如果你不嫌路远，就到他那里，
If you do not mind the journey, you can go to his house.

他住在平望，说远也不远。
He lives at Pingwang, which is not really so far away.

不然，就在同里，
Otherwise, here in Tongli.

他有个老相好是这里出名的私门头，
He has a long-standing mistress here, a well-known private courtesan.

名叫？”他敲敲自己的额角，
Her name is—” He tapped his forehead.

“这两年的记性坏了，
“My memory has grown poor these last two years.

怎么一下子就想不起？”
Why has it suddenly escaped me?”

“是不是叫妙珍？”
“Is it Miaozhen?”

“妙珍，妙珍！”俞武成一叠连声地：
“Miaozhen, yes, Miaozhen!

“老胡，你怎么知道？”
Old Hu, how did you know?”

“大哥！”胡雪岩用极冷静的声音答道：“我给你看样东西。”
“Brother,” Hu answered in an exceptionally cool voice, “I shall show you something.”

不用说，就是刘不才的那块杭纺手绢，
It was, of course, Liu’s silk handkerchief.

展开来铺在桌上，潦潦草草十个大字：“不在长根家，就在妙珍家。”
Hu spread it on the table, revealing the ten large, hastily written characters: “If not at Changgen’s, then at Miaozhen’s.”

“老胡，”俞武成疑云满面，“这，这是啥讲究？”
Yu’s face clouded with suspicion. “Old Hu, what does this mean?”

胡雪岩不答他的话，只顾自己说：
Hu did not answer, but continued with his own point.

“大哥，今天我们同船合命，
“Brother, we are in the same boat now, with our lives bound together.

有哈话你无论如何不能瞒我！”
Whatever you know, you must not conceal it from me.”

看他面色凝重，俞武成便知内中大有文章，而且事机可能非常急迫，
His grave expression told Yu that there was much behind this, and that the situation might be urgent.

于是拉着他的膀子说：“来，来！
Taking Hu’s arm, he said, “Come.

到我房间里去谈。”
Let us talk in my room.”


朱老大为他师父预备的住处，不但讲究，而且严密，是个花木扶疏的小院落，北面三间平房，
The quarters Zhu had prepared for his master were not only elegant but secure: a little courtyard thick with flowers and trees, with three single-storey rooms along its northern side.

俞武成往在最里面那一间，
Yu occupied the innermost room.

引客入内，在一张临窗的红木小圆桌旁边坐下，脸朝着外，窗外若是有人经过，绝逃不脱他的视、
He led Hu inside and sat beside a small round rosewood table at the window, facing outwards so that nobody passing could escape his notice.

其实这是顾虑，
The precaution was really unnecessary.

从开始筹划要动那票洋枪开始，这三间精舍，便成了禁地，
Ever since the plot to seize the foreign guns had begun, these three fine rooms had been forbidden ground.

除却朱老大和杨凤毛以外，什么人都不敢擅自入内的。
Apart from Zhu and Yang, nobody dared enter without permission.

“老胡，我想你一定另外有路子！”俞武成说，
“Old Hu, I imagine you must have another channel of information,” Yu said.

“既然你说同船合命，你那边如果另有打算，也不要瞒我。”
“Since you say our lives are bound together, do not keep it from me if your side has other plans.”

真是“光棍眼，赛夹剪”，一下就看出端倪来了，
A worldly man’s eyes were sharper than shears: he had seen the clue at once.

胡雪岩自然不肯再隐瞒，
Hu naturally concealed it no longer.

“另外打算是没有，
“We have no other plans.

另外有路子，倒是真的。
Another channel of information, yes.

不过这条路，来得也意外，
But that too came about unexpectedly.

回头我当然一五一十都要告诉大哥你听。”
I shall tell you every detail presently.”

他停了一下说：
He paused.

“我先请问大哥一句话，
“First let me ask you something.

跷脚长根为人怎么样？
What sort of man is Changgen?

跟大哥的交情够不够？”
Are his ties with you strong enough?”

“要说他为人，向来是有心计的，
“He has always been a schemer.

外号‘赛吴用’，
His nickname is ‘Outdoing Wu Yong.’

至于跟我的交情，那就难说了。”
As for his ties with me, that is harder to say.”

“怎么呢？”
“Why?”

“我跟他本人交情不算深，不过，他的‘前人’跟我一辈，
“I am not particularly close to him personally, but his master belonged to my generation.

叫做‘金毛狗炳奎’。
He was called Bingkui, the Golden-haired Dog.

我救过金毛狗的性命，这话一时也说不清楚。”俞武成紧接着说：
I once saved his life; that is too long a story to tell now.

“长根是金毛狗最喜欢的一个徒弟，
Changgen was one of his favourite disciples.

金毛狗临死的时候，关照徒弟：俞某人的恩，我今生是无法报答了！
On his deathbed, the Golden-haired Dog told his disciples, ‘I cannot repay my debt to Yu in this life.

将来你们见了他，就当见了我一样。
Whenever you see him in future, you must treat him as you would me.’

等他的徒弟点头答应了，金毛狗才咽的气。
Only after they nodded their assent did he breathe his last.

所以他的徒弟都叫我俞师父，长根也就是为此，才来找我帮忙。”
That is why his disciples all call me Master Yu, and why Changgen came to me for help.”


“这样说，此人就是‘欺师灭祖’了！”
“Then this man is betraying his master and dishonouring his forebears!”

听这一说，俞武成骇然，
Yu was appalled.

这四个字是他们帮中极严重的恶行，
Within their brotherhood, that was an accusation of the gravest misconduct.

犯者“三刀六洞”，决不容情，
An offender faced the punishment of “three knife thrusts, six holes,” without mercy.

所以俞武成神情紧张，一时竟无法开口了。
Yu grew so tense that for a moment he could not speak.

“大哥，你大概不大相信？”
“You probably find it hard to believe, brother?”

“是的。”
“Yes.”

俞武成慢慢点着头，
Yu nodded slowly.

“跷脚长根脚一跷就是一个主意，
“Every time Changgen lifts his lame leg, he has another scheme.

我也不相信他是什么好人。
I do not suppose he is a good man.

不过，老胡，江湖上不讲义气，也要讲利害，
But even if a man ignores loyalty, he must consider the consequences.

他做了‘初一’，不怕我做‘初二’？”
If he acts on the first day, does he not fear what I may do on the second?”

“你做初一，我做初二”，是与“君子报仇，三年不晚”大同小异的说法。大同者有仇必报，小异者时间不同，
“You act on the first, and I shall act on the second” was much like “Three years is not too late for a gentleman to take revenge.” Both promised retaliation; the difference lay in the timing.

一个是“三年不晚”，一个是初一吃了亏，初二就要找场。
One allowed three years, while the other demanded redress the very day after an injury.

俞武成的话问得自然有道理，不过胡雪岩也可以解释，
Yu’s question was reasonable, but Hu could answer it.

诚如他自己所说的，“不讲义气，讲利害”，
As Yu himself had said, a man who ignored loyalty would still consider advantage and danger.

跷脚长根认为俞武成已经失势，
Changgen believed that Yu had lost his power.

“虎落平阳被犬欺”，无足为奇，
A tiger brought down to the plains might be bullied by dogs; there was nothing surprising about it.

只是这知不便直说，怕俞武成听了伤心。
Hu could not put that bluntly, however, for fear of hurting him.

“大哥的话是不错。”他这样答道：
“You are right, brother,” he replied.

“跷脚长根已经预备逃到那方面去了，
“But Changgen is already preparing to flee to the other side.

当然不怕大哥做初二。”
Naturally, he is not afraid of your acting on the second day.”

“逃得了和尚，逃不了庙……”“跟他算帐是以后的事。”
“The monk may escape, but his temple cannot—” “Settling accounts with him comes later.”

胡雪岩有些着急，抢着开口，将话题拉了回来，
Growing impatient, Hu interrupted and brought him back to the point.

“我们先谈眼前，
“First we must deal with what is before us.

这消息宁可信其有，不可信其无。”
It is safer to believe this warning than to dismiss it.”


俞武成摇摇头，
Yu shook his head.

“不是什么信不信！
“It is not a question of belief.

要弄清楚，这个消息真不真？”
We must establish whether the information is true.”

他抬头逼视着胡雪岩问：
He looked up and fixed Hu with a searching gaze.

“你这个消息哪里来的？”
“Where did you hear it?”

“有个姓周的湖南人，
“From a Hunan man named Zhou.

从前在水师衙门做过事，水路上的情形很熟悉，
He used to work at a naval yamen and knows the waterways well.

是他得来的消息。”
He obtained the information.”

“能不能请来见个面？”
“Can you bring him here for us to meet?”

“当然可以。
“Of course.

我托刘三爷去找他。”
I shall ask Third Master Liu to fetch him.”

于是将刘水才从牌桌子上拉了下来，
Liu was summoned from the gaming table.

胡雪岩当着俞武成的面，把任务告诉了他，特意说明是俞武成要跟周一鸣见面。
In Yu’s presence Hu explained the errand, taking particular care to say that it was Yu who wanted to meet Zhou.

这是个暗示，
This was a hint.

周一鸣一定会想得到是怎么回事，该当如何答复，便好早作准备。
Zhou would surely understand what had happened and could prepare his answers in advance.

在等待的工夫中，俞武成将杨凤毛、朱老大都找了来，关门密议，宣布了周一鸣所得来的消息，
While they waited, Yu sent for Yang and Zhu, closed the door, and told them what Zhou had discovered.

杨凤毛跟朱老大的看法不同，一个信以为真，一个说靠不住。
They disagreed: Yang believed the report, while Zhu thought it unreliable.

说靠不住的是朱老大，他的理由是，妙珍、妙珠这双姐妹的香巢每日户限为穿，人来人在不知有多少，
Zhu argued that so many people visited the sisters Miaozhen and Miaozhu every day that their threshold was almost worn through.

众目昭彰之下，根本不能干那种绑架的事。
With all those eyes about, such an abduction would be impossible.

而且，她家后门那段河面，离码头不远，整夜有船只来往，
Besides, the river behind their house was close to the wharf, with boats coming and going throughout the night.

要想悄悄将俞武成、胡雪岩弄上船，运出水关，也不是轻而易举的。
Quietly putting Yu and Hu aboard a boat and carrying them out through the water gate would be no easy matter.


“你是小开出身，
“You were brought up as a rich man’s son.

没有经过这种花样。”杨凤毛平静地驳他，
You have never experienced this sort of trick,” Yang countered calmly.

“只要他起了这种心思，办法多得很。
“Once he sets his mind on it, there are any number of ways.

说实话，跷脚长根这个人，照我看就是魏延，脑有反骨。
To tell the truth, I see Changgen as another Wei Yan, with the traitor’s bone in his skull.

事情有七、八分是真的，
The story is seven or eight parts true out of ten.

幸亏周朋友的消息得来得早，我们还好想法子防备，
Fortunately, our friend Zhou brought us the news early, so we still have time to take precautions.

不过，也难！”
Even so, it will be difficult.”

“怎么呢？”俞武成说，
“Why?” Yu asked.

“你说出来，向胡大叔讨教。”
“Say what you mean and ask Uncle Hu’s advice.”

“胡大叔！”杨凤毛问道：“你老看，是软做，还是硬做？”
“Uncle Hu, do you think we should take a gentle approach or a forceful one?”

“怎么叫软做？”
“What do you mean by a gentle approach?”

“软做是当场戳穿他的把戏，劝他不要这样子做！”
“Expose his trick when we meet and persuade him not to proceed.”

“不好，不好！”
“No, no!”

俞武成大摇其头，
Yu shook his head vigorously.

“这样子软法，越让他看得我们不值钱。
“That sort of softness will only make him despise us.

而且他真的敢这样做，就是生了一副狼心狗肺，
If he really dares do this, he has the heart of a wolf and the guts of a dog.

你跟他说人话，他哪里会听？”
Why would he listen to human reason?”

“这话说得是。
“That is true.

软做怕没有用。”胡雪岩又说，
A gentle approach may be useless,” Hu said.

“不过硬做要做得漂亮。
“But if we use force, it must be done properly.

最要紧的是，先把证据抓在手里。
The first and most important thing is to get the evidence into our hands.”

““着啊！”
“Exactly!”

杨凤毛拍看大腿说，
Yang slapped his thigh.

“胡大叔的话，一滴水落在油瓶里，
“Uncle Hu has put the drop straight into the oil bottle.

再准不过。
Nothing could be more precise.

硬做的办法很多，就是要看证据说话。”
There are plenty of ways to act forcefully, but everything depends on the evidence.”

“怎么样抓证据，我们回头再说。”俞武成问：
“We can discuss how to obtain evidence later,” Yu said.

“你先说，硬做有几个做法？”
“First tell us what forceful measures you propose.”

杨凤毛很奇怪地，却又踌躇不语，
Strangely, Yang hesitated and fell silent.

他师父连连催问，才将他的话逼出来：“我的办法不妥当！”
Only after repeated urging from his master did he admit, “My plan will not do.”

为来为去是为了证据，
It all came back to evidence.

照杨凤毛的设计，俞武成和胡雪岩要先入牢宠再设法跳出来，才可以抓得住跷脚长根犯罪的真凭实据。
His scheme required Yu and Hu to enter the trap first and then find a way out, thereby obtaining solid proof of Changgen’s crime.

万一配合得不凑手，跳不出来，反激起长根的杀机，
If their coordination failed, they might be unable to escape and might instead provoke Changgen into killing them.

那就神仙都难救了。
Then even an immortal could not save them.


相谈尚无结论，刘不才却陪着周一鸣到了，
Before they reached any conclusion, Liu arrived with Zhou.

他在胡雪岩面前，身分低一等，但对俞武成师弟而言，却同样是朋友，
Zhou stood below Hu in status, but with Yu and his disciples he was a friend on equal terms.

而且有了那个消息，等于已嘉惠俞武成，
Moreover, by bringing the warning he had already done Yu a great service.

所以他们师弟对他很客气，着买敷衍了一阵，才谈到正题。
They therefore treated him with marked courtesy, and some time passed in polite conversation before they came to the point.

话当然要由胡雪岩来问：
Naturally, Hu had to put the question.

“老周，你那个消息，很有点道理。
“Old Zhou, your information makes a good deal of sense.

不过其中也不能说没有疑问。
Still, there are questions about it.

这件事关系太大，非要弄清楚不可。
So much depends on this that we must establish the facts.

这消息是怎么来的，你能不能讲出来听听？”如果光是胡雪岩一个人私下问他，他自然据实而言，
Can you tell us how you obtained it?” Had Hu asked him alone, Zhou would readily have told the truth.

但有初会面的俞武成师徒在，不免有所顾忌。
With Yu and his disciples, whom he was meeting for the first time, present, he could not help feeling wary.

俞武成看出端倪，但作了很诚恳的表示：
Yu detected his hesitation and spoke with great sincerity.

“周老兄，你尽管说，
“Brother Zhou, speak freely.

我们这面，决不会泄漏半个字。
Not half a word will escape anyone here.

你如果不相信，我拿我老娘来罚咒……”周一鸣倏然动容，连连摇手：
If you do not believe me, I shall swear an oath upon my mother—” Zhou’s expression changed at once, and he waved his hands repeatedly.

“这怎么可以？”
“You must not do that!”

他想了想问：“我想请问俞大爷，跷脚长根做的那些坏事，你是不是都晓得？”
After a moment’s thought he asked, “May I ask, Master Yu, whether you know all the wicked things Changgen has done?”

“晓得一点，不能说完全晓得。”
“Some, but I cannot claim to know everything.”

“他欺侮过一个寡妇，这件事你听说过没有？”
“Have you heard how he mistreated a widow?”

“听说过。”
“Yes.”

俞武成点点头，
Yu nodded.

“他先搭上了一个寡妇，赌输了就去伸手，
“He began an affair with her and then demanded money whenever he lost at gambling.

那寡妇的一点私房跟首饰，都让他逼光了。
He forced her to give up all her private savings and jewellery.

长根要她卖祭祀田，
Then he wanted her to sell the land set aside to support ancestral rites.

她不肯，就吓她，要撕她的面皮。
When she refused, he threatened to expose and disgrace her.

那寡妇想想左右做不来人，一索子上吊死了，
She felt that whatever she did, she could no longer face the world, and hanged herself.

是不是这么回事？
Is that the affair?”

““是的，
“Yes.

那寡妇姓魏，
Her surname was Wei.

有个兄弟在长根手下，长根大意，不在乎他……”“我懂了。”
She had a brother serving under Changgen, but Changgen was careless and paid him no attention—” “I understand.”

俞武成不需他再说下去，
Yu needed no more explanation.

“姓魏的，是你老兄的好朋友？”
“Is this Wei a close friend of yours?”

“不是，我跟他初交。
“No, I have only just met him.

我有个换帖弟兄，跟他是好朋友，
One of my sworn brothers is his close friend.

这趟跟我换帖弟兄谈起长根，他才找了小魏来跟我见面。
When I mentioned Changgen to my sworn brother this time, he brought Young Wei to meet me.

消息是决不假，
There is no doubt that the information is true.

可惜详细情形他还不清楚。”
Unfortunately, Wei does not yet know the details.”


“这已经够了。”俞武成问道：
“That is enough already,” Yu said.

“不知道小魏肯不肯出面做见证？”
“Would Young Wei be willing to come forward as a witness?”

“不会肯的。”胡雪岩接口，
“He would not,” Hu answered.

“就肯出面，口说无凭，长根也可以赖掉的。”
“And even if he did, a statement without proof could simply be denied by Changgen.”

“那么，”俞武成断然决然地说，“就我一个人去会他！”
“Then I shall go and meet him alone!” Yu declared.

“不！”胡雪岩说，
“No.

“大哥，你一个人去无用，
Going alone would achieve nothing, brother.

他一定按兵不动。
He would certainly make no move.

我看此事只好作罢。
I think we must abandon the matter.

那一船洋枪，承大哥情让，我另有补报……”“嗐！”俞武成抢着打断，
I am grateful that you have agreed to leave that boatload of guns alone, and I shall repay your kindness in some other way—” “Oh, come!” Yu interrupted.

“老胡，你这不成话了。
“Old Hu, you cannot say that.

事情弄到这步田地，糟糕得很，
For things to reach this miserable state!

窝窝囊囊，叫我以后怎么再在场面上混？
If I submit to such humiliation, how can I ever show my face again?

这样，你先请回去，
Here is what we shall do: you go back first.

我跟松江老大去商量，一定把你这一船洋枪，运到杭州。
I shall talk to the Songjiang Chief and make certain your guns reach Hangzhou.

跷脚长根，当然也饶不过他，
As for Changgen, of course I shall not let him off.

不要看我借地安营，我照样要跟他拼个明白。”
I may be camped on borrowed ground, but I shall still fight this out with him.”

看到俞武成有些闹意气的模样，胡雪岩认为这件事不宜再谈下去，
Seeing that Yu was letting wounded pride govern him, Hu decided they should not continue the discussion.

先要让他冷一冷，消一消气，
He must first cool down and lose some of his anger.

所以一面向刘不才使个眼色，一面摆摆手说：
Hu signalled to Liu and waved his hand.

“‘性急吃不得热粥’，
“You cannot swallow hot porridge in a hurry.

回头再谈吧！
Let us discuss it later.

反正有大哥在这里，没有什么办不通的事。”
With you here, brother, there is nothing that cannot be managed.”

“对了！”
“Exactly!”

刘不才领受默喻，附和着说：
Liu understood the unspoken request and chimed in.

“我陪俞老先玩一场牌九，换换脑筋！”
“I shall play a round of pai gow with Elder Yu first, to give his mind a change.”

说着，他将俞武成硬拖了走。
He practically dragged Yu away.

朱家吃闲饭的人很多，等场面摆开，自有人聚拢来，很快地凑起一桌小牌九。
There were plenty of idle dependants in Zhu’s household; as soon as the game was set out, people gathered, and they soon had enough players for the small version of pai gow.

刘不才有意推让俞武成做庄，绊住了他的身子，以便胡雪岩与杨凤毛好从容筹计。
Liu deliberately insisted that Yu take the bank, keeping him occupied so that Hu and Yang could devise a plan at leisure.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十八章（下）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Twenty-Eight, Part Three
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


他的测度，丝毫不差，胡雪岩正是这样希望。
Liu had guessed exactly right: this was precisely what Hu Xueyan wanted.

他对俞武成有多少实力，肚子里有些什么货，以及他的想法和脾气。尽皆了然，
Hu now understood how much real influence Yu Wucheng possessed, what abilities he had, and how he thought and behaved.

觉得跟他谈，不如跟杨凤毛谈，来得有用。
He felt that a discussion with Yang Fengmao would be more useful than one with Yu.

当然，还有个少不得的人：周一鸣。
There was, of course, another indispensable participant: Zhou Yiming.

三个人是在水阁中促膝画策。
The three sat close together in the waterside pavilion to work out a plan.

胡雪岩首先表明了态度，
Hu began by explaining his position.

他的目的，已经有所更改，
His purpose had changed.

那一船洋枪如何运到杭州，犹在其次，主要的是想帮俞武成翻身，也不枉三婆婆一番器重的情意。
Getting that boatload of foreign rifles to Hangzhou was now a secondary concern; his chief aim was to help Yu Wucheng regain his standing and thus prove worthy of Third Granny’s regard.

江湖上就讲这一点“意思”。
In the brotherhood, such a gesture counted for everything.

杨凤毛对胡雪岩的态度，一变再变，由不甚在意，到相当佩服，而此刻是十分感激了，
Yang’s feelings toward Hu had changed again and again, from indifference to considerable admiration; now they had become profound gratitude.

“胡大叔，”他说了句很坦率的话：“你老的心，我师父或许还不明白，我是完全晓得的。
“Uncle Hu,” he said frankly, “my master may not yet understand what is in your heart, but I understand it completely.

只要胡大叔吩咐，我们做得到的，一定出全力去做。
Give us your instructions, and whatever we can do, we shall do with all our strength.

现在胡大叔是这样的用心，我倒想请问一句，照胡大叔看，我师父要怎么样才能翻身？”
Since this is what you have in mind, may I ask how you think my master can recover his position?”

“官私两面。”胡雪岩很快地回答：
“On two fronts: with the authorities and within the brotherhood,” Hu answered at once.

“官的，譬如说能够办好这一次招抚，自然最好，
“As far as the authorities are concerned, successfully arranging this surrender would naturally be best.

不然，就要有杀搏的做法，
Failing that, there must be action to put the men down by force.

也是大功一件。”
That, too, would be a great service.”

杨凤毛领会得他的意思，
Yang understood.

一颗心怦怦然，相当紧张，但还不便表示态度，
His heart began to pound, but he was not yet ready to commit himself.

只眼神专注着，等他再说下去。
He watched Hu intently, waiting for him to continue.

“私的，在江猢上要把你师父的名气，重新打它响来！”
“Within the brotherhood, we must make your master’s name ring out again!”

“是的。”
“Exactly.”

对这一点，杨凤毛深有同感，
On this point Yang agreed wholeheartedly.

“我也一直这样子在想。
“That is what I have always wanted.

不过，也要有机会，
But we need an opportunity.

能够有机会干一两件漂亮的事就好了。”
If only he could accomplish one or two things that would really impress people!”


“眼前就是个机会。
“The opportunity is right before us.

这且摆下来再说。
But let us put that aside for a moment.

我现在想到一个主意，说出来你看看，行不行？“胡雪岩说：”
An idea has just occurred to me; see what you think of it.

有句话叫做‘明修栈道，暗渡陈仓’，
There is a saying: ‘Repair the plank road in plain sight, but secretly cross at Chencang.’

现在跷脚长根全副精神，都在你师父跟我身上，
Lame Changgen’s whole attention is fixed on your master and me.

一双眼睛，只顾看着同里，别的方面就疏忽了。
With both eyes on Tongli, he is neglecting everything else.

我想趁这个空档，将上海的那船军火，赶紧起运。
I want to take advantage of that opening to get the arms shipment out of Shanghai at once.

好在松江那方面有照应，
Fortunately, we have people in Songjiang to look after it.

一定不会出毛病。
Nothing should go wrong.”

““嗯，嗯！”
“Yes, yes!”

杨凤毛连连点头，
Yang nodded repeatedly.

“这个险值得冒。”
“That is a risk worth taking.”

“不过也有个做法，
“But there is another part to it.

我想请少武押运。
I should like Shaowu to escort the shipment.

当然，”胡雪岩紧接着说：“万一出了毛病，决不要他负责任。
Of course,” Hu added quickly, “if anything does go wrong, he will certainly not be held responsible.

我的意思是，有这样一趟‘劳绩’，等军火到了杭州，奏保议叙，就可以拿他的名字摆在前面，
My idea is that once the arms reach Hangzhou, this service will allow us to put his name near the top when recommendations for rewards are submitted to the throne.

多少有点好处，对三婆婆也是个交代。”
It should do him some good, and it will give us something to show Third Granny.”

“好的。
“Excellent.

胡大叔挑他，那还有什么话说？
If you have chosen him, Uncle Hu, what more is there to say?

等我回苏州去一趟，当面告诉他。”
I shall go back to Suzhou and tell him myself.”

“不必你去，
“You need not go.

我会安排。”
I shall arrange it.”


接下来便是商量如何对付跷脚长根。
They next discussed how to deal with Changgen.

胡雪岩与杨凤毛的看法相同，整个关键，就在证据！
Hu and Yang agreed that everything depended on evidence.

有了证据，怎么样都好办，
Once they had proof, any course would be open to them.

大则动用官兵围剿，是师出有名，小则照他们帮里“家门”的规矩，“开香堂”问罪，
They could call in government troops to surround and suppress his men with full justification; or, on a smaller scale, they could convene an incense-hall tribunal under their own brotherhood’s rules.

亦可问得他俯首无辞，三刀六洞，任凭处置。
Confronted with the evidence, he could have no defense and would have to submit to their punishment, even the sentence of “three knife thrusts and six holes.”

“现在只有这样的消息，
“At present all we have is this report.

既无书信字迹，也没有人肯挺身指证，
There are no letters or written documents, and no one will come forward to testify.

这就莫亲其何？
What can we do to him?

当然，我也可以想法子拿他抓到公堂上，严刑拷问，
Naturally, I could find a way to have him brought before a magistrate and interrogated under torture.

不过这一来，我结了怨还在其次，
The resentment that would earn me is a minor matter.

损了你们老头子的威名，说他仗势损人，
What matters is the damage to your leader’s reputation: people would say he had used official power to harm another man.

这个名声，我想他也决不肯背的。”
I am sure he would never accept that name.”

“ 当然，当然。”杨凤毛一叠连声地说，
“Certainly not, certainly not,” Yang said repeatedly.

“一落这个名声，在江湖上就难混了。”
“Once a man acquires that reputation, he can scarcely hold his ground in the brotherhood.”

“所以，除非罢手，不上他的圈套，不然就只有一条路子，叫做‘不入虎穴，焉得虎子’！”
“So unless we abandon the matter and keep clear of his trap, there is only one course left: ‘How can you catch the tiger’s cub without entering the tiger’s den?’”

“我也想到过，觉得太危险！”
“I have thought of that too, but it seemed too dangerous.”

“只要接应得好，决不要紧。
“Provided the rescue is properly coordinated, there is no danger.

我想这样子做法……”
Here is what I propose...”


胡雪岩的做法是跟俞武成去赴这一场“鸿门宴”，准备谈判决裂，准备被绑架，
Hu’s plan was to accompany Yu Wucheng to this Banquet at Hongmen, prepared for the negotiations to break down and for both of them to be kidnapped.

等船到关卡，借稽查为名，出其不意，上船相救，
When their captors’ boat reached a checkpoint, men would board unexpectedly on the pretext of an inspection and rescue them.

那时候就证实了跷脚长根的不逞之心，
Changgen’s treachery would then be established.

是官了还是私了，到时候再说。
Whether to settle the affair through the authorities or within the brotherhood could be decided afterward.

杨凤毛极注意地听着，从头到底，细作盘算，认为他的计划，比自己的打算来得周密，
Yang listened closely, working through every stage, and found Hu’s plan more thorough than his own.

前面的一段经过相同，不同的是脱险的方法，
Their ideas for the first part were the same; the difference lay in the escape.

杨凤毛预备邀人埋伏，唱一出“临江夺斗”，
Yang had intended to station men in ambush and stage a rescue like the opera Seizing Adou by the River.

胡雪岩是动用官方的力量作掩护，围赵救燕。
Hu would use official authority as cover, “besieging Zhao to save Yan.”

一个力夺，一个智取，自然后者比前者高明。
One meant a rescue by force, the other by strategy; the latter was plainly superior.

“胡大叔，你老随机应变的功夫，我是信得过的，
“Uncle Hu, I have complete confidence in your ability to meet whatever happens.

就怕我师父脾气暴躁，搞得跷脚长根恼羞成怒。
My only fear is that my master’s violent temper may provoke Changgen into a rage.

除此以外，只要接应得好，不会不成功。”
Apart from that, with the rescue properly arranged, we cannot fail.”

“成败的关键在明暗之间。”胡雪岩说：
“Success depends on who knows what,” Hu replied.

“跷脚长根以为他在暗处，我们在明处，
“Changgen thinks he is hidden while we stand in the open.

其实他明我暗。
In fact, it is he who is exposed and we who are hidden.

如果消息泄漏出去，就又变成我们在明处了。”
If word gets out, we shall be the ones exposed again.”

“是的。”杨凤毛郑重地答道：
“Yes,” Yang said solemnly.

“我想，这件事就胡大叔、周先生跟我三个人知道。
“I suggest that only you, Mr Zhou, and I know of this.

等筹划好了，再告诉我师父。”
Once the arrangements are complete, we can tell my master.”

“一点不错。”
“Exactly.”

于是彼此不动声色，
They gave nothing away.

吃罢了饭，仍旧由刘不才陪着俞武成赌钱，他们三个人接续未完的话题，
After the meal, Liu Bucai again kept Yu company at the gaming table while the three resumed their discussion.

将一切细节，都筹划到了，然后分头行事。
When every detail had been settled, they went about their separate tasks.


首先当然是要告诉俞武成。
The first task, naturally, was to inform Yu Wucheng.

对于整个计划，他有不以为然的地方，
He objected to parts of the plan.

譬如由他儿子去押运那一船洋枪，俞武成就觉得将来说出去，是他先背弃了跷脚长根，
Having his own son escort the rifles, for instance, might allow people to say afterward that he had been the first to betray Changgen.

名声不好听。
That would sound very bad.

但他一向倚人成事，
But he had always relied on others to accomplish things.

杨凤毛是他最得力的学生，胡雪岩又处处显得比自己这面高明，
Yang was his most capable disciple, while Hu had shown himself superior at every turn to anyone on Yu’s side.

加以有那一层干亲在，越发不便多说什么。
Their newly established family connection made it still harder to object.

所以慨然答应：
He therefore agreed with an expansive air.

“都随你们，
“I leave it all to you.

你们怎么说，我怎么做！”
Whatever you say, I shall do!”

“有一层要请示大哥，
“There is one point on which I need your decision, Brother Yu.

等事情抖明了，是官了，还是私了？”胡雪岩说，
Once everything has been exposed, shall we settle it officially or privately?

“官了，我来奔去，
If it is to go through the authorities, I shall make the arrangements.

私了，是你们家门里的事，我就不能过问了。”
If it is to be settled privately, that is a matter for your brotherhood, and I cannot interfere.”

俞武成想了想说：
Yu considered.

“我想还是私了。
“Privately, I think.

惊官动府也不大好。”
Bringing in the authorities would not be a good thing.”

“那都随大哥的意思，
“Then we shall do as you wish.

好在我跟大哥始终在一起，有事随时听招呼就是了。”
I shall be with you throughout, in any case, ready to follow your instructions whenever anything arises.”


“始终在一起”这五个字，俞武成深深印入脑中，
The words “with you throughout” sank deep into Yu’s mind.

不由得便有患难祸福相共的感觉，因而对胡雪岩的情分也就不同了。
They gave him the sense that here was a man who would share his troubles and good fortune alike, and his feelings toward Hu changed accordingly.

他是豪爽，加上些纨袴子弟想到就做的鲁莽性格，
He was generous by nature, with something of a spoiled young gentleman’s reckless habit of acting on impulse.

当时便说：“凤毛，你告诉你那些兄弟和‘小角色’，以后胡大叔说的话，就跟我同你说的一样。”
“Fengmao,” he said at once, “tell your fellow disciples and all the younger men that from now on Uncle Hu’s word carries exactly the same weight as yours or mine.”

“是！”杨凤毛心悦诚服地答道：
“Yes,” Yang answered with willing sincerity.

“我们不敢不敬胡大叔。”
“We would not dare treat Uncle Hu with anything less than respect.”

“不敢当，不敢当！”
“You are too kind, far too kind!”

胡雪岩既得意，又惭愧，
Hu felt both pleased and abashed.

“贤师弟如此厚爱，叫我不知何以为报？”
“With such affection from you and your disciple, how can I ever repay you?”

“老胡，你说反了……”
“My dear Hu, you have it the wrong way round...”

“师父！”杨凤毛打断他的话说：
“Master!” Yang interrupted.

“这不是谈这些话的时候。
“This is not the time for that.

胡大叔还有正事要赶着办，
Uncle Hu still has urgent business to attend to.

晚上宵夜再谈吧！”
We can talk over supper tonight.”


胡雪岩深知江湖上行事，越是光棍，越易多心，
Hu knew that in the world of the brotherhood, the more seasoned a man was, the more readily he took offense or grew suspicious.

过节上的话，要交代得清楚，
Every point of etiquette had to be made clear.

无端冒出个周一鸣来，已有些自张一帜，独行其是的味道，
Zhou Yiming had appeared without warning, which already suggested that Hu was setting up a separate camp and acting on his own.

再藏着个“黑人”裘丰言，再不成话，
To keep Qiu Fengyan hidden as well, another man working in the shadows, would be altogether improper.

因而把握机关，作了说明。
He therefore took the opportunity to explain.

“有件事，我要跟大哥回明白。
“There is something I must make clear to you, Brother Yu.

老周跟我还有个朋友，也就是那一船洋枪的押运委员裘丰言，
Zhou and I have another friend, Qiu Fengyan, the officer appointed to escort that shipment of rifles.

他们两位不放心我，现在都赶到同里，预备帮忙。
Both of them were worried about me and have now hurried to Tongli to help.

人多好做事，
More hands make the work easier.

我们调兵遣将，原该在一起，不过，人一多，怕风声太大，
Since we are deploying our people, we ought by rights to be together; but too many of us in one place might attract attention.

我跟大哥请示，是大家住一起，还是分开来的好？”
I should like your opinion: should we all lodge together or remain apart?”

是合是分，俞武成无从作判断，不过听话是听得懂的，
Yu had no means of deciding which arrangement was better, but he could understand what he was being told.

胡雪岩既“怕风声太大”，则意向如何？不言可知。
Since Hu was worried about attracting attention, his own preference was obvious.

于是俞武成毫不迟疑地答道：“分开来的好，分开来的好！”
“Apart would be better, apart would be better!” Yu replied without hesitation.

“那位裘大老爷是‘州县班子’，
“Mr Qiu belongs to the class of officials eligible for subprefectural and county magistracies.

跟刘三爷一样，极有趣的人，
Like Third Master Liu, he is excellent company.

三婆婆认胡大婶，算是他引进。”
It was through him that Third Granny came to take Mrs Hu as a sworn daughter.”

“喔！”俞武成说，
“Oh!” said Yu.

“那么，我该尽点道理，
“Then I must show him some courtesy.

明天下个帖子，请裘大老爷吃饭。”
I shall send an invitation tomorrow and ask him to dinner.”

“那就不必了。
“That is unnecessary.

等事情成功了，我们再好好热闹一下子。
Once the business is successfully concluded, we can celebrate properly.

如果大哥想跟他见一面，我今晚上就把他带了来。”
If you would like to meet him, I can bring him here tonight.”

“那好极了！
“Excellent!

只怕简慢不恭。”
I only hope he will forgive the informality.”


这样说定了，胡雪岩便由周一鸣陪着去看裘丰言。
With that settled, Hu went with Zhou to see Qiu.

他正在客栈里，捏着一卷黄仲则的《两当轩全集》，醉眼迷离地在吟哦。
At the inn they found him holding a volume of Huang Zhongze’s Complete Works of Liangdang Studio, reciting poetry with a tipsy, misty gaze.

一见胡雪岩便即笑道：
At the sight of Hu he laughed.

“老胡，我真服了你！
“My dear Hu, I truly admire you!

来，来，先奉敬一杯。”
Come, come, let me offer you a cup first.”

“等等，等等，
“Wait, wait.

回头消夜，我再陪你吃。
I shall drink with you over supper later.

如今‘军情紧急’，
For the moment, ‘the military situation is urgent.’

你先把酒杯放下来。”
Put down your cup.”

夺去他的酒杯，自是件极扫兴的事，
To deprive Qiu of his wine was certainly to spoil his pleasure.

但他是真的服胡雪岩，说什么是什么，
But his admiration for Hu was genuine, and he accepted whatever Hu said.

当时便陪着胡雪岩到另一张桌子坐下，细谈正事。
He joined him at another table to discuss the business in detail.

胡雪岩将“暗渡陈仓”的计划说了一遍，当时便请他写了三封信，
Hu explained the plan for the secret shipment and had Qiu write three letters on the spot.

一封是给松江老大，说明经过，请求在水路上照应，
One was to the Songjiang Chief, explaining the circumstances and requesting protection along the waterways.

一封是由裘丰言自己出面，写给王有龄，说明委任俞少武押运洋枪，作为将来叙功的根据，
Another, written in Qiu’s own name to Wang Youling, set out Yu Shaowu’s appointment to escort the rifles, providing a record on which a future recommendation for reward could be based.

再一封是写给何桂清，介绍周一鸣晋谒，说有“机密要事”密陈。
The third introduced Zhou Yiming to He Guiqing, saying that Zhou had confidential matters of importance to report in person.


写完了信，胡雪岩邀他到朱家消夜，跟俞武成见面。
When the letters were finished, Hu invited Qiu to the Zhu house for supper and a meeting with Yu Wucheng.

“酒糊涂”的裘丰言，却忽然谨小慎微了，
Qiu, the Wine Muddlehead, suddenly became exceedingly cautious.

认为做事以隐秘为上，而且他也没有跟俞武成见面的必要。
Secrecy should come first, he argued, and there was no need for him to meet Yu.

但胡雪岩认为说好了见面，临时变卦，怕俞武成多心，所以坚持原议。
Hu insisted, however, that since the meeting had already been promised, a last-minute change might arouse Yu’s suspicions.

这样便不得不有此一行。
Qiu therefore had to go.

见了面互道仰慕，而且酒杯中容易交朋友，俞武成觉得此人颇为投机。
The two exchanged expressions of admiration; wine made friendship easy, and Yu found him very congenial.

谈到俞少武押运的差使，做父亲的虽不以为然，而此时竟不能不郑重拜托。
When they spoke of Shaowu’s escort assignment, Yu, though he disapproved of it, now felt obliged to commend his son earnestly to Qiu’s care.

这顿消夜，直吃到深夜才罢，
Supper lasted far into the night.

裘丰言和周一鸣双双告辞，回到客栈打个盹，上了预先雇定的船，
Qiu and Zhou then took their leave together, returned to the inn for a short nap, and boarded boats hired in advance.

一个往北到苏州去见何桂清，并通知俞少武到上海会齐，
One went north to Suzhou, to see He Guiqing and notify Yu Shaowu that he should join the others in Shanghai.

一个往东，先到松江见“老太爷”，然后回上海去运洋枪。
The other went east, first to Songjiang to see the Old Master, then back to Shanghai to ship the rifles.


由于关卡上的安排援救脱险，得有些日子来部署，所以依照预先的商议，先用一条缓兵之计，
Arranging the rescue at the checkpoints would take some days, so they first employed the delaying tactic they had agreed upon.

俞武成向跷脚长根说，胡雪岩为表敬意，坚持要先请他吃饭，
Yu told Changgen that Hu insisted on entertaining him first as a mark of respect.

从来“行客拜坐客”，但坐客却须先尽地主之谊，
A visitor should always call on the local man, but the local man should first extend hospitality.

因此俞武成提出折中办法，由他作东，先请双方小叙会面，
Yu therefore offered a compromise: he would give a small dinner at which the two sides could meet and talk.

等条件谈妥当了，再领跷脚长根的情。
Once the terms had been settled, they could accept Changgen’s invitation.

这个说话，合情合理，
This was perfectly reasonable.

跷脚长很当然想不到其中别有作用，只觉得自己的计划，晚几天实行，也无所谓，
Changgen suspected no hidden purpose and felt that postponing his own plan for a few days would do no harm.

因而欣然应诺。
He readily agreed.

于是就在裘丰言动身的第二天中午，俞武成在朱家设下盛筵，
At noon on the day after Qiu’s departure, Yu held a grand banquet at the Zhu house.

跷脚长根一跷一拐地到了，不知是有意炫耀，还是自觉不甚安全，需人保护，他竟带了二十名随从。
Changgen arrived limping, with no fewer than twenty followers. Whether this was a display of importance or a precaution because he felt unsafe, no one could tell.

这一下，主人家固然手忙脚乱，得要临时添席招待，胡雪岩亦不得不关照刘不才，赶着添办礼物。
The hosts had to scramble to provide extra tables, while Hu hurriedly told Liu to obtain more gifts.

每人一套衣料，二两银子的一个红包，原来备了八份，此刻需再添十二份。
He had prepared eight sets, each consisting of cloth for an outfit and a red packet containing two taels; now twelve more were needed.

这倒不是他摆阔，
This was no mere display of wealth.

是有意笼络，
He meant to win the men over.

保不定将来遇着性命呼吸的生死关头，有此一重香火因缘，就可能会发生极大的作用。
At some future moment when his life hung by a thread, even this slight bond of goodwill might make an enormous difference.

入席谦让，胡雪岩是远客，坐了首座，与跷脚长根接席，
After the customary exchange of courtesies over seating, Hu, as the visitor from afar, took the place of honor next to Changgen.

在场面上自然都是些冠冕堂皇的应酬话。
The conversation consisted, naturally, of polished pleasantries.

吃完了饭，刘不才做庄推牌九，以娱“嘉宾”，俞武成则陪着胡雪岩和跷脚长根，到水阁中谈正经，
Afterward Liu took the bank at pai gow to entertain the “honored guests,” while Yu led Hu and Changgen to the waterside pavilion for serious business.

在座的只有一个杨凤毛。
Yang was the only other person present.


“长根！”俞武成先作开场白，“这位胡老兄的如夫人，是我老娘从小就喜欢，认了干亲的，
“Changgen,” Yu began, “my mother has been fond of our friend Hu’s concubine since she was a child, and has taken her as a sworn daughter.

‘大水冲倒龙王庙’，一家人不认识一家人，
It is a case of ‘the flood washing into the Dragon King’s own temple’—members of one family failing to recognize one another.

说起来也是巧事。
A remarkable coincidence, when you think of it.

老胡虽是空子，其实比我们门槛里都还够朋友，
Hu is not an initiate, but he is a truer friend than many within our ranks.

他踉松江老大、尤五的交清，是没话说的。
His friendship with the Songjiang Chief and You Laowu needs no explanation.

还有湖州的郁四，你总也听说过，他们在一伙做生意。
And you must have heard of Yu Si of Huzhou; they are in business together.

所以，那件事，要请你高抬贵手！”
So I must ask you to show consideration over that matter.”

“俞师父，你老人家说话太重了，”
“Master Yu, there is no need to put it so strongly.”

跷脚长根的态度显得很恳切，
Changgen appeared entirely sincere.

“江湖上碰来碰去自己人，
“We meet people here and there, only to discover that they are our own.

光是三婆婆跟你老的面子，我就没话可说。
Out of respect for Third Granny and yourself alone, I could have nothing more to say.

何况，我也很想结交我们胡老兄。”
Besides, I very much want to make our friend Hu’s acquaintance.”

“承情，承情！”
“I am grateful, very grateful!”

胡雪岩拱拱手说：
Hu clasped his hands.

“多蒙情让，我总也要有点意思……”
“Since you are being so accommodating, I must make some gesture in return...”

“笑话！”
“Nonsense!”

跷脚长根摆着手说，
Changgen waved this aside.

“那件事就不必谈了！”
“There is no need to discuss that matter again!”

洋枪的事，总算有了交代。
The question of the rifles had at last been addressed.

于是谈招抚。
They turned to the proposed surrender.


跷脚长根亦颇会做作，
Changgen was an accomplished actor.

明明并无就抚之心，却在条件上斤斤较量，反复争论，显得极其认真似地，
He had no intention of surrendering, yet he haggled over every condition and argued back and forth as though he were perfectly serious.

特别是对改编为官军以后的驻区，坚持要在嘉定、昆山和青浦这个三角形的地带上。
Above all, he insisted that once his men were incorporated into the government army, they must remain stationed in the triangle formed by Jiading, Kunshan, and Qingpu.

一直是胡雪岩耐着性子跟他磨，到了僵持不下之时，
Hu patiently argued with him until they reached an impasse.

俞武成忍不住要开口，
Then Yu could contain himself no longer.

“长根！”他用低沉的声音说：“做事总要‘前半夜想想自己，后半夜想想别人’。
“Changgen,” he said in a low voice, “when you do anything, you should ‘think of yourself for the first half of the night, and of others for the second.’

我倒要问你一句：等招安以后，上头要派你出队去打上海县城，你肯不肯去？”
Let me ask you this: once you have accepted the amnesty, if your superiors order you to attack the county town of Shanghai, will you go?”

“这……
“Well...

俞师父，你晓得我的处境的。”
Master Yu, you know my position.”

“是啊！”
“Exactly!”

俞武成紧接着他的话说，
Yu seized on his reply.

“别人也就是晓得你的处境，不肯叫你为难，所以要把你调开。
“And it is because other people understand your position and do not want to put you in a difficulty that they intend to move you elsewhere.

不然的话，你跟小刀会倒还有香火之情，小刀会不见得跟你请义气，
Otherwise, you may still feel a bond with the Small Swords Society, but they may not feel any obligation to you.

冷不防要来吃掉你，
Suppose they suddenly try to swallow you up.

那时候你怎么办？
What will you do then?

老实说一句：你想退让都办不到！
To be frank, you would not even be free to give way.

为什么呢，
Why?

一则，你当官军，小刀会就不当你朋友了，说不定赶尽杀绝，
First, once you become government troops, the Small Swords will no longer regard you as friends; they may even try to wipe you out.

再则，你一退就动摇军心，
Second, if you retreat, you shake the army’s morale.

军令如山，父子部不认帐的，
Military orders are immovable as a mountain; they make no allowance even for fathers and sons.

‘辕门斩子’这出戏，你难道没有看过？”
Surely you have seen the opera Executing the Son at the Camp Gate?”


跷脚长根被驳倒了，沉吟了好半晌，做出情恳的神态，
Unable to answer this, Changgen brooded for some time, then assumed an earnest expression.

“俞师父，胡老兄，我实在有我的难处，
“Master Yu, my dear Hu, I really do have difficulties.

弟兄们一份饷只好混自己，养家活口是不够的，
The men’s pay is barely enough to keep them alive; it will not support their families.

在本乡本土，多少有点生路，
At home they have other ways of making a little money.

一调开了，顾不到家眷，没有一个人安得下心来。
If they are transferred and cannot look after their dependents, none of them will have any peace of mind.

俞师父你老的话，当然再透彻都没有，我就听凭上头作主，
What you say, Master Yu, could not be clearer, and I shall leave the decision to the authorities.

不过‘皇帝不差饿兵’，
But ‘even the emperor does not send hungry soldiers into the field.’

请上头无论如何发半年的恩饷，算是安家费。
Whatever happens, I must ask them to grant six months’ bonus pay to provide for the men’s families.

家不安，心不定，出队打仗也不肯拼命的，
If their homes are unsettled, their minds will be unsettled, and they will not fight with all their strength.

胡老兄，你说是不是？
Am I not right, my dear Hu?”

““是，是。
“Yes, yes.

你老兄再明白不过。”
You understand the situation perfectly.”

胡雪岩很诚恳地说，
Hu spoke with great sincerity.

“我一定替你去力争。
“I shall certainly press your case.

半年，恐怕不大办得到，三个月，我一定替你争来。
Six months may be difficult, but I promise to obtain three.

能多自然最好。”
More would naturally be better.”

“好了，好了！
“Enough, enough!

话说到这里，长根，
We have got this far, Changgen.

你要再争就不够意思了！”
It would be unreasonable to keep arguing!”

“是的。”
“Very well.”

跷脚长根略带些勉强地，仿佛是因为俞武成以大压小，不敢不听，
Changgen appeared a little reluctant, as though Yu were invoking his seniority and he dared not disobey.

“我就听你老的吩咐了。”
“I shall do as you say.”

“好极！
“Excellent!

总算谈出个结果。”
At last we have reached an agreement.”

胡雪岩看着俞武成说：
Hu turned to Yu.

“大哥，我想明天就回苏州。
“Brother Yu, I should like to return to Suzhou tomorrow.

官场上做事慢，恐怕要五、六天才谈得好。
Official business moves slowly; settling this may take five or six days.

不过，到底有多少人马，要有个确数，上头才好筹划。”
But we need exact figures for the men and horses, so the authorities can make their plans.”

这是想跟跷脚长根要本花名册，
He wanted Changgen’s muster roll.

俞武成虽懂得他的意思，却感到有些不易措词，
Yu understood, but found the request difficult to frame.

怕跷脚长根托词拒绝，碰一个钉子，则以自己的身分，面子上下不来。
If Changgen made an excuse and refused, a man of Yu’s standing would suffer an intolerable loss of face.


谁知跷脚长根倒爽快得很，
Unexpectedly, Changgen was most accommodating.

不待俞武成开口，自己就说：“对，对！”接着便喊一声：“贵生！”
Before Yu could speak, he said, “Quite right, quite right!” Then he called, “Guisheng!”

贵生是他的一名随从，生得雄武非常，腰里别一把短枪，枪上一绺猩红丝穗子，昂然走了进来候命。
One of his followers, a remarkably powerful-looking man, strode proudly in to receive his orders. A pistol hung at his waist, decorated with a scarlet silk tassel.

“你把我那个‘护书’拿来。”
“Bring me my document wallet.”

取来“护书”，跷脚长根从里面抽出一张纸来，递给胡雪岩，
When it arrived, Changgen took out a sheet of paper and handed it to Hu.

打开一看，上面记得有数字：两千七百人，三百五十匹马，此外记着武器的数目，如长枪、大刀、白蜡杆子，另外还有四十多支洋枪。
It listed 2,700 men and 350 horses, followed by the quantities of their weapons: long spears, broadswords, white-waxwood staves, and more than forty foreign rifles.

胡雪岩虽不曾经手过招抚的事务，但平时跟王有龄、嵇鹤龄、裘丰言闭谈之中，已略知其中的关键虚实，
Hu had never personally handled a negotiated surrender, but conversations with Wang Youling, Ji Heling, and Qiu had given him some understanding of how to distinguish appearance from reality in such affairs.

大致盗匪就抚，老老实实陈报实力的，例子极少，
Very few bandit leaders reported their strength honestly.

不是虚增，就是暗减。而就在这增减之中，可以看出受抚者的态度，
They either inflated it or concealed part of it, and the direction of the discrepancy revealed their intentions.

如果有心受抚，自然希望受到重视，所以人马总是多报些，用虚张声势来自高身价，
A man sincerely wishing to surrender wanted to be taken seriously, so he exaggerated his men and horses to increase his bargaining value.

倘或一时势穷力蹙，不得不暂时投降，暂保生路，那就一定有所隐瞒，作为保存实力，俟机翻复的退步。
A man driven by desperation to surrender temporarily merely to survive would conceal some of his forces, preserving strength for a later change of sides.

胡雪岩现在想探明的，就是跷脚长根真正的实力。
What Hu now wanted to discover was Changgen’s actual strength.


“老兄诚意相待，让我中间人毫不为难，
“You have dealt so frankly with me that my work as intermediary could not be easier.

实在心感之至。
I am deeply grateful.

现在有句话想请教，我回到苏州，是不是拿老兄的这张单子，送了上去？”
There is just one thing I should like to ask: when I return to Suzhou, may I submit this list of yours to the authorities?”

这意思是说，单子送了上来，即是备了案，
Submission meant that the list would become an official record.

“一字入公门，九牛拔不转”，将来就抚时，便得照单点验。
“Once a word enters a government office, nine oxen cannot pull it back”: when Changgen surrendered, his men and horses would have to be inspected and counted against it.

他这样试探，就是要看看跷脚长根的态度，
Hu was testing his attitude.

倘或有心就抚，听此一说，自然要郑重考虑，否则，便不当回事了。
Anyone seriously contemplating surrender would consider this carefully; anyone who was not would attach no importance to it.

果然，胡雪岩试探出来了，
The test produced its answer.

“尽管送上去！”跷脚长根答道，
“Submit it by all means!” Changgen replied.

“将来照这单子点数，
“When the time comes, they can count according to that list.

我可以写包票，一个人不少，一匹马不缺。”
I will give you a written guarantee: not a man short, not a horse missing.”

越是说得斩钉截铁，越显得是假话，
The more emphatic he was, the less credible his words became.

因为天有不测风云，人有旦夕祸福，
Misfortune could arrive without warning.

这两千七百多人中，难免没有暴疾而亡的事情发生，
Among 2,700 men, someone might suddenly fall ill and die.

何能包得下一个不少？
How could he guarantee that not one would be missing?

他的心思深，跷脚长根和俞武成都想不到有这样的用意在内，
Hu’s thinking ran too deep for either Changgen or Yu to suspect his purpose.

只觉得事情谈到此，可以告一段落，当时约定，等他从苏州回来那天，便是在妙珍香闺畅饮庆功之日。
They merely felt that the discussion had reached a suitable stopping point, and agreed that on the day Hu returned from Suzhou they would drink to their success in Miaozhen’s chambers.


谈完正事，少不得有点余兴，
After business, some entertainment was in order.

这时在大厅上的赌，已经由一桌变成两桌，一桌牌九一桌摊，
The gaming in the main hall had expanded from one table to two: pai gow at one and the dice-shaking game at the other.

另外在厢房里有两桌麻将。
There were also two mahjong tables in the side rooms.

俞武成陪着跷脚长根来做庄，胡雪岩反对，
Yu accompanied Changgen over to take the bank, but Hu objected.

认为庄家赢了钱该继续往下推，让下风有个翻本的机会。
The banker had won money, he said, and ought to continue so that the other players had a chance to recover their losses.

刘不才这一阵子跟胡雪岩朝夕相处，默契更深，
Living in Hu’s company day and night had deepened Liu’s understanding of him.

听他这一说，立即会意，当时便改了宗旨，不以赢钱为目的。
He caught the meaning at once and changed his objective: he would no longer try to win.

赌钱想赢不容易，想输不难，
Winning at gambling is difficult; losing is easy.

不过刘不才就是输钱，也要使点手段，
But even when losing, Liu employed some skill.

潜注默察，哪个大输，哪个小赢，一一了然于胸，
By unobtrusive observation he knew exactly who had lost heavily and who had won a little.

然后运用大牌九配牌的巧妙，斟酌情形，该放的放，该紧的紧，调剂盈虚，
Using the possibilities for arranging hands in the full version of pai gow, he eased up or held firm as appropriate, redistributing the gains and losses.

很快地使得十之七八都番本出了赢钱。
Before long, seven or eight players out of ten had recovered their stakes and were showing a profit.

自己结一结帐，输了三千银子，便笑嘻嘻地站起身“推位让国”。
Liu reckoned his own loss at three thousand taels, then rose with a smile and “abdicated his throne.”

这三千银子输得跷脚长根的手下，皆大欢喜，一致称赞他是第一等的赌客。
His loss left Changgen’s followers delighted; all declared him a gambler of the first order.

接下来跷脚长根推庄，
Changgen took the bank next.

照规矩，他一个做头脑的，跟他手下赌，必得送几文，一千银子很快地输光。
Custom required a leader playing against his followers to let them win something, and he soon lost a thousand taels.

胡雪岩想输些钱给他，却不知怎么样才输得掉？
Hu wanted to lose some money to him, but could not see how to manage it.


“怎么！”跷脚长根不明他的用意，看着胡雪岩问道：
“Well?” Changgen asked, unaware of Hu’s intention.

“不下手玩玩？”
“Aren’t you going to try your hand?”

“我对此道外行。”胡雪岩微笑着答道，
“I am a novice at this,” Hu replied with a smile.

“再看一看！”
“Let me watch a little longer.”

跷脚长根不知是忽发豪兴，还是别有作用，突然间提高了声音，
Whether from a sudden burst of enthusiasm or some other motive, Changgen abruptly raised his voice.

看着胡雪岩说道：“老兄，我们赌一记，怎么样？”
“My dear Hu, how about a wager between the two of us?”

“好！”胡雪岩答得也很爽脆，
“Certainly!” Hu answered just as readily.

“奉陪。”
“I shall be happy to oblige.

然后又问：“是不是对赌？”
You mean head to head?”

对赌就没有庄家、下风之分，
In such a game there was no distinction between banker and ordinary player.

跷脚长根在场面上也很漂亮，很快地答道：
Changgen knew how to make a handsome gesture in public.

“自然是对赌，
“Naturally!

两不吃亏。
Neither of us will have an advantage.

怎么赌法，
What shall we stake?

你说！”
You decide.”

所谓“怎么赌法”是问赌多少银子，胡雪岩有意答非所问地说：
He meant how much money, but Hu deliberately answered a different question.

“赌一颗真心！”
“A sincere heart!”

这话出口，旁人的眼光都不约而同地看一看胡雪岩，再看跷脚长根，
Everyone looked from Hu to Changgen.

只见他一愣，双眼不住眨着，仿佛深感困惑似地，接着笑容满面地答道：
Changgen paused, blinking as though deeply puzzled, then broke into a broad smile.

“对，对！
“Yes, yes!

赌一颗真心！
A sincere heart!

老兄，我不会输给你。”
My dear friend, I shall not lose to you.”

这意思是他亦有一颗真心，然而这话也在可信、可疑之间，
He meant that his own heart was sincere too, though the claim might be true or false.

借机喻意，当不得真，
It was a figurative declaration prompted by the occasion and could not be taken literally.

胡雪岩自己把话拉了转来：
Hu brought the conversation back.

“我是说笑话。
“I was joking.

你我连俞大哥在内，待朋友啊个不是真心。
You, I, Brother Yu—which of us is anything but sincere with our friends?

何用再赌？
Why wager on that?

来，来！赌钱，赌钱！”
Come, let us play for money!”

他看着刘不才说，
He turned to Liu.

“三爷，借一万银子给我。”
“Third Master, lend me ten thousand taels.”


等刘不才数了一万两的银票，交了过去，
Liu counted out ten thousand taels in banknotes and handed them over.

胡雪岩顺手就摆在天门上。
Hu laid them at the Heaven Gate position on the table.

于是跷脚长根又叫贵主把那个护书拿来，朝桌子中间一放，表示等见了输赢再结算，
Changgen called for Guisheng to bring his document wallet again, then placed it in the middle, indicating that he would settle after the result was known.

但在赌场中，这是个狂傲的举动，有着以大压小的意味，
At a gaming table this was an arrogant gesture, implying a right to impose on someone of lesser standing.

俞武成看着很不舒服，
Yu found it offensive.

忍不住就说了句：“我也赌一记！”
“I shall have a wager too!” he said.

真所谓“光棍一点就透”，
A seasoned man needed no more than a hint.

跷脚长根赶紧一面伸手去取护书，一面赔笑说道：“俞师父出于，我就不敢接了。
Changgen immediately reached for the wallet, saying with an apologetic smile, “If Master Yu is playing, I should not dare accept the wager.

回头你老人家推几方给我们来打。”
Later, you must take the bank for a few rounds and let us play against you.”

这是打俞武成的招呼，自是一笑置之，
It was an acknowledgment of Yu’s rebuke, and Yu let it pass with a smile.

跷脚长根也不敢再有什么出格的花佯，
Changgen ventured no further liberties.

规规矩矩理了一叠银票，放在手边，然后问道：“赌大的，还是小的？”
He properly laid a stack of banknotes beside him, then asked, “The full game or the small one?”

“小的爽快！”
“The small one is quicker!”

跷脚长根便将副乌木牌九，一阵乱抹，随手捡了两副，拿起骰子说道：
Changgen shuffled the ebony pai gow tiles, picked out two hands, and took up the dice.

“单进双出。”
“Odd comes in, even goes out.”

骰子撒出去，打了个五点，
He threw a five.

这是单进，他把外面的那副牌收进来，顺手一翻，
Since that meant the outer hand came in, he drew it toward himself and turned it over.

真正“两瞪眼”了！是个蹩十。
His eyes widened in dismay: a dead ten!


胡雪岩不想赢他这一万银子。
Hu did not want to win those ten thousand taels.

他的赌不精，对赌徒的心情却很了解，
He was no expert gambler, but he understood gamblers’ feelings.

有时输钱是小事，一口气输不起。
Sometimes the money was a small matter; it was the humiliation they could not bear.

特别是跷脚长根此时的境况，不用打听，就可以猜想得到，
Changgen’s present circumstances were especially easy to guess.

势穷力蹙，已到了铤而走险的地步，
He was so hard pressed that he was ready to take desperate risks.

一万银子究竟不是小数目，
Ten thousand taels was no small sum.

一名兵勇的饷银是一两五钱到二两银子，他手下二千七百人，如果改编为官军，发三个月的恩饷，还不到一万银子，
A soldier’s pay was between one and a half and two taels; even three months’ bonus pay for his 2,700 men, if they joined the government army, would come to less than ten thousand taels.

就这样一举手之间输掉了，替他想想，心里也不是味道！
To lose it all in a single turn of the hand—Hu felt uncomfortable merely imagining it.

有钱输倒还罢了，
If Changgen could afford the loss, that would be one thing.

看样子是输不起的，
But he plainly could not.

一输就更得动歪脑筋，等于逼他“上梁山”。
Losing would only drive him toward more desperate schemes, as though he were being forced to “take to Liangshan” as an outlaw.

这样电闪一般转着念头，手下就极快，
These thoughts flashed through Hu’s mind, and his hands moved just as quickly.

当大家还为跷脚长根错愕嗟叹之际，他已把两张牌，抢到了手里。
While everyone else was still staring and sighing over Changgen’s bad luck, he seized his own two tiles.

场面上是胡雪岩占尽了优势，
Everything favored Hu.

跷脚长根已经认输，将那一万银票推到了他的面前，脸色自不免有些尴尬。
Changgen had already conceded defeat and pushed his ten thousand taels in notes across, looking decidedly embarrassed.

其余的人则都将视线集中在胡雪岩的两张牌上，心急的人，并且喊道：“先翻一张！”
The others all watched Hu’s tiles, and the impatient ones called, “Turn one over first!”

胡雪岩正拇指在上，中指在下，慢慢摸着牌，
With thumb above and middle finger below, Hu slowly felt a tile.

感觉再迟钝的人也摸得出来，是张地牌，
Even the least sensitive fingers could have identified it: an Earth tile.

这张牌决不能翻，因为一翻就赢定了跷脚长根。
He must not expose it, for the moment he did, his victory over Changgen would be certain.

他决计不理旁人的怂勇关切，只管自己做作，
Ignoring the spectators’ encouragement and concern, he continued his performance.

摸到第二张牌，先是一怔，然后皱眉，继之以摇头，
At the second tile he started, frowned, then shook his head.

将两张牌，往未理的乱牌中一推，顺手收回了自己的银票。
He pushed both tiles back into the unarranged heap and casually retrieved his own banknotes.


“怎么样？”跷脚长根一面问，一面取了张胡雪岩的牌去摸。
“What have you got?” Changgen asked, picking up one of Hu’s tiles and feeling it.

“丁七蹩！”胡雪岩懒懒地答道：
“Ding-seven, a dead ten,” Hu answered languidly.

“和气！”
“An amicable draw!”

怎会是“丁七瞥”？
How could it be ding-seven?

跷脚长根不信，
Changgen did not believe him.

细细从中指的感觉上去分辨，明明是张“二六”，有这张牌就决没有“蹩十”，
His middle finger carefully traced what was unmistakably a “two-six” tile; with that tile, the hand could not be a dead ten.

再取另外一张来摸，
He felt the other and understood.

才知道十点倒也是十点，只不过是一副地罡。
The total was indeed ten, but the combination was an Earth Gang.

“难得和气！”他说：
“An amicable result is a rare pleasure!” he said.

“和气最好！
“Harmony is best.

赌过了，
We have had our wager.

好朋友只好赌一次，不好赌第二次。
Good friends should play against each other once, never twice.

谢谢俞师父了，叨扰，叨扰！”
Thank you for your hospitality, Master Yu!”

“时候还早嘛！
“But it is still early.

再玩一息？”
Won’t you stay a little longer?”

“不玩了。”跷脚长根答道：
“No more gambling,” Changgen replied.

“相聚的日子还长。
“We shall have plenty of time together.

等胡老兄从苏州回来，我们再叙，”
When our friend Hu returns from Suzhou, we can meet again.”


等他一走，俞武成悄悄问胡雪岩：“你到底是副什么牌，
After he left, Yu asked Hu quietly, “What hand did you really have?

我不相信你连蹩十都吃不了它！”
I cannot believe you failed to beat a dead ten.”

“是副地罡。”胡雪岩说，
“An Earth Gang.

“我看他的境况也不大好，于心不忍。”
His circumstances did not seem good, and I could not bring myself to take his money.”

“你倒真舍得！
“You certainly know how to part with money!

铜钱掼在水里还听个响声，
Throw a copper coin into water and you at least hear a splash.

你一万两银子就这样阴干了？”
Your ten thousand taels have simply dried up without a sound!”

其词若有憾焉，其实是故意这样讥嘲，
His words suggested regret, but he was deliberately teasing.

胡雪岩一时辨不清他的意思，唯有报之以一笑。
Hu could not immediately tell what he meant and could only smile.

“老胡，怪不得我老娘都佩服你！”俞武成这时才说了他的想法，
“My dear Hu, no wonder even my mother admires you!” Yu now explained his thinking.

“现在，你交情是放出去了！
“You have extended your friendship.

要看跷脚是人，还是畜生？
We shall see whether the cripple is a man or a beast.

是人，当然不会做出什么狗屁倒灶的事，
If he is a man, he will not do anything foul.

是畜生，我们就当他一条毒蛇打，要打在七寸上！
If he is a beast, we shall treat him as a venomous snake and strike straight at its vital spot.

死不足惜。
His death would be no loss.”

““我就是这个意思。”胡雪岩说，
“Exactly my intention,” Hu replied.

“这一来，我们就是下了辣手，只怪他自己不好，
“If we have to act harshly now, he will have only himself to blame.

不但我们自己心里不会难过，就是有人替他出头，‘四方台子八方理’，我们也可以把话摆在台面上来讲。”
Not only shall we have easy consciences; even if someone comes forward on his behalf, there are reasons to be heard on every side of the table, and we can put ours before everyone.”

“一点都不错！
“Quite right!

你对江湖上的过节，熟透，
You know every nicety of brotherhood conduct.

真不晓得你是哪里学来的？”
I cannot imagine where you learned it all.”

胡雪岩笑笑答道：
Hu smiled.

“闲话少说，
“Enough of that.

我明天一早就走，大概三、五天就回来。
I shall leave early tomorrow and should be back in three to five days.

这里都拜托大哥了。“
Everything here is in your hands, Brother Yu.”


第五天上，胡雪岩如他自己所预定的期限，回到了同里，周一鸣是跟他一起来的。
On the fifth day, within the time he had set himself, Hu returned to Tongli with Zhou Yiming.

一到便调兵遣将，
They began deploying their people at once.

周一鸣和杨凤毛守住运河两头的卡子，朱老大打接应，刘不才串清客，陪着胡雪岩和俞武成去赴那场“鸿门宴”。
Zhou and Yang were to hold the checkpoints at the two ends of the canal, Eldest Brother Zhu would provide support, and Liu would play the part of a convivial guest, accompanying Hu and Yu to their Banquet at Hongmen.

等布置停当，跷脚长根的帖子也送到了，
Once everything was arranged, Changgen’s invitation arrived.

日期是在两天以后，
The dinner was set for two days later.

所以不一到就请，理由是妙珍家的厨子，整治一桌水陆杂陈的盛宴，需要两天的工夫。
The reason for the delay, rather than entertaining Hu immediately on his return, was that Miaozhen’s cook needed two days to prepare a lavish feast of delicacies from land and water.

当然，谈正事归谈正事，
Business, of course, still had to be discussed separately.

送帖子的当天，跷脚长根专诚来讨消息。
On the day the invitation was delivered, Changgen came in person to ask for news.

跷脚长根随身带一个蓝布包裹，
He brought a blue cloth bundle.

不知包着什么东西？客人不说。主人也不便问，
What it contained was a mystery; since the guest said nothing, the hosts could hardly ask.

说过几句闲话，随即问起此行的结果。
After a few pleasantries, he inquired about the results of Hu’s journey.

“四个月的恩饷……”
“Four months’ bonus pay...”

四个月的恩饷，跷脚长根可以保为四品的武官，驻区此刻不能预定，但一定会周到他处。胡雪岩说了这三个主要条件，
Hu set out the three principal terms: four months’ bonus pay; the possibility of recommending Changgen for a fourth-rank military appointment; and a posting still to be determined, but certainly outside his present area.

留视观察跷脚长根的态度，倒要看看他用些什么话来敷衍。
He watched Changgen closely, curious to see what evasions he would offer.


“既然要投过来，好坏都说不得了。
“If we are going to come over, we cannot keep complaining about the terms.

有你老兄在，决不会叫我们弟兄吃亏，
With you there, my dear friend, our men will never be allowed to suffer.

我就谨遵台命了。”
I shall do as you say.”

说着，跷脚长根亲自解开蓝布包裹，
Changgen untied the blue cloth himself.

里面是一叠旧簿子，封面上写着四个大字：“同心一德”。
Inside was a stack of old registers, their covers bearing the words “One Heart, One Purpose.”

“这是花名册。
“These are the muster rolls.

我就只有这一份，
I have only this one set.

时间局促，来不及誊清，只好请你看底册了。”
There was no time to have a fair copy made, so I must ask you to look at the originals.”

胡雪岩和俞武成相顾愕然，竟不知跷脚长根是何用意？
Hu and Yu exchanged astonished glances, unable to understand his intention.

看那册子，油腻垢污，拿在手里部有些厌恶，
The books were greasy and grimy, unpleasant even to hold.

翻开来看，里面涂涂改改，
Inside, the entries were covered in alterations and corrections.

有些地方注一个“逃”字，有些地方注一个“亡”字，有些地方注着“改归某队”，
Some were marked “deserted,” some “dead,” and others “transferred to such-and-such a unit.”

是真实不虚的底册。
These were genuine working registers.


“好极，好极！”
“Excellent, excellent!”

胡雪岩只好当他确有诚意，
Hu could only treat this as evidence of real sincerity.

“这份底册，我借用两天，
“Let me borrow these originals for two days.

请几个人分开来赶抄。”
I shall divide them among several people and have them copied quickly.”

“不用你老兄费心，
“There is no need to trouble yourself.

里面有些变动的情形，别人弄不清楚，
Other people would not understand some of the changes.

我派人来抄。
I shall send my own men to copy them.

不过，“跷脚长根看着朱老大说，”我预备派三个人来，
But,” Changgen added, turning to Eldest Brother Zhu, “I intend to send three men.

要在府上打扰两天。
They will have to impose on your hospitality for two days.”

“这好象是更进一步表现了诚意，当朱家是他自己办机密事务的地方。
This seemed a further demonstration of good faith, treating the Zhu house as a place where he could transact confidential business.

俞武成不等主人开口，便代为应允：
Before the host could answer, Yu agreed for him.

“小事，小事！
“A small matter, a small matter!

尽管请过来。”
Send them over by all means.”

“谢谢！
“Thank you!

就这样说了。
Then it is settled.

今天我还有点事，不打搅了，
I have something else to attend to today, so I shall not keep you.

后天下午，早点请过来，
Please come early in the afternoon the day after tomorrow.

还有许多事要请教。”
There are still many things on which I want your advice.”


等跷脚长根一走，胡雪岩大为紧张，也大为兴奋，
Once Changgen had gone, Hu felt both deeply anxious and greatly excited.

将俞武成拉到一边，悄悄问道：“大哥，你看怎么样？
Drawing Yu aside, he asked quietly, “What do you think, Brother Yu?

这家伙，不象是耍花样？”
The fellow does not seem to be playing tricks.”

“是啊！我也有点想不懂。
“Yes, I cannot quite understand it either.

他把底册都拿了来了，
He has even brought the original registers.

竟象是真有这回事！
It almost looks as though he means it!

我想，“俞武成说：”不如托老周再去摸一摸底看。
I think we should ask Zhou to investigate again.”

““对！”
“Quite right!”

于是，周一鸣受命去打听跷脚长根的真实意向，
Zhou was accordingly sent to discover Changgen’s real intentions.

如果真的愿意就抚，则前后的态度大不相同，
If he genuinely wished to surrender, his attitude had changed completely.

何以有此突然的大变化？
What could account for such a sudden reversal?

要找出能够令人满意的解释来，方可以使人信其为真。
They needed a convincing explanation before they could believe it.

周一鸣的消息不曾来，苏州却有了信息，
Before Zhou’s report arrived, however, news came from Suzhou.

何桂清用专差送了一封信给胡雪岩，
He Guiqing sent Hu a letter by special messenger.

说是由江苏营务处得来的消息，青浦、嘉定之间，不断有一股一股的“匪徒”在移动，携带武器，行迹诡秘，自称是由各地集中，听候官方点验。
The Jiangsu Military Affairs Office had reported that armed bands of “bandits” were continually moving between Qingpu and Jiading, behaving furtively and claiming that they were gathering from various places to await an official inspection.

深怕这是借机蠢动，请胡雪岩赶紧打探明白，是不是确有其事。
He feared that they were using this pretext to stir up trouble and urged Hu to find out at once whether there really was such a gathering for surrender.

如果并无其事，则将出动清军兜剿。
If there was not, Qing troops would be sent to surround and suppress them.

信尾特别赘了一句：“此事关系重大，
At the end of the letter he added a special injunction: “This matter is of great consequence.

务望火速回示。”
I earnestly request an immediate reply.”



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第二十九章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Twenty-Nine, Part One
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第二十九章｜CHAPTER TWENTY-NINE


这轻飘飘的一封八行，在胡雪岩感觉中，仿佛肩上压下一副沉重的担子。
That flimsy letter seemed to lay a heavy burden on Hu's shoulders.

地方的安危，跷脚长根的祸福，以及何桂清的前程，都系于他的一句话中。
The safety of the district, Lame Changgen's fate and He Guiqing's future all depended on a word from him.

说一声：是预备点验，不是别有用心，则清军自然撤围，
If he said that the men were assembling for inspection and had no hidden purpose, the Qing troops would withdraw their encirclement.

但万一跷脚长根乘机作乱，则追究责任，岂仅何桂清不得了，自己亦有脑袋搬家的可能。
But if Changgen seized the chance to rebel, He would face ruin, and Hu himself might lose his head.

倘或答说：情况不明，难作判断，则清军便可能围剿，
If, on the other hand, he said the situation was unclear and impossible to judge, the troops might attack.

有如杀降，
It would be like killing men who had surrendered.

自己在场面上如何交代，还在其次，身上等于背了一笔血债，
How he could explain himself was a secondary matter; he would carry a debt of blood.

以后的日子怎么过得下去？
How could he live afterwards?

跟俞武成商量的结果，只有这样答复：已经遵谕开始调查，真相未明之前，请何桂清转告营务处，按兵不动，加意防范。
After consulting Yu Wucheng, he replied that inquiries had begun as instructed, and asked He to tell the military affairs office to hold its position and exercise particular vigilance until the truth was clear.

这是搪塞眼前，究竟真相如何，亟待澄清，
This put off the immediate difficulty, but the facts urgently needed establishing.

周一鸣却又不知到哪里去了？
Where had Zhou Yiming gone?

胡雪岩心想，形势象炉子上烘着一罐火药，随时可以爆发，
Hu felt as though a jar of gunpowder were heating on a stove, ready to explode at any moment.

这罐火药不早早设法拿开，令人片刻难安。
Until it was removed, he could have no peace.

因而当机立断，决定了一个开门见山的办法。
He therefore decided to tackle the matter directly.


这天晚上打听到，跷脚长根歇在妙珍那里，
That evening he learned that Changgen was staying with Miaozhen.

胡雪岩请朱老大派了个人引导，径造妙珍香阁。
He asked Eldest Brother Zhu for a guide and went straight to her rooms.

这是不速之客，跷脚长根深感意外。
His unexpected arrival greatly surprised Changgen.

内心紧张，表面却甚闲豫，
Though tense within, Hu appeared perfectly at ease.

胡雪岩先打量妙珍，
He first took stock of Miaozhen.

貌不甚美，但长身玉立，身段极好，而且花信年华，正是风尘女子中最妙的那段年岁。
Her face was not especially beautiful, but she was tall and graceful, with an excellent figure, and at the flowering age considered the finest in a courtesan's life.

至于谈吐应酬，更见得气度不凡，
Her conversation and social manner showed unusual distinction.

配了跷脚长根那样一个草莽英雄，他倒替她觉得可惜。
Hu felt it a pity that she should be paired with a rough adventurer like Changgen.

等摆出碟子来小酌，胡雪岩才看一看妙珍问跷脚长根：“有封信，想给你看。”
Only after small dishes had been set out for a drink did he glance at her and tell Changgen, “There's a letter I'd like you to see.”

“喔，”
“Oh.”

跷脚长根会意了，“请到这边来，”
Understanding, Changgen said, “Come this way.”

一引引入妙珍的卧室，请胡雪岩坐在妆台边，
He led Hu into Miaozhen's bedroom and seated him by the dressing table.

跷脚长根自己坐在床沿上，俯身相就，静候问话。
Changgen sat on the edge of the bed, leaning towards him, and waited.

“我听你一句话，
“I'll take your word.

你说怎么样，我就怎么样答复前途。”
Whatever you tell me, that is what I'll report to the authorities.”

胡雪岩一面说，一面把信递了过去。
Hu handed him the letter.

看完了信，跷脚长根的脸色显得很不安，
After reading it, Changgen looked troubled.

静静想了一会答道：
He considered silently for a moment.

“老兄，你看我是什么意思？”
“Brother, what do you think my intentions are?”

这话问得很有分量，
It was a weighty question.

胡雪岩很慎重地答道：
Hu answered carefully.

“如果我不相信，我就不拿这封信给你看了。”
“If I didn't trust you, I wouldn't show you this letter.”

跷脚长根点点头，表示满意：
Changgen nodded, satisfied.

“好的！
“Good.

我晓得你为难。
I know your difficulty.

该怎么办，请你吩咐。”
Tell me what I should do.”

“言重，言重！”
“You honour me.”

胡雪岩想了想答道：
Hu thought for a moment.

“也难怪官军！
“We can hardly blame the troops.

实在时世太乱，不能不防，
These times are so unsettled that they must take precautions.

弄出误会来，说句实话，总是我们吃亏。
If a misunderstanding arises, frankly, we shall be the ones to suffer.

所以，我想不如等一等，
Why not wait?

到有了点验的日子，大家再来，官军就不会疑心了。”
Once an inspection date is fixed, everyone can assemble, and the troops will have no reason for suspicion.”

“是！”
“Very well.

跷脚长根说：“吃酒去！”
Let's have a drink.”


走到外间，他立刻找了贵生来，嘱咐他连夜派人，分头通知部下，各回原处。
Back in the outer room, Changgen immediately summoned Guisheng and ordered him to send men out that night in every direction, telling his followers to return to their original quarters.

这样明快的处置，胡雪岩也深感满意。
Hu was deeply satisfied by this prompt decision.

喝酒闲谈之际，由于撤除了内心的戒备，两个人越谈越投机，
With his inner guard lowered, their conversation over wine grew increasingly congenial.

胡雪岩不待周一鸣来回报，就已知道了跷脚长根改变态度，愿意就抚的原因，当然，这是出于他的自叙。
Before Zhou returned to report, Hu learned why Changgen had changed his attitude and decided to accept the amnesty—at least, according to Changgen's own account.

一言以蔽之，是为了胡雪岩的态度。
In a word, it was Hu's conduct.

那副牌九上的“高抬贵手”，当然是促成跷脚长根改变态度的主要原因，但不是唯一原因。
His generosity over that pai gow hand had been the chief cause, but not the only one.

他认为胡雪岩讲江湖义气讲得“上路”，固然心服，
Changgen admired the way Hu understood and practised loyalty among friends.

而真正使他能够信任的，还在胡雪岩的才干。
What truly won his trust, however, was Hu's ability.

讲义气也要有个讲法，
Even loyalty needed the right means of expression.

同生共死算得是最义气的，但同年同月同日的同死，究竟不如一起吃酒吃肉的同生来得有味道。
Living and dying together might be its highest form, but dying together on the same day of the same month and year was less enjoyable than living together over wine and meat.

跷脚长根很坦白地表示，他就是相信胡雪岩有让他吃酒吃肉的本事。
Changgen frankly admitted that he trusted Hu to provide the wine and meat.

这番推心置腹的话，自然令胡雪岩有着意外的感动，
Such confidence moved Hu unexpectedly.

不过他向来的处世之道是，大家越尊敬他，他越替人着想，
Yet his usual rule was that the more respect people showed him, the more consideration he owed them.

所以一再谦虚，认为跷脚长根“够朋友”，给他这么一个面子。
He repeatedly disclaimed the credit, saying that Changgen was a true friend to grant him such favour.

同时又极力推崇俞武成，让跷脚长根清楚地感觉到，能尊敬俞武成，则比尊敬他更能使他高兴。
He also praised Yu Wucheng warmly, making Changgen understand that respect shown to Yu would please him even more than respect shown to himself.

这一番小酌，吃到深更半夜，
They drank far into the night.

俞武成却有些不放心，特为派朱老大来探问，托词苏州有连夜送到的信，要请他回去看。
Yu grew anxious and sent Zhu to inquire, using the excuse that a letter had arrived from Suzhou and Hu must return to read it.

到家相见，彼此说明经过，俞武成便越发对他刮目相看了。
Once home, they explained what had happened, and Yu's esteem for him rose still higher.

第二天一早，周一鸣带来的消息，与跷脚长根自己所说的，大致相仿，
Early next morning, Zhou brought information broadly matching Changgen's account.

而他，此刻又有了新的任务。
Zhou now had another task.

在苏州那方面，胡雪岩的布置是七分防备，三分招抚，
Hu's arrangements in Suzhou had been seven parts precaution and three parts amnesty.

现在防备不需要了，关卡上所设的暗桩，应该撤回，
The precautions were no longer needed; the concealed men at the checkpoints should be withdrawn.

而招抚的准备工作，只做了三分是不够的，必得立刻替跷脚长根去安排，
Three parts preparation for the amnesty was insufficient, however, and arrangements for Changgen must be made at once.

特意先派周一鸣去见何桂清，报个信息，他自己打算在这晚上赴宴以后，连夜回苏州去料理。
Hu sent Zhou ahead to inform He, intending to return to Suzhou himself overnight after that evening's banquet.


一场“鸿门宴”，变成了庆功宴，
The banquet meant as a trap became a celebration of success.

在妙珍姐妹殷勤侍奉，以及跷脚长根的不断相劝之下，胡雪岩跟俞武成一样喝得酪酊大醉。
Attended devotedly by Miaozhen and her sister, and urged on continually by Changgen, Hu became as thoroughly drunk as Yu.

等酒醒过来，忽切间不辨身在何处？
When he woke, he could not for a moment tell where he was.

一只手无意间一伸，触摸到极软、极滑的肌肤，
An unthinking movement of his hand brought it against skin exquisitely soft and smooth.

于是接着闻到了脂香，看到了粉光，
Then came the scent of cosmetics and the pale gleam of a powdered face.

昏昏罗帐中有个妙年女子陪他睡着，只是脸朝外面，一时看不出是谁？
A young woman lay sleeping beside him in the dim bed curtains, but her face was turned away, and he could not see who she was.

定定神细想，除了猜拳闹酒的情形，再也想不起酒阑人散的光景。
Collecting himself, he remembered the drinking games, but nothing of the party's end.

于是摇摇他身边那段藕也似的手臂，摇醒了一看，
He shook the arm beside him, pale as a lotus root, and woke her.

是妙珍的妹妹，颜色远胜于她姐姐的妙珠。
It was Miaozhen's younger sister, Miaozhu, far more beautiful than her elder sister.

“喔，胡老爷，你醒了！”
“Oh, Master Hu, you're awake!”

和衣而睡的妙珠，急忙坐了起来，
Still fully dressed, she sat up quickly.

“要不要喝茶？”
“Would you like tea?”

“要的。”
“Yes.

胡雪岩觉得嗓子干涩，说话都很吃力，“要冷茶，大大来一杯！”
Cold tea—a great cupful!” His throat was so dry that speech was difficult.

“酒吃得忒多了。
“You drank far too much.

俞大爷也醉得人事不知。”
Master Yu was insensible too.”

说着，她掀帐下床，剔亮了灯，倒了一大杯半温的茶，
She lifted the curtains, got out of bed, brightened the lamp and poured a large cup of lukewarm tea.

挂起帐子，拿茶杯送到胡雪岩唇边。
Hooking up the curtains, she brought it to his lips.

他一饮而尽，喘口气问道：“什么时候了？”
He drank it all, caught his breath and asked, “What time is it?”

“快四点钟了。”
“Almost four.”

“只怕害你半夜不曾好睡，
“I'm afraid I've kept you from sleeping half the night.

真正过意不去。”
I'm very sorry.”


“胡老爷为啥这样子说？
“Why say that?

你是李七爷的朋友。”
You're Seventh Master Li's friend.”

李七爷是指跷脚长根，
By Seventh Master Li she meant Changgen.

胡雪岩便问：“他醉了没有？”
“Was he drunk?” Hu asked.

“李七爷从不醉的。”
“Seventh Master Li never gets drunk.”

“喔！”
“Oh!”

胡雪岩很诧异，
Hu was surprised.

“他的酒量这么大？”
“Can he hold so much?”

“李七爷的酒量并不大，不过，他会得吃酒。”“你这话倒有趣！”胡雪岩讪笑地说，
“He can't hold much, but he knows how to drink.” Hu laughed teasingly. “That's an amusing way to put it.

“又说他会吃酒，又说他酒量并不大。”
You say he knows how to drink, and then that he can't drink much.”

“喔唷！胡老爷，你不作兴‘扳差头’的！”
“Oh, Master Hu, don't pick holes in what I say!”

妙珠的神态，声音都嗲得令人发腻，
Her voice and manner were cloyingly coy.

“我是说李七爷吃酒上会变把戏。”
“I mean he can play tricks when he drinks.”

“我不是扳你的差头，
“I'm not picking holes.

你说话真的有趣。”
You really do say amusing things.”

胡雪岩捧着她的脸说：
Hu cupped her face in his hands.

“吃酒还会变把戏，你自己想想，话可有趣！”
“Think of it yourself: playing tricks with drinking!”

“真的！
“It's true.

不作兴瞎说。”
You mustn't talk nonsense.

妙珠问道：“胡老爷，你跟李七爷熟不熟？”
Do you know Seventh Master Li well?”

“也算熟，也算不熟。”
“In one way, yes; in another, no.”

“你自己呢？”妙珠反唇相讥，
“And what about you?” she retorted.

“说话也是一脚进、一脚出。”
“One foot in and one foot out whenever you speak!”

“这有个说法，
“There's an explanation.

相交的日子不久，不能算熟，
We haven't known each other long, so I can't say I know him well.

不过交情已很深了，所以也可以说是很熟。”
But our friendship is already deep, so in that sense I do.”

“熟了你就知道了，
“Once you know him, you'll understand.

豁拳敬酒，你要当心李七爷，
Watch him during drinking games and toasts.

明明看他已经灌进嘴，实在是倒在地上，或者袖子里。
You may see him pouring wine into his mouth when it's really going onto the floor or into his sleeve.

他晓得自己酒量的深浅，永远喝到七分数就不喝了。
He knows his own capacity and always stops at seven-tenths of it.

不过，他不肯说一句话吃不下了，
But he'll never say he can't drink any more.

那时候……”
At that point...”

妙珠笑笑不再说下去，
She smiled and left the rest unsaid.

意思是到那时候，就有“把戏”看了。
That was when the tricks began.


这句毫不相干的闲谈，在胡雪岩觉得极其有用，
Hu found this apparently irrelevant chatter extremely useful.

喝酒赌钱，最可以看出性情，
Drinking and gambling were the best ways to reveal a man's character.

照跷脚长根这种喝酒的情形来看，显然是个极能自制的人，但也是极难惹的人，
Changgen's way of drinking showed exceptional self-control, but also that he was difficult to push.

到他不说做这件事，而逼着他非做不可时，他就出花样了。
When he would not agree to do something and others insisted, he resorted to tricks.

因此，胡雪岩对他仍不免引起了一两分戒心。
A little caution therefore returned to Hu's mind.

妙珠极其机敏，
Miaozhu was perceptive.

从他眼睛里看出他神思不属，随即问道：“胡老爷你在想点啥？”
Seeing the distraction in his eyes, she asked what he was thinking.

“我在想李七爷吃酒的把戏，
“About Seventh Master Li's drinking tricks.

以后遇到这种情形，要防备他，不叫他变把戏。”
Next time I must watch him and stop him playing them.”

“不容易，
“That won't be easy.

李七爷花样多得很，你防不住的。”
He has too many tricks for you to guard against.”

“喔！”
“Oh!”

胡雪岩的戒心更深了，
Hu grew more wary.

“你们看，李七爷这个人怎么样？”
“What do you think of him?”

妙珠想了想答道：
She considered.

“极能干的。”
“Extremely capable.”

“他的脾气呢？”
“And his temper?”

“一个人总有脾气的。
“Everyone has a temper.

李七爷有佯好，脾气不乱发。
His good point is that he doesn't lose it without reason.

我姐姐就欢喜他这一点。”
That's what my sister likes about him.”

“你呢？
“And you?

你跟你姐姐是不是一样？”
Do you feel the same as your sister?”

“是啊！”
“Of course.”

妙珠做出那种娇柔不胜的神态：
Her manner grew languishing.

“喔唷，碰着有种脾气丑的客人，那么，我们吃这碗饭，真是叫作孽，
“Oh, when we meet one of those foul-tempered customers, earning our living this way is a real torment.

什么伤人心的话都说得出来！”
There's no hurtful thing they won't say.”

“照这样说，你也跟你姐姐欢喜李七爷那样，会得欢喜我。”胡雪岩说：
“Then you'll like me as your sister likes Seventh Master Li.

“我是从不发脾气的。”
I never lose my temper.”

“真的？”
“Really?”

“自然是真的。”
“Of course.”


“那我欢喜。”
“Then I like you.”

说着，妙珠一把抱住胡雪岩，而且深深吸气，仿佛无端兴奋得不克自持似地。
Miaozhu threw her arms round him and drew a deep breath, suddenly seeming unable to contain her delight.

胡雪岩静静享受着那种温馨的滋味，
Hu quietly enjoyed the warmth of the embrace.

同时想到以前亲近过的几位女子，觉得妙珠别有动人之处。
Comparing the sensation with the women he had known, he found something especially appealing in Miaozhu.

芙蓉沉静，阿巧姐老练，而妙珠娇柔灵动，自有一番魅力。
Furong was reserved, A’qiao experienced, while Miaozhu had a tender, lively charm of her own.

他沉浸在眼前的亲密之中。
He gave himself over to their present intimacy.

一番缱绻，万种风情，胡雪岩心满意足地沉沉睡去。
After loving embraces and countless endearments, he fell into a deep, contented sleep.

一觉醒来，红日满窗，
When he woke again, sunlight flooded the window.

第一件事，就是想到要上苏州，
His first thought was that he must go to Suzhou.

但不知如何，一念及此，那颗心便往下一沉，就象小时候新年里正玩得高高兴兴，忽然听说蒙馆里开学那样，
Somehow, the thought made his heart sink, like a child enjoying the New Year holidays who suddenly hears that lessons are beginning again.

真是一万个不情愿。
He was utterly unwilling to go.


算了！
Never mind!

他将心一横，决定偷一天懒。
He hardened his resolve and decided to steal a day of leisure.

于是翻个身又睡，
Turning over, he tried to sleep again.

只是枕上衾底，香泽犹存，缭绕鼻端，荡漾心头，怎么样也睡不着了。
But the lingering fragrance in the pillows and quilts drifted round his nose and stirred his heart; sleep would not come.

辗转反侧之际，惊动了在后房理妆的妙珠，
His tossing disturbed Miaozhu, who was dressing in the back room.

轻轻走了出来，探望动静。
She came quietly to see what was happening.

胡雪岩从簇新的珠罗纱帐子中望出去，
Through the new gauze bed curtains, Hu watched her.

只见妙珠淡妆犹如浓抹，因为天生来唇格外红，皮肤格外白，
Her light makeup seemed rich, for her lips were naturally red and her skin exceptionally fair.

朝阳映照，犹如一株带露的芍药，
In the morning sun she looked like a dew-covered peony.

而隔青帐子，又如雾里看花，逗得他格外心痒，渴望着再亲一亲。
Through the blue-green curtains she was a blossom in mist, exciting his desire to kiss her again.

因此，等妙珠刚一掀帐子，他就伸子去拉，
As soon as she raised the curtain, he reached out and pulled her towards him.

突如其来，动作又太猛了些，妙珠真的吓一大跳，
The movement was so sudden and forceful that she was genuinely startled.

“啐！啐！”
“Oh!”

她拍着自己的胸说：
She patted her chest.

“吓得我来！”
“You frightened me!”

“对不起，对不起！”
“I'm sorry.”

胡雪岩歉意的赔笑，同时将身子往里缩了一下，示意她坐下。
He smiled apologetically and shifted farther into the bed to make room for her to sit.

“真正是‘猛门’老爷！”
“What a fierce gentleman you are!”

妙珠还在拍胸，
She was still patting her chest.

“到现在我心还在跳！”
“My heart is pounding even now.”

“哪里就吓得这样了？”胡雪岩不满地说，
“Surely you weren't that frightened?

“我不相信。”
I don't believe it.”

“不相信你摸摸看。”
“Feel it, then.”

胡雪岩便伸手摸到她胸前，一面摸，一面得意地笑了，
Hu put his hand to her breast and smiled triumphantly as he touched her.

这才让妙珠发觉上了当，
Only then did she realize she had been tricked.

将腰一扭，捉住他的手，“啪”地打了一下，然后白着眼，将他的手塞到被头里。
Twisting away, she caught his hand, slapped it and gave him a reproachful look before thrusting it beneath the quilt.


“妙珠！”胡雪岩涎着脸说，“再陪我睡一会！”
“Miaozhu,” Hu pleaded with an unabashed smile, “lie with me a little longer.”

“啐！
“No.

不作兴的。”
You mustn't.”

说着站起来要走。
She rose to go.

“别走，别走！”
“Don't go!”

胡雪岩软化了，连声喊道：
He yielded.

“我不跟你罗嗦，
“I won't bother you.

陪我说说话总可以吧！”
Surely you can stay and talk?”

妙珠嫣然一笑，又坐了下来，
She smiled and sat down again.

“时候还早，
“It's still early.

你再睡一息。”
Sleep a little more.

她问，“今天想吃点啥？
What would you like to eat today?

鲥鱼，好不好？”
Shad?”

“好！”
“Good.”

“那么，我要早点去关照大司务。”
“Then I must tell the cook early.”

妙珠按着他的被头，不让他将手伸出来，
She held down the quilt to keep his hands beneath it.

“我马上就来！”
“I'll be straight back.”

果然，言而有信，一去即回，
She kept her word.

一面收拾房间，一面有一搭没一搭地与胡雪岩说闲话。
As she tidied the room, she chatted with him intermittently.

这一来，越发使得胡雪岩无法再睡，但他深知那种地方的规矩，
This made it still more impossible to sleep, but Hu knew the customs of such houses.

午饭之前，除了厨子和打杂男工以外，娘姨、大姐都还在床上，
Before lunch, everyone except the cook and male odd-job servants was still in bed.

非到中午不起市面，
The maids and attendants did not begin their day until noon.

自己如果起身，则按规矩要有人来伺候，
If he got up, someone would have to attend him.

岂不是扰了人家的好梦？
Why disturb their pleasant dreams?

胡雪岩最肯体恤下人，
Hu was always considerate towards servants.

为此便依旧“赖”在床上，口中闲话，心里盘算着事，倒也难得悠闲。
He therefore continued to linger in bed, talking while turning business over in his mind, enjoying a rare spell of leisure.


就这佯挨到近午时分，方始起身。
He remained there until nearly noon, then rose.

漱洗完毕，正想去跟跷脚长根见面，忽然来了个不速之客，是朱老大，带来了一个意外的消息，
After washing, he was about to seek Changgen when an unexpected visitor arrived: Zhu, with surprising news.

说尤五和古应春都到了，俞武成请他立刻去见面。
You Laowu and Gu Yingchun had both come, and Yu wanted him to meet them at once.

“好！”
“Excellent!”

胡雪岩十分高兴，
Hu was delighted.

“我跟主人说一声，马上就走。”
“I'll tell our host and come immediately.”

到得后进妙珍的香巢，才知道跷脚长根一早就走了，
In Miaozhen's rooms at the rear, he learned that Changgen had left early.

因为胡雪岩那时好梦正酣，不便惊扰，
Hu had been sound asleep, so Changgen had not disturbed him.

临走留下话，留胡雪岩住一天，晚上依然在这里宴叙。
He had left word inviting Hu to stay another day and dine there again that evening.

为了报答珠珠，同时，既还跷脚长根的席，又替尤、古二人接风，
Hu wished to repay Miaozhu's attentions, return Changgen's hospitality and welcome You and Gu.

胡雪岩使用妙珠的称呼，对妙珍说：“珍姐，今天应该我‘做花头’，
Using Miaozhu's form of address for her sister, he told Miaozhen, “Sister Zhen, today I should provide the entertainment.

请你备个‘双台’。
Arrange two tables, please.

菜跟酒都要好！”
Both the food and wine must be good.”

说着，取了张五十两的银票，放在桌上。
He laid a fifty-tael note on the table.

妙珍无论如何不肯收，又说用不了这么多钱，
Miaozhen refused it firmly, saying so much money was unnecessary.

推让再四，胡雪岩只能收回，
After repeated offers and refusals, Hu could only take it back.

另外给了二十两银子的赏钱，
Instead he gave twenty taels in gratuities.

娘姨、大姐、相帮一齐来谢赏，个个笑逐颜开。
