这，我来想办法。”
I'll try to find a way.”

“对啊！”
“Exactly!”

尤五十分欣慰，
You was delighted.

“我们要请小爷叔来出头，
“That's why we want you to lead us.

就是这些关节，都要仰仗大力来打通。”
We need your help to clear those obstacles.”

“打不打得通，还不敢说。”
“I can't promise they can be cleared.

胡雪岩又问：“你们还谈些什么生意，”
What other businesses did you discuss?”

“丝、茶两项销洋庄，现在看样子是一定可以恢复的了。
“Exports of silk and tea seem certain to recover.

我们想集一笔资本，请小爷叔替我们来做。”
We thought of pooling capital and asking you to trade for us.”

“这当然可以。
“That is possible.

不过我先要问一问，这两项生意，赚了钱，是私人的，还是公众的。”
But first, would the profits belong to individuals or to the whole body?”

这话问得尤五一愣，
You was taken aback.

“是啊！”
“True.

他搔搔头皮说，“我倒没有想到这一点，
I hadn't considered that.

现在是请小爷叔来替漕帮弟兄想办法，
We're asking you to find a livelihood for our brothers.

如果赚钱公众分，当然没话说。
If the profits are shared by everyone, naturally there's no objection.

不然，就只好搁在后头了。”
Otherwise that business must wait.”

“我也是这个意思。
“That's my view too.”

五哥，”胡雪岩迟延了一下，终于问了出来，“我倒要请教，你的意思，是为公，还是……”
Hu hesitated, then asked, “Brother Five, are your own intentions public or...”

“我的情形，你晓得的，
“You know my situation.

无所谓公私。
There's no distinction between public and private.

有钱，老太爷的用度先提起一份，
When there's money, I first set aside the Old Master's expenses.

此外就是大家用，
The rest is for everyone.

手长的多用几个，脚慢的少用几个。”
Those who reach farther take more; those who move slowly take less.”

“这不是办法，
“That won't do.

你总要定个章程出来。
You must establish rules.

不要说你是一帮之主，就是我自己的生意，对伙计们也要一碗水往平处端，大家才会心服，”
Never mind being the leader of a branch—even in my own business I must treat the employees fairly if I want them sincerely to accept things.”

“是！小爷叔说得是。”尤五深深点头。
You nodded earnestly. “You're right.”

“这件事你不妨请老古替你参赞。
“Ask Old Gu to advise you on that.

现在不必会谈它。
We needn't discuss it now.

丝、茶两项生意，当然要做的，不过应该还有别的，大家有饭吃的生意好做。
We should certainly trade in silk and tea, but there must be other businesses that can provide food for everyone.

等我空一空来替你们动脑筋。”
When I have some leisure, I'll think them through for you.”


“是的。
“Good.

我先跟你说明白了，
I wanted to explain first.

回头席面上，他们还有话说。”
The others will have more to say at dinner.”

这一夜的盛宴，算是漕帮公众特请，
That night's banquet was given expressly by the brotherhood as a whole.

虽非鸿门宴，但这顿饭也着实难吃，
It was no trap, yet the meal was hard to endure.

大家越是恭维，胡雪岩越觉责任沉重。
The more they praised Hu, the heavier his responsibility felt.

所以一面谦虚，一面腹中寻思：江湖上行事，有时要“充”，不会的也得要大包大揽，满口答应，
As he answered modestly, he reflected that sometimes a man moving in their world had to put on a bold front, promising everything even beyond his ability.

有时要“冲”，不管做得到做不到，硬做了去。
Sometimes he had to charge ahead, whether he could accomplish a thing or not.

但是，有时既不能充，更不能冲，一要诚实，二要稳健。
But sometimes neither pretence nor a headlong charge would do: honesty must come first, steadiness second.

象此时的情形，
This was such an occasion.

充对了、冲过了，未见得见好，
Even if he carried off the bluff or forced his way through, he might gain little credit.

充不好、冲不过，则误人大事，吃力而不讨好，
If he failed, he would ruin important affairs for others and earn only blame for his efforts.

不智之甚！
That would be folly.

因此，他等大家的话告一段落，从容冷静他说道：
When their speeches ended, he spoke calmly.

“刚才尤五哥跟我说，
“Brother You has explained your wishes.

承各位台爱，我说不出推辞的话来。
You honour me so greatly that I cannot refuse.

此刻想想，有两句话，一定先要向各位说明白。”
But there are two things I must make clear first.”

这不能不预先声明的两点苦衷是：第一，他个人的生意，以及招揽在身上的闲事很多，而且也都到了不容再拖，必须料理的时候，
First, his own business and the many other affairs he had undertaken had reached a point where further delay was impossible.

所以一时还无法为漕帮效劳，
He could not immediately devote himself to the brotherhood.

其次，他感叹着说：“做事容易做人难”，
Second, he sighed, “Doing the work is easier than dealing with people.”

将来必不能尽如人意，希望大家谅解。
He could not hope to satisfy everyone and asked for their understanding.

对于第一点，自是同声应承，
They all readily accepted the first point.

提到第二点，尽管他措词委婉，仍有好些人觉得不安，
The second, however tactfully expressed, made several uneasy.

尤其是俞武成，很费劲地申述，大家决没有任何成见，希望他不要多心。
Yu in particular laboured to assure him that nobody harboured any prejudice and that he must not suspect them.

胡雪岩对“麻布筋多，光棍心多”这句江湖上人人皆知的谚语，深具戒心，
Hu was wary of the familiar saying, “Hemp has many fibres; worldly men have many suspicions.”

所以本来还想在这方面再发挥几句的，见此光景，也只好缄口不言了。
He had meant to say more on the subject, but now held his tongue.

这一顿酒吃下来，已是斗转参横，
By the time the drinking ended, the stars had wheeled far across the sky.

除掉跷脚长根，其余都回到朱家歇宿。
Everyone except Changgen returned to the Zhu house to sleep.


尤五因为同里事毕，而松江、上海都还有许多事要等他去料理，决定第二天一早离去，
With the Tongli business finished and much still awaiting him in Songjiang and Shanghai, You decided to leave early next morning.

特地到胡雪岩那里话别。 不想一谈起来就没有完，
He came especially to say goodbye to Hu, but once they began talking there was no end to it.

胡雪岩一再催促，他总舍不得走，
Hu repeatedly urged him to go, yet he was reluctant to leave.

话虽多，其实以后有机会再谈亦可以，只是久别重逢，乍逢又别，觉得依依不舍而已。
There would be other chances to say all this; they had simply met again after a long separation and hated to part so soon.

就这样一谈谈到夭亮，
They talked until dawn.

尤五索性直接上船，睡到松江。
You decided to board at once and sleep on the way to Songjiang.

由于有他的朋友在一起，胡雪岩在礼节上不能不送行。
Since his friends were travelling with him, courtesy obliged Hu to see them off.

河千握别，人已疲乏不堪，正待回朱家蒙头大睡，
After their handclasps by the river, Hu was exhausted and ready to return to Zhu's and bury himself in bed.

在一起的古应春眼尖，拉了他一把，急急说：
Gu, beside him, caught his arm.

“你看！”
“Look!”

注目看时，一顶小轿，如飞而过，
A small sedan chair swept past.

只从两方镶嵌的玻璃小窗中，看出是个女人，却不辨是何面貌。
Through its two glass windows Hu could see a woman, but not her face.

“是哪个？”
“Who is it?”

“还有哪个？”
“Who else?”

古应春笑道：
Gu smiled.

“请问在同里，还有哪个女人是小爷叔你关心的？”
“What other woman in Tongli concerns you?”

这当然是指妙珠，
He plainly meant Miaozhu.

但古应春这样硬指他对妙珠关心，却使他感到有口难辩的委屈。
Hu felt unfairly cornered by the insistence that he cared for her.

就在这苦笑无以为答之际，只见轿子已转入一条小巷，
Before he could find an answer to accompany his rueful smile, the chair turned into a lane.

他便脱口问了一句：“昨天搬出去以后，不知道她住在哪里？”
“Where did she move to yesterday?” he blurted out.

“也许就住在这条巷子里。”古应春怂恿着说：
“Perhaps this very lane.

“去看看！”
Let's see.”

拉着走到巷口一望，
Gu drew him to its entrance.

果不其然，轿子已经停了下来。
Sure enough, the chair had stopped.

胡雪岩心想，既已如此，不如看个明白，因而不必古应春相劝，先就走了过去。
Since they were there, Hu thought he might as well see for himself, and needed no further urging.

到那里一看，首先触入眼帘的是，一幅簇新的朱笺，写着乌光闪亮的两个径尺大字：“胡寓”。
The first thing he saw was a new sheet of scarlet paper bearing two enormous, shining black characters: “Hu Residence”.

胡雪岩大为诧异，“老古，老古！”他慌慌张张地问：
“Old Gu!” he asked in alarm.

“妙珠也姓胡？”
“Is Miaozhu's surname Hu too?”

“我不晓得。”
“I don't know.”

“这就有点奇怪了！”
“This is strange!

胡雪岩狐疑满腹，“这样‘霸玉硬上弓’的事！我还是第一回看见。
Such high-handed compulsion—I've never seen the like.

回去倒要问问妙珍！“
I must ask Miaozhen when we get back.”


“何必那么费事？
“Why go to that trouble?

现在有妙珠在这里，
Miaozhu is here.

为啥不问？”
Why not ask her?”

说着，古应春伸手便去叩门，胡雪岩想要阻止，已是不及，古应春拉起铜环“当当”地拍了两下。
Before Hu could stop him, Gu lifted the brass ring and knocked twice.

黑漆双扉开启，
The black-lacquered doors opened.

垂鬟小婢正是妙珠身边的小大姐阿金。
The maid with hanging hair was A’jin, Miaozhu's attendant.

“胡老爷！”面团团象“无锡大阿福”的阿金，笑嘻嘻他说：
Her round face looked like one of Wuxi's plump clay dolls, and she greeted them with a smile. “Master Hu!

“你莫非千里眼、顺凤耳？
Have you eyes that see a thousand li and ears that hear on the wind?

一早就寻得来了。”
You've found us so early.”

胡雪岩无心跟她逗笑，只问：
Hu had no wish to joke.

“二小姐呢？”
“Where is Second Miss?”

“刚刚回来。”
“Just back.”

一句话不曾完，妙珠已掀帘而出，
Before she finished, Miaozhu lifted the curtain and appeared.

布衣布裙，屏绝铅华，已俨然“人家人”的样子了。
In a plain cloth jacket and skirt, without cosmetics, she already looked like a woman of a respectable household.

“古老爷，”她含笑迎客：“请里面坐。”说着，抛给胡雪岩一个眼风，作为“尽在不言中”的招呼。
“Mr Gu, please come in.” She smiled and cast Hu a glance in greeting, as though everything between them went without saying.

这样的举止，是以胡家的主妇自居，
She was taking the position of mistress of the Hu household.

胡雪岩心想：这就不必再问她的本姓了。
There was no need to ask her surname now.

如今要动脑筋的是，设法让她将“胡寓”这张朱笺取消。
The problem was how to persuade her to remove that notice.

这样盘算着，便声色不动他说：“你这房子，倒不错。
Keeping his expression unchanged, Hu said, “A good house.

难为你觅得着，
Clever of you to find it.

说搬就搬，一搬就有合适的房子，
You decide to move, and at once there's a suitable place.

倒真凑巧。”
What a coincidence.”

“是啊，巧得很！”妙珠很高兴他说，
“Yes, very fortunate!

“我领你们看看。”
Let me show you.”

于是从前到后，走了一遍，最后到客堂落座。
She led them from front to back, then seated them in the reception room.

家具似是现成有在那里的，屋角堆着箱笼什物，还未整理。
The furniture seemed to have come with the house; trunks and other belongings still stood unpacked in the corners.

“今天还乱糟糟的，没有地方坐。
“It's all in disorder today, with nowhere to sit.

古老爷，你下次来就好了。”
Next time will be better, Mr Gu.

妙珠又说，“做丝生意，总少不得要到同里来，
The silk trade must bring you to Tongli.

如果没有地方落脚，就住在这里好了。
If you need somewhere to stay, come here.

这里，古老爷，你当它自己的家一样。”
Treat it as your own home.”

“多谢，多谢。”古应春说，
Gu thanked her.

“如果到同里，一定来看你。”
“Whenever I come to Tongli, I'll certainly visit.”


修行的话也不说起了！
There was no more talk of religious devotion!

胡雪岩心里好笑，
Hu was inwardly amused.

想挖苦她两句，又怕她动气，便忍住了。
He wanted to tease her but feared angering her and restrained himself.

但嘴角掩不住那种近乎捉住人错处的笑容，
Still, he could not quite suppress the smile of a man who had caught someone out.

使得妙珠忍不住要问。“胡老爷，你笑啥。
“What are you laughing at?” she asked.

笑我做事顾前不顾后，是不是？”
“That I act without thinking ahead?”

“顾前不顾后”五个字，不堪寻味，胡雪岩却不说破，只问：
Those words invited reflection, but Hu did not pursue them.

“你这房子是租，是典，还是买的？”
“Is this house rented, held under a redeemable transfer, or bought?”

“租的，”
“Rented.”

“房东卖不卖？”
“Would the landlord sell?”

“卖也可以谈。”
“We could discuss it.”

“看样子，你倒象很中意这所房子。”
“You seem very fond of it.”

胡雪岩略停一下说：
He paused.

“我看为了省事，我就买这所房子给你好了。”
“To save trouble, I might as well buy it for you.”

“随你的意思。”
“As you wish.”

“照我的意思，你先把‘胡寓’这张条子拿掉？”
“Then first take down the ‘Hu Residence’ notice.”

“不！”
“No.”

妙珠断然拒绝，
Her refusal was firm.

“我姓胡，
“My surname is Hu.

为啥不能贴那张条子？”
Why shouldn't I put it up?”

“你将来不是要改做家庵吗……”
“Weren't you going to turn the place into a private nunnery?”

“对，”
“Exactly.

妙珠抢着说道，“那时再换一张条子，叫做‘胡氏家庵’。”
Then I'll replace it with ‘Hu Family Nunnery’.”

“那也随你的便。
“As you please.

反正天下姓胡的多得很，
There are plenty of people called Hu.

随你高兴姓啥就姓啥。”
Call yourself whatever you like.”

依然是拒人千里的语气，
Again his words held her at a distance.

妙珠觉得他太过于簿情，脸色便有些不大好看了。
She felt he was being too cold, and her face darkened.


胡雪岩神思困倦，肝火上升，认为妙珠过于惫赖，
Exhausted and irritable, Hu thought her obstinate and unreasonable.

有意想跟她吵一架，吵散了拉倒。
He almost wanted to quarrel and let the quarrel end everything.

但未及开口，为古应春看出端倪，急忙抢在前面做和事佬。
Before he could speak, Gu saw the danger and intervened.

“啊！”
“Ah!”

他故意装作耽误大事，突然想起的那种吃惊的神色。目瞪口呆地望着妙珠。
He stared at Miaozhu in apparent horror, like a man suddenly remembering some gravely neglected matter.

这是为了想移转他们的注意力，两个人当然都上当，
Both fell for the distraction.

胡雪岩先问：“怎么回事？”
“What's wrong?” Hu asked first.

“喔，”他忽又放缓了神色，摇摇头说：
Gu relaxed, shaking his head.

“没有什么！
“Nothing.

想起来了，
I remember now.

不要紧。”
It's all right.”

“真正是！”妙珠拍着胸说：“古老爷真会吓人，”
Miaozhu patted her chest. “You really do frighten people!”

胡雪岩对他，当然远比妙珠来得关心，因而追问：
Hu was naturally much more concerned about Gu than she was.

“你想起什么？
“What did you remember?

什么事不要紧？”
What's all right?”

根本无事，如何作答？古应春便信口胡扯：
There was nothing to explain, so Gu improvised.

“我想起个很有趣的故事。”
“A very amusing story came to mind.”

胡雪岩啼笑皆非，
Hu did not know whether to laugh or cry.

妙珠却是想想滑稽，这古老爷莫非有痰疾？
Miaozhu found it absurd: was Mr Gu subject to some disorder?

再看到胡雪岩那副懊恼而无可奈何的模样，不由得“噗哧”一声，忍俊不禁了。
Seeing Hu's vexed, helpless expression, she burst out laughing.

这破颜一笑，便至少是安抚了一方，
At least one side was now soothed.

古应春旁观者清，此时若得妙珠的一番柔情蜜意，则百炼钢可以化为绕指柔，
Gu could see that a little tenderness from her would turn the hardest steel soft.

因而先抛个眼色，然后指着胡雪岩对妙珠说：
He gave her a glance, then pointed to Hu.

“他跟尤五爷谈了一夜，又送他上船，又来看你，
“He talked with Master You all night, saw him aboard, and then came to see you.

这会儿真的累了。
He's truly exhausted.

你让他好好睡一觉吧！”
Let him have a proper sleep.”

说完，起身就走，脚在移动，眼睛中不敢放松，
He rose to leave, watching Hu closely.

一看胡雪岩也要站起，立即回身硬按着他坐下。
When Hu tried to rise too, Gu turned and firmly pressed him back into his chair.

“朱家人来人往，嘈杂不过。
“Zhu's house is full of people coming and going, far too noisy.

你这两天精神耗费得太多了，
You've worn yourself out these past few days.

难得几样大事都已有了头绪，正该好好息一息，养足了精神，
Now that several important affairs are taking shape, rest properly and regain your strength.

我们明天一起到苏州，转上海。
Tomorrow we'll go together to Suzhou and then Shanghai.”

““古老爷是好话！”妙珠从容接口，
“Mr Gu means well,” Miaozhu said calmly.

“一个人，好歹要晓得，好话一定要听。”
“One should know good advice from bad and listen to the good.”

胡雪岩也实在是倦得眼都要睁不开，勉强撑持在那里，
Hu could scarcely keep his eyes open.

经他们两人这样相劝，一念把握不住，如水就下，浑身劲泄，
Under their persuasion, his last resistance gave way like water running downhill.

不但懒得动，连话都懒得说了。
He was too weary even to speak.

看古应春刚要出门，他想起一句话，非说不可，
But as Gu reached the door, he remembered something essential.

“老古，老古，你等等！”
“Wait, Old Gu.

他吃力地说，“老周只怕今天会从苏州回来，
Zhou may return from Suzhou today.

如果有啥信息，你赶紧派人来通知我。”
If there's any news, send someone to tell me at once.”

“我知道了。
“I understand.

你尽管安心在这里休息好了。”
Rest here without worry.”


等古应春一走，妙珠亲自去绞了一把热毛巾，递到胡雪岩手里，同时问道：
Once Gu had gone, Miaozhu wrung out a hot towel herself and handed it to Hu.

“饿不饿？”
“Are you hungry?”

“饿倒不饿，
“Not hungry.

心里有点发虚。”
I feel rather empty inside.”

“不是心里虚，是身子虚。
“It's your body that's weak.

我煨了一罐莲芯粥在那里，
I've been simmering lotus-seed porridge.

你吃一碗，就上床去吧！”
Have a bowl, then go to bed.”

一面说，一面便走了开去，不多片刻，阿金捧着一只闽漆托盘，端来了一碗桂花冰糖莲芯粥。
She left, and soon A’jin brought a bowl on a Fujian lacquer tray: lotus-seed porridge with osmanthus and rock sugar.

胡雪岩本来就爱甜食，
Hu liked sweet things.

那碗粥清腴甘糯，吃完了意有未尽。
It was delicate, rich, sweet and soft, and he wanted more when it was gone.

妙珠仿佛预知他的心意似地，紧接着端来了第二碗。
As though anticipating his thought, Miaozhu immediately brought a second bowl.

“没有打算你会来，不曾多预备，
“I didn't expect you, so I made little.

就只有这一碗了。
This is the last bowl.

我马上再炖，等你起来再吃。”
I'll put more on, ready when you wake.

妙珠又向：“另外还想吃点啥？
What else would you like?

好趁早动手。”
I can begin preparing it early.”

这样深情款款，胡雪岩心头的樊篱尽撤，
Her tenderness swept away his defences.

看看阿金走得远了，便笑笑说道：
Once A’jin was out of earshot, he smiled.

“啥也不要，
“Nothing else.

只要你的人！”
Only you.”

嘴里说着话，一只手便伸过来拉，妙珠腰肢一扭，翩然避开，
He reached to draw her towards him, but she twisted away lightly.

带着顽皮的笑容说：“君子动口，小人动手。”
“A gentleman uses words; a small-minded man uses his hands,” she teased.

胡雪岩一笑而罢，伸过懒腰，站起身来，
Hu laughed, stretched and rose.

妙珠便引着他到卧房，房间甚大，却犹未布置妥帖，不过窗帘已经装好，床上衾枕整洁，尽堪安卧，
Miaozhu led him to a spacious bedroom, not yet fully arranged, but with curtains hung and clean bedding ready.

身子一歪，倒在床上，就不想动了。
He sank onto the bed and would not move.

“起来嘛！等我铺床。”
“Get up a moment so I can make it properly.”

“马马虎虎好了。”
“It's good enough.”

胡雪岩的眼睛已经合拢，
His eyes were already closing.

“我不想再动了。”
“I don't want to move.”

妙珠无奈，叫进阿金来，
Helplessly, she called A’jin.

替他脱靴宽衣，一个身子拨过来拨过去，费了好半天的事，
Together they removed his boots and loosened his clothes, turning him this way and that with considerable effort.

刚把他的头搬到枕上，鼾声已经起了。
His head had barely reached the pillow before he was snoring.


他这一觉睡到下午才醒，
He slept until afternoon.

首先听到的是柔靡的小调，用鼻音低低哼着，
The first thing he heard was a soft, languid tune hummed through the nose.

转身朝外，从雪白方孔纱帐中望出去，只见妙珠正坐在窗前通头发，
Turning towards the room, he looked through the white mesh curtains and saw Miaozhu combing her hair by the window.

发长及腰，一梳子通不到底，不能不抬起又白又腻的一弯手臂，反握发梢，才料理得了。
It reached her waist, too long for a single stroke; she had to lift a smooth white arm and take the ends in her other hand.

胡雪岩看在眼里，痒在心头，
The sight stirred him.

便咳嗽一声，等她揭帐来视，很快地将她一拉。
He coughed, and when she lifted the curtain to look, he quickly pulled her towards him.

猝不及防的妙珠，恨声说道：“总是这样子蛮来！”
Taken by surprise, she protested, “Always so rough!”

等她一放手，她脱身退后，正色而言：“这里地方不同了。”
When he released her, she stepped back and said seriously, “This is a different place now.”

胡雪岩愣了一下，才明白她的意思，
Hu paused, then understood.

是良家妇女了，不同于她们姐妹一起张艳帜的时候。
She was a respectable woman now, no longer keeping a courtesan's house with her sister.

一夜之隔，居然身分不同，
Overnight, her status had changed.

然而对一个睡在她床上的男人，说这样的话，不太可笑吗？
But was it not absurd to say this to a man lying in her bed?

因此，他不假思索地问了一句：“那么我呢？睡在这里，算是啥名堂？”
Without thinking, he asked, “Then what am I, sleeping here?”

“问你自己！
“Ask yourself.

你不说明白，我只好拿你当客人看。”
Until you explain, I can only treat you as a guest.”

“客人？”
“A guest!”

胡雪岩忍不住好笑，
He could not help laughing.

“睡在女主人床上的客人！”
“A guest sleeping in the hostess's bed!”

妙珠也忍不住抿嘴笑了，但很快地又绷起脸来，
She too suppressed a smile, then grew stern again.

“难得一次。”
“Just this once.

她说，“下次再来，就对不起了。”
Next time, I'm afraid...”

“怎么样？
“What?

莫非赶我出门？”
You'll turn me out?”

妙珠词穷不答，只叫阿金舀脸水进来，
Unable to answer, she called A’jin for washing water.

自己虽也在招呼照料，却总是远远地躲着胡雪岩，深怕他要动手动脚来轻薄似地。
Though she attended him, she kept her distance, as if afraid he would lay hands on her.

这样子见他如见了一条蛇的神情，使得胡雪岩大起反感，
Her manner, as though facing a snake, offended Hu.

便忍不住挖苦她：
He could not resist a taunt.

“真象个人家人的样子了！
“You really look the respectable woman now!

是不是想造贞节牌坊？”
Planning a chastity arch?”

话说得太重，
The words were harsh.

妙珠勃然变色，强自按捺怒气，冷笑着说：
Miaozhu changed colour, restrained her anger and answered with a cold smile.

“随便你怎么样说好了！
“Say what you like.

总而言之一句话：我的主意打走了，你一天不拿真心出来，我一天饶不了你。
I've made up my mind: until you show me your true heart, I won't leave you in peace.

你等在那里！
Wait.

自有麻烦来找上你的门。”
Trouble will come to your door.”

象要挟，又象恫吓，但更象撒娇，
It sounded like coercion, or a threat, but more than either like a lover's petulance.

胡雪岩笑道：
Hu laughed.

“你倒说说看，怎么样找我的麻烦？”
“Tell me how you'll trouble me.”

“不告诉你。”
“I won't tell you.

妙珠恨恨地说：“没良心的人，值不得可惜，
A heartless man deserves no pity.

你看我！
Just wait.

总有一天要你讨饶。“
One day you'll beg for mercy.”


明知是因爱生恨，胡雪岩仍不免哑然失笑，
Knowing that love lay beneath the anger, Hu still could not help laughing.

“到底你我有啥解不开的仇？”他问，“你拿我恨成这个样子？”
“What irreconcilable feud is there between us, that you hate me so?”

妙珠也是一时冲动，
Miaozhu had spoken impulsively.

发泄了固然快意，事后却不免失悔。
The release had pleased her, but now regret followed.

由他这一问，少不得从头想起，也不过几天间的事，
His question made her reconsider the few days behind them.

象他这样场面上的人，走马章台，不足为奇，
A man of his position visiting pleasure houses was nothing unusual.

如说有人喜欢她，就得量珠聘去，世上哪里有这样的事？
If every man who liked her had to bring wealth and marry her, where would that lead?

置妾虽不比娶妻，也不是一件小事，
Taking a concubine was less momentous than marrying a wife, but it was no small matter.

当然他有他的难处。
Naturally, he had difficulties.

只为自己一片痴情，都在他身上，相形之下好象显得他薄情，
Her whole heart was fixed on him, making his feelings seem shallow by comparison.

其实他守着他做客人的道理，丝毫不错，
Yet as a guest he had observed every proper obligation.

怪来怪去，只怪自己一厢情愿，钻到牛角尖里去了。
She could only blame her own one-sided longing and stubborn pursuit of it.

这是有苦说不出委屈，
Her distress had no outlet.

既以自怨，又以自责，更以自惭，那眼泪就止不住了，
Self-pity, self-reproach and shame brought tears she could not stop.

面朝外坐在妆台边，泪水沾湿了衣襟一大片，也懒得去拭一拭眼。
Sitting at the dressing table, facing away, she let them soak the front of her clothes without even wiping her eyes.

胡雪岩坐在床沿上，是在她身后，看不见她的脸，
Hu, seated behind her on the bed, could not see her face.

只觉得她无语兀坐，态度可怪，
Her motionless silence seemed strange.

等走过来一看，方始惊惶，
Only when he came round did he understand.

“咦，咦！”他问，
“Why?

“怎么了？
What's happened?

伤这么大的心！”
Why such grief?”

“我也想穿了，”妙珠哭过一阵，心境比较开朗，情感不再那么黏滞，
After crying, she felt clearer and less entangled in her emotions. “I've thought it through.

“各人有各人的处境，
Everyone has their own circumstances.

硬凑到一起，也没有意思。
Forcing ourselves together is pointless.

回去是决不会回去了，不过，我也不会再嬲住你。”
I certainly won't go back, but I won't cling to you any longer either.”

说着，擦一擦眼睛，醒一醒鼻子，走了出去。
She wiped her eyes, blew her nose and left the room.

胡雪岩的心情很矛盾。听她这样的表示，原该有如释重负之感，却反觉得无趣，
Hu should have felt relieved, yet instead he felt empty.

就坐在妙珠原来的座位上，茫然不知所措。
He sat in her chair, bewildered.

坐又有些坐不往，站起来随便走一走，一定走到窗前，无意中向外一望，恰好看到妙珠，手里拿着一张红笺，上面仿佛有字，
Unable to remain still, he wandered to the window and happened to see her holding a red sheet with writing on it.

这很容易理解，她将那张“胡寓”的门牌取消了。
The meaning was plain: she had taken down the ‘Hu Residence’ notice.

这反使得他怅然若失。
He felt a strange sense of loss.

但是妙珠两手空空走了进来，不提此事，他也不便先问，
When she returned empty-handed and said nothing, he could hardly ask first.

搭讪着说：“老古怎么不来？”又问：
Awkwardly, he said, “Why hasn't Old Gu come?

“几点钟了？”
What time is it?”


“快打三点了。”
“Almost three.”

妙珠换了一副态度，平添些周旋的形迹，
Her manner had changed, acquiring the formality of a hostess entertaining a guest.

“还是吃饭，还是先吃些点心？”
“Would you like a meal or some refreshments first?”

“午饭、晚饭并在一起吃了！
“I'll combine lunch and dinner.

我也不饿。”
I'm not hungry.

他说，“哪家馆子好，
Which restaurant is good?

晚上叫一桌席来，
Order a banquet for this evening.

我借你的地方请客。”
I'll borrow your house to entertain.”

妙珠似有难色，但终于点点头：
She seemed hesitant, but nodded.

“是哪几位客？”
“Whom are you inviting?”

“还不就是这几个熟人。
“Our usual friends.

主客是朱老大，
Zhu is the guest of honour.

在他家打搅了好几天，
We've imposed on him for days.

应该表示点意思。”
I ought to show my appreciation.”

“叫酒席倒现成。”
“Ordering food is simple enough.

妙珠提醒他说，“如果你是临时起意，要赶紧通知客人。”
But if you've just decided, you must tell your guests quickly.”

“是的。
“Yes.

我自己去。”
I'll go myself.”

于是妙珠伺候他穿上长衫，送他出门。
She helped him into his long gown and saw him out.

等她关上大门，他才回身去看，
Only after the doors closed did he turn to look.

果然，那张“胡寓”的朱笺消失了。但深红的四只纸角残迹犹在，好比“家有喜事”的条子刚刚撕去那样，
The scarlet notice had indeed gone, though its four dark-red corners still clung to the wood, like the remnants of a festive announcement after the celebration had ended.

令人兴起一种曲终人散的怅惘。
He felt the melancholy of a finished song and departed company.

胡雪岩站了好一会，方始回身又走，
After standing there a long while, he turned away.

走出巷口，就是一家笺纸店，
At the mouth of the lane was a stationer's.

他买了一张虎皮笺，看着柜台上的大墨海说：“你们这里哪位字写得好，
He bought a sheet of tiger-patterned paper and, looking at the large inkstone on the counter, asked, “Who here has a good hand?

劳驾替我写两个字。”
Would someone write two characters for me?”

“喏，”小徒弟指着坐在帐台旁吸水烟的白胡子老头说：
The apprentice pointed to a white-bearded old man smoking a water pipe beside the accounts desk.

“我们老东家的字，呱呱叫！”
“Our old proprietor's writing is splendid.”

那个鬓眉皆白的老掌柜，便捧着水烟袋起身，含笑招呼，
The old man rose with his pipe and a welcoming smile.

问明了胡雪岩要写的字样，就着现成的笔墨，一挥而就，
Once told what Hu wanted, he took the brush and wrote in a single sweep.

年虽衰迈，腕力不弱，
Despite his years, his wrist was strong.

一笔魏碑，将“胡寓”二字写得典雅凝重，很够气派。
In the dignified manner of Wei inscriptions, the characters ‘Hu Residence’ looked elegant and imposing.

写完裁齐，
The sheet was trimmed.

一客不烦二主，托小徒弟带着浆糊，领他到妙珠家，在门柱上悄悄贴好，
Keeping the errand with the same shop, Hu asked the apprentice to bring paste, led him to Miaozhu's house and had the notice quietly fixed to the doorpost.

然后出巷雇了顶小轿一直来到朱家。
Then he hired a small chair and went to Zhu's.


进门就遇见周一鸣，
He met Zhou as soon as he entered.

他是中午到的。因为古应春体恤胡雪岩连日辛苦，特意不让周一鸣去扰他的好梦。
Zhou had arrived at noon, but Gu, mindful of Hu's exhaustion, had deliberately kept him from disturbing his sleep.

此时自是先谈这一件大事，
Naturally, they discussed the important business first.

据说何桂清接信颇为高兴，也颇为热心，当时就上督署接洽，
He Guiqing had been pleased by the letter and had acted energetically, going at once to the governor-general's office.

由营务处指派一位委员，是个姓奚的候补同知，专责办理此案。
The military affairs office had appointed an expectant assistant prefect named Xi as commissioner in sole charge of the matter.

奚同知在一两天内，就要到同里来跟跷脚长根见面。
Assistant Prefect Xi would come to Tongli within a day or two to meet Changgen.

“姓奚的，是我极熟的熟人。”俞武成在一旁插嘴，
“I know Xi very well,” Yu put in.

“此人极能干，也极四海，
“He's exceptionally capable and generous-minded.

是个好朋友。”
A good friend.”

“那太好了！”胡雪岩喜不开言，拱手长揖：
Hu was delighted and bowed deeply.

“大哥，偏劳了！
“Elder Brother, I must trouble you.

我本来就在发愁，只怕分不开身，
I was worrying that I couldn't get away.

如今就都拜托大哥了，
Now I can leave it all to you.

我把老周留在这里，听你招呼。”
I'll keep Old Zhou here to follow your instructions.”

“大家都有分的事，
“It's everyone's business.

说什么偏劳？”俞武成慨然应承，
Why speak of troubling me?” Yu readily agreed.

“我也晓得你这阵子管闲事，耽误了好些正经。
“I know these other affairs have delayed much of your proper work.

这里都交给我好了。
Leave this to me.

你啥时候走？”
When do you go?”

“明天一定要走了。”
“Tomorrow, without fail.”

胡雪岩趁机邀客，
Hu took the opportunity to invite them.

“打搅了朱老大好几天，无以为敬，
“I've imposed on Zhu for several days and have no way to show my thanks.

今天借个地方，专请你们几位叙一叙。
I've borrowed a place to entertain you tonight.

这个地方，老古知道，
Old Gu knows where.

请他陪了去。”
He'll bring you.”

“是啥地方？
“What sort of place?

方便不方便？”
Is it convenient?

俞武成说，“我最怕在陌生地方应酬。”
I dislike entertaining among strangers.”

“方便，方便！”古应春代为回答：
“Entirely convenient,” Gu answered for him.

“包你不会拘束。”
“You won't feel constrained.”

客是请好了，妙珠那里却还令人放心不下，
The guests were invited, but Hu remained concerned about Miaozhu.

怕她只有一个阿金，主婢二人，铺排不开，
With only A’jin to help, might the two women find the arrangements too much?

因而又带周一鸣，赶回“胡寓”去照料。
He took Zhou back to ‘Hu Residence’ to assist.


到了那里一看，才知是过虑。
His anxiety proved unnecessary.

妙珠叫了半副“茶箱”，茶水、烫酒，兼带值席，一起都有人照应。
Miaozhu had hired half a ‘tea-chest’ service to provide tea, warm the wine and wait at table.

另外馆子里派来三个人，一个厨子、一个下手、一个打杂上菜，
The restaurant had sent three men as well: a cook, an assistant and a man for odd jobs and serving.

请一桌客有这么多人料理，女主人根本清闲无事，
With so many attending to one table, the hostess had nothing to do.

在廊上嗑瓜子闲眺，显得十分悠闲。
She stood at ease in the corridor, cracking melon seeds and looking about.

“不过，老周，”妙珠很高兴地说：“你来得正好，
“Old Zhou, you've come at just the right time.

要劳你的驾，给我去借几副牌来。”
Would you borrow some gaming sets for me?”

这是“余兴”中少不得的。
These were indispensable to the entertainment.

周一鸣回朱家去借了麻将、牌九、摇缸，
Zhou fetched mahjong tiles, pai gow tiles and a dice-shaking bowl from Zhu's.

刚刚铺设停当，大队人马已经到了。
The arrangements were barely complete when the whole party arrived.

一马当先的古应春，
Gu led the way.

见了女主人就问：“妙珠，刚贴上去，簇簇新的一张条子，为啥又换过？
At once he asked Miaozhu, “Why replace a notice that had only just been put up?”

“妙珠一愣，想不通是怎么回事，
She stared.

“什么条子？”她问。
“What notice?”

“还不是那两个字！
“Those two characters, of course.

你难道不明白。”
Surely you know?”

她是真的不明白。
She truly did not.

空言相辩无用，所以先不作答，奔出大门一看，
Argument was useless, so she ran outside.

虎皮笺上“胡寓”二字，
There stood ‘Hu Residence’ on tiger-patterned paper.

看墨迹已经干了，不是刚贴上去的。
The ink was already dry; it had not just been pasted up.

“是哪个？”她心里疑惑，
Who had done it?

莫非是……
Could it be Hu?

如果是他，又是什么时候贴上去的？
If so, when?

会不会是古应春呢？他是个热心人，也许说动了胡雪岩，回心转意，有些抚慰的表示。
Perhaps Gu, always eager to help, had persuaded Hu to relent and offer this reassurance.

但再想一想，便知不然，古应春根本不知道自己跟胡雪岩怄气，撕下门牌这回事，
But no: Gu knew nothing of the quarrel or her removal of the old sign.

则何由而出此举？
Why would he have acted?

照这样看来，还是胡雪岩自己改变了主意。
Hu himself must have changed his mind.

到底把他感动得“降服称臣”，拜倒在石榴裙下。
At last she had moved him to surrender and bow before her charms.

妙珠十分得意，当然，更多的是欣喜和感动。
She was triumphant, and happier and more touched still.

走回里面，只见胡雪岩望着他一笑，这就是证实了是他干的事。
Back inside, Hu looked at her and smiled, confirming that he had done it.

只不知道他是什么时候干下的？
But when?

这样一件小事，都有点神出鬼没，
Even in such a small matter, he moved mysteriously.

这个人实在厉害！
What a formidable man!

不能不佩服，也不能不小心。
She must admire him—and be careful.

心里这样在想，脸上也报以莫逆于心的一笑。
She returned a smile of perfect understanding.

古应春看在眼里，越觉好奇心起。只是这样的场合，他要帮着胡雪岩应酬，一时无法去盘根问底。
Gu saw it and grew more curious, but he had guests to help entertain and could not investigate.


“吃饭还早，”刘不才这时已很起劲地在拉搭子了，
“It's early for dinner,” Liu said, already eagerly gathering players.

“我们怎么玩？
“What shall we play?

请俞老出主意。”
Let Elder Yu decide.”

“都是自己人，
“We're all friends.

不好当真。”
We mustn't take it seriously.

俞武成说，“今天妙珠从良，我们该有点意思，
Today Miaozhu has left her old life, and we ought to make a gesture.

我出个主意，请大家公断。我们推一桌轮庄牌九，赢了的不准落荷包，
Let everyone judge my proposal: rotating banks at pai gow, with no winnings pocketed.

都拿出来，替妙珠置点啥！”
Everything goes towards buying her something.”

“不必，不必！”胡雪岩急忙辞谢：
Hu hastily declined.

“没有这个规矩。”
“There's no such custom!”

大家都赞成，只有胡雪岩坚辞不允，
Everyone else approved, but he continued to refuse.

俞武成心直口快，便即问道：“老胡，你是不是怕我们扫了你的面子？”
Bluntly, Yu asked, “Old Hu, are you afraid we'll make you lose face?”

“大哥！”胡雪岩觉得他的话不中听，但不能不表示惶恐，“你怎么说这话？
Hu disliked the words, but had to show alarm. “Elder Brother, how can you say that?

我只好不响了。”
I can only be silent now.”

“对！”俞武成笑道：
“Exactly!” Yu laughed.

“不是我这样子说，没有办法叫你不开口。
“Nothing else would stop your objections.

来，来，我痴长两岁，第一个庄该我。”
I'm a little older, so I'll take the first bank.”

这桌牌九，味道特别，
It was an unusual game.

大家都想输几文，让妙珠有点好处，结果反而扯平了，
Everyone wanted to lose a little for Miaozhu's benefit, and the result was almost a balance.

四个庄，俞武成、刘不才、古应春、杨凤毛分别推完，结帐只多了两百五十两银子。
When Yu, Liu, Gu and Yang had each banked, only two hundred and fifty taels remained in profit.

“这不够！
“Not enough.

再来！”
Again!”

俞武成掳过牌来洗着，
Yu gathered the tiles and shuffled.

“这一下推小的，
“The small game this time.

大家放开手打。”
Bet freely.”

于是下风出手都不能太少，
The players could hardly make small wagers now.

台面上有一千六百两银子，
There were sixteen hundred taels on the table.

掷骰分牌，他看了一下，扣住牌不响，
Yu threw the dice and dealt, glanced at his tiles, then kept them face down without a word.

三门翻牌，点子都不小，
The three gates revealed respectable hands.

俞武成轻轻将牌一掀，一对宝子，统吃。
He turned his over lightly: a pair, beating them all.

“够了，够了！
“Enough!

我替妙珠谢谢。”
I thank you for Miaozhu.”

俞武成将牌一推，拿银票集中在桌子中间，笑盈盈地站起身来。
He pushed the tiles away, gathered the banknotes in the centre and rose smiling.

一方牌九只推一条便散场，刘不才赌了这么多年，还是第一回见过这种事。
In all Liu's years of gambling, he had never seen a set of pai gow end after a single deal.

输钱还在其次，赌瘾被勾了起来，未免难受，
Losing was secondary; his appetite had been roused and left unsatisfied.

但亦无可奈何，只能罢手。
But he could only stop.

古应春的感想不同，
Gu felt differently.

“俞老真是快人快事！”他说，
“Elder Yu acts as briskly as he speaks.

“我就佩服这种爽快的性子。”
That's the spirit I admire.”


俞武成本来就觉得得意，听古应春这一说，越发有兴，
Already pleased with himself, Yu grew more excited at the praise.

不假思索地大声说道：“今天我们索性再做件痛快的事。
Without thinking, he announced, “Let's do another fine, decisive thing today.

我一说，大家赞成，
Once I say it, everyone will agree.

不过，老胡不准开口。
But Old Hu mustn't speak.”

““何以不准我开口？”胡雪岩笑着抗议。
“Why not?” Hu protested with a smile.

“怕你煞风景……”
“You might spoil the occasion.”

俞武成刚说了这一句，古应春已猜到他的心里，
Gu had already guessed his intention.

深怕一个说出口，一个有推托，好事变成僵局，所以急忙拦在前面说：
Afraid that Yu would speak and Hu refuse, turning a happy plan into a deadlock, he hurried to intervene.

“俞老，俞老！你请过来。”
“Elder Yu, come here a moment.”

拉到旁边一问，果不其然，
Drawing him aside, he found he was right.

俞武成就趁此刻，要为胡雪岩与妙珠撮合，
Yu meant to unite Hu and Miaozhu at once.

现成的酒席，便是喜筵，贺客贺礼，也都来了。
The banquet was ready to serve as their wedding feast; the guests and gifts were there too.

办了喜事，胡雪岩明天好回苏州去干正经。
With the marriage settled, Hu could return to Suzhou tomorrow and attend to business.

“俞老，你的美意，我那位小爷叔一定感激。
“Little Uncle will certainly appreciate your kindness.

不过，家家有本难念的经，
But every household has its own difficult scripture.

他到底有何难处，还不晓得。
We don't yet know his troubles.

你老的一句话，重似千金，
Your word carries great weight.

说出来，他不能说个不字，
Once you've spoken, he cannot refuse.

但心里如果有什么嘀咕，想来你也不愿意。
Yet you wouldn't want him to harbour private misgivings.

交朋友，总也彼此丝毫无憾，
Friends should leave one another no cause for regret.

你说是不是呢？”
Don't you agree?”

“丝毫无憾”这句话，俞武成听不懂，但他的意思是很容易明白的。
Yu did not understand the formal phrase, but grasped the meaning readily.

仔细想一想，自己有点冒失，
On reflection, he had been rash.

说出话来，收不回去，面子上下不来，岂非自讨没趣？
Once spoken, the words could not be recalled; if matters went wrong, his own dignity would suffer.

这样想着，便对古应春油然而生敬服之心。
He felt a new respect for Gu.

“不错，不错。
“Quite right.

老古你想得周到，
You've thought it through.

如今，你看这件事怎么办？”
What should we do?”

古应春知道他好热闹，更知道他的性情是那种自以为是好意，便不许人不受的纨袴脾气。
Gu knew Yu's love of excitement, and his spoilt young master's belief that a well-meant offer must never be refused.

再细想一想胡雪岩的态度，对妙珠已经回心转意好事有望，便答应由他去作个探问。
Reflecting that Hu had softened towards Miaozhu and a happy outcome seemed possible, he agreed to inquire privately.


私下一谈，胡雪岩的答复是古应春再也想下到的，
Hu's answer astonished him.

“我已经叫老周接妙珍来了。”
“I've already sent Zhou to fetch Miaozhen.

他说：“俞老一开口，我就懂了，
As soon as Elder Yu spoke, I understood.

既然如此，回头就烦你们两位跟妙珍谈一谈，
Since things have reached this point, you two can discuss it with her when she comes.

什么都好答应，只有一样：不能老住在外面。”
I'll agree to anything, with one exception: she cannot be left living away from me indefinitely.”

“小爷叔！”
“Little Uncle!”

古应春楞了一下说：
Gu paused in surprise.

“我晓得你意思已经活动了，不想变得这么快？
“I knew you were wavering, but not that you'd change so quickly.

是怎么想了一想？”
What made you decide?”

男女间事，无理可喻，
There was no reasoning out affairs between men and women.

胡雪岩的改变心意，是决定于重新贴上“胡寓”门牌的那一刻，
Hu had made his choice when he replaced the ‘Hu Residence’ notice.

而到底又是什么原因让他决定贴上“胡寓”的门牌，是为了妙珠忽作悬崖勒马之计而受了感动，还是一时兴起？已莫可究诘。
Why he had done that—whether moved by Miaozhu's sudden drawing back, or by a passing impulse—could no longer be disentangled.

不过，他是个不肯欺心的人，
But he would not deceive his own conscience.

既然有此决定，即令不为人知，亦不可相负。
Having decided, he could not betray that decision even if nobody knew of it.

至于趁今天纳宠，无非不愿辜负朋友的好意，乐得“凑兴”。
Taking her as his concubine today merely meant accepting his friends' goodwill and joining in the pleasure of the occasion.

感到兴趣的，自然不止俞武成和古应春，
Yu and Gu were not the only delighted ones.

未吃喜酒，先闹新房，都挤在妙珠屋中，欢然谐笑。
Before the wedding wine was drunk, the guests were already crowding into Miaozhu's room with cheerful bridal jokes.

等妙珍一到，俞武成和古应春“做媒”，代为谈判条件，问她有何要求？
When Miaozhen arrived, Yu and Gu acted as matchmakers and asked what terms she required.

“我没有要求，
“None.

这是件好事，我只有高兴。
It's a good thing, and I'm only happy.

不过，我总得问问妙珠的意思。”
But I must ask Miaozhu what she wants.”

这是理所当然的，便让她们姐妹密谈。
Naturally, the sisters were allowed a private talk.

妙珍的意思，怕胡雪岩将来会变心，
Miaozhen feared that Hu might one day tire of her sister.

要他拿出一笔钱来，以防人老珠黄，后半辈子的衣食可以无忧。
He should provide money now to secure her later years, when youth and beauty had gone.

“你心里要放明白，不是我在打什么主意。
“Understand me: I'm not scheming for myself.

初出来那两年的债务，总算弄清楚了，
The debts from our first two years in the trade are finally cleared.

我不想一个钱的好处，
I don't want a single coin.

他那笔钱拿出来，用你的户名去存去放，折子仍旧交给你。”
His money can be deposited or lent out in your name, and you keep the passbook.

妙珍又说，“我们姐妹一场，
You're my sister.

我完全是为你着想。”
I'm thinking only of you.”

“那就跟他要三千银子好了。”
“Then ask for three thousand taels.”

妙珠的身价，应该不止三千两。不过这桩喜事，与一般情形不同，妙珍也就不便再多劝。
Miaozhu's value should have been greater, but this marriage differed from the usual arrangement, and Miaozhen would not press her.

把话转到古应春那里，他不需征询胡雪岩的意见，便代为答应了下来，
Gu accepted the request without consulting Hu.

当时向这一晌掌管着胡雪岩的财务的刘不才，如数要足银票，用个红封袋套好，封签上写明“奁仪”，交了给妙珍。
He obtained the full amount in banknotes from Liu, who had lately been managing Hu's funds, put them in a red envelope labelled ‘Bridal Gift’, and handed it to Miaozhen.

妙珍再转交妙珠，她却不肯收，送给姐姐，作为敬意。
When she passed it to Miaozhu, the younger sister refused it and offered it to her elder sister in gratitude.

妙珍无论如何不要，
Miaozhen would not accept.

姐妹俩推让了半天，最后作为妙珠托她代为放息，妙珍才收下那个“红包”。
After much mutual insistence, she finally took it on the understanding that she would lend it at interest on Miaozhu's behalf.


酒阑人散，妙珠方得有机会跟胡雪岩说话。
Only when the drinking ended and the guests dispersed could Miaozhu speak with Hu.

只是原有无数语言，迫不及待地想倾吐，而到了此时，反觉无从说起。
She had countless things to say, yet now did not know where to begin.

望着高烧的红烛，回想这两天的波折，
Watching the tall red candles, she thought of the past two days' upheavals.

心里不辨是悲，是喜，是感慨，还是感激——
Was she sad, joyful, moved or grateful?

感激日日在念经礼拜的白衣大士，
Grateful, surely, to the White-Robed Bodhisattva before whom she prayed every day.

菩萨有灵，终于如愿以偿。
The compassionate power had answered her wish at last.

胡雪岩的心思也跟她差不多，
Hu's feelings were much the same.

在绯色的光晕中，有着如梦似幻的感觉，
In the crimson glow, everything seemed dreamlike.

凝视着镜中的宜喜宜嗔春风面，自不免兴奋而得意，
The lively face reflected in the mirror, equally lovely in pleasure and displeasure, filled him with excitement and pride.

但想到在苏州的芙蓉，不由得又生歉意。
Then he thought of Furong in Suzhou and felt guilty.

就这样心潮起伏，便想不起该怎么找两句话来跟妙珠说了。
His emotions shifted so much that he too could find nothing to say.

“洞房”中是出奇地沉寂，寂静得灯花爆裂的声音都听得见。
The bridal chamber was extraordinarily quiet; even the crackling candlewicks could be heard.

这使得炒珠大起警觉，也可以说是大起疑虑，
Miaozhu became alert, then suspicious.

如此良宵，决不该有这样清冷的光景，
Such a night should not be so cold and silent.

于是觉得有句话非说不可。
She had to ask.

“你懊侮了是不是？”她问。
“You regret it, don't you?”

胡雪岩很诧异，“懊悔什么？”他反问一句。
“Regret what?” he asked in surprise.

“懊悔不该自己贴上‘胡寓’那张条子？”
“Putting up ‘Hu Residence’ yourself.”

“没有这话！
“Nothing of the sort.

我做事从来不懊悔的。”
I never regret what I do.”

妙珠默然。
She fell silent.

这总算是一种安慰，但究不知他真心如何？
It was some comfort, but what were his true feelings?

也许口中否认，心里真有悔意。
Perhaps he denied regret while feeling it.

那样子倒是自己该懊悔孟浪了。
Then she ought to regret her own rashness.

生米已经煮成熟饭，却还未了咽。
The rice was cooked, but not yet swallowed.

她心里在想，错了一步，错不得第二步，
One false step must not lead to another.

宁可落下笑柄，也不能自误一辈子，
Better become a laughingstock than ruin her whole life.

无论如何得要试出他的真心来。
She must test his heart.

一念到此，立刻有了计较。要试别人的真心，先得自己表示真心，
The way came to her at once: to test another's sincerity, she must first show her own.

她毫不迟疑地打开一只描金皮箱，从箱底取出首饰箱来，开锁揭盖，送到胡雪岩面前。
Without hesitation, she opened a gilded leather trunk, took the jewel box from its bottom, unlocked it and brought it to Hu.


箱子里有玉镯、宝石、戒指、珠花、金镑、珈南香手串，都用新棉花包着，
Inside were jade bangles, gems, rings, pearl ornaments, gold sovereigns and fragrant aloeswood beads, each wrapped in fresh cotton.

此时一样一样揭开来放在桌上，五光十色，令人目眩。
As she uncovered them one by one and placed them on the table, their colours dazzled the eye.

胡雪岩不解所谓，忍不住问道：
Hu did not understand.

“你这样献宝干什么？”
“Why are you showing off your treasures?”

“我的私房都在这里。
“These are all my private savings.

喏，你看！”
Look.”

她捡起一扣存折，递给胡雪岩。
She picked up a passbook and handed it to him.

“你自己的东西，用不着给我看！”
“Your own belongings needn't be shown to me.”

他不着存折，顺手抛在首饰箱里。
Without looking, he tossed it back into the jewel box.

“这些首饰，我自己估一估，值两万银子。
“I estimate the jewellery at twenty thousand taels.

你看呢？”
What do you think?”

“我不大懂。”
“I'm no expert.

胡雪岩说：“快收起来！
Put it away quickly.

财不露白。
Wealth shouldn't be displayed.

如果这时候外面有个贼在偷看，以后就危险了。”
If a thief were watching outside, there could be trouble later.”

“ 不要紧的！
“Don't worry.

这房子严密得很，围墙极高，不怕贼来。”
The house is secure and the walls very high.”

妙珠略停一下，回入正题：
After a pause she came to the point.

“我留着这些东西无用，
“I have no use for these things.

说不定如你所说，叫贼偷了去，反害得我心疼，
Perhaps, as you say, a thief will steal them and leave me heartbroken.

不如交了给你。”
Better give them to you.”

“交给我做什么？”
“What for?”

“咦！那还不是随便你，
“Whatever you like.

做生意派点本钱也是好的。”
They could provide some capital for your business.”

听得这两句话，胡雪岩的感想极多，但最后却是笑了出来，
Hu had many feelings at this, but finally laughed.

想到“唱本”上的故事：公子落难，花园赠金，大魁天下，奉旨归娶。
He thought of the stories in songbooks: a young gentleman fallen on hard times, a gift of gold in a garden, triumph in the examinations, then an imperial command to return and marry his benefactress.

看起来，妙珠多少也有这样子的想法。
Miaozhu seemed to harbour some such notion.


这一笑，显得有些轻侮，
The laugh seemed slightly contemptuous.

妙珠微感不悦，正色说道：“我是诚心诚意的正经话。”
A little hurt, she said seriously, “I mean it sincerely.”

“我晓得你是诚心诚意。
“I know.

可惜，”
Unfortunately...”

胡雪岩想了想，还是将那句话说了出来：
He considered, then said what he had been thinking.

“你这番诚心，用错了地方。”
“Your sincerity has found the wrong object.”

“怎么呢？诚心待人还会错？”
“How can sincerity towards someone be wrong?”

“本心不错，用得不得当。
“The intention is good; its use is mistaken.

你要遇见一个肯上进的穷书生就好了，
You should have met an ambitious, poor scholar.

将来不说中状元，进京赶考中个进士好了，
Even if he didn't finish first in the empire, he might go to the capital and gain the jinshi degree.

明媒正娶，还挣副诰封给你。
Then he could marry you properly as his wife and earn you an imperial title.

那有多好？”
How fine that would be.”

“我不稀罕。
“I don't care for that.

只要……”
All I want...”

“只要怎么样？”
“What?”

“只要……”妙珠很吃力地说：“只要你不变心就好了。”
With difficulty, she answered, “For you not to change your heart.”

胡雪岩默然。
Hu was silent.

觉得所遇到过的几个女子，以妙珠用心最苦，胁之以死，动之以利，先怕嫁不成，嫁成了又怕人变心，
Of all the women he had known, Miaozhu had taken the greatest pains: first threatening death, then appealing with wealth; first fearing she could not marry him, then fearing that he would change once she had.

心眼儿这么多，将来怕难得相处。
With so many calculations, she might be hard to live with.

他的心里很矛盾，有畏惧也有怜惜，
He felt both apprehension and pity.

因而既想设法将刚结上的红丝剪断，却又觉得割舍不下，
Part of him wanted to cut the red thread they had just tied, yet he could not bear to part with her.

就这踌躇莫决之际，听得妙珠幽幽地叹了口气。
While he hesitated, she sighed softly.

“唉！嫁鸡随鸡，嫁狗随狗，
“Marry a cock, follow the cock; marry a dog, follow the dog.

我也跟你一样，做事不会懊悔的。
Like you, I won't regret what I've done.

将来都看你！
The future rests with you.

反正不管怎么样，我姓胡是姓定了。”
Whatever happens, my name is Hu now.”

听得出来，这是从心底掏出来的真话。
The words came from her heart.

她有这样的表示，自己便再无别的主意好打。
After that declaration, he could entertain no other plan.

但是胡雪岩也警觉到，此时不宜轻许诺言，
Yet he realized that easy promises would be unwise.

宜乎硬起心肠来，言明在先。
He must harden himself and speak plainly first.


“你这样一片诚心待我，我怎么肯变心。
“With such sincerity towards me, how could I change?

不过，我有为难之处，你也该体谅。
But I have difficulties too, and you must understand them.

将来有不得不让你委屈的地方，你肯不肯咬起牙关来承受？”
If circumstances force me to make you bear some hardship, will you grit your teeth and accept it?”

妙珠咬一咬牙，答了一个字：“肯！”
Miaozhu clenched her teeth and gave one word: “Yes.”

“那就好了。
“Good.

什么委屈，这时候也不必去说它，
We needn't discuss what hardships now.

总之将心比心，到时候你肯为我设想，就晓得我要你受那种委屈，也是无奈。”
Put yourself in my place when the time comes, and you'll understand that I have no choice.”

这番话暧昧难明，
The words were too vague.

妙珠认为必须问个清楚：
She had to ask.

“你倒说说看，是啥委屈？让我心里也好有个预备。
“Tell me what you mean, so I can prepare myself.”

““譬如说，我明天一早就要走了，丢下你一个人在这里，
“For instance, I must leave early tomorrow and leave you alone here.

岂不是委屈了你？”
Won't that be hard on you?”

“象这样，不算委屈。”妙珠又问：
“That doesn't count.

“还有呢？”
What else?”

“还有？”胡雪岩摇摇头，
He shook his head.

“一时无比说起。
“I can't list everything now.

反正都是这种事出无奈的情形。
They will be things beyond my control.

我们先谈明天，
Let's talk about tomorrow.

我起了以后，你怎么样？”
Once I've left, what will you do?”

“自然是关起门来过日子。”
“Close my doors and live quietly, of course.”

这样的答复，是可以意料得到的。
He could have predicted that answer.

但说出口来，有声音灌入耳中，少不得要想一想，这一想，便有疑问了。
Hearing it aloud, however, made him consider it, and a question followed.

“你是过惯了热闹日子的，
“You're used to a lively life.

一个人清清冷冷，熬得下来吗？”
Can you endure the loneliness?”

话问得很坦率，也很实在，可是妙珠却觉得不中听，
It was a frank, practical question, but she disliked it.

因而语声中便有不服气的意味：
Defiance entered her voice.

“你看着好了，看我熬得下来，熬不下来？”
“Wait and see whether I can.”

熬不下来又如何？
And if she could not?

胡雪岩心里在想，
Hu thought.

将来红杏出墙丢了自己的面子。
An affair would disgrace him.

这件事非同小可，必得好好想个办法。
This was serious; he must find a sound arrangement.

生米已经煮成熟饭，
The rice was already cooked.

说不算也不行，
He could not pretend otherwise.

那就只有一条路好走。
There was only one course.


对这一重姻缘，一直优柔寡断、访煌游移、自己都不知道如何是好的胡雪岩，恢复了他的明快果断的性格，
After all his indecision over this marriage, Hu recovered his usual clarity and firmness.

“妙珠！”他用毫不含糊的语气说：“这些东西你自己先收起来，
“Miaozhu, put these things away for now.

有机会我替你做点‘小货’，
When there's an opportunity, I'll do some small trading for you.

是你的私房，我决不来动你，
They are your private assets; I won't touch them for myself.

至于丢你一个人在这里，我也不放心，
As for leaving you here alone, I can't feel easy about that either.

你等我明天一走，就收拾收拾行李，
Once I go tomorrow, begin packing.

我再来接你，
I'll come back for you.

我想把你摆在上海。”
I mean to settle you in Shanghai.”

到底有了个明确的了断！
At last there was a definite decision.

转弯抹角，终于逼出了他心里的话，妙珠大为欣慰。
After so many twists, she had drawn out his real intention, and was deeply relieved.

但是，他还有个芙蓉在那里，
But there was still Furong.

又将作何处置？
What would become of her?

“此刻在苏州的‘那一个’呢？”
“And the one in Suzhou?”

“你是说芙蓉？”胡雪岩毫不迟疑地答道：
“You mean Furong?” He answered without hesitation.

“我拿她摆在湖州。”
“I'll settle her in Huzhou.”

这就很容易明白了，
It was plain enough to her.

他预备立三个“门口”，除了杭州在老家，上海、湖州各一处。
He meant to establish three households: the old family home in Hangzhou, and others in Shanghai and Huzhou.

上海是繁华之地，而且要做生意，就碍常住上海，
Shanghai was prosperous, and business would keep him there often.

比较上以自己的处境最优越。
Her position was the best of the three.

妙珠苦心设计，做作得太久，这时候再也不愿掩饰她的真情，
She had schemed and acted for too long to conceal her true feelings any more.

收好她的首饰箱往床里枕头边一放，随即便贴住他的身子坐下，两手环抱，抱住他的上半身，将脸偎依在他肩头，深深地吸着气，显得极其满足恬适似地。
Putting away her jewel box beside the pillows, she sat close against him, wrapped both arms round his upper body, laid her face against his shoulder and drew a deep breath, looking utterly content and at peace.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第三十章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Thirty, Part One
逐句中英对照

第三十章｜CHAPTER THIRTY


第二天一早便有人敲门，

做啥？”

“What news?

坏在胡雪岩不在上海，一时不能签约，

He too was willing to guarantee by contract that the merchant could buy all their silk for the next three years, while offering the present stock below Hu’s price.

“这家伙是跟洋商这么说：你不必担心杀了价，胡某人不肯卖给你！

His capital has all been brought in from elsewhere.

本钱搁熬在那里，还要吃拆息，
While it lies tied up in stock, he has to pay short-term interest.

这把算盘怎么打得通？
How can that calculation work?

不要说杀了价，他还有钱可赚，就是没有钱赚，只要能保本，他已经求之不得。

再说，新丝一上市，陈丝一定跌价，更卖不掉。”

小爷叔，你说！”

于今接到欧洲的信息，丝价已跌，所以不能照原定的价格成交，
News had now arrived from Europe that silk prices had fallen, so the transaction could not proceed at the original price.

他个人表示非常抱歉。
He was personally very sorry.

又说：如果当初订下草约，则此刻照约行事，总公司明知亏本，亦无可奈何。

我已经说得很清楚了。”吉伯特答道：

““这……我正也为这一层在伤脑筋。

洋人坏得很，

Our capital is small; we cannot.”

Had Zhu understood the situation, accepted the five-thousand-tael gift, and stopped obstructing them, all could have ended well. Gu would still represent the trade in negotiations with Gilbert, as originally arranged; the contract would be signed, the sale concluded, and everyone would share the benefits.

无奈此人利令智昏，

一只手如意，一只手算盘，心里在想，一转手之间，有一万多银子好赚，
With a wish-fulfilling scepter in one hand and an abacus in the other, so to speak, he reflected that a single resale would bring him more than ten thousand taels.

而且归自己出面订约，马上就变成同业的头脑，
By signing the contract himself, he would also immediately become the leader of the trade.

这样名利双收的机会，岂可错过？
How could he pass up such a chance to gain both money and standing?

歇个三、四天，给你回音好不好？”
May I give you an answer in three or four days?”

这两句托词，早在胡雪岩意料之中，
Hu had anticipated this excuse.

古应春心里好笑，一1165 只脚已经被拉住了，他还在鼓里！
Gu laughed inwardly: one of the fellow’s feet was already caught, and he still knew nothing of the trap.

当时答道：“是的。
Aloud he said, “Certainly.

规矩应该如此，
That is the proper procedure.

不过总要拜托老兄格外上紧。”
But please give it your most urgent attention.”


“我晓得，我晓得，
“I understand.

最多四天工夫，一定有确实回信。”
Within four days at most, you shall have a definite answer.

朱福年又说：“那五千银子，决不敢领，
As for those five thousand taels, I really cannot accept them.

请你带了回去。”
Please take them back.”

Zhu reached for his keys to open the foreign-made safe and fetch banknotes.

“不！”
“No!”

古应春将他那只拿钥匙的手按住，放低了声音说：
Gu stopped the hand holding the keys and lowered his voice.

“老兄，我们迟早要付的，
“Sooner or later, we have to pay it.

四天以后有了确实回信，我再把余数补足。”
Once we have a definite answer in four days, I shall make up the balance.”

“嗯，嗯！”
“Yes, yes...”

朱福年还不大懂他的话。
Zhu had not quite understood.

“老兄，”古应春的声音放得更低，
Gu spoke still more quietly.

“这笔生意，怎么样一个折扣、怎么样出帐，完全听你老兄的。
“How the discount is arranged and how the transaction is entered in the accounts is entirely up to you.

如果是照原价出让，我们再补一万一千银子到福记。”
If the sale is recorded at the original price, we shall pay another eleven thousand taels into Fuji.”

这是叫朱福年作弊，
This was an invitation to dishonesty.

意思是他大可跟庞二去说，为了帮胡雪岩的忙，照吉伯特的原价，先行垫付，帐上十足照给，暗中收下一万六千银子的回扣，
Zhu could tell Pang that, to help Hu, he had advanced the full original price agreed with Gilbert, entering that entire amount in the books while secretly receiving a sixteen-thousand-tael kickback.

这也是做法之一。
It was one possible method.

朱福年一时无从决定，当然是先保留着这条路，
Unable to decide immediately, Zhu naturally kept that option open.

所以点点头说：
He nodded.

“那也好！
“Very well.

我们到时候再结帐。”
We can settle the account when the time comes.”

于是欢然辞别。
They parted on excellent terms.

回到裕记丝栈，古应春找着尤五，不曾开口，先就得意大笑。
Back at Yuji Silk Warehouse, Gu found You Laowu and burst into triumphant laughter before speaking a word.


由于古应春一到上海就忙着跟洋人与“猪八戒”打交道，
Since arriving in Shanghai, Gu had been occupied with the foreign merchant and Pigsy.

匆匆一晤，尤五只知道胡雪岩已授以“锦囊妙计”，却不知其详，
During their brief encounter, You had learned only that Hu had supplied an ingenious plan, without hearing its details.

所以这时看他得意大笑，虽觉欣慰，更多困惑，急于要问个明白。
Gu’s delighted laughter therefore pleased but puzzled him, and he was eager for an explanation.

古应春说了经过，他还是不明白，
Even after hearing the account, he still failed to understand.

“这里头有啥‘窍槛，？
“What is the trick?

我倒不懂，”
I don’t see it.

尤五问道，“四天以后，照你的价钱卖给猪八戒，无非白白让他得一万六千银子的好处，外带捧他做个‘老大，。”
Four days from now, if you sell to Pigsy at your proposed price, you will simply hand him sixteen thousand taels and promote him to leader of the trade into the bargain.”

“哪里有这么便宜的事？
“It will not be that easy for him.

等我修起一封书信来，
Wait until I have written a letter.

刘三爷一到，直投雪得，
As soon as Third Master Liu arrives, he will take it straight to Nanxun.

那时候就要叫‘猪八戒照镜子，里外不是人’了！”
Then Pigsy will find himself facing that mirror, with neither side willing to call him human!”

“啊，啊！”
“Ah!”

尤五被点醒了，却还不曾点透，
You had been shown the way, but did not yet see it clearly.

“庞二是大少爷脾气，要面子的，
“Pang has a rich young gentleman’s pride and cares about appearances.

跟小爷叔的交情也够。
His friendship with Little Uncle is sound too.

不过……”他说，“照我来说，猪八戒帮东家赚钱，他也不能说他错。”
But if Pigsy is making money for his employer, surely Pang cannot call that wrong?”

“不然！”
“Can’t he?

古应春问道：“五哥，你算是朱福年，设身处地想一想，
Brother Five, put yourself in Zhu’s place.

他有几个做法？”
How many courses are open to him?”

尤五想了一会答道：
You considered.

“他有三个做法，
“Three.

一个是自己‘做小货’，赚钱归自己，蚀本归东家。
He could trade privately on his own account, keeping any profit and charging any loss to his employer.

帮人做伙计，这是最犯忌的事。
That is the gravest offense an employee can commit.

第二，他照你教他的办法，跟庞二说是帮我们的忙，十足垫付，暗地里收了个九五回扣，
Second, he could follow your suggestion, tell Pang that he is helping you by advancing the full price, and secretly pocket the five-percent rebate.

这也是开花帐，对不起东家的事。
That would be falsifying the accounts and cheating his employer too.

但是，他如果老老实实，替庞二打九五折收我们的货，赚进一万六千银子归入公帐，那就一点不错了。”
But if he honestly buys your silk for Pang at ninety-five percent of the price and enters the sixteen-thousand-tael gain in the business accounts, there is nothing wrong with it.”


“说得不错，
“Quite right.

可惜还有一样把柄在我们手里。”
Unfortunately for him, we have something else against him.”

古应春将同兴钱庄所掣的那张收据一扬。
Gu flourished the receipt issued by Tongxing.

“这……”
“That?”

尤五疑惑地，
You looked doubtful.

“这也好算是把柄？”
“Can that count as evidence against him?”

“怎么不是把柄？
“Why not?

就看话怎么说！”
It depends how the story is told.”

古应春得意洋洋地，
Gu was thoroughly pleased with himself.

“不说他借东家的势力敲竹杠，
“We need not say he used his employer’s power to extort money from us.

只说他吃里扒外，如果不是送了五千银子，我们的丝卖不到这个价钱！”
We need only say that he took an outsider’s money to betray his employer: without paying him five thousand taels, we could never have obtained such a price for our silk.”

“我懂了，我懂了。”尤五恍然大悟，
“I understand!” You exclaimed.

“意思是说，吉伯特要打八五折，我们跟猪八戒串通好，提高到九五折？”
“You mean Gilbert offered eighty-five percent, but we conspired with Pigsy to raise it to ninety-five?”

“对！
“Exactly!

不然我们为什么要送他五千银子？
Why else would we have given him five thousand taels?

银子多得发霉了是不是？”
Because we had so much money it was going moldy?”

“这咬他一口，倒也厉害。
“That is a vicious bite.

不过，他要退了回来呢？
But what if he gives it back?

岂不是嫌疑洗刷干净了？”
Wouldn’t that clear him?”

“怎么洗刷得干净？
“How could it?

他要今天硬不肯收那五千银子，而且自己先跟他东家说明白：人家送我五千银子，我不要！那才算他硬气，
If he had absolutely refused the money today and immediately told his employer, ‘They offered me five thousand taels, but I refused,’ he could stand his ground.

这一步错过，
He has missed that chance.

嫌疑洗刷不干净了。”
The suspicion will not wash away.”

尤五想一想，
You thought it over.

果然！
Quite true!

“小爷叔想条把计策，也蛮毒的。”他笑说道，
“Little Uncle can devise a poisonous scheme when he chooses,” he said with a laugh.

“当然，只怪猪八戒心大狠，
“Of course, Pigsy has only his own greed to blame.

这五千银子本来是‘人参果’，现在变成蜜糖裹的砒霜，
Those five thousand taels began as ginseng fruit; now they are arsenic wrapped in sugar.

看它啥时候发作？”
I wonder when the poison will act.”

“信一到就会发作。”
“As soon as the letter arrives.

古应春说，“这封信很要紧，
It is a very important letter.

我得快点动手。”
I must begin at once.”


于是他精心构思，用胡雪岩的语气，给庞二写了一封求援的信。
Gu composed it with great care, writing to Pang in Hu’s voice to ask for help.

信上第一段说，吉伯特要杀他的价，而他急于脱货求现，跟朱福年已经谈过。
The first paragraph explained that Gilbert was demanding a lower price and that Hu, urgently needing to turn his stock into cash, had already spoken to Zhu.

第二段是引用朱福年自己的话，也道出了写这封信的缘故，因为朱福年表示不敢作主，要请东家决定，所以他特地向庞二请求，希望“鼎力赐援，俾济眉急”。
The second quoted Zhu’s own words and explained the reason for writing: Zhu had said that he dared not decide without his employer’s approval, so Hu was appealing directly to Pang, hoping that he would “extend your fullest assistance and relieve my pressing difficulty.”

第三段最难措词，
The third paragraph was hardest to frame.

要在惭愧中有感慨，感慨中寓不满，意思是说：
It had to convey regret within an expression of shame, and dissatisfaction within the regret.

回想当初，承庞二全力支持，原以为可以借重他的实力，有一番作为，
With Pang’s wholehearted support at the outset, Hu had expected to accomplish something by drawing on his resources.

不想落到今日的地步，
Instead, matters had reached this unfortunate pass.

当然是自己才具不胜，辜负了好朋友的厚爱，
Naturally, Hu’s own inadequacy was to blame; he had disappointed a good friend’s generosity.

这是惭愧中有感慨。
That supplied the shame and regret.

然而又何以落到这步田地呢？
But why had matters reached such a pass?

当然是猪八戒从中捣乱的缘故，
Because Pigsy had been interfering.

但这话决不宜说破，而又不能太隐晦，
This could not be stated outright, yet neither could it be too obscure.

明暗之间要恰恰能引起庞二的关切怀疑，不能不加以追究为度，
Between explicit statement and suggestion, the wording had to arouse just enough concern and suspicion in Pang to compel an inquiry.

过与不及，皆非所宜，是相当费斟酌的事。
Too much or too little would spoil the effect.

好在古应春英文虽佳，中文也不坏，
Fortunately, Gu’s Chinese was good as well as his English.

改了又改，又征询尤五的意见，毕竟写得了恰到好处的程度。
He revised repeatedly and consulted You until the balance was exactly right.

等誊清校对，看明只字不误，这就要等刘不才了。
Once the letter had been copied and checked word by word, they had only to wait for Liu.

尤五的意见，认为不管朱福年是真的要请求东家，还是别有用心，这封信却必须尽快递到南浔，
You thought it must reach Nanxun as quickly as possible, whether Zhu truly intended to consult his employer or had some other purpose.

无论如何要在朱福年之前“抢个原告”，才有效验。
They must get their version before Pang first.

古应春认为这个看法很实在，但刘不才不到，没有第二个人认识庞二，也是枉然。
Gu agreed, but without Liu, the only available man who knew Pang, they could do nothing.


“这样，我们迎了上去，
“Let us go to meet him.

如果能在松江截住刘三爷，转舵直奔南得，起码可以省出来一天的工夫。”
If we can intercept Third Master Liu at Songjiang and send his boat straight to Nanxun, we shall save at least a day.”

“也好！”古应春说，
“Very well,” Gu said.

“我顺便到府上去等七姐，
“I can wait for Seventh Sister at your house.

说不定小爷叔也到了，
Little Uncle may have arrived too.

有啥话，我们在松江细谈，也是一样。”
Whatever we need to discuss can be discussed in Songjiang just as well.”

于是在裕记丝栈留下话，万一中途错过，刘不才到了上海，让他即刻翻回松江。
They left instructions at Yuji: if they missed Liu on the way and he reached Shanghai, he was to return to Songjiang immediately.

当然，水路上一路而去，尤五处处皆熟，逢人打听，是很少会有错失可能的。
In fact, You knew people everywhere along the water route and asked as they traveled, so there was little chance of missing him.

到了松江，才知道这一着真是走对了。
Their arrival in Songjiang proved the wisdom of the move.

他们是一早到家的，进门就遇见刘不才在客厅上喝早酒，
They reached home early in the morning and found Liu in the sitting room, drinking his morning wine.

问起来才知道他是前一天晚上到的，护送七姑奶奶和芙蓉在尤家暂住，他自己预备中午下船回上海。
He had arrived the previous evening, escorting the Seventh Lady and Furong to stay with the You family, and intended to leave by boat for Shanghai at noon.

“小爷叔呢？”尤五问。
“Where is Little Uncle?” You asked.

“他跟何学使还有点要紧事谈。
“He still has important business to discuss with Education Commissioner He.

大概一两天回上海。”
He should be back in Shanghai in a day or two.”

“暂时不管他。”古应春说：
“Never mind him for now,” Gu said.

“三爷，事不宜迟，
“Third Master, there is no time to lose.

你的酒带到船上去喝。”
Take your wine aboard and drink it there.”

“可以。”
“Certainly.”

于是尤五替他准备船只，古应春交代此行的任务，将其间的作用关键，细细说完，
You arranged a boat while Gu explained the mission in detail, dwelling on every crucial point.

千叮万嘱：“说话要当心，
His repeated warning was, “Be careful what you say.

言多必失。”
The more you talk, the more likely you are to make a mistake.”

“是了。
“Understood.

你放心。”
Don’t worry.

刘不才说，“问起来，我只说我在同里，不清楚就是了。”
If anyone asks, I shall simply say I was in Tongli and know nothing about it.”


* * *一条“无锡快”分班摇橹，日夜不停，赶到南浔，
A Wuxi fast boat, its oarsmen working in shifts without stopping day or night, carried Liu to Nanxun.

刘不才上岸雇桥，直奔庞家。
He hired a sedan chair on landing and went straight to the Pang residence.

来得不巧，也来得很巧，
His timing was both unfortunate and fortunate.

不巧的是庞二的老太太正做六十大寿，巧的是嘉宾云集，象刘不才这副清客材料，正好派上用场。
Unfortunate, because Pang’s mother was celebrating her sixtieth birthday; fortunate, because distinguished guests had gathered, and a companion of Liu’s talents was exactly what was needed.

到寿堂磕过了头，庞二一把拉住他说：
After Liu had kowtowed in the birthday hall, Pang caught him by the arm.

“刘三哥，你来得好极。
“Third Brother Liu, you could not have come at a better time.

有帮客人，要你替我招呼。”
I have some guests I need you to entertain.”

不用说，当然是赌客，
Gamblers, naturally.

刘不才的心跟手都痒了，但办正事要紧。
Liu’s heart and hands both itched to begin, though the serious business must come first.

这天是寿诞正日，
This was the birthday itself.

前一天暖寿，下一天补寿，一共三天。
There had been a preliminary celebration the day before, and a further celebration would follow the next, making three days in all.

远道来的贸客，余兴未尽，少不得还要赌几天，
Guests from afar, still eager for diversion, would doubtless gamble for several more days.

所以刘不才打算着，总得五天以后才能回上海。
Liu reckoned that he could not return to Shanghai for at least five days.

两天过去，他已结交了好些朋友。
Two days passed, and he had made many new friends.

这两天当中，他也确实卖力，根据客人的兴趣，组合赌局，各得其所，皆大欢喜，
He worked hard, arranging games according to the guests’ tastes so that everyone was satisfied.

大家都夸奖刘不才；主人也有面子，
They praised him freely, which reflected well on their host.

所以庞二对刘不才大生好感。
Pang consequently took a great liking to him.

第三天上午，赌局还未开场以前，特地到他下榻的小花厅来道劳。
On the third morning, before the gaming began, he came especially to the small reception pavilion where Liu was lodging to thank him for his trouble.


道过谢，说些闲话，庞二提了胡雪岩，
After expressing his thanks and exchanging a few remarks, Pang mentioned Hu.

“老胡的礼数真周到。”
“Old Hu is wonderfully attentive to courtesy.

他说，“昨天特为派了人来送礼，
He sent someone specially with gifts yesterday.

真正盛情可感，”
I am deeply touched.”

“应该的。”刘不才也很机警，答得十分漂亮：
Liu was alert and answered gracefully. “It was only right.

“若不是那票丝弄得他焦头烂额，照他跟二哥你的交情，一定还要赶来替我伯母磕头拜寿。”
Had that silk not left him at his wits’ end, he would surely have come himself to kowtow and wish your mother a happy birthday, considering his friendship with you.”

这一下倒提醒了庞二，
This reminded Pang of the business.

皱着眉头说：“老胡长袖善舞，我最佩服他。
Frowning, he said, “I have the greatest admiration for Hu’s skill at making the most of his resources.

何至于弄得如此！
How could things have come to this?

而且我也不懂，他是怎么跟洋人搞决裂的？
Nor do I understand how he fell out with the foreigners.

照朱福年说，他心太急了些，让洋人看透他的实力，趁机‘拿跷’，
According to Zhu Funian, he was too impatient and let them see the true extent of his resources, so they took the opportunity to put pressure on him.

不知道有没有这话？”
Is that what happened?”

“这我就不大清楚了。
“I do not really know.

他跟洋人打交道，都是一位姓古的经手，所以这方面的情形，我隔膜得很。”
A man named Gu handles all his dealings with the foreigners, so I know very little of that side.”

“你是说古应春？
“You mean Gu Yingchun?

这个人我也知道，
I know of him too.

极能干的，洋人那里的信用也很好。
Extremely capable, and well trusted by the foreigners.

老胡有他，如虎添翼，
With him, Hu is like a tiger given wings.

所以越发叫人弄不懂了。
That makes it still harder to understand.”

“话要入港了，
The conversation was approaching the point Liu wanted.

刘不才暗暗高兴，表面上却还是装洋，
Secretly pleased, he continued to feign ignorance.

“怎么弄不懂？”他问。
“What is hard to understand?”


于是刘不才不慌不忙他说道：“老伯母的大寿，理当效劳，
Quite unhurried, Liu said, “It is only right that I should help with your mother’s birthday.

只要用得着我，十天八天都要伺候。
If you need me, I shall gladly stay eight or ten days.

不过，我是雪岩特地派来的，有封信，
But Xueyan sent me here especially with a letter.

请二哥先过目。”
May I ask you to read it first?”

庞二拆开信，一目十行，匆匆看去，
Pang opened it and glanced rapidly down the page.

还未看完，就连声答说：“小事，小事，
Before he had finished, he said repeatedly, “A small matter, a small matter!

朱福年今天也要来的，
Zhu Funian is coming today too.

我关照他就是。”
I shall give him instructions.”

这封信是要从容寻味，才能看出名堂，
The letter required leisurely reflection before its full meaning could emerge.

照眼前的情形，庞二哪里有心思细琢磨？
In the present circumstances, Pang had no time to study it.

看起来古应春的这番精心构思，变成“俏媚眼做给瞎子看”。
Gu’s painstaking composition seemed to have become a coquettish glance thrown at a blind man.

自己虽守着“言多必失”之诫，未便多说，但这意外的情形，应该通知古应春，好作个准备。
Bound by the warning against talking too much, Liu could say little, but he ought to inform Gu of this unexpected development so that Gu could prepare.

打算停当，便即摆出欣然的颜色：
Having decided, he assumed a delighted air.

“二哥肯这样帮忙，我的差使也好交代了。
“With your help, I can give a satisfactory account of my mission.

上海还在等我的回音，
They are waiting for news in Shanghai.

我写封信叫原船带回去，回头再来帮你招呼客人。”
I shall write a letter and send my boat back with it, then return to help entertain your guests.”

“何必你亲自去跑。”庞二说道：
“Why trouble to go yourself?

“船在哪里？
Where is the boat?

你写好了信，我派人替你送去。”
Write the letter and I shall have someone take it.”

“不必，不必！”
“No need, no need.

刘不才答道：“我本来是打算原船回去的，
I had meant to return in the same boat.

现在总还得住两天，船上的东西，要收拾收拾，
Since I must now stay another couple of days, I ought to collect my belongings from it.

还是我自己去一趟的好。”
I had better go myself.”

听他这样说法，庞二只得由他，
Pang could only let him.

派了一名佣工，又派了轿子，送他到码头。
He provided a servant and a sedan chair to take Liu to the landing.

刘不才先在船上收拾好行李，关照庞家的听差押着走，
Liu first packed his luggage aboard and sent it away under the Pang servant’s care.

然后在舱中写好一封信，叮嘱船家即时赶回松江，送交尤五。
Then he wrote his letter in the cabin and instructed the boatman to return immediately to Songjiang and deliver it to You Laowu.


“应该可以做得极出色的事，为啥弄得这样子狼狈，
“What should have been a brilliant success has become this wretched muddle.

我就不懂。
That is what I cannot understand.

我想，以老胡和姓古的手腕，加上老胡跟我的实力，我真不相信搞不过洋人！”
With Hu’s skill and Gu’s, backed by Hu’s resources and mine, I cannot believe they would fail to get the better of the foreigners!”

“是啊！”
“Exactly!”

刘不才做出被提醒的神气，
Liu looked as though the thought had only just been suggested to him.

眨着眼，皱着眉说：“照规矩说，不应该如此。
Blinking and frowning, he said, “By rights, it should not have happened.

到底啥道理，这趟我回上海倒要问问他。”
When I return to Shanghai, I must ask him why.”

“我们一起走。”庞二立即相邀，
“We shall go together,” Pang promptly offered.

“我早就要走了。只为家母的整生日，分不开身，
“I have wanted to go for some time, but could not leave because of my mother’s birthday.

还有几位比较客气的朋友，
There are still a few guests to whom I owe particular attention.

明天都要走了，快的话，我们后天就可以动身。”
They will all leave tomorrow, so we could set out the day after.”

案头正好有本皇历，
An almanac happened to lie on the desk.

刘不才随手一翻，看到后天那一行，
Liu opened it and found the entry for the day after tomorrow.

一个大“宜，字下，密密麻麻的小字，
Beneath a large “Auspicious” was a dense row of small characters.

不问可知是黄道吉日。
Plainly it was a lucky day.

看皇历有句俗语，叫做”呆人看长行“，
There was a saying about almanacs: “A fool looks for the long entry.”

长行的都是宜什么，宜什么，
Long entries listed the many activities favored that day.

如果是个”破日“，只有短短一行，四个大字：”诸事不宜“。
An unlucky “broken day” had only the short warning, “Nothing should be undertaken.”

“后天宜乎出门。”他正好怂恿，
“The day after tomorrow favors travel,” Liu urged.

“过了后天，就得隔五天才有好日子，
“After that, there is no good day for another five days.

我常在外面跑，无所谓，你好久不出门了，
I travel so often that it makes no difference to me, but you have not been away for some time.

该挑个好日子。”
You ought to choose a lucky day.”

“那，”庞二略一沉吟，毅然作了决定：
Pang considered briefly, then decided. “Very well.

“准定后天走。”
We shall definitely leave the day after tomorrow.”


于是，刘不才陪客，庞二料理出门的杂物。
Liu attended to the guests while Pang prepared for the journey.

纨袴子弟好面子，送人的礼物就装了半船，
A wealthy young gentleman cared about appearances: the gifts he meant to distribute filled half a boat.

除了南浔的土产以外，还有两箱瓷器，是景德镇定烧的，庞老太太“六秩华诞”的寿碗，
Besides Nanxun specialties, there were two chests of porcelain birthday bowls, specially commissioned at Jingdezhen to commemorate his mother’s sixtieth birthday.

预备分送那种礼到人不到的亲友。
These were for relatives and friends who had sent gifts but had not attended.

五月底的天气，又闷又热，出门是一大苦事，
The end of the fifth lunar month was oppressively hot, and traveling was a misery.

但庞二有庞二的办法，
Pang had his own solution.

在水路上“放夜站”，白天找浓密的柳荫下将船泊下，
They made the water journey at night, mooring by day beneath thick willow shade.

船是两条，一条装行李，住佣人，一条是他跟刘不才的客船，十分宽敞，
There were two boats: one for the luggage and servants, the other a spacious passenger boat for Pang and Liu.

听差的以外，随带一位十分伶俐的小丫头服侍，
Besides his personal attendants, Pang had brought a particularly clever young maid.

纳凉、品茗、喝酒、闲谈，十分逍遥自在。
Enjoying the cool, drinking tea and wine, and chatting, they passed the time very pleasantly.

谈风月、谈赌经以外，少不得也谈到胡雪岩。
Along with women and gambling, they naturally discussed Hu.

庞二虽是纨袴，但出身生意人家，
Pang was a pampered son of wealth, but he came from a business family.

与做官人家那种昏天黑地、骄恣狂妄的“大少爷”毕竟不同，
He was quite different from the heedless, arrogant young masters of official households.

不但在生意买卖上相当精通，而且颇能识好坏、辨是非，
He understood trade and could distinguish good from bad and right from wrong.

加以刘不才处处小心，
Liu, moreover, was careful at every turn.

说到胡雪岩这一次的受窘，总是旁敲侧击，以逗人的怀疑和好奇为主。
Whenever Hu’s present difficulty arose, he approached it obliquely, chiefly to awaken suspicion and curiosity.

因此，庞二不能不拿古应春的信重新出来，再看一遍。
Pang was thus led to take out Gu’s letter and read it again.

这一看，使得他大为不安。
This time it made him deeply uneasy.

当时因为家里正在做寿，贺客盈门，忙得不可开交，无暇细思，
During the birthday festivities, with guests crowding the house, he had had no leisure to think.

朱福年来了以后，也只是匆匆的交代一番，说照胡雪岩的意思办就是。
When Zhu arrived, he had merely told him in haste to do as Hu requested.

这话乍看不错，其实错了，
That had seemed right, but was actually wrong.

以自己与胡雪岩的交情，如何去赚他这个九五扣一万六千银子？
Given his friendship with Hu, how could he take sixteen thousand taels from him by buying at a five-percent discount?

当然是照洋人的原价收买。
Naturally, he ought to buy at the full price originally offered by the foreigner.


“糟了！糟了！”他不胜懊丧地说：
“Terrible, terrible!” Pang exclaimed in distress.

“老胡心里一定骂我不够朋友！
“Hu must be cursing me for being a poor friend.

刘三哥，你要替我解释。”接着，他把他的疏忽，说了给刘不才听。
Third Brother Liu, you must explain for me.” He told Liu how he had been careless.

“庞二哥，你也太过虑了，
“Brother Pang, you worry too much.

老胡绝不是那种人！
Hu is not that sort of man.

感激你帮忙还来不及，
He can scarcely thank you enough for helping him.

哪里会多心？”
Why should he take offense?”

“这叫什么帮忙？
“What sort of help is that?

要帮忙就该……”
To help him properly, I should...”

庞二突然顿住，心里涌起好些疑问。
Pang stopped abruptly, his mind filling with questions.

道理是很明白地摆在那里，
The answer was plain.

要讲“帮忙”，就得跟胡雪岩采取一致的态度，迫使洋人就范。
Helping Hu meant standing with him and forcing the foreign merchant to yield.

论彼此的交情，应该这么办，况且过去又有约定，更应当这么办。
Their friendship required it; their earlier agreement made it still more necessary.

而目前的情形是，显而易见的各行其是了。
Yet they were plainly pursuing separate courses.

到底是胡雪岩自己知难而退，解消了齐心一致对付洋人的约定，还是另有其他原故？
Had Hu himself retreated before the difficulty and abandoned their agreement to stand together, or was there some other reason?

必须弄个清楚。
Pang must find out.

纨袴子弟都是有了疑问，渴望立即求得解答的脾气，
Like other pampered young gentlemen, once a question arose he wanted an immediate answer.

所以庞二吩咐船家，彻夜赶路，兼程而进，
He ordered the boatmen to travel all night and press on at full speed.

到了上海，邀刘不才一起在“一品香”客栈住下，随即命他的贴身跟班庞义，去找朱福年来见面。
On reaching Shanghai, he invited Liu to stay with him at the Yipinxiang Inn, then immediately sent his personal attendant, Pang Yi, to summon Zhu Funian.

在路上，刘不才已隐约听庞二谈起他的困惑，心里在想，这一见上面，说不定有一顿声色俱厉的斥责，
During the journey Liu had heard enough of Pang’s doubts to suspect that their meeting might bring a furious reprimand.

自己是外人，夹在中间，诸多不便，
As an outsider, he would be awkwardly placed between them.

因而表示要先去看胡雪岩，
He therefore said that he must go and see Hu first.

庞二亦不坚留，只说等下请他约了胡雪岩一起来，大家好好叙一叙。
Pang did not insist on his staying, but asked him to bring Hu back afterward so that they could have a proper talk.


* * *“这下要‘猪八戒，的好看了！”
“Now Pigsy is in for it!”

听刘不才说了经过，古应春兴奋地看着胡雪岩说，
Having heard Liu’s account, Gu turned excitedly to Hu.

“我们照计行事吧！”
“Let us proceed as planned!”

朱福年的底细已经摸清楚了，
They had established what Zhu was doing.

他本来是想“做小货”的，
He had originally intended to trade on his own account.

亏得有庞老太太做寿一事，
But the celebration of Pang’s mother’s birthday had intervened.

到了南得，庞二先提胡雪岩的信，他见机改口，说是“正为这件事、要跟二少爷来请示”。
At Nanxun, Pang mentioned Hu’s letter first, and Zhu promptly changed his story, saying that this was precisely the matter on which he had come to ask the Second Young Master’s instructions.

这下，就如尤五所预料的，变成为东家赚钱，无可为非。
As You had foreseen, it had thus become a legitimate transaction to make money for his employer.

古应春亦就针对这情形作了布置，
Gu had made arrangements to meet this development.

有个丝商也是南浔人，生意不大，人却活跃，跟庞二极熟，与古应春也是好朋友，
A lively, small-scale silk merchant from Nanxun knew Pang well and was also Gu’s good friend.

预备通过他的关系，将胡雪岩与朱福年的秘密交涉，透露给庞二。
Through him, Gu intended to disclose Hu’s secret dealings with Zhu to Pang.

这个“秘密交涉”已经了结，五千银子已经退了回来。
That private arrangement had already been brought to an end: the five thousand taels had been returned.

古应春“存心不良”，另外打张收条给他，将同兴钱庄的笔据，捏在手里，作为把柄。
With deliberate malice, Gu had issued a separate receipt to Zhu and kept Tongxing’s original document as evidence against him.

但是胡雪岩却不愿意这样做了。
Hu, however, no longer wished to pursue this course.

“不必，不必！
“No need.

一则庞二很讲交情，必定有句话给我，
Pang values friendship and is sure to give me some satisfaction.

二则朱福年也知道厉害了，
Besides, Zhu has learned his lesson.

何必敲他的饭碗？”
Why break his rice bowl?

他说，“我们还是从正路上去走最好。”
We had better take the proper course.”

所谓“正路”就是将交情拉得格外近，
By the proper course, Hu meant drawing his friendship with Pang still closer.

当时决定，借怡情老二的地方，为庞二接风。
They decided to give him a welcoming dinner at Second Miss’s rooms in Yiqing House.

本来想即时去看他，当面邀约，怕他正跟朱福年谈话，诸多不便，
Hu had meant to call at once and invite him personally, but the possibility that Pang was talking to Zhu made a visit inconvenient.

决定先发请帖。
He would send an invitation first.

“有个人要请他作陪客。”古应春笑嘻嘻他说，是不怀好意的神气。
“There is someone else we should invite,” Gu said with a smile that suggested no good intentions.

“你是说朱福年？”
“You mean Zhu?

胡雪岩说，“照道理应该。
Strictly speaking, we ought to.

不过，我看他不会来。”
But I doubt he will come.”

“不管他来不来？发了再说！”
“Whether he comes or not, send it!”


请帖送到一品香，带回来一网篮的东西，有寿碗，有土产，另外还有庞二的一封信，道谢以外，表明准时践约。
The invitation sent to the Yipinxiang Inn brought back a basket of gifts: birthday bowls, local specialties, and a letter in which Pang thanked Hu and promised to arrive punctually.

时刻定的是“西正”，也就是傍晚六点钟，庞二却是五点半钟就到了。
Dinner was set for six in the evening, but Pang came at half past five.

欢然道故之余，胡雪岩为他引见了尤五和古应春。
After a cheerful exchange of greetings and recollections, Hu introduced You and Gu.

庞二对古应春慕名已久，
Pang had long known Gu by reputation.

此时见他是个举止漂亮、衣饰时新的外场人物，越有好感。
Finding him a man of polished manners, fashionable clothes, and easy social presence increased his liking.

至于对尤五，听说他是漕帮中的顶儿尖儿，先就浮起一层神秘之感，
As for You, hearing that he was a leading figure in the Grain Transport Brotherhood lent him an immediate air of mystery.

因而看他朴实拙讷，更为好奇。
His plain, awkward manner only sharpened Pang’s curiosity.

纨袴子弟常喜结交江湖人物，尤五又是忠厚可亲的样子，
Wealthy young gentlemen often enjoyed knowing men of the brotherhoods, and You seemed honest and approachable.

自然一见如故。
They were soon as friendly as old acquaintances.

觉得这天来赴胡雪岩的邀约，大有所得。
Pang felt that accepting Hu’s invitation had brought him much.

“你那里的那位朱先生呢？”胡雪岩问道：
“Where is your Mr Zhu?” Hu asked.

“怎么不跟你一起来。”
“Why did he not come with you?”

一提到朱福年，庞二的笑容尽敛，
At the mention of Zhu, Pang’s smile disappeared.

代之而起的神色，不仅歉仄，还有恼怒。
His expression showed not only embarrassment but anger.

“ 老胡，”他略一踌躇，“还是我们私底下谈的好。”
“Old Hu,” he said after a pause, “we had better discuss this privately.”

他又转脸问怡情老二：“二阿姐，可有清静房间，让我们谈一歇？”
Turning to Second Miss, he asked, “Second Sister, is there a quiet room where we can talk?”

“有的，
“Certainly.

请过来。”
This way, please.”

怡情老二带他们到了尤五平时烧酒的小房间，
She led them to the little room where You usually smoked opium.

红木炕床上摆着现成的烟盘，
A smoking tray stood ready on the rosewood couch.

她一面点上那盏“太谷灯”，一面问道：“庞二少，要不要烧一口白相？”
As she lit the Taigu lamp, she asked, “Second Young Master Pang, would you like a pipe?”

庞二喜欢躺烟盘，但并没有瘾，
Pang enjoyed reclining by an opium tray but had no habit.

眼时有正事要谈，无心烧烟来玩，便摇摇头，表示不要。
With serious business to discuss, he had no inclination to smoke for amusement and shook his head.

怡情老二也知道他们讲的是“私话”，便悄悄退了出去，顺手掩上了房门。
Knowing that their conversation was private, Second Miss withdrew quietly and closed the door.


“老胡，”庞二的声音很奇怪，是充满着忧虑，“你看我那个性朱的，人怎么样？”
“Old Hu,” Pang began in a strange, anxious voice, “what do you think of that man Zhu?”

胡雪岩略一沉吟答说：
Hu considered briefly.

“我跟他不熟。”
“I do not know him well.”

“人虽不熟，你跟他有过交往。
“Perhaps not, but you have had dealings with him.

你的这双眼睛，象电火一样，
Those eyes of yours are like lightning.

什么都瞒不过你。
Nothing escapes them.

我们是好朋友，而且说句老实话，我佩服的人也没有几个，
We are good friends, and to tell you the truth, there are few men I admire.

你就应该知无不言、言无不尽。”
You must tell me everything you know, without holding anything back.”

这番话说得太恳切了，使胡雪岩在感动以外，更有不安，
His sincerity moved Hu and also made him uneasy.

拿他的话细细玩味了一番，似乎是他对朱福年起了绝大的怀疑。
Considering the words carefully, he felt that Pang must have developed grave suspicions of Zhu.

莫非……
Could it be...?

“姓朱的拆了你的什么烂污？”他忍不住问出口来。
“Has Zhu been making a mess of your affairs?” he could not help asking.

“现在还不敢说。”
“I cannot yet be certain.”

庞二点点头，
Pang nodded.

“我一直当他忠心耿耿，人也能干。
“I always thought him utterly loyal as well as capable.

现在才知道不是这么回事。
Now I find that things are not as I supposed.”

““怎么呢？”
“How so?”

“事情就是从你身上起的。
“It all began with your business.

我在想，既然我答应了你，请你全权去跟洋人打交道，何以会搞成这个样子。
I wondered why matters had turned out this way when I had agreed to give you full authority to deal with the foreigners.

所以一到就找了朱福年来问，
So as soon as I arrived, I sent for Zhu and questioned him.

越问越不对，
The more I asked, the less satisfactory his answers became.

一时也说不清楚，
It would take too long to explain everything.

我只觉得他好象不知道我跟你的交情，跟你不大合作。
I felt that he hardly seemed to understand our friendship and had not cooperated with you.

老胡，”庞二加强语气问：“是不是这样？”
Old Hu,” he asked emphatically, “is that true?”

胡雪岩不肯马上回答，
Hu chose not to answer at once.

有意踌躇了一会才说：“事情已经过去了，
After a deliberate hesitation, he said, “It is over.

不必再谈它。”
There is no need to discuss it further.”


“这样说来是有的！
“Then it is true!

可见我的想法不错。
My suspicions were right.

接下来我问我自己的生意。”
After that I asked about my own business.”

庞二咽了口唾沫，很吃力他说：
Pang swallowed and continued with difficulty.

“人与人之间，不能起疑心，一起疑心，处处都是毛病……”
“Once you begin to suspect someone, you find faults everywhere...”

“这话也不尽然。”胡雪岩插了句嘴。
“That is not always so,” Hu interjected.

“我不是冤枉他，
“I am not wronging him.

确确实实有毛病。”
There really are faults.”

“是不是帐上有毛病？”
“In the accounts?”

“帐还没有看，不过大致问了几笔帐，我已经发现有讲不通的地方。
“I have not examined the books yet, but I asked about a few transactions and already found things that made no sense.

譬如说你这面吧，
Take your affair.

我在南浔就关照他：照人家胡老板的意思办。
In Nanxun I told him to do as Mr Hu wished.

今天问他，他说货价还没有送过来，
When I asked today, he said that payment for the goods had not yet been sent to you.

这就不对了。”
That is wrong.”

“这没有什么不对。”
“There is nothing wrong with it.”

胡雪岩要表示风度，便得回护朱福年，
To behave generously, Hu had to defend Zhu.

“照交易的规矩，应该由我们这面跟他去接头，
“Under the usual procedure, we should contact him first.

我们因为货色先要盘一盘，算清楚确数，才能结帐，
We need to check our stock and establish the exact quantity before settling the account.

所以耽搁下来了。”
That has caused the delay.”

“不然！”
“No!”

庞二大摇其头，
Pang shook his head vigorously.

“信义通商，
“Business rests on good faith.

你我的交情，他不是不晓得，
He knows our friendship.

既然我这样说了，他应该先把贷款送过来，帐随后再结不要紧。
Once I had given those instructions, he should have sent the payment first; we could settle the precise account afterward.

现在他的做法，替我得罪朋友，可以说是得罪同业，
Instead, his conduct makes enemies of my friends—of my fellow merchants, you might say.

我要他做啥。”
What use have I for him?”

听庞二的口气，预备撤换朱福年。
His tone suggested that he meant to dismiss Zhu.

这原是胡雪岩的本意，现在他的想法不同了，
That had originally been Hu’s intention, but now his thinking had changed.

庞二够朋友，
Pang had proved a true friend.

他为庞二设想，不能杂以私意，因此他也大摇其头。
Hu must consider Pang’s interests without allowing private motives to intrude, so he too shook his head.


“庞二哥，光是为这件事，你大光其火，是说不通的……”
“Brother Pang, if this alone has made you so angry, I cannot agree...”

“当然，还有别的。”庞二抢着说，
“There is more, of course,” Pang interrupted.

“譬如，泥城桥有块地皮，
“For example, a piece of land at Nicheng Bridge.

也是他来跟我说的，预备买下来造市房出租。
He brought it to my attention, and we intended to buy it and build commercial premises to let.

这话有两个月了，
That was two months ago.

我总以为他已经成交，
I always assumed the purchase had been completed.

今天一问，说是让人家捷足先登了。
Today, when I asked, he said that someone else had got there first.

问买主是哪个，他又说不出来。
But when I asked who the buyer was, he could not tell me.

老胡，你想，既然晓得人家捷足先登，怎么会不晓得人家姓啥？
Think of it, Hu: if he knew someone had bought it first, how could he not know the buyer’s name?

为啥不问一问买主？
Why had he not asked?

所以我要去查一查，看看是不是他自己在捣鬼？
I mean to investigate and see whether he has been playing some trick himself.

此外还有好些前言不搭后语的地方，
There are many other contradictions in what he says.

从前我相信他，都忽略了，现在听起来，处处是毛病。
I trusted him before and overlooked them; now everything sounds wrong.

这个人决不能再用。
I cannot keep employing this man.

你说是不是？”
Don’t you agree?”

胡雪岩对那方面的情形，不甚明了，不肯轻作断语，
Hu knew too little of Pang’s affairs to give a hasty judgment.

未答之前，先问一句：“你那面‘抓总’的是哪个？”
Before answering, he asked, “Who is in overall charge on your side?”

“就是他！
“He is!

我那样子信任他，他对不起我，
I trusted him so completely, and he has betrayed me.

这个人真是丧尽天良。”庞二愤愤地答说。
The man has no conscience!” Pang replied angrily.

其实这是无足为奇的事，
There was nothing unusual in this.

豪门巨室的帐户，明欺暗骗，东家跌倒，西宾吃饱的情形，比比皆是。
Open and concealed fraud in the finances of wealthy households was commonplace: when the master fell, his retainers grew fat.

看样子朱福年也是心狠手辣的人，
Zhu appeared to be a ruthless man.

照庞二这种态度，说不定他一不做，二不休，反会出大毛病。
Faced with an employer in Pang’s present mood, he might decide to go to extremes, and serious trouble could follow.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第三十章（下）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Thirty, Part Two
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


因此他压容警告：“庞二哥，你千万动不得！
Hu therefore grew grave and warned him, “Brother Pang, you must not act against him yet.

他现在搞了些啥花样，你还不清楚，
You still do not know what tricks he has been playing.

你在明里，他在暗里，你的形势就不利。
You are in the open while he is in the dark; that puts you at a disadvantage.

大家不破面子，他还不敢明目张胆出大毛病。
So long as neither of you breaks openly with the other, he will not dare cause flagrant trouble.

一听说你有动他的意思，先下手为强，拆你个大烂污，
But if he hears that you mean to move against him, he may strike first and leave you with a terrible mess.

你怎么收拾？”
How will you put it right?”

这话说得庞二一愣，好半天答不出话来。
Pang was taken aback and could not answer for some time.

“不说别的，一本总帐在他手里，
“To take just one thing, he has the general ledger.

交易往来，人欠欠人，只有他最清楚，
