He knows better than anyone who owes you money and whom you owe.

帐里出点毛病，等你弄清楚，已是一两个月以后的事，
If something goes wrong in the accounts, it may take you a month or two to discover it.

他早就布置好了。
By then he will have made all his arrangements.

你又能奈其何？”
What could you do to him?”

“老胡，亏得你提醒我！
“Old Hu, thank goodness you reminded me!

现在没有别的好说了，
There is nothing more to say.

你我的交情，你不能不帮我这个大忙。”
With our friendship, you must help me out of this.”

“当然。
“Of course.

只要帮得上，你说，怎么帮法？”
If I can help, tell me how.”

“他的毛病，一定瞒不过你，
“He could never hide his tricks from you.

我不说请他走路的话，
I shall say nothing about dismissing him.

只请你接管我的帐，替我仔仔细细查一查他的毛病。”
I shall merely ask you to take charge of my accounts and examine them carefully for any wrongdoing.”

“这件事，我不敢从命。
“I cannot oblige you in that.

做不到！”
It would not work.”

庞二大为沮丧：
Pang was deeply disappointed.

“我晓得的，
“I know.

你待人宽厚，不肯得罪人。”
You are generous to people and do not like to offend them.”

“这不是这么说法！
“That is not the point.

庞二哥你的事，为你得罪人，我也认了，
For your sake, Brother Pang, I would willingly offend someone.

不过这洋做法要有用才行，
But it must achieve something.

徒然得罪人，没有益处，何必去做它？
Why offend a man for no benefit?

你听我说……”
Hear me out.”


胡雪岩有三点理由，
Hu had three reasons.

第一，怕打草惊蛇，反逼得朱福年去舞弊使坏，
First, he feared that raising the alarm would drive Zhu Funian into fraud or deliberate mischief.

第二，庞二手下用的人很多，
Second, Pang employed many men.

就算要换朱福年，也该从伙计当中去挑选替手，徐图整顿，
Even if Zhu were to be replaced, a successor should be chosen from among the staff and improvements made gradually.

此刻弄个不相干的人去查帐，仿佛看大家都靠不住，是跟朱福年走在一条路上，通同作弊，
To bring in an outsider to inspect the accounts would suggest that everyone was untrustworthy and in league with Zhu.

岂不令人寒心？
Would that not dishearten them?

第三，胡雪岩也实在抽不出那许多工夫替他专办这件事。
Third, Hu really could not spare the time to devote himself to the task.

“而况，我对你那方面的情形又不清楚，
“Besides, I know nothing of the circumstances of your business.

贸贸然下手，一年半载不能完事，
If I plunge in unprepared, it might take six months or a year.

在我有没有工夫，且不去说它，
Leave aside whether I can spare the time.

就怕一年半载下来，查不出名堂，
Suppose that after all those months I find nothing definite.

那时你做东家的，对伙计如何交代？”
How would you, as their employer, explain yourself to the staff?”

“这没有什么！
“That does not matter.

我现在可以断定，朱福年一定有毛病。”
I am now certain there is something wrong with Zhu.”

“毛病可以弥补的……”“对啊！”庞二抢着说道：
“Irregularities can be made good—” “Exactly!” Pang interrupted.

“只要你一去，他看见厉害的人来了，赶紧想法子把他的毛病弥补起来，
“Once you arrive, he will see that a formidable man has come and hurry to put his irregularities right.

你不就帮了我的大忙了吗？”
Would that not be a great service to me?”

这话倒也驳他不倒。
It was difficult to refute this.

胡雪岩想了一会，总觉得庞二的做法，不甚妥当，
Hu thought for a while, but still felt that Pang’s approach was unsatisfactory.

就算将朱福年的毛病查出来了，甚至于照庞二的如意算盘，把胡雪岩三个字抬了出去，就能叫朱福年敛迹，弥补弊病，然而以后还用不用他呢？
Even if he uncovered Zhu’s misconduct—or if, as Pang hoped, merely invoking Hu Xueyan’s name made Zhu mend his ways and repair the damage—would Pang continue to employ him afterwards?

这样想着，便问出口来：
He put the question aloud.

“庞二哥，这朱某人的本事到底怎么样？”
“Brother Pang, how capable is this man Zhu?”

“本事是有的。”
“He has ability.”

“如果他肯改过，实实在在替你办事，你还用不用他？”
“If he were willing to reform and serve you honestly, would you still employ him?”

“如果是这佯，当然可以用。
“In that case, of course.

不过……”他摇摇头，觉得说下去就没有味道了。
But—” Pang shook his head, feeling that there was little point in continuing.


“我懂你的意思。”
“I understand what you mean.”

胡雪岩停了一下说，
Hu paused.

“人不对，请他走路。这是普通人的做法，
“If a man is no good, dismiss him: that is the ordinary way.

你庞二哥要么不出马，一出马就要叫人晓得厉害，佩服你确是有一套。”
But you, Brother Pang, should either stay out of the field or, once you enter it, make everyone recognize your strength and admire your methods.”

这两句话，最配争强好胜的纨绔脾气，
This appealed perfectly to the competitive pride of a wealthy young gentleman.

所以庞二精神一振，有了笑容。
Pang brightened and smiled.

“老胡，你这两句话我交关听得进。
“Old Hu, that is exactly the sort of thing I like to hear.

你倒再说说看，
Tell me more.

应该怎么做法？”
What should I do?”

“要象诸葛亮‘七擒孟获’那样，
“Be like Zhuge Liang, capturing Meng Huo seven times.

‘火烧藤甲兵’不足为奇，
Burning the troops in rattan armour was nothing remarkable.

要烧得他服帖，死心塌地替你出力，才算本事。”
The real achievement was to make him submit wholeheartedly and serve with complete devotion.”

“话是一点都不错，
“You are quite right.

不过，”庞二踌躇着说，“我实在没有这份本事。”
But I really have no such ability.”

说到这里，突然眼睛一亮，
Suddenly Pang’s eyes lit up.

拍着自己的后脑勺：
He slapped the back of his head.

“我真糊涂了！
“What a fool I am!

现成的诸葛亮在这里。
Here is Zhuge Liang, ready to hand.

老胡，”他停了一下，喜逐颜开地又说，“我送你股份，
Old Hu”—he paused, then continued with a delighted smile—“I shall give you shares.

你算是跟我台伙，也是老板的身分，名正言顺来管事，
You will be my partner, an owner yourself, with every right to take charge.

不就可以收服朱福年了吗？”
Then you can bring Zhu Funian to heel!”

胡雪岩的打算就是如此，不过自己说不出口，
This was precisely what Hu had intended, though he could hardly propose it himself.

难得庞二的想法相同。光就是这一点，使值得替他出一番力了。
That Pang had reached the same idea was reason enough to make a considerable effort on his behalf.

胡雪岩有项过人的长处，能在心血来潮之际，作出重要而正确的决定，
Hu possessed an exceptional gift: on the spur of the moment, he could make important decisions and make them correctly.

思路快不足为奇，
Quick thinking alone was nothing extraordinary.

能快又能细致深刻，就只有他有此本事。
To think quickly while remaining thorough and penetrating was his particular strength.


此刻便是这样。
So it was now.

因为庞二先作提议，就是个极好的机会，
Pang’s own proposal had presented an excellent opportunity.

他抓住了题目的精义，立即使有一篇好文章交卷。
Hu grasped its essential point and immediately had his response ready.

“庞二哥，”他正色说道，“生意是生意！
“Brother Pang, business is business,” he said seriously.

分花红彼此礼让，是交朋友的情分、义气，
“Giving one another a share of profits is a matter of friendship and loyalty.

不可一概而论。
The two must not be confused.

我是不赞成吃干股这一套花佯的，
I do not approve of holding shares without putting in capital.

如果你看得起我，愿意让我搭点股份，我交现银出来。
If you think well enough of me to let me take a stake, I shall pay for it in silver.”

““好啊！”庞二欣然同意，因为这一来，胡雪岩就更加出力。
“Excellent!” Pang readily agreed: this would give Hu still more reason to work hard.

他问：“你想要多少股子？”
“How large a stake would you like?”

“我的实力比你差得远，
“My means are far below yours.

只能来个两成。”
I could manage only two tenths.”

“一句话！
“Agreed!

我们重新盘过，
We shall make a fresh reckoning.

你十万，我四十万，
You put in a hundred thousand taels and I four hundred thousand.

我们五十万银子下手，上海的市面，可以捏在手里了。”
Starting with half a million, we can hold the Shanghai market in our hands.”

“准定如此，
“Then that is settled.”

庞二哥，”胡雪岩带点兴奋的神色，“我的钱庄，你也来点股子。
Hu looked a little excited. “Brother Pang, you must take a stake in my bank too.

索性大家滚在一起，有福同享，有难同当，
Let us join our interests completely, sharing good fortune and hardship alike.

人看好不好？”
What do you say?”

“怎么不好！
“Why not?

礼尚往来，再好不过！
Reciprocity could not be better.

而且便宜不落外方，
And the benefit will stay among ourselves.

你在上海立一爿分号起来，我们自己的款了存在自己的钱庄里，
Establish a branch in Shanghai, and we can keep our own money in our own bank.

岂不方便？”
How convenient!”

胡雪岩的打算就是如此，
This was exactly Hu’s plan.

他还有进一步的打算，此刻却不宜先露，只是连连称“是”。
He had something further in mind, but it was too early to reveal it, so he merely agreed repeatedly.

接着又说定庞二的股份，真个礼尚往来，他也是十万，
They then settled Pang’s contribution: in true reciprocity, it would also be a hundred thousand taels.

彼此只要立个合伙的合同，划一笔帐，都不必另拨现银。
All they needed was a partnership agreement and a transfer in the books; neither would have to send over additional cash.


他们谈得津津有味，外面却等得心急了，
They were absorbed in their talk, but the people outside were growing impatient.

酒已经回烫过两遍，再烫就要走味，
The wine had already been warmed twice; another warming would spoil its flavour.

怡情老二推门望到第三遍，看他们还没有住口的样子，忍不住便轻轻咳嗽了一声。
When Second Miss opened the door for the third time and saw no sign of their stopping, she could not resist a discreet cough.

这下才惊醒了庞二，歉然说道：
Only then did Pang come to himself.

“对不起，对不起，
“My apologies!

害他们久等了，
We have kept everyone waiting.

我们出去吧！”
Let us go out.”

等坐定下来，第一件事是叫局。
Once they were seated, the first business was to summon the courtesans.

怡情老二亲自捧过一只长方红木托盘，里面是笔砚局票，
Second Miss personally brought a long rosewood tray holding brush, inkstone, and invitation cards.

拈笔在手，先问庞二。
Taking up the brush, she asked Pang first.

“我好久没有到上海来了，市面不灵。”
“I have not been to Shanghai for a long time and am out of touch.”

他想了想说：
He thought for a moment.

“叫宝琴老三吧？”
“Shall we ask for Third Miss Baoqin?”

“是怡红院的宝琴老三吗？”怡情老二问。
“Third Miss Baoqin of Yihong House?”

“对了。怡红院。”
“Yes, Yihong House.”

“这一节不做了。”
“She is no longer working this season.

怡情老二说，“节前嫁了个道台，做官太太去了。”
Before the festival she married a circuit intendant and became an official’s wife.”

于是庞二又想了两个人，非常不巧，不是从良，便是开了码头，
Pang thought of two more women, but his luck was poor: they had either married out of the profession or moved elsewhere to work.

他不免怅惘，说一声：“随便找好了！”
A little wistfully, he said, “Find anyone you like.”

“你替庞二少做个媒吧。”尤五对怡情老二说了这一句，便又转脸问庞二：
“Make a match for Second Master Pang,” You Laowu told Second Miss, then turned to Pang.

“喜欢啥样子的？”
“What sort do you like?”

“脾气爽快的好。”
“Someone with a frank, easy temper.”

“有了！”怡情老二喜滋滋他说，
“I have just the one!” Second Miss said happily.

“我替庞二少保荐一个，
“Let me recommend someone.

包管中意。”
I guarantee you will like her.”

这个人叫怡云老七，就在怡情院“铺房间”，
The woman was called Seventh Miss Yiyun and had rooms at Yiqing House itself.

她怕庞二以为她有意照应小姐妹，不管好歹，硬塞给他，
Second Miss feared Pang might suppose she was pushing a sister of the house on him merely to help her, regardless of suitability.

所以只说名字，不说地方。
She therefore gave only the name, not the address.

刘不才会意，也不多问，
Liu understood and asked no questions.

将一叠局票写好，交给“相帮”发了出去。
He filled out a stack of invitations and gave them to an attendant to dispatch.


隔不多久，莲步姗姗进来一个丽人，鹅蛋脸，高身材，长眉入鬓，神采飞扬，是那种一见便能令人目眩神移的尤物。
Before long a beauty entered with graceful steps: tall, with an oval face, long eyebrows sweeping towards her temples, and a radiant liveliness that could dazzle a man at first sight.

在座的人都没有见过她，她却全认得，含笑一一招呼，
None of those present had seen her before, yet she knew them all and greeted each with a smile.

最后才在庞二身后坐下，
Finally she sat behind Pang.

未曾开口，先抛媚眼，然后轻声说道：“二少，长远不见了！”
Before speaking, she cast him an enticing glance, then said softly, “Second Master, it has been such a long time!”

“原来你们是老相好！”
“So you are old sweethearts!”

刘不才起哄，
Liu raised a clamour.

“庞二哥怎不早说？
“Why did you not tell us, Brother Pang?

罚酒，罚酒。”
A penalty cup!”

“你看！”庞二对怡云老七说，
“You see?” Pang told Yiyun.

“你一来就害我罚酒。
“You have only just arrived, and already you have landed me with a drinking penalty.

我们啥地方见过？
Where have we met?

我怎么想不起来？
Why can I not remember?”

““在怡红院。
“At Yihong House.

二少，你自然想不起了，
Naturally you would not remember.

一则贵人多忘事，二则也看我不上眼。”
Important men have short memories, and besides, you never thought me worth a glance.”

庞二将牙一龇，故意说道：
Pang bared his teeth deliberately.

“好酸！”
“How sour!”

“庞二哥，你不要假惺惺装不认识。
“Brother Pang, stop pretending not to recognize her.

这杯酒非罚不可！”
You must drink this cup.”

刘不才将一杯酒端了过来。
Liu brought him the wine.

庞二顺手就端向怡云老七，意思是要她代酒，
Pang promptly held it out to Yiyun, asking her to drink on his behalf.

怡云老七毫无难色，一仰脸干了那杯酒。
Without the least reluctance, she tipped back her head and emptied it.

“谢谢！”庞二开始有了笑容。
“Thank you!” Pang began to smile.

于是怡云老七执壶敬酒，
She then took the wine pot and toasted the company.

酒量很好，一个个都照了杯，
Her capacity was excellent; she drank with each man in turn, showing her empty cup.

最后是自己喝了半杯酒，剩下的半杯敬庞二，却又温柔地问：“嫌不嫌脏？”
Finally she drank half a cup herself and offered the remaining half to Pang, asking tenderly, “Do you mind its being soiled?”

杯沿脂痕宛然，美人余泽，脏之何有？
Rouge marked the rim: what could be dirty about a beauty’s lingering traces?

庞二笑嘻嘻地干了酒，
Pang drank it with a delighted smile.

大家也都相视而笑，笑庞二是如此容易地掉入怡云老七的罗网中。
The others exchanged smiles too, amused at how easily he had fallen into her net.


“你住在哪里？”庞二悄然相问。
“Where do you live?” Pang asked quietly.

“ 等下告诉你。”
“I shall tell you later.”

他还想说什么，只听门帘响动，
He wanted to say more, but the door curtain stirred.

胡雪岩和刘不才叫的局，陆续到了。
The women summoned by Hu and Liu began arriving one after another.

为求热闹，叫得不少，
To make the party lively, they had invited quite a number.

片刻之间，莺莺燕燕，翩然群集，猜拳的猜拳，唱戏的唱戏，
Soon the room was filled with graceful, chattering beauties: some played drinking games, others sang opera.

因为庞二是主客，自然都应酬他，左顾右应，忙得不可开交。
Pang was the guest of honour, so all attended to him, and he scarcely knew which way to turn.

叫的局来了又去，川流不息，怡云老七却始终不动，
The summoned women came and went in an endless stream, but Yiyun remained.

娘姨拿进一叠局票，悄悄塞了过来，
A maid slipped her a stack of invitation cards.

她看都不看、就交了回去，只说得一声：
Without looking at them, she handed them back.

“随它去！”
“Never mind them.”

这一下反倒使得庞二过意不去了，
This made Pang feel guilty.

“你管你出局去！”他说，
“Do go to your engagements,” he said.

“回头我们‘翻台，过来。
“We shall move the party to your place afterwards.

你住得远不远？”
Is it far away?”

“是真的要翻台过来？”
“Do you really mean to come?”

“这，我骗你干什么？”
“Why should I deceive you?”

怡云老七笑一笑不响，却依然坐着不动。
She smiled without answering and remained seated.

“你先回去，预备预备，
“Go back and make your preparations.

我们就过去。”
We shall follow.”

“叫我回哪里去？”
“Where do you want me to go?”

怡云老七用手一指，
She pointed.

“喏，前厢房就是我的房间。”
“Those rooms in the front wing are mine.”

“原来你也在这里！”
“So you live here too!”

庞二顿觉意外，
Pang was surprised.

“为啥早不说？”
“Why did you not say so?”

“现在说也不晚。”
“It is not too late to say it now.”

怡云老七越发坐近了，手扳着他的肩，低声说道：
She moved closer, rested a hand on his shoulder, and lowered her voice.

“翻来翻去，都在一处地方。
“Wherever we move, it is all the same house.

尤五少的面子，你就在这里多坐一会。
For Fifth Master You’s sake, stay here a little longer.

回头到我那里去消夜好不好？”
Afterwards, will you come to my rooms for supper?”

这便是一种暗示，有身分的“红棺人”，通常是不肯作此露骨的表示的，
This was a hint of the kind that a sought-after courtesan with a reputation to maintain would not ordinarily make so openly.

所以庞二颇为高兴。
Pang was therefore particularly pleased.


他们低眉垂眼，款款深谈的神情，都落入旁人眼中，也猜得到他们已有密约，
Their lowered eyes and intimate conversation had not escaped the others, who could guess that they had made a private arrangement.

所以为了予人方便，作主人的竟一反常例，提议早早散席，理由是因为怕庞二在路上辛苦了，需要早早休息。
To oblige them, their hosts departed from the usual practice and proposed ending the banquet early, on the grounds that Pang must be tired from his journey and needed rest.

“多谢关切！”
“Thank you for your concern!”

庞二指着怡云老七说，
Pang pointed to Yiyun.

“我答应到她那里宵夜。
“I have promised to take supper at her place.

大家一起过去坐一息。”
Come over with me and sit a while.”

怡云老七唯恐客人推辞，抢着先拜托怡情老二：
Afraid that the guests might decline, Yiyun quickly appealed to Second Miss.

“二阿姐，你替我讲一声，
“Second Sister, please speak for me.

请各位老爷，赏我个面子。”
Ask the gentlemen to honour me.”

直待大家都答应了，怡云老七方始匆匆赶回自己房间去准备。
Only when all had agreed did she hurry back to her rooms to prepare.

等庞二陪春客人一到，已经准备停当，
By the time Pang arrived with his friends, everything was ready.

虽是消夜，依然丰盛，
Though it was only supper, the spread was lavish.

还特地用了一副“银家伙”，开了一小坛十年陈的“竹叶青”，
She had brought out a set of silverware and opened a little jar of ten-year-old Zhuyeqing wine.

此外果盘茶烟，无不精美，
The fruit, tea, and tobacco were all of the finest quality.

这又合了庞二的脾胃，
This suited Pang perfectly.

脸上飞了金似地，相当得意。
His face seemed to shine with gold, so pleased was he.

“明天原班人马在这里，
“The same company here tomorrow.

我不发帖子了。”
I shall send no formal invitations.”

“好的。”刘不才说，
“Very well,” Liu said.

“后天该我……”“不行！刘三哥！
“The day after tomorrow is my turn—” “No, Brother Liu!

你再让我两天，
Give me another two days.

后天、大后天仍旧应该是我的，还是在这里。”
The day after tomorrow and the following day must still be mine, and here again.”

阔客捧场，也要有个规矩，所以刘不才问道：“明天算是庞二哥还席，
Even a wealthy patron’s generosity needed a proper form, so Liu asked, “Tomorrow can be your return banquet.

后天、大后天算是啥名堂？
But what are the next two occasions?”

““我跟老胡的交情，还席可以摆在后头……”
“With Old Hu and me, returning his hospitality can wait.”

照庞二的说法，明天是他诚意结交新朋友，专请尤五和古应春，
Pang’s explanation was that tomorrow he wished sincerely to cultivate new friends, so You and Gu would be his particular guests.

后天则是酬谢刘不才，在南浔替他照料宾客，
The next day he would thank Liu for entertaining his visitors at Nanxun.

大后天才是不胡雪岩的席，
Only on the third day would he return Hu’s hospitality.

花丛哄饮，能够说得出道理，没有不凑兴的道理，
At a drinking party among the flowers, any plausible reason deserved support.

因而大家都答应了，然后又徘定次序，接下来是刘、古、尤三人做主人。
Everyone agreed, then fixed the order afterwards: Liu, Gu, and You would host in turn.

庞二的兴致极好，还要叫局，只是大家都说良朋良夜，清谈最好，
Pang was in excellent spirits and wanted to summon more women, but the others said that with good friends on such a fine night, quiet conversation was best.

只把抬情老二找了来，浅斟低酌，又消磨了一个时辰，方始兴尽而散。
They brought in only Second Miss, sipped their wine, and passed another two hours before dispersing at last.

当然，这一夜的庞二是不会再回一品香了。
Naturally, Pang would not return to the Yipinxiang Inn that night.


第二天午后，刘不才听从胡雪岩的指挥，特地去陪伴庞二。
The following afternoon, at Hu’s direction, Liu went specially to keep Pang company.

胡雪岩则与古庆春和尤五在裕记丝栈谈了一下午，
Hu spent the afternoon at Yuji Silk Warehouse with Gu and You.

听说了庞二与他昨天所谈的话，尤、古二人大为兴奋。
Both were greatly excited to hear what Pang and Hu had discussed.

能够与庞二合作，无论讲声势、讲实力，都是十分有利的事，
Cooperation with Pang would bring substantial advantages in influence and resources alike.

尤其是在上海设一爿钱庄，现成有五十万银子这么个大户头作往来，这个局面的开展，是件非同小可的事。
In particular, opening a bank in Shanghai with a half-million-tael business ready to become a major customer would create an opportunity of immense consequence.

不过障碍也不是没有，
There were obstacles, however.

“朱福年多年耕耘，视庞二的事业如禁膏，
“Zhu Funian has worked at this for years and regards Pang’s business as his private preserve.

肯拱手上让人吗？”
Will he hand it over meekly?”

古应春怀着浓重的疑惑。
Gu was deeply doubtful.

“小爷叔，”尤五也说，“你在庞二面前已夸下口了，要‘七擒孟获’，
“Little Uncle,” You added, “you have already promised Pang that you will capture Meng Huo seven times.

我倒要问问，怎么个擒法？”
How do you mean to do it?”

“用不着七擒！”胡雪岩说：
“There is no need for seven captures.

“昨天我在床上就想好了办法，
I worked out a method in bed last night.

要下一着狠棋。
We must make a ruthless move.

五哥，同兴的档手你熟不熟？”
Brother Five, do you know the manager at Tongxing?”

“你是说同兴钱庄？”
“You mean Tongxing Bank?

尤五答道：“档手姓邵，镇江人，
His name is Shao, and he comes from Zhenjiang.

我不熟，不过我可以托朋友去说话。”
I do not know him, but I can ask friends to approach him.”

“说要我自己来说，
“I must speak to him myself.

不有让第三者知道。
No third person can know about it.

你能不能托人介绍，大家见一面？”
Can you get someone to introduce us?”

“这不难。
“That is easy enough.

你想要啥时候见面？”
When would you like to meet?”

“越快越好。”
“The sooner the better.”

“今天晚上就可以。
“This evening would be possible.”

应春，”尤五转脸说道，“你替我写封信给华佩卿。”
You turned to Gu. “Yingchun, write a letter to Hua Peiqing for me.”


古应春也认识华佩卿，
Gu knew Hua Peiqing too.

他是个书贾，跟北京的琉璃厂有联络，
He was a bookseller with connections in Beijing’s Liulichang district.

以前在江南旧家收买了善本古书，总是搭松江帮的漕船进京，
In the past, when he bought rare old editions from established Jiangnan families, he had always sent them to the capital on the Songjiang brotherhood’s grain boats.

所以跟尤五颇有交情。古应春跟他相识，就是从尤五的关系上来的。
He was therefore on friendly terms with You, through whom Gu had met him.

“今天晚上要应酬庞二。
“We have to entertain Pang this evening.

请他约一约，明天中午见面如何？”
Could you ask Hua to arrange a meeting for tomorrow at noon?”

“随便你。”
“As you please.”

于是古应春用尤五的名义给华佩卿写了信，立即派“出店”送去。
Gu wrote in You’s name, and a messenger was sent off at once.

信上注明：“即晚候玉”，而回信在他们到怡情院赴约以前就收到了。
The letter said, “Your reply is awaited this evening,” and it arrived before they left for the banquet at Yiqing House.

华佩卿很热心，
Hua had been most obliging.

回信中说，接到信他立即照办，找到了同兴的档手邵仲甫，说明经过。
On receiving the letter he had immediately sought out Tongxing’s manager, Shao Zhongfu, and explained the request.

邵仲甫也知道有胡雪岩这么一位同业，仰慕已久，乐于相交。
Shao already knew of Hu as a fellow banker and had long admired him; he would gladly make his acquaintance.

不过他明天中午有个“非践不可之约”，
Unfortunately, he had an engagement at noon the next day that he could not fail to keep.

所以华佩卿已经跟他约好，第二天上午吃早茶，由华佩卿作东。
Hua had therefore arranged to host morning tea instead.

介绍认识以后，胡雪岩要跟邵仲甫单独相谈，“自行面约可也”。
Once they had been introduced, Hu could make his own appointment for a private conversation with Shao.


* * *名为“吃早茶”，其实是约在一家扬帮馆子里。
Though called “morning tea,” the meeting was at a restaurant serving Yangzhou food.

扬州人早晨这一顿很讲究，
Yangzhou people took considerable care over their morning meal.

先拿肴肉、干丝来吃酒，然后点过桥面，
They began by drinking wine with jellied meat and finely shredded bean curd, then ordered guoqiao noodles.

“浇头”也先炒出来下酒。
The toppings were cooked first and also served to accompany the wine.

主客一共四个人，胡雪岩是由尤五陪着去的，
There were four men in all, for You had come with Hu.

四碗面两样花色，炒出来两大盘浇头，一盘虾腰，一盘“马鞍桥”，
Their four bowls of noodles had two different toppings, brought on two large platters: shrimps and kidneys on one, and a dish called “Saddle Bridges” on the other.

华佩卿不断劝客，十分殷勤。
Hua urged them to eat with great hospitality.

彼此都是“外场人物”，做生意又讲究和气亲热，不似官场中人矜持，
They were all men accustomed to dealing with the world, and business encouraged warmth and friendliness rather than the reserve of officials.

所以胡雪岩跟邵仲甫第一遭相见，就很熟了。
Hu and Shao therefore felt at ease together at this first meeting.

尤五看华佩卿健谈而又健啖，这顿早酒，着实要消磨些工夫，
Seeing that Hua was as hearty an eater as he was a talker, You realized that the morning drinking would occupy some time.

便向胡雪岩使个眼色：
He signalled to Hu.

“你跟邵先生有话，
“You have something to discuss with Mr Shao.

就这里借个地方谈谈，
Why not find a place here?

岂不省事？”
It would save trouble.”

“对，对！你们两位尽管请便，
“Yes, by all means!” Hua agreed.

我跟尤五哥好久不见，
“Brother You and I have not met for ages.

也要叙叙。”
We have plenty to talk about too.”

于是一桌化做两桌，
One table thus became two.

胡雪岩跟邵仲甫另外在僻静角落坐定，喝茶密谈。
Hu and Shao settled in a quiet corner to talk privately over tea.

在这一顿点心的工夫中，胡雪岩对邵仲甫的性情，已有了解，
During the meal Hu had already formed an idea of Shao’s character.

不善言词而是心有丘壑的人，
He was no eloquent talker, but a man with well-considered plans of his own.

这路人物比较讲实际，动以利害则自能分辨，
Such men were practical and could judge their interests clearly.

所以他决定开门见山，实话直说。
Hu decided to come straight to the point.


“仲甫兄，”他问，“宝号跟宠家的‘恒记，有往来？”
“Brother Zhongfu,” he asked, “does your bank do business with the Pang family’s Hengji?”

“是的。”
“Yes.

邵仲甫答道，“我们做往来，不是一年了。”
We have dealt with them for years.”

“那以后还要请你多帮忙。”
“Then I shall need your help in future too.

胡雪岩说，“庞家二少爷已经到了上海，
Second Master Pang has reached Shanghai.

你总见过面了。”
I imagine you have seen him?”

“还没有。
“Not yet.

约了今天中午见面。”
I am meeting him at noon today.”

胡雪岩心里明白，所谓“非践不可之约”，就是跟庞二见面。
Hu understood: this was the engagement that could not be missed.

照此看来，他对庞二的重视，又不言可知，然则自己动以利害的打算，越显得不错，
The importance Shao attached to Pang was plain, confirming Hu’s judgment that an appeal to his interests would be effective.

不过，胡雪岩灵机一动，改变了主意，
Then an idea struck him, and he changed his approach.

“这样说，我们中午还要见面。”
“In that case we shall meet again at noon.

他说，“我有几句话，不妨明后天再谈。”
What I have to say can wait until tomorrow or the next day.”

邵仲甫跟恒记有多年的关系，所以跟恒记有往来的客户，大致也都了解，就没有听说过有胡雪岩在内。
Through his long connection with Hengji, Shao knew most of the people with whom it did business, but had never heard of Hu among them.

然而照他此刻的话来看，似乎跟庞二很熟，与恒记在生意上有密切的牵连，
Yet Hu now spoke as though he were close to Pang and intimately concerned with Hengji’s affairs.

岂不费解？
It was puzzling.

既为了生意上的关切，也为了好奇，邵仲甫何能置而不问，
Both his business interests and his curiosity made it impossible to let the matter rest.

“雪岩兄，我们一见如故，
“Brother Xueyan, we feel like old friends at our first meeting.

有话尽说不妨！”
Speak freely.”

他用套交情的方式来套话，
He used a profession of friendship to draw Hu out.

“何必等到明后天？”
“Why wait until tomorrow or the next day?”

在胡雪岩原是盘马弯弓，有意要引起邵仲甫的注意，
Hu had deliberately held his bow drawn to attract Shao’s attention.

见他这副神情，便知已经入彀，不妨略为透露，于是很快地答道：
Seeing his expression, he knew that the bait had taken and could reveal a little.

“原是一见如故，我才跟仲甫兄谈到深处。
“It is precisely because we feel like old friends that I am speaking to you so intimately.

庞二哥是我的好朋友，最近进一步谈到彼此合伙。
Brother Pang is a good friend of mine, and recently we have gone a step further and discussed a partnership.

当然，恒记是以他为主，
Naturally, he remains the principal man in Hengji.

听他跟你老兄是怎么说，我们再细谈。
Once I know what he has said to you, we can talk in detail.

彼此同业，要讲义气，
As fellow bankers, we must honour our obligations to one another.

没有不好谈的。”
There is nothing we cannot discuss.”


这几句话闪闪烁烁，越引人关切，
These elusive remarks made Shao still more attentive.

邵仲甫拿他的话，一个字一个字地体味了一遍，有些明白了，
He weighed every word and began to understand.

既然他们合伙，则庞二跟钱城有银钱往来，自然要问问做钱庄的胡雪岩的意见，
If Hu and Pang became partners, Pang would naturally consult Hu, himself a banker, about Hengji’s banking arrangements.

最后讲的两句话，就是这个意思。
That was the meaning of the last two sentences.

恒记是同兴的大户，也是一根台柱，
Hengji was a major customer and one of Tongxing’s main supports.

如果这根台柱一抽走，后果不堪设想。
Losing it would have unthinkable consequences.

虽然胡雪岩的话，靠得住靠不住，尚待求证，但宁可信其有，不可信其无，
Whether Hu’s claims could be trusted still needed confirmation, but it was safer to believe them than not.

难得他有讲同业义气的善意表示，不正好拉近了交情？
And since he had expressed goodwill towards a fellow banker, was this not a chance to draw closer?

“好极了！
“Excellent!

庞二少有你搭档，将来做出来的市面不得了，
With you as his partner, Second Master Pang will build an extraordinary business.

雪岩兄，”他急转直下他说，“我是久仰大才，也久仰阜康的信誉，
Brother Xueyan”—Shao abruptly changed direction—“I have long admired your ability and Fukang’s reputation.

大树底下好乘凉，
It is pleasant to sit in the shade of a great tree.

想沾你老兄一点光，
I should like to share a little of your good fortune.

不晓得肯不肯照应照应我们？”
Might you be willing to look after us?”

“好说，好说，
“You are too kind.

请吩咐！
Tell me what you wish.

只要力量够得上，决不推辞。”
If it is within my power, I shall certainly not refuse.”

“我是想，同兴跟阜康做个联号，
“I wondered whether Tongxing might become an associate bank of Fukang.

不晓是高攀得上，高攀不上？”
I do not know whether we could aspire to such a connection.”

对这个提议，胡雪岩倒有些意外之感，暗暗佩服邵仲甫的手腕也不坏，
The proposal took Hu somewhat by surprise, and he privately admired Shao’s skill.

做成联号，则恒记跟同兴的往来，也就等于跟阜康往来，
If the banks became associates, Hengji’s dealings with Tongxing would effectively be dealings with Fukang too.

他考虑了一下答道：“只怕阜康高攀不上。
After considering it, he answered, “It is Fukang that may not be worthy of the connection.

仲甫兄，我说句实话，现在丝生意是我自己管，钱庄都托了一个刘姓朋友，
To tell you frankly, brother, I manage the silk business myself, but have entrusted the bank to a friend named Liu.

你老兄晓得的，东家未见得都了解，
You know how it is: an owner may not understand everything.

全盘情形，都在档手肚子里。
The manager has the whole business in his head.

彼此联手，我完全赞成，不过先要问一问我那个刘朋友，
I thoroughly approve of our joining forces, but I must first consult my friend Liu.

我写信叫他上来，大家一起谈好不好？
Shall I write and ask him to come up, so that we can all discuss it?”

““是的。
“Certainly.

做事情是应该如此。”
That is the proper way to conduct business.”

“就这样说了。”
“Then we shall leave it at that.”

胡雪岩假意掏出表来看了一下：
Hu made a show of taking out his watch.

“我还有个约会，先走一步，
“I have another appointment and must go.

中午再碰头。”
We shall meet again at noon.”


于是胡雪岩站起身来，向华佩卿道了谢，与尤五告辞出门，
Hu rose, thanked Hua, and took his leave with You.

一起赶到怡情院，
Together they hurried to Yiqing House.

庞二刚穿好衣服，预备到一品香去会见约好了的人。
Pang had just dressed and was preparing to go to the Yipinxiang Inn to meet the people he had invited.

“二哥！”
“Brother Pang!”

胡雪岩将他拉到一边，悄然问道：
Hu drew him aside.

“你今天中午是不是约了同兴的邵仲甫见面？”
“Are you meeting Shao Zhongfu of Tongxing at noon?”

“是啊！
“Yes.

你怎么知道？”
How did you know?”

“我跟他刚见了面。”
“I have just seen him.”

胡雪岩以郑重的神色，低声说道：
Hu lowered his voice and grew serious.

“恒记跟同兴的往来，都由朱福年经手，
“All Hengji’s dealings with Tongxing pass through Zhu Funian.

我先要拿同兴方面稳往，以防万一。”
I must first make sure of Tongxing’s position, as a precaution.”

“不错，不错！
“Quite right!

你的心思真细。”
You think of everything.

庞二说道：“谈得怎么样？”
How did the talk go?”

“没有深谈，
“We did not go into detail.

因为恒记到底是你的事业，要你作主。
Hengji is your business, after all, and you must decide.

我告诉他，要先听你怎么说，我才能跟他进一步谈。”
I told him I had to hear what you said before I could discuss it further.”

这两句话中，一方面表示尊重庞二，一方面也是为他自己表白，并无喧宾夺主的意思。
These two sentences both showed respect for Pang and assured him that Hu had no intention of usurping his authority.

同时也在暗示，需将双方的关系，公开向邵仲甫说明。
They also hinted that Pang needed to make their new relationship clear to Shao.

措词相当巧妙，而丝毫不着痕迹。
The wording was skilful without showing any trace of artifice.

庞二深为满意，不知不党中便由胡雪岩牵着鼻子走了。
Pang was delighted and, without realizing it, allowed Hu to lead him by the nose.


“好的。
“Very well.

回头我们一起吃饭，我当面跟邵仲甫说。
We shall have lunch together, and I shall tell Shao myself.

时候不早了，
It is getting late.

一起走吧。”
Let us go.”

到了一品香，已有好些人在等。包括朱福年在内，
At the Yipinxiang Inn, several people were already waiting, Zhu among them.

一见胡雪岩跟庞二在一起，他的脸色一变。
At the sight of Hu beside Pang, his expression changed.

庞二不曾发觉，胡雪岩是见如不见，
Pang did not notice; Hu noticed but behaved as though he had not.

神色不动地跟他寒暄，说前天请他作陪，未见赏光，深为遗憾。
He greeted Zhu calmly and said how sorry he had been that Zhu could not join them at dinner the day before yesterday.

朱福年当然也有几句致歉的话，只是神色之间，不免忸怩。
Zhu naturally offered apologies, though he could not conceal his awkwardness.

由这一番周旋，便看出朱福年其实不是什么厉害角色，因而越有自信必可将他收服。
This exchange showed Hu that Zhu was not really such a formidable man after all, strengthening his confidence that he could bring him to heel.

“福年！”庞二打发走了一些不相干的访客，招招手说：“你请过来，
After dismissing some unrelated visitors, Pang beckoned. “Funian, come here.

我有件事告诉你。”
I have something to tell you.”

庞二住的是一进五间屋子，
Pang occupied a suite of five rooms.

将朱福年找到最东面那一间，谈了好半天，
He took Zhu into the easternmost one, and they talked for a considerable time.

才见朱福年出来，脸上的气色越发难看了，但对胡雪岩却又不能不敷衍。
When Zhu emerged, his colour was worse than ever, though he still had to be polite to Hu.

“胡先生，刚才二少爷跟我说了，说胡先生有大股份加到恒记来。”
“Mr Hu, Second Master has just told me that you are bringing a substantial stake into Hengji.”

他极力装出欣幸的神情，
He strained to look delighted.

“好极，好极！
“Excellent!

以后要请胡先生多教导。”
In future I shall depend on your guidance.”

“不敢当，不敢当。”
“You are too kind.”

胡雪岩很恳切地，但说话已有老板的味道：
Hu sounded sincere, but already spoke as an owner.

“老兄在恒记多年，
“You have been at Hengji for years, brother.

将来着实还要借重。”
We shall have much to rely on you for.”

听得这一说，朱福年的脸色好看了些，赔着笑敷衍了一会。
Zhu’s expression eased a little, and he continued the courtesies with a conciliatory smile.

胡雪岩以话套话，将庞二跟他说的话，都打听了出来，
Drawing one remark out of another, Hu learnt what Pang had said.

果然说的是“大股份”。
He had indeed spoken of a “substantial stake.”

显然的，这是为了让他好受恒记的同人着重，有意这么说，
Clearly Pang had deliberately put it that way so that Hengji’s staff would give Hu due weight.

庞二真的很够交情。
He was a loyal friend indeed.


* * *由邵仲甫作东，吃了一顿丰盛的“番菜”，
Shao hosted a sumptuous Western meal.

庞二要陪怡云老七到洋行里去买首饰衣料，匆匆走了，
Pang, who was to accompany Yiyun to the foreign shops to buy jewellery and dress fabrics, left in haste.

主人留胡雪岩在原处喝“英国红茶”，有话要谈。
Their host detained Hu over “English black tea”; he had something to discuss.

在邵仲甫面前，庞二也说胡雪岩在恒记有大股份，
Pang had told Shao too that Hu held a substantial stake in Hengji.

因而他的神态也显得跟第一次见面不同，连称呼也改过了，
Shao’s manner had consequently changed since their first meeting, as had his form of address.

不是称兄道弟，而是叫“胡先生”。
Instead of calling him brother, he now called him “Mr Hu.”

“胡先生！”他说，“我有句话请教，
“Mr Hu, there is something I must ask.

刚刚庞二少爷关照，以后恒记跟同兴往来，归胡先生你经手，
Second Master Pang has just instructed us that you will henceforth handle Hengji’s dealings with Tongxing.

那么，朱福年来说的话，算不算数？
Does that mean we should still act on Zhu Funian’s instructions?”

“一下子问到要害上，
The question went straight to the heart of the matter.

胡雪岩不敢轻率回答，
Hu would not answer hastily.

先反问一句：“是什么话？”
“What sort of instructions?”

“恒记跟同兴的往来，本来都归朱福年一个人接头，
“Until now, Zhu alone has dealt with us for Hengji.

上十万银子的出入，或者调拨户头，都听他一句话。
Payments and receipts of over a hundred thousand taels, or transfers between accounts—we have acted on his word.

以后，我们听不听呢？”
Should we continue to do so?”

这“调拨户头”四个字，正就是胡雪岩要弄明白的，
“Transfers between accounts” was exactly what Hu wished to understand.

当然往下追问：
He followed it up.

“恒记在宝号有几个户头？”
“How many accounts does Hengji have with your bank?”

“三个。”邵仲甫答道：“恒记、继嘉堂、福记。”
“Three: Hengji, Jijia Hall, and Fuji.”

“继嘉堂”是庞家的堂名，“福记”当然是朱福年，
Jijia Hall was the Pang family’s hall name, while Fuji was, of course, Zhu Funian’s account.

这个都算是私人户头，
The latter two were private accounts.

但恒记与继嘉堂不可分，福记的私人户头如何可以跟恒记混在一起？
Hengji and Jijia Hall could not be separated, but how could Zhu’s own account properly be mixed with Hengji’s?

这其间，不言可知有了弊病。
The existence of irregularities was plain.

于是胡雪岩不但不答邵仲甫的询问，而且提出要求：
Instead of answering Shao, Hu made a request.

“请同兴先将福记历年进出的数目，抄个单子给我。”
“First have Tongxing copy out a statement of all Fuji’s receipts and payments over the past years for me.”


邵仲甫一听吓一跳。
Shao was startled.

这是钱庄的大忌，
This was a grave taboo in banking.

有钱的人，守着“财不露白”的古训，在钱庄里存款是决不肯告诉人的，
Wealthy people followed the old rule of never displaying their riches and would not tell others what they had deposited.

用堂名或用个什么“记”的户名，就是为了隐藏真相，
They used a family hall name or an account name ending in ji precisely to conceal the truth.

而钱庄里也有义务为客户守机密，
Banks, in turn, were obliged to keep their customers’ affairs secret.

如今将福记存款进出的数目，泄漏给第三者，这话一传出去，信用一失，
To disclose Fuji’s deposits and withdrawals to a third person—if word of it spread, confidence would collapse.

人人白危，都来提存，
Every customer would fear for himself and withdraw his money.

岂不把同兴挤垮。
Tongxing would be ruined by a run.

“胡先生，你是内行。”他哭丧着脸说：
“Mr Hu, you know our business,” Shao said miserably.

“这件事实在不敢从命。”
“I really cannot comply.”

他的难处，胡雪岩完全了解，所以早就想好了的，
Hu understood his difficulty perfectly and had already considered it.

这时便即问道，“仲甫兄，我跟你有没有仇？”
“Brother Zhongfu, is there any enmity between us?”

“哪里来的仇？”
“Why should there be?”

“那不就是了！
“Exactly.

我跟你无冤无仇，何必来害你？
Since we have no grievance against one another, why should I wish to harm you?

福记是纯粹的私人户头，我没有资格查他的帐，
If Fuji were a purely private account, I should have no right to inspect it.

既然跟恒记混在一起，当然我要弄弄清楚。
But since it has been mixed with Hengji’s, naturally I must find out what has happened.

就是在同兴来说，也有义务拿福记的进出开给我看。”
Tongxing too has an obligation to show me its transactions.

胡雪岩又说：“你放心好了！
Set your mind at rest.

我不会坏同业的规矩的。
I shall not break the rules of our profession.

这件事，无知地知，你知我知，
Heaven knows, Earth knows, you know, and I know.

连庞老二我都不告诉他，
I shall not tell even Pang.

你还怕什么？
What is there to fear?”

“邵仲甫想了想问道：
Shao considered this.

“胡先生，你要这张单子做啥用场，
“Mr Hu, what will you use the statement for?

是不是跟朱福年去算帐？”
To settle accounts with Zhu?”

“不是！”
“No.

胡雪岩说：“朱福年也不会晓得有这件事，
He will not even know it exists.

我是根据你开的单子，盘恒记的帐。”
I shall use the figures you give me to examine Hengji’s books.”

邵仲甫真的为难了，
Shao was in a genuine quandary.

“英国红茶”喝了一杯又一杯，只是答不出来。
He drank cup after cup of “English black tea,” unable to give an answer.


胡雪岩也知道这是件极严重的事，
Hu knew that this was a matter of the utmost seriousness.

不加点压力，邵仲甫决不肯就范，
Without pressure, Shao would never agree.

所以用相当冷峻的声音说道：“庞老二本有意叫我在上海立阜康的分号，
He therefore said in a rather cold voice, “Pang wanted me to establish a Fukang branch in Shanghai.

我因为你老兄有言在先，没有答应他。
Because of what you had already said to me, I did not agree.

现在在看来，只有自己有钱庄，帐目才能弄得清楚。”
Now it seems that only by having a bank of my own can I get a clear view of the accounts.”

说着，便有起身告辞的模样。
He made as though to rise and leave.

阜康一设分号，同兴当然再也做不成恒记的生意，
If Fukang opened a branch, Tongxing would naturally lose Hengji’s business.

这一着棋是“将”邵仲甫的“军”，他不能不着急。
The move put Shao in check, and he could not help growing anxious.

“胡先生，胡先生，有话好商量。
“Mr Hu, let us discuss this.

你能不能让我明天答你的话。”
Could you allow me until tomorrow to answer?”

“那自然可以。
“Certainly.

不过有一层，仲甫兄你千万记住，
But remember one thing, brother.

无论你答应也好，不答应也好，这件事只有你我两个人晓得。”
Whether you agree or refuse, this must remain known only to the two of us.”

意思是不可泄露其事给朱福年。
He meant that Zhu must hear nothing of it.

邵仲甫当然意会得到，连连答说：“我知道，我知道。”
Shao understood perfectly and repeatedly assured him, “I know.”


到了第二天一早，同兴钱庄派人送了信来，
Early the next morning a messenger came from Tongxing with a letter.

邵仲甫约胡雪岩，中午仍旧在那家番菜馆见面。
Shao asked Hu to meet him at noon at the same Western restaurant.

准时赴约，
Hu arrived on time.

点好了菜，等“仆欧”迟了出去，做主人的取出一个信封，摆在面前，跟他先有番话要交代。
Once they had ordered and the waiter had withdrawn, Shao took out an envelope, laid it before him, and said that there were some points he must first make clear.

邵仲甫提出了“约法三章”：
He proposed three conditions.

第一，这份清单不得泄漏给任何人，
First, the statement must not be disclosed to anyone.

第二，不得以此作为对付朱福年的根据，
Second, it must not be used as evidence against Zhu.

第三，不管胡雪岩是不是在上海设阜康的分号，恒记不能与同兴断绝往来。
Third, whether or not Hu opened a Fukang branch in Shanghai, Hengji must not break off its dealings with Tongxing.

第三点其实是请求，只是邵仲甫的措词不甚恰当，有些近乎要挟的意味。
The third point was really a request, but Shao’s unfortunate wording made it sound almost like coercion.

胡雪岩颇为不悦，
Hu was displeased.

“仲甫兄，”他这样答道：“第一、第二两点，我谨遵台命，
“Brother Zhongfu, I shall observe the first two conditions.

第三点，我只能这么说，我一定讲同业的义气。
On the third, I can only say that I shall honour my obligations to a fellow banker.

恒记如果是我一个人的事业，老兄吩咐，闲话一句，
If Hengji were mine alone, a word from you would settle it.

无奈大老板是庞老二，他又是大少爷脾气，
Unfortunately, the principal owner is Pang, and he has a young gentleman’s temper.

如果恼了他，翻脸不认人，我说的话，他也未见得听。
Anger him and he may turn his back on you; he will not necessarily listen to me.

所以这一点，完全要看你自己的做法，
So that depends entirely on your own conduct.

我在旁边总替同兴说好话就是。”
I shall always speak well of Tongxing at his side.”

这是暗示邵仲甫，如果同兴是这种近乎要侠的做法，庞二首先就会着恼，
The implication was that if Tongxing adopted this almost coercive manner, Pang would be the first to take offence.

邵仲甫也是极老到的人，一听他这话，自知失态，很见机地道歉。
Shao was experienced enough to recognize his mistake at once and tactfully apologized.

“胡先生，我不会说话，
“Mr Hu, I have expressed myself badly.

请你不要见怪。
Please do not hold it against me.

将来仰仗的地方还多，一切心照。
I shall have much to depend on you for in future, and we understand one another.

我也不多说了，
There is no need to say more.

总而言之，听你的吩咐就是。”
In short, I shall follow your instructions.”


胡雪岩的度量宽，有他这两句话，不满之意，随即消失。
Hu was generous in temper, and those words dispelled his displeasure.

等邵仲甫将他面前的信封移了过来，便即抽出里面的单子来看，
When Shao pushed the envelope across the table, he drew out the statement.

只见开头写的是“福记名下收付清单”，后面盖着“同兴协记钱庄”的书柬图章。
At the top it read “Statement of Receipts and Payments under the Fuji Account”; at the end was the correspondence seal of “Tongxing Xieji Bank.”

他不暇细看内容，将前后折起，用桌上现成的餐，裁下“福记”字样及同兴图章，
Without pausing to examine the figures, Hu folded back the top and bottom, took the table knife lying ready to hand, and cut off the account name “Fuji” and Tongxing’s seal.

各约一指宽的两张纸条，交回邵仲甫。
He returned the two strips, each about a finger’s width, to Shao.

这个小小的动作，使得邵仲甫大为服帖，
This small act won Shao over completely.

一则见得胡雪岩的诚意，不会拿这张清单作为对付朱福年的把柄，
First, it demonstrated Hu’s sincerity: he would not use the statement as evidence against Zhu.

二则也见得他心细，
Second, it revealed his care for detail.

邵仲甫发觉自己做错了，
Shao realized that he himself had made a mistake.

本来就不必写明“福记”字样，更不必盖上书柬图章，
There had been no need to write the name Fuji, still less to stamp the paper with the bank’s seal.

纵然胡雪岩无他，万一遗失了这张清单，落入旁人手中，依然是件极不妥的事。
Even if Hu intended no harm, the statement might be lost and fall into someone else’s hands, which would be highly undesirable.

幸好，他的这个错误，为胡雪岩及时纠正了。
Fortunately, Hu had corrected the mistake in time.

“胡先生，”他由衷地表示佩服，“有魄力的人，粗枝大叶，心细的人，手面放不开。
“Mr Hu,” Shao said with heartfelt admiration, “bold men tend to overlook details, while careful men lack breadth of action.

只有你胡先生，这两样长处都有，
You alone possess both qualities.

实在是没话可说了。”
There is really nothing more to be said.”

“谬奖，谬奖！”
“You praise me too highly!”

胡雪岩亦颇欣慰，
Hu too was pleased.

因为邵仲甫言出至诚，看起来自己是在事业上结交了一个很有用的朋友。
Shao spoke with complete sincerity, and it seemed that Hu had gained a very useful friend in business.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第三十一章（上）
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Thirty-One, Part One
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第三十一章｜CHAPTER THIRTY-ONE


朱福年的“把柄”虽已入手，胡雪岩却反丢开了，
Although Hu now held evidence against Zhu Funian, he put it aside.

他做事一向往好的方面走，眼前的唯一大事是与庞二谈判合伙的细节。
He always preferred to turn affairs towards a favourable outcome, and his one immediate concern was to settle the details of his partnership with Pang Er.

由于彼此都具诚意，谈判相当顺利，
Since both were sincere, their negotiations went smoothly.

胡雪岩在恒记不居任何名义，但先要为恒记作一番整顿，
Hu would hold no formal title at Hengji, but would first put its affairs in order.

等到有了头绪，再进行筹设阜康钱庄上海分号。
Once that work had taken shape, he would proceed with preparations for a Shanghai branch of Fukang Bank.

对这方面，庞二表示概不过问，
Pang said he would leave that entirely to Hu.

又说，如果胡雪岩资金不足，他可以拉一批长期存款的户头来，变相地为阜康增添资本。
If Hu lacked funds, he could introduce customers willing to make long-term deposits, thereby increasing Fukang's working capital indirectly.

于是，双方找了见证人来写台伙的契约，
They then invited witnesses to draw up the partnership agreement.

胡雪岩请的是尤五，庞二找了一个他的父执，专做桐油出口的孙大存，
Hu asked You Laowu; Pang chose Sun Dacun, a friend of his father's who specialized in exporting tung oil.

合同签押好了，庞二大张筵席，请见证人，也请恒记管事的人，包括朱福年在内，
Once the agreement had been signed and sealed, Pang gave a grand banquet for the witnesses and Hengji's managers, Zhu included.

即席宣布，赋胡雪岩以盘查银钱货色、考查同人、重新改组的大权。
There he announced that Hu had full authority to examine the firm's money and merchandise, assess its staff and reorganize its operations.

胡雪岩接着又站起来说了话，表示决不轻易更动，
Hu rose in turn and assured everyone that he would make no changes lightly.

请大家照常办事，不必三心两意，
They should carry on as usual, without doubts or divided minds.

话不多而扼要，每人都象服了颗定心丸。当然，只有朱福年是例外。
His few concise words reassured them all—except Zhu.

到了第二天，朱福年来请胡雪岩到恒记去“视事”。
Next day Zhu came to invite Hu to Hengji to assume his duties.

他早就打好了主意，
Hu had already decided how to proceed.

到了恒记在帐户中坐定，管事的人一个个来见过，他问了问各人的经历，随即起身辞别，
Once seated in the countinghouse, he received the managers one by one, asked about their experience, then rose to leave.

朱福年请他看帐，
Zhu invited him to examine the accounts.

他回说：“不忙。
“There is no hurry.

慢慢儿来好了。”
We can take our time.”

这一半是放朱福年一马，看他是不是自己去弥补他的“花帐”，一半也是实话，
Partly he was giving Zhu a chance to repair his irregular accounts himself; partly he meant exactly what he said.

因为眼前先有件与他切身利害有关的大事要办。
Another urgent matter directly affecting his own interests came first.


恒记人事上的变动，朱福年已经告诉了怡和洋行的大班吉伯特。
Zhu had told Gilbert, the head of Jardine Matheson, about the changes at Hengji.

这个意外的变化，自然是一大打击，
This unexpected development was naturally a serious blow.

但朱福年还不服气，
But Zhu remained defiant.

怂恿吉伯特说：胡雪岩实力不足，只要吉伯特坚持原议，必可迫他杀价脱手。
He urged Gilbert to remember that Hu lacked sufficient resources: by holding to his proposal, Gilbert could force Hu to sell at a reduced price.

因此，当古应春跟吉伯恃再度会面，说明恒记的丝亦归他经手，要求照最初的议价成交时，吉伯特断然拒绝，
When Gu Yingchun met Gilbert again, explained that Hengji's silk was now also in his hands, and requested a sale at the price originally negotiated, Gilbert therefore refused outright.

依旧以欧洲丝价大跌为托词，只肯照八五折收买。
Still pleading a sharp fall in European silk prices, he would offer only eighty-five per cent of that price.

事情成了僵局，胡雪岩相当为难，
The business was deadlocked, and Hu faced a real dilemma.

如果坚持原价，万一不能成交，不但自己的本钱搁不起，丝也会变质，而且对庞二这方面也难以交代，
If he held to the original price and no sale resulted, he could not afford to leave his capital tied up, the silk would deteriorate, and he would have difficulty explaining matters to Pang.

倘或委曲，则更不能求全，
Yet yielding would bring no satisfactory solution either.

不但为宠二所笑，在商场上辛辛苦苦建立起来的名声，亦会大打折扣。
Pang would laugh at him, and the commercial reputation he had built with such effort would suffer badly.

同时还有一层顾虑，
He had another concern.

也许朱福年已经跟庞二说过，他那里的货色，可以照原定的价钱卖给吉伯特，
Perhaps Zhu had already told Pang that he could sell Hengji's goods to Gilbert at the agreed price.

由自己来经手，反打了个八五折，即或庞二了解其中的苦衷，为了划一步骤，以后易于控制全局，眼前不能不吃点亏，但心里总不会舒服，
If Hu took over and obtained only eighty-five per cent, Pang might understand the difficulty—that a unified course of action and future control of the whole business required an immediate sacrifice—but he could hardly feel pleased.

那就要影响彼此合伙的关系了。
Their partnership would suffer.


“我在想，吉伯特恐怕也是‘嘴硬骨头酥’，
“I wonder whether Gilbert is all hard words and soft bones.

莫非他买不成我们中国的丝，外国那些绸厂就拿织机停下来，不同绸缎？
If he cannot buy our Chinese silk, will the foreign silk mills stop their looms and cease weaving?

我想总没有这样的道理吧？”
Surely that cannot be so?”

这一说，触发了古应春的灵感，
This gave Gu an inspiration.

“有了，”他喜滋滋地说，
“I have it!” he said delightedly.

“我有个办法，打听他的虚实！”
“I know a way to discover how he really stands.”

“那太好了。”
“Excellent!”

胡雪岩精神一振，
Hu brightened.

“我就是想要晓得他手里的牌，
“That is just what I want: to see his hand.

看样子‘三副落地’，到底是不是清一色呢？
He seems to have three sets exposed already, but is he really playing for a hand all of one suit?

如果不是，我们死扣着那张牌，不是自己害自己？”
If he isn't, aren't we hurting ourselves by holding back that one tile?”

“就是这话。
“Exactly.

我马上去打听”““慢来！”
I shall find out at once.” “Wait.”

胡雪岩拉住他说，
Hu caught his arm.

“你怎么样下手，先说来我听听！”
“Tell me how you mean to go about it.”

“吉伯特听了朱福年的话，自然以为千稳万妥，
“After listening to Zhu, Gilbert must think himself perfectly secure.

买不成我们的货色，至少可以买恒记的，
Even if he cannot buy our goods, he can at least buy Hengji's.

有了货色，当然要定轮船舱位装货。
With goods in prospect, he will naturally have booked space aboard steamships.

我就从轮船公司方面去打听，看他定了舱位没有？
I shall ask the shipping company whether he has made a reservation.

“古应春又说，”货色不在少数，
This is a substantial shipment.

一两条船还装不下，非先预定不可。
One or two ships cannot take it all; space must be booked in advance.

所以一定打听得出来的。“
We are certain to find something out.”


“对！
“Good!

这个办法好。”
An excellent idea.”

胡雪岩的脑筋极快，当时便说：
Hu's mind moved quickly.

“除非他真的不想做这票生意，要做这票生意，不但要他照我们的价钱，额外还要他破费。”古应春笑了。
“Unless he truly means to abandon this transaction, we shall make him pay our price—and something extra besides.” Gu laughed.

由于心情由沉重转为轻松，所以戏谑地挖苦胡雪岩：
Relieved of his earlier heaviness, he teased Hu.

“小爷叔，你也真是，得着风就是雨！
“Little Uncle, you hear a breeze and call it rain!

给不得你三分颜色，就要开大红染坊了。”
Give you a little colour and you open a great scarlet dyehouse.”

“我说个道理你听，你就晓得我不是胡言乱说。”
“Let me explain my reasoning, and you will see that I am not talking nonsense.”

照他的判断，吉伯特以为自己这方面迟早总会就范，所以轮船的舱位定好了不会退掉，
Hu thought Gilbert believed they would eventually submit, so he would not cancel the shipping space he had booked.

如果能够跟轮船公司接洽，以高价将吉伯特所定的舱位抢过来，则洋人买下了丝运不出去，
If they approached the shipping company and offered a higher price to take that space themselves, the foreigner might buy the silk only to find he could not ship it.

又会来跟自己这方面情商转让，岂不又可以赚他一笔。
He would then have to negotiate with them for the space, allowing them to make another profit.

“这是如意算盘。”古应春说，
“That is a very hopeful calculation,” Gu said.

“不过也不妨试试。”
“Still, we might try.”

说到这里，他触类旁通，仍旧觉得胡雪岩的话极有用，
The suggestion gave him another idea, and he again found Hu's words useful.

“小爷叔，你说的办法，恐怕行不通，不过我倒想到了，大可借这个说法，逼他一逼。”
“Your plan may not work, Little Uncle, but we could certainly use the threat of it to put pressure on him.”

“嗯，嗯！”胡雪岩意会了，点点头说：
Hu understood and nodded.

“你请吧！
“Go, then.

我等你的回音。”
I shall wait for your news.”


于是古应春去寻一个名叫陈顺生的朋友，此人是他的同乡，在太古轮船公司做买办，专门负责招揽客货承运。
Gu went to see a friend named Chen Shunsheng, a fellow townsman who worked as a comprador for the Swire Steamship Company, responsible for securing passenger and freight business.

太古也是英国人的资本，怡和有货色交运，当然委托太古。
Swire was also British-owned, so Jardine Matheson naturally entrusted its shipments to it.

一问果然，
His inquiry confirmed the guess.

“不错，有这回事。”陈顺生答道：
“Yes, that is right,” Chen said.

“先是定了两班轮船的舱位，
“He first booked space on two sailings.

到期说货色还不齐，要延到下两班，
When the time came, he said the goods were not ready and asked to postpone to the next two.

贴了四百两银子的损失。”
He paid four hundred taels to cover the loss.”

“那么下两班什么时候到？”
“When do the next two arrive?”

“一班十天以后，还有一班要半个月。
“One in ten days, the other in half a month.

到埠卸货装货，要十天工夫。”
Unloading and loading in port will take ten days.

陈顺生问，“你打听它是为什么？”
Why are you asking?”

托人办事，当然要相见以诚，
When requesting help, one ought to speak frankly.

而且是同乡好友，也不必顾虑他会“泄底”，
Chen was both a fellow townsman and a close friend, so Gu had no reason to fear that he would disclose their position.

所以古应春将跟吉伯特斗法的经过，源源本本说了一遍，接着便托陈顺生去“逼他一逼”。
He explained the contest with Gilbert from beginning to end, then asked Chen to put some pressure on him.

“延过一次期，话就更好说了。”古应春低声说道：
“Since he has already postponed once, you have all the more reason to ask,” Gu said quietly.

“我拜托你问一问吉伯特，货色齐了没有？到时候能不能装船？
“Please find out whether his goods are ready and can be loaded on time.

如果不能，要趁早说，好让太古另外去招揽客户。”
If not, he should say so early, allowing Swire to seek other customers.”

“懂了。
“Understood.

这个忙我可以帮你。”
I can help you with that.”

“多谢，多谢。
“Thank you.

今天晚上我请你吃花酒，顺便听你的消息。”
I shall entertain you at a courtesan house tonight and hear your news.”

“这么急？”
“So urgent?”

“拜托，拜托！”古应春长揖恳求，“务必请你就跑一趟。”
Gu bowed deeply. “I beg you to go at once.”


情面难却，陈顺生真的丢下了自己的事，去为古应春奔走。
Unable to refuse his friend's appeal, Chen set aside his own affairs and went on Gu's errand.

到了晚上在估情院见面，他带来了吉伯特的消息。
When they met at Yiqing House that evening, he brought Gilbert's answer.

“他说等三夭看。
“He asks us to wait three days.

如果三天当中没有回话再谈。”
If he has not replied by then, we can discuss it again.”

“怎么叫‘再谈，？”古应春问，
“Discuss what?” Gu asked.

“是谈班期顺延，还是根本就不要舱位了？”
“Postponing to another sailing, or giving up the space altogether?”

“怎么不要？
“Why would he give it up?

当然要的！”
Of course he still wants it.”

古应春听得这个回音，十分满意。
Gu was thoroughly satisfied.

足见怡和洋和非买丝不可，而且在三天以内就会来谈判。
This showed, he thought, that Jardine Matheson had to buy the silk and would come to negotiate within three days.

这个看法，胡雪岩也认为不错，但主张再逼一逼。
Hu agreed with this assessment, but favoured applying still more pressure.

这就是请陈顺生再跟吉伯特去说，有客户求货运舱位甚急，
Chen should tell Gilbert that another customer urgently wanted freight space.

请他在三天以内，必须提出确实答复，否则，吉伯特就得照约履行，即使放弃不用，亦要照全价收费。
Gilbert must give a definite answer within three days; otherwise, he would have to fulfil the contract and pay the full charge even if he chose not to use the space.


“这一逼还不够。”胡雪岩又说，
“That is still not enough,” Hu added.

“我们还要想个办法，让吉伯特以为我们不愿意跟他再做生意，
“We must make Gilbert think we no longer wish to do business with him.

他才会着慌，
Then he will become anxious.

你看，我们是不是能够另外找洋人接头，虚张声势一番？”
Could we approach another foreigner and make a show of it?”

“不行！
“No.

洋人比我们团结，彼此都通声气的，
The foreigners are more united than we are and exchange information.

而且哪个洋行做哪项买卖，完全听他们国内指挥，
Besides, each firm's line of business is determined by instructions from home.

不会突然之间改做别项生意。
They do not suddenly change to something else.

虚张声势瞒不过吉伯特。”古应春又说：
Such a display would not deceive Gilbert.

“倒是有个办法，我们放个风声出去，预备立一间号子，专做洋庄，直接写信给外国厂家交涉。
But there is another possibility: spread word that we intend to establish a firm dealing directly with foreign markets and write to manufacturers overseas ourselves.

看吉伯特怎么说？”
Then see what Gilbert says.”

“这也是一个办法。
“That is one way.

不过，”
Still...”

胡雪岩沉吟了一会说：
Hu reflected.

“俗语说得好：”前半夜想想自己，后半夜想想人家。
“As the saying goes, think of yourself for the first half of the night, and of others for the second.

‘吉伯特就算愿意回头，总也要有个’落场话‘。
Even if Gilbert is willing to reconsider, he needs a way to retreat with dignity.

大家的话都很硬，自己转不来弯，
Both sides have spoken so firmly that neither can turn back easily.

我们要替吉伯特开条路子出来。
We must leave him a way out.

你说是不是？
Don't you agree?”

““我也想到过。
“I have thought of that too.

就怕我们想转圜，他以为我们软弱，越发搭架子，
But if we seek a compromise, he may mistake it for weakness and grow more overbearing.

岂非僵上加僵？”
Wouldn't that only deepen the deadlock?”

对这个顾虑，胡雪岩无法作判断了，
Hu could not judge this concern.

因为洋人做生意的规矩，以及吉伯特的性情，他都不太了解。
He knew too little about foreign business practices or Gilbert's character.

只是将心比心，自己不肯低头，谅来吉伯特也是如此，
Putting himself in the other man's place, he merely felt that since he was unwilling to bow first, Gilbert probably felt the same.

如果从中有个穿针引线的人，搭一搭桥，事情使容易办通了。
An intermediary to bring them together would make matters easier.

“小爷叔！”古应春看他犹豫的神色，提醒他说：“洋人做生意，讲利益，也讲道理，
Seeing his hesitation, Gu reminded him, “Little Uncle, foreigners care about profit, but also about reason.

只要我们道理站得住，态度坚决，洋人倒是不讲面子的，自会笑嘻嘻来跟你说好话。
If our case is sound and our position firm, they will not stand on dignity; they will come smiling to speak pleasantly to us.

所以你不要三心二意，
So do not waver.

让洋人看穿了，事情格外难办。”
If they see through you, matters will become still harder.”


胡雪岩最尊重行家的意见，
Hu always respected expert opinion.

古应春跟洋人的交道打得多，自然听他的，
Gu had dealt extensively with foreigners, so he naturally followed his advice.

“那好！”
“Very well.

他说，“我们就做一番态度坚决的表示给他看，
Let us show Gilbert how firm we are.

请尤五哥弄两条船，我们拿货色装上去。”
Ask Brother You to find two boats; we shall load our goods aboard.”

“这，这表示，绝不卖给他了？”
“To show that we absolutely will not sell to him?”

“对了！
“Exactly.

对外头说，我们的丝改内销了，预备卖给杭州织造衙门。”
Say we are turning to the domestic market and intend to sell the silk to the Hangzhou Imperial Weaving Office.”

“那么，恒记的货色呢？”
“And Hengji's goods?”

“这我会跟庞二说，让庞二关照朱福年，也是雇船运杭州。”
“I shall speak to Pang and have him tell Zhu to hire boats for Hangzhou too.”

古应春闭着嘴，脸色郑重地考虑好一会，
Gu considered this silently for some time, his expression grave.

毅然决然地答道：“可以！
Then he answered decisively, “Yes.

我们就这么做。
Let us do it.

不过，庞二对朱福年说的话很要紧。”
But what Pang says to Zhu will be crucial.”

“那当然！
“Of course.

我知道。”
I understand.

胡雪岩说，“朱福年自然要劝他，不必受我们这方面的牵累拿丝卖给吉伯特。
Zhu will advise him to avoid being dragged into our difficulties and sell his silk to Gilbert.

庞二只要说一句：”胡某人怎么样，我们怎么样，
Pang need only say, ‘We shall do whatever Hu does.

吉伯特要买丝跟胡某人去接头。
If Gilbert wants silk, let him approach Hu.’

‘那就成功了。
That will settle it.”

“照胡雪岩的估计，朱福年当然会将庞二的态度告诉吉伯特，吉伯特一定会回头。
Hu reckoned that Zhu would certainly report Pang's attitude to Gilbert, who would then reconsider.

如果不理，那么僵局就真的不能化解了。
If he ignored it, the deadlock would indeed become insoluble.

自己这方面固然损失惨重，怡和洋行从此也就不用再想在中国买丝。
Their own losses would be heavy, but Jardine Matheson need never again expect to buy silk in China.


想到就做，而且象煞有介事，
They acted at once, with every appearance of earnest purpose.

裕记线栈开了仓，一包包的丝，用板车送到内河码头上去装船。
Yuji Silk Warehouse opened its store, and carts carried bundle after bundle of silk to the inland-waterway wharf for loading.

另一方面，庞二听了胡雪岩的话，照计行事。
Meanwhile, Pang followed Hu's plan.

他做生意多少有点公子哥儿的脾气，喜欢发发“骠劲”，
In business he retained something of a rich young gentleman's temperament and enjoyed an occasional display of defiance.

把朱福年找了来，叫他雇船装丝运杭州，
Summoning Zhu, he ordered him to hire boats and load the silk for Hangzhou.

一言不合，拿朱福年训了一顿。
At the first disagreement, he gave Zhu a scolding.

“二少爷！”朱福年问，“这是为啥？”
“Second Master,” Zhu asked, “why are we doing this?”

“丝不卖给洋人了！
“Because we are not selling to the foreigners!

可以不可以？”
May we not choose?”

“那也不用运杭州。
“But there is no need to send it to Hangzhou.

运到杭州卖给哪个？”
Who will buy it there?”

“卖给织造衙门。”
“The Imperial Weaving Office.”

“二少爷，这不对吧！”
“That cannot be right, Second Master.

他说，“从一闹长毛，京里就有圣旨。各织造衙门的贡品都减少了。
Ever since the Taiping troubles began, imperial orders from the capital have reduced the tribute goods required of all the weaving offices.

怎么会买我们的丝？
Why would they buy our silk?

这点道理，难道二少爷都不懂？”
Surely you understand that much?”

“我不懂你懂！”
“You understand everything, and I understand nothing!”

庞二的声音粗了，
Pang's voice grew harsh.

“除非有人吃里扒外，不然洋人怎么会晓得我们的情形？
“Unless someone was betraying us from within, how would the foreigners know our circumstances?

你跟洋人去说，他有洋钱是他的，我不希罕。
Tell the foreigner that his silver is his own; I care nothing for it.

他到中国来做生意，三翻四覆，处处想占便宜，
He comes to China to trade, changes his position again and again, and tries to take advantage at every turn.

当我们中国人好欺负？
Does he think we Chinese are easily bullied?

滚他娘的蛋！”
To hell with him!”


这种情形，遇到过不止一次，
Zhu had encountered such scenes before.

朱福年也知道他不过一时之气，
He knew this was merely a passing fit of temper.

做伙计的遇上有脾气的东家，当不得真，否则不如早早卷铺盖走路。
An employee with a hot-tempered master could not take everything seriously; otherwise, he might as well pack up and leave.

而况，庞二虽有脾气，御下相当宽厚，
Besides, for all his temper, Pang treated his staff generously.

象恒记这种职位是“金饭碗”，丢掉了不易再找。
A post at Hengji was a golden rice bowl, hard to replace once lost.

所以想一想，宁可挨骂，该说的话还是要说，才显得自己是“忠心耿耿”。
Zhu therefore decided to endure the abuse and say what needed saying, demonstrating his “unswerving loyalty.”

“二少爷，难怪你发脾气，
“You have reason to be angry, Second Master.

洋人是不大对，
The foreigner has behaved badly.

不过，他既然是来做生意，当然没有空手而回的道理，
But he came to do business and can hardly return empty-handed.

我看，丝是一定要买的，
I believe he must buy the silk.

就是价钱上有上落……”
The only question is the price.”

“免谈。
“No discussion.

少一个‘沙壳子’都办不到。
I will not take a single copper less.

就算现在照我的价钱，卖不卖也要看我的高兴。”
Even if he offers my price now, whether I sell depends on my mood.”

“二少爷，生意到底是生意。”他试探着说：
“Business is business, after all,” Zhu ventured.

“要不要我再跟洋人去谈谈？
“Shall I speak to him again?

如果肯依我们的价钱，不如早早脱手，钱也赚了，麻烦也没有。”
If he accepts our price, we might as well sell quickly, make our profit and end the trouble.”

“我不管。
“I am not dealing with it.

你跟胡先生去谈，看他怎么说就怎么说。”
Speak to Mr Hu and follow whatever he says.”

听得这一句话，朱福年只觉得酸味直味脑顶，
At these words, bitterness seemed to rise to the top of Zhu's head.

顿时改了主意，
He changed his mind at once.

回到帐房里，自己在咕哝：“他娘的，随他去。
Back in the countinghouse, he muttered, “Damn him, let him do as he likes.

看他这票货色能摆到啥辰光？”
We shall see how long he can sit on that silk.”

这话是什对胡雪岩而说的，
He meant Hu.

原来是“忠心耿耿”对东家，此时决定牺牲东家的利益，变相打击胡雪岩，
His earlier “loyalty” to his employer gave way to a decision to sacrifice that employer's interests in order to strike indirectly at Hu.

真的雇了船，连夜装货，预备直驶杭州。
He actually hired boats, loaded them through the night and prepared to send them straight to Hangzhou.

但是，吉伯特却沉不住气了，
Gilbert, however, was losing his composure.

一面是陈顺生来催，一面是对方的丝真有改为内销的迹象，不由得便软化了，急于想找个人来转圜。
With Chen pressing him on one side, and real signs that the silk might be diverted to the domestic market on the other, he began to yield and urgently sought someone to arrange a compromise.


* * *这些情形胡雪岩不知道，
Hu knew none of this.

他只听庞二说过，朱福年自告奋勇，愿跟吉伯特去重开谈判。又说已告诉朱福年，一切都听自己作主。
Pang had merely told him that Zhu had volunteered to reopen negotiations with Gilbert, and that he had instructed Zhu to leave all decisions to Hu.

既如此，则朱福年不论谈判得如何，都该跟自己来接头。
In that case, whatever the result, Zhu should have approached him.

何以不见他的踪影，反倒真的雇船装货？
Why had he vanished instead, actually hiring boats and loading the goods?

显见得其中起了变化。
Something had plainly changed.

“如果朱福年肯去说，倒是最适当的人选。”古应春也说，
“If Zhu were willing to speak to him, he would be the best intermediary,” Gu said.

“不过现在对他弄僵了，我们不便在他面前示弱，
“But now that our relations with him are strained, we cannot appear weak before him.

只有再请庞二去问他。”
We can only ask Pang to inquire.”

胡雪岩沉吟未答，
Hu reflected without answering.

古应春看的是一面，他要看两面，
Gu was considering one side; he had to consider two.

一面容易找出办法，
Finding a remedy for one side was easy.

要兼顾两面，就煞费周章了。
Providing for both required much more care.

“庞二以东家的身分，问他一声，这件事办得怎么了，有何不可。”
“As his employer, Pang can surely ask how the business is progressing,” Gu continued.

“自无不可，
“Of course.

不过那是不得已的办法，套句你们文绉绉的话，是下策。”
But that is a last resort—the inferior strategy, to borrow your scholarly language.”

“怎么样才是上策呢？”胡雪岩有些答非所问地：
“What would be the superior strategy?” Hu answered somewhat indirectly.

“象猪八戒这种样子，我们杭州话，叫做‘不入调’。
“A man like Pigsy is what we in Hangzhou call ‘out of tune.’

现在好比唱出戏，
Imagine that we are performing an opera.

我跟庞二唱的是‘乙字调’，他唱的是”扒字调‘，
Pang and I are singing in a high key, and he in a low one.

根本搭配不拢。
We cannot fit together.

我们调门高的，唱到半路拉不低，就算拉低了来迁就他，这出戏也好听不到哪里去了。
Halfway through, we cannot lower our key; even if we did, the performance would not be worth hearing.”

“古应春把他这个比方，体味了一会，恍然大悟，
Gu considered the comparison and suddenly understood.

“我懂了！”
“I see!

他说，“上策是叫朱福年将调门提高，让它入调！”
The superior strategy is to make Zhu raise his key and sing in tune.”

“一点都不错。”
“Exactly.”

“想倒想得不错。”
“A fine idea.”

古应春看一看胡雪岩的脸色，猜不透他葫芦里卖的什么药，
Gu studied Hu's expression, unable to guess his concealed purpose.

只好老实问道：“计将安出？”
He could only ask plainly, “But how?”


“喏！就靠这个。”
“With this.”

他从身上掏出一张纸来一扬，
Hu produced a sheet of paper and waved it.

古应春认出是同兴抄来的那张“福记”收付清单。
Gu recognized the statement of receipts and payments for the Fuji account copied from Tongxing's records.

“你倒看看，
“Look at it.

这里面有啥毛病？”
What is wrong here?”

古应春仔细看了一遍，实在找不出毛病，
Gu examined it carefully but could find nothing.

“我看不出。”
“I cannot see it.

他摇摇头，“钱庄生意，我是外行。”
Banking is outside my trade.”

“用不着行家，
“You need no special knowledge.

照普通清理，就可以看得出来的。
Ordinary reasoning will do.

他一个做伙计的人，就算在恒记是头脑，
He is an employee, even if he is Hengji's chief manager.

进出数目，充其量万把银子，至矣尽矣。
At the very most, his own transactions could amount to ten thousand taels or so.

所以，”胡雪岩指着单子说：“这几笔大数目，都有毛病，
These large entries must therefore be wrong.

尤其是这一笔，收五万、付五万，
Especially this one: fifty thousand received, fifty thousand paid out.

收的哪一个的，付的哪一个的？
From whom, and to whom?

如果说是恒记的生意，头寸一时兜不转，他有款子，先代垫五万，这倒也说得过去。
If Hengji were temporarily short of funds and he had fifty thousand to advance, that might make sense.

现在明明是转一个手，
But here the money simply passes through his hands.

我可以断定收的五万是从恒记来的。
I am certain the fifty thousand came from Hengji.

如果恒记要付偿款，直接支付好了，
If Hengji had a payment to make, why not make it directly?

为啥在要福记的户头里打个转？”
Why pass it through the Fuji account?”

他这样一说，古应春也觉得大有疑问，
Gu now found it highly suspicious too.

“那么，”他问，“小爷叔，你就当面拆穿他，让他不能不买你的帐？”
“Then will you expose him to his face and force him to respect your wishes?”

要当面拆穿，我早就动手了，
“If I meant to expose him, I would have acted long ago.

为的是要顾他的面子。
I am considering his dignity.

我自有道理，
I have my reasons.

明天上午你在这里等我消息。“
Wait here for word from me tomorrow morning.”


* * *第二天上午，胡雪岩到恒记说要看看帐，
Next morning Hu went to Hengji and asked to examine the accounts.

朱福年自然无话可说，
Zhu had no grounds to refuse.

硬着头皮，亲自开锁，从柜子里捧出一大叠总帐来。
Bracing himself, he unlocked a cabinet and brought out a great stack of general ledgers.

“总帐不必看，
“No need for the general ledgers.

我看看流水。
Let me see the daybooks.

你的帐不会错的，我随便挑几天看看好了。”
Your accounts will be correct; I shall merely choose a few days at random.”

接着，胡雪岩便说，“请你拿咸丰三年七月、十月、十一月的流水帐给我。”
Hu then requested the daybooks for the seventh, tenth and eleventh lunar months of the third year of Xianfeng's reign.

听这样交代，朱福年大放其心，以为他真的不过随便抽查，便依言将这三个月的流水帐找了出来，捧到他的面前。
Greatly relieved, Zhu assumed that Hu really intended only a casual spot check and brought him the three months' books.

胡雪岩翻到七月初八那一天细看，
Hu turned to the eighth day of the seventh month and examined it closely.

果然，有一笔五万两银子的现款，送于同兴。
Sure enough, fifty thousand taels in cash had been sent to Tongxing.

“福年兄。”他说，“请你拿‘恒记’户头的存折我看看。”
“Brother Funian, let me see the passbook for the Hengji account.”

朱福年的一颗心，陡地提了起来：
Zhu's heart suddenly rose into his throat.

“是不是现在在用的那一个？”
“The one currently in use?”

这句话便是个老大的漏洞。
The question exposed a serious weakness.

按常理而论，应该就是目前在用的那一个，何消问得？
Ordinarily, that would naturally be the book required; why ask?

问到这话，便表示他是“哑子吃馄饨，肚里有数”，
His question showed that, like a mute man eating wontons, he knew the count in his own stomach.

胡雪岩的不是这一个。
He knew Hu wanted a different book.

这见得朱福年不是什么老奸巨滑，
This suggested that Zhu was no hardened master of deception.

只因为庞二到底是大少爷，只要对了他的脾气，什么都好说话。
Pang was, after all, a pampered young gentleman: humour him properly and everything was easy.

意会到此，胡雪岩越发打定了将朱福年收为己用的主意，
Recognizing this, Hu became still more determined to win Zhu over for his own use.

因而在表面上越对他尊重，和颜悦色地说：“不晓得找起来方便不方便？
Outwardly, he treated him with greater respect and asked pleasantly, “Would they be easy to find?

我想拿这两年的存折，大略看一遍。”
I should like to glance through the passbooks for the last two years.”

越是这样，越使朱福年有莫测高深之感，
The more considerate he was, the less Zhu could fathom him.

喏喏连声地说：“方便，方便。”
“Quite easy, quite easy,” he answered repeatedly.


一把存折送了过来，
A bundle of passbooks was brought over.

胡雪岩慢条斯理地随意浏览，一面说着闲话，根不不象查帐的样子。
Hu browsed through them at leisure, chatting as he did so, with nothing in his manner to suggest an audit.

朱福年却没有他那份闲豫情致，
Zhu had no such ease.

惴惴然坐在帐桌对面，表面是准备接受询问，其实一双眼只瞪在存折上。
He sat anxiously across the desk, ostensibly ready to answer questions, while his eyes remained fixed on the books.

“朱先生！”小徒弟走来通报，“船老大有事来接头。”
“Mr Zhu,” a young apprentice came to announce, “the boatmaster has come on business.”

这“船老大”就是承揽装丝运杭州的船家。朱福年不能不去接头。
This was the man engaged to carry the silk to Hangzhou, and Zhu had to see him.

趁这空档，胡雪岩在存折上翻到咸丰三年七月初八那一天。
During his absence, Hu turned in the passbook to the eighth day of the seventh month in Xianfeng's third year.

那里有同兴收银五万两的记载。
There was a record of Tongxing receiving fifty thousand taels.

胆子倒真大！
What nerve!

胡雪岩心里在想，莫非硬吞五万银子？
Had he actually pocketed fifty thousand?

这盘帐倒要细看了。
Hu must examine this transaction closely.

他是这一行的好手，
He was an expert in the trade.

如今虽因不大管帐打算盘，但要算起帐来，还是眼明手快，
Though he seldom kept accounts or worked an abacus now, his eyes and hands were still quick.

帐薄与存折一对，再看一看总帐，便弄清楚了，
Comparing the account book with the passbook, then consulting the general ledger, he soon understood.

朱福年硬吞五万银子还不敢，
Zhu had not dared to steal fifty thousand outright.

只是挪用了公款，以后在半个月中，分四次归还了。
He had diverted the firm's money to his own use, then repaid it in four instalments over the following half month.

然而这已是做伙计的大忌。
Even this, however, was a grave offence for an employee.

胡雪岩认为不必细看，
Hu felt no need to examine further.

将翻开的帐簿、存折都收好，静等朱福年来答话。
He closed the books and passbooks he had opened and waited quietly for Zhu's return.


“船老大来问，货都装齐了，问啥时候开船？”朱福年说，
“The boatmaster says everything is loaded and asks when to sail,” Zhu reported.

“我告诉他，跟胡先生的货色搭帮走，比较有照应。
“I told him to travel with your shipment so that the boats could look after one another.

不晓得胡先生的丝船，啥时候开？”
When will your silk boats leave?”

很显然地，就这样一查帐，还未有何结果，就已让他感到威胁，不能不来周旋示好。
Plainly, the mere examination of the accounts, before any result had been announced, had threatened him enough to make him seek friendly relations.

胡雪岩便将计就计地说：
Hu took advantage of the opening.

“我们那票货色，是我的朋友古应春在料理。
“My friend Gu Yingchun is handling our shipment.

如果福年兄有空，中午我们一起吃饭，当面谈一谈这件事。
If you are free, Brother Funian, why not lunch together and discuss it with him?

你看好不好。”
What do you say?”

“好，好！”朱福年急忙答应，
“Certainly!” Zhu agreed eagerly.

“我做个小东，请胡先生吃徽馆。”
“Allow me to offer a modest lunch at a Huizhou restaurant.”

“哪个做东都一样。
“It makes no difference who is host.

请你拿帐薄、存折收一收，我们就走吧。”
Put away the books and passbooks, and let us go.”

看样子太平无事了，
Everything seemed to have passed without incident.

朱福年顿觉步履轻快，浑身是劲，
Zhu suddenly felt light on his feet and full of energy.

收拾一切，陪着胡雪岩出了恒记的大门。
After putting everything away, he accompanied Hu out of Hengji.


“就是后马路，有家徽馆，叫做福源楼，
“There is a Huizhou restaurant on Houmalu, called Fuyuanlou.

做几样我们家乡菜，着实道地。
Some of its dishes taste exactly as they do at home.

请胡先生尝尝看。
Do try them.”

““原来你是徽州人，
“So you are from Huizhou?

口音倒听不出。”
I could not tell from your accent.”

“我原籍徽州。”
“My family comes from there.

朱福年说，“在外多年，口音变过了。”
After so many years away, my accent has changed.”

“既是徽州，对典当自然熟悉？”
“Then you must know the pawnshop business?”

“怎么不熟悉？
“Of course.

我也劝过二少爷开典当。
I have urged Second Master to open a pawnshop.

他说，穷人的钱不忍心赚。怎么也不肯。”
He says he cannot bear to make money from the poor and refuses.”

“开典当是为了方便穷人，
“Pawnshops provide a service to the poor.

穷人出点利息，也是心甘情愿的。”
They pay a little interest willingly.”

“我也是这样说，二少爷听不进去，也是枉然。”
“That is what I told him, but it is useless if he will not listen.”

就这样一路谈着典当，不知不觉地走到了福源楼。
Talking of pawnshops, they reached Fuyuanlou almost without noticing.

坐定下来，胡雪岩先写张条子，交柜上派人送到裕记丝栈去请古应春，
Once seated, Hu wrote a note and asked the restaurant to send someone with it to Yuji Silk Warehouse to invite Gu.

然后点了菜，趁这等客等菜的工夫，他跟朱福年谈到了帐务。
He ordered the dishes, then, while waiting for their guest and the food, returned to the accounts.


“福年兄，刚才我看的那笔五万银子的帐，恐怕有点错了。”
“Brother Funian, there may be a slight error in that fifty-thousand-tael transaction I looked at.”

“喔。”
“Oh?”

因为胡雪岩语气缓和，所以朱福年也能沉得住气，平静地问道：
Hu's mild tone allowed Zhu to remain composed.

“我倒还不清楚。
“I am not quite sure.

日子久了，不大记得起来。”
It was some time ago; I cannot remember it clearly.”

“帐上有送存同兴的一笔帐，存折上没有。”
“The account book records a deposit at Tongxing, but the passbook does not.”

“是说恒记这个折子？”
“You mean the Hengji passbook?

朱福年答道，“恒记在同兴有三个折子。”
Hengji has three passbooks at Tongxing.”

“我知道。”
“I know.

胡雪岩接着便问，“福记是你老兄的户头吧？”
Fuji is your own account, is it not?”

这就是所谓作贼心虚了，
A guilty conscience betrayed Zhu at once.

朱福年脸上的颜色，立刻就不大自然，勉强答说，“是的。”
His expression changed, and he forced out a “Yes.”

“我做钱庄也多年了，这种情形，倒还少见。”
“I have been in banking for years, but have seldom seen this arrangement.”

“各处地方不一样。”
“Customs differ from place to place.

朱福年说，“为了调度方便，二少爷叫我也立一个户头。”
Second Master told me to open an account too, for convenience in managing funds.”

“喔，”胡雪岩抓住他“调度方便”这四个字追问：
Hu seized on those words.

“是不是说，有时候要向外头调动头寸，恒记不便出面，用你福记的名义？”
“Do you mean that when funds must be raised outside and Hengji cannot conveniently appear in the transaction, you use the name of Fuji?”

这话，朱福年就答不出来了，
Zhu could not answer.

因为庞二财大势雄，从不向外面调动头雨，
Pang was immensely wealthy and influential and never needed to raise funds outside.

如果应声“是”，胡雪岩跟庞二一谈，西洋镜马上拆穿，金饭碗也就要不翼而飞了。
If he said yes and Hu mentioned it to Pang, the deception would be exposed at once, and his golden rice bowl would vanish.

因此，他只能含含糊糊地答说：“不是这意思。”
He could only answer vaguely, “That is not what I mean.”

“那么是什么意思呢？”胡雪岩若无其事地问，声音中不带丝毫诘质的意味。
“What do you mean, then?” Hu asked casually, without the slightest interrogatory edge.

而朱福年却已急得满头大汗，结结巴巴地不知道说些什么。
Zhu, however, was sweating with anxiety and could only stammer incoherently.


“那也不必说它了！”
“Let us leave that aside.”

胡雪岩不再侧面相逼，正面指出他的错，
Abandoning indirect pressure, Hu pointed out his fault plainly.

“那五万银子，细看前后帐，分毫不少……”
“Looking carefully at the accounts before and after that fifty thousand, not a fraction is missing.”

“是啊！”
“Exactly!”

朱福年急忙抢着辩白，
Zhu hastened to defend himself.

“帐是决不会错的。”
“The figures cannot be wrong.”

“错不错，要看怎么个看法，什么人来看？”胡雪岩答得极快，
“Whether they are wrong depends on how—and by whom—they are examined,” Hu answered at once.

“我看是不错，因为以前的帐目，跟我到底没有啥关系，
“To my eyes they are correct, since the earlier accounts have nothing to do with me.

叫你们二少爷来看，就错了。
To Second Master's eyes, they would be wrong.

你说是不是呢？”
Don't you agree?”

最后这一问，使得朱福年又大受其窘，只得先虚晃一枪：
Again cornered by the final question, Zhu tried an evasion.

“我倒还不明白胡先生你的话？”
“I still do not quite understand you.”

“再明白都没有，
“It could not be clearer.

五万银子说存恒记，结果存入福记，
Fifty thousand was said to have been deposited under Hengji, but went into Fuji.

福记再分四次归还。
Fuji then repaid it in four instalments.

前后数目不错，起码拆息上，恒记吃亏了。
The totals agree, but at the very least Hengji lost the interest.

不过，这在我看，是小事，
Still, I regard it as a small matter.

你倒拿我前后的话，仔细想一想！”
Think carefully about everything I have said.”

他以前说过什么话？
What had he said?

朱福年茫然不辨，
Zhu was confused.

定定心细想，才意会到他有句话，大有深意。这句话就是：“我看是不错，因为以前的帐目，跟我到底没有啥关系！”
Collecting himself, he finally grasped the significance of one sentence: “To my eyes they are correct, since the earlier accounts have nothing to do with me.”

这就是暗示，以前的帐目他不会顶真，
Hu was indicating that he would not insist on pursuing the old accounts.

但以后他是恒记的股东，
From now on, however, he would be a partner in Hengji.

帐目便不能说无关，当然也就要认真了。
Its accounts would concern him, and he would examine them seriously.

意会到此，朱福年才知道自己不是“猪八戒”，倒是“孙悟空”，跳不出胡雪岩这尊“如来佛”的手掌心，
Zhu realized that he was not Pigsy after all, but Sun Wukong, unable to escape from Hu Xueyan’s palm, as though Hu were the Buddha himself.

乖乖儿认输，表示服帖，是上上大吉。
His best course was to admit defeat and submit.


“胡先生，我在恒记年数久了，手续上难免有疏忽的地方，
“Mr Hu, I have been at Hengji for many years, and there may have been oversights in procedure.

一切要请胡先生包涵指教。
I ask your understanding and guidance.

将来怎么个做法，请胡先生吩咐，我无不遵办。”
Tell me how to proceed in future, and I shall follow every instruction.”

这是递了“降表”。
This was his declaration of surrender.

到此地步，胡雪岩无需用旁敲侧击的办法，更用不着假客气，
Hu no longer needed hints or false politeness.

直接提出他的意见：
He stated his wishes directly.

“福年兄，受人之托，忠人之事，
“Brother Funian, when entrusted with a man's affairs, one must serve him faithfully.

你们二少爷既然请我来看看帐，我当然对他要有个交代。
Since Second Master has asked me to examine the accounts, I must give him an explanation.

你是抓总的，我只要跟你谈就是了，
You are in overall charge, so I need speak only to you.

下面各人的帐目，你自己去查，
Examine the accounts of those beneath you yourself.

用不着我插手。”
I need not interfere.”

“是。”
“Yes.

朱福年说，“我从明天就清查各处的帐目，日夜赶办，
I shall begin checking every department tomorrow and work day and night.

有半个月的工夫，一定可以盘清楚。”
Within half a month, I shall have everything reconciled.”

“好的。
“Good.

你经手的总帐，我暂时也不看，
For the moment, I shall leave the general ledger in your hands unexamined too.

等半个月以后再说。”
We can discuss it in half a month.”

“是！”
“Yes.”

“这半个月之中，你也不妨自己检点一下，
“Meanwhile, review your own work.

如果还有疏忽的地方，想法子自己弥补。
If there are any further oversights, find a way to put them right yourself.

我将来也不过看几笔帐，”
Later, I shall look at only a few transactions.”

接着，胡雪岩清清楚楚他说了几个日子，这是从同兴送来的福记收支清单中挑出来的，
He then named several dates clearly and precisely, chosen from the statement of Fuji's receipts and payments supplied by Tongxing.

都是有疑问的日子。
Every one was questionable.

朱福年暗暗心惊，
Zhu was secretly alarmed.

自己的毛病自己知道，却不明白胡雪岩何以了如指掌，
He knew his own irregularities, but could not understand how Hu knew them so thoroughly.

莫非他在恒记中已经埋伏了眼线？
Had he already planted informants at Hengji?

照此看来，此人高深莫测，
The man was unfathomable.

真要步步小心才是。
He must be careful at every step.


他的疑惧都流露在脸上，胡雪岩使索性开诚布公地说：
His fear and suspicion showed on his face, so Hu decided to speak openly.

“福年兄，你我相交的日子还浅，
“Brother Funian, we have known each other only a short time.

恐怕你还不大晓得我的为人。
Perhaps you do not yet understand my character.

我一向的宗旨是：有饭大家吃，不但吃得饱，还要吃得好。
My principle has always been that everyone should eat—not merely enough, but well.

所以，我决不肯敲碎人家的饭碗。
I would never willingly smash another man's rice bowl.

不过做生意跟打仗一样，总要同心协力，人人肯拼命，才会成功。
Yet business is like war: success requires everyone to work together and give all their strength.

过去的都不必说了，
Let us say no more about the past.

以后看你自己，
The future depends on you.

你只要肯尽心尽力，不管心血花在明处还是暗处？说句我自负的话，我一定看得到，
If you serve wholeheartedly, whether your efforts are visible or hidden, I venture to say that I shall see them.

也一定不会抹煞你的功劳，在你们二少爷面前会帮你说话。
I shall never deny you the credit, and I shall speak for you before Second Master.

或者，你倒看得起我，将来愿意跟我一道来打天下，只要你们二少爷肯放你，我欢迎之至。
Or, if you think well enough of me to wish to build a business at my side one day, I shall welcome you warmly, provided Second Master is willing to release you.”

““胡先生，胡先生！”
“Mr Hu!”

朱福年激动不已，
Zhu was deeply moved.

“你说到这样的金玉良言，我朱某人再不肯尽心尽力，就不是人了。
“After such precious words, I should scarcely deserve to be called a man if I failed to give my best.

胡先生，我敬一杯，表表我的心。”
Let me drink to show my feelings.”

说罢，满斟一杯，仰脸饮尽。
He filled a cup and drained it.

胡雪岩当然高兴，陪了一满杯，然后笑道：
Hu gladly drank a full cup with him, then smiled.

“福年兄，从此我们是一家人了，
“Brother Funian, from now on we belong to one family.

有啥说啥，
Speak freely.

不要见外。”
There is no need for ceremony.”


“是的。”
“Yes.”

朱福年想一想说，
Zhu considered.

“胡先生，以后恒记的跟同兴的往来，只用两个户头，公款用恒记，二少爷私人收支用继嘉堂。
“Mr Hu, in future our dealings with Tongxing should use only two accounts: Hengji for the firm's money, Jijia Hall for Second Master's personal receipts and payments.

我在同兴的户头，决定结了它。”
I have decided to close my own account there.”

“结了它也不必。”胡雪岩说，
“There is no need,” Hu replied.

“不必让外头人猜测，以为我们内部生了啥意见。”
“We need not set outsiders wondering whether there has been a disagreement within the firm.”

这更见得胡雪岩的体恤，顾到自己的面子，当然乐受这番好意，
This showed still greater consideration for Zhu's dignity, and he gladly accepted it.

“是！”他很恭敬地回答：“我懂胡先生的意思，
“Yes, I understand,” he answered respectfully.

找机会，我要告诉下面的‘朋友’们，恒记是一家，
“I shall find an opportunity to tell the men under me that Hengji is one family.

总要让外头人看得我们上下一心，不敢来动我们的歪脑筋才好。”
Outsiders must see that we are united from top to bottom, so that they dare not plot against us.”

“就是这话！
“Exactly.

‘打落牙齿往肚里咽’，方算好汉。”
A man must be able to swallow his broken teeth without a word.”


说到这里，只见古应春步履安详地踏了进来，
At this point Gu entered with an unhurried step.

朱福年起身让坐。极其殷勤。
Zhu rose and offered him a seat with great attentiveness.

在右应春的心目中，此人自视甚高，
Gu had always thought Zhu full of self-importance.

加以东家“弹硬”，所以平日总在无意间流露出“架子大”“的味道，
Backed by a powerful employer, he habitually revealed an overbearing air.

此刻一反常态，不用说，是对胡雪岩服帖了，才有这番连带尊敬的表示。
His changed manner could only mean that he had submitted to Hu and was extending the respect to Hu's friend.

意会到此，他的神情越发从容，
Understanding this, Gu grew still more composed.

说着闲话，不提正事。
He chatted without mentioning business.

倒是朱福年忍不住了，
Zhu finally could bear it no longer.

“胡先生，应春兄来了，我们拿丝上的事说个定规。”
“Mr Hu, now Brother Yingchun is here, let us settle what to do about the silk.”

他略停了一下又说：“ 照我看，‘只拉弓，不放箭’也就够了。”
After a pause he added, “In my opinion, drawing the bow without loosing the arrow will be enough.”

胡、古二人，目视而笑。
Hu and Gu exchanged a smile.

然后是胡雪岩回答他的话，反问一句：“我们在‘打弓’，吉伯特晓不晓得？”
“We are drawing the bow,” Hu replied, “but does Gilbert know it?”

“我想他是晓得的。
“I think so.

我们真的‘放箭’他也会着急。”
If we really loose the arrow, he will be anxious.”

“当然罗！”古应春接口，极有信心地说：
“Of course!” Gu said confidently.

“他万里迢迢跑了来为啥？
“Why did he travel all these thousands of miles?

不是为了生意？
For business.

生意做不成，他的盘缠开销哪里来？
If no business is done, where will the money for his expenses come from?”

““话虽如此，事情有点弄僵！”
“True, but things have become rather strained.”

胡雪岩问古应春：
Hu turned to Gu.

“你肯不肯向他去低头？”
“Are you willing to bow to him?”

“我不去了！
“I shall not go again.

洋人是‘蜡烛脾气’，越迁就他，他越摆架子。”
Foreigners have a candle's temper: the more you indulge them, the more airs they put on.”

“为来为去，只为了我是当事人。
“The difficulty is simply that I am a party to the transaction.

如果这票货色不是我的，替双方拉场，话就好说了。而且双方也都一定感激此人。”
If the silk were not mine, it would be easy to mediate—and both sides would surely be grateful to whoever did.”


“这个人很难。”
“Such a man would be hard to find.”

古应春会意，故意不去看朱福年，尽自摇头：
Understanding Hu's meaning, Gu deliberately avoided looking at Zhu and kept shaking his head.

“不容易找！”
“Very hard.”

他们这样一拉一唱。 暗中拉住了朱福年，
Between them they drew Zhu in.

他终于忍不住：
At last he could not resist.

“胡先生！你看，我跟吉伯特去谈一谈，是不是有用？”
“Mr Hu, do you think it would help if I spoke to Gilbert?”

“噢！”
“Ah!”

胡雪岩一拍前额，做出茅塞顿开的姿态，
Hu slapped his forehead as though suddenly enlightened.

“有你老兄出面，再好都没有了。
“Nothing could be better than having you act for us.

有用，有用，一定有用。”
It would help enormously.”

受了鼓励的朱福年，越发兴致勃勃，自告奋勇：
Encouraged, Zhu grew more eager.

“吃完饭，我就去看他。
“I shall see him after lunch.

我要吓他一吓，他不照原议买我们的这票货色，劝他趁早回国，
I shall give him a fright: if he will not buy our silk on the original terms, he had better go home.

他在这里永远买不到我们的丝！
He will never buy our silk here.”

““对。
“Yes.

就这么说。
Say that.

这倒也不完全是吓他，
Nor would it be entirely an empty threat.

反正这票生意做不到，我们就斗气不斗财了！”
If this transaction falls through, we shall fight for our pride instead of our profit.”

朱福年倒真是赤胆忠心，即时就要去办事。
Zhu was now wholly devoted to the cause and wanted to leave immediately.

胡雪岩当然要留住他，劝他从容些，把话想停当了再说。
Hu naturally detained him, urging him to take his time and prepare what to say.

接着便设想吉伯特可能会有反响，他这么说便那么回答，那么说便这么回答，一一商量妥帖，
They considered Gilbert's possible responses, deciding how to answer each one.

还要先约个时间，
They should also arrange an appointment first.

从容不迫地谈，才能收效。
Only a calm, unhurried discussion would achieve the desired result.



胡雪岩
《平步青云（下）》第三十一章（下）及编后小语
A Swift Rise to Prominence, Volume III — Chapter Thirty-One, Part Two, and Editorial Afterword
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


正事谈毕，酒兴未已，
Their business was settled, but they were still in the mood for drinking.

胡雪岩一直对典当有兴趣，此时正好讨教，
Hu had always been interested in pawnshops, and this was a good opportunity to learn.

“福年兄，”他先问：“你是不是典当出身？”
“Brother Funian,” he began, “did you start out in the pawnbroking trade?”

“不是。不过我懂，
“No, but I know something about it.
