我故世的三叔是朝奉，我在他那里住过一年。”
My late third uncle was a pawnshop appraiser, and I lived with him for a year.”

接下来，朱福年便谈了典当中的许多行规和弊端，娓娓道来，闻所未闻。
Zhu went on to describe many of the trade’s rules and abuses, speaking so engagingly that Hu heard one thing after another entirely new to him.

最后似感叹，又似遗憾地说，“当初未曾入典当，
At last, with something between a sigh and an expression of regret, he said, “I never entered the trade.

自己都不知道是得计，还是失策？
Even now I cannot tell whether that was a wise decision or a mistake.

因为‘吃典当饭’与众不同，
Earning your living in a pawnshop is unlike any other occupation.

是三百六十行生意中，最舒服的一行，住得好、吃得好，入息优厚，工作轻松，
Of all the three hundred and sixty trades, it is the most comfortable: good accommodation, good food, generous pay, and light work.

因此吃过这碗饭，别的饭就难吃了！”
Once you have eaten from that bowl, it is hard to stomach any other.”

“照你这样说，如果开爿典当，要寻好手还不容易。”
“From what you say, finding good staff to open a pawnshop cannot be easy.

胡雪岩问，“典业中的好手，宾主相得，一动不如一静，
An able man who gets on well with his employer is better off staying where he is.

轻易不肯他就。
He will not readily take another position.

是这样吗？”
Is that right?”

“大致是这样子。
“Broadly speaking, yes.

不过人材是不断在冒出来的，
But new talent keeps emerging.

本典无可位置，另求发展，也是有的。”
Sometimes there is no room for advancement in a man’s own shop, and he seeks an opportunity elsewhere.”

“那么，我倒要请你留意，
“Then keep an eye out for me.

有这样的人，我想见见。”
I should like to meet someone of that sort.”

这表示胡雪岩也有创办典当的打算，
Clearly Hu was considering opening a pawnshop himself.

朱福年欣然应诺，而且跃跃欲试地，颇有以半内行作内行，下手一试，以补少年未曾入此业之憾的意思。
Zhu readily agreed and seemed eager to try his hand, treating his partial knowledge as full expertise and making up for the opportunity he had missed in his youth.


* * *朱福年是在第二天跟吉伯特见面的，那是陈顺生来探问运货舱位消息的时候，也正是由东印度公司转来伦敦总公司发出的何以今年的丝，至今未曾起运的质问之时，
Zhu met Gilbert the next day, just as Chen Shunsheng was enquiring about the shipping space and a demand had arrived from the London head office, forwarded by the East India Company, asking why this year’s silk had still not been shipped.

所以，吉伯特一见他的面，便先追问恒记和裕记两处的货色，可曾运离上海？
The moment Gilbert saw him, he asked whether Hengji’s and Yuji’s consignments had left Shanghai.

“明天就要开船了。”朱福年用英语答说，
“The boats sail tomorrow,” Zhu replied in English.

“吉伯特先生，我觉得我对你有种道义上的责任，
“Mr Gilbert, I feel a moral obligation towards you.

必须为你争取最后一个机会。
I must try to secure one last opportunity for you.

最近商场上有一个大消息，
There has been important news in the business world lately.

不知道你听说了没有？”
Have you heard it?”

“我不知道你指的是什么？”
“I do not know what you mean.”

“恒记的东家，也就是我的雇主庞先生，跟胡雪岩在事业上达成了合作的协议，
“Hengji’s proprietor, my employer Mr Pang, has entered into a business partnership with Hu Xueyan.

胡雪岩的实力并不充足，但他是商场上一个非常特殊的人物，
Hu’s resources were insufficient, but he is a most unusual figure in business.

主要的是他在各方面都有极好的关系，而且他的手腕十分灵活。
Above all, he has excellent connections in every quarter and is exceptionally resourceful.

这两项就是他最大的资本，
Those are his greatest assets.

他所缺少的是现金，而这个缺点，由于跟庞先生的合作而充分弥补了。
What he lacked was cash, and his partnership with Mr Pang has fully remedied that deficiency.

因此，我可以这样说：胡雪岩是无敌的，
I can therefore say this: Hu Xueyan is invincible.

没有任何人能够在商场上击败他，包括你吉伯特先生在内。”
No one can defeat him in business, including you, Mr Gilbert.”

“我不需要击败他，
“I have no need to defeat him.

我只为我的公司的利益打算。
I am concerned only with my company’s interests.

最初是我采纳了你的建议，
It was your advice I followed in the first place.

否则，也不至于有今天的僵局。”
Otherwise we should never have reached this impasse.”

“吉伯特先生！” 朱福年放下脸来问：“你是不是要讨论这件事的责任？”
Zhu’s face hardened. “Mr Gilbert, do you wish to discuss who is responsible?”

“不！”
“No.”

吉伯特摇摇头，
Gilbert shook his head.

“那是没有用的。
“That would serve no purpose.

我又不能向你要求赔偿，哪里来的责任可言？
I cannot demand compensation from you, so what is the point of talking about responsibility?

你觉得对我有种道义上的责任，足见得你对我还存着友谊，
Your feeling of moral obligation shows that you still have some friendship for me.

我希望我们仍旧是朋友。”
I hope we remain friends.”


听他这一番话，朱福年报之以诚恳的神色，
Zhu responded with a look of sincerity.

“就因为如此，我要尽我的友谊。”
“That is precisely why I want to do what friendship requires.”

他停了一下，用平静但很坚定的声音说：
He paused, then continued in a calm but firm voice.

“吉伯特先生，你并没有失败，
“Mr Gilbert, you have not been defeated.

一切都可以照你原来的计划实现。
Everything can still go according to your original plan.

但你如果错过此这个最后的机会，那么，你的失败不止于这一次，是明年及以后的日子。
But if you miss this final opportunity, your failure will extend beyond this one occasion, into next year and the years that follow.

用最简单的话说：你将不能在上海买到你所需要的丝。”
To put it simply, you will be unable to buy the silk you need in Shanghai.”

“照你看，丝价是不是能够减少若干？”吉伯特说，
“Do you think the price could be reduced at all?” Gilbert asked.

“如果你办得到，我们当然会付你应得的佣金。
“If you can arrange that, we shall of course pay you the commission you deserve.”

““不！”
“No!”

朱福年斩钉截铁地说，
Zhu was emphatic.

“决无可能！
“It is absolutely impossible.

你应该知道，胡雪岩做生意的精明，是无人可及的，
You should know that Hu Xueyan’s shrewdness in business is unequalled.

现在他不向你提出延期损失的赔偿，已经是很宽大了。”
He is already being very generous in not claiming compensation for the losses caused by the delay.”

“好！”
“Very well.”

吉伯特终于低头了，
Gilbert finally yielded.

“我一切照办，
“I agree to everything.

只希望赶快订约。”
I ask only that we sign the contract quickly.”


订了约，收银交货，胡雪岩如释重负。
Once the contract was signed, payment collected, and the silk delivered, Hu felt a great weight lift from him.

但经过一整夜的计算，却又爽然若失，自己都不知道为谁辛苦为谁忙。
Yet after a whole night’s calculations he was left strangely empty, scarcely knowing for whom he had worked and worried so hard.

赚是赚了十八万银子，然而，不过说来好听，甚至于连帐面上的“虚好看”都没有。
The profit was indeed a hundred and eighty thousand taels, but it only sounded impressive: not even a handsome figure on paper survived.

因为合伙的关系太多，开支也太大。
There were too many partners and too many expenses.

跟尤五、古应春分了红利以外，还要跟郁四再分，
The profits had to be shared with You Laowu and Gu Yingchun, and then with Yu Si.

付了各处的利息，还要为王有龄弥补海运局的亏空，加上裘丰言和嵇鹤龄那里都要点缀。
Interest had to be paid in various quarters; Wang Youling’s deficit at the Sea Transport Bureau had to be made good; Qiu Fengyan and Ji Heling also had to receive their tokens of appreciation.

这一下已经所余无几，
That left very little.

却还有开销杭州、湖州、同里三个“门口”所拉下来的“宕帐”，
There were still the outstanding bills from his three households in Hangzhou, Huzhou, and Tongli.

细看一算，除了阜康钱庄的本钱，依旧是一整笔债务以外，还有万把银子的亏空。
A close reckoning showed that, apart from the capital of Fukang Bank, which remained entirely a debt, he was another ten thousand taels or so short.

万把银子在他当然不必发愁，
Ten thousand taels in itself did not worry him.

要愁的是这样子费心费力，到头来还闹了一笔亏空，
What troubled him was that so much thought and effort should end in a deficit.

则所谓“创业”也者，岂非缘木求鱼？
If that was how he meant to build a business, was he not climbing a tree to catch fish?

照道理不应该如此！
It ought not to have worked out this way.

落到这样的地步，总有个道理在内，当然是自己的做法有了毛病。
There must be a reason, some fault in his own methods.

这个毛病不找出来，令人寝食难安。
Until he found it, he could neither eat nor sleep in peace.

为此，他虽然一整夜未睡，脑子里昏昏沉沉地，但精神有种异样的亢奋，怎么样也不想上床。
Although he had been awake all night and his head was heavy, a peculiar nervous excitement kept him from wanting to go to bed.


到了快中午时，古应春和刘不才相偕来访，
Towards noon, Gu Yingchun and Liu Bucai came together.

一见了面，古应春失声说道：“小爷叔，你的气色好难看！
The moment Gu saw him, he exclaimed, “Little Uncle, you look dreadful!

是不是病了？”
Are you ill?”

刘不才开过药店，对于伤风发烧之类的毛病，也能诊察，
Liu had once run a pharmacy and could diagnose such ordinary ailments as colds and fevers.

当时伸手一探他的额头，又叫他伸舌头出来看了舌苔，很准确地作了判断：
He felt Hu’s forehead, asked him to put out his tongue, examined its coating, and gave a very accurate diagnosis.

“睡得太少，用心过度，
“Too little sleep and too much mental exertion.

是虚火上升。
Deficiency heat is rising.

好好吃一顿，舒舒服服睡一觉，精神马上就好了。”
Eat a good meal and have a comfortable sleep, and you will feel yourself again.”

“一点不错。”
“Exactly.”

胡雪岩有意将他遣开：
Hu deliberately found a reason to send him away.

“请你替我去约一约庞二，晚上在哪里叙一叙。
“Please arrange for me to meet Pang somewhere this evening.

回头四、五点钟，你到浴德池来找我。”
Come and find me at Yudechi Bathhouse at four or five.”

等刘不才一走，胡雪岩将预先一张张计算好的单子，取了出来，捡出古应春的一张交了给他，
Once Liu had left, Hu brought out the individual statements he had calculated beforehand and handed Gu his.

照胡雪岩的算法，古应春应该分一万五千多银子的盈余。
According to Hu’s reckoning, Gu was entitled to a profit of more than fifteen thousand taels.

“小爷叔！”古应春略看了一看，将单子推了回去，“第一，你分得我多了，
Gu glanced through it and pushed it back. “Little Uncle, first, you have allotted me too much.

第二，现在不要分，
Second, let us make no distribution now.

我们仍旧在一起做，
We shall go on working together.

商量商量以后怎么个做法，才是正经。”
What matters is to discuss how we should proceed.”

胡雪岩脱口答道：“我正就是不晓得以后怎么个做法？”接着便皱起了眉不断摇头。
“That is precisely what I do not know!” Hu blurted out, frowning and shaking his head repeatedly.

这态度很奇怪，古应春大为惊疑，
His strange manner startled Gu.

“小爷叔！”他很吃力地说，“你好象有啥难言之隐似地。
With some difficulty, he said, “Little Uncle, you seem to have some trouble you find hard to speak about.

大家自己人，
We are all friends.

你尽吩咐，
Tell me what you need.

有啥‘摆不平’，我的一份不必计算在内。”
If there is anything you cannot settle, leave my share out of the reckoning.”


“应春兄！”胡雪岩相当感动，率直答道：“我一无所得，就是朋友的情分义气，千金不换。”
Deeply moved, Hu answered frankly, “Brother Yingchun, I have gained nothing—except the loyalty and affection of friends, which a fortune could never buy.”

“岂止于千金不换？
“Worth more than any fortune!

小爷叔，你不要说一无所得，
But do not say you have gained nothing, Little Uncle.

在我看，所得正多。
To my mind you have gained a great deal.

不说别的，只说朱福年好了，
Take Zhu Funian alone.

庞二虽有些大少爷的脾气，有时讲话不给人留情面，到底御下宽厚，非别的东家好比，
Pang has something of a pampered young gentleman’s temper and sometimes speaks without sparing anyone’s feelings, but he is generous to his staff in a way few employers are.

可是朱福年还是有二心，
Yet Zhu still harboured disloyal intentions.

只有遇到小爷叔你，化敌为友，服服帖帖，
Only when he encountered you did an enemy become a friend and submit completely.

这就是你的大本事，也就是你的大本钱。
That is your great ability and your great capital.”

“由于说得中肯，不是一般泛泛的恭维可比，
These observations went to the heart of the matter; they were far more than empty compliments.

所以胡雪岩听了这几句话，深受鼓舞，
Hu was greatly encouraged.

“老古，”他便索性问道：“你直言谈相，
“Old Gu,” he asked outright, “speak frankly.

看我做生意有啥毛病要改？”
What faults do you see in the way I do business? What should I change?”


“毛病是谈不到。
“I would not call them faults.

不过，小爷叔，中国人有句话，叫做‘业精于勤，荒于嬉’，
But there is a Chinese saying: ‘A calling is mastered through diligence and ruined by play.’

这个‘勤’字照我讲，应该当做敬业的敬，
I take ‘diligence’ to mean respect for one’s calling.

反过来‘嬉’字不作懒惰解释，要当作浮而不实的不敬来讲。
And ‘play’, in turn, means not laziness but a shallow lack of seriousness.

敬则专，专心一志，自然精益求精。
Respect brings concentration; single-minded concentration brings continual improvement.

小爷叔，如果说你有失策之处，我直言谈相，就是不专心。
Little Uncle, if you have made a mistake, I must tell you plainly that it is a lack of concentration.

“古应春又说，”人的精力到底有限，你经手的事情到底太多了，
A man’s energy is limited, after all, and you have far too many affairs in hand.

眼前来看，好象面面俱到，未出纰漏，
For the moment, everything seems to be attended to and nothing has gone wrong.

其实是不是漏了许多好机会，谁也不得而知。
Yet who can say how many good opportunities you may have missed?”

“他一路说，胡雪岩一路点头，
Hu nodded throughout.

等他说完，随即答道：“有好几位都这样劝过我，不过没有你说得透彻。
When Gu had finished, he immediately replied, “Several people have advised me along these lines, but none has explained it as clearly as you.

我刚才在想，忙了半天，两手空空，
Just now I was thinking that after all this effort I was left empty-handed.

总有个毛病在那里，
There must be something wrong.

你说我不专心，
You say I lack concentration.

这就是我的毛病。
That is my fault.

不过，也不能说两手空空……”
Still, I cannot really say I am empty-handed…”

他没有再说下去，说下去怕古应春多心，
He stopped, afraid that saying more might make Gu uneasy.

他本人两手空空，还亏下了帐，但相交合作的朋友，都有好处。
He himself had nothing to show for his work and was even in debt, but all the friends who had worked with him had benefited.

这盘帐要扯过来算，还是有成就的。
Viewed from that side of the ledger, he had achieved something after all.


这样转念，更觉精神一振，
The thought revived him further.

“走，走，”
“Come, come!”

他站起身来说：
He rose.

“照刘三爷的话，好好吃它一顿，睡它一觉。
“We shall follow Third Master Liu’s advice: a good meal and a good sleep.

有没有什么好番菜？
Is there any good Western food to be had?

吃完了到浴德池去泡它一下午。”
Afterwards we can spend the afternoon soaking at Yudechi.”

“好番菜是有，只怕你吃不来。”
“There is, but I am afraid you might not like it.”

“怎么吃不来？”
“Why should I not?”

“夏天讲究吃‘色白大菜’，生冷清淡，半生不熟，
“In summer the fashionable thing is a se-bai Western dinner: cold, lightly flavoured food, raw or only half cooked.

吃不惯的会倒胃口。”
It can turn your stomach if you are not used to it.”

“那就算了。
“Then forget it.

还是……”
We had better…”

“还是到我这里去吃饭吧！
“We had better eat at my place.

七姐现在返璞归真了，
Seventh Sister has returned to simpler ways.

到处跟人学做菜，
She is learning to cook from everyone she meets.

今天在做粉蒸鸡，还有你们西湖上的莼菜……”
Today she is making chicken steamed with rice meal, and there is water shield from your own West Lake…”

“你不要再说了。”
“Say no more!”

胡雪岩咽了口唾沫答道，
Hu swallowed.

“再说下去，我真要流口水了。”
“If you go on, I shall start drooling.”

于是一起到古应春那里。
They went together to Gu’s house.

七姑奶奶果然卷起衣袖，在厨房里大忙特忙，
Sure enough, the Seventh Lady had rolled up her sleeves and was busy in the kitchen.

汗水蒸润，她那张银盆似的脸，和两条藕也似的手臂，格外显得红白分明，
The heat had brought a sheen of perspiration to her round, silver-basin face and her lotus-root arms, making their pink and white all the more vivid.

看见胡雪岩在厨房门口探头一望，赶紧喊道，“厨房里象火焰山一样，
Seeing Hu peer through the kitchen doorway, she called at once, “It is like the Flaming Mountain in here!

小爷叔，快不要进来！”
Do not come in, Little Uncle!”

“我饿了！”胡雪岩老实答说，
“I am hungry,” he replied honestly.

“有啥吃的，先弄点来喂喂我。”
“Whatever you have, give me something to eat first.”

“我先下碗米粉干，让你点点饥。
“I shall cook a bowl of rice noodles to take the edge off your hunger.

回头慢慢吃酒。”
Then we can have a leisurely drink.”

等一碗鸡汤火腿笋干米粉下肚，接着便摆桌子喝酒，
He finished a bowl of rice noodles in chicken broth with ham and dried bamboo shoots, and the table was set for wine.

恰好尤五也到了，胡雪岩越有兴致。
You Laowu happened to arrive as well, putting Hu in still better spirits.


席间当然要问他今后的打算，胡雪岩却反问尤五和古应春，要怎么样打算，才能于大家有益？
Naturally they asked about his plans, but he put the question back to You and Gu: what course would benefit everyone?

“这话就是很难说了。”尤五答说，
“That is difficult to say,” You replied.

“照我的心思，最好你别人的闲事都不管。”
“If I had my way, you would leave everyone else’s affairs alone.”

“五哥也是！”
“Just listen to Brother Five!”

七姑奶奶性子直，马上就补了一句他未曾说出来的话：
The Seventh Lady was direct by nature and at once supplied the words he had left unsaid.

“别人的闲事不要管，只管你的事。
“Leave everyone else’s affairs alone and attend only to yours.

是不是？”大家都笑了。
Is that it?” Everyone laughed.

“这当然是一厢情愿。不过，”尤五正色说道，“我们漕帮方面，生路越来越狭，
“Of course that is only wishful thinking on my part,” You said. Then he grew serious. “But the ways of earning a living are narrowing for our grain-transport brotherhoods.

小爷叔，你答应过的，
You promised, Little Uncle.

总要替我们想个办法。”
You must find a way for us.”

“当然，当然。
“Certainly, certainly.

我一定当我自己的事来办。”
I shall treat it as my own business.”

胡雪岩又问古应春：
Hu turned to Gu.

“你看呢，我以后该怎么做法？”
“And what do you think I should do?”

“我刚才就说过了。”
“I told you just now.”

胡雪岩点点头，重新回想他上午所作的那番劝告。
Hu nodded, recalling the advice Gu had given him that morning.

那些话，尤五和七姑奶奶并不知道，
You and the Seventh Lady had not heard it.

尤其是七姑奶奶性子急，便追问首，胡雪岩将古应春劝他专心的话，说了给她听，并且盛赞古应春看得深，识得透。
Impatient as ever, she pressed him for an explanation, and he repeated Gu’s counsel about concentrating his efforts, warmly praising its insight and clarity.


“谢谢一家门！”
“Thanks to him and his entire family!”

七姑奶奶撇着嘴说，
The Seventh Lady curled her lip.

“小爷叔，他是狗头军师，
“Little Uncle, he is a bungling strategist.

你不要听他的话。”
Do not listen to him.”

古应春不服气，但也不敢跟她争辩，
Gu disagreed but dared not argue with her.

只说：“小爷叔，‘妇人之言，慎不可听’。”
He merely said, “Little Uncle, ‘Take care never to heed a woman’s words.’”

“啥叫‘妇人之言’？”七姑奶奶的反应快得很，
“What do you mean, ‘a woman’s words’?” she retorted instantly.

“场面总是越大越好。
“Surely the larger your sphere of activity, the better.

照你的说法，有皇帝做也不要做了，因为管的事太多太杂？
By your reasoning, a man should refuse to be emperor because he would have too many different affairs to manage!”

“一句话驳得古应春哑口无言，
That left Gu without an answer.

摇摇头轻轻说了句：“歪理十八条。”
He shook his head and murmured, “Eighteen varieties of crooked reasoning.”

胡雪岩看他那无奈七姑奶奶之何的尴尬神态，未免好笑，
Hu was amused by Gu’s helpless embarrassment.

但一向不以他那个“宝贝妹子”为然的尤五，却帮着她说话：
You, however, who usually took a dim view of his precious younger sister, now supported her.

“阿七说的倒也不是歪理。
“What Seventh Sister says is not altogether unreasonable.

事情不怕多，要有人管，
There is no harm in having many affairs, provided there are people to manage them.

皇帝好做，难的是用不着一个好宰相。
Being emperor is easy; the difficulty is finding a good chief minister.

小爷叔，我想，考古的话也不错，阿七的比喻也有道理，
Little Uncle, I think Old Gu is right, but Seventh Sister’s comparison also makes sense.

你是聪明人，
You are a clever man.

不妨拿他们两个人的话好好想一想，作一番打算。
Think over what they have both said and work out a plan.”

““是的！”
“Yes.”

胡雪岩深深点头。
Hu nodded gravely.

于是他一面吃喝闲谈，一面在心中盘算，
As he ate, drank, and chatted, he kept turning the matter over.

等酒醉饭饱，他的盘算也大致停当了。
By the time he had enjoyed enough wine and food, his plan was largely settled.


“五哥，老古！”他说，“我们先把帐分了……”
“Brother Five, Old Gu,” he began, “first let us divide up the accounts…”

“不必分！”尤五抢着说，
“There is no need!” You interrupted.

他的意思跟古应春一样，主张就原来的资本和盈余，听候胡雪岩全权运用，能够“利上滚利”。
His view was the same as Gu’s: the original capital and the profits should remain entirely at Hu’s disposal, to earn profit upon profit.

“我懂你们的意思。”胡雪岩说，
“I understand,” Hu said.

“我要重起炉灶，做几样事业，大家分开来管，我只抓个总。
“But I want to make a fresh start, with several businesses managed separately by different people, while I take overall charge.

就好比做皇帝一样，要宰相大臣分开来办事，用不着我亲自下手。”
Like an emperor, I shall have ministers handling their own affairs without needing to do everything myself.”

“嗯，嗯！”在座的三个人，不约而同地颔首表示同意。
All three listeners nodded their agreement.

“第一样是钱庄，
“First comes banking.

这方面是我的根本，我也内行，恐怕还是要亲自下手。
That is my foundation, and I know the trade, so I shall probably still have to attend to it myself.

第二样是丝，
Second comes silk.

在湖州，我交给陈世龙，在上海，我交给老古。
In Huzhou I shall put Chen Shilong in charge; in Shanghai, Old Gu.”

““好的！”古应春说，
“Good,” Gu replied.

“我当仁不让，无需客气。
“I shall accept that responsibility without standing on ceremony.

将来茶叶、桐油也好做洋庄，
Later we can also export tea and tung oil.

慢慢儿再说。”
We can discuss those in due course.”

“将来销洋庄都归你一手担当。
“All our exports will be in your hands.

茶叶、桐油我也想过，
I have thought about tea and tung oil too.

只要你认为可以做，我无不赞成。
If you think they are worth doing, I shall support you.

不过眼前新丝就要上市了，所以要请你赶紧筹划，
But the new silk will soon be on the market, so you must begin planning at once.

专心一致，百事不管。
Concentrate entirely on that and leave everything else alone.

不过……”
Except…”

胡雪岩看一看七姑奶奶，笑笑不再说下去。
He glanced at the Seventh Lady and stopped with a smile.


这大有皮里阳秋的意味，七姑奶奶免不了要问：“小爷叔，不过什么？”
There was plainly something behind the remark, and the Seventh Lady could not help asking, “Except what, Little Uncle?”

“不过，”胡雪岩笑道，“百事不管，你们的终身大事是非管不可的。
“Except,” Hu answered, laughing, “that however much you leave everything else alone, your marriage must be attended to.

我也是这样子，
The same goes for me.

别样闲事不能再管，你的这桩大事，非效劳到底不可。
I can no longer concern myself with every other matter, but I must see this one through for you.

当着五哥在这里，我做大媒的说一句，你们挑日子、办喜事，
With Brother Five here, let me say this as your chief matchmaker: choose a day and arrange the wedding.

乾坤两宅，自己商量，不必我来传话。
The bride’s and bridegroom’s families can discuss it directly without having me carry messages between them.

古家老族长那里的归我疏通，
I shall bring the Gu family’s old clan head round.

一定不会办不通，你们放心好了。
I am certain it can be done, so set your minds at rest.”

““是的。”尤五点点头说，
“Yes,” You said, nodding.

“这件事，我就这几天要好好谈一谈。
“We must have a proper talk about it in the next few days.

现在且不去说它，
But let us leave it for now.

小爷叔你再讲你的打算。”
Go on with your plans, Little Uncle.”


“我还打算办两样事业，一样是典当，一样是药店。
“I also intend to start two other businesses: a pawnshop and a pharmacy.

药店请刘三爷来做，
I shall ask Third Master Liu to run the pharmacy.

典当，我想跟庞二谈一谈，请朱福年帮我的忙。”
As for the pawnshop, I want to speak to Pang and ask for Zhu Funian’s help.”

对他的这番打算，尤五和古应春默然不置可否，
You and Gu offered neither approval nor objection.

这意思就是不以为然，
Their silence meant that they did not agree.

在古应春觉得他不宜做此自己不懂的事业，
Gu thought Hu should not enter trades he did not understand.

而刘不才的本性，也不宜于苦干创业，
Liu Bucai’s temperament was also ill suited to the hard work of establishing a new business.

朱福年则相交未几，
As for Zhu, they had known him only a short time.

虽说“南蛮不复反矣”，但他究竟有几许本事，尚未明了，
Though they might now say of him, “The southern barbarians will never rebel again,” his actual abilities were still uncertain.

何以轻付以重任？
How could such important responsibilities be entrusted to him so readily?

尤五也略有这样的想法，此外他还有疑虑，率直问道：
You had similar thoughts and another doubt besides, which he expressed frankly.

“小爷叔，一样钱庄，一样丝，都是大本钱，
“Little Uncle, banking needs a great deal of capital, and so does silk.

你哪里还有余力开当铺、开药店？”
Where will you find the means to open a pawnshop and a pharmacy as well?”

“五哥说到要害上来了。”胡雪岩很起劲地，
“Brother Five has put his finger on the point,” Hu said eagerly.

“自然我都有打算。”
“Naturally I have made plans.”

胡雪岩的打算，是凭他的信誉、本领，因人成事。
His plan was to use his reputation and ability to enlist other people’s help.

阜康设分号，是庞二有过承诺，愿意支持的，做丝生意，仍旧是大家集股。
Pang had promised support for a Fukang branch, while the silk business would continue to be financed by pooled shares.

开典当的本钱，他看中了苏州潘叔雅那班富家公子，
For the pawnshop’s capital, he had his eye on Pan Shuya and the other wealthy young gentlemen of Suzhou.

开药店则预备在江浙官场上动脑筋。
For the pharmacy, he intended to find a way through official circles in Jiangsu and Zhejiang.


“我再说，为啥要开典当、开药店？
“Let me explain why I want a pawnshop and a pharmacy.

这两样事业，一时都无利可图，
Neither will make a profit immediately.

完全是为了公益，
I mean them entirely for the public good.

我开典当是为方便穷人。
A pawnshop will help poor people.

胡雪岩三个字，晓得的人，也不算少了，但只有做官的和做生意的晓得，
Quite a few people already know the name Hu Xueyan, but they are all officials and businessmen.

我以后要让老百姓都晓得，
In future I want ordinary people to know it too.

提起胡雪岩，说一声：这个人不错！
When they hear my name, I want them to say, ‘That is a decent man!’

事业就会越做越大。
Then my businesses will keep growing.

为此，我要开药店，这是扬名的最好办法。
That is why I want a pharmacy: it is the best way to make a name.

再说，乱世多病痛，大乱之后，必有瘟疫，
Besides, troubled times bring illness, and great upheavals are always followed by epidemics.

将来药店的生意，利人利己，
A pharmacy will benefit others and ourselves.

是一等一的好事业。
It is one of the best businesses there is.”

“听得这一说，七姑奶奶首先就钦佩不止，
The Seventh Lady was the first to express her admiration.

“你听听，”她带点教训意味地对古应春说：
“Listen to him,” she told Gu, with a touch of admonition.

“小爷叔的眼光，才真叫眼光！
“That is real foresight!

看到大乱以后了。
Little Uncle is already looking beyond the war.

你要学学小爷叔。”
You ought to learn from him.”

“本来就跟小爷叔在学。”
“I am learning from him.”

古应春转脸问道，
Gu turned to Hu.

“小爷叔，你说开药店的本钱，出在公家，
“You said the pharmacy’s capital would come from public funds.

是怎么个办法？”
How would that work?”

“ 这要靠关系了。
“Through our connections.

军营里自然要用药，
The army must have medicines.

我要跟刘三爷商量，弄两张好方子，真材实料修合起来，譬如刀伤药、诸葛行军散、辟瘟丹之类，
I shall discuss it with Third Master Liu and get a couple of good prescriptions, then prepare them properly with genuine ingredients—wound medicine, for instance, Zhuge Marching Powder, or Biwen Pills.

要一服见效，与众不同。
They must work with a single dose and stand apart from ordinary remedies.

这样子就好禀请各路粮台，先定我们多少，领下价款来做本钱。”
Then we can ask the various army supply offices to place advance orders and use their payments as capital.”

“真是！”七姑奶奶听得眉飞色舞，
The Seventh Lady was delighted. “Really!

“我看世界上，没有小爷叔没有办法的事！”
I do not believe there is anything in the world Little Uncle cannot find a way to do!”

“七姐，”胡雪岩有些惶恐，“这话捧得我太过分了。
Hu was a little alarmed. “Seventh Sister, that is far too much praise.

一个人的力量到底有限，
A single man’s strength is limited.

就算三头六臂，也办得了多少事？
Even with three heads and six arms, how much could he do?

要成大事，全靠和衷共济，
Great undertakings depend entirely on people working together.

说起来我一无所有，有的只是朋友。
You might say I have nothing except friends.

要拿朋友的事当自己的事，朋友才会拿你的事当自己的事。
Only if you treat your friends’ affairs as your own will they treat yours as theirs.

没有朋友，就是有天大的本事，也还是没有办法。”
Without friends, the greatest ability in the world will still get you nowhere.”


“小爷叔这话一针见血，”尤五紧接着他的话说，
“You have struck the nail on the head, Little Uncle,” You said at once.

“我们那一伙弟兄，都当小爷叔好朋友，
“All our brothers regard you as a good friend.

现在等着你老发号施令呢！”
They are waiting for your orders.”

“你别忙！
“Not so fast!

我答应替你们筹出一条生路来，一定要做到，
I promised to find a livelihood for you, and I shall keep that promise.

说句老实话，我眼前第一件大事，就是替你们去开路，
To tell you the truth, opening that path is my most urgent business.

大致的办法，我已经有了……”
I already have the outline of a plan…”

这是胡雪岩另一项与民生国计有关的大事业，
This was another major undertaking affecting both the people’s livelihood and the country’s economy.

他准备利用漕帮的人力、水路上的势力跟现成的船只，承揽公私货运，
Hu intended to use the grain-transport brotherhoods’ manpower, influence along the waterways, and existing boats to carry government and private cargo.

同时以松江漕帮的通裕米行为基础，大规模贩卖粮食。
At the same time, he would use the Songjiang brotherhood’s Tongyu Rice Shop as the basis for a large grain business.

“乱世米珠薪桂，原因有好多，
“There are several reasons why rice costs as much as pearls and firewood as much as cassia in wartime.

要一样样去考究。
We must examine them one by one.

兵荒马乱，田地荒了，出产少了，当然是一个原因，
Fighting leaves fields untended and reduces production: that is one reason.

再有一个原因是交通不便，
Another is the difficulty of transport.

眼看有米的地方因运不出，卖不掉，多么可惜！
How wasteful it is when places have rice but cannot move it out or sell it!

这还不算，最可惜的是糟蹋掉了！
But there is something more wasteful still: grain destroyed outright.

有些人家积存了好多粮食，但打起仗来，烧得光光，
Some households have large stores, only to see them burned in the fighting.

或者秋收到了，战事迫近，有稻无人割，白白作践。
Or autumn comes and the war draws near: rice stands ready in the fields, but there is no one to cut it, and it is wasted.

能够想办法不糟蹋，你们想，于公于私多么好！”
If we could prevent that waste, think what a benefit it would be to the public and to ourselves!”

“有道理！”
“That makes sense!”

尤五矍然而起，
You sprang up.

“前面两个原因，我懂，后面说的这一层道理，我还是第一次听到。
“I understand the first two reasons, but I have never heard this last point made before.

倒要请教小爷叔，怎么样才能不糟蹋？”
Tell me, Little Uncle, how can we prevent the waste?”

“这就要看局势了。
“By watching the situation.

眼要明，手要快，
We must see clearly and act quickly.

看啥地方快靠不住了，我们多调船过去，拿存粮抢运出去。
When a place is becoming unsafe, we send plenty of boats and get its stored grain out in time.

能割的稻子，也要抢着割下来。”
Any rice ready for cutting must be harvested quickly too.

胡雪岩又说：“这当然要官府帮忙，或者派兵保护，或者关卡上格外通融，
Of course we shall need official help: troops to protect us, perhaps, or special accommodation at the checkpoints.

只要说好了，五哥，你们将来人和、地利都具备，
Once it is all arranged, Brother Five, you will have both the cooperation of your people and the advantages of the waterways.

是独门生意。”
No one else could match the business.”


尤五和古应春都不作声，
You and Gu were silent.

两个人将胡雪岩的话，细细体味了一会，才大致懂得了他的做法。
They considered Hu’s words carefully before grasping the broad outline of his method.

这确是一项别人所抢不去的好生意，但是做起来不容易。
It was indeed an excellent business that no one else could wrest from them, but carrying it out would not be easy.

“官场的情形，小爷叔你晓得的，
“You know how officials are, Little Uncle.

未见得肯帮我们的忙。”
They may not be willing to help.”

“一定肯！
“They certainly will!

只看怎样说法？
It all depends on how the case is put.

其中还有个道理：打仗两件事，一是兵，二是粮，叫做足食足兵。
There is another reason: war requires two things, troops and grain—enough food and enough soldiers.

粮食就这么多，双方又是在一块地方，
There is only so much grain, and both sides are in the same area.

我们多出一分粮食，长毛就少一分粮食，
Every measure we gain is one the Taipings lose.

一进一出，关系不轻。
The effect on both sides is considerable.

所以，我去一说这层道理，上头一定会赞成。”
Once I explain that, the authorities are bound to approve.”

“ 对！”尤五问道：“小爷叔你预备跟哪个去说？
“Exactly!” You asked, “Whom do you intend to speak to?

王大老爷？”
Prefect Wang?”

“是的。我先跟他去说。
“Yes, I shall speak to him first.

事不宜迟，
There is no time to lose.

明天我就走！
I leave tomorrow!

我还有好多法子可以治长毛，譬如加紧缉私，断绝他们的日用百物的供应之类。”
I have plenty of other ways to deal with the Taipings, such as tightening the suppression of smuggling and cutting off their supplies of everyday necessities.”

胡雪岩站起身来，很起劲地挥着手：
Hu stood up and waved his hand with enthusiasm.

“做小生意迁就局势，
“Small traders adapt themselves to circumstances.

做大生意先帮公家拿局势扭过来。
A businessman on a large scale first helps the government change the circumstances.

大局好转，我们的生意就自然有办法。
Once the overall situation improves, our business will find its way.

你们等着，
Just wait.

看我到了杭州，重起炉灶，另有一番轰轰烈烈的事业。”
When I reach Hangzhou, I shall make a fresh start and launch undertakings that will really stir the world.”


（本篇终）
End of this part.


编后小语｜EDITORIAL AFTERWORD


至此，胡雪岩依靠官府、利用漕帮、结识外商买办、网罗赌徒、拉拢富商，
By this point, Hu Xueyan has relied on official support, made use of the grain-transport brotherhoods, established connections with foreign merchants and compradors, recruited gamblers, and cultivated wealthy businessmen.

终于发迹于战乱的年代，在上海、杭州立足。
He has at last risen to prosperity in an age of war, establishing himself in Shanghai and Hangzhou.


此后，高阳先生在《红顶商人》和《灯火楼台》等书中，依然以其丰富的历史知识和深厚的写作功力，铺叙了胡雪岩自上海、杭州发迹后，资财逐渐过于鼎盛之势，而最终归于破产的过程。
In The Red-Topped Merchant, Towers of Light, and other books, Gao Yang continues to draw on his extensive historical knowledge and accomplished storytelling to recount how Hu Xueyan’s wealth rose to its height after his beginnings in Shanghai and Hangzhou, and how he ultimately went bankrupt.

书中说道，身为江浙大贾的胡雪岩，运饷粮助清军解杭州之围，
These books describe Hu, by then a great merchant of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, transporting military funds and grain to help the Qing forces relieve the siege of Hangzhou.

城破，即转倚左宗棠为靠山，为其筹措军饷，购运西洋新式枪炮，借巨资于洋商，助左宗棠西征并协大办洋务；
After the city falls, he turns to Zuo Zongtang as his patron, raising military funds, buying and transporting modern Western guns and artillery, borrowing immense sums from foreign merchants to support Zuo’s western campaigns, and assisting in his Western-style enterprises.

继而倚仗官府，扩充实力，操纵了江浙商业，
Relying on official patronage, Hu then expands his power and comes to dominate commerce in Jiangsu and Zhejiang.

声名盛于东南，
His reputation spreads throughout the southeast.

直至身受二品顶戴，获赏穿黄马褂、紫禁城骑马的殊荣，赫赫然成为晚清唯一顶红顶子的商人；
He is eventually granted the insignia of the second official rank and the privileges of wearing a yellow riding jacket and riding a horse inside the Forbidden City, becoming the only merchant of the late Qing to wear the red-topped official hat.

胡雪岩穷奢极侈、酷好女色，在上海、杭州等地，营造多处富丽宅园，姬妾成群，荒淫无度，以为乐事，
Extravagant in the extreme and passionately fond of women, he builds splendid residences and gardens in Shanghai, Hangzhou, and elsewhere, surrounds himself with concubines, and delights in unrestrained debauchery.

十数年间，财势鼎盛至极；
For more than a decade, his wealth and influence reach extraordinary heights.

不想胡雪岩非真有奇计雄略，
Yet Hu does not possess truly remarkable strategy or far-reaching ability.

经不住洋商的排挤，商事日渐中落，
Unable to withstand the pressure of foreign merchants, his business gradually declines.

由盛转衰，终至破产，身败名裂。
Prosperity turns to ruin, until he is bankrupt and his reputation destroyed.

胡雪岩因而成为我国近代史中一奇特人物。
He thus becomes one of the singular figures of China’s modern history.


高阳先生独具慧眼，落笔如神，情节曲折，人物如生，文字畅达，场景开阔，使一幅描绘动荡的晚清社会的画面，跃然纸上。
With a distinctive eye and an inspired pen, Gao Yang creates intricate plots, lifelike characters, fluent prose, and scenes of great scope, bringing a vivid picture of the turbulent society of the late Qing to the page.


欲知晚清巨贾胡雪岩由商而官、暴起暴落地过程，请见本公司出版的《红顶商人》和《灯火楼台》等书。
For the story of how Hu Xueyan, the great merchant of the late Qing, moved from commerce into official rank and rose and fell with such dramatic speed, see The Red-Topped Merchant, Towers of Light, and other titles published by our company.



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第一章（本章第1部分，共6部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第一章
CHAPTER ONE


『禀大帅，』戈什哈向正在『饭后一局棋』的曾国藩请个安说，『浙江的差官求见。
“Your Excellency,” said the bodyguard, saluting Zeng Guofan, who was enjoying his customary game of go after dinner, “a dispatch officer from Zhejiang requests an audience.

请大帅的示∶见是不见？』
Will Your Excellency receive him?”

曾国藩正在打一个劫；
Zeng was in the middle of a ko fight.

这个劫关乎『东南半壁』的存亡，非打不可，
The survival of his entire southeastern quarter of the board depended on it; he could not afford to abandon the struggle.

然而他终于投子而起。
Yet in the end he put down his stones and rose.

『没有不见之理。
“Of course I must see him.

叫他进来好了。』
Tell him to come in.”


那名差官穿着一身破破烂烂的行装；
The dispatch officer wore travelling clothes that were all but in rags.

九月底的天气，早该换戴暖帽了，而他仍是一顶凉帽，
It was late in the ninth month, long past the time for changing to a winter hat, yet he still wore a summer one.

顶戴是亮蓝顶子，可知是个三品武官。
Its bright blue finial showed that he was a military officer of the third rank.

『浙江抚标参将游天勇，给大帅请安。』
“You Tianyong, assistant brigade commander of the Zhejiang governor’s own troops, pays his respects to Your Excellency.”

那游天勇抢上两步，跪下去磕头，
He hurried forward a couple of paces, knelt and kowtowed.

背上衣服破了个大洞，露出又黄又黑的一块皮肉。
A great hole in the back of his coat exposed a patch of yellow-brown skin.

『起来，起来！』
“Get up, get up!”

曾国藩看他那张脸，仿佛从未洗过似的；内心老大不忍，
His face looked as though it had never been washed, and Zeng could scarcely bear the sight.

便吩咐戈什哈说，『先带游参将去息一息，
“Take Commander You somewhere to rest,” he told the bodyguard.

吃了饭再请过来说话。』
“Give him a meal, then ask him back to speak with me.”

『回大帅的话，』游天勇抢着说道∶『卑职奉敝省王抚台之命，限期赶到安庆，投递公文，
“If I may report to Your Excellency,” You interrupted, “Governor Wang ordered me to reach Anqing within a fixed time and deliver these dispatches.

请大帅先过目。』
I beg Your Excellency to read them first.”

『好，好！你给我。
“Very well, give them to me.

你起来说话！』
Get up and speak.”

『谢大帅！』
“Thank you, Your Excellency.”


游天勇站起身来，略略退后两步；
You stood and retreated a couple of paces.

微侧着身子，解开衣襟，取出一个贴肉而藏的油纸包，
Turning a little sideways, he opened his coat and drew out an oilpaper packet he had carried against his skin.

厚甸甸地，似乎里面装的不止是几张纸的一封信。
It was thick and heavy, evidently containing more than a letter of a few sheets.

那油纸已经破裂，但解开来看，里面的一个尺把长的大信封却完好如新；
The oilpaper had split, but the large envelope within, a foot or so in length, remained as clean and sound as new.

曾国藩接到手里，便发觉里面装的不是纸，是一幅布或绸。
The moment Zeng took it, he knew it held cloth or silk, not paper.

翻过来先看信面，写的是∶『专呈安庆大营曾制台亲钧启。』
He turned it over to read the address: “For the personal and exclusive attention of Governor-General Zeng at Headquarters, Anqing.”

下面署明∶『王有龄亲笔谨缄。』
Below stood: “Respectfully sealed in his own hand by Wang Youling.”

再拆开来，
He broke it open.

果不其然，是一方折叠着的雪白杭纺；
As he had expected, it contained a folded square of snow-white Hangzhou silk.

信手一抖，便是一惊，
With an idle flick of his hand he shook it out, then started.

字迹黑中带红；还有数处紫红斑点，一望而知是血迹——
The writing was black tinged with red, and several purplish-red spots were plainly bloodstains.

王有龄和血所书的，只有四个海碗大的字∶『鹄候大援』；
Wang Youling had written in blood just four characters, each as large as a great bowl: “We await your mighty reinforcements.”

另有一行小字∶『浙江巡抚王有龄谨率全省数百万官民百拜泣求。』
Beneath them ran a line in smaller characters: “Wang Youling, Governor of Zhejiang, respectfully leads the millions of officials and people of this province in a hundred prostrations, and begs you with tears.”

曾国藩平主修养，以『不动心』三字为归趋；
Zeng had cultivated himself all his life towards the ideal of an unshaken mind.

而此时不能不色变了。
Now, however, his expression changed despite himself.


大营中的幕友材官，见了这幅惊心动魄∶别具一格的求援书，亦无不动容，
The civil advisers and military officers at headquarters were all visibly moved by this startling, extraordinary appeal.

注视着曾国藩，要看他如何处置？
They watched Zeng, waiting to see what he would do.

曾国藩徐徐卷起那幅杭纺，
Slowly he rolled up the silk.

向游天勇说道∶『你一路奔波，风尘劳苦，
“You have had a hard and arduous journey,” he told You.

且先休息。』
“Go and rest first.”

『是，多谢大帅。』游天勇肃然答说∶『卑职得见大帅，
“Thank you, Your Excellency,” You replied solemnly.

比什么都安慰；
“Nothing could comfort me more than to have reached you.

种种苦楚，这会都记不起来了。
All my hardships are forgotten now.

只求大帅早早发兵。』
I beg only that Your Excellency send troops at once.”

『我自有道理。』
“I have my own plans.”

看他不愿休息，曾国藩便问他浙江的情形，
Since You would not leave to rest, Zeng began asking about Zhejiang.

『你是哪天动身的？』
“When did you set out?”

『卑职是九月二十从杭州动身的，
“I left Hangzhou on the twentieth of the ninth month.

那时余杭已经沦陷。』游天勇答道，
Yuhang had already fallen.

『看样子，现在杭州已经被围。』
I imagine Hangzhou is under siege by now.”

『杭州的城池很坚固。
“Hangzhou has very strong walls and moats.

我记得「一统志」一说，是十个城门。』
If I remember the Comprehensive Gazetteer of the Empire correctly, it has ten gates.”

曾国藩念道∶『「候潮」听得「清波」响，「涌金」「钱塘」定「太平」。
Zeng recited, “‘Awaiting the Tide’, one hears the ‘Clear Waves’ sound; ‘Surging Gold’ and ‘Qiantang’ make ‘Great Peace’ secure.

宋仁宗的时候，处士徐仲晦，愿子孙世世不离钱塘，
In the reign of Emperor Renzong of the Song, the recluse Xu Zhonghui wished that his descendants might never leave Qiantang.

说是永无兵燹之灾。
He said it would always be spared the ravages of war.

想来杭州可以守得住。』
I should think Hangzhou could hold out.”

他念的那句诗，游天勇倒是听过，是拿杭州的十个城门，候潮门、清波门等等缀成诗成；
You had heard the verse: it strung together the names of Hangzhou’s ten gates, such as Houchao, Awaiting the Tide, and Qingbo, Clear Waves.

至于什么宋朝人的话，他就莫名其妙了。
But this talk of some man from the Song dynasty meant nothing to him.

只是听语气，说杭州守得住便无发兵之意，
He understood only that, by saying Hangzhou could hold out, Zeng seemed to have no intention of sending troops.

游天勇大为着急，不能不说话。
Desperately anxious, he had to speak.


『杭州的城坚固，倒是不错。
“Hangzhou’s walls are strong, certainly.

不过守不长久的。』
But the city cannot hold out for long.”

『喔，』
“Oh?”

曾国藩揸开五指，抓梳着胡须问∶『这是什么道理？
Zeng spread his fingers and combed them through his beard. “Why is that?

你倒说来我听听。』『杭州存粮不足——。』
Tell me.”

杭州虽称富足，但从无积米之家。
“Hangzhou has insufficient stores of grain—” Prosperous though Hangzhou was said to be, its households did not keep large stocks of rice.

浙西米市在杭州东北方一百里处的长安镇；
The rice market of western Zhejiang was at Chang’an, a hundred li northeast of the city.

杭州的地主，每年所收租谷，除了留下一家食米之外，都运到长安镇待价而沽，
Each year the landlords retained only enough of the grain collected as rent to feed their own families, sending the rest to Chang’an to await a favourable price.

所以城里无十日之粮。
Thus the city had not even ten days’ provisions.

这年春夏，青黄不接之际，米价大涨；
That spring and summer, in the lean months before the harvest, rice prices had soared.

而杭州经过上年二月间的一番沦陷，劫掠一空，留下来的百姓，艰苦度日，
Hangzhou had been captured and stripped bare in the second month of the previous year, and the inhabitants who remained were struggling to survive.

哪里来的钱购粮存贮？
Where could they find money to buy and store grain?

本来是想等新谷登场，好好作一番储粮的打算，谁知兵败如山，
They had meant to lay in proper reserves when the new crop came in, but no one had foreseen the army’s headlong collapse.

累累满野，都便宜了太平军。
The grain lying in abundance across the fields had all fallen to the Taiping forces.

『唉！』曾国藩深深叹息，
Zeng sighed deeply.

『在浙东的张玉良、李定太，如果肯拼命抵挡一阵就好了。』他接着又问，『守城最要紧的是粮食丰足。
“If only Zhang Yuliang and Li Dingtai in eastern Zhejiang had been willing to fight with all their strength and hold them off for a while!” Then he asked, “Ample provisions are the first requirement in defending a city.

王抚台难道就不想办法？』
Has Governor Wang done nothing?”


『王抚台也在极力想办法，
“Governor Wang has been doing everything he can.

去年就出告示，招商采买，答应所过地方，免抽厘税。
Last year he issued a proclamation inviting merchants to buy supplies, promising exemption from likin duties wherever they passed.

不过路上不平靖，米商都不敢来。』游天勇说，
But the roads were unsafe, and the rice merchants dared not come.

『卑职动身的时候，听说王抚台预备请胡道台到上海去采办粮食军火，
When I left, I heard that he intended to ask Intendant Hu to go to Shanghai to purchase food and arms.

也不知运到了没有？』
I do not know whether they have arrived.”

『哪个胡道台？』曾国藩问，
“Which Intendant Hu?” Zeng asked.

『是胡元博吗？』
“Hu Yuanbo?”

『不是。是胡雪岩。』
“No, Hu Xueyan.”

『喔，喔，是他！
“Ah, yes, him!

听说他非常能干？』
I hear he is a very capable man.”

『是！胡道台很能干的；
“He is indeed.

杭州城里，大绅士逃的逃，躲的躲，
All the great local gentlemen in Hangzhou have either fled or gone into hiding.

全靠胡道台出面，借粮借捐维持官军。』
It is entirely through Intendant Hu’s efforts to borrow grain and raise contributions that the imperial troops have been kept going.”

曾国藩点点头，默想了一下杭州的形势，
Zeng nodded and considered Hangzhou’s situation for a moment.

随又问道∶『钱塘江南岸呢？
“What about the south bank of the Qiantang?

现在浙江的饷源在宁绍；
Zhejiang’s military funds now come from Ningbo and Shaoxing.

这条路线是畅通的吧？』
That route is still open, I take it?”

『是。
“Yes.

全靠这条路。
We depend entirely on it.

不过——。』『你说！
But—” “Go on.

有什么碍口的？』
Why should you hesitate?”


『回大帅的话，过钱塘江，萧山、绍兴、宁波一带，都归王大臣管；
“If I may report to Your Excellency, once one crosses the Qiantang, Xiaoshan, Shaoxing and Ningbo are all under Commissioner Wang.

他跟王抚台不和。
He and Governor Wang do not get on.

事情——。『游天勇略微摇一摇头，说不下去了。
Things—” You shook his head slightly, unable to continue.

王大臣是指钦命团练大臣王履谦。
Commissioner Wang was Wang Lüqian, the imperially appointed commissioner for militia organisation.

曾国藩亦深知其人，并且曾接到他来信诉苦，说绍兴、宁波两府，每月筹饷十万两银子解送省城；而王有龄未发一卒渡江。
Zeng knew him well and had received a letter from him complaining that Shaoxing and Ningbo prefectures raised a hundred thousand taels a month for the provincial capital, yet Wang Youling had not sent a single soldier across the river.

现在听游天勇的话，似乎事实并非如此。
From what You was now saying, the truth seemed otherwise.

但不论谁是谁非，将帅不和，兵民相仇，总不是好兆。
But whoever was right or wrong, discord among commanders and hostility between soldiers and civilians could bode no good.

浙江的局势，真是令人灰心。
The situation in Zhejiang was profoundly discouraging.


『你下去休息。』
“Go and rest.”

以曾国藩的地位，若有所处置，自不须跟游天勇明说，更不必向他作解释，
A man in Zeng’s position had no need to tell You what measures he proposed, much less explain his reasons.

只这样吩咐∶『你今晚上好好睡一觉，
He merely gave his orders. “Get a good night’s sleep.

明来取了回信，即刻赶回杭州去复命。
Collect my reply tomorrow, then return to Hangzhou at once and report.

公文、马匹、盘缠，我会派人给你预备。』
I shall have someone prepare the dispatches, a horse and your travelling expenses.”

『是！』
“Yes, Your Excellency.”

游天勇站起身来请个安，
You rose and saluted.

『多谢大帅。』
“Thank you, Your Excellency.”


跑上海、安庆的轮船，是英商太古公司的四明号，
The steamer plying between Shanghai and Anqing was the Siming, owned by the British firm of Swire.

船上的买办叫萧家骥，原是上海的富家子，生就一副喜欢搜奇探秘的性格，
Her comprador, Xiao Jiaji, came from a wealthy Shanghai family and had been born with a taste for seeking out the strange and unexplored.

最初是因为好奇，拜了古应春做老师学英文。
Curiosity had first led him to study English under Gu Yingchun.

再由他的『师娘』七姑奶奶而认识了『舅舅』尤五——他跟着七姑奶奶的孩子这样叫，因而对漕帮也有了渊源。
Through his teacher’s wife, the Seventh Lady, he had come to know “Uncle” You Wu—the name he used in imitation of her child—and so acquired connections with the Grain-Boat Guild.

但是，他跟胡雪岸一样，是一个深懂『门槛』里的内幕，却是个在『门槛』外面的『空子』。
Yet, like Hu Xueyan, he understood everything that went on inside its “threshold” while remaining an uninitiated outsider.

为了曾国藩派李鸿章 领兵援沪，四明号接连跑了几趟安庆；
Zeng Guofan had sent Li Hongzhang with troops to relieve Shanghai, and the Siming had consequently made several trips to Anqing in succession.

到得事毕，已在深秋，萧家骥方得抽空去看古应春。
By the time the business was over, it was late autumn before Xiao could find time to visit Gu.


古应春很得意了，
Gu Yingchun was doing very well.

先跟胡雪岩合作丝茶生意，很发了点财；
His partnership with Hu in silk and tea had brought him a tidy fortune.

及至江浙局势大变，丝茶来路中断，改行经营地皮，
When the worsening situation in Jiangsu and Zhejiang cut off supplies, he had turned to land.

由于逃难的富室大族，纷纷涌向上海租界，地价大涨特涨，越发财源茂盛。
Wealthy families seeking refuge poured into the foreign settlements at Shanghai, driving land prices higher and higher and swelling his profits.

而且近水楼台，选地鸠工购料都方便，所以在新辟的二马路上，造了一所极精致的住宅；
Being on the spot also made it easy to choose a site, engage workmen and buy materials, so he had built an exquisite residence on the newly opened Second Road.

一家三口——七姑奶奶生了个儿子；倒用了上十口的下人。
His family of three—the Seventh Lady had borne him a son—employed more than ten servants.

他们师弟的感情一向深厚，
Teacher and pupil had always been close.

自然先谈些旅途情况之类的闲话。
Naturally, they began with easy conversation about Xiao’s travels.

说不到几句，听得七姑奶奶的声音；接着便出现在他们面前，
They had exchanged only a few remarks when they heard the Seventh Lady’s voice; then she appeared before them.

浓妆艳抹，一张银盆大脸，白的格外白，红的格外红，
Her broad, round face was heavily made up, the white exceptionally white and the red exceptionally red.

加以首饰炫耀，更令人不可逼视。
Her dazzling jewellery made her almost too brilliant to look at.

『师娘要出门？』
“Are you going out, Madam?”

萧家骥站起身来招呼。
Xiao rose to greet her.

『是啊，
“Yes.

有两个远道来的亲戚，去见见上海的市面。
Two relatives have come from far away, and I am taking them to see something of Shanghai.

逛逛洋行兜兜风——。』
We shall browse in the foreign shops and take a little air—”


『这么冷的天去兜风？』古应春打断她的话笑道∶『你在发疯！』
“In this cold weather?” Gu interrupted, laughing. “You must be mad!”

古应春就爱捉他妻子话中的漏洞，
He delighted in picking holes in his wife’s expressions.

七姑奶奶听惯了不理他，管自己往下说∶『中午请客人吃番菜；下午去看西洋马戏。
Long accustomed to it, she ignored him and continued. “At noon I shall treat them to a foreign meal, and in the afternoon we shall see the Western circus.

晚上还没有定，
Nothing is settled for the evening.

要不要在一起吃饭？』
Shall we dine together?”

『不必了！
“No need to arrange anything.

晚上回家吃饭。
Come home for dinner.

这两天蟹好，我去弄一篓蟹来。』
The crabs are good just now; I shall get a basket.”

『对！』七姑奶奶大为高兴，
“Yes!” she exclaimed with delight.

『今年还没有好好吃过一顿蟹。』接着又叹口气∶『遭劫！
“We have not had a proper feast of crabs this year.” Then she sighed. “What a calamity!

兵荒马乱，蟹的来路都断了。
With all this war and turmoil, even the supply of crabs has been cut off.

这个年头，做人真没味道。』
There is no pleasure in being alive these days.”

『好了，好了，
“There, there!

不要不知足了！』古应春说，
You should be content,” Gu said.

『你住在夷场上，不忧穿、不忧吃，还说做人没有味道；
“You live in the foreign settlement, with no worries about food or clothing, yet you say life has no pleasure.

那末陷在长毛那里的人呢？』
What of the people trapped among the Longhairs?”

『就为的有人陷在长毛那里，消息不通，生死不明；教人牵肠挂肚，
“It is precisely because people are trapped among them, with no news coming through and no knowing whether they are alive or dead, that one cannot stop worrying.

所以说做人没有味道。』
That is why I say there is no pleasure in life.”

说着，便是满脸不欢。
Her face clouded.

『顾不得那么多了。』古应春用劝慰的语气说∶『你们去逛逛散散心；
“We cannot attend to everything,” Gu said consolingly. “Go out and look around; take your minds off it.

晚上回来吃蟹。』
Come back this evening for crabs.”

七姑奶奶没有再说什么，低着头走了。
She said no more, but went out with her head lowered.


古应春亦不免黯然，
Gu, too, grew despondent.

『局势很坏。』
“Things are very bad.”

他摇摇头，
He shook his head.

『杭州只怕就在这几天完蛋。』
“I fear Hangzhou may be finished within the next few days.”

『胡先生呢？』萧家骥问道∶『不晓得在杭州怎么样？』
“And Mr Hu?” Xiao asked. “I wonder how he is managing there.”

『没有信来。』
“No letter has come.”

古应春忽然流下两滴眼泪，
Two tears suddenly rolled down Gu’s face.

『这么一个好朋友，眼看他失陷在里面，
“Such a good friend, and we can only watch him being trapped inside!

也不晓得将来还有没有见面的日子？
Who knows whether we shall ever see him again?

这两天晚上跟你师娘谈起来，都是一整夜睡不着觉。』
These last two nights, whenever your teacher’s wife and I have spoken of him, neither of us has slept till morning.”

『吉人天相！』萧家骥劝慰他说，
“Heaven protects good men,” Xiao said to comfort him.

『我看胡先生，不管他的相貌、性情、行为，都不象是遭劫的人。
“Nothing about Mr Hu—his features, his temperament or his conduct—suggests a man destined for disaster.

再说，以胡先生的眼光、心思，又哪里会坐困愁城，束手无策？』
Besides, with his insight and ingenuity, how could he sit helpless in a beleaguered city, unable to think of anything?”

这几句话很有用，
These words helped a great deal.

古应春想了好一会，点点头说∶『我也怎么样都看不出他是短命相。』
Gu thought for some time, then nodded. “I cannot see the signs of a short life in him either, however I look.”


在古家吃了饭，师弟二人，同车而出；
After a meal at Gu’s house, teacher and pupil went out in the same carriage.

古应春将他送到了船公司，自己便到他的做地产的号子里，派『出店老司务』去买蟹；
Gu dropped Xiao at the shipping company, then went to his property firm and sent its senior outside clerk to buy crabs.

特为关照∶只要好，价钱不论。
His instructions were explicit: they must be good, whatever the price.

有这一句话，事情就好办了。
With that authority, the task was easy.

那老事务也很能干，
The clerk was an able man.

到内河码头上等着，等到一只嘉兴来的船，载来十几篓蟹；
He waited at the inland-waterway wharf until a boat from Jiaxing arrived with a dozen or more baskets of crabs.

眼明手快，先把住一篓好的不放手，然后再谈价钱。
Quick of eye and hand, he laid hold of a good basket and refused to release it before discussing the price.

『五钱银子一个，大小不论；
“Half a tael each, large or small.

这一篓三十二个，
There are thirty-two in this basket.

格外克己，算十五两银子。』
I shall be especially generous and ask only fifteen taels.”

『十五两银子，还说克己？』
“Fifteen taels—and you call that generous?”

『要就要，不要拉倒。
“Take them or leave them.

你要晓得，蟹在嘉兴不贵，这一路到上海，是拿性命换来的；
You ought to understand: crabs are not dear in Jiaxing, but we have risked our lives bringing them all the way to Shanghai.

难道不值五钱银子一个？』
Surely that is worth half a tael each?”

说着，就要来夺回他的货色。
He reached to reclaim his goods.

老司务哪里肯放，但是也不能照数付价；
The clerk would not let go, but neither would he pay the asking price.

摸出十二两现银，塞到货主手里；
He took out twelve taels in silver and pressed them into the owner’s hand.

此人不肯接，
The man refused.

软磨硬吵，十四两银子成交。
After much coaxing and noisy bargaining, they settled at fourteen taels.


将蟹送到古家，七姑奶奶刚好回家；
The Seventh Lady had just returned when the crabs reached the house.

拿蟹来看，只见金毛紫背，壮硕非凡，
She took them out to look at them: golden-haired, purple-backed, extraordinarily large and strong.

取来放在光滑如镜的福建漆圆桌上，八足挺立，到处横行。
Set upon a round Fujian lacquer table as smooth as a mirror, they braced themselves on their eight legs and scuttled imperiously in every direction.

那老司务看着，不由得就咽唾沫。
The sight made the clerk swallow.

七姑奶奶本性厚道，也会做人，当时便对老司务说，『买得多了，
Kind-hearted by nature and skilled at putting people at their ease, she said at once, “You have bought too many.

你拿几个带到号子里，跟同事分着尝尝。』
Take a few back to the firm and share them with your colleagues.”

说着便从篓子里拎了一串出来，恰好五尖五团，整整十个，就手递了过去。
She lifted a string from the basket—five with pointed abdominal flaps and five with round ones, ten in all—and handed it to him.

老司务却不肯要，无奈七姑奶奶执意要大家分尝，只好带了回去。
He refused, but she insisted that everyone should have a taste, and he finally took them away.

然后亲自下厨，指挥厨子用紫苏蒸蟹。
She then went into the kitchen herself to direct the cook in steaming the crabs with perilla leaves.

接着又开箱子找出一套银餐具，小钳子、小钉锤，做得极其玲珑可爱。
Afterwards she opened a chest and brought out a set of silver implements: tiny pincers and hammers, exquisitely made.


正在吃得热闹的当儿，只见人影幢幢，有人声、也有脚步声——
They were eating with great animation when shifting shadows appeared outside, accompanied by voices and footsteps.

七姑奶奶天不怕、地不怕，就怕见这种情形，
The Seventh Lady feared neither heaven nor earth, but such a commotion terrified her.

一下子吓得手足发软、脸色苍白；
Her limbs suddenly weakened and her face went white.

因为她家在她六岁的时候，遭过一阵火灾，当时的情形就是如此，
When she was six, her family’s house had caught fire; this was exactly how it had begun.

快三十年了，印象不消，余悸犹在。
Nearly thirty years had passed, yet the impression had never faded, and the old terror remained.

『不要这样子，』她又气又急地喊，
“Do not do that!” she cried, at once angry and alarmed.

『你们在乱什么？』
“What are you all rushing about for?”

一句话没有完，只见男仆扶进一个人来；
Before she had finished, she saw the male servants helping someone inside.

七姑奶奶越发惊心，但总算还好，一眼瞥见古应春是好好的。
Her alarm grew, though she was somewhat reassured to see at a glance that Gu was unhurt.

他抢上几步，亲手揭开门帘，不断地喊∶『扶好，
He hurried ahead to lift the door curtain himself, calling repeatedly, “Hold him steady!

扶好！』
Hold him steady!”

又抽空向里说了句，自是对七姑奶奶而发∶『快叫人搬一张藤靠椅来！』
Then he found a moment to call into the room, plainly addressing her, “Get someone to bring a reclining cane chair, quickly!”

惊魂初定的七姑奶奶问道∶『谁啊？』
Recovering a little, she asked, “Who is it?”


不知从哪里闪出来一个萧家骥，
Xiao Jiaji appeared from somewhere.

接口说道∶『胡先生！』
“Mr Hu!” he answered.

『哪个胡先生？』
“Which Mr Hu?”

『还有哪个？
“Who else?

小爷叔！』
Little Uncle!”

七姑奶奶一听心就酸了；
At that her heart contracted.

急急往门口迎了出去，正好男仆扶着胡雪岩到门口，
She hurried to the door just as the servants brought Hu there.

灯光映照，哪里还认得出来？
In the lamplight she could scarcely recognise him.

『是小爷叔？』
“Little Uncle?”

『七姐！』
“Seventh Sister!”

满脸于思，憔悴异常的胡雪岩勉强笑了笑，露出一嘴森森的白牙，
His face was covered in beard, and he looked dreadfully worn. He managed a faint smile that exposed a startling row of white teeth.

『是我。』
“It is I.”

『真是小爷叔？』
“It really is Little Uncle!”

七姑奶奶双泪交流，
Tears streamed from her eyes.

『怎么弄成这个样子？』
“How have you come to this?”

『这时候哪里有功夫说话？』古应春不耐烦地催促∶『还不快搬藤椅来？』
“This is no time for questions!” Gu urged impatiently. “Where is that cane chair?”


七姑奶奶赶紧回身指挥丫头，搬来一张藤椅，铺上褥子；
She turned at once and told the maids to bring it and lay a padded quilt upon it.

男仆们七手八脚地将胡雪岩扶着躺下，她这时才发觉，胡雪岩一条腿受伤了。
The male servants crowded around to help Hu recline, and only then did she notice the injury to his leg.

『快请医生来！
“Fetch a doctor!

拿姜汤！』
Bring ginger broth!”

古应春一叠连声地吩咐∶『熬粥！』
Gu gave his orders in rapid succession. “Put some congee on!”

事出突兀，七姑奶奶乱了枪法，
Taken by surprise, the Seventh Lady had lost all presence of mind.

倒是萧家骤比较镇静∶『师父，你让胡先生先坐定了再说。』
Xiao was calmer. “Sir, let Mr Hu settle himself first.”

胡雪岩那边坐定下来，已有丫头端来一碗红枣姜汤，
By the time Hu was resting in the chair, a maid had brought a bowl of ginger broth with red dates.

他一面喝，一面喘气，手在发抖、腿在抽筋，
He drank it between gasps, his hands shaking and his legs twitching.

那副样子看在七姑奶奶眼里，视线立刻就模糊了。
At the sight, the Seventh Lady’s vision blurred with tears.


『这是虚极了！』古应春对他妻子说，
“He is utterly exhausted!” Gu told his wife.

『这时候还不能多吃东西；
“He must not eat much at a time yet.

你把那枝老山人参拿出来。』
Bring out that old wild ginseng.”

这是因为胡雪岩已经两个月没有吃过一顿饱饭；
Hu had not eaten a full meal for two months.

坐只小船一路逃出来，由于身上带着公事，不敢露面，
He had escaped all the way in a little boat, but because he carried official dispatches he dared not show himself.

昼伏夜行穿过一个接一个的『长毛窝』，沿途也不容易弄到食料；
Hiding by day and travelling by night, he had passed through one Longhair stronghold after another, with scarcely any chance to find food.

就算有，也不能尽情饱餐，因为肠胃太弱，骤饱之下，无法消化。
Even when he found some, he could not eat his fill: his stomach and intestines were so weakened that a sudden full meal would have been impossible to digest.

相传每年冬天开施粥厂，头一天总有几个穷汉因为过于贪心而胀死；
It was said that whenever the soup kitchens opened in winter, a few starving men died on the first day because they ate too greedily.

七姑奶奶也懂这个道理，
The Seventh Lady understood this too.

急急去取了那枝出自大内、珍藏已久的吉林老山人参来，让胡雪岩嚼咽而食，扶保元气。
She hurried to fetch the old wild Jilin ginseng she had treasured for so long, originally obtained from the imperial palace, and gave it to Hu to chew and swallow, to sustain his failing strength.

『小爷叔，』七姑奶奶望着他那条受伤的腿说∶『我看看你的伤口。』
“Little Uncle,” she said, looking at his injured leg, “let me see the wound.”


说着，就要伸手去捧他的脚，胡雪岩急忙往里一缩。
She reached to lift his foot, but he hastily drew it away.

伤是在嘉兴附近为长毛盘问时，一句话不对劲被砍了一刀；
Near Jiaxing, while the Longhairs were questioning him, a single unfortunate answer had earned him a sword cut.

无医无药，在荒郊野庙胡乱找了些香火掩敷，从小褂子上撕了些布条扎紧，
Without doctor or medicine, he had found some incense ash in a deserted country temple and roughly covered the wound, then bound it with strips torn from his underjacket.

如今正在溃烂，血污淋漓，肮脏不堪，所以胡雪岩不愿让她沾手，
Now it was festering, filthy with blood and discharge, and he would not let her soil her hands.

『七姐，你不要动它。』
“Seventh Sister, do not touch it.”

胡雪岩说一句便喘气，
The few words left him breathless.

停了一下又说了两个字∶『我饿！』
After a pause he managed two more: “I’m hungry!”

『我晓得、我晓得！
“I know, I know!

粥在熬了。』
The congee is cooking.”

七姑奶奶想到一个办法，
An idea occurred to her.

『我先弄些东西来给小爷叔吃。』
“I shall get Little Uncle something to eat first.”

我亲自入厨，舀了一碗现成的鸡汤，撇去浮油，
She went into the kitchen herself, ladled out a bowl of ready-made chicken broth and skimmed off the fat.

撕一块脯子肉剁成肉泥，倒在汤里；
She tore off a piece of breast meat, chopped it to a paste and stirred it into the broth.

然后取一块米粉做的奶糕，在鸡汤中捣碎泡化，成了一碗『浆糊』，亲手捧给胡雪岩。
Then she took a rice-flour milk cake, crushed it and soaked it in the soup until the whole became a bowl of gruel, which she carried to Hu herself.

一闻见香味，胡雪岩先就忍不住连连咽着唾沫；
The smell alone made him swallow repeatedly.

接到手里恨不得一下子吞进肚里，
Once the bowl was in his hands, he longed to gulp it down at once.

但他想到，过于露出『馋相』，会伤他们夫妻的心，
But he thought that an open display of his ravenous hunger would wound the couple’s feelings.

所以不得不强自抑制着，装得斯文从容地，一匙一匙舀着吃。
Forcing himself to exercise restraint, he pretended to be composed and ate delicately, spoonful by spoonful.



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第一章（本章第2部分，共6部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


一大碗浆糊吃得光光，实在意有未尽；
He finished the great bowl of gruel without leaving a trace, yet it was nowhere near enough.

便用无可奈何的声音说道∶『七姐，五脏庙还在造反。』
“Seventh Sister,” he said helplessly, “the temple of my five organs is still in revolt.”

『小爷叔，』古应春劝他，『等下再吃！
“Little Uncle,” Gu urged, “wait a little before you eat again!”

『喔！』
“Oh!”

胡雪岩点点头，但脸上是异常失望的神色。
Hu nodded, but his disappointment was plain.

七姑奶奶大为不忍，但也不能不顾他的肠胃，
The Seventh Lady could scarcely bear it, though she could not disregard the condition of his stomach.

随即说道∶『这样吧，
“I know.

弄点吃不坏的东西来吃。』
Let us find something that will do you no harm.”

于是装了几盘零食，松子、杏仁、蜜枣、金橘饼之类，为他『煞馋』；
She brought out several plates of small delicacies—pine nuts, almonds, honeyed dates and candied kumquats—to appease his craving.

而就在这个时候，伤科医生到了，
Just then the doctor who treated injuries arrived.

检视伤口，认为相当严重，总要半个月才能行动。
After examining the wound, he pronounced it serious: Hu would need at least a fortnight before he could move about.


『这，这办不到，』胡雪岩很着急地说，
“That—that is impossible,” Hu said anxiously.

『至多三、五天，我一定要回去。』
“I must go back in three to five days at the very most.”

『什么？』七姑奶奶急急问道，
“What?” the Seventh Lady asked urgently.

『小爷叔，你还要回去？
“Little Uncle, you are going back?

回杭州？』
Back to Hangzhou?”

『是啊！
“Yes.

杭州城里，多少张嘴都朝天张大了在等我。』
Think how many mouths are open there, waiting for me.”

『小爷叔是受王抚台的重托，特为到上海来买米的。』古应春向七姑奶奶解释∶『这是救命的事，
“Governor Wang has entrusted Little Uncle with a special mission to buy rice in Shanghai,” Gu explained to her. “Lives depend on it.

小爷叔确是不便耽搁；
He really cannot afford to linger.

我已经派人去请五哥来商量了。
I have already sent someone to ask Brother Five to come and discuss matters.

不过，』他转脸向伤科医生问道∶『先生，无论如何要请你费心；
But—” He turned to the doctor. “Sir, whatever happens, I must beg you to do your utmost.

不管用什么贵重药，
No medicine is too costly.

总要请你想个法子，让我们这位小爷叔，三五天以内，就能走动。』
Please find some way of getting Little Uncle on his feet within three to five days.”

『真的。』
“Indeed!”

这时的七姑奶奶也帮着恳求，
The Seventh Lady joined her pleas to his.

『郎中先生，你要做做好事；
“Doctor, you must perform this act of kindness.

我们这位小爷叔早到一天，杭州城里就要多活好些人。
Every day sooner that Little Uncle gets back means many more lives saved in Hangzhou.

这是阴功积德的大好事；
You will earn untold merit for such a deed.

郎中先生，你一生看过的病人，没有比这位再要紧的。』
In all your life, you have never treated a patient more important than this one.”

最后这句话很有力量，
That last sentence had great force.

伤科医生大为动容，将他的伤口左看右看，攒眉咂嘴了好半天，
Deeply moved, the doctor examined the wound from every angle, frowning and clicking his tongue for a long time.

说出一句话来。
At last he spoke.

『办法是有，
“There is a way.

只怕病人吃不起痛苦。』
I fear only that the patient could not bear the pain.”

『不要紧！』
“Never mind that!”

胡雪岩咬一咬牙说，
Hu clenched his teeth.

『什么痛我都不在乎，只要早好！』
“I care nothing for pain, so long as I recover quickly.”


『说说容易。』
“Easy enough to say.”

伤科医生大摇其头，
The doctor shook his head.

『看你的样子，人是虚弱到了极点；
“You are exhausted to the very limit.

痛得厉害，人会昏过去。
Severe pain could make you faint.

等我想想。』
Let me think.”

他转脸问道∶『古先生，你不是认识外国医生？』
He turned to Gu. “Mr Gu, do you not know a foreign doctor?”

这一说，提醒了古应春；悔恨不迭——
The question reminded Gu of something he bitterly regretted forgetting.

只为胡雪岩的模样，令人震惊；一时昏瞀，竟想不起请西医，
Hu’s appearance had so shocked him that he had been too bewildered to think of summoning a Western physician.

如今倒不便『另请高明了』了。
Now it would be awkward to seek another doctor’s services.

『是！』他只好先回答了再说。
“Yes,” he answered, having little choice.

『外国医生的看法来得慢∶不过他们有两样药很管用；
“Foreign doctors take their time over a case, but they have a couple of very useful medicines.

你能不能去要点止痛药来。』
Could you obtain some painkiller from them?”

『这，』古应春面有难色，
“Well—” Gu looked troubled.

他知道西医跟中医不同，不曾诊视过病人，不肯随便给药；
He knew that Western physicians differed from Chinese practitioners: they would not readily prescribe for a patient they had not examined.

而且止痛的药也不止一种，有外敷、有内服，
Moreover, there was more than one kind of painkiller, some applied externally and others taken internally.

『要哪一种止痛药，
“Which kind would you want?

总得有个药名才好。』
I should at least need its name.”


『药名就说不出来了；
“I cannot tell you its name.

叽哩咕噜的洋文，弄不清楚。』
I cannot make sense of that foreign gibberish.”

伤科医生略停一下，下了决心，
The doctor paused, then made up his mind.

『算了！
“Never mind!

耽误时候，也不是一回事，
We cannot keep wasting time.

我先动手。』
I shall begin.”

于是他从药箱里取出一个布包，
From his medicine chest he took a cloth bundle.

一打开来，雪亮耀眼，是几把大小不同的刀钳；
Unfolded, it revealed several knives and forceps of different sizes, gleaming brightly.

然后用新棉花擦拭伤口，运刀剜去腐肉，
He cleaned the wound with fresh cotton, then cut away the dead flesh.

疼得胡雪岩满头大汗。
The pain brought sweat pouring from Hu’s head.

古应春和七姑奶奶心惊肉跳，也陪着他淌汗；同时还得胡作镇静，想出话来安慰病人，
Gu and the Seventh Lady were trembling with alarm and sweating with him, yet they had to pretend to be calm and find something to say to comfort him.

七姑奶奶象哄小孩似地，不断地说∶『不疼、不疼，
Like someone coaxing a child, she kept repeating, “It does not hurt, it does not hurt.

马上就好了。』
It will soon be over.”

毕竟好了，
At last it was over.

敷上止血定痛的『降香散』包扎妥当；
The doctor applied Jiangxiang Powder to stop the bleeding and ease the pain, then bandaged the wound carefully.

伤科医生自己也大大地舒了口气，
He too breathed a great sigh of relief.

『总算还好，没有变成破伤风。』他说，
“Fortunately it has not developed into tetanus,” he said.

『「金疮出血太多，其脉虚细者生。」
“‘When a blade wound has bled heavily, a weak and fine pulse foretells survival.’

如今千万要好好照料，
He must now be looked after with the utmost care.

疏忽不得。』
There must be no neglect.”

接着他又说了许多禁忌，不能劳动，不能生气，不能大说大笑；
He went on to enumerate many prohibitions: no exertion, no anger, no loud talk or laughter.

还要『忌口』，咸、酸、辣和热酒、热汤都不能喝，连热粥也在禁忌之列。
Hu must also restrict his diet—nothing salty, sour or spicy, no hot wine or soup, not even hot congee.

『糟了！』七姑奶奶说，
“Oh dear!” the Seventh Lady exclaimed.

『刚喝了一大碗热鸡汤。』
“He has just had a great bowl of hot chicken soup.”

『喝也喝过了，
“He has already drunk it.

提它干什么？』古应春说，
What is the use of mentioning it now?” Gu said.

『以后小心就是了。』
“We must be careful from now on.”


等伤科医生一走，古应春要改请西医来看；
Once the doctor had left, Gu proposed bringing in a Western physician instead.

七姑奶奶不赞成，胡雪岩也表示不必，
The Seventh Lady objected, and Hu too said it was unnecessary.

因为他自觉痛楚已经减轻，证明这位伤科医生有些手段，自不宜更换医生。
He felt the pain had already diminished, which proved that the doctor had some skill; they ought not to replace him.

『我精神好多了。』胡雪岩说，
“I feel much stronger,” Hu said.

『办大事要紧。
“We must attend to the important business.

五哥怎么还不来？』
Why is Brother Five still not here?”

『今天是他一徒弟续弦，在吃喜酒，
“One of his pupils is marrying again today, and he is at the wedding feast.

我已经派人去追了。
I have sent someone after him.

小爷叔，』古应春说∶『有事你先分派我。』
Little Uncle, give me your instructions first.”

『好！』
“Very well.”

他探手入怀，掏摸了好半天，才掏出一个油纸包；
Hu put a hand inside his coat and felt about for a long time before bringing out an oilpaper packet.

递了给古应春。
He handed it to Gu.


打开油纸包，里面是惊心动魄的王有龄的两通血书，
Inside were two appalling letters written in Wang Youling’s blood.

一通致闽浙总督庆端，
One was addressed to Qingduan, Governor-General of Fujian and Zhejiang.

乞援以外，更望设法督催一直逗留在衡州的李元度，带领所募的湘勇，往杭州这方面打，
Besides begging for reinforcements, Wang hoped he would press Li Yuandu, who was still lingering at Hengzhou, to lead the Hunan recruits he had raised towards Hangzhou.

好牵制长毛，减轻杭州的压力。
This would hold the Longhairs in check and ease the pressure on the city.

还有一通是给江苏巡抚薛焕的，要求筹饷筹粮，
The other was for Xue Huan, Governor of Jiangsu, asking him to raise funds and provisions.

同时附着一件奏稿，托薛焕代缮拜发。
Enclosed was the draft of a memorial, which Wang asked Xue to have copied out and forwarded to the throne on his behalf.


其中详叙杭州被围绝粮，
The memorial described in detail how Hangzhou had been besieged and deprived of food.

归咎于驻在绍兴的团练大臣王履谦，勾结劣绅，把持地方，视省城的危急，如秦人之视越；
It laid the blame on Wang Lüqian, the militia commissioner stationed in Shaoxing, who had colluded with corrupt local gentry to monopolise power and regarded the provincial capital’s peril as indifferently as the people of distant Qin might regard the troubles of Yue.

更骇人听闻的是，居然唆使莠民戕害命官——
Still more shocking, he had actually incited ruffians to assault an imperial official.

九月廿四，长毛窜陷钱塘江南岸，与杭州隔水相望的萧山，
On the twenty-fourth of the ninth month, the Longhairs had overrun Xiaoshan, across the Qiantang from Hangzhou.

如兴知府廖宗元派炮船，迎头拦击；
Liao Zongyuan, prefect of Shaoxing, sent gunboats to intercept them.

寡不敌众，官军败退。
Hopelessly outnumbered, the imperial troops were forced to retreat.

王履谦和萧绍一带的百姓，平时就与官军不和，猜忌甚深；
Wang Lüqian and the people of Xiaoshan and Shaoxing had long been on bad terms with the government forces and distrusted them deeply.

这时以为炮船通敌，回来是替长毛带路，
Now they supposed the gunboats had gone over to the enemy and were returning to guide the Longhairs.

王履谦便下令包围活捉，格杀不论。
Wang ordered the boats surrounded and their crews captured, with no penalty for killing them.

廖宗元得报，知道这纵非诬陷，也是极严重的误会，
When Liao heard the report, he knew that, even if the accusation was not deliberately false, it was a grave misunderstanding.

赶紧亲自出城弹压。
He hurried outside the city in person to restore order.

暴民一声呼啸，将廖宗元从马上拉下来痛殴，王履谦袖手旁观，默赞其事。
With a roar the mob dragged him from his horse and beat him savagely, while Wang stood by, silently approving.

由这一番内讧，替敌人制造了机会；
This internal strife gave the enemy their opportunity.

长毛长驱猛扑，兵不血刃而陷绍兴。
The Longhairs swept forward and took Shaoxing without shedding a drop of blood.

长毛进城的前一天，王履谦携带家眷辎重，由绍兴逃到宁波，经海道逃到福建；
The day before they entered, Wang had fled with his family and baggage from Shaoxing to Ningbo, and thence by sea to Fujian.

而杭州的粮道，也就此断了。
Hangzhou’s supply route had thus been severed.

王有龄自然要参劾王履谦，
Naturally, Wang Youling wished to impeach him.

措词极其严厉；甚至有『臣死不瞑目』的话，
His language was exceptionally severe, even declaring, “Your servant could not close his eyes in death.”

可以想见他对王履谦怨恨入骨。
One could imagine the depth of his hatred.


『这两封血书，』古应春问道，『怎么样处置？』
“What shall I do with these two letters?” Gu asked.

『都送薛抚台——。』『好。』
“Send them both to Governor Xue—” “Very well.”

古应春不等他话完，就要起身，
Before Hu had finished, Gu was already making to rise.

『我连夜送去。』
“I shall take them tonight.”

『这倒不必。
“There is no need for that.

明天一早送去好了；
First thing tomorrow will do.

我还有话。』
I have more to say.”

『是！
“Of course.

你说。』
Tell me.”

『我要托你面见薛抚台。』
“I want you to see Governor Xue in person.”

胡雪岩虽然气弱，但低微的语声中，仍然显得很有决断∶『米，我自己想办法；
Weak though Hu was, his low voice still carried great resolution. “I shall find the rice myself.

运米的船，回头要问五哥，
As for boats to carry it, I must ask Brother Five when he comes.

能够不麻烦官府最好。
It would be best if we could manage without troubling the authorities.

不过，他要替我派兵护运。』
But the governor must detail troops to escort us.”

『这条路通吗？』
“Is there a route open?”


『有一条路好走，
“There is one way through.

你不明白；五哥知道，
You would not know it, but Brother Five does.

等他来了再说。』胡雪岩又说∶『还有几首诗，也请你送给薛抚台；
We shall discuss it when he comes.” Hu continued, “There are some poems for Governor Xue as well.

你说我因为腿伤，不能当面去见他，
Tell him that my injured leg prevents me from calling on him.

要问杭州惨状到什么样子？请他看这几首诗就知道了。』
If he wishes to know how terrible things are in Hangzhou, he need only read them.”

一面说，一面又在衣襟中摸索半天，才掏出几张极皱的纸。
Again he felt inside his coat for a long time before producing several badly crumpled sheets.

古应春摆在桌上抹平了细看，
Gu spread them on the table, smoothed them out and read carefully.

标题叫《辛酉杭城纪事诗》，作者名叫张荫榘。一共是十二首七绝；每首都有注解，
They were entitled Poems Recording Events in Hangzhou in the Xinyou Year, by Zhang Yinju: twelve quatrains of seven-character lines, each with explanatory notes.

看到第五首，古应春念道∶雍容铃阁集簪裾，九月秋清气象舒；
At the fifth, Gu read aloud: “Dignified officials gather in the commander’s hall; / The ninth month’s clear autumn breathes an air of ease.

无数妖氛惊乍逼，十门从此断军书。
/ Suddenly countless evil mists press close; / Henceforth no military dispatch passes the ten gates.”

诗下的注解是∶『九月二十六日，贼以数十万众围城，
The note beneath read: “On the twenty-sixth of the ninth month, several hundred thousand rebels surrounded the city.

十门紧闭，文报从此不通，
All ten gates were shut, and official communications ceased.

居民如笼中鸟，釜中鱼。』
The inhabitants were like birds in a cage or fish in a cauldron.”

古应春念到这里，屈指数了一下∶『今天十一月初五，
Gu counted on his fingers. “Today is the fifth of the eleventh month.

围了四十天了。』
They have been under siege for forty days.”

『四十天不算多，无奈缺粮已久；
“Forty days is not so long, but the shortage of food began much earlier.

围到第十天就人心大乱了。』胡雪岩叹口气说∶『你再看下去。』
By the tenth day of the siege, the people were already in a panic.” Hu sighed. “Read on.”

接下去看，写的是∶十面城门十面围，大臣谁是识兵机？
Next came: “Ten city gates besieged on every side; / Which minister understands the art of war?

国人望岁君胡胄，
/ Your people await you like the harvest—why the helmet, lord?

传说张巡整队师。
/ Word comes that Zhang Xun is marshalling his men.”


注是∶『十月初六日，张军门玉良援到，大获胜仗；
The note explained: “On the sixth of the tenth month, General Zhang Yuliang arrived to relieve the city and won a great victory.

即派况副将文榜于下午入城见王中丞有龄，请城内连夜移兵出扎，
That afternoon he sent Deputy Commander Kuang Wenbang inside to see Governor Wang Youling, requesting that troops move out during the night and establish a camp outside.

便可与张军门联络，以通粮道。
They could then link up with General Zhang and open a route for provisions.

饶军门从旁阻之云∶』明日总来得及。
General Rao, who was present, opposed the proposal, saying, ‘There will still be time tomorrow.’

「不料伪逆李秀成连夜筑成木城，于是饷道与张营隔绝。
Unexpectedly, the rebel Li Xiucheng erected a wooden fortification during the night, cutting off the supply route from Zhang’s camp.

而十城隔濠，亦遍筑土城。
Earthen works were also built across the moat all around the city’s ten gates.

当张军门令况副将入城见中丞，以灭贼自任，百姓延颈觇伺，均言贼必扑灭。
When General Zhang sent Deputy Commander Kuang to see the governor and pledged to destroy the rebels, the people had craned their necks in eager expectation, all declaring that the enemy would surely be crushed.”

『看完这首诗和原注，古应春问道∶』饶军门是谁？
After reading the poem and its original note, Gu asked, “Who is General Rao?”

『』饶廷选。
“Rao Tingxuan.

这个人因为救过广信府，靠沈夫人出了大名，
He became famous through Madam Shen when he relieved Guangxin Prefecture.

其实没用。『胡雪岩叹口气说∶』我劝过王雪公多少次，说他因人成事，自己胆子小得很。
In truth, he is useless.” Hu sighed. “How many times have I told Governor Wang that Rao’s achievements depended on others, and that the man himself is a coward!

王雪公不听我的话。
Governor Wang would not listen.

救杭州就靠这个机会；
That was the one chance of saving Hangzhou.

错过这个机会，神仙来都没救了。
Once it was lost, not even an immortal could save the place.”

『』张玉良呢？『古应春又问，』
“And Zhang Yuliang?” Gu asked.

这个人大家都说他不行，
“Everyone says he is no good.

到底怎么样？
What is the truth about him?”

『『你再往下看。
“Read on.

下面有交代。』
The next poem explains.”


诗中是这样交代∶桓侯勇健世无双，飞炮当前岂肯降？
The poem explained it thus: “Marquis Huan, unrivalled in courage and strength, / Would never yield before the flying cannon shot.

万马不嘶军尽泣，将星如斗落长江。
/ Ten thousand horses silent, the whole army weeps; / A commander’s star, huge as a grain measure, falls into the Yangtze.”

『怎么？
“What?

阵亡了？』
Was he killed?”

『阵亡了。』
“Killed in battle.”

胡雪岩摇摇头，
Hu shook his head.

『这个人也耽误了大事，
“He too did enormous harm through his failures.

嘉兴一败，金华兰溪又守不住，杭州就危险了。
After his defeat at Jiaxing, he could not hold Jinhua or Lanxi either, and Hangzhou was placed in danger.

不过，总算亏他。』
Still, we owed something to him in the end.”

『诗里拿他比做张飞，
“The poem compares him to Zhang Fei.

说得他很好。』
It praises him highly.”

『他是阵亡殉国的，
“He died fighting for his country.

自然要说得他好。』
Naturally they must speak well of him.”

胡雪岩黯然说道∶『我劝王雪公暂且避一避。
Hu’s face darkened. “I urged Governor Wang to withdraw for a while.

好比推牌九摇摊一样，这一庄手气不顺；歇一歇手，重新来过。
It is like banking at pai gow or playing the dice-shaking game: if luck runs against you, stop for a spell and begin again.

王雪公不肯，
But he refused.

他说他当初劝何根云，守土有责，决不可轻离常州；
He said that he had once told He Genyun that an official was bound to defend the territory entrusted to him and must on no account abandon Changzhou lightly.

现在自己倒言行不符；怎么交代得过去？
If he now acted contrary to his own words, how could he justify himself?”

『『看起来王雪公倒是忠臣。』
“It seems Governor Wang is a loyal servant of the throne after all.”


『忠臣？』
“A loyal servant?”

胡雪岩冷笑∶『忠臣几个钱一斤？
Hu gave a bitter laugh. “How many coins a catty are loyal servants worth?

我看他——。』语声哽咽欲绝。
I think he—” His voice choked and nearly failed.

古应春从未听胡雪岩说过什么愤激的话，
Gu had never heard him speak with such angry bitterness.

而居然将『忠臣』说得一文不值，可以想见他内心的沉痛悲愤。
That he should now dismiss loyalty as utterly worthless revealed the pain and indignation within him.

只是苦于没有话可以安慰他。
Yet Gu could think of nothing to offer him in comfort.

『先吃饭吧！』七姑奶奶说，
“Let us eat first,” the Seventh Lady said.

『天大的事，总也得吃饱了才好打主意。
“However great the trouble, we must fill our stomachs before we can think what to do.

而且小爷叔真的也饿了。』
And Little Uncle really is hungry.”

『提到杭州，我哪里还吃得下饭？』
“How can I eat when we are talking of Hangzhou?”

胡雪岩泪汪汪地抬眼，
Hu looked up, his eyes full of tears.

『你看最后那两首诗。』
“Read the last two poems.”

古应春细细看了下，颜色大变；
Gu read them closely and his face changed.

七姑奶奶不免奇怪，
The Seventh Lady could not understand it.

『怎么了？』她问，
“What is it?” she asked.

『说什么？』
“What do they say?”

『你听我念！』
“Listen.”

古应春一个字一个字地念。
He read aloud, pronouncing every word distinctly.


剜肉人来非补疮，饥民争啖事堪伤；
“Men come to carve flesh, not to heal a wound; / The starving vie to eat it—grief beyond words.

一腔热血三升血，强作龙肝凤脯尝。
/ A breastful of hot blood, three measures of blood, / Forced down as though it were dragon’s liver or phoenix breast.”

『什么？』七姑奶奶大惊问道『人吃人？』
“What?” the Seventh Lady cried in horror. “People eating people?”

古应春不即回答，一个字一个字地念着注解∶『兵勇肆掠，
Gu did not answer at once, but read out the note word by word. “Soldiers pillaged at will.

居民鸣锣捕获，解送凤山门王中丞常驻之处。
The inhabitants sounded gongs, seized them and brought them to Fengshan Gate, where Governor Wang was usually stationed.

中丞询实，请王命尽斩之；
The governor established the facts and, invoking the emperor’s authority, had them all beheaded.

尸积道旁，
Their bodies lay heaped by the roadside.

兵士争取心肝下酒，饥民亦争脔食之。
Soldiers fought for their hearts and livers to eat with wine, and starving civilians likewise competed for morsels of their flesh.

「食人肉」，平日见诸史乘者，至此身亲见之。』
‘Eating human flesh’, something formerly encountered only in histories, I now witnessed with my own eyes.”

就这一段话，将厅前厅后的人，听得一个个面无人色，
Everyone within hearing, before the hall and behind it, turned pale.

七姑奶奶连摇摇头∶『世界变了！
The Seventh Lady shook her head again and again. “The world has changed!

有这样的事！』
That such things should happen!”

『我也不大相信。
“I can scarcely believe it myself,” Gu said.

小爷叔真有其事？』
“Little Uncle, is it really true?”

『不但真有其事，简直叫无足为奇。』
“Not only true; there is scarcely anything surprising in it.”

胡雪岩容颜惨淡地喘着气说∶『人饿极了，什么东西都会吃。』
Hu’s face was bleak as he struggled for breath. “People will eat anything when they are starving.”

他接下来，便讲杭州绝粮的情形——
He went on to describe the famine in Hangzhou.

这年浙西大熟，但正当收割之际，长毛如潮水般涌到；
Western Zhejiang had enjoyed a bumper harvest that year, but just as the crop was being gathered, the Longhairs had swept in like a tide.

官军节节败退，现成的稻谷，反而资敌，得以作长围久困之计。
The imperial troops retreated at every turn, and the grain ready for harvesting supplied the enemy instead, enabling them to maintain a long blockade.

否则，数十万长毛无以支持；杭州之围也就不解而自解了。
Otherwise their hundreds of thousands of men could not have sustained themselves, and Hangzhou’s siege would have collapsed of its own accord.


杭州城里的小康之家，自然有些存粮；升斗小民，却立刻就感到了威胁，
The comfortably off households in Hangzhou naturally held some grain in reserve, but people who lived from one small measure of rice to the next felt the danger immediately.

米店在闭城之前，就已歇业。
The rice shops had closed even before the gates were shut.

于是胡雪岩发起开办施粥厂，上中下三城共设四十七处，
Hu therefore took the lead in establishing soup kitchens: forty-seven throughout the upper, middle and lower divisions of the city.

每日辰、申两次，每次煮米一石，
They served twice daily, in the morning and late afternoon, cooking one shi of rice at each serving.

粥少人多，
There was too little congee and too great a crowd.

老羽妇孺挤不到前面，有去了三、四次空手而回的。
The old and infirm, women and children could not force their way to the front; some went three or four times and came away empty-handed.

没有多久，粥厂就不能不关闭。
Before long, the kitchens had to close.

但官米还在计口平卖，
Government grain was still sold at controlled prices in quantities allotted by household size.

米卖完了卖豆子，豆卖完了卖麦子。
When the rice was gone, they sold beans; when the beans were gone, wheat.

有钱的人家，另有买米的地方，是拿黄金跟鸦片向旗营的八旗兵私下交换军粮。
The rich had another source of rice: they secretly exchanged gold and opium with the Eight Banner troops for their military rations.

又不久，米麦杂粮都吃得光光，便吃药材南货，
Soon the rice, wheat and other grains were all exhausted, and people turned to medicinal roots and dried provisions.

熟地、米仁、黄精，都可以代饭；
Prepared rehmannia, Job’s tears and Solomon’s seal could all serve in place of meals.

枣栗之类，视如珍品，而海参，鱼翅等等席上之珍，反倒是穷人的食料。
Dates and chestnuts became treasures, while sea cucumbers, shark’s fins and other delicacies of the banquet table became the food of the poor.


再后来就是吃糠、吃皮箱、吃钉鞋——钉鞋是牛皮做的；吃浮萍，吃草根树皮。
After that they ate bran, leather trunks and hobnailed shoes—the shoes were made of oxhide—then duckweed, grass roots and tree bark.

杭州人好佛，有钱人家的老太太，最喜欢『放生』；
The people of Hangzhou were devoted to Buddhism, and old ladies of wealthy families particularly loved to purchase animals and spare their lives.

有处地方叫小云楼，专养放生的牛羊猪鸭，
At a place called Little Cloud Tower, cattle, sheep, pigs and ducks were kept for this purpose.

自然一扫而空了。
Naturally, they were all swept away.

『杭州城里的人，不是人，
“The people in Hangzhou are no longer people.

是鬼；一个个骨头瘦得成了一把，
They are ghosts, every one of them a bundle of bones.

望过去脸上三个洞，两个洞是眼睛，一个洞是嘴巴。
Look at a face and you see three holes: two for the eyes and one for the mouth.

走在路上，好比「风吹鸭蛋壳」，飘飘荡荡，站不住脚。』
In the streets they are like empty eggshells blown by the wind, swaying and drifting, unable to keep their feet.”

胡雪岩喘口气，很吃力地说∶『好比两个人在路上遇着，有气无力在谈话；
Hu paused for breath, then continued with great effort. “Two people might meet in the road and talk, both too weak to raise their voices.

说着，说着，有一个就会无缘无故倒了下去。
As they speak, one suddenly falls down for no apparent reason.

另一个要去扶他；
The other tries to help him.

不扶还好，一扶头昏眼花，自己也一跟头栽了下去，爬不起来了。
It would be better if he did not: the moment he bends to lift him, his own head swims, his eyes blur, and down he goes too, unable to rise.

象这样子的，「倒路尸」，不晓得有多少？
Who can count the bodies left in the roads like that?

幸亏是冬天，
It is fortunate that this is winter.

如果是夏天，老早就生瘟疫了。』
In summer, plague would have broken out long ago.”

『那末，』七姑奶奶急急问道∶『府上呢？』
“Then what of your own family?” the Seventh Lady asked urgently.


『生死不明。』
“I do not know whether they are alive or dead.”

胡雪岩垂泪说道∶『早在八月里，我老娘说是避到乡下好；
Tears fell as Hu spoke. “Back in the eighth month, my mother thought we would be safer taking refuge in the country.

全家大小送到北高峰下的上天竺，
I sent the whole household, young and old, to Upper Tianzhu below the Northern Peak.

城一关，就此消息不知。』
Once the city gates shut, all news of them ceased.”

『一定不要紧的。』七姑奶奶说，
“They will be all right,” the Seventh Lady said.

『府上是积善之家，
“Yours is a family that has accumulated merit.

老太太又喜欢行善做好事，
Your mother is always doing good and helping people.

吉人天相，
Heaven protects the virtuous.

一定平安无事。』
They will certainly be safe.”

『唉！』古应春叹口气，
“Ah!” Gu sighed.

『浩劫！』
“What a catastrophe!”

这时已经钟打八点，
By now the clock was striking eight.

一串大蟹，蒸而又冷，但得知素称佛地的杭州，竟有人吃人的惨状，上上下下，谁都吃不下饭。
The great crabs had been steamed and had grown cold, but after learning that Hangzhou, so often called a Buddhist sanctuary, had been reduced to the horror of people eating one another, no one in the household could swallow a meal.

七姑奶奶做主人的，自不能不劝；但草草终席，塞责而已。
