As hostess, the Seventh Lady was obliged to urge them to eat; they merely went through the motions and soon left the table.

吃饱了的，只有一个闻信赶来的尤五，
The only man who had eaten his fill was You Wu, who arrived after hearing the news.

吃他徒弟的喜酒，自然奉为上宾；
At his pupil’s wedding feast he had naturally been treated as an honoured guest.

席间听得胡雪岩已到的消息，急于脱身，但仍旧被灌了好些酒，方得离席。
When he learnt that Hu had come, he was eager to leave, but still had to drink a good deal more before he could get away.

此时一见之下，酒意去了七八分，
Now the sight of Hu drove most of the wine from his head.

只望着胡雪岩发愣。
He could only stare.


『小爷叔，怎么弄成这个样子？』
“Little Uncle, how have you come to this?”

『五哥，你不要问他了。
“Brother Five, do not ask him about it.

真正人间地狱，九死一生，
It was truly hell on earth; he escaped by the narrowest margin.

现在商量正事吧！』
Let us discuss what must be done.”

『请到里头来。』七姑奶奶说，
“Please come inside,” the Seventh Lady said.

『我替小爷铺排好了。』
“I have everything ready for Little Uncle.”

她将胡雪岩的卧室安排在古应春书斋旁边的一间小屋；
She had prepared a small room beside Gu’s study as Hu’s bedroom.

裱糊得雪白的窗子，生着极大的火盆，一张西洋铜床铺得极厚的被褥。
The windows were papered a spotless white, a great brazier was burning, and a Western brass bed had been furnished with thick quilts and bedding.

同时又预备了『独参汤』和滋养而易于消化的食物；让他一面吃、一面谈。
She had also prepared a decoction of ginseng alone, together with nourishing, easily digested food, so that he could eat while they talked.


实际上是由古应春替他发言，
In fact it was Gu who spoke for him.

『五哥，』他说，『杭州的百姓都要活活饿死了，
“Brother Five, the people of Hangzhou are starving to death.

小爷叔是受王抚台的重托，到上海来办米的；
Governor Wang has entrusted Little Uncle with the task of buying rice in Shanghai.

越多越好，越快越好。』
The more the better, and the sooner the better.”

『浙江藩库发了两万银子；现银没法带，我是空手来的。』胡雪岩说，『我钱庄里也不知道怎么样？
“The Zhejiang provincial treasury allocated twenty thousand taels,” Hu said. “But I could not bring silver with me. I have come empty-handed, and I do not know what has happened to my bank either.

五哥，这笔帐只好以后再算了。』
Brother Five, this account will have to be settled later.”

『钱小事，』古应春接口说道，
“Money is a small matter,” Gu put in.

『我垫。』
“I shall advance it.”

『也用不着你垫，』尤五接口说道，
“There is no need even for that,” You replied.

『通裕庄一千石米在仓里；
“Tongyu has a thousand shi of rice in its warehouse.

另外随时可以弄一千石，
I can get another thousand at any time.

如果不够；再想办法。
If that is not enough, we shall find more.

米总好办，
The rice itself is easy enough.

就是怎么样运法？』
The question is how to transport it.”



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第一章（本章第3部分，共6部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


『运河不通了，
“The Grand Canal is blocked.

嘉兴这一关就过不去。』胡雪岩说，
We cannot get past Jiaxing,” Hu Xueyan said.

『只有一条路，走海道经鳖子门。』
“There is only one route left: by sea, through Biezimen.”

鳖子门在海宁，是钱塘江入海之处、在明朝是杭州防备倭患的第一门户。
Biezimen lay in Haining, at the mouth of the Qiantang River; in the Ming dynasty it had been Hangzhou’s first line of defense against Japanese pirates.

尤五对运河相当熟悉，海道却陌生得很，
Brother You knew the canal well, but the sea routes were another matter.

便老实说道∶『这我就搞不清楚了。
“That is beyond me,” he admitted frankly.

要寻沙船帮想办法。』
“We shall have to find the Sea-Junk Guild and ask them to work something out.”


沙船帮走海道，
The Sea-Junk Guild operated along the coast.

从漕米海运之议一起，漕帮跟沙船帮就有势不两立的模样。
Ever since the proposal to ship the tribute grain by sea, relations between it and the Grain-Boat Guild had verged on open hostility.

现在要请他跟沙船帮去打交道，未免强人所难；
Asking Brother You to approach its members now was asking a great deal.

胡雪岩喝着参汤，还在肚子里盘算，应该如何进行，古应春却先开口了。
Hu drank his ginseng broth, still turning over in his mind how best to proceed, but Gu Yingchun spoke first.

『沙船帮的郁老大，我也有一面之识；
“I have met Chief Yu of the Sea-Junk Guild once.

事到如今，也说不得冒昧了。
Things have come to such a pass that I cannot stand on ceremony.

我去！』
I shall go!”

说着，就站起身来；尤五将他一拉，
He rose as he spoke, but Brother You caught his arm.

慢条斯理地说∶『不要忙，
“No hurry,” he said deliberately.

等我想一想。』
“Let me think.”


胡雪岩依然非常机敏，
Hu’s wits were as quick as ever.

看出尤五的意思，便挣扎着起身；
Seeing what Brother You had in mind, he struggled to rise.

七姑奶奶紧赶一面扶，
The Seventh Lady hurried to support him.

一面问∶『小爷叔，你要啥？』
“What do you want, Little Uncle?”

胡雪岩不答她的话，
He did not answer.

站起身，叫一声∶『五哥！』便跪了下去。
Getting to his feet, he cried, “Brother Five!” and dropped to his knees.

尤五大惊，一跳老远，
Brother You recoiled in alarm and sprang well out of his way.

大声说道∶『小爷叔、
“Little Uncle!

小爷叔，
Little Uncle!

你这是为啥？
What are you doing?

折熬我了。』
You do me far too much honor!”


古应春夫妇，双双将他扶了起来，
Gu and his wife helped him up together.

七姑奶奶要开口，他摇摇手说∶『我是为杭州的百姓求五哥！』
The Seventh Lady was about to speak, but Hu waved her into silence. “I am begging Brother Five on behalf of the people of Hangzhou!”

『小爷叔，你何必如此？』
“Little Uncle, why must you do this?”

尤五只好说痛快话了∶『只要你说一句，
Brother You had no choice but to speak plainly. “You have only to say the word.

哪怕郁老大跟我是解不开的对头，我也只好去跟他说好话。』
Even if Chief Yu were my bitterest enemy, with no hope of a reconciliation, I should still have to go and ask him nicely.”

他跟郁老大确是解不开的对头——
In fact, Chief Yu was just such an enemy.

郁老大叫郁馥华，家住小南门内的乔家滨，
His name was Yu Fuhua, and he lived at Qiaojiabin, inside the Little South Gate.

以航行南北洋起家，发了好大一笔财。
Coastal shipping had made him a considerable fortune.

本来一个走海道，一个走运河，真所谓『河水不犯井水』；并无恩怨可言，
Originally, one man worked the sea routes and the other the canal: river water and well water never crossed, as the saying went, and there had been no cause for either friendship or enmity.

但从南漕海运以后，情形就很不同了。
The transfer of the southern tribute grain to sea transport had changed everything.

尤五倒还明事理，大势所趋，不得不然，
Brother You himself was reasonable enough to recognize an inevitable development.

并非郁馥华有意想承揽这笔生意，打碎漕帮的饭碗；
Yu Fuhua had not deliberately sought the contract in order to take the Grain-Boat Guild’s livelihood away.

但他手下的小弟兄，却不是这么想。
His younger followers, however, saw it differently.

加以沙船帮的水手，趾高气扬；茶坊酒肆，出手阔绰，
To make matters worse, the sea-junk sailors strutted about, spending lavishly in teahouses and taverns.

漕帮弟兄相形出绌，越发妒恨交加，常起摩擦。
The grain-boat men looked poor beside them; jealousy bred resentment, and clashes were frequent.


有一次两帮群殴，说起来，道理是漕帮这面欠缺。
On one occasion the two guilds fought a pitched brawl, and in fairness the grain-boat men were more at fault.

但江湖事，江湖了；
Even so, disputes among men of their world ought to have been settled within it.

郁馥华听信了江苏海运局中几个候补佐杂的话，将尤五手下的几个弟兄，扭到了上海县衙门。
Instead, Yu Fuhua listened to several minor expectant officials at the Jiangsu Maritime Grain Transport Bureau and had some of Brother You’s men hauled before the Shanghai county magistrate.

知县刘郇膏是江苏的能员，
Liu Xungao was one of Jiangsu’s capable officials.

也知道松江漕帮是『百足之虫，死而不僵』，不愿多事；
He also knew that the Songjiang Grain-Boat Guild was like a hundred-legged insect that went on wriggling even after death, and he had no wish to stir up trouble.

同时古应春在上海县衙门也算是吃得开的，受尤五之托，去说人情。
Gu Yingchun, meanwhile, had some influence at the county yamen and, at Brother You’s request, went to intercede.

两下一凑，刘郇膏大事化小，小事化无；
These considerations together led Liu to turn a major affair into a minor one and the minor one into nothing at all.

传了尤五到堂，当面告诫一番，叫他具了『不再滋事』的切结，
He summoned Brother You, admonished him in open court, and required a written pledge that there would be no further disturbances.

将人领了回去。
Then he allowed him to take his men away.


这一下结怨就深了。
This only deepened the grudge.

在尤五想，连县大老爷都知道松江漕帮不好惹，网开一面；
As Brother You saw it, even the county magistrate knew better than to provoke the Songjiang guild and had left an opening for mercy.

郁馥华反倒不讲江湖义气，
Yu Fuhua, by contrast, had shown none of the loyalty their way of life demanded.

不想想大家都是『靠水吃水』，一条线上的人。
Had he forgotten that they all lived by the water and belonged to the same fraternity?

既然如此，两不往返；
Very well, then: there would be no further dealings between them.

尤五特地召集所属码头的头脑，郑重宣布∶凡是沙船帮的一切，松江漕帮，不准参预。
Brother You summoned the heads of the wharves under his authority and formally announced that the Songjiang Grain-Boat Guild was to take no part in anything connected with the Sea-Junk Guild.

有跳槽改行到沙船帮去做水手的，就算『破门』，从今见面不认。
Any man who changed allegiance and became a sailor on a sea junk would be considered expelled; thereafter, even if they met, he would no longer be acknowledged.

郁馥华自己也知道做错了一件事，深感不安；
Yu Fuhua knew that he had made a mistake and was deeply uneasy about it.

几次托人向尤五致意，希望修好。
Several times he sent intermediaries to express his goodwill and seek a reconciliation.

尤五置之不理，
Brother You ignored them.

如今却不得不违反自己的告诫，要向对方去低头了。
Now he would have to break his own rule and bow to the other man.


『为小爷叔的事，三刀六洞，我也咬一咬牙「顶」了；
“For you, Little Uncle, I would grit my teeth and take three knife thrusts clean through me.

不过这两年，我的旗号扯得忒足，一时无法落篷。
But these past two years I have flown my colors so high that I cannot bring myself to lower the sail all at once.

难就难在这里。』
That is the difficulty.”

『五哥，你是为杭州的百姓。』胡雪岩说，
“Brother Five, you would be doing it for the people of Hangzhou,” Hu said.

『我腿伤了，没办法跟郁老大去办交涉——
“With my leg injured, I cannot go and negotiate with Chief Yu myself.

话说回来了，出海进鳖子门这一段，不要紧；一进鳖子门，反有风险，
Besides, the sea passage to Biezimen is safe enough; the danger begins once we are through it.

郁老大作兴不肯点头只有你去托他，他要卖你一个交情，不肯也得肯。
Chief Yu may well refuse. Only if you ask him will he feel bound to do you a favor and agree, however unwillingly.

至于你说旗号扯得太足，落不下篷，这也是实话；
As for your having flown your colors so high that you cannot lower the sail, that is true too.

我倒有个办法，能够让你落篷，不但落篷，还让你有面子，
But I have thought of a way to let you lower it—and save face into the bargain.

你看怎么样？』
What do you say?”

『小爷叔，你不要问我，
“There is no need to ask me, Little Uncle.

你说怎么样，就怎么样。
Whatever you say goes.

其实我也是说说而已；
I was only talking, after all.

真的没有办法也只好硬着头发去见郁老大。』
If there were no other way, I should have to swallow my pride and see Chief Yu just the same.”

『不会让你太受委屈。』
“We shall not make you swallow too much.”

胡雪岩转脸说道∶『老古，我请你写封信；写给何制台——。』『写给何制台？』古应春说，
Hu turned to Gu. “Old Gu, I should like you to write a letter for me—to Governor-General He—” “To Governor-General He?” Gu repeated.

『他现在不知道躲在哪里？』
“Who knows where he is hiding now?”

『这难道打听不到？』
“Surely we can find out?”


『打听是一定打听得到的。』尤五接口说道，
“We certainly can,” Brother You put in.

『他虽然革了职，要查办，到底是做过制台的人，
“He may have been dismissed and be facing an investigation, but he was a governor-general, after all.

不会没人晓得。
Someone must know where he is.

不过，小爷叔，江苏的公事，他已经管不到了，
But, Little Uncle, he no longer has any say in Jiangsu’s affairs.

你写信给他为啥？』
Why write to him?”

『江苏的公事他虽管不到，老长官的帐，人家还是要卖的。』胡雪岩说，
“He has no authority now, but people will still show their former superior some respect,” Hu replied.

『我想请他交代薛抚台或者上海道，让他们出来替五哥跟郁老大拉拉场。』
“I want him to speak to Governor Xue or the Shanghai circuit intendant and have one of them mediate between you and Chief Yu.”

『不必，不必！』
“No, no!”

尤五乱摇双手，
Brother You waved both hands.

『现任的官儿，我跟他们身分不配；
“I am no match in status for an official in office.

这种应酬，场面上尴尬得很，
Such occasions are terribly awkward.

多一事不如少一事。』
Better to avoid an unnecessary complication.”

古应春倒觉得胡雪岩的话，大有道理，
Gu, however, thought Hu’s suggestion very sensible.

便道∶『冤家宜解不宜结，
“Better to settle a feud than to prolong it.

如有地方大员出面调停，双方都有面子，
If a senior local official mediates, both sides will save face.

应该顺势收篷了。』
You ought to take the opportunity to lower your sail.”

『这还在其次，』他接下来讲第二个理由∶『为了小爷叔的公事，郁老大的沙船是无论如何少不了的；
There was another reason too. “And that is only part of it. For Little Uncle’s mission, Chief Yu’s junks are indispensable.

不过风险太大，就算卖五哥你的面子，欠他的这个情，将来很难补报。
But the risk is so great that, even if he agrees out of regard for you, it will be hard to repay the favor.

有官府出面，一半就等于抓差；
If the authorities intervene, it will be half an official requisition.

五哥，你的人情债不就可以轻得好多？』
That would make your debt of gratitude much lighter, would it not, Brother Five?”

『老古的话，一点不错。』胡雪岩连连点头，
Hu nodded repeatedly. “Exactly, Old Gu.

『我正是这个意思。』
That was precisely what I meant.”


既然他们都这样说，尤五自然同意。
With both of them taking this view, Brother You naturally agreed.

于是胡雪岩口述大意，古应春代为执笔，写好了给何桂清的信；
Hu dictated the substance of the letter, and Gu wrote it out for He Guiqing.

约定第二天一早分头奔走，中午都得办妥。
They arranged to go their separate ways early the next morning and have everything settled by noon.

至于运米的细节，要等尤五跟郁馥华言归于好以后才谈得到。
The details of transporting the rice would have to wait until Brother You and Yu Fuhua had made their peace.


安顿好了两拨客人，七姑奶奶上床已交半夜子时了；
By the time the Seventh Lady had settled both sets of guests and gone to bed, it was already midnight.

向丈夫问好胡雪岩的公事，
She asked her husband about Hu’s mission.

听说其中有写信给何桂清的这一段周折，当时就『跳』了起来。
When she heard of the elaborate plan to write to He Guiqing, she fairly leaped up.

『这是什么时候？还容得你们「城头上出棺材，大兜大转」！
“At a time like this, can you still afford to carry the coffin round the city wall—taking every possible detour?

且不说杭州城里的老百姓，都快饿死光了；
Never mind that the people inside Hangzhou are nearly all starving to death.

光是看小爷叔这副样子来讨救兵，就该连夜办事。』
One look at Little Uncle, coming in that condition to beg for help, ought to have set you working through the night!”

她气鼓鼓地说，
She was positively bristling.

『真正是，
“Honestly!

看你们男子汉，大丈夫，做事怎么这样子娘娘腔？』古应春笑了，
You call yourselves grown men, and yet you go about things like a pack of dithering women!” Gu laughed.

『你不要跟我跳脚，
“Do not stamp your feet at me.

你去问你哥哥！』
Ask your brother!

他说∶『不是我劝，五哥跟郁老大的过节还不肯解呢！』
If I had not persuaded him, Brother Five would not even have agreed to settle his quarrel with Chief Yu.”

『等我去！』七姑奶奶毫不迟疑地，
“I shall go!” she declared without a moment’s hesitation.

『等我去跟五哥说。』
“I shall go and speak to Brother Five.”

不用她去，
She had no need to.

尤五恰好还有私话要跟妹夫来说；一开门就遇见，
Brother You happened to have something private to discuss with his brother-in-law, and she met him as she opened the door.

见她满脸不悦的样子，不由得诧异。
Her angry expression astonished him.

『怎么？
“What is it?

跟哪个生气？』
Who has upset you?”


古应春一听这话，赶紧拦阻∶『七姐，你跟五哥好说。
At this, Gu hastened to intervene. “Seventh Sister, speak gently to Brother Five.

五哥有五哥的难处，
He has difficulties of his own.

只要你讲得有道理，五哥会听的。』
If you put your case reasonably, he will listen.”

『好，我就讲道理。
“Very well, I shall be reasonable.

五哥，你进来坐，
Come in and sit down, Brother Five.

我请问你一句话，是小爷叔的交情要紧？还是什么制台、抚台的面子要紧？』
Let me ask you one thing: which matters more, your friendship with Little Uncle or the prestige of some governor or governor-general?”

『你问这话啥意思？』
“What do you mean by asking that?”

『自然有讲究。
“I have my reasons.

你先回了我的话，我再讲缘故给你听。』
Answer me first, and I shall explain.”

『当然小爷叔的交情要紧。』
“Of course my friendship with Little Uncle matters more.”

『好！』
“Good!”

七姑奶奶脸色缓和下来了，
Her expression softened.

『我再问一问，
“Now let me ask you something else.

杭州一城百姓的命，跟我们漕帮与郁老大的过节，五哥，你倒放在天平上称一称，
Put the lives of the whole population of Hangzhou on one side of a scale and our guild’s quarrel with Chief Yu on the other.

哪一方来得重？』
Which weighs more, Brother Five?”


尤五哑然，被驳得无话可说。
Brother You was silenced; he had no answer to that.

古应春又高兴，又有些不安；
Gu was delighted, but also a little uneasy.

因为虽是娘舅至亲，到底要保持一分客气，有些话不便率直而言，
Close as he was to his wife’s brother, courtesy still imposed a certain reserve, and there were things he could not say outright.

现在有了『女张飞』这番快人快语，足以折服尤五，
Now this female Zhang Fei, with her fearless plain speaking, had said enough to convince Brother You.

但又怕她妻子得理不让人，再说下去会使得尤五起反感，
Yet Gu feared that, having proved her point, she might refuse to leave it there and provoke resentment by pressing too hard.

希望她适可而止。
He hoped she would know when to stop.

七姑奶奶长了几岁，又有了孩子，自然亦非昔比；
The Seventh Lady had grown a few years older and had a child now; she was naturally no longer quite the woman she had been.

此时声音放得平静了∶『依我说，小爷叔是想替你挣面子，其实主意不大高明。』
Her voice grew calm. “As I see it, Little Uncle wants to help you save face, but his plan is not a very good one.”

『这样说，你必有高明主意？』
“Then you must have a better plan?”

古应春点她一句∶倒不妨慢慢说给五哥听一听，看看行不行得通？『
Gu prompted her. “Why not explain it calmly to Brother Five and see whether it will work?”


『要做官的出来拉场，就有点吃罚酒的味道，不吃不行——。』『对！』
“If you bring officials in to mediate, there is something of a punishment cup about it: you have to swallow it, whether you like it or not—” “Exactly!”

尤五一拍大腿，大为称赏，
Brother You slapped his thigh in hearty approval.

『阿七这话说到我心里了，
“A’qi has put her finger on it.

小爷叔那里我不好驳，实实在在是有点这样的味道。』
I could hardly contradict Little Uncle, but that is precisely how it feels.”

『江湖事，江湖了。』七姑奶奶又有些慷慨激昂了，
“Let men of our own world settle their own affairs,” the Seventh Lady continued, warming to her subject again.

『五哥，你明天去看郁老大，
“Go and see Chief Yu tomorrow, Brother Five.

只说为了杭州一城百姓的性命，小爷叔的交情，向他低头，请他帮忙。
Tell him plainly that, for the sake of every life in Hangzhou and your friendship with Little Uncle, you have come to bow your head and ask for help.

这话传出去，哪个不说你大仁大义？』
When word of that gets about, who will fail to praise your humanity and generosity?”


尤五凝神想了一下，倏然起身，一句话不说就走了——
Brother You considered this intently, then rose abruptly and left without a word.

他要跟妹夫说的私话，就是觉得不必惊动官府，看看另外有更好的办法没有？
The private matter he had meant to discuss with his brother-in-law was his feeling that they need not involve the authorities: could they not find a better way?

这话，现在也就不必再说了。
There was no longer any need to ask.


一到小南门内乔家滨，老远就看到郁家的房子，
As soon as he reached Qiaojiabin, inside the Little South Gate, he could see the Yu residence from a considerable distance.

既新且大。
It was both new and large.

郁馥华的这所新居，落成不久，就有小刀会起事，为刘丽川头尾盘踞了三年；
Soon after Yu Fuhua had completed it, the Small Swords Society had risen in revolt, and Liu Lichuan had occupied the house for a period extending over three calendar years.

咸丰五年大年初一，江苏巡抚吉尔杭阿由法国海军提督辣尼尔帮忙，克复了上海县城，
On New Year’s Day in the fifth year of Xianfeng’s reign, Jiangsu’s governor, Jirhangga, had recaptured the walled city of Shanghai with the help of the French admiral Lani’er.

郁馥华收复故居，大事修葺，比以前更加华丽了。
Yu recovered his home and had it extensively refurbished, making it even more splendid than before.


尤五还是第一次到郁家来，
This was Brother You’s first visit to the Yu house.

轻车简从，无人识得；
He had come without pomp and with few attendants, and no one recognized him.

他向来不备名帖，只指一指鼻子说∶『我姓尤，
He never carried a visiting card; he merely pointed to himself and said, “My name is You.

松江来的。』
I am from Songjiang.”

尤五生得劲气内敛，外貌不扬，衣饰亦朴素得很；
His strength lay hidden beneath an unimposing exterior, and his clothes were very plain.

郁家的下人不免轻视，当他是来告帮求职的，
The servants looked down on him, assuming that he had come to beg assistance or seek employment.

便淡淡地说了句∶『我们老爷不在家，
“Our master is out,” one said indifferently.

你明天再来。』
“Come back tomorrow.”

『不，我有极要紧的事，
“No, I have something extremely urgent to discuss.

非见你家老爷不可。
I must see him.

请派人去找一找，
Please send someone to find him.

我就在这里立等。』
I shall wait here.”

『到哪里去找？』
“And where are we supposed to look?”

郁家的下人声音不好听了。
The servant’s tone had become unpleasant.


尤五是极有涵养的人，
Brother You had great self-control.

而且此来既然已下了降志以求的决心，亦就容易接受委屈，
Having already resolved to humble himself in pursuit of his purpose, he found it easier to put up with a slight.

便用商量的语气说道∶『既然如此，你们这里现成的条凳，
“In that case,” he said reasonably, “you have benches here already.

让我坐等，可以不可以？』
Might I sit down and wait?”

郁家门洞里置两条一丈多长的条凳，原是供来客随带的跟班和轿夫歇脚用的，
In the entrance passage stood two benches, each more than a zhang long, provided for visiting servants and sedan-chair bearers to rest their feet.

尤五要坐，有何不可？
If he wished to sit there, why should he not?

尽管请便就是。
He was welcome to do so.

这一坐坐了个把时辰，只见来了一辆极漂亮的马车，
He had sat there for the better part of a two-hour watch when a handsome carriage arrived.

跨辕的俊仆，跳下车来，将一张踏脚凳放在车门口，
A smartly dressed servant riding on the shaft jumped down and placed a step beneath the carriage door.

车厢里随即出来一名华服少年，昂然入门。
A young man in rich clothes emerged and strode proudly inside.


这个华服少年是郁馥华的大儿子郁松年，人称『郁家秀才』——郁馥华虽发了大财，总觉得子侄不得功名，虽富不贵，心有未足，
This was Yu Fuhua’s eldest son, Yu Songnian, known as “the Yu Family Licentiate.” For all his wealth, Yu Fuhua had felt something lacking so long as none of the younger men in the family held a scholarly degree: they were rich, but not distinguished.

所以延请名师，督促郁松年下帷苦读。
He therefore engaged eminent tutors and drove Songnian to study in seclusion.

但『场中莫论文』，一直连个秀才都中不上，
But examination success did not necessarily follow literary merit, and the young man repeatedly failed to obtain even the lowest degree.

因而捐银五万，修葺文庙，
His father consequently donated fifty thousand taels toward repairing the Confucian temple.

朝廷遇有这种义举，不外两种奖励，一种是饬令地方官为此人立牌坊褒奖，一种是增加『进学』，也就是秀才的名额。
The court usually rewarded such public benefactions in one of two ways: it might order the local authorities to erect a commemorative arch for the donor, or it might increase the quota of successful candidates admitted as licentiates.

郁馥华希望得到后一种奖励，经过打点，如愿以偿。
Yu Fuhua wanted the latter reward and, after making the necessary arrangements, obtained it.

这是为地方造福，但实在也是为自己打算。
The donation benefited the locality, but he had certainly considered his own interests too.

学额既已增加，『入学』就比较容易；郁松年毕竟得青一衿。
With the quota enlarged, admission became easier, and Songnian at last earned his scholar’s blue collar.

秀才的官称叫做『生员』；其间又有各种分别，占额外名额的叫做『增生』，
The official term for a licentiate was shengyuan, and there were various distinctions within that grade; those admitted to supplementary places were called zengsheng.

但不论如何，总是秀才，
Whatever the category, however, a licentiate was a licentiate.

称郁松年为『郁家秀才』，表示这个秀才的名额，是郁家斥巨资捐出来的，当然有点菲蒲的意味在内。
Calling Songnian “the Yu Family Licentiate” implied that his place had been purchased by the family’s huge donation, and was naturally a little disparaging.


但是郁松年倒非草包，
Yet Songnian was no fool.

虽不免纨绔习气，却是有志于学，彬彬有礼；
Though he had some of the habits of a rich young idler, he sincerely aspired to learning and was courteous and well mannered.

当时已经在下人一片『大少爷』的招呼声中，进入屏门，忽然发觉有异，
Amid the servants’ cries of “Young Master!” he had already passed through the screen doorway when he sensed that something was wrong.

站定了，回身注视，
He stopped and looked back.

果然看到了尤五。
Sure enough, there was Brother You.

『尤五叔！』
“Uncle You!”

他疾趋而前，请了个安，惊喜交集地问，『你老人家怎么在这里？』
He hurried over, bowed respectfully, and asked in mingled surprise and delight, “What brings you here, sir?”

『我来看你老人家，』
“I have come to see your father.”

尤五气量甚宽，不肯说郁家下人的坏话，
Brother You was too generous to complain of the servants.

『听说不在家，我等一等好了。』
“I hear he is out, so I am waiting for him.”

『怎么在这里坐？』
“But why are you sitting here?”

郁松年回过脸去，怒声斥责下人∶『你们太没有规矩了，
Songnian turned on the servants angrily. “Where are your manners?

尤五爷来了，怎么不请进去，让贵客坐在这里？』
Master You has come to see us, and you leave an honored guest sitting here instead of asking him inside?”


原先答话的下人，这才知道自己『有眼不识泰山』。
Only then did the servant who had spoken earlier realize that he had failed to recognize a great man under his very nose.

自家主人跟尤五结怨，以及希望修好而不得的经过，平时早就听过不止一遍；
He had heard more than once of his master’s quarrel with Brother You and his unsuccessful attempts to mend it.

如今人家登门就教，反倒慢客，
Now that the visitor had come of his own accord, the servant had treated him discourteously.

因此而得罪了尤五，过在不宥，说不定就此敲碎了绝好的一只饭碗，
If Brother You took offense, it would be an unforgivable fault; he might have smashed his own excellent rice bowl.

所以吓得面无人色。
The thought drained his face of color.

尤五见此光景，索性好人做到底了，
Seeing this, Brother You decided to carry his kindness through to the end.

『你不要骂他，你不要骂他。』他赶紧拦在前面，
“Do not scold him, do not scold him,” he said, stepping quickly between them.

『管家倒是一再邀我进去，
“Your man invited me inside more than once.

是我自己愿意在这里等，比较方便。』
I chose to wait here myself; I thought it more convenient.”

听得这一说，郁松年才不言语，
At this Songnian said no more.

『尤五叔，请里面坐！』他说，
“Please come inside, Uncle You.

『家父在勘察城墙，
Father is inspecting the city wall.

我马上派人去请他回来。』
I shall send for him at once.”

『好的，好的！
“Thank you, thank you.

实在是有点要紧事，不然也不敢惊动你老人家。』
It really is rather urgent; otherwise I would not presume to trouble your father.”

『尤五叔说哪里话？
“Please do not say that, Uncle You.

请都请不到。』
We could hardly have hoped to bring you here even with an invitation.”


肃客入厅，
Songnian ceremoniously led him into the reception hall.

只见华堂正中，悬一块蓝底金字的匾额，御笔四个大字∶『功襄保赤』。
In the center hung a blue plaque with four large gold characters in the emperor’s own hand: “Meritorious Service in Protecting the People.”

这就是郁馥华此刻去勘察城墙的由来——
The plaque explained why Yu Fuhua was inspecting the wall.

当上海收复时，外国军舰在浦江南码头开炮助攻，从大南门到大东门的城墙，轰坏了一大片；
When Shanghai was retaken, foreign warships had fired from the southern wharf on the Huangpu to support the assault, wrecking a long stretch of wall between the Great South Gate and the Great East Gate.

朝廷以郁家巨宅曾为刘丽川盘踞，郁馥华难免资匪之嫌，罚银十万两修复城墙，
Since Liu Lichuan had occupied the Yu mansion, the court considered its owner open to suspicion of having supported the rebels and fined him one hundred thousand taels to repair the damage.

而经地方官陈情，又御赐了这一方匾额。
After the local officials had pleaded his case, however, the emperor also bestowed this plaque.

如今又有长毛围攻上海的风声；
Rumors were now circulating that the Longhairs would attack Shanghai.

郁馥华怕自己所修的这段城墙，不够坚固；
Yu feared that the stretch he had rebuilt might not be strong enough.

万一将来由此攻破，责任不轻，所以连日勘察，未雨绸缪。
If an enemy broke through there, the responsibility would be serious, so he had spent several days inspecting it and taking precautions.

听郁松年说罢究竟，尤五趁机安了个伏笔，
When Songnian had finished explaining, Brother You took the opportunity to prepare the way for his request.

『令尊一向热心公益，
“Your father has always been devoted to the public good.

好极、好极！』
Excellent, excellent!

他说，『救人就是救己，
In saving others, one saves oneself.

我今天就是为了这件事来的。』
That is what has brought me here today.”

『是！』郁松年很恭敬地问道∶『尤五叔是先吩咐下来，还是等家父到了再谈？』
“Indeed,” Songnian said respectfully. “Would you care to give me your instructions first, Uncle You, or would you prefer to wait for Father?”


『先跟你谈也一样。』于是尤五将胡雪岩间关乞粮的情形，从头细叙；
“I can tell you first; it makes no difference.” Brother You began a detailed account of Hu’s perilous journey in search of grain.

谈到一半郁馥华到家，打断了话头。
Halfway through it, Yu Fuhua came home and interrupted them.

『尤五哥；』
“Brother You!”

郁馥华是个中号胖子，走得上气不接下气，
He was a plump man of medium height, and his haste had left him breathless.

又喘又笑地说，
He spoke between panting and laughing.

『哪阵风把你吹来的。
“What wind has blown you here?

难得，难得！』
What a rare pleasure!”

『无事不登三宝殿，
“One does not visit a temple without a purpose.

有件事来求你；
I have come to ask a favor.

正跟你们老大谈。』
I was just telling your eldest boy.”

郁松年接口提了一句∶『是要运粮到杭州——。』
“It is about shipping grain to Hangzhou—” Songnian began.

郁馥华脑筋极快，手腕极其圆滑，
Yu Fuhua was quick-witted and exceptionally smooth in his dealings.

听他儿子说了一句，立刻就猜想到一大半；
His son’s few words were enough for him to guess most of the story.

急忙打岔说∶『好说，好说！
He hastened to interrupt. “Of course, of course!

尤五哥的事，总好商量。
Anything concerning Brother You can be discussed.

先坐定下来；
First, settle yourself comfortably.

多时不见，谈谈近况。
We have not met for so long; let us hear how you have been.

尤五哥，你的气色好啊，
You are looking well, Brother You.

要交鸿运了！』
Good fortune must be on its way!”

『托福、托福。
“Thanks to your good wishes.

郁老大，今天我来——。』
Chief Yu, I have come today—”


『我晓得，我晓得。』
“I know, I know.”

郁馥华不容他谈正事；
Yu Fuhua would not let him begin the business.

转脸向他儿子说道∶『你进去告诉你娘，尤五叔来了；
Turning to his son, he said, “Go in and tell your mother that Uncle You is here.

做几样菜来请请尤五叔，要你娘亲手做。
Ask her to prepare a few dishes for him—with her own hands.

现成的「糟钵头」拿来吃酒，
Bring out the pot of wine-lees stew that is ready, and we shall have a drink.

我跟你尤五叔今天要好好叙一叙。』
Your Uncle You and I must have a proper talk today.”

尤五早就听说，郁馥华已是百万身价，起居豪奢；
Brother You had long heard that Yu Fuhua was worth a million and lived in great luxury.

如今要他结发妻子下厨，亲手治馔款客，
Now he was asking the wife who had shared his early years to go into the kitchen and cook for his guest herself.

足见不以富贵骄人，
Clearly he did not intend to put on airs because of his wealth.

这点象熬不忘贫贱之交的意思，倒着实可感，也就欣然接受了盛情。
This gesture of remembering friendships formed in humbler days was genuinely touching, and Brother You gladly accepted the hospitality.



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第一章（本章第4部分，共6部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


摆上酒来，宾主相向相坐；
The wine was brought out, and host and guest sat facing each other.

郁馥华学做官人家的派头，子弟侍立执役，
Yu Fuhua had adopted the style of an official household, with the younger members standing by to wait on their elders.

任凭尤五怎么说，郁松年不敢陪席。
However much Brother You urged him, Songnian dared not join them at the table.

等他执壶替客人斟满了，郁复华郑重其事地双手举杯，高与鼻齐，专敬尤五；
Once he had filled the guest’s cup, Yu Fuhua solemnly raised his own in both hands to the level of his nose and offered a toast to Brother You alone.

自然有两句要紧话要交代。
Naturally, there were a few important words to be said.

『五哥，』他说，『这几年多有不到的地方，
“Brother Five, I have been remiss in many ways these past few years.

一切都请包涵。
I beg you to overlook it all.

江海一家，无分南北西东；
River and sea belong to one family; north, south, east, or west makes no difference.

以后要请五哥随处指点照应。』
From now on, I shall rely on your guidance and help.”

说着，仰脸干了酒，翻杯一照。
He tipped back his head, drained the wine, and turned the empty cup toward his guest.

尤五既为修好而来，自然也干了杯，
Since Brother You had come to make peace, he drank his own cup dry as well.

『郁老大，』他也照一照杯，『过去的事，今天一笔勾销。
“Chief Yu,” he said, showing that it was empty, “let us wipe out the past today.

江海一家这句话不假，
River and sea do belong to one family.

不过有些地方，也要请老大你手下的弟兄，高抬贵手！』
Still, in certain matters, I must ask you to have your men show us a little consideration.”

『言重、言重！』郁馥华惶恐地说了这一句，
“You are too kind, too kind!” Yu said with an air of trepidation.

转脸问道∶『看福全在不在？』
Then he turned aside. “See whether Fuquan is here.”


尤五也知道这个人，是帮郁复华创业的得力助手；如今也是面团团的富家翁。
Brother You knew the man: he had been an able assistant to Yu Fuhua when the latter was building his fortune and was now a prosperous, round-faced gentleman himself.

当时将他唤了来，不待郁复华有所言语，便兜头作了个大揖，
Summoned into the room, Fuquan did not wait for his employer to speak, but immediately made a deep bow.

满脸暗笑地寒暄∶『尤五叔，你老人家还认得我吧？』
With a broad smile he offered his greeting. “Uncle You, you still remember me, I hope?”

『喔，』
“Oh!”

尤五有意眨一眨眼，作出惊喜的神气，
Brother You deliberately blinked and assumed an expression of delighted surprise.

『是福全哥，
“Brother Fuquan!

你发福了。』
You have filled out.”

『不敢当，不敢当。尤五叔，
“I would not presume to be called your brother, Uncle You.

你叫我小名好了。』
Just call me Fuquan.”

『真的，他们是小辈；
“Indeed, they are all your juniors.

尤五哥你客气倒是见外了。』
Such politeness only puts a distance between us, Brother You.”

郁馥华接着转脸告诫福全∶『你关照下去，江海一家，
Yu then turned to instruct Fuquan. “Pass the word: river and sea are one family.

松江漕帮的弟兄，要当自己人一样，处处尊敬、处处礼让。
The men of the Songjiang Grain-Boat Guild are to be treated as our own, with respect and consideration in everything.

尤五叔有啥吩咐，就跟我的话一式一样。』他说一句，福全答应一句；
Whatever Uncle You orders is exactly as if I had said it myself.” Fuquan acknowledged each instruction.

神态不但严肃，而且诚恳。
His manner was not merely solemn, but sincere.

江湖上讲究的是『受人一尺，还人一丈』；
In their world, a man repaid a foot of kindness with ten feet in return.

尤五见此光景，少不得也有一番推诚相与、谦虚退让的话交代。
Seeing this, Brother You could hardly fail to respond with assurances of trust, friendship, modesty, and mutual consideration.


多时宿怨，一旦解消，郁馥华相当高兴。
Yu Fuhua was delighted to see a long-standing feud dissolved in a single meeting.

从利害关系来说，沙船帮虽然兴旺一时，而漕帮到底根深蒂固，势力不同，
In terms of their respective interests, although the Sea-Junk Guild was prospering for the moment, the Grain-Boat Guild had deep roots and a different order of influence.

所以两帮言归于好，在沙船帮更尤其来得重要。
Reconciliation therefore mattered even more to the sea-junk men.

郁馥华是个极有算计的人，觉得这件事值得大大铺张一番；
Yu was an exceptionally calculating man, and he felt that the occasion deserved a splendid public celebration.

传出去是尤五自己愿意修好，岂不是足可以增加光彩与声势的一件好事？
If word spread that Brother You had come voluntarily to restore friendly relations, would that not add greatly to Yu’s prestige and standing?

打定了主意，当即表示，就在这几天，要挑个黄道吉日，大摆筵宴，略申敬意。
Having made up his mind, he immediately announced that he would choose an auspicious day within the next few days and give a grand banquet as a modest token of respect.

言语恳切，尤五不能也不宜推辞；
He spoke so earnestly that Brother You could neither refuse nor properly wish to.

当下未吃先谢，算是定了局。
He thanked his host for the meal before it had even been prepared, and the matter was settled.


这一下情分就更觉不同，
Their friendship now seemed closer still.

郁馥华豪饮快谈，兴致极好。
Yu Fuhua drank freely and talked merrily, in the highest of spirits.

尤五却颇为焦急，
Brother You, however, was growing anxious.

他是有要紧事要谈，哪有心思叙旧？
He had urgent business to discuss; how could he give his mind to reminiscence?

但又不便扫他的高兴；
Yet he could hardly spoil his host’s pleasure.

这样下去，等主人喝得酪酊大醉，岂不白来一趟？
If this went on until Yu was hopelessly drunk, would the whole visit not have been wasted?

等了又等，也是忍了又忍，
He waited and waited, restraining himself again and again.

快将忍不住时，郁松年看出苗头，提醒他父亲说∶『爹！尤五叔有事要跟爹商量呢！』
Just as his patience was about to give out, Songnian noticed and reminded his father, “Father, Uncle You has something to discuss with you.”

『喔，喔，是的。』
“Oh, yes, of course.”

郁馥华不能再装马虎了，
Yu could no longer pretend to have forgotten.

随即转脸说道∶『尤五哥，你倒请再说一遍看。』
He turned to his guest. “Please tell me again, Brother You.”


『是这样的，
“It is this.

有一批米，要借重老大你的船；
There is a consignment of rice for which we need your boats.

走海道，由海宁进鳖子门，入钱塘江，运到杭州。』
It must go by sea, enter Biezimen at Haining, and travel up the Qiantang River to Hangzhou.

尤五又说，『杭州城里的百姓，不但吃草根树皮，
The people inside the city are no longer merely eating roots and bark.

在吃人肉了；
They are eating human flesh.

所以这件事务必要请老大你帮忙，越快越好。』
We absolutely must have your help, Chief Yu, and the sooner the better.”

『尤五哥，你的事，一句话。
“For anything of yours, Brother You, you have only to say the word.

不过，沙船帮的情形，瞒不过你，
But you know our circumstances.

鳖子门这条路从来没有去过，
The Sea-Junk Guild has never taken the Biezimen route.

水性不熟，会得搁浅，
We do not know the waters and might run aground.

岂不耽误大事？』
That could ruin the whole undertaking.”

他紧接着说，
He hurried on.

『当然，漕帮弟兄可以领路，不过沙船走到江里，路道不对。
“Of course, your grain-boat men could pilot us, but taking sea junks into the river is not the proper way to use them.

这样子，我马上找人来商量，
Let me send for some people at once and discuss it.

总要想条万全之计。
We must find a plan that is safe in every respect.

好不好明天给你回话？』
May I give you an answer tomorrow?”


听得这一说，尤五颇为不悦；
Brother You was distinctly displeased.

心里在想，这种兵荒马乱的时候，到哪里都是冒险；
In such a time of war and disorder, he thought, where could one go without taking risks?

就算承平时候，风涛险恶，也没有什么保险不出事的把握。
Even in peace, with treacherous winds and waves, no one could guarantee freedom from mishap.

说要想一条万全之计，不就是有心推托？
Was this talk of finding a wholly safe plan not simply a deliberate excuse?

想是这样想，当然决没有发作的道理，
He thought so, but there was naturally no question of losing his temper.

不过话要点他一句，
Still, he had to give the man a hint.

『郁老大，』他说，『亲兄弟，明算帐，
“Chief Yu, even brothers keep clear accounts.

人情归人情，生意归生意；
Friendship is friendship, and business is business.

请你仔细盘算一下，
Work out the figures carefully.

运费出公帐，
The freight will be paid from public funds.

何必放着河水不洗船？』
Why leave the river water unused when you could wash your boat in it?”

『言重，言重！
“Please, please!

尤五哥，你误会了，
You misunderstand me, Brother You.

我决不是在这上头打算盘。
I am certainly not calculating my advantage in that respect.

为的是┅┅。』郁馥华觉得怎么样说都不合适，
My concern is—” Whatever he said seemed wrong.

而且也要问问路上的情形，便改口问道∶『尤五哥，
He also needed to learn more about conditions along the route, so he changed tack.

那位胡道台，我久仰大名，
“I have long heard of that Circuit Intendant Hu.

好不好领我会一会他？』
Might you introduce me to him?”

胡道台就是胡雪岩；
Circuit Intendant Hu was Hu Xueyan.

这几年连捐带保，官运亨通，成了浙江省城里亦官亦商的一位特殊人物；
Over the past few years, purchased rank and recommendations for promotion had carried him smoothly upward, making him a peculiar figure in Zhejiang’s provincial capital: part official, part merchant.

尤五原就有意替他们拉拢见一面，
Brother You had intended to bring the two men together in any case.

现在郁馥华自己开口，当然毫无推辞，
Now that Yu had asked, he agreed without hesitation.

而且表示∶『说走就走，
“We can go this moment, if you wish.

悉听尊便。』
I am entirely at your disposal.”


『今天太匆促了！
“Today would be too hurried.

一则喝了酒，二则，草草未免不恭。
For one thing, I have been drinking; for another, a hastily arranged call might seem disrespectful.

准定明天一早，我去拜访；
I shall certainly visit first thing tomorrow.

不知道胡道台耽搁在哪里？』
Where is Circuit Intendant Hu staying?”

『他住在舍亲古应春家。
“At the house of my relative, Gu Yingchun.

明天一早我来接。』
I shall come and fetch you in the morning.”

『原来是老古那里。
“So he is at Old Gu’s!

我们也是熟人，他府上我去过；
We know each other too, and I have been to his house.

不必劳驾，
Do not trouble yourself.

我自己去就是了。』
I can go on my own.”

谈到这里，告一段落；而且酒也够了，
That brought their discussion to a close, and they had drunk enough as well.

尤五起身告辞。
Brother You rose to take his leave.

一回到古家，七姑奶奶迎上前来，
When he returned to Gu’s house, the Seventh Lady came forward to meet him.

虽未开口，那双眼睛却比开口还显得关切。
Even before she spoke, her eyes expressed a concern stronger than words.


『怎么样？』
“Well?”

尤五不答，只问胡雪岩的伤势如何？
Brother You did not answer, but asked after Hu’s injury.

这倒是使得七姑奶奶可以高兴的，
Here the Seventh Lady had good news.

夸赞伤科医生有本事；胡雪岩的痛楚大减，伤口好得很快，预计三天以后，就可以下床走动了。
She praised the doctor’s skill in treating wounds: Hu was in far less pain, the wound was healing quickly, and in three days he should be able to get out of bed and walk.

『这也是人到了这里，心就安了。』七姑奶奶又说，
“Part of it is that his mind has been at rest since he arrived here,” she added.

『人逢喜事精神爽，
“Good news lifts a man’s spirits.

郁老大如果肯帮忙；真比吃什么药都有用。』
If Chief Yu will help, it will do him more good than any medicine.”

『帮忙是肯帮的，事情没有那么快。
“He is willing to help, but these things cannot be settled so quickly.

先跟小爷叔谈了再说。』
Let me speak to Little Uncle first.”


于是从头谈起。
Brother You began his account.

一旁静听的七姑奶奶，先是一直含着笑；
The Seventh Lady stood listening beside them, smiling throughout the first part.

听到郁馥华说要明天才有回话，一下子跳了起来。
When he reached Yu Fuhua’s promise to give an answer the next day, she sprang up.

『这明明是推托嘛！』
“That is plainly an excuse!”

『七姐，』胡雪岩赶紧拦住她说∶『人家有人家为难的地方。
Hu hurried to restrain her. “Seventh Sister, he has difficulties of his own.

你先不要着急；
Do not be anxious yet.

慢慢儿商量。』
Let us talk it through.”

『我是替你着急，小爷叔！』
“It is for you that I am anxious, Little Uncle!”


『我晓得，我晓得。』胡雪岩依旧从容不迫地，
“I know, I know,” Hu replied, as composed as ever.

『换了我是郁老大，也不能不仔细；
“If I were Chief Yu, I too should have to consider the matter carefully.

海面上没有啥，一进了鳖子门，走在钱塘江里，两岸都是长毛，
There is little to fear at sea, but once we pass through Biezimen and enter the Qiantang, the Longhairs are on both banks.

他自然要担足心事。
Naturally, he has every reason to be worried.

这件事只有这样办，
There is only one way to proceed.

一方面，我们要跟他说实话，哪里有危险，哪里没有危险，出了危险，怎么样应付？
On the one hand, we must tell him the truth: where the danger lies, where it does not, and what we shall do if trouble comes.

一方面得要请他放点交情；冒一冒险。
On the other, we must ask him to put friendship before caution and take a risk.

俗语说∶』前半夜想想人家，后半夜想想自己。
As the saying goes, spend the first half of the night thinking about others and the second half thinking about yourself.

「我们现在先想自己，有什么好处到人家那里；人家肯看交情上头，一冒一冒险。
For the moment, let us consider our own part: what can we do for him that will make him willing, out of friendship, to take that risk?”

『』对！
“Quite right!”

『尤五不胜倾倒，』
Brother You was full of admiration.

小爷叔这两句话入情入理；
“Little Uncle, that is both reasonable and fair.

照这样去想，事情就可以办通了。
If we approach it that way, we can get the thing done.”

『』好吧！
“Very well!”

『七姑奶奶无可奈何；
The Seventh Lady could do nothing with them.

转个念头，自己女流之辈，可以不必来管这桩大事，
Then she reflected that, as a woman, she need not concern herself with such weighty affairs.

便即说∶』天塌下来有长人顶，
“If the sky falls, there are taller people to hold it up.

与我不相干，
It is nothing to do with me.

你们去商量。
You can discuss it yourselves.”

『说完转身就走。
She turned to go.


『七姐！』胡雪岩急忙喊道∶『有件事非跟你商量不可。
“Seventh Sister!” Hu called after her. “There is something I simply must consult you about.

你请回来！』
Please come back!”

她自然又立脚站定。
Naturally, she stopped.

胡雪岩原是听她的话近乎赌气，其实并没有什么事要她商量，
He had only called because her words sounded rather petulant; in fact, he had nothing to ask her.

不过既已说出口，倒又不得不找件事跟她商量了。
Now that he had spoken, however, he had to find something.

灵机一动，
An idea flashed into his mind.

开口只道∶『七姐，上海我半年不曾来过了，
“Seventh Sister, I have not been in Shanghai for six months.

最近有没有好的棺子？』
Have any good restaurants opened lately?”

『有啊！』七姑奶奶答道∶『新开一家泰和馆，
“Yes!” she replied. “There is a new one called Taihe.

一统山河的南北口味，
It serves northern and southern dishes from all over the country.

我吃过几次，
I have eaten there several times.

菜刮刮叫。』
The food is first-rate.”

『地方呢，宽敞不宽敞？』
“And the place itself—is it spacious?”

『岂止宽敞？
“Spacious? It is more than that!

庆兴楼、复新园、鸿运楼，数得出的几家大馆子，哪一家都没有它讲究。』
Qingxinglou, Fuxinyuan, Hongyunlou—none of the big restaurants you can name is so splendidly fitted out.”

七姑奶奶问道∶『小爷叔，你是不是要请客？』
She looked at him. “Are you thinking of giving a banquet, Little Uncle?”


『我的心思瞒不过七姐。』
“Nothing escapes you, Seventh Sister.”

胡雪岩笑着回答，是有意恭维她一句；
Hu smiled; the compliment was deliberate.

然后转脸看着尤五说∶『五哥，你既然委屈了，索性看我们杭州一城百姓的面上，委屈到底，
Then he turned to Brother You. “Brother Five, since you have already humbled yourself, do it to the end for the sake of all the people of Hangzhou.

请你出面请个客拿郁老大手下的大小脚色都请到；
Give a banquet in your name and invite every man under Chief Yu, great or small.

我们漕帮弟兄，最好也都到场，
It would be best if all our grain-boat men were there too.

给足了他面子，看他怎么说？』
Let us pay him every possible honor and see what he says.”

『好的。
“Certainly.

一句话。』
You have only to ask.”

『那就要托七姐，定泰和馆的席。
“Then we must trouble Seventh Sister to book the tables at Taihe.

名归五哥出，钱归我出┅┅。』『这用不着你交代。』七姑奶奶抢着说，
The invitation will be in Brother Five’s name, and I shall pay—” “You need not tell me that,” she broke in.

『就不知道有多少人；要定多少桌席。』
“What I need to know is how many guests there will be, and how many tables to order.”

这当然要问尤五，
That, of course, was for Brother You to answer.

他慢吞吞地答道∶『要么不请；请了就不管他多少人了。
“If we are going to invite them at all,” he said slowly, “we need not worry about how many.

我只一张帖子，统请沙船帮全体弟兄；
I shall send a single invitation to every brother in the Sea-Junk Guild.

拿泰和馆包下来，开流水席，有一桌算一桌。』
We shall take the whole restaurant and serve a continuous banquet: as many tables as are needed.”

『这倒也痛快。
“That is a generous way to do it.

就这么说了。』
Agreed.”

胡雪岩向七姑奶奶拱拱手∶『拜托、拜托！』
Hu clasped his hands toward the Seventh Lady. “I leave it in your capable hands.”


七姑奶奶最喜欢排场热闹，一诺无辞；
The Seventh Lady loved a grand, lively occasion and agreed at once.

但粗中有细，
Beneath her expansive manner, however, she had an eye for detail.

想了想问道∶『哪一天请？』
After a moment’s thought she asked, “What day?”

『不是要快嘛！』尤五答说，
“Are we not in a hurry?” Brother You replied.

『要快就在明天。』
“If we want to be quick, make it tomorrow.”

七姑奶奶不作声，将排在门背后的皇历取了下来，翻了翻说∶『明天怕不成功，
Without a word, she took down the almanac hanging behind the door and turned its pages. “Tomorrow may not be possible.

是好日子；总有人做亲，在它那里请客。
It is an auspicious day; someone is sure to be holding a wedding feast there.

后天是个平日，「宜祭祀、订盟、余事不宜。」
The day after is an ordinary day: ‘Suitable for sacrifices and the making of covenants; unsuitable for other undertakings.’

不晓得可以不可以？』
Would that do?”

『可以！』胡雪岩接口便说∶『我们这就算「订盟」。』
“Certainly,” Hu answered at once. “We can call this the making of a covenant.”

事不宜迟，
There was no time to lose.

七姑奶奶当时便取了一封银洋，亲自坐马车到泰和馆去定席。
The Seventh Lady took a wrapped packet of silver dollars and drove to Taihe herself to arrange the banquet.

尤五便找古家的帐房赵先生来，写好一封大红全帖，送到乔家滨郁家，
Brother You asked Mr Zhao, the Gu household’s accountant, to write out a full formal invitation on red paper and sent it to the Yu residence at Qiaojiabin.

同时又派人去找他一个心爱的徒弟李得隆来办事。
At the same time he summoned a favorite disciple, Li Delong, to help with the arrangements.


他们兄妹在忙，胡雪岩一个人躺在床上盘算；
While brother and sister were busy, Hu lay alone in bed and thought things through.

等尤五再回进来时，他已经盘算停当了。
By the time Brother You returned, his plans were ready.

『五哥，我们现在一桩桩来谈。
“Brother Five, let us take things one at a time.

米怎么样？』
What about the rice?”

『我已经关照下去，
“I have passed the word.

今天下午就可成局。』
We can have it settled this afternoon.

尤五答道∶『虽说多多益善，也要看郁老大有多少船？
The more the better, of course, but we must also see how many boats Chief Yu can provide.

总而言之一句话，只要他有船，我就有米。』
In a word: if he has the boats, I have the rice.”

『那好。
“Good.

我们谈船。
Now let us discuss the boats.

郁老大怕来怕去，最怕长毛。
Whatever else he fears, Chief Yu is most afraid of the Longhairs.

不过不要紧；
But that need not stop us.

长毛在岸上，我们在江里，
They are on shore, and we shall be on the river.

他们没有炮船，就不必怕他。
They have no gunboats, so there is no need to fear them.

至多坐了小划子用洋枪来攻；
At worst, they can come out in small craft and attack with foreign rifles.

我们自己能有一批人，备它几十杆好枪，说开火就开火，打他个落流水。』
If we have a force of our own, with a few dozen good guns, we can open fire as soon as necessary and rout them.

胡雪岩又说，『这批人，我也想好了；
I have thought of where to find the men too.

不知道老古跟杨坊熟不熟？』
Is Old Gu well acquainted with Yang Fang?”

尤五懂他的意思，点点头说∶『很熟的。
Brother You understood his intention and nodded. “Very well acquainted.

就不熟也不要紧。』
And even if he were not, it would not matter.”

『何以呢？』胡雪岩问。
“Why is that?” Hu asked.


『小爷叔，你的意思是不是想借洋将华尔的人？』
“Little Uncle, do you mean to borrow some men from Ward, the foreign commander?”

『对啊！』胡雪岩问，
“Exactly.

『不是说洋将跟上海道的交涉，都是杨坊在居间接头的吗？』
Is Yang Fang not the intermediary in all the foreign commander’s negotiations with the Shanghai circuit intendant?”

『一点不错。
“Quite right.

杨坊是「四明公所」的董事；
Yang is a director of the Siming Guildhall.

宁波也是浙江，为家乡的事，他没有不肯出力的道理，
Ningbo is in Zhejiang too; he has every reason to help his home province.

就算不认识，一样也可以请他帮忙。』
Even without a personal acquaintance, we could still ask him.”

『我对此人的生平不大清楚，
“I know little of the man’s background.

当然是有熟人从中说话，事情更容易成功。
Of course, a mutual friend would make the matter easier.

不过，我想是这样，行不行得通，还不晓得。
But this is only my idea; I do not yet know whether it will work.

先要问一问老古；
We must ask Old Gu first.

他不知道什么时候回来？』
When will he be back?”

『不必问他，』
“There is no need to ask him.”

尤五手一指∶『现在有个人在这里。』
Brother You pointed. “We have someone here already.”

这个人就是萧家骥。他是一早跟了古应春去办事的；
He meant Xiao Jiaji, who had gone out with Gu early that morning.

由于胡雪岩关照，王有龄的两封血书要面递薛焕，所以古应春一直守在江苏巡抚设在上海的行署中，等候传见。
Hu had instructed them to deliver Wang Youling’s two letters written in blood to Xue Huan in person, so Gu was still at the Jiangsu governor’s temporary headquarters in Shanghai, waiting to be received.

为怕胡雪岩惦念，特地先派萧家骥回来送信。
Fearing that Hu would be anxious, he had sent Xiao back ahead with a message.


『你看，』胡雪岩对尤五说，『这就是我刚才盘算，要借重洋将的道理。
“You see,” Hu said to Brother You, “this is just why I have been thinking of using the foreign commander’s men.

官场办事，没有门路。就会行不通；
In official business, unless you have the right connections, you get nowhere.

要见薛抚台一面都这么难，哪里还能巴望他派兵替我们护粮。
If even obtaining an audience with Governor Xue is so difficult, how can we hope for troops to escort our grain?

就算肯派；也不是三天两天就走得动的。』
Even if he agreed, they could not be on their way in two or three days.”

他加重语气又说∶『我主意打定了，
He emphasized his next words. “My mind is made up.

决定我们自己想办法。』于是尤五将他的打算告诉了萧家骥；萧家骥静静地听完，并未作声。
We shall find our own solution.” Brother You explained their plan to Xiao, who listened quietly without speaking.

『怎么样？家骥！』胡雪岩催问着∶已看出他另有主意。
“Well, Jiaji?” Hu urged him, already sensing that he had another idea.

『这件事有个办法，
“There is a way.

看起来费事，其实倒容易。』他说，
It looks troublesome, but in fact it is easier.

『不如请英国或者法国的海军提督，派兵船护送。』
Why not ask the British or French admiral to send warships as an escort?”

『这——』尤五首先就表示怀疑，『这行得通吗？』
“But—would that be possible?” Brother You was the first to express doubt.

『行得通的。』萧家骥说∶『外国人另有一套规矩，
“It would,” Xiao said. “Foreigners have another set of rules.

开仗是一回事，救老百姓又是一回事。
Fighting a war is one thing; saving civilians is another.

如果说∶这批米是军粮，他们就不便护送；
If this rice were military provisions, they could not properly escort it.

为了救老百姓，当然可以。』
If it is to save the common people, of course they can.”

听这一说，胡雪岩大为高兴；
Hu was delighted to hear this.

但是，
Still, there was a question.

『这要怎么样说法；跟哪个去接头？』他问。
“How should we put the request, and whom should we approach?”

『我就可以去！』萧家骥自告奋勇；但立刻又加了一句∶『不过先要问问我师父。』
“I can go myself,” Xiao volunteered, but immediately added, “Only I must consult my teacher first.”


『你的师父当然赞成，』尤五接口说道，
“Your teacher will certainly approve,” Brother You put in.

『不过，我始终不大相信，
“But I am still doubtful.

只怕没有这么好的事。』
I fear there may be no such good fortune.”

『那也不妨双管齐下。』胡雪岩问萧家骥∶『你看，我们自己出钱，请华尔派几十个人保护，
“Then we can try both approaches at once,” Hu said, asking Xiao, “What if we paid Ward ourselves to send a few dozen men to protect us?

这个办法可以不可以试一试？』
Could we try that?”

『试是没有什么不可以试的。』萧家骥答说∶『不过，我看很难。为什么呢——。』
“There is no harm in trying,” Xiao replied. “But I think it would be difficult, and for two reasons.”

为的是第一，华尔部下的『佣兵』，已经为上海道吴煦『惯』坏了，
First, Wu Xu, the Shanghai circuit intendant, had spoiled Ward’s mercenaries.

花了大钱，未必能得他们的出死力；
Even a great deal of money might not persuade them to risk their lives.

第二，这批佣兵是『步军』，在水上能不能发挥威力，大成疑问。
Second, they were infantry; whether they could make their strength felt on the water was very doubtful.

『说得有道理。』
“That is sound reasoning.”

胡雪岩最不肯掩没人的长处，对萧家骥大为欣赏，
Hu was always ready to acknowledge another man’s merits, and he greatly admired Xiao.

『家骥，这件事倒要请你好好帮我一个忙。』
“Jiaji, I must ask you to give me all the help you can with this.”

『胡先生言重了，
“You are too kind, Mr Hu.

有什么事，尽管吩咐就是。』
Whatever needs doing, you have only to tell me.”


一个赏识，一个仰慕，
One man appreciated the other’s ability; the other looked up to him.

于是尤五有了一个计较，
Seeing this, Brother You conceived a plan of his own.

暂且不言；要等古应春回来了再说。
He kept it to himself for the moment, intending to wait until Gu returned.

『薛抚台见着了。』古应春的神情不愉，
“I saw Governor Xue,” Gu reported, plainly unhappy.

『小爷叔，王雪公要想指望他肯出什么大力，恐怕是妄想。』
“Little Uncle, if Mr Xuexuan hopes for any substantial help from him, I fear he is dreaming.”

『他怎么说？』胡雪岩很沉着地问。
“What did he say?” Hu asked steadily.


不问还好，问起来教人生气。
The question was enough to make Gu angry all over again.

薛焕叹了一大遍苦经；
Xue Huan had recited a long catalogue of his own troubles.

又怪王有龄在浙江自己不想办法练军队，军饷都接济了皖南和江西，如今局势一坏，连带上海亦吃紧。
He blamed Wang Youling for failing to raise and train troops in Zhejiang and for sending all his military funds to southern Anhui and Jiangxi; now that the situation had deteriorated, Shanghai too was under pressure.

又提到他在江苏的时候，如何跋扈刚愎；
He also recalled how overbearing and obstinate Wang had been during his time in Jiangsu.

言下大有落到今日的光景，是自取其咎之意。
The clear implication was that Wang had brought his present plight on himself.

『也难怪他！』古应春又说∶『京里闹得天翻地覆，
“And one can hardly blame Xue for being in a bad temper,” Gu added. “Beijing has been turned upside down.

两个亲王都送了命，如今又是恭王当政；
Two princes have lost their lives, and Prince Gong is now in power.

一朝天子一朝臣，
A new sovereign brings a new set of ministers.

曾国藩也快到两江来了，
Zeng Guofan will soon be coming to Liangjiang too.

薛抚台署理两江总督跟实缺江苏巡抚的两颗印把子，看起来摇摇欲坠，
Both seals in Governor Xue’s hands—acting governor-general of Liangjiang and substantive governor of Jiangsu—look in danger of slipping away.

心境当然不好。』
Naturally he is unhappy.”

『我知道。』胡雪岩说，
“I know,” Hu replied.

『你没有来之前，我跟五哥还有家骥，都商量过了；
“Before you came back, Brother Five, Jiaji, and I had already discussed things.

本来就不想靠他。
We never intended to rely on him.

不过，他到底是江苏巡抚，王雪公的折子，一定只有请他拜发。
But he is still the governor of Jiangsu, and we have no choice but to ask him to forward Mr Xuexuan’s memorial to the throne.

不知道这件事，他办了没有？』
Has he done that?”

『这他不敢不办。』古应春说，
“He would not dare refuse.

『连催李元度的公事，都已经交待下去。
He has even given orders for the dispatch urging Li Yuandu to hurry.

我还怕下面太慢，特意打了招呼；
I was afraid the clerks might be slow, so I spoke to them specially.

答应所有的公事，明天都一起办出。』
They promised to send all the official papers out together tomorrow.”

『那就不管它了。我们商量我们的。』
“Then let us leave that alone and discuss our own plans.”


于是尤五和萧家骥将刚才所谈经过，原原本本说了给古应春听。
Brother You and Xiao Jiaji gave Gu a full account of their earlier discussion.

这在他是个很大的安慰；
It was a great comfort to him.

本来为了要见薛焕，将大好时光，白白糟蹋，不但生气，而且相当着急。
Wasting so much valuable time waiting to see Xue Huan had left him not only angry but seriously anxious.

照现在看起来，路子甚多，事情并不是无处措手，
Now it appeared that several courses were open; they were by no means at a loss where to begin.

因此愁怀一去，精神大为振作。
His worries lifted, and his spirits revived.



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第一章（本章第5部分，共6部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


『既然如此，我们要把宗旨先定下来；
“In that case, we must first decide what we mean to do.

请兵护送的事，能够说动英、法提督，派兵护送，不但力量够强，足可保险，而且还不用花钱，
As for an escort, if we can persuade the British and French admirals to send troops, we shall have a force strong enough to make the voyage safe, and it will cost us nothing.

不过有两层顾虑，
But there are two difficulties.

第一、恐怕仍旧要江苏巡抚出公事；
First, they may still require an official request from the governor of Jiangsu.

第二、不是三、五天之内可以办得成的。』
Second, it cannot be arranged in three or five days.”

『慢就不行！』胡雪岩立即答说，
“A delay is out of the question!” Hu Xueyan answered at once.

『我现在度日如年，
“Every day seems like a year to me.

巴不得明天就走。』
I wish I could leave tomorrow.”

『要快只有雇华尔的部下。
“Then the only quick solution is to hire some of Ward’s men.

这笔钱，恐怕不在少数。』
That will probably cost a considerable sum.”

『要多少？』
“How much?”

『要看雇多少人？
“It depends on how many we hire.

每个人起码三十两银子；死一下抚恤一千。
At least thirty taels a man, with a thousand in compensation for each man killed.

照五十个人算，最少一千五；
For fifty men, that means fifteen hundred at the very least.

如果——。』如果全数阵亡，就得另外抚恤五万；
And if—” If they were all killed, another fifty thousand would be payable in compensation.

话到口边，古应春才发觉这话太丧气，
Only as the words reached his lips did Gu Yingchun realize how ominous they sounded.

果然如此，胡雪岩的性命自然也就不保，
If that happened, Hu himself would surely not survive.

所以把话硬咽了下去了。
He swallowed the rest of the sentence.


胡雪岩却不以为意，
Hu took no offence.

『一千五就一千五；
“Fifteen hundred it is, then.

带队官总要多送些，
The officer in command will need an extra payment, of course.

我不在乎。
I do not mind.

倒是，』他指着萧家骥说，『他的顾虑不错，
But”—he pointed to Xiao Jiaji—“his concern is sound.

只怕在岸上打惯了仗的，一上了船，有劲使不出，有力用不上。』
Men accustomed to fighting ashore may find, once they are aboard a boat, that all their strength and courage are of no use.”

『这要问他们自己才知道。
“We shall have to ask them.

虽说重赏之下，必有勇夫，性命到底是拿钱换不来的；
A generous reward may bring brave men forward, but money cannot buy back a life.

如果他们没有把握，当然不敢贸然答应。
Unless they feel reasonably certain, they will not agree rashly.

我们局外人，不必自作聪明。』
We are outsiders; there is no need to imagine that we know better.”

古应春最后这句话，颇有告诫学生的意味；因而原有一番意见想陈述的萧家骥，就不便开口了。
Gu’s last remark had something of a master’s admonition to his pupil about it, and Xiao, who had been preparing to offer an opinion, could hardly speak now.


『说到杨坊，我也认识；
“I know Yang Fang, as it happens.

交情虽不深，倒承他不弃，还看得起我。
We are not intimate, but he has been kind enough to think well of me.

今天晚上我就去看他。』
I shall call on him tonight.”

『对了！
“Good!

我们分头行事。
We shall divide the work.

此刻大家规定一下，米跟沙船，归我；请洋将归你。』
Let us settle it now: I shall see to the rice and the sea-going junks; you arrange for the foreign officers.”

尤五对古应春说，
Brother You turned to Gu.

『还有件事，你要调一批现头寸来。』
“One other thing: you must get some ready funds together.”

『这不要紧！』
“That presents no difficulty.”

胡雪岩从手上取下一个戒指，交给古应春∶『我往来的几家号子你是晓得的；
Hu took a ring from his hand and gave it to Gu. “You know the firms with which I do business.

看存着有多少头寸，你随意调度就是。』
Find out how much money I have with them and draw on it as you need.”

戒指是赤金的，
The ring was of pure gold.

没有一两也有八钱，
If it did not weigh a whole tael, it weighed at least eight mace.

其大无比，其俗也无比；
It was enormous, and equally ostentatious.

但实际上是一枚图章 ，
In fact, however, it was a seal.

凭戒面上『胡雪岩印』四个朱文篆字，调集十万八万银子，叱嗟立办。
The four characters on its face, “Seal of Hu Xueyan,” cut in relief in seal script, could summon eighty or a hundred thousand taels almost at a word.

不过以古应春实力，也还用不到此。
Gu’s own resources were sufficient without it.

『不必！』
“There is no need.

你这个戒指片刻不离身，
You never take that ring off.

还是你自己带着。
Keep it yourself.”

『』不然！『胡雪岩说，』
“No,” Hu replied.

我另外还有用意。
“I have another reason.

这一次回杭州，好便好；
If all goes well on this return to Hangzhou, well and good.

如果将来再不能见面，一切托你料理。
But if we never meet again, I entrust everything to you.

人欠欠人，等我明天开出一张单子来交给你。
Tomorrow I shall give you a list of what others owe me and what I owe them.”

『托到后事，无不惨然；
This provision for his own death distressed everyone.

古应春也越发不肯收下他那枚戒指图章 ，
Gu was even more unwilling to accept the seal ring.

拉过他的手来，硬要替他戴上，
Taking Hu’s hand, he tried to force it back onto his finger.

正在拉拉扯扯的时候，七姑奶奶回来了；少不得询问究竟。
They were still struggling over it when the Seventh Lady returned and naturally asked what was going on.

大家都知道她重感情，说破了一定会惹她伤感，所以彼此使了个眼色，随意扯句话掩饰了过去。
Knowing how deeply she felt things, and that the truth would grieve her, they exchanged a glance and put her off with some casual explanation.


『菜定好了，八两银子一桌的海菜席；
“The food is ordered: seafood banquets at eight taels a table.

包他们四十桌。』七姑奶奶说，
We have booked forty tables,” the Seventh Lady announced.

『那里老板说是亏本生意，不过要借这桩生意创招牌。
“The proprietor says he will lose money, but he wants to make his name through this engagement.

人家既然看得这么重，人少了，场面不够热闹，面子上不好看，
Since he attaches so much importance to it, we shall look foolish if too few people come and the occasion falls flat.

五哥，我倒有点担心。』
Brother Five, I am a little worried.”

『担什么心？
“What is there to worry about?

叫人来场面、吃酒席，
We are inviting people to a gathering and a feast.

还怕没有人？
Do you suppose we cannot find enough guests?

回头我会关照李得隆。』
I shall speak to Li Delong presently.”

『那末郁老大那里呢？』
“And Chief Yu?”

『这你更可以放心。
“You need worry even less about him.

小爷叔想的这个办法，在郁老大求之不得，
This plan of Little Uncle’s is just what he could wish for.

来的人一定多。』尤五又说，『你再要不放心，我叫李得隆放个风出去，说我们包了泰和馆，大请沙船帮，
Plenty of his people are sure to come.” Brother You added, “If you are still uneasy, I shall have Li Delong spread the word that we have taken over the Taihe Restaurant to entertain the whole Sea-Junk Guild.

不来就是看不起我们。』
Anyone who stays away will be showing contempt for us.”

『那好。
“Good.

我叫人去通知，再预备十桌在那里。』
I shall send word for another ten tables to be held in readiness.”

七姑奶奶一面说，一面就走了出去。
With that, she went out again.


『七姐真有趣。』胡雪岩笑道∶『好热闹，一定是福气人。』
“Sister Seven is a delightful woman,” Hu said with a smile. “So fond of a lively gathering—she is surely born to good fortune.”

『闲话少说。
“Never mind that.

我还有一桩事，
There is another matter.

应春，你看如何？』尤五说道∶『小爷叔要人帮忙；
Yingchun, what do you think of this?” Brother You continued, “Little Uncle needs men to help him.

我说实话，你我去都没啥用处。
To be frank, neither you nor I would be much use on the journey.

我派李得隆，你派萧家骥，跟了小爷叔一路到杭州。』
I shall send Li Delong, and you can send Xiao Jiaji to accompany him all the way to Hangzhou.”

『嗯１』古应春略有迟疑的神情。
“Well…” Gu looked hesitant.

『不必，不必。』胡雪岩最知趣，赶紧辞谢。
“No, no, there is no need,” Hu hastened to say, sensitive as ever to other people’s difficulties.

古应春实在很为难。
Gu was genuinely in a quandary.

因为萧家骥跟他的关系，与漕帮的情形不同；漕帮开香堂收徒弟，师父之命，其重如山，而且出生入死，不当回事。
His relationship with Xiao differed from those in the Grain-Boat Guild, where disciples were received in a formal initiation, a master’s command carried absolute weight, and men thought nothing of risking death.

萧家骥到底只是学洋文，学做生意的徒弟，
Xiao was merely his apprentice in foreign languages and business.

到这种性命出入的事，不便勉强，要问问他本人。
In a matter of life and death, he could not compel him; he must ask the young man himself.

但是胡雪岩这方面的交情，实在太厚；能有一分力，一定要尽一分力，
Yet his friendship with Hu was so deep that, wherever he could help, he was bound to do all he could.

决说不出推辞的话来。
He could not bring himself to refuse.

同时看出胡雪岩口称『不必』；脸上却有失望的表情，越觉得过意不过去了。
Moreover, although Hu said there was no need, his face betrayed disappointment, which made Gu feel worse.

想一想只有老实说∶『小爷叔，如果我有个亲兄弟，我都一定叫他跟了你去。
After considering the matter, he could only speak frankly. “Little Uncle, if I had a brother of my own, I would certainly send him with you.

家骥名为徒弟，到底姓萧；
Jiaji may be my apprentice, but he belongs to the Xiao family.

我来问问他看。』
Let me ask him.”

说到这里，发觉话又不妥，如果萧家骥胆怯不肯去；岂不又显得自己的徒弟『不够料』，
Then it struck him that this too was ill judged: if Xiao proved afraid and refused, would it not make his apprentice seem unworthy?

因而只好再加一句掩饰的话∶『他老太太病在床上，
He added an excuse to cover a possible refusal. “His mother is ill in bed.

如果病势不碍；我想他一定会去的。』
If her condition permits, I am sure he will go.”

话刚完，门外有人接口，是萧家骥的声音；
He had scarcely finished when Xiao’s voice came from outside the door.

他正好走了来听见，自告奋勇∶『我去！
Arriving just in time to hear, he volunteered at once. “I shall go!

我一定去！』
Of course I shall go!”

这一下解消了古应春的难题；也觉得脸上很有光彩，
This solved Gu’s difficulty and did him credit as well.

但胡雪岩却不能不辞谢——
Hu, however, still had to make a polite refusal.

他也知道萧家骥母亲病在床上的话，是古应春为了体恤徒弟，有意留下的一个退步。
He knew that the sick mother was an excuse Gu had provided out of consideration for his apprentice, leaving him a way to retreat.

只是『光棍好做，过门难逃』；而且这个『过门』，古应春不便来打，
But even men who understood one another still had to observe the proper forms; and this particular formality could not be left to Gu.

要自己开口。
Hu must say the words himself.


『家骥，我晓得你义气，
“Jiaji, I know you are loyal to your friends.

不过为人忠孝当先，
But loyalty and filial duty come first.

令堂老太太身体不舒服，你该留下来侍奉。』
Since your mother is unwell, you ought to stay and look after her.”

『不碍，不碍！』
“It is nothing serious!”

萧家骥也很机警，很快地答说∶『我娘胃气痛是老毛病；
Xiao, quick to take the hint, answered promptly. “She has an old stomach complaint.

两三天就好了。』
She will be better in two or three days.”

『那就这样吧！』
“Then it is settled.”

古应春站起身来∶『既然你要跟了去，一切事情要接得上头才好；
Gu rose. “Since you are going, you had better be involved in the arrangements from the beginning.

你跟我一起去看「大记」杨老板。』
Come with me to see Mr Yang at Daji.”

杨坊开的一家专销洋庄的号子，就叫『大记』；
Daji was the name of Yang Fang’s firm, which dealt exclusively in goods for the foreign trade.

师徒二人到了那里，杨坊正在大宴客商，
When master and apprentice arrived, Yang was giving a large dinner for visiting merchants.

相邀入座应酬一番，亦无不可；但古应春为了表示事态紧急，
They could quite properly have accepted his invitation to join the company and exchanged the usual courtesies, but Gu wished to make clear the urgency of his business.

坚辞婉拒；同时表示有个不情之请∶需要当然就单独交谈。
He declined politely but firmly, adding that he had an awkward favour to ask. Naturally, it would have to be discussed in private.

『好！』杨坊慨然许诺，
“Certainly!” Yang readily agreed.

『请到这面来。』
“Come this way.”

就在客厅一角，促膝并坐；
They sat close together in a corner of the reception room.

古应春开门见山地道明来意，
Gu came straight to the point.

杨坊吸了口气，样子显得颇为棘手似地。
Yang drew in his breath, looking as though the request presented considerable difficulty.

『杨兄，恕我再说句不该说的话，
“Brother Yang, forgive me for saying something more that I ought perhaps to leave unsaid.

浙东浙西，休戚相关；
Eastern and western Zhejiang share their fortunes and their troubles.

看在贵省同乡的面上，无论如何要请你想办法。』
For the sake of the people of your own province, you must somehow find a way.”

『我自然要想办法，
“Of course I shall try.

自然要想办法。』杨坊一叠连声地说∶『为难的是，最近华尔跟吴道台闹意气。
Of course I shall.” Yang repeated the assurance several times. “The difficulty is that Ward has recently quarrelled with Intendant Wu.

洋人的脾气很倔，
Foreigners can be very stubborn.

说好什么都好；犯了他的性子，不容易说得进话去。
Get on the right side of him, and anything is possible; cross him, and it is hard to make him listen.

现在只有这样∶我先派人去约他，今天晚上见个面。
The only thing to do now is send someone to arrange a meeting with him tonight.

等我敷衍完了客人，我们一起去；
Once I have finished attending to my guests, we can go together.

便菜便酒，你何妨就在这里坐了。
Meanwhile, stay and have a little food and wine.”


说到这话，古应春自然不便再推辞；
At this, Gu could hardly decline again.

入席酬酢，同时在肚子里盘算，如何说动华尔？
He joined the dinner and exchanged courtesies while turning over in his mind the problem of persuading Ward.

『师父，我想我先回去一趟，等下再来。』萧家骥忽然说道∶『我要好好去问一问胡先生。』
Suddenly Xiao said, “Master, I think I ought to go back for a while and return later. I must question Mr Hu carefully.”

『问什么？』
“About what?”

洋人做事情仔细，又是打仗；
“Foreigners are very thorough in their work, and this involves fighting.

路上的情形，一定要问得清清楚楚。
They are sure to want a precise account of the conditions along the route.

不然决不肯答应。
Otherwise they will never agree.”

『』一点不错。『杨坊大为赞许，』
“Exactly!” Yang said approvingly.

这位小阿弟实在有见识。
“This young fellow has excellent judgement.

那你就快去吧！
Go quickly, then.

两个钟头谈得完谈不完？
Will two hours be enough for your questions?”

『『够了。』
“Quite enough.”

『好。
“Good.

我就约华尔九点钟碰头；
I shall arrange to meet Ward at nine.

八点半钟请你无论如何赶了来。』
Whatever happens, be back here by half past eight.”


萧家骥不到顶定的时间，就已去而复回；
Xiao returned before the appointed time.

除了将他想到该问的情形都问明白以外，还带来胡雪岩一句话。
Besides obtaining answers to all the questions he had thought necessary, he brought a message from Hu.

『师父！胡先生叫我跟师父说∶请将不如激将！』
“Master, Mr Hu asked me to tell you: ‘A challenge will move a commander more readily than a request.’”

这真有点『军师』的味道了；运筹帷幄，决胜千里，付下来这样一个『锦囊』。
This had the true flavour of a strategist’s advice: directing events from the command tent, he had sent out a secret prescription for victory at a distance.

古应春在颠簸的马车上，反复体味着『请将不如激将』这六个字。
As the carriage jolted along, Gu pondered Hu’s brief maxim over and over.

华尔扎营在沪西静安寺附近；
Ward was encamped near Jing’an Temple in western Shanghai.

杨坊是来惯的，
Yang was a familiar visitor.

营门口的卫兵拿马灯一照，挥挥手放行，
The sentry at the gate held up a lantern, took a look, and waved them through.

马车一直驶到华尔的『签押房』。
The carriage drove straight to Ward’s office.


介绍过后，四个人围坐在一张小圆台上；
After the introductions, the four men sat around a small round table.

杨坊开个头，说古应春是浙江官场的代表之一，有事相恳。
Yang began by saying that Gu was one of the representatives of the Zhejiang authorities and had a favour to ask.

接着便由古应春发言，首先补充杨坊的话，表明自己的身分，
Gu then took over, first clarifying his position.

说浙江官场的正式代表是胡雪岩；一个受有清朝官职的很成功的商人，而他是胡雪岩所委派的代表。
The authorities’ official representative, he explained, was Hu Xueyan, a highly successful merchant who held office under the Qing government; he himself had been appointed to act on Hu’s behalf.

说到这里，华尔提出第一个疑问∶『胡先生为什么要委派代表？』
At this, Ward raised his first question. “Why has Mr Hu sent a representative?”

『他受伤了，伤势很重；
“He has been wounded, quite seriously.

为了希望在三到五天以内赶回去，他需要遵守医生的嘱咐，绝不能行动。』
He hopes to return within three to five days, and to do so he must obey the doctor’s orders and remain absolutely still.

古应春说∶『他就住在我家养伤。』
He is recovering at my house.”

『喔！』
“I see.”

华尔是谅解的神态∶『请你说下去。』于是古应春道及本意，
Ward appeared to understand. “Please go on.” Gu explained his purpose.

提出希望以外，还有一番恭维；说华尔一定会站在人道的立场，助成这场义举，而他的勇敢的部下，亦一定会圆满达成任务。
Along with his request, he offered a generous compliment: Ward, he was sure, would support this charitable undertaking on humanitarian grounds, and his brave men would certainly carry out the mission successfully.


说到一半，华尔已在不断摇头；
Before Gu was halfway through, Ward was already shaking his head.

等他说完，随即用冷峻的声音答道∶『抱歉！
As soon as he finished, Ward answered coldly, “I am sorry.

我很同情，但是没有办法给你们什么帮助。』
You have my sympathy, but I can do nothing to help you.”

『这太教我失望了。』
“That is a great disappointment.

古应春问道∶『你能不能告诉我，不能予以帮助的原因？』
May I ask why you cannot help?”

『当然！
“Certainly.

第一，浙江不是我应该派兵的范围；
First, Zhejiang lies outside the area in which I am supposed to deploy troops.

第一，任务很危险，
And the mission is dangerous.

我没有把握。』
I cannot be sure of success.”

『第一个理由，似乎不成立。
“Your first reason hardly seems valid.

我已经说过，这是慈善任务——。』『不！』华尔抢着说∶『我有我的立场。』
As I have already explained, this is a charitable mission—” “No!” Ward interrupted. “I have my responsibilities.”

『你的立场不是助顺——帮助中国政府吗？』
“Are they not to support the established authorities—to assist the Chinese government?”

『是的。』华尔很勉强地说，
“Yes,” Ward said reluctantly.

『我必须先顾到上海。』
“But Shanghai must come first.”

『但是，抽调五十个人，不致于影响你的实力。』
“Detaching fifty men would scarcely impair your strength.”

『是不是会影响，要我来判断。』
“Whether it would or not is for me to judge.”


『上校，』杨坊帮着说好话，『大家都对你抱着莫大的希望，
“Colonel,” Yang put in soothingly, “everyone has placed great hopes in you.

你不应该这样坚拒。』
You should not refuse so categorically.”

『不！』华尔仅自摇头，
“No!” Ward continued to shake his head.

『任务太危险。
“The mission is too dangerous.

这是毫无价值的冒险。』
It is a worthless risk.”

『并不危险！』
“It is not dangerous.”

古应春指萧家骥说∶『他可以为你解释一切情况。』
Gu pointed to Xiao. “He can explain all the circumstances.”

『不！
“No.

我不需要听他的解释。』
I do not need his explanation.”


这样子拒人于千里之外，且大有藐视之意，古应春忍不住火发，
This flat refusal to hear them, with its unmistakable suggestion of contempt, angered Gu.

想到胡雪岩的话，立即有了计较，
Remembering Hu’s advice, he immediately saw what to do.

冷笑一声，面凝寒霜地对杨坊说∶『人言不可信。
With a cold laugh and a face like frost, he turned to Yang. “You cannot believe what people say.

都说客将讲公理正义，急人之急，忠勇奋发；
We are told that these foreign officers uphold justice, hasten to help those in distress, and are full of loyalty and courage.

谁知道完全不是这回事。
Who would have thought it was nothing of the kind?

一群胆怯贪利的佣兵而已！』
They are merely a pack of cowardly, money-grubbing mercenaries!”

说到最后这一句，华尔勃然变色；
At the last words, Ward’s expression changed violently.

霍地站起来，居高临下地俯视着古应春喝道∶『你说谁是胆怯贪利的佣兵？』
He sprang up and glared down at Gu. “Whom are you calling cowardly, money-grubbing mercenaries?”

『你应该知道。』
“You ought to know.”

『我当然知道！』华尔咆哮着∶『你必须道歉，
“I certainly do!” Ward roared. “You must apologize.

我们不是佣兵。』
We are not mercenaries.”

『那末，你是正规军队？』
“Then you are regular troops?”

『当然。』
“Of course.”

『正规军队，一定受人指挥；
“Regular troops must take orders from someone.

请问，你是不是该听命于中国官员？
Tell me, are you not subject to the Chinese authorities?

是薛还是吴；
Is it Xue or Wu?

只要你说了，我自有办法。』
Just give me the name, and I shall find a way.”

这一下击中了华尔的要害，
This touched Ward’s most vulnerable point.

如果承认有人可以指挥他；那末找了可以指挥他的人来下命令，
If he admitted that someone could command him, they could simply have that person issue an order.

岂不是自贬身分。
Would that not diminish his own standing?

『说老实话，贪利这一点，也许我过分了；
Gu continued, “To be fair, perhaps I went too far in accusing you of greed.

但是我不承认说你胆怯，也是错了！』
But I do not admit that I was wrong to call you a coward.”

『你最大的错误，就是这一点。
“That is your greatest mistake.

说一个军人胆怯，你知道不知道是多么大的侮辱？』
Do you realize what an insult it is to call a soldier a coward?”


古应春丝毫不让，针锋相对地顶了过去∶『如果是侮辱；也因为你自己的表现就是如此！』
Gu gave no ground, meeting him word for word. “If it is an insult, your own conduct has invited it.”

『什么！』
“What!”

华尔一把抓住了古应春的肩，使劲地摇撼着∶『你说！
Ward seized him by the shoulder and shook him hard. “Tell me!

我何处有胆怯的表现？』
How have I shown cowardice?”

一看他要动武，萧家骥护师心切，首先就横身阻挡；
Seeing violence threaten his master, Xiao immediately stepped between them.

接着杨坊也来相劝，无奈华尔的气力大，又是盛怒之际，死不放手。
Yang also tried to intervene, but Ward was strong and furious, and would not let go.

古应春却是神色泰然，
Gu remained perfectly composed.

冷冷说道∶『凡是胆怯的人，都是勇于私斗的。』
“Cowards are always brave enough in private quarrels,” he said coldly.

一句话说得华尔放了手，
At that, Ward released him.

转身对杨坊说道∶『我必须维持我的威信；
Turning to Yang, he declared, “I must maintain my authority.

此人的行为，所侮辱的不是个人，是整个团体。
This man has insulted not merely an individual but the entire force.

这件事相当严重。
It is a serious matter.

如果他没有合理的解释，他将要担负一切不良的后果。』
Unless he has a satisfactory explanation, he will be responsible for all the consequences.”

杨坊不知道古应春葫芦里卖的什么药？不免怨责∶『这样子不大好！
Yang had no idea what Gu was trying to do and could not help reproaching him. “This is hardly the way to proceed.

本是来求人的事，
We came to ask a favour.

怎么大破其脸？
Why provoke an open quarrel?

如今，有点不大好收场了。』
It will be difficult to put matters right now.”

他是用中国话说的，古应春便也用中国话回答他∶『你放心！
He had spoken in Chinese, and Gu answered in the same language. “Do not worry.

我就要逼得他这个样子！
This is precisely the position I wanted to force him into.

我当然有合理的解释。
Of course I have a satisfactory explanation.”

『杨坊哪知道他是依照胡雪岩』请将不如激将『这条』锦囊妙计『，另有妙用；
Yang knew nothing of the further purpose behind Hu’s clever prescription of challenging a commander rather than petitioning him.

只郑重其事地一再嘱咐∶』千万平和，千万平和，不要弄出纠纷来。『
He could only urge Gu repeatedly, and with great earnestness, to keep calm and avoid a dispute.


『你请放心，
“Set your mind at rest.

除非他蛮不讲理，不然一定会服我。』古应春用中国话说了这几句；转脸用英语向华尔说∶『上校！杭州有几十万人，濒临饿死的命运；
Unless he refuses to listen to reason, I shall convince him.” Having said this in Chinese, Gu turned to Ward and continued in English. “Colonel, hundreds of thousands of people in Hangzhou are on the verge of starvation.

他们需要粮食，跟你我现在需要呼吸一样。
They need food as you and I need air at this moment.

如果由于你的帮助，冒险通过这条航路，将粮食运到杭州，有几十万人得以活命。
With your help, we could risk this passage and carry grain into the city, saving hundreds of thousands of lives.

这是「毫无价值的冒险」吗？』
Is that a ‘worthless risk’?”

一句话就将华尔问住了。
The question silenced Ward.

他卷了根烟就着洋灯点燃，在浓密的烟氛中喷出答语∶『冒这个险，没有成功的可能。』
He rolled a cigarette, lit it at the lamp, and sent his answer out through a thick cloud of smoke. “There is no possibility of success.”

『是不是有可能，我们先不谈；
“Let us leave the possibility aside for a moment.

请你回答我的话∶如果冒险成功，有没有价值？』
Answer my question first. If the risk brought success, would it be worth taking?”

华尔被逼得没有办法，只能承认∶『如果能成功，当然有价值。』
Cornered, Ward could only admit, “If it succeeded, of course it would.”


『很好！』
“Excellent!”

古应春紧接着他的话说∶『我认为你是一个有价值的人，当然也愿意做有价值的事。
Gu seized on the admission. “I regard you as a man of worth, and naturally you would wish to do something worthwhile.

你应该记得，我向你说过，这个任务并不危险；
You will recall that I told you the mission was not dangerous.

萧可以向你说明一切情况。
Xiao could explain all the circumstances.

而你，根本不作考虑；
Yet you refused even to consider it.

听到洪杨的部队，先就有了怯意——。』『谁说的！』华尔不大服气，
At the mere mention of the Taiping forces, you lost your nerve—” “Who says so!” Ward protested.

『你在侮蔑我。』
“You are slandering me.”

『我希望你用行为表现你的勇敢；表现你的价值。』
“I should like you to demonstrate your courage by your actions—and show your worth.”

『好！』
“Very well!”

华尔受激，脱口说道∶『让我先了解情况。』
Stung into agreement, Ward blurted out, “Let me hear the circumstances first.”

说着，便站起身来，走到一张地图面前立定。
He rose and went over to a map.

事情有了转机，杨坊既佩服，又兴奋，赶紧取一桌上的洋灯，同时示意萧家骥去讲解情况。
Delighted by the change and filled with admiration, Yang hurriedly picked up the lamp from the table and motioned Xiao to explain.

连古应春一起跟着过去，
Gu joined them.

在洋灯照映下都望着墙壁上所贴的那张厚洋纸画的地图；
In the lamplight, they all studied the map pinned to the wall, drawn on a sheet of thick foreign paper.

这比中国的舆图复杂得多，又钉着好些红蓝小三角旗，更让人看不明白。
It was far more complicated than a Chinese map, and the many little red and blue triangular flags made it harder still to understand.

但萧家骥在轮船上也常看航海图；
Xiao, however, often looked at navigation charts aboard steamships.

所以略略注视了一会，便已了然。
After studying it briefly, he understood it.


『在海上不会遭遇任何敌人；
“We shall encounter no enemy at sea.

可能的危险从这里开始。』
The possible danger begins here.”

萧家骥指着鳖子门说∶『事实上上也只有一处比较危险的地方，
Xiao pointed to Biezimen. “In fact, there is only one stretch that presents much danger.

因为海面辽阔，洪杨部队没有炮艇，不能威胁我们的船只。
The sea is wide, and the Taiping forces have no gunboats, so they cannot threaten our vessels.

只有这一处，南北两座山夹束，是个隘口，
Only here, where hills on the north and south constrict the channel, is there a narrow passage.

也就是闻名的「浙江潮」所以造成的由来，
This is what produces the famous Zhejiang tidal bore.

冲过这个隘口，江面又宽了，危险也就消失了。』
Once we have passed through it, the river widens again, and the danger is over.”

『那么这个隘口的江面，有多宽？』
“Then how wide is the river at that passage?”



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第一章（本章第6部分，共6部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


『没有测量过。
“It has never been measured.

但是在岸上用长枪射击，就能打到船上也没有力量了。』
But even if a shot fired from the shore reached a vessel, it would have lost its force.”

华尔摇摇头∶『我不怕步枪。』他接着又问∶『有没有炮台？』
Ward shook his head. “Rifles do not worry me.” Then he asked, “Are there any batteries?”

『决没有。』古应春在旁边接口。
“Certainly not,” Gu answered from beside him.

『即使没有炮台，也一定有临时安置的炮位。
“Even without permanent batteries, there must be temporary gun positions.

如果是我，一定在这里部署炮兵阵地。』
If I were there, I should certainly deploy artillery at this point.”

『你不要将洪杨部队，估计得太高。』古应春又说，
“You must not rate the Taiping forces too highly,” Gu said.

『他们不可能了解你们的兵法。』
“They cannot understand your methods of warfare.”

这一点，华尔认为说得不错；
Ward thought there was truth in this.

他跟长毛接过许多次仗，对此颇有了解，
He had fought the rebels many times and knew something of their abilities.

他们连用洋枪都不十分熟练，当然不会懂得用火力扼守要隘的战法。
They were not even fully proficient with foreign firearms; naturally, they would not understand the tactics of holding a strategic passage by concentrated fire.

要进一步看，即使懂得，亦用不着防守这个隘口，
Moreover, even if they did understand, there would be no reason to defend this particular passage.

因为在这一带的清军，兵力薄弱，更无水师会通过这个隘口，增援杭州；
The Qing forces in the area were weak, and there was no naval force likely to pass through it to relieve Hangzhou.

那末，布炮防守，岂不是置利器于无用之地。
To station guns there would be to put valuable weapons where they served no purpose.


但是，『多算胜』的道理，中外兵法都是一样的；
Still, the principle that victory favoured the side which planned more carefully was common to Chinese and foreign military thinking.

华尔觉得还是要采用比较安全的办法，
Ward preferred to take the safer course.

所以又问∶『这个隘口，是不是很长？』
“Is this narrow passage very long?” he asked.

『不会。』古应春估计着说∶『至多十里八里路。』
“No,” Gu estimated. “Eight or ten li at most.”

『那末，用什么船呢？』
“And what sort of vessels will you use?”

『用海船。』
“Sea-going junks.”

所谓海船就是沙船。
These were the flat-bottomed trading vessels known as shachuan.

华尔学的是陆军，对船舶是外行；不过风向顺逆之理总知道的，
Ward was trained for land warfare and knew little about ships, but he understood the effect of a favourable or contrary wind.

指着地图说道∶『现在是西北风的季节，
Pointing to the map, he said, “This is the season of northwesterly winds.

由东向西行驶；风向很不利。』
Sailing from east to west, you will have the wind against you.”

『这一点，』古应春很谨慎地答道∶『我想你不必过虑，
“On that point,” Gu answered cautiously, “I do not think you need be too anxious.

除了用帆以外，总还有其它辅助航行的办法。
Besides sails, there must be other ways of helping the vessels along.

海船坚固高大，
These sea-going junks are large and strongly built.

船身就具备相当的防御力；
Their hulls alone provide considerable protection.

照我想，是相当安全的。』
I should think them fairly safe.”

『这方面，我还要研究；
“I must look into that further.

我要跟船队的指挥者研究。
I shall have to discuss it with the commander of the flotilla.

最好，我们能在黑夜之间，偷渡这个隘口，避免跟洪杨部队发生正面的冲突。』
Ideally, we should slip through the passage at night and avoid a direct engagement with the Taiping forces.”

这样的口气，已经是答应派兵护航了，
His tone already suggested agreement to provide an escort.

杨坊便很高兴地说∶『谢谢上校！
Yang spoke with delight. “Thank you, Colonel!

我们今天就作个决定，将人数以及你所希望补助的饷银，定规下来，你看如何？』
Shall we settle the matter today—the number of men and the contribution you would like towards their pay?”


『你们要五十个人，
“You asked for fifty men.

我照数派给你们。
I shall give you fifty.

其他的细节，请你们明天跟我的军需官商量。』
Discuss the other details with my quartermaster tomorrow.”

『好的！』杨坊欣然答道∶『完全遵照你的意思。』
“Certainly!” Yang replied gladly. “We shall do exactly as you wish.”

于是『化干戈为玉帛』，
Hostility had given way to friendship.

古应春亦含笑道谢，告辞上车。
Gu too smiled, offered his thanks, and took his leave.

『老古，』在车中，杨坊表示钦佩∶『你倒是真有一套。
“Gu,” Yang said admiringly in the carriage, “you really know how to handle a situation.

以后我们多多合作。』
We must work together more often.”

『侥幸！亏得高人指点。』
“It was good luck, with some guidance from a wiser man.

古应春说∶『也是胡道台一句话∶请将不如激将。
Intendant Hu gave me one piece of advice: a challenge will move a commander more readily than a request.

果然把华尔激成功了。』
And it did move Ward.”

『原来胡道台也是办洋务的好手。』
“So Intendant Hu is skilled in dealing with foreigners as well.”

『他倒不十分懂洋务，
“He knows little of foreign affairs.

只是人情熟透熟透！』
What he understands through and through is human nature.”

『几时我倒要见见他。』杨坊又说∶『华尔的「军需官」，也是我们中国人；我极熟的。
“I must meet him sometime,” Yang said. “Ward’s quartermaster is Chinese, and I know him extremely well.

明天晚上我约他出来吃花酒，
Tomorrow evening I shall invite him to dine with courtesans.

一切都好谈。』
Everything will be easy to discuss.”

『那好极了。
“Excellent.

应该我做东。
I ought to be the host.

明天早晨，我就行帖子送到你那里，请你代劳。』
Tomorrow morning I shall send the invitations to your house and ask you to arrange it.”


『你做东，还是我做东，都一样。
“It makes no difference whether you give the dinner or I do.

这就不去说它了，
Let us leave that aside.

倒是有句话，我要请教∶杭州不是被围了吗？
There is something I should like to ask you. Is Hangzhou not under siege?

粮船到了那里，怎么运进城。』
Once the grain boats get there, how will the rice enter the city?”

这句话让古应春一楞，
