Gu was taken aback.

『啊，』他如梦初醒似地，
“Ah!” he said, as though waking from a dream.

『这倒是！
“Of course.

我还没有想到。
I had not thought of that.

等我回去问了，再答复你。』
I shall ask when I get back and let you know.”

『可以不可以今天就给我一个确实回音？』
“Could you give me a definite answer tonight?”

到了杭州的事，此刻言之过早；
It seemed premature to worry about what would happen once the boats reached Hangzhou.

而且米能不能运进杭州城，与杨坊无干，
Besides, whether the rice could enter the city was no concern of Yang’s.

何以他这么急着要答复？
Why did he want an answer so urgently?

看起来，别有作用，倒不能不弄个明白。
There seemed to be another purpose behind it, and Gu felt he must find out.

这样想着，便即问道∶『为什么这么急？』
“Why the hurry?”

『我另外有个想法。
“I have another idea.

如果能运进杭州城，那就不必谈了；
If the rice can enter Hangzhou, there is nothing more to say.

否则——。』杨坊忽然问道∶『能不能此刻就替我引见，
Otherwise—” Yang broke off to ask, “Could you introduce me to him now?

我想跟胡道台当面谈一谈。』
I should like to discuss it with Intendant Hu himself.”

『这有什么不可以？』
“Why not?”


于是马车转向，直驶古家；
The carriage changed direction and drove straight to Gu’s house.

车一停，萧家骥首先奔了进去通知。
As soon as it stopped, Xiao ran inside to announce the visitor.

胡雪岩很讲究礼节，要起床在客厅里迎接会面；
A great stickler for courtesy, Hu wanted to get out of bed and receive him in the reception room.

七姑奶奶坚决反对，
The Seventh Lady firmly opposed this.

结果折衷办法，起床而不出房门，就在卧室里接见客人。
They finally compromised: he might get up, but must remain in his bedroom and receive the guest there.

女眷自然回避。
Naturally, the women withdrew.

等古应春将杨坊迎了进来，胡雪岩已经穿上长袍马褂，扶着萧家骥的肩，等在门口了。
By the time Gu ushered Yang inside, Hu had put on a long gown and riding jacket and was waiting at the doorway, leaning on Xiao’s shoulder.

彼此都闻名已久，
Each had long known the other by reputation.

所以见礼以后，非常亲热，互相仰慕，话题久久不断。
Once the formal greetings were over, they spoke with great warmth and mutual admiration, their conversation continuing for some time.

古应春找个机会，插进话去，将与华尔交涉的经过，略略说了一遍；
Gu found an opening to give a brief account of the negotiations with Ward.

胡雪岩原已从萧家骥口中，得知梗概，此刻少不得要向杨坊殷殷致谢。
Hu had already heard the outline from Xiao, but now he naturally thanked Yang most earnestly.

『都是为家乡的事，
“It concerns our home province.

应当出力。
I ought to do what I can.

不过，』杨坊急转直下的转入本题∶『粮船到了杭州，不晓得怎么运进杭州？』
But”—Yang turned abruptly to the business that concerned him—“once the grain boats reach Hangzhou, how is the rice to enter the city?”


提到这一层，胡雪岩的脸色，马上转为忧郁了；
At this, Hu’s face immediately clouded.

叹口气说∶『唉！
He sighed.

这件事也是失策。
“That was another mistake.

关城之先，省城里的大员，意见就不一，
Before the city was closed, the high officials disagreed.

有的说十个城门统通要关；有的说应该留一两个不关。
Some wanted all ten gates shut; others thought one or two should be left open.

结果是统统关了。
In the end, they shut them all.

这里一关，长毛马上在城外掘壕沟，做木墙。
As soon as that happened, the rebels dug trenches and put up wooden barriers outside.

围困得实腾腾。』他一口气说到这里，喘息了一下又说∶『当初还有人提议，从城上筑一道斜坡，直到江边，作为粮道。
They sealed us in completely.” Having said this in one breath, he paused for air, then continued. “Someone had proposed building a sloping causeway from the city wall right down to the river, to serve as a supply route.

这个主意听起来出奇∶大家都笑。
It sounded so extraordinary that everyone laughed.

而且工程也浩大，所以就没有办。
The work would also have been enormous, so nothing was done.

其实，此刻想来，实在是一条好计；
Looking back now, it was an excellent idea.

如果能够这么做，虽费点事，可是粮道不断，杭州就能守得住！』
It would have taken some trouble, but with the supply route open, Hangzhou could have held out.”

接着，又是一声长叹。
He gave another long sigh.

听得这样说法，古应春先就大为着急∶『小爷叔，』他问∶『照你这么说，我们不是劳而无功？』
Gu was the first to show alarm. “Little Uncle, if that is so, will all our efforts be wasted?”

『这也不见得。』
“Not necessarily.

胡雪岩说∶『只要粮船一到，城里自然拼死命杀开一条血路，护粮进城。』
Once the grain boats arrive, the people inside will fight their way out at all costs and escort the grain into the city.”

杨坊点点头，看一看古应春，欲语不语地；
Yang nodded, glanced at Gu, and seemed about to speak, then stopped.

胡雪岩察言观色，便知其中有话。
Watching his expression, Hu knew he had something to say.


『杨兄，』他说，『你我一见如故，
“Brother Yang, we have met as though we were old friends.

有话尽请直说。』
Please speak freely.”

『是这样的，
“The situation is this.

我当然也希望杭州的同乡，有一口活命的饭吃。
Naturally, I too want our fellow provincials in Hangzhou to have enough food to stay alive.

不过，凡事要从最坏的地方去打算∶万一千辛万苦将粮船开到杭州，城里城外交通断绝，
But one must allow for the worst. Suppose you get the grain boats to Hangzhou after endless hardships, only to find all communication between the city and the outside world cut off.

到时候，胡先生，你怎么办？』
What will you do then, Mr Hu?”

『我请问杨兄，依你看，应该怎么办？』
“What would you advise?”

『在商言商，这许多米，总不能送给长毛，更不能丢在江里。』
“Speaking as a businessman, you can hardly hand all that rice to the rebels or throw it into the river.

杨坊说道∶『如果运不进杭州城，可以不可以请胡先生改运宁波？』
If it cannot enter Hangzhou, could I ask you to divert it to Ningbo?”

原来他急于要见胡雪岩，是为了这句话。
So this was why he had been so eager to meet Hu.

古应春心想∶此人倒也是厉害脚色，『门槛』精得很，不可小觑了他。
Gu thought to himself that Yang was a formidable fellow, shrewd in every calculation, and not to be underestimated.

因此，很注意地要听胡雪岩如何回答。
He listened closely for Hu’s reply.

『杨兄的话很实在。
“That is a practical suggestion.

如果米运不进杭州城，我当然改运别处，
If the rice cannot enter Hangzhou, of course I shall send it elsewhere.

只要不落在长毛手里，运到什么地方都可以。』
So long as it does not fall into rebel hands, any destination will do.”

说到这里，胡雪岩下了一个转语∶『不过，
Then Hu qualified his answer.

杨兄的话，我倒一时答应不下。
“But I cannot promise what you ask just yet.

为什么呢？
Why?

因为宁波的情形，我还不晓得；
Because I do not know the situation in Ningbo.

许了杨兄，倘或办不到，岂不是我变成失信用。』
If I gave you my word and then could not fulfil it, I should be breaking faith.”

『宁波的情形，跟上海差不多——。』
“The situation in Ningbo is much like Shanghai’s—”


因为宁波也有租界。
Ningbo too had a foreign settlement.

江苏的富室逃到上海，浙东的大户，则以宁波租界为避难之地；
Just as wealthy Jiangsu families had fled to Shanghai, the rich households of eastern Zhejiang had taken refuge in the Ningbo settlement.

早在夏天，宁波的士绅就条陈地方官，愿集资五十万两银子，雇英法兵船代守宁波，
As early as the summer, Ningbo’s gentry had submitted proposals to the local authorities, offering to raise five hundred thousand taels to hire British and French warships to defend the city.

及至萧绍失守，太平军一路向东，势如破竹，攻余姚、下慈溪、陷奉化，
After Xiaoshan and Shaoxing fell, the Taiping army swept eastward, taking Yuyao, Cixi, and Fenghua in rapid succession.

宁波旦夕不保；
Ningbo might fall at any moment.

于是英、法、美三国领事，会商以后，决定派人到奉化会晤太平军守将范汝增，劝他暂缓进攻宁波。
The British, French, and American consuls therefore conferred and decided to send representatives to Fenghua to meet the Taiping commander, Fan Ruzeng, and urge him to postpone an attack on Ningbo.

范汝增对这个请求，不作正面答复，但应允保护洋人，
Fan gave no direct answer to the request, but promised to protect foreigners.

因此三国领事已经会衔了布告，保护租界；
The three consuls had consequently issued a joint proclamation guaranteeing the safety of the settlement.

但陆路交通，近乎断绝，商旅裹足，也在大闹粮荒。
Yet land communications were virtually severed, travelling merchants dared not move, and the city was suffering a severe grain shortage.

杨坊的打算，一方面固然是为桑梓尽力；
Yang’s purpose was partly to help his native place.

另一方面亦有善价而沽，趁此机会做一笔生意的想法。
It was also to obtain a good price and make a profitable transaction out of the opportunity.


不过杨坊的私心，自然不肯透露，
His private interest, of course, was something Yang had no intention of revealing.

『胡先生，』他说，『据我晓得，逃在宁波的杭州人也不少。
“Mr Hu, I understand that many Hangzhou people have taken refuge in Ningbo as well.

所以你拿粮食改运宁波，实在是不得已而求其次的唯一出路。』
If you cannot achieve your first object, sending the grain there is really the only alternative.”

『那末，到了宁波呢？
“And when it reaches Ningbo?

如果不能上岸，又怎么办？』
What if it cannot be landed?”

『不会的。
“That will not happen.

英、法、美三国领事，哪一位都可以出面保护你，
Any one of the three consuls—British, French, or American—can arrange protection for you.

到那时候，我当然会从中联络。』
Naturally, I shall make the necessary contacts.”

『既然如此——。』胡雪岩矍然而起——
“In that case—” Hu sprang to his feet.

想好了主意，一时兴奋，忘却腿伤，
A plan had occurred to him, and in his excitement he forgot his injured leg.

一下子摔倒在地，疼得额上沁出黄豆大的汗珠。
He fell to the floor, pain bringing beads of sweat as large as soybeans to his forehead.

萧家骥动作敏捷，赶紧上前扶起；
Xiao quickly stepped forward to help him up.

古应春也吃了一惊，为他检视伤势。
Gu, badly startled, examined the injury.

乱过一阵，胡雪岩方能接着他自己的话说下去。
Only after the commotion subsided could Hu finish what he had been saying.

『杨兄，既然如此，我们做一笔交易。
“Brother Yang, in that case, let us make a bargain.

杭州缺粮，宁波也缺粮，
Hangzhou is short of grain; so is Ningbo.

我们来合作；
We can work together.

宁波，我负责运一批米过去，米、船，都归我想办法。
I shall undertake to send a consignment of rice to Ningbo and find both the rice and the vessels.

杭州这方面，可以不可以请你托洋人出面，借个做善事的名义，将我这一批米护送进城？』
In return, could you ask the foreigners to intervene on charitable grounds and escort this consignment of mine into Hangzhou?”


『这个办法——。』
“That proposal…”

杨坊看着古应春，颇有为难的神情。
Yang looked at Gu, visibly uneasy.

『小爷叔，做生意，动脑筋，不能不当你诸葛亮。』古应春很委婉地说，
“Little Uncle, when it comes to business and ingenuity, we must acknowledge you as a Zhuge Liang,” Gu said tactfully.

『可惜，洋务上，小爷叔你略为有点外行，
“Unfortunately, you are something of a novice in foreign affairs.

这件事行不通。』
This cannot be done.”

『怎么呢？』
“Why not?”

『因为外国领事，出面干预，要有个名目；
“Foreign consuls need grounds for intervening.

运粮到宁波，可以「护侨」为名，为的洋人不能没有食物接济。
Grain can be sent to Ningbo in the name of protecting their nationals, since foreigners must have food.

但杭州的情形就不同了，
Hangzhou is different.

并无英法美三国侨民，需要救济；
There are no British, French, or American residents there in need of relief.

而救济中国百姓，要看地方，
As for feeding Chinese civilians, it depends on the place.

在交战区域，民食军粮是无从区分的。』
In a war zone, there is no way to distinguish food for civilians from provisions for troops.”

等古应春解释完了，杨坊接着补充∶『八月里，英国京城有一道命令给他们的公使，叫做「严守中立」；
When Gu had finished, Yang added, “In the eighth month, the British government sent its minister orders to maintain strict neutrality.

这就是说，哪一面也不帮。
That means helping neither side.

所以胡先生的这个打算，好倒是好，可惜办不通。』
Your proposal is excellent, Mr Hu, but unfortunately it is impracticable.”

胡雪岩当然失望，但不愿形诸颜色；
Hu was disappointed, of course, but did not want to show it.

将话题回到杨坊的要求上，慨然说道∶『那就一言为定了。
Returning to Yang’s request, he declared generously, “Then it is settled.

这批米如果运不进杭州城，就转运宁波。
If this rice cannot enter Hangzhou, we shall divert it to Ningbo.

不过，这话要跟郁老大先说明白；
But Chief Yu must be told beforehand.

到时候，沙船不肯改地方卸货，就要费口舌了。』
If the junk owners refuse to discharge at a different destination, we shall have an argument on our hands.”

『这一层，我当然会请应春兄替我打招呼；
“Of course I shall ask Brother Yingchun to make that clear.

我要请胡先生吩咐的是粮价——。』
What I should like your instructions on is the price of the rice—”


『这不要紧！』
“That is no difficulty!”

胡雪岩有力地打断他的话，
Hu cut in firmly.

『怎么样说都可以。
“We can settle it however you wish.

如果是做生意，当然一分一厘都要算清楚；
If this were business, every fraction of a tael would have to be reckoned.

现在不是做生意。』
But this is not business.”

『是，是！』
“Yes, yes.”

杨坊不免内惭；
Yang felt an inward pang of shame.

自语似地说∶『原是做好事。』
Almost to himself, he said, “Of course, we are doing a good deed.”

谈话到此告一段落，
With that, the discussion reached a conclusion.

古应春怕胡雪岩过于劳累，于伤势不宜，邀了杨坊到客厅里去坐；
Afraid that Hu was tiring himself and delaying his recovery, Gu invited Yang into the reception room.

连萧家骥在一起，商定了跟华尔这方面联络的细节，
There, with Xiao, they settled the details of their further dealings with Ward.

直到深夜方散。
The party did not break up until late at night.


第二天大家分头办事，
Next day everyone went off on his separate business.

只有胡雪岩在古家养伤，反觉清闲无事；
Hu alone remained at Gu’s house to recover, with nothing to occupy him.

行动不便，不能出房门，一个人觉得很气闷，
Unable to move freely or leave his room, he found solitude oppressive.

特为将七姑奶奶请了来，不免有些微怨言。
He sent especially for the Seventh Lady and could not help voicing a mild complaint.

『我是不敢来打扰小爷叔；
“I did not dare disturb you, Little Uncle.

让你好好养伤。』七姑奶奶解释她的好意，
I wanted you to rest and let the wound heal,” she explained.

『说话也费精神的。』
“Talking takes strength too.”

『唉！七姐，你哪晓我的心事。
“Ah, Sister Seven, you do not know what is on my mind.

一个人思前想后，连觉都睡不着；
Left alone, I keep turning things over until I cannot even sleep.

有人谈谈，辰光还好打发。』
Someone to talk to would help the time pass.”

谈亦不能深谈，
Yet they could not talk too deeply.

胡雪岩一家，消息全无，谈起来正触及他的痛处。
There was no news of any member of Hu’s family; to speak of them was to touch his sorest wound.

因此，平日健谈的七姑奶奶，竟变得笨嘴拙舌，不知道说什么好？
The Seventh Lady, ordinarily so talkative, found herself tongue-tied, at a loss for anything to say.

『七姐，』胡雪岩问道∶『这一阵，你跟何姨太太有没有往来？』
“Sister Seven,” Hu asked, “have you had any dealings with Madam He lately?”

何姨太太就是阿巧姐。
Madam He was A’qiao.

从那年经胡雪岩撮合，随着何桂清到通州；
After Hu had arranged her match with He Guiqing, she had accompanied him to Tongzhou.

不久，何桂清果然出仓场侍郎，外放浙江巡抚；升任两江总督，一路扶摇直上。
Before long, He had indeed left his post as granary vice-minister to become governor of Zhejiang, then governor-general of Liangjiang, rising steadily in the world.

阿巧姐着实风光过一阵子。
For a time A’qiao had enjoyed considerable splendour.

『好久没有见到她了。』七姑奶奶不胜感慨地，
“I have not seen her for a long while,” the Seventh Lady said with deep feeling.

『那时候哪个不说她福气好？
“Who did not call her fortunate then?

何大人在常州的时候，我去过一次；
When Mr He was in Changzhou, I visited once.

她特为派官船到松江来接我，还有一百个兵保护，
She sent an official boat to fetch me from Songjiang, with a hundred soldiers for protection.

让我也大大出了一次风光。
I enjoyed a grand occasion myself!

到了常州，何大人也很客气。
Mr He was very courteous when we arrived.

何太太多病，都是姨太太管事，
His wife was often ill, and A’qiao managed everything.

走到哪里，丫头老妈子一大群跟着，
Wherever she went, a whole crowd of maids and serving women followed.

那份气派还了得！
What airs and grandeur!

人也长得越漂亮了，满头珠翠，
She had grown prettier too, her hair full of pearls and jade.

看上去真象一品夫人。
She looked every inch the wife of a first-rank official.

哪晓得何大人坏了事！
Who could have imagined that Mr He would come to grief?

前一晌听人说，人都老得认不得了。
Not long ago someone told me she had aged beyond recognition.

伍子胥过昭关，一夜工夫急白了头发；
They say Wu Zixu’s hair turned white in a single night as he struggled to get through Zhaoguan Pass.

看起来真有这样的事。』
It seems such things really do happen.”

『这样说起来，她倒还是有良心的。』
“Then she has a conscience after all.”


『小爷叔是说她为何制台急成这个样子？』
“You mean she has worried herself into this state over Governor-General He?”

『是啊！』胡雪岩说，
“Yes.

『我听王雪公说，何制台的罪名不得了。』
Governor Wang told me the charges against him are extremely grave.”

『怎样不得了？
“How grave?

莫非还要杀头？』
Surely they would not behead him?”

胡雪岩看着她，慢慢点头，意思是说∶你不要不信，确有可能。
Hu looked at her and slowly nodded, as if to say that, unbelievable though it might seem, it was quite possible.

『这样大的官儿，也会杀头？』
“They would execute an official as high as that?”

七姑奶奶困惑地，大有不可思议之感。
The Seventh Lady found it almost inconceivable.

『当然要杀！』
“Of course they should!”

胡雪岩忽然出现了罕见的激动，
Hu suddenly became agitated in a way she seldom saw.

『不借一两个人头做榜样，国家搞不好的。
“Unless one or two heads are taken as an example, the country will never be put right.

平常作威作福，要粮要饷，说起来是为了朝廷、为了百姓；
In ordinary times they lord it over everyone, demanding grain and money, claiming it is all for the court and the people.

到真正该他出力的时候，收拾细软，一溜了之。
When the moment comes for them to do their duty, they gather up their valuables and run.

象这样的人，可以安安稳稳拿刮来的钱过舒服日子；尽心出力，打仗阵亡的人，不是太冤枉了吗？』
If men like that can live comfortably on the money they have squeezed out of others, what justice is there for the men who do their utmost and die fighting?”

七姑奶奶从未见过朝雪岩有这样气急败坏的愤激之态，因而所感受的冲击极大。
She had never seen him so fiercely indignant, and the outburst affected her deeply.

同时也想到了他的境况；心里有着说不出的难过。
Thinking too of his own position, she felt a grief she could not express.


『小爷叔，』她不由自主地说∶『我看，你也用不着到杭州去了；
“Little Uncle,” she said involuntarily, “I do not think you need return to Hangzhou.

粮船叫五哥的学生子跟家骥押了去，
Let Brother Five’s disciple and Jiaji escort the grain boats.

你在上海养养伤，
Stay in Shanghai and let your wound heal.

想办法去寻着了老太太，拿一家人都接到上海来，
Find a way to locate your mother and bring the whole family here.

岂不甚好？』
Would that not be better?”

『七姐，谢谢你！
“Thank you, Sister Seven.

你是替我打算，
You are thinking of my interests.

不过办不到。』
But it cannot be done.”

『这有什么办不到？』七姑奶奶振振有词地说话∶『这一路去，有你无你都一样。
“Why not?” she argued vigorously. “On the voyage it makes no difference whether you are there or not.

船归李得隆跟沙船帮的人料理；
Li Delong and the Sea-Junk Guild will handle the vessels.

洋将派来保护的兵，归家骥接头。
Jiaji will deal with the troops sent by the foreign commander.

你一个受了伤的人，自己还要有人照应，
You are wounded and need looking after yourself.

去了有帮什么忙？
What help could you give?

越帮越忙，反而是累赘。』
You would only make more trouble and become a burden.”

『话不错。
“That is true.

不过到了杭州，没有我在从中联络，跟王雪公接不上头，岂不误了大事？』
But once they reach Hangzhou, without me to make contact with Governor Wang, the whole undertaking might be ruined.”

想一想这话也不错；
On reflection, she could see the force of that.

七姑奶奶便又问道∶『只要跟王抚台接上头，城里派兵出来运粮进城；小爷叔，就没有你的事了。』
“Once you have reached Governor Wang, and the city sends troops out to escort the grain inside, there is nothing more you need do?”

『对。』
“That is so.”

『那就这样，
“Then do this.

小爷叔，你不要进城，
Do not enter the city.

原船回上海；
Return to Shanghai on the same boat.

我们再商量下一步，怎么样想法子去寻老太太。』
We can discuss the next step and how to find your mother.

七姑奶奶又说，『其实，小爷叔你就在杭州城外访查也可以；
You could even make enquiries outside Hangzhou yourself.

总而言之，已经出来了，决没有自投罗网的道理。』
In any case, having got out, you must not walk back into the trap.”

『这话也说得是——。』
“There is truth in that too—”


听他的语气，下面还有转语；
His tone suggested that an objection was coming.

七姑奶奶不容他出口，抢着说道∶『本来就是嘛，
Before he could voice it, the Seventh Lady broke in. “Of course there is!

小爷叔，你是做生意的大老板；
You are a great businessman, Little Uncle.

捐班的道台，
You purchased your rank as intendant.

跟何制台不同，没有啥守土的责任。』
You are not like Governor-General He; you have no responsibility for defending territory.”

『不尽是为公，
“It is not entirely a matter of public duty.

为的是交情。』胡雪岩说∶『我有今天，都是王抚台的提拔，
It is friendship,” Hu replied. “Everything I am today is due to Governor Wang’s support.

他现在这样子为难，真正是在十八层地狱里受熬煎，
He is in such desperate straits now, suffering as though he were in the deepest hell.

我不跟他共患难，良心上说不过去。』
If I will not share his danger, my conscience will never be clear.”

『这自然是义气，
“That is loyalty, certainly.

不过这份义气，没啥用处。』七姑奶奶说，
But loyalty of that sort serves no purpose.

『倒不如你在外头打接应，还有用些。』
You could do him more good by helping from outside.”

这话说得很有道理，但胡雪岩总觉得不能这么做。
Her argument was sound, yet Hu still felt he could not act on it.

他做事一向有决断，不容易为感情所左右——
Ordinarily he was decisive and not easily swayed by sentiment.

其实，就是为感情所左右，也总在自己的算盘上先要打得通；
Even when sentiment did move him, the course of action usually had to make sense in his own calculations first.

道穿了，不妨说是利用感情。
To put it plainly, he might be said to make use of sentiment.

而对王有龄，又当别论了。
With Wang Youling, however, it was different.


『唉！』他叹口气，
He sighed.

『七姐，我何尝不知道你是一句好话；
“Sister Seven, do you think I cannot see that your advice is good?

不但对我一个人好，而且对王雪公也好。
Good not only for me, but for Governor Wang as well.

不过，我实在办不到。』
Yet I simply cannot do it.”

『这就奇怪了！
“That is strange!

既然对你好，对他也好，又为什么不这么做？
If it is good for you and good for him, why not do it?

小爷叔，你平日为人不是这样的。』
This is not like you.”

『是的。我平日为人不是这样；
“No, it is not.

唯独这件事，不知道怎么，想来想去想不通。
But in this one matter, however much I think, I cannot find a way through.

第一、我怕王雪公心里会说；胡某人不够朋友，
First, I fear Governor Wang will say to himself: ‘Hu is no true friend.

到要紧关头，他一个人丢下我不管了。
At the critical moment, he abandoned me and saved himself.’

第二、我怕旁人说我，只晓得富贵，不知道啥叫生死交情？』
Second, I fear other people will say I understand wealth and honour but know nothing of friendship that stands the test of life and death.”

『嗳！』
“Oh!”

七姑奶奶有些着急了，因此口不择言∶『小爷叔，你真是死脑筋，
Growing impatient, she spoke without choosing her words. “Little Uncle, you are being stubborn.

旁人的话，哪里听得那么多，
How can you listen to everything other people say?

要说王抚台，既然你们是这样深的交情，他也应该晓得你的心。
As for Governor Wang, if your friendship runs so deep, he ought to understand your heart.

而况，你又并没有丢下他不管；
Besides, you would not be abandoning him.

还是替他在外办事。』
You would still be working for him outside.”

说到这里，她觉得有一肚子的议论要发∶『为人总要通情达理。
Now she felt she had a great deal more to say. “People must be reasonable.

三纲五常，总也要合道理，才有用处。
Even the Three Bonds and Five Constant Virtues are useful only when they make sense.

我最讨厌那些伪道学，或者不明事理的说法∶什么「君要臣死，不能不死∶父要子亡，不得不亡」！
I cannot bear those moralizing hypocrites and their unreasonable doctrines: ‘If the ruler orders his minister to die, he must die; if the father orders his son to perish, he must perish.’

你倒想想看，
Just think!

忠臣死了，哪个替皇帝办事？
If the loyal minister is dead, who will serve the emperor?

儿子死了，这一家断宗绝代，孝心又在哪里？』
If the son dies and the family line ends, where is the filial devotion in that?”


胡雪岩笑了，
Hu laughed.

『七姐，』他说，『听你讲道理，真是我们杭州人说的∶』刮拉松脆「。
“Sister Seven, listening to you reason is what we Hangzhou people call crisp and clear.

好痛快！
How refreshing!”

『』小爷叔，你不要恭维我；
“Do not flatter me.

你如果觉得我的话，还有点道理，那就要听我的劝！
If you think my words have any sense in them, take my advice!”

『七姑奶奶讲完君臣、父子；又谈』第五伦『朋友∶』我听说大书的说「三国」，
Having dealt with ruler and minister, father and son, she turned to friendship, the fifth of the human relationships. “I have heard storytellers recite the Three Kingdoms.

桃园结义，刘关张不愿同年同月同日生，但愿同年同月同日死，
When Liu Bei, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei swear brotherhood in the Peach Garden, they say they do not ask to have been born in the same year, month, and day, but wish to die in the same year, month, and day.

这话就不通！
That makes no sense either!

如果讲义气的好朋友，死了一个，别的都跟着他一起去死，这世界上，不就没有君子，只剩小人了？
If one loyal friend dies and all the others follow him to the grave, will there not be a world without decent men, with only scoundrels left?”

『『这话倒是。』胡雪岩兴味盎然，
“True enough,” Hu said, thoroughly interested.

『凡事不能寻根问底，
“One must not examine everything too closely.

追究到底好些话都不通。』
Follow things to their foundations, and a great many sayings cease to make sense.”


『原是如此！
“Exactly!

小爷叔，这天把，我夜里总在想你的情形；
Little Uncle, these last nights I have been thinking about your situation.

想你，当然也要想到王抚台。
And if I think of you, naturally I must think of Governor Wang.

我从前听你说过，他曾劝过何制台不要从常州逃走；说一逃就身败名裂了！
You once told me that he urged Governor-General He not to flee Changzhou, warning that flight would ruin his name and standing.

这话现在让他说中；
That prediction has come true.

想来杭州如果不保，王抚台是决不会逃走；
If Hangzhou cannot be saved, I am sure Governor Wang will never flee.

做个大大的忠臣。
He will be a great loyal servant of the dynasty.

不过，你要替他想一想，他还有什么好朋友替他料理后事？
But consider this for his sake: what friend has he to take care of his affairs after his death?

不就是小爷叔你吗？
Who but you?”

『这话说得胡雪岩矍然动容，
Hu looked up, visibly moved.

『七姐，』他不安地，『你倒提醒我了。』
“Sister Seven,” he said uneasily, “you have reminded me of something important.”

『谢天谢地！』
“Thank Heaven!”

七姑奶奶合掌当胸，长长地舒了口气∶『小爷叔，你总算想通了。』
She pressed her palms together at her breast and let out a long breath. “At last you have seen reason.”

『想是还没有想通。
“Not quite.

不过，这件事倒真的要好好想一想。』
But this really is something I must think about carefully.”


于是他一面跟七姑奶奶闲谈，一面在心里盘算。
He continued talking with her while turning the matter over in his mind.

看样子七姑奶奶的话丝毫不错，王有龄这个忠臣是做定了！
It appeared that she was entirely right: Wang Youling was determined to fulfil the role of a loyal minister.

杭州的情形，要从外面看，才知道危险；
Only from outside could one see how perilous Hangzhou’s position was.

被围在城里的，心心念念只有一个想法∶救兵一到，便可解围。
Those shut inside the besieged city had only one thought: once reinforcements arrived, the siege would be lifted.

其实，就是李元度在衢州的新军能够打到杭州，亦未见得能击退重重包围的长毛。
Yet even if Li Yuandu’s newly raised army at Quzhou could fight its way to Hangzhou, it might not be able to drive off the many surrounding rebel forces.

破城是迟早间事；王有龄殉节，亦是迟早间事。
The city’s fall was only a matter of time; so was Wang’s death in the cause of loyalty.

且不说一城的眼光，都注视在他身上，容不得他逃；就有机会也不能逃走，
Quite apart from the eyes of the whole city, which were fixed upon him and would not permit him to flee, he could not run even if an opportunity presented itself.

因为一逃，不但所有的苦头都算白吃，
Escape would make all his suffering meaningless.

而且象何桂清这样子，就能活又有什么味道？
And if he lived on as He Guiqing now did, what pleasure would there be in life?

『我想通了。』胡雪岩说∶『王雪公是死定了！
“I have thought it through,” Hu said. “Governor Wang is bound to die.

我要让他死得值。』
I must make his death count.”


『是嘛！』
“Exactly!”

七姑奶奶异常欣慰，
The Seventh Lady was immensely relieved.

『原说小爷叔是绝顶聪明的人，
“I always said you were an exceptionally clever man.

哪里会连这点道理都想不通？
How could you fail to grasp so simple a truth?

常言的道的是「生死交情」，
People speak of friendship through life and death.

一个人死了，有人照他生前那样子待他；这个人就算有福气了。』
If, after a man dies, someone still treats him as faithfully as when he was alive, he is a fortunate man.”

『是啊！
“Yes.

他殉了节，一切都在我身上；
Once he dies for his duty, everything will fall to me.

就怕——。』他虽没有说出口来，也等于说明白了一样——。
My only fear is—” Though he stopped, his meaning was as plain as if he had finished.

这倒不是他自己嫌忌讳；是怕七姑奶奶伤心。
It was not that he himself shrank from mentioning an ill omen; he feared distressing her.

然而，在这样的情形之下，以七姑奶奶的性情，自然也会有句痛快话。
But in such circumstances a woman of her temperament would naturally have something direct to say.

『小爷叔，这一层你请放心。
“Little Uncle, set your mind at ease on that score.

万一有个三长两短，一切都在我们兄妹夫妻身上。』
If anything happens to you, my brother, my husband, and I will take everything upon ourselves.”

『是了！』
“Good!”

胡雪岩大大地喘了口气，
Hu drew a great breath.

『有七姐你这句话，我什么地方都敢去闯。』
“With that assurance from you, Sister Seven, there is nowhere I would fear to venture.”

这话又说得不中听了，
This again was unwelcome language.

七姑奶奶有些不安∶『小爷叔，』她惴惴然地问∶『你是怎么闯法？』
Uneasily, she asked, “Little Uncle, what sort of venture do you mean?”

『我当然不会闯到死路上去。
“I certainly do not mean rushing down a road to death.

我说的闯是，遇到难关，壮起胆子来闯。』胡雪岩说，
I mean facing a difficult passage with courage.

『不瞒你说，这一路来，我遇见长毛，实在有点怕；
To tell you the truth, I was rather frightened whenever I encountered the rebels on my way here.

现在我不怕了，
Now I am not afraid.

越怕越误事，
The more frightened one is, the more likely one is to make a mistake.

索性大胆去闯，反倒没事。』
Facing things boldly may prove the safer course.”



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第二章（本章第1部分，共4部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第二章
CHAPTER TWO


由济河出长江，经崇明岛南面入海；
They sailed out of the Ji River into the Yangtze, then passed south of Chongming Island and entered the sea.

一共是十八号沙船，
There were eighteen sea junks in all.

保护的洋兵——最后商量定规，一共是一百十二个人，一百士兵，大多是『吕宋人』；十二个官长，七个吕宋人，三个美国人，还有两个中国人算是联络官。
The foreign escort, as finally agreed, numbered a hundred and twelve: a hundred soldiers, most of them men from Luzon, and twelve officers—seven from Luzon, three Americans and two Chinese serving as liaison officers.

分坐两号沙船，插在船队中间。
They occupied two junks in the middle of the convoy.

胡雪岩是在第一条船上。同船的有萧家骥、李得隆、郁馥华派来的『船老大』李庆山；还有一个姓孔的联络官。
Hu Xueyan travelled aboard the leading vessel, together with Xiao Jiaji, Li Delong, the skipper Li Qingshan whom Yu Fuhua had sent, and a liaison officer surnamed Kong.

一切进退行止，都由这五个人在这条船上商量停当，发号施令。
These five settled every question of movement and action aboard that vessel and issued the orders.

一上船，胡雪岩就接到警告，沙船行在海里，忌讳甚多，
As soon as he came aboard, Hu was warned of the many taboos observed when sea junks sailed at sea.

舵楼上所设，内供天后神牌的小神龛，尤其不比等闲。
The little shrine on the steering deck, containing a spirit tablet of the Queen of Heaven, was especially sacred.

想起『是非只为多开口』这句话，胡雪岩在船上便不大说话，
Remembering the saying that trouble comes from speaking too much, Hu said little.

闲下来只躺在铺位上想心事。
In his spare time he merely lay on his bunk, absorbed in thought.

但是，别人不同，
The others behaved differently.

萧家骥虽惯于水上生活，但轮船上并无这些忌讳；姓孔的更不在乎；
Xiao was accustomed to life afloat, but steamships had none of these taboos, and Kong cared even less about them.

李庆山和李得隆识得忌讳，不该说虽不说，该说的还是照常要说。
Li Qingshan and Li Delong knew which subjects to avoid; they refrained from saying what ought not to be said but otherwise talked as usual.

相形之下，就显得平日谈笑风生的胡雪岩仿佛心事重重，神情万分抑郁似的。
Beside them, Hu, normally so lively and entertaining, seemed weighed down by cares and sunk in the deepest gloom.


于是姓孔的提议打麻将，
Kong suggested mahjong.

萧家骥为了替胡雪岩解除寂寞，特地去请他入局。
Hoping to relieve Hu’s loneliness, Xiao went specially to invite him to join them.

『五个人怎么打。
“How can five of us play?

除非一个人做——。』说到『做』字，胡雪岩缩住了口；
Unless one man has a—” Hu stopped short.

他记起坐过『水路班子』的船，『梦』是忌讳的，要说『黄粱子』，
He remembered travelling on a floating pleasure boat, where the word “dream” was taboo and had to be replaced by “golden millet”.

便接下去∶『除非一个人做黄粱子。』
“Unless one man has his golden millet,” he finished.

萧家骥一楞，想了一下才明白，
Xiao stared, then understood.

『用不着。』他说，
“There is no need,” he said.

『我不想打。
“I do not wish to play.

胡先生你来，
Come, Mr Hu.

解解厌气。』
It will relieve the tedium.”

于是胡雪岩无可无不可地入了局。
Indifferent either way, Hu joined the game.

打到一半，风浪大作，被迫终止；
Halfway through, a gale and heavy seas forced them to stop.

胡雪岩又回到铺上去睡觉，
He returned to his bunk to sleep.

心里不免忐忑不安，加以不惯风涛之险，大呕大吐，
He was anxious enough already; now, unused to the violence of the wind and waves, he began vomiting miserably.

心里那份不宁帖，真有求生不得，求死不能之感。
His whole being was so unsettled that life seemed intolerable, while death offered no escape.

『胡先生，不要紧的！』
“There is nothing to worry about, Mr Hu!”

萧家骥一遍一遍地来安慰他。
Xiao came again and again to comfort him.

不光是语言安慰，还有起居上的照料，对待胡雪岩真象对待古应春一样，尊敬而亲热。
Nor did he offer words alone: he attended to all Hu’s needs, with the same affectionate respect he showed Gu Yingchun.

胡雪岩十分感动，
Hu was deeply touched.

心里有许多话，只是精神不佳，懒得去说。
There was much he wanted to say, but he felt too ill to make the effort.


入夜风平浪静，
By nightfall the wind and waves had subsided.

海上涌出一轮明月，胡雪岩晕船的毛病，不药而愈，
A bright moon rose out of the sea, and Hu’s seasickness vanished without medicine.

只是腹饥难忍，
Now, however, hunger tormented him.

记得七姑奶奶曾亲手放了一盒外国饼干在网篮，
He remembered the box of foreign biscuits that the Seventh Lady had put into his mesh basket with her own hands.

起床摸索，惊醒了熟睡中的萧家骥。
He got up to search for it and woke Xiao, who had been sleeping soundly.

『是我！』他歉然说道∶『想寻点干点心吃。』
“It is only me,” he said apologetically. “I was looking for something dry to eat.”

『胡先生人舒服了！』萧家骥欣然说道∶『尾舱原留了粥在那里，
“You feel better, Mr Hu!” Xiao said delightedly. “They kept some congee for you in the stern cabin.

我替你去拿来。』
I shall fetch it.”

于是萧家骥点上了盏马灯，到尾舱去端了粥米，另外是一碟盐鱼，一个盐蛋；
He lit a storm lantern and went aft, returning with the congee, a plate of salted fish and a salted egg.

胡雪岩吃得一干二净，抹一抹嘴笑道∶『世乱年荒，做人就讲究不到哪里去了。』
Hu ate everything, wiped his mouth and smiled. “In times of war and famine, one cannot be too particular about how one lives.”


『做人不在这上面，讲究的是心。』萧家骥说，
“What matters in a man’s life is not that sort of thing, but his heart,” Xiao said.

『王抚台交胡先生这样的朋友，总算是有眼光的。』
“Governor Wang showed sound judgement in choosing a friend like you.”

『没有用！』
“It is no use!”

胡雪岩黯然，
Hu’s face darkened.

『尽人事，听天命。
“We do what we can and leave the rest to Heaven.

就算到了杭州，也还不知道怎么个情形；
Even if we reach Hangzhou, who knows what we shall find?

说不定就在这一刻，杭州城已经破了。』
The city may be falling at this very moment.”

『不会的。』萧家骥安慰他说∶『我们总要朝好的地方去想。』
“No,” Xiao said consolingly. “We must always look towards the brighter possibility.”

『对！』
“True!”

胡雪岩很容易受鼓舞，
Hu was easily encouraged.

『人，就活在希望里面。
“Hope is what keeps a man alive.

家骥，我倒问你，你将来有什么打算？』
Jiaji, tell me: what do you mean to do in the future?”

这话使萧家骥有如逢知音之感。
Xiao felt that at last he had found someone who understood him.

连古应春都没有问过他这句话。
Not even Gu had ever asked him that question.

所以满腹大志，无从诉说；不想这时候倒有了倾诉的机会。
All his great ambitions had remained unspoken; now, unexpectedly, he had a chance to pour them out.

『我将来要跟外国人一较短长。
“One day I mean to compete with the foreigners.

我总是在想，他们能做的，我们为什么不能做？
I am always asking myself: why should we not do what they can do?

中国人的脑筋，不比外国人差，
Chinese minds are no worse than theirs.

就是不团结；
We simply fail to work together.

所以我要找几个志同道合的人，联合起来，跟外国人比一比。』
I want to find a few men who share my aims, join forces with them and see how we measure up against the foreigners.”

『有志气！』胡雪岩脱口赞道∶『我算一个。
“That is ambition!” Hu exclaimed in admiration. “Count me in.

你倒说说看，怎么样跟他们比？』
Tell me how you propose to compete.”

『自然是做生意。
“In business, naturally.

他到我们这里来做生意，我们也可以到他那里去做生意。
They come here to trade; we can go to their countries and do the same.

在眼前来说，中国人的生意应该中国人做；中国人的钱也要中国人来赚。
For the present, Chinese business ought to be conducted by Chinese, and Chinese money earned by Chinese.

只要便宜不落外方，不必一定要我发达。』
So long as the advantage stays in our hands, I need not be the one to prosper.”

胡雪岩将他的话细想了一会，
Hu considered this for a moment.

赞叹着说∶『你的胸襟了不起。
“What breadth of spirit!

我一定要帮你，
I shall certainly help you.

你看，眼前有啥要从外国人那里抢过来的生意——。』
What business could we begin taking from foreign hands now?”

『第一个就是轮船——。』
“Steamships, first of all—”


于是，从这天起，胡雪岩就跟萧家骥谈开办轮船公司的计划；
From that day, Hu and Xiao discussed plans for establishing a steamship company.

直到沙船将进鳖子门，方台停了下来。
Only when the junks were about to enter Biezimen did their discussions cease.

依照预定的计划，黑夜偷渡，
According to their plan, they slipped through under cover of darkness.

越过狭处，便算脱险，沿钱塘江往西南方向走；
Once through the narrows, they were out of danger and sailed southwest along the Qiantang.

正遇着东北风，很快地到了杭州；停泊在江心。
A favourable northeasterly wind soon brought them to Hangzhou, where they anchored in midstream.

但是，胡雪岩却不知道如何跟城里取得联络；
But Hu did not know how to communicate with the city.

从江心遥望，凤山门外，长毛猬集，仿佛数十里连绵不断，
Looking from the river towards Fengshan Gate, they saw the Longhairs massed outside it, apparently stretching unbroken for tens of li.

谁也不敢贸然上岸。
No one dared go ashore rashly.

『原来约定，是王雪公派人来跟我联络；
“The arrangement was that Governor Wang would send someone to contact me.

关照我千万不要上岸。』胡雪岩说∶『我只有等、等、等！』
He warned me on no account to land,” Hu said. “All I can do is wait, and wait, and wait!”

王有龄预计胡雪岩的粮船，也快到了，
Wang Youling expected the grain boats to arrive shortly.

此时全力所谋求的，就是打通一线之路，直通江边，可以运粮入城。
His whole effort now went into opening a passage to the riverbank through which the provisions could enter the city.

无奈十城紧围，战守俱穷，
But all ten gates were tightly besieged, and the defenders had exhausted their resources for both attack and defence.

因而忧愤成疾，
Anxiety and anger made him ill.

肝火上升；不时吐血，一吐就是一碗，
His liver fire rose, and he repeatedly vomited blood, a bowlful at a time.

失血太多，头昏目眩，脸如金纸，
The loss left him dizzy and faint, his face as yellow as gold paper.

然而他不肯下城休息，
Yet he would not leave the wall to rest.

因为休息亦归于无用，倒不如勉力支撑，反倒可收激励士气的效用。
Rest would do no good; better to force himself to hold on, and at least encourage the troops by his presence.


哀兵的士气，倒还不坏；
The defenders’ spirit, born of desperation, was not bad.

但俗语道得好∶『皇帝不差饿兵』；
Yet the saying was sound: even an emperor does not send hungry soldiers on a mission.

打仗是费气力的事，
Fighting requires strength.

枵腹操戈，连跑都跑不动，哪谈得到杀敌？
With empty bellies and weapons in their hands, the men could scarcely run, let alone kill an enemy.

所以每天出城攻击，长毛一退，官军亦随即鸣金收兵。
Each day they sallied out, but the moment the Longhairs drew back, the imperial troops sounded the gong to recall their own men.

这样僵持了好久，一无成就，而城里饿死的人，却是越来越多了；
This stalemate continued for a long time without achieving anything, while more and more people starved inside the city.

先还有做好事的人，不忍见尸骨骨露，掘地掩埋，
At first, charitable souls who could not bear to see the bodies exposed dug graves and buried them.

到后来埋不胜埋，只好听其自然；
Eventually the dead were too numerous to bury, and they had to leave them where they lay.

大街小巷『路倒尸』不计其数，
Bodies beyond counting filled the streets and alleys.

幸好时值冬天，还不致发生疫疠，但一城的尸臭，也熏得人够受的了。
Fortunately it was winter, so no epidemic had yet broken out, but the stench throughout the city was torment enough.

到了十月底，城外官军的营盘，都为长毛攻破；硕果仅存的，只有候潮门外，副将曾得胜一营，屹然不动。
By the end of the tenth month, the Longhairs had overrun all the imperial camps outside the walls except one: Deputy Commander Zeng Desheng’s battalion stood firm outside Houchao Gate.

这一营的不倒，是个奇迹；但说穿了不希奇，
Its survival seemed a miracle, though the explanation was simple.

城外比较容易找粮食，真的找不到了，到长毛营盘里去找。
Food was easier to find outside the city; when none could be found elsewhere, the men sought it in the Longhairs’ camps.

反正打仗阵亡也是死，绝粮坐毙也是死；
Death in battle and death from starvation were equally death.

既然如此，不如去夺长毛的粮食，反倒是死中求活的一条生路。
Better, then, to seize the enemy’s provisions and seek a chance of life in mortal danger.

因此，曾军打起仗来，真有视死如归之概。
Zeng’s men accordingly fought with a courage that made them appear to welcome death as a homecoming.

说也奇怪，长毛望见『曾』字旗帜，先就心慌，往往不战而遁；
Strangely enough, the Longhairs lost heart at the sight of the flag bearing the character “Zeng” and often fled without fighting.

但是，这一营也只能自保，
Yet this single battalion could do no more than preserve itself.

要想进击破敌，实力悬殊过甚。
The disparity in strength was too great for it to launch an offensive and break the enemy.

到底无能为力。
It was powerless to do more.


只是王有龄却对这一营寄以莫大的期望，
Wang nonetheless placed enormous hopes in it.

特别下令仁和知县吴保丰，将安置在城隍山上的一尊三千斤重的大炮，费尽力量，移运到曾得胜营里，
He specially ordered Wu Baofeng, magistrate of Renhe, to move a cannon weighing three thousand jin from City God Hill to Zeng’s camp, at immense effort.

对准长毛的壁垒，大轰特轰。这一带长毛倒是绝迹了，
Trained on the Longhairs’ fortifications, it thundered away until no enemy remained in that immediate area.

但仍无法直通江边，
Still they could not reach the riverbank.

因为大炮射程以外，长毛仍如牛毛，重重隔阻，处处填塞，
Beyond the cannon’s range the Longhairs remained as numerous as hairs on an ox, blocking every approach in layer upon layer.

始终杀不开重围。
The encirclement could not be broken.

就在这时候，抓住一名奸细——
Just then a spy was caught.

奸细极易分别，因为城里的人，不是面目浮肿，就是骨瘦如柴，走路挪不了三寸，说话有气无力；
Spies were easy to recognise: the people inside the city were either bloated in the face or wasted to skin and bone; they could scarcely shuffle a few inches and spoke in voices too weak to hear.

如果遇到一个气色正常，行动舒徐，说话不必侧耳就可以听得清楚的，必是从城外混进来的；
Anyone of normal complexion who walked easily and could be heard without straining one’s ears must have slipped in from outside.

这样一座人间地狱，还有人跳了进来，其意何居？
What purpose could draw a man into such a hell on earth?

不问可知。
There was no need to ask.

果然，抓住了一顿打，立刻打出了实话，
Sure enough, a beating soon brought out the truth.

此人自道是长毛所派，送一封信来给饶廷选部下的一外营官，约定里应外合的日期。
The man admitted that the Longhairs had sent him with a letter for a battalion commander under Rao Tingxuan, fixing a date for a coordinated attack from within and without.

同时也从他口中得到一个消息，说钱塘江中，停泊了十几号大船，满装粮食。
He also revealed that more than a dozen large vessels, laden with provisions, lay in the Qiantang.

这不问可知，是胡雪岩的粮船到了；
Plainly Hu’s grain boats had arrived.

王有龄陡觉精神一振，
Wang’s spirits revived at once.

当即去看杭州将军瑞昌，商量如何杀开一条血路，能让江中的粮食运入城内？
He went immediately to Ruichang, the garrison general of Hangzhou, to discuss how to force a bloody passage through which the grain might be brought into the city.

不须多作商量，
Little discussion was needed.

便有了结果，决定请副都统杰纯，当此重任。
They decided to entrust the task to Deputy Lieutenant-General Jiechun.

事实上怕也只有此人堪当重任——
Indeed, there was probably no one else equal to it.

杰纯是蒙古人，他祖先驻防杭州，早有好几代；
Jiechun was a Mongol whose ancestors had served in the Hangzhou garrison for generations.

杰纯本人是正六品骁骑校出身，
He had begun as a cavalry officer of the senior sixth rank.

武艺娴熟，深得军心，积功升到正四品的协领，颇为瑞昌所倚重。
Highly skilled in arms and deeply trusted by his men, he had risen through service to the senior fourth rank as a banner commander, and Ruichang relied heavily upon him.


咸丰十年春天，杭州城第一次为长毛轰破，瑞昌预备自刎殉国；
In the spring of the tenth year of Xianfeng, when the Longhairs first breached Hangzhou, Ruichang had prepared to cut his throat and die for his country.

杰纯劝他不必轻生，
Jiechun urged him not to throw away his life.

认为安徽广德来的敌军，轻骑疾进，未有后继，不足为忧，
The enemy had advanced rapidly with light cavalry from Guangde in Anhui and had no reinforcements behind them; there was no cause for despair.

不妨固守待援。
They should hold their ground and await relief.

瑞昌听了他的话，退守满营；营盘在西湖边上，
Ruichang accepted his advice and withdrew into the Manchu garrison beside West Lake.

实际是一座子城，俗称满城。
In effect it was a city within the city, commonly called the Manchu City.

因为防御得法，长毛连攻六天，劳而无功；
Its defences were so skilfully managed that six days of Longhair attacks achieved nothing.

杰纯的长子守城阵亡，
Jiechun’s eldest son died defending the walls.

杰纯殓而不哭，认为长子死得其所，死得其时。
His father laid out the body without tears, believing that his son had died as a man should, at the proper moment.

到了第七天，张玉良的援兵到了；
On the seventh day Zhang Yuliang’s reinforcements arrived.

杰纯怒马突出，当者披靡，
Jiechun burst forth on a charging horse, sweeping aside all opposition.

配合援军，大举反攻，将长毛逐出城外十几里。
In concert with the relieving army, he launched a great counterattack and drove the Longhairs more than ten li beyond the city.

以此功劳，赏戴花翎，升任为宁夏副都统，但仍旧留在杭州，成了瑞昌的左右手。
For this service he received the right to wear a peacock feather and was promoted to deputy lieutenant-general of Ningxia, though he remained in Hangzhou as Ruichang’s right-hand man.

这次杭州再度吃紧，杰纯战功卓著，赐号巴图鲁，调任乍浦副都统，这是海防上的一个要缺；
During the present crisis his distinguished services earned him the title Baturu, “the Brave”, and a transfer to the deputy lieutenant-generalship of Zhapu, an important coastal-defence post.

但乍浦已落入长毛手中，所以仍旧留防省城。
But Zhapu had fallen to the Longhairs, so he stayed to defend the provincial capital.

杭州十城，最关紧要的就是北面的武林门和南门的凤山门；
Of Hangzhou’s ten gates, Wulin in the north and Fengshan in the south were the most important.

凤山门原由王有龄亲自坐镇，
Wang had originally commanded at Fengshan in person.

这一阵因为呕血过多，气衰力竭，才改由杰纯防守——
Only recently, exhausted by vomiting blood, had he handed its defence to Jiechun.

胡雪岩的粮船，就泊在凤山门外的江面；
Hu’s grain ships lay in the river outside that very gate.

让杰纯去杀开一条血路，亦正是人和地理，两皆相合的顺理成章 之事。
To send Jiechun to force a passage was therefore the obvious choice, both for the man and for the position he held.


围凤山门的长毛主将叫做陈炳文，照太平天国的爵位，封号称为『朗天义』。
The Longhair commander besieging Fengshan Gate was Chen Bingwen, whose title in the Taiping hierarchy was Langtianyi.

他本来要走了——长毛的军粮，亦渐感不敷；
He had been about to leave: the Longhairs too were beginning to run short of provisions.

李秀成已经拟定行定计划，回苏州度岁，预备明年春天，卷土重来。
Li Xiucheng had already drawn up plans to return to Suzhou for the New Year and resume the campaign the following spring.

但陈炳文已从城里逃出来的难民口中，得知城内绝粮，已到了人吃人的地步；
But Chen learnt from refugees escaping the city that its food was gone and its inhabitants had begun eating one another.

所以翻然变计，坚持不走；
He abruptly changed his mind and insisted on staying.

同时也知道城内防守，以凤山门为重点，因而又厚集兵力，一层夹一层，直到江边，弹丸之地，集结了四万人之多。
Knowing also that Fengshan Gate was the key to the city’s defence, he massed his forces there in layer after layer all the way to the river, concentrating as many as forty thousand men in that tiny area.

等到粮船一到，遥遥望见，陈炳文越发眼红，
When he saw the grain boats in the distance, his eagerness to seize them grew fiercer.

一方面防备城内会冲出来接粮；一方面千方百计想攻夺粮船，
He prepared against a sortie from the city to collect the provisions while trying every means of capturing the vessels.

无奈江面辽阔，而华尔的部下防守严密，
But the river was broad and Ward’s men guarded them closely.

小划子只要稍稍接近，便是一排抢过来，
Whenever a small boat drew near, a volley met it.

就算船打不沉，人却非打死打伤不可。
Even if the boat did not sink, its occupants could scarcely escape death or injury.

一连三日，无以为计；
Three days passed without success.

最后有人献策，依照赤壁鏖兵，大破曹军的办法，用小船满载茅柴，浇上油脂，从上游顺流而下，火攻粮船。
Finally someone proposed copying the method by which Cao Cao’s army had been destroyed at Red Cliffs: load small boats with brushwood, soak it in oil and send them downstream from above to burn the grain ships.

陈炳文认为此计可行。
Chen thought the scheme feasible.

但上游不是自己的战区，需要派人联络；又要禀报忠王裁夺，
But the upper reaches were outside his sector, so he had to make contact with the commanders there and submit the proposal to the Loyal King for a decision.

不是一两天所能安排停当的。
Such arrangements could not be completed in a day or two.

同时天气回暖，风向不定，江面上有自己的许多小划子；
Moreover, the weather had grown warmer, the wind was changeable, and many of their own small boats were on the river.

万一弄巧成拙，惹火烧身，岂不糟糕？
What if the clever plan backfired and they burned themselves instead?

因而迟疑未发。
He hesitated to act.

就在这时候，粮船上却等不得了。
Meanwhile, the men aboard the grain ships could wait no longer.


因为一连三天的等待，胡雪岩度日如年，
For Hu, the three days had felt like years.

眠食俱废。
He could neither eat nor sleep.

而护航洋兵的孔联络官，认为身处危地，如果不速作鼾，后果不堪设想，
Kong, liaison officer with the foreign escort, believed they were in a dangerous position and that failure to decide quickly might have disastrous consequences.

不断催促胡雪岩，倘或粮食无法运上陆地，就应依照原说，改航宁波。
He kept urging Hu to sail for Ningbo, as originally agreed, if the provisions could not be landed.

沙船帮的李庆山口中不言，神色之间亦颇为焦急，
Li Qingshan of the Sea-Junk Guild said nothing, but his face betrayed considerable anxiety.

这使得胡雪岩越发集躁，
This made Hu still more frantic.

双眼发红，终日喃喃自语，不知说些什么，
His eyes reddened, and he muttered unintelligibly to himself all day.

看样子快要发疯了。
He looked close to madness.

『得隆哥，』萧家骥对胡雪岩劝慰无效，只好跟李得隆商议，『我看，事情不能不想办法了。
Unable to comfort him, Xiao turned to Li Delong. “Brother Delong, we must find some way out of this.

这样「屏」下去要出事。』
Something will go wrong if we remain bottled up like this.”

『是啊！我也是这样在想。
“Yes, I have been thinking the same thing.

不过有啥办法呢？
But what can we do?

困在江心动弹不得。』
We are trapped in the middle of the river.”

李得隆指着岸上说∶『长毛象蚂蚁一样；
Li pointed ashore. “The Longhairs are like ants.

将一座杭州城，围得铁桶似的，
They have sealed Hangzhou as tight as an iron barrel.

城里的人，怎么出得来？』
How can anyone get out?”

『就是为了这一点。
“That is precisely the point.

我想，城里的人出不来，只有我们想法子进城去，讨个确实口信；
If the people inside cannot get out, we must find a way in and obtain a definite answer.

行就行，不行的话，胡先生也好早作打算。
If it can be done, good; if it cannot, Mr Hu can make other plans at once.

这样痴汉等老婆一船，
We are waiting like a fool for a wife.

等到哪一天为止？』
How long can this go on?”

李得隆也是年轻性急，而且敢冒险的人，
Li too was young, impatient and willing to take risks.

当然赞成萧家骥的办法；而且自告奋勇，愿意泅水上岸，进城去通消息。
He naturally approved of Xiao’s proposal and volunteered to swim ashore and carry a message into the city.

『得隆哥，』萧家骥很平静地说∶『这件事倒不是讲义气，更不是讲客气的。
“Brother Delong,” Xiao said calmly, “this is not a question of proving our loyalty, still less of making polite offers to one another.

事情要办得通；
We have to get the task done.

你去我去都一样，只看哪个去合适？
Whether you go or I go makes no difference; what matters is which of us is better suited.

你水性比我好，人比我灵活，手上的功夫，更不是我比得了的——。』『好了，好了！』李得隆笑道，
You swim better than I do, you are more agile, and your skill in a fight is far beyond mine—” “Enough, enough!” Li laughed.

『你少捧我！
“Stop flattering me.

前面捧得越高，后面的话越加难所；
The higher you praise me now, the harsher the words that follow.

你老实说，我能不能去？』
Tell me plainly: can I go or not?”

『不是我有意绕弯子说话，
“I am not trying to be roundabout.

这种时候，杂不得一点感情意气，
At a time like this we must not allow feeling or pride to interfere.

自己好弟兄，为啥不平心静气把话说清楚。
We are good brothers; why should we not discuss it calmly and frankly?

我现在先请问你，得隆哥，你杭州去过没有？
Let me first ask you this, Brother Delong: have you ever been to Hangzhou?

你晓得我们前面的那个城门叫啥？』
Do you know the name of the gate in front of us?”


『不晓得。
“No.

我杭州没有去过。』
I have never been to Hangzhou.”

『这就不大相宜了。
“Then you are not quite the right man.

杭州做过宋朝的京城，
Hangzhou was the capital of the Song dynasty.

城里地方也蛮大的。不熟，寻不着；
It is a large city, and without knowing it you will have trouble finding your way.

这还在其次，
But that is the lesser difficulty.

最要紧的一点是，你不是听胡先生说过，杭州城里盘查奸细严得很；
The chief point is this: you heard Mr Hu say how strictly they are hunting spies inside the walls.

而且因为饿火中烧，不讲道理。
Hunger has inflamed people’s tempers, and they will not listen to reason.”

得隆哥，』萧家骥停了一下说∶『我说实话，你不动气。
Xiao paused. “Brother Delong, do not be angry if I speak frankly.

你的脾气暴躁；口才不如我。
You have a quick temper, and you are not as ready with words as I am.

你去不大相宜！』
It would not be wise to send you.”

李得隆性子直爽，服善而肯讲道理，
Li was straightforward, willing to listen to reason and accept sound advice.

听萧家骥说得不错，例即答道∶『好！
Recognising the truth of Xiao’s words, he answered at once, “Very well.

你去。』
You go.”

于是两个人又商量了如何上岸；如何混过长毛的阵地；到了城下，如何联络进城，
The two then discussed how Xiao should land, pass through the Longhairs’ positions and make contact beneath the walls to enter the city.

种种细了，大致妥当，才跟胡雪岩去说明其事。
Only when these details were largely settled did they take their proposal to Hu.

『胡先生！』是由李得隆开口，『有件事禀告你老人家，
“Mr Hu,” Li began, “there is something we must report.

事情我们都商量好了，辰光也不容我们再拖下去了，
We have worked it all out, and we cannot afford any more delay.

我说了，请你老人家照办，不要驳回。
Once I have told you, I beg you to agree and not refuse.

请你写封信给王抚台，
Please write a letter to Governor Wang.

由家骥进城去送。』
Jiaji will take it into the city.”

李得隆其实是将胡雪岩看错了。
In fact, Li had misjudged Hu.

他早就想过，自己必须坐守，免得城里千辛万苦派出人来，接不上头，造成无可挽救的错失；
Hu had long understood that he himself must stay where he was, lest someone from the city should reach the boats after terrible hardships only to miss him, with irreparable consequences.

此外，只要可能，任何人都不妨进城通消息。
Apart from that, anyone who could possibly carry a message into the city ought to go.

所以一听这话，神态马上变过了。
At Li’s words, his whole manner changed.


『慢慢来！』
“Steady!”

他又恢复了临大事从容不乱的态度；比起他这两天的坐卧不宁来，判若两人，
He had recovered his customary calm in the face of great affairs, utterly different from the restless man of the past two days.

『你先说给我听听，怎么去法？』
“First tell me how you intend to get there.”

『泅水上去——。』『不是，不是！』
“Swim ashore—” “No, no!”

第一句话就让他大摇其头，
Hu shook his head at the very first sentence.

『湿淋淋一身，就不冻出病来，上了岸怎么办？
“What will you do once you land, soaked to the skin, even if you do not fall ill from the cold?

难道还有客栈好投，让你烤干衣服？』
Do you imagine there is an inn where you can dry your clothes by a fire?”

『原是要见机行事。』
“We meant to act as circumstances required.”

『这时候做事，不能说碰运气了。
“At a time like this we cannot simply trust to luck.

要想停当再动手。』胡雪岩说，
We must think everything through before acting,” Hu said.

『你听我告诉你。』
“Listen to me.”

他也实在没有什么腹案，
He had no prepared plan himself.

不过一向机变快，一路想，一路说，居然就有了一套办法——
But he had always been quick-witted; thinking as he spoke, he soon worked out a complete scheme.

整套办法中，最主要的一点是，遇到长毛，如何应付？
Its most important point was how to deal with any Longhairs Xiao encountered.

胡雪岩教了他一条计策∶冒充上海英商的代表，向长毛兜售军火。
Hu suggested a stratagem: pose as the representative of a British merchant in Shanghai and offer to sell them arms.



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第二章（本章第2部分，共4部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


『好在你会说英文，上海洋行的情形也熟；
“You speak English, and you know the foreign firms in Shanghai.

人又聪明，
You are clever too.

一定装得象。』胡雪岩说∶『你要记住，长毛也是土里土气的，
You will certainly make a convincing show,” Hu said. “Remember, the Longhairs are provincial fellows as well.

要拿外国人唬他。』
Use the foreigners to overawe them.”

——交代停当，却不曾写信；
Once his instructions were given, however, he wrote no letter.

这也是胡雪岩细心之处，怕搜到了这封信，大事不成，反惹来杀身之祸。
This too showed his care: if a letter were found in a search, the whole undertaking would fail and Xiao would lose his life.

但见了王有龄，必须有一样信物为凭；
Yet Xiao needed some token to prove his credentials when he met Wang Youling.

手上那个金戒指本来是最真确的，又怕长毛起眼劫掠，
The gold ring on Hu’s hand would have been unmistakable, but he feared it would catch a Longhair’s eye and be stolen.

胡雪岩想了半天，只有用话来交代了。
After long consideration, he could think of nothing but an oral message.

『我临走的时候，王抚台跟我谈了好些时候，
“Before I left, Governor Wang talked with me for a long time.

他的后事都托了我。
He entrusted all his affairs after his death to me.

他最钟爱的小儿子，名叫苕云，今年才五岁，
His youngest son, whom he loves most dearly, is called Tiaoyun and is only five this year.

要寄在我名下；
He wanted to place the boy under my name.

我说等我上海回来再说。
I said we should discuss it after I returned from Shanghai.

这些话，没有第三个人晓得，
No third person knows of this conversation.

你跟他说了，他自然会相信是我请你去的。』
Tell him, and he will know that I sent you.”

这是最好的征信办法，
This was the best possible proof.

萧家骥问清楚了『苕云』二字的写法，紧记在心。
Xiao asked exactly how the two characters of Tiaoyun’s name were written and committed them to memory.

但是，一时还不能走；先要想办法找只小船。
But he could not yet leave: first they had to find a small boat.


小船是有，
There were boats about.

过往载运逃难的人的渡船，时有所见，但洋兵荷枪实弹，在沙船上往来侦伺，没有谁敢驶近。
Ferries carrying refugees passed from time to time, but with the foreign soldiers patrolling the junks, loaded guns in hand, none dared approach.

这就要靠李得隆了，
Here they needed Li Delong.

借了孔联络官的望远镜，看准远远一只空船；泅水迎了上去，
Borrowing Kong’s telescope, he picked out an empty boat in the distance and swam towards it.

把着船舷，探头见了船老大，
He caught hold of its side and raised his head to face the boatman.

先不说话，身上摸出水淋淋的一块马蹄银，递了过去；
Before saying a word, he drew a dripping horseshoe-shaped silver ingot from his clothing and handed it up.

真是『重赏之下，必有勇夫』，很顺利地雇到了船。
Truly, a handsome reward will always find a brave man: he hired the boat without difficulty.

这是天色将暮，视界不明，却更易混上岸去；
Dusk was falling and visibility was poor, making it easier to slip ashore.

胡雪岩亲自指点了方向，
Hu pointed out the direction himself.

就在将要开船时，他忽然想到了一件事。
Just as they were about to cast off, another thought struck him.

『喂，喂，船老大，
“Wait, boatman!

你贵姓？』
What is your surname?”

船老大指指水面∶『我就姓江。』
The man pointed at the water. “Jiang—River.”

『老江，亲苦你了。』胡雪岩说∶『你拿我这位朋友送到岸，回来通个信给我，
“Old Jiang, thank you for your trouble,” Hu said. “Take my friend ashore, then come back and bring me word.

我再送你十两银子。
I shall give you another ten taels.

决不骗你；
I will not deceive you.

如果骗你，教我马上掉在钱塘江里，不得好死。』
If I do, may I fall straight into the Qiantang and die a dreadful death.”

听他罚得这么重的咒，江老大似乎颇为动容，
Such a terrible oath seemed to move the boatman.

『你老爷贵姓？』他问。
“What is your honourable surname, sir?” he asked.


『我姓王。』
“Wang.”

『王老爷，你老人家请放心；
“Rest assured, Mr Wang.

我拿这位少爷送到了，一定来报信。』
Once I have landed this young gentleman, I shall certainly come back and report.”

『拜托、拜托！』
“I am relying on you!”

胡雪岩在沙船上作揖，
Hu bowed from the junk.

『我备好银子在这里等你，
“I shall have the silver ready and wait for you here.

哪怕半夜里都不要紧，你一定要来！
Even if it is the middle of the night, come back without fail.

你船上有没有灯笼？』
Have you a lantern on your boat?”

『灯笼是有的。』
“A lantern, yes.”

江老大也很灵活，知道他的用意，
Jiang was quick-witted too and understood his purpose.

『晚上如果挂出来，江风一吹，马上就灭了。』
“But if I hang it outside at night, the wind off the river will blow it out at once.”

『说得有理。
“Quite right.

来，来，
Come, then!

索性「六指头搔痒」，格外奉承你了。』
I shall scratch your back with six fingers—an extra favour for you.”

胡雪岩另外送他一盏燃用『美孚油』的马灯，
Hu gave him a storm lantern burning Mobil kerosene.

作为报信时挂在船头的信号，免得到时洋兵不明就里，误伤了他。
He was to hang it at the bow as a signal when returning with news, lest the foreign soldiers, unaware of his purpose, fire on him by mistake.


等萧家骥一走，李得隆忍不住要问，何以要这样对待江老大，甚至赌神罚咒，唯恐他不信似的。
Once Xiao had gone, Li Delong could not help asking why Hu had treated the boatman in that manner, even swearing by the gods as though afraid of being disbelieved.

是不是不放心萧家骥？
Was he worried about Xiao?

『已经放他出去了，没有什么不放心。』胡雪岩说，
“Once I have let him go, there is no point worrying,” Hu replied.

『我是防这个船老大；
“It is the boatman I am guarding against.

要防他将人送到了，又到长毛那里去密告讨赏。
He might land our man and then go to the Longhairs to inform on him for a reward.

所以用十两银子拴住他的脚，好教他早早回来。
I tied his feet with ten taels so that he would come straight back.

这当然要罚咒，不然他不相信。』
Naturally I had to swear an oath, or he would not believe me.”

『胡先生，实在服了你了，
“Mr Hu, I truly admire you.

真正算无遗策。
You leave nothing to chance.

不过，胡先生，你为啥又说姓王呢？』
But why did you tell him your surname was Wang?”

『这另外有个缘故，
“That has another cause.

钱塘江摆渡的都恨我；
The Qiantang ferrymen all hate me.

说了真姓要坏事。
My real name would have caused trouble.

你听我说那个缘故给你听；
Let me tell you why.

二十年前——。』二十年前的胡雪岩，还在钱庄里学生意，
Twenty years ago—” Twenty years before, Hu had still been an apprentice in a bank.

有一次奉命到钱塘江南岸的萧山县去收一笔帐款；
On one occasion he was sent to Xiaoshan County on the south bank of the Qiantang to collect a debt.

帐款没有收到，有限的几个盘缠，却在小菜馆里掷骰子输得只剩十个摆渡所需的小钱。
He failed to collect it, and in a little eating house he lost almost all his scant travelling money at dice, keeping only the ten copper coins needed for the ferry.

『船到江心，收钱了。』胡雪岩说，
“When the boat reached midstream, they collected the fares,” he said.

『到我面前，我手一伸进衣袋里，拿不出来了。』
“The man came to me, and I put my hand in my pocket—but could bring nothing out.”

『怎么呢？』李得隆问。
“Why?” Li asked.

『也叫祸不单行，
“Misfortunes never come singly.

衣袋破了个沿；十个小钱不知道什么时候漏得光光。
A hole had worn in the pocket, and all ten coins had slipped out without my noticing.

钱塘江的渡船，出了名的凶，
The Qiantang ferrymen were notoriously fierce.

听说真有付不出摆渡钱，被推到江里的事。
I had heard of people actually being pushed into the river because they could not pay.

当时我自然大窘，
Naturally I was desperately embarrassed.

只好实话实说，答应上岸到钱庄拿了钱来照补。
I could only tell the truth and promise to fetch the money from my bank as soon as we landed.

叫啥说破了嘴都无用，
I might as well have talked my mouth off.

硬要剥我的衣服。』
They insisted on stripping off my clothes.”

『这么可恶！』李得隆大为不平，
“The villains!” Li exclaimed indignantly.

『不过，难道一船的人，都袖手旁观？』
“But surely the whole boat did not just stand by and watch?”


当然不致于，
Of course not.

有人借了十文钱给他，方得免褫衣之辱。
Someone lent him ten cash, sparing him the humiliation of being stripped.

但胡雪岩经此刺激，上岸就发誓∶只要有一天得意，力所能及，一定买两只船；雇几个船夫，设置来往两岸不费分文的义渡。
Yet the experience stung him so deeply that, once ashore, he swore that if he ever prospered and had the means, he would buy two boats, engage some boatmen and establish a charitable ferry to carry passengers between the banks without charging a single coin.

『我这个愿望，说实话，老早就可以达到。
“To tell the truth, I could have fulfilled that wish long before I did.

哪知道做好事都不行！
Who would have thought one could be prevented from doing good?

得隆，你倒想想看，是啥道理？』
Delong, what do you suppose the reason was?”

『这道理好懂。
“Easy enough.

有人做好事，就有人没饭吃了。』
When one man does good, another loses his livelihood.”

『对！
“Exactly.

为此钱塘江摆渡的，联起来来反对我，不准我设义渡。
The Qiantang ferrymen joined forces against me and would not let me establish the free crossing.

后来幸亏王抚台帮忙。』
Fortunately Governor Wang helped me in the end.”

那时王有龄已调杭州知府，
At the time Wang had been transferred to the post of prefect of Hangzhou.

不但私人交情，帮胡雪岩的忙义不容辞；就是以地方官的身分，为民造福，奖励善举，亦是责无旁贷的事。
His personal friendship made helping Hu a duty; equally, as the local official, he was bound to benefit the people and encourage charitable acts.

所以一方面出告示不准告摆渡为生的人，阻挠这件好事；一面还为胡雪岩请奖。
He issued a proclamation forbidding those who earned their living by ferrying passengers to obstruct the scheme, and also applied for an official reward for Hu.

自设义渡，受惠的人，不知凡几；
Countless people benefited from the free ferry.

胡雪岩纵非沽钓誉，而声名洋溢，就此博得了一个『胡善人』的美名。
Even though Hu had not set out to fish for praise, his reputation spread everywhere, and he became known as “Hu the Benefactor”.

只是钱塘江里的船家，提起『胡善人』，大多咬牙切齿，
But most Qiantang boatmen gnashed their teeth at the mention of that name.

此所以他不肯对江老大透露真姓。
That was why he had concealed his true surname from Jiang.

小小的一个故事，由于胡雪岩心情已比较开朗，恢复了他原有的口才，
Now that his spirits had lifted, Hu had recovered his usual gift for telling a story.

讲得颇为风趣，所以李得隆听得津津有味，同时也更佩服了。
He made this little incident so entertaining that Li listened with delight—and with growing admiration.


『胡先生，因果报应到底是有的。
“Mr Hu, there must be such a thing as moral recompense.

就凭胡先生你在这条江上，做下这么一桩好事；应该决不会在这条江上出什么风险。
After the good you have done on this river, you surely cannot come to harm upon it.

我们大家都要托你的福。』
We shall all share in your good fortune.”

这两句话说得很中听，
This was exactly what Hu wished to hear.

胡雪岩喜逐颜开地说∶『谢谢！谢谢！
His face lit up. “Thank you, thank you!

一定如你金口。』
May your gracious words come true.”

不但胡雪岩自己，
Nor was he the only one encouraged.

船上别的人，也都受了李得隆那几句话的鼓舞，认为有善人在船，必可逢凶化吉。
Everyone aboard took heart from Li’s remarks, believing that with a good man among them, calamity would turn to blessing.

因而也就一下子改变了前两天那种坐困愁城，忧郁不安，令人仿佛透不过气来的味道；
At once the oppressive atmosphere of the past two days—their sense of being trapped, their anxiety and despondency—lifted.

晚饭桌上，兴致很好，
Dinner was a cheerful affair.

连不会喝酒的李得隆也愿意来一杯。
Even Li, who was no drinker, agreed to take a cup.


『说起来鬼神真不可不信。』孔联络官举杯在手，悠闲地说，
“One really cannot disbelieve in spirits and gods,” Kong observed comfortably, cup in hand.

『不过行善要不教人晓得，才是真正做好事；
“But true goodness is doing good without letting anyone know.

为了善人的名声做好事，不足为奇。』
There is nothing remarkable in charity performed merely to gain a reputation for virtue.”

『不然。
“I disagree.

人人肯为了善人的名声，去做好事，这个世界就好了。
If everyone would do good for the sake of a good name, this world would be a fine place.

有的人简直是「善棍」。』胡雪岩说，
Some people are simply charity swindlers,” Hu said.

『这就叫「三代以下，唯恐不好名」。』
“As the saying goes, ‘Since the Three Dynasties, the fear should be that men care too little for a good name.’”

『什么叫「善棍」？』李得隆笑道，
“Charity swindlers?” Li laughed.

『这个名目则是第一次听见。』
“That is a new name to me.”

『善棍就是骗子。借行善为名行骗，
“It means cheats who use charity as a cover.

这类骗子顶顶难防。不过日子一久，总归瞒不过人。』
They are the hardest sort of swindler to guard against, though in time people always see through them.

胡雪岩说，『什么事，一颗心假不了；
In anything a man does, he cannot counterfeit his heart for ever.

有些人自以为聪明绝顶，人人都会上他的当；
Some imagine themselves so clever that everyone will fall into their trap.

其实到头来原形毕露，自己毁了自己。
In the end their true nature shows, and they ruin themselves.

一个人值不值钱，就看他自己说的话算数不算数；
A man’s worth depends on whether he keeps his word.

象王抚台，
Take Governor Wang.

在我们浙江的官声，说实话，并不是怎么样顶好；
To speak frankly, his reputation as an official in Zhejiang was not among the very best.

可是现在他说不走，就不走，
But now he says he will not leave, and he stays.

要跟杭州人同祸福，共存亡，
He means to share the fortunes of Hangzhou’s people, to live or die with them.

就这一点上他比何制台值钱得多。』
In that alone he is worth far more than Governor-General He.”

话到这里，大家不期而然地想到了萧家骥，
At this, everyone’s thoughts turned naturally to Xiao.

推测他何时能够进城？
When would he enter the city?

王有龄得到消息，会有什么举动？
What would Wang do on receiving the news?

船上该如何接应？
How should the boats respond?

『举动是一定会有举动的。
“He is certain to take action.

不过——，』胡雪岩忽然停杯不饮，
But—” Hu suddenly held his cup without drinking.

容颜惨淡，
His face grew bleak.

好久，才叹口气说∶『我实在想不出，怎样才能将这批米运上岸；
After a long silence he sighed. “I really cannot see how we are to get this rice ashore.

就算杀开一条血路，又哪里能够保得住这条粮道畅通？』
Even if they fight a passage through, how can they keep the supply route open?”


『胡先生，有个办法不晓得行不行？』李得隆说∶『杭州不是有水城门吗？
“Mr Hu, I wonder whether this might work,” Li said. “Does Hangzhou not have water gates?

好不好弄几条小船，拿米分开来偷运进城？』
Could we get a few little boats, divide the rice among them and smuggle it into the city?”

『只怕不行——。』话刚说得半句，只听一声枪响；
“I fear not—” Hu had scarcely begun when a shot rang out.

随即有人喊道∶『不能开枪，
Immediately someone shouted, “Do not fire!

不能开枪；
Do not fire!

是报信的来了。』
The messenger is coming back!”

于是胡雪岩、李得隆纷纷出舱探望，
Hu and Li hurried out of the cabin.

果然，一点星火，冉冉而来；
Sure enough, a point of light was slowly approaching.

渐行渐近，看出船头上挂的是盏马灯。
As it drew nearer they could see a storm lantern hanging at the bow.

等小船靠近，李得隆喊一声∶『江老大！』
When the boat came alongside, Li called, “Boatman Jiang!”

『是我。』江老大答应着，将一根缆索抛了过来。
“It is I!” Jiang answered, throwing up a rope.

李得隆伸手接着，系住小船，将江老大接了上来，延入船舱；
Li caught it, made the boat fast, helped him aboard and invited him into the cabin.

胡雪岩已将白花花一锭银子摆在桌上了。
Hu had already placed a gleaming silver ingot on the table.

『那位少爷上岸了。』江老大说，
“The young gentleman has gone ashore,” Jiang said.

『我来交差。』
“I have come to report.”

『费你的心。』
“Thank you for your trouble.”

胡雪岩将银子往前一推，
Hu pushed the silver towards him.

『送你做个过年东道。』
“A little something for your New Year’s entertainment.”


『多谢，多谢。』
“Thank you, thank you.”

江老大将银子接到手里，略略迟疑了一下才说∶『王老爷，有句话想想还是要告诉你∶那位少爷一上岸，就教长毛捉了去了。』
Jiang took the silver, then hesitated before speaking. “Mr Wang, there is something I think I had better tell you. As soon as the young gentleman landed, the Longhairs took him.”

捉去不怕，要看如何捉法？
Capture itself was nothing to fear; what mattered was how he had been taken.

胡雪岩很沉着地问∶『长毛是不是很凶？』
Hu asked calmly, “Were they very rough with him?”

『那倒还好。』
“No, not particularly.

江老大说，『这位少爷胆子大，
He is a brave young gentleman.

见了长毛不逃；长毛对他就客气点了。』
He did not try to run when he saw them, so they treated him rather politely.”

胡雪岩先就放了一半心，顺口问道∶『城里有啥消息？』
Half relieved already, Hu asked casually, “Is there any news from inside the city?”

『不晓得，』
“I do not know.”

江老大摇摇头，面容顿见愁苦，
Jiang shook his head, his face suddenly full of distress.

『城里城外象两个世界。』
“Inside and outside are two different worlds.”

『那末城外呢？』
“Then what about outside?”

『城外？
“Outside?

王老爷，你是说长毛？』
You mean the Longhairs, Mr Wang?”

『是啊！
“Yes.

长毛这方面有啥消息？』
What news is there on their side?”

『也不大清楚。
“I do not know much.

前几天说要回苏州了；
A few days ago they were saying they would return to Suzhou.

有些长毛摆地摊卖抢来的东西，三文不值两文，好象急于脱货求现；
Some of them were selling their plunder from roadside stalls for next to nothing, as though anxious to turn it into cash.

这两天又不听见说起了。』
But these last two days I have heard no more about leaving.”

胡雪岩心里明白，
Hu understood.

长毛的军粮亦有难乎为继之势∶现在是跟守军僵持着，
The Longhairs too were finding their provisions hard to maintain. For the moment they were locked in a stalemate with the defenders.

如果城里有粮食接济，能再守一两个月，长毛可以不战自退。
If the city could be supplied and hold out for another month or two, the enemy might retreat without a fight.

但从另一方面看，长毛既然缺粮，那末这十几船粮食摆在江面上，必启其觊觎之心，
Yet there was another side to it: since the Longhairs were short of food, the dozen or more grain-laden boats lying on the river must tempt them greatly.

如果调集小船，不顾死命来扑，实在是件很危险的事。
If they massed small craft and attacked regardless of their lives, the danger would be severe.

因此，这晚上他又急得睡不着，
That night Hu was once more too anxious to sleep.

心心念念只望萧家骥能够混进城去，王有龄能够调集人马杀开一条血路，保住粮道；
His every thought was a hope that Xiao would get into the city and Wang would assemble enough men to fight a passage through and hold the supply route.

只要争到一天的工夫，就可以将沙船撑到岸边，卸粮进城。
A single day would suffice: they could bring the junks alongside the bank, unload the grain and carry it into the city.


萧家骥果然混进城了。
Xiao did indeed find his way inside.

被捕之时，长毛就对他『另眼相看』；
From the moment of his capture, the Longhairs had regarded him differently.

因为凡是被掳的百姓，没有不吓得瑟瑟发抖的。
Every civilian they seized ordinarily trembled with terror.

只有这个『新家伙』——长毛对刚被掳的百姓的通称——与众不同。
Only this “new fellow”—their usual term for a newly captured civilian—was different.

因此别的『新家伙』照例双手被缚，这个的辫子跟那个的辫子结在一起，防他们『逃长毛』；
The others had their hands bound, and one man’s queue was tied to the next man’s to prevent them escaping.

对萧家骥却如江老大所说的，相当『客气』，
Xiao, however, was treated with considerable courtesy, just as Jiang had reported.

押着到了『公馆』，问话的语气亦颇有礼貌。
They escorted him to the officer’s “residence”, where even the questioning was polite.

『看你样子，是外路来的。
“You look as though you come from elsewhere.

你叫什么名字，干什么行当？』一个黄衣黄帽，说湖北话的小头目问。
What is your name, and what is your business?” asked a minor commander in a yellow robe and cap, speaking with a Hubei accent.

『我姓萧，
“My name is Xiao.

从上海来。』萧家骥从容答道∶『说实话，我想来做笔大生意。
I have come from Shanghai,” Xiao answered calmly. “To tell you the truth, I hope to conclude a large piece of business.

这笔生意做成功，杭州城就再也守不住了。』
If it succeeds, Hangzhou will be unable to hold out any longer.”

那小头目听他口气不凡，顿时肃然起敬，改口称他∶『萧先生，请问是什么大生意？
The breadth of his claim instantly impressed the commander, who changed his form of address. “Mr Xiao, what great business is this?

怎么说这笔生意成功，他们杭州就会守不住？』
Why should Hangzhou become unable to hold out once it succeeds?”


『这话我实在不能跟你说。』萧家骥道∶『请你送我去见忠王。』
“I really cannot discuss it with you,” Xiao said. “Please send me to see the Loyal King.”

『忠王不知道驻驾在哪里？我也见不着他，
“I do not know where His Highness is stationed, and I cannot gain an audience with him myself.

只好拿你往上送。
I can only refer you to my superiors.

不过，萧先生，』那小头目踌躇着说∶『你不会害我吧？』
But, Mr Xiao—” The man hesitated. “You will not get me into trouble, will you?”

『怎么害我？』
“How could I?”

『如果你说的话不实在，岂不都是我的罪过？』萧家骥笑了。
“If what you say is untrue, will not all the blame fall on me?” Xiao laughed.

见此人老实可欺，有意装出轻视的神色，
Seeing that the man was simple and easily deceived, he deliberately assumed a look of contempt.

『你的话真教人好笑？
“What an amusing thing to say!

你怎么知道我的话不实在；
Why should you suppose I am not telling the truth?

我在上海住得好好的，
I was living very comfortably in Shanghai.

路远迢迢跑到这里来干什么？
Why else would I travel all this way?

跟你实说吧，我是英国人委托我来的，
Let me be frank: the British have commissioned me to come here.

要见忠王，有大事奉陈。』他突然问道∶『请问尊姓大名？』
I must see the Loyal King and lay an important matter before him.” Suddenly he asked, “May I know your name?”

『我叫陆德义。』
“Lu Deyi.”

『见了忠王，我替你说好话，
“When I see the Loyal King, I shall put in a good word for you.

包有重赏。』
You are certain to receive a handsome reward.”

李秀成治军与其他洪杨将领，本自不同，
Li Xiucheng managed his army differently from the other Taiping commanders.

一向注重招贤纳士；
He had always set great store by attracting able men.

所以陆德义听了他这话，越发不敢怠慢，
At Xiao’s words, Lu was more anxious than ever to show him proper attention.

『萧先生，』他很诚恳地答道∶『多蒙你好意，我先谢谢。
“Mr Xiao,” he answered sincerely, “thank you for your kindness.

不过，今天已经晚了，
But it is late today.

你先住一夜；我一面派人禀报上头，
Stay the night while I send a report to my superiors.

上头派人来接。
They will send someone to fetch you.

你看好不好？』
Would that suit you?”


这也不便操之过急，
It would not do to press too hard.

萧家骥心想，先住一夜，趁这陆德义好相与，打听打听情形，行事岂不是更有把握？
Xiao thought that a night’s stay would allow him to question this obliging man and learn more about the situation, giving him a firmer basis for action.

便即欣慰答道∶『那也好。
He therefore replied with apparent satisfaction, “Very well.

我就住一夜。』
I shall stay the night.”

于是陆德义奉之为上宾，设酒款待。
Lu treated him as an honoured guest and entertained him with wine.

萧家骥跑惯长江码头，而陆德义是汉阳人；
Xiao knew the Yangtze ports well, and Lu came from Hanyang.

因而以湖北近况为话题，谈得相当投机。
Recent events in Hubei supplied a topic, and they soon fell into congenial conversation.

最后谈到杭州城内的情状，
Eventually they came to conditions inside Hangzhou.

那陆德义倒真不失为忠厚人，
Lu showed himself a man of genuine kindness.

愀然不乐，
His face fell.

『真正是劫数！』
“Truly a calamity!”


他叹口气说∶『一想起来，教人连饭都吃不下。
He sighed. “The thought of it spoils one’s appetite.

但愿早早破城，杭州的百姓，还有生路；
I only hope the city falls soon, so that its people may have a chance to live.

再这样围困着，只怕杭州的百姓都要死光了。』
If this siege goes on, I fear they will all perish.”

『是啊！』萧家骥趁机说道，
“Yes,” Xiao said, seizing his opportunity.

『我来做这笔大生意，当然是帮你们，实在也是为杭州百姓好。
“Naturally, the great business I have come to arrange will help your side, but it will really benefit Hangzhou’s people too.

不过，我也不懂，
Yet there is something I do not understand.

忠王破苏州，大仁大义，百姓无不感戴。
When the Loyal King took Suzhou, his humanity and generosity won everyone’s gratitude.

既然如此，何不放杭州百姓一条生路。』
Why, then, does he not give the people here a way to survive?”

『现在是骑虎难下了。』陆德义答道∶『听说忠王射箭进城，箭上有封招降的书信，
“It is hard to dismount once one has mounted a tiger,” Lu replied. “I hear the Loyal King had an arrow shot into the city with a letter urging surrender.

说得极其恳切；无奈城里没有回音。』
It was most earnestly expressed, but no answer came.”

『喔！』
“Oh?

萧家骥问道∶『招降的书信怎么说？』
What did the letter say?”

『说是不分军民满汉，愿投降的投降，不愿投降的遣散。
“That soldiers and civilians, Manchus and Han alike, might surrender if they wished, and those who did not wish to surrender would be allowed to leave.

忠王已经具本奏报「天京」，请天王准赦满军回北，
The Loyal King has already sent a memorial to the Heavenly Capital, asking the Heavenly King to pardon the Manchu troops and let them return north.

从这里到「天京」往返要二十几日，「御批」还没有因来。
The journey there and back takes more than twenty days, and the imperial rescript has not yet arrived.

一等「御批」发回，就要派人跟瑞昌议和。
Once it comes, someone will be sent to negotiate peace with Ruichang.

那时说不定又是一番场面了。』
Things may look very different then.

陆德义说∶『我到过好多地方，看起来，杭州的满兵顶厉害。』
I have been to many places,” Lu added, “but the Manchu soldiers in Hangzhou seem to be the fiercest of all.”

这使得萧家骥又想起胡雪岩的话，杭州只要有存粮，一年半载都守得住，
This recalled Hu’s words to Xiao: with food in store, Hangzhou could hold out for six months or a year.

因而也越发感到自己的责任重大，
He felt the weight of his responsibility more keenly than ever.

所以这一夜睡在陆德义的『公馆』里，一遍一遍设想各种情况，
Lying that night in Lu’s “residence”, he imagined every possible turn of events again and again.

盘算着如何能够取信于李秀成，脱出监视；
How could he gain Li Xiucheng’s trust and free himself from surveillance?

如何遇到官军以后，能够使得他们相信他不是奸细，带他进城去见王有龄？
Once he encountered the imperial troops, how could he convince them that he was no spy and have them take him into the city to see Wang?

这样辗转反侧，直到听打四更，方始朦胧睡去；
He tossed and turned until he heard the fourth watch being called, and only then drifted into an uneasy sleep.

也不知睡了多少时候，突然惊醒，
He had no idea how long he had slept before he woke with a start.

只听得人声嘈杂，脚步匆遽，仿佛出现了极大的变故。
Voices clamoured and footsteps hurried outside, as though something momentous had happened.

萧家骥一惊之下，睡意全消，
All sleep vanished.

倏然坐起，凝神静听；听出一句话∶『妖风发了，
He sat bolt upright and listened intently, catching a cry: “The demon wind is up!

妖风发了！』
The demon wind is up!”

这句话似乎在哪里听过，
He seemed to have heard the expression somewhere.

萧家骥咬紧了牙，苦苦思索，终于想到了，是沙船上无事，听胡雪岩谈过，长毛称清军为『妖』，
Clenching his teeth, he searched his memory until at last he remembered: in an idle moment aboard the junk, Hu had told them that the Longhairs called the Qing troops “demons”.

『妖风发了』就是清军打过来了。
“The demon wind is up” meant that imperial troops were attacking.


一想到此，又惊又喜，急忙起床，扎束停当；
Alarmed and delighted at once, Xiao hurried out of bed and dressed himself securely.

却还不敢造次，
Still he dared not act rashly.

推开一条门缝，往外张望，
Opening the door a crack, he peered out.

只见长毛蜂拥而出，手中的武器，种类不一，有红缨枪、有白蜡杆、有大砍刀、也有洋枪——枪声已经起了；杂着呼啸之声，忽远忽近，忽东忽西，随着风势大小在变化，
Longhairs were pouring outside with weapons of every kind—red-tasselled spears, ash-wood staffs, great chopping swords and foreign firearms. Gunfire had begun already, mingled with shouts that seemed now near, now far, now east, now west as the wind rose and fell.

似乎清军颇不少。
The attacking imperial force appeared considerable.



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第二章（本章第3部分，共4部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


怎么样？
What should he do?

萧家骥在心中自问；
Xiao Jiaji asked himself.

要脱身，此时是大好机会，
If he meant to escape, this was an excellent opportunity.

但外面的情况不清楚，
But he knew nothing of conditions outside.

糊里糊涂投入枪林弹雨中，死了都只怕没人知道，岂不冤枉？
To blunder into a hail of bullets and die without anyone even knowing what had happened—what a senseless end that would be!

然而不走呢？别的不说，起码要见李秀成，就不是一下子办得到的；
Yet if he stayed, there was at least one obvious difficulty: he could hardly expect to meet Li Xiucheng at once.

耽误了工夫不说，也许陆德义就死在这一仗中，再没有这样一个讲理的人可以打交道，
Apart from the time he would lose, Lu Deyi might be killed in this very battle, leaving him without such a reasonable man to deal with.

后果更不堪设想。
The consequences did not bear thinking about.

就在这样左右为难之际，只见院子外面又闪过一群人，
While he wavered, another group hurried past outside the courtyard.

脚步轻，语声也轻，但很急促，
Their footsteps and voices were light, but urgent.

『快，快！』有人催促，
“Quick, quick!” someone urged.

『快「逃长毛」，
“Get away from the Longhairs!

逃到哪里算哪里？』
It does not matter where we end up!”

『逃长毛』是句很流行的话，萧家骥听胡雪岩也常将这三个字挂在口头，
“Getting away from the Longhairs” was a common expression; Xiao had often heard Hu use it.

意思是从长毛那里逃走；
It meant escaping from their hands.

而『逃到哪里算哪里』，更是一大启示。
But “it does not matter where we end up” was a revelation.

『逃！』他对自己说，
“Escape!” he told himself.

『不逃，难道真的要跟李秀成做军火生意？』
“If I do not, am I really going to sell arms to Li Xiucheng?”


打字主意，更不怠慢；不过虽快不急，
His mind made up, he wasted no time, though he moved quickly rather than rashly.

看清楚无人，一溜烟出了夹弄，豁然开朗，
Making sure no one was about, he slipped down the narrow passage and emerged into an open space.

同时闻到饭香，
The smell of cooking reached him.

抬头一看，是个厨房。
He looked up: a kitchen.

厨房很大，但似乎没有人。
It was large and apparently deserted.

萧家骥仔细察看着，一步一步走过院落，
He examined it carefully, crossing the courtyard a step at a time.

直到灶前，才发现有个人生在灶下烤火；
Only when he reached the stove did he discover a man sitting beside its base, warming himself.

人极瘦，眼睛大，骤见之下，形容格外可怖，吓得他倒退了两步。
The man was terribly thin, with enormous eyes; coming upon him so suddenly, Xiao found his appearance frightening and recoiled two paces.

那人却似一个傻子，一双虽大而失神的眼，瞅着萧家骥，什么表情都没有。
The man merely stared, as if half-witted, his large, lifeless eyes showing no expression.

『你是什么人？』他问。
“Who are you?” Xiao asked.

『你不要来问我！』那人用微弱的声音答道∶『我不逃！
“Do not bother asking me,” the man replied feebly. “I am not running away.

逃来逃去逃不出他们的手；
Run where you will, you never get out of their hands.

听天由命了。』
I shall leave it to fate.”

听得这话，萧家骥的心凉了一半，
Half of Xiao’s courage ebbed away.

怔怔地望着他，半晌无语。
He stared at the man, unable to speak for some time.


『看你这样子，不是本地人；
“By the look of you, you are not from here.

哪里逃来的？』
Where have you escaped from?”

看他相貌和善、
The man had a kindly face.

而且说话有气无力，生趣索然似的，萧家骥便消除一恐怕戒备之心，
His voice was weak, as though life held no interest for him, and Xiao’s fear and suspicion subsided.

老实答道∶『我从上海来。』
“I have come from Shanghai,” he answered truthfully.

『上海不是有夷场吗？
“Is there not a foreign settlement in Shanghai?

大家逃难都要逃到那里去，
Everyone fleeing the troubles wants to get there.

你怎么反投到这里来？』
Why have you come into this place instead?”

那人用听起来空落落的绝望的声音说∶『天堂有路你不走，地狱无门闯进来！
His voice sounded hollow with despair. “Heaven’s road lay open, and you would not take it; hell had no gate, yet you forced your way in.

何苦？』
Why bring such trouble on yourself?”

『我也是无法，』
“I had no choice.”

萧家骥借机试探，却又不便说真话，
Xiao used the opportunity to sound him out, though he dared not yet tell the truth.

『我有个生死至交，陷在杭州，
“I have a friend in Hangzhou, a man bound to me for life and death.

我想进城去看他。』
I wanted to go into the city to see him.”

『你发疯了！』
“You are mad!

那人说道，『杭州城里人吃人，
People are eating each other inside Hangzhou.

你那朋友，只怕早饿死了；
Your friend is probably dead of starvation already.

你到哪里去看他？
Where would you go to see him?

就算看到了，你又不能救他；
And even if you found him, you could not save him.

自己陷在里头，活活饿死。
You would be trapped yourself and starve to death.

这打的是什么算盘？
What sort of reckoning is that?

真正气数。』
Truly, it must be fate.”

话中责备，正显得本心是好的，
His reproaches revealed a good heart.

萧家骥决定跟他说实话，先问一句∶『你老人家贵姓？』
Xiao decided to tell him the truth, first asking, “May I know your name, sir?”


『人家都叫我老何。』
“Everyone calls me Old He.”

『老何，我姓萧，
“Old He, my name is Xiao.

跟你老人家老实说吧，
I shall be honest with you.

我是来救杭州百姓的——也不是我，是你们杭州城里鼎鼎大名的一位善人做好事；
I have come to save the people of Hangzhou—or rather, it is not I, but a philanthropist of great renown in your city who is doing this good deed.

带了大批粮食，由上海赶来。教我到城里见王抚台送信。』
He has brought a large quantity of grain from Shanghai and sent me to see Governor Wang with a message.”

萧家骥略停一下，摆出一切都豁出去的神态说∶『老何，我把我心里的话都告诉你，
Xiao paused briefly, then assumed the manner of a man staking everything on a single throw. “I have told you what is in my heart.

你如果是长毛一伙，算我命该如此，今年今月今日今时，要死在这里。
If you belong to the Longhairs, then it is my fate to die here, in this year, this month, this day, and this hour.

如果不是，请你指点我条路子。』
If you do not, please show me a way through.”

老何听他说完，沉思不语，
Old He listened and sat in thought without speaking.

好久，才抬起头来；
After a long time he raised his head.

萧家骥发觉他的眼神不同了，
Xiao saw that his eyes had changed.

不再是那黯然无光，近乎垂死的人的神色，
They no longer had the dull, almost dying look of before.

是闪耀着坚毅的光芒，仿佛一身的力量都集中在那方寸眸子中似的。
They shone with determination, as though all the strength in his body had gathered within them.


他将手一伸∶『信呢？』
He held out his hand. “Where is the letter?”

萧家骥愕然∶『什么信？』
Xiao was taken aback. “What letter?”

『你不是说，那位大善人托你送信给王抚台吗？』
“Did you not say that this great benefactor had sent you with a message for Governor Wang?”

『是的。是口信。』
“Yes, but it is a spoken message.

萧家骥说，『白纸写黑字，万一落在长毛手里，岂不糟糕？』
If there were black words on white paper and they fell into the Longhairs’ hands, would that not be disastrous?”

『口信？』
“A spoken message?”

老何踌躇着，
Old He hesitated.

『口信倒不大好带。』
“That would be rather difficult to carry.”

『怎么？老何，』
“What do you mean, Old He?”

萧家骥了解了他的意思∶『你是预备代我去送信？』
Xiao understood him. “Were you intending to take it for me?”

『是啊？
“Yes.

我去比你去总多几分把握。
I should have a better chance than you.

不过，凭我这副样子，说要带口信给王抚台，没有人肯相信的。』
But looking as I do, no one would believe me if I said I had an oral message for the governor.”

『那这样，』萧家骥一揖到地，『请老何你带我进城。』
“Then let me ask you”—Xiao bowed to the ground—“to take me into the city.”

『不容易。
“It will not be easy.

我一个人还好混；象你这样子，混不进去。』
I might slip through alone, but someone who looks like you could never get in.”

『那末，要怎样才混得进去？』
“Then what must I do?”


『第一、你这副脸色，又红又白，就象天天吃大鱼大肉的样子，
“First of all, your face is pink and white, as if you ate fish and meat every day.

混进城里，就是麻烦。
