“There is something important I must ask you,” Xiao continued.

那笔米价，大记的人问我怎么算法？
“The people at Daji wanted to know how the rice was to be accounted for.

是卖了拆帐、还是作价给他们？
Should they sell it and divide the proceeds with us, or take it over at an agreed price?

我说米先领了去，
I told them to receive the rice first.

怎样算法，要问了你才能定规；
The terms could only be settled after I had asked you.

如果他们不肯答应，我作不了主，米只好原船运回。
If they would not agree to that, I had no authority to do otherwise, and the rice would have to return on the same boats.

大记答应照我的办法；
Daji accepted.

现在要问胡先生了。
Now I must ask you.

照我看，拆算比较合算！』
In my view, sharing the proceeds would be the more advantageous arrangement.”

『不！』胡雪岩断然答道∶『我不要钱。』
“No,” Hu answered firmly. “I do not want money.”

那末要什么呢？
What did he want, then?

胡雪岩要的是米；要的是运粮的船，
Rice—and vessels to carry it.

只等杭州一旦克复，三天以内就要。
Once Hangzhou was recaptured, he wanted them available within three days.

他的用意是很容易明白；
His purpose was easily understood.

等杭州从长毛手里夺了回来，必定饿殍载途，灾民满城，
When the city was recovered from the rebels, the roads would surely be strewn with those who had starved, and the city full of distressed survivors.

那时所需要的就是米。
What they would need was rice.

『何必这么做？』萧家骥劝他∶『胡先生，
“Why arrange it like that?” Xiao urged.

在商言商，你的算盘是大家佩服的，这样做法，不等于将本钱「搁煞」在那里。
“Speaking strictly as a businessman—and everyone admires your calculations—would this not leave your capital tied up and idle?

而况杭州克复，遥遥无期。』
Besides, the recapture of Hangzhou may be a long way off.”

『不见得。
“Not necessarily.

气运要转的。』胡雪岩显得有些激动，
Fortunes will turn,” Hu said with some agitation.

『长毛搞的这一套，翻覆无常，
“The rebels’ conduct is erratic and unreliable.

我看他们不会久了。
I do not think they can last.

三、五年的功夫，就要完蛋。』
In three or five years they will be finished.”

『三、五年是多少辰光，
“Three or five years is a long time.

利上盘利，一担米变成两三担米；
With interest compounding, one dan of rice can become two or three.

你就为杭州百姓，也该盘算盘算。』
Even for the sake of Hangzhou’s people, you ought to consider the calculation.”

『话不错！』
“That is true.”

胡雪岩又比较平静了，
Hu grew calmer again.

『我有我的想法，
“But I have my own reasons.

第一、我始终没有绝望，
First, I have not entirely given up hope.

也许援兵会到，杭州城可以不破，
Reinforcements may arrive, and Hangzhou may not fall.

如果粮道可以打通，我立刻就要运米去接济，
If the supply route can be opened, I shall want to send rice at once.

那时候万一不凑手，岂不误了大事；
If it were not readily available, we might lose the opportunity.

第二、倘或杭州真的失守，留着米在那里，等克复以后，随时可以启运——
Second, if the city does fall, keeping rice ready means it can be dispatched whenever the place is recovered.

这是一种自己安慰自己的希望；
It is a hope with which I comfort myself.

说穿了，是自己骗自己，总算我对杭州也尽到心了。』
To put it plainly, I am deceiving myself, but at least I shall have done what I can for Hangzhou.”

『这也有道理，
“That makes sense too.

我就跟大记去交涉。』
I shall negotiate with Daji on those terms.”



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第三章（本章第3部分，共4部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


『这不忙。』胡雪岩问道∶『医生啥时光来？』
“There is no hurry about that,” Hu said. “When does the doctor come?”

『每天都是中饭以后。』
“Every day after lunch.”

『那就早点吃饭；吃完了她好收拾。』
“Then let us eat early, so she has time to clear everything away.”

胡雪岩又问阿巧姐，
He turned to A’qiao.

『等会医生来了，你要不要回避？』
“When the doctor comes, will you need to withdraw?”

虽然女眷不见男客，但对医生却是例外，不一定要回避；
Women of the household did not receive male visitors, but doctors were an exception; she need not necessarily hide herself.

只是他问这句话，就有让她回避的意思，
His question, however, implied that he wanted her to withdraw.

阿巧姐当然明白，顺着他的心意答道∶『我在屏风后面听好了。』
Understanding perfectly, she gave the answer he desired. “I shall listen from behind the screen.”

胡雪岩是知道她会回避，有意这样问她；
Hu had deliberately asked because he knew she would offer to leave.

不过她藏在屏风后面听，调虎不能离山，在自己等于不回避，
But listening behind a screen hardly amounted to leaving at all: he had lured the tiger aside without getting it off the mountain.

还要另动脑筋。
He needed another plan.

这也简单得很，
That was simple enough.

他先请萧家骥替他写信，占住了他的手；
First he asked Xiao to write a letter for him, keeping his hands occupied.

然后说想吃点甜汤，要阿巧姐到厨房里去要洋糖，
Then he said he fancied some sweet soup and sent A’qiao to the kitchen for foreign sugar.

这样将她调遣了开去，就可以跟萧家骥说私了。
Once she was out of the way, he could speak privately.

『家骥，你信不必写了，
“You need not write the letter, Jiaji.

我跟你说句话，
There is something I want to tell you.

你过来。』
Come here.”

萧家骥走到床前，
Xiao came to the bedside.

他说∶『我决定马上回上海，
“I have decided to return to Shanghai at once,” Hu said.

你跟医生说一说；
“Speak to the doctor.

我无论如何要走。』
Whatever happens, I must go.”

『为什么？』萧家骥诧异，
“Why?” Xiao asked in surprise.

『何必这么急？』
“What is the hurry?”


『不为什么？
“No particular reason.

我就是要走。
I simply must go.

到了上海，我才好打听消息。』胡雪岩又说，『本来我的心冷透了。
Only in Shanghai can I find out what is happening.” Hu continued, “My heart had gone completely cold.

今天一早跟阿巧谈了半天，说实话，我的心境大不相同。
But after talking with A’qiao this morning, I feel very differently.

我现在有两件事，
I have two things to do now.

第一件是救杭州，
The first is to save Hangzhou.

不管它病入膏盲，我死马要当活马医。
However hopeless its condition, I shall treat even a dead horse as though it could still be saved.

第二件，我要做我的生意；
The second is to attend to my business.

做生意一步落不得后，
In business one cannot afford to fall a single step behind.

越早到消息灵通的地方越好。
The sooner I reach a place where news travels freely, the better.

你懂了吧？』
Do you understand?”

『第二点我懂，头一点我不懂。』
“I understand the second point, but not the first.

萧家骥问道∶『你怎么救杭州？』
How are you going to save Hangzhou?”

『现在没法子细谈。』
“There is no time to explain.”

胡雪岩有些张皇地望着窗外。
Hu glanced anxiously towards the window.

这是因为苗条一影，已从窗外闪过，阿巧姐快进来了。
A slender figure had just passed outside; A’qiao was about to come in.

胡雪岩就把握这短短的片刻，告诫萧家骥跟医生私底下『情商』，不可让阿巧姐知道。
Seizing the few moments left, he instructed Xiao to negotiate privately with the doctor and let her know nothing of it.

是何用意，不易明了；但时机迫促，无从追问，
Xiao could not readily understand his purpose, but there was no time to ask.

萧家骥只有依言行事。
He could only do as he was told.

等胡雪岩喝完一碗桂圆洋糖蛋汤，阿巧姐收拾好了一切，医生也就到了。
By the time Hu had finished a bowl of longan-and-egg soup sweetened with foreign sugar and A’qiao had put everything in order, the doctor arrived.


那医生颇负盛名，医道医德都高人一等。
The physician enjoyed a considerable reputation, distinguished as much for his professional integrity as for his skill.

见胡雪岩人虽瘦弱，双目炯炯有光，
Though Hu was still thin and weak, his eyes shone brightly.

大为惊异，一夜之隔，病似乎去了一大半，
The doctor was astonished: in a single night, more than half the illness seemed to have gone.

他自承是行医四十年来罕见之事。
He acknowledged that he had seldom seen such a thing in forty years of practice.

『这自然是先生高明。』
“That is naturally due to your skill, sir.”

胡雪岩歉意地问∶『先生贵姓？』
Somewhat apologetically, Hu asked, “May I know your surname?”

『张先生。』萧家骥一旁代答，顺便送上一顶高帽子，
“Dr Zhang,” Xiao answered for him, adding a flattering introduction.

『宁波城里第一块牌子；
“The foremost physician in Ningbo.

七世祖传的儒医。
His is a family of scholarly doctors, seven generations in the profession.

张先生本人也是有功名的人。』
Dr Zhang himself holds a scholarly degree.”

所谓『功名』，想起来是讲过学的秀才，
Presumably that meant he had qualified as a licentiate.

『失敬了！』胡雪岩说∶『我是白丁。』
“I have been wanting in respect,” Hu said. “I have no degree at all.”

『胡大人太客气了。
“You are too modest, Your Excellency.

四海之大，三品顶戴无论如何是万人之上。』
Wherever one goes in this great world, a man entitled to the hat button of the third rank is above ten thousand others.”

『可惜不是一人之下。』胡雪岩自嘲着纵声大笑。
“A pity there is still more than one man above me!” Hu laughed loudly at his own expense.


笑得太急，呛了嗓子，咳得十分厉害；
He laughed too suddenly, caught his breath the wrong way and began coughing violently.

萧家骥赶紧上去替他捶背，却是越咳越凶，
Xiao hurried to pat his back, but the cough only grew worse.

张医生亦是束手无策，坐等他咳停。
Dr Zhang too was helpless and could only wait for it to stop.

这一下急坏了阿巧姐；
A’qiao became desperately anxious.

她知道胡雪岩的毛病，要抹咽喉，喝蜜水才能将咳嗽止住；
She knew Hu’s complaint: his throat needed stroking, and honey water would quiet the cough.

萧家骥不得其法，自然无效。
Xiao was using the wrong method, so naturally it did no good.

蜜水一时无法张罗，另一点却是办得到，
Honey water could not be procured at once, but the other remedy was within reach.

『萧少爷，』她忍不住在屏风后面喊∶『拿他的头仰起来，抹抹喉咙。』
“Mr Xiao,” she could not help calling from behind the screen, “tilt his head back and stroke his throat.”

是娇滴滴的吴侬软语，
The voice was soft and sweet, with the gentle inflections of the Wu dialect.

张医生不免好奇，转脸张望；而且率直问道∶『有女眷在？』
Curious, Dr Zhang turned to look and asked directly, “Is there a lady here?”

医生是什么话都可以问，不算失礼；
A physician might ask anything without offence.

但萧家骥却很难回答，
Xiao, however, found the question awkward.

一面替胡雪岩抹着喉头，一面含含糊糊地答道∶『嗯，嗯，是！』
As he stroked Hu’s throat, he replied indistinctly, “Mm, yes.”

张医生欲语又止；
The doctor seemed about to say more, then stopped.

等胡雪岩咳停了才切脉看舌苔，仔细问了饮食起居的情形，
Once the coughing ceased, he took Hu’s pulse, inspected his tongue and asked carefully about his food, sleep and daily habits.

欣慰地表示∶『病势已经不碍，
He then announced with satisfaction, “The illness is no longer dangerous.

只须调养，
He needs only nursing and rest.

大概半个月以后可以复原。』
He should recover in about a fortnight.”


『多谢，多谢！』
“Thank you, thank you!”

胡雪岩拱拱手说∶『家骥你陪张先生到你那里开方子去吧！』
Hu clasped his hands. “Jiaji, take Dr Zhang to your room to write the prescription.”

萧家骥会意，
Xiao understood.

等开好方子，便谈到胡雪岩想回上海的话。
When the prescription was finished, he raised the question of Hu’s wish to return to Shanghai.

张医生深为困惑，
The doctor was deeply perplexed.

『病人连移动床铺都是不相宜的。』
“It would be inadvisable even to move him to another bed.

他问，『大病刚有转机，
His grave illness has only just begun to improve.

何可这样子轻率冒失？』
How can he act so rashly?”

『实在是在上海有非他到场不可的大事要办。』家骥说∶『路上也只有一两天的功夫，
“There really is important business in Shanghai that cannot be managed without him,” Xiao said. “The journey takes only a day or two.

请张先生多开几服调理药带去；格外当心照料，想来不碍。』
If you would prescribe several doses to support his recovery, and we were especially careful in looking after him, surely he would come to no harm?”

『照料！
“Look after him?

那个照料？
Who would do that?

万一病势翻覆，我又不在船上；
If the illness returned, I should not be aboard.

你们怎么办。』
What would you do then?”

『是！』萧家骥说，
“Quite so,” Xiao said.

『那就只好算了。』
“We shall have to abandon the idea.”

而间壁的胡雪岩耳朵尖，
But Hu had sharp ears.

听了张医生的话，已经有了主意，请他到上海出诊，随船照料。
Listening from the next room, he had already found an answer: invite Dr Zhang to make a professional visit to Shanghai and care for him during the voyage.


等张医生开好方子，告辞上轿，阿巧姐自然也不必回避了，
Once the doctor had taken his leave and entered his sedan chair, A’qiao no longer needed to remain hidden.

胡雪岩便当着萧家骥透露了他的意思。
With Xiao present, Hu revealed his idea.

这个想法亦未始不可行；
It was not inherently impracticable.

富室巨户，多有这样重金礼聘，专用车船奉迎的，
Wealthy households often paid handsomely to engage a doctor in this manner and sent special carriages or boats to fetch him.

但是眼前时地不同，阿巧姐和家骥都觉得不易办到。
But at this particular time and place, both A’qiao and Xiao thought it would be difficult.

『他肯去当然最好；就怕他不肯。』萧家骥说∶『第一、宁波的市面还不甚平靖，
“It would be ideal if he agreed,” Xiao said. “I only fear he will not. First, Ningbo is still unsettled.

离家远行，恐怕不放心；
He may be uneasy about leaving his home.

第二、快过年了，
Second, the New Year is approaching.

宁波人的风俗，最重过年团圆，
Ningbo people attach great importance to the family reunion.

在外头做生意的，都要赶回家来，
Even those doing business elsewhere hurry home.

哪里反倒有出远门的？』
Who sets off on a long journey then?”

『过年还早，
“There is still time before New Year.

我一定赶年前送他回来。』胡雪岩又说∶『说不说在我，肯不肯在他；
I shall certainly send him back beforehand,” Hu replied. “It is for me to ask and for him to agree or refuse.

你何妨去谈一谈。』
Why not go and speak to him?”

『那当然可以。
“Of course I can.

我本来要到他清仪堂去撮药；顺便就看他。』
I must go to his Qingyi Hall to have the prescription made up anyway, so I can see him there.”

『原来他也开着药店？』胡雪岩说，
“He owns a pharmacy too?” Hu said.

『那太好了！
“Excellent!

就是他不肯到上海，我也想跟他谈谈。』
Even if he will not come to Shanghai, I should like to talk with him.”

胡雪岩想开药店是大家知道的；
Everyone knew Hu wanted to open a pharmacy.

萧家骥心中一动，点点头说∶『这倒或许会谈得投机。』
An idea occurred to Xiao, and he nodded. “You might well find much to discuss.”

『那是另外一回事，
“That is another matter.

家骥，只要他肯去，他怎么说，我们怎么依他。
Jiaji, so long as he agrees to come, we shall accept whatever terms he names.

还有，要投其所好。
And appeal to his particular interests.

你懂我的意思吧？』
You understand?”

『我懂，』
“I understand.”

萧家骥笑道，
Xiao smiled.

『不过，恐怕要请了他来，你自己跟他谈。』
“But I fear you must invite him here and speak to him yourself.”

去了一个多时辰，萧家骥回来了，
More than two hours later he returned.

说张医生答应来吃晚饭，又说他喜欢字画。
Dr Zhang had accepted an invitation to dinner, he reported, and was fond of calligraphy and painting.

问到邀他同行照料的话，萧家骥表示还不便开口；
Asked about inviting him to accompany them as physician, Xiao said he had not yet found it convenient to raise the matter.

又说最好由阿巧姐来说，
He added that A’qiao ought to make the request.

因为这是不情之请，只有女眷相求，容易成功。
It was an unreasonable favour to ask; a lady’s appeal would be more likely to succeed.


『这话也是。
“That is true.

男人说话，一句就是一句，
When a man speaks, his word must mean what it says.

碰了钉子或者打了折扣，以后说话就不值钱了。
If he is rebuffed or has to climb down, his words will carry less weight afterwards.

阿巧，』胡雪岩问道∶『你肯不肯说？』
A’qiao, will you ask him?”

『本来是不肯说的，
“I ought to refuse.

女人的话就不值钱；碰钉子、打折扣都不要紧？
So a woman’s word is worth nothing, and it does not matter if she is rebuffed or has to climb down?

真正气数！
What treatment!

不过——』她故意做个无可奈何的表情∶『唉！不说又不行；
Still—” She deliberately assumed a helpless expression. “Ah, there is nothing for it.

只好我来出面了。』
I shall have to do the asking.”

说停当了，要准备肴馔款客。
That settled, they had to prepare dinner for their guest.

胡雪岩认为不如到馆子里叫菜，比较郑重；
Hu thought ordering dishes from a restaurant would be more respectful.

阿巧姐也想省事，自然赞成；
A’qiao welcomed the saving of trouble and readily agreed.

但萧家骥不甚同意，
Xiao was less enthusiastic.

他肚子里另有一番话，要避着胡雪岩跟阿巧姐说。
He had something else to say to her, out of Hu’s hearing.

『胡先生，这些小事，你不必操心了，
“You need not trouble about these small matters, Mr Hu.

我要跟阿巧姐去商量。
I shall discuss them with A’qiao.

阿巧姐，我陪你到他们厨房里看了再说。』
Let me go with you to look at the kitchen first.”

走到廊下僻处，估量着胡雪岩听不见了，他站住脚，
When they reached a secluded stretch of the corridor where Hu could not hear, Xiao stopped.

要问她一句话。『阿巧姐，你是不是真的想帮胡先生办成功这件事？』
“A’qiao, do you really mean to help Mr Hu carry this through?”

『是啊！
“Yes.

本来我不赞成的，不过他一定要这样做，我无论如何只有依他。』
I did not approve at first, but if he insists, I can only do as he wishes.”

『既然无论如何要依他，那末，我有句话说出来，
“If you mean to do as he wishes whatever happens, there is something I must say.

你可不能动手。』
But you must not strike me.”


『不会的。
“I shall not.

你说好了。』
Tell me.”

『姓张的很关心你。
“Dr Zhang is very interested in you.

也不知道他怎么打听到的，晓得你姓何；
I do not know how he discovered it, but he knows you as Madam He.

何姨太长，何姨太短，不停地问。』
It was ‘Madam He’ this and ‘Madam He’ that; he never stopped asking.”

说到这里，萧家骥停下来看她的脸色。
Xiao paused to watch her face.

她的脸色自然不会好看，
Naturally, she did not look pleased.

气得满脸通红∶『这种郎中，
She flushed scarlet with anger. “A doctor like that!

狼心狗肺；
A heartless beast!

杀千刀！』
He deserves to be cut into a thousand pieces!”

『是不是？』萧家骥很冷静地说∶『我知道你要动气。』
“There, you see?” Xiao said calmly. “I knew you would be angry.”


一句话提醒了阿巧姐，知道他还有未说出来的话；如果自己还是这样子，那些话就听不到了。
That reminded her that he had more to say; if she carried on like this, she would never hear it.

转念又想，总怪自己的身分尴尬，
On reflection, her own awkward position was to blame.

何姨太出现在姓胡的这里，在人家看，当然也不是什么好女人；
Madam He appearing in a man named Hu’s quarters—people would hardly suppose her a respectable woman.

既然如此，就不妨动动歪脑筋了。
Since that was so, she might as well use a little crooked ingenuity herself.

这样转着念头，脸色自然就缓和了，
As these thoughts passed through her mind, her expression softened.

『随他去胡说八道，
“Let him talk whatever nonsense he pleases.

只要我自己行得正，坐得正好了。』
So long as I behave properly, that is enough.

她催促着，『你再说下去。』
Go on.”

『只为胡先生不走不可；要走，就非姓张的一起走不可。
“Mr Hu must leave, and he cannot leave unless Dr Zhang comes too.

所以，我只好耍记花枪。
So I had to try a little trick.

阿巧姐，你是明白人，又看在胡先生分上，一定不会怪我。』
You are an understanding woman, A’qiao, and for Mr Hu’s sake I am sure you will not blame me.”

话风不妙，阿巧姐有些吃惊，不过戒心起在暗中∶表面上又是一种态度∶『不会，不会。
This sounded ominous and rather alarmed her, though she kept her wariness to herself. Outwardly she took a different tone. “Of course not.

我晓得你是为他。
I know you are doing it for him.

你说出来商量。』
Tell me, and we shall discuss it.”

『我在想，如果直言相谈，说请他一起陪到上海；他一定不会答应。
“I thought that if I simply asked him to accompany us to Shanghai, he would refuse.

这话等他一出口，事情就僵了；
Once he had said no, we should be at an impasse.

所以我灵机一动，
So an idea came to me.

说是∶』何姨太特为要我来奉请，
I said, ‘Madam He specially asked me to invite you.

晚上她亲手做两样菜，请张先生喝酒。
She will cook a couple of dishes herself this evening and hopes you will join her for wine.

一定要请你赏光。
She begs the honour of your company.’

「他很高兴地答应了，说是」一定来，一定来！
He was delighted and said, ‘Certainly, certainly!’”

「『这用的是一条美人计，
It was a beauty’s lure.

阿巧姐心里当然不是味道；不过一想到是为胡雪岩，她自然就不会对萧家骥介意，
A’qiao naturally disliked it, but the thought that it was for Hu’s sake kept her from resenting Xiao.

她很平静地问道∶』他还有什么话？『
“What else did he say?” she asked calmly.


『自然还有话，
“He said more, of course.

他问我∶』何姨太为什么要请我？「我说∶『是因为你看好了胡道台，略表谢意。
‘Why should Madam He invite me?’ I told him, ‘To thank you for curing Intendant Hu.

另外还有件事求你。」
She also has another favour to ask.’

他一再问我什么事，我不肯说。
He kept asking what it was, but I would not tell him.

回头全要看你了。』
Now everything depends on you.”

阿巧姐点点头，将他前后的话细想了一遍，
A’qiao nodded and considered all he had said.

心里有了主意；只是有一点必须先弄清楚。
A plan formed in her mind, but one point had to be settled first.

『问到我怎么会在这里？你是怎么告诉他的？』
“When he asked why I was here, what did you tell him?”

『我说∶』何姨太现在下堂了。
“I said, ‘Madam He has now been dismissed from her household.

她是胡道台的大姨子；
She is Intendant Hu’s sister-in-law, the elder sister of his wife.

苏州现在沦陷在那里，娘家回不去，只好来投奔至亲。「他说∶『怪不得！
Suzhou is occupied, so she cannot return to her own family and has had to seek refuge with a close relation.’ He said, ‘That explains it!

人在难中，谈不到避嫌疑；
In troubled times one cannot be overparticular about appearances.

大姨子照料妹夫的病，也是应该的。
It is only right that a wife’s elder sister should nurse her brother-in-law.’”

「『阿巧姐明白，
A’qiao understood.

所谓』大姨子『是意指她有个妹妹嫁做胡雪岩的偏旁；
This supposed sister-in-law relationship implied that she had a younger sister who was one of Hu’s concubines.

关系如此安排，是疏而亲，亲而疏，不但她穿房入户，照料病人，可以说得过去，而且让色迷迷的张郎中希望不绝，才会上钩。
The arrangement made them close enough, yet not too close: it explained her freedom to come and go in his rooms and care for him, while leaving the amorous doctor enough hope to take the bait.


阿巧姐十分欣赏萧家骥的机智，但也不免好笑，
She greatly admired Xiao’s ingenuity, but could not help laughing.

『要死快哉！
“You dreadful boy!

耐那哼想得出格介？』她用道道地地苏州话笑着说。
How ever did you think of such a thing?” she said in the broadest Suzhou dialect.

萧家骥自己也笑了，
Xiao laughed too.

『看起来，他是想跟胡先生做「连襟」；
“It appears that he would like to become Mr Hu’s brother-in-law by marrying his wife’s sister.

既然至亲，无话不好谈。』
With so close a family connection, anything could be discussed.”

他提醒她说，『这出戏包定唱得圆满，
He reminded her, “This play is certain to come off beautifully.

不过，要不要先跟胡先生说好？你自己斟酌。』
But whether you ought to prepare Mr Hu first is for you to decide.”

阿巧姐考虑结果，认为不可不说，亦不可全说。
After considering it, A’qiao concluded that she must tell Hu something, but not everything.

她是在风尘中打过滚的，
She had known the world of the pleasure quarters.

男人的心，别样摸不透；只有这一层上，她真是了如指掌。
Other workings of a man’s mind might escape her, but in this one respect she understood him perfectly.

男人的气量大，固然不错，却就是论到夺爱，不能容忍；
A man might be generous by nature, yet he could not endure a rival taking the woman he loved.

因为这不但关乎妒意，还有面子在内。
It was not merely jealousy; his pride was involved as well.

于是略略安排了酒食，找个萧家骥不在眼前的机会，
Having made some arrangements for the food and wine, she found a moment when Xiao was absent.

问胡雪岩说∶『你是不是一定要姓张的郎中陪到上海？』
“Must you really have Dr Zhang accompany you to Shanghai?” she asked Hu.

『对！』
“Yes!”

胡雪岩答得斩钉截铁，
His answer was decisive.

『他不陪去，你不放心。
“Unless he comes, you will not feel easy.

那就只好想办法说动他了。』
We must find a way to persuade him.”

『办法，我跟萧家骥商量好了。
“Xiao and I have settled on a way.

不过有句话说在前面，
But there is something I must say first.

你要答应了，我们才好做。』
We can only proceed if you agree.”


一听就知道话中有话，
Hu could hear at once that there was more behind her words.

胡雪岩信得过他们两人，落得放漂亮些，
He trusted them both and might as well be magnanimous.

『不必告诉我。』
“You need not tell me.

他说∶『你们觉得怎么好，就怎么做。』
Do whatever you think best.”

『唷，唷，倒说得大方。』
“Oh, how generous you sound!”

阿巧姐用警告的口吻说∶『回头可不要小气。』
Her voice held a warning. “Do not turn mean afterwards.”

这就不能不好好想一想了。
That deserved some thought.

胡雪岩自负是最慷慨、最肯吃亏的人，所以对这『小气』的两字之贬，倒有些不甘承受。
Hu prided himself on his generosity and his readiness to accept a loss, and did not relish being called mean.

转念又想，阿巧姐阅历甚深，看男人不会看错；看自己更不会看错，
Yet A’qiao knew the world and was a shrewd judge of men; she would be especially unlikely to misjudge him.

然则说『小气』一定有道理在内。
There must be a reason for the word.

他的心思，这时虽不如平时敏捷，但依旧过人一等，
Though his mind was not as quick as usual, it was still quicker than most.

很快地想到萧家骥从家回来那时，说话带些吞吞吐吐，仿佛有难言之隐的神情，终于看出因头了。
He recalled Xiao’s hesitation on returning, his air of having something awkward to say, and soon grasped the clue.

于是他故意这样说∶『你看得我会小气∶一定是拿我什么心爱的东西送他。
Deliberately, he said, “If you think I shall be mean, you must be planning to give him something I treasure.

是不是？』
Is that it?”

『是啊』你有什么心爱的东西？
“Yes. What do you treasure?”

『『只有一样，』
“Only one thing.”

胡雪岩笑道∶『是个活宝。』
Hu smiled. “A living treasure.”

『你才是活宝！』
“You are the living treasure!”

阿巧姐嫣然一笑；不再提这件事了。
A’qiao smiled radiantly and said no more about it.


张医生早早就来了。
Dr Zhang arrived early.

一到自然先我看病人，少不得也要客气几句∶『多蒙费心，不知道怎么样道谢。
Naturally he first went to see his patient, and Hu offered the customary courtesies. “You have taken so much trouble that I do not know how to thank you.

谢过来吃顿便饭，真正千里鹅毛一片心；
This simple meal is only a goose feather brought a thousand li—a small token of heartfelt regard.

不过，我想总有补报的日子。
But I hope the day will come when I can repay you properly.

张先生，我们交个朋友。』
Let us be friends, Dr Zhang.”

『那是我高攀了。』张医生说，
“Then the honour is mine,” the doctor said.

『我倒觉得我们有缘同样的病，同样的药，有的一服见效，有的吃下去如石沉大海；
“I do feel there is an affinity between us. With the same illness and the same medicine, one patient responds to a single dose, while in another the drug sinks like a stone into the sea.

这就是医家跟病家有缘没有缘的道理。』
That is the difference between a doctor and patient who have an affinity and those who do not.”

『是的。』萧家骥接口说道∶『张先生跟我们都有缘。』
“Indeed,” Xiao interjected. “You have an affinity with all of us.”

『人生都是个缘字。』胡雪岩索性发议论，
“Life is all a matter of affinity,” Hu declared, launching into a little discourse.

『我做梦也没有想到会到宁波，
“I never dreamt that I should come to Ningbo.

到了宁波也不曾想到会生病，会承张先生救我的命——。』『言重，言重！』张医生说，
Even after arriving, I never imagined I should fall ill and owe my life to you—” “You are too kind!” Dr Zhang protested.

『药医不死人，
“Medicine cures those not destined to die.

原是吉人天相，所以药到病除，
Heaven protects a good man, and so the medicine takes effect.

我不敢贪天之功。』
I dare not claim Heaven’s credit.”

就这时门帘一掀，
Just then the door curtain lifted.

连萧家骥都觉得眼前一亮；
Even Xiao felt that the room had brightened.

但见阿巧姐已经着意修饰过了，
A’qiao had taken great care with her appearance.

虽是淡妆，偏令人有浓艳非凡之感。
Though her make-up was light, the effect was extraordinarily striking.

特别那一双剪水双瞳，眼风过处，不由得就吸住了张医生的视线。
Above all, her clear, liquid eyes drew the doctor’s gaze irresistibly wherever they glanced.

萧家骥知道阿巧姐跟胡雪岩的话说得不够清楚详细，
Xiao knew that she had not explained matters to Hu in sufficient detail.

深怕言语不符，露了马脚，赶紧借着引见这个因头，将他们的『关系』再『提示』一遍。
Afraid that their accounts might differ and expose the deception, he seized the opportunity of an introduction to remind them of their “relationship”.


『张先生，』他指着阿巧姐说∶『这位就是何姨太；胡大人的大姨子。』胡雪岩几乎笑出声来。
“Dr Zhang,” he said, indicating A’qiao, “this is Madam He, His Excellency Hu’s sister-in-law.” Hu almost laughed aloud.

萧家骥的花样真多，
Xiao had endless devices.

怎么编派成这样一门亲戚？
How had he invented such a family connection?

再看阿巧姐，倒也不以为意；
A’qiao, however, seemed entirely untroubled.

盈盈含笑地裣衤任为礼，大大方方招呼一声∶『张先生请坐！』
Smiling gracefully, she gathered her skirts in a courteous salute and said with perfect composure, “Please sit down, Dr Zhang.”

『不敢当，不敢当。』
“You are too kind, too kind.”

张医生急忙还礼，一双眼睛却始终舍不得向别处望一望。
He hastened to return the courtesy, though his eyes would not leave her.

『我们都叫何姨太阿巧姐。』萧家骥很起劲地作穿针引线的工作，
“We all call Madam He A’qiao,” Xiao continued, busily drawing them together.

『张先生，你也这样叫好了。』
“You should do the same.”

『是，是！
“Yes, yes.

阿巧姐。』
A’qiao.”

张医生问道∶『阿巧姐今年青春是？』
The doctor asked, “May I ask your youthful age?”

『哪里还有什么青春？
“Youth?

人老珠黄不值钱；
I am old now, a faded pearl without value.

今年三十二了。』
Thirty-two this year.”

『看不出，看不出。
“One would never guess it.

我略为懂一点相法；
I know a little of physiognomy.

让我仔细替阿巧姐看一看。』
Let me look at you carefully.”

也不知是他真的会看相，还是想找个借口恣意品评？
Whether he truly knew the art or merely wanted a pretext for admiring her at leisure was uncertain.

不过在阿巧姐自然要当他是真的，
Naturally, A’qiao had to take him at his word.

端然正坐，微微含笑，让他看相；
She sat upright with a faint smile, allowing him to read her features.

那副雍容自在的神态，看不出曾居偏房，更看不出来自风尘。
Her dignified ease betrayed neither that she had been a concubine nor that she had come from the pleasure quarters.


张医生将她从头看到脚；
Dr Zhang looked her over from head to foot.

一双脚缩在裙幅之中看不见，但手是可以讨来看的——
Her feet were hidden beneath the folds of her skirt, but he could ask to examine her hands.

看相要看手是通例；阿巧姐无法拒绝。
Reading the hands was a normal part of fortune-telling, and she could hardly refuse.

本来男左女右，只看一只，
Ordinarily a man showed his left hand and a woman her right, only one in either case.

也索性大方些，将一双手都伸了出来。
She chose to be generous and held out both.

手指象葱管那样，又长、又白、又细；
Her fingers were like tender scallion shoots, long, white and slender.

指甲也长，色呈淡红，象用凤仙花染过似的，
The nails too were long, with a delicate pink tint as though dyed with balsam flowers.

将张医生看得恨不能伸手去握一握。
Gazing at them, the doctor longed to reach out and clasp them.



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第三章（本章第4部分，共4部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


『好极了！』他说，
“Excellent!” he said.

『清贵之相。
“The signs of refinement and distinction.

越到晚年，福气越好。』
Your blessings will increase as you grow older.”

阿巧姐看了胡雪岩一眼，淡淡一笑，不理他那套话，
A’qiao glanced at Hu, smiled faintly and ignored his predictions.

说一句∶『没有什么菜。
“There are only a few dishes.

只怕怠慢了张先生！』
I fear we shall not entertain you properly, Dr Zhang.”

随即站起身来走了。
With that she rose and left.

张医生自不免有怅然若失之感。
He felt an inevitable sense of loss.

男女不同席，而况又是生客；
Men and women did not dine together, especially when the man was a stranger.

这一见面，就算表达了做主人的礼貌。
By appearing, she had fulfilled the courtesies of a hostess.

而且按常理来说，已赚过分，此后就再不可能相见了。
Indeed, by ordinary standards he had already enjoyed more than he could expect; there would be no further opportunity to see her.

『但是，她不是另外还有事要求我吗？』
“But does she not have another favour to ask?”

想到这一点，张医生宽心了；
The thought reassured him.

打定主意，不论什么事，非要她当面来说，才有商量的余地。
Whatever the request might be, he resolved that there could be no discussion unless she made it in person.


果然，一顿饭只是萧家骥一个人相陪；
As expected, only Xiao kept him company at dinner.

肴馔相当精致，
The dishes were delicately prepared.

最后送上火锅，阿巧姐才隔帘相语，说了几句客气话，从此芳踪杳然。
When the hotpot was brought in at the end, A’qiao spoke a few polite words from behind the curtain, then vanished again.

饭罢闲谈，又过了好些时候，张医生实在忍不住了；
They talked for some time after the meal, until Dr Zhang could bear it no longer.

开口问道∶『不是说阿巧姐有事要我办吗？』
“Did you not say that A’qiao wanted me to do something for her?”

『是的。
“Yes.

等我去问一问看。』
Let me go and ask.”

于是张医生只注意屏风，侧着耳朵静听；
The doctor watched the screen, straining his ears.

好久，有人出来了，却仍旧是萧家骥，
After a long while someone emerged, but it was only Xiao.

但是屏风后面却有纤纤一影。
Behind the screen, however, a slender shadow could be seen.

『阿巧姐说了，张先生一定不会答应的，不如不说。』
“A’qiao says you will certainly refuse, so she had better not mention it.”

『为什么不说？』张医生脱口答道∶『何以见得我不会答应。』
“Why should she not?” he blurted out. “What makes her think I shall refuse?”

『那我就说吧！』是屏风后面在应声。
“Then I shall tell you!” came the answer from behind the screen.


人随话到，阿巧姐翩然出现。
A’qiao appeared with the words.

衣服也换过了，
She had changed her clothes.

刚才是黑缎灰鼠出锋的皮袄，下系月白绸子百褶裙；
Earlier she had worn a black satin fur jacket edged with grey squirrel and a pleated skirt of palest blue silk.

此刻换了家常打扮，竹叶青宁绸的丝绵袄，
Now she was in informal dress: a silk-padded jacket of bamboo-green ning silk.

爱俏不肯穿臃肿的棉裤，也不肯象北地胭脂那样扎脚；
Too fond of looking pretty to wear bulky padded trousers, she would not bind the cuffs at the ankles as northern women did either.

是一条玄色软缎，镶着极宽的『栏杆』的撒脚裤。
Instead, her loose-cuffed trousers were of soft black satin, trimmed with very broad ornamental bands.

为了保暖，衣服腰身裁剪得极紧；越显得体态婀娜，更富风情。
For warmth, the jacket had been cut to fit closely at the waist, making her figure all the more graceful and alluring.

有了五六分酒意的张医生，到底本心还是谨饬一路的人物；
Dr Zhang was half-tipsy, yet at heart he remained a cautious, proper man.

因为艳光逼人，意不敢细看，
Her beauty was so dazzling that he dared not look closely.

略略偏着脸问道∶『阿巧姐有话就请吩咐。
Turning his face slightly aside, he asked, “Whatever you wish, A’qiao, please tell me.

是不是要我格外细心替你拟张膏滋药的方子？』
Is it a particularly careful prescription for a tonic paste?”

『这当然也要。』阿巧姐答说∶『不过不忙。
“That too, naturally,” she replied. “But there is no hurry.

我是受了我妹妹的重托，
My younger sister entrusted me with this duty.

不放心我这位至亲一个人在宁波；
She was uneasy about leaving our dear relation alone in Ningbo.

我又不能常川照应；就是照应总不及我妹妹细心体贴。
I cannot look after him constantly, and even when I do, I cannot be as attentive and considerate as my sister.

我在想，舍亲这场大病，幸亏遇着张先生，
I have been thinking how fortunate it was that, in such a grave illness, he found you.

真正着手成春，医道高明；
Your skill has brought him back to health as surely as spring revives the earth.

如今一定不碍了。
He must be out of danger now.

不过坐船到上海，没有张先生你照应，实在不放心。
But if he travels to Shanghai by boat without you to care for him, I really cannot feel easy.

那就只好——。』说到这里，她抽出腋下的乡花手绢，抿着嘴笑了一下，仿佛下面的话，不好意思出口似的。
So there is nothing for it but—” She drew an embroidered handkerchief from beneath her arm and smiled with her lips pressed together, as though too embarrassed to finish.

在张医生；那沥沥莺啭似的声音，听得他心醉不已；
Dr Zhang was intoxicated by the clear, oriole-like notes of her voice.

只顾欣赏声音，不免忽略了话中的意思，
Absorbed in the sound, he had paid too little attention to its meaning.

见她突然停住；不由得诧异。
Her sudden silence puzzled him.

『怎么不说下去。
“Why have you stopped?

请说，请说，
Please go on.

我在细听。』
I am listening carefully.”


其实意思已经很明显，
Her meaning was already perfectly clear.

细听而竟听不出来，可见得心不在焉。
If he had listened carefully and still failed to understand, his mind must have been elsewhere.

萧家骥见他有些丧魂落魄的样子，便向阿巧姐使个眼色，示意她实话直说，不必盘马弯弓，宛转透露了。
Seeing how thoroughly he had lost his senses, Xiao gave A’qiao a glance: she need not wheel her horse and draw her bow any longer, but should come straight to the point.

『好的，我就说。
“Very well, I shall.

不过，张先生，』阿巧姐一双大眼珠灵活地一闪，做出象娇憨的女孩子那样的神情∶『等我把话说出口，你可不能打我的回票！』
But, Dr Zhang—” Her large eyes flashed with a lively, almost girlish innocence. “Once I have said it, you must not turn me down!”

这话相当严重，
This was a serious demand.

张医生定定神，将她的话回想了一遍，
The doctor collected himself and went over her words in his mind.

才弄清楚是怎么回事，倒有些答应不下了。
Only then did he understand, and he found agreement rather difficult.

『是不是？』
“There, you see?”

阿巧姐意轻声对萧家骥说，
A’qiao deliberately spoke softly to Xiao.

『我说不开口的好；
“I said I had better not ask.

开了口白白碰钉子——。』『没有这话。』张医生不安地抢着说，
Now I have only invited a refusal—” “Not at all,” the doctor broke in uneasily.

『你的意思我懂了。
“I understand what you mean.

我在想的，不是我该不该陪着去。』
The question I am considering is not whether I ought to accompany him.”

『那末是什么呢？』
“Then what is it?”

『是病人能不能走？
“Whether the patient can travel.

这样的天气，跋涉波涛，万一病势反复，可不是件开玩笑的事。』
A sea voyage in weather like this—if his illness returned, it would be no laughing matter.”


话说得有理，但究竟是真话，还是托词，却不易估量；
His objection was reasonable, but it was hard to know whether it was sincere or merely an excuse.

阿巧姐也很厉害，便有意逼一逼；却又不直接说出来，
A’qiao was formidable herself and deliberately pressed him, though indirectly.

望着萧家骥问∶『张先生不是说，一路有他照应，就不要紧吗？』
Looking at Xiao, she asked, “Did Dr Zhang not say that, with him to look after the patient on the journey, there would be nothing to worry about?”

『是！
“Certainly.

有张先生在，还怕什么？』
With Dr Zhang there, what need we fear?”

两人一唱一和，倒象张医生不肯帮忙似的，使得他大为不安，
Their exchange made him seem unwilling to help, which distressed him greatly.

但到底还不敢冒失；
Still he dared not act rashly.

站起身来说∶『我再看看病。』
Rising, he said, “Let me examine him again.”

在隔室的胡雪岩，将他们的对答，只字不遗地听了进去；
In the next room, Hu had heard every word.

一半是心愿可望达成，心中喜乐，一半是要隐瞒病情，所以诊察结果，自然又显得大有进境。
Partly because the prospect of having his wish fulfilled delighted him, and partly because he meant to conceal his remaining symptoms, the examination naturally showed a marked improvement.

这时候张医生才能考虑自己这方面的情形。
Only now could Dr Zhang consider his own circumstances.

兵荒马乱，年近岁逼，实在不是出远门的时候；
Amid war and disorder, with the year drawing to its close, it was hardly the time for a long journey.

但话说得太慷慨，无法收科或者打折扣；
But he had spoken too generously to retreat or qualify his offer.

同时也存着满怀绮想，
At the same time, romantic fancies filled his mind.

实在舍不得放弃这个与阿巧姐海上同舟的机会，
He could not bear to relinquish the chance of sharing a sea voyage with A’qiao.

终于毅然答应了下来。
At last he made up his mind and agreed.


这一下，胡雪岩自然感激不尽；
Hu was naturally grateful beyond measure.

不过张医生所要的是阿巧姐的感激。
But it was A’qiao’s gratitude that Dr Zhang wanted.

此中微妙，胡雪岩也看得很清楚；
Hu understood the delicate distinction perfectly.

所以用红纸包了一百两银子，让她亲手致赠。
He wrapped a hundred taels in red paper and asked her to present them with her own hands.

『医家有割股之心。』张医生摇着双手说∶『谈钱，反倒埋没我的苦心了。』
“A physician should have a heart ready to sacrifice his own flesh,” the doctor said, waving both hands in refusal. “To speak of money would obscure the sincerity of my intentions.”

话说得很漂亮，不过阿巧姐也深知他的这片『苦心』，越发要送；因为无法也不愿酬答他的『苦心』。
Fine words—but A’qiao understood those “intentions” only too well, and was the more determined to give him the money because she could not and would not repay them in the manner he desired.

当然，这只是深藏在她心里的意思。
Naturally, she kept that thought deep within herself.

『张先生，你的苦心我知道。
“I understand your kind intentions, Dr Zhang.

这是我那位「妹夫」的一点小意思；
This is a small token from my ‘brother-in-law’.

他说了，若是张先生不受，于心不安，病好得不快；
He says that if you refuse it, his mind will be uneasy and his recovery will be slower.

他就不敢劳动大驾了。』
In that case, he would not dare ask you to undertake the journey.”

张医生将她的话，细细咀嚼了一遍，
The doctor savoured every word.

『你的苦心我知道』这几个字，简直就象用烙铁印了在心版上，再也忘不掉的了。
“I understand your kind intentions” was branded on his heart as if with a hot iron, never to be forgotten.

『既然如此，我也只好老脸皮收下。
“In that case, I can only be shameless enough to accept.

不过——。』他没有再说下去。
But—” He went no further.

为了要在阿巧姐面前表示她这番交情，完全是卖给她的，他决定要补还胡雪岩的人情；投桃报李，想送两样贵重补药。
To show A’qiao that he had agreed entirely for her sake, he decided to repay Hu’s gift with one of his own: a couple of valuable restorative medicines.

但话不必先说，
But there was no need to announce it beforehand.

说了味道就不够了；因而缩住了口。
To do so would spoil the gesture, so he checked himself.


『那末，要请问张先生。』萧家骥插进来说，『预备哪天动身？』
“Then may I ask, Dr Zhang,” Xiao interposed, “when should we prepare to leave?”

『越早越好。
“The sooner the better.

我要趁年里赶回来。』
I must return before the New Year.”

『那是一定赶得回来的。』
“You will certainly be back in time.”

萧家骥盘算了一下，作了主张∶『我尽明天一天预备；
Xiao considered the arrangements and made a proposal. “Let me have all tomorrow to prepare.

后天就动身怎么样？』
Shall we leave the day after?”

『后天一定是好日子，』
“The day after tomorrow must be a good day.”

阿巧姐识得的字不多，但看皇历还能应付，
A’qiao knew few characters, but could manage an almanac.

很有把握地指着十二月初一那一行说∶『「宜出门。」』
Confidently pointing to the entry for the first day of the twelfth month, she read, “‘Auspicious for setting out.’”



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第四章（本章第1部分，共2部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第四章
CHAPTER FOUR


尽一天的功夫安排妥帖；
They spent a full day making the arrangements.

第三天一早都上了船，略略安顿，鸣锣启碇。
Early on the third morning, everyone went aboard; after they had settled themselves, the gong sounded and the anchor was raised.

张医生捧着个蓝布包到了胡雪岩舱里。
Dr Zhang brought a bundle wrapped in blue cloth to Hu’s cabin.

『胡大人，』他说，『红包太丰厚了，
“Your gift was far too generous, Mr Hu.

受之有愧。
I feel ashamed to accept so much.

有两样药，请胡大人留着用。』
I have brought two medicines for you to keep.”

『多谢！多谢！
“Thank you, thank you!

真正不敢当。』
You are too kind.”

胡雪岩只当是普通药材，
Hu assumed that they were ordinary medicinal ingredients.

等他打开来一看，是两个锦盒，才知道是珍贵补药；
Only when the bundle was opened and revealed two brocade-covered cases did he realize that they were precious tonics.

长盒子里是全须全尾的一支参，红绿丝线扎住，
In the long case lay a complete ginseng root, every fine rootlet intact, secured with red and green silk threads.

上贴金纸红签，上写八字∶『极品吉林老山人参』。
A red label on gold paper bore eight characters: “Finest Wild Mountain Ginseng from Jilin.”

『这支参是贡品；
“This root was an item of tribute.

张尚书府上流出来的，真正大内的货色。』
It came out of Minister Zhang’s household—genuine imperial-palace stock.”

张医生一面说，一面打开方盒子。
As he spoke, the doctor opened the square case.

方盒子里是鹿茸。一寸多长一段，共是两段；上面长着细细的白毛，
Inside were two sections of deer antler, each a little over a cun long and covered with fine white hairs.

看不出是好是坏。
Nothing about their appearance told Hu whether they were good or bad.


『鹿茸就是鹿角，是大家都晓得的；不过鹿角并不就是鹿茸。
“Everyone knows that velvet antler comes from a deer’s horns, but not every deer’s horn is velvet antler.

老角无用，里面都是筋络；
Old antler is useless; inside it is all fibers and channels.

要刚长出来的新角，长满了精血，象这样子的才合适。』
What one wants is newly grown antler, filled with vital essence and blood, like this.”

张医生又说，『取鹿茸也有诀窍；
Dr Zhang went on, “There is an art to harvesting it too.

手段不高，一刀会拿鹿头砍掉——。』张医生是亲眼见过的——
If the man lacks skill, one stroke may take off the deer’s head—” He had seen the process himself.

春夏之交，万物茂盛；驱鹿于空围场中，不断追赶；
At the turn of spring into summer, when everything flourished, deer were driven into an empty enclosure and chased without respite.

鹿胆最小，自是尽力奔避，因而血气上腾，贯注于新生的鹿角中。
Timid creatures by nature, they fled with all their strength, driving their blood and vital energy upward into the newly growing antlers.

然后开放栅门，正好窗口一头鹿逃避；
A gate was then opened, just wide enough for one deer to escape at a time.

栅门外是曲栏，
Beyond it was a curved passage formed by rails.

一端有人手持利斧，聚精会神地在等待，
At one end a man waited with a sharp axe, concentrating intently.

等这头鹿将出曲栏时，看准了一斧下去，正好砍断了新生的那一段鹿角。
As the deer was about to emerge, he judged his moment and struck, severing precisely the newly grown section of antler.

要这样采取的鹿茸，才是上品。
Only velvet antler gathered in this way was of the finest quality.

胡雪岩对这段叙述深感兴趣，
Hu listened with great interest.

『虽说「修合无人见，存心有天知」，
“They say, ‘No one may see how medicines are prepared, but Heaven knows the maker’s heart.’

货色好坏，日子一久，总会有人知道的；
Yet good or bad quality will become known in time.

一传十，十传百，口碑就出去了。
One person tells ten, and ten tell a hundred; that is how a reputation spreads.

张先生，』他说，『听说你也有家药店，
Dr Zhang, I hear that you have a pharmacy too.

想来规模很大。』
It must be a large concern.”

『谈不到规模。
“I could hardly call it that.

祖传的产业，守守而已。』
It is a family business that I merely keep going.

张医生又说，『我诊断很忙，也顾不到。』
My medical practice keeps me so busy that I have little time for it.”


听得这样说，胡雪岩就不便深谈了——
At this, Hu could hardly pursue the subject.

刘不才陷溺于赌，对胡雪岩开药店的打算，不甚关切；
Liu Bucai had become so absorbed in gambling that he took little interest in Hu’s plan to open a pharmacy.

胡雪岩本想问问张医生的意见；现在听他的话，对自己的事业都照顾不周，自然没有舍己而耘人之田的可能，
Hu had thought of asking Dr Zhang’s advice, but a man who could scarcely tend his own affairs would hardly leave his own field to cultivate another’s.

那又何必谈它。
There was no point in discussing it.

不过既是特地延请来的上客，总得尽心招待，
Still, the doctor was an honored guest specially invited to accompany them, and they must do their best to entertain him.

找些什么消遣？
What diversion could they find?

清谈不如手谈，最合适也差不多是唯一的消遣，就是凑一桌麻将。
Conversation with the hands would be better than mere talk: the most suitable amusement, and almost the only one available, was a game of mahjong.

宁波麻将跟广东麻将齐名，
Ningbo mahjong was as famous as the Cantonese variety.

据说，由马吊变为麻将，就是宁波人由明朝以来，不断研究改进的结果。
It was said that the transformation of madiao cards into mahjong had resulted from Ningbo players’ continual experiments and improvements since the Ming dynasty.

张医生亦好此道，所以听得胡雪岩这个提议，欣然乐从。
Dr Zhang was a devotee himself and readily agreed to Hu’s proposal.


胡雪岩自己当然不能打；
Hu, of course, could not play.

眼前的搭子三缺一，拉上船老大一个才能成局。
They needed one more person to complete the table, so the boat’s master would have to join them.

萧家骥亦是此中好手；但不知阿巧姐如何？
Xiao Jiaji was an expert, but what of A’qiao?

少不得要问一声。
He had to ask.

『阿巧姐，你跟宁波人打过牌没有？』
“Sister A’qiao, have you played with Ningbo people before?”

『当然打过。』
“Of course.”

『有没有在这种船上打过？』
“Have you ever played aboard a boat like this?”

『这种船我还是第二次坐。』
“This is only the second time I have traveled in one.

阿巧姐说∶『麻将总是麻将；
But mahjong is mahjong.

船上岸上有啥分别？』
What difference does it make whether one plays afloat or ashore?”

『这种麻将要记性好——。』『那自然。』
“For this kind of mahjong, you need a good memory—” “Naturally.”

阿巧姐认为萧家骥无须关照，
She thought the warning unnecessary.

『打麻将记性不好，上下家出张进张都弄不清楚，这还打什么？』
“If you cannot remember what the players before and after you are discarding or taking, how can you play at all?”

听这一说，他不便再说下去了。
Hearing this, Xiao could hardly say more.

等拉开一张活腿小方桌，分好筹码，
They unfolded a small square table and divided the counters.

只见船老大将一系在舱顶上的绳子放了下来；拿只竹篮挂在绳端的钩子上，
The boat’s master then lowered a cord fastened to the cabin roof and hung a bamboo basket on the hook at its end.

位置恰好悬在方桌正中，高与头齐，伸手可及，
It hung exactly over the center of the table, level with their heads and within easy reach.

却不知有何用处。
A’qiao had no idea what it was for.


阿巧姐也是争强好胜的性格，一物不知，引以为耻，所以不肯开口相问；
She was competitive by nature and hated to admit ignorance of anything, so she would not ask.

反正总有用处，看着好了。
It must have some use; she would watch and see.

扳庄就位，
They determined the dealer and took their seats.

阿巧姐坐在张医生下家；对家船老大起庄，
A’qiao sat next in turn after Dr Zhang, while the boat’s master, opposite her, dealt first.

只见他抓齐了十四张牌，从左到右看了一遍，立即将牌扑倒，取出一张亮一亮，是张北风。
Having drawn his fourteen tiles, he inspected them from left to right, immediately laid them face down, and displayed a North Wind as his discard.

他的上家萧家骥叫碰；张医生便向阿巧姐说∶『这就是宁波麻将算得精的地方；
Xiao, who preceded him in the order of play, called “Pung!” Dr Zhang explained to A’qiao, “This is where the Ningbo players calculate so finely.

庄家头一张不打南风打北风，
On his first discard the dealer puts out North instead of South.

上家一碰，马上又摸一张，
If the player before him claims it for a pung, the dealer gets another draw at once.

也许是张南风，本来该第二家摸成后对的，现在是自己摸成双；
It may be a South Wind, giving him the pair that would otherwise have gone to the next player.

这一摸味道就好了。』摸呀摸的，阿巧姐听来有些刺耳，
A draw like that makes all the difference.” His repeated use of the word for drawing tiles, with its other sense of touching or feeling, grated on A’qiao.

便不理他；
She ignored him.

只见萧家骥拿张东风亮一亮，没有人要，便抬起手来将那张东风，往挂着的竹篮中一丢。
Xiao displayed an East Wind; when no one wanted it, he raised his hand and tossed it into the hanging basket.


原来竹篮是这样的用处，
So that was the basket’s purpose!

阿巧姐心里有些着慌，
A’qiao began to feel alarmed.

脱口说道∶『宁波麻将的打法特别。』
“The Ningbo way of playing is different,” she blurted out.

『是的——。』张医生马上又接口解释，
“Yes—” Dr Zhang immediately explained.

由于海上风浪甚大，船会颠簸，所以宁波麻将讲究过目不忘，合扑着打；
Heavy seas made the vessel pitch and roll, so Ningbo players prided themselves on remembering their tiles at a glance and playing with them face down.

又因为船上地方小，摆不下大方桌，
Space aboard was limited too; there was no room for a large square table.

甚至有时候团团围坐四个人，膝盖上支块木板，就当牌桌，
Sometimes four players merely sat in a circle with a board across their knees.

这样自然没有富裕的地方来容纳废牌，因而打在竹篮里。
Naturally, there was no spare space for discarded tiles, so these went into a basket.

『不过，』张医生看着船老大和萧家骥说，『这张桌子也不算太小，
“But this table is not so very small,” he added, looking at the boat’s master and Xiao.

我们照岸上的打法好了。』
“Why not play as we do ashore?”

船老大当然不会反对；
The master had no objection.

萧家骥却笑了笑——这一笑使得阿巧姐不大舒服；
Xiao, however, smiled—and that smile offended A’qiao.

觉得他有轻视之意，大不服气。
She thought he was looking down on her and resented it bitterly.


『不要紧，不要紧。』她说，
“Never mind, never mind,” she said.

『照规矩打好了。』
“Let us play by the rules.”

这等于不受张医生的好意，然而他丝毫不以为忤。
In effect, she had refused the doctor’s kindness, but he took no offense.

阿巧姐却是有点如俗语说的『死要面子活受罪』，
She, however, was discovering the truth of the saying about suffering any misery to save face.

硬记三家出张，颇以为苦。
Trying to remember the other three players’ discards was a torment.

打到一半，三家都似『听叫』，而她的牌还乱得很；
Halfway through the hand, all three seemed ready to win, while her own tiles were still a muddle.

而且越打越为难，生熟张子都有些记不住了。
The longer they played, the harder it became to remember which tiles had already appeared and which had not.

『这样子不是路道，只怕一副都和不成功。输钱在其次，面子输不起。』她这样在心中自语着，
“This is no way to go on,” she told herself. “I may never win a single hand. Losing money is one thing, but I cannot afford to lose face.”

决定改变打法。新的打法是只顾自己，不顾外面；
She decided to change her tactics and concentrate entirely on her own hand.

只要不是三副落地，包人家的辣子，她什么生张都敢打。
Provided she did not become liable for another player’s limit hand after three exposed sets, she would risk discarding any tile, however unfamiliar.

张医生打替她担心，不断提示，那张牌出了几张，那张牌已经绝；
The doctor worried on her behalf, continually reminding her how many of a tile had appeared and which were exhausted.

阿巧得其所哉，专心一致管自己做牌，
With this help, she settled comfortably into the game and devoted herself to building her own hands.

两圈不到，就和了一副清一色；一副三元；一副凑一色，
In less than two rounds she won with a pure one-suit hand, a Three Dragons hand, and a mixed one-suit hand.

手气大旺。
Her luck was running high.


『张先生，你下家的风头不得了。』船老大说，
“Dr Zhang, the player after you is on a tremendous streak,” the boat’s master said.

『要看紧点！』
“You must keep a closer watch on her.”

越是这样说，张医生的手越松，
The more he urged caution, the more freely the doctor played.

不但不扣她的牌，还会拆搭子给她吃，而且还要关照∶『阿巧姐，这张三万是第四张，
Not only did he refuse to withhold tiles she needed; he even broke up promising combinations to feed her, adding reminders such as, “Sister A’qiao, this is the fourth Three of Characters.

你再不吃就没有得吃了。』
If you do not take it now, there will be no other.”

加上萧家骥打得很厉害，扣住了船老大的牌，很难得吃到一张；
Xiao was playing sharply too, withholding the tiles the boat’s master wanted and scarcely allowing him a single claim.

这样就几乎变成三个对付一个，
It was almost three against one.

船老大一个人大输，却不敢得罪主顾，
The master lost heavily, but dared not offend his customers.

打完四圈装肚子痛，拆散了场头。
After four rounds he pleaded a stomachache and broke up the game.

阿巧姐一个人大赢；但牌打得并不有趣，
A’qiao alone had won a great deal, yet she had not found the game particularly enjoyable.

自己觉得赢船家的钱不好意思，将筹码一推，
Embarrassed to take the boatman’s money, she pushed away the counters.

『算了，
“Let it go!

算了！』
Let it go!”

接着起身离去。
Then she stood up and left.


这个慷慨大方的举动，自然赢得了船老大的感激与尊敬，因此照料得很周到；
Her generosity naturally earned the boat’s master’s gratitude and respect, and he attended to them with exceptional care.

一路顺顺利利到上海，
The voyage to Shanghai went smoothly.

胡雪岩也不劳张医生费心，按时服药，毫无异状。
Hu took his medicines regularly and developed no new symptoms, giving Dr Zhang little trouble.

话虽如此，对张医生还是很重视的，
Nevertheless, he continued to show the doctor great consideration.

所以一到上海码头先遣萧家骥去通知，说有这样一位贵客，请他预备招待。
As soon as they reached the Shanghai wharf, he sent Xiao ahead to announce the distinguished visitor and ask Gu to prepare a welcome.

古应春不在家，好在七姑奶奶一切都能作主。
Gu was out, but fortunately the Seventh Lady could decide everything herself.

宁波的情形，前半段她已听李得隆谈过；
She had already heard the earlier part of the Ningbo story from Li Delong.

虽替胡雪岩的病担忧，但有阿巧姐在照料，也略略可以放心，
Though anxious about Hu’s illness, she had been somewhat reassured to know that A’qiao was caring for him.

估量着总要到年后，病势才会养到能够长途跋涉，
She had expected him to remain too ill for a long journey until after the New Year.

不想这么快就已回上海，自觉惊喜交集。
His unexpectedly early return therefore filled her with both surprise and delight.


于是匆匆打点，雇了三乘暖轿，带着男女佣人，直奔码头；
She hurriedly made the arrangements, hired three enclosed winter sedan chairs, and rushed to the wharf with male and female servants.

上船先见阿巧姐，后见胡雪岩，
Going aboard, she saw A’qiao first and then Hu.

看他瘦得可怕，不免有点伤心，掉了两滴眼泪。
His frightening thinness saddened her, and she shed a couple of tears.

『张先生不要笑我！』七姑奶奶自己都觉得有些不好意思，
“You must not laugh at me, Dr Zhang,” she said, rather embarrassed herself.

『我们这位小爷叔，这一阵子真是多灾多难，
“Little Uncle has suffered one misfortune after another lately.

说到他的苦楚，眼泪好落一脸盆。
The story of his troubles would fill a basin with tears.

不过总算还好，命中有贵人相扶，逢凶化吉，遇难成祥，
But at least Heaven has sent him good people to help him, turning danger to safety and misfortune to good.

才会遇着张先生这种医道高明心又热的人。』
That is how he came to meet someone as skillful and kind-hearted as you.”

张医生也听说过有这样一位姑奶奶，心直口快，大家不但服她，也有些怕她；
The doctor had heard of this lady, whose frank, outspoken manner commanded both respect and a measure of fear.

自己要在阿巧姐身上打主意，还非得此人的助力不可，因而格外客气，
If he hoped to win A’qiao, her help would be indispensable, so he was especially courteous.

连声答道∶『好说，好说。
“You are too kind, too kind!

七姑奶奶才是天字第一号的热心人。』
You yourself are the most warm-hearted person under Heaven.”

七姑奶奶最喜欢听人说她热心，
The Seventh Lady loved nothing better than to be praised for her kindness.

觉得这个张医生没有名医的架子，人既和气，言语也不讨厌，
She found that he had none of a famous physician’s airs: he was pleasant and agreeable in conversation.

顿生好感；
She took to him at once.

原来打算请他住客栈的，此时改了主意，
Originally she had meant to put him up at an inn; now she changed her mind.

『张先生，』她说，『难得来一越，多玩些日子！
“Dr Zhang, since you have come all this way, stay and enjoy yourself for a few days.

就住在舍下好了；只怕房子太小，委屈了张先生。』
You must be our guest at home—though I fear our little house will not do you justice.”

话刚说完，阿巧姐拉了她一把，显然是不赞成她的办法；
A’qiao tugged at her, plainly disapproving.

但话已说出口，不能收回，
But the invitation had been given and could not be withdrawn.

只好看张医生如何答复，再作道理。
She could only see how the doctor answered and then decide what to do.


『不敢当，不敢当。
“You are too kind!

我年内要赶回去。
I must get home before the year is out.

打搅府上，只怕诸多不便。』
I fear staying with you would put you to a great deal of inconvenience.”

他是客气话，七姑奶奶却将计就计，不作决定∶『先到了舍下再说。』
He meant this as a polite demurral, but the Seventh Lady took advantage of it to leave the question open. “Let us get you home first and discuss it there.

她这样答道∶『现在就上岸吧！』
We should go ashore now.”

第一个当然安排胡雪岩，
Hu naturally had to be settled first.

轿子抬到船上，然后将胡雪岸用棉被包裹，象个『蜡烛包』似的，抱入轿内，遮紧轿帘。
A chair was carried aboard, and he was wrapped in a quilt like a swaddled infant, lifted inside, and screened securely behind its curtains.

上岸时，当然要特别小心，
Getting him ashore required particular care.

船老大亲自指挥，全船上下一起动手，搭了四条跳板，才将轿子抬到岸上。
The boat’s master directed the operation himself; the whole crew helped, laying four gangplanks before carrying the chair to the wharf.

再一顶轿子是张医生；
The second chair was for Dr Zhang.

余下一顶应该是阿巧姐，她却偏要跟七姑奶奶挤在一起，为的是有一番心事，迫不及待地要透露。
The remaining one should have been A’qiao’s, but she insisted on squeezing into it with the Seventh Lady: she had something on her mind that could not wait.

七姑奶奶听阿巧姐刚说了个开头，就忍不住笑了；
The Seventh Lady had barely heard the opening when she began to laugh.

阿巧姐便有些气，
A’qiao was annoyed.

『跟你规规矩矩说，你倒笑话我！』她说。
“I am speaking seriously, and you laugh at me!”

『我不是笑你，
“I am not laughing at you.

是笑张郎中癞虾蟆想吃天鹅肉。
I am laughing at that doctor—a toad dreaming of swan’s flesh.

不要紧！
Never mind.

你跟我说，我替你想办法。』
Tell me, and I shall find a way out for you.”

『这才象句话！』
“That is more like it!”

阿巧姐回嗔作喜，
Her annoyance vanished.

细细说明经过；话完，轿子也到家了。
She explained everything in detail, finishing just as the chair reached the house.


到家第一件事是安置胡雪岩；第二件事是招待客人，
The first task at home was to settle Hu; the second was to entertain their guest.

这得男主人回家才行，
For that the master of the house must return.

而且七姑奶奶已有了为阿巧姐解围的策略，也得古应春来照计而行。
Moreover, the Seventh Lady had devised a way of rescuing A’qiao from her predicament, and Gu would have to carry it out.

因此，她赴萧家骥要赶着回家省视老母之便，关照他先去寻到师父，说知其事。
Xiao was eager to go home and see his mother, so she asked him to find his teacher first and explain the situation.

找了两处都不见，
He tried two places without success.

最后才在号子里听说古应春去了一处地方，是浙江海运局。
Finally, at the firm, he learned that Gu had gone to the Zhejiang Maritime Grain Transport Bureau.

浙江的漕运久停，海运局已成了一个浙江派在上海的驿站，传递各处的文报而已。
Zhejiang’s tribute-grain shipments had long been suspended, and the bureau now served merely as the province’s dispatch station in Shanghai, forwarding official communications.

古应春到那里，想来是去打听杭州的消息。
Gu had presumably gone there for news of Hangzhou.

正留了话想离去时，他师父回来了，
Xiao was leaving a message and preparing to go when his teacher returned.

脸色阴郁，如果说是去打听消息，可想而知，消息一定不好。
His face was so gloomy that, if he had been seeking news, it was plainly bad.


然而见了徒弟，却有喜色。
The sight of his pupil, however, brought him pleasure.

他也跟他妻子一样，猜想着萧家骥必得过了年才会回来；
Like his wife, he had expected Xiao to remain away until after the New Year.

因而首先就问∶『病人呢？』
His first question was therefore, “Where is our patient?”

『一起回来了。』萧家骥紧接着说∶『是郎中陪着来的。
“He has come back too—with the doctor.

年底下不肯走这一趟，很承他的情；
It was very kind of the man to make the journey so near the year’s end.

师娘请师父马上回家，
Madam asks you to come home at once.

打算要好好陪他玩两天。』
She wants you to show him a good time for a couple of days.”

『这是小事。』
“That is easily done.

古应春问，『我们这位小爷叔的病呢？』
But how is Little Uncle?”

『不碍了。
“Out of danger.

调养几天就可以起床。』『唉！』古应春长叹一声，
A few days’ rest and care should get him on his feet.” Gu sighed deeply.

『起了床只怕又要病倒。』
“I fear that once he gets up, he will fall ill again.”

萧家骥一听就明白，
Xiao understood at once.

『是不是杭州失守了？』他问。
“Has Hangzhou fallen?”

『上个月廿八的事。』
“On the twenty-eighth of last month.”

回答的声音似乎有气无力，
Gu’s voice seemed drained of strength.

『刚才从海运局得来的消息。』
“I have just heard at the bureau.”

『王抚台呢？』
“And Governor Wang?”

『听说殉节了。』胡应春又说。
“They say he died for his duty.

『详细情形还不晓得。
We do not yet know the details.

也许逃了出来，亦未可知。』
Perhaps he escaped; one cannot be sure.”

『不会的。』
“No, he would not have.”

萧家骥想到跟王有龄一经识面，便成永诀的凄凉近事，
Xiao remembered their recent meeting: the first time he had seen Wang had become their final parting.

不由得两行热泪汩汩而下。
Hot tears streamed down his cheeks.


『唉！』
“Ah!”

古应春顿着足叹气，
Gu stamped his foot and sighed.

『你都如此，何况是他？
“If even you feel like this, what will it do to him?

这个坏消息，还真不知道怎么跟他开口？』
I truly do not know how to tell him.”

『现在说不得，
“You must not tell him now.

一说，病势马上反复。
His illness would return at once.

不但师父不能说，还得想法子瞒住他。』
You must not merely keep silent, but find some way of preventing him from hearing it.”

『我晓得。
“I know.

你回家去看一看；
Go home and see your family.

今晚上不必来了。
There is no need to come back tonight.

明天上午，再碰头。』
We shall meet tomorrow morning.”

于是师弟二人同车，
Teacher and pupil took the same carriage.

先送了萧家骥，古应春才回家。
Gu dropped Xiao at home before returning to his own house.

跟胡雪岩相见自有一番关切的问讯；然后才跟张医生亲切相叙，
Naturally, he first greeted Hu with affectionate inquiries, then sat down for a cordial conversation with Dr Zhang.

这样就快到了晚饭时分了。
By then it was almost dinnertime.


七姑奶奶找个机会将她丈夫唤到一边，商量款客；
The Seventh Lady found an opportunity to draw her husband aside and discuss the evening’s entertainment.

她的意思是，如果在家吃饭，加上一个李得隆，只有三个人，未免清冷，
At home, even with Li Delong, there would be only three men at dinner, making a rather dull party.

不如请张医生上馆子，
Better to take the doctor to a restaurant.

『最好是请他吃花酒。』她说。
“Best of all, give him a dinner with courtesans,” she said.

『花酒总要请他吃的。
“Of course we shall do that.

不过，你怎么知道他喜欢吃花酒？』
But how do you know he likes such dinners?”

『不但吃花酒，
“It should not stop at dinner.

最好还替他寻个好的；能够讨回去的。
Better still, find him a good woman whom he can take home.

其中自有道理，回头我再跟你细谈。』
There is a reason for it; I shall explain later.”

『我也不管你搞什么鬼！照办就是。』古应春又说，『有句要紧话关照你，
“I do not know what you are plotting, but I shall do as you say.” Gu continued, “There is something important I must tell you.

千万要当心，不能在小爷叔面前透露；不然不得了——。』『急煞人了！』七姑奶奶不耐烦了，
Be extremely careful not to let Little Uncle hear it, or the consequences will be dreadful—” “You are driving me frantic!

『到底是啥事，
What is it?

你倒是快说呀！』
Tell me!”

纵然如此知妻莫若夫，
Yet no one knew her better than her husband.

贸然说出杭州的变化，以七姑奶奶的性情，先就会大惊小怪，满不住人，
If he blurted out the news of Hangzhou, she would make such an outcry that everyone would hear.

因而又先要关照一句∶『你可不要叫！
He warned her once more. “Do not cry out.

杭州失守了；
Hangzhou has fallen.

王雪松不知存亡，十之八九殉了节。』
We do not know whether Governor Wang is alive, but almost certainly he died for his duty.”

七姑奶奶倒没有叫，
She did not cry out.

是半晌作不得声；
For a long time she could say nothing.

接着也跟萧家骥那样，热泪滚滚，
Then, like Xiao, she began to weep.

闭着眼睛说∶『我好悔！』
Closing her eyes, she said, “How bitterly I regret it!”


『悔！』
“Regret it?”

古应春大为不解，
Gu was bewildered.

『悔什么？』
“Regret what?”

『我们也算干亲。
“We are his adopted kin, after all.

虽说高攀，不敢认真；到底有那样一个名分在。
It may have been presumption on our part, and we dared not take it too seriously, but the relationship existed.

看了困在杭州等死，我们做亲戚的一点不曾尽心，
We watched him trapped in Hangzhou, waiting for death, and did nothing for him.

只怕他在地下也在怨我们。』
Perhaps even beneath the earth he is reproaching us.”

『这是劫数！
“This was fate.

小爷叔那样的本事，都用不上力；
Even a man as capable as Little Uncle could do nothing.

你我有什么办法？
What could you and I have done?

只有拿他的下落打听清楚，
We can only find out exactly what happened.

果然殉了节，替他打一场水陆，超度超度。』
If he really died for his duty, we shall arrange a Water-and-Land service to deliver his spirit.”

七姑奶奶不作声，皱紧双眉苦苦思索——
She said nothing, but knitted her brows in deep thought.

遇到这种情形，古应春总是格外留神；因为这是七姑奶奶遇到疑难，要拿出决断来的时候。
Gu always watched her particularly closely at such moments: this was how she looked when faced with a difficult matter on which she meant to reach a decision.

『你先陪客人出去。
“Take our guest out first.

能早回来最好早回来。
Come back early if you can.

再打听打听王抚台的下落。』
And make further inquiries about Governor Wang.”

她说一句，他应一句，最后问说∶『张先生住在哪里？』
He assented to each instruction, then asked, “Where will Dr Zhang stay?”

『住在我们的家。』七姑奶奶毫不迟疑地回答，
“Here in our house,” she answered without hesitation.

『这几天着实还有偏劳他的地方。』
“We shall have considerable need of his help over the next few days.”


古应春不知道她葫芦里卖的什么药？反正对这位郎中要格外巴结，他已能会意的；
Gu did not know what she had in mind, but he understood that he must court the physician’s favor with particular care.

因此，安排在最好的番菜馆『吃大菜』，在那里就叫了两个局。
He therefore arranged a full dinner at the best Western restaurant and summoned two courtesans to join them.

张医生对一个『红信人』艳春老四，颇为中意；
The doctor was much taken with a popular woman, the Fourth Miss of Yanchun House.

古应春便在艳春院摆了个『双台』，飞笺召客，奉张医生为首座。
Gu accordingly arranged a two-table banquet at her establishment, sent invitations flying out to his friends, and installed Dr Zhang in the seat of honor.

客人无不久历花丛，每人起码叫两个局，
The guests were all veterans of the pleasure quarters; each summoned at least two courtesans.

珠围翠绕，热闹非凡；
Surrounded by jewels and beauty, the party became extraordinarily lively.

将个初涉洋场的张医生弄得晕头转向，然而乐在其中了。
The doctor, new to the foreign settlement, was quite bewildered—and thoroughly enjoying himself.

席间闲话，当然也有谈时局的；
Naturally, their table talk included current events.

古应春正要打听杭州的情形，少不得要细细追问。
Gu was anxious for news of Hangzhou and questioned the speakers closely.


据说杭州城内从十一月二十以后，军心就已瓦解了；
According to their accounts, the army’s resolve inside Hangzhou had begun to collapse after the twentieth of the eleventh month.

最主要的原因，还在『绝粮』二字。
The chief reason was the exhaustion of food.

廿四那天，在一家海货行，搜到一批木耳，每人分得一两；
On the twenty-fourth, a quantity of wood-ear fungus had been found in a dried-seafood merchant’s shop, allowing each man one liang by weight.

廿五那天又搜到一批杭州人名『盐青果』的盐橄榄，每人分得五钱。
On the twenty-fifth, some salted olives, known locally as “salted green fruit,” had been discovered, yielding half a liang apiece.

于是外省军队，开始大家小户搜食物；
Troops from other provinces then began searching households, rich and poor, for food.

抚标中军都是本省人，在杭日久，熟人甚多，
The governor’s own central troops were all Zhejiang men who had spent many years in Hangzhou and knew many people there.

倒还略有羞耻之心，压低帽檐，索粮用福建或者河南口音；
Retaining a little shame, they pulled their hat brims low and demanded provisions in assumed Fujian or Henan accents.

当然，除去搜粮，还有别样违犯军纪的行为，
Nor was looting food their only breach of military discipline.

这一下秩序大乱，
Order collapsed.

王有龄带领亲兵小队，亲自抓了十几个人，当街正法。
Wang Youling personally led a small detachment of his own guards, seized more than a dozen offenders, and had them executed in the street.

然而无救于军纪，更无补于军心。
It did nothing, however, to restore either discipline or morale.



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第四章（本章第2部分，共2部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


这时还有个怪现象，就是『卖钱』；
Another strange phenomenon had appeared: people were “selling money.”

钱重不便携带，要换银子或者银洋，
Copper cash was heavy and awkward to carry, so they exchanged it for silver bullion or silver dollars.

一串一串的铜钱，公然插上草标出卖，
Strings of coins were openly offered for sale with wisps of straw stuck into them as signs.

当然银贵钱贱。
Naturally, silver commanded a high price and copper fell cheap.

这是预作逃亡之计，
These were preparations for flight.

军心如此，民心更加恐慌，
With the soldiers in such a state of mind, the civilians were more frightened still.

这时相顾谈论的，只有一个话题∶长毛会在哪天破城？
Whenever they met, there was only one subject of conversation: on what day would the Longhairs take the city?

到了十一月廿七，守城的官军，决定死中求活，
On the twenty-seventh of the eleventh month, the defenders decided to seek life in the midst of death.

第二天黎明冲出艮山门，杀开一条血路，接引可能会有的外援。
At dawn the next day they would charge out through Genshan Gate, force a passage, and meet whatever relief forces might conceivably be outside.

这虽是妄想，但无论如何是奋发自救的作为，可以激励民心士气，
It was a desperate fantasy, yet at least it represented a determined attempt to save themselves, capable of heartening troops and people alike.

有益无害。
It could do good and no harm.

不想到了夜里，情况起了变化，
During the night, however, matters changed.

士兵三三两两，缒城而下；
Soldiers began lowering themselves from the wall in twos and threes.

这就变做军心涣散，各奔前程的『开小差』了。
The planned assault had become desertion, each man seeking his own escape.

据说，这个变化是有人从中煽动的结果。煽动的人还是浙江的大员∶藩司林福祥。
It was said that someone had incited this change, and that the instigator was no less a person than Zhejiang’s provincial treasurer, Lin Fuxiang.

林福祥带领的一支军队，名为『定武军』，军纪最坏，而作战最不力。
Lin commanded a force called the Dingwu Army, whose discipline was the worst and whose fighting was the least effective.

而林福祥则颇善于做作，专干些毫无用处的花样；
He was skilled at empty display, forever devising useless flourishes.

又喜欢出奇计，但到头来往往『赔了夫人又折兵』，
He also liked ingenious stratagems, which usually cost him both the prize he sought and the men he risked.

因此颇有人怀疑他已与长毛暗通了款曲。
Many consequently suspected that he was secretly in league with the Longhairs.

说他曾与一个姓甘的候补知府，到长毛营盘里议过事。
It was said that he and an expectant prefect surnamed Gan had visited the enemy camp to discuss matters.


这些传闻虽莫可究诘，但有件事却实在可疑；
Those rumors could not be verified, but one incident did give substantial grounds for suspicion.

王有龄抓到过一个奸细名为徐宗鳌，就是林福洋保举在定武军当差的营官。
Wang Youling had captured a spy named Xu Zong’ao, a battalion commander whose appointment to the Dingwu Army Lin Fuxiang had recommended.

王有龄与张玉良在城内城外互通消息，约期会合的『战书』，都由定武军转送，
The messages exchanged between Wang inside the city and Zhang Yuliang outside, fixing dates for coordinated operations, had all passed through the Dingwu Army.

先后不下十余通之多，都为徐宗鳌转送到了长毛那里；
Xu had forwarded more than ten of these military dispatches to the Longhairs.

后来经人密告，逮捕审问属实，
After an informer exposed him, he was arrested, interrogated, and proved guilty.

徐宗鳌全家，除了留下三岁的一个小儿子以外，尽数斩决。
His entire family was beheaded, apart from a three-year-old son who was spared.

可是只办了这样一个罪魁祸首；
Yet only this principal offender was dealt with.

王有龄虽然对幕后的林福祥已大具戒心，却因投鼠忌器，
Though Wang had become deeply suspicious of Lin behind the scenes, he feared smashing the vessel while striking at the rat.

不愿在强敌包围之下，还有自乱阵脚的内讧出现，
With a powerful enemy surrounding them, he would not risk an internal conflict that might throw their own ranks into disorder.

只好隐忍不言。
He could only suppress his anger and remain silent.


而林福祥却确确实实跟长毛已取得了默契，
Lin, however, had indeed reached a secret understanding with the Longhairs.

虽不肯公然投降，却答应在暗底下帮着『拆墙脚』，
Unwilling to surrender openly, he had promised to help undermine the defenses from within.

这天晚上煽动艮山门守军潜逃，就是要拆杭州这座将倒的危墙。
His incitement of the Genshan Gate troops to desert that night was meant to bring down Hangzhou’s tottering wall.

夜里的逃兵，长毛不曾发觉；
The Longhairs did not notice the deserters during the darkness.

到了天明，发现踪迹，长毛认为这是杭州城内守军溃散的迹象，
At dawn they discovered the traces and took them as evidence that the garrison was disintegrating.

于是发功攻势，凤山、候潮、清波三门，首先被破。
They launched an attack, and Fengshan, Houchao, and Qingbo gates were the first to fall.

报到王有龄那里，知道大势去矣！
When the news reached Wang, he knew that all was lost.

自道∶『不负朝廷，只负了杭州城内数十万忠义士民。』
“I have not failed the court,” he said, “only the hundreds of thousands of loyal and righteous people of Hangzhou.”

殉节之志早决，
He had long resolved to die for his duty.

这是时候了！
The moment had come.

回到巡抚衙门，穿戴衣冠，望阙谢恩，留下遗书，
Returning to the governor’s yamen, he put on his formal robes and cap, bowed toward the imperial palace in gratitude for the emperor’s favors, and left a final letter.

然后吞金，唯恐不死，又服鸦片烟；
He swallowed gold; fearing that it would not kill him, he also took opium.

而这时衙门内的哭声和衙门外人声相应和，
By then the cries of the household mingled with the uproar outside.

长毛已经迫近，为怕受辱，王有龄上吊而死。
The Longhairs were approaching, and, rather than suffer humiliation, Wang hanged himself.

同时殉难的有学政员锡庚、处州镇总兵文瑞、仁和知县吴保丰。
Among those who died for their duty at the same time were Education Commissioner Yun Xigeng, Wenrui, brigade commander of Chuzhou, and Wu Baofeng, magistrate of Renhe.

盐运使庄焕文所带的是晓勇善战的福建泉州籍的『泉勇』，
Salt Commissioner Zhuang Huanwen led the Quanzhou troops, fierce and experienced fighters recruited in that district of Fujian.

奋战突围，不幸兵败，庄焕文投水自尽。
They fought desperately to break out but were defeated, and Zhuang drowned himself.


林福祥却果然得到长毛的破格优遇，
Lin Fuxiang, by contrast, received exceptional favor from the Longhairs.

被安置在藩司衙门的西花厅；好酒好肉款待，而且答应听凭林福祥自己决定，要到哪里便护送到哪里。
He was lodged in the western reception hall of the provincial treasurer’s yamen, entertained with fine food and wine, and promised an escort to any destination he chose.

林福祥选择的是上海，
He chose Shanghai.

据说此来还有一项任务，是护送王有龄的灵柩及家眷，由上海转回福建原籍。
It was said that he would also escort Wang Youling’s coffin and surviving family there, for onward travel to their native Fujian.

听到这里，古应不能不打断话问了。
At this, Gu had to interrupt with questions.

因为王有龄的灵柩到上海，且不说胡雪岩凭棺一恸，决不可免；
If Wang’s coffin came to Shanghai, Hu would inevitably insist on mourning before it.

就是他在情分上亦不能不吊祭一番。
Quite apart from that, Gu’s own relationship with the dead man obliged him to pay his respects.

尤其是想到刚听妻子听说，颇以对这位『干亲』生前，未能稍尽心意而引为莫大憾事；
He remembered his wife’s bitter regret that they had done nothing for their adopted kinsman while he lived.

那就不但灵前叩拜，还须对遗属有所慰恤，才能稍舟弥补歉疚的心情。
Bowing before the coffin would not be enough; they must also offer comfort and assistance to the surviving family if they were to ease their sense of guilt.

问到王有龄灵柩到上海的日期，谁也不知道。
No one could tell him when the coffin would reach Shanghai.

然而也不碍；
That did not matter greatly.

到时候必有迎灵、路祭等等仪式，不管哪个衙门都会知道，不难打听。
There would be a formal reception and roadside offerings when it arrived; any yamen would know, and the date would be easy to discover.


一顿花酒吃到半夜。
The courtesan banquet continued until midnight.

古应春看张医生对艳春老四有些着迷的模样，有心作个『红娘』；
Seeing how fascinated the doctor was with the Fourth Miss of Yanchun House, Gu thought of playing matchmaker.

将外号『金大块头』的『本家』唤到一边，探问是否可以让张医生『借干铺』？
He drew aside the proprietor, a man nicknamed Big Jin, and asked whether the doctor might “borrow a bed for the night.”

『古大少！』金大块头笑道，
“Young Master Gu!” Big Jin laughed.

『你是「老白相」，
“You are an old hand at pleasure.

想想看可有这规矩？』
Think for yourself: is that the way things are done?”

『规矩是人兴出来的。』古应春说，
“Rules are made by people.

『我跟你说老实话，
Let me be frank.

这位医生朋友我欠他的情，
I owe this doctor a favor.

你自帮我的忙，不要讲规矩好不好？
Help me out, and leave the rules aside, will you?

再说，他是外路来的，又住不到多少日子，
Besides, he is from out of town and will not be staying long.

也不能跟你慢慢讲规矩。』
He cannot spend weeks observing all your formalities.”

古应春是花丛阔客，金大块头要拉拢他，
Gu was a lavish patron, and Big Jin wanted to cultivate him.

听他一开口，心里便已允许，
He had inwardly consented as soon as the request was made.

但答应得太爽快，未免自贬身价，也不是让古应春见情，
But agreeing too readily would cheapen his concession and prevent Gu from appreciating the favor.

所以说了些什么『小姐名声要紧』∶『头一天叫的局，什么「花头」都没有做过，就借干铺，会教人笑话』之类的言语；
He therefore spoke of the young lady’s reputation, of how people would laugh if a man who had summoned her for the first time that day and observed none of the customary preliminaries were allowed to stay overnight.

而到头来是『古大少的面子，不肯也要肯。』
In the end, naturally, “For Young Master Gu’s sake, even if I were unwilling, I must agree.”

这面肯了，那面反倒不肯；
Once that side had consented, however, the other refused.

张医生到了洋场，算『乡下人』，在宁波也是场面上的人物，
In Shanghai’s foreign settlement, Dr Zhang might be a countryman, but in Ningbo he was a person of standing.

不肯留个『头一天到上海就住在堂子里』的话柄，
He would not give people grounds to say that he had spent his very first night in Shanghai in a courtesan house.

所以坚持要回家。
He insisted on going home.


一到家，又替胡雪岩看了一回病，『望闻问切』四个字都做到，
On returning, he examined Hu again, carrying out all four stages of a physician’s inquiry: inspection, listening and smelling, questioning, and taking the pulse.

很高兴地告诉古应春夫妇，说病人十天一定可以起床。
He then told Gu and his wife, with great satisfaction, that the patient would certainly be able to get out of bed in ten days.

『那末，张先生，』七姑奶奶说，『我留张先生住十天，肯不肯赏我一个面子？』
“Then, Dr Zhang,” the Seventh Lady said, “will you do me the honor of staying with us for those ten days?”

『言重，言重！』
“You are too kind, too kind!”

张医生面有难色∶『再住十天，就到了送灶的日子了。』
He looked troubled. “Another ten days would take us to the festival for sending off the Kitchen God.”

古应春也觉得急景凋年，硬留人羁栖异乡，不但强人所难，也不近人情，
Gu too felt that, with the year drawing so rapidly to its close, forcing a man to remain far from home would be unreasonable and unkind.

所以折衷提议∶『再住五天吧』『好，就住五天。』
He proposed a compromise. “Stay five more days, then.” “Very well, five days.”

张医生略有些忸怩地说，
The doctor looked a little bashful.

『我还有件事，恐怕要重托贤伉俪。』
“There is another matter in which I may have to ask a considerable favor of you both.”

这话正好为要掀门帘进屋的阿巧姐听见，扭头就走；
A’qiao, just about to lift the curtain and enter, heard this and turned away at once.

古应春不明白是怎么回事，想开口相问；七姑奶奶机警，抢着悄悄拉了他一把衣服，才将他的话挡了回去。
Gu did not understand and was about to ask, but his wife quickly tugged at his clothes to silence him.

『张先生，不要这么说。』
“Please do not put it that way, Dr Zhang.

七姑奶奶答道∶『只要我们办得到的事，你尽管吩咐。
If there is anything within our power, you have only to tell us.

今天怕累了，
You must be tired today.

吃了粥，请安置吧！』
Have some congee, then go to bed.”

『粥是不吃了；
“I shall not have any congee.

累倒真有些累了。』
But yes, I am rather tired.”

张医生略有些怏怏然。
He sounded somewhat disappointed.


七姑奶奶向来待客殷勤诚恳，
The Seventh Lady was always sincerely attentive to guests.

煮了一锅极道地的鱼生粥，定要请客人试试她的手段；
She had cooked an excellent pot of congee with fresh sliced fish and insisted that he taste her handiwork.

又说还有话要谈。
Besides, she said, there were still things to discuss.

张医生自然没有坚拒之理；于是一面吃宵夜，一面谈正事。
He could hardly persist in refusing, so they talked over the late supper.

第一件大事，就是古应春谈杭州的情形。
The first important subject was Hangzhou.

这些话张医生已经在艳春院听过一遍，所以古应春不便再详细复述，
The doctor had already heard the details at Yanchun House, so Gu could not properly repeat them at length.

顶要紧的是证实王有龄殉节，以及由林福祥护送灵柩到上海的话，要告诉七姑奶奶。
The essential points to tell his wife were that Wang’s death had been confirmed and that Lin Fuxiang was escorting the coffin to Shanghai.

『那就对了！
“Then I was right.

我的想法不错。』
My idea was sound.”

她转脸对张医生说∶『张先生大概还不十分清楚。
She turned to the doctor. “Perhaps you do not quite understand the situation yet.

我们这位小爷，跟王抚台是生死之交；
Little Uncle and Governor Wang were friends bound to one another in life and death.

现在听说王抚台死得这么惨，病中当然更受刺激。
To hear that the governor died so tragically must naturally upset him all the more while he is ill.

不过我在想，我这位小爷叔，为人最明道理，最看得开；
But Little Uncle is exceptionally reasonable and knows how to accept things.

而且王抚台非死不可，他也早已看到了的，所以这个消息也不算意外。
He had already foreseen that the governor could hardly escape death, so the news will not be entirely unexpected.

现在王抚台的灵柩到上海，马上要回福建，
Now the coffin is coming to Shanghai and will soon leave for Fujian.

如果他不能到灵前去哭一场，将来反倒会怪我们。
If he cannot go and weep before it, he will blame us afterward.

所以我想，不如就在这一两天告诉他。
I therefore think we should tell him within the next day or two.

张先生，你看可以不可以？』
What do you say, Dr Zhang?”


『这就很难说了。』张医生答道∶『病人最怕遇到伤心的事；
“It is very difficult to judge,” the doctor replied. “Nothing is worse for a sick man than grief.

不过照你所说，似乎又不要紧。』
Yet from what you say, perhaps it would do no harm.”

『应春，』七姑奶奶转脸问道∶『你看呢？』
“Yingchun, what do you think?” She turned to her husband.

古应春最了解妻子，知道她已经拿定了主意，
Gu knew that she had already made up her mind.

问这一句，是当着客人的面，表示尊重他做丈夫的身份。
She was asking only to show respect for his position as her husband in front of their guest.

自己应该知趣。知趣就要凑趣∶『张先生自然要慎重。
He ought to take the hint—and taking it meant playing his part. “Dr Zhang is naturally cautious.

以小爷叔的性情来说，索性告诉了他，让他死了心，也是一个办法。』
But knowing Little Uncle’s temperament, one way might be to tell him plainly and put an end to his hopes.”

『对！』
“Exactly!”

张医生觉得这话有见地，
The doctor thought this perceptive.

『胡道台心心念念记挂杭州，于他养病也是不宜的。
“His constant preoccupation with Hangzhou is not good for his recovery either.

不过告诉他这话，要一步一步来，
But you must prepare him gradually.

不要说得太急。』
Do not give him the news too abruptly.”

『是的。』
“Certainly.”

七姑奶奶这时便要提出请求了，
The Seventh Lady now came to her request.

『我在想，告诉了他，难免有一场伤心；
“I imagine that once he knows, there must be an outpouring of grief.

只怕他一时会受震动，要请张先生格外费心。
He may suffer a shock, and we shall need you to take particular care of him.

张先生，我虽是女流之辈，做事不喜欢扭扭捏捏，
I may be a woman, Dr Zhang, but I do not like to beat about the bush.

话先说在前面，万一病势反复，我可要硬留张先生在上海过年了。』
Let me say it beforehand: if his illness returns, I shall insist on keeping you in Shanghai for the New Year.”

此时此地，张医生还能说什么？
What could the doctor say in such circumstances?

只好报以苦笑，含含糊糊地先答应下来。
He could only offer a wry smile and give a vague assent for the moment.


等吃完粥，古应春亲送张医生到客房；
When they had finished the congee, Gu personally escorted the doctor to his room.

是七姑奶奶亲自料理的，大铜床，全新被褥，还特为张了一顶灰鼠皮帐子，以示待客的隆重，
The Seventh Lady had arranged it herself: a large brass bed, entirely new bedding, and, as a special mark of honor, a canopy of grey squirrel fur.

害得张医生倒大为不安。
The lavish attention made the doctor quite uneasy.

又说了些闲话，谈谈第二天逛些什么地方？
They chatted a little longer about where to go sightseeing the next day.

然后道声『明天见』，古应春回到卧室，七姑奶奶已经卸了妆在等他了。
Then, with “Until tomorrow,” Gu returned to the bedroom, where his wife had removed her makeup and was waiting for him.

『今天张医生高兴不高兴？』
“Did Dr Zhang enjoy himself tonight?”

『有个艳春老四，他看了很中意，
“There was a Fourth Miss at Yanchun House whom he liked very much.

我本来想替他拉拢，就住在那里。
I meant to arrange things so that he could stay there.

都已经说好了，张医生一定不肯，只好由他。』
Everything was settled, but he absolutely refused, so I had to let him have his way.

古应春又问，『你这样子热心，总有道理在内吧？
What is behind all this eagerness of yours?

我一直在想，想不通。』
I have been turning it over in my mind and cannot work it out.”

『说起来有趣。
“It is an amusing story.

你晓得张医生这趟，怎么来的？』
Do you know what brought him on this journey?”


这一问自然有文章 ，
Clearly the question had a meaning behind it.

古应春用右手掩着他妻子的嘴说∶『你不要开口，
Gu covered his wife’s mouth with his right hand. “Do not tell me.

让我想一想。』
Let me think.”

聪明人一点就透。
An intelligent man needs only a hint.

古应春只要从女人身上去思索，立刻就想到方才阿巧姐帘前惊鸿一瞥的情；
Once he began to think in terms of a woman, he immediately remembered A’qiao’s fleeting appearance at the curtain a moment earlier.

于是张医生刚到时对阿巧姐处处殷勤的景象，亦都浮现脑际，
The doctor’s attentive behavior toward her on his arrival also came back to him.

恍然大悟，原来如此！
Now he understood.

『是为了这个？』
“Was that the reason?”

他缩回右手，屈起两指。做了个『七』的手势；暗扣着一个『巧』字。
He withdrew his hand and bent two fingers to make the sign for seven, hinting at the word qiao, “cleverness.”

七姑奶奶似乎有些扫兴，
The Seventh Lady looked rather disappointed.

『真无趣！』她说，
“How tiresome!

『怎么会让你猜到？』
How did you manage to guess?”


『猜到这一点没有用处。
“Guessing that much tells me nothing.

来，来，』
Come.”

他拉着妻子并肩坐下，
He drew her down to sit beside him.

『你讲这段新闻来听听。』这段新闻讲得有头有尾，纤细无遗，比身历其境的人还清楚；
“Tell me the whole story.” She told it from beginning to end, omitting no detail, more clearly than anyone who had been present could have done.

因为他们都只知道自己在场或者听说过的一部分，
Each participant knew only what he or she had witnessed or been told.

萧家骥有些话不便出口；阿巧姐跟胡雪岩的想法，亦颇多保留，
There were things Xiao was reluctant to say, while A’qiao and Hu had kept much of their thinking to themselves.

唯有在七姑奶奶面前倾囊而出，反能了解全盘真相。
Only before the Seventh Lady had they emptied their hearts, allowing her to grasp the whole truth.

『家骥这个小鬼头！』
“That young rogue Jiaji!”

古应春骂着，有些忧虑，却也有些得意，
Gu scolded, a little worried but also rather proud.

『本来人就活动，
“He was resourceful enough already.

再跟小爷叔在一起，越发学得花样百出。
Put him with Little Uncle, and he learns ever more tricks.

这样下去，只怕他会走火入魔，专动些歪脑筋。』
If he goes on like this, he may become so carried away that he thinks of nothing but crooked schemes.”

『他不是那种人。』七姑奶奶答道，
“He is not that sort of person,” she replied.

『闲话少说，
“Enough of that.

有件事，我还要告诉你∶小爷叔的脾气你晓得的，出手本来就大方；又觉得欠了张郎中很重的一个情，
There is something else you must know. You know how generous Little Uncle is, and he feels deeply indebted to the doctor.

所以我的办法——。』『慢来，慢来！』古应春打断他的话问，
So my plan—” “Wait!

『你是什么办法，还没有告诉我；
You have not told me your plan yet.

是不是李代桃僵？』
Do you mean to sacrifice the plum tree to save the peach—to find a substitute?”

『是啊！
“Of course.

不然真要弄僵。』七姑奶奶说，
Otherwise, things really will turn ugly.

『小爷叔也觉得只有我这件办法。
Little Uncle agrees that my plan is the only way.

而且他想最好年内办成，让张郎中高高兴兴回家；
He would like it settled before the New Year so that the doctor can go home happy.

花个千把银子，把归他去。』
He says he will pay a thousand taels or so and let him have the woman.”

虽说长三的身价高，千金赎身，也算很阔绰了；
Even among the expensive changsan courtesans, a thousand taels was a generous redemption price.

但这样身价的『红倌人』，给张郎中作妾，就有些『齐大非偶』的意味了。
But to make so celebrated and costly a woman the doctor’s concubine would be to give him a match altogether too grand for him.


『这样做法不妥。
“That would not do.

你再行，到底外场的事情懂得太少——。』『这我又不服了。』
Capable as you are, you know too little of affairs outside the home—” “I will not accept that!”

七姑奶奶性急的毛病发作了，
Her impatience flared.

『就算我一窍不通，难道小爷叔的话也不对？』
“Even if I knew nothing, are you saying Little Uncle is wrong too?”

『自然不对，
“Of course he is.

刚刚一场大病，脑筋自然不够用。
He has just had a serious illness; naturally his mind is not yet working at its best.

再说，小爷叔对堂子里的情形，到底也没有我懂得多。
Besides, even he knows less about the pleasure quarters than I do.

象这种「红倌人」，一句话，叫做不甘寂寞！
A popular courtesan of that sort can be described in a word: she cannot endure a quiet life.

平日穿得好，吃得好，且不去说它；
Never mind the fine clothes and good food.

光是夜夜笙歌的热闹，已经养成习惯，
She has become accustomed to music, company, and revelry every night.

你想想，跟了张郎中，怎么会称心如意？』
How could she be content with Dr Zhang?”


『照你说，那里头就没有一个能从良的？』
“According to you, then, not one of them can leave the profession and marry?”

『十室之内，必有芳草。
“Even among ten houses, fragrant herbs may be found.

要说出淤泥而不染的，自然也有，
Of course there are women who emerge unstained from the mud.

不过可遇而不可求，
But you encounter them by chance; you cannot summon them to order.

一下子哪里打了灯笼去找？
Where could we find one at a moment’s notice, even with a lantern?

就算找到了，也要看彼此有没有缘分；
And if we did, we should still have to see whether the two were suited.

光是一头热，有啥用处？』
What use is affection on only one side?

古应春又说，『看在银子分上，勉强跟回家也会过日子，也会生儿子，
For money’s sake, a woman might reluctantly go home with a man, keep his house, and bear him sons.

就是没有笑脸；要笑也是装出来的。
