But she would never smile; or, if she did, the smile would be forced.

如果是这样的情形，哪怕她天仙化人，我也敬谢不敏。』
In those circumstances, I would respectfully decline even a fairy descended from Heaven.”

话是不能说没有道理，只是有些言过其实。
There was sense in what he said, though he overstated it.

但是不这么做，
Yet if they did not follow the plan, what were they to do?

『难道就此罢手不成？』她怔怔地问她丈夫。
“Must we simply abandon the whole thing?” she asked, staring at him.

『最后罢手，花了钱挨骂；
“In the end you would have to abandon it anyway, after spending the money and being cursed for it.

岂不冤枉？』
What a waste that would be!”


这句话，七姑奶奶大为不服，
She objected strongly.

『奇了！』她说，
“How strange!

『这种事也多得是。
Such things happen all the time.

你不是自己说过，上个月，什么办厘金的朱老爷，就花三千银子弄了个「活宝」送上司。』
Did you not tell me yourself that last month some Mr Zhu who collected likin spent three thousand taels on a ‘living treasure’ and presented her to his superior?”

『献活宝巴结上司，又当别论——。』
“Presenting a living treasure to curry favor with a superior is another matter.”

古应春另有一番议论——
Gu had further arguments.

官场中巴结上司，物色美人进献，原是自古已然的事；
Finding beauties to offer to men above one had been a practice of official life since ancient times.

但取悦一时，不必计及后果。
Its purpose was to please for the moment; consequences need not be considered.

而且名妓为达官贵人作妾，即令家规森严，行动不自由；然而锦衣玉食，排场阔绰，总也有贪图。
Moreover, if a famous courtesan became the concubine of a high official, even a strict household and restrictions on her movements were compensated by rich food, fine clothes, and splendid display.

风尘中受慕虚荣的多；
Many women of the pleasure quarters loved vanity.

珠围翠绕，婢仆簇拥，夸耀于旧日小姊妹，听得啧啧称羡之声的那一刻，也还是很『过瘾』的。
Surrounded by jewels and attendants, showing off to former companions and hearing their admiring exclamations—that moment could be deeply satisfying.


『张郎中能够有什么给艳春老四？』古应春说，
“What could Dr Zhang give the Fourth Miss of Yanchun House?” Gu asked.

『就算他殷实，做生意人家总是生意人家的规矩，
“Even if he is comfortably off, a business household follows business habits.

讲究实惠；
It values practical things.

不见得经常替她做衣服，打首饰。
He is unlikely to keep having clothes and jewelry made for her.

日常饮食，更不会象做大官的人家，天天鸡鱼鸭肉。
Nor will the daily table resemble a great official’s, with chicken, fish, duck, and meat every day.

内地又不比上海，
An inland town is not Shanghai.

过惯了繁华日子的，你想想她心里是何滋味？
Think how a woman accustomed to all this splendor would feel.

少不得三天两头生闲气，
She would be finding something to be angry about every few days.

这就叫不安于室。
That is what it means to be restless at home.

张郎中哪里还有艳福好享？』
How would Dr Zhang enjoy his good fortune then?”

七姑奶奶想起一句成语∶『爱之适足以害之』；
The Seventh Lady remembered the saying that love may do precisely the harm it wishes to prevent.

也觉得不妥，
She too began to think the plan unsuitable.

然而又何致于挨骂？
But why should it bring curses upon them?

她心里这样在想，还未问出口，古应春却已有了解释∶『做人情也是一门学问。
Before she could ask, Gu supplied the answer. “Doing a favor is an art in itself.

象这样的情形，懂道理的人，一定批评小爷叔，简直就是以怨报德，
In such a case, anyone with sense would accuse Little Uncle of repaying kindness with injury.

这倒还在其次；
And that is the least of it.

张郎中家里的人，一定骂死了小爷叔。
The doctor’s family would curse him to death.

你想是不是呢？』
Would they not?”


设身处地想一想，自己也会如此；
Putting herself in their place, she realized that she would do the same.

不但要骂出钱的人，还会骂出主意的人。
She would curse not only the person who paid, but the person who proposed the scheme.

七姑奶奶这样想着，深为不安。
The thought troubled her deeply.

可是，阿巧姐又如何？
Yet what was to become of A’qiao’s predicament?

『事情总要有个了结。』七姑奶奶说，
“There must be some conclusion to this.

『当然，这件事要两厢情愿，
Naturally, it requires willingness on both sides.

这面不肯，那面也没有话说；
If one refuses, the other has nothing to say.

不过当初那样做法，显得有点有意用「美人计」骗人上当，
But the way it began makes it look as though we deliberately used a beauty to lure him into a trap.

倘或就此记恨，说出去的话一定难听；
If he resents it, what he says afterward will be unpleasant.

不要说阿巧姐，就是小爷叔也一定不开心。』
Quite apart from A’qiao, Little Uncle will certainly be unhappy too.”

古应春沉吟了一会，从从容容地答道∶『没有别的办法，
Gu considered for a while, then answered calmly, “There is no other way.

只有多送银子，作为补偿。』
We must give him more money as compensation.”

『也只好如此。』七姑奶奶说，
“Then that is what we must do,” she said.

『到时候再说，
“We can discuss it when the time comes.

此刻不必去伤脑筋了！』
There is no need to rack our brains over it now.”



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第五章（本章第1部分，共3部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第五章
CHAPTER FIVE


住在洋场的人，特别是经常在花天酒地中的，都有迟睡迟起的习惯；
People in the foreign settlement, particularly those who spent their time in pleasure and revelry, were accustomed to late nights and late mornings.

古应春因为有生意要照料，起得还算早的，但也要九点钟才下床。
With business to attend to, Gu Yingchun rose comparatively early, but even he did not get out of bed until nine.

这天八点钟就有娘姨来敲房门；
This morning, at eight, a maid knocked at the bedroom door.

说号子里派了人来，有话要说。
Someone had come from the firm with a message.

『什么话？』古应春隔着窗子问。
“What message?” Gu asked through the window.

『杭州有位刘三爷来。
“A Third Master Liu has arrived from Hangzhou.

人在号子里。』
He is at the firm.”

『哪个刘三爷？』
“Which Third Master Liu?”

睡眼惺松的古应春，一时想不起是谁。
Still sleepy, Gu could not think who it was.

七姑奶奶在后房却想到了，
The Seventh Lady, in the inner room, remembered at once.

掀开帐子说道∶『不是刘不才刘三爷吗？』
Lifting the bed curtains, she said, “Is it not Liu Bucai—Third Master Liu?”

『是他？
“Him?

不会是他！』古应春说，
Surely not.

『刘三爷也是自己人；
He is one of our own people.

一来，当然会到这里来，
He would come straight here.

跑到号子里去干什么？』
Why go to the firm?”

『老板娘的话不错。』号子里的伙计在窗外接口，
“Madam is right,” the clerk answered from outside the window.

『本来是要请刘三爷到家里来的。他说，他身上破破烂烂不好意思来。』
“We asked him to come to the house, but he said his clothes were too ragged. He was embarrassed to call.”

果然是刘不才！
So it really was Liu Bucai.

这个意外的消息，反替古应春带来了迷茫，竟忘了说话。
The unexpected news left Gu bewildered and momentarily speechless.

还是七姑奶奶的心思快，
The Seventh Lady thought faster.

胡家的情形还不知道，也许有了什么不幸之事；
They still knew nothing of the Hu family’s circumstances; some misfortune might have occurred.

如果让胡雪岩知道了，一定立刻要见他，
If Hu learned that Liu was here, he would insist on seeing him immediately.

当面锣，对面鼓，什么话都瞒不住他，大是不妥。
Face to face, nothing could be concealed from him, and that might be disastrous.

因此，她便替丈夫作主，吩咐伙计先回号子，说古应春马上去看他；
She therefore answered for her husband, telling the clerk to return to the firm and say that Gu would be there at once.

同时叮嘱下人，不准在胡雪岩面前透露刘不才已到上海的消息。
She also warned the servants not to let Hu know that Liu had arrived in Shanghai.


『想不到是他来了。』古应春说，
“To think that he has come,” Gu said.

『你要不要跟我一道去看他。』
“Will you go with me?”

『自然要罗！』
“Of course!”

夫妇俩一辆马车赶到号子里；
Husband and wife hurried to the firm together in a carriage.

相见之下，彼此都有片刻的沉默。
When they met Liu, all three were silent for a moment.

沉默中，古应春夫妇将刘不才从头看到底，
Gu and his wife studied him from head to foot.

衣衫虽然褴褛，精神气色都还不错，
His clothes were ragged, but his spirits and complexion were quite good.

不象是快饿死了的样子。
He did not look like a man near starvation.

『刘三叔！』
“Third Uncle Liu!”

终于是七姑奶奶先开口，
The Seventh Lady was the first to speak.

『你好吧？』
“Are you well?”

『还好，还好！』
“Well enough, well enough!”

刘不才仿佛一下子惊醒过来，
Liu seemed suddenly to awaken.

眨一眨眼说∶『再世做人，又在一起了，自然还好！』
Blinking, he said, “Alive for a second time, and together with you again—of course I am well.”

听得这话，古应春夫妇不约而同地松了口气，
Husband and wife both breathed more easily.

『胡家呢？』七姑奶奶问道，
“And the Hu family?” she asked.

『都好吧？』
“Are they all well?”

『逃难苦一点，
“Refugee life has been hard.

大大小小轮流生病，现在总算都好了。』
The old and young took turns falling ill, but now they have all recovered.”

『啊——！』
“Ah!”

七姑奶奶长长舒口气，双手合掌，当胸顶礼∶『谢天谢地。』然后又说∶『不过我倒又不懂了，
She let out a long breath and pressed her palms together in thanksgiving. “Thank Heaven!” Then she added, “But now I do not understand.

杭州城里饿死的人无其数——。』说到这里，她咽口唾沫，将最后那句话缩了回去。
Countless people have starved to death in Hangzhou—” She swallowed the rest.

那句话是个疑问∶饿死的人既然无其数，何以胡家上下一个人都没有饿死？
Her unspoken question was plain: if so many had starved, how had every member of the Hu household survived?

刘不才懂她的意思，但不是一句话所能解释答得了的，
Liu understood, but no brief answer could explain it.

『真正菩萨保佑！
“It was truly the Bodhisattva’s protection.

要谈起来三天三夜说不尽。』
I could not tell it all in three days and nights.”


他急转直下地问道∶『听说雪岩运粮到过杭州，不能进城又回上海。
He changed the subject abruptly. “I hear Xueyan brought grain to Hangzhou but could not get it into the city and returned to Shanghai.

人呢？』
Where is he?”

『他一场大病，还没有好。不过，不要紧了。』
“He has been very ill and is not fully recovered, though he is out of danger now.”

七姑奶奶歉意地说∶『对不起，刘三叔，你现在还不能跟他见面；
The Seventh Lady spoke apologetically. “Forgive us, Third Uncle Liu, but you must not see him yet.

等我们把事情问清楚了再说。
Let us find out exactly what happened first.

王抚台是不是真的殉节了？』
Did Governor Wang really die for his duty?”

『死得好，
“A good death!

死得好！』
A good death!”

凡事吊儿郎当，从没有什么事可以教他认真的刘不才，大声赞叹，
Liu, ordinarily so easy-going that nothing could make him take matters seriously, spoke with loud conviction.

『死得有价值。
“A death that counted.

王抚台的官声，说实在的，没有啥好；
To be honest, his reputation as an official was not particularly good.

这一来就只好不坏了，
Now there can be nothing but good said of him.

连长毛都佩服。』
Even the rebels admire him.”

据刘不才说，杭州城陷那天，『忠王』李秀成单骑直奔巡抚衙门，
According to Liu, on the day Hangzhou fell, Li Xiucheng, the Loyal King, rode alone straight to the governor’s yamen.

原意是料到王有龄会殉节，想拦阻他不死；
Expecting Wang to take his own life, he had hoped to prevent it.

可是晚了一步，
But he was too late.

王有龄已朝服自缢于大堂右面的桂花树下。
Dressed in his court robes, Wang had already hanged himself from an osmanthus tree to the right of the main hall.

李秀成敬他忠义，解下尸首，停放在东辕门彭亭左侧，
Respecting his loyalty, Li had the body taken down and laid to the left of the pavilion by the eastern outer gate.

觅来上好棺木盛殓；
He found a fine coffin for the burial preparations.

王家上下老幼，自然置于保护之下。
Naturally, Wang’s household, old and young alike, was placed under protection.

『长毛总算也有点人心。』七姑奶奶问道∶『不是说要拿王抚台的灵柩送到上海来吗？』
“The rebels have some humanity after all,” the Seventh Lady said. “Was there not talk of sending the coffin to Shanghai?”

『那倒没有听见说起。』
“I heard nothing of that.”


『满城呢？古应春问∶』将军瑞昌，大概也殉节了？
“What of the Manchu quarter?” Gu asked. “General Ruichang must have died for his duty too?”

『』满城在三天以后才破——。『在这三天中，李秀成暂停进攻，派人招降，
“The Manchu quarter held out for another three days—” During those days, Li suspended his attacks and sent men to offer terms of surrender.

条件相当宽大，
The terms were generous.

准许旗人自由离去，准带随身细软以外，另发川资；
The bannermen would be allowed to leave freely, taking their portable valuables, and would receive travelling money as well.

同时将』天王『特赦杭州旗人的』诏旨『送给瑞昌看，
Ruichang was also shown an edict from the Heavenly King granting the Hangzhou bannermen a special pardon.

目的是想消除他们的疑虑，而效用适得其反。
The intention was to allay their fears, but it had the opposite effect.

也许是条件太宽大，反令人难以置信。
Perhaps the terms were so generous that they were difficult to believe.

而且，败军之将归旗，亦必定治罪，
Besides, defeated officers returning to the banner establishment would certainly be punished.

难逃一死；反倒失去了抚恤，甚至还褫籍，害得子孙不能抬头，无法生活，
Death would be hard to escape; they would lose the compensation their families might otherwise receive and might even be struck from the banner rolls, leaving their descendants disgraced and without a livelihood.

所以瑞昌与部将约定，决不投降。
Ruichang and his officers therefore agreed never to surrender.

于是三天一过，李秀成下令攻击，
Once the three days were over, Li ordered an assault.

驻防旗人，个个上阵，极力抵抗；
Every member of the garrison took up arms and resisted fiercely.

满城周围九里，有五道城门，城上有红衣大炮，
The Manchu quarter had a circuit of nine li, five gates, and large hongyi cannon mounted on its walls.

轰死了长毛三千多人，
More than three thousand rebels were killed by their fire.

到十二月初一午后城破。
It was not until the afternoon of the first day of the twelfth month that the quarter fell.

将军瑞昌投荷花池而死；
Ruichang drowned himself in a lotus pond.

副都统杰纯、关福亦都自戕。
The deputy banner commanders Jiechun and Guanfu also took their own lives.

男女老小纵火自焚以及投西湖而死的，不计其数。
Countless men, women, and children died in fires they themselves had set or by throwing themselves into West Lake.


讲到这里，刘不才自我惊悸，面无人色；
At this point in his account, Liu himself grew frightened and pale.

古应春赶紧叫人倒了热茶来，让他缓一缓气，再问他个人的遭遇。
Gu quickly ordered hot tea so that he could recover his breath, then asked about his own experiences.

『杭州吃紧的时候，我正在那里。
“I happened to be in Hangzhou when the situation became critical.

雪岩跟我商量，
Xueyan discussed it with me.

湖州亦已被围，总归一时回不去了；
Huzhou was under siege too, so I could not return there for the time being.

托我护送他的家眷到三天竺逃难。
He asked me to escort his family to the three Tianzhu temples for refuge.

从此一别，就没有再见过他；
We parted then, and I never saw him again.

因为后来看三天竺亦不是好地方，
Later I decided that the temples were unsafe as well.

一步一步往里逃，
We kept retreating farther into the countryside.

真正菩萨保佑，
Truly, the Bodhisattva protected us.

逃到留下。』
We reached Liuxia.”

『留下』是个地名，在杭州西面；
Liuxia was a place west of Hangzhou.

据说当初宋高宗迁都杭州，相度地势，起造宫殿，此处亦曾中意，嘱咐『留下』备选，所以叫做留下。
Its name meant “keep it.” According to tradition, when Emperor Gaozong of the Song moved his capital to Hangzhou and surveyed possible sites for a palace, this place pleased him, and he ordered it kept for consideration. Hence the name.

其地多山，峰回泉绕，颇多隐秘之处，是逃难的好去处。
With its hills, winding paths, streams, and many secluded places, it was well suited to sheltering refugees.

『逃难的人很多，人多成市，
“But there were so many refugees that a market sprang up.

就谈不到隐秘了。
With all those people, there was no seclusion left.

我一看情形不妙，跟雪岩夫人说∶』要逃得远，逃得深，越是荒凉穷苦的地方越好。
Seeing the danger, I told Xueyan’s wife that we must go farther and deeper into the hills: the more remote and impoverished the place, the better.

雪岩夫人很有眼光，说我的话对。
She had good judgement and agreed.

我就找到一处深山，真正人迹不到之处；
I found a spot deep in the mountains where people scarcely ever went.

最好的是有一道涧，
Best of all, there was a ravine with running water.

有涧就有水，什么都不怕了。
Once we had water, there was nothing to fear.

我雇人搭了一座茅棚，只有三尺高，下面铺上水板；
I hired men to build a thatched shelter, only three chi high, with boards laid underneath.

又运上去七八担米，一缸盐菜，十来条火腿。
Then I had seven or eight dan of rice, a jar of salted vegetables, and a dozen or so hams carried up.

说起来不相信，那时候杭州城里饿死的人，不知道多少。就我们那里没有一天不吃干饭。
You may find it hard to believe: while untold numbers were starving in Hangzhou, we never went a day without solid rice.”

『』怪不得。刘三叔不象没饭吃的样子。『七姑奶奶说，』
“No wonder you do not look as though you have gone hungry,” said the Seventh Lady.

长毛倒没有寻到你们那里？『
“Did the rebels never find you?”


『差一点点。』刘不才说，
“They nearly did.

『有一天我去赌钱——』『慢点。』七姑奶奶插嘴问道∶『逃难还有地方赌钱？』
One day I went gambling—” “Wait a moment,” she interrupted. “Were there places to gamble even among the refugees?”

『不但赌钱，
“Not only gambling.

还有卖唱的呢！
There were singing entertainers too.

市面热闹得很。』
The market was thriving.”

市面是由逃难的人带来的。
It was the refugees who had created that market.

起先是有人搭个茅棚，卖些常用的杂物，
At first someone had put up a thatched hut to sell everyday necessities.

没有字号，通称『小店』；
It had no business name and was simply called “the little shop.”

然后小店成为茶店，作为聚会打听消息的所在；
Then it became a tea shop, where people gathered to hear the news.

难中岁月，既愁且闷，少不得想个排遣之道，于是茶店又变成赌场。
Refugee life was full of anxiety and boredom; people needed distraction, and the tea shop became a gambling house.

刘不才先是不愿与世隔绝，每天走七八里路到那个应运而生的市集中去听听新闻，
At first Liu had walked seven or eight li to this new market each day merely to avoid losing contact with the world and to learn what was happening.

到后来就专为去过赌瘾，
Later he went chiefly to satisfy his appetite for gambling.

牌九、做宝、掷骰子，什么都来；
Pai gow, the treasure game, dice—he played them all.

有庄做，就做庄家，没有庄做就赌下风，
If he could hold the bank, he did; otherwise he played against it.

成了那家赌场的台柱。
He became one of the gambling house’s mainstays.


这天午后，刘不才摊庄赌小牌九，手气极旺，
One afternoon he was banking at the small version of pai gow and enjoying extraordinary luck.

往往他翻蹩十，重门也翻蹩十，算起来还有钱赢。
Often he turned up a zero-point hand, only to find that the heavily backed opposing hand was also zero, so that he still came out ahead.

正赌得兴头时，突然有人喊道∶『长毛来了！』
At the height of the game, someone suddenly shouted, “The rebels are coming!”

刘不才不大肯相信，因为他上过一回当；
Liu was reluctant to believe it, having once been deceived by the same cry.

有一次也是听说『长毛来了』，赌客仓皇走避，结果无事，
On that occasion, the players had fled in panic and nothing had happened.

但等回到赌场，台面上已空空如也。
When they returned, however, the gaming table had been stripped bare.

事后方知，是有人故意捣乱，好抢台面；
They learned afterwards that someone had raised the false alarm to seize the money.

他疑心这一次也是有人想趁火打劫，所以大家逃，他不逃，不慌不忙地收拾起自己的赌注再说。
Suspecting another attempt to profit from panic, Liu stayed while the others ran, calmly collecting his stakes.

『刘三爷！』开赌场的过来警告∶『真的是长毛来了。』
“Third Master Liu!” the proprietor warned him. “The rebels really are here.”

这一说刘不才方始着慌，
Only then did Liu take fright.

匆匆将几十两银子塞入腰际，背起五六串铜钱，拔脚夺门而走。
He hurriedly thrust several dozen taels into his waistband, slung five or six strings of copper cash over his shoulder, and bolted through the door.

然而已经晚了，有两个长毛穷追不舍。
But it was already too late: two rebels pursued him relentlessly.

刘不才虽急不乱，
Urgent though the danger was, he kept his head.

心里在想，自己衣服比别人穿得整齐；肩上又背着铜钱，长毛决不肯放过自己。
His clothes were better than other people’s, and he had copper cash over his shoulder; they would never let him go.

这样一逃一追，到头来岂不是『引鬼进门』？
If he simply kept running, would he not lead the enemy to the family’s hiding place?

念头转到此处，对付的办法也就有了；
Once he saw that, he knew what to do.

拉过一串铜钱来，将『串头绳』上的活结，一下扯开，『哗哗』地将一千铜元落得满地；
He pulled a string of cash towards him, undid its slipknot, and sent a thousand coins clattering across the ground.

然后跑几步，如法炮制。
After a few more strides he did the same again.

五六串铜钱撒完，肩上的重负全释，脚步就轻快了；
When all five or six strings had been scattered, the weight was gone and he could run more lightly.

然而还是不敢走正路，怕引长毛发现住处，
Even so, he dared not take the direct route for fear of revealing their shelter.

兜了好大一个圈子，到晚上才绕道到家。
He made a long circuit and did not get home until evening.


『从那一次以后，胡老太太跟雪岩夫人就不准我再去赌了。
“After that, Xueyan’s mother and wife forbade me to go gambling again.

其实，市面也就此打散了——
In any case, the market broke up.

那一次是一小队长毛，误打误撞闯到了那里；
That first party was only a small detachment of rebels which had stumbled upon the place.

人数太少，不敢动手。
There were too few of them to do much.

第二天，还是第三天，来了大队人马，
The next day, or perhaps the day after, a large force came.

奸淫掳掠外加一把火；
They raped, looted, seized people, and finally set the place on fire.

难民遭劫的不知多少？』
Who knows how many refugees suffered?”

刘不才说到这里，表情相当复杂，
Liu’s expression was complicated.

余悸余哀都犹在，却又似乎欣慰得意，
Fear and sorrow still lingered, yet he also looked relieved, even pleased with himself.

『亏得我见机！
“Luckily I saw what was coming.

这一宝总算让我看准了。』
That was one wager I judged correctly.”

谈这样的生死大事，仍旧不脱赌徒的口吻，
Even discussing matters of life and death, he could not shed a gambler’s language.

七姑奶奶对他又佩服，又好笑，但更多的是关切∶『以后始终没有遇见长毛？』
The Seventh Lady felt both admiration and amusement, but concern predominated. “You never met the rebels again after that?”

『没有！
“No.

不过好几次听见声音；
Several times we heard them, though.

提心吊胆的味道，只有尝过的人才晓得真不好受！』
Only someone who has lived through it knows how dreadful that constant fear can be.”


然而，此刻提心吊胆的日子，也并不算完全过去。
Even now, the days of fear were not entirely over.

长毛进城，由于李秀成的约束，照例会有的烧、杀、奸、抢倒不甚厉害；
Once the rebels entered Hangzhou, Li’s discipline kept the usual burning, killing, rape, and robbery from becoming too severe.

但杭州人不肯从贼，
Yet the people of Hangzhou were unwilling to submit.

男的上吊、女的投井、阖家自尽的，不计其数。
Men hanged themselves, women threw themselves into wells, and whole families took their own lives in countless numbers.

这也不尽是忠义之气使然，
This was not entirely an expression of loyalty to the dynasty.

而是生趣索然；其中又分成几类∶怕受辱吃苦头的是一类；
Many had lost all desire to live, for different reasons. Some feared humiliation and suffering.

满目极人间未有之惨，感情上承受不住，愿求解脱的，也是类；
Some had seen horrors beyond anything they could emotionally endure and sought release.

无衣无食，求苟延残喘而不可得，以为迟早是死，不如早死的，又是一类；
Others had neither clothes nor food and could find no means of prolonging their lives; believing death inevitable, they chose it sooner rather than later.

历尽浩劫，到头来仍不免一场空，于心不甘，愤而自裁的，更是一类。
Still others, having survived terrible calamities only to find everything lost in the end, killed themselves in bitter despair.

象胡家这样『跳出劫数外，不在五行中』的；只怕十万人家找不出一家；
Among a hundred thousand households, perhaps not one had escaped the catastrophe as the Hu family had.

然而现在却又在劫数中了。
Yet now calamity threatened them again.

荒山茅棚，自然不能再住；最主要的原因是，存粮已罄，不能不全家『出山』；
They could no longer remain in their mountain hut, chiefly because their food was exhausted and the whole family had to come down.

城里尸臭不可向迩，如果不是严冬，瘟疫早已流行，当然不能再住。
The city was uninhabitable: the stench of bodies made it impossible to approach. Had it not been the depths of winter, epidemic disease would already have spread.

好的是胡老太太本来信佛，
Fortunately, Hu’s mother had always been devout.

自从胡雪岩平地一声雷，发达起来，更认定是菩萨保佑，
Since her son’s sudden rise in the world, she had been more convinced than ever of the Bodhisattva’s protection.

大小庙宇庵堂，只要和尚尼姑上门化缘，必不会空手而回；
Monks and nuns who came soliciting donations for temples, large or small, never left her empty-handed.

三天竺是香火盛地，几座庙宇，无不相熟，
The three Tianzhu temples were an important centre of worship, and she knew them all.

找一处安顿下来，倒也容易。
Finding a place to stay was therefore easy enough.

苦恼的仍旧是粮食。
The difficulty was still food.

整个杭州城，全靠李秀成从嘉兴运来两万石米；
All Hangzhou depended on twenty thousand shi of rice that Li had brought from Jiaxing.

如果不包括军食在内，倒也能维持一段时期，
Without the troops’ needs, it might have lasted some time.

无奈先发军粮，再办平粜，
But the army received its rations first, and only afterwards was grain sold to civilians at controlled prices.

老百姓的实惠就有限了。
The benefit to ordinary people was limited.


『现在全家大小，每天只吃一顿粥。
“Now the whole household, old and young, has only one meal of gruel a day.

我倒还好，就是上面老的，下小的，不能不想法子。』
I can manage, but something must be done for the old people and the children.”

『这个法子总想得出。』古应春说，
“We shall find a way,” Gu said.

『不过，刘三叔，你有句话我不懂；
“But there is something I do not understand, Third Uncle Liu.

你一向胃口很好，
You have always had a good appetite.

每天吃一顿粥，倒能支持得住？还说「还好」！』
How can you keep going on one meal of gruel a day and still say you can manage?”

刘不才笑笑，不好意思地答道∶『我会到长毛公馆里去打野食。』七姑奶奶也笑了，
Liu smiled a little sheepishly. “I find ways to get a meal at the rebels’ residences.” The Seventh Lady laughed too.

『刘三叔，你真正是，老虎嘴里的食，也敢夺来吃。』她说，
“You really would snatch food from a tiger’s mouth!

『你怎么打法？』
How do you manage it?”

『这就不好告诉你了。
“That I cannot tell you.

闲话少说，
Let us leave idle talk aside.

有句正经话，我要跟你们商量，
There is something serious I must discuss with you.

有个王八蛋来找雪岩的麻烦；
A bastard is making trouble for Xueyan.

如果不理他会出事。』
If he is ignored, something will happen.”

刘不才口中的『王八蛋』叫袁忠清，是钱塘县署理知县。
The “bastard” was Yuan Zhongqing, acting magistrate of Qiantang County.

此人原来是袁甲三部下的一个『勇目』，
He had originally been a petty militia commander under Yuan Jiasan.

打仗发了笔横财，活动袁甲三的一个幕友，在一次『保案』中将他添上了一个名字，
After making a windfall from the war, he worked through one of Yuan’s advisers to have his name added to a list of men recommended for honours.

得了『六品蓝翎』的功名。
He obtained sixth-rank status and the right to wear a blue feather.

后来犯了军令，袁甲三要杀他；
Later he violated military orders, and Yuan Jiasan intended to execute him.

吓得连夜开了小差，逃回江西原籍。
Terrified, he deserted overnight and fled to his native Jiangxi.


那时的江西巡抚是何桂清的同年、穆彰阿的得意门生张芾；
The governor of Jiangxi at that time was Zhang Fu, a fellow graduate of He Guiqing’s examination year and a favourite pupil of Muzhang’a.

袁忠清假报为六品蓝翎的县丞，
Yuan falsely represented himself as a sixth-rank county assistant magistrate entitled to the blue feather.

又走了门路，投效在张芾那里。
Through further connections, he secured a position under Zhang.

不久，长毛攻江西省城，
Before long, the rebels attacked Nanchang, the provincial capital.

南昌老百姓，竭力助守，使得张芾大起好感；
The people of Nanchang threw themselves into its defence, winning Zhang’s warm regard.

爱屋及乌，便宜了『忘八蛋』，竟被委为制造局帮办军装。
That goodwill extended to their fellow native, and the “bastard” benefited: he was appointed to assist with military supplies at the manufacturing bureau.

这是个极肥的差使，在袁忠清手里更是左右逢源，得其所哉。
It was an extremely lucrative post, and Yuan found opportunities for profit on every side.

不久，由于宁国之捷，专案报奖，
Soon afterwards, the victory at Ningguo occasioned a special recommendation for honours.

张芾倒很照顾袁忠清，特意嘱咐幕友，为他加上很好的考语，保升县令。
Zhang took particular care of Yuan, telling his advisers to give him an excellent assessment and recommend him for promotion to county magistrate.

这原是一个大喜讯，
Ordinarily this would have been wonderful news.

在他人当然会高兴不得了，
Anyone else would have been delighted.

而袁忠清不但愁眉苦脸，甚至坐卧不宁。
Yuan, however, looked miserable and could neither sit nor rest in peace.

同事不免奇怪，
His colleagues naturally wondered why.

少不得有人问他∶『老袁，指日高升！
“Yuan, promotion is just ahead of you!

上头格外照应你，
The authorities have taken special care.

不是列个字的泛泛保举；你是十六个字的考语，
This is no routine recommendation with a token appraisal; yours runs to sixteen characters.

京里一定照准。
The capital is sure to approve it.

眼看就是「百里侯」；
You are about to rule a county.

如何倒象如丧考妣似的。』
Why look as though you have lost both parents?”

『说什么指日高升？
“Promotion?

不吃官司，只怕都要靠祖宗积德。』
It will take all the merit my ancestors accumulated to keep me from a criminal charge.”

接着，又摇摇着∶『官司吃定了！
Then he shook his head. “No, the charge is certain.

祖宗积德也没用。』
Even my ancestors’ merit will not help.”

他那同事大为惊惑∶『为什么？』
His colleague was astonished. “Why?”

袁忠清先还不敢说，
At first Yuan dared not explain.

经不起那同事诚恳热心，拍胸脯担保，必定设法为他分忧，袁忠清才吐露了心底的秘密。
But the man was so earnest and helpful, solemnly promising to find a way out, that Yuan finally revealed his secret.

『实不相瞒，我这个「六品蓝翎」，货真价实；
“To be frank, my sixth rank and blue feather are perfectly genuine.

县丞是个「西贝货」。
The county assistant magistracy is a fake.

你想这一保上去，怎么得了？』
What will happen when this recommendation goes up?”


『什么？
“What?

你的县丞是假的！』
You are not really an assistant magistrate?”

假的就不能见天日。
A false appointment could not stand scrutiny.

江西的保案上去，吏部自然要查案；
Once Jiangxi’s recommendation reached the Ministry of Personnel, the records would naturally be checked.

袁忠清因为是县丞才能保知县，
Yuan was being recommended for county magistrate because he supposedly held an assistant magistracy.

知则先要问他这个县丞是什么『班子』？
The first question would be how he had obtained that appointment.

一查无案可稽；就要行文来问。
Finding no record, the ministry would send an enquiry.

试问袁忠清可拿得出『部照「或是捐过班的』实收『？
Could Yuan produce an official certificate or a receipt for a purchased appointment?

象这种假冒的事，不是没有；
Such impostures were not unknown.

史部的书办十九是吃人不吐骨头的积年滑吏，无弊不悉，只怕没有缝钻，
Almost all the ministry’s clerks were old hands at extortion, knowing every variety of fraud and forever looking for an opening.

一旦拿住了短处，
Once they had discovered his weakness, they would demand whatever they pleased.

予取予求勒索够了，怕还是要办他个』假冒职官『的罪名，落个充军的下场。
Even after extracting enough money, they might still charge him with falsely claiming official status and have him sent into military exile.

他那同事，倒也言而有信，
His colleague proved as good as his word.

为他请教高人，想出一条路子，补捐一个县丞。
After consulting someone knowledgeable, he found a solution: Yuan could purchase an assistant magistracy now.

军兴以来，为了筹饷，大开捐例，
Since the war began, the government had greatly expanded the sale of appointments to raise military funds.

各省都向吏部先领到大批空白收据；
Each province had received large quantities of blank receipts from the Ministry of Personnel.

即名为『实收』——
These were called receipts for the actual amount paid.

捐班有各种花样，各种折扣，以实际捐纳银数，掣给收据，就叫『实收』，将来据以换领正式部照；
There were many schemes and discounts for purchasing appointments; the receipt stated the silver actually contributed and could later be exchanged for a formal ministry certificate.

所以这倒容易，兑了银子，立时可以办妥。
Paying the silver and obtaining a receipt was easy enough.

但是，日期不符也不行；
The difficulty was the date.

缴验『实收』，一看是保案以后所捐，把戏立刻拆穿。
If the receipt showed that the appointment had been purchased after the recommendation, the deception would be exposed at once.

『这没有别的办法，
“There is only one way.

只有托人情。』
We must call in a favour.”

『托人情要钱，
“And favours cost money.

我知道。』袁忠清说，
I know,” Yuan replied.

『我这个差使虽有点油水，平时都结交了朋友；
“My post yields a little, but I have spent it on cultivating friends.

吃过用过，也就差不多了。
After food and expenses, there is not much left.

如今，都在这里了！』
Everything I have is here.”

将枕头箱打开，
He opened a small chest kept by his pillow.

里面银票倒是不少，但零零碎碎加起来，不过百把两银子；
It contained quite a few banknotes, but all the little sums together came to only a hundred taels or so.

象这种倒填年月的花样，担着极大的干系，少说说也得三百两，
Backdating a receipt was a serious risk and would cost at least three hundred.

他那朋友知道袁忠清是有意做作；
His friend knew that Yuan was putting on a performance.

事到如今，人家半吊子，自己不能做为德不卒的事，
But having taken the matter this far, he could hardly abandon a good deed halfway through merely because Yuan was unreliable.

只好替他添上五十两银子，跟『前途』好说歹说，将他这件事办了下来。
He added fifty taels of his own and, after much pleading with the people handling the business, got it arranged.



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第五章（本章第2部分，共3部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


但是，袁忠清『不够意思』的名声，却已转了出去；
But Yuan Zhongqing’s reputation for shabby conduct had spread.

江西不能再混，
He could no longer get on in Jiangxi.

事实上也非走不可，因为保升了知县，不能在本省补缺，
In any case, he had to leave: having been recommended for promotion to county magistrate, he could not be appointed to a vacancy in the same province.

托人到部里打点，分发浙江候补。
Through contacts at the ministry, he was assigned to Zhejiang to await a post.

袁忠清原来是指望分发广东，却以所托的人，不甚实在，改了分发浙江，
He had originally hoped for Guangdong, but the intermediary proved less reliable than expected and had the assignment changed to Zhejiang.

万般无奈，只有『颤到』候补，
With no alternative, Yuan reported there.

那时浙江省城正当初陷收复以后，
This was shortly after the provincial capital had fallen for the first time and been recovered.

王有龄全力缮修战备，构筑长壕，增设炮台，城上鳞次栉比的营房；
Wang Youling was putting all his efforts into preparing its defences: long trenches were dug, batteries added, and rows of barracks built along the walls.

架起极坚固的吊车，安上轴辘，整天不停地储备枪械子药。
Strong hoisting frames with winding drums worked all day, bringing up firearms and ammunition.

放眼一望，旗帜鲜明，刀枪雪亮，
Everywhere were bright banners and gleaming weapons.

看样子是一定守得住了。
The city certainly looked capable of holding out.

于是袁忠清精神复振，
Yuan’s spirits revived.

走了藩司麟趾的门路，竟得『挂牌』署理钱塘县。
Working through Provincial Treasurer Linzhi, he actually secured appointment as acting magistrate of Qiantang.

杭州城内，钱塘仁和两县，而钱塘是首县。县官分更自不同。
Hangzhou comprised two counties, Qiantang and Renhe; Qiantang was the senior one, and its magistracy carried particular weight.

袁忠清工于心计，只具『内才』；
Yuan was calculating and possessed the talents needed behind the scenes.

首县却是要『外才』的，讲究仪表出众、谈吐有趣、服饰华丽、手段圆滑，最要紧的是出手大方、善于应酬，
The magistrate of the senior county, however, needed public accomplishments: a fine appearance, engaging conversation, splendid clothes, smooth manners, and, above all, a generous hand and a gift for entertaining.

袁忠清本非其选。
Yuan was not the natural choice.

但此时军情紧急，大员过境的绝少，送往迎来的差使不繁，
But with military affairs so urgent, few high officials passed through, and there was little ceremonial receiving and seeing off to do.

正可发挥他的所长。
He could put his own abilities to use.

袁忠清的长处就在搞钱；
His strength lay in extracting money.

搞钱要有名目，而在这个万事莫如守在急的时候，又何愁找不到名目？
For that, one needed a pretext; and when defence took precedence over everything, how could pretexts be lacking?

为了军需，摊派捐献，抓差征料，完全是一笔烂帐；
Levies, compulsory donations, requisitioned labour and materials—all could be charged to military needs in accounts no one could untangle.

只要上面能够交差，下面不激出民变，从中捞多少都没有人会问的。
So long as he satisfied his superiors and did not drive the people into revolt, no one would ask how much he pocketed in between.


到了九月里杭州被围，家家绝粮，人人瘦瘠，
When Hangzhou was besieged in the ninth month, households ran out of food and everyone grew thin.

只有袁忠清似乎精神还很饱满；
Yuan alone seemed full of vigour.

多疑心他私下藏着米粮，背人『吃独食』，然而事无佐证，莫可究诘。
Many suspected that he had hidden grain and was secretly feeding himself, but without evidence nothing could be proved.

这样的人，一旦破城，自然不会殉节——
Naturally, such a man would not sacrifice his life when the city fell.

有人说他还是开城门放长毛进城的人；
Some even said he had opened the gates to the rebels.

这一点也无实据，
That too was unsubstantiated.

不过李秀成进城的第二天他就受了伪职，却是丝毫不假。
What was beyond doubt was that, on the second day after Li Xiucheng entered the city, Yuan accepted office under the rebels.

他受的伪职，名为『钱塘监军』，而干的差使却是『老本行』，替长毛备办军需。
His new title was Military Supervisor of Qiantang, but the work was his old occupation: procuring military supplies.

长毛此时最迫切需要的是船，
What the rebels most urgently needed was boats.

因为一方面掳掠而得的大批珠宝细软、古董字画，要运到『天京』，进献天王；
On the one hand, their plundered jewels, valuables, antiques, paintings, and calligraphy had to be carried to the Heavenly Capital as offerings to the Heavenly King.

一方面要从包埠赶粮食到杭州，
On the other, grain had to be brought quickly into Hangzhou from the outlying ports.

所以袁忠清摔掉翎领，脱去补挂，换上红绸棉袄，用一块黄绸子裹领，打扮得跟长毛一样，
Yuan discarded his official hat and feather, took off his rank-badged coat, and dressed like a rebel in a red silk padded jacket with yellow silk wrapped around his head.

每天高举李秀成的令箭在江干封船。
Every day he went down to the river, brandishing Li’s command token, to requisition boats.

城外难民无数，
Countless refugees were outside the city.

有姿色的妇女，遇到好色如命的袁忠清，就难保清白了。
Any attractive woman who encountered the insatiably lustful Yuan was in danger of assault.


『这个王八蛋！』刘不才愤愤地说，
“That bastard!” Liu said angrily.

『居然亲自到胡家，跟留守在那里的人说∶胡某人领了几万银子的公款，到上海去买米，
“He actually went to the Hu residence himself and told the people left to look after it: ‘Hu took several tens of thousands of taels in public money to Shanghai to buy rice.

怎么不回来？
Why has he not returned?

你们带信给他，应该有多少米，赶快运到杭州来。
Send him word to bring the amount of rice he owes to Hangzhou at once.

不然，有他的罪受！
Otherwise he will suffer for it!’

你们想想看，这不是有意找麻烦？』
Tell me, is that not a deliberate attempt to make trouble?”

这确是个麻烦。
It certainly was trouble.

照袁忠清这样卑污的人品，毒辣的手段，如果不早作铺排；说不定他就会打听到胡家眷属存身之处，凌辱老少妇孺，
With Yuan’s degraded character and vicious methods, unless precautions were taken promptly he might discover where the family was hiding and ill-treat the old people, women, and children.

岂不可忧？
The danger was alarming.

『顶教人担心的是，这是王八蛋成事不足，败事有余；
“What worries me most is that the bastard can ruin things more easily than he can achieve them.

如果说他拿胡家大小弄了进去，托到人情，照数释放，倒也还不要紧。
If he arrested the family and could be persuaded through connections to release them all, that would be one thing.

就怕他跟长毛一说，人是抓进去了；要放，他可作不了主。
But I fear he may tell the rebels about them and have them arrested, then have no authority to get them freed.

这一来，要想走条路子，只怕比登天还难。』
Once that happened, finding a way out might be harder than climbing to Heaven.”

刘不才这番话，加上难得出现的沉重的脸色，使得七姑奶奶忧心忡忡，
Liu’s words, reinforced by an unusually grave expression, filled the Seventh Lady with anxiety.

也失去了平时惯有爽朗明快的词色。
Her usual cheerful decisiveness deserted her.

古应春当然也相当担心；
Gu was worried too, naturally.

但他一向深沉冷静，一半也是受了胡雪岩的濡染，
But he had always been thoughtful and calm, partly through Hu’s influence.

总觉得凡事只要不怕难，自然就不难。
He believed that difficulties became less formidable once one ceased to fear them.

眼前的难题，不止这一端；
This was not the only problem before them.

要说分出缓急，远在杭州的事，
In deciding what was urgent, they must remember that Hangzhou was far away.

如果已生不测，急也无用。
If disaster had already occurred, anxiety would achieve nothing.

倘或根本不会有何危险，则病不急而乱投医，反倒是自速其祸。
If there was in fact no danger, frantic attempts to find a remedy might only hasten calamity.

然而这番道理说给刘不才听，或许他能接受；
Liu might have accepted this reasoning.

在七姑奶奶却是怎么样也听不进去的。
The Seventh Lady certainly would not.

因而他只有大包大揽地先一肩担承了下来，作为安慰妻子的手段。
To reassure his wife, Gu therefore took the whole burden on himself.


『不要紧！不要紧！』他拍一拍胸说，
“It will be all right,” he said, tapping his chest.

『我有办法；我有路子，
“I have ways and contacts.

我今天就去办。
I shall attend to it today.

眼前有件事，先要定个主意。』
First we must decide something else.”

这件事就是要将杭州的消息，告诉胡雪岩。
That was how to tell Hu the news from Hangzhou.

家小陷贼，至交殒命，是他不堪承受的两大伤心之事；
His family at the rebels’ mercy and his closest friend dead—these were two griefs he could scarcely bear.

可是老母健在，合家无恙，这个喜讯，也足以抵消得过，
Yet the news that his mother was alive and the whole family safe might counterbalance them.

所以古应春赞成由刘不才去跟他面谈。
Gu therefore favoured letting Liu speak to him in person.

七姑奶奶表示同意，刘不才当然依从，
The Seventh Lady agreed, and Liu naturally complied.

不过；他要求先去洗个澡——这是他多少天来，梦寐以思的一种欲望。
First, however, he wanted a bath, something he had longed for day after day.

『那容易。』
“That is easily arranged.”

七姑奶奶对古应春说∶『你先陪刘三叔到澡塘子去；
She turned to Gu. “Take Third Uncle Liu to the bathhouse.

我回家去收拾间屋子出来。』
I shall go home and have a room prepared.”

『不必，不必！七姐，』刘不才说，
“No need, Sister Seven.

『我还是住客栈，
I would rather stay at an inn.

比较自由些。』
It gives me more freedom.”

『刘三叔喜欢自由自在，
“He likes to come and go as he pleases.

你就让他去。』古应春附和着；
Let him do so,” Gu agreed.

他是另有用意，想到或许有什么不便当着胡雪岩说的话，跟刘不才在客栈里接头，比较方便些。
He had another reason: if there were matters that could not be discussed in front of Hu, an inn would be a convenient place to meet Liu privately.


在新辟的『石路』上，买好从里到外，从头到脚的全套衣衫鞋帽；
On the newly laid-out Stone Road they bought a complete set of clothes, shoes, and headgear, from the innermost layer to the outermost.

照道理说，刘不才脱下来的那身既破且脏的旧衣服，可以丢进垃圾箱里去了。
The ragged, filthy clothes Liu took off should by rights have gone straight into the rubbish.

但是，他却要留着。
But he insisted on keeping them.

『从前，我真正是不知稼穑之艰难，
“Before this, I never truly understood how hard it is to earn the necessities of life.

虽然也有落魄，
I have been down on my luck.

混到吃了中饭不知夜饭在哪里的日子也有过，
There were days when, after eating lunch, I had no idea where supper would come from.

可是我从来不愁，从没有想过有了钱要省俭些用。
But I never worried, and it never occurred to me to save when I had money.

经过这一场灾难，我变过了。』刘不才说，
This calamity has changed me.

『这身衣服我要留起来，当作「传家之宝」。
I shall keep these clothes as a family treasure.

这不是说笑话，
I am not joking.

我要子孙晓得，他们的祖宗吃过这样子的苦头！』
I want my descendants to know that their ancestor suffered like this.”

古应春相当惊异，
Gu was surprised.

『刘三叔，』他说，你有这样子的想法，我倒没有想到。
“Third Uncle Liu, I never expected you to think in that way.”

『』我也是受了点刺激；
“Something else shook me too.

想想一个人真要争气。『刘不才说，』
A man must have the will to prove himself.

从天竺进城，伤心惨目，自不必说，
The sights on the road from Tianzhu into the city were heartbreaking; there is no need to describe them.

不过什么东西可怕，都不如人心可怕。
But nothing is as frightening as the human heart.

雪岩在地方上，总算也很出过一番力的，
Xueyan did a great deal for the place.

哪知道现在说他好的，十个之中没有一个。
Yet now not one person in ten has a good word for him.

我实在不大服气。
I cannot accept it.

如果雪岩真的垮了下来，或者杭州也真的回不去了，那就冤屈一辈子，坏名誉也不能洗刷。
If he really falls, or can never return to Hangzhou, he will be wronged for the rest of his life and never clear his name.

到有一天光复，雪岩依旧象从前那样神气，回到杭州，我倒要看看那班人又是怎么个说法？
One day, when the city is recovered and he returns as influential as before, I should like to hear what those people have to say.”

『这是一番牢骚，古应春颇有异样的感觉。
This complaint struck Gu as unusual.

从他认识刘不才以来，就难得听他发牢骚；
In all the time he had known Liu, he had seldom heard him grumble.

偶尔那么一两次，也总是出以冷隽嘲弄的口吻，
On the rare occasions when he did, it was with detached, sardonic humour.

象这样很认真的愤激之词，还是第一次听到。
This was the first time Gu had heard such earnest indignation.

再将他话中的意思，好好咀嚼了一会，终于辨出一点味道来了∶『刘三叔，』他试探着问，『你好象还有什么话，藏在肚子里似的。』
Thinking over his words, he began to sense something behind them. “Third Uncle Liu, you seem to be keeping something back.”

『刘不才倏然抬眼，怔怔地望着古应春，
Liu looked up sharply and stared at him.

好半晌才深深点头，』
After a long pause, he nodded deeply.

应春兄，你猜对了。
“You have guessed correctly, Brother Yingchun.

我是还有几句话，倒真应该跟你谈才是。
There are things I ought to discuss with you.

雪岩的处境很不利——。『听他谈了下去，才知道胡雪岩竟成众矢之的。
Xueyan’s position is very unfavourable—” As Liu continued, Gu learned that Hu had become the target of attacks from every direction.

有人说他借购米为名，骗走了藩库的一笔公款，为数可观；
Some said he had used the purchase of rice as a pretext to abscond with a substantial sum from the provincial treasury.

有人说王有龄的宦囊所识，都由胡雪岩替他营运，如今死无对证，已遭吞没。
Others alleged that Wang’s savings from office had all been invested through Hu, who, now that Wang was dead and could not testify, had appropriated them.

此外还有人说他如何假公济私；如何虚有善名；
There were further accusations that he had used public business for private profit and that his reputation for benevolence was false.

将他形容成一个百分之百的奸恶小人。
They portrayed him as a thoroughly unscrupulous villain.


『这都是平时妒嫉雪岩的人，或者在王雪公手里吃过亏的迁怒到他头上。
“These are people who were always jealous of him, or who suffered at Governor Wang’s hands and are taking their resentment out on him.

疯狗乱咬，避开就是；
When mad dogs snap, keep out of their way.

本来可以不必理他们，
He could have ignored them.

哪知长毛也看中了雪岩，这就麻烦了。』
But now the rebels have taken an interest in him too, and that makes trouble.”

越说越奇，如何长毛又看中胡雪岩？
Why should the rebels want Hu?

古应春大感不解；不过一说破也就无足为奇了；
Gu was greatly puzzled, though the explanation made it understandable enough.

『雪岩向来喜欢出头做好事，
“Xueyan always liked taking the lead in good works.

我们凭良心说，一半他热心好热闹；一半也是咕名钓誉。
Let us be honest: part of it was enthusiasm and a liking for lively affairs; part was a desire for reputation.

李秀成打听到了，想找雪岩出来替他办善后。
Li Xiucheng heard about him and wants him to come forward and help restore order after the fighting.

这一来就越发遭忌；
That makes the jealousy worse.

原来有批人在搞，
There is already a group exploiting the situation.

如果雪岩一出面，就没得那批人好搞的，
If Xueyan appears, their opportunities will be gone.

所以第一步由袁忠清那样的王八蛋来恐吓；
First they sent a bastard like Yuan to threaten him.

这也还罢了，
That was bad enough.

第二步手段真毒辣了。
Their next move is vicious.

据说，那批人在筹划鼓动京官要告雪岩，说他骗走浙江购米的公款，贻误军需民食，
They are said to be planning to stir up officials in the capital to accuse him of taking Zhejiang’s public rice-purchasing funds and thereby obstructing supplies for the army and the people.

请朝廷降旨查办。』
They want an imperial order for his investigation.”

听到这里，古应春大惊失色，
Gu changed colour.

『这，从何说起？
“How could they say such a thing?

不是要害他家破亡吗？』
They mean to destroy his family and his life!”

他大摇其头，
He shook his head.

『不过我又不懂，
“But I do not understand.

果然降旨查办，逼得小爷叔在上海存身不住，只好投到长毛那里，
If an imperial investigation makes it impossible for Little Uncle to remain in Shanghai, he will have no choice but to turn to the rebels.

于他们又有何好处？』
How would that benefit them?”

『不要忙，还有话。』刘不才说，
“There is more.

『他们又放出风声来了，说是胡雪岩不回杭州便罢，一回杭州，要鸣锣聚众，跟他好好算帐。』
They have also spread word that, if he returns to Hangzhou, they will beat gongs, summon a crowd, and settle accounts with him.”

『算什么帐？』
“What accounts?”

『哪晓得他们算什么帐？
“Who knows?

这句话毒在「鸣锣聚众」四个字上头；
The poison lies in summoning a crowd.

真的搞成那样的局面，雪岩就变成过街老鼠了，人人喊打！』
Once they create a scene like that, he will be a rat crossing the street, with everyone shouting to strike him.”

古应春敲敲额角，『刘三叔，』他紧皱着眉着∶『你的话拿我搞糊涂了，
Gu tapped his temple and frowned. “You have confused me.

一方面不准他回去；一方面又逼得他在上海不能住，非投长毛不可，
They forbid him to return, yet they want to make Shanghai uninhabitable for him and force him to join the rebels.

那末他们到底要怎么办呢？
What exactly do they want?

莫非真要逼人上吊，
Surely they cannot expect to drive him to hang himself.

只怕没有那样容易吧？』
That would not be so easy.”


『当然。
“Of course not.

雪岩要让他们逼得走投无路，还能成为胡雪岩？
If he let them drive him into a corner, would he still be Hu Xueyan?

他们也知道这是办不到的；
They know it cannot be done.

目的是想逼出雪岩一句话；你们饶了我，我决不会来坏你们的事。
They want to force one promise out of him: ‘Leave me alone, and I shall never interfere with your affairs.’

应春兄，你想雪岩肯不肯说这句话？』
Do you think he will say it?”

『不肯也得肯，
“Whether he wishes to or not, he must.

一家老少，关系太重了。』
His whole family is at stake.”

『话是不错。
“True.

但是另外又有一层难处。』
But there is another difficulty.”

这层难处是个不解的结，
That difficulty was a knot that could not be untied.

李秀成的一个得力部下，实际上掌握浙江全省政务的陈炳文，因为善后工作棘手，一定要胡雪岩出头来办事。
Chen Bingwen, an able subordinate of Li’s who in practice controlled civil affairs throughout Zhejiang, found the work of restoring order so troublesome that he was determined to enlist Hu.

据说已经找到阜康钱庄的档手，嘱咐他转言。
He was said to have found a senior clerk at Fukang Bank and told him to carry the message.

照刘不才判断，也就在这两三天之内，会到上海。
Liu reckoned that the man would arrive in Shanghai within two or three days.

『照这样说，是瞒不住我这位小爷叔的了。』古应春觉得情势棘手，
“Then we cannot keep it from Little Uncle,” Gu said, feeling how difficult the situation was.

问刘不才说∶『你是身历其境的人，这几天总也想过，
“You have seen it for yourself and must have thought about it these past few days.

有什么解救之方？』
Is there any way out?”

『我当然想过。
“Of course I have thought about it.

要保全家老小，只有一条路∶不过——。』刘不才摇摇头说，
There is only one way to protect the whole family. But—” Liu shook his head.

『说出来你不会赞成。』
“You will not approve.”

『说说何妨。』
“Tell me anyway.”

『事情明摆在那里，
“It is plain enough.

只有一个字∶去！
There is only one word for it: go.

说老实话，雪岩真的回杭州去了，那班人拿他又有什么办法？』
Frankly, if Xueyan really returned to Hangzhou, what could those people do to him?”


古应春大不以为然。
Gu strongly disagreed.

但因刘不才言之在先，料他不会赞成；他倒不便说什么责备的话了。
But Liu had already anticipated his disapproval, which made it difficult to reproach him.

『刘三叔，』他慢吞吞地说∶『眼前的急难要应付，将来的日子也不能不想一想。
“Third Uncle Liu,” he said slowly, “we must meet the immediate danger, but we must also think about the years ahead.

我看，这件事，只有让小爷叔自己去定主意了。』
I believe Little Uncle must decide this himself.”

带来了全家无恙的喜讯，也就等于带来了王有龄殉难的噩耗；
Bringing news that the whole family was safe also meant bringing confirmation of Wang’s death.

刘不才不提王有龄，真所谓『尽在不言中』，
Liu did not mention Wang; the silence said everything.

胡雪岩双泪交流，但哀痛还能承受得住，
Tears ran down Hu’s face, but the grief was bearable.

因为王有龄这样的下场，原在意中，
This end had long been expected.

一个多月前，钱塘江中一拜，遥别也就是永诀；
More than a month earlier, his bow from the boat on the Qiantang River had been a final farewell.

最伤心的时刻已经过去了。
The sharpest moment of sorrow was already past.

王有龄的遗属呢？
What of Wang’s surviving family?

他想问，却又怕问出来一片悲惨的情形，有些不敢开口。
He wanted to ask, but feared hearing something so tragic that he hesitated to speak.

而七姑奶奶则是有意要谈能教人宽心的事，
The Seventh Lady, meanwhile, deliberately steered the conversation towards reassurance.

特意将胡家从老太太起，一个个挨次问到；这就越发没有机会让胡雪岩开口了。
Beginning with Hu’s mother, she asked about every member of the family in turn, giving him still less opportunity to ask.

谈到吃晚饭，
They talked until supper.

正好张医生回来，引见过后，同桌共饮；
Dr Zhang returned just then, and after introductions they all sat down to eat and drink.

他们两人算是开药店的开行，彼此都别有亲切之感，
He and Liu were in the same line of business, both having connections with medicine shops, which gave them an immediate sense of fellowship.

所以谈得很投机。
They talked readily.

饭后，古应春特为又请张医生替胡雪岩去诊察；
After the meal, Gu specially asked the doctor to examine Hu again.

也许是因为有了喜讯的缘故，神旺气健，比上午诊脉时又有了进境。
Perhaps because of the good news, his spirits and vitality were stronger; his condition had improved even since the morning’s examination.


『还有件很伤脑筋的事要跟病人谈。』古应春悄悄问张医生，
“There is another very troubling matter we must discuss with him,” Gu asked the doctor quietly.

『不知道对他的病势相宜不相宜？』
“Would that be bad for his condition?”

『伤脑筋的事，没有对病人相宜的。
“Nothing troubling is good for a patient.

不过，他的为人与众不同，
But he is an unusual man.

经得起刺激，也就不要紧了。』
If he can bear the shock, it need not harm him.”

既然如此，古应春便不再瞒——
Gu therefore decided to conceal it no longer—from Hu, at least.

要瞒住的倒是他妻子；
It was his wife who must not hear.

所以等七姑奶奶回卧房去看孩子时，他才跟刘不才将杭州对胡雪岩种种不利的情形，很委婉地，但也很详细地说了出来。
Once she had gone to the bedroom to see the child, he and Liu explained the threats from Hangzhou, gently but in full detail.

胡雪岩很沉着，脸色当然也相当沉重。
Hu remained composed, though his face was grave.

听完，叹口气∶『乱世会坏心术。
When they had finished, he sighed. “Disorder corrupts men’s hearts.

也难怪，
It is hardly surprising.

这个时候哪个要讲道理，讲义气，只有自己吃亏。
In times like these, a man who insists on reason and loyalty is liable to suffer for it.

不过，还可以讲利害。』
But interests and consequences can still be discussed.”

听这口气，胡雪岩似乎已有办法，
His tone suggested that he already saw a solution.

古应春随即问道∶『小爷叔，事不宜迟，
Gu asked at once, “Little Uncle, there is no time to lose.

不管定的什么主意，要做得快！』
Whatever you decide, it must be done quickly.”

『不要紧，
“No hurry.

「尽慢不动气」！』
Take it slowly and keep your temper!”

到这时候，胡雪岩居然还有心思说这样轻松的俏皮话，古应春倒有点不大服气了，
That Hu could still make so light a remark at such a moment irritated Gu a little.

『看样子，小爷叔倒真是不在乎！』他微带不满地说，
“You really do not seem concerned,” he said with mild reproach.

『莫非真的有什么神机妙算？』
“Have you some miraculous strategy?”

『不是啥神机妙算！
“Nothing miraculous.

事情摆明在那里，
It is quite plain.

他们既然叫我钱庄里的人来传话；当然要等有了回信，是好是歹，再作道理。
Since they have sent a man from my bank with a message, naturally they must wait for a reply before deciding what to do next.

现在人还没有到，
The man has not even arrived.

急什么？』
Why the panic?”

听得这一说，古应春实在不能不佩服；
Gu could not help admiring him.

原是极浅的道理，只为方寸一乱，看不真切。
The reasoning was simple; his own agitation had prevented him from seeing it.

这一点功夫，说来容易，临事却不易做到；
Such composure was easy to praise but difficult to maintain when matters came to a crisis.

正就是胡雪岩过人的长处。
It was precisely where Hu excelled.


『那好！』
“Very well!”

古应春笑道，
Gu smiled.

『听小爷叔一说破，我也放心了。
“Now that you have explained it, I feel easier.

就慢慢商量吧。』
We can discuss it calmly.”

急人之急的义气，都在他这一张一弛的神态中表露无遗。
His sudden tension and release revealed how deeply he shared his friend’s distress.

这在胡雪岩是个极大的安慰；也激起了更多的信心，
This greatly comforted Hu and gave him fresh confidence.

因而语气就越发从容了。
He spoke more calmly still.

『那个袁忠清，他的五脏六腑，我都看得见；
“As for Yuan Zhongqing, I can see right through him.

他是「泥菩萨过江，自身难保」，
He is a clay Bodhisattva crossing a river—hard pressed to save himself.

绝不敢多事。
He will not dare stir up too much trouble.

别的人呢，都要仔细想一想，
The others must think carefully too.

如果真的跟我家眷为难，也知道我不是好惹的人。』
If they really make difficulties for my family, they know I am not a man to be trifled with.

胡雪岩说∶『他们不会逼我的！
They will not push me too far.

逼急了我，于他们没有好处∶第一，
It would do them no good.

我可以回杭州，
First, I could return to Hangzhou.

长毛要我，就会听我的话，
The rebels want me and would listen to me.

他们自己要想想，斗得过我，斗不过我。
Those people must consider whether they could prevail against me.

第二，如果我不回杭州；他们总也有亲人至戚在上海，
Second, if I stay here, they have relatives and close connections in Shanghai.

防我要报复。
They must fear retaliation.

第三——那就不必去说它了；
Third—but there is no need to speak of that.

是将来的话。』
It concerns the future.”

古应春却偏要打听∶『将来怎么样？』
Gu nevertheless pressed him. “What about the future?”

『将来，总有见面的日子，
“We are bound to meet again someday.

要留个余地。
They should leave themselves room to do so.

为人不可太绝；
One must not carry things to extremes.

就拿眼前来说，现在大家都说我如何如何不好，
Even now, everyone is saying how bad I am.

如果他们为难我的家眷，就变成他们不对了。
But if they harm my family, they will put themselves in the wrong.

有理变成无理，
They will turn a seemingly justified position into an unjustifiable one.

稍为聪明的人，不肯做这样的事。』
Anyone with a little sense will avoid that.”

这一点古应春不能同意，
Gu could not agree with the last argument.

留个相见余地的话，也未免太迂，
Leaving room for future encounters seemed excessively scrupulous.

不过仅是前两点的理由也尽够了。
The first two reasons, however, were quite enough.

古应春便催着他说∶『小爷叔，你说你的办法！』
“Tell us your plan, Little Uncle.”


『我的办法是做一笔交易。
“My plan is to make a bargain.

他们不愿意我回杭州，可以；
If they do not want me back in Hangzhou, very well.

我不但不跟他们去争，
I shall not compete with them.

而且要放点交情给他们，有朝一日，官军光复杭州，我自有保护他们的办法。
I shall even do them a favour: when the government troops recover the city, I shall find a way to protect them.

不过，眼前他们要替我想办法；拿我的家眷送出杭州。』
In return, they must help me now and get my family out of Hangzhou.”

这样的一笔交易是不是做得成？
Could such a bargain really be made?

古应春颇为怀疑；
Gu was doubtful.

因而默然不语，只望着刘不才，想听他的意见。
He said nothing, merely looking at Liu to hear what he thought.



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第五章（本章第3部分，共3部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


刘不才却对他的话大感兴趣，
Liu, however, was greatly interested.

『这倒是个办法。』他说，
“That might work,” he said.

『照我看，那批人又想吃羊肉，又怕羊骚臭；
“As I see it, they want to eat the mutton without enduring its smell.

怕将来官军光复了，跟他们算帐。
They are afraid that, once the government troops recover the city, they will be called to account.

如果真的有保护他们的把握，那批人肯照我们的办法做的。
If you really can protect them, they will be willing to do as we ask.

不过，空口说白话可不行。』
But mere words will not suffice.”

『现在当然只有空口说白话；
“For the moment, words are all we have.

话要动听，能够做得到，他们自然会相信。』
If the offer appeals to them and is something we can fulfil, they will believe it.”

胡雪岩停了一下说∶『三叔，这件事只有你辛苦，再去一趟∶因为别人去说，他们不大容易相信。』
Hu paused. “Third Uncle, I must trouble you to make another journey. They would find it harder to believe anyone else.”

『这还用说？自然是我去。
“Of course I shall go.

你说，跟他们怎么个讲法。』
What shall I say to them?”

『当然要吹点牛。』
“A little boasting will be necessary.”

胡雪岩停了下来∶『等我好好想一想。』
Hu broke off. “Let me think it over properly.”

这一想想了好多时候，或者是暂且丢开此事；
He thought for a long time—or perhaps put the matter aside for the moment.

总而言之，不见他再谈起，
At any rate, he said no more about it.

尽自问着杭州的情形，琐琐屑屑，无不关怀。
Instead he asked about Hangzhou, showing concern for every trifling detail.

雪岩的交游甚广，但问起熟人，不是殉难，就是下落不明，
He had a wide acquaintance, but of the people he asked after, most had died in the calamity or vanished without trace.

存者十不得一。
Fewer than one in ten were known to have survived.

连不相干的古应春，都听得凄怆不止。
Even Gu, who had no personal connection with them, listened in deep distress.


到得十点多种，刘不才一路车船劳顿，又是说话没有停过，再好的精神也支持不住了。
After ten o’clock, the strain of the journey by land and water, followed by so much uninterrupted talking, had exhausted even Liu’s vigorous constitution.

古应春例劝他不必再住客栈，先好好睡一觉再说；
Gu urged him to forget about returning to the inn and get a good night’s rest first.

刘不才依从，
Liu agreed.

由古家的丫头侍候着，上床休息。
A maid of the household attended to him, and he went to bed.


胡雪岩的精神却还很好，
Hu was still full of energy.

『老古，』他招招手让古应春坐在床前，低声说道∶『我对人不用不光明的手段，
“Gu,” he said, beckoning his friend to sit by the bed, “I do not use underhand methods against people.

这一次要做它一次一百零一回的买卖，
This time I must make an exception.

全家大小在那班王八蛋手里，不能不防他们一着。
My whole family is in the hands of those bastards; I cannot afford to leave myself unprotected.

我现在要埋一条药线在那里；
I intend to lay a fuse.

好便好，
If all goes well, well and good.

搞得不好，我点上药线轰他娘的，教他们也不得安逸。
If it does not, I shall light it and blast the devils out of their comfort.

话说明了，你心里也有数了；
Now that I have explained, you know what is in my mind.

要劳你的神，替我做一件公事。』
I need you to take some trouble over an official dispatch for me.”

他是『话说明了』，古应春却如丈二金刚摸不着头脑，
He might consider himself to have explained, but Gu was utterly bewildered.

『小爷叔，』他皱着眉说，『我还莫名其妙；
“Little Uncle,” he said, frowning, “I still have no idea what you mean.

什么药线，
What fuse?

什么公事？』
What official dispatch?”


『公事就是药线，药线就是公事。』胡雪岩说∶『这件公事，是以我浙江候补道兼团练局委员，奉王抚台委派，筹划浙江军需民食，以及地方赈济事宜的身分，报给闽浙总督衙门庆制军。
“The dispatch is the fuse, and the fuse is the dispatch,” Hu replied. “It is to be addressed to Governor-General Qing at the office of the governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang. I shall write in my capacity as a circuit intendant awaiting appointment in Zhejiang and a member of the militia bureau, commissioned by Governor Wang to arrange military supplies, food for the people, and local relief.

公事上要说明，王雪公生前就顾虑援兵不到，杭州恐怕保不住，
Begin by explaining that, before his death, Mr Xuexuan feared that reinforcements might not arrive and Hangzhou might prove impossible to hold.

特意嘱咐我，他是决定城亡人亡，一死报答朝廷；但是杭州的百姓，不可不顾，
He expressly charged me with this duty: he himself was determined to die with the city and repay the court with his life, but the people of Hangzhou must not be abandoned.

因为我不是地方官，并无守土之责，
I held no local administrative post and bore no responsibility for defending the territory.

所以，万一杭州沦陷，必得顾念家乡，想办法保护地方百姓。
Therefore, should Hangzhou fall, I must remember my native place and find ways of protecting its people.

这是第一段。』
That is the first section.”

古应春很仔细地听着，已理会得胡雪岩入手的意思，
Gu listened closely and began to understand how Hu meant to proceed.

并即说道∶『第二段当然是叙你运粮到杭州，不能进城的情形？』
“The second section will presumably describe your attempt to bring rice to Hangzhou and your inability to enter the city?”

『对！
“Exactly.

不过转道宁波这一层不必提。』
But there is no need to mention the diversion to Ningbo.”

胡雪岩略停一下又说，
Hu paused briefly.

『现在要叙顶要紧的第三段，
“Now comes the third and most important section.

要这样说法∶我因为人在上海，不能回杭州，已经派人跟某某人、某某人联络，请他们保护地方百姓，并且暗中布置，以便官军一到，可以相机策应。
It must say this: since I am in Shanghai and cannot return to Hangzhou, I have sent someone to contact such-and-such persons, asking them to protect the inhabitants and secretly prepare to assist the government troops when a favourable opportunity arises upon their arrival.

这批人都是地方公正士绅，秉心忠义，
These men are all upright local gentlemen, loyal at heart.

目前身陷城中，不由自主；
At present they are trapped in the city and cannot act freely.

将来收复杭州，不但不能论他们在长毛那里干过什么职司，
When Hangzhou is recovered, whatever offices they may have held under the rebels must not be counted against them.

而且要大大地奖励他们。』
On the contrary, they should be generously rewarded.”

『啊，啊！』
“Ah!”

古应春深深点头，
Gu nodded deeply.

『我懂了，我懂了，
“I understand.

这就是替他们的将来留个退步。』
You are leaving them a way out for the future.”


『对了。
“Precisely.

这道公事要等庆制军的批示，他人在福州，一时办不到；
We ought to wait for Governor-General Qing’s endorsement, but he is in Fuzhou and that cannot be obtained quickly.

所以要来个变通办法，
So we must improvise.

一方面呈报庆制军，一方面请江苏巡抚衙门代咨闽浙总督衙门，同时给我个复文，拿我的原文都叙在里头，
While submitting the report to him, I shall also ask the governor of Jiangsu to forward an official communication to his office and give me a reply reciting my original report in full.

我好给他们看。』
I can then show it to those men.”

『嗯、嗯！』古应春想了一下，
Gu reflected.

记起一句话∶『那么什么叫「公事就是药线」呢？』
“But what did you mean when you said the dispatch was the fuse?”

『这你还不懂？』
“Do you still not see?

胡雪岩提醒他说∶『你先从相机策应官军这句话上去想，就懂了。』
Think about the passage concerning assistance to the government troops.”

真所谓『光棍一点就透』，古应春恍然大悟，
A hint was enough for a man as shrewd as Gu.

如果那批人不肯就范，甚至真个不利于胡家眷属；胡雪岩就可用这件公事作为报复，
If those people refused to cooperate, or actually harmed Hu’s family, Hu could retaliate with this very dispatch.

向长毛告密，说这班人勾结清军，江苏巡抚衙门的回文，便是铁证。
He could inform the rebels that the men were in league with the Qing forces, producing the reply from the governor of Jiangsu as conclusive evidence.

那一来，后果就可想而知了。
The consequences were easy to imagine.

这一着实在狠。
It was a ruthless move.

但原是为了报复，甚至可以作为防卫；
But it was intended for retaliation, and might serve as protection in itself.

如果那批人了解到这道公事是是一根一点便可轰发火药，炸得粉身碎骨的药线，自然不敢轻举妄动。
If the men understood that the dispatch was a fuse which, once lit, could blow them to pieces, they would not dare act rashly.

『小爷叔！』古应春赞叹着说『真正「死棋肚子里出仙着」；
“Little Uncle,” Gu exclaimed in admiration, “you have found a brilliant move in a position that looked completely lost!

这一着，亏你怎么想出来的？』
How did you think of it?”


『也不是我发明的。
“I did not invent it.

我不过拿人家用过的办法，变通一下子。
I have merely adapted a method used before.

说起来，还要谢谢王雪公，
In fact, I owe Mr Xuexuan my thanks.

他讲过一个故事给我听；这个故事出在他们家乡，
He once told me a story from his own province.

康熙年间有位李中堂，据说在福建名气大得很，
In the Kangxi reign there was a Minister Li, a very famous man in Fujian, apparently.

他的同年陈翰林跟他有段生死不解的仇——。』
A fellow graduate of his, Hanlin Academician Chen, became his sworn enemy.”

王有龄告诉胡雪岩的故事如此∶这位李中堂是福建安溪人，他的同年陈翰林是福州人。
This was the story Wang had told him. Minister Li came from Anxi in Fujian; Academician Chen came from Fuzhou.

这年翰林散馆，两个人请假结伴回乡。
When their period of training at the Hanlin Academy ended, the two took leave and travelled home together.

不久就有三藩之乱，
Not long afterwards came the Revolt of the Three Feudatories.

耿精忠响应吴三桂，在福州也叛变了，开府设官，
Geng Jingzhong responded to Wu Sangui’s call and rebelled in Fuzhou, establishing an administration and appointing officials.

陈翰林被迫受了伪职。
Chen was compelled to accept an office under him.

李中堂见猎心喜，也想到福州讨个一官半职。
Li saw the opportunity with keen interest and also wanted to seek a post in Fuzhou.

而陈翰林却看出耿精忠恐怕不成气候，便劝李中堂不必如此。
Chen, however, doubted that Geng’s venture would succeed and advised him against it.

而且两个人闭门密谈，定下一计，
The two then closeted themselves together and devised a plan.

由李中堂写下一道密疏，指陈方略，请朝廷速派大兵入闽。
Li would write a secret memorial setting out a strategy and urging the court to send a large army into Fujian at once.

这道密疏封在蜡丸之中，
The memorial was sealed in a pellet of wax.

由李家派人取道江西入京，请同乡代为奏达御前。
A messenger from Li’s household carried it through Jiangxi to the capital, where a fellow provincial was asked to submit it to the emperor.


『这是「刀切豆腐两面光」的打算。』胡雪岩说∶『李中堂与陈翰林约定，如果朝廷大兵到福建，耿精忠垮台，李中堂当然就是大大的功臣，
“They meant to come out well whichever side won,” Hu continued. “Li and Chen agreed that, if the imperial troops entered Fujian and Geng fell, Li would of course have performed a great service.

那时候他就可以替陈翰林洗刷，说他投贼完全是为了要打探机密，策应官军——。』『啊、啊，妙！
He could then clear Chen’s name, explaining that Chen had joined the rebels solely to discover their secrets and assist the government forces—” “Ah, excellent!

如果耿精忠成了功，李中堂这首密疏，根本没有人知道；
And if Geng succeeded, no one would know of Li’s secret memorial.

陈翰林依旧可以保荐他成为新贵。
Chen could still recommend him for a fine position under the new regime.

是不是这样的打算？』
Was that the plan?”

『一点不错。』
“Exactly.”

『那末后来呢？』古应春很感兴趣地问∶『怎么说是成了生死不解的冤家？』
“What happened afterwards, then?” Gu asked with interest. “How did they become mortal enemies?”

『就为李中堂不是东西，出卖朋友。
“Because Li was a scoundrel who betrayed his friend.

耿精忠垮台，朝廷收复福建，要办叛逆的罪；
Geng fell, the court recovered Fujian, and the rebels were to be punished.

李中堂自己得意了，竟不替他洗刷。害得陈翰林充军到关外。』
Li, secure in his own success, did nothing to clear Chen, who was sent into military exile beyond the pass.”

胡雪岩说，『我现在仿照他们的办法，
Hu went on, “I am now borrowing their method.

但愿那批人很识相，
I only hope those people have the sense to cooperate.

我替他们留下的这条洗刷的路子，将来一定有用。』
The means of clearing their names that I am providing will certainly be useful to them one day.”

『对！小爷叔的意思，我完全懂了；
“I understand your intentions completely, Little Uncle.

这道公事我连夜替你预备起来。』
I shall prepare the dispatch for you tonight.”


『不忙。
“There is no hurry.

明天动笔也不迟。』胡雪岩说，
Tomorrow will be soon enough,” Hu said.

『我还有件事要先跟你商量。』
“There is something else I must discuss with you first.”

这件事是为王有龄身后打算，自不外名利两字。
This concerned provision for Wang after his death: his reputation and his property.

王有龄的宦囊虽不太丰，却决不能说是一清如水∶『三年清知府，十万雪花银』，
His savings from office were not exceptionally large, but neither could it be said that he had taken nothing. As the saying went, even an honest prefect might save a hundred thousand taels in three years.

许多收入象征粮的『羡余』；漕粮折实，碎角子熔铸为五十两银子一个的『官宝』，照例要加收的『火耗』，
Officials had many sources of income, including surpluses from grain taxation and the customary allowance for wastage when small pieces of silver, collected in commutation of tribute grain, were melted down into official ingots weighing fifty taels each.

在雍正年间就已『化暗为明』，明定为地方官的『养廉银』。
In the Yongzheng reign, such receipts had been brought into the open and formally designated as allowances for the maintenance of integrity.

此外『三节两寿』——过年、端午、中秋三节；本人及太太的两个生日，
There were also gifts at the New Year, the Dragon Boat Festival, and the Mid-Autumn Festival, and on the birthdays of the official and his wife.

属员必有馈敬，而且数目亦大致有定规，
Subordinates invariably sent them, in amounts largely fixed by custom.

这都是朝廷所许的收入。
These were all forms of income permitted by the court.


王有龄的积蓄，当然是交给胡雪岩营运；
Wang’s savings had naturally been entrusted to Hu for investment.

他现在要跟古应春商议的，就因为经手的款子，要有个交代。
What Hu now needed to discuss was how to account for the money that had passed through his hands.

『他们说王雪公有钱在我手里，
“They say I have Mr Xuexuan’s money.

这是当然的。
Of course I have.

我跟死者的交情，当然也不会「起黑心」。
With the friendship there was between us, I would never dream of keeping it dishonestly.

不过，』说到这里，他有点烦躁，『这样的局面，放出去的款子；摆下去的本钱，一时哪里去回笼？
But”—he grew agitated—“in a situation like this, how can I call in loans and recover invested capital at a moment’s notice?

真教我不好交代。』
I truly do not know how to settle matters.”

这确是极为难的事。
It was indeed a serious difficulty.

古应春的想法比胡雪岩还要深，
Gu’s thoughts went further.

王有龄已经殉节，遗属不少，
Wang had died for his duty and left a sizeable family.

眼前居家度日，将来男婚女嫁，不但在在要钱，
They needed money for their immediate living expenses and, later, to marry off the children.

而且有了钱也不能坐吃山空。
Even if they received the money, they could not simply live on their capital until it was exhausted.

所以，他说∶『你还不能只顾眼前的交代，
“You must think beyond settling the account now,” he said.

要替王家筹个久长之计才好。』
“You ought to make lasting provision for the Wang family.”

『这倒没有什么好筹划的，
“There is not much to plan there.

反正只要胡雪岩一家有饭吃；决不会让王家吃粥，
So long as the Hu family has rice to eat, I shall never let the Wangs live on gruel.

我愁的是眼前！』
It is the immediate problem that worries me.

胡雪岩说∶『王雪公跟我的交情，可以说他就是我，我就是他。
Mr Xuexuan and I were so close that he was as much myself as I was.

他在天之灵，一定会谅解我的处境。
His spirit in Heaven will understand my predicament.

不过王太太或者不晓得我的心，他家的亲友更加隔膜，
But Mrs Wang may not know what is in my heart; her relatives and friends will understand even less.

只知道有钱在我这里，不知道这笔钱一时收不回来。
All they know is that I hold this money, not that I cannot recover it at once.

现在外头既有这样的闲话，我如果不能拿白花花的现银子捧出来，人家只当我欺侮孤儿寡妇。
Since such rumours are already abroad, unless I can produce the shining silver itself, people will say I am taking advantage of a widow and orphans.

这个名声，你想想，我怎么吃得消？』
Think what that would do to my reputation!”


古应春觉得这个看法不错，
Gu thought this sound reasoning.

他也是熟透人情世故的人，心里又有进一步的想法∶如果胡雪岩将王有龄名下的款子，如数交付，王家自然信任他，继续托他营运，手里仍可活动。
He too understood human nature thoroughly, and carried the argument a step further. If Hu handed over the entire sum belonging to Wang, the family would naturally trust him and ask him to continue investing it, leaving it at his disposal.

否则，王家反倒有些不大放心，会要求收回。
Otherwise they might become uneasy and insist on withdrawing it.

既然如此，就乐得做得漂亮些。
Given that, he might as well make a handsome job of it.

麻烦的是，杭州一陷，上海的生意又一时不能抽本，
The trouble was that Hangzhou had fallen, while the capital invested in Shanghai could not be withdrawn immediately.

无法做得『漂亮』。那就要靠大家帮忙了。
A handsome settlement was therefore impossible without help from their friends.

『小爷叔，』他问∶『王雪公有多少款子在你手里？』
“Little Uncle, how much of Mr Xuexuan’s money do you have?”

『王太太手里有帐的，
“Mrs Wang has the accounts.

大概有十万；
About a hundred thousand taels.

另外还有两万在云南，不知道王太太知道不知道。』
There are another twenty thousand in Yunnan, though I do not know whether she knows about those.”

『那就奇怪了。
“How strange!

怎么在云南会有两万银子？』
How did twenty thousand taels come to be in Yunnan?”


『是这样子的，』胡雪岩说，
“This is how it happened,” Hu said.

『咸丰六年冬天，何根云交卸浙江巡抚，王雪公在浙江的官，也没有什么做头了；
“In the winter of the sixth year of Xianfeng, He Genyun left his post as governor of Zhejiang, and Mr Xuexuan had little prospect of making a career there any longer.

事先安排，调补云南粮道。
Arrangements had already been made for him to become grain intendant in Yunnan.

我替他先汇了两万银子到云南。
I remitted twenty thousand taels there in advance.

后来何根云调升两江，王雪公自然跟到江苏；
Afterwards He was promoted to governor-general of Liangjiang, and Mr Xuexuan naturally followed him to Jiangsu.

云南的两万银子始终未动，存在昆明钱庄是生息。
The twenty thousand in Yunnan were never touched; they remained on deposit with a bank in Kunming, earning interest.

王雪公始终不忘云南，
Mr Xuexuan never forgot Yunnan.

生前跟我说过，有机会很想做一任云南巡抚；
He used to tell me that, given the opportunity, he would very much like to serve a term as governor there.

能做到云贵总督，当然更好。
Better still if he could become governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.

这两万银子在云南迟早有用处，不必去动它。
Sooner or later, he said, the money would be useful in Yunnan, so we need not withdraw it.

现在，当然再也用不着了！』
Now, of course, he will never need it again.”

说到这里，胡雪岩又生感触，泫然欲涕。
At this, emotion overcame Hu once more, and tears rose to his eyes.


等他拭一拭眼睛，擤一擤鼻子，情绪略略平伏，古应春便接着话题顺∶『款子放在钱庄里，总有折子；
Gu waited while he wiped his eyes, blew his nose, and recovered some composure, then resumed the discussion. “Money deposited with a bank must have a passbook.

折子在谁手里？』
Who has it?”

『麻烦就在这里。
“That is the difficulty.

折子是有一个，我交了给王雪公；
There was a passbook, and I gave it to Mr Xuexuan.

大概是他弄掉了，也记不起这回事，反来问我。
I suppose he lost it and forgot about it, for he later asked me where it was.

这原是无所谓的事；
It did not seem to matter at the time.

跟他们再补一个就是。
We could simply ask them for a replacement.

后来事多，一直搁着未办；
Then other business intervened, and it was left undone.

如今人已过世，倒麻烦了，
Now that he is dead, it becomes troublesome.

只怕对方不肯承认。』
I fear they may refuse to acknowledge the deposit.”

『你是原经手。』古应春说，
“You handled the original transaction,” Gu said.

『似乎跟王雪公在世还是故世，不生关系。
“Whether Mr Xuexuan is alive or dead would seem to make no difference.

不过，钱庄的规矩，我也不大懂，
But I do not know much about banking customs.

不知道麻烦何在？』
Where is the difficulty?”

『钱庄第一讲信用；第二讲关系；第三才讲交情。
“For a bank, credit comes first, business connections second, and personal friendship only third.

云南这家同业，信用并不见得好；交情也谈不上；
This Yunnan bank’s credit is not particularly good, and there is no friendship to speak of.

唯一讲得上的，就是关系。
The only thing we could count on was influence through our connections.

王雪公在日，现任的巡抚，云南方面说得上话；
While Mr Xuexuan lived, he was a serving governor whose word carried weight in Yunnan.

我自己呢，阜康在上海的生意不算大，浙江已经坐第一把交椅，
As for me, Fukang’s Shanghai business may be modest, but in Zhejiang we hold first place.

云南有协饷之类的公款往来，我可以照应他们，
Yunnan has transactions involving interprovincial military subsidies and other public funds, and I could help them with those.

论生意上的关系也够。
Our business connections should have been sufficient.

不过，现在不同了，
But things have changed.

他们未见得再肯买帐。』
They may no longer choose to oblige us.”

这番分析，极其透彻。
The analysis was penetrating.

古应春听入心头，亦颇有感慨；如今做生意要想发展，似乎不是靠官场的势力关系，就得沾洋人的光。
Gu took it to heart, reflecting sadly that success in business nowadays seemed to depend either on official influence or on foreign connections.

风气如此，夫复何言？
With things as they were, what more could be said?

看起来王有龄那笔款子，除非大有力者援手，恐怕要『泡汤』了。
Unless someone very powerful intervened, Wang’s money might well be lost.


『只有这样，
“There is only one course,” Gu said.

托出人来，请云贵总督，或者云南巡抚，派人去关照一声。
“We must find an intermediary to ask the governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou, or the governor of Yunnan, to send someone to speak to the bank.

念在王雪公为国殉难，遗属理当照应。
Mr Xuexuan died for his country; his family deserves consideration.

或者那批大老肯出头管这个闲事。』
Perhaps one of those great men will consent to concern himself with the matter.”

『也只好这样。』胡雪岩说，
“That is all we can do,” Hu agreed.

『交涉归交涉，眼前我先要赔出来。』
“But whatever negotiations we undertake, I must make up the money myself for the present.”

『这一来总数就是十二万。』
“That makes a hundred and twenty thousand altogether.”

古应春沉吟了一下，毅然决然地说∶『生意在一起，信用也是大家的。
Gu considered for a moment, then said resolutely, “We are in business together, and our credit is shared.

我想法子来替小爷叔凑足了就是。』
I shall find a way to raise the full amount for you.”

这就是朋友的可贵了。
Here was the value of friendship.

胡雪岩心情很复杂，既感激，又不安；
Hu felt both gratitude and unease.

自觉不能因为古应春一肩承担，自己就可以置身事外，
Gu’s willingness to bear the burden did not absolve him of responsibility.

所以还是要问一问。
He still had to ask how it would be managed.


『老古，你肯帮我这个忙，我说感激的话，是多余的，
“Gu, words of gratitude are unnecessary between us.

不过，不能因为我，拖垮了你。
But I cannot let you ruin yourself on my account.

十二万银子，到底也不是个小数目；
A hundred and twenty thousand taels is no small sum.

我自己能凑多少，还不晓得，想来不过三五万。
I do not yet know how much I can raise myself—perhaps thirty to fifty thousand at most.

还有七八万，
That still leaves seventy or eighty thousand.

要现款，只怕不容易。
Finding that much ready cash will not be easy.”

『』那就跟小爷叔说实话，七八万现款，我一下子也拿不出；
“To tell you the truth, Little Uncle, I cannot produce seventy or eighty thousand at once either.

只有暂时调动一下，希望王太太只是过一过目，仍旧交给你放出去生息。
I can only move money around temporarily, in the hope that Mrs Wang will merely look at it and entrust it to you again to invest at interest.”

『』嗯，嗯！『胡雪岩说，
“Yes,” Hu said.

「这个打算办得到的。
“I think that can be arranged.

不过，也要防个万一。』
But we must allow for the possibility that it cannot.”

『万一不成，只有硬挺。
“Then we shall simply have to hold on somehow.

现在也顾不得那许多了。』
We cannot take every contingency into account now.”

胡雪岩点点头，
Hu nodded.

自己觉得这件事总有八成把握，也就不再去多想；
He reckoned the plan had an eight-in-ten chance of success and thought no further about it.

接下来谈到另一件事。
They turned to another matter.


『这件事，关系王雪公的千秋。』胡雪岩说，
“This concerns Mr Xuexuan’s reputation through the ages,” Hu said.

『听大书我也听得不少，忠臣也晓得几个；
“I have heard plenty of storytellers and know of a few loyal ministers.

死得象王雪公这样惨的，实在不多。
Few died as cruelly as he did.

总要想办法替他表扬表扬，留下长远的纪念，
We must find some way to honour him and leave a lasting memorial.

才对得起死者。』
Only then shall we have done our duty by him.”

『这又何劳你费心？
“Why should you have to trouble yourself over that?

朝廷表扬忠义，自然有一套恤典的。』
The court has its established honours for loyalty.”

朝廷的恤典，胡雪岩当然知道，
Hu knew this, of course.

象王有龄的这种情形，恤典必须优渥，
In a case such as Wang’s, the posthumous honours must be generous.

除了照『巡抚例赐恤』，在赐谥、立传、赌祭以外，
Besides the customary provision for a deceased governor, there would be a posthumous title, an official biography, and sacrificial offerings.

殉节的封疆大吏，照便可以入祀京师昭忠祠，
A high provincial official who died for his duty could customarily be honoured in the Shrine of Illustrious Loyalty in the capital.

子孙亦可获得云骑尉之类『世袭罔替』的『世职』。
His descendants might receive a hereditary rank such as Yunqiwei, to be transmitted without reduction.

至于在本省及『立功省份』建立专祠，只要有人出面奏请，亦必可邀准，不在话下。
As for a special shrine in his own province or in a province where he had performed distinguished service, approval was virtually assured if someone submitted the appropriate memorial.


胡雪岩的意思，却不是指这些例行的恤典，
But Hu was not thinking of these customary honours.

『我心里一直在想，王雪公死得冤枉！』他说，
“I cannot stop thinking how unjustly Mr Xuexuan died,” he said.

『想起他「死不瞑目」那句话，只怕我夜里都会睡不着觉。
“When I remember his words about being unable to close his eyes in peace, I doubt I shall ever sleep soundly.

我要替他伸冤。
I want to obtain redress for him.

至少，他生前的冤屈，要教大家晓得。』
At the very least, people must know the wrongs he suffered while alive.”

照胡雪岩的看法，王有龄的冤屈，不止一端∶第一、王履谦处处掣肘，
In Hu’s view, there were several. First, Wang Lüqian had obstructed him at every turn.

宁绍可守而失守，以致杭州粮路断绝，陷入无可挽救的困境；
Ningbo and Shaoxing could have been held but were lost, cutting off Hangzhou’s food route and placing it in a hopeless position.

第二，李元度做浙江的官，领浙江的饷，却在衡州逗留不进。
Second, Li Yuandu held office in Zhejiang and drew his pay from Zhejiang, yet lingered in Hengzhou without advancing.

如果他肯在浙西拼命猛攻，至少可以牵制浙西的长毛，杭州亦不会被重重围困得毫无生路；
Had he fought hard in western Zhejiang, he could at least have diverted the rebels there, and Hangzhou would not have been so completely surrounded.

第三，两江总督曾国藩奉旨援浙而袖手旁观，大有见死不救之意，
Third, Zeng Guofan, governor-general of Liangjiang, had received an imperial command to assist Zhejiang but stood by with folded arms, apparently willing to watch others perish.

未免心狠。
That was surely heartless.

由于交情深厚，而且身历其境，同受荼毒，所以胡雪岩提到这些，情绪相当激动。
Hu spoke with considerable agitation. His friendship with Wang had been profound, and he himself had lived through the events and shared the suffering.

而在古应春，看法却不尽相同；
Gu’s view was different.

他的看法是就利害着眼，比较不涉感情。
He considered consequences and interests, with less involvement of feeling.


『小爷叔，』古应春很冷静地问道∶『你是打算怎么样替王雪公伸冤？』
“Little Uncle,” Gu asked calmly, “how do you propose to seek redress?”

『我有两个办法，
“I have two plans.

第一是要请人做一篇墓志铭，拿死者的这些冤屈都叙上去；
First, I shall ask someone to write an epitaph setting out all these wrongs.

第二是花几吊银子，到京里请一位「都老爷」出面，狠狠参他一本。』
Second, I shall spend some money in the capital and get a censor to impeach them severely.”

『参哪个？』
“Impeach whom?”

『参王履谦、李元度、还有两江的曾制台。』
“Wang Lüqian, Li Yuandu, and Governor-General Zeng of Liangjiang.”

『我看难！』古应春说，
“I think that will be difficult,” Gu replied.

『曾制台现在正大红大紫的时候，
“Governor-General Zeng is at the height of his favour.

参他不倒。
You will not bring him down by impeachment.

再说句良心话，人家远在安庆，救江苏还没有力量，
Besides, in fairness, he is far away in Anqing and lacks even the strength to relieve Jiangsu.

哪里又分得出兵来救浙江？』
Where could he find troops to spare for Zhejiang?”


胡雪岩心里不以为然，但不愿跟古应春争执，
Hu did not agree, but he had no wish to quarrel.

『那末，王履谦、李元度呢？』
“What about Wang Lüqian and Li Yuandu, then?

他说，『这两个人总是罪有应得吧？』
Surely those two deserve punishment?”

『王履廉是一定要倒霉的；
“Wang Lüqian is bound to suffer.

李元度就说不定了。
Li Yuandu is another matter.

而且，现在兵荒马乱，路又不通，朝廷要彻查也无从查起。
Besides, with war and disorder everywhere and the roads closed, how could the court conduct a thorough investigation?

只有等将来局势平定了再说。』
It must wait until peace is restored.”

这一下惹得胡雪岩心头火发，
Hu flared up.

咆哮着问∶『照你这样说，莫非就让这两个人逍遥法外？』
“Do you mean we are simply to let those two go unpunished?” he roared.

胡雪岩从未有过这样的疾言厉色，
He had never spoken to Gu with such harshness.

古应春受惊发楞，好半天说不出话。
Gu stared in astonishment, unable to answer for a long while.

那尴尬的脸色，亦是胡雪岩从未见过的；因而象镜子一样，使得他照见了自己的失态。
The embarrassed expression on his face was something Hu had never seen before; it reflected his own loss of control back to him.

『对不起，老古！』他低着头说，
“I am sorry, Gu,” he said, lowering his head.

声音虽轻缓了许多；但仍掩不住他内心的愤慨不平。
His voice was much gentler, though it could not conceal his indignation.

当然，这愤慨决不是对古应春。
That indignation was not directed at Gu, of course.

他觉得胡雪岩可怜亦可敬，然而却不愿说些胡雪岩爱听的话去安慰他。
Gu felt both pity and respect for him, but would not comfort him merely by saying what he wanted to hear.

『小爷叔，我知道你跟王雪公的交情。
“Little Uncle, I know how close you were to Mr Xuexuan.

不过，做事不能只讲感情，
But we cannot act on feeling alone.

要讲是非利害。』
We must consider right and wrong, and the likely consequences.”

这话胡雪岩自然同意，
Hu naturally accepted that principle.

只一时想不出，在这件事上的是非利害是什么？
At the moment, however, he could not see what those considerations meant in this case.

一个人有了冤屈，难道连诉一诉苦都不能？
If a man had been wronged, was he not even allowed to complain?

然则何以叫『不平则鸣』？
What, then, became of the saying that injustice must find a voice?

古应春见他不语，也就没有再说下去，
Seeing him silent, Gu went no further.

其实他亦只是讲利害，未讲是非；
In truth, he too was thinking only of consequences, not of right and wrong.

这一阵子为了替胡雪岩打听杭州的消息，跟官场中人颇有往来，
While seeking news of Hangzhou for Hu, he had lately had much contact with official circles.

王有龄之殉节，以及各方面对杭州沦陷的感想批评，亦听了不少。
He had heard many opinions on Wang’s death and the fall of the city.

大致说来，是同情王有龄的人多；但亦有人极力为曾国藩不救浙江辩护，
Most people sympathized with Wang, but some defended Zeng’s failure to help Zhejiang with great vigour.

其间党同伐异的论调，非常明显。
The arguments plainly reflected factional loyalties and hostilities.

王有龄孤军奋战，
Wang had fought alone.

最有渊源的人，是何桂清，却是『泥菩萨过江，自身难保』。
His closest patron was He Guiqing, who was himself barely able to keep his head above water.

在这种情形之下，如果什么人要为王有龄打抱不平，争论是非，当然会触犯时忌；遭致不利，
In such circumstances, anyone who championed Wang and disputed the rights and wrongs would inevitably offend powerful sensitivities and invite trouble.

岂不太傻？
Would that not be foolish?

古应春也知道自己的想法，庸俗卑下；
Gu knew that his own reasoning was commonplace and ignoble.

但为了对胡雪岩的关切特甚，也就不能不从利害上去打算了。
Yet his concern for Hu was so deep that he could not help calculating the dangers.

这些话一时说不透彻；而且最好是默喻而不必言传，
These considerations could not be fully explained at once; indeed, it was better that Hu should understand them without their being spoken.

他相信胡雪岩慢慢就会想明白，
Gu believed that, in time, he would.

眼前最要紧的是筹划那十二万银子；以及替胡雪岩拟公文上闽浙总督。
For the present, the urgent tasks were to raise the hundred and twenty thousand taels and prepare the dispatch to the governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.


从第二天起，古应春就为钱的事，全力奔走。
From the next day, Gu devoted all his energy to finding the money.

草拟公文则不必自己动笔；
He did not need to draft the dispatch himself.

他的交游亦很广，找了一个在江苏巡抚衙门当『文案委员』的候补知县雷子翰帮忙；
His acquaintance was wide, and he enlisted Lei Zihan, a county magistrate awaiting appointment who served as a drafting officer in the Jiangsu governor’s office.

一手包办，
Lei took the entire matter in hand.

两天功夫连江苏巡抚薛焕批给胡雪岩的回文，都已拿到了。
Within two days, they had even obtained Governor Xue Huan’s written reply to Hu.

这时，胡雪岩才跟刘不才说明经过，
Only then did Hu explain the arrangements to Liu.

『三叔，』最后他说，『事情是这样去进行。
“Third Uncle,” he concluded, “that is how we shall proceed.

不过，我亦不打算一定要这样子办。
But I do not insist on carrying the plan through.

为什么呢？
Why?

因为这件事很难做。』
Because it will be very difficult.”

刘不才的性情，是恨人家看不起他；说他是纨绔，不能正事；
Liu hated being looked down upon or dismissed as an idle scion incapable of serious work.

因而听了胡雪岩的话，大不服气，
