Who could have thought A’qiao would become so absorbed in it?”

一口气说到这里，七姑奶奶才发觉自己的猜想完全错了！
Only then did the Seventh Lady realize that her guesses had been entirely wrong.

照这段话听来，阿巧姐去看阿金，或者与那位师太有关；不是为了想铺房间。
A’qiao’s visit might have concerned the abbess, not the opening of a courtesan establishment.

因而急急问道∶『怎样子的入迷？』
“What do you mean, absorbed?” she asked urgently.

『说起来真教人想不到。
“It is quite unexpected.

她那天来问我白衣庵的地址，
The other day she asked me for the address of White-Robed Convent.

我告诉了她；又问她打听地址何用？
I told her, then asked why she wanted it.

她先不肯说，
At first she would not say.

后天被逼不过，才说实话∶要到白衣庵去出家！』
When I pressed her, she finally admitted that she wanted to enter the convent and leave the world.”

七姑奶奶大惊失色∶『做尼姑？』
The Seventh Lady’s face changed with shock. “Become a nun?”


『哪个晓得呢？』阿金忧郁地答道∶『我劝了她一夜，她始终也没有一句确实的话；
“Who can tell?” A’jin answered unhappily. “I spent the whole night trying to persuade her out of it, but she never gave me a definite answer.

是不是回心转意了，哪个也猜不透。』
No one can guess whether she changed her mind.”

『我猜不会的。』怡情老二却有泰然的神情，
“I do not think she will do it,” the Second Miss said calmly.

『阿巧姐这许多年，吃惯用惯从没有过过苦日子。
“For all these years she has been accustomed to comfort and has never lived a hard life.

尼姑庵里那种清苦，她一天也过不来。
She could not endure the austerity of a convent for a single day.

照我看——。』她不肯再说下去；
As I see it—” She stopped.

说下去话就刻薄了。
To go on would have been unkind.

照七姑奶奶想，阿巧姐亦未必会走到这条路上去。
The Seventh Lady too thought A’qiao might not take that road.

自宽自慰之余，却又另外上了心事；
Yet even as she comforted herself with this thought, another worry arose.

她不愿重堕风尘，固然可以令人松一口气，
It was a relief that A’qiao did not intend to return to the pleasure quarters.

但这种决绝的样子，实在也是抓住胡雪岩不放的表示。
But such a drastic gesture also showed that she would not release her hold upon Hu.

看起来麻烦还有的是。
There seemed to be plenty of trouble still ahead.

『现在怎么办呢？』七姑奶奶叹口气说，
“What are we to do now?” she sighed.

『我都没有招数了。』
“I have no more ideas.”

怡情老二跟她交往有年，从未见她有这样束手无策的神情。
In all their years of friendship, the Second Miss had never seen her so helpless.

一半是为她，一半为阿巧姐，自觉义不容辞地，在此时要出一番力。
Partly for her sake and partly for A’qiao’s, she felt bound to make an effort.


『阿巧姐落发做尼姑是不会的，
“A’qiao will not shave her head and become a nun.

无非灰心而已！
She is only disheartened.

我们大家为她好，要替她想条路走！』
We all want what is best for her, and we must find her a way forward.”

怡情老二向阿金说∶『她今年整四十岁了，
The Second Miss turned to A’jin. “She is exactly forty this year.

这把年纪，还有啥世面好混？
At that age, what future has she in this world of ours?

七姑奶奶预备替她做个媒——。』听她谈完张郎中，阿金亦颇为兴奋∶『有这样的收缘结果，还做啥尼姑！』她说，
The Seventh Lady is proposing a marriage—” When A’jin had heard the story of Dr Zhang, she too grew excited. “With such a proper ending in prospect, why become a nun?

『难得七姑奶奶热心；
How good of the Seventh Lady to take such trouble!

我们跟阿巧姐是小姊妹，更加应该着力。
We are A’qiao’s old companions and ought to work even harder.

这头媒做成功，实在是你阴功积德的好事。
Bringing this match about would be a true deed of merit.

我看我们在这里空谈无用，
There is no use sitting here talking.

不如此刻就去看她，
Let us go and see her now.

我不相信三张嘴说不过也一个。
I refuse to believe that the three of us cannot persuade one woman.”


由于怡情老二与阿金很起劲，七姑奶奶的信心也恢复了，
Their enthusiasm restored the Seventh Lady’s confidence.

略想一想问道∶『阿金姐，二阿姐，你们是不是决心要帮阿巧姐的忙？』
After a little thought she asked, “Sister A’jin, Second Sister, are you determined to help A’qiao?”

『自然。』怡情老二说，『只要帮得上。』
“Naturally,” the Second Miss replied, “if we can.”

『好的！
“Good.

那么两位听我说一句。
Then listen to me.

凡事事缓则圆；
Matters settle more smoothly when one takes time.

又道是只要功夫深，铁杵磨成针，
And with sufficient effort, an iron pestle can be ground into a needle.

从今天起。索性叫胡老爷不必再跟阿巧姐见面；
From today, let Mr Hu stop seeing her altogether.

我们先把她的心思引开来，让她忘记有姓胡的这个人。
We shall first divert her thoughts and make her forget that such a person exists.

这当然不是三天两天的事，所以我要先问一问两位；
That cannot be done in two or three days, which is why I had to ask you first.

真要帮她的忙，一定要花功夫下去。
If we truly mean to help, we must devote time to it.

从今天起，我们三个嬲住她，
Beginning today, the three of us will keep her company constantly.

看戏听书吃大菜，坐马车兜风，看外国马戏，凡是好玩的地方，都陪她去；
Plays, storytelling, Western dinners, carriage rides, foreign circuses—wherever there is something enjoyable, we shall take her.

好不肯去，就说我们要玩。
If she refuses, we shall say that we want to go.

人总是重情面的，
People care about their friends’ feelings.

她决计不好意思推辞；也不好意思哭丧了脸扫大家的兴。
She will be too embarrassed to refuse and too considerate to spoil everyone’s pleasure with a gloomy face.

到夜里我们分班陪着她住在一起，一面是看住她；一面是跟她谈天解闷。
At night we shall take turns staying with her, both to watch over her and to talk and ease her mind.

这样有半个月二十天下来，她的心境就不同了；
After fifteen or twenty days of that, her mood will change.

到那时候再跟她提到张郎中，事情就容易成功！
Then we can mention Dr Zhang, and success will be much easier.

至于这些日子在外头玩儿的花费，我说句狂话，我还用得起，
As for the cost of these outings, let me boast a little: I can still afford it.

统通归我！』
I shall pay for everything.”

『二阿姐！』阿金深深透口气，『七姑有奶这样子的血性；话说到头了，
A’jin drew a deep breath. “Second Sister, with such generosity, the Seventh Lady has said all there is to say.

我们只有依她。
We can only follow her lead.

不过，也不好七姑奶奶一个人破费。』
But we cannot let her bear all the expense.”

『当然。』
“Of course not.”

怡情老二向七姑奶奶说∶『什么都依你，只有这上头，
The Second Miss turned to the Seventh Lady. “We shall do everything as you say, except on that point.

请你不要争，
Do not argue.

大家轮着做东；今天是我。
We shall take turns as hostess, and today is mine.

我们走吧，邀她出来看「杨猴子」。』
Come, let us invite her out to see the foreign circus.”

于是由怡情老二结了帐，侍者将帐单送了来，她在上面用笔画了一个只有她自己认得的花押。
She signed for the bill, putting a personal flourish on the account the waiter brought, a mark intelligible only to herself.

这原是西洋规矩，名为『签字』，表示承认有这笔帐；
This was a Western custom called “signing,” an acknowledgment of the debt.

本来要写名字，如果不识字的，随意涂一笔也可以，应到规矩就行了。
Ordinarily one wrote one’s name; an illiterate person could make any distinctive mark, provided the proper form was observed.


三个人都带着小大姐，
Each woman had brought a young maid.

挤上两辆『野鸡马车』，直放阿巧姐寓处∶下车一看，便觉有异，
They crowded into two hired street carriages and drove straight to A’qiao’s lodgings. On getting out, they immediately sensed something wrong.

大门开了一半，却无人应门。
The front door stood half open, but no one answered.

七姑奶奶便提高了声音喊道∶『阿祥、
The Seventh Lady raised her voice. “A’xiang!

阿福！』
A’fu!”

阿祥、阿福都不见，
Neither appeared.

楼梯上匆匆奔下来一个人，晃荡着长辫子，满脸惊惶；
Instead, someone hurried down the stairs, her long braid swinging, her face full of alarm.

是阿巧姐的丫头素香。
It was Suxiang, A’qiao’s maid.



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第七章（本章第3部分，共4部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


三个人面面相觑，
The three women exchanged glances.

都猜到了是怎么回事？
Each guessed what had happened.

七姑奶奶遇到这种情形，却很沉着，反安慰她说∶『素香，你不要急！
In such a situation the Seventh Lady remained calm and even comforted the maid. “Suxiang, do not be frightened.

有话慢慢说。』
Tell us slowly.”

『奶奶不见了！』素香用带哭的声音说，
“Madam has disappeared!” Suxiang said, almost in tears.

『不晓得到哪里去了？』叫她慢慢说，她说得还是没头没脑，
“No one knows where she has gone.” Asked to speak slowly, she still began in the middle of the story.

七姑奶奶只好问道∶『你怎么知道你奶奶不见了？
The Seventh Lady had to question her. “How do you know she has disappeared?

她什么时候出的门？』
When did she leave?”

『老爷一走，没有多少时候，她叫我到香粉弄去买丝线；又差阿祥去叫米叫柴。
“Not long after Master went out, she sent me to buy silk thread in Xiangfen Lane and sent A’xiang to order rice and firewood.

等到我跟阿祥回来，她已经不知道什么时候出门了；连门上都不知道，
When we came back, she had already gone. No one knew when she had left, not even the man at the front door.

再看后门；是半开在那里。
Then we looked at the back door and found it half open.

一直到下半天三点钟都不见回来；
By three this afternoon she still had not returned.

我进房去一看，一只小首饰箱不见了，替换衣服也少了好些。
I went into her room: a small jewelry box was missing, and quite a few changes of clothes.

这——这——！』素香着急地，不知如何表达她的想法。
That—that—” Too anxious to explain, Suxiang faltered.

这不用说，自然是到老师太那里去了。
There was no need to say it: she must have gone to the elderly abbess.

七姑奶奶倒吸一口冷气，怔怔地望着同伴；
The Seventh Lady drew in a sharp breath and stared at her companions.

怡情老二便问∶『素香，你们老爷知道不知道？』
The Second Miss asked, “Suxiang, does your master know?”

『不知道。』
“No.

素香答说∶『阿祥跟轿班去寻老爷去了。』
A’xiang and the chairmen have gone to look for him.”

『你们老爷在钱庄里。』七姑奶奶说，
“Your master is at the bank,” the Seventh Lady said.

『你看，轿班还有哪个在？
“See whether any of the chairmen are still here.

赶快去通知；
Send someone to tell him at once.

请你们老爷到这里来，我有要紧话说。』
Ask him to come here; I have something important to say.”


就在这时候，雪岩已经赶到；同来的还有萧家骥。
At that moment Hu arrived, accompanied by Xiao Jiaji.

胡雪岩跟怡情老二熟识，与阿金却是初见，
He knew the Second Miss well but had never met A’jin.

不过此时亦无暇细问，同时因为有生客在，要格外镇静，免得『家丑』外扬，
There was no time for inquiries; indeed, the presence of a stranger made him all the more determined to remain composed and keep his domestic troubles from becoming public.

所以只点点头，平静地问∶『你们两位怎么也来了？』
He merely nodded and asked quietly, “How do you two come to be here as well?”

『我们是碰上的。』七姑奶奶答说，
“We happened to meet,” the Seventh Lady replied.

『有话到里面去说。』
“Let us talk inside.”

进入客厅，她方为胡雪岩引见阿金。
In the sitting room she introduced A’jin.

话要说到紧要地方了，却不宜让素香与阿祥听到；所以她要求跟胡雪岩单独谈话。
They were approaching matters that Suxiang and A’xiang ought not to hear, so she asked to speak with Hu privately.

『阿巧姐去的地方，我知道，在法华镇，一座尼姑庵里，
“I know where A’qiao has gone—to a convent in Fahua Town.

事不宜迟，现在就要去寻她。
We must lose no time; someone must go for her at once.

我看，『七姑奶奶踌躇着说，』
I think—” She hesitated.

只好我跟阿金姐两个人去；
“It had better be just Sister A’jin and me.

你不宜跟她见面。
You ought not to meet her.”

『胡雪岩大惑不解，』
Hu was utterly bewildered.

到底怎么回事？
“What has happened?

『他问∶』何以你又知道她的行踪？
How do you know where she is?

那位阿金姐，又是怎么回事？
And who is this Sister A’jin?”

『『这时候没有办法细说。
“There is no time to explain everything now.

小爷叔，你只安排我们到法华好了。』
Little Uncle, just arrange for us to get to Fahua.”


『法华一带都是安庆来的淮军。
“The whole Fahua district is occupied by Anhui Army troops from Anqing.

还不知道好走不好走呢！』
I do not even know whether we can get through.”

『不要紧！』萧家骥说，
“That does not matter,” Xiao said.

『我去一趟好了。』
“I shall go.”

『好极！
“Excellent!

你去最好。』
You are the best person.”

七姑奶奶很高兴地说；
The Seventh Lady was delighted.

因为萧家骥跟淮军首领很熟，此去必定有许多方便。
Xiao knew the Anhui Army commanders well, and his presence would make many things easier.

『七姐，我想我还是应该去。』胡雪岩说，
“Seventh Sister, I still think I ought to go,” Hu said.

『不见面不要紧，至少让她知道我不是不关心她。
“I need not see her, but at least let her know that I am not indifferent.

你看呢？』
What do you think?”

『我是怕你们见了面吵起来，弄得局面很不好收场。
“I was afraid you would quarrel if you met and make matters impossible to resolve.

既然小爷叔这么说，去了也不要紧。』
Since you put it that way, Little Uncle, there is no harm in your going.”

到得法华镇，已经黄昏。
It was dusk when they reached Fahua Town.

萧家骥去找淮军大将程家启部下的一个营官，姓朱；
Xiao sought out a battalion commander named Zhu, who served under the Anhui Army general Cheng Xueqi.

人很爽朗热心，问明来意，请他们吃了一顿饭，然后命手下一个把总将地保老胡找了来，说知究竟。
A frank and helpful man, Zhu heard their errand, gave them a meal, then ordered a subordinate officer, a bazong, to fetch the local constable, Old Hu, and explain what was needed.


『好的，好的！
“Certainly, certainly.

我来领路。』老胡说道∶『请三位跟我来。』
I shall show the way,” Old Hu said. “The three of you, please follow me.”

于是迎着月色，往东面去；走不多远，折进一条巷子，
They headed east in the moonlight and soon turned into a lane.

巷底有处人家，一带粉墙，墙内花木繁盛，
At its far end stood a residence behind a whitewashed wall, with luxuriant flowers and trees inside.

新月微光，影影绰绰；
In the faint light of the new moon, the shapes were indistinct.

薰风过处，传来一阵浓郁的『夜来香』的香味，
A warm breeze carried out the rich scent of night-blooming flowers.

每个人都觉得精神一振，而一颗心却无缘无故地飘荡不定，有着一种说不出的胀满的感觉。
Everyone felt suddenly refreshed, yet for no reason their hearts grew restless, filled with a swelling emotion they could not name.

这份感觉以萧家骥为尤甚，
Xiao felt it most strongly.

不由得便问∶『这是什么地方？』
“What is this place?” he could not help asking.

『这里？』
“Here?

地保答道∶『就是白衣庵。
White-Robed Convent.

晚上来，要走边门。』
At night we use the side entrance.”

边门是一道厚实的木板门，
The side entrance had a solid wooden door.

举手可及的上方，有个不为人所注意的扁圆形铁环；
Above it, within reach, was an inconspicuous flattened iron ring.

地保一伸手拉了两下，
Old Hu reached up and pulled it twice.

只听『克啷、克啷』的响声。
Clang, clang.

不久，听得脚步声、然后门开一线，有人问道∶『哪位？』
After a little while came footsteps; the door opened a crack, and someone asked, “Who is it?”

『小音，是我！』
“Xiaoyin, it is me.”

『噢！』
“Oh.

门内小音问道∶『老胡，这辰光来做啥？』
Old Hu, what brings you here at this hour?”

『你有没有看见客人？』
“Can you not see the visitors?”

地保指着后面的人说，
He pointed behind him.

『你跟了尘师父去说，是我带来的人。』
“Tell Sister Liaochen that I have brought them.”


门『呀』地一声开了。
The door swung open with a creak.

灯光照处，小音是个俗家打扮的垂发女郎；
By the light they saw Xiaoyin, a girl in ordinary secular dress with her hair hanging loose.

等客人都进了门，将门关上；然后一言不发地往前走，穿过一条花径，越过两条走廊，到了一处禅房，看样子是待客之处；
Once the visitors were inside, she shut the door and led them forward without a word, along a flower-lined path and through two covered passages to a monastic room apparently used for receiving guests.

她停了下去，看着地保老胡。
There she stopped and looked at Old Hu.

老胡略有些踌躇，『总爷！』他哈腰问∶『是不是我陪着你老在这里坐一坐？』
He hesitated a little, then bowed to the officer. “Sir, shall I keep you company here for a while?”

这何消说得？那把总自然照办。
There was scarcely any need to ask; the officer naturally agreed.

于是老胡跟小音悄悄说了几句；然后示意胡雪岩跟着小音走。
Old Hu whispered a few words to Xiaoyin, then motioned Hu to follow her.

穿过禅房，便是一个大院子∶绕向西边的回廊，但见人影、花影一齐映在雪白的粉墙上；
Beyond the room lay a large courtyard. As they turned into the western covered walk, their shadows mingled with those of the flowers upon the whitewashed wall.

还有一头猫的影子，弓起背，正在东面屋脊上『叫春』。
There was also the shadow of a cat, arching its back and yowling for a mate on the roof to the east.

萧家骥用手肘轻轻将胡雪岩撞了一下，同时口中在念∶『「曲径通幽处，禅房花木深」！』
Xiao nudged Hu gently with his elbow and murmured a couplet: “A winding path leads into seclusion; the monks’ quarters lie deep among flowers and trees.”

胡雪岩也看出这白衣庵大有蹊跷。
Hu too could see that something about this convent was unusual.

但萧家骥的行径，近乎佻亻达；不是礼佛之道，
But Xiao’s behavior verged on frivolity and was scarcely respectful in a Buddhist sanctuary.

便咳嗽一声，示意他检点。
He coughed to warn him to restrain himself.

于是默默地随着小音进入另一座院落，一庭树木，三楹精舍，
They followed Xiaoyin silently into another courtyard, planted with trees and facing an elegant three-bay retreat.

檀香花香，交杂飘送；
Sandalwood incense mingled with the scent of flowers.

萧家骥不由得失声赞道∶『好雅致的地方！』
Xiao exclaimed involuntarily, “What a refined place!”

『请里面坐。』小音揭开门帘肃客，
“Please sit inside,” Xiaoyin said, lifting the curtain to admit them.

『我去请了尘师父来。』
“I shall fetch Sister Liaochen.”

说完，她又管自己走了。
Then she went off on her own.


两个人进屋一看，屋中上首供着一座白瓷观音；
Entering, the two men saw a white porcelain Guanyin enshrined at the upper end of the room.

东面是一排本色的桧木几椅；西面一张极大的木榻，上铺蜀锦棉垫。
To the east stood a row of tables and chairs of unpainted cypress; to the west, an enormous wooden couch covered with padded Sichuan brocade.

瓶花吐艳、炉香袅袅，配着一张古琴，布置得精雅非凡；
Flowers glowed in vases, incense curled from a burner, and an ancient qin completed an exceptionally tasteful arrangement.

但这一切，都不及悬在木榻上方的一张横披，更使得萧家骥注目。
Yet none of these things caught Xiao’s attention as much as the horizontal scroll hanging above the couch.


『胡先生！』
“Mr Hu!”

萧家骥显得有些兴奋，
Xiao sounded excited.

『你看！』
“Look!”

横披上是三首诗；
The scroll contained three poems.

胡雪岩总算念得断句∶闲叩禅关访素娥，醮坛药院覆松萝，
Hu could at least make out where the lines began and ended: “At leisure I knock at the Buddhist gate to visit a moonlike beauty; / Pine and creepers cover the ritual altar and the garden of herbs.

一庭桂子迎人落，满壁图书献佛多；
/ A courtyard of osmanthus flowers falls to greet the visitor; / Books and paintings fill the walls, rich offerings to the Buddha.

作赋我应惭宋玉，拈花卿合伴维摩。
/ In writing rhapsodies I must blush before Song Yu; / With a flower in your hand, you should be Vimalakirti’s companion.

尘心到此都消尽，细味前缘总是魔！
/ Coming here, my worldly thoughts all melt away; / Yet savoring our former ties, I find them all temptation.”


旧传奔月数嫦娥，今叩云房锁丝萝，
“Old legend tells of Chang’e’s flight up to the moon; / Now I knock at a cloudlike cell enclosed in clinging vines.

才调玄机应不让，风怀孙绰扇区我；
/ Your gifts need yield nothing to Xuanji’s; / Your romantic ardor seems greater even than Sun Chuo’s.

谁参半分优婆塞？
/ Who has attained even half a lay disciple’s practice?

待悟三乘阿笈摩。
/ We wait to grasp the Three Vehicles and the Agamas.

何日伊蒲同设馔，清凉世界遣诗魔。
/ When shall we share a Buddhist vegetarian feast, / And in this cool, pure world dispel the demon of verse?”


群花榜上笑良多，梓里云房此日过。
“On the register of flowers are many traces of smiles; / Today I visit this cloudlike cell in our native place.

君自怜才留好然，我曾击节听高歌；
/ Cherishing talent, you have left fine lines behind; / I once beat time in praise as I heard you sing aloud.

清阴远托伽山竹，冶艳低牵茅屋萝。
/ Cool shade finds distant shelter in the holy mountain’s bamboo; / Lush beauty trails low among a thatched hut’s vines.

点缀秋光篱下菊，尽将游思付禅魔。
/ Chrysanthemums beneath the hedge adorn the autumn light; / All wandering thoughts I give to the demon of meditation.”


胡雪岩在文墨这方面，还不及萧家骥，
In literary matters Hu knew even less than Xiao.

不知道宋玉、孙绰是何许人？也不知道玄机是指的唐朝女道士鱼玄机。
He had no idea who Song Yu and Sun Chuo were, nor that Xuanji meant Yu Xuanji, the Tang dynasty Taoist nun.

佛经上的那些出典是莫名其妙。
The allusions to Buddhist scriptures were wholly beyond him.

但诗句中的语气不似对戒律森严的女僧，却是看得出来的。
Yet he could tell that the tone of the poems was hardly one in which to address a nun who kept strict vows.

因而愕然相问∶『这是啥名堂？』
Astonished, he asked, “What is all this?”

『你看着好了。』萧家骥轻声答道∶『这位了尘师父，不是嘉兴人就是昆山；
“Wait and see,” Xiao answered softly. “This Sister Liaochen must come from Jiaxing or Kunshan.

不然就是震泽、盛泽。』
If neither, then Zhenze or Shengze.”

昆山的尼姑有何异处，胡雪岩不知道；但嘉兴的尼庵是亲自领教过的。
Hu knew nothing of what distinguished the nuns of Kunshan, but he had personal experience of the convents of Jiaxing.

震泽和盛泽的风俗，他在吴江同里的时候，也听人说过，
When staying at Tongli in Wujiang, he had also heard about the customs of Zhenze and Shengze.

这两处地方，盛产丝绸，地方富庶，风俗奢靡。
Both were prosperous silk-producing towns, luxurious in their habits.

盛泽讲究在尼姑庵宴客，一桌素筵，比燕菜席还要贵；
In Shengze it was fashionable to entertain guests at convents, where a vegetarian banquet cost more than a feast featuring bird’s nest.

据说是用肥鸡与上好的火腿熬汁调味，所以鲜美绝伦。
The dishes were said to be flavored with stock made from plump chickens and the finest ham, which accounted for their extraordinary savor.

震泽尼姑庵的烹调，亦是有名的，荤素并行，不逊于无锡的船菜。
The convents of Zhenze were equally famous for their cooking: meat and vegetarian dishes alike rivaled the celebrated boat cuisine of Wuxi.

当然，佳肴以外，还有可餐的秀色。
Besides the delicacies on the table, of course, there were beauties to feast one’s eyes upon.

这样回忆着，再又从初见老胡，说夜访白庆庵『没有啥不便』想起，
Remembering all this, Hu thought back to Old Hu’s assurance when they first met that there was “no inconvenience” in visiting White-Robed Convent at night.

一直到眼前的情景，觉得无一处不是证实了萧家骥的看法，
Everything from that moment to the scene before him seemed to confirm Xiao’s view.

因而好奇大起，渴望着看一看了尘是什么样子？
His curiosity rose, and he longed to see what Liaochen looked like.

萧家骥反显得比他沉着，
Xiao, however, had grown more sober than he.

『胡先生，』他说，『只怕弄错了！
“Mr Hu, I am afraid there has been a mistake.

阿巧姐不会在这里。』
A’qiao cannot be here.”


『何以见得？』
“Why do you say that?”

『这里，哪是祝发修行的地方？』
“Is this a place for shaving one’s head and practicing religion?”

胡雪岩正待答话，一眼瞥见玻璃窗外，一盏白纱灯笼冉冉而来，
Hu was about to reply when he glimpsed a white gauze lantern floating toward them beyond the glass window.

便住口不言，同时起身等候；
He fell silent and rose to wait.

门帘启处，先见小音，次见了尘一若非预知，不会相信所见的是个出家人。
The curtain lifted; first came Xiaoyin, then Liaochen. Had they not known beforehand, they would never have believed her to be a nun.

她当然也不是纯俗家打扮，
Her appearance was not entirely secular, certainly.

不曾『三绺梳头，两截穿衣』发长齐肩，穿的是一件圆领长袍；
She wore neither an ordinary woman’s three-part coiffure nor separate upper and lower garments. Her hair reached her shoulders, and she had on a long, round-necked robe.

说它是僧袍固然可以，但僧袍不会用那种闪闪生光的玄色软缎来做，更不会窄腰小袖，裁剪得那么称体。
One might have called it a nun’s robe, but a nun’s robe would hardly be made of such glossy soft black satin, still less be cut so closely to the body, with a narrow waist and slender sleeves.

看到脸上，更不象出家人，
Her face looked less monastic still.

虽未敷粉，却曾施朱；她的皮肤本来就白，亦无须敷粉。
Though she wore no powder, she had applied rouge; her naturally fair skin needed no powder.

特别是那双眼睛，初看是剪水双瞳，再看才知别蕴春情。
Above all there were her eyes: at first glance clear as water, but at a second revealing an undertone of amorous feeling.


是这样的人物，便不宜过于持重拘谨，
With such a person, excessive solemnity and reserve seemed unnecessary.

胡雪岩笑嘻嘻地双掌合十，打个问讯∶『可是了尘师太？』
Smiling, Hu brought his palms together in greeting. “Are you Sister Liaochen?”

『我是了尘。
“I am Liaochen.

施主尊姓？』
May I ask your surname, benefactor?”

『我姑胡。
“Mine is Hu.

这位姓萧。』
This gentleman is Mr Xiao.”

于是了尘——行礼，请『施主』落座；
Liaochen greeted them in turn and invited her “benefactors” to sit.

她自己盘腿坐在水榻上相陪，动问来意。
She herself sat cross-legged on the wooden couch and asked what had brought them.

『原是来见当家老师太的；
“We originally came to see the elderly abbess,” Hu said.

听地保老胡说，宝庵其实是由了尘师太当家。
“But Old Hu, the constable, tells us that you are really in charge here.

有点小事打听，
There is a small matter we wish to ask about.

请我这位萧老弟说吧！』
Perhaps my young friend Xiao had better explain.”

萧家骥点点头，
Xiao nodded.

不谈来意却先问道∶『听了尘师太的口音是震泽？』
Instead of coming to the point, however, he first asked, “Judging by your accent, Sister Liaochen, are you from Zhenze?”

了尘脸上一红∶『是的。』
She blushed. “Yes.”


『这三首诗，』萧家骥向她上方一指，『好得很！』
“These three poems,” Xiao said, pointing above her, “are very fine.”

『也是三位施主，一时雅兴；
“They were written by three benefactors in moments of poetic inspiration.

疯言疯语的，
Such wild nonsense!

无奈他何！』
What can one do with them?”

说着，了尘微微笑了，
Liaochen smiled faintly.

『萧施主在震泽住过？』
“Have you lived in Zhenze, Mr Xiao?”

『是的。住过一年多；
“Yes, for more than a year.

那时还是小孩子，什么都不懂。』
But I was only a child then and understood nothing.”

『意思是现在都懂了？』
“Meaning that you understand everything now?”

这样率直反问，有些咄咄逼人的意味；
So direct a question had something challenging about it.

萧家骥自非弱者，不会艰于应付，从容自若地答道∶『也还不十分懂，
Xiao was no weak opponent and had no difficulty answering with composure. “Not everything, even now.

改日再来领教。
I shall return another day for instruction.

今天有件事，要请了尘师太务必帮个忙。』
Today there is something in which I must ask your help.”

『言重！
“You put it too strongly.

请吩咐，
Please tell me what you wish.

只怕帮不了什么忙。
I only fear there may be little I can do.”

『』只要肯帮忙，只是一句话的事『。
“If you are willing, a word is all it will take.

萧家骥问道∶』白衣庵今天可有一位堂客；是来求当家老师太收容的。
Has a lady come to White-Robed Convent today to ask the elderly abbess for refuge?

这位堂客是闹家务一时想不开，
She has had domestic difficulties and, in a moment of distress, could see no way out.

或许她跟当家师太说过，为她瞒一瞒行迹。
She may have asked the abbess to conceal her whereabouts.

倘或如此，她就害了白衣庵了！
If so, she has done your convent a disservice.”

『了尘颜色一变，是受惊的神气；
Liaochen’s expression changed; she looked frightened.

望望这个，又望望那个，终于点点头说∶』有的。
She glanced from one man to the other, then finally nodded. “Yes, someone has come.

可就是这位胡施主的宝眷？『
Is she perhaps Mr Hu’s lady?”


果然在这里，
So she was here after all.

一旦证实了全力所追求的消息，反倒不知所措。
Once the news they had sought so eagerly was confirmed, the two men found themselves at a loss.

萧家骤与胡雪岩对望着、沉默着；交换的眼色中，提出了同样的疑问∶阿巧姐投身在这白衣庵中，到底是为了什么？
Xiao and Hu looked at one another in silence, their glances asking the same question: what had A’qiao meant by coming to this convent?

若说为了修行，诚如萧家骥所说∶『这里，哪是祝发修行的地方？』
If she sought religious discipline, Xiao’s question was justified: “Is this a place for shaving one’s head and practicing religion?”

倘使不是为了修行，那末非杨即墨，阿巧姐便是另一个了尘。
If she did not seek that, she must be choosing the other path and becoming another Liaochen.

这一层不先弄明白，不能有所决定；这一层要弄明白，却又不知如何着手。
Until they understood which it was, they could decide nothing; yet they did not know how to begin finding out.

终于是胡雪岩作了一个决定∶『了尘师太，我请这位萧老弟先跟敝眷见一面。
At last Hu made a decision. “Sister Liaochen, I should like my young friend Xiao to see my lady first.

不知道行不行？』
Would that be possible?”

『有什么不行？
“Why not?

这样最好。
That would be best.

不过，我得先问一问她。』
But I must ask her first.”

由于了尘赞成萧家骥跟阿巧姐见面，因而可以猜想得到，所谓『问一问她』，其实是劝一劝她。
Since Liaochen approved of Xiao’s seeing A’qiao, they could guess that “asking her” really meant persuading her.

反正只要了尘肯帮忙，一定能够见得着面，
Provided Liaochen would help, the meeting was assured.

胡雪岩和萧家骥就都无话说，愿意静等。
Hu and Xiao said no more and were content to wait.

等了尘一走，萧家骥问道∶『胡先生，见了阿巧姐，我怎么说？』
As soon as she had gone, Xiao asked, “Mr Hu, what shall I say when I see A’qiao?”


『我只奇怪，』胡雪岩答非所问∶『这里是怎样一处地方，莫非那个什么阿金一点都不晓得？』
“What puzzles me,” Hu said, without answering, “is whether that woman A’jin knows nothing of the kind of place this is.”

『现在没有功夫去追究这个疑问。
“There is no time to investigate that now.

胡先生，你只说我见了阿巧姐该怎么样？』
Just tell me what I ought to do when I see A’qiao.”

『什么都不必说，
“You need say nothing else.

只问问她，到底作何打算？
Only ask what she means to do.

问清楚了，回去跟你师娘商量。』
Once you know, we can go back and discuss it with your master’s wife.”

跟阿巧姐见面的地方，是当家老师太养静的那座院子；
Xiao met A’qiao in the courtyard where the elderly abbess lived in quiet retirement.

陈设比不上了尘的屋子，但亦比其他的尼姑庵来得精致，
Its furnishings were less fine than those in Liaochen’s rooms, but still more elegant than those of other convents.

见得白衣庵相当富庶，
Plainly White-Robed Convent was prosperous.

如果不是有大笔不动产，可以按期坐收租息，便是有丰富的香金收入。
Either it owned extensive property from which it received regular rents, or its income from devotees’ offerings was substantial.


阿巧姐容颜憔悴，见了萧家骥眼圈都红了；
A’qiao looked worn and haggard, and her eyes reddened at the sight of Xiao.

招呼过后，她开门见山地问∶『阿巧姐，你怎么想了想，跑到这地方来了？』
After greeting her, he came straight to the point. “A’qiao, whatever made you come to this place?”

『我老早想来了。
“I have wanted to come for a long time.

做人无味，
Life has no savor.

修修来世。』
I might as well cultivate merit for the next.”

这是说，她的本意是要出家；
So she had intended to become a nun.

萧家骤便问∶『这里你以前来过没有？』
Xiao asked, “Have you been here before?”

『没有。』
“No.”

怕隔墙有耳，萧家骥话不能明说；
Afraid of listeners beyond the wall, he could not speak openly.

想了一下，记起胡雪岩的疑问，
After a moment’s thought he remembered Hu’s question.

随即问道∶『阿金呢？
“What about A’jin?

她来过没有？』
Has she been here?”

这意思是问，阿金如果来过，当然知道这里的情形，莫非不曾跟你说过？
He meant that, if A’jin had visited, she must know what went on here: had she not told A’qiao?

『阿巧姐摇摇头∶』也没有。
A’qiao shook her head. “No, she has not either.”

『』那就难怪了！
“That explains it.”

『话只能说这一句；
He could say no more.

而阿巧姐似乎是了解的，
A’qiao seemed to understand.

幽幽地叹了口无声的气，仿佛也是有好些话无法畅所欲言似的。
She gave a long, soundless sigh, as though she too had much that she could not freely express.


『现在怎么样呢？』萧家骥问道∶『你总有个打算。』
“What now?” Xiao asked. “You must have some plan.”

『我——，』阿巧姐说，
“I—” A’qiao paused.

『我先住在这里。慢慢打算。』
“I shall stay here for the present and decide in time.”

『也好。』萧家骥说，
“Very well.

『明天，我师娘会来看你。』
My master’s wife will come to see you tomorrow.”

『不要！』阿巧姐断然决然地说∶『请她不要来。』
“No!” A’qiao answered decisively. “Please tell her not to come.”

这很奇怪！
That was extraordinary.

能见一个象自己这样渊源不深的男客，倒不愿见和向交好的七姑奶奶，
She would receive a male visitor with whom she had no particularly close connection, yet refused to see the Seventh Lady, who had long been her friend.

而且语气决绝，其中必有缘故。
Such an emphatic refusal must have a reason.

他的思路很快，想得既宽且深；所以在这些地方，格外谨慎，
Xiao thought quickly, widely, and deeply; in matters of this kind he was especially cautious.

想了一下说∶『阿巧且，我晓得你跟我师娘、感情一向很好；
After considering, he said, “A’qiao, I know you have always been very close to my master’s wife.

你这话，我回去是不是照实说？』
Am I to repeat exactly what you have said?”

『为什么不能照实说？』
“Why should you not?”


『那末，我师娘问我∶为啥她不要我去？我怎么答复她？』
“Then if she asks why you do not want her to come, what am I to tell her?”

问到这话，阿巧姐脸上出现了一种怨恨的表情∶『我俗家的亲戚朋友都断了！』她说，
At this question a look of resentment came over A’qiao’s face. “I have broken with all my worldly relations and friends.

『所以不要她来看我；
That is why I do not want her here.

来了我也不见。』
If she comes, I shall refuse to see her.”

语气越发决绝，加上她那种脸色，竟似跟七姑奶奶有不解之仇。
Her voice was more determined than ever; coupled with her expression, it suggested an irreconcilable hatred of the Seventh Lady.

萧家骥大为惊骇；可是说话却更谨慎了。
Xiao was deeply alarmed, but spoke all the more cautiously.

『阿巧姐，』他旁敲侧击地探索真相∶『我不也俗家人吗？』
“A’qiao,” he asked indirectly, probing for the truth, “am I not a person of the world too?”

这一问算是捉住她话中一个无法辩解的漏洞。
This exposed a flaw in her argument that she could not explain away.

她脸上阴晴不定地好半天，终于有了答复∶『萧少爷，说实话，我是怕你师娘。
Her expression changed back and forth for a long time before she answered. “Young Master Xiao, to tell the truth, I am afraid of your master’s wife.

她手段厉害；我弄不过她。
Her methods are formidable; I am no match for her.

再说句实话，做人无味，教人灰心，也就是为了这一点；
And to tell you another truth, this is precisely what has made life seem so empty and disheartening.

自以为是心换心的好朋友，
I thought she was a friend who gave her heart for mine.

哪知道两面三刀，帮着别人来算计我。
Who could have known she was two-faced, helping others scheme against me?

真正心都凉透了！
My heart has turned completely cold.

萧少爷，这话你一定奇怪，一定不相信；
You must find this strange; you must refuse to believe it.

行过，你也要想想，我三十多岁的人，各种各样的世面也见识过，
But think: I am a woman in my thirties and have seen every sort of thing in the world.

总还不致于连人好人坏都看不出，无缘无故冤枉你师娘。
Surely I am not so foolish that I cannot tell a good person from a bad one, or would accuse your master’s wife without reason.

你师娘啊，真正是——。』她摇摇头，不肯再说下去。
She is really—” A’qiao shook her head and would say no more.

这番话，在萧家骥简直是震动了！
Xiao was shaken to the core.

他实在不明白，也不能接受她对七姑奶奶这样严酷的批评，
He could neither understand nor accept so harsh a judgment of the Seventh Lady.

楞了好一会才说∶『阿巧姐到底为了啥？
For a long while he sat stunned. At last he said, “A’qiao, what is this all about?

我实在想不通！
I truly cannot understand.

请你说给我听听看。
Please tell me.

如果是师娘不对，我们做晚辈的，当然不敢说什么；
If my master’s wife is in the wrong, those of us of the younger generation would naturally not presume to criticize her.

不过肚子里的是非是有的。』
But we know right from wrong in our hearts.”

『如果，萧少爷，你肯当着菩萨起誓，什么话只摆在肚子里；我就说给你听。』
“Young Master Xiao, if you will swear before the Bodhisattva to keep everything I say to yourself, I shall tell you.”



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第七章（本章第4部分，共4部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


『你是说，你的话不能告诉我师父，师娘？』
“You mean I must not tell my master or his wife what you say?”

『对了。』
“Exactly.”

『好！我起誓∶如果阿巧姐对我说的话，我告诉了我师父师娘，叫我天打雷劈。』
“Very well, I swear it: if I tell either of them what A’qiao tells me, may Heaven strike me dead with lightning.”

阿巧姐点头表示满意；
A’qiao nodded, satisfied.

然后说道∶『你师娘真叫「又做师娘又做鬼」——。』用这句苟刻的批评开头，阿巧且将七姑奶奶几次劝她的话『夹叙夹议』地从头细诉，
“Your master’s wife really does play both the spirit-medium and the ghost—” Beginning with this harsh judgment, she recounted in detail the several occasions on which the Seventh Lady had advised her, interweaving the conversations with comments of her own.

照她的看法，完全是七姑奶奶有意要拆散她跟胡雪岩的姻缘，
In her view, the Seventh Lady had deliberately set out to break her bond with Hu.

七姑奶奶劝她委屈，入门见礼正正式式做胡家的偏房，看似好意，
Her advice that A’qiao swallow her pride, enter the household, make the proper obeisances, and formally become Hu’s concubine only appeared well meant.

其实是虚情，
It was false kindness.

因为明知也决不愿这么做，就尽不妨这么说，好逼得不能不下堂求去。
Knowing perfectly well that A’qiao would never agree, she could safely urge it upon her and thereby force her to ask to leave.


对胡雪岩，七姑奶奶在她面前一再说他『滑头』，『没常性，见一个爱一个』；
As for Hu, the Seventh Lady had repeatedly called him “slippery,” a man with “no constancy, who falls in love with every woman he sees.”

听来是骂胡雪岩而其实是帮他。
It sounded like abuse of Hu, but in fact it helped him.

『萧少爷你想，
“Think, Young Master Xiao.

你这位师娘开口「小爷叔」，闭口』小爷叔『，
Your master’s wife is forever saying ‘Little Uncle’ this and ‘Little Uncle’ that.

敬得他来象菩萨。
She reveres him as though he were a bodhisattva.

就算他真的「滑头」、「没常性」，又怎好去说他？』
Even if he really were slippery and inconstant, how could she speak of him that way?”

阿巧姐说到这里很激动了，
A’qiao had grown agitated.

「我先倒也当她生来爽直，真的是为我抱不平，所以有啥说啥。
“At first I thought she was naturally outspoken and was truly indignant on my behalf, so she said whatever came into her head.

后来越想越不对，
Later, the more I thought, the less it seemed right.

前前后后，想了又想，才晓得她的意思，
I went over everything again and again until I understood.

无非说胡某人怎么样不是人，犯不着再跟他而已！
All she meant was that Hu was such a scoundrel that he was not worth staying with!”

『听她对七姑奶奶的指责，实在不无道理。
Her accusations against the Seventh Lady were not without reason.

但越觉得她有道理，越觉得心里难过；
Yet the more reasonable they seemed, the more painful Xiao found them.

因为萧家骥对他的这位师娘，有如幼弟之于长姐，既敬且爱。
He regarded his master’s wife as a young brother regards an elder sister, with both respect and affection.

多少年来存在心目中的一个伉爽、正直、热心、慷慨的完美印象，
For years he had cherished a perfect image of her as forthright, honest, warmhearted, and generous.

此时似乎发现了裂良，
Now he seemed to see a crack in it.

怎不教人痛心？
How could that not hurt?

因此，他竟没有一句话说。
He could not utter a word.

这一方面是感到对阿巧姐安慰，或为七姑奶奶辩护都不甚合适；另一方面也实在是沮丧得什么话都懒得说了。
Neither comforting A’qiao nor defending the Seventh Lady seemed quite appropriate; besides, he was too dejected to feel like saying anything at all.


一见萧家骥的脸色，胡雪岩吓一大跳；
The sight of Xiao’s face gave Hu a shock.

他倒象害了一场病似的。
He looked as though he had been ill.

何以跟阿巧姐见了一次，有这样的似乎受了极大刺激的神情？
What could one meeting with A’qiao have done to leave him so visibly shaken?

令人惊疑莫释，而又苦于不便深问；
Hu was troubled and bewildered, yet could hardly question him closely here.

只问得一句∶『见过面了？』
He merely asked, “Have you seen her?”

『见过了。
“Yes.

我们谢谢了尘师太，告辞吧！』
Let us thank Sister Liaochen and take our leave.”

了尘又变得很沉着了，
Liaochen had recovered her composure.

她也不提阿巧姐，只殷勤地请胡雪岩与萧家骥再来『随喜』。
She too said nothing of A’qiao, only warmly invited the two men to return and “share in the religious joys” of the place.

居姑庵中何以请男施主来随喜？
Why should men be invited to enjoy religious visits to a convent?

这话听来便令人有异样之感；只是无暇去分辨她的言外之意。
The words had an odd sound, but there was no time to consider what lay beneath them.


不过，胡雪岩对人情应酬上的过节，一向不会忽略，
Hu, however, never neglected the niceties of social dealings.

想到有件事该做，随即说了出来∶『请问，缘簿在哪里？』
Remembering something he ought to do, he asked at once, “Where is the book of donations?”

『不必客气了！』
“There is no need for such ceremony.”

胡雪岩已经发现，黄色封面的缘簿，就挂在墙壁上，
He had already spotted the yellow-covered book hanging on the wall.

便随手摘下，文给萧家骥说∶『请你写一写，写一百两银子。』
Taking it down, he handed it to Xiao. “Please enter a hundred taels for me.”

『太多了！』
“That is too much!”

了尘接口说道∶「如果说是为了宝眷住在我们这里，要写这么多，那也用不着！
Liaochen interposed. “If you mean to give so much because your lady is staying here, there is no need.

出家人受十方供养，也供养十方；
Those who have left the world receive support from all quarters and offer support to all quarters.

不必胡施主费心。
You need not concern yourself.”

『』那是两回事。『萧家骥越出他的范围，代为回答∶』各人尽各人的心意。
“Those are separate matters,” Xiao replied on Hu’s behalf, going beyond his own role. “Each of us does what is in his heart.”

『接着，萧家骥便用现成的笔砚，写了缘簿；
He used the brush and ink already laid out to make the entry.

胡雪岩取一张一百两的银两，夹在缘簿中一起放在桌上，随即告辞出庵。
Hu put a banknote for a hundred taels inside the book, placed it on the table, and took his leave.

回营谢过朱管带，仍旧由原来护送的人送回上海。
They returned to the camp to thank Commander Zhu, then rode back to Shanghai under the same escort.

一路奔驰，无暇交谈，
They traveled too fast for conversation.

到了闹区，萧家骥才勒住马说道∶『胡先生，到你府上去细谈。』
Only when they reached the busy streets did Xiao rein in his horse. “Mr Hu, let us go to your house and talk at length.”


于是遣走了那名马弁，一起到胡雪岩与阿巧姐双栖之处。
They dismissed the mounted orderly and went together to the house Hu had shared with A’qiao.

粉奁犹香，明镜如昨；
Her powder box still held its fragrance; the bright mirror stood as before.

但却别有一股凄凉的意味；
Yet the rooms had taken on a desolate air.

胡雪岩换了一个地方，在他书房中闭门深浅。
Hu chose another room, shutting himself in his study with Xiao for a private conversation.

听萧家骥转述了阿巧姐的愤慨之词，胡雪岩才知道他为何有那样的痛苦的神态。
When Xiao repeated A’qiao’s indignant words, Hu understood why he had looked so distressed.

当然，在胡雪岩也很难过；
He too was deeply troubled.

自他认识七姑奶奶以来，从未听见有人对她有这样严苛的批评，
In all the time he had known the Seventh Lady, he had never heard anyone criticize her so harshly.

如今为了自己，使她在阿巧姐口中落了个阴险小人的名声，
Now, because of him, A’qiao had branded her a treacherous schemer.

想想实在对不起七姑奶奶。
He felt he had done the Seventh Lady a great wrong.

『胡先生，』萧家骥将一路上不断在想的一句话，问了出来∶『我师娘是不是真的象阿巧姐所说的那样，是有意耍手段？』
“Mr Hu,” Xiao asked, voicing a question that had occupied him all the way back, “has my master’s wife really been deliberately maneuvering things as A’qiao says?”

『是的。』
“Yes.”

胡雪岩点点头，
Hu nodded.

『这是她过于热心之故。
“She is too eager to help.

阿巧姐的话，大致都对；
Most of what A’qiao says is true.

只有一点她弄错了。你师娘这样做，实实在在是为她打算。』
She has misunderstood only one point: your master’s wife is doing it entirely for her sake.”

接着胡雪岩便为七姑奶奶解释，
He went on to explain.

她是真正替阿巧姐的终身打算，
The Seventh Lady was sincerely considering A’qiao’s lifelong welfare.

既然不愿做偏房，不如分手，择人而事。
Since she would not become a concubine, she would do better to part from him and choose another man.

他虽不知道七姑奶奶有意为阿巧姐与张郎中撮合，但他相信，以七姑奶奶的热心待人，一定会替阿巧姐觅个妥当的归宿。
Hu did not know that the Seventh Lady intended to match her with Dr Zhang, but he believed that, with her warm concern for others, she would certainly find A’qiao a suitable home.


这番解释，萧家骥完全能够接受；
Xiao could accept this explanation completely.

甚至可以说，他所希望的，就是这样一番能为七姑奶奶洗刷恶名的解释。
Indeed, it was precisely what he had hoped for: an explanation that would clear the Seventh Lady of the charge against her.

因此神态顿时不同；
His manner changed at once.

轻快欣慰，仿佛卸下了肩上的重担似的。
He became cheerful and relieved, as though a heavy burden had slipped from his shoulders.

『原说呢，
“That is what I thought!

我师娘怎么会做这种事？
How could my master’s wife do such a thing?

她如果听说阿巧姐是这样深的误会，不知道要气成什么样子？』
If she heard how deeply A’qiao misunderstood her, there is no knowing how angry she would be.”

『对了！』
“Exactly!”

胡雪岩矍然惊觉∶『阿巧姐的话，绝对不能跟她说。』
Hu suddenly took alarm. “You must on no account tell her what A’qiao said.”

『不说又怎么交代？』
“But if we say nothing, how are we to explain?”

于是两个人商量如何搪塞七姑奶奶？
They discussed how to put the Seventh Lady off.

说没有找到，她会再托阿金去找；
If they said they had not found A’qiao, she would ask A’jin to look again.

说是已经祝发，决不肯再回家，她一定亦不会死心，自己找到白衣庵去碰钉子。
If they said A’qiao had shaved her head and absolutely refused to return, she would still persist and go to White-Robed Convent herself, only to be rebuffed.

想来想去没有妥当的办法。
However much they thought, they could find no satisfactory answer.


丢下这层不谈，萧家骥问道∶『胡先生，那末你对阿巧姐，究竟作何打算呢？』
Leaving that difficulty aside, Xiao asked, “Mr Hu, what do you mean to do about A’qiao?”

这话也使得胡雪岩很难回答；
That too was hard for Hu to answer.

心里转了好半天的念头，付之一叹∶『我只有挨骂了！』
He turned it over in his mind for a long time, then sighed. “I can only resign myself to being cursed.”

『这是说，决定割舍？』
“You mean you have decided to give her up?”

『不割舍又如何？』
“What else can I do?”

『那就这样，索性置之不理。』萧家骥说∶『心肠要硬就硬到底！』
“Then leave the matter entirely alone,” Xiao said. “If you are to harden your heart, harden it all the way.”

『是我自己良心上的事。』胡雪岩说，
“It is a matter of my own conscience,” Hu replied.

『置之不理，似乎也不是办法。』
“Ignoring her altogether hardly seems right.”

『怎么才是办法？』
“What would be right, then?

萧家骥说，『要阿巧姐心甘情愿地分手，是办不到的事。』
There is no way to make A’qiao agree willingly to the separation.”


『不求她心甘情愿，
“I do not ask for willing agreement.

只望她咽得下那口气。』
I only hope she can swallow the bitterness.”

胡雪岩作了决定∶『我想这样子办——。』他的办法是一方面用缓兵之计，隐住七姑奶奶，只说阿巧姐由白衣庵的当家师太介绍，已远赴他乡，目前正派人追下去劝驾了；
Hu made his decision. “This is what I propose—” He would first gain time and keep the Seventh Lady quiet by saying that the abbess of White-Robed Convent had sent A’qiao to another place far away, and that someone was already following to persuade her to return.

一方面要拜托怡情老二转托阿金∶第一、帮着瞒谎，不能在七姑奶奶面前道破真相；
At the same time, he would ask the Second Miss to enlist A’jin’s help. First, A’jin must support the story and never reveal the truth to the Seventh Lady.

第二、请她跟阿巧姐去见一面，转达一句话，不管阿巧姐要干什么，祝发也好，从良也好，乃至于步了尘的后尘也好，胡雪岩都不会干预，
Second, she must see A’qiao and deliver a message: whatever A’qiao wished to do—take the tonsure, marry respectably, or even follow in Liaochen’s footsteps—Hu would not interfere.

而且预备送她一大笔钱。
He was also ready to give her a large sum of money.

说完了他的打算，胡雪岩自己亦有如释重负之感；
Once he had explained the plan, Hu too felt relieved.

因为牵缠多日，终于有了快刀斩乱麻的处置。
After so many days of entanglement, he had at last found a way to cut through it.

而在萧家骥，虽并不以为这是一个好办法；只是除此以外，别无善策，
Xiao did not consider it a good solution, but could think of no better one.

而况毕竟事不干己，要想使劲出力也用不上，
Besides, it was not his own affair; however much he wished to help, there was little he could do.

只有点点头表示赞成。
He could only nod his agreement.

『事不宜迟，
“We must act at once,” Hu said.

你师娘还在等回音；
“Your master’s wife is still waiting for news.

该干什么干什么，
Let us do what needs doing.

今天晚上还要辛苦你。』
I must trouble you with more work tonight.”

『胡先生的事就等于我师父的事，』
“Your business is as much my concern as my master’s.”

萧家骥想了一下说，
Xiao thought for a moment.

『我们先去看怡情老二。』
“Let us see the Second Miss first.”


到了怡情老二那里，灯红酒绿，夜正未央。
At the Second Miss’s establishment, lamps glowed red, wine flowed, and the night was still young.

不过她是『本家』，另有自己的『小房子』；
But she was the proprietress and had a separate little house of her own.

好在相去不远，『相帮』领着，片刻就到。
Fortunately it was nearby; an attendant led them there in a few moments.

入门之时，正听得客厅里的自鸣钟打十二下；
As they entered, they heard the clock in the sitting room strike twelve.

怡情老二虽不曾睡，却已上楼回卧室了。
The Second Miss had not gone to sleep, though she had retired upstairs to her bedroom.

听得小大姐一报，她请客人上楼。
When her maid announced the visitors, she invited them up.

端午将近的天气，相当闷热；
With the Dragon Boat Festival approaching, the weather had grown close and hot.

她穿一件家常绸夹袄对客，袖管很大也很短，露出两弯雪白的膀子，
She received them in an informal lined silk jacket whose broad, short sleeves exposed her white forearms.

一只手膀上戴一支金镯，一只手腕上戴一支翠镯，
On one arm she wore a gold bracelet, on the other a jade bangle.

丰容盛髻、一副福相；
Her full face and abundant, carefully dressed hair gave her a look of prosperity and good fortune.

这使得萧家骥又生感触，相形之下，越觉得阿巧姐憔悴可怜。
The sight stirred Xiao again: by comparison, A’qiao seemed all the more worn and pitiable.

由于胡、萧十分是初次光临，怡情老二少不得有一番周旋，
Since this was the two men’s first visit to her house, the Second Miss had to observe the usual courtesies.

倒茶摆果碟子，还要『开灯』请客人『躺一息』。
She poured tea, set out dishes of fruit, and even offered to light the opium lamp and let them recline for a while.

主要殷勤，客人当然也要故作闲豫，
Before such hospitality, the guests too had to make a show of being at leisure.

先说些不相干的话，然后谈入正题。
They began with irrelevant conversation before turning to their purpose.


萧家骥刚说得一句『阿巧姐果然在白衣庵』，小大姐端着托盘进房；
Xiao had barely said, “A’qiao was at White-Robed Convent after all,” when the maid came in with a tray.

于是小酌宵夜，一面继谈此行经过。
Over a little wine and a late supper, he continued his account of the visit.

萧家骥话完；胡雪岩接着开口，拜托怡情老二从中斡旋。
When he finished, Hu asked the Second Miss to act as intermediary.

一直静听不语的怡情老二，不即置答；
She had listened without a word and did not answer at once.

事情太离奇了，她竟一时摸不清头绪。
The whole affair was so strange that she could scarcely make sense of it.

眨着眼想了好一会才摇摇头说∶『胡老爷，我看事情不是这么做法。
For a while she blinked in thought, then shook her head. “Mr Hu, I do not think that is the way to handle matters.

这件事少不得七姑奶奶！』接着，她谈到张郎中；认为七姑奶奶的做法是正办。
We cannot do without the Seventh Lady in this.” She told him about Dr Zhang and argued that the Seventh Lady’s course was the right one.

至于阿巧姐有所误会，无论如何是解释得清楚的。
A’qiao’s misunderstanding could surely be explained away.

为今之计，只有设法将阿巧姐劝了回来；化解误会，消除怨恨，归嫁张宅，
What they must do now was persuade her to return, clear up the misunderstanding, dispel her resentment, and arrange her marriage into the Zhang household.

这一切只要大家同心协心花功夫下去，一定可以有圆满的结局。
If everyone worked together patiently, there was every prospect of a happy conclusion.

『阿金不必让她插手了；决绝的话，更不可以说。
“There is no need to involve A’jin, and you certainly must not send a message that closes every door.

现在阿巧姐的心思想偏了，要耐心拿它慢慢扭过来。
A’qiao’s thoughts have taken a wrong turning; we must patiently guide them back.

七姑奶奶脾气虽毛糙，倒是最肯体恤人、最肯顾大局；
The Seventh Lady may be hasty, but no one is more considerate or more willing to think of everyone’s interests.

阿巧姐的误会，她肯原谅的，也肯委屈的。
She will forgive A’qiao’s misunderstanding and put up with some unfairness.

不过话可以跟她说明白；犯不着让她一白衣庵去碰钉了。
We can explain matters to her openly; there is no reason to let her go to the convent and be rebuffed.

我看，胡老爷——。』她有意不再说下去，是希望胡雪岩有所意会，自动作一个表示。
As I see it, Mr Hu—” She deliberately stopped, hoping that Hu would understand and volunteer the necessary offer.

而胡雪岩的心思很乱，不耐细想，
But his mind was in turmoil and he had no patience for subtlety.

率直问道∶『二阿姐，你要说啥？』
“What do you mean, Second Sister?”


『我说，胡老爷，你委屈一点，
“I mean that you should put your pride aside a little.

明天再亲自到白衣庵去一趟，陪个笑脸，说两句好话，拿阿巧姐先劝了回来再说。』这个要求，
Go to White-Robed Convent again yourself tomorrow, smile, say a few kind words, and first persuade A’qiao to return. We can consider the rest afterward.”

胡雪岩答应不下。
Hu could not agree.

三番两次，牵缠不清，以致于搁下好多正事不能办；他心里实在也厌倦了。
This repeated and endless entanglement had forced him to neglect a great deal of important business; he was thoroughly weary of it.

如今好不容易有了个快刀斩乱麻的措施，却又不能实行；
Now that he had finally found a way to cut himself free, he was to be prevented from using it.

反转要跟阿巧姐去陪笑脸，说好话，
Instead, he must smile at A’qiao and speak ingratiatingly.

不但有些于心不甘，也怕她以为自己回心转意，觉得少不得她，
He resented that; worse, he feared she would think he had changed his mind and could not do without her.

越发牵缠得紧，
She would cling to him still more tightly.

岂不是更招麻烦？
Would that not merely invite further trouble?

看他面难色，怡情老二颇为着急说∶『胡老爷，』她说∶『别样见识，我万万不及你们做官的老爷们；
Seeing his reluctance, the Second Miss grew anxious. “Mr Hu, in every other kind of judgment I am far below gentlemen in official life such as yourself.

只有这件事上，我有把握。
But on this matter I am confident.

为啥呢？
Why?

女人的心思，只有女人晓得；
Because only a woman understands a woman’s thoughts.

再说，阿巧姐跟我相处也不止一年，
Besides, A’qiao and I lived together for more than a year.

她的性情，我当然摸得透。
Naturally I know her disposition.

胡老爷，我说的是好话，
I am giving you good advice.

你不听会懊悔！』
If you refuse it, you will regret it.”

胡雪岩本对怡情老二有些成见，觉得她未免有所袒护，再听她这番话，成见自然加深，
Hu already suspected the Second Miss of being partial to A’qiao, and her words only strengthened his prejudice.

所以一时并无表示，只作个沉吟的样了，当作不以为然的答复。
He made no commitment, merely adopting a thoughtful expression to indicate his disagreement.


萧家骥旁观者清，
As an onlooker, Xiao could see more clearly.

一方面觉得怡情老二的话虽说得率直了些，而做法是高明的；
The Second Miss had spoken rather bluntly, but her approach was sound.

另一方面又知道胡雪岩的心境，这时不便固劝，越劝越坏。
Yet he also understood Hu’s state of mind: pressing him now would only make things worse.

好在巧姐的下落明了，在白衣庵多住些日子亦不要紧。
Fortunately, they knew where A’qiao was, and there was no harm in her remaining at the convent a little longer.

为了避免造成僵局，只有照『事缓则圆』这句话去做。
To avoid a deadlock, they must follow the maxim that matters settle more smoothly when given time.

『胡先生也有胡先生的难处；
“Mr Hu has his own difficulties.

不过你的宗旨是对的！』
But your intention is right.”

他加重了语气，同时对怡情老二使个眼色，
Xiao emphasized the words and gave the Second Miss a meaningful look.

『慢慢来，
“Let us take things slowly.

迟早要拿事情办通的。』
Sooner or later we shall find a way through.”

『也好。
“Very well.

请萧少爷劝劝胡老爷！』
Please try to persuade him, Young Master Xiao.”

『我知道，我知道。』萧家骥连声答应，
“I will, I will,” Xiao promised repeatedly.

『明天我给你回话。
“I shall bring you an answer tomorrow.

今天不早了，
It is late now.

走吧！』
We should be going.”


辞别出门，
They took their leave.

胡雪岩步履蹒跚，真有心力交瘁之感。
Hu walked unsteadily, utterly exhausted in body and mind.

萧家骥当然亦不便多说，只问一句∶『胡先生，你今在歇在哪里？
Xiao could hardly add anything; he only asked, “Where will you sleep tonight, Mr Hu?

我送你去。』
I shall see you there.”

『我到钱庄里去睡。』
“At the bank.

胡雪岩说道∶『你今天还要不要去见你师娘。』
Will you still go to your master’s wife tonight?”

『今天就不必去了。
“There is no need now.

这么晚！』
It is so late.”

『好的。』。
“Very well.”

胡雪岩沉吟了一会，皱眉摇头，显得不胜其烦似的，
Hu pondered a moment, then frowned and shook his head, looking unbearably harassed.

『等一两天再说吧！
“Let us leave it for a day or two.

我真的脑筋都笨了，
My mind has truly gone dull.

从来没有见过这种拉拉扯扯，弄不清爽的麻烦！
I have never known such a tangle of trouble, with everyone pulling at everyone else and nothing ever settled.”

『』那末，『萧家骥低声下气地，倒像自己惹上了麻烦，向人求教那样∶』明天见了我师娘，我应当怎么说？
“Then,” Xiao asked in a subdued voice, almost as though he himself had caused the trouble and was begging for advice, “what should I say when I see my master’s wife tomorrow?”

『这一次胡雪岩答得非常爽脆∶』只要不伤你师娘的心，怎么说都可以。
This time Hu answered promptly and decisively. “Say anything you like, provided you do not hurt her.”

『回到钱庄，只为心里懊恼，胡雪岩在床上辗转反侧，
Back at the bank, his vexation kept him tossing in bed.

直到市声渐起，方始朦胧睡去。
Only as the sounds of the city began to rise did he drift into an uneasy sleep.


正好梦方酣之时，突然被人推醒；
He was deep in a dream when someone suddenly shook him awake.

睁开涩重的睡眼，只见萧家骥笑嘻嘻地站在床前，
Opening his heavy, sore eyes, he saw Xiao standing beside the bed with a broad smile.

『胡先生，』他说，『宝眷都到了！』
“Mr Hu, your family has arrived!”

胡雪岩睡意全消，
All sleep vanished.

一骨碌地翻身而起，一面掀被，
Hu sprang up, throwing back the quilt.

一面问道∶『在哪里？』
“Where are they?”

『先到我师娘那里，
“They went first to my master’s wife.

一番皇历，恰好是宜于进屋的好日子，决定此刻就回新居。
She checked the almanac and found that today is an auspicious day for moving into a house, so they decided to go straight to the new home.

师娘着我来通知胡先生。』
She sent me to tell you.”

于是胡家母子夫妇父女相聚，恍如隔世，
Mother and son, husband and wife, father and daughter were reunited as though after a lifetime apart.

全家大小，呜咽不止；还有七姑奶奶在一旁陪着掉泪。
Everyone in the Hu household sobbed, and the Seventh Lady wept beside them.

好不容易一个个止住了哭声，细叙别后光景，
At last, one by one, they stopped crying and began to describe what had happened since their separation.

谈到悲痛之处，少不得又淌眼泪；
At every painful recollection the tears started again.

就这样谈了哭、哭了谈；一直到第三天上，胡老太太与胡雪岩的情绪，才算稳定下来。
Thus they talked and wept, wept and talked; not until the third day did Hu and his mother begin to regain their composure.

这三天之中，最忙的自然是七姑奶奶；
During those three days, the busiest person was naturally the Seventh Lady.

胡家初到上海，一切陌生，处处要她指点照料。
Newly arrived in Shanghai, the Hu family found everything unfamiliar and depended upon her guidance and care at every turn.


但是只要稍微静了下来，她就会想到阿巧姐；中年弃妇，栖身尼寺，
Yet whenever there was a quiet moment, she thought of A’qiao: a woman forsaken in middle age, taking refuge in a convent.

设身处地为她想一想，不知生趣何在？
Putting herself in A’qiao’s place, she could see little joy left in life.

因此，她不时会自惊∶不要阿巧姐寻了短见了？
From time to time an alarming thought struck her: what if A’qiao took her own life?

这种不安，与日俱增；不能不找刘不才去商量了。
Her anxiety increased each day until she had to consult Liu Bucai.

『不要紧！』刘不才答说，
“Do not worry,” he replied.

『我跟萧家骥去一趟，看情形再说。』
“I shall go there with Xiao Jiaji, and we shall see how matters stand.”

于是找到萧家骥，轻车熟路，到了白庆庵；
He found Xiao, and they set out for White-Robed Convent along the now familiar route.

一叩禅关，来应门的仍旧是小音。
When they knocked at its gate, Xiaoyin again answered.

『喔，萧施主，』
“Oh, Mr Xiao!”

小音还认得他，
She still recognized him.

『阿巧姐到了宁波去了！』
“A’qiao has gone to Ningbo.”

这个消息太突兀了，
The news was entirely unexpected.

『她到宁波去做什么？』萧家骥问。
“What has she gone to Ningbo for?” Xiao asked.

『我师父会告诉你。
“My teacher will tell you.

小音答说，』我师父说过，萧施主一定还会来，果然不错。
She said you would certainly come again, and she was right.

请进，请进。
Please come in.”

『于是两人被延入萧家骥上次到过的那座精舍中；
She conducted them to the elegant retreat Xiao had visited before.

坐不到一盏茶的工夫，了尘飘然出现，
They had scarcely sat long enough to drink a cup of tea when Liaochen appeared with a graceful step.

刘不才眼睛一亮，不由得含笑起立。
Liu’s eyes brightened, and he rose involuntarily with a smile.


『了尘师太，』萧家骥为刘不才介绍，『这位姓刘，是胡家的长亲。』
“Sister Liaochen,” Xiao said by way of introduction, “this is Mr Liu, a senior relation of the Hu family.”

『喔，请坐！』
“Ah, please sit.

了尘开门见山地说，『两位想必是来劝阿巧姐回去的。』
I suppose you have come to persuade A’qiao to return?”

『是的。
“Yes.

听小师太说，她到宁波去了？
The young sister tells us she has gone to Ningbo.

可有这话？』
Is that true?”

『前天走的。去觅归宿去了。』
“She left the day before yesterday—to seek a settled home.”

萧家骥大为惊喜，
Xiao was delighted and surprised.

『了尘师太，』他问，『关于阿巧姐的身世，想来完全知道？』
“Then I presume you know all about A’qiao’s life?”

『不错！
“I do.

就因为知道了她的身世，我才劝她到宁波去的。』
It was precisely because I knew her story that I urged her to go to Ningbo.”

『原来是了尘师太的法力无边，劝得她回了头！』
“So it was your boundless spiritual power that persuaded her to turn back!”

刘不才合十在胸，闭着眼喃喃说道∶『大功德，大功德！』
Liu brought his palms together, closed his eyes, and murmured, “A great deed of merit, a great deed of merit.”

模样有点滑稽，
He looked rather comical.

了尘不由得抿嘴一笑；对刘不才仿佛很感兴味似的。
Liaochen could not help smiling behind pursed lips and seemed to find him distinctly interesting.


『的确是一场大功德！』萧家骥问道∶『了尘师太开示她的话，能不能告诉我们听听？』
“It is indeed a great deed of merit,” Xiao said. “May we hear the instruction with which you persuaded her?”

『无非拿「因缘」二字来打动她。
“I moved her simply by speaking of causes and affinities.

我劝她，跟胡施主的缘分尽了，不必强求。
I told her that her bond with Mr Hu had run its course and must not be forced.

当初种那个因，如今结这个果，是一定的。
Having sown that cause in the beginning, she must now reap this result.

至于张郎中那面，种了新因，依旧会结果；
With Dr Zhang, however, she has sown a new cause, and that too must bear fruit.

此生不结，来世再结。
If it does not ripen in this life, it will do so in the next.

尘世轮回，就是这样一番不断的因果；
Our passage through worldly lives is nothing but this endless chain of cause and effect.

倒不如今世了掉这番因缘，来世没有宿业，就不会受苦，
Better to complete this bond in the present life; with no old karmic debt carried into the next, she need not suffer.

才是大彻大悟的大智慧人。』了尘接着又说∶『在我养静的地方，对榻而谈，
That is the course of a person of great wisdom and complete understanding.” Liaochen continued, “We talked from facing couches in my quiet retreat.

整整劝了她三天，毕竟把她劝醒了！』
For three whole days I reasoned with her, until at last she woke to the truth.”

『了不起！
“Wonderful!

了不起！苦海无边，回头是岸！』刘不才说。
Wonderful!” Liu exclaimed. “The sea of suffering is boundless, but turn your head and there is the shore.

『不是大智慧人遇着大智慧人，不会有这场圆满的功德。』
Only when one person of great wisdom meets another can such perfect merit be achieved.”

『刘施主倒真是辩才无碍。』
“Mr Liu truly has the gift of unhindered eloquence.”

了尘微笑着说，眼睛一瞟，低头无缘无故地微微笑着。
Liaochen smiled, cast him a glance, then lowered her head and smiled faintly again for no apparent reason.


『了尘师太太夸奖我了。
“You praise me too highly, Sister Liaochen.

不过，佛经我亦稍稍涉猎过，
Still, I have dipped into the Buddhist scriptures myself.

几时得求了尘师太好好开示。』
One day I must seek proper instruction from you.”

『刘施主果真向善心虔，随时请过来。』
“If you truly desire goodness and are sincere in your devotion, come whenever you wish.”

『一定要来，一定要来！』
“I certainly shall, certainly!”

刘不才张目四顾，不胜欣赏地，
Liu looked about him with open admiration.

『这样的洞天福地，得与师太对榻参禅；这份清福真不知几时修到？』了尘仍是报以矜持的微笑；
“To discuss meditation with you on facing couches in such a blessed retreat—who knows how many lifetimes of merit it would take to earn such pure enjoyment?” Liaochen answered with another reserved smile.

萧家骥怕刘不才还要噜苏，赶紧抢着开口∶『请问了尘师父，阿巧姐去了还回不回来？』
Afraid Liu would go on indefinitely, Xiao quickly intervened. “May I ask, Sister Liaochen: will A’qiao return?”

『不回来了！』
“No.”

『那末她的行李呢？
“Then what of her luggage?

也都带到了宁波？』
Has she taken it all to Ningbo?”

『不！
“No.

她一个人先去。
She went ahead alone.

张郎中随后会派人来取。』
Dr Zhang will send someone for it later.”

『张郎中派的人来了，能不能请了尘师太带句话给他，务必到阜康钱庄来一趟。』
“When his man comes, could you ask him to be sure to call at Fukang Bank?”

『不必了！』了尘答说∶『一了百了，
“There is no need,” Liaochen replied. “Once it is ended, let everything end.

请萧施主回去，也转告胡施主，缘分已尽，
Please tell Mr Hu when you return that the bond has run its course.

不必再自寻烦恼了。』
He need not go on seeking troubles for himself.”

『善哉！
“Excellent!

善哉！』
Excellent!”

刘不才高声念道∶『「欲除烦恼须无我，各有因缘莫羡人！」』
Liu intoned loudly. “‘To rid yourself of trouble, let the self be gone; each has his own affinities—envy no one else.’”


见此光景，萧骥心里不免来气；
Xiao could not help growing angry.

刘不才简直是在开搅。
Liu was simply making mischief.

一赌气之下，别的话也不问了，起身说道∶『多谢了尘师父，
In a fit of annoyance he abandoned his remaining questions and stood. “Thank you, Sister Liaochen.

我们告辞了。』
We shall take our leave.”

刘不才犹有恋恋不舍之意，萧家骥不由分说，拉了他就走。
Liu still seemed reluctant to go, but Xiao allowed no discussion and pulled him away.

一回到家，细说经过，
Back at home, he gave a full account of their visit.

古应春夫妇喜出望外；不过七姑奶奶犹有怏怏不乐之意，
Gu Yingchun and his wife were delighted beyond expectation, though the Seventh Lady remained somewhat dissatisfied.

『欠还应该问详细点！』好略有怨言。
“You ought to have asked for more details,” she complained mildly.

这一下正好触动萧家骥的怨气，
This touched Xiao’s own grievance exactly.

『师娘，』他指着刘不才说，『刘三爷跟了尘眉来眼去吊膀子，哪里有我开口的份？』
“How could I get a word in?” he asked, pointing at Liu. “Third Master Liu was busy making eyes and flirting with Liaochen!”

接着将刘不才的语言动作，描画了一遍。
He proceeded to imitate Liu’s words and gestures.

古应春夫妇大笑；七姑奶奶更是连眼泪都笑了出来。
Gu and the Seventh Lady burst out laughing; she laughed until tears came.

刘不才等他们笑停了说∶『现在该我说话了吧？』
Liu waited for them to stop. “May I speak now?”

『说，说！』七姑奶奶笑着答应，
“Speak, speak!” the Seventh Lady said, still laughing.

『刘三叔，你说。』
“Go ahead, Third Uncle Liu.”

『家骥沉不住气，
“Jiaji cannot keep his patience.

这有啥好急的？
What is there to be so anxious about?

明天我要跟了尘去「参禅」，
Tomorrow I shall go and ‘discuss meditation’ with Liaochen.

有多少话不好问她？』
What is there that I cannot ask her then?”


『对啊！
“Exactly!

刘三叔，请你问问她，越详细越好。』
Third Uncle Liu, please do ask her—the more detail the better.”

古应春当时不曾开口；过后对刘不才说∶『你的话不错，「欲除烦恼须无我，各有因缘莫羡人」。
Gu said nothing at the time, but afterward spoke privately to Liu. “Your words were right: ‘To rid yourself of trouble, let the self be gone; each has his own affinities—envy no one else.’

小爷叔跟阿巧姐这段孽缘，能够有这样一个结果，真正好极！
For Little Uncle’s unhappy bond with A’qiao to end in this way is an excellent outcome.

不必再多事了。
There is no need to stir matters up again.

刘三叔，我还劝你一句，不要去参什么禅！』
And let me give you a word of advice, Third Uncle: do not go there to discuss any meditation.”

『我原是说说好玩的。』
“I was only joking.”



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第八章（本章第1部分，共9部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第八章
CHAPTER EIGHT


左宗棠从安徽进入浙江，也是稳扎稳打，先求不败；
Entering Zhejiang from Anhui, Zuo Zongtang advanced cautiously, securing each position and making safety from defeat his first concern.

所以第一步肃清衢州，作为他浙江巡抚在本省境内发号施令之地，
His initial move was to clear Quzhou and establish a base within the province from which he could exercise his authority as governor.

这是同治元年六月初的事。
This was early in the sixth month of the first year of Tongzhi.

在衢州定了脚跟，左宗棠进一步规取龙游、兰溪、寿昌、淳安等地，将新安江以南、信安江以西地区的长毛，都撵走了；
Once firmly established there, he moved against Longyou, Lanxi, Shouchang, Chun’an, and the surrounding districts, driving the rebels out of the country south of the Xin’an River and west of the Qu River, also called Xin’an.

然后在十一月下旬，攻克了新安、信安两江交会的严州。
Late in the eleventh month, he captured Yanzhou at the confluence of the two rivers.

由此虎过山高水长的严子陵钓台，沿七里泷湖江北上，
From there his forces passed Yan Ziling’s Fishing Terrace, with its lofty hills and long reaches of water, and proceeded north along the river through Qililong.

第二年二月间进围杭州南面的富阳；距省城不足百里了。
In the second month of the following year they laid siege to Fuyang, south of Hangzhou and less than a hundred li from the provincial capital.

钱塘江南面，洋将德克碑的常捷军；丢乐德克的常安军，在不欠以前，攻克绍兴，接着，太平军又退出萧山。
South of the Qiantang River, the Changjie Army under the foreign commander d’Aiguebelle and the Chang’an Army under Diuledeke had recently captured Shaoxing; the Taiping forces then withdrew from Xiaoshan.

整个浙江的东西南三面，都已肃清；
The eastern, western, and southern regions of Zhejiang had all been cleared.

然而膏腴之地的浙北，也就是杭州以北，太湖以南，包括海宁、嘉兴、湖州在内的这一片活土，仍旧在太平军手里。
But the rich northern tract, between Hangzhou and Lake Tai and including Haining, Jiaxing, and Huzhou, remained in Taiping hands.

这时，左宗棠升任闽浙总督；
At this point Zuo was promoted to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

浙江巡抚由曾国荃补授，他人在金陵城外，无法接事，仍由左宗棠兼署。
Zeng Guoquan was appointed governor of Zhejiang, but, being outside the walls of Jinling, he could not take up the post; Zuo continued to act in his place.

为了报答朝廷，左宗棠全力反攻，
To repay the court’s favour, Zuo threw all his strength into the counter-offensive.

谁都看得出来，杭州克复是迟早间事。
Everyone could see that the recovery of Hangzhou was only a matter of time.


那时攻富阳、窥杭州的主将是浙江藩司蒋益澧。
The commander attacking Fuyang with an eye to Hangzhou was Jiang Yili, Zhejiang’s provincial treasurer.

左宗棠本人仍旧驻节衢州，设厂督造战船；
Zuo himself remained at Quzhou, where he established workshops and supervised the building of war vessels.

富阳之战，颇得舟师之力。
The flotilla proved of considerable assistance in the fighting at Fuyang.

但太平军在富阳的守将，是有名骁勇的汪海洋，因而相持五月，蒋益澧仍无进展。
But the Taiping defender was Wang Haiyang, famous for his courage, and after five months Jiang had made no progress.

左宗棠迫不得已，只好借重洋将，
Zuo was obliged to call upon the foreign commander.

札调常捷军二千五百人，由德碑率领，自萧绍渡江，会攻富阳；
He ordered d’Aiguebelle to bring twenty-five hundred men of the Changjie Army across the river from Xiaoshan and Shaoxing for a combined attack.

八月初八终于克复。
Fuyang was finally recovered on the eighth day of the eighth month.

其时也正是李鸿章 、刘铭传、郭松林合力攻克江阴；李秀成与李世贤自天京经溧阳到苏州，想设法解围的时候。
At about the same time, Li Hongzhang, Liu Mingchuan, and Guo Songlin joined forces to capture Jiangyin, while Li Xiucheng and Li Shixian travelled from the Heavenly Capital through Liyang to Suzhou, hoping to find a way to relieve the siege.

浙江方面，蒋益澧与德克碑由富阳北上，进窥杭州；同时分兵攻杭州西面的余杭。
In Zhejiang, Jiang and d’Aiguebelle advanced north from Fuyang towards Hangzhou, sending a separate force against Yuhang to the west.

太平军由『朝将』汪海洋∶『归王』邓光明∶『听王』陈炳文，连番抵御，却是杀一阵败一阵。
The Taiping commanders Wang Haiyang, the Court General, Deng Guangming, the Gui King, and Chen Bingwen, the Ting King, resisted repeatedly, but lost battle after battle.

到十一月初，左宗棠亲临余杭督师，
Early in the eleventh month, Zuo went in person to Yuhang to direct operations.

但杭州却仍在太平军苦守之中。
Hangzhou, however, was still being stubbornly defended.


其时李鸿章 已下苏州、无锡。
By then Li Hongzhang had taken Suzhou and Wuxi.

按照他预定的步骤，不愿往东去占唾手可得的常州，免得『挤』了曾国荃；
In accordance with his earlier plan, he would not move east to seize the easily obtainable prize of Changzhou, lest he encroach upon Zeng Guoquan.

却往浙北去『挤』左宗棠；
Instead, he moved into northern Zhejiang to encroach upon Zuo.

一面派翰林院侍讲面奏调到营的刘秉璋，由金山卫沿海而下，
On one side he sent Liu Bingzhang, a Hanlin lecturer whom he had personally requested from the emperor for service in his camp, south along the coast from Jinshanwei.

收复了浙北的平湖、乍浦、海盐；
Liu recovered Pinghu, Zhapu, and Haiyan.

一面派程学启由吴江经平望，南攻嘉兴。
On the other, he sent Cheng Xueqi from Wujiang through Pingwang to attack Jiaxing from the north.

收复了浙北各地，当然可以接收太平军的辎重，征粮收税；
Recovery of these districts naturally brought possession of Taiping baggage and stores, as well as the right to collect grain levies and taxes.

而且仿照当年湖北巡抚胡林翼收复安徽边境的先例，
Li also invoked the precedent of Hu Linyi, governor of Hubei, who had recovered districts on the Anhui border.

以为左宗棠远在杭州以南，道理隔阻，鞭长莫及，应该权宜代行职权，派员署理浙西收复各县的州县官。
Since Zuo was far to the south of Hangzhou, with communications obstructed and these places beyond his effective reach, Li considered it proper to exercise authority temporarily on his behalf and appoint acting magistrates to the recovered districts of western Zhejiang.

这一下气得左宗棠暴跳如雷。
Zuo was furious.

李鸿章 不但占地盘，而且江苏巡抚这个官做到浙江来了，
Li had not merely seized territory; he was carrying his office as governor of Jiangsu into Zhejiang.

未免欺人太甚！
It was an intolerable affront.

但一时无奈其何，
For the moment, however, Zuo could do nothing about it.

只好先全力收复了杭州再说。
He could only concentrate on recovering Hangzhou first.


于是，胡雪岩开始计划，重回杭州；
Hu now began planning his return to Hangzhou.

由刘不才打先锋；北去是要收服一个张秀才，化敌为友，做个内应。
Liu was to go ahead, his task being to win over a certain Licentiate Zhang, turn an enemy into a friend, and secure help from within the city.

这个张秀才本是『破靴党』，
Zhang belonged to the shabby fraternity of petty scholars who exploited their status.

自以为衣冠中人，可以走动官府，平日包揽讼事，说合是非，欺软怕硬，
Considering himself a gentleman entitled to enter official offices, he habitually took charge of lawsuits and meddled in disputes, bullying the weak and cringing before the strong.

十分无赖。
He was an utter scoundrel.

王有龄当杭州知府时，深恶其人；久已想行文学官，革他的功名，
When Wang Youling had been prefect of Hangzhou, he had detested the man and long wanted to ask the educational authorities to strip him of his degree.

只是一时不得其便，隐忍在心。
Lacking a suitable opportunity, he had kept his anger to himself.

这张秀才与各衙门的差役都有勾结——
Zhang was in league with the runners at the various government offices.

杭州各衙门的差役，有一项陋规收入，凡是有人开设商铺，照例要向该管地方衙门的差役缴纳规费，
These men enjoyed a customary illicit source of income: anyone opening a shop had to pay a fee to the runners attached to the office with jurisdiction over the premises.

看店铺大小，定数目高下，缴清规费，方得开张，
The amount varied with the size of the shop, and the fee had to be settled before business could begin.

其名叫做『吃盐水』。
This was called “drinking salt water.”

王有龄锐于任事，贴出告示，永远禁止；
Eager to discharge his duties, Wang posted a proclamation forbidding it for good.

钱塘、仁和两县的差役，心存顾忌，一时敛迹；
The runners of Qiantang and Renhe, fearful of the consequences, temporarily restrained themselves.

巡抚、藩司两衙门，自觉靠山很硬，不买知府的帐，照收不误，
Those at the governor’s and provincial treasurer’s offices, confident in their powerful superiors, paid no heed to the prefect and continued collecting.

不过自己不便出面，指使张秀才去『吃盐水』，讲明三七分帐。
Since they could not conveniently appear in person, they sent Zhang, agreeing to divide the proceeds in a ratio of three to seven.


谁知运气不好，正在盐桥大街向一家刚要开张的估衣店讲斤头，讲不下来的时候，遇到王有龄坐轿路过，
Unfortunately for him, Wang happened to pass in his sedan chair while Zhang was haggling over the sum demanded from a second-hand clothing shop about to open on Yanqiao Street.

发现其事，停轿询问，
Wang noticed the disturbance, stopped, and made inquiries.

估衣店的老板，照实陈述；
The proprietor told him exactly what had happened.

王有龄大怒，决定拿张秀才『开刀』，立个榜样。
In a rage, Wang decided to make an example of Zhang.

当时传到轿前，先申斥了一顿；疾言厉色警告，一定要革他的功名。
He summoned him before the chair, reprimanded him, and sternly declared that his degree would be revoked.

这一下张秀才慌了手脚，
Zhang panicked.

一革秀才，便成白丁，
Once stripped of his licentiate’s status, he would be a commoner.

不但见了地方官要磕头，而且可以拖翻在地打屁股；锁在衙门照墙边『枷号示众』。
He would have to kneel before the local magistrate and could be thrown to the ground and beaten on the buttocks, or fastened in a cangue beside the screen wall of the yamen for public humiliation.

想来想去只有去托王有龄言中计从的胡雪岩。
After much thought, he could see only one course: appeal to Hu, whose advice Wang ordinarily followed.

带了老婆儿女到阜康钱庄，见了胡雪岩便跪倒在地，苦苦哀示。
He brought his wife and children to Fukang Bank, fell to his knees before Hu, and pleaded desperately.

胡雪岩一时大意，只当小事一件，王有龄必肯依从，
Hu carelessly assumed that this was a small matter and Wang would oblige him.

因而满口答应，包他无事。
He promised without reservation that Zhang would come to no harm.

哪知王有龄执意不从，
But Wang refused to yield.

说这件事与他的威信有关；
His authority was at stake, he said.

他新兼署了督粮道，又奉命办理团练，
He had recently become acting grain intendant and had also been ordered to organize militia.

筹兵筹饷，号令极其重要，
In raising troops and funds, obedience to his commands was essential.

倘或这件为民除害的陋习不革，号令不行，何以服众？
If he could not abolish an abuse that harmed the people, or enforce his own proclamation, how could he command respect?

说之再三，王有龄算是让了一步。
After repeated persuasion, he finally made one concession.

本来预备革掉张秀才的功名，打他两百小板子，枷号三月；
He had intended to revoke Zhang’s degree, give him two hundred strokes with the small paddle, and expose him in the cangue for three months.

现在看胡雪岩的份上，免掉他的皮肉受苦，出乖露丑，
For Hu’s sake, he would spare the physical suffering and public disgrace.

秀才却非革不可。
But the degree must go.

说实在的，胡雪岩已经帮了他的大忙；
In truth, Hu had done Zhang an enormous service.

而他只当胡雪岩不肯尽力，塘塞敷衍，
Zhang, however, thought he had merely made excuses instead of exerting himself.

从此怀恨在心，处处为难。到现在还不肯放过胡雪岩。
He bore a grudge thereafter, obstructing Hu wherever he could, and had not relented even now.


幸好一物降一物∶『恶人自有恶人磨』，
Fortunately, everything has its master, and one rogue can be made to curb another.

张秀才什么人不怕，除了官就只怕他儿子。
Apart from officials, the only person Zhang feared was his son.

小张是个纨绔嫖赌吃着，一应俱全。
Young Zhang was a wastrel, devoted to whoring, gambling, and every luxury.

张秀才弄来的几个造孽钱，都供养了宝贝儿子。
The ill-gotten money his father scraped together all went to maintain this treasured son.

刘不才也是纨绔出身，论资格比小张深得多；
Liu had himself been a rich young idler and possessed far more experience than the younger Zhang.

所以胡雪岩想了一套办法，用刘不才从小张身上下手。
Hu therefore devised a plan to reach the father through the son.

收服了小张，不怕张秀才不就范。
Once the son was won over, the father could be brought to terms.

到杭州的第二天，刘不才就进城去访小张——
On his second day back in Hangzhou, Liu went into the city to look for the young man.

杭州的市面还萧条得很，十室九空，
Business remained desperately depressed; nine houses in ten stood empty.

只有上城清河坊、中城荐桥、下城盐桥大街，比较象个样子；
Only Qinghefang in the upper city, Jianqiao in the middle, and Yanqiao Street in the lower city retained something of their former appearance.

但是店家未到黄昏，就都上了排门，
Even there, shops put up their shutters before dusk.

入夜一片沉寂，
After nightfall everything fell silent.

除掉巡逻的长毛，几乎看不见一个百姓。
Apart from patrolling rebels, scarcely a civilian was to be seen.

但是，有几条巷子里，却是别有天地；
A few lanes, however, belonged to another world.

其中有一条在荐桥，因为中城的善后局设在这里，
One was in Jianqiao, where the middle city’s reconstruction bureau had been established.

一班地痞流氓，在张秀才指使之下，假维持地方供应长毛为名，派捐征税，俨然官府；
Under Zhang’s direction, a band of local ruffians levied contributions and taxes in the name of preserving order and supplying the rebels, acting as though they were the government itself.

日常聚会之处，少不得有烟有赌有土娼。
Their usual meeting places naturally offered opium, gambling, and unlicensed prostitutes.

刘不才心里在想，小张既是那样一个脚色，当然倚仗他老子的势力，在这种场合中当『大少爷』；
Liu reasoned that a young man of Zhang’s character would surely exploit his father’s influence to play the grand young master in such places.

一定可以找到机会跟他接近。
There he would find an opportunity to approach him.


去的时候是天刚断黑，
It was just growing dark when he arrived.

只见门口两盏大灯笼，一群挺胸凸肚的闲汉在大声说笑；
Two large lanterns hung at the entrance, where a crowd of swaggering idlers were laughing and talking loudly.

刘不才踱了过去朝里一望，
Liu strolled over and looked inside.

大门洞开，直到二厅，
The doors stood open through to the second hall.

院子里是各种卖零食的担子，厅上灯火闪耀照出黑压压的一群人，
Vendors had set up their snack stalls in the courtyard, and bright lights in the hall illuminated a dense crowd.

一望而知是个赌局。
It was plainly a gambling establishment.

是公开的赌局，就谁都可以进去；
Since it was open to the public, anyone could enter.

刘不才提脚跨上门槛，
Liu stepped over the threshold.

有个人喝一声∶『喂！』
“Hey!” someone called.

刘不才站住脚，陪个不亢不卑的笑，
He stopped with a smile that was neither servile nor arrogant.

『老兄叫我？』他问。
“Were you calling me, friend?”

『你来做啥？』
“What have you come for?”

『我来看小张。』
“To see young Zhang.”

『小张！
“Young Zhang?

哪个小张？』
Which young Zhang?”

『张秀才的大少爷。』刘不才不慌不忙地答道∶『我跟他是老朋友。』
“Licentiate Zhang’s son,” Liu replied unhurriedly. “An old friend of mine.”

这下还真冒充得对了；
His pretence was well chosen.

因为张秀才得势的缘故，他儿子大为神气，除非老朋友，没有人敢叫他小张。
With his father’s rise to power, the son had grown so important that only an old friend would dare call him merely “young Zhang.”

那个人听他言语合拢，挥挥放他进门。
Finding the answer plausible, the man waved him in.


进门到二厅，两桌赌摆在那里，一桌牌九一桌宝；
In the second hall stood two gambling tables, one for pai gow and one for bao.

牌九大概是霉庄，所以场面比那桌宝热闹得多。
The pai gow banker appeared to be losing, and his table was much livelier.

刘不才知道赌场中最犯忌在人丛中乱钻，
Liu knew that pushing through a crowd was particularly unwelcome in a gambling house.

只悄悄站在人背后，踮起脚看。
He stood quietly behind the others and rose on tiptoe to watch.

推庄的是个中年汉子，满脸横肉，油光闪亮；
The banker was a middle-aged man with a fleshy, belligerent face shining with oil.

身上穿一件缎面大毛袍子，袖口又宽又大，显然的这件贵重衣服不是他本人所有。
He wore a satin-covered robe of heavy fur, with sleeves so broad and large that the expensive garment plainly did not belong to him.

人多大概又输得急了，但见他解开大襟衣纽，一大块毛茸茸的白狐皮翻了开来，斜挂在胸前，
Whether from the crowd or the strain of his losses, he had unfastened the buttons across his chest, exposing a broad fold of white fox fur that hung diagonally down the front.

还不住喊热，扭回头去向身后的人瞪眼，是怪他们不该围得这么密不通风，害他热得透不过气来的神情。
Still complaining of the heat, he turned to glare at those behind him, as though they were to blame for crowding so close that he could hardly breathe.

『吴大炮！』上门一个少年说，
“Wu Bigmouth!” said a young man at the upper hand.

『我看你可以歇歇了。
“I think you should rest.

宁与爷争，莫与牌争！』
Argue with a man if you must, but never with the tiles!”

输了钱的人，最听不得这种话；
A losing gambler could bear no advice less easily.

然而那吴大炮似乎敢怒而不敢言，
Yet Wu seemed afraid to answer.

紧闭着嘴，将两个肋帮子鼓得老高，那副生闷气的神情，教人好笑。
He kept his lips tightly shut and puffed out his cheeks in such silent resentment that he looked comical.


『好话不听，没有法子。』那少年问家∶『你说推长庄，总也有个歇手的时候；
“If you will not listen to good advice, there is nothing I can do,” the young man continued. “You said you would bank for a long run, but you must stop sometime.

莫非一个人推到天亮？』
Do you mean to sit there until dawn?”

『是不是你要推庄？』
“Do you want to be banker?”

吴大炮有些沉不住气了，
Wu was losing patience.

从身上摸出一叠银票，
He pulled out a bundle of banknotes.

『这里二百两只多不少，
“There are at least two hundred taels here.

输光了拉倒。』
I shall stop when I have lost them.”

『银票！』
“Banknotes!”

少年顾左右而言，
The young man looked from side to side.

『这个时候用银票？
“Banknotes at a time like this?

哪家钱庄开门，好去兑银子？』
Which bank is open to redeem them?”

『一大半是阜康的票子。』吴大炮说，
“Most are Fukang notes,” Wu replied.

『阜康上海有分号，
“Fukang has a branch in Shanghai.

为啥不好兑？』
Why should they not be redeemable?”

『你倒蛮相信阜康的！
“You certainly have faith in Fukang.

不过要问问大家相信不相信？』
But you must ask whether everyone else does.”

少年扬脸回顾，
The young man looked around.

『怎么说？』
“Well?”

『银票不用，原是说明了的。』有人这样说，
“We agreed at the start: no banknotes,” someone said.

『不管阜康啥康，统通一样。
“Fukang or any other bank, it makes no difference.

要赌就是现银子。』
Gambling means silver in hand.”

『听见没有？』少年对吴大炮说，
“Did you hear?” the young man said to Wu.

『你现银子只有二、三十两了，
“You have only twenty or thirty taels in silver left.

我在上门打一记，
I shall stake against it on the upper hand.

赢了你再推下去；
If you win, keep banking.

输了让位。
If you lose, give up your place.

好不好？』
Agreed?”


吴大炮想了一下，咬一咬牙说∶『好！』
Wu thought, gritted his teeth, and agreed.

开门掷骰，是个『五在首』，
The dice were thrown: a five at the head.

吴大炮抓起牌来就往桌上一番，
Wu snatched up his tiles and turned them over at once.

是个天杠，顿时面有得色。
He had a Heaven-gong combination, and triumph appeared on his face.

那少年却慢条斯理地先翻一张，是张三六；另外一张牌还在摸，
The young man slowly exposed one tile, a three-six, while continuing to feel the other.

吴大炮却沉不住气了，哗啦一声，将所有的牌都翻了开来，
Unable to contain himself, Wu turned over all the remaining tiles with a clatter.

一面检视，一面说∶『小牌九没有「天九王」，
Examining them, he said, “There is no Heaven-nine King in small pai gow.

你拿了天牌也没用。』
Even if you have a Heaven tile, it will not help.”

刘不才在牌上的眼光最锐利，
Liu had a remarkably sharp eye for the tiles.

一目了然，失声说道∶『上门赢了，
He saw the position at once and involuntarily exclaimed, “The upper hand wins.

是张红九。』
It is a red nine!”

那少年看了他一眼，拿手一摸，喜孜孜地说∶『真叫得着！』
The young man glanced at him, ran his fingers over his tile, and smiled. “You called it exactly!”

翻开来看，
He turned it over.

果然是张红九，凑成一对；
It was indeed a red nine, completing a pair.

吴大炮气得连银子带牌往前一推，起身就走。
Furious, Wu shoved his silver and tiles forwards, stood up, and began to leave.


『吴大炮。』那少年喊道，
“Wu Bigmouth!” the young man called.

『我推庄，你怎么走了？』
“Why leave now that I am banking?”

『没有钱赌什么？』
“How can I gamble without money?”

『你的银票不是钱？
“Are your banknotes not money?

别家的我不要，阜康的票子，我不怕胡雪岩少！
I do not want those of other banks, but I am not afraid that Hu Xueyan will fail to honour Fukang’s.

拿来，
Give them to me.

我换给你。』
I shall exchange them for you.”

吴大炮听得这一说，却不过意似的，在原位上坐了下来。
Wu seemed a little abashed and sat down again.

等那少年洗牌时，便有人问道∶『小张大爷，你推大的还是推小的？』
While the young man shuffled, someone asked, “Young Master Zhang, will it be big pai gow or small?”

这小张大爷的称呼很特别；刘不才却是一喜，原来他就是张秀才的『宝贝儿子』——
The form of address was unusual, but it delighted Liu: this was the licentiate’s treasured son.

市井中畏惧张秀才，都称他张大爷；
People in the streets, afraid of the father, called him Master Zhang.

如今小张必是子以父贵，所以被称为小张大爷。
The son evidently borrowed his dignity to become Young Master Zhang.

这样想着，便整顿全神专注在小张身上。
Liu concentrated all his attention on him.

小张倒不愧纨绔，做庄家从容得很，
Zhang proved worthy of his reputation as an accomplished idler; he was perfectly at ease as banker.

砌好牌才回答那个人的问话∶『大牌九「和气」的时候多，
Only after arranging the tiles did he answer. “Big pai gow produces more ties.

经玩些。』于是文文静静地赌大牌九。
The play lasts longer.” They began a quiet game of big pai gow.

刘不才要找机会搭讪，便也下注；
Hoping for an opportunity to strike up a conversation, Liu also placed bets.

志不在赌，输赢不大，所以只是就近押在上门。
Gambling was not his object, and he kept his stakes modest, betting on the upper hand nearest him.


这个庄推得很久，
Zhang remained banker for a long time.

赌下风的去了来，来了去，长江后浪推前浪似的，将刘不才从后面推到前面，由站着变为坐下。
Bettors came and went, wave following wave, gradually pushing Liu from the back to the front until he exchanged his standing place for a seat.

这一来，他越发只守着本门下注了。
He consequently continued to bet only on his own hand.

慢慢地，小张的庄变成霉庄；
Slowly, the bank began to lose.

吴大炮扬眉吐气，大翻其本——
Wu recovered his spirits and won back his losses with a substantial profit.

下门一直是『活门』，到后来打成『一条边』，
The lower hand kept winning, until almost all the stakes were concentrated on that side.

唯一的例外，是刘不才的那一注，十两银子孤零零摆在上门，格外显眼。
The sole exception was Liu’s lonely ten taels on the upper hand, conspicuous in its isolation.

这有点独唱反调的意味，
His persistence seemed almost an act of opposition.

下风都颇讨厌；而庄家却有亲切之感，
The other bettors disliked it, but the banker felt a corresponding warmth towards him.

小张深深看了他一眼，眼中不自觉地流露出感动的神色。
Zhang gave him a long look, an involuntary expression of gratitude in his eyes.


刘不才心里在说∶有点意思了！
Now we are getting somewhere, Liu thought.

却更为沉着，静观不语。
He grew more composed still, watching silently.

『上门那一注归下门看！』吴大炮吼着。
“Count the upper-hand stake with the lower!” Wu shouted.

『对不起！』小张答道∶『讲明在先的，大家不动注码。』
“Sorry,” Zhang replied. “We agreed beforehand that no one would move the stakes.”

吴大炮无奈，只好跟刘不才打交道∶『喂！喂！上门这位老兄的注码，自己摆过来好不好？
Wu had to appeal to Liu. “Hey, friend at the upper hand! Why not move your own stake over here?

配了我再贴你一半，
If it wins, I shall add another half.

十两赢十五两。』
Your ten taels will win fifteen.”

刘不才冷冷问道∶『输了呢？』
“And if it loses?” Liu asked coldly.

『呸！』
“Bah!”

吴大炮狠狠向地下吐了口唾沫∶『活见鬼。』
Wu spat savagely on the floor. “The devil take it!”

刘不才不作声；小张却为他不平，
Liu said nothing, but Zhang took offence on his behalf.

『吴大炮！』他沉下脸来说，
“Wu Bigmouth!” he said, his expression darkening.

『赌有赌品，
“A gambler ought to have some manners.

你赌不起不要来，
If you cannot bear to play, stay away.

人家高兴赌人家的上门，
He likes betting on the upper hand.

关你鸟事！
What bloody business is it of yours?

你这样子算啥一出？』
What do you think you are doing?”

『好了，好了！』有人打岔解劝，
“Enough, enough!” someone interposed.

『都离手！
“Hands off the table.

庄家要下骰子了。』
The banker is about to throw the dice.”


骰子一下，吴大炮一把抓住，
When the dice had been cast, Wu snatched up his tiles.

放在他那毛茸茸的手中，咪着眼掀了几掀，很快地分成两副，一前一后摆得整整齐齐。
Holding them in his hairy hands, he narrowed his eyes and peeped at them repeatedly, then swiftly arranged them in two neat pairs, one before the other.

有人想看一下；手刚伸到牌上，『叭哒』一声，挨了吴大炮一下。
Someone reached out for a look and received a sharp slap on the hand.

不问可知是副好牌，
Plainly Wu held something good.

翻开来一比，天门最大；其次下门；再次庄家；上门最小。
When the tiles were exposed, the Heaven hand ranked first, the lower hand second, the banker third, and the upper hand last.

照牌路来说，下门真是『活门』。
The lower hand certainly seemed charmed.

配完了下门，庄家才吃刘不才的十两银子；
After paying it, the banker collected Liu’s ten taels.

有些不胜歉疚地说∶『我倒情愿配你。』
“I would rather have paid you,” he said apologetically.

『是啊！』刘不才平静地答道∶『我也还望着「三十年风水轮流转」，上门会转运。
“Yes,” Liu replied calmly. “I keep hoping that fortune will turn and the upper hand will have its day.

现在——，』他踌躇了一会，摸出金表来，解表坠子问道∶『拿这个当押头，借五十两银子，可以不可以？』
But now—” He hesitated, then drew out his gold watch, detached its pendant, and asked, “Could I pledge this for a loan of fifty taels?”


这表坠子是一块碧绿的悲翠，琢成古钱式样，市价起码值二百两银子；
