The pendant was a piece of vivid green jadeite carved in the shape of an ancient coin, worth at least two hundred taels.

但小张却不是因为它值钱才肯借∶『有啥不可以？
But its value was not what moved Zhang to lend. “Why not?

我借五十两银子给你，
I shall lend you fifty taels.

要啥押头？』
What need have I of a pledge?”

『不！
“No.

庄家手气有关系。』刘不才固执地，
It affects the banker’s luck,” Liu insisted.

『如果不要押头，我就不必借了。』
“If you will not take a pledge, I need not borrow.”

其实他身上有小张所信任的，阜康的银票；
In fact, he had Fukang banknotes on him—the very notes Zhang trusted.

有意如此做作，是要铺个进身之阶。
He staged the transaction to create an opening for further acquaintance.

等小张歇手，他五十两银子也输得差不多了；
By the time Zhang stopped banking, Liu had lost almost all the fifty taels.

站起身来请教住处，说第二天拿银子来赎。
He stood up and asked where Zhang lived, saying he would bring the money and redeem the pendant the next day.

『你贵姓？』小张问。
“What is your surname?” Zhang asked.

『敝姓刘。』
“Liu.”

『那我就叫你老刘。』小张说，
“Then I shall call you Old Liu.

『我倒喜欢你这个朋友，
I like you.

东西你拿回去；
Take your property back.

好在总有见面的时候，
We are bound to meet again.

你随便哪一天带钱来还我就是。』
Bring the money whenever you please.”

说着又将那块悲翠递了过来。
He held out the jadeite.

『你这样子说，我更不好收了。
“Since you put it that way, I am all the less able to accept it,” Liu replied.

府上在哪里？
“Where do you live?

我明天取了银子来赎。』
I shall fetch the silver and redeem it tomorrow.”


『说什么赎不赎？』
“Why keep talking of redemption?”

小张有些踌躇；
Zhang hesitated.

他一年三百六十五天，倒有三百天不在家，
Out of three hundred and sixty-five days in a year, he spent three hundred away from home.

姓刘的『上门不见土地』，有何用处？
What use would there be in Liu calling on an absent host?

如果为了等他，特意回家；却又怕自己把握不住自己的行踪。
He might go home specially to wait, but he could not be sure of keeping to that intention.

刘不才很机警，
Liu was quick to understand.

虽不知他心里怎么在想，反正他愿客人上门的意思，却很明显。
He did not know precisely what was in Zhang’s mind, but his reluctance to have a visitor at home was plain.

自己有意将表坠子留在他那里，原是要安排个单独相处的机会；
Leaving the pendant had merely been a means of arranging a private meeting.

这不必一定到他家，还有更好的地方。
That need not be at Zhang’s house; there was a better place.

『小张大爷，』他想定了就说∶『你如果不嫌弃，我们明天勺个地方见面，好不好？』
“Young Master Zhang,” he said, “if you have no objection, why do we not arrange to meet somewhere tomorrow?”

『好啊！
“Gladly.

你说。』
Name the place.”

『花牌楼的阿狗嫂，你总知道？』
“You know Madam A’gou at Huapailou, surely?”



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第八章（本章第2部分，共9部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


小张怎么不知道？
How could Zhang fail to know her?

阿狗嫂是有名的一个老鸨；主持一家极大的『私门头』，
Madam A’gou was a celebrated procuress who ran a very large private brothel.

凡是富春江上『江山船』中投怀送抱的船娘，一上了岸都以阿狗嫂为居停。
The boatwomen who offered their favours aboard the Jiangshan boats on the Fuchun River all lodged with her when they came ashore.

小张跟她，亦很相熟；
Zhang knew her well.

只是杭州被围，花事阑珊，乱后却还不曾见过。
But the siege of Hangzhou had ruined the pleasure trade, and he had not seen her since the upheaval.

因而小张又惊又喜地问∶『阿狗嫂倒不曾饿杀！』
“So Madam A’gou did not starve to death!” he exclaimed, surprised and delighted.

『她那里又热闹了。
“Her place is lively again.

不过我住在她后面，很清静。』
But I am staying in the rear, where it is very quiet.”

『好！
“Good!

明天下午我一定来。』
I shall certainly come tomorrow afternoon.”


刘不才的住处是阿狗嫂特地替他预备的，
Madam A’gou had prepared the rooms specially for Liu.

就在后面，单成院落，有一道腰门，闩上门便与前面隔绝；另有出入的门户。
They occupied a separate courtyard at the back, with a dividing gate that could be bolted to shut them off from the front and an entrance of their own.

『』张兄，『刘不才改了称呼，』阜康的票子你要不要？
When Zhang arrived, Liu changed his form of address. “Brother Zhang, will you accept Fukang notes?”

『』喔，我倒忘记了。
“Oh, I nearly forgot.”

『小张从身上掏出一个棉纸小包，递了过去，』
Zhang took a small tissue-paper parcel from his pocket and handed it over.

东西在这里，
“Here is your property.

你看一看！
Have a look.”

『『不必看。』
“No need.”

刘不才交了五十两一张庄票；
Liu gave him a fifty-tael banknote.

银货两讫以后，拉开橱门说道∶『张兄，我有几样小意思送你。
With the transaction settled, he opened a cupboard. “Brother Zhang, I have a few little things for you.

我们交个朋友。』
Let us be friends.”

那些『小意思』长短大小不一，长的是一枝『司的克』；小的是一个金表；大的是一副吕宋烟；还有短不及五寸，方楞折角的一包东西，就看不出来了——
The little things varied in size and shape: a long walking stick, a small gold watch, a large box of Manila cigars, and an angular rectangular parcel less than five cun long that was harder to identify.

样子象书；小张却不相信他会送自己一部书。
It looked like books, but Zhang could not believe that Liu would give him books.

而且给好赌的人送书，也嫌『触霉头』。
Besides, to give books to a gambler was to invite bad luck—the word sounded like “lose.”


『你看这枝「司的克」，
“Look at this stick.

防身的好东西。』
An excellent thing for protecting yourself.”

刘不才举起来喝一声∶『当心！』
Liu raised it. “Watch out!”

接着便当头砸了下来。
Then he brought it down towards Zhang’s head.

小张当然拿手一格，捏住了尾端。
Zhang naturally threw up a hand to block it and caught the far end.

也不知刘不才怎么一下，那根『司的克』分成两截，
With some movement of Liu’s, the stick parted in two.

握在刘不才手里的，是一枝雪亮的短剑。
What remained in his hand was a gleaming short sword.

『怎么搞的？』小张大感兴趣，
“How does it work?” Zhang asked eagerly.

『我看看，我看看。』
“Let me see!”

看那短剑，形制与中国的剑完全不同；三角形；尖端如针；剑身三面血槽，
The blade was quite unlike a Chinese sword: triangular, with a needle-sharp point and a groove along each of its three faces.

确是可以致人于死的利器。
It was unquestionably a deadly weapon.

『你看，这中间有机关。』
“There is a mechanism in the middle,” Liu explained.

原来司的克中间有榫头，做得严丝合缝，极其精细；
The join in the stick fitted with remarkable precision.

遇到有人袭击，拿司的克砸过去，
If someone attacked, its owner could strike with it.

对方不抓不过挨一下打；若是想夺它就上当了，
An opponent who did not catch it would merely suffer a blow; one who tried to seize it would fall into the trap.

正好借势一扭，抽出短剑刺过去，突出不意，必定得手。
A twist, using the other man’s grip, released the short sword for an unexpected thrust.

了解了妙用，小张越发喜爱；
Once Zhang understood its ingenuity, he liked it all the more.

防身固然得力；无事拿来献献宝，夸耀于人，更是一乐。
It would protect him, certainly; better still, he could display it and boast of it to others when nothing threatened him.


所以笑得嘴都合不拢了。『这里是几本洋书。』
He was still grinning with delight when Liu said, “Here are some foreign books.”

果然是书！
So they were books after all!

这就送得不对路了，
That gift was wide of the mark.

小张拱拱手说∶『老刘！好朋友说实话∶中国书我都不大看得懂；
Zhang clasped his hands. “Old Liu, between friends, let me be frank. I can barely understand Chinese books.

洋书更加「赵大人看榜」，莫名其妙。』
Foreign ones would leave me completely at sea.”

『你看得懂的。』
“You will understand these.”

刘不才将交到他手里，
Liu put them in his hands.

『带回去一个人慢慢看。』
“Take them home and look through them slowly, by yourself.”

这句话中，奥妙无穷，小张就非当时拆开来看不可了。
The suggestion was too intriguing: Zhang had to open the parcel immediately.

打开来一翻，顿觉血脉贲张——
A glance made his blood race.

是一部『洋春宫』。
It was a foreign erotic picture book.

这一下就目不旁观了。
Nothing else could hold his attention now.

刘不才悄悄端了张椅子扶他坐下；自己远远坐在一边，
Liu quietly brought a chair and helped him sit, then took a seat some distance away.

冷眼旁观，看他眼珠凸出，不断咽口水的穷形极相，
He watched coolly as Zhang stared and swallowed, every expression betraying his absorption.

心里越发泰然。
Liu’s confidence grew.

好不容易，小张才看完，
At last Zhang finished.

『过瘾！』他略带些窘地笑道∶『老刘，你哪里觅来的？』
“What a treat!” he said with a somewhat embarrassed smile. “Old Liu, where did you find this?”


『自然是上海夷场上。』
“In the foreign settlement at Shanghai, of course.”

『去过上海的也很多，从没有看着他们带过这些东西回来。』
“Plenty of people have been to Shanghai, but I have never seen them bring back anything like these.”

小张不胜钦服地说，
Zhang was full of admiration.

『老刘，你真有办法！』
“Old Liu, you certainly know how to manage!”

『我也没办法。
“Not at all.

这些东西，我也不知道哪里去觅？
I would not know where to find them myself.

是一个亲戚那里顺手牵来的。
I picked them up from a relative.

这话回头再说；
But we can discuss that later.

你先看看这两样东西。』
Look at these other two things first.”

这就是一大一小两个盒子；
These were the large box and the small one.

小张倒都仔细看了。
Zhang examined both carefully.

一面看，一面想，凭空受人家这份礼，实在不好意思；
As he did so, he felt ashamed to receive such presents for nothing.

不受呢，那支司的克和那部『洋书』真有些舍不得放手。
Yet he could not bear to give up the stick and the foreign books.

想了半天，委决不下，只有说老实话∶『老刘，我们初交，
After prolonged indecision, he could only speak honestly. “Old Liu, we have only just met.

你这样够朋友，我也不晓得怎么说才好？
You are so generous that I do not know what to say.

不过，我真的不大好意思。』
But I really feel rather embarrassed.”

『这你就见外了。老弟台，
“Then you are treating me as a stranger, my dear fellow.

朋友不是交一天；
Friendship is not for a single day.

要这样分彼此，以后我就不敢高攀了。』
If you insist on drawing such distinctions between us, I shall scarcely dare presume upon your acquaintance again.”

『我不分，我不分。』小张极力辩白，
“I make no distinctions!” Zhang protested earnestly.

不过，『你总也要让我尽点心意才好。』
“Only you must let me do something in return.”


看样子是收服了，
He appeared won over.

那就不必多费功夫，打铁趁热，
There was no need to labour the point; Liu would strike while the iron was hot.

『我也说老实话，
“I shall be frank too.

这些东西，不是我的；
These things do not belong to me.

是我一个亲威托我带来的。』他接着又说∶『你家老太爷，对我这个亲戚有点误会；
A relative asked me to bring them.” He added, “Your father has misunderstood this relative of mine.

不但误会，简直有点冤枉。』
More than misunderstood him—he has really done him an injustice.”

『喔，』小张问道∶「令亲是哪一个？
“Who is your relative?”

『『阜康钱庄的胡雪岩。』
“Hu Xueyan of Fukang Bank.”

小张失声说道∶『是他啊！』
“Him!” Zhang exclaimed.

『是他。
“Yes.

怎么说你家老太爷对他的误会是冤枉的呢？
Why do I say your father has wronged him through this misunderstanding?

话不说不明，
Such things must be explained.

我倒晓得一点。』
I happen to know something about it.”

小张很注意地在等他说下去，而刘不才却迟疑着不大愿意开口的样子；
Zhang waited attentively, but Liu seemed reluctant to proceed.

这就令人奇怪了，
This was puzzling.

『老刘！』小张问道∶『你不是说晓得其中的内情吗？』
“Old Liu, did you not say that you knew the inside story?”


『是的，我完全晓得。
“Yes, I know it thoroughly.

王抚台由湖州府调杭州的时候，我是从湖州跟了他来的，在他衙门里办庶务，
When Governor Wang was transferred from Huzhou to Hangzhou, I came with him and managed miscellaneous affairs in his office.

所以十分清楚。
I know exactly what happened.

不过，这件事谈起来若论是非；你家老太爷也是我长辈。
But if we discuss the rights and wrongs, your father is my elder too.

我不便说他。』
I ought not to criticize him.”

『那有什么关系？
“What does that matter?

自己人讲讲不要紧。
We are among friends.

我们家「老的」，名气大得很，
The old man at home is famous enough.

不晓得多少人说过他，
Heaven knows how many people have criticized him.

我也听得多了，又何在乎你批评他？』
I have heard plenty; why should I mind hearing you?”

『我倒不是批评他老人家，
“It is not criticism, really.

是怪他太大意，太心急了。
I only think he was too careless and impatient.

「新官上任三把火」，该当避他一避；
A newly appointed official is eager to make his authority felt; he ought to have kept out of the way for a while.

偏偏「吃盐水」让他撞见。
Instead, he was caught collecting ‘salt-water’ fees.

告示就贴在那里浆糊都还没有干，就有人拿他的话不当话，
The proclamation was still posted there—the paste was scarcely dry—yet someone was already treating the prefect’s words as nothing.

好比一巴掌打在他脸上——
It was like a slap in the face.

人家到底是杭州一府之首，管着好几县上百万的老百生；
After all, he was the head of Hangzhou prefecture, responsible for several counties and more than a million people.

这一来他那个印把子怎么捏得牢？
How could he hold his authority securely after that?

老弟，「前半夜想想人家。后半夜想想自己。」
My dear fellow, spend the first half of the night considering the other man, and the second half considering yourself.

换了你是王抚台，要不要光火？』
If you had been Governor Wang, would you not have been furious?”

小张默然。
Zhang said nothing.

倒不仅因为刘不才的话说得透彻；主要的还是因为有交情在那里，就什么话都容易听得进去了。
Liu’s reasoning was clear enough, but it was their new friendship that principally disposed him to listen.

『不错，雪岩当时没有能保得住你家老太爷的秀才。
“True, Xueyan failed to save your father’s degree.

不过，外头只知其一，不知其二；
But outsiders know only half the story.

王抚台动公事给学里老师，革掉了秀才还要办人出气。
Governor Wang not only wrote to the educational authorities to have it revoked; he intended to punish your father afterwards to satisfy his anger.

这个上头，雪岩一定不答应，
Xueyan would not consent to that.

先软后硬，王抚台才算勉强卖了个面子。』
He tried entreaty first and then defiance, until the governor reluctantly yielded.”

『喔，』
“Oh?”

小张乱眨着眼说∶『这我倒不晓。
Zhang blinked repeatedly. “I did not know that.

怎么叫「先软后硬？」』
What do you mean by entreaty and defiance?”


『软是下跪，硬是吵架。
“Entreaty meant kneeling; defiance meant a quarrel.

雪岩为了你家老太爷，要跟王抚台绝交；
Xueyan was ready to break with Governor Wang for your father’s sake.

以后倒反说他不够朋友不帮忙，
Afterwards they said he had failed as a friend and would not help.

你说冤枉不冤枉？』
Was that not unjust?”

『照你这么说，倒真的是冤枉了他？』
“As you explain it, he certainly seems to have been wronged.

小张紧接着说∶『那末，他又为啥要送我这些东西。
But why send me these things?

好人好到这样子，也就出奇了。』
It would be extraordinary to be so kind.”

『一点不奇。
“Nothing extraordinary.

他自然有事拜托你。』
Naturally, he has a favour to ask.”

『可以！』小张慨然答道∶『胡老板我不熟，不过你够朋友。
“Then ask!” Zhang replied generously. “I do not know Mr Hu well, but you have treated me as a friend.

只要我做得到，你说了我一定帮助。』
If it is something I can do, I shall certainly help.”

『说起来，不是我捧自己亲戚，
“I am not praising my own relative without cause.

胡雪岩实在是够朋友的；
Hu Xueyan really does stand by his friends.

你家老太爷对他虽有误会，他倒替你家老太爷伸好后脚，留好余地在那里了。』
Although your father has misunderstood him, he has already made provision for your father’s future and left him room to retreat.”

这两句话没头没脑，小张不明所以；但话是好话，却总听得出来，
This was too obscure for Zhang to follow, though he could tell it meant something favourable.

『这倒是谢谢他了。』他问，
“Then I must thank him.

『不知道伸好一只什么后脚？』
What sort of provision?”

『我先给你看样东西。』
“Let me show you something.”


刘不才从床底下拖出皮箱来，开了锁，取出一本『护书』，抽了一通公文，送到小张手里。
Liu dragged a leather case from beneath the bed, unlocked it, took out a document folder, and handed Zhang an official communication.

小张肚子里的墨水有限，
Zhang’s learning was limited.

不过江苏巡抚部堂的紫泥大印，是看得懂的；他父亲的名字也是认识的，此外由于公文套子转来转去，一时就弄不明白是说些什么了。
He could recognize the great purple seal of the governor of Jiangsu and his father’s name, but the elaborate official phrasing left him unable to make out the meaning.

『这件公事，千万不能说出去。
“You must never speak of this dispatch outside.

一说出去，让长毛知道了不得了。』
If word reaches the rebels, the consequences will be terrible.”

刘不才故作郑重地嘱咐；然后换了副轻快的神情说∶「你带回去，请老太爷密密收藏；
Liu assumed an air of solemn warning, then lightened his manner. “Take it home and ask your father to keep it secretly.

有一天官军克复杭州，拿出公文来看，
When the government troops recover Hangzhou, he can produce it.

不但没有助逆反叛之罪，还有维持地方之功。
Far from being guilty of aiding rebellion, he will be credited with preserving order.

你说，胡雪岩帮你家老太爷这个忙，帮得大不大。『这一说，小张方始有点明白；
Tell me, has Hu Xueyan done your father a great service or not?” Zhang began to understand.

不解的是∶』那末眼前呢？
One point still puzzled him. “What about now?

眼前做点啥？『
What are we to do now?”


『眼前，当然该做啥就做啥。
“For the present, do whatever needs doing.

不是维持地方吗，
Are you not preserving order?

照常维持好了。』
Continue as before.”

『喔，喔！』
“Ah!”

小张终于恍然大悟，
Zhang finally saw.

『这就是脚踏两头船。』
“A foot in each boat.”

『对！脚踏两头船。
“Exactly.

不过，现在所踏的这只船，早晚要翻身的；
But the boat you are standing in now will capsize sooner or later.

还是那只船要紧。』
The other boat matters more.”

『我懂。我懂。』
“I understand.”

『你们老太爷呢？』
“And your father?”

『我去跟他说，
“I shall tell him.

他一定很高兴。』
He will be delighted.

小张答说∶『明天就有回话。
You shall have an answer tomorrow.

时候不早，我也要去了。』
It is getting late; I must go.”

第二天一早，小张上门，邀刘不才到家。
Early the next morning, Zhang came to invite Liu to the family home.

张秀才早就煮酒在等了。
The licentiate was already waiting with wine warming.


为了套交情，刘不才不但口称『老伯』；而且行了大礼，
To cultivate their intimacy, Liu addressed him as “Uncle” and performed a full ceremonial bow.

将张秀才喜得有些受宠若惊的模样。
Zhang was almost overwhelmed by the honour.

『不敢当，不敢当！
“You are too kind, much too kind!

刘三哥，』他指着小张说，『我这个畜生从来不交正经朋友；
Brother Liu,” he said, pointing to his son, “this wretch never makes respectable friends.

想不到交上了你刘三哥。
Who would have thought he would meet a man like you?

真正我家门之幸。』
A blessing for our family indeed!”

『老伯说得我不曾吃酒，脸就要红了。』
“Uncle, you will make my face red before I have even drunk any wine.”

『对了，
“Quite right!

吃酒，吃酒！
Let us drink.

朋友交情，吃酒越吃越厚，赌钱越赌越薄。』
Drinking makes friendship stronger; gambling makes it weaker.”

他又骂儿子，
He scolded his son again.

『这个畜生，就是喜欢赌；
“This wretch loves gambling.

我到赌场里去，十次倒有九次遇见他。』
Nine times out of ten, when I go to a gambling house, I find him there.”

『你也不要说人家。』小张反唇相讥，
“You need not complain about others,” the son retorted.

『你去十次，九次遇见我；总还比你少一次！』
“If you go ten times and find me there nine, I still go once less than you!”

『你看看，你看看！』
“Listen to him!”

张秀才气得两撇黄胡子乱动，
Zhang’s two wisps of yellow moustache quivered with anger.

『这个畜生说的话，强词夺理。』
“The wretch twists every argument!”


刘不才看他们父不父，子不子，实在好笑∶『老伯膝下，大概就是我这位老弟一个。』他说，
The sight of a father and son each so far from the proper dignity of his role amused Liu greatly. “I suppose my young friend is your only son,” he said.

『从小宠惯了！』
“Spoiled from childhood!”

「『都是他娘宠的。
“His mother spoiled him.

家门不幸，叫你刘三哥见笑。』
A misfortune for the family, Brother Liu. We make ourselves ridiculous before you.”

『说哪里话！
“Not at all.

我倒看我这位老弟，着实能干、漂亮。绝好的外场人物。
I find him most capable and personable—admirably suited to dealing with the world.”

『一句话说到张秀才得意的地方，
This touched the father’s pride.

敛容答道∶』刘三哥，玉不琢，不成器；
Composing his face, he replied, “Brother Liu, jade must be polished before it becomes useful.

我这个畜生，鬼聪明是有的，不过要好好跟人去靡炼。
The wretch has a sort of cleverness, but he needs to follow someone and gain experience.

回头我们细谈，
We can discuss that later.

先吃酒。
First, let us drink.”

『于是宾主三人，围炉小炊；少不得先有些不着边际的闲话。
The three sat around the brazier, eating and drinking, with the usual preliminary talk of inconsequential matters.


谈到差不多，张秀才向他儿子呶一呶嘴；
When enough had been said, the father signalled with his mouth.

小张便起身出堂屋，四面看了一下，大声吩咐他家的男仆∶『贵生，你去告诉门上；老爷今天身子不舒服，不见客。
The son rose, went out of the hall, looked around, and called loudly to a servant. “Guisheng, tell the gatekeeper that the master is unwell today and will receive no visitors.

问到我，说不在家。
If anyone asks for me, say I am out.

如果有公事，下午到局子里去说。
Official business can be brought to the bureau this afternoon.”

『这便是摒绝闲杂，倾心谈秘密的先声，
This exclusion of outsiders announced that a confidential discussion was about to begin.

刘不才心里就有了预备，只待张秀才发话。
Liu prepared himself and waited.

『刘三哥，你跟雪岩至亲？』
“Brother Liu, are you a close relative of Xueyan?”

话是泛泛之词，称呼却颇具意味；
The question itself was ordinary, but the form of address was significant.

不叫『胡道台』而直呼其号，
Instead of calling him Intendant Hu, Zhang used his personal name.

这就是表示∶一则很熟；二则平起平坐的朋友。
This suggested both familiarity and equality.

刘不才再往深入细想一想，是张秀才仿佛在暗示∶他不念前嫌，有紧要话，尽说不妨。
Thinking further, Liu felt that Zhang might be implying that old resentments were forgotten and important matters could now be discussed freely.

如果自己猜得不错，那就是好征兆；
If that reading was correct, it was a good sign.

不过知人知面不知心，
Yet one could know a man’s face without knowing his heart.

又想起胡雪岩的叮嘱∶『逢人只说三分话』，所以很谨慎地答道∶『是的，我们是亲戚？』
Remembering Hu’s warning to reveal only a third of what he knew, Liu answered cautiously. “Yes, we are related.”


『怎么称呼？』
“How do you address one another?”

『雪岩算是比我晚一辈。』
“Xueyan belongs to the generation below mine.”

『啊呀呀，
“Ah!

你是雪岩的长亲，我该称你老世叔才是。』
Then, as his elder, you ought to be my honoured uncle.

张秀才说，『你又跟小儿叙朋友，
Yet you and my son call each other friends.

这样算起来，辈分排不清楚了。
We shall never straighten out the generations.

刘三哥。我们大家平叙最好！』
Brother Liu, it is best if we all meet as equals.”

『不敢！不敢！
“You are too kind.

我叫张大爷吧。』
I shall call you Master Zhang.”

刘不才不愿在礼节上头，多费功夫，
Liu had no wish to spend more time on ceremonial niceties.

急转直下地说∶『雪岩也跟我提过，说有张大爷这么一位患难之交；
He went straight on. “Xueyan mentioned you too, as a friend from difficult times.

嘱咐我这趟回杭州，一定要来看看张大爷，替他说声好。』
He particularly asked me to call on you when I returned to Hangzhou and convey his good wishes.”

『说患难之交，倒是一点不错。
“Friends from difficult times—that is perfectly true.

当初雪岩不曾得发的时候，我们在茶店里是每天见面的。
Before Xueyan prospered, we saw each other in the teahouse every day.

后来他有跟王抚台这番遇合，平步青云，
Then came his fortunate connection with Governor Wang, and he rose straight into the clouds.

眼孔就高了。
His eyes rose with him.

一班穷朋友不大在他眼里；我们也高攀不上。
He scarcely noticed his poor friends any more, and we could no longer presume on his acquaintance.

患难之交，变成了「点头朋友」。』
A friendship forged in hardship became a mere nodding acquaintance.”

这是一番牢骚，刘不才静静听他发完，自然要作解释∶『雪岩后来忙了，礼节疏漏的地方难免；
Liu listened quietly to this complaint, then naturally offered an explanation. “He became busy, and some lapses in courtesy were inevitable.

不过说到待朋友，我不是回护亲戚，雪岩无论如何「不伤道」这三个字，总还做到了的。』
But as to friendship, I am not shielding my own relative when I say that Xueyan has always managed at least to keep faith with others.”

『是啊！他外场是漂亮的。』张秀才说∶『承蒙他不弃，时世又是这个样子，过去有啥难过，也该一笔勾销，
“Yes, he knows how to conduct himself in the world,” Zhang conceded. “Since he is good enough to remember me, and times are what they are, whatever was unpleasant in the past should be wiped away.

大家重新做个朋友。』
Let us be friends afresh.”

『是！』刘不才答说，『雪岩也是这个意思。
“That is exactly his wish,” Liu replied.

说来说去，大家都是本乡本土的人，
“After all, we belong to the same place.

叶落归根，将来总要在一起。
Leaves return to their roots; one day we shall all be together again.

雪岩现在就是处处在留相见的余地。』
Xueyan is taking care everywhere to leave room for future meetings.”

这番话说得很动听，
It was beautifully put.

是劝张秀才留个相见的余地，却一点不着痕迹；
Without openly admonishing Zhang, Liu had urged him to leave just such room himself.

使得内心原为帮长毛做事而惶惑不安的张秀才，越发觉得该跟胡雪岩『重新做个朋友』了。
Already anxious about his service to the rebels, Zhang felt all the more strongly that he ought to renew his friendship with Hu.


『我也是这么想，
“I think the same.

年纪也都差不多了；时世又是如此。说真的，现在大家都是再世做人；
None of us is young any longer, and with times like these—truly, we have all lived a second life.

想想过去，看看将来，不能再糊涂了。
Looking back on the past and ahead to the future, we cannot afford to remain foolish.

我有几句话！』张秀才毅然说了出来∶『要跟刘三哥请教。
There are some things,” Zhang said resolutely, “on which I should like your advice.”

听这一说，刘不才将自己的椅子拉一拉，凑近了张秀才；两眼紧紧望着，是极其郑重、也极其诚恳的倾听之态。
Liu drew his chair nearer, fixed his eyes on Zhang, and assumed a manner of grave, sincere attention.

『明人不说暗话，
“Let us speak plainly.

雪岩的靠山是王抚台；如今已不在人世。
Xueyan’s patron was Governor Wang, who is now dead.

另外一座靠山是何制军，听说「泥菩萨过江，自身难保」。
His other support was Governor-General He, who, they say, is hard put to save himself.

既然这样子，我倒要请教刘三哥，雪岩还凭啥来混？』
In that case, Brother Liu, what has Xueyan left to rely on?”

这话问在要害上，
The question went to the heart of the matter.

刘不才不敢随便，
Liu dared not answer carelessly.

心里第一个念头是∶宁慢勿错。
Better slow than wrong, he thought.

所以一面点头，一面细想；
He nodded while considering.

如果随意编上一段关系，说胡雪岩跟京里某大老如何如何；跟某省督抚又如何如何？话也可以编得很圆，无奈张秀才决不会相信；
He could invent a plausible tale about Hu’s relations with some great man in the capital or some provincial governor, but Zhang would never believe it.

所以这是个很笨的法子。
That would be a foolish course.

刘不才认为话说得超脱些，反而动听，
A more independent answer would be more persuasive.

因而这样答道∶『靠山都是假的，
“Patrons are unreliable.

本事跟朋友才是真。
Ability and friends are what count.

有本事、有朋友，自然寻得着靠山。』他又补上一句∶『张大爷，我这两句话说得很狂。
With ability and friends, a man will naturally find a patron.” He added, “Master Zhang, those are bold words.

你老不要见气。』
Please do not take offence.”

『好！』
“Good!”

张秀才倒是颇为倾心，
Zhang was plainly impressed.

『刘三哥，听你这两句话，也是好脚色！』
“Those two sentences show that you are a man of substance yourself.”

『不敢，
“You flatter me.

我乱说。』
I am merely talking.”


『刘三哥，我再请教你，』
“Let me ask you something else, Brother Liu.”

张秀才将声音放得极低∶『你看大局怎么样？』
Zhang lowered his voice almost to a whisper. “What do you think of the general situation?”

这话就不好轻易回答了；
This could not be answered lightly.

刘不才拿眼看一看小张——小张会意，重重点头；表示但说不妨。
Liu glanced at the son, who understood and nodded emphatically: he could speak freely.

『我从前也跟张大爷一样，人好象闷在坛子里，黑漆一团；
“I used to be like you, Master Zhang, shut in a jar, with everything dark around me.

这趟在上海住了几天，
This time I spent a few days in Shanghai.

夷场上五方杂处，消息灵通。
People from every quarter gather in the foreign settlement, and news travels quickly.

稍微听到些，
I heard a little.

大家都在说∶』这个「不长的！
Everyone is saying that this will not last.”

『一面说，一面做了个手势，指一指头发，意示『这个』是指长毛。
As he spoke, he pointed to his hair, indicating the Long-haired Rebels.

张秀才听罢不响，
Zhang said nothing.

拿起水烟袋，噗噜噜、噗噜噜，抽了好一会方始开口。『你倒说说看，为啥不长？』
He took up his water pipe and smoked, bubbling away for some time before asking, “Tell me why it will not last.”

『这不是三言两语说得尽的——。』
“That cannot be explained in a few words—”


刘不才的口才很好，何况官军又实在打得很好；
Liu was an excellent speaker, and the government troops were in fact fighting very well.

两好并一好，刘不才分析局势，将张秀才说得死心塌地。
With both advantages on his side, he analysed the situation so persuasively that Zhang became entirely convinced.

他也知道他们父子的名声不好，
Zhang also knew that he and his son had bad reputations.

必得做一件惊世骇俗，大有功于乡邦的奇行伟举，才能遮掩得许多劣迹，令人刮目相看。
They needed some extraordinary deed, a conspicuous service to their native place, to cover their many misdeeds and make people see them anew.

现在有胡雪岩这条路子，岂可轻易放过？
With this opportunity through Hu before him, how could he let it pass?

『刘三哥，我想明白了，
“Brother Liu, I have made up my mind.

拜托你回复雪岩，等官军一到，撵走长毛，光复杭州，我做内应。
Tell Xueyan that, when the government troops arrive to drive out the rebels and recover Hangzhou, I shall assist them from within.

到那时候，雪岩要帮我洗刷。』
When that day comes, he must help clear my name.”

『岂止于洗刷！』刘不才答说，
“Clear it? Much more than that!” Liu replied.

『那时朝廷褒奖，授官补缺，
“The court will reward you and appoint you to office.

这个从军功上得来的官，比捐班还漂亮些！』
An office earned through military service is more honourable than one obtained by purchase.”

果然，
And so it proved.

等杭州克复，张秀才父子因为开城迎接藩司蒋益澧之功，
When Hangzhou was recovered, father and son were credited with opening the gates to welcome Provincial Treasurer Jiang Yili.

使小张获得了一张七品奖札，并被派为善后局委员。
The son received a certificate granting him the seventh rank and was appointed to the reconstruction bureau.

张秀才趁机进言，杭州的善后，非把胡雪岩请回来主持不可。
The father took the opportunity to insist that Hu must be invited back to direct Hangzhou’s reconstruction.



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第八章（本章第3部分，共9部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


蒋益澧深以为然。
Jiang Yili thoroughly agreed.

于是专程迎接胡雪岩的差使，便落到了小张身上。
The special mission to bring Hu back therefore fell to young Zhang.

到得上海，先在『仕宦行台』的长发客栈安顿下来；
On reaching Shanghai, he settled at the Changfa Inn, a lodging favoured by travelling officials.

随即找出刘不才留给他的地址，请客栈里派个小伙计去把刘不才请来。
He then found the address Liu had given him and sent a junior attendant from the inn to fetch him.

『我算到你也该来了，果不其然。』
“I reckoned you must be due, and here you are.”

刘不才再无闲话，开口就碰到小张的心坎上，
Without wasting words, Liu said exactly what Zhang wanted to hear.

『我先带你去看舍亲，
“I shall take you to see my relative first.

有啥话交代清楚；接下来就尽你玩了。』
Once your business is settled, you can enjoy yourself to your heart’s content.”

『老刘，』小张答说，『我现在是浙江善后局的委员，七品官儿。
“Old Liu, I am now a member of the Zhejiang Reconstruction Bureau, with the seventh rank.

这趟奉蒋藩台委派，特地来请胡大人回杭州；
Provincial Treasurer Jiang has specially sent me to invite His Honour Hu back to Hangzhou.

要说的就是这句话。』
That is all I have to say.”

『好！
“Good.

我晓得了。
I understand.

我们马上就走。』
Let us go at once.”

于是小张将七品官服取出来，当着客人的面更衣；
Zhang took out his seventh-rank official robes and changed in front of his visitor.

换好了不免面有窘色，自觉有些沐猴而冠的味道。
Once dressed, he looked embarrassed, feeling rather like a monkey in an official hat.

刘不才倒没有笑他；
Liu did not laugh.

只说∶『请贵管家把衣包带去，
“Have your servant bring a change of clothes,” he said.

省得再回来换便衣了。』
“That will save us returning here when you want to dress informally.”

小张带的一个长随张升，倒是一向『跟官』的，
Zhang’s attendant, Zhang Sheng, was accustomed to serving officials.

名帖、衣包，早就预备好了，
He already had the visiting cards and clothes bundle ready.

三个人一辆马车，径自来到阜康钱庄。
The three took a carriage straight to Fukang Bank.


胡雪岩跟一班米商在谈生意，正到紧要关头；
Hu was at a crucial stage in negotiations with several rice merchants.

因为小张远道而来，又是穿官服来拜访，
But Zhang had come from a distance and was calling in official dress.

只得告个罪，抛下前客，来迎后客。
Hu had to apologize to his earlier visitors and leave them to greet the newcomer.

小张是见过胡雪岩的，
Zhang had seen him before.

所以一等他踏进小客厅，不必刘不才引见，便即喊一声∶『胡老伯！』恭恭敬敬地磕下头去。
As soon as Hu entered the small reception room, without waiting for an introduction, he cried, “Uncle Hu!” and respectfully knelt to kowtow.

『不敢当，不敢当！
“You are too kind!

世兄忒多礼了。』
My young friend, you are much too ceremonious.”

胡雪岩赶紧亦跪了下去。
Hu hastily knelt as well.

对磕过头，相扶而起，少不得不家几句寒暄；然后转入正题。
After exchanging bows and helping one another up, they made the usual inquiries after the family, then turned to business.

等小张道明来意，胡雪岩答说∶『这是我义不容辞的事，
When Zhang had explained his mission, Hu replied, “It is a duty I cannot refuse.

已经在预备了。
I am already making preparations.

世兄在上海玩几天，我们一起走。』
Enjoy a few days in Shanghai, and we shall travel together.”

『是！』
“Yes, sir.”

『好了！』
“Good!”

刘不才插进来对小张说，
Liu interposed.

『话交代清楚了；
“The business is settled.

你换一换衣服，我们好走了。』
Change your clothes, and we can go.”


于是刘不才带着小张观光五光十色的夷场；
Liu took Zhang sightseeing in the dazzling foreign settlement.

到晚来吃大菜、看京戏。
In the evening they ate a Western dinner and watched Peking opera.

小张大开眼界，
Zhang’s eyes were opened to an entirely new world.

夜深入倦，兴犹未央；
Though tired late at night, he remained excited.

刘不才陪他住在长发客栈，临床夜语，直到曙色将明，方始睡去。
Liu stayed with him at the Changfa Inn, and they talked beside their beds until nearly dawn before falling asleep.

这时的胡雪岩却还未睡，
Hu was still awake.

因为他要运一万石米到杭州，
He needed to ship ten thousand shi of rice to Hangzhou.

接头了几个米商，说得好好的，到头来却又变了封，
Several merchants had agreed to supply it, only to change their minds at the last moment.

迫不得已只好去找尤五；
He had no choice but to seek out You Wu.

半夜里方始寻着，直截了当地提出要求。
Finding him only in the middle of the night, he stated his need directly.

尤五对米生意本是内行，但松江漕帮公设的米行，早已歇业，
You knew the rice trade, but the rice firm collectively run by the Grain-Boat Guild in Songjiang had long since closed.

隔膜已久；而且数量甚巨，并非叱嗟可办。
He had been out of touch for some time, and such a vast quantity could not be produced at a word.

他这几年韬光隐晦，谨言慎行，做事越发仔细；
Over the past few years he had kept out of sight, guarded his speech, and grown increasingly cautious.

没把握的事，一时不敢答应。
He dared not promise what he could not guarantee.

『小爷叔，你的吩咐，我当然不敢说个「不」字；
“Little Uncle, naturally I would not refuse an instruction from you.

不过，我的情形你也晓得的，
But you know my circumstances.

现在要办米，我还要现去找人。
To buy rice now, I should first have to find the people.

「班底」不凑手，日子上就捏不住了。
Without my old team ready to hand, I cannot be certain of the time.

从前你运米到杭州进不了城，改运宁波，不是他们答应过你的，一旦要用，照数补米？』
When you could not get your rice into Hangzhou and diverted it to Ningbo, did they not promise to replace the full quantity whenever you needed it?”


这是当初杨坊为了接济他家乡，与胡雪岩有过这样的约定。
Yang Fang had indeed made that agreement with Hu to obtain relief for his native place.

只是杨坊今非昔比，
But Yang’s position had changed.

因为白齐文劫饷殴官一案受累，在李鸿章 那里栽了大跟头，
Implicated in the affair in which Burgevine seized military funds and assaulted an official, he had fallen badly from Li Hongzhang’s favour.

现在撤职查办的处分未消，
His suspension and investigation had not yet been lifted.

哪里有实践诺言的心情和力量。
He had neither the inclination nor the means to fulfil his promise.

胡雪岩不肯乘人于危，决定自己想办法。
Hu would not take advantage of a man in distress and had decided to find his own solution.

听完他所讲的这番缘由，尤五赞叹着说∶『小爷叔，你真够朋友；
After hearing the explanation, You said admiringly, “Little Uncle, you truly stand by your friends.

不过人家姓杨的不象你。
But Yang is not like you.

他靠常胜军，着实发了一笔财；李抚台饶不过他，亦是如此。
He made a considerable fortune out of the Ever-Victorious Army, which is also why Governor Li will not let him off.

如今米虽不要他补，米款应当还你；
Even if you do not require replacement rice, he should repay the money.

当初二两多银子一石；
It cost a little over two taels a shi then.

现在涨到快六两了，还不容易采办。
Now it is nearly six, and hard to buy even at that price.

莫非你仍旧照当初的价钱跟他结算？』
Surely you do not mean to settle with him at the old rate?”

『那当然办不到的。
“Certainly not.

要衣他照市价结给我。
He must pay me at the current market price.

不然我跟他动公事，看他吃得消，吃不消？』
Otherwise I shall proceed against him through official channels and see whether he can bear it.”


『钱是不愁了，』尤五点点头，
“Then the money need not worry us,” You said, nodding.

『不过，小爷叔，你想办一万石米，实在不容易。
“But, Little Uncle, finding ten thousand shi will be extremely difficult.

这两年江苏本来缺粮，靠湖广、江西贩来；
Jiangsu has been short of grain these past two years and has depended on shipments from Huguang and Jiangxi.

去年李抚台办米运进京，还采办了洋米，
Last year, when Governor Li bought rice to send to the capital, he had to purchase foreign rice as well.

三万人办了两个月才凑齐；
Thirty thousand men worked for two months before the quantity was complete.

你此刻一个月当中要办一万石，只怕办不到。』
I fear you cannot obtain ten thousand shi within a month now.”

『不是一个月。
“It is not a month.

一个月包括运到杭州的日子在内，
The month must include delivery to Hangzhou.

最多二十天就要办齐。』
The purchase must be complete in twenty days at most.”

『那更难了。
“That is harder still.

只怕官府都办不到。』
I doubt even the authorities could manage it.”

『官府办不到，我们办得到，才算本事。』
“If we can do what the authorities cannot, that will show our ability.”

这句话等于在掂尤五的斤两。
The remark put You’s capabilities to the test.

说了两次难，不能再说第三次了；
Having spoken of difficulty twice, he could hardly do so a third time.

尤五不作声，思前想后打算了好久，还是叹口气说∶『只好大家来想办法。』
He remained silent, considering every possibility at length, before sighing. “We can only all put our heads to it.”


分头奔马，
They went off in different directions to seek help.

结果是七姑奶奶出马，找到大丰米行的老板娘『粉面虎』；
In the end it was the Seventh Lady who found the proprietress of Dafeng Rice Firm, known as the Fair-faced Tigress.

将应交的京米，以及存在怡和洋行的两千石洋米，都凑了给胡雪岩，一共是八千五百石，
She combined rice due for delivery to the capital with two thousand shi of foreign rice held at Jardine Matheson, making eighty-five hundred shi for Hu.

余数由尤五设法，很快地凑足了万石之数。
You found the remainder, quickly bringing the total to ten thousand.

米款跟杨坊办交涉，收回五万两银子；
Negotiations with Yang yielded fifty thousand taels towards the purchase price.

不足之数由胡雪岩在要凑还王有龄遗族的十二万银子中，暂时挪用。
Hu temporarily made up the shortfall from the hundred and twenty thousand he was raising to return to Wang’s surviving family.

一切顺利，
Everything went smoothly.

只十三天的工夫，沙船已经扬帆出海，
Within thirteen days, the sea junks had spread their sails.

照第一次的行程，由海宁经钱塘江到杭州望江门外。
Following the same route as the first expedition, they sailed by way of Haining and the Qiantang River to the waters outside Hangzhou’s Wangjiang Gate.


小张打前站，先回杭州，
Zhang went ahead to Hangzhou.

照胡雪岩的主意，只说有几百石米要捐献官府；
At Hu’s suggestion, he said only that a few hundred shi of rice were to be donated to the authorities.

再用一笔重礼，结交了守望江门的营官张千总，讲好接应的办法，
With a handsome gift he then cultivated Battalion Officer Zhang, who commanded at Wangjiang Gate, and arranged how they were to be received.

然后坐小船迎了上来复命，
He came out in a small boat to meet them and report.

细谈杭州的情形，实在不大高明；
His detailed account of conditions in Hangzhou was far from encouraging.

胡雪岩听完，抑郁地久久不语。
Hu listened, depressed, and remained silent for a long time.

既是至亲，而且也算长辈，刘不才说话比较可以没有顾忌；
As a close relative and an elder, Liu could speak to him with comparative freedom.

他很坦率地问道∶『雪岩，你是不是在担心有人在暗算你？』
“Xueyan, are you afraid someone is plotting against you?”

『你是指有人在左制军那里告我？
“Do you mean someone might accuse me to Governor-General Zuo?

那没有什么，
That is nothing.

他们暗算不到我的。』
They cannot harm me that way.”

『那末，你是担啥心事呢？』
“What troubles you, then?”

『怎么不要担心事？
“How can I be easy?

来日大难，眼前可忧！』
Great difficulties lie ahead, and danger is before our eyes.”

这八个字说得很雅驯，不象胡雪岩平时的口吻，因而越使得刘不才和小张奇怪。
The polished phrasing was unlike Hu’s usual speech, making both men more curious.

当然，刘不才对胡雪岩，要比小张了解得多，
Liu understood him better than Zhang did.

『来日大难，这句话他懂，因为平时听胡雪岩谈过，光复以后，恤死救生，振兴市面善后之事，头绪万端。
He knew what the future difficulties meant: Hu had often spoken of the countless tasks of reconstruction after recovery—caring for the dead, relieving the living, and restoring commerce.

可是，眼前又有何可忧呢？』
But what danger threatened them now?

我没有想到，官军的纪律亦不比长毛好多少！『胡雪岩说，』
“I never imagined the government troops’ discipline would be little better than the rebels’,” Hu said.

刚才听小张说起城里的情形，着实要担一番心事。
“What young Zhang has just told us about the city gives real cause for anxiety.

白天总还好，
Daylight may be safe enough.

只怕一到了夜里，放抢放火，奸淫掳掠都来了！
But once night falls, I fear there will be robbery, arson, rape, and looting.”

『怪不得他这样子忧心忡忡，
No wonder he was so troubled.

不管他是不是过甚其词；总不可不作预防。
Whether or not he exaggerated, precautions were plainly necessary.

小张家在城里，格外关切，失声问道∶』胡先生！
Zhang, whose home was in the city, was especially alarmed. “Mr Hu!

那，怎么办呢『
What can we do?”


『办法是有一个。
“There is one way.

不过要见着「当家人」才有用处。』
But it will be of use only if I can see the man in charge.”

整个杭州城现在是蒋益澧当家；
Jiang Yili now controlled the whole city.

小张想了一下问道∶『胡先生，我请你老人家的示，
Zhang thought for a moment. “May I ask your wishes, Mr Hu?

进了城是先跟家父见见面呢？还是直接去看杭州的「当家人」？』
When we enter, shall we see my father first, or go directly to the man in charge?”

『当然先看「当家人」。』
“The man in charge, naturally.”

『好的！』
“Very well.”

小张也很有决断，
Zhang could be decisive too.

『老刘，我们分头办事；
“Old Liu, let us divide the work.

等到上了岸，卸米的事，请你帮帮张千总的忙。
Once we land, please help Battalion Officer Zhang with the unloading.

现在秩序很乱，
Everything is disordered just now.

所谓帮忙，无非指挥指挥工人；
By helping, I mean directing the labourers.

别的，请你不必插手。』
There is no need for you to concern yourself with anything else.”

刘不才懂得他的言外之意，
Liu understood the implication.

不须负保管粮食之责；
He was not to assume responsibility for guarding the grain.

如果有散兵游勇，强索软要；听凭张千总去处理，大可袖手旁观。
If stragglers or wandering soldiers tried to extort it by force or persuasion, he could leave the matter to the officer.

『我知道了。
“I understand.

我们约定事后见面的地方好了。』
Let us agree where to meet afterwards.”

『在我舍间。』小张答说，
“At my house,” Zhang replied.

『回头我会拜托张千总，派人护送你去。』
“I shall ask the officer to have you escorted there.”

于是，胡雪岩打开小箱子，里面是一套半新旧的三品顶戴官服；
Hu opened a small chest containing a serviceable suit of official robes and the hat insignia of the third rank.

等他换穿停当，船也就到岸了。
By the time he had changed, they had reached the shore.


虽说到岸，其实还有一段距离，
Reached it, that is, as nearly as they could.

因为沙船装米，吃水很深；
Laden with rice, the sea junks drew considerable water.

而望江门外的码头失修，近岸淤浅，
The landing outside Wangjiang Gate had fallen into disrepair, and silt had made the shallows dangerous.

如果沙船靠得太近，会有搁浅之虞。
Coming too close would risk running aground.

好在重赏之下，自有勇夫，
Fortunately, a generous reward inspired willing service.

张千总颇为尽心，
Battalion Officer Zhang had taken considerable pains.

不但已找好一所荒废的大房子，派兵打扫看守，备作仓库之用；而且也扣着小船，预备接驳。
He had found a large abandoned house, posted soldiers to clean and guard it as a warehouse, and held small boats ready to transfer the cargo.

此时相度情势，又改了主意，下令士兵在浅河滩涉水负载，更为简捷。
Now, on examining the conditions, he changed his plan and ordered the soldiers to wade through the shallows with the loads, which would be quicker and simpler.

小船只用了一只，将胡雪岩、小张、刘不才和胡雪岩的跟班长贵送到岸下；
Only one small boat was used, carrying Hu, young Zhang, Liu, and Hu’s attendant Changgui ashore.

交代明白，胡、张二人就由挟着拜匣的长贵陪着，先进城了。
Once the arrangements had been explained, Hu and Zhang entered the city, accompanied by Changgui with the visiting-card case under his arm.

望见城头上飘拂的旗帜，胡雪岩感从中来，流涕不止，
At the sight of banners fluttering above the walls, emotion overcame Hu and tears streamed down his face.

他是在想王有龄；
He was thinking of Wang.

如果今天凯旋入城的主帅，不是蒋益澧而是王有龄，那有多好？
How wonderful it would have been if the victorious commander entering the city today were Wang, not Jiang!

今日之下，自然是以成败论英雄，
People naturally judged heroes by success or failure.

但打了胜仗的人不知道可会想到，王有龄当年苦守危城，岂仅心力交瘁，直是血与泪俱；
But would the victorious men remember how Wang had clung to the doomed city, exhausting not merely his strength and spirit but his very blood and tears?

所吃的苦、所用的力，远比打胜仗的人要多得多？
His suffering and exertions had far exceeded theirs.

这样想着，恨不得一进城先到王有龄殉节之处，放声痛哭一场。
Hu longed to go first to the place where Wang had died and weep aloud.

无奈百姓还在水深火热之中，
But the people were still in dire distress.

实在没有功夫让他去泄痛愤，
There was no time to release his own grief and indignation.

只好拭拭眼泪，挺起胸膛往里走！
He wiped his eyes, straightened his shoulders, and walked on.


守城的已经换了班，是个四品都司；
The guard had changed, and a fourth-rank military officer now commanded the gate.

一见胡雪岩的服气，三品文官，与蒋益澧相同，不敢怠慢，
Seeing Hu’s third-rank civil robes—the same rank as Jiang’s—he dared not be discourteous.

亲自迎上来行了礼问道∶『大人的官衔是？』
He came forward, saluted, and asked his official title.

『是胡大人。』小张代为解说，
“This is His Honour Hu,” young Zhang explained.

『从上海赶来的，有紧要公事跟蒋藩台接头。』
“He has come urgently from Shanghai to discuss important official business with Provincial Treasurer Jiang.”

这时长贵已经从拜匣里取出一张名帖递了过去；
Changgui had already taken a visiting card from the case and handed it over.

那都司不识字，
The officer could not read.

接过名帖，倒着看了一下，装模作样的说道∶『原来胡大人要见蒋大人！
He accepted the card, looked at it upside down, and said with an air of comprehension, “So His Honour Hu wishes to see His Honour Jiang!

请问，要不要护送？』
May I offer an escort?”

『能护送再好不过！』小张说道，
“Nothing could be better,” Zhang replied.

『顶要紧的是，能不能弄两匹马来？』
“Most importantly, could you find two horses?”

『马可没有。
“There are no horses.

不过，胡大人可以坐轿子。』
But His Honour Hu could take a chair.”

城门旁边，就是一家轿行；居然还有两乘空轿子在，
A sedan-chair firm stood beside the gate, with two empty chairs still available.

轿夫自然不会有，
There were naturally no bearers.

那都司倒很热心，表示可以抓些百姓来抬轿。可是胡雪岩坚决辞谢——
The officer obligingly offered to press some townspeople into service, but Hu firmly declined.

这时候还要坐轿子，简直是毫无心肝了。
To ride in a chair at a time like this would be utterly heartless.


没有马，又不肯坐轿，自然还借重自家的一双腿。
Without horses, and unwilling to use a chair, they had to depend on their own legs.

不过都司派兵护送，一路通行无阻；很顺利又到了三元坊孙宅，蒋益澧的公馆，
The officer’s soldiers escorted them, however, and they passed everywhere without obstruction, reaching the Sun residence at Sanyuanfang, where Jiang had established his headquarters.

投帖进去，中门大开；蒋益澧的中军来肃客入内。
When Hu’s card went in, the central gate was opened wide and Jiang’s staff officer came out to conduct the guest inside.

走近大厅，但见滴水檐前站着一个穿了黄马褂的将官，
Approaching the hall, Hu saw a commander in a yellow riding jacket standing beneath the eaves.

料知便是蒋益澧；胡雪岩兜头长揖∶『恭喜，
Taking him for Jiang, he bowed deeply. “Congratulations!

恭喜！』
Congratulations!”

这是贺他得胜，
He was saluting the victory.

蒋益澧拱手还礼，
Jiang returned the bow with clasped hands.

连声答道∶『彼此，彼此！』
“A joy we share!” he replied repeatedly.

于是小张抢上一步，为双方正式引见∶进入大厅，宾主东西平坐，少不得先有一番寒暄。
Young Zhang stepped forwards to make a formal introduction. They entered the hall and sat opposite one another as equals, host and guest, beginning with the customary civilities.

胡雪岩先以浙江干绅的身分，向蒋益澧道谢；
Speaking as a member of Zhejiang’s gentry, Hu thanked Jiang.

然后谈到东南兵燹，杭州受祸最深。
He then observed that, among the southeastern provinces devastated by war, Hangzhou had suffered most.

接下来便是为蒋益澧打算，而由恭维开始。
From there he turned to Jiang’s own interests, beginning with a compliment.


蒋益澧字芗泉，所以胡雪岩之称为『芗翁』；
Jiang’s courtesy name was Xiangquan, so Hu addressed him respectfully as “Mr Xiang.”

他说，『芗翁立这样一场大功，将来更上层楼，巡抚两浙，是指日可待的事。』
“With such a great achievement to your credit, your further promotion to governor of Zhejiang must be close at hand.”

『不见得，
“Not necessarily.

我亦不敢存这个妄想。』蒋益澧说∶『曾九帅有个好哥哥；
I would not dare entertain such a vain hope,” Jiang replied. “Ninth Marshal Zeng has a fine elder brother.

等金陵一下，走马上任，我还是要拿「手本」见他。』
Once Jinling falls, he will come to take office, and I shall still have to present myself as his subordinate.”

浙江巡抚是曾国荃，一直未曾到任；现在是由左宗棠兼署。
Zeng Guoquan held the appointment as governor but had never assumed his duties; Zuo was acting in his place.

蒋益澧倒有自知之明，
Jiang understood his own position.

不管从勋名、关系来说，要想取曾国荃而代之，是件不容易的事。
In military distinction and in connections alike, replacing Zeng would be no easy matter.

但是胡雪岩另有看法∶『曾九帅是大将，
Hu saw things differently. “Ninth Marshal Zeng is a great general.

金陵攻了下来，朝廷自然另有重用之处。
Once Jinling is taken, the court will surely have important work for him elsewhere.

至于浙江巡抚一席，看亦止于目前遥领；
I believe his governorship of Zhejiang is merely an appointment held from a distance for the present.

将来不会到任的。
He will not come to take it up.

芗翁，你不要泄气！』
Do not lose heart, Mr Xiang.”

『噢？』
“Oh?”

蒋益澧不自觉地将身子往前俯了一下，
Jiang leaned forwards involuntarily.

『倒要请教，何以见得曾九帅将来不会到任？』
“May I ask what makes you think he will not come?”


『这道理容易明白，
“The reasons are plain.

第一，曾九帅跟浙江素无渊源，
First, Ninth Marshal Zeng has no previous connection with Zhejiang.

人地生疏，不大相宜；
He knows neither the place nor its people, which makes the appointment unsuitable.

第二，曾大帅为人谦虚，也最肯替人设想，
Second, his elder brother is modest and most considerate of others.

浙江的局面是左大人定下来的，他决不肯让他老弟来分左大人的地盘。』
Governor-General Zuo has secured Zhejiang; Commander Zeng will never allow his younger brother to share out Zuo’s territory.”

『啊，啊！』
“Ah!”

蒋益澧精神一振，
Jiang’s spirits rose.

『雪翁见得很透彻。』
“You see the matter very clearly, Mr Xueyan.”

『照我看，将来浙江全省，特别是省城里的善后事宜，要靠芗翁一手主持。』
“In my view, the reconstruction of Zhejiang, and especially of the provincial capital, will depend entirely upon you.”

胡雪岩停了一下，
Hu paused.

看蒋益澧是聚精会神在倾听的神态，知道进言的时机已到；
Seeing Jiang listen intently, he knew the moment for his real advice had come.

便用手势加强了语气，很恳切地说∶『杭州百姓的祸福，都在芗翁手里，
Reinforcing his words with a gesture, he spoke earnestly. “The welfare or misery of Hangzhou’s people lies in your hands.

目前多保存一分元气，将来就省一分气力！』
Every measure of strength preserved now will save a measure of effort later.”

『说的是，说的是！』
“Quite so!”

蒋益澧搓着手，微显焦灼地，
Jiang rubbed his hands, showing a little anxiety.

『请雪翁指教；
“Please advise me.

只要能保存元气，我无有不尽力的！』
I shall spare no effort in preserving that strength.”

『芗翁有这样的话，真正是杭州百姓的救星。』
“With such words, you truly are the saviour of Hangzhou’s people.”

胡雪岩站起来就请了个安∶『我替杭州百姓给芗翁道谢！』
Hu rose and bowed. “On their behalf, I thank you.”

『真不敢当！』蒋益澧急忙回礼；
Jiang hastily returned the courtesy. “You honour me too much!”

同时拍着胸说∶『雪翁，你请说；保存劫后元气，应该从哪里着手？』
Touching his chest, he added, “Tell me, Mr Xueyan: where should we begin in preserving what remains after this calamity?”


『请恕我直言，
“Forgive my frankness.

芗翁只怕未必知道，各营弟兄，还难免有骚扰百姓的情形。』
You may not be fully aware that men from the various camps are still disturbing the inhabitants.”

『这——。』胡雪岩知道他有些为难。
“Well—” Hu knew that Jiang was in a difficult position.

官军打仗，为求克敌制胜，少不得想到『重赏之下，必有勇夫』这句老古话，预先许下赏赐；
To win battles, commanders inevitably recalled the old saying that generous rewards produced brave men, and promised rewards beforehand.

但筹饷筹粮，尚且困难，哪里还筹得出一笔巨款可作犒赏之用。
Yet when even military pay and provisions were hard to obtain, where could they find another great sum for bonuses?

这就不免慷他人之慨了；
They were consequently generous at other people’s expense.

或者暗示、或者默许，只要攻下一座城池，三日之内，可以不守两条军法∶抢劫与奸淫。
Whether by hint or tacit permission, soldiers might be allowed, for three days after taking a city, to disregard the two military prohibitions against robbery and rape.

蒋益澧可能亦曾有过这样计诺；
Jiang might have made such a promise.

这时候要他出告示禁止，变成主将食言，将来就难带兵了。
To issue a proclamation forbidding these acts now would make him a commander who broke his word and would hamper his ability to lead the troops in future.

因此，胡雪岩抢着打断了他的话∶『芗翁，我还有下情上禀。』
Hu therefore interrupted quickly. “Mr Xiang, there is more I must explain.”


『言重、言重！』
“You speak too gravely,” Jiang said.

蒋益澧怕他还有不中听的话说出来，搞得彼此尴尬，所以招呼打在先，
Fearing further unwelcome words that might embarrass them both, he tried to forestall them.

『雪翁的责备，自是义正辞严。
“Your reproach is entirely just.

我惟有惭愧而已。』
I can only feel ashamed.”

不说整饬军纪，只道惭愧；
He spoke of shame, not of enforcing discipline.

这话表面客气，暗中却已表示不受责备。
Courteous on the surface, the answer quietly rejected the criticism.

胡雪岩听他的语气，越觉得自己的打算是比较聪明的做法；
Hearing his tone, Hu felt still more certain that his own plan was the wiser course.

而且话也不妨得率直些。
He could also speak more directly.

『芗翁知道的，经商人。
“As you know, I am a merchant.

在商言商，讲究公平交易；
In business, we speak of fair exchange.

俗语说的礼尚往来，也无非讲究一个公平。
The customary courtesy of giving and receiving rests upon the same principle.

弟兄们拼性命救杭州的百姓，
Your men risked their lives to save Hangzhou’s people.

劳苦功高，
Their exertions and achievements were great.

朝廷虽有奖赏，地方上没有点意思表示，也就太不公平，太对不起弟兄了。』
The court may reward them, but if the locality offers no token of appreciation, it is unfair and does them an injustice.”

蒋益澧听他这段话，颇为困惑，
Jiang was puzzled.

前面的话，说得很俗气；而后面又说得很客气，
The opening sounded very worldly, the conclusion exceedingly polite.

到底主旨何在？
What was the purpose?

要细想一想，才好答话。
He needed to think before answering.

他心里在想，此人很漂亮，但也很厉害；
This was an impressive man, but a formidable one.

应付不得法，朋友变成冤家，其中的出入很大，不可不慎。
Handle him badly and a friend might become an enemy, with considerable consequences.

于是他细想了一下，终于弄明白了胡雪岩的意思；
After reflection, Jiang understood.

谦虚地答道∶『雪翁太夸奖了。
He replied modestly, “You praise us too much.

为民除寇，份所当为，
Clearing out bandits for the people is simply our duty.

哪里有什么功劳可言？』
What merit can we claim?”


『芗翁这话才真是太客气了。
“Now it is you who are too modest.

彼此一见如故，我就直言了。』胡雪岩从从容容地说∶『敝处是出了名的所谓「杭铁头」，最知道好歹，
Since we meet as though we were old friends, I shall speak plainly.” Hu continued with composure. “Our people are famous for their stubborn Hangzhou heads, but they know how to distinguish kindness from injury.

宫军有功，理当犒劳。
The government troops have served us well and deserve a reward.

不过眼前十室九空，这两年也让长毛搜括净了；
At present, however, nine homes in ten stand empty, and the rebels have stripped the place bare over the past two years.

实在没有啥好劳军的。
There is really nothing with which to honour the army.

好在杭州士绅逃难在外的，还有些人，我也大多可以联络得到。
Fortunately, a number of Hangzhou gentlemen took refuge elsewhere, and I can reach most of them.

如今我斗胆做个主，决定凑十万两银子，送到芗翁这里来，请代为谢谢弟兄们。』
I have ventured to take the responsibility of raising a hundred thousand taels and placing it in your hands, so that you may thank the men on our behalf.”

这话让蒋益澧很难回答，
Jiang found it difficult to answer.

颇有却之不恭，受之不可之感。
Refusal seemed discourteous, acceptance impossible.

因为胡雪岩的意思是很显然的，十万两银子买个『秋毫无犯』，
Hu’s intention was unmistakable: a hundred thousand taels to purchase absolute freedom from molestation.

这就是他所说∶『公平交易』∶『礼尚往来』。
That was his “fair exchange,” his “giving and receiving.”

只是十万两银子听上去是个巨数，几万人一分，所得有限，
But although a hundred thousand sounded enormous, divided among several tens of thousands of men it would give each only a modest amount.

能不能『摆得平』，大成疑问。
Whether it could settle the matter remained very doubtful.



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第八章（本章第4部分，共9部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


见他踌躇的神气，胡雪岩自能猜知他的心事，
Hu could guess the reason for Jiang’s hesitation.

若问一句∶『莫非嫌少？』未免太不客气；如果自动增加，又显得讨价还价地小气相。
To ask, “Is it too little?” would be discourteous; to increase the amount unprompted would make him seem petty, as though haggling over a price.

考虑下来，只有侧面再许他一点好处。
After consideration, he could see only one course: offer a further benefit indirectly.

『至于对芗翁的敬意，自然另有筹划——』『不，不！』蒋益澧打断他的话，
“As for a token of respect to yourself, Mr Xiang, separate arrangements will naturally be made—” “No, no!” Jiang interrupted.

『不要把我算在里头。
“Do not include me.

等局势稍为平定了，贵省士绅写京信的时候，能够说一句我蒋某人对得起浙江，就承情不尽了。』
When matters have settled a little and your province’s gentlemen write to their friends in the capital, if they can say that Jiang Yili has done his duty by Zhejiang, I shall be more than grateful.”

『那何消说得？
“That need hardly be said.

芗翁，你对得起浙江，浙江也一定对得起你！』
Mr Xiang, if you do your duty by Zhejiang, Zhejiang will certainly do its duty by you.”

『好，
“Good!

这话痛快！』
That is well spoken.”

蒋益澧毅然决然地说∶『雪翁的厚爱，我就代弟兄们一并致谢了。』接着便喊一声∶『来啊！
Jiang decided. “Then let me thank you for your generosity on behalf of all the men.” He called for an attendant.

请刘大老爷！』
“Ask Mr Liu to come.”

『刘大老爷』举人出身，捐出州县班子；
Mr Liu held the provincial examination degree and had purchased entry to the ranks eligible for prefectural and county appointments.

蒋益澧倚为智囊，也当他是文案委员。
Jiang relied upon him as an adviser and employed him as a drafting officer.

请了他来，是要商议出告示，整饬军纪，严禁骚扰。
He was summoned to discuss a proclamation enforcing military discipline and strictly prohibiting interference with the inhabitants.


这是蒋益澧的事，胡雪岩可以不管；
That was Jiang’s business; Hu need not concern himself with it.

他现在要动脑筋的是，如何实践自己的诺言，有十万两白花花的银子，解交藩库，供蒋益澧分赏弟兄？
His own problem was how to fulfil his promise: how to deliver a hundred thousand taels of shining silver to the provincial treasury for distribution among Jiang’s men.

一想到藩库，胡雪岩心中灵光一闪，仿佛暗夜迷路而发现了灯光一样，
At the thought of the treasury, an inspiration flashed through his mind, like a light seen by someone lost at night.

虽然一闪即灭，但他确信不是自己看花了眼而生的错觉，
Though it vanished at once, he was certain it had not been an illusion.

一定能够找出一条路来。
There must be a way forward.

果然，息心静虑想了一会，
He composed himself and thought quietly for a while.

大致有了成算；
A plan began to take shape.

便等蒋益澧与他的智囊谈得告一段落时，开口问道∶『芗翁的粮台在哪里？』
When Jiang’s discussion with his adviser reached a pause, Hu asked, “Where is your military supply office, Mr Xiang?”

『浙江的总粮台，跟着左大帅在余杭；
“Zhejiang’s main supply office is at Yuhang with Commander Zuo.

我有个小粮台在瓶窑。
I have a smaller one at Pingyao.

喏，』蒋益澧指着小张说，『他也是管粮台的委员。』
He”—Jiang pointed to young Zhang—“is also an officer concerned with supply.”

『那末，藩库呢？』
“And the provincial treasury?”

『藩库？』蒋益澧笑道，
“The treasury?” Jiang laughed.

『藩司衙门都还不知道在不在；
“I do not even know whether the provincial treasurer’s office still stands.

哪里谈得到藩库？』
How can we speak of a treasury?”

『藩库掌一省的收支，
“The treasury controls the revenue and expenditure of the entire province.

顶顶要紧；要尽快恢复起来。
It is of the greatest importance and should be restored as quickly as possible.

藩库的牌子一挂出去，自有解款的人上门。
Once its sign is up, people with money to remit will find their way there.

不然，就好象俗语说，「提着猪头，寻不着庙门。」
Otherwise it is like the saying: carrying a pig’s head for an offering, but unable to find the temple gate.

岂不耽误库收？』
Will that not delay receipts?”


蒋益澧也不知道这时候会有什么人来解款？
Jiang did not know who might have money to remit at such a time.

只觉得胡雪岩的忠告极有道理，藩库应该赶快恢复；
Still, Hu’s advice sounded entirely reasonable: the treasury ought to be restored promptly.

可是该如何恢复，应派什么人管库办事？却是茫无所知。
How to restore it, and whom to put in charge, he had no idea.

于是胡雪岩为他讲解钱庄代理公库的例规与好处。
Hu therefore explained the established practice and advantages of a private bank acting for a public treasury.

阜康从前代理浙江藩库，如今仍愿效力；
Fukang had formerly handled Zhejiang’s provincial treasury and was willing to serve again.

不过以前人欠欠人犹待清理，
But its old debts and credits still required settlement.

为了划清界限起见，他想另立一爿钱庄，叫做『阜丰』。
To keep the old and new business distinct, he proposed to establish another bank, called Fufeng.

『阜丰就是阜康，不过多挂一块招牌。
“Fufeng is Fukang, with an additional signboard.

外面有区分，内部是一样的，
They will be distinct to the outside world, but internally the same.

叫阜丰，叫阜康都可以。
Either name will do.

芗翁！』胡雪岩说，『我这样做法，完全是为了公家；
Mr Xiang, I am doing this entirely for the public service.

阜康收进旧欠，解交阜丰，也就是解交芗翁。
When Fukang collects outstanding debts and transfers the proceeds to Fufeng, that means transferring them to you.

至于以前藩库欠人家的，看情形该付的付，该缓的缓，急公缓私，
As for what the old treasury owed others, we can judge each case: pay what must be paid and postpone what may wait, giving urgent public needs priority over private claims.

岂非大有伸缩的余地？』
Will that not leave us considerable room to manoeuvre?”

『好，好！
“Excellent!”

准定委托雪翁。』蒋益澧大为欣喜，
Jiang was delighted. “I shall certainly entrust it to you.

『阜丰也好，阜康也好，
Fufeng or Fukang, it makes no difference.

我只认雪翁。』
You are the man I rely on.”

『既蒙委任，我一定尽心尽力。』
“Since you honour me with the commission, I shall do my utmost.”

胡雪岩略停一下又说∶『应该解缴的十万银子，我去筹划；看目前在杭州能凑多少现银？
Hu paused briefly. “I shall arrange the hundred thousand taels I have promised, seeing how much ready silver can be raised in Hangzhou.

不足之数归我垫；
I shall advance the shortfall myself.

为了省事，我想划一笔帐；
For convenience, I propose an adjustment between the accounts.

这一来粮台、藩库彼此方便。』
That will suit both the supply office and the treasury.”

『这，这笔帐怎么划法？』
“How would the accounts be adjusted?”


是这样，譬如说现在能凑出一半现银，
“Suppose we can raise half the amount in silver here.

我就先解了上来；
I shall deliver that first.

另外一半，我打一张票子交到粮台，随时可以在我上海的阜丰兑现。
For the other half, I shall give the supply office a note redeemable at any time at my Fufeng bank in Shanghai.

倘或交通不便，一时不能去提现，那也不要紧，
If communications are difficult and the money cannot immediately be collected, that need not matter.

阜丰代理藩库，一切代垫，就等于缴了现银；
As Fufeng will be acting for the provincial treasury, any expenditure it advances on the treasury’s behalf will count as cash paid against the note.

藩库跟粮台划一笔帐就可以了。
The treasury and the supply office need only make the corresponding adjustment.

垫多少扣多少；按月结帐。
Each advance will be deducted, with the accounts settled monthly.”

『听他说得头头是道，
Hu made it sound entirely orderly.

蒋益澧只觉得振振有词，到底这笔帐怎么算，还得要细想一想，才能明白。
Jiang found the argument persuasive, but needed to think carefully before he understood how the entries would work.

想是想明白了，却有疑问∶『藩库的收入呢？
When he did, a question remained. “What about the treasury’s receipts?

是不是先还你的垫款？』
Will those first repay your advances?”

这，怎么可以？
“How could I do that?”

『胡雪岩的身子蓦然往后一仰，靠在椅背上，不断摇头；似乎觉得他所问的这句话，太出乎常情似的。
Hu suddenly leaned back against his chair, shaking his head repeatedly, as though the very suggestion were beyond ordinary reason.

光是这一个动作，就使得蒋益澧死心塌地了。
That gesture alone won Jiang’s complete confidence.

他觉得胡雪岩不但诚实，而且心好，真能拿别人的利害当自己的祸福。
He felt that Hu was not merely honest but kind-hearted, genuinely able to treat another man’s interests as his own.

不过太好了反不易使人相信；
Yet the offer seemed almost too generous to believe.

他深信是自己有所误会，还是问清楚的好。
Jiang was sure he must have misunderstood and thought it best to clarify.

『雪翁，』他很谨慎地措词，『你的意思是，在你开给粮台的银票数目之内，你替藩库代垫；就算是你陆续兑现。
“Mr Xueyan,” he asked cautiously, “do you mean that, up to the amount of the note you give the supply office, your advances for the treasury will count as successive payments redeeming it?

至于藩库的收入，你还是照缴。是不是这话？』
Meanwhile, you will still remit the treasury’s receipts in full?”


『是！就是这话。』胡雪岩紧接着说，
“Yes, exactly.” Hu continued at once.

『哪怕划帐已经清楚了，阜丰既然代理浙江藩库，当然要顾浙江藩司的面子，
“Even after that account has been cleared, Fufeng, as agent for Zhejiang’s treasury, must uphold the credit of Zhejiang’s provincial treasurer.

还是照垫不误。』
We shall continue to make advances.”

这一下，蒋益澧不但倾倒，简直有些感激了，
Jiang was now not merely convinced but grateful.

拱拱手说∶『一切仰仗雪翁，
Clasping his hands, he said, “We shall depend upon you in everything.

就请宝号代理藩库；
Your bank shall act for the treasury.

要不要备公事给老兄？』
Would you like an official letter of appointment?”

『芗翁是朝廷的监司大员，
“You are a high provincial official appointed by the court.

说出一句话，自然算数；
Your word is sufficient.

有没有公事，在我都是无所谓的。
To me, the presence or absence of a document makes no difference.

不过为了取信于人，阜丰代理藩库，要请一张告示。』
But to establish confidence with others, I should like a proclamation announcing Fufeng’s appointment.”

『那方便得很！
“Easily done.

我马上叫他们办。』
I shall have it prepared at once.”

『我也马上叫他们连夜预备；明天就拿告示贴出去。
“I too shall have preparations made overnight, and tomorrow we can post the notices.

不过，』胡雪岩略略放低了声音，『什么款该付，什么款不该付，实在不该付，阜丰听命而行。
But”—Hu lowered his voice—“as to which payments should be made, which should wait, and which really must not be made, Fufeng will obey your instructions.

请芗翁给个暗号，以便遵循。』
Please give us a private sign to guide us.”

『给个暗号？』
“A private sign?”

蒋益澧搔搔头，显得很为难似的。
Jiang scratched his head, looking perplexed.

这倒是小张比他内行了，
Young Zhang understood this better than he did.

『大人！』
“Your Honour!” he said.


他是『做此官，行此礼』，将『大人』二字叫得非常自然；
Now that he held office, Zhang performed its courtesies, and “Your Honour” came very naturally.

等蒋益澧转脸相看时，他才又往下说∶『做当家人很难，
When Jiang turned towards him, he continued. “It is difficult to be the man in charge.

有时候要粮与饷，明知道不能给，却又不便驳，
Sometimes men ask for provisions or pay, and although you know it cannot be given, you cannot conveniently refuse.

只好批示照发；粮台上也当然遵办。
You have to endorse the request for payment, and the supply office must of course comply.

但实在无银无饷，就只好婉言情商。
Yet if there is truly neither money nor food, it must find tactful ways of discussing the matter.

胡观察的意思，就是怕大人为难，
Intendant Hu means to spare you embarrassment.

先约定暗号，知道了大人的意思，就好想办法敷衍了。』
With a signal agreed beforehand, he will know your wishes and can find a way to put the applicants off.”

『啊，啊！』
“Ah!”

蒋益澧恍然大悟，『我懂了。
Jiang understood.

我一直就为这件事伤脑筋。
“This has troubled me continually.

都是出生入死的老弟兄，何况是欠了他们的饷；
These are old comrades who have faced death with me, and their pay is already in arrears.

你说，拿了「印领」来叫我批，我好不批照发吗？
When they bring sealed claims for my endorsement, how can I refuse to approve them?

批归批，粮台上受得了、受不了，又是另外一回事。
But whether the supply office can bear the expenditure is another matter.

结果呢，往往该给的没有给；不该给的，倒领了去了。
Often those who should be paid receive nothing, while those who should not receive anything get their money.

粮台不知有多少回跟我诉苦，甚至跳脚。我亦无可奈何。
The supply office has complained to me countless times, sometimes stamping in exasperation, and I have been helpless.

现在有这样一个「好人」我做，「坏人」别人去做的办法，那是太好了。
A method that lets me play the good man while someone else plays the bad one—that is excellent.

该用什么暗号，请雪翁吩咐。』
Tell me what signal to use.”

『不敢当！』胡雪岩答道，
“You are too kind,” Hu replied.

『暗号要常常变换，才不会让人识透。
“The signal must change frequently to prevent people from discovering it.

现在我先定个简单的办法，
For the moment, let us begin simply.

芗翁具衔只批一个「澧」字，阜丰全数照付；
If you sign with the single character ‘Li,’ Fufeng will pay in full.

写台甫「益澧」二字，付一半；
If you write the two characters of your given name, ‘Yili,’ it will pay half.

若是尊姓大名一起写在上头，就是「不准」的意思，阜丰自会想办法塘塞。』
If you sign your full name, surname included, that will mean refusal, and Fufeng will find an excuse.”

『那太好了！』
“Excellent!”

蒋益澧拍着手说∶『「听君一席话，胜做十年官。」』
Jiang clapped his hands. “One conversation with you is worth ten years in office!”


宾主相视大笑，真有莫逆于心之感。
Host and guest looked at one another and laughed, feeling a complete understanding between them.

文情到此，胡雪岩觉得有些事，大可不必保留了；
With relations so warm, Hu thought there were matters he need no longer withhold.

因而向小张使个眼色，只轻轻说了一个字∶『米！』然后微一努嘴。
He glanced at young Zhang, whispered the single word “Rice,” and made a slight motion with his lips.

小张也是玲珑剔透的一颗心，察言辨色，完全领会，
Zhang was quick to read both words and expression.

斜欠着身子，当即开口向蒋益澧说道∶『有件事要跟大人回禀，
Leaning forwards, he addressed Jiang. “There is something I must report.

那几百石米，已经请张千总跟胡观察的令亲在起卸了。
Battalion Officer Zhang and Intendant Hu’s relative are unloading the few hundred shi of rice.

暂时存仓，听候支用。
It will be stored temporarily pending instructions.

这几百石米，我先前未说来源；
I did not previously explain where it came from.

如今应该说明了，就是胡观察运来的。数目远不止这些。』
I should now say that Intendant Hu brought it, and the quantity is far greater.”

『喔，有多少？』蒋益澧异常关切地说。
“How much?” Jiang asked with intense interest.

『总有上万石。』胡雪岩说道∶『这批米，我是专为接济官军与杭州百姓的。
“Ten thousand shi or more,” Hu replied. “I brought it expressly to relieve the government troops and the people of Hangzhou.

照道理说，应该解缴芗翁，才是正办。
Strictly speaking, the proper course would be to deliver it to you.

不过，我也有些苦衷；
But I have a difficulty of my own.

好不好请芗翁赏我一个面子，这批米算是暂时责成我保管；
Could you do me the favour of leaving it temporarily in my custody?

等我见了左制军，横竖还是要交给芗翁来作主公派的。
After I have seen Governor-General Zuo, it will in any case be placed at your disposal for public distribution.

只不过日子晚一两天而已。』
The delay will be only a day or two.”

蒋益澧大出意外。
Jiang was astonished.

军兴以外，特别是浙江，饿死人不足为奇；
Since the war began, especially in Zhejiang, death by starvation had become commonplace.

如今忽有一万石米出现，真如从天而降，
The sudden appearance of ten thousand shi of rice was like a gift from Heaven.

怎不令人惊喜交集。
How could he fail to be amazed and delighted?


『雪翁你这一万石米，岂止雪中送炭？
“Mr Xueyan, your rice is more than charcoal brought through the snow.

简直是大旱甘霖！
It is rain in a great drought!

这样，我一面派兵保护，就请张委员从中联络襄助；
I shall send soldiers to guard it and have Officer Zhang assist with the arrangements.

一面我派妥当的人，送老兄到余杭去见左大帅。
At the same time, I shall send a reliable man to escort you to Yuhang to see Commander Zuo.

不过，我希望老兄速去速回，
But I hope you will return quickly.

这里还有多少大事，要请老兄帮忙。』
There are so many important matters here on which we need your help.”

『是！我尽快赶回来。』
“I shall come back as quickly as I can.”

『那末，老兄预备什么时候动身？
“When do you intend to leave?

今天晚上总来不及了吧？』
It must be too late tonight.”

『是的！
“Yes.

明天一早动身。』
Early tomorrow morning.”

蒋益澧点点头，随即又找中军，又找文案；将该为胡雪岩做的事，——分派停当。
Jiang nodded, summoned his staff and drafting officers, and assigned every task required for Hu.

护送他到余杭的军官，派的是一名都司，姓何，是蒋益澧的表侄；也是他的心腹。
The escort to Yuhang was an officer named He, a nephew through Jiang’s cousin and a trusted subordinate.

于是胡雪岩殷殷向何都司道谢，很敷衍了一番，约定第二天一早在小张家相会，陪同出发。
Hu thanked Officer He warmly, cultivated his goodwill, and arranged to meet him early the next morning at Zhang’s house for their departure.


到了张家；张秀才对胡雪岩自然有一番尽释前嫌、推心置腹的话说。
At the Zhang house, the father naturally spoke to Hu with complete openness, declaring all former grievances forgotten.

只是奉如上宾，只有在礼貌上尽心，没有什么酒食款待。
He honoured him as a distinguished guest, though circumstances allowed courtesy rather than elaborate food and wine.

而胡雪岩亦根本无心饮食，
Hu had no appetite for either.

草草果腹以后，趁这一夜功夫，还有许多大事要交待；
After a hasty meal sufficient to fill his stomach, he had many important instructions to give during the one night available.

苦恨人手不足，只好拿小张也当作心腹了。
Bitterly short of help, he had to treat young Zhang as a trusted assistant too.

胡雪岩没有功夫跟他们从容研商；只是直截了当地提出要求。
There was no time for leisurely discussion; he stated his requirements directly.

『第一件大事，请小张费心跟你老太爷商量，能找到几位地方上提得起的人物，
“First, young Zhang, please consult your father and find a few respected local men.

大家谈一谈，想法子凑现银给蒋方伯送了去，作为我阜丰暂借。
Talk to them and see how much silver can be raised to deliver to Provincial Treasurer Jiang as a temporary loan to Fufeng.

要请大家明白，这是救地方，也是救自己；
Make them understand that this is to save the locality and themselves.

十万银子的责任都在我一个人身上，
Responsibility for the hundred thousand taels rests entirely upon me.

将来大家肯分担最好，
If they are willing to share it later, so much the better.

不然，也就是我一个人认了。
If not, I shall bear it alone.

不过，此刻没有办法从上海调款子过来，要请大家帮我的忙。』
But I cannot bring the funds from Shanghai at this moment, and must ask for their help.”

『好的。』小张连连点头，
Zhang nodded repeatedly.

『这件事交给我们父子好了。
“Leave that to my father and me.

胡先生仁至义尽，
You have done everything a man could do for us, Mr Hu.

大家感激得很；
Everyone is grateful.

只要有现银，一定肯借出来的。』
Anyone who has ready silver will certainly be willing to lend it.”

『其次，阜康马上要复业，阜丰的牌子要挂出去。
“Next, Fukang must reopen at once, and Fufeng’s sign must go up.

这件事我想请三爷主内，小张主外。』
I should like Third Master Liu to handle the internal arrangements and you to deal with matters outside.”

胡雪岩看着刘不才说，
Hu turned to Liu.

『先说内部，第一看看阜康原来的房子怎么样？
“First, inspect Fukang’s old premises.

如果能用，马上找人收拾，
If they can be used, have them cleaned immediately.

再写两张梅红笺，一张是「阜康不日复业」；一张是「阜丰代理藩库」，
Write two notices on plum-red paper: ‘Fukang will reopen shortly,’ and ‘Fufeng acts for the provincial treasury.’

立刻贴了出去。』
Post them at once.”

『藩司衙门的告示呢？』
“What about the treasurer’s proclamation?”


『到复业那天再贴。』
“Post that on the day we reopen.

胡雪岩又说，『第二，准备一两千现银；
Next, prepare one or two thousand taels in cash.

顶要紧的是，弄几十袋米摆在那里。
Most importantly, get several dozen sacks of rice into the premises.

然后贴出一张红纸∶』阜康旧友，即请回店。
Then put up a red notice: ‘All former Fukang staff are requested to return immediately.’

「来了以后，每人先发十两银子五斗米。
As each man arrives, give him ten taels and five dou of rice.

我们这台戏，就可以唱起来了。
Then our performance can begin.”

『』那末，『小张抢着说道，』
Young Zhang hurried to speak.

胡先生，我有句话声明在先，
“Mr Hu, I must make one thing clear.

您老看得起我，汤里来，火里去，惟命是从。
Since you think well of me, I would go through boiling water and fire at your command.

不过，我也要估计估计我自己的力量，
But I must judge my own abilities.

钱庄我是外行；功夫又怕抽不出来，
I know nothing of banking, and I fear I may not have enough time.

不要误了胡先生的大事。
I must not delay your important business.

那时候胡先生不肯责备我，我自己也交代不过去。
Even if you were too kind to reproach me, I could not forgive myself.”

『』不要紧。
“Never mind.

我晓得你很忙，
I know you are busy.

只请你量力而为。
Do what you can.”

『胡雪岩放低了声音说，』
Hu lowered his voice.

我为什么要代理藩库？
“Why do I want to act for the treasury?

为的是要做牌子。
To establish the name.

阜康是金字招牌，固然不错；可是只有老杭州才晓得。
Fukang has an excellent reputation, certainly, but only old residents of Hangzhou know it.

现在我要吸收一批新的存户，非要另外想个号召的办法不可。
I now want to attract new depositors, and I need another way of appealing to them.

代理藩库，就是最好的号召，
Acting for the treasury is the best possible recommendation.

浙江全省的公款，都信托得过我，还有啥靠不住的？
If all Zhejiang’s public funds can be entrusted to me, what doubt can remain about my reliability?

只要那批新存户有这样一个想法，阜丰的存款就会源源不绝而来；
Once the new depositors think that way, money will flow steadily into Fufeng.

应该解蒋方伯的犒赏银两和代理藩库要垫的款子，就都有了。
Then we shall have both the reward money promised to Jiang and the funds needed for advances on the treasury’s behalf.”

『看着事情都交代妥当了，刘不才有句话要跟胡雪岩私下谈；
With the instructions apparently settled, Liu had something private to say.

使个眼色，将他拉到一边，低声说道∶』你跟蒋芗泉搞得很好，没有用；
He signalled to Hu, drew him aside, and spoke quietly. “Getting on well with Jiang Xiangquan will not help.

我今听到一个消息，颇为可靠，
I heard something today from a fairly reliable source.

左制军要跟你算帐，
Governor-General Zuo intends to call you to account.

已经发话下来了，
He has already spoken of it.

弄得不好，会指名严参。
If matters go badly, he may name you in a severe memorial of impeachment.”

『』你不要担心！
“Do not worry.”

『胡雪岩夷然不以为意，』
Hu remained wholly untroubled.

我亦没有啥算不算清的帐。
“There is no account of mine that cannot be explained.

外面的话听不得。『
You cannot believe all the talk outside.”


刘不才见他是极有把握的样子，也就放心了。
Seeing his confidence, Liu felt reassured.

小张却还有话问。
Young Zhang still had a question.

『胡先生的算计真好。
“Your calculation is excellent, Mr Hu.

不过，说了半天，到底是怎样的新存户呢？』
But after all this, who exactly are these new depositors?”

『长毛！』胡雪岩说，
“The rebels,” Hu answered.

『长毛投降了；这两年搜括的银子带不走，
“Once they surrender, they cannot carry away all the silver they have squeezed out of people these two years.

非要找个地方去存不可！』
They must find somewhere to deposit it.”

胡雪岩所要吸收的新存户，竟是长毛！
The new customers Hu meant to attract were the rebels themselves!

小张和刘不才都觉得是做梦亦想不到的事；
Neither Zhang nor Liu could have dreamed of such an idea.

同时亦都觉得他的想法超人，但麻烦亦可能很多。
Both thought his conception remarkable, but both also foresaw considerable trouble.

那种目瞪口呆的带些困惑的表情，是说明了他们内心有些什么疑问，
Their astonished and puzzled expressions told Hu what questions lay behind them.

胡雪岩完全了解；
He understood perfectly.

但是，这时候不是从容辩理的时候，所以他只能用比较武断的态度∶『事情决不会错！
But there was no time to debate at leisure, and he could only adopt a somewhat peremptory tone. “The plan is sound.

你们两位尽管照我的活去动脑筋。
Both of you should think along the lines I have laid down.

动啥脑筋，
Think about what?

就是怎么样让他们死心塌地拿私蓄存到阜丰来？
How to make them fully confident in entrusting their private savings to Fufeng.

两位明白了吧？』
Do you understand?”

『我明白。
“I understand.

不过——。』刘不才没有再说下去。
But—” Liu stopped.

『我也明白。杭州的情形我比较熟；找几个人去拉这些存户，一定不会空手而回。不过，在拉这些客户以前，人家一定要问，钱存到阜丰会不会泡汤？这话我该怎么说？』小张这样问说。
“So do I,” Zhang said. “I know conditions in Hangzhou better. If I find a few people to solicit these deposits, they certainly will not return empty-handed. But before depositing, the men will ask whether their money will be lost at Fufeng. How should I answer?”


『你告诉他∶决不会泡汤。
“Tell them it will not be lost.

不过朝廷的王法，也是要紧的，
But the court’s law must also be respected.

如果他自己觉得这笔存款可能有一天会让官方查扣，那就请他自己考虑。』
If a man himself thinks his deposit may one day be seized by the authorities, he must consider that for himself.”

胡雪岩停一下又说∶『总而言之一句话∶通融方便可以；违犯法条不可以。
Hu paused, then continued, “In a word, we can offer convenience and accommodation; we cannot break the law.

户头我们不必强求，
There is no need to force anyone to open an account.

我们要做气派，做信用。
We must establish our standing and our credit.

信用有了；哪怕连存折不给人家；只凭一句话，照样会有人上门。』
Once we have credit, people will come even without a passbook, trusting our word alone.”

刘不才和小张都觉得他的话一时还想不透；
Neither Liu nor Zhang could immediately fathom this.

好象有点前后不符。
It seemed somewhat inconsistent.

不过此刻无法细问；而且也不是很急的事，无须在这时候追根究底去辨清楚。
But they could not question him closely now, and the matter was not so urgent that its every implication must be settled that night.

因此，两人对看了一眼，取得默契；决定稍后再谈。
They exchanged a glance, reached a silent understanding, and decided to discuss it later.


『做事容易做人难！』
“Doing the work is easy; conducting oneself is hard.”

胡雪岩在片刻沉默以后，突如其来地以这么一句牢骚之语发端，作了很重要的一个揭示；也是一个警告∶『从今天起，我们有许多很辛苦，不过也很划算的事要做；
After a brief silence, Hu unexpectedly began with this complaint, leading into an important explanation—and a warning. “From today, we have much hard work ahead, but it will be worthwhile.

做起来顺利不顺利，全看我们做人怎么样？
Whether it proceeds smoothly depends entirely on how we conduct ourselves.

小张，你倒说说看，现在做人要怎么样做？』
Young Zhang, tell me: how should we behave now?”

小张想了一会，微微笑道，
Zhang considered, then smiled slightly.

『做人无非讲个信义。
“Conduct comes down to good faith and loyalty.

现在既然是帮左制军，就要咬定牙关帮到底。』
Since we are helping Governor-General Zuo, we should clench our teeth and help him to the end.”

『我们现在帮左制军，既然打算帮忙到底，就要堂堂正正站出来。不过这一下得罪的人会很多。』刘不才说。
“If we intend to help him through to the end, we must stand openly on his side,” Liu added. “But that will offend a great many people.”

『面面讨好，面面不讨好！
“Try to please everyone and you please no one,” Hu replied.

惟有摸摸胸口，
“We need only examine our hearts.

如果觉得对得起朝廷，对得起百姓，问心无愧，哪就什么都不必怕。
If we can say we have done our duty by the court and the people, with a clear conscience, there is nothing to fear.

时候不早了，
It is late.

上床吧！』
Let us go to bed.”

这一夜大家都睡不着；
None of them slept well that night.

因为可想的事太多。除此以外，更多的是情绪上的激动。
There was too much to think about, and still more emotional excitement.

上海、杭州都已拿下来，金陵之围的收缘结果，也就不远了。
Shanghai and Hangzhou had both been secured; the conclusion of the siege of Jinling could not be far away.

那时是怎样的一种局面？
What would the situation be then?

散兵游勇该怎么料理，
How were the scattered and unattached soldiers to be dealt with?

遣散还是留用，
Should they be discharged or retained?

处处都是疑问，实在令人困惑之至！
Everywhere were questions, perplexing beyond measure.



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第八章（本章第5部分，共9部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


忽然，胡雪岩发觉墙外有人在敲锣打梆子，
Suddenly Hu Xueyan heard someone outside the wall striking a gong and wooden clapper.

这是在打更。
A watchman was making his rounds.

久困之城，刚刚光复，一切还都是兵荒马乱的景象，居然而有巡夜的更夫；
The long-besieged city had only just been recovered; everywhere still bore the confusion of war, yet a night watchman was abroad.

听着那自远而近『笃、笃、镗；笃、笃、镗』的梆锣之声，胡雪岩有着空谷足音的喜悦的感激。
As the “tok, tok, clang; tok, tok, clang” drew nearer, Hu felt the joy and gratitude of a man hearing footsteps in an empty valley.

而心境也就变过了，
His mood changed.

眼前的一切都抛在九霄云外；回忆着少年时候，寒夜拥衾，遥听由西北风中传来的『寒冬腊月，火烛小心！』的吆喝，
Everything before him vanished from his mind, and he remembered his boyhood: snug beneath his quilt on a cold night, hearing a distant cry borne on the northwest wind—“In this bitter winter weather, take care with fire and candles!”

真有无比恬适之感。
How incomparably peaceful it had felt.

那是太平时世的声音。如今又听到了！
That was the sound of settled times, and now he heard it again.

胡雪岩陡觉精神一振，再也无法留在床上。
Suddenly invigorated, he could no longer remain in bed.

三个人是睡一房，
All three men slept in the same room.

他怕惊扰了刘不才和小张。悄悄下地；可是小张已经发觉了。
He rose quietly, unwilling to disturb Liu Bucai and young Zhang, but Zhang had already noticed.

『胡先生，你要作啥？』
“What are you doing, Mr Hu?”

『你没有睡着？』
“Have you not fallen asleep?”

『没有。』
“No.

小张问道∶『胡先生呢？』
Have you?”

『我也没有。』
“Neither have I.”

『彼此一样。』刘不才在帐子中接口，
“We are all alike,” Liu said from behind his bed curtains.

『我一直在听，
“I have been listening all along.

外面倒不安静；
There is quite a stir outside.

蒋藩司言而有信，约束部下，已经有效验了。』
Treasurer Jiang has kept his word; his efforts to restrain the troops are already taking effect.”

『这是胡先生积的阴德。』
“Mr Hu has earned merit in Heaven’s hidden account.”

小张也突然受了鼓舞，一跃下床，
Young Zhang, suddenly inspired too, sprang from bed.

『这两天的事情做不完，
“There is more to do these next two days than we can finish.

哪里有睡觉的功夫？』
Who has time to sleep?”

等他们一起床，张家的厨房里也就有灯光了。
As soon as they rose, a light appeared in the Zhang family’s kitchen.

洗完脸，先喝茶，
They washed and drank tea.

小张以为胡雪岩会谈未曾谈完的正事，而他却好整以暇地问道∶『刚才你们听到打更的梆子没有？』
Zhang expected Hu to return to their unfinished business, but he asked instead, quite at his ease, “Did you hear the watchman’s clapper just now?”

『听到。』
“Yes.

小张答道∶『杭州城什么都变过了，只有这个更夫老周没有变；
Everything in Hangzhou has changed except Old Zhou the watchman.

每夜打更，从没有断过一天。』
He has made his rounds every night, without missing a single one.”

胡雪岩肃然动容，
Hu’s expression grew solemn.

『难得！
“Remarkable!

真难得！』
Truly remarkable!

他问，『这老周多大年纪？』
How old is he?”


『六十多岁了。
“Over sixty.

身子倒还健旺；不过，现在不晓得怎么样了。』
He was still strong, though I do not know how he is now.”

『他没有饿死，而且每天能打更，
“He has escaped starvation and still makes his rounds every day.

看来这个人的禀赋，倒是得天独厚。可惜，』刘不才说，『只是打更！』
He must have an unusually blessed constitution,” Liu observed. “A pity he is only a watchman.”

『三爷，话不是这么说。
“Third Master, that is not the way to look at it.

世界上有许多事，本来是用不着才干的，
There are many tasks in the world that require no special talent.

人人能做；
Anyone can do them.

只看你是不是肯做，是不是一本正经去做？
The question is whether you are willing to do them, and whether you take them seriously.

能够这样，就是个了不起的人。』
A man who does that is remarkable.”

胡雪岩说，
Hu turned to Zhang.

『小张，我托你，问问那老周看，愿意不愿意改行？』
“Do something for me: ask Old Zhou whether he would like to change his occupation.”

『改行？』小张问道，
“Change his occupation?

『胡先生，你是不是要提拔他？』
Do you mean to advance him, Mr Hu?”

『是啊！
“Yes.

我要提拔他；也可以说是借重他。
Or you might say I mean to make use of his strengths.

现在我们人手不够，
We are short of hands.

象这种尽忠职守的人，不可以放过。
We cannot let a man so faithful to his duty pass us by.

我打算邀他来帮忙。』
I should like him to help us.”

『我想他一定肯的。
“I am sure he would be willing.

就怕他做不来啥。』
I only fear there is little he can do.”

『我派他管仓库。
“I shall put him in charge of a warehouse.

他做不来，再派人帮他的忙；
If he cannot manage, I shall give him someone to help.

只要他象打更那样，那时候去巡查就是。』
He need only inspect it at the proper hours, as he makes his rounds.”

说到这里，张家的男佣来摆桌子开早饭。
At this point, the Zhangs’ manservant laid the table for breakfast.

只不过拿剩下的饭煮一锅饭泡粥；佐粥的只有一样咸菜，
It was only leftover rice boiled into a pot of thin porridge, with a single dish of salted greens.

可是『饥者易为食』，尤其是在半夜休息以后，胃口大开，
But the hungry are easily fed, and after their half-night’s rest the men’s appetites were keen.

吃得格外香甜。
Everything tasted unusually good.

『我多少年没有吃过这样好吃的东西了！』胡雪岩很满意地说，
“I have not eaten anything so delicious in years!” Hu declared contentedly.

『刘三爷说得不错，「用得着就好」！
“Third Master Liu was right: ‘If it serves the purpose, it is good.’

泡饭咸菜，今日之下比山珍海味还要贵重。』
At a time like this, rice in hot water and salted greens are more precious than every delicacy of land and sea.”

这使得小张又深有领悟，
Young Zhang gained another deep insight.

用人之道，不拘一格；
The art of employing people was not bound by a single pattern.

能因时因地制宜，就是用人的诀窍。
Its secret was to adapt to time and place.

他深深点头，知道从什么地方去为胡雪岩物色人才了。
He nodded thoughtfully, knowing now where to look for people Hu could use.


何都司是天亮来到张家的，带来两个马弁；另外带了一匹马来∶『提起此马来头大』，是蒙古亲王僧格林沁所送，蒋益澧派人细心喂养，专为左宗棠预备的坐骑，
Officer He arrived at dawn with two mounted orderlies and an extra horse. The animal had a distinguished history: a gift from the Mongol prince Sengge Rinchen, it had been carefully tended on Jiang Yili’s orders as a mount reserved for Zuo Zongtang.

现在特借给胡雪岩乘用。
Now it was being lent specially to Hu.

何都司同时也带来了一个消息，
He also brought news.

余杭城内的长毛，亦在昨天弃城向湖州一带逃去。
The Longhairs in Yuhang had abandoned that city the previous day and fled towards Huzhou.

左宗棠亲自领兵追剿；如今是在瓶窑以北的安溪关前驻扎。
Zuo was pursuing them in person and was now encamped before Anxi Pass, north of Pingyao.

要去看他，得冒锋镝之危，
To visit him meant risking arrows and blades.

问胡雪岩的意思如何？
What did Hu wish to do?

『死生有命，
“Life and death are decreed.

左大帅能去，我当然也能去。
If the Commander-in-Chief can go there, so can I.

用不着怕！』
There is no need for fear.”

『不过，路很远，
“But it is a long journey.

一天赶不到，中途没有住宿的地方，
We cannot arrive in a day, and there is nowhere to lodge along the way.

也很麻烦。』
That is another difficulty.”

『尽力赶！
“We shall go as fast as we can.

赶不到也没有办法；
If we cannot arrive, there is nothing to be done.

好在有你老兄在，我放心得很。』
With you beside me, I feel quite at ease.”

这本是随口一句对答之词，而在何都司听来，是极其恳切的信任。
It was merely a casual reply, but He heard it as a deeply sincere expression of trust.

因而很用心地为他筹划，
He therefore took particular care over the arrangements.

好一会方始问道∶『胡大人，你能不能骑快马？』
After some thought, he asked, “Your Excellency, can you ride at speed?”

『勉强可以。』
“I can manage.”

『贵管家呢？』
