Hu knew that he could not escape the burden; he must perform his part, however crushing the weight upon his head.

不过，刚才那句『问在要害』上的话，并无答复，还得追问。
Yet the crucial question remained unanswered, and he had to ask again.

『大人这么说，我当然只有遵命。』
“Then I can only obey.

胡雪岩说，『就不知道将来在福建还要伺候哪位？』
But whom shall I have to serve in Fujian?”

『不要说什么伺候的话。
“Do not speak of serving.

雪岩，你最聪明不过；
Xueyan, you are exceptionally clever.

没有什么你不能相处的。
There is no one you cannot get on with.

惟其我付托了这个人，更得借重你——。』左宗棠没有再说下去∶胡雪岩却完全懂了他的意思，他所付托的，是个很难「伺候」的人。
It is precisely because I shall entrust the work to this man that I need you still more—” He broke off. Hu understood perfectly: the chosen man would be difficult to serve.

这就更急着要问∶『是哪位？』
He was all the more eager to know. “Who is it?”

『沈幼丹。』
“Shen Youdan.”


原来是丁忧回籍守制的前任江西巡抚沈葆桢。
It was Shen Baozhen, the former governor of Jiangxi, now at home observing mourning.

这在胡雪岩却真有意外之感。
Hu was genuinely surprised.

细想一想，付托倒也得人；不过以本省人做本省官，而且必是大官，为法例所不许。
On reflection, the choice was sound, but the regulations forbade a man to serve as an official—particularly a high official—in his native province.

兼以丁忧，更成窒碍。
Mourning created a further obstacle.

不知左宗棠是怎么想来的？
What was Zuo’s intention?

他只有付之默然了。
Hu remained silent.

『我知道你的想法，
“I know what you are thinking.

我给你看个奏稿。』
Let me show you a draft memorial.”

奏向洋洋千言，畅论造船之利；最后谈到主题∶臣维轮船一事，势在必行，岂可以去闽在迩，忽为搁置？
The lengthy document argued the advantages of shipbuilding before reaching its principal point. The undertaking was imperative, it said; Zuo’s approaching departure from Fujian could not justify setting it aside.

且设局制造，一切繁难事宜，均臣与洋员议定，
He and the foreign officers had negotiated the many complicated arrangements for establishing the works.

若不趁臣在闽定局，不但头绪纷繁，接办之人无从咨防；且恐要约不明，后多民议，臣尤无可诿咎。
Unless these were settled while he remained, his successor would face tangled affairs without anyone to consult; unclear agreements might also cause later controversy for which Zuo could not evade responsibility.

臣之不能不稍留三旬，以待此局之定者，此也！
He therefore had to remain another thirty days to bring the arrangements to completion.

惟此事固须择接办之人；尤必接办之人能久于其事，
A successor must be chosen, but above all he must be able to remain at the work for a long time.

然后一气贯注，众志定而成功可期；亦研求深而事理愈熟。
Continuity would steady everyone’s purpose, make success attainable, and allow deeper study to bring greater mastery.

再四思维，惟丁忧在籍前江西抚臣沈荷桢，
After repeated consideration, Zuo could think only of Shen Baozhen.

在官在籍，久负清望，为中外所仰。
In office and at home, Shen had long enjoyed a reputation for integrity admired throughout the realm.

其虑事详审精密，早在圣有洞鉴之中。
His careful, exact judgment was already known to the emperor.

现在里居侍养，爱日方长，非若宦辙靡常，时有量移更替之事；
At present he was at home attending to his family and might remain there for many years, unlike officials liable to frequent transfer.

又乡评素重，更可坚乐事赴功之心。
His high local reputation would strengthen his commitment to the enterprise.

若令主持此事，必期就绪。
If given charge, he would certainly see it established.

商之英桂、徐宗余亦以为然。
Yinggui and Xu Zonggan agreed.

臣曾三次造庐商情，沈荷桢始终逊谢不遑。
Zuo had visited him three times to discuss the matter, but Shen had repeatedly declined.

可否仰恳皇上天恩，俯念事关至要，局在垂成，温谕沈葆桢，勉轻大义，特命总理船政，
Might the emperor, considering the project’s importance and near completion, graciously urge him to accept the public duty and appoint him director-general of shipbuilding?

由部颁发关防，凡事涉船政，由其专奏请旨，以防牵制。
An official seal should be issued by the appropriate board, and he should have authority to memorialize directly on all shipbuilding matters, preventing obstruction by others.


其经费一切，会商将军督抚随时调取；
The necessary funds would be obtained as required in consultation with the general, governor-general, and governor.

责成署藩司周开锡，不得稍有延误。
Acting Provincial Treasurer Zhou Kaixi was to ensure that there was no delay.

一切工料及延洋匠、雇华工、开艺局，责成胡光墉一手经理。
Hu Guangyong was to manage all materials, the engagement of foreign artisans and Chinese workers, and the opening of the technical school.

缘胡光墉才长心细，熟谙洋务，为船局断不可少之人，且为洋人所素信也。
Hu, the memorial explained, was capable, meticulous, experienced in foreign affairs, indispensable to the shipbuilding establishment, and already trusted by the foreigners.

『好！
“Good!

我就交给你了！』
I entrust it to you.”

左宗棠站起身，一面走向书案，
Zuo rose and moved towards his writing table.

一面说道∶『现在要跟你谈第一件大事了！』
“Now we must discuss the first great task.”



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第十一章（本章第1部分，共2部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第十一章
CHAPTER ELEVEN


他的第一件大事，便是西征。
The first great task was the western expedition.

而凡有大征伐，首先要筹划的是兵、饷二事。
Any major campaign began with two questions: troops and funds.

左宗棠连日深宵不寐，灯下沉思，已写成了一个筹划的概略；
For several nights Zuo had remained awake, thinking beneath the lamp, and had written an outline of his plans.

此时从书案抽斗中取了出来，要胡雪岩细看。
He now took it from a drawer and asked Hu to study it.

这个节略先谈兵，次筹饷。
The outline dealt first with troops, then with finance.

而谈兵又必因地制宜，
Military arrangements had to suit local conditions.

西北与东南的地势，完全不同；
The terrain of the northwest differed completely from that of the southeast.

南方的军队，到了西北，第一不惯食科；第二不耐寒冷。
Southern soldiers would find the food unfamiliar and the cold intolerable.

因此，左宗棠在东南转战得力的将领部队，特别是籍贯属于福建、广东两省的，都不能带到西北。
The effective commanders and units with whom Zuo had fought across the southeast, particularly those recruited in Fujian and Guangdong, could therefore not be taken northwest.

带到西北的，只有三千多人，
He intended to bring only three thousand and more men.

另外他预备派遣原来帮办福建军务，现已出奏保荐帮办陕甘军务的刘典回湖南，召募三千子弟兵，带到西北。
Liu Dian, formerly assistant director of military affairs in Fujian and now recommended for the corresponding duties in Shaanxi and Gansu, would return to Hunan to recruit another three thousand men and lead them west.

这六千多人，左宗棠用来当作亲兵；
These six thousand and more would form Zuo’s personal force.

至于用来作战的大批部队，他打算在本地招募，要与『关中豪杰』共事业。
The main fighting army he intended to raise locally, making common cause with the able men of Guanzhong.


看到这里，胡雪岩不由得失声说道∶『大人，照你老人家的办法，要什么时候才能平得了回乱？』
At this point Hu exclaimed, “Your Excellency, if you proceed in this way, when can the Hui rebellion be suppressed?”

『你这话，我不大懂。』
“I do not quite understand you.”

『大人请想，
“Consider, sir.

招募成军，不是一朝一夕的事；练成精锐，更是谈何容易？
Recruiting an army is not the work of a day, and training it into an elite force is harder still.

这一来，要花一两年的功夫。』
It will take a year or two.”

『岂止一两年？』
“A year or two?

左宗棠说道∶『经营西域，非十年不足以收功。』
Establishing the Western Regions will require no less than ten years.”

『十年？』
“Ten years!”

胡雪岩吓一跳，
Hu was startled.

『那得——。』他虽住口不语，左宗棠也知道，说的是要费多少饷？
“That would take—” He stopped, but Zuo knew he meant the cost.

笑笑说道∶『你不要争！
Smiling, he said, “Do not be anxious.

我要在西北办屯垦；
I intend to establish agricultural colonies in the northwest.

这是长治久安之计。
That is the way to lasting peace.

就象办船厂一样，不能急切图利；
As with the shipyard, one must not seek an immediate return.

可是一旦见效，你就知道我的打算不错了。』
Once the results appear, you will see that I have planned correctly.”

『是！』胡雪岩将那份节略搁下，低着头沉思。
Hu set the outline down and bent his head in thought.

『你在想什么？』
“What are you considering?”

『我想得很远。』
“A long way ahead.

胡雪岩答说∶『我也是想到十年八年以后。』
I too am thinking eight or ten years into the future.”

『着！』
“Exactly!”

左宗棠拊掌欣然，
Zuo clapped his hands in delight.

『你的意思与我不谋而合；
“Our thoughts coincide.

我们要好好打算，筹出十年八年的饷米。』
We must plan carefully and find provisions and pay for eight or ten years.”

胡雪岩暂且不答，
Hu did not answer immediately.

捡起节略再看，大致了解了左宗棠在西北用兵的计划。
He picked up the outline and continued reading until he understood the broad scheme.

他要练马队；又要造『两轮炮车』；开设『屯田总局』——
Zuo intended to train cavalry, build two-wheeled gun carriages, and establish a central bureau for agricultural colonies.

办屯垦要农具、要种子、要车马、要垫发未收成以前的一切粮食杂用，
The colonies would need implements, seed, carts, horses, and advances for all food and incidental expenses until the first harvest.

算起来这笔款子，真正不在少数。
The amount was considerable.

『大人，』胡雪岩问道∶『练马队、造炮车、是致胜所必需，朝廷一定会准。
“Your Excellency, cavalry and gun carriages are necessary for victory, and the court will certainly approve them.

办屯垦，朝廷恐怕会看作不急之务吧？』
But might it regard the agricultural colonies as a matter that can wait?”


『这，你就不懂了。』
“That is where you do not understand.

左宗棠说，『朝中到底不少读书人，
There are still many men of learning at court.

他们会懂的。』
They will understand.”

胡雪岩脸一红，却很诚恳地说∶『是！
Hu reddened, but spoke sincerely. “Yes, sir.

我确是不大懂，
I do not fully understand.

请大人教导。』
Please instruct me.”

于是左宗棠为胡雪岩约略讲述用兵西域的限制，
Zuo outlined the restrictions upon campaigning in the Western Regions.

自秦汉以来，西征皆在春初，及秋而还。
Since the Qin and Han dynasties, armies had gone west in early spring and returned in autumn.

因为第一，秋高马肥，敌人先占了优势；其次就是严寒的天气，非关内的士兵所能适应。
When autumn came and the horses were fat, the enemy held the advantage; the severe cold that followed was also beyond the endurance of troops from within the passes.

『就是为了这些不便，汉武帝元朔初年征匈奴，几乎年年打胜仗，而年年要出师，
“Because of these difficulties, Emperor Wu of Han won victories almost every year against the Xiongnu in the early Yuanshuo period, yet had to send an army out again every year.

斩草不能除根，成了个无穷之累。』
The grass was cut, but the roots remained—a burden without end.”

左宗棠一番引经据典以后，转入正题∶『如今平回乱，亦仿佛是这个道理∶选拔两三万能打的队伍，春天出关，尽一夏天追奔逐北，交秋班师，如当年卫霍之所为，我亦办得到。
After citing precedents, Zuo returned to the present. “The Hui rebellion presents much the same problem. I could choose twenty or thirty thousand good troops, take them beyond the passes in spring, pursue the enemy through the summer, and return in autumn, as Wei Qing and Huo Qubing did.

可是，回乱就此算平了吗？』
But would that settle the rebellion?”

『自然没有平。』
“Naturally not.”

胡雪岩了然了，
Hu understood.

『有道是「野火烧不尽，春风吹又生。」
“As the verse says, wildfire cannot burn it all away; the spring wind brings it back.

只要花大功夫拿那块地彻底翻一翻，野草自然长不出来了。』
Only by thoroughly turning over the ground can the weeds be prevented from returning.”

『一点不错！
“Precisely!

你这个譬喻很恰当。』
Your comparison is apt.”

左宗棠欣慰地说，
Zuo was pleased.

『只要你懂我的意思，我就放心了。
“If you understand my purpose, I can rest easy.

你一定会把我所要的东西办妥当。』
You will obtain what I need.”

这顶『高帽子』出于左宗棠之口，弥觉珍贵；然而也极沉重。
Praise from Zuo was precious, but it was also a weighty burden.

胡雪岩知道左宗棠的意思是要他负筹饷的主要责任。
Hu knew that he was being asked to bear the principal responsibility for raising funds.

凝神细想了一会，觉得兹事体大，而且情况复杂，非先问个明白不可。
After concentrated thought, he felt that so great and complicated a matter required some definite answers first.


『大人，将来要练多少营的队伍。』
“Your Excellency, how many battalions do you intend to train?”

『这很难说，
“That is difficult to say.

要到了关外看情形再说。』
I must see the circumstances beyond the passes.”

第一个疑问，便成了难题；
The very first question thus became a difficulty.

人数未定，月饷的数目就算不出来。
Without the number of men, monthly expenditure could not be calculated.

胡雪岩只能约略估计，以五万人算，每人粮饷、被服、武器；以及营帐锅碗等等杂支，在五两银子以内开支，每月就要二十五万两。
Hu could only estimate: at fifty thousand men, with pay, food, clothing, weapons, tents, cooking utensils, and other expenses kept within five taels per man, the total would be two hundred and fifty thousand a month.

于是他再问第二问∶『是带六千人出关？』
He asked a second question. “You will take six thousand men beyond the passes?”

『是的。
“Yes.

大概六千五百人。』
About sixty-five hundred.

左宗棠答说，『三千五百人由闽浙两省动手；
Thirty-five hundred will set out from Fujian and Zhejiang.

另外三千人在湖南招募成军以后，直接出关。』
Another three thousand, once recruited in Hunan, will go directly west.”

『行资呢？
“What about travelling expenses?

每人十两够不够？』
Would ten taels a man suffice?”

『我想，应该够了。』
“I think it should.”

『那就是六万五千两，而且眼前就要。』胡雪岩又问第三问∶『大人预备练多少马队？』
“That is sixty-five thousand, needed immediately.” Hu asked his third question. “How much cavalry do you propose to train?”


『马队我还没有带过，营制也不甚了然。
“I have never commanded cavalry and do not yet know its battalion organization very well.

只有自初步打算，要练三千马队。』
My preliminary intention is three thousand men.”

『那就至少要有三千匹马。』胡雪岩说，
“Then at least three thousand horses will be needed,” Hu said.

『买马要到张家口，
“They must be bought at Zhangjiakou.

这笔钱倒是现成的，我可以垫出来。』
That money is available; I can advance it.”

『怎么？你在张家口有钱？』
“You have money in Zhangjiakou?”

『是的。』
“Yes.

胡雪岩说，『我有十万银子在张家口，原来打算留着办皮货、办药材的，
A hundred thousand taels, originally intended for furs and medicinal materials.

现在只好先挪来买马。』
I shall have to use it for horses first.”

『这倒好。』
“Excellent.”

左宗棠很高兴地说，
Zuo was delighted.

『既然如此，我立刻就可以派委员去采办了。』
“Then I can send a purchasing officer at once.”

『是！大人派定了通知我；我再派人陪着一起去。』胡雪岩又问，『两轮炮车呢？
“Let me know whom you appoint, and I shall send someone with him.” Hu continued, “What about the two-wheeled gun carriages?

要多少？』
How many?”

『「韩信将兵，多多益善」。
“Like Han Xin with soldiers, the more the better.

塞外辽阔，
Beyond the passes the country is vast.

险精骑驰骋以外，炮车轰击，一举而廓清之，
In addition to swift cavalry, guns on carriages can sweep the ground clear at a stroke.

最是扫穴犁庭的利器！』
There is no better instrument for destroying the enemy’s strongholds.”

听这一说，胡雪岩觉得心头沉重。
Hu’s heart grew heavy.

因为他也常听说，有那不恤民命的官军，常常使炮口对准村落，乱轰一气。
He had often heard of government troops who cared nothing for civilian lives, turned their guns upon villages, and bombarded indiscriminately.

窝藏在其中的盗匪，固然非死即伤或逃；而遭受池鱼之殃的百姓，亦复不少。
Bandits hiding there might be killed, wounded, or driven out, but many innocent inhabitants suffered with them.


左宗棠所部的洋枪洋炮，多由胡雪岩在上海采办；
Most of the Western firearms and artillery in Zuo’s army had been purchased by Hu in Shanghai.

推原论始，便是自己在无形中造了孽，
Follow the matter back to its origin, and he himself had unknowingly contributed to wrongdoing.

为了胡雪岩的购办杀人利器，胡老太太不知道劝过他多少次；
His mother had remonstrated with him countless times over his procurement of weapons that killed people.

胡雪岩十分孝顺，家务巨细，母命是从，
He was a devoted son and obeyed her in every detail of family affairs.

惟独到公事上头，不能不违慈命。
Only in public business did he feel unable to follow her wishes.

好在胡老太太心地亦很明白；知道不是儿子不听话，实在是无可奈何。
Fortunately, she understood: it was not deliberate disobedience, but a situation from which he saw no escape.

因此，只有尽力为他弥补『罪过』，
She could only do her utmost to make amends for his “sins.”

平时烧香拜佛，不在话下；夏天施医施药施凉茶，冬天舍棉衣、散米票，
Besides her customary worship, she provided medical treatment, medicines, and cooling tea in summer, padded clothing and rice vouchers in winter.

其他修桥铺路，恤老怜贫的善举，只要求到她，无不慷慨应诺。
Anyone seeking help to repair bridges or roads, care for the old, or relieve the poor received a generous promise.

但是，尽管好事做了无其数；买鸟雀放生，总抵偿不了人命，
Yet however many good deeds she performed, buying birds to release could not compensate for human lives.

所以胡老太太一提起买军火，便会郁郁不乐。
Every mention of arms purchases saddened her.

胡雪岩此时听左宗棠说得那么起劲，不由得便想起了老母的愁颜；因而默不作声。
Hearing Zuo speak so enthusiastically now, Hu saw his mother’s troubled face in his mind and remained silent.


『怎么？』
“What is it?”

左宗棠当然不解，
Zuo naturally did not understand.

『你是不是觉得我要造两轮炮车，有困难？』
“Do you think building the gun carriages will be difficult?”

『不是。
“No.

我是在想，炮车要多少，每辆要多少银子？
I am wondering how many will be required and what each will cost.

这笔预算打不出来。』
I cannot draw up that budget.”

『那是以后的事。
“That comes later.

眼前只好算一个约数；
For now, we must allow a rough amount.

我想最好能抽个二十万银子造炮车。』
I should like to set aside two hundred thousand taels.”

『那末办屯田呢？
“And the agricultural colonies?

请问大人，要筹多少银子？』
How much must be raised for those?”

『这更难言了。』
“Harder still to say.

左宗棠说∶『好在办屯田不是三年五载的事；而且负担总是越来越轻。
Fortunately, the colonies are not an undertaking of merely three or five years, and their burden will steadily diminish.

我想有个五十万银子，前后周转着用，一定够了。』
I think five hundred thousand taels, used as a revolving fund, will certainly suffice.”

『是的。』胡雪岩心里默算了一会，失声说道∶『这样就不得了！
Hu calculated silently for a moment, then exclaimed, “This is tremendous!

不得了！』
Tremendous!”

『怎么？』
“How so?”

『我算给大人听！』
“Let me reckon it for you.”

胡雪岩屈指数着∶『行资六万。
He counted on his fingers. “Travelling expenses, sixty thousand.

买马连鞍辔之类，算他一百二十两银子一匹，三千匹就是三万六千。
Horses with saddles and bridles, say a hundred and twenty taels each: three thousand horses make thirty-six thousand.

造炮车二十万。
Gun carriages, two hundred thousand.

办屯田先筹一半，二十五万。
Half the agricultural fund to begin with, two hundred and fifty thousand.

粮饷以五万人计，每人每月五两，总共就是二十五万，一年三百万。
Pay and provisions for fifty thousand men at five taels per month, two hundred and fifty thousand monthly, or three million a year.

合计三百五十四万，
Altogether, three million five hundred and forty thousand.

这是头一年要筹的饷。』
That is what must be raised for the first year.”

这一算，左宗棠也楞住了。
Zuo too was stunned.

要筹三百五十四万两的饷，谈何容易？
Raising three million five hundred and forty thousand taels was no easy matter.

就算先筹一半，也是一百七、八十万，实在不是一笔小数目了。
Even half—one million seven or eight hundred thousand—was a formidable sum.


『而且我想，西北运输不便，凡事都要往宽处去算。
“And with transport so difficult in the northwest, we must make generous allowances everywhere.

这笔饷非先筹好带去不可！
The money has to be secured before you take it with you.

大人，这不比福州到上海，坐海轮两天功夫就可以到，遇有缓急之时，我无论如何接济得上。
This is not like Fuzhou and Shanghai, only two days apart by sea, where I can somehow provide assistance in an emergency.

西北万里之外，冰天雪地之中，那时大人乏粮缺食，呼应不灵，岂不是急死了也没用？』
Thousands of miles away, amid snow and ice, if you run short of provisions and cannot make yourself heard, what use will frantic anxiety be?”

『说得是，说得是！
“Exactly.

我正就是这个意思。
That is precisely my thought.

雪岩，这笔饷，非先筹出来不可；
Xueyan, we must raise it beforehand.

筹不足一年，至少也要半年之内不虞匮乏之好。』
If not enough for a year, then at least enough to prevent shortage for six months.”

『只要有了确实可靠的「军饷」，排前补后，我无论如何是要效劳的。』接着，胡雪岩又分析西征军饷，所以绝不能稍有不继的缘故。
“Provided there is a dependable source of military funds, I shall do everything I can to arrange advances and subsequent receipts.” Hu then explained why the western army could never be allowed even a temporary interruption.

在别的省份，一时青黄不接，有厘税可以指拨，有钱粮可以划提，或者有关税可以暂时周转，至不济还有邻省可以通融。
Elsewhere, a gap could be filled from likin, land revenue, or customs receipts, or at worst by an accommodation with a neighbouring province.

西北地瘠民贫，无可腾挪，
The northwest was barren and poor, leaving no room to move money around.

邻省则只有山西可缓急之恃，但亦有限，
Only Shanxi offered a possible neighbouring resource, and that was limited.

而且交通不便，现银提解，往往亦须个把月的功夫。
Communications were difficult; transporting silver might itself take a month.

所以万一青黄不接，饥卒哗变，必成不可收拾之势。
If funds failed and hungry soldiers mutinied, the situation could become irretrievable.

这个看法，亦在左宗棠深思熟虑的预见之中。
Zuo had foreseen this in his own careful deliberations.

因而完全同意胡雪岩的主张，应该先筹好分文不短，一天不延的『的饷』；也就是各省应该协解的『甘饷』。
He fully agreed that they must first secure funds guaranteed to arrive without a tael missing or a day’s delay: the contributions assigned to the various provinces for Gansu.

谈到这一层上头，左宗棠便很得意于自己的先见了；
Here he felt pleased with his foresight.

如果不是撵走了他的『亲家』郭嵩焘，便顶多只有福建、浙江两个地盘，
Without driving out his relative by marriage, Guo Songtao, he would have had only Fujian and Zhejiang as bases of support.

而如今却有富庶的广东在内。
Now wealthy Guangdong was included.

要筹的饷，自然先从这三省算起。
Those three provinces must be the starting point.


三省之中，又必先从福建开始。
Fujian came first.

福建本来每月协济左宗棠带来的浙军军饷四万两；闽海关每月协济一万两。
It had been contributing forty thousand taels a month towards Zuo’s Zhejiang troops, with another ten thousand from Fujian Customs.

从长毛余孽肃清以来，协浙的四万两，改为协济甘肃；
After the Taiping remnants were cleared, the forty thousand had been reassigned to Gansu.

现在自是顺理成章 归左宗棠了。
It now naturally came under Zuo’s control.

至于海关的一万两，已籴接济船厂经费；
The customs contribution, however, had already been allocated to the shipyard.

此事是他所首创，不能出尔反尔，这一万两只得放弃。
Since that was his own initiative, he could not reverse himself and had to relinquish those ten thousand.

其次是浙江。
Next came Zhejiang.

当杨岳斌接任陕甘总督，负西征全责时，曾国藩曾经代为出面筹饷，派定浙江每月协解两万。
When Yang Yuebin became governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu with responsibility for the western campaign, Zeng Guofan had helped arrange funds and assigned Zhejiang twenty thousand a month.

上年十月间左宗棠带兵到广东，『就食于粤』的计划既已实现，
In the tenth month of the previous year, Zuo had brought his army into Guangdong and achieved his plan of feeding it there.

在胡雪岩的侧面催促之下，不得不守减除浙江负担的诺言。
Under Hu’s indirect pressure, he had then had to honour his promise to relieve Zhejiang’s burden.

在浙江等于每月多了十四万银子；
That left Zhejiang with an additional hundred and forty thousand a month.

马新贻是很顾大局的人，自请增拨甘饷三万两，每月共讲五万银子。
Ma Xinyi, mindful of the wider situation, voluntarily increased the Gansu subsidy by thirty thousand, making fifty thousand monthly.

『浙江总算对得起我；
“Zhejiang has treated me well,” Zuo said.

马谷山为人亦很漂亮，
“Ma Gushan is a fine man.

每月五万银子协饷，实在不能算少了，
Fifty thousand a month is no small contribution.

不过，』左宗棠停了一下说∶『有两笔款子，在浙江本来是要支出的，
But”—he paused—“there are two other sums already budgeted in Zhejiang.

我拿过来并不增加浙江的负担，
Taking those would add nothing to its burden.

你看如何？』
What do you think?”

『这要看原来是给什么地方？』
“That depends on their original destination.”

『一笔是答应支持船厂的造船经费，每月一万两。
“One is the promised shipbuilding contribution, ten thousand a month.

现在设厂造船，全由福建关税、厘金提拨；
The shipyard is now funded entirely from Fujian Customs and likin.

这一万两不妨改为甘饷。』
Zhejiang’s ten thousand could be redirected to Gansu.”

这是变相增加福建负担的办法。
This was an indirect way of increasing Fujian’s burden.

胡雪岩心里好笑，左宗棠的算盘，有时比市侩还精；
Hu found it privately amusing: Zuo’s calculations could be sharper than a petty merchant’s.

但只要不累浙江，他没有不赞成之理。
But so long as Zhejiang did not suffer, he had no reason to object.

因而点点头说∶『这一层，我想马中丞决不会反对。』
“I do not think Governor Ma will oppose that.”


『另一笔协济曾相的马队，也是一万两。
“The other ten thousand supports Lord Zeng’s cavalry.

照我想，也该归我。
I think that should come to me too.

雪岩，你想想其中的道理。』
Consider the reason.”

『曾相从前自己定过，江苏协济甘饷，每月三万；听说每月解不足。
“Lord Zeng originally assigned Jiangsu thirty thousand a month for Gansu, but I hear the full sum is never remitted.

大人是不是想拿浙江的这一万两，划抵江苏应解的甘饷？』
Do you propose to offset Zhejiang’s ten thousand against what Jiangsu owes?”

『是啊！
“Precisely.

算起来于曾无损，为什么不能划帐？』
It costs Zeng nothing, so why should the accounts not be adjusted?”

就事论事，何得谓之『与曾无损』？
On the merits, how could it be said to cost Zeng nothing?

胡雪岩本想劝他，犯不上为这一万两银子，惹得曾国藩心中不快。
Hu wanted to advise against displeasing him for the sake of ten thousand taels.

转念又想，若是这样开口一劝，左宗棠又一定大骂曾国藩。正事便无法谈得下去。
Then he reflected that any such advice would make Zuo launch another tirade against Zeng, bringing their serious business to a halt.

因而将到口的话又缩了回去。
He swallowed the words.


这下来就要算广东的接济了。
Next came Guangdong.

广东的甘饷，本来只定一万；造船经费也是一万，
Its existing contribution to Gansu was only ten thousand; another ten thousand was intended for shipbuilding.

仿照浙江的例子协甘，共是两万。
Following the Zhejiang precedent, both could go to Gansu, making twenty thousand.

左宗棠意思，希望增加一倍，与福建一样，每月四万。
Zuo hoped to double that to forty thousand, matching Fujian.

『这一定办得到的。』胡雪岩说，
“That can certainly be done,” Hu said.

『蒋中丞是大人一手提拔，于公于私，都应该尽心。
“Governor Jiang owes his advancement to you and should exert himself for public and personal reasons alike.

事不宜迟，大人马上就要写信。』
There is no time to lose; you should write at once.”

『这倒无所谓，
“That hardly matters.

反正蒋芗泉不能不买我的面子，
Jiang Xiangquan cannot refuse me.

现在就可以打入预算之内。』
We may include it in the budget now.”

『福建四万、浙江七万、广东四万、另加江海关三万，，
“Fujian forty thousand, Zhejiang seventy thousand, Guangdong forty thousand, and Jianghaiguan Customs another thirty thousand.

目前可收的确数是十八万；一年才两百十六万。
That gives a dependable hundred and eighty thousand a month, only two million one hundred and sixty thousand a year.

差得很多。』
The gap is still large.”

『当然还有。
“There are others, of course.

户部所议，应该协甘饷的省份，还有七省。
The Ministry of Revenue has designated seven further provinces.

江西、湖北、河南三省，等我这次出关路过的时候，当面跟他们接头；
I shall speak in person to the authorities in Jiangxi, Hubei, and Henan while passing through on my way west.

江苏、河南、四川、山东四省的甘饷，只有到了陕西再说。
Jiangsu, Henan, Sichuan, and Shandong must wait until I reach Shaanxi.

我想，通扯计算，一年两百四十万银子，无论如何是有的。』
Taking everything together, I think we can certainly count on two million four hundred thousand a year.”

『那，我就替大人先筹一半。』胡雪岩若无其事地说。
“Then I shall raise half of that in advance for you,” Hu said as though it were a casual matter.

『一半？』左宗棠怕是自己没有听清楚，
“Half?” Zuo wondered if he had heard correctly.

特意钉一句∶『一半就是一百二十万银子。』
“Half is one million two hundred thousand taels.”

『是，一百二十万。』
“Yes.

胡雪岩说∶『我替大人筹好了带走。』
I shall have it ready for you to take.”

『这，』左宗棠竟不知怎么说才好了，
“But—” Zuo scarcely knew what to say.

『你哪里去筹这么一笔巨数？』
“Where will you find such an enormous sum?”

『我有办法。
“I have a method.

当然，这个办法，要大人批准。
Naturally, it will require your approval.

等我筹划好了，再跟大人面禀。』
Once I have worked out the arrangements, I shall explain them.”

左宗棠不便再追着问。
Zuo could not press further.

他虽有些将信将疑，地是信多于疑；
He was doubtful, but more confident than doubtful.

再想到胡雪岩所作的承诺，无一不曾实现，也就释然、欣然了。
Remembering that Hu had fulfilled every promise he had made, he felt reassured and pleased.


『大人什么时候动身，什么时候出关？』
“When will you leave, sir, and when do you expect to pass beyond the frontier gates?”

『我想十一月初动身，
“I intend to leave early in the eleventh month.

沿途跟各省督抚谈公事，走得慢些，
I shall travel slowly, discussing affairs with governors and governors-general along the way.

总要年底才能到京。』
I shall probably not reach the capital until the year’s end.”

『到京？』
“The capital?

胡雪岩不解地问，『上谕不是关照，直接出关。』
Did the edict not direct you to proceed straight to the west?”

这哪里是上头的意思？
“That was hardly the intention of Their Majesties.

无非有些人挟天下以令诸侯。
It was certain men using the authority of the realm to command its governors.

他们怕我进京找麻烦，
They fear I shall cause trouble in the capital.

我偏要去讨他们的厌；
I mean to be a nuisance to them.

动身之前，奏请陛见。
Before leaving, I shall request an audience.

想来两宫太后决不致于拦我。
I do not believe the two empress dowagers will refuse.”

『左宗棠停了一下又说∶』至于出关的日期，现在还不能预定。
Zuo paused. “As for passing beyond the gates, I cannot fix the date yet.

最早也得在明年春天。
Next spring at the earliest.”

『』那还有三四个月的功夫。
“Then we have another three or four months.

大人出关以前，这一百二十万一定可筹足；
The million two hundred thousand will be ready before you go.

至于眼前要用，二、三十万银子，我还调度得动。
For immediate needs, I can still arrange two or three hundred thousand.”

『』那太好了！
“Excellent!

雪岩我希望你早早筹划停当，好让我放心。
Xueyan, settle it as soon as you can, so that I may rest easy.”

『这又何消左宗棠说得？
Hu needed no such reminder.

胡雪岩亦希望早早能够定局。
He too wished to settle the matter quickly.

无奈自己心里所打的一个主意，虽有八成把握，到底银子不曾到手。
Although he gave his plan an eight-in-ten chance, the silver was not yet in his hands.

俗语说的『煮熟了鸭子飞掉了』，自是言过其实；但凡事一涉银钱，即有成议，到最后一刻变卦，亦是常有之事。
The proverb about a cooked duck flying away was an exaggeration, but where money was concerned, even an agreed arrangement could change at the last moment.

一百二十万两不是个小数目，
A million two hundred thousand was no trifling sum.

西征大业成败和左宗棠封爵以后能不能入阁拜相的关键都系于此，关系真个不轻。
The western expedition’s success, and whether Zuo might rise from his noble title to a grand secretaryship, depended upon it.

倘或功败垂成，如何交代？
If the plan failed just before completion, how could Hu answer for it?

兴念及此，胡雪岩深深失悔，何以会忘却『满饭好吃，满话难说？之戒？
He deeply regretted forgetting the warning: a full bowl of rice is easy to eat, but a sweeping promise is hard to fulfil.

如今既不能打退堂鼓，就得全力以赴加紧进行。
Since he could not retreat, he must throw all his strength into carrying it through.



胡雪岩 · 红顶商人
The Red-Topped Merchant
第十一章（本章第2部分，共2部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


所苦的是眼前还脱不得身，
The difficulty was that Hu could not yet get away.

因为日意格、德克碑与中国官场打交道，大至船厂计划，小至个人生活，都要找他接头。
In their dealings with Chinese officials, Giquel and d’Aiguebelle came to him about everything, from the shipyard scheme to the smallest details of their daily lives.

在左宗棠，对洋人疑信参半；
Zuo, for his part, was divided between trust and suspicion of foreigners.

而有些话怕一说出来，洋人憨直，当场驳回，未免伤他的身分与威望，
He also feared that, if he said certain things himself, their bluntness might lead them to contradict him outright, injuring his dignity and authority.

因而亦少不得胡雪岩这样一个居间曲曲转达的人。
An intermediary such as Hu, who could convey his meaning tactfully, was indispensable.

这就难了！
It was a predicament.

左思右想，一时竟无以为答；坐在那里大大发楞。
Hu turned it over in his mind without finding an answer and sat lost in thought.

这是左宗棠从未见过的样子，
Zuo had never seen him like this.

不免诧异；却又不好问得。
He was surprised, but could hardly ask what was wrong.

主宾二人，默然相答；
Host and guest sat facing each other in silence.

使得侍立堂下的戈什哈亦惊愕不止，因为平日总见左宗棠与胡雪岩见了面，谈笑风生，滔滔不绝，
Even the guards below the hall were astonished: normally these two would be laughing and talking without pause.

何以此刻对坐发呆？
Why were they now staring blankly at each other?

于是，有个左宗棠亲信的戈什哈上前问道∶『可是留胡大人在这里便饭？』
At last a trusted guard approached. “Will His Excellency Hu be staying for a simple meal?”


这下使胡雪岩惊醒了，
Hu came to himself.

『不，不，多谢！』他首先辞谢，
“No, no, thank you,” he said at once.

『我还要到码头去送客。』
“I must go to the wharf to see someone off.”

『送什么人？』左宗棠问。
“Who is it?” Zuo asked.

『福州税务局布浪。』
“Brown, the Fuzhou Customs Commissioner.”

『喔，他到上海去。』
“Ah, he is going to Shanghai.”

『是的。』
“Yes.

胡雪岩答说，『是驻上海的法国总领事白来尼找他谈公事。』
Brenier, the French Consul General in Shanghai, has asked to see him on official business.”

『谈什么公事？』
“What business?

左宗棠问道∶『莫非与船厂有关？』
Could it concern the shipyard?”

胡雪岩灵机一动，
A thought flashed through Hu’s mind.

点点头答说∶『也许。』
He nodded. “It might.”


『那可得当心。』左宗棠说，
“Then we must be careful,” Zuo said.

『洋人花样多。
“Foreigners have plenty of tricks.

日意格、德克碑办理此事，起先越过他们总领事，直接回国接头；
When Giquel and d’Aiguebelle first took up this project, they bypassed their consul general and approached people in France directly.

白来尼当然不高兴。
Naturally Brenier was displeased.

而此刻一切合同，又非白来尼画押不可；
Now every contract requires his signature.

恐怕他会阻挠。』
He may obstruct us.”

『大人深谋远虑，
“Your Excellency has considered the matter with great foresight.

见得很是。
You are quite right.

我看——，』胡雪岩故意踌躇着，
I think—” Hu hesitated deliberately.

『办不到的事。
“But it cannot be done.

算了！』
Never mind.”

『怎么？』左宗棠问∶『什么事办不到？』
“What cannot be done?” Zuo asked.

『我想最好我也走一趟；钉住布浪。
“It would be best if I went too and kept close to Brown.

只是这里不容我分身。』
Only I cannot leave my work here.”

左宗棠摸着花白短髭，沉吟了一会，
Stroking his short, greying moustache, Zuo considered this for a while.

徐徐说道∶『速去速回，亦自不碍。』
“If you went and came back quickly,” he said slowly, “it need not interfere.”


听得这话，胡雪岩精神一振，
Hu brightened immediately.

『是！』
“Yes!

他立即答说『我遵大人吩咐，速去速回。
I shall follow Your Excellency’s instructions and return as quickly as possible.

如果布浪谈的公事与轮船无关，不过三、五天功夫，就可以回福州。』
If Brown’s business has nothing to do with the steamships, I can be back in Fuzhou within three to five days.”

『好！』左宗棠说，
“Very well.

『你就请吧！
Go, then.

我还有好些大事，跟你商量；
I have many important matters still to discuss with you.

尤其是那一百二十万银子，一天没有着落，我一天心不安。』
Above all, until that million two hundred thousand taels is secured, I shall not have a day’s peace.”

胡雪岩这一次不敢再说满话了，
This time Hu dared make no sweeping promises.

只答应尽速赶回。
He merely agreed to return at the earliest opportunity.

至于在福州，唯一不放心的日意格与德克碑已萌退之意，
His only anxiety in Fuzhou concerned Giquel and d’Aiguebelle, who were already thinking of withdrawing.

深恐事生周折，斡旋无人，以致决裂；
If difficulties arose without anyone to mediate, he feared an outright breach.

而左宗棠却劝他不必过虑，同时拍胸担保，必定好言相劝，善为抚慰。
Zuo told him not to worry and gave him his personal assurance that he would reason with them kindly and do his best to reassure them.

如果有什么意见不能相合之处，自会暂且搁下，等胡雪岩回到福州以后再说。
Any differences they could not resolve would be set aside until Hu returned.

得此保证，胡雪岩才算放心；
Only with that promise could Hu feel at ease.

回到寓处，匆匆收拾行装，赶到码头，与布浪同船，直航上海。
He hurried back to his lodgings, packed, and reached the wharf in time to sail directly for Shanghai on Brown’s ship.

到上海第一件事是访古应春密谈。
His first business on arrival was a confidential visit to Gu Yingchun.


古应春近年又有新的发展，是英商汇丰银行的买办；
Gu’s career had taken another turn in recent years: he had become comprador of the British firm HSBC.

照英文译名，俗称『康白度』，在银行中是华籍职员的首脑；
Known in Chinese by a phonetic rendering of the foreign term, the comprador was the head of the bank’s Chinese staff.

名义上只是管理帐目及一切杂务，其实凡与中国人的一切交涉，大至交接官场，小至雇用苦力，无不唯买办是问。
Nominally he managed accounts and miscellaneous business; in practice, every dealing with Chinese people, from relations with officials to the hiring of labourers, came under his charge.

而中国人上外国银行有业务接头，更非找买办不可。
Chinese customers likewise had to go through him when doing business with a foreign bank.

因此，古应春在汇丰银行权柄很大；
Gu consequently wielded considerable authority at HSBC.

他又能干而勤快，极得洋东信任，言听计从，
Able and industrious, he had won his foreign employers’ complete confidence; they listened to his advice.

这就是胡雪岩所以首先要找他的缘故。
That was why Hu came to him first.

『我要请几家外国银行的「档手」吃饭。』他一开口就说∶『你倒替我开个单子看！』
“I want to invite the managers of several foreign banks to dinner,” he began. “Make me a list, will you?”

『小爷叔，』古应春问道∶『是不是为船厂的事？』
“Little Uncle,” Gu asked, “is this about the shipyard?”

『不是！
“No.

我要跟他们借钱。』
I want to borrow money from them.”


平时向外国银行借钱，十万廿万银子，只凭胡雪岩一句话就可以借到。
Ordinarily Hu could borrow a hundred or two hundred thousand taels from a foreign bank on his word alone.

如今特为要请洋人吃饭，可见得数目不小。
A special dinner invitation suggested a much larger sum.

古应春想了一下，拿出一本同治四年的洋商行名簿，翻到『银行』这一栏问道∶『是不是十家都请？？
Gu thought for a moment, took out a directory of foreign firms for the fourth year of Tongzhi, and turned to the banks. “Shall we invite all ten?”

胡雪岩看这十家外国银行∶一、
Hu looked down the list: 1.

阿加剌银行二、
Agra Bank; 2.

利中银行三、
Lizhong Bank; 3.

利商银行四、
Lishang Bank; 4.

汇泉银行五、
Huiquan Bank; 5.

麦加利银行六、
the Chartered Bank; 6.

汇隆银行七、
Huilong Bank; 7.

有利银行八、
the Mercantile Bank; 8.

法兰西银行九、
the French Bank; 9.

汇丰银行十、
HSBC; 10.

丽如银行这一着，他倒踌躇了。
the Oriental Bank. Now he hesitated.

因为通称外国银行，而国籍不同；
They were all called foreign banks, but their nationalities differed.

尤其英法两国，一向钩心斗角，各自扩张势力，如今为了左宗棠设厂造船，更加不和。
Britain and France in particular were constantly manoeuvring against each other to extend their influence; Zuo’s shipbuilding project had sharpened their rivalry.

如果请在一起，彼此猜忌，不肯开诚布公相见，
Invited together, they might become suspicious and refuse to speak openly.

岂不是白费功夫？
Would that not waste everyone’s time?

于是他问∶』分开来请如何？
“What about inviting them separately?” he asked.

『『当然可以。
“Certainly.

不过，小爷叔，照我看，只请有用的好了。
But, Little Uncle, I would invite only those who can help.

一次弄妥当了，其余的就不必理了。』
If we settle it with them at one sitting, we need not bother with the others.”

『那末，你说，哪些是有用的呢？』
“Which ones would be useful, then?”

古应春提笔在手，毫不考虑地在五、七、九三家银行上面一钩。
Without hesitation Gu marked numbers five, seven, and nine.

这也是胡雪岩意中，
Hu had expected as much.

因为汇丰银行在古应春是必不会少的；既有汇丰，便有麦加利与有利两家，因为这两家是英国银行，与汇丰的渊源较深。
Gu would naturally include HSBC; with HSBC came the Chartered and Mercantile Banks, both British institutions with close connections to it.


但是，汇丰银行却并非纯然英国银行。
HSBC, however, was not an exclusively British bank.

它原名『香港上海银行有限公司』，同治三年创设总行于香港，资本定为港币五百万元，
Originally named the Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Company Limited, it had established its head office in Hong Kong in the third year of Tongzhi, with a capital of five million Hong Kong dollars.

由英国的怡和洋行、仁记洋行；美国的旗昌洋行，以及德国、中东的商人投资。
Investors included the British firms Jardine Matheson and Renji, the American firm Qichang, and merchants from Germany and the Middle East.

华商亦有股份加入；
Chinese merchants also held shares.

古应春即是其中之一，而且以此渊源，得以充任上海分行的买办。
Gu was among them, and this connection had helped him obtain the comprador’s position at the Shanghai branch.

香港上海银行的上海分行，较总行迟一年成立，
That branch opened a year after the head office.

派来的总经理名叫麦林，是英国人；与古应春是旧识，久知他干练可靠，
Its manager, a Briton named McLean, had known Gu for years and considered him capable and trustworthy.

且又是本行的股东，因而延揽他出任买办。
Gu’s position as a shareholder provided a further reason to engage him.

古应春接事后第一个建议是『正名』；
His first suggestion after taking office concerned the bank’s name.

香港上海银行的名称，照英文原名直译，固无错误，但照中国的习惯，开店不管大小，总要取个吉利的名字；
A literal rendering of “Hongkong and Shanghai Bank” was accurate enough, but Chinese custom required a business, however small, to have an auspicious name.

用地名，而且用两个地名作为银行的名称，令人有莫名其妙之感。
To name a bank after a place—indeed, two places—struck people as puzzling.

如果『香港上海银行』之下，再赘以『上海分行』四字，更觉不伦不类，
Add “Shanghai Branch” after “Hongkong and Shanghai Bank,” and the result became more awkward still.

文理不协，难望成为一块『金字招牌』。
Such an ungainly name could hardly become a celebrated commercial signboard.


麦林从善如流，接纳了古应春的意见，
McLean readily accepted the suggestion.

依照中国『讨口采』的习俗，取名香港上海汇丰银行；简称汇丰银行或汇丰，
Following the Chinese preference for auspicious associations, they adopted the name Hongkong and Shanghai Huifeng Bank, shortened to Huifeng Bank or simply Huifeng: “abundant remittances.”

无论南北口音，喊起来都很响亮。而且南北口音，都无甚区别；
It sounded clear and resonant in both northern and southern speech, with little variation in pronunciation.

不比麦加利银行的麦加二字，在上海人口中便与北方人并不一致。
The Chinese name Maijiali, used for the Chartered Bank, was less fortunate: its first two syllables sounded different in Shanghai from the way northerners pronounced them.

古应春的第二个建议是，
Gu’s second proposal concerned the shareholders.

股东的国籍不同，彼此立场不同，就会意见分歧，形成相互掣肘，无可展布的不利情况。
Different nationalities brought different interests, producing disagreements and mutual obstruction that could prevent the bank from acting effectively.

所以主张以英国为主体，逐渐收买他国股份；同时联络友行，厚集势力，相互支援。
He therefore urged that British interests should predominate, gradually buying out shareholders of other nationalities, while alliances with friendly banks would strengthen their collective resources and provide mutual support.

亦为麦林所欣然接纳。
McLean welcomed this advice too.


汇丰所联络的两家友行，当然是英国银行，亦就是麦加利与有利两行。
The two banks HSBC cultivated were naturally British: the Chartered and the Mercantile.

有利是上海资格最老的外国银行，创设于咸丰四年。
The Mercantile, established in the fourth year of Xianfeng, was Shanghai’s oldest foreign bank.

它是英国的海外银行之一，总行设在伦敦；在印度孟买及上海都有分行。
It was one of Britain’s overseas banks, with its head office in London and branches in Bombay and Shanghai.

麦加利银行是英皇发布敕令，特许在印度、澳洲、上海设立分行的股份有限公司。
The Chartered Bank was a joint-stock company authorised by royal charter to establish branches in India, Australia, and Shanghai.

总行设在伦敦；咸丰七年在上海开设分行，
Its head office was in London; its Shanghai branch opened in the seventh year of Xianfeng.

广东人称它为『喳打银行』；喳打的是英文『特许』一词的音译；
Cantonese speakers called it “Ja Da,” a phonetic rendering of “chartered.”

可是上海人却赚喳打二字拗口，索性以它第一任总经理麦加利为名，叫它麦加利银行。
Shanghai people found that name awkward to pronounce and instead called it Maijiali, after its first manager.

麦加利银行完全是为了便利英商在印度、澳洲、上海的贸易而设，
It had been established specifically to facilitate British trade with India, Australia, and Shanghai.

所以跟胡雪岩在阜康钱庄的同行关系以外，还有『销洋庄』生意上的往来。
Thus, besides its dealings with Fukang as a fellow banking concern, it also did business with Hu through his sales to foreign trading houses.


『这三家银行当然有用。』胡雪岩踌躇说，
“Those three banks would certainly be useful,” Hu said doubtfully.

『只怕还不够。』
“I am afraid they may not be enough.”

『还不够？』
“Not enough?”

古应春这时才发觉，谈了半天，是怎么回事，还没有弄明白；
Only now did Gu realise that, after all this discussion, he still did not know what the matter involved.

只凭彼此相知既久，默契已深，猜测着谈论，
They had known each other so long and understood each other so well that they had been talking on assumptions.

毕竟是件可笑的事，
It was rather absurd.

He came to the point. “Little Uncle, how much do you want to borrow?”

『至少一百二十万。』
“At least a million two hundred thousand.”

『这是银行从来没有贷放过的一笔大数目。』
“The banks have never advanced such a large sum.

His Excellency Zuo, of course?”

西征的军饷。』

不过一定要办成功。』

胡雪岩从不畏难，徒劝无效；
Hu had never shrunk from difficulties; persuasion would be wasted.

他知道自己唯一所能采取的态度，便是不问成败利钝，尽力帮胡雪岩去克服困难。
The only course open to him was to help Hu overcome them, without counting the chances of success or failure.

『借一百二十万，
“A million two hundred thousand.

利息不妨稍为高些。
The interest can be a little high.

期限一年，前半年只行息；下半年拔月按本，分六期拔还。』
A term of one year: interest only for the first six months, then repayment of the principal in six monthly instalments.”

这就是十五万，只差五万了。

江海关打它三万的主意，还差两万，无论如何好想法子。』
We can look to Jianghaiguan Customs for thirty thousand; the remaining twenty thousand can surely be found somehow.”

『小爷叔，你打的如意算盘。

万一拖欠呢？』

“Fukang will guarantee them.”

古应春大摇其头，

“You have no reason to do that.

而且洋人做事，讲究直接了当；

Hu considered this and nodded. He was always willing to accept sound advice.

『他说，』只要事情办通，什么条件我都接受。『』洋人办事跟我们有点不同。

我们是讲信义通商，只凭一句话就算数；不大去想后果。

洋人呢，虽然也讲信义，不过更讲法理；
They value good faith too, but attach greater importance to legal principles.

而且有点」小人之心「，不算好，先算坏，
They are also rather suspicious: instead of calculating how things will go well, they first consider how they might go wrong.

拿借钱来说，第一件想到的事是，对方将来还不还得起？如果还不起又怎么办？
In a loan, their first questions are whether the borrower will be able to repay and what happens if he cannot.

『』我明白了。

The western campaign is a great undertaking.

哪一省不解，贻误戎机，罪名不轻。

『』好，

I can tell the foreigners that.

担保呢？『
What about security?”

Still, it is a proposal.

“You need not worry about that.

左大人自然做得到。
His Excellency Zuo can manage it.

「挟天子以令诸侯」的花样，他最擅长。』

『大板』是『大老板』的简称；洋行的华籍职员，都是这样称他们的『洋东』。

汇丰的『大板』麦林，胡雪岩也曾会过，
Hu had met McLean before.

He was shrewd, but also, as Shanghai people said, a man who understood how things worked: if a proposal made sense, one could usually reach an agreement with him.

所以胡雪岩欣然表示同意。

这等于确定麦林是作了借款的承诺；

连古应春都笑了，
Even Gu smiled.

『小爷叔，』他说，『我看交涉是你自己办的好；
“Little Uncle, you had better handle the negotiations yourself.

我只管传译。
I shall confine myself to interpreting.

麦林很精明；也只有精明的人才能让他佩服。
McLean is a shrewd man; only someone equally shrewd can win his respect.”

『于是即时展开了秘密而冗长的谈判；
Secret and lengthy negotiations began at once.

前后三天，反复商议，几于废寝忘食。
For three days they discussed and reconsidered the terms, almost forgetting food and sleep.

麦林原来就佩服精明的人，此时更为胡雪岩的旺盛企图心所感动；更为胡雪岩的过人的精力所压倒，
McLean already admired intelligence; now he was moved by Hu’s powerful ambition and overwhelmed by his extraordinary energy.

终于建成了协议。
At last they reached agreement.


这一协议并未订成草约，亦未写下笔录，
They drew up no draft contract and made no written record.

但彼此保证，口头协定，亦具有道义上的约束力量，决无翻悔。
Both sides nevertheless pledged that their oral agreement would bind them in honour, and that neither would go back on it.

商定的办法与条件是∶第一、借款总数，关于一百二十万两；由汇丰银行组成财团承贷。
The arrangements and conditions were these. First, the total loan would be one million two hundred thousand taels, to be provided by a syndicate organised by HSBC.


第二、月息八厘，付款先扣。
Second, interest would be 0.8 per cent a month, deducted in advance when the funds were disbursed.


第三、由胡雪岩、古应春介绍华商向汇丰银行存款，月息明盘四厘、暗盘六厘。
Third, Hu and Gu would introduce Chinese merchants as depositors at HSBC, with a publicly quoted monthly rate of 0.4 per cent and a private rate of 0.6 per cent.


第四、各海关每月有常数收入，各税务局多为洋人，因此，借款笔据，应由各海关出印票，并由各省督抚加印，
Fourth, since the customs houses had regular monthly receipts and their commissioners were mostly foreigners, the loan instruments would be sealed notes issued by the customs houses, bearing the additional seals of the provincial governors or governors-general.

到期向各海关兑取。
They would be redeemable at the customs houses when due.


第五、自同治六年七月起，每月拔本二十万两，半年清偿。
Fifth, beginning in the seventh month of the sixth year of Tongzhi, two hundred thousand taels of principal would be repaid each month, discharging the loan within six months.


这五条办法中，第三条是洋商与胡雪岩、古应春合得的好处，
Of these five provisions, the third gave the foreign bankers, Hu, and Gu a shared benefit.

明盘四厘，暗盘六厘，即是中间人得二厘的佣金；
The difference between the public rate of 0.4 per cent and the private rate of 0.6 per cent was a commission of 0.2 per cent for the intermediaries.

这也就是说，洋商向中国人借了钱，转借与中国官场，四厘入，八厘出，
In other words, the foreign bankers would borrow Chinese money and lend it on to Chinese officials, paying 0.4 per cent and receiving 0.8.

所得四厘好处，各半均分。
The resulting margin of 0.4 per cent would be divided equally between bankers and intermediaries.


至于印票必出自海关，是麦林坚决的主张。
McLean insisted that the sealed notes must come from the customs houses.

因为他虽相信胡雪岩与左宗棠，却不相信有关各省的督抚，
Though he trusted Hu and Zuo, he did not trust the governors and governors-general of the provinces concerned.

到时候印票如废纸，无可奈何；
Their notes might prove worthless when due, leaving him helpless.

而海关由洋人担任税务局，一经承诺，没有理由不守信用。
The customs commissioners, however, were foreigners; once they had given their word, he saw no reason why they should fail to keep it.

这在胡雪岩却是个难题，
This presented Hu with a difficulty.

因为除江海关每月协解三万两，可以情商上海道先出印票以外，
Jianghaiguan was already obliged to contribute thirty thousand taels a month, so he could ask the Shanghai circuit intendant to arrange for its notes to be issued in advance.

其余各海关并无协饷之责，就不见得肯出印票。
The other customs houses had no corresponding obligation and might refuse.

想来想去只有一个办法，就是奏明朝廷，每月由各省藩司负责将应解甘饷，解交本省海关归垫。
After much thought, he saw only one solution: obtain imperial approval for each provincial treasurer to remit the province’s monthly contribution for Gansu to its own customs house, reimbursing the sums advanced there.


幸好协饷各省都有海关，
Fortunately, all the contributing provinces had customs houses.

每月闽粤两海关各代借二十四万；浙海关代借四十二万两；加上江海关本身应解的十八万两，
Fujian and Guangdong Customs could each provide notes for two hundred and forty thousand taels, Zhejiang Customs for four hundred and twenty thousand, and Jianghaiguan for the hundred and eighty thousand it was itself due to contribute.

共计一百零八万两，所缺只有十二万。
Together these made one million eighty thousand, leaving only a hundred and twenty thousand short.

胡雪岩建议左宗棠要求湖北每月协饷两万，由江汉关出十二万两的印票，
Hu suggested that Zuo ask Hubei to contribute twenty thousand a month, with Jianghan Customs issuing notes for a hundred and twenty thousand.

合成一百二十万整数。
This would bring the total to exactly one million two hundred thousand.


这些办法，左宗棠完全同意；
Zuo approved all these arrangements.

但等奏准，已在开春，
By the time imperial permission arrived, however, spring had begun.

丝茶两市方兴，正须放款，因而利息提高到一分三厘。
The silk and tea markets were gathering momentum, demand for loans was strong, and the interest rate rose to 1.3 per cent a month.

这是从未有过的高利贷，
Such a high lending rate was unprecedented.

于是流言四起，说胡雪岩从中渔利；
Rumours spread that Hu was profiting from it.

尤其是李鸿章一派的人，不但展开口头的攻击，而且亦有实际的破坏行动。
Li Hongzhang’s faction in particular went beyond verbal attacks and took practical steps to sabotage the loan.

这个行动很简单，却很有效，就是策动江海关税务司拒绝出具印票。
The measure was simple but effective: they induced the Jianghaiguan Customs Commissioner to refuse to issue sealed notes.

一关如此，他关皆然，
Once one customs house refused, the others followed.

几于功败垂成。
Success was almost lost at the last moment.

经过胡雪岩的巧妙斡旋，这笔大借款还是做成功了。
Through Hu’s skilful mediation, the great loan was nevertheless completed.

是为中国借外债的开始；而左宗棠的勋业，以及胡雪岩个人的事业，亦因此而有了一个新的开始。
This was the beginning of China’s foreign borrowing; it also marked a new beginning for Zuo’s achievements and Hu’s own career.

但福者祸所倚，
Yet misfortune lies hidden in good fortune.

『红顶商人』胡雪岩的结局，相当凄惨；种因亦在于此！
The Red-Topped Merchant would meet a tragic end, and the seed of it was planted here.



胡雪岩
《灯火楼台》内容简介与前记
Towers of Light — Synopsis and Foreword
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


《灯火楼台》内容简介｜TOWERS OF LIGHT — SYNOPSIS


胡光墉（1823—1885 ），字雪岩，安徽绩溪人。
Hu Guangyong (1823–1885), courtesy name Xueyan, was a native of Jixi in Anhui.

《灯火楼台》是台湾著名作家高阳先生接续《胡雪岩》和《红顶商人》的一部长篇系列小说之第一部。
Towers of Light is the first instalment of a new sequence of novels by the celebrated Taiwan-based author Gao Yang, continuing Hu Xueyan and The Red-Topped Merchant.

作者在书中继续讲述胡雪岩的传奇经历。
Here the author resumes the account of Hu's extraordinary life.


胡雪岩因协助左宗棠镇压捻、回起义，为其筹措军饷、购办西洋新式火器、运送军前药品，
Hu had helped Zuo Zongtang suppress the Nian and Muslim uprisings, raising military funds, purchasing modern Western firearms and sending medicines to the armies at the front.

所以，得左宗棠在“收功”之后的出奏保举。
When Zuo's campaigns were concluded, he recommended Hu to the throne for reward.

由于胡雪岩的“殊功”，朝廷破格优奖，赏穿黄马褂，顶戴用珊瑚，
In recognition of his “exceptional services,” the court granted special honours beyond the usual rules: permission to wear a yellow riding jacket and a coral button on his official hat.

赫然成了一名“红顶商人”。
He had become a conspicuous “red-topped merchant.”

由此，官助商势，胡雪岩的发展，亦达到了巅峰。
With official influence supporting his commercial power, his career reached its summit.

胡雪岩凭借其雄厚的资本和靠捐纳与“殊功”所获的高官身分，活动于商界和官场，结交上层人物，
Drawing on his substantial capital and the high official standing acquired through contributions and “exceptional services,” Hu moved between commerce and government and cultivated powerful acquaintances.

并以官场中互相倾轧、利用的复杂关系、为左宗棠向英、德两国外商一次借银数百万两，以应支出浩繁的军费，从而多得左宗棠的庇荫。
He made use of the complex rivalries and mutual manipulation within officialdom to borrow several million taels in a single transaction from British and German merchants for Zuo's enormous military expenditure, thereby gaining still more of Zuo's protection.

由于精细的买卖，胡雪岩往往一夕之间，获利巨万，时称“财神”。
His skilful transactions often brought immense profits overnight, earning him the name “God of Wealth.”

于是，他大兴土木，营造庭园，规模甚巨，并纳多房姬妾，生活腐化，不堪言状。
He undertook lavish building projects, laid out gardens on a vast scale and took many concubines, living in unspeakable corruption and indulgence.

然而，树大招风，
Yet a tall tree catches the wind.

己遭非难，终于，在商事达于鼎盛之际，胡雪岩面临了危机。
Criticism had already gathered, and at the very height of his commercial success, Hu faced a crisis.


高阳先生于《灯火楼台》之后的《萧瑟洋场》（ 《灯火楼台》之二，亦为本公司出版）中，讲叙了胡雪岩在发展至巅峰之后，所面临的如履薄冰、危机四伏的处境和开始衰落的过程。
In The Desolate Foreign Settlement, which follows Towers of Light as its second volume and is also published by our company, Gao Yang describes the dangers surrounding Hu after his rise to the summit, his precarious position as though walking on thin ice, and the beginning of his decline.


前记｜FOREWORD


同光年间有“财神”之号的胡光墉，与王有龄、左宗棠遇合之奇，为拙作《胡雪岩》、《红顶商人》的主要题材小《灯火楼台》接续《红顶商人》，，写胡雪岩的结局。
The remarkable circumstances that brought Hu Guangyong, known during the Tongzhi and Guangxu reigns as the “God of Wealth,” together with Wang Youling and Zuo Zongtang form the principal subject of my novels Hu Xueyan and The Red-Topped Merchant. Towers of Light continues The Red-Topped Merchant and tells the story of Hu's end.

胡雪岩事业的颠峰，亦正是左宗囊“西征”收功，新疆底定，晋封二等候，一生勋业的巅峰，
The summit of Hu's career coincided with the conclusion of Zuo's western campaigns, the pacification of Xinjiang and Zuo's elevation to a marquisate of the second class—the height of his lifetime's achievements.

时在光绪四年春天。
This was in the spring of the fourth year of Guangxu's reign.


饮水思源，
One must remember the source when drinking the water.

没有胡雪岩筹饷及后勤支援之功，左宗棠的“西征”不可能获致辉煌的成就。
Without Hu's fundraising and logistical support, Zuo's western campaigns could not have achieved such brilliant results.

因此，这年四月十四日，左宗棠会陕西巡抚谭钟麟，联衔出奏，请“破格奖叙道员胡光墉”，
On the fourteenth day of the fourth lunar month that year, Zuo and Tan Zhonglin, governor of Shaanxi, submitted a joint memorial requesting “exceptional rewards for Circuit Intendant Hu Guangyong.”

历举他的“功劳”。 计九款之多。
They listed no fewer than nine instances of his “services.”

前面五款是历年各省水陆灾荒，胡雪岩奉母命捐银赈济的实绩，
The first five concerned donations Hu had made at his mother's instruction over the years to relieve disasters by land and water in various provinces.

因而为胡老太太博得一个正一品的封典，使得胡雪岩在杭州城内元宝街的住宅，得以大起门楼，
These earned his mother an honorary title of the senior first rank, allowing Hu to erect an imposing gatehouse at his residence on Yuanbao Street in Hangzhou.

浙江巡抚到胡家，亦须在大门外下轿，因为巡抚的品秩只是正二品。
Even the governor of Zhejiang had to leave his sedan chair outside the main gate when visiting, since his own rank was only senior second.


后四款是胡雪岩真正的“功绩”。
The remaining four were Hu's actual “achievements.”

一是胡雪岩在杭州设了一座字号“胡庆余堂”，规模宏大，声名媲美北京同仁堂的药店，
First, he had founded Hu Qingyu Hall in Hangzhou, a large pharmacy whose reputation rivalled Beijing's Tongren Hall.

历年，西征部队日常所需的“诸葛行军散”、“辟瘟丹”、神曲“、”六神九“之类的成药，治跌打损伤的膏药、金创药，以及军中所用药材，都由胡雪岩捐解。
Over the years, he had donated and dispatched the prepared medicines needed by the western armies—Zhuge Marching Powder, Biwen Pills, Shenqu and Liushen Pills—as well as plasters for bruises and injuries, wound medicines and other medicinal supplies for military use.

其次是奉左宗棠之命，在上海设立采运局，转运输将毫无延误，
Second, at Zuo's direction, he had established a purchasing and transport bureau in Shanghai, forwarding supplies without delay.

再次是经手赚买外洋火器，物美价廉。
Third, he had procured foreign firearms of good quality at reasonable prices.

泰西各国出有新式武器，随时采购，运至军前，
Whenever Western countries produced new weapons, he purchased them and sent them to the front.

左宗棠认为“新疆速定，虽已兵精，亦由器利”。
Zuo held that “the swift pacification of Xinjiang owed not only to the excellence of the troops but also to the effectiveness of their weapons.”


最后一项最重要，即是为左宗棠筹饷，
The final service was the most important: raising funds for Zuo.

除了借洋债及商债，前后合计在一千六百万两以上之外，各省的“协商”，亦由胡雪岩一手经理。
Besides arranging foreign and merchant loans totalling more than sixteen million taels, Hu alone managed the supporting remittances from the provinces.

协响未到，而前线不能不关饷时，多由胡雪岩代垫。
When these had not arrived but the front-line troops had to be paid, he often advanced the money himself.

湘军、淮军多曾出现过索响哗变事件，只有西征之师从不“闹响”。
Both the Hunan and Anhui armies had repeatedly suffered mutinies over pay; only the western expeditionary forces never “made trouble over their pay.”


这份能维持西征士气的功劳，左宗囊认为“实与前敌将领无殊”，
Zuo considered this contribution to military morale “truly no different from that of the commanders at the front.”

事先曾问过胡雪岩，打算得个什么奖励？
Beforehand, he had asked Hu what reward he hoped to receive.

回答是“想弄件黄马褂穿”，
“I should like a yellow riding jacket to wear,” Hu answered.

所以奏折中请子“破格优奖，赏穿黄马褂”，奉旨准如所请。
The memorial accordingly requested that he receive “exceptional honours and permission to wear a yellow riding jacket,” and the emperor approved it.

胡雪岩是捐班的道员，
Hu was a circuit intendant who had entered official service through the contribution system.

以军功赏加布政使衔，
His military services brought the additional honorary title of provincial treasurer.

从二品文官顶戴用珊瑚。
A civil official of the junior second rank wore a coral hat button.

乾隆年问的盐商，有戴红顶子的，戴红顶而又穿黄马褂，只有一个胡雪岩。
There had been salt merchants with red hat buttons in the Qianlong reign, but a red hat button together with a yellow riding jacket belonged to Hu Xueyan alone.


光绪六年十一月，左宗棠奉旨入觐，
In the eleventh lunar month of Guangxu's sixth year, Zuo was summoned to an imperial audience.

“仗差大臣督办新疆军务”及陕甘总督的差缺，分别由他麾下大将刘锦棠及杨昌浚接替。
His posts as imperial commissioner supervising military affairs in Xinjiang and governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu were taken over, respectively, by his generals Liu Jintang and Yang Changjun.

左宗棠于下年正月底到京，
He reached the capital at the end of the first lunar month of the following year.

奉旨以东阁大学士管理兵部，派为军机大臣，并在总理各国事务衙门行走。
As Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, he was ordered to administer the Ministry of War, appointed to the Grand Council and assigned duties in the Zongli Yamen, the office for foreign affairs.

当他从甘肃启程时，曾专函胡雪岩，约他灯节后在北京相晤，
When leaving Gansu, he had written personally to Hu, inviting him to meet in Beijing after the Lantern Festival.

可是……
But...

《灯火楼台》第一章（上）
Towers of Light — Chapter One, Part One
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


胡雪岩全传——灯火楼台
Hu Xueyan: Towers of Light


第一章 出将入相｜CHAPTER ONE: FROM GENERAL TO MINISTER


光绪七年三月初七，胡雪岩终于践约抵达北京。
On the seventh day of the third lunar month in the seventh year of Guangxu, Hu Xueyan at last fulfilled his promise and arrived in Beijing.

同行的有两个洋人，一个是在华经商多年，泰来洋行的经理，德国人福克，一个是英商汇丰银行的代表凯密伦。
Two foreigners accompanied him: Focke, a German who had traded in China for many years and managed the Tailai Trading House, and Cameron, a representative of the British-owned Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation.

由于这年天气格外冷，天津海口尚未解冻，所以胡雪岩是从陆路来的，
The weather had been exceptionally cold that year, and the harbour at Tianjin was still frozen, so Hu had travelled overland.

浩浩荡荡十几辆车，一进右安门，直投前门外草厂十条胡同阜康福钱庄。
His imposing procession of more than ten carriages entered You’an Gate and made straight for Fukangfu Bank in Caochang Shitiao Hutong outside Qianmen.

为了接待东家，“大伙”汪惟贤十天以前就预备好了，
Wang Weixian, the head manager, had begun preparing for his employer’s arrival ten days earlier.

车队一到，胡雪岩与他的客人，还有古应春与办笔墨的杨师爷，被接入客厅，
As soon as the carriages stopped, Hu and his guests, together with Gu Yingchun and Secretary Yang, who handled his correspondence, were ushered into the reception room.

特为挑出来的四名伶俐的学徒，倒脸水倒茶，忙个不停。
Four bright apprentices, specially chosen for the occasion, hurried about bringing water for washing and pouring tea.

胡雪岩是汪惟贤亲自照料，一面伺候，一面问讯旅况。
Wang attended to Hu himself, seeing to his needs while asking about the journey.


乱过一阵，坐定下来，胡雪岩贴身小斯之一的保福，捧着金水烟袋来为胡雪岩装烟，
When the bustle had subsided and they were seated, Baofu, one of Hu’s personal attendants, brought his gold water pipe and filled it for him.

同时悄声说道：“张姨太已经打发丫头来催请了。”
“Madam Zhang has already sent her maid to ask you to come in,” he murmured.

“现在哪里有工夫？”
“How can I possibly find time now?”

话中似嫌张姨娘不懂事。
Hu’s tone suggested that Madam Zhang ought to know better.

保福不作声，
Baofu said nothing.

只望着屏风后面一个十六七岁的丫头摇一摇手，表示胡雪岩还不能进去。
He merely waved a hand at a maid of sixteen or seventeen standing behind the screen, indicating that Hu could not come in yet.

由南到北，通都大邑中，有阜康钱庄，就有胡雪岩的一处“行馆”，大多有女主人，
From south to north, in the great cities where Fukang had branches, Hu also maintained residences, most of them with a woman in charge.

住在阜康福后进的张姨娘，不甚得宠，所以胡雪岩有这种语气。
Madam Zhang, the concubine who occupied the rear quarters of Fukangfu, was not a particular favourite; hence his tone.


“大先生，”汪惟贤来请示：“是用中菜，还是大菜。”紧接着又表功：
“Mr Hu,” Wang Weixian asked, “would you prefer Chinese food or Western food?” He promptly added a word about his own efforts.

“恐怕两位外国客人吃不来中菜，特为跟文大人借了个做大菜的厨子，
“I was afraid our two foreign guests might not take to Chinese dishes, so I specially borrowed a Western cook from His Excellency Wen.

都预备好了。”
Everything is ready.”

所谓“文大人”指的是刑部尚书文煜，他是正蓝旗的满洲人，同治七年出任福州将军。
His Excellency Wen was Wenyu, the Minister of Punishments, a Manchu of the Plain Blue Banner who had become Fuzhou Garrison General in the seventh year of Tongzhi.

清兵入关，在冲要之地没有驻防的将军坐镇，
After the Qing forces entered the passes, garrison generals had been stationed at strategic points throughout the country.

其中福州将军因为兼管闽海关之故，是有名的肥缺，
The Fuzhou post was famously lucrative because its holder also supervised the Fujian Maritime Customs.

文煜一干十年，官囊极丰，有上百万的款子，存在阜康。
Wenyu had held it for ten years and accumulated a very substantial official purse; he had over a million deposited with Fukang.

汪惟贤知道胡雪岩跟他是在福州的旧识，交情甚厚，
Wang knew that he and Hu were old friends from Fuzhou and on excellent terms.

所以不嫌冒昧，借了他从福州带来的会做大菜——西餐的厨子，来接待福克与凯密伦。
He had therefore felt free to borrow the cook Wenyu had brought from Fuzhou, who could prepare Western meals, to entertain Focke and Cameron.

既然预备好了，自然是吃大菜。
Since everything was ready, Western food it was.

胡雪岩本有些话要问汪惟贤，但因他也是主人的身分，按西洋规矩，与汪惟贤分坐长餐桌的两端，不便交谈。
Hu had wanted to ask Wang several questions, but as they were both acting as hosts, Western custom placed them at opposite ends of the long dining table, making conversation difficult.

直到饭罢，两洋客由阜康福中会说英语的伙计陪着去观光大栅栏以后，胡雪岩才能跟汪椎贤谈正事。
Only after dinner, when English-speaking clerks from Fukangfu took the two foreigners to see Dashilan, could Hu discuss business with Wang.


正事中最要紧的一件，便是他此行的任务，跟左宗棠谈一笔三四百万两银子的借款。
The most important matter was the purpose of Hu’s journey: to discuss with Zuo Zongtang a loan of three or four million taels of silver.

胡雪岩急于想知道的是，左宗棠人朝以后的境遇，
Hu was eager to learn how Zuo had fared since entering the court.

“帘眷”是否仍如以前之隆，
Did he still enjoy the same great favour from the empress dowagers behind the curtain?

与两王——掌枢的恭亲王及光绪皇帝的生父醇亲玉的关系，
How did he stand with the two princes, Prince Gong, who headed the Grand Council, and Prince Chun, the Guangxu Emperor’s father?

以及在军机中的地位等等，
What position did he hold within the Council itself?

必须了解得清清楚楚，他才能决定哪些话可以说，哪些事不必谈。
Hu needed to understand all this thoroughly before deciding what he could say and what he had better leave unmentioned.

“我看左大人在京里顿不长的。”
“I don’t reckon His Excellency Zuo will stop long in the capital,” Wang said.

汪惟贤也是杭州人，跟东家打乡谈，“待不长”称之为“顿不长”，
Wang too was from Hangzhou and spoke to his employer in their native dialect, using its local word for “stay long”.

使得胡雪岩大吃一惊。
The remark gave Hu a sharp shock.

“为啥顿不长？”
“Why won’t he stop long?”

“还不是他的‘沃不烂，煮不熟’的老脾气又发作了。”
“His old temper has come out again: no amount of stewing will soften him, no amount of boiling will cook him.”

“沃不烂、煮不熟”也是杭州的俚语，有刚愎自用之意。
This was another Hangzhou expression, meaning obstinately determined to have one’s own way.

接着，汪惟贤举左宗棠在军机处议俄约及“海防”一事，来支持他的看法。
To support his opinion, Wang went on to describe Zuo’s conduct during Grand Council discussions of the Russian treaty and coastal defence.


原来新疆回民起义一起，俄国以保侨为名。出兵占领了伊犁，
When the Muslim uprising had begun in Xinjiang, Russia had sent troops to occupy Ili under the pretext of protecting its subjects.

扬言暂时接管，回民起义一平，即当交还中国，
It announced that the occupation was temporary and that Ili would be returned to China as soon as the uprising had been suppressed.

及至左宗棠西征，先后克复乌鲁木齐、吐鲁番等重镇，天山南北路次第平靖，
In his western campaign, Zuo Zongtang had recovered such important towns as Urumqi and Turfan, restoring order in succession on both sides of the Tianshan Mountains.

开始议及规夏伊犁、要求俄国实践诺言，
He then raised the question of recovering Ili and called on Russia to honour its promise.

而俄国推三阻四，久假不归的本意，逐渐暴露。
Russia made one excuse after another, gradually revealing its true intention: to keep what it had supposedly borrowed.

于是左宗棠挟兵力以争，相持不下。
Zuo brought military pressure to bear, but neither side would yield.

这样到了光绪四年秋天，朝议决走循正式外交途径以求了结，
In the autumn of the fourth year of Guangxu, the court decided to seek a settlement through formal diplomacy.

特派左都御史崇厚为出使俄国饮差大臣，又赏内大臣衔，
Chonghou, the Left Censor-in-Chief, was appointed imperial envoy to Russia and given the honorary title of Minister of the Inner Court.

为与俄议约的全权大臣，许他便宜行事。
As plenipotentiary for the treaty negotiations, he was authorized to act at his own discretion.

这年腊月，崇厚取道法德两国，抵达俄京圣彼得堡，立即与俄国外务部尚书格尔思展开谈判。
In the last lunar month of that year, Chonghou travelled through France and Germany to St Petersburg and immediately began negotiations with Giers, the Russian foreign minister.

谈了半年才定议，
After six months they reached an agreement.

而且崇厚以“便宜行事”的“全权大臣”资格，在黑海附近，签订了《里瓦几亚条约》，
Exercising his discretionary powers as plenipotentiary, Chonghou signed the Treaty of Livadia near the Black Sea.

内容是割伊犁以西以南之地予俄，偿付“兵费”五百万卢布，增开通商口岸多处，许俄人通商西安、汉中、汉口，以及松花江至伯都呐贸易自由。
It ceded the territory west and south of Ili to Russia, provided five million roubles in compensation for military expenses, opened several additional trading ports, and allowed Russian trade at Xi’an, Hanzhong and Hankou, as well as unrestricted trade along the Songhua River as far as Boduna.


消息传回国内，舆论大哗，痛责崇厚丧权辱国。
When the news reached China, public opinion erupted, denouncing Chonghou for surrendering sovereign rights and humiliating the country.

而崇厚敢于订此条约，是因为背后有两个强有力的人在支持，
He had dared sign the treaty because two powerful men stood behind him.

一个是军机大臣沈桂芬，他是朝中足以与“北派”领袖李鸿藻抗衡的“南派”领袖，深得两宫太后的信任。
One was Grand Councillor Shen Guifen, leader of the Southern faction at court, who could hold his own against Li Hongzao, leader of the Northern faction, and enjoyed the deep confidence of both empress dowagers.

一个是直隶总督北洋大臣李鸿章，以继承曾国藩的衣钵标榜，
The other was Li Hongzhang, Governor-General of Zhili and Beiyang Minister, who presented himself as the heir to Zeng Guofan’s mantle.

在军务与洋务两方面的势力，已根深柢固，难以摇撼。
His influence in military and foreign affairs was firmly entrenched and difficult to shake.

在议约的半年中，崇厚随时函商，
Throughout the six months of negotiations, Chonghou had regularly sought their advice by letter.

获得沈、李二人的同意，才敢放心签约，
Only after receiving Shen’s and Li’s approval had he felt safe in signing.

而且未经请旨，即起程回国，留参赞邵友廉署理出使大臣。
He had then set off home without first requesting an imperial command, leaving his counsellor, Shao Youlian, to serve as acting envoy.

沈桂芬、李鸿章虽都赞成伊犁条约而动机不同。
Though Shen and Li both supported the Ili treaty, their motives differed.

沈桂芬是因为僵持的局面持续，朝廷即不能不派重兵防守，左宗棠的洋债就不能不借，
Shen believed that a continuing deadlock would oblige the court to maintain large forces on the frontier and Zuo to keep borrowing abroad.

长此以往，浩繁的军费会搞得民穷财尽，
In time, the enormous military expenditure would impoverish the people and exhaust the treasury.

用心可说是委曲求全。
His intention could be described as accepting a compromise to preserve the greater good.

李鸿章就不同了，多少是有私心的，
Li’s position was different and partly self-interested.

第一，如果中俄交恶而至于决裂，一旦开战，俄国出动海军，必攻天津，
First, if relations with Russia broke down and war followed, the Russian navy would surely attack Tianjin.

身为北洋大臣的李鸿章，就不知道拿什么抵挡了，
As Beiyang Minister, he did not know what he could use to repel it.

其次，左宗棠不断借洋债扩充势力，自非李鸿章所乐见，
Second, Zuo’s continual foreign borrowing to extend his power was hardly something Li welcomed.

伊犁事件一结束，左宗棠班师还朝，那就无异解甲归田了。
Once the Ili affair was settled and Zuo brought his army home, it would be virtually the same as laying down his arms and retiring.


无奈崇厚的交涉办得实在不高明，两宫震怒，士林痛诋，
Unfortunately, Chonghou had conducted the negotiations so badly that both empress dowagers were furious and the scholarly world condemned him bitterly.

连恭王与沈桂芬主持的总署——总理各国事务衙门行走的诸大臣，亦觉得过于委屈，有改议的必要。
Even the ministers serving in the Zongli Yamen, the office for foreign affairs headed by Prince Gong and Shen Guifen, thought the concessions excessive and considered revision necessary.

于是朝命以出使俄国大臣崇厚不候谕旨，擅自启程回国的罪名，开缺交部严加议处。
The court accordingly removed Chonghou from his post as envoy to Russia for setting out home without awaiting an imperial order and referred him for severe disciplinary review.

所议的俄约，交六部九卿、翰詹科道妥议具奏。
The Russian treaty was submitted to the Six Boards, the Nine Ministers, the Hanlin and Heir Apparent’s establishments, and the supervising secretaries and censors, for careful deliberation and a joint report.

这就是明朝的所谓“延议”。
This was what the Ming dynasty had called a court deliberation.

廷议的结果，崇厚所签的条约，无一可许，
Its conclusion was that not a single provision of Chonghou’s treaty could be accepted.

两宫因而召开“御前会议”，
The two empress dowagers therefore convened an imperial conference.

慈禧太后原想严办崇厚，加以“翰林四谏”中的宝连与黄体芳，上奏力攻崇厚，而且语中侵及李鸿章与恭王，
Cixi already intended to punish him severely; now Baolian and Huang Tifang, two of the Four Remonstrants of the Hanlin, submitted fierce attacks on him that also touched on Li Hongzhang and Prince Gong.

这一来，崇厚便免不了革职拿问，交刑部议罪，
Chonghou could no longer escape dismissal and arrest, followed by examination of his offences at the Ministry of Punishments.

虽非。 铛入狱， 而软禁在刑部提牢司的“火房”中，
Though he was not thrown into prison in chains, he was confined in the heated room of the Ministry’s Prison Office.

这度日如年的况味，也就可想而知了。
It was easy to imagine how each day there must have seemed a year.


此举是抵触“万国公法”的，各国公使，群起抗议，但朝廷不为所动，
This treatment conflicted with international law, and the foreign envoys protested as one, but the court remained unmoved.

一面派使英兼使法的钦差大臣、曾国藩的长子曾纪泽兼使俄，谋求改约，
It appointed Zeng Jize, Zeng Guofan’s eldest son and currently imperial envoy to Britain and France, to serve concurrently as envoy to Russia and seek a revised treaty.

一面将崇厚走了“斩监”的罪名。
At the same time, Chonghou was sentenced to beheading, to await review in prison.

不过，朝廷亦并未放弃和平解决的意愿，
Yet the court had not abandoned hope of a peaceful settlement.

备战以外，由李鸿章策动英、法、德三国公使，出面调停，
Alongside its preparations for war, Li Hongzhang induced the British, French and German envoys to mediate.

免了崇厚的死刑，但仍监禁，
Chonghou’s death sentence was remitted, though he remained confined.

然后曾纪泽才在光绪六年六月，由伦敦动身赴俄，修订崇约。
Only then, in the sixth lunar month of the sixth year of Guangxu, did Zeng leave London for Russia to revise Chonghou’s treaty.

交涉开始之时不会顺利，是可想而知的。
The negotiations were bound to be difficult at first.

幸而曾纪泽不愧名父之子，
Fortunately, Zeng proved worthy of his distinguished father.

运用他对“万国公法”的知识、出使的经验及关系，促请英、法驻俄公使的协助，
Drawing on his knowledge of international law, his diplomatic experience and his connections, he enlisted the help of the British and French envoys in Russia.

在左宗棠到京的前两天，与格尔思改走了约稿，伊犁收回，嘉峪通商，不明定可通至某处，松花江通航取消，
Two days before Zuo Zongtang reached Beijing, he and Giers agreed on a revised draft: Ili would be recovered; trade through Jiayu Pass would be allowed without specifying how far inland it might extend; navigation on the Songhua River would be cancelled.

只是赔偿“军费”增加四百万卢布，共为九百万。
The compensation for military expenses, however, was increased by four million roubles, making nine million in all.


当中俄关系紧张时，李鸿章提出“海防论”的主张，与左宗棠的“陆防论”针峰相对。
During the tension with Russia, Li Hongzhang had advocated coastal defence in direct opposition to Zuo Zongtang’s emphasis on land defence.

及至左宗棠到京入军机，先议俄约，
When Zuo arrived in Beijing and entered the Grand Council, the Russian treaty was discussed first.

由于曾纪泽挽回利权之多，超过朝野的期望，左宗棠亦表示满意，无甚争执，
Zeng Jize had recovered more rights and interests than either the court or the public had expected, so Zuo too expressed satisfaction, and there was little dispute.

后议李鸿章“海防”的计划，他的话就多了，
But when discussion turned to Li’s coastal-defence plans, he had much more to say.

由海防谈到陆防，一转而为西睡的形势，与他在新疆用兵的经过，
From coastal defence he moved to land defence, then to conditions on the western frontier and the story of his campaigns in Xinjiang.

滔滔不绝，目无余子，
He talked endlessly, as though nobody else mattered.

军机处只听得他一个人又说又笑，
In the Grand Council, only his voice and laughter could be heard.

“礼绝百僚”的恭王，默坐一两个时辰，连句话都插不上。
Prince Gong, whose rank placed him above all the officials, sat silently for two to four hours at a stretch without being able to get in a word.

“大先生你想，”汪惟贤说：
“Just think, Mr Hu,” Wang said.

“不要说恭王，哪个都吃不消他。
“Never mind Prince Gong; nobody could stand it.

恭王忍了又忍，忍到后来，索性要军机章京把原折收了起来，
The prince endured it again and again, until at last he simply told the Council secretaries to put the original memorial away.

不议了。”
They would discuss it no further.”

“不议了？”
“No further?”

胡雪岩诧异：
Hu was astonished.

“李合肥的海防，规模大得很呢！
“Li of Hefei has enormous plans for coastal defence!

要开办北洋舰队、电报局，
There’s the Beiyang Fleet and the Telegraph Bureau to be set up.

多少人等着吃这块大肥肉，
So many people are waiting for a bite of that rich meat.

哪里就说说算数，不议了？”
How can it all end with a few words and no more discussion?”

“喏，”汪惟贤放低了声音说：“毛病就出在这里，
“There,” Wang lowered his voice, “is the trouble.

不议不可以，要议又怕我们左大人独讲空话。
They have to discuss it, but if they do, they’re afraid our His Excellency Zuo will monopolize the conversation with empty talk.

那就只有调虎离了山再议。”
The only way is to lure the tiger away from the mountain before they resume.”

一听这话，胡雪岩心冷了一半。
Hu’s hopes sank halfway at these words.

原以为有左宗棠这样一座靠山当大军机，将来要借洋债，必然由他来主持，财源滚滚不绝。
With a powerful patron like Zuo on the Grand Council, he had assumed that Zuo would inevitably take charge of future foreign loans, bringing an endless stream of profit.

如今看样子怕又要外放，自己的想法也就落空了。
Now Zuo seemed likely to be sent out to a provincial post again, and Hu’s expectations would come to nothing.

而且恭王似乎有些讨厌左宗棠，
Worse still, Prince Gong appeared to dislike him.

此事颇为不妙，
That did not bode well.

只不知醇王待他如何？
But how did Prince Chun treat him?


“醇王待他是好的。
“Prince Chun treats him well.

大先生晓得的，醇王是好武的一伙，
You know he has a taste for military affairs, Mr Hu.

左大人有这样的战功，拿他当个英雄看，
With His Excellency Zuo’s military achievements, he regards him as a hero.

所谓惺惺相惜，
As they say, men of spirit appreciate one another.

常常有往来，走得很近的，
They visit often and are very close.

醇王还要请他到神机营去看操呢！”
The prince has even invited him to watch the drills at Shenji Camp.”

“你说啥！”胡雪岩问道：
“What did you say?” Hu asked.

“醇王请左大人到神机营看操！”
“Prince Chun has invited His Excellency Zuo to watch the drills at Shenji Camp?”

“是啊。”
“Yes.”

“你听哪个说的？”
“Who told you that?”

这话有不相信的意味，
The question carried a note of disbelief.

而且看得出来，胡雪岩很重视这件事，
It was also clear that Hu considered the matter important.

汪惟贤倒有些猜不透，只好据实作答。
Unable to fathom his reaction, Wang could only answer truthfully.

“我是听‘小军机’徐老爷说的。”汪惟贤又说：
“Mr Xu, the ‘junior grand councillor’, told me.

“左大人是正月底到京的，
His Excellency Zuo arrived at the end of the first month.

二月初醇亲王就请他吃饭，逛太平湖新修好的花园，
Early in the second, Prince Chun invited him to dinner and to see the newly completed garden at Taiping Lake.

二月十几又请，当面约他看操，
Sometime in the teens of that month, he invited him again and personally asked him to watch the drills.

左大人答应了，一定去，不过日子没有定。
His Excellency Zuo promised that he would certainly come, but they didn’t fix a day.

大先生这一来，大概要走日子了。”
Now that you are here, Mr Hu, I expect they will.”

胡雪岩越发不解，不过他并未立即发问，
Hu was more puzzled than ever, but he did not ask immediately.

先想了一下，何以醇亲王请左宗棠看操，先不能定日子，等他一来，才可以定日子呢？
Why could no date be fixed for Prince Chun’s invitation until he himself arrived?

想通了才问：“你这话是听哪个说的，
Only when he had thought it through did he ask, “Who told you that?

徐老爷？”
Mr Xu?”

“不是他还有哪个？”
“Who else?”

胡雪岩心想，“小军机徐老爷”——军机章京徐用仪，跟左宗棠的关系向来密切，左宗棠应酬京官，一直都托他经手，
Mr Xu, the so-called junior grand councillor, was Xu Yongyi, a secretary of the Grand Council. Hu reflected that he had always been close to Zuo, who consistently entrusted him with arrangements for his dealings with officials in Beijing.

他要谈到左宗棠，话都是靠得住的。
Anything he said about Zuo could be relied upon.


继而转念，一客不烦二主，
Then another thought struck Hu: why trouble two hosts when one would do?

自己有好些事何不也委托了徐用仪？
He too had many matters that could be entrusted to Xu.

于是立刻关照杨帅爷写了个帖子，请徐用仪“小酌”，特别注明“盼即命驾，俾聆教益”，
He immediately told Secretary Yang to write an invitation asking Xu to join him for a modest drink, with a special request that he come at once so Hu might benefit from his advice.

另外捡了四样杭州的名物，两只方裕和的火腿，十把舒莲记的檀香扇，四坛景阳观的酱菜，还有胡庆余堂的“本作货”辟瘟丹、虎骨本瓜烧之类，
He also selected four kinds of Hangzhou speciality: two Fang Yuhe hams, ten Shulianji sandalwood fans, four jars of Jingyangguan pickled vegetables, and Hu Qingyu Hall’s own products, including Biwen Pills and tiger-bone-and-papaya liquor.

装了一网篮，伴着请帖，一起送到徐府。
These were packed into a basket and sent with the invitation to Xu’s house.

日落时分，徐用仪来了。还是穿了官服来的，
Xu arrived at sunset, still wearing his official robes.

他的底缺是刑部主事，胡雪岩的顶戴是珊瑚顶子，
His substantive appointment was as a secretary in the Ministry of Punishments, whereas Hu wore a coral button on his official hat.

官阶差着一大截，所以用的是属员参见长官的礼节。
Their ranks were far apart, so Xu observed the formalities of a subordinate calling on a superior.

“大人几时到京的？”徐用仪见了胡雪岩，急趋踱步，一面说话，一面捞起袍衬下摆，打算要请安了。
“When did Your Excellency arrive in Beijing?” he asked, hurrying forward and gathering up the hem of his robe, ready to make his formal obeisance.

徐用仪字筱云，
Xu’s courtesy name was Xiaoyun.

胡雪岩跟他见过一次面，称他“筱翁”，这时急忙双手扶住，带着埋怨的语气说：
Hu, who had met him once before and addressed him as Mr Xiaoyun, quickly caught him with both hands.

“筱翁，筱翁，
“Mr Xiaoyun, Mr Xiaoyun!

你这样子简直在骂人了。
You positively insult me with these formalities.

赶紧请换了衣服再说。”
Please change your clothes at once, and then we can talk.”

徐用仪的跟班，早就挟着衣包在廊上等候，
Xu’s attendant was already waiting in the corridor with a bundle of clothes.

听得这话，便进来伺候主人更换便衣。宝蓝宁绸夹袍，玫瑰紫贡缎琵琶襟坎肩，
At these words he came in to help his master change into informal dress: a lined gown of royal-blue Nanjing silk and a rose-purple tribute-satin vest with a curved, pipa-shaped front fastening.

这是军机章京习惯成自然而专用的服饰，在应酬场中很出风头的。
This had become the customary, distinctive attire of Grand Council secretaries and made quite a show in social gatherings.

相互作了辑，上炕落坐，
They exchanged bows and sat on the kang.

徐用仪改了称呼：
Xu now changed his form of address.

“胡大先生是哪天到的？”
“On what day did you arrive, Mr Hu?”


“刚到。
“Just now.

我的第一位客，就是筱翁。”
You are my first guest, Mr Xiaoyun.”

徐用仪有些受宠若惊似地，抱着拳文绘绘地说：
Looking almost overwhelmed by the honour, Xu clasped his hands and replied in polished literary phrases.

“辱承不弃，又蒙宠赐多珍，真是既感且愧。”
“Your gracious regard, and the many precious gifts you have so kindly bestowed, leave me at once grateful and ashamed.”

“小意思，小意思，
“Mere trifles, mere trifles!

何足道哉！”胡雪岩问：“筱翁跟左大人常见？”
Not worth mentioning.” Hu asked, “Do you see His Excellency Zuo often?”

“天天见面的，
“Every day.

该我的班，一天要见两回，早晨在军机处，下午在左大人的公馆贤良寺。”
When I’m on duty, twice a day: in the morning at the Grand Council, and in the afternoon at his residence in Xianliang Temple.”

“他老人家精神倒还好？”
“Is the old gentleman keeping well?”

“还好，还好。
“Very well, very well.

不过……”
Only…”

徐用仪微蹩着眉说：
Xu frowned slightly.

“好得有点过头了，反倒不大好。”
“Rather too well, which is not altogether a good thing.”

“大概是他老人家话多之故？”
“Because he talks so much, I suppose?”

“话不但多，中气还足。
“Not only does he talk a great deal; he has powerful lungs.

他在北屋高谈阔论，我们在南屋的人都听得到。”
When he holds forth in the north room, those of us in the south room can hear everything.”


胡雪岩点点头，暂且丢开左宗棠，
Hu nodded and put Zuo aside for the moment.

“筱翁，”他说，“我在京里，两眼漆黑，
“Mr Xiaoyun, I am completely in the dark here in Beijing.

全要靠你照应。”
I must depend on you to look after me.”

徐用仪知道这是客气话，
Xu knew this was only courtesy.

胡雪岩拿银子当灯笼，双眼雪亮，当下答说：
With silver for his lantern, Hu could see perfectly clearly.

“不敢当，不敢当，
“You are too kind.

如果有可以效劳的地方，不必客气，尽请吩咐。”
If there is anything I can do, please give me your instructions without hesitation.”

“太言重了。”胡雪岩说：
“You put it too strongly,” Hu said.

“我是真心要拜托筱翁，
“I truly do want to ask your help.

想请筱翁开个票子，
Would you draw up a list for me?

哪里要应酬，
Whom must I attend to?

哪里要自己去，
Whom must I visit myself?

应酬是怎么个应酬法？
And how should I go about it in each case?

都请筱翁指点。
I should like your guidance on all these points.

还有个不情之请，这张票子，要请筱翁此刻就开。”
I have one further, unreasonable request: please draw up the list now.”

这是委以重任了。徐用仪自然照办，
This was an important responsibility, and Xu naturally agreed.

想了一下说：“第一是同乡高官，尤其是言路上的几位，
After a moment’s thought he said, “First, the senior officials from your home province, especially those whose office is to remonstrate with the throne.

要多送一点。”
They should receive rather more.”

“是的。
“Exactly.

请筱翁指示好了。
Please tell me what to do.

说多少就是多少。”
Whatever amounts you say, I shall accept.”

浅交而如此信任，徐用仪不免起了报答知己之感，
Such confidence from a man he scarcely knew made Xu feel that he must repay one who appreciated him.

“我要冒昧请教胡大先生，”他问：“这趟进京，是不是来谈借洋款的事？”
“May I venture to ask, Mr Hu, whether you have come to Beijing to discuss a foreign loan?”

“是的。”
“Yes.”

“还有呢？”
“Anything else?”

“还有，想打听打听洋法缫丝，京里是怎么个宗旨？”
“I also want to find out what view the capital takes of silk reeling by Western methods.”

“这容易，
“That is easy.

我就知道，回头细谈。”徐用仪接着又说：
I know the answer myself; we can discuss it later.

“如果是为借洋债的事，总理衙门的章京，户部的司官，不能不应酬。
But if you are here about a foreign loan, the secretaries of the Zongli Yamen and the departmental officials of the Ministry of Revenue must receive attention.

我开个单子出来。”
I’ll draw up a list.”

于是端出笔砚，徐用仪就在茶几上开出一张单子，
Brush and inkstone were brought, and Xu wrote at the tea table.

斟酌再三，在名字下写上数目，自一百至五百不等，自然是银票的数目。
After careful consideration he put a figure beneath each name, ranging from one hundred to five hundred: the amounts, of course, to be given in banknotes.


“有个人，怎么送法，要好好考究。”徐用仪搁笔说道：
“There is one man whose gift will require careful thought,” Xu said, laying down his brush.

“为今管户部的是宝中堂，他又是总理大臣。”
“Grand Secretary Bao now oversees the Ministry of Revenue, and he also serves in the Zongli Yamen.”

清朝有“大学士管部”的制度，
Under the Qing system, grand secretaries were assigned oversight of ministries.

勋业彪炳的左宗棠，以东阁大学士奉旨“人阁办事”。 自然是管兵部，
Zuo Zongtang, with his outstanding military achievements, had been summoned to serve at court as Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion and naturally supervised the Ministry of War.

宝鋆则是以武英殿大学士，继去世的文祥管户部，实掌度支大权。
Bao Yun, Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory, had succeeded the late Wenxiang in supervising the Ministry of Revenue, giving him actual control over the national finances.

对于左宗棠借重息的洋债，啧有烦言，这是胡雪岩也知道的，
He had often criticized Zuo’s high-interest foreign loans, as Hu was well aware.

为今听徐用仪提到宝鋆，正说到心事上，
Xu’s mention of Bao touched the very point troubling him.

不由得便将身子凑了过去，声音也低了。
He leaned closer and lowered his voice.

“我没有跟宝中堂打过交道。
“I have never had dealings with Grand Secretary Bao.

请教筱翁，
Can you advise me, Mr Xiaoyun?

有没有路子？”
Is there a way to approach him?”

“有条路子，
“There is one.

我也是听说，不过可以试一试。”
I have only heard about it, but we could try.”

“什么路子？”
“What is it?”

“是这样的……”
“This is how it works…”

“法不传六耳”，徐用仪说得仅仅只有胡雪岩听得见。
A secret was not to be passed to a third pair of ears: Xu spoke so softly that only Hu could hear.

于是，在摆点心请徐用仪时，他抽个空将古应春找了来，有话交代。
