Later, while refreshments were being served to Xu, Hu found an opportunity to call Gu Yingchun over and give him some instructions.


“你对古董字玩都是内行，
“You know antiques, calligraphy and paintings.

我想托你到琉璃厂走一趟。”
I should like you to make a trip to Liulichang.”

古应春不免奇怪，
Gu was puzzled.

胡雪岩到京，正事一件未办，倒忽然有闲情逸致要物色古董字画，其故安在？
Hu had only just arrived in Beijing and had not yet attended to a single item of business; why had he suddenly found the leisure to hunt for works of art?

看出他心中的疑惑，胡雪岩便又说道：“我要买样东西送人。”
Seeing his doubt, Hu added, “I want to buy something as a gift.”

原来是送礼，
So that was it.

“送哪个？”古应春问。
“For whom?” Gu asked.

胡雪岩接过他的手来，在他掌心写了个“宝”字，
Hu took his hand and traced the character Bao on his palm.

然后开口：“明白？”
“Understand?”

“明白。”
“I do.”

“好。”胡雪岩说：
“Good.

“琉璃厂有一家‘海岳山房’，上海的海，岳老爷的岳。
There is a shop in Liulichang called Haiyue Shanfang: Hai as in Shanghai, Yue as in Lord Yue.

你进去找一个姓朱的伙计，是绍兴人，
Go in and ask for a clerk surnamed Zhu, a man from Shaoxing.

你问他，某某人喜欢什么？
Ask him what a certain person likes.

他说字画，你就要字画，他说古董，你就要古董。
If he says calligraphy and paintings, ask for those; if he says antiques, ask for antiques.

并要关照：东西要好，价钱不论。”
And make it clear: the pieces must be good, whatever the price.”

古应春将他的话细想了一遍，深深点头，表示会意：
Gu considered these instructions carefully, then nodded emphatically to show that he understood.

“我马上去。”
“I’ll go at once.”

等他回来，主客已经入席了。
By the time he returned, host and guest were already at table.

胡雪岩为古应春引见了徐用仪，然后说道：
Hu introduced him to Xu.

“来，来，陪筱翁多喝几杯？”接着又问：“怎么样？”
“Come, come, have a few more cups with Mr Xiaoyun.” Then he asked, “Well?”

“明天看东西。”
“I’m to see the goods tomorrow.”


胡雪岩知道搭上线上，便不再多问，
Knowing that contact had been established, Hu asked no more.

转脸看着徐用仪说：
He turned to Xu.

“筱翁刚才说，如今做官有四条终南捷径，
“You said just now that there are four shortcuts to official advancement these days, Mr Xiaoyun.

是哪四条？”
What are they?”

“是四种身分的人：”帝师王佐，鬼使神差‘。
“Four sorts of people: imperial tutors, princely aides, envoys to devils, and men on divine commissions.

象李兰荪、翁步平都是因为当皇上的师傅起家的，此谓之’帝师‘。
Men like Li Lansun and Weng Buping made their way by teaching the emperor: those are the imperial tutors.

宝中堂是恭王的死党，以前文中堂也是，
Grand Secretary Bao is a devoted partisan of Prince Gong, as Grand Secretary Wen used to be.

这是’王佐‘。
Those are the princely aides.”

““文大人？”胡雪岩不觉诧异，
“His Excellency Wen?” Hu exclaimed.

“入阁拜相了。”
“Has he become a grand secretary?”

徐用仪一愣，旋即省悟。
Xu paused in surprise, then understood.

他指的是已去世的体仁阁大学士文祥，胡雪岩却以为文煜升了协办大学士。
He meant the late Wenxiang, Grand Secretary of the Tiren Pavilion, whereas Hu thought Wenyu had been promoted to assistant grand secretary.

当即答说：“尚书照例要转到吏部才会升协办，
“As a rule, a minister has to be transferred to the Ministry of Personnel before he can become assistant grand secretary.

他现在是刑部尚书，
He is still Minister of Punishments.

还早。”
It will be some time yet.”

“喔，喔，”胡雪岩也想到了，
“Ah, yes,” Hu said, understanding in turn.

“筱翁是说以前的文文忠。”
“You mean the late Wen Wenzhong.”

文忠是文祥的谥称。
Wenzhong was Wenxiang’s posthumous name.

“不错。”
“Exactly.”

“筱翁，”古应春插进来说：“ ‘鬼使’顾名思义，是出使外国，跟洋鬼子打交道。
“Mr Xiaoyun,” Gu put in, “‘envoys to devils’ explains itself: men sent abroad to deal with foreign devils.

何谓‘神差’就费解了。”
But what are these ‘divine commissions’?”

“一说破很容易明白。”
“Once explained, it is quite simple.”

徐用仪指着胡雪岩说：
Xu gestured towards Hu.

“刚才胡大先生跟我在谈神机营，
“Mr Hu and I were just discussing Shenji Camp; shen in its name means divine.

‘神差’就是神机营的差使。
A ‘divine commission’ means a posting there.

因为醇王之故，在神机营当差，保举特优。
Because of Prince Chun, men serving in the camp receive exceptionally favourable recommendations for promotion.

不过汉人没分，
But Han Chinese have no share in it.

就偶尔有，也是武将，
Even the occasional exception is a military officer.

文官没有在神机营当差的。”
There are no Han civil officials serving there.”


“应春，”胡雪岩说：“刚刚我跟筱翁在谈，醇王要请左大人到神机营去看操，
“Yingchun,” Hu said, “Mr Xiaoyun and I were just talking about Prince Chun’s invitation to His Excellency Zuo to watch the drills at Shenji Camp.

左大人要等我来定日子，
His Excellency is waiting for me to arrive before fixing the day.

你道为啥？
Do you know why?

为的是去看操要犒赏，左大人要等我来替他预备。
Because he must reward the troops when he goes, and he is waiting for me to prepare the rewards.

你倒弄个章程出来。
Work out a plan for me.”

古应春心想，犒赏兵丁，
Gu reflected that rewarding troops ordinarily meant paying cash.

无非现在有阜康福钱庄在此，左宗棠要支银，派人来说一声就是。
With Fukangfu Bank here, Zuo need only send someone over to say that he wanted silver.

不此之图，自然是认为犒赏现银不适宜，要另想别法。
Since he had not done so, he must consider cash unsuitable and want something else.

“我们也不晓得人家喜欢什么东西？”古应春建议，
“We don’t know what they would like,” Gu suggested.

“我看不如索性请荣大人到醇王那里去老实问一问，
“Why not simply ask His Excellency Rong to go to Prince Chun and inquire frankly?

该怎么犒赏，听醇王的吩咐预备。”
We can prepare the rewards according to the prince’s instructions.”

“荣仲华早已不上醇王的门了。”
“Rong Zhonghua stopped calling at Prince Chun’s house long ago,” Xu said.

荣仲华就是荣禄，大家都知道他是醇王一手所提拔，
Rong Zhonghua was Ronglu, whom everyone knew to have been raised to prominence by the prince himself.

居然不上“举主”的门了，宁非怪事？
That he should no longer visit his own patron was extraordinary.

这就连胡雪岩也好奇地要一问究竟。
Even Hu wanted to know why.

“说来话长。其中还牵涉到一桩谈起来任何人都不会相信的秘密。”
“It is a long story, involving a secret that nobody would believe.”

徐用仪放低声音问道：
Xu lowered his voice.

“你们在南边有没有听说过，西太后是什么病？”
“Have you heard in the south what illness the Western Empress Dowager is suffering from?”

“听说是干血痨。”胡雪岩答说：
“I heard it was dry-blood wasting disease,” Hu replied.

“怎么会弄出来这个毛病？”
“How could she have developed such an illness?”

“是……”
“It is…”

徐用仪突然顿住，
Xu broke off abruptly.

“这话以不说为宜，两位亦以不听为妙，
“Better that I should not speak of it, and better that you should not hear it.

听了不小心传出去会闯大祸，
If you heard and accidentally passed it on, it could bring terrible trouble.

那就是我害了两位了。
I should have harmed you both.

我们谈别的吧。”
Let us talk of something else.”

说到紧要之处，徐用仪忽然卖起关子来，胡雪岩不免怏怏。
Hu was disappointed to have Xu become mysterious just at the critical point.

但转念觉得徐用仪如此谨慎小心，倒是可信任的。这一转念间，心中的不怏，涣然而释。
Then he reflected that such caution made Xu a man to be trusted, and his disappointment dissolved.


于是又把杯闲谈了片刻，
They drank and chatted a little longer.

徐用仪因为初次同席，不肯多饮，
Since this was his first time at Hu’s table, Xu would not drink much.

要了一碗粥喝完，预备告辞了。
He asked for a bowl of rice gruel, finished it and prepared to leave.

“惟贤！”胡雪岩问道：“预备好了没有？”
“Weixian,” Hu called, “is everything ready?”

“预备好了。”
“It is.”

汪惟贤亲自端来一个托盘，上有十几个红封套，另外一张名单，
Wang himself brought a tray containing more than ten red envelopes and a list of names.

这是要托徐用仪代为致送的“菲敬”。
These were the “small tokens of respect” Xu was to deliver on Hu’s behalf.

“拜托，拜托！”胡雪岩拱拱手说：
“I am most obliged,” Hu said, clasping his hands.

“其余的我亦照筱翁的意思办，或我亲自去拜候，或我派人送，
“I shall deal with the others just as you advised, either calling myself or sending someone with the gift.

尽明天一天办妥。”
Everything will be done tomorrow.”

“好！好！”徐用仪问：
“Good, good.

“胡大先生你明天什么时候去看左大人？”
When will you see His Excellency Zuo tomorrow, Mr Hu?”

“一早去等他。”
“I shall go early and wait for him.”

“那么明天我们在贤良寺见，有话到时候再说。”
“Then we will meet at Xianliang Temple and talk further there.”

“是，是！”
“Yes, indeed.”

胡雪岩一面说，一面向汪惟贤手一伸，接过来一个红封套，抽出里面的银票来看，
As he spoke, Hu held out a hand to Wang, took a red envelope, and drew out the banknote to check it.

照他的意思，开出四百两不误，
It had been made out for four hundred taels, exactly as he had instructed.

便悄悄塞到徐用仪手中，顺势捏住，不让他推辞。
He quietly slipped it into Xu’s hand and closed his own hand over it so that Xu could not refuse.

“不，不！
“No, no!

没有这个道理。”
There is no reason for this.”

“小意思。
“A mere trifle.

筱翁不收就是不拿我胡某人做朋友。”
If you will not accept it, you do not regard me as a friend.”

“真是受之有愧。
“I truly feel ashamed to accept it.

谢谢，谢谢。”
Thank you, thank you.”


等客人走了，胡雪岩问起海岳山房的情形，
After Xu had left, Hu asked about Haiyue Shanfang.

古应春告诉他说，会到了姓朱的伙计，问起宝鋆喜欢什么，
Gu said that he had met the clerk surnamed Zhu and asked what Bao Yun liked.

姓朱的答说都喜欢。
Zhu had replied that he liked everything.

古应春便照胡雪岩的话交代，价钱贵不要紧，只要东西好，
Gu had then repeated Hu’s instructions: a high price did not matter, provided the pieces were good.

当下约走次日上午看货。
They had arranged for him to inspect the goods the following morning.

“你早点去。
“Go early.

看过了，马上陪洋人到紧良寺来。”胡雪岩又说：
As soon as you have seen them, bring the foreigners to Xianliang Temple,” Hu said.

“左大人犒赏神机营，我倒想好了一个办法，
“As for His Excellency Zuo’s rewards for Shenji Camp, I have thought of a plan myself.

不知道办得通，办不通，都等明天下午再谈吧！”
Whether it can be carried out or not, we will leave that until tomorrow afternoon.”

说罢，打了一个呵欠。
He yawned.

海岳山房的朱伙计，外号“朱铁口”，所以有这个仿佛星相术上艺名的外号的由来是，
The clerk at Haiyue Shanfang was nicknamed Zhu Tiekou, or Iron Mouth Zhu, a name that sounded like a fortune-teller’s professional title.

他对古董、字画、版本的鉴别，无一不精，视其必真，说伪必伪。
He had earned it through his unfailing judgment of antiques, paintings, calligraphy and book editions: what he declared genuine was genuine; what he called false was false.

因此，虽是受人雇用的伙计，而琉璃厂中古玩铺、南海店的掌柜，当面都尊称他为“朱先生”。
Although only an employee, he was respectfully addressed as Mr Zhu by the proprietors of Liulichang’s antique shops and Nanhai shops.

古应春做事很精细，知道了朱铁口的本事，有意拉交情，
Gu, always careful in his dealings, had learned of his abilities and wanted to cultivate his friendship.

委屈自己主顾的身分，也称他为“朱先生”，
Putting aside the superior standing of a customer, he too called him Mr Zhu.

朱铁口自然谦称“万不敢当”，自己建议：“叫我老朱好了。”
Zhu naturally protested that he did not deserve such respect and suggested, “Just call me Old Zhu.”

“恭敬不如从命。”古应春说道：
“Better to obey than insist on courtesy,” Gu replied.

“老朱，你有些什么东西给我看。”
“Old Zhu, what have you to show me?”

那一声“朱先生”改变了朱铁口平时接待顾客的方式，
That single “Mr Zhu” had altered Zhu’s usual manner of receiving customers.

“东西很多。”
“A great many things.”

他随手捧起一方砚池说：
He picked up an inkstone.

“古老爷，你看。”
“Look at this, Mr Gu.”


古应春看即方砚池七寸长、五寸宽、三寸高，色如猪肝，
The inkstone was seven cun long, five wide and three high, and the colour of pig’s liver.

正面两边各有一行篆字，
A line of seal-script characters ran down either side of its upper surface.

右边是“丹心贯日”，左边是“汤阴鹏举志”。
On the right was “A loyal heart shines through the sun”; on the left, “Inscribed by Pengju of Tangyin.”

“原来是岳武穆用过的。”
“So it was used by Yue Fei, Lord Wumu.”

“不光是岳武穆用过，
“Not only by Lord Wumu.

明太祖还用过呢！”朱铁口微笑着说。
The founding emperor of the Ming used it too,” Zhu said with a smile.

古应春仔细一看，砚池右侧还刻着四行楷书：“岳少保砚向供宸御，
Looking more closely, Gu saw four lines in regular script carved on the right side: “The inkstone of Yue, the Junior Guardian, formerly served the imperial presence.

今蒙上赐臣达。
His Majesty has now graciously bestowed it upon his servant Da.

古忠臣宝砚也，
It is the precious inkstone of a loyal minister of old.

臣何能堪？
How can I be worthy of it?

谨矢竭忠贞，无辱此砚。
I solemnly pledge my utmost loyalty and devotion, that I may bring no dishonour upon this inkstone.

洪武二年正月朔日，臣徐达谨记。”
Respectfully recorded by the servant Xu Da on the first day of the first month in the second year of Hongwu.”

“ 徐达是明朝开国元勋第一位，又是明太祖的儿女亲家，
“Xu Da ranked first among the founders of the Ming, and his children married into the founding emperor’s family,” Gu said.

这方砚有这样的来历，明朝人的笔记当中，一定有记载的。
“With such a history, this inkstone must surely appear in some Ming scholar’s collected notes.

老朱，你说是不是？”朱铁口笑了，
Wouldn’t you say so, Old Zhu?” Zhu laughed.

“听古老爷这话，就晓得是内行。
“One can tell from that remark that you know your subject, Mr Gu.

真人面前不说假话，
No false words before a true master.

是不是中山王徐达收藏过，也不必去谈它了。”
Whether Xu Da, Prince of Zhongshan, ever owned it is something we needn’t discuss.”

他将砚池置回原处又说：
He put the inkstone back.

“古老爷，你请里面来坐。”
“Please come inside and sit down.”


所谓“里面”是帐柜后面的一间斗室，
“Inside” meant a tiny room behind the accounts counter.

一关上门，就靠屋顶一方天窗透光进来，
Once the door was shut, its only light came through a skylight in the roof.

阳光斜射，恰好照亮靠壁的方桌。
A slanting ray of sunshine fell neatly across the square table against the wall.

朱铁口等古应春在对面坐定，方始俯身向前，低声开口，神态显得神秘而郑重。
When Gu had seated himself opposite, Zhu leaned forward and spoke in a low voice, his manner solemn and mysterious.

“古老爷，你是哪位介绍你来的？”
“Who introduced you to us, Mr Gu?”

“是我的东家交代我来的，
“My employer told me to come.

没有人介绍。”
There was no introduction.”

“贵东家是哪位？”
“And who is your employer?”

古应春有些踌躇，不知道能不能透露胡雪岩的姓名，因而久久未答。
Gu hesitated, uncertain whether he could reveal Hu’s name, and did not answer for some time.

“古老爷，”朱铁口说：“贵东家是怎么关照你的？”
“What instructions did your employer give you, Mr Gu?”

“就说让我来找你老朱，问一问宝中堂喜欢什么。
“Only to find you, Old Zhu, and ask what Grand Secretary Bao likes.

东西要好。价钱不在乎。”
The pieces must be good; the price doesn’t matter.”

“那就怪不得你不肯说破了，
“Then it’s no wonder you won’t tell me everything.

贵东家没有交代清楚。”朱铁口说：
Your employer didn’t make himself clear.

“贵东家要买古董字画送宝中堂，当然是有作用的。
Naturally, he has some purpose in buying antiques and paintings for Grand Secretary Bao.

到底是为了啥，
What exactly is it?

预备送值多少钱的东西？
How much does he intend to give?

古老爷，你老实告诉我，我来替你盘算一下，
Tell me frankly and I’ll work it out for you.

包你一钱不落虚空地，都用在刀口上。”
I guarantee that not a penny will be wasted; every bit will go where it counts.”

古应春听出话中大有曲折，
Gu could hear that there was much beneath these words.

看朱铁口意思诚恳，便老实答道：
Zhu seemed sincere, so he answered honestly.

“确如你所说，
“You are quite right.

敝东家没有交代清楚。
My employer did not explain clearly.

老朱，你能不能先把其中的奥妙告诉我，
Could you first tell me how it all works, Old Zhu?

我再看能不能替敝东家作主。”
Then I can judge whether I may act on his behalf.”

“这有何不可。”朱铁口说：
“Of course.

“我们这里跟各王府，几位中堂府上都有往来的，
We have dealings with the various princely households and several grand secretaries’ residences.

说穿了……”
To put it plainly…”


说穿了是卖官鬻爵，
To put it plainly, this was the sale of offices and honours.

过付之处，公然受贿，有所不便，所以要有人居间来遮蔽形迹。
It was inconvenient for those receiving the payments to take bribes openly, so intermediaries were needed to conceal the transaction.

“假使说，你古老爷想放个考官，或者少爷乡试要下场了。
“Suppose you wanted an appointment as an examiner, Mr Gu, or your son was about to sit the provincial examination.

怕‘场中莫论文’，想买个‘关节’，
Afraid that literary merit might count for nothing in the examination hall, you might want to buy a private arrangement.

就得要到打磨厂去请教江西金谿人开的卖‘闱墨’的书坊，
Then you would go to Damochang, to the shops selling collections of examination essays, run by men from Jinxi in Jiangxi.

他们会跟你讲价钱。
They would quote you a price.

倘或要谋缺谋差呢，就得来找我们，
But if you wanted a post or a commission, you would come to us.

我们会替你去问了来告诉你，要送什么东西，
We would make inquiries and tell you what you must give.

自然是在我们这里买……”
Naturally, you would buy it here…”

“慢慢！”古应春打断他的话问：
“Wait,” Gu interrupted.

“你是说一定要在你这里买？”
“Do you mean it has to be bought from you?”

“是的。”
“Yes.”

“价钱由你开？”
“At a price you set?”

“当然。”
“Of course.”

“能不能还价？”
“Can one bargain?”

“能还价，
“Certainly.

怎么不能？”朱铁口说，
Why not?

“古老爷承你看得起，我不忍赚你的昧心钱，
You have been good enough to think well of me, Mr Gu, and I couldn’t bear to make a dishonest profit from you.

所以要请你告诉我，贵东家打算谋个什么差缺，我好告诉你真正的行情。
That is why I ask what post your employer wants, so that I can tell you the true going rate.”

““嗯，嗯。”
“I see.”

古应春细想了一下，还有不甚明白的地方，便义说道：
Gu thought it over, but some points were still unclear.

“请你打个比方我听听。”
“Give me an example.”


“比方，你老想放上海道。
“Suppose you wanted to be Shanghai Circuit Intendant.

我去问了来告诉你，送宝中堂一部《玉枕兰亭》就可以了。
I would inquire and tell you that all you needed was to give Grand Secretary Bao a copy of the Jade-Pillow Lanting calligraphy album.

这部帖要十二万银子，
The album would cost a hundred and twenty thousand taels.

你买了这部帖送进去，
You would buy it and send it in.

宝中堂知道已经到手了，就会如你所愿。
Once the grand secretary knew the money was in hand, you would get your wish.

其实呢，上海道的行情是十万银子，
The actual price of the Shanghai post is a hundred thousand.

我们外加两成帽子，内扣两成回佣，一笔交易赚四万。
We add twenty per cent on top and deduct twenty per cent as commission, making forty thousand on the transaction.

如果主顾精明，磨来磨去讨价还价，顶多磨掉外加的那两成帽子，
A shrewd customer who haggles and haggles can at most knock off the twenty per cent added on top.

至于放交情，象你老这样的，我就老实告诉你。十万银子一文不能少。”
For someone to whom I want to show friendship, such as yourself, I would state it frankly: a hundred thousand, and not a single coin less.”

“喔，原来如此。”古应春又问：
“Ah, so that is how it works.

“如果不知道你们这里这条门路，另外托人去活动呢？”
What if someone didn’t know this route through your shop and approached someone else to arrange it?”

“他们也会告诉你，送一部《玉枕兰亭》，而且告诉你要到哪里去买。”朱铁口又说：“这个法子是乾隆年间和坤发明的，
“They too would tell him to give a copy of the Jade-Pillow Lanting, and tell him where to buy it.” Zhu continued, “Heshen invented this method in the Qianlong reign.

他说送什么东西，根本就是他自己的收藏，
Whatever item he told a man to give was actually from his own collection.

我们去问价钱的时候，顺便就把东西带回来了。”
When we went to ask the price, we simply brought the object back with us.”


“多谢，多谢！
“Thank you, thank you.

我学到了一个秘诀。
I have learned a secret.

不过，还有一点想请教，
But there is one more point.

譬如说，我倒不想计价还价，直接想送某人多少，
Suppose I didn’t want to bargain at all, but simply wanted to give someone a certain sum.

这又该怎么办呢？”
How would that be done?”

“这我们也有规矩的。
“We have rules for that too.

先问你送什么人，
First we ask whom you want to give it to.

送恭王有送恭王的东西，送宝中堂有送宝中堂的东西。
There are things for Prince Gong and things for Grand Secretary Bao.

譬如你说送恭王，
Say you wanted to give something to Prince Gong.

我会告诉你，喏，这方岳少保砚，两千，那部‘阁帖’三千，一部宋版杜诗五千，
I would tell you: this inkstone of Yue, the Junior Guardian, is two thousand; that Ge Tie calligraphy album is three thousand; a Song edition of Du Fu’s poems is five thousand.

你如果想送一万银子，凑起来正好。”
If you wanted to give ten thousand taels, they would add up exactly.”

“有没有帽子在里头？”
“Would there be a markup in those prices?”

“货真价实，
“Genuine goods at fair prices.

不加帽子。”朱铁口解释这种情形跟卖差卖缺不同，
No markup.” Zhu explained that this differed from selling posts and appointments.

譬如上海道一缺值十万银子，收到十万，则该到手都到手了，
If the Shanghai post was worth a hundred thousand taels, then once that amount was received, all that was due had been paid.

外加帽子吃亏的是“买主”。
Any additional markup came at the buyer’s expense.

倘或有人想送八万，而实际上照底价只是七万银子的东西，岂不是侵吞了“卖主”应得之款？
But if a man intended to give eighty thousand and the goods were actually worth only seventy thousand at the agreed base prices, would that not be taking money owed to the seller?

信用一失，另觅别家过付，
Once trust was lost, the seller would use another intermediary.

这样好的买卖做不成，真正贪小失大，不智之甚。
To lose such excellent business for a small immediate gain would be exceedingly foolish.


“老朱，你把话都说明了。我也不能有一点骗你。
“Old Zhu, since you have told me everything, I must not deceive you in the least.

敝东家不是谋差谋缺，另有缘故，
My employer is not seeking a post or an appointment; he has another purpose.

想送多少我虽还不知道，不过猜想不是三、五万银子的事。
I don’t yet know how much he intends to give, but I suspect this is no mere matter of thirty or fifty thousand taels.

等找回去间清楚了，我们再进一步商量。”古应春又加重了语气说，“老朱，你请放心。除非不送，要送一定请你经手，
Let me go back and ask him clearly, and then we can discuss it further.” Gu added with emphasis, “Rest assured: unless he decides to give nothing, the transaction will certainly go through you.

即使敝东家想另找别家，我也不会答应的。”
Even if my employer wanted to use another shop, I wouldn’t agree.”

看他说得如此诚恳，又看他的仪表服饰，朱铁口知道遇见阔客了，
Hearing his sincerity and observing his appearance and dress, Zhu knew he had found a wealthy customer.

这件事成功，掌柜起码要分他几千银子，
If the business succeeded, the proprietor would have to give him at least several thousand taels.

大可自立门户了。
He could easily set up for himself.

转念到此，心花怒放，
The thought delighted him.

“古老爷载培，感激不尽。”
“I cannot thank you enough for your patronage, Mr Gu.”

朱铁口站起身来请了个安说：
He rose and made an obeisance.

“古老爷想来收藏很多，
“You must have a considerable collection yourself.

不知道喜欢玩点什么，
What do you like?

看看我能不能效劳？”
Let me see whether I can be of service.”

古应春心想，即然拉交情，即不能空手而回，
Gu thought that if he wanted to make a friend, he ought not to leave empty-handed.

但一时想不起要些什么，便信口问道：“有没有什么新奇的东西？”
Unable to think immediately of anything he wanted, he asked casually, “Have you anything unusual?”

“有，怎么没有。
“Indeed I have.

古老爷请到外面来看。”
Please come out and look.”


朱铁口寻寻觅觅，找出来四样古玩，长圆方扁不一，
After some searching, Zhu produced four curios, respectively long, round, square and flat.

长的是仿佛黄玉所制的萧，
The long object was a xiao flute that appeared to be made of yellow jade.

圆的是一具大明宣德年制的蟋蟀罐，
The round one was a cricket jar from the Xuande reign of the Ming.

方的是明朝开国元勋魏国公徐辉祖蒙御赐得以免死的铁券，
The square one was an iron certificate of immunity from execution, bestowed by the emperor on Xu Huizu, Duke of Wei, a founding worthy of the Ming.

扁的是康熙年所制的“葫芦器”，是一只印泥盒。
The flat one was a moulded-gourd object from the Kangxi reign: a box for seal paste.

“古老爷，你倒估估看，哪一样最值钱？”
“Which would you say is worth most, Mr Gu?”

“应该是这一支玉萧。”
“I should think this jade flute.”

“玉萧？
“Jade?

你老倒仔细看一看，
Look carefully.

是不是玉？”
Is it jade?”

古应春拿起那支萧，用手指弹了两下，
Gu picked up the flute and tapped it twice with a finger.

其声铿然，
It rang clearly.

“不是玉是什么？”他问。
“What is it, if not jade?”

“你再看。”
“Look again.”

再看上面有题词：“外不泽，中不干，受气独全，
On closer inspection he found an inscription: “Not lustrous without, not dry within; it receives the breath whole.

其音不窒不浮，品在佳竹以上。”
Its tone is neither stifled nor floating, and its quality surpasses the finest bamboo.”

字是墨迹。
The writing was in ink.

玉器何能着墨？
How could ink adhere to jade?

这就奇怪了。
That was strange.

“是纸萧，出在福建。”朱铁口说：
“It is a paper flute, made in Fujian,” Zhu said.

“这是明朝的东西，
“It dates from the Ming.

制法现在已经失传。”
The method of making it has now been lost.”


古应春大为惊异，随手摆在一旁，表示中意要买，然后问道：
Greatly surprised, Gu set the flute aside to show that he liked it and would buy it.

“老朱，你说哪样东西最难得？”
“Which is the rarest piece, Old Zhu?”

物以稀为贵，最难得的自然值钱，
Rarity made for value, so the rarest should naturally be the most expensive.

朱铁口小心翼翼地拿起那具蟋蟀罐，用指轻扣，
Zhu carefully lifted the cricket jar and tapped it with a finger.

渊渊作金石之声，
It gave a deep, resonant ring like metal or stone.

很满意地说道：“不假，五百年前的东西。”
“Genuine. Five hundred years old,” he said with satisfaction.

见此光景，古应春好奇心起，
His manner aroused Gu’s curiosity.

接过那具陶罐细看，
Taking the earthenware jar, Gu examined it closely.

罐子四周雕镂人物，
Figures were carved around its sides.

罐底正中刻着“大明宣德年制”，另有一行小字：“苏州陆墓邹大秀敬造”。
In the centre of the base were the words “Made in the Xuande Reign of the Great Ming,” with a smaller line beside them: “Respectfully made by Zou Daxiu of Lumu, Suzhou.”

但制作虽相当精巧，毕竟只是个蟋蟀罐，
The workmanship was certainly delicate, but it was only a cricket jar.

经历四五百年，也不能就算值钱的古董。
Having survived four or five hundred years did not in itself make it a valuable antique.

他不好意思直抒观感，只好这样问说：
Gu felt awkward about saying so directly.

“老朱，你说它好处在哪里？”
“What is so good about it, Old Zhu?”

“好处在旧、在有土性，
“Its age, and the quality of its clay.

火气尽脱，才不伤虫。
All the fierceness of the firing has left it, so it won’t harm the insect.

古老爷，你总斗过蛐蛐吧？”
You have fought crickets, surely?”

蟋蟀在北方唤做“蛐蛐”，南方亦有此称呼，
Crickets were called ququ in the north, and sometimes in the south as well.

古应春虽不好此道，但斗蟋蟀搏彩，输赢进出极大，他是知道的。
Though Gu did not pursue the pastime, he knew that enormous sums changed hands in wagers on cricket fights.

“一场蛐蛐下来，银子上千上万算，
“A single contest can involve thousands or tens of thousands of taels.

好蛐蛐说得难听些，真当它祖宗看待，
To put it bluntly, they treat a good cricket like an honoured ancestor.

上百两银子一只宣德盆，又算得了啥？”
What is a hundred-odd taels for a Xuande jar to such a man?”

古应春暗暗咋舌，
Gu marvelled inwardly.

“一只瓦罐，值一百两银子？”他问。
“A hundred taels for an earthenware pot?”

“是的。
“Yes.

不过古老爷要，当然特别克己。”朱铁口说：
But for you, of course, I would make a special concession.

“四样东西，一共算二百两银子好了。”
Let us say two hundred taels for all four pieces.”


这不应该算贵，
That could hardly be considered expensive.

古应春一语不发，从身上掏出来一个洋式的皮夹，取出来一叠银票，凑好数目二百两，收起皮夹。
Without a word, Gu took a Western-style leather wallet from his clothes, drew out a sheaf of banknotes, counted out two hundred taels and put the wallet away.

朱铁口在一旁看得很清楚，所有的银票都是阜康福所出，
Watching closely, Zhu saw that every note had been issued by Fukangfu.

当下灵机一动，惊喜地说道：“原来古老爷的贵东家，就是‘胡财神’。
A sudden realization made him exclaim in delighted surprise, “So your employer is Hu, the God of Wealth!”

胡雪岩被称为“胡财神”，已有好几年了。
Hu had been known by that name for several years.

古应春不便否认，
Gu could hardly deny it.

只低声说道：
He merely lowered his voice.

“老朱，你知道就好。
“It is enough that you know, Old Zhu.

放在肚子里！
Keep it to yourself.

一张扬开来，这笔交易就做不成了。”
If the news gets about, this transaction will be impossible.”

“我知道，我知道，
“I understand, I understand.

这种事怎么好张扬？”
How could anyone spread word of such a thing?”

古应春点点头，关照老朱将四样古玩送到阜康福，
Gu nodded and told Zhu to deliver the four curios to Fukangfu.

自己坐着车匆匆进城，赶到冰盏胡同贤良寺去作翻译。
He himself hurried into the city by carriage, making for Xianliang Temple in Bingzhan Hutong to act as interpreter.



胡雪岩
《灯火楼台》第一章（下）
Towers of Light — Chapter One, Part Two
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


贤良寺本来是雍正朝抬贤亲王的故居，
Xianliang Temple had originally been the residence of Prince Yixian in the Yongzheng reign.

屋宇精洁、花木扶疏，而且离东华门很近，上朝方便，
Its buildings were clean and elegant, its grounds thick with flowers and trees, and its proximity to Donghua Gate made attendance at court convenient.

所以封疆大吏入觐述职，都爱住在这里。
Provincial governors and governors-general therefore liked to stay there when summoned to report to the emperor.

左宗棠下榻之处，是其中最大的一个院落，另外开门出入，
Zuo Zongtang occupied the largest courtyard, with a separate entrance.

门口站着七八名壮汉，服饰随便，举止粗率，形似斯养卒，
Seven or eight burly men stood at the gate, casually dressed and rough in manner, looking like ordinary menials or soldiers.

但古应春却丝毫不敢怠慢。
Gu Yingchun nevertheless dared not treat them lightly.

原来左宗棠镇压洪杨、捻回，二十年指挥过无数战役，
Over twenty years of suppressing the Taipings, the Nian, and the Muslim rebellions, Zuo had commanded countless battles.

麾下将校，百战余生，从军功上保到总兵，提督的，不知凡几？
Many officers who survived those campaigns had won promotion through military merit to brigade commander or provincial military commander.

但武人诚朴，
But soldiers were straightforward and loyal.

颇有不愿赴任，而宁愿跟着左杀棠当差官，出入相从，
A good number preferred not to take up their appointments, choosing instead to remain with Zuo as officers on special duty, accompanying him wherever he went.

不说破不知道他们都有红顶子，黄马褂，甚至双眼花翎。
Unless someone told you, you would never guess that they were entitled to red hat buttons, yellow riding jackets, and even double-eyed peacock feathers.


一次，有个何总兵奉左宗棠之命，去见陕西藩司谈公事。
Once, Zuo sent a brigade commander named He to discuss official business with the provincial treasurer of Shaanxi.

这个藩司是满洲的世家子，架子极大，
The treasurer came from an established Manchu family and put on tremendous airs.

平时视部属如仆从，呼来喝去，视作当然，因而都敬鬼神而远之。
He treated his subordinates as servants, ordering them about as a matter of course, so they kept a respectful distance.

此人本来对外事不大明白，加以部下疏远，对各方面的情形，更加隔膜，
He already knew little of affairs outside his office, and their remoteness made him still more ignorant.

不知道何总兵的来头，不过看在左宗棠的分上，接见时以平礼相待。
Unaware of Commander He’s standing, he received him as an equal only out of regard for Zuo.

只是心里有个想法：我是敬其上而重其下，你就该守着你的规矩，要谦虚客气才是。
Inwardly he thought: I honor the subordinate out of respect for his superior; you should know your place and show some humility in return.

不道何总兵全不理会，
He, however, paid no heed to any of this.

“升炕”就升炕！“上坐”就上坐，
Invited onto the raised couch, he took his seat; offered the place of honor, he accepted it.

而且翘起二郎腿，高谈阔论旁若无人。
Crossing his legs, he talked freely, paying no heed to anyone else.

藩司心里已很讨厌了，
The treasurer was already deeply annoyed.

及至“端茶”送客，何总兵昂然直出中门，将藩司抛任身后，竟似以长官自居了。
When he lifted his teacup to signal the end of the visit, He strode grandly out through the central doorway, leaving his host behind as though he were the senior official.

是可忍，孰不可忍？
This was intolerable.

藩司震怒之余，第二天谒见左宗棠时，谈及此事，惯愤不平之意，还现于词色。
The next day, when the treasurer called on Zuo, indignation still showed in his voice and face as he recounted the affair.

左宗棠笑一笑，将何总兵传了来训斥，他说：
Zuo smiled, summoned He, and rebuked him.

“你们自以为都出生入死，立过战功，在我面前随意坐卧淡笑，
“You men think that because you have risked your lives and earned distinction in battle, you may sit, lounge, talk, and laugh freely in my presence.

固无不可。
That is all very well with me.

藩台大人是朝廷大员，体制何等尊贵，
But His Excellency the Treasurer is a great officer of the court, whose position commands the highest respect.

你怎么可以放肆，当是在我面前一样，
How dare you behave as freely with him as you do with me?

何以这样不自量。
You have no sense of your place.

你现在赶快给藩台磕头陪罪，
Kowtow and apologize at once.

不然藩台发了脾气，我亦没有这张脸替你再求情。
Otherwise, if His Excellency loses his temper, I shall have no standing to plead for you.”

何总兵答应一声，跪倒在地，磕头请罪。
He obeyed, kneeling and kowtowing.

过了一会，左宗棠送客，藩司一出中门就看到十几个红顶花翎黄马褂的武官手扶腰刀在那里站班，
Presently, when Zuo saw the treasurer out, the man passed through the central doorway and found a dozen or so military officers standing in attendance, hands on their sword hilts, all wearing red buttons, peacock feathers, and yellow jackets.

其中有一个就是何总兵。
Commander He was among them.

这一下，头上蓝顶子，脑后只有一条辫子的藩司，大惊失色，手足无措。
The treasurer, whose own hat button was blue and who wore no peacock feather, turned pale in alarm and scarcely knew what to do.

还算见机，定定神伛偻着身子，一一请安招呼，
Recovering enough presence of mind, he bent deferentially and saluted each in turn.

步行到辕门外，方始上轿，但己汗透重棉了。
He walked all the way beyond the outer gate before entering his chair, by which time sweat had soaked his thick padded clothes.


古应春从听说这个笑话以后，就不敢小看这些“老粗”们，
Ever since hearing that amusing story, Gu had known better than to look down on these rough soldiers.

当时陪笑问道：“大人回来了？”
He therefore asked with a smile, “Has His Excellency returned?”

其时有个差官认识古应春，上前接话，
One of the officers recognized him and came forward.

“我们大人刚回来。”他说：
“He has just returned.

“胡大先生陪着洋人早就到了，派人出来问过你两次，
Mr Hu arrived with the foreigners some time ago and has sent out twice to ask for you.

赶快请进去吧！”
Please hurry in.”

到得花厅，见了胡雪岩，还来不及叙话，只见角门已开，闪出来两名差官，
Gu reached the reception hall and found Hu, but before they could speak, a side door opened and two officers appeared.

知道左宗棠要来了，当即招呼两名洋人站起来迎接。
Knowing that Zuo was coming, Gu at once asked the two foreigners to rise.

左宗棠自然是便衣，一件旧薄棉袍，头上是兰州织呢厂所出的一顶鼻烟色的毡帽。
Zuo was naturally in informal dress: an old, lightly padded robe and a snuff-colored felt hat made by the Lanzhou woolen mill.

胡雪岩跟古应春自然磕头请安，洋人则是一鞠躬，然后又跟左宗某拉手。
Hu and Gu kowtowed, while the foreigners bowed and then shook hands with him.

于是左宗棠独坐，
Zuo alone took a seat.

问了些“哪天到的”、“路上如何”、“江南有什么新闻”之类的话，
He asked when they had arrived, how the journey had gone, and what news there was from Jiangnan.

胡雪岩一一照答，一阵寒暄过后，谈入正题。
Hu answered each question, and after these preliminary courtesies they turned to business.


正题是借洋债。
The business was a foreign loan.

胡雪岩自同治五年至光绪四年，为左宗棠借过四次外债，以充“西饷”。
Between the fifth year of Tongzhi and the fourth year of Guangxu, Hu had arranged four foreign loans for Zuo to finance the western campaigns.

西睡用兵，需由各省补助军饷，称为“协响”。
Military operations on the western frontier depended on contributions from other provinces, known as supplementary military funds.

但协饷分年解送，
But those contributions arrived year by year.

而打仗不能说今年饷银用完，不打了，明年有了饷再打。
A war could not be stopped merely because the year’s money had run out, to be resumed when next year’s allocation arrived.

时而胡雪岩想出一个借洋债的办法，最大的“银主”是英商汇丰银行。
Hu had therefore devised a system of foreign borrowing, with HSBC as the principal lender.

还款的方式是由江海关开出期票，
Repayment was arranged through dated bills issued by Jianghaiguan Customs.

而由协饷省分，主要的是江苏、浙江、广东、福建四省的督抚、盖上大印，表示承诺在到期以前，将协饷解交江海关，偿还洋商。
The governors or governors-general of the contributing provinces—chiefly Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Guangdong, and Fujian—affixed their official seals, undertaking to remit their contributions to Jianghaiguan before the bills fell due so that the foreign lenders could be repaid.

年限总在六年上下，半年一期，付息拔本。
The term was generally about six years, with interest and principal paid in installments every six months.

方式是由胡雪岩秉承左宗棠的意思，找洋商谈妥细节，然后由左宗棠出奏。
Hu first negotiated the details with the foreigners in accordance with Zuo’s wishes; Zuo then submitted a memorial.

奏准后，以上谕饬协饷冬省出具印票，并江海关，
Once imperial approval had been obtained, an edict directed the contributing provinces to furnish sealed bills through Jianghaiguan.

同时由总理衙门照会英闰公使，转知贷款的汇丰银行照付。
At the same time, the Zongli Yamen notified the British minister, who instructed the lending bank to release the money.


这套手续很繁琐，其中还有两道关口，
This procedure was cumbersome, and two further barriers stood in the way.

一道是总税务司赫德。
One was Hart, the Inspector-General of Customs.

根据中英条约，关税是用来赔偿鸦片战争失败军费的保证，
Under the Sino-British treaties, customs revenue served as security for the indemnity arising from China’s defeat in the Opium War.

因此英国人要求控制中国新开各口岩，称为“洋关”的海关，
The British therefore demanded control of the customs offices at the newly opened ports, known as the foreign customs.

职称是税务司，都归总税务司赫德管辖，
Their commissioners were all under Hart.

赫德不下命令，江海关税务司不肯出票，钱就借不成了。
Without his orders, the commissioner at Jianghaiguan would not issue the bills, and the loan could not proceed.

再一道关口是英国驻华公使，
The other barrier was the British minister in China.

没有他的核准，汇丰银行不能拔款，
Without his approval, the bank could not release the funds.

有他批准了，即等于英国政府担保汇丰银行不会吃倒帐。
His approval effectively amounted to a British government guarantee that the bank would not suffer a default.

赫德还好，
Hart was comparatively easy to manage.

因为他毕竟是中国的客卿，不能不买总理衙门的帐，
After all, he was a foreigner in Chinese official service and could not disregard the Zongli Yamen.

而且有回佣好分，亦愿乐观其成。
There was also commission to be shared, so he was willing to see the business succeed.

但英国公使这一关很罗嗦，
The British minister was far more troublesome.

哪怕上谕批准了，各省的印票也备齐了，总理衙门跟赫德也说好了，没有英国公使点头，饯仍旧借不到。
Even with an imperial edict, all the provinces’ sealed documents, and an understanding between the Zongli Yamen and Hart, the money remained unavailable until he gave his assent.


以左宗棠天马行空的性格，这当然是件不能容忍的事，
To a man of Zuo’s unfettered temperament, this was intolerable.

中国人借洋债，要做中国官的英国人赫德同意，更起反感。
He especially resented the idea that Chinese borrowing required the consent of Hart, an Englishman serving as a Chinese official.

因此当德国泰来洋行的经理福克，向左宗棠表示，有钱可错，手续可以节减许多，左宗棠自然是欢迎的。
Naturally, therefore, he welcomed an offer from Focke, manager of the German firm Tailai Trading House, who said that money was available with much less formality.

福克之得以谒见左宗棠，出于胡雪岩的推荐，那是一年前的话，
Hu had introduced Focke to Zuo a year earlier.

西陲已经平定，左宗棠准备在陕甘大兴实业，
The western frontier had been pacified, and Zuo was preparing to develop industry in Shaanxi and Gansu.

关照胡雪岩招聘技师，胡雪岩找上了福克。
Asked to recruit technicians, Hu had approached Focke.

在哈密行营一席之谈，左宗棠认为福克“切实而有条理”，颇为欣赏，
During a conversation at the Hami field headquarters, Zuo found him practical and methodical and formed a favorable impression.

福克便抓住机会，为德国资本找出路，
Focke seized the opportunity to find an outlet for German capital.

当然，要谈这笔借款，仍旧需要胡雪岩。
Hu’s participation, of course, was still necessary to negotiate the loan.

当时正是崇厚擅自订约，被捕下狱，中俄关系搞得剑拔弩张之时，
At that time Chonghou had been arrested and imprisoned for signing a treaty without authorization, and Sino-Russian relations were dangerously tense.

左宗棠接到一个情报，说俄国举了一笔“国债”达五千二百万两之巨，用来扩充军备，
Zuo received intelligence that Russia had raised a national loan equivalent to fifty-two million taels to expand its armaments.

认为中俄难免一战，将来兵连祸结，其势难以停止，亦须未雨绸缪，
Believing war between China and Russia almost inevitable, and fearing that once begun it might continue indefinitely, he felt obliged to prepare.

如果能惜二三千万银子，分数十年偿还，则饷源一广，练兵必精，
A loan of twenty or thirty million taels, repayable over several decades, would provide abundant funds and allow the troops to be thoroughly trained.

写信给胡雪岩，要他跟泰来洋行谈判，而且约他在开年灯节以后，进京面谈。
He wrote to Hu, asking him to negotiate with Tailai and to come to Beijing after the Lantern Festival early in the new year.

不久，这件事打消了，
Before long the proposal was dropped.

因为由于曾纪泽斡旋，中俄形势已趋缓和，没有再大举外债的理由。
Through Zeng Jize’s diplomacy, relations with Russia had eased, and there was no longer any reason for such extensive foreign borrowing.


这是第一遍。
That was the first proposal.

第二遍旧事重提，又要借了。
Then the matter was revived, and borrowing was again required.

原来左宗棠内召入关进军机时，奉旨将他的一差一缺，分别交卸，
When Zuo was recalled within the passes to join the Grand Council, he was ordered to hand over both his special commission and his substantive office.

一差是“钦差大臣督办新疆军务”，交由刘锦棠接替，一缺是“陕甘总督”交由杨昌浚署理。
Liu Jintang would succeed him as Imperial Commissioner Supervising Military Affairs in Xinjiang; Yang Changjun would act as Governor-General of Shaanxi and Gansu.

刘、杨都是左宗棠麾下的大将，但资望不足，难当重任，
Both were senior commanders under Zuo, but neither had sufficient standing and prestige to bear these responsibilities easily.

陕甘贫瘠，全靠各省协饷，
Shaanxi and Gansu were poor and depended entirely on supplementary funds from the other provinces.

各省如果不买帐，刘、杨就一筹奠展，
If those provinces refused to cooperate, Liu and Yang would be helpless.

因此，左宗棠必须为刘锦棠、杨昌浚筹好了饷，西征的功绩，才算有了着落。
Only by securing their military funding could Zuo make the achievements of his western campaigns lasting.

照左宗棠的盘算，新疆与陕甘以玉门关为界，
He calculated the requirements on either side of Yumen Pass, which divided Xinjiang from Shaanxi and Gansu.

每年关外军饷要三百七十万，关内二百一十万，全年为五百八十万两。
The army beyond the pass needed 3.7 million taels a year; the forces within it needed 2.1 million, making 5.8 million in all.

光绪五年起，上谕各省协饷，必须解足五百万两，
From the fifth year of Guangxu, imperial edicts had required the provinces to remit a full five million annually.

相差八十万，前后套搭，总还可敷衍得过，
The gap of eight hundred thousand could still be bridged by shifting funds between payments.

哪知上谕归上谕，协饷归协饷，
But the edicts were one thing and the remittances another.

两年之间，各省协饷欠解竟达四百二十万两之巨。
In two years, provincial arrears had reached 4.2 million taels.

为此，刘锦棠忧心忡忡，
Liu was deeply troubled.

左宗棠为他出奏陈情说：“不虞兵机之迟钝，而忧饷事之难难，
Zuo memorialized on his behalf: “His concern is not that military operations will falter, but that funding will prove difficult.

深惧仔肩难卸，掣时堪虞，
He fears that the burden of responsibility cannot be discharged while his efforts are continually hampered.

将来恼不应手，必致上负圣恩，悔已无及。”
Should his plans prove impossible to carry out, he will fail the imperial trust, and regret will come too late.”

这也是实在情形，
These were real difficulties.

即令宝鋆表示：“西饷可缓，洋款不必着急。”朝廷仍旧许他再借一笔外债，弥补协饷之不足。
Although Grand Secretary Bao Yun argued that “the western army’s funding can wait; there is no need to hurry over a foreign loan,” the court nevertheless authorized further borrowing to make up the shortfall.

胡雪岩与福克，就是为这件事来的。
It was this business that had brought Hu and Focke to Beijing.


胡雪岩在左宗棠面前的信用，大不如前了。
Hu’s standing with Zuo was much lower than before.

一则是借洋债及商款的利息过重，人言藉藉，连左宗棠都没面子，
For one thing, the heavy interest on foreign loans and funds borrowed from merchants had provoked widespread criticism and embarrassed Zuo himself.

二则是采买军火有浮报情事。
For another, there had been inflated charges in the purchase of arms.

但左宗棠仍旧少不了胡雪岩，而胡雪岩亦想力盖前愆，
Yet Zuo still could not dispense with Hu, and Hu wished to make amends.

对这趟借洋债，格外尽心尽力，希望左宗棠能对他的成绩满意。
He was taking exceptional pains over this loan, hoping that the result would satisfy his patron.

“雪岩，你信上说票要出给汇丰，
“Xueyan, your letter says that the bills must be made out to HSBC.

怎么又是汇丰呢？”
Why that bank again?”

左宗棠指着福克说：
Zuo pointed to Focke.

“不是他们泰来洋行吗？”
“Isn’t the money coming from their Tailai firm?”

“是。
“Yes.

一大半是泰来的款子，不过要由汇丰出面。”
More than half comes from Tailai, but the bank must act as intermediary.”

“这是什么讲究？”
“Why is that?”

“汇丰是洋商的领袖。
“The bank is the leader among the foreign firms.

要它出面，款子调度起来才容易。
With it taking the lead, the funds can be assembled more easily.

这好有一比。
Let me give you a comparison.

好比刘饮差、杨制台筹饷筹不动，只要大人登高一呼，马上万山响应，
Commissioner Liu and Governor-General Yang may have difficulty raising military funds, but if Your Excellency calls from the heights, ten thousand mountains answer.

是一样的道理。
It is the same principle.”

“左宗棠平生一癖，是喜欢人恭维，听胡雪岩这一说，心里很舒服，
Zuo had a lifelong weakness for flattery, and this pleased him greatly.

“雪岩，”他说：“你这一阵子倚红偎翠之余，想来还读读书吧？”
“Xueyan, between your embraces of the fair sex, I take it you have been doing a little reading?”

这话，想来是指着“登高一呼”、“万山响应”这两句话而说的。
Hu supposed that the phrases about calling from the heights and the answering mountains had prompted the remark.

胡雪岩笑着答道：
He smiled.

“大人太夸奖我了，
“Your Excellency is too generous.

哪里谈得到读书？
I could hardly call it reading.

无非上次大人教导我，闲下来看看，《唐诗三百首》，
Following your advice last time, I look through Three Hundred Tang Poems when I am free.

现在总算平仄也有点懂了，王黄也分得清了。”
I now understand a little about level and oblique tones, and can even tell wang and huang apart.”


“居然平仄也懂了，
“You even understand the tones now?

难得，难得。”
Remarkable, remarkable!”

左宗棠转脸看着福克说：
Zuo turned to Focke.

“我本来打算借三百万，
“I originally intended to borrow three million.

你一定要我多借一百万，我也许了你了，
You insisted on my borrowing another million, and I agreed.

你利息上头，应该格外克己才是。”
You ought to be particularly accommodating over the interest.”

古应春司翻译之责，
Gu served as interpreter.

福克与凯密伦各有所言，及至他再翻给左宗棠听时，已非洋人原来的话了。
Focke and Cameron each had something to say, but what Gu translated back to Zuo was no longer what the foreigners had actually said.

福克的回答是：“不早就谈好了吗？”
Focke’s answer was, “Wasn’t that agreed long ago?”

经古应春翻给左宗棠听是：“一钱一分。”
What Gu rendered for Zuo was, “Eleven percent.”

“还是高了。”
“Still too high.”

左宗棠的话刚完，胡雪岩便即接口：“是不是？”
No sooner had Zuo spoken than Hu put in, “There!

他向古应春说：“我早说大人不会答应的。
Didn’t I say His Excellency would never agree?” He turned to Gu.

你跟他说，无论如何不能超过一钱。”于是古应春便要求福克，就谈好的利率再减若干，
“Tell him that under no circumstances can it exceed ten percent.” Gu accordingly asked Focke to reduce the rate they had already agreed upon.

福克自然不悦，便有了争执的模样。
Focke was naturally displeased, and the conversation took on the appearance of an argument.

其间当然也牵涉到汇丰的利益，所以凯密伦亦有意见发表。
Since the bank’s interests were involved too, Cameron also had his say.

最后，古应春说了句：“好吧！
Finally Gu said, “Very well.

就照原议。”
We shall keep to the original terms.”

洋人都不响了。
The foreigners fell silent.


“怎么样？”胡雪岩问：
“Well?” Hu asked.

“肯不肯减？”
“Will they reduce it?”

“福克跟凯密伦说：以前是一钱二分五。这回一钱一分已经减了。
“Focke and Cameron say the previous rate was twelve and a half percent, and eleven percent is already a reduction.

我跟他们说：你不能让胡先生没面子。
I told them they could not make Mr Hu lose face.

总算勉强答应在一钱以内，九分七厘五。”
At last, though reluctantly, they agreed to come below ten percent: nine and three-quarters.”

“是年息？”
“That is annual interest?”

“当然是年息。”
“Of course.”

于是胡雪岩转眼看着左宗棠，一面掐指甲，一面说道：
Hu turned to Zuo, counting on his fingers.

“年息九分七厘五，合着月息只有八厘一毫二丝五。
“Nine and three-quarters percent a year is only 0.8125 percent a month.

四百万两一个月的息钱是三万两千五，六个月也不过二十万银子。
On four million taels, that comes to thirty-two thousand five hundred a month, and no more than two hundred thousand for six months.

头两年只付息，不还本，
During the first two years we pay interest only, without repaying principal.

第三年起始，每年拔还一百万，四年还清。
From the third year, we repay a million a year and clear the principal in four years.

大人看，这个章程行不行？”
Does Your Excellency find that arrangement acceptable?”

“一共是六年。”
“Six years in all.”

“是。”胡雪岩答说：
“Yes.

“头两年只付息，不还本，我是磨了好久才磨下来的。
I argued for a long time before securing those first two years without principal repayments.

这一两年各省关有余力还以前的洋款，就宽裕得多了。”
It will leave the provinces and customs offices much more room over the next year or two to pay off the earlier foreign loans.”


“好，好！”左宗棠连赞两声，
“Good, good!” Zuo said approvingly.

然后俯身向前，很关切地问：“要不要海关出票？”
Then he leaned forward and asked with particular concern, “Will the customs have to issue bills?”

“不要！”胡雪岩响亮地回答。
“No!” Hu answered emphatically.

“只要陕甘出票？”
“Only Shaanxi and Gansu?”

“是。
“Yes.

只凭‘陕甘总督部堂’的关防就足够了。”
The official seal of the Governor-General of Shaanxi and Gansu will be sufficient.”

左宗棠连连点头，表示满意，但也不免感慨系之，
Zuo nodded repeatedly in satisfaction, though the thought also stirred his feelings.

“陕甘总督的关防，总算也值钱了！”接着还叹口气：“唉！”
“So the governor-general’s seal is worth something at last!” He sighed.

“事在人为。”胡雪岩说：
“It all depends on the man,” Hu replied.

“陕西。甘肃是最穷最苦最偏僻的省份。
“Shaanxi and Gansu are the poorest, most afflicted, and most remote provinces.

除了俄国以外，哪怕是久住中国的外国人，也不晓得陕甘在哪里？
Apart from the Russians, even foreigners who have lived in China for years scarcely knew where they were.

如今不同了，
Now it is different.

都晓得陕甘有位左爵爷，
They all know that Marquis Zuo is there.

洋人敬重大人的威名，连带陕甘总督的关防，比直隶两江还管用。
The foreigners respect Your Excellency’s great name, and consequently the seal of the Governor-General of Shaanxi and Gansu carries more weight than those of Zhili or Liangjiang.”

“说到这里，他转脸关照古应春：”
He turned to Gu.

你问他们，如果李合肥要借洋款，他们要不要直隶总督衙门的印票。“古应春跟福克、凯密伦各说了一句不知什么话，
“Ask them whether, if Li of Hefei wanted a foreign loan, they would accept bills bearing the seal of the Governor-General of Zhili.” Gu said something or other to Focke and Cameron.

等他们回答以后才说：“都说还是要关票。”
After hearing their replies, he announced, “Both say they would still require customs bills.”

听得这一句，左宗棠笑逐颜开，
Zuo’s face lit up.

他一直自以为勋业过于李鸿章，如今则连办洋务都凌驾其上了。
He had always considered his achievements greater than Li Hongzhang’s; now he had surpassed him even in foreign affairs.

这份得意，自是非同小可。
His satisfaction was extraordinary.

“好！
“Good!

我们就这样说定了。
Then it is settled.

三两天后就出奏，
I shall submit the memorial in two or three days.

这回宝中堂应该不会有后言了。”
Grand Secretary Bao should have no grounds for criticism this time.”


胡雪岩不懂“后言”二字，不过意思可以猜得出来，
Hu did not understand Zuo’s particular expression for criticism, though he could guess its meaning.

而且他也有把握能使得宝釜服帖。
He was also confident that he could bring Bao Yun into line.

因而提出最要紧的一句话。
He therefore raised the most important point.

“有一层要先跟大人回明白，
“There is one thing I must make clear, Your Excellency.

如今既然仍旧要汇丰来领头调度，那就仍旧要总理衙门给英国公使一个照会。”
Since the bank must still take the lead in assembling the funds, the Zongli Yamen must still send a formal note to the British minister.”

“这是一定的道理。
“Naturally.

我知道。”
I understand.”

“还有一层，要请大人的示，
“And there is one further matter on which I need your instructions.

是不是仍旧请大人给我一道札子。”
May I ask Your Excellency to issue me an official directive as before?”

下行公事叫“札子”，指令如何办理？
A directive was an official communication to a subordinate, specifying how he should proceed.

左宗棠答说：“这不行！
“That will not do,” Zuo answered.

不在其位，不谋其政，
“One should not direct affairs outside one’s office.

你是陕西驻上海转运局的委员，
You are an officer of the Shaanxi Transport Bureau in Shanghai.

应该杨制军下札子给你。”
Governor-General Yang should issue your instructions.”

“是！
“Yes.

不过，我有句话，不知道该不该说？”
But there is something I am not sure I ought to say.”

“你说，
“Say it.

不要紧。”
There is no harm.”

“同样是陕甘总督衙门下的札子，分量不一样。
“Though both would come from the Governor-General’s office, they would not carry the same weight.

如果是大人的札子，我办事就方便得多了。”
With a directive from Your Excellency, my work would be much easier.”

“呃，呃！我明白了。”
“Ah, I see.”

左宗棠心想，杨昌浚的威望不够，
Zuo reflected that Yang’s prestige was insufficient.

胡雪岩即不能见重于人，
Hu would therefore not command the necessary respect.

为他办事顺利起见，这个障碍得替他消除。
To let him conduct the business smoothly, this obstacle must be removed.

盘算了好一会，有个变通办法，
After considering for some time, he found a way around it.

“这样”，他说，“只要是牵涉到洋人，总署都管得到的，
“The Zongli Yamen has authority over anything involving foreigners.

我在奏折上特为你叙一笔，请旨下总理衙门札饬道员胡某某遵照办理。
I shall mention you specifically in the memorial and request an imperial order directing the Yamen to instruct Circuit Intendant Hu to carry out the arrangements.

你看如何？”
How would that be?”

胡雪岩喜出望外，
Hu was delighted.

因为这一来就是受命于恭亲王，声价又抬高了。
He would then be acting under Prince Gong, which would raise his standing still further.

不过，表面上却不敢有何形色，
Outwardly, however, he showed none of this.

而用微感无奈的神情说：“如果大人不便下札子给我，那也就只好请总理衙门下了。”
With an air of slight resignation, he said, “If Your Excellency cannot conveniently issue the directive yourself, I suppose we must ask the Zongli Yamen to do so.”


“好！
“Good.

这就说定了。”
That is settled.”

左宗棠接着又说：“雪岩，我们打个商量，
Zuo went on, “Xueyan, let us discuss something else.

西边境况很窘，
Conditions in the west are desperate.

刘毅斋又要撤勇，打发的盘川还不知道在哪里？
Liu Yizhai must disband some troops, and does not yet know where to find their journey money.

你能不能先凑一百万，尽快解到杨石泉那里。”
Can you raise a million first and send it to Yang Shiquan as quickly as possible?”

毅斋、石泉分别是刘锦棠、杨昌浚的别号。
Yizhai and Shiquan were the respective alternate names of Liu Jintang and Yang Changjun.

胡雪岩责无旁贷，很爽快地答应了。
Hu could not evade the responsibility and readily agreed.

这时有一名听差，悄然到左宗棠身边说了句话，
At that moment an attendant approached Zuo and whispered something.

他便问道：“这两个洋朋友，会不会用筷子？”
Zuo asked, “Can these two foreign friends use chopsticks?”

左宗棠是打算留福克与凯密伦吃饭。
He intended to keep Focke and Cameron for a meal.

胡雪岩觉得大可不必，便即答说：“大人不必费心了。”
Hu saw no need for that and answered, “Your Excellency need not trouble yourself.”

“那么，你留下来陪我谈谈。”
“Then you stay and talk with me.”

“是。”
“Yes.”

见此光景，古应春便向洋人表示，公事已经谈妥，应该告辞了。
Gu understood that the official business was finished and told the foreigners they should take their leave.

接着便站起来请了个安，洋人亦起立鞠躬。
He rose and made his formal salutation; the foreigners stood and bowed.

左宗棠要送客，胡雪岩劝住，说是由他代送，
Zuo meant to see them out, but Hu persuaded him to remain, offering to do it for him.

乘此机会可跟古应春说几句话。
That would also give him a chance to speak to Gu.


“应春，你把他们送回去了，交代给陪他们的人，
“Yingchun, take them back and leave them with the men attending them.

空出身体来办两件事。”
Then free yourself to do two things.”

胡雪岩交代，一件是跟汪惟贤去谈，能不能在京里与天津两处地方，筹划出一百万现银？
First, he was to speak to Wang Weixian and discover whether a million taels in ready silver could be raised between Beijing and Tianjin.

“这件事马上要有回音。”胡雪岩轻声说道：
“I need an answer immediately,” Hu said quietly.

“左大人一开了话匣子，先讲西征功劳，再骂曾文正，
“Once His Excellency starts talking, he first recounts his western victories and then abuses Zeng Wenzheng.

这顿饭吃下来，起码三个钟头，
This meal will last at least three hours.

你三点钟以前来，我一定还在这里。”
Come before three, and I am sure to be here.”

“好！
“Very well.

还有一件呢？”
What is the other thing?”

“还有一件，你倒问问福克，王府井大街的德国洋行里，有没有望远镜、挂表。
“Ask Focke whether the German trading house in Wangfujing Street has telescopes and pocket watches.

如果有，你问他有多少，先把它定下来。”
If it does, find out how many and reserve them.”

“喔，”古应春明白了，是左宗棠应醇王之邀，到神机营“看操”，作犒赏用的，便即问说：
Gu understood: these were rewards for the Shenji Camp when Zuo accepted Prince Chun’s invitation to review its drill.

“有是一定有的。
“They certainly have them.

不知道要多少？”
How many do you need?”

现在还不知道。
“I do not know yet.

你先问了再说。“古应春答应着，陪着洋人回阜康福。
Ask first.” Gu agreed and accompanied the foreigners back to Fukangfu Bank.

下午三点钟复又回到贤良寺，
At three that afternoon he returned to Xianliang Temple.

果然，那顿午饭尚未结束，
Just as Hu had predicted, lunch was not over.

他在花厅外面等待时，听得左宗棠正在谈“湖湘子弟满天山”的盛况，
Waiting outside the reception hall, he heard Zuo describing the grand sight of “the sons of Hunan filling the Tianshan.”

中气十足，毫无倦容，看来还得有些时候才会散。
His voice was powerful, with no sign of weariness; the meal might continue for some time.

古应春心想，胡雪岩急于要知道交办两事的结果，无非是即席可以向左宗棠报告。
Gu thought that Hu wanted the answers urgently only so that he could report to Zuo there and then.

既然如此，就不必等着面谈，写个条于通知他好了。
There was no need to wait for a conversation; he could send a note.

打定主意，便从怀中掏出一个洋纸笔记本来，撕一张纸，抽出本子上所附的铅笔，蘸一点口水，
He took out a notebook of foreign paper, tore off a sheet, and moistened the point of its attached pencil with his tongue.

写道：“现银此间有三十万，天津约十余万。
He wrote: “Three hundred thousand in ready silver available here, somewhat over a hundred thousand in Tianjin.

镜表各约百余具，已付定。
A little over a hundred each of telescopes and watches; deposits paid.

惟大小参差不齐。”
Sizes vary.”


这张字条传至席面时，为左宗棠发现问起，胡雪岩正好开口，
Zuo noticed the note being passed to the table and asked about it, giving Hu his opportunity.

“回大人，”他说：“京里现银可以凑五十万，一两日内就解出去，
“Your Excellency, we can assemble five hundred thousand in ready silver in Beijing and send it off within a day or two.

另外一半，等我回上海以后，马上去想法子。
I shall find the other half as soon as I return to Shanghai.

不知道来得及，来不及？”
Will that be soon enough?”

“能有一半先解，其余慢一点不要紧。”
“If half can be sent first, a little delay over the rest does not matter.”

“是。”
“Yes.

胡雪岩又问：“听说醇亲王要请大人到神机营去看操？”
I also hear that Prince Chun wishes to invite Your Excellency to review the Shenji Camp.”

“有这回事”。“一提到此，左宗棠的精神又来了，”
The mention revived Zuo’s spirits. “Indeed.

神机营是八旗劲旅中的精华。
The Shenji Camp is the flower of the Eight Banners’ best troops.

醇王现在以皇上本身父的身分，别样政务都不能管，只管神机营，
As the emperor’s natural father, Prince Chun cannot concern himself with other affairs of government; he has charge only of the Shenji Camp.

上头对神机营的看重，可想而知。
You can imagine how highly it is regarded at court.

李少荃在北洋好几年了，醇王从未请他去看过操，
Li Shaoquan has been in charge of the Beiyang for years, yet the prince has never invited him to a review.

我一到京，头一回见面，他就约我，要我定日子，他好下令会操。
At our very first meeting after I reached Beijing, he invited me and asked me to name a day so that he could order a combined drill.

我心里想，人家敬重我，我不能不替醇王做面子。
When someone honors me, I must return the honor and give the prince face.

想等你来了商量，应该怎么样犒赏？
I meant to wait for you and discuss suitable rewards.”

““大人的意思呢？”
“What did Your Excellency have in mind?”

“我想每人犒赏五两银子，按人数照算。”
“Five taels for every man, calculated according to their numbers.”

“神机营的士兵，不过万把人，
“There are only about ten thousand soldiers in the Shenji Camp.

五、六万银子的事，
Fifty or sixty thousand taels would cover it.

我替大人预备好了。”胡雪岩又说：
I have made provision for that on your behalf.

“不过现银只能犒赏士兵，对官长似乎不大妥当。”
But silver seems suitable only for the soldiers, not quite appropriate for their officers.”


“是啊！
“Exactly.

我也是这么想。”
I thought so too.”

“我看送东西好了。送当然也要实用，而且是军用。
“We should give the officers presents—useful things, naturally, and useful for military purposes.

我有个主意，大人看能不能用。”
I have an idea, if Your Excellency approves.”

“你说。”
“Tell me.”

“每人送一架望远镜、一个挂表。”
“A telescope and a pocket watch for each.”

话刚完，左宗棠便击案称赞，
As soon as Hu finished speaking, Zuo struck the table in approval.

“这两佯东西好！
“Excellent choices!

很切实用。”他说：
Very practical.

“神机营的官长一百多，要一百多份，
There are more than a hundred officers.

不知道备得齐，备不齐？”
Can you obtain enough sets?”

“大人定了主意，我马上写信到上海，尽快送来。
“Once Your Excellency decides, I shall write to Shanghai and have them sent as quickly as possible.

我想日子上一定来得及。“胡雪岩紧接着说：”大人去看操的日子，最好等借洋款的事办妥了再定。
I am sure they can arrive in time.” Hu added at once, “It would be best to fix the day of the review only after the foreign loan is settled.

不然，恐怕有人会说闲话，说大人很阔，西饷一定很宽裕，洋款缓一缓不要紧。
Otherwise someone may gossip that Your Excellency is so wealthy that the western army must have ample funds, and the loan can wait.”

“不等他话完，左宗棠便连连点着头说：
Before he had finished, Zuo was nodding repeatedly.

“你倒提醒了我。
“You have reminded me of something important.

此事虽小，足以影响大局。
A small matter, but enough to affect the whole situation.

我准定照你的话办。”
I shall certainly do as you say.”

“是！”胡雪岩问：“大人还有什么交代？”
“Does Your Excellency have any further instructions?”

“一时倒想不起，
“Nothing occurs to me just now.

想起来再跟你谈。”左宗棠说：
I shall tell you when it does.

“借洋款的章程，你马上写个节略来，
Write me a summary of the loan terms at once.

我尽明天一天办好奏稿递上去，
I shall have the memorial ready and submit it by tomorrow.

倘或顺利的话，大概三五大就定局了。”
If all goes smoothly, the matter should be settled within three to five days.”

“是！”胡雪岩说道：“明天我想跟大人告一天假，办办私事。
“I should like to ask for tomorrow off to attend to some private business.

后来来伺侯。”
I shall return the day after.”

“后天如果没事也不必来。
“If there is nothing to do, you need not come the day after either.

有事我会随时派人来招呼你，
I shall send for you whenever necessary.

你尽管办你自己的事去好了。”
Attend to your own affairs.”


于是胡雪岩告辞回阜康福，
Hu took his leave and returned to Fukangfu Bank.

先请杨师爷将借洋款的条件写成一个节略，即刻派人送到贤良寺。
He first had Secretary Yang prepare a summary of the loan conditions and immediately sent it to Xianliang Temple.

然后向古应春细问到海岳山房接头的经过。
Then he asked Gu for a detailed account of his dealings at Haiyue Shanfang.

“应春，你知道的，为了去年买水雷的价钱，福德多嘴泄了底，
“Yingchun, you know that Fude talked too freely about the price of last year’s naval mines and gave the game away.

左大人对我已经起疑心了。
His Excellency has been suspicious of me ever since.

这件事我心里很难过，
That troubles me deeply.

所以这趟借洋款，除了大家该得的好处以外，我不但分文不要，
This time, apart from the benefits properly due to everyone else, I shall take nothing myself.

而且预备贴几万银子，
I am even prepared to spend several tens of thousands of taels of my own money.

一定要把这件事办成功。办成功不算，还要办得漂亮，要叫左大人心里舒服，
I must make the loan succeed, and success alone is not enough: it must be done handsomely, so that His Excellency feels pleased.

倘或宝中堂罗嗦，就算办成功，他也不会高兴，
If Grand Secretary Bao makes difficulties, even a successful loan will give him no pleasure.

所以宝中堂那里，一定要摆平，
Bao must therefore be brought round.

能听他说一句：这笔洋款借得划算，我这几万银子，花得就值了。”
If I can hear him say, ‘This loan was obtained on favorable terms,’ my money will have been well spent.”

“小爷叔的心思，我是早看出来了。
“I understood your intention long ago, Little Uncle.

不过，我想也不必把钱花在宝中堂一个人身上，
But I do not think all the money should go to Bao himself.

他手下的人也是要紧的。”
His subordinates matter too.

古应春问道：“小爷叔预备花多少。”
How much do you intend to spend?”

“这个数。”
“This much.”

胡雪岩将手一伸。
Hu held out his hand.

“那么，送四万，留一万作开销。”
“Then forty thousand for him, and ten thousand for expenses.”

“好的。
“Very well.

你跟徐筱云去商量，看这条路子应该怎么样走通？”
Discuss it with Xu Xiaoyun and see how this approach can be made to work.”


第二天三月初九，徐彼云不待去请，自己来访，
The next day, the ninth day of the third lunar month, Xu came without waiting to be invited.

胡雪岩不在，由古应春接待，
Hu was out, so Gu received him.

他告诉古应春说，左宗棠的奏槁是他办的，已经誊正呈递。
Xu explained that he had drafted Zuo’s memorial, which had already been copied and submitted.

不过，三五天内，决不会有结果，
There could be no result within three to five days, however.

因为恭亲王为福晋安葬，请了七天假，而这件大事，非恭亲王来议不可。
Prince Gong had taken seven days’ leave for his consort’s burial, and such an important matter could not be discussed without him.

“这样说，宝中堂也不能起作用？”
“Then Grand Secretary Bao can have no effect either?”

“不，不！有作用的，
“On the contrary, he can.

恭王听他的话，
Prince Gong listens to him.

而且凡是到了这个地位，不管怎么样，败事总是有余的。”
Besides, anyone in such a position always has more than enough power to spoil things.”

“筱翁，这么说，胡大先生要重重拜托你，
“Mr Xiaoyun, in that case Mr Hu must ask a great favor of you.

海岳山房我去过了，跟老朱谈得很好。
I have been to Haiyue Shanfang and had an excellent talk with Zhu.

胡大先生要我跟筱翁商量，
Mr Hu asked me to consult you.

这条路子一定要走通，
We must make this approach succeed.

你看该送多少？”
How much do you think we should send?”

“借洋款的条件比过去都好，我的奏稿上写得很切实，
“The loan conditions are better than before, and my memorial sets them out very clearly.

事情一定可成，
The business is sure to succeed.

不送亦可，要送，有这差不多了。”
You need send nothing, but if you do, about this much should be enough.”

说着，徐用仪示以一指。
Xu held up one finger.

“筱翁，‘差不多’不够，
“Mr Xiaoyun, ‘about enough’ is not enough.

要势在必成。”
We need certainty.”

“多送当然更保险，
“More money will naturally make it safer.

不过钱要用在刀口上。”徐用仪问道：
But it should be used where it counts.

“明天你会去贤良寺不会？”
Will you be at Xianliang Temple tomorrow?”

“会去，
“Yes.

明天我带洋人给左大人去辞行。”
I shall take the foreigners to say goodbye to His Excellency.”

“那么，我们明天中午在贤良寺见，
“Then we shall meet there at noon.

到时候我再跟你谈。”
I shall speak to you again.”


第二天中午胡雪岩、古应春带着两个洋人，都到了贤良寺，
At noon the following day, Hu and Gu took the two foreigners to Xianliang Temple.

静等左宗棠自军机处散值回寓，以便辞行。
They waited for Zuo to return from duty at the Grand Council so that they could take their leave.

哪知一等等到下午三点半钟，还不见人影，亦无消息。
Yet half past three came with no sign of him and no message.

宫门申正下钥，申正就是四点钟，
The palace gates were locked at four.

通常军机处自大臣至章京人，最迟未正二刻，也就是两点半钟，一定已走得光光，
Ordinarily, everyone from the grand councillors to their secretaries had left by half past two at the latest.

而左宗棠到此时尚未出宫，是件令人百思不得其解的事。
Why Zuo should still be inside the palace was utterly baffling.

“只怕宫里出事了。”胡雪岩悄悄跟古应春耳语：
“Something must have happened in the palace,” Hu whispered to Gu.

“莫非西太后的病，起了变化？”
“Could the Western Empress Dowager’s illness have taken a turn?”

一语未终，只见徐用仪匆匆而来，
Before he had finished, Xu hurried in.

他也顾不得行礼，一把将胡雪岩拉到僻处，低声说道：
Disregarding formal greetings, he pulled Hu aside and lowered his voice.

“左大人叫我来送个信，
“His Excellency sent me with a message.

洋人慢点走，
The foreigners must delay their departure.

事情或许会有波折。”
There may be complications.”

“怎么？”胡雪岩又问：
“Why?

“左大人何以到现在还不出宫。”
And why has His Excellency not left the palace yet?”

“宫里出了件意想不到的怪事。”
“Something extraordinary and quite unexpected has happened.”

徐用仪的声音越发低了，
Xu spoke still more quietly.

“今天军机没有叫起，
“The Grand Council was not summoned to an audience today.

说太后受了寒，人不舒服。
We were told that the Empress Dowager had caught a chill and felt unwell.

大家都当是感冒，
Everyone supposed it was a cold.

到内奏事处看药方，管事太监说没有发下来。
We went to the Inner Memorial Office to look at the prescription, but the eunuch in charge said that none had been sent down.

后来听内务府的人说，是昨天下午发的病，突然之间，口吐白沫，象发羊癫疯。
Later, someone from the Imperial Household Department told us that she fell ill suddenly yesterday afternoon, foaming at the mouth as though in an epileptic seizure.

今天到现在为止，已经请了三次脉，早晨一次，午时一次，未时一次，
Her pulse has been examined three times today: in the morning, at noon, and in the early afternoon.

人只怕不中用了。”
I fear she may not survive.”

“慢慢，筱翁，”胡雪岩问道：
“Wait, Mr Xiaoyun.

“你说是东太后，还是西太后？”
Do you mean the Eastern Empress Dowager or the Western?”

“是东太后。”
“The Eastern.”

“东太后？”
“The Eastern?”

胡雪岩越发诧异。
Hu was still more astonished.

“自然是东太后。
“Of course.

西太后好久不视朝，
The Western Empress Dowager has not attended court for a long time.

因为东太后违和，军机才没有叫起。”
It was because the Eastern Empress Dowager was unwell that the Grand Council was not called.”

“喔。”胡雪岩点点头说：“我知道了。
“I understand.” Hu nodded.

我来把洋人留下来。”
“I shall keep the foreigners here.”


于是胡雪岩向古应春密言经过，关照他先带洋人回去，随便找个理由，请他们暂留几天。
Hu privately explained the situation to Gu and told him to take the foreigners back, find some pretext, and ask them to remain for a few days.

“如果东太后真的驾崩了，宫里要办丧事，洋款的事就会搁下来。”
“If the Eastern Empress Dowager really dies, the court will have a funeral to arrange, and the loan will be put aside.

胡雪岩问道：“应春，你看左大人会怎么办？”“这一搁下来，”古应春答非所问地：
What do you think His Excellency will do, Yingchun?” Gu answered a different question.

“人家款子早已筹好了，
“The money has already been assembled on their side.

吃利息犹在其次，
Interest is the least of it.

倘或一搁搁得不办了，
What if the matter is put off and then abandoned altogether?

对人家怎么交代？”
How could we explain that to them?”

“这不会的。”胡雪岩说：
“That will not happen.

“吃利息还是小焉者也，
Interest is a minor matter.

刘毅斋、杨石泉筹饷急如星火，
Liu Yizhai and Yang Shiquan need military funds with desperate urgency.

这上头耽误了才是大事。”
Delay there would be the serious problem.”

“那么，大先生，你看左大人会怎么办呢？”
“Then what do you think His Excellency will do, Mr Hu?”

“自然是独断独行，办了再说。”
“Act on his own authority and settle the rest afterward.”

以左宗棠的性情，这是可能的，
Given Zuo’s character, this was possible.

但古应春终有疑惑，
Yet Gu remained doubtful.

因为四百万银子到底不是个小数目，
Four million taels was no small amount.

左宗棠即令有魄力，也不敢如此擅专。
Bold though Zuo was, surely he would not dare act so arbitrarily.


左宗棠是过了四点才回贤良寺的，一到就传胡雪岩，
Zuo returned to Xianliang Temple after four and immediately summoned Hu.

“国将大变！”他一开口就发感慨，接着又说：
“The state faces a great upheaval!” he exclaimed.

“应变要早。
“We must prepare early.

你告诉福克他们，事情就算定局了，请他们一回上海就预备款子。
Tell Focke and the others to consider the matter settled and have the money ready as soon as they return to Shanghai.

印票现成，
The sealed documents are at hand.

我带得有盖了陕甘总督关防的空白文书，
I brought blank forms bearing the official seal of the Governor-General of Shaanxi and Gansu.

一填就是，让他们带了去。”
We need only fill them in and let the foreigners take them.”

果如胡雪岩所料，
It was exactly as Hu had predicted.

但他不能不为左宗棠的前程着想，
But he could not neglect the danger to Zuo’s future.

“大人，”他很直爽地说，“数目太大，
“Your Excellency,” he said frankly, “the sum is so large.

将来宝大人会不会说闲话？”
Might Grand Secretary Bao criticize it afterward?”

“说闲话也是没法子的事。”左宗棠又说：
“If he does, it cannot be helped.

“将在外，君命有所不受。
A commander in the field may decline to obey the sovereign’s orders.

现在连‘君命’都没有，
Here we have not even received an order.

我辈身为勋臣，与国同休戚，不能不从权处置。
As ministers who have served the state and share its fortunes, we must act as circumstances require.”

““大人，我倒有个想法。
“I have a suggestion.

这件事，大人何妨跟醇王说一说，
Why not mention it to Prince Chun?

醇王是带兵的，总知道‘闹饷’不是闹着玩的。”
He commands troops and must understand that disturbances over unpaid wages are no laughing matter.”

“通极！”
“Excellent!”

左宗棠拍着膝盖说：
Zuo slapped his knee.

“有他知道这回事，谅宝佩蘅也不敢再说闲话。”
“Once he knows, I doubt Bao Peiheng will dare say anything against it.”

宝佩蘅就是宝鋆.胡雪岩心想，要他不说闲话，只有找海岳山房朱铁口，
Bao Peiheng was Bao Yun. Hu thought that the only way to silence him was through Zhu Tiekou at Haiyue Shanfang.

否则即使不敢说闲话，也尽有刁难的手段。
Otherwise, even if Bao dared not speak against the plan, he had plenty of ways to obstruct it.


“我得躺一会。”左宗棠说：
“I must lie down for a while,” Zuo said.

“今天晚上，说不定宫里会出大事。”
“Something momentous may happen in the palace tonight.”

“是。”
“Yes.”

胡雪岩乘机打听，
Hu took the opportunity to inquire further.

“刚才徐筱云来传大人的话，说起东太后政躬违和，
“When Xu Xiaoyun brought your message just now, he mentioned that the Eastern Empress Dowager was unwell.

仿佛来势不轻呢？”
It sounded serious.”

“岂止来势不轻，
“More than serious.

牙齿都撬不开了。”
They cannot even pry her jaws apart.”

“那么，到底是什么病呢？”
“What illness is it, then?”

“谁知道？”
“Who knows?”

左宗棠将两手一拍，
Zuo brought his hands together.

“牝鸡司晨，终非佳事。”
“A hen crowing to announce the dawn never bodes well.”

胡雪岩听不懂他说的什么，
Hu did not understand him.

站起身来告辞，“明天再来伺侯。”他请了个安。
He rose to take his leave and made his salutation. “I shall come again tomorrow.”

“明天，
“Tomorrow?

明天还不知道怎么样呢？”
Who knows what tomorrow will bring?”



胡雪岩
《灯火楼台》第二章（上）
Towers of Light — Chapter Two, Part One
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第二章 深宫疑云｜CHAPTER TWO: MISGIVINGS IN THE INNER PALACE


左宗棠只睡得两个时辰，刚交子时便让老仆左贵推醒了，
Zuo Zongtang had slept for only four hours when, just after eleven that night, his old servant Zuo Gui shook him awake.

告诉他说：“军机徐老爷有急信。”
“An urgent letter from Mr Xu at the Grand Council.”

说着，将左宗棠扶了起来，另有一仆擎着烛台，照着他看信，
He helped Zuo sit up while another servant held a candlestick for him to read by.

信封上浓墨淋漓地写着：“飞递左爵相亲钩启”，
In thick, dripping ink, the envelope was addressed: “Express. To Marquis Zuo, Grand Secretary, for his personal attention.”

抽出信笺，上面只有八个字：“东朝上宾，请速入宫。”
The letter contained only eight Chinese characters: “The Eastern Empress Dowager has died. Enter the palace at once.”

原来这天军机章京换班，徐用仪值夜，所以消息来得快。
The Grand Council secretaries had changed shifts that day, and Xu Yongyi was on night duty, which was why the news had come so quickly.

左宗棠遇到这种意外变故，最能沉得住气，
Unexpected emergencies brought out Zuo’s greatest composure.

下床看到红烛，便指着说道：
Getting out of bed, he pointed at the red candle.

“明天得换白的。”
“Tomorrow that must be changed for a white one.”

“老爷，”左贵服伺左宗棠多年，称呼一直未改，他怕自己听错了，侧耳问道：“换白蜡？”
Zuo Gui had served him for many years and had never altered his form of address. Afraid that he had misheard, he bent an ear towards him. “Master, a white candle?”

“对了。
“Yes.

这会别多问！
No questions now.

传轿，
Order the sedan chair.

我马上进宫。”
I am going to the palace immediately.”


进宫时为丑正，
It was two in the morning when he entered the palace.

乾清门未开，都在内务府朝房聚集，
The Gate of Heavenly Purity was still shut, and everyone had gathered in the court waiting rooms of the Imperial Household Department.

左宗棠一看，近支亲贵有惇亲王、醇亲王、惠亲王，御前大臣有伯彦讷漠诂、奕劻，军机大臣有宝鋆、李鸿藻、王文韶，此外便是六部尚书、“毓庆宫行走”的师傅、南书房翰林。
Zuo saw the close imperial kinsmen Princes Dun, Chun, and Hui; the ministers in imperial attendance Boyannemohu and Yikuang; Grand Councillors Bao Yun, Li Hongzao, and Wang Wenshao; and, besides these, the presidents of the Six Ministries, the imperial tutors serving in the Palace of Nurturing Happiness, and the Hanlin scholars of the Southern Study.

国家大事，权在军机，
Authority over great affairs of state rested with the Grand Council.

军机领班的恭王不在，便该左宗棠为首。
In the absence of its head, Prince Gong, Zuo should take the lead.

他此刻才发觉自己的地位特殊，
Only now did he recognize the peculiar difficulty of his position.

初次当京官，朝中典故，茫然莫晓，
This was his first appointment in the capital, and he knew nothing of court precedents.

且又遇着这样意想不到的情况，虽说他善能应变，亦有手足无措、尴尬万分之感。
Faced with such an unforeseen event, even his gift for handling emergencies could not prevent him from feeling helpless and deeply embarrassed.

正要开口动问，只见徐用仪疾趋而前，借搀扶的机会，贴身说道：“听宝中堂的。”
He was about to ask a question when Xu hurried forward and, under cover of supporting him, whispered close to his body, “Follow Grand Secretary Bao.”

争强好胜的左宗棠，到此亦不能不退让一步，
Even Zuo, competitive and eager to prevail as he was, had to yield on this occasion.

与三王略略招呼后，向宝鋆拱拱手说：
After briefly greeting the three princes, he clasped his hands towards Bao Yun.

“我初遇大丧，
“This is my first great state mourning.

军机职司何事，都请佩翁主持。”
Please take charge of all that falls to the Grand Council, Mr Peiheng.”

“这是责无旁贷的事。”
“It is a duty I cannot shirk.”


一语未毕，有人来报，乾清门开了。
Before Bao Yun had finished, someone announced that the Gate of Heavenly Purity was open.

于是惇王领头，入乾清门先到“内奏事处”。章奏出纳，皆经此处，
Prince Dun led the way through it to the Inner Memorial Office, through which all memorials passed in and out.

照规矩帝后违和，派案药方亦存内奏事处，王公大臣谁都可以看的。
By established practice, when an emperor or empress was ill, the medical records and prescriptions were also kept there, available for princes and ministers to inspect.

药方一共五张，
There were five prescriptions.

最后一张注明“西刻”，是左宗棠出宫以后请脉所开的，
The last, marked with the You hour, had been written after Zuo left the palace.

说是“六脉将脱，
It stated: “The pulses at all six positions are on the point of failing.

药不能下。”
Medicine cannot be swallowed.”

“宾天是什么时候？”惇王在问。
“At what time did she pass away?” Prince Dun asked.

“戌时。”
“At the Xu hour.”

戍时是晚上八点钟。
That meant eight in the evening.

左宗棠心里在想，接到徐用仪的信是十一点钟，计算他得知消息不会早于十点钟，
Zuo reflected that he had received Xu’s letter at eleven, and Xu could not have learned the news before ten.

相隔两个钟头，
Two hours had elapsed.

在这段辰光之中，不知道钟粹宫中是何境况？
What had happened during that interval in the Palace of Accumulated Purity?

“大人！”
“Your Excellency.”

徐用仪牵着他的袖子说：
Xu tugged at his sleeve.

“请到南书房。”
“Please come to the Southern Study.”

宫中定制，凡有大丧，都以乾清门内西边的南书房为“治丧办事处”。
Whenever there was a great imperial bereavement, palace rules made the Southern Study, west of the Gate of Heavenly Purity on its inner side, the funeral arrangements office.

一到了那里，第一件事便是将宫帽上的顶戴与红缨子都摘了下来，
On arrival, the first thing everyone did was remove the buttons and red tassels from their official hats.

然后各自按爵位官阶大小，找适当的座位坐下来。
They then took seats according to their titles and ranks.

“真是想不到！”醇王向宝鋆说道：
“Who could have expected this?” Prince Chun said to Bao Yun.

“得赶紧把六爷追回来。”
“We must get Sixth Brother back at once.”

“六爷”是指恭王，
He meant Prince Gong.

“已经派人去了。”宝鋆答说：
“Someone has already gone,” Bao Yun replied.

“大概明天下午才能回来。”
“He probably cannot return until tomorrow afternoon.”

“得找个人来问一问才好。”惇王说道：
“We ought to find someone to question,” Prince Dun said.

“譬如有没有遗言？”
“Whether she left any last words, for instance.”

“不会有的。”惠王接口：
“She could not have,” Prince Hui answered.

“中午的方子已经说‘神识不清’，
“The noon prescription already said she was unconscious.

以后牙关都撬不开，
Later they could not even prise her jaws apart.

怎么能开口说话？”
How could she speak?”

惇王默然，举座不语，
Prince Dun fell silent, and no one else said a word.

但每人心里都有一个疑问：到底是什么病？
Yet the same question was in everyone’s mind: what had her illness been?


“要问什么病，实在没有病。”
“If you ask what the illness was, there was really no illness at all.”

徐用仪左右看了一下，
Xu glanced about him.

下人都在廊上，客厅中除了胡雪岩的贴身跟班以外，别无闲人，
The servants were in the corridor; apart from Hu’s personal attendant, no outsiders remained in the reception room.

方始低声说道：
Only then did he lower his voice.

“是中了毒。”
“She was poisoned.”

此言一出，胡雪岩跟古应春互看了一眼。
Hu and Gu looked at each other.

原来胡雪岩因为创设胡庆余堂药号，自然而然地对药性医道，都不太外行，
Since founding Hu Qingyu Hall, Hu had naturally acquired some knowledge of medicines and medical practice.

看了从内奏事处抄出来的五张药方，又打听了慈安太后前一日御朝的情形，向古应春谈起，唯一可能的死因是中毒。
Having examined copies of the five prescriptions from the Inner Memorial Office and enquired how Empress Dowager Ci’an had appeared at court the previous day, he had told Gu that poisoning was the only possible cause of death.

此刻是证实了，
To him, Xu’s account now confirmed it.

只不知如何中的毒。
What he still did not know was how the poison had been given.

“毒是下在点心里头的。”徐用仪说：
“It was put in a cake,” Xu said.

“东太后有歇午党的习惯，睡醒以后，经常要吃甜点心。
“The Eastern Empress Dowager was accustomed to taking a nap at midday and often ate something sweet after waking.

初九那天，午觉醒来，西太后派梳头太监李莲英，进了一盘松仁百果蜜糕，
On the ninth, the Western Empress Dowager sent her hairdressing eunuch Li Lianying with a plate of honey cakes made with pine nuts and assorted dried fruits.

刚蒸出来又香又甜，
Fresh from the steamer, they were fragrant and sweet.

东太后一连吃了三块，不到半个钟头，病就发作了。”
The Eastern Empress Dowager ate three in succession, and within half an hour the illness began.”

胡雪岩骇然，
Hu was horrified.

“是西太后下的毒？”他问：
“The Western Empress Dowager poisoned her?

“为什么呢？”
Why?”

“这话说来就长了……”
“That is a long story…”


慈禧太后一直有桩耿耿于怀，说什么也无法自我譬解的事，就是为什么她该低于慈安太后一等，
One grievance had always rankled with Empress Dowager Cixi, and no reasoning could reconcile her to it: why should she stand one degree below Empress Dowager Ci’an?

而这一等非同小可，
That single degree mattered enormously.

皇后母仪天下，生日称为“千秋”，受群臣在宫门外朝贺。
An empress was the mother of the realm; her birthday was celebrated as a festival of a thousand autumns, and the ministers offered congratulations outside the palace gates.

下皇后一等的皇贵妃，不独无此荣耀，
An imperial noble consort, one rank lower, enjoyed none of this honour.

甚至连姓氏亦不为群臣所知。
The ministers did not even know her family name.

东西两宫——慈安、慈禧由“选秀女”进身，家世是一样的，
The occupants of the Eastern and Western Palaces, Ci’an and Cixi, had both entered through the selection of palace women and came from comparable families.

慈安之父为广西左江道，慈禧之父是安徽池太广道。
Ci’an’s father had been circuit intendant of Zuojiang in Guangxi; Cixi’s, circuit intendant of Chi-Tai-Guang in Anhui.

起初身分虽同，
Their standing had originally been equal.

但当文宗元后既崩，立第二后时，选中了慈安，
Yet after Emperor Wenzong’s first empress died, Ci’an was chosen as the second.

便使得那时封号为“懿贵妃”的慈禧，愤不能平，
Cixi, then bearing the title Noble Consort Yi, had been furious.

因为慈安无子而她有子，且是唯一的皇子，
Ci’an had no son, whereas she had borne the emperor’s only son.

不是她的肚子争气，大清朝的帝系，将从咸丰而绝。
Had her womb not proved its worth, the direct imperial line of the Great Qing would have ended with Xianfeng.

由此可知，她是大有功于宗社的人，
She had therefore rendered a great service to the dynasty.

有功之人反遭贬损，这口气如何咽得下？
How could she swallow the humiliation of being placed below another woman despite that service?

可是文宗却又是一种想法，
Wenzong, however, reasoned differently.

正因为她生了皇子，断送了被立为皇后的希望。
It was precisely because she had borne an imperial son that her hope of becoming empress was extinguished.

原来慈禧精明能干、争胜揽权的性格，文宗已看得很清楚，
He had already recognized her intelligence and ability, her determination to win and to seize power.

自知在世之日无多，一旦驾崩，幼主嗣位，皇后成为太后，倘或骄纵不法，无人可制。
Knowing that he had little time left, he feared that, once he died and a child inherited the throne, an empress who became empress dowager might behave arrogantly and unlawfully with no one able to restrain her.


纵然如此，仍有隐忧，
Even so, an anxiety remained.

因为母以子贵，
A mother’s status rose with her son’s.

将来仍旧会成为太后，两宫并尊，
Cixi would still become empress dowager, and the two women would share that dignity.

而慈安赋性忠厚，必受欺侮。
Kind and honest by nature, Ci’an would surely be bullied.

这重心事，偶尔与他的宠臣肃顺吐露，肃顺便劝文宗行“钩戈夫人”的故事。
Wenzong occasionally confided this concern to his favourite minister Sushun, who advised him to follow the precedent of Lady Gouyi.

“钩弋夫人”是汉武帝的宠姬。
She had been a favourite consort of Emperor Wu of Han.

当他六十三岁时，钩弋夫人为他生了一个儿子，取名弗陵，生得茁壮聪明，颇受钟爱。
When he was sixty-three, she bore him a son, Fuling, a sturdy, intelligent child whom he loved dearly.

汉武帝晚年多病，年长诸子，看来多不成材，几经考虑，决定传位幼子弗陵，
Ill in his old age, and finding his older sons generally unpromising, Emperor Wu considered the matter repeatedly before deciding to leave the throne to Fuling.

但顾虑得幼主在位，母后年轻，每每会骄淫乱政，
But a child emperor with a young mother often meant a licentious empress dowager disrupting government.

春秋战国，不乏其例，秦始皇初年的情形，更当引以为鉴。
There had been many examples in the Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods; the early reign of the First Emperor of Qin provided a particularly clear warning.

因而狠心将钩弋夫人处死，以绝后患。
Emperor Wu therefore hardened his heart and put Lady Gouyi to death to forestall trouble.

文宗也觉得肃顺的建议不错，但却缺乏汉武帝的那一副铁石心肠。
Wenzong approved Sushun’s suggestion but lacked Emperor Wu’s iron resolution.

到得病入膏肓，势将不起时，特为用朱笔亲书密谕一道，交付慈安，
When his illness became incurable and death was near, he instead wrote a secret edict in vermilion and entrusted it to Ci’an.

大意是“西宫援母以子贵之义，不得不并尊为太后。
Its substance was: “The Western Palace must, by the principle that a mother’s dignity rises with her son’s, share the title of empress dowager.

然其人绝非可倚信者，
Yet she is by no means a person to be trusted.

即不有事，汝亦当专决，
Even when there is no trouble, decisions must remain yours alone.

彼果安分无过，当始终曲全恩礼，
If she keeps her place and commits no fault, preserve every kindness and courtesy towards her to the end.

若其失行彰著，汝可召集群臣，将联此言宣示，立即赐死，以杜后患。”
But if her misconduct becomes manifest, summon the ministers, show them these words of Mine, and order her death immediately, to prevent future calamity.”

不但有失谕，而且还口头叮嘱，倘或需要用这道密旨时，应该如何召集群臣，如何宣示，又如何可能有人为西宫求情，而决不可稍为之动，必须当机立断，斩草除根。
Besides the written edict, he gave detailed oral instructions: how she should summon the ministers and announce it; how someone might plead for the Western Palace; and how she must remain unmoved, decide at once, and eradicate the danger.

慈安含泪倾听，将朱谕珍重密藏，而心里却从未想过有用得到它的一天。
Ci’an listened in tears and carefully hid the vermilion edict, never imagining in her heart that she would have occasion to use it.


事隔二十年，慈禧已经四十六岁，
Twenty years had passed, and Cixi was forty-six.

这年，光绪六年二月初，忽然得了重病，
Early in the second month of Guangxu’s sixth year, she suddenly became seriously ill.

脉案对病因的叙述，含糊不清，而所开药方，则属于专治胎前产后诸症的“四物汤”，
The medical records were vague about the cause, but the prescription was Four-Substance Decoction, a treatment for disorders before and after childbirth.

群臣皆为之困惑不解。
The ministers were baffled.

据御医庄守和、李德立向人透露，说是“血崩”，但用血崩的药，却并不对症。
The imperial physicians Zhuang Shouhe and Li Deli told people that she was suffering from severe uterine bleeding, yet medicines for that condition did not suit her symptoms.

于是降旨征医。
An edict therefore called for doctors to be recommended.

直隶总督荐山东泰武临道无锡薛福辰，山西巡抚曾国荃荐太原府阳曲县知县杭州汪守正，
The governor-general of Zhili proposed Xue Fuchen of Wuxi, circuit intendant of Tai-Wu-Lin in Shandong; Zeng Guoquan, governor of Shanxi, recommended Wang Shouzheng of Hangzhou, magistrate of Yangqu County in Taiyuan Prefecture.

此两人都是世家子弟，饱读医书，精研方脉，
Both came from established families, had read widely in medical works, and had studied prescriptions and pulse diagnosis closely.

六月间先后到京，
They arrived in the capital, one after the other, in the sixth month.

一经“请脉”，都知病根所在，不约而同的表示慈禧太后患的是“骨蒸”，
As soon as they examined her, both understood the root of the illness and independently described it as “bone-steaming fever.”

其实是“蓐劳”，产后失血过多，成了俗语所说的“干血痨”，
In fact it was postpartum exhaustion: excessive loss of blood after childbirth had produced what was commonly called “dry-blood wasting disease.”

用温补甘平之法，病势日有起色。
With warming, nourishing medicines of a sweet and mild nature, her condition improved daily.

到了这年年底，已无危险，只待调养了。
By the end of that year she was out of danger and needed only convalescence.

宅心仁厚的慈安太后，自然亦为之庆幸。
Naturally, the kindly Ci’an rejoiced.

有一天，就在几天以前，在她所住的钟粹宫，邀慈禧共餐，
One day, only a few days earlier, she had invited Cixi to dine in her residence, the Palace of Accumulated Purity.

还喝了酒，
They drank wine as well.

到得席散，暗示宫女尽皆回避，促膝深谈，作了一番规劝。
After the meal, she signalled all the palace women to withdraw, drew close to Cixi, and began a long, intimate conversation in which she offered some counsel.


据私下窥视的宫女所传出来的消息，说是慈安真的动了感情，
According to reports passed on by palace women who secretly watched them, Ci’an was deeply moved.

首先追叙当年文宗逃难到热河的种种苦楚，文宗崩后，“孤儿寡妇”受肃顺欺侮，
She first recalled the hardships of their flight with Wenzong to Rehe and how, after his death, the “widows and orphan” had been bullied by Sushun.

幸而“姐妹”同心协力，诛除权臣，转危为安。
