The total was therefore 2,220,000 taels, more than three hundred thousand below the original asking price.

至于付款的办法，在十一月十九日已先付定银二十万两，
As for payment, he reported that a deposit of two hundred thousand had already been paid on the nineteenth of the eleventh month.

约定十二月十八日续付二十万，明年正月十六再付三十万，即行交盘。
A further two hundred thousand would be paid on the eighteenth of the twelfth month, followed by three hundred thousand on the sixteenth of the first month of the coming year, when possession would be transferred.

余数如何分期交付，亦已商定。
Instalment arrangements for the remainder had also been agreed.

至于商股，盛宣怀说已招到一百二十二万两，短缺“官本”一百万两，
Sheng claimed to have raised 1,220,000 taels in merchant subscriptions, leaving one million to be supplied by the government.

盛宣怀亦已借著代筹，某处可拨多少，一一指明，当然这也是预先跟梅启煦商量好的。
He had even taken the trouble to identify how much could be drawn from each official source—arrangements, of course, settled beforehand with Mei.


谈停当了，便需出奏，
A memorial now had to be submitted.

类此案例，倘为北洋主稿，便需南洋会衔，南洋主稿，自然亦需北洋会衔，
In cases of this kind, a memorial drafted by the Northern administration required the Southern commissioner's joint signature, and the converse applied if the South drafted it.

盛宣怀极力申说，时机迫促，往返磋商，误了二批交款之期，所付二十万定洋将遭没收，
Sheng insisted that time was short: correspondence back and forth would delay the second payment and cause the two-hundred-thousand-tael deposit to be forfeited.

劝沈葆祯单衔出奏，
He urged Shen to submit the memorial under his own name alone.

又说李鸿章与沈葆祯是同年，遇到这样的好事，只会赞成，不会反对。
Li and Shen had passed the examination in the same year, he added; Li could only welcome so advantageous a transaction.

沈葆祯思想也不错，同意单衔出奏：在折尾上声明：“时值冻阻，不及函商北洋大臣。”
Shen agreed and appended the explanation: “The waterways being obstructed by ice, there has been no time to consult the Northern Trade Commissioner by letter.”

运道冰封，陆路仍可通行，
Even if the waterways were frozen, the roads remained open.

显然的，这是一个很牵强的理由。
The excuse was plainly strained.

沈葆祯做梦也没有想到，这是盛宣怀特设的圈套，
Shen never dreamed that it was part of a trap.

先则以“十六之朗”劝沈葆祯“当仁不让”，继而以恐误二批交银之朗，会遭损失，迫使沈葆祯单衔出奏，
First Sheng had invoked the deadline of the sixteenth to persuade him to assume sole responsibility; then he used the danger of missing the second payment to force a memorial bearing only Shen's name.

这种种设计，都是为了要出脱李鸿章，以便将来骗局败露时，李鸿章得以未与闻共事的局外人身分，易于回护。
Every step was designed to keep Li clear of the affair, so that, when the fraud emerged, he could defend Sheng more easily from the position of an uninvolved outsider.


果然，四年以后骗局败露了。
Four years later, the fraud did indeed come to light.

发难的是一个湖南籍的名士，国子监祭酒王先谦，
The first attack came from Wang Xianqian, a celebrated Hunan scholar serving as director of the Imperial Academy.

上折严劾招商局管事道员盛宣怀等蒙蔽把侍，营私舞弊。
He submitted a severe impeachment of Sheng and the other circuit intendants managing China Merchants, accusing them of deception, domination of the enterprise, and fraudulent pursuit of private profit.

当时言路上很有力量，朝廷对一般“清流”的议论与主张，十分重视，
Critical officials then wielded considerable influence, and the court paid close attention to the views of the “pure stream” critics.

当即饬下两江总督“痛加整顿，逐一严查”。
It immediately ordered the Governor-General of Liangjiang to undertake a thorough reform and investigate every item rigorously.

其时的两江总督名叫刘坤一，湖南新宁人，对于李鸿章久怀不满。
The incumbent was Liu Kunyi of Xinning, Hunan, who had long resented Li.

原来李鸫章自从“用沪平吴”后，一直视两江是他的地盘，
Since using Shanghai as his base to pacify the Wu region, Li had continued to regard Liangjiang as his own territory.

官拜直隶总督北洋大臣，却能巧妙地运用洋人，以及实际上办理洋务的关系，在两江安插私人，直接指挥。
Although appointed Governor-General of Zhili and Northern Trade Commissioner, he skilfully used foreign connections and the practical administration of Western affairs to install his own men in Liangjiang and direct them personally.

最使刘坤一不能忍受的是，李鸿章的妻舅赵继元在两江的胡作非为。
What Liu found most intolerable was the conduct of Li's brother-in-law, Zhao Jiyuan.


赵继元是安徽太湖人，
Zhao came from Taihu in Anhui.

他的祖父名叫赵文楷，是嘉庆元年丙辰科的状元，
His grandfather, Zhao Wenkai, had been the top graduate in the bingchen examination of Jiaqing's first year.

赵继元本人亦点了翰林，但肚子里一团茅草，如何侥幸而得列清班，一直是个谜。
Zhao himself had entered the Hanlin Academy, although his head was full of straw; how luck had secured him such scholarly distinction remained a mystery.

不过，他本人倒也有自知之明，
He did at least recognize his limitations.

知道凭他的那支笔，做京官决无出头之日，因而以翰林捐班为道员，在吏部走了门路，分发江南候补。
Knowing that his writing would never carry him far in the capital, he used his Hanlin status to purchase circuit-intendant rank, cultivated contacts in the Ministry of Personnel, and obtained assignment to await a vacancy in Jiangnan.

那时的两江总督是曾国藩，
The Governor-General of Liangjiang was then Zeng Guofan.

当洪杨初年时，怕功高震主，决定急流勇退，遣散湘军，扶植李鸿章的淮军来替代。
In the early years of the Hong-Yang upheaval, fearing that excessive achievement might alarm the throne, Zeng decided to withdraw at the height of his success, disband his Hunan Army, and foster Li's Anhui Army as its replacement.

所以赵继元一到江宁“禀到”，便派了他一个极重要极肥的差使：两江军需总局坐办。
Accordingly, when Zhao reported at Jiangning, he received an exceptionally important and lucrative assignment: executive director of the Liangjiang General Military Supply Bureau.

赵继元凡事自作聪明，自恃有妹夫李鸿章作靠山，
Zhao thought himself clever in everything and relied on his younger sister's husband, Li, as his protector.

在曾国藩以后的历任两江总督马新贻、李宗羲、沈葆祯，都不大能指挥得动他。
Zeng's successors—Ma Xinyi, Li Zongxi, and Shen Baozhen—could scarcely make him obey.

沈葆祯病殁，继任的刘坤一，资格比较浅，就更不在他眼里了。
When Shen died, the less senior Liu Kunyi counted for even less in Zhao's eyes.


除了赵继元对身在南洋而唯北洋之命是从的盛宣怀等人，刘坤一亦耿耿于怀，
Besides Zhao, Liu resented Sheng and the others who served in the South but obeyed only the North.

久已想动手了。
He had long wanted to act.

因此，一奉朝旨，立刻派上海道刘瑞芬及上海制造局总办李兴锐，“调看该局帐目，逐款严查。”
On receiving the imperial order, he immediately appointed Liu Ruifen, the Shanghai circuit intendant, and Li Xingrui, director of the Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau, to examine the company's books item by item.

刘瑞芬是安徽贵池人，出身是个秀才，同治元年从李鸿章援沪，主管军械的采购与转运，
Liu Ruifen, a licentiate from Guichi in Anhui, had accompanied Li to relieve Shanghai in Tongzhi's first year, taking charge of purchasing and forwarding military equipment.

以军功保到道员，
Military merit had won him circuit-intendant rank.

曾经督办淞沪厘金，署理过两淮盐运使，是淮军系统中一名很重要的文官。
He had supervised the Songhu likin administration and acted as Lianghuai Salt Transport Commissioner, becoming an important civil official in the Anhui Army system.

刘瑞芬跟李鸿章的关系很密切，但奉命查办此案，却很认真，
His ties to Li were close, but he investigated conscientiously.

因为他为人比较正派，看不起盛宣怀那种奸诈取巧的小人行径，
He was comparatively upright and despised Sheng's deceitful opportunism.

加以刘坤一为人精明，在授命之前将他找了去，率直警告：如果查得不确实，他会另外派人再查，
Moreover, the shrewd Liu Kunyi had summoned him beforehand and warned him plainly: if the inquiry was inaccurate, another investigator would be appointed.

“那时老兄面子上不好看，
“You would lose face then, my friend.

可别怪我。”
Do not blame me.”


其实盛宣怀搞的那套把戏，知道的人很多，刘瑞芬即令想为他掩饰也办不到，
In fact, so many people knew about Sheng's tricks that Liu Ruifen could hardly have concealed them even had he wished to.

及至调出帐目来一看，疑问到处都是。
Once the books were produced, questions appeared everywhere.

刘瑞芬为了慎重起见，特为找了几个内行朋友来研究，其中之一就是古应春。
To proceed cautiously, he consulted several knowledgeable friends, including Gu Yingchun.

“帐本说商股只有四万多银子，
“The accounts show only forty-odd thousand taels in merchant subscriptions.

可是盛杏荪当时具禀两江，说‘已于十一月十八日公商定议，即于十九日付给定银二十万两’，
Yet Sheng Xingsun's original report to Liangjiang states: ‘Agreement was reached after consultation on the eighteenth of the eleventh month, and a deposit of two hundred thousand taels was paid on the nineteenth.’

这二十万两银子是哪里来的？”
Where did those two hundred thousand come from?”

“根本没有这回事。”古应春说，
“The whole story is false,” Gu replied.

“只要算一算日子，就知道他是假话。”
“You need only work out the dates.”

光绪二年十一月十六日，照西历算是公元一八七七年元旦，
The sixteenth day of the eleventh month in Guangxu's second year corresponded, by the Western calendar, to New Year's Day, 1877.

盛宣怀当初跟沈葆祯说：“若逾十六之期，则受代人来，即无从更议。”即指新的年度开始而言。
Sheng's warning to Shen that no further agreement would be possible once the sixteenth passed and the replacement manager arrived referred to the beginning of the new year.

然则中历的十一月十八、十九，即是西历的正月初一、初二，
The eighteenth and nineteenth of the Chinese eleventh month, then, were the first and second of January in the Western calendar.

洋人犹在新年假期之中，
The foreigners were still on their New Year holiday.

旗昌公司固然无人办事，外商银行亦一律封关，
Nobody was conducting business at Qichang, and all the foreign banks were closed.

所谓“定议”，所谓“付给定银二十万两”，全属子虚乌有。
The supposed agreement and payment of a two-hundred-thousand-tael deposit were pure invention.

其次是各省所拨的官款，总计一百万两，照数转付旗昌银行，
Next came the government funds allocated by the provinces: one million taels in all, recorded as transferred in full to Qichang Bank.

银数固然分毫不短，
Not a tael was missing from the stated payment.

但古应春深知内幕，指出这一笔百万银子中，盛宜怀等人中饱了四十四万两。
But Gu knew the inside story and pointed out that Sheng and his associates had pocketed 440,000 taels of it.

证据呢？
His evidence?

“各省官款是实数，都由阜康汇来，
“The provincial funds were real money, all remitted through Fukang.

招商局派人来提走了白花花的现银，转存外国银行。
China Merchants sent someone to withdraw actual silver and deposit it in a foreign bank.

可是，付给旗昌的，不是现款，
But what they handed Qichang was not cash.

是旗昌的股票。”
It was Qichang's own stock.”

古应春有《申报》为凭，载明当时旗昌股票的行情是，票面一百两，实值五十六两。
Gu could produce the Shen Bao newspaper, which recorded the contemporary market price: shares with a face value of one hundred taels were selling for fifty-six.

这就是说，盛宣怀只需花五十六万两银子买进旗昌的股票，便可抵一百万银子的帐，
Sheng thus needed to spend only 560,000 taels to purchase stock that would discharge a debt of one million.

岂非中饱了四十四万两。
Had he not pocketed the remaining 440,000?

光是这两点，舞弊的证据便很确实了。
Those two points alone provided firm evidence of fraud.


彻查的结果，掀开了整个的内幕，
The thorough inquiry exposed the entire operation.

盛宣怀与徐润等人所玩的花样是：
Sheng, Xu, and their associates had proceeded in seven stages.

第一，以定银二万五千两，与旗昌订定收买的草约。
First, they paid twenty-five thousand taels as a deposit on a preliminary purchase agreement with Qichang.

第二，挪用招商局的官款，收购每一百两已贬值至五十六两的旗昌股票。
Second, they diverted government money held by China Merchants to buy Qichang stock that had fallen from a face value of one hundred taels to a market price of fifty-six.

第三，以对抗洋商轮船公司，挽回利权的理由，捏词已集商股一百二十二万，说动沈葆祯拨给官本。
Third, invoking competition with foreign steamship companies and the recovery of Chinese commercial interests, they falsely claimed to have raised 1,220,000 taels in merchant subscriptions and persuaded Shen to provide official capital.

第四，捏称已付定银二十万两，造成既成事实，并以运道冻阻，无需咨商北洋为借口，迫使沈葆祯单独负责。
Fourth, they falsely reported having paid a two-hundred-thousand-tael deposit, presenting the transaction as a fait accompli; then, using the frozen waterways as an excuse to dispense with Northern consultation, they forced Shen to bear sole responsibility.

第五，取得旗昌百分之五十一以上的股权，委托英籍律师担文，依法接收旗昌。
Fifth, after obtaining more than fifty-one per cent of Qichang's shares, they engaged the British lawyer Danwen to take it over legally.

第六，官本一百万两汇到招商局后，盛宣怀等以旗昌股票，照面额十足抵换现银。
Sixth, when the million taels in government capital reached China Merchants, they exchanged Qichang stock for cash at its full face value.

第七，应付旗昌余款，先由招商局官款中垫付四十余万两，
Seventh, towards the outstanding purchase price they first advanced more than four hundred thousand taels from China Merchants' official funds.

尚短六十九万，由“官本缓息”、“商股存息”，以及保险费盈余等陆续给付。
Another 690,000 remained unpaid, to be met gradually through deferred interest on government capital, retained interest on merchant shares, and insurance profits.

事实上现银与股票之间，仍有很大的一个差额，饱人私囊。
Here again, a substantial difference between cash and stock values went into private pockets.

所谓“官本缓息”是江南各省拨交招商局的官款一百九十八万两，应付利息，暂时停止。
“Deferred interest on government capital” meant temporarily suspending interest payments on the 1,980,000 taels that the Jiangnan provinces had advanced to China Merchants.

“商股存息”是商股利息暂付一半，所余一半改为股本。
“Retained interest on merchant shares” meant paying shareholders only half their interest and converting the other half into share capital.

这样陆陆续续，东挪西凑牵扯不清，根本是一盘糊涂帐。
With funds shifted from one pocket to another and obligations endlessly entangled, the whole affair became an unintelligible muddle of accounts.


哪知刘坤一尚未出奏，盛宣怀等人先发制人，
Before Liu Kunyi could memorialize, however, Sheng and his associates struck first.

列举了十八条申辩的理由，具禀北洋，由李鸿章抢先出奏，希望造成朝廷的先人之见，发生排拒刘坤一的意见的作用。
They submitted eighteen points of defence to the Northern administration, and Li hurried a memorial to court, hoping to establish a favourable first impression that would prejudice the throne against Liu's conclusions.

加以盛宣怀的大肆活动，刘坤一的夏奏，果然“留中”了。
With Sheng also exerting himself energetically behind the scenes, Liu's report was indeed retained in the palace without further action.

李鸿章的复奏，照例要抄送南洋，
By established practice, a copy of Li's memorial went to the Southern administration.

刘坤一一看，真正是“歪理十八条”。
Reading it, Liu found it nothing less than eighteen specious arguments.

他的笔下很来得，当下亲自草拟奏稿，驳斥李鸿章。
A powerful writer himself, he personally drafted a rebuttal.

首先说明：李鸿章认为刘瑞芬等，查案不无错误，为盛宣怀极力剖辩，奏请免议。
He began by explaining that Li considered the investigators' findings erroneous, had vigorously defended Sheng, and had requested that no disciplinary action be taken.

此则朝廷自有权衡，非臣下所能置议，
The court must naturally weigh that question; it was not for a subject to prejudge.

不过，刘瑞芬等所禀盛宣怀的贪诈情形，颇为明确，“有不敢不再陈于圣主之前者。”
Nevertheless, the investigators' account of Sheng's greed and fraud was sufficiently clear that Liu dared not refrain from presenting it once more before the throne.


首先要驳的是，李鸿章所陈，
His first target was Li's account of the financing.

当初收买旗昌，请拨官本银一百万，并饬两淮盐运使劝盐商就“盐引”派搭股份，
According to Li, the original proposal had sought one million taels in official capital and an order directing the Lianghuai Salt Transport Commissioner to encourage salt merchants to subscribe for shares through allocations attached to their salt certificates.

预计可得银八十万两，
This was expected to yield eight hundred thousand taels.

再通饬南洋各省藩司、各海关道，随时劝谕富商搭股，
Provincial treasurers and customs intendants throughout the Southern jurisdiction were also to encourage wealthy merchants to subscribe as opportunities arose.

并无已集商股一百二十二万两之说。
There had been no claim that 1,220,000 taels had already been raised.

刘坤一先引沈葆祯当年所奏“臣于病榻传见盛宣怀等，
Liu quoted Shen's original memorial: “From my sickbed I summoned Sheng Xuanhuai and the others.

续据禀称，各商尽力攒凑，只能集成银一百二十二万两，
They subsequently reported that, despite every effort to assemble the funds, the merchants could raise only 1,220,000 taels.

所短之数，拨请南洋各省，尽力筹拨一百万两”的原文，
To meet the deficiency, they requested that the Southern provinces make every effort to allocate one million taels.”

向李鸿章提出质问：“如盛宣怀无此凑集一百二十二万两之说，则沈葆祯何所据而云然？
Liu then challenged Li: if Sheng had never claimed to have assembled 1,220,000 taels, on what basis had Shen written this?

如谓此一百二十二万两即系原禀请饬藩运海关劝商搭股之项，则事既经官，沈葆祯何以不于折内明晰声叙，又何以不札饬各司道查照办理？”
If the sum referred instead to subscriptions that provincial treasurers, the salt commissioner, and customs officials were being asked to solicit, why had Shen neither stated that official involvement clearly in his memorial nor instructed those officials to proceed?


李鸿章又说，藩司、运使、关道并未“帮同劝谕，各商亦未即附本，仅集股银四万余两”。
Li further maintained that the officials had not assisted with solicitation, the merchants had not promptly contributed, and only forty-odd thousand taels had been raised.

虽有“官本缓息”等项，可以弥补此一百二十二万两的一部分，所短尚多，
Deferred interest on official capital and other arrangements could cover part of the 1,220,000, but a large deficiency remained.

因而盛宣怀等不得不暂向钱庄借款来付旗昌，这也就是招商局利息负担甚重的由来。
Sheng had therefore been obliged to borrow from banks to pay Qichang; this explained China Merchants' heavy interest burden.

对这一点，刘坤一分两方面来驳，
Liu attacked this from two directions.

一是由沈藻祯方面来看，倘如盛宣怀不是表明已集有商股一百二十二万两，而要动用官方力量劝谕商人附本，如此渺茫之事，沈葆祯能“轻掷百万库款”吗？
From Shen's position, if Sheng had not represented the merchant capital as already available, but merely proposed that officials persuade merchants to contribute, would Shen have risked a million taels from the treasury on so uncertain a prospect?

再是从盛宣怀方面来看，如果商股是照他所说的方法来凑集，那么“盐引”上派搭股份之事如何？
From Sheng's position, if funds were indeed to be raised in the manner described, what had happened to the shares allocated through salt certificates?

各藩司关道劝谕富商附股，已有多少？
How much had the treasurers and customs intendants persuaded wealthy merchants to contribute?

理当具呈催问，
Surely he ought to have submitted inquiries or reminders.

而竟无一字之禀，甘愿以重息在外称贷，这是合理的吗？
Was it reasonable that he had written not a word, while willingly borrowing elsewhere at high interest?

由此分析，刘坤一作一论断：“是盛宣怀先有凑集百二十二万两之言，故不敢复有所请，而沈葆祯信以为实，无俟他谋也。”
Liu concluded that Sheng had already claimed to possess the 1,220,000 and therefore dared not ask for further assistance, while Shen, believing him, had seen no need to seek other means.

又说：“此等重大事件，往往反复筹商，至于数目，必须斟酌尽善，而后上闻，
Matters of such importance, Liu continued, were normally discussed repeatedly, and financial figures carefully settled before being reported to the throne.

似不得执盛宣怀等饰词而抹煞沈葆祯奏案，以刘瑞芬等为未查原卷也。
Sheng's evasions could not be used to erase Shen's memorial or to accuse the investigators of neglecting the original records.

沈葆祯于光绪三年陈奏饷事，论及提拔招商局之款，自悔孟浪，
When Shen discussed military funding in a memorial during Guangxu's third year, he had regretted the rashness of his advances to China Merchants.

固有难言之隐矣。”
There had plainly been circumstances he found difficult to disclose.


接下来又说：“臣之所以奏参盛宣怀者，原不独此两端”，
Nor, Liu continued, did his impeachment rest on those two points alone.

而是因为另有更不堪容忍的弊端，
Other abuses were still less tolerable.

旗昌公司当时已濒临倒闭边缘，
Qichang had been near collapse.

即欲收买，应照西洋“折旧”之例，
Even if worth buying, its assets should have been valued with depreciation, according to Western practice.

为何照原价承受。
Why accept them at their original value?

刘坤一最有力的指责是：“盛宜怀等收买旗昌轮船，原谓去一劲敌，可以收回利权，乃局面愈宽，而虚靡更巨，
His strongest charge was that, although Sheng and his associates had promised to remove a formidable rival and recover profits, expansion had brought still greater waste.

去年系第五届，竟亏银至二十四万六千有奇，国需高货，势将付之乌有。
In the fifth financial year the company had lost more than 246,000 taels, threatening to consume both government funds and merchant capital.

随经候选道员叶廷春人局经理，是为第六届，遂余银至二十九万有奇，
Yet after Ye Tingchun, a candidate for a circuit intendancy, took over in the sixth year, it earned more than 290,000.

短长并计，实多出银五十三万二千两，
Counting the elimination of the loss together with the gain, Liu put the improvement at 532,000 taels.

其收效如是之巨而且速，悉由力求节省而来，则盛宣怀等之滥用滥支，一年之内数十万两，岂不骇人听闻，
Such a rapid and substantial result, achieved entirely through economy, exposed the appalling scale of the previous managers' annual waste.

即将盛宣怀查抄，于法亦不为过，仅请予以某职，已属格外从宽。
Even confiscating Sheng's property would not exceed the law, he argued; merely requesting his dismissal was exceptionally lenient.

“原来此骗局成功后，局本大增、利息日重，而旧船、码头、仓库的管理，亦需大皂费用，
What had happened was that the acquisition greatly enlarged the company's capital obligations and interest burden, while the old vessels, wharves, and warehouses required heavy expenditure.

成了个无法收拾的烂摊子。
The result was a hopeless mess.

盛宣怀、唐廷枢计议，不如找个人来接办，以便脱身。
Sheng and Tang decided to find someone to take over so that they could extricate themselves.

多方物色，找到一个江苏的候补道叶廷春，同意接手，
After searching widely, they persuaded Ye, an expectant circuit intendant in Jiangsu, to accept.

其时为光绪四年夏天。
This was the summer of Guangxu's fourth year.

依照四洋会计年度跨年的算法，称之为“一届”，这年是第六届。
Following the Western accounting practice of a financial year spanning two calendar years, the company called each such period a “term”; this was its sixth.

叶廷春接办后，实事求是，力求节流，
Ye dealt with practical realities and concentrated on reducing expenditure.

至年底盈余二十九万两，到第二年会计年度届满，实盈五十三万余两，即是刘坤一所说的“短长并计”。
By the end of the calendar year he had produced a surplus of 290,000 taels; by the close of the financial year in the following year, the actual surplus exceeded 530,000—what Liu described as counting the shortfall and the gain together.

盛宣怀等人的原意是，金蝉脱壳，将叶廷春当作“替死鬼”，
Sheng's original intention had been to slip out of his predicament and leave Ye as the scapegoat.

不过叶廷春居然能将这个烂摊子经理得有声有色，贪念一动，便又设计排挤。
But when Ye unexpectedly made the business thrive, greed revived, and Sheng's group began scheming to drive him out.

叶廷春一看不是路，
Ye saw the danger.

知道盛宣怀心狠手辣，又有北洋的奥援，说不定会惹祸上身，因而急流勇退，
Knowing Sheng's ruthlessness and Northern backing, he feared trouble and withdrew while he could.

招商局便又归盛宣怀等人把持了。
China Merchants once again fell under Sheng's control.


刘坤一此奏，事实俱在，理由充足，
Liu's memorial rested on established facts and compelling arguments.

盛宣怀本万无可免，
Sheng ought to have had no escape.

哪知奏报到京，适逢慈安太后暴崩，这件案子便压了下来。
But it reached Beijing just as Empress Dowager Ci'an died suddenly, and the case was set aside.

胡雪岩原以为慈安的“大事”一过，会有结果，盛宣怀等人撤职，招商局或者会派他接办。
Hu expected a decision after the great funeral observances were over: Sheng and his associates would be dismissed, and perhaps Hu would be appointed to take charge of China Merchants.

可是他没有想到，盛宣怀另外走了一条路子，同时李鸿章亦正有用他之处，
What he had not foreseen was that Sheng had opened another avenue of influence, while Li had an immediate need for his services.

两下一凑，竟得化险为夷。
Together, these circumstances enabled him to survive.

盛宣怀新走的一条路子，便是慈禧太后的亲信、长春宫的总管太监李莲英。
His new connection was Li Lianying, Empress Dowager Cixi's trusted chief eunuch at the Palace of Eternal Spring.

此人本学的皮毛行生意，京师称之为“毛毛匠”，
Li had originally learned the fur trade, whose practitioners in Beijing were called fur workers.

又以制皮需用硝，所以李莲英的外号叫做“皮硝李”，
Because saltpetre was used in preparing hides, he acquired the nickname “Saltpetre Li.”

他是二十几岁时赌输了为债主所遥，无可奈何，“净身入宫”，作为逃避。
In his twenties he lost heavily at gambling. Hounded by creditors and seeing no other escape, he had himself castrated and entered the palace.

原是“半路出家”，早先的许多同行、朋友，仍有往来，
Since he had joined the profession relatively late, he still kept in touch with many former colleagues and friends.

所以盛宣怀得以找到关系，大事结构。
Through these connections Sheng found a way to cultivate him lavishly.


至于李鸿章有重用盛宣怀之处是，正在开办电报。
Li Hongzhang, meanwhile, needed Sheng to develop telegraphy.

早在同治三年，俄国要求自治克图铺设陆线，直达北京，
As early as Tongzhi's third year, Russia had requested permission to build an overland line from Kyakhta directly to Beijing.

朝廷继然拒绝，
The court flatly refused.

俄国改变计划，采取迂回的办法，先将西伯利亚陆线延伸至海参出，然后与丹麦大北公司合作，先在公海上敷设单心水线三条，一是条海参出至长崎，一条是长崎至吴淞口外的大山岛，又一条是香港至大山岛。
Russia adopted an indirect approach instead, extending its Siberian line to Vladivostok, then cooperating with Denmark's Great Northern Telegraph Company to lay three single-core submarine cables: one from Vladivostok to Nagasaki, another from Nagasaki to Dashan Island off the mouth of the Wusong, and a third from Hong Kong to Dashan Island.

先后在同治十年完工，
These were completed successively in Tongzhi's tenth year.

大山鸟已在中国领海之内，但朝廷认为无足轻重，置之不问。
Dashan Island lay within Chinese territorial waters, but the court considered the matter insignificant and ignored it.

于是大北公司得寸进尺，由大山岛沿长江伸一条水线进来，直通上海，在黄浦滩登陆，而且公然设局营业，
Great Northern then pushed further, running a cable from the island up the Yangtze to Shanghai, landing it on the Huangpu waterfront, and openly establishing a commercial office.

这一来，俄国经海参出、长崎而达上海，对于中国的政情、商务、瞬息之间便能传到圣彼得堡。
Russia could now receive Chinese political and commercial intelligence in St Petersburg almost instantly through Shanghai, Nagasaki, and Vladivostok.

当然欧洲各国，也能经由圣彼得堡的转运，获得同样的便利。
Other European countries enjoyed the same convenience through relay at St Petersburg.

这条名为北线，
This was called the northern route.

大北公司另有一条南线，由大山岛经厦门鼓浪屿而达香港，长九百五千海里，再由香港通新加坡、槟榔屿以达欧洲。
Great Northern also operated a southern route from Dashan Island through Gulangyu, off Xiamen, to Hong Kong, its length stated in the text as “nine hundred five thousand nautical miles”; from Hong Kong it connected through Singapore and Penang to Europe.

南北两线的电报最初只用洋文，
At first, telegrams on both routes used only foreign languages.

后来发明四个阿拉伯数字编组的中文码，一共七千字，
Later, a Chinese code was devised, assigning four Arabic numerals to each of seven thousand characters.

印刷成书，普遍发售，于是，不识洋文的中国人，也能分享电报的便利了。
Printed codebooks were widely sold, enabling Chinese people who knew no foreign language to use the service.

其次英国亦不甘让大北公司独檀利查，
Britain, too, was unwilling to leave the profits entirely to Great Northern.

同治九年由英国公使威妥玛策动英商东方电报公司，自英国设海线经大西洋、红海及印度洋而达印度。
In Tongzhi's ninth year, the British minister, Thomas Wade, encouraged the Eastern Telegraph Company to establish a submarine route from Britain through the Atlantic, the Red Sea, and the Indian Ocean to India.

再另组大东电报公司，由印度南境，延伸这条海线经新加坡、越南西贡等处至香港。
The Eastern Extension Telegraph Company was then formed to continue the line from southern India through Singapore and Saigon in Vietnam to Hong Kong.

及至正式向中国申请自香港铺钱经汕头、厦门、福州、宁波至上海时，却一直未获成议。
Its formal application for a route from Hong Kong through Shantou, Xiamen, Fuzhou, and Ningbo to Shanghai remained unsettled.

到同治十二年大北公司既在黄埔设局营业，大东公司毫不客气地自香港经福州，设海线至上海宝山，再转接至英租界，开张营业。
But once Great Northern opened its Huangpu office in Tongzhi's twelfth year, Eastern Extension proceeded without ceremony: it laid a cable from Hong Kong through Fuzhou to Baoshan, connected it to the British concession in Shanghai, and opened for business.


盛宣怀是早已看出电报这项万里一瞬，恍同晤对的通信利器，必有前途，
Sheng had long recognized the future of an instrument that could carry a message across ten thousand miles in an instant, almost as though the correspondents were face to face.

但在内地架设陆线，颇为不易，
Building landlines in the interior, however, was difficult.

最大的障碍是，破坏了人家的风水，
The greatest obstacle was the belief that they disturbed people's feng shui.

一定会发生冲突，即令勉强架设好了，亦会遭人拔杆剪线，
Conflict was certain; even poles and wires successfully installed might later be pulled down or cut.

所以对此事的进行，一直心有余而力不足。
His ambition had therefore exceeded his means.

这样到了光绪五年，机会终于来了。
In Guangxu's fifth year, an opportunity finally arose.

当时因为伊犁交涉，中俄关系大为紧张，
Negotiations over Ili had severely strained relations between China and Russia.

除西北以外，东北及朝鲜的情势亦颇为不稳。
Besides the northwest, the northeast and Korea were unsettled.

李鸿章统筹军务全局，看人家有电报之利，掌握军情，占尽先机，未战已先输一着，
Surveying the military situation, Li saw that an opponent equipped with telegraphs could obtain intelligence and seize the initiative, leaving China a move behind before fighting even began.

因而接纳盛宣怀的建议，延聘大北公司的技术人员，架设自大沽口北塘海口炮台起，到天津北洋公所的陆线，
He accepted Sheng's proposal to employ technicians from Great Northern and build a landline from the Dagu and Beitang coastal forts to the Northern administration's office in Tianjin.

试办军报，效果良好。
Its trial use for military communications proved successful.

这一来，盛宣怀自然要进一步建议，创设由天津至上海的陆线电报。
Sheng naturally proposed a further step: a landline between Tianjin and Shanghai.

光绪六年七月，李鸿章上奏：“用兵之道，必以神速为贵，
In the seventh month of Guangxu's sixth year, Li memorialized that speed was essential in war.

是以泰西各国于讲求枪炮之外，水路则有快轮，陆路则有火轮车，飞行绝迹数万里。
Besides studying firearms and artillery, Western nations used fast steamers on water and locomotives on land to traverse enormous distances.

海洋欲通军信，则又有电报之法，于是和则玉帛相亲，战则兵戎相见，海围如户庭焉。
Telegraphy carried military intelligence across the oceans, bringing countries as close as neighbouring households, whether exchanging friendly courtesies in peace or confronting one another in war.

近来俄罗斯、日本均效而行之，
Russia and Japan had adopted the same methods.

故由各国以至上海，莫不设立电报，瞬息之间，可以互相问答，
Telegraph connections now linked foreign countries with Shanghai, allowing questions and answers to pass almost instantly.

独中国文书尚恃驿递，
China alone still depended on relay couriers.

虽日行六百里加紧，亦以迟速悬殊，望尘莫及。”
Even urgent dispatches travelling six hundred li a day fell hopelessly behind.


最明显的实例是，曾纪泽从俄国打回来的电报，到上海只需一天，而上海至北京，由轮船传递，要六、七天，
The clearest example was a telegram from Zeng Jize in Russia: it took only one day to reach Shanghai, but another six or seven days to reach Beijing by steamer.

如果海道不通，由陆路驿递，最快也得十天，
If the sea route was unavailable, even the fastest overland relay required ten days.

“是上海至京仅二千数百里，较之俄国至上海数万里反迟十倍。”
Thus the two-thousand-odd li from Shanghai to Beijing took ten times as long as the tens of thousands of li from Russia to Shanghai.

电报的灵捷，真令人梦想不到。
The telegraph's speed was almost beyond imagination.

至于军务上的用途，李鸿章举大沽北塘海口炮台至天津的军报为例，说是“号召各营，顷刻响应。”
For its military value, Li cited the line from the Dagu and Beitang forts to Tianjin: orders could summon the various camps and receive responses in moments.

这两句话对醇亲王来说，真有莫大的魅力，
Those words held immense appeal for Prince Chun.

全力支持李鸿章的要求，亦即是接纳了盛宣怀的策划，
He fully supported Li's request, thereby accepting Sheng's plan.

决定建设天津至上海的陆路电线，当然是委任盛宣怀负责筹备。
The Tianjin–Shanghai landline was approved, with Sheng naturally placed in charge of preparations.


其时他在招商局舞弊的案子，已将发作，
The China Merchants fraud was then about to erupt.

盛宣怀看得很清楚，筹办内陆电报一事办成功，可以将功折罪，
Sheng understood that successful construction of the inland telegraph could earn enough merit to offset his offences.

但必须从速进行，而且要诸端并举，头绪搞得非常复杂，非由他一手经理，换个人就无从措手不及，
But he had to move quickly and begin many activities simultaneously, making the undertaking so complicated that only he could manage it and a replacement would be unable to take hold.

因为那一来即令有了处分，亦不能马上执行。
Even if a penalty were imposed, it could not then be enforced immediately.

只要一拖下来，等大功告成，李鸿章奏请奖叙，自然可以抵消原有的处分。
If enforcement of the penalty could be delayed until the enterprise succeeded, Li could request a reward that would cancel it.

因此，盛宣怀首先在天津设立电报总局，
Sheng therefore established the General Telegraph Administration at Tianjin.

奉到总办的差委外，立刻到上海聘请丹麦教席，在天津开办电报学堂，同时向外洋采买机器。
On receiving appointment as its director, he immediately went to Shanghai to engage Danish instructors, opened a telegraph school in Tianjin, and ordered machinery abroad.

三天一个禀帖，五天一个条陈，把场面搞得非常热闹。
Reports every three days and proposals every five created a tremendous appearance of activity.

至于最要紧的勘察线路，却不妨慢慢进行，
The most important task, surveying the route, could proceed more slowly.

他知道这件事很麻烦，不愿一上来便遭遇一片反对的声浪，
He knew it would be troublesome and did not wish to provoke a chorus of opposition at the outset.

且等机器买到了，人也训练好了，诸事就绪，就差架线，
Better to wait until the equipment had arrived, the personnel were trained, and everything was ready except the wires.

那时用一道上谕，责成沿路各省督抚实力奉行，自然畅通无阻。
An imperial decree could then require the governors and viceroys along the route to carry the project through in earnest, removing every obstruction.


胡雪岩料事，一向总有七八分把握，
Hu's judgments were usually seven or eight parts certain.

在他以为盛宣怀这一关就算能过得去，“电报总局总办”这个差使，一定不保。
He believed that even if Sheng survived the immediate crisis, he would certainly lose his directorship of the General Telegraph Administration.

哪知这一回的预料，完全落空。
This time, however, his prediction failed completely.

依然是徐用仪那里来的消息，刘坤一的奏折，让慈禧太后塞在抽斗里了。
The news again came through Xu Yongyi: Cixi had put Liu's memorial away in a drawer.

凡是外省的奏折，由各省驻京的“提塘官”直接送交内奏事处，用黄匣呈送御前。
Provincial memorials were delivered by the provinces' capital dispatch officers directly to the Inner Memorial Office, which presented them to the sovereign in yellow boxes.

目前是送到长春宫由慈禧太后先看，
At present they went to the Palace of Eternal Spring for Cixi to read first.

在软而厚的折子上，用指甲掐出记号，内奏事处的太临看掐痕用朱笔代批，不外乎“知道了”、“该部知道”、“交议”，以及请安折子上批一个“安”字之类。
She marked the thick, soft paper with her fingernail, and the office's eunuchs interpreted the marks and wrote the appropriate responses in vermilion: “Noted,” “Let the ministry take note,” “Refer for deliberation,” or, on a memorial inquiring after her health, simply “Peace.”

凡是重要事件，一定“交议”，亦就是交军机处议奏，
Important matters were invariably referred to the Grand Council for deliberation and a report.

在第二天一清早发交值班的军机章京，名为“早事“。
They were handed to the secretary on duty early the next morning as “morning business.”

奏折留中，”早事“不下，军机处根本不知有此一折，自然也就无从催问，
If a memorial was retained in the palace and never came down with the morning business, the Grand Council had no official knowledge of it and could not inquire after it.

当然也可以假作不知，故意不问。
Of course, its members could also pretend ignorance and deliberately refrain from asking.

盛宣怀在军机处都打点到了，所以绝无人谈论刘坤一有这么一个复奏。
Sheng had paid his way throughout the Council, so nobody mentioned Liu's reply at all.

能使得慈禧太后作此釜底抽薪的措施，有人说是李莲英的功劳。
Some attributed Cixi's decisive suppression of the case to Li Lianying.

但据徐用仪说，却得力于醇王的庇护，而醇王的肯出大力，主要还是盛宣怀那三寸不烂之舌厉害。
Xu, however, said it was Prince Chun's protection that had made the difference; and the prince had exerted himself chiefly because of Sheng's formidable powers of persuasion.


由于李莲英的保荐，醇王特地在宣武门内太平湖的府邸接见盛宣怀。
On Li Lianying's recommendation, Prince Chun received Sheng at his residence by Taiping Lake inside Xuanwu Gate.

原来从光绪皇帝接位以后，醇王是“皇帝本生爷”的身分，
Since Guangxu's accession, Chun had occupied the sensitive position of the emperor's natural father.

大家怕他以“太上皇”自居，所以近支亲贵及朝中重臣，都认为他不宜过问政务，
Fearing that he might behave like a retired emperor, close imperial relatives and senior ministers had agreed that he should not participate in government.

投闲置散，只管着神机营，
He had been left with little to do beyond commanding the Shenji Camp.

六。六年下来，不免静极思动。
After six years of inactivity, he naturally longed for action.

如今慈安太后驾崩，慈槽太后大权独揽，而恭王当政二十年，已有倦勤的模样，
Now Ci'an was dead, Cixi held sole power, and Prince Gong, after twenty years at the centre of government, seemed weary of his responsibilities.

看样子起而代之的日子已不会远。
Chun's opportunity to replace him appeared near.

一旦接了军机处，必定同时也接总理衙门，
If he took over the Grand Council, he would surely take over the Zongli Yamen too.

当今政事，最要紧的是洋务，
Foreign affairs were the most pressing business of the day.

听说盛宣怀在这方面是个难得的人才，又听说电报是最得力的“耳目”，
He had heard that Sheng possessed unusual ability in this field, and that the telegraph was an exceptionally effective means of seeing and hearing at a distance.

究竟如侗得力？却还茫然不解，
How it worked remained obscure to him.

因而听得李鸿章谈起盛宣怀的能干，以及筹办电报总局如何尽心尽力，当即欣然表示：“我很想找他来谈一谈。”
When Li Hongzhang praised Sheng's ability and tireless preparations for the telegraph administration, Chun readily said he would like to talk to him.

盛宣怀以前虽没有见过醇王，但醇王信任的一个门客“张师爷”，却早为盛宣怀所结纳，
Sheng had never met the prince, but had long cultivated a trusted retainer, Secretary Zhang.

逢年过节，必有礼物，不一定贵重，但样数很多，而且常常有新奇之物，显得情意殷勤。
Gifts arrived at every festival and New Year: not necessarily expensive, but numerous, varied, and often novel, displaying attentive goodwill.

张师爷对盛宣怀颇有好感，所以在他未见醇王以前，特别关照两点。
Zhang therefore liked him and gave him two special warnings before the audience.

第一，醇王跟恭王不同，恭王认为中国要跟西洋学，醇王不以为中国人不如洋人。
First, Chun differed from Gong: Gong believed China must learn from the West, whereas Chun did not believe Chinese people inferior to foreigners.

第二，醇王虽然好武，但自己觉得书也读得很好，诗文都不差，
Second, although Chun loved military matters, he also considered himself well read and accomplished in poetry and prose.

所以说话时要当心，千万不能让他觉得人家以为他但明武略，并无文采。
Sheng must take care not to suggest that he regarded the prince as a soldier without literary distinction.

盛宣怀心领神会，
Sheng understood perfectly.

想起素有往来的工部尚书翁同龢，身为帝师，与醇王走得很近，常常吟诗唱和，
He remembered that Weng Tonghe, Minister of Works and imperial tutor, whom he knew socially, was close to Chun and often exchanged poems with him.

便去抄了些醇王的诗稿来，念熟了好几着，以备“不时之需”。
He obtained copies of several of the prince's poems and learned them thoroughly against possible need.

在府中抚松草堂，大礼谒见了醇王，自然是站着回话，略略报了覆历，静听醇王发问。
At Fusong Cottage in the princely residence, he performed the full ceremonial greeting, remained standing to answer questions, briefly recounted his career, and waited for the prince to speak.


“那电报到底是怎么回事？”
“What exactly is this telegraph?”

“回王爷的话，电报本身并没有什么了不起，
“Your Highness, there is nothing extraordinary about the apparatus itself.

全靠活用，
Everything depends on how it is used.

所谓‘运用之妙，存乎一心’，
As the saying goes, ‘The art of effective deployment lies in the mind.’

如此而已。”
That is all.”

醇王听他能引用岳武穆的话，不免另眼相看，便即问说：
Hearing him quote Yue Fei, the prince regarded him with fresh respect.

“你也读过兵书？”
“Have you studied military writings too?”

“在王爷面前，怎么敢说读过兵书？
“Before Your Highness, how could I claim to have studied them?

不过英法内犯，文宗显皇帝西狩，忧国忧民，竟至于驾崩。
But when the British and French invaded, Emperor Xianfeng fled the capital on an imperial “hunt” and died under the weight of his concern for the country and its people.

那里如果不是王爷伸武，力擒三凶，大局真不堪设想了。”
Had Your Highness not displayed your martial power and seized the three villains, the consequences would have been unimaginable.”

盛宣怀略停一下又说：
Sheng paused.

“那时有血气的人，谁不想湔雪国耻，
“Who with any spirit did not then wish to wipe away the national humiliation?

宣怀也就是在那时候，自不量力，看过一两部兵书。”
It was at that time that I, presumptuously enough, read one or two books on war.”

所谓“力擒三凶”，是指“辛酉政变”时，
The seizure of the three villains referred to the Xinyou coup.

醇王受密命在热河回銮途中，夜擒肃顺，到京以后，又主持逮捕怡亲王载垣、郑亲王端华，
Acting on secret orders, Chun had captured Sushun at night on the return journey from Rehe, then directed the arrests of Prince Yi, Zaiyuan, and Prince Zheng, Duanhua, in Beijing.

那是醇王早年很得意的事，听盛宣怀提到，不由得就面露笑容了。
These were among the proudest achievements of his youth, and the reminder brought a smile to his face.

“宣怀在想，当年英法内犯时，如果也象去年那样，由大沽口到天津架设了电线，大局就完全不同了。”
Sheng continued, “I have often thought that if a telegraph line had existed between Dagu and Tianjin during the invasion, as it did last year, the whole situation would have been different.”

“喔，”醇王很注意地问：
“Indeed?” Chun asked attentively.

“你倒说其中的道理。”
“Explain why.”


“有了电报，就是敌暗我明了。
“With telegraphy, the enemy would be in the dark while we possessed clear intelligence.

兵贵神速，制胜的要诀在‘出其不意，攻其不备’，
Speed is essential in war, and victory depends on striking unexpectedly at an unprepared opponent.

洋人刚刚上岸，两眼漆黑，全靠他的器械精良，往前硬闯。
The foreigners, newly landed, knew nothing of the situation and simply forced their way forward with superior weapons.

可是他的耳目不灵，就可以智取，
Their poor intelligence would have allowed us to outwit them.

譬如他们有多少人？枪炮有多少？打算往哪一路进攻？我们打听好了，发电报过来，就可以在险要之处，部署埋伏，杀他个片甲不回。
Once we discovered their numbers, their guns, and their intended route, a telegram could bring the information, allowing us to prepare an ambush at a strategic position and destroy them utterly.”

““啊，
“Ah!

啊！”
Ah!”

醇王不断握拳，仿佛不胜扼腕似地。
The prince repeatedly clenched his fists, as though overcome by regret.

“僧忠亲王的神武，天下闻名，
“Prince Sengge Rinchen's martial prowess was renowned throughout the realm,” Sheng went on.

八里桥那一仗，非战之罪，
“The defeat at Palikao was no failure of generalship.

当时如果有电报，洋人决不能侥幸。”
Had telegraphs existed, the foreigners could never have enjoyed such luck.”

“我想想。”
“Let me think.”

醇王闭上眼，过了好一会才睁开来，
Chun closed his eyes for a considerable time.

“照你的说法，洋人的兵轮来了，如果炮台挡不住，一上了岸，行踪就完全在我掌握之中，简直是寸步难行了？”
“According to you, if their warships came and our forts could not stop them, once they landed we should know all their movements and make it almost impossible for them to advance?”

“是！
“Exactly!

王爷真是明见万里，
Your Highness sees far indeed.

有了电报，不但洋人内犯，寸步难行，就是海口的炮台也挡得住。
With telegraphy, not only would invading foreigners be unable to move freely; our coastal forts could stop them in the first place.

譬如说，登州到大沽口，沿线如果有电报，就可以把洋人兵轮的方向、大小，还有天气好坏，逐段报了过来，
If there were a line from Dengzhou to Dagu, for example, reports could pass along it concerning the direction and size of their warships and the weather.

以逸待劳，有备无息，
Rested and prepared, we could await them.

哪里会有挡不住的道理？”
How could we fail to hold them off?”

“嗯，嗯。
“Yes, yes.

这道理也通。”醇王问道：
That makes sense too.

“电报还有什么用处？”
What other uses does it have?”


“用处要自己想，
“One must think of uses for oneself.

中国人的脑筋比洋人好，所以想得到的用处比洋人多。
Chinese minds are better than foreign minds, so we can devise more uses than they can.

不过利用电报也可以做坏事，
But telegraphy can also serve evil purposes.

所以请王爷千万记住，将来管电报的人，一定要是王爷信得过的亲信。
Your Highness must therefore remember that whoever controls it must be someone you trust completely.”

““喔，”醇王问道：“怎么能用电报做坏事？”
“How can it be used for evil?”

“要防到捏造消息。”盛宣怀说，
“We must guard against fabricated news.

“打仗的时候，谎报军情，是件不得了的事。”
False military intelligence in wartime would be a terrible matter.”

“说得不错，
“Quite right.

这一层倒真要当心。”醇王又问：
That certainly requires care.

“用电报还能做什么坏事？”
What other harm could it do?”

“有。”
“There is another example.”

盛宣怀想了一下，
Sheng considered for a moment.

“我说个笑话给玉爷听。”
“Let me tell Your Highness an amusing story.”


在他人看是笑话，身历其境的人却是俗哭无泪。
It might amuse an outsider; the victim had suffered too bitterly even to weep.

数年前有个姓胡的候补道，被派到外国去当参赞，
Some years earlier, an expectant circuit intendant surnamed Hu was sent abroad as a diplomatic counsellor.

无意间得罪了同僚，一个姓吕的庶务，在使馆经手采买，营私舞弊，
He inadvertently offended a colleague named Lü, who handled administrative purchases at the legation and was making fraudulent private profits.

为胡参赞在不经意中所揭发，
Counsellor Hu exposed this without intending to.

于是公使以此人“水土不服”为理由，奏请调遣回国，仍回原省候补。
The minister consequently requested Lü's recall on the pretext that he could not adjust to the climate, asking that he return to await appointment in his original province.

京中照准的公事一到，吕庶务方知其事，
Lü learned of it only when approval arrived from Beijing.

私下打听，才知道是吃了胡参赞的亏，自然恨之入骨。
Private inquiries revealed that Hu was responsible, and he hated him deeply.

这姓吕的城府极深，表面声色不动，
A man of considerable cunning, Lü showed nothing.

对胡参赞的态度，一如平时，仿佛根本就不知道他之回国，是由于胡参赞多嘴的缘故。
His manner towards Hu remained unchanged, as though he had no idea that Hu's indiscretion had caused his return.

临时之时，问胡参赞是否要带家信？
Before leaving, he asked whether Hu wished to send a family letter.

万里重洋，难得有便人回国，使馆同事都托他带家信，带物品，
With oceans between them and home, a trustworthy returning traveller was rare; all the other members of the legation entrusted him with letters and gifts.

胡参赞如果独成例外，显得彼此例象有什么芥蒂似地，
For Hu alone to abstain would suggest some grievance between them.

所以也写了家信，另外还买了两个表，托他顺便带回国去转寄。
He therefore wrote home and bought two watches for Lü to forward after reaching China.

姓吕的是捐班知县，原在江苏候补，
Lü had purchased eligibility for a county magistracy and originally awaited appointment in Jiangsu.

胡参赞家住吴江，密迩苏州，
Hu's family lived at Wujiang, close to Suzhou.

因此，信上虽写了吴江的地址，并且关照只需托民信局转递即可，而姓吕的情意殷勤，特为跑了一趟吴江，拜见胡参赞的封翁，
Although the letter bore their Wujiang address and Hu had said a private postal agency could deliver it, Lü made a special journey to visit Hu's father.

大谈异国风光。
He talked at length about foreign lands.

胡封翁心系远人，得到这些亲切珍贵的信息，自然很高兴，也很感激，写给胡参赞的家信中，对这位“吕公”盛赞不已。
Concerned for his distant son, the elder Hu was delighted and grateful for this intimate, precious news, and praised “Mr Lü” extravagantly in his letters to Counsellor Hu.

姓吕的得暇便去看胡封翁，走动得很勤。
Lü visited whenever he had leisure; the calls became frequent.

胡参赞也常跟姓吕的通信，竟结成了至好。
Counsellor Hu also corresponded with him regularly, and they became close friends.

此人之谋报复，是一开头就打定了主意的，
Yet Lü had intended revenge from the beginning.

但采取什么手段，却需看情况，视机会而走。
Only its method remained to be chosen according to circumstances and opportunity.

不过他也深知情况愈了解，机会就愈容易找的道理，
He understood that the better he knew the household, the easier an opening would be to find.

认为只要常去胡家，熟悉了全家上下，就一定会有机会。
By visiting often and becoming familiar with everyone, he was certain to obtain one.

果然，机会来了。
Eventually he did.


这机会其实也就是利用他所了解的情况，
The opportunity arose from what he had learned.

胡封翁在家具有绝对的权威地位，全家亦无不重视“老太爷”的一言一动，
The elder Hu exercised absolute authority at home, and the whole family attached enormous importance to his every word and movement.

有一次胡封翁“发痧”，这不是什么大不了的事，但已闹得天翻地覆。
Once he developed a minor ailment known as sha, and the household was thrown into an uproar.

姓吕的看在眼里，不由得在肚子里做功夫。
Lü observed this and began devising a plan.

几经考虑，定下了一计，只是要等，等胡封翁生病。
After much consideration, he settled on one; now he needed only to wait for the old man to fall ill.

两年前的夏天，天时不正，疫流行，胡家病倒了好几个人，
Two summers earlier, unusual weather brought an epidemic, and several members of the Hu household became sick.

胡封翁并未感染时疫，
The old man did not catch the disease.

只是年纪大了，看家有病人，且不只一个，内心不免抑郁，因而眠食不安，精神大不如前。
But age and anxiety over several ailing relatives left him depressed, sleeping and eating poorly, and much weakened in spirit.

姓吕的便写了一封极恳切的信给胡参赞，细述胡封翁的颓唐老境，却又劝慰胡参赞，
Lü wrote an earnest letter to Counsellor Hu, describing his father's declining condition in detail while offering reassurance.

“为国宣劳，自有天助”，
A man serving his country would receive Heaven's help, he said.

全家孝顺，对老人照顾得极周到，何况还有朋友在，缓急之济，必当全力相助，
The family was devoted and cared for the old gentleman attentively; friends were available too, and he himself would do everything possible in an emergency.

胡参赞大可放心。
Hu need not worry.

估量这封信已寄到了胡参赞手里，同时判断胡参赞亦已接到家信，所述胡封翁的情形，跟他的话绝无矛盾时，他发了一个电报，只有八个字：“老伯病故，
When he judged that this letter had arrived, and that family letters describing the same condition would also have reached Hu, he sent an eight-character telegram: “Your father has died.

速定行止。”
Decide your return at once.”

胡参赞自然深信不疑，
Naturally, Hu believed it.

所谓“速定行止”，意思是催他回来奔丧。
The instruction meant that he should hurry home for the funeral.

胡参赞便向公使陈明，公使电奏：参赞丁忧，请予开缺。并声明派何人代理参赞的职务。
He informed the minister, who telegraphed a memorial requesting that the counsellor's post be declared vacant because he must enter mourning, and naming an acting replacement.

哪知电奏到达上海之日，姓吕的又发了一个电报，更正前电。
On the very day that telegram reached Shanghai, Lü sent another telegram correcting his earlier message.

可是已经奏了丁忧开缺，却无法更正。
But the report of bereavement and vacancy had already been memorialized and could not be undone.

胡参赞吃了一个哑巴亏，
Hu had to swallow the injury.

只有请公使备文呈报总理衙门，转咨吏部备案，
His only remedy was to ask the minister to submit an explanatory document to the Zongli Yamen for transmission to the Ministry of Personnel and preservation on file.

否则将来到了胡封翁寿终正寝时，胡参赞连发丧守制都不能，那才真的成了空前绝后的笑话。
Otherwise, when his father really died, he would be unable even to announce the death and observe mourning—an unprecedented absurdity indeed.


醇王由于这个笑话的启发，想到了许多事该警惕，
The story suggested many dangers to Chun.

“水能载舟，亦能覆舟，
“Water can carry a boat, but it can also overturn it.

电报亦是如此，
The telegraph is the same.

非得托付给很妥当的人不可，否则机密容易外泄。”他说：
It must be entrusted to thoroughly reliable men, or secrets will easily leak.

“疆臣窥探朝廷意旨，尚且不可，
Provincial authorities should not even pry into the court's intentions.

何况廷寄未到，已先有所知，得以事先弥缝，
How much worse if they learn of an imperial dispatch before it arrives and can conceal their faults beforehand!

那一来朝廷的号令不行，国将不国，
The court's orders would become ineffective, and the country would cease to function as a state.

太可握了。”听得这话，盛宣怀以言多必失自警，
A terrifying prospect.” Sheng warned himself that too much talk could lead to a mistake.

同时觉得有消除醇王的恐惧，只让他想到电报的好处的必要。
He must dispel the prince's fears and leave him thinking only of the telegraph's advantages.

于是他略想一想答说：“王爷想得深、想得透，不是我们知识浅薄的人所能及。
After a moment, he replied, “Your Highness's insight is deeper and more penetrating than anything men of limited knowledge like ourselves could attain.

不过由王爷的开示，宣怀倒想起西洋的一个法子，
Yet your instruction reminds me of a Western method.

不知道有用没有用？”
I do not know whether it might be useful.”

“什么法子？”
“What method?”


“就是密码。”盛宣怀答说：
“Cipher,” Sheng replied.

“现在汉字的电报，每个字四码，
“In the present Chinese telegraph system, every character has a four-digit code.

有现成的书，照码译字，
There is a published book by which the numbers can be turned back into characters.

那是明码，
That is an open code.

如果事先约走，码子怎么拿它变化一下，譬如加多少码，或者减多少码，只有彼此知道，机密就不容易外泄了。”
If the correspondents agree beforehand to alter the numbers—adding or subtracting a certain amount known only to themselves—their secrets are much less likely to escape.”

“原来还有这个法子！”醇王问道：
“So there is such a method!

“这个加码、减码的法子，是不是跟”套格‘差不多？
Is adding and subtracting rather like using a cipher grille?”

““比‘套格’方便得多了。”
“Much more convenient.”

所谓“套格”是挖出若干空格的一张厚纸。
A cipher grille was a piece of thick paper with openings cut in it.

使用的方法是，通信双方预先约定，用多大的纸、每页几行、每行几字，
The correspondents first agreed on the size of the writing paper, the number of lines on each page, and the number of characters per line.

其次是看用哪种套格，挖空的位置在何处？
They also agreed which grille to use and where its openings would fall.

然后就要花心思了，
Then came the difficult work.

犹如科场考试的“关节”那样，把要说的一两句话，嵌在一大篇不相干的废话之中。
Like the concealed signals used in examination fraud, the one or two sentences that mattered had to be embedded in a long passage of irrelevant writing.

收信的人，将套格在原信上一覆，空格中露出来的字，连缀成文，就是对方要说的话。
The recipient placed the grille over the letter and joined the characters visible through its openings to recover the message.

“套格”确有保密的功效，但用起来很不方便，
It did preserve secrecy, but was inconvenient.

第一，必得肚子里有墨水，嵌字贵乎嵌得很自然，不用套格绝不知其中的奥妙，
First, the writer needed literary skill: the concealed characters had to fit so naturally that nobody without the grille would suspect their purpose.

第二，是不能畅所欲言，
Second, it severely restricted expression.

数百言的一封长函中，也许只说得五六句话。
A letter of several hundred characters might convey only five or six sentences.

“比较起来，加码、减码就方便得大多了。”盛宣怀又说。
“Addition and subtraction are far more convenient,” Sheng continued.

“还有一层，
“There is another advantage.

套格一定要预先做好，送交对方，
A grille has to be made in advance and delivered to the other person.

加码减码，只要先有一句话的约定，可以做成好多密码本，
With addition and subtraction, a single prior agreement can establish several different cipher systems.

当然头两个字要用明码，不然对方就不知道要用哪一个密码本了。“
Naturally, the first two characters must be sent in the open code, or the recipient will not know which cipher book to use.”


“这话我不大懂。”
“I do not quite understand.

盛宣怀字杏苏，醇王很客气地称他，“杏翁，请你说清楚一点儿。”
Please explain more clearly, Mr Xingsun,” the prince said courteously, addressing him by his courtesy name.

“是。
“Yes, Your Highness.

譬如说吧，王爷交代我‘天地玄黄’四个密码本，
Suppose you assign me four cipher books called Tian, Di, Xuan, and Huang.

实际上是交代一句活，‘天’字减一百二，‘地’字减三百三。‘玄，字加一百二，’黄‘字加三百三。
In practice, a single instruction will suffice: for Tian, subtract one hundred and twenty; for Di, subtract three hundred and thirty; for Xuan, add one hundred and twenty; for Huang, add three hundred and thirty.

到得王爷给我密码时，头两个明码是’地密‘，我就知道，下面所有的数码都要减三百三十，
If your message begins with the two openly coded characters Di Mi, I know that I must subtract three hundred and thirty from every number that follows.

原码一千五百八十九。其实是一千二百五十九，
A transmitted number of 1,589 therefore means 1,259.

找到这个码子的字，才是王爷要用的字。”
The character assigned to that number is the one Your Highness intends.”

“那么，旁人只要知道了加减多少，密码不就不密了吗？”
“But if someone learns how much to add or subtract, is the cipher not exposed?”

“是，是！
“Exactly!

王爷一语破的。”盛宣怀答说：
Your Highness has put your finger on the point.

“所以最保密的办法，就是自己编一本密码本，不按部首，随意乱编。
The most secure method is therefore to compile a private codebook, arranging the characters at random instead of by their radicals.

这个密码本一样也可以加减数码，
Addition and subtraction can still be applied to its numbers.

密上加密，就更保险了。”接着盛宣怀又讲了许多使用电报的方法与诀窍，
One layer of secrecy reinforces another.” Sheng then explained numerous other methods and conveniences of telegraphy.

譬如象“洪状元”——洪钧发明的韵目代日，配合十二地支，
The top examination graduate Hong Jun, for example, had devised a way to represent days by rhyme headings, combined with the twelve earthly branches for months.

用两个字来表明月日，如“寅东”就是正月初一，正月建寅，东为“一东”，
Two characters could thus express a date: Yin Dong meant the first day of the first month, since the first month corresponded to Yin and Dong was the first rhyme heading.

当然也可以再加上时辰，
The hour could also be added.

“寅东寅”为正月初一寅时，
Yin Dong Yin meant the first day of the first month at the Yin hour.

第二个寅字与第一个寅字的用法不同，一望而知，不会弄错。
The final Yin served a different function from the first, evident at a glance, so there was no confusion.


“听君一席话，胜读十年书。”
“A conversation with you is worth ten years of study!”

醇王完全为电报着迷了，“杏翁，”他说：“你能不能把电报怎么发、怎么收，演练给我看看？”
Completely fascinated, Chun asked, “Mr Xingsun, could you demonstrate how a telegram is sent and received?”

“王爷怎么说‘能不能’？
“Your Highness need not ask whether I can.

王爷吩咐，宣怀自然遵办，
If you command it, I shall naturally obey.

不过先得预备预备。”
I merely need a little time to prepare.”

“要预备多少日子？”
“How many days?”

看他迫不及待的模样，盛宣怀计算了一下，允以五日为期。
Seeing his impatience, Sheng calculated the requirements and promised a demonstration in five days.

辞出王府，立即遣派专人到天津，调了两名电报学堂的教习，带同得力学生及工匠，运用收发报机、发电机之类，
Immediately after leaving the residence, he sent a special messenger to Tianjin to summon two instructors from the telegraph school, capable students, and workmen, together with transmitting and receiving apparatus and a generator.

在醇王府中，临时架线，布置妥当，恰好是第五天自设的期限。
A temporary line was erected in the residence, and everything was ready on the fifth day, precisely within his promised time.

醇王府的范围很广，
The grounds were extensive.

花园题名“适园”，正厅名为“颐寿堂”，是恭王所题，
The garden was called Shiyuan, the Garden of Contentment; its main hall, Yishou Hall, bore a name bestowed by Prince Gong.

内悬同治后帝御笔“宣德七德”的匾额。
Inside hung a plaque in the Tongzhi emperor's own calligraphy, reading “Xuande Qide.”

这是极严肃的所在，堂前立有“神杆”，不便再设电杆，
This was a solemn place, with a sacred pole in front, where it would be inappropriate to erect a telegraph pole.

所以在颐寿堂后拉线，一端通往堂东的风月双清楼，一端通往抚松草堂。
The wire was therefore run behind the hall, linking Fengyue Shuangqing Tower to its east with Fusong Cottage.

醇王自己在风月双清楼写了一通很长的电码交发，
At the tower, Chun himself prepared a long coded message and handed it in for transmission.

盛宣怀亲自在抚松草堂照料，收到电码，交由丙名学生分译。
Sheng supervised at Fusong Cottage, where the incoming numbers were given to two students to decode.


这两个学生程度很不坏，电码更是熟得不需翻书，便能识字，
The students were accomplished enough to recognize the telegraph codes without consulting a book.

一个念，一个写。
One read aloud while the other wrote.

盛宣怀站在他们身后细看，只见写的是：“京华盛冠盖，车马纷长衙，
Standing behind them, Sheng watched the following emerge: “In the capital, hats and carriages abound; horses and vehicles crowd the long official avenues.

十日黄尘中，女足女足意不舒，
Ten days amid the yellow dust, woman-foot, woman-foot, my spirit ill at ease.

何期朝事繁，忽见林壑疏，
Who could have expected, amid the press of court affairs, suddenly to find these open woods and valleys?

朱邪开名园，别在城西隅，
Vermilion gates reveal a famous garden, set apart in the city's western corner.

东风二三月，杂花千万株，
In the east wind of the second and third months, countless trees bear mingled blossoms.

俯檐弄嘉禽，出沼窥文鱼，
Beneath the eaves one plays with lovely birds; beside the pool one peers at patterned fish.

追陪竟日夕，暂欲忘簪据。
In company through day and evening, for a while I would forget the trappings of office.

此少荃相国春日游适园诗也。
This is Grand Secretary Shaochuan's poem on visiting Shiyuan in spring.

即录送风月双清楼。
Copied here and sent to Fengyue Shuangqing Tower.

九思堂主人。”
The Master of Jiusi Hall.”

“少茶相同”指李鸿章，“九思堂主人”是醇王的别署，
Grand Secretary Shaochuan was Li Hongzhang, and the Master of Jiusi Hall was Prince Chun's literary name.

都容易明白，
Those references were clear enough.

然而“女足女足意不舒”这句诗竟不成话说了。
But the line “woman-foot, woman-foot, my spirit ill at ease” made no sense.

盛宣怀便指着字面问：
Sheng pointed to it.

“这是不是错了？”
“Is this a mistake?”

“不错。”
“No.”

“可是意思不通。”
“But the meaning is unintelligible.”

笔录的那学生想了一下，将“女足女足”四字涂去，另写了“娖娖”二字。
The student holding the brush thought for a moment, struck out the four component characters, and replaced them with the two characters pronounced chuochuo.

盛宣怀恍然大悟，
Sheng suddenly understood.

六千八百九十九字的“电报新书”中，并无“龊”字，所以醇王用测字法，写成“女足”。
The required character was absent from the 6,899-character New Telegraph Codebook, so the prince had split it into its “woman” and “foot” components for transmission.

这是不得已，但也是情理中的一个小小的变通办法，
It was a small, sensible improvisation forced by necessity.

醇王对于自己初次使用电报，遇到难题，而能应变，且为人所接受，证明他的变通办法是行得通的这一点，非常得意。
Chun was extremely pleased that, on his first use of the telegraph, he had overcome a difficulty in a way others could understand.

同时电报在他的感觉中，不仅是可靠的，也是可亲的了。
The instrument now seemed not merely dependable but congenial.


这使他记起许多往事，有些得自传闻，有些则是亲身的经历。
It brought many things to mind, some heard from others and some experienced personally.

清宫中对秘密通讯的方法，一向重视，
Secret communication had always mattered greatly within the Qing palace.

尤其是在得失荣辱，甚至生死存亡，决于俄顷的紧要关头，能够运用独特的秘密通信方法，或者知患未然，或者求得外援，
At moments when gain or loss, honour or disgrace, even life or death could be decided in an instant, a distinctive method of sending confidential messages might provide warning of danger or secure outside assistance.

那出入是太大了。
The difference could be enormous.

在他的记忆中，早年听说过康熙未年夺嫡的许多故事，
Chun remembered stories of the struggle for the succession late in the Kangxi reign.

有的使用“矾书”，有的用罗马字代替满洲话的“字头”来拼音，
Some conspirators had used invisible alum writing; others had used Roman letters to represent Manchu syllables.

“九阿哥”胤■的门客中，有一个是“东正教”的教士，因而发明了用俄文拼音来表达满洲话，传递反抗雍正的信息，
Among the Ninth Prince's retainers was an Orthodox Christian cleric, and a method had consequently been devised for expressing Manchu sounds through Russian writing to transmit messages opposing Yongzheng.

虽为雍正截获了，却不知说些什么？因而胤■所部署的“造反”的策略，始终是个谜。
Although Yongzheng intercepted them, he could not understand them, and the Ninth Prince's plans for rebellion remained a mystery.

醇王亲身所经历的是“辛酉政变”。
Chun's own experience was the Xinyou coup.

那时肃顺等人将两宫太后与诸王隔离开来，尤其是对恭王，监视更严，
Sushun and his associates had separated the two empress dowagers from the princes, keeping Prince Gong under especially strict surveillance.

以至于不得已用太监安德海使一条苦肉计，伪装他犯了严重的过失，痛责一顿板子，打发回京，
They had therefore resorted to a painful deception involving the eunuch An Dehai: he was made to appear guilty of a grave offence, severely beaten, and sent back to Beijing.

实际上是携带两宫太后的密旨，面交恭王。
In reality he carried the empress dowagers' secret instructions to Gong.

如果当时有电报，能用密码通信，调遣神机营到热河“勤王”，可以堂而皇之地逮捕“三凶”，
Had telegraphy and cipher communication existed, the Shenji Camp could have been summoned to Rehe to protect the sovereign, and the three villains arrested openly.

根本就不必他半夜里带人到旅舍，将肃顺从他的姨太太身边接起来那种有欠光明磊落的手段。
Chun would not have needed the less than honourable expedient of leading men to an inn at midnight and hauling Sushun away from his concubine.


就这样，由于醇王直接向慈禧太后进言，
Prince Chun accordingly spoke directly to Cixi.

说盛宣怀同前总办电报局的差使，极其要紧，且亦无人替代，
Sheng's work as director of the telegraph administration was extremely important, he said, and nobody could replace him.

不宜对他有所处分。
He should not be punished.

而况就算他有过失，能将电报办好了，亦足以将功折罪。
Even if he had committed offences, successfully establishing the telegraph would provide merit sufficient to offset them.

同时李莲英亦一再说盛宣怀如何有良心，一定会感恩图报，如何能干，可资以为耳目，
Li Lianying repeatedly added that Sheng had a conscience, would certainly repay imperial favour with gratitude, and possessed abilities that could make him a valuable source of intelligence.

终于使得慈禧太后决定将刘坤一的奏折“留中不发”，
Cixi finally decided to retain Liu Kunyi's memorial without issuing it.

只是由总理衙门给了北洋一道咨文，饬令盛宣怀不得干预招商局局务。
The Zongli Yamen merely sent an official communication to the Northern administration ordering Sheng not to interfere in China Merchants' affairs.

获知了这些内幕，胡雪岩在内心中激起了很大的波澜。
Learning these details profoundly disturbed Hu.

数年以来，他虽看出盛宣怀机诈百出，不是个好惹的人，
For several years he had recognized Sheng's endless cunning and known that he was difficult to deal with.

但总觉得此人还个成气候，无需过虑，
Yet he had thought the man insufficiently established to warrant serious concern.

而此刻他觉得遇到了一个劲敌了。
Now he realized that he faced a formidable opponent.

“将来上海。天津的电报一通，盛杏苏在管这件事，消息比我们灵通，
“Once the Shanghai–Tianjin telegraph is connected, Sheng Xingsun will control it and obtain news more quickly than we do.

已经占先一着。”胡雪岩对汪推贤说：
That already gives him an advantage,” he told Wang Weixian.

“这还在其次、
“But there is something more serious.

更要防他在电报上动手脚，弄些伪消息、伪行情过来，
We must guard against his tampering with telegrams and sending false news or false market quotations.

一相信了它，岂不大上其当。
If we believe them, we shall fall straight into his trap.

这一点，你要格外当心。”
You must be particularly careful.”

“我知道。”汪惟贤答说：
“I understand,” Wang replied.

“电报学堂我也有熟人，
“I know people at the telegraph school too.

到时候我会想办法，也弄它几套密码出来，行情我们自己报。”
When the time comes, I shall find a way to obtain several sets of cipher codes, and we can send our own market reports.”

“不错。
“Exactly.

将来丝的行情，一定要自己报。”
In future, we must transmit our silk prices ourselves.”



胡雪岩
《灯火楼台》第三章（上）
Towers of Light — Chapter Three, Part One
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第三章 元宝街｜CHAPTER THREE: YUANBAO STREET


八月初，在西湖上正是“一年好景君须记，最是橙黄橘绿时”，在上海已略感厌倦于酒绿灯红，脂香粉腻的宝森：为胡雪岩接到了杭州。
Early in the eighth lunar month, when West Lake offered the prospect celebrated in the lines, “Remember the finest scenes of the year: the time when oranges turn yellow and tangerines are green,” Baosen was brought to Hangzhou by Hu Xueyan. He had begun to tire a little of Shanghai’s lights and wine, its perfumes and painted beauties.

他是由古应春陪着来的。
Gu Yingchun accompanied him.

船到望仙桥埠头上早有一乘绿呢、一乘蓝呢的大轿在等候，
When their boat reached the landing at Wangxian Bridge, two large sedan chairs, one covered in green woolen cloth and the other in blue, were already waiting.

另外一匹顶马、两匹跟马，
There were also a horse to lead the procession and two to follow it.

四名兵丁，都穿着布政司的号衣，四散排开，挡住了行人，留出一片空地，容宝森登岸。
Four soldiers in the livery of the Provincial Treasury stood apart, holding back passersby and clearing a space for Baosen to land.

船家将船泊稳，搭好跳板，
The boatmen moored the vessel and laid the gangplank.

船家与岸上胡家的听差合作，伸出一条粗竹杆，捏稳两端，高及腰际，宝森以竹杆作扶手，
Working with Hu’s servants on shore, they held a stout bamboo pole firmly at either end, waist-high, for Baosen to use as a handrail.

自跳板登上埠头，立即便有一个穿是极体面的中年人，含笑迎上前来。
As he stepped ashore, an impeccably dressed middle-aged man came smiling forward.

宝森在上海也见过此人，名叫陶敦甫，字厚斋，捐了个候补知县，作胡雪岩的清客，专责是接待宾客。
Baosen had met him in Shanghai: Tao Dunfu, courtesy name Houzhai, who had purchased the rank of expectant county magistrate and served as a gentleman retainer in Hu’s household, chiefly responsible for receiving guests.


“森二爷到底到了，
“You have come at last, Second Master Sen.

胡大先生盼望了好几天了。
Mr Hu has been looking forward to your arrival for days.

森二爷路上还舒服？”
Was the journey comfortable?”

“舒服得很。”
“Very comfortable.”

宝森舒了口气，游目四顾，看过往辐辏的行人，不由得赞叹：
Baosen drew a contented breath and looked about at the throng of people.

“都说杭州是洞夭福地，
“They call Hangzhou a blessed retreat of the immortals.

真是名不虚传。”
It certainly deserves the name.”

“森二爷只看到今天的热闹，
“You see how lively it is today, Second Master Sen.

哪知道十六七年前满目凄凉，
You cannot imagine the desolation sixteen or seventeen years ago.

惨不忍睹。”
It was unbearable to look at.”

杭州经两度战事，毁坏独重，善后复兴之功，推胡雪岩为首。
Hangzhou had suffered especially grievous destruction in two periods of warfare, and Hu deserved foremost credit for its relief and restoration.

做清客捧宾客以外，亦须不忌捧东主，但以不着痕迹为贵。
Besides flattering guests, a retainer must not shrink from praising his employer; the art lay in leaving no obvious trace.

听得这话，宝森连连点头，
Baosen nodded repeatedly.

“雪岩之有今日、实在是积德之报。”
“Xueyan’s good fortune is truly the reward of accumulated virtue.”

他跟胡雪岩的交情已很厚了，所以径以雪岩相称。
His friendship with Hu had become close enough for him to use Xueyan without further formality.


陶敦甫觑空跟古应春招呼过了，请宝森坐上胡雪岩自用的绿呢大轿，古应春坐蓝呢轿，
Finding a moment to greet Gu, Tao invited Baosen into Hu’s own green-covered chair and Gu into the blue one.

由顶马引导前行，陶敦甫乘一顶小轿自间道先赶往“元宝街”等候。
The lead horse guided them forward, while Tao took a small sedan by a side route to reach Yuanbao Street ahead of them.

“元宝街”满铺青石板，足容四马并行，
The street was paved throughout with blue stone slabs and wide enough for four horses abreast.

街中突起，两头低下，形似元宝，因而得名。
Raised in the middle and lower at either end, it resembled a silver ingot, hence its name, Yuanbao.

不过，胡雪岩当初铺这条街时，却并未想到这个能配合他的“财神”之号的俗气的街名，
When Hu had first laid it out, he had not intended this rather vulgar name, so appropriate to his own title of God of Wealth.

只是为了便于排水，
His purpose had simply been to provide good drainage.

当然，四周的阴沟经过细心修建，畅通无阻，
The surrounding drains had also been carefully constructed and flowed freely.

每遇夏日暴雨，它处积水两三尺，元宝街却只要雨停，便即水消。
After a summer downpour, water might stand two or three chi deep elsewhere, but in Yuanbao Street it disappeared as soon as the rain stopped.

由望仙桥到元宝街，只是一盏茶的工夫，
The journey from Wangxian Bridge took no longer than a cup of tea.

坐在绿呢轿中的宝森，由左右玻璃窗中望出去，只见五，六丈高的一大圈围墙墙脚基石，竞有一人多高。
Through the glass windows on either side of his chair, Baosen saw a vast enclosing wall five or six zhang high, with stone foundations rising above a man’s height.

大轿抬入可容两乘轿子进出的大门，穿过门楼，抬人二门歇轿，
His chair passed through a gateway wide enough for two sedans, beneath the gatehouse, and through the second gate before being set down.

胡雪岩已站在大厅滴水檐前等候了。
Hu was waiting beneath the eaves at the front of the main hall.

“森二爷，”胡雪岩拱拱手说：“一路好吧？”
“A good journey, Second Master Sen?”

“很好，很好。”
“Very good indeed.”

宝森扶着他的手臂，偏着脸细看了一下说：
Resting a hand on Hu’s arm, Baosen tilted his head to study him.

“雪岩，一个多月不见，你又发福了。”
“It has been over a month, Xueyan, and you have grown stouter again.”

“托福，托福。
“Thanks to your good wishes.

请里面坐。”
Please come inside.”

宝森点点头，已把脸仰了起来，
Baosen nodded, his face already turned upward.

倒不是他摆架子不理人，而是因为胡家的厅堂过于宏敞，必须仰着脸才能看清楚。
He was not putting on airs or ignoring his host; the hall was so lofty and spacious that he had to look up to take it in.


未看大厅，先回顾天井，
Before examining the hall, he looked back at the courtyard.

天井有七开间大，而且极深，为的是可以搭台唱戏。
It was seven bays wide and exceptionally deep, allowing room for a stage on theatrical occasions.

大厅当然也是七开间，估计可摆三十桌席。
The hall was likewise seven bays across and could, he estimated, hold thirty banquet tables.

由于高敞之故，堂奥虽深，却很明亮，
Its height made even the deep interior bright.

正中树一方蓝地金底，四周龙纹的大立匾，案巢大书“积菩衍庆”四个黑字，
In the center stood a great upright plaque, blue and gold with dragons around its edges, bearing four large black characters: “Accumulate Goodness, Extend Blessings.”

正中上端一颗大方印，一望即知是御玺，
A large square impression at the upper center was unmistakably an imperial seal.

上下款却因相距得远，看不清楚，不知是慈禧皇太后，还是先帝的御笔。
The inscriptions above and below were too far away to read, so Baosen could not tell whether the calligraphy was Empress Dowager Cixi’s or the late emperor’s.

转眼看去，东西两面板壁上，各悬一方五尺高、丈余宽的紫檀挂屏，
On the eastern and western paneled walls hung two red-sandalwood screens, each five chi high and more than a zhang wide.

西面是一幅青绿山水，东面是贝子奕模写的《滕王阁序》，
The western one showed a blue-and-green landscape; the eastern one bore the Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng, copied by Beizi Yimo.

旁有两扇屏门，料想其中当是家词。
Beside it were two screen doors, beyond which Baosen supposed the family shrine must lie.

旗人向来重礼节，当即表示，理当瞻拜。
Bannermen were always attentive to propriety, and he immediately said that he ought to pay his respects.

胡雪岩自然连称“不敢当”。
Hu protested that he could not presume to accept such an honor.

只是宝森意思诚敬，当下唤人开了屏门，点燃香烛，
Baosen was sincerely insistent, however, so the doors were opened and incense and candles lit.

宝森向神龛中“胡氏列祖神位”恭恭敬敬地磕了三个头，
Before the tablets of the Hu ancestors, Baosen respectfully kowtowed three times.

胡雪岩一旁陪礼，最后又向宝森磕头道谢。
Hu performed the rites at his side, then kowtowed to Baosen in thanks.

“还要见见老太太。”
“I must also call on your honored mother.”

“改天吧！”胡雪岩说：
“Another day, perhaps.

“家母今天到天竺烧香去了。”
My mother has gone to offer incense at Tianzhu today.”

“森二爷刚到，先请歇一歇。”陶敦甫插嘴说道：
Tao intervened. “Second Master Sen has only just arrived. Let him rest a little first.

“我来引路，”
I shall lead the way.”


于是出了大厅，由西面走廓绕出去，往北一折，一带粉墙上开着个月洞门，上榜“芝径”二字，
They left the main hall by the western corridor, turned north, and came to a moon gate in a whitewashed wall, inscribed “Zhijing,” the Path of the Auspicious Herb.

迎门一座玲珑剔透的假山，
An intricate, openwork rockery faced the entrance.

陶敦甫由东面绕了过去，豁然开朗，
Tao went around its eastern side, and suddenly the view opened out.

室森放眼一望，但见树木掩映，楼阁参差，窗子上的五色玻璃，为偏西的日光照耀得光怪陆离，真有目迷五色之感。
Baosen saw towers and pavilions at different heights among the trees, their windows of colored glass catching the declining sunlight in a bewildering play of hues.

“请过桥来！”
“This way across the bridge, please.”

宝森跟着陶敦甫经过一道三曲的石桥，踏上一座极大的白石露台，
Following Tao over a stone bridge with three turns, Baosen reached a broad terrace of white stone.

中间便是三开间大，正方的楠木“四面厅”，
In its center stood a square nanmu building, three bays wide, known as the Four-Sided Hall.

上悬一方黄杨木蓝字的匾额，榜书“迎紫”二字。
A boxwood plaque above it bore the blue characters “Welcoming Purple.”

进门可是一番光景，
Inside was a different scene.

用紫檀隔板，隔出两间大小的一个长方形房间，里面是西式布置，
Red-sandalwood partitions enclosed a rectangular room two bays in size, furnished in Western style.

四周红色丝绒的安乐椅，配着白色髹金漆的茶几，中间一张与茶几同一质料式样的大餐台，上面已摆好了八只纯银的高脚果盘。
Red-velvet armchairs stood around it with white-and-gilt lacquer tea tables; in the middle was a large dining table of the same material and design, already set with eight solid-silver footed fruit dishes.

等主客坐定，随即有两个面目姣好的丫头来奉茶敬烟，
Once host and guests were seated, two pretty maids brought tea and offered tobacco.

至此才是开始寒暄的时候。
Only now could leisurely conversation begin.

“森二爷这一晌的酒兴怎么样？”
“How has your appetite for wine been lately, Second Master Sen?”

“很好哇！”宝森笑道：
“Excellent!” Baosen laughed.

“从天津上船那天起，酒兴就没有坏过。”
“It has never failed me since the day I boarded the steamer at Tianjin.”

“要这样才好。”
“That is how it should be.”

胡雪岩问古应春，
Hu turned to Gu.

“森二爷怎么没有把花想容带来？”
“Why did Second Master Sen not bring Hua Xiangrong?”

“多谢，多谢！”宝森抢着回答，
“Thank you, thank you,” Baosen answered before Gu could speak.

“我到府上来作客，
“I am your guest.

没有把她带来的道理。”
It would hardly be proper to bring her to your house.”

原来花想容是“长三”上的“红倌人”，为宝森所眷。
Hua Xiangrong was a sought-after courtesan of a changsan house, and Baosen was attached to her.

胡雪岩邀他来一赏西湖秋色，原曾在信上写明，不妨挟美以俱，
In inviting him to enjoy the autumn scenery of West Lake, Hu had expressly written that he might bring his beauty along.

而宝森却认为于礼不合，没有带花想容来。
Baosen, however, had considered it improper and left her behind.


按下来便纵谈上海声色与新奇之事，
They went on to talk freely of Shanghai’s pleasures and novelties.

宝森兴味盎然他说他开了多少眼界，看了外国的马戏、东洋女子“天胜娘”的戏法。
Baosen spoke with lively interest of how much he had seen: a foreign circus and the tricks of the Japanese woman Tianshengniang.

一面谈，一面不断有丫头送点心来，
As they talked, maids kept bringing refreshments.

宝森喜欢甜食，最中意又香又软用冰糖煮的桂花栗子。
Baosen had a sweet tooth, and his favorite was the soft, fragrant chestnuts cooked with rock sugar and sweet osmanthus.

“雪岩，”宝森是衷心向往，“我看当皇上都没有你舒服，
“Xueyan,” he said with heartfelt envy, “I doubt even the emperor lives as comfortably as you.

简直是神仙嘛！”
You are simply an immortal!”

他指着窗外，耸起于假山上的那座“百狮楼”，忽然想起一句唐诗，便念了出来，“楼阁玲珑五云起。”
Pointing through the window at the Hundred Lions Tower rising above the rockery, he suddenly recalled a line of Tang poetry and recited it: “Exquisite towers and pavilions rise amid five-colored clouds.”

“森二爷谈诗，我就接不上话了。”
“Once you begin discussing poetry, Second Master Sen, I cannot keep up.”

胡雪岩转脸说道：
Hu turned to Tao.

“厚齐，你看哪一天，把我们杭州城里那几位大诗翁请了来，陪森二爷谈谈。”
“Houzhai, find a day to invite our great Hangzhou poets here to talk with Second Master Sen.”

“不，不！”
“No, no!”

宝森急忙摇手，
Baosen waved his hands hastily.

“我哪里会做诗？
“I know nothing of writing poetry.

千万不必，免得我受窘。”
Please do not embarrass me.”

看他是真心话，胡雪岩一笑置之，不再多说。
Seeing that he meant it, Hu smiled and let the matter drop.

陶敦甫怕场面冷落，便即问说：“森二爷，上海消息灵通，
To keep the conversation from flagging, Tao asked, “News travels quickly in Shanghai, Second Master Sen.

不知道刘制台的参案怎么样了？”
What has come of the impeachment of Governor-General Liu?”

听得这话，宝森突然站了起来：
Baosen suddenly sprang to his feet.

“嘿！”
“Ha!”

他摹地里一拍双掌，声音极大，加以动作近乎粗鲁，倒让大家都吓一跳，
He clapped his hands so loudly, with such a rough gesture, that he startled everyone.

再看他脸上有掩抑不住的笑容，便越发奇怪了。
The irrepressible smile on his face made them more puzzled still.

“森二爷，”胡雪岩说：“请坐下来，
“Sit down, Second Master Sen,” Hu said.

慢慢谈起。”
“Tell us at your leisure.”

“谈起刘岘庄的参案，
“The impeachment of Liu Xianzhuang!

可真是大快人心！”
Now that is something to gladden the heart.”

他摩腹说道：
He rubbed his stomach.

“我肚子里的积滞都消了……”
“It has cleared all the stagnation out of my belly…”

刘岘庄便是两江总督刘坤一。
Liu Xianzhuang was Liu Kunyi, Governor-General of Liangjiang.

自从出了盛宣怀的案子，李鸿章便觉得此人在两江，对他是一大妨碍，而盛宣怀更是耿耿在心，企图中伤。
Since the Sheng Xuanhuai affair, Li Hongzhang had regarded his presence there as a serious obstacle, while Sheng nursed resentment and sought to damage him.

但刘坤一的官声不错，
Liu’s reputation was good, however.

封疆大吏又不比京官，号称“都老爷”的监察御史，见闻不足，无法参他，就上折参劾，慈禧太后亦未必见听。
A great provincial governor was less exposed than a capital official: the investigating censors lacked the information to impeach him, and even a memorial might not persuade Cixi.

几经筹划，认为只有一个人够资格参他，而且一定见效。
After much planning, they concluded that only one man had the standing to denounce him with certain effect.


此人就是“彭郎夺得小姑回”的彭玉鳞，湘军水师的领袖。
That man was Peng Yulin, the Peng associated with the verse “Young Peng carried Maiden Gu away,” and the leader of the Hunan Army’s naval forces.

洪杨失败，彭玉麟淡于名利，
After the Taiping defeat, Peng showed little interest in fame or profit.

外不愿当督抚，内不愿当尚书，
He would accept neither a provincial governorship nor a ministry at court.

于是有人建议，
Someone therefore proposed a different appointment.

长江水师龙蛇混杂，盐枭勾结，为害地方不浅。
The Yangtze naval forces contained men of every description, some colluding with salt smugglers and doing great harm to the districts along the river.

彭玉麟清刚正直，嫉恶如仇，在长江威望素著，
Peng was upright, stern, and fiercely opposed to wrongdoing, with an established reputation throughout the region.

不如仿照旗营“专操大臣”的制度，派他专门巡阅长江水师，
Why not follow the Banner armies’ system of special commissioners for drills and appoint him to inspect the Yangtze naval forces?

得以专折奏事，并颁给“王命旗牌”，遇有不法官吏，得以便宜行事。
He could submit memorials independently and receive the imperial command banner and tablets, authorizing him to act at his discretion against offending officials.

彭玉麟接受了这个差使，
Peng accepted.

一年一次巡阅长江水师，其余的日了，便住在西湖上，与他的孙儿女亲家俞曲园唱酬盘醒，消闲如鹤。
He made one inspection each year and spent the rest of his time at West Lake, exchanging poems and enjoying long visits with Yu Quyuan, whose grandchild had married his own, living as freely as a crane.

不过到得彭玉麟出巡时，威名所播，确能使贪官墨吏，相顾敛迹，
When Peng set out on inspection, however, his reputation made corrupt officials look anxiously at one another and curb their conduct.

他所管的事，亦不限于整顿水师纪律，
He concerned himself with far more than naval discipline.

长江沿岸各地他看下顺眼的事都要管，职权仿佛明朝“代天巡守”的巡按御史。
Anything he found objectionable along the Yangtze came within his attention, much like a Ming censor inspecting on the sovereign’s behalf.

曾经在武昌请王命旗牌立斩不法的水师总兵谭祖纶，
At Wuchang he had invoked the imperial warrant to execute the offending naval brigade commander Tan Zulun on the spot.

至于地方官经他参劾，革职查办的，亦颇不乏人。
Many local officials had also been dismissed and investigated after his denunciations.

总之，只要彭玉麟参谁，准就非倒媚不可。
Whoever Peng impeached was certain to suffer.


盛宣怀想到了这个人，李鸿章亦认为可加利用，
Sheng thought of him, and Li agreed that he could be used.

于是摭拾浮言，激动了彭玉麟的脾气，真个以密折严劾刘坤一，大致是：
They collected circulating allegations and inflamed Peng’s temper until he submitted a severe confidential impeachment of Liu.

第一，鸦片瘾大，又好逸乐，精神不济，无力整顿公事，
First, Liu was heavily addicted to opium and pleasure, leaving him too enervated to put public business in order.

第二，姨太太很多，稀见宾客，又纵容家丁，收受门包，
Second, he kept many concubines, seldom received visitors, and allowed his servants to demand payments at the door.

第三点最厉害，亦是彭玉麟亲眼所见，最感不满而又是他应该管的事，
The third charge was the strongest: something Peng had seen himself, deeply resented, and was responsible for correcting.

“沿江炮台，多不可目，
“Many forts along the river are a disgrace to behold.

每一发炮，烟气迷目，甚或坍毁。”
Whenever a gun is fired, smoke blinds the eyes; some structures even collapse.”

密折到京，慈禧太后召见军机，决定派彭玉麟进一步密查，
On receiving the memorial, Cixi summoned the Grand Council and ordered Peng to investigate further in secret.

同时内召来京觐见，打算不让他回任了。
She also summoned Liu to Beijing for an audience, intending not to send him back.

据说荣王曾经跟李鸿章商量过这件事，
Prince Gong was said to have discussed the matter with Li.

其时陕甘总督改派曾国荃，而曾国荃嫌地方太苦，又怕无法指挥左宗棠的嫡系部队，
Zeng Guoquan had lately been appointed Governor-General of Shaanxi and Gansu, but considered the region too harsh and feared he could not command Zuo’s own troops.

一直不愿就任，使得朝廷深感为难，
His continuing refusal to take up the post embarrassed the court.

不如乘此机会，改派刘坤一当陕甘总督。
Liu might now be transferred there instead.

至于两江总督则以清望素著的四川总督丁宝祯调补，遗缺由李鸿章的胞兄李瀚章接任。
Ding Baozhen, the well-regarded Governor-General of Sichuan, could take Liangjiang, and Li’s elder brother Li Hanzhang could succeed Ding.


这是李鸿章的一把如意算盘，
This was Li Hongzhang’s carefully calculated plan.

原来清朝的制度，封疆大吏、划疆而治，
Under the Qing system, the great provincial authorities governed defined territories.

总督往往亦仅管得一省，不比明朝的总督、巡抚是有流动性的。
Even a governor-general often administered only one province, unlike the Ming governors and governors-general, whose jurisdictions could shift.

这种制度之形成，当然有许多原因，
Many circumstances had produced this arrangement.

其中之一是，皇帝认为各有专责，易于考查，也就是易于驾驭。
One was the emperor’s belief that separate responsibilities made officials easier to assess and therefore easier to control.

因此，尽管常有“不分畛域”的上谕，实际上限制甚严，不准有越权的行为，
Despite frequent edicts urging them not to confine themselves to territorial divisions, restrictions were severe, and encroachments on another’s authority were forbidden.

及至洪杨兵起，这个相沿两百年而不替的传统被打破了。
The Taiping rising broke a tradition that had endured for two hundred years.

清朝在道光以前，凡有大征伐、调兵遣将，权皆操之于皇帝，军饷亦由国库拨发，
Before the Daoguang reign, the emperor had controlled every major expedition and deployment, and military expenditure had come from the imperial treasury.

统帅功成还朝，缴还兵权，受赏而回本职，
A victorious commander returned to court, surrendered his military authority, accepted his reward, and resumed his substantive post.

并无私有的军队。
He possessed no private army.

但自曾国藩创立湘军，而军饷又需带兵将帅就地白筹以后，整个情况大变，
Once Zeng Guofan created the Hunan Army and commanders had to raise funds locally, everything changed.

变成官不符职、守非其地、财难己用、兵为私有。
Posts no longer matched duties; service extended beyond one’s jurisdiction; locally raised revenue was unavailable for local needs; armies became private property.

曾国荃进围金陵时，他的官衔是浙江按察使，
When Zeng Guoquan advanced to besiege Jinling, his title was Judicial Commissioner of Zhejiang.

一省司法长官，带兵打伏，岂非“官不符职”？
For a province’s chief judicial officer to lead troops into battle was surely a case of office and duty failing to match.

而打仗又非为浙江划守土之责，这就是“守非其地”。
Nor was he fighting to defend Zhejiang: he was serving outside his own territory.

“财难己用”就更微妙了，
The revenue problem was subtler still.

本秦人视越，肥瘠漠不相关，
Normally, one province’s prosperity might seem as remote as Yue’s affairs to a man of Qin.

但在左宗棠西征时，却非希望浙江丰收不可，
Yet during Zuo’s western campaign, good harvests in Zhejiang became essential.

因为浙江按月要交西征协晌十四万银子，而本省修理海塘，反需另筹财源。
Zhejiang had to contribute a hundred and forty thousand taels every month to the western army, while money to repair its own coastal embankments had to be found elsewhere.

至于“兵为私有”，则以湘、淮两军原为子弟兵，爷子兄弟叔侄，递相率领，成为规例，
As for private armies, both the Hunan and Anhui forces had begun as local bands, in which fathers, sons, brothers, uncles, and nephews served under one another.

淮军的这个传统，更是牢不可破。
In the Anhui Army especially, this tradition had become unbreakable.


因为打破了疆域与职守的限制，李鸿章才能运用手腕，伸张其势力于两江——南洋。
Only after the restrictions of territory and office had been broken could Li Hongzhang maneuver to extend his power into Liangjiang, the Southern jurisdiction.

直督兼北洋大臣，江督兼南洋大臣，
The Governor-General of Zhili also served as Beiyang Minister, while the Governor-General of Liangjiang served as Nanyang Minister.

李鸿章一直强调，无论筹办防务或者与外洋通商，南北洋必须联络一致，不分彼此。
Li repeatedly insisted that coastal defense and foreign trade alike required the Northern and Southern administrations to act together without distinction.

话是如此，却只有北冰侵南洋之权，南洋的势力达不到北洋，
In practice, however, the North could encroach on the South, while Southern influence could not reach the North.

因为北洋近在畿辅，得地利之便，可直接与各国驻华公使联络交涉，
Situated close to the capital, the Northern administration could deal directly with foreign ministers in China.

这样，有关南洋的通商事务，自然而然地由北洋代办了。
Southern trading affairs consequently passed quite naturally into its hands.

同时“总理各国国务衙门”，为了在交涉上留有缓冲的余地，往往先委托北洋从事初步谈判，保留着最后的裁决权，
