When a present is needed, he can simply produce one.”

“原来这样子的。”
“So that is the explanation.”

罗四姐的疑团一释，“七姐夫，请你再讲。”
Her doubt resolved, Luo asked Gu to continue.

如果你抽不出工夫。或者她到上海来看你。”
If you cannot spare the time, perhaps she might come to Shanghai instead.”

她说，“把你娘接了来歇夏，
Bring her here for the summer.

住两三个月再回去。
She can stay two or three months before going back.”

““上海是比杭州要凉快些。”罗四姐点点头：
Luo nodded. “Shanghai is cooler than Hangzhou.

“等我来想想。”
Let me think about it.”

“后面还有段话，是乌先生‘附笔’，
“There is another passage, a postscript from Mr Wu.

很有意思！”
Quite interesting.”

古应春微笑着，
Gu smiled.

“He says that since Mr Hu’s personal visit, the tea drinkers at the temple have talked of little else for days.

都说胡大先生厚道。
Everyone calls him a generous and loyal man.

照他看，胡大先生是你命中的‘贵人’，亦未可知。”
Mr Wu thinks he might even be the benefactor destined to enter your life.”

这话触及罗四姐心底深处，
The words touched the deepest part of Luo’s heart.

再沉着也不同得脸一红，
Composed as she was, she could not help blushing.

七姑奶奶非常识趣，故意把话扯了开去，
With great tact, the Seventh Lady deliberately changed the subject.

“What tea drinkers?

“什么庙？”
What temple?”

“关帝庙，就在我家邻近。
“The Temple of Lord Guan, near our house.

替我娘写这封信的乌先生，是那里的庙祝，
Mr Wu, who wrote this letter for my mother, is its keeper.

靠平常摆桌子卖茶、说大书，
He sets out tables and sells tea, with storytellers performing.

关帝庙的香火才有着落。”
That is how the temple’s worship and incense are supported.”

正谈到此处，洋人来拜访古应春了。
At this point Gu’s foreign visitor arrived.

在他会客时，罗四姐与七姑奶奶的话题未断，
While he received him, the two women continued talking.

她也很想接她母亲来往，苦无便人可以护送。
Luo would very much like her mother to stay, but had no suitable person to escort her.

七姑奶奶认为这根本算不了一回事，写信给胡雪岩就是。
The Seventh Lady thought that no difficulty at all: she need only write to Hu.

“不好！”
“No, that would not do.”

罗四姐只是摇头，却不说为何不好，及至七姑奶奶追问时，她才答说：“我欠他的情大多了。”
Luo kept shaking her head, and only when pressed explained, “I owe him too much already.”

“已经多了，何妨再欠一回。”
“Then what harm in owing him one kindness more?”

“我怕还不清。”
“I am afraid I could never repay him.”

“那也有办法……”
“There is a way of doing that too…”

七姑奶奶想一想，还是不必说褥大露骨。

罗四姐也没有再问，这件事就暂且搁下来了。
Luo asked no further question, and the matter was left for the time being.

They chatted until the lamps were lit.

The Seventh Lady proposed an early dinner followed by a visit to a Western circus.

罗四姐答应在她家吃饭，但不想去看马戏，因为散戏已晚，劳她远送回家，于心不安。
Luo agreed to dine but declined the circus: it would finish late, and she would feel guilty at making her hostess escort her so far home.

“那还不好办？
“That is easily settled.

你住在我这里好了。
Stay here.

我们还可以谈谈。”
We can talk some more as well.”

罗四姐想了一下，终于接受邀约。
After considering it, Luo accepted.

When they returned from the circus after dinner, Gu had just arrived home too.

“阿七，请你替我收拾收拾行李。”
“A’qi, please pack my things.

他说：“今天来的洋人。是德国洋行新来的总管。
Today’s visitor is the new manager of a German trading house.

他说要专程到杭州去拜访小爷叔，顺便逛逛西湖，
He wants to make a special journey to Hangzhou to see Little Uncle and take the opportunity to visit West Lake.

我只好陪他走一趟。”
I have no choice but to accompany him.”

“怎么？”七姑奶奶高兴他说：“你要到杭州！
“You are going to Hangzhou?

好极，好极！
Wonderful!

你把罗四姐的老太太带了来。”
Bring Sister Luo’s mother back with you.”

古应春愣了一下，想到罗大娘信中的话，方始会意，欣然答说：
Gu paused, then remembered the letter and understood.

“好，好！
“Gladly.

我一走办到。”
I shall certainly arrange it.”

他们夫妇已经这样作了决定，罗四姐除了道谢，别无话说。
With husband and wife having decided between them, Luo could do nothing but thank them.

接着便谈行程，古应春计算，来去约需半个月。
They discussed the journey, which Gu reckoned would take about half a month there and back.

七姑奶奶便又出了主意。
His wife had another idea.

“你索性搬到‘大英地界’来往，
“Why not move into the British settlement?

我们来去也方便。”
It would be easier for us to visit each other.

她说：“寻房带搬家，有半个月尽够了。”
Half a month is quite enough to find a house and move.”

“嗯，嗯。等我想一想。”
“Let me think.”

“你不必想。
“You need not.

等我来替你想。”
Let me think for you.”

七姑奶奶是在想，有什么熟人的房子，或租，或买，一切方便，思索了一会，想到了，
She considered whose house might conveniently be rented or bought, and an idea came.

“老宓不是在造‘弄堂房子’？她问，
“Wasn’t Old Mi building a row of houses in a lane?

“完工了没有？”
Are they finished?”

“Long ago.”

“他那条弄堂，一共二十四家，算是条很长的弄堂。
“There are twenty-four houses in that lane—a long one,” Gu continued.

我想一定有的。”
“I am sure some must be available.”

“那好。”
“Then that is settled.”

七姑奶奶转脸对罗四姐说：“老宓是阜康的二伙，
Turning to Luo, the Seventh Lady explained, “Old Mi is Fukang’s deputy manager.

现在也发财了。
He has made a fortune too.

是他的房子，只要一句话，就可以搬进去住。”
If the houses are his, one word is all it will take for you to move in.”

“There, you see!”

罗四姐急忙否定，
Luo hastily rejected the suggestion.

“我想另外寻，比较好。”
“I think it would be better to find somewhere else.”

“Why?”

罗四姐不答，只是摇头，
She would only shake her head.

七姑奶奶终于想到了，
At last the Seventh Lady understood.

在此她跟胡雪岩的关系，正当微妙的时刻，她是有意要避嫌疑，免得太着痕迹。
At this delicate stage in Luo’s relations with Hu, she wished to avoid suspicion and leave no obvious sign.

七姑奶奶觉得罗四姐人虽精明能干，而且也很重义气交情，但不免有些做作。
The Seventh Lady found her shrewd, capable, and loyal to her friends, yet also somewhat affected.

她是个心直口快的人，遇到这种情形，有她一套快刀斩乱麻的手法，是罗四姐所做不到的。
A frank woman herself, she had a way of cutting through complications that Luo could not manage.

总而言之，言而总之一句话，你搬家是搬定了。
To sum it up, and sum it up again: you are moving.

房子呢，或租、或典、或买下来，我来替你作主，

你不必管。”
You need not concern yourself.”

Luo yielded.

The lane was called Fuhou Lane.

二十四户，望衡对宇，两面可通，
Its twenty-four houses faced one another across a passage open at both ends.

七姑奶奶挑定的一户，坐北朝南，
She chose one facing south.

楼下东西厢房，大客厅，后面是“灶披间”、下房、储藏室。
Downstairs were side rooms to east and west, a large reception room, and, at the back, a kitchen, servants’ quarters, and storeroom.

扶梯设在中间，
The stairs were in the middle.

楼上大小五个房间，
Upstairs were five rooms of different sizes.

最大的一个，由南到北，直通到底，是个套房，足供藏娇。
The largest was a suite running the full depth of the house from south to north, ample accommodation for a beauty in seclusion.

另外四间，一间起坐、一间饭厅、两间客房，
The other four were a sitting room, a dining room, and two guest rooms.

家具摆饰，亦都是七姑奶奶亲自挑选，布饰得富丽堂皇，着实令人喜爱。
The Seventh Lady personally selected all the furniture and ornaments, arranging them with an attractive richness and splendor.

前后不过十天工夫，诸事妥帖，七姑奶奶自己也很得意。
Everything was ready in only ten days, and she was thoroughly pleased with herself.

第十一天早上，派马车将罗四姐接了来，告诉她说：
On the eleventh morning she sent the carriage for Luo.

“房子我替你弄好了。
“I have arranged your house.

现在陪你去看看。”
Come and see.”

一看之下，罗四姐又惊又喜，兴奋之情，溢于言表，不断他说：
Luo was astonished and delighted.

“太好了，太好了。
“It is wonderful!

只怕我没有福气，住这么好的房子。”
I only fear I lack the good fortune to live in such a house.”

七姑奶奶不理她这话，光是问她还有什么不满意之处，马上可以改正。
Ignoring this, the Seventh Lady asked what she disliked; anything could be changed at once.

罗四姐倒也老实说了，还应该加上窗帘。
Luo frankly mentioned that curtains were still needed.


“窗帘已经量了尺寸，叫人去做了，
“The windows have been measured, and the curtains are being made.

明天就可以做好。”七姑奶奶接着又问：
They will be ready tomorrow.

“你哪天搬？”
When will you move?”

“慢点！”
“Wait.”

罗四姐拉着她并排坐下，踌躇了一下说道：
Luo drew her down to sit beside her and hesitated.

“七姐，说实话，房子我是真欢喜。
“To tell the truth, I love the house.

不过，我怕力量办不到，
But I am afraid it is beyond my means.

房子连家具，一起在内，总要四千银子吧？”
House and furniture together must cost four thousand taels?”

“四千不到。
“Less than four thousand.

我有细帐在那里。”
I have a detailed account.

七姑奶奶说：“你现在不必担心买不起。
You need not worry about affording it now.

这幢房子现在算是我置的，白借给你住，
For the moment, regard it as my property, lent to you to live in free of charge.

到你买得起了，我照原价让给你。”
When you can afford it, I shall let you have it at the original price.”

“世界上有这样的好事吗？”
“Can such good things happen in this world?”

“你不相信，
“You don’t believe it?

我自己郡不相信呢！”七姑奶奶笑道：
I hardly believe it myself!” The Seventh Lady laughed.

“看起来，吴铁口的话要应验了。”
“It looks as though Wu Tiekou’s words are coming true.”

罗四姐记得很清楚，
Luo remembered them perfectly.

吴铁口断定她要“做小”，
He had insisted she must become a concubine.

如果“偏要做大”，就会“嫁一个克一个”。
If she insisted on being a principal wife, she would bring death to one husband after another.

假使不愿“做小”，又不能“做大”，本身就会遭殃，性命不保。
If she would neither accept the lesser position nor occupy the higher one, disaster would overtake her own life.

倘或如此，八字中前面那四个字的“财”、“官”、“印”，自然都谈不到了。
In that case, the Wealth, Officer, and Seal represented in the first four of her birth characters would count for nothing.

所以只有心甘情愿“做小”，才会有福气。
Only by willingly becoming a concubine could she enjoy good fortune.

这样一想，七姑奶奶话中的意思，也就很明显了。
The Seventh Lady’s meaning was therefore plain.

话虽如此，罗四姐却不愿表示承认，可也不愿表示否认。
Yet Luo would neither acknowledge nor reject it.

这一来，唯一的办法便是装作未听清楚而忽略了她的弦外余音，故意言他。
Her only course was to pretend she had not quite heard, ignore the implication, and deliberately change the subject.


“七姐，搬家是件蛮麻烦的事，
“Moving is a troublesome business, Seventh Sister.

恐怕……”
I am afraid…”

“你用不着顾前想后。
“There is no need to worry about every possibility.

这里家具摆设都有了，
The furniture and fittings are all here.

你那里的木器，能送人的送人，没人可送，叫个收旧货的来，一脚踢。
Give away what you can of your old furniture, and have a secondhand dealer take the rest in one lot.

收拾收拾衣服、首饰、动用器具，不过一天的工夫，
Packing clothes, jewelry, and household utensils cannot take more than a day.

有啥麻烦？
Where is the trouble?”

““我那班客户呢？”
“What about all my customers?”

“这倒比较麻烦。”
“That is more difficult.”

七姑奶奶沉吟了一会说：“我劝你也不必再做了……”
After a pause, the Seventh Lady said, “I advise you to give up the business…”

“不！”罗四姐抢着说道：
“No!” Luo interrupted.

“不光是为我自己。
“It is not only for my own sake.

人家也是养家活口的一项行当，
This is a livelihood by which other people support their families.

我不能不管。”
I cannot simply abandon them.”

“那也容易，
“That is easily managed too.

你找个能干的人，做你的替手。
Find someone capable to take your place.

说不走，还可以要一笔‘顶费’。”
You might even receive a payment for handing over the business.

七姑奶奶又说：“新旧交替，难免接不上头，老马可以慢慢搬过来。
The change between old and new management is bound to leave loose ends, so Old Ma can come to the new house later.

或者老马投了新东家，你就更加省事了。
Or he might stay with the new proprietor, which would save you still more trouble.”

“听七姑奶奶为她的打算，简捷了当却又相当周到，罗四姐实在无话可说了，
Her arrangements were so simple and decisive, yet so considerate of the details, that Luo could find nothing more to object to.

“七姐，我真服了你了。”她说，
“I truly admire you, Seventh Sister.

“如今只剩下一件事：挑日子。”
There is only one thing left now: choosing a day.”

“对。”
“Exactly.

七姑奶奶说，“到我那里去，一面挑日子。一面再好好商量。”
Let us go back to my house, choose a day, and discuss everything further.”


回到古家，略为息一息，七姑奶奶叫人取了皇历来挑日子。
After a short rest at the Gu house, the Seventh Lady had the almanac brought.

很不巧，一连八、九天都不宜迁居，
Unluckily, none of the next eight or nine days was suitable for moving.

最快也得十天以后。
The earliest favorable date was ten days away.

“那时候老太太已经来了。”
“Your mother will be here by then.

七姑奶奶说：“我的想法是：顶好这三、四天以内就搬停当，老大太一来就住新房子，
I think it would be best to have everything settled within three or four days, so that she can go straight into the new house when she arrives.

让她老人家心里也高兴，而且也省事得多，
It would please her and save a great deal of trouble.

四姐，你说呢？”
What do you say?”

“话自然不错。
“Of course that would be best.

不过，日子不好，没有办法。”
But if the days are unfavorable, there is nothing we can do.”

七姑奶奶想了一下说，
The Seventh Lady thought for a moment.

“有办法。
“Yes, there is.

俗语道得好：拣日不如撞日。
As the saying goes, better to take the day you happen upon than labor over choosing one.

撞到哪天是哪天，
Whatever day comes our way will be the day.

你说好不好？”
How about that?”

“怎么撞法？”
“How are we to happen upon it?”

“以老太太到上海的那天，就算你撞到的日子。
“Take the day your mother reaches Shanghai.

老太太到了，先在我这里歇一歇脚，马上进屋，
She can rest briefly at my house and then go straight to yours.

你也把要紧东西先搬运了来，
Move your essential things beforehand.

晚上摆两桌酒，叫一班髦儿戏，热闹热闹，
In the evening, give a dinner for two tables and engage a troupe of mao’er opera performers to make it lively.

顺便就算替老太太接风，
It will welcome your mother at the same time.

不是一举两得。”
Two purposes served by one arrangement.”

罗四姐觉得这样安排也很好，便即问道：
Luo approved.

“七姐夫不晓得哪天回来？”
“When will Brother-in-Law Gu be back?”

“快了。
“Soon.

大概还有四、五天工夫。”
Probably in another four or five days.”


古应春回来了。使得罗四姐深感意外的是：她的母亲没有来，
Gu returned, but to Luo’s astonishment, her mother had not come.

倒是乌先生来了。
Mr Wu had arrived instead.

那乌先生有五十多岁，身材矮胖，满头白发，长一个酒糟鼻子，
He was in his fifties, short and stout, with a head of white hair and a red, bulbous nose.

形容古怪，但那双眼睛极好，
His features were odd, but his eyes were excellent.

看人时，眼中两道光芒射过来，能把人吸引住，自然而然地觉得此人可亲且可信赖，
Their penetrating brightness held anyone he looked at and naturally inspired both affection and trust.

因此，七姑奶奶一会便对他有好感。
The Seventh Lady took to him at once.

在古应春引见以后，自然有一番客套，七姑奶奶问到罗四姐的母亲何以不来，
After Gu’s introductions and the customary courtesies, she asked why Luo’s mother had not come.

乌先生乘机道明了来意。
Mr Wu used the question to explain his visit.

“罗四姐的娘因天气大热，又是吃‘观音素’，
“The weather is very hot, and her mother is observing a vegetarian fast for Guanyin.

到上海来作客，种种不方便，所以不来。
A visit to Shanghai would be inconvenient in several ways.

不过她娘倒有几句要紧话，要我私下限她说，
But she has some important things she wants me to tell her daughter privately.

所以沾古先生的光，携带我到上海来开开眼界。”
Thanks to Mr Gu, I have been brought along to broaden my experience of Shanghai.”

“蛮好，蛮好。”
“Excellent.

七姑奶奶说：“罗四姐，我跟她一见如故，感情象亲姐妹一样，
Sister Luo and I became close at once, like true sisters.

乌先生是她敬重的人，到了这里，一切不必客气。
Since you are someone she respects, please stand on no ceremony here.

现在，乌先生看，是把罗四姐接了来呢？还是你去看她。”
Shall we send for her, or would you prefer to call on her?”

“她娘还有点吃的、用的东西给罗四姐，
“Her mother has sent a few things to eat and use.

还是我去好了。”
I had better take them to her.”

“那么，我来送你去。”“不敢当，不敢当，决不敢当。”
“Then I shall take you.” He protested repeatedly that he could not accept such an honor.

“乌先生，你不要客气。
“There is no need for formality.

为啥要我亲自送你去呢？这有两个缘故。”
I have two reasons for taking you myself.”

说到这里，七姑奶奶转眼看着丈夫说：
She turned to her husband.

“你恐怕还不晓得，罗四姐搬家了，
“You probably haven’t heard that Sister Luo has moved.

是老窗的房子，
Into Old Mi’s house.

我一手替她料理的。
I arranged everything.”

““好快！”
“So quickly!”

古应春说了这一句，便又对乌先生说：
Gu turned to Mr Wu.

“罗四姐的新居在哪里，我都不知道，
“I don’t even know where her new home is.

那就非内人送你去不可了。”
My wife really must take you.”

“我送了乌先生去，顺便约一约罗四姐，今天晚上替乌先生接风，请她作陪。”
“And while I am there, I can invite her to accompany you to dinner tonight, when we welcome you properly.”

听得这么说，乌先生除了一再道谢以外，再无别话，
Mr Wu could only keep thanking her.

于是舍车坐轿，一起到了罗四姐那里。
They took sedan chairs instead of the carriage and went to Luo’s house.

七姑奶奶把人带到，又约好罗四姐晚上陪乌先生来吃饭，随即匆匆忙忙赶回家，因为她急于要听古应春谈此行的经过。
After delivering him and arranging for them both to come to dinner, the Seventh Lady hurried home, eager to hear Gu’s account of the journey.


“他是女家的‘大冰老爷’……”
“He is the bride’s matchmaker…”

原来胡雪岩一回杭州，略得清闲，便与老母妻子谈罗四姐的事。
Soon after returning to Hangzhou, Hu had found time to discuss Luo with his mother and wife.

本来娶小纳妾，胡雪岩原是自己可以做主的，但罗四姐的情形不同，
Ordinarily, he could decide for himself to take a concubine, but Luo’s circumstances were different.

好些有关系的事，都要预先谈好，最要紧的，第一是虚名，第二是实权。
Several consequential matters had to be settled beforehand, above all her title and her actual authority.

杭州官宦人家的妾侍，初进门称“新姑娘，
In Hangzhou official households, a concubine was first called the New Miss.

一年半载亲党熟悉了，才会称姓，假如姓罗，便叫”罗姑娘“，
After six months or a year, when relatives and friends knew her, her surname would be used: Miss Luo, for instance.

三年玉载以后，才换称”姨奶奶“的称呼。
Several years might pass before she became yinainai, or Auntie.

至于熬到”姨太太“总要进入中年，儿女成长以后。
The more dignified title yitaitai, or Aunt-Madam, generally came only in middle age, after her children had grown.

可是胡雪岩却为罗四姐提出要求，一进门就要称”太太“。
Hu, however, requested that Luo be addressed as Madam from the moment she entered the household.

“那么，”胡老太太问道：“你的元配呢？
“Then what of your principal wife?” Old Madam Hu asked.

这个也是‘太太’，那个也是‘太太’，
“One is Madam and the other is Madam.

到底是叫哪个？”
How is anyone to know which is meant?”

“一个叫‘二太太，好了。”
“Call one of them Second Madam.”

胡老太太沉吟了一会道：
His mother considered this.

“她怎么说呢？”
“What does she say?”

胡老太太用手遥指，这“地”是指胡太太。
She pointed vaguely in his wife’s direction.

“我还没有跟她谈到这上头。
“I haven’t discussed that part with her yet.

先要娘准了，我再跟她去说。”
I wanted your approval before speaking to her.”

胡老太太知道，媳妇贤惠而软弱，
Old Madam Hu knew her daughter-in-law was kind and weak.

即使心里不愿，亦不会公然反对，
Even if reluctant, she would not openly oppose him.

但她作为一家之主，却不能不顾家规，所以一时不便轻许，只说：
As head of the family, however, she herself had to consider its rules and could not agree lightly.

“我要好好儿想一想，
“I must think carefully.

总要在台面上说得过去才可以。”
Whatever we do must be defensible before others.”

“台而上是说得过去的。
“It is defensible.”

为啥呢”胡雪岩正好谈“实权”，他说：
This gave Hu his opening to discuss authority.

“目下这种场面，里头不能没有一个人来‘抓总’，
“With the establishment we now maintain, someone must take overall charge indoors.

媳妇太老实，身子又不好。
Your daughter-in-law is too unassertive, and her health is poor.

以至于好些事，还要老太太来操劳，做儿子的心里不安。
You still have to attend to so much, which makes me feel a failure as a son.

再说句老实话，外头的情形，老太太并不清楚，
To be frank, you don’t fully understand affairs outside the house.

有时候想操心，也无从着力。
Sometimes, even when you want to help, you cannot see how.

我想来想去，
I have thought it over endlessly.

只有把罗四姐讨了来当家。
The only answer is to marry Sister Luo and put her in charge.

既然当家，不能没有名分，
If she manages the household, she must have the standing to do so.

这是所谓‘从权办理’。
This is a special arrangement to meet the circumstances.

台面上说得过去的。“
It can be justified.”


“你要她来当家，这件事，我就更加要好好想一想了。
“If you want her to manage the household, I must consider it still more carefully.

你总晓得，当家人是很难做的。”
You know how hard it is to be the person in charge.”

“我晓得。
“I do.

罗四姐极能干，
She is exceptionally capable.

这个家一定当得下来。”
She can certainly manage it.”

“不光是能干。”
“Ability is not everything.

胡老太太说：“俗语说：”不痴不聋，不做阿家翁。
As the saying goes, ‘Unless you can play the fool and turn a deaf ear, you cannot be the elder of a household.’

‘做当家人要吃得起哑巴亏。
The person in charge must bear injuries without complaint.

丫头老妈子、厨子轿班，都会在背后说闲话，
Maids, older women servants, cooks, and chair bearers will all gossip behind her back.

她有没有这份肚量，人家明明’当着和尚骂贼秃‘，她只当没有听见，脸上有一点懊恼的神气都没有？
Has she the generosity to hear an insult aimed plainly at her—like cursing bald-headed scoundrels in front of a monk—and pretend she heard nothing, without the slightest displeasure showing on her face?”

““这一点……”
“As for that…

胡雪岩说：“我当然要跟她说清楚，
I shall explain it clearly.

她一定会答应的。”
She is sure to agree.”

胡老太太大摇其头，
His mother shook her head emphatically.

“说归说，答应归答应，到时候就不同了。”
“Words and promises are one thing; the moment itself is another.

她说：“泥菩萨都有个土性，
Even a clay bodhisattva has a temper.

一个忍不住闹了起来，弄得家宅不和，那时候你懊悔嫌迟了。”
If she loses patience and makes a scene, disrupting the household, you will regret it when it is too late.”

这是各人的看法不同。
Their perspectives differed.

胡老太太以前也见过罗四姐，但事隔多年，是何面貌都记不清楚了，当然只就一般常情来推测。
Old Madam Hu had met Luo years before, but could no longer remember even her appearance and could judge only by ordinary human behavior.

胡雪岩心想，这不是一下子可将老母说服的，
Hu realized that he could not persuade his mother all at once.

惟有多谈一谈罗四姐的性情才具，
He must tell her more about Luo’s character and abilities.

渐渐地让母亲有了信心，自然水到渠成。
Once confidence grew, agreement would follow naturally.


就在这时候，古应春陪着洋人到了杭州，
It was at this point that Gu arrived in Hangzhou with the foreign visitor.

谈妥公事，派人陪着洋人去逛六桥三竺，
After their business was settled, someone else was sent to accompany the foreigner around the Six Bridges and Three Tianzhu Temples.

古应春才跟胡雪岩详谈罗四姐所托之事。以及乌先生代笔信中的内容，
Gu could then speak fully with Hu about Luo’s requests and Mr Wu’s letter.

认为事机已成熟，可以谈嫁娶了。
He thought the time was ripe to discuss marriage.

“我门老太太还有顾虑。”
“Mother still has doubts.

胡雪岩说，“老太太是怕她只能任劳，不能任怨。”
She is afraid Sister Luo can bear hard work but not unfair criticism.”

“那么，小爷叔，你看呢？”
“What do you think, Little Uncle?”

“这要先看我们怎样子待人家，”
“That depends first on how we treat her.

胡雪岩说：“罗四姐不肯拉倒，
If she refuses, there is nothing more to say.

如果肯了，她总也知道，我不能拿元配休了，讨她做大太太，
If she agrees, she must understand that I cannot divorce my principal wife to make her First Madam.

而只有做小。
She can only enter as a concubine.

做小称太太，又让她掌权，她只要这样想一想，就算有闲言闲语难听，一口气咽得下去，自然心平气和了。”
Yet if she has the title of Madam and authority over the household, surely reflecting on that will make it easier to swallow unpleasant gossip and remain at peace.”

“小爷叔的话很透彻。”
“You have put it very clearly.

古应春自告奋勇，“我来跟老太太说。”
Let me speak to your mother.”


说当然有个说法，
Gu had his own approach.

根本不提胡雪岩，只谈七姑奶奶跟罗四姐如何投缘，以及罗四姐如何识好歹，
He did not mention Hu at all, speaking instead of how well his wife and Luo suited each other, and how Luo knew when she was being treated well.

因为七姑奶奶待她好，所以言听计从，情如同胞姐妹。
Because the Seventh Lady had been kind to her, Luo listened to everything she said; the two were like sisters.

胡老太太很尊重患难之交的古应春夫妇，对七姑奶奶更有份特殊的感情与信心，当时便说：
Old Madam Hu held the Gus, her friends through adversity, in great respect, and felt particular affection and confidence toward the Seventh Lady.

“七姐中意的人，一定不会错的。
“Anyone Seventh Sister approves of must be sound.

这个媒要请七姐来做，
She must arrange this match.

我也要听了七姐的话才算数。”
I must hear what she has to say before deciding.”

一桩好事，急转直下，看来成功在望了。
Matters had suddenly taken a favorable turn, and success seemed near.

但古应春心思细密，行事谨慎，觉得乐观的话以少说为宜。
But Gu was thoughtful and cautious, and saw little reason to encourage excessive optimism.

“老太太也不要太高兴，
“Please do not be too pleased yet.

人家肯不肯，还在未知之数。”古应春接下来细谈七姑奶奶陪罗四姐去算命，几乎与吴铁口吵架的趣事，
Whether the other party will agree is still unknown.” He told her how his wife had taken Luo to have her fortune read and how Luo had almost quarreled with Wu Tiekou.

当然，他决不会透露，这是他们夫妇事先跟吴铁口说通了的秘密。
Naturally, he concealed their advance arrangement with the fortune-teller.

胡老太太听得很仔细，而且越听笑意越浓，
Old Madam Hu listened closely, smiling more and more.

“原来她有这样的一副好八字，
“So she has such excellent birth characters.

看来真是命中注定了。”
It really does seem destined.

她接着又说：“这种人的脾气是这样的，要嘛不肯，要肯了，说的话，一定有一句，算不句。”
People of that temperament either refuse outright or, once they consent, keep every word they give.”

“小爷叔，”古应春又想到一件事：“不知道婶娘的意思怎么样？”
Gu thought of another point. “Little Uncle, what does your wife think?”

“她肯的。”胡老太太接口，
“She agrees,” Old Madam Hu answered.

“我跟她谈过了，
“I have spoken to her.

她要我作主，
She leaves the decision to me.

现在，七姐夫，这桩事情，我就拜托你了。”
Now, Brother-in-Law Gu, I entrust the matter to you.”


“只要老太太作主，婶娘也不会埋怨，我同阿七当然要尽心尽力把这件事办圆满来。”
“If you give your approval and your daughter-in-law will not resent us, A’qi and I will do everything we can to bring it to a satisfactory conclusion.”

于是古应春为胡雪岩策划，男家的媒人是七姑奶奶，女家的媒人不妨请乌先生承担。
Gu proposed that the Seventh Lady act as matchmaker for Hu, while Mr Wu might represent the bride.

胡雪岩自然同意，便发了一份请帖，请乌先生吃饭。
Hu agreed and sent Mr Wu a dinner invitation.

这在乌先生自有受宠若惊之感，准时到胡家来赴宴。
Naturally overwhelmed by the honor, the temple keeper arrived punctually.

做主人的介绍了古应春与其他的陪客，敬过一杯酒，托辞先离席了。
His host introduced Gu and the other guests, drank a cup with him, and then excused himself from the table.

席间闲谈，不及正事，
Conversation over dinner remained general; the real business was not mentioned.

饭罢到客座喝茶，古应春才将乌先生邀到一边，
Only afterward, over tea, did Gu draw Mr Wu aside.

笑着说道：“乌先生，你我神交已久。”
“We have been acquaintances in spirit for a long time.”

乌先生愕然，及至古应春提到彼此为罗四姐一家代笔的事，乌先生方始明白，
Mr Wu was puzzled until Gu explained their respective roles in writing letters for Luo’s family.

人虽初识，笔迹早熟，
Though they had never met, each already knew the other’s handwriting.

这就是神交，因为如此，一切都好谈了。
That was their acquaintance at a distance, and it made everything easy to discuss.


“照此看来，事情已经定局了。”七站奶奶很高兴他说，
“Then the matter is settled!” the Seventh Lady said happily.

“这乌先生看起来很关心罗四姐，
“Mr Wu seems very concerned about Sister Luo.

不晓得他看了她的新房子，心里是怎么想？”
I wonder what he thinks of her new house.”

乌先生等七姑奶奶一走，从房子看到摆饰，
Once she had left him there, Mr Wu had examined the house and its furnishings.

在他心目中无一不新，无一不精，
Everything seemed new and exquisite.

想不到她如此阔气，
He had not imagined that Luo was so wealthy.

只以有七姑奶奶这个初会面的堂客在，不便现于形色，怕人家笑话他没有见过世面，
With a woman he had only just met present, he had concealed his reaction for fear of appearing ignorant of the world.

此时就不再需要任何矜持了，毫不掩饰地显出艳羡惊异的神态。
Now restraint was unnecessary, and his admiration and amazement showed without disguise.

“罗四姐，我真没有想到，你年纪轻轻一个女人家，会闯出这样一个场面来！
“I never expected a young woman like you to establish herself so splendidly.

上海我也来过两回，说实话，这样漂亮的帚子，我还是头一回见。”
I have visited Shanghai twice before, but this is the first house of such beauty I have seen.

他紧接着又说：“古家当然是有身分的人家，
The Gus are plainly people of standing.

房子虽比你的大，不过没有你的新，
Their house is larger, but not as new.

摆饰家具也比你多，可惜有细有粗，有好有坏，
They have more furnishings, but fine pieces are mixed with ordinary ones, good with bad.

不比你的整齐。”
Yours are so consistent throughout.”

听他这样夸赞，罗四姐心里有种说不出的舒服，
His praise gave Luo an indescribable pleasure.

人生得意之事，无过于从小相亲的熟人，看到此人肯争气、有出息，青云直上，乱目相看。
Few satisfactions could equal being seen by someone who had known one from childhood as a person of ambition and achievement, risen far enough to deserve new respect.

她此时的心情，亦大有衣锦还乡之感，
She felt almost as though she had returned home in glory.

不过紧接着而来的感觉，却是美中不足的空虚。
Yet an emptiness followed: the glory was incomplete.

“房子、家具都不是我的，
“Neither house nor furniture is mine.

我哪里就到得了能这样子摆场面的地步？”
How could I have risen far enough to maintain such a display?”


这话在乌先生并不觉得全然意外，
Mr Wu was not entirely surprised.

略想一想说道：“就算是胡大先生替你置的，即使用了，就算是你的了。”
“Even if Mr Hu bought them for you, once you use them, they are yours.”

“也不是他，
“It wasn’t he.

是七姑奶奶的。”
They belong to the Seventh Lady.”

“七姑奶奶？”
“The Seventh Lady?

乌先生诧异，“你们罗家哪里跑出来这样一位姑奶奶？”“乌先生你缠到哪里去了？”罗四姐笑道：
Where did such a married aunt suddenly appear in your Luo family?” Luo laughed. “How have you got so confused?

“就是古太太，
I mean Mrs Gu.

娘家姓尤，行七，
Her maiden name is You, and she is seventh in her family.

大家都叫她七姑奶奶，我叫她七姐。”
Everyone calls her the Seventh Lady; I call her Seventh Sister.”

“啊，啊，原来是她。”
“Ah, so it is she.”

乌先生眨着眼想，越想越糊涂，
The more he thought, the more confused he became.

“那么，古家两夫妇，怎么叫胡大先生‘小爷叔’？
“Then why do the Gus call Mr Hu Little Uncle?

上海人叫叔叔叫‘爷叔’，
Shanghai people use that word for an uncle.

胡大先生怎么会是他们的小叔叔？”其中有个缘故，我也是前几天才听七姑奶奶谈起，
How can he be their young uncle?” Luo explained what she herself had learned only days before.

她的哥哥行五……“罗四姐告诉他说，尤五是松江漕帮的当家。
The Seventh Lady’s brother, You Laowu, led the Songjiang Grain Transport Brotherhood.

尤五的师父跟胡雪岩是朋友，交情很厚，
His master was Hu’s close friend.

清帮中人，极重家规，所以尤五年龄虽比胡雪岩大，却尊他为长辈，
The Green Gang placed great weight on its rules of seniority, so although You was older than Hu, he honored him as an elder.

七姑奶奶和古应春亦都跟着尤五叫胡雪岩为小爷叔。
His sister and Gu followed his usage.

“照七姑奶奶说，松江的潜帮称为‘疲帮’。
“Seventh Sister says the Songjiang group is called an exhausted brotherhood.

他们这一帮的漕船很多，是大帮，不过是个空架子，
It is large and has many grain boats, but little substance behind the name.

所以当家的带帮很吃力，亏得胡大先生帮他们的忙。
Leading it is difficult, and Mr Hu has helped them greatly.

为此，胡大先生在杭州到上海的这条水路上很吃得开，就因为松江漕帮的缘故。”
That is why he has so much influence along the water route between Hangzhou and Shanghai.”


乌先生听得很仔细，一面听，一面在心里想他自己的事。
Mr Wu listened closely while considering his own position.

他虽受托来做媒，但仔细想想；不是什么明媒正娶，他这个媒人也没有什么面子，
He had agreed to act as matchmaker, but this was not a marriage to a principal wife through the full formal rites, and there was little distinction in arranging it.

所以一路上抱定一个主张，如果罗四姐本人不甚愿意，或者胡雪岩的为人，在杭州以外的地方，风评不佳，那就说不得打退堂鼓了。
On the journey he had resolved that if Luo was not particularly willing, or Hu’s conduct outside Hangzhou had earned him an unfavorable reputation, he would have to withdraw.

此刻看来，自己一路上的想法，似乎都不切实际了。
What he now saw made those earlier reservations seem unrealistic.

既然如此，就不妨谈正事了，
He might as well turn to business.

“罗四姐，”他说：“你晓不晓得，我这趟为啥来的？”
“Sister Luo, do you know why I have come?”

这佯问法，罗四狙不免有些发窘，
The question embarrassed her.

不过这是自己的终身大事，不能因为羞于出口，以致弄成误会，
But this concerned the rest of her life; she must not let reluctance to speak create a misunderstanding.

所以很沉着他说：“是不是我娘有什么话，请乌先生来跟我说。”
She answered steadily, “Has my mother asked you to tell me something?”

“是的。
“Yes.

我原来的意思，你娘即使不能来，写信给你，也是一样，
I thought that if she could not come herself, a letter would do just as well.

你娘不赞成。她的话也有道理，
But she disagreed, with reason.

写信问你，等你的回信，一来一去个把月，
A letter to you and a reply would take a month or so between them.

倒不如我来一趟，直接问个明白。”
Better for me to come and ask you directly.”

“娘要问我的是什么话？”
“What does she wish to ask?”

“问你对胡大先生怎么样？”
“How you feel about Mr Hu.”

这一下，罗四姐的脸有些红了，
Luo blushed.

“什么怎么样呢？”
“Feel about him in what way?”

她用埋怨来遮掩羞涩，
She covered her shyness with a complaint.

“乌先生你的话，说得不清不楚，
“You are being so vague.

叫我怎么说？”
How can I answer?”

乌先生在关帝庙设座卖茶，一天见过三教九流的人不知多少，阅历甚丰，
Serving tea at the temple brought Mr Wu into contact with every sort of person, and his experience was considerable.

不过做媒人却是第一次，
Matchmaking, however, was new to him.

因而有时不免困惑，心想，大家都说“媒人的嘴”是最厉害的，成败往往在一句活上，
People always spoke of a matchmaker’s formidable tongue: one sentence could make or ruin a match.

到底如何是一言丧邦、一言兴邦，却始终无法模拟，不想，此时自然而然就懂了，他在想：
He had never understood quite how a word could save a kingdom or destroy it, but now the meaning came naturally.

只要答一句：“胡大先生要讨你做小。”罗四姐必然既羞且恼，一怒回绝，好事就难谐了。
If he simply said, “Mr Hu wants to take you as a concubine,” she would surely be angry and ashamed, refuse in indignation, and destroy the prospect.

“如果乌先生对胡雪岩的印象不佳，他就会那样说，
Had he thought poorly of Hu, that was what he would have said.

但此刻已决心来牵这根红线，便要拣最动听的话来说：
Since he had now decided to join the pair, he chose the most pleasing words.

“罗四姐，胡大先生要请你去当家。”
“Mr Hu would like you to take charge of his household.”


这话让她心里一跳，但却不大敢相信，
Her heart leapt, but she hardly dared believe him.

“哪里有这回事？”
“Can that be true?

她说：“大家都叫胡大先生是‘财神’，
Everyone calls him the God of Wealth.

他家那佯子大的排场，我怎么当得了他的家。”
With such a grand establishment, how could I manage his household?”

“罗四姐，我劝你不要客气，
“There is no need for modesty.

你的能干，从小就看得出来的，
Your ability was evident from childhood.

胡大先生向来最识人，
Mr Hu has always been an excellent judge of people.

他说要请你去当家，当然看准了你挑得起这副担子。”
If he asks you to manage his house, he is certain you can bear the responsibility.”

看来不象是随口玩笑的话，
It did not sound like an idle joke.

罗四姐不由得问一句：“真的？”
“Really?”

“当然是真的。
“Of course.

没有这句话，我根本不会来。”
Without that undertaking, I would never have come.

乌先生说：“名分上你已经吃亏了，
You would already be making a sacrifice in formal status.

没有别的东西来弥补，你想我肯不肯来做这个媒？”
Without anything to compensate for it, do you think I would agree to arrange the match?”

乌先生的话说得很巧妙，
His wording was skillful.

用“名分上已经吃亏了”的说法，代替听者刺耳的“做小”二字，罗四姐不知不觉便在心里接受了。
In place of the offensive word “concubine,” he spoke of a sacrifice in formal status, and Luo accepted the idea inwardly almost without noticing.

“你的意思到底怎么样？”乌先生催问着，
“What do you think, then?” he urged.

“如果你没有话，晚上我就要跟古太太去谈了。
“If you have nothing further to say, I shall speak to Mrs Gu this evening.

当然，我是女家的媒人，一定会替你争。”
As your side’s matchmaker, I shall certainly press your interests.”

“怎么？为啥要跟七姑奶奶去谈？”
“Why speak to the Seventh Lady?

罗四姐问“莫非她是……”
Is she…”

“她是男家的媒人。”
“The matchmaker for his side.”

“我娘的意思呢？”
“What does my mother think?”

“你娘情愿结这门亲的。”
“She favors the marriage.”

罗四姐心潮起伏，思前想后，
Luo’s feelings surged as she considered it from every angle.

觉得有些话是连在乌先生面前都难出口的，
Some things were difficult to say even to Mr Wu.

考虑了好一会说，“乌先生，你晓得的，七姑奶奶跟我象同胞姐妹一样，
After a long pause, she replied, “You know that the Seventh Lady and I are like sisters.

我看，我自己来问问她。”
I think I had better ask her myself.”


“让我做个现成媒人，那再好都没有了。”
“If I need only arrange a match you have settled yourselves, nothing could be better.

乌先生说：“不过，罗四姐，你娘是托了我的，
But your mother has entrusted me with this, Sister Luo.

你自己跟古太太谈的辰光，不要忘记了替你娘留一条退路。”
When you speak to Mrs Gu, do not forget to leave your mother something to fall back on.”

何谓“退路”？罗四姐不明白，便即问说：
Luo did not understand.

“乌先生，我娘是怎么跟你说的？”
“What did my mother say to you?”

乌先生有些懊悔，“退路”的话是不应该说的。
Mr Wu regretted mentioning a safeguard.

所谓“退路”是以罗四姐将来在胡家的身分，她母亲不会成为“亲家太太”，也就不会象亲戚那样往来，
With the position Luo would occupy in the Hu household, her mother would not become a recognized fellow mother-in-law or visit on the footing of an ordinary relative.

这样，便需为她筹一笔养老的款子，才是个“退路”。
A fund should therefore be provided for her old age: that was the safeguard he meant.

但看目前的情形，且不说罗四姐，即便是胡雪岩也一定会想到他那句话便是多余的了。
But in the present circumstances, surely not only Luo but Hu himself would think of it. The remark had been unnecessary.

因此，他就不肯再说实话，只是这样回答：“你娘没有说什么，
Unwilling to state his full meaning, he merely answered, “Your mother said nothing.

是我想到的，
It was my own thought.

养儿防老，积谷防饥，
One raises children against old age and stores grain against hunger.

你要替你娘打算打算。”
You must make provision for her.”

“原来是这一层！”罗四姐很轻松地答说：
“So that is what you mean!” Luo answered readily.

“我当然有打算的。”
“Naturally, I have plans for that.”

“那好，我也放心了。
“Then I am reassured.

等下到了古家，你自己跟古太太去谈好了。”
When we reach the Gu house, speak to Mrs Gu yourself.”


为了替乌先生接风，古应春稍微用了些心思。
Gu gave some thought to the dinner welcoming Mr Wu.

乌先生既是生客，跟七姑奶奶又是第一次见面，应该照通常的规矩，男女分席，
As a new guest meeting his wife for the first time, he should, by ordinary custom, dine separately from the women.

但主客一共四个人，
But there were only four of them.

分做两处，把交情都拉远了，而且说话也不方便，
Dividing the company would create distance and make conversation awkward.

因此古应春决定请乌先生“吃大菜”。
Gu therefore decided on a Western dinner.

在人家家里“吃大菜”，乌先生还是第一回。
Mr Wu had never eaten one in a private house.

幸好做主人的想得很周到，
Fortunately, his host had considered the difficulties.

“吃大菜”的笑话见得多，
There were many stories of mishaps at Western meals.

刀子割破舌头虽是故甚其词，拿洗手指的水当冷开水喝，却非笑话，至于刀叉乱响，更是司空见惯之事，
Cutting one’s tongue with a knife was an exaggeration, but drinking the finger-bowl water as though it were plain drinking water was no joke; clattering knives and forks were commonplace.

所以古应春除了刀叉以外，另备一双筷子。
Gu provided chopsticks as well as Western cutlery.

选的菜，第一，避免半生的牛排，第二，凡是肉类都先去骨头，第三，调味少用西洋的佐料。
He avoided underdone beef, had every meat dish boned, and used few Western seasonings.

不过酒是洋酒，
The drinks, however, were foreign.

也不分饭前酒、饭后酒，黄的、白的、红的，摆好了几瓶，请乌先生随意享用。
Instead of distinguishing between those served before or after food, he set out several bottles—yellow, white, and red—for Mr Wu to choose.

“乌先生！”七姑奶奶入座时就说：“自己人，我说老实话，
As they sat down, the Seventh Lady said frankly, “We are among friends.

用不惯刀叉，用筷子好了。”
If you are not used to knives and forks, use chopsticks.”

“是！是！
“Very well.

恭敬不如从命，
Obedience is better than ceremony.

我就老实了。”
I shall be frank too.”

乌先生欣然举著。
He happily picked up his chopsticks.

“乌先生看见罗四姐的新房子了？”
“Have you seen Sister Luo’s new house?”

七姑奶奶有意将“子”字念得极轻，听去象“新房”。
The Seventh Lady softened the last part of the Chinese word, making it sound like “bridal chamber.”

在她是开玩笑，乌先生却误会了，
She was joking, but Mr Wu misunderstood.

以为将来罗四姐会长住上海，她目前的新居，将来便是双栖之处。
He thought Luo would remain in Shanghai and her present home would become the couple’s shared residence.

心想，如果是这样子，又怎么让罗四姐去当家？
How, then, could she manage Hu’s household?

心里有些疑问，却不暇细思，因为要回答七姑奶奶的话，
He had no time to examine the doubt, for he must answer.

“好得很。”
“It is excellent.

他说：“我听罗四姐说，是古太太一手经理的。”
Sister Luo tells me you arranged it all, Mrs Gu.”

“乌先生，”罗四姐不等他话完，便即说道：“你叫七姐，也叫七姑奶奶好了。”
Before he could finish, Luo said, “Please call her Seventh Sister, or the Seventh Lady.”

“好！
“Very well.

七姑奶奶，真是中帼英雄！”
Seventh Lady, you are a heroine among women!”

“怎么会想出这么一句话来？”罗四姐笑道：
“How did you think of that?” Luo laughed.

“恭维嘛，也要恭维得象才是。
“Even a compliment must fit.

七姐又不是‘白相人嫂嫂’，
Seventh Sister isn’t some adventurer’s wife.

怎么叫中帼英雄？”
Why call her a heroine?”

乌先生自己也觉得拟于不伦，
Mr Wu himself felt the comparison was misplaced.

便即说道：“我来之前，‘大书’说岳传，
“Before I came, the storytellers were performing the tale of Yue Fei.

正说梁红玉擂鼓破金兵，
They had reached Liang Hongyu beating the war drums to defeat the Jin.

‘中帼英雄’这句话听得多了，才会脱口而出。”
I heard ‘heroine among women’ so often that it slipped out.”


“乌先生喜欢听大书，明天我陪你。”
“If you enjoy storytelling, I shall take you tomorrow.”

古应春爱好此道，兴致勃勃他说：
Gu, a devotee himself, spoke eagerly.

“城隍庙的两档大书，一裆‘英烈’，一档‘水浒’，都是响档。
“Two performances at the City God Temple, one of Tales of Heroes and the other of Water Margin, are both celebrated.

乌先生不可错过机会。”
You must not miss the chance.”

“苏州话，”罗四姐说，
“They speak Suzhou dialect,” Luo pointed out.

“乌先生恐怕听不懂。”
“Mr Wu may not understand.”

“听得懂、听得懂。”
“I understand, I understand.”

乌先生接着用生硬的苏白说道：“阴立，白坐。”大家都笑了。
In stiff Suzhou speech, he added, “Yinli, baizuo.” Everyone laughed.

“乌先生不但懂。”古应春说：
“He not only understands,” Gu said.

“而且是内行。”
“He knows the business.”

原来“阴立、白坐”是“英烈、白蛇”的谐音，
The expressions were puns on Yinglie, Tales of Heroes, and Baishe, White Snake.

是书场里挖苦刮皮客的术语，
Story-house patrons used them to mock freeloaders.

有的阴阴地站在角落，不花一文听完一回书。名为“阴立”，
Some stood furtively in a corner and heard an entire episode without paying a copper: “shadow standing,” yinli.

有的大大方方坐在后面，看跑堂的要‘打钱“了，悄悄起身溜走，名为”白坐“。
Others sat quite openly at the back, then slipped away as soon as the attendant came to collect payment: “free sitting,” baizuo.

由于彼此同好，皆有喜遇知音之感，大谈“大书”，以及说书人的流派。
Discovering their shared enthusiasm, Gu and Mr Wu felt the pleasure of meeting a kindred spirit and talked at length about storytelling and its different schools.

罗四姐见此光景，轻轻向七姑奶奶说道：“乌先生这顿酒会吃到半夜，
Luo watched them, then said quietly to the Seventh Lady, “Mr Wu will be drinking until midnight.

我们离桌吧！”
Let us leave the table.”



胡雪岩
《灯火楼台》第六章（中）
Towers of Light — Chapter Six, Part Two
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


七姑奶奶亦正有此意。
The Seventh Lady had been thinking the same thing.

找个空隙，打断他们的谈锋，说了两句做女主人应有的门面话，与罗四姐双双席席。
Finding a pause, she interrupted the men's flow of talk with a few of the gracious remarks expected of a hostess, and the two women left the table.

七姑奶奶将她带到楼上卧室。这间卧室一直为罗四姐所欣赏，
She took Luo Sijie upstairs to her bedroom, which Luo had always admired.

因为经过古应春设计，改成西式，有个很宽敞的阳台，装置很大的玻璃门，门上加两层帷幕、一层薄纱、一层丝绒，
Gu Yingchun had redesigned it in the Western style, with a spacious balcony and large glass doors hung with two layers of curtains, one gauze and the other velvet.

白天拉开丝绒那一层，阳光透过薄纱，铺满整个房间，明亮华丽，令人精神一爽。
When the velvet curtains were drawn back by day, sunlight passed through the gauze and filled the room, making it bright, splendid, and wonderfully refreshing.

晚上坐在阳台上看万家灯火，亦别有一番情趣，
At night, the sight of countless lights from the balcony had a charm of its own.

尤其是象这种夏天，在阳台上纳凉闲谈，是最舒服不过的一件事。
In summer, especially, nothing could be more comfortable than sitting there in the cool air and talking.

“你是喝中国茶，还是喝洋茶？”
“Will you have Chinese tea or foreign tea?”

所谓“喝洋茶”是英国式的奶茶。
Foreign tea meant English tea with milk.

七姑奶奶有全套的银茶具，照英国规矩亲自调制，而且亲自为客人倒茶，颇为费事。
The Seventh Lady had a complete silver tea service and followed the English custom of preparing the tea herself and pouring it for her guests, a rather elaborate business.

罗四姐此刻要谈正事，无心欣赏“洋茶”，便即说道：
Luo, intent on discussing serious matters, had no mind to appreciate it.

“我想吃杯菊花茶。”
“I'd like a cup of chrysanthemum tea.”

黄白“杭菊花”可以当茶叶泡来喝，有清心降火之功，
The yellow and white Hangzhou chrysanthemums could be brewed like tea to calm the mind and dispel internal heat.

七姑奶奶笑着问道：“你大概心里很乱？”
“Is your mind rather unsettled?” the Seventh Lady asked with a smile.

“也不晓得啥道理，心里一直烦躁。”
“I don't know why, but I've been feeling restless all this time.”

“我们到阳台上来坐。”
“Let's sit out on the balcony.”

七姑奶奶挑到阳台上去密谈，是替罗四姐设想，
She chose the balcony out of consideration for Luo.

因为谈到自己的终身大事，她难免腼腆，阳台上光线幽暗，可以隐藏妞促的表情，就比较能畅所欲言了。
Discussing her own marriage was bound to make her shy; in the dim light she could conceal her embarrassment and speak more freely.


等小大姐泡了菊花茶来，背光坐着的罗四姐幽幽地叹口气说：
When the maid had brought their chrysanthemum tea, Luo, sitting with her face turned away from the light, gave a soft sigh.

“七姐只怕我真的是命中注定了。”
“Seventh Sister, perhaps it really is my destiny.”

“喔，”
“Oh?

七姑奶奶问道：“胡家托乌先生来作媒了，
The Hu family has asked Mr Wu to act as matchmaker.

他怎么说？”
What did he say?”

“他说的话也不晓得是真是假？
“I don't know whether to believe him.

说胡大先生的意思，要我去替他当家。”
He said Mr Hu wanted me to run his household.”

“不错，
“That's true.

这话应春也听见的。”
Yingchun heard him say it too.”

“这么说，看起来是真的！”
“Then it seems he really means it!”

罗四姐心里更加踏实，但心头的疑虑亦更浓重，
Luo felt more assured, yet her misgivings grew stronger.

“七姐，你说。 我凭啥资格去替他当家？”
“Tell me, Seventh Sister, what standing would I have to run his household?”

七姑奶奶心想，胡雪岩顾虑者在此，罗四姐要争者亦在此，
This, the Seventh Lady reflected, was precisely what troubled Hu Xueyan and what Luo meant to fight for.

足见都是厉害角色，不开口则已，一开口必中要害。
They were both formidable people: once either of them spoke, the words went straight to the heart of the matter.

不过，她虽然已从古应春口中摸透了“行情”，却不愿轻易松口，
Although Gu had already told her exactly how things stood, she was unwilling to commit herself too readily.

因为不知道罗四姐还会开什么条件，不能不谨慎行事。
She did not know what further conditions Luo might put forward, so caution was necessary.

于是她试探地问道：“四姐，你自己倒说呢？
“What do you think yourself?” she asked tentatively.

要啥资格，才好去替他当家。”
“What standing would you need to manage the household?”

“当家人的身分，
“It is the housekeeper's position that matters.

身分不高，下人看不起，
If your rank is low, the servants look down on you.

你说的话他左耳进、右耳出，
Everything you say goes in one ear and out the other.

七姐，你说，这个家我怎么当？”
Tell me, how could I run a household like that?”

“是的。这话很实在。
“Yes, that's a very practical consideration.

我想，我们小爷叔，不会不懂这个道理，
I don't suppose Little Uncle fails to understand it.

他总有让下人敬重你的办法。”
He will find some way to make the servants respect you.”


“啥办法？”罗四姐紧接着问，
“What way?” Luo asked at once.

“七姐夫怎么说？”
“What did Brother-in-Law Gu say?”

“他说，胡老太太托我来做媒。
“He said Old Madam Hu had asked me to act as matchmaker.

不过，我还不敢答应。”
But I haven't dared agree yet.”

罗四姐又惊又喜，
Luo was both startled and delighted.

“原来是胡老太太出面？”她问：
“So Old Madam Hu herself is behind this?

“胡太太呢？”
What about Mrs Hu?”

“他们家一切都是老太太作主。
“The old lady decides everything in their household.

胡太太最贤惠不过，
Mrs Hu is as virtuous as can be.

老太太说啥就是啥，百依百顺的。”
Whatever the old lady says, she accepts; she obeys her in everything.”

听得这一说，罗四姐心头宽松了些，
Luo felt easier on hearing this.

不过七姑奶奶何以不敢答应做媒？
But why had the Seventh Lady not dared accept the commission?

这话她却不好意思问。
She was too embarrassed to ask.

“我为啥不敢答应呢？”七姑奶奶自问自答他说：
“Why haven't I dared agree?” the Seventh Lady went on, answering her own question.

“因为我们虽然一见如故，象同胞姐妹一样，到底这是你的终身大事，
“Though we felt like old friends from the moment we met, as close as real sisters, this is still your marriage, a matter for your whole life.

你没有跟我详详细细谈过，我不晓得你心里的想法，
You haven't talked it over with me in detail, so I don't know exactly what you want.

如果冒冒失失答应下来，万一做不成这个媒，反而伤了我们感情。”
If I rashly agreed and then failed to arrange the match, it might end by hurting our friendship.”

“七姐，这一层你尽管放心。
“Seventh Sister, you can put that fear aside.

不管怎么样，你我的感情是不会伤的。”
Whatever happens, it will never hurt the friendship between us.”

“That gives me courage.

四姐，除了名分以外，还有啥？
Sister Luo, apart from your formal status, what else is there?

请你一样一样告诉我。
Tell me everything, one thing at a time.

看哪一样是我可以代为答应下来的，哪一样我能替你争的，哪一样是怎么样也办不到的。”
Then we can see what I can agree to on their behalf, what I can try to obtain for you, and what cannot possibly be done.”


“怎么佯办不到的事，我也不会说。”
“I wouldn't ask for anything impossible.”

罗四姐想了一下说：
Luo thought for a moment.

“七姐，我顶为难的是我老娘。”
“My mother is my greatest difficulty.”

她老娘何以会成为难题？
Why should her mother present a difficulty?

七姑奶奶想一想才明白，必是指的当亲戚来往这件事。
After a little thought, the Seventh Lady understood: Luo must mean whether the two families would acknowledge each other as relatives by marriage.

以她的看法，这件事是否为难，主要的是要看罗四姐自己的态度？
In her view, whether this became a problem depended chiefly on Luo's own attitude.

倘或她坚持要胡老太太叫一声“亲家太太”，这就为难了！
If she insisted that Old Madam Hu address her mother as a fellow mother-in-law, that would indeed be difficult.

否则胡家也容易处置。
Otherwise, the Hu family could easily manage it.

谈到这里，话就要明说了，
At this point, they had to speak plainly.

“四姐，你的意思我懂了。”她说：
“I understand what you mean.

“还有啥，
What else is there?

你一股脑儿说出来，我们一样一样来商量。”
Tell me everything, and we'll discuss the points one by one.”

“还有，你晓得的，我有个女儿。”
“Then there's my daughter, as you know.”

“你的女儿当然姓她老子的姓。”七姑奶奶说：
“Your daughter naturally bears her father's surname,” said the Seventh Lady.

“你总不见得肯带到胡家去吧？”
“Surely you wouldn't want to take her into the Hu household?”

“当然，
“Of course not.

那算啥一出？”
What sort of arrangement would that be?”

“既然不带到胡家，那就是你自己的事，
“Since you won't be bringing her into their household, she is your own concern.

不管你怎么安排，胡家都不便过问的。
Whatever arrangements you make, the Hu family would have no business interfering.

这件事可以不必谈，
We needn't discuss that.

还有啥？”
What else?”


“还有，我只能给老太太一个人磕头。”
“One more thing: I can kowtow to the old lady, but to no one else.”

“是不是！”七姑奶奶马上接口，
“There!” the Seventh Lady replied immediately.

“我不敢答应，
“That is just why I was afraid to agree.

就是怕你有这样的话，叫我说都不便去说的。”
I feared you might say something like this, a condition I couldn't even bring myself to put to them.”

罗四姐自己也觉得要求过分了一些，
Luo herself felt she had asked a little too much.

不过话既已出口，亦不便自己收回，因而保持沉默。
Having said it, however, she could hardly withdraw it of her own accord, so she remained silent.

当然，在七姑奶奶看，这就是不再坚持的表示，能商量得通的。
To the Seventh Lady, this naturally meant that she was no longer insisting and could be persuaded.

“四姐，我现在把人家的意思告诉你：
“Now let me tell you what the family proposes.

第一是称呼，下人部叫你太太，
First, the form of address: all the servants will call you Madam.

第二进门磕一个头，以后都是平礼，
Second, you will make the required kowtow when you first enter the household; after that, all greetings will be exchanged as between equals.

第三生了儿子着红裙。
Third, once you have borne a son, you may wear a red skirt.

这三洋，是老太大交代下来的。”
These three instructions come from the old lady herself.”

罗四姐考虑了一会，
Luo considered them for a while.

觉得就此三事而言，再争也争不出什么名堂来，
She felt that, on these three points, no amount of argument would gain her anything further.

不如放漂亮些，换取对方在他处的让步。
Better to concede gracefully and obtain concessions elsewhere.

于是她说：“七姐这么说，我听七姐的。
“If that is what you say, Seventh Sister, I'll accept your advice.

不过，我进他家的门，不晓得是怎么个进法？”
But how exactly am I to enter their household?”


七姑奶奶心想，这是明知故问。
The Seventh Lady thought that Luo knew the answer perfectly well.

妾侍进门，无非一乘一轿抬进门，在红烛高烧之下，一一磕头定称呼。
A concubine was carried into the house in an ordinary sedan chair and, before the blazing red candles, made the kowtows that established her rank and the proper forms of address.

罗四姐问到这话，意思是不是想要坐花轿进门呢？
Was Luo asking because she wanted to arrive in a decorated bridal chair?

当然，照一般的办法，是太委屈了她，但亦决无坐花轿之理。
Certainly the ordinary procedure would be too humiliating for her, but there could be no question of the bridal chair either.

七姑奶奶觉得这才真的遇见难题了。
Here, the Seventh Lady felt, was a real difficulty.

想了又想，七姑奶奶只能这佯回答：“这件事我来想办法，
After much thought, she could only say, “I'll try to find a way.

总归要让你面子上看得过去。
Whatever we do, it must preserve your dignity.

你明天倒问问乌先生，看他有啥好办法？”
Ask Mr Wu tomorrow and see whether he has a good idea.”

正事谈到这里，实在也可以说是很顺利了。
Their discussion had, in fact, gone very smoothly.

做媒本来就要往返磋商，一步一步将双方意见接近来，
Matchmaking always required negotiation back and forth, bringing the two sides closer step by step.

罗四姐也很明白事缓则圆的道理，
Luo understood that patience gave matters time to come right.

因而很泰然地答说：“事情不急，
“There's no hurry,” she answered calmly.

七姐尽管慢慢想。”
“Take your time thinking it over.”

“你是不急，小爷叔恐怕急着要想做新郎官。”
“You may not be in a hurry, but Little Uncle is probably eager to become a bridegroom.”

七姑奶奶笑着将她的脸扳向亮处，
With a smile, the Seventh Lady turned Luo's face toward the light.

“不晓得你装扮成新娘子，是个啥样子？”
“I wonder what you'll look like dressed as a bride.”

这话说得罗四姐心里不知是何滋味？
Luo could hardly have described the feelings this stirred in her.

说一句：“七姐真会寻开心。”一闪站起身来，
“You do love teasing me!” she said, springing to her feet.

“乌先生不知道吃好了没有？”
“I wonder whether Mr Wu has finished his dinner.”

“我们一起下去看看。”
“Let's go down together and see.”


两人携着手夏回楼下，只见古应春陪着乌先生在赏鉴那些西洋小摆设。
Hand in hand, they went downstairs, where Gu Yingchun was showing Mr Wu his little Western ornaments.

七姑奶奶少不得问些吃饭了没有之类的客气话，然后间到乌先生下榻之处。
The Seventh Lady made the customary inquiries about whether their guest had eaten enough, then asked where he was staying.

“客栈已经定好了。”古应春问道：
“His room at the inn has already been booked,” Gu said.

“不知道罗四姐今天晚上，是不是还有事要跟乌先生谈？”
“Does Sister Luo have anything else she wants to discuss with Mr Wu tonight?”

“今天太晚了。”
“It's too late tonight.

罗四姐答说：“有事明天也可以谈。”
Anything we need to discuss can wait until tomorrow.”

“那么，我送乌先生回客栈。
“Then I'll take Mr Wu back to his inn.

明天一早我会派人到客栈陪了乌先主到罗四姐那里。
First thing tomorrow, I'll send someone there to accompany him to your house.

下午我陪乌先生到各处逛逛。”
In the afternoon, I'll show him around.”

When Gu returned from seeing their guest home, the Seventh Lady was still awake, waiting to tell him about her conversation with Luo.

最后谈到罗四姐如何“进胡家的门”。
She ended with the question of how Luo was to enter the Hu household.

“To be carried in in a little chair and made to kowtow here, there, and everywhere—quite apart from the humiliation to Sister Luo, it would do us matchmakers no credit.”

“为小爷叔，没有面子也就算了。”古应春说：
“For Little Uncle's sake, we can put up with losing a little face,” Gu said.

“你不要把你的想法也摆进去，
“Don't add your own feelings to the problem.

那一来事情就越发摆不平了。”
That will only make it harder to settle.”

“Very well!

那么罗四姐，总要让他的面子过得去。”
But at least Sister Luo must be allowed to keep her dignity.”

“That's rather difficult.

又有里子，又要面子，世界上恐怕没有那么便宜的事。”
To get both the substance and all the outward honours—I'm afraid there are few bargains as good as that in this world.”

The Seventh Lady knew her husband had a point, but she had promised Luo a dignified arrangement and went on searching for a solution.

“睡吧！
“Go to sleep.

我累了。”
I'm tired,” Gu said.

古应春旅途劳顿，一上床，鼾声即起，
Exhausted by his journey, he began to snore as soon as he was in bed.

七姑奶奶却无法合眼，
She could not close her eyes.

最后终于想到了一个办法，而且自己觉得很得意，
At last she hit upon an idea of which she was particularly proud.

很想唤醒古应春来谈，却又不忍，只好闷在心里。
She wanted to wake him and discuss it, but could not bear to disturb him, so she kept it to herself.


第二天一早，古应春正在漱洗时，七姑奶奶醒了，掀开珠罗纱的帐子，探头说道：
Early the next morning, while Gu was washing, the Seventh Lady awoke, drew aside the gauze bed curtains, and poked out her head.

“不要紧了！
“It's all right now!

我有法子了。”
I've found a way.”

没头没脑一句话，说得古应春愣在那里，

好一会才省悟，
After a moment he understood.

“你是说罗四姐？”他问。
“You mean Sister Luo?”

“对。”
“Yes.”

一样可以坐花轿、着红裙。”
Then she can have both the decorated bridal chair and the red skirt.

What do you think?”

人家问起来怎么说？”
What will they say when people ask?”

“He can be heir to two family branches!” she answered at once.

“Who's going to investigate their genealogy?”

“There's something in that.

不知道小爷叔肯不肯？”
I wonder whether Little Uncle would agree.”

“肯不肯是他自己的事，
“That's for him to decide.

我们做媒人的，是有交代了。”七姑奶奶又说：
We matchmakers will at least have offered a solution.

“我想他也不会不肯的。”
Besides, I don't think he'll refuse.”

古应春考虑了一会，同意了她的办法，只问：“回到杭州呢？”
Gu considered the idea and agreed to it, asking only, “What happens when she goes back to Hangzhou?”

“照回门的办法，先到祖宗堂磕头，再见老太太磕头。”

是‘庙见’，
It's the formal presentation at the ancestral shrine.

这就抬举罗四姐的身分了。”
That would raise Sister Luo's standing.”

古应春深深点头：
Gu nodded emphatically.

“可以！”
“It could work.”

下半天，你问问乌先生，看他怎么说。”
Ask Mr Wu this afternoon and see what he says.”

至到你说‘走规’，这话是错了，
But you're wrong to say it's settled.

要小爷叔答应了才能定规。”
It can only be settled when Little Uncle agrees.”

古应春觉得不必如此匆促。
Gu thought there was no need for such haste.

不过，这一点他觉得也不必跟爱妻去争，反正是不是写了信，她也不会知道，
He also thought there was no need to argue with his beloved wife over it: she would not know whether he had written or not.

所以答应着说：“我会写。”
“I'll write,” he said.

Mr Wu visited Luo that morning.

下午由古应春陪着他，坐了马车去观光，一圈兜下来，乌先生自己提出要求，想到古家来吃晚饭，为的是谈罗四姐的亲事。
In the afternoon, Gu took him sightseeing by carriage, and when they had completed their tour, Mr Wu himself asked to dine at the Gu house so that they could discuss the marriage.

“I've talked to her.

她说她的意思，七姑奶奶都晓得。
She says the Seventh Lady knows what she wants.

不过，既然我是媒人，她说有些话，要我跟七姑奶奶来商量。

““是的。

乌先生你说。”
Please go ahead.”

不过，她的女儿，要胡太太认做子女儿，
But she wants Mrs Hu to take her daughter as a god-daughter.

将来要到胡家来的，下人要叫她‘干小姐’。
The girl will be visiting the Hu house, and the servants must address her as the family's young god-daughter.”

““胡太太的儿女，还要叫她妹妹。”七姑奶奶补充着，极有把握他说：
“And Mrs Hu's children must call her their younger sister,” the Seventh Lady added with complete confidence.

“这件事包在我身上。”
“Leave that to me.”

“The second point is more difficult.

她说七姑奶奶答应了她的，要我请问七姑奶奶，不晓得是啥办法？”
She says you made her a promise, and she has asked me to find out what arrangement you have in mind.”

“We have thought of one, but I can't commit us to it yet.

这个办法，一定要胡大先生点了头才能算数。”
Mr Hu must approve it before it can be agreed.”

“是的，
“Of course.

做媒本来要双方自己愿意，
In matchmaking, both parties must consent.

象七姑奶奶这样爽快有担当，肯代胡大先生作主，真是难得。”
It is rare to find someone so decisive and ready to take responsibility on Mr Hu's behalf as you are.

乌先生可说：“不过，先谈谈也不要紧。”
But there can be no harm in discussing it first.”


这件事很有关系，
The matter was consequential.

七姑奶奶心想，倘或自己说错了一句话，要收回或更改就不漂亮了，
If she herself said something wrong, the Seventh Lady thought, it would look awkward to withdraw or alter it.

不如让她丈夫去谈，自己在一旁察言观色，适时加以纠正或者补充，比较妥当。
Better to let her husband explain while she watched Mr Wu's expression and supplied a correction or addition at the right moment.

于是古应春便在她授意之下，讲他们夫妇这天清早商量好的办法。
At her prompting, Gu described the plan they had discussed that morning.

讲得一点不错，七姑奶奶认为无需作何修正。
He explained it perfectly, and she felt no need to amend anything.

倒是乌先生的态度，让她奇怪，
Mr Wu's manner, however, puzzled her.

只见他一面听，一面锁紧眉头，
As he listened, his brows drew together.

她不知道这是乌先生在用心思索一件事时，惯有的样子，只当他对这样的办法还不满意，心里不免大起反感。
She did not know this was simply his customary expression when thinking hard; she supposed that he was dissatisfied with their proposal and began to resent it.

于是等古应春讲完了，她冷冷地问：“乌先生觉得这个办法，还有啥欠缺的地方？”
When Gu had finished, she asked coldly, “What does Mr Wu find lacking in this arrangement?”

“不是欠缺，
“It isn't a matter of something lacking.

我看很不妥当。”
I think it is very inappropriate.”

这就连古应春都诧异了，
Now even Gu was astonished.

“乌先生，请你说个道理看。”
“Please tell us why.

他问“何以不妥当。”
What is inappropriate about it?”

“胡大先生现在是天下闻名的人，
“Mr Hu is famous throughout the country.

佩服他、赞成他的人很多，妒忌他、要他好看的人也不少。
Many people admire and support him, but plenty are jealous and would like to teach him a lesson.

万一京里的御史老爷参上一本，不得了。”
If one of the censors in the capital submitted an impeachment, it could cause serious trouble.”

“参上一本？
“An impeachment?

参胡大先生？”
Against Mr Hu?”

“这我就不懂。”七姑奶奶接着也说，
“I don't understand either,” the Seventh Lady put in.

“犯了啥错？御史要参他。”
“What wrong would he have committed for a censor to impeach him?”

“七姑奶奶，请你耐耐心，听我说……”
“Seventh Lady, please be patient and let me explain.”


原来乌先生的先世是杭州府钱塘县的刑房书办，已历四代，
Mr Wu's forebears had served as clerks in the criminal section of the Qiantang county office in Hangzhou Prefecture for four generations.

现在由乌先生的长兄承袭，
His eldest brother had now inherited the post.

《大清律例》是他的家学，对“户婚律”当然亦很熟悉，
The Great Qing Code was a family field of learning, and he was naturally familiar with its provisions on households and marriage.

所以能为古应春夫妇作一番很详细的解释。
He could therefore give the couple a detailed explanation.

他说，以“兼祧”为取“两头大”的借口，是刁俗如此，而律无明文，
Using succession to two family branches as a pretext for taking two wives of equal standing, he said, was a crafty practice established by custom, with no explicit basis in the code.

不过既然习俗相沿，官府亦承认的，只是兼祧亦有一定的规矩，
Since the custom had long been followed, the authorities did recognize it, but only under certain conditions.

如俗语所说的“两房台一子”，方准兼桃，
As the saying went, there must be “one son between two branches” before he could serve as heir to both.

这在胡雪岩的情形，显然不合。
Hu Xueyan's case plainly failed to meet that requirement.

“你们两位请想，
“Consider his title.

即称‘胡大先生’及有‘胡二先生’，
If there is an Eldest Mr Hu, there is also a Second Mr Hu.

好比合肥李家，有‘李大先生’李瀚章，就一定有‘李二先生’李鸿章。
It is like the Li family of Hefei: where there is an Eldest Mr Li, Li Hanzhang, there must be a Second Mr Li, Li Hongzhang.

胡大先生既然有兄弟，就可以承继给他无子的叔伯，
Since Mr Hu has brothers, one of them could be adopted as heir by a childless uncle.

何用他来兼祧？”
Why should he himself have to carry on two branches?”

“这话说得有道理，
“That makes sense.

‘胡大先生’这个称呼，就摆明了他是有兄弟的。”
Calling him Eldest Mr Hu shows plainly that he has brothers.”

古应春对他妻子说：“兼桃这两个字，无论如何用不上。”
Turning to his wife, Gu said, “Whatever else we do, we cannot invoke succession to two branches.”

“用不上就不能娶两房正室。
“And without that, he cannot take two principal wives.

一定要这么办，且不说大清律上怎么样，论官常先就有亏了，
If he insists, quite apart from what the Qing code may say, he will already have violated the standards expected of an official.

这叫做‘宠妾灭妻’，
This is called favouring a concubine at the expense of one's wife.

御史老爷一本参上去，事实俱在，逃都逃不了的。”
A censor need only submit an impeachment: the facts would be there, with no way of evading them.”


一听这话，七姑奶奶吓出一身冷汗，
The Seventh Lady broke into a cold sweat.

“真是亏得乌先生指点，”
“It's fortunate you explained this, Mr Wu.

她说，“差点做错了事情，害我们小爷叔栽个筋斗。”
I nearly made a mistake that could have brought Little Uncle down.”

“筋斗倒也栽不大，不过面子难看。”
“The fall would not be very serious, but it would look bad.

乌先生又说：“讲老实话，胡大先生还在其次，
To tell the truth, Mr Hu is my second concern.

我先要替罗四姐想一想，
I must think of Sister Luo first.

倘或因为她想坐花轿、穿红裙，弄出来这场麻烦，胡老太太、胡大先生一定很不高兴，
If her wish for a decorated bridal chair and a red skirt brought on all this trouble, Old Madam Hu and Mr Hu would certainly be displeased.

说风凉知的人就会说：‘一进门就出事，
Those inclined to sneer would say, ‘Trouble the moment she enters the house!

一定是个扫帚星。’
She must bring bad luck.’

七姑奶奶你倒想，罗四姐以后还好做人？”
Think how hard her life would be after that.”

“乌先生，你想得真周到，
“You have considered everything, Mr Wu.

见识真正高人一等。”
Your judgement is truly exceptional.”

七姑奶奶由衷的佩服，
The Seventh Lady's admiration was sincere.

“而且人家本来不知道罗四姐是啥身分，
“Besides, people might not originally have known her status.

这一来‘妾’的名声就‘卖朝报’了。”
Then the fact that she was a concubine would be hawked about like the Court Gazette.”

“卖朝报”是句杭州的俗话，还是南宋时候传下来的，
“Hawking the Court Gazette” was a Hangzhou expression handed down from the Southern Song.

老百姓的名字忽然在“朝报”上出现，一定出了新闻，
If an ordinary person's name suddenly appeared in the gazette, something newsworthy must have happened.

“卖朝报”的人为广招徕，必然大声吆喝，以至大街小巷，无人不知。
The sellers would shout it out to attract customers until everyone in every street and alley knew.

如果胡雪岩因为“宠妾灭妻”而奉旨申斥，上谕中就会有罗四姐的名字。
If Hu were reprimanded by imperial decree for favouring a concubine at his wife's expense, Luo's name would appear in the edict.

清朝的“宫门抄”就是南宋的“朝报”，所以七姑奶奶的这个譬喻，十分贴切。
The Qing Palace Gate Bulletin corresponded to the Southern Song Court Gazette, making the Seventh Lady's comparison especially apt.

“是啊！”乌先生说，
“Exactly,” Mr Wu said.

“那一来，不但杭州上海，到处都知道了，
“Then people everywhere would know, not just in Hangzhou and Shanghai.

真正叫做‘求荣反辱’。
She would truly have sought honour and gained disgrace.

我想我只要一说明白，罗四姐一定也懂的。”
I think she'll understand once I explain it clearly.”

“是，是！”
“Yes, yes!”

古应春忽忙接口，
Gu put in hastily.

“那就拜托先生跟罗四姐婉言解释。
“Then please explain it to her tactfully.

只要讲一层讲通了，我想我们的这个媒就做成功了。”
If we can settle this one point, I think our match will be made.”


罗四姐自然能够体谅其中的苦衷，但总觉得快快有不足之意，
Naturally Luo could appreciate the difficulty, but she still felt disappointed and dissatisfied.

不过对七姑奶奶极力帮她讲话出主意，非常感激，
At the same time, she was deeply grateful to the Seventh Lady for speaking up for her and trying so hard to find a solution.

因而也就更觉得可以说知心话，所以反而拿乌先生向她解释的话，来跟七姑奶奶商量。
Feeling all the more able to confide in her, she brought Mr Wu's explanation back for discussion.

“四姐，我想劝你一句话，
“Let me offer you a little advice,” the Seventh Lady said.

英雄不怕出身低，
“A hero need not fear a humble beginning.

一个人要收缘结果好，才是真正的风光。
It is a good outcome that brings real honour.

你不是心胸不开阔的人，不要再在这上头计较了。”
You aren't a narrow-minded woman; don't keep dwelling on this.

七姑奶又说：“我当你陪嫁的奶妈，送了你去，
I'll be your dowry wet nurse and go with you to your new home.

你看好不好？”
How would that be?”

江浙风俗，富家小姐出阁时，贴身的侍女、哺育的乳母，往往都陪嫁到夫家，而且保留着原来的称呼。
In Jiangsu and Zhejiang, when a girl from a wealthy family married, her personal maid and the wet nurse who had brought her up often accompanied her to her husband's home, retaining their old titles.

罗四姐听七姑奶奶用这样的说法，表示就算委屈，她亦愿意分担，
In putting it this way, the Seventh Lady was saying that, if there was humiliation to endure, she was willing to share it.

这份情意，求之于同胞姐妹，亦未见得必有，应该能够弥补一切了。
Such affection was not always to be found even between sisters of the same blood; it ought to make up for everything.

“七姐，”罗四姐眼圈红红他说：“我也不知道前世敲破了多少木鱼，今生才会认识你。”
“Seventh Sister,” Luo said, her eyes reddening, “I wonder how many wooden prayer fish I must have worn out in a previous life to earn the chance of knowing you in this one.”

“认识我没有啥了不得，
“Knowing me is nothing remarkable.

倒是你嫁我们小爷叔，真是前世修来的。”
Marrying Little Uncle is the blessing you earned in a former life.

七姑奶奶说：“做个女人家，无非走一步帮夫运，天大的本事，也是有限制的，
A woman can only help her husband prosper; however great her abilities, they have their limits.

丈夫是个阿斗太子，哪怕你是诸葛亮，也只好叹口气。
If her husband is an incapable Prince Adou, even a Zhuge Liang can do nothing but sigh.

我们小爷叔的本事，现在用出来的，不过十之二三，
Little Uncle has so far used only two or three tenths of his ability.

你能再把他那七、八分挖出来，你就是女人家当中第一等人物，
If you can bring out the remaining seven or eight tenths, you will rank among the finest of women.

何在乎名分上头？”
Why worry about formal status?”


听这一说，顿时激起罗四姐的万丈雄心，
These words awakened boundless ambition in Luo.

很兴奋他说：“七姐，我同你说心里的话，
“Seventh Sister, I'll tell you what I really think,” she said excitedly.

我自己也常在想，我如果是个男的，一样有把握创一番名堂出来，
“I've often thought that, if I were a man, I could certainly make something of myself.

只可惜是个女的。
It's just my misfortune to be a woman.

如今胡大先生虽说把个家交给我，我看他倒也并非一定只限制我把家当好了就好了，
Mr Hu says he is putting the household in my hands, but I don't think he necessarily means to limit me to keeping it in order.

在生意上头，如何做法，他也会听我的，
He will listen to my ideas about business too.

我倒很想下手试一试。”
I'd very much like to try my hand at it.”

“是的。”七姑奶奶很婉转他说：“不过，这到底在其次，
“Yes,” the Seventh Lady said tactfully, “though that comes second.

你出了主意，是好的，他一定会听，那就等于你自己在做，并不一定要你亲自下手。
If your ideas are good, he will certainly take your advice, and that amounts to doing the work yourself; you needn't carry it out with your own hands.

照我看，你的顶大的一桩生意是开矿，开人矿。
In my view, your greatest enterprise will be mining—mining a man's abilities.

这话你懂不懂？”
Do you understand?”

“不懂。七姐，”罗四姐笑道：“你的花样真多。”
“No.” Luo laughed. “You have so many tricks, Seventh Sister.”

“我是实实在在的话，
“I'm quite serious.

不是耍花佯。
This isn't a trick.

我刚刚说道，你要把我们小爷叔没有用出来的七、八分本事，把它挖出来。
As I just said, you must dig out the seven or eight tenths of Little Uncle's ability that he hasn't yet used.

如果你做得到，你就是开着了一座金矿！
If you can do that, you'll have opened a gold mine.

别的都算小生意了。”
Every other business will be a small affair beside it.”

罗四姐先当七姑奶奶是说笑话，
At first Luo had thought she was joking.

听完了细细思量，方始逐渐领悟，
Now she considered the words carefully and gradually understood.

庄容说道：“七姐，你的这番道理我懂了。
“I see what you mean,” she said gravely.

不过，以前我没有想到这一点，
“It hadn't occurred to me before.

只想到要逞自己的本事，
I thought only of showing what I could do myself.

现在才晓得，我要逞本事，一定要从胡大先生身上去下功夫。”
Now I understand that, to demonstrate my own ability, I must devote my efforts to bringing out Mr Hu's.”

“对啊！”
“Exactly!”

七姑奶奶高兴地拍着手说：
The Seventh Lady clapped her hands with pleasure.

“你到底聪明，
“You are clever, after all.

想得透，看得透。”
You can think things through and see to the heart of them.”


除了“迎亲”的花轿以外，其余尽量照“六礼”的规矩来办，
Only the decorated bridal chair for bringing her to her new home was omitted; in all other respects, the arrangements followed the Six Rites of marriage as closely as possible.

先换庚帖，然后下聘，
First they exchanged cards bearing the birth dates and hours; then came the betrothal gifts.

聘礼是两万现银，存在杭州阜康钱庄生息，供罗四姐为老娘养老之用，
The monetary gift was twenty thousand taels of ready silver, deposited with Fukang Bank in Hangzhou to earn interest for Luo to support her mother.

当然还有一座房子，仍旧置在螺狮门外。
There was a house as well, again bought outside Luosimen.

罗四姐在上海的新居，亦已过户在她名下，七姑奶奶所垫的房价及其他费用，自然是由胡雪岩结算。
Luo's new home in Shanghai had also been transferred into her name, and Hu naturally settled the purchase price and other expenses advanced by the Seventh Lady.

聘礼最重首饰，
Jewellery was the most important part of the betrothal gifts.

只得四样，不过较之寻常人家的八样，还更贵重，新穿的珠花、金刚钻的镯子、翡翠耳环、红玉簪子，
There were only four kinds, but they were more valuable than the eight kinds commonly given: newly strung pearl flowers, diamond bracelets, jade earrings, and red jade hairpins.

其实是罗四姐自己挑的。
Luo had chosen them herself.

胡雪岩关照古应春，请七姑奶奶陪罗四姐去选定了，叫珠宝店直接送到上海阜康钱庄，验货收款。
Hu had told Gu to ask the Seventh Lady to accompany her in making her selection, then have the jeweller deliver the pieces directly to the Shanghai branch of Fukang Bank for inspection and payment.


“四姐，应春昨天跟我说：你们情同姐妹，这一回等于我们嫁妹子，应该要备一份嫁妆。
“Yingchun said to me yesterday that, since we're as close as sisters, this is like marrying off a sister of our own, and we ought to provide a dowry.

这话一点不错。”七姑奶奶说：
He's quite right,” the Seventh Lady told Luo.

“我想，仍旧你自己去挑，
“I think you should choose that yourself too.

大家的面子，你尽管拣好的挑，不要客气。
For all our sakes, pick the best and don't stand on ceremony.

说老实话，几千两银子，应春的力量还有。”
To be frank, Yingchun can still afford a few thousand taels.”

罗四姐心想，只要嫁到胡家，将来一定有许多机会帮古应春的忙，借为补报，
Once she was married into the Hu family, Luo thought, there would be plenty of opportunities to help Gu and repay his kindness.

所以不必说客气话。
There was no need for polite refusals.

不过，也不好意思让他们多破费，
Still, she was embarrassed to let them spend too much.

因而这样答说：“七姐跟姐夫这番意思，我不能不领。
“I can't refuse such kindness from you and Brother-in-Law Gu.

不过，东西也不在乎贵重，
But things needn't be expensive.

只要欢喜就好，你说是不是？”
What matters is that one likes them, wouldn't you say?”

“正是。”
“Exactly.

七姑奶奶说：“先挑木器。
Let's choose the furniture first.

明天你空不空。”
Are you free tomorrow?”

“空。”
“Yes.”

“那就明天下半天。
“Then tomorrow afternoon.

仍旧到昌发去好了。”
We may as well go to Changfa again.”

昌发在南市，是上海最大的一家木器行，
Changfa Furniture Shop, in Nanshi, was the largest furniture firm in Shanghai.

罗四姐新居的家具，就是在那里买的，
Luo had bought the furnishings for her new home there.

“好！
“Good.

就是昌发。”
Changfa it is.

罗四姐说，“今天家里会有客人来，我要走了。”
I'm expecting a visitor at home today, so I must go.”

等七姑奶奶用马车将她送到家，
The Seventh Lady sent her home in her carriage.

罗四姐立即关照老马，另雇一辆马车，要带小大姐到南市去办事。
As soon as she arrived, Luo told Old Ma to hire another carriage: she wanted to take her maid to Nanshi on an errand.


到得南市在昌发下车，老板姓李，一见老主顾上门，忽忙亲自迎了出来招呼：
When she alighted at Changfa in Nanshi, the owner, Mr Li, recognized his regular customer and hurried out to greet her himself.

“罗四小姐，今天怎么有空？
“Miss Luo, what brings you here today?

请里面坐，
Do come inside.

里面坐。”
Please, come in.”

“我来看堂木器。”
“I've come to look at a set of furniture.”

“喔，喔！”
“Ah, yes!”

李老板满脸堆笑，
Mr Li was all smiles.

“是哪里用的？”
“What room is it for?”

“房间里。”
“The bedroom.”

所谓“房间里”是指卧房，首要的就是一张床，但既称“一堂”，当然应该还有几椅桌凳之类，
A bedroom set meant, first and foremost, a bed, but since she wanted a whole set, it should naturally include tables, chairs, and stools as well.

李老板便先间材料，
Mr Li began by asking about the material.

“罗四小姐喜欢红木，还是紫檀？”
“Would you prefer hongmu rosewood or zitan, Miss Luo?”

“当然是紫檀。”
“Zitan, of course.”

“罗四小姐，你既然喜欢紫檀，我有一堂难得的木器，
“If you like zitan, I have a remarkable set.

不可错过机会。”
You mustn't miss the opportunity.”

“好！
“Very well.

我来看看。”
Let me see it.”


李老板将她领入后进一个房间，
Mr Li led her into a room at the back.

进门便觉目眩，原来这些紫檀木器，以螺甸嵌花，有耀眼的反光，以致眩目。
The moment she entered, she was dazzled: the zitan furniture was decorated with mother-of-pearl inlay, which caught the light in brilliant flashes.

细细看去，华丽精巧，实在可爱，
On closer inspection, the pieces were splendid, delicately worked, and very appealing.

“这好象不是本地货色。”罗四姐说：
“This doesn't look like local work,” Luo said.

“花样做法部不同。”
“The designs and workmanship are different.”

“罗四小姐，到底是顶瓜瓜的行家，”李老板说：
“You really are a first-rate judge, Miss Luo.

“一眼就只透了。
You saw it at a glance.

这堂木器是广东来的，
This set came from Guangdong.

广东叫酸枝，就是紫檀。
They call the wood suanzhi there; it's what we call zitan.

光是广东来的不稀奇，
But coming from Guangdong is nothing extraordinary.

另外还有来历，说出来，罗四小姐，你要吓一跳。”
It has a history that will astonish you.”

“为啥？”
“Why?”

“这本来是进贡的……”“进贡的？”罗四姐打断他的话说：
“It was originally made as tribute—” “Tribute?” she interrupted.

“你是说，原来是皇帝用的。”
“You mean it was originally for the emperor?”

“不错。”
“Exactly.”

“李老板，”罗四姐笑道：“你说大话不怕豁边？
“Mr Li,” she said with a laugh, “aren't you afraid a boast like that will burst at the seams?

皇帝用的木器，怎么会在你店里？”
How could furniture meant for the emperor end up in your shop?”

“喏，罗四小姐，你不相信是不是？
“You don't believe me, do you?

其中当然有个道理。
There is naturally an explanation.

你请坐下来，等我讲给你听。”
Please sit down and let me tell you.”


李老板请罗四姐在一张交椅上坐了下来，自己在下首相陪。
Mr Li invited her to sit in an armchair and took a lower place beside her.

他很会做生意，用的伙计、徒弟亦很灵活，
He was an able businessman, and his clerks and apprentices were quick to act.

等罗四姐刚刚坐定，现泡的盖碗茶与四个高脚果碟，已经送了上来。
She had scarcely sat down before freshly brewed tea in a covered bowl and four stemmed fruit dishes were brought in.

罗四姐存心要来买木器，生意一定做得成，所以对昌发的款待，但然接受，连道声谢都没有。
Luo had come intending to buy furniture, and a sale was certain, so she accepted Changfa's hospitality without ceremony or even a word of thanks.

“罗四小姐，请你先仔细看看东西。”
“First, please take a good look at the pieces, Miss Luo.”

她原有此意。
She had intended to do just that.

因为所坐的那张交椅，小巧玲珑，高低正好，靠背适度，
The armchair was compact and elegant, at exactly the right height, with a well-proportioned back.

一坐下来双时自然而然地搭在扶手上，非常舒服，
As soon as she sat down, her elbows rested naturally on the arms; it was extremely comfortable.

本就想仔细看一看，所以听得这话，便低头细细赏鉴，
Now she bent her head to examine it closely.

工料两精，毫无瑕疵。
Both the material and the craftsmanship were excellent, without a flaw.

看完交椅，再看椅旁的长方套几，
After the chair, she studied the rectangular nesting tables beside it.

一共三层，推拢了不占地位，拉开了颇为实用，
There were three, taking up little space when pushed together and proving very useful when drawn out.

一碗茶，四只果碟摆在上面，一点都不湿得挤。
The tea bowl and all four fruit dishes stood on them without the least crowding.

“东西是好的。”罗四姐说：
“The pieces are good,” Luo said.

“不过花样不象宫里用的，
“But the design doesn't look like palace furniture.

宫里用的应该是龙凤，不应该是‘五福捧寿，。”
Surely palace pieces should have dragons and phoenixes, not ‘Five Blessings Supporting Longevity.’”



胡雪岩
《灯火楼台》第六章（下）
Towers of Light — Chapter Six, Part Three (conclusion)
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


“罗四小姐，你驳得有道理，
“Your objection is reasonable, Miss Luo.

不过你如果晓得用在哪里，你就不会驳了。

宫殿有各式各样的宫殿，何止三宫六院？

看地方，看用场，陈设大不相同，
The furnishings differ greatly according to the place and its purpose.

通通是龙凤的花佯，千篇一律，看都看厌了。

你说，是不是呢？

““话倒也不错。

The scheme had been discussed privately for several months.

当政的恭亲王大不以为然，不过不便说破，
Prince Gong, who was directing the government, strongly disapproved but could not say so openly.

意思是希望慈禧太后自动打消这个念头。
He hoped Cixi would abandon the idea herself.

慈禧太后不便庇护，准如所请，
Cixi could hardly protect him and granted the request.

那知府就此下狱。
The prefect was imprisoned.

押运的是那知府的胞弟，将木器卸在上海变卖，

Choose another shop.”

“怎么不上路？”
“What did he do?”

“ 他，”
“He…”

七姑奶奶想一想说：
She paused.

“硬要我八百两银子。”
“He insisted on eight hundred taels.”

“你照付了没有呢？”
“Did you pay?”

“你倒想！”
“What do you think?”

七姑奶奶预先付过“差价”，是告诉过古应春的，
She had told Gu about paying the difference in advance.

他心里在想，李老板的生意做得很大，而且人虽精明，却很讲信用，
He knew that Mr Li had a large business and, though shrewd, was reliable.

似乎不至于硬吞二百两银子，
It seemed unlikely that he would simply pocket an extra two hundred taels.

其中或者另有缘故，
Perhaps there was another explanation.

只是当着罗四姐，不便深谈，只好沉默。
With Luo present, however, Gu could not pursue the matter and remained silent.


于是罗四姐便劝七姑奶奶说：
Luo tried to soothe her friend.

“七姐，东西实在是好的，
“The furniture really is good, Seventh Sister.

八百两银子是真正不贵。
Eight hundred taels is very reasonable.

你先消消气，
Calm down first.

我要好好跟你商量，这堂木器有个用法。”
I want to discuss a use I have in mind for it.”

七姑奶奶正要答话，让小大姐进来打断了。她是来通报，李老板来了，要见七姑奶奶。
Before the Seventh Lady could reply, the maid came in to announce that Mr Li had arrived and wished to see her.

“不见。”
“I won't see him.”

“我见。”古应春接口，
“I will,” Gu said.

“等我来问他。”
“Let me question him.”

去了不多片刻，古应春笑嘻嘻地回进来，手里拿着个红封套，
He returned shortly afterwards, smiling broadly and carrying a red envelope.

七姑奶奶接过来一看，
The Seventh Lady took it.

封套签条上写“贺仪”二字，下面是李老板具名，
On the label were the words “Wedding Gift,” with Mr Li's name below.

贺仪是一张二百四十两的银票。
Inside was a banknote for two hundred and forty taels.

“这算啥？”
“What is this supposed to mean?”

“不是送你的。”古应春说：
“It is not for you,” Gu said.

“你不是告诉我，罗四姐要做新娘子了，
“You told me Miss Luo was to be a bride, didn't you?

人家是送喜事的贺礼。
This is his wedding present.”

“听这一说，七姑奶奶与罗四姐相顾愕然，事出突兀，都用眼色催古应春说下去，
Taken completely by surprise, the two women exchanged bewildered looks, then urged him with their eyes to go on.

但古应春却是一副忍俊不禁的神气。
But Gu seemed barely able to contain his laughter.

“你笑啥？”七姑奶奶白了丈夫一眼，
His wife gave him a sharp look. “What are you laughing at?

“快说啊！”
Tell us!”

“怎么不要好笑？
“How could I not laugh?

这种事也只有你们心思用得深的人，才做得出来。”
Only people who think as deeply as you two could manage something like this.”


古应春看了罗四姐一眼，向妻子说道：“你晓得这堂木器多少钱？
Gu glanced at Luo, then told his wife, “Do you know what the furniture costs?

一千二百两。”
Twelve hundred taels.”

“晴！”罗四姐叫了起来，
“Oh!” Luo exclaimed.

“七姐夫，李老板告诉你了？”
“Brother-in-Law Gu, he told you?”

“当然告诉我了，
“Of course.

不然，他另外收了二百两银子的定洋，硬不认帐，这话怎么交代呢？”
How else could he explain taking a further two hundred as deposit and then flatly refusing to acknowledge it?”

“啊？”罗四姐问说：“七姐，你已付过他二百两？”
“You had already paid him two hundred, Seventh Sister?”

七姑奶奶愣了一下，弄明白是怎么回事了，
The Seventh Lady stared for a moment, then understood.

反问一句：“你先付过他四百两？”
“And you had paid four hundred first?”

“是的。”
“Yes.”

“为啥？”
“Why?”

“我不愿意你太破费。”
“I didn't want you to spend too much.”

“两个人走到一条路上来了。”七姑奶奶哈哈大笑，
The Seventh Lady burst out laughing. “We both took the same road!

“我晓得你不愿意我太破费，所以预先付了他二百两。
I knew you didn't want me to spend too much, so I paid him two hundred beforehand.

我道呢，哪里有这么便宜的东西！”
I was wondering how such fine things could be so cheap.”

罗四姐也觉得好笑，
Luo found it amusing too.

“七姐夫说得不错，
“Brother-in-Law Gu is right.

心思用得太深，才会做出这种事来。
Only people who think too hard would do this.

你瞒我，我瞒你，大家都钻到牛角尖里去了。
I kept it from you; you kept it from me; we both reasoned ourselves into a corner.

不过，”她说：“李老板也不大对，
Still, Mr Li was not quite right either.

当时他就让二百两好了，何苦害七姐白白生一场气。”
Why didn't he simply take two hundred less at the time, instead of making you angry for nothing?”

“他也有他的说法。”古应春接口答道：
“He has an explanation,” Gu replied.

“我拿李老板的话照佯说一遍。
“Let me repeat his words.

他说：那位罗四小姐，看起来是很厉害的角色，
He said, ‘That Miss Luo looks a very formidable woman.

我不能不防她，
I had to be on my guard.

收条上写明白，报价只能报八百两，改口的话，加倍退还定洋，
The receipt expressly says I must quote eight hundred taels, and if I change my words I must return double the deposit.

万一我改了口，罗四小姐拿出收条，一记‘翻天印，打过来，
Suppose I altered the price, and she produced the receipt and struck me with it like the Heaven-Overturning Seal?

我没话说，
I would have no defence.

所以我当时不松口，
That is why I would not give way.

宁可得罪了古太太，事后来赔罪。“
I preferred to offend Mrs Gu and come afterwards to apologize.’”


七姑奶奶前嫌尽释，
The Seventh Lady's resentment vanished.

高兴地笑道：“这个人还算上路，
“He does know how to behave, after all,” she said happily.

还多送了四十两贺礼。”
“He has even added forty taels as a wedding gift.”

说着将红封套递给罗四姐。
She handed the red envelope to Luo.

“我不要。”
“I don't want it.

罗四姐不肯接，“不是我的。”
It isn't mine.” Luo refused to take it.

“莫非是我的？”
“Then is it mine?

七姑奶奶开玩笑：“又不是我做新娘子。”
I am not the one becoming a bride!” the Seventh Lady joked.

罗四姐窘笑着，仍旧不肯接，七姑奶奶的手也缩不回去，
Luo smiled in embarrassment but still refused, leaving her friend's hand suspended between them.

古应春说：“交给我。
“Give it to me,” Gu said.

二百两是退回来的定洋，四十两送的贺礼，
“Two hundred is the returned deposit, and forty is the wedding gift.

我叫人记笔帐在那里。”
I shall have them entered in the accounts.”

于是七姑奶奶将红封套交了给古应春，接着便盛赞那堂酸枝嵌螺甸的家具，
His wife handed him the envelope, then began praising the suanzhi furniture with its mother-of-pearl inlay.

认为一千二百两银子，实在也不算贵。
Even twelve hundred taels, she thought, was not too much for it.


由此便谈到这堂木器的来历，
They went on to discuss the furniture's history.

它之贵重，已经不能拿银子多寡来论了。
Its value could no longer be measured simply in silver.

罗四姐因此有个想法，
Luo had therefore formed a plan.

觉得自己用这堂木器，虽说出于“陪嫁”，亦嫌过分，难免遭人议论；
Even if it were part of her dowry, such a set seemed too grand for her own use and might attract criticism.

因而私下跟七姑奶奶商量，打算把这堂木器，孝敬胡老太太。
She privately proposed to the Seventh Lady that she present it to Old Madam Hu.

“我这个念头，是听了李老板的一句话才转到的，
“It was something Mr Li said that gave me the idea.

他说：有个江西的未道台，想买这堂木器孝敬一位总督的老太太。
A Circuit Intendant Zhu from Jiangxi had wanted to buy it for a governor-general's mother.

我心里就在想，将来我用这堂木器，胡老太太用的不及我，我用了心里也不安。
I thought: if I use it and Old Madam Hu's furniture is not as fine, I shall feel uncomfortable.

倒不如借花献佛，做个人情。
Better to offer borrowed flowers to the Buddha and turn it into a gift.

七姐，你不会怪我吧？”
You won't blame me, will you, Seventh Sister?”

“哪里，哪里：”
“Of course not.”

七姑奶奶异常欣慰地，
The Seventh Lady was deeply pleased.

“说实话，你这样子会做人，我就放心了。
“To tell the truth, seeing how well you understand people sets my mind at rest.

胡家人多口杂，
There are so many people and so much gossip in the Hu household.

我真怕你自己觉得行得正、坐得正，性子太直了，会得罪人。”
I was afraid you might feel that, since you had done nothing wrong, you could be too outspoken and offend them.”

“得罪人是免不了的。
“One cannot avoid offending people.

只要有几个人不得罪就好了。
As long as certain people are not offended, that is enough.

譬如胡老太太，一定要伺候得好。”
Old Madam Hu, for instance, must be very well attended to.”

七姑奶奶暗暗点头，
The Seventh Lady nodded inwardly.

心里在想，罗四姐一定懂。挟天子以令诸侯‘的道理，
Luo must understand the principle of holding the emperor in one's power to command the feudal lords, she thought.

不但会做人，还会做“官”，
Luo knew not only how to deal with people but how to practise the art of government.

替她担心，实在是多余的。
Worrying about her had been quite unnecessary.



胡雪岩
《灯火楼台》第七章（全章，至本卷结束）
Towers of Light — Chapter Seven (complete; end of volume)
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第七章 帮夫运｜CHAPTER SEVEN: A WIFE WHO BRINGS HER HUSBAND PROSPERITY


自从罗四姐嫁到到胡家，真是走了一步帮夫运，
Once Luo Sijie married into the Hu household, she truly entered upon a fortune that advanced her husband.

胡雪岩的事业如《红楼梦》上所形容的“鲜花着锦”般兴旺。
Hu Xueyan's enterprises flourished like “fresh flowers upon brocade,” as Dream of the Red Chamber puts it.

当然，兴旺的由来是他恃左宗棠为靠山，左宗棠视他为股肽，
Their prosperity, of course, rested on Zuo Zongtang's support, while Zuo regarded Hu as his indispensable right hand.

只要左宗棠西征，节节胜利，所请在朝廷无有不准，胡雪岩水涨船高，亦就事事顺手了。
As the western campaign advanced from victory to victory and the court granted every request Zuo made, Hu rose with the tide and found everything going smoothly.

原来从道光年问开始，君暗臣愚，激出内忧外患，
Since the Daoguang reign, benighted rulers and foolish ministers had provoked troubles at home and abroad.

西北的回民起义，亦是贪官污吏激荡而成。
The Muslim uprisings in the northwest had likewise been stirred up by corrupt officials.

其时所谓“甘回”共有西、南北三大支，三大首领，
The forces then known as the Gansu Muslims fell into three main divisions, western, southern and northern, with three principal leaders.

西面的叫马朵之，驻扎在青海的西宁，
In the west was Ma Duozhi, based at Xining in Qinghai.

南面的叫马占鳌，以甘肃与青海的河州，也就是临夏为根据地，
In the south was Ma Zhan'ao, whose base was Hezhou, also called Linxia, in the Gansu–Qinghai region.

北面叫马化龙，是三大首领中最厉害的一个，
The northern leader, Ma Hualong, was the most formidable of the three.

势力范围在宁夏、灵武一带，根据地名为金积堡，
His influence extended over Ningxia and Lingwu, and his stronghold was Jinjibao.

这个地方就是“黄河百害，惟富一套”的河套的起点，
