这自然是人家看重的缘故，胡雪岩不免得意，
It was plainly a sign of the sender’s high regard, and Hu could not help feeling pleased.

想了一下说∶『他不晓得住在哪里？
After a moment’s thought, he said, “I wonder where he is staying.

今天晚了，来不及了，
It is too late today.

明天一大早，我同你先去拜访。
First thing tomorrow morning, you and I should go and call on him.

这也是我们做主人该尽的道理。』
That is only proper, since we are the hosts.”

『他住在梅藤更那里。』
“He is staying with Dr Meitenggeng.”

梅藤更是个英国教士，也是医生，到杭州传教，在中城大方伯开了一家医院；
Meitenggeng was an English missionary and physician who had come to Hangzhou to preach and established a hospital at Dafangbo in the center of the city.

大方伯这个地方有一座桥，在宋朝叫广济桥，因此这家医院题名就用了双关的『广济』二字。
There was a bridge there that had been called Guangji Bridge in the Song dynasty, and the hospital took the same name, Guangji, which also conveyed the idea of bringing help to all.

梅藤更开设广济医院时，胡雪岩捐过一大笔钱，所以他跟梅藤更亦算是老朋友，
Hu had made a large donation when the hospital was founded and could count the doctor as an old friend.

当即说道∶『既然是住在梅藤更那里，我派人去通知一声，请他转告赫德，说我们明天一早去看他，请他问一问赫德什么时候方便。』
“Since he is staying there,” he said, “I shall send someone to ask the doctor to tell Hart that we will call tomorrow morning, and to find out what time would suit him.”

『不必叫人去。
“There is no need to send anyone.

好在晚上去看医生，不算冒昧，
Calling on a doctor in the evening cannot be considered improper.

我自己去一趟，比较稳当。』
I shall go myself; it will be more satisfactory.”


『也好！
“Very well.

辛苦，辛苦。』
Thank you for the trouble.

胡雪岩问道∶『你吃了饭没有？』
Have you eaten?”

『忙得肚子饿都忘记了。
“I have been so busy I forgot to be hungry.

实在也不饿。』
In fact, I am not hungry now.”

『我也不饿，
“Neither am I.

我等你一来一起吃。』
I shall wait for you, and we can eat together when you return.”

『好！』
“Good.”

『瑞香，你送古才爷下去。』胡雪岩忽又问道∶『这礼是啥辰光送来的？』
“Ruixiang, show Mr Gu down.” Then Hu suddenly asked, “When did these presents arrive?”

『未末申初。』瑞香答说∶『梅院长派人送来的。』
“About three in the afternoon,” Ruixiang replied. “Dr Mei sent someone with them.”


『那个时候！』
“At that hour!”

胡雪岩蹙着眉说∶『照道理要送席。』
Hu frowned. “We ought, properly, to have sent over a banquet.”

『席是没有送。』瑞香接口，
“We did not send a banquet,” Ruixiang put in.

『送了个一品锅、四样点心，还有一篓水蜜蟠桃。
“But we sent a first-class hotpot, four kinds of pastries, and a basket of juicy flat peaches.

太太叫我包了一个八封的赏封，打发来人，
Madam had me prepare a gratuity envelope for the messenger [the amount is corrupt in the source].

请他告诉梅院长，我们老爷在灵隐，所以不晓得这位洋大人的身分，不过总归是我们老爷的好朋友。
She told him to explain to Dr Mei that our master was at Lingyin and therefore did not know who this foreign dignitary was, but that he must in any case be a good friend of our master’s.

梅院长是象自己人一样的，请他费心代为款侍，
Dr Mei was like one of the family, and we asked him to take the trouble to entertain the guest on our behalf.

明天我们老爷回来了，再当面同他道谢。』
When our master returned tomorrow, he would thank him in person.”

瑞香咭咭呱呱一口气说下来，事情交代得清清楚楚；
Ruixiang rattled it all off in one breath, setting out everything clearly.

胡雪岩觉得螺蛳太太处置得颇为得体，
Hu thought Madam Luosi had handled the matter most suitably.

很满意地说∶『亏得我不叫她到灵隐去，
“A good thing I did not have her come to Lingyin,” he said with satisfaction.

不然，没有人料理得来。』
“Otherwise there would have been no one capable of attending to it.”

『也亏得强将手下无弱兵。』
“A good thing, too, that a strong commander has no weak soldiers.”

瑞香听出来是在夸赞她，古应春嫣然一笑，随即把头别了开去。
Ruixiang recognized Gu’s compliment, smiled prettily at him, then turned her head away.

古应春也笑，笑得眼角露出两条鱼尾纹。
Gu smiled as well, two crow’s-feet showing at the corners of his eyes.

等瑞香送了古应春回来，向胡雪岩说道∶『面想来不要了。
When Ruixiang returned from seeing him out, she said to Hu, “I suppose you will not want the noodles now.

我已经关照小厨房，弄几样精致爽口的菜；
I have told the small kitchen to prepare a few delicate, refreshing dishes.

请老爷的示，在哪里开饭？』
Where would you like dinner served?”


『就在这里好了。』胡雪岩又说∶『我倒不晓得你这么凶！
“Here will do,” Hu replied. Then he added, “I had no idea you were so vicious!

女人厉害，可以；
A woman may be formidable; that is all very well.

凶，不可以，自己吃亏。』
But viciousness will only hurt her in the end.”

『太太当家，
“Madam runs the household.

总要有个人来替她做恶人。
Someone has to play the villain for her.

莫非倒是太太自己来做恶人，我们在旁边替人家说好话？』
Would you have her be the villain herself while we stand by putting in kind words for everyone?”

胡雪岩觉得她的话竟无可驳；
Hu could find no answer to that.

想了一下说∶『就做恶人也犯不着撒蠢；
After a moment’s thought he said, “Even if you must play the villain, there is no need to behave like a fool.

什么小Ｘ不小ＸＸ，难听不难听？』
Those filthy insults you used—do you not hear how ugly they sound?”

瑞香涨红了脸，
Ruixiang flushed.

欲待分辩，却又实在没有理由，以致于僵在那里有些手足无措的模样。
She wanted to defend herself but could think of no excuse, and stood rooted to the spot, at a loss what to do.


胡雪岩便又掉了一句文∶『「人必自悔而后人侮之。」』
Hu offered a literary quotation. “‘A person must first demean herself before others will demean her.’

他说∶『如果人家回你一句∶我「小」你「大」！
Suppose she had turned your own obscenity back on you,” he went on.

你一个大青娘，脸上挂得住、挂不住？』
“How would a young woman like you have held up her head?”

杭州人叫妙龄女郎为『大青娘』，是最多悉善感的时候；
In Hangzhou, the expression he used referred to a girl in the bloom of youth, the age at which feelings were most tender and easily stirred.

瑞香又羞又悔，
Ruixiang was ashamed and remorseful.

眼圈红红的，要哭出来了。
Her eyes reddened, and she was on the verge of tears.

『咦，咦，咦！』胡雪岩大为诧异，
“Why, why, why!” Hu exclaimed in astonishment.

『你叫人家不准哭，自己倒要哭了，
“You forbade her to cry, and now you are about to cry yourself.

为啥？
What is the matter?

莫非我的话说得重了。』
Have I spoken too harshly?”

一听这话，瑞香顿时收泪，
At once Ruixiang checked her tears.

抽出腋下的一方白纺绸绣一枝瑞香花的手绢，擤一擤鼻子答说∶『哪个哭了。』
She drew from beneath her arm a white silk handkerchief embroidered with a spray of daphne, the flower whose Chinese name was her own, and blew her nose. “Who is crying?”

『不哭最好，
“Best not to cry.

你把牙牌拿来，再到前面看看，坐席坐到啥光景了？』
Bring me the dominoes, then go out front and see how far the dinner has got.”


瑞香答应着，取出一盒牙牌，倒在红木方桌上，然后下了阁子。
Ruixiang fetched a box of ivory dominoes, tipped them onto the square rosewood table, and went downstairs.

胡雪岩一个人拿牙牌『通五关』打发辰光连着几副不通，便换了起数问前程。
Left alone, Hu played “Passing the Five Gates” to while away the time. After several unsuccessful rounds, he turned from the game to divination, seeking a sign of his future.

于是照牙牌神数的歌诀∶『全副牙牌一字开，中间看有几多开，连排三次分明记，上下中平内取裁。』头一次得了十六开，第二次更多，竟有廿一开，第三次却只得一副对子，一副分相，共计六开。
Following the rhyme for consulting the domino oracle—“Lay the full set out in line; count the openings that you find; three successive layouts mark, then judge the high, the low, the middle”—he counted sixteen openings in the first layout, twenty-one in the second, but in the third only one matched pair and one unmatched combination, six openings in all.


胡雪岩是弄熟了的，
Hu knew the method well.

一算是『上上、上上、中下』。
He worked out the result as “highest auspice, highest auspice, lower middle.”

诗句也还约略记得，但『解』与『断』，却须找书来看。
He could more or less remember the verse, but he needed the book for its “Explanation” and “Judgment.”

找到『兰闺清玩』的『牙牌神数』，翻开来一看，那着诗是『一帆风顺及时扬，稳度鲸川万里航，
Finding the section on the domino oracle in Elegant Pastimes of the Ladies’ Chamber, he opened it and read: “With a fair wind, hoist your sail in time; / Cross safely the whale’s vast waters, ten thousand miles.

若到帆随湘转处，下坡骏马早收缰。』
/ Should you reach the turn where the sail follows the Xiang, / Rein in the gallant horse before it takes the downward slope.”

一面念，一面心想∶『有点意思。』
As he recited it, he thought, “There is something in that.”

再往下看，『解曰∶谋为勿忧煎，
He read on: “Explanation: Do not torment yourself over your undertakings.

成全在眼前，
Their fulfillment lies before your eyes.

施为无不利，到处要周旋。』
Whatever you attempt will prosper, but everywhere you must handle others tactfully.”

看到最后一句，不由得蓦然一拍桌子，大声自语∶『今天这个数起得神了！』
At the last phrase, he suddenly slapped the table and exclaimed, “Today’s reading is uncannily accurate!”

语声刚终，有人接口∶『你在作啥？』
He had scarcely finished when someone asked, “What are you doing?”

抬眼看时，前面螺蛳太太手扶小丫头的肩，正踏进门来，后面跟着瑞香。
Looking up, he saw Madam Luosi entering with a hand on a little maid’s shoulder; Ruixiang followed behind.

『客散了？』
“Have the guests gone?”


『还没有，不过每桌都有人陪。』螺蛳太太说∶『我是听说七姐夫来了又出去了，
“Not yet, but every table has someone to attend to it,” Madam Luosi replied. “I heard that Brother-in-law Gu had come back and gone out again.

不知道是不是有啥要紧的事，所以我特别来看看—』『他到梅藤更那里去了，
I wondered whether something important had happened, so I came specially to see.” “He has gone to Dr Meitenggeng’s.

说一句话就回来的。』
He will be back as soon as he has had a word with him.”

胡雪岩接着又往下看『解』了以后的『断』。
Hu then went on to the “Judgment” that followed the “Explanation.”



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第一章（本章第3部分，共4部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


『断曰∶黄节晚香，清节可贵，
“Judgment: The yellow bloom gives its fragrance late; unsullied integrity is precious.

逝水回波，急流勇退。』
Flowing water swirls back upon itself: have the courage to withdraw from the swift current.”

最后这四个字，胡雪岩是懂得；
Hu understood that final injunction perfectly.

而且这也正是内则老母、外则良友在一再劝他的。
It was precisely what his mother at home and his good friends outside had repeatedly urged him to do.

此刻不自觉地便仔细想了下去。
Without quite realizing it, he began to ponder it closely.

螺蛳太太也常看他起数，但都不似此刻这么认真，而且是上了心事的模样，
Madam Luosi had often watched him cast a divination, but never with such seriousness or with anything weighing on his mind as it seemed to do now.

当然深感关切。
Naturally, she was concerned.

『瑞香，去调一杯玫瑰薄荷露来，我解解酒。』
“Ruixiang, mix me a glass of rose-and-mint cordial to clear my head after the wine.”

说着，在胡雪岩对面坐了下来问道∶『你起的数，倒讲给我听听。』
Seating herself opposite Hu, she asked, “Tell me about the reading you have had.”

『今天起的这个数，我愈想愈有道理。』胡雪岩说∶『先说我一帆风顺，不过到时候要收篷。
“The more I think about today’s reading, the more sense it makes,” Hu replied. “First it says I am sailing before a fair wind, but that when the time comes I must furl my sail.

啥时候呢？
When?

「帆随湘转处」，
‘Where the sail turns with the Xiang.’

灵就灵在这个「湘」字上，
The uncanny thing is that word Xiang.

是指左大人；
It means Lord Zuo.

到左大人不当两江总督了，我就要「下坡骏马早收缰」了。』
When Lord Zuo ceases to be Governor-General of Liangjiang, I must ‘rein in the gallant horse before it takes the downward slope.’”

『还有呢？』
“And what else?”


『还有这两句，也说得极准∶』施为无不利，到处要周旋。
“These two lines are remarkably accurate too: ‘Whatever you attempt will prosper, but everywhere you must handle others tactfully.’

「拿银子铺路，自然无往不利路路通了。
Pave the way with silver and naturally every road opens before you.”

『』还有呢？
“And what else?”

『『那就是「急流勇退。」』
“‘Have the courage to withdraw from the swift current.’”

螺蛳太太点点头，喝了一大口玫瑰薄荷露说∶『我看只有「急流勇退」四个字说得最好。
Madam Luosi nodded and took a long drink of her rose-and-mint cordial. “I think that last advice is the best of all.

又是「下坡」又是「骏马」，你想收缰都收不住。』
A gallant horse, and a downward slope as well—by then, even if you wanted to pull on the reins, you might not be able to hold it back.”

胡雪岩正要回答，只听外面人在报∶『古老爷回来了。』
Hu was about to answer when someone announced from outside, “Mr Gu is back.”

『瑞香，』螺蛳太太一面站起来，一面说∶『带人来开饭。』
Madam Luosi rose. “Ruixiang, bring the servants in to lay dinner.”


『讲妥当了？』
“Is everything arranged?”

胡雪岩也站了起来，迎上去问。
Hu stood up too and went to meet him.

『讲好了。
“Yes.

明天上午八点钟去看赫德。
We shall call on Hart at eight tomorrow morning.

然后他料理公事完毕中午到灵隐去拜寿。
Then, once he has finished his official business, he will come to Lingyin at noon to offer birthday greetings.”

『』吃饭呢？『螺蛳太太急忙问说。
“And what about his meal?” Madam Luosi asked at once.

『这就要好好商量了。』
“We must discuss that carefully.”

『对，对，好好商量。』
“Yes, yes, let us do so.”

胡雪岩扬一扬手，
Hu waved a hand.

『我们这面来谈。』
“Come over here.”

古应春跟到书桌旁边坐定了说∶『我不但见了梅藤更，还见了赫德，
Gu followed him to the desk and sat down. “I saw not only Dr Meitenggeng but Hart himself.

他说他这一次一则来拜寿；二则还有事要跟小爷叔约谈。』
He says he has come partly to offer birthday greetings and partly because there is something he wishes to discuss with you, Uncle.”

『什么事？
“What is it?

汇丰的款子，应付的本息还早啊！』
The principal and interest due to HSBC will not fall due for some time yet.”

『是茧子的事。』
“It concerns the cocoons.”


『这个，』胡雪岩问∶『怡和的大板怎么不来呢？』
“In that case,” Hu asked, “why has Jardine Matheson’s chief manager not come?”

『已经来了，
“He has.

也住在梅藤更那里。』
He is staying with Dr Meitenggeng too.”

『这样说，是有备而来的。
“Then they have come prepared.

我们倒要好好儿想个应付的办法。』
We had better think carefully about how to deal with them.”

『当然。』古应春又说∶『小爷叔，你哪天有空？』
“Certainly,” Gu said. “What day would suit you, Uncle?”

『要说空，哪一天都不空。』
“If you mean a day when I have nothing to do, none would.

胡雪岩答说∶『他老远从北京到这里，
But he has come all the way from Beijing.

当然主随客便，我们只有看他的意思。』
The host must accommodate the guest; we can only see what suits him.”

『既然小爷叔这么说，明天中午等他到灵隐拜了生日，请他到府上来吃饭，
“Since you feel that way, why not invite him to dine at your house tomorrow after he has offered birthday greetings at Lingyin at noon?

顺便带他逛逛园子。』
You could show him the garden as well.”

『我也是这么想。』
“That is what I had in mind.

胡雪岩问∶『吃西餐，还是中国菜。』
Shall we serve Western food or Chinese?”

『还是西餐吧。』
“Western food, I think.

古应春说∶『我这回带来的六个厨子，其中有一个是法皇的御厨，
Of the six cooks I have brought this time, one formerly cooked for the Emperor of the French.

做出来的东西，不会坍台的。』
His food will not disgrace us.”

『来，来！』螺蛳太太喊道∶『来坐吧！』
“Come, come!” Madam Luosi called. “Sit down!”


『来了！』
“Coming!”

胡雪岩走过来说道∶『明天中午总税务司赫德要来吃饭，
Hu walked over. “Inspector-General Hart will be dining here tomorrow at noon.

吃西餐；
Western food.

厨子应春带来，
Yingchun will provide the cook.

席摆在哪里方便，要预备点啥，顶好趁早交代下去。』
Where it would be convenient to set the table and what else will be needed had best be settled early.”

『有多少人？』
“How many people?”

『主客一共四位。』古应春答说。
“Four altogether, including hosts and guests,” Gu replied.

『应春，』胡雪岩问∶『你是说，怡和的大班也请？』
“Yingchun, do you mean to invite Jardine Matheson’s chief manager too?”

一听这语气，古应春便即反问∶『小爷叔的意思呢？』
At the sound of Hu’s voice, Gu immediately asked in return, “What would you prefer, Uncle?”

『我看「阳春面加重，免免」了！』
“I think we shall have ‘a double helping of plain noodles’—mian, mian: let us leave him out!”

『我看预备还是要预备在那里，』螺蛳太太插进来说∶『说不定赫德倒带了他来呢？』
“I think we should prepare for him anyway,” Madam Luosi put in. “Hart might bring him along.”

洋人没有挟带不速之客的习惯。
Foreigners were not in the habit of arriving with uninvited companions.

螺蛳太太对这方面的应酬规矩不算内行；
Madam Luosi did not fully understand their rules of social intercourse.

不过多预备总不错，
Still, it could do no harm to prepare extra.

或许临时想起还有什么人该请，即不致于捉襟见肘。
They might suddenly think of someone else who ought to be invited, and then they would not be caught short.

因此，胡雪岩点点头说∶『对，
Hu nodded. “Quite right.

多预备几份好了。』
Have a few extra places ready.”

说着，相将落座，
They sat down together.

喝的是红葡萄酒；
Red wine was served.

古应春看着斟在水晶杯中、紫光泛彩的酒说∶『这酒要冰了，味道才出得来。』
Looking at the purple glow of the wine in the crystal glasses, Gu said, “This wine needs chilling to bring out its flavor.”

『那就拿冰来冰。』
“Then bring some ice and chill it.”

原来胡家也跟大内一样，自己有冰窖。
Like the imperial palace, the Hu household had its own ice cellar.

数九寒天，将热水倒在物制的方形木盒中，
In the depths of winter, hot water was poured into specially made square wooden molds.

等表里晶莹，冻结实了，置于掘得极深、下铺草荐的地窖，
Once it had frozen solid, clear through and through, the blocks were laid in a very deep cellar with straw matting underneath.

到来年六月，方始开窖取用。
Ordinarily, it would not be opened until the sixth month of the following year.

此时胡雪岩交代，当然提前开窖。
Hu’s order meant opening it ahead of time.


这一来不免大费手脚，耽误工夫，古应春颇为不安，
This required considerable trouble and caused a delay, which made Gu uneasy.

但已知胡雪岩的脾气愈来愈任性，
But he knew Hu was growing more willful by the day.

劝阴无用，只好听其自然。
Remonstrance would be useless, so he could only let matters take their course.

趁这工夫，胡雪岩与古应春将次日与赫德会谈可能涉及的各方面，细细研究了一番。
They used the interval to examine in detail all the questions that might arise in the next day’s discussion with Hart.

其时螺蛳太太已回到前面，等席散送客；
Madam Luosi had meanwhile gone back to the front of the house to wait for the banquet to end and see the guests off.

镜槛阁中，凿冰冻酒，检点肴馔，都是瑞香主持，
At Jingjian Pavilion, Ruixiang supervised the breaking of the ice, the chilling of the wine, and the checking of the dishes.

只见她来往俏影，翩翩如蝶，不时吸引着古应春的视线移转。
Her graceful figure flitted to and fro like a butterfly, repeatedly drawing Gu’s eyes after her.


胡雪岩看在眼里，
Hu noticed.

愈发觉得刚才胸中所动的一念，应该从速实现。
All the more reason, he thought, to put into effect without delay the idea that had occurred to him earlier.

等入了座，他先看一看桌上的菜，
Once seated, he surveyed the dishes on the table.

问道∶『还有啥？』
“What else is there?”

『还有锦乡长寿面、八仙上寿汤。』瑞香答说∶『古老爷跟老爷还想吃点啥？
“Splendid Longevity Noodles and Eight Immortals Offering Birthday Blessings Soup,” Ruixiang replied. “Would you or Mr Gu like anything else?

我去交代。』
I shall tell the kitchen.”

『够了，够了。』古应春说∶『两个人吃八样菜，已经多了；
“Enough, enough,” Gu said. “Eight dishes for two people are more than sufficient.

再多，反而看饱了吃不下。』
Any more and we should be full just from looking.”

『什么叫八仙上寿汤？』
“What is Eight Immortals Offering Birthday Blessings Soup?” Hu asked.

『就是八珍汤。』瑞香笑道∶『今天是老太太的好日子，所以我拿它改个名字。』
“Eight Delicacies Soup,” Ruixiang answered with a smile. “I gave it a different name because this is the old lady’s happy day.”

『好，
“Good.

晓得了。』
I see.

胡雪岩答说∶『我想吃点甜的，
I should like something sweet.

你到小厨房去看看，
Go to the small kitchen and see what they have.

等弄好了带回来。』
Bring it back when it is ready.”

这是胡雪岩故意遣开瑞香，
Hu was deliberately sending Ruixiang away.

因为他要跟古应春说的话，是一时不便让瑞香知道睥。
What he wanted to discuss with Gu could not yet be allowed to reach her ears.


『老太太说，这回生日样样都好，
“The old lady says everything about her birthday is wonderful this year.

美中不足的，就是七姐没有来。』
The one thing lacking is that Sister Seven has not come.”

『要美中不足才好。』古应春答说∶『曾文正分别号叫「求阙斋」，
“It is better to have something lacking,” Gu replied. “Zeng Guofan called his study ‘Seeking Imperfection.’

特为去求美中不足，那才是持盈保仄之道。
He deliberately sought a flaw in perfection; that is the way to preserve prosperity and keep oneself safe.

醇亲王从儿子做了皇帝以后，置了一样古董，叫做「欹器」，
After his son became emperor, Prince Chun acquired an antique vessel called a tilting bowl.

盛水不能满，一满就翻倒了。』
You cannot fill it right up: when it is full, it overturns.”

胡雪岩并未听出他话中的深意，管自己问道∶『七姐现在身子怎么样？』
Hu missed the deeper meaning of his words and pursued his own question. “How is Sister Seven’s health now?”

『无非带病延年。
“She can only nurse her illness and hope to live on.

西医说∶中风调养比吃药重要；
The Western doctor says that after a stroke, proper care matters more than medicine.

调养第一要心兀，她就是心静不下来，
The first requirement is peace of mind, but she simply cannot be at peace.

我怎么劝也没用。』
Nothing I say will persuade her.”

『为啥呢？』胡雪岩问∶『为啥心静不下来？』
“Why?” Hu asked. “Why can she not settle her mind?”

『小爷叔，你晓得她的，
“You know her, Uncle.

凡事好强。
She insists on doing everything well.

自从她病倒以后，家里当然不比从前那样子有条理了，
Since she fell ill, the house has naturally not been as orderly as before.

她看不惯，自己要指挥，话又说不清楚，丫头老妈子弄来总不如她的意。
She cannot bear to see it and wants to direct things herself, but she cannot speak clearly, and whatever the maids and older servants do never satisfies her.

你想，一个病人一天到晚操心，还要生气，
Think of it: a sick woman worrying all day and getting angry into the bargain.

糟糕不糟糕？』说到这里，古应春叹口气，将酒杯放了下来。
Is that not dreadful?” Gu sighed and set down his glass.


提起不愉快的事，害得他败了酒兴，胡雪岩不免歉然，
Hu felt sorry to have raised an unhappy subject and spoiled his friend’s pleasure in the wine.

但正因为如此，更要往深处去谈。
Yet this was precisely why he had to pursue it.

『还有呢？』
“And what else?”

『还有，就是她总不放心我；
“She is always worrying about me.

常说她对不起，因为她病在床上，没法子照料我的饮食起居。
She often says she has failed me because she is confined to bed and cannot look after my meals and daily needs.

我说，你千万不要这样想，这是没法子的事；再说，有丫头老妈子，我自己会指挥。
I tell her she must not think like that: it cannot be helped, and besides, there are maids and older servants whom I can direct myself.

她说∶没有体己的人，到底不一样。
She says that without someone close to me it is simply not the same.

又说∶』中年丧妻大不幸，
Then she says, ‘To lose your wife in middle age is a great misfortune.

弄个半死不活的老婆在那里，你反而要为我操心，是加倍的大不幸。
To have a wife who is neither quite alive nor dead, and to have to worry about her as well, is twice the misfortune.’

「常时谈得她也哭，我也哭。
Often we talk until she is crying and I am crying too.”

『说着，古应春又泫然欲涕了。
As he spoke, Gu was again close to tears.

『应春，你说得我也想哭了。
“Yingchun, you make me want to cry myself,” Hu said.

你们真正是所谓伉俪情深，
“Yours truly is a marriage of deep affection.

来世也一定是恩爱夫妻。
I am sure you will be a loving couple in the next life as well.

不过，既然七姐是这样子的情形，我的想法倒又改过了。』
Still, if that is how things stand with Sister Seven, it changes my thinking.”

『小爷叔，你有啥想法？』
“What have you been thinking, Uncle?”


『我在想，要替你弄个人。
“I have been thinking of finding someone for you.

这个人当然要你中意，要七姐也中意。
Naturally, she must be someone you like and Sister Seven likes too.

人，我已经有了，
I already have someone in mind.

虽说有把握，你们都会中意，不过，女人家的事情，有时候是很难说的，尤其是讨小纳妾，更加要慎重，
Though I am confident you would both be pleased with her, matters involving women are sometimes difficult to judge, and taking a concubine calls for even greater care.

所以我想过些日子，叫罗四姐到上海去一趟，当面跟七姐商量，
I had therefore thought of sending Sister Luo to Shanghai in a few days to discuss it with Sister Seven in person.

照现在看，我想这件事，可以定局了。』
From what you have told me, however, I think we may be able to settle it.”

一番话说得古应春心乱如麻，
Gu’s thoughts were in turmoil.

不知是喜是惧？
He hardly knew whether he was pleased or afraid.

定定神，理出一个头绪，先要知道，胡雪岩心目中，『已经有了』的那个人是谁？
Composing himself, he picked out the first question to be answered: who was the woman Hu already had in mind?

等他一问出来，胡雪岩答道∶『还有哪个，
When he asked, Hu replied, “Who else?

自然是瑞香。』
Ruixiang, of course.”

古应春又惊又喜，
Gu was startled and delighted.

眼前浮起瑞香的影子，耳边响起瑞香的声音，顿时生出无限的遐想。
Her figure rose before his eyes and her voice sounded in his ears, setting his imagination wandering.

『应春，』胡雪岩问说∶『你看怎么样，
“Yingchun,” Hu asked, “what do you think?

七姐会不会中意她？』
Would Sister Seven be pleased with her?”

『我想，应该会。』
“I think she ought to be.”


『你呢？』
“And you?”

古应春笑笑不答，只顾自己从冰桶中取酒瓶来斟酒。
Gu smiled without answering and busied himself taking the wine bottle from the ice bucket to refill his glass.

『我说得不错吧！
“Was I not right?

这个人你们夫妻俩都会中意。』
Both husband and wife would be pleased with her.”

『话也不能这么说。』
“One cannot quite put it that way.”

古应春将七姑奶奶得病以来说过的话，细细搜索了一遍，
Gu searched his memory for everything the Seventh Lady had said since falling ill.

有些悲伤地说∶『小爷叔，有件事，我不能不提出来。
With some sadness he continued, “Uncle, there is something I cannot leave unmentioned.

阿七从来没有提过要替我弄一个人的话。』
A’qi has never once suggested finding someone for me.”

这使得胡雪岩一楞，
That gave Hu pause.

心中寻思，七姑奶奶既然因为无法亲自照料丈夫的饮食起居而深感抱歉；同时也觉得没有一个得力的帮手替她治家，
The Seventh Lady felt deeply sorry that she could no longer personally care for her husband’s meals and daily needs; at the same time, she plainly lacked a capable assistant to manage the household.

那末以她一向看得广、想得深的性情，一定会转过替古应春提过，
Given her habitual breadth of view and depth of thought, she must surely have considered finding someone for Gu. Yet she had never raised the subject.

这中间就大可玩味了。
There was much to ponder in that.


『应春，』他问∶『你自己有没有讨小的打算？』
“Yingchun,” he asked, “have you yourself thought of taking a concubine?”

古应春仔仔细细地回忆着，而且在重新体认自己曾经有过的感想以后，
Gu searched his memory carefully and reconsidered feelings he had once had.

很慎重地答说∶『如果说没有，我是说假话。
At last he answered with great seriousness. “I should be lying if I said no.

不过，这种念头只要一起，我马我会丢掉，
But whenever the thought arises, I immediately dismiss it.

自己告诉自己∶不要自讨苦吃。』
I tell myself not to go looking for trouble.”

『这种心境，你同七姐谈过没有？』
“Have you ever discussed these feelings with Sister Seven?”

『没有。』
“No.”

『从来没有谈过？』
“Never?”

『从没有。』
“Never.”

『有没有露过这样的口风呢？』
“Have you ever even hinted at them?”

见他这样『打破沙锅问到底』，古应春倒不敢信口回答了，
Hu’s insistence on getting to the bottom of the matter made Gu unwilling to answer casually.

复又想了一下，方始开口∶『没有。』
He thought again before saying, “No.”


『好！
“Good.

我懂了。』胡雪岩说∶『讨小讨得不好，是自讨若吃；
I understand,” Hu said. “A badly chosen concubine does indeed mean looking for trouble.

讨得好，另当别论。
A well-chosen one is another matter.

我料七姐的心事，不是不想替你弄个人，是这个人不容易去觅。
I suspect Sister Seven is not opposed to finding you someone; the difficulty is finding the right person.

又要能干，又要体贴，又要肯听她的话；还要相貌看得过去，
She must be capable and considerate, willing to obey her, and reasonably good-looking as well.

所以心里虽有这样的念头，没有觅着中意的人之前，先不开口。
So although the idea is in her mind, she will say nothing until she has found someone suitable.

七姐做事向来是这样的，
That is how Sister Seven has always done things.

我晓得。』
I know her.”

古应春觉得他的话也不无道理，
Gu thought there was some reason in his words.

倒不防探探妻子的口气。
Perhaps he might sound his wife out.

旋即转念，
But immediately he checked himself.

此事决不能轻发！
This was not a subject to raise lightly.

倘若妻子根本不愿，一说这话，岂非伤了感情？
If she was fundamentally unwilling, would mentioning it not wound her feelings?

『能干、体贴、听话、相貌过得去，这四个条件，顶要紧的是听话。
Hu went on, “Capable, considerate, obedient, and reasonably good-looking: of those four conditions, obedience matters most.

七姐人情、世故熟透，
Sister Seven knows human nature and the ways of the world thoroughly.

世界上总是听话的老实无用；能干调皮捣蛋，
Obedient people tend to be honest but useless; capable ones tend to be unruly and mischievous.

她一个端正人，躺在床上，
She is an upright woman, lying there in bed.

如果叫人到东，偏要到西，拿她有啥法子？
If she tells someone to go east and that person insists on going west, what can she do?

那一来，不是把她活活气死？
It would anger her to death.

七姐顾虑来，顾虑去，就是顾虑这个。
That is the worry she turns over and over in her mind.

应春，你说对不对！』
Is that not so, Yingchun?”

『是的。』古应春不能不承认∶『小爷叔把职七的为人，看得很透。』
“Yes,” Gu had to admit. “You understand A’qi very well, Uncle.”

『闲话少说，
“Enough talk.

我们来谈瑞香。
Let us consider Ruixiang.

四个条件，她占了三个；
She meets three of the four conditions.

体贴或许差一点，不过那也是将来你们感情上的事，
Perhaps she falls a little short in consideration, but that will depend on your feelings for each other later.

感情深了，自然会体贴。』
Once the affection is deep, consideration will come naturally.”

『哪里就谈得到将来了？』古应春笑着喝了口酒说∶『这件事要慢慢商量。』
“How can we already be talking about later?” Gu laughed and took a sip of wine. “This matter needs careful discussion.”


『你说谈不到将来，我说喜事就在眼前。』
“You say we cannot talk about later; I say the happy occasion is just before us.”

胡雪岩略略放低了声音∶『贤慧，瑞香当然还谈不到；
Hu lowered his voice a little. “I cannot yet call Ruixiang a model of womanly virtue.

不过，我同罗四姐两个人一起替你写包票，一定听七姐的话。
But Sister Luo and I will jointly guarantee that she obeys Sister Seven.

你信不信。』
Do you believe us?”

古应春何能不信，亦何能不喜，
How could Gu fail to believe him, or fail to be delighted?

但总顾虑着妻子如果真的有妨意，这件事就弄巧成拙了。
Yet he still feared that if his wife truly resented the idea, their clever plan might produce the opposite of what they intended.

看他脸上忽喜忽忧的神情，胡雪岩当然也能约略猜到他的心事。
Hu could readily guess his thoughts from the way delight and anxiety alternated on his face.

但夫妻之间的这种情形，到底只有同床共枕的人才能判断。
Still, only those who shared a bed could really judge such matters between husband and wife.

所以他不再固劝，让它冷一冷，
He pressed no further, allowing the subject to cool.

看古应春多想一想以后的态度，再作道理。
He would see what attitude Gu took after more thought and decide what to do then.


于是把话题扯了开去，海阔天空地聊了一阵，
He changed the subject, and they chatted freely for a while.

瑞香亲自提来一个细篾金漆圆笼，
Ruixiang herself brought in a round basket of finely woven bamboo coated with gold lacquer.

打开来看，青花瓷盘中，盛着现做的枣泥核花奶酥；是醇亲王厨子传授的。
Inside, on a blue-and-white porcelain plate, lay freshly made cream pastries filled with date paste and walnuts, made from a recipe passed on by Prince Chun’s cook.

接着，小厨房另外送来寿面跟『八仙上寿汤』；
The small kitchen next sent in the birthday noodles and the Eight Immortals Offering Birthday Blessings Soup.

寿面一大盘，炒得十分出色，但胡雪岩与古应春都是应应景，浅尝即止。
There was a great platter of beautifully fried noodles, but both Hu and Gu merely tasted a little for the occasion.

『多吃点嘛！』瑞香劝道∶『这么好的寿面，不吃真可惜。』
“Do have some more,” Ruixiang urged. “Such fine birthday noodles—it would be a pity not to eat them.”

『说得不错。』古应春答说∶『我再来一点。』
“You are right,” Gu replied. “I shall have a little more.”


于是好替他们各自盛了一小碗，
She filled a small bowl for each of them.

古应春努力加餐，算是吃完了。
Gu made an effort and finished his.

胡雪尝了一口说道∶『我再来一点。』
Hu tasted a mouthful and said, “I shall have a little more.”

『糟蹋了实在可惜。』瑞香向外喊道，
“It would be a shame to let them go to waste.” Ruixiang called outside.

『小梅，你们把这盘寿面拿去，分了吃掉∶沾沾老太太的福气。』
“Xiaomei, take this platter of birthday noodles and share it among you. Have a little of the old lady’s good fortune!”

说着，亲自将一盘炒面捧了出去。
She carried the platter out herself.

胡雪岩看在眼里，暗自点头。
Hu watched and nodded inwardly.

等饭罢茶时，螺蛳太太亦已客散稍闲，来到镜槛阁休息；
When they had finished eating and were drinking tea, Madam Luosi came to Jingjian Pavilion to rest, her guests now departed.

当然还有许多杂条要料理，
There were, of course, still many miscellaneous matters to attend to.

走马换将，都交给瑞香了。
The two women exchanged duties, leaving everything to Ruixiang.


『我刚刚跟应春谈了一件大事，
“I have just been discussing an important matter with Yingchun.

现在要同你商量了。』
Now I must consult you.”

商量的便是嫁瑞香之事；
It was the proposed marriage of Ruixiang.

不等胡雪岩话毕，螺蛳太太便即说道∶『我早就有这个意思了。
Before Hu had finished, Madam Luosi said, “I have long had the same idea.

七姐夫，史要七姐一句话，我马上来办。』
Brother-in-law Gu, let Sister Seven say the word, and I shall arrange it at once.”

『就是这句话为难。』古应春答说∶『我自己当然不便提；就是旁人去提，也不大妥当。』
“That one word is precisely the difficulty,” Gu replied. “I can hardly raise the subject myself, and it would not be quite proper even for someone else to do so.”

『何以见得？』
“Why not?”

『人家去说，她表面上说不出不愿意的话来，
“If someone speaks to her, she will be unable to say openly that she objects.

心里有了疙瘩，对她的病，大不相宜。』
But she may harbor a grievance in her heart, which would be very bad for her health.”


『我看七姐不会的。』胡雪岩对螺蛳太太说∶『下个月我到上海，你同我一起去，当面跟七姐谈这件事。』
“I do not think Sister Seven would,” Hu said. He turned to Madam Luosi. “Come with me when I go to Shanghai next month and discuss it with her face to face.”

『那一来，她怎么样不愿意，也得很高兴。』古应春大为摇头∶『不妥，不妥！
Gu shook his head vigorously. “Then, however unwilling she was, she would have to pretend to be delighted. No, no.

她决不肯说真心话的。』
She would never tell you her true feelings.”

『我倒有个办法，
“I have a way,” Madam Luosi said.

我要由七姐自己开口。』
“I shall have Sister Seven herself bring it up.”

此言一出，古应春、胡雪岩一齐倾身注目，倒要听听她是何好办法，能使得七姑奶奶自愿为丈夫纳妾。
At this, both men leaned forward and fixed their eyes on her, eager to hear how she could induce the Seventh Lady voluntarily to arrange a concubine for her husband.

『办法很容易。』
“It is quite simple.

螺蛳太太说∶『我把瑞香带了去。
I shall take Ruixiang along.

只说我不放心她的病，特为叫瑞香去服侍她，帮她理家的。
I shall merely say that I am worried about her illness and have brought Ruixiang specially to wait on her and help her manage the house.

只要瑞香服侍得好，事事听她的话，她自然会想到，要留住瑞香只有一条路，让她也姓古。』
Provided Ruixiang serves her well and obeys her in everything, she will naturally see that there is only one way to keep her: let her become a member of the Gu family.”

『此计大妙！』
“A marvelous plan!”

岩胡雪拍着手说∶『准定这么办。』
Hu clapped his hands. “That is settled, then.”


古应春也觉得这是个很妥当的办法，
Gu, too, thought it a very sound plan.

但螺蛳太太却提出了警告∶『七姐夫，不过我劝你不要心急，
Madam Luosi added a warning, however. “Brother-in-law Gu, do not be impatient.

你最好先疏远瑞香一点。』
You had better keep your distance from Ruixiang at first.”

『人逢喜事精神爽』古应春这一夜只睡了两个辰，一觉醒来，天还没有亮透，
Happiness renews a man’s spirits. Gu slept only four hours that night, and when he woke, it was not yet fully light.

看自鸣钟上一直线，恰好六点钟响。
Looking at the clock, he saw the hands in a straight line just as it struck six.

他住的是胡家花园中的一处客房，名叫锁春院，茶木甚盛，
He was staying in a guest suite in Hu’s garden called Suochun Court, where flowers and trees grew thickly.

揭开重帘，推出窗去，
He lifted the heavy curtains and pushed open the window.

花香鸟语，令人精神一振，
Fragrant blossoms and birdsong refreshed his spirits.

心里寻思，这天洋人拜寿，是他的『重头戏』，
Today’s reception for the foreign birthday visitors would be his great undertaking.

宁可赶早去巡查，看有什么不妥的地方，须先改正，庶几不负至交所托。
He had better begin his inspections early, discover and correct anything amiss, and justify the trust his close friend had placed in him.

于是漱洗早餐，随即带了跟班，坐着胡家替他预备的轿子，
He washed, ate breakfast, and set out with an attendant in the sedan the Hu household had provided.

先巡视了设在城里的六处寿堂，一一检点妥当，
First he inspected the six birthday halls inside the city and checked that all was in order.

然后出钱塘门到灵隐，
Then he went out through Qiantang Gate to Lingyin.

不过九点刚过。
It was only just after nine when he arrived.

这灵隐的寿堂，原规定了是英国人来拜寿的地方，只是洋人闹不清这些细节，
The Lingyin hall had originally been assigned to the British visitors, but foreigners did not understand these fine distinctions.

有的逛了天竺、灵隐，顺便就来拜寿，
Some simply called to offer their congratulations after sightseeing at Tianzhu and Lingyin.

人数不多，倒是看的人多，指指点点，嘻嘻哈哈，乱得很热闹。
There were not many guests, but a great many spectators, pointing, chattering, and laughing in lively disorder.



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第一章（本章第4部分，共4部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


不久，胡雪岩到了，拉着古应春到一边说道∶『我看原来请到我那里吃西餐的办法得不通了。』
Hu Xueyan arrived shortly afterward and drew Gu Yingchun aside. “I am afraid our plan to invite him to my house for a Western lunch will not work.”

『怎么呢？』
“Why not?”

『赫德到杭州来的消息，不知道怎么传出去了。
“Somehow the news that Hart is in Hangzhou has got out.

德晓峰派人通知我，说要来作陪，
De Xiaofeng has sent to say that he wishes to join us.

他是好意，我怎么好挡驾？』
He means well; how can I turn him away?

胡雪岩又说∶『这一来，邀赫德到家，似乎不太方便。』
But with him there, inviting Hart to the house would be rather awkward.”

古应春想了一下说∶『不要紧，
Gu thought for a moment. “Never mind.

中午在这里开席，晚上请他到府上好了。』
We can entertain him here at noon and invite him to your house in the evening.”

『只好这样。』
“That will have to do.”


刚说完，已隐隐传来呜锣喝道之声，
They had scarcely finished speaking when the faint sound of gongs and cries clearing the way reached them.

料想是德馨到了。
They supposed Dexin had arrived.

胡雪岩迎出去一看，方知来的是赫德，
Hu went out to receive him and discovered that the visitor was Hart.

原来此人极其醉心中国官场的气派，特为借了巡抚的绿呢大轿，全副『导子』，前呼后拥，趁机会大过了一番官瘾。
Enamored of the grandeur of Chinese official life, Hart had specially borrowed the governor’s large green-cloth sedan and a complete ceremonial escort, with attendants calling before and behind, to indulge his taste for official splendor.

他穿的自然是二品补服。
He naturally wore the insignia robe of the second rank.

红顶花翎的大帽子后面还装了根乌油油的大辫子；
His hat had a red button and a peacock feather, and a long, glossy black queue had even been attached at the back.

胡雪岩是见过的，不足为奇，
Hu had seen him like this before and found nothing unusual in it.

其他游客闲人，何曾见过洋人有这样的打扮？
But what sightseer or idle spectator had ever seen a foreigner dressed in such a manner?

顿时都围了上来，
The crowd immediately closed around him.

好在胡家的下人多，
Fortunately, the Hu household had plenty of servants.

两面推排，留出一条路来，由胡雪岩陪着，直趋寿堂。
They pushed people back on either side to open a path, and Hu escorted Hart straight into the birthday hall.

于是『清音堂名』，咪哩吗啦地吹打了起来；
The ceremonial musicians struck up a lively clamor.

赫德甩一甩马蹄袖，有模有样地在红毡条上跪了下去，
Hart flicked back his horsehoof cuffs and knelt on the strip of red felt with a convincing air of knowing what he was about.

磕完头起身，与陪礼的胡雪岩相互一揖，
After kowtowing, he rose and exchanged a bow with Hu, who had knelt beside him to return the courtesy.

方始交谈。
Only then did they begin to talk.


『恭喜，恭喜。』
“Congratulations, congratulations!”

赫德说得极好的一口京片子，
Hart spoke excellent Beijing Chinese.

『老太太在哪里，
“Where is the old lady?

应该当面拜寿。』
I ought to offer my birthday wishes in person.”

胡雪岩略有些踌躇，
Hu hesitated.

有这第一个戴红顶子的洋大人去见老母，实在是件很有起的事；
It would be a matter of considerable interest for this first foreign dignitary to wear a red official button to meet his mother.

但一进去他，女着就得回避，
Yet if he went inside, the women would have to withdraw.

不免会有屏风后面，窃窃私议，失礼闹笑话就不妙了，
There might then be whispering behind screens, and an embarrassing breach of manners would be most unfortunate.

因而答说∶『不敢当，
“You are too kind,” he replied.

我说到就是了。』
“Allow me to convey your wishes.”

赫德点点头，回身看见古应春说∶『昨天拜托转达雪翁的话，想必已经说过。』
Hart nodded, then turned and saw Gu. “I presume you have passed on the message I asked you to give Mr Xue yesterday.”

『是的。』
“Yes.”

古应春门见山地答说∶『雪翁的意思，今天晚上想请阁下到他府上便饭，饭后细谈。』
Gu came straight to the point. “Mr Xue would like to invite you to a simple meal at his house this evening, with a fuller discussion afterward.”

『那就叨扰了。』
“Then I shall impose on your hospitality.”

赫德向胡雪岩说∶『谢谢。』
Hart turned to Hu. “Thank you.”


于是让到一边待茶。
They moved aside for tea.

正在谈着，德馨到了；
While they were talking, Dexin arrived.

他是有意结纳赫德，陪着很敷衍了一阵。
He was eager to cultivate Hart’s acquaintance and entertained him attentively for some time.

中午一起坐了面席，方始回城。
They shared a birthday noodle banquet at noon before returning to the city.

这天原是比较清闲的一天，因为来拜寿洋人，毕竟有限。
It was, in fact, a relatively quiet day: the number of foreigners coming to offer birthday greetings was limited.

到得下午三点钟，古应春便已进城；
By three in the afternoon, Gu had already returned to the city.

略息一息亲自去接赫德，顺便邀梅藤更作陪，这是胡雪岩决定的。
After a short rest, he went personally to fetch Hart, also inviting Dr Meitenggeng to join them, as Hu had decided.

到时天还未黑，但萃锦堂上的煤油打汽灯，已点得一片烨烨白光。
It was not yet dark when they arrived, but the pressurized kerosene lamps in Cuijin Hall were already blazing with brilliant white light.

那萃锦堂是五开间的西式洋楼，楼前一个大天进，
The hall was a Western-style building five bays wide, with a large courtyard in front.

东面有座喷水池；
A fountain stood to the east.

西面用朱漆杉木，围成一个圆形栅栏，里面养着雌雄一对孔雀，
To the west, a circular enclosure of red-lacquered firwood housed a pair of peacocks.

一见赫德进来，冉冉开屏，不由得把他吸引住了。
As soon as Hart appeared, the male slowly spread his tail and held the visitor spellbound.

『这只孔雀戴的是「三眼花翎」。』赫德指着雀屏笑道∶『李中堂都没有它阔。』
“This peacock wears a ‘three-eyed feather,’” Hart said, pointing at the fan and laughing. “Even Grand Secretary Li is not as grand as he is.”


于是入座以后，便谈李鸿章了。
Once they were seated, the conversation naturally turned to Li Hongzhang.

赫德带来最新的消息，直隶总署是调两广总督张树声署理，湖广总督果然是由湖南巡抚涂宗瀛升任。
Hart had brought the latest news: Zhang Shusheng, Governor-General of Liangguang, was being transferred to act as Governor-General of Zhili, while the governorship-general of Huguang would indeed go to Tu Zongying, Governor of Hunan.

『那末，两广呢？』
“And Liangguang?”

『现在还不知道。』赫德答说∶『听说曾九帅很有意思谋这个缺。』
“I do not know yet,” Hart replied. “I hear Ninth Marshal Zeng is very interested in obtaining that post.”

『湖南，』胡雪岩又问∶『湖南巡抚不晓得放的哪个？』
“Hunan?” Hu asked. “Do you know who is to be appointed Governor of Hunan?”

『这倒没有听说。』
“I have heard nothing about that.”


就这时候，瑞香翩然出现，进门先福一福，拢总请了一个安，然后向胡雪岩说道∶『太太要我来说，小小姐有点发烧，
At that moment Ruixiang entered gracefully, curtsied to the company as a whole, and addressed Hu. “Madam has sent me to say that the little miss has a slight fever.

怕是出痧子，想请梅先生去看一看。』
She is afraid it may be measles and would like Dr Mei to look at her.”

『喔，』
“Oh.”

胡雪岩皱着眉说∶『梅先生是来作客的，
Hu frowned. “Dr Mei is here as a guest.

皮包听筒也不晓得带了没有？』
I do not even know whether he has brought his medical bag and stethoscope.”

『带了，带了。』梅藤更是一口杭州话，
“I have it, I have it,” the doctor replied in his Hangzhou accent.

『听筒是我的吃饭家伙，随身法宝，
“My stethoscope is how I earn my living, my indispensable companion.

哪里会不带。』
How could I leave it behind?”

说着，从口袋中掏出一副听筒，向瑞香扬一扬说∶『我们走。』
He took it from his pocket, held it up to Ruixiang, and said, “Let us go.”

『小小姐』是螺蛳太太的小女儿，今年七岁，胡雪岩爱如掌珠；
The little miss was Madam Luosi’s younger daughter, seven years old that year, whom Hu cherished like the pearl of his palm.

听说病了，不免有神思不属的模样，
Hearing that she was ill, he became somewhat distracted.

幸而有古应春陪着赫德闲谈，未曾慢客。
Fortunately, Gu kept Hart engaged in conversation, so their guest was not neglected.

『怎么样？』一见梅藤更回来，胡雪岩迎上去问∶『不要紧吧？』
As soon as the doctor returned, Hu went to meet him. “How is she? Nothing serious, I hope?”

『不要紧，不要紧。』
“Nothing serious at all.”


当梅藤便在开药方，交代胡家的管家到广济医院去取药时，赫德已开始与古应春谈到正事，
While Dr Meitenggeng wrote a prescription and instructed the Hu steward to fetch the medicine from Guangji Hospital, Hart began discussing business with Gu.

刚开了一个头，因人入席而将话题打断了。
They had barely started when the call to dinner interrupted them.

进餐当然是照西洋规矩。
The meal was naturally served in the Western manner.

桃花心木的长餐桌，通称『大餐桌』，胡雪岩与古应春分坐两端主位，
Hu and Gu took the host’s places at opposite ends of the long mahogany table, the kind commonly called a “Western dining table.”

胡雪岩的右手方是赫德，左手方是梅藤更。
Hart sat on Hu’s right and Dr Meitenggeng on his left.

菜当然很讲究，而酒更讲究；
The food was elaborate, but the wines were more remarkable still.

古应春春有意为主人炫耀，命待者一瓶一瓶地将香槟酒与红葡萄酒取了来，
Deliberately displaying his host’s wealth, Gu had the servants bring bottles of champagne and red wine one after another.

为客人介绍哪一瓶为法国哪一位君王所御用；哪一瓶已有多少年陈，
He explained which had been served to which French monarch and how many years others had aged.

当然还有英国人所喜爱的威士忌，亦都是英国也很珍贵的名牌。
There was also, of course, the whisky the English liked, all distinguished brands highly prized even in Britain.


这顿饭吃了有一个钟头，
The meal lasted an hour.

先是海阔天空地随意闲谈，以后便分成两对，
At first they talked freely of everything under the sun; later they split into two pairs.

梅藤更跟胡雪岩谈他的医院，
Dr Meitenggeng spoke to Hu about his hospital.

说诊务愈来愈盛，医院想要扩充，苦于地基不足，
The number of patients kept increasing, and he wished to expand, but there was not enough land.

胡雪岩答应替他想想办法；
Hu promised to consider what could be done.

又说门前的路太狭，而且高低不平，
The doctor went on to complain that the road in front was too narrow and uneven.

轿马纷纷，加以摊贩众多，交通不便，
With sedans and horses constantly coming and going, and so many street vendors besides, access was difficult.

向胡雪岩诉了许多苦，胡雪岩许了替他修路，
After hearing his many complaints, Hu promised to improve the road.

但梅藤更请他向杭州府及钱塘县请一张告示驱逐摊贩，胡雪岩却婉言谢绝了。
But when the doctor asked him to obtain an official notice from the Hangzhou prefecture and Qiantang county authorities ordering the vendors away, Hu politely refused.

另一对是赫德与古应春，断续入席以前的话题，而是用英语交谈，
The other pair, Hart and Gu, resumed their earlier conversation in English.

谈的是广东丝业的巨头陈启沅。
They were discussing Chen Qiyuan, the leading figure in Guangdong’s silk industry.

这陈启沅是广州南海县人，一直在南洋一带经商，
Chen came from Nanhai county in Guangzhou and had long traded in Southeast Asia.

同治末年回到家乡开了一家缫丝厂，招牌叫继昌隆，
Near the end of the Tongzhi reign, he returned home and opened the Jichanglong Silk-Reeling Mill.

用了六、七百女工，规模很大，
It was a large establishment employing six or seven hundred women.

丝的品质亦很好，行销欧美，很受欢迎。
Its silk was of excellent quality and sold well in Europe and America.


『他的丝好，是因为用机器，比用手工好。』赫德说∶『机器代替人工，是世界潮流。
“His silk is good because he uses machinery, which is better than working by hand,” Hart said. “The replacement of manual labor by machinery is the way the world is going.

我在中国二十年，
I have been in China for twenty years.

对中国的感情，跟对英国一样，甚至更为关切，因为中国更需要帮助；
I feel as much for China as I do for Britain—indeed, I am even more concerned for her, because she is in greater need of help.

所以，我这一回来，想跟胡先生谈怡和丝厂开工一事，实在也为中国富强着眼。』
That is why, in coming here to speak to Mr Hu about opening Jardine Matheson’s silk mill, I truly have China’s wealth and strength at heart.”

『是的。
“Yes.

我们都知道你对中国的爱护，
We all know your concern for China.

不过，英国讲民主，中国亦讲顺应民情，
But just as Britain speaks of democracy, China too speaks of respecting the feelings of the people.

就象细昌隆的情形，不能不引以为鉴。』
We cannot ignore the lesson of what happened at Jichanglong.”

原来陈启沅前两年改用机器，曾经引起很大的风潮；
Chen’s adoption of machinery two years earlier had provoked considerable unrest.

陈启沅不能不设法改良，制造一种一型的缫丝机，推广到农村，将机器之利，与人共享。
He had been obliged to find a better arrangement and developed a small silk-reeling machine for use in the villages, thus sharing the benefits of machinery with others.

赫德在宣扬机器的好处；
Hart was extolling its advantages.

古应春承认这一点，但隐然指出，想用机器替代人手，独占厚利是行不通的。
Gu acknowledged them but quietly made the point that replacing people with machines in order to monopolize the enormous profits would not work.


及至席散，梅藤更告辞先行，赫德留下来；
After dinner, Dr Meitenggeng took his leave, while Hart stayed.

与胡雪岩正式商谈时，赫德的话又同了。
When he began formal discussions with Hu, his approach was different again.

『雪翁！』他用中国官场的称呼，『你能不能跟怡和合伙？』
“Mr Xue,” he said, adopting the Chinese official style of address, “could you go into partnership with Jardine Matheson?”

胡雪岩颇为诧异，
Hu was rather surprised.

怡和洋行是英国资本，亦等于是英国官方的事业，
Jardine Matheson was financed by British capital and, as he understood it, virtually an official British enterprise.

何以会邀中国人来合伙？
Why should it invite a Chinese merchant into partnership?

事情没有弄清楚以前，他不愿表示态度，
Until he understood the matter, he would give no indication of his position.

只是含蓄地微笑着。
He merely smiled reservedly.


『我是说怡和洋行所人的丝厂。』赫德接下来说∶『他们愿意跟你订一张合同，丝都由你供应；
“I mean the silk mill owned by Jardine Matheson,” Hart continued. “They would be willing to sign a contract with you for all their silk supplies.

市价以外，另送佣金。』
On top of the market price, they would pay a commission.”

还是为了原料！
So it was still a question of raw materials!

原来怡和丝厂，早在光绪元年便已开设，
Jardine Matheson’s silk mill had opened as early as the first year of the Guangxu reign.

自以为财大势雄，派人到乡下收购茧子，
Confident in its wealth and influence, the firm had sent buyers into the countryside to purchase cocoons.

价钱虽出得不坏，但挑剔得也很厉害，
Though the prices it offered were not bad, its buyers were extremely exacting.

派人到乡下收购茧子，价线虽出得不坏，但执，甚至大起纠纷，恼了自浙江嘉与苏州一带，
Serious disputes had even arisen [the ensuing passage about opposition in the silk-producing districts around Jia— in Zhejiang and Suzhou is damaged in the source].

丝产旺地的几闲置的机器，又因保养不善，损坏，生的生锈，
Machinery left idle had then suffered from poor maintenance: some was damaged, some rusted.

只好闭歇。
The mill had no choice but to close.


但就这两三年，日本的机器缫丝业，大为发达，
During the past two or three years, however, machine silk-reeling had made great advances in Japan.

怡和丝厂在去年重整鼓，新修厂房，买了意利造新机器，准备复业。
Last year Jardine Matheson had regrouped, renovated its mill buildings, and bought new Italian machinery in preparation for reopening.

此外，有个澄州人叫黄佐卿，开一家公和永丝厂，向法国买的机器，亦已运到；
In addition, Huang Zuoqing, a man from Chengzhou, had opened the Gongheyong Silk Mill, and the machinery he had bought from France had arrived.

另有公平洋行，亦打算在这方面投资。
Gongping Trading House also intended to invest in this field.

这三家丝厂一开工，需要大量原料，丝价必定上涨，
Once the three mills began work, they would require huge quantities of raw material, and silk prices would inevitably rise.

胡雪岩早就看准了。
Hu had foreseen all this long ago.

可是，他是站在反对丝厂这方面的，
Yet he stood with the opponents of the mills.

因为有陈启沅的例子在，机器马达一向，不知道有多少养蚕做丝人心惊肉跳。
Chen Qiyuan’s example was there for all to see: the moment the motors began to run, who could say how many people raising silkworms and making silk would tremble for their livelihoods?



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第二章（本章第1部分，共6部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第二章
CHAPTER TWO


江浙的养蚕人家，大部分是产销合一的。
Most silkworm-raising households in Jiangsu and Zhejiang both produced and marketed their own silk.

茧子固然亦可卖给领有『部帖』的茧行，
They could, of course, sell their cocoons to cocoon firms holding licenses from the ministry.

但茧行估价不高，而且同行公议，价格划一，
But those firms offered low prices, and the members of the trade had agreed to a uniform rate.

不卖茧则已，卖茧子一定受剥削；
Once a family decided to sell cocoons, exploitation was unavoidable.

再则收茧有一定的日子，
Moreover, cocoons were bought only on specified days.

或者人等不及，急于要钱用；或者茧子等不及，时间一长蚕蛾会咬破茧子，
Sometimes the growers could not wait because they needed money urgently; sometimes the cocoons could not wait, since in time the moths would bite their way out and ruin them.

所以除非万不得已，或者别有盘算，总是自家养蚕、自家做丝，
Unless driven by necessity or guided by some special calculation, families therefore raised their own silkworms and made their own silk.

这就要养活许多人了，
This provided a livelihood for many people.

因为做丝从煮茧开始，手续繁多，
From boiling the cocoons onward, silk-making involved a multitude of operations.

缫丝以后『捻丝』、『拍丝』，进炼染炼染，纬丝捻成经丝，还有『掉经』、『牵经』等等名目，
After reeling came twisting and beating, scouring and dyeing, twisting weft silk into warp silk, and the various stages of preparing and drawing out the warp.

最后是『接头』，到此方可上机织绸。
Only after the final joining of the threads could the silk go onto a loom to be woven into fabric.

一旦出现了机器缫丝厂，茧子由机器这头进去，丝由那头出来，
Once a mechanized silk-reeling mill appeared, however, cocoons went in at one end and silk emerged at the other.

什么『拍丝』、『牵经』都用不着了，这一行的工人，亦都敲破饭碗了。
The beating and drawing of threads were no longer needed, and the workers who had performed them lost their livelihoods.

更为严重的是，江浙农村，几乎家家户户都有缫丝的纺车，
More serious still, almost every rural household in Jiangsu and Zhejiang had a reeling wheel.

妇女无分老幼，大都恃此为副业；
Women of all ages relied on it for supplementary income.

孤寒寡妇的『棺材本』，小家碧玉的『嫁时装』，出在一部纺车上的，比比皆是，
A poor widow’s savings for her coffin, a girl from a modest household’s dowry—countless such sums came from a single wheel.

如果这部纺车一旦成为废物，那就真要出现『一路哭』的场面了。
If that wheel became useless, there would indeed be weeping all along the road.


因此，早就不断有人向胡雪岩陈情，要求他出面控制机器缫丝厂；
For this reason, people had long been coming to Hu Xueyan with petitions, asking him to intervene and restrain the mechanized mills.

就因为他的力量太大，
His power was immense.

手头经常握有价值三百万两银子的一万包丝在手里，可以垄断市场，
He regularly held ten thousand bales of silk worth three million taels of silver, enough to dominate the market.

所以恰和洋行竟搬动了『二品大员』的赫德来谈条件。
That was why Jardine Matheson had even persuaded Hart, a dignitary of the second rank, to negotiate terms.

条件是很好。
The terms were very good.

所谓『市价以外，另送佣金』，便是两笔收入，
“A commission on top of the market price” meant two sources of income.

因为『市价』中照例每包有二两五钱的佣金，由介绍洋行买丝的中间人与红纵栈对分；
The market price already included the customary commission of two taels and five mace per bale, divided equally between the intermediary who introduced the foreign buyer and the silk warehouse.

如果『另送佣金』，每包至少亦有一两，
An additional commission would be at least another tael per bale.

坐享厚利，在他人求之不得，而胡雪岩却只好放弃。
Here was a handsome profit for no effort, an opportunity others would have coveted; Hu could only let it go.

麻烦的是，赫德的情面不能不顾；
The difficulty was that he could not disregard Hart’s feelings.

至少要想个虽拒绝而不伤赫德面子，让他能向怡和洋行交代的说法。
At the very least, he must find a way to refuse without costing Hart face, so that the latter could still give Jardine Matheson an acceptable account of the meeting.

转了转念头，决定采取拖延的手段。
After turning the matter over, he decided to play for time.


『鹭翁，』他从从容容地答道∶『中国人有句话，叫做「在商言商」，
“Mr Lubin,” he replied calmly, “we Chinese have a saying: ‘In business, speak as a businessman.’

怡和这样好的条件，在我求之不得。
Terms as good as Jardine Matheson’s are more than I could hope for.

不过，鹭翁总也晓得广东的情形，缫丝的机器都打坏了；
But you must know what happened in Guangdong, where the silk-reeling machines were smashed.

如果我同怡和订了合同，起了风潮，不是我一个人的损失，
If I signed a contract with Jardine Matheson and disturbances followed, I should not be the only one to suffer.

地方上亦要受害。
The whole locality would suffer too.

鹭翁，请你想一想，外到我们浙江巡抚，内到军机处、总理衙站，岂不都要怪我？
Consider it: from our governor here in Zhejiang to the Grand Council and Zongli Yamen in the capital, would they not all blame me?

「都老爷」的厉害，鹭翁在京多年，总也晓得，
You have spent many years in Beijing and know how formidable the censors are.

他们会饶得了我？』
Would they let me off?”

看看是水都泼不进去了，
His case seemed watertight.

不道胡雪岩突然一转，
Then he abruptly changed course.

『不过，』他的语声很重，『鹭翁，你不是替怡和做说客，
“But”—he emphasized the word—“you are not merely speaking for Jardine Matheson.

你是为了我们中国富强，
Your concern is the wealth and strength of China.

这件事情，一定要弄它成功，
We must find a way to make this succeed.

等我同各方面筹划出一个妥当办法出来，
Let me work out a suitable arrangement with everyone concerned.

只要不起风潮，不弄坏市面原来靠养蚕缫丝的人家，有条生路，我一定遵鹭翁的吩咐，只跟怡和一家订约。
Provided there is no unrest, the market is not disrupted, and the families who have lived by raising silkworms and reeling silk retain a livelihood, I shall certainly do as you ask and contract with Jardine Matheson alone.

至于额外的佣金，是鹭翁的面子，决不敢领。』
As for the extra commission, out of regard for you I could never accept it.”

这番话说得很漂亮，
It was a handsome speech.

但赫德有名的老奸巨猾，对中国的人情世故，摸得透熟；心想不起风潮，不坏市面，还要养蚕人家有生路，要避免这三点的『妥当办法』，花十年的工夫也未见得能筹划得出来。
But Hart, famously shrewd and thoroughly versed in Chinese social dealings, reflected that a satisfactory plan meeting all three conditions—no unrest, no market disruption, and a living for the silkworm-raising families—might not be devised in ten years.

然则什么『只跟怡和一家订约』，额外佣金『不敢领』，无非是有名无实的『口惠』而已。
The promise to contract exclusively with Jardine Matheson and the refusal of extra commission were thus generous words with nothing behind them.

话虽如此，但仍能体谅胡雪岩的苦心，
Nevertheless, he could appreciate Hu’s care.

明明是办不到；或者说他不肯抹煞良心，不顾利害去做的事，
The thing was plainly impossible, or at least something Hu would not do at the cost of silencing his conscience and disregarding the consequences.

有他则才前半段的话，也就够了，
The first half of his reply would have been sufficient.

而还有后斗段『不过』以下的补充，是一种很尊重客人的表现，其意还是可感的。
Everything after “but” was an additional mark of respect for his guest, and the intention deserved gratitude.


因此，他深深点头，
Hart nodded deeply.

『雪翁真是明理的人，比京中那几位大老，高明得太多了。』
“You are a man who understands reason, Mr Xue—far more enlightened than those venerable gentlemen in Beijing.

他说∶『我总算也是不虚此行。』
My journey has not been in vain.”

『哪里，哪里！』胡雪岩答说∶『都象鹭翁这么样体谅，什么都好谈。』
“You are too kind,” Hu replied. “If everyone were as understanding as you, anything could be discussed.”

侍者上菜，暂时隔断了谈话。
A servant brought in another dish, briefly interrupting the conversation.

这道菜是古应春发明的，名为『炸虾饼』，
It was Gu’s invention, called Fried Shrimp Cakes.

外表看来象炸板鱼，上口才知味道大不相同，
At first sight it resembled fried flatfish; only on tasting it did one discover how different it was.

是用虾仁捣烂，和上鸡胸肉切碎的鸡绒，用豆腐衣包成长方块，沾了面包粉油炸，
Pounded shrimp was mixed with finely minced chicken breast, wrapped in tofu skin in rectangular parcels, coated in breadcrumbs, and fried.

做法仿佛杭州菜中的『炸响铃』，只是材料讲究得太多了。
The method resembled Hangzhou’s fried “ringing bells,” but the ingredients were far more luxurious.

赫德的牙齿不太好，所以特别赞赏这道菜。
Hart’s teeth were poor, and he particularly appreciated the dish.

这就有了个闲谈的话题，
This supplied a lighter topic.

赫德很坦率地说，他舍不得离开中国，口腹之欲是很大的一个原因。
He freely admitted that the pleasures of the table were a major reason for his reluctance to leave China.

『董大人常常请我吃饭。』他不胜神往地说∶『他家的厨子，在我看全世界第一！』
“Lord Dong often invites me to dinner,” he said longingly. “To my mind, his cooks are the finest in the world!”


『董大人？是指户部尚书董恂，在总理衙门』当家『；
Lord Dong was Dong Xun, Minister of Revenue, who managed affairs at the Zongli Yamen.

他是扬州人，善于应酬，用了两个出身于扬州』八大盐商『家的厨子，
A native of Yangzhou and an accomplished host, he employed two cooks who had worked in the households of that city’s Eight Great Salt Merchants.

都有能做』全羊席『、』全鳝席『的本事。
Both could prepare entire banquets made from mutton or from eel.

董恂应酬洋人，还有一套扬州盐商附庸风雅的花样，经常来个』投壶『、』射虎『的雅集。有时拿荷马、拜伦的诗，译成』古内『或』近体『。
In entertaining foreigners, Dong also adopted the salt merchants’ displays of cultivated taste: gatherings for pitch-pot or riddle guessing, sometimes even translating Homer and Byron into ancient-style or regulated Chinese verse.

醉心中国文化的赫德，跟他特别投缘。』
Hart, enamored of Chinese culture, felt a particular affinity with him.

白乐天在贵外杭州做的诗∶『未能抛得杭州去，一半勾留为此湖。
“Bai Letian wrote a poem while in your city of Hangzhou: ‘I cannot bring myself to leave Hangzhou; / Half of what holds me here is this lake.’

「我倒想改一改，」未能抛得中华去，一半勾留是此┅┅「』赫德有点抓瞎，
I should like to alter it: ‘I cannot bring myself to leave China; / Half of what holds me here is this—’” Hart was stuck.

搔着花白头发『此』了好一会，
Scratching his graying hair, he repeated “this” for some time.

突然双眉一掀，
Then his eyebrows suddenly rose.

『肴！
“Fare!

一半勾留是此肴。』
‘Half of what holds me here is this fare.’”


胡雪岩暗中惭愧，不知道他说的什么。
Hu felt secretly ashamed: he had no idea what Hart was talking about.

古应春倒听懂了一半，便即问道∶『听说赫大人常跟董大人一起做诗唱和，
Gu understood at least part of it and asked, “I hear that you and Lord Dong often exchange poems.

真是了不起！』
A remarkable accomplishment!”

『唱和还谈不到，
“I could hardly claim to exchange poems with him.

不过常在一起谈诗、谈词。』赫德又说∶『小犬是从小读汉文，
But we often discuss poetry and lyrics.” Hart continued, “My son has studied Chinese writing from childhood.

老师也是董大人荐来的；
Lord Dong recommended his teacher.

现在已经开手做八股了，将来想在科场里面讨个出身，
He has now begun composing eight-legged essays, and he hopes eventually to gain a degree through the examinations.

董大人答应替我代奏，
Lord Dong has promised to submit a memorial on his behalf.

不知道能准不能准？』
I do not know whether permission will be granted.”

这番话，胡雪岩是听明白了。
This Hu understood.

『洋娃娃』读汉文、做八股『已经是奇事；居然还想赴考，真是闻所未闻了。』
A foreign child reading Chinese and writing eight-legged essays was strange enough; that he should actually hope to sit the examinations was unheard of.

一定会准。『古应春在回答。』
“It will certainly be granted,” Gu answered.

难得贤乔梓这样子仰慕中华，
“Such admiration for China on the part of both father and son is rare.

皇上一定恩出格外。
His Majesty is sure to show exceptional favor.”

『』但原能准。『赫德忽然说道∶』我想起一件，
“I only hope so.” Hart suddenly said, “That reminds me of something.

趁现在谈，免得回头忘记。
Let me mention it now before I forget.

雪翁，有件事，想请你帮忙，
Mr Xue, there is a matter in which I should like your help.

怡和洋行派人到湖州去买丝，定洋已经付出去了；
Jardine Matheson sent someone to Huzhou to buy silk, and the deposits have been paid.

现在有个消息，说到新丝上市，不打算交货了。
Now we hear that when the new silk comes onto the market, the sellers do not intend to deliver.

将来真的这样子，恐怕彼此要破脸了。
If that really happens, I fear there will be an open rupture.”

『胡雪岩隐约听说过这回事，
Hu had heard something vaguely about the affair.

其中还牵涉到一个姓赵的』教民『，但不知其详，更不知谁是谁？
It involved a Christian convert named Zhao, but he knew neither the details nor exactly who was concerned.

不过赫德话中的分量，却是心里已经掂到了。
He had, however, already weighed the significance of Hart’s words.


『鹭翁，』他问∶『你要我怎么帮怡和的忙，请你先说明了，我来想想办法。』
“Mr Lubin,” he asked, “tell me first exactly how you would like me to help Jardine Matheson, and I shall see what can be done.”

『雪翁一言九鼎。
“Your word carries enormous weight.

既然怡和付了定洋，想请雪翁交代一声，能够如期交货。』
Since Jardine Matheson has paid the deposits, I should like you to give instructions that delivery be made on time.”

胡雪岩心想赫德奸滑无比，
Hu reflected that Hart was exceedingly cunning.

他说这话，可能是个陷井，
This might be a trap.

如果一口应承，他回到京里说一句，养蚕做丝的人家，都只凭胡某人一句许，他们的丝，说能卖就卖；说不能卖，谁也不敢卖。
If he agreed too readily, Hart could go back to Beijing and say that all the silkworm growers and silk producers acted solely on Hu’s word: when he said their silk could be sold, they sold it; when he said it could not, nobody dared sell.

那一来总理衙门就可能责成他为了敦睦邦交，一定要让怡和在乡下能直接买丝，
The Zongli Yamen might then order him, in the interests of friendly foreign relations, to ensure that Jardine Matheson could buy silk directly in the countryside.

这不是很大的难题。
What a difficulty that would create!

于是胡雪岩答说∶『一言九鼎这句话，万万不敢当。
“I cannot possibly accept your description of my influence,” he replied.

丝卖不卖，是人家的事，
“Whether people sell their silk is their own affair.

我姓胡的，不能干预；干预了他们亦未必肯听。
I have no right to interfere, and even if I did, they might not listen.

不过交易总要讲公道，
But business must be conducted fairly.

收了定洋不交货，说不过去；
To accept a deposit and then refuse delivery is indefensible.

再有困难，至少要还定洋。
Whatever the difficulty, at the very least the deposit must be returned.

鹭翁特为交代的事，我不能不尽心力去办。
Since you have specially asked me, I must do all I can.

这样，』他沉吟了一下说∶『听说其中牵涉到一个姓赵的，在教堂做事；
Let us put it this way”—he paused to consider—“I hear the affair involves a man named Zhao who works at a church.

我请应春兄下去，专门为鹭翁料理这件事。』
I shall send Brother Yingchun down expressly to deal with it for you.”

『承情之至。』
“I am most grateful.”

赫德拱拱手道谢。
Hart clasped his hands in thanks.


『请问赫大人，』古应春开口问道∶『能不能让怡和派个人跟我来接头。』
“May I ask,” Gu said, “whether Jardine Matheson could send someone to make contact with me?”

『怡和的东主艾力克就在杭州。』赫德用英语问道∶『你们不是很熟吗？』
“Ailike, the proprietor of Jardine Matheson, is here in Hangzhou,” Hart replied in English. “Are you not well acquainted?”

『是的，很熟。
“Yes, very well.

而且听说他也到杭州来了，不知道什么地方可以找得到他。』
I had heard he was here, but I did not know where to find him.”

『你到我这里来好了。』梅藤更插进来说。
“Come to my place,” Dr Meitenggeng put in.


『好。』古应春答说∶『我明天上午到广济医院去。』
“Very well,” Gu replied. “I shall call at Guangji Hospital tomorrow morning.”

送走了客人，胡雪岩跟古应春还有话要谈。
When the guests had gone, Hu still had things to discuss with Gu.

酒阑人散，
The drinking was over and the company dispersed.

加以胡家的内眷，都在灵隐陪侍老太太，少了二、三十个丫头，
Most of the women of the Hu household were at Lingyin attending on the old lady, taking twenty or thirty maids with them.

那份清静简直就有点寂寞了。
The resulting quiet was almost lonely.

『难得，难得！
“A rare opportunity, a rare opportunity!

今天倒真是我们弟兄挖挖心里的话的辰光。
Tonight we brothers can really speak from the heart.

应春！今天很暖和，
Yingchun, it is warm.

我们在外面坐。』
Let us sit outside.”

『外面』指的镜槛阁的前廊，因为要反映阁外的景致，造得格外宽大，
Outside meant the gallery in front of Jingjian Pavilion, built unusually broad to allow the scenery beyond to be reflected inside.

不过凭栏设座，却在西面一角，
The seats by the railing were in a corner to the west.

三月十一的月亮也很大了，
The moon of the eleventh day of the third month was already large.

清光斜照，两人脸上都是幽幽地一种肃散的神色。
Its clear light fell obliquely across the two men, giving their faces a faintly somber and withdrawn look.

『应春，』胡雪岩说∶『我这几天有个很怪的念头，
“Yingchun,” Hu said, “I have had a very strange thought these past few days.

俗语说「人在福中不知福」，
There is a saying: ‘A man surrounded by good fortune does not know how fortunate he is.’

这句话不晓得对不对？』
I wonder whether it is true.”

古应春无从回答，因为根本不知道他为什么有这样一个『很怪的念头』。
Gu could not answer, having no idea what had prompted this strange thought.


『我们老太太常说要惜福，
“My mother is always telling me to cherish my blessings.

福是怎么个惜法？』
But how does one cherish them?”

『这——』
“Well…”

古应春一面想，一面说∶『无非不要太过分的意思福不要享尽。』
Gu thought as he spoke. “I suppose it means not carrying things too far—not using up all one’s good fortune.”

『对，
“Quite.

不过那一来就根本谈不到享福了。
But then one can scarcely speak of enjoying good fortune at all.

你只要有这样子一个念头在心里，喝口茶、吃口饭都要想一想，是不是太过分？
Once that thought is in your mind, every sip of tea and every mouthful of rice makes you wonder whether you are going too far.

做人做到这个地步，还有啥味道？』
What pleasure is there in a life like that?”

古应春觉得他多少是诡辩，但驳不倒他，
Gu felt this was something of a sophistry, but he could not refute it.

只好发问∶『那末，小爷叔，你说应该怎么样呢？』
He could only ask, “What do you suggest, then, Uncle?”

『照我想，反倒是「人在福中不知福」，才真是在享福。』
“I think it is precisely the man who does not know how fortunate he is who truly enjoys his good fortune.”

『小爷叔，你的意思是一个人不必惜福？』
“Do you mean one need not cherish one’s blessings?”

『不是，我不是这个意思。
“No, that is not what I mean.

我是说∶享福归享福，发财归发财，
I mean that enjoying oneself is one thing and making money another.

两桩事情不要混在一起，
Do not confuse the two.

想发财要动脑，要享福就不必去管怎么样发财。』『小爷叔』，古应春笑道∶『你老人家的话，我愈听愈不懂。』
To make money, one must use one’s brains; to enjoy oneself, one must stop thinking about how to make money.” Gu laughed. “Uncle, the more I hear, the less I understand.”


胡雪岩付之一笑，
Hu smiled back.

『不但你愈听愈不懂，我也愈想愈不懂。』
“The more I think about it, the less I understand it myself.”

他急转直下地说∶『我们来想个发财的法子——不对，想个又能发财，又要享福的法子。』
Then he abruptly changed direction. “Let us think of a way to make money—no, a way both to make money and enjoy ourselves.”

古应春想了一会，笑了，
Gu considered for a while, then laughed.

『小爷叔，』他说，『法子倒有一个，只怕做不到；
“There is one way, but I doubt it can be done.

不过，就算能够做到了，恐怕小爷叔，你我也决不肯去做。』
Even if it could, I am afraid neither you nor I would agree to it.”

『说来听听，
“Tell me.

啥法子？』
What is it?”

『「嫖能倒贴，天下营生无双」。
“‘To visit courtesans and have them pay you—there is no business like it under Heaven.’

那就是又发财又享福的法子。』
That is a way to make money and enjoy yourself at once.”

『这也不见得！』
“Not necessarily!”

胡雪岩欲语不语，
Hu seemed about to say more, then stopped.

『好了，
“Enough.

我们还是实实惠惠谈生意。
Let us talk about practical business.

今天我冒冒失失答应赫德了，
I rashly gave Hart my word today.

你总要把我这个面子绷起来。』
You must make sure I do not lose face over it.”

『那还要说！
“That goes without saying.

小爷叔说出去了，我当然要做到，
Once you have spoken, I must see it through.

好在过了今天就没有我的事；
Fortunately, after today my duties here will be over.

明天上半天去看艾力克，下半天来开销我带来的那班人，
Tomorrow morning I shall see Ailike; in the afternoon I shall settle up with the people I brought.

后天就可以动身。』
The day after tomorrow I can leave.”

『要带什么人？』
“Whom will you take with you?”


古应春沉吟一会说∶『带一个丝行里的伙计就够了。
After a little thought, Gu said, “One clerk from the silk firm will be enough.

要人，好在湖州钱庄典当、丝行里都可以调动，
If I need anyone else, the banks, pawnshops, and silk firms in Huzhou can all provide men.

倒是有一样东西不可不带。』
But there is one thing I must take.”

『是啥？』
“What is it?”

『藩司衙门的公事——』
“An official dispatch from the provincial treasurer’s office.”

『为啥？』胡雪岩迫不及待地追问。
“Why?” Hu asked eagerly.

『这道公事给湖州府，要这样说∶风闻湖州教民赵某某仗势欺人，所作所为都是王法所不容，
“It must be addressed to the Huzhou prefecture and say something like this: reports have been received that a Christian convert in Huzhou, one Zhao, abuses his influence to bully others and acts in ways intolerable under the law.

特派古某某下去密查，湖州府应该格外予以方便。』
Gu is therefore being sent specially to investigate in secret, and the prefecture is to give him every assistance.”

『古某某』是古应春自称。
By “Gu,” he meant himself.

他捐了个候补通判的职衔，又在吏部花了钱，分发到浙江。
He had purchased the title of expectant assistant prefect and paid further money at the Ministry of Personnel to be assigned to Zhejiang.

实际上他不想做官，又不想当差，
He did not actually wish to hold office or take an official assignment.

只是有了这样一个头衔，有许多方便；甚至于还可以检便宜，
Such a title merely afforded many conveniences and could even bring opportunities for personal advantage.

这时候就是用得到的时候了。
This was one occasion when it would prove useful.


『我有了这个奉宪命查案的身分，就可以跟赵某人讲斤头了，
“With the status of an investigator acting under the provincial authority’s orders, I can bargain with Zhao.

斤头谈不拢，我再到湖州府去报文，也还不迟。』
If we cannot come to terms, it will still be time enough to present my credentials to the Huzhou prefecture.”

『这个法子不坏！』胡雪岩说∶『明天上午我们一起去见德晓峰。』
“Not a bad plan,” Hu said. “Let us call on De Xiaofeng together tomorrow morning.”

『上午我约好要去看艾力克，
“I have already arranged to see Ailike in the morning.

是不是下午看德藩台？』
Could we call on Treasurer De in the afternoon?”

『只怕公事当天赶不及。』胡雪岩紧接着，『晚一天动身也不要紧。』
“I am only afraid they may not get the dispatch ready that same day.” Hu added at once, “There is no harm in leaving a day later.”

『好，
“Very well.

那就准定后天动身。』
Then we shall definitely leave the day after tomorrow.”


『应春，』胡雪岩换了个话题，『你明天见了艾力克，要问他要帐，
Hu changed the subject. “Yingchun, when you see Ailike tomorrow, ask for his accounts.

他到底放出去多少定洋，
Exactly how much has he advanced in deposits?

放给什么人，数目多少，
To whom, and in what amounts?

一定要他开个花名册。』
He must provide an itemized list of names.”

『这——』
“Well…”

古应春迟疑着，
Gu hesitated.

『只怕他开不出来，
“He may not be able to do that.

帐都在他洋行里。』
His accounts are at the firm.”

『不要紧，
“Never mind.

等他回上海再开。
He can prepare it when he returns to Shanghai.

你告诉他，只要花名册开来，查过没有花帐，一定如数照付，
Tell him that once the list arrives, and we have checked that there are no fictitious entries, we shall pay the whole amount.

叫他放心好了。』
He need not worry.”

『小爷叔，』古应春郑重警告∶『这样做法很危险。』
“Uncle,” Gu warned gravely, “that is dangerous.”

『你是说风险？』
“You mean there is a risk?

胡雪岩问∶『我们不背风险，叫哪个来背？』
If we do not bear it, who will?”

古应春想了一说∶『既然如此，何不索性先把款子付了给他，也买个漂亮。』
Gu thought for a moment. “In that case, why not pay him the money first and make a handsome gesture of it?”

『我正是这个意思，
“That is precisely my intention.

也不光是买个漂亮，
And it is not merely a handsome gesture.

我是要叫他知难而退；
I want him to see the difficulties and retreat.

而且这一来，他的那班客户都转到我手里来了。』『还是小爷叔厉害。』古应春笑道∶『我是一点都没有想到。』
Besides, all his suppliers will then pass into my hands.” Gu laughed. “You are the shrewder man, Uncle. That never occurred to me.”

谈到这里，只见瑞香翩然而至，问宵夜的心开在何处？
At this point Ruixiang appeared, asking where the late supper should be served.

胡雪岩交代∶『就开到这里来！』
“Bring it here,” Hu instructed.

古应春根本就吃不下宵夜，而且也有些疲累，
Gu had no appetite at all and was rather tired.

很想早点归寝，但仿佛这一下会辜负瑞香的一番殷勤之意，怕她会觉得扫兴，
He wanted to go to bed early, but felt that leaving now would slight Ruixiang’s attentiveness and disappoint her.

所以仍旧留了下来。
So he stayed.


不过一开了来，他倒又有食欲了，
Once supper appeared, his appetite returned.

因为宵夜的只是极薄的香粳米粥，六样粥菜，
There was only a very thin gruel of fragrant rice and six accompaniments.

除了醉蟹以外，其他都是凉拌笋尖之类的素肴。
Apart from drunken crab, all were vegetable dishes such as cold dressed bamboo-shoot tips.

连日饱沃肥甘，正思清淡食物，所以停滞的胃口又开了。
After days of rich eating, he had been longing for something plain, and his sluggish appetite revived.

盛粥之先，瑞香问道∶『古老爷要不要来杯酒？』
Before serving the gruel, Ruixiang asked, “Would you like a glass of wine, Mr Gu?”

『好啊！』
“Gladly.

古应春欣然答说∶『我要杯白兰地。』
I should like some brandy.”

『有我们太太用人参泡的白兰地，
“We have some brandy in which Madam has steeped ginseng.

我去拿。』
I shall fetch it.”

说着，先盛了两碗粥，然后去取来浸泡在水晶瓶里的药酒，
She filled two bowls of gruel first, then brought the medicinal liquor in a crystal decanter.

取来的水晶杯也不错，是巨腹矮脚，用来喝白兰地的酒杯。
The crystal glass she chose was right too: a large-bowled, short-stemmed glass designed for brandy.

这就使得古应春想到上个月在家请客，请的法国的一个家有酒窑的巨商，
It reminded Gu of a dinner at home the month before for a wealthy French merchant whose family owned wine cellars.

饭前酒、饭后酒，什么菜配红酒，什么菜配白酒，都有讲究。
There were rules for everything: drinks before and after the meal, red wine with one dish and white with another.

古应春原有全套的酒杯，但女仆不懂这套规矩，预备得不周全；
Gu possessed a full set of glasses, but the maidservants did not understand the rules and had not prepared them properly.

七姑奶奶不知道怎么知道了，在床空着急。
Somehow the Seventh Lady learned of it and could only fret helplessly in bed.

如果有瑞香在，她便可以不必操心了。
With Ruixiang there, she would not have to worry.

这样想着，不自觉抬头去看瑞香，脸上自然是含着笑意∶瑞香正在斟酒，不曾发觉，胡雪岩冷眼旁观，却看得很清楚。
Thinking this, Gu unconsciously looked up at Ruixiang with a smile. She was pouring the brandy and did not notice, but Hu, watching quietly, saw it all.

『湘阴四月里要出巡，
“Xiangyin will be making an inspection tour in the fourth month,” he said.

上海的制造局是一定要去看的，那时候我当然要去等他。
“He is certain to visit the arsenal in Shanghai, and naturally I must be there to wait for him.

应春，我想等老太太的生日一过，让罗四姐先去看七姐；
Yingchun, once Mother’s birthday is over, I think I shall have Sister Luo go ahead to see Sister Seven.

到时候我再跟他换班，
Then I can take her place when I arrive.

那就两头都顾到了。
That way we shall attend to both ends.

你看好不好？』
What do you think?”


『怎么不好？』古应春答说∶『这回罗四姐去，就住在我那里好了。』
“What could be better?” Gu replied. “Sister Luo must stay at my house on this visit.”



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第二章（本章第2部分，共6部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


『当然，当然，
“Of course, of course.

非住你那里不可的，
She must stay with you.

不然就不方便了。』
It would be inconvenient otherwise.”

古应春觉得他话中有话，却无从猜测；
Gu felt that there was more behind Hu’s words, but could not guess what it was.

不过由左宗棠出巡到上海，却想到了好些事。
The thought of Zuo Zongtang’s inspection visit to Shanghai, however, brought several other matters to mind.

『湘阴到上海，我们该怎么预备？』
“What preparations should we make for Xiangyin’s arrival?”

『喔，这件事我早想到了，因为老太太生日，没有工夫谈。』
“Ah, I thought of that some time ago, but Mother’s birthday left no opportunity to discuss it.

胡雪岩答说∶『湘阴两样毛病，你晓得的，一样是好虚面子，一样是总想打倒李二先生。
You know his two weaknesses: he loves outward marks of prestige, and he is always intent on bringing down Second Master Li.

所以我在想，先打听打听李二先生当年以两江总督的身分到上海，是啥场面？
I thought we should first find out what sort of reception Li had when he came to Shanghai as Governor-General of Liangjiang.

这一回湘阴去了，场面盖过李二先生，他就高兴了。』
If we give Xiangyin a grander reception, he will be pleased.”

『我记得李二先生是同治四年放江督的，
“I remember that Li was appointed in the fourth year of Tongzhi.

十几年的工夫，情形不大同了。
That was more than ten years ago, and things have changed.

当年的「常胜军」，算是他的部下，当然要请他去看操；
The Ever-Victorious Army was under his command, so naturally he was invited to review it.

现在各国有兵舰派在上海，是人家自己的事，
The foreign warships now stationed at Shanghai are there for their own countries’ purposes.

不见得会请他上船去看。』
They may not invite him aboard for an inspection.”

『提起这一层，我倒想到了。
“That reminds me of something.

兵舰上可以放礼炮；
Warships can fire salutes.

等他坐船到高昌庙的时候，黄浦江里十几条外国兵舰一齐放礼炮，
When his vessel reaches Gaochangmiao, let a dozen or more foreign warships on the Huangpu fire together.

远到昆山、松江都听得到，
The sound will carry as far as Kunshan and Songjiang.

湘阴这个面子就足了。』
That should give Xiangyin all the prestige he wants.”

『这倒可以办得到，
“It can be arranged.

外国人这种空头人情是肯做的。
Foreigners are quite willing to confer that sort of empty honor.

不过，俄国兵舰，恐怕不肯。』
The Russian ships, however, may refuse.”

这是顾虑到伊犁事件中，左宗棠对俄国采取敌对态度之故。
Gu was thinking of Zuo’s hostile attitude toward Russia during the Ili affair.

但胡雪岩以为事过境迁，俄国兵舰的指挥官，不见得还会记着这段旧怨。
Hu thought circumstances had changed and the Russian commanders might no longer bear that old grudge.


『应春，这件事你要早点去办，都要讲好，
“Yingchun, arrange it early and settle everything beforehand.

俄国人那里，可以转托人去疏通；
Someone else might help smooth the way with the Russians.

俄国同德国不是蛮接近的吗？』
Are Russia and Germany not rather close?”

『好。
“Very well.

我会去找路子。』
I shall look for a way.”

『我想，来得及的话，罗四姐跟你一起去，倒也蛮好。胡雪岩说了这一句，眼尖瞥见瑞香留心在听，
“If there is time, it would be quite good for Sister Luo to travel with you.” As he said this, Hu noticed Ruixiang listening closely.

便招招手将她唤了过来，
He beckoned her over.

有话问她。『瑞香，』他说∶『太太要到上海去看七姑奶奶，
“Ruixiang, Madam is going to Shanghai to see the Seventh Lady.

你要跟了去。』
You are to go with her.”


『是。』
“Yes, Master.”

『我再问你一句话，
“There is something else I want to ask.

太太有这个意思，想叫你留在上海，帮七姑奶奶管家，
Madam is thinking of leaving you in Shanghai to help the Seventh Lady manage the house.

你愿意不愿意。』
Would you be willing?”

『要说管家，我不敢当。
“I would not presume to manage the house.

七姑奶奶原有管家的。』
The Seventh Lady already has someone to do that.”

『那末，照应七姑奶奶的病呢？』
“Then what about caring for her during her illness?”

『这，当然是应该的。』
“That would certainly be my duty.

瑞香答说∶『只要老爷、太太交代，我当然伺候。』
If you and Madam instruct me, of course I shall attend to her.”

『伺候不敢当。』古应春插进来说∶『不过她病在床上，没有个人跟她谈得来的，
“We could hardly ask you to serve us,” Gu interposed. “But she lies ill in bed without anyone she can really talk to.

心里难免闷气，病也不容易好了。
She is bound to feel depressed, and that makes recovery more difficult.

我先谢谢你。』
Let me thank you in advance.”

说着，站了起来。
He rose.

『不敢当，不敢当。』
“Please do not, please do not!”

瑞香想按他的肩，不让他起立，
Ruixiang reached out to press his shoulder and keep him seated.

手伸了出去，才想到要避嫌疑，
Only after extending her hand did she remember that she must avoid any appearance of impropriety.

顿时脸一红往后退了两步，把头低着。
Blushing, she stepped back twice and lowered her head.

『好！
“Good!

这就算说定规了。』胡雪岩一语双关地说∶『应春，你放心到湖州去吧！』
Then that is settled,” Hu said with a double meaning. “Yingchun, you can go to Huzhou with an easy mind.”


胡家自己有十二条船，
The Hu household owned twelve boats.

最好的两条官船，一大一小；
The best were two official-style vessels, one large and one small.

古应春一行只得四个人，坐了小的那一条，由小火轮拖带，当天便到了湖州以北的南浔。
Gu’s party numbered only four, so they took the smaller, towed by a little steam launch, and reached Nanxun, north of Huzhou, that same day.

这个位于太湖南岸的市镇，为东南财赋之区的精华所聚，
This town on the southern shore of Lake Tai concentrated the wealth of the prosperous southeast.

名气不大，而富庶过于有名的江西景德镇、广东佛山镇，就因为这里出全中国最好的『七里丝』。
Less famous than Jingdezhen in Jiangxi or Foshan in Guangdong, it was richer than either, for it produced the finest silk in China, known as Qili silk.

古应春对南浔并不陌生，
Gu knew Nanxun well enough.

随同胡雪岩来过一回，自己来过两回，
He had come once with Hu and twice on his own.

这一次是一年之中，再度重临，不过去年是红叶乌桕的深秋，今年是草长莺飞的暮春。
This was his second visit within a year, but last time it had been late autumn, with red leaves on the tallow trees; now it was late spring, with grass growing high and orioles on the wing.

船是停在西市梢，
They moored at the far end of the western market.

踏上石埠头，一条青石板铺的『纤路』，却有一条很宽的死巷子，
From the stone landing, a towpath paved with blue stone led to a broad blind alley.

去到尽头才看到左首有两扇黑油铜环，很气派的大门，
Only at its end did they see, on the left, an imposing pair of black-lacquered doors with bronze rings.

门楣上嵌着一方水磨砖嵌字的匾额，篆书四字∶『莲池精舍』。
A plaque of polished brick inlaid with lettering above the lintel bore four seal-script characters: Lotus Pond Retreat.


『这里就是了。』古应春向跟着身后的同伴雷桂卿说∶『如果我一个人来，每回都住在这里。』
“This is the place,” Gu told Lei Guiqing, who followed him. “Whenever I come alone, I stay here.”

说着，找到门上有个扣环，拉了两下，
Finding a pull-ring on the door, he tugged it twice.

只听门内琅琅铃响，不久门开；
A bell rang inside, and presently the door opened.

应门的是二十来岁的女子，
The woman who answered was in her twenties.

穿着淡青竹布僧袍，却留着一头披到肩下的长发。
She wore a pale blue-green cotton monastic robe, but her hair hung long below her shoulders.

雷桂卿在船上就听古应春谈过『莲池精舍』这座家庭，与众不同；
On the boat, Gu had already told Lei how unusual this private Buddhist retreat was.

他处家庵大多是官宦人家老主人的姬妾，
Such foundations were generally established for the concubines of deceased officials or wealthy householders.

年纪有比『少爷』、『少奶奶』还轻的，
Some of these women were younger than the heir and his wife.

老主人下世，既不能下堂求去，又嫌在家拘束，
After the old master’s death, they could neither leave the family to make new lives nor endure its restrictions.

往往由小主人斥资造一座家庵，置百十亩良田，供她长斋礼佛，带发修行。
The new master would often pay to build a private retreat, endow it with roughly a hundred mu of good farmland, and support the woman in a permanent vegetarian life of Buddhist devotion, practiced without shaving her hair.

惟独这座莲池精舍的『住持』，
The woman presiding over Lotus Pond Retreat was different.

原是苏州自立门户的一个名妓，
She had once been a famous Suzhou courtesan with an establishment of her own.

只为先后结过两个已论嫁娶的恩客，
On two occasions she had become attached to patrons with whom marriage had already been discussed.

一个病故，一个横死，
One died of illness, the other met a violent death.

勘透情关，造了这座莲池精舍，奉莲池大师的『净土宗』，忏悔宿业。
Disillusioned with love, she built Lotus Pond Retreat and followed the Pure Land teaching of Master Lianchi to repent the karmic debts of her former life.

这法名悟心的住持，
Taking the religious name Wuxin, she became its mistress.

在家时，便以豪爽善应酬驰名于十里山塘；
Even in her worldly days, her generosity and skill in entertaining had been famous throughout Shantang.

出了家，本性难改，
Religious retirement had not changed her nature.

有谈得来的男客，一样接待在庵里住，但不能动绮念。
She still received male guests whose company she enjoyed and allowed them to stay at the retreat, but they must entertain no amorous designs.

倘不知趣，她有王熙凤收拾贾瑞的手段，叫人吃了哑巴亏而无可奈何。
If a man failed to understand, she possessed all Wang Xifeng’s skill in dealing with Jia Rui: she could make him suffer a humiliation he dared neither complain of nor remedy.


古应春是当她在风尘中时，便曾有一面之缘，
Gu had met her once when she was still a courtesan.

第一回到南浔来，听人谈起，特地来访。
On his first visit to Nanxun, hearing people speak of her, he had made a special call.

古应春文雅而风趣，肚子里的『杂货』很多，谈什么都能谈出个名堂来，
Cultivated and witty, with a rich store of miscellaneous knowledge, he could make something interesting of almost any subject.

加以善于体贴，在花丛中是到处受欢迎的客人；到了『方外』，亦复如是，
His consideration for others made him welcome wherever women entertained, and he was equally welcome in this retreat from the world.

悟心跟他很投缘，
He and Wuxin got on extremely well.

第一次作客莲池以后，坚约以后到南浔来，一定要以她这里为居停，
After that first visit, she had insisted that whenever he came to Nanxun, he must make her house his lodging.

不过这一回却有负悟心的好意了。
This time, however, he would have to disappoint her.

『小玉，』古应春向应门的女子说∶『这位是雷三爷。』
“Xiaoyu,” he said to the woman at the door, “this is Third Master Lei.”

『雷三爷请。』
“Please come in, Third Master Lei.”

小玉一面关门，一面问道∶『古老爷，怎么不先写封信来？』
As she closed the door, Xiaoyu asked, “Mr Gu, why did you not write ahead?”

『临时有事才决定到湖州来一趟。』
“The business that brings me to Huzhou arose quite suddenly.

古应春问道∶『你师父呢？
Where is your teacher?

那只哈叭狗怎么不见？』
And where is the little lapdog?”

悟心有条善解人意的哈叭狗，
Wuxin had an exceptionally responsive little dog.

每回听到古应春的声音——哪怕是脚步声，都会摇着项下的金铃，蹒蹒跚跚地跑来向他摇尾巴大吠；
Whenever it heard Gu’s voice—or even his footsteps—it would come waddling up, the gold bell at its neck jingling, to wag its tail and bark at him.

此时声息全无，所以他诧异地问。
Now there was neither sound nor movement from it, which puzzled him.

『师父让黄太太请了去了。』小玉答说∶『大概也快回来了，
“Madam Huang has invited my teacher over,” Xiaoyu replied. “She should be back soon.

请到师父的禅房里坐。』
Please sit in her rooms.”

悟心的禅房是一座五开间的敞轩，正中铺着佛堂，
Wuxin’s quarters occupied an open pavilion five bays wide, with a Buddhist shrine in the center.

东首是两间打通的客座，收拾得纤尘不染。
The two eastern bays had been joined into a reception room kept spotless.

小玉肃客落座，
Xiaoyu ceremoniously showed them to their seats.

随即便有一个十二三岁与小玉般打扮的小姑娘，走来奉茶。
Soon a girl of twelve or thirteen, dressed like Xiaoyu, came to serve tea.


『是你的师弟？』古应春说，
“Is she a junior fellow disciple of yours?” Gu asked.

『去年没有见过。』
“I did not see her last year.”

『今年正月里来的。』接着便叫∶『阿文，这位古老爷，这位雷三爷。』
“She came in the first month of this year.” Xiaoyu then called to her. “A’wen, this is Mr Gu, and this is Third Master Lei.”

阿文腼腼腆腆地叫了人，向小玉说道∶『三师兄，老佛婆说师父今天在黄家，总要吃了斋才回来，
