A’wen shyly greeted them, then addressed Xiaoyu. “Third Senior, Old Buddha Granny says Teacher will stay at the Huangs’ for the vegetarian meal before coming back.

她也要回家看孙子去了。』
Granny is going home to see her grandson.”

古应春知道这里的情形，所以懂她的意思，
Gu knew the arrangements here and understood what she meant.

老佛婆烧得一手好素菜；
Old Buddha Granny was an excellent vegetarian cook.

这天不在庵里，回头款客的素斋，便无着落，
If she was away, there would be no one to prepare the visitors’ meal.

特意提醒小玉。
A’wen was tactfully alerting Xiaoyu.

因此，古应春不等小玉开口，先抢着说道∶『我们不在这里吃饭。
Before Xiaoyu could speak, Gu said, “We shall not eat here.

船菜还多得很，天气热了，不吃坏掉也可惜。
There is plenty of food on the boat, and in this warm weather it would be a pity to let it spoil.

喔，还有，这一回我不能住在你们这里，
Oh, and I cannot stay here this time.

我同雷三爷回船去睡。』
Third Master Lei and I shall sleep aboard.”

『古老爷，』小玉微笑道∶『都等我师父回来了再说。』
Xiaoyu smiled. “Mr Gu, let us wait until my teacher returns before deciding all that.”


古应春点头，问些庵中近况。
Gu nodded and asked about recent happenings at the retreat.

不一会阿文来上点心；
Soon A’wen brought refreshments.

家庵中的小吃，一向讲究质地，不重形式，
Snacks at such private retreats were valued for their ingredients rather than their appearance.

端出来的枣泥方糕，不甚起眼，但上口才知道香甜无比，
The square date-paste cakes looked unremarkable, but one bite revealed an incomparable fragrance and sweetness.

本以初次作客，打算浅尝即止的雷桂卿忍不住一连吃了三块。
On his first visit, Lei had intended to do no more than taste one politely. Instead he found himself eating three in succession.

吃得一饱，正待告辞，悟心翩然而归，一见便有惊喜之色；
Satisfied, they were preparing to take their leave when Wuxin returned with graceful steps, surprise and pleasure lighting her face at the sight of them.

等古应春引见了雷桂卿，少不得有一番客套。
Gu introduced Lei, and the usual courtesies followed.

雷桂卿看她三十五、六年纪，丰神淡雅，
She looked thirty-five or thirty-six, with a quiet elegance.

但偶尔秋波一转，光如闪电，别有一股摄人的魔力，雷桂卿不由得心旌摇摇。
But an occasional turn of her eyes flashed like lightning with a peculiar, compelling power, and Lei felt his heart stir.

及至悟心与古应春说话时，开出口来，让雷桂卿大感惊异，悟心竟是直呼其名∶『应春！』她问，『你不说二月里会来吗？
When she spoke to Gu, he was astonished: she addressed him directly by his given name. “Yingchun, did you not say you would come in the second month?

何以迟到现在？』
Why have you left it until now?”


『原来是想给胡老太太拜寿以前，先来看看你，
“I meant to see you before going to Old Madam Hu’s birthday celebration.

哪知道一到杭州就脱不了身。』
But once I reached Hangzhou, I could not get away.”

『这话离奇。』悟心说道∶『胡老太太做生日，前后七天，我早就听说了。
“That is a strange story,” Wuxin replied. “I heard long ago that her birthday festivities would last seven days.

今天还在七天当中，
Those seven days are not over yet.

你怎么倒脱身了呢？』
How have you managed to get away now?”

『那是因为有点要紧事要办。』
“There is some urgent business to attend to.

古应春问道∶『有个人，不知道听说过没有？赵宝禄。』
I wonder whether you have heard of someone: Zhao Baolu.”

『你跟我来打听他，不是问道于盲吗？』
“Asking me about him is like asking a blind person for directions.”

『听你这么说，我大概是打听对了。』
“From the way you say that, I think I have come to the right person.”

古应春笑道∶『你们虽然道不同，不过都是名人，
Gu smiled. “You may follow different paths, but you are both well-known figures.

不应该不知道。』
You can hardly be unaware of him.”

『我算什么「名人」？
“What sort of ‘well-known figure’ am I?

应春，你不要瞎说！
Do not talk nonsense, Yingchun.

让雷先生误会我这莲池精舍六根不净。』
You will make Mr Lei think this Lotus Pond Retreat is still full of worldly passions.”

『不，不！』雷桂卿急忙分辩∶『哪里会误会。』
“No, no!” Lei hastily protested. “I could never misunderstand it so.”

『我是说笑话的，
“I am joking.

误会我也不怕。
And I should not be afraid even if you did misunderstand.

雷先生，你不必介意。』
Do not trouble yourself.”

悟心转脸问道∶『应春，你打听赵宝禄为点啥？』
Wuxin turned back to Gu. “Why are you inquiring about Zhao Baolu?”

『我也受人之托。为生意上的事。』
“Someone has entrusted me with a matter of business.”


古应春说∶『这话说来很长，
“It is a long story,” Gu said.

你如果对此人熟悉，跟我谈谈他的为人。』
“If you know the man, tell me what he is like.”

『谈到他的为人，最好不要问我。』接着便向外喊道∶『小玉，
“On his character, you had better not ask me.” She called outside. “Xiaoyu!

小玉！』
Xiaoyu!”

等把小玉唤了来，她说∶『你倒讲讲，你家婶娘信教的故事。』
When Xiaoyu came, she said, “Tell them about your aunt’s conversion.”

小玉一时楞住了，不知如何回答；
Xiaoyu was taken aback and did not know how to begin.

古应春便提了一个头∶『我是想打听打听赵宝禄。』
Gu supplied an opening. “I am trying to find out about Zhao Baolu.”

『喔，这个吃教的！「小玉鄙夷不屑地说∶』开口耶稣，闭口耶稣，骗杀人，不偿命。
“Oh, that man who makes a living out of religion!” Xiaoyu said contemptuously. “Jesus this, Jesus that—and he could swindle a person to death without answering for it.”

『』骗过你婶娘？
“Did he cheat your aunt?”

『『是啊。
“Yes.

说起来丢丑——』看小玉有不愿细谈的模样，古应春很知趣地说∶『丑事不必说了。
It is shameful to speak of—” Seeing her reluctance to go into details, Gu tactfully said, “There is no need to tell an embarrassing story.

小玉，我想问你，他是不是放定洋，买了好些丝？』
What I want to ask is this: has he paid deposits on a large quantity of silk?”

『定洋是有，没有放下来。』
“There are deposits, but they were never paid out.”

『这话是怎么个说法？』
“What do you mean?”

『他说，上海洋行里托他买丝，
“He said a Shanghai foreign firm had commissioned him to buy silk.

价钱也不错，先付三成定洋，
The price was good, with a thirty-percent deposit.

叫人家先打收条，第二天去收款子。』
He had people sign receipts first and told them to come for the money next day.”

小玉愤愤地说∶『到第二天去了，他说要修教堂，劝人家奉献；
Xiaoyu spoke indignantly. “When they went, he said the church needed repairing and urged them to contribute.

软的硬的磨了半天，老实的认了；
After endless coaxing and pressure, the meek ones gave in.

厉害的说∶没有定洋没有丝，
The bolder ones said, ‘No deposit, no silk.

到时候打官司好了。
Let there be a lawsuit when the time comes.’

话是这么说，笔据在他手里，
But he holds the written receipts.

还不知道怎么样呢？』
Who knows what will happen?”


『那应该早跟他办交涉啊！
“Then they should take it up with him at once.

夜长梦多，
Delay only breeds trouble.

将来都是他的理了。』
Later he will have all the evidence on his side.”

『古老爷，要伺候「蚕宝宝」啊。』
“Mr Gu, they have the silkworm babies to look after.”

其实，不必她说，古应春便已发觉，话问错了，
In fact, before she spoke, Gu had already realized that his question was ill judged.

环绕太湖的农家，三、四月间称为『蚕月』，
Around Lake Tai, the third and fourth months were known as the silkworm months.

家家红纸粘门，不相往来，而且有许多禁忌。
Every household pasted red paper on its doors, stopped visiting its neighbors, and observed numerous taboos.

因为养蚕是件极辛苦的事，
Raising silkworms was exhausting work.

一个照料不到，生了『蚕瘟』或者其他疾病，一年衣食就要落空了。
One lapse of attention could bring silkworm plague or another disease and destroy a family’s food and clothing for the whole year.

所以明知该早办交涉，也只好暂且抛开。
Though they knew they ought to deal with the matter promptly, they could only put it aside for the time being.


『应春，』悟心问道∶『你问这件事，总有缘故吧？』
“Yingchun,” Wuxin asked, “you must have some reason for inquiring into this?”

『当然，
“Of course.

我就是为此而来的，
It is why I have come.

他受上海怡和洋行之托，在这里收丝；放出风声去，说到时候怕不能交丝，说不定有场官司好打，闹成「教案」。
He has been commissioned by Jardine Matheson in Shanghai to buy silk here, but he is spreading word that delivery may not be possible and that there may be a lawsuit—perhaps even a dispute involving the church.

人家规规矩矩做生意的外国人，不喜欢闹教案，
Foreign merchants who do honest business do not want such a dispute.

想把定洋收回，利息也不必算了。
They would rather recover their deposits and waive the interest.

我就是代怡和来办这件事的。』
I have come to deal with it on Jardine Matheson’s behalf.”

『难！
“It will be difficult.

人家预备闹教案了，存心耍赖，恐怕你弄他不过。』
If he is preparing to make it a religious dispute and means to evade his obligations, you may find him too much for you.”

『他不能不讲道理吧？』
“Surely he must listen to reason?”

悟心沉吟了一回说道∶『你先去试试看，
Wuxin considered for a while. “Go and try first.

谈不拢再说。』
If you cannot reach an agreement, we shall see.”

看这情形，悟心似乎可以帮得上忙，古应春心便宽了∶向雷桂卿说∶『我们明天一早进城；
She seemed to have some means of helping, and Gu felt easier. “We shall go into the city first thing tomorrow,” he told Lei.

谈得好最好，
“If the discussion goes well, excellent.

如果他不上路，我们回来再商量。』
If he will not behave reasonably, we shall come back and talk it over.”

『好！』悟心接口∶『今天老佛婆不在庵里，
“Good,” Wuxin said. “Old Buddha Granny is away today.

明天我叫她好好弄几样素菜，请雷先生。』
Tomorrow I shall have her prepare some good vegetarian dishes for Mr Lei.”

话虽如此，由小玉下厨整治的一顿素斋，亦颇精致入味；
Even so, the vegetarian dinner Xiaoyu prepared was delicate and flavorful.

加以有自酿的百果酒，色香俱佳，
There was also home-brewed mixed-fruit wine, excellent in color and bouquet.

雷桂卿陶然引杯，兴致极好。
Lei drank with contented enjoyment and grew increasingly cheerful.

古应春怕他酒后失态，不让他多喝；匆匆吃完，告辞回船。
Afraid he might lose his composure in drink, Gu prevented him from having too much, finished the meal quickly, and took his leave to return to the boat.


到了第二天清晨，正待解缆进城时，只见两乘小轿，在跳板前面停住，
Early next morning, just as they were about to cast off for the city, two small sedan chairs stopped before the gangplank.

轿中出来两个白面书生，
Two pale-faced young scholars stepped out.

仔细看时，才知是悟心跟小玉。
Only on looking closely did Gu recognize Wuxin and Xiaoyu.

由于她们是易装来的，自以不公然招呼为宜，
Since they had come in disguise, it was best not to greet them openly.

古应春只担心她们穿了内里塞满棉花的靴子，步履维艰，
Gu’s chief concern was that their boots, stuffed inside with cotton, made walking difficult.

通过晃荡起伏的跳板会出事，
Crossing the swaying gangplank might be dangerous.

所以亲自帮着船案，把住伸到岸上作为扶手之用的竹篙，同时不断警告∶『慢慢走，慢慢走，
He therefore helped the boatman steady the bamboo pole extended to the bank as a handrail, repeatedly cautioning them, “Slowly, slowly.

把稳了！』
Keep your footing!”

等她们师徒战战兢兢地上了船，迎入舱中，古应春方始问道∶『你们也要进城？』
Once teacher and disciple had come aboard with nervous steps and been shown into the cabin, Gu asked, “Are you going into the city too?”

『对！』
“Yes.”

悟心流波四转，
Wuxin’s eyes traveled around the cabin.

『这只船真漂亮，
“What a beautiful boat.

坐一回也是福气。
It is a privilege to have a ride in it.

小玉，你把纱窗帘拉起来。』
Xiaoyu, draw the gauze curtains.”

船窗有两层窗帘，一层是白色带花纹的外国纱，一层是紫红丝绒，
The windows had two layers of curtains, one of white patterned foreign gauze, the other of purple-red velvet.

拉起纱帘，舱中仍很明亮，但岸上及别的船却看不清舱中的情形了。
With the gauze drawn, the cabin remained bright, but people on the bank or in other boats could not see clearly inside.


于是悟心将那顶帽后缀着一条假辫子的青缎瓜皮帽摘了下来，头晃了两下，
Wuxin removed her blue satin skullcap, with its false queue attached at the back, and shook her head twice.

原来藏在帽中的长发便都披散下来；
The long hair concealed beneath it fell loose.

然后坐了下来，脱去靴子，轻轻捏着脚趾。
Then she sat down, took off her boots, and gently massaged her toes.

这样的行径，不免予人以风流放诞的感觉。
Her behavior had an air of free and unconventional charm.

古应春不以为奇，而雷桂卿却是初见，心中不免兴起若干绮想。
Gu found it unremarkable, but Lei, seeing it for the first time, could not help entertaining romantic thoughts.

『你知道我进城去做什么？』悟心问说。
“Do you know why I am going into the city?” Wuxin asked.

『我也正要问你这话。』
“I was just about to ask.

古应春答说∶『看你要到哪里，我叫船老大先送你。』
Tell me where you want to go, and I shall have the boatman take you there first.”

『我哪里也不去，
“I am not going anywhere.

等下，我在船上等你们。』
I shall wait for you aboard.

悟心答说∶『你们跟赵宝禄谈妥当了最好，
If you settle things with Zhao Baolu, so much the better.

不然，我替你们找个朋友。』
If not, I shall find a friend to help you.”

原来是特为来帮忙的，
So she had come expressly to assist them.

雷桂卿愈发觉得悟心不同凡俗，
Lei admired her all the more as someone out of the ordinary.

不由得说道∶『悟心师太，你一个出家人，这样子热心，真是难得。』
“Mistress Wuxin, such readiness to help from someone who has left the world is truly rare.”


『我也不算出家人，
“I can hardly count myself as having left it.

就算出了家，人情世故总还是一样的。』
And even for those who have, human feelings and the ways of the world remain the same.”

『是、是。』
“Yes, yes.”

雷桂卿合十说道∶『我佛慈悲！』
Lei pressed his palms together. “The Buddha is merciful!”

那样子有点滑稽，大家都笑了。
There was something comical in his manner, and everyone laughed.

说笑过了，古应春问道∶『你要替我找个怎么样的朋友？』
When the laughter subsided, Gu asked, “What sort of friend will you find for us?”

『还不一定，
“That depends.

看哪个朋友对你们有用，我就去找哪个。』
I shall find whichever of my friends can be useful to you.”

此言一出，不但雷桂卿，连古应春亦不免惊奇，
This surprised even Gu, to say nothing of Lei.

看来悟心交游广阔，而且神通广大，
Wuxin seemed to know people everywhere and possess extraordinary influence.

但这份关系是如何来的呢？
Where had all these connections come from?

雷桂卿心里也存着同样的疑问，只是不便出口；
Lei wondered the same thing but could hardly ask.

悟心却很大方，
Wuxin was frank enough.

从他们脸上，看到他们心里，笑笑说道∶『你们一定在奇怪，我又不是湖州人，何以会认识各式各样的人？
Reading their thoughts in their faces, she smiled. “You must be wondering how someone who does not come from Huzhou knows so many different people here.

说穿了，不足为奇，
There is nothing remarkable about it.

我认识好些太太，都跟我很谈得来，
I know a good many wives, and we get on very well.

连带也就认识她们的老爷了。』
Through them, I have come to know their husbands.”

『喔，我倒想起来了。古应春问∶』昨天你就是到黄太太那里去了？
“Oh, that reminds me,” Gu said. “Yesterday you went to Madam Huang’s, did you not?”

『『是啊。』
“Yes.

悟心答说∶『这黄老爷或许就能帮你的忙。
Her husband may be able to help you.

这黄老爷是——』这黄老爷单然一个毅字，
Mr Huang is—” His given name was Yi.

是个候补知县，派了在湖州收竹木税的差使。
An expectant magistrate, he had been assigned to collect taxes on bamboo and timber in Huzhou.

同治初年曾国藩派遣幼童赴美时，他是随行照料的庶务，
When Zeng Guofan sent boys to study in America early in the Tongzhi reign, Huang had accompanied them as the officer responsible for their practical arrangements.

在美国住过半年，亦算深通洋务，
He had spent six months in America and was considered well versed in foreign affairs.

所以湖州府遇到有跟洋人打交道的事，不管知府还是知县都要找他；
Whenever dealings with foreigners arose in Huzhou, both the prefect and the county magistrate would turn to him.

在湖州城里亦算是响当当的一个人物。
He was a figure of considerable consequence in the city.



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第二章（本章第3部分，共6部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


『那太好了。』古应春很高兴地说∶『既然替湖州府帮忙办洋务，教会里的情形一定熟悉，
“Excellent!” Gu Yingchun said with pleasure. “If he helps the prefecture with foreign affairs, he must know the church’s circumstances well.

赵宝禄不能不买他的帐。
Zhao Baolu will have to take him seriously.

悟心，你这个忙帮得大了。』
Wuxin, you have done us a great service.”

到了湖州城里，问清楚赵宝禄的教堂在何处，就在附近挑个清静之处泊舟。
On reaching Huzhou, they asked where Zhao’s church was and chose a quiet mooring nearby.

古应春与雷桂卿带着一个跟班上岸；悟心在船上等，
Gu and Lei Guiqing went ashore with an attendant, while Wuxin waited aboard.

她带来一个食盒，现成的素菜，在船上热一下便可食用，
She had brought a food box containing vegetarian dishes that needed only heating.

正整治好了尚未动箸，不道古应春一行已经回船了。
Everything was ready, but she had not yet lifted her chopsticks when the men returned.

『怎么这么快？』
“Back so soon?”

『事情很顺利。
“Things went smoothly.

不过太顺利了。』
Too smoothly.”

『这是怎么说？』悟心又说∶『我总当你们办完事下馆子，我管我自己吃饭了，
“What do you mean?” Wuxin added, “I assumed you would eat at a restaurant after finishing your business, so I was going to eat by myself.

现在看样子，你们也还没有吃，
It seems you have not eaten either.

要不要先将就将就？』
Will you make do with this?”

『我们也还有点船菜，
“We have some food aboard too.

不必再上岸了。
There is no need to go ashore again.

我要把经过情形告诉你，看有什么法子，不让赵宝禄耍花样。』
I must tell you what happened and see whether you can think of a way to prevent Zhao Baolu from playing tricks.”

原来古应春到得教堂，见到赵宝禄，道明来意，
At the church, Gu had found Zhao and explained his purpose.

原以为他必有一番支吾，哪知他绝口否认有任何耍赖的企图。
He had expected evasions, but Zhao flatly denied any intention of defaulting.

『做人要讲信用，对洋人尤其重要，
“A man must keep his word, especially when dealing with foreigners.

我吃了多年的教，当然很明白这层道理。
I have lived within the church for many years and naturally understand that.

两位请放心，
Rest assured, gentlemen.

我收了怡和洋行的定洋，丝也定好了，
I received Jardine Matheson’s deposits, and the silk has been contracted for.

到时候大家照约行家，
When the time comes, everyone will fulfill his agreement.

决无差错。』
Nothing will go wrong.”

『可是，』古应春探询似地说∶『听说赵先生跟教友之间，有些瓜葛？』
“But,” Gu asked tentatively, “I hear there is some difficulty between you and your fellow Christians?”


『什么瓜葛？』
“What difficulty?”

赵宝禄不待古应春回答，自己又说∶『无非说我逼教友捐献。
Without waiting for an answer, Zhao went on, “Merely the claim that I force believers to make donations.

那要自愿，
Donations must be voluntary.

他不肯我不好抢他的；
If someone refuses, I cannot rob him.

总而言之，到时候如果出了差错，两位再来问我，
In short, if anything goes wrong when the time comes, come and question me then.

现在时候还早。』
It is too early now.”

明知道他是敷衍，也明知他将来会耍赖，
Gu knew he was being put off and was equally certain that Zhao would evade his obligations later.

但却什么劲都用不上，
Yet there was nothing he could bring to bear on him.

真叫无可奈何。
It was maddeningly helpless.

古应春从未遇到过这样的对手，所以神色之间，颇为沮丧。
Never having encountered such an opponent, Gu looked thoroughly discouraged.

『你不要烦恼！』悟心劝慰着说∶『一定有办法，
“Do not worry,” Wuxin comforted him. “There is bound to be a way.

你先吃完了饭再说。』
Finish your meal first.”

古应春胃口不开，但经不住悟心殷殷相劝，
Gu had no appetite, but could not resist her repeated urging.

便拿茶泡了饭，就着悟心带来的麻辣油焖笋，匆匆吞了一碗；
He poured tea over his rice and hurriedly swallowed a bowl with the spicy oil-braised bamboo shoots she had brought.

雷桂卿吃得也不多，
Lei ate little too.

两个都搁下筷子，看悟心捏着三镶乌木筷，慢慢在饭中拣稗子，
Both laid down their chopsticks and watched Wuxin slowly pick barnyard-grass grains from her rice with ebony chopsticks bearing three inlays.

拣好半天才吃一口。
Only after a long search would she take a mouthful.


『这米不好，是船老大在这里买的。』古应春歉意地说∶『早知道，自己带米来了』。
“The rice is poor,” Gu said apologetically. “The boatman bought it here. Had I known, I should have brought some.”

悟心也省悟了，
Wuxin realized that she was keeping them waiting.

『对不起，对不起。』
“Forgive me.

她说∶『我吃得慢，
I eat slowly.

两位不必陪我，
Please do not feel obliged to sit with me.

请宽坐用茶。』
Make yourselves comfortable and have some tea.”

雷桂卿却舍不得走，
Lei was reluctant to leave.

尤其是悟心垂着眼皮注视碗中时，是个恣意贪看的好机会，
With her eyes lowered over her bowl, he could gaze at her to his heart’s content.

所以接口说道∶『不要紧，不要紧，
“Not at all, not at all,” he said.

你尽管慢用。』
“Take your time.”

悟心嫣然一笑，对她的饭不再多挑剔，
Wuxin gave a lovely smile and ceased to be so particular about the rice.

吃得就快了。
Her meal went more quickly.


等小玉来收拾了桌子，水也开了。
By the time Xiaoyu had cleared the table, the water was boiling.

沏上一壶茶来，扑鼻一股杏子香，雷桂卿少不得又要动问了。
The tea she brewed gave off a fragrance of apricots, prompting another question from Lei.

『那没有什么诀窍。』悟心答说∶『挑没有熟的杏子，摘下来拿皮纸包好，放在茶叶罐里，
“There is no great secret,” Wuxin answered. “Pick unripe apricots, wrap them in bark paper, and put them in the tea canister.

隔两天便有香味了。
After two days the tea will be fragrant.

不但杏子，别的果子，也可以如法炮制。』
Other fruit can be used in the same way.”

『悟心师太，』雷桂卿笑道∶『你真会享清福。』
“Mistress Wuxin,” Lei said, laughing, “you certainly know how to enjoy a peaceful life.”

悟心笑笑不作声，转脸问古应春∶『你的心事想得怎么样了？』
She smiled without answering, then turned to Gu. “Have you made any progress with what is troubling you?”

古应春确是在想心事，
He had indeed been thinking.

他带着藩司衙门的公文，可以去看湖州知府，请求协助；
With the provincial treasurer’s dispatch, he could call on the Huzhou prefect and ask for assistance.

但如传了赵宝禄到案，他仍旧是这套说法，那就不但于事无补，
But if Zhao were summoned and repeated the same arguments, nothing would be gained.

而且还落一个仗势欺人的名声，
Worse, Gu would acquire a reputation for using official influence to bully others.

太划不来了。
It would scarcely be worth it.


等他说了心事，悟心把脸又转了过去∶『雷先生，要托你办件事。』
When he had explained, Wuxin turned back to Lei. “Mr Lei, I must ask you to do something.”

『是、是。』雷桂卿一叠连声地答应，
“Yes, yes,” he answered eagerly.

『你说，你说。』
“Tell me.”

『我写个地址，
“I shall give you an address.

请你去找一位杨师爷；
Go and find a certain Secretary Yang.

见了面，说我请他来一趟，有事求他。』悟心又加一句∶『他是乌程县的刑名师爷。』
Tell him I should like him to come here; there is something I must ask of him.” She added, “He advises the Wucheng magistrate on criminal and legal affairs.”

做州县官，至少要请两个幕友，一个管刑名、一个管钱谷，
A prefect or magistrate needed at least two private secretaries: one for criminal and legal matters, the other for revenue and grain.

权柄极大。
Their influence was considerable.

请乌程县的刑名师爷来料理此案，不怕赵宝禄不就范。
With Wucheng’s legal secretary brought in to manage the affair, Zhao could surely be made to comply.

雷桂卿很高兴地说∶『悟心师太，你真有办法！
Lei was delighted. “Mistress Wuxin, you truly know how to get things done!

把这位杨师爷请了来对付赵宝禄，比什么都管用。』
Bringing Secretary Yang to deal with Zhao will be more effective than anything.”

『也不见得，
“Not necessarily.

等请来了再商量。』
Let us discuss it once he is here.”

于是悟心口述地址，请古应春写了下来，
She dictated the address and had Gu write it down.

船老大上岸雇来一顶轿子，将欣欣然的雷桂卿抬走了。
The boatman hired a sedan ashore, and Lei was carried off in high spirits.


『你要不要去睡个午觉？』悟心说道∶『雷先生要好半天才会回来。』
“Would you like an afternoon nap?” Wuxin asked. “Mr Lei will not be back for some time.”

『怎么？
“Why?

那杨师爷住得很远，是不是？』
Does Secretary Yang live far away?”

『不但住得远，
“Not only far away.

而且要去两个地方。』
He will have to go to two places.”

『为什么？』
“Why?”

悟心诡秘地一笑说道∶『这位雷先生，心思有点歪，
Wuxin gave a mysterious smile. “This Mr Lei’s thoughts stray a little.

我要他吃点小苦头。』
I mean to make him suffer a small penalty.”

『什么苦头？』
“What penalty?”

古应春有点不安，
Gu was uneasy.

『是我的朋友，
“He is my friend.

弄得他惨兮兮，他会骂我。』
If you make him miserable, he will blame me.”

『他根本不会晓得，是我故意罚他。』
“He will never know I am punishing him deliberately.”

原来这杨师爷住在县衙门，但另外租了一处房子，作为私下接头讼事之用，
Secretary Yang lived at the county yamen, but had rented another house for private consultations about lawsuits.

为了避人耳目，房子租在很荒僻的地方，
To avoid attention, he had chosen a very secluded place.

又因为荒僻之故，养了一条很凶的狗。
Its isolation in turn made it necessary to keep a fierce dog.

雷桂卿找上门去，一定会扑空，而且会受惊。
Lei would certainly fail to find him there and would get a fright into the bargain.


『怎么会扑空呢？
“Why will he fail to find him?”

悟心解释∶』除非杨师爷自己关照，约在哪里见面，不然他就是在那里，下人也会说不在，有事到衙门去接头。
“Unless Secretary Yang himself has arranged where to meet,” Wuxin explained, “even if he is there, the servants will say he is out and direct callers to the yamen.”

『』怎么会倒在其次，
“Missing him is a lesser matter.

让狗咬了怎么办？
What if the dog bites Lei?”

『『不会！
“It will not.

那条狗是教好了的，
The dog is trained.

来势汹汹把人吓走了就好了，从不咬人。』
It rushes at people fiercely and frightens them away, but never bites.”

听这一说，古应春才放下心来；
Only then was Gu reassured.

他知道悟心有午睡的习惯，便即说道∶『我倒不困，
Knowing that Wuxin habitually slept after lunch, he said, “I am not sleepy.

你去打个中觉。』
You should take your nap.”

『好！』
“Very well.

悟心问说∶『哪张是你的铺？』
Which berth is yours?”

『跟我来。』
“Come with me.”


后舱一张大铺，中间用红木隔成两个铺位，
A broad sleeping platform in the aft cabin was divided into two berths by a rosewood partition.

上铺洋式床垫，软硬适度，
Western mattresses, neither too soft nor too hard, covered it.

悟心用手揿一揿床垫，又看一看周围的陈设，
Wuxin pressed one with her hand and surveyed the furnishings.

不由得赞叹∶『财神家的东西，到底不同。』
“Things belonging to the God of Wealth’s household really are different!” she exclaimed.

『这面是我的铺。』
“Mine is this side.”

古应春指着左面说∶『你睡吧，
Gu pointed to the left. “Lie down.

我在外面。
I shall be outside.

有事拉这根绳子。』
Pull this cord if you need anything.”

悟羽将一根红弦绳一拉，前舱的银铃琅琅作响；
Wuxin tugged a red cord, and a silver bell rang in the forward cabin.

小玉恰好进前舱，闻声寻来，一看亦有惊异之色。
Xiaoyu, who had just entered it, followed the sound and looked equally impressed.

『真讲究！』
“How beautifully arranged!”

小玉抚摸着红木～＊子说∶『是可以移动的。』
She ran a hand over the rosewood partition. “It can be moved.”

『索性把它推了过去。』古应春说∶『一人个睡也宽敞些。』
“Push it aside altogether,” Gu said. “There will be more room for one person to sleep.”

小玉便依言将红木～＊子推到一边。古应春也退了出去，在中舱喝茶闲眺，
Xiaoyu did so, and Gu withdrew to the middle cabin to drink tea and look out at the scenery.

心里在盘算，
He considered their plans.

杨师爷来了，如果谈得顺利，还来得及回庵；
If the discussion with Secretary Yang went well, there would still be time to return to the retreat.

倘或需要从长计议，是回庵去谈呢？还是一直谈下去，夜深了上岸觅客栈投宿，让悟心师徒住在船上。
If more thought was needed, should they go back there to continue it, or talk on aboard, however late it grew? They could then find an inn ashore and leave the boat to Wuxin and Xiaoyu.

转念未定，听得帘挂钩响动，
Before he decided, he heard the curtain rings move.

是小玉出来了，
Xiaoyu emerged.

『古老爷，』她说，『你请进去吧，
“Mr Gu, please come in.

我师父有事情商量。』
Teacher wishes to discuss something.”

到得后舱，只见悟心在他的铺位上和衣侧卧，身上半盖着一条绣花丝被，
In the aft cabin, Wuxin lay on her side in his berth, fully clothed, with an embroidered silk quilt half covering her.

长发纷披，遮盖了大半个枕头；
Her long hair spread over most of the pillow.

一手支颐，袖子褪落到肘弯，奇南香手串的香味，俞发馥郁了。
One hand supported her chin; the sleeve had slipped down to her elbow, and the fragrance of her agarwood prayer beads seemed richer than ever.

『你有事？』
“What is it?”

古应春在这一面铺前的一张红木骨牌凳上坐了下来。
Gu sat on a rosewood stool beside the other berth.


『杨师爷很晚才回来。』悟心说道∶『恐怕要留他吃饭，
“Secretary Yang will not be back until quite late,” Wuxin said. “We may have to ask him to dinner.

似乎要预备预备。』
Perhaps something should be prepared.”

『菜倒是有。』
“There is food.

古应春说，『船家一早就上岸去买了菜，
The boatman went ashore to buy it early this morning.

只以为中午是在城里吃了，你又带了素菜来，所以没有弄出来。
We thought we should lunch in the city, and you brought vegetarian dishes as well, so it was not served.

你闻！』
Smell that!”

悟心闻到了，是火腿炖鸡的香味，
She caught the aroma of chicken stewing with ham.

『你引我动凡心了。』她笑着又说∶『酒呢？』
“You are tempting me back to worldly desires,” she said with a laugh. “And wine?”

『那更是现成，
“Ready too.

一坛花雕是上船以后才开的。
We opened a jar of huadiao after coming aboard.

我还有白葡萄酒，你也可以喝。』
I have white wine as well, which you can drink.

古应春又说∶『倒是有件事得早早预备，今晚上你跟小玉睡在船上，我跟雷桂卿住客栈，
There is one thing we ought to arrange early: you and Xiaoyu can sleep aboard tonight while Lei and I stay at an inn.

得早一点去定妥当了它。』
I had better reserve the rooms.”

『不！』
“No.

悟心说道∶『睡在船上不妥当了，
It would not be proper for me to sleep here.

我还是回庵；不过船家多吃一趟辛苦。』
I shall return to the retreat, even if it means another journey for the boatmen.”

『那没有什么。
“That is no trouble.

好了，说妥当了，
Then it is settled.

你睡吧！』
Sleep now.”


『我还不困，
“I am not sleepy yet.

陪我谈谈。』
Stay and talk.”

说着，悟心拍拍空铺位，示意他睡下来。
Wuxin patted the empty berth, inviting him to lie down.

古应春有些踌躇，但终于决定考验自己的定力，
Gu hesitated, then decided to test his self-command.

在雷桂卿的铺位横倒，脸对脸不到一尺的距离。
He stretched out in Lei’s berth, their faces less than a chi apart.

『古太太的病怎么样？
“How is Mrs Gu?

好点了没有？』
Is she any better?”

『还是那样子。
“Much the same.

总归是带病延年了。』
She can only nurse her illness and hope to live on.”

『那末，你呢？』悟心幽幽地说∶『没有一个人在身边，也不方便。』
“And you?” Wuxin asked softly. “It must be inconvenient, with no one beside you.”

古应春想把瑞香的事告诉她，
Gu thought of telling her about Ruixiang.

转念一想，这一来悟心一定寻根究底，追问不休，
But she would be sure to pursue every detail and question him endlessly.

不如不提为妙。
Better not mention it.


『也没有什么不便。
“It is no great inconvenience.

多一事不如少一事。』
One less complication is better than one more.”

『什么事都好省，这件事省不得，除非——』悟心忽然笑了起来。
“You may dispense with anything else, but not this—unless—” Wuxin suddenly laughed.

这一笑实在诡秘，古应春忍不住问∶『话说半句，无缘无故发笑，
There was something so mysterious in the laugh that Gu could not help asking, “You leave your sentence unfinished and laugh for no reason.

是什么花样？
What game is this?

除非什么？』
Unless what?”

『除非你也看破红尘，出家当了和尚，
“Unless you too renounce the world and become a monk.

那件事才可以省，
Only then can you dispense with that need.

不然是省不了的。』
Otherwise you cannot.”

『这话也没有啥好笑啊！』
“There is nothing so funny about that.”

『我笑是笑我自己。』
“I am laughing at myself.”


『在谈我，
“We are discussing me.

何以忽然笑你自己。』
Why suddenly laugh at yourself?”

古应春口滑，想不说的话。还是说了∶『总与我有关吧？』
Gu’s tongue slipped into the very question he had meant not to ask. “It must have something to do with me.”

『不错，与你有关。
“It does.

我在想，你如果出家做了和尚，不晓得是怎么个样子？
I was imagining what you would look like as a monk.

想想就好笑了。』
The thought made me laugh.”

『我要出家，也做头陀，同你一样。』
“If I renounced the world, I would become a toutuo—like you.”

『啥叫头陀？』
“What is a toutuo?”

『亏你还算出家，
“And you call yourself a religious person!

连头陀都不懂。』
You do not even know what a toutuo is.

古应春答说∶『出家而没有剃发，带发修行的叫做头陀；
Someone who renounces the world without shaving his head and practices with his hair intact is called a toutuo.

岂不是跟你一样。』
Is that not just like you?”

『喔，我懂了，
“Oh, I see.

就是满头乱七八糟的头发，弄个铜环，把它箍住，象武松的那种打扮？』
A head of unruly hair held in place with a copper band, dressed like Wu Song?”

『就是。』
“Exactly.”

『那叫「行者」！不叫头陀，
“That is called a xingzhe, not a toutuo!

我那里有本《释氏要贤》说得清清楚楚。』
My copy of Shishi Yaoxian makes it perfectly clear.”

原来她是懂的，有意相谑，
So she had known all along and was deliberately teasing him.

这正是悟心的本性；
It was typical of Wuxin.

古应春苦笑着叹了口气，无话可说。
Gu gave a rueful smile and sighed, with nothing to say.


『应春，我们真希望你是出家的行者。』
“Yingchun, I really wish you were a xingzhe who had renounced the world.”

『为什么？』
“Why?”

『那一来，你不是一个人了吗？』
“Then you would be alone, would you not?”

古应春心一跳，故意问说∶『一个人又怎么样了呢？』
Gu’s heart gave a leap, but he deliberately asked, “And what if I were?”

『你不懂？』
“Do you not understand?”

『我真不懂。』
“I truly do not.”

『不跟你说了。』
“Then I shall say no more.”

悟心突然一翻身，背对古应春。
Wuxin suddenly turned her back on him.

古应春心想，这就是考验自己定力的时候了，
This, Gu thought, was the moment to test his resolve.

心猿意马地几次想伸手去扳她的身子，却始终迟疑不定。
His thoughts raced. Several times he wanted to reach out and turn her toward him, but hesitation held him back.

终于忍不住要伸手了，
At last he could resist no longer.

而且手已快碰到悟心的身子了，突然听得扑通一声，是重物落水的声音，古应春一惊缩手，
His hand was almost touching her when a sudden splash—the sound of something heavy falling into water—made him start and draw back.

随即听见有人大喊∶『有人掉到河里去了！』
Someone shouted, “A person has fallen into the river!”


悟心也吓得坐了起来，推着古应春说∶『你去看看。』
Wuxin sat up in alarm and pushed him. “Go and see.”

等他出去一看，失足落水的一个半大孩子，已经被救了起来。
By the time he went out, the half-grown boy who had lost his footing was already rescued.

是一场虚惊。
It had been no more than a fright.

回到后舱，略说经过，
Gu returned to the aft cabin and briefly explained.

只见悟心眼神湛然，脸色恬静，
Wuxin’s eyes were clear, her expression tranquil.

从容说道∶『刚才「扑通」那一声，好比当头棒喝。』
“That splash just now was like a blow and a shout awakening a deluded mind,” she said calmly.

绮念全消的古应春，亦有这样的感觉，
Gu, whose amorous thoughts had vanished, felt the same.

不过当悟心『面壁』而卧时，居然亦跟他一样意马心猿，却使他感到意外。
What surprised him was that even while lying with her back to him, she too had been as agitated by desire as he.

『我在想一个人能不做坏事，也要看看运气。』
“I was thinking that whether a person avoids doing wrong depends partly on luck.”

悟心一翻身拉开丝绒窗帘，指着透过纱窗，影绰绰看得到的一座贞节牌坊说∶『我不相信守寡守了几十年的人，真正是自始至终，冰清玉洁，没有动过不正经的念头，
Wuxin turned and pulled back the velvet curtain, pointing to a chastity arch dimly visible through the gauze. “I do not believe a woman who has remained a widow for decades has truly been pure as ice and jade from beginning to end, never once entertaining an improper thought.

不过没有机会，或者临时有什么意外，打断了「好事」而已。
She may simply have had no opportunity, or some accident at the last moment may have interrupted her ‘happy encounter.’

如果因为这样子，自己就以为怎样了不起，依我说，是问心有愧的。』
If she then thinks herself wonderfully virtuous on that account, I say she has something to answer for in her own conscience.”

这番话说得古应春自惭不如，
Gu felt that he fell short of her candor.

笑笑说道∶『你睡吧！
Smiling, he said, “Sleep now.

我不陪你「参禅」了。』
I shall not stay to meditate with you.”

雷桂卿直到黄错日落，方始回船，样子显得有些狼狈，一双靴子溅了许多烂泥。
Lei returned only at sunset, looking somewhat disheveled, his boots splashed with mud.

古应春心知其故，也有些好笑，但不敢现于形色，
Gu knew why and was amused, but dared not show it.

只是慰劳地说∶『辛苦，辛苦。』
“You have had a tiring errand.”

『还好，还好！』
“Not so bad.”

雷桂卿举起脚说∶『路好难走，
Lei lifted a foot. “What a dreadful road!

下了轿，过一顶独木桥，又是一段烂泥路，
After leaving the sedan I crossed a single-plank bridge, then trudged through mud.

好不容易找到那里，说杨师爷在县衙门。』
When I finally found the place, they said Secretary Yang was at the county yamen.”

『那么，你又到县衙门？』
“So you went there as well?”


『当然。』
“Of course.

雷桂卿说，『还好，这一回没有扑空。
Fortunately, I did not miss him this time.

人倒很客气，问我悟心是不是有什么事找他？
He was very courteous and asked whether Mistress Wuxin wanted him for something.

我说∶请你来了就知道了。
I told him he would find out when he came.

他说还有件公事，料理完了就来。
He said he had an official matter to finish first.

大概也快到了。』
He should be here soon.”

正在谈着，悟心翩然出现，脸上刚睡醒的红晕犹在，星眼微饧，别具一种媚态。
As they talked, Wuxin appeared, her face still flushed from sleep, her eyes slightly drowsy, with a charm all their own.

雷桂卿一看，神情又不同了。
At the sight, Lei’s expression changed again.

『交差，交差。他很起劲地，但却有些埋怨地∶』悟心师太，你应该早告诉我，杨家有条大狗——
“I have carried out my commission!” he said eagerly, though with a trace of complaint. “Mistress Wuxin, you ought to have told me there was a great dog at the Yang house.”

『』怎么？
“What?”

『悟心装得吃惊是，』
She feigned alarm.

你让狗咬了？
“Did it bite you?”

『』咬倒没有咬，不过性命吓掉半条。
“No, but it frightened half the life out of me.”

『雷桂卿面有余悸，指手划脚地说∶『我正在叫门，忽然发现后面好象有两只手搭在我肩膀上，
Still shaken by the memory, Lei gestured as he told them. “I was calling at the door when I suddenly felt what seemed like two hands on my shoulders from behind.

回头一看，乖乖，好大一条狗，
I turned—and heavens, what a dog!

拖长了舌头，朝我喘气。
Its tongue was hanging out, and it was panting in my face.

这一吓，真正魂灵要出窍了。』
My soul nearly left my body.”

『唷，唷，对不起，对不起！』
“Oh, I am so sorry!”

悟心满脸歉意，
Wuxin looked thoroughly apologetic.

『我是晓得他家有条狗，不晓得这么厉害。
“I knew they had a dog but not that it was so fierce.

后来呢？』
What happened then?”

『后来赶出来一个人，不住口跟我道歉，问我吓到了没有？
“A man came running out, apologizing over and over and asking whether I had been frightened.

我只好装「大好佬」，
I had to put on a brave face.

我说∶没有什么，
I said, ‘Not at all.

我从前养过一条狗，比你们的狗还大。』
I once kept a dog even bigger than yours.’”

『好！』古应春大笑，
Gu burst out laughing. “Good!

『这牛吹得好。』悟心也笑得伏在桌上，抬不起头来；
That was a fine boast!” Wuxin laughed too, until she bent over the table and could not lift her head.

雷桂卿颇为得意，
Lei was rather pleased.

觉得受一场虚惊，能替他们带来一场欢乐，也还值得。
A fright was worth enduring if it brought them such merriment.

『你看！』他指着远远而来的一顶轿子，
“Look,” he said, pointing to a sedan approaching in the distance.

『大概杨师爷来了。』
“That must be Secretary Yang.”


果然，轿子停了下来，
Sure enough, the sedan stopped.

一个跟班正在打听时，雷桂卿出舱走到船头上去答话。
While an attendant made inquiries, Lei came out of the cabin and went forward to answer.

『是不是杨师爷？』
“Is that Secretary Yang?”

于是杨师爷下轿，古应春亦到船头上去迎接，
Yang alighted, and Gu also went to the bow to welcome him.

进入舱内，由悟心正式引见。
Once they were inside, Wuxin made the formal introductions.

那师爷是绍兴人，年纪不大，只有三十四、五岁，
The secretary came from Shaoxing and was only thirty-four or thirty-five.

不过绍兴师爷一向古貌古心，显得很老成的样子，所以骤看竟似半百老翁了。
But Shaoxing legal advisers cultivated an old-fashioned appearance and manner that made them seem exceptionally mature; at first glance he looked almost fifty.

彼此请教名字，
They exchanged names.

那杨师爷号叫莲坡，古应春便以『莲翁』相称，
Yang’s literary name was Lianpo, so Gu addressed him as “Mr Lian.”

寒暄了一会，悟心说道∶『你们喝酒吧！
After a little polite conversation, Wuxin said, “Have some wine.

一面喝，一面谈。』
You can talk as you drink.”

于是摆设杯盘，请杨莲坡上坐；
Cups and dishes were set out, and Yang Lianpo was invited to take the place of honor.

悟心不上桌，坐在一旁相陪。
Wuxin did not join the table but sat to one side to keep them company.


话题当然也要她开头，
Naturally, she had to open the subject.

『老杨！』她说，『雷老爷我是初识；应春是多年的熟人，
“Yang, I have only just met Mr Lei, but I have known Yingchun for years.

他有事请你帮忙。
He needs your help.

他的事就是我的事。』
His business is my business.”

『我晓得。』杨莲坡答说∶『四海之内皆兄弟，
“I understand,” Yang replied. “All within the four seas are brothers.

你就不说，我也要尽心尽力，交个朋友。』
Even without your asking, I would do my best and make a friend.”

『多谢、多谢！』
“Thank you, thank you!”

古应春敬了一杯酒，细谈此行的来意，以及跟赵宝禄见面的经过。
Gu offered him a cup of wine, then described the purpose of his journey and his meeting with Zhao Baolu.

杨莲坡喝着酒，静静听完全，开口问道∶『应翁现在打算怎么办？』
Yang drank and listened quietly to the whole account before asking, “Mr Yingchun, what do you propose to do now?”

『这要问你啊！』悟心在一旁插嘴，
“That is what we are asking you,” Wuxin put in.

『人家无非要有个着落。』
“He simply wants a dependable outcome.”

『所谓着落有两种，一是将来要他依约行事，一是现在就有个了断。
“There are two kinds of outcome: having Zhao fulfill the agreement later, or settling the matter now.

不知道应翁要哪一样？』
Which does Mr Yingchun want?”


『这个人很难弄，将来一定会有麻烦，
“He is a difficult man, and trouble is certain to arise later.

不如现在就来个了断。』古应春说，
Better to settle things now,” Gu said.

『此刻要他退钱，不知道办得到，办不到？』
“Could he be made to return the money at once?”

『不怕讨债的凶，只怕欠债的穷。
“A fierce creditor is less to be feared than an impoverished debtor.

如果他钱已经用掉了，想退也没法子。』
If he has spent the money, he cannot return it even if he wishes.”

这是实话，
This was true.

不过古应春亦并不是要赵宝禄即时退钱不可，
Gu, however, did not insist that Zhao repay immediately.

怡和洋行那方面，只要将与赵宝禄所订的契约转过来，胡雪岩已承诺先如数退款，
As far as Jardine Matheson was concerned, Hu had already promised to refund the full sum in advance once its contract with Zhao was transferred to him.

但将来要有保障，赵宝禄有丝交丝，无丝退还定洋。
But there had to be security for the future: Zhao must deliver silk if he had it, or return the deposit if he did not.

只是要如何才有保障，他就不知道了。
How to secure that guarantee, Gu did not know.

『最麻烦的是，他手里有好些做丝人家写给他的收据，
“The greatest difficulty is that he holds receipts from a number of silk-producing families.

一个说付过钱了，一个说没有收到，
He says he has paid; they say they received nothing.

打起官司来，似乎对赵宝禄有利。』
If it comes to a lawsuit, the position seems to favor him.”

『不然。』杨师爷说∶『打官司一个对一个，当然重在证据，
“Not necessarily,” Yang replied. “In a case between two individuals, the evidence naturally carries great weight.

就是上了当，也只好怪自己不好。
Even if one party has been cheated, he may have only himself to blame.

如果赵宝禄成了众矢之的，众口一词说他骗人，那时候情形就不同了。
But if Zhao becomes the target of everyone’s complaints, and they all say with one voice that he deceived them, the situation changes.

不过上当的人，官司要早打，
The victims must bring their case early, however.

现在就要递状子进来。』
Their petitions should be filed now.”

『你也是。』
“You too!”

悟心插嘴说道∶『这是啥辰光，
Wuxin broke in. “What season do you think this is?

家家户户都在服侍蚕宝宝！
Every household is tending its silkworm babies.

哪里来的工夫打官司？』
Where are they to find time for a lawsuit?”



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第二章（本章第4部分，共6部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


杨师爷沉吟了一回说道∶『办法是有，不过要按部就班，一步一步都要走到。
Secretary Yang considered for a while. “There is a way, but we must proceed in order and omit none of the steps.

赵宝禄有没有「牙帖」？』
Does Zhao Baolu have a broker’s license?”

交易的介绍人，古称『驵侩』，
Intermediaries in trade had anciently been called zangkui.

后汉与四夷通商，在边境设立『互市』；
When the Later Han traded with the peoples beyond its frontiers, mutual markets were established along the borders.

到唐朝，『互市』扩大，且由边境延伸到长安，特设『互市监』，掌理其事，
Under the Tang, these expanded and extended as far as Chang’an, with special market supervisors to administer them.

『互市』中有些『互郎』，即是『驵侩』，
Some intermediaries were called hulang.

互市之物，孰贵孰贱，孰重孰轻，只凭他一句话，因而得以操纵其间，
Their word determined which goods were dear or cheap, weighty or insignificant, allowing them to manipulate transactions.

是个很容易发财的行业，不过第一、须通番语；第二、要跟互市监拉得上关系。
It was an easy occupation in which to grow rich, but it required both a command of foreign languages and connections with the market supervisors.

所以胡人当互郎的很多，如安禄山就是。
Many foreigners therefore became hulang; An Lushan was one.

不过胡人写汉字，笔划不真切，互字不知如何写成『牙』字，
Their Chinese handwriting, however, was imprecise, and somehow the character hu came to be written as the similar-looking ya.

以论传论，称为『牙郎』；后世简称为『牙』，
The error spread, and the intermediaries became known as yalang, later shortened to ya.

一个字叫起来不便，就加一个字，名之为『牙行』。
Since a single syllable was awkward to use, another character was added, giving yahang, or brokerage.

『牙行』是没本钱生意，
It was a business that required no capital.

黑道中人手里握一杆秤，在他的地盘上强买强卖，两面抽佣，
A man from the underworld could seize a pair of scales and force people within his territory to buy and sell through him, taking commission from both sides.

甚至于右手买进、左手卖出，大『戴帽子』。
He might even buy with one hand and sell with the other, piling on an enormous markup.

所以有句南北通行的谚语∶『车船店脚牙，无罪也该杀』，
Hence a proverb common to north and south: “Carters, boatmen, inn servants, porters, and brokers deserve death even without a crime.”

车案、船老大、店小二、脚案，无非欺侮过往的陌生旅客；只有牙行欺侮的不是旅客而是本地人。
The first four merely preyed on strangers passing through; brokers preyed on the local people themselves.


当然也有适应需要，为买卖双方促成交易、收取定额佣金的正式牙行，
There were, of course, legitimate brokers who met a real need, bringing buyers and sellers together for a fixed commission.

那要官府立案，取得户部或者本省藩司衙门所发的执照，称为『牙帖』，方能从事这个行当。
They had to register with the authorities and obtain a license from the Ministry of Revenue or the provincial treasurer before entering the trade.

赵宝禄不过凭借教会势力，私下在做牙行，
Zhao, however, merely relied on the church’s influence to act as a broker privately.

古应春推测他是不可能领有牙帖的。
Gu supposed it unlikely that he held a license.

『我想他大概也不会有。』杨师爷说∶『怡和洋行想要有保障，要写个禀帖来。
“I suspect he has none either,” Yang said. “If Jardine Matheson wants security, it must submit a petition.

县衙门把赵宝禄传来，问他有没有这回事？
The county yamen can summon Zhao and ask whether the matter is as stated.

他说「有」；好，叫他象牙帖出来看看。
If he says yes, very well: have him produce his broker’s license.

没有牙帖，先就罚他。』
If he has none, begin by fining him.”

『罚过以后呢？』
“And after the fine?”

『要他具结，将来照约行事。』
“Make him give a written undertaking to fulfill the contract.

杨师爷说∶『这是怡和跟他的事，
That concerns him and Jardine Matheson.

将来要打官司，怡和一定赢。』
If a lawsuit follows, the firm is certain to win.”

『赢是赢了，就是留下刚才所说的，不怕讨债的的凶，只怕欠债的穷，
“It may win, but we still face what you said just now: the difficulty is not a fierce creditor but a poor debtor.

他如果既交不出丝，又还不出定洋，莫非封他的教堂？』
If he can neither deliver silk nor repay the deposit, can we seal up his church?”


『虽不能封他的教堂，可以要他交保。
“We cannot seal up the church, but we can require him to provide surety.

那时如果受骗上当的人，进状子告他，就可以办他个「诈伪取财」的罪名。』杨师爷又说∶『总而言之，办法有的是。
Then, if the people he has deceived file complaints, he can be prosecuted for obtaining money by fraud.” Yang continued, “In short, there are plenty of ways.

不过「凡事豫则立」；
But preparation is the foundation of success.

刑名上有所谓「抢原告」，就是要抢先一步，防患未然。
In legal practice there is what we call ‘seizing the plaintiff’s position’: act first and forestall trouble.

你老兄照我的话去做，先叫怡和洋行写禀帖来，
Follow my advice and have Jardine Matheson write its petition.

这是最要紧的一着。』
That is the essential first move.”

『是，是！
“Yes, yes.

多承指点，以后还要请多帮忙。』
I am grateful for your guidance and shall need your help again.”

正事谈得告一段落，酒也差不多了。
The business discussion had reached a stopping point, and they had drunk enough.

杨师爷知道悟心还要赶回庵去，所以不耽误她的工夫，
Knowing that Wuxin still had to return to the retreat, Yang did not detain her.

吃完饭立即告辞；
He took his leave immediately after dinner.

古应春包了个大红包犒赏他的仆从，看着杨师爷上了轿，吩咐解缆回南浔。
Gu prepared a generous gratuity envelope for his attendants, watched him into his sedan, and ordered the boat to cast off for Nanxun.


归寝已是三更时分，
It was the third watch when they went to bed.

雷桂卿头一着枕，突然猛吸鼻子，发出『嗤，嗤』的响声，
The moment his head touched the pillow, Lei began sniffing noisily.

古应春不由得诧异。
Gu was puzzled.

『怎么？』
“What is it?

他问∶『有什么不对？』
Is something wrong?”

我枕头上有气味。
“There is a smell on my pillow.”

『『气味？』古应春更觉不解，
“A smell?

『什么气味？』
What kind?”

『是香气。』
“A fragrance.

雷桂卿说，『好象悟心头发上的香气。
It seems like the scent of Wuxin’s hair.

你没有闻见？』
Did you not notice it?”

『我的鼻子没有你灵。』
“My nose is not as keen as yours.”

古应春心想，这件事实在奇怪，
Gu thought this very strange.

悟心并没有用他的枕头，
Wuxin had not used Lei’s pillow.

何以会沾染香味？
How could her fragrance have reached it?

这样想着，不免侧脸去看，一看看出蹊跷来了。雷桂卿的枕头上，有一根长长的青丝，可以断定是悟心的头发，
Turning to look, he discovered something curious: a long black hair lay on the pillow, unquestionably hers.

然则她真的用过雷桂卿的枕头？
Had she really used it after all?

『不对！』雷桂卿突然又喊∶『这不是我的枕头，
“No!” Lei suddenly exclaimed. “This is not my pillow.

是你的。』
It is yours.”

他仰起身子说∶『我记得很清楚，
He raised himself. “I remember perfectly.

这对鸳鸯枕，你绣的花样的鸳，我的是鸯，
Of these two mandarin-duck pillows, yours had the male embroidered on it and mine the female.

现在换过了。』
They have been exchanged.”

古应春恍然大悟，点点头说∶『不错，换过了。
Gu understood at once and nodded. “Yes, they have.

你知道不知道，是哪个换的？』
Do you know who exchanged them?”


『莫非是悟心？』
“Could it have been Wuxin?”

『不错，一定是她。
“Certainly.

她有打中觉的习惯；
She always naps after lunch.

原来睡的是我的枕头，现在换到你那里了。』
She originally used my pillow, and now it has been put on your side.”

『这——』雷桂卿惊喜交集地，『这，
“Then—” Lei was astonished and delighted.

这是啥意思？』
“What does it mean?”

说着将脸伏下去，细嗅枕上的香气。
He buried his face in the pillow to inhale its fragrance.

古应春本来不想『杀风景』，见此光景不能不扫他的兴了，
Gu had not intended to spoil his pleasure, but at this sight felt obliged to do so.

『「贾氏窥帘韩掾少，宓妃留枕魏王才」，
“‘Lady Jia peered through the curtain at young Han the clerk; / The Goddess of the Luo left her pillow for the gifted Prince of Wei.’

桂卿，』他说∶『你要想一想，两样资格，你有一样没有？』
Guiqing, consider: do you possess either of those two qualifications?”


『我不懂你的意思。』
“I do not understand.”

古应春的意思是说，除非雷桂卿觉得在年轻英俊，或者博学多才这两个条件占有一个，就难望获得悟心的青睐。
Gu meant that unless Lei could claim either handsome youth or exceptional learning and talent, he could hardly expect to win Wuxin’s favor.

而悟心一向好恶作剧，
She had always enjoyed practical jokes.

他去请杨师爷所吃的苦头，就是悟心对他的轻佻所予的惩罚。
The ordeal he had endured in fetching Yang was her punishment for his frivolous behavior.

如今将留有香泽的枕头换给他，是一个陷阱，也是一种考验；
Giving him the pillow scented by her hair was another trap, another test.

雷桂卿倘或再动绮念，后面就还有苦头吃。
If he again indulged amorous thoughts, more suffering lay ahead.

雷桂卿倒抽一口冷气，
Lei drew a sharp breath.

对悟心的感觉当然受过了；不过那只是片刻之间的事，
His feelings toward Wuxin changed, but only briefly.

古应春所说的话，到底不及他脑中『美目盼兮，巧笑倩兮』的印象来得深刻，
Gu’s words could not efface the image of her lovely eyes and enchanting smile.

所以仍为枕上那种非兰非麝、似有似无的香味，搅得大半夜六神不安。
The faint, elusive scent on the pillow, neither orchid nor musk, kept him restless for much of the night.


第二天醒来，已是阳光耀眼，
When he awoke, sunlight dazzled his eyes.

看表上是九点钟，比平时起身，起码晚了两个钟头；
His watch showed nine, at least two hours later than he ordinarily rose.

出舱一看，古应春静静地在看书喝茶。
Coming out of the sleeping cabin, he found Gu quietly reading and drinking tea.

『昨晚上失眠了？』他问。
“Could you not sleep last night?” Gu asked.

雷桂卿不好意思地笑一笑，顾而言他地问∶『我们怎么办？』
Lei smiled awkwardly and changed the subject. “What are we to do?”

『你先洗脸。』
“Wash first.

古应春说∶『悟心一早派人来请我们去吃点心，
Wuxin sent an invitation early this morning for us to take refreshments with her.

我在等你。』
I have been waiting for you.”

雷桂卿有点迟疑，
Lei hesitated.

很想不去，但似乎显得心存芥蒂，气量太小；
He wanted to refuse, yet that might make him seem resentful and small-minded.

如果去了，又怕自己沉不住气，脸上现出悻悻之色，
If he went, however, he feared he might lose his composure and reveal his annoyance.

因而不置可否，慢慢地漱洗完了，
Giving no definite answer, he washed slowly.

只见小玉又来催请了。那就容不得他再多作考虑，
Then Xiaoyu arrived to urge them to come, leaving no more room for hesitation.

相将上岸，到了莲池精舍，仍旧在悟心禅房中的东间坐落，
They went ashore together and returned to the eastern reception room in Wuxin’s quarters.

那只小哈叭狗只往雷桂卿身上扑，
The little lapdog kept jumping at Lei.

他把它抱了起来，居然不吠不动，乖乖地躺在他怀里。
He picked it up, and it lay quietly in his arms without barking or struggling.

『它倒跟你投缘。』
“It has taken to you.”

雷桂卿抬头一看，悟心含笑站在门口；
Lei looked up to see Wuxin smiling in the doorway.

哈叭狗看见主人，从雷桂卿身上跳了下来。转入悟心怀中，用舌头去舐主人的脸。
At the sight of its mistress, the dog sprang from him into her arms and licked her face.


『不要闹！』
“Do not make a fuss!”

悟心将狗放了下来，
She put it down.

『到外面去玩。』
“Go and play outside.”

狗通人性，响着颈下的小金铃，摇摇摆摆地往外走去，
The intelligent creature waddled out, its little gold bell ringing.

雷桂卿笑道∶『这只狗真好玩。』
Lei laughed. “What an amusing dog.”

『你欢喜，送了给你好不好？』
“If you like it, shall I give it to you?”

雷桂卿大感意外，
Lei was taken completely by surprise.

不知道她这话是真是假，更不知道她说这话的用意；
He did not know whether she meant it, still less why she had offered.

由于存着戒心之故，就算她是真话，他亦不敢领受这份好意。
On his guard now, he would not dare accept even if she was sincere.

『谢谢，谢谢！
“Thank you, thank you.

君子不夺人之所好。』
A gentleman does not deprive another of something cherished.”

『我是真的要送你。』
“I really mean to give it to you.”

『真的我也不敢领。』雷桂卿说，
“Even so, I could not accept.

『而且狗也对你有感情了。』
Besides, it is attached to you.”


这时点心已经端出来，有甜有咸，颇为丰盛；
The refreshments had arrived, a plentiful assortment of sweet and savory dishes.

一直未曾开口的古应春便说∶『悟心，我想赶回去办事，
Gu, who had so far said nothing, spoke. “Wuxin, I must hurry back to attend to business.

中午的素斋，下次来叨扰。
Let us leave the vegetarian lunch until next time.

好在吃这顿点心，中饭也可以不必吃了。』
After all these refreshments, we shall hardly need lunch.”

『喔，』
“Oh?

悟心问道∶『你总还要回来，
You will be coming back, then.

哪一天？』
When?”

这就问到古应春为难之处了。
This touched on Gu’s difficulty.

原来他在来到湖州之前就筹划好了的，在湖州的交涉办得有了眉目，未了事宜由雷桂卿接下来办，以便他能脱身赶到上海，安排迎接左宗棠出巡。
Before coming to Huzhou, he had planned that once negotiations were under way, Lei should take over the unfinished business, freeing him to go to Shanghai and arrange Zuo Zongtang’s reception.

如今照原定计划，应该由雷桂卿在怡和洋行与杨师爷之间任联络之责；
Under that plan, Lei should now serve as liaison between Jardine Matheson and Secretary Yang.

可是这一来少不得还是要托悟心居间，
But Wuxin would still have to act as intermediary.

他怕雷桂卿绮念未断，与悟心之间发生纠纷，因而不知如何回答。
Gu feared that Lei’s continuing infatuation might lead to trouble between them and did not know how to answer.

『咦！』悟心问道∶『你怎么不开口？』
“Well?” she asked. “Why are you silent?”

『我在想。』
“I am thinking.”

『怎么到这时候你才来想？』
“Why have you waited until now to think?”

这样咄咄逼人的姿态，使得古应春有些发窘，
Her pressing manner embarrassed him.

只好再想话来搪塞。
He sought an excuse.

『这件事很麻烦，
“The matter is complicated.

我要跟桂卿回去以后，跟怡和商量以后再说。』
Guiqing and I must go back and consult Jardine Matheson before deciding.”


『以我说也不必这么费事。』
“I do not think so much trouble is necessary.”

『你有什么好办法？』
“Have you a better plan?”

『依我说，你回去办怡和洋行的禀帖，
“You should go back to obtain Jardine Matheson’s petition.

雷老爷不妨留下来，
Mr Lei can stay here.

「蚕禁」马上要过了，
The silkworm restrictions will soon be over.

做丝虽忙，说几句话的工夫总有，
Silk-making is busy work, but people can spare time for a few words.

哪个收了赵宝禄多少定洋，大家算算清楚，说说明白，
Let everyone work out and make clear how much, if anything, he received from Zhao in deposits.

如果要进状子告赵宝禄，里面有杨师爷，外面有雷老爷，事情就好办了。』悟心又说∶『这是昨天晚上我跟小玉商量出来的办法。
If they decide to sue him, with Secretary Yang working inside the yamen and Mr Lei outside, matters will be much easier.” Wuxin added, “Xiaoyu and I worked this out last night.

她有好几家亲戚，我也有几个熟人都跟赵宝禄有纠葛；
Several of her relatives and a few people I know have disputes with Zhao.

难得你们替怡和来出面，
It is fortunate that you are acting for Jardine Matheson.

大家是一条线上的。』
We are all pursuing the same end.”

这个意外的变化，不但古应春想不到，雷桂卿更感意外，
This unexpected development surprised Gu, and Lei even more.

心里有好些话要说，但照理应该由古应春先表示意见，所以默然等待。
Lei had much to say but properly left Gu to express his view first.

古应春是完全赞成悟心的办法，但先要说好一个条件，
Gu thoroughly approved, but wanted one condition settled.

『不错，内有杨师爷，外有雷老爷。』
“Yes, Secretary Yang inside and Mr Lei outside.

他说∶『不过，你也不要忘记，中有悟心师太，
But you must not forget Mistress Wuxin in the middle.

都要靠你联络。』
We shall rely on you to keep everyone in touch.”

『那当然。』
“Of course.”


『你怎么联络法？』古应春说∶『雷老爷在这里人生地不熟，
“And how will you do that?” Gu asked. “Mr Lei knows neither the people nor the place.

再遇到那么一条吓坏人的狗，不是生意经。』
Another encounter with a terrifying dog would hardly help the business.”

『不会了。』悟心答说，
“There will not be another,” Wuxin replied.

『我保险不会再遇到。』
“I guarantee it.”

说罢嫣然一笑。
She smiled beautifully.

这一笑又让雷桂卿神魂飘荡了；不过这一回古应春却不再担心，
Lei was captivated once more, but Gu no longer worried.

他担心的是悟心会出花样，
His concern had been Wuxin’s tricks.

既然她如此保证，而且要靠雷桂卿办事，也不敢再恶作剧。
Having given her guarantee and needing Lei’s help, she would hardly play another prank.

至于雷桂卿这面，已经对他下过警告，
As for Lei, he had been warned.

倘或执迷不悟，那是他自己的事。
If he persisted in his delusions, that was his own affair.

转念到此，便向雷桂卿笑道∶『这一来我也放心了。
Gu smiled at him. “Then I can rest easy.

你虽不是曹植、韩寿，不过做了鲁仲连，反而更吃香了。』
You may not be Cao Zhi or Han Shou, but play the mediator Lu Zhonglian and you will be more welcome still.”

悟心不知道他为雷桂卿讲过『贾氏窥帘韩掾少，宓妃留枕魏王才』这两句诗的典故，便叩问说∶『你在打什么哑谜。』
Unaware that he had explained the verse about Lady Jia, Han Shou, the goddess’s pillow, and the Prince of Wei to Lei, Wuxin asked, “What riddle are you speaking in?”

『不错，是个哑谜；
“A riddle, indeed.

你要想知道，等我不在的时候，你问他好了。』
If you want the answer, ask him when I am gone.”

悟心这下大致可以猜到了，这个哑谜与她有关。
Wuxin could now guess that it concerned her.

此时当然不必再问，
There was no need to pursue it.

一笑置之。
She let it pass with a smile.

『我们谈谈正事。』古应春说，
“Let us return to business,” Gu said.

『悟心，我准定你的办法，
“I accept your plan.

今天吃过中饭，我就回杭州，
I shall go back to Hangzhou after lunch today.

桂卿一半帮你们的忙，照应他的责任，都在你身上。』
Guiqing will be working partly on your behalf, and I leave his welfare entirely to you.”

『那当然。
“Naturally.

我庵里不便住，我另外替雷老爷找个好地方借住，
He cannot conveniently lodge in my retreat, but I shall find him a good place elsewhere.

一定称心如意。』
I am sure he will be pleased.”


刚谈到这里，小玉来报，说船老大带了个陌生人来觅古应春。
Just then Xiaoyu reported that the boatman had brought a stranger looking for Gu.

此刻人在大殿上，请去相见。
He was waiting in the main hall.

出去一看，才知道是胡雪岩特遣的急足来投信。
Gu went out and found that Hu Xueyan had sent a special express messenger with a letter.

信上说∶左宗棠已自江宁起程，一路视察防务、水利，
Zuo had already left Jiangning, it said, inspecting defenses and waterworks along the way.

在镇江、常州、苏州都将逗留，大概十天以后，可到上海，
He would stop in Zhenjiang, Changzhou, and Suzhou and reach Shanghai in about ten days.

在杭州所谈之事，希望古应春即速办理，
Hu urged Gu to attend promptly to what they had discussed in Hangzhou.

可由湖州径赴上海，省事得多。
It would save trouble to go straight from Huzhou to Shanghai.

这一来，计划就要重新安排了，
The plan had to be revised again.

古应春吩咐来人回船待命∶随即拿着信报找悟心与雷桂卿去商量。
Gu told the messenger to wait aboard, then took the letter back to consult Wuxin and Lei.

『左大人出巡到上海，胡大先生要替他摆摆威风，
“Lord Zuo is coming to Shanghai on inspection, and Mr Hu wishes to give him an imposing reception.

这件事我要赶紧到上海托洋人去办。
I must hurry there and arrange matters with the foreigners.

桂卿，我看，你要先回一趟杭州，把情形跟胡先生说清楚了再回来。
Guiqing, you had better go to Hangzhou first, explain the situation to Mr Hu, and then return here.”

『』怡和的禀帖呢？『雷桂卿问∶』你在上海办妥了，不如直接寄湖州，似乎比寄到杭州多一个周折来得妥当。
“What about Jardine Matheson’s petition?” Lei asked. “Once you have it ready in Shanghai, it would be better to send it directly to Huzhou, rather than through Hangzhou.”

『』好！
“Good.

湖州寄到哪里，
Where in Huzhou should it be sent?

是——『古应春的话犹未完，悟心抢着说道∶』寄给杨师爷，请他代呈好了。『
To—” Before he finished, Wuxin said, “Send it to Secretary Yang and ask him to submit it.”


『可是信里说些什么，桂卿不知道啊！』
“But Guiqing will not know what it says.”

『杨师爷知道，
“Secretary Yang will.

莫非不能问他？
Can he not ask him?

你如果再不放心，抄个底子寄到我这里转，也可以。
If you are still uneasy, send a copy to me and I can pass it on.

不过，光寄封信，你自己也不好意思吧？』
But surely you will be ashamed to send nothing except a letter?”

『你说，你说，你要啥，我给你寄了来。』
“Tell me what you want, and I shall send it.”

『敲你一个小竹杠，
“I shall levy a small tribute.

到洋房里买一包洋糖给我寄来。』
Buy me a packet of foreign sweets at a foreign shop.”

『还有呢？』
“Anything else?”

『就这一样。』
“That is all.”

『好了，
“Very well.

我知道了。』
I understand.”

古应春对雷桂卿说∶『你坐一会，
Gu turned to Lei. “Stay a moment.

我回船去写了信再来。』
I shall go back to the boat, write a letter, and return.”


『何必回船上去写？
“Why go back to the boat?

我这里莫非连纸墨砚笔都没有？』
Have I no paper, ink, inkstone, or brushes here?”

说着，悟心抬一抬手，将古应春带到后轩，是她抄经做功课的所在。
With a gesture, Wuxin led him to the rear pavilion, where she copied scriptures and performed her devotions.

『到上海往东走，回杭州往南走，
Gu addressed Lei about the journey. “Shanghai is east, Hangzhou south.

船你坐了回去。』古应春向悟心说道；「能不能请你派人打听一下，往上海的船是啥辰光有？
You take the boat back.” Then he asked Wuxin, “Could you send someone to find out when there is a boat for Shanghai?”

『『每天都有。几点钟开，我就不晓得了。
“There is one every day, but I do not know the time.

我去问。』
I shall inquire.”

等悟心一走，古应春向雷桂卿笑道∶『这是意外的机缘。
Once she had gone, Gu smiled at Lei. “This is an unexpected opportunity.

悟心似乎有还俗的意思，
Wuxin seems inclined to return to secular life.

你断弦也有两年了，
You have been a widower for two years.

好自为之。』
Conduct yourself wisely.”

雷桂卿笑笑不作声；不过看得出来，心里非常高兴。
Lei smiled without answering, but his delight was plain.

『我只劝你一句，要顺其自然，
“I have only one piece of advice: let things take their course.

千万不可心急，更不可强求。』
Do not be impatient, and above all do not force anything.”

『我明白，
“I understand.

你放心好了。』
You need not worry.”


胡雪岩替老母做过了生日，第二天就赶往上海，
The day after his mother’s birthday celebrations ended, Hu hurried to Shanghai.

那是在古应春回家的第六天。
It was the sixth day since Gu’s return home.

一到当然先去看七姑奶奶，
Naturally, his first visit was to the Seventh Lady.

絮絮不断地谈了好久，直到吃晚饭时，才能谈正事，
They talked at length, and only at dinner could business be discussed.

『左大人已经到苏州了，预定后天到上海，
“Lord Zuo has reached Suzhou and expects to arrive here the day after tomorrow.

小爷叔来得正是时候。』
You have come at just the right time, Uncle.”

『他来了当然住天后宫。转运局是一定要来的，
“He will stay at Tianhou Temple, of course, and he is certain to visit the Transport Bureau.

你看应该怎么接待？』
How should we receive him?”

『左大人算是自己人，
“He is one of our own people.

来看转运局是视察属下，
Visiting the bureau means inspecting his subordinates.

我看不必弄得太客气，倒好象疏远了。』
There is no need for excessive ceremony; that would only make us seem distant.”

『太客气虽不必，让他高兴高兴是一定要的。』
“Perhaps not excessive ceremony, but we must certainly please him.

胡雪岩说∶『我想挑个日子，请他吃饭陪客除了我们自己官面上的人以外，能不能把洋人的总领事、司令官都请来。』
I should like to choose a day to give him a dinner. Besides our own officials, can we invite the foreign consuls-general and naval commanders?”

『这要先说好。照道理，请他们没有不来的道理。』古应春又说∶『放礼炮的事，已经谈妥当了，
“It must be arranged beforehand, but there is no reason for them to refuse.” Gu continued, “The salutes are arranged.

不过，日子不晓得哪一天？』
What I do not know is the day.”


『何不到道台衙门去问一问？』
“Why not ask at the intendant’s yamen?”

古应春不作声，
Gu said nothing.

胡雪岩看出其中别有蹊跷，便即追问是怎么回事？
Seeing that something lay behind his silence, Hu pressed him.

『「排单」是早已来了，
“The itinerary arrived long ago.

哪天到，哪天看哪个地方，哪天什么人请客，都规定好了，
His arrival, his visits, his hosts for each day—everything has been fixed.

就是我们转运局去要排单，推说没有。』
But when our bureau asks for a copy, they say there is none.”

胡雪岩不由得生气，
Hu was angry.

『他们是什么意思呢？』
“What do they mean by it?

他问∶『我们转动局一问也很敬重他们的。
Our bureau has always treated them with respect.

明天我倒要去看看邵小村，怎么跟我说的。』
I shall see Shao Xiaocun tomorrow and hear what he has to say.”

古应春始而默然，继而低声说道∶『小爷叔，你不要动意气。
Gu was silent at first, then said quietly, “Do not let anger carry you away, Uncle.

我听到一个说法，不晓得是真是假？
I have heard something, though I do not know whether it is true.

据说李合肥已经派人通知邵小村，关照他跟盛杏荪联络，不许左湘阴的势力伸到上海。
They say Li of Hefei has sent word to Shao to work with Sheng Xingsun and prevent Zuo of Xiangyin from extending his influence into Shanghai.

有人在邵小面前献计，说左湘阴容易对付，就是胡某人不大好惹，要防左，先要防胡。』
Someone advised Shao that Zuo would be easy to deal with, but Hu was not a man to provoke lightly: to guard against Zuo, first guard against Hu.”

胡雪岩听完，不大在意这话，
Hu took little notice.

『他们防我也不止今天一天了。』
“They have been on their guard against me for more than a day.

他说∶『见怪不怪，其怪自败，
Ignore a strange trick, and it defeats itself.

你不必把这件事看得太认真。』
Do not take it too seriously.”

看他这种掉以轻心的态度，古应春不免兴起一种隐忧，但此时不便再多说什么，
His dismissive attitude gave Gu an uneasy sense of danger, but he could say no more then.

自己私下打了一个主意，要为胡雪岩作耳目，多方注意李鸿章与左宗棠在两江明争暗头，
Privately, he resolved to act as Hu’s eyes and ears, watching the open and covert rivalry between Li and Zuo in Liangjiang.

倘或有牵涉及于胡雪岩的可能时，更要预先防备，弭祸于无形。
If it threatened to involve Hu, he must take precautions before harm arose.

由于古应春的极力活动，同时也由于左宗棠本身的威望，上海英、法两租界的工部局，以及各国驻沪海军，都以很隆重的礼节致敬；
Through Gu’s strenuous efforts, and because of Zuo’s own prestige, the municipal councils of Shanghai’s British and French settlements and the foreign navies gave Zuo an exceptionally ceremonious reception.

经过租界，派出巡捕站岗、仪队前导，
When he passed through the settlements, police stood guard and an honor escort went before him.

尤其是出吴淞口阅兵时，黄浦江上的各国兵舰，都升起大清朝的黄龙旗，呜放十三响礼炮，
Most strikingly, when he went out through Wusong to review the forces, the foreign warships on the Huangpu hoisted the Qing yellow-dragon flag and fired thirteen-gun salutes.

声彻云霄，震动了整个上海，
The thunder filled the sky and shook all Shanghai.

都知道左宗棠到上海来了。
Everyone knew Zuo Zongtang had arrived.



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第二章（本章第5部分，共6部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


行馆设在天后宫，
Zuo’s temporary headquarters were at Tianhou Temple.

上海道邵友濂率领松江知府及所属各县『庭参』，
Shao Youlian, the Shanghai intendant, led the prefect of Songjiang and the subordinate county magistrates in paying formal respects.

接着是江海关税务司及工部局的董事拜会，在上海的文武官员谒见，
Next came the commissioner of the Jiang Customs and directors of the municipal councils, followed by the civil and military officials stationed in Shanghai.

然后是邵友濂联合在上海有差使的道员，包括胡雪岩、盛宣怀在内，『恭宴爵相』，
Shao then joined the intendants holding appointments there, including Hu Xueyan and Sheng Xuanhuai, in a banquet honoring the marquis and grand secretary.

散席时，已经起更了。
By the time it ended, the first night watch had begun.

胡雪岩与古应春当然留在最后，
Hu and Gu naturally stayed until last.

『大人今天很累了。』胡雪岩说∶『请早早安置，
“Your Excellency has had a tiring day,” Hu said. “Please retire early.

明天再来请安。』
We shall return tomorrow to pay our respects.”

『不、不！』
“No, no!”

左宗棠摇着手说∶『我明天看了制造局，后天就回江宁了。
Zuo waved a hand. “I inspect the arsenal tomorrow and return to Jiangning the day after.

有好些事情跟你谈谈，
There are many things I must discuss with you.

不忙走。』
Do not hurry away.”

胡雪岩原是门面话，
Hu had offered only the customary polite words.

既然左宗堂精神很好，愿意留他相谈，自是求之不得，
Since Zuo was in good spirits and wished him to stay, he could ask for nothing better.

答应一声，坐了下来。
He assented and sat down.


『陆防、海防争了半天，临到头来，还是由我来办，
“After all that argument over land defense and maritime defense, in the end I have to attend to it myself.

真是造化弄人。』
What tricks fortune plays!”

说罢，左宗棠仰空大笑，声震屋瓦。
Zuo threw back his head and laughed so loudly that the roof seemed to shake.

这一笑只有胡雪岩明白，是笑李鸿章。
Only Hu understood that the laughter was directed at Li Hongzhang.

原来同治十一年五月，俄国见新疆回乱，有机可乘，出兵伊犁；
In the fifth month of the eleventh year of Tongzhi, Russia had taken advantage of the Muslim rebellion in Xinjiang to send troops into Ili.

十三年三月，日本借口琉球难民事件，派军入侵台湾，
In the third month of the thirteenth year, Japan used the incident involving shipwrecked Ryukyuans as a pretext to invade Taiwan.

一时陆防、海防相继告警，因而出现了陆防与海防孰重的争论；
Threats on land and at sea followed one another, provoking debate over which kind of defense should take priority.

相争两方的主角，正就是左宗棠与李鸿章。
Its principal opponents were Zuo and Li.

左宗棠经营西北，李鸿章指挥北洋，各有所司，亦各有所持，
Zuo managed affairs in the northwest, Li commanded Beiyang; each had his own responsibilities and convictions.

朝迁认为兹事体大，命各省督抚，各抒所见。
Considering the issue of great importance, the court ordered governors-general and governors throughout the provinces to state their views.

其时湖南巡抚王文韶，正好回杭州扫墓，
Wang Wenshao, then Governor of Hunan, happened to be back in Hangzhou to visit his ancestral graves.

胡雪岩便问他∶『赞成陆防，还是海防？』
Hu asked him whether he favored land or maritime defense.


王文韶反问一句∶『你看呢？』
“What do you think?” Wang countered.

『你当湖南巡抚，自然应该帮湖南人讲话。』
“As Governor of Hunan, you should naturally speak for a Hunan man.”

『不错。
“Quite.

为政不得罪巨室。』
A man governing a province must not offend its powerful families.

王文韶说∶『我为这件事，一直踌躇不决，
I have been unable to decide this matter.

现在听老兄一句话，算是定了主意。
Your words have settled it.

李大先生的交情，暂时要搁一搁了。』
My friendship with Lord Li must be put aside for the moment.”

原来王文韶跟李鸿章的关系很深，为了在湖南做官顺利，王文韶决定赞成陆防，
Wang’s ties with Li were deep, but for the sake of governing Hunan smoothly, he decided to support land defense.

复奏说道∶『江海两防，亟宜筹备，
In his memorial he wrote: “Defenses on both river and sea urgently require preparation.

然海疆之患，不能无因而至，其关键则在西陲军务，
Yet a threat to the coast cannot arise without a cause; the crucial matter lies in the military situation on our western frontier.

俄人据我伊犁，强有久假不归之势，
The Russians occupy our Ili and show every sign of holding it indefinitely.

我师迟一日，则俄人进一日，
Each day our troops delay gives them another day’s advance.

事机之急，莫此为甚。』
Nothing could be more urgent.”

就因为这个奏折，使得陆防论占了上风。
This memorial gave the land-defense argument the advantage.

不久同治驾崩，争端暂息。
Soon afterward the Tongzhi Emperor died, and the dispute subsided temporarily.

光绪元年，争议复起，慈禧太后命亲郡王、大学士、六部九卿，会议海防事宜。
It revived in the first year of Guangxu, when Empress Dowager Cixi ordered princes, grand secretaries, and the heads of the Six Ministries and Nine Courts to confer on maritime defense.

李鸿章上折请罢西征；左宗棠当然反对，
Li memorialized for an end to the western expedition; Zuo naturally opposed him.

最后是由于文祥的支持，派左宗棠以钦差大臣督办新疆军务，
Finally, with Wenxiang’s support, Zuo was appointed imperial commissioner to direct military affairs in Xinjiang.

显然的，海防论又落了下风。
Plainly, the maritime-defense argument had again lost ground.


不过陆防之议，实际上是由伊犁事件而来，
In practice, however, the case for land defense had arisen from the Ili affair.

及至曾纪泽使俄，解决了中俄纠纷，陆防论就不再有人提起。
After Zeng Jize’s mission to Russia settled the Sino-Russian dispute, it ceased to be raised.

到得左宗常西征收功，内召入军机；不久又外放两江，
When Zuo completed his western campaign, he was summoned to the Grand Council, then soon appointed Governor-General of Liangjiang.

李鸿章旧事重提，这回大获全胜，
Li revived the old question and this time won a complete victory.

海防的计划，朝廷完全同意，
The court accepted his maritime-defense plan in full.

首先要办的是三件事∶一是在营口设营，编练新工海军；二是筹款续造『钢面铁甲』兵轮，招商局原应归还的官款暂缓归还，拨作购铁甲船之用；三是南北洋各紧要海口修船坞、修炮台，同时并举。
Three measures were to come first: establishing a base at Yingkou to train a new naval force; raising funds to continue building steel-armored warships, with government loans due for repayment by China Merchants temporarily retained and diverted to the purchase of ironclads; and simultaneously building docks and forts at the important harbors of both Nanyang and Beiyang.

哪知正在干得如火如茶之时，李太夫人病殁汉口，
Just as the work gathered momentum, Old Madam Li died in Hankou.

李鸿章丁忧回籍，调两广总督张树声署理直督，
Li Hongzhang returned home to observe mourning, and Zhang Shusheng, Governor-General of Liangguang, was transferred to act in Zhili.

筹设海防一事，便暂时拦下来了。
The coastal-defense preparations temporarily came to a halt.


『海防，北洋可管，南洋又何尝不可管；
“If Beiyang can manage maritime defense, why should Nanyang not do so?

而且经费大部分出在两江，南洋来管，更觉名正言顺。
Most of the money comes from Liangjiang anyway, making it still more proper for Nanyang to take charge.

我现在想先从船坞、炮台这两件事着手。
I mean to begin with docks and forts.

已经派人去邀彭宫保了；
I have already sent for Lord Peng.

我要赶回江宁，就因为他从长江上游巡阅下来，日内可到江宁，
The reason I must hurry back to Jiangning is that he is coming down the Yangtze on an inspection and should arrive within days.

客临主不在，未免失礼。』左宗棠一口气说到这里，突然叫一声∶『雪岩！』
It would hardly be courteous for the host to be absent when his guest arrives.” Having said all this in one breath, Zuo suddenly called, “Xueyan!”

『大人有什么吩咐？』
“What are your instructions, Your Excellency?”

『福克在不在上海？』
“Is Focke in Shanghai?”

『在。』
“Yes.

胡雪岩答说∶『他本来要回国了，因为听说大人巡视上海，特为迟一班轮船走。
He was about to return home, but on hearing of your inspection he specially postponed his departure by one steamer.

明天一定会来见大人。』
He will certainly call on you tomorrow.”

『喔，他回德国以后，还来不来？』
“Will he come back after returning to Germany?”

『来，来。』
“Yes, indeed.”

『那好。
“Good.

正好趁他回国之便，我们再商量商量，看有什么新出的利器，托他采办。』
Then we can discuss the matter further and take advantage of his journey home to have him purchase any new and effective weapons.”


胡雪岩正待回答，只见一名戈什哈掀帘而入，手里持着一个卷夹，
Hu was about to reply when a personal guard lifted the curtain and entered with a document folder.

走到左宗棠面前，一言不发，只将卷夹打了开来，
Without speaking, he approached Zuo and opened it.

里面张纸；
There was a sheet inside.

左宗棠拿起来看完，随手便递了给胡雪岩。
Zuo read it and immediately passed it to Hu.

接过来一看，是一份密电的译文∶『申局探呈左爵相，（享密）沅帅督粤，即明发。』
It was the decoded text of a confidential telegram: “Shanghai office respectfully reports to Marquis Zuo: [confidential] Marshal Yuan to govern Liangguang; public appointment decree imminent.”

署名是一个『云』字，
The signature was the single character “Yun.”

胡雪岩知道，是徐用仪发来的密电。
Hu knew the message came from Xu Yongyi.

这『沅帅』当然是指号沅甫的曾国荃，
Marshal Yuan was, of course, Zeng Guoquan, whose courtesy name was Yuanfu.

胡雪岩笑道∶『两广是好地方。
Hu smiled. “Liangguang is a good place.

曾九帅这回不会象去年那样，陕甘总督当不到半年，就因为太苦而一定要求去了。』
This time Ninth Marshal Zeng will not be like last year, when he insisted on leaving the governorship-general of Shaanxi and Gansu after less than six months because conditions were too harsh.”

左宗棠点点头，沉吟了一会，
Zuo nodded and considered for a while.

抬起头来，徐徐说道∶『叫曾老九到两广，可见张振仙是不会回任，
Raising his head, he said slowly, “Sending Zeng the Ninth to Liangguang shows that Zhang Zhenxian will not return there.

要真除直督了。
He is to be confirmed in Zhili.

雪岩，我要乘此机会，大加整顿，
Xueyan, I must use this opportunity for a thorough reorganization.

南洋的归南洋，北洋的归北洋，
Let Nanyang belong to Nanyang and Beiyang to Beiyang.

把李少荃那只看不见的「三只手」消除出去。』
We must remove Li Shaoquan’s invisible meddling hand.”

『是。』
“Yes, Your Excellency.”

胡雪岩心想李鸿章在南洋的势力，已有根深柢固之势，要清除不容易；
Hu reflected that Li’s influence in Nanyang was deeply rooted and would not be easy to eliminate.

但真的办到了，将来另有一番局面，
If it could be done, however, an entirely new situation would open before them.

这件事值得出一番大气力。
It was worth a great effort.


『明天我去看制造局，
“I am going to inspect the arsenal tomorrow.

你最好跟我一起去，看看有什么可以改良的地方。』
You had better come with me and see what can be improved.”

『是。
“Certainly.

我明天一早来伺候。』
I shall attend you early tomorrow morning.”

辞出行辕，不过九点多钟，十里洋场正是热闹的时候；
When they left the headquarters, it was only a little after nine, and Shanghai’s foreign settlement was at its liveliest.

上车时，古应春的车案悄悄说道∶『老爷，七小姐那里的约会是今天。』
As they climbed into the carriage, Gu’s driver quietly said, “Master, your appointment with Seventh Miss is tonight.”

『你倒比我记得还清楚。』
“You remember it more clearly than I do.

古应春说道∶『是不是七小姐特为关照，要你到时候提醒我。』
Did Seventh Miss specially ask you to remind me?”

那车案笑嘻嘻地不作声，只扬鞭驱车，往南而去。
The driver merely grinned, cracked his whip, and drove south.

『七小姐是哪个？』胡雪岩问。
“Who is Seventh Miss?” Hu asked.


『爱月楼老七。』
“Seventh Miss Aiyuelou.

古应春答说，『刚从苏州来的。』
She has just come from Suzhou.”

『人长得怎么样？』
“What does she look like?”

『不过大方而已。
“Presentable, that is all.

应酬工夫可是一等。』
But her skill in entertaining is first-rate.”

『看样子不止于应酬工夫。』胡雪岩笑道∶『扎客人的工夫也是一等。』
“From the look of things, it is not only her entertaining that is first-rate.” Hu laughed. “She knows how to hold on to a client too.”

『小爷叔看了就知道了。』
“You will see for yourself, Uncle.”

转眼之间，马车在宝善街兆荣里停了下来，
Soon the carriage stopped at Zhaorong Lane off Baoshan Street.

爱月楼老七家就在进弄堂右首第二家，
Seventh Miss Aiyuelou’s establishment was the second house on the right.

相帮高喊一声∶『后厢房。』即时便有一名娘姨迎了出来。
An attendant called, “Rear wing!” and a serving woman immediately came to receive them.


古胡二人便站在天进中等，
Hu and Gu waited in the courtyard.

只见那名娘姨插了满头红花，擦一脸白粉，
The woman’s hair was covered with red flowers, her face thick with white powder.

丑而且怪，真是所谓鸠盘荼，
Ugly and outlandish, she looked like a demoness.

但开出口来，那一口娇滴滴的吴侬软语，恰如十七八女郎，这就是苏州人所说的『隔壁西施』！
Yet when she spoke, her soft, delicate Wu dialect sounded like that of a girl of seventeen or eighteen: a true “beauty on the other side of the wall,” as Suzhou people called such women.

『喔唷，古老爷，耐那哼故歇才来介？
“Oh, Mr Gu, why are you so late?

七小姐等是等得来。』
Seventh Miss has been waiting and waiting!”

及至发现胡雪岩，愈发大惊小怪，
On discovering Hu, she made a greater fuss still.

『喔唷唷唷，
“Oh, my goodness!

难末事体大格哉！
What an occasion!

啥叫财神老爷还清得来哉介？
How have we managed to invite the God of Wealth himself?”

她这一喊不打紧，楼上纷纷开窗，探出好几张俊俏面庞，住天井中探望；
Her cries brought windows opening upstairs and several pretty faces peering down into the courtyard.

其中有一个大声喊道∶』胡老爷，胡老爷，
One called loudly, “Mr Hu!

耐阿记得我介？
Do you remember me?

奴是湘云老四，
Fourth Miss Xiangyun!

晏歇到倪搭来坐。
Come and sit with me later.”

『胡雪岩涉历花丛，阅人甚多，记不得有么一个湘云老四，
Hu had met so many women in his visits to the pleasure quarters that he could not remember this Fourth Miss Xiangyun.

只连声答应∶』好！
He merely answered, “Certainly!

好！
Certainly!”

『当下随着娘姨上楼，只见后厢房门口，有个花信年华的女子，打起门帘，含笑等待；
Following the serving woman upstairs, they found a woman of about twenty-four holding up the curtain at the rear room’s door, smiling as she waited.

等一进门，古应春说道∶『老七，你大概没有见过胡老爷？』
As they entered, Gu said, “Seventh Miss, I suppose you have never met Mr Hu?”


『啥叫见过歇？
“Never met him?

奴见过格。』
Of course I have.”

说着敛衽见礼，
She curtsied.

口中说道∶『胡老爷，耐发福哉。』
“Mr Hu, you have grown more prosperous-looking.”

『喔，』
“Oh?

胡雪岩问道∶『七小姐，我们在哪里见过？』
Where did we meet, Seventh Miss?”

『山塘畹？是大前年年脚边浪格事体哉。
“At Shantang, near the end of the year before the year before last.

格日子是勒抚台格大少爷请客。
Governor Le’s eldest son gave the dinner.

胡老爷还转过奴一个局，
You even called me over to entertain you.

耐末贵人多忘事，奴是一直记好勤心里浪向。』
A great man has too much to remember, but I have always treasured it.”

说着，便上前来替胡雪岩解钮扣，卸马褂。
She came forward to undo Hu’s buttons and remove his riding jacket.

胡雪岩闻到她头发上的香味，记起有这么一回事，
The scent of her hair stirred his memory.

那年年底路过苏州，江苏巡抚勒方琦的长子，在上海便是稔友；
Passing through Suzhou near the year’s end, he had been entertained by the eldest son of Le Fangqi, Governor of Jiangsu, whom he already knew well in Shanghai.

特地在虎丘一家局书寓中请客，
The dinner had been given at a courtesan’s establishment at Tiger Hill.

仿佛是在席间转过局，
He vaguely remembered calling one of the women over during the banquet.

面貌依稀，但名字却记不起，
Her face seemed familiar, but her name escaped him.

但决不是三个字。
It had certainly not consisted of three characters.

『那时候你不叫爱月楼吧？』
“You were not called Aiyuelou then?”

『伊个辰光叫惜芳。』
“I was called Xifang.”


『怪不得了。』
“That explains it.”

胡雪碉笑笑寒喧∶『这几年还好吧？』
Hu smiled and asked politely, “Have the last few years treated you well?”

『为仔好嘞，混到上海滩来格。』
“I came to Shanghai hoping for better things.”

爱月楼老七向古应春瞟了一眼，
Aiyuelou glanced at Gu.

『自从古老爷来捧仔场，慢慢叫好起来格哉。』
“Since Mr Gu began supporting my establishment, things have gradually improved.”

『今朝日脚，勿壳张财神菩萨驾到，格末加二要好格哉畹！』插嘴的是那鸠盘荼，
“And with the God of Wealth arriving so unexpectedly today, they will improve still more!” the serving woman put in.

胡雪岩与古应春是听惯了这种奉承话，不以为意；
Hu and Gu were accustomed to such flattery and paid it little heed.

倒是爱月楼老七听得刺耳，
Aiyuelou, however, found it grating.

当即说道∶『耐闲话那哼介多介？』说着，又使个眼色，让她退了出去。
“Why do you talk so much?” she said, giving the woman a look that sent her out.

这时果盘已经摆上来了，
Fruit trays had now been set out.

等胡雪岩与古应春坐了下来，爱月楼老七一面敬瓜子、敬茶，一面寒喧。
Once the men were seated, Aiyuelou offered melon seeds and tea and continued the courtesies.

『胡老爷是落里一日到格介？』
“When did Mr Hu arrive?”

『来是来了两三天了。』古应春代为回答∶『不过今天头一回出来吃花酒。』
“Two or three days ago,” Gu answered for him. “But this is his first evening out at a courtesan’s dinner.”


『啊唷！
“Oh!

头一转就到奴搭，
And you came to me on your very first outing!

格是看得起奴畹！
What an honor.

多谢、多谢。』
Thank you!”

『早知道你们是老相好，我昨天就请我们小爷叔来了。』
“Had I known you were old friends, I should have brought our Little Uncle yesterday.”

『那哼叫小爷叔？
“Why Little Uncle?

古老爷，耐姓半个胡畹，
Your surname Gu is only half of Hu.

啥叫是叔侄辈子？』
How can you be uncle and nephew?”

『妙！』胡雪岩笑道∶『应春，我还是头一回听说，你姓半个胡。』古应春也笑了，
“Excellent!” Hu laughed. “Yingchun, this is the first time I have heard that your surname is half a Hu.” Gu laughed too.

回顾一班小大姐说∶『你们以后就叫我半胡老爷好了。』
Turning to the young attendants, he said, “You may all call me Mr Half-Hu from now on.”

『格就呒趣哉！』爱月楼老七接口说道∶『吃酒末吃半壶，碰麻雀末一和还勿和。
“That would be no fun!” Aiyuelou replied. “Half a pot of wine to drink, and not even one complete winning hand at mahjong!

阿要作孽？』
Would that not be a miserable fate?”


胡雪岩看她心思灵活、口齿便给，颇有好感；
Hu liked her quick wit and ready tongue.

古应春看出他的心思，便即说道∶『小爷叔，今天这个客，你来请了吧？』
Gu saw it and said, “Uncle, why do you not take over as host tonight?”

胡雪岩跟他走马章台，已历多年，间或也有这种『让贤』之举；
They had visited the pleasure quarters together for many years, and Gu occasionally yielded his place in this way.

正在考虑是否接受此番美意时，爱月楼老七却开口了。
Hu was considering whether to accept when Aiyuelou spoke.

『勿作兴格！
“That will not do!

古老爷，耐今朝格台酒那哼好赖？
Mr Gu, how can you escape paying for tonight’s dinner?

停吃得有兴末，翻台到前厢房，
If everyone is enjoying himself afterward, we can move to the front room for another round.

胡老爷耐看阿好？』
Would that suit you, Mr Hu?”

『前厢房？』
“The front room?

胡雪岩问，『是湘云老四那里。』
Fourth Miss Xiangyun’s?”

既然人家都已画好道了，逢场作戏惯了的胡雪岩毫无异议，
Since she had already arranged their course, Hu, well accustomed to these social games, had no objection.

只问古应春∶『请哪些人？』
He merely asked Gu, “Whom shall we invite?”


『小爷叔想看哪些人。』
“Whom would you like to see?”

于是胡雪岩随口报了四、五个名字，都是青楼中善会凑趣的人物；
Hu named four or five men known for making good company in the pleasure quarters.

古应春下笔如飞，写好了请柬，
Gu’s brush flew as he wrote the invitations.

点一点主客一共七人，便即说道∶『我们来个八仙过海。』
Counting seven hosts and guests in all, he said, “Let us make Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea.”

说着，又写一张请柬∶『飞请三马路长发栈，沙大爷印一心，惠临一叙。』
He wrote another invitation: “Urgently inviting Mr Sha Yixin, staying at Changfa Inn on Third Road, to join us.”

赘上名字以后，另外又用小字注了一行∶『有贵客介见，
After signing it, he added in smaller characters, “A distinguished guest awaits an introduction.

千请勿却。』
Please do not decline.”

巧得很，偏偏就是这个特邀的客人，因病未能赴约。
By an odd chance, this specially invited man was prevented by illness from coming.

不过今雨不来旧雨来，
An old acquaintance arrived instead.

有个胡雪岩与古应春都认识的兵部司官林茂先，外放福建的知府，
Lin Maoxian, whom both Hu and Gu knew, was a Ministry of War official newly appointed prefect in Fujian.

路过上海也住在那家客栈，
Passing through Shanghai, he was staying at the same inn.

得知古应春请吃花酒；这是照例可以闯席的，逆旅无聊，便作了不速之客。
On hearing that Gu was giving a courtesan’s dinner—an occasion one could customarily join without invitation—he relieved the tedium of travel by appearing unannounced.


『好极，
“Excellent!

好极！』
Excellent!”

古应春颇为欢迎，
Gu welcomed him warmly.

因为这林茂先也是很有趣的人，谈锋极健，肚子里掌故很多，
Lin was entertaining, a brilliant talker with a store of anecdotes.

声色场中宴饮，必得要有这样一个人，席面上才不会冷落。
A dinner in the pleasure quarters needed such a man to keep it from falling flat.

台面铺设好了，
The banquet was laid.

名为『双台』，其实仍是一张圆桌；
Though called a “double table,” it was still only one round table.

爱月楼老七拿一方簇新的白洋布，裹着一把镶银象牙筷，走到古应春面前问道∶『客人可曾齐？』
Aiyuelou approached Gu with a bundle of silver-mounted ivory chopsticks wrapped in a fresh white cloth. “Are all the guests here?”

『还差一位。不过开席吧！』
“One is still missing, but let us begin.”

这时胡雪岩便发话了，
Hu now spoke.

因为勾栏虽非官场，但席次也讲身分地位；
Though a courtesan’s house was no government office, seating still reflected rank and standing.

胡雪岩名正言顺是首座，他不等人家来请，抢着前面逊谢。
He was unquestionably entitled to the place of honor, but before anyone could invite him to it, he declined.

『今天这个首座，林茂翁推都推不掉的——』『雪翁，雪翁！』
“Mr Maoxian cannot possibly refuse the first seat tonight—” “Mr Xue, Mr Xue!”

『足下听我说完，
“Hear me out.

如果不在道理上，你再驳我。』
If my reasons are unsound, you may refute them.”

胡雪岩挥手拦住他说∶『第一，你是远客；
Hu raised a hand to stop him. “First, you have come from afar.

第二，你有喜事；
Second, you have something to celebrate.

第三，除我跟应春以外，其余跟足下都是初会，理当客气。』话一完，大家都说道理很通，
Third, apart from Yingchun and myself, everyone here meets you for the first time and ought to show you courtesy.” All agreed that his reasoning was sound.

林茂先便拱拱手说道∶『有僭、有僭。』
Lin clasped his hands. “Then forgive my presumption.”

等爱月楼老七安了席，首先落座。
Once Aiyuelou had arranged the places, he sat first.


次席当然胡雪岩，
Hu naturally took the second seat.

其余都是稔友，不分上下，只留了主位给古应春，
The others were old friends and did not distinguish among their places, leaving only the host’s seat for Gu.

等他一坐下，小大姐立即捧上一个黑木盘，内中笔砚以外，便是一叠局票。
As soon as he sat down, a young attendant brought a black wooden tray holding brush, inkstone, and a stack of summons cards for the courtesans.

『茂翁，你叫哪位？』
“Mr Maoxian, whom shall you call?”

『这里我是外行，
“I know nothing of the place.

而且昨天刚到，今天是第一回来观光，
I arrived only yesterday, and this is my first visit.

请你举贤吧！』
Recommend someone.”

『叫湘云老四好了。』胡雪岩说，
“Call Fourth Miss Xiangyun,” Hu suggested.

『我记得她那张嘴很能说，
“I remember she has a ready tongue.

跟茂翁的谈锋倒相配。』
She would suit Mr Maoxian’s conversation.”

古应春略想一想，写了下来，便又问道∶『小爷叔你自己呢？』
Gu considered briefly, wrote the name, and asked, “And for you, Uncle?”

胡雪岩的相识可是太多了，笑笑说道∶『你替我作主好了。』
Hu knew so many women that he merely smiled. “Choose for me.”


古应春点点头说∶『我替小爷叔叫两个，
Gu nodded. “I shall call two for you.

一个是好媛老九。一个是——』『不、不！
Ninth Miss Haoyuan, and—” “No, wait.

我想起来。』
I remember.

胡雪岩说∶『另外一个叫娇凤老五。』
Let the other be Fifth Miss Jiaofeng.”

『何必叫她呢？』
“Why call her?”

古应春皱着眉说。
Gu frowned.

『你不要管，
“Never mind.

我找她有事。』
I have something to discuss with her.”

于是一一写好局票，发了出去；
The summons cards were completed and sent out.

首先来的是近在前厢房的湘云老四，
First to arrive was Fourth Miss Xiangyun, close at hand in the front room.

小足伶仃，扶着十三四岁的一个小大姐的肩膀，
Moving on tiny bound feet, she leaned on the shoulder of a maid of thirteen or fourteen.

进门问道∶『落里一位是林老爷？』
“Which gentleman is Mr Lin?” she asked on entering.

『喏、喏！』
“Here!”

胡雪指着说道∶『就是这位京里来的林老爷，现任的知府大人。
Hu pointed. “This is Mr Lin from the capital, now an appointed prefect.

老四，我特为给你做这个媒』湘云老四因为胡雪岩没有叫她，心里老大不悦；
Fourth Miss, I have specially arranged this introduction for you.” Xiangyun had already been displeased that Hu had not called her for himself.

现在才知道是有意把她推给别人，愈发生气∶『谢谢耐！』她说得极快，同时将一双杏儿眼往旁边一瞟，
Discovering that he meant to hand her over to someone else made her angrier still. “Thank you!” she said rapidly, casting her almond-shaped eyes aside.

都看得出来，她是生气了。
Everyone could see that she was angry.


原来这也是胡雪岩待客的一番苦心。
Hu had actually made the arrangement out of consideration for his guest.

这林茂先在京中亦是一个嫖客，但喜欢逛『茶室』。
