“Exactly.”


『照此说来，京里只说叫李某某回任，对于张曾两位没不交代，意思也就是要李合能只领虚衔，暂时不必回任。』
“Then the capital’s order restoring Li, with no instructions about Zhang or Zeng, means he is to hold the title for the moment without actually resuming the post.”

『不错，
“Correct.

举一反三，
You can infer the rest from one point.

你明白了。』
You understand.”

『那末，李合肥怎么办呢？』
“What will he do, then?”

左宗棠沉吟了好了一会「问说∶『你看呢？』
Zuo pondered for a long time. “What do you think?”

『我看，他仍旧会到上海。』
“I think he will still come to Shanghai.”

左宗棠点点头，
Zuo nodded.

『我想他也只能先驻上海。』
“I too think he can only stay in Shanghai first.

他说∶『而且他也不能忘情上海。』胡雪岩当即说道∶『我本来想跟大人辞了行，回杭州，以后再到上海；
Besides, he cannot quite relinquish it.” Hu answered at once, “I had intended to take leave of Your Excellency, return to Hangzhou and go to Shanghai afterwards.

照现在看，似乎应该直接到上海的好。』
In these circumstances, it seems better to go straight to Shanghai.”

原来各省关应解陕甘，以便还本的协款，都交由江海关代转；
The provincial and customs contributions assigned to Shaanxi and Gansu for repayment of principal all passed through Shanghai Customs.

所以各省解缴的情况如何，非要胡雪岩到上海去查了才知道。
Only by going there could Hu discover what had actually been remitted.

『好，
“Good.

你到上海首先办这件事，看情形如何赶紧写信来。
Make that your first business in Shanghai and write at once with the position.

看哪里还没有解到，好及早去催。』
We must know which remittances are missing so that we can press for them early.”

胡雪岩的估计很正确，
Hu’s estimate proved correct.

李鸿章果然奏请暂驻上海，统筹全局，察酌南北军情，再取进止。
Li petitioned to remain temporarily in Shanghai, coordinating affairs, assessing the military situation in north and south, and deciding his next move accordingly.

意思是江南防军如果力量不足，无法南调，那就不一定用武，以求和为宜。
His meaning was that if the lower Yangtze forces could not spare troops for the south, war need not follow; peace would be preferable.

恭王懂他的用意，奏请准如所请；
Prince Gong understood and obtained approval.

于是李鸿章在三月底专轮到了上海，驻节天后宫行辕。
At the end of the third month, Li arrived in Shanghai by a specially arranged steamer and established headquarters at Tianhou Temple.



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第五章（本章第1部分，共3部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第五章
CHAPTER FIVE


一见古应春的面，胡雪岩一吓跳，
The sight of Gu Yingchun gave Hu Xueyan a shock.

他人都瘦得落形了。
He had grown so thin that his whole appearance had changed.

『应春，你，你怎么弄成这个样子？』『唉！』古应春长长地叹口气，
“Yingchun, what—what has happened to you?” Gu sighed deeply.

『小爷叔，我的运气太坏！
“Little Uncle, my luck has been terrible.

也怪我自己大意。』
I was careless too.”

『你出了什么事？
“What happened?

快告诉我。』
Tell me at once.”

『我要倾家荡产了。』
“I am going to lose everything.

古应春说∶『都是听信了徐雨之的话。』
All because I listened to Xu Yuzhi.”

这徐雨之是广东籍的富商，胡雪岩跟他也很熟。
Xu was a wealthy Guangdong merchant whom Hu also knew well.

此人单名一个润字，
His personal name was Run.

人很能干，运气也很好，在上海一家洋行学生意，深得洋人的器重，
Both capable and fortunate, he had learnt business in a Shanghai foreign firm, winning the foreigners’ high regard.

从廿二岁开始与人合伙开钱庄，开丝号，开茶栈，无不大发利市。
From the age of twenty-two, he had joined partners to establish banks, silk firms and tea warehouses, profiting handsomely in every venture.

同治二年廿六岁，已经积赀十来万，
By the second year of Tongzhi, when he was twenty-six, he had accumulated a hundred thousand taels or more.

在江南粮台报捐员外郎，加捐花翎，俨然上海洋场上有名的绅士了。
Through the Jiangnan military supply office he purchased the rank of an assistant departmental director, adding a peacock feather, and became a prominent gentleman of the Shanghai foreign settlement.

因此，同治十年得了个差使。
In Tongzhi’s tenth year, he consequently received a commission.

那时两江总督南洋大臣曾国藩决定挑选幼童出洋留学；
Zeng Guofan, governor-general of Liangjiang and Nanyang minister, had decided to send young boys abroad to study.

事先研究，这批幼童以在广东挑选为宜，
Preliminary enquiries suggested selecting them in Guangdong.

因为美国的华侨绝大部分是广东人，广东风气开通，
Most Chinese residents in America came from that province, whose people were receptive to new ideas.

作父兄的固不以幼年子弟在万里重洋之外而不放心；而此辈幼童在美国常有乡音亲切的长辈去看他们，亦可以稍慰思乡之苦。
Fathers and elder brothers would not be unduly alarmed at sending young relatives across ten thousand li of ocean; meanwhile, the boys could be visited in America by older countrymen speaking familiar dialects, easing their homesickness.

由于徐润是上海『广东帮』商人的领袖，所以曾国藩把这个差使交了给他。
As a leader of Shanghai’s Guangdong merchants, Xu received the task.

徐润策划得很周到，挑选了一百二十个资质很不错的幼童，分四批出洋，每批三十人；
He planned carefully, choosing a hundred and twenty promising boys to travel in four groups of thirty.

第一批在同治十一年七月初上船，由容闳带队，
The first sailed early in the seventh month of Tongzhi’s eleventh year under Yung Wing.

大部分是广东籍，广东籍中又以香山为最多，因为徐润就是香山人。
Most were from Guangdong, especially Xiangshan, Xu’s own county.


当然，也有其他省份的人，但为数极少，只得五个，两个江苏、一个山东、一个福建、还有一个是徽州人，不过是广东招来的，
There were only five boys from elsewhere: two from Jiangsu, one from Shandong, one from Fujian, and one whose family came from Huizhou, though he had been recruited in Guangdong.

这个十二岁、生在辛酉政变那一年的幼童，叫做詹天佑，
The last was twelve, born in the year of the Xinyou coup, and named Zhan Tianyou.

他的父亲叫詹作屏，在福建船政局当机器匠，家眷寄居广州。
His father, Zhan Zuoping, worked as a machinist at the Fujian shipbuilding establishment, while the family lived in Guangzhou.

詹天佑应募时，有人劝詹作屏让他的儿子学法律，学成回国，可以做官；
When Tianyou applied, someone advised his father to let him study law so that he could return and become an official.

但詹屏坚持他的儿子要学技艺，而且要学最新的技艺。
Zhan insisted that his son learn technical skills, and the newest ones at that.

第二批是在同治十二年五月放洋的，由徐润的亲家黄平甫领队。
The second group sailed in the fifth month of Tongzhi’s twelfth year, led by Huang Pingfu, whose family was linked to Xu’s by marriage.

这回在挑选的官费生三十名以外，另有七名广东少年，由他们的家长自备资斧，
Besides the thirty government-supported boys, seven more from Guangdong went at their parents’ expense.

请黄平甫带到美国——风气到底大开了，已经有自费留学的了。
Their families asked Huang to take them to America: attitudes had indeed changed, and privately funded overseas study had begun.

第三批是在同治十三年八月间派遣。
The third group left in the eighth month of Tongzhi’s thirteenth year.

这回与以前不同的是，除了两个学技艺、一个学机器以外，其余的都念普通学校，年长的念『中馆』；年幼的念『小馆』，
This time, apart from two boys studying technical crafts and one studying machinery, all attended ordinary schools: the older boys at middle schools, the younger at elementary schools.

但所谓年长，亦不过十三岁，台广东香山的唐绍仪、江苏常州的朱宝奎；
Even the older ones were only thirteen, including Tang Shaoyi of Xiangshan and Zhu Baokui of Changzhou, Jiangsu.

而最年幼的，至少也要十岁。
The youngest were at least ten.

第四批放洋在光绪元年九月，
The fourth group departed in the ninth month of Guangxu’s first year.

增加了十个名额，一共是四十名，
Ten additional places brought the total to forty.

这回一律念普通学校，到中学毕业，再视他们性之所近，决定学什么。
All would attend ordinary schools and choose a specialisation after completing middle school, according to their aptitudes.

同时外省籍的幼童也多了，但仍不脱江苏、浙江、安徽三省。
More boys came from other provinces, though these were still confined to Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Anhui.

幼童放洋是曾国藩所创议，但他不及见第一批幼童放洋，同治十一年二月殁于任上；
Zeng had initiated the scheme but did not live to see the first departure, dying in office in the second month of Tongzhi’s eleventh year.

以后便由李鸿章支持这件事，
Li Hongzhang subsequently supported it.

徐润亦由此获得李鸿章的赏识，由北洋札委为招商局的会办，与盛宣怀同事。
Xu thereby gained Li’s appreciation and received a Beiyang appointment as associate director of China Merchants, working alongside Sheng Xuanhuai.


在这七八年中，徐润的事业蒸蒸日上，
During those seven or eight years, Xu’s enterprises had flourished.

当然还远不及胡雪岩，但亦算是上海『夷场』上的殷商。
He remained far below Hu in wealth, but was a substantial Shanghai merchant.

胡雪岩跟他除了作善举以外，别无生意上的往来，
Apart from charitable undertakings, Hu had no business dealings with him.

而古应春因为原籍广东，又以跟洋商打交道时，常会聚在一起，所以跟徐润走得很近，
Gu, however, came originally from Guangdong, often encountered him when dealing with foreign firms, and had become close to him.

也有好些合伙的事业，其中之一是做房地产生意。
They shared several ventures, including property speculation.

徐润的房地产很多，地皮有两千九百多亩，建成的洋房有五十一所，市房更多，不下两千间，
Xu held more than two thousand nine hundred mu of land, fifty-one foreign-style houses and at least two thousand commercial premises.

照帐面上算，值到两百二十几万，但积压的资本太重，
Their book value exceeded two million two hundred thousand taels, but too much capital was tied up.

空地毫无收入，还要付税；市房则只是收租金，为数有限。
Vacant land produced nothing and still incurred taxes, while rents from the premises were limited.

于是，他有一个英国朋友，名叫顾林，此人在英国是个爵士，本人热心运动，交游很广，亦很懂生意经，他向徐润建议，彼此合作。
A British friend named Gulin, a knight keen on sport, widely connected and knowledgeable about business, proposed a partnership.

顾林亦是古应春的朋友，因此，徐润邀他跟顾林一起谈合作，
Gulin also knew Gu, so Xu invited him to their discussions.

『我们组织一个大公司，投入资金，在空地上都盖起房子来。』顾林说道∶『造一批，卖一批；卖来的款子造第二批。
“Let us form a large company and invest capital to build on all the empty land,” Gulin said. “Build one group of houses and sell it, then use the proceeds for the next.

空地用完了，把旧房子再来翻造，不断更新，
Once the vacant land is used, rebuild the old houses and keep renewing them.

外国的大都市，尤其是美国，都是这样建造起来的。』
That is how great foreign cities, especially American ones, have grown.”

这个周而复始盖房子的决窍，徐润也懂，
Xu understood the cycle of building and selling.

『可是，「他问∶』这要大批现金，
“But it needs a great deal of ready cash.

你能不能投资？
Can you invest?”

『『当然，
“Of course.

我没有这个意思，不会跟你谈合作。
Otherwise I would not propose a partnership.

不过，我也是要回国去招股。
But I too must return home to raise subscriptions.

我们把合作的办法商量好了，拿章程在伦敦市场上传了出去，相信不到三个月，就能把股本募足。』
Once we agree on the terms and circulate the prospectus in London, I believe we can raise the capital in less than three months.”

『股本算多少呢？』
“How much capital?”

『这要看你的意思。
“That depends on you.

你拿你的房地产作价——当然是实价；看值多少，我就募多少股本。』
Value your property—at its real value, of course—and I shall raise an equal sum.”

『徐润点点头问古应春∶』你看呢？
Xu nodded and asked Gu’s view.

『『他这个法子可行，也很公平。
“It is workable and fair.

不过，我认为我们这方面股份要多占些。』
But I think our side should hold a larger share.”

徐润想了一下，提出很明确的办法，这中英合资的公司股本定为四百万两，华方占五成半，英方占四成半；
After consideration, Xu proposed definite terms: capital of four million taels, fifty-five per cent Chinese and forty-five per cent British.

华方以房地产核实作价，英方四成半计一百八十万两，由英国汇来现金。
The Chinese side would contribute property at an agreed real valuation, and the British side remit one million eight hundred thousand taels in cash.


于是，请律师撰文签订了草约，
A lawyer drew up a preliminary agreement, which they signed.

徐润还送了一万两银子给顾林，让他回国去招股。
Xu also gave Gulin ten thousand taels to go home and raise subscriptions.

但是徐润的房地产，照实价只值一百五十万两；
But his property’s true value was only one and a half million.

还要再买价值七十万两的地皮，才能凑足二百二十万两，合足五成半之数。
Another seven hundred thousand taels’ worth of land had to be bought to make up the Chinese share of two million two hundred thousand.

『应春兄，好朋友利益均沾，
“Brother Yingchun, good friends should share the profits.

这七十万两，你来入股如何？』
Will you subscribe that seven hundred thousand?”

古应春筹划了一下，愿意出五十万两银子。
After examining his resources, Gu agreed to contribute five hundred thousand.

这是去年年底的话；
This was at the end of the previous year.

到这年二月里，地皮买足数了，可是顾林却出了事。
By the second month of the present one, enough land had been purchased—but disaster overtook Gulin.

原来顾林回到伦敦不久，在一次皇室邀请的狩猎会中，
Soon after returning to London, he attended a royal hunting party.

马失前蹄、人从马上倒栽出去，头先着地，脑子受了重伤，
His horse stumbled and threw him headfirst, inflicting a grave brain injury.

请了两位名医诊治，性命虽已保住，但得了个癫痫症，
Two eminent physicians saved his life, but he developed epilepsy.

合作设大分司的事，就此无疾而终。
The great company project quietly died.

这一来徐润跟古应春大受打击，
Xu and Gu were hit hard.

因为中法在越南的纠纷，法国政府不惜推翻已经达成和解的协议，准备动武，且已派水师提督孤拔，率舰东来，
In the Vietnamese dispute, France had repudiated the settlement and prepared for war, sending Admiral Courbet east with a fleet.

同时国会通过，拨款五百万法郎，作为战费，
Its legislature also voted five million francs for military expenditure.

因此上海谣言纷纷，
Rumours swept Shanghai.

流传最盛的一个说法是，法国军舰不断巡弋在吴淞口外，决定要攻制造局。
The most widespread said that French warships were continually cruising outside Wusong and had decided to attack the arsenal.

胆小的人已经开始逃难；
Timid people were already fleeing.

在这种风声鹤唳的情况之下房地产根本无人问津。
In this atmosphere of panic, no one would even enquire about property.


『我那五十万银子，其中卅五万是借来的；
“Of my five hundred thousand taels, three hundred and fifty thousand were borrowed.

现在银根紧到极点，
Money is now desperately tight.

上海三十几家钱庄，家家心惊肉跳，只怕再来一个风潮，
All thirty-odd Shanghai banks are trembling, afraid of another panic.

大家提存挤兑，一倒就是多少家。
If everyone withdraws their deposits, any number may collapse together.

我借的款子，催得很急；实在是急！
My lenders are pressing hard—very hard.

每天都有钱庄里的伙计上门坐讨，
Their clerks come and sit at my door every day, demanding payment.

只好不断同人家说好话。』古应春又说∶『还有一层，我怕阿七晓得了着急，还要时时刻刻留心瞒住她。
I can only keep pleading with them.” Gu added, “And I am afraid A’qi will hear and worry, so I must constantly hide it from her.

小爷叔，你想，我过的是啥日子？』
Little Uncle, imagine the life I am leading.”

胡雪岩听了他这番话，再看到他憔悴的形容，恻然心伤，
Hearing this and seeing his haggard face, Hu felt a sharp pang of pity.

『应春，你放心！』
“Do not worry, Yingchun!”

他拍一拍胸脯说∶『我来替你了；
He struck his chest. “I shall settle it for you.

都在我身上。』
Leave everything to me.”

古应春迟疑未答。
Gu hesitated without answering.

胡雪岩倒奇怪了，
Hu was surprised.

照情理说，现有人替他一肩担承，他应该高兴才是，
Surely he should be delighted to have someone shoulder the whole burden?

何以有此显得困惑的神情？
Why look so troubled?

『应春，』他问∶『还有啥难处？
“What other difficulty is there?

我们这样的交情，你还有啥在我面前说不出口的话？』
With our friendship, what can you not tell me?”

『小爷叔，』古应春顿了一下问道∶『莫非上海的市面，你真的一点都不晓得？』
“Little Uncle,” Gu paused, “do you really know nothing of the Shanghai market?”

『怎么？
“What do you mean?

市面有好有坏，
Markets rise and fall.

这也是常有的事。』
That is ordinary enough.”

古应春楞住了，好一会方始开口∶『看起来你老人家真的不晓得。
Gu stared, then at last spoke. “It seems you truly do not know.

我现在说实话吧，来催讨欠款，来催得最厉害的，就是老宓。』
Let me tell you plainly: the man pressing hardest for repayment is Old Mi.”

此言一出，胡雪岩脸上火辣辣地发烧，真象上海人所说的『吃耳光』一样，
Hu’s face burned as though he had been slapped.

一时心里七上八下，竟开不得口了。
His thoughts tumbled, and he could not speak.

原来古应春口中的『老宓』，就是他阜康钱庄的档手宓本常。
Old Mi was Mi Benchang, the managing clerk of his own Fukang Bank.

『自己人催欠款催得这么厉害！
“Pressing our own people so hard!

岂有此理！』
Outrageous!”

胡雪岩非常生气；
Hu was angry.

但转念一想，连自己人的欠款都催得这么厉害，可见得阜康的境况也很窘。
Then another thought came: if even a friend was being pursued so urgently, Fukang itself must be in serious difficulty.

这一转念间，惊出一身汗，定一定神说道∶『应春，你晓得的，这几年，阜康的事，我都交老宓，难得问一问；
He broke into a sweat, steadied himself and said, “You know that for years I have left Fukang to Mi and seldom asked about it.

照现在看，阜康的银根好象比哪一家都紧，
From what you say, its funds seem tighter than anyone’s.

你倒同我说一说，到底是怎么个情形？』
Tell me exactly what is happening.”


『小爷叔，你从江宁来，
“You have come from Jiangning, Little Uncle.

莫非没有听左大人跟你谈上海的市面？』
Did His Excellency Zuo not discuss the Shanghai market with you?”

『怎么？
“What?

上海的市面，莫非┅┅』『从来没有这么坏过。
Is the market—” “It has never been worse.

小爷叔，你晓得现在上海的现银有多少？』
Do you know how much ready silver there is in Shanghai now?”

『有多少？』
“How much?”

『这个。』古应春伸一指相示。
Gu raised one finger.

『一千万？』
“Ten million?”

『一百万。』
“One million.”

胡雪岩大吃一惊，
Hu was shocked.

『真的？』他问。
“Really?”

『你差别老宓就晓得了。』
“Ask Mi and you will see.”

胡雪岩仍旧有点不大相信，
Hu still found it hard to believe.

『市面这么坏，应该有人告诉左大人啊！』他说，
“If the market is so bad, someone should tell His Excellency Zuo.

『我在江宁，跟左大人谈起上海他说因为法国称兵，上海市面多少受点影响，不过不要紧。』
When we discussed Shanghai in Jiangning, he said that French military threats had affected trade somewhat, but it was nothing serious.”

『哼！』古应春冷笑一声∶『现在做官的，哪个不是瞒上欺下，
Gu gave a cold snort. “Which official nowadays does not deceive those above and bully those below?

只会做喜鹊，不肯当乌鸦。』
They all want to be magpies bringing good news; none will be a crow.”

『走！
“Come.

「胡雪岩说∶』我们一起到集贤里去。
Let us go to Jixian Lane together.”

『阜康钱庄设在英租界集贤里，与胡雪岩的公馆只隔一条马路，
Fukang stood in Jixian Lane in the British settlement, just across a road from Hu’s residence.

他经常是安步当车走了去的。
He usually walked there at leisure.

正要出门时，女管家陈嫂赶出来问道∶』老爷，啥辰光回来？『
As they were leaving, the housekeeper, Mrs Chen, hurried out. “When will you be back, sir?”


『现在还不晓得。』
“I do not know yet.”

『刚刚宓先生派徒弟来通知，他说晓得老爷已经来了，吃夜饭辰光他会来。』陈嫂又说∶『今夜难得买到一条很新鲜的鲥鱼，
“Mr Mi has just sent an apprentice to say he knows you have arrived and will come at dinnertime.” She added, “We have found a very fresh shad today, which is rare.

老爷回来吃夜饭吧！』
Do come back for dinner.”

一听宓本常要来，胡雪岩倒有些踌躇了；
Hearing that Mi was coming, Hu hesitated.

古应春便即说道∶『即然如此，不如等老宓来，
Gu said, “Then perhaps we should wait for him.

有些话也是在家里谈，比较方便。』
Some things are more easily discussed at home.”

胡雪岩听这一说，便从纱背心口袋中掏出打簧表来看，
Hu took his striking watch from his gauze waistcoat pocket.

已经四点半了，
It was already half past four.

便点点头说∶『那就叫人去说一声∶请宓先生早一点来。』
“Then send word asking him to come early.”

于是重回客厅去密谈。
They returned to the drawing room for a private discussion.

胡雪岩此时最关心的是要还汇丰银行第一期的本银五十万两。
Hu’s chief concern was the first five-hundred-thousand-tael principal payment to HSBC.

陕甘总督衙门出的『印票』，不过是摆个样子，
The sealed notes issued by the governor-general’s office in Shaanxi and Gansu were little more than a formality.

还款来源是各省交上海道衙门代收的协饷；
Repayment came from provincial contributions collected through the Shanghai circuit intendant.

数目如果不够，他可以代垫，但银根如此之紧，代垫恐有不能，
Hu could cover a shortfall, but with money so tight he might be unable to do so.

须要及早筹划。
He must plan early.

『应春，』他问，『汇丰的款子，月底要交，
“Yingchun, the HSBC payment is due at the end of the month.

你晓不晓得，邵小村那里已经收到多少了？』
Do you know how much Shao Xiaocun has received?”

『前十来天我听说，已经收到半数了。
“Ten days or so ago I heard that half had arrived.

这几天，总还有款子进来。
More should have come in since.

差也不过差个百把万，
The shortage should be no more than a million or so.

不过，现在全上海的现银只有一百万，』
But there is only a million in ready silver in all Shanghai.”

古应春吸着气说∶『这件事恐怕也是个麻烦。』
Gu drew a breath. “This may be troublesome too.”

胡雪岩的心一沉，
Hu’s heart sank.

『我的信用，伤不得一点点。
“My credit cannot suffer the slightest blemish.

应春，』他说∶『只有半个月的工夫了。
There is only half a month left.

你有没有啥好主意？』
Have you any good idea?”

『一时倒还没有。』
“Not at the moment.

古应春答说∶『且等老宓来了再说。』
Let us wait for Mi.”

宓本常一直到天黑才来。
Mi did not arrive until dark.

据他说，一接到通知，本来马上就要赶来，只为有几个大客户提存，
He said he had meant to come immediately upon receiving the message, but several large customers were withdrawing deposits.

调度费时，所以耽误了工夫。
Arranging the funds had delayed him.


胡雪岩知道，所谓调度，
Hu knew what those arrangements involved.

无非先开出银票，问客户到何处提款；然后通兑付的联号。
First a banknote was issued and the customer asked where he wished to collect the silver; then the paying branch was notified.

譬如客户要提五万银子的存款，说要到江宁去提；
Suppose he wanted fifty thousand taels in Jiangning.

便用最快的方法通知江宁的阜康。
The fastest means would be used to alert Fukang there.

如果江宁『头寸』不足，再查何处有多余的『头寸』——
If that branch lacked funds, they would look for another with a surplus.

上海阜康是总号，各联号存款进出的情形，都有帐可查；
Shanghai Fukang was the head office and kept records of deposits and withdrawals at every branch.

查清楚了，透过同行的汇划，以有余补不足。
Once the position was clear, remittances through other banks could use one branch’s surplus to cover another’s shortage.

不过这是近来的情形，
But that was the recent practice.

早些日子说要提现银，还要照付；
Earlier, customers asking for ready silver had been paid it.

胡雪岩便查问那些现银都到哪里去了？
Hu asked where all that silver had gone.

『都分散到内地去了。』宓本常说∶『不靠水路码头的联号，存款都增加了。
“It has dispersed inland,” Mi said. “Deposits are up at branches away from major navigable-waterway ports.

不过照我计算，转到别处的只占十之六七；还有十之三四，是摆在家里了。
By my reckoning, sixty or seventy per cent of the money has moved elsewhere; the other thirty or forty per cent is being kept at home.

这些现银，要到市面平空了，才会派到市面上。』
That will return to circulation only when the market calms.”

『喔，』胡雪岩沉吟了好一会儿说道∶『这十之三四的现银，也要想个法子，早点让它回到市面上。
Hu thought for a long time. “We must find a way to bring that thirty or forty per cent back sooner.

你开个单了给我，看哪几处地方，存款增加了。』
Give me a list of the places where deposits have increased.”

『我说过了，只要不是水路上的大码头，存款都比以前多。』
“As I said, everywhere except the major ports on navigable waterways.”


『那是怕中法一开仗，法国兵轮会到水路大码头。』
“People fear that French warships will reach those ports if war begins.

胡雪岩问∶『京里怎么样？』
What about Beijing?”

『加了很多，而且都是大数目。』
“Deposits have risen greatly, and in large amounts.

宓本常说∶『文中堂的三十万都提走了。不过，北京存了四十六万。』
Grand Secretary Wen withdrew all his three hundred thousand here, but deposited four hundred and sixty thousand in Beijing.”

文中堂便是前年升了协办大学士的刑部尚书文煜；
Wen was Wenyu, Minister of Punishments, promoted to assistant grand secretary two years earlier.

提三十万存四十六万，表示他对阜康的信心十足，胡雪岩自然深感安慰。
Withdrawing three hundred thousand but depositing four hundred and sixty thousand showed complete confidence in Fukang, and Hu was deeply reassured.

『难怪大家都想做官。』
“No wonder everyone wants to be an official.

胡雪晨说∶『他调到京里，也不过三、四年的工夫，倒又积了十六万银子了。』
He has been in Beijing only three or four years and has accumulated another hundred and sixty thousand.”

『不！』宓本常说∶『其中十万两是他的本家的。』
“No,” Mi corrected him. “A hundred thousand of it belongs to a member of his clan.”

『不管他了，
“Never mind.

总是他的来头。』胡雪岩又问∶『上海几十家钱庄，现银只有一百万，大家是怎么应付的呢？』
It all comes through him.” Hu asked, “With dozens of banks and only a million taels of ready silver, how is everyone managing?”

『全靠同心协力，在汇划上耍把戏。』
“Entirely by working together and juggling the clearing accounts.”

『喔，』
“Oh?”

胡雪岩从受知于左宗棠开始，一面要办西征粮台；一面又创办了好些事业，
Since gaining Zuo’s patronage, Hu had managed the western expedition’s supply office and founded many enterprises.

而且做生意的兴趣，集中在丝上，对于钱庄的经营，差不多完全交给宓本常主持，
His commercial interest had centred on silk, while banking was left almost wholly to Mi.

钱庄的制度，有所改变，亦很隔膜，『汇划』上能够，『耍把戏』，却不甚明白。
He had little knowledge of changes in its practices and did not quite understand what “juggling” the clearing accounts meant.

在过去，他可以不求甚解，
Once he might have been content with a vague idea.

现在出现了危机，他就非问问清楚不可了。
Now that a crisis had arisen, he must understand it fully.


『说穿了，一句话∶等于常在一起打牌的朋友一样，
“Put simply, it is like friends who play cards together regularly.

赌得再大，不过赌筹码，
However large the stakes, they use counters.

今天我输他赢，明天你赢他输，
I lose and he wins today; you win and he loses tomorrow.

听起来很热闹，无非数数筹吗，记一笔帐，到时候结一结就轧平了。
It sounds lively, but all we do is count the counters and make entries, settling the balance at the proper time.

不过，这只好常常在一起的朋友这么办，
It works only among regular friends.

夹一个外头人进来，赢了一票，要拿现款走；这个把戏就耍不下去了。
Let an outsider join, win a large sum and demand cash, and the trick cannot continue.

所以┅┅『所以上海的钱庄，由阜康领头，联络了十来家』大同行『，成立了一个』汇划总会『，
So—” Thus Fukang had taken the lead in joining with a dozen or so of Shanghai’s major banks to establish a clearing association.

仿照日本在明治十二年所设立的』手形交换所『的办法，用交换票据来代替现银收解。
Following the model of the bill-exchange institution founded in Japan in the twelfth year of Meiji, they exchanged notes instead of transferring silver.

票据交换，不能私下办理，一定要送总会；
The exchange could not be conducted privately; everything had to go through the association.

凡是汇划钱庄，到期的银票，一律先送总会，
Participating banks first sent all maturing notes there.

分门别类理齐，派老司务送到各钱庄『照票』。
These were sorted, and senior clerks took them to the issuing banks for verification.

如果不误，这家钱庄便将银票收了下来，另外打出一张收据，名为『公单』，
If correct, a bank accepted its notes and issued a receipt called a “public clearing certificate”.

规定以五百两为基数，
These used five hundred taels as the basic unit.

不足五百两，或用现金找补，或者记帐另外再算。
Smaller amounts were either made up in cash or entered separately for later settlement.

这些『公单』大概在下午三、四点钟，都已集中到总会，
By three or four in the afternoon, the certificates had generally all reached the association.

算盘一打，立刻可以算出哪家该收多少、该付多少；
A few calculations on the abacus showed what each bank should receive or pay.

譬如，阜康应收各庄银票共计一百万，本号开出的银票只有八十四万，有十六万头寸多。
Suppose Fukang held a million taels in notes due from other banks, while only eight hundred and forty thousand of its own notes were presented: it had a surplus balance of a hundred and sixty thousand.



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第五章（本章第2部分，共3部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


有多就有少，
Where one bank had a surplus, another had a deficit.

由总会开出『划条』交阜康向欠头寸的钱庄先收现银。时间规定是在第二天下午两点钟以前。
The association issued a transfer order authorising Fukang to collect silver from a bank short of funds, with payment due before two the following afternoon.

那么，缺头寸的钱庄怎么办呢？
What could the bank in deficit do?

不要紧，第二天上午可以到公会向有头寸多的同行去拆进，
No matter: the next morning it could borrow through the association from another bank with a surplus.

利息以日计，称为『银拆』这种一两天的同业借款，不必打收据，由公会记一笔帐就可以了。
Interest was calculated by the day, the transaction being called a “silver loan”. Such interbank advances for a day or two required no receipt, only an entry in the association’s books.

至于利息的计算，又分两种，
There were two methods of charging interest.

不打收据的拆借，称为『活拆』，利息高低视银根松紧而定。
Loans without receipts were “floating advances”, their rates rising and falling with the money market.

另外一种同业长期的拆借，称为『呆拆』，要立票据，议定利息；在此期间，不受每天挂牌的『银拆』的影响。
Longer interbank loans were “fixed advances”, supported by written instruments at an agreed rate, unaffected by the daily quotation.

『这种打「公单」的法子，就好象赌钱发筹码，
“Issuing public clearing certificates is like handing out gambling counters,” Mi explained.

所不同的是，
“There are two differences.

第一，赌场的筹码，只有头家可以管；公单只要是汇划钱庄，家家可开。
First, only the house controls a casino’s counters, while every participating bank can issue these certificates.

第二，赌场的筹码，不能拿到外面去用，
Second, casino counters cannot be spent outside.

公单可以化成本号的银票，到处可用。
A clearing certificate can be converted into the bank’s own notes and used anywhere.

说实了，无非无中生有，凭空生出几千万银子来；
In plain terms, it creates something from nothing—tens of millions of taels out of thin air.

所以现银不过一百万，市面上的大生意照样在做。
That is why great transactions continue even though there is only a million in actual silver.

这就是要汇划的把戏。』
That is the clearing trick.”

接下来便谈到丝茧的情形。
They then turned to silk and cocoons.

丝茧业下乡收值，多仰赖钱庄放款，
Buyers going into the countryside depended largely on bank loans.

胡雪岩也就因为有钱庄在手里，所以成为丝业领袖，
Hu’s control of a bank had helped make him a leader of the silk trade.

这两年因为抵制新式缫丝厂，收的茧子与丝更多。
During the past two years, his campaign against modern reeling mills had led him to buy still more cocoons and silk.

宓本常虽非胡雪岩经营丝业方面的档手，但可以从各联号存放款进出的总帐中，看出存货有多少。
Mi did not manage the silk business, but could judge the size of its stocks from the consolidated records of deposits and loans at the branches.


『大先生，』宓本常神情严肃地说∶『现在存丝总有六七千包，茧子更多，
“Sir,” Mi said gravely, “there must now be six or seven thousand bales of silk in stock, and still more cocoons.

我看用不着这么多存货。』
I do not think we need so much.”

『你是说吃本太重？』
“You mean too much capital is tied up?”

『是啊。』
“Yes.

宓本常说∶『粗估一估差不多有三百万银子的本钱压在那里。
At a rough estimate, nearly three million taels are immobilised there.

不是因为这样子，古先生的十万银子，我也不好意思来讨。』
Otherwise I would be ashamed to press Mr Gu for his hundred thousand.”

『呃！』胡雪岩立即接口∶『这十万银子转到我名下。』
“Ah!” Hu answered at once. “Transfer those hundred thousand to my account.”

他紧接着又转脸对古应春说∶『另外的，再想办法。
He turned to Gu. “We shall find a way with the rest.

好在你有地皮在那里，
You have the land, after all.

不过现金一时周转不开而已。』
It is only a temporary shortage of cash.”

古应春满怀忧虑一扫而空；但自己虽不愁了，又为胡雪岩发愁，
Gu’s own anxiety vanished, but concern for Hu took its place.

『小爷叔，』他说∶『现在三家缫丝厂都缺货，
“Little Uncle, all three reeling mills are short of material.

你何妨放几千包茧子出去；
Why not release a few thousand bales of cocoons?

新式机器，做丝快得很，
The new machines work very quickly.

一做出来，不愁外洋没有买主，
Once the silk is made, there will be no shortage of foreign buyers.

那一来不就活络了？』
Would that not get things moving?”

『古先生这话一点不错。』宓本常也说，
“Mr Gu is quite right,” Mi said.

『今年「洋庄」不大动，是外国人都在等，等机器的丝，
“The export buyers have been inactive this year because the foreigners are waiting for machine-reeled silk.

凭良心说，机器做的丝，比脚踏手摇土法子做的丝，不知道要高明多少。』
In fairness, it is far superior to what our old foot-driven and hand-turned methods produce.”

『我也晓得。』胡雪岩用低沉的声音说∶『不过，做人总要讲宗旨，更要讲信用，说一句算一句，
“I know,” Hu said quietly. “But a man must have principles, and above all he must keep his word.

我答应过的，不准新式缫丝厂来抢乡下养蚕做丝人家的饭碗，
I promised not to let modern mills steal the livelihood of country families who raise silkworms and reel silk.

我就不能卖茧子给他们。
I cannot sell them cocoons.

现在我手里再紧一紧，这三家机器缫丝厂一倒，外国人没有想头了，
If I tighten my grip a little longer and those three mills collapse, the foreigners will have nothing to wait for.

自然会买我的丝，那时候价钱就由我开了。
They will buy my silk, and then I shall name the price.”

『古应春与宓本常，都认为他打的如意算盘。
Both Gu and Mi thought this wishful calculation.

不过，古应春是好朋友的身分，而宓本常是伙计，所以只有古应春还可以劝他。
But Gu was a close friend, Mi an employee; only Gu could continue trying to persuade him.


『小爷叔，如果那三家新式缫丝厂倒闭了洋商当然只好仍旧买我们土法子做的丝；
“Little Uncle, if the three mills close, foreigners will naturally have to buy our traditionally reeled silk.

可是那三家厂不倒呢？』
But what if they do not close?”

『不倒而没有货色，跟倒了有啥两样？』
“If they have no material, what difference does staying open make?”

『还有一层，小爷叔要想到，
“There is something else to remember.

茧子虽然烘干了，到底也还是摆不长的。
Dried cocoons still cannot be stored indefinitely.

一发黄就卖不起价钱了。』
Once they yellow, they lose their value.”

『这话是不错。
“True.

不过，你说上海现银不到一百万，
But you say Shanghai has less than a million taels of silver.

我就放茧子出去，也换不出现银。』
Even if I release the cocoons, I cannot turn them into cash.”

『有英镑、有花旗票就可以了。』宓本常接口来个快，
“Sterling or American notes would do,” Mi put in quickly.

『譬如说，现在要还汇丰五十万，
“For example, you owe HSBC five hundred thousand.

如果大先生有卖茧子的外国钱在汇丰，就可以折算给他，
If the foreign currency from selling cocoons were deposited there, it could be converted and credited against that sum.

收进五十万现银，周转不就活络了？』
Bringing in five hundred thousand in silver would free up our funds, would it not?”

胡雪岩沉吟了一会说∶『为了维持我的信用，只好抛茧子，这话我说得响的。
Hu considered. “If I must sell cocoons to preserve my credit, that is a reason I can stand behind.

明天我去看邵小村，看看这五十万两银子，到底收得齐收不齐？
Tomorrow I shall see Shao Xiaocun and find out whether the full five hundred thousand can be collected.

如果银数不够，决定照你们的办法，卖茧子来拿它补足。
If it falls short, I shall follow your proposal and sell cocoons to make up the difference.

不然，我另有主意。』
Otherwise, I have another idea.”

『小爷叔，你是啥主意？』
“What idea?”

胡雪岩笑笑，
Hu smiled.

『天机不可泄漏。』
“Heaven’s secrets cannot be revealed.

他说，『是蛮狠的一着。』
It is a rather ruthless move.”


吃完了饭，宓本常告辞，古应春却留了下来，
After dinner, Mi took his leave, but Gu stayed.

因为胡雪岩刚到上海，尚未露面，
Hu had only just arrived in Shanghai and had not yet appeared publicly.

到第二天消息一传，应酬就会忙不过来，那时候就没有工夫细谈了。
Once the news spread tomorrow, social obligations would leave no time for a long conversation.

当然胡雪岩也要跟他谈谈近况，
Hu too wanted to hear his recent news.

第一个关切的是七姑奶奶，
His first concern was the Seventh Lady.

『怎么样？』他问∶『七姐好点了？』
“How is Seventh Sister? Any better?”

『好得多了。』
“Much better.”

古应春的神气不同了，显得很有生气的模样，
Gu’s expression brightened.

『本来右半身完全瘫了，
“Her whole right side was paralysed.

现在有点知觉了。』
Now some feeling has returned.”

『那好！
“Good!

说不定还会复原呢！』
Perhaps she may recover completely.”

这一说，使得古应春很不安，只好老实说了，
This made Gu uneasy, and he had to speak frankly.

『小爷叔，我心里有个疙瘩，
“Little Uncle, something troubles me.

从瑞香一进门，没有几天就有消息。顾林在英国女皇的行宫外面，从马上摔下来，把脑子摔坏了。』
Only a few days after Ruixiang entered our household, the news came that Gulin had fallen from his horse outside the British queen’s country palace and injured his brain.”

他迟疑着说∶『我怕她跟我八字上不大相配。』
He hesitated. “I fear her birth signs may not agree with mine.”

『！』胡雪岩大不以为然，
Hu strongly disagreed.

『你蛮洋派的人，
“You are so Western in your ways.

怎么也相信这个。
How can you believe that?

要不然，你拿你们两个人的八字，叫吴铁口去合一合看。』
If necessary, take both sets of birth particulars to Wu Ironmouth and let him compare them.”

提到吴铁口，不免令人失笑；
Mention of Wu was enough to provoke a smile.

当初罗四姐去合八字，原是七姑奶奶跟他串好一的出双簧。
When Madam Luosi had once consulted him about birth signs, it had been a performance secretly arranged with the Seventh Lady.

胡雪岩也知道其中的奥妙，
Hu knew the trick.

竟真的相信吴铁口是真的铁口，岂非自欺欺人？
To believe Wu’s pronouncements genuinely infallible now would be deceiving himself and others.

『你笑点啥？』胡雪岩说∶『你当我荒唐？
“What are you smiling at?” Hu asked. “Do you think me ridiculous?

实在说一句∶假的说成真的，「真的是真的，那就是不折不扣的铁口。』听他说得象绕口令似的，古应春不由得笑了，
Let me say this: when a falsehood is made true, and the truth really is true, that is an infallible Ironmouth.” Gu laughed at the tongue-twister.

『好，好！
“Very well.

我听小爷叔的话，叫吴铁口去合她的八字，
I shall do as you say and ask him to compare her birth signs.

不过，』他说∶『她的八字我不晓得。』
But I do not know her birth particulars.”

『我来问她。』
“I shall ask her.”

『慢慢，
“Wait.

总要等阿七有了表示以后。』
We must first have some indication from A’qi.”

『当然。』
“Of course.

胡雪岩说∶『我明天看了七姐，包你当天就有好消息。』
Once I see Seventh Sister tomorrow, I guarantee good news that very day.”


『怎么？』
“What?

古应春问∶『小爷叔是打算当面她明说。』
Do you mean to speak to her directly?”

『当面是当面，不是明说。
“Face to face, yes; directly, no.

你到明天就晓得了。』
You will see tomorrow.”

『复原是办不到，
“Complete recovery is impossible.

只望她能够起床就好了。』古应春又说∶『谈到这一点，实在要谢谢瑞香。』
I only hope she can get out of bed,” Gu said. “For that, we really must thank Ruixiang.”

『对了！』
“Exactly!”

胡雪岩谈到他第二件关心的事，
Hu came to his second concern.

『七姐对瑞香怎么样？』
“How does Seventh Sister treat her?”

『那没有话说，
“There is nothing to complain of.

当她自己妹子一样。
Like her own younger sister.

当然这也一半是看罗四姐的面子。』
Of course, half of that is out of regard for Madam Luosi.”

『照这样说，应该是照她的锦囊妙计，一步一步走拢来；
“Then we should follow the ingenious plan she gave us, step by step.

七姐对你有没有表示？』
Has Seventh Sister said anything to you?”

『有。不过我没有答腔。』
“Yes, but I did not answer.”

『咦！』胡雪岩大为诧异∶『为啥？』
“Why?” Hu was astonished.

『小爷叔，你看我现在弄得这样焦头烂额，哪里还有讨小的意恳。』
“With my affairs in such a mess, Little Uncle, how could I think of taking a concubine?”

『这倒也是实话。』
“True enough.

胡雪岩问∶『阜康的十成旭不必再提了，你还差多少头寸？』
Leaving aside the hundred thousand at Fukang, how much more do you need?”

应春想了一下答说∶『还差十二、三万。』
Gu thought. “Another hundred and twenty or thirty thousand.”

『差点是现款，
“What you lack is cash.

能够变现就好。』
Anything you can turn into cash will serve.

胡雪岩说∶『我再借五百包丝给你，
I shall lend you five hundred bales of silk.

你洋行里的朋友多，总可以卖得掉。』
With all your friends in foreign firms, you should be able to sell them.”

古应春打的正是这个主意，踌躇好久，难于启齿，
This was precisely what Gu had hoped for but had long hesitated to ask.

不想胡雪岩自己说了出来；
Now Hu had offered it himself.

心里的那份感激与痛快，难以形容了。
Gu’s gratitude and relief were beyond description.

『小爷叔，你真是杭州人说的，是我的「救命王菩萨」。』
“Little Uncle, as we say in Hangzhou, you are my life-saving King Bodhisattva.

他说∶『我把道契都抵给你。』
I shall pledge all the title deeds to you.”


『不必，不必，
“No need.

我们弟兄何在乎此？
Between brothers, why trouble about that?

不过应春，你开价不能太低，
But you must not ask too low a price.

不然，有个盘口在那里，以后我就抬不高了。』
Once a market quotation is established, I cannot raise mine later.”

『是的。』
“Yes.”

古应春凝神想了一下说∶『这样，小爷叔，你索性再借两百包给我∶七面百丝抵押十四万银子，一定可以，
Gu thought carefully. “Then lend me another two hundred bales. I can certainly raise a hundred and forty thousand taels by pledging seven hundred bales.

那就什么都摆平了。』
That will settle everything.”

『好！
“Good.

光押不卖，就不算把行情压低。
Pledging without selling will not depress the market price.

准定如此。』胡雪岩紧接着说∶『你现在有心思想瑞香了吧？』
We shall do that.” Hu added immediately, “Now can you think about Ruixiang?”

这一点，古应春还是不能爽爽快快地答复；
Even so, Gu could not answer freely.

沉吟未答之际，胡雪岩少不得要追问了。
As he hesitated, Hu pressed him.

『这件事老太太都蛮关心的。罗四姐更不用说，
“My mother is concerned about this, and Madam Luosi even more so.

应春，你要晓得，不光是你，
Remember, Yingchun, it is not only you.

她对瑞香也要有个交代。』
She owes Ruixiang an answer too.”

第二天一大早，胡雪岩就到了古家。
Early the next morning, Hu went to the Gu household.

七姑奶奶已知道胡雪岩要来，叫瑞香替她栉发梳妆；
The Seventh Lady knew he was coming and had Ruixiang comb her hair and help her dress.

又关照预备菜留胡雪岩吃饭，大为兴奋。
She also ordered food prepared so that he could stay for a meal, and was much excited.


胡雪岩一来，当然请到病榻前面，
Hu was naturally shown straight to her sickbed.

『七姐，』他很高兴地说，『看起来精神是好得多了。』
“Seventh Sister,” he said gladly, “you do look much stronger.”

『是啊，
“Yes.

都要谢谢四姐。』
It is all thanks to Fourth Sister.”

『为啥？』
“Why?”

『不是四姐派了瑞香来帮我的忙，我不会好起来，
“If she had not sent Ruixiang to help me, I would never have improved.

小爷叔你看！』
Look, Little Uncle!”

七姑奶奶将右手提高了数寸，
She raised her right hand a few inches.

『现在手能够动了，
“I can move it now.

都是瑞香，一天给按摩多少遍。』
Ruixiang massages it so many times every day.”

『喔！』
“Oh!”

胡雪岩看一看瑞香，想要说话，却又住口，仿佛有难言之隐似的。
Hu glanced at Ruixiang as though about to speak, then stopped, suggesting something difficult to say.

七姑奶奶虽在病中，仍旧神智清明，察言辨色的本事一点也不差；
Though ill, the Seventh Lady remained clear-minded and as skilled as ever at reading faces.

殷殷地从胡老太太起，将胡雪岩全家大小都问到了。
She enquired warmly after everyone in Hu’s household, beginning with his mother.

直到瑞香离去，她才问道∶『小爷叔，刚才提到瑞香，你好象有话没有说出来。』
Only when Ruixiang had left did she ask, “Little Uncle, when we mentioned Ruixiang, you seemed to leave something unsaid.”


『是的。
“Yes.

我有句话，实在不想说，不过又非说不可。』
There is something I do not want to say, but must.”

『那么，小爷叔我们两家是一家，你说嘛！』
“Then say it. Our two families are one.”

『话句话是罗四姐要我带来的。』
“Madam Luosi asked me to bring this message.

胡雪岩说∶『瑞香是好人家出身，
Ruixiang comes from a respectable family.

他哥哥现在生意做得还不错，想把他妹子赎回去。』
Her brother’s business is doing fairly well now, and he wants to redeem her.”

『赎回去？』
“Redeem her?”

七姑奶奶脸色都变了，
The Seventh Lady’s expression changed.

『当初不是一百两银子卖到胡家的？』
“Was she not sold to your household for a hundred taels?”

『不是。
“No.

罗四姐弄不清楚，我也记不起来，
Madam Luosi was uncertain, and I could not remember.

捡出老契来一看，才知道当初是典的一百两银子，规定八年回赎；
We found the old contract and discovered that she had been pledged for a hundred taels, with redemption after eight years.

今年正好是第八年。』
This is the eighth.”

『那，四姐的意思呢？』
“What does Fourth Sister think?”

『四姐当然不肯，尤其听说在你这里还不错，更加不肯了。』
“Naturally she does not want to let her go, especially after hearing how well she is doing here.”

『四姐待我好。』
“Fourth Sister is good to me.”

七姑奶奶用殷切盼望的眼色看着胡雪岩说∶『她晓得我离不开瑞香，
The Seventh Lady looked at Hu with eager hope. “She knows I cannot do without Ruixiang.

应该替我想想办法。』
She ought to find a way for me.”

『办法何尝不想。
“She has tried.

不过，她哥哥说出一句话来，四姐就说不下去了。』
But her brother said something she could not answer.”

『喔，一句什么话。』
“What?”

『她哥哥说，要为她妹子的终身着想。
“He said he must consider his sister’s future.

意思是把瑞香赎回去，要替她好好寻个婆家。』
He means to redeem her and find her a good husband.”

『真的？』
“Really?”

看七姑奶奶是不信的语气，胡雪岩也就正好说活终话，
The disbelief in her voice gave Hu room to manoeuvre.

『哪晓得他是真是假？
“Who knows whether he means it?

不过，』他又把话说回来∶『男大当婚，女大当嫁，
Still,” he turned the argument back, “when men and women grow up, they should marry.

就算他是假话，也驳不倒他。
Even if he does not mean it, we cannot refute the reason.

三个人抬不过去一个理字。
Three men together cannot carry away a sound argument.

七姐，你说呢？』
What do you say, Seventh Sister?”


『依我说，』七姑奶奶微微冷笑，『小爷叔，你手下那么多人，莫非就不能派一个能干的去打听打听他哥哥的情形，
“I say,” she answered with a faint, cold smile, “that with so many people working for you, surely you can send someone capable to investigate her brother.

是真的为瑞香着想呢，还是说好听话，拿他妹子赎回去，另打主意？』
Is he really thinking of Ruixiang, or merely saying pleasant things so that he can redeem her for some other purpose?”

『打啥主意？』
“What purpose?”

『知人知面不知心。
“You can know a man’s face without knowing his heart.

照瑞香这份人材，在她身上好打的主意多得很。』
With Ruixiang’s looks and qualities, there are plenty of plans he might make for her.”

胡雪岩不作声，这是故意作出盘马弯弓的姿态，好逼七姑奶奶往深处去谈。
Hu said nothing, deliberately holding his horse and drawing his bow, as it were, to force her further into the subject.

七姑奶奶此时心事如麻，是为瑞香在着急；
The Seventh Lady’s thoughts tangled with anxiety for Ruixiang.

盘算了好一会，方又开口说道∶『小爷叔，你同四姐决不可以让瑞香的哥哥把她赎回去。
After considerable reflection she said, “You and Fourth Sister must not let him redeem her.

不然会造孽。』
It could be a terrible sin.”

『造孽？』
“A sin?”

胡雪岩故意装出吃惊的神气，
Hu feigned alarm.

『怎么会造孽？』
“How?”

『如果瑞香落了火坑，不就是造孽？』
“If she fell into the pit of fire, would that not be a sin?”

『七姐，』胡雪岩急急问说∶『你是说，她哥哥会把她卖到堂子里？』
“Do you mean,” Hu asked urgently, “that he might sell her to a brothel?”

『说不定。』
“He might.”

胡雪岩想了一下说∶『不会的。
Hu considered. “I do not believe so.

第一，瑞香不肯；
First, she would refuse.

第二，她哥哥也不敢。
Second, he would not dare.

如说我胡某某家的丫头，会落到堂子里；他不怕我办他一个「逼良为娼」的罪？』
If a maid from my household ended in a brothel, would he not fear my prosecuting him for forcing a respectable woman into prostitution?”

『到那时候就来不及了。
“By then it would be too late.

小爷叔，你既然想到你的面子，何不早点想办法？』
If your reputation concerns you, why not find a way now?”


『对！』胡雪岩很快地接口，
“Exactly!” Hu responded quickly.

『七姐，你倒替我想个法子看。』
“Suggest one for me.”

『法子多得很。
“There are plenty.

第一，同他哥哥去商量，
First, bargain with her brother.

再补他多少银子，重新立个卖断的契。』
Pay him more and draw up a new contract for outright sale.”

『不，不！这点没有用。』
“No, that would be useless.

胡雪岩说∶『如果有用，罗四姐早就办了。
If it could work, Madam Luosi would have done it already.

我不说过，人家生意做得蛮好，
Did I not say his business is doing well?

赎瑞香不是打钱的主意。』
He is not redeeming her for money.”

『好！
“Very well.

就算他不是打钱的主意，诚心诚意是为瑞香的终身；
Suppose he truly cares about her future.

不过，他替他妹子到底挑的是什么人家？
What sort of family has he chosen?

男家好不好要看一看；瑞香愿不愿意也要问一问。
We must see whether the man’s household is suitable, and ask whether Ruixiang is willing.

如果是低三下四的人家，瑞香又不愿意，小爷叔，那就尽有理由不让他赎回去了。』
If the family is disreputable and she unwilling, there is every reason to prevent her redemption.”

『这话——』胡雪岩不便驳她太武断，急转直下地说∶『我看，只有一个办法，
“Well—” Hu could hardly tell her how arbitrary that was, so changed direction. “I think there is only one course.

他为瑞香好，我们也是为瑞香好，
He wishes her well, and so do we.

替瑞香好好找份人家，
Let us find her a good marriage.

只要瑞香自己愿意，他哥哥也就没话说了。』
If she herself agrees, her brother can have nothing to say.”

七姑奶奶想了一下说∶『小爷叔，
The Seventh Lady considered.

我想请四姐来一趟，请她来劝一劝瑞香。』
“I should like Fourth Sister to come and persuade her.”

『劝啥？』胡雪岩答说∶『莫非我就不能劝她？』
“Persuade her of what? Could I not do it?”

『我怕小爷叔说话欠婉转；
“I fear you might not be tactful enough.

瑞香是怕你，
Ruixiang is afraid of you.

就肯答应，也是很勉强的。
Even if she agreed, it might be unwillingly.

这种事，一勉强就没有意思了。』
There is no point in forcing a matter like this.”

『什么事要瑞香答应？而且要心里情愿？
“What must she agree to, and willingly?

七姐，你何妨同我实说；
Tell me plainly.

你晓得的，我们家的丫头都不怕我的，
You know our maids are not afraid of me.

倒是对四姐，她们还有忌惮。』
If anything, they are more in awe of Madam Luosi.”

『即然如此，我就实说吧！
“Then I shall speak plainly.

小爷叔，我在瑞香来的第二天，心里就在转念头了，
On the second day after Ruixiang arrived, I began thinking of it.

我一直想替应春弄个人，要他看得上眼，要我也投缘，
I have always wanted to find someone for Yingchun, someone he would like and with whom I too would feel at ease.

象瑞香这样一个拿灯笼都寻不着的人，四姐替我送了来，我心里好高兴；
Fourth Sister sent me Ruixiang, a girl one could not find even by searching with a lantern, and I was delighted.

本想等小爷叔你，或者四姐来了，当面求你们，
I meant to wait until you or Fourth Sister came and ask in person.

哪知道其中还有这么一层曲折，
Who could have imagined this complication?

真教好事多磨了。』
Good things meet so many obstacles.”

『七姐，你说实话，我也说实话。』胡雪岩很恳切地答道∶『我们也想到，你要有个好帮手，凡事能够放心不管，病才好得起来。
“Since you speak frankly, so shall I,” Hu answered earnestly. “We too thought you needed a good helper, someone to whom you could leave matters without worry, so that you might recover.

不过你们夫妻的感情，大家都晓得的，
But everyone knows the closeness between you and your husband.

这件事只有你自己来发动，我们决不好多说。
The initiative had to come from you; we could not say more.

如今七姐你既然这样说了，我同四姐没有不赞成的。
Now that you have spoken, Madam Luosi and I can only approve.

不过，这件事要三方面都愿意。』
But all three parties must agree.”

『哪三方面？』七姑奶奶抢着问说。
“Which three?” she asked quickly.


『你，应春，还有瑞香。』
“You, Yingchun and Ruixiang.

胡雪岩紧接着说∶『瑞香我来劝她；
I shall speak to Ruixiang.

我想，她一定也肯的？』
I think she will certainly agree.”

小爷叔，你怎么晓得她一定肯？
“How do you know?”

『『我们家常常来往的女太太，不管是亲戚，还是朋友，少说也有二、三十位，
“Among the ladies who visit our house, relatives and friends, there must be twenty or thirty at least.

一谈起人缘，瑞香总说∶』要算七姑奶奶「，
Whenever we speak of whom everyone likes best, Ruixiang always says, ‘The Seventh Lady.’

从这句话上，就可以晓得了？
That tells us enough, does it not?”

『胡雪岩编出来这套话，使得七姑奶奶面露微笑，双眼发亮，
Hu’s invented story brought a smile to her face and a brightness to her eyes.

显然大为高兴。
She was plainly delighted.

『七姐，』胡雪岩问说∶『现在我要提醒你了，你应该问一问应春愿意不愿意。』
“Now I must remind you to ask whether Yingchun is willing.”

『他不愿也要愿。』七姑奶奶极有把握地，
“Willing or not, he will have to be,” she said confidently.

『小爷叔你不必操心。』
“You need not worry.”

『不见得。』
“Not necessarily.”

胡雪岩摇摇头∶『去年他去拜生日，老太太问过他，
Hu shook his head. “When he came for my mother’s birthday last year, she asked him.

他说他决不想，
He said he would never consider it.

好好一个家，何苦生出许是非？
Why bring trouble into a happy home?

看来他作兴不肯讨小。』七姑奶奶『哈』一声笑了出来，
He may well refuse a concubine.” The Seventh Lady laughed aloud.

『世界上哪个男人不喜欢讨小？』
“What man in the world does not like the idea?

她说∶『小爷叔，你真当我阿木林？』
Do you really take me for an amulin?”

『阿木林』是洋场上新兴起来的一句俗语，傻瓜之意。
Amulin was a new expression in the foreign settlement, meaning a fool.

胡雪岩听她语涉讥嘲，只好报以窘笑。
At her mocking tone, Hu could only answer with an embarrassed smile.



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第五章（本章第3部分，共3部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


『倒是瑞香家里，小爷叔怎么把它摆平来？』
“But how will you settle matters with Ruixiang’s family, Little Uncle?”

『我想——』
“I think…”

胡雪岩边想边说∶『只有叫瑞香咬定了，不肯回去。
Hu considered as he spoke. “She must simply insist that she will not go back.

她哥哥也就没法子了。』
Then her brother can do nothing.”

『一点不错。
“Exactly.

小爷叔，请你去探探瑞香的口气，
Please sound her out.

只要她肯了，我会教她一套话，去应付她哥哥。』
If she agrees, I shall teach her what to say to her brother.”

于是，胡雪岩正好找个僻静的地方，先去交代瑞香；
Hu thus had an opportunity to find a quiet place and instruct Ruixiang first.

原是一套无中生有的假话，只要瑞香承认有这么一个哥哥，谎就圆起来了。
The whole story was an invention; so long as she acknowledged having such a brother, the lie would hold together.

至于为古应春作妾，是罗四姐早就跟她说通了的，就不必费辞了。
As for becoming Gu’s concubine, Madam Luosi had already secured her agreement, so no further persuasion was needed.


等吃完了饭，胡雪岩与古应春一起出门，
After the meal, Hu and Gu went out together.

七姑奶奶便将瑞香找了来，握着她的手悄悄问说∶『你们老爷跟你说过了？』
The Seventh Lady sent for Ruixiang, took her hand, and asked quietly, “Has your master spoken to you?”

瑞香想了一下才明白，
Ruixiang thought for a moment before understanding.

顿时脸红了，将头扭了过去说∶『说过了。』
Blushing, she turned her head away. “He has.”

『那末，你的意思怎么样呢？』
“And what do you think?”

瑞香很为难，
Ruixiang was embarrassed.

一则是害羞，再则是为自己留点身分，『愿意』二字怎么样也说不出口；
Shyness, and a wish to preserve some dignity, made it impossible to say she was willing.

迟疑了好一会才想起一句很含蓄也很巧妙的话∶『就怕我哥哥作梗。』
After a long hesitation, she found a discreet and ingenious answer. “I am only afraid my brother will object.”

『七姑奶奶大喜∶』这么说，你是肯了。
The Seventh Lady was delighted. “Then you agree!

『她说∶』瑞香，我老早就当你妹子一样了，
Ruixiang, I have long regarded you as a sister.

将来决不会薄待你。
I shall never treat you poorly.”

『』我晓得。
“I know.”

『瑞香的声音低得几乎听不见。
Ruixiang’s voice was scarcely audible.


七姑奶奶是真的怕瑞香觉得作妾委屈，
The Seventh Lady genuinely feared that Ruixiang might feel humiliated by becoming a concubine.

在胡雪岩跟她谈过此事以后，便叫小大姐把她的首饰箱取了来，拣了一只翡翠镯子、一只金刚钻戒藏在枕下，
After Hu spoke to her, she had asked the young maid to bring her jewel box and had selected a jade bracelet and a diamond ring, which she hid beneath her pillow.

此时便将头一侧说道∶『我枕头下面有个纸包，
Now she tilted her head towards it. “There is a paper packet under my pillow.

你把它拿出来。』
Take it out.”

枕下果然有个棉纸包，
Sure enough, there was a tissue-paper parcel.

一打开来，宝光耀眼，瑞香自然知道是怎么回事了。
The jewels flashed when Ruixiang opened it, and she naturally understood their purpose.

当然，她要将首饰交到七姑奶奶手里。
She handed them to the Seventh Lady.

『来！』七姑奶奶说∶『你把手伸过来。』
“Come, give me your hand.”

瑞香不肯，
Ruixiang resisted.

七姑奶奶便用另一只不甚方便的手，挣扎着要来拉她的手；
The Seventh Lady struggled to grasp it with her other, less mobile hand.

看那力不从心的模样，瑞香于心不忍，终于将手伸过去了。帮七姑奶奶的忙。
Unable to bear the sight of her helpless effort, Ruixiang finally offered her hand and helped her.

翠镯套上左腕；钻戒套入右手无名指，
The jade bracelet slipped over her left wrist, the diamond ring onto her right ring finger.

瑞香忍不住端详了一下，心头泛起一阵无可形容的兴奋。
She could not resist admiring them, and an indescribable excitement rose within her.

『妹妹！
“Little sister!

现在真是一家人了。』
Now we truly are one family.”


『七姑奶奶，这个称呼不敢当。』
“Seventh Lady, I do not deserve to be called that.”

『有啥不敢当，
“Why not?

我本来就一直拿你当妹子看待。』
I have always thought of you as my sister.

七姑奶奶又说∶『你对我的称呼也要改一改了。』
You must change what you call me too.”

『我，』
“I…”

瑞香窘笑道∶『我还不知道怎么改呢？』
Ruixiang smiled awkwardly. “I do not yet know what to call you.”

『一时不改也不要紧。』
“There is no hurry.

七姑奶奶接下来说∶『我们谈正经。
Now let us talk seriously.

将来你哥哥、嫂嫂来，我们当然也拿他们夫妇当亲戚看待。
When your brother and his wife come, we shall naturally treat them as relations.

眼前，你有没有想一想，怎么样应付他？』
But have you thought how to answer him?”

『我还没有想过。』
“Not yet.

瑞香迟疑地说∶『我想只有好好跟他商量。』
I suppose I can only reason with him,” she said hesitantly.

『商量不通呢？』
“And if he will not listen?”

『那，我就不晓得怎么说了。』
“Then I do not know what to say.”


『我教你。』
“I shall teach you.

七姑奶奶问道∶『《红楼梦》你看过没有？』
Have you read Dream of the Red Chamber?”

瑞香脸一红∶『我也不认识多少字。』
Ruixiang blushed. “I know so few characters.

她说∶『哪里能够看书？』
How could I read a book?”

『听总听人说过？』
“But you have heard people talk about it?”

『是的。』
“Yes.

瑞香答说∶『有一回听人说我们胡家的老太太，好比贾太君；
Once someone compared our Old Madam to Grandmother Jia.

我问我们大小姐贾太君是什么人，才知道出在《红楼梦》上。』
I asked our eldest young lady who Grandmother Jia was, and learned that she came from that book.”

『那末贾宝玉你总也知道？』
“Then you know Jia Baoyu?”

『贾宝玉、林黛玉、薛宝钗、王凤姐都听说过的。』
“I have heard of Jia Baoyu, Lin Daiyu, Xue Baochai, and Wang Xifeng.”

『袭人呢？』
“And Xiren?”

『不是怡红院里的丫头？』
“Is she not a maid in the House of Crimson Delights?”

『不错。
“Exactly.

袭人姓花，她的哥哥叫花自芳，也是要来赎他妹妹，
Her surname is Hua, and her brother, Hua Zifang, also wanted to redeem his sister.

袭人就说，当初是家里穷，把我卖到贾家，
Xiren said, ‘You sold me to the Jia family because we were poor.

即然如此，何苦现在又要把我赎回去？
Since that was so, why insist on buying me back now?’

我想，你也可以这样跟你哥哥说。
You can say the same to your brother.

如果他说，现在把你弄回去，是为你着想；你就问他当初又何以不为你着想！
If he says he is bringing you home for your own good, ask why he did not think of your good in the first place.

看他有什么话说？』
See what answer he can give!”

『嗯，嗯！』瑞香答应着，『我就这样子同他说。』
“Yes, I shall tell him that.”

『当然。我们还要送聘金。』
“Of course, we shall also pay a betrothal gift.”


『这一层，』瑞香抢着说∶『奶奶同我们老爷谈好了。』
“That,” Ruixiang interposed, “you have already settled with our master, Madam.”

无意中改了口，名分就算从此而定了。
Unconsciously, she had changed her form of address, and with it her new position was established.

胡雪岩去看邵友濂扑了个空，
Hu’s visit to Shao Youlian proved fruitless.

原来这天李鸿章从合肥到了上海，以天后宫为行馆，
Li Hongzhang had arrived that day from Hefei and taken up residence at the Temple of the Heavenly Empress.

邵友濂必须终日陪待在侧，听候驱遣。
Shao had to remain beside him all day, awaiting his commands.

非常意外的，胡雪岩并未打算去看李鸿章；而李鸿章却派人送了一封信到转运局去邀胡雪岩，请他第二天上午相晤；
Quite unexpectedly, although Hu had no intention of calling on Li, Li sent a letter to the Transport Bureau inviting him to meet the following morning.

信中并且说明，是为了『洋药』进口加税一事，有些意见想请他转达左宗棠。
It explained that he wished to convey certain views to Zuo through Hu concerning an increased import duty on “foreign medicine.”


『洋药进口加税，左大人去年跟我提过。
“His Excellency mentioned raising the duty last year,” Hu told Gu.

我还弄不清其中的来龙去脉，
“I still do not understand the background.

李合肥明天跟我谈起来，一问三不知，似乎不大好。』
It would look poor if I could answer none of Li’s questions tomorrow.

胡雪岩问古应春∶『我记得你有个亲戚是土行大老板，
I remember you have a relation who is a large opium merchant.

他总清楚吧？』
Surely he knows?”

他所说的是古应春的远房表叔，广东潮州人，姓曾，
He meant Gu’s distant maternal uncle, a native of Chaozhou in Guangdong surnamed Zeng.

开一家烟土行，牌号就叫『曾记』，规模极大，
His very large opium business traded as Zeng & Company.

曾老板是名副其实的『土财主』。
Mr Zeng was a wealthy dealer in the literal sense of “opium wealth.”

古应春跟他不大有来往，但为了胡雪岩，特地到南市九亩地去向他请教。
Gu seldom saw him, but for Hu’s sake made a special visit to Jiumudi in the southern district to seek his advice.


『实不相瞒，你问我，我还要问人。
“To be honest, if you ask me, I must ask someone else.

我们帐房吴先生最清楚。』曾老板说∶『胡大先生，我久已仰慕了，不过高攀不上；
Our accountant, Mr Wu, knows best,” Zeng said. “I have admired Mr Hu for years but never had the standing to approach him.

应春，你晓得的，我一个月吃三回鱼翅，
Yingchun, you know I eat shark’s fin three times a month.

今天碰得巧，
You have come on just the right day.

能不能请胡大先生来吃饭，
Could you invite Mr Hu to dinner?

由吴先生当面讲给他听，
Mr Wu could explain everything to him directly.

岂不省事？』
Would that not be simpler?”

『不晓得他今天晚上有没有应酬？』
“I do not know whether he has an engagement tonight.”

古应春因为胡雪岩不大愿意跟这些人来往，不敢代为答应，
Knowing that Hu did not much care to associate with such people, Gu would not accept on his behalf.

只说∶『我去试试看。』
“I shall see what I can do.”

于是曾老板备了个『全贴』交古应春带回。
Zeng prepared a full formal invitation for him to take back.

胡雪岩有求于人，加以古应春的交情，自无拒绝这理，
Since Hu sought a favour, and Gu was involved, there was no reason to refuse.

欣然许诺，而且带了一份相当重的礼去，是一支极大的吉林老山人参。
He gladly accepted and brought a substantial present: an exceptionally large root of old wild ginseng from Jilin.

曾老板自是奉如上宾，
Zeng treated him as an honoured guest.

寒暄恭维了好一阵，将帐房吴先生请了来相见，是个文质彬彬的中年人；
After prolonged compliments and civilities, he summoned the accountant, a cultivated middle-aged man.

谈起来才知道是秀才，
Conversation revealed that Wu was a licentiate.

在这烟土行当帐房，似乎太委屈了。
Accounting in an opium firm seemed a waste of his talents.


『鸦片是罂粟熬炼出来的。
“Opium is extracted from the poppy,” Wu began.

罂粟，中国从古就有的，出在四川，
“Poppies have existed in China since ancient times, particularly in Sichuan.

苏东坡四川人，他做的诗∶』道人劝饮鸡苏水，童子能煎罂粟汤「，
Su Dongpo, who came from Sichuan, wrote: ‘The Daoist urges a draught of mint; the boy can boil a poppy broth.’

汤里加蜜，是当调肺养胃的补药服的。
Honey was added, and it was taken as a tonic for the lungs and stomach.”

『『到底是秀才。』胡雪岩说道∶『一开口就是诗。』
“A scholar indeed!” Hu remarked. “His first words are poetry.”

『吴先生，』古应春说，『我们不必谈得这样远，
“Mr Wu,” Gu said, “we need not begin so far back.

光说进口的鸦片好了。』
Let us confine ourselves to imported opium.”

鸦片进口，最早在明朝成化年间；
Imports first arrived during the Chenghua reign of the Ming.

到万历年间，规定要收税，
By Wanli’s reign, a duty had been prescribed.

是当药材用的，鸦片治痢疾，万试万灵。
It was used medicinally, being considered unfailingly effective against dysentery.

不过明末清初，吸食鸦片是犯禁的，
Smoking it, however, was prohibited in the late Ming and early Qing.

而且当时海禁甚严鸦片亦很少进口，
Strict maritime restrictions also kept imports low.

到了康熙二十三年，放宽海禁，鸦片仍准当作药材进口，
In the twenty-third year of Kangxi, those restrictions were eased, and opium could again enter as a medicine.

收税不多，每十斤征税两钱银子。
The duty was slight: two mace of silver on every ten jin.

以后吸鸦片的人慢慢多了，雍正年间，曾下禁令。
As smoking gradually spread, Yongzheng issued a prohibition.

有句俗语∶『私盐愈禁愈好卖』，
But as the saying went, “The more illicit salt is forbidden, the better it sells.”

鸦片亦是如此，愈禁得严，走私的愈多；
Opium was the same: stricter prohibitions brought more smuggling.

从乾隆三十八年起，英国设立东印度公司，将鸦片出口贸易当作国家的收入，走私的情形就更严重了。
From the thirty-eighth year of Qianlong, when Britain established the East India Company and made opium exports a source of state revenue, smuggling became still worse.


走私的结果是『白的换黑的』，鸦片进口，白银出口。
The result was “white exchanged for black”: opium came in and silver went out.

乾隆三十年前，进口的鸦片不过两三百箱，
Before the thirtieth year of Qianlong, annual opium imports had amounted to only two or three hundred chests.

末年加到一千箱；
By the end of the reign they reached a thousand.

道光初年是四千箱，十年工夫加到两万三千多箱，
At the beginning of Daoguang they stood at four thousand, increasing within ten years to over twenty-three thousand.

至于私运白银出口，道光三年以前，不过数百万两，到道光十八年增加到三千万两，
Before Daoguang’s third year, the silver smuggled out amounted to only a few million taels; by his eighteenth year it had risen to thirty million.

这还是就广东而言，
That figure concerned Guangdong alone.

此外福建、浙江、山东、天津各海口亦有数千万两，
Tens of millions more left through ports in Fujian, Zhejiang, Shandong, and Tianjin.

国家命脉所关，终于引起了鸦片战争。
The country’s economic lifeblood was at stake, and the Opium War followed.

『至于正式开禁抽税，则在咸丰七年。』吴秀才说，
“Formal permission to import and tax it came in the seventh year of Xianfeng,” Wu continued.

『当时是闽浙总督王懿德，说军需紧要，暂时从权，
“Wang Yide, then governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang, pleaded urgent military needs and temporary expediency.

朝迁为了洪杨造反，只好允许。
Faced with the Taiping rebellion, the court could only agree.

第二年跟法国定约。每百斤收进口税三十两，
A treaty with France followed the next year, fixing the import duty at thirty taels per hundred jin.

鸦片既然当作药材进口，所以称做「洋药」；在云南、四川出产的，就叫「土药」，
Since it entered as medicine, imported opium was called ‘foreign medicine’; that grown in Yunnan and Sichuan was ‘native medicine.’

不论洋药、土药在内地运销，都要收厘捐，那跟进口税无关。』
Both paid likin when transported and sold inland, quite separately from the import duty.”

但左宗棠却认『税』跟『厘』实际上是一回事，
Zuo, however, considered customs duty and likin effectively the same.

主张寓禁于征，每百斤共收一百五十两。
He advocated restraining consumption through taxation, charging a combined hundred and fifty taels per hundred jin.

胡雪岩拿这一点向吴秀才请教，是分开征收的好，还是合并为宜。
Hu asked Wu whether separate collection or a consolidated charge was preferable.


以合并为宜。『吴秀才说∶』厘捐是从价征税，
“Consolidation is better,” Wu replied. “Likin is assessed on value.

土药便宜洋药贵，
Native opium is cheap, foreign opium expensive.

如果拿洋药冒充土药，税收就减少了。
If the foreign product is passed off as native, the revenue falls.”

『』不错、不错。
“Quite right.

这个道理很浅，也很透彻；不过不懂的人就想不到。
A simple and clear principle, yet someone unfamiliar with the trade would never think of it.”

『胡雪岩很高兴地说∶』多谢、多谢，
Hu was pleased. “Thank you.

今天掉句文真叫「获益良多」。
To borrow a literary phrase, I have ‘benefited greatly.’”

『胡雪岩有个习惯，每到上海，一定要到宝善街一家叫渭园的茶馆去吃一次茶；而且一定带足了十两二十两的银票一这是他本性仁厚、不忘老朋友的一点心意。
Whenever he came to Shanghai, Hu made a point of visiting Weiyuan Teahouse on Baoshan Street, carrying plenty of banknotes in denominations of ten and twenty taels. It was an expression of his kindness and fidelity to old friends.

他有许多朋友，境况好的在长三堂子吃花酒见面；
Those doing well he met over wine in the high-class courtesan houses.

在谓园见到的，大臻境况并不太好，
Those he saw at Weiyuan were generally less fortunate.

问问的近况，量人所需，捍两张银票在手里，悄悄塞了过去；
He asked after their circumstances and, according to their needs, quietly slipped a couple of notes into their hands.

见不到的他会问，一样也托人带钱去接济，
He also inquired after absent friends and sent assistance through others.

所以他有好几个老朋友，经常会到阜康或者转运局去打听∶』胡大先生来了没有？『
Several old acquaintances therefore regularly called at Fukang or the Transport Bureau to ask whether Mr Hu had arrived.


这天到渭园来的老朋友很多，大多是已经打听好了来的一一周旋，不知不觉到了十点钟；
There were many old friends at Weiyuan that day, most having learned of his visit beforehand. As Hu greeted them one after another, ten o’clock arrived unnoticed.

古应春提醒他说∶『小爷叔，你的辰光快到了，
Gu reminded him, “It is almost time, Little Uncle.

这个约会不能耽误。』
You must not be late for this appointment.”

李鸿章的约会怎好误时？
Naturally Hu would not keep Li waiting.

胡雪岩算好了的，约会是十一点钟，从渭园到天后宫，不过一刻钟的工夫，
He had calculated carefully: the appointment was at eleven, and the temple was only a quarter of an hour from Weiyuan.

尽来得及。
There was ample time.

『还早，还早！』
“Still early!”

『不，小爷叔，我们先到转运局坐一坐，』
“No, let us go to the Transport Bureau first.

古应春说∶『刚才我在这里遇见一个朋友，打听到一个蛮要紧的消息，
I met a friend here who gave me some important news.

要先跟你谈一谈。』
We ought to discuss it.”

『好！
“Very well.

我本来要到转运局去换衣服。』
I intended to change there anyway.”

胡雪岩不再逗留，相偕先到转运局，在他的『签押房』中密谈。
They went together and conferred privately in Hu’s office.

『我在谓园遇见海关上的一个朋友，据他告诉我，各省的款子大致都到了，
“A friend from the customs told me that nearly all the provincial remittances have arrived.

就少也极有限。
Any shortfall is small.

不过，听说邵小村打算把这笔现银压一压，
But apparently Shao Xiaocun means to hold the silver back for a while.

因这一阵「银拆」大涨，他想套点利息。』
Short-term silver rates have risen sharply, and he wants to earn some interest.”

胡雪岩点点头，沉吟了一会说∶『套利息也有限，
Hu nodded and considered. “The interest cannot amount to much.

邵小村还不致于贪这点小利；
Shao is hardly so greedy for a small profit.

说不一定另外有花样在内。』
There may be another scheme behind it.”

不管他什么花样，这件事要早点跟他去接头。
“Whatever it is, we ought to approach him soon.”

『』不！
“No.

『胡雪岩说∶』他如果要耍花样，迟早都一样，
If he means to play tricks, the timing makes no difference.

我就索性不跟他谈了。
I shall simply not approach him.”

『』那！『古应春诧异∶』小爷叔你预备怎么办呢？
“Then what do you intend to do?” Gu asked in surprise.

『』我主意还没有定。
“I have not decided.

『胡雪岩说∶』到天后宫回来再商量。『
We shall discuss it after I return from the temple.”


换了公服，到天后宫递上手本。
Hu changed into official dress and presented his card at the temple.

李鸿章关照先换便衣相见；
Li asked him to change into informal clothes before meeting.

他本人服丧，穿一件淡蓝竹布长衫，上套黑布马褂，
Still in mourning, Li wore a pale-blue bamboo-cloth robe and a black cloth riding jacket.

形容颇为憔悴。
He looked worn and haggard.

胡雪岩自然有一番慰问∶李鸿章还记得他送了一千两银子的奠议，特地道谢，
Hu naturally offered condolences. Remembering Hu’s funeral gift of a thousand taels, Li thanked him specially.

又说礼太重，但又不便退回，只好捐了给善堂。
It had been too generous, he said, but as returning it would have been awkward, he had donated it to a charitable institution.

寒暄了好一阵，方始谈入正题。
After lengthy civilities, they turned to business.

『鸦片害人，由来已久。
“Opium has caused harm for a long time.

不过洋药进口税是部库收入的大宗，
But its import duty is a major source of revenue for the ministry’s treasury.

要说寓禁于征，不如说老实话，还是着眼在增加税收上面，
Instead of claiming that taxation will restrain consumption, we should speak frankly: what matters is increasing revenue.

来得实惠。』
That is the practical approach.”

一开口便与左宗棠的宗旨相悖，
His opening directly contradicted Zuo’s principle.

胡雪岩无话可说，只能答应一声∶『是。』
Hu could say nothing beyond an acknowledgment.


『增加税收，加税不是好办法；
“Higher rates are not the best way to increase revenue.

要拿偷漏的地方塞住，才是正本清源之计。』李鸿章又说∶『同治十一年上海新行洋药税章程，普鲁士的领事反对，说加厘有碍在华洋商贸易。
Plugging the leaks is the fundamental remedy,” Li continued. “When Shanghai introduced new opium regulations in the eleventh year of Tongzhi, the Prussian consul protested that additional likin obstructed foreign trade in China.

这话是说不通，
That argument was unreasonable.

加厘是我们自己的事，与缴纳进口税的洋商何干？
Likin was our affair; what did it have to do with foreign merchants paying import duty?

当时总署驳了他；
The Zongli Yamen rejected his objection.

不过赫德说过，厘捐愈重，走漏愈甚，
But Hart pointed out that heavier likin meant more smuggling.

私货的来路不明，正当的洋商生意也少了。
With contraband entering through obscure channels, legitimate foreign merchants also lost business.

所谓加厘有碍在华洋商贸易，倒也是实话。』
In that sense, the claim that higher likin harmed foreign trade was true.”

『是。』胡雪岩答说∶『听说私货都是香港来的。』
“I hear the contraband comes from Hong Kong,” Hu said.

『一点不错。』
“Exactly.

李鸿章说∶『我这里有张单子，你可以看看。』
Here is a statement you may examine.”

说着，从炕桌上随手拿起一张纸，递了过来。
Li took a sheet from the low table on the kang and handed it over.

胡雪岩急忙站起，双手将单子接了过来，回到座位上去看。
Hu rose hastily, received it with both hands, and sat down to read.

单子上写明∶从同治十三年至光绪四年，到香港的洋药，每年自八万四千箱至九万六千箱不等，但运销各口，有税的只有六万五千箱到七万一千箱。
From the thirteenth year of Tongzhi to the fourth of Guangxu, between eighty-four thousand and ninety-six thousand chests of foreign opium had reached Hong Kong annually; only sixty-five thousand to seventy-one thousand subsequently entering the various ports had paid duty.

光绪五年到港十万七千箱，有税的只有八万六千箱，
In Guangxu’s fifth year, a hundred and seven thousand arrived at Hong Kong, but only eighty-six thousand paid duty.

每年走私进口的，总在两万箱以上。
Every year, smuggled imports exceeded twenty thousand chests.

『洋药进口税每箱收税三十两，厘捐额定二十两，地方私收的不算，
“Import duty is thirty taels per chest, and the fixed likin twenty, apart from unofficial local charges.

合起来大概每箱八十两。
Altogether it comes to roughly eighty taels a chest.

私货有两万箱，税收就减少一百六十万。』
Twenty thousand smuggled chests mean a revenue loss of one million six hundred thousand taels.”

李鸿章急转直下地说∶『赫德现在答应税厘一起加，正税三十两以外，另加八十两；
Li changed direction abruptly. “Hart has now agreed to consolidate and raise the charges: eighty taels in addition to the regular thirty.

而且帮中国防止走私，
He will also help China prevent smuggling.

这个交涉也算办得很圆满了。』
These negotiations have produced a satisfactory result.”

『大人办洋务，当今中国第一。』胡雪岩恭维着说∶『赫德一向是服大人的。』
“No one in China handles foreign affairs better than you, Your Excellency,” Hu replied flatteringly. “Hart has always respected you.”


『洋人总还好办，
“Foreigners are manageable enough.

他们很厉害，不过讲道理，
They are formidable, but they listen to reason.

最怕自己人闹意气，
What troubles me most is personal rivalry among our own people.

我今天请你来就是为此。』
That is why I have asked you here.”

显然的这所谓自己人闹意气，是指左宗棠而言；
He plainly meant Zuo.

胡雪岩只好含含糊糊地答应一声，不表示任何意见。
Hu gave a vague acknowledgment without expressing an opinion.

『我想请你转达左爵帅，他主张税厘合征，每箱一百五十两。
“Please explain to Marquis Zuo: he advocates a combined charge of a hundred and fifty taels a chest.

赫德答复我说∶如果中国一定要照这个数目征，他也可以承认，不过他不能担保不走私。
Hart says he can agree if China insists, but cannot then guarantee the prevention of smuggling.

雪岩，就算每年十万箱，其中私货两万五千箱，
Xueyan, suppose annual imports are a hundred thousand chests, of which twenty-five thousand are smuggled.

你倒算算这笔帐看。』
Calculate the difference.”

胡雪岩心算极快。
Hu calculated quickly.

十万箱乘一百十两，应征一千一百万两银子；
A hundred thousand chests at a hundred and ten taels yielded eleven million taels.

照一百五十两征税，七万五千箱应征一千一百二十五万两，仍旧多出二十五万两银子。
Seventy-five thousand taxed at a hundred and fifty yielded eleven million two hundred and fifty thousand—still two hundred and fifty thousand more.

『二十五万两银子是小事，
“Two hundred and fifty thousand is a small matter.

防止走私，关系甚大；
Preventing smuggling is far more important.

有赫德保证，我们的主权才算完整。
Only with Hart’s guarantee can our sovereignty be complete.

不然以后走私愈来愈多，你跟他交涉，他说早已言明在先，歉难照办。
Otherwise, when smuggling grows and we remonstrate, he will say he warned us and can do nothing.

你又其奈他何。
What answer shall we have?

所以请你劝劝左爵帅，不必再争。
Please persuade Marquis Zuo not to dispute the matter further.

『李鸿章又说∶』目前局势不好，强敌压境，
The present situation is poor, with powerful enemies pressing upon us.

我们但求交涉办得顺利，好把精力工夫，用到该用的地方。
We need smooth negotiations so that our energy and time can go where they are needed.

雪岩，你觉得我的话怎么样？
What do you think?”

『』大人为国家打算，真是至矣尽矣，
“Your consideration for the country could not be more thorough.

左大人那里我一定切切实实去劝，
I shall certainly impress this upon His Excellency Zuo.

他也一定体谅大人的苦心的。
He will appreciate your pains.”

『』这就仰仗大力了。『
“Then I must rely upon your assistance.”


『言重、言重！』
“You are too kind.”

胡雪岩掌握机会，转到自己身上的事∶『不过，说到对外交涉上头，尤其是现在我们要拉拢英国对付法国，有件事要请大人作主。』
Hu seized the opportunity to introduce his own concern. “Speaking of foreign dealings, particularly now that we need British support against France, there is something on which I must ask your help.”

『喔！』李鸿章问∶『什么事？』
“What is it?”

『汇丰的借款，转眼就到期，
“The HSBC loan will soon fall due.

听说各省应解的协饷，差不多都汇到了，即使相差也有限。
I hear nearly all the provincial military subsidies have arrived; any shortfall must be small.

我想求大人交付小村，把这笔款子早点拨出来，如果稍为差一点，亦请小村那里补足。
Would you instruct Xiaocun to release the funds promptly and make up any slight deficiency?

现在上海市面上现银短缺，
Ready silver is scarce in Shanghai.

只有请海关拿库存现银放出来调剂调剂。
Only the customs can ease matters by releasing some of its reserves.

小村能帮这个忙，左大人一定也领情的。
If Xiaocun helps, His Excellency Zuo will appreciate it too.”

『』我来问问小村。
“I shall ask him.”

『李鸿章的话说得很漂亮，』都是公事，都是为国家，
Li put it admirably: “It is all public business, all for the country.

理当无分彼此。
There should be no distinction between your side and mine.”

『话漂亮，而且言行相符；
His actions matched his words.

当天下午，胡雪岩就接到邵友濂的信，说各省应解款项只收到四十七万，不送之数奉谕暂垫，
That afternoon Hu received a letter from Shao: only four hundred and seventy thousand taels of provincial remittances had arrived, but he had been instructed to advance the balance.

请他派人去办理提款手续。
Hu should send someone to arrange withdrawal.


『还款是在月底。』宓本常很高兴地说，
“Repayment is not due until the end of the month,” Mi Benchang said happily.

『这笔头寸有几天可以用，
“We can use these funds for a few days.

这几天的「银拆」很高，小小赚一笔。』
With silver rates so high, there is a small profit to be made.”

『不必贪小。』
“Do not chase a petty gain.”

胡雪岩另有打算，
Hu had another plan.

『你明天去办个转帐的手续，
“Arrange a transfer tomorrow.

请他们打汇丰的票子，原票转帐，掉回印票，
Ask them to draw a draft on HSBC, transfer that draft directly, and recover the sealed voucher.

做得漂亮点。』
Let us make a handsome job of it.”

宓本常是俗语说的『铜钱眼里翻跟斗』的人物，
Mi was a man who could, as the saying went, turn somersaults through a cash coin’s hole.

觉得胡雪岩白白牺牲了利息，未免太傻。不过东家交代，惟有遵命。
He thought Hu foolish to sacrifice the interest, but his employer’s instructions had to be obeyed.

第二天一早就把转收的手续办妥当，领回了盖有陕甘总督衙门关防的印票。
Early the next morning he completed the transfer and brought back the voucher bearing the official seal of the governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.

胡雪岩便将印票注销，交代转运局的文案朱师爷，写信给左宗棠，
Hu cancelled it and instructed Secretary Zhu, the Transport Bureau’s drafting clerk, to write to Zuo.

报告还款经过以外，将李鸿章所托之事，切切实实叙明；最后特别提到，李鸿章很够意思，请左宗棠务必也买他一个面子。
Besides reporting the repayment, the letter was to set out Li’s request fully and emphatically, stressing in conclusion that Li had behaved generously and urging Zuo to return the courtesy.


这封信很要紧，胡雪岩亲自看着，
The letter was important, and Hu supervised its composition himself.

到下午四点多钟写完，
It was finished after four that afternoon.

正要到古家去看七姑奶奶，哪知古应春却先来了。『小爷叔，』他手里持着一份请柬，『汇丰的「康白度」曾友生，亲自送帖子来，托我转交，
Just as he was about to visit the Seventh Lady, Gu arrived with an invitation in his hand. “HSBC’s comprador, Zeng Yousheng, delivered this personally and asked me to bring it to you.

今天晚上请小爷叔吃饭，特别关照，请小爷叔务必赏光。』
He invites you to dinner tonight and particularly hopes you will come.”

『喔！』胡雪岩智珠在握，
Hu seemed to have the matter in hand.

首先问说∶『他还请了哪个？』
His first question was, “Who else is invited?”

『除了邀我作陪，没有别人。』
“Only me, to keep you company.”

『地方呢？』
“Where?”

『在虹口泰利。』
“At Taili in Hongkou.”

『那不是只有外国人去的馆子？』
“Is that not a restaurant frequented only by foreigners?”

『不错。』
“Yes.

古应春说∶『我想他为的是说话方便，特为挑这家中国人不去的法国菜馆。』
I think he chose this French restaurant, where Chinese people do not usually go, so that you could speak freely.”

『喔！』胡雪岩沉吟了一会，捻一捻八字胡子微笑道∶『看样子不必我开口了。』
Hu reflected, stroked his moustache, and smiled. “It seems I shall not have to raise the subject myself.”

『小爷叔，』古应春说，『你本来想跟他开口谈啥？』
“What had you intended to discuss with him?”

『你想呢？』
“What do you think?”

古应春仔细想了想说∶『我懂了。』
Gu considered carefully. “I understand.”



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第六章（本章第1部分，共2部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第六章
CHAPTER SIX


汇丰银行的买办曾友生，为人很势利，喜欢借洋人的势力以自重。
HSBC’s comprador, Zeng Yousheng, was a snob who liked to bolster his own importance with foreign power.

他对胡雪岩很巴结，主要的原因是，胡雪岩跟汇丰银行的『大班』，不论以前是否认识，都可以排闼直入去打交道，
His attentiveness to Hu arose chiefly from the fact that Hu could walk straight into the bank manager’s office and deal with him directly, whether or not they had met before.

所以他不敢不尊敬；但胡雪岩却不大喜欢这个人，就因为他势利之故。
Zeng dared not withhold respect; Hu, however, disliked precisely this snobbery.

但这回他是奉了他们大班之命，
This time Zeng had come on his manager’s instructions.

来跟胡雪岩商量，刚收到五十万现银，需要『消化』，
The bank had just received five hundred thousand taels in ready silver and needed to put it to work.

问胡雪岩可有意借用？
Would Hu care to borrow it?

『现在市面上头寸很紧，
“Money is very tight in the market.

你们这笔款子可以借给别人，
You could lend it to someone else.

何必来问我这个做钱庄的？』
Why ask a banker like me?”

『市面上头寸确是很紧，不过局势不大好；
“Money is tight, certainly, but the situation is unfavourable.

客户要挑一挑。
We must choose our borrowers carefully.

论到信用，你胡大先生是天字第一号的金字招牌。』
For credit, your name stands above all others.”

曾友生陪着笑说∶『胡大先生，难得有这么一个机会，
Zeng smiled ingratiatingly. “Such an opportunity seldom comes, Mr Hu.

请你挑挑我。』
Please give me a helping hand.”

『友生兄，你言重了。
“You flatter me, Brother Yousheng.

汇丰的买办，只有挑人家的，
HSBC’s comprador is the one who helps others along.

哪个够资格来挑你？』
Who is qualified to help you?”

『你胡大先生就够。』
“You are.

曾友生说∶『真人面前不说假话，
There is no pretending with a man like you.

除了你，汇丰的款子不敢放给别人，
HSBC dares lend this money to no one else.

所以只有你能挑我。』
Only you can help me.”

『既然你这么说，做朋友能够帮忙的，只要我办得到，无不如命。
“Since you put it that way, I shall do whatever a friend can, so far as it lies within my power.

不过，我不晓得怎么挑法？』
But I do not understand what help you want.”


『无非在利息上头，让我稍稍戴顶帽子。』曾友生开门见山地说∶『胡大先生，这五十万你都用了好不好？』
“Only permission to add a little to the interest for myself,” Zeng said frankly. “Could you use the whole five hundred thousand?”

『你们怕风险，我也怕风险。』
“You fear risks, and so do I.”

胡雪岩故意问古应春∶『正中堂有二十万银子，一定要摆在我们这里，
Hu deliberately turned to Gu. “Minister Wang insists on depositing two hundred thousand taels with us.

能不能回掉他？』
Can we turn him down?”

古应春根本不知道他说的『王中堂』是谁？不过他懂胡雪岩的意思，是要表示阜康的头寸很宽裕，
Gu had no idea who this “Minister Wang” was, but understood the intention: Hu wanted to suggest that Fukang had ample funds.

便也故意装困惑地问∶『呀！小爷叔，昨天北京来的电报，你没看到？』
He therefore feigned puzzlement. “Did you not see yesterday’s telegram from Beijing?”

『没有啊！
“No.

电报上怎么说？』
What did it say?”

『王中堂的二十万银子，一半在北京，一半在天津，都存进来了。』
“Minister Wang’s two hundred thousand has already been deposited: half in Beijing and half in Tianjin.

古应春又加一句∶『莫非老宓没有告诉你？』
Has Mi not told you?”

『老宓今天忙得不得了，
“He has been terribly busy today.

大概忘掉了。』
He must have forgotten.”

胡雪岩脸看着曾友生说∶『收丝的辰光差不多也过了，
Hu looked at Zeng. “The silk-buying season is almost over too.

实在有点为难。』
This is rather difficult.”

『胡大先生，以你的实力，手里多个几十万头寸，也不算回事；
“With your resources, a few hundred thousand more would scarcely matter.

上海谣言多，内地市面不坏。
Shanghai is full of rumours, but business inland is sound.

加上五荒六月，青黄不接的时候，
Besides, the lean fifth and sixth months, between the old harvest and the new, are approaching.

阜康有款子，不怕放不出去，
If Fukang has funds, it need never fear being unable to lend them.

你们再多想一想看。
Think it over.

吃进这笔头寸，只有好处，没有坏处。』
Taking this money can only help you.”

胡雪岩点点头停了一下问道∶『利息多少？』
Hu nodded, paused, and asked the rate.


『一个整数。』曾友生说∶『不过我报只报八五。
“A round one,” Zeng said. “But I shall report only point eight-five to the bank.

胡大先生，这算蛮公道吧？』
That is fair enough, surely?”

『年息还是月息？』
“Annual or monthly?”

『自然是月息。』
“Monthly, of course.”

『月息一厘，年息就是一分二。
“One per cent a month means twelve per cent a year.

这个数目，一点都不公道。』
There is nothing fair about that.”

『现在的银根，胡大先生，你不能拿从前来比，
“You cannot compare present conditions with the old days.

而且分家借有扣头，
Besides, other lenders deduct something at the outset.

不比这笔款子你是实收。』
You will receive this sum in full.”

胡雪岩当然不会轻信他的话，但平心而论，这笔借款实在不能说不划算，
Hu did not readily believe him, but, considered fairly, the loan could hardly be called unattractive.

所以彼此磋磨，最后说定年息一分，半年一付；期限两年，到期得展延一年。
They bargained back and forth and finally agreed upon ten per cent a year, payable half-yearly, for a two-year term with an option to extend for another year.

至于对汇丰银行，曾友生要戴多少帽子，胡雪岩不问，只照曾友生所开的数目承认就是。
Hu did not ask what additional margin Zeng would arrange in his account with HSBC; he would simply acknowledge the figures Zeng presented.


胡雪岩原来就已想到要借汇丰这笔款子，而汇丰亦有意贷放给胡雪岩。
Hu had already intended to borrow this money, just as HSBC had intended to lend it to him.

彼此心思相同，
Their wishes coincided.

加以有胡雪岩不贪小利、提前归还这很漂亮的一着，汇丰的大班，愈发觉得胡雪岩确是第一等的客户，
His handsome gesture of repaying early instead of pursuing a small interest gain had strengthened the manager’s conviction that he was a first-class customer.

所以曾友生毫不困难地将这笔货款拉成功了，
Zeng therefore arranged the loan without difficulty.

利息先扣半年，
Six months’ interest was deducted in advance.

曾友生的好处，等款子划拨到阜康，胡雪岩自己打一张票子，由古应春转交曾友生，
Once the proceeds had been transferred to Fukang, Hu personally drew a draft for Zeng’s benefit and had Gu deliver it.

连宓本常都不知道这笔借款另有暗盘。
Even Mi knew nothing of this private side of the transaction.

司行中的消息很灵通，
News travelled quickly among bankers.

第二天上午城隍庙豫园的『大同行』茶会上，宓本常那张桌子上，热闹非凡，都是想来拆借现银的。
At the senior bankers’ gathering in Yuyuan at the City God Temple the next morning, Mi’s table was unusually crowded with men hoping to borrow silver.

但宓本常的手很紧，
But he kept a tight hold on it.

因为胡雪岩交代，这笔款子除了弥补古应春的宕帐以外，余款他另有用途。
Hu had instructed that, apart from covering Gu’s outstanding bad debts, the money was reserved for another purpose.

『做生意看机会。』他说∶『市面不好，也是个机会；
“Business depends on recognizing opportunities,” Hu said. “A poor market can be an opportunity too.

当然，这要看眼光，看准了赚大钱，看走眼了血本无归。
It requires judgment: judge correctly and you make a fortune; judge wrongly and you lose your capital.

现在银根紧，都在脱货求现，
With money tight, everyone is selling goods for cash.

你们看这笔款子应该怎么用？』
How do you think we should use these funds?”

古应春主张囤茶叶，宓本常提议买地皮，
Gu favoured stocking up on tea; Mi suggested land.

但胡雪岩都不赞成，唯一的原因是，茶叶也好，地皮也好，投资下去要看局势的演变，不能成上发生作用。
Hu rejected both for one reason: either investment would depend on subsequent developments and could not produce an immediate effect.


『大先生，』宓本常说∶『局势不好，什么作用都不会发生，
“In an unfavourable situation, nothing will produce an effect,” Mi argued.

我看还是放拆息最好。』
“Short-term lending seems best.”

『放拆息不必谈；
“We shall not discuss that.

我们开钱庄，本意就不是想赚同行的钱，
We did not open a bank merely to profit from other bankers.

至于要发生作用，局势固然有关系，主要的是看力量，
As for producing an effect, circumstances matter, but strength matters more.

力量够，稍为再加一点，就有作用发生。』
If you already have enough, a small addition will make the difference.”

胡雪岩随手取过三只茶杯，斟满其中的一杯说∶『这两只杯子里的茶只有一半，
Hu took three teacups and filled one. “These two are only half full.

那就好比茶叶同地皮，离满的程度还远得很；
They are like tea and land: still a long way from the brim.

这满的一杯，只要倒茶下去，马上就会到外面，
Add more to this full cup, however, and it overflows at once.

这就是你力量够了，马上能够发生作用。』
That is what happens when your existing strength is sufficient.”

古应春颇有领会了，
Gu understood.

『这是四两拨千斤的道理。』
“Four ounces moving a thousand jin.

他说∶『小爷叔，你的满杯茶，不止一杯，
But you have more than one full cup, Little Uncle.

你要哪一杯发生作用？』
Which do you intend to make overflow?”

『你倒想呢？』
“What do you think?”

『丝？』
“Silk?”

『不错。』
“Exactly.”


古应春大不以为然。
Gu strongly disagreed.

因为胡雪岩囤积的丝很多，
Hu already held enormous stocks of silk.

而这年的『洋庄』并不景气；洋人收丝，出价不高，
The foreign market was poor that year, and overseas buyers offered low prices.

胡雪岩不愿脱手，积压的现银已多，没有再投入资金之理。
Hu refused to sell, tying up much ready silver; there was no reason to invest still more.

『不！应春。』
“No, Yingchun.

胡雪岩说∶『出价不高，是洋人打错了算盘，
Their prices are low because they have miscalculated.

以为我想脱货求现，打算买便宜货，
They think I want to sell for cash and mean to buy cheaply.

而且，市面上也还有货，所以他们还不急。
There is still silk available elsewhere, so they are in no hurry.

我呢！
What about me?

你们说我急不急？』
Do you think I am in a hurry?”

忽然看出这么一句话来，古应春与宓本常都不知如何回答了。
The sudden question left Gu and Mi at a loss.

『你们倒说说看，
“Well?

怎么不开口。』
Why do you say nothing?”

『我不晓得大先生怎么样』宓本常说∶『不过我是很急。』
“I do not know about you,” Mi said, “but I am certainly anxious.”

『你急我也急。
“So am I.

我何尝不急，
How could I not be?

不过愈急愈坏事；
But showing anxiety only makes matters worse.

人家晓得你急，就等着要你的好看了。
Once people know you are desperate, they wait to take advantage of you.

譬如汇丰的那笔款子，我要说王中堂有大批钱存进来，头寸宽裕得很，
With the HSBC loan, I said Minister Wang had deposited a large sum and we had plenty of money.

曾友生就愈要借给你，利息也讨俏了；
That made Zeng all the more eager to lend, and gave us an advantage over the rate.

只要你一露口风，很想借这笔钱，那时候你们看着，他又是一副脸嘴了。』
Had I let slip how much I wanted it, you would have seen quite another face.”

『这似乎不可以一概而论。』
“I do not think the principle applies in every case,” Gu said.

古应春总觉得他的盘算不对，但却不知从何驳起。
He felt Hu’s calculations were wrong but could not find where to begin his objection.


『你说不可一概而论，
“You say we cannot generalize.

我说道理是一样的。
I say the principle is the same.

现在我趁市价落的时候，把市面上的丝收光，
While prices are low, I shall buy up all the silk on the market.

洋人买不到丝，自然会回头来寻我。』
Unable to find supplies, the foreigners will naturally return to me.”

『万一倒是大家都僵在那里，一个价钱不好不卖；一个价钱太贵，不买。
“Suppose both sides hold out: one refuses to sell because the price is too low, the other refuses to buy because it is too high.

小爷叔，那时候，你要想想，吃亏的是你，不是他。』
You must remember, Little Uncle, that you will suffer, not they.”

『怎么吃亏的是我？』
“Why should I?”

『丝不要发黄吗？』
“Does silk not turn yellow?”

『不错，
“Certainly.

丝要发黄。不过也仅止于发黄而已，
But it only turns yellow.

漂白费点事，总不致于一无用处，要掼到汪洋大海。』
Bleaching will take some trouble; it will not become so useless that we must throw it into the sea.

胡雪岩又说∶『大家拼下去，我到底是地主，总有办法好想；
If we hold out against each other, I am on my own ground and can find some way through.

来收货的洋人，一双空手回去，
The foreigners who come for supplies cannot return empty-handed.

没有原料，他厂要关门。
Without raw materials, their mills must close.

我不相信他拼得过我。
I do not believe they can outlast me.

万一他们真是齐了心杀我的价，我还有最后一记死中求活的仙着。』
If they really unite to force my price down, I still have one last inspired move to turn defeat into survival.”

大家都想听他说明那死中求活的一着是什么？
Both men wanted to hear it.

但胡雪岩装作只是信口掩饰短处的一句『游词』，笑笑不再说下去了。
Hu merely smiled and said no more, as though the remark had been an offhand evasion intended to conceal a weakness.


可是当他只与古应春两个人在一起时，态度便不同了，
Alone with Gu, however, his manner changed.

『应春，你讲的道理我不是没有想过。』
“I have considered your objections, Yingchun.”

他显得有些激动，
He seemed agitated.

『人家外国人，特别是英国，做生意是第一等人。
“Abroad, especially in Britain, merchants rank among the foremost people.

我们这里呢，士农工商，做生意的，叫啥「四民之末」；
