Here we have scholars, farmers, artisans, and merchants, and merchants are called the lowest of the four classes.

现在更加好了，叫做「无商不奸」。
Now it is better still: ‘Every merchant is a rogue.’

我如果不是懂做官的诀窍，不会有今天。
If I had not understood how official life works, I should never have reached my present position.

你说，我是不是老实话？』
Is that not the truth?”

『不见得。』
“Not necessarily.

古应春答说∶『小爷叔光讲做生意，一定也是第一流人物。』
In business alone, you would still be a first-rate man.”

『你说的第一流，不过是做生意当中的第一流，不是「四民」当中的第一流。
“First-rate among merchants, you mean—not among the four classes.

应春，你不要「晕淘淘」，真的当你做生意的本事有多少大！
Do not lose your head, Yingchun, and imagine your business ability is so remarkable.

我跟你说一句，再大也大不过外国人，尤其是英国人。
However great it is, it cannot surpass the foreigners’, especially the British.

为啥？
Why?

他是一个国家在同你做生意；
Because a whole country is doing business against you.

好比借洋款，
Take a foreign loan.

一切都谈好了；英国公使出面了，要总理衙门出公事，
Once the terms are agreed, the British minister intervenes and requires an official undertaking from the Zongli Yamen.

你欠英商的钱不还，就等于欠英国女皇的钱不还。
Failing to repay a British merchant becomes the same as failing to repay the queen.

真的不还，你试试看，
Try it!

软的，海关捏在人家手里；
Their gentler method is to hold the customs in their hands.

硬的，他的兵舰开到你口子外头，大炮瞄准你城里热闹的地方。
Their harsher method is to bring warships off your port and aim their guns at the busiest parts of your city.

应春，这同「阎王帐」一样，
It is a debt to the King of Hell.

你敢不还？
Dare you refuse?

不还要你的命！』
They will take your life!”

胡雪岩说话的语气一向平和，从未见他如此锋利过。
Hu normally spoke calmly; Gu had never heard such sharpness.

因此，古应春不敢附和；但也不敢反驳，因为不管附和还是反驳，都只会使得他更为偏激。
He dared neither agree nor contradict, since either response would only drive Hu further.


胡雪岩却根本不理会他因何沉默，
Hu paid no attention to the reason for his silence.

只觉得『话到口边留不住』，要说个痛快，
The words had reached his lips and would not be held back.

『那天我听吴秀才谈英国政府卖鸦片，心里头感慨不少。
“When Mr Wu described the British government’s opium trade, I had much to reflect upon.

表面上看起来，种鸦片的，都是东印度公司，其实是英国政府在操纵，
Outwardly it is the East India Company that grows the opium; in reality, the government directs everything.

只要对东印度公司稍为有点不利，英国政府就要出面来交涉了。
The slightest injury to the company’s interests brings government intervention.

东印度公司的盈余，要归英国政府，这也还罢了。
Its profits go to the government, so that is understandable.

然而，丝呢？
But silk?

完全是英国商人自己在做生意，
British merchants trade in it entirely on their own account.

盈亏同英国政府毫不相干；
Their profits and losses have nothing to do with the government.

居然也要出面来干预，说你们收的茧捐太高了，英商收丝的成本加重，所以要减低。
Yet it still intervenes, claiming that our cocoon levies are too high and increase British buyers’ costs, and demanding reductions.

人家的政府，处处帮商人讲话；
Their government speaks for its merchants at every turn.

我们呢？应春，你说！』
What about ours, Yingchun?”

『这还用得着我说？』古应春苦笑着回答。
“Must I say it?” Gu replied with a bitter smile.

『俗语说∶不怕不识货，只怕货比货。
“As the saying goes, you need not know good goods from bad if you can compare them.

政府也是一样的。
Governments are the same.

有的人说，我们大清朝比明朝要好得多，
Some say our Qing dynasty is much better than the Ming.

照明朝末年，皇帝、太监那种荒唐法子，明朝不亡变成没有天理了。
With the absurd conduct of the emperors and eunuchs at the end of the Ming, there would have been no justice in Heaven had the dynasty survived.

但是，货要比三家，所谓货比三家不吃亏，
But you must compare three shops, not two.

大清朝比明朝高明，固然不错；还要比别的国家，
Granted, the Qing is better than the Ming; we must compare it with other countries as well.

这就是比第三家。
That is the third shop.

你说，比得上哪一国，
Which can it match?

不但英法美德，照我看比日本都不如。』
Not Britain, France, America, or Germany—not even Japan, in my view.”

『小爷叔，』古应春插嘴说道∶『你的话扯得远了。』
“You are straying from the subject, Little Uncle.”

『好！我们回来再谈生意。
“Then back to business.

我，胡某人有今天，朝廷帮我的忙的地方，我晓得；
I know where the court has helped me.

象钱庄，有利息轻的官款存进来，就是我比人家有利的地方。
Official deposits at low interest give my bank an advantage.

不过，这是我帮朝廷的忙所换来的；
But I earned that by helping the court.

朝廷是照应你出了力、戴红顶子的胡某人，不是照应你做大生意的胡某人，
It favours Hu the red-buttoned official who has rendered service, not Hu the great merchant.

这中间是有分别的。
There is a distinction.

你说是不是？』
Do you agree?”

『爷叔，你今天发的议论太深奥了。』
“Your argument is rather profound today.”

古应春用拇指揉着太阳穴∶『等我想一想。』
Gu rubbed his temples. “Let me think.”

『对！
“Do.

你要想通了，我们才谈得下去。』
We cannot proceed until you understand.”


古应春细细分辨了两者之间的区别。以后问道∶『小爷叔的意思是，朝廷应该照应做大生意的？』
Gu carefully considered the distinction, then asked, “Do you mean the court should support large-scale business?”

『不错。』胡雪岩说∶『不过，我是指的同外国人一较高下的大生意而言。
“Yes—business that competes with foreigners.

凡是销洋庄的，朝廷都应该照应；
It should support everyone selling to the foreign market.

因为这就是同外国人「打仗」，不过不是用真刀真枪而已。』
That is warfare with foreigners, though without swords and guns.”

『是，是。
“Indeed.

近来有个新说法，叫做「商战」，
There is a new term for it: commercial warfare.

那就是小爷叔的意思了。』
That is what you mean.”

『正是。』
“Exactly.

胡雪岩说∶『我同洋人「商战』，朝廷在那里看热闹，甚至还要说冷活、扯后腿，
While I fight this commercial war, the court stands watching, sometimes jeering or pulling me back.

你想，我这个仗打得过、打不过人家？
Can I defeat the other side?”

『当然打不过。』
“Of course not.”

『喏！』
“There!”

胡雪岩突然大声说道∶『应春，我胡某人自己觉得同人家不同的地方就在这里，
Hu suddenly raised his voice. “That is where I differ from others.

明晓得打不过，我还是要打。
Knowing I cannot win, I mean to fight all the same.

而且，』他清清楚楚地说∶『我要争口气给朝廷看；教那些大人先生自己觉得难为情。』
And”—his words were deliberate—“I mean to vindicate myself before the court and make those great gentlemen feel ashamed.”

『那，』古应春笑道∶『那不是争气，是赌气了。』
“Then it is obstinacy, not self-respect,” Gu said with a smile.

『赌气同争气，原是一码事。
“They are much the same.

会赌气的，就是争气；不懂争气的，就变成赌气了。』
Well-directed obstinacy becomes self-respect; without understanding how to vindicate yourself, it is merely obstinacy.”

『这话说得好。
“Well said.

闲话少说，小爷叔，我要请教你，你的这口气怎么争法？
But enough talk: how do you mean to prove yourself?

万一争不到，自扳石斗自压脚，那就连赌气都谈不到了。』
If you fail and drop the stone on your own foot, even obstinacy will be too flattering a name.”

这就又谈到所谓『死中求话的仙着』上头来了。
This brought them back to Hu’s inspired last resort.

胡雪岩始终不愿谈个打算，事实上他也从没有认真去想过，
He had consistently avoided discussing the plan; in truth, he had never thought it through seriously.

此时却不能不谈不想了。
Now he had to think and speak.


『大不了我把几家新式缫丝厂都买了过来，自己来做丝。』
“At worst, I can buy up several modern silk-reeling mills and produce the silk myself.”

此言一出，古应春竟有些不相信自己的耳朵了。
Gu could scarcely believe his ears.

胡雪岩一向不赞成新式缫丝厂，
Hu had always opposed modern mills.

现在的做法完全相反，实在不可思议。
Such a complete reversal seemed extraordinary.

然而稍为多想一想，就觉得这一着实在很高明。
After a little reflection, however, Gu thought the idea excellent.

古应春在这方面跟胡雪岩的态度一直不同，
He had always differed from Hu on this question.

他懂洋文跟洋人打交道的辰光也多，对西方潮流比较清楚，
Knowing foreign languages and dealing frequently with foreigners, he understood Western developments better.

土法做丝，成本既高、品质又差，老早该淘汰了。
Traditional reeling was costly and produced inferior silk; it should long ago have been superseded.

只因为胡雪岩一直顾虑乡下丝户的生计，一直排斥新式缫丝，
Hu’s concern for rural silk households had made him resist modern methods.

现在难得他改变想法，不但反对，而且更进一步，自己要下手做，
Now he had not merely abandoned his opposition but proposed entering the industry himself.

怎不教人既惊且喜。
Gu was both astonished and delighted.

『小爷叔，就是洋人不跟你打对台，你也应该这样做的。
“Even if the foreigners were not opposing you, Little Uncle, you ought to do this.

你倒想——』古应春很起劲地为胡雪岩指陈必须改弦易辙的理由，
Consider—” Eagerly he set out the reasons for changing course.

第一是新式缫丝机器，比手摇脚踏的『土机器』要快好几倍，
First, modern machinery worked several times faster than hand- and foot-operated equipment.

茧子不妨尽量收，收了马上运到厂里做成丝，
Cocoons could be bought in any quantity and sent straight to the mills.

既不用堆栈来存放干茧，更不怕茧中之蛹未死，咬出头来；
No warehouses would be needed for dried cocoons, nor would there be fear of living pupae emerging through them.

第二，出口的匀净、光泽远胜于土法所制『第三，自己收茧，自己做丝，自己销洋庄，竞』一条鞭『到底，
Second, the finished silk’s evenness, cleanliness, and lustre far surpassed the traditional product. Third, buying the cocoons, reeling the silk, and selling it abroad oneself would place the entire operation under one direction.

不必怕洋人来竞争，事实上洋人也无法来竟争。
Foreign competition need no longer be feared; indeed, foreigners would have no means of competing.

这三点理由，尤其是最后一点，颇使胡雪岩动心；
These arguments, especially the last, moved Hu considerably.

但一时也委决不下，只这样答一句∶『再看吧！
Still unable to decide, he answered only, “We shall see.

这不是很急的事。』
There is no great urgency.”


但古应春的想法不同，
Gu thought otherwise.

他认为这件事应该马上进行。
Action should begin at once.

胡雪岩手里有大批干茧，
Hu held large stocks of dried cocoons.

如果用土法做成丝，跟洋人价钱谈不拢，摆在堆栈里，丝会发黄；
If he had them reeled by traditional methods and could not agree on a price with foreign buyers, the silk would sit in warehouses and turn yellow.

如果自己有厂做丝直接外销，就不会有什么风险了。
With mills of his own and direct foreign sales, Gu believed, there would be little risk.

因此，他积极奔走，去打听新式缫丝厂的情形，
He therefore actively investigated the modern mills.

共有五家，
There were five.

最早是法国人卜鲁纳开设的宝昌丝厂，
The earliest, Baochang, had been founded by a Frenchman named Brunat.

其次是美商旗昌洋行附设的旗昌丝厂。
Next came the Qichang mill, attached to the American firm of Russell & Company.

第三家去年才开，名为公和永，老板是湖州人黄佐卿。
The third, Gongheyong, had opened only the previous year under Huang Zuoqing of Huzhou.

此外怡和、公平两家洋行，跟旗昌洋行一样，也都附设了丝厂。
Jardine’s and Gongping Trading House also operated mills, as Russell’s did.

这五家丝厂，规模都差不多，也都不赚钱，原因有二∶第一，是干茧的来路不畅，机器常常停工待料。
All five were of roughly similar size and all were unprofitable, for two reasons. Supplies of dried cocoons were unreliable, frequently leaving machinery idle.

第二，机器的效用不能充分发挥，成品不如理想之好。
Nor was the machinery’s capacity fully realized, and the finished silk fell short of expectations.

据说，公和永、怡和、公平三家打算联合聘请一名意大利有名的技师来管工程。
It was said that Gongheyong, Jardine’s, and Gongping intended jointly to engage a renowned Italian technician to supervise operations.

其余两家，已有无意经营之势，
The other two seemed ready to abandon the business.

如果胡雪岩想收买，正是机会。
If Hu wished to buy, this was the opportunity.


古应春对这件事非常热中，
Gu was enthusiastic.

先跟七姑奶奶商量，看应该如何向胡雪岩进言。
He first consulted the Seventh Lady about how best to put the matter to Hu.

『新式缫丝厂的情形，我不在清楚，不过洋丝比土丝好，那是外行都看得出来的。』
“I do not know much about modern reeling mills,” she said, “but even an outsider can see that machine-reeled silk is better than the traditional kind.”



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第六章（本章第2部分，共2部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


『东西好就不怕没有销路。』古应春说∶『小爷叔做什么生意，都要最好的；
“Good products will find buyers,” Gu said. “Little Uncle insists on the best in every business.

现在明明的最好的东西在那里，他偏不要，
Now the best is plainly available, yet he refuses it.

这就有点奇怪了。』
That is strange.”

七姑奶奶想了一下说∶『我来跟他说。』
The Seventh Lady considered. “I shall speak to him.”

『七姐，不是我不要。
“It is not that I do not want it, Sister Seven,” Hu explained when she did.

我也知道洋丝比起土丝来起码要高两档。
“I know machine-reeled silk is at least two grades better.

不过，七姐，做人总要讲定旨、进信用，
But a man must have settled principles and keep faith.

我一向不赞成新式缫丝，
I have always opposed modern reeling.

现在反过来自己下手，那不是反复小人？
If I now undertake it myself, will I not be an unprincipled turncoat?

人家要问我，我有啥话好说。』
What could I say when challenged?”

『小爷叔，所谓此一时也，彼一时也，
“Times change.

世界天天在变。
The world changes every day.

我是从小生长在上海的，哪里会想到现在的上海会变成这个样子？
I grew up in Shanghai: how could I ever have imagined the city as it is now?

人家西洋，样样进步；
Everything advances in the West.

你不领益，自己吃亏。
Refuse the benefits, and you suffer.

譬如说，左大人西征，不是你替他买西洋的军火，他哪里会成功？』
Could His Excellency Zuo have succeeded in the west without the foreign weapons you bought him?”

『七姐，你误会了，
“You misunderstand.

我不是说洋丝不好——』『我知道，我也没有误会。』
I do not say the silk is inferior—” “I know, and I have not misunderstood.

七姑奶奶抢着说∶『我的意思是，人要识潮流，
My point is that one must recognize the direction of events.

不识潮流，落在人家后面，等你想到要赶上去，已经来不及。
Fall behind, and by the time you try to catch up it is too late.

小爷叔，承你帮应春这么一个忙，我们夫妇是一片至诚。』
You have helped Yingchun so greatly; our concern for you is entirely sincere.”

『七姐，七姐，』胡雪岩急忙打断，
“Sister Seven!” Hu interrupted hastily.

『你说这种话，就显得我们交情浅了。』
“To speak like that makes our friendship sound shallow.”


『好！我不说。
“Very well.

不过，小爷叔，我真是替你担足心思。』
But I truly am anxious for you.

七姑奶奶说∶『现在局势不好，
The situation is bad.

听说法国人预备拿兵舰拦在吴淞口外，不准商船通行，
I hear the French intend to station warships off Wusong and stop merchant vessels passing.

那一来洋庄不动，小爷叔，你垫本几百万银子的茧子跟丝，怎么办？』
If the export trade stops, what becomes of the cocoons and silk in which you have invested several million taels?”

『这，这消息，你是从哪里来的？』
“Where did you hear that?”

『是替我看病的洋大夫说的。』
“From the foreign doctor treating me.”

『真的？』
“Really?”

『我几时同小爷叔说过假话？』
“When have I ever lied to you?”

『喔，喔，』胡雪岩急忙道歉，『七姐，我说错了。』
“Of course—my mistake,” Hu apologized hastily.

『小爷叔，人，有的时候要冒险，有的时候要稳当，
“There are times to take risks and times to be cautious.

小爷叔，我说句很难听的话，白相人说的「有床破棉被，就要保身家」。
Forgive a coarse saying used by men about town: ‘Once you possess even a ragged quilt, you must protect what you have.’

小爷叔，你现在啥身家？』
How much have you to protect now, Little Uncle?”


胡雪岩默然半晌，叹口气说∶『七姐，我何尝不晓得？
After a long silence, Hu sighed. “Do you think I do not know?

不过，有的时候，由不得自己。』
But sometimes the choice is not mine.”

『我不相信。』
“I do not believe that.

七姑奶奶说∶『事业是你一手闯出来的，
You built this business yourself.

哪个也做不得你的主。』
No one else can decide for you.”

『七姐，这你就不大清楚了，
“You do not quite understand.

无形之中有许多牵制，
There are many unseen restraints.

譬如说，我要一做新式缫丝厂，就有多少人来央求我，说「你胡大先生不拉我们一把，反而背后踢一脚，
If I start operating modern mills, people will come begging: ‘Instead of helping us, Mr Hu, you kick us from behind.

我们做丝的人家，没饭吃了。」
We silk-reeling families will have nothing to eat.’

这一来，你的心就狠不下来了。』
Then I cannot harden my heart.”

七姑奶奶没有料到，他的话会说在前头，等于先发制人，将她的嘴封住了。
The Seventh Lady had not expected him to forestall her argument so effectively.

当然，七姑奶奶决不会就此罢休，另外要想话来说服他。
But she would not give up; she must find another way to persuade him.

『小爷叔，照你的说法，好比从井救人。
“That is like climbing into a well to rescue someone.

你犯得着，犯不着？
Is it worth risking yourself?

再说新式缫丝是潮流，
Modern reeling is the way things are moving.

现在光是销洋庄；
At present its silk goes only to the foreign market.

将来厂多了，大家都喜欢洋机丝织的料子，土法做丝，根本就没人要；
As mills multiply, everyone will prefer cloth woven from machine-reeled silk, and no one will want the traditional product.

只看布好了，
Look at cotton cloth.

洋布又细又白又薄，
Foreign cloth is fine, white, and light.

到夏天哪个不想弄件洋布衫穿？
Who does not want a shirt of it in summer?

毛蓝布只有乡下人穿，再过几年乡下人都不穿了。』
Only country people still wear coarse blue homespun, and in a few years even they will stop.”

『这不可以一概而论的。』
“You cannot apply one rule to everything.”

『为啥不可以，
“Why not?

事情是一样的。』
The principle is the same.

七姑奶奶接着又说∶『从井救人看自己犯得着、犯不着是一桩事；值得不值得救，又是一桩事。
With a rescue from a well, your own risk is one question; whether the person can usefully be saved is another.

如果鲜龙活跳一个人，掉在井里淹死了，自然可惜；
If a healthy, vigorous man drowns, that is a pity.

倘或是个骨瘦如柴的痨病鬼，就救了起来，也没有几年好活，
But if he is a consumptive, skin and bones, he will have few years left even if rescued.

老实说，救不救是一样的，
Frankly, it makes little difference.

现在土法做丝，就好比是个去日无多的痨病鬼。』
Traditional silk-reeling is like that dying consumptive.”

她这个譬方，似乎也有点道理，
There seemed something in her comparison.

胡雪岩心想，光跟她讲理，没有用处，只说自己的难处好了。
Hu decided that argument alone was useless; he had better confine himself to his own difficulty.


『七姐，实在是做人不能「两面三刀」，「又做师娘又做鬼」。
“A man cannot be double-faced, playing both the spirit-medium and the ghost.

你说，如果我胡某人是这样一个人，身家一定保不住。』
If I behaved like that, I should certainly lose all I have.”

七姑奶奶驳不倒他∶心里七上八下转着念头，
Unable to refute him, the Seventh Lady turned the problem anxiously over in her mind.

突然灵机一动，
Suddenly she had an inspiration.

便即问道∶『小爷叔，照你刚才的话，你不是不想做新式缫丝厂，是有牵制，不能做，
“Then you do want modern mills, but those restraints prevent you.

是不是？』
Is that right?”

『是的。』
“Yes.”

『那么牵制没有了，你就能做，是不是。』
“Without the restraints, you could proceed?”

『也可以这么说。』
“You could put it that way.”

『那好，我有一个法子，包你没有牵制。』
“Then I can guarantee a way to remove them.”

『你倒说说看。』
“Let me hear it.”

『很容易，
“Simple.

小爷叔，你不要出面好了。』
Keep your own name out of it.”

『是┅┅』胡雪岩问∶『是暗底下做老板？』
“You mean… be the owner behind the scenes?”

『对！』
“Exactly.”


胡雪岩心有点动了，但兹事体大，必须好好想一想，
Hu was tempted, but the matter was too important to decide without thought.

见此光景，七姑奶奶知道事情有转机了，松不得劲，当即又想了一番话说。
Seeing the possibility of a change, the Seventh Lady knew she must keep pressing.

『小爷叔，局势要坏起来是蛮快的，
“The situation can deteriorate very quickly.

现在不趁早想办法，等临时发觉不妙，就来不及补救了。
If you do not prepare now, there may be no remedy when you discover the danger.

几百万银子，不是小数目；
Several million taels is no small sum.

小爷叔，就算你是「财神」，只怕也背不起这个风险。』
Even the God of Wealth could scarcely bear that risk.”

这话自然是不能当为耳旁风的；
Hu could not disregard this.

胡雪岩不由得问了一句∶『叫哪个来做呢？』
“Who would undertake it?”

要谈到委托一个出面的人，事情就好办了，
Once they were discussing a representative, the problem became easier.

七姑奶奶说∶『我在想，最好请罗四姐来；
“I should like Madam Luosi to come,” she said.

我的身子风瘫了，脑子没有坏，
“My body is paralysed, but my mind is sound.

也可以帮她出出主意。』
I could help her think things through.”

『她一来，一家人怎么办？』
“And who would manage the household?

胡雪岩说∶『除非七姐你能起床，还差不多。』
It might work if you could get about.”

『我是决不行的。
“I certainly cannot.

要么┅┅』她沉吟着。
Perhaps…” She hesitated.

『你是说应春？』
“Yingchun?

不过应春同我的关系，大家都晓得的，
Everyone knows his connection with me.

他出面同我自己出面差不多。
His appearance would be much the same as mine.

这种掩耳盗铃的做法，不大妥当。
Such self-deception would hardly do.”

『』我不是想到应春，我光是在想，哪里去寻一个靠得住的人。
“I was not thinking of him, only wondering where to find someone trustworthy.”

『七姑奶奶停了一下说∶』小叔爷，你自己倒想一想，
She paused. “Think of someone yourself first.

如果真的没有，我倒有个人。
If there really is no one, I have a person in mind.”

『』那么，你说。
“Tell me.”

『『不！
“No.

一定要小爷叔你自己先想。』
You must consider your own people first.”


胡雪岩心想，做这件事少不了古应春的参预，而他又不能出面；
Hu reflected that Gu’s participation would be indispensable, yet Gu could not appear openly.

如果七姑奶奶举荐一个人，就等于古应春下手一样，那才比较能令人放心。
If the Seventh Lady nominated someone, it would be almost as reassuring as having Gu act himself.

这样一转念头，根本就不去考虑自己这方面的人，
He therefore did not even consider his own people.

『七姐，』他说∶『我没有人。
“I have no one, Sister Seven.

如果你有人，我们再谈下去，那才比较能令人放心。
If you do, we can discuss it further with greater confidence.”

这是逼着她荐贤。七姑奶奶明白，这是胡雪岩更加重她的责任；因而重新又考量了一下，确知不会出纰漏，
He was making her take responsibility for the recommendation. She understood and reconsidered carefully, satisfying herself that nothing should go wrong before speaking.

方始说道∶『由我五哥出面来做好了。』
“Let my fifth brother act for us.”

尤五退隐已久，在上海商场上，知道他的人不多，
Brother You had long been retired, and few in Shanghai’s business world knew him.

但他在漕帮中的势力仍在，
His influence in the Grain Transport Brotherhood remained, however.

由他出面，加以有古应春做帮手，这件事是可以做的。
With Gu’s assistance, he could undertake the task.

『如果五哥肯出面，我就没话说了。』胡雪岩说∶『等应春回来，好好商量。』
“If Brother Five agrees, I have no objection,” Hu said. “We shall discuss it properly when Yingchun returns.”


古应春专程到松江去了一趟，将尤五邀了来，当面商谈。
Gu made a special journey to Songjiang to bring Brother You back for a meeting.

但胡雪岩只有一句话∶事情要做得隐秘，
Hu insisted on one condition: everything must be kept secret.

他完全退居幕后，避免不必要的纷扰。
He would remain entirely behind the scenes to avoid unnecessary trouble.

『若要人不知，除非已莫为。』尤五的话很坦率∶『不过，场面摆出来以后，生米煮成熟饭，就人家晓得了，也不要紧。』
“If you want nobody to know, the only sure course is not to do it,” Brother You said frankly. “But once the concern is established and the rice cooked, it will not matter if people discover it.”

『这也是实话，
“True enough.

不过到时候，总让我有句话能推托才好。』
Still, I should like something to say by way of an excuse.”

『小爷叔你不认帐，人家有什么办法？』七姑奶奶说道∶『到时候，你到京里去一趟，索性连耳根都清净了。』
“If you deny it, what can they do?” the Seventh Lady asked. “Go to Beijing for a while then, and spare yourself even the noise.”

『对，对！』胡雪岩连连点头，
“Exactly.

『到时候我避开好了。』
I shall keep out of the way.”

这就表示胡雪岩在这桩大生意上是完全接受了古应春夫妇的劝告。
Hu had thus fully accepted the couple’s advice on this large undertaking.

纺丝收茧子，在胡雪岩全部事业中，规模仅次于钱庄与典当而占第三位，
Silk-reeling and cocoon purchases ranked third among his businesses, behind banking and pawnbroking.

但钱庄与典当都有联号，而且是经常性的营业，所以在制度上都有一个首脑在『抓总』，
The banks and pawnshops, however, had affiliated houses and carried on regular operations, each with a principal manager in overall charge.

惟独丝茧的经营，是胡雪岩自己在指挥调度。钱庄、典当两方面的人，只要是用得着时，他随时可以调用，
Hu alone directed the silk and cocoon trade, drawing upon banking and pawnshop staff whenever necessary.

譬如放款『买青』，要用到湖州等地阜康的档手；存丝、存茧子的堆栈不够用，他的典当便须协力，销洋庄跟洋人谈生意时，少不了要古应春出面。
Advances for purchasing the future crop required Fukang’s senior clerks in Huzhou and elsewhere; when silk and cocoon warehouses lacked space, the pawnshops had to assist; foreign sales inevitably called for Gu’s services.

丝行、茧行的『档手』，只是管他自己的一部分业务，
The head clerks in individual silk and cocoon firms managed only their own portions of the business.

层次较低，地位根本不能跟宓本常这班『大伙』相比。
Their rank was far below that of chief managers such as Mi.

多年来，胡雪岩总想找一个能够笼罩全局的人，可以将这部分的生意，全盘托付；但一直未能如愿。
For years Hu had sought someone capable of overseeing the whole concern, to whom he could entrust it completely.

如今他认为古应春应该是顺理成章地成为适当的人选了。
Now Gu seemed the natural choice.


『应春，现在我都照你们的话做了，以后这方面的做法也跟以前不相同了。
“I am doing as you advise, Yingchun, and this business will henceforth be conducted differently.

既然如此，丝跟茧子的事，我都交了给你。』
I therefore entrust all the silk and cocoon operations to you.

胡雪岩又说∶『做事最怕缚手缚脚，
Nothing hinders business more than having one’s hands tied.

尤其是同洋人打交道，不管合作也好，竞争也好，贵乎消息灵通，当机立断，
Whether cooperating or competing with foreigners, one must have prompt information and make immediate decisions.

如果你没有完全作主的权柄，到要紧关头仍旧要同我商量，那就一定输人家一着了。』
Without full authority, if you still have to consult me at a critical moment, you will inevitably lose a move.”

他的这番道理说得很透彻；态度之诚恳，更是令人感动，
His reasoning was clear and his sincerity moving.

但古应春觉得责任太重，不敢答应；
But Gu felt the responsibility too heavy to accept.

七姑奶奶却沉默无语，显得跟他的感觉相同，便愈发谨慎了。
The Seventh Lady remained silent, apparently sharing his concern, which made him more cautious still.

但他不敢推托；
Yet he dared not refuse.

因为坚持不允，便表示他对从事新式缫丝，并无把握的事，
To insist on declining would imply that he had no confidence in modern reeling.

极力劝人家去做，是何居心？
What motive, then, had he had for urging someone else into it?

光在这一点上就说不通了。
That alone would be impossible to explain.


于是他说∶『小爷叔承你看得起我，我很感激；
“I am grateful for your confidence, Little Uncle.

以我们多少年的交情来说，我亦决无推辞之理。
After so many years of friendship, I have no reason to refuse.

不过，一年进出几百万的生意，牵涉的范围又很广，
But this is a business turning over several million a year, with very wide connections.

我没有彻底弄清楚，光是懂一点皮毛，是不敢承担这样大的责任的。』
Knowing only its surface, I dare not assume such responsibility before understanding it thoroughly.”

『这个自然是实话。』
“Naturally.

胡雪岩说∶『不过，我是要你来掌舵，下面的事有人做。
But you are to steer the ship; others will do the work below.

专门搞这一行的人，多是跟了我多年的，
Most of the specialists have served me for years.

我叫他们会集拢来，跟你谈个一两天，其中的决窍，你马上就都懂了。』
I shall bring them together to explain things. In a day or two, you will understand the essentials.”

『如果我来接手，当然要这么做。』
“If I take over, that will certainly be necessary.”

古应春很巧妙地宕开一笔∶『凡事要按部就班来做，
Gu adroitly deferred the point. “We must proceed step by step.

等我先帮五哥，把收买两个新缫丝厂的事办妥当了，
Let me first help Brother Five complete the purchase of the two mills.

再谈第二步，好不好？』
Then we can discuss the next stage.”

『应该这样子办。』七姑奶奶附和着说∶『而且今年蚕忙时期也过了∶除了新式缫丝厂以外，其余都不妨照常年旧规去办。
“That is the proper course,” the Seventh Lady agreed. “The busy silkworm season is over for this year. Apart from the modern mills, everything can follow the established arrangements.

目前最要紧的是，小爷叔手里的货色要赶紧脱手。』
The immediate priority is to sell the stock you hold.”

她的话，要紧的是最后一句∶她还是怕局势有变，市面愈来愈坏，脱货求现为上上之策。
Her last sentence mattered most. Still fearing a worsening political situation and declining trade, she considered conversion of goods into cash the safest course.

但胡雪岩的想法正好相反，
Hu thought precisely the opposite.

他觉得自己办了新式缫丝厂，不愁茧子没有出路，
With modern mills of his own, he need not fear finding an outlet for his cocoons.

则有恃无恐，何不与洋商放手一搏？
Secure on that point, why not fight the foreign merchants without restraint?

胡雪岩做生意，事先倒是周咨博询，不耻下问，
Before a transaction, Hu consulted widely and willingly sought advice from anyone.

但遇到真正要下决断时，是他自己在心里拿主意。
At the moment of decision, however, he made up his own mind.

他的本性本就是如此，加以这十来年受左宗棠的熏陶，领会到岳飞所说的『运用之妙，存乎一心』的道理，
That was his nature; more than ten years of Zuo’s influence had also taught him the meaning of Yue Fei’s saying that the art of applying a method rests in the commander’s own judgment.

所以七姑奶奶的话，并未多想，也不表示意见，只点点头表示听到了而已。
He gave the Seventh Lady’s suggestion little thought and merely nodded to show he had heard.

『现在我们把话说近来。』
“Let us turn to the immediate arrangements.

胡雪岩说∶『既然是请五哥出面，样子要做得象，
Since Brother Five is to represent the concern, we must make it convincing.

我想我们要打两张合同。』
I think two contracts are needed.”

『是的，这应该。』尤五答说∶『我本来也要看看，我要做多少事，负多少责任？
“Certainly,” Brother You said. “I should like to see how much work and responsibility I am taking on.

只有合同上才看得清楚。』
Only a contract will make that clear.”

『五哥，』胡雪岩立即接口∶『你有点误会了，
“You misunderstand me.

我不是要你负责任。
I am not asking you to bear responsibility.

请你出来，又有应春在，用不着你负责任；
With you representing us and Yingchun involved, you need not carry the burden.

但愿厂做发达了，你算交一步老运，我们也沾你的光。
If the mills prosper, may they bring you good fortune in your later years, and us some reflected benefit.”

『』小爷叔，你把话说倒了┅┅『』唷、唷，大家都不要说客气话了。『七姑奶奶性急，打断尤五的话说∶』现在只请小爷叔说，打怎样两张合同？
“You have that backwards, Little Uncle—” “Enough politeness!” the Seventh Lady interrupted impatiently. “Tell us about the two contracts.”

『』一张是收买那两个厂，银子要多少；开办要多少；将来开工、经常周转又要多少？
“First, calculate the purchase price of the mills, the cost of setting them up, and the working capital needed after they open.

把总数算出来，跟阜康打一张往来的合同、定一个额了，
With that total, arrange a credit agreement with Fukang and fix a limit.

额子以内，随时凭折子取款。
Within it, funds can be drawn against the passbook at any time.

至于细节上，我会交代老宓，格外方便。
I shall tell Mi to make the details especially convenient.”

『』是的。『古应春说∶』合同稿子请小爷叔交代老宓去拟；
“Please ask Mi to draft the agreement,” Gu said.

额子多少，等我谈妥当，算好了，再来告诉小爷叔。
“Once I have negotiated and calculated the amount, I shall report it.

现在请问第二张。
What is the second contract?”

『』第二张是厂里的原料，
“For raw materials.

你要仔细算一算，要多少茧子，写个跟我赊茧子，啥辰光付款的合同。
Calculate the quantity of cocoons required, then draw up an agreement to buy them from me on credit, specifying when payment is due.

『胡雪岩特别指示∶』这张合同要简单，
Keep it simple.

更不可以写出新式缫丝厂的字样。
Above all, it must contain no mention of modern silk mills.

我只当是个茧行，
As far as I am concerned, this is a cocoon firm.

你跟我买了茧子去，作啥用途，你用不着告诉我，我也没有资格问你。
You buy cocoons from me; you need not tell me what you do with them, and I have no right to ask.

你懂不懂我的意思？『
Do you understand?”


『怎么不懂？』
“Of course.”

古应春看着尤五说∶『总而言之一句话，不要把小爷叔的名字牵连到新式缫丝厂。』
Gu looked at Brother You. “In a word, Little Uncle’s name must not be connected with modern reeling mills.”

『这样行，我们先要领张部照，开一家茧行。』
“Then we must first obtain a ministry licence and establish a cocoon firm.”

『一点不错。』胡雪岩说∶『这样子就都合规矩了。』
“Exactly,” Hu agreed. “That will put everything in proper order.”

『好的。我来办。』
“I shall arrange it.

古应春问∶『小爷叔还有啥吩咐？』
Any other instructions?”

『我没有事了。
“Nothing more from me.

倒要问你，还有啥要跟我谈的。』
Have you anything else to discuss?”

『一时也想不起了。
“Nothing occurs to me now.

等想起来再同小爷叔请示。』
I shall ask when it does.”

『也不要光谈新式缫丝厂。』七姑奶奶插进来说∶『小爷叔手里的那批丝，不能再摆了。』
“We must not speak only of the mills,” the Seventh Lady interposed. “That silk must not be held any longer.”

『是啊！』古应春说∶『有好价钱好脱手了。』
“Yes,” Gu said. “It should be sold when a good price is available.”

『当然！』
“Certainly.”

听得这一声，七姑奶奶心为之一宽。
Hu’s agreement reassured her.

但古应春心里明白，『好价钱』之『好』，各人的解释不同，
Gu, however, knew that “good” meant different things to different people.

有人以为能够保本，就是好价钱；有人觉得赚得不够，价钱还不算好。
Some considered merely recovering their capital a good price; others rejected a price because the profit was insufficient.

胡雪岩的好价钱，决不是七姑奶奶心目中的好价钱。
Hu’s good price was certainly not the Seventh Lady’s.


正在谈着，转运局派人来见胡雪岩，
During their conversation, a messenger from the Transport Bureau arrived.

原来是左宗棠特派专差送来一封信，上面标明『限两日到，并钤着』两江总督部堂『的紫泥大印，
Zuo had sent a special courier with a letter marked “Deliver within two days” and bearing the great purple seal of the governor-general of Liangjiang.

未曾拆封，便知是极紧急的事。
Its urgency was evident before it was opened.

果然胡雪岩拆信一看，略作沉吟，起身说道∶』应春，你陪我到集贤里去一趟。
Hu read it, reflected briefly, and rose. “Come with me to Jixian Lane, Yingchun.”

『『集贤里』是指阜康钱庄。
He meant Fukang Bank.

宓本常有事出去了，
Mi was out on business.

管总帐的二伙周小棠，一面多派学徒，分头去找宓本常；
The second manager, Zhou Xiaotang, who supervised the general accounts, sent apprentices in several directions to find him.

一面将胡雪岩引入只有他来了才打开的一间布置得非常奢华的密室，亲自伺候，非常殷勤。
Meanwhile, he ushered Hu into a lavishly furnished private room opened only for his visits and attended to him with great solicitude.

『小棠，』胡雪岩吩咐，『你去忙你的，
“Attend to your work, Xiaotang.

我同古先生有话谈。』
Mr Gu and I must speak.”

等周小棠诺诺连声地退出，胡雪岩才将左宗棠的信拿给古应春看。
Once Zhou had withdrawn with repeated acknowledgments, Hu showed Gu the letter.

原来这年山东闹小灾，
Shandong had suffered floods that year.

黄河支流所经的齐河、历城、齐东等地都决了好大的口子，
Great breaches had opened in embankments at Qihe, Licheng, Qidong, and other places along tributaries of the Yellow River.

黄流滚滚，灾情甚重。
Muddy water poured through, causing severe devastation.

山东巡抚陈士杰，奏准『以工代赈』——用灾民来抢修堤工，发给工资，以代赈济。
Governor Chen Shijie had obtained approval to provide relief through work: the victims would repair the embankments and receive wages instead of charity.

工料所费甚巨，
Labour and materials would be costly.

除部库拨出一大笔款子外，许多富庶省份都要分摊助赈；
Besides a substantial grant from the central treasury, several prosperous provinces had been assessed contributions.

两江分摊四十万两，但江宁藩库只能凑出半数，
Liangjiang’s share was four hundred thousand taels, but the Jiangning provincial treasury could raise only half.

左宗棠迫不得已，只好向胡雪岩乞援，
With no alternative, Zuo appealed to Hu.

信上说∶『山东河患甚殷，
“Shandong’s river calamity is grave.

廷命助赈，而当事图兴工以代，
The court has ordered relief, and the authorities intend to provide it through public works.

可否以二十万借我？』
Could you lend me two hundred thousand?”


『真是！』古应春大为感慨，
“Indeed!” Gu exclaimed with feeling.

『两江之富，举国皆知，哪知连四十万银子都凑不齐。
“Liangjiang’s wealth is known throughout the country, yet it cannot raise even four hundred thousand taels.

国家之穷，可想而知了。』
Imagine the state’s poverty.”

『这二十万银子，不知道什么时候才能还，』胡雪岩说∶『索性算我报效好了。』
“Who knows when this two hundred thousand can be repaid?” Hu said. “I may as well make it a contribution.”

『不！』
“No!

古应春立即表示反对，『现在不是小爷叔踊跃输将的时候。』
This is no time for conspicuous generosity.”

『喔，有啥不妥当？』
“Why not?”

『当然不妥当。第一，没有上谕劝大家捐款助赈，
“First, there has been no imperial appeal for donations.

小爷叔何必自告奋勇？好象钱多得用不完了。
Why volunteer, as though you had more money than you could use?

其次，市面很不好，
Second, the market is poor.

小爷叔一捐就是二十万，大家看了眼红。
A gift of two hundred thousand would make everyone jealous.

第三，现在防务吃紧，军费支出浩繁，
Third, defence needs are urgent and military expenditure immense.

如果有人上奏，劝富商报效，头一个就会找到小爷叔，
If someone proposed asking wealthy merchants for contributions, you would be the first approached.

那时候报效的数目，只怕不是二十万能够过关的。
Then two hundred thousand might be far from enough.

小爷叔，这个风头千万出不得！』
You must not draw that attention to yourself!”

最后一句话，措词直率，胡雪岩不能不听，
The last warning was blunt, and Hu could not disregard it.

『也好。』
“Very well.

他说∶『请你马上拟个电报稿子，问在哪里付款。』
Draft a telegram asking where payment is required.”

于是古应春提笔写道∶『江宁制台衙门，
Gu wrote: “Governor-General’s Office, Jiangning.

密。
Confidential.

赐函奉悉，
Your letter received.

遵命办理。
Your instructions will be carried out.

款在江宁抑济南付，乞示。
Please advise whether payment is to be made in Jiangning or Jinan.

职道胡光墉叩。
Respectfully, your subordinate Circuit Intendant Hu Guangyong.”

『胡雪岩看完，在』乞『字下加了个』即『字，随即交给周小棠，派人送到转运局去发。
Hu read it and inserted “immediately” into the request for instructions, then gave it to Zhou to send to the Transport Bureau for transmission.


其时宓本常已经找回来了，
Mi had meanwhile been found.

胡雪岩问道∶『那五十万银子，由汇丰拨过来了？』
“Has HSBC transferred the five hundred thousand?” Hu asked.

『是的。』
“Yes.”

『没有动？』
“Untouched?”

『原封未动。』
“Entirely.

宓本常说，『不过先扣一季的息，不是整数了。』
But a quarter-year’s interest was deducted first, so it is no longer the full amount.”

『晓得。』
“I know.

胡雪岩说∶『这笔款子的用途，我已经派好了。
I have allocated the funds.

左大人同我借二十万，余数我要放给一个茧行。
His Excellency Zuo is borrowing two hundred thousand; the remainder is to be lent to a cocoon firm.”

『这两笔用途，都是宓本常再也想不到的；
Neither use had occurred to Mi.

他原来的打算，是想用这笔款子来赚』银拆『，经过他表弟所开的一家小钱庄，以多报少，弄点』外快『。
He had meant to earn short-term interest through a small bank owned by his younger cousin, underreporting the return and pocketing the difference.

这一来如意算盘落空，不免失望，但心里存着一个挽回的念头。
Disappointed at the collapse of this pleasant calculation, he nevertheless hoped to salvage something.


因为如此，便要问了∶『左大人为啥跟大先生借银子？』他说，
“What does His Excellency need the money for?

『左大人有啥大用场，要二十万？』
What requires two hundred thousand?”

『不是他借，是江宁藩库借。』
“The borrower is not he personally, but the Jiangning provincial treasury.”

如果是左宗棠私人借，也许一时用不了这么多，短期之内，犹可周转；
A personal loan to Zuo might not all be required at once, leaving room to use the money briefly.

公家借就毫无想头了。
A public loan offered no such hope.

『茧行呢？』
“And the cocoon firm?

他又问∶『是哪家茧行？
Which is it?

字号叫啥？』
What is its name?”

『还不晓得啥字号。』
“I do not know its name yet.”

『大先生，』宓本常愈发诧异，
Mi grew still more astonished.

『连人家字号都不晓得，怎么会借这样一笔大数目？』
“You are lending so much without even knowing the firm’s name?”

『实在也不是借人家，
“It is not really a loan to someone else.

是我们自己用；
We shall use it ourselves.

你还要起个合同稿子。』
You must draft a contract.”

胡雪岩转脸又说∶『应春，经过情形请你同老宓说一说，
Hu turned to Gu. “Explain the arrangements to Mi.

稿子弄妥当，打好了合同，我就好预备回杭州了。』
Once the draft is ready and the contracts signed, I can prepare to return to Hangzhou.”

宓本常不作声，听古应春细说了收买新式缫丝厂的计划，
Mi listened in silence as Gu described the proposed mill purchase.

心里很不舒服；
He was deeply displeased.

因为他自己觉得是胡雪岩的第一个『大伙』，地位在唐子韶之上。
He considered himself Hu’s foremost chief manager, senior even to Tang Zishao.

而且丝跟钱庄有密切关系，
Silk was closely connected with the banking business.

这样一件大事，他在事先竟未能与闻，自然妒恨交加。
To have been excluded beforehand from so important a decision filled him with jealousy and resentment.

『你看着好了！』他在心里说∶『「倒翻狗食盆，大家吃不成。」』
“Just wait,” he thought. “Tip over the dog’s feeding bowl, and no one gets to eat.”



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第七章（本章第1部分，共6部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第七章
CHAPTER SEVEN


合同稿子是拟好了，
The contracts were drafted.

但由于设立茧行需要呈请户部核准，方能开张，宓本常便以此为借口，主张等『部照』发下来，再签合同。
But a cocoon firm could not open without approval from the Ministry of Revenue, and Mi used this as a pretext to suggest waiting for the ministry licence before signing.

胡雪岩与古应春哪里知道他心存叵测？
Hu and Gu had no suspicion of his malicious intentions.

只认为订合同只是一个形式，只要把收买新式缫丝厂这件事说好了，款子随时可以动用，
To them the contracts were merely a formality: once the mill purchase was agreed, the money would be available whenever required.

所以都同意了。
They therefore consented.

在上海该办的事都办了，胡雪岩冒着溽暑赶回杭州；
With his Shanghai business concluded, Hu hurried back to Hangzhou through the oppressive summer heat.

原来胡三小姐的红鸾星动，有人做媒，由胡老太太作主，许配了『王善人』的独养儿子。
A marriage had been proposed for his third daughter, and his mother had accepted on her behalf: she was to marry the only son of “Wang the Philanthropist.”

王善人本名王财生，与胡雪岩是多年的朋友，
Wang, whose personal name was Caisheng, had been Hu’s friend for many years.

年纪轻的时候，都是杭州人戏称为『柜台猢狲』的商店伙计，所不同的是行业，
In their youth both had been shop assistants, the men Hangzhou people jokingly called “counter monkeys,” though in different trades.

王财生是一家大酱园的『学徒』出身。
Wang had begun as an apprentice in a large sauce-making establishment.

当胡雪岩重遇王有龄，青云直上时，王财生仍旧在酱园里当伙计，
When Hu renewed his acquaintance with Wang Youling and rose rapidly in the world, Wang Caisheng remained an assistant.

但到洪杨平定以后，王财生摇身一变，以绅士姿态出现，
After the Taiping rebellion was suppressed, however, he reappeared in the guise of a gentleman.

有人说他之发财是由于『趁火打劫』；有人说他『掘藏』掘到了『长毛』所埋藏的一批金银珠宝。
Some said he had enriched himself by looting during the disorder; others that he had unearthed gold, silver, and jewels buried by the rebels.

但不管他发财的原因是什么，他受胡雪岩的邀约，同办善后，扶伤救死，抚缉流亡，做了许多好事，
Whatever the source of his fortune, one fact was certain: at Hu’s invitation he helped with reconstruction, tending the wounded, saving the dying, and aiding displaced people.

博得个『善人』的美名，却是事实。
These good works earned him the title “Philanthropist.”

杭州克复的第二年，王财生得了个儿子，都说他是行善的报应。
In the second year after Hangzhou’s recovery, a son was born to him, and people called it a reward for his charity.


那年是同治四年乙丑，
That was the yichou year, the fourth of Tongzhi.

所以王财生的这个独子，小名阿牛，这年十九岁。
The boy, nicknamed A’niu, was now nineteen.

王财生早就想跟胡雪岩结亲家，而胡雪岩因为阿牛资质遇鲁，真有其笨如牛之概，一直不肯答应，
Wang had long wanted a marriage connection with Hu, but Hu thought A’niu dull—indeed, as stupid as the ox suggested by his name—and had consistently refused.

不道这年居然进学成了秀才；因而旧事重提，
Unexpectedly, the young man had now passed into the county school as a licentiate, and the proposal was renewed.

做媒的人说∶阿牛天性淳厚，胡三小姐嫁了他一定不会吃亏，
The matchmaker argued that his honest, kindly nature would ensure that Hu’s daughter was never mistreated.

而况又是独子；定受翁姑的宠爱。
As an only son’s wife, she would also be cherished by her parents-in-law.

至于家世，富虽远不敌胡雪岩，但有『善人』的名声弥补，亦可说是门当户对，
Wang’s wealth fell far short of Hu’s, but his reputation for benevolence made up the difference; the families could be considered suitable equals.

所欠缺的只不过阿牛是个白丁；
The sole deficiency had been A’niu’s lack of a degree.

如今中了秀才，俗语说『秀才乃宰相之根苗』，前程远大，
Now a licentiate, he had a promising future: as the saying went, “A licentiate is the seedling of a chief minister.”

实在是头良缘匹配的好亲事。
It was an excellent match.

这番说词，言之成理，
The argument was reasonable.

加以胡老太太认为阿牛是独子，胡三小姐嫁了过去，即无妯娌，就不会受气，
Hu’s mother particularly valued the fact that, with no brothers-in-law’s wives in the household, her granddaughter would suffer no friction from sisters-in-law.

因而作主许婚，只写信告诉胡雪岩有这回事，催他快回杭州，因为择定七月初七『传红』。
She therefore accepted, merely writing to inform Hu and urge him home: the formal betrothal ceremony was set for the seventh day of the seventh month.

回到杭州，才知道王家迎娶的吉期也定下了，是十一月初五；
On returning, he learned that the wedding too had been fixed, for the fifth day of the eleventh month.

为的是王善人的老娘，风烛残年，朝不保夕，急于想见孙媳妇进门；
Wang’s aged mother was frail and might die at any time; she longed to see her grandson’s bride enter the household.

倘或去世，要三年之后才能办喜事，耽误得太久了。
If she died first, the wedding would have to wait three years, an excessive delay.

这番理由，光明正大，胡老太太深以为是，
The reasoning was entirely proper, and Hu’s mother agreed.

好在嫁妆是早就备好了的，
Fortunately the dowry had long been prepared.

只要再办一批时新的洋货来添妆就是了。
Only some fashionable foreign goods remained to be added.


但办喜事的规模，却要等胡雪岩来商量；
The scale of the celebration, however, awaited Hu’s return.

这件事要四个人来决定，便是胡雪岩与他的母、妻、妾——螺蛳太太。
Four people had to decide: Hu, his mother, his wife, and his concubine, Madam Luosi.

而这四个人都有一正一反的两种想法，
All four had conflicting inclinations.

除了胡雪岩以外，其余三人都觉得场面应该收束，但胡老太太最喜欢这个小孙女儿，怕委屈了她；
The three women favoured restraint, yet Hu’s mother loved this youngest granddaughter best and feared slighting her.

胡太太则认为应该一视同仁，她的两个姐姐是啥场面，她也应该一样地风光；
His wife wanted equal treatment: the girl should enjoy the same splendour as her two elder sisters.

螺蛳太太则是为自己的女儿设想，
Madam Luosi thought of her own daughter.

因为开了一个例子在那里，将来自己的女儿出阁，排场也就阔不起来了。
A restrained wedding now would set a precedent limiting the display when her daughter married.

至于胡雪岩当然愈阔愈好，但市面不景气，怕惹了批评。
Hu naturally preferred the grandest possible occasion, but feared criticism in a depressed market.

因此谈了两天没有结果；
Two days of discussion produced no decision.

最后是胡雪岩自己下了个结论∶『场面总也要过得去，
At last he concluded, “The occasion must be respectable.

是大是小，相差也有限；
The difference between a large and small celebration is limited anyway.

好在还有四个月的工夫，到时候再看吧。』
There are still four months; we shall see how matters stand.”

『场面是摆给人家看的。』螺蛳太太接口说道∶『嫁妆是自己实惠。
“The celebration is for other people to look at,” Madam Luosi observed. “The dowry brings real benefit.

三小姐的陪嫁，一定要风光；这样子，到时候场面就小一点，
Give Third Miss a splendid dowry, and a smaller celebration will do.

对外说起来是市面不好；对内，三小姐也不会觉得委屈，
Publicly, we can explain that business is poor; privately, she will not feel slighted.

就是男家也不会有话说。』
Even the bridegroom’s family can have no objection.”

这番见解，真是面面俱到，
This considered every side.

胡老太太与胡太太听了都很舒服；胡雪岩则认为惟有如此，就算排场不大，但嫁妆风光，也就不失面子了。
Both Hu’s mother and his wife were pleased, while Hu felt that a magnificent dowry would preserve his dignity even without a lavish ceremony.


『罗四姐的话不错。
“Sister Luo is right.

嫁妆上不能委屈她。
We must not stint the dowry.

不过添妆也只有就现成的备办了。』
But the additions will have to be bought ready-made.”

『那只有到上海去。』胡太太接着她婆婆的话说，同时看着罗四姐。
“Then someone must go to Shanghai,” Hu’s wife said after her mother-in-law, looking at Madam Luosi.

罗四姐很想自告奋勇，但一转念间，决定保持沉默；
Madam Luosi wanted to volunteer, but reconsidered and remained silent.

因为胡家人多嘴杂，
There were too many tongues in the household.

即使尽力，必定也还有人在背后说闲话，甚至造谣言∶三小姐不是她生的，她哪里舍得花钱替三小姐添妆。
However hard she tried, someone would talk behind her back, perhaps alleging that she begrudged the expense because Third Miss was not her own daughter.

胡雪岩原以为她会接口，
Hu had expected her to respond.

看她不作声，便只好作决定了，
When she did not, he decided for her.

『上海是你熟，
“You know Shanghai.

你去一趟。』他说∶『顺便也看看七姑奶奶。』
Go there, and visit the Seventh Lady while you are about it.”

『为三小姐的喜事，我到上海去一趟，是千应万该的。
“Of course I should go for Third Miss’s wedding.

不过，首饰这样东西，贵不一定好；
But expensive jewellery is not necessarily pleasing.

我去当然挑贵的买，只怕买了来，花样款式不中三小姐的意。
Naturally I would choose costly pieces, yet their designs might not suit her taste.”

我看，』螺蛳太太笑一笑说∶『我陪小姐到上海，请她自己到洋行、银楼里去挑。』
She smiled. “Why not let me take her and have her choose for herself at the foreign firms and jewellers?”

『不作兴的！』胡老太太用一口道地的杭州话说∶『没有出门的姑娘儿，自己去挑嫁妆，
“Quite improper!” the Old Madam exclaimed in broad Hangzhou speech. “An unmarried girl choosing her own dowry!

传出去把人家笑都笑煞了。』
People would laugh themselves sick if they heard of it.”

『就是你去吧！』胡雪岩重复一句。
“You go yourself,” Hu repeated.


螺蛳太太仍旧不作承诺，
Madam Luosi still would not commit herself.

『不晓得三小姐有没有兴致去走一趟？』她自语似地说。
“I wonder whether Third Miss might enjoy a visit,” she murmured, as if to herself.

『不必了。』胡太太∶『三丫头喜欢怎么样的首饰，莫非你还不清楚？』
“There is no need,” Hu’s wife said. “Surely you know what jewellery she likes.”

最后还是由胡老太太一言而决，由螺师太太一个人到上海去采办。
Finally the Old Madam settled the matter: Madam Luosi would go alone.

当然，她要先问一问胡三小姐的爱好，还有胡太太的意见，
She would, of course, first consult the girl’s preferences and Hu’s wife’s wishes.

同时最要紧的是，一个花费的总数，这是只有胡雪岩才能决定的。
Most important was a spending limit, which only Hu could set.

『她这副嫁妆，已经用了十几万银子了。
“The dowry has already cost over a hundred thousand taels.

现在添妆，最多再用五万银子。』
Spend no more than another fifty thousand on additions.

胡雪岩说∶『上海银根很紧，银根紧，东西一定便宜，
Money is tight in Shanghai, so goods must be cheap.

五万银子起码好当七万用。』
Fifty thousand should buy at least seventy thousand’s worth.”


到了上海，由古应春陪着，到德商别发洋行里一问，
In Shanghai, Gu accompanied her to the German firm Biefa.

才知道胡雪岩的话适得其反。
Their first inquiries showed that the opposite was true.

国内的出产，为了脱货求现，削价出售，固然不错，但舶来品却反而涨价了。
Domestic products were indeed being discounted for ready cash, but imported goods had risen in price.

『古先生，』洋行的管事解释∶『局势一天比一天紧，
“The situation grows more tense every day, Mr Gu,” the manager explained.

法国的宰相换过了，现在的这个叫茹斐理，手段很强硬，
“France has a new premier, Jules Ferry, a very determined man.

如果中国在越南那方面，不肯让步，他决心跟中国开仗。
If China refuses to yield over Vietnam, he means to go to war.

自从外国报纸登了法国水师提督孤拔到越南的消息以后，各洋行的货色，马上都上涨了一成到一成五；
Ever since the foreign newspapers reported Admiral Courbet’s arrival in Vietnam, goods at every foreign firm have risen by ten to fifteen per cent.

现在是有的东西连出价都买不到了。』
Some things cannot now be bought at any price.”

『这是为啥？』螺蛳太太发问。
“Why?” Madam Luosi asked.

『胡太太，战事一起，法国兵舰封住中国的海口，外国商船不能来；
“If war begins, French warships will close China’s ports and foreign merchant ships will be unable to enter.

货色断档，那时候的价钱，老实说一句，要多少就是多少，
Once supplies stop, sellers can ask whatever they please.

只问有没有，不问贵不贵，
The question will be whether an article is available, not whether it is dear.

所以现在卖一样少一样，大家拿好东西都收起来了。』
Every item sold now is one less for later, so everyone is putting the best goods aside.”

『怪不得！』
“No wonder!”

螺蛳太太指着玻璃柜子中的首饰说∶『这里的东西，没有一样是看得上眼的。』
She pointed at the jewellery in the glass cabinets. “There is nothing here I like.”

『胡太太的眼光当然不同。』
“Your taste is naturally exceptional, Madam Hu.

那管事说道，『我们对老主顾，不敢得罪的。
We would not risk offending an old customer.

胡太太想置办哪些东西，我开保险箱，请胡太太挑。』
Tell me what you require, and I shall open the safe for you.”

螺蛳太太知道，在中国的洋人，不分国籍，都是很团结的；
Madam Luosi knew that foreigners in China, whatever their nationality, acted together.

他们亦有『同行公议』的规矩，
They too had agreements among traders.

这家如此，另一家亦复如此，『货比三家不吃亏』这句话用不上，
One firm would be much like another, so the maxim about comparing three shops would be little use.

倒不如自己用『大主顾』的身分来跟他谈谈条件。
Better to negotiate as a major customer.


『我老实跟你说，我是替我们家三小姐来办嫁妆，
“To be frank, I am buying a dowry for our third daughter.

谈得拢，几万银子的生意，我都作成了你。
If we agree, I shall give you the entire order—several tens of thousands of taels.

不然，说老实话，上海滩上的大洋行，不是你别发一家。』
Otherwise, Biefa is hardly Shanghai’s only large foreign firm.”

听说是几万银子的大生意，那管事不敢怠慢，
The prospect demanded attention.

『办三小姐的嫁妆，马虎不得。
“Third Miss’s dowry must be treated seriously.

胡太太，你请里面坐！』
Please come inside.

他说∶『如果胡太太开了单子，先交给我，我照单配齐了，送进来请你看。』
If you have a list, let me take it and assemble the goods for you to examine.”

螺蛳太太是开好了一张单子的，但不肯泄漏底细，
She had prepared a list but would not reveal her hand.

只说∶『我没有单子。
“No list.

只要东西好，价钱克己，我就多买点。
If the goods are good and the prices reasonable, I shall buy more.

你先拿两副钻镯我看看。』
First show me two pairs of diamond bracelets.”

中外服饰时尚不同，
Chinese and Western fashions differed.

对中国主顾来说，最珍贵的首饰，就是钻镯；
To Chinese customers, diamond bracelets were the most precious jewellery.

那管事一听此话，心知嫁妆的话不假，这笔生意做下来，确有好几万银子，
The request confirmed that she really was buying a dowry and that the order might indeed run to tens of thousands.

是难得一笔大生意，便愈发巴结了。
The manager became still more attentive.

将螺蛳太太与古应春请到他们大班专用的小客厅，还特为找了个会说中国话的外籍女店员招待；
He escorted her and Gu to the foreign director’s private sitting room and specially brought in a foreign saleswoman who spoke Chinese.

名叫艾敦，螺蛳太太便叫她『艾小姐。』
Her name was Aidun; Madam Luosi called her “Miss Ai.”


『艾小姐，你是哪里人？』
“Where are you from, Miss Ai?”

『我出生在爱丁堡。』艾敦一面调着奶茶，一面答说。
“I was born in Edinburgh,” she replied while preparing tea with milk.

螺蛳太太不知道这个地名，古应春便即解释∶『她是英国人。』
Madam Luosi did not know the place, so Gu explained that she was British.

『喔！』螺蛳太太说道∶『你们英国同我们中国一样的，
“Then your country is like ours,” Madam Luosi said.

都是老太后当权。』
“Both are ruled by an old empress dowager.”

艾敦虽会说中国话，也不过是日常用语，
Aidun’s Chinese covered everyday conversation only.

什么『老太后当权』，就跟螺蛳太太听到『爱丁堡』这个地名一样，瞠目不知所对。
Talk of an “empress dowager ruling” left her as bewildered as the name Edinburgh had left Madam Luosi.

这就少不得又要靠古应春来疏通了∶『她是指你们英国的维多利亚女皇，跟我们中国的慈禧太后。』
Gu had to explain again. “She means your Queen Victoria and our Empress Dowager Cixi.”

『喔，』艾敦颇为惊异，
Aidun was surprised.

因为她也接待过许多中国的女顾客，除了北里娇娃以外，间或也有贵妇与淑女，但从没有一个人在谈话时会提到英国女皇。
She had served many Chinese women—courtesans, and occasionally ladies of rank or respectable young women—but none had mentioned the British queen.

因为如此，便大起好感，招待螺蛳太太用午茶，非常殷勤。
She warmed to Madam Luosi and served her afternoon tea with particular care.

接着，管事的捧来了三个长方盒子，一律黑色真皮，上烫金字，
The manager then brought three oblong boxes, all of black leather with gold lettering.

打开第一个盒子，蓝色鹅绒上，嵌着一双光芒四射的白金钻镯，
Inside the first, a pair of brilliantly sparkling platinum bracelets set with diamonds rested on blue velvet.

镶嵌得非常精致。
The workmanship was exquisite.


仔细看去，盒子虽新，白金的颜色却似有异，
On closer inspection, however, the box looked new while the metal’s colour seemed otherwise.

『这是旧的？』她问。
“These are used?” she asked.

『是的。
“Yes.

这是拿破仑皇后心爱的首饰。』
They were favourite jewels of Napoleon’s empress.”

『我不管什么皇后。』
“I care nothing for empresses.

螺蛳太太说∶『嫁妆总是新的好。』
New things are better for a dowry.”

『这两副都是新的。』
“Both these other pairs are new.”

另外西副，一副全钻，一副镶了红蓝宝石，
One was set entirely with diamonds; the other combined diamonds with rubies and sapphires.

论贵重是全钻的那副，
The all-diamond pair was the more valuable.

每一只有四粒黄豆大的钻石，用碎钻连接，拿在手里不动都会闪耀；
Each bracelet held four diamonds the size of soybeans, linked by smaller stones, and glittered even when held still.

但谈到华丽，却要算镶宝石的那副。
For splendour, however, the coloured stones excelled.

『什么价钱？』
“What are the prices?”

『这副三万五，镶宝石的这副三万二。』
“Thirty-five thousand for these; thirty-two thousand for the pair with coloured stones.

管事的说∶『胡太太，我劝你买全钻的这副，
I advise the all-diamond pair, Madam Hu.

虽然贵三千银子，其实比镶宝的划算。』
It costs three thousand more but is better value.”

螺蛳太太委决不下，便即说道∶『艾小姐，请你戴起来我看看。』
Unable to decide, she asked Aidun to put them on.


艾敦便一只手腕戴一样，平伸出来让她仔细鉴赏，
Aidun wore one kind on each wrist and held out her arms for inspection.

螺蛳太太看了半天转眼问道∶『七姐夫，你看呢？』
After a long look, Madam Luosi turned to Gu. “What do you think, Brother-in-law?”

『好，当然是全钻的这副好，可惜太素净了。』
“The all-diamond pair is better, certainly, but rather too plain in colour.”

这看法跟螺蛳太太的完全一样，顿时作了决定，
This exactly matched her own view, and she decided at once.

『又是新娘子，又是老太太在，不宜太素净。』
“For a bride, with the Old Madam present, the effect should not be too subdued.”

她向管事说道∶『我东西是挑定了，
She turned to the manager. “I have chosen.

现在要谈价钱，价钱谈不拢，挑也是白挑。
Now we must discuss the price, or choosing is pointless.

我倒请问你，这副镯子是啥时候来的？』
When did these bracelets arrive?”

『一年多了。』
“More than a year ago.”

『那末一年以前，你的标价是多少？』
“What price did you mark them at then?”

『三万。』
“Thirty thousand.”

『这不相信，
“I do not believe it.

你现在只涨了两千银子，一成都不到。』
You have added only two thousand—less than ten per cent.”

『我说的是实话。』
“It is true.”

管事的从天鹅绒衬底的夹层中，抽出来一张标鉴说∶『古先生，请你看。』
He drew a label from beneath the velvet lining. “Mr Gu, please look.”

标签上确是阿拉伯字的『三万』；
The Arabic numerals did indeed read thirty thousand.

螺蛳太太也识洋数码，她的心思很快，
Madam Luosi could read them too and responded quickly.

随即说道∶『你刚才自己说过，买全钻的这副划算，可见得买这副不划算。
“You yourself said the all-diamond pair was better value, so this one must be poor value.

必是当初就乱标的一个码子，大概自己都觉得良心上过不去，所以只涨了一成不到，
You must have marked an excessive price originally and felt too guilty to raise it by even ten per cent.

是不是？』
Is that not so?”

『胡太太真厉害。』管事的苦笑道∶『驳得我都没有话好说了。』
The manager smiled ruefully. “You are formidable, Madam Hu. I have no answer.”


螺蛳太太一笑说∶『大家驳来驳去，尽管是讲道理，到底也伤和气。
She smiled. “However reasonable our arguments, too much disputing spoils goodwill.

这样，镯子我一定买你的，
Let us do this: I shall certainly buy the bracelets from you.

现在我们先看别的东西，镯子的价钱留到最后再谈，好不好？』是，是。『。
Show me the other goods first, and we shall settle their price last.” He agreed.

于是看水晶盘碗、看香水、看各种奇巧摆设；
They examined crystal plates and bowls, perfumes, and all manner of ingenious ornaments.

管事的为了想把那副镶宝钻镯卖个好价钱，在这些货色上的开价都格外公道。
Hoping to obtain a good price for the gem-set bracelets, the manager priced these other articles especially fairly.

挑停当了，最后再谈镯价。
Once her choices were complete, they returned to the bracelets.

『这里一共是一万二。』螺蛳太太说道∶『我们老爷交代，添妆不能超过四万银子；
“These goods total twelve thousand,” she said. “My husband told me not to spend more than forty thousand on additions to the dowry.

你看怎么样？』
What do you say?

她紧接着又说∶『不要讨价还价，成不成一句话。』
No bargaining now—yes or no.”

『胡太太，』管事的答说∶『你这一记「翻天印」下来，教我怎么招架？』
“Madam Hu, how can I withstand such a crushing stroke?”

『做生意不能勉强。
“Business cannot be forced.

镯子价钱谈不拢，我只好另外去物色；
If we cannot agree on the bracelets, I must look elsewhere.

这一万二是谈好了的，我先打票子给你。』
The twelve thousand is settled; I shall draw you a draft for that now.”

管事的楞住了，只好示意艾敦招待螺蛳太太喝茶吃点心，将古应春悄悄拉到一边，
Stunned, the manager signalled Aidun to serve more tea and refreshments, then quietly drew Gu aside.

苦笑着说∶『这胡太太手段我真服了。
“I truly admire her methods,” he said with a bitter smile.

为了迁就，后来看的那些东西，都是照本卖的，
“To accommodate her, I offered those later goods at cost.

其中一盏水晶大吊灯，盛道台出过三千银子，我们没有卖，卖给胡太太只算两千五。
Intendant Sheng offered three thousand for one of the large crystal chandeliers, and we refused; I have charged her only two thousand five hundred.

如果胡太太不买镯子，我这笔生意做下来，饭碗都要敲破了。』
If she does not buy the bracelets, this transaction will cost me my job.”

『她并不是不买，
“She is willing to buy.

是你不卖。』
You are unwilling to sell.”


『哪里是我不卖？
“It is not that I am unwilling.

价钱不对。』
The price is wrong.”

古应春说∶『做这笔生意，赚钱其次；
“Profit is secondary here.

不赚也就是赚了！
Even without it, you gain.

这话怎么说呢？胡财神嫁女儿，漂亮的嫁妆是别发洋行承办的，你想想看，这句话值多少钱？』
Consider the value of people saying that Biefa supplied the splendid dowry when Hu, the God of Wealth, married off his daughter.”

『原就是贪图这个名声，才各外迁就，
“That reputation is precisely why I have been so accommodating.

不过总价四万银子，这笔生意实在做不下来！』
But I really cannot conclude the business at forty thousand.”

『要亏本？』
“Would you lose money?”

『亏本虽不至于，
“Not exactly.

不过以后的行情——』『以后是以后，现在是现在。』
But future prices—” “The future is the future; this is now.

古应春抢着说道∶『说老实话，市面很坏，有钱的人都在逃难了；
Frankly, trade is poor, and wealthy people are already fleeing the danger.

以后你们也未见得有这种大生意上门。』
You may not see another order like this later.”

管事的沉默了好一会才说了句∶『这笔生意我如果答应下来，我的花红就都要赔进去了。』
After a long silence, the manager said, “If I accept, I shall sacrifice my entire bonus.”

古应春知道洋行中的规矩，薪金颇为微薄，全靠售货的奖金，
Gu knew how foreign firms worked: salaries were modest, and employees depended on sales bonuses.

看他的神情不象说假话，
The man seemed truthful.

足见螺蛳太太杀得太凶；也就是间接证明，确是买到了便宜货，
Madam Luosi had plainly bargained very hard—which also confirmed that she was obtaining excellent value.

因此觉得应该略作让步，免得错过了机会。
Some concession was needed lest they lose the opportunity.


『你说这话，我要帮你的忙。』他将声音放极轻，
“In that case, I shall help you,” Gu said, lowering his voice.

『我作主，请胡太太私下津贴你五百两银子，弥补你的损失。』
“I shall take responsibility for having Madam Hu give you five hundred taels privately to compensate for your loss.”

管事的未餍所欲，
The manager wanted more.

但人家话已说在前面，是帮他的忙，倘或拒绝，变成不识抬举，不但生意做不成，而且得罪了大主顾，
But Gu had presented this as a favour; refusing would look ungrateful, lose the sale, and offend a major customer.

真正不是『生意经』了。
That was hardly sound business.

这样一转念头，别无选择，
He had no real choice.

『多谢古先生。』
“Thank you, Mr Gu.

他说∶『正好大班在这里，
The director happens to be here.

我跟他去说明白。
I shall explain the position to him.

古先生即然能替胡太太作主，那么，答应我的话，此刻就先不必告诉胡太太。』
Since you can decide for Madam Hu, there is no need to tell her of your promise just yet.”

古应春明白，
Gu understood.

他是怕螺蛳太太一不小心，露出口风来，
The manager feared that she might carelessly let something slip.

照洋人的看法，这种私下收受顾客津贴的行为，等于舞弊，
To the foreign owners, accepting a private payment from a customer amounted to dishonesty.

一旦发觉，不但敲破碗饭，而且有吃官司的可能。
Discovery could mean not only dismissal but prosecution.

因而重重点头，表示充分领会。
Gu nodded emphatically to show that he fully understood.

于是，管事的向螺蛳太太告个罪，入内去见大班。
The manager excused himself to Madam Luosi and went to see the director.

不多片刻，带了一名洋人出来，碧眼方颐，留两撇往上翅的菱角须，
Soon he returned with a blue-eyed foreigner, square-jawed and wearing an upward-curving moustache.

古应春一看便知是德国人。
Gu recognized him at once as German.



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第七章（本章第2部分，共6部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


果然，是别发的经理威廉士，
The newcomer was indeed Biefa’s manager, Weilianshi.

他不会说英语，而古应春不通德文，需要管事的翻译；
He spoke no English, while Gu knew no German, so the head clerk had to interpret.

经过介绍，很客气地见了礼。
Introductions and courteous greetings followed.

威廉士表示，他亦久慕胡雪岩的名声，爱女出阁，能在别发洋行办嫁妆，在他深感荣幸。
Weilianshi said that he had long admired Hu’s reputation and felt deeply honored that Biefa should supply the dowry for his beloved daughter’s marriage.

至于价格方面，是否损及成本，不足计较，
Whether the price fell below cost was hardly worth considering.

除了照螺蛳太太的开价成交以外，他打算另外特制一只银盘，作为贺礼。
He would accept Madam Luosi’s offer and, in addition, have a silver salver specially made as a wedding gift.

听到这里，螺蛳太太大为高兴，忍不住对古应春笑道∶『有这样的好事，
Delighted, she could not resist turning to Gu with a smile. “Such good fortune!

倒没有想到。』
I never expected it.”

『四姐，你慢点高兴。』古应春答说∶『看样子，另外还有话。』
“Do not rejoice too soon, Sister Luo,” he answered. “I think there is something more.”

『古先生看得真准。』管事的接口，
“Mr Gu sees very clearly,” the clerk said.

『我们大班有个主意，想请胡太太允许，
“Our manager has a proposal for Madam Hu.

就是想把胡三小姐的这批嫁妆，在我们洋行里陈列一个月，
He would like to display the Third Miss’s dowry here for a month.

陈列期满，由我们派专差护送到杭州交货。』
Afterward, we would send a special escort to deliver it in Hangzhou.”

在他说到一半时，古应春已经向螺蛳太太递了个眼色；
Halfway through this explanation, Gu had given Madam Luosi a warning glance.

因此，她只静静地听着，不置可否，让古应春去应付。
She therefore listened quietly, neither agreeing nor refusing, and left him to answer.

『你们预备怎么样陈列？』
“How would you display it?”


『我们辟半间店面，用红丝绳拦起来，作为陈列所。』
“We would set aside half the shop and cordon it off with red silk ropes.”

『要不要作说明？』
“Would there be an explanation?”

『当然要。』
“Naturally.

管事的说∶『这是大家有面子的事。』
It is something that brings distinction to everyone.”

『不错，大家有面子。
“Certainly.

不过，这件事我们要商量商量。』
But we must discuss it.

古应春问道∶『这是不是一个交易的条件？』
Is this a condition of the sale?”

管事的似乎颇感意外——
The clerk looked surprised.

在他的想法，买主决无不同意之理∶因而问道∶『古先生，莫非一陈列出来，有啥不方便的地方。
He had never imagined that the buyers could object. “Would displaying it cause some inconvenience, Mr Gu?”

『是的，或许有点不方便，
“Possibly.

原因现在不必说。
There is no need to explain why just now.

能不能陈列，现在也还不能定规，
Nor can we yet decide whether to agree.

只请你问一问你们大班，如果我们不愿意陈列，这笔交易是不是就不成功了。』
Please ask your manager only this: if we decline the display, does the sale fall through?”

管事的点点头，与他们大班用德国话交谈了好一会，
The clerk nodded and spoke with his employer in German for some time.

答复古应春说∶『我们大班说∶这是个额外的要求，不算交易的条件。
“He says this is an additional request, not a condition of the sale.

不过，我们真的很希望古先生能赏我们一个面子。』
But we sincerely hope you will do us the honor.”

『这不是我的事。』古应春急忙分辩，
“It is not my decision,” Gu explained quickly.

『就象你所说的，这是大家有面子的事，我亦很希望能陈列出来。
“As you say, the display would bring credit to everyone, and I too would like to see it.

不过，胡大先生是朝廷的大员，
But Mr Hu is a senior servant of the court.

他的官声也很要紧。
His public reputation matters.

万一不能如你们大班的愿，要请他原谅。』
If we cannot meet your manager’s wishes, we must ask his understanding.”

一提到『官声』，管事的明白了，连连点头说道∶『好的，好的。
At the mention of an official’s reputation, the clerk understood and nodded repeatedly. “Of course.

请问古先生，啥辰光可以听回音？』
When might we hear your answer?”


古应春考虑了一会答说∶『这样，你把今天所看的货色，开一张单子，注明价钱，明天上午到我那里来，谈付款的办法。
After considering, Gu said, “Prepare a list of everything we saw today, with the prices, and come to my house tomorrow morning to discuss payment.

至于能不能陈列，明天也许可以告诉你，
I may be able to answer about the display then.

倘或要写信到杭州，那就得要半个月以后，才有回音』『好的，我照吩咐办。』
If we must write to Hangzhou, however, it will take another half month.” “Certainly.

管事的答说∶『明天我亲自到古先生府上去拜访。』
I shall call on you myself tomorrow.”

对于这天的『别发』之行，螺蛳太太十分得意，
Madam Luosi was extremely pleased with the day’s visit to Biefa.

坐在七姑奶奶床前的安乐椅上，口讲指划，
Sitting in the armchair beside the Seventh Lady’s bed, she described it with lively words and gestures.

津津乐道古应春谈到私下许了管事五百两银子的津贴，螺蛳太太不但认帐，而且很夸奖他处理得法。
When Gu mentioned privately promising the clerk five hundred taels in compensation, she not only accepted the expense but praised his handling of it.

见此光景，七姑奶奶当然亦很高兴。
Naturally, the Seventh Lady was pleased too.

『还有件事，』螺蛳太太说∶『请七姐夫来讲。』
“There is one other matter,” Madam Luosi said. “Let my brother-in-law explain.”

『不是讲，是要好好商量。』
“It needs discussion, not merely explanation.”

古应春谈了陈列一事，接着问道∶『你们看怎么样？』
Gu described the proposed display and asked their opinion.

『我看没有啥不可以。』螺蛳太太问道∶『七姐，你说呢？』
“I see no objection,” Madam Luosi said. “What do you think, Seventh Sister?”

『恐怕太招摇。』
“It might be too ostentatious.”

『尤其，』古应春接口，『现在山东在闹水灾；局势又不大好，
“Especially now,” Gu added, “with floods in Shandong and the general situation unsettled.

恐怕会有人说闲话。』
People may criticize.”

听得这话，螺蛳太太不作声，
Madam Luosi fell silent.

看一看七姑奶奶，脸色阴下来了。
She glanced at the Seventh Lady, and her face darkened.


『应春，』七姑奶奶使个眼色，『你给我摇个「德律风」给医生，
“Yingchun,” the Seventh Lady said, giving him a look, “telephone the doctor for me.

说我的药水喝完了，再配两服来。』
Tell him my mixture is finished and ask for two more doses.”

古应春会意，点点头往外便走，好容她们说私说话。
Understanding, Gu nodded and went out, leaving the women free to speak privately.

『七姐，』螺蛳太太毫不掩饰她内心的欲望，『我真想把我们三小姐添妆的这些东西陈列出来，让大家看看。』
“Seventh Sister,” Madam Luosi said without disguising her wish, “I truly want these additions to our Third Miss’s dowry displayed for everyone to see.”

七姑奶奶没有想到她对这件事如此重视，而且相当认真，
The Seventh Lady had not imagined that she cared so deeply and seriously about it.

不由得楞在那里说不出话。
For a moment she could say nothing.

在螺蛳太太，做事发议论，不发则已一发就一定要透彻，
Once Madam Luosi expressed an opinion, she always carried it through thoroughly.

所以接着她自己的话又说∶『那个德国人，不说我再也想不到∶一说，我马上就动心了。
“If that German had not suggested it, the idea would never have occurred to me. The moment he spoke, I wanted it.

七姐，你想想，嫁女儿要花多少工夫，
Think of all the work that goes into marrying off a daughter.

为来为去为点啥？
What is it for?

为的是一个场面。
To make a splendid occasion.

发嫁妆要教大家都来看，
When the dowry goes out, everyone should come to look.

人愈多，愈有面子，
The more people, the greater the honor.

花了多少心血，光看那一天，人人称赞、个个羡慕，心里头就会说∶』喏，这就叫人生在世！
After all the care and effort, to hear praise and envy on that one day makes one think: ‘Ah, this is what it means to live!’

「七姐，拿你我当初做女儿的辰光，看大户人家嫁女儿，心里头的感想，
Remember how we felt as girls, watching wealthy families marry their daughters.

来想想」大先生「现在的心境，
Think of Mr Hu’s feelings now.

你说，那个德国人的做法，要不要动心？『
Would the German’s proposal not tempt him?”


大姑奶奶的想法，开始为她引入同一条路子了。
The Seventh Lady’s thoughts began to follow the same course.

大贵大富之家，讲到喜庆的排场，最重视的是为父母做寿及嫁女儿，
In rich and distinguished families, the grandest celebrations were parents’ birthdays and daughters’ marriages.

但做寿在『花甲』以后，还有『古稀∶』古稀『以后还有八十、九十，讲排场的机会还有；
Yet after sixty came seventy, and after seventy, eighty or ninety: there would be further opportunities for splendid birthdays.

只有嫁女儿，风光只得一次，
A daughter’s wedding came only once.

父母能尽其爱心的，也只有这一次，所以踵事增华，多少阔都可以摆。
Parents had only that occasion on which to show their love in full, and could therefore add magnificence to magnificence without limit.

七姑奶奶小时候曾看过一家巨室发嫁妆，殿后的是八名身穿深蓝新布袍的中年汉子，
As a child, the Seventh Lady had seen one great household’s dowry procession end with eight middle-aged men in new dark-blue robes.

每人手里一个朱漆托盘，盘中是一本厚厚的毛蓝布面的簿子，
Each carried a red-lacquered tray holding a thick ledger bound in coarse blue cloth.

这算什么陪嫁？
What sort of dowry was that?

问起来才知道那家的陪嫁中，有八家当铺。
On asking, she learned that the bride was receiving eight pawnshops.

那八名中年汉子，便是八家当铺的朝奉，盘中所捧，自然是那当铺的总帐。
The eight men were their senior appraisers, and the books their general ledgers.

这种别开生面的』嫁妆『，真正是面子十足，令人历久难忘。
Such an extraordinary dowry displayed wealth so impressively that the memory never faded.

如今别发洋行要陈列胡三小姐的一部分嫁妆，在上海这个五方杂处的地方，
Now Biefa proposed to exhibit part of the Third Miss’s dowry in Shanghai, where people from every region gathered.

有这样一件新闻，会弄得云贵四川，再僻远的地力也会有『胡雪岩嫁女儿』如何阔气这么一个传说，
News of it could carry stories of Hu’s lavish wedding preparations to Yunnan, Guizhou, Sichuan, and the remotest places.

这是花多少钱也买不来的一件事，
No amount of money could buy that publicity.

难怪螺蛳太太要动心。
Small wonder Madam Luosi was tempted.

『大先生平生所好的是个面子；
“What Mr Hu loves above all is prestige.

有这样一件有面子的事，我拿它放过了，自己觉得也太对不起大先生了。
If I let such an opportunity pass, I should feel I had failed him.

七姐，你说呢？』
Do you not agree?”


『那，』七姑奶奶说∶『何不问问他自己？』
“Then why not ask him?” the Seventh Lady suggested.

『这不能问的。
“We cannot.

一问┅┅』螺蛳太太停了一下说∶『七姐，
If we ask—” Madam Luosi paused.

你倒替他设身处地想一想呢！』
“Put yourself in his place.”

稍为想一想就知道行不通。
A moment’s thought showed the difficulty.

凡是一个人好虚面子，口中决不肯承认的，
A man fond of outward show would never admit it.

问到他，一定拿『算了，算了』这些不热中但也不反对的语气来答复。
Asked directly, he would say, “Never mind, never mind,” in a tone neither eager nor actually opposed.

不过，现在情势不同，似乎可以跟他切切实实谈一谈。
Yet circumstances were different now; perhaps they could discuss the matter candidly with him.


念头尚未转定，螺蛳太太却又开口了，『七姐，』她说，

『这回我替我们三小姐来添妆，说实话，是件吃力不讨好的事，
“To tell the truth, buying these additions to the dowry is a thankless task.

价钱高低，东西好坏，没有个「准稿子」，
There is no fixed standard for prices or quality.

便宜不会有人晓得，但只要买贵了一样，就尽有人在背后说闲话了。
No one will notice a bargain, but let me overpay for one thing and there will be plenty of talk behind my back.

现在别发把我买的东西陈列出来，足见这些东西的身价，就没有人敢说闲话了。
If Biefa displays what I have bought, that proves its worth, and no one will dare complain.

到于对我们老太太，还有三小姐的娘，胡家上上下下我也足足可以交代了，
I can account for myself to our old lady, the Third Miss’s mother, and everyone in the Hu household.

我要教大家晓得，我待我们三小姐，同比我自己生的还要关心。』
I want them to know that I care for her even more than if she were my own daughter.”

最后这句话，打动了七姑奶奶，
The last words moved the Seventh Lady.

这件事对螺蛳太太在胡家的声名地位很重要。
This mattered deeply to Madam Luosi’s reputation and standing in the family.

由于别发洋行陈列了胡三小姐的嫁妆，足以证明螺蛳太太所采办的都是精品，同时也证明了螺蛳太太的贤慧，对胡三小姐爱如己出。
The exhibition would prove both the excellence of her purchases and her generosity toward a daughter she loved as her own.

从另一方面看，有这样一个出风头的机会，而竟放弃了，大家都不会了解，原因是怕太招摇，于胡雪岩的官声不利；
Conversely, if such an opportunity for distinction were refused, no one would understand that the reason was to avoid ostentation harmful to Hu’s official reputation.

只说都因为是些拿不出手的不值钱的东西，怕人笑话，所以不愿陈列，
They would say the goods were worthless and too embarrassing to show.

这一出一入之间关系的变化是太重要了。
The difference between these impressions was crucial.

七姑奶奶沉吟了好一会说∶『别发的陈列，是陈列给洋人看的；
After pondering for some time, the Seventh Lady said, “Biefa’s displays are for foreigners.

中国人进洋行的很少，陈列不陈列，不和多大的关系。
Few Chinese enter foreign shops, so it makes little difference to them whether the goods are displayed.

所以别发陈列的这些东西，我看纯然是拿给洋人看的。
These things would chiefly be shown to foreigners.

既然如此，我倒有个想法，
In that case, I have an idea.

你看行不行？』
See what you think.”


『你说。』
“Tell me.”

『陈列让他陈列，说明都用英文，
“Let them exhibit the goods, but require every description to be in English.

不准用中国字，
No Chinese characters.

这样子就不显得招摇了。』
That way it will look less ostentatious.”

螺蛳太太稍想一想，重重地答一声∶『好。』显得对七姑奶奶百依百顺似的。
After a moment Madam Luosi answered with an emphatic “Good,” seeming entirely willing to follow her lead.

于是七姑奶奶喊一声∶『妹妹！』
The Seventh Lady then called, “Little Sister!”

喊瑞香为『妹妹』，已经好几个月了；瑞香亦居之不疑，答应得很响亮，
For several months she had addressed Ruixiang that way, and Ruixiang had accepted it naturally, answering readily.

但此时有螺蛳太太在座，却显得有些忸怩，连应声都不敢，
With Madam Luosi present, however, she grew shy and did not even dare reply aloud.

只疾趋到床前，听候吩咐。
She merely hurried to the bedside to await instructions.


『你看老爷在哪里？请他来。』
“Find out where the master is and ask him to come.”

瑞香答应着走了，
Ruixiang went.

螺蛳太太便即轻声说道∶『七姐，
Madam Luosi lowered her voice.

我这趟来三件事，一是我们三小姐添妆，二是探望你的病，还有件事就是瑞香的事。
“I came for three things: the Third Miss’s dowry, a visit to you in your illness, and Ruixiang.

怎么不给他们圆房？』
Why have they still not begun married life together?”

『我催了他好几遍了。』
“I have urged him several times.”

这个他是指古应春；此时已经出现在门外，
“Him” meant Gu, who had now appeared at the door.

七姑奶奶便住了口，却对螺蛳太太做个手势，递个眼色，意思是回头细谈。
The Seventh Lady fell silent but gestured and gave Madam Luosi a look indicating that they would discuss it later.

『应春，我想到一个法子，罗四姐也赞成的。』七姑奶奶接着便说了她的办法。
“Yingchun, I have thought of a way, and Sister Luo agrees.” She explained the plan.

古应春心想，这也不过是掩耳盗铃的办法；
Gu thought it scarcely better than stopping one’s ears while stealing a bell.

不过比用中文作说明，总要好些，
Still, it was preferable to Chinese labels.

当下点点头说∶『等别发的管事来了，我告诉他。
He nodded. “I shall tell Biefa’s clerk when he comes.

不过┅┅』
But—”


他没有再说下去。七姑奶却明白，
He left the sentence unfinished, but the Seventh Lady understood.

『只要不上报，就招摇不到哪里去了。』
“Provided it stays out of the newspapers, it cannot attract too much attention.

她说∶『你同「长毛状元」不是吃花酒的好朋友？』
Are you not a friend of the ‘Rebel First Scholar’—the man you go drinking with in the pleasure quarters?”

『对！
“Yes!

你倒提醒我了；
You have reminded me.

我来打他一个招呼。』
I shall speak to him.

古应春问道。『还有什么话？』
Is there anything else?”

『就是这件事。』
“Only that.”

『那，』古应春转脸说道∶『四姐，对不起，今天晚上我不能陪你吃饭。
Gu turned to Madam Luosi. “I am sorry I cannot dine with you tonight, Sister Luo.

我同密本常有个约，很要紧的，我现在就要走了。
I have an important appointment with Mi Benchang and must leave now.

喔，还有件事，他也晓得你来了，要你吃饭，
Oh, he knows you are here and wants to invite you to dinner.

看你哪天有空？』
When would you be free?”

『不必，谢谢他罗。』
“No, thank him for me.

螺蛳太太说∶『他一个人在上海，没有家小，请我去了也不便。
He lives in Shanghai without his family; it would be awkward for me to visit.

姐夫，你替我切切实实辞一辞。
Please decline firmly on my behalf.”

『等他一走螺蛳太太有个疑团急于要打开，不知道』长毛状元『是怎么回事？』
Once Gu had gone, Madam Luosi hastened to ask about the “Rebel First Scholar.”

这个人姓王，叫王韬，你们杭州韧光的韬。
“His surname is Wang, and his name Tao—the same character as in Hangzhou’s Taoguang,” the Seventh Lady explained.

长毛得势的时候开过科，状元就是这个王韬。
“When the rebels were powerful, they held examinations, and Wang Tao came first.

上海人都叫他「长毛状元」。
Everyone in Shanghai calls him the ‘Rebel First Scholar.’”

『』那末，上报不上报，关长毛状元啥事情？
“What does that have to do with the newspapers?”

『『长毛状元在《申报》馆做事，蛮有势力的；
“He works at Shenbao and has considerable influence there.

叫应春打他一个招呼，别发陈列三小姐的嫁妆那件事，不要上报，家里不晓得就不要紧了。』
If Yingchun asks him to keep the dowry display out of the paper, the family will not hear about it, and there will be no trouble.”

原来如此！
“I see.”

『螺蛳太太瞄了瑞香一眼。
Madam Luosi glanced toward Ruixiang.


七姑奶奶立即会意，便叫瑞香去监厨；调开了她好谈她的事。
The Seventh Lady understood at once and sent Ruixiang to supervise the kitchen, freeing them to discuss her.

『我催了应春好几次，
“I have urged Yingchun several times.

他只说∶慢慢再谈。
He always says we can talk later.

因为市面不好，他说他没心思来做这件事。
Business is poor, he says, and he has no heart for such matters.

你来了正好，
Your visit is timely.

请你劝劝他；
Persuade him for me.

如果他再不听，你同他办交涉。
If he still refuses, take it up with him.”

『』办交涉？
“Take it up with him?”

『螺蛳太太诧异，』
Madam Luosi was astonished.

我怎么好同姐夫办这种交涉？
“How could I approach my brother-in-law on a matter like that?”

『『咦！
“Why not?

瑞香是你的人，
Ruixiang came from you.

你要替瑞香说话啊！』
You ought to speak for her.”

『喔！』螺蛳太太笑了，
“Ah!” Madam Luosi laughed.

『七姐，什么事到了你嘴里，没理也变有理了。？』
“Once a thing passes through your mouth, even the unreasonable becomes reasonable.”

本来就有理嘛！
“It is reasonable.”

『七姑奶奶低声说道∶』他们倒也好，一个不急；一个只怕是急在心里，嘴里不说。
The Seventh Lady lowered her voice. “They are all right: one is in no hurry, and the other is probably impatient inwardly but says nothing.

苦的是我，倒象亏欠了瑞香似的。
I am the one who suffers, feeling as though I owe Ruixiang something.”

『』好！『螺蛳太太立即接口，』有这个理由，我倒好同姐夫办交涉，
“With that reason, I certainly can take it up with him.

不怕他不挑日子。
He will have to choose a day.”

『』等他来挑，又要推三阻四了。
“If we wait for him, he will find more excuses.

不如我们来挑。
Let us choose it ourselves.

『七姑奶奶又说∶』总算也是一杯喜酒，你一定要吃了再走。
There must at least be a wedding cup of wine, and you must stay to drink it.”

『』当然。
“Of course.”

『螺蛳太太沉吟着说∶』今天八月廿八，
Madam Luosi considered. “Today is the twenty-eighth of the eighth month.

这个月小建，后天就交九月了。
This is a short month; the ninth begins the day after tomorrow.

三小姐的喜事只得两个月的工夫，
The Third Miss’s wedding is only two months away.

我亦真正是所谓归心如箭。
I really am longing to get home.”

『』我晓得，我晓得。
“I know, I know.

『七姑奶奶说∶』四姐，皇历挂在梳妆台镜子后面，
The almanac hangs behind the dressing-table mirror.

请你拿给我。
Please bring it.”

『取皇历来一翻，九月初三是』大满棚『的日子。
They consulted it and found the third day of the ninth month auspicious for everything.

由于螺蛳太太急于要回杭州，不容别作选择，
Madam Luosi’s eagerness to return to Hangzhou left no time to choose another date.

一下就决定了九月初三为古应春与瑞香圆房。
They settled at once on that day for Gu and Ruixiang to begin their married life together.


『总要替她做几件衣服，打两样首饰，七姐，
“She must have some new clothes and a couple of pieces of jewelry,” Madam Luosi said.

这算是我的陪嫁，
“Those will be my dowry gift.

你就不必管了。』
You need not trouble about them.”

『你陪嫁是你的。』七姑奶奶说∶『我也预备了一点，好象还不大够；
“Your gift is yours,” the Seventh Lady replied. “I have prepared something too, though perhaps not enough.

四姐，你不要同我客气。』
Do not stand on ceremony.”

说着，探手到枕下，取出一个阜康的存折，
Reaching beneath her pillow, she took out a Fukang passbook.

『请你明天带她去看看，
“Take her shopping tomorrow.

她喜欢啥，我托你替她买。』
Whatever she likes, please buy it for her on my behalf.”

彼此有交情在，不容她客气，更不容她推辞；
Their friendship allowed neither polite hesitation nor refusal.

螺蛳太太将折子接了过来，看都不看，便放入口袋了。
Madam Luosi took the passbook and put it into her pocket without looking inside.

『七姐，我们老太太牵挂你得好厉害。
“Our old lady worries about you so much.

十一月里，不晓得你能不能去吃喜酒？』
Will you be able to come to the wedding in the eleventh month?”

『我想去！
“I should like to.

就怕行动不便，替你们添麻烦。』
But I may have difficulty getting about and cause you trouble.”

『麻烦点啥？
“What trouble?

不过多派两个丫头老妈子照应你。
We need only assign another couple of maids or older serving women to look after you.

而况还有瑞香。』
And Ruixiang will be there.”

七姑奶奶久病在床，本就一直想到哪里去走走，此时螺蛳太太一邀，心思便更加活动了，
Long confined to bed, the Seventh Lady had often wished to go somewhere, and the invitation made her still more eager.

但最大的顾虑，还在人家办喜事已忙得不可开交，只怕没有足够的工夫来照料她。
Her chief concern was that a household already overwhelmed with wedding preparations might lack time to care for her properly.

果然有此情形，人家心里自是不安；自己忖度，内心也未见得便能泰然。
They would feel uneasy, and she herself might not be comfortable either.

因此任凭螺蛳太太极力怂恿，她仍旧觉得有考虑的必要。
Despite Madam Luosi’s encouragement, she still felt the matter required thought.


『太太，』瑞香走来说道∶『你昨天讲的两样吃食，都办来了。
“Madam,” Ruixiang said, coming in, “both dishes you mentioned yesterday have arrived.

饿不饿？
Are you hungry?

饿了我就开饭。』
If so, I shall serve dinner.”

『哪两样？』
“Which dishes?”

螺蛳太太前一天晚上闲话旧事时谈到当年尝过的几种饮食，怀念不置，不知瑞香的是哪两样，所以有此一问。
The previous evening Madam Luosi had fondly recalled several foods she used to enjoy and could not tell which two Ruixiang meant.

『太太不是说，顶想念的就是糟钵头，还有菜圆子？』
“Did you not say you missed zaobotou, the wine-lees casserole, and dumplings stuffed with greens most of all?”

『对！』
“Exactly!

螺蛳太太立即答说∶『顶想这两样，不过一定要三牌楼同陶阿大家的。』
But they must come from Sanpailou and Tao A’da’s.”

『不错，
“They do.

我特为交代过，就是这两家买来的。』
I gave particular instructions to buy from those places.

瑞香又说∶『糟钵头怕嫌油腻，奶奶不相宜，菜圆子可以吃。
The casserole may be too rich for my mistress, but she can eat the vegetable dumplings.

要不，我就把饭开到这里来。』
Shall I bring dinner in here?”

『好！好！』
“Yes, yes!”

七姑奶奶好热闹，
The Seventh Lady loved company.

连连说道∶『我从小生长在上海，三牌楼的菜圆子，只闻其名，没有见过，
“I grew up in Shanghai and have always heard of Sanpailou’s vegetable dumplings, but never seen them.

今天倒真要尝尝。』
I must try them tonight.”

『三牌楼菜圆子有好几家，
“Several shops there make them.

一定要徐寡妇家的才好。』
Widow Xu’s are the best.”

『喔，好在什么地方？』
“What is so good about them?”

原来上海称元宵的汤圆为圆子。
In Shanghai, the glutinous-rice dumplings eaten at the Lantern Festival were called yuanzi.

三牌楼徐寡妇家的圆子，货真价实。
Widow Xu’s, at Sanpailou, gave full value.

有那省俭的顾客，一碗肉圆子四枚，仅食皮子，剩下馅子便是四个肉圆，带回家用白菜粉条同烩，便可佐膳。
Frugal customers would buy a bowl containing four meat dumplings, eat only the wrappers, and take the four balls of filling home to stew with cabbage and bean-thread noodles for another meal.

但徐寡妇家最出名的却是菜圆子，
Her greatest specialty, however, was the vegetable variety.

『她说有秘诀，说穿了也不稀奇。』螺蛳太太说∶『我去吃过几回，冷眼看看，也就懂了。
“She says she has a secret, but once explained it is nothing remarkable,” Madam Luosi said. “I ate there several times and watched quietly until I understood.

秘诀就是工要细，
The secret is painstaking work.

拣顶好的菜叶子，黄的、老的都不要；
Only the finest leaves are chosen; yellow and old ones are discarded.

嫩叶子还要抽筋，抽得极干净，
Even the tender leaves have every vein stripped out.

滚水中捞一捞，斩得极细倒在夏布袋里把水分挤掉，
They are briefly blanched, chopped very fine, put into a ramie-cloth bag, and squeezed dry.

加细盐、小磨麻油拌匀，就是馅子，
Mixed thoroughly with fine salt and stone-ground sesame oil, they make the filling.

皮子用上好水磨粉，当然不必说。』
Naturally, the wrappers use the best wet-milled rice flour.”

『那末，』七姑奶奶恰好有些饿了，不由得咽了口唾沫，惹得螺蛳太太笑了。
“Then—” The Seventh Lady was just hungry enough to swallow involuntarily, making Madam Luosi laugh.



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第七章（本章第3部分，共6部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


『七姐，我老实告诉你，那种净素的菜圆子，除了老太太以外，大家都是偶尔吃一回还可以，一多，胃口就倒了。』螺蛳太太又说∶『我自己也觉得完全不是三牌楼徐家的那种味道。』
“To tell you the truth, Seventh Sister, apart from the Old Lady, everyone finds those plain vegetable dumplings pleasant enough once in a while, but too many of them spoil the appetite,” Madam Luosi said. “Even to me, ours taste quite different from the Xu family’s at Sanpailou.”

糟钵头是上海道地的所谓『本帮菜』，通常只有今天才有，
The wine-lees casserole was an authentic Shanghai dish, one of the so-called local specialities, usually available only at this time.

用猪肚、猪肝等等内脏，加肥鸡同煮，到够火候了，倾陶钵加糟，所以称之为糟钵头『。
Pork tripe, liver, and other offal were simmered with a plump chicken; when everything was properly cooked, it was poured into an earthenware pot and wine lees were added—hence its name.

糟青鱼切块，与黄芽菜同煮作汤菜，即是』川糟『。
Wine-lees-cured black carp, cut into pieces and cooked with pale-hearted Chinese cabbage as a soupy dish, was called chuanzao.

『那末，你觉得比陶阿大的是好，还是坏？』
“And do you think yours is better or worse than Tao A’da’s?”

『当然不及陶阿大的。』
“Worse, of course.

螺蛳太太说∶『不然我也不会这么想了。』
Otherwise I should not keep thinking of his.”

『只怕现在不会象你所想的那样子好。』
“I suspect his would not seem quite as good now as you remember.”

『喔，』
“Oh?

螺蛳太太问道∶『莫非换过老板？』
Has the shop changed hands?”

『菜圆子我没有吃过，县衙前陶阿大的糟钵头，我没有得病以前是吃过的。
“I have never tried those dumplings, but before I fell ill I used to eat Tao A’da’s casserole, outside the county yamen.

去年腊月里五哥从松江来了，还特为去吃过。
Last year, when Brother Five came from Songjiang in the twelfth month, he made a special trip there.

人家做得兴兴旺旺的生意，
Their business is flourishing.

为啥要换老板？』
Why should it change hands?”

『那末，』螺蛳太太也极机警，知道七姑奶奶刚才的话，别有言外之意，
Madam Luosi was quick to detect a further meaning.

便即追问∶『既然这样子，你的话总有啥道理在里头吧？
“Then there must be a reason for what you said.”

七姑奶奶想了一下说∶』我是直性子；我们又同姊妹一样。
The Seventh Lady considered. “I speak my mind, and we are as close as sisters.

我或者说错了，你不要怪我。
If I say something mistaken, do not take offence.”

『』哪里会！
“How could I?

七姐，你这话多余。『
Seventh Sister, there is no need to say that.”


『我在想，做菜圆子，或者真的有啥诀窍；
“There may indeed be some special knack to making those dumplings.

至于糟钵头，我在想，你家吃大俸禄的大司务，本事莫非就不及陶阿大？
But as for the casserole, surely your highly paid master cook is no less skilful than Tao A’da?

说到材料，别的不谈，光是从绍兴办来的酒糟，这一点就比陶阿大那里要高明了。
And as for ingredients, leaving everything else aside, the wine lees you have brought from Shaoxing are better than anything he uses.

所以府上的糟钵头，决不会比陶阿大来得差。
Your casserole cannot possibly be inferior to his.

然而，你说不及陶阿大的糟钵头这是啥道理。』
Yet you say it is. Why?”

『七姐！』螺蛳太太笑道∶『我就是问你，
“Seventh Sister!” Madam Luosi laughed. “That was what I asked you.

你怎么反倒问我？』
Why turn the question back on me?”

『依我看，糟钵头还是当年的糟钵头，
“The casserole, I think, is still the casserole of those days.

罗四姐不是当年的罗四姐了。』
But Sister Luo is no longer the Sister Luo of those days.”

七姑奶奶紧接着说∶『四姐，我这话不是说你忘本，
She hastened to add, “I do not mean that you have forgotten your beginnings.

是说此一时，彼一时，
I mean that times and circumstances change.

这番道理，也不是我悟出来的，
Nor did I discover this truth for myself.

是说书先生讲的一段故事，
It came from a story I heard a storyteller tell.

唐朝有个和尚叫懒残——』讲了懒残和尚煨芋的故事，
In the Tang dynasty there was a monk called Lancan—” She told the story of the monk roasting taro.

螺蛳太太当然决不会觉得七姑奶奶有何讽刺之意，但却久久无语，心里想得很深。
Madam Luosi certainly felt no suggestion of mockery in it, but she remained silent for a long time, deep in thought.


这时瑞香已带了小大姐来铺排餐桌，
Ruixiang now brought a maid to lay the table.

然后将七姑奶奶扶了起来，抬坐在一张特制的圈椅上，
They helped the Seventh Lady up and lifted her into a specially made round-backed chair.

椅子很大，周围用锦垫塞紧，使得七姑奶奶不必费力便能坐直，
It was large, with brocade cushions packed around her to keep her upright without effort.

前面是一块很大的活动木板，以便置放盘碗，木板四周镶嵌五分高的一道『围墙』以防汤汁倾出，以不致流得到处都是。
Across the front lay a broad, removable wooden tray for plates and bowls, edged with a little “wall” five fen high to prevent spilled soup from running everywhere.

那张圈椅跟『小儿车』的作用相同；
The chair served much the same purpose as a child’s chair.

七姑奶奶等瑞香替她系上『围嘴』以后，自嘲地笑道∶『无锡人常说「老小、老小」，
When Ruixiang had tied on her bib, the Seventh Lady laughed at herself. “People in Wuxi are always saying that the old become children again.

我真是愈老愈小了。』
The older I grow, the more of a child I am.”

『老倒不见得。』螺蛳太太笑道∶『皮肤又白又嫩，我都想摸一把。』
