“You scarcely look old,” Madam Luosi said with a smile. “Your skin is so fair and soft that I want to feel it myself.”

说着便握住她的手臂，轻轻捏了两下，
She took her arm and gave it a couple of gentle squeezes.

肌肉到底松弛了。
The flesh had lost its firmness, after all.

『是先吃圆子，还是先吃酒？』瑞香问道。
“Dumplings first, or wine?” Ruixiang asked.

菜圆子，已经煮好了，自然先吃圆子；
The dumplings were already cooked, so naturally they came first.

圆子很大，黄花累瓷饭碗中只放得下两枚，
They were so large that only two would fit in a rice bowl decorated with yellow flowers.

瑞香格外道地加一几条火腿后，两三片芫荽，
Ruixiang had taken particular pains, adding a few strips of ham and two or three coriander leaves.

红绿相映，动人食欲。
The contrast of red and green was appetizing.


『我来尝一个。』
“Let me try one.”

七姑奶奶拿汤匙舀了一枚，嘘口气，咬了一口，紧接着便咬第二口，，欣赏之意显然。
The Seventh Lady lifted a dumpling in her spoon, blew on it, and took a bite, followed immediately by another: her enjoyment was plain.

螺蛳太太也舀了一枚送入口中，接着放回圆子舀口汤喝，
Madam Luosi also put one to her lips, then set it down and tasted the soup.

『瑞香，』她疑惑地问∶『是三牌楼徐寡妇家买的？』
“Ruixiang,” she asked doubtfully, “did these come from Widow Xu’s at Sanpailou?”

『是啊！』
“Yes.”

瑞香微笑着回答。看她的笑容，便知内有蹊跷，
Ruixiang’s smile suggested a secret.

『你拿什么汤下的圆子？』她问。
“What soup did you cook them in?”

『太太尝出来了。』
“You noticed, madam!

瑞香笑道∶『新开一家广东杏花楼，
A Cantonese restaurant called Xinghua Lou has just opened.

用它家的高汤下的。』
I used their stock.”

『高汤？』
“Stock?”

在小馆子，『高汤』是白送的；肉骨头熬的汤，加一匙酱油，数粒葱花便是。
In a modest eating house, stock was free: bone broth with a spoonful of soy sauce and a sprinkling of chopped scallions.

这样的汤下菜圆子能有这样的鲜味，螺蛳太太自然要诧异了。
Madam Luosi naturally wondered how such a broth could make vegetable dumplings taste so delicious.

『杏花楼的高汤，不是同洗锅水差不多的高汤；
“Xinghua Lou’s stock is nothing like that pot-rinsing water.

它是鸡、火腿、精肉、鲫鱼，用文火熬出来的汤，
They simmer chicken, ham, lean pork, and crucian carp over a low flame.

论两卖的。』
It is sold by the liang.”

『怪不得！』七姑奶奶笑道∶『如说徐寡妇的菜圆子有这样的味道，除非她是仙人。』
“No wonder!” the Seventh Lady laughed. “If Widow Xu’s dumplings tasted like this by themselves, she would have to be an immortal.”

『瑞香倒是特别巴结我，不过我反而吃不出当年的味道来了。』
“Ruixiang has gone out of her way to please me,” Madam Luosi said, “but now I cannot recover the taste I remember at all.”


『那末太太尝尝糟钵头，
“Then try the casserole, madam.

这是陶阿大那里买回来以后，原封没有动过。』
We bought it at Tao A’da’s and have done nothing to it.”

螺蛳太太点点头，挟了一块猪肚，细细嚼；同时极力回忆当年吃糟钵头的滋味，
Madam Luosi nodded, picked up a piece of tripe, and chewed it carefully, doing her utmost to recall the flavour of the old days.

可是没有用，
It was no use.

味道还不如她家厨子做的来得好。
This tasted less good than her own cook’s.

『七姐，你的话不错。
“Seventh Sister, you were right.

我罗四姐，不是当年的罗四姐了。』
I am no longer the Sister Luo I used to be.”

七姑奶奶默不作声，
The Seventh Lady said nothing.

心里还颇有悔意，刚才的话不应该说得那么率直，惹起她的伤感。
She rather regretted speaking so bluntly and making her friend sad.


瑞香却不知她们打的什么哑谜，瞪圆了一双大眼睛发楞。
Ruixiang, who could make nothing of their riddling conversation, stared wide-eyed in bewilderment.

罗四姐便又说道∶『瑞香，你总要记牢，吃得苦中苦，方为人上人。』
“Ruixiang,” Madam Luosi said, “remember this: only those who endure the bitterest hardships can rise above others.”

瑞香仍旧不明她这话的用意，只好答应一声∶『是。』
Still unable to understand what she meant, Ruixiang could only answer, “Yes.”

『话要说回来，人也不是生来就该吃苦的。』七姑奶奶说道∶『有福能享，还是要享。
“Then again, people are not born simply to suffer,” the Seventh Lady said. “If you have the good fortune to enjoy life, you should enjoy it.

不过——』她觉得有瑞香在旁，话说得太深了也不好，便改口说道∶『就怕身在福中不知福。』
Only—” With Ruixiang present, she thought it better not to go too deeply into the subject, and changed her words. “The danger is to live in good fortune without knowing it.”

『七姐这句话，真正是一针见血。』
“Seventh Sister, that goes straight to the heart of it.

螺蛳太太说∶『瑞香，你去烫一壶花雕来，
Ruixiang, warm a pot of huadiao wine.

我今天想吃酒。』
I feel like a drink today.”

螺蛳太太的酒量很不错，
Madam Luosi could hold her wine well.

烫了来自斟自饮，喝得很猛；
When it came, she poured for herself and drank rapidly.

七姑奶奶便提了一句∶『四姐，酒要吃得高兴，
“Sister Luo, wine is for pleasure,” the Seventh Lady reminded her.

慢慢吃。』
“Take it slowly.”

『不要紧，
“Do not worry.

这一壶酒醉不倒我。』
One pot will not make me drunk.”

『醉虽醉不倒，会说醉话；
“Perhaps not, but you may talk as though you were.

你一说醉话，人家就更加不当真的了。』
And once you do, people will take you even less seriously.”

这才真正是哑谜，只有她们两人会意。
That was a riddle only the two of them understood.

螺蛳太太想到要跟古应春谈瑞香的事，便听七姑奶奶的劝，
Remembering that she had to speak to Gu about Ruixiang, Madam Luosi accepted the warning.

浅斟低酌，闲谈着将一壶酒喝完，也不想再添，
She took small, leisurely sips as they talked, finished the pot, and asked for no more.

要了一碗香粳米粥吃完，古应春也回来了。
After she had eaten a bowl of fragrant rice porridge, Gu returned.


先是在七姑奶奶卧室中闲话；
At first they chatted in the Seventh Lady’s bedroom.

听到钟打九下，螺蛳太太便即说道∶『七姐只怕要困了；
When the clock struck nine, Madam Luosi said, “Seventh Sister must be sleepy.

我请姐夫替我写封信。』
Brother-in-law, I should like you to write a letter for me.”

『好！
“Certainly.

到我书房里去。』
Come to my study.”

等他们一进书房，瑞香随即将茶端了进来，
As soon as they entered, Ruixiang brought tea.

胡家的规矩，凡是主人家找人写信，下人是不准在旁边的，她还记着这个规矩，所以带上房门，管自己走了。
She remembered the Hu household rule that servants must withdraw when a member of the family asked someone to write a letter, and closed the door behind her.

『姐夫，写信是假，
“Brother-in-law, the letter is a pretence.

跟你来办交涉是真。』
I have really come to settle a matter with you.”

『什么事？』
“What is it?

古应春说∶『有什么话，四姐交代就是。』
Whatever you wish, Sister Luo, just tell me.”

『那末，我就直说。
“Then I shall speak plainly.

姐夫。你把我的瑞香搁在一边，是啥意思。』
What do you mean by leaving my Ruixiang to one side?”

看她咄咄逼人，看有点办交涉的意味，古应春倒有些窘了。
Faced with this aggressive challenge, Gu was embarrassed.

本来就是件不容易表达清楚的事，在这样的情况之下，自然更是讷讷然无法出口。
The matter was hard enough to explain at the best of times; under these circumstances he could scarcely find a word.

罗四姐原是故意作此姿态，说话比较省力，
Her manner was deliberate, intended to save argument.

既占上风，急忙收敛，『姐夫，』她的声音放得柔和而恳切，『你心里到底是啥想法？
Having gained the advantage, she immediately softened her tone. “Brother-in-law, what is really in your mind?

尽管跟我说；
Tell me freely.

是不是日子一长，看出来瑞香的人品不好。』
Have you found, after knowing her longer, that Ruixiang’s character is not what it should be?”

『不、不！』
“No, no!”

古应春急急打断，
Gu broke in hastily.

『我如果心里有这样的想法，那就算没良心到家了。』
“If I thought anything of the kind, I should have no conscience at all.”


『照你说，瑞香你是中意的。』
“Then you do like her?”

『不但中意┅┅』古应春笑笑没有再说下法。
“More than like her…” Gu smiled and left the sentence unfinished.

『意思是不但中意，而且交关中意？』
“You mean you do not merely like her—you like her very much?”

『这也是实话。』
“That is true too.”

『即然如此，七姐又巴不得你们早早圆房，你为啥一点都不起劲。
“Then, with Seventh Sister longing for you to begin your married life together, why do you show no enthusiasm?

姐夫，请你说个道理给我听。』
Brother-in-law, give me a reason.”

螺蛳太太的调子又拉高了。
Her voice rose again.

古应春微微皱眉，不即作答；
Gu frowned slightly and did not answer at once.

他最近才有了吸烟的嗜好——不是鸦片是吕宋烟；
He had recently taken to smoking—not opium, but Manila cigars.

打开银烟盒，取出一支『老美女』用特制的剪刀剪去烟头，用根『红头火柴』在鞋底上划燃了慢慢点烟。
Opening his silver case, he took out an Old Beauty, clipped its end with a special cutter, struck a red-headed match against his shoe sole, and slowly lit it.

霎时间螺蛳太太只闻到浓郁的烟香，却看不见古应春的脸，因为让烟雾隔断了。
A moment later Madam Luosi could smell the rich tobacco but could no longer see his face through the smoke.


『四姐，』古应春在烟雾中发声∶『讨小纳妾，说实话，是我们男人家人生一乐。
“Sister Luo,” his voice emerged from the cloud, “taking a concubine is, to speak frankly, one of the pleasures of a man’s life.

既然这样子，就要看境况、看心情，
That being so, it depends on circumstances and on one’s state of mind.

境况不好做这种事，还可以说是苦中作乐；
If circumstances are bad, one may still find a little pleasure amid one’s troubles.

心情不好，就根本谈不到乐趣了。』
But if one’s heart is troubled, there can be no pleasure at all.”

这个答复，多少是出人意外的；
The answer was rather unexpected.

螺蛳太太想了一会说∶『大先生也跟我谈过，说你做房地产受了姓徐的累，
Madam Luosi considered it. “The Master told me that you were dragged into trouble over property by that man Xu.

不过现在事情已经过去了，
But it is over now.

心情也应该不同了。』
Surely your spirits ought to be different?”

『恰恰相反，
“Quite the contrary.

事情也应该不同了。』
Things are different now, too.”

『为啥呢？』
“Why?”

『四姐，小爷叔待我，自然没有话说；
“Little Uncle could not have treated me better.

十万银子，在他也不会计较。
He would never begrudge me a hundred thousand taels.

不过，在我总是一桩心事，尤其现在市面上的银根极紧；
But it weighs on my mind, especially with money so tight in the market.

小爷叔不在乎，旁人跟他的想法不一样。』
Little Uncle does not mind; other people do not think as he does.”

最后这句话，弦外有音，螺蛳太太不但诧异，而且有些气愤，
The implication in his last words made Madam Luosi both astonished and indignant.

『这旁人是哪一个？』
“Who are these other people?

她问∶『旁人的想法，同大先生啥相干？
What have their opinions to do with the Master?

你为啥要去听？』
Why should you listen to them?”

古应春不作声，
Gu did not reply.

深深地吸了口烟，管他自己又说∶『小爷叔帮了我这么大一个忙，我想替小爷叔尽心尽力做点事，心里才比较好过。
He drew deeply on his cigar and continued with his own thought. “Little Uncle has helped me so much that I can feel easier only if I do something for him with all the ability and devotion I possess.

上次好不容易说动小爷叔，收买新式缫丝厂，自己做丝直接销洋庄；
Last time, after a great deal of effort, I persuaded him to buy modern silk-reeling mills, produce his own silk, and sell directly to the foreign firms.

哪晓得处处碰钉子，
Who could have expected obstacles at every turn?

到今朝一事无成。
To this day I have achieved nothing.

尤五哥心灰意冷，回松江去了。
Brother You has lost heart and gone back to Songjiang.

四姐，你说我哪里会有心思来想瑞香的事？』
Sister Luo, how can I be in the mood to think about Ruixiang?”

这番话说得非常诚恳，螺蛳太太深为同情；话题亦就自然而然地由瑞香转到新式缫丝厂了。
His sincerity deeply moved her, and their conversation naturally shifted from Ruixiang to the mills.


『当初不是筹划得好好的？』
“Was not everything carefully planned at the start?

她问∶『处处碰钉子是啥缘故；
Why these obstacles at every turn?

碰的是啥个钉子？』
What sort of obstacles?”

『一言难尽。』
“It is a long story.”

古应春摇摇头，不愿深谈。
Gu shook his head, unwilling to go further.

螺蛳太太旁敲侧击，始终不能让古应春将他的难言之隐吐露出来。
She tried approaching him from several directions but could not draw out what troubled him.

以致于螺蛳太太都有些动气了。但正当要说两句埋怨的话时，灵机一动想到了一个激将法。
She was beginning to feel annoyed and was about to reproach him when an idea occurred to her: she would provoke him into speaking.

『姐夫，你尽管跟我说，
“Brother-in-law, tell me freely.

我回去决不会搬弄是非；
When I go home I shall certainly not make mischief.

只会在大先生面前替你说话。』
I shall only put in a good word for you with the Master.”

一听这话，古应春大为不安。
This made Gu extremely uneasy.

如果仍旧不肯说，无异表示真的怕她回去『搬弄是非』。
To refuse further would be virtually to admit that he feared she would “make mischief.”

同时听她的语气，似乎疑心他处置不善，甚至怀有私心，以致『一事无成』。
Her tone also suggested that she suspected him of mismanagement, or even of pursuing some private interest that had left him with nothing accomplished.

这份无端而起的误会，亦不甘默然承受。
He was unwilling to accept such an unfounded misunderstanding in silence.

于是，古应春抑制激动的心情，考虑了一会答说∶『四姐，我本来是「打落牙齿和血吞」，有委屈自己受。
Suppressing his agitation, he considered for a moment and said, “Sister Luo, I meant to swallow my broken teeth with the blood—to bear my grievance myself.

现在看样子是非说不可了！
Now it seems I must speak.

不过，四姐，有句话，我先要声明，我决没有疑心四姐会在小爷叔面前搬弄是非的意思。』
But first let me make one thing clear: I have never suspected you of making mischief between Little Uncle and me.”

『我晓得，我晓得。』
“I know, I know.”

螺蛳太太得意地笑道∶『我不是这样子逼一逼，哪里会把你的话逼出来？』
She smiled triumphantly. “If I had not pressed you like that, how could I ever have got it out of you?”


听得这话，古应春才知道上当了∶『我说是说。
Only then did Gu realize that he had been caught. “I shall tell you.

不过，』他说∶『现在好象是我在搬弄是非了。』
But now it feels as though I am the one making mischief.”

『姐夫，』螺蛳太太正色说道∶『我不是不识轻重的人。
“Brother-in-law,” she said gravely, “I do understand what matters.

你告诉我的话，哪些能说，哪些不能说，我当然也会想一想。
Of course I shall consider what may be repeated and what must be kept to myself.

为了避嫌疑不肯说实话，就不是自己人了。』
If you refuse to tell me the truth merely to avoid suspicion, you are not treating me as one of your own.”

最后这句话，隐然有着责备的意思，使得古应春更觉得该据实倾诉∶『说起来也不能怪老宓，
There was an undertone of reproach in her final words, and Gu felt all the more obliged to speak frankly. “Strictly speaking, we cannot blame Old Mi altogether.

他有他的难处——』『是他！』螺蛳太太插进去说，
He has his own difficulties—” “So it is he!” she interrupted.

『我刚就有点疑心，说闲话的旁人，只怕是他，
“I began to suspect that the other person making remarks might be him.

果不其然。
And sure enough!

他在阜康怎么样。』
How is he doing at Fukang?”

『他在阜康有情形我不清楚，
“I know nothing about his affairs at Fukang.

我只谈我自己。
I can speak only of my own.

我也弄不懂是什么地方得罪了老宓，有点处处跟我为难的味道。』
I cannot understand where I have offended Old Mi, but he seems bent on making things difficult for me at every turn.”

原来，收买新式缫丝厂一事，所以未成，即由于宓本常明处掣肘、暗处破坏之故。
The reason the purchase of the modern mills had failed to go through was that Mi Benchang was obstructing it openly and sabotaging it in secret.

他放了风声出去，说胡雪岩并无意办新式缫丝厂，
He had spread the word that Hu Xueyan had no intention of running such mills.

是古应春在做房地产的生意上扯了一个大窟窿，所以买空卖空，希图无中生有，来弥补他的亏空。
Gu, he said, had made a tremendous loss in property and was now speculating in purchases and sales he could not finance, hoping to conjure up money to fill the hole.

如果有缫丝厂想出让，最好另找主顾；否则到头来一场空，自误时机。
Any mill owner wishing to sell would do better to find another buyer; otherwise he would end up with nothing and miss his opportunity through his own mistake.


这话使人将信将疑，
These reports left people divided between belief and doubt.

信的是古应春在上海商场上不是无名小卒，信用也很好。
In Gu’s favour was the fact that he was no obscure figure in Shanghai business, and his credit was good.

只看他跟徐愚斋合作失败，而居然能安然无事，便见得他不是等闲之辈了。
That he had emerged unscathed from his failed partnership with Xu Yuzhai showed that he was a man of more than ordinary resources.

疑的是，古应春的境况确实不佳；
Against him stood the fact that his circumstances were indeed poor.

而更使人觉得不可思议的是，胡雪岩一向反对新式缫丝，何以忽然改弦易辙？
Still harder to understand was why Hu Xueyan, who had always opposed modern silk-reeling, should abruptly change course.

大家都知道，胡雪岩看重的一件事是∶说话算话。
Everyone knew how highly Hu valued keeping his word.

大家都想不起来，他做过什么出尔反尔的事。
No one could recall an occasion on which he had gone back on it.

因为如此，古应春跟人家谈判，便很吃力了，因为对方是抱着虚与委蛇的态度。
Gu’s negotiations consequently became laborious: the other side was merely humouring him.

当然只要没有明显的决裂的理由，尽管谈判吃力，总还要谈下去，而且迟早会谈出一个初步的结果。
Nevertheless, so long as there was no clear reason for an outright rupture, he had to continue, however difficult the talks, and sooner or later they were bound to yield some preliminary result.


其时古应春谈判的目标是公和永的东主黄佐卿。
At this time Gu was negotiating with Huang Zuoqing, the owner of Gongheyong.

他跟怡和、公平两洋行，同时建厂，
Huang had built his mill at the same time as Jardine Matheson and Gongping Trading House had built theirs.

规模大小相仿，都有上百部的丝车，买的是意大利跟法国的丝车；
All three were of much the same size, with over a hundred reeling machines apiece, bought from Italy and France.

公平洋行的买办叫刘和甫，提议三厂共同延请一名工程师，
Liu Hefu, Gongping’s comprador, proposed that the three jointly engage an engineer.

黄佐卿同意了，由刘和甫经手，聘请了一个意大利人麦登斯来指导厂务、训练工人，
Huang agreed, and Liu hired an Italian named Maidengsi to supervise operations and train the workers.

此人技术不错，可是人品甚坏，最大的毛病是好色。
He was technically capable but a man of very bad character; his chief failing was his appetite for women.

原来那时的工人，以女工居多，称之为『湖丝阿姐』。
Most mill hands then were women, known as the Silk Sisters.

小家碧玉为了帮助家计，大多以帮佣为主；
Women from modest families who needed to help support their households had generally gone into domestic service.

做工是领了材料到家来做，旧式的如绣花、糊锡箔；新式的如糊火柴匣子、缝军服。
Those who did paid piecework took the materials home: embroidery and the pasting of tinfoil were older trades, while making matchboxes and sewing uniforms were newer ones.

但做『湖丝阿姐』，汽笛一响，成群结队，招摇而过，却是前所未有，
But the Silk Sisters, gathering in groups at the sound of the factory whistle and making their conspicuous way through the streets, were something wholly new.

因而看湖丝阿姐上工、放工，成了一景。
Watching them go to and from work became a public spectacle.

这些年轻妇女，抛头露面惯了，行动言语之间，自然开通得多；
These young women grew accustomed to appearing in public and naturally became much freer in speech and manner.

而放荡与开通不过上下床之别，久而久之便常有荡检逾闲的情事出现；
The distinction between an open manner and loose morals, however, was little more than a matter of getting into bed; in time, breaches of convention became common.

至于男工，『近水楼台先得月』，尤其是『小寡妇』，搭上手的很多。
The male workers, being nearest at hand, enjoyed the first opportunities, and many formed liaisons, particularly with young widows.

当然这是『互惠』的，
There were benefits on both sides, of course.

女工有个男工作靠山，就不会受人欺侮；倘或靠山是个工头，好处更多，
A woman with a male worker to support her would not be bullied; if her protector was a foreman, the advantages were greater still.

起码可以调到工作轻松的部门。
At the least, she might be transferred to an easier department.

相对的，工头倘或所欲不遂，便可假公济私来作报复，调到最苦的缫丝间，
Conversely, a foreman whose wishes were denied could use his official authority to avenge a private grievance, assigning a woman to the worst work of all in the reeling room.

沸水热汽，终年如盛暑；
There boiling water and steam created a perpetual midsummer.

盛暑偶尔还有风，缫丝间又热又闷，
Even midsummer had an occasional breeze; the reeling room was both hot and airless.

一进去要不了一顿饭的工夫，浑身就会湿透，
Before one had been inside for the time it took to eat a meal, one was drenched from head to foot.

男工可以打赤膊，着短裤，女工就只好着一件『湿布衫』，
Men could strip to the waist and wear shorts; women had to remain in their soaking clothes.

机器一开就是十二个钟头，这件火热的『湿布衫』就得穿一整天。
Once the machinery started, it ran for twelve hours, and they had to wear those scorching, wet garments all day.

夏天还好，
Summer was bearable enough.

冬天散工，冷风一吹，『湿布衫』变成『铁衣』，
In winter, when the shift ended and the cold wind struck, the wet clothing became an iron shell.

因而致病，不足为奇，
That this should cause illness was hardly surprising.

所以有个洋记者参观过缫丝间以后，称之为『名副其实的活地狱』。
After visiting a reeling room, one foreign journalist called it “a veritable hell on earth.”


工头如此，工程师自然更可作威作福，
If a foreman could wield such power, an engineer could lord it over the workers even more easily.

麦登斯便视蹂躏湖丝阿姐为他应享的权利，利用不肖工头，予取予求，
Maidengsi treated the sexual exploitation of the Silk Sisters as his rightful privilege, using unscrupulous foremen to satisfy his demands.

黄佐卿时常接到申诉，要求刘和甫警告麦登斯，
Huang Zuoqing frequently received complaints and asked Liu Hefu to warn him.

稍为好几天，很快地复萌故态，
He would improve for a few days, then soon revert to his old behaviour.

如是几次以后，黄佐卿忍无可忍，打算解雇麦登斯，
After several repetitions, Huang could bear it no longer and decided to dismiss him.

哪知刘和甫跟人家订了一张非常吃亏的合约，倘或解雇须付出巨额的赔偿。
He then discovered that Liu had signed a deeply disadvantageous contract: dismissal would require a huge payment in compensation.

为此黄佐卿大为沮丧，
Huang was thoroughly discouraged.

加以生意又不好做，才决定将公和永盘让给古应春。
With business poor as well, he finally decided to sell Gongheyong to Gu Yingchun.



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第七章（本章第4部分，共6部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


条件都谈好了，厂房、生财、存货八万银子『一脚踢』。
All the terms had been settled: the buildings, equipment, and stock were to go for a lump sum of eighty thousand taels.

古应春便通知宓本常，照数开出银票；
Gu Yingchun therefore notified Mi Benchang to issue a bank draft for the full amount.

哪知所得的回答是∶『不便照拨。』
The answer, to his astonishment, was that the funds could not be released.

『怎么？』古应春诧异，『不是有「的款」存在那里的吗？』
“What?” he asked. “Was there not a sum specifically set aside for this?”

当初汇丰借出来的五十万银子，除了左宗棠所借的二十万以外，
Of the original five hundred thousand taels borrowed from HSBC, two hundred thousand had been lent to Zuo Zongtang.

余数由胡雪岩指明，借给尤五出面所办的茧行，作为收买新式缫丝厂之用，
Hu Xueyan had expressly designated the remainder as a loan to the cocoon firm headed by Brother You, to finance the purchase of modern silk-reeling mills.

这一点宓本常并不否认，但他有他的说法。
Mi did not deny this, but he had his own explanation.


『应春兄，「死店活人开」，
“Brother Yingchun, a shop may be dead, but the man who runs it must be alive.

大先生是有那样子一句话，
The Master did say that, certainly.

不过我做档手的，如果只会听他的话，象算盘珠一样，他拨一拨、我动一动，我就不是活人，
But if, as his manager, I can do nothing except obey him—if I am like a bead on an abacus, moving only when he pushes me—then I am hardly a living man.

只不过比死人多口气。
I have only one breath more than a corpse.

你说是不是呢？』
Would you not agree?”

古应春倒抽一口冷气，
Gu drew in a sharp breath.

结结巴巴说∶『你的话不错，大先生的话也要算数。』
“You—you are right,” he stammered, “but the Master’s word must count for something too.”

『我不是说不算数，
“I am not saying it counts for nothing.

是现在没有钱，
I am saying there is no money at present.

有，钱又不是我的，我为啥不给你。』
If there were, why should I withhold it? It is not mine.”

『这钱怎么会没有？
“How can the money be gone?

指明了做这个用途的。』
It was expressly assigned to this purpose.”

『不错，指明了作这个用途的。
“Quite true.

不过，应春兄，你要替我想一想，更要替大先生想一想。
But you must consider my position, Brother Yingchun—and the Master’s even more.

几次谈到缫丝厂的事，你总说「难，难，
Every time we discussed the silk mills, you said, ‘Difficult, difficult!

不晓得啥辰光才会成功？」
Who knows when anything will come of it?’

如果你说∶快谈成功了，十天半个月就要付款，我自然会把你这笔款子留下来。
If you had told me, ‘The agreement is almost settled; payment will be due in ten days or a fortnight,’ naturally I should have kept the money for you.

你自己都没有握，怎么能怪我？』
When you yourself had no certainty, how can you blame me?”

『你不必管我有没有把握，
“My certainty is no concern of yours.

指明了给我的，你就要留下来。』
Money expressly assigned to me ought to have been kept for me.”


这话很不客气；
This was distinctly brusque.

宓本常冷笑一声说道∶『如果那时候你请大先生马上交代，照数拨给你，另外立个折子，算是你的存款，我就没有资格用你这笑钱。
Mi gave a cold laugh. “Had you asked the Master then and there to order the sum transferred, with a separate passbook opened so that it became your deposit, I should have had no right to use it.

没有归到你名下以前，钱是阜康的。
Until it was entered in your name, however, the money belonged to Fukang.

阜康的钱是大先生所有；不过阜康的钱归我宓某所管。
Fukang’s money belongs to the Master, but its management belongs to me.

受人之禄，忠人之事，
A man who takes another’s pay must serve his interests faithfully.

银根这么紧，我不把这笔钱拿来活用；只为远在杭州的大先生的一句话，把这笔钱死死守住，等你不知道哪天来用，
With credit as tight as it is, am I to leave that money idle merely because of a word from the Master, far away in Hangzhou, and guard it until some unknown day when you may want it?

你说有没有这个道理？』
Would that make sense?”

这几句话真是将古应春驳得体无完肤，
These arguments left Gu without a leg to stand on.

他不能跟他辩，也不想跟他辩了。
He could not argue further and no longer wished to.


可是宓本常却还有话∶『你晓得的，大先生的生意愈做愈大，就是因为一个钱要做八个钱、十个钱的生意。
Mi, however, had more to say. “You know how the Master’s business keeps expanding: he makes one coin do the business of eight or ten.

大先生常常说∶』八个坛子七个盖，盖来盖去不穿帮，就是会做生意。
He is always saying, ‘Eight jars and seven lids—keep moving the lids without letting anyone see an uncovered jar, and you know how to do business.’

「以现在市面上的现款来说，岂止八个坛子七个盖？
With the cash available in the market today, we have nothing like seven lids for eight jars.

顶多只有一半，
At most we have half as many lids as jars.

我要把他搞得不穿帮，哪里是件容易的事。
Do you think it is easy to keep everything covered?

老兄，我请问你，
Let me ask you this, my dear fellow.

今天有人来提款，库房里只有那二十几万银子，我不拿来应付，
If a depositor came to withdraw his money today, and the only cash in the vault was that two hundred thousand taels and more, should I refuse to use it?

莫非跟客户说∶那笔银子不能动，是为古先生留在那里收买缫丝厂用的？
Should I tell him, ‘That money cannot be touched; it is being kept for Mr Gu to buy silk mills’?

古先生啊古先生，我老宓跟你，到那时候，不要说本来就是阜康的钱，哪怕是两江总督衙门的官款，明天要提了去给兄弟们关饷，我都要动用。
My dear Mr Gu, at such a moment I tell you I would use not merely Fukang’s own money, but even official funds belonging to the Governor-General of Liangjiang, due to be withdrawn tomorrow to pay the troops.

客户这一关过不去，马上就有挤兑的风潮，
Fail to satisfy our customers and we shall have a run on the bank at once.

大先生就完完大吉了。
That would finish the Master.”

『』四姐，老宓的说法，只要是真的，就算不肯帮我忙，我亦没话说。
“Sister Luo,” Gu went on with his account, “if what Old Mi said was true, then even if he would not help me, I had nothing to complain of.

因为虽然都是为小爷叔办事，各有各的权限，各有各的难处，
We both work for Little Uncle, but each of us has his own authority and his own difficulties.

我不能怪他。
I could not blame him.”

『』那末，『螺蛳太太立即钉一句∶』你现在是怪他罗？
“Then,” she immediately pressed him, “you do blame him now?”

『古应春老实答道∶』是的。
“Yes,” Gu admitted frankly.

有一点。
“A little.”

『』这样说起来，是老宓没有说真话！不然你就不会怪他。
“In that case Old Mi cannot have been telling the truth, or you would not blame him.

『螺蛳太太问道∶』他那几句话不真？『
Which part of what he said was untrue?”


『还不是头寸。』
“The part about the shortage of funds, of course.”

话到此处，古应春如箭在弦，不发不可，
Gu had now drawn the bow and could no longer hold back the arrow.

『他头寸是调得过来的，
“He could have arranged the funds.

而且指定了收买缫丝厂的那笔款子，根本没有动，
Moreover, the money earmarked for purchasing the mills has never been touched.

仍旧在汇丰银行。』
It is still at HSBC.”

一听这话，螺蛳太太动容了，
Madam Luosi’s expression changed.

『姐夫，』她问，『你怎么知道他没有动过？』
“Brother-in-law, how do you know he has not touched it?”

『我听人说的。』
“Someone told me.”

『是哪个？』
“Who?”

『这——』古应春答说∶『四姐，你不必问了。
“Well—Sister Luo, please do not ask.

我的消息很靠得住。』
My information is thoroughly reliable.”

螺蛳太太有些明白了，
She thought she understood.

阜康管总帐的周小棠，跟宓本常不甚和睦，
Zhou Xiaotang, who kept Fukang’s general accounts, was not on particularly good terms with Mi Benchang.

也许是他透露的消息。
Perhaps he had let the information out.


『姐夫要我不问，我就不问。
“If you would rather I did not ask, I shall not.

不过我倒要问姐夫，这件事现在怎么办？』
But there is something else I must ask: what are you going to do now?”

『收买缫丝厂的事，已经不必再谈了。
“There is no longer any point in discussing the purchase.

现在就有八万银子，也买不成功；
Even with eighty thousand taels in hand, I could not buy the mill now.

人家黄佐卿看我拿不出现银，另外寻了个户头，卖了九万五千银子。』
When Huang Zuoqing saw that I could not produce the cash, he found another buyer and sold it for ninety-five thousand.”

古应春说到这里，摇一摇头，脸色非常难看，
Gu shook his head, his face dark with distress.

『四姐，我顶难过的是，在上海滩上混了几十年，听了一句教人要吐血的话。』
“What hurts me most, Sister Luo, is that after all my decades in Shanghai, I had to hear something that could make a man spit blood.”

『噢！』
“Oh!”

螺蛳太太大为同情，
Her sympathy was immediate.

『你说了出来，
“Tell me what he said.

我来替你出气。』
I shall get satisfaction for you.”

『出气？』
“Satisfaction?”

古应春连连摇头，
Gu shook his head repeatedly.

『那一来变成「窝里反」了，
“That would mean fighting among ourselves.

不好「不好。』
No, no, that would never do.”

『就算我不响，你也要说出来；
“Even if I say nothing about it, you must tell me.

心里有委屈，说出来就舒服。』
Speaking about an injustice makes it easier to bear.”

古应春沉吟了说∶『好，
Gu hesitated. “Very well.

我说。
I shall tell you.

那天——』
That day—”


那天——螺蛳太太到上海的前两天，黄佐卿发了个帖子请古应春吃花酒。
That day—two days before Madam Luosi arrived in Shanghai—Huang Zuoqing had sent Gu an invitation to a banquet with courtesans.

买卖不成，朋友还是朋友，古应春准时赴约；
Though their business had fallen through, they were still friends, and Gu arrived punctually.

场面很热闹，黄佐卿请了有近二十位的客，
It was a lively gathering, with nearly twenty guests.

两桌麻将，一桌牌九，打了上千大洋的头。
Two tables of mahjong and one of pai gow yielded over a thousand silver dollars in table fees.

接下来吃花酒，摆的是『双双台』；
The banquet that followed was arranged with courtesans seated alongside the guests.

客人连叫来的局，不下五十人之多，
Counting the women summoned to join them, there were at least fifty people.

须将整楼三个大房间打通，才摆得下四桌酒。
The partitions between three large upstairs rooms had to be opened before there was room for four dining tables.


主客便是收买公和永的潮州帮『鸦片大王』陈和森；
The guest of honour was the purchaser of Gongheyong, Chen Hesen, the Chaozhou merchants’ “Opium King.”

古应春也被邀在这一桌坐。
Gu was seated at the same table.

笙歌嗷嘈之余，黄佐卿举杯向古应春说道∶『应春兄，我特为要敬你一杯酒；
Amid the clamour of music and singing, Huang raised his cup to him. “Brother Yingchun, I particularly want to drink to you.

如果十天之前不是你头寸不便，我就不会跟「陈大王」谈公和永，也就少卖一万五千银子了。
Had you not been short of funds ten days ago, I should never have discussed Gongheyong with King Chen, and I should have received fifteen thousand taels less.

说起来这一万五千两，是你老哥挑我赚的，
In a manner of speaking, it was you who helped me make that extra fifteen thousand.

我是不是应该敬杯酒。』说完哈哈大笑，管自己干了酒。
Ought I not to drink to you?” He laughed heartily and drained his cup.

讲完了这一段，古应春又说∶『四姐，你想，这不是他存心给我难堪？
Having related this, Gu added, “Sister Luo, was he not deliberately trying to humiliate me?

当时，我真正是眼泪往肚子里流。』
I truly had to swallow my tears.”

螺蛳太太亦为他难过，更为他不平，
She grieved for him and felt the injustice even more keenly.

『这件事，大先生晓不晓得？』她问。
“Does the Master know about this?” she asked.


『这件事，我怎么好告诉大先生？
“How could I bring myself to tell him such a thing?

不过收买公和永不成这一节，我已经写信给大先生了。』
But I have written to him about the failure to buy Gongheyong.”

『我在杭州没有听说。』
“I heard nothing of it in Hangzhou.”

古应春想了一下说∶『算起来你从杭州动身的时候，我的信还没有到。』
Gu considered a moment. “My letter probably had not arrived when you left.”


『好！这一节就不去谈它了。
“Very well, we shall say no more about that.

至于老宓勒住银不放，有意跟你作对，这件事我一定要问问他。』
But as for Old Mi holding back the money and deliberately obstructing you, I must certainly question him.”

『不！』古应春说∶『请四姐一定要顾大局，
“No!” Gu exclaimed. “Please think of the larger situation, Sister Luo.

现在局势不大好，全靠大家同心协力，
Things are difficult at present; everything depends on our working together.

你一问他，必生是非，
If you question him, it is bound to stir up trouble.

无论如何请你摆在心里。』
Whatever you do, please keep this to yourself.”

『你晓得的，我也同七姐一样，
“You know I am like Seventh Sister.

有不平的事，摆在心里，饭都吃不下的。』
If I keep an injustice bottled up, I cannot even eat.

螺蛳太太说∶『我只要不「卖原告」，他哪里知道我的消息是哪里来的。
So long as I do not give away the complainant, how can he know where my information came from?”


看她态度非常坚决，古应春知道无法打消她的意向；
Seeing her determination, Gu knew he could not dissuade her.

考虑了一会说∶『四姐，你以为不提我的名字，他就不会疑心到我，那是自己骗自己。
After some thought he said, “Sister Luo, if you think that merely leaving out my name will keep him from suspecting me, you are deceiving yourself.

你总要有个合情理的说法，才可以瞒得过他。』
You need a plausible explanation if you are to put him off the scent.”

『你讲，
“Tell me, then.

应该怎么个说法？』
What explanation should I give?”

『在汇丰银行，你有没有认识的人？』
“Do you know anyone at HSBC?”

螺蛳太太想了一下说道∶『有个张纪通，
She thought for a moment. “There is a Zhang Jitong.

好象是汇丰银行的。』
I believe he works there.”

『不错，张纪通是汇丰银行「二写」。』
“Yes, he is HSBC’s second clerk.

古应春问∶『四姐跟他熟？』
Do you know him well?”

『他太太，我们从前是小姊妹。
“His wife and I were friends as girls.

去年还特为到杭州来看过我。』
She made a special trip to Hangzhou to see me last year.”

『好！
“Good.

那就有说法了。
Then you have your explanation.

四姐，你如果一定问这件事，见了老宓就这样子说∶你说，古应春告诉我，阜康的头寸紧得不得了；
If you insist on questioning Old Mi, say this when you see him: ‘Gu Yingchun tells me that Fukang is desperately short of funds.

可是，我听张政通的太太说∶阜康有廿几万银子，一直存在汇丰没有动过。
Yet I hear from Mrs Zhang Jitong that Fukang has more than two hundred thousand taels sitting untouched at HSBC.’

看他怎么说？』
See what he says to that.”


『我懂了，
“I understand.

我会说得一点不露马脚；
I shall give nothing away.

明天早晨我先去看张太太，做得象真的一样。
Tomorrow morning I shall first call on Mrs Zhang, to make the story look genuine.

我看他一定没话可说；
I am sure he will have no answer.

那时候我再埋怨他几句，替你出气。』
Then I can reproach him a little and get satisfaction for you.”

『出气这两个字，不必谈它。』
“Please leave satisfaction out of it.”

『好，
“Very well.

不谈出气，谈你圆房。』
Let us leave that and discuss your wedding night.”

螺蛳太太急转直下地说∶『这件事就算不为你，也不为瑞香，为了七姐，你也要趁我在这里，请我吃这杯喜酒。』古应春终于答应了。
She changed the subject with startling abruptness. “Even if you will do nothing for your own sake or Ruixiang’s, you must do this for Seventh Sister: hold the wedding while I am here, so that I may drink a cup at your celebration.” Gu finally agreed.

于是螺蛳太太便将与七姑奶奶商量好的计划，一一说知；
Madam Luosi then explained, point by point, the arrangements she had settled with the Seventh Lady.

事到如今，古应春除了唯唯称是以外，别无话说。
Matters had gone so far that Gu could only murmur his assent.


第二天早饭既毕，螺蛳太太便催瑞香瑞得出门。
The next morning, as soon as breakfast was over, Madam Luosi urged Ruixiang to get ready to go out.

这是前一天晚上就说好了；
This had been agreed the previous evening.

但瑞香因为一出门便是一整天，有好些琐屑家务要安排好，因而耽误了工夫，
But since they would be away all day, Ruixiang had a number of small household matters to arrange, and these delayed her.

七姑奶奶帮着一催再催，
The Seventh Lady joined in urging her to hurry.

快到不耐烦时，方始相偕登车，看表上已经十一点了。
They were almost out of patience before the two women finally entered the carriage together; a glance at the watch showed that it was already eleven.

『刚刚当着七姑奶奶，我不好说，我催你是有道理的，
“I could not explain in front of the Seventh Lady just now, but I had a reason for hurrying you.

先要到张太太家去一趟，稍为坐一坐到阜康去开银票。
We were to call briefly on Mrs Zhang, then go to Fukang to get the bank drafts.

现在，辰光不对了，
The timing is all wrong now.

吃中饭的时候去了，一定留住；
If we arrive at lunchtime, she is sure to keep us for the meal.

下半天等去了阜康，就办不成事了。
By the time we have been to Fukang in the afternoon, we shall get nothing done.

看首饰不能心急；不然十之八九要后悔。
One must take one’s time choosing jewellery, or nine times out of ten one regrets it.

现在，没法子，张家只好不去了。』
We shall have to miss the Zhangs.”

『都是我不好。』瑞香陪笑说道∶『太太何不早跟我说一句。』
“It is all my fault,” Ruixiang said with an apologetic smile. “Why did you not tell me earlier, Madam?”


『我也不晓得你这么会磨！
“I did not know you could dawdle so!

摸东摸西，忘记掉辰光。
Fiddling with this and that until you forget the time.

喔！』螺蛳太太特为关照∶『回头我同宓先生说，我们是从张家来，你不要多说什么，免得拆穿西洋镜。』瑞香答应着，随同螺蛳太太坐轿子到了阜康；
Oh—and remember: when I tell Mr Mi that we have come from the Zhangs, do not say anything that will give the game away.” Ruixiang agreed and accompanied her by sedan chair to Fukang.

宓本常自然奉如上宾，
Mi Benchang naturally treated Madam Luosi as an honoured guest.

他的礼貌很周到，从胡老太太起，胡家全家，——问到。
His courtesies were meticulous: beginning with Old Madam Hu, he asked after every member of the family in turn.

接下来又敷衍瑞香，笑嘻嘻地问道∶『瑞姑娘，哪天请我们吃喜酒？』
He then turned his attentions to Ruixiang and asked with a broad smile, “Miss Rui, when are you going to invite us to your wedding feast?”


瑞香红着脸不答；
Ruixiang blushed and said nothing.

螺蛳太太接口∶『快了，快了！』
“Soon, soon!” Madam Luosi answered for her.

她说∶『今天就是为此到钱庄来的，
“That is why we have come to the bank today.

我想支两千银子，
I should like to withdraw two thousand taels.

七姑奶奶也有个折子在这。』
I also have the Seventh Lady’s passbook here.”

取出七姑奶奶的折子来一看，存银四千五百余两，
She took it out and found a balance of more than four thousand five hundred taels.

螺蛳太太作主，也提二千，一共是四千银子，关照宓本常开出数目大小不等的十来张银票，
On her own authority, she withdrew another two thousand from that account, making four thousand in all, and asked Mi to issue a dozen or so bank drafts in assorted amounts.

点收清楚，要谈古应春的事了。
Once she had counted and received them, she was ready to raise Gu’s affairs.

『宓先生，』她闲闲问说∶『这一晌，上海市面怎么样？』
“Mr Mi,” she asked casually, “how has business been in Shanghai lately?”

『不好，不好！
“Bad, bad!

银根愈来愈紧了。』
Money grows tighter every day.”

『我们阜康呢？』
“And at our Fukang?”

『当然也紧。』
“Tight here too, of course.”


『既然紧，』螺蛳太太摆出一脸困惑的神情，『为啥我们有廿几万银子摆在汇丰银行，动都不动？』
“If money is tight,” she said with a look of bewilderment, “why do we leave more than two hundred thousand taels at HSBC without touching it?”

一听这话，宓本常心里一跳；
Mi’s heart gave a jolt.

正在难于作答时，不道螺蛳太太又添了一句话，让松了口气。
He was struggling for an answer when she unexpectedly added a question that allowed him to breathe again.

『这笔款子是不是汇丰借出来的？』
“Is this the money borrowed from HSBC?”

『是的。』
“Yes.”


『汇丰借出来的款子，当然要出利息；
“Naturally, interest must be paid on money borrowed from HSBC.

存在汇丰虽也有利息，不过一定放款利息高，存款利息低，是不是？』
A deposit there earns interest too, but surely the rate they charge on a loan is higher than the rate they pay on a deposit?”

『是的。』
“Yes.”

『借他的钱又存在他那里，白贴利息的差额；
“Then we borrow their money and leave it with them, paying the difference in interest for nothing.

宓先生，这把算盘是怎么打的，我倒不太懂了。』
Mr Mi, I cannot quite follow the reckoning.”

这时宓本常已经想好了一个很巧的理由，可以搪塞；
By now Mi had thought of an ingenious excuse with which to fend her off.

因而好整以暇地答说∶『罗四太太，这里头学问很大，
At his leisure, he replied, “Madam Luo, there is a great deal to be learned here.

不是我吹，其中的诀窍是我跟了大先生十几年才摸出来的。
I am not boasting: I discovered the secret only after working for the Master for more than ten years.

我们先吃饭，等我慢慢讲给罗四太太你听。』
Let us eat first, and I shall explain it to you slowly.”

已是午饭辰光，而且宓本常已有预备，螺蛳太太也就不客气了。
It was lunchtime, and Mi had already made preparations, so she accepted readily.

不过既无堂客相陪，而瑞香的身分不同，不肯与螺蛳太太同桌，却颇费安排；
Seating them posed some difficulty, however. There was no lady of the household to accompany her, while Ruixiang, conscious of their difference in status, would not sit at the same table.

最后是分了两样菜让瑞香在另一处吃，密本常陪螺蛳太太一面吃、一面谈。
In the end two dishes were set aside for Ruixiang to eat elsewhere, and Mi kept Madam Luosi company over lunch and conversation.


『罗四太太，阜康有款子存在汇丰，想来是应春告诉你的？』
“Madam Luo, I imagine it was Yingchun who told you that Fukang had money deposited at HSBC?”

『不是。』螺蛳太太从从容容地答说∶『今天去看一个张太太，
“No,” she answered composedly. “I called on a Mrs Zhang today.

他们老爷也在汇丰，
Her husband works at HSBC too.

是她告诉我的。』
She told me.”

『呃，是弓长张，还是立早章？』
“Ah, is that Zhang written with ‘bow’ and ‘long,’ or Zhang written with ‘stand’ and ‘early’?”

『弓长张。』
“The one with ‘bow’ and ‘long.’”

『那末是张纪通？』
“Then it must be Zhang Jitong?”

『对的，
“Yes.

他们老爷叫张纪通。』
Her husband’s name is Zhang Jitong.”


宓本常心想，螺蛳太太明明是撒谎。
Mi knew perfectly well that she was lying.

张纪通跟他也是朋友，前一天还在一起打牌；
Zhang Jitong was a friend of his; they had played cards together only the previous evening.

打到深夜一点钟，张纪通大输家，『扳轿杠』一定要再打四圈。
At one in the morning, Zhang, the heaviest loser, had insisted on another four rounds to try to recover his money.

当时就有人说∶『老张，你向来一到十二点，一定要回去的。
Someone had teased him: “Old Zhang, you always go home on the stroke of twelve.

今天夜不归营，不怕张大嫂罚你跪算珠珠、顶马桶盖。』
If you stay out all night today, are you not afraid your wife will make you kneel on abacus beads and balance a chamber-pot lid on your head?”

原来张纪通惧内，所以这样打趣他；
Zhang was afraid of his wife, hence the joke.

哪知他拍一拍胸脯说∶『放心，放心，
But he had slapped his chest and declared, “No fear, no fear!

雌老虎前天回常熟娘家，去吃她侄儿的喜酒去了。』
The tigress went back to her family in Changshu the day before yesterday, for her nephew’s wedding.”

这是所谓『欲盖弥彰』，
Here was an attempt at concealment that only made the truth more conspicuous.

愈发可以证实，汇丰存款的消息是古应春所泄露。
It gave Mi further confirmation that Gu had disclosed the HSBC deposit.

不过他绝不说破，
He said nothing to expose the lie, however.

相反地，在脸上表现了对古应春抱歉的神态。
Instead, he assumed an expression of regret towards Gu.


『螺蛳太太，阜康的存款、放款都有帐可查的，存在汇丰的这笔款子当然也有帐；
“Madam Luosi, all Fukang’s deposits and loans are recorded in the books, including this deposit at HSBC.

不过每个月倒贴的利息，在帐上看不出是亏损。
But the extra interest we pay each month does not appear as a loss.

啥道理呢？
Why?

这笔利息的差额是一厘半，算起来每个月大概要贴四百两银子，
The difference in the rates is 0.15 percent a month, which costs us about four hundred taels monthly.

我是打开销里面，算正当支出。』
I enter it among our expenses, as a legitimate operating cost.”

说到这里他停了下来，看螺蛳太太的表情。
He paused to observe her expression.

她当然是面现惊异之色，
Naturally, she looked astonished.

『是正当开支？』她问，仿佛自己听错了似的。
“A legitimate operating cost?” she asked, as if she must have misheard.

『如果她声色不动，宓本常便不能确定，她是不是把他的话听了进去；
Had her expression remained unchanged, Mi could not have been sure she had taken in his words.

而惊讶却是正常的，他就更有把握能将她的疑团消除了。
Surprise was the natural response and increased his confidence that he could dispel her doubts.


『不错，
“Exactly.

是正当开支，好比逢年过节要应酬官场一样，是必不可少的正当开支。』
A legitimate expense—as necessary as the money spent maintaining relations with officials at New Year and the other festivals.

他说∶『螺蛳太太，你晓得的，阜康全靠公家同大户的存款，
You know, Madam Luosi, that Fukang depends entirely on deposits from public offices and wealthy households.

阜康的利息比人家低，
We pay less interest than other banks.

为啥愿意存阜康，
Why do people still put their money with us?

就因为可靠如果有人存点疑惑怕靠不住，来提存款，一个两个不要紧，
Because we are dependable. If someone begins to doubt that and comes to withdraw his deposit, one or two withdrawals do no harm.

人一多，消息一传，那个风潮一闹开来，螺蛳太太我就只有一条路好走。』
But if the numbers grow, word spreads, and a run begins, there will be only one road left for me.”

『喔！
“Oh?

哪一条路？』
What road is that?”


『死路。
“The road to death.

不是一条绳子，就是三钱鸦片烟。』
A rope, or three mace of opium.

宓本常说∶『我只有来生报答大先生了。』
I could repay the Master only in my next life.”

螺蛳太太再精明，也不能不为宓本常蓄意表示尽忠负责的神态所感动，
Shrewd as she was, Madam Luosi could not help being moved by this carefully contrived display of loyalty and responsibility.

『宓先生，你不要这么说！
“Mr Mi, you must not talk like that!

只要你实心实力，一定不会没有好结果。』
So long as you do your utmost in good faith, things cannot fail to turn out well.

她说∶『你的忠心，大先生晓得的。』
The Master knows how loyal you are.”

『就为了大先生得罪了人也值得。』
“For his sake, even offending people is worthwhile.”

宓本常马上又将话拉回来，
Mi immediately brought the conversation back to his point.

『螺蛳太太，有阜康这块金字招牌，存款不必我去兜揽，
“With Fukang’s golden signboard, I need not go out soliciting deposits.

自会送上门来。
They come to our door of their own accord.

我的做法，就是要把我们的这块金字招牌擦得晶光丈亮，不好有一点点不干净的地方。
My method is to polish that signboard until it positively shines, without the smallest blemish.

款子存在汇丰，倒贴利息，就是我保护金字招牌的办法。』
Keeping money at HSBC and paying the difference in interest is how I protect our reputation.”

『嗯！嗯！』
“I see, I see.”

螺蛳太太想了一会说∶『你的意思是阜康有廿几万银子在汇丰，不去动它，显得阜康的头寸很宽裕，
She thought for a moment. “You mean that leaving those two hundred thousand taels and more untouched at HSBC makes Fukang appear amply supplied with ready money.

人家就放心不来提存了。』
People feel reassured and do not come to withdraw their deposits.”

『一点不错。
“Exactly!

螺蛳太太，你真是内行。』
Madam Luosi, you are a true expert.”

宓本常举一举杯，自己喝了一大口，得意之情，溢于言表。
Mi raised his cup and took a long drink, unable to conceal his satisfaction.


『原来有这样一招在里面。
“So that is the trick.

说起来也是迫不得已。』
Necessity drove you to it, then.”

『先是迫不得已，
“At first it was necessity.

后来我才悟出诀窍，实在是正当的做法，
Later I understood the principle and saw that it was really the right thing to do.

就银根不紧，也应该这么办。
We ought to do it even when money is not tight.

有一回法大马路周道台的五姨太来提款，
Once the fifth concubine of Intendant Zhou, who lives on French Main Road, came to withdraw some money.

我说∶你是不是要转存汇丰？
I asked her, ‘Are you transferring it to HSBC?

如果要存汇丰，我打汇丰的票子给你，
If so, I can give you a draft on HSBC.

转帐不但方便，而且进出不必「贴水」，
The transfer will be convenient, and you will lose nothing in exchange deductions when the money goes out and comes in.

比较划算。
It will be more economical.’

螺蛳太太，你道她听了我的话怎么说？』
Madam Luosi, what do you think she said?”

『我猜不着。
“I cannot guess.

她怎么说？』
What did she say?”



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第七章（本章第5部分，共6部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


『她说∶算了，算了。
“She said, ‘Never mind, then.

我们老爷说，现在市面上银根紧，阜康只怕要紧要慢的时候，没有现银，不如存到外国银行。
My husband says money is tight and Fukang might not have ready silver when we urgently need it, so a foreign bank would be safer.

现在听人你这样子说，我倒不好意思了。
But after what you have said, I feel rather ashamed.

还是存在你们这里好了。
I shall leave it with you.’

螺蛳太太，我当时悟出一个诀窍，
Madam Luosi, that taught me a trick.

我们这块金字招牌，要用外国货的擦铜油来擦。
We must polish our golden signboard with foreign metal polish.

啥叫外国货的擦铜油，
What is that polish?

就是跟外国银行往来，
Dealings with foreign banks.

我要到所有外国银行去开户头，
I mean to open an account with every one of them.

象遇到周家五姨太那种来提存的户头，我问她要哪家外国银行的票子，
If a customer like Intendant Zhou’s fifth concubine comes to withdraw money, I shall ask which foreign bank’s draft she wants.

说哪家就是哪家；
Whichever she names, she shall have it.

这一下阜康的招牌不是更响了。』
Would that not make Fukang’s name more impressive still?”

螺蛳太太因为他的话中听，所以能够深入，
Madam Luosi found his argument persuasive and followed it closely.

这时听出来一个疑问∶『法子是蛮好，不过这一来不是有大笔头寸搁在那里了？』
Now a question occurred to her. “A fine method, but would it not leave large sums lying idle in those banks?”

『哪里，哪里！』宓本常乱摇着双手，
Mi waved both hands. “No, no!

『那样做法不是太笨了？』
That would be foolish.”

『不笨怎么办？』
“What is the clever way, then?”

『这里头又有诀窍了。
“There is another trick.

每家银行开个户头，存个三两千银子；
Open an account at each bank and deposit two or three thousand taels.

等开出票子，我先一步把头寸调足送进去，就不会穿帮了。』
When a draft is issued, I arrange to send in enough funds before it is presented, and nothing goes wrong.”

『来得及吗？』
“Can you do it in time?”


『来得及，来得及。
“Certainly.

喏，这就是德律风根的好处，
That is where the telephone comes in.

拿起话筒摇过去，说有这么一回事，
Lift the receiver, ring them up, and explain.

那里的行员，自会替我们应付。』
Their staff will find a way to accommodate us.”

螺蛳太太听他的谈论，学到很多东西；
Madam Luosi was learning a great deal.

中国钱庄经营的要诀，她听胡雪岩谈过几回，并不外行，但外国银行的情形，却不知其详，
Hu had explained the essentials of Chinese banking several times, so she was no novice; foreign banks, however, were less familiar.

这时听宓本常说得头头是道，遇事留心的她，自然不肯放弃机会，
Hearing Mi speak so confidently, she would not miss the chance to learn.

所以接上来便问，是如何应付？人家又为什么会替阜康应付？
How did the staff accommodate Fukang, and why should they do so?

『应付的法子多得很，不过万变不离其宗，就是拖一拖辰光，等我们把头寸调齐补足。』
“There are many ways, but the principle is always the same: gain a little time until we have assembled and supplied the funds.”

『万一调不齐呢。』
“What if you cannot?”

『不错，
“Exactly.

不怕一万，只怕万一。
However unlikely, the worst possibility must be allowed for.

这种情形，从来没有过，不过不能不防。
It has never happened, but we must be prepared.

说到这上头，就靠平常的交际，
Then we depend on ordinary social connections.

外国银行的「康白度」，我都有交情的；那班「洋行小鬼」，平时也要常常应酬，
I know all the foreign banks’ compradors and regularly entertain their junior Chinese clerks too.

所以万一遇到头寸调不齐，只要我通知一声，他们会替我代垫。
If ever I cannot assemble the money, I need only send word and they will advance it.

这是事先说好了的，
That is agreed beforehand.

代垫照算拆息，日子最多三天。』宓本常特为又重复一句∶『不过，这种情形从来没有过。』
We pay the usual short-term interest, and the advance may last no more than three days.” He repeated emphatically, “But it has never happened.”

『喔，』螺蛳太太又问∶『我们跟哪几家外国银行有往来？』
“Which foreign banks do we deal with?” she asked.

统统有。『
“All of them.”


接下来，宓本常便屈指细数。
Mi began counting them off.

上海的外国银行，最有名的是英文名称叫做『香港上海银行有限公司』的汇丰银行，
Shanghai’s best-known foreign bank was HSBC, whose English name was the Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Company Limited.

但最老的却是有利银行，咸丰四年便已开办；
The oldest, however, was the Mercantile Bank, opened in the fourth year of Xianfeng.

不过后来居上的却是麦加利银行，
The Chartered Bank had come later but overtaken its rivals.

这家银行的英文名称叫做∶Ｃｈａｒｔｅｒｃｄ－ＢａｎｋｏｆＩｎｄｉａ，ＡｕｓｔｒａｌｉａａｎｄＣｈｉｎａ。
Its full English name was the Chartered Bank of India, Australia and China.

但香港分行与上海分行的译名不同，
Its Hong Kong and Shanghai branches nevertheless had different Chinese names.

香港照音译，称为渣打银行；上海的银钱业嫌它叫起来不响，而且顾名不能思义，
Hong Kong used the phonetic “Zhada,” while Shanghai bankers considered that insufficiently resonant and uninformative.

所以用他总经理麦加利的名字，称之为麦加利银行。
They called it Maijiali, after its manager.

『麦加利是英国女皇下圣旨设立的，
“It was established by a royal charter from the British queen.

不过这家银行是专门为了英国人在印度、澳洲同我们中国经商所开的，
But it exists specifically to serve British trade in India, Australia, and China.

重在存放款跟汇兑，纯然是商业银行，跟汇丰银行带点官派的味道不大一样。』
Its main business is deposits, loans, and remittances—a purely commercial bank, unlike HSBC, which has something of an official air.

宓本常又说∶『自从左大人到两京，大先生亦不经手偿洋债了，我们阜康跟汇丰的关系就淡了。
Since His Excellency Zuo came to Liangjiang, Mr Hu no longer handles foreign-debt repayments, and Fukang’s connection with HSBC has weakened.

所以我现在是向麦加利下工夫。
I am now concentrating on the Chartered Bank.

这一点顺便拜托罗四太太告诉大先生。』
Please mention that to Mr Hu, Madam Luo.”

『好的，我晓得了。』
“I shall.”

螺蛳太太对宓本常的长袖善舞，印象颇为深刻；观感当然也改变了，
Mi’s skill in managing his connections impressed her and changed her opinion.

觉得他是为了本身的职司，要对得起老板，就免不了得罪朋友。
In fulfilling his duties and serving his employer, he could hardly avoid offending friends.

不过，自己是在古应春面前夸下海口，要来替他出气。
Yet she had promised Gu that she would obtain satisfaction for him.

如今搞成个虎头蛇尾，似乎愧对古应春。
To begin boldly and end feebly would seem a betrayal.


这样转着念头，脸上自不免流露出为难的神气。
Her difficulty showed in her face.

善于察言观色的宓本常便即问道∶『罗四太太，你是不是有啥话，好象不大肯说，
Quick to read an expression, Mi asked, “Is there something you hesitate to say?

不要紧的，
Please do not.

我跟大先生多年，就同晚辈一样；
After so many years with Mr Hu, I am almost one of the younger generation.

罗四太太，你是长辈，
You are my elder.

如果我有啥不对，请你尽管说！
If I have done anything wrong, tell me.

我是、我是——掉句书袋，叫做「有则改之，无则加勉」。』
To borrow a literary phrase, I shall correct any fault I have, and guard against those I have not.”

螺蛳太太听他的话很诚恳，觉得稍为透露也不妨，
His apparent sincerity persuaded her that a hint could do no harm.

于是很含蓄地说∶『你没有啥不对，
“You have done nothing wrong.

大先生把阜康交给你，你当然顾牢阜康，这是天经地义。
Mr Hu entrusted Fukang to you; naturally you must protect it.

不过，有时候朋友的事，也要顾一顾，
But sometimes you must consider a friend’s affairs too.

到底大家都是在一条船上的人。』
After all, everyone is in the same boat.”

这一下等于是泄了底，螺蛳太太是为了他勒住该付古应春的款子来兴师问罪，
That revealed her purpose: she had come to call him to account for withholding the money due to Gu.

当即认错，表示歉意∶『是！是！
He immediately admitted fault and apologized. “Yes.

我对应春，是想到阜康是大先生事业的命脉，处理得稍为过分了一点；
I went a little too far with Yingchun, thinking of Fukang as the lifeblood of Mr Hu’s business.

其实公是公、私是私！我同他的交情是不会变的。
But public business and private friendship are separate; my feelings for him have not changed.

如今请罗四太太说一句我应该怎么样同他赔不是？我一定遵命。』
Tell me how I ought to make amends, and I shall obey.”

『赔不是的话是严重了。』
“Making amends is too strong a phrase.”

螺蛳太太忽然灵机一动∶『眼前倒有个能顾全你们交情的机会。』
An idea struck her. “There is an opportunity now to preserve your friendship.”

她朝外看了一下，没有再说下去。
She glanced outside and left the thought unfinished.

宓本常稍为想一想，便能领悟，是指古应春纳宠而言。
Mi understood after a moment: Gu’s taking a concubine.

她刚才看一看，是防着瑞香会听见。
She had looked out to make sure Ruixiang could not hear.

『我懂了。
“I understand.

我来办；好好替他热闹热闹。』
I shall take charge and give him a proper celebration.”


说送一份重礼，不足为奇；
An expensive gift alone would be unremarkable.

如果是宓本常自告奋勇来为古应春办这场喜事，费心费力，才显得出朋友的交情。
Mi’s volunteering to organize the occasion, giving his own time and effort, would demonstrate real friendship.

螺蛳太太非常满意，但怕他是敷衍面子，不能不敲钉转脚加一句∶『宓先生，这是你自己说的噢！』
Madam Luosi was delighted, though she feared mere polite evasion and therefore pinned him down. “Remember, Mr Mi, that was your own offer.”

『罗四太太请放心，
“Do not worry.

完全交给我，
Leave everything to me.

一定办得很风光。』宓本常接着很郑重地表示∶『不过，公是公，私是私。
I shall make it splendid.” He added gravely, “But business and private matters must remain separate.

我刚才同罗四太太谈的各样情形，千万不必同应春去讲。』
There is no need to tell Yingchun anything of what I have explained today.”

『我晓得。』
“I understand.”

宓本常一面应酬螺蛳太太，一面心里在转念头。
While entertaining her, Mi was turning over plans of his own.

原来他也有一番雄心壮志，
He too had ambitions.

看胡雪岩这么一片『鲜花着锦』的事业，不免兴起『大丈夫不当如是耶』的想法，
Looking at Hu’s dazzling success, he could not help thinking that a man ought to achieve as much himself.

觉得虽蒙重用，毕竟是做伙计，
However trusted, he remained an employee.

自己也应该创一番事业。
He should build a business of his own.

此念起于五年以前，但直到前年年底，方成事实。
The idea had first occurred five years earlier, but only at the end of the year before last had it taken shape.


原来他有个嫡亲的表弟叫陈义生，一向跟沙船帮做南北货生意，
His younger cousin, Chen Yisheng, had long worked with the coastal junk merchants in the trade between north and south.

那年押货到北方，船上出事，一根桅杆忽然折断，砸伤了他的腿，
While accompanying a shipment north that year, he had been injured when a mast suddenly snapped and struck his leg.

得了残疾；东家送他两千银子，请他回宁波原籍休养；
Left disabled, he received two thousand taels from his employer and was sent home to Ningbo to recuperate.

宓本常回家过年，经常在一起盘桓，
Mi returned there for the New Year and spent much time with him.

大年三十夜里谈了一个通宵，谈出结果来了。
On New Year’s Eve, they talked through the night and reached a conclusion.

宓本常是盘算过多少遍的，
Mi had considered his position repeatedly.

如果跟胡雪岩明言，自己想创业，胡雪岩也会帮他的忙，但一定是小规模重头做起，而又必须辞掉阜康的职务。
If he told Hu that he wanted a business of his own, Hu would help him, but he would have to begin on a small scale and resign from Fukang.

不做大寺庙的知客，去做一个不茅庵的住持，不是聪明的办法——
To leave the position of guest-master at a great monastery for the abbacy of a tiny thatched hermitage was hardly wise.

他认为最聪明的办法是，利用在阜康的地位，调度他人的资本，去做自己的生意；
The clever course, he believed, was to use his position at Fukang to deploy other people’s capital in his own enterprise.

但决不能做钱庄，也不能做丝茧，因为这跟『老板』的事业是犯冲突的。
It must not be banking or silk and cocoons, however, since those would compete with his employer.

他的难题是∶第一，不知道哪种生意加收得快？
There were two difficulties. First, what business would return its capital quickly?

因为要调集三、五十万，他力量是够得到，只是临时周转，
He could mobilize three to five hundred thousand taels, but only temporarily.

周而复始，看不出他在挪用公款，期限一长，少不得要露马脚。
Repeated short turns of the money might conceal his misuse of entrusted funds; a long commitment would expose him.

其次，他不能出面；
Second, he could not appear openly.

一出面人家就会打听，他的资本来自何处，更怕胡雪岩说一句∶『创业维艰，一定要专心，
People would inquire into the source of his capital; worse, Hu might say, “Building a business takes concentration.

你不能再替我做档手了。
You cannot remain my head clerk.

不然「驼子跌跟斗，两头落空」，耽误了你自己，也耽误了我。』
Otherwise you will fall between two stools, harming both your affairs and mine.”

那一来，什么都无从谈起了。
Then the whole scheme would collapse.

这两个难题，遇到陈义生迎刃而解。
Chen solved both problems.

他说∶『要讲回收得快，莫如南北货；
“For a quick return of capital, nothing beats the north-south trade.

货色都是须先定好的，先收定洋，货到照算。
Orders are placed beforehand and deposits collected; the balance is settled when the goods arrive.

南货销北，北货销南，一趟船做两笔生意；
Southern goods go north, northern goods south—two transactions on one voyage.

只要两三个来回，本常哥，你马上就是大老板了。』
After two or three return trips, Brother Benchang, you will be a great merchant.”

『看你讲得这么好，为啥我的朋友当中，做这行生意的，简直找不出来？』
“If it is so good, why can I scarcely find anyone among my acquaintances in that line?”


『不是找不出来，是你不晓得而已。』
“It is not that there are none; you simply do not know about them.

陈义生说∶『做这行生意，吃本很重，不是一般人能做的。
The trade requires substantial capital, beyond most people’s reach.

至于真正有钱想做这行生意的。又吃不起辛苦。
Those with enough money are often unwilling to bear the hardship.

做南北货生意，如果不是内行，不懂行情，也不会看货，哪怕亲自下手押船，也一定让人家吃掉。
Without experience, knowledge of prices, and the ability to judge goods, even a man escorting his own cargo will be taken advantage of.

所以有钱的人，都是放帐叫人家去做，
Wealthy people therefore advance money for others to trade with.

只要不出险，永远都是赚的。』
Unless disaster strikes, there is always a profit.”

『对了，
“Exactly.

汪洋大海出了事，船沉了，货色也送了海龙王了，
Suppose something happens at sea and the ship sinks, giving its cargo to the Dragon King.

那时候怎么办？』
What then?”

『就是这个风险。
“That is the risk.

不过现在有保险公司也很稳当。』
But with insurance companies now, matters are quite secure.”

『从前没有保险呢？』
“What did people do before insurance?”

『』没有保险，一样也要做。
“Traded all the same.

十趟里面不见得出一趟事，
Not one voyage in ten necessarily ends in disaster.

就算出一趟事，有那几趟的赚头，也抵得过这一趟的亏蚀。
Even if one does, the profits from the others cover the loss.”

『听得这一说，宓本常大为动心，』
Mi was greatly tempted.

义生，『他说，』可惜你的脚跛了。
“A pity about your lame leg, Yisheng.”

『』我的脚是跛了。
“My leg is lame.”

『陈义生敲敲自己的头，』
Chen tapped his head.

我的脑子没有坏。
“My mind is not.

而且伤养好了，至多行动不太方便，
Besides, the injury has healed; at worst, moving about is a little inconvenient.

又不是病倒在床起不来。
I am not confined to bed.”

『宓本常心想，
Mi considered.

如果让陈义生出面，由于他本来就干这一行，背后原有好些有钱的人撑腰，资本的来源决没有人会知道。
Chen already knew the trade and had long had wealthy backers. With him acting openly, nobody would know where the capital came from.

就怕他起黑心，因而沉默不语。
Mi feared only that he might turn dishonest, and remained silent.


陈义生的娘是宓本常的姑母，，很想乘此机会跟他合作，一个发大财，一个发小财；
Chen, whose mother was Mi’s paternal aunt, very much wanted the partnership: a large fortune for one cousin and a smaller one for the other.

见此光景，不免失望。但他有他的办法，
Mi’s silence disappointed him, but he had a remedy.

将他的老娘搬请了出来。
He enlisted his mother.

陈义生当然也看出宓本常的心意，
She too understood Mi’s concern.

年初四那天，将宓本常请了去说∶『阿常，你同义生是一起长大的，
On the fourth day of the New Year, she invited him over. “A’chang, you and Yisheng grew up together.

你两岁死娘，还吃过我的奶，
Your mother died when you were two; you even drank my milk.

这样子象同胞手足的表兄弟，
You cousins are like brothers.

你为啥有话不肯同义生说？』
Why will you not speak openly with him?”

宓本常当然不能承认，
Mi could hardly acknowledge his suspicion.

否则不但伤感情，而且以后合作的路子也断了，
It would hurt their feelings and close off future cooperation.

所以假托了一个理由。
He invented another reason.

『我不是不肯同义生说，
“It is not that I will not tell him.

钱不是我的，
The money is not mine.

我总要好好儿想一想；等想妥当了再来谈。』
I must think carefully before we discuss it further.”

『我懂你的意思，
“I understand.

你是怕风险。
You fear the risks.

风险无非第一，路上不顺利；第二，怕义生对不起你。
There are only two: an unfortunate voyage, or Yisheng’s failing you.

如果是怕路上出事，那就不必谈；
If you fear an accident on the voyage, there is nothing more to say.

至于说义生对不起你，那就是对不起我。
As for Yisheng, to fail you would be to fail me.

今天晚上烧「财神纸」，我叫义生在财神菩萨面前赌个咒，明明心迹。
Tonight, when we burn offerings to the God of Wealth, I shall have him swear an oath before the deity and make his intentions clear.”

『这天晚上到一交子时，便算正月初五，财神菩萨赵玄坛的生日，
At the beginning of the zi hour that evening, it counted as the fifth day of the first month, the birthday of Zhao Xuantan, God of Wealth.

家家烧财神纸，
Every household burned paper offerings.

陈义生奉母之命，在烧纸时立下重誓；
At his mother’s command, Chen swore a solemn oath during the burning.

然后与宓本常计议，议定一个出钱，一个出力，所得利润，宓本常得两份，陈义生得一份但相约一年内，彼此都不动用盈余，这样才能积累起一笔自己的本钱。
He and Mi then settled their agreement: one would provide capital, the other work; profits would be divided two shares to Mi and one to Chen. Neither would draw on the profits for a year, allowing them to accumulate capital of their own.


于是陈义生又到了上海，在十六铺租了房子住下来。
Chen returned to Shanghai and rented quarters at Shiliupu.

等宓本常拨付的五万银子的本钱到手，开始招兵买马，运了一船南货到辽东湾的营口；
Once Mi’s first fifty thousand taels arrived, he recruited his staff and took a shipload of southern goods to Yingkou on Liaodong Bay.

回程由营口到天津塘沽，装载北货南下，
Returning, he sailed from Yingkou to Tanggu at Tianjin, loaded northern goods, and brought them south.

一去一来恰好两个月，
The round trip took exactly two months.

结算下来，五万银子的本钱，除去开销、净赚三千，是六分的利息，
On the fifty thousand taels, the profit after expenses was three thousand—a six-per-cent return.

而宓本常借客户的名义，动支这笔资金，月息只得二厘五，两个月亦不过五厘。
Mi, meanwhile, had drawn the funds in a customer’s name at only a quarter of one per cent a month, or half of one per cent for the two months.

宓本常之敌视古应春，就因为自己做了亏心事，怕古应春知道了会告诉胡雪岩，所以不愿他跟阜康过于接近。
His hostility towards Gu sprang from his own misconduct: he feared that Gu would discover it and tell Hu, and therefore wanted to keep him away from Fukang.

但现在的想法却大大地一变，
Now his thinking changed completely.

主要的是他有了信心，觉得以自己的手腕，很可以表现得大方些；
Growing confidence convinced him that he could afford to show generosity.

再往深处去想，胡雪岩最信任的就是螺蛳太太与古应春，
More deeply considered, Hu trusted Madam Luosi and Gu above all others.

将这两个人笼络好了，便是立于不败之地，局面愈发得以开展。
Winning those two over would make his position impregnable and give his enterprise still greater scope.


就这一顿饭之间，打定了主意，而且立刻开始实行，
Within the course of that lunch, Mi decided upon the plan and began putting it into practice.

自告奋勇带了个伶俐的小徒弟，陪着螺狮太太与瑞香，先到他们宁波同乡开的方九霞银楼去看首饰；然后到抛球场一带的绸缎庄去看衣料。
Taking a bright young apprentice, he volunteered to accompany Madam Luosi and Ruixiang, first to Fang Jiuxia’s jewellery shop, owned by a fellow Ningbo native, then to the silk shops around the recreation ground.

宓本常在十时洋场上也是响当当的人物，
Mi was himself a prominent figure in Shanghai’s foreign settlement.

奉命唯谨地伺奉在两个堂客左右；不但螺蛳太太觉得面子十足，瑞香的观感亦为之一变——
His punctilious attendance upon the two women greatly enhanced Madam Luosi’s dignity and altered Ruixiang’s opinion of him.

平时听古应春与七姑奶奶谈起宓本常，总说他『面无四两肉』，是个难缠的人物，
Whenever Gu and the Seventh Lady mentioned Mi, they spoke of his lean, fleshless face as a sign of a difficult man.

如今才知道并非如此。
Now she found him quite different.

到得夕阳西下，该置办的东西都办齐了，
By sunset, everything was purchased.

帐款都归宓本常结算，
Mi would settle all the accounts.

首饰随身携带，其余物品，送到阜康钱庄，凭货取款，自有随行的小徒弟去料理。
They carried the jewellery with them; the other goods were to be delivered to Fukang and paid for on receipt, with the apprentice attending to the details.


『罗四太太，辰光不早了，
“It is getting late, Madam Luo.

我想请你同瑞姑娘到虹口去吃一顿大菜。』
May I invite you and Miss Rui to a Western dinner in Hongkou?

宓本常又说∶『今天月底，九月初三好日子，
Today is the last day of the month, and the third of the ninth month is the auspicious date.

喜事要连夜筹备才来得及；
We must prepare the celebration immediately.

我们一面吃，一面商量。』
We can discuss it over dinner.”

多谢、多谢。
“Thank you.

吃大菜是心领了。
I appreciate the invitation, but must decline.

不过商量办喜事倒是要紧的。
The arrangements do need discussion, though.

我把你这番好意，先同应春说一说，
Let me first tell Yingchun of your kindness.

你晚上请到古家来，一切当面谈，好不好？
Come to his house this evening, and we can settle everything face to face.”

『『好，好！
“Certainly.

这样也好。』
That will do very well.”

宓本常还是将螺蛳太太与瑞香送回家，只是过门不入而已。
Mi escorted the women home, but did not go inside.


螺蛳太太见了古应春，自然另有一套说法，
To Gu, Madam Luosi naturally presented matters differently.

她先将宓本常是为了『做信用』、『教客户好放心』，才在汇丰存了一笔款子的解释说明白，
She first explained that Mi kept money at HSBC to establish Fukang’s credit and reassure its customers.

然后说道∶『他这样做，固然不能算错，不过他对朋友应该讲清楚。
“That is not wrong in itself, but he should explain it to his friends.

这一点，他承认他不对；我也好好说了他一顿。』
He admits that fault, and I gave him a proper talking-to.”

『这又何必？』
“There was no need.”

『当然要说他。
“Of course there was.

世界上原有一种人，你不说，他不晓得自己错；
Some people do not know they are wrong until told.

一说了，他才晓得不但错了，而且大错特错，心里很难过。
Then they realize they were very wrong indeed and feel deeply troubled.

宓本常就是这样一个人，
Mi is such a man.

为了补情认错，他说九月初三的喜事，归他来办；
To make amends, he has offered to organize the celebration on the third.

回头他来商量。』螺蛳太太紧接着说∶『姐夫，你亦不必同他客气。
He will come shortly to discuss it.” She added at once, “Do not stand on ceremony.

我再老实说一句∶他是大先生的伙计，你是大先生的好朋友，
To speak plainly, he is Mr Hu’s employee; you are Mr Hu’s close friend.

要他来当差，也是应该的。』
There is nothing improper in asking him to do the work.”

听得这一说，古应春惟有拱手称谢。
Gu could only clasp his hands in thanks.

但也就是刚刚谈完，宓本常已经带着人将为瑞香置办的衣物等等送到；
They had scarcely finished speaking when Mi arrived with men carrying Ruixiang’s new clothes and other purchases.

见了古应春，笑容满面地连连拱手。
Smiling broadly, he greeted Gu with repeated bows.


『应春兄，恭喜、恭喜。
“Congratulations, Brother Yingchun!

九月初三，我来效劳；
I shall be at your service on the third.

日子太紧，我不敢耽误工夫，
With so little time, I dare waste none.

今天晚上在府中叨扰，
Let me impose on your hospitality tonight.

喜事该怎么办？我们一路吃、一路谈，都谈妥当了它；
We can discuss the arrangements as we eat and settle everything.

明天一早就动手，尽两天办齐，后天热热闹闹吃喜酒。』
Tomorrow morning we begin; two days to prepare, and the day after tomorrow we shall have a splendid wedding feast.”

见他如此热心，古应春既感动。又困惑——
Gu was moved but puzzled by such enthusiasm.

困惑的是，宓本常平时做人，不是这个样子的；
Mi did not usually behave this way.

莫非真的是内疚于心，刻意补过。
Was he truly troubled by his conscience and determined to make amends?

心里是这样想，表面上当然也很客气，
Whatever his thoughts, Gu responded courteously.

『老宓，你是个大忙人，
“You are a busy man, Mi.

为我的事，如此费心，真正不安，不敢当。』
I am embarrassed by all this trouble on my account.

他说∶『说实在的，我现在也没有这种闲心思，
Frankly, I have little inclination for festivities now.

只为内人催促、罗四太太的盛意，不得不然，
I agreed only because my wife urged me and Madam Luo was so kind.

只要象个样子，万万不敢铺张。』
Something respectable will do; I could not presume to be extravagant.”

『不错，总要象个样子。
“Certainly—it must be respectable.

应春兄，你也是上海滩上鼎鼎大名的人物，
You are a celebrated man in Shanghai, Brother Yingchun.

喜事的场面不可以太俭朴，不然人家背后会批评。
The occasion must not be too plain, or people will criticize it behind your back.”



胡雪岩 · 萧瑟洋场
The Desolate Foreign Settlement
第七章（本章第6部分，共6部分）
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


原是一桩喜事，
“It is a happy occasion.

落了些不中听的闲话，就犯不着了。
There is no point in giving people something unpleasant to say about it.”

『这话倒提醒古应春了。
Mi’s words reminded Gu of a danger.

七姑奶奶是最讨厌闲言闲语的，
The Seventh Lady detested gossip.

场面过于俭朴，就可能会有人说∶』古应春不敢铺张；因为讨小老婆的场面太热闹了，大老婆会吃醋。
If the celebration was too modest, someone might say that Gu dared not make a fuss over taking a concubine because his wife would be jealous.

『倘或有这样的一种说法，传到七姑奶奶耳朵里，她会气得发病。
Should that reach her ears, she would make herself ill with anger.

这是非同小可的一件事，
This was serious.

古应春很感谢宓本常能适时提醒，让他有此警惕。因而拱着手说∶『老宓，你完全是爱护我的意思，我不敢不听，
Grateful for the timely warning, Gu clasped his hands. “You have my interests entirely at heart, Mi, and I must listen.

不过到底只有两天的工夫预备，也只好适可而止。』
Still, with only two days to prepare, we must observe some limits.”

『当然、当然，
“Certainly.

一定要来得及。
Everything must be ready in time.

现在第一件要紧的是，把请客的单子拟出来。
First we need a guest list.

你的交游一向很广，起码也要请个十桌八桌，
Your acquaintance is wide: at least eight or ten tables.

我看要另外借地方。』
I think we shall need another venue.”

『不，不！
“No!

那一来就没有止境了。
Then there would be no end to it.

请客多少只能看舍间地方大小而定。』
The number must depend on the space in my house.”

于是细细估量，
They calculated carefully.

将内外客厅、书房、起坐间都算上，大概只能摆七桌，
Including the inner and outer reception rooms, study, and sitting room, there was room for about seven tables.

初步决定五桌男客，两桌女客。
Provisionally they allotted five to men and two to women.

『本来天井里搭篷，还可以摆四桌，那一来「堂会」就没地方了。』宓本常说∶『好，准定七桌，
“A canopy over the courtyard would give us four more,” Mi said, “but then there would be nowhere for the entertainment. Very well, seven tables.

名单你开，帖子我叫我那里的人来写，
You make the list; my staff will write the invitations.

至晚明天下午一定要发出。
They must go out by tomorrow afternoon at the latest.

菜呢，你看用哪里的菜？』
Where shall we order the food?”


请你斟酌，
“Choose for me.

只要好就好。
So long as it is good.”

『』不但要好，还要便宜。
“Good and reasonably priced.

『宓本常又问∶』客人是下半天四五点钟前后就来了，
The guests will arrive around four or five.

堂会准定四点钟开场，到晚上九点钟歇锣，总要三档节目；
The entertainment must begin at four and finish at nine, so we shall need three acts.

应春兄，你看，用哪三档？
Which would you like?”

『』此道我亦是外行，
“I know little about that.

请你费心提调。
Please arrange it.”

『』我看？『宓本常一面想，一面说∶』先来档苏州光裕社的小书；
Mi considered. “First, a programme of ballad-storytelling from Suzhou’s Guangyu Society.

接下来弄一档魔术，日本的女魔术师天胜娘又来了，我今天就去定好了；
Then magic: the Japanese conjuror Tianshengniang is back, and I shall book her today.

压轴戏是「东乡调大戏」，
The finale can be Dongxiang opera.

蛮热闹的。『古应春称是，都由宓本常作主。
That is very lively.” Gu agreed and left everything to him.

等他告辞而去，古应春将所作的决定告诉七姑奶奶，
After Mi departed, Gu told the Seventh Lady what they had decided.

她却颇有意见。
She had objections.

『我看堂客不要请。』她说，
“I do not think we should invite women.

『请了，人家也未见得肯来。』
Even if invited, they may not come.”

本来纳宠请女客，除非是儿孙满堂的老封翁，
Ordinarily, women were not invited to a celebration of taking a concubine unless the man was an elderly patriarch surrounded by children and grandchildren.

晚辈内眷为了一尽孝心，不能不来贺喜见礼；
The younger women of his family would then have to offer congratulations and pay their respects from filial duty.

否则便很少有请女客的。
Otherwise such invitations were rare.

上海虽比较开通，但吃醋毕竟是妇人天性，而嫡庶之分，又看得极重；
Shanghai might be more liberal, but jealousy was still regarded as natural to women, and the distinction between wife and concubine remained strict.

如果是与七姑奶奶交好的，一定会作抵制。
Women close to the Seventh Lady would certainly stay away in protest.

古应春觉得自己同意请女客，确是有欠思量。
Gu realized that he had agreed too thoughtlessly.


『再说，我行动不便，没法子作主人；更不便劳动四姐代我应酬。』
“Besides, I cannot get about to act as hostess, and it would be awkward to trouble Sister Luo to entertain on my behalf.

七姑奶奶又说∶『如果有几位堂客觉得无所谓的，尽管请过来；
If a few women feel comfortable coming, by all means let them.

我们亦就象平常来往一样不拘礼数，主客双方都心安，
We can treat it as an ordinary informal visit, without ceremony, so that everyone feels at ease.

这跟特为下帖子是不同的。
That is different from issuing special invitations.

你说是不是呢？』
Do you agree?”

『完全不错。』古应春从善如流地答说∶『不请堂客。』
“Entirely,” Gu readily conceded. “We shall not invite women formally.”

『至于堂会热闹热闹；顺便也算请四姐玩一天，我赞成。
“As for some lively entertainment, I approve. It will give Sister Luo a pleasant day too.

不过，东乡调可以免了。』
But omit the Dongxiang opera.”

原来东乡调是『花鼓戏』的一种，发源于浦东，所以称为『东乡调』，
Dongxiang was a form of flower-drum opera originating in Pudong, hence its name, “eastern district tunes.”

又名『本滩』是『本地滩簧』的简称。
It was also called bentan, short for local tanhuang.

曲词卑俚，但连唱带做，淫治异常，所以颇具号召力，
Its lyrics were coarse, and the combination of singing and acting was extremely bawdy, which made it popular.

浦东乡下，点起火油灯唱东乡调的夜台戏，真有倾村来观之盛。
In rural Pudong, whole villages would turn out for night performances by kerosene light.

但却难登大雅之堂。
It was hardly suitable for a refined gathering.

『「两只奶奶抖勒抖」，』七姑奶奶学唱了一句东乡调说，
“‘Those two breasts go jiggle-jiggle,’” the Seventh Lady sang in imitation.

『这种戏，怎么好请四姐来看？』
“How could we invite Sister Luo to watch that?”

看她学唱东乡调的样子，不但古应春忍俊不禁，连下人都掩着嘴笑了。
Her performance made Gu laugh despite himself; even the servants covered their mouths and giggled.


『不唱东乡调，唱啥呢？』
“What shall we have instead?”

『杭州滩簧，
“Hangzhou tanhuang.

文文气气，又弹又唱，
It is elegant, with strings and singing.

说是宋朝传下来，当时连宫里都准去唱的。
They say it dates from the Song dynasty and was even admitted to the palace.

为了请四姐，杭州滩簧最好；
That would be best for Sister Luo.

明天倒去打听打听，如果上海有，叫一班来听听。』
Inquire tomorrow: if there is a troupe in Shanghai, ask it to perform.”

『好！』
“Very well.”

古应春想了下说∶『堂客虽不请，不过你行动不便，四姐可是作客总要请一两个来帮忙吧！
Gu considered. “Even without women guests, you cannot get about, and Sister Luo is a visitor. We ought to ask one or two women to help.”

『请王师母好了。』
“Ask Mrs Wang.”

王师母的丈夫王仲文是古应春的学生，
Her husband, Wang Zhongwen, was Gu’s pupil.

在教堂里当司事，也收学生教英文，所以称的他的妻子为『师母』，
He served as a church clerk and also took pupils in English, so his wife was called shimu, “teacher’s wife.”

七姑奶奶也是这样叫她。
The Seventh Lady used that title too.

但七姑奶奶却不折不扣地是王师母的『师母，』
Yet as the wife of Wang’s own teacher, the Seventh Lady was in turn Mrs Wang’s shimu.

因此，初次听她们彼此的称呼，往往大惑不解。
Anyone first hearing their forms of address was apt to be thoroughly confused.


螺师太太即是如此，
Madam Luosi was no exception.

那天王师母来了，七姑奶奶为她引见，又听王师母恭恭敬敬地说∶『师母这两天的气色，比前一晌又好得多了。』
When Mrs Wang arrived that day and was introduced, she heard the young woman respectfully say, “Shimu, you look better again than you did a little while ago.”

便忍不住要问。『你们两位到底哪个是哪个的师母？』
Madam Luosi could not resist asking, “Which of you is whose shimu?”

『自然是师母是我的师母；
“Naturally, Shimu is my shimu.

我请师母不要叫我小王师母，师母不听，
I have asked Shimu not to call me Young Mrs Wang, but Shimu will not listen.

有一回我特为不理师母，师母生气了，只好仍旧听师母叫我小王师母。』
Once I deliberately failed to answer Shimu, and Shimu was angry, so I had to let Shimu go on calling me Young Mrs Wang.”

一片叽叽喳喳的师母声，倒象在说绕口令；
The torrent of shimu sounded like a tongue-twister.

螺蛳太太看她二十五六岁年纪，生就一张圆圆脸，觉得亲切可喜，
Madam Luosi found the round-faced woman, about twenty-five or twenty-six, warm and agreeable.

自然而然地便熟悉得不象初见了。
They quickly felt as though they had known each other for years.


尤其是看到小王师母与瑞香相处融洽的情形，更觉欣慰。
She was especially relieved by the easy affection between Young Mrs Wang and Ruixiang.

原来瑞香虽喜终身有托，但在好日子的这一天，跟一般新嫁娘一样，总不免有凄惶恐惧之感，
Ruixiang was glad to have her future settled, yet on this auspicious day she felt the anxiety and fear common to a bride.

更因是螺蛳太太与七姑奶奶虽都待她不坏，但一个是从前的主母，一个是现在的大妇，
Madam Luosi and the Seventh Lady treated her well, but one was her former mistress and the other now the principal wife.

平时本就拘谨，这一天更不敢吐露内心的感觉，怕她们在心里会骂她『轻狂不识抬举』。
She had always been reserved with them, and today dared reveal still less of her feelings, lest they think her frivolous or ungrateful.

幸而有热心而相熟的小王师母殷勤照料，不时嘘寒问暖，竟如同亲姊妹一般；
Fortunately, the familiar and warm-hearted Young Mrs Wang attended to her needs with the care of a sister.

瑞香一直悬着的一颗心才能踏实，脸上也开始有笑容了。
Only then did Ruixiang’s anxious heart settle and smiles begin to appear.

在螺蛳太太，心情非常复杂，
Madam Luosi’s feelings were complicated.

对瑞香，多少有着嫁妇儿的那种心情；但更重要的是古家的交情。
Towards Ruixiang she felt something of a mother marrying off her daughter, but her friendship with the Gu household mattered still more.

因此，她虽了解瑞香心里的感觉；却苦于没有适当的话来宽慰她；
She understood Ruixiang’s emotions without finding the right words to comfort her.

如今有了小王师母能鼓舞起瑞香的一团喜气，等于自己分身有术，
Now that Young Mrs Wang could bring out her happiness, Madam Luosi felt almost as though she had gained a second self.

可以不必顾虑瑞香，而全力去周旋行动不便的七姑奶奶，将这场喜事办得十分圆满。
Free of that concern, she could devote herself to the Seventh Lady and help make the celebration a complete success.

当然，这场喜事能办得圆满，另一个『功臣』是宓本常。
Another contributor, of course, was Mi.

对于他的尽心尽力，殷勤周到，不但螺蛳太太大为嘉许，连古应春夫妇都另眼相看了。
His tireless and thoughtful attention won not only Madam Luosi’s praise but a changed opinion from Gu and his wife.


果如七姑奶奶的估计，堂客到得极少，连一桌都凑不满，
As the Seventh Lady had predicted, few women came—not enough even for one full table.

但男客却非常踊跃。
The men, however, arrived eagerly.

当堂会开始时，估计已经可以坐满五桌了。
By the start of the entertainment, there seemed enough to fill five tables.

由于是纳妾，铺陈比较简单，
Since the occasion was the taking of a concubine, the decorations were relatively simple.

虽也张灯结彩，但客堂正中却只挂了一帽大红缎子彩绣的南极寿星图，
There were lanterns and festive hangings, but the centre of the reception hall displayed only a brightly embroidered picture on red satin of the Old Man of the South Pole, the God of Longevity.

不明就里的，只当古家做寿。
An uninformed visitor might have thought it a birthday celebration.

这是七姑奶奶与螺蛳太太商量定规的，
The Seventh Lady and Madam Luosi had agreed upon this.

因为纳妾向来没有什么仪节，只是一乘小轿到门，向主人主母磕了头，便算成礼。
Taking a concubine ordinarily involved little ceremony: a small sedan arrived, the woman kowtowed to master and mistress, and the matter was complete.

如今对瑞香是格外优遇，
Ruixiang was receiving exceptional consideration already.

张灯结彩，已非寻常，如果再挂一幅和合二仙图，便象正式结裏，礼数稍嫌过分，
Lanterns and coloured hangings were unusual; to display the Two Immortals of Harmony as well would make it resemble a formal marriage and exceed the proper rites.

所以改用一幅寿星图。
They had therefore chosen the longevity picture instead.

瑞香的服饰，也是七姑奶有与螺蛳太太商量过的。
The two women had also discussed Ruixiang’s clothes.

妇人最看重的是一条红裙，以瑞香的身份，是没有资格着的；
A red skirt was what women valued most, but her status did not entitle her to wear one.

为了弥补起见，许她着紫红夹袄，
As compensation she was allowed a plum-red lined jacket.

时日迫促，找裁缝连夜做亦来不及；
Time was too short even for a tailor working through the night.

仍旧是宓本常有办法，到跟阜康钱庄有往来的当铺中去借了一件全新的来，
Again Mi found a solution: he borrowed a completely new one from a pawnshop that dealt with Fukang.

略微显得小了些，但却更衬托出她的身材苗条。
It was slightly small, but that only emphasized her slender figure.


到得五点钟吉时，一档『白蛇传』的小书结束，
At the auspicious hour of five, the storytelling performance of The White Snake ended.

宾客纷纷从席棚下进入堂屋观礼。
Guests streamed from beneath the courtyard awning into the reception hall to watch the ceremony.

七姑奶奶由仆妇背下楼来，
A maidservant carried the Seventh Lady downstairs on her back.

纳入一张太师椅中，抬到堂前；
She was settled in a ceremonial armchair, which was then carried to the front of the hall.

她的左首，另有一张同样的椅子，是古应春的座位。
An identical chair on her left awaited Gu.

于是便有人起哄地喊道∶『新郎倌呢？新郎倌！』
“Where is the bridegroom? Bridegroom!” someone shouted playfully.

『新郎倌』古应春为人从人丛中推了出来，
Gu was pushed forward from the crowd.

宝蓝贡缎夹袍，玄色西洋华丝葛马褂，脚踏粉底皂靴，头上一顶硬胎缎帽，帽檐正中镶一块碧玉，
He wore a lined robe of sapphire-blue tribute satin, a black riding jacket of imported silk faille, black boots with white soles, and a stiff satin cap with a piece of green jade set centrally above its brim.

新剃的头；
His head had been freshly shaved.

他是洋派不留胡子，翕显得年轻了。
Following foreign fashion, he wore no beard, which made him look younger.

等他一坐下来，视线集中，自然而然地看到了七姑奶奶，下身百褶红裙，上身墨绿夹袄，头上戴着珠花，面如满月，脸有喜气，真正福相。
Once he sat down, everyone’s attention naturally took in the Seventh Lady: a pleated red skirt, a dark-green lined jacket, pearl flowers in her hair, a face round as the full moon and bright with happiness—a truly fortunate appearance.

再看到旁边，扶着七姑奶奶的椅背的一个中年妇人，
Beside her, a middle-aged woman rested a hand on the chair back.

一张瓜子脸，脂粉不施，天然丰韵，
Her oval face needed no powder or rouge; its grace was natural.

一双眼睛，既黑且亮，恍如阳光直射寒潭，只觉得深不可测，令人不敢逼视。
Her dark, bright eyes resembled sunlight falling directly into a cold, deep pool: unfathomable, almost impossible to meet.

她穿的是玄色缎袄，下面也是红裙；
She wore a black satin jacket and, like the Seventh Lady, a red skirt.

头上没有什么首饰，但扶着椅背的那只手上戴着一枚钻戒，不时闪出耀眼的光芒，
There was little jewellery in her hair, but the diamond ring on the hand resting against the chair flashed dazzlingly.

可以想见戒指上镶的钻，至少也有蚕豆瓣那么大。
Its stone must have been at least the size of half a broad bean.


『那是谁？』有人悄悄在问。
“Who is she?” someone whispered.

『听说是胡大先生的妾。』
“I hear she is Mr Hu’s concubine.”

『是妾，怎么着红裙？』
“Then why is she wearing a red skirt?”

『又不是在她自己家里，
“She is not in her own house.

哪个来管她？』
Who can stop her?”

『不！』另有一个人说∶『她就是胡家的螺蛳太太，
“No,” another man said. “That is Madam Luosi of the Hu household.

着红裙是胡老太太特许的。』
The Old Madam has specially permitted her to wear red.”


那两个人还想谈下去，但视线为瑞香所吸引了。
The first two men would have continued, but Ruixiang drew their eyes.

只见她低着头，但见满头珠翠，却看不清脸，
Her head was lowered beneath a wealth of pearls and jade, hiding her face.

不过长身玉立，皮肤雪白，已可想见是个美人。
Yet her tall, graceful figure and fair skin already suggested beauty.

她是由小王师母扶着出来的，嬝嬝婷婷地走到红毡条前立定；
Supported by Young Mrs Wang, she approached the strip of red felt and stood poised before it.

古家的老王妈赞礼∶『新姑娘见老爷、太太磕头∶一叩首、
Old Nanny Wang of the Gu household called out the ritual directions: “The new lady pays her respects to Master and Mistress. First kowtow!

二叩首、
Second kowtow!

三叩首、
Third kowtow!

兴！』
Rise!”

小王师母便将瑞香扶了起来；
Young Mrs Wang helped Ruixiang to her feet.

七姑奶奶抬抬手喊一声∶『你过来！』老王妈便又高唱∶『太太赏新姑娘见面礼。』
The Seventh Lady raised her hand. “Come here.” Old Nanny Wang announced, “Mistress presents the new lady with a welcoming gift.”

这时螺蛳太太便将一个小丝绒匣子悄悄递了给七姑奶奶，
Madam Luosi quietly handed the Seventh Lady a small velvet box.

她打开匣了——也是一枚钻戒，拉起瑞香的手，将戒指套在她右手九名指上。
She opened it to reveal another diamond ring, took Ruixiang’s hand, and slipped the ring onto her right ring finger.

『谢谢奶奶！』瑞香低声道谢；
“Thank you, Madam,” Ruixiang said softly.

还要跪下去，却让螺蛳太太拉住了。
She was about to kneel again, but Madam Luosi stopped her.


这就算礼成了，不道奇峰突起，古应春站起身来，看着螺蛳太太说道∶『四姐，你请过来，
The ceremony was complete—until Gu unexpectedly stood and turned to Madam Luosi. “Sister Luo, come here.

应该让瑞香给你磕头。』
Ruixiang ought to kowtow to you.”

『没有这个规矩，
“There is no such custom.

这算啥一出？』
What are you doing?”

说着，便待避开，哪知七姑奶奶早就拉住了她的衣服；
She tried to withdraw, but the Seventh Lady had already caught her clothing.

适时瑞香竟也走上前来，扶着她说∶『太太请坐。』
Ruixiang also stepped forward and supported her. “Please sit, Madam.”

小王师母与老王妈亦都上前来劝驾，
Young Mrs Wang and Old Nanny Wang joined in the urging.

螺蛳太太身不由主，只好受了瑞香的大礼。
Unable to escape, Madam Luosi had to accept Ruixiang’s full obeisance.

乱轰轰一阵过去，正要散开，奇峰又起，
When the bustle subsided and everyone was about to disperse, another surprise followed.

这回是宓本常，站到一张凳子上，举双手喊道∶『还要照照相、
This time Mi climbed onto a stool, raised both hands, and called, “Photographs!

照照相。
We must have photographs!”


这一下大家都了下来，听从他的指挥，
Everyone stopped and followed his instructions.

照了两张相，一张是古应春、七姑奶奶并坐，瑞香侍立在七姑奶奶身后；一张是全体合照，
Two photographs were taken: one of Gu and the Seventh Lady seated together, with Ruixiang standing behind her; another of the entire company.

螺蛳太太觉得自己无可位置，悄悄地溜掉了。
Feeling there was no appropriate place for her, Madam Luosi quietly slipped away.

照相很费事，
The photography took time.

第二张镁光不亮，重新来过；
The magnesium flash failed for the second picture, and the attempt had to be repeated.

到开席时，已经天黑了。
By the time the meal began, it was dark.

女客只有一桌，开在楼上，螺蛳太太首座；
The women had a single table upstairs, with Madam Luosi in the seat of honour.

七姑奶奶因为不耐久坐，行动也不便，特意命瑞香代作主人，
Unable to sit for long or move easily, the Seventh Lady specially instructed Ruixiang to act as hostess.

这自然是抬举她的意思。
This was plainly intended to honour her.

螺蛳太太也觉得很有面子，
Madam Luosi too felt that she had been shown great respect.

不由得又想到了宓本常，
Once more she thought of Mi.

都亏他安排，才能风风光光嫁了瑞香，了却一桩心事，成全了主婢之情。
His arrangements had enabled her to send Ruixiang into her new life with dignity, settle a longstanding concern, and fulfil the affection between mistress and maid.



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》卷名与第一章（一）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Volume Title and Chapter One, Part One
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


胡雪岩全传──烟消云散
Hu Xueyan: Vanishing into Thin Air


第一章 甲申之变｜CHAPTER ONE: THE CRISIS OF THE JIASHEN YEAR


上海的市面更坏了，是受了法国在越南的战事的影响。
Business in Shanghai had deteriorated further under the impact of France's war in Vietnam.

法国凯觎越南，由来已久。
France had long coveted Vietnam.

同治元年，法皇拿破仑第二，以海军大举侵入越南。
In the first year of Tongzhi, the French emperor Napoleon II launched a major naval invasion.

其时清廷正因洪杨之变自顾不暇，所以越南虽是清王朝的属国，却无力出兵保护，
The Qing court, fully occupied with the rebellion of Hong and Yang, had no strength to protect Vietnam, though it was a tributary state.

越南被迫订了城下之盟，割让庆和、嘉定、定祥三省。
Vietnam was forced to sign a humiliating treaty and cede the three provinces of Qinghe, Jiading, and Dingxiang.

嘉定省便是西贡，法国人在那里竭力经营，作为进一步侵略越南、进窥中国云南的根据地。
Jiading was Saigon, where the French worked energetically to establish a base for further aggression against Vietnam and eventual advances toward China's Yunnan Province.


同治十一年，越南内乱，
In the eleventh year of Tongzhi, internal disorder broke out in Vietnam.

头目叫做黄崇英，拥众数万，用黄旗，号称“黄旗军”。
