Its leader, Huang Chongying, commanded tens of thousands of men under yellow banners, hence the name Yellow Flag Army.

法国人勾通了黄崇英，规取“东京”，渡汉江。攻取广西镇南关外的谅山，
The French colluded with him to seize Tonkin, crossed the Han River, and captured Lang Son beyond Zhennan Pass on the Guangxi frontier.

广西巡抚是湘军宿将刘长佑，派兵助越平乱，同时邀请刘永福助剿——
Liu Changyou, Governor of Guangxi and a veteran commander of the Hunan Army, sent troops to help Vietnam suppress the disorder and also invited Liu Yongfu to join the campaign.

刘永福是广西上思州人，本是个私枭，
Liu Yongfu came from Shangsi in Guangxi and had originally been a smuggler.

咸丰年间，洪杨起事，刘永福却另有心胸，率领部下健儿三百人，出镇南关进入越南保胜。
During the Xianfeng reign, when Hong and Yang rose in rebellion, he followed an ambition of his own, leading three hundred sturdy followers through Zhennan Pass into Baosheng in Vietnam.

此地本为一个广东人何均昌所占领，为刘永福起而代之，
A Guangdong man named He Junchang had occupied the place, but Liu supplanted him.

所部用黑旗，号称“黑旗军”。
His men carried black banners and became known as the Black Flag Army.

既受刘长佑的邀请，复又受越南王的招抚，与广西官兵夹击法军，威震一时，
Having accepted Liu Changyou's invitation and the Vietnamese king's offer to bring him into the royal service, he joined the Guangxi troops in attacks on the French from two sides and won a formidable reputation.

但越南内部意见分歧，最后决定议和，
Opinion within Vietnam was divided, however, and peace negotiations were eventually chosen.

所派遣的大臣三名，为法军拘禁，被迫订了二十二条的《西贡条约》，
The three envoys sent to negotiate were detained by the French and compelled to sign the twenty-two-article Treaty of Saigon.

割地通商以外，承认受法国的保护。
Besides ceding territory and opening trade, Vietnam accepted French protection.

为了安抚刘永福，授职为三宣副提督。
To placate Liu Yongfu, he was appointed deputy commander of Sanxuan.

刘永福便在边境深山中，屯垦练兵，
He settled in the remote mountain frontier, farming and training his troops.

部下聚集至二十万之多，其中劲旅两万人，年龄在十七以上，二十四以下，
His followers grew to as many as two hundred thousand, including twenty thousand picked men between seventeen and twenty-four.

一个个面黑身高，孔武有力，越林超涧，轻捷如猿，士气极其高昂，
Tall, dark-faced, and powerfully built, they crossed forests and ravines as nimbly as apes, their morale exceptionally high.

因而为法军视如眼中钉，曾经悬重金买他的首级。
The French regarded him as a thorn in their side and offered a large reward for his head.


自从《西贡条约》订立以后，越南举国上下，无不既悔且愤，
After the Treaty of Saigon, regret and resentment spread through Vietnam from the highest ranks to the lowest.

越南王阮福时，决意重用黑旗兵。不道法国先下手为强，以重兵陷河内。
King Ruan Fushi resolved to make full use of the Black Flags, but France struck first, capturing Hanoi with a powerful force.

于是在顺化的阮福时遂予黑旗军驱逐法军的任务。
From Hue, the king ordered the Black Flags to drive the French out.

越南有失，广西、云南便受威胁，而且法国已正式向中国提出通商的要求。
If Vietnam were lost, Guangxi and Yunnan would be threatened; France had also formally demanded trading relations with China.

朝中议论，分为为战、主和两派，
At court, opinion divided between war and peace.

主战派以李鸿藻为首，
The war party was led by Li Hongzao.

除了支持云贵总督岑毓英支持刘永福以外，且特起曾国荃为两广总督，部署海防。
Besides supporting Cen Yuying, Governor-General of Yunnan and Guizhou, in his support for Liu Yongfu, it secured the special appointment of Zeng Guoquan as Governor-General of Liangguang to organize coastal defence.

此外左宗棠亦力主作战，清议更为激昂，
Zuo Zongtang also urged war, and opinion among the scholar-officials grew more impassioned.

但主和派的势力亦不小。
Yet the peace party was far from weak.

当然，李鸿章是主和的，驻法公使曾纪泽亦不主张决裂，
Li Hongzhang, naturally, favoured peace, and Zeng Jize, the minister to France, also opposed a rupture.

但对其中的利害得失，看得最清楚的是曾经使法的郭嵩焘。
The clearest understanding of the advantages and dangers, however, belonged to Guo Songtao, who had previously represented China in France.

这年光绪九年正月，李鸿章与法国公使宝海，本已达成“中国撤兵、法不侵越”的协议，
In the first lunar month of that year, the ninth of Guangxu, Li and the French minister Bourée had reached an agreement: China would withdraw its troops, and France would not invade Vietnam.

不意法国发生政潮，内阁改组，
But political upheaval in France brought a cabinet reshuffle.

新任外务部长拉克尔是个野心家，一面将宝海撤任、推翻成议，一面促使法国增兵越南。
The new foreign minister, Challemel-Lacour, was ambitious: he recalled Bourée, repudiated the agreement, and urged the dispatch of more French troops to Vietnam.

于是朝旨命丁忧守制之中的李鸿章迅往广东督办越南事宜，节制两广云南防军。
An imperial order then instructed Li, who was observing mourning, to proceed urgently to Guangdong, direct Vietnamese affairs, and command the defence forces of Liangguang and Yunnan.

就表面看，是派李鸿尊去主持战局，而实际上并非如此。此中消息为郭嵩焘所参透，
Outwardly, he appeared to be taking charge of a war, but Guo saw otherwise.

特意从他的家乡、湖南湘阴派专差送了一封长信给李鸿章，
From his home at Xiangyin in Hunan, he sent a special messenger with a long letter.

以为“处置西洋，始终无战法”，他说，
“In dealing with the West, war has never offered a solution,” he argued.

洋人意在通商，就跟他谈通商好了。
The foreigners wanted trade; China should discuss trade with them.

只要一答应谈判通商，越南的局势自然就会缓和。
Agreeing to negotiations would ease the situation in Vietnam.

如今派李鸿章出而督师，大张旗鼓，摆出一决雌雄的阵势，是逼迫法国作战。
Sending Li to command armies with a great show of force, as if determined to fight to the finish, would compel France to fight.

法国本无意于战，
France had not originally wished for war.

逼之应战，是兵法上的“不知彼”。
To force it into one was to fail, in military terms, to understand the enemy.


如果真的要战，又是“不知己”，
If China actually went to war, Guo continued, it would also be failing to understand itself.

他的话说得很沉痛：“用兵三十余年，
His words were bitter: “For more than thirty years we have waged war.

聚而为兵，散而为盗，蔓延天下，隐患方深。
Gathered together, men become soldiers; dispersed, they become bandits, spreading across the empire and leaving profound dangers in their wake.

重以水旱频仍，吏治调敝，盗贼满野，民不聊生，
Add repeated floods and droughts, a decaying administration, robbers everywhere, and a population unable to sustain life.

而于是时急开边畔，募兵以资防御，旷日逾时，而耗敝不可支矣。”
To provoke trouble on the frontier now and recruit still more troops for defence would, as the days and months passed, produce exhaustion beyond endurance.”

这是就军费者言，说中国不能战。
In terms of military expenditure alone, China could not fight.

就算战胜了，又怎么办？
Even if it won, what then?

战胜当然要裁兵，将刚招募的新兵遣散，结果是“游荡无所归”，聚集“饥困之民图逞”，
Victory would require demobilizing the newly recruited troops, leaving them “wandering with nowhere to return,” gathering “the hungry and destitute to pursue their designs.”

是自己制造乱源。
China would be creating the sources of its own disorder.

接下来，他转述京中的议论：“枢府以滇督援甲厉兵，而粤督处之泰然，数有訾议，
Guo next reported the discussion in Beijing: “The Grand Council has repeatedly criticized the contrast between the Governor-General of Yunnan's preparations for battle and the Governor-General of Guangdong's apparent unconcern.

是以属中堂以专征之任。”
That is why Your Excellency has been entrusted with supreme command.”

看起来是因为岑毓英想打，而曾国茎袖手旁观，前方将帅意见不一，需要一个位高权重的李鸿章去笼罩全面，主持一切。
It seemed that Cen Yuying wanted to fight while Zeng Guoquan stood aside, and that a man of Li's seniority and authority was needed to bring the commanders into agreement and direct the whole undertaking.

事实上呢“京师议论，所以属之中堂，仍以议和，非求战也”。
In reality, however, “the capital's purpose in entrusting this to Your Excellency is still to negotiate peace, not to seek war.”


李鸿章虽然在守制之中，但朝中情形，毫不隔膜，
Although in mourning, Li was fully informed about the court.

他在京师有好几个“坐探”，朝中一举一动，无不以最快的方法，报到合肥，
He maintained several resident informants in Beijing, who reported every development to Hefei by the fastest available means.

知道恭王子和战之际，游移不决，而主战最力的是“北派”领袖李鸿藻及一班清流，尤其是左副都御史张佩纶。
He knew that Prince Gong wavered between war and peace, while the strongest advocates of war were Li Hongzao, leader of the northern faction, and the men of the Pure Stream group, particularly Zhang Peilun, the Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.

因此，李鸿章纵有议和之意，却不敢公然表示，
Even if Li intended to negotiate peace, he dared not say so openly.

因为清议的力量很大，而且刘永福的黑旗军打得很好，更助长了主战派的声势，
Scholarly opinion carried great force, and the Black Flags' successes had further strengthened the war party.

此时主和是冒天下之大不韪，
To advocate peace now would defy the sentiment of the whole country.

所以迟迟其行，
He therefore delayed his departure.

到上海以后，与接替宝海的新任法国公使德理固，谈了几次，态度不软亦不硬，掌握了一个“拖”字诀。
On reaching Shanghai, he held several talks with Tricou, the new French minister who had replaced Bourée, adopting a manner neither yielding nor aggressive and relying above all on delay.

“拖”下去会有什么结果呢？
What would delay achieve?

这是李李鸿章自己都不知道的事，
Li himself did not know.

不过他在暗中大下功夫，想消除几个议和的障碍，
Behind the scenes, however, he worked hard to remove obstacles to negotiation.

第一个左副都御史张佩纶，他是清流的中坚，
The first was Zhang Peilun, a pillar of the Pure Stream group.

能把他疏通好，主战的高调不是唱得那么响，议和便较易措手。
If Zhang could be won over and the clamour for war quieted, peace would be easier to arrange.

另一个是驻法公使曾纪泽，
Another obstacle was Zeng Jize.

他不主张交涉决裂，但并不表示他主张对法让步，
His opposition to a breakdown in negotiations did not mean that he favoured concessions to France.

尤其是在从俄国回到巴黎以后，眼看法国的政策亦在摇摆之中，主战的只是少数。
After returning from Russia to Paris, he had observed that French policy was still unsettled and that only a minority wanted war.

因此特地密电李鸿章及总理衙门，建议军事援越，对德理固的交涉不妨强硬。
He sent secret telegrams to Li and the Zongli Yamen recommending military aid to Vietnam and a firm line with Tricou.

李鸿章对曾纪泽的意见，不置可否，但却致书郭嵩焘，暗示希望他能影响曾纪泽。
Li neither accepted nor rejected his advice, but wrote to Guo, hinting that he should influence Zeng.

郭嵩焘与曾纪泽的关系很深，而且驻法是前后任，
Guo's ties with Zeng were close; they had also served in succession as minister to France.

他的言论一定能为曾纪泽所尊重。
Zeng would certainly respect his views.


就在这“拖”的一两个月中，法国与越南的情势，都起了变化，
During these one or two months of delay, developments in both France and Vietnam changed the situation.

法国的政策已趋一致，
French policy grew more unified.

内阁总理茹斐理向国会声称，决心加强在越南的军事行动，
Prime Minister Jules Ferry told parliament that he was determined to intensify military operations in Vietnam.

同时派出九千人援越，另遣军舰十二艘东来，水师提督古拔代陆军提督布意为法军统帅。
Nine thousand reinforcements and another twelve warships were sent east, and Admiral Courbet replaced General Bouët as commander of the French forces.

越南则国王阮福时去世，由王弟阮福升继位，称号为“合和王”。
In Vietnam, King Ruan Fushi died and was succeeded by his younger brother Ruan Fusheng, under the title King Hehe, or “Harmonious Peace.”

由这称号，便知他是愿意屈服于法国的，
The title itself suggested a willingness to submit to France.

即位只有一个月，便与法国订立了二十七条的《顺化条约》，正式承认越南为法国的保护国，而又仍旧尊重中国为宗主国，
Only a month after his accession, he signed the twenty-seven-article Treaty of Hue, formally acknowledging Vietnam as a French protectorate while continuing to recognize China as its suzerain.

原来每年进贡，取道镇南关循陆路进京，今后改由海道入贡。
The annual tribute, previously carried overland through Zhennan Pass to Beijing, would henceforth travel by sea.

这一法越《顺化条约》，促成了法国政策的一致，同时也赋予了法军名正言顺得以驱逐黑旗军的地位。
This Franco-Vietnamese treaty helped unite French policy and gave the French troops a recognized basis for expelling the Black Flags.

因此，越南政府中的主战派大为不满。
The war party within the Vietnamese government was furious.

弑合和王而另立阮福吴，称号是“建福王”。
It killed King Hehe and enthroned Ruan Fuwu as King Jianfu.

尽管已到天津回任的李鸿章仍与法国公使在谈判越南的主权，而事实上中法双方剑拔弩张，开仗几不可免，
Though Li, now back at his post in Tianjin, continued negotiating with the French minister over Vietnamese sovereignty, the two countries were in fact poised for battle, and war seemed almost unavoidable.

尤其是特命彭玉鳞办理广东军务，消息一传，上海的人心越发恐慌。
News of Peng Yulin's special appointment to direct military affairs in Guangdong deepened the panic in Shanghai.

其时在九月中旬，正当螺蛳太太由上海回到杭州时。
It was now the middle of the ninth lunar month, just when Madam Luosi returned from Shanghai to Hangzhou.


就在她回到杭州的第二夭，江宁派了个专差来，
The day after her return, a special envoy arrived from Jiangning.

身穿红装，风尘满面，但头上一顶披满红丝穗的纬帽，高耸一粒红顶子，后面还拖一条花翎，
He wore red and was covered in the dust of travel, but on his hat, fringed all over with red silk, rose a red rank button, with a peacock feather trailing behind.

身后跟着四名从人，亦都有顶戴。
Four attendants followed, each with an official button of his own.

他们是由陆路来的，五匹高头大马，一路沙尘滚滚、辔铃当当、威风凛凛，路人侧目。
They had come by road on five tall horses, raising clouds of dust to the jingle of bridle bells, so imposing a procession that passers-by turned to stare.

一进了武林门，那专差将手一扬，都勒了马，
Just inside Wulin Gate, the envoy raised his hand and all five reined in.

其中一个戴暗蓝顶子的武官，走马趋前，听候吩咐。
One officer, wearing a dark blue button, rode forward for orders.

“问问路！”
“Ask the way.”

“喳！”
“Yes, sir!”

那人滚鞍下马，一手执缰，一手抓住一个中年汉子问道：
He slipped from the saddle and, holding the reins in one hand, caught a middle-aged man with the other.

“来、来，老兄，打听一个地名，无宝街在哪里？
“Here, my friend, a place I want to ask about: where's Wubao Street?”

““啊！
“What?

你说啥？”
What did you say?”

原来那武官是曾国藩的小同乡，
The officer came from Zeng Guofan's own home district.

湖南话中湘乡话最难懂，加以武夫性急，说得很快，便越发不知他说些什么了。
Of all Hunan speech, the Xiangxiang dialect was the hardest to understand; delivered rapidly by an impatient soldier, it became even more incomprehensible.

还好，那武官倒有自知之明，
Fortunately, he recognized the problem.

一字一句地答道：“元宝街。”说着还双手上捧，作手势示意元宝。
“Yuan-bao Street,” he repeated, syllable by syllable, cupping both hands to suggest a silver ingot.

“喔、喔、喔，你老人家是说元宝街！”
“Ah, Yuanbao Street! That's what you mean, sir.”

那人姓卜，是钱塘县“礼房”的书办，
The man, surnamed Bu, was a clerk in the rites section of the Qiantang county office.

不作回答，却反问：“请问，你们是从哪里来的？
Instead of answering, he asked, “May I ask where you have come from?

江宁？”
Jiangning?”

“不错。”
“Yes.”

“这样说，到元宝街是去看胡大先生？”
“Then you are going to Yuanbao Street to see Mr Hu?”

“胡大先生？”
“Mr Hu?”

那人一愣，旋即想到：
The officer hesitated, then understood.

“不错，不错，
“Yes, yes.

胡大先生就是胡雪岩胡大人。”
Mr Hu is His Honour Hu Xueyan.”


卜书办点头，趋前一步，手指着低声问道：
Clerk Bu nodded, stepped closer, and pointed discreetly.

“马上那位红顶子的人，是什么人？”
“Who is the gentleman on horseback with the red button?”

那武官有些不耐烦了，
The officer was growing impatient.

天下人走天下路，问路应是常事，
The roads were open to everyone, and asking directions was an ordinary matter.

知道而热心的，详细指点，知道而懒得回答的，说一声“不清楚”，
Someone who knew the way and felt helpful could explain it; someone who knew but could not be bothered could say he wasn't sure.

真的不知道而又热心的，会表示歉意，请对方另行打听，不知道而又懒得回答的，只字不答，掉臂而去。
A helpful person who did not know could apologize and suggest asking someone else, while an unhelpful one could simply turn and walk away.

象这样问路而反为别人所问，类似盘查，却还是第一次遇见。
But to ask directions and be questioned in return, almost as though under investigation, was a new experience.

卜书办看那武官的脸色，急忙提出解释：
Seeing his expression, Bu hastened to explain.

“你老人家不要嫌我罗嗦，
“Please don't think me tiresome, sir.

实在是马上那位大人一品武官，
The gentleman on that horse is a first-rank military officer.

我不敢怠慢，
I dare not neglect him.

晓得了身分，好禀报本县大老爷，有啥差遣，不会误事。”
If I know who he is, I can report to our magistrate, and any service he requires can be attended to promptly.”


原来是这样一番好意！
So that was his kindly intention!

那武官倒觉得过意不去，但却不知如何回答——
The officer felt embarrassed, but did not know how to answer.

那专差本名高老三，
The envoy had originally been called Gao Laosan, Third Son Gao.

投效湘军时，招募委员替他改名“乐山”来谐音，“仁者乐山”而又行三，因而又送他一个别号叫“仁叔”。
When he joined the Hunan Army, the recruiting official had given him the more elegant name Leshan, playing on the sound of his old name and the saying that the benevolent delight in mountains. Because he was third-born, he also received the courtesy name Renshu.

这高乐山原隶刘松山帐下，
Gao had originally served under Liu Songshan.

左宗棠西征，曾国藩特拨刘松山一营隶属于左，时人称为“赠嫁”。
When Zuo began his western campaign, Zeng assigned Liu and his battalion to him, an arrangement people jokingly called a dowry.

刘松山在西征时，战功彪炳，左宗棠大为得力。
Liu's brilliant service proved invaluable.

左曾不和，在才气纵横的左宗棠眼中，曾国藩无一事可使他佩服，
Zuo and Zeng did not get on; in the gifted Zuo's eyes, Zeng had otherwise done nothing worthy of admiration.

唯独对“赠嫁”刘松山，心悦诚服，感激不已。因为如此，左宗棠对刘松山，亦总是另眼看待。
For this gift of Liu, however, he was sincerely grateful, and he always treated Liu with special regard.

这高乐山原是刘松山的马弁，
Gao had been Liu's mounted orderly.

为人诚朴，有一次左宗棠去视察，宿于刘营，刘松山派高乐山去伺候，
Honest and sincere, he was once assigned to attend Zuo during an inspection visit.

彻夜巡更，至晓不眠，为左宗棠所赏识，跟刘松山要了去，置诸左右，
He patrolled through the night without sleeping, so impressing Zuo that he asked Liu to transfer him to his own staff.

每有“保案”，在“密保”中总有高乐山的名字，
Whenever recommendations for promotion were submitted, Gao's name appeared among the confidential ones.

现在的职衔是“记名总兵加提督衔”，在“绿营”中已是“官居极品”，
He was now listed for appointment as a brigade commander, with the honorary rank of provincial military commander: the summit of advancement in the Green Standard Army.

但实际的职司，仍是所谓“材官”，仅奔走之役，在左宗棠的部属中，他的身份犹如宫中的“御前侍卫”。
In practice, he remained a military attendant, carrying out errands, with a position among Zuo's staff rather like that of a bodyguard attending the emperor.

但一品武官不过是个“高等马弁”，这话说出去，贬损了高乐山的红顶子，
To say that this first-rank officer was merely a superior sort of mounted orderly would diminish his red button.

所以那蓝顶子的武官含含糊糊地答说：“是左大人特为派来看胡大先生的。”
His blue-buttoned subordinate therefore answered vaguely, “Lord Zuo has sent him specially to see Mr Hu.”


“我就猜到，”
“I guessed as much!”

卜书办又拍手、又翘拇指，
Bu clapped his hands and raised his thumb.

“一定是左大人派来的。
“He must have been sent by Lord Zuo.

好、好、好，
Excellent!

元宝街远得很，一南一北，
Yuanbao Street is a long way off, at the other end of the city.

等我来领路。
I'll lead you there.

你请等一等，等我去租匹马来。”
Just wait while I hire a horse.”

武林门是杭州往北进出的要道，运河起点的拱宸桥就在武林门外，
Wulin Gate was Hangzhou's main northern entrance, and Gongchen Bridge, at the beginning of the canal, stood outside it.

所以城门口有车有轿有骡马，雇用租赁，均无不可。
Carriages, sedan chairs, mules, and horses were all available for hire at the gate.

卜书办租赁了一匹“菊花青”，洋洋得意地在前领路。
Bu rented a dapple-grey and proudly led the way.

那匹“菊花青”是旗营中淘汰下来的老马，驯顺倒很驯顺，但脚程极慢——
It was an old horse discarded by the Banner garrison: docile enough, but painfully slow. Horses had understanding too.

马通灵性，为人雇乘太久，出发时知道负重任远，一步懒似一步，因为走得越快越吃亏，
Hired out for so long, this one knew that setting out meant a burden and a distant destination; every step was lazier than the last, since the faster it walked, the worse its bargain.

及至回程，纵不说如渴骥奔泉，但远非去路可比，昂首扬鬃，急于回槽。
On the return journey, it might not quite rush like a thirsty steed toward a spring, but its pace was transformed, its head and mane high as it hurried back to its manger.

那匹菊花青，正是这样一个马中的“老油条”。
It was an old hand among horses.

当书办的，十之八九是“老油条”，
Nine county clerks out of ten were old hands too.

这一下“老油条”遇着“老油条”，彼此得其所哉。
Here, one old hand had met another, and they suited each other perfectly.

卜书办款款徐行，后随五名武官，亦步亦趋，倒象是他的跟马。
Bu proceeded at a leisurely pace, with five officers following step for step as though they were his mounted attendants.

杭州的文武官员，品级最高的是“将军”，其次是巡抚，
Hangzhou's highest-ranking official was the garrison general, followed by the governor.

本身虽都是红顶子，但出行的随从，从无戴红顶子的。
Though both wore red buttons, none of their attendants did.

因此，卜书办满脸飞金，得意之状，难描难画，尤其是一路上遇着熟人，
Bu glowed with pride, especially when he met acquaintances.

在马上一会儿抱拳扬臂，一会儿弯腰点头，同时一定要高声加一句，“我带他们去看胡大先生。”
He would raise clasped hands or bend forward in greeting, always adding loudly, “I'm taking them to see Mr Hu!”

有几次得意忘形，几乎掉下马来，急急扳住马鞍上的“判官头”，才能转危为安。
Several times he nearly fell off in his excitement, saving himself only by clutching the saddle pommel.

这样丑态百出，惹得路人笑逐颜开，而高乐山的脸色却越来越难看了。
His antics made the passers-by smile, while Gao's expression grew darker and darker.


快到元宝街时，卜书办在转角之时，向前扬一扬手，示意暂停，自己却双腿夹一夹马腹，催快往前，直到胡府大门前勒住了马。
Near Yuanbao Street, Bu raised a hand at a corner to signal a halt, then squeezed his horse forward and rode ahead to the Hu residence.

“老卜，”胡家门前的下人中，有一个认得他，“你来作啥？”
“Old Bu, what brings you here?” asked a servant who recognized him.

“我来报信，
“I've brought news.

两江总督左大人，派了红顶子的武官来看胡大先生，
Lord Zuo, Governor-General of Liangjiang, has sent a red-buttoned officer to see Mr Hu.

一进城门，是我领路来的。”
I met him at the city gate and guided him here.”

“在哪里？”
“Where is he?”

“在后面。”
“Just behind.”

那人抬眼一看，
The servant looked up.

果然有五匹马在后面，红蓝顶子在明亮的秋阳中看得很清楚。
Sure enough, five horses were approaching, the red and blue buttons clear in the bright autumn sunlight.

这一来，胡家门前的十几个人都紧张了。
All dozen or so men at the entrance grew nervous.

原来左宗棠派红顶子的戈什哈传令是常事，但当初是陕甘总督，公私事务派专差只到上海转运局。
Zuo often sent red-buttoned guards with orders, but when he had been Governor-General of Shaanxi and Gansu, his messengers on public or private business had gone only to the transshipment bureau in Shanghai.

直接派到胡家却是头一回，
This was the first to come directly to the Hu house.

少见自然多怪，顿时便有机灵的，不看热闹，抢先报到上房。
The unfamiliar caused alarm, and the quick-witted servants hurried to report instead of lingering to watch.


螺蛳太太一听吓一跳。
Madam Luosi was startled.

原来胡家为了红顶子，花了好大的气力，
The Hu family had gone to great lengths for a red button.

胡雪岩本身是道员加按察使衔，三品顶戴蓝顶子，
Hu himself held circuit-intendant rank with the honorary title of provincial judicial commissioner, entitling him to a third-rank blue button.

倘或胡雪岩肯做官，放一任实缺的道员，左宗棠保他加布政使的衔，是一定办得到的事，
Had he accepted an actual circuit post, Zuo could certainly have obtained the additional title of provincial treasurer for him.

无奈胡雪岩只能做一个“官商”，
But Hu could only be an official merchant.

如果真的“商而优则官，”必须“弃商从官”，
To turn business success into an official career, he would have had to give up trade.

不但“做此官，行此礼，胡，雪岩受不了那种拘束，而且也决不会是一个出色的官。
Every office imposed its own rules of conduct; he could not bear such restrictions, nor would he have made an outstanding official.

这一点不但他本人有自知之明，凡是爱护他的，亦莫不认为胡雪岩要是真的去做官，便是舍长就短，最为不智。
He knew this himself, and all who cared for him agreed that taking office would foolishly abandon his strengths for his weaknesses.

因为如此，要摆官派，只有拿钱来做官，
If he wanted official splendour, therefore, he had to purchase it.

本身捐官有限制，到三品便是“官居极品”，但父母的荣衔，却是花钱可以买体面的，
Purchased rank for himself stopped at the third grade, but money could buy honorary distinctions for his parents.

十余年来每逢水旱灾荒，胡雪岩总是用胡老太大的名义，捐银、捐米、捐棉衣、捐药材，好不容易才得了个“一品夫人”的封典，
For more than ten years, whenever flood, drought, or famine struck, he had donated silver, rice, padded clothing, and medicines in his mother's name, finally obtaining for her the title of a first-rank lady.

胡雪岩“子以母贵”也能戴红顶子了。
By sharing in his mother's distinction, he too could wear a red button.

红顶子是如此珍贵，在螺蛳太太的记忆中，红顶子的文武大员登门拜访，没有几次，每一次都是事先得到信息，如何迎接、如何款待、如何打发从人，都要好几天筹划，临时郑重将事。
In Madam Luosi's memory, visits from red-buttoned civil or military dignitaries had been rare, always announced in advance and requiring days of careful planning for the reception, hospitality, and treatment of their attendants.

象这样突然来了个红顶子的武官，自然要吓一跳，紧张得有些不知所措了。
Such an officer's sudden arrival naturally left her alarmed and at a loss.


但胡雪岩却是司空见惯的，高乐山又是熟人，
Hu was accustomed to such visitors, however, and Gao was an old acquaintance.

不妨从容以礼款接。
He could receive him calmly and courteously.

当下先交代了螺蛳太太一番，换了官服到花厅相见。
After giving Madam Luosi a few instructions, he changed into official dress and met Gao in the garden drawing room.

一个称“雪翁”，一个称“高军门”，平礼相见，
They greeted each other as equals, one addressing the other as Mr Xueyan, the other replying with General Gao.

又到走廊上向高乐山的从人，请教了姓乐，寒暄了一阵，另外派人接待，
Hu then went into the corridor, asked Gao's attendants their names, exchanged a few courtesies, and assigned someone to look after them.

然后说道：“请换便衣吧！”
“Please change into something informal,” he said.

话刚说完，已有一名听差，捧着衣包，进屋伺候——
At once, a servant entered carrying a bundle of clothes to help Gao dress.

官场酬酢，公服相见是礼，便衣欢叙是情，
In official society, meeting in ceremonial robes fulfilled the requirements of courtesy, while conversation in informal clothes expressed friendship.

但总是客人忖度与主人的交情，预料有此需要，自己命跟班随带衣包，
Normally, though, a guest judged the closeness of the relationship for himself and had his attendant bring a change of clothes.

象这样由主人供应便衣的情形，高乐山不但是第一次经验，而且也是闻所未闻。
Gao had never experienced, or even heard of, a host supplying them.

不过，想到胡雪岩以豪阔出名，那么类此举动，自亦无足为奇。
Still, Hu was famous for his lavishness, so perhaps it was not surprising.

当下说道：“雪翁亦请进去换衣服吧！”
“Please go and change yourself too, Mr Xueyan.”

“是，是，
“Yes, yes.

换了衣服细谈。”
Then we can talk at leisure.”

等胡雪岩换了衣服出来，只见高乐山已穿上簇新的一身铁灰的结夹抱、上套珊瑚扣的贡缎马褂，头上一顶红结子的青缎小帽，
When Hu returned, Gao was wearing a brand-new iron-grey lined silk robe, with a tribute-satin riding jacket fastened by coral buttons and a dark satin cap topped with a red knot.

而且刚洗了脸，显得容光焕发，神采奕奕。
He had also washed his face and looked refreshed and vigorous.

“衣服倒还合身？”
“Do the clothes fit reasonably well?”

“多谢，多谢。
“Thank you, thank you!

比我自己叫裁缝来现制还要好，
Better than anything I could have had a tailor make for me.

我也不客气了，雪翁，
I won't stand on ceremony.

多谢，多谢！”
Many thanks!”

说着高乐山又连连拱手。
Gao repeatedly clasped his hands in gratitude.


“左大人精神还好吧？”
“Is Lord Zuo still in good spirits?”

听这一说，高乐山的笑容慢慢收敛，
Gao's smile slowly faded.

“差得多了。”
“He's much worse.

他说：“眼力大不如前，
His eyesight has deteriorated badly.

毛病不轻。”
It's no small trouble.”

“请医生看了没有呢？”
“Has a doctor seen him?”

“请了。”高乐山答说：“看也白看！
“Yes, but to no purpose.

医生要他不看公事，不看书，闭上眼睛静养。
The doctor wants him to stop reading official papers and books, close his eyes, and rest.

雪翁，你想他老人家办得到吗？”
Can you imagine him doing that?”

“那么，到底是什么病呢？”
“What exactly is the disease?”

“医生也说不上来。
“The doctor can't say.

左眼上了翳，右面的一只迎风流泪。”
A film has formed over his left eye, and his right waters whenever the wind touches it.”

“会不会失明？”
“Could he go blind?”

“难说。”
“It's hard to say.”

“我荐一个医生。”胡雪岩说：“跟了高军门一起去。”
“I'll recommend a doctor,” Hu said, “and have him go back with you.”

“是。”
“Yes.”

高乐山这时才将左宗棠的信拿了出来。
Only now did Gao produce Zuo's letter.

信上很简单，
It was brief.

只说越南军情紧急，奉旨南北洋的防务均须上紧筹划，并须派兵援越，
The military situation in Vietnam was urgent; by imperial order, preparations for both the northern and southern maritime defences had to be hastened, and troops were to be sent to assist Vietnam.

因而请胡雪岩抽工夫到江宁一晤，
Zuo therefore asked Hu to find time for a meeting in Jiangning.

至于其他细节，可以面问高乐山。
Any further details could be obtained from Gao.


胡雪岩心想，这少不得又是筹械筹饷，
Hu supposed that, as usual, it would mean finding arms and military funds.

不在其位，不谋其政，
A man should not concern himself with the duties of an office he did not hold.

自己并未受两江总督衙门的任何委任，倘需效劳，纯粹是私人关系，
He had received no appointment from the Governor-General of Liangjiang's administration; any service he rendered would be purely a matter of personal friendship.

这一层不妨先向高乐山说明白。
He might as well make that clear to Gao first.

“高军门晓得的，左大人说啥就是啥，我只有‘遵办’二字。
“You know that whatever Lord Zuo says, I can only obey.

不过，江宁不是陕甘，
But Jiangning is not Shaanxi and Gansu.

恐怕有吃力不讨好的地方。”
I fear I may find myself working hard and getting no thanks.”

“是的。”
“Yes.

高乐山答道：“左大人亦说了，江宁有江宁的人，胡某替我办事，完全是交情，
Lord Zuo said that Jiangning has its own people, and that anything Mr Hu does for him is done entirely out of friendship.

论到公事，转运局是西征的转运局，
As far as official business is concerned, your transshipment bureau serves the western expedition.

我只有跟他商量，不能下札子。
He can only consult you; he cannot issue a written order.

这就是要请雪翁当面去谈的缘故。”
That is why he wants you to come and discuss matters in person.”

“喔，不晓得要谈点啥？”胡雪岩问：
“And what does he want to discuss?

“是钱，是械？”
Money or weapons?”

“是枪械。”
“Weapons.”

“嗯，嗯。”
“Ah.”

胡雪岩稍稍放了些心，
Hu felt a little easier.

“不谈钱，事情总还好办。”
“As long as it isn't money, things are more manageable.”

“雪翁预备哪天动身？”
“When do you intend to leave?”

“这还要跟内人商量起来看。”胡雪岩率直回答，他所说的“内人”，自然是指螺蛳太太，
“I must discuss that with my wife,” Hu replied frankly, meaning, of course, Madam Luosi.

接下来又问：“左大人预备派哪位到广西？”
“Who is Lord Zuo sending to Guangxi?”

“是王大人。”
“Mr Wang.”

“王大人？”
“Mr Wang?”

胡雪岩一时想不起来，左宗棠手下有哪个姓王的大将。
Hu could not immediately recall a senior commander of that surname on Zuo's staff.

“是，
“Yes.

王阆帅。”
Commander Wang Langqing.”

“幄，是他。”
“Oh, him.”


原来高乐山指的是王德榜，他踉高乐山一样，有个很雅致的别号叫阆青，
Gao meant Wang Debang, who, like Gao himself, possessed an elegant courtesy name: Langqing.

是湖南永州府江华县人，这个偏僻小县，从古以来也没有出过什么出色的人物，
He came from Jianghua County in Yongzhou Prefecture, Hunan, a remote little county that had never produced any particularly outstanding figure.

但王德傍在湘军中却是别具一格，颇有可称的宿将。
Within the Hunan Army, however, Wang was a distinctive and respected veteran.

此人在咸丰初年，毁家练乡团，保卫家乡颇有劳绩，
Early in the Xianfeng reign, he had devoted his family fortune to organizing a local militia and rendered valuable service in defending his home district.

后来援江西有功，早在威咸七年，便叙文职“州同”，
Later, he distinguished himself in Jiangxi and, as early as the seventh year of Xianfeng, received the civil rank of assistant department magistrate.

改隶左宗棠部下后，数建奇功，是有名的悍将，赐号“锐勇巴图鲁”，赏穿黄马褂，
After joining Zuo, he repeatedly won remarkable victories and became a famous fighting commander, receiving the title “Bold and Brave Baturu” and permission to wear the yellow riding jacket.

同治四年积功升至藩司，
In the fourth year of Tongzhi, his accumulated service brought him the rank of provincial treasurer.

从左宗棠征新疆，功劳不在刘松山叔侄之下，但始终不得意，
He followed Zuo into Xinjiang and performed services no less distinguished than those of Liu Songshan and his nephew, yet advancement never satisfied him.

藩司虚衔领了六、八年，始终不能补实缺。
He held the honorary treasurer's rank for six or eight years without obtaining an actual post.

原来王德榜是个老粗，
Wang was an uncouth soldier.

当他升藩司奉召入觐时，语言粗鄙，加以满口乡音，两宫太后根本不知道他说些什么，
When summoned to court after his promotion, he spoke so crudely and with so strong a local accent that the two empress dowagers could not understand him.

因而名为藩司，当的却是总兵的职司。
Thus, while nominally a provincial treasurer, he performed the duties of a brigade commander.

光绪元年丁忧回籍，六年再赴新疆，
In the first year of Guangxu, he returned home for mourning; in the sixth, he went back to Xinjiang.

不久左宗棠晋京人军机，以大学士管兵部，
Soon afterwards, Zuo entered the Grand Council in Beijing and, as a grand secretary, took charge of the Ministry of War.

受醇王之托，整顿旗营，特地保荐王德榜教练火器、健锐两营，
At Prince Chun's request, he reorganized the Banner troops and specially recommended Wang to train the Firearms and Stalwart camps.

他的部下兴修畿输水利，挑泥浚河，做的是苦工而毫无怨言，因而亦颇得醇王赏识。
Wang's men also worked on waterways near the capital, carrying earth and dredging rivers without complaint, which earned Prince Chun's approval.

左宗棠当然深知他的长处，但他的短处实在也不少，只能为将，不能做官。
Zuo understood Wang's strengths well, but his weaknesses were considerable: he could command soldiers, not administer a civil office.

这回彭玉麟向左宗棠求援，他想起王德榜，认为可以尽其所长，
When Peng Yulin asked for assistance, Zuo thought of him as the right man for the task.

因而奏请赴援两广，归彭玉麟节制，并答应接济军械，
He requested imperial approval to send Wang to Liangguang under Peng's command and promised to supply weapons.

找胡雪岩去，便是商量这件事。
This was what he wished to discuss with Hu.


了解了经过情形，胡雪岩心里有数了，
Now that Hu understood the circumstances, he knew where matters stood.

“高军门，”他说，“你在这里玩两天，
“Stay here for a couple of days, General Gao.

我跟内人商量好了，或许可以一起走。”
Once I've discussed it with my wife, perhaps we can leave together.”

“如果雪翁一起走，我当然要等，
“If you are coming with me, I will certainly wait.

不然，我就先回去复命了。
Otherwise, I should return first to report.

左大人的性子，你知道的。”
You know Lord Zuo's temperament.”

“你想先回去复命亦好。
“Then you may as well go back first.

哪天动身。”
When would you leave?”

“明天。”
“Tomorrow.”

当下以盛筵款待，当然不用胡雪岩亲自相陪，
A sumptuous banquet was provided, though Hu did not need to attend personally.

宴罢连从人送到客房歇宿，招呼得非常周到。
Afterwards, Gao and his men were shown to guest rooms and looked after with the greatest care.

第二天要动身了，自然先要请胡雪岩见一面，问问有什么话交代。
Before leaving the next day, Gao naturally asked to see Hu for any final instructions.


传话进去，所得到的答复是，胡雪岩中午请他吃饭，有带给左宗棠的书信面交。
The answer was that Hu would invite him to lunch and give him a letter for Zuo in person.

到了午间，请到花园里，又是一桌盛筵，连他的从人一起都请，
At noon, they were taken into the garden for another lavish meal, this time including Gao's attendants.

厅上已摆好五份礼物，
Five sets of gifts had been laid out in the hall.

一身袍褂，两匹机纺，一大盒胡庆余堂所产的家用良药，另外是五十两银子一个的“官宝”两个。
Each contained a robe and riding jacket, two bolts of machine-woven cloth, a large box of household medicines made at Hu Qingyu Hall, and two official silver ingots of fifty taels each.

额外送高乐山的一个打簧金表，一支牙柄的转轮手枪。
Gao received, in addition, a gold repeater watch and an ivory-handled revolver.

“本来想备船送你们回去，只怕脚程太慢，
“I meant to send you home by boat, but I fear it would be too slow.

说不得只好辛苦各位老哥，仍旧骑马回去了。”
I'm afraid I must ask you gentlemen to endure another journey on horseback.”

“雪翁这样犒赏，实在太过意不去了。”高乐山连连搓手，真有却之不恭，受之有愧之概。
Gao rubbed his hands repeatedly, feeling that refusal would be discourteous and acceptance undeserved. “Such generous rewards are really too much.”

“小意思、小意思！
“A trifle, a trifle!

请宽饮一杯。”
Do have another cup.”

高乐山不肯多喝，
Gao would not drink much.

他那四个部下，从未经过这种场面，更觉局促不安，
His four subordinates, unused to such hospitality, felt still more awkward.

每人闷倒头扒了三碗饭，站起身来向胡雪岩打千道谢兼辞行。
Each kept his head down and ate three bowls of rice, then rose, made the formal kneeling salutation to Hu, and thanked him as they took their leave.

由于红顶子的关系，胡雪岩自然开中门送客，
In honour of the red button, Hu naturally had the central gate opened to see them off.

大门照墙下一并排五匹马，仍是原来的坐骑，不过鞍辔全新，连马鞭子都是新的。
Five horses stood abreast by the screen wall outside, the same mounts as before but with new saddles, bridles, and even whips.

胡雪岩自己有一副“导子”，两匹跟马将高乐山一行，送出武林门外，
Hu had his own ceremonial escort; two mounted attendants accompanied Gao's party out through Wulin Gate.

一路上惹得路人指指点点，都知道是“胡大先生家的客人”。
People pointed along the way, knowing them to be Mr Hu's guests.


高乐山走后，胡雪岩与螺蛳太太商量行止。
After Gao had left, Hu discussed his movements with Madam Luosi.

“第二批洋款也到期了，
“The second instalment of the foreign loan is also due.

我想先到上海料理好了，再到江宁。”
I thought I would go to Shanghai and settle that first, then proceed to Jiangning.

胡雪岩说，“好在王阆青也不过刚从京里动身，我晚一点到江宁也不至于误事。”
Wang Langqing has only just left Beijing, so a slightly later arrival at Jiangning shouldn't delay anything.”

“不好，
“No.

既然左大人特为派差官来请，你就应该先到江宁，才是敬重的道理。
Since Lord Zuo has sent an officer specially to invite you, respect requires that you go to Jiangning first.

至于上海这方面，有宓本常在那里，
Mi Benchang is in Shanghai.

要付的洋款，叫他先到上海道那里去催一催，
Let him press the circuit intendant for the foreign-loan payment in advance.

等你一到上海，款子齐了，当面交清，
By the time you arrive, the funds will be ready and you can make the payment in person.

岂不是顺理成章的事？”
Isn't that the natural order?”

“上海的市面，我也不大放心，
“I'm uneasy about the Shanghai market too.

想先去看看。”
I'd like to have a look first.”

“那更用不着了，
“There is even less need for that.

宓本常本事很大，一定调度得好好的。”螺蛳太太说：
Mi Benchang is extremely capable; he is certain to have everything properly arranged.

“你听我的话没有错，
Take my advice.

一定要先到江宁，后到上海，回来办喜事，
Go to Jiangning first, then Shanghai, and come home for the wedding.

日子算起来正好，
The timing will be just right.

如果先到上海，后到江宁，万一左大人有差使交派，误了喜期，就不好了。”
If you go to Shanghai first and then Jiangning, Lord Zuo may give you some further task, and it would be a pity to miss the wedding date.”


在天津的李鸿章，经过深思熟虑，认为张佩纶才高志大，资格又好，决心要收他做个帮手。
In Tianjin, after careful consideration, Li Hongzhang decided that Zhang Peilun, with his talent, ambition, and excellent qualifications, should be brought into his service.

张佩纶的父亲在李鸿章的家乡安徽做过官，叙起来也算世交，
Zhang's father had held office in Li's home province of Anhui, giving them something of an inherited family connection.

便遣人专程将他接了来，在北洋衙门长谈了几次。
Li sent a special invitation and held several long conversations with him at the northern maritime administration.

原来李鸿章也有一番抱负，
Li had an ambition of his own.

跟醇王秘密计议过，准备创办新式海军。
In secret consultation with Prince Chun, he had been planning a modern navy.

他自己一手创立了淮军，深知陆军是无法整顿的了，
Having founded the Anhui Army himself, he knew that the army could no longer be put into proper order.

外国的陆军，小兵亦读过书，看重懂书面的命令，中国的陆军，连营官都是目不识丁，
In foreign armies, even ordinary soldiers had schooling and could read written orders; in China's army, even battalion commanders were illiterate.

怎么比得过人家？
How could they compete?

再说，陆军练好了，亦必须等到外敌踏上中华国上，才能发生保国卫民的作用，
Besides, however well the army was trained, it could defend the country only after an enemy had set foot on Chinese soil.

不如海军得以拒敌于境外。
A navy could keep the enemy beyond the frontier.

因此，李鸿章已悄悄着手修建旅顺港，在北洋办海军学堂。
Li had therefore quietly begun developing the port of Lushun and establishing a naval school for the northern fleet.

这番雄图壮志，非十年不足以见功，而且得在平定的局势之下，方能按部就班，寸寸积功。
This great undertaking would require at least ten years and a peaceful situation in which to advance steadily, step by step.

这就是李鸿章力主对法妥协的原因，忍一时之忿，图百年之计。
That was why he insisted on compromise with France: endure a moment's anger to secure the country's future for a century.

张佩纶觉得谋国远谟，正应如此，因而也作了不少献议，
Zhang agreed that this was the proper way to plan for the nation and offered many suggestions.

彼此谈得非常投机。
They found themselves in complete accord.

“老夫耄矣！
“I am an old man,” Li said.

足下才气纵横，前程远大，
“You have extraordinary talent and a great future.

将来此席非老弟莫属。”
In time, this seat must surely be yours.”

这已隐然有传授衣钵之意。
There was already a hint of handing on his mantle.

张佩纶想到曾国藩说过，“办大事以找替手为第一，”
Zhang recalled Zeng Guofan's dictum that the first task in great undertakings was to find a successor.

他当年遣散湘军，扶植淮军，便是找到了李鸿章作替手。
Zeng had disbanded the Hunan Army and fostered the Anhui Army because he had found Li.

想来，李鸿章以湘乡“门生长”自居，顾念遗训，找到他来作替手。
Li, who regarded himself as Zeng's foremost disciple, must now be following that teaching by choosing Zhang.

这番盛意，关乎国家气运，当仁不让，倒不可辜负。
This honour concerned the nation's destiny; Zhang should accept the responsibility and not disappoint him.


由于有了这样的默契，张佩纶在暗中亦已转为主和派。
With this unspoken understanding, Zhang privately joined the peace party.

同时有人为李鸿章设计，用借刀杀人的手法，拆清流的台——将清流中响当当的人物，调出京去，赋以军务重任，
Meanwhile, someone proposed to Li a way of using another's blade to strike at the Pure Stream group: send its most prominent men out of Beijing and give them important military responsibilities.

书生都是纸上谈兵，一亲营伍，每每偾事，
Scholars who had only discussed war on paper would often fail when confronted with real troops.

便可借此收拾清流，而平时好发议论的人，见此光景，必生戒心，
Their failures could then be used to break the group's power, while other habitual critics would learn caution.

亦是箝制舆论的妙计。
It was an excellent means of silencing opinion.

李鸿章认为是借刀杀人，还是登坛拜将，视人而异，
Li thought that whether such an appointment amounted to destroying a man or raising him to high command depended on the man.

象张佩纶便属于后者，
Zhang belonged to the second category.

决定设法保他督办左宗棠所创办、沈葆祯所扩大的福建船政局，作为他将来帮办北洋海军的张本。
Li decided to secure his appointment to direct the Fujian Navy Yard, founded by Zuo and expanded by Shen Baozhen, as preparation for his future service with the northern navy.

此外就不妨借刀杀人了。
The others could be dealt with by the borrowed blade.


但这是需要逐步布置，徐图实现的事，
That plan would require gradual preparation and patient execution.

而眼前除了由张佩纶去压低主战的高调以外，最要紧的是，要让主战的实力派，知难而退，
For the moment, besides having Zhang quiet the clamour for war, the most urgent task was to make the advocates with real military power retreat before the difficulties.

这实力派中，第一个便是左宗棠，
Foremost among them was Zuo.

得想法子多方掣肘，叫他支援彭玉麟的计划，步步荆棘，怎么样也走不通，
He must be obstructed from every direction until his plan to support Peng Yulin met barriers at every step and could not proceed.

这就是李鸿章特召邵友濂北上，要商量的事。
This was why Li specially summoned Shao Youlian north for consultation.

“左湘阴无非靠胡雪岩替他出力。
“Zuo of Xiangyin relies entirely on Hu Xueyan's efforts,” Shao said.

上次赈灾派各省协济，两江派二十万银子，
“When the provinces were last asked to contribute to disaster relief, Liangjiang was assigned two hundred thousand taels.

江宁藩库，一空如洗，
The Jiangning treasury was empty.

他到江海关来惜，我说要跟赫德商量。
Zuo asked to borrow from the Jianghaiguan Customs, and I said I would have to consult Hart.

湘阴知难而退，结果是向胡雪岩借了二十万银子。
He retreated before the difficulty and ended by borrowing the money from Hu.

湘阴如果没有胡雪岩，可说一筹莫展。”
Without Hu, he would be helpless.”

“胡雪岩这个人，确是很讨厌。”李鸿章说：
“Hu is a thoroughly troublesome man,” Li said.

“洋人还是很相信他，以致于我这里好些跟洋人的交涉，亦受他的影响。”
“The foreigners still trust him, and that affects many of my dealings with them.”

“既然如此，有一个办法，叫洋人不再相信他。”邵友濂说：
“Then there is a way to make them stop trusting him,” Shao replied.

“至少不如过去那样相信他，”
“Or at least trust him less than before.”

“不错，这个想法是对的，
“Yes, that is the right idea.

不过做起来不大容易，
But it will not be easy.

要好好筹划一下。”
We must plan carefully.”

“眼前就有一个机会……”
“There is an opportunity at this very moment.”

这个机会便是胡雪岩为左宗棠经手的最后一笔借款，到了第二期还本的时候了！
The second repayment of principal was now falling due on the final loan that Hu had arranged for Zuo.



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第一章（二）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter One, Part Two
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


当邵友濂谒见李鸿章，谈妥了以打击胡雪岩作为对左宗棠掣肘的主要手段时，胡雪岩不过刚刚到了江宁。
By the time Shao Youlian had met Li Hongzhang and agreed that striking at Hu Xueyan would be their principal means of obstructing Zuo Zongtang, Hu had only just reached Jiangning.

原来胡雪岩与螺蛳太太商量行程，螺蛳太太力主先到江宁，后到上海。
When he discussed his itinerary with Madam Luosi, she strongly urged him to visit Jiangning before Shanghai.

胡雪岩觉得她的打算很妥当，
He thought her reasoning sound.

因为由于螺蛳太太的夸奖，他才知道宓本常应变的本事很到家，这样就方便了，
Her praise of Mi Benchang had made him realize how well Mi could handle unexpected situations, which simplified matters.

在南京动静要伺候左宗棠，身不由主，
In Nanjing he must attend upon Zuo and could not control his own movements.

到了上海，是宓本常伺候自己，
In Shanghai, Mi would attend upon him.

即令有未了之事，可以交给宓本常去料理，欲去欲留，随心所欲，决不会耽误了为女儿主持嘉礼这一件大事。
Any unfinished business could be left to Mi, allowing him to come and go as he pleased without missing the important duty of presiding over his daughter's wedding.

于是，他一面写信通知宓本常与古应春，一面打点到江宁的行李——行李中大部分是送人的土仪。
He wrote to Mi and Gu Yingchun while preparing his baggage, most of which consisted of local gifts.

江宁候补道最多，有句戏言叫做“群‘道，如毛”。
Jiangning had more expectant circuit intendants than anywhere else, giving rise to a joke that its “circuit men were as thick as hairs.”

这些候补道终年派不到一个差使，但三品大员的排场，不能不摆，
They might go a whole year without an assignment, yet still had to maintain the appearance of third-rank dignitaries.

所以一个个苦不堪言，只盼当肥缺阔差使的朋友到江宁公干，才有稍资沾润的机会。
Struggling to do so, they awaited visits from friends holding lucrative posts, hoping for a little help.

胡雪岩在江宁的熟人很多，又是“财神”，
Hu had many acquaintances there and was the God of Wealth.

这趟去自然东西是东西、银子是银子，个个要应酬到。
Everyone must receive attention, in gifts or silver.

银子还可在江宁阜康支用，土仪却必须从杭州带去，整整装满一船，
The silver could be drawn from Fukang in Jiangning, but the Hangzhou gifts filled an entire boat.

连同胡雪岩专用的座船，由长江水师特为派来的小人轮拖带，经嘉兴、苏州直驶江宁。
A small steamer specially sent by the Yangtze naval forces towed it and Hu's private passenger boat through Jiaxing and Suzhou to Jiangning.

当此时也，李鸿章亦以密电致上海道邵友濂，要他赴津一行，有要事面谈。
Meanwhile, Li secretly telegraphed Shao, the Shanghai circuit intendant, summoning him to Tianjin for an important personal discussion.

上海道是地方官，不能擅离职守，所以在密电中说明，总理衙门另有电报。
As a local official, Shao could not leave his post without authorization, so Li explained that a separate telegram would come from the Zongli Yamen.

关照他先作准备，等总理衙门的公事一到，立即航海北上。
Shao was to prepare and sail north as soon as its official instructions arrived.

公事是胡雪岩从杭州动身以后，才到上海的。
They reached Shanghai only after Hu had left Hangzhou.

但因上海到天津的海道，费时只得两天一夜，所以邵友濂见到李鸿章时，胡雪岩还在路上。
But the sea passage to Tianjin took just two days and a night; when Shao saw Li, Hu was still on his way.


这南北洋两大臣各召亲信，目的恰好相反。
The ministers responsible for the northern and southern maritime administrations were thus each summoning a trusted man, but for opposite purposes.

左宗棠主战，
Zuo favoured war.

积极筹划南洋防务以外，全力支持督办广东军务的钦差大臣彭玉麟。
Besides actively preparing southern coastal defences, he fully supported Peng Yulin, the imperial commissioner supervising military affairs in Guangdong.

李鸿章则表面虽不敢违犯清议，但暗中却用尽了釜底抽薪的手段，削弱主战派的力量及声势。
Li, though unwilling openly to defy respectable public opinion, secretly used every means to remove the war party's support and weaken its power and prestige.

第一个目标是左副都御史张佩纶，因为他是主战派领袖大学士李鸿藻的谋主，
His first target was Zhang Peilun, the Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief, chief strategist for Grand Secretary Li Hongzao, leader of the war party.

制服他亦就是擒贼擒王之意。
Bringing Zhang under control would be like capturing the leader to subdue the band.

就压制主战派这个目的来说，收服张佩纶是治本，打击胡雪岩是治标。
In terms of suppressing the advocates of war, winning Zhang over dealt with the root; attacking Hu dealt with the branches.


可是首当其冲的胡雪岩，却还睡在鼓里，
Hu, who would bear the first blow, knew nothing of this.

到了江宁，先到他自己所置的公馆休息。
On reaching Jiangning, he went first to rest at his own residence.

胡雪岩在通都大邑，都置有公馆，但一年难得一到，
He kept houses in the great cities but rarely visited them even once a year.

江宁因为左宗棠的关系，这年是第二次来往。
Because of Zuo, this was his second stay at Jiangning that year.

这个公馆的“女主人”姓王，
The “mistress” of this house was surnamed Wang.

原是秦淮“旧院”钓鱼巷的者鸨，运气不佳，两个养女，连着出事，一个殉情，一个私奔，
She had formerly run a brothel in Diaoyu Lane in Qinhuai's Old Quarter, but misfortune had struck her two adopted daughters in succession: one died for love, and the other eloped.

私奔的可以不追究，殉情的却连累老鸨吃了人命官司，
The elopement could be left alone, but the death involved Madam Wang in a homicide case.

好不容易才得无罪被释，心灰意懒再不愿意吃这碗“把势饭”了。
She was finally acquitted and released, yet so disheartened that she no longer wished to earn her living by that precarious trade.

既然如此，只有从良之一途。
The only alternative was to leave it and marry.

这个王鸨，就象《板桥杂记》中所写的李香君的假母那样，虽鸨不老，三十出头年纪，丰韵犹存，
Like Li Xiangjun's adoptive mother in Miscellaneous Records of Banqiao, she was a madam without being old, only a little over thirty and still attractive.

要从良亦着实有人愿量珠来聘。
There were men willing to offer riches for her.

但秦淮的勾栏中人，承袭了明末清初“旧院”的遗风，
But Qinhuai courtesans inherited the Old Quarter's traditions from the late Ming and early Qing.

讲究饮食起居，看得骚人墨客，
They cared about refinement in food and daily life and admired poets and cultivated men.

而看中她的，腰有万金之缠，身无一骨之雅；她看中的，温文尔雅，不免寒酸。
Those who wanted her had fortunes but no trace of elegance; those she wanted were gentle and refined but poor.

因而空有从良之志，难得终身之托。
She wished to leave the profession, yet could find no one to entrust her future to.


这是三年前的事，
That was three years earlier.

江宁阜康新换一个档手，名叫江德源，此人是由阜康调过来的，
Jiangning Fukang had just acquired a new manager, Jiang Deyuan, transferred from another Fukang establishment.

深通风月，得知有王鸨这么一个人，延聘她来当“胡公馆”的管家，
Well versed in the world of pleasure, he heard of her and hired her to manage Hu's residence.

平时作为应酬特等客户的处所，等“东家”到江宁，她便是“主持中馈”的“主妇”。
Normally it entertained especially important clients; when the proprietor visited, she became its hostess, presiding over the household.

当然，这“主妇”的责任，也包括房帏之事在内。
Those duties naturally extended to the bedroom.

王鸨为胡公馆的饮食起居舒服，且又不受拘束，欣然同意。
Comfortable living and freedom from restraint made her readily accept.

那年秋天，胡雪岩到江宁，首先就看中了她的裙下双钩，纤如新月，
When Hu came that autumn, the first thing to attract him was the pair of tiny curved feet beneath her skirt, slender as crescent moons.

一夕缱绻，真如袁子才所说的“徐娘风味胜雏年”，
After a night together, he found Yuan Zicai's saying true: “A mature woman's charms surpass those of youth.”

厚赠以外，送了她一个外号叫做“王九妈”，南宋发生在西湖上的，有名的“卖油郎独占花魁女”的故事，其中的老鸨就叫王九妈。
Besides generous gifts, he gave her the name Mother Wang Jiu, after the brothel keeper in the famous Southern Song tale set on West Lake, The Oil Vendor Wins the Flower Queen.

这王九妈已得到江德源的通知，早就迎合胡雪岩的喜好，除饮食方面有预备以外，另外还打听了许多新闻，作为陪伴闲谈的资料。
Now, warned by Jiang, she had prepared Hu's favourite food and gathered plenty of news to entertain him.


这些新闻中，胡雪岩最关切的，自然是有关左宗棠的情形。
Naturally, Hu cared most about news of Zuo.

据说他衰病侵寻，意气更甚，
He was said to be increasingly old and infirm, but more overbearing than ever.

接见僚属宾客，不能谈西征，一谈便开了他的“话匣子”，铺陈西征的勋业，御将如何恩威并用，用兵如何神奇莫测。
Visitors and subordinates must never mention the western campaign: it opened a floodgate of talk about his achievements, his combination of kindness and authority in handling generals, and the miraculous unpredictability of his strategy.

再接下来便要骂人，第一个被骂的是曾国藩，其次是李鸿章，有时兼骂沈葆祯。
Then came the abuse, first of Zeng Guofan, next of Li Hongzhang, and sometimes of Shen Baozhen too.

这三个人都是左宗棠的前任，有好些旧部在江宁，尤其是曾国藩故旧更多，
All three had preceded him in office, and many of their former subordinates remained in Jiangning, especially Zeng's.

而且就人品来说，左宗棠骂李鸿章犹可，骂曾国藩则不免令人不服，
Whatever might be said of Li, people resented attacks on Zeng's character.

因此，曾国藩的旧部，每每大庭广众之间批评他说：“大帅对老帅有意见，
Zeng's old followers often complained openly: “The present commander has grievances against the old commander.

他们之间的恩怨，亦难说得很。
The rights and wrongs between them are hard to judge.

就算老帅不对，人都过去了，也听不见他的骂，
Even if the old commander was at fault, he is dead and cannot hear the abuse.

何必在我们面前罗嗦。
Why must we endure it?

而且道理不直，话亦不圆，
Besides, the arguments are neither just nor convincing.

说来说去，无非老帅把持饷源，处处回护九帅，
It all comes down to the same thing: he monopolized military funds and protected Ninth Marshal.

耳朵里都听得生茧了。”胡雪岩心想，也不过半年未见左宗棠，何以老境颓唐至此？
We have heard it until our ears have grown calluses.” Hu wondered how Zuo could have declined so much in the mere six months since they last met.

便有些不大相信，及至一问江德源，果然如此，他说：
He was doubtful until Jiang confirmed it.

“江宁现在许多事办不通。
“Many things cannot be done in Jiangning now.

为什么呢？左大人先开讲，后开骂，一个人滔滔不绝，
His Excellency begins with a lecture, then starts abusing people, talking without pause.

说到时候差不多了，戈什哈把茶碗交到他手里，外面伺候的人马上喊一声‘送客’。
When the allotted time is nearly over, a guard puts a teacup into his hand and someone outside immediately calls, ‘See the guest out!’

根本就没法子谈公事。”
There is no chance to discuss business.”


“这是难得一次吧？”
“Surely that happens only occasionally?”

“哪里？可说天天如此。”
“Almost every day.

江德源说，“左大人有点‘人来疯’，人越多他越起劲。
He becomes more excited with a larger audience.

大先生亦不必讲究礼节。
You needn't stand on ceremony, sir.

‘上院，去见，不如就此刻在花厅或者签押房里见，
Instead of attending a formal audience, go now and see him in the garden reception room or his office.

倒可以谈点正经。”
Then you might discuss something useful.”

原来督抚接见“两司”——藩司、桌司以及道员以下的僚属，大致五天一次，“衙参”之期定在逢三、逢八的日子居多，
Governors-general and governors generally received the provincial treasurer and judicial commissioner, together with circuit intendants and lesser subordinates, about once every five days, often on dates ending in three or eight.

接见之处，称为“官厅”，而衙参称之为“上院”。
These formal visits, called “going up to the court,” took place in the official reception hall.

胡雪岩到的这天是十月十七，原想第二天“上院”，
Hu had arrived on the seventeenth of the tenth lunar month and intended to attend on the eighteenth.

如今听江德源这一说，决定接受他的建议，当即换了官服，坐轿直闯两江总督的辕门。
Accepting Jiang's advice, he instead put on his official robes at once and went straight by sedan chair to the Liangjiang governor-general's gates.


辕门上一看“胡财神”到了，格外巴结，
Seeing the God of Wealth, the gatekeepers were exceptionally attentive.

擅作主张开正门，让轿子抬到官厅檐前下轿，
On their own authority they opened the main gate and let his sedan be carried to the eaves of the reception hall.

随即通报到上房，传出话来：“请胡大人换了便服，
Word was sent inside, and instructions came back: “Ask His Excellency Hu to change into informal clothes.

在签押房见面。”
We shall meet in the office.”

于是跟班打开衣包，就在官厅上换了便服，引人签押房，左宗棠已经在等了，
His attendant opened the clothes bundle, and Hu changed in the hall before being shown into the office, where Zuo was already waiting.

胡雪岩自然是行大礼请安，
Hu naturally made his full ceremonial greeting.

左宗棠亲手相扶，延入客座，少不得有一番寒暄。
Zuo helped him up himself and led him to the guest seats, where they exchanged the usual courtesies.

胡雪岩一面说话，一面细看左宗棠的眼睛，
As they spoke, Hu studied his eyes.

左眼已长了一层白翳，右眼见风流泪，非常厉害，不时拿一块绸绢擦拭，
A white film covered the left, while the right watered badly in a draught, forcing him to wipe it repeatedly with a silk handkerchief.

于是找一个空隙说道：“听说大人的眼睛不好，我特为配了一副眼药来，
Finding an opening, Hu said, “I heard your eyes were troubling you and had a special medicine prepared.

清凉明目，很有效验，”
It is cooling and clears the sight, with very good results.”

说着，将随手携带的一个小锦袱解开来又说：“还替大人配了一服膏滋药，
Undoing a small brocade bundle he had brought, he added, “I also had a medicinal paste made for you.

如果服得好，请大人交代书启师爷写信来，我再送来。”
If it agrees with you, have your correspondence secretary write, and I shall send more.”

“多谢，多谢！”
“Thank you!

左宗棠说：“我现在多靠几个朋友帮忙，不但私务，连公事都要累你。
Nowadays I depend on a few friends for help, not just with private matters; even official business must trouble you.

上次山东闹水灾，两江派助赈四十万，藩库只拿得出一半，
When Shandong suffered floods, Liangjiang was assigned four hundred thousand taels for relief, and the provincial treasury could provide only half.

多亏你慷慨援手。
Your generous help saved us.

不过，这笔款子，两江还无法奉还。”
But Liangjiang still cannot repay you.”

“大人不必挂齿。”胡雪岩原想再说一句：“有官款在我那里，我是应该效劳的。”但话到口边，又缩了回去。
“Please don't mention it.” Hu nearly added that, with public funds deposited with him, he ought to be of service, but checked the words before speaking.


“这一回越南吃紧，朝命彭雪琴督办广东军务，
“With the situation in Vietnam urgent, the court has ordered Peng Xueqin to supervise military affairs in Guangdong.

我跟他三十年的交情，不能不助他一臂之力，
We have been friends for thirty years, and I must help him.

而况我奉旨筹办南洋防务，
Moreover, I have been commanded to prepare southern maritime defences.

粤闽洋面，亦在我管辖之下，其势更不能兼筹并顾。
The waters off Guangdong and Fujian fall within my jurisdiction; I cannot neglect them.

可恨的是，两江官场，从曾湘乡以来，越搞越坏，
What infuriates me is that, since Zeng of Xiangxiang's time, officialdom in Liangjiang has grown steadily worse.

推拖敷衍，不顾大局，以致于我又要靠老朋友帮忙了。”
Evasion and delay, with no thought for the wider situation—so once again I must rely on old friends.”

“是。”胡雪岩很沉重地答应着。
Hu assented gravely.

“王阆青已经出京回湖南去招兵了，打算招六千人，
“Wang Langqing has left Beijing for Hunan to recruit six thousand men.

总要有四千支枪才够用。
He will need at least four thousand rifles.

江宁的军械局，为李少荃的大舅子搞得一塌糊涂，
Li Shaoquan's elder brother-in-law has made a complete mess of the Jiangning Arsenal.

交上海制造局赶办，第一是经费尚无着落，其次是时间上缓不济急，
If we order the Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau to produce them, first the money is not yet available, and second they cannot arrive in time for the emergency.

所以我想由转运局来想法了。
So I thought the Transport Bureau might find a way.

雪岩，你说呢？
What do you say, Xueyan?”

““转运局库存洋枪，细数我还不知道。
“I don't yet know the exact number of Western rifles in stock.

不过大人既然交代要四千支，我无论如何要想法子办齐。”
But if you require four thousand, I shall find some means of supplying the full number.”

“好！”
“Good!

左宗棠说：“我就知道，跟你商量不过是一句话的事，
I knew that a word to you would settle it.

最痛快不过。”
Nothing could be more satisfying.”

“光塘……”胡雪岩称名谦谢：“承大人栽培，
Referring to himself respectfully by his personal name, Hu replied, “Guangyong owes everything to your patronage.

不敢不尽心尽力伺候。”
I dare not fail to serve you with all my heart and strength.”


“好说，好说。
“You are too modest.

还有件事，
There is something else.

王阆青招来的兵，粮饷自然由户部去筹划，一笔开拔费，数目可观，
The Ministry of Revenue will of course arrange pay and provisions for Wang's recruits, but the cost of mobilizing them is considerable.

两江不能不量力相助。
Liangjiang must contribute what it can.

雪岩，你能不能再帮两江一个忙？”
Could you help us once more?”

如果是过去，胡雪岩一定会问：“要多少？”
In the past, Hu would simply have asked how much.

但目前情形不同，
Circumstances were different now.

他想了一下说：“回大人的话，现在市面上银根紧得不得了，
After a little thought, he replied, “Your Excellency, money is desperately tight in the market.

就是不紧，大人要顾到老部下。
Even if it were not, you must consider your old subordinate.

如今我遵大人的吩咐，要多少筹多少，到了陕甘接济不上时，就变成从井救人了。”
If I raise whatever you ask now and later cannot supply Shaanxi and Gansu, I shall be like a man who jumps into a well to rescue someone.”

所谓“老部下”是指刘锦棠，
The old subordinate was Liu Jintang.

而胡雪岩又是西征转运局的委员，在他的职司有主有从，
Hu held a commission with the western expedition's Transport Bureau, and his responsibilities had an order of priority.

如两江筹饷是额外的差使，行有余力，不妨效劳，
Raising funds for Liangjiang was additional work, which he could undertake if he had capacity to spare.

否则他当然要顾全西征军为主。
Otherwise, the western army must come first.

左宗棠了解到这一点，便不能不有所顾虑，
Zuo understood and could not disregard the concern.

想了一下说道：“这样吧，
“Very well.

明天我再找藩司来想法子。
Tomorrow I shall speak to the provincial treasurer again.

如果真有难处，那就不能不仰赖老兄拔刀相助了。”
If there really is difficulty, we shall have to rely on you to come to our rescue.”

“大人言重。”
“You are too kind.

胡雪岩问道：“不知道什么时候再来请示。”
When should I return for instructions?”

“请示”便是听回音。
By instructions, Hu meant the answer.

左宗棠答说：“很快、很快，
“Soon.

三两天之内，就有信息。”
There will be news within two or three days.”

于是胡雪岩起身说道：
Hu rose.

“我听大人的指挥办理，
“I shall act as you direct.

今天就告辞了。”
For today, I take my leave.”

“嗯，嗯。”左宗棠问：“今天晚上没事吧？”
“Are you free this evening?”

胡雪岩知道要留他吃饭，急说道：“今天晚上有个不能不去的饭局。”
Realizing that Zuo meant to invite him to dinner, Hu quickly said that he had an engagement he could not miss.

“既然如此，我不留你了。
“Then I won't keep you.

我知道你事情多，
I know you are busy.

不必来看我，
There is no need to call again.

等有了信息，我自然会派人来请你。”
When there is news, I shall send for you.”


于是胡雪岩请安辞出。接着便转往秦淮河河房去赴宴会，
After his farewell salute, Hu went to a banquet in a riverside house on the Qinhuai.

在座的都是江宁官场上提得起来的人物，消息特别灵通，胡雪岩倒是听了许多内幕，
The guests were prominent men in Jiangning officialdom, unusually well informed, and he learned much inside news.

据说李鸿章已向总理衙门正式表明他的看法，中国实力不足，对越南之事应早结束，舍此别无良法。
Li Hongzhang was said to have formally told the Zongli Yamen that China's strength was insufficient and the Vietnamese affair must be settled promptly: there was no other satisfactory course.

但总理衙门主张将法国对中国种种挟制及无理的要求，照会世界各国，以明其曲在彼。
The Yamen, however, favoured notifying the countries of the world of France's coercion and unreasonable demands, making clear that the fault lay with France.

如果法军来犯，即与开战。
If French troops attacked, China should fight.

李鸿章虽不以为然，无奈他想谈和，连对手都没有，法国的特使德理固已转往日本去了。
Li disagreed, but even if he wanted negotiations, he had no one to negotiate with: the French special envoy Tricou had left for Japan.

“中国的若恼是，欲和不敢和，欲战不能战。”督署的洋务委员候补道张凤池说：
“China's difficulty is that we want peace but dare not make it, and want war but cannot fight it,” said Zhang Fengchi, an expectant circuit intendant serving as foreign-affairs commissioner at the governor-general's headquarters.

“现在是彼此‘耗’的局面，
“Now each side is trying to outlast the other.

就不知道谁耗得过谁了？”
The question is which can do it.”

“那么，照凤翁看，是哪个耗得过哪个？”
“Who do you think will last longer, Mr Feng?”

“这一层很难说。
“Hard to say.

不过，在法国，原来只有他们的外务部长最强硬，现在意见已经融洽了，
In France, only the foreign minister was initially so intransigent, but opinion has now become united.

他们的内阁总理在国会演说：决心在越南打到底。
Their premier told parliament that they were determined to fight to the end in Vietnam.

而我们呢，朝廷两大柱石，纵不说势如水火，可是南辕北辙，说不到一起，
Meanwhile, our court's two great pillars may not be fire and water, but they are certainly pulling in opposite directions and cannot agree.

大为可虑。”
That is deeply worrying.”

所谓“朝廷两大住石”，自是指李鸿章与左宗棠。
The two pillars were plainly Li and Zuo.

在座的虽以两江的官员居多，但其中跟李鸿章渊源甚深的也不少，
Most guests were Liangjiang officials, but many had close ties to Li.

谈到李、左不和，是个犯忌讳的话题，如果出言不慎，会惹麻烦上身，
Their quarrel was a dangerous topic: an incautious word could bring trouble.

所以都保持着沉默。
Everyone remained silent.


只有一个人是例外，
Everyone, that is, except one man.

此人是山东的一个候补道，名叫玉桂，蒙古旗人，
Yugui, an expectant circuit intendant in Shandong, was a Mongol Bannerman.

原来在两江候补，署道实缺，也当过好些差使，
He had formerly awaited appointment in Liangjiang, acted in an established circuit post and held many assignments.

资格甚老，年纪最长，大家都叫他“王大哥”。
Senior in service and the oldest man present, he was called Brother Yu by everyone.

此人理路很明白，勇于任事，本来是应该红起来的一个能员，只以心直口快，妨了他的官运。
Clear-minded and ready to shoulder responsibility, he should have risen as an able official, but his blunt speech had harmed his prospects.

这回是奉山东巡抚所派，到江宁来谒见左宗棠，商议疏浚运河，
The Shandong governor had sent him to consult Zuo about dredging the Grand Canal.

哪知来了半个月，始终不得要领，以致牢骚满腹，
He had spent half a month in Jiangning without getting anywhere, leaving him full of grievances.

一提到李左不和，忍不住要开口了。
At mention of the quarrel, he could not remain silent.

“左、李两公，勋业彪炳，天下仰望，
“Lords Zuo and Li have illustrious achievements and the admiration of the empire.

朝廷酬庸有功，封侯拜相，
The court has rewarded them with titles and high office.

过去的战功是过去了，可以不谈了，
Their past military services are past; there is no need to keep discussing them.

好汉不提当年勇，
A true hero doesn't boast of former valour.

何必呢？”
Why do it?”

这明明是在说左宗棠。
He plainly meant Zuo.

八座咫尺，忌讳益甚，更没有人敢置一词。
With the great official so near at hand, the subject became more perilous still, and nobody dared say a word.

有了三分酒意的玉桂，只当大家默许他的议论，因而就更起劲了，
Slightly tipsy, Yugui took their silence as approval and grew more animated.

“如说打仗，兵贵神速，
“In war, speed is everything.

倘或一天到晚说空话，正事不只，到得兵临城下，还在大谈春风已度玉门关，
If we talk emptily all day and neglect real work, what happens when the enemy reaches the city walls while we are still boasting that the spring wind has already passed the Jade Gate?

各位倒想，那会弄成怎么一个局面？”
Think what a state we shall be in!”

听得这番话，座客相顾失色。
The guests exchanged frightened looks.

有跟玉桂交情比较深的，便很替他担心，
His closer friends were particularly worried.

因为这话一传到左宗棠耳朵里，就一定会找上他去，
If this reached Zuo, Yugui would certainly be summoned.

如果只是痛斥一顿倒还罢了，
A severe scolding would be the least of it.

就怕找了他去质问：你说“兵临城下”是什么兵？
What if Zuo asked, “What troops do you mean at the city walls?

是法国军队吗？
The French?”

一怒之下，指名严劾，安上他一个危言惑众、动摇民心士气的罪名，
In anger, he could impeach Yugui by name for alarming the public and undermining civilian and military morale.

起码也是一个革职的处分。
Dismissal would be the minimum punishment.

于是有人便乱以他语：
Someone hurriedly changed the subject.

“玉大哥、玉大哥，今宵只可谈风月，
“Brother Yu, tonight let us discuss only pleasant things.

喝酒，喝酒。”
Drink, drink!”


王桂还想再说，作主人的张凤池见机，大声说道：
Yugui wanted to continue, but their host, Zhang Fengchi, seized his opportunity.

“玉大哥的黑头、黄钟仲吕，可以醒酒，
“Brother Yu's black-faced roles ring like great bells and will sober us up.

来，来，来一段让我们饱饱耳福。”“对！”有人附和：
Come, give us a passage to delight our ears.” Others agreed enthusiastically.

“听玉大哥唱黑头，真是痛快淋漓。
“His singing is wonderfully stirring.

快，快，‘场面’呢？”
Quickly, where are the musicians?”

文场、武场都现成，很快地摆设好了，
String and wind players and percussionists were all available and soon took their places.

When they asked what to play, Zhang said, “His specialities are Exploring Mount Yin and Ascending the Heavenly Terrace.

我看先上天台，后探阴山吧！”
Let us ascend the terrace first, then explore the mountain.”

“不！”玉桂答说：
“No,” Yugui replied.

“今天我反串，唱‘胡子’，
“I shall change roles today and sing a bearded character.

来段《斩谡》。”
Give me Executing Ma Su.”

等打鼓佬下鼓糙领起胡琴，

过门一到，玉桂变了主意，

“我还是唱《上天台》吧。”他说。
“Better make it Ascending the Heavenly Terrace after all.”

原来玉桂编了一段辙儿，想骂左宗棠如失街亭的那个蜀中大将，“言过其言，终无大用”，
He had improvised some words to attack Zuo through the example of the Shu general who lost Jieting: “His words outrun his deeds; he will never be of great use.”

但想想身居客地，而左宗棠到底是年高位尊，
But he reconsidered. He was a visitor here, and Zuo was, after all, an elderly man of high standing.

过于嚣张，实在也不很相宜，所以不为已甚。
Excessive insolence would be improper; he had better not go too far.

这些情形看在胡雪岩眼中颇有感触，
Watching all this, Hu was deeply affected.

回想当年左宗棠意气风发，连曾国藩都不能不让他几分，
He remembered Zuo in his vigorous prime, when even Zeng Guofan had to yield to him.

哪知如今老境颓唐，为人如此轻视，
Who could have imagined such decline in old age, and such contempt from others?

这样转着念头，一面为左宗棠悲哀，一面也不免兴起急流勇退的念头。
Grieving for Zuo, he also began thinking of withdrawing while the current still ran strong.


在江宁已经十天了，左宗棠始终没有派人来请他去见面。
He had been in Jiangning ten days, yet Zuo had not sent for him.

由于他事先有话，胡雪岩不便再去求见，
Given the earlier instruction, he could hardly seek another audience.

只有托熟人去打听。但始终不得要领。
He asked acquaintances to inquire, but learned nothing definite.

好不容易左宗棠来请了，
At last the summons came.

一见面倒没有废话，
This time Zuo wasted no words.

开门见山地说：“雪岩，陕甘那面我另有部署，
“Xueyan, I have made other arrangements for Shaanxi and Gansu.

你把转运局的官款，拨二十五万出来。”
Allocate two hundred and fifty thousand from the Transport Bureau's public funds.”

这笔款子自然是拨给王德榜的，
The money was plainly for Wang Debang.

不加商量，直接交代，胡雪岩除了唯唯称是以外，别无话说。
It was an order, with no discussion, and Hu could only assent.

“这笔钱能不能在这里拨？”左宗棠问。
“Can it be paid here?”

“大人要在哪里拨就哪里拨！”
“Wherever you wish.”

“好，
“Good.

就在这里拨好了。
Here, then.

你替王阆青立个折子。”
Open an account for Wang Langqing and issue him a passbook.”

“是。”
“Yes.”

“你什么时候回去？”
“When will you leave?”

“我一直在候大人的命，
“I have been awaiting your instructions.

既然有了交代，我想明天就走。”
Now that they are settled, I hope to leave tomorrow.”

“对了，你要回去办喜事？”
“Yes, you must return for the wedding.

We have shared hardships; I feel sorry that I cannot attend the feast.”

“You are too kind.”

“我想再送点什么别致的贺礼。

雪岩，你倒替我想想，

不必客气。”
Don't stand on ceremony.”

Hu thought for a moment.

“如果有大人亲笔的一副喜联，那就真的是蓬荜生辉了。”
“A pair of wedding couplets in your own hand would truly bring glory to our humble house.”

“A small matter.

左宗棠答说：“不过今天可来不及了，反正喜期以前，一定会送到。”
There is no time today, but I shall certainly send them before the wedding.”

“You are so busy with public affairs that I am asking more than I should.

既蒙大人许了，我把喜堂最上面的位置留下来了。”
Since you have granted the request, I shall reserve the place of honour in the wedding hall.”


这是变相的坚约，
This was an indirect way of making the promise binding.

左宗棠不可言而无信，否则喜堂正面，空着两块不好看。
Zuo could not fail to keep his word, leaving two blank spaces in the place of honour.

左宗棠理会得这层意思，便喊一声：“来啊！”
Understanding, he called for an attendant.

“喳！”厅上一呼，廊下百诺，进来一名亮蓝顶子的材官，站在他身旁待命。
An answer rang from the corridor, and an officer wearing a bright blue finial entered to await his orders.

“胡大人的小姐出阁，我许了送一副喜联，
“I have promised His Excellency Hu a pair of couplets for his daughter's wedding.

你只要看我稍为闲一点儿，就提醒我这件事，免得失礼。”
Whenever you see me with a little time to spare, remind me, so that I don't fail in courtesy.

左宗棠又说：“你要不断提醒我。”
Keep reminding me.”

“是。”
“Yes.”

“好！
“Good.

就这么说了。”左宗棠又问，“你是先到上海？”
That settles it.” He asked Hu, “You are going to Shanghai first?”

“是的。”
“Yes.”

“有什么事要我替你招呼？”
“Is there anything you need me to arrange?”

胡雪岩心里不放心的是，那笔到期还本的洋债，为限已近，
Hu was uneasy about the foreign loan principal soon falling due.

但看宓本常并无信来，谅想已经办妥，
But Mi had sent no letter, so he supposed everything had been settled.

就不必再请左宗棠费事了。
There was no need to trouble Zuo.

“等有事再来求大人。”
“I shall ask when something arises.”

“Very well.

“这回你来，我连请你吃顿饭的工夫都抽不出来，
I have not even found time to give you a dinner on this visit.

实在有点说不过去。
It is hardly proper.”

““大人太客气了。”
“You are too courteous.

Is there anything you would like me to attend to in Shanghai or Hangzhou?”

左宗棠想了一下说：
Zuo thought briefly.

“就是王阆青的那四千支枪。
“Only those four thousand rifles for Wang Langqing.”

“别的就没有了。”
“Nothing else.

As you said yourself, I shall ask when something comes to mind.”

胡雪岩告辞而去，又重重地托了那些材官，务必提醒喜联那件事。
Hu took his leave, then earnestly reminded the attendant officers that they must prompt Zuo about the couplets.

当然，少不得还有一个上写“别敬”的红包奉送。
Naturally, he also presented a red envelope marked “Parting Gift.”


一到上海，胡雪岩才失悔在江宁荒废的日子太多了。
As soon as he reached Shanghai, Hu regretted the time wasted in Jiangning.

上海也仿佛变了一个样子，
The city seemed transformed.

其所谓市面萧条，
Business was depressed.

熟人一见了面，不是打听战事，就是相询何处避难最好？
Acquaintances, on meeting, asked either for war news or where it would be safest to take refuge.

这些情形在江宁是见不到的。
Nothing of the sort had been apparent in Jiangning.

做钱庄最怕遇到这样局势，谣言满天，人心惶惶。
Such conditions were a banker's greatest fear: rumours everywhere and people in panic.

而且遇到这种时候，有钱的人都相信手握现款是最妥当的事，因此，钱庄由于存款只提不存，
The wealthy believed cash in hand was safest, so deposits were withdrawn but not replaced.

周转不灵而倒闭的，已经有好几家。
Several banks had already failed through lack of funds to meet payments.

阜康是块金字招牌，所受的影响比较小，但暗中另有危机，
Fukang's excellent name protected it to some extent, but another danger was developing in secret.

只是宓本常守口如瓶，不让胡雪岩知道而已。
Mi kept his lips sealed and let Hu know nothing.

但即令如此，已使得胡雪岩大为头痛。
Even what Hu could see was enough to cause a severe headache.

首先是供应王德榜的四千支洋枪，
First came Wang Debang's four thousand rifles.

转运局的库存仅得两千五，尚少一千五百支，需要现购，
The Transport Bureau had only twenty-five hundred in stock, leaving fifteen hundred to buy.

每支纹银十八两，连水脚约合三万两银子，
At eighteen taels of standard silver each, with freight, they would cost about thirty thousand taels.

这倒还是小事，
That was relatively minor.

伤脑筋的是，他在左宗棠面前，已经大包大揽地答应下来，
The trouble was that Hu had given Zuo an unqualified promise.

如果交不足数，信用有关。
Failure to deliver the full number would affect his credit.

“You needn't attach too much importance to it, Little Uncle,” Gu said.

将来拿定单给左湘阴看就是了。”
“You can show Zuo of Xiangyin the order later.”

“应春，”胡雪岩说：“我在左湘阴面前，说话从来没有打过折扣，
“Yingchun, I have never fallen short of my word to him.

而且，这回也只怕是最后一两回替他办差了，
This may be one of the last one or two commissions I carry out for him.

为人最要紧收缘结果，
What matters most is how one finishes.

一直说话算话，到临了失一回信用，且不说左湘阴保不定会起疑心，以为我没有什么事要仰仗他，对他就不象从前那样子忠心，
If I break my word at the end, he may suspect that, no longer needing his protection, I am less loyal.

就是自己，也实在不大甘心，多年做出来的牌子，为这件小事砸掉。
Besides, I cannot bear to destroy a name built over so many years for such a small matter.

应春你倒替我想想，
Think of something.

无论如何要帮我一个忙。”
You must help me.”

办军火一向是古应春的事，从来也没有说过一句客气话，
Gu had always handled arms purchases, and no such appeal had ever been necessary.

忽然冒出来这么一句“无论如何要帮忙”的话，古应春心里当然也很不是味道。
The sudden plea made him uncomfortable.

他盘算了好一会说：“看看日本那方面有没有办法好想。
After considering for some time, he said, “Let us see whether Japan offers a way.

如果有现成的货色，日子上还来得及，
If there is stock ready, we can still make the deadline.

不过枪价就不能谈了。”
But we shall not be able to bargain over the price.”

“Price is a small matter.

只要快。
Speed is everything.

应春，你今天就去办。”
Start today.”


古应春依他的要求，奔走了两天，总算有了头绪，
After two days' work, Gu at last had a lead.

急于想要报告胡雪岩，哪知寻来寻去，到处扑空，
Eager to tell Hu, he looked everywhere but could not find him.

但到得深夜，古应春正要归寝时，胡雪岩却又不速而至，气色显得有点不大正常。
Late that night, just as Gu was about to retire, Hu arrived unannounced, looking unwell.

“老爷只怕累坏了。”瑞香亲自来照料，一面端来一杯参汤，一面问道：
Ruixiang attended to him herself, bringing ginseng broth. “You must be exhausted, Master.

“饿不饿？”
Are you hungry?”

“饿是饿，吃不下。”
“Hungry, yes, but I can't eat.”

“你去想想看，”古应春交代，“弄点开胃的东西来消夜。”
“Think of something appetizing for supper,” Gu told her.

When she had gone, Hu asked, “Has Seventh Sister gone to bed?”

“是的。
“Yes.

她睡得早。”
She retires early.”

“那就不惊动她了。”
“Then don't disturb her.

胡雪岩又问：“听说你寻了我一天。”
I hear you have been looking for me all day.”

“是啊！古应春很起劲地说：”
Gu brightened.

我有好消息要告诉小爷叔，
“I have good news.

枪有着落了。
We have found the rifles.”

““这好！”胡雪岩也很高兴，
“Excellent!

Where?”

How did it happen?”

找到日本一个军火商，有两千支枪可以出售。
They had found a Japanese arms dealer with two thousand for sale.

古应春多方探查，得到这么一个消息，托人打电报去问，愿出高价买一千五百支。
Through extensive inquiries, Gu learned of the stock and had a telegram sent offering a high price for fifteen hundred.

At least that is one worry settled.” Hu suddenly asked, “Have you heard that Old Mi is secretly trading in goods from north and south without telling me?”

“Do you think I should confront him?”

这一点关系很大，古应春不敢造次，
The matter was important, and Gu dared not answer hastily.

过了好一会却反问一句：“小爷叔看呢？”

俗话说的‘横竖横、拆牛棚’。

一说破了，他索性放手大做，

应还洋商借款的第二期本金，期限即在十月底，
The second repayment of principal on the foreign loan fell due at the end of the tenth lunar month.

宓本常是十月初就不断到上海道衙门去催问，所得的答复是：备省尚未汇到。
Since the beginning of that month, Mi had repeatedly asked at the Shanghai circuit intendant's office, only to be told that the provinces had not yet remitted the money.

Mr Hu, five hundred thousand taels is nothing to you.

一句话将胡雪岩堵得开不出口，

我垫一垫当然无所谓，

哪晓得偏偏就垫不出。”

Misfortunes have happened to coincide, and I cannot explain my difficulty.”


何为“不巧是巧”？古应春要多想一想才明白，不巧的事凑在一起，成为巧合，便是“不巧是巧”。
Gu had to think for a moment to understand Hu's phrase: several unlucky circumstances coming together made a coincidence of misfortunes.

细细想去，不巧的事实在很多，
There were many.

第一是市面不景气，银根极紧。
First, business was poor and money desperately tight.

第二是屯丝屯茧这件事，明知早成困局，力求摆脱，
Second, Hu knew that his stocks of silk and cocoons had trapped him and had tried hard to escape.

但阴借阳差，他的收买新式缫丝厂，为存货找出路的计划，始终未能成功，
Yet through one mishap after another, his scheme to acquire modern silk-reeling factories and create an outlet for the stock had never succeeded.

目前天津、上海都有存丝，但削价求售，亦无买主。
Silk remained in both Tianjin and Shanghai, without buyers even at reduced prices.

第三是左宗棠先为协赈借了二十万银子，如今又要拨付王德榜二十五万两，
Third, Zuo had already borrowed two hundred thousand taels for relief contributions and now required another two hundred and fifty thousand for Wang Debang.

虽说是转运局的官款，但总是少了一笔可调度的头寸。
Although these were the Transport Bureau's public funds, their removal still reduced the cash available for Hu to deploy.

第四是十一月初五的吉期在即，
Fourth, the wedding on the fifth of the eleventh month was approaching.

场面大，开销多，至少还要预备二十万银子。
Such a grand occasion meant heavy spending; at least another two hundred thousand taels must be ready.

最后就是窗本常私下借客户的名义，提取存款去做南北货生意，
Finally, Mi was privately using customers' names to withdraw deposits for his trade in northern and southern goods.

照古应春的估计，大概是十万银子左右。
Gu estimated the amount at roughly a hundred thousand taels.

“今天十月二十五了。
“Today is the twenty-fifth of the tenth month,” Hu said.

这个月小建，
“This month has only twenty-nine days.

到十一月初五，十天都不到。”
There are fewer than ten days until the fifth of next month.

胡雪岩说：“这笔头寸摆不平，怎能放心去办喜事。”
How can I attend to the wedding with an easy mind until I have put our cash position in order?”

“小爷叔亦不必着急，
“Don't be too anxious.

到底只有五十万银子。
After all, it is only five hundred thousand.

总有办法可想的。”
There must be a solution.”

“要想就要早想。”
“Then we must look for it early.”

一面催上海道，一面自己来想法子调头寸，

“I thought of that too.

就怕人家也同邵筱村一样，来一句‘你先垫一垫好了’。
But what if they say, like Shao Xiaocun, ‘Why don't you advance it yourself?’

我就没有话好说了。”
I shall have no answer.”

“不会的。
“They won't.

洋人公私分明，
Foreigners distinguish public from private affairs.

公家欠的债，你们不会叫私人来垫的。
They won't expect a private person to advance money for a public debt.

如果他们真的说这样的话，小爷叔回他一句：”我垫不如你垫，
If they do say so, tell them, ‘Better for you to advance it than for me to do it.

以前汇丰要放款给阜康，
Before, HSBC wanted to lend to Fukang.

阜康不想用，还是用了，
Fukang didn't want the money but eventually took it.

如今仍旧算阜康跟汇丰借好了。
Let this again count as a loan from HSBC to Fukang.’

‘看他怎么说。
See what they say.”

““这话倒也是。”胡雪岩深深点头。
Hu nodded earnestly. “That is true.”

“小爷叔愿意这样做，我就先同汇丰去说好了它。
“If you agree, I can settle it with HSBC in advance.

小爷叔不就可以放心了？”
Then you can put your mind at rest.”

“慢慢、慢慢！”
“Not so fast!”

胡雪岩连连摇手。
Hu repeatedly waved his hand.

原来他有他的顾虑，
He had his own concerns.

因为请求展期，无异表示他连五十万银子都无法垫付。
Requesting an extension would amount to admitting that he could not even advance five hundred thousand taels.

这话传出去，砸他的金字招牌，
If that became known, it would damage his golden reputation.

不但左宗棠对他的实力与手腕，会生怀疑，十一月初五那一天，盈门的贺客少不得会谈论这件事，
Zuo would doubt his resources and ability, and on the fifth of the next month the crowds of wedding guests would be bound to discuss it.

喜事风光，亦将大为减色。
The glory of the celebration would be greatly diminished.


“我们先走第一步同第二步。”胡雪岩说：
“Let us take the first and second steps for now,” Hu said.

“第一步我来，第二步托你。”
“I shall handle the first and entrust the second to you.”

第一步就是到上海道衙门去催问，第二步“自己想法子来调度”。
The first meant pressing the circuit intendant's office; the second, finding ways to arrange funds themselves.

这一步无非督促宓本常去办。
In practice, that meant urging Mi to act.

古应春因为有过去的芥蒂，不肯作此吃力不讨好，而且可能徒劳无功的事，
Because of their earlier friction, Gu was unwilling to undertake an arduous, thankless task that might achieve nothing.

因而面有难色。
His face showed his reluctance.

“怎么样？”
“What is it?”

“我想跟小爷叔调一调，
“I should like us to exchange roles.

头一步归我，第二步小爷叔自己来。”
Leave the first step to me, and take the second yourself.

古应春说：“小爷叔催老宓，名正言顺，
You have every right to press Old Mi.

我来催老宓，他心里不舒服，不会买帐的。”
If I do it, he will resent it and pay no attention.”

“也好。”
“Very well.

胡雪岩说：“事情要快了。”
But we must act quickly.”

“我明天一早就去，
“I shall go first thing tomorrow.

上海道衙门我有熟人。”
I have acquaintances at the office.

古应春说：“小爷叔明天中午来吃饭，听消息。”
Come for lunch and hear the news.”

“好。”
“Good.

胡雪岩说：“这几天我们早晚都要碰头。”
These next few days we must see each other morning and evening.”



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第一章（三，至本章结束）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter One, Part Three (conclusion)
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第二天中午，古应春带来一个极好的消息，各省协助的“西饷”，已快收齐了，
At noon the next day, Gu Yingchun brought excellent news: almost all the provincial contributions to the western military funds had been collected.

最早的一笔，在十月初便已汇到。
The earliest payment had arrived at the beginning of the tenth month.

“有这样的事！”
“Can that be true?”

胡雪岩大为困惑，
Hu Xueyan was thoroughly puzzled.

“为啥邵筱村同我说一文钱都没有收到？
“Why did Shao Xiaocun tell me he had not received a single cash?

你的消息哪里来的？”
Where did you hear this?”

“我有个同乡晚辈，早年我照应过他，
“From a younger fellow townsman whom I helped years ago.

他现在是上海道衙门电报房的领班。
He is now the head clerk in the telegraph room at the Shanghai circuit office.”

“那就不错了！”
“Then there can be no mistake!”

胡雪岩既喜且怒，
Hu was delighted and angry at once.

“邵筱村不晓得在打什么鬼主意？
“What game is Shao Xiaocun playing?

我要好好问他一问。
I shall have a word with him!”

““小爷叔不必如此。
“There is no need for that, Little Uncle.

我想最好的办法是请左大人打个电报给邵筱村。”
I think the best course is to ask Lord Zuo to send him a telegram.”

原来古应春从他同乡晚辈中，另获有很机密的消息，说是李鸿章正在设法打击左宗棠，
Gu had also obtained highly confidential information from his fellow townsman: Li Hongzhang was looking for ways to strike at Zuo Zongtang.

因而想到，邵友濂对胡雪岩有意留难，是别有用心。
This suggested that Shao Youlian had an ulterior motive for deliberately obstructing Hu.

但这个消息，未经证实，告诉了胡雪岩，反而会生出是非，
But the report had not been confirmed, and telling Hu might only cause trouble.

只有用左宗棠出面，措词严厉些，带着警告的意味，让邵友濂心生顾忌，在期限之前拨出这笔代收的款子，了却胡雪岩的责任，最为上策。
The best course was to have Zuo intervene with a sternly worded warning, making Shao think twice and release the money he had collected before the deadline, thereby discharging Hu’s responsibility.


但胡雪岩又何从去了解他的用心，
Hu, however, had no way of knowing what lay behind Gu’s advice.

他仍旧是抱着在左宗棠面前要保持面子的用心。
His concern was still to save face before Zuo.

在江宁时，左宗棠原曾问过他，有什么事要他出面，意思就是指上海道代收“西饷”这件事，
In Jiangning, Zuo had asked whether there was anything in which he should intervene, meaning the western military contributions collected through the Shanghai circuit office.

当时如说请他写封信催一催邵友濂，是很正常的回答，左宗棠不会想到别的地方去。
Had Hu then asked him to write and hurry Shao along, it would have been a perfectly natural answer; Zuo would have thought nothing of it.

已经回答没有什么事要他费心，
But Hu had already said that there was nothing he needed to trouble him about.

而结果仍旧要他出面，这等于作了垫不出五十万银子的表示是一样的。
To ask for his intervention now would amount to admitting that he could not advance five hundred thousand taels.

因此，他这样答说：“不必劳动他老人家了，
He therefore replied, “There is no need to trouble His Excellency.

既然各省都快到齐了，我去催他。”
Since almost all the provincial payments have arrived, I shall go and press Shao myself.”


胡雪岩一向沉得住气，这一次因为事多心烦，竟失去了耐性，
Hu had always been able to keep his temper, but this time the strain of too many affairs made him lose patience.

气冲冲地去看邵友濂，门上回答：“邵大人视察制造局去了。”
He went angrily to see Shao, only to be told at the door, “His Excellency has gone to inspect the Manufacturing Bureau.”

吃了个闭门羹，心中越发不快，
This fruitless visit made him still more displeased.

回到制造局命文案师爷写信给邵友濂，
Returning to the Manufacturing Bureau, he ordered his correspondence secretary to write to Shao.

措词很不客气，有点打官腔的味道，而且暗示，邵友濂如果不能如期付款，只好请左宗棠自己来料理了。
The letter was decidedly discourteous, with something of an official’s peremptory tone; it also hinted that, if Shao could not pay on time, Hu would have to ask Zuo himself to deal with the matter.

这封信送到江海关，立即转送邵友濂公馆，
Delivered to Jianghaiguan Customs, it was immediately forwarded to Shao’s residence.

他看了自然有些紧张，
Naturally, it made him uneasy.

因为“不怕官，只怕管”，
As the saying went, “It is not an official you need fear, but the man who has authority over you.”

自太平军被平息后，督抚权柄之重，为清朝开国以来所未有，
Since the suppression of the Taiping armies, provincial governors and governors-general had acquired powers unequalled since the founding of the Qing dynasty.

左宗棠是现任的两江总督，
Zuo was the incumbent Governor-General of Liangjiang.

如果指名严参，再有理也无法申诉，
If he submitted a severe impeachment naming Shao, no argument, however sound, could win Shao a hearing.

而况实际上确也收到了好几省的“西饷”，靳而不予，也是件说不过去的事。
Besides, contributions from several provinces had indeed arrived; withholding them was indefensible.

因此，他很不情愿地作了个决定，将已收到的“西饷”开单送交转运局，
Very reluctantly, he decided to draw up a statement and send the money already received to the Transport Bureau.

为数约四十万两，
It came to about four hundred thousand taels.

胡雪岩只需垫十万银子，便可保住他对洋人的信用。
