“What makes you think it might collapse?”

“人心太坏！”
“People are too wicked!”

话中大有文章，值得打听，但是来不及开口，月如家的一个老妈子赶了来通知，
There was much behind those words, well worth probing, but before Yueru could ask, a serving woman from her own house hurried in.

唐子韶要她赶紧回家。
Tang Zishao wanted her home at once.


“那几张当票呢？”唐子韶问。
“Where are those pawn tickets?” Tang Zishao asked.

月如开了首饰箱，取出一叠当票，唐子韶一张一张细看。
Yueru opened her jewelry box and took out a stack of them, which he examined one by one.

月如虽也认得几个字，但当票上那笔“鬼画符”的草书，只字不识，
She could recognize a few characters, but the wild cursive scrawls on pawn tickets were utterly beyond her.

看他捡出三张摆在一边，便即问说：“是些啥东西？”
When he selected three and laid them aside, she asked, “What are those for?”

原来唐子韶在公济典舞弊的手法，无所不用其极，
Tang had resorted to every conceivable form of fraud at Gongji Pawnshop.

除了在满当货上动手脚以外，另外一种是看满当的日期已到，原主未赎，而当头珍贵，开单子送进府里，
Besides tampering with goods whose redemption periods had expired, he would make lists of particularly valuable unredeemed articles and send them to the Hu residence.

“十二楼”中的姨太太，或许看中了要留下来，便以“挂失”为名，另开一张当票。
If one of the concubines in the Twelve Chambers took a fancy to something and wanted to keep it, a new ticket would be issued on the pretext that the original had been lost.

此外还有原主出卖，或者来路不明，譬如“扒几手”扒来，甚至小偷偷来的当票，以极低的价钱收了下来，都交给月如保管，看情形取赎。
There were also tickets sold by their owners, or acquired from dubious sources—picked from pockets or stolen by thieves—which Tang bought for next to nothing and entrusted to Yueru, to be redeemed when convenient.

这捡出来的三张，便是预备赎取的，
The three he had selected were to be redeemed now.

一张是一枚帽花，极大极纯的一块波斯祖母绿，时价值两千银子，只当了五百两；
One covered a hat ornament: an exceptionally large, flawless Persian emerald worth two thousand taels at current prices, on which only five hundred had been lent.

一张是一副银台面，重六百两，
Another covered a set of silver tableware weighing six hundred taels.

却当不得六百银子，因为回炉要去掉“火耗”，又说它成色不足，再扣去利息，
That did not mean a loan of six hundred taels, for a deduction had to be made for the loss in remelting; its purity was also pronounced deficient, and interest was deducted.

七折八扣下来，六百两银子减掉一半，只当三百两，
After one reduction and another, the six hundred taels of silver had yielded a loan of only three hundred.

可是照样打这么一副，起码要一千银子。
Yet making another set to match it would cost at least a thousand taels.


第三张就更贵重了，是一副钻镯，大钻十二、小钻六十四，
The third article was even more valuable: a pair of diamond bracelets set with twelve large diamonds and sixty-four small ones.

不算镶工，光是金刚钻就值八千两银子，只当得二千两，
Without counting the workmanship, the diamonds alone were worth eight thousand taels, but the loan had been only two thousand.

是从一个小毛贼那里花八两银子买来的，
Tang had bought the ticket from a petty thief for eight taels.

第二天，原主的听差气急败坏来挂失，
The next day the owner’s servant had come rushing in, distraught, to report its loss.

唐子韶亲自接待，说一声：
Tang had attended to him personally.

“实在很对不起，
“I’m terribly sorry.

已经有人来赎走了。”
Someone has already redeemed the goods.”

拿出当票来看，原主都说“不错”，
He had produced the ticket, which the owner’s side acknowledged was indeed the right one.

但问到是什么人来赎的？
But who had redeemed them?

又是一声：“实在对不起，
Again: “I’m terribly sorry.

不晓得。”
I have no idea.”

天下十八省的当铺，规矩是一样的，认票不认人，
Throughout the empire’s eighteen provinces, pawnshops followed the same rule: they recognized the ticket, not the person presenting it.

来人只好垂头丧气去回复主人。
The servant could only return dejectedly to report to his master.

“这三张票子赶紧料理。”唐子韶说，
“Get these three tickets taken care of at once,” Tang now said.

“阜康存了许多公款，
“Fukang holds a great deal of public money.

从钱塘、仁和两县到抚台衙门，都有权来封典当，
Every authority from the Qiantang and Renhe county offices up to the governor’s yamen has grounds to seal the pawnshops.

不赎出来，白白葬送在里面。”
Unless we redeem the goods, we’ll simply lose them.”

“阜康倒了，跟公济典有啥关系？”
“If Fukang fails, what has that to do with Gongji Pawnshop?”

“亏你问得出这种话！
“How can you ask such a question?

只要是胡大先生的产业都可以封。”
Anything belonging to Mr Hu can be seized.”

说完，唐子韶匆匆忙忙地去了。
With that, Tang hurried away.


月如送他到门口，顺便看看热闹。
Yueru saw him to the door and took the opportunity to look at the commotion outside.

她家住在后街，来往的人不多，但前面大街上人声嘈杂，却听得很清楚，
Her house stood in a back street with little traffic, but the clamor from the main street was clearly audible.

其中隐隐有鸣锣喝道之声，
Among the voices she thought she could hear gongs and calls to clear the way.

凝神静听，果然不错，
Listening carefully, she found she was right.

月如想起刚才唐子韶说过的话，不由得一惊，
Tang’s warning came back to her, and she started in alarm.

莫非宫府真的来封阜康钱庄与公济典了？
Could officials really be coming to seal Fukang Bank and Gongji Pawnshop?

她的猜测恰好相反，
The truth was precisely the reverse of her guess.

由杭州府知府吴云陪着来的藩司德馨，不是来封阜康的门，而是劝阜康开门营业。
Provincial Treasurer Dexin, accompanied by Wu Yun, the prefect of Hangzhou, was coming to urge Fukang to reopen, rather than to seal its doors.

原来这天上午，螺蛳太太照谢云青的建议，特地坐轿到藩司衙门去看德藩台的宠妾。
Earlier that morning, following Xie Yunqing’s suggestion, Madam Luosi had gone by sedan chair to the provincial treasurer’s yamen to visit his favorite concubine.

相传这座衙门是南宋权相秦桧的住宅，
The building was said to have been the residence of Qin Hui, the powerful Southern Song chief minister.

又说门前两座石栏围绕的大池，隐藏着藩库的水门，池中所养的大鼋，杭州人称之为“癫头鼋”，便是用来看守藩库水门的，
According to another story, the two great pools enclosed by stone balustrades outside concealed water gates leading to the provincial treasury, guarded by the enormous soft-shelled turtles that Hangzhou people called “scabby-headed turtles.”

这些传说，虽难查证，但“藩司前看癞头鼋”，是杭州城里市井中的一景，却是亘亘数十年不改。
Such legends were difficult to verify, but watching the turtles outside the treasurer’s yamen had been a familiar city pastime for decades.

螺蛳太太每次轿子经过，看池边石栏上，或坐或倚的人群，从未有何感觉，
Normally Madam Luosi paid no attention to the people sitting or leaning against the balustrades as her sedan passed.

这天却似乎觉得那些闲人指指点点，都在说她：“喏，那轿子里坐的就是胡大先生的螺蛳太太。
Today she imagined them pointing and saying, “Look, that’s Mr Hu’s Madam Luosi in the chair.

财神跌倒，变成赤脚，
The God of Wealth has fallen and lost even his shoes.

螺蛳太太也要抛头露面来求人家了。”
Now she has to show herself in public and beg for help.”

这样胡思乱想着，她心里酸酸的，
These imaginings made her heart ache.

突然觉得眼眶发热，赶紧拭去眼泪，强自把心定下来，
Suddenly her eyes grew hot; she hastily wiped away the tears and steadied herself.

自己对自己说：不要紧的！
It would be all right, she told herself.

无论如何自己不可先摆出着急的样子。
Whatever happened, she must not be the first to show alarm.

于是她将平日来了以后的情形回忆了一下，警惕着一切如常，不能有甚异样的态度。
Recalling how she usually behaved on these visits, she resolved to do everything as usual.

由于她那乘轿子格外华丽，更由于她平时出手大方，
Her sedan was unusually splendid, and she had always tipped generously.

所以未进侧门以前，不待执帖家人上前通报，便有德藩台的听差迎了出来，敞开双扉，
Before her card bearer could announce her at the side entrance, one of the treasurer’s attendants came out and opened both doors.

容她的轿子沿着正厅西面的雨道，在花园入口处下轿。
The sedan passed along the covered passage west of the main hall, and she alighted at the garden entrance.


德藩台的宠妾，名叫莲珠，
The treasurer’s favorite concubine was named Lianzhu.

在家行二，她们是换帖姐妹，莲珠比螺狮太太大一岁，
Second-born in her family and a year older than Madam Luosi, she had exchanged sworn-sisterhood pledges with her.

所以称之为二姐，莲珠唤她四妹，
Madam Luosi called her Second Sister; Lianzhu called Madam Luosi Fourth Sister.

出来迎接时，象平时一样，彼此叫应了略作寒暄，
They greeted one another with their usual affectionate names and exchanged a few pleasantries.

但一进屋尚未坐定，莲珠的神情就不一样了。
But once they were inside, even before they had settled into their seats, Lianzhu’s expression changed.

“四妹，”她执着螺蛳太太的手，满腹疑惑地问：“是怎么回事？
“Fourth Sister,” she said, taking Madam Luosi’s hand, “what is happening?

一早听人说，阜康不开门，我说没有的事。
Early this morning I heard Fukang hadn’t opened, and I said it couldn’t be true.

刚刚我们老爷进来，我问起来才知道上海的阜康倒了，这里挤满了人，怕要出事。
Only when the master came in just now and I asked him did I learn that the Shanghai Fukang has failed, and that there are crowds outside the bank here and trouble may break out.

我们老爷只是叹气，我也着急，
He kept sighing, and I’ve been worried too.

到底要紧不要紧？”
How serious is it?”

这一番话说得螺蛳太太心里七上八下，
Her words threw Madam Luosi into fresh confusion.

自己觉得脸上有点发烧，
Her face felt hot.

但力持镇静，不过要想象平时那样有说有笑，却怎么样也办不到了。
She struggled to remain calm, but it was quite impossible to laugh and talk as she normally did.

“怎么不要紧？
“How could it not be serious?

一块金字招牌，擦亮来不容易，要弄脏它很方便。”螺蛳太太慢条斯里地说：
A gilded signboard is hard to polish bright and very easy to soil,” she said slowly.

“怪只怪我们老爷在路上，上海、杭州两不接头。
“The trouble is that our master is still on the road, with neither Shanghai nor Hangzhou able to reach him.

我一个女人家，就抛头露面，哪个来理我？
Even if a woman like me comes out in public, who will listen?

说不得只好来求藩台了。”
I can only ask the treasurer for help.”

“以我们两家的交情，说不上一个求字。”莲珠唤来一个丫头说：
“Between our two families, there’s no question of asking a favor.” Lianzhu called a maid.

“Go to the inner gate and send word to A’fu: as soon as the master has finished receiving visitors, ask him to come in.”


阿福是德馨的贴身跟班，
A’fu was Dexin’s personal valet.

接到中门上传来的消息，便借装水烟袋之便，悄悄在德馨耳际说了一句：“姨太太请。”
On receiving the message from the inner gate, he took the opportunity of filling his master’s water pipe to whisper, “Madam wishes to see you.”

德馨有好几个妾，但不加区别仅称“姨太太”便是指莲珠。
Dexin had several concubines, but “Madam,” without qualification, meant Lianzhu.

心想她有什么要紧事，等不及他回上房吃午饭时谈？
What could be so urgent that she could not wait until he returned to the inner apartments for lunch?

一定是胡家的事。
It must be something to do with the Hus.

这样想着，便对正在会见的一个候补道说：
He turned to the expectant circuit intendant he was receiving.

“你老哥谈的这件案子，兄弟还不十分清楚，
“My dear fellow, I’m not yet entirely familiar with this case.

等我查过了再商量吧！”
Let me look into it, and we can discuss it later.”

接着不由分说，端一端茶碗，
Without allowing an answer, he lifted his teacup.

花厅廊上的听差，便高唱一声：“送客！”
An attendant in the reception-hall corridor immediately called, “See the gentleman out!”

将那候补道硬生生地撵走了。
The expectant intendant was thus summarily dismissed.

看“手本”，还有四客要接见，三个是候补知县。一个是现任海宁州知州，
Four visiting cards remained: three expectant county magistrates and the serving magistrate of Haining Department.

他踌躇了一回，先剔出两个手本，
Dexin hesitated, then singled out two.

自语似他说：“这两位，今天没工夫了。”
“No time for these gentlemen today,” he said, almost to himself.

阿福取手本来一看，其中一个姓刘，送过很大的一个门包，便即说道：
A’fu took the cards and saw that one belonged to a man named Liu, who had given him a substantial gatekeeper’s tip.

“这位刘大老爷是姨太太交代过的。”
“Madam has given instructions about this Mr Liu.”

“交代什么？”
“What instructions?”

“刘大老爷想讨个押运明年渣米的差使。
“He wants the assignment of escorting next year’s grain shipment.

姨太太交代。老爷一定要派。”
Madam said you must appoint him.”

“既然一定要派，就不必见了。”
“If I’m bound to appoint him, there’s no need to see him.”

“那么，怎么样回他？”
“What shall I tell him, then?”

“叫他在家听信好了。”
“To wait at home for word.”

“是。”
“Yes, sir.”

“这一位，”
“As for this one…”

德馨拿起另一份手本，沉吟了一下，用快刀斩乱麻的手法，连海宁州知州的手本，一起往外一推：
Dexin picked up another card, paused, then cut through the difficulty at a stroke: he pushed that card away together with the Haining magistrate’s.

“说我人不舒服，
“Say I’m feeling unwell.

都请他们明天再来。”
Ask them to come back tomorrow.”

He rose, returned to the inner apartments through a side door of the reception hall, and went straight to Lianzhu’s rooms.

螺蛳太太一见急忙起身，裣袄为礼。

德馨跟胡雪岩的交情很厚，私底下管他叫“胡大哥”，对螺蛳太太便叫“罗四姐”，
Dexin was a close friend of Hu Xueyan, whom he privately called Brother Hu; to Madam Luosi he used the familiar Sister Luo.

His first question was, “Sister Luo, when will Xueyan be back?”

“今天下半天。”
“This afternoon.”

“唉！”
“Ah!”

他顿一顿足说：
He stamped his foot.

“就差这么一天工夫。”
“Just one day too late.”

意思是胡雪岩只要昨天到，今天的局面就不会发生。
He meant that if Hu had arrived yesterday, today’s crisis would never have arisen.

螺蛳太太不知道他能用什么办法来解消危机？但愿倾全力相助的心意是很明显的。
Madam Luosi had no idea how he might resolve it, but his willingness to do everything he could was evident.

患难之际，格外容易感受他人的好意，
In adversity, people feel kindness all the more keenly.

于是螺蛳太太再一次裣衽行礼，噙着泪光说道：
With tears glistening in her eyes, she curtsied again.

“藩台这样照应我们胡家，上上下下都感激的。”
“Everyone in our household is grateful for your concern, Treasurer.”

“罗四姐，你别这么说，
“Please don’t say that, Sister Luo.

如今事情出来了，我还不知道使得上力，使不上力呢？”
Now that this has happened, I don’t even know whether I can be of any use.”

“有什么使得上，使不上？”
“What do you mean, whether you can be of use?”

莲珠接口说道：
Lianzhu put in.

“只要你拿出力量来，总归有用的，”
“If you put your authority behind it, it’s bound to help.”

“我当然要拿力量出来。
“Of course I shall.

胡大哥的事，能尽一分力，尽一分力，
Whatever I can do for Brother Hu, I’ll do.

罗四姐，你先请回去，
You go home first, Sister Luo.

我过了瘾，马上请吴知府来商量。”德馨又说：“饭后我亲自去看看，
Once I’ve had my smoke, I’ll send for Prefect Wu and discuss it with him.” He added, “After lunch I’ll go and see for myself.

我想不开门总不是一回事。
Keeping the doors shut can’t be the answer.

不过，事也难说，
Still, it’s difficult to say.

总而言之，一定要想个妥当办法出来。”
In any case, we must find a sound way to handle it.”

有最后一句话，螺蛳太太放心了。
That last sentence reassured Madam Luosi.

“You have so much to do today, Fourth Sister,” Lianzhu said.

我不留你了。”
“I won’t keep you.”

只要他肯到阜康，到底是藩台，总能压得下去的。”
If only he’ll go to Fukang—he is the provincial treasurer, after all—he should be able to keep things under control.”

“Yes, Second Sister.

我现在象‘没脚蟹’一样，
I’m like a crab without legs just now.

全靠你替我作主。”
I’m depending entirely on you to act for me.”

螺蛳太太又放低了声音说，
Madam Luosi lowered her voice still further.

“上次你说我戴的珠花样子好，
“Last time, you admired the design of the pearl ornaments I was wearing.

我叫人另外穿了一副，

明后天送过来。”
I’ll send them over tomorrow or the day after.”

“No, no.

你现在何必还为这种事操心？
Why worry about such things at a time like this?

喔，”
Oh!”

莲珠突然想起，
Lianzhu suddenly remembered.

“喜事呢？”
“What about the wedding?”

“It will have to go ahead as usual, or there’ll be even more rumors outside.

螺蛳太太又说：“人，势利的多，只怕有的客人不会来了。”
People are so worldly—I’m afraid some of the guests may not come.”

“I certainly shall.”

“当然，当然。”
“Of course, of course!”

螺蛳太太怕她误会，急忙说道：
Fearful of being misunderstood, Madam Luosi hurried on.

“我们是自己人。
“We’re our own people.

且不说还没有倒下来，就穷得没饭吃了，二姐还是一样会来的。”
Never mind that we haven’t collapsed yet—even if we were too poor to eat, you’d still come, Second Sister.”

“正是这话。”
“Exactly.

莲珠叮嘱，“胡大先生一回来，你们就送个信来。”
Send us word as soon as Mr Hu gets back.”

“The treasurer will certainly be the first person he visits.”

“对！
“Yes.

哪怕晚上也不要紧。”
Even if it’s late at night, that doesn’t matter.”

“I understand.

螺蛳太太又说：“我看珠花穿好了没有，
I’ll see whether the pearl ornaments are ready.

穿好了叫他带来，二姐好戴。”
If they are, I’ll have him bring them for you to wear.”

The first thing Madam Luosi attended to on reaching home was this gift.

说“叫人另外穿一副”是故意这样说的，
Her claim that she had commissioned another set was deliberate.

螺蛳太太的珠花有好几副，
She owned several sets of pearl ornaments already.

挑一副最莹白的，另外配一只金镶玉的翠镯，立即叫人送了给莲珠。
Choosing the one with the whitest, most lustrous pearls, she added a gold-mounted jadeite bracelet and had both sent to Lianzhu at once.


这份礼真是送在刀口上，
The gift arrived at precisely the critical moment.

原来德馨在旗员中虽有能吏之称，但出身纨垮，最好声色，
Although Dexin had a reputation as an able official among the bannermen, he had been born to privilege and was passionately fond of women and entertainment.

听说胡家办喜事，来了两个“水路班子”——
He had heard that two traveling waterway troupes had come for the Hu wedding.

通都大邑的戏班，都是男角，坤角另成一班，称为“髦儿戏”，
In the great cities, opera companies consisted entirely of male performers; women formed separate companies, known as mao’er troupes.

惟有“水路班子”男女合演，
Only the waterway troupes mixed men and women.

其中有一班叫“福和”，当家的小旦叫灵芝草，色艺双全，
One of these companies, Fuhe, had a leading actress named Lingzhicao, who specialized in young female roles and was celebrated for both her beauty and her art.

德馨听幕友谈过这个坤伶，久思一见，
Dexin had heard his advisers talk of her and had long wanted to see her.

如今到了杭州，岂肯错过机会，
Now that she was in Hangzhou, how could he miss the chance?

已派亲信家人去找班主，看哪一天能把灵芝草接了来，听她清唱。
He had sent a trusted retainer to ask the manager when she could come and sing for him privately.

也就是螺蛳太太辞去不久，德馨正在抽鸦片过痛时，亲信家人来回复，
Shortly after Madam Luosi left, while he was satisfying his craving for opium, the retainer returned.

福和班主，听说藩台“传差”，不敢怠慢，这天下午就会把灵芝草送来，
On hearing that the treasurer had summoned her for official duty, the Fuhe manager had not dared delay: Lingzhicao would be brought that very afternoon.

德馨非常高兴，变更计划，对于处理阜康挤兑这件事，另外作了安排。
Delighted, Dexin changed his plans and made other arrangements for dealing with the run on Fukang.

就这时莲珠到了签押房，
Just then Lianzhu came into his private office.

她是收到了螺蛳太太的一份重礼对阜康的事格外关切，特意来探问究竟。
Madam Luosi’s substantial gift had made her particularly concerned about the bank, and she had come specifically to find out what was happening.

德馨答说：“我已经派人去请吴知府了，
“I’ve already sent for Prefect Wu,” Dexin told her.

等他来了，我会切切实实关照他。”
“When he comes, I’ll give him very thorough instructions.”


“关照他什么？”
“What instructions?”

“关照他亲自去弹压。”
“To go in person and keep order.”

“那么，”莲珠问道：“你呢？
“And you?

你不去了？”
Aren’t you going?”

“有吴知府一个人就行。”
“Prefect Wu will be enough on his own.”

“你有把握，一定能料理得下来？”
“Are you certain he can handle it?”

“这种事谁有把握。”德馨答说：
“Who can be certain about something like this?

“就是我也没有。”
Even I can’t.”

“你是因为没有把握才不去的？”
“Is that why you aren’t going?”

“不是。”
“No.”

“是为什么？”
“Why, then?”

“我懒得动。”
“I can’t be bothered to move.”

“老头子，你叫人寒心！
“Old man, you make my heart turn cold!

胡雪岩是你的朋友，
Hu Xueyan is your friend.

人家有了急难，弄得不好会倾家荡产，你竟说懒得动，连去看一看都不肯。
He’s in desperate trouble and may lose everything he owns, yet you can’t be bothered even to go and see him.

这叫什么朋友？
What sort of friendship is that?

莫非你忘记了，放藩台之前，皇太后召见，
Have you forgotten your audience with the empress dowager before you were appointed provincial treasurer?

如果不是胡雪岩借你一万银子，你两手空空，到了京里，人家会敷衍你，买你的帐？”
If Hu hadn’t lent you ten thousand taels, would anyone in the capital have paid you any attention or shown you consideration when you arrived empty-handed?”

莲珠停了一下，直截了当地说：
Lianzhu paused, then spoke bluntly.

“你如果觉得阜康的事不要紧，有吴知府去了就能料理得下来，你可以躲懒，
“If you think Fukang’s difficulties are minor and Prefect Wu can settle them alone, you may spare yourself the effort.

不然，你就得亲自去一趟，
Otherwise, you must go yourself.

那样，就阜康倒了，你做朋友的力量尽到了，胡雪岩也不会怪你。
Then, even if Fukang fails, you’ll have done your duty as a friend, and Hu Xueyan won’t blame you.

你想呢？”
What do you say?”


德馨正待答话，只听门帘作响，
Dexin was about to answer when the door curtain rustled.

回头看时，阿福兴冲冲奔了进来，脸上挂着兴奋的笑容，
Turning, he saw A’fu hurry in, beaming with excitement.

一见莲珠在立即缩住脚，脸上的笑容也消失了。
The moment the valet saw Lianzhu, he stopped short and his smile vanished.

“什么事？”
“What is it?”

莲珠骂道：
she snapped.

“冒冒失失，鬼头鬼脑，一点规矩都不懂！”
“Barging in, looking so shifty—you haven’t the least idea how to behave!”

阿福不作声，只不住偷看着德馨，德馨却又不住向他使眼色。
A’fu said nothing, merely stealing glances at Dexin, who kept signaling with his eyes.

这种鬼鬼祟祟的模样，落在莲珠眼中，不由得疑云大起，
Their furtiveness aroused Lianzhu’s suspicions.

“A’fu!” she shouted.

“What is it?

快说！”
Speak!”

“是，”
“Yes, madam.”

阿福赔笑说道：
He forced a smile.

“没有什么事。”
“Nothing at all.”

“你还不说实话！”
“Still refusing to tell the truth?”

莲珠向打烟的丫头说道：

“Fetch Steward Zhang!

I’ll have both his wretched legs broken.”

藩台衙门的下人，背后都管莲珠叫“泼辣货”，
Behind her back, the yamen servants called Lianzhu “the firebrand.”

阿福识得厉害，
A’fu knew what she could do.

“Please spare me, madam.

I won’t do it again.”

这回还没有了呢！
We haven’t finished with this time!

说！

Tell the truth and I’ll let you off.”

心想连老爷都怕姨太太，就说了实话，也不算出卖老爷，
Even the master was afraid of her; surely telling the truth could hardly count as betraying him.

Dexin was now giving a succession of warning coughs.

灵芝草，

A man or a woman?”

“A woman.”

“好。

I understand.

You may go.”

阿福磕一个头站起身来，德馨把他叫住了，

这是德馨的享受，
This was a treat for Dexin.

因为莲珠打的烟，“黄、高、松”三字俱全，抽一筒长一回精神。
Lianzhu’s opium fulfilled all three desirable qualities—golden, tall, and loose—and each pipe seemed to give him fresh energy.

但自她将这一手绝技传授了丫头，便不再伺候这个差使，而他人打的烟总不如莲珠来得妙，
Since teaching the maids her special skill, she had ceased performing this service herself, but nobody else did it so well.

因此，她现在自告奋勇，多少已弥补了不能一聆灵芝草清唱之憾。
Her offer now went some way toward compensating him for missing Lingzhicao’s singing.

Without speaking, she concentrated on preparing a pipeful, fitted it to the pipe, drew the handkerchief from beneath her arm, and wiped the ivory mouthpiece.

送到德馨口中，对准了火，拿烟签子替他拨火。
She placed it between Dexin’s lips, held it to the flame, and tended the heat with her opium needle.

德馨吞云吐雾，一口气抽完，
Dexin drew in and exhaled clouds of smoke, finishing the pipe in one continuous effort.

拿起小茶壶便喝，
Then he picked up a small teapot and drank.

茶烫得常人不能上口，但他已经烫惯了，舌头乱卷了一阵，喝了几口，然后拈一粒松子糖放入口中，悠闲地说道：“你有话说吧！”
The tea was too hot for an ordinary person to touch, but he was accustomed to it; after rolling his tongue about, he took several mouthfuls, popped a pine-nut sweet into his mouth, and said at leisure, “Now, what have you to say?”


“我是在想，”莲珠一面打烟一面说：“胡雪岩倒下来，你也不得了！
“I was thinking,” Lianzhu said as she prepared another pipe, “if Hu Xueyan collapses, you’ll be in terrible trouble too.

你倒想，公款有多少存在那里？
Just think how much public money is deposited there.”

““这我不怕，
“That doesn’t worry me.

可以封他的典。”
I can seal his pawnshops.”

“私人的款子呢？”
“And private money?

莲珠问说：“莫非你也封他的典？
Will you seal his pawnshops for that too?

就算能封，人家问起来。你怎么说？”
Even if you can, what will you say when people ask?”

“是啊！”
“Yes…”

德馨吸着气说：
Dexin drew in his breath.

“这话倒很难说。”
“That would be difficult to explain.”

“就算不难说，你还要想想托你的人，愿意不愿意你说破。
“Even if it weren’t, you must consider whether the people who entrusted the money to you want you to reveal it.

象崇侍郎大少爷的那五万银子，
Take the fifty thousand taels belonging to Vice-Minister Chong’s eldest son.

当初托你转存阜康的时候，千叮万嘱，不能让人知道。
When he asked you to deposit it with Fukang for him, he insisted again and again that nobody must know.

你这一说，崇侍郎不要恨你？
Wouldn’t Vice-Minister Chong hate you if you told?”

““这……这……”
“Well…well…”

德馨皱着眉说：
Dexin frowned.

“当初我原不想管的，
“I didn’t want to have anything to do with it at first.

崇侍郎是假道学，做事不近人情，
Chong is a hypocritical moralist, unreasonable in everything he does.

替他办事吃力不讨好，
Working for him is thankless labor.

只为彼此同旗世交，他家老大，对我一向很孝敬，我才管了这桩事。
But we belong to the same Banner, our families are old friends, and his eldest son has always treated me very respectfully, so I agreed.

我要一说破，坏了崇侍郎那块清廉的招牌，他恨我一辈子。”
If I expose the business and ruin Chong’s reputation for incorruptibility, he’ll hate me for the rest of his life.”

“也不光是崇侍郎，
“And it isn’t only Chong.

还有孙都老爷的太太，
There’s Censor Sun’s wife.

她那两万银子是私房钱，
Her twenty thousand taels are her own private savings.

孙都老爷也是额角头上刻了‘清廉’两个字的，
Sun might as well have ‘incorruptible’ engraved on his forehead.

如果大家晓得孙太太有这笔存款，不明白是她娘家带来，压箱底的私房钱，
If people find out his wife has that deposit, they won’t know it came from her own family, the reserve she brought with her in marriage.

只说是孙都老爷‘卖参’的肮脏钱。
They’ll say it’s dirty money he made by selling his power of impeachment.

那一来孙都老爷拿他太太休回娘家，那说在哪里的。
If he then repudiates her and sends her back to her family, how could such a wrong ever be put right?

老头子啊老头子，你常说‘宁拆八座庙，不破一门婚’，
Old man, you’re always saying you’d rather demolish eight temples than break up one marriage.

那一来，你的孽可作得大了！”
What a terrible sin you’d have committed!”


叽哩呱啦一大篇话，说得德馨汗流浃背，
This torrent of words left Dexin drenched in sweat.

连烟都顾不得抽了，坐起身来，要脱丝绵袄。
Forgetting even his opium, he sat up and began to take off his silk-wadded jacket.

“脱不得，要伤风。”莲珠说道：
“Don’t—you’ll catch cold,” Lianzhu said.

“你也别急，
“And don’t panic.

等我慢慢儿说给你听。”
Let me explain things properly.”

“好、好！
“Yes, yes!

我真的要请教你这位女诸葛了！”
I really must seek the advice of my female Zhuge Liang.”

“你先抽了这筒烟再谈。”
“Smoke this pipe first.”

等德馨将这筒烟抽完，莲珠已经盘算好了，
By the time he had finished it, Lianzhu had worked out her plan.

但开出口来，却是谈不相干的事。
Yet she began with something apparently unrelated.

“老头了，你听了一辈子的戏，
“Old man, you’ve listened to opera all your life.

我倒请问，戏班子的规矩，你懂不懂？”
Tell me, do you understand the rules of a troupe?”

“你问这个干什么？”
“Why ask me that?”

“你甭管，
“Never mind why.

你只告诉我懂不懂？”
Just tell me whether you do.”

“当然懂。”
“Of course I do.”

“好，那么我再请问：
“Then let me ask you this.

一个戏班子是邀来的，不管它是出堂会也好，上园子也好，本主儿那里还没有唱过，角儿就不能在别处漏一漏他的玩艺。
When a troupe is invited somewhere, whether to perform at a private celebration or in a theater, its actors mustn’t display their art elsewhere before performing for the original host.

有这个规矩没有？”
Is that the rule?”

“有。”
“Yes.

德馨答说：“不过这个规矩用不上。
But it doesn’t apply here.

如今我是不想再听灵芝草，如果想听，叫她来是‘当差’，
I no longer want to hear Lingzhicao; if I did, summoning her would be calling her to official duty.

戏班子的规矩，难道还能拘束官府吗？”
Can theatrical rules bind the authorities?”

“不错，拘束不着。
“No, they can’t.

可是，老头子，你得想想，俗语说的‘打狗看主人面’，
But remember the saying: before beating a dog, consider its master.

人家三小姐出阁，找福和班来唱戏，
The Hus brought Fuhe here for their Third Miss’s wedding.

贺客还没有尝鲜，你倒先叫人家来唱过了，
Their guests haven’t had the first taste, yet you want the actors to perform for you beforehand.

你不是动用官府力量，扫了胡家的面子？”
Isn’t that using official power to make the Hu family lose face?”


莲珠虽是天津侯家浚的青楼出身，但剖析事理，着实精到，德馨不能不服，当下说道：
Although Lianzhu had come from a brothel in Houjiajun, Tianjin, her analysis was remarkably shrewd, and Dexin could not help conceding her point.

“好在事情已经过去了，
“Fortunately, the matter is over.

不必再提。”
There’s no need to bring it up again.”

“不必再提的事，我何必提。
“Why would I bring it up if there were no need?

我这段话不是废话，
I’m not talking nonsense.

你还听不明白，足见得我说对了。”
The fact that you still don’t understand proves my point.”

“咦！怪了，
“This is strange!

什么地方我没有听明白？”
What haven’t I understood?”

“其中有个道理，你还不明白。
“The principle behind it.

我说这段话的意思是，你不但要顾胡雪岩的交情，眼前你还不能让胡雪岩不痛快。
I mean that you must not only honor your friendship with Hu Xueyan: at this moment, you must also avoid upsetting him.

你得知道，他真的要倒了，就得酌量酌量为人的情分，
If he really is going under, he’ll have to weigh what he owes to people.

他要害人，害那不顾交情，得罪了他的人，
If anyone is to suffer, it will be those who disregarded their friendship and offended him.

如是平常交情厚的人，他反正是个不了之局，何苦‘放着河水不洗船’？
For his close friends, on the other hand—since he can’t settle the whole affair anyway, why leave the river water unused when he could wash a boat with it?

你要懂这个道理，就不在了我那篇废话了。”
If you understood that, you wouldn’t think all I’ve said was idle talk.”

话中有话，意味很深，
There was a great deal beneath her words.

德馨沉吟了好一会说：
Dexin pondered for some time.

“我真的没有想到。
“I truly hadn’t thought of that.

想想你的话是不错，
You’re right.

我犯不上得罪他，
I’ve nothing to gain by offending him.

否则‘临死拉上一个垫背的’，我吃不了，兜着走，
If a dying man drags someone down into the grave with him, I’d be in more trouble than I could bear.

太划不来了。
It wouldn’t be worth it.

来，来，你躺下来，
Come, lie down.

我烧一筒烟请你抽。”
Let me prepare a pipe for you.”

“得了！
“Enough!

我是抽着玩儿的，
I only smoke for amusement.

根本没有痛，你别害我了。”
I have no craving, so don’t ruin me.”

莲珠躺下来，隔着烟盘说道：
Lianzhu lay down across the smoking tray from him.

“阜康你得尽力维持住了，
“Do everything you can to keep Fukang going.

等胡雪岩回来，你跟他好好谈一谈，
When Hu returns, have a proper talk with him.

我想他也不会太瞒你。
I don’t think he’ll conceal too much from you.

等摸清了他的底，再看情形，
Once you know how matters really stand, judge what to do.

能救则救，不能救，你把你经手的款子抽出来，
Save him if you can; if you can’t, withdraw all the funds you handled.

胡雪岩一定照办。
He’ll certainly oblige.

那一来，你不是干干净净，什么关系都没有了。”
Then you’ll be entirely clear, with nothing tying you to the affair.”

“妙啊妙！
“Splendid!

这一着太高了。”
A brilliant move!”

于是两人并头密语，
They put their heads together and whispered.

只见莲珠拿着烟签子不断比划着，德馨不断点头，偶尔也开一两句口，想来是有不明白之处，要请教“女诸葛”。
Lianzhu gestured continually with the opium needle, while Dexin nodded and occasionally spoke a few words, presumably asking his female Zhuge Liang to clarify some point.


阿福又来了，
A’fu returned.

这回是按规矩先咳嗽一声，方始揭帘入内，远远地说道：“回老爷的话，杭州府吴大人来了。”
This time, observing proper etiquette, he coughed before lifting the curtain and announced from a distance, “Prefect Wu of Hangzhou is here, sir.”

“喔，
“Ah.

请在花厅坐，
Ask him to sit in the reception hall.

我马上出来。”
I’ll be out at once.”

“不！”
“No!”

莲珠立即纠正，
Lianzhu corrected him immediately.

“你说老爷在换衣服，请吴大人稍等一等。”
“Say the master is changing and ask Prefect Wu to wait a moment.”

“是。”
“Yes, madam.”

阿福心想换衣服当然是要出门，但不知是便衣还是官服，
Changing clothes meant going out, A’fu thought, but would it be in informal dress or official robes?

便衣只需“传轿”，官服就还要预备“导子”，
The former required only a sedan; the latter required a ceremonial escort as well.

当即问道：“老爷出门，要不要传导子？”
“Will you need the escort called out, sir?”

“要。”
“Yes.”

阿福答应着，自去安排。
A’fu went to make the arrangements.

莲珠便在签押房内亲手伺候德馨换官服，灰鼠出风的袍子，外罩补褂，
In the private office, Lianzhu helped Dexin into his official clothes: a robe with gray squirrel fur showing at its edges, and an outer coat bearing his rank badge.

一串奇南香的朝珠是胡雪岩送的，价值三千银子，
The court beads of fragrant qinan wood, worth three thousand taels, had been a gift from Hu Xueyan.

德馨颇为爱惜，
Dexin treasured them.

当即说道：“这串朝珠就不必挂出去了。”
“There’s no need to wear these beads outside,” he said.

他不知道这是莲珠特意安排的，为了让他记得胡雪岩的好处：
He did not realize Lianzhu had laid them out deliberately to remind him of Hu’s kindness.

这层用意当然不宜说破，
Naturally she could not explain that.

她只说：“香喷喷，到处受欢迎倒不好？
“Isn’t it pleasant to smell so sweet and be welcome everywhere?

而且人堆里，哪怕交冬了，也有汗气，
Besides, crowds smell of sweat even in winter.

正用得着奇南香。”
That’s just where qinan fragrance comes in useful.”

“言之有理。”
“Very reasonable.”

“来，升冠！”
“Come—let me raise your cap!”

莲珠捧着一顶貂檐暖帽，等德馨将头低了下来，她替他将暖帽戴了上去，
Holding a sable-brimmed winter hat, she waited for him to bow his head, then put it on him.

在帽檐上弹了一下，
She flicked the brim.

说道：“弹冠之庆。”
“Dusting off the cap to celebrate promotion!”

接着，莲珠从丫头手里接过一柄腰圆形的手镜，退后两步，将镜子举了起来，
Taking an oval hand mirror from a maid, she stepped back and held it up.

德馨照着将帽子扶正，
Dexin straightened his hat in the glass.

口中说道：“不知道什么时候才能换顶戴？”
“I wonder when I’ll be able to change the finial.”

藩司三品蓝顶子，换顶戴当然是换红顶子，
A provincial treasurer wore the blue finial of the third rank; changing it meant changing to red.

德馨的意思是想升巡抚，
He was thinking of promotion to governor.

莲珠便即答说：“只要左大人赏识你，换顶戴也快得很。”
Lianzhu answered, “Once Lord Zuo appreciates you, you’ll soon have a new finial.”



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第三章（全章）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Three (complete)
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第三章 仗义执言｜CHAPTER THREE: SPEAKING UP FOR JUSTICE


杭州府知府吴云，一名吴世荣，到任才一个多月，对于杭州的情形还不十分熟悉。
Wu Yun, also known as Wu Shirong, had been Prefect of Hangzhou for little more than a month and was not yet thoroughly familiar with local conditions.

德馨邀他一起去为阜康纾困，觉得有几句话，必须先要交代。
Before taking him along to help Fukang out of its difficulties, Dexin felt there were a few things he must explain.

“世荣兄，”他说：“杭州人名为‘杭铁头’，
“Brother Shirong,” he said, “Hangzhou people are known as ‘Iron Heads.’

吃软不吃硬，
They respond to kindness, but not to force.

硬碰的话，会搞得下不了台，
Confront them head-on and you may find yourself in a humiliating position.

以前巡抚、学政常有在杭州吃了亏的事，你总听说过？”
You must have heard how provincial governors and education commissioners have come to grief here?”

“听说过‘万马无声听号令，一牛独坐看文章’。”
“I have heard the story of ‘Ten thousand horses silently await commands; one ox sits alone appraising compositions.’”

吴世荣是听说有一个浙江学政，赋性刻薄，戏侮士子，
Wu had heard of a harsh Zhejiang education commissioner who delighted in humiliating scholars.

孝试时怕彼此交头接耳，通同作弊，下令每人额上贴一张长纸条，一端黏在桌上，
To prevent candidates from whispering together and cheating during an examination, he ordered a long strip of paper pasted to each man’s forehead, with the other end fixed to his desk.

出了个试帖诗题是：“万马无声听号令，得瘏字。”
Then he set a formal examination poem on the line “Ten thousand horses silently await commands,” prescribing the rhyme tu.

这明明是骂人，
This was plainly an insult.

哪知正当他高坐堂室，顾盼自喜时，有人突然拍案说道：“ ‘万马无声听号令’是上联，
While he sat high in the examination hall, looking about him in self-satisfaction, someone suddenly slapped his desk and declared, “‘Ten thousand horses silently await commands’ is the first line of a couplet.

下联叫做‘一牛独坐看文章’。”
The second is ‘One ox sits alone appraising compositions.’”

顿时哄堂大笑，纸条当然都裂断。
The whole hall roared with laughter, and naturally the paper strips all snapped.

那学政才知道自取其辱，只好隐忍不言。
Realising that he had brought the humiliation on himself, the commissioner could only swallow it in silence.


“老兄知道这个故事就好。
“It is just as well that you know the story.

今天请老兄一起去弹压，话是这么说，可不要把弹压二字，看得太认真了。”
I have asked you to come with me today to keep order, but do not take that expression too literally.”

这话便不易明白了，
This was harder to understand.

吴世荣哈着腰说：
Wu bowed slightly.

“请大人指点。”
“I should be grateful for Your Excellency’s guidance.”

“胡雪岩其人在杭州光复之初，对地方上有过大功德。
“When Hangzhou was first recovered, Hu Xueyan did a great deal for the city.

洪杨之役，杭州受灾最重，可是复原得最快，
During the rebellion of Hong and Yang, Hangzhou suffered the worst devastation, yet it recovered the fastest.

这都是胡雪岩之功。”
That was all Hu’s doing.”

“喔，
“Ah.

大人的意思是杭州人对胡雪岩是有感情的。”
You mean that the people of Hangzhou feel warmly towards him.”

“不错。
“Exactly.

妒嫉他的人，只是少数，
Those who envy him are a minority.

还有靠胡雪岩养家活口的人也很多。”
A great many people also depend on him for their living.”

既是靠胡雪岩养家活口，当然站在他这一边，
Anyone whose livelihood depended on Hu would naturally stand by him.

而更要紧的一种关系是，决不愿见胡雪岩的事业倒闭，
More importantly, such people would have no wish to see his businesses fail.

吴世荣恍然有悟，连边点头。
Understanding dawned on Wu, and he nodded repeatedly.

“照此看来，风潮应该不会大。”
“In that case, the disturbance ought not to be very serious.”

德馨认为吴世荣很开窍，便用嘉许的语气说：“世荣兄目光如炬，明察秋毫，
Dexin thought him quick to grasp the point and said approvingly, “Your eyes are like torches, Brother Shirong, discerning the finest autumn down.

兄弟不胜佩服之至。”
My admiration is boundless.”

话中的成语，用得不甚恰当，不过类此情形吴世荣经过不是第一次，
His choice of literary expressions was not particularly apt, but Wu had encountered this sort of thing before.

也听人说过，德馨虽有能员之称，书却读得不多，
He had also heard that, capable an official though Dexin was reputed to be, he had read little.

对属下好卖弄他腹中那“半瓶醋”的墨水，所以有时候不免酸气，
Before his subordinates, he liked to display his half-filled bottle of learning, which occasionally gave his speech a sour, pedantic flavour.

偶尔还加上些戏词，那就是更酸且腐的一股怪味了。
When he added a line or two from the theatre, the mixture became stranger and staler still.


这样转变念头，便觉得无足为奇了，
Remembering this, Wu ceased to find it surprising.

“大人谬奖了。”
“You are too generous, sir.”

他接着问道：“府里跟大人一起去弹压，虽以安抚为主，
He went on, “When I accompany you to keep order, reassurance will of course be our chief purpose.

但如真有不识轻重、意因鼓动风潮的，请大人明示，究以如何处置，方为恰当？”
But if some people fail to understand the gravity of the situation and deliberately stir up trouble, how should they be dealt with?”

“总以逆来顺受为主。”
“Above all, we must accept provocation with good grace.”

“逆”到如何犹可“顺受”，此中应该有个分寸，
There ought to be some limit to how much provocation could be borne.

“请大人明示！”他问：
“Please instruct me, sir.

“倘有人胆敢冲撞，如之奈何？”
What if someone dares to insult or defy us?”

“这冲撞么，”
“As for that…”

德馨沉吟了一会儿说：
Dexin considered for a moment.

“谅他们也不敢！”
“I do not suppose they would dare!”

吴世荣可以忍受他的语言不当，比拟不伦，
Wu could put up with inappropriate language and ill-chosen comparisons.

但对这种滑头话觉得非打破砂锅问到底不可。
Such an evasive answer, however, required him to get to the bottom of the matter.

“如果真有这样的情形呢？”
“But what if it does happen?”

吴世荣也降低了措词雅饰的层次：
He too abandoned some of the refinements of official speech.

“俗语说不怕一万，只怕万一，
“As the saying goes, it is not the ten thousand ordinary cases we fear, but the one exception.

不能不防。”
We must be prepared.”

“万一冲撞，自然是言语上头的事。
“Any offence would naturally be a matter of words.

你我何必跟小民一般见识？
Why should you and I lower ourselves to the level of the common people?

有道是忍得一时气，保得百年身；
Endure a moment’s anger and preserve yourself for a lifetime.

又道是不痴不聋，不作阿家翁。
And they say no man can be a father-in-law unless he knows how to play the fool and turn a deaf ear.

贵府是首府，
Yours is the prefecture of the provincial capital.

就好象我们浙江的一个当家人一样。”
You are, as it were, the head of Zhejiang’s household.”

能做到这样，需要有极大涵养，吴世荣自恐不易办到，
Such forbearance required immense self-control, and Wu doubted his ability to practise it.

但看德馨的意思，非常清楚，一切以平息风潮为主，
Still, Dexin’s intention was clear: everything must serve the restoration of calm.

至于手段，实在不必听他的，
As for the means, Wu need not really follow his advice.

能迁就则迁就，不能迁就，还是得动用权威，只要大事化小，又不失体统，便算圆满。
Yield where he could, use authority where he could not; if a major disturbance could be reduced to a minor one without loss of official dignity, that would be a satisfactory outcome.


他考虑了一下，觉得有一点不能不先说清楚，
After some thought, Wu decided there was one point he must settle in advance.

“回大人的话，为政之道，宽猛相济。
“Sir, government requires a balance of leniency and severity.

不过何人可宽，何人可猛；何时该宽，何时该猛？一点都乱不得。
But we must be quite clear about whom to treat leniently, whom severely, and when each is called for.

照府里来想，今天的局面，大人作主，该猛应猛，交代严办，
As I see today’s situation, Your Excellency should direct proceedings and order stern measures where they are necessary.

府里好比当家的家妇，少不得代下人求情，请从轻发落，
I shall be like the woman managing the household, pleading on behalf of the servants for lighter punishment.

这样一个红脸、一个白脸，这出戏才唱得下来。
One of us plays the stern red face, the other the kindly white face: that is how we can carry the performance through.

“他接着说：”倘或有那泼妇刁民，非临之以威不足以让他们就范，
But suppose there are shrews or unruly fellows whom only a show of force will bring to heel.

那时候府里派人锁拿，大人倒说要把他们放了，这样子府里就不知道该怎么办了。
If I send men to put them in chains and you then order their release, I shall not know how to proceed.”

““不会，不会！”德馨连连说道：
“That will not happen!” Dexin assured him repeatedly.

“我做红脸，你做白脸，
“I shall be the red face and you the white.

你如果做红脸，我决不做白脸，
If you take the red face, I certainly shall not take the white.

总而言之，你当主角我‘扫边’，
In short, you will play the leading role and I the supporting part.

我一定捧着你把这出戏唱下来。”
I shall back you throughout the performance.”

话很客气，但这一回去平息阜康风潮的主要责任，已轻轻套在他头上了。
Courteous though this was, he had lightly slipped the chief responsibility for settling the Fukang disturbance onto Wu’s shoulders.

吴世荣心想，德馨真是个装傻卖乘的老狐狸！
What an old fox, Wu thought, playing the fool to get his own way!


有此承诺吴世荣才比较放心，
With this assurance, Wu felt easier.

于是起身告辞，同时约好，他先回杭州府，摆齐“导子”先到清和坊阜康钱庄前面“伺候”，
He rose to take his leave, agreeing to return to his prefectural office, assemble his ceremonial escort and go first to “await” Dexin outside Fukang in Qinghefang.

德馨随后动身。
Dexin would follow.

两人拟好辰光，先后来到阜康，
They timed their departures and arrived one after the other.

人群恰如潮汐之有“子午潮”，日中甫过，
As a tide has its midnight and midday surges, so the crowd swelled just after noon.

上午来的未见分晓，坚持不去，得到信息的，在家吃罢午饭，纷纷赶到，
Those who had come in the morning still had no answer and refused to leave; others, hearing the news, finished lunch at home and hurried over.

杭州府与仁和、钱塘两县的差役，看看无从措手，都找相熟的店家吃茶歇脚，
The runners from the Hangzhou prefectural office and the counties of Renhe and Qiantang, seeing no way to manage the situation, had gone to familiar shops for tea and a rest.

及至听得鸣锣喝道之声，听说吴知府到了，随后德藩台也要来，自然不能躲懒，
But when gongs and shouted commands announced that Prefect Wu had arrived and Treasurer De was following, they could no longer shirk.

好在经过休息，精神养足，一个个挺胸凸肚，迎风乱挥皮鞭，一阵阵呼呼作响，即时在人潮中开出一条路来。
Refreshed by their rest, they thrust out their chests and bellies and swung their whips through the air with a succession of swishes, clearing a path through the crowd.

清和坊是一条大街，
Qinghefang was a broad street.

逼退人潮，阜康门前空出来一片空地，足容两乘大轿停放。
Once people had been driven back, there was room outside Fukang for two large sedan chairs.

谢云青是已经得到螺蛳太太的通知，官府会出面来料理，
Xie Yunqing had already been informed by Madam Luosi that the authorities would intervene.

所以尽管门外人声如沸，又叫又骂，让人心惊肉跳，他却如老僧入定般，闭目养神，
Terrifying though the shouting and cursing outside might be, he sat with his eyes closed like an old monk in meditation, conserving his strength.

“心里在一层深一层地盘算，官府出面时，会如何安排，阜康应该如何应付。
Beneath that stillness, he was considering, layer upon layer, what the officials might arrange and how Fukang should respond.

等盘算得差不多了，吴世荣也快到了。
By the time he had thought it through, Wu was nearly there.


这要先迎了出去，
Xie had to go out to meet him first.

如果知府上门，卸排门迎接，主顾一拥而入，就会搞得不可收拾，
If the prefect arrived at the door and the shutters were taken down to admit him, the customers would surge in and all control would be lost.

因此，他关照多派伙计，防守边门，然后悄悄溜了出去，
Xie therefore ordered extra employees to guard the side entrance, then slipped out quietly.

一顶毡帽压到眉际，同时装做怕冷，手捂着嘴跟鼻子，
He pulled a felt hat down to his eyebrows and covered his mouth and nose with his hand, as though against the cold.

幸喜没有人识破，
Fortunately, nobody recognised him.

到得导子近前，他拔脚便冲到轿前，轿子当然停住了。
On reaching the ceremonial escort, he suddenly ran forward to the sedan, which naturally came to a halt.

这叫“冲道”，
This was called breaking into an official’s procession.

差役照例先举鞭子护轿，然后另有人上前，看身分处理，
The runners would first raise their whips to protect the chair; someone else would then come forward to determine the intruder’s status and deal with him accordingly.

倘苦是老百姓，可以请准了当街拖翻打屁股。
An ordinary person might, with permission, be thrown down in the street and beaten on the buttocks.

谢云青衣冠楚楚，自然要客气些，
Xie’s respectable clothes earned him more courtesy.

喝问一声：“你是干什么的？”
“What are you doing?” a runner demanded.

谢云青在轿前屈膝打千，
Xie bent one knee in a formal salute before the sedan.

口中说道：“阜康钱庄档手谢云青，向大人请安。”
“Xie Yunqing, manager of Fukang Bank, pays his respects to Your Honour.”

“喔，”
“Oh.

吴世荣在轿中吩咐，“停轿。”
Halt the chair,” Wu ordered from inside.

“停轿”不是将轿子放下地，
This did not mean setting it on the ground.

轿杠仍在轿夫肩上，不过有根带桠杈的枣木棍，撑住了轿杠，其名叫做“打杆子”。
The poles remained on the bearers’ shoulders, but were supported by forked sticks of jujube wood, a practice known as propping the poles.

这时轿帘自然亦已揭起来了，
The curtain was lifted.

吴世荣问道：“你就是谢云青？”
“You are Xie Yunqing?”

“是。”
“Yes, sir.”

“你们东家什么时候回来？”
“When will your employer return?”

“今天晚上，一定可到。”
“He is certain to arrive this evening.”

吴世荣点点头说：
Wu nodded.

“藩台马上也要来，
“The Treasurer will be here shortly.

我跟他在你店家坐一坐，好商量办法。“
He and I shall sit in your bank and discuss what can be done.”


接着，德馨亦已驾到，
Dexin arrived soon afterwards.

仍旧是由谢云青引领着，由边门进入阜康钱庄的客座。
Xie again led the way, taking them through the side entrance into Fukang’s reception room.

这里的陈设非常讲究，广东酸枝木嵌螺甸的家具，四壁是名人书画，上款差不多都是“雪岩观察大人雅属”，
It was furnished with great elegance: Guangdong rosewood inlaid with mother-of-pearl, and distinguished paintings and calligraphy on all four walls, most dedicated “To His Honour Circuit Intendant Xueyan, at his gracious request.”

最触目的是正中高悬一幅淡彩贡宣的中堂，
The most striking piece was a central scroll, hung high, on delicately tinted tribute-quality xuan paper.

行书一首唐诗，字有碗口那么大，下款是“恭亲王书”，
It bore a Tang poem in running script, each character as large as the mouth of a bowl, signed “Written by Prince Gong.”

下铃一方朱文大印，印文“皇六子”三字，
Below the signature was a large seal impression in red lettering, reading “The Emperor’s Sixth Son.”

左右陪衬的一副对联是左宗棠的亲笔。
A couplet in Zuo Zongtang’s own hand hung on either side.

客座很大，也很高，正中开着玻璃天窗，
The room was spacious and high, with a glass skylight in the centre.

时方过午，阳光直射，照出中间一张极大的大理石面的八仙桌，
Just after noon, sunlight fell directly onto a huge square marble-topped table.

桌上摆了八个大号的高脚盘，尽是精巧的茶食，但只有两碗细瓷银托的盖碗茶，自然是为德馨与吴世荣预备的。
Eight large raised dishes held delicate tea snacks; there were only two covered teacups of fine porcelain on silver stands, plainly prepared for Dexin and Wu.

“赶紧收掉！”德馨一进来便指着桌上说：
“Take those away at once!” Dexin said on entering, pointing at the table.

“让人见了不好。”“德大人说得是，”吴世荣深以为然，向谢云青说道：
“It will look bad if people see them.” Wu thoroughly agreed. “His Excellency is right,” he told Xie.

“德大人跟我今天不是来作客的。”
“We have not come as guests today.”

“是，是。”
“Yes, of course.”

谢云青指挥伙计，收去了高脚盘，请贵客落座，他自己站在两人之间，等候问话。
Xie had the raised dishes removed, invited the visitors to sit and remained standing between them, awaiting their questions.


“不开门，总不是一回事。”德馨问吴世荣：
“Keeping the doors closed will never do,” Dexin said to Wu.

“我看应该照常营业。”
“I think business ought to continue as usual.”

此言一出，晨世荣无以为答，谢云青更是一脸的苦恼。
Wu had no answer, and Xie looked thoroughly distressed.

能够“照常营业”，为何不下排门？
If they could conduct business as usual, why had they not taken down the shutters?

这话是真正的废话。
The remark was utterly pointless.

德馨也发觉自己的话不通，便又补了一句：“不过，应该有个限制。”
Dexin realised this himself and added, “There should, however, be a limit.”

这才象话，
That made more sense.

吴世荣接口说道：
Wu took it up.

“我看怎么限制，
“We must consider what limit to impose.

阜康总不至于库空如洗吧？”
Surely Fukang’s vault is not entirely empty?”

“不错，
“Exactly.

限制要看阜康的库存而定。”德馨问道：“你们库里有多少现银？”
The limit must depend on the reserve.” Dexin asked Xie, “How much silver have you in the vault?”

库存有四十余万，但谢云青不敢说实话，
There were over four hundred thousand taels, but Xie dared not tell the truth.

打一个对折答道：
He halved the amount.

“二十万出头。”
“A little over two hundred thousand.”

“有二十万现银，很可以挡一阵子。”
“Two hundred thousand in silver should hold things off for a while.

德馨又问：“胡观察的事业很多，
Circuit Intendant Hu has many businesses.

他处总还可以接济吧？”
Surely the others can help?”

“回大人的话，我们东家的事业虽多，我只管钱庄，
“Sir, our employer does have many businesses, but I manage only the bank.

别处的情形不大清楚。”
I am not very familiar with the others’ affairs.”

“别处银钱的收解，当然是跟阜康往来，
“Their receipts and payments must pass through Fukang.

你怎么会不清楚？”吴世荣说，语气微有斥责的意味。
How can you be unfamiliar with them?” Wu asked with a note of reproof.

“回大人的话，”谢云青急忙解释，“我之不清楚是，不清楚别处有多少现银，
Xie hurried to explain. “What I do not know, sir, is how much ready silver they have.

不过就有也有限的，
In any case, it can only be a limited amount.

象间壁公济典，存银至多万把两，
Gongji Pawnshop next door, for example, holds at most ten thousand taels or so.

有大笔用途，都是临时到阜康来支。”
Whenever it needs a large sum, it draws it from Fukang at the time.”


“那么，”德馨问道：“你们开出去多少票子，总有帐吧？”
“Then,” Dexin asked, “you must have records of the notes you have issued?”

“当然，当然！
“Certainly, certainly!

哪里好没有帐！”
How could we not?”

“好！
“Good.

我问你，你们开出去的票子，一万两以下的有多少？”
What is the total value of your notes for ten thousand taels or less?”

“这要看帐。”
“I must consult the accounts.”

谢云青告个罪，在旁边的椅子上坐下，叫伙计取帐薄来，
With an apology, Xie sat in a nearby chair and called for the ledgers.

一把算盘打得飞快，
His fingers flew over an abacus.

算好了来回报，“一共三十三万挂零。”
When he had finished, he reported, “A little over three hundred and thirty thousand taels in all.”

“并不多嘛！”
“That is not very much!”

“大人，”谢云青说：“本号开出去的票子虽不多，可是别处地方就不知道了。
“Sir, the notes we have issued here are not so very many, but I cannot say what there may be elsewhere.

譬如上海阜康开出去的票子，我们一样也有照兑的，”
For instance, we also honour notes issued by Shanghai Fukang.”

“啊，啊！”
“Ah!”

德馨恍然大悟，
Dexin suddenly understood.

“难就难在这里。”
“That is where the difficulty lies.”

这一来只好将限制提高。
The restriction would have to be tighter.

尽管德馨与吴世荣都希望五千两以下的银票，能够照兑，但谢云青却认为没有把握，
Dexin and Wu both hoped that notes for five thousand taels or less could be redeemed as usual, but Xie was not confident.

如果限额放宽，以致存银兑罄，
If the limit was too generous, the reserve might be exhausted.

第二次宣布停兑，那一来后果更为严重。
A second announcement that redemption had stopped would have even more serious consequences.

这是硬碰硬的毫无假借的事，
This was a hard, practical matter that allowed no compromise.

最后还是照谢云青的要求，限额放低到一千两。
In the end, they accepted Xie’s demand and lowered the limit to one thousand taels.

接下来便要研究一千两以上银票的处理办法。
They then had to consider what to do about notes above that amount.


“我们东家一定有办法的。”谢云青说：
“Our employer is sure to find a solution,” Xie said.

“阜康钱庄并没有倒，
“Fukang has not failed.

只为受市面的影响，一时周转不灵而已。”
It is only suffering a temporary shortage of funds because of market conditions.”

德馨想了一下说：
Dexin considered this.

“也不能说胡观察一回来，一切都会恢复正常，
“We cannot say that everything will return to normal the moment Circuit Intendant Hu arrives.

总也给他一个期限来筹划。
He must be given some time to make arrangements.

这个期限不宜太长，但也不宜太短，
Not too long, but not too short either.

三天如何？”
How about three days?”

吴世荣认为适宜，谢云青亦无意见，
Wu thought that suitable, and Xie had no objection.

就算决定了。
The decision was made.

但这个决定如何传达给客户，却颇费斟酌，
How to convey it to the customers, however, required careful thought.

因为持有一千两以上银票的，都是大户，
Those holding notes for more than a thousand taels were substantial clients.

倘若鼓噪不服，该怎么办？
What if they protested and refused to accept the arrangement?

必得预先想好应付之计，否则风潮马上就会爆发。
They must prepare their response, or a disturbance would break out at once.

“这要先疏通。”吴世荣说：
“We must first win people over,” Wu said.

“今天聚集在前面的，其中总有体面绅士，
“There must be some respectable gentlemen among the crowd outside.

把他们邀进来，请大人当面开导，托他们带头劝导。
Let us invite them in, ask Your Excellency to reason with them personally, and have them take the lead in persuading the others.

同时出一张红告示，说明办法，
At the same time, we can post a red proclamation explaining the arrangements.

这样双管齐下，比较妥当。”
That combined approach would be safer.”

“此计甚好！”
“An excellent stratagem!”

德馨点点头说：
Dexin nodded.

“不过体面绅士要借重，遇事失风的小人也不可不安抚，
“But while we enlist respectable gentlemen, we must also pacify the troublemakers who seize on every disturbance.

你我分头进行。”
You and I should divide the work.”

于是，谢云青派了两个能干的伙计，悄悄到左右邻居，
Xie sent two capable employees quietly into the neighbouring shops on either side.

借他们的楼窗，细看人潮中，有哪些人需要请进来谈的。
From their upper windows, they could examine the crowd and identify people who should be invited in.

要请进来的人，一共分三类，第一类是“体面绅士”，第二类是惯于起哄的“歪秀才”，第三类是素不安分“撩鬼儿”，——凡是不务正业，游手好闲，唯恐天下不乱，好从中浑水摸鱼，迹近地痞无赖的人，杭州人称之为“撩鬼儿”。
There were three categories: respectable gentlemen; troublesome scholars accustomed to stirring up a crowd; and the habitually unruly fellows whom Hangzhou people called liaoguier—idlers who did no honest work and welcomed disorder as a chance to fish in troubled waters, men little different from local ruffians.


当这两名伙计分头出发时，德馨与吴世荣已经商定，由杭州府出面贴红告示，
As the two employees set out separately, Dexin and Wu agreed that the red proclamation should be issued by the Hangzhou prefectural office.

这种告示，照例用六言体，
Such notices were conventionally written in lines of six characters.

吴世荣是带了户房当办来的，就在阜康帐户拟稿呈阅。告示上写的是：“照得阜康钱庄，信誉素来卓著，联号遍设南北，调度绰绰有余，只为时世不靖，银根难得宽裕，周转一时不灵，
Wu had brought a clerk from the revenue section, who drafted it in Fukang’s accounts room for their approval: “Whereas Fukang Bank has long enjoyed a distinguished reputation, with affiliated establishments throughout north and south and ample means of transferring funds, present disorders alone have tightened the supply of silver and caused a temporary difficulty in meeting payments.

无须张皇失措，
There is no need for alarm.

兹奉宪台德谕：市面必求平静，小民升头应顾，
By instruction of His Excellency Treasurer De: the marketplace must remain tranquil, and the livelihoods of ordinary people must be considered.

阜康照常开门，银票亦可兑付，
Fukang shall open as usual and its notes shall be redeemable.

千两以下十足，逾千另作区处，
Those for a thousand taels or less shall be paid in full; those exceeding a thousand shall be dealt with separately.

阜康主人回杭，自能应付裕如，
When the proprietor returns to Hangzhou, he will be able to meet his obligations with ease.

为期不过三日，难关即可度过，
Within no more than three days, the difficulty can be overcome.

切望共体时艰，和衷共济应变，
All are earnestly requested to recognise the hardships of the time and cooperate in meeting this emergency.

倘有不法小人，希冀浑水摸鱼，或者危言惑众，或者暗中煽动，一经拿获审实，国法不贷尔汝。
Should lawless persons seek to profit from confusion, spread alarming falsehoods or secretly incite disturbance, once apprehended and found guilty they shall receive no indulgence from the law.

本府苦口婆心，
This prefecture counsels you earnestly and patiently.

莫谓言之不须！
Let none say that he was not warned.

切切此谕。”
Take heed and obey.”


德馨与吴世荣对这通六言告示的评价不同，
The two officials differed in their judgement of this six-character proclamation.

德馨认为写得极好，但有两点要改，一是提存与兑银相同，皆以一千两为限，二是银很大紧，到处都一样，不独沪杭为然。
Dexin thought it excellent, but wanted two amendments: withdrawals of deposits should be subject to the same thousand-tael limit as the redemption of notes, and it should state that money was tight everywhere, not only in Shanghai and Hangzhou.

但吴世荣一开头就有意见，
Wu, however, objected from the outset.

说阜康信誉卓著，说胡雪岩一回来，必能应付裕如之类的话，不无过甚其词，有意袒护之嫌，
To praise Fukang’s reputation and declare that Hu could meet every obligation as soon as he returned seemed exaggerated and unduly protective.

倘或阜康真的倒闭了，出告示的人难免扶同欺骗之咎，
If Fukang really failed, those who issued the notice might be held responsible for assisting a fraud.

因而主张重拟，要拟得切实，有什么说什么，才是负责的态度。
He wanted it redrafted to state only what was known; that was the responsible course.

“世荣兄！此言差矣！”德馨答说：
“Brother Shirong, you are mistaken!” Dexin replied.

“如今最要紧是稳定民心。
“What matters most now is restoring confidence.

不说阜康信誉卓著，难道说它摇摇欲坠？
If we do not say Fukang’s reputation is excellent, are we to say it is tottering?

那一来不等于明告杭州百姓，赶紧来提存兑现？
Would that not tell every person in Hangzhou to hurry and withdraw deposits or redeem notes?

而且正好授人以柄。
Worse, it would put a weapon into other people’s hands.

如果阜康真的挤倒了，胡观察会说：本来不过一时周转不灵，只为杭州府出了一张告示，才起的风潮。
If the run really brought Fukang down, Hu could say, ‘It was merely a temporary shortage of funds until the prefectural office issued its proclamation and started the panic.’

那时候，请问你我有何话说？”
What answer could you or I make then?”

吴世荣无以为答，
Wu had none.

只勉强答说：“府里总觉得满话难说，
He could only say reluctantly, “I still feel that sweeping assurances are dangerous.

将来替人受过犯不着。“
There is no reason to take the blame for someone else later.”


“现在还谈不到个人犯得着，犯不着这一层。
“This is no time to consider whether you or I should take a personal risk.

如今最要紧的是把局面稳下来。
We must stabilise the situation.

胡雪岩号称‘财神’，
Hu is known as the God of Wealth.

‘财神’落难，不是好事，会搞成一路哭的凄惨景象。
If the God of Wealth falls into distress, the consequences will be dreadful—lamentation everywhere.

世荣兄，你要想想后果。”
Think of that, Brother Shirong.”

“是。”
“Yes, sir.”

吴世荣越发没话说了，而德馨却更振振有词。
Wu had still less to say, while Dexin grew more emphatic.

“就事论事，说阜康‘信誉素来卓著’，并没有错，
“On the facts alone, it is not wrong to say Fukang ‘has long enjoyed a distinguished reputation.’

他的信用不好，会大半个天下都有他的联号？
Could it have affiliated banks across more than half the country without good credit?

所以要救阜康，一定要说胡雪岩有办法。
To save Fukang, we must insist that Hu has a solution.

老实说，阜康不怕银栗兑现，只伯大户提存，
Frankly, note redemption is not the real danger; withdrawals by large depositors are.

如果把大户稳住了，心里就会想，款子存在阜康，白天生利息，晚上睡觉也在生利息，
Keep them calm and they will reflect that money in Fukang earns interest by day and even while they sleep.

何必提了现银，摆在家里？
Why bring silver home?

不但大钱不会生小钱，而且惹得小偷强盗眼红，
It would earn nothing and attract the envy of thieves and robbers.

还有慢藏海盗之忧。
Carelessly kept wealth invites theft.

世荣兄，你说我这话是不是？
Am I not right?”

““是！是！”
“Indeed, indeed!”

吴世荣完全为他说服了，尤其是想到“慢藏海盗”这一点，
Wu was completely persuaded, especially by that last consideration.

出了盗案，巡抚、按察使以下至地方官，都有责任，
When a robbery occurred, everyone from the provincial governor and judicial commissioner down to the local officials bore responsibility.

唯有藩司不管刑名，可以置身事外。
Only the provincial treasurer, who did not handle criminal matters, could stand apart.

照此看来，德馨的警告，实在是忠告。
Seen in that light, Dexin’s warning was friendly advice.


于是传言告示定稿，
Orders were therefore given to finalise the proclamation.

谢云青叫人买来上等梅行纸，找了一个好书手，用碗口大的字，正楷书写。
Xie sent out for fine-quality paper and found a skilled copyist, who wrote it in regular script with characters as large as the mouth of a bowl.

告示本应用印，但大印未曾携来，送回衙门去铃盖，又嫌费时，
The official seal should have been affixed, but it had not been brought along, and sending the notice back to the office would waste time.

只好变通办法，由吴世荣在他自己的衔名之下，画了个花押，证明确是杭州府的告示。
Wu improvised by putting his personal flourish beneath his own name and title, certifying that this was indeed a proclamation of the Hangzhou prefectural office.

其时奉命去邀客的两个伙计，相继回店复命，却是无功而返，
Meanwhile, the two employees sent to invite people in returned one after the other, empty-handed.

只为没有适当的人可邀，
They had found nobody suitable.

倒是有自告奋勇，愿意来见藩台及知府的，但争先恐后，请这个不请那个，反而要得罪人，
Some people had volunteered to meet the Treasurer and prefect, but they competed so eagerly that to invite one and not another would only give offence.

只好推托去请示了再说。
The employees could merely say they must ask for instructions first.

从他们的话中听得出来，挤兑的人群中，并没有什么有地位的绅士，足以号召大众，
Their report made it clear that there was no gentleman of standing in the crowd who could command the others’ attention.

而争先恐后想来见官府的，都是无名小卒。
Those clamouring to see the officials were all nobodies.

既然如此，无足为虑。
There was therefore little to fear.

德馨想了一下，看着吴世荣跟谢云青问道：
After a moment’s thought, Dexin looked at Wu and Xie.

“有没有口才好的人？
“Is there anyone who speaks well?

声音要宏亮，口齿要清楚，见过大场面，能沉得住气的。”
He must have a strong voice, clear diction, experience of large gatherings and the ability to keep his head.”

吴世荣尚未开口，谢云青却一叠连声他说：“有，有，
Before Wu could reply, Xie said eagerly, “Yes, sir!

就是大人衙门里的周书办。”
Clerk Zhou from your own office.”

“周书办。”德馨问道：“是周少棠不是？”
“Do you mean Zhou Shaotang?”

“是，是！就是他。”
“Yes, precisely.”

“不错，此人很行。
“An able man.

他怎么会在这里？”
What is he doing here?”

“他跟我们东家是早年的朋友，
“He is an old friend of our employer’s.

今天听说阜康有事，特为来帮忙的。
When he heard of the trouble today, he came specially to help.”


其实，此人是谢云青特为请来的。
In fact, Xie had specially sent for him.

原来各省藩司衙门，都“有包办上下忙钱粮的书办，
Every provincial treasury office had clerks who handled the two seasonal collections of land tax.

俗称”粮书“，公文上往往称此辈为”蠹吏“，
They were popularly known as grain-tax clerks, and official documents often called them corrupt vermin.

所谓”钱粮“就是田赋，为国家主要的收入，其中弊端百出，最清廉能干的地方大吏，亦无法彻底整顿，
Land tax was the state’s principal source of revenue, yet the system contained so many abuses that even the most honest and capable provincial authorities could not thoroughly reform it.

所以称之为“粮糊涂”。
Hence its reputation as an unfathomable muddle.

但是这些“蠹吏”另有一本极清楚的底册，
These “vermin,” however, possessed another set of perfectly clear underlying registers.

这本底册，便是极大的财源，亦只有在藩司衙门注册有案的粮书，才能获得这种底册。
Those registers were a source of immense wealth, accessible only to grain-tax clerks officially registered at the provincial treasury.

粮书是世袭的职务，父死子继，兄终弟及以外，
The posts were hereditary: sons succeeded fathers and younger brothers succeeded elder brothers.

亦可以顶名转让，
They could also be transferred to buyers who took over the registered name.

买这样一个书办底缺，看他所管的县分而定，
The price depended on the county concerned.

象杭州府的仁和、钱塘两县的粮书，顶费要十几万银子，就是苦瘠山城，亦非两三万两莫办。
A post for Renhe or Qiantang, in Hangzhou prefecture, cost over a hundred thousand taels; even a poor mountain county required twenty or thirty thousand.

这周少棠原是胡雪岩的贫贱之交，
Zhou had known Hu in the days when both were poor.

后来靠胡雪岩的资助，花了五万银子买了个专管嘉兴府嘉眷县的粮书，
With Hu’s financial support, he had later paid fifty thousand taels for the grain-tax clerkship responsible for Jiashan County in Jiaxing prefecture.

只有上下忙开征钱粮的时候，才到嘉善，
He went to Jiashan only for the two seasonal collections.

平时只在省城里专事结交，
The rest of the time he stayed in the provincial capital, devoting himself to making connections.

生得一表人才，能言善道。谢云青跟他很熟，
Good-looking and eloquent, he was well known to Xie.

这天因为阜康挤兑，怕应付不下来，特为请了他来帮忙，
Fearing that he could not cope with the run on Fukang, Xie had invited him to help.

这时候正好派上用场了。
Now his talents would come into use.


当时将周少棠找了来，
Zhou was summoned.

向德馨及吴世荣分别行了礼，然后满面赔笑的肃立一旁，听候发落。
After paying his respects to Dexin and Wu in turn, he stood deferentially to one side with a broad, obliging smile, awaiting their commands.

“周书办，我同吴知府为了维持市面，不能不出头来管阜康的事。
“Clerk Zhou, Prefect Wu and I must intervene in Fukang’s affairs to preserve order in the marketplace.

现在有张告示在这里，
Here is a proclamation.

你看了就知道我们的苦心了。”
Once you read it, you will understand our intentions.”

“是，是！
“Indeed, indeed!

两位大人为我们杭州百姓尽心尽力，
You are sparing no effort for the people of Hangzhou.

真正感激不尽。
We cannot thank you enough.

胡大先生跟两位大人，论公是同事，论私是朋友，
Mr Hu is your colleague in public affairs and your friend in private.

他不在杭州，就全靠两位大人替他作主了。”
While he is away, he must rely entirely on you to act for him.”

“我们虽可以替他作主，也要靠大家顾全大局才好。
“We can act for him, but everyone must also consider the larger situation.

说老实话，胡观察是倒不下来的，
Frankly, Circuit Intendant Hu is not going to fail.

万一真的倒下来了，杭州的市面大受影响，亦非杭州人之福。
If he did, it would seriously damage trade throughout Hangzhou and bring the people no good.

我请你把这番意思，切切实实跟大家说一说。“
I want you to explain this to them thoroughly.”


周少棠答应着，往后退了几步，向站在客座进口处的谢云青，使了个眼色，
Zhou agreed, stepped back a few paces and caught Xie’s eye at the entrance.

相偕到了柜房，阜康几个重要的伙计，以及拟六言告示的户房书办都在。
They went together to the accounts room, where several senior employees and the revenue clerk who had drafted the proclamation were waiting.

周少棠一进门就说：“老卜，你这支笔真刮刮叫！”说着，大拇指举得老高。
“Bu, your pen is truly formidable!” Zhou exclaimed, raising his thumb.

“老卜是叫户房书办，他们身分相同，走得极近，
The revenue clerk he called Bu was his equal in rank and a close acquaintance.

平时玩笑开惯的，
They often joked together.

当下老卜答说：”我的一支笔不及你的一张嘴，
“My pen is no match for your tongue,” Bu replied.

现在要看你的了。
“Now it is your turn.”

““你不要看我的笑话！
“Do not just wait to laugh at me.

倒替我想想看，这桩事情，要从哪里下手？”
Help me work out how to begin.”

“要一上来就有噱头，一噱把大家吸住了，
“You need a trick at the outset to seize everyone’s attention.

才会静下来听你吹。”老卜说道：
Then they will quieten down and listen to your bluster.

“我教你个法子，你不是会唱‘徽调儿’？
Here is an idea: you can sing Hui opera, can you not?

搬一张八仙桌出去，你在上面一站，
Put a square table outside and stand on it.

象‘徐策跑城’一样，捞起皮袍子下摆，唱它一段‘垛板’，
Hitch up your fur robe like Xu Ce in Xu Ce Runs Along the City Wall and give them a rapid-fire passage.

包你一个满堂彩。
I guarantee a round of applause.

这一来，什么都了说了。”
After that, you can say anything.”

明明是开玩笑，周少棠却不当它笑话，
This was plainly a joke, but Zhou did not treat it as one.

双眼望着空中，眼珠乱转乱眨了一阵，
He looked into the air, his eyes darting and blinking.

开口说道：“我有办法了，
Then he said, “I have it.

要做它一篇偏锋文章。
We must approach this from an unexpected angle.

来，老谢，你叫人搭张八仙桌出去。”
Xie, have a square table carried outside.”

“怎么？”老卜笑道：
“What?” Bu laughed.

“真的要唱‘徐策跑城’？
“Are you really going to perform Xu Ce Runs Along the City Wall?

一张桌子跑圆场跑不转，
You cannot make a proper circuit on one table.

要不要多搭一张桌子？”
Shall we put out another?”


“你懂个屁！”
“You know bugger-all!”

周少堂转脸对谢云青说：
Zhou turned to Xie.

“这开门去贴告示，就有学问，
“Opening the doors to post that proclamation takes some thought.

没有预备，门一开，人一挤，马上天下大乱。
Without preparation, the moment they open, the crowd will rush in and all hell will break loose.

现在这样，你叫他们从旁门搭一张桌子出去，贴紧排门，
Have the table taken through the side door and placed right against the shutters.

再把桌子后面的一扇排门卸下来。
Then remove the shutter behind it.

这一来前面有桌子挡住，人就进不来了。”
The table will block the entrance and keep people out.”

“你呢？”
“And you?”

老卜接口，
Bu interposed.

“你从桌子后面爬出去？”
“You crawl out from behind the table?”

“什么爬出去？
“Not out.

我是从桌子后面爬上去。”
Up onto it.”

“好！好！”
“Excellent!”

谢云青原就在为一开门，人潮汹涌，秩序难以维持发愁，
Xie had been worrying about just this problem: how to control the crowd once the doors opened.

所以一听这话，大为高兴，立即派人照办。
Delighted, he immediately ordered the arrangement made.


等桌子一抬出去，外面鼓噪之声稍微安静了些，
As soon as the table appeared, the uproar outside subsided a little.

及至里面排门一卸，先出去两名差役，接着递出红告示去。
When the shutter behind it was taken down, two runners went out first, followed by the red proclamation.

大家争先恐后往前挤，大呼小叫，鼓噪之声变本加厉了。
Everyone tried to push forward at once, shouting and calling more loudly than before.

“不要挤，
“Do not push!

不要挤！”
Do not push!”

周少棠急忙跳上桌子，高举双手，大声说道：“杭州府吴大人的告示，
Zhou hurriedly climbed onto the table, raised both hands and called out, “A proclamation from Prefect Wu of Hangzhou!

我来念。”
I shall read it.”

接着他指挥那两名差役，将红告示高高举了起来，
He directed the runners to hold it high.

他就用唱“徽调”念韵白似地，“照得”云云，有板有眼地念了起来。
Then, like an actor delivering rhythmic speech in Hui opera, he began, “Whereas…” and read the notice in measured cadences.

念完又大声喝道：“大家不要乱动！”
When he finished, he suddenly shouted, “Nobody move!”

他这蓦地里一喝，由于量大声宏，气势惊人，别有一股慑入的力量，居然不少人想探手入怀的，手在中途停了下来。
His voice was so powerful and commanding that many people whose hands were reaching inside their clothes stopped halfway.

“为啥叫大家不要乱动？
“Why do I tell you not to move?

扒儿手就在你旁边！
Because there may be a pickpocket beside you!

你来不及想摸银票来兑现，哪晓得银票摆在哪里，已经告诉扒儿手了。
In your hurry to get out your banknote and redeem it, you show him exactly where you keep it.

铜钱是你的总归是你的，
Your money is yours.

阜康的银票，就是现银，
A Fukang note is as good as silver.

今天不兑，明天兑，明天不兑后天兑，分文不少，哪天都一样。
Redeem it today, tomorrow or the day after: not a fraction will be missing, whichever day you come.

不过人家阜康认票不认人，
But Fukang honours the note, not the person.

你的银票叫扒儿手摸了去，朝我哭都没有用。“
If a pickpocket takes yours, crying to me will do you no good!”


夹枪带棒一顿排摈，反而将人声压了下去，
His mixture of warning and mockery actually quietened the crowd.

但人丛中却有人放天嗓子说道：“周少棠，你是唱‘徽调儿’，还是卖梨膏糖？”
Then someone bawled, “Zhou Shaotang, are you singing Hui opera or selling pear-syrup sweets?”

此言一出，人丛中颇有笑声。
Laughter rippled through the gathering.

原来周少棠早年卖过梨膏糖，这一行照例以唱小调来招揽顾客，触景生情，即兴编词，开开无伤大雅的玩笑，
Zhou had once sold pear-syrup sweets, a trade in which sellers attracted customers by singing popular tunes, improvising verses about whatever they saw and making harmless jokes.

不但要一条极好的嗓子，而且要有一点捷才，
It demanded not only a fine voice but a quick wit.

周少棠随机应变的本事，便是在卖梨膏糖那两年练出来的。
His two years in that trade had taught him to think on his feet.

尽管人讪笑，他却神态自若，游目四顾，趁此机会动动脑筋。
He remained unruffled by the laughter, looking about while he used the pause to think.

等笑声停住，他大声说道：“黄八麻子，你不要挖我的痛疮疤！
When it stopped, he called, “Huang Bamazi, do not reopen my old sores!

我周少棠，今天一下唱徽调儿，二不卖梨膏糖，
Today I am neither singing Hui opera nor selling sweets.

是来为大家打抱不平的。”
I am here to speak up against injustice on everyone’s behalf.”

最后这句话，又引起窃窃私议，但很快地复归于平静，
This brought another murmur, which quickly died away.

那黄八麻子又开口了。
Huang, the pockmarked man, spoke again.

“周少棠，你为哪个打抱不平？”
“Whose injustice are you speaking up against?”

“我为大家打！”周少棠应声而答。
“Everyone’s!”

“打哪个？”
“And who are you taking on?”

“打洋鬼子！”他说：
“The foreign devils!” Zhou declared.

“洋鬼子看我们中国好欺侮，
“They think China is easy to bully.

娘卖×的法国人，在安南打不过刘永福，弄两只灯笼壳的铁甲火轮船，在吴淤口外晃啊晃。
Those bloody French bastards cannot beat Liu Yongfu in Annam, so they bring a couple of ironclad steamships, flimsy as paper lanterns, to hover outside the Wusong.

上海人都是不中用的‘铲头’，自己吓自己，弄得市面大乱，
The useless fools in Shanghai frighten themselves into a panic and throw the whole market into disorder.

连带金字招牌的阜康都罩不住。
Even Fukang’s golden reputation cannot withstand it.

说来说去，是法国人害人！
When all is said and done, the French are to blame!

不过，法国人总算还是真小人，
But at least they are open villains.

另外杀人不见血，还有比法国更加毒的洋鬼子。”
There are other foreign devils more poisonous still, who kill without spilling blood.”

说到这里，他故意停下来，看看反应，
He paused deliberately to judge the response.

只听一片“哪一国，哪一国”发问的声音。
Voices called from every side, “Which country? Which country?”

“要问哪一国，喏，
“You want to know?

青竹蛇儿口，黄蜂尾上针，两样都不毒，最毒英国人。”
The green snake’s mouth, the wasp’s sharp sting—neither is as poisonous as the British!”


对这两句话，大家报以沉默。
The crowd greeted these words with silence.

此一反应不大好，因为广济医院的梅藤更，颇获杭州人的好感，而此人是英国人。
This was not a favourable reaction: Mei Tenggeng of Guangji Hospital was well liked in Hangzhou, and he was British.

“你们只看见梅藤更，”周少棠把大家心里的疙瘩抓了出来，
“You are thinking only of Mei Tenggeng,” Zhou said, putting his finger on their objection.

“梅藤更是医生，医家有割股之心，
“He is a doctor, with a physician’s readiness to cut flesh from his own thigh to save another.

自然是好的。
Naturally, he is a good man.

另外呢？
But what of the others?

第一个是赫德，
Take Hart first.

我们中国的海关，归他一把抓，好比我们的咽喉给他卡住了！”
He has all our Chinese customs in his grip, as though he were holding us by the throat.”

说着他伸手张开虎口，比在自己脖子上作个扼喉的姿势，
Zhou spread the thumb and fingers of one hand and held them against his own neck in a gesture of strangulation.

“他手松一松，中国人就多吃两口饭，紧一紧就要饿肚皮！
“If he loosens his hand, we Chinese get a few more mouthfuls of rice; if he tightens it, we go hungry.

这个娘卖×的赫德，他只要中国人吃‘黑饭’，不要中国人吃白饭。”
That bastard Hart wants the Chinese to eat only ‘black food,’ never white rice!”

说到这里，恰好有个涕泗横流的后生，极力往外挤，
Just then, a young fellow with tears and mucus streaming down his face forced his way towards the edge of the crowd.

引起小小的骚动，给了周少棠一个借题发挥的机会。
The small commotion gave Zhou something else to exploit.

“你看你，你看你！”他指着那后生说：
Pointing at him, he cried, “Look at you!

“年纪轻轻不学好，吃乌烟！
So young, and already taking to bad ways—smoking opium!

瘾头一来，就是这副鬼相。
See what a creature it makes of him when the craving comes!

不过，“他提高了声音，”也不要怪他，
But,” he raised his voice, “do not blame him.

要怪杀人不见血的英国人！
Blame the British, who kill without spilling blood!

没有英国人，今天阜康没有事。
Without the British, nothing would be wrong with Fukang today.”

““周少棠，你不要乱开黄腔，
“Zhou, stop that ‘yellow talk’—spouting nonsense!

旱康显原形，跟英国人啥相千？
What have the British to do with Fukang showing its true colours?

屙不出屎怪茅坑，
You cannot shit, so you blame the privy.

真正气数。”
Infuriating!”

责问的是黄八麻子，词锋犀利。
The challenge came from Huang Bamazi, and it was sharp.

周少棠不慌不忙地答道：“你说我开黄腔，我又不姓黄。”
Zhou replied calmly, “You accuse me of ‘yellow talk,’ but my surname is not Huang—Yellow!”


话一出口，立刻引起一阵爆笑，
The retort brought a burst of laughter.

还有拍手顿足，乐不可支的。
Some people clapped and stamped their feet in delight.

这又给周少棠一个机会，
This gave Zhou another opening.

等笑声咯停，大声向黄八麻子挑战。
When the laughter eased, he challenged Huang loudly.

“黄八麻子，你说屙不出屎怪茅坑，
“You say a man who cannot shit blames the privy.

是要怪茅坑不好，
Well, sometimes the privy is to blame.

你敢不敢同我辩一辩？”
Dare you argue it out with me?”

“别人怕你的歪理十八条，
“Other people may fear your eighteen varieties of crooked reasoning.

我姓黄的石骨铁硬的杭铁头，
I am a Hangzhou Iron Head, bone of stone and iron.

偏要戳穿你的西洋镜。”
I shall expose your tricks!”

“你是杭铁头，
“You are an Iron Head?

莫非我是苏空头？
Do you take me for a Suzhou Empty Head?

放马过来！”
Come on, then!”

大家一看有好戏看了，自动让出一条路来，容黄八麻子挤到前面，
Anticipating a good show, the crowd made way for Huang.

便有人喊：“上去！上去！”更有人将他抬了起来。
“Up you go!” people shouted, and some lifted him onto the table.

周少棠很有风度，伸手拉了他一把，自己偏到一边，腾出地方来让他对立。
Zhou, with great courtesy, gave him a hand and moved aside to make room for him to stand opposite.

经此鼓舞的黄八麻子，信心更足了，
Encouraged, Huang grew still more confident.

“周少棠，我辩不过你输一桌酒席。”他问：
“Zhou, if I cannot beat you in argument, I shall pay for a banquet.

“你输了呢？”
What if you lose?”

“我输了，一桌酒席以外，当场给大家磕头赔不是。”
“I shall pay for a banquet too, and kowtow here and now to everyone in apology.”

“好！
“Good.

你问我答，我问你答，
You ask, I answer; I ask, you answer.

答不出来算输。
Whoever cannot answer loses.

你先问。”
You ask first.”

周少棠本就想先发问，如下围棋的取得“先手”，
Zhou had wanted the first question, just as a player seeks the initiative at go.

所以一听黄八麻子的话，正中下怀，
The offer suited him perfectly.

当即拱拱手说：
He clasped his hands.

“承让，承让！”
“You are too kind!”

“不必客气，
“No need for courtesy.

放马过来。”
Come on!”

黄八麻子，人高马大，
Huang was a tall, imposing fellow.

又站在东面，偏西的阳光，照得他麻子粒粒发亮，
Standing on the eastern side of the table, he faced the declining western sun, which lit up every pockmark.

只见他叉手仰脸，颇有睥睨一世的气概。
With his arms folded and chin raised, he looked as though he scorned the whole world.


“请问，现在有一种新式缫丝的机器，你晓得不晓得？”
“Tell me, do you know about the new silk-reeling machines?”

“晓得。”黄八麻子看都不看地回答。
“I do,” Huang answered without even looking at him.

“这种机器，一部好当一百部纺车用，你晓得不晓得？”
“Do you know that one machine can do the work of a hundred spinning wheels?”

“晓得。”
“I do.”

“既然一部机器，好当一百部纺车用，那么，算他每家有五部纺车，
“Then suppose each household has five spinning wheels.

二五得十，加十倍变一百，
Twice five makes ten; multiply by ten and you have a hundred.

就有二十家人家的纺车没用处了，
That means twenty households’ wheels become useless.

这一点你晓得不晓得？”
Do you understand that?”

“晓得。”
“I do.”

“二十家的纺车没有用处，就是二十家人家没饭吃。
“Twenty households with useless wheels means twenty households with nothing to eat.

这一点，你当然也晓得。”周少棠加了一句：“是不是？
You understand that too, of course.” Zhou added, “Do you not?

黄八麻子请你说。”
Please answer, Huang Bamazi.”

“这有啥好说的？”
“What is there to answer?”

黄八麻子手指着周少棠说：
Huang pointed at him.

“这件事同阜康要上排门，有啥关系？
“What has any of this to do with Fukang putting up its shutters?

你把脑筋放清楚来，不要乱扯。”
Keep your head clear and stop wandering off the subject.”

“你说我乱扯就乱扯，
“Call it wandering if you like.

扯到后来，你才晓得来龙去脉，原来在此！
Once I reach the end, you will understand how it all connects.

那时候已经晚了，一桌酒席输掉了。”
But by then it will be too late: you will have lost your banquet.”

“哼哼！”黄八麻子冷说，
“Hmph!” Huang sneered.

“倒要看看是我输酒席，还是你朝大家磕头。”
“We shall see whether I lose a banquet or you kowtow to everyone.”


“好！
“Very well!

言归正传。”周少棠问：
Back to the point,” Zhou said.

“虽然是机器，也要有茧子才做得出丝，
“Even a machine needs cocoons before it can make silk.

是不是？”
Correct?”

“这还用你说！”
“That goes without saying!”

“那么，没有茧子，他的机器就没有用了，这也是用不着说的。
“Then it is equally obvious that, without cocoons, the machine is useless.

现在，我再要问你一件事，他们的机器是哪里来的？”
Now another question: where do these machines come from?”

“当然是外洋来的。”
“Abroad, naturally.”

“是哪个从外洋运来的？”
“Who brought them here?”

“我不晓得，
“I do not know.

只有请教你‘万宝全书缺只角’的周少棠了。”
I must ask you, Zhou Shaotang, the encyclopaedia with one corner missing.”

“这一点，倒不在我‘缺’的那只‘角’里面，
“That happens not to be in my missing corner.

我告诉你，怡和洋行，
I shall tell you: Jardine Matheson.

大班是英国人。”
Its chief is British.”

周少棠这时变了方式，面朝大众演说：
Zhou now changed his method and addressed the crowd.

“英国人的机器好，就是嘴巴大，
“The British machines are good, but they have huge mouths.

一部机器要吃掉我们中国人二十家做给人家的饭。
One machine swallows the rice that feeds twenty Chinese households.

大家倒想，有啥办法对付？
Think about it: what can we do?

只有一个办法，
There is only one answer.

根本叫他的机器饿肚皮。
Starve their machines from the outset.

怎么饿法，
How?

不卖茧子给他。”
Sell them no cocoons!”

这时台底下有些骚动了，
A stir ran through the audience.

“嗡嗡”的声音出现在好几处地方，
Buzzing conversations broke out in several places.

显然是被周少棠点醒了，有些摸到胡雪岩的苦衷了。
Evidently, Zhou had opened their eyes, and some were beginning to understand Hu’s difficulties.


这样的情况不能继续下去，
He could not let that continue.

否则凝聚起来的注意力一分散，他的话就说不下去了，
Once the attention he had gathered dispersed, he would be unable to go on.

因此找到一个熟人，指名发问。
Spotting an acquaintance, he called on him by name.

“喂，小阿毛，
“Xiao A’mao!

你是做机坊的，你娘是‘湖丝阿奶’，
You work at the looms, and your mother is a ‘husi granny.’

你倒说说看！”
Tell us what you know!”

在家络丝，论件计酬，贴补家用的妇女，杭州人称之为“湖丝阿奶”，
In Hangzhou, women who wound silk at home, paid by the piece to supplement the household income, were called husi grannies.

小阿毛父子都是织造衙门的织工，
Xiao A’mao and his father were both weavers employed by the Imperial Weaving Office.

一家人的生计都与丝有关，对于新式缫丝厂的情况相当清楚，
The whole family depended on silk and knew a good deal about the new reeling factories.

当即答说：“我娘先没有‘生活’做，
He answered at once, “My mother had no work before.

现在又有了。”
Now she has some again.”

“是啥辰光没有‘生活’做？”
“When did she lose her work?”

“上海洋机厂一开工，就没有了。”
“When the foreign machine factory in Shanghai began operating.”

“现在为啥又有了呢？”
“Why has she work again now?”

“因为洋机厂停工。”
“Because the foreign factory has stopped.”

“洋机厂为啥停工？”
“Why did it stop?”

“我不晓得。”
“I do not know.”

“你晓不晓得？”
“Do you know?”

周少棠转脸问黄八麻子，但不等他回答，自己说了出来，
Zhou turned to Huang, but answered his own question before Huang could reply.

“是因为不卖茧子给它。”
“Because nobody will sell it cocoons.

然后又问：“养蚕人家不卖茧子，吃什么？
But if the silkworm rearers do not sell their cocoons, how are they to eat?

茧子一定要卖，
The cocoons must be sold.

不卖给洋鬼子，总要有人来买？
If not to the foreign devils, someone else has to buy them.

你说，这是哪一个？
Who is it?”

“黄八麻子知道而不肯说，一说就要输，
Huang knew, but would not say: to answer would be to lose.

所以硬着头皮答道：
He brazened it out.

“哪个晓得？”
“Who knows?”

“你不晓得我告诉你！喏！”
“If you do not, I shall tell you!”

周少棠半转回身子，指着“阜康钱庄”闪闪生光的金字招牌说：
Zhou half-turned and pointed at the shining gold characters of Fukang’s sign.

“就是这里的胡大先生，”
“Mr Hu, of this very bank!”


“周少棠，你又要捧‘财神’的卵泡了！”
“Zhou, you are cradling the God of Wealth’s balls again!”

黄八麻子展开反击，
Huang counterattacked.

“胡大先生囤的是丝，茧子没有多少，
“Mr Hu is hoarding silk, not many cocoons.

事情没有弄清楚，牛皮吹得哗打打，
You have not got your facts straight, yet you boast away as though a drum were beating.

这里又没有人买你的梨膏糖。”
Nobody here is buying your pear-syrup sweets!”

“我的梨膏糖消痰化气。
“My sweets clear phlegm and soothe ill temper.

你倒想想看，那时节，只要你晚上出去赌铜钱到天亮不回来，你娘就要来买我的梨膏糖吃了。”
Think back: whenever you went out gambling and stayed away till dawn, your mother used to come and buy some from me.”

这是周少棠无中生有，编出来的一套话，
This was a complete invention.

气得黄八麻子顿足敦指地骂：
Furious, Huang stamped his feet and jabbed his finger at Zhou.

“姓周的，你真不要脸，乱说八道，
“You shameless liar!

哪个不晓得我姓黄的从来不赌铜钱的！”
Who does not know that I never gamble?”

这时人丛中已有笑声了，周少棠却故意开玩笑说：
Laughter had already begun in the crowd, but Zhou deliberately pressed the joke.

“你晚上出去，一夜不回家，不是去赌铜钱，那就一定去逛‘私门头’。
“If you stayed out all night and were not gambling, you must have been visiting a private brothel.

这一来，你老婆都要来买我的梨膏糖了。”
Then your wife would need my sweets too.”

台下哄然。
The audience roared.

黄八麻子咬牙切齿却无可奈何。周少棠仍是一副惫懒的神情，
Huang ground his teeth, helpless, while Zhou remained cheerfully shameless.

相形之下，越发惹笑。
The contrast made it funnier still.

“你不要生气！”周少棠笑道：
“Do not be angry!” Zhou laughed.

“大家笑一笑就是消痰化气。
“A good laugh clears everyone’s phlegm and temper.

老弟兄寻寻开心，
We are old acquaintances having a little fun.

犯不着认真；
No need to take it seriously.

等一息，我请你吃‘皇饭儿’。
I shall treat you at Huangfan’er shortly.

现在，”他正一正脸色：“我们话说回头。”
Now,” he resumed a serious expression, “let us return to the matter in hand.”


接下来，周少棠又诉诸群众了，
Zhou appealed to the crowd again.

他将胡雪岩囤丝，说成是为了维护养蚕做丝人家的利益，与洋商斗法。
He presented Hu’s hoarding of silk as a struggle against the foreign merchants to protect the interests of those who reared silkworms and produced silk.

他说，洋商本来打算设新式缫丝厂，低价收买茧子，产丝直接运销西洋，
The foreigners, he said, had intended to set up modern reeling factories, buy cocoons cheaply and ship the silk straight to the West.

“中国人只有辛辛苦苦养蚕，
“The Chinese would do all the hard work of raising the silkworms.

等‘蚕宝宝上山，结成茧子，以后，所有的好处，都归洋鬼子独吞了！”
Once the little creatures climbed onto their frames and spun their cocoons, every bit of profit would be swallowed by the foreign devils!”

他转脸问黄八麻子：“你们说，洋鬼子的心肠狠不狠？
Turning to Huang, he asked, “Are they not ruthless?

你有啥话好帮他们说？”
What can you possibly say in their defence?”

这句话惹火了他的对手，
This enraged his opponent.

“周少棠，你不要含血喷人，
“Do not slander me, Zhou!

我哪里帮洋鬼子说过好话？
When have I ever spoken up for foreign devils?

只有你，捧‘财神’的卵泡！”
You are the one cradling the God of Wealth’s balls!”

黄八麻子指着他说：
He pointed at Zhou.

“你有本事，说出阜康收了人家的存款，可以赖掉不付的道理来，我佩服你。”
“If you can explain why Fukang is entitled to take people’s deposits and then refuse to pay them back, I shall admire you.”

“黄八麻子，你又乱开黄腔了！
“There you go with your ‘yellow talk’ again!

你睁开眼睛看看红告示，
Open your eyes and read the red proclamation.

我们杭州府的父母官说点啥，
What does our parent-official, the Prefect of Hangzhou, say?

藩台大人又说点啥？
What does His Excellency the Treasurer say?

胡大先生手里有五万包丝，
Mr Hu holds fifty thousand bales of silk.

一包四百两，一共两千万，
At four hundred taels a bale, that is twenty million.

你听清楚，两千万两银了，
Listen carefully: twenty million taels!

五十两一个的大元宝，要四十万个，
In fifty-tael ingots, that would be four hundred thousand ingots.

为啥要赖客户的存款。“
Why would he refuse to repay his depositors?”


“不赖，那么照付啊！”
“If he is not refusing, let him pay!”

黄八麻子从怀中取出一叠银票在空中扬一扬说：
Huang pulled a wad of banknotes from inside his clothes and waved them in the air.

“你们看，
“Look!

阜康的银票，
Fukang notes!

马上要‘擦屁股，嫌罪过’了。”
Soon they will hardly be fit to wipe your arse with.”

他这一着，变成无理取闹，有些泼妇的行径了。
He was now becoming unreasonable, behaving almost like a quarrelsome shrew.

周少棠不慌不忙地将手一伸：
Zhou calmly held out his hand.

“你的银票借我看看！
“Let me see your notes.

你放心，
Do not worry.

当了这么多人，我不会骗你、抢你的。”
In front of all these people, I shall neither cheat you nor rob you.”

这一下，黄八麻子知道要落下风了，
Huang knew he was losing ground.

想了一下硬着头皮将银票交了过去，
After a moment’s thought, he steeled himself and handed them over.

“一共五张，两千六百多两银子，
“Five notes, over two thousand six hundred taels altogether.

看你付不付，”
Let us see whether you will pay.”

他心里在想，周少棠绷在情面上，一定会如数照付，
He thought Zhou, caught by the need to save face, would surely have them paid in full.

虽然嘴上吃了亏，但得了实惠，还是划算的。
He might lose the verbal contest, but the practical gain would make it worthwhile.

“周少棠不理他的话，接过银票来计算了一下，朝后面喊道：“兑一千四百四十两银子出来！
Ignoring this challenge, Zhou counted the notes and called over his shoulder, “Bring out one thousand four hundred and forty taels!

听到没有？”
Did you hear?”

谢云青精神抖擞地高声答应：“听到。”
“I heard!” Xie replied loudly, full of vigour.

“对不起！
“I am sorry,” Zhou told Huang.

现在兑不兑不是阜康的事情了，
