“Whether these notes can be redeemed is no longer Fukang’s decision.

藩台同杭州府两位大人在阜康坐镇，
The Treasurer and the prefect are here in person.

出告示一千两以下照付，一千两以上等旱康老板回来，自会理清楚，
Their proclamation says that notes for a thousand taels or less will be paid; anything above that must wait for Fukang’s owner to return and settle matters.

大人先生的话，我们只有照听不误。”
We can only obey Their Honours.”

他捡出一张银票递了回去，
He selected one note and handed it back.

“这张一千二百两的，请你暂时收回，等胡大先生回来再兑，
“Please keep this one for twelve hundred taels until Mr Hu returns.

其余四张，一共一千四百四十两，
The other four come to one thousand four hundred and forty.

赌，
Look!

来了！”
Here it is!”


阜康的伙计抬上来一个箩筐，将银子堆了起来，二十八个人元宝，堆成三列，另外四个十两头的元丝。
Fukang’s employees carried out a wicker basket and piled up the silver: twenty-eight large ingots in three rows, with four smaller ingots of ten taels each.

都是刚出炉的“足纹”，白光闪闪，耀眼生花。
All were freshly cast silver of full standard purity, dazzlingly white.

“先生，”谢云青在方桌后面，探身出来，很客气他说：“请你点点数。”
Leaning out from behind the square table, Xie said very politely, “Sir, please check the amount.”

“数是不要点了，
“There is no need.

一目了然。
It is plain at a glance.

不过，”
But…”

黄八麻子大感为难，
Huang was in difficulty.

“我怎么拿呢？”
“How am I to carry it?”

“照规矩，应该送到府上。
“Normally, we ought to deliver it to your house.

不过，今天兑银票的人多，实在抽不出人。
Today, however, so many people are redeeming notes that we really cannot spare anyone.

真正对不住，真正对不住！
We are most sorry, most sorry!”

“说着，谢云青连连拱手。
Xie repeatedly clasped his hands in apology.

“好了，好了！”人丛中有人大喊：
Someone in the crowd shouted, “That is enough!

“兑了银子的好走了，
If you have your silver, move along!

前客让后客！
Let the next customer come forward.

大家都有分。
There is enough for everyone!”

“这一催促提醒了好些原有急用、要提现银的人。
This reminded others that they needed ready money for urgent purposes.

热闹看够了，希望阜康赶紧卸排门开始兑银，
They had seen enough entertainment and wanted Fukang to take down the shutters and begin paying out.

所以亦都不耐烦地鼓噪，
Their impatient clamour grew.

黄八麻子无可奈何，愤愤地向周少棠说：“算你这张卖梨膏糖的嘴厉害！
With no alternative, Huang said angrily to Zhou, “I admit that sweet-seller’s tongue of yours is formidable!

银子我也不兑了，
I shall not take the silver.

银票还我！”
Give me back my notes!”

“对不起，对不起！”谢云青赔笑说道：
“We are very sorry,” Xie said with an apologetic smile.

“等明天稍为闲一闲，要用多少现银，我派‘出店，送到府上。
“When things are a little quieter tomorrow, I shall send our outside clerk to your house with whatever silver you need.

暗，这里是原票，
Here are your original notes.

请收好了。”
Please put them away safely.”


“八哥，
“Brother Eight!

八哥！”
Brother Eight!”

周少棠跳下桌，来扶黄八麻子，
Zhou jumped down and helped Huang off the table.

“多亏你捧场。
“Thank you for helping the performance along.

等下‘皇饭儿’你一定要赏我个面子。”
You must do me the honour of coming to Huangfan’er later.”

周少棠耍了一套把戏。黄八麻子展示了一个实例，
Zhou had played a neat trick, and Huang had supplied a practical demonstration.

即便是提一千两银子，亦须有所准备，
Even withdrawing a thousand taels required preparation.

一千两银子五十五斤多，
A thousand taels of silver weighed more than fifty-five jin.

要个麻袋，起码还要两个人来挑，银子分量重，一个人是提不动的。
One needed a sack and at least two men to carry it; the weight was too much for one man to lift.

这一来，极大部分的人都散去了，
Most of the crowd now dispersed.

也没有人对只准提一千两这个限额，表示异议，但却有人要求保证以后如数照兑，
Nobody objected to the thousand-tael limit, though some wanted an assurance that they would eventually be paid in full.

既不必立笔据，无非一句空话，谢云青乐得满口答应。
Since no written undertaking was required, it amounted to no more than words, and Xie readily promised everything.

不过要兑现银的小户，比平常是要多得多，
There were nevertheless far more small customers seeking silver than usual.

谢云青认为应该做得大方些，当场宣布，延时营业，直到主顾散光为止，
Feeling that the bank should act generously, he announced on the spot that business would continue until the last customer had left.

又去租来两盏煤气灯，预备破天荒地做个夜市。
He also rented two gas lamps, preparing to open at night for the first time.

偌大一场风波，如此轻易应付过去，德馨非常满意。
Dexin was thoroughly satisfied that so great a disturbance had been handled with such ease.

周少棠自然成了“英雄“，上上下下无不夸奖。
Zhou naturally became the “hero,” praised by everyone from top to bottom.

不过大家也都知道，风潮只是暂时平息，”
Yet all knew that the crisis had only been quietened for the moment.

重头戏“在后面，只待”主角“胡雪岩一回来便要登场了。
The main act was still to come, waiting for its leading player, Hu Xueyan, to return and take the stage.



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第四章（上）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Four, Part One
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第四章 夜访藩司｜CHAPTER FOUR: A NIGHT VISIT TO THE PROVINCIAL TREASURER


胡雪岩船到望仙桥，恰正是周少棠舌战黄八麻子，在大开玩笑的时候，
When Hu Xueyan’s boat reached Wangxian Bridge, Zhou Shaotang was in the midst of his verbal battle with Huang Bamazi, making jokes at his opponent’s expense.

螺蛳太太午前便派了亲信，沿运河往北迎了上去，在一处关卡上静候胡雪岩船到，遇船报告消息。
Before noon, Madam Luosi had sent a trusted man north along the canal to wait at a checkpoint and report the news as soon as Hu’s boat arrived.

这个亲信便是乌先生。
That man was Mr Wu.

他在胡家的身分很特殊，即非“师爷”，更非“管事”，但受胡雪岸或螺蛳太太的委托，常有临时的差使。
His position in the Hu household was unusual: he was neither a secretary nor a steward, but Hu or Madam Luosi often entrusted him with particular errands.

这个人当螺蛳太太与胡雪岩之间的“密使”，自然是最适当的人选。
No one could have been better suited to serve as their confidential messenger.

“大先生，”，他说：“起暴风了。”
“Sir,” he said, “a violent storm has broken.”

不说起风波，却说“起暴风”，
He had said a violent storm, not merely a disturbance.

胡雪岩的心一沉，但表面不露声色，
Hu’s heart sank, but his face betrayed nothing.

只说：“你特为赶了来，当然出事了。
“Since you have come all this way, something must have happened.

什么事？
Tell me what it is.

慢慢说。”
Take your time.”

“你在路上，莫非没有听到上海的消息？”
“Have you heard nothing of the news from Shanghai on your journey?”

等乌先生将由谢云青转到螺蛳太太手里的电报，拿了出来，
Mr Wu produced the telegram that Xie Yunqing had passed to Madam Luosi.

胡雪岩一看色变，不过他矫情镇物的功夫过人，
Hu changed colour as he read it, but his ability to command his expression and steady others was exceptional.

立即恢复常态，只问：“杭州城里都晓得了？”
He recovered at once and asked only, “Does everyone in Hangzhou know?”

“当然。”
“Of course.”

“这样说，杭州，亦会挤兑？”
“Then there will be a run here too?”

“罗四姐特为要我来，就是谈这件事……”
“That is exactly why Sister Luo sent me…”

乌先生遂将谢云青深夜报信，决定卑康暂停营业，以及螺蛳太太亲访德馨求援，德馨已答应设法维持的经过，细说了一遍。
Mr Wu gave a full account of Xie’s visit late at night, the decision to suspend business at Fukang, Madam Luosi’s personal appeal to Dexin, and the treasurer’s promise to do what he could to keep matters under control.


胡雪岩静静听完，
Hu listened quietly to the end.

第一句话便问：“老太太晓得不晓得？”
His first question was, “Does the old lady know?”

“当然是瞒牢的。”
“Naturally, it has been kept from her.”

“好！”
“Good!”

胡雪岩放心了，
Hu felt relieved.

“事情已经出来了，
“What has happened has happened.

着急也没有用。
Worrying is no use.

顶要紧的是，自己不要乱。
Above all, we must not lose our heads.

乌先生，喜事照常办，不过，我恐怕没有工夫来多管，
Mr Wu, the wedding is to go ahead as usual, but I am afraid I shall have little time to attend to it.

请你多帮一帮罗四姐。”
Please give Sister Luo all the help you can.”

“我晓得。”
“I understand.”

乌先生突然想起：
Mr Wu suddenly remembered something.

“罗四姐说，大先生最好不要在望仙桥上岸。”
“Sister Luo says it would be better if you did not go ashore at Wangxian Bridge.”

胡雪岩上船下船，一向在介乎元宝街与清河坊之间的望仙桥，
Hu invariably boarded or left his boat there, between Yuanbao Street and Qinghefang.

螺蛳太太怕惹人注目，所以有此劝告。但胡雪岩的想法不同。
Madam Luosi had made the suggestion because she feared attracting attention, but he thought differently.

“既然一切照常，我当然还是在望仙桥上岸。”胡雪岩又问：
“If everything is to proceed as usual, I must go ashore at Wangxian Bridge as usual.

“罗四姐原来要我在啥地方上岸？”
Where did she intend me to land?”

“万安桥。
“At Wan’an Bridge.

轿子等在那里。”乌先生答说：
Your sedan chair is waiting there,” Mr Wu replied.

“这样子，我在万安桥上岸，关照轿子仍旧到望仙桥去接。”
“In that case, I shall get off there and tell the bearers to go on to Wangxian Bridge to meet you.”


胡雪岩的一乘绿呢大轿，华丽是出了名的，
Hu’s large green-cloth sedan chair was famous for its splendour.

抬到望仙桥，虽然已经暮色四合，但一停下来，自有人注目。
Though dusk had fallen by the time it reached Wangxian Bridge, its arrival inevitably drew attention.

加以乌先生了解胡雪岩的用意，关照来接轿的家人，照旧摆出排场，
Understanding Hu’s purpose, Mr Wu told the household men to make their usual display.

身穿簇新棉“号褂子”的护勇，码头上一站，点起官衔灯笼，
Guards in brand-new padded livery took their places on the landing and lit the lanterns bearing his official titles.

顿时吸引了一大批看热闹的行人。
A large crowd of passers-by soon gathered to watch.

见此光景，胡雪岩改了主意。
At this sight, Hu changed his mind.

往时一回杭州，都是先回家看娘，
Whenever he returned to Hangzhou, he normally went home first to see his mother.

这一次怕老娘万一得知沪杭两处钱庄挤兑，急出病来，更加不放心。
Now he was all the more anxious to do so, fearing that news of the runs on the Shanghai and Hangzhou banks might have reached her and made her ill.

但看到这么多人在注视他的行踪，心里不免设身处地想一想，
But with so many people watching his movements, he could not help putting himself in their place.

如果自己是阜康的客户，又会作何想法？
What would he think if he were a Fukang customer?

只要一抛开自己，胡雪岩第一个念头便是：不能先回家！
The moment he set himself aside, his first thought was that he must not go home first.

多少人的血汗钱托付给卓康，
So many people had entrusted their hard-earned money to Fukang.

如今有不保之势，而阜康的老板居然好整以暇地光顾自己家里，不顾别人死活，
Now it was in danger, yet the owner was calmly attending to his own household, regardless of what happened to anyone else.

这口气是咽不下的。
Who could swallow that?

因此船一靠岸，他先就询问：“云青来了没有？”
As soon as the boat touched the bank, he asked, “Has Yunqing come?”

谢云青何能不来？
How could Xie have stayed away?

不过他是故意躲在暗处，此时闪出来疾趋上前，口中叫一声：
He had deliberately kept in the shadows, but now stepped out and hurried forward.

“大先生！”
“Sir!”

“好，好！
“Good, good!

云青，你来了！
You are here, Yunqing.

不要紧，不要紧，
Nothing to worry about!

阜康仍旧是金字招牌。”
Fukang still has its golden reputation.”

他特意提高了声音说，“我先到店里。”
Raising his voice deliberately, Hu added, “I shall go to the bank first.”


店里便是阜康。轿子一到，正好店里开饭，
When his sedan chair reached Fukang, the staff were just sitting down to their meal.

胡雪岩特为去看一看饭桌，
Hu made a point of inspecting the dinner table.

这种情形平时亦曾有过，但在这种时候，他竟有这种闲情逸致，就不能不令人惊异了。
He had done so before, but that he should have leisure for such things at a moment like this was astonishing.

“天气冷了！”胡雪岩问谢云青说：
“The weather has turned cold,” he said to Xie.

“该用火锅了。”
“You ought to be having hotpot.”

“年常旧规，要冬至才用火锅。”谢云青说：
“Our standing rule is to start at the winter solstice.

“今年冬至迟。”
It falls late this year.”

“以后规矩改一改。
“Change the rule from now on.

照外国人的办法，冬天到寒暑表多少度，吃火锅，夏天，则多少度吃西瓜。
Follow the foreigners’ practice: in winter, serve hotpot when the thermometer falls to a certain temperature; in summer, serve watermelon when it rises to a certain temperature.

云青，你记牢。”
Remember that, Yunqing.”

这是稳定“军心”的办法，
This was his way of steadying his troops.

表示阜康倒不下来，还会一年一年开下去。
It told them that Fukang would not fall, but would carry on year after year.

谢云青当然懂得这个奥妙，
Xie understood perfectly.

一叠连声地答应着，交代“饭司务”从第二天起多领一份预备火锅的菜钱。
Agreeing at once, he told the cook to draw an extra allowance for hotpot ingredients from the following day.

“阜康的饭碗敲不破的！”有人这样在说。
“No one is going to smash our rice bowls at Fukang!” someone said.


在听谢云青的细说经过时，胡雪岩一阵阵胃冷中，
As Xie described what had happened, chills ran through Hu.

越觉得侥幸，越感到惭愧。
He felt increasingly fortunate, and increasingly ashamed.

事业不是他一人能创得起来的，所以出现今天这种局面，当然也不是他一个人的过失，
He had not built the business single-handed, and its present predicament could not be his fault alone.

但胡雪岩虽一想起宓本常，就恨不得一口唾沫当面吐在他脸上，
Whenever he thought of Mi Benchang, he wanted to spit in the man’s face.

但是，这种念头一起即消，
Yet the thought vanished almost as soon as it arose.

他告诉自己，不必怨任何人，连自己都不必怨，
He told himself not to blame anyone, not even himself.

最好忘记掉自己是阜康的东家，当自己是胡雪岩的“总管”，颇雪岩已经“不能问事”，委托他全权来处理这一场灾难。
Best of all would be to forget that he owned Fukang and imagine himself as Hu Xueyan’s chief steward, entrusted with full authority to handle this disaster because Hu himself could no longer attend to his affairs.

他只有尽力将得失之心丢开，心思才能比较集中，
Only by setting his personal hopes and fears aside could he concentrate.

当时紧皱双眉，闭上眼睛，通前彻后细想了以后说：
He closed his eyes, his brows tightly knitted, and thought the matter through from beginning to end.

“面子就是招牌，
Then he said, “Our standing is our reputation.

面子保得住，招牌就可以不倒，
Preserve that standing, and the name need not fall.

这是一句总诀。
That is the key to it all.

云青，你记牢！”
Remember it, Yunqing.”

“是，
“Yes.

我懂。”
I understand.”


“你跟螺蛳太太商量定规，今天早晨不开门，
“You and Madam Luosi decided not to open this morning.

这一点对不对，我们不必再谈。
There is no need to discuss now whether that was right or wrong.

不过，你要晓得，拆烂污的事情做不得。”
But you must understand: we cannot simply shirk our responsibilities and leave a mess behind.”

“我不是想拆烂污……”“我晓得。”
“I did not mean to—” “I know.”

胡雪岩摇摇手阻止他说：
Hu raised a hand to stop him.

“你不必分辩，
“You need not defend yourself.

因为我不是说你。
I am not accusing you.

不过，你同螺蛳太太有个想法大错特错，
But you and Madam Luosi have one idea that is utterly mistaken.

你刚才同我说，万一撑不住，手里还有几十万款子，做将来翻身的本钱。
You told me just now that, if we could not hold out, we would at least have several hundred thousand taels left as capital for a fresh start.

不对，
Wrong!

抱了这种想法，就输定了，
Think that way, and we are certain to lose.

永远翻不得身。
We shall never recover.

云青，你要晓得，我好象推牌九，
Yunqing, imagine me keeping the bank at pai gow.

一直推得是‘长庄’，注码不管多少都要，
I have always played with an unlimited bank: whatever the stake, I take it.

你输得起，我赢得进，
If you can afford to lose it, I can accept the winnings.

现在手风不顺，忽然说是改推‘铲庄’，尽多少铜钱赌，自己留起多少，当下次的赌本，
Now my luck turns against me, and I suddenly announce that I am limiting the bank: I shall risk only so much and keep the rest for another game.

云青，没有下次了，
Yunqing, there will be no other game!

赌场里从此进不去了！
I shall never be allowed into the gambling house again.”

“谢云青吸了口冷气，然后紧闭着嘴，
Xie drew a sharp breath, then pressed his lips together.

无从赞一词。
He could not add a word.


“我是一双空手起来的，
“I began with empty hands.

到头来仍旧一双空手，
If I end with empty hands, what have I lost?

不输啥！
Nothing!

不但不输，吃过、用过、阔过，都是赚头。
Everything I have eaten, enjoyed and spent in grand style has been a gain.

只要我不死，你看我照样一双空手再翻起来。”
So long as I live, you will see me rise again with nothing.”

“大先生这样气概，从古到今也没有几个人有。
“Few men in any age have had your spirit, sir.

不过，”
But…”

谢云青迟疑了一下，终于说了出来：
Xie hesitated, then finally said it.

“做生意到底不是推牌九。”
“Business is not quite the same as keeping the bank at pai gow.”

“做生意虽不是推牌九，道理是一样的，‘赌奸赌诈不赌赖’。
“It may not be, but the principle is the same: you may gamble with cunning and deception, but never welsh on a bet.

不卸排门做生意，不讲信用就是赖！”
Keeping the shutters up and refusing to honour your word is welshing!”

“大先生这么说，明天照常。”
“Then, as you say, we open as usual tomorrow.”

“当然照常！”
“Of course!

胡雪岩说：“你今天要做一件事，
There is one thing you must do tonight.

拿存户的帐，好好看一看，
Go carefully through the depositors’ accounts.

有几个户头要连夜去打招呼。”
There are several customers we must approach before the night is out.”

“好。
“Very well.

我马上动手。”
I shall begin at once.”

“对。
“Good.

不过招呼有个打法，
But there is a way of approaching them.

第一，一向初五结息，
First, interest is normally settled on the fifth.

现在提早先把利息结出来，送银票上门。”
Settle it early this time and send notes for the amount to their homes.”

“是。”
“Yes.”

“第二，你要告诉人家年关到了，
“Second, tell them the year’s end is approaching.

或者要提款，
Perhaps they will need to withdraw money.

要多少，请人家交代下来好预备。”
Ask them to let us know how much, so that we can have it ready.”

“嗯、嗯、嗯。”谢云青心领神会地答应着。
Xie nodded repeatedly, understanding exactly what Hu meant.


能将大户稳定下来，零星散户，力能应付，无足为忧。
If the large depositors could be kept steady, the scattered small withdrawals were within their means and gave no cause for fear.

胡雪岩交代清楚了，方始转回元宝街，
Only after giving these instructions did Hu return to Yuanbao Street.

虽已入夜，一条街上依旧停满了轿马，
Night had fallen, but the street was still packed with sedan chairs and horses.

门灯高悬，家人排班，雁行而立，
Lanterns hung high at the doors, and household attendants stood in orderly ranks.

仿佛一切如常，但平时那种喧哗热闹的气氛，却突然消失了。
Everything seemed as usual, except that the customary bustle and cheerful noise had suddenly disappeared.

轿子直接抬到花园门口，
His chair was carried straight to the garden entrance.

下轿一看，胡太太与螺蛳太太在那里迎接，
When he alighted, the First Madam and Madam Luosi were waiting for him.

相见黯然，但只转瞬之间，螺蛳太太便浮起了笑容，
Their meeting was sombre, but within a moment Madam Luosi produced a smile.

“想来还没有吃饭？”
“I suppose you have not eaten?

她问：“饭开在哪里？”
Where shall dinner be served?”

这是没话找话，
She was merely finding something to say.

胡雪岩根本没有听进去，
Hu scarcely heard her.

只说：“到你楼上谈。”他又问：
“Let us talk upstairs in your rooms.

“老太太晓得不晓得，我回来了。”
Does the old lady know I am back?”

“还没有禀告她老人家。”
“She has not been told yet.”

“好！
“Good.

关照中门上，先不要说。”
Tell the people at the inner gate not to say anything for the moment.”

“我晓得。
“I know.

不会的。”
They will not.”

胡家的中门，仿佛大内的乾清门一般，禁制特严，真个外言不入，
The household’s inner gate was guarded by restrictions as strict as those at the Gate of Heavenly Purity in the imperial palace: no word from outside was allowed through.

螺蛳太太早已关照过了，大可放心。
Madam Luosi had already given her orders, and he could be easy on that score.

到得螺蛳太太那里，阿云捧来一碗燕窝汤，一笼现蒸的鸡蛋糕，另外是现沏的龙井茶，
Upstairs, A’yun brought a bowl of bird’s-nest soup, a steamer of freshly made egg cakes and newly brewed Longjing tea.

预备齐全，随即下楼，这是螺蛳太太早就关照好了的。阿云武守在楼梯口，不准任何人上楼。
Once everything was ready, she went downstairs, as Madam Luosi had instructed beforehand, and stood guard at the foot of the stairs to keep everyone else away.


“事情要紧不要紧？”胡太太首先开口。
“Is it serious?” the First Madam asked first.

“说要紧就要紧，说不要紧就不要紧。”胡雪岩说：
“You could call it serious, or you could call it nothing,” Hu replied.

“如今是顶石臼做戏，
“We are performing a play with a stone mortar balanced on our heads.

能把戏做完，大不了落个吃力不讨好，
If we can finish it, the worst that happens is that we work hard and get no thanks.

没有啥要紧，
That is nothing.

这出做不下去，石臼砸下来，非死即伤。”
But if we cannot carry the performance through, the mortar falls, and we are killed or injured.”

“那么这出戏要怎样做呢？”螺蛳太太问说。
“Then how are we to perform it?” Madam Luosi asked.

“要做得台底下看不出我们头上顶了一个石臼，
“So that the audience never sees the mortar on our heads.

那就不要紧了。”
Then we shall be all right.”

“我也是这样关照大家，
“That is what I told everyone too.

一切照常，喜事该怎么办，还是该怎么办。
Everything as usual: the wedding is to be conducted exactly as it should be.

不过，场面可以拿铜钱摆出来的，
But money can provide the grand display.

只怕笑脸摆不出来。”
It may not provide the smiling faces.”

“难就难在这里。
“That is precisely the difficulty.

不过，”胡雪岩加重了语气说：“再难也要做到，
Still”—Hu spoke with added force—“however difficult it is, it must be done.

场面无论如何要好好儿把它绷起来，不管你们用啥法子。
Whatever means you use, you must keep up the display.”

胡太太与螺蛳太太相互看了一眼，
The two women looked at each other.

都将这两句话好好地想了一下，各有会心，不断点头。
Both considered his words carefully, understood them in their own ways and nodded.

“外头的事情有我。”
“Leave the outside affairs to me.

胡雪岩问说：“德晓峰怎么样？”
How has De Xiaofeng behaved?”

“总算不错。”螺蛳太太说：
“Well enough,” Madam Luosi said.

“莲珠一下午都在我这里，
“Lianzhu spent the whole afternoon here.

她说：你最好今天晚上就去看看德藩台。”
She says you would do best to see Treasurer De tonight.”

“晚上，恐怕不方便。”
“Would it not be inconvenient at night?”

“晚上才好细谈。”
“Night is the best time for a proper conversation.”

“好，
“Very well.

我等一下就去。”
I shall go shortly.”


胡雪岩有些踌躇，
Hu hesitated.

因为这时候最要紧的事，并不是去看德馨，
Calling on Dexin was not the most urgent business before him.

第一件是要发电报到各处，第二件是要召集几个重要的助手，商量应变之计。
First he had to send telegrams to various places; then he must bring his principal assistants together to discuss how to meet the emergency.

这两件事非但耽误不得，而且颇费功夫，
Neither task could wait, and both would take time.

实在抽不出空去看德馨。
He really could not spare any to visit Dexin.

“有应春在这里就好了。”
“If only Yingchun were here!”

胡雪岩叹口气，颓然倒在一张安乐椅，头软软地垂了下来。
With a sigh, he sank dejectedly into an armchair, his head drooping.

螺蛳太太大吃一惊，
Madam Luosi was alarmed.

“老爷！
“My dear!

老爷！”
My dear!”

她走上前去，半跪着摇撼着他双肩说：
She hurried over and half knelt before him, shaking his shoulders.

“你要撑起来！
“You must hold yourself together.

不管怎么样要撑牢！”
Whatever happens, you must!”

“胡雪岩没有作声，一把抱住她，将头埋在她肩项之间，”
Without a word, he clasped her and buried his face between her neck and shoulder.

罗四姐，“他说，“怕要害你受苦了，
“Sister Luo,” he said, “I am afraid I may bring suffering upon you.

你肯不肯同我共患难？
Will you share my troubles?”

“怎么不肯？
“How could I refuse?

我同你共过富贵，
I have shared your prosperity.

当然要同你共患难。”
Of course I shall share your troubles.”

说着，螺蛳太太眼泪掉了下来，落在胡雪岩手背上。
Her tears fell onto the back of his hand.

“你不要哭！
“Do not cry.

你刚才劝我，现在我也要劝你。
You were encouraging me just now; now I must encourage you.

外面我撑，
I shall hold things together outside.

里面你撑。”
You must do the same within.”

“好！”
“I will!”

螺蛳太太抹抹眼泪，很快地答应。
She wiped her eyes and answered at once.

“你比我难。”
“Your task is harder than mine.

胡雪岩说：“第一，老太太那里要瞒住，
First, you must keep the old lady from knowing.

第二，亲亲眷眷，还有底下人，都要照应到，
Second, you must look after the relatives and all the servants.

第三，这桩喜事仍旧要办得风风光光。”
Third, the wedding must be as splendid as ever.”

螺蛳太太心想第一桩还好办，到底只有一个人，
The first task was manageable, she thought: after all, it concerned only one person.

第二桩就很吃力了，第三桩更难，
The second would be taxing, and the third harder still.

不管怎么风光，贺客要谈煞风景的事，
However splendid the wedding, how could she stop the guests discussing things that would spoil it?

莫非去掩住他们的嘴？
Cover their mouths?

正这样转着念头，胡雪岩又开口了，
While she was thinking, Hu spoke again.

“罗四姐，”他说：“你答应得落答应不落？
“Sister Luo, can you undertake it or not?

如果答应不落，我……”
If you cannot, I…”


等了一会不听他说下去，
She waited, but he said no more.

螺蛳太太不由得要问：“你怎么样？”
“You will do what?” she asked.

“你撑不落，我就撑牢了，也没有意思。”
“If you cannot hold things together, there is no point in my holding on.”

“那么，怎么样呢？”
“Then what?”

“索性倒下来算了。”
“We may as well let everything collapse.”

“瞎说八道！”
“Nonsense!”

螺蛳太太跳了起来，大声说道，“胡大先生，你不要让我看不起你！”
She sprang to her feet and cried, “Mr Hu, do not make me despise you!”

胡雪岩原是激励她的意思，
He had meant to stir her courage.

想不到同时也受了她的激励，
Unexpectedly, she had stirred his as well.

顿时精神百倍地站起身来说：
Suddenly full of energy, he rose.

“好！
“Very well!

我马上去看德晓峰。”
I shall go and see Mr Xiaofeng at once.”

“这才是。”
“That is more like it.

螺蛳太太关照：“千万不要忘记谢谢莲珠。”
Whatever you do, do not forget to thank Lianzhu.”

“我晓得。”
“I know.”

“还有，你每一趟外路回来去看德藩台，从来没有空手的，
“And whenever you come home from a journey and call on Treasurer De, you never go empty-handed.

这回最好也不要破例。”
It would be best not to make an exception this time.”


这下提醒胡雪岩，
That reminded Hu.

“我的行李在哪里？”
“Where is my luggage?

他说：“其中有一只外国货的皮箱，里头新鲜花样很多。”
There is a leather trunk of foreign goods, with all sorts of novelties in it.”

“等我来问阿云。”
“Let me ask A’yun.”

原来胡雪岩每次远行，都是螺蛳太太为他收拾行李，同样地，胡雪岩一回来，行李箱亦照例卸在她这里，所以要问阿云。
Madam Luosi always packed for his journeys, and when he returned the luggage was invariably brought to her rooms, so A’yun was the person to ask.

“有的。
“Yes, it is here.

等我去提了来。”
I shall fetch it.”

那只皮箱甚重，是两个丫头抬上来的，
The trunk was heavy enough to require two maids to carry it upstairs.

箱子上装了暗锁，要对准号码，才能打开。
It had a combination lock that would open only when the numbers were correctly aligned.

急切间，胡雪岩想不起什么号码，
In his haste, Hu could not remember the combination.

怎么转也转不开，
However he turned it, the lock would not open.

又烦又急，弄得满头大汗。
Frustration and anxiety brought the sweat pouring from his forehead.

“等我来！”
“Let me!”

螺蛳太太顺手捡起一把大剪刀，朝锁具的缝隙中插了下去，
Madam Luosi picked up a large pair of scissors and thrust a blade into a gap in the lock.

然后交代阿云：“你用力往后扳。”
“Pull it back hard, A’yun.”

阿云是大脚，
A’yun had unbound feet.

近尺莲船抵住了皮箱，双手用足了劲往后一扳，
Planting one, almost a chi long, against the trunk, she pulled back with both hands.

锁是被撬开了，却以用力过度，仰开摔了一交。
The lock gave way, but she had used so much force that she fell backwards onto the floor.

“对！”胡雪岩若有所悟地自语：
“Exactly!” Hu murmured, as though something had dawned on him.

“快刀斩乱麻！”
“Cut through the tangle with one stroke!”

一面说，一面将皮纸包着的大包小包取了出来，堆在桌上，
As he spoke, he took out parcels large and small, wrapped in tough paper, and piled them on the table.

皮箱下面铺平了的，是舶来品的衣料。
Imported cloth lay flat at the bottom of the trunk.


“这个是预备送德晓峰的。”
“This was intended for Mr Xiaofeng.”

胡雪岩将一个小纸包递给螺蛳太太，又加了一句：“小心打碎。”
Hu handed Madam Luosi a small parcel and added, “Careful. It may break.”

打开来一看，是个乾隆年间烧料的鼻烟壶，配上祖母绿的盖子。
Inside was a glass snuff bottle made in the Qianlong reign, with an emerald stopper.

螺蛳太太这几年见识得多，知道名贵，
She had seen enough fine things in recent years to recognize its value.

“不过，”她说：“一样好象太少了。”
“But one item seems rather little.”

“那就再配一只表。”
“Then add a watch.”

这只表用极讲究的皮盒子盛着，
The watch came in an exquisite leather case.

打开来一看，上面是一张写着洋文的羊皮纸，
When she opened it, she found a sheet of parchment covered in foreign writing.

揭开来，是个毫不起眼的银表。
Beneath it lay a thoroughly unremarkable silver watch.

“这只表……”
“This watch…”

“这只表，你不要看不起它，
“Do not look down on it.

来头很大，
It has a very distinguished history.

是法国皇帝拿破仑用过的，
Napoleon, the Emperor of France, used it.

我是当古董买回来的。
I bought it as an antique.

这张羊皮纸是‘保单’，只要还得出‘报门’不是拿破仑用过，包退还洋，另加罚金。”
This parchment is the guarantee: anyone who can produce proof that Napoleon did not use it gets a refund, with a penalty payment besides.”

“好！
“Very well.

送莲珠的呢？
And for Lianzhu?”

“只有一个金黄寇盒子。
“There is only a gold box.

如果嫌轻，再加两件衣料。”
If that seems too slight a gift, add two lengths of cloth.”


从箱子下面取出几块平铺着的衣料出来，螺蛳太太忽生感慨，
As she lifted out several lengths laid flat beneath the other things, Madam Luosi was suddenly moved.

从嫁到胡家，什么绫罗绸缎，在她跟毛蓝布等量齐观，
Since marrying into the Hu household, she had come to regard every kind of silk and satin as no more remarkable than coarse blue cotton.

但一摸到西洋的衣料，感觉大不相同。这种感觉形容不出。
Yet the touch of Western cloth gave her quite a different feeling, one she could not describe.

她见过的最好的衣料是“贡缎”，这种缎子又分“御用”与“上用”两种，
The finest material she had known was tribute satin, divided into two categories: “imperial use” and “the sovereign’s use.”

“御用”的贡缎，后妃所用，亦用来赏赐王公大臣。
The former was used by the empress and imperial consorts, and was also bestowed on princes and high officials.

皇帝所用，才专称为“上用”。
Satin for the emperor himself was specifically designated “the sovereign’s use.”

但民间讲究的人，当然亦是世家巨族，用的亦是“上用”的缎子，
Discerning private households—naturally, the great families of generations’ standing—also used satin of this quality.

只是颜色避免用“明黄”以及较“明黄”为暗的“香色”，
They merely avoided bright yellow and the darker shade known as incense colour.

“明黄”只皇帝、太上皇帝能用，“香色”则是皇子专用颜色，
Bright yellow was reserved for the emperor and a retired emperor; incense colour was for imperial princes.

除此以外，百无禁忌，
Apart from those colours, there were no restrictions.

但争奇斗妍，可以比“上用”的缎子更讲究，
In their rivalry for novelty and beauty, private households could be more exacting even than the sovereign’s wardrobe.

譬如上午所着与晚间所着，看似同样花样的缎袍，而暗花已有区分，上午的花含苞待放，下午的花已盛开。
A satin robe worn in the morning might appear to have the same pattern as one worn in the evening, yet the subtly woven designs would differ: the morning flowers were buds about to open, while those for the afternoon were in full bloom.

这些讲究，已是“不是三世做官，不知道穿衣吃饭”的人家所矜重，
Such refinements were cherished in families of whom it could be said, “It takes three generations in office to learn how to dress and dine.”

但是，比起舶来品的好衣料来，不免令人兴起绚烂不如平淡之感。
Yet compared with fine imported cloth, they prompted the thought that splendour could not equal simplicity.


螺蛳太太所拣出来的两件衣料，都是单色，一件藏青、一件玄色，
The two lengths she selected were plain colours, one navy blue and the other black.

这种衣料名叫“哔叽”，
The fabric was called serge.

刚刚行销到中国，名贵异常，但她就有四套哔叽袄裤，
It had only just begun to be sold in China and was exceptionally precious, yet she already had four suits of serge jackets and trousers.

穿过了才知道它的好处。
Only by wearing it had she discovered its virtues.

这种在洋行发售，内地官宦人家少见，
Sold through the foreign trading houses, it was seldom seen among official families inland.

就是上海商场中，也只有讲时髦的阔客才用来作袍料的“哔叽”，
Even in Shanghai’s commercial circles, only rich men with a taste for fashion had it made into robes.

在胡家无足为奇。
In the Hu household, however, it was nothing unusual.

胡雪岩爱纤足，姬妾在平时不着裙子，
Hu loved slender feet, so his concubines did not ordinarily wear skirts.

春秋佳日用“哔叽”裁制夹袄夹裤，稳重挺括，颜色素雅，自然高贵。
On fine spring and autumn days, they wore lined jackets and trousers made of serge: dignified and crisp, sober in colour, with a natural distinction.

她常说：“做人就要象哔叽一样，经得起折磨，到哪里都显得有分量。”
She often said, “One should be like serge: able to withstand wear and carry weight wherever one goes.”

此时此地此人，想到自己常说的话，不由得凄然泪下。
Remembering her own words at this moment, in these circumstances, she could not help weeping.

幸好胡雪岩没有注意，
Fortunately, Hu did not notice.

她背着灯取手绢醒鼻子，顺便擦一擦眼睛，
Turning away from the light, she took out her handkerchief to blow her nose and wiped her eyes at the same time.

将拣齐了的礼物，关照阿雪用锦袱包了起来，然后亲自送胡雪岩到花园的西侧门。“
She told A’xue to wrap the chosen gifts in a brocade cloth, then personally escorted Hu to the western side gate of the garden.


这道门平时关闭，只有胡雪岩入夜“微行”时才开，
This gate was normally kept shut and opened only when Hu went out privately at night.

坐的当然也不是绿呢大轿，更没有前呼后拥的“亲兵”，
Naturally, he did not use the large green-cloth sedan chair, nor did a crowd of guards precede and follow him.

只有两个贴身小跟班，前后各擎一盏灯笼，照着小轿直到藩司衙门。
Only two personal attendants accompanied the little chair, one before and one behind, each holding a lantern to light the way to the provincial treasurer’s office.

由于预先已有通知，德馨派了人在那里等候。
Notice had already been sent, and Dexin had someone waiting.

胡雪岩下了轿，一直就到签押房。
Hu alighted and went straight to the private office.

“深夜过来打搅晓翁，实在不安。
“I am very sorry to disturb you so late, Mr Xiaofeng.”

胡雪岩话是这么说，态度还是跟平时一样，潇洒自如，毫不显得窘迫。
Despite his words, his manner was as easy and composed as ever, without a trace of embarrassment.

“来！来！
“Come, come!

躺下来。”
Lie down.”

刚起身来迎的德馨，自己先躺了下去！
Dexin had risen to greet him, but lay down again first.

接过丫头递过来的烟枪，一口气抽完，但却用手势指挥，如何招待客人。
He took the opium pipe a maid handed him and smoked it in one breath, directing his guest’s reception by gestures.

他指挥丫头，先替胡雪岩卸去马褂，
The maid first removed Hu’s riding jacket.

等他侧身躺下来，丫头便将他的双腿抬到搁脚凳上，脱去双梁鞋，然后取一床俄国毯子盖在腿上，掖得严严的，
When he lay on his side, she lifted his legs onto a footstool, took off his double-ridged shoes and covered his legs with a Russian blanket, tucking it closely around him.

温暖无比。
It was wonderfully warm.

“雪岩，”德馨说道：“我到今天才真佩服你！”
“Xueyan,” Dexin said, “only today have I truly come to admire you.”

没头没脑的这一句话，说得胡雪岩唯有苦笑，
With no explanation for this sudden remark, Hu could only smile wryly.

“晓翁，”他说：“你不要挖苦我了。”
“Mr Xiaofeng, please do not mock me.”


“不是我挖苦你。”
“I am not mocking you.

德馨说道：“从前听人说，孟尝君门下食客三千，鸡鸣狗盗，到了紧要关头，都会大显神通。
I used to hear that Lord Mengchang kept three thousand retainers, and even those whose talents lay in crowing like cocks or thieving like dogs could work wonders in a crisis.

你手下有个周少棠，你就踉孟尝君一样了。”
With a Zhou Shaotang among your men, you are another Lord Mengchang.”

周少棠大出风头这件事，他只听谢云青略为提到，不知其详，
Xie had briefly mentioned Zhou’s great performance, but Hu did not know the details.

如今听德馨如此夸奖，不由得大感兴趣，
Such praise from Dexin naturally interested him.

便问一句：“何以见得？”好让德馨讲下去。
“How so?” he asked, inviting him to continue.

“我当时在场，亲眼目睹，
“I was there and saw it myself.

实在佩服。”
Truly admirable!

德馨说道：“京里有个丑儿叫刘赶三，随机应变，临时抓限是有名的，可是以我看来，不及周少棠。”
There is a comic actor in Beijing called Liu Gansan, famous for his quick responses and improvised jokes, but in my judgement he is no match for Zhou.”

接着德馨眉飞色舞地将周少棠玩弄黄八麻子于股掌之上的情形，细细形容了一遍，
With animated delight, Dexin described in detail how Zhou had made a plaything of Huang Bamazi.

胡雪岩默默地听着，心里在想，这周少棠以后有什么地方用得着他。
Hu listened silently, wondering where he might make use of Zhou in future.

“雪岩，”德馨又说：“周少棠给你帮的忙，实在不小。
“Xueyan, the service he has done you is considerable.

把挤兑的那班人哄得各自回家，犹在其次，
Talking the people demanding their money into going home was the lesser part of it.

要紧的是，把你帮了乡下养蚕人家的大忙，大大吹嘘了一番。
More important was his great account of how you helped the country people who raise silkworms.

这一点很有用，而且功效已显出来了，
That is very useful, and it has already had an effect.

今儿下午刘仲帅约我去谈你的事，
Commander Liu asked me to discuss your affairs this afternoon.

他就提到你为了跟英国人斗法，以至于被挤，说应该想法子维持。”
He mentioned that your struggle with the British had brought this pressure upon you, and said we ought to find a way to support you.”

刘仲帅是指浙江巡抚刘秉璋，
Commander Liu was Liu Bingzhang, the governor of Zhejiang.

他跟李鸿章虽非如何融洽，但总是淮军一系，
Although his relations with Li Hongzhang were not particularly close, he belonged to the Huai Army faction.

能有此表示，自然值得珍视，所以胡雪岩不免有兴奋的语气。
Such words from him were therefore to be valued, and Hu’s voice betrayed some excitement.

“刘仲帅亦能体谅，
“Commander Liu understands my position too!

盛情实在可感。”
His kindness is deeply appreciated.”


“你先别高兴，
“Do not rejoice yet.

他还有话；能维持才维持，不能维持趁早处置，
He had more to say: support you if you can be supported; otherwise, make arrangements without delay.

总以确保官款为第一要义。
The first consideration must always be the safety of public funds.”

雪岩，”德馨在枕上转脸看着胡雪岩说：“你得给我一句话。”
Turning his face on the pillow towards Hu, Dexin added, “Xueyan, you must give me your word.”

这句话自然是要胡雪岩提供保证，决不至于让他无法交代。
Clearly, he wanted a guarantee that Hu would not leave him unable to account for the money.

胡雪岩想了一下说：
Hu thought for a moment.

“晓翁，我们相交不是一天，
“Mr Xiaofeng, we have known each other for years.

你看我是对不起人的人吗？”
Do you think I am a man who would let others down?”

“这一层，你用不着表白。
“You need not assure me of that.

不过，雪岩，你的事业太大了，或许有些地方你自己都不甚了了。
But your enterprises are so extensive that you may not fully understand every part of them yourself.

譬如，你如果对你自己的虚实，一清二楚的话，上海的阜康何至于等你一走，马上就撑不住了？”
If you knew your own position through and through, for instance, why did the Shanghai bank lose its footing the moment you left?”

这番话说得胡雪岩哑口无言，
Hu had no answer.

以他的口才，可以辩解，但他不想那样做，因为他觉得那样就是不诚。
With his eloquence, he could have defended himself, but he did not wish to, because that would not have been honest.

“雪岩，你亦不必难过。
“There is no need to take it to heart.

事已如此，只有挺直腰杆来对付。”德馨紧接着说：
Things being as they are, you can only stand straight and face them.

“我此刻只要你一句话。”
For the moment, I want just one word from you.”

“请吩咐。”
“Please tell me.”

“你心里的想法，先要告诉我。
“You must let me know what you are thinking.

不必多，只要一句话好了。”
Nothing more than one word is needed.”

这话别具意味，
There was a particular meaning beneath this.

胡雪岩揣摩了半天，方始敢于确定，
Hu considered it for some time before he felt certain enough to reply.

“晓翁，”他说。“如果我真的撑不下去了，我一定先同晓翁讨主意。”
“If I really cannot hold on, I shall consult you first, Mr Xiaofeng.”

这话的意思是一定会维护德馨的利益，不管是公、是私？
What he meant was that he would protect Dexin’s interests, public and private alike.

“好！
“Good!

咱们一言为定。
That is agreed.

现在，雪岩，你说吧，我能替你帮什么忙？”
Now, Xueyan, tell me what I can do to help.”


“不止于帮忙，”胡雪岩说：
“I ask more than help,” Hu said.

“我现在要请晓翁拿我的事，当自己的事办。”
“I want you to treat my affairs as your own.”

这话分明一也很重，
This too carried considerable weight.

德馨想了一下说：
Dexin reflected.

“这不在话下。
“That goes without saying.

不过，自己的事，不能不知道吧？”
But one must know about one’s own affairs, must one not?”

“是，
“Yes.

我跟晓翁说一句，只要不出意外，一定可以过关。”
Let me tell you this: provided nothing unforeseen happens, I can certainly get through.”

“雪岩，你的所谓意外是什么？”
“What do you mean by unforeseen?”

“凡是我抓不住的，都会出意外。”胡雪岩说：
“Anything beyond my control can produce a surprise.

“第一个是李合肥。”
First of all, Li of Hefei.”

说到这里，他不由得叹了一口报导，
He could not suppress a sigh.

“唉！原以为左大人到了两江，是件好事，
“I thought Lord Zuo’s coming to Liangjiang was a good thing.

哪晓得反而坏了。”
Who could have known it would turn out to be the opposite?”

“喔。
“Indeed?

这一层，你倒不妨谈谈。”
Tell me about that.”

谈起来很复杂，也很简单，
The explanation was at once complex and simple.

左宗棠一到两江，便与李鸿章在上海的势力发生冲突。
As soon as Zuo came to Liangjiang, he clashed with Li Hongzhang’s power in Shanghai.

如果左宗棠仍有当年一往无前笼罩各方的魄力，加上胡雪岩的精打细算，则两江总督管两江，名正言顺，李鸿章一定会落下风。
Had Zuo retained the irresistible energy with which he once dominated every side, reinforced by Hu’s careful calculations, Li would certainly have had the worst of it. After all, the Governor-General of Liangjiang had every right to govern Liangjiang.

无奈左宗棠老境颓唐，加以在两江素无基础，
But Zuo was declining with age and had no established base there.

更糟糕的是对法交涉，态度软硬，大相径庭，
Worse still, their positions on negotiations with France—one hard, the other soft—were worlds apart.

而李鸿章为了贯彻他的政策，视左宗棠为遇事掣时、非拔除不可的眼中钉，
To carry out his own policy, Li regarded Zuo as an obstacle at every turn, a thorn that had to be removed.

而又以剪除左宗棠的党羽为主要手段，
His principal method was to strip away Zuo’s supporters.

这一来便将胡雪岩看作保护左宗棠的盾牌，集矢其上了。
Hu thus became the shield protecting Zuo, and all the arrows were directed at him.


“我明白了。”德馨说道：
“I understand,” Dexin said.

“冤家宜解不宜结，
“Better to resolve enmity than create it.

李合肥那方面要设法去打个照呼。
We must find some way to approach Li of Hefei.

这一层，我可以托刘仲帅。”
I can ask Commander Liu to do that.”

“这就重就拜托了。”
“Then I entrust it to you most earnestly.

胡雪岩问：“刘仲帅那里，我是不是应该去见一见？”
Should I go and see Commander Liu myself?”

“等明天‘上院’见了他再说。”德馨又说：
“Let me see him at the official audience tomorrow first.

“你倒想一想，李合肥如果要跟你过不去，会用什么手段？”
Think, though: if Li of Hefei means to make trouble for you, what means will he use?”

“别的我都不在乎，”
“Nothing else concerns me.

胡雪岩说：“最怕他来提北洋属下各衙门的官款，
What I fear most is that he will demand the public funds deposited by the offices under Beiyang.

提不到可以封我的典当，
If I cannot repay them, he can seal up my pawnshops.

那一来就要逼倒我了。”
That would force me under.”

“封典当，影响平民生计，
“Closing pawnshops affects ordinary people’s livelihoods.

果然如此，我可以说话。”
If it comes to that, I can speak out.”

“正要晓翁仗义执言。
“That is precisely what I ask you to do.

不过后说不如先后，尤其要早说。”
But it is better to speak beforehand than afterwards, and the sooner the better.”

“好！
“Very well.

我明天就跟刘仲帅去谈。”
I shall speak to Commander Liu tomorrow.”

“能不能请刘仲帅出面，打几个电报出去，就说阜康根基稳固，请各处勿为谣言所惑，
“Could he send out a few telegrams, saying that Fukang stands on firm foundations and asking the various offices not to be misled by rumours?

官款暂且不提，免得逼倒了阜康。”
They should refrain from withdrawing public funds for the moment, to avoid forcing Fukang into collapse.”

“说当然可以说。
“He can certainly be asked.

不过，刘仲帅一定会问：是不是能保证将来各处的官款，分文不少？”
But he will want to know whether you can guarantee that every office’s public money will ultimately be repaid in full.

德馨又加一句：“如果没有这一层保证，刘仲帅不肯发这样子的电报。”
Without that guarantee, he will not send such telegrams.”

胡雪岩默然半晌，方始答说：
Hu was silent for a long time before he answered.

“如果我有这样的把握，也就根本不必请刘仲帅发电报了。”
“If I could be that certain, there would be no need to ask him to send them in the first place.”


这下是德馨默然。
Now it was Dexin’s turn to fall silent.

一直等将烟瘾过足，方又开口：
He did not speak again until he had satisfied his craving for opium.

“雪岩，至少本省大小衙门存在阜康的官款，我有把握，在一个月之内不会提。”
“Xueyan, at least I can assure you that none of the public funds deposited with Fukang by the offices of this province, great or small, will be withdrawn for a month.”

“只要一个月之内，官款不动，就不要紧了。”胡雪岩说：
“If the public funds remain untouched for a month, we shall be all right,” Hu said.

“我在天津的丝，可以找到户头，
“I can find a buyer for my silk in Tianjin.

一脱手，头寸马上就松了。”
Once it is sold, funds will immediately become easier.”

“上海呢？”
“What about Shanghai?

德馨问道：“你在上海不也有许多丝囤在那里吗？”
Have you not a great deal of silk stored there too?”

“上海的不能动！
“The Shanghai stock must not be touched!

洋人本来就在杀我的价钱，
The foreigners were already beating down my price.

现在看我急需周转，更看得我的丝不值钱。
Now that they see how urgently I need funds, they will value my silk even less.

晓翁，钱财身外之物，
Mr Xiaofeng, money is only a worldly possession.

我不肯输这口气，尤其是输给洋人，更加不服。”“唉！”德馨叹口气，
I will not swallow this defeat—least of all at the foreigners’ hands.” Dexin sighed.

“大家都要象你这样子争气，中国就好了。”
“If everyone had your determination to stand their ground, China would be better off.”



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第四章（下，至本章结束）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Four, Part Two (conclusion)
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


正在谈着，闪出一个梳长辫子的丫头，带着老妈子来摆桌子，预备吃消夜。
While they were talking, a maid with a long braid slipped in, followed by older women who set the table for a late supper.

胡雪岩本想告辞，转念又想，应该不改常度：
Hu Xueyan had been about to take his leave, but on reflection he decided that he ought to keep to his usual ways.

有几次夜间来访，到了时候总是吃消夜，这天也应该照常才是。
On several previous evening visits he had stayed for supper when the time came; he ought to do the same tonight.

“姨太太呢？”德馨问说，
“Where is your mistress?” Dexin asked.

“说我请她。”
“Tell her I should like her to join us.”

“马上出来。”
“She will be out directly.”

原来莲珠是不避胡雪岩的，
Lianzhu did not observe the convention of avoiding Hu Xueyan.

这天原要出来周旋，一则慰问，再则道谢。
She had already intended to come out and entertain him that evening, both to express her concern and to thank him for his gifts.


及至胡雪岩刚刚落座，听得帘钩微响，
Hu Xueyan had scarcely taken his seat when he heard the faint clink of a curtain hook.

扭头看时，莲珠出现在房门口，
Turning, he saw Lianzhu in the doorway.

她穿的是件旗袍，不过自己改良过了，袖子并不太宽，腰身亦比较小，
She was wearing a Manchu gown, though she had altered the design herself: the sleeves were less wide and the waist more closely fitted.

由于她身材颀长，而且生长北方，穿惯了旗装，
She was tall and slender, had grown up in the north, and was accustomed to Manchu dress.

所以在她手握一方绣花手帕，一摇三摆地走了来，一点都看不出她是汉人。
As she approached with an embroidered handkerchief in her hand and a graceful swaying walk, there was nothing to suggest that she was Han Chinese.

“二太太！”
“Second Madam!”

胡雪岩赶紧站起来招呼。
Hu rose at once to greet her.

“请坐，请坐！”
“Please sit down, please!”

莲珠摆一摆手说：
She waved him back to his seat.

“胡大先生，多谢你送的东西，
“Mr Hu, thank you for all those things you sent me.

太破费了。”
You have been far too extravagant.”

“小意思，小意思。”胡雪岩说：
“A mere trifle, a mere trifle,” Hu replied.

“初五那天，二太太你要早点来。”
“You must come early on the fifth, Second Madam.”

“胡大先生，你不用关照，
“There is no need to remind me, Mr Hu.

我扰府上的喜酒，不止一顿，
I shall be enjoying more than one wedding feast at your house.

四姐请我去陪客，
Fourth Sister has asked me to help entertain the guests.

一前一后，起码扰你三顿。”
With the gatherings before and after the wedding, I shall be eating at your expense at least three times.”

原来杭州是南宋故都，婚丧喜庆，有许多繁文褥节，
Hangzhou, the former capital of the Southern Song, retained many elaborate observances for weddings, funerals, and other family occasions.

富家大族办喜事，请亲友执事，前期宴请，名为“请将”，事后款待，称为“谢将”。
When a wealthy family held a wedding and enlisted relatives and friends to help, the preliminary banquet was called “inviting the generals,” and the feast afterwards, “thanking the generals.”

莲珠是螺蛳太太特为邀来陪官眷的“支宾”。
Madam Luosi had specially invited Lianzhu to act as a hostess to the wives of officials.


“雪岩！”德馨问道：“喜事一切照常？”
“Xueyan,” Dexin asked, “is everything for the wedding going ahead as usual?”

胡雪岩尚未答话，莲珠先开口了，
Before Hu could answer, Lianzhu spoke.

“自然照常。”
“Of course it is.

她说：“这还用得着问？”
Do you even need to ask?”

“你看！”
“There, you see!”

德馨为姨太太所抢白，脸上有点挂不住，指着莲珠，自嘲地向胡雪岩说：“管得越严了，
A little embarrassed at being put down by his concubine, Dexin pointed at her and said to Hu with a self-mocking smile, “She keeps me under tighter control every day.

连多说句话都不得。”
I am not even allowed an extra word.”

“只怕没有人管。”胡雪岩答说：
“The thing to fear is having no one to look after you,” Hu replied.

“有人管是好事。”
“Having someone who does is a blessing.”

“我就是爱管闲事，也不光是管你。”莲珠紧接着又说：
“I do like to meddle, and you are not the only person I meddle with,” Lianzhu went on.

“胡大先生的事，我们怎么好不管，
“How could we stand aside when Mr Hu needs us?

有件事我要提醒你，到了好日子那天，要约了刘抚台去道喜！”
There is something I must remind you of: on the wedding day, you must arrange to go with Governor Liu and offer your congratulations.”

这正是胡雪岩想说不便说，关切在心里的一句话，
This was precisely what Hu had been longing to ask but had felt unable to put into words.

所以格外注意德馨的反应，
He watched Dexin's reaction with particular attention.

只听他答了一句：“当然非拉他去不可。”顿觉胸怀一宽。
When Dexin answered, “Of course I must drag him along,” a weight lifted from his heart.


“胡大先生，我特为穿旗袍给你看，
“Mr Hu, I put on this Manchu gown especially to show you.

你送我的哔叽衣料，我照这样子做了来穿，
I want to have the serge you sent me made up in this style.

你说好不好看？”
Do you think it would look well?”

通家之好，到了这样的程度，似乎稍嫌过分，
Even between families on such intimate terms, this seemed a little too familiar.

胡雪岩只好这样答说：“你说好就好。”
Hu could only answer, “If you think it looks well, then it does.”

“好是好，太素了一点儿。
“It would, only it would be a little too plain.

胡大先生，我还要托你，
There is something else I must ask you, Mr Hu.

有没有西洋花边，
Can one get Western lace?

下次得便请你从上海给我带一点来。”
Next time you have an opportunity, would you bring me some from Shanghai?”

“有！有！”胡雪岩一叠连声地答说：
“Certainly, certainly!” Hu answered eagerly.

“不必下一次。
“There is no need to wait until next time.

明天我就叫人送了来。”
I will have some sent over tomorrow.

他接着又说：“西洋花边宽细都有，花式很多，
Western lace comes in broad and narrow widths, and in a great many patterns.

我多送点来，请二太太自己挑。”
I shall send a selection for you to choose from.”

“那就更好了。”
“That would be even better.”

“别老站着。”德馨亲自移开一张凳子，
“Do not keep standing there,” Dexin said, moving a stool himself.

“你也陪我们吃一点儿。”
“Sit down and have something with us.”

于是莲珠坐了下来，为主客二人酌酒布菜，静静地听他们谈话。
Lianzhu sat down, poured wine and served food for host and guest, and quietly listened to their conversation.


“雪岩，我听说你用的人，也不完全靠得住。
“Xueyan, I hear that not all the people you employ can be relied upon.

你自己总知道吧？”
You must know that yourself?”

“过了这个风潮，我要好好整顿了。”胡雪岩答说：
“Once this crisis is over, I shall put things thoroughly in order,” Hu replied.

“晓翁说周少棠值得重用，
“You said Zhou Shaotang deserved to be given greater responsibilities, Mr Xiaofeng.

我一定要重用。”
I shall certainly see that he gets them.”

“你看了人再用。”莲珠忍不住插嘴，
Lianzhu could not resist intervening. “Judge the man for yourself before you employ him.

“不要光看人家的面子，
Do not do it merely out of regard for someone else.

人用得不好，受害的是自己。”
If you choose badly, you are the one who suffers.”

“是，是！
“Yes, yes!

二太太是金玉良言。”
Those are words of gold, Second Madam.”

胡雪岩深为感慨，
Hu spoke with deep feeling.

“这回的风潮，也是我不听一两个好友的话之故。”
“This crisis, too, has come about because I failed to listen to one or two good friends.”

“其实你不必听外头人的话，
“In fact, you need not listen to outsiders.

多听听罗四姐的话就好了。”
You would do well enough if you listened more to Luo Sijie.”

“她对外面的情形不大明白。
“She does not understand very much about affairs outside the household.

这一点，比二太太你差多了。”
In that respect she is a long way behind you, Second Madam.”

听得这话，莲珠颇有知己之感，
Lianzhu felt that here, at least, was someone who appreciated her.

“胡大先生，你是明白的。
“Mr Hu, you understand.

不比我们老爷，
Our master is quite different.

提到外面的事，总说：“你别管‘。
Whenever I mention outside affairs, he says, ‘Keep out of it.’

一个人再聪明，也有当局者迷的时候。
However clever a person may be, there are times when being in the middle of things prevents him from seeing clearly.

刚才你同我们老爷在交谈的情形，我也听到了这一点儿。”
I caught something of what you and our master were discussing just now.”

说到这里，她突然问道：“胡大先生，上海跟杭州两处的风潮，左大人知道不知道？”
At this point she suddenly asked, “Does Lord Zuo know about the trouble in Shanghai and Hangzhou, Mr Hu?”


“恐怕还不晓得。”
“I am afraid he does not yet.”

“你怎么不告诉他？”
“Why have you not told him?”

“告诉他？”
“Tell him?”

胡雪岩有些茫然，
Hu sounded rather bewildered.

多少年来，凡是失面子的事，他从不告诉左宗棠，
For many years he had never reported anything to Zuo Zongtang that would cost him face.

所以阜康的风潮一起，他根本就没有想到过左宗棠。
When the trouble at Fukang broke out, Zuo had therefore never even entered his thoughts.

“为什么不告诉他？”莲珠说道：
“Why should you not tell him?” Lianzhu asked.

“你瞒也瞒不住的。”
“You cannot keep it from him in any case.”

“说得不错。”德馨也说：
“Quite right,” Dexin agreed.

“如果左大人肯出面，到底是两江总督部堂！”
“If Lord Zuo were willing to intervene—he is, after all, the Governor-General of Liangjiang!”

这个衔头在东南半壁，至高无上，
In the southeastern half of the empire, no office stood higher.

但到底能发生什么作用，却很难说。
What practical effect its intervention could have, however, was another question.

哪知道莲珠别有深心，
Lianzhu, as it happened, had a further purpose in mind.

“胡大先生这会心很乱，
“Mr Hu's thoughts must be in turmoil at present.

恐怕不知道该跟左大人说什么好？”
Perhaps he does not know what he ought to say to Lord Zuo?”

她随即提出一个建议：
She promptly made a suggestion.

“是不是请杨师爷来拟个稿子看看？”
“Why not ask Secretary Yang to draw up a draft for us to look at?”

那杨师爷是苏州人，年纪很轻，但笔下很来得，而且能言善道，善体人意，
Secretary Yang was a young man from Suzhou, an excellent writer, an accomplished speaker, and particularly good at understanding other people's wishes.

莲珠对他很欣赏。
Lianzhu thought highly of him.

德馨只要是莲珠说好就好，所以对杨师爷亦颇另眼相看，
Since Dexin was content to approve anyone she approved of, he too treated the young secretary with special favour.

此时便问胡雪岩：“你的意思怎么样？”
“What do you think?” he now asked Hu.

“好是好！不过只怕太缓了。”
“It would be a good idea, only I am afraid it would take too long.”

“怎么缓得了？
“How could it?

发电报出去，明天一早就到了。”
Send a telegram and it will be there first thing tomorrow morning.”

“我密码本不在这里。”
“I have not brought my codebook.”

“用我们的好了。”莲珠接口。
“Use ours,” Lianzhu put in.

“对啊！”德馨说道，
“Of course!” Dexin said.

“请杨师爷拟好了稿子，就请他翻密码好了。
“Once Secretary Yang has drafted it, he can put it into code.

小妾也可以帮忙。”
My concubine can help him.”

“这，怎么好麻烦二太太？”
“But how could I trouble Second Madam with that?”

“怕什么，
“What trouble?

我们两家什么交情！”
Think how close our two families are!”

真是盛情难地，胡雪岩只有感激的分儿。
Faced with such warmth, Hu could only feel grateful.

在请杨师爷的这段时间中，离座踱着方步，将要说的话都想好了。
While they sent for Secretary Yang, he left his seat and paced slowly about, arranging in his mind what he wished to say.


“杨师爷，拜托你起个稿子，要说这样子几点：
“Secretary Yang, may I trouble you to prepare a draft covering these points?

第一，请左大人为了维持人心，打电报给上海道，尽力维持阜康。
First, to preserve public confidence, ask Lord Zuo to telegraph the Shanghai circuit intendant and instruct him to do everything possible to support Fukang.

第二，请两江各衙门，暂时不要提存款。
Second, ask the various government offices in Liangjiang to leave their deposits untouched for the time being.

第三，浙江刘抚台、德馨台很帮忙，请左大人来个电报，客气一番。”
Third, Governor Liu and Treasurer Dexin here in Zhejiang have been most helpful; ask Lord Zuo to send a telegram expressing his appreciation.”

“客气倒不必。”德馨说道：
“There is no need for compliments,” Dexin said.

“要重重托一托刘抚台。”
“But he ought to make a strong personal appeal to Governor Liu.”

“是！是！”
“Certainly, certainly!”

杨师爷鞠躬如也地问：
Secretary Yang bowed deferentially.

“还有什么话？”
“Is there anything else?”

“想到了，再告诉你。”莲珠接口说道：
“If we think of anything, we shall tell you,” Lianzhu interposed.

“杨师爷，你请到外面来写，
“Come and write in the outer room, Secretary Yang.

清静一点儿。”
It will be quieter there.”

莲珠很热心地引领着杨师爷到了外屋，悄悄嘱咐了一番。
She led him out with great solicitude and gave him some instructions in a whisper.

他下笔很快，不到半个钟头，便将稿子送了上来，
He wrote quickly, and in less than half an hour brought back the draft.

除了照胡雪岩所要求的三点陈述以外，前面特为加一段，盛称德馨如何帮忙，得以暂度难关，实在令人感激，
Besides setting out the three points Hu had requested, it opened with a special passage praising Dexin's assistance, which had enabled Hu to weather the immediate difficulty and deserved his profound gratitude.

同时也说了些德馨在浙江的政绩。
It also mentioned some of Dexin's achievements in the administration of Zhejiang.

着墨不多，但措词很有力量，
The passage was short but forcefully worded.

这当然是莲珠悄悄嘱咐的结果。
This was plainly the result of Lianzhu's whispered instructions.


胡雪岩心里雪亮，
Hu understood perfectly.

德馨曾透露过口风，希望更上层楼，由藩司升为巡抚，作一个真正的方面大员，
Dexin had previously let fall a hint that he hoped to rise another step, from provincial treasurer to governor, and become a true provincial chief.

而目标是江西。
The province he had in mind was Jiangxi.

这就需要两江总督的支持了。
For that he needed the support of the Governor-General of Liangjiang.

原来所谓两江是明朝的说法，安徽是上江，江苏是下江，
The expression “Liangjiang,” or “the Two Jiangs,” dated from the Ming: Anhui was the Upper Jiang and Jiangsu the Lower Jiang.

两江总督只管江苏、安徽两省，但江西与苏皖密迩，两江总督亦管得着，犹之乎直未总督，必要时能管山东。
The Governor-General of Liangjiang governed only Jiangsu and Anhui, but because Jiangxi adjoined them, his authority could extend there too, just as the Governor-General of Zhili could, when necessary, intervene in Shandong.

将来江西巡抚出缺，如果左宗棠肯保德馨，便有一言九鼎之力。
If the governorship of Jiangxi should fall vacant and Zuo Zongtang were willing to recommend Dexin, his word would carry decisive weight.

所以电报中由胡雪岩出面，力赞德馨如何帮忙，实际上即是示好于左宗棠，为他自己的前程“烧冷灶”。
By having Hu lavish praise on Dexin's assistance in the telegram, they were in effect making an overture to Zuo and tending a currently cold hearth for the sake of Dexin's future career.

当然胡雪岩是乐于帮这个惠而不费的忙，
Naturally Hu was happy to do a favour that cost him nothing.

而且电报稿既出于杨师爷之手，便等于德馨作了愿全力维持的承诺，
Moreover, since the draft came from Dexin's own secretary, it virtually amounted to a promise by Dexin to give him his fullest support.

更是何乐不为！
Why should he not welcome it?

因此，他看完稿子，口中连声说道：“好极，好极！
Having read it, he said repeatedly, “Excellent, excellent!

杨师爷的一支笔实在佩服。”
I truly admire your pen, Secretary Yang.”

“哪里，哪里？”
“You are too kind.”

杨师爷递过一支毛笔来，
Yang offered him a writing brush.

“有不妥的地方，请胡大先生改正。”
“If anything is unsuitable, please correct it, Mr Hu.”

“只字不改！
“I would not change a single word.

都是我心里的话，
It says exactly what is in my heart.

为啥要改？”
Why should I alter it?”

说着，接过毛笔来，写了个“雪”字，表示同意。
Taking the brush, he wrote the character Xue from his name to signify his approval.


正谈到里，只见阿福掀帘人内，
At that moment A’fu lifted the curtain and came in.

悄悄地走到德馨身边，送上一个卷宗，口中轻声说道，“刚到的。”
Going quietly to Dexin's side, he handed him a folder and murmured, “Just arrived.”

“喔！”
“Oh?”

德馨将卷宗掀开，
Dexin opened it.

内中只有一张纸，
There was only one sheet inside.

胡雪岩遥遥望去，看出是一通电报，字迹却看不清楚。
From where he sat, Hu could see that it was a telegram, but he could not make out the writing.

“我的眼镜呢？”
“Where are my spectacles?”

德馨一面说，一面起身找眼镜，借此走到间壁，
Dexin rose to look for them, using this as an excuse to go into the adjoining room.

杨师爷随即跟了过去。
Secretary Yang immediately followed.

胡雪岩有点心神不定，
Hu began to feel uneasy.

深夜来了电报，是不是有关阜康的消息？
Could a telegram arriving so late concern Fukang?

如果是阜康的消息，德馨应该告诉他才是。
If it did, Dexin ought to tell him.

这样想着，双眼不由得一直注视里间。
As he thought this, his eyes remained fixed on the inner room.

“胡大先生，”莲珠说道：“你不要着急，
“Mr Hu,” Lianzhu said, “do not distress yourself.

有什么为难的事，你不便出面，让罗四姐来跟我说，
If there is any awkward matter you cannot conveniently raise in person, have Luo Sijie come and tell me.

我来告诉我们老爷。”
I will speak to our master.”

“是，是，多谢二太太！”
“Thank you, thank you, Second Madam.”

莲珠还有话要说，但德馨已经出来了，
Lianzhu had more to say, but Dexin had already returned.

她跟胡雪岩都盯着他看，希望他宣布深夜来电报，是何事故。
Both she and Hu looked intently at him, waiting to hear what the late-night telegram concerned.

但德馨却不作声，
Dexin said nothing.

坐了下来，举杯徐饮。
He sat down, raised his cup, and sipped his wine.

“哪里来的电报？”莲珠问说。
“Where was the telegram from?” Lianzhu asked.

“不相干的事。”
“Nothing to do with this.”

只说了这句又没话了。
That was all he said.


原来这个电报是宁波海关监督候补道瑞庆打来的，
The telegram was in fact from Ruiqing, the expectant circuit intendant serving as superintendent of the Ningbo Customs.

说他得到密报，上海阜康钱庄的档手宓本常潜回宁波来筹现银。
He had received confidential information that Mi Benchang, manager of the Shanghai Fukang Bank, had slipped back to Ningbo to raise cash.

阜康在宁波的联号，共有两家，一家叫通泉钱庄，一家叫通裕银号。
Fukang had two affiliated establishments there, Tongquan Bank and Tongyu Banking House.

但因宁波市面亦以越南战事的影响，颇为萧条，通泉、通裕都无从接济阜康。
But business in Ningbo had also been badly depressed by the war in Vietnam, and neither establishment was in a position to assist Fukang.

而且通泉的档手不知避匿何处，通裕银号的档手则自行请求封闭，
Worse still, Tongquan's manager had gone into hiding and could not be found, while Tongyu's manager had himself requested that his establishment be sealed.

因此，瑞庆即命鄞悬知县查封通裕，请德馨转知通泉、通裕的东主，即速清理。
Ruiqing had accordingly instructed the magistrate of Yin County to seal Tongyu, and was asking Dexin to notify the proprietors of both banks to settle their affairs without delay.

德馨对通泉、通裕的情况还不清楚，一时不知如何处置，因而就不便公开这通电报。
Dexin knew too little about their circumstances to decide what to do, and had therefore felt unable to disclose the telegram.

直到胡雪岩告辞以后，才跟莲珠商量。首先问她，这个消息暂且瞒着胡雪岩，是不是做错了？
Only after Hu had left did he discuss it with Lianzhu, first asking whether he had been wrong to withhold the news for the time being.

““当然错了！”莲珠问道：
“Of course you were!” she replied.

“你为什么当时不说？”
“Why did you not tell him then?”

“我一说，雪岩当时就会要我复电请老瑞维持，通泉启封，
“If I had, Xueyan would immediately have asked me to telegraph Ruiqing for help and have Tongquan unsealed.

那两家庄号的情形，我一点都不知道，
I know nothing whatever about those two banks.

现在一启封，一定挤兑，
The moment they reopen there is bound to be a run.

撑不住出了事，还是要封，
If they cannot withstand it and trouble follows, they will have to be sealed again.

那又何苦？“
What would be the point?”


“你把他看错了，
“You have misjudged him.

他决不会这么冒昧，让你做为难的事。”
He would never be so inconsiderate as to put you in an impossible position.

莲珠又说：“你说那两家庄号的情形一点都不知道，可是人家原主，知道啊！
You say you know nothing about those two banks, but their owner does!

听他说了，看要不要紧，再想办法。
You could have listened to him, decided how serious the situation was, and then looked for a solution.

你现在瞒着他不说，又不知道该怎么办，
Instead you conceal the news from him and have no idea what to do.

请问怎么回复人家？
How, may I ask, are you going to answer the telegram?

公事哪有这样子办的？”
Is that any way to conduct official business?”

一顿排揎，将德馨说得哑口无言。
Her scolding left Dexin speechless.

“看起来我是没有做对。”他问：
“It appears I did the wrong thing,” he admitted.

“如今该怎么弥补？”
“How can I make it right now?”

“只有我去一趟，去看罗四姐，
“I shall have to go and see Luo Sijie.

就说你当时怕胡大先生心境不好，没有敢说，特为要我通知罗四姐，看是要怎么办才妥当。”
I will say that you were afraid Mr Hu was too distressed to bear the news and did not dare tell him, so you have specially sent me to inform her and discuss what ought to be done.”

“好！”德馨答说：
“Very well,” Dexin answered.

“不过也不必今天晚上，
“But there is no need to go tonight.

明儿一大早好了。”
First thing tomorrow morning will do.”

“不！
“No!

这跟救人一样，
This is like saving someone's life.

耽误不得。”
We cannot afford to delay.”

“好吧！
“All right, then.

那就辛苦你了。”
I am sorry to put you to the trouble.”

“辛苦小事，
“The trouble is nothing.

你得给我一个底，我才好跟人家去谈。”莲珠又说：
But you must give me something definite to work with before I can talk to them.

“我的意思是你能给他担多少风险？”
What I mean is, how much risk are you prepared to take for him?”

“这要看他们的情形，
“That depends on their position.

譬如说一二十万银子可以维持住的，我就打电报请宁波关代垫，归藩库归还。
If, for example, one or two hundred thousand taels would keep them afloat, I could telegraph the Ningbo Customs and ask them to advance it, with repayment from the provincial treasury.

窟窿太大，可就为难了。”
If the hole is too large, it would be difficult.”

“那么，到底是十万呢？还是二十万？”
“Then which is it: a hundred thousand or two hundred thousand?”

“二十万吧！”
“Two hundred thousand.”


于是先遣阿福去通知，
A’fu was sent ahead to announce her visit.

随后一乘小轿，悄悄将莲珠抬到无主街。
Then a small sedan chair quietly carried Lianzhu to Yuanbao Street.

其时三更已过，
The third watch had already passed.

胡雪岩在百狮楼上与螺蛳太太围炉低语，
Upstairs in the Hundred Lions Tower, Hu Xueyan and Madam Luosi sat by the brazier talking softly.

谈的却不是阜康，也不是丝茧，而是年轻时候的往事。
Their subject was neither Fukang nor silk and cocoons, but memories of their youth.

这是由扶乩谈起来的，
The conversation had begun with spirit-writing.

“乌先生接了你回来，你到阜康，他回家，
“After Mr Wu went to meet you, you went on to Fukang and he came home.

顺路经过一处乩坛，进去看了看，
On the way he passed a spirit-writing altar and went in to have a look.

也替我们求了一求，看前途如何？
He also asked on our behalf what the future held.

哪晓得降坛的是一位大忠臣，叫什么史可法。
Who should descend to the altar but some great loyal minister called Shi Kefa!

乌先生知道这个人，
Mr Wu knew who he was.

说是当初清兵到扬州时殉难的。”螺蛳太太问道：
He said the man had died a martyr when the Qing troops reached Yangzhou.

“老爷，你晓得不晓得这个人？”
Have you heard of him, Master?”

“听说过。”胡雪岩问：
“I have heard the name,” Hu replied.

“史可法降坛以后怎么说？”
“What did Shi Kefa say after he descended?”

“做了一首诗。
“He composed a poem.

喏，”
Here.”

螺蛳太太从梳妆台抽斗中取出一张黄纸，递给胡雪岩说：
Madam Luosi took a sheet of yellow paper from a drawer in her dressing table and handed it to him.

“你看。”
“Read it.”

黄纸上写的是一首七绝：“江黑云寒闭水城，饥兵守堞夜频惊，
On the paper was a seven-character quatrain: “Dark river, cold clouds: the moated city closed; / Hungry soldiers guard the walls, startled again at night.

此时自在茅檐下，风雨萧萧听柝声。”
/ Now, free from care beneath a thatched roof, / Through sighing wind and rain, I hear the watchman's clapper.”

胡雪岩将这首诗吟哦数过，方始开口。
Hu recited it several times before speaking.


“乌先生看了这首诗，有没有给你破解？”
“Did Mr Wu explain the poem to you?”

“有的。
“Yes.

乌先生说，这首诗一定是史可法守扬州的时候做的，
He said Shi Kefa must have written it while defending Yangzhou.

情形是很危险，不过为人要学史可法，稳得住！
The situation was very dangerous, but we should learn from him to remain steady.

管他后荒马乱，自自在在睡在茅檐下，听风听雨，听城头上打更。”
No matter how wild the fighting grows, lie at ease beneath the thatch, listening to the wind and rain and to the watch being called on the walls.”

“他人是很稳，不过大明的江山没有稳住。
“He may have remained steady, but he did not keep the Ming empire standing.

我看这首诗不是这个意思。”
I do not think that is what the poem means.”

“那么，老爷你说，是啥意思。”
“Then what do you think it means, Master?”

“那时候史可法手里有几十万人马，
“At that time Shi Kefa had several hundred thousand men under his command.

可惜史可法不是曾文正、左大人，
Unfortunately he was no Zeng Guofan or Lord Zuo.

兵多没有用，真正叫一筹莫展。
Numbers were no use; he truly did not know which way to turn.

早知如此，不如不要当元帅、带兵马，做个一品老者姓，
Had he known what was coming, he would have done better never to become a commander or lead an army, but to remain a commoner of the highest order.

肩上没有千斤重担，就困在茅檐下面，自自在在一颗心是安逸的。”
Without that enormous burden on his shoulders, he could have slept beneath a thatched roof with an easy, untroubled heart.”

胡雪岩声音凄凉地说：
Hu's voice was desolate.

“罗四姐，如果当年你嫁了我，我没有同王抚台的那番遭遇，凭我们两个人同心协力，安安稳稳吃一口饱饭，
“Luo Sijie, if you had married me in those days, and I had never had those dealings with Governor Wang, the two of us could have worked together and made a quiet, sufficient living.

哪里会有今天的苦恼。”
How could we have ended up with the misery we have today?”

由此开始，细数往事，又兴奋、又悲伤，
From there they began recalling the past in detail, sometimes with excitement and sometimes with sadness.

但不管兴奋悲伤都是一种安慰。
Yet whether their memories excited or saddened them, they brought comfort.


正在谈得入神时忽然得报，说莲珠马上要来，
They were absorbed in their conversation when word suddenly came that Lianzhu would shortly arrive.

不由得都愣住了。
Both were taken aback.

莲珠此来，目的何在，虽不可知，但可断定的是，一定出于好意，而且一定有极紧要的事谈。
They could not know her purpose, but they could be certain that it sprang from goodwill and concerned something extremely urgent.

因此，要考虑的是在什么地方接见，胡雪岩应该不应该在场。
What they had to decide was where to receive her and whether Hu should be present.

在这时候，当然不容他们从容商议，
There was no time for leisurely discussion.

螺蛳太太本想在那间专为接待贵客，装饰得金碧辉煌的“藏翠轩”接见，
Madam Luosi first thought of the resplendent Cangcui Pavilion, reserved for distinguished guests.

但时已隆冬，即令现搬几个在火盆过去，屋子也一时暖和不起来，
But it was the depths of winter, and even if several large braziers were carried in at once, the room would not warm up quickly enough.

所以稍想一想，
After a moment's thought she decided.

当机立断地对胡雪岩说：“你先从后楼下去，等一下从前楼上来。”
“Go down by the back stairs first,” she told Hu, “and come up by the front stairs in a little while.”

胡雪岩点一点头，匆匆而去。
Hu nodded and hurried away.

螺蛳太太便下楼亲自接了莲珠上来，
Madam Luosi went downstairs to meet Lianzhu herself and bring her up.

一大群丫头围绕着，捧凤凰似地接莲珠安置在靠近火盆的一张安乐椅上，手炉、脚炉、清茶、水果一一送到面前。
A whole cluster of maids surrounded their visitor, attending her as reverently as if she were a phoenix. They settled her in an easy chair close to the brazier and brought hand warmers, foot warmers, tea, and fruit.

螺蛳太太顾不得跟她说话，只是指挥着丫头招待客人，
Madam Luosi was too busy directing the maids to speak to her.

直待告一段落，丫头都退了出去，她才开口。
Only when everything was ready and the maids had withdrawn did she begin.

“有啥事情，打发人来通知我一声，我去看你就是。
“Whatever it is, you need only have sent someone to tell me, and I would have gone to see you.

这么冷的天，万一冻出病来，叫我们心里怎么过意得去？”
In weather as cold as this, if you caught a chill and fell ill, how could we forgive ourselves?”

“你我不分彼此，
“There is no distinction between you and me.

与其请你来，多费一层周折，我也仍旧是耽误工夫，
Sending for you would only have added another step and wasted more time.

倒不如我亲自来一趟。”
It was better to come myself.”

莲珠四面看了一下问：
Lianzhu looked about the room.

“胡大先生不在这里？”
“Is Mr Hu not here?”

“去通知他了，
“They have gone to tell him.

马上就会来的，”
He will be here directly.”


“趁胡大先生不在这里，我先跟你说了吧！
“While he is away, let me tell you first.

胡大先生在我们那里，不是来了个电报吗？
A telegram came while Mr Hu was at our house, did it not?

是宁波打来的，
It was from Ningbo.

通泉、通裕都出毛病了！
Both Tongquan and Tongyu are in trouble.

我们者爷怕他刚回杭州，心境不好，没有敢告诉他，
Our master was afraid that, having only just returned to Hangzhou, he was already too distressed, and did not dare tell him.

特为让我来一趟，跟你来谈。”
He has specially sent me to discuss it with you.”

螺蛳太太心里一跳，但不能不强自镇静，
Madam Luosi's heart gave a leap, but she forced herself to remain composed.

“多谢，多谢！”
“Thank you, thank you!”

她还要再说下去时，只听楼梯上有脚步声，便停了下来。
She was about to continue when footsteps sounded on the stairs, and she stopped.

“老爷来了！”有个丫头掀开门帘说。
“The master is here!” a maid announced, lifting the curtain.

“罗四姐！”莲珠问说：“要不要当着他的面谈？”
“Luo Sijie,” Lianzhu asked, “shall we discuss it in front of him?”

“瞒也瞒不住的。”
“We cannot keep it from him in any case.”

“好！”
“Very well.”

其时胡雪岩已经衣冠整齐地一路拱手、一路走进来说道：
By now Hu was approaching neatly dressed, saluting with clasped hands as he entered.

“失迎，失迎！
“Forgive me for not coming out to meet you!

二太太这么晚还来，当然是为我的事，
If you have come so late, Second Madam, it can only be on my account.

这份情分，真正不知道怎么说了！
I truly do not know how to express my gratitude for such kindness.”

““自己人不必说这些话。”莲珠说道：
“We are all one family; there is no need for that,” Lianzhu said.

“刚刚宁波来的电报，没有拿给你看的缘故，我跟罗四姐说过了，
“I have told Luo Sijie why we did not show you the telegram from Ningbo just now.

她说不必瞒你，那就请你先看电报。”
She says there is no need to conceal it, so please read it first.”


宁波的情形，在胡雪岩真所谓变起不测，
To Hu, the situation in Ningbo was indeed an unforeseen turn for the worse.

因为宓本常在那里，
Mi Benchang was there.

他维持不住上海的阜康，莫非连宁波的“两通”都会撑不起来？
If he could not save the Shanghai Fukang, was he incapable even of keeping Ningbo's two Tong banks afloat?

但因此使他想到，这或许是宓本常的运用，
Then another possibility occurred to him: perhaps this was some manoeuvre of Mi's.

亦未可知，虽不知他葫芦里卖的什么药？不过有一点是很明显的，
He did not know what Mi was up to, but one thing was clear.

宓本常本来就已有“拆烂污”的迹象，
Mi had already shown signs of being prepared to let the whole affair fall to pieces.

如果自己再出头去管宁彼的事，越发会助长他“天塌下来有长人顶”的想法，
If Hu now stepped forward to take charge in Ningbo as well, he would only encourage Mi to think that when the sky fell, someone taller would hold it up.

因此，他觉得如今首要之着，是借重宁波官场的势力，逼一逼宓本常，让他的把所有的力量拿出来。
The first necessity, Hu decided, was to use the influence of Ningbo's officials to put pressure on Mi and make him employ every resource at his disposal.


于是他说：“不瞒二太太说，这回的事情，总怪我有眼无珠，用错了人。
“To speak frankly, Second Madam,” he said, “the blame for this affair lies with me for being blind enough to choose the wrong man.

上海阜康的档手叫宓本常，
The manager of the Shanghai Fukang is called Mi Benchang.

他是宁波人，
He comes from Ningbo.

瞒着我私下同他的亲戚做南北货生意，
Without telling me, he went into the trade in northern and southern produce with his relatives.

听说有两条沙船在海里，叫法国兵船打沉了，
I hear that two of their sand junks were sunk at sea by French warships.

亏空的是阜康的款子，
The money lost belonged to Fukang.

数目虽然不大，而在目前银根极紧的当口，就显得有关系了。
The sum was not especially large, but at a time when cash is so desperately scarce, it matters.

此刻他人在宁波，
He is in Ningbo now.

通泉、通裕的情形，是不是他弄出来的，我不敢说。
I cannot say whether he has deliberately brought about the trouble at Tongquan and Tongyu.

不过，以他的手面，要维持通泉、通裕是办得到的。
But with his connections and resources, he is capable of keeping them going.

藩台肯替我垫二十万银子，实在感激不尽，
I am profoundly grateful that the provincial treasurer is willing to advance two hundred thousand taels for me.

不过二太太头痛医头，脚痛医脚，说实话，徒然连累好朋友，并不是好办法，
Yet, Second Madam, treating the head when the head aches and the foot when the foot aches is no real solution. To be frank, it only drags good friends into trouble.

做事要做得干净、彻底，
A matter must be settled cleanly and thoroughly.

我胡某人最好面子，
No one values his reputation more than I do.

如今面子撕了一条缝，
Mine has now developed a tear.

补起来容易，就怕这里弥补了，那面又裂开，
It would be easy enough to patch, but what I fear is that as soon as one tear is mended, another will appear elsewhere.

所以我现在的想法是，先要保住没有裂开的地方。
My present concern, therefore, is to protect the places that have not yet split.

二太太，请你先替我谢谢藩台，同时请你把我的意思，同藩台说一说。“
Please thank the treasurer for me, Second Madam, and explain my thinking to him.”


听他长篇大套地在谈，莲珠不断点头，表示完全能领会他的意思，
Throughout his long explanation Lianzhu nodded, showing that she understood him perfectly.

等他说完，随即答道：“胡大先生的做法是对的，
When he finished she answered at once, “You are right, Mr Hu.

我一定把你的话，同我们老爷说到，
I shall certainly tell our master what you have said.

帮你的忙，要从大处去落墨。
If we are to help you, we must address the larger picture.

不过，宁波的事，你还没有说出一个办法来！”
But you have still not proposed a way of dealing with Ningbo.”

“是。”胡雪岩答说：
“Quite so,” Hu replied.

“宓本常在宁波，
“Mi Benchang is in Ningbo.

找到宓本常，就可以责成他来维持。
Once he is found, he can be held responsible for keeping the banks going.

请藩台就照意思拟复电好了。”
Please ask the treasurer to draft his reply along those lines.”

“如果宓本常不听呢？”莲珠问说：
“And if Mi Benchang refuses?” Lianzhu asked.

“是不是什么手段都可以用？”
“May any means be used?”

这便是说，是否可以拘禁到讯？
What she meant was whether he could be detained and brought in for questioning.

螺蛳太太对宓本常犹有好感，深恐他吃亏便即说道：
Madam Luosi still had a good opinion of Mi and feared that he might suffer.

“打狗看主人面，
“Even when beating a dog, one must consider its master,” she said at once.

他虽做错了事，到底是我们的人。
“He may have done wrong, but he is still one of our people.

这一点……”
That point…”

她顿住了，不知道该怎么说。
She stopped, unsure how to continue.

“这一点，我们都很明白。
“We understand that very well.

不过，人家不知道，电报当中也很难说得清楚。”
But the officials there do not, and it is difficult to make the position clear in a telegram.”

莲珠想了一下说：
Lianzhu thought for a moment.

“是不是胡大先生请你的师爷拟个稿子，
“Why not have your own secretary prepare a draft, Mr Hu?

我带回去，请我们老爷照发？”
I could take it back and ask our master to send it exactly as written.”


胡雪岩答应着，下楼而去。
Hu agreed and went downstairs.

莲珠目送他走远了，执着螺蛳太太的手，
Lianzhu watched him go, then took Madam Luosi's hand.

欲言又止，脸上是万般无奈的神情，让螺蛳太太反过来不能不安慰她了。
She seemed about to speak but checked herself, her face so full of helpless distress that Madam Luosi had to comfort her instead.

“我晓得你替我们难过，
“I know you are grieving for us.

不过，你请放心，
But do not worry.

不要紧的，
It will be all right.

船到桥门自会直。”
A boat will find its way straight when it reaches the bridge.”

“罗四姐，”莲珠叹口气说：“我同我们老爷，真是恨不得能平空发一笔大财！”
“Luo Sijie,” Lianzhu sighed, “our master and I wish we could suddenly come into a great fortune from nowhere!”

“你不要这样子说。”
“Please do not say that.”

螺蛳太太极其感动，也紧握着她的双手，
Deeply moved, Madam Luosi clasped both her hands.

“我同胡大先生最难过的，也就是连累藩台同你替我们担心。
“What pains Mr Hu and me most is that we have made you and the treasurer worry on our account.

这份人情债，只怕要欠到来生了。”
I fear we shall still owe you this debt of kindness in our next life.”


听得这话，莲珠怀然动容，
At these words Lianzhu's expression changed.

紧盯着她看了好一会，方始问道：“罗四姐，你到底有什么打算？”
She looked steadily at Madam Luosi for a long time before asking, “Luo Sijie, what plans have you actually made?”

螺蛳太太愕然，
Madam Luosi was startled.

好一会才明白她的意思，
It took her some time to grasp what Lianzhu meant.

“你倒说说看，”她反问一句：“应该怎么个打算？”
“Tell me, then,” she asked in return, “what plans ought I to make?”

“我不知道。
“I do not know.

我总觉得到了这个时候，总应该仔细想一想。
I only feel that at a time like this, you ought to think things through very carefully.

罗四姐，”莲珠是极冷静的语气，“我们是自己人，
Luo Sijie”—Lianzhu's tone was perfectly calm—“we are close enough to speak plainly.

旁观者清，
An onlooker sometimes sees more clearly.

我见到了不能不提醒你。”
When I see something, I cannot help reminding you.”

这话大有文章了，
There was much beneath these words.

螺蛳太太急急问说：“是不是藩台有什么消息？”
Madam Luosi asked anxiously, “Has the treasurer heard something?”

“不是他有什么消息，
“It is not that he has heard anything.

如果他有了什么消息，事情只怕就来不及了。”
If he had, I am afraid it might already be too late.”

螺蛳太太心一沉，
Madam Luosi's heart sank.

怔怔地思索了好一会问说：“藩台是不是有什么话？”
She sat thinking in a daze for some time, then asked, “Has he said anything?”

“话是没有。
“Nothing.

不过他着急是看得出来的。”
But anyone can see that he is worried.”

迂回吞吐，说了好一会，螺蛳太太方始明白莲珠的意思，
Only after a good deal of hesitation and indirect talk did Madam Luosi understand.

是暗示她如果觉得有将财物寄顿他处的必要，她可以效劳。
Lianzhu was hinting that if she felt it necessary to place money and valuables elsewhere for safekeeping, Lianzhu would be willing to help.


莲珠一向言辞爽脆深刻，
Lianzhu usually spoke with briskness and penetration.

隐微难达之情，在她往往三、五句话，便能直透深处。
Feelings too subtle to express could often be laid bare by her in three or five sentences.

唯独这件事如此难于出口，其中的道理，在同样善体人情的螺蛳太太；不难明白，
That this subject alone should prove so difficult was not hard for Madam Luosi, equally sensitive to human feelings, to understand.

正因为交情厚了，才不易措词。
Their very closeness made the words harder to find.

因为，要谈这件事，便有一个不忍出口的前提，就是阜康的风潮，会牵连到许多衙门来提公款，
For to raise the matter was to imply something too cruel to say aloud: the crisis at Fukang might cause numerous government offices to demand their public funds.

倘或无以应付，即可查封财产备抵，而犹不足，不可避免地就会抄家。
If Hu could not pay, his property could be sealed as security; if that still proved insufficient, confiscation of the household would inevitably follow.

莲珠一面说，一面心里就有一种顾忌，是设想螺蛳太太听了她的话以后的想法：什么！
As Lianzhu spoke, she was troubled by the thought of how Madam Luosi might interpret her words: What!

已经看得我们胡家要抄家了。
Had she already decided that the Hu household was going to be confiscated?

照此看来是黄鼠狼给鸡拜年，没有存着好心。
In that case, she was like a weasel paying a New Year's call on a hen—her intentions were far from kind.

如果再谈到寄顿财物，似乎坐实了她没有存着好心，
If she then offered to keep their valuables, would that not seem to confirm the suspicion?

胡家抄家于她有什么好处？
What could she gain from the confiscation of the Hu estate?

不就可以吞没了寄存的财物了吗？
Surely she could simply swallow up whatever they had entrusted to her.

不但抄家，最好充军、杀头，才能永绝后患。
And confiscation alone would not be enough: exile or execution would be better still, leaving no one to trouble her afterwards.

在这佯的顾虑之下，微稍聪明些的人都知道，这不是谈这件事的时候。
With such considerations in mind, anyone of even modest intelligence would know that this was no time to broach the subject.

但象这种寄顿家财，以防籍没的事，时机最要紧，愈早部署愈好。
Yet in arranging safekeeping for family wealth against confiscation, timing was crucial: the earlier the preparations, the better.

莲珠必是想到了这一点，
Lianzhu must have thought of that.

正见得是为好朋友深谋远虑的打算。
Her willingness to speak showed how carefully she was considering her friend's future.


转念到此，螺蛳太太异常感动，
When this occurred to Madam Luosi, she was deeply moved.

“莲姐，不枉我们同烧过一炉香。
“Sister Lian, we did not burn incense together in vain.

真正是急难可以倚靠，比同胞还亲的姐妹。”
You truly are a sister I can rely upon in adversity, closer to me than my own flesh and blood.”

她声音急促他说：
She spoke quickly.

“不过，莲姐，我现在只能作我自己的主，
“But for now I can only dispose of what belongs to me.

我有点首饰，
I have some jewellery.

初五那天还要戴，
I shall still need to wear it on the fifth.

过了这场喜事，我理好了送到你那里去。”
Once the wedding is over, I will put it in order and send it to you.”

这一说莲珠反倒推辞了，
This time Lianzhu held back.

她主要的是要提醒螺蛳太太，应该有最坏的打算。
Her main purpose had been to remind Madam Luosi to prepare for the worst.

如今看她显然已领会到了，那就不必亟亟，
Now that her meaning was clearly understood, there was no need to hurry.

“罗四姐，你懂我的意思就好。”她说，
“It is enough that you understand me, Luo Sijie,” she said.

“现在也还不到那步田地，
“Things have not yet come to that.

不过人无远虑，必有近忧，
Still, without thought for the future, trouble will soon be at one's door.

但愿你们逢凶化吉，遇难成祥，我今天的这番心里的话，完全是多余的。”
May every danger turn to good fortune for you, and may all these words from my heart prove entirely unnecessary.”

“莲姐，算命的都说我命中有‘贵人’，
“Sister Lian, the fortune-tellers always said there would be a benefactor in my life.

你今天就是。
Today, that benefactor is you.

但愿如你金口，
May your kind words come true.

等这场凤潮过了，莲姐，我们到普陀去烧香，
When this crisis is over, let us go to Putuo to burn incense together.

保佑藩台高升抚台，你老来结子，生个白胖儿子。”
We will pray for the treasurer to be promoted to governor, and for you to bear fruit in your later years and have a fine, plump baby boy.”


“不要说笑话了。”
“Do not tease me.”

莲珠的脸一红，嗫嚅了好一会说，“不知道你们胡庆余堂，有没有好的调经种子丸？”
Lianzhu blushed and hesitated for some time before saying, “I wonder whether your Hu Qingyu Hall has any good pills for regulating the monthly courses and promoting conception?”

“有，有！
“Yes, indeed!

我明天叫人送来。”
I shall have some sent over tomorrow.”

“不要，不要！”
“No, no!”

莲珠连连摇手，
Lianzhu waved both hands.

“传出去笑死人了。”
“If word got out, people would laugh themselves to death.”

“那么，改天我亲自带来。”
“Then I shall bring them myself another day.”

于是促膝低语谈了许多房帏间的心得，一直到胡雪岩重新上楼，方始结束。
Sitting close together, they went on to exchange a great many private observations about married intimacy, and stopped only when Hu returned upstairs.

此时此地居然有这样的闲情逸致，且不说螺蛳太太，连莲珠亦觉得是件不可思议的事。
That they could find leisure for such a conversation at such a moment seemed extraordinary even to Lianzhu, let alone Madam Luosi.


“稿子是拟好了，
“The draft is ready,” Hu said.

请二太太看看，有不妥当的地方，再改。”
“Please look it over, Second Madam, and alter anything that is unsuitable.”

“唷！胡大先生，我哪里看得懂。
“Oh, Mr Hu, how could I make sense of it?

你说给我听听好了。”
Tell me what it says instead.”

“大意是……”
“The substance of it is…”

大意是告诉宁波关监督瑞庆，说胡雪岩的态度光明磊落，
In substance, it informed Ruiqing, superintendent of the Ningbo Customs, that Hu Xueyan's intentions were open and honourable.

通泉、通裕的倒闭，虽非始料所及，但一定会负责到底，而且以胡雪岩的实力，亦必能转然为安。
Although the failure of Tongquan and Tongyu had taken him by surprise, he would accept responsibility to the end, and his resources were certainly sufficient to turn danger into safety.

但阜康受时间的影响，事出无奈，
Fukang's position, however, had been affected by the times, and the present difficulty was unavoidable.

为了维持市面，只可尽力协助，不宜逼迫过急，反生事端。
To preserve stability in the market, every assistance should be given; excessive pressure might merely provoke further trouble.

接着提到窗本常在宁彼，希望瑞庆即刻传他到案，责成他料理‘两通’，但所用手段，宜以劝导为主。
The telegram then mentioned that Mi Benchang was in Ningbo and requested that Ruiqing summon him at once and hold him responsible for putting the two Tong banks in order, relying chiefly on persuasion.

语气婉转周至，
Its tone was tactful and considerate throughout.

而且暗示瑞庆，若能费心尽力，料理妥当，德馨会面陈巡抚，今年的年终考绩，必有优异的“考语”。
It also hinted that if Ruiqing would take the necessary trouble and settle the affair satisfactorily, Dexin would report his efforts personally to the governor, ensuring an excellent assessment in that year's official review.

“好！好！”莲珠满口答应，
“Good, very good!” Lianzhu agreed readily.

“我请我们老爷，马上发出去。”
“I shall ask our master to send it at once.”

“是！多谢二太太。”
“Thank you, Second Madam.”

“我要走了。”
“I must be going.”

莲珠起身说道：
Lianzhu rose.

“你们也早点休息，
“You should go to bed early too.

初五办喜事，一定要把精神打起来。
With the wedding on the fifth, you must both keep your spirits up.”



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第五章（全章）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Five (complete)
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第五章 回光返照｜CHAPTER FIVE: THE LAST FLICKER


从第二天起，阜康照常开门，
From the following day, Fukang opened for business as usual.

典当、药店、丝行，凡是胡雪岩的事业，无不风平浪静。
The pawnshops, the pharmacy, the silk firms—every one of Hu Xueyan's enterprises appeared calm and undisturbed.

大家都兴致勃勃地注视着初五那一天胡家的喜事，阜康的风潮为一片喜气所冲淡了。
Everyone looked forward eagerly to the wedding at the Hu residence on the fifth, and the festive atmosphere softened the impression left by Fukang's troubles.

迎亲是在黄昏，但东平巷从遏开始，便挤满了看热闹的人，
The bridal procession was to arrive at dusk, but Dongping Lane was crowded with spectators from early in the day.

各式各样的灯牌、彩亭，排出去两三里路，
Lantern standards and decorated ceremonial pavilions of every kind stretched for two or three li.

执事人等，一律蓝袍黑褂，扛抬的伕子是簇新的蓝绸滚红边的棉袄，
The attendants all wore blue robes and black jackets, while the bearers had brand-new blue silk padded coats edged in red.

气派非凡。
It was a magnificent display.

其时元宝街胡家，从表面来看，依旧是一片兴旺气象，
At the Hu residence in Yuanbao Street, outward prosperity likewise seemed undiminished.

里里外外，张灯结彩，轿马纷纷，笑语盈盈，
Lanterns and decorations adorned the house inside and out, sedan chairs and horses came and went, and laughter filled the air.

只是仔细看去，到处都有三、五人聚集在一起，窃窃私议，
Yet a closer look revealed little groups of three or five whispering together everywhere.

一见有主人经过，不约而同都缩口不语，茫然地望着远处，
Whenever a member of the household passed, they all fell silent and stared vaguely into the distance.

看在眼里，令人无端起不安之感。
The sight inspired an uneasy feeling that was hard to account for.


这种情形，同样地也发生在花园中接待堂客之处，
The same thing happened in the garden, where the women guests were received.

而最令人不安的是，看不见“新娘子”，
Most disturbing of all was the bride's absence.

也就是三小姐，不知道躲在何处？
No one knew where the Third Young Lady was hiding.
