据者妈子、丫头们悄悄透露的消息，说是三小姐从这天一早就哭，眼泪一直没有停过。
According to information whispered by the older women and maids, she had been weeping since morning and had never stopped.

“新娘子”上花轿以前舍不得父母姐妹，哭一场原是不足为奇的事，
It was nothing unusual for a bride to cry before entering her wedding chair because she could not bear to leave her parents and sisters.

但一哭一整天，就不能不说是罕见之事了。
To cry all day, however, was rare.


不过，熟知胡家情形的客人，便觉得无足为奇。
Guests familiar with the Hu household were not surprised.

原来这三小姐的生母早逝，
The Third Young Lady's own mother had died early.

她跟胡雪岩在杭州二次失陷于太平军时，曾共过患难，
Her mother had shared Hu Xueyan's hardships during Hangzhou's second capture by the Taiping army.

因此贤惠的胡太太将三小姐视如己出，在比较陌生的堂客面前，都说她是亲生女儿，
The kind-hearted Mrs Hu consequently treated her as her own and told less familiar women visitors that she was her natural daughter.

从小娇生惯养，
The child had always been indulged.

加以从她出生不久，胡雪岩便为左宗棠所赏识，家业日兴，
Soon after her birth, Hu had won Zuo Zongtang's appreciation and the family fortunes had risen steadily.

都说她的命好，格外宠爱，
Everyone said she brought good fortune, and she was especially cherished.

要什么有什么，没有不如意的时候，但偏偏终身大事不如意，
Whatever she wanted, she received; nothing had ever disappointed her—except the marriage that would determine her whole life.

在定亲以后，才慢慢知道，“新郎倌”阿牛，脾气同他的小名一样，粗鲁不解温柔，
Only after the engagement had she gradually learned that the bridegroom, A’niu, was as ox-like as his nickname suggested: rough and quite without tenderness.

看唱本，听说书，离“后花园私订终身”的“落难公子”的才貌，差得十万八千里都不止。
He fell immeasurably short of the handsome, talented young gentleman in distress who secretly pledged his love in a rear garden, as she had read in ballad books and heard in storytellers' tales.

原本就一直委屈在心，
She had long felt wronged.

不道喜期前夕，会出阜康钱庄挤兑的风潮，
Now, on the eve of her wedding, a run had broken out at Fukang.

可想而知的，一定会有人说她命苦。
Inevitably, people would say she was unlucky.

她也听说，王善人想结这门亲，完全是巴结她家的财势，
She had also heard that Philanthropist Wang wanted the marriage solely to attach himself to her family's wealth and influence.

如果娘家败落，将来在夫家的日子就难过了。
If her parents' household fell, her life with her husband's family would be difficult.

她的这种隐痛，大家都猜想得到，但没有话去安慰她，
Everyone could guess at her hidden suffering, but no one had anything to say that would comfort her.

她也无法向人诉苦，除了哭以外，没有其他的办法，可以使她心里稍为好过些，
She could not confide her troubles either; crying was the only means of obtaining a little relief.

当然，胡太太与螺蛳太太都明白她的心境，但找不出一句扎扎实实的话来安慰她。
Mrs Hu and Madam Luosi understood her feelings well enough, but neither her principal mother nor her father's concubine could find a single solid reassurance to offer.

事实上三小姐的这两个嫡母与庶母，也是强打精神在应酬贺客，心里有着说不出的苦，
They themselves were forcing their spirits up to entertain the wedding guests, with an unspoken bitterness in their hearts.

自己都希望怎么能有一个好消息稍资安慰，
Each was longing for some good news to comfort herself.

哪里还能挖空心思来安慰别人？
How could they rack their brains to console anyone else?


“不要再哭了！
“Stop crying!

眼睛已经红肿了，
Your eyes are already red and swollen.

怎么见人？”
How will you face people?”

胡太太只有这样子一遍一遍他说，
Mrs Hu could only repeat this again and again.

双眼确是有点肿了，只有靠丫头们一遍一遍地打了新手中来替她热敷消肿。
The girl's eyes were indeed swollen, and the maids kept bringing fresh towels to apply hot compresses.

及至爆竹喧天，人声鼎沸，花轿已经到门，
At last firecrackers thundered, voices rose all around, and the bridal chair stood at the door.

三小姐犹自垂泪不止，
Still the Third Young Lady wept.

三催四请，只是不动身。
Despite repeated urging, she would not move.

胡太太与螺蛳太太还有些亲近的女眷，都急得不知如何是好。
Mrs Hu, Madam Luosi, and the women relatives closest to them were at their wits' end.

还是螺蛳太太有主意，
Madam Luosi finally found a way.

请大家退后几步，将凳子拉一拉近，在梳妆台前紧挨着三小姐坐下，轻声说道：
Asking the others to step back, she drew her stool close to the girl at the dressing table and spoke softly.

“你老子养到你十九岁好吃好穿好嫁妆，送你出门，
“Your father has brought you up to nineteen, given you fine food and clothes, and provided a splendid dowry to send you into marriage.

你如果有点良心，也要报答报答你老子。”
If you have any conscience, you ought to do something for him in return.”

这一说很有效验，
This had an immediate effect.

三小姐顿时止住了哭声，
The Third Young Lady stopped sobbing.

虽未开口而看着螺蛳太太的眼睛却在发问：要如何报答。
She said nothing, but her eyes asked how she could repay him.

“你老子一生争强好胜，
“Your father has striven to come out on top all his life.

尤其是现在这个当口，更加要咬紧牙关撑守。
At a moment like this, above all, he must grit his teeth and hold on.

不想。爷要争气，儿要撒屁‘，
Who would have thought it would be a case of ‘the father striving for honour while the child lets it all go with a fart’?

你这样子，把你老子的锐气都哭掉了！
With all this weeping, you are crying away his fighting spirit!”

““哪个说的？”
“Who says so?”

三小姐胸一挺，一副不服气的神情。
The girl straightened, suddenly defiant.

“ 这才是，
“That is more like it.

快拿热毛巾来！”螺蛳太太回头吩咐。
Quick, bring a hot towel!” Madam Luosi called over her shoulder.

“马上来！”丫头答得好响亮。
“Coming!” a maid answered brightly.


“三小姐！我有一扣上海汇丰银行的存折，一万两银子，
“Third Young Lady, I have a passbook for the Shanghai HSBC, with ten thousand taels on deposit.

你私下藏起来，不到要紧时候不要用。”
Keep it hidden, and do not use it unless it becomes necessary.

螺蛳太太又说：“我想也不会有啥要紧的时候，不过‘人是英雄钱是胆’，
I do not suppose any such necessity will arise, but ‘a person may be a hero, yet money gives that hero courage.’

有这扣折子，你的胆就壮了。”
With this passbook, you will feel braver.”

说着，塞过来一个纸包，并又关照：“图章是一个金戒指的戒面，上面一个‘罗’字。
She slipped a paper-wrapped packet into the girl's hands and added, “The seal is on the face of a gold ring, engraved with the character Luo.

等等到了花轿里，你顶好把戒指戴在手上。”
Once you are inside the bridal chair, you had better put the ring on your finger.”

她说一句，三小姐点一点头，
The Third Young Lady nodded at every instruction.

心里虽觉酸楚，但居然能忍住了眼泪。
Her heart still ached, but now she could hold back her tears.


胡家的喜事，到新郎倌、新娘子“三朝回门”，才算告一段落。
The wedding celebrations did not draw to a close until the bride and groom returned to her parents' home on the third day.

但这三天之中，局势又起了变化，而且激起了不小的风潮。
During those three days, however, the situation changed again and a serious new disturbance broke out.

风潮起在首善之地的京城。
It began in the capital, the empire's foremost city.

十一月初六，上海的消息传到天津，天津再传到北京，
On the sixth day of the eleventh month, the news from Shanghai reached Tianjin and passed from there to Beijing.

阜康福顿时被挤，
Fukangfu was immediately besieged by depositors.

白惟贤无以应付，只好上起排门，溜之大吉。
Unable to meet their demands, Wang Weixian put up the shutters and slipped away.

地痞起哄，半夜里打开排门放抢，
Local ruffians stirred up a mob, broke open the shutters at midnight, and looted the premises.

等巡城御史赶到，已经不成样子了。
By the time the censor responsible for patrolling the city arrived, the place was a wreck.

第二天一早来挤兑的人更多。
Early the next morning, still more people came to demand cash.

顺天府府尹只好会同巡城御史出安民布告，
The prefect of Shuntian had to join the patrolling censor in issuing a proclamation to reassure the public.

因为京城的老牌钱庄，一共四家，都开在东四牌楼，字号是恒兴、恒和、恒利、恒源，
Beijing's four long-established banks—Hengxing, Henghe, Hengli, and Hengyuan—were all in the Dongsi Pailou district.

有名的所谓“四大恒”，向来信用卓著，
Known as the Four Great Hengs, they had always enjoyed an outstanding reputation for reliability.

这里受了阜康福的影响，亦是挤满了要兑现银的客户。
Now, affected by Fukangfu's collapse, they too were packed with customers demanding silver.

“四大恒”如果一倒，市面不堪设想，
If the Four Great Hengs fell, the consequences for business were unthinkable.

所以地方官不能不出面维持，
The local authorities therefore had to intervene.

规定银票一百两以下照付，一百两至一千两暂付五十两，一千两以上暂付一百两。
They ordered notes below a hundred taels to be paid in full; those from a hundred to a thousand taels were to receive fifty taels for the time being; those above a thousand were to receive a hundred.

不过四大恒是勉强维持住了，
This barely kept the Four Great Hengs afloat.

资本规模较小的钱庄，一挤即倒，市面大受影响。
Smaller banks collapsed as soon as a run began, and commerce suffered severely.

同时，银票跌价，钱价上涨，
Meanwhile, banknotes depreciated and copper cash rose in value.

本来银贱钱贵，有益于小民生计，但由于银票跌价、物价波动，家无隔宿之粮的平民，未蒙其利，先受其害。
Cheap silver and dear copper cash would normally benefit ordinary people, but falling note values and fluctuating prices harmed households with not even a night's grain in reserve before they could enjoy any advantage.

这种情形惊动了朝廷，
The situation came to the court's attention.

胡雪岩知道大事要不妙了。
Hu knew that matters were taking a very dangerous turn.


其时古应春已经由上海专程赶到杭州，与胡雪岩来共患难。
By then Gu Yingchun had come specially from Shanghai to Hangzhou to share Hu's adversity.

他们相交三十年，但古应春为人极守分际，
They had been friends for thirty years, but Gu was scrupulous about observing proper boundaries.

对于胡雪岩的事业，有的了解极深，有的便很隔膜，
He knew some of Hu's businesses intimately and very little about others.

平时为了避嫌疑，不愿多打听，
Ordinarily he avoided making inquiries that might invite suspicion.

到此地步便顾不得嫌疑不嫌疑了。
At this point he could no longer concern himself with appearances.

“小爷叔，且不说纸包不住火，
“Little Uncle, it is not merely that paper cannot wrap up a fire.

一张纸戳个洞都不可以，
We cannot even afford to let a hole be poked through it.

因为大家都要从这个洞中来看内幕，那个洞就会越扯越大。”
Everyone will peer through that hole to see what is inside, and it will be torn wider and wider.”

他很吃力他说：
He spoke with difficulty.

“小爷叔，我看你索性自己把这张纸掀开，先让大家看个明白，
“I think you should simply lift the paper yourself and let everyone see clearly.

事情反倒容易下手。”
It would make matters easier to deal with.”

“你是说，我应该倒下来清理？”
“You mean I ought to admit failure and settle up?”

“莫非小爷叔没有转过这个念头？”
“Have you never considered it?”

“转过。”
“I have.”

胡雪岩的声音有气无力，
Hu's voice was faint.

“转过不止一次，
“More than once.

就是下不了决心。
I simply cannot make up my mind.

因为牵连太多。
Too many people are involved.”

““哪些牵连？”
“Who?”

“太多了。”
“So many.”

胡雪岩略停一下说：
Hu paused.

“譬如有些人当初看得起我，把钱存在我这里，
“For instance, some people thought well enough of me to entrust their money to me.

如今一倒下来，打折扣还人家，怎么说得过去？”
If I fail now and repay them only a fraction, how could I justify it?”

“那么，我倒请问小爷叔，你是不是有起死回生的把握？
“Then let me ask you this, Little Uncle: are you certain you can bring the business back to life?

拖一拖能够度过难关，存款可以不折不扣照付？”
Will holding on a little longer carry you through the crisis and enable you to repay every deposit in full?”

胡雪岩无以为答。
Hu had no answer.

到极其难堪的僵硬空气，快使得人要窒息了，他才开口。
Only when the strained silence had become almost suffocating did he speak.


“市面太坏，洋人太厉害，
“Business is too bad, and the foreigners are too formidable.

我不晓得怎么才能翻身？”
I do not know how to recover.

他说：“从前到处是机会，
In the old days there were opportunities everywhere.

钱庄不赚典当赚，典当不赚丝上赚，
If the banks made no money, the pawnshops did; if the pawnshops did not, silk would.

还有借洋债，买军火，
Then there were foreign loans and purchases of arms.

八个坛子七个盖，盖来盖去不会穿帮，
Eight jars and seven lids—you could keep moving the lids about without exposing anything.

现在八个坛子只有四个盖，
Now there are only four lids for eight jars.

两只手再灵活也照顾不到，
However quick your hands, you cannot cover them all.

而况旁边还有人盯在那里，专挑你盖不拢的坛子下手。
And people stand watching, ready to strike at whichever jar you cannot cover.

难，难！”
It is hard, terribly hard!”

“小爷叔，你现在至少还有四个盖，
“Little Uncle, at least you still have four lids.

盖来盖去，一失手，甚至于旁边的人来抢你的盖子，那时候……”
If you keep moving them about and make one mistake—or if someone beside you snatches one away—then…”

古应春迸足了劲说出一句话：
Gu summoned all his strength to say it.

“那时候，你上吊都没有人可怜你！”
“Then even if you hanged yourself, no one would pity you!”

这话说得胡雪岩毛骨惊然。
The words sent a chill through Hu.

越拖越坏，
Delay would only make things worse.

拖到拖不下去时，原形毕露，让人说一句死不足惜，其所谓“一世英名，付之流水”，
If he dragged matters out until the truth stood naked and people said he deserved to die, his lifelong reputation would be washed away.

那是胡雪岩怎么样也不能甘心的事。
That was something he could never accept.


“来人！”
“Someone!”

走来一个丫头，
A maid came in.

胡雪岩吩咐她将阿云唤了来，交代她告诉螺螂太太晚上在百狮楼吃饭，
Hu sent her to fetch A’yun and told the latter to inform Madam Luosi that he would dine in the Hundred Lions Tower that evening.

宾主一共四人，
There would be four people in all.

客人除了古应春以外，还有一个乌先生，立刻派人去通知。
Besides Gu Yingchun, Mr Wu was to be invited at once.

“我们晚上来好好商量，看到底应该怎么办？”胡雪岩说：
“We shall discuss the whole matter properly tonight and see what ought to be done,” Hu said.

“此刻我要去找几个人。”
“For now, I must go and see a few people.”

明耀璀璨，炉火熊熊，佳肴美酒，百狮楼上，富丽精致，一如往昔。
Brilliant lights, a roaring brazier, fine food and wine: the Hundred Lions Tower was as sumptuous and exquisite as ever.

宾主四人在表面上亦看不出有何异样，
The four people at the table likewise appeared outwardly unchanged.

倘或一定要找出与平日不同之处，只是胡雪岩的豪迈气概消失了。
If there was one difference, it was that Hu's old expansive confidence had vanished.

他是如此，其余的人的声音也都放低了。
As he grew subdued, the others lowered their voices too.

“今天就我们四个人，
“There are only the four of us tonight.

大家要说心里的话。”
Everyone must speak from the heart.”

胡雪岩的声音有些嘶哑，
Hu's voice was a little hoarse.

“这两天，什么事也不能做，闲工夫反而多了，
“These last two days I have been unable to do anything and have had more idle time than ever.

昨天一个人独坐无聊，抓了一本《三国演义》看，
Yesterday, sitting alone with nothing to occupy me, I picked up the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

诸葛亮在茅庐做诗‘大梦谁先觉，
In his thatched cottage Zhuge Liang recites, ‘Who first awakens from the great dream?’

我看应春是头一个从梦里醒过来的人。
I think Yingchun is the first to wake.

应春，你说给乌先生听。”
Yingchun, tell Mr Wu what you said.”

古应春这时候的语气，倒反不如最初那么激动了，
Gu spoke less emotionally now than he had at first.

同时，他也有了新的想法，可以作为越拖越坏，亟宜早作了断的补充理由。
He had also thought of a further reason for reaching a decision quickly, before delay made matters worse.

“阜康福一出事，四大恒受挤，京城市面大受影响，只怕有言官出来说话。
“With Fukangfu in trouble, the Four Great Hengs under siege, and business in the capital badly affected, I fear a censor may speak out.

一惊动了养心殿，要想象今天这样子坐下来慢慢商量，恐怕……”
Once it reaches the Hall of Mental Cultivation, I doubt we shall be able to sit here discussing things at our leisure as we are doing tonight…”

他没有再说下去。
He left the sentence unfinished.

大家都沉默着，
Everyone was silent.

不是不说话，而是倒闭清算这件事，关系太重了，必须多想一想。
It was not that they had nothing to say, but failure and liquidation were matters of such consequence that they needed careful thought.


“四姐，”胡雪岩指名发问：“你的意思呢？”
“Fourth Sister,” Hu asked directly, “what do you think?”

“拖下去是坏是好，总要拖得下去。”螺螂太太说，
“Whether delay would help or harm, the first question is whether we can keep it up.

“不说外面，光是老太太那里，我就觉得拖不下去了。
Leaving everything outside aside, I already feel that I cannot go on deceiving the old lady.

每天装得没事似地，实在吃力，
Pretending every day that nothing is wrong is exhausting.

老太太到底也是有眼睛的，有点看出来了，
She has eyes, after all, and has begun to notice.

一再地问：是不是出了什么事？
She keeps asking whether something has happened.

到有一天瞒不住了，这一个睛天霹雳打下来，老太太会不会吓坏？
When the day comes that we can no longer hide it and the news strikes like a thunderbolt, will it frighten her out of her senses?

真正叫人担心。”
I truly worry about that.”

这正也是胡雪岩下不得决心的原因之一，
This was one of the very reasons Hu had been unable to decide.

不过这时候他的态度有些改变了，
His attitude was changing, however.

心里在想的是，如何能使胡老太太不受太大的惊吓。
He was now wondering how to spare his mother too great a shock.


“我赞成应春先生的办法，
“I favour Mr Yingchun's proposal.

长痛不如短痛。”乌先生说：
A short pain is better than a long one,” Mr Wu said.

“大先生既然要我们说心里的话，有件事我不敢再摆在心里了，
“Since you have asked us to speak from the heart, there is something I dare no longer keep to myself.

有人说‘雪岩’两个字就是‘冰山，，
Some people say your name, Xueyan—Snow Rock—amounts to an iceberg.

前天我叫我孙了抽了一个字来拆……”
The day before yesterday, I had my grandson draw a character for divination…”

“是为我的事？”
“About my affairs?”

“是的。”
“Yes.”

乌先生拿手指蘸着茶汁，在紫檀桌面上一面写，
Dipping a finger in tea, Mr Wu wrote on the rosewood tabletop as he explained.

一面说：“抽出来的是个‘五归来不看山，的’‘字。
“He drew the character for ‘peak’ in the saying ‘After seeing the Five Sacred Peaks, one need see no other mountains.’

这个字不好，
It is an ominous character.

冰’山‘一倒，就是牢‘’之灾。
When the mountain of ice falls away, what remains is imprisonment.”

一听这话，螺蛳太太吓得脸色大变，
Madam Luosi's face changed in alarm.

胡雪岩便伸出手去扶住她的肩膀，安慰着说：
Hu put a hand on her shoulder.

“你不要怕。
“Do not be frightened.

冰山没有倒，就不要紧。
The iceberg has not fallen, so we are all right.

乌先生一定有说法。”
Mr Wu must have more to say.”

“是的。
“Indeed.

测字是触机，
Character divination depends upon a sudden insight.

刚刚听了应春先生的话，我觉得似乎更有道理了。
Hearing Mr Yingchun just now, I felt this reading made still more sense.

‘’字中间的‘言，就是言官，
The ‘speech’ in the centre represents the censors, whose duty is to speak.

现在是有座山压在那里，不要紧，
For the moment a mountain weighs upon them, and there is no danger.

靠山一倒，言肩出头，
Once your mountain of support falls, the censors emerge.

那时候左面是犬，右面也是犬，
Then there is a dog on the left and a dog on the right.

一犬吠日，众犬吠声，
One dog barks at the sun; the rest bark because they hear it.

群起而攻，
They all attack at once.

怎么吃得消。
How could anyone withstand them?”

“说得合情合理，胡雪岩、古应春都认为不可不信，
It sounded so coherent that both Hu and Gu felt they must take it seriously.

螺蛳大太更不用说，
Madam Luosi was more convinced still.

急急问道：“乌先生，靠山不倒莫非点事都没有了？”
“Mr Wu,” she asked anxiously, “does that mean there will be no trouble as long as the mountain behind us does not fall?”

“事情不会一点事没有，
“There will certainly be some trouble.

你看左面这只犬已经立了起来，张牙舞爪要扑过来咬人，
Look: the dog on the left has already risen, baring its teeth and claws to bite.

不过只要言官不出头就不要紧，
But as long as the censors do not come forward, it need not matter.

肉包子打狗让它乖乖儿不叫就没事。”
Throw the dog a meat bun and it will keep quiet. Then all will be well.”


“不错，一点不错！”胡雪岩说：
“Exactly, exactly!” Hu said.

“现在我们就要做两件事，
“We have two things to do now.

一件是我马上去看左大人，一件是赶紧写信给徐小云，请他务必在京里去看几个喜欢讲话的都老爷，好好儿敷衍一下。”
I must go and see Lord Zuo at once, and we must write immediately to Xu Xiaoyun, asking him to call on several of the more talkative censors in the capital and keep them in good humour.”

这就是“肉包子打狗”的策略，
This was the strategy of throwing a meat bun to the dog.

不过，乌先生认为写信缓不济急，要打电报。
Mr Wu thought a letter would be too slow; they must telegraph.

“是的。”
“Yes.”

胡雪岩皱着眉说：
Hu frowned.

“这种事，不能用明码，
“But this cannot be sent in plain code.

一用明码，盛杏芬马上就知道了。”
If it is, Sheng Xingsun will know at once.”

“德藩台同军机章京联络，总有密码吧？”
“Surely Treasurer De has a cipher for communicating with the secretaries of the Grand Council?”

“那是军机处公用的密码本，
“That is the Grand Council's official codebook.

为私事万不得已也只好说个三两句话，譬如某人病危，某人去世之类，
In an absolute emergency it might be used for two or three words on private business—someone critically ill, someone dead, that sort of thing.

我的事三两句话说不清楚。”
My affairs cannot be explained in a few words.”

“只要能说三两句话，就有办法。”古应春对电报往来的情形很熟悉，
“If we can send even a few words, there is a way,” said Gu, who knew the workings of telegraphic correspondence well.

“请德藩台打个密电给徐小云，告诉他加减多少码，
“Ask Treasurer De to send Xu Xiaoyun a cipher telegram telling him how much to add to or subtract from the code numbers.

我们就可以用密码了。”
We can then send our own message in cipher.”

“啊，啊！
“Ah!

这个法子好。
That is an excellent idea.

应春，你替我拟个稿子。”
Yingchun, draft it for me.”

胡雪岩对螺蛳太太说，“你去一趟，请德藩台马上替我用密码发。”
Turning to Madam Luosi, Hu said, “Go and ask Treasurer De to send it in cipher immediately.”


于是螺蛳太太亲自去端来笔砚，
She fetched a brush and inkstone herself.

古应春取张纸，一挥而就：“密。
Gu took a sheet of paper and wrote without pausing: “Confidential.

徐章京小云兄：另有电，
Brother Xu Xiaoyun, Secretary: Another telegram follows.

前五十字加计，以后减廿。
Add twenty for the first fifty characters; thereafter subtract twenty.

晓峰。”
Xiaofeng.”

这是临时设计的一种密码，前面五十字，照明码加二十，后面照码减二十，
This was an improvised cipher: twenty was to be added to the ordinary telegraph code for the first fifty characters and subtracted thereafter.

这是很简单的办法，仓卒之间瞒人耳目之计，要破还是很容易，
It was a simple device to conceal the message in haste, and would be easy enough to break.

但到得破了这个密码，已经事过境迁，秘密传递信息的功用已经达到了。
By the time it was broken, however, events would have moved on and it would already have served its purpose of transmitting the information secretly.

倒是“另有电”三字，很有学问，
The phrase “another telegram follows” was particularly shrewd.

电报生只以为德馨“另有电”，就不会注意胡雪岩的电报，
The telegraph clerk would assume that Dexin himself was sending another message and would pay no special attention to Hu's.

这样导人入歧途，是瞒天过海的一计。
This misleading suggestion was a way of slipping past unnoticed.


于是胡雪岩关照螺蛳太太，立刻去看莲珠，转请德馨代发密电，
Hu instructed Madam Luosi to go to Lianzhu at once and ask her to have Dexin send the confidential telegram.

同时将他打算第二天专程到江宁去看左宗棠的消息，顺便一提，托他向驻在拱宸桥的水师统带，借一条水火轮拖带坐船。
She was also to mention that he intended to leave specially for Jiangning the next day to see Zuo Zongtang, and ask Dexin to borrow a steamer from the naval commander stationed at Gongchen Bridge to tow his passenger boat.

“你去了就回来。”胡雪岩特地叮嘱，
“Come straight back afterwards,” Hu added particularly.

“我等你来收拾行李，”
“I shall wait for you to pack my things.”

接下来，胡雪岩请了专办笔墨的杨师爷来，口述大意，请他即刻草拟致徐用仪的电报稿，
He then summoned Secretary Yang, who handled his correspondence, dictated the substance of a telegram to Xu Yongyi, and asked him to prepare a draft immediately.

又找总管去预备次臼动身的坐船。
He also sent for the chief steward to arrange a boat for the next day's departure.

交代了这些杂务，他开始跟古应春及乌先生商议，如何来倚仗左宗棠这坐靠山，来化险为夷。
Having dealt with these matters, he began discussing with Gu and Mr Wu how to use Zuo's support to turn danger into safety.

“光是左大人帮忙还不够，
“Lord Zuo's help alone will not be enough,” Gu said.

要请左大人出面邀出一个人来，
“We need him to bring in one other person.

一起帮忙，事情就不要紧了。
If they help together, the difficulty will be over.

不过，”古应春皱着眉说：“只怕左大人不肯向这个人低头。”
Only”—he frowned—“I am afraid Lord Zuo will not consent to bow to this man.”

听到这一句，胡雪岩与乌先生都明白了，这个人指的是李鸿章。
Both Hu and Mr Wu understood at once: he meant Li Hongzhang.

如果两江、直隶，南北洋两大臣肯联手来支持胡雪岩，公家存款可以不动，
If the governors-general of Liangjiang and Zhili, who also directed the southern and northern maritime administrations, would jointly support Hu, the public deposits could remain untouched.

私人存款的大户，都是当朝显宦，看他们两人的面子，亦不好意思逼提，
The large private depositors were all prominent officials at court; out of regard for those two men, they too would hesitate to press for repayment.

那在胡雪岩就没有什么好为难的了。
Hu would then have little to worry about.


“这是死中求活的一着。”乌先生说：
“That is a move that could bring life out of death,” Mr Wu said.

“无论如何要请左大人委屈一回。
“Whatever happens, Lord Zuo must be persuaded to humble himself this once.

大先生，这步棋实在要早走。
Mr Hu, this move really should be made early.”

““说实话！”
“To tell the truth!”

胡雪岩懊丧地敲自己的额头，
Hu struck his forehead in frustration.

“前几天脑子里一团乱丝，
“These last few days my mind has been a tangle of threads.

除了想绷住场面以外，什么念头都不转，
I could think of nothing except keeping up appearances.

到了绷不住的时候，已经精神疲力竭，索性赖倒了，听天由命，
When I could no longer manage that, I was so utterly exhausted that I simply gave up and left everything to fate.

啥都不想。
I thought of nothing.

说起来，总怪我自己不好。”
The fault is my own.”

“亡羊补牢，尚未为晚。”乌先生说，
“It is not too late to mend the fold after losing a sheep,” Mr Wu replied.

“如果决定照这条路子去走，场面还是要绷住，
“If we decide upon this course, appearances must still be maintained.

应该切切实实打电报通知各处，无论如何要想法子维持。
Explicit telegrams should go to every branch, telling them to find some way to hold on, whatever happens.

好比打仗一样，哪怕只剩一兵一卒，也要守到底。”
It is like a battle: even if only one man remains, he must defend his position to the end.”

“说得不错。”
“Quite right.”

胡雪岩深深点头：
Hu nodded deeply.

“乌先生就请你来拟个电报稿子。”
“Mr Wu, will you draft that telegram?”


包先生义不容辞，
Mr Wu could not refuse.

桌上现成的文房四宝，
The writing materials were ready on the table.

铺纸伸毫，一面想，一面写，
He spread out a sheet and began composing as he wrote.

写到一半，杨师爷来交卷了。
Halfway through, Secretary Yang returned with his draft.

杨师爷的这个稿子，措词简洁含蓄，但说碍不够透彻，
Yang's language was concise and restrained, but it did not make the position sufficiently clear.

胡雪岩表面上自然连声道好，然后说道：“请你放在这里，等我想一想还有什么话应该说的。”
Hu naturally praised it aloud, then said, “Leave it here, please, while I consider whether anything needs adding.”

也就是杨师爷刚刚退了出去，螺蛳太太就回来了，带来一个颇令人意外的信息：
Yang had scarcely withdrawn when Madam Luosi returned with unexpected news.

“德藩台说，他要来看你。
“Treasurer De says he is coming to see you.

有好些话当面跟你谈……”
He has a number of things to discuss in person…”

“你为啥不说，我去看他。”胡雪岩打断她的话问。
“Why did you not say I would go to him?” Hu interrupted.

“我怎么没有说？
“Of course I did.

我说了。德藩台硬说他自己来的好。
I told him, but he insisted it would be better for him to come.

后来莲珠私下告诉我，你半夜里到藩台衙门，耳目众多，会有人说闲话。”
Afterwards Lianzhu told me privately that there were too many eyes and ears at the treasurer's yamen; if you went there in the middle of the night, people would talk.”

听这一说，胡雪岩暗暗心惊，同时也很难过，
Hu was secretly alarmed and deeply distressed.

看样子自己是被监视了，
It appeared that he was being watched.

从今以后，一举一动都要留神。
From now on, he would have to be careful about every movement.

“德藩台此刻在抽烟，
“Treasurer De is smoking just now.

等过足了痛就来。”螺蛳太太又说：
He will come once he has satisfied his craving,” Madam Luosi continued.

“密码没有发，
“He has not sent the cipher message.

不过他说他另有办法，等一下当面谈。”
He says he has another method and will explain it when he arrives.”

“喔。”
“Oh.

胡雪岩又问：“我要到南京去的话，你同他说了？”
Did you tell him I was going to Nanjing?”

“自然说了，
“Naturally.

只怕他就是为此，要赶了来看你。”
I suspect that is why he wants to hurry over.”


“好！
“Good.

先跟他谈一谈，做事就更加妥当了。”
It will be safer to discuss matters with him first.”

胡雪岩不避宾客，握着她的冰冷的手，怜惜他说：“这么多袖笼，你就不肯带一个。”
In front of the guests, Hu took her ice-cold hand and said tenderly, “With all those muffs you have, you will not bring a single one.”

螺蛳太大的袖笼总有十几个，紫貂、灰鼠、玄狐，叫得出名堂的珍贵皮裘她都有，搭配着皮袄的种类花式来用，
She owned more than a dozen—sable, squirrel, black fox, every precious fur one could name—chosen to match her various fur-lined coats.

可是在眼前这种情形之下，她哪里还有心思花在服饰上？
But at a time like this, how could she spare a thought for clothes?

此时听胡雪岩一说，想起这十来天眠食不安的日子，
His words brought back the sleeplessness and troubled meals of the past ten days or more.

眼泪几乎夺眶而出，赶紧转身避了开去。
Tears nearly rose to her eyes, and she quickly turned away.

“罗四姐，你慢走。”胡雪岩问道：
“Wait, Luo Sijie,” Hu said.

“等德藩台来了，请他在哪里坐？”
“Where shall we receive Treasurer De?”

“在洋客厅好了。
“In the Western drawing room.

那里比较舒服、方便。”
It is more comfortable and convenient.”

“对！
“Yes.

叫人把洋炉子生起来。”
Have the Western fireplace lit.”

“晓得了。”
“It shall be done.”

螺蛳太太答应着，下楼去预备接待宾客。
She went downstairs to prepare for their visitor.


洋客厅中是壁炉，壁炉前面有两张红丝绒的安乐椅，每张椅子旁边一张茶几，
The Western drawing room had a fireplace, with two red velvet easy chairs before it and a small table beside each.

主位这面只有一壶龙井，
On the host's side there was only a pot of Longjing tea.

客位这面有酒、有果碟，还有一碟松子糖、一碟猪油枣泥麻酥，
The guest's table held wine, dishes of fruit, pine-nut sweets, and flaky sesame cakes made with lard and date paste.

因为抽鸦片的人都爱甜食，是特为德馨所预备的。
Opium smokers liked sweet things, so these had been specially prepared for Dexin.

“这麻酥不坏！”
“These cakes are rather good!”

德馨拈了一块放在口中，咀嚼未终，伸手又去拈第二块了。
He put one in his mouth and reached for a second before he had finished chewing.

在外面接应待命的螺蛳太太，便悄悄问阿云：“麻酥还有多少？”
Waiting outside to direct the servants, Madam Luosi quietly asked A’yun, “How many cakes are left?”

“要多少有多少。”
“As many as you want.”

“我是说湖州送来的猪油枣泥麻酥。”
“I mean the lard-and-date-paste cakes sent from Huzhou.”

“喔，”
“Oh.

阿云说道：“我去看看。”
I shall go and look.”

“对，
“Yes.

你看有多少，都包好了，等下交给德藩台的跟班。”
Whatever is left, wrap it all up and give it to Treasurer De's attendant when he leaves.”

阿云奉命而去，
A’yun went to obey.

螺蛳太太便手捧一把细瓷金链的小茶壶，贴近板壁去听宾主谈话。
Holding a small fine-porcelain teapot with a gold chain, Madam Luosi moved close to the wooden partition to listen to host and guest.


“你要我打密电给徐小云，不大妥当，
“It would not be suitable for me to send Xu Xiaoyun the cipher message you requested,” Dexin said.

军机处的电报，盛杏荪的手下没有不照翻的，
“Sheng Xingsun's men decode every Grand Council telegram as a matter of course.

这种加减码了的密码，他们一看就明白了。”
They would understand that addition-and-subtraction device at a glance.

德馨又说：“我是打给我在京的一个朋友，让他去告诉徐小云，你有事托他，电报随后就发。”
Instead, I shall telegraph a friend of mine in the capital and have him tell Xu that you need his help and that a telegram will follow.”

“那么，我是用什么密码呢？”
“Then what cipher am I to use?”

“用我的那本。”
“The one in my own codebook.

德馨说道：“我那个朋友心思很灵，
That friend of mine has a remarkably ingenious mind.

编的密码，他们破不了的。”
They will not break the code he devised.”

胡雪岩心想，照此一说，密码也就不密了，
Hu thought that this would scarcely preserve secrecy either.

因为德馨不会把密码本惜给他用，
Dexin would not lend him the codebook.

拟了稿子交出去，重重周折，
Hu would have to hand over a draft, which would pass through one intermediary after another.

经手的人一多，能免秘密泄漏，反为不妙。
With so many people involved, a leak would be hard to avoid and might make matters worse.

与其如此，不如干脆跟他说明白，
He might as well tell Dexin plainly.

“晓翁，我想托徐小云替我在那些都老爷面前烧烧香，
“Mr Xiaofeng, I want Xu Xiaoyun to burn a little incense for me before those censors.

快过年了，
The New Year is near.

节敬从丰从速，请他们在家纳福，不必管闲事，
Let the seasonal gifts be generous and prompt, so that they can enjoy their blessings at home and leave other people's affairs alone.

就是帮了我的忙。
That would be a great help to me.

这些话，如果由晓翁来说，倒显得比我自己说，来得冠冕些。”他问：
If you put it to him, it would sound more respectable than if I did so myself.

“不晓得晓翁肯不肯帮我这个忙？”
Would you be willing to do me this favour?”

“有何不可？”
“Why should I not?”

“谢谢！谢谢！”
“Thank you, thank you!

胡雪岩问：“稿子是晓翁那里拟，还是我来预备？”
Shall the draft be prepared at your office, or should I have one ready?”

德馨此来是想定了一个宗旨的，
Dexin had come with a settled principle in mind.

胡雪岩的利益，到底不比自己的利益来得重要，
Hu's interests did not, after all, matter as much as his own.

但要顾到自己眼前的利益，至少要顾到胡雪岩将来的利益。
Yet to protect his own immediate interests, he had to show at least some concern for Hu's future.

换句话说：他可以为胡雪岩的将来做任何事，借以换取胡雪岩保全他眼前的利益，
In other words, he was willing to do anything for Hu's future in exchange for Hu's protection of his present position.

所以对于致电徐小云的要求，不但一口答应，而且觉得正是他向胡雪岩表现义气的一个机会。
He therefore agreed readily to the request to telegraph Xu, seeing in it an opportunity to demonstrate his loyalty as a friend.


因此，他略一沉吟后问：“你请一位笔下来得的朋友来，
After a moment's thought, Dexin said, “Ask a friend who writes well to join us.

我告诉他这个稿子怎么拟。”
I shall explain how this draft should be composed.”

笔下当然是杨师爷来得，但胡雪岩认为古应春比较合适，
Secretary Yang was naturally the strongest writer, but Hu thought Gu more suitable.

因为德馨口述的大意，可能会有不甚妥当的话，
Dexin might dictate something ill-judged.

杨师爷自然照录不误，古应春就一定会提出意见，请德馨重新斟酌。
Yang would simply write it down; Gu would certainly object and ask him to reconsider.

“我有个朋友古应春在这里，
“My friend Gu Yingchun is here.

晓翁不也见过的吗？”
You have met him, have you not?”

“啊，他在这里！”
“Ah, he is here!”

德馨很高兴他说：
Dexin sounded delighted.

“此君岂止见过！
“Met him?

那回我到上海很得他的力！
He was of the greatest assistance when I went to Shanghai.

快请他来。”
Do invite him in.”

于是叫人将古应春请了来与德馨相见。
Gu was summoned.

前年德馨到上海公千，古应春受胡雪岩之托，招待得非常周到，
Two years earlier, when Dexin had gone to Shanghai on official business, Gu had entertained him with the utmost care at Hu's request.

公事完了以后，带他微服冶游，消息一点不露，
Once the business was finished, he had taken him out incognito in pursuit of pleasure, without allowing a word to escape.

德馨大为满意，而且一直认为古应春很能干，有机会要收为己用。
Dexin had been thoroughly satisfied and had regarded Gu ever since as a capable man whom he would like to employ himself if the opportunity arose.

因此，一见之下，欢然道故，情意显得十分殷勤。
He greeted him with delighted reminiscences and marked warmth.

“我们办正事吧！”胡雪岩找个空隙插进去说：
“Let us get to business,” Hu interposed when he could.

“应春，刚才我同德藩台商量，徐小云那里，由德藩台出面托他，
“Yingchun, Treasurer De and I have agreed that he will approach Xu Xiaoyun for me.

第三者的措词，比较不受拘束。
A third party can speak with greater freedom.

德藩台答应我了，现在要拟个稿子，
The treasurer has consented; now we need a draft.

请德藩台说了意思，请你大笔一挥。
He will explain what he wishes to say, and you can put it on paper.

有啥没有弄明白的地方，你提出来请教德藩台。
If there is anything you do not quite understand, ask him about it.”

“古应春对这一暗示，当然默喻，
Gu naturally grasped the hint.

点一点头说：“等我来找张纸。”
Nodding, he said, “Let me find a sheet of paper.”

“那里不是笔砚！”
“Are there not brush and ink over there?”

“不！”
“No.”

古应春从身上掏出一支铅笔来，
Gu took a pencil from his pocket.

“我要找一张厚一点的纸。最好是高丽笺。
“I need thicker paper, preferably Korean stationery.”

““有，有！”螺蛳太太在门口答应。
“We have it!” Madam Luosi called from the doorway.

话虽如此，高丽笺却一时无处去觅，不过找到一张很厚的洋纸。
In fact, no Korean paper could be found immediately, but she brought a thick sheet of Western paper.

等古应春持笔在手，看着德馨时，他站起来背手踱了几步，开始口述。
When Gu sat ready, pencil in hand, Dexin rose, paced a few steps with his hands behind his back, and began to dictate.


“这个电报要说得透彻，
“The telegram must explain matters thoroughly.

第一段叙时局艰难，市面极坏，
The first paragraph should describe the difficult times and the dreadful state of commerce.

上海商号倒闲，不知凡几，
Countless Shanghai firms have closed.

这是非常之变，非一人一家之咎。”
This is an exceptional calamity, not the fault of one man or one establishment.”

古应春振笔如飞，
Gu's pencil flew.

将第一段的要点记下来以后，抬头说道：
Having noted the first paragraph's main points, he looked up.

“德公，请示第二段。”
“Your instructions for the second paragraph, Treasurer?”

“第二段要讲雪岩的实力，跟洋商为了收丝买茧这件事，合力相谋。
“The second must describe Xueyan's financial strength and the foreign merchants' concerted manoeuvres over buying silk and cocoons.

此外，还有一层说法，
There is also another point.

你们两位看，要不要提？”德馨紧接着说：“朝廷命沿省疆臣备战，
Do you think we should mention it?” Dexin continued, “The court has ordered the provincial authorities along the coast to prepare for war.

备战等于打仗，打仗要钱，
Preparing for war is much the same as fighting one, and war requires money.

两江藩库空虚，
The Liangjiang treasuries are empty.

左爵相向雪岩作将伯之呼，不能不勉力相助，
Lord Zuo has appealed to Xueyan for help, and Xueyan could not but do his utmost to assist.

以致头寸更紧，亦是被挤的原因之一。”
This has tightened his cash position still further and is one reason for the run.”

“不必，不必！”
“No, no!”

胡雪岩表示异议，
Hu objected.

“这一来，一定得罪好些人，
“That would offend a great many people.

尤其是李合肥，更不高兴。”
Li of Hefei, above all, would dislike it.”

“我亦觉得不提为妙。”古应春附和着说：
“I too think it better left unsaid,” Gu agreed.

“如果徐小云把这话透露给都老爷，一定节外生枝，把左大人牵涉进去，反而害他为难。”
“If Xu Xiaoyun passed that on to the censors, it would certainly create fresh complications, dragging Lord Zuo into the affair and putting him in a difficult position.”

“对，对！
“Quite right.

就不提。”
We shall omit it.”

德馨停了下来，等古应春笔停下来时，才讲第三段。
Dexin paused until Gu had finished writing, then began the third paragraph.


第三段是说胡雪岩非常负责，但信用已受影响，维持格外吃力，
This was to say that Hu was fully prepared to meet his responsibilities, but that his credit had suffered and it was now exceptionally difficult to carry on.

如今是在安危成败关头，
He stood at the dividing line between safety and disaster, success and failure.

是能安度难关，还是一败涂地，要看各方面的态度而定，
Whether he came through or collapsed completely depended upon the attitudes of others.

如果体谅他情非得已，相信他负责到底，他就一定能无负公私存户，
If they appreciated that circumstances had left him no choice and trusted him to accept responsibility to the end, he would certainly not fail either his public or his private depositors.

倘或目光短视，日急于提存兑现，甚至唯恐天下不乱，出以落井下石之举，只怕损人不利己，
If, however, they took a shortsighted view and pressed daily to withdraw deposits and redeem notes—or, worse, deliberately made trouble and threw stones at a man already down a well—they might harm others without benefiting themselves.

胡雪岩固然倒下来，存户只怕亦是所得无几。
Hu would fall, and his depositors would recover very little.

这一段话，胡雪岩与古应春都认为需要推敲，不过意见是古应春提出来的，
Both Hu and Gu thought this passage needed reconsidering, but Gu voiced the objections.

说“落井下石”似乎暗指李鸿章，
“Throwing stones at a man down a well” might seem to point at Li Hongzhang.

而损人不利己，只怕所得无几，更足以引起存户的恐慌，
Saying that depositors would gain little by harming others would be even more likely to cause panic.

尤其是公款，可以用查封的手段保全债权，而私人存户，势力不及公家，
Public funds could be protected by having property sealed, whereas private depositors lacked the government's power.

唯一的自保之计是，抢在前面，先下手为强。
Their only means of self-protection would be to rush ahead of everyone else and seize what they could.

那一来不是自陷于危地？
Would that not place Hu in danger of his own making?

“说得也是。”
“True enough.”

德馨趁机表明诚意，
Dexin took the opportunity to show his goodwill.

“我完全是说公道话，
“I am only trying to be fair.

如果你们觉得不妥，怎么说都行。”
If you find it unsuitable, we can phrase it however you wish.”

“我看，只说正面，不提反面。”
“I think we should state only the positive side and leave the negative unsaid.”

这就是说，要大家对胡雪岩体谅情非得已，相信负责到底。
That meant asking people to understand Hu's difficulties and trust him to fulfil his obligations.

德馨自然同意，接下来讲第四段。
Dexin naturally agreed and moved on to the fourth paragraph.


这一段说到最紧要的地方，
This reached the essential point.

但却要言不烦地只要说出自己这方面的希望，在京处于要津的徐用仪，自会有透彻的了解，
It need only state their wishes briefly and clearly; Xu Yongyi, occupying a key position in the capital, would understand thoroughly.

但接下来需要胡雪岩作一个安排，应该先商量好。
But the next step required an arrangement by Hu, which ought to be settled first.

“马上过年了，”他看着胡雪岩说：
“The New Year is close,” Dexin said, looking at him.

“今年的炭敬、节敬，你还送不送？”
“Are you still sending this year's charcoal gifts and seasonal presents?”

“当然照送。”胡雪岩毫不迟疑地回答，还加了一句：“恐怕还要多送。”
“Of course,” Hu answered without hesitation, adding, “I am afraid I must send more than usual.”

“你是怎么送法？”德馨问说：
“How will you do it?

“阜康福今年不能来办这件事了，
Fukangfu cannot handle the matter this year.

你托谁去办？款子从哪里拨？”
Whom will you entrust it to, and where will the money come from?”

这一问，胡雪岩才觉得事情很麻烦，
Only then did Hu realise how troublesome this was.

一时意乱如麻，怔怔地看着德馨，无以为答。
His thoughts tangled, and he stared at Dexin, unable to answer.

这时古应春忍不住开口了：
Gu could not refrain from speaking.

“事到如今，既然托了徐小云，索性一客不烦二主，都托他吧。”
“Since matters have come to this, and we are already asking Xu Xiaoyun's help, let us trouble the same man with everything.”

“是的。我也是这么想。”德馨说道：
“Yes, that is what I thought,” Dexin said.

“雪岩如果同意，咱们再商量步骤。”
“If Xueyan agrees, we can discuss the steps.”

“我同意。”
“I agree.”

“好！
“Good.

现在再谈款子从哪里拨？
Now, where is the money to come from?

这方面我是外行，只有你们自己琢磨。”
Finance is outside my province; you must work that out yourselves.”

于是胡雪岩与古应春稍作研究，便决定了办法，由汇丰银行汇一笔款子给徐用仪，请他支配。
After a brief discussion, Hu and Gu decided to remit a sum through HSBC to Xu Yongyi for him to distribute.

为了遮人耳目，这笔款子要由古应春出面来汇。
To avoid attracting attention, Gu would make the remittance in his own name.

当然，这一点先要在密电中交代明白。
Naturally this had to be explained in the confidential telegram first.


要斟酌的是不知道应该汇多少？
The question was how much to send.

胡雪岩想了一会说：
Hu thought for a while.

“我记得去年一共花了三万有余、四万不到。”
“I remember spending more than thirty thousand but less than forty thousand taels altogether last year.

胡雪岩说：“今年要多送，就应该汇六万银子。”
If we are to give more this year, we should remit sixty thousand.

“至于哪个该送多少？汪敬贤那里有单子，
As for who should receive what, Wang Jingxian has the list.

请小云找他去拿就是。”胡雪岩说。
Xiaoyun can ask him for it.”

德馨点点头说：
Dexin nodded.

“电报上应该这么说：雪岩虽在难中，对言路诸公及本省京官卒岁之年，仍极关怀，
“The telegram should say this: Although Xueyan is in difficulties, he remains deeply concerned for the year-end needs of the censors and the officials from his home province serving in the capital.

现由某某人出面自汇丰汇银六万两至京，
He is arranging for so-and-so to remit sixty thousand taels to Beijing through HSBC.

请他从汪敬贤处取来上年送炭敬、节敬名单，酌是加送，并为雪岩致意，
Ask Xu to obtain last year's list of charcoal and seasonal gifts from Wang Jingxian, increase the amounts as he judges appropriate, and convey Xueyan's respects.

只要对这一次阜康风潮，视若无事，不闻不问，则加以时日，难关定可安度。
If they will treat the present Fukang crisis as though nothing has happened, neither hearing nor asking about it, time will certainly enable him to overcome his difficulties.

即此便是成全雪岩了。
That alone will be sufficient assistance.

至于对雪岩有成见、或者素不好哗众取宠者，尤望加意安抚。”
Those prejudiced against him, or ordinarily disinclined to court public attention, should receive particular care and reassurance.”

这段话，意思非常明白，措词也还妥当，
The meaning was clear and the language reasonably suitable.

古应春几乎一字不更地照录，然后又将全稿细细修正，再用毛笔誊出清稿，请德馨与胡雪岩过目。
Gu recorded it almost word for word, then revised the entire draft carefully and made a clean copy with a brush for Dexin and Hu to inspect.

“很好！”
“Very good!”

德馨将稿子交给胡雪岩：
Dexin handed it to Hu.

“请你再细看一遍。”
“Please read it closely once more.”

“不必看了。
“There is no need.

拜托，拜托。”
I leave it in your hands.”

胡雪岩拱拱手说。
Hu saluted with clasped hands.

于是等德馨收起电报稿，
Dexin put away the draft.

古应春道声“失陪”，悄悄退下来以后，宾主复又开始密谈。
Gu excused himself and quietly withdrew, leaving host and guest to resume their confidential conversation.


“雪岩，咱们的交情，跟弟兄没有什么分别，
“Xueyan, our friendship is no different from brotherhood.

所以我说话没有什么忌讳，
That is why I need not guard my words with you.

否则反倒容易误事。
Otherwise we might only make matters worse.

你说是不是？”
Do you not agree?”

一听这段话，胡雪岩心里就有数了，
Hu understood at once.

他是早就抱定了宗旨的，不论怎么样，要出以光明磊落。
He had long ago resolved that, whatever happened, he must act openly and honourably.

生意失败，还可以重新来过，
A failed business could be started again.

做人失败不但再无复起的机会，而且几十年的声名，付之东流，还是他宁死不愿见的事。
Failure as a man would leave no possibility of recovery and would sweep away the reputation of decades—a prospect he would rather die than face.

于是，他略想一想，慨然答说：
After a moment's reflection, he answered with feeling.

“晓翁，路遥知马力，日久见人心，
“Mr Xiaofeng, distance tests a horse's strength, and time reveals a person's heart.

你今天晚上肯这样来，就是同我共患难。
By coming tonight, you show that you will share my adversity.

尤其是你刚才同我说的一番话，不枉我们相交一场。
What you have just said proves that our years of friendship have not been in vain.

晓翁，我完全是自作孽，
I have brought this upon myself.

开头把事情看轻了，
At first I took the matter too lightly.

偏偏又夹了小女的喜事，把顶宝贵的几天光阴耽误了。
Then my daughter's wedding intervened and I lost several days of the greatest value.

从现在起，我不能再走错一步。
From now on I cannot afford one more false step.

其实，恐怕也都嫌晚了，尽人事听天命而已。
Perhaps it is already too late; I can only do what lies within my power and leave the rest to Heaven.

趁现在我不能作主的时候，晓翁，你有话尽管说，
While matters are still in my hands, tell me whatever you wish.

我一定遵办。”
I shall certainly comply.”

德馨巴不得他有这句话，当好说道：
This was precisely what Dexin had hoped to hear.

“雪岩，咱们往好处想，可是不能不作最坏的打算。
“Xueyan, let us hope for the best, but we cannot neglect to prepare for the worst.

我有张单子在这里，你斟酌，
I have a list here for you to consider.

只要你说一句‘不要紧，，这张单子上的人，都归我替你去挺。”
If you can simply say there is no cause for concern, I shall hold off everyone on it for you.”


这张单子三寸高，六、七寸宽，蝇头小楷密密麻麻地写满了，
The sheet was three cun high and six or seven cun wide, densely covered in tiny regular characters.

胡雪岩一拿到手，先就烦了，
Hu felt irritated as soon as he took it.

欲待细看，却又以老花眼镜不在手边，
He tried to examine it, but his reading spectacles were not at hand.

将那张单子拉远移近，总是看不清楚，头都有些发晕了。
Moving it nearer and farther away did no good; he could not see clearly, and his head began to swim.

这一阵的胡雪岩，食不甘味，寝不安枕，
For some time he had neither eaten with appetite nor slept peacefully.

只以虚火上炎，看来依旧红光满面，其实是硬撑着的一个空架子，
A feverish flush still made his face look ruddy, but in reality he was an exhausted shell holding himself upright by force of will.

此时又急又气，突然双眼发黑，往后一倒，
Now, agitated and distressed, he suddenly saw black and fell backwards.

幸亏舶来的安乐椅，底座结实，文风不动，
Fortunately the imported easy chair had a solid base and did not move.

但旁边茶几上的一碗茶，却上他带翻了，
He did, however, knock over a cup on the adjacent table.

细瓷茶碗落地，碎成好几片，
The fine porcelain struck the floor and broke into several pieces.

声音虽下大，但已足以使得在隔室的螺蛳太太吃惊了。
The sound was not loud, but it was enough to alarm Madam Luosi in the next room.

“阿呀呀！”她一奔进来便情不自禁地大嚷，而且将杭州的土话都挤出来了，“甲格地，甲格地？”
“Oh! Oh!” she cried as she rushed in, so startled that she broke into Hangzhou dialect: “Jiage di, jiage di?”

这是有音无字的一句乡谈，犹之乎北方人口中的惊诧：“怎么啦？”
This was a local expression with a sound but no established written form, much like a northerner's startled “What has happened?”

她一面说，一面上前来掐胡雪岩的“人中”。鼻底唇上这道沟名谓“人中”，据说一个人昏厥需要急救时，掐人中是最有效的办法。
As she spoke, she went forward and pinched the groove between Hu's nose and upper lip. This groove was called the renzhong, and pinching it was said to be the most effective emergency measure when someone fainted.

不过胡雪岩只是虚弱，并未昏厥，
Hu, however, was merely weak, not unconscious.

人虽倒在安乐椅上，仿佛呼吸都停了似的，其实心里清楚得很。
Although he had fallen back in the chair and seemed almost to have stopped breathing, his mind was perfectly clear.

此刻让螺蛳太太养了多年的长指甲死命一掐，疼得眼泪直流，
When Madam Luosi dug in with the long nails she had cultivated for years, the pain brought tears streaming down his face.

象“炸尸”似地蹦了起来，将德馨吓了一大跳。
He sprang up like a corpse suddenly coming to life, giving Dexin a tremendous fright.


吓过以后，倒是欣喜，
Alarm soon gave way to delight.

“好了！好了！”
“He is all right, all right!

他说，“大概是心境的缘故。”
It must have been his state of mind.”

螺蜘太太已领悟到其中的原因，
Madam Luosi now understood.

“也不光是心境不好，
“It is not only that.

睡不熟、吃不好，
He cannot sleep or eat properly.

人太虚了。”接着便喊：“阿云，阿云！”将阿云唤了进来，是吩咐“开点心”，燕窝粥加鸽蛋，
He is far too weak.” She called A’yun in and ordered refreshments: bird's-nest porridge with pigeon's eggs.

但另有一碗参汤，原是早就为胡雪岩预备着的，
There was also a bowl of ginseng broth, prepared for Hu earlier.

只以有贵客在，她觉得主人不便独享，所以没有拿出来，
Because an honoured guest was present, she had thought it improper to serve it to the host alone and had kept it back.

这时候说不得了，只好做个虚伪人情。
Now she had no choice but to make a show of generosity.

“那碗参汤，你另外拿个碗分做两半，
“Bring another bowl and divide the ginseng broth into two portions.

一碗敬藩台。”
Offer one to the treasurer.”

这碗参汤，是慈禧太后赐胡老太太的吉林老山人参所熬成的，
The broth was made from old wild ginseng from Jilin, bestowed on Old Madam Hu by Empress Dowager Cixi.

补中益气，确具功效。胡雪岩的精神很快地恢复了，
It did indeed restore Hu's strength, and he soon revived.

拿起单子来只看最后，总数是三十二万多银子。
Picking up the list, he looked only at the total at the end: more than three hundred and twenty thousand taels.


“晓翁，”他说，“现款怕凑不出这许多，
“Mr Xiaofeng,” he said, “I am afraid I cannot assemble that much cash.

我拿容易变钱的细软抵给你。”
I shall settle with you in readily saleable valuables.”

“细”是珠宝，“软”指皮货字画，
These were the “fine and soft” valuables: “fine” meant jewels, and “soft” meant furs, paintings, and calligraphy.

以此作抵，估价很难，但德馨相信他只会低估，不会高算，心里很放心，
They would be difficult to value for payment in kind, but Dexin trusted Hu to understate rather than inflate their worth, and felt quite reassured.

但口头上却只有一番说词。
His spoken explanation was different.

“雪岩，我拿这个单子给你看，也不过是提醒你，有这些款子是我跟小妾的来头，
“Xueyan, I showed you this list only to remind you that these deposits came through my concubine and me.

并没有打算马上要。
I had no intention of demanding them immediately.

事到如今，我想你总帐总算过吧，
Now that matters have reached this point, I suppose you have drawn up an overall account?

人欠欠人，到底有多少，能不能抵得过来？”
How much are you owed, how much do you owe, and can one cover the other?”

问到这话，胡雪岩心里又乱又烦，
The question left Hu confused and vexed.

但德馨深夜见访，至少在表面上是跟朋友共患难，
Yet Dexin had come late at night, at least outwardly to share a friend's adversity.

他不能不定下心来，好好想一想，作个比较恳切的答复。
Hu had to compose himself, think carefully, and give a reasonably candid answer.

当然，“算总帐”这件事，是一直索绕在他心头的，
The need for a complete reckoning had, of course, been constantly on his mind.

不过想想就想不下去了，
But every time he began, he found himself unable to continue.

所以只是些断断续续、支离破碎的思绪，
His thoughts had remained disconnected fragments.

此时耐着性子，理了一下，才大致可以说出一个完整的想法。
Now, patiently putting them in order, he was able to give a roughly coherent account.


“要说人欠欠人，两相比较，照我的算法，足足有余，
“If we compare what is owed to me with what I owe, my reckoning leaves a comfortable surplus.

天津、上海两处的存货——丝跟茧子，照市价值到九百万，
The silk and cocoons held in Tianjin and Shanghai are worth nine million taels at market prices.

二十九家典当，有的是同人家合伙的，
There are twenty-nine pawnshops, some held in partnership.

通扯来算，独资有二十家，
Taken together, my shares amount to twenty wholly owned shops.

每家架本算它十万两，就是两百万，
At a hundred thousand taels of capital in each, that makes two million.

胡庆余堂起码要值五十万。
Hu Qingyu Hall must be worth at least half a million.

至于住的房子，就很难说。”
As for the house we live in, that is hard to say.”

“现住的房子不必算。”德馨问说：
“Leave your present home out of the calculation,” Dexin said.

“古董字画呢？”
“What about antiques, paintings, and calligraphy?”

提到古董字画，胡雪岩但有苦笑，
Hu could only smile bitterly.

因为赝鼎的居多，
Most were forgeries.

而且胡雪岩买古董字画，只是挥霍，绝少还价。
Besides, his collecting had been an extravagance; he seldom bargained.

有一回一个“古董鬼”说了一句：“胡大先生，我是实实惠惠照本钱卖，
Once an antique dealer had said, “Mr Hu, I am selling this to you honestly at cost.

没有赚你的钱。”
I am making nothing out of you.”

胡雪岩大力不悦，
Hu had been thoroughly displeased.

挥挥手说道：“你不赚我的钱，赚哪个的钱？”
Waving a hand, he replied, “If you do not make money out of me, whom are you to make it out of?”

有这段的故事一传，“古董鬼”都是漫夭讨价，
Once that story spread, dealers demanded outrageous prices.

胡雪岩说一句：“大贵了。”人家就会老实承认，笑嘻嘻他说：
If Hu said, “Too expensive,” they would cheerfully admit it.

“遇到财神，该我的运气来了。”
“Meeting the God of Wealth means my good fortune has arrived.”

在这种情况下，除非真的要价要得太离谱，通常都是写个条子到帐房支款，
Unless the asking price was truly absurd, he would generally write a note authorising payment at the accounts office.

当然帐户要回扣是必然的。
Naturally the accounts staff would demand their own commission.

他的这种作风，德馨也知道，便不再提古董字画，
Dexin knew of these habits, so he pursued the subject no further.

屈着手指计算：“九百加两百，一千一，
Counting on his fingers, he said, “Nine million and two million make eleven million.

再加五十，一共是一千一百五十万。
Add half a million: eleven and a half million altogether.

欠人呢？
How much do you owe?”

““连官款在内，大概八百万。”
“Including public funds, about eight million.”

“那还多下三百五十万，
“Then you still have three and a half million left.

依旧可算豪富。”
You remain a very wealthy man.”

“这是我的一把如意算盘。”胡雪岩哀伤他说：
“That is merely my hopeful arithmetic,” Hu said sadly.

“如果能够相抵，留下住身房子，还有几百亩田，日子能过得象个样子，我就心满意足了。”
“If I could settle everything, keep a roof over my head and a few hundred mu of land, and live decently, I should be entirely content.”


“怎么呢？”
“Why?”

“毛病就在丝上……”
“The difficulty lies in the silk…”

原来胡雪岩近年来做丝生意，已经超出在商言商的范围，
In recent years Hu's silk business had gone beyond ordinary commerce.

而是为了维护江浙养茧人家，几百万人的生计，跟洋商斗法，
He was fighting the foreign merchants to protect the livelihoods of several million people raising cocoons in Jiangsu and Zhejiang.

就跟打仗一样，论虚实，讲攻守，
It was like war: strength and weakness, attack and defence.

洋商联合在一起，实力充足，千方百计进攻，
The foreigners had joined forces, possessed ample resources, and attacked by every possible means.

胡雪岩孤军应战，唯有苦撑待变。
Hu fought alone and could only hold out, waiting for the situation to change.

这情形就跟围城一样，
He resembled a city under siege.

洋商大军压境，吃亏是劳师远征，利于速战；
The foreign army lay before its walls, suffering the disadvantages of a distant campaign and therefore needing a quick victory.

被围的胡雪岩，利于以逸待劳，
Hu, within the walls, benefited from waiting at ease for an exhausted enemy.

只要内部安定，能够坚守，等围城的敌军，师老无功，军心涣散而撤退时，开城追击，可以大获全胜。
If he could preserve order inside and hold firm until the besiegers tired of fruitless effort and withdrew in low spirits, he could open the gates, pursue them, and win a great victory.

但自上海阜康的风潮一起，就好比城内生变，
The run on the Shanghai Fukang was like a mutiny within the city.

但兵不厌诈，
Yet war permitted deception.

如果出之以镇静，对方摸不透他的虚实，仍有化险为夷的希望。
If he remained composed and prevented the enemy from discovering his true condition, there was still hope of turning danger into safety.

这就是胡雪岩照样维持场面，而且亦决不松口打算抛售存货的道理。
This was why he kept up appearances and refused to admit any intention of selling off his stocks.

“一松口就是投降，
“The moment I give way, I surrender.

一投降就听人摆布了。
Once I surrender, they can do as they please with me.

九百万的货色，说不定只能打个倒八折……”
Goods worth nine million may fetch only a ‘reverse eight-tenths’ price…”

“雪岩，我没有听懂。”德馨插嘴问道：
“Xueyan, I do not follow,” Dexin interrupted.

“什么叫‘倒八折’？”
“What do you mean by a reverse eight-tenths price?”

“倒八折就是只剩两成，
“I mean only two tenths would remain.

九百万的货色，只值一百八十万。
Nine million taels' worth of goods would fetch just one million eight hundred thousand.

洋商等的就是这一天。
This is the day the foreigners have been waiting for.

晓翁，且不说生意盈亏，光是这口气我就咽不下。
Mr Xiaofeng, quite apart from profit and loss, I cannot swallow the humiliation.

不过，”胡雪岩的眼角润湿了，“看样子怕非走到这一步不可了！”
But”—tears gathered at the corners of his eyes—“it looks as though I may have no choice.”

德馨不但从未见胡雪岩掉过眼泪，听都未曾听说过，
Dexin had never seen Hu weep, nor even heard of it.

因此心里亦觉凄凄恻恻的，非常难过，只是无言相慰。
He too was deeply distressed, but could find no words of comfort.


“象我这种情形，在外国，譬如美国、英国，甚至于日本，公家一定会出面来维持。”胡雪岩又说：
“In a foreign country—in America, Britain, even Japan—the authorities would certainly support a man in my position,” Hu continued.

“我心里在想，我吃亏无所谓，只要便宜不落外方，
“I keep thinking that it would not matter if I took a loss, provided the benefit did not go abroad.

假如朝廷能出四百五十万银子，我全部货色打对折卖掉，
If the court would put up four million five hundred thousand taels, I would sell my entire stock at half price.

或者朝廷有句话，胡某人的公私亏欠，一概归公家来料理，我把我的生意全部交出来，亦都认了。
Or if it would undertake to settle all my public and private liabilities, I would willingly hand over every business I own.

无奈……唉！”
But… ah!”

他摇摇头不想再说下去了。
He shook his head and would say no more.

“这倒不失为一个光明磊落、快刀斩乱麻的办法！”德馨很兴奋他说：
“That would certainly be an open and honourable way to cut through the tangle!” Dexin said eagerly.

“何不请左爵相出面代奏？”
“Why not ask Lord Zuo to submit it to the throne?”

“没有用！”
“It would be no use.”

胡雪岩摇摇头：
Hu shook his head.

“朝廷现在筹兵费要紧，
“The court's priority is raising money for the war.

何况阎大人管户部，
Besides, Lord Yan controls the Ministry of Revenue.

他这把算盘精得很，一定不赞成。”
His calculations are too exact; he would never agree.”

“阎大人”指协办大学士阎敬铭，以善于理财闻名，
Lord Yan was Yan Jingming, Assistant Grand Secretary, renowned for financial ability.

而他的理财之道是“量人为出、省吃俭用”八个字，
His method consisted of matching expenditure to income and practising thrift.

对胡雪岩富埒王侯的生活起居，一向持有极深的成见，决不肯在此时加以援手的。
He had always deeply disapproved of Hu's princely way of life and would certainly not offer assistance now.

“那么，”德馨有些困惑了，“你不想请左爵相出面帮你的忙，你去看他干吗？”
“Then,” Dexin asked, puzzled, “if you do not want Lord Zuo to intervene, why are you going to see him?”

“也不是我不想请他出面，
“It is not that I do not want his help.

不过，我觉得没有用，
I merely feel it would be useless.

当然，我要看他的意思。
Naturally, I must hear what he thinks.

晓翁，你晓得的，左大人是我的靠山，
You know that Lord Zuo is the mountain behind me.

这座靠山不能倒。”
That mountain must not fall.”

接着胡雪岩谈起乌先生拆那个“”字的说法。
He then related Mr Wu's interpretation of the divinatory character.


不道德馨亦深好此道，
Dexin, it turned out, was also keenly interested in such matters.

立即问说：“乌先生在不在？”
“Is Mr Wu here?” he asked at once.

“不知道走了没有？”
“I do not know whether he has left.”

胡雪岩起身想找螺蛳太太去问，她已听见他们的话，自己走了进来说：
Hu rose to find Madam Luosi and ask, but she had heard their conversation and came in of her own accord.

“乌先生今天在这里，
“Mr Wu is staying here tonight.

就不知道睡了没有？”
I do not know whether he has gone to bed.”

“你叫人去看看。”
“Send someone to see.”

“如果睡了，就算了。”德馨接口：
“If he is asleep, leave him,” Dexin put in.

“深夜惊动，于心不安。”
“I should feel bad about disturbing him so late.”

其实这是暗示，即使睡了，也要惊动他起身。
What this really meant was that Mr Wu should be woken even if he had retired.

官做大了，说话都是这样子的。
High officials always spoke in this fashion.

螺蛳太太识得这个窍门，
Madam Luosi understood the convention.

口中答应着，出来以后却悄悄嘱咐阿云，传话客房，不论乌先生睡了没有，请他马上来一趟。
Aloud she agreed; once outside, she quietly told A’yun to send word to the guest rooms and ask Mr Wu to come immediately, whether he was asleep or not.



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第六章（上）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Six, Part One
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第六章 探骊得珠｜CHAPTER SIX: SEIZING THE DRAGON’S PEARL


乌先生却还未睡，所以一请就到，
Mr Wu had not yet gone to bed and came as soon as he was summoned.

他是第一次见德馨，
This was his first meeting with Dexin.

在胡雪岩引见以后，少不得有一番客套，
After Hu Xueyan introduced them, the usual courtesies were exchanged.

德馨又恭维他测字测得妙，接下来便要向他“请教”了。
Dexin complimented him on his ingenious character divination, then proceeded to ask his advice.

“不敢当，不敢当！
“You are too kind!

雕虫小技，不登大雅。”乌先生问：
A trifling skill, quite unworthy of serious company,” Mr Wu replied.

“不知道德大人想问什么？”
“What would Your Excellency like to ask?”

“我在谋一件事，不知道有成功的希望没有？
“I am pursuing a certain ambition and do not know whether there is any hope of success.

想请乌先生费心替我卜一下。”
Would you be kind enough to divine the outcome?”

“是！
“Certainly.

请报一个字。”
Please give me a character.”

德馨略想一想说：“就是谋字吧。”
After a moment’s thought, Dexin said, “Let it be mou: ‘to scheme.’”

一旁有现成的笔砚，
Brush and ink were ready at hand.

乌先生坐下来取张纸，提笔将“谋”字拆写成“言”、“某”两字，
Mr Wu sat down, took a sheet of paper, and separated the character into its two components, yan, meaning “speech,” and mou, meaning “a certain person.”

然后搁笔思考。
Then he laid down the brush to think.

这时德馨与胡雪岩亦都走了过来，手捧水烟袋，静静地站在桌旁观看。
Dexin and Hu came over, each holding a water pipe, and stood quietly beside the table.

“德大人所谋的这件事，要托人进‘言’，
“For what you are planning, Your Excellency, you need someone to speak on your behalf.

这个人心目中已经有了，没有说出来，那就是个‘某，。”
You already have a person in mind but have not named him: hence ‘a certain person.’”

乌先生笑道：
Mr Wu smiled.

“不瞒德大人说，我拆字是’三脚猫，，
“To be honest, I am only a dabbler at this.

也不会江湖诀，
I know none of the professional diviners’ formulas.

不过就字论字，
I simply consider the character itself.

如果说对了，一路拆下去，或许谈言微中，亦未可知。”
If I have begun correctly and continue taking it apart, perhaps I may stumble upon something pertinent.”

“是，是！”
“Yes, yes!

德馨很客气地：“高明之至。”
Most perceptive,” Dexin said politely.

“那么，请问德大人，我刚才一开头说对了没有？
“Then was my opening statement correct?

不对，重新来，
If not, we must begin again.

请德大人不要客气，一定要说实话。”
Please do not spare my feelings; you must tell the truth.”

“是的，我一定说实话，
“I certainly shall.

你老兄一开头就探骊得珠了。”
You have plunged straight to the dragon’s pearl.”

乌先生定睛细看一看他的脸色，直待确定了他是说的实话，
Mr Wu studied his face until he felt sure the answer was sincere.

方始欣慰地又说：“侥幸，侥幸。”燃后拈起笔来说道：
“A fortunate guess!” he said with satisfaction, taking up the brush again.

“人言为信，这个人立在言字旁边，
“‘Person’ beside ‘speech’ makes xin, ‘trust.’

意思是进言的人要钉在旁边，才会有作用。”
The person standing beside the speech means that your spokesman must keep close at hand if he is to be effective.”

“嗯，嗯！”德馨不断点头，而且不断眨眼，似乎一面听，一面在体味。
Dexin nodded repeatedly, blinking as though weighing the words as he listened.


“现在看这个某字，
“Now look at the component mou, ‘a certain person.’

加女为媒，
Add ‘woman,’ and it becomes mei, ‘a go-between.’

中间牵线的要个女人。”
A woman must provide the connection.”

“请教乌先生，这个牵线的女人，牵到哪一面？”
“May I ask which party this woman connects with?”

“问得好！”
“A good question!”

乌先生指着“信”字说，
Mr Wu pointed to xin, “trust.”

“这里有两个人，一个进言，一个纳言，
“There are two people here: one who speaks, and one who listens.

牵线是牵到进言的人身上。”
The woman makes the connection with the one who speaks.”

“意思是，这个为媒的女子，不是立在言子旁边的那个人？”
“You mean that the woman acting as go-between is not the person standing beside ‘speech’?”

“不错。”
“Exactly.”

“我明白了。”
“I understand.

德馨又问：“再要请教，我谋的这件事，什么时候着手？
Now let me ask: when should I begin?

会不会成功，
Will I succeed?

能够成功，是在什么时候？
And if so, when?”

““这就要看某字下面的这个木字了。”
“For that, we must consider the ‘wood’ beneath mou.”

乌先生将“某”下之“木”涂掉，成了“甘”、“言”二字，
Mr Wu blotted out that lower component, leaving gan, “sweet,” and yan, “speech.”

这就不必他解释了，
No explanation was necessary.

德馨便知道他所托的“某”人，满口答应，其实只是饴人的“甘言”。
Dexin understood that the person he relied on might promise everything, yet offer nothing more than soothing “sweet words.”

因此，他问：“要怎么样才会失掉这个木字？”
“How would the ‘wood’ be lost?” he asked.


“金克木。”乌先生答说：
“Metal overcomes Wood,” Mr Wu answered.

“如果这件是在七、八月里着手，已经不行了。”
“If you began in the seventh or eighth month, the venture would already be lost.”

“为什么呢？”
“Why?”

“七月申月，八月西月，
“The seventh month is shen, the eighth you.

都是金。”
Both belong to Metal.”

“现在十一月，”胡雪岩插嘴：
“This is the eleventh month,” Hu put in.

“十一月是不是子月？”
“Isn’t the eleventh month zi?”

“县的”胡雪岩略通五行生克之理，便向德馨说道：
“Yes.” Hu knew something of how the Five Elements generated and overcame one another.

“子是水，水生木，
“Zi is Water, and Water generates Wood.

晓翁，你赶快进行。”
Mr Xiaofeng, you must begin at once.”

“万万来不及。”德馨说道：
“There is no possible way to do it in time.

“今天十一月十六日，
Today is the sixteenth of the eleventh month.

只半个月不到，
Less than half a month remains.

哪来得及？”
How could I manage it?”

“而且水固生木，到下个月是丑月，丑为土，木克土不利。”乌先生接下来说：
“Besides,” Mr Wu continued, “though Water generates Wood, next month is chou, which belongs to Earth. Wood overcomes Earth: an unfavorable relation.

“最好开年正月里着手，
It would be best to begin in the first month of the new year.

正月寅，二月卯，都是木，
The first month is yin, the second mao, both Wood.

三月里有个顿挫，不过到四、五月里就好了，
There will be a setback in the third month, but all will be well by the fourth or fifth.

四月已，五月午都是火……”
The fourth is si, the fifth wu, both Fire…”

“木生火。”胡雪岩接口，
“Wood generates Fire,” Hu supplied.

“大功告成。”
“Complete success!”

“正是这话。”乌先生同意。
“Precisely,” Mr Wu agreed.

“高明，高明！
“Wonderful!

真是心悦诚服。”
I am entirely convinced.”

德馨满面笑容将水烟袋放下，
Beaming, Dexin put down his water pipe.

“这得送润笑，不送就不灵了。”
“I must offer you a fee, or the prediction will not come true.”

一面说，一面掀开“卧龙袋”，里面束着一条蓝绸汗巾作腰带，
He lifted his sleeveless outer garment, revealing a blue silk kerchief serving as a sash about his waist.

旗人在这条带子上的小零碎很多，
Bannermen carried many small accessories on such sashes.

他俯首看了一下，解下一个玉钱，双手递了过去。
Looking down, he detached a jade coin and presented it with both hands.

“不成敬意，
“A trifling token.

留着玩。”
Keep it to amuse yourself.”

乌先生接过来一看，倒是纯净无暇的一块羊脂白玉，上镌“乾隆通宝”四字，制得颇为精致，
Mr Wu found it was a flawless piece of mutton-fat white jade, finely carved with the four characters for “Qianlong circulating treasure.”

虽不甚值会，但确是很好的一样玩物，
It was not particularly valuable, but made a charming object to handle.

便连连拱手，口说：“谢谢，谢谢！”
He repeatedly clasped his hands in thanks.

“这个不算，
“This hardly counts,” Dexin added.

等明年夏天我谋的事成功了，再好好表一表谢意。”
“When my plan succeeds next summer, I shall thank you properly.”


等乌先生告辞退出，胡雪岩虽然自己心事重重，但为了表示关怀好朋友，仍旧兴致盎然地动问，德馨所谋何事？
After Mr Wu withdrew, Hu, despite his own heavy troubles, made a show of lively interest in his friend’s concerns and asked what he was planning.

“还不是想独当一面。
“What else but a post where I can take charge in my own right?

我走的是宝中堂的路子，托他令弟进言。”
I am working through Grand Secretary Bao, asking his younger brother to speak for me.

德馨又说：“前年你不是邀他到南边来玩，我顺便请他逛富春江，约你作陪，你有事不能去。你还记得这回事不？”
You invited the brother south for a visit the year before last, remember? I offered to take him along the Fuchun River and asked you to join us, but you were too busy.”

“嗯嗯。我记得。”
“Yes, I remember.

胡雪岩问说：“逛富春江的时候，你就跟他谈过了？”
Did you discuss it with him on that trip?”

“不！
“No.

那时候我刚升藩司不久，
I had only recently become provincial treasurer.

不能作此非分之想。”
I could hardly aspire beyond my station so soon.

德馨说道：“我们这位宝二爷看中了一个江山船上的船娘，向我示意，想藏诸金屋，
Our Second Master Bao took a fancy to a boatwoman on one of the Jiangshan boats and hinted that he wanted to install her in a secluded love nest.

而且言外之意，自备身价银子，不必我花费分文。
He also let me understand that he would supply the money himself: I need not spend a penny.

不过，我刚刚到任，
But I had just taken office.

怎么能拉这种马，
How could I act as a procurer?

所以装糊涂没有答腔。
I pretended not to understand.

最近，他跟我通信，还没有忘记这段旧情，
He has written to me recently and still hasn’t forgotten her.

而那个船娘，只想择人而事，
As for the woman, she wants to choose a suitable man to attach herself to.

我已经派人跟她娘老子谈过，
I’ve already sent someone to speak to her parents.

只要两千两银子，宝二爷即可如愿。
For just two thousand taels, Second Master Bao can have his wish.

我一直还在犹豫，今晚上听乌先生这一谈，吾志已决。”
I’ve been hesitating, but after listening to Mr Wu tonight, my mind is made up.”

这样去谋方面大员，胡雪岩心里不免菲薄，
Hu could not help thinking little of such a way to seek a major provincial appointment.

而且他觉得德馨的路子亦没有走对。
He also thought Dexin had chosen the wrong channel.

既然是朋友，不能不提出忠告。
As a friend, he ought to warn him.

“晓翁，”他问：“宝中堂跟他老的情形，你清楚不清楚？”
“Mr Xiaofeng, do you know how matters stand between Grand Secretary Bao and his brother?”

“弟兄不甚和睦是不是？”
“They don’t get on very well?”

“是的。”
“Exactly.

胡雪岩又说：“宝中堂见了他很头痛，
The grand secretary finds him a headache.

进言只怕不见得效。”
I doubt his intercession would do much good.”

“不然。”德馨答说：
“On the contrary.

“我跟他们昆仲是世交，他家的情形我知道。
Our families are old friends, and I know their affairs.

宝中堂对他这位令弟，一筹莫展，唯有安抚，
Bao can do nothing with his brother except placate him.

宝二爷只要天天在他老兄面前罗嗦，宝中堂为了躲麻烦，只有听他老弟的活。”
If Second Master Bao nags him every day, he’ll have to listen simply to escape the nuisance.”


听得这一说，胡雪岩只好付之一笑，
Hu could only smile at this.

不过想起一件事，带笑警告着说：
Then something occurred to him, and he added a smiling warning.

“晓翁，这件事你要做得秘密，
“You must keep the business secret, Mr Xiaofeng.

让都老爷晓得了，参上一本，又出江山船的新闻，
If the censors hear and submit an impeachment, there’ll be another Jiangshan boat scandal.

划不来。”
It wouldn’t be worth it.”

所谓“又出江山船的新闻”，是因为一年以前在江山船上出过一件新闻，
He was referring to a scandal of the previous year.

“翰林四谏”之一的宝廷，放了福建的主考，
Baoting, one of the “Four Hanlin Remonstrators,” had been appointed chief examiner in Fujian.

来去经由杭州，坐江山船溯富春江而入上闽，
Passing through Hangzhou on both journeys, he had taken a Jiangshan boat up the Fuchun River and into upper Fujian.

归途中纳江山船的一个船娘为妾，
On his return, he made one of the boatwomen his concubine.

言官打算搏击，宝廷见机，上奏自劾，因而落职。
The censors prepared to attack him, but Baoting anticipated them and submitted a memorial impeaching himself, whereupon he lost office.

在京的大名士李慈铭，做了一首诗咏其事，其中有一联极其工整：“宗室八旗名士草，江山九姓美人麻。”
Li Ciming, a celebrated man of letters in the capital, wrote a poem about it, including a particularly neat couplet: “Eight-Banner royal clansman, a scholar of grass; / Nine-Surname Jiangshan woman, a beauty with pockmarks.”

宝廷是宗室，也是名士，但加一“草”字，自是讥刺。
Baoting belonged to the imperial clan and was indeed a man of letters, but the addition of “grass” was plainly satirical.

下句则别有典故，
The second line contained another allusion.

据说江山船上的船户，共有九姓，皆为元末陈友谅的部将之后，
The families living on Jiangshan boats were said to bear nine surnames, all descended from commanders who had served Chen Youliang at the end of the Yuan.

朱元璋得了天下，为惩罚此辈，不准他们上岸居住，只能讨水上生涯。
After winning the empire, Zhu Yuanzhang punished them by forbidding them to live ashore: they could earn their living only on the water.

而宝廷所眷的船娘，是个俗语所说的“白麻子”，
The woman Baoting admired was what people called a “white-pockmarked woman.”

只以宝廷近视，咫尺之外，不辨人物，竟未发觉，
Being so shortsighted that he could barely distinguish people and things even at close quarters, he had failed to notice.

所以李慈铭有“美人麻”的谐谑。
Hence Li Ciming’s joke about a pockmarked beauty.

这两句诗，亦就因此烩炙人口，腾为笑柄。
The lines became widely quoted, and the affair a laughingstock.

德馨当然也知道这个故事，
Dexin naturally knew the story.

想起言官的气焰，不免心惊肉跳，
Remembering the censors’ ferocity, he felt distinctly uneasy.

所以口中所说“不要紧”，暗地里却接受了胡雪岩的警告，颇持戒心。
Though he said there was nothing to worry about, privately he accepted Hu’s warning and resolved to be cautious.


一夜之隔，情势大变，
Overnight, the situation changed drastically.

浙江巡抚刘秉漳接到直隶总督北洋大臣李鸿章的密电，
Liu Bingzhang, governor of Zhejiang, received a confidential telegram from Li Hongzhang, Governor-General of Zhili and Minister for the Northern Ports.

说有直隶水灾赈款六十万两银子，存在阜康福，被倒无着，
Six hundred thousand taels of Zhili flood-relief funds had been deposited in Fukangfu and were now stranded by its collapse.

电请刘秉漳查封胡雪岩所设的典当，备抵公款。
Li asked Liu to seal Hu Xueyan’s pawnshops as security for the public money.

于是刘秉璋即时将德馨请了去，以电报相示，问他有何意见？
Liu immediately sent for Dexin, showed him the telegram, and asked his opinion.

德馨已估量到会有这种恶劣的情况出现，老早亦想好了最后的办法，
Dexin had anticipated just such an adverse development and long since considered his last resort.

“司里的愚见，总以不影响市面为主。”他说，
“In my humble view, our principal concern must be to avoid disturbing trade,” he replied.

“如果雷厉风行，丝毫不留情面，刺激民心，
“If we act with ruthless speed, showing no consideration, we shall alarm the public.

总非地方之福，
That cannot benefit the province.

至于胡雪岩本人，气概倒还光明磊落，
As for Hu himself, his spirit is honorable and straightforward.

我看不如我去劝一劝他，要他自作处置。”
I suggest that I speak to him and persuade him to make his own arrangements.”

“何以谓之自作处置？”
“What do you mean by that?”

“让他自已把财产目录，公私亏欠帐目开出来，捧交大人，请大人替他作主。”
“Let him draw up an inventory of his property and accounts of his public and private debts, and place them in Your Excellency’s hands, asking you to act for him.”

刘秉璋原以为德馨的所谓“自作处置”，是劝胡雪岩自裁，
Liu had imagined that “make his own arrangements” meant persuading Hu to take his own life.

听了德馨的话，才知道自己误会了，也放心了。
Discovering his mistake, he felt relieved.

“好！
“Very well.

你者哥多费心。”
I must trouble you with this.

刘秉璋问：“什么时候可以听回音。”
When may I expect an answer?”

“总得明儿上午。”
“Tomorrow morning, at the earliest.”

当夜德馨又去看胡雪岩，
That night Dexin called on Hu again.

一见哽咽，居然挤出一副急泪，
At their meeting his voice caught, and he actually squeezed out a few anxious tears.

这就尽在不言中了。
They said everything.

胡雪岩却很但然，说一声：
Hu, however, was quite calm.

“晓翁，说我看不破，不对，说我方寸不乱，也不对。
“It would be wrong to say I cannot face the truth, Mr Xiaofeng, but equally wrong to say I am untroubled.

一切都请晓翁指点。”于是德馨道明来意，
I leave everything to your guidance.” Dexin explained his purpose.

胡雪岩一诺无辞。但提出一个要求，要给他两天的时间，理由是他要处分家务。
Hu agreed without argument, asking only for two days to settle his household affairs.

德馨沉吟了好一会说：
Dexin pondered for some time.

“我跟刘中丞去力争，大不了赔上一顶纱帽，也要把你这两天争了来。
“I shall fight for those two days with Governor Liu, even if it costs me my official cap.

但望两夭以后，能把所有帐目都交了给他。”
But I hope you can hand him all the accounts when they are over.”

“一言为定。”
“Agreed.”


等德馨一走，胡雪岩与螺蛳太太关紧了房门，整整谈了一夜。
After Dexin left, Hu and Madam Luosi shut themselves in and talked all night.

第二天分头采取了几项行动，
The next day they took several steps.

首先是发密电给汉口、镇江、福州、长沙、武昌各地的阜康，即日闭歇清理，
First, they sent confidential telegrams to the Fukang branches in Hankou, Zhenjiang, Fuzhou, Changsha, and Wuchang, instructing them to close immediately and begin liquidation.

其次是托古应春赶紧回上海，觅洋商议价出售存丝，
Next, they asked Gu Yingchun to hurry back to Shanghai and find foreign merchants with whom to negotiate the sale of the stored silk.

第三是集中一批现银，将少数至亲好友的存款付讫，
Third, they gathered a quantity of ready silver and paid off the deposits of a small number of close relatives and friends.

再是检点一批首饰、古玩，约略估价，抵偿德馨经手的一批存款。
They also selected jewelry and antiques, valued them approximately, and used them to settle a group of deposits handled through Dexin.

当然，还有最要紧的一件事是，开列财产目录。
Most important of all, they drew up an inventory of their property.

密密地忙到半夜，方始告一段落，
They worked quietly until midnight before reaching a stopping point.

胡雪岩累不可当，喝一杯人参浸泡的葡萄酒，正待上床时，德馨派专人送来一封信，
Utterly exhausted, Hu drank a glass of wine in which ginseng had been steeped and was about to go to bed when a special messenger brought a letter from Dexin.

信中写的是：“给事中邓承修奏请责令贪吏罚捐巨款，以济要需，
It read: “Supervising Censor Deng Chengxiu has memorialized, requesting that corrupt officials be ordered to contribute large sums as a penalty, to meet urgent needs.

另附一片，
A supplementary memorial was attached.

抄请察觉。”
A copy follows for your information.”

所附的抄件是：“另片奏：闻阜康银号关闭，协部大学士刑部尚书文煜，所存该号银数至七十余万之多，
The enclosure read: “In a supplementary memorial he states: ‘I hear that Fukang Bank has closed, and that the sum deposited there by Wenyu, Assistant Grand Secretary and Minister of Punishments, amounts to more than seven hundred thousand taels.

请旨查明确数，究所从来，等语，
I request an imperial order to ascertain the exact amount and investigate its source.’

着顺天府确查具奏。”
The Shuntian prefectural authorities are hereby ordered to investigate and report.”

这封信及抄件，不是个好消息，但胡雪岩亦想不出对他还有什么更不利之处，
Neither letter nor enclosure brought good news, but Hu could not see how this might make his own position any worse.

因而丢开了睡觉。
He put them aside and went to sleep.


一觉醒来，头脑清醒，自然而然地想到德馨传来的消息，同时也想到了文煜——
He awoke with a clear head and naturally thought of Dexin’s news, and of Wenyu himself.

他是满洲正蓝旗人，与恭王是姻亲，早在咸丰十一年就署理过直隶总督，
A Manchu of the Plain Blue Banner, related by marriage to Prince Gong, Wenyu had served as acting Governor-General of Zhili as early as the eleventh year of Xianfeng.

但发财却是同治七年任福州将军以后的事。
His fortune, however, had begun only after he became Fuzhou Garrison General in the seventh year of Tongzhi.

原来清兵入关，虽代明而得天下，但南明亡后，浙东有鲁王，西南有永历帝，海外有郑成功，
The Qing armies had entered the passes and won the empire from the Ming, but even after the Southern Ming fell, the Prince of Lu remained in eastern Zhejiang, the Yongli Emperor in the southwest, and Zheng Chenggong overseas.

此外还有异姓封王的“三藩”，手握重兵，亦可能成为心腹之患，
There were also the Three Feudatories, princes of other surnames commanding powerful armies who might become a grave internal threat.

因而在各省冲要枢纽之地，派遣旗营驻防，借以防备汉人反清复明。
Banner garrisons were therefore stationed at strategic centers in the provinces to guard against Han attempts to overthrow the Qing and restore the Ming.

统率驻防旗营长官，名为“将军”，上加地名，驻西安即名之为西安将军，驻杭州即名之为杭州将军。
Their commanders were styled generals, with the place name attached: the commander at Xi’an was the Xi’an Garrison General, the one at Hangzhou the Hangzhou Garrison General.


各地将军的权责不一，因地因时制宜，
Their authority and responsibilities varied with local conditions and circumstances.

福建因为先有郑成功父子的海上舟师，后有耿精忠响应吴三桂造反，
Fujian had first faced the fleets of Zheng Chenggong and his son, then Geng Jingzhong’s rebellion in support of Wu Sangui.

是用兵的要地，所以福州将军权柄特重，
As a strategic military region, it gave the Fuzhou Garrison General exceptional power.

他处将军，只管旗营，只有福州将军兼管“绿营”，
Elsewhere, generals commanded only Banner troops; the Fuzhou general alone also controlled Green Standard troops.

此外还有一项差使，兼管闽海关。
He had a further duty: supervision of the Fujian Maritime Customs.

起初只是为了盘查海船，以防偷渡或私运军械，到后来却成了一个专门收税的利薮，
Originally intended to inspect seagoing vessels and prevent illicit crossings or arms smuggling, this had gradually become a lucrative tax-collecting office.

尤其是鸦片战争以后，海禁大开，英、法、美、日各国商人都在福州设有洋行，
Especially after the Opium War, when the maritime restrictions were thrown wide open, British, French, American, and Japanese merchants established trading houses in Fuzhou.

闽海关的税收大增，兼管海关亦就成了有名的美差。
Customs revenue grew enormously, and its supervision became a famously profitable appointment.

文烃从同治七年当福州将军，十年兼署闽浙总督，
Wenyu became Fuzhou Garrison General in the seventh year of Tongzhi and concurrently acted as Governor-General of Fujian and Zhejiang from the tenth year.

直至光绪三年内调，前后在福州九年，
He remained until his transfer to the capital in the third year of Guangxu, spending nine years in Fuzhou.

宦囊丰盈，都存在阜康银号。
His official purse grew fat, and he deposited the money with Fukang.

及至是京以后，先后充任崇文门正监督、内务府总管大臣，亦都是可以搞钱的差使，
In the capital, he served successively as chief superintendent at Chongwen Gate and minister of the Imperial Household Department, both posts offering opportunities to make money.

所以存在阜康的款子，总数不下百万之多，是胡雪岩最大的一个主顾。
His deposits with Fukang totaled no less than a million taels, making him Hu’s largest customer.


这个主顾的存款，要查他的来源如何？虽与胡雪岩无关，
An investigation into the source of this customer’s money had nothing to do with Hu himself.

但因此使得阜康的倒闭更成了大新闻，对他大为不利。
Yet it would make Fukang’s collapse an even greater sensation, which was very bad for him.

但这亦是无可奈何之事，
There was nothing he could do, however.

胡雪岩只有丢开它，细想全盘帐目交出以后的情形。
He put it aside and considered what would happen once he had handed over all the accounts.

帐都交了，清理亦无从清理起。不是吗？
With the books gone, there would be no way for him to conduct the liquidation himself—would there?

胡雪岩这样转着念头，突然精神一振，
As this thought took shape, his spirits suddenly lifted.

不可思议地、竟有一种无债一身轻之感。
Incredible as it seemed, he felt the lightness of a man freed from debt.

这道理是很明白的，交出全部帐目，等于交出全部财务，当然也就交出了全部债务，
The reasoning was plain: surrendering all the accounts meant surrendering all the finances, and therefore all the debts as well.

清理是公家的责任，
Liquidation would become the authorities’ responsibility.

当然，这在良心上还是有亏欠的，但事到如今也顾不得那许多了。
Of course, his conscience would still be burdened, but at this stage he could no longer attend to every consideration.

不过，胡雪岩还存着万一之想，那就是存在上海、天津的大批丝货，能够找到一条出路。来偿还全部债务；
He also retained one faint hope: that some outlet might be found for the great stocks of silk in Shanghai and Tianjin, enabling him to repay every debt.

这件事，虽托了古应春，但他的号召力不够，
He had entrusted the matter to Gu, but Gu lacked sufficient influence.

必得自己到上海，在古应春协助之下，才有希望。
There would be hope only if Hu went to Shanghai himself and worked with Gu’s assistance.

照这个想法来说，他交出全部帐目，债务由公家来替他抵挡一阵，等于获得一段喘息的时间，得以全力在丝货上作一番挣扎。
Seen in that light, handing over the accounts would let the authorities hold off the creditors for a time, giving him breathing space to concentrate all his efforts on the silk.

这样一想，他的多日来的忧烦与萎靡，消失了一半，
Half his recent anxiety and dejection vanished.

级着鞋，悄悄到房里去找螺蛳太太。
Slipping his feet into his shoes, he quietly went to Madam Luosi’s bedroom.


她也忙了半夜，入睡不过一个多时辰。
She too had worked late into the night and had slept for only a little over two hours.

胡雪岩揭开皮帐子，一股暖香，直扑鼻观，
Hu lifted the fur bed curtains, and a warm fragrance met him.

螺蛳太太鼻息微微，睡得正酣，
Madam Luosi was sound asleep, breathing softly.

胡雪岩不忍惊醒她，轻轻揭开丝棉被，侧身睡下，
Unwilling to disturb her, he gently raised the silk-wadded quilt and lay down on his side.

不道惊醒了螺蛳太大，一翻身朝里，口中说道：“你真是不晓得死活，
But she woke, turned inward, and said, “You really have no idea what trouble you’re in!

这里候还有心思来缠我。”
At a time like this, you still have a mind to pester me.”

胡雪岩知道她误会了，忍不住好笑，
Realizing her mistake, Hu could not help smiling.

而且心境不同，也比较有兴来开玩笑了，
His changed mood even gave him some appetite for a joke.

便扳着螺蛳太太的依旧圆润温软的肩头说：“这就叫吃着黄连弹琴，苦中作乐。”
Taking hold of her shoulder, still rounded, soft, and warm, he said, “It’s like playing music while chewing bitter coptis: finding pleasure in suffering.”

“去！去！
“Go away!

哪个同你作乐？”
Who wants to find pleasure with you?”

话虽如此，身子却回过来了，而且握住了胡雪岩的手。
Yet she turned back and took his hand.

“我刚刚想了一想。”胡雪岩开始谈正事，
“I’ve just been thinking,” Hu said, coming to business.

“我见了刘中丞，请他替我一肩担待。
“When I see Governor Liu, I’ll ask him to take the whole burden on his shoulders.

我正好脱室身体到上海去想办法。
That will leave me free to go to Shanghai and try to find a solution.

你看我这个盘算怎么样？”
What do you think?”

听得这话螺蛳太太睁开双眼，坐起身来，
At this, Madam Luosi opened her eyes and sat up.

顺手将里床的一件皮袄披在身上，抱着双膝，细细恩量。
She put on a fur jacket lying on the inner side of the bed, clasped her knees, and considered carefully.

“他肯不肯替你担待呢？”
“Will he be willing to take it on for you?”

“不肯也要肯。”
“He’ll have to.

胡雪岩说：“交帐就是交产，
Handing over the books means handing over the property.

原封不动捧出去，请他看了办。”
I’ll surrender it intact and ask him to deal with it as he sees fit.”

“你说交产？”
“The property?

螺蛳太太问：“我们连安身之处都没有了。”
Then we won’t even have anywhere to live.”

“那当然不是。”
“Of course we will.

胡雪岩说：“我跟你来商量的，就是要弄个界限出来。”
What I’ve come to discuss is where to draw the line.”


“这个界限在哪里？”
“Where is the line?”

“在……”胡雪岩说：“在看这样东西，是不是居家过日子少不了的，
“It depends…on whether something is indispensable to living our everyday lives.

如果是，可以留下来，
If it is, we can keep it.

不然就是财产，要开帐，要交出去。”
Otherwise it is property, and must be listed and handed over.”

“这哪里有一定的界限，
“How can there be a fixed line?

有的人情茶淡饭，吃得蛮好，有的没有肉吃不下饭。
Some people are perfectly happy with plain tea and simple food; others can’t eat a meal without meat.

你说，怎么来分？”
How do you distinguish between them?”

“当然这里的伸缩性，也蛮大的。”
“Of course, there is considerable room for interpretation.”

螺蛳太太沉吟不语。
Madam Luosi considered this in silence.

她原来总以为只是胡雪岩的事业要交出去，私财除了金块、金条、金叶子以及现银以外，其他都能不动。
She had always imagined that only Hu’s businesses would be surrendered; among their private possessions, only gold ingots, bars, and leaf, together with ready silver, would be touched.

照现在看，跟抄家也差不多了。
Now it seemed little different from having their home confiscated.

一想到“抄家”，心里发酸，不过她也是刚强明达一路人，
The thought made her heart ache, but she was strong-minded and clear-sighted.

仍能强忍住眼泪想正经。
Holding back her tears, she tried to consider the practical questions.

只是想来想去，想不出一个头绪来，
Yet she could find no starting point.

因为细软摆饰、动用家具、一切日常什物，诚如胡雪岩所说的伸缩性很大，似乎每一样东西都必须评估一番，才能区分。
Jewelry and fine possessions, ornaments, furniture, everyday utensils—each item seemed to require a separate assessment before it could be classified. As Hu had said, the scope for interpretation was enormous.

“这样一片家业，哪里是即时之刻，开得出帐目来的？”螺蛳太太说：
“How could an estate like this be inventoried in an instant?” she asked.

“我看只有两个办法，
“I can see only two ways.

一是同刘抚台声明，私财的帐目太琐碎，一时没法子开得周全，一个是只开大数，自己估个价，譬如说红木家具几堂，大毛皮统子多少件，每一项下面估个总数。”
Either tell Governor Liu that the private property is too complicated to list completely in such a short time, or give only broad totals with our own valuations: so many sets of hongmu furniture, so many linings of heavy fur, and an estimated total under each heading.”

“我看照第二个办法比较好。”
“The second seems better.”

“不过，估价也很难，
“But valuation is difficult too.

譬如说我们的住身房子，
Take this house we live in.

你倒估估看。”
What would you put on it?”

“这只有把造价开上去。
“We can only enter the cost of construction.

数目也好看些。”
