That will make the figures look better.”

为了求帐面好看，不但房子照造价开，其他一切亦都照买进的价钱开列。
To improve the appearance of the accounts, they listed not merely the house at its building cost, but everything else at its purchase price.


第二天又忙了大半天，
They spent most of the following day at work again.

诸事齐备，胡雪岩去看德馨，约期晋见巡抚刘秉璋。
When everything was ready, Hu went to Dexin to arrange an audience with Governor Liu Bingzhang.

“最好是在今天晚上。”他说，
“Tonight would be best,” he said.

“这不是啥有面子的事，
“It’s hardly something to be proud of.

最好少见人，
The fewer people I meet, the better.

而且，晚上可以穿便衣。”
Besides, I can wear informal clothes at night.”

“我看不必，
“I don’t think that is necessary.

这是很光明磊落的事，没有什么见不得人。
This is an entirely honorable proceeding, nothing to hide.

而且，刘中丞是翰袜出身，很讲究这些过节，
Governor Liu comes from the Hanlin Academy and is particular about such conventions.

晚上谈这件事，倒仿佛私相授受似的，他一定不愿意。
Discussing it at night would make it look like a private bargain, which he certainly would not want.

准定明天上午上院吧。”
Let us fix the audience for tomorrow morning.”

“是。好！”
“Yes, very well.”

胡雪岩只得答应。
Hu could only agree.

“穿便衣也不必。
“And there’s no need for informal clothes.

倒象有了什么罪过，青衣小帽负罪辕门似的。
That would make you look like a guilty man arriving at the yamen gate in a plain gown and little cap to confess.

不过，雪岩，你的服饰也不必太华丽。”
Still, Xueyan, you need not dress too splendidly.”

这是暗示，红顶花翎都不必戴。
The hint was that he should leave off the red finial and peacock feather.

胡雪岩当然会意，
Hu understood.

第二天循规蹈矩，只按道员三品眼色穿戴整齐，带着从人上轿到佑圣观巷巡抚衙门。
The next day, observing all the rules, he dressed simply according to the third-rank attire of a circuit intendant and set off by sedan, accompanied by his attendants, for the governor’s yamen in Youshengguan Lane.


其时德馨已先派了人在接应，
Dexin had already sent someone ahead to receive him.

手本一递进去，刘秉璋即时在西花厅延见，
As soon as Hu’s visiting card was presented, Liu Bingzhang admitted him to the western reception hall.

胡雪岩照官场规矩行了礼，刘秉璋很客气地请他“升炕”，
Hu made the proper official salute, and Liu courteously invited him onto the kang.

平时他来看刘秉漳，本是在炕床上并坐的，但这天却再三谦辞，
On ordinary visits they had sat together there, but today Hu repeatedly declined.

因为回头德馨要来，如果他升了炕，德馨只能坐在东面椅子上，未免委屈，
Dexin would be coming shortly; if Hu occupied the kang, Dexin could only take the chair to the east, which would slight him.

所以他只坐在西面椅子上，留着上首的位子给德馨。
Hu therefore sat in the western chair, leaving the place of honor for Dexin.

此时此地，当然不必寒暄，
At such a time there was no need for small talk.

胡雪岩开门见山他说：
Hu came straight to the point.

“职道没有想到今天。
“I never imagined I should reach this position, Your Excellency.

公私债务，无从料理，要请大人成全。
I cannot settle my public or private debts and must ask your help.”

““言重，言重！”刘秉璋说：
“Please, there is no need to put it so strongly.

“如今时局艰难，
These are difficult times.

一切总以维持市面，安定人心为主。
Our first concern must be to sustain trade and reassure the public.

在这个宗旨之下，如果有可为雪翁略效绵薄之处，亦是我分内之事。”
Whatever small service I can render you within that purpose, Mr Xueyan, is part of my duty.”

谈到这里，花厅外面有人高唱：“德大人到。”
Just then a voice outside announced, “His Excellency De!”

于是刘秉璋站了起来，而胡雪岩则到门口相迎。
Liu rose, while Hu went to the doorway to meet him.

听差打开门帘，
An attendant lifted the curtain.

德馨人内，先向刘秉璋行了礼，然后转身道：
Dexin entered, first saluted Liu, then turned to Hu.

“雪翁，你请这面坐！”
“Mr Xueyan, please sit over here.”

说着，他占了胡雪岩原来的位置，将上首留给胡雪岩。
He took Hu’s former seat, leaving the place of honor to him.

“不，不！
“No, no!

晓翁请上坐。”
That is your place, Mr Xiaofeng.”

两人辞让了好一会，刘秉璋忍不住发话：
They exchanged courtesies for some time before Liu intervened.

“细节上不必争了。
“No need to dispute over details.

雪翁就坐在这面，
Sit on this side, Mr Xueyan.

说话比较方便。”
It will be easier to talk.”

听得这话，胡雪岩方始在靠迎刘秉璋的东首椅子上坐了下来，向对面的德馨问道：“我帐国已经带来了，
Hu finally took the eastern chair, nearer Liu, and asked Dexin opposite him, “I have brought the accounts.

是否现在就呈上刘大人？”
Shall I present them to His Excellency now?”

“是，是，
“Yes, yes.

我看现在就上呈吧！”
I think you should.”


胡雪岩便起身将置在一旁的一厚叠帐簿，双手捧起，送上炕床，
Hu rose, lifted the thick stack of account books placed beside him with both hands, and carried them to the kang.

德馨也站起来帮着点交。
Dexin stood too and helped check them as they were handed over.

帐傅一共六本，
There were six books in all.

第一本是阜康钱庄连各地分号的总帐，
The first was the general ledger of Fukang Bank and all its branches.

第二本是二十九家当铺的档手及架本数目清帐，
The second listed the managers and capital of the twenty-nine pawnshops.

第三本是所有田地一万一千亩，座落的地点及田地等则的细帐，
The third gave the locations and grades of all eleven thousand mu of land.

第四本是丝茧存货数量地点的清册，
The fourth inventoried the quantities and locations of the silk and cocoons in stock.

第四本是杂项财产，包括胡庆余堂药店在内的目录，
The fourth listed miscellaneous property, including Hu Qingyu Hall.

第五本是私人财产清单，第六本便是存户名册。
The fifth was an inventory of personal possessions, and the sixth a register of depositors.

但各钱庄所开出的银票，列在第一本之内。
Notes issued by the various banks, however, appeared in the first book.

刘秉璋只略翻一翻，便即搁下，
Liu merely leafed through them and put them down.

等胡雪岩与德馨归座以后，他才问道：“雪翁这六本帐的收支总数如何？”
Once Hu and Dexin had resumed their seats, he asked, “What is the overall balance of these six books?”

“照帐面上来说，收支相抵，绰绰有余，
“On paper, there is far more coming to me than I owe.

不过欠人是实数，人欠就很难说了。”
But what I owe is a definite sum; what is due to me is much less certain.”

“所谓‘人欠’；包括货色在内。”德馨补充着说：
“‘What is due’ includes the goods,” Dexin explained.

“雪翁的丝茧，因为跟洋人斗法的缘故，将来只怕必须出之以‘拍卖，一途，
“Because of his struggle with the foreign merchants, Mr Xueyan may eventually have to sell his silk and cocoons by auction.

能收回多少成本就很难说了。”
How much of their cost he can recover is difficult to say.”


“何谓‘拍卖’？”
“What is an auction?”

“这是外国人的规矩。”胡雪岩说：
“A foreign practice,” Hu replied.

“有意者彼此竞价。
“Those interested bid against one another.

由底价叫起，
The bidding starts at a reserve price.

只要有两个人出价，就一路往上叫，
So long as two people keep offering more, the price rises.

叫到没有人竟价，主持人拍一拍‘惊堂木，，就算敲定了。”
When nobody bids further, the person presiding strikes a block of wood, like a magistrate’s desk block, and the sale is settled.”

“这样说，洋人可以勾通好，故意不竞价。”
“Then the foreigners could agree among themselves and deliberately refrain from competing.”

“不但故意不竟价，甚至不出价，
“They might not merely refuse to compete; they might refuse to bid at all.

那一来就只好把底价再往下压。”
Then the reserve would have to be lowered.”

“照此而言，雪翁的丝茧值多少银子，根本无从估计？”
“In that case, there is no way to estimate what your silk and cocoons are worth?”

“是！”
“Exactly.”

“难。”
“Difficult.”

刘秉璋转脸问道：
Liu turned to Dexin.

“晓翁看，应该如何处理？”
“How do you think we should proceed, Mr Xiaofeng?”

“只有先公后私，一步一步清理。”
“Settle the public claims before the private ones, step by step.”

“也只好如此。”
“There seems no alternative.

刘秉璋说：“现在朝廷的意思还不知道，
We do not yet know the court’s intentions.

我亦暂时只能在‘保管’二字上尽力。”他又问道：“雪翁，一时不会离开杭州吧？”
For now, I can only do my best to hold everything in safekeeping.” He added, “You won’t be leaving Hangzhou for the time being, will you?”


这句话问出来的暗含着有监视他的行踪的意味在内，
The question carried an implication that Hu’s movements were to be watched.

胡雪岩略想一想，决定据实而陈。
After a moment’s thought, he decided to tell the truth.

“回大人的话，职道想到上海去一趟，
“Your Excellency, I should like to go to Shanghai.

能够让丝茧不至于拍卖，于公于私，都有好处。”
If I can prevent the silk and cocoons from being auctioned, it will benefit both the public and private interests involved.”

“呃，你要去多少时候？”
“How long would you be away?”

“总得半个月。”
“At least half a month.”

刘秉璋微微颔首，视线若不经意似地转向德馨，却带着一种戒备与征询的神色。
Liu nodded slightly, his eyes turning towards Dexin as if casually, though their expression was wary and inquiring.

然后又转过脸来说：
Then he looked back at Hu.

“雪翁，这半个月之中，万一有事一定要请你来面谈，
“Suppose something arises during that half-month which requires me to speak to you in person.

怎么办？”
What then?”

胡雪岩还没有想到这一点，
Hu had not considered this.

一时愣在那里，无从答言，不想德馨却代他回答了。
He was momentarily nonplussed, unable to answer, but Dexin spoke for him.

“如果有这样的情形，请大人告诉我就是。”
“If that happens, Your Excellency, please let me know.”

“好！”刘秉璋很爽快地答应：
“Very well!” Liu agreed readily.

“雪翁，你干你的正经去吧！
“Go about your business, Mr Xueyan.

但望这半个月之中，你能料理出一个眉目来，
I only hope you can bring some order to matters within that half-month.

只要公款不亏，私人不闹，我又何必多事？”
So long as no public money is lost and private creditors make no trouble, why should I interfere?”

“是，是。”
“Yes, yes.”

胡雪岩站起身来，垂手哈着腰，
Hu rose, hands lowered, and bowed.

“多仗大人成全。”
“I am deeply indebted to Your Excellency’s kindness.”

“言重，言重！”
“Please, please.”

说着，刘秉璋手已摸到茶碗上。
As he spoke, Liu’s hand moved towards his teacup.



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第六章（下，至本章结束）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Six, Part Two (conclusion)
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


站在门口的戈会哈随即一面掀帘，一面向外高唱：“送客等胡雪岩一走，刘秉璋回到签押房，随即将一本由吏部分发到浙江的候补知县的名册取了出来，
The orderly at the doorway immediately raised the curtain and called out, “See the guest out!” Once Hu Xueyan had gone, Liu Bingzhang returned to his private office and took out the register of expectant county magistrates whom the Ministry of Personnel had assigned to Zhejiang.

细细检阅，
He examined it carefully.

这本名册除了姓名、年龄、籍贯、出身、到省年月以外，另有两项记载，
Besides each man’s name, age, native place, qualifications, and date of arrival in the province, the register contained two further kinds of information.

一项是曾派何差，如某年月派案某、某年月派解”京饷“之类，
One recorded previous assignments: an investigation undertaken in such-and-such a month and year, for instance, or the escorting of revenue silver to the capital.

再一项便是此人的关系，是刘秉璋亲笔所注，如某中堂表亲、某年月日某尚书函托等等。
The other recorded his connections, in Liu’s own hand: a cousin of a certain grand secretary, or recommended by a particular minister in a letter of a certain date.

刘秉璋现在要派二十九员候补知县的差使，根据四个条件来考虑。
Liu now had assignments for twenty-nine expectant magistrates and would make his choices according to four criteria.


第一个条件是出身，正途优先，
The first was qualifications, with priority going to men who had entered through the regular examination route.

假使是“榜下即用”的新科进士，一时无缺可补，甚至连署理都没有机会，当然毫不考虑地先派这个差使。
A newly successful jinshi designated for immediate appointment, but still unable to obtain a vacancy or even an acting post, would naturally receive one of these assignments without further consideration.

一翻名册，这种情形只有三个人，当时在名册上一勾，还剩下二十六个人要派。
Liu found only three such men in the register and marked their names, leaving twenty-six places to fill.

两榜出身的进士以外，举人当然比军功保举及捐班来得占便宜，
After the jinshi, who had passed both the provincial and metropolitan examinations, provincial graduates naturally enjoyed an advantage over men recommended for military merit or admitted by purchase.

但须看第二个条件，即是其人的关系，
But this depended on the second criterion: their connections.

如果曾有朝中大老的“八行”推毅，当然是在候选之列，但还要看第三个条件，
A letter of recommendation from a senior figure at court would certainly place a man among the candidates, though the third criterion still had to be considered.

最近派过差使没有？派的差使是苦是美？
Had he received an assignment recently, and had it been onerous or lucrative?

最近派过苦差使，为了“调剂”起见，不妨加以考虑，否则就要缓一缓了。
A man recently given an onerous task might be considered in the interests of balancing things out; otherwise, he would have to wait.

费了好大的功夫，才将一张名单拟妥，
It took considerable effort to complete the list.

即时派戈什哈个别通知，翌日上午到巡抚衙门等候传见。
Liu then sent orderlies to notify the men individually that they were to await an audience at the governor’s office the next morning.

同时另抄一张全单，送交德馨作参考。
A copy of the full list went to Dexin for his reference.


接到通知的二十九名候补州县官不敢怠慢，
The twenty-nine expectant department and county magistrates dared not neglect the summons.

第二夭一大早，都备好了“手本”，齐集在抚院官厅待命。
Early the next morning, with their formal visiting slips ready, they assembled in the waiting hall at the governor’s office.

这天逢“衙参”之期，
It happened to be a day for the regular official audience.

刘秉璋接见藩、桌二司及盐道、巡道、首府、首县——杭州知府及钱塘知县，
Liu received the provincial treasurer and judicial commissioner, the salt and inspection circuit intendants, and the prefect and county magistrate of the provincial capital—the prefect of Hangzhou and the magistrate of Qiantang.

一直到午牌时分，才轮到道班候补州县官进见，在座的还有德馨。
It was noon before the expectant magistrates were admitted, with Dexin also present.

知县见巡抚照例是有座位的，但人数太多，没有那么多椅子，
County magistrates were ordinarily offered seats when they saw the governor, but there were too many men and too few chairs.

值堂的差役去端了几张长条凳来，二十九位“大老爷”，挨挨挤挤地坐了下来，
The attendants brought in several long benches, and the twenty-nine “Your Honours” squeezed together.

却还有两个人无处容身，
Even so, two men could find no room.

一个赌气，退到廊下去听消息，一个做官善于巴结，看刘秉璋因为他还没有安顿好，不便开口，
One withdrew sulkily to the corridor to hear what happened; the other, more practised in ingratiating himself with his superiors, noticed that Liu was waiting for him to settle before beginning.

觉得让“宪台”久候，不好意思，便蹲了下来，臀部临空，双手按膝，仿佛已经落座似地。
Embarrassed to keep His Excellency waiting, he squatted down with his hands on his knees and his backside unsupported, as though he too were seated.

“今邀各位老哥来，有个差使要请各位分头去办。”刘秉璋说：
“I have invited you gentlemen here because there is an assignment I wish each of you to undertake,” Liu said.

“各位想必都已经从《申报》上看到了，胡观察的阜康银号倒闭，市面大受影响。
“You have presumably read in the Shenbao that Circuit Intendant Hu’s Fukang Bank has failed, seriously disturbing the markets.

阜康的存款之中，官款很多，不能没有着落。
Its deposits include a great deal of public money, which must be secured.

胡观察自愿拿他所开设的二十九家当铺，请我查封，备抵官款。
Intendant Hu has voluntarily offered the twenty-nine pawnshops he owns for me to take into official custody as security for those funds.

现在就要请各位老哥，每人查封一家。“
I now ask each of you to take charge of one.”


此言一出，无不诧异，却不敢发问，
Everyone was surprised, but no one dared ask a question.

只有刚才虚蹲着的那人，因为双腿得无法忍受，正好装作发言，站起来舒舒筋骨。
Only the man suspended in his squat, whose legs had become unbearably painful, seized the chance to rise and stretch them under cover of speaking.

“回大人的话，这种差使，从来没有人当过，
“Your Excellency, no one has ever undertaken an assignment of this kind.

卑职不知道怎么样个当法？”
I do not know how it is to be carried out.”

“喔，”刘秉璋看了他一眼间道：
“Oh?” Liu looked at him.

“老哥贵姓？”
“What is your surname, sir?”

“卑职姓马。
“Ma, Your Excellency.”

“他叫马逢时，陕西人，
“His name is Ma Fengshi, from Shaanxi.

刚至省不久。”德馨在一旁悄悄提示。
He arrived in the province only recently,” Dexin prompted quietly.

刘秉璋点点头说：
Liu nodded.

“马大哥的话不错，
“Mr Ma is right.

这种差使，我也是头一回遇到，
This is my first encounter with such an assignment too.

不过，人不是生而知之的。
But people are not born knowing everything.

各位莫非没有想到过，将来退归林下，也许会设典当谋生？
Have none of you considered that, when you eventually retire, you might open a pawnshop to support yourselves?

收典当跟开典当是一样的，
Taking over a pawnshop is much the same as opening one.

不外验资、查帐而已。”
It amounts to verifying the capital and examining the accounts.”

“再要请示。”马逢时又问：“验资、查帐以后，是不是封门。”
“May I ask further,” Ma said, “whether we are to seal the premises after verifying the capital and accounts?”

“不是，不是。
“No, no.

验资、查帐，如果毫无弊病，责成黄当管事，照旧经营。
If the capital and accounts are found to be in order, hold the manager responsible for continuing the business as before.

各位只要取具管事甘结，承认该典有多少资本，就可以交差了。
You need only obtain his written undertaking acknowledging the amount of capital held by the establishment, and your assignment will be complete.”

“原来名为查封，其实是查而不封。
So, though it was called sequestration, the premises were to be inspected rather than closed.

接下来便由德馨主持抽签，
Dexin then supervised the drawing of lots.

马逢时抽到的，恰好是作为总号的公济典。
Ma happened to draw Gongji Pawnshop, the principal establishment.


其时已在午后未未申初，当天查封，时间已不许可。
It was already about three in the afternoon, too late to carry out the inspection that day.

马逢时领了公事回头，一个人坐着发愣，
Ma returned home with his official papers and sat alone, staring into space.

心里在想典当里又是帐目，又是“ 当头”，
A pawnshop meant both accounts and pledged articles.

帐目则是那笔龙飞凤舞之字，比张旭、怀素的草书还要难识，“当头”则包罗万象，无所不有，
The accounts would be written in a flying scrawl harder to decipher than the cursive calligraphy of Zhang Xu or Huaisu; the pledges could include anything under the sun.

自己一个人赤手空拳，如何盘查封存？
How was he to inspect and secure it all single-handed, with no assistance?

而况公济典既然是总号，规模一定很大，
Gongji, being the principal shop, must be a large concern.

倘或照顾不过来，查封之际出现了虚冒走漏等等情事，责任非轻。
If he failed to keep an eye on everything and fraudulent claims or concealed removals occurred during the takeover, his responsibility would be serious.

转念到此，愁眉不展，马太太不免困惑，
His worried expression puzzled his wife.

一早兴冲冲上院，说有差使，
He had set off for the governor’s office so eagerly that morning, saying he had an assignment.

看起来今年这个年是可以过得去了。
It had looked as though they would be able to get through the New Year after all.

不道一回来是这等神气，岂不可怪？
Why had he returned in such a state?


这一来，少不得动问缘由，
She had to ask.

马逢时叹口气说：
Ma sighed.

“派了个从来没有千过的差使，去查封胡财神的公济典。
“They have given me a task I have never done before: taking the God of Wealth Hu’s Gongji Pawnshop into official custody.

光是查帐验资，典当仍旧照常开门。
I am only to examine the accounts and verify the capital; the shop is to remain open.

你想，我连算盘都不会打，
Think of it—I cannot even use an abacus.

这个差使怎么顶得下来。”
How am I to manage?”

“马太太的想法不同，”
His wife saw it differently.

到浙江来候补，只派过一个解饷的差使，
“Since we came to Zhejiang to wait for an appointment, you have had only that one assignment escorting revenue silver.

靠当当过日子，朝奉的脸真难看。“她兴高彩烈他说：”
We have lived by pawning things, and those pawnbrokers have given us such sour looks!” she said delightedly.

想不到你会派这个差使，
“Who would have thought you would get this assignment?

让我也出口气。
Now I can get a little of my own back.”

“马逢时破颜一笑，
Ma broke into a smile.

“真正妇人之见。他说：”
“A woman’s view, indeed!

这个差使好处‘没有，倒霉有份。
This task offers no benefit, only a chance of trouble.”

““怎么会倒霉？”
“How could it bring trouble?”

“查帐，验资！
“Examining accounts and verifying capital!

如果我们动了手脚，将来责任都在我头上，
If there has been any tampering, the responsibility will fall on my head.

吃不了，兜着走呢！”
I shall have to bear all the consequences.”

“我不懂你说的什么？”
“I do not understand what you mean.”

马太太想了一下说：
She thought for a moment.

“你何不去请教请教杨大哥？”
“Why not ask Brother Yang’s advice?”


这倒提醒了马逢时。
This reminded Ma of a possibility.

原来这“杨大哥”是仁和县礼房的书办，住得不远，
“Brother Yang” was a clerk in the rites section of the Renhe county office and lived nearby.

马逢时夫妇为人都很随和，并不看轻他的身分，平时“杨大哥、杨大哥”叫得很亲热。
Ma and his wife were easygoing people who did not look down on his position, always addressing him warmly as Brother Yang.

杨书办受宠若惊，也很照应马逢时，
Flattered by their kindness, the clerk did what he could for Ma.

每年学台院试发榜，是他最忙的时候，
His busiest time came each year when the education commissioner posted the results of the qualifying examination.

有些土财主家的子弟中了秀才，请客开贺，总希望来几位有功名的贵客，壮壮门面，
When the sons of wealthy country families won their first degree, their families gave celebratory banquets and hoped to attract a few distinguished guests with examination honours to lend the occasion prestige.

于是杨书办就会来通知马逢时，穿上官服，去当贺客，
Clerk Yang would notify Ma, who put on his official robes and attended.

酒足饭饱，主人家还有一个红包，最少也有二两银子。
Besides being well fed and supplied with wine, he received a red envelope from the host containing at least two taels.

一年象这样的机会总有七、八次，在马逢时也算受惠不浅了。
There were usually seven or eight such opportunities a year, so Ma owed Yang a good deal.

因此，听了马太太的话，愁颜一展，唤他的儿子去请“杨伯伯”。
At his wife’s suggestion his face brightened, and he sent his son to invite “Uncle Yang.”

杨书办这夭正好没有应酬，一请就到，动问何事。
The clerk happened to have no engagement that day and came at once, asking what was the matter.

“我有个差使，不知道怎么办？
“I have an assignment I do not know how to carry out.

还是内人有主意，说要请教杨大哥。
My wife had the good sense to suggest asking your advice, Brother Yang.”

“喔，马大老爷，”杨书办倒是按规矩来称呼：“是啥差使？”
“Oh, Your Honour”—Yang observed the proper form of address—“what sort of assignment?”

“查封当铺。”
“Taking a pawnshop into official custody.”

杨书办一愣，旋即笑道：
Yang was startled, then smiled.

“恭喜，
“Congratulations!

恭喜！
Congratulations!

马大老爷，你好过个肥年了。”
Your Honour, you will have a fat New Year.”


此言一出，马逢时的表情，顿时不同，
Ma’s expression changed at once.

又惊又喜地问：“杨大哥，你这话怎么说？”
Surprised and delighted, he asked, “Brother Yang, what do you mean?”

“我先请问，是不是查封胡大先生的当铺？”
“First let me ask: is it one of Mr Hu’s pawnshops?”

“是阿！”
“Yes.”

“哪一家？”
“Which one?”

“公济。”
“Gongji.”

“嘿！
“Ha!

那马大老爷，你这个年过得越发肥了。”
Then your New Year will be fatter still.”

马逢时心里越喜，但也越困感，
Ma grew happier and more puzzled.

搔搔头问：“我，我是看得到，吃不下。”
Scratching his head, he said, “I can see the food, but I cannot get it into my mouth.”

“这话怎么说？”
“What do you mean?”

杨书办立即又是省悟的神情，
Understanding immediately dawned on Yang’s face.

“喔，马大老爷，你是说，不晓得怎么样下手，是不是？”
“Ah, Your Honour, you mean you do not know how to begin?”

“不错。”马逢时紧接着说：“要肥大家肥。
“Exactly.” Ma added at once, “If there is to be any fat, let us all share it.

杨大哥，你是诸葛亮，我是刘先生。”
Brother Yang, you are Zhuge Liang, and I am Master Liu.”

“不敢，不敢！
“You flatter me!

等我想想，
Let me think.

有个朋友，一定帮得上忙。”
There is a friend who could certainly help.”

“杨大哥，你这位令友，今天找得找不到？
“Can this friend of yours be found today?

你要知道，明天一早就要动手。”
You see, I have to begin first thing tomorrow.”

杨书办想起一个朋友，便是周少棠。
The friend Yang had in mind was Zhou Shaotang.

从他的阜康门前“登台说法”，为胡雪岩解围以后，名气大为响亮，
Since his performance outside Fukang had relieved Hu’s predicament, Zhou’s reputation had grown considerably.

马逢时也知道有这样一个人，很乐意向他请教，但怕时间上来不及，因为查纣一事，次日上午便须见诸行动。
Ma had heard of him and was very willing to seek his advice; he was only afraid there would not be time, since the takeover had to begin the following morning.

“不要紧，不要紧！”
“Do not worry.”

杨书办看一看天色说：
Yang looked at the sky.

“这时候去正好，
“This is just the right time.

他在大井巷口隆和酒店吃酒。”
He will be drinking at Longhe Tavern, by the entrance to Dajing Lane.”

大井巷在城隍山脚下，有口极大的甜水井，
Dajing Lane lay at the foot of City God Hill and contained a very large well with sweet water.

井的对面，就是隆和酒店，
Longhe Tavern stood opposite it.

周少棠每天傍晚在那里喝酒，即令有饭局，也一定先到隆和打个照面，
Zhou went there for a drink every evening; even when invited to dinner elsewhere, he always put in an appearance first.

所以这时候去了，即令他不在，也会知道他的行踪。
If they went now, they could find out where he was even if he had already left.


当下安步当车，走到隆和，
They walked leisurely to Longhe.

其实华灯初上，隆和正在上市。
The lamps had just been lit, and business was getting under way.

吃“柜台酒”的贩夫走卒，各倚着柜台，人各一碗，悠闲自在，
Hawkers and labourers drinking at the counter leaned there at their ease, each with a bowl.

其中识得杨书办的人很不少，纷纷招呼。
Many knew Clerk Yang and greeted him.

杨书办一面答应，一面往里走——里面是一座敞厅，摆了十几张方桌，已上了七成座，
Answering as he went, Yang made his way inside to an open hall containing more than a dozen square tables, about seven-tenths of them occupied.

杨书办站定看了一下，没有发现周少棠，便拉一个伙计问讯。
He stopped to look, saw no sign of Zhou, and caught a waiter to ask.

“周先生来过走了。不过，停一停还要来。”
“Mr Zhou has been and gone, but he will be back shortly.

伙计问道：“你老是等他，还是留话？”
Would you like to wait or leave a message?”

“我等他好了。”
“I shall wait.”

于是挑了一张位在僻处的桌子，两人坐了下来，要了酒慢慢喝着，
They chose a table in a quiet corner, ordered wine, and drank slowly.

喝到第三碗酒，周少棠来了。
Zhou arrived as they were on their third bowl.

“少棠，
“Shaotang!

少棠！”
Shaotang!”

杨书办起身叫唤，将他拉了过来说道：
Yang rose and drew him over.

“我们等你好半天了。
“We have been waiting ages.

我先来引见，
Let me introduce you.

这位是马大老爷，”
This is Magistrate Ma.”

周少棠是很外场的人，对马逢时很客气地敷衍了一阵。
Zhou was adept in company and spent some time exchanging courtesies with Ma.

等酒到微酣，杨书办方始道明来意，
Only when the wine had put them pleasantly at ease did Yang explain why they had come.

马逢时随即举杯相敬：
Ma immediately raised his bowl in a toast.

“我对当铺一窃不通，
“I know nothing whatever about pawnshops.

接了这个差使，不知道该怎么办？”他说：
Now I have accepted this assignment, I have no idea how to carry it out.

“全要仰仗周先生指点。”
I must rely entirely on your guidance, Mr Zhou.”

“好说，好说。”周少棠一面应答，一面在肚子里做功夫。
“You are very kind,” Zhou replied, while working things out in his mind.

他跟公济典的唐子韶，只是点头之交，但阜康的谢云青，却跟他很熟，最近的过从更密，
He and Gongji’s Tang Zishao were merely nodding acquaintances, but he knew Xie Yunqing of Fukang well and had seen a great deal more of him lately.

从谢云青口中，知道了紧邻公济典的好些秘密，这当然也就是唐子韶的秘密。
From Xie he had learned quite a few secrets about neighbouring Gongji—and those, of course, were Tang’s secrets too.


周少棠很看不起唐子韶，
Zhou had a very low opinion of Tang.

同时因为与胡雪岩是贫贱之交，情分不同，
His own friendship with Hu dated from their days of poverty, which gave it a particular depth.

所以对唐子韶在胡雪岩遭遇这样沉重的打击，不想想平日所受的提携，拿出良心来共患难，
Now that Hu had suffered such a heavy blow, Tang ought to have remembered all the help he had received and shown enough conscience to stand by him.

反而乘人于危，趁火打劫，在公济典中大动手脚，暗中侵吞，
Instead, he was taking advantage of Hu’s distress, manipulating Gongji’s affairs and secretly embezzling its funds.

大为不平。
Zhou bitterly resented it.

如今恰有这样一个马逢时可以去查帐的机会，岂可错过。
Here was an opportunity to have Ma examine the accounts; how could he let it pass?

“马大老爷，人家都说我周少棠好说大话，做起事来不扎实。
“Your Honour, people say I talk big and never do anything properly.

所以，查封公济典这件事，我不想多说啥，
So I shall not say much about taking Gongji into custody.

只有一句话奉告，
I have just one piece of advice.

马大老爷把我这句话想通摸透，包你差使办得漂亮。”
Understand it thoroughly, and I guarantee you will carry out the assignment splendidly.”

周少棠停了一下说：
He paused.

“这句话叫做：”看帐不如看库，验资不如验货‘。
“It is this: ‘Better to inspect the storeroom than read the books; better to examine the goods than verify the capital.’”

“马逢时一愣，
Ma was taken aback.

因为周少棠的两句话开场白颇为突兀，有点发牢骚的意味在内，
Zhou’s opening had been abrupt and sounded rather like a complaint.

因而嗫嚅着说：“周先生我们今天是初会，
“Mr Zhou,” he stammered, “this is our first meeting.

我从没有说过那些话……”
I have never said anything of the kind...”

“啊，啊，误会了误会了。
“Ah, a misunderstanding!

马大老爷，我不是说你，也不是说杨大哥，
I did not mean you, Your Honour, or Brother Yang.

不过因为今天正好有人这样子说我，顺便一提。”周少棠又说：“马大老爷，你不是要我指点？
Someone happened to say that about me today, so I mentioned it in passing.” Zhou continued, “Did you not ask for guidance?

我刚才那两句话，就是把‘总筋’指点给你看，
Those two phrases point out the central thread.

你要看清楚，想透彻。”
You must see it clearly and think it through.”

原来刚才那种近乎牢骚的话，是周少棠为引起交谈对方注意的一种方式，
His almost aggrieved opening had merely been a device to seize the other man’s attention.

经此折冲，马逢时已将“看帐不如看库，验资不如看货”十二个字深印入脑中，
After this exchange, those twelve Chinese characters were firmly imprinted on Ma’s mind.

当即作出受教的神色说道：“周先生，你这两句话，从字面上说，就大有学问在里头，
Looking duly receptive, he said, “Mr Zhou, even on the surface those words contain a great deal of learning.

索性请你明明白白地开导一番。”
Please go further and explain them plainly.”


“言重，言重。”周少棠问道：
“You are too kind,” Zhou said.

“马大老爷，典当的规矩，你懂不懂？”
“Do you understand pawnshop practices, Your Honour?”

“我刚才不说过，一窃不通。”
“Did I not say I knew nothing about them?”

“那就难怪了……”
“Then it is no wonder...”

“老周，”杨书办忍不住了，“你不必城头大出丧，大兜大转了。
“Old Zhou,” Yang interrupted impatiently, “stop leading us on a grand funeral procession round the city walls.

马大老爷明天去查封，
His Honour has to take charge tomorrow.

要留意哪几件事，请你细说一说。”
Tell him plainly what to watch for.”

“是的。”马逢时接口，
“Yes,” Ma added.

“还有，一去要怎样下手？”
“And how should I begin when I arrive?”

周少棠心想，查封胡雪岩的典当，是为了备抵存在阜康的公款，
Zhou reflected that Hu’s pawnshops were being taken into custody to secure the public money deposited with Fukang.

能多保全一分，胡雪岩的责任即轻一分，
Every additional sum preserved would reduce Hu’s liability.

因此，能将唐子韶在公济典侵吞的款子追出来，对胡雪岩就是最直接、也最切实的帮忙。
Recovering what Tang had embezzled from Gongji would therefore be the most direct and practical help he could offer Hu.

转念到此，他决定插手干预。
He decided to intervene.

于是他问：“马大老爷去查封公济典，有没有委札？”
“Have you an official warrant for this assignment?”

“有。
“Yes.

不过交代是抚台交代，委札是藩台所出。”
The instructions came from the governor, but the warrant was issued by the treasurer.”

“那一样，
“That makes no difference.

都是宪台。”
Both are your superiors.

周少棠又问：“领了封条没有？”
Have you collected any sealing strips?”

“领了”“几帐？”
“Yes.” “How many?”

“两张。”
“Two.”

“怎么只领两张呢？”
“Why only two?”

“我以为查封是封前后门，所以只领了两张。”马逢时又说：
“I thought taking the premises into custody meant sealing the front and back doors, so I took only two.

“后来想想不对，
Afterwards I realised that could not be right.

抚台交代，查封归查封，当铺还是照常取赎。
The governor said the shop was to continue allowing customers to redeem their pledges.

既然如此，纣了门，岂非当主不能上门了。”
If I sealed the doors, how could they come in?”

“不独当主不能上门，公济的人也不能进出了。”
“Nor could Gongji’s own people get in or out.”

周少棠想了一下说：
Zhou thought for a moment.

“不过不要紧，
“But that does not matter.

马大老爷今天就去刻一个长条戳，上面的字是：”奉宪谕查封公济典委员候补知县马，。
Have an oblong stamp cut today, bearing the words: ‘By order of His Excellency: Commissioner Ma, Expectant County Magistrate, appointed to take Gongji Pawnshop into official custody.’

凭这个长条戳，马大老爷自己就可以封。“
With that stamp, you can apply seals yourself.”


“嗯，嗯，”
“Yes, yes.”

马逢时一面想一面点头：
Ma nodded thoughtfully.

“我应该有这人权柄。”
“I ought to have that authority.”

“当然有。”
“Of course you do.”

“周先生，，‘马逢时问道：”明天我去了，第一步做什么？第二步做什么？
“Mr Zhou, what should I do first tomorrow, and what should I do next?

请你给我说一说。
Please tell me.”

““这，这要看情形，
“Well, that depends on what we find.

现在很难说。”
It is difficult to say now.”

说着，周少棠望一望杨书办。
Zhou glanced at Yang.

一直很冷静在旁听的杨书办，知道该他说话了：
The clerk, who had been listening calmly, knew his turn had come.

“马大老爷，我看你要请少棠去帮忙。”
“Your Honour, I think you should ask Shaotang to help you.”

“是啊，是啊！”马逢时一叠连声他说：
“Yes, indeed!” Ma answered eagerly.

“我就有这样一个打算，不过不知道合不合公事上的规矩？”
“I had just that in mind, but I did not know whether it would conform to official practice.”

“怎么会不合？
“Why should it not?

譬如马大老爷你‘挂牌’放了实缺，起码要请刑名、钱谷两位师爷，
If you received a substantive appointment and opened your own office, you would engage at least two secretaries, one for legal affairs and one for revenue.

现在请少常去帮忙，也是同样的道理。”
Asking Shaotang to help now is the same sort of thing.”

“是，是！
“Quite so!

这个譬喻通极。”
An excellent comparison.”

马逢时双手举起酒杯：
Ma raised his bowl with both hands.

“周先生，请你帮忙。
“Mr Zhou, please help me.

不过，惭愧的是，现在还谈不到什么敬意，只有感激在心里。”于是商定几个步骤，其实也就是周少棠在发号司令，
I am ashamed to say I cannot yet offer any token of appreciation—only my heartfelt gratitude.” They then agreed on several steps, though in fact Zhou was issuing the instructions.

马逢时要做的是，连夜将长条戳刻好，第二天一早在开市以前，便须到达公济典，
Ma was to have the oblong stamp cut that night and reach Gongji before business began the next morning.

首行要贴出一张告示：“奉宪谕查封，
His first action would be to post a notice: “Taken into official custody by order of His Excellency.

暂停营业一天。”
Business suspended for one day.”

然后分头查村，最要紧的是库房跟银柜。
They would then divide up the inspection, concentrating above all on the storeroom and the silver chest.

“这就要看帐了。
“Then we shall examine the books.

‘看帐不如看库，验资不如验货’，此话怎讲？
Why did I say it was better to inspect the storeroom than read the books, and to examine the goods than verify the capital?

因为帐是呆的，帐面上看不出啥。
Because the books are lifeless things; you cannot see much from the figures alone.

到库房看过，再拿帐来对照，真假弊病就一目了然了。”
Inspect the storeroom first, then compare it with the accounts, and truth, falsehood, and malpractice will be clear at a glance.”


“是，是。
“Yes, yes.

请教周先生，这姓唐的有哪些弊病？”马逢时间。
What sort of malpractice has this Tang been guilty of, Mr Zhou?” Ma asked.

“我也是听说，
“I have only heard reports.

到底如何，要明天去看了才晓得。”周少棠说：
We shall not know exactly until we go tomorrow.

“第一种是满当的货色上动脑筋，
The first kind concerns pledges whose redemption period has expired.

当本轻、东西好，这也有两种脑筋好动，
If the loan is small and the article valuable, there are two tricks he can play.

一种是掉包，譬如大毛的皮统子，换成二毛的，
One is substitution: replacing a heavy fur lining with one of lighter fur, for example.

还有一种……”
The other...”

“慢慢，周先生，
“A moment, Mr Zhou.

请问这个弊病要怎么查？”
How do we detect that first trick?”

“容易。
“Easily.

一种是看帐，不过当铺里的帐，总是好的写成坏的，所以不如估价。”周少棠说：
One way is to read the accounts, but pawnshop books always describe good things as poor ones, so valuation is better.

“朝奉的本事就在看货估价，决不会走眼，
A pawnbroker’s skill lies in judging and valuing goods; he will not get it wrong.

大毛是大毛的价钱，二毛是二毛的价钱，
Heavy fur commands one price and lighter fur another.

你拿同样的货色来比较，问它同样的当价，为啥一个大老，一个是二毛？
Compare similar articles and ask why, if the loan amounts are the same, one pledge is heavy fur and the other light.

他话说不清楚，里头就有弊病了。”
If he cannot explain it, something is wrong.”

“我懂了。
“I understand.

请问还有一种呢？”
And the other trick?”

“还有一种说是赎走了，其实是他占了满当的便宜。
“He says the pledge has been redeemed, when in fact he has appropriated the valuable article after its term expired.

要查封这种弊病也不难，
That is not difficult to detect either.

叫他拿销号的原票出来看，
Ask him to produce the original pawn ticket cancelled on redemption.

有，是真的赎走了，
If he has it, the pledge was genuinely redeemed.

没有，就是当主根本没有来赎。”
If not, the customer never came to redeem it at all.”


处理满当货的弊端，马逢时大致已经了解，
Ma now had a general understanding of the abuses involved in handling expired pledges.

但是否还有其他毛病呢？
But were there others?

问到这一点，周少棠的答复是肯定的，而且词色之间，颇为愤慨。
Zhou’s answer was emphatically yes, and his voice and expression showed considerable indignation.

“这个姓唐的，真是狗彘不如！
“This Tang is worse than a beast!

今日之下，他居然要趁火打劫，真正丧尽天良。”
To plunder his employer at a time like this—he has no conscience left.”

原来唐子韶从早康出事以后，认为胡雪岩之垮只是迟早间事，
Since Fukang’s troubles began, Tang had believed Hu’s collapse only a matter of time.

公济典当然也保不住了，
Gongji could not survive it either.

既然如此，且趁眼前还能为所欲为之时正捞一笔。
He might as well seize what he could while he was still free to do as he pleased.

“他的手法很毒，不过说穿了一个钱不值，
“His method is vicious, though once explained it is worth nothing.

弄个破铜表来算是金表，一当十两、八两银子，
He brings in a broken brass watch, treats it as a gold one, and advances eight or ten taels on it.

马大老爷，你说，这是不是放抢？”
Your Honour, is that not outright robbery?”

“太可恶了！”马逢时亦是义形于色，
“Abominable!” Ma too looked righteously indignant.

“在满当货上动手脚，还可以说是取巧，因为东家的本息到底已经收回了，只不过没有占到额外的好处而已。
“Tampering with expired pledges might at least be called sharp practice: after all, the proprietor has recovered his principal and interest and merely loses an additional profit.

象这样子，以假作真，以贱为贵，诈欺东家，是可以重办他的罪的。
But passing off false goods as genuine and cheap goods as valuable to defraud the proprietor is an offence that can be severely punished.”

““当然应该重办。”周少棠冷笑一声：
“And severely punished it should be.” Zhou gave a cold laugh.

“他自以为聪明，
“He thinks himself clever.

假货要到满当没有人来赎，盘库日验货，才会发现，
The fake goods would not be discovered until the pledges expired without being redeemed and the storeroom was checked.

那时他已回徽州老家了，
By then he would be back home in Huizhou.

你就告他，他也可以赖，说当初原是金表，不晓得怎么掉包了。
Even if you prosecuted him, he could deny it: the watch had originally been gold, and he had no idea how it had been switched.

也没有想到，偏偏会遇到你马大爷，又遇到我，
He never expected to run into you and me, Your Honour.

不等满当，就要办它一个水落石出，
Before the pledges expire, we shall get to the bottom of it.

这叫‘人有千算，天只一算’。“
As the saying goes, ‘A man may make a thousand calculations; Heaven needs only one.’”


谈到这里杨书办插嘴了，
Yang spoke up.

“唐子韶总还有同党吧？”他说，
“Tang must have an accomplice.

“朝奉是很爱惜名誉的，
Pawnbrokers value their reputations.

如果有为唐子韶勾结、欺骗东家这个名声在外，以后就没有人敢请教他，只好改行了。”
If a man became known for conspiring with Tang to cheat his employer, no one would engage him again; he would have to change his trade.”

“老杨，你问得好。
“A good question, Old Yang.

唐子韶自然有同党；不过这个同党，同他的关系不同，是他一手提拔起来的外甥。”
Tang certainly has an accomplice, but the relationship is a special one: his sister’s son, whom he has advanced entirely through his own efforts.”

“嗯，嗯！这就是了。
“Ah, that explains it.

唐子韶预备卷铺盖了，当然也要带了他一起走。”
If Tang is preparing to pack up and leave, he will naturally take the nephew with him.”

“一点不错。”
“Exactly.”

周少棠转脸说道：
Zhou turned to Ma.

“马大老爷，你明天去了，就要着落在唐子韶的外甥身上，追究真相。
“Tomorrow you must get at the truth through Tang’s nephew.

要格外留心最近的帐，
Pay particular attention to the recent entries.

拿当得多的几笔，对帐验货，
Select several of the largest advances and compare the pledged goods with the accounts.

如果货帐不符，再问是哪个经的手？
If the goods do not match the entries, ask who handled the transactions.

第一步只要这样就可以了，”
That is all you need do at first.”

“你是说当时不要追究？”
“You mean I should not pursue the matter on the spot?”

“对，当时不要追究，
“Exactly.

因为当时一问，唐子韶一定有番花言巧语，
If you ask then, Tang will have some plausible story ready.

打草惊蛇，不是聪明的办法？”
Alerting him before you are prepared is hardly wise.”

“那么，怎么是聪明的办法呢？”
“What would be wise, then?”

“把唐子韶的外甥带走，另外找个地方去间。
“Take his nephew away and question him elsewhere.

那些小生后经不起吓，一吓什么都说出来了。”周少棠又说：“最好到县衙门里惜两名差役带了去，
These youngsters cannot stand a fright; frighten them and they tell you everything.” Zhou added, “Better still, borrow two runners from the county office and take them with you.

威风更足，事情也就更容易办了。”
You will look more imposing, and it will make the work easier.”

“是，是，这倒容易，
“Yes, that is easy.

仁和县的王大老爷，我很熟。”
I know Magistrate Wang of Renhe well.”

马逢时越听越有兴趣，很起劲地问：
The more Ma heard, the keener he became.

“问出来以后呢？”
“And after we have the answers?

是不是再传唐子韶来问。“
Do we summon Tang for questioning?”


“用不着你去传他，
“You will not need to summon him.

他自己会到府上来求见。”
He will come to your house and ask to see you.”

“何以见得？”
“What makes you so sure?”

“这……”周少棠迟疑一下，
“Well...” Zhou hesitated.

说声：“我先同老杨说句话。”
“Let me have a word with Old Yang first.”

“他将杨书办拉到一边，悄悄问他跟马逢时的关系。
Drawing the clerk aside, he quietly asked about his relationship with Ma.

杨书办据实以告，周少棠便另有话问了。
Yang told him truthfully, and Zhou asked another question.

“快过年了，
“The New Year is approaching.

马木老爷当然要弄几个过年盘缠是不是？”
His Honour will naturally want to find a little money to see him through it?”

“当然。”
“Of course.

杨书办问：“你的意思是要他敲唐子韶一笔？”
You mean he should squeeze something out of Tang?”

“不错，
“Exactly.

不过，公私要兼顾，
But both public and private interests must be considered.

他可以同唐子韶提条件：
He can give Tang two conditions.

条一，要他拿原当赎回去，这是公，
First, Tang must redeem the pledged articles himself: that protects the public interest.

第二，要弄几两银子过年，
Second, he must provide a few taels for the New Year.

数目他自己同唐子韶去谈……或者，同你谈。
His Honour can negotiate the amount with Tang—or you can.

如果唐子韶不就范，报上去请他吃官司。
If Tang refuses, report him and let him face prosecution.”

“杨书办盘算了一下，觉得其事可行，笑笑说道：
Yang considered it, decided the scheme was workable, and smiled.

“你对胡大先生倒是蛮够朋友。”
“You really are a good friend to Mr Hu.”

“贫贱之交不可忘。”周少棠掉了句文，
“One must not forget the friends of one’s poverty,” Zhou replied, dropping into a literary phrase.

虽然有些不伦，却不能说他这句话不通。
The quotation was not altogether appropriate, but neither could one say it made no sense.


两人再深入地谈了一下，自然而然地出现了一种演变，即是襄助马逢时的工作，由周少棠移转到杨书办身上。
As they discussed the matter further, a change came about naturally: the task of assisting Ma passed from Zhou to Yang.

不过周少棠仍在幕后支援，
Zhou would still support them from behind the scenes.

商定他在阜康钱庄对面的一家安利茶店喝茶，
They agreed that he would sit drinking tea at Anli Tea House, opposite Fukang Bank.

公济典近在咫尺，有事随时可以接头。
Gongji was only a step away, so they could contact him whenever necessary.

等相偕回到原座，周少棠作了交代，“马大者爷，”他说：“你同杨书办很熟，
Returning to the table together, Zhou explained, “Your Honour, you and Clerk Yang know each other well.

明天请他陪了你去，有啥话说起来也方便。
Ask him to accompany you tomorrow; it will be easier to discuss anything that arises.

其中的窍门，我同杨书办说过了，这桩差使，一定可以办得漂亮。”
I have told him the essential points, and this assignment will certainly go well.”

说着起身告辞而去。
He then rose, said goodbye, and left.

其时已是万家灯火，酒客络绎而至，
By now lights shone from every house, and drinkers were streaming into the tavern.

热闹非凡，
It was extremely noisy.

说话轻了听不见，重了又怕泄漏机密，
If they spoke softly they could not be heard; if loudly, they risked revealing their secrets.

杨书办提议另外找个地方去喝酒。
Yang suggested going elsewhere for another drink.

“到哪里？”
“Where?”

“你跟我去，
“Come with me.

不过，”杨书办声明在行先，“马大老爷，到了那个地方，我不便用尊称，
But I must say this first: when we get there, I cannot address you by your title.

一叫马大者爷，露了相不好。”
Calling you ‘Your Honour’ would give you away.”

“不要紧，
“Never mind.

你叫我老马好了。”
Call me Old Ma.”

“最好连姓都不要用真的。
“Better not use your real surname either.

你们老太太尊姓？”
What is your honoured mother’s surname?”

“姓李。”
“Li.”

“我就叫你老李了。
“Then I shall call you Old Li.

离这里不远，
It is not far.

我们走了去。”
Let us walk.”



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第七章（一）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Seven, Part One
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第七章 大封典铺｜CHAPTER SEVEN: THE MASS SEQUESTRATION OF THE PAWNSHOPS


杨书办惠了帐，带着马逢时穿过两条街，进入一条曲曲折折的小巷，
Clerk Yang paid the bill and led Ma Fengshi across two streets into a winding lane.

在巷底有一家人家，双扉紧闭，
At its end stood a house with both doors shut.

但门旁有一盏油灯，微弱的光焰，照出一张退了色的梅红笺，上写“孙寓”二字。
An oil lamp beside the entrance cast a feeble light on a faded rose-red slip of paper bearing the words “Sun Residence.”

“这是什么地方？”马逢时有些不安地问。
“What is this place?” Ma asked uneasily.

“马……”杨书办赶紧顿住，
“Ma…” Yang checked himself.

“老李，这个地方你不能告诉李大嫂。”
“Old Li, you must not tell Mrs Li about this place.”

一听这话，马逢时不再作声，
Ma said no more.

只见杨书办举手敲门，三急三缓，
Yang knocked three times quickly and three times slowly.

刚刚敲完，大门呀地一声开了，
As he finished, the door creaked open.

一个半老徐娘，高举着“手照”说：
A middle-aged woman, still attractive, held up a hand lantern.

“我道哪个，
“I wondered who it was.

是你。
You!

算算你也应该来了。”
I thought it was about time you came.”

接着，脸上浮满了笑容又问：
Her face filled with smiles.

“这位是……”
“And this gentleman is…?”

“李老板。”杨书办紧接着问：“楼上有没有客人？”
“Mr Li,” Yang answered, then asked at once, “Any guests upstairs?”

“没有。”
“No.”

“楼下呢？”
“Downstairs?”

“庆余堂的老朱同朋友在那里吃酒，
“Old Zhu from Qingyu Hall is drinking with some friends.

就要走的。”
They will be leaving soon.”

“他们东家遭难，他倒还有心思吃花酒。”杨书办又说：
“His employer is in trouble, yet he still has a mind for courtesan parties!

“你不要说我在这里。”
Do not tell him I am here.”

“多关照的。”
“As if I needed reminding!”

那半老徐娘招呼“李老板”说：
The woman turned to “Mr Li.”

“请你跟我来。
“Come with me, please.

走好！”
Mind your step.”

于是一行三人，由堂屋侧面的楼梯上楼，
The three of them went up the stairs beside the main room.

楼上一大两小三个房间，
Upstairs were three rooms, one large and two small.

到了当中大房间，等主人剔亮了灯，杨书办方为马逢时引见。
In the central room, once their hostess had brightened the lamp, Yang introduced her.

“她姓孙。
“Her surname is Sun.

你叫她孙干娘好了。”
You can call her Auntie Sun.”

马逢时已经了然，这里是杭州人所说的“私门头”，而孙干娘便是鸨儿，
Ma now understood: this was what Hangzhou people called a private brothel, and Auntie Sun was its madam.

当即笑嘻嘻地说道：“孙子娘的子女儿一定很多？”
Smiling broadly, he said, “You must have a great many daughters, Auntie Sun?”

“有，有。”
“Indeed I do.”

孙子娘转脸问杨书办：
She turned to Yang.

“先吃茶还是先吃酒？”
“Tea first, or wine?”

“茶也要，酒也要，还要吃饭。”
“Both—and we shall want a meal as well.”

说着，杨书办拉着孙干娘到外房，过了好一会才进来。
He drew her into the outer room and returned some time later.


“这个孙干娘，倒是徐娘半老，丰韵犹存。”马逢时说道。
“Auntie Sun may be past her first youth, but she still has plenty of charm,” Ma remarked.

“怎么？
“What?

你倒看中她了！
Have you taken a fancy to her?

我来做媒。”
I shall be your matchmaker.”

“算了，算了！
“Enough of that!

我们先谈正事。”
Let us discuss our business first.”

这话正好符合杨书办的安排，
This suited Yang’s arrangements perfectly.

他已关照好孙干娘备酒备饭，要讲究，但不妨慢慢来，公便跟马逢时先谈妥了明日之事，再开怀畅饮。
He had instructed Auntie Sun to prepare good wine and a good meal, but to take her time, so he could settle tomorrow’s business with Ma before they drank freely.

“你的事归我来接下半段。
“Leave the rest of your business to me.

我先问你，你年底有多少帐？”
First, how much do you owe at the year’s end?”

马逢时一愣，
Ma was taken aback.

约莫估计了一下说：“总要五六十两银子才能过关。”
After a rough calculation, he said, “I shall need fifty or sixty taels to get through it.”

“我晓得了。”杨书办说：
“I understand.

“明天我陪了你去，
I shall go with you tomorrow.

到了公济典，你看我的眼色行事。”
Once we reach Gongji Pawnshop, take your cue from my eyes.”

何谓看眼色行事？
What exactly did that mean?

马逢时在心里好好想了一会问道：
Ma pondered it for a while.

“杨大哥……”
“Brother Yang…”

“慢点，慢点。”杨书办硬截断了他的话，
“Wait!” Yang cut him short.

“明天在公济典，你可不能这样叫我。”
“You must not address me like that at Gongji tomorrow.”

“我明白。
“I understand.

做此官，行此札，
When holding an office, observe its forms.

到那时候，我自然会官派十足地叫你杨书办，
I shall call you ‘Clerk Yang’ in my grandest official manner.

你可不要生气。”
Do not take offence.”

“不会，不会。
“Of course not.

这不过是唱出戏而已。”
We are only putting on a performance.”

“这出戏你是主角。”马逢时问：
“You are the leading player.

“你认识不认识唐子韶。”
Do you know Tang Zishao?”

“怎么不认识，不过没有什么交情。”
“Naturally, though we are not close.”

“你认识最好，
“Good.

我想明天我做红脸，你做白脸，
Tomorrow I shall play the stern red face and you the kindly white.

遇见有不对的地方，我打官腔，你来转圜，
If anything is wrong, I shall speak with official severity and you can smooth matters over.

唐子韶当然就要找上你了，
Tang will naturally turn to you.

什么事可以马虎，什么事不能马虎，我都听你的语气来办。
Whether something can be overlooked or must not be, I shall follow the tone you take.”

““一点不错。”杨书办很欣慰他说，
“Exactly!” Yang said with satisfaction.

“我们好好儿来唱他一出‘得胜回朝’。”
“We shall give a fine performance of Returning to Court in Triumph.”


谈到这里，楼梯上有响声，
Footsteps sounded on the stairs.

只见帘启处，孙干娘在前，后面跟着女佣，手中端一个大托盘，四样酒菜，两副杯筷。
The curtain lifted, and Auntie Sun entered, followed by a maid carrying a large tray with four dishes and two sets of cups and chopsticks.

“怎么只有两副？”杨书办问。
“Why only two?” Yang asked.

“我怕你们要谈事情，不要旁人来打搅。
“I thought you had business to discuss and would not want to be disturbed.”

“谈好了，
“We have finished.

再去添两副来。”杨书办问：
Bring two more sets.

“巧珍在不在？”
Is Qiaozhen here?”

“今天没有来。”孙干娘说：
“She has not come today.

“阿兰在这里，
A’lan is here, though.

不晓得李老板看得中，看不中？”
I do not know whether Mr Li would care for her.”

杨书办心中一动，因为看到马逢时目不转睛地看着孙干娘，决心成全他们这一段露水姻缘，
Noticing that Ma could not take his eyes off Auntie Sun, Yang decided to bring about a brief liaison between them.

当即说道：“等一等再说。
“We shall see later,” he said.

你先陪我们吃两杯。”
“Have a couple of cups with us first.”

于是又去添了杯筷来，
More cups and chopsticks were brought.

孙干娘为客人布菜斟酒，颇为周到，马逢时不住地夸赞酒好菜好，
Auntie Sun served the guests attentively, and Ma kept praising the wine and food.

杨书办只是微笑不语。
Yang merely smiled.

看看是时候了，他问：“庆余堂的老朱还没有走吧？”
When he thought the time was right, he asked, “Old Zhu from Qingyu Hall has not left yet?”

“还没有？”
“Not yet.”

“我下楼去看一看他。”
“I shall go down and see him.”

杨书办站起身来，对孙干娘说：“你陪李老板多吃几杯，
Rising, Yang told Auntie Sun, “Keep Mr Li company over a few more cups.

我的好朋友，
He is a good friend of mine.

你要另眼相看。”
You must treat him especially well.”

于是杨书办扬长下楼，叫相帮进去通知，
He went downstairs and had an attendant announce him.

床余堂的老朱，满脸通红地迎了出来，
Old Zhu came out, his face flushed scarlet.

“老杨，老杨！”
“Yang!

他拉着他的手说：“请进来吃酒。”
Come in for a drink!” he said, taking his hand.

“方便不方便。”
“Would it be convenient?”

“方便，方便。
“Certainly.

不是你的熟人，就是我的熟人。”
Everyone is either a friend of yours or a friend of mine.”

进去一看，四个人中只有一个不认识，
Inside, Yang knew three of the four men.

请教姓名，才知道是老朱的同事。
On asking the fourth man’s name, he learned that he was Zhu’s colleague.

杨书办之来闯席，一则是故意避开，好让马逢时有跟孙千娘勾搭的机会，再则便是打听庆余堂的情形，
Yang had joined the party partly to leave Ma an opportunity to make advances to Auntie Sun and partly to find out how Qingyu Hall was faring.

尤其使他困惑而又好奇的是，胡雪岩的全盘事业，都在风雨飘摇之中，何以老朱竟还兴高采烈地在这里寻欢作乐。
What especially puzzled him was how Zhu could be enjoying himself so heartily when all Hu Xueyan’s businesses were in peril.


席间一一应酬过了，一巡酒下来有人提起阜康的风波，
After the greetings and a round of drinks, someone mentioned the crisis at Fukang.

这是最近轰动南北的大新闻，凡是应酬场中，几乎无一处不资以为谈助。
It was the great news of the day throughout the country, discussed at almost every social gathering.

杨书办只是静静地听着，等到谈得告一段落时，他开口了。
Yang listened quietly until there was a pause.

“老朱，你在庆余堂是啥职司？”
“Zhu, what exactly is your job at Qingyu Hall?”

“我管查验。”
“I handle inspections.”

“查验？”杨书办问：“查验点啥？
“Inspections of what?

查验货色？
The quality of the goods?

你又不是药材行出身，
You did not start in the medicinal-herb trade.

药材‘路脚’正不正，你又不懂。”
You cannot tell whether the ingredients come from the proper sources.”

“货色好坏不懂，斤两多少还不会看？
“I may not know their quality, but I can read a weight!

等看货的老先生说药材地道，过秤时就要请我了。”
Once the experienced men pronounce the herbs genuine, they call me to supervise the weighing.

老朱又说：“不过，我顶重要的一项职司，是防备货色偷漏。”
My most important duty, though, is preventing goods from being stolen or spirited away.”

“有没有抓到过。”
“Have you ever caught anyone?”

“当然抓到过，不过不多。”
“Of course, but not many.”

“你说不多；
“You say not many.

只怕已经偷漏了的，你不晓得。
Perhaps goods have disappeared without your knowing.”

“不会。”老朱停了一下说：
“No.” Zhu paused.

“老实说，你就叫人偷漏，你们也不肯。
“To be frank, even if you urged the men to steal, they would refuse.

你倒想，饭碗虽不是金的、银的，至少也是铁的，一生一世敲不破；
Think of it: their rice bowls may not be gold or silver, but they are at least iron, unbreakable for a lifetime.

工钱之外有花红，
Besides wages, there are bonuses.

遇到夏天有时疫流行，上门的主顾排长龙等药，另外有津贴。
When summer epidemics bring customers queuing for medicines, there is an extra allowance.

再说家里大人、小伢儿有病痛，用药不管丸散膏丹，再贵重的都是白拿，
If an adult or child at home falls ill, medicines—pills, powders, pastes or pellets—are free, however costly.

至于膏滋药、药酒，收是收钱，不过比成本还要低。
They do pay for tonic pastes and medicinal wines, but at less than cost.

如果贪便宜，偷了一两支人参，这些好处都没有了，
Steal a root or two of ginseng out of greed, and all those benefits vanish.

你想划得来，划不来？“
Would that be worth it?”


“你的话是不错，
“You have a point.

不过这回恐怕要连根铲了！”
But this time the whole thing may be uprooted!”

“你是说胡大先生的生意怕会不保？
“You mean Mr Hu’s businesses may not survive?

别的难说，庆余堂一定保得住。”
I cannot speak for the others, but Qingyu Hall is certain to remain.”

“为啥？”
“Why?”

“有保障。”老朱从从容容地说：
“It has protection,” Zhu replied calmly.

“这回阜康的事情出来，我们的档手同大家说：胡大先生办得顶好的事业，就是我们庆余堂。
“When the trouble at Fukang began, our manager told us that Qingyu Hall was the best of all Mr Hu’s enterprises.

不但挣钱，还替胡大先生挣了名声。
It earns money and has earned him a reputation too.

如果说亏空公款，要拿庆余堂封了抵债，
Suppose they say there is a shortage of public funds and seal Qingyu Hall to cover the debt.

货色生财，都可以入官，庆余堂这块招脾拿不出去的。
They can confiscate the stock and equipment, but they cannot take away its signboard.

庆余堂是简称，
Qingyu Hall is only the short name.

正式的招牌是胡庆余堂，
The full name is Hu Qingyu Hall.

如果老板不姓胡了，怎么还好用庆余堂的招牌。
If the owner is no longer a Hu, how can they keep using that sign?

所以官府一定不会封庆余堂，
So the authorities are certain not to seal it.

仍旧让胡大先生来当老板。
They will let Mr Hu remain the owner.

大家要格外巴结，抓药要道地，对待客人要和气，
We must all work especially hard, dispense genuine medicines and treat customers courteously.

这只饭碗一定捧得实，
Then our rice bowls will be secure.

不必担心。”
There is no need to worry.”


听到这里，杨书办心中浮起浓重的感慨，
Yang was deeply moved by what he heard.

胡雪岩有如此大的事业，培植了不知道多少人材，是可想而知的事，
With enterprises on so vast a scale, Hu must have trained more capable men than anyone could count.

但培植人材之始。如果只是为他自己找个不问手段，只要能替他嫌钱的帮手，结果不是宓本常，就是唐子韶，
But if, at the beginning, he sought only assistants who would make money for him by whatever means, the result would be a Mi Benchang or a Tang Zishao.

因为水涨船高，“徒弟”升伙计，伙计升档手，
As the water rose, so did the boat: an apprentice became an employee, an employee became a manager.

这时候的档手心里就会想：“你做老板，
Then the manager would think, “How did you become the proprietor?

还不是靠我做徒弟的时候，洗尿壶、烫水烟袋，
When I was an apprentice, I emptied your chamber pot and rinsed your water pipe with hot water.

一步一步抬你起来的？
I raised you up step by step.

伙计做到啥时候？
How long must I remain an employee?

我要做老板了。”
I want to be a proprietor myself.”

一动到这个念头，档手就不是档手了，
Once that thought took hold, he ceased to be a true manager.

第一步是“做小货”，
First came private trading on the side.

有好生意，自己来做，
If a profitable transaction presented itself, he took it for himself.

譬如有人上门求售一批货色，明知必赚，却多方挑剔，最后明点暗示，到某处去接头，有成交之望，
Someone might offer a consignment he knew would make money; he would find fault with it in every way, then openly or indirectly suggest another place where a deal might be struck.

其实指点之处就是他私下所设的号子。
That place would be his own secret business.

其次是留意人材，伙计、徒弟中看中了的，私下刻意笼络，一旦能成局面，不愁没有班底，
Next, he would watch for talent, privately cultivating promising employees and apprentices so that, when he could establish himself, he would have his staff ready.

最后是拉拢客户，
Finally came drawing away customers.

其道孔多，但要拉拢客户，一定不会说原来的东家的好话，是一定的道理，
There were many methods, but one thing was certain: to win them over, he would never speak well of his present employer.

否则客户不会“跳槽”。
Otherwise, why would they change firms?

因此，只要有了私心重的档手，一到动了自立门户的念头，就必然损人以利己，侵蚀到东家的利益，
A selfish manager who decided to set up on his own would inevitably profit at his employer’s expense.

即令是东家所一手培植出来的，亦不会觉得自己忘恩负义，
Even if the employer had trained him from the start, he would feel no ingratitude.

因为他替东家赚过钱，自以为已经报答过了。
He had made money for the man and believed that debt was already paid.


庆余堂的档手能够如此通达诚恳，尽力维持庆余堂这块金字招牌，为胡雪岩保住一片事业，这原因是可想而知的，
The reason Qingyu Hall’s manager could be so sincere and understanding, doing everything to preserve its reputation and one part of Hu’s business, was not difficult to imagine.

胡雪岩当初创办庆余堂，虽起于西征将士所需要成药及药材，数量极大，
Hu had founded the medicine shop because the troops on the western campaign required enormous quantities of prepared medicines and herbs.

向外采购不但费用甚巨，而且亦不见得能够及时供应，
Buying them elsewhere was expensive and did not always ensure timely delivery.

他既负责后路粮台，当然要精打细算，
Responsible for the supply administration behind the army, he had to calculate carefully.

自己办一家大药店，有省费、省事、方便三项好处，
A large shop of his own would save money, save trouble and make supply easier.

并没有打算赚钱，
He had not intended to earn a profit.

后来因为药材地道、成药灵验、营业鼎盛，大力赚钱。
Later, genuine ingredients and effective preparations brought flourishing trade and substantial earnings.

但盈余除了转为资本，扩大规模以外，平时对贫民施药施医，历次水旱灾荒、时疫流行，捐出大批成药，亦全由盈余上开支，
But apart from profits reinvested to expand the business, the surplus paid for free medicines and treatment for the poor, and for large donations of prepared remedies during floods, droughts, famines and epidemics.

胡雪岩从来没有用过庆余堂的一文钱。
Hu had never taken a single cash from Qingyu Hall for his own use.


由于当初存心大公无私，物色档手的眼光，当然就不同了，
Because his original purpose was entirely public-spirited, he had sought a different sort of manager.

第一要诚实，
Honesty came first.

庆余堂一进门，供顾客等药休息之处，高悬一幅黑漆金字的对联：“修合虽无人见，存心自有天知。”
Just inside the shop, above the place where customers waited and rested, hung a black-lacquered couplet in gold: “Though none may see your medicines prepared, Heaven knows the intentions in your heart.”

因为不诚实的人卖药，尤其是卖成药，材料欠佳，分量不足，服用了会害人。
A dishonest medicine seller, especially one selling ready-made preparations, could harm people by using poor ingredients or insufficient quantities.

其次要心慈。
Compassion came next.

医家有割股之心，卖药亦是如此，
A physician must have the heart to sacrifice his own flesh for another; a medicine seller should be the same.

时时为病家着想，才能刻刻顾到药的品质。
Only by constantly thinking of the sick could he constantly attend to quality.

最后当然还要能干，否则诚实、心慈，反而成了易于受欺的弱点。
Finally, the man must be capable, or honesty and compassion might merely make him easy to deceive.

这样选中的一个档手，不必在意东家的利润，会全心全力去经营事业，
Such a manager, free from concern for the proprietor’s personal profit, would devote himself wholeheartedly to the business.

东家没有私心，也就引不起他的私心，加以待遇优厚，亦不必起什么私心。
An unselfish employer would not awaken selfishness in him; generous treatment removed any need for it.

庆余堂能不受阜康的影响，细细考查来龙去脉，自有种善因、得善果的颠扑不破之理在内。
Examined closely, Qingyu Hall’s escape from Fukang’s troubles exemplified the enduring truth that good causes bear good fruit.

念头转到这里，不由得对那连姓名都还不知道的余庆堂的档手，油然而起敬慕之心。
Yang felt a spontaneous admiration for its manager, whose name he did not even know.

于是在把杯闲谈之际，杨书办向老朱问起此人的生平，
Over their drinks he asked Zhu about the man’s history.

据说庆余堂的档手姓叶；当初是由胡雪岩的一个姓刘的亲戚去物色来的，
He learned that his surname was Ye and that a relative of Hu’s named Liu had originally found him.

性情、才干大致证明了杨书办的推断，这就更使他感到得意了。
What he heard of Ye’s character and ability broadly confirmed his deductions, making Yang still more pleased with himself.


“你们的档手对得起胡大先生，也对得起自己，
“Your manager has done right by Mr Hu and by himself,” Yang said.

不比公济典的那个黑良心的唐子韶，
“Not like that black-hearted Tang Zishao at Gongji.

我看他快要吃官司了。”
I think he will soon find himself facing charges.”

“怎么？”老朱问道：
“What?” Zhu asked.

“你这话是哪里来的？”
“Where did you hear that?”

这一问才使杨书办意识到酒后失言了。
Only then did Yang realise that wine had loosened his tongue.

他当然不肯再说，
Naturally, he would say no more.

支支吾吾地敷衍了一会，重回楼上。
After some evasive replies, he returned upstairs.

楼上的马逢时与孙干娘，还在喝酒闲谈，
Ma and Auntie Sun were still drinking and talking.

彼此的神态倒都还庄重，但谈得很投机，却是看得出来的，
Their manner remained decorous, but they were plainly getting on very well.

因而杨书办便开玩笑他说：“老李，今天不要回去了。”
Yang joked, “Old Li, do not go home tonight.”

“你在同哪个说话？”孙子娘瞟眼过来问说。
“Whom are you speaking to?” Auntie Sun asked, glancing across.

杨书办尚未开口，马逢时却先笑了，
Before Yang could answer, Ma laughed.

这一笑自有蹊跷在内，他就不作声了。
There was something behind that laugh, so Yang held his tongue.

“明明是马大老爷，
“He is Magistrate Ma.

你怎么说是李老板？”孙干娘质问：
Why did you call him Mr Li?” Auntie Sun demanded.

“为啥要说假话？”
“Why tell a lie?”

“对不起！”马逢时向杨书办致歉：
“I am sorry,” Ma apologised to Yang.

“她说我不象生意人，又问我哪里学来的官派，所以我跟她说了实话。”
“She said I did not look like a businessman and asked where I had acquired my official manner, so I told her the truth.”

“说了实话？”杨书办问：
“The truth?

“是啥实话？
What truth?

除了身分还有啥？”
Anything besides who you are?”

“没有别的。”
“Nothing else.”

杨书办比较放心了，转脸对孙干娘说：
Somewhat reassured, Yang turned to Auntie Sun.

“你要识得轻重，
“You must understand the importance of this.

不要说马大老爷到你这里来玩过。”
Do not tell people Magistrate Ma has been here for pleasure.”


“这有啥好瞒的？
“What is there to hide?

道台大人都到我这里来吃过酒。”
Even a circuit intendant has come here to drink.”

“你不要同我争，
“Do not argue.

你要我常常带朋友来，你就听我的话。”杨书办又说：“今天要走了，
If you want me to keep bringing friends, listen to me.” Yang continued, “We must go now.

马大老爷明天有公事，
Magistrate Ma has official business tomorrow.

改天再来。”
We shall come another day.”

“哪天？”孙干娘问：
“When?” Auntie Sun asked.

“明天？”
“Tomorrow?”

“明天怕还不行。”马逢时自己回答：
“Tomorrow may still be impossible,” Ma answered for himself.

“我等公事一完了，就来看你。”
“I shall come as soon as my business is finished.”

“条戳没有到，今天晚上也找不着人了，明天一早去请教刻字店。”杨书办说：
“The rectangular stamp has not been made,” Yang said. “We shall find nobody to do it tonight. I shall go to an engraver first thing tomorrow.

“总要到中午，一切才会预备好，
It will be noon before everything is ready.

我看准定明天吃中饭去查封。”
We had better settle on taking the shop into official custody at lunchtime.”

“好！
“Very well.

一切拜托，我在舍间听你的信。”
I leave everything to you and shall wait for word at home.”

于是相偕离座出门，
They rose and left together.

走在路上，杨书办少不得有所埋怨，而马逢时不断道歉，他也就不便多说什么了。
On the way, Yang could not help reproaching Ma, but Ma apologised so persistently that he could hardly say more.


第二夭是“卯期”，
The next day was one on which attendance had to be marked.

杨书办照例要到“礼房”去坐一坐，以防“县大老爷”有什么要跟“学者爷”打交道的事要问，好及时“应卯”。
As usual, Yang went to sit in the rites section, so that if the county magistrate had questions about dealings with the education official, he would be on hand to answer the roll.

礼房有现成的刻字匠，
An engraver was readily available there.

找了一个来，将一张马逢时的临时衔名条交了给他，
Yang summoned one and handed him a slip bearing Ma’s temporary title.

不到一顿饭的工夫，已经刻好送来，
In less than the time it took to eat a meal, the stamp was cut and brought back.

看看无事，起身回家，预备伴随马逢时到公济典去查封。
Finding nothing else to do, Yang went home to prepare to accompany Ma to Gongji.

一进门跨进堂屋，便看到正中方桌上堆了一条火腿，大小四个盒子，
The moment he entered the main room, he saw a ham and four boxes of different sizes piled on the central table.

门口又是五十斤重的一坛花雕，
By the door stood a fifty-jin jar of Huadiao wine.

知道是有人送礼，
Someone had sent a gift.

便喊：“阿毛娘，阿毛娘！”
“A’mao’s mother!” he called.

阿毛是他儿子的乳名，“阿毛娘”便是叫他的妻子。
A’mao was his son’s childhood name; he was calling his wife.

杨太太应声而至，不等他开口便说：
She came at once and spoke before he could.

“有张片子在这里，
“Here is a card.

是公济典的姓唐的。
The man is Tang from Gongji Pawnshop.

我们跟他没有来往，送的礼我也不敢动。
We have no dealings with him, so I dared not touch the gifts.”

“说着，杨太太递过来一张名片，
She handed him the card.

一看果然是唐子韶，
It was indeed Tang Zishao’s.

略一沉吟，杨书办问道：“他有什么话？”
After a moment’s thought, Yang asked, “What did he say?”

“说等等再来。”杨太太答说：
“That he would come back shortly.

“看他吞吞吐吐，好象有什么话，要说不肯说似的。”
He seemed hesitant, as though he had something to say but would not say it.”

“我晓得了。
“I understand.

这份礼不能收的。”
We cannot accept these gifts.”

杨书办坐了下来，一面喝茶一面想，
Yang sat drinking tea and thinking.

唐子韶的来意，不问可知？
Tang’s purpose was obvious.

他只奇怪，此人的消息，何以如此灵通，知道他会赔马逢时去查封公济？
What puzzled him was how the man had learned so quickly that Yang would accompany Ma to take Gongji into official custody.

是不是已经先去看过马逢时，马逢时关照来找他的呢？
Had he already visited Ma and been told to come here?

倘是如此，似乎先要跟马逢时见个面，问一问他交谈的情形，才好定主意。
If so, Yang ought to see Ma first and find out what they had discussed before deciding how to act.


正这样转着念头，听得有人敲门，
While he was considering this, someone knocked.

便亲自起身去应接。
Yang went to answer the door himself.

他跟唐子韶在应酬场中见过，是点头之交，
He and Tang were nodding acquaintances from social gatherings.

开门看时，果然是他，少不得要作一番讶异之状。
Sure enough, Tang stood outside, and Yang had to make a show of surprise.

“杨先生，”唐子韶满脸堆笑地说：“想不到是我吧？”
“You did not expect me, did you, Mr Yang?” Tang asked with a broad smile.

“想不到，想不到。
“Indeed I did not.

请里面坐。”
Please come in.”

杨书办在前头领路，进了堂屋，指着桌子说：
Leading him into the main room, Yang pointed at the table.

“唐朝奉，无归不肥禄，
“Master Tang, I cannot accept a reward I have not earned.

你这份礼，我决不收。”
I certainly shall not accept these gifts.”

唐子韶似乎已经预知他会有这种态度，毫不在乎他说：
Tang seemed to have expected this response and took it lightly.

“小事，小事，
“A small matter.

慢慢谈。”
We can discuss it in due course.”

杨书办见他如此沉着，不免心生警惕，
His composure made Yang wary.

说声：“请坐。”
“Please sit.”

也不叫人倒茶，自己在下首正襟危坐，是不想久谈的神情。
He did not call for tea, but sat stiffly upright in the lower seat, signalling that he did not intend a long conversation.

“杨先生，听说你要陪马大老爷来查封公济典？”
“Mr Yang, I hear you are to accompany Magistrate Ma to take Gongji into official custody?”

见他开门见山地发问，杨书办却不愿但然承认，
Faced with this direct question, Yang was unwilling to admit it outright.

反问一句：“唐朝奉，你听哪个说的？”
“Who told you, Master Tang?”

“是辗转得来的消息。”
“The news reached me indirectly.”

辗转传闻，便表示他不曾跟马逢时见过面，
If it was indirect news, he had not met Ma.

而消息来源，只有两处，一是周少棠，一是庆余堂的老朱。
There were only two possible sources: Zhou Shaotang or Old Zhu from Qingyu Hall.

细想一想，多半以后者为是。
On reflection, the latter seemed more likely.

“请问，你是不是从庆余堂那边得来的消息？”
“Did you hear it through Qingyu Hall?”

这也就等于杨书办承认了这件事，
That was itself an admission of the matter.

唐子韶点点头说：“是的。”
Tang nodded. “Yes.”


“那么，老兄就是打听这一点。”
“So you came only to find out about that?”

“当然还有话要请教杨先生。”唐子韶问：
“There are other things I should like to ask you, of course.

“请问，预备什么时候来？
When do you intend to come?

我好等候大驾。
I should like to be ready to receive you.”

““言重！言重！
“You are too courteous.

这要问马大老爷。”
You must ask Magistrate Ma about that.”

由于活不投机，唐子韶不能吐露真意，
Finding the conversation unpromising, Tang could not disclose his real purpose.

不过他送的那份不能算菲薄的札，始终不肯收回，
Yet he would not take back the gifts, which were by no means trifling.

杨书办亦无可奈何，
Yang could do nothing about it.

心头不免有欠了人家一份人情，协助马逢时去查封公济时，较难说话的困惑。
He now felt uncomfortably indebted, and feared it would be harder to take a firm line when assisting Ma at Gongji.

“杨先生，”唐子韶起身预备告辞时，忽然问出一句话来：“我想请问你，同周少棠熟不熟？”
As Tang rose to leave, he suddenly asked, “Mr Yang, may I ask whether you know Zhou Shaotang well?”

杨书办沉吟了一下，只答了一个字：“熟。”
Yang considered, then answered simply, “Well.”

“他同马大老爷呢？”
“And how well does he know Magistrate Ma?”

问到这句话，显得此人的交游很广、路子很多，
This question suggested extensive connections and many sources of information.

也许前一天他与马逢时、周少棠曾在酒店中一起聚晤这件事，已有人告诉了他，
Perhaps somebody had already told Tang that Yang, Ma and Zhou had met in the wine shop the previous day.

然则用一句“不大清楚”来回答，便是故意说假话，
To answer “I am not sure” would then be a deliberate lie.

受了人家一份礼，连这么一句话都不肯实说，唐子韶自然会在心里冷笑。
If, after receiving his gifts, Yang would not answer even that small question honestly, Tang would surely sneer inwardly.

以后如何是以后的事，眼前先让唐子韶这样的人对他鄙视，未免太划不来了。
Whatever happened later, it was hardly worth earning the contempt of a man like Tang now.

这样转着念头，不由得说了实话：
Without quite intending to, Yang told the truth.

“不算太熟。”
“Not particularly well.”

唐子韶似乎对他的回答很满意，
Tang appeared satisfied.

微笑着说：“打扰，打扰。
Smiling, he said, “I have taken up your time.

改天公事完了，我要请杨先生、马大老爷好好叙一叙。”
Once the official business is finished, I should like to invite you and Magistrate Ma for a proper gathering.”


正当杨书办在马逢时家，准备出发去查封公济典时，他家里的女仆匆匆奔了来，请他回家，
Yang was at Ma’s house, preparing to set out for Gongji, when his maid hurried over to ask him to come home.

道是“太太有要紧事要商量”。
“Madam has something urgent to discuss,” she said.

杨书办还在踌躇，马逢时开口了，
While Yang hesitated, Ma spoke.

“你就先请回去吧！”他说：
“Go back first.

“商量好了马上请过来，
Come straight over when you have finished.

我在这里等。”
I shall wait here.”

好在离得近，
Fortunately, the houses were close.

杨书办决定先回去一趟，到家一看，非常意外地是周少棠在等候，
Yang decided to return briefly, only to find, to his great surprise, that Zhou was waiting for him.

明明是他要请他来说话，却作了托辞，显然的，周少棠来看他，是不愿让马逢时知道的。
Clearly Zhou was the one who wanted to talk; the excuse about his wife meant he did not wish Ma to know of the visit.

“事情有了变化。”周少棠停了一下说：
“Things have changed,” Zhou said. He paused.

“我说实话吧，唐子韶来看过我了。”
“I shall tell you frankly: Tang Zishao has been to see me.”

“喔，”杨书办问：
“Oh?

“啥辰光？”
When?”

“就是刚刚的事，
“Just now.

他寻到阜康来的。”周少棠说：
He found me at Fukang.

“他的话也有点道理，
There is something in what he says.

公济的事一闹出来，又成了新闻，对胡大先生不利。
If Gongji’s affairs cause a commotion, there will be another scandal, which will harm Mr Hu.

而且查封的事，一生枝节，官府恐怕对胡大先生有更厉害的处置。
And if complications arise during the proceedings to take the shop into official custody, the authorities may deal with him more severely.

我想这两点也不错，
Both points are sound, I think.

投鼠忌器，
We must not smash the vessel while trying to strike the rat.

特为来同你商量。”
That is why I came to consult you.”

杨书办想了一下答说：“他先到我这里来过了，还送了一份礼。
After a moment’s thought, Yang replied, “He came to see me first and brought gifts.

事情很明白了，他在公济确有毛病，而且毛病怕还不小。
The position is clear: something is wrong at Gongji, and probably something quite serious.

现在你说投鼠忌器，
Now you speak of sparing the vessel.

是不是放他一马，就此拉倒？”
Do you mean we should let him off and drop the affair?”

“那不太便宜他了？
“Would that not be letting him off too cheaply?

他亦很识相，答应‘吐’出来。”
He understands his position and has agreed to disgorge the money.”

“怎么吐法？”
“How?”

“这就要看你了。”
“That depends on you.”

周少棠的意思是，杨书办陪了马逢时到公济典，细细查库、查帐，将唐子韶的毛病都找了出来，
Zhou wanted Yang to accompany Ma to Gongji and examine the storeroom and accounts carefully, uncovering every irregularity.

最好作成笔录，但不必采取任何行动，
A written record would be best, but they need take no action.

回来将实情告诉周少棠，由他跟唐子韶去办交涉。
Yang should bring the facts back, and Zhou would negotiate with Tang himself.

杨书办心想，这等于是一切由周少棠做主，他跟马逢对不过是周少棠的“伙计”而已。
Yang thought this made Zhou master of the entire affair, with himself and Ma merely Zhou’s employees.

不过，只要有“好处”，做“伙计”亦无所谓。
Still, provided there was something in it for them, being employees did not matter.


当然，这不必等他开口，
There was no need for him to raise the point.

周少棠亦会有交代：
Zhou supplied the assurance himself.

“这样做法，不过是免了唐子韶吃官司，
“This arrangement only saves Tang from a lawsuit.

他再要想讨便宜，就是妄想。
If he thinks he can profit from it as well, he is dreaming.

我们还是照原来的计划，一方面是帮胡大先生的忙，一方面我们三个，你、我、老马，弄几两银子过年。”
We shall follow our original plan: help Mr Hu on the one hand, and find a few taels for the three of us—you, me and Ma—to see us through the New Year on the other.”

“我倒无所谓。”杨书办说：
“It does not matter so much about me,” Yang said.

“老马难得派个差使，而且这件事也要担责任，
“Ma seldom gets an assignment, and this one carries responsibility.

似乎不好少了他的。”
We ought not to stint his share.”

“一点不错。
“Exactly.

你叫他放心好了。”
Tell him he need not worry.”

“你做事，他也很放心的，
“He trusts you to handle it.

不过，最好开个‘尺寸’给他。”
Still, it would be best to give him a ‘measurement.’”

尺寸是商场的切口，意指银数，
In business slang, a measurement meant a sum of money.

周少棠答说：“现在有‘几尺水，还不晓得，
“We do not yet know how many ‘feet of water’ there are,” Zhou replied.

这个尺寸怎么开法？”
“How can I give him a measurement?”

“几尺水”者是指总数。
The depth of the water meant the total amount.

唐子韶侵吞中饱几何，能“吐”出来多少？
How much had Tang embezzled, and how much could be recovered?

目前无从估计，
They could not yet estimate it.

周少棠不能承诺一个确数，固属实情，但亦不妨先“派派份头”。
Zhou was right not to promise a definite sum, but they could at least agree on the shares.

等杨书办提出这个意见以后，周少棠立即说道：“大份头当然是归胡大先生。
When Yang suggested this, Zhou immediately said, “The largest share must naturally go to Mr Hu.

如果照十份派，胡大先生六份，老马两发，你、我各一份。
Divide it into ten parts: six for him, two for Ma, and one each for you and me.

怎么样？”
How does that sound?”

杨书办心想，如果能从唐子韶身上追出一万银子，马逢时可得两千，自己亦有一千两进帐，
If ten thousand taels could be recovered from Tang, Yang thought, Ma would receive two thousand and he himself one thousand.

这个年可以过得很肥了。
That would make a very comfortable New Year.

于是欣然点头：
He nodded happily.

“好的，
“Good.

就照这样子派好了。”
Let us divide it that way.”


由于事先已有联络，马逢时由杨书办陪着到了公济典，不必摆什么官派，
Since contact had already been made, Ma needed no display of official importance when he arrived at Gongji with Yang.

只将预先写好的、暂停营业三夭的告示贴了出去，等顾客散尽，关上大门。
They simply posted the prepared notice suspending business for three days, waited for the customers to leave and shut the main doors.

开始封库查帐。
Then they began sealing the storeroom and examining the accounts.

唐子韶先很从容，
Tang was composed at first.

看马逢时态度平和，杨书办语言客气，以为周少棠的路子已经走通了，
Seeing Ma’s mild manner and hearing Yang’s courteous words, he thought his approach through Zhou had succeeded.

及至看到要封库，脸色已有些不大自然，
When he saw that the storeroom was to be sealed, his expression became less natural.

再听说要查帐，便无法保持常态了。
On hearing that the accounts would be examined, he could no longer keep calm.

“杨先生，你请过来。”
“Mr Yang, a word.”

他将杨书办拉到一边，低声问道：“今天中午，周少棠同你碰过头了？”
Drawing Yang aside, he asked quietly, “Did you meet Zhou Shaotang at noon today?”

“是的。”
“Yes.”

“他怎么说？”
“What did he say?”

杨书办不免诧异；不过他的念头转得很快，
Yang was surprised, but his mind worked quickly.

知道周少棠下了一着狠棋，
He realised that Zhou had played a ruthless move.

因而声色不动地问说，“你同他怎么说的？”
Without betraying his feelings, he asked, “What did you tell him?”

原来唐子韶托谢云青居间，见到周少棠以后，
Tang had met Zhou through Xie Yunqing.

隐约透露出，请他转托杨书办及马逢时，在查封公济典时，不必认真，同时许了周少棠三千银子的好处，“摆平”一切。
He had hinted that Zhou should ask Yang and Ma not to be too exacting in their inspection of Gongji, and had promised Zhou three thousand taels to settle everything.

复又央请谢云青作保，事过以后，三千银子分文不少。
He had also asked Xie to guarantee that, once the affair was over, every cash of the three thousand would be paid.

谢云青也答应了。
Xie had agreed.

但他不知道周少棠有意要助胡雪岩，并非为了他自己的好处，
What Tang did not know was that Zhou intended to help Hu, not to pursue his own gain.

有为胡雪岩不平的意味在内，这就不关钱的事了。
He felt indignant on Hu’s behalf, so this was not a matter of money.

当时周少棠满口应承，实是一个“空心汤圆”，
His ready agreement had been an empty dumpling—a promise with nothing inside.

而犹一直不曾醒悟，
Tang had still not grasped this.

只以为周少棠自己吞得太多，杨书办嫌少，故而有意刁难，
He merely assumed that Zhou had kept too much for himself and Yang, dissatisfied with his share, was making difficulties.

说不得只好大破悭囊了。
There was nothing for it but to open his purse wider.


“杨先生，大家都是场面上的人，
“Mr Yang, we are all men who know the ways of society.

有话好说，
Everything can be discussed.

不要做得太难堪。”
Do not make matters too embarrassing.”

情急之下，他口不择言了，
In his anxiety, Tang no longer chose his words carefully.

“快过年了，
“The New Year is coming.

大家都有帐要付，这一层我知道的。
We all have debts to pay; I understand that.

除了原来的以外，我另外再送两千银子，
Besides the original amount, I shall give another two thousand taels.

马大老爷那里，只要你老大哥摆平，我不说话。”
If you can settle matters with Magistrate Ma, I shall have nothing to say.”

什么是原来的？
What original amount?

杨书办略想一想也就明白，不过还是要打听一下：
Yang could guess, but still needed to find out.

“原来多少？”
“How much was it originally?”

等将唐子韶与周少棠打交道的情形问清楚以后，杨书办觉得很为难。
Once he had learned the details of Tang’s dealings with Zhou, he felt deeply uncomfortable.

他为人比较忠厚，
Yang was comparatively kind-hearted.

觉得唐子韶可怜兮兮的，不忍心象周少棠那样，虚与委蛇，让他吃个“空心汤圆”，
Tang looked so pitiful that he could not bear to string him along with an empty promise as Zhou had done.

当然，要接受他的条件，也是决不可能的事。
Yet accepting his terms was equally out of the question.

“杨先生，”唐子韶近乎哀求他说：“你就算交我一个朋友。
“Mr Yang,” Tang said almost pleadingly, “do it for the sake of making a friend.

我知道你在马大老爷面前一言九鼎，
I know your word carries enormous weight with Magistrate Ma.

只要你说一声，他就高抬贵手，放我过去了。”
One word from you and he will show mercy and let me through.”

谈到“交朋友”。杨书办倒有话说了，
Friendship gave Yang something to say.

“朋友是朋友，公事是公事。”他说，
“Friendship is one thing, official business another.

“只要马大老爷公事上，能过得去，我当然要顾朋友的交情。
So long as Magistrate Ma can answer for his conduct of the assignment, I shall certainly consider our friendship.

唐朝奉，我答应你一件事，今天决不会让你面子难看，
Master Tang, I promise you one thing: you will not be humiliated today.

不过，我只希望你不要妨碍公事。
But I hope you will not obstruct official business.

至于查封以后，如何办法，我们大家再商量。”
We can all discuss what to do after the inspection and sealing.”

这番话是“绵里针”，唐子韶当然听得出来，
Tang recognised the needle hidden in the cotton.

如果自己不知趣，不让马逢时查帐，变成“妨碍公事”，
If he failed to take the hint and refused to let Ma examine the accounts, he would be obstructing official business.

他是有权送他到县衙门的“班房”去收押的。
Ma could have him detained in the county office’s holding room.

好在还有以后再商量的话，
Fortunately, there was still the promise of later discussion.

好汉不吃眼前亏，
A sensible man did not invite immediate suffering.

先敷衍好了杨书办，再作道理。
He would satisfy Yang first and consider the rest afterwards.

“杨先生，你这样子说，我不能不听，
“Since you put it that way, Mr Yang, I must listen.

一切遵吩咐就是。”
I shall follow every instruction.”


唐子韶也豁出去了，
Tang now committed himself.

不但要什么帐簿有什么帐簿，而且问什么答什么，非常合作，因此查帐非常顺利。
He supplied every ledger they requested and answered every question, cooperating so fully that the examination proceeded smoothly.

只是帐簿太多，
There were simply too many account books.

这天下午只查了三分之一，至少第二天还要费一整天才能完事。
That afternoon they checked only a third; finishing would take at least the whole of the following day.

等回到家，杨太太告诉丈夫：“周少棠来过了，
When Yang returned home, his wife told him, “Zhou Shaotang came.

他说他在你们昨天吃酒的地方等你。”
He said he would wait for you where you were drinking yesterday.”

“喔！”杨书办问：
“Oh?

“光是指我一个人？”
Did he mean only me?”

“还有哪个？”
“Who else?”

“有没有叫老马也去？”
“Did he ask Ma to go too?”

“他没有说。”
“He did not say.”

“好。
“Very well.

我马上就去。”
I shall go at once.”

杨书办带着一份记录去赴约。
Yang took a written record of the findings with him to the meeting.


“胡大先生怎么能不倒霉！”周少棠指着那份记录说：
“How could Mr Hu escape misfortune?” Zhou said, pointing at the record.

“光是这张纸上记下来的，算一算已经吞了三、四万银子都不止了。”
“Add up what is on this sheet alone, and the money swallowed already exceeds thirty or forty thousand taels.”

“你预备怎么个办法？”
“What do you intend to do?”

“还不是要他吐出来。”周少棠说：
“Make him disgorge it, of course.

“数目太大，我想先要同胡大先生谈一谈。”
The amount is so large that I think I must speak to Mr Hu first.”

“这，”杨书办为马逢时讲话，“在公事上不大妥当吧？”
Speaking for Ma, Yang said, “Would that be quite proper in official business?”

“怎么不妥当？”周少棠反问“杨书办亦说不出如何不妥，
“Why not?” Zhou countered. Yang could not explain exactly why it was improper.

他只是觉得马逢时奉派查封公济典，如何交差，要由周少棠跟胡雪岩商量以后来决定，似乎操纵得大过分，心生反感而已。
He merely felt resentful that Ma, officially commissioned to take charge of Gongji, should have to wait for Zhou and Hu to decide how he was to discharge his assignment. Zhou was exercising too much control.

“公事就是那么一回事，
“Official business is what it is.

你老兄是‘老公事’，还有啥不明白的？”
You are an old hand at it—what is there that you do not understand?”

周少棠用抚慰地语气说，
Zhou spoke soothingly.

“总而言之，老马的公事，一定让他交代得过，私下的好处，也一定会让他心里舒服。
“In any case, I shall make sure Ma can account satisfactorily for his assignment, and that the private benefit pleases him too.

至于你的一份，当然不会比者马少，
As for your share, it certainly will not be less than his.

这是说都用不着说的，”
That goes without saying.”

当然，周少棠的“好处”亦不会逊于他跟马逢时，更不待言。
Naturally, Zhou’s own benefit would be no smaller than either man’s.

照此看来，唐子韶的麻烦不小，
Tang appeared to be in serious trouble.

想起他那万般无奈、苦苦哀求的神情，不由得上了心事。
Recalling his helpless expression and desperate pleas, Yang grew troubled.

“怎么？”周少棠问：
“What is it?” Zhou asked.

“你有啥为难？”
“Is something troubling you?”

“我怎么不为难？”杨书办说：
“How could it not?

“你给他吃了个空心汤圆，他不晓得，
You gave him an empty dumpling, but he does not know it.

只以为都谈好了，
He thinks everything has been settled.

现在倒好象是我们跟他为难，
Now it looks as though we are deliberately making trouble for him.

他到我家里来过一次，当然会来第二次，
He has been to my house once and will certainly come again.

我怎么打发他？”
How am I to deal with him?”

“那容易，
“That is easy.

你都推在我头上好了。”
Put it all on me.”

事实上这是唯一的应付办法，杨书办最后的打算亦是如此。
In fact, this was the only possible answer, and Yang had already intended to use it in the end.

此刻既然周少棠自己作了亏诺，他也就死心塌地，不再去多想了。
Now that Zhou had offered the assurance himself, he accepted it wholeheartedly and ceased to worry further.



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第七章（二）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Seven, Part Two
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第二天仍如前一天那样嘴上很客气，眼中不容情，
The next day the inspection continued as before: polite words, unsparing eyes.

将唐子韶的弊端，一样一样，追究到底。
Tang Zishao’s irregularities were pursued one by one to the end.

唐子韶的态度，却跟前一天有异，
His own manner, however, had changed.

仿佛对马逢时及杨书办的作为，不甚在意。只是坐在一边，不断地抽水烟，
He seemed scarcely concerned with what Ma Fengshi and Clerk Yang were doing, merely sitting to one side and smoking his water pipe.

有时将一根纸煤搓了又搓，直到搓断，方始有爽然若失的神情，显得他在肚子里的功夫，做得根深。
Sometimes he rolled a paper spill between his fingers again and again until it broke; only then did he look momentarily lost, revealing how deeply his mind was at work.

约莫刚交午时，公济开出点心来，请马逢时暂时休息。
Shortly after noon began, Gongji served refreshments and invited Ma to rest.

唐子韶便趁此时机，将杨书办邀到一边有话说。
Tang took the opportunity to draw Yang aside.

“杨先生，”他问：“今天查得完查不完？”
“Mr Yang, can you finish the inspection today?”

一想把它查完。
“We mean to try.”

““以后呢？”唐子韶问道：
“And afterward?

“不是说好商量？”
Didn’t you say we could discuss things?”

“不错，好商量。
“Certainly.

你最好去寻周少棠，
You had better find Zhou Shaotang.

只要他那里谈好了，马大老爷这里归我负责。”
Once you have settled matters with him, I’ll answer for His Honour Ma.”

唐子韶迟疑了好一会说：
Tang hesitated for some time.

“本来是谈好了，
“I thought we had settled things already.

哪晓得马大老爷一来，要从头查起。
Who could have known His Honour would come and insist on examining everything from the beginning?”

语气中仿佛在埋怨杨书办跟周少棠彼此串通，有意推来推去，不愿帮忙。
His tone suggested that Yang and Zhou were working together, deliberately passing him back and forth without helping.

杨书办心想，也难怪他误会，其中的关键，不妨点他一句。
Yang thought the misunderstanding natural enough; he might as well give him a hint.

“老兄，你不要一厢情愿！
“My dear fellow, don’t indulge in wishful thinking.

你这里查都还没有查过，无从谈起，更不必说啥谈好了。
Before we’ve even examined the place, there’s nothing to discuss, let alone settle.

你今天晚上去寻他，
Go and see him tonight.

包你有结果。
I guarantee you’ll get a result.”

“唐子韶恍然大悟，
Tang suddenly understood.

原来是要看他在公济典里弄了多少“好处”，然后再来谈“价钱”。
They wanted to see how much he had taken from Gongji before naming their price.

看样子打算用几千银子“摆平”，是一种不切实际的妄想。
Expecting to settle everything for a few thousand taels was an absurd dream.

“树倒猢狲散”，
When the tree fell, the monkeys scattered.

不如带着月如远走高飞，
Better to take Yueru and flee far away.

大不了从此不吃朝奉这一行的饭，后半世应可衣食无忧。
At worst, he would never work as a pawnbroker again; he should still have enough to live comfortably for the rest of his life.

就在这刹那间打定了主意，就更不在乎杨书办与马逢时了，不过表面上仍旧很尊敬，
The decision formed in an instant, leaving him even less concerned with Yang and Ma, though outwardly he remained respectful.

当天查帐完毕，要请他们吃饭。
When the day’s examination ended, he invited them to dinner.

马逢时当然坚辞，杨书办且又暗示，应该早早去觅周少棠“商量”。
Ma firmly declined, while Yang again hinted that he should find Zhou early and “discuss matters.”


唐子韶口头上边声称“是”，其实根本无此打算，
Tang repeatedly agreed, without the least intention of doing so.

他要紧的是赶回家去跟月如商量。
His urgent business was to get home and consult Yueru.

约略说了经过，随即向月如透露了他的决心。
After briefly describing what had happened, he revealed his decision.

“三十六计，走为上让。
“Of the Thirty-Six Stratagems, running away is the best.

你从现在起始，就要预备，
Start preparing now.

最好三、五天之内料理清楚，我们开溜，”
We should have everything ready in three to five days, then slip away.”

月如一愣，
Yueru stared.

“溜到哪里？”她说：
“Where to?

“徽州我是不去。”
I won’t go to Huizhou.”

唐子韶的结发妻子在徽州原籍，
Tang’s first wife remained in his native Huizhou.

要月如去服低做小，亲操井臼，宁死不愿，
Yueru would rather die than go there to take a subordinate place and do the household drudgery herself.

这一层意思表明过不止一次，唐子韶当然明白。
She had made that clear more than once, and he knew it perfectly.

“我怎么会让你到徽州去吃苦？
“How could I send you to suffer in Huizhou?

就算你自己要去，我也舍不得。
Even if you wanted to go, I couldn’t bear it.

我想有三个地方，一个是上海，一个是北京，再有一个是扬州，我在那里有两家亲戚。”
I have three places in mind: Shanghai, Beijing, or Yangzhou, where I have two sets of relatives.”

只要不让她到徽州，他处都不妨从长计议，
Provided Huizhou was excluded, the choice could be discussed at leisure.

但最好是能不走，
Better still, though, would be not to leave at all.

上生上长三十年，从没有出过远门，
