Yueru had lived here all her thirty years and had never traveled far.

怕到了他乡水土不服住不惯。
She feared that elsewhere the climate and water would disagree with her and she would not settle.


“不走办不到，除非倾家荡产。”
“We can’t stay, unless we’re prepared to lose everything.”

“有这么厉害？”
“Is it as bad as that?”

“自然。”唐子韶答说：
“Of course.

“这姓周的，良心黑，手段辣，
This Zhou has a black heart and a ruthless hand.

如今一盘帐都抄了去，
They have copied all the accounts.

一笔一笔照算，没有五万银子不能过门。”
Once he adds them up item by item, it will take fifty thousand taels to get past him.”

“你不会赖掉？”
“Can’t you deny it?”

“把柄在人家千里，怎么赖得掉？”
“With the evidence in their hands?”

“不理他呢？”
“What if you ignore him?”

“不理他？你去试试看。”唐子韶说：
“Try it!

“姓马的是候补县，奉了宪谕来查封，
Ma is an expectant magistrate acting under his superior’s orders.

权力大得很呢！
He has enormous powers.

只要他说一句，马上可以送我到仁和县班房，
One word from him, and I’m in the lockup at Renhe.

你来送牢饭吧！”月如叹口气说：
You can bring me my meals there.” Yueru sighed.

“那就只好到上海去了。
“Then it will have to be Shanghai.

只怕到了上海还是保不得平安。”
But even there, we may not be safe.”

“一定可以保！”唐子韶信心十足地说，
“We certainly will!” Tang declared confidently.

“上海市场等于外国地方，
“The foreign settlement is practically foreign territory.

哪怕是道台也不能派差役去抓人，上海县更加不必谈了。
Even the circuit intendant can’t send runners in to arrest people, let alone the Shanghai magistrate.

而且上海市场上五方杂处，各式各样的人都有，
People come there from everywhere, every sort imaginable.

只要有钱，每天大摇大摆，坐马车、逛张园、吃大菜、看京戏，
So long as you have money, you can swagger about every day, ride in carriages, visit Zhang Garden, eat Western meals, and watch Beijing opera.

没有哪个来管你的闲事。”
Nobody will meddle in your affairs.”

听他形容上海的繁华，月如大为动心，
This picture of Shanghai’s pleasures thoroughly tempted Yueru.

满腔离愁，都丢在九霄云外，
All her sorrow at leaving vanished.

细细盘算了一会说道：“好在现款存在汇丰银行，
After careful thought, she said, “Fortunately, the cash is in HSBC.

细软随身带了走，有三天工夫总可以收拾好，
We can take our valuables with us and should be packed within three days.

不动产只好摆在那里再说。
The property we can’t move will have to stay for now.

不过，这三天当中，会不会出事呢？”
But might something happen during those three days?”


“当然要用缓兵之计。
“We must play for time.

杨书办要我今天晚上就去看周少棠。
Yang told me to see Zhou tonight.

他一定会开个价钱出来，
He’s bound to name a price.

漫天讨价，就地还钱，
He’ll ask the earth, and I’ll bargain him down.

一定谈不拢，
Naturally, we won’t agree.

我请他明天晚上来吃饭，你好好下点功夫……”
I’ll invite him to dinner tomorrow evening, and you must make a special effort…”

“又要来这一套了！”月如吼了起来，
“That trick again!” Yueru shouted.

“你当我什么人看。”
“What do you take me for?”

“我当你大慈大悲、救苦救难的观世音菩萨看。”唐子韶说：
“The compassionate Guanyin herself, saving those in distress.

“这姓周的请我吃空心汤圆，
This Zhou fed me an empty dumpling.

你要替我报仇。
You must avenge me.”

““报仇？哼，”月如冷笑，
“Avenge you?” She gave a cold laugh.

“我不来管你的事！
“I’ll have nothing to do with it.

你弄得不好‘赔了夫人又折兵’，我白白里又让人家占一回便宜，
You may end up losing the lady as well as the troops, and I’ll have let another man take advantage of me for nothing.

啥犯着？”
Why should I?”

“你真傻，
“Don’t be foolish.

你不会请他吃个空心汤圆？
Can’t you give him an empty dumpling too?

两三天一拖拖过去，我们人都到上海了，
Drag it out for two or three days, and we’ll be in Shanghai.

他到哪里去占你的便宜？”
How will he take advantage of you then?”

“万一，”月如问说：“万一他来个霸王硬上弓呢？”
“Suppose he forces himself on me?”

“你不会叫？
“Can’t you shout?

一叫，我会来救你。”
I’ll come and rescue you.”

“那不是变成仙人跳了？
“Then it becomes a blackmail set-up.

而且，你做初一，他做初二。
And what you do to him one day, he’ll repay the next.

看起来我一定要去送牢饭了。”
It looks as though I’ll be bringing you prison meals after all.”

唐子韶不作声。
Tang fell silent.

月如不是他的结发妻子，而且当初已经失过一回身，
Yueru was not his first wife, and she had already once slept with another man.

反正不是从一而终了，再让周少棠尝一回甜头，亦无所谓。
Since lifelong fidelity was no longer in question, he thought, it would hardly matter if Zhou enjoyed her favors too.

不过这话不便说得太露骨，只好点她一句。
But he could not say so crudely and could only hint.

“如果你不愿意送牢饭，实在说，你是不忍心我去吃牢饭，那么全在你发个善心了。”
“If you don’t want to bring meals to prison—if, in truth, you can’t bear to see me imprisoned—then everything depends on your showing a little compassion.”

月如亦不作声，
Yueru said nothing either.

不过把烧饭的老妈子唤了来，关照她明天要杀鸡，要多买菜。
She merely called the serving woman who did the cooking and told her to kill a chicken and buy extra food for the following day.


周少棠兴冲冲地到了元宝街，要看胡雪岩，不道一说来意，就碰了一个钉子。
Zhou went eagerly to Yuanbao Street to see Hu Xueyan, only to meet a rebuff as soon as he explained his purpose.

“说实话，周先生，”胡家的门上说：“生病是假，挡驾是真。
“To be frank, Mr Zhou,” the doorkeeper said, “illness is an excuse; the master is refusing visitors.

你老倒想想，我们老爷还有啥心思见客。
Just think—what mood can he be in to receive anyone?

我通报，一定去通报，不过，真的不见，你老也不要见怪。”
I’ll announce you, certainly, but if he won’t see you, please don’t take offense.”

“我是有正事同他谈。”
“I have serious business to discuss with him.”

“正事？”门上大摇其头，
“Business?” The man shook his head vigorously.

“那就一定见不着，
“Then you definitely won’t see him.

我们老爷一提起钱庄、当店、丝行，头就大了。”
Mention the bank, pawnshops, or silk business, and his head begins to ache.”

“那么，你说我来看看他。”
“Then say I’ve come to visit him.”

“也只好这样说。
“That’s all I can say.

不过，”
Still…”

门上一面起步，一面咕哝着，“我看是白说。”
As he started off, the doorkeeper muttered, “I doubt it will do any good.”

见此光景，周少棠的心冷了。
Zhou’s enthusiasm cooled.

默默盘算，自己想帮忙的意思到了，胡雪岩不见，是没法子的事。
He reflected silently that he had done his part in wishing to help; if Hu would not see him, nothing could be done.

唐子韶当然不能便宜他，
Tang must not be let off, of course.

不妨想想看，用什么手段卡住他的喉咙，让他把吞下去的东西吐出来：
He could think of some means of gripping the man by the throat and making him disgorge what he had swallowed.

过年了，
The New Year was coming.

施棉衣、施米、做做好事，也是阴功积德。
Distributing padded clothes and rice would do good and earn merit in the unseen world.

这一落入沉恩，就不觉得时光慢了，忽然听得一声：“周先生！”抬头看时，
Absorbed in these thoughts, he lost track of time, until a sudden “Mr Zhou!” made him look up.

是门上在他面前，
The doorkeeper stood before him.

“我们老爷有请，”
“The master asks you in.”

“喔，”周少棠定定神说：
“Oh!” Zhou collected himself.

“居然见我了？”
“So he will see me after all?”

“原来周先生是我们老爷四十年的老朋友。”门上赔笑说道：“我不晓得！
“I didn’t know you were his friend of forty years!” the man said with an apologetic smile.

周先生你不要见气。”
“Please don’t be offended.”

“哪里，哪里！
“Not at all.

你请领路。”
Lead the way.”


门上领到花园人口处，有个大丫头由一个老妈子陪着，转引客人直上百狮楼。
At the garden entrance the doorkeeper handed him over to a senior maid accompanied by an older serving woman, who led him straight to the Hundred Lions Tower.

“周先生走好！”一上楼便有个中年丽人在迎接，
“Mind your step, Mr Zhou!” A beautiful middle-aged woman greeted him upstairs.

周少棠见过一次，急忙拱手说：
He had met her once before and hastily clasped his hands.

“螺蛳太太，
“Madam Luosi!

不敢当，不敢当！”
You are too kind!”

“大先生在里头等你。”
“Mr Hu is waiting inside.”

说着螺蛳太太亲自揭开门帘，
She lifted the curtain herself.

周少棠是头一回到这里，
This was Zhou’s first visit to these rooms.

探头一望，目迷五色，东也是灯，西也是灯，东也是胡雪岩，西也是胡雪岩。
Looking in, he was dazzled: lamps to the east, lamps to the west; Hu Xueyan to the east, Hu Xueyan to the west.

灯可以有多少盏，胡雪岩不可能分身，
There might be any number of lamps, but Hu could not multiply himself.

周少棠警告自己，这里在镜子很多，不要象刘姥姥进了怕红院那样闹笑话。
He warned himself that there were many mirrors here: he must not make a fool of himself like Granny Liu entering Yihong Court.

因此，进门先站住脚，看清楚了再说。
He stopped just inside the doorway to get his bearings.

“少棠！”胡雪岩在喊：
“Shaotang!

“这面坐。”
Sit over here.”

循声觅人，只见胡雪岩坐在一张红丝绒的安乐椅上，上身穿的小对襟棉袄，下身围着一条花格子的毛毡，
Following the voice, he found Hu in a red-velvet armchair, wearing a short padded jacket buttoned down the front, with a checked woolen blanket around his lower body.

额头上扎一条寸许宽的缎带，大概是头痛的缘故。
A satin band about a cun wide was tied around his forehead, presumably for a headache.

“坐这里！”胡雪岩拍一拍他身旁的绣墩，指着头上笑道：
“Sit here.” Hu patted the embroidered stool beside him and pointed to his head with a smile.

“你看我这副样子，象不象产妇做月子？”
“Don’t I look like a woman resting after childbirth?”

这时候还有心思说笑话，周少棠心怀一宽，看样子他的境况，不如想象中那么坏。
If he could still joke, Zhou thought with relief, perhaps things were not as bad as he had imagined.


于是闲闲谈起查封公济典的事，原原本本、巨细靡遗，
He began casually describing the inspection of Gongji, recounting the whole affair without omitting the smallest detail.

最后谈到从唐子韶那里追出中饱的款子以后，如何分派的办法。
Finally he explained how the money was to be divided once recovered from Tang.

“算了，算了。”胡雪岩说：
“Let it go,” Hu said.

“不必认真。”
“There’s no need to pursue it so seriously.”

此言一出，周少棠愣住了，
Zhou stared.

好半天才说了句：“看起来，倒是我多事了，”
Only after a long silence could he say, “It seems I’ve been meddling unnecessarily.”

“少棠，你这样子一说，我变成半吊子了。
“Shaotang, that makes me sound a halfwit.

事到如今，我同你说老实话，
Let me tell you the truth.

我不是心甘情愿做洋盘瘟生，不分好歹，不识是非，
I’m not willingly playing the gullible fool, unable to distinguish good from bad or right from wrong.

我是为了另外一个人。”
I’m thinking of someone else.”

“为了哪一个？”周少棠当然要追问。
“Who?” Zhou naturally asked.

“唐子韶的姨太太。”
“Tang’s concubine.”

“喔，喔！”周少棠恍然大悟，
“Ah!” Zhou understood at once.

他亦久知胡雪岩有此一段艳闻，此刻正好求证：
He had long known of Hu’s amorous adventure and now had a chance to confirm it.

“我听说，唐子韶设美人局，你上了他的当？”
“I heard Tang laid a beauty trap and you fell into it?”

“也不算上当，
“It wasn’t exactly that.

是我一时糊涂。
I lost my head for a moment.

这话也不必去说它了。”
There’s no need to discuss it now.”

胡雪岩紧接着说：“昨天我同我的几个妾说：我放你们一条生路，
Hu went on, “Yesterday I told my concubines: ‘I’m giving you a way out.

愿意走的自己房间里东西都带走，我另外送五千银子。
Any of you who wish to leave may take everything in your rooms, and I’ll give you five thousand taels besides.’

想想月如总同我好过。
Yueru, after all, once shared my affection.

现在有了这样一个机会，我想放他一马。
Now that I have this opportunity, I’d like to let Tang off.

不过，这是马逢时的公事，又是你出了大力，
But it is Ma Fengshi’s official business, and you have gone to such trouble.

我只好说一声：多谢你！
All I can do is thank you.

到底应该怎么办？我也不敢多干预。”
I wouldn’t presume to interfere too much with how it is handled.”

“原来你是这么一种心思，
“So that is what you have in mind.

倒是我错怪你了。”同少棠又说：
I misjudged you.

“原来是我想替你尽点心，
I only wanted to do something for you.

你不忘记者相好，想这样子办，我当然照你的意思。
If you remember an old lover and want it handled this way, naturally I’ll follow your wishes.

至于论多论少，我要看情形办，
As for how much or how little, I must judge by circumstances.

而且我要告诉人家。”
And I shall tell them.”


“不必，不必！
“No, no!

不必说破。”
Don’t explain it.”

胡雪岩忽然神秘地一笑，
Hu suddenly smiled mysteriously.

“少棠，你记不记得石塔儿头的‘豆腐西施’阿香？”
“Shaotang, do you remember A’xiang, the ‘Tofu Beauty’ at Shita’ertou?”

周少棠愣了一下，从尘封的记忆中，找出阿香的影子来——
Zhou paused, retrieving her image from the dust of memory.

石塔儿头是地名，
Shita’ertou was a place name.

有家豆腐店的女儿，就是阿香，艳声四播。
A’xiang, the daughter of a tofu-shop owner there, had been famous for her beauty.

先是周少棠做了入幕之宾，后来胡雪岩做了他的所谓“同靴弟兄”，周少棠就绝迹不去了。
Zhou had first become her lover; later Hu had become his so-called “brother sharing the same boots,” and Zhou had stopped visiting altogether.

少年春梦，如今回想起来，什么感觉都没有了，
Looking back on that youthful dream of love, he felt nothing now.

只是奇怪胡雪岩何以忽然提了起来？
He only wondered why Hu had suddenly brought it up.

“当初那件事，我心里一直难过，
“I’ve always felt bad about that.

‘兔子不吃窝边草’，
A rabbit shouldn’t eat the grass beside its own burrow.

我不该割你的靴腰子。
I shouldn’t have poached on you.

现在顶好一报还一报。”
Now it would be best to repay you in kind.”

胡雪岩放低了声音说：“月如是匹扬州人所说的‘瘦马，，
Lowering his voice, Hu said, “Yueru is what Yangzhou people call a ‘slender horse.’

你倒骑她一骑看。”
Why don’t you try riding her?”

听此一说，周少棠有点动心，不过口头上却是一叠连声地道：“笑话，笑话！”
Zhou felt a flicker of interest, though he repeatedly protested, “You must be joking!”

胡雪岩不作声，
Hu said nothing.

笑容慢慢地收敛，双眼却不断眨动，显然有个念头在转。
His smile slowly faded, while his eyes kept blinking: plainly another thought was forming.

“那么，少棠，我说一句决不是笑话的话，你要不要听？”
“Then, Shaotang, would you like to hear something that is certainly no joke?”

“要的。”
“Yes.”


“年大将军的故事，你总晓得罗？”
“You know the stories about General Nian, surely?”

“年大将军”是指年羹尧。
General Nian was Nian Gengyao.

这位被杭州人神乎其词他说他“一夜工夫连降十八级“的年大将军，
Hangzhou people told fantastic tales of his being “demoted eighteen ranks in a single night.”

在杭州大概有半年的辰光，他是先由一等公降为杭州将军，然后又降为”闲散章京“，满洲话叫做”拜他喇布勒哈番“，汉名叫做”骑都尉“，正四品，被派为西湖边上涌金门的城守尉，
He had spent roughly six months in the city, first reduced from duke of the first class to Hangzhou Garrison General, then to an unattached officer—baitalabulehafan in Manchu, cavalry commandant in Chinese, of the regular fourth rank—and assigned as commander of the guard at Yongjin Gate beside West Lake.

杭州关于他的故事极多，所以周少棠问说：”你是问哪一个？
There were so many stories about him in Hangzhou that Zhou asked, “Which one?”

““是年大将军赠妾的故事。”
“The story of General Nian giving away his concubine.”

这是众多年羹尧的故事中，最富传奇性的一个。
This was one of the most remarkable of the many Nian Gengyao legends.

据说，年羹尧每天坐在涌金门口，
It was said that he sat every day at Yongjin Gate.

进出乡人，震于他的威名，或者避道而行，或者俯首疾趋，
Country people passing through, awed by his formidable reputation, either avoided him or hurried past with lowered heads.

惟有一个穷书生，早晚进出，必定恭恭敬敬地作一个揖。
Only a poor scholar, who came and went morning and evening, always greeted him with a respectful bow.

这样过了几个月，
Several months passed.

逮捕年羹尧入京的上谕到了杭州，
Then an imperial order arrived for Nian’s arrest and removal to the capital.

于是第二夭一早，年羹尧等那穷书生经过时，喊住他说：
Early the next morning, he stopped the scholar.

“我看你人很忠厚，
“I can see that you’re an honest, kindhearted man.

我这番入京，大概性命不保，
I doubt I shall survive this journey to the capital.

有个小妾想送给你，
I have a concubine I should like to give you.

请你照料，千万不要推辞。”
Please look after her, and do not refuse.”

那个穷书生哪敢作此非分之想，
The poor scholar dared not entertain such an extravagant thought.

一再推辞，年羹尧则一再相劝。
He repeatedly declined, while Nian repeatedly urged him.

最后，穷书生说了老实话，家徒四壁，添一口人实在养不起。
Finally he admitted the truth: his house was bare, and he could not afford another mouth to feed.

“原来是为这一层，
“So that is the difficulty!

你无庸担心，
You needn’t worry.

明天我派人送她去。
I’ll send her tomorrow.

你住哪里？”
Where do you live?”

问了半天，穷书生才说了他家的住址。
Only after much questioning did the scholar reveal his address.

下一天黄昏，一乘小轿到门，随携少数“嫁妆”。
At dusk the next day, a small sedan arrived, accompanied by a modest “dowry.”

那轿中走出来一个风信年华的丽人，便是年羹尧的爱妾。
A beautiful woman in the bloom of her twenties stepped out: Nian’s favorite concubine.

穷书生无端得此一段艳福，自然喜心翻倒，但却不知往后何以度日。
The scholar was overwhelmed with joy at this unexpected romantic good fortune, yet did not know how they would live.

那丽人一言不发，只将带来的一张双抽屉的桌子，开锁打开抽屉，
Without a word, the woman unlocked the two drawers of a table she had brought.

里面装满了珠宝，足供一生。
They were full of jewels—enough for a lifetime.


“我现在跟年大将军差不多。”胡雪岩说：
“I am much like General Nian now,” Hu said.

“我的几个妾，昨天走了一半，
“Half my concubines left yesterday.

有几个说一定要跟我，
Some insist on staying with me.

有一个想走不走，主意还没有定，看她的意思是怕终身无靠。
One has not decided whether to go; I think she fears having nobody to depend on for the rest of her life.

我这个妾人很老实，我要替她好好找个靠得住的人。
She is a very honest woman, and I want to find someone trustworthy for her.

少棠，你把她领了回去。”
Shaotang, take her home with you.”

“你说笑话了！”周少棠毫不思索地说，
“You’re joking!” Zhou replied without thinking.

“没有这个道理！”
“There can be no question of it.”

“怎么会没有这个道理。
“Why not?

你没有听‘说大书’的讲过，
Haven’t you heard the storytellers?

这种赠妾、赠马的事，古人常常有的。
People in the old days often gave away concubines or horses.

现在是我送给你，可不是你来夺爱，
I’m offering her to you; you aren’t stealing my beloved.

怕啥？”
What is there to fear?”

周少棠不作声，
Zhou fell silent.

他倒是想推辞，但找不出理由，
He wanted to refuse but could find no reason.

最后只好这样说：“我要同我老婆去商量看。”
At last he could only say, “I must discuss it with my wife.”


第二天一大早，周少棠还在床上，杨书办便来敲门了。
Early the next morning, while Zhou was still in bed, Clerk Yang knocked at his door.

起床迎接，周少棠先为前一日晚上失迎致歉，接着动问来意。
Zhou rose to receive him, apologized for having been out the previous evening, and asked why he had come.

“唐子韶！”杨书办说：
“Tang Zishao!

“昨天早晚就来看我，要我陪了他来看你。
He came to see me last night and asked me to accompany him to your place.

看起来此人倒蛮听话，
He seems quite obedient.

我昨天叫他晚上来看你，他真的来了。”
I told him yesterday to see you in the evening, and he really came.”

“此刻呢？人在哪里？”
“Where is he now?”

“我说我约好了你，再招呼他来见面，叫他先回去。
“I said I’d arrange a meeting with you and let him know, then sent him home.

你看，在哪里碰头？”
Where shall you meet?”

“要稍为隐蔽一点的地方。”
“Somewhere reasonably secluded.”

“那么，在我家里好了。”杨书办说：
“My house, then.

“我去约他，
I’ll fetch him.

你洗了脸、吃了点心就来。”
Come over when you’ve washed and had something to eat.”

周少棠点点头，
Zhou nodded.

送杨书办出门以后，一面漱洗，一面盘算，
After seeing Yang out, he washed and considered his plans.

想到胡雪岩昨天的话，不免怦然心动，
Remembering Hu’s words the previous day, he could not help feeling tempted.

想看看月如倒是怎么样的一匹“瘦马”？
He wanted to see what sort of “slender horse” Yueru might be.

到得杨家，唐子韶早就到了，
Tang was already at Yang’s house when Zhou arrived.

一见周少棠，忙不迭地站了起来，反客为主，代替杨书办招待后到之客，十分殷勤。
He hastily stood and, behaving like the host rather than a guest, attended to the newcomer with great solicitude.

“少棠兄，”杨书办站起来说：“ 你们谈谈，
“Brother Shaotang,” Yang said as he rose, “you two talk.

我料理了一桩小事，马上过来。
I have a small matter to attend to and will be back shortly.

中午在我这里便饭。”
Stay for a simple lunch.”

这是让他们得以密谈，声明备饭，更是暗示不妨详谈、长谈。
He was leaving them to speak privately; mentioning lunch further suggested that they need not hurry and could discuss everything at length.


但实际上无须花多少辰光，因为唐子韶成竹在胸，不必抵赖，
In fact, little time was needed, for Tang had his plan ready and had no intention of denying anything.

当周少棠出示由杨书办抄来的清单，算出他一共侵吞了八万三千多银子时，他双膝一跪，口中说道：
When Zhou produced Yang’s copied list and calculated that the total embezzled exceeded eighty-three thousand taels, Tang dropped to his knees.

“周先生，请你救救我。”
“Mr Zhou, please save me!”

“言重，言重！”周少棠赶紧将他拉了起来，
“Please, please!” Zhou hastily pulled him up.

“唐朝奉，你说要我救你，不管我办得到、办不到，你总要拿出一个办法来，我才好斟酌。”
“Mr Tang, whether or not I can save you, you must first propose some course for me to consider.”

“周先生，我先说实话，
“Let me tell the truth.

陆陆续续挪用了胡大先生的架本，也是叫没奈何！
I took money from Mr Hu’s capital little by little because I had no choice.

这几年运气不好，
My luck has been bad these past few years.

做生意亏本，我那个小妾又好赌，输掉不少。
I lost money in business, and my concubine loves gambling and has lost a great deal too.

胡大先生现在落难，我如果有办法，早就应该把这笔款子补上了。”
Now that Mr Hu is in trouble, if I had any means of doing so, I ought to have replaced the money long ago.”

“照此说来，你是‘铁公鸡，一毛不拔，？”
“So you’re an iron rooster, unwilling to part with a single feather?”

“不是，不是。”唐子韶说，
“No, no!

一我手里还有点古董、玉器。
I still have a few antiques and jades.

我知道周先生你是大行家，
I know you are an expert.

什么时候到我那里看看，能值多少？
Perhaps you could come and see what they’re worth?”

“唐子韶略停一下又说：”现款是没有多少，我再尽量凑。
Tang paused, then added, “There isn’t much cash, but I’ll gather whatever I can.”

““你能凑多少？”
“How much?”

“一时还算不出。
“I can’t say at once.

总要先看了那些东西，估个价，看缺多少，再想办法。”
First we must value the objects and see what is lacking; then I’ll try to find a way.”

原来这是唐子韶投其所好，编出来的一套话。
This was a story Tang had invented to appeal to Zhou’s tastes.

周少棠玩玉器，在“茶会”上颇有名声，
Zhou’s interest in jade was well known in the collectors’ tea gatherings.

听了唐子韶的话信以为真，欣然答说：
Taking Tang at his word, he readily agreed.

“好！
“Very well.

你看什么时候，我去看看。”
When shall I come?”

“就是今天晚上好不好，”唐子韶说：
“Would this evening suit you?

“小妾做的菜，很不坏。
My concubine cooks very well.

我叫她显显手段，请周先生来赏鉴赏鉴。”
I’ll ask her to show what she can do, and you can judge her skill.”

一听这话，周少棠色心与食指皆动，
The invitation stirred both Zhou’s lust and his appetite.

不过不能不顾到杨书办与马逢时，因而说道：
Still, he could not ignore Yang and Ma.

“你不该请我一个。”
“You shouldn’t invite only me.”

“我知道，我知道。
“I understand.

马大老爷我不便请他，我再请杨书办。”
It would be awkward for me to invite His Honour Ma, but I’ll ask Clerk Yang as well.”


杨书办是故意躲开的，根本没有什么事要料理，
Yang had deliberately withdrawn and had nothing to attend to.

所以发觉唐子韶与周少棠的谈话已告一段落，随即赶了出来留客。
Realizing that their conversation had ended, he immediately came out to urge them to stay.

“便饭已经快预备好了，
“Lunch is almost ready.

吃了再走。”
Have it before you go.”

“谢谢！谢谢！”唐子韶连连拱手，
“Thank you, thank you!” Tang clasped his hands repeatedly.

“我还有事，
“I have something to do.

改日再来打搅。
I’ll trouble you another day.

顺便提一声：今天晚上我请周少棠到舍下便饭，
By the way, I’ve invited Zhou to a simple dinner at my house tonight.

请你老兄作陪。”
Please join us.”

说成“顺便提一声”，可知根本没有邀客的诚意，
The phrase “by the way” showed how little sincerity there was in the invitation.

而且杨书办也知道他们晚上还有未完的话要谈，亦根本不想夹在中间。
Yang also knew they had unfinished business to discuss and had no wish to come between them.

当即亦以晚上有事作推托，回绝了邀约。
Claiming an engagement that evening, he declined.

送走唐子韶，留下周少棠，把杯密谈，
After seeing Tang off, he kept Zhou for a confidential conversation over wine.

周少棠将前一天去看胡雪岩的情形，说了给杨书办听。不过，他没有提到胡雪岩劝他去骑月如那匹瘦马的话。
Zhou described his visit to Hu the day before, omitting the suggestion that he ride Yueru, the “slender horse.”

这倒并非是他故障隐瞒，而是他根本还没有作任何决定，
This was not deliberate concealment; he had simply made no decision.

即使见了动心，跃跃欲试，也要看看情形再说。
Even if the sight of her tempted him, he would first have to judge the circumstances.

“胡大先生倒真是够气概！”杨书办说：
“Mr Hu has real generosity of spirit,” Yang said.

“今日之下，他还顾念着老交情！
“Even now he remembers old affections.

照他这样厚道来看，将来只怕还有翻身的日子。”
A man as kindhearted as that may yet rise again.”

“ 难！
“Hardly.

他的靠山已经不中用，他本人呢，锐气也倒了，
His powerful patron is no longer any use, and his own spirit is broken.

哪里还有翻身的日子？”
How can he rise again?”

周少棠略停一下说：
Zhou paused.

“闲话少说，
“Enough of that.

言归正传，你看要唐子韶吐多少出来？”
To business: how much should we make Tang disgorge?”

“请你作主。”
“You decide.”

周少棠由于对月如存着企图，便留了个可以伸缩的余地，
Having designs on Yueru, Zhou left himself room to maneuver.

“多则一半，少则两三万。”他说，
“Half at most; twenty or thirty thousand at least.

“我们三一三十一。”
We three will divide it equally.”


唐子韶家很容易找，
Tang’s house was easy to find.

只要到公济典后面一条巷子问一声“唐朝奉住哪里？”自会有人指点给他看。
One had only to go into the lane behind Gongji Pawnshop and ask where Pawnbroker Tang lived; someone would point it out.

是唐子韶亲自应的门，一见面便说：
Tang answered the door himself.

“今天很冷，
“It’s very cold today.

请楼上坐。”
Come upstairs.”

楼上升了火盆，板壁缝隙上新糊了白纸条，
A brazier was burning there, and fresh strips of white paper covered the cracks in the wooden partitions.

外面虽然风大，里头却是温暖如春，
Though the wind outside was strong, the room was as warm as spring.

周少棠的狐皮袍子穿不住了，
Zhou could not bear to keep his fox-fur robe on.

依主人的建议脱了下来，只穿一件直贡呢夹袄就很舒服了。
At his host’s suggestion, he removed it and was perfectly comfortable in his lined jacket of woolen satin.

“周先生，要不要‘香一筒，？”唐子韶指着烟盘说。
“Would you care for a fragrant pipeful?” Tang asked, indicating the smoking tray.

“你自己来。”周少棠说：
“You go ahead.

“我没有瘾，不过喜欢躺烟盘。”
I have no craving, though I like reclining beside a smoking tray.”

“那就来靠一靠。”唐子韶令丫头点了烟灯，然后去捧出一只大锦盒来，放在烟盘下方说道：
“Then make yourself comfortable.” Tang told a maid to light the opium lamp, brought out a large brocade-covered box, and placed it below the tray.

“周先生，你先看几样玉器。”
“Have a look at a few jades first.”

两人相对躺了下来，
They lay facing each other.

唐子韶抽大烟，周少棠便打开锦盒，鉴赏玉器，
Tang smoked while Zhou opened the box to examine its contents.

那锦盒是做了隔板的，
It was divided by removable trays.

每一层上面三块汉玉，每一块的尺寸大致相仿，一寸多长，六七分宽，
On the top lay three Han jades, each roughly the same size: a little over one cun long and six or seven fen wide.

上面刻的篆字，周少棠只认得最后四个字。
Zhou could recognize only the last four seal-script characters carved on them.

“这是‘刚卯’。”周少棠指着最后四个字说：
“These are gangmao amulets,” he said, pointing.

“一定有这四个字：”莫我敢当‘。
“They must have these four characters: ‘None dare confront me.’”

““喔，”唐子韶故意问说：
“Oh?” Tang asked deliberately.

“刚卯作啥用场？”
“What are gangmao used for?”

“辟邪的。”
“Warding off evil.”

“刚卯的刚好懂，
“Gang means strong—that I understand.

既然辟邪，当然要刚强。”唐子韶说：
Naturally, something that wards off evil must be strong.

“卯就不懂了。”
But I don’t understand mao.”

“卯是‘卯金刀’，
“Mao, together with ‘gold’ and ‘knife,’ gives the surname Liu.

汉朝是姓刘的天下。
The Han was the Liu dynasty.

还有一个说法，要在正月里选一个，所以叫刚卯。”
Another explanation says the choice must be made in the first month of the year; hence the name gangmao.”

“周先生真正内行。”
“You really are an expert.”

“玩儿汉玉，这些门道总要懂的。”
“Anyone who collects Han jade must know such things.”

说着周少棠又取第二方，就着烟灯细看。
Zhou took up the second piece and examined it by the opium lamp.


“你看这三块刚卯，怎么样？”
“What do you think of these three gangmao?”

“都还不错。
“They’re all quite good.

不过……”
But…”

唐于韶见他缩口不语，便抬眼问道：
When Zhou stopped, Tang looked up.

“不过不值钱？”
“But they aren’t worth much?”

“也不好说不值钱。”
“I wouldn’t say that.”

周少棠没有再说下去。
Zhou went no further.

唐子韶当然明白，他的意思是，几万银子的亏欠，拿这些东西来作抵，还差得远，
Tang understood: against a debt of tens of thousands, objects like these would fall far short.

因而也就不必再问了，
There was no need to ask more.

只伸手揭开隔板说道：“这样东西，恐怕周先生以前没有见过。”
Lifting the partition, he said, “I doubt you have seen anything like this before.”

周少棠拿起来一看，
Zhou picked it up.

确是初见，是很大的一块古色斑斓的汉玉，大约八寸见方，刻成一个圆环，
It was indeed new to him: a large piece of Han jade with a rich, mottled patina, about eight cun square, carved with a circular ring.

再由圆环中心向外刻线，每条线的未端有个数目字，从一到九十，
Lines radiated outward from the center, each ending in a number, from one to ninety.

一共是九十条线，刻得极细极深极均匀。
There were ninety lines in all, exceptionally fine, deep, and evenly cut.

“这是啥？
“What is it?

象个罗盘。”
It looks like a compass.”

“不错，同罗盘差不多，
“Yes, rather like one.

是日规。”
It’s a sundial.”

“日规？”周少棠反复细看，
“A sundial?” Zhou examined it repeatedly.

“玉倒确是汉玉，
“The jade is certainly Han.

好象出土不久。”
It looks as though it was excavated recently.”

“法眼、法眼！”唐子韶竖起大拇指说：
“A discerning eye!” Tang held up his thumb.

“出土不过三四年，是归化城出土的。”
“Only three or four years ago, in Guihua City.”

“喔，”周少棠对此物颇感兴趣，“这块玉啥价钱？”
Intrigued, Zhou asked, “What is it worth?”

“刚刚出土，以前也没有过同样的东西，所以行情不明。”唐子韶又说：
“It’s only recently come to light, and nothing like it had been seen before, so there’s no established price.

“原只要当一千银子，
The owner originally wanted a loan of a thousand taels.

我还了他五百，最后当了七百银子。
I offered five hundred, and we finally settled on seven hundred.

这样东西，要遇见识货的，可以卖好价钱。”“嗯。”周少棠不置可否，去揭第二块隔板，
In the hands of someone who appreciates it, it could fetch a good price.” Zhou murmured without committing himself and lifted the second partition.

下面是大大小小七八方玉印。
Beneath it lay seven or eight jade seals of various sizes.

正取起一块把玩时，只听得楼梯上有响声，
He had just picked one up when footsteps sounded on the stairs.

便即侧身静听。
Turning onto his side, he listened.


“你去问问老爷，饭开在哪里？”
“Ask the master where dinner is to be served.”

语声发自外面那间屋子，清脆而沉着，
The voice came from the outer room, clear and composed.

从语声的韵味中，想象得到月如过了风信年华，正将步入徐娘阶段的年龄。
Its tone suggested that Yueru was past the first bloom of womanhood and approaching the age of mature charm.

这样在咫尺之外，发号施令，指挥丫头，是不是意味着她不会露面？
Giving orders to a maid from only a few steps away—did that mean she would not appear herself?

转念到此，周少棠心头，不免浮起一丝怅惘之感。
A slight disappointment rose in Zhou.

此时丫头进来请示，唐子韶已经交代，饭就开在楼上，理由仍旧是楼上比较暖和。
When the maid came to inquire, Tang ordered dinner served upstairs, again because it was warmer.

接着，门帘启处，周少棠眼前一亮，
Then the curtain lifted, and Zhou’s eyes brightened.

进来的少妇，约可三十上下年纪，长身玉立，鹅蛋形的脸上，长了一双极明亮的杏眼，
The woman who entered was about thirty, tall and graceful, with an oval face and exceptionally bright almond-shaped eyes.

眼风闪处，象有股什么力量，将周少棠从烟榻上弹了起来，
As her glance swept towards him, some force seemed to spring him from the smoking couch.

望着盈盈含笑的月如，不由得也在脸上堆满了笑容。
Looking at her gentle smile, he found his own face wreathed in smiles.

“这是小妾月如。”在烧烟的唐子韶，拿烟签子指点着说：
“This is my concubine, Yueru,” Tang said, indicating her with his opium needle as he prepared another pipe.

“月如，这是周老爷，
“Yueru, this is Mr Zhou.

你见一见。”
Make your greeting.”

“喔，是姨大大！”周少棠先就抱拳作揖。
“Ah, Madam!” Zhou clasped his hands and bowed first.

“不敢当，不敢当！”月如裣作礼，
“You are too kind!” She curtsied.

“周老爷我好象哪里见过。”
“Mr Zhou, I feel I’ve seen you somewhere.”

“你自然见过。”唐子韶说：
“Naturally you have,” Tang said.

“那天阜康门口搭了高台，几句话说得挤兑的人鸦雀无声，
“Remember the platform outside Fukang, and the few words that silenced everyone demanding their money?

就是周老爷。”
That was Mr Zhou.”


“啊！我想起来了。”
“Ah, now I remember!”

月如那双眼睛，闪闪发亮，惊喜交集，
Her eyes sparkled with delighted surprise.

“那天我同邻居去看热闹回来，
“I went with our neighbors to watch.

谈周老爷谈了两三夭。
We talked about you for two or three days afterward.

周老爷的口才，真正没话说。
Your eloquence is beyond praise.

这倒还在其次，
But that is the lesser thing.

大家都说周老爷的义气，真正少见。
Everyone says your loyalty is truly rare.

胡大先生是胡财神，平常捧财神的不晓得多少，
Mr Hu was the God of Wealth; who knows how many people flattered him then?

到了财神落难，好比变了瘟神，哪个不是见了他就躲，
Once misfortune struck, he became a God of Pestilence, and everyone fled at the sight of him.

只有周老爷看不过，出来说公道话。
Only you could not bear it and came forward to speak fairly.

如今一看周老爷的相貌，就晓得是行善积德，得饶人处且饶人，有大福气的厚道君子。
Now that I see you, I can tell you’re a blessed, kindhearted gentleman who does good, earns merit, and shows mercy wherever he can.”

“这番话说得周少棠心上象熨过一样服帖，
Her words soothed Zhou as though his heart had been gently ironed.

当然，他也有数，“得饶人处且饶人”，话中已经递过点子来了。
Naturally, he recognized the hint conveyed by “shows mercy wherever he can.”

“好说，好说！”周少棠说：
“You are too kind.

“我亦久闻唐姨太太贤惠能干，是我们老唐的贤内助。
I too have long heard how capable and virtuous Mistress Tang is—a worthy helpmate to our Old Tang.”

唐子韶一听称呼都改过了，知道周少棠必中圈套，
Hearing this change of address, Tang knew Zhou was certain to fall into the trap.

“随你奸似鬼，要吃老娘洗脚水”，心中暗暗得意，
“Cunning as a devil, yet you’ll drink the water a woman has washed her feet in,” he thought smugly.

一丢烟枪，翻身而起，口中说道：
Tossing aside his pipe, he sprang up.

“好吃酒了。”
“Time for wine!”



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第七章（三，至本章结束）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Seven, Part Three (conclusion)
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


其时方桌已经搭开，
The square table had been set.

自然是请周少棠上座，但只唐子韶侧面相陪。
Naturally Zhou Shaotang was given the seat of honour, but only Tang Zishao sat beside him.

菜并非如何讲究，但颇为人味，
The dishes were not particularly elaborate, yet they were delicious.

周少棠喜爱糟臃之物，所以对糟蒸白鱼、家乡肉、醉蟹这三样肴馔，格外欣赏，
Zhou liked foods preserved in wine or wine lees, and especially enjoyed the whitefish steamed with lees, the country-style cured pork, and the drunken crabs.

听说家乡肉、醉蟹并非市售，而是月如手制，便更赞不绝口了。
On learning that the pork and crabs had been prepared by Yueru herself rather than bought, he praised them still more warmly.

周少棠的谈锋很键，兴致又好，加以唐子韶是刻意奉承，
Zhou was an animated talker and in excellent spirits; Tang was deliberately flattering him.

所以快饮剧谈，相当投机。
They drank freely, talked eagerly, and got on very well.

当然，话题都是轻松有趣的。
Their subjects were naturally light and entertaining.

“老唐，”周少棠间到唐子韶的本行，“天下的朝奉，都是你们徽州人，好比票号都是山西人，
“Old Tang,” Zhou asked, turning to his host’s trade, “all the pawnbrokers in the country seem to be Huizhou men, just as all the remittance banks belong to Shanxi men.

而且听说只有太谷、平遥这两三府的人。
I have heard that even those come from only two or three prefectures, such as Taigu and Pingyao.

这是啥道理？”
Why is that?”

“这话，周先生，别人问我，我就装糊涂，随便敷衍几句，
“Mr Zhou, if anyone else asked, I should pretend not to know and put him off with a few words.

你老哥问到，我不能不跟你谈来历，
But since it is you, I must tell you the history.

不过，说起来不是啥体面的事？”
It is not a very creditable story, though.”

“喔，
“Oh?

怎么呢？”
How so?”


“明朝嘉靖年间，我们徽州有个人，叫汪直，
“During the Jiajing reign of the Ming, there was a man from our Huizhou called Wang Zhi.

你晓得不晓得。”
Have you heard of him?”

“我只晓得嘉靖年间有个‘打严嵩’的邹应龙，
“I know only that there was a Zou Yinglong in the Jiajing reign—the man who attacked Yan Song.

不晓得啥汪直。”
I know nothing about Wang Zhi.”

“你不晓得我告诉你，
“Then I shall tell you.

汪直是个汉奸。”
Wang Zhi was a traitor.”

“汉奸？
“A traitor?

莫非象秦桧一样私通外国。”
You mean he conspired with foreigners, like Qin Hui?”

“一点不错。”唐子韶答说，
“Exactly.

“不过汪直私通的不是金兵，
But Wang Zhi’s allies were not the Jin troops.

是日本人，那时候叫做倭寇。
They were Japanese, what people then called the wokou pirates.

倭寇到我们中国，在江浙沿海地方一登了陆，两眼漆黑，
When they landed on the Jiangsu and Zhejiang coast, they knew nothing of the country.

都是汪直同他的部下做向导，带他们一路奸淫掳掠。
Wang Zhi and his followers guided them as they raped and plundered their way inland.

倭寇很下作，放枪的时候，什么东西都要，
The pirates were a base lot: when looting, they took everything.

不过有的带不走，带走了，到他们日本也未见得有用，
Some things they could not carry away; others would be of little use in Japan even if they could.

所以汪直动了个脑筋，
So Wang Zhi had an idea.

开爿典当，什么东西都好当，
He opened a pawnshop that would accept anything.

老百姓来当东面，不过是个幌子，
Ordinary people bringing in their pledges were merely a cover.

说穿了，不过替日本人销赃而已。
In plain language, he was disposing of stolen goods for the Japanese.”

““怪不得了，你们那笔字象鬼画符，说话用‘切口’，
“No wonder your writing looks like a sorcerer’s charms, and you speak in special jargon.

原来都有讲究的。”周少棠说：
There was a reason for it all,” Zhou said.

“这是犯法的事情，当然要用同乡人。”
“Since it was illegal, you naturally had to use men from your own district.”

“不过，话要说回来，徽州地方苦得很，
“Still, one must remember how poor Huizhou is.

本地出产养不活本地人，
What the district produces cannot support its own people.

只好出外谋生，呼朋招友，同乡照顾同乡，
They have to go elsewhere for a living, calling in friends and helping fellow townsmen.

也是迫不得已。”
They have little choice.”


“你们微州人做生意，实在厉害，
“You Huizhou men certainly know how to do business.

象扬州的大盐商，问起来祖籍一大半是徽州。”周少棠说：
Ask the great salt merchants of Yangzhou where their families came from, and more than half say Huizhou.

“象汪直这样子，做了汉奸，还替日本人销赃，倒不怕公家抓他法办？”
But if Wang Zhi was both a traitor and a receiver of the Japanese pirates’ stolen goods, was he not afraid of being arrested?”

“这也有个原因的，
“There was a reason for that too.

当时的巡按御史，后来做了巡抚的胡宗宪，也是徽州人，
Hu Zongxian, the inspecting censor who later became governor, was also a Huizhou man.

虽不说包庇，念在同乡份上，略为高一高手，事情就过去了。
One need not call it protection; he had only to be a little lenient towards a fellow townsman, and the matter passed.

官司不怕大，只要有交情，总好商量。”
However serious a case may be, if there is friendship, something can always be arranged.”

唐子韶举杯相邀：
Tang raised his cup.

“来，来，周先生干一杯。”
“Come, Mr Zhou, let us drink.”

最后那两句话，加上敬酒的动作，意在言外，的然可见，
The last two sentences, accompanied by the toast, plainly carried another meaning.

但周少棠装作不觉，
Zhou pretended not to notice.

千了酒，将话题扯了开去，
He drained his cup and changed the subject.

“那个胡宗宪，你说他是巡按御史，
“You say this Hu Zongxian was an inspecting censor.

恐怕并没有庇护汪直的权柄。”
I doubt he had the power to protect Wang Zhi.

他又问一句：“真的权柄这么大。”
Was his authority really so great?”

“那只要看三堂会审的王金龙好了。”
“You have only to look at Wang Jinlong in The Trial Before Three Judges.”

“王金龙是小生扮的，好象刚刚出道，
“Wang Jinlong is played as a young man, apparently just beginning his career.

哪有这样子的威风？
How could he have such authority?

戏总是戏。”
A play is only a play.”

谈到这方面，唐子韶比周少棠内行得多了，
Tang knew much more about this than Zhou.

“明朝的进士，同现在不一样。
“Ming jinshi were different from those today.

现在的进士，如果不是点翰林或者到六部去当司官，放出来不过是个‘老虎班’的知县，
Nowadays, unless a jinshi enters the Hanlin Academy or becomes an official in one of the Six Ministries, he is sent out as no more than a county magistrate of the ‘tiger class.’

明朝的进士，一点‘巡按御史’赏上方宝剑，
But a Ming jinshi appointed inspecting censor received an imperial sword of authority.

等于皇上亲自来巡查，
He was as good as the emperor himself on a tour of inspection.

威风得不得了。
His power was tremendous.

我讲个故事，周先生你就晓得巡按御史的权柄了。”
Let me tell you a story, and you will understand.”


据说明朝有个富人，生两个女儿，
There was said to have been a rich man in the Ming with two daughters.

长女嫁武官，次女嫁了个寒士，
The elder married a military officer, the younger a poor scholar.

富人不免有势利之见，所以次婿受了许多委屈。
The father was somewhat snobbish, and the younger son-in-law suffered many slights.

及至次婿两榜及第，点了河南的巡按御史，
Eventually the scholar passed the provincial and metropolitan examinations and was appointed inspecting censor for Henan.

而长婿恰好在河南南阳当总兵。
His fellow son-in-law happened to be brigade commander at Nanyang in that province.

御史七品，总兵二品，
A censor held the seventh rank, a brigade commander the second.

但巡按御史“代天巡狩”，地位不同，
But an inspecting censor toured on the emperor’s behalf, which gave him a different standing.

所以次婿巡按到南阳，第二天五更时分，尚未起身，长婿已来禀请开操阅兵，
When he reached Nanyang, the commander came before he was out of bed, during the fifth watch next morning, to request permission to parade the troops for inspection.

那次婿想到当年岳家待他们连襟二人，炎凉各异，一时感慨，在枕上口占一绝：“黄草坡前万甲兵，碧纱帐里一书主；
Remembering how differently their father-in-law had treated them, the scholar was moved to compose a quatrain on his pillow: “Before the yellow-grass slope, ten thousand armoured men; behind green gauze curtains, a solitary scholar.

于今应识诗文贵，卧听元戎报五更。”
Now you should know the worth of verse and prose: lying in bed, I hear the commander announce the fifth watch.”

既“有诗为证”，周少棠不能不信，
With a poem to prove the story, Zhou could hardly disbelieve it.

而且触类旁通，有所领悟，
He also drew a further conclusion.

“这样说起来，‘三堂会审’左右的红袍、蓝袍，应该是藩司同臬司？”他问：
“Then the men in red and blue robes on either side in The Trial Before Three Judges must be the provincial treasurer and judicial commissioner.

“我猜得对不对？”
Am I right?”

“一点不错。”
“Exactly.”

“藩司、桌司旁坐陪审，那么居中坐的，身分应该是巡抚？”
“If those two sit beside him as fellow judges, the man in the centre ought to have the standing of a governor?”

“胡宗宪就是由巡按浙江的御史，改为浙江巡抚的。”
“Hu Zongxian went from inspecting censor for Zhejiang to governor of Zhejiang.”

“那就是了。”周少棠惋惜他说“胡大先生如果遇到他的本家就好了。”
“That explains it.” Zhou sighed. “If only Mr Hu had encountered that namesake of his!”

这就是说，胡雪岩如果遇见一个能象胡宗宪照顾同乡汪直那样的巡抚，他的典当就不至于会查封。
He meant that, had Hu Xueyan found a governor willing to protect him as Hu Zongxian had protected his fellow townsman Wang Zhi, his pawnshops would not have been taken into official custody.

唐子韶明白他的意思，但不愿意接口。
Tang understood but did not care to respond.


“周先生，”唐子韶忽然说道：“公济有好些满当的东西，
“Mr Zhou,” Tang said suddenly, “Gongji has quite a few unredeemed pledges whose terms have expired.

你要不要来看着？”
Would you like to come and look?”

周少棠不想贪这个小便宜，但亦不愿一口谢绝，便即问说：
Zhou did not want to take such a petty advantage, but neither did he wish to refuse outright.

“有没有啥比较特别、外面少见的东西？
“Is there anything unusual, something one does not often see elsewhere?”

““有，有，多得很。”
“Yes, plenty.”

唐子韶想了一会说：
Tang thought for a moment.

“快要过年了，
“The New Year is approaching.

有一堂灯，我劝周先生买了回去。
There is a set of lanterns I advise you to buy.

到正月十五挂起来，包管出色。”
Hang them up on the fifteenth of the first month, and I guarantee they will be a splendid sight.”

一听这话，周少棠不免诧异，
Zhou was puzzled.

上元的花灯、竹篾彩纸所扎，以新奇为贵，
Lantern Festival lanterns were made of bamboo strips and coloured paper; novelty was their chief attraction.

他想不明白，凭什么可以上当铺？
How could they be accepted as pledges?

因此，他愣了一下问道：“这种灯大概不是纸扎货？”
“These cannot be paper lanterns, I suppose?”

“当然。
“Of course not.

不然怎么好来当？”唐子韶说：
How could they be pawned otherwise?

“灯是绢灯，样子不多，大致照宫灯的式样，以六角形为主。
They are silk lanterns, in a limited number of designs, mostly hexagonal, like palace lanterns.

绢上画人物仕女，各种故事，
The silk is painted with figures, beautiful women, and all sorts of stories.

架子是活动的，
The frames fold.

用过了收拾干净，折起包好，明年再用。
After use, you clean them, fold and wrap them, and bring them out again next year.

海宁一带，通行这种灯。
They are common around Haining.

周先生没有看过？”
Have you never seen them?”

“没有。”
“No.”

“周先生看过了就晓得了。
“You will understand when you do.

这种灯不是哄小讶儿的纸扎走马灯，
They are not revolving paper lanterns for amusing children.

要有身分的人家，请有身分的客人吃春酒，厅上、廊上挂起来，
A respectable family gives a New Year dinner for distinguished guests and hangs them in the hall and corridors.

手里端杯酒，慢慢赏鉴绢上的各家画画。
With a cup in hand, one can study the paintings by different artists at leisure.

当然，也可以做它多少条灯谜，挂在灯上，请客人来打。
One can also hang riddles from them for the guests to solve.

这是文文静静的玩法：
It is a quiet, cultivated amusement.

象周先生现在也够身分了，应该置办这么一堂灯。”
A man of your present standing ought to acquire a set.”

周少棠近年收入不坏，常想在身分上力争上流，
Zhou’s income had been good in recent years, and he was eager to improve his social position.

尤其是最近为阜康的事，跟官府打过交道，已俨然在绪绅先生之列，
Since his dealings with the authorities over Fukang, he was by now virtually counted among the gentry.

所以对唐子韶的话，颇为动心，想了一下间道：
Tang’s suggestion appealed to him.

“办这么一堂灯，不晓得要花多少？”
“How much would such a set cost?”


“多少都花得下去！”唐子韶说：
“You could spend any amount,” Tang replied.

“这种灯，高下相差很大，
“There are enormous differences in quality.

好坏就在画上，要看是不是名家？
It all depends on the paintings—whether they are by famous artists.

就算是名家，未见得肯来画花灯，值钱就在这些地方。
Even a famous artist may not consent to paint lanterns; that is what makes them valuable.

譬如说，当今画仕女的，第一把手的费晓楼，
Take Fei Xiaolou, the foremost painter of beauties today.

你请他画花灯，他就不肯。”
Ask him to paint lanterns, and he will refuse.”

“那么，你那里满当的那一堂灯呢？是哪个画的呢？”
“Then who painted the set of expired pledges you have?”

“提起此人大大的有名，
“An exceedingly famous man.

康熙年间的大人先生，请他画过‘行乐图’的，不晓得多少。
Countless great officials of the Kangxi reign commissioned him to paint portraits of them at leisure.

他是扬州人，
He came from Yangzhou.

姓大禹的禹，名叫禹之鼎，
His surname was Yu, like Yu the Great, and his full name Yu Zhiding.

他也做过官，官名叫鸿胪寺序班。
He also held office as an usher in the Court of State Ceremonial.

这个官、照规矩是要旗人来做的，不晓得他怎么会做这个官……”
By regulation that post was for bannermen; I do not know how he came to hold it...”

“老唐，”周少棠打断他的话说：“我们不要去管他的官，谈他的画好了。”
“Old Tang,” Zhou interrupted, “let us leave his office aside and talk about his paintings.”

于是唐子韶言归正传，
Tang returned to the point.

说禹之鼎所画的那堂绢制花灯，一共二十四盏，六种样式，画的六个故事，西施沼吴、文君当垆、昭君出塞、文姬归汉、宓妃留枕、梅杨争宠，
Yu’s set comprised twenty-four silk lanterns in six designs, illustrating six stories: Xi Shi and the fall of Wu, Wenjun tending the wine shop, Zhaojun going beyond the frontier, Wenji returning to the Han, Fufei leaving her pillow, and Mei and Yang competing for favour.

梅是梅妃，杨是杨玉环，
Mei was Consort Mei, and Yang was Yang Yuhuan.

所以六个故事，却有七大美人。
Thus the six stories contained seven beauties.

“禹之鼎的画，假的很多，不过这堂灯绝不假，
“There are many counterfeit Yu Zhiding paintings, but these lanterns are certainly genuine.

因为来历不同。”唐子韶又说：
Their history is different.

‘康熙年间，有个皇帝面前的大红人，名叫高江村，他原来是杭州人，
In the Kangxi reign there was a great imperial favourite called Gao Jiangcun, originally from Hangzhou.

后来住在嘉兴的平湖县，
Later he lived in Pinghu County, Jiaxing.

到了嘉庆年间，子孙败落下来，
By the Jiaqing reign his descendants had fallen into poverty.

这堂灯就是高江村请禹之鼎画的，所以不假，
Gao commissioned Yu Zhiding to paint this set, so there can be no doubt about it.

周先生，这堂灯，明天我叫人送到府上。
Mr Zhou, I shall have it sent to your house tomorrow.”

““不，不！”周少棠摇着手说：
“No, no!” Zhou waved his hands.

“看看东西，再作道理。”
“Let me see it first; we can decide afterwards.”


唐子韶还要往下说时，只见一个丫头进来说道：
Tang was about to continue when a maid came in.

“公济派人来通知，
“Someone has come from Gongji.

说‘首柜，得了急病，
The chief counter appraiser has been taken suddenly ill.

请老爷马上去。”
They ask you to go at once.”

典当司事，分为“内缺”、“外缺”两种，
Pawnshop clerks held either internal or counter posts.

外缺的头脑，称为“首柜”，照例坐在迎门柜台的最左方，
The head of the latter was called the chief counter appraiser and ordinarily sat at the extreme left of the counter facing the entrance.

珍贵之物送上柜台，必经首柜镜定估价，
Any valuable article brought in had to pass through his hands for examination and valuation.

是个极重要的职司，所以唐子韶得此消息，顿时忧形于色，
It was therefore an important position, and worry immediately appeared on Tang’s face.

周少棠也就坐不住了。
Zhou could no longer remain comfortably seated.

“老唐，你有急事尽管请。
“Old Tang, if you have urgent business, please go.

我也要告辞了。”
I was about to take my leave.”

“不！不！
“No, no!

我去看一看就回来。
I shall go and look, then return.

我们的事也要紧的。”接着便喊：“月如，月如！”
Our business is important too.” He called for Yueru.

等丫头将月如去唤了来，唐子韶吩咐她代为陪客，随即向周少棠拱拱手，道声失陪，下楼而去。
When the maid brought her, he told her to keep their guest company, saluted Zhou with clasped hands, and went downstairs.

面临这样的局面，周少棠自然而然地想起了胡雪岩中美人汁的传说，起了几分戒心。
In this situation Zhou naturally remembered the story of Hu falling into a beauty trap, and became a little wary.

但月如却落落大方地一面布菜斟酒，一面问起周少棠的家庭情形，由周太太问到子女，因话搭话，
But Yueru was entirely at ease. Serving food and pouring wine, she asked about Zhou’s family, moving from his wife to his children as one subject led naturally to another.

谈锋很健，却很自然，完全是熟不拘札的闲话家常。
She talked readily, with the unceremonious familiarity of an old acquaintance discussing household affairs.

在周少棠的感觉中，月如是个能干贤惠的主妇，因而对于她与胡雪岩之间的传说，竟起了不可思议之感。
To Zhou, she seemed an able and virtuous housewife, making the stories about her and Hu almost impossible to believe.

当然也少得谈到胡雪岩的失败，月如更是表现了故主情殷，休戚相关的忠捆。
Inevitably Hu’s failure came up, and she showed deep loyalty to her former master, as though his fortunes were her own.

周少棠倒很想趁机谈一谈公济的事，但终于还是不曾开口。
Zhou was tempted to raise Gongji’s affairs, but in the end said nothing.


“姨太，”丫头又来报了，“老爷叫人回来说，首柜的病很重，
“Madam,” the maid reported again, “the master has sent word that the chief appraiser is very ill.

他还要等在那里看一看，
He must remain there a little longer to see how things develop.

请周老爷不要走，还有要紧事谈。”
Mr Zhou is asked not to leave; there is still important business to discuss.”

“晓得了。
“Very well.

你再去烫一壶酒来。”
Warm another pot of wine.”

“酒够了，酒够了。”周少棠说，
“I have had enough wine,” Zhou said.

不必再烫，
“There is no need for more.

有粥我想吃一碗。
If there is congee, I should like a bowl.”

““预备了香粳米粥在那里，
“We have fragrant rice congee ready.

酒还可以来一点。”
You can still have a little more wine.”

“那就以一壶为度。”
“Then let us stop after one pot.”

喝完了酒喝粥，接着又喝茶，
After the wine they had congee, then tea.

而唐子韶却无回来的消息，周少棠有些踌躇了。
Still there was no word of Tang’s return, and Zhou began to feel uncertain.

“周老爷，”
“Mr Zhou.”

月如从里间走了出来，是重施过脂粉了，
Yueru emerged from the inner room, her powder and rouge freshly applied.

她大大方方地说：“我来打口烟你吃。”
Quite openly she said, “Let me prepare you a pipe.”

“我没有瘾。”
“I have no habit.”

“香一简玩玩。”
“Just enjoy one for amusement.”

说着，她亲自动手点起了烟灯，自己便躺了下去，拿烟签子挑起烟来烧。
She lit the opium lamp herself, lay down, and lifted some opium on the needle to heat it.


丫头端来一小壶滚烫的茶，一盘松子糖，放在烟盘上，然后一言不发地退了出去。
The maid brought a small pot of piping-hot tea and a plate of pine-nut sweets, set them on the smoking tray, and withdrew without a word.

“烟打好了。”月如招呼：
“Your pipe is ready,” Yueru called.

“请过来吧！”
“Come over.”

周少棠不由自主地躺在月如对面，
Almost against his will, Zhou lay down opposite her.

两人共用一个长枕头，一躺下去便闻到桂花油的香味。
They shared a long pillow, and he immediately caught the fragrance of her osmanthus hair oil.

魔障一起，对周少棠来说，便成了苦难，
Once desire took hold, it became a torment.

由她头上的桂花油开始，鼻端眼底，触处无不是极大的挑逗。
Beginning with that scent, everything that met his eyes or nostrils was an irresistible provocation.

“周少棠啊周少棠！”他在心中自语：
“Zhou Shaotang, Zhou Shaotang!” he told himself.

“你混了几十年，
“You have been about the world for decades.

又不是二三十岁的小伙子了，
You are no youngster of twenty or thirty.

莫非还是这样子的‘嫩’？”
Can you still be so green?”

这样自我警告着，心里好象定了些，但很快地又意乱神迷了，需要第二次再提警告，
The warning steadied him a little, but soon he was bewildered again and had to repeat it.

就这样一筒烟，还没有到口，倒已经在内心中挣扎了三四回了。
Before that single pipe reached his lips, he had struggled with himself three or four times.

月如终于打好了一个“黄、长、松”的烟泡，安在烟枪“斗门”上，拿烟签子轻轻地捻通，
Yueru finally prepared a yellow, elongated, loosely rolled pellet, placed it over the pipe bowl’s opening, and gently pierced it with the needle.

然后将烟枪倒过来，烟嘴伸到周少棠唇边，说一声：
Turning the pipe, she brought the mouthpiece to his lips.

“尝一口看。”
“Try it.”

这对周少棠来说，无异为抵御“心中贼”的一种助力，
To Zhou, this offered a means of resisting the thief within his heart.

他虽没有瘾，却颇能领略鸦片烟的妙处，
Though he was not addicted, he could appreciate opium’s attractions.

将注意力集中在烟味的香醇上，暂时抛开了月如的一切。
Concentrating on its rich, mellow flavour, he temporarily forgot everything about Yueru.

分儿口抽完了那筒烟，口中又干又苦，
A few draws finished the pipe and left his mouth dry and bitter.

但如“嘴对嘴”喝一口热茶，把烟压了下去，便很容易上瘾，所以他不敢喝茶，只取了块松子糖送人口中。
But following it immediately with hot tea made addiction easy, so he dared not drink any and took a pine-nut sweet instead.


“周老爷，”月如开口了，“你同我们老爷，原来就熟悉的吧？”
“Mr Zhou,” Yueru began, “you and my husband have known each other well for a long time, have you not?”

“原来并不熟，
“Not well, originally.

不过，他是场面上的人，我当然久闻其名。”
But he is a man of standing, and of course I had long heard his name.”

“我们老爷同我说，现在有悠扬事，要请周老爷照应，
“He tells me there is something for which he needs your help.

不晓得是什么事？”
I do not know what it is.”

一听这话，周少棠不由得诧异，
Zhou was surprised.

不知道她是明知故问呢，还是真个不知？
Did she really not know, or was she asking a question whose answer she knew already?

想一想，反问一句：“老唐没有跟你谈过？”
After a moment he asked, “Has Old Tang not discussed it with you?”

“他没有。
“No.

他只说买的一百多亩西湖田，要赶紧脱手，不然周老爷面上不好交代。”
He only said that we must sell the hundred-odd mu of land by West Lake as soon as possible, or he would find it difficult to face you.”

“怎么不好交代。”
“Why should he find it difficult?”

“他说，要托周老爷帮忙，空口说白话不中用。”月如忽然叹口气说：
“He says that asking your help with nothing but empty words would be no use.” She suddenly sighed.

“ 唉，我们老爷也是，
“Ah, that husband of mine!

我常劝他，你有亏空，老实同胡大先生说，
I have often told him: if you have a shortfall, tell Mr Hu frankly.

胡大先生的脾气，天大的事，只要你老实说，没有不让你过门的。
With his temperament, however serious the matter, he will always let you through if you are honest.

他总觉得扯了窟窿对不起胡大先生，
But my husband felt he had wronged Mr Hu by creating the deficit.

‘八个坛儿七个盖’，盖来盖去盖不周矣，
Eight jars and seven lids—however he shifted them, he could not cover everything.

到头儿还是落个没面子，
He has lost face in the end all the same.

何苦？”
Why go through it?”

“喔，”周少棠很注意地问：
“Oh?” Zhou listened closely.

“老唐扯了什么窟窿？”
“What sort of deficit did he create?”

接下来，月如便叹了一大堆苦经，
Yueru poured out a long tale of misery.

不外乎唐子韶为人外精明、内糊涂，
Tang, she said, was shrewd on the surface but foolish underneath.

与合伙做生意，吃了暗亏，迫不得已在公济典动了手脚。
He had suffered concealed losses in business partnerships and had been forced to tamper with Gongji’s funds.

说到伤心处，该然欲涕，连周少棠都心酸酸地为她难过。
At the saddest points she seemed ready to weep, and even Zhou’s heart ached for her.

“You say Old Tang suffered concealed losses and could not speak of his troubles.

到底是啥个亏，
What losses?

啥个苦？”
What troubles?”

“There is no harm in telling you.

“胡大先生有个朋友，这个姓很少见的，姓古，
Mr Hu has a friend with an unusual surname—Gu.

周老爷晓不晓得？”
Do you know him?”

“I have heard of him.

是替胡大先生办洋务的。”
He handles Mr Hu’s foreign business.”

“Exactly.

就是他这位古老爷做地皮，邀我们老爷合股。
This Mr Gu invited my husband to join him in property development.

当初计算得蛮好，
The original calculations looked excellent.

哪晓得洋人一打仗，市面不对了。
Then the foreigners went to war and the market changed.

从前‘逃长毛’，都逃到上海，因为长毛再狠，也不敢去攻租界。
When people fled the Longhairs, they went to Shanghai; however savage the rebels were, they dared not attack the concessions.

一到洋人要开仗了，轮到上海人逃难了，
But once the foreigners were going to war, it was the people of Shanghai who had to flee.

造好的房子卖不掉，亏了好几十万。
The completed houses would not sell, and they lost several hundred thousand taels.

击老爷你想想，怎么得了？”
Think what that meant!

And the worst of it was that he could not tell Mr Hu.”

因为第一，唐子韶当年曾有承诺，须以全副精力为胡雪岩经营典当，自己不可私营贸易。
For one thing, Tang had originally undertaken to devote all his energies to managing Hu’s pawnshops and conduct no private trade of his own.

这项承诺后来虽渐渐变质，但亦只属于与胡雪岩有关的生意为限，譬如收茧卖丝之类，
Although this promise had gradually been diluted, his other ventures had remained confined to businesses connected with Hu, such as buying cocoons and selling silk.

He was, in effect, taking subsidiary shares.

Property development was a new business altogether.

If we said we had lost money in property with him, Mr Hu would be displeased.

Why?

是不是要我贴补呢？
Do you expect me to make it good?

再说，同古老爷合伙，生意为啥亏本，有些话根本不便说，

Speaking of them would do no good.

“Why?” Zhou asked.

Yueru said nothing.

上海的行情不熟，市面不灵，
He knew little of Shanghai prices and had no reliable market information.

怕胡大先生晓得，还不敢去打听，
Afraid that Mr Hu might find out, he did not even dare make inquiries.

这话很明显地表示，古应春有侵吞的情事在。
Her words plainly suggested that Gu had been embezzling.

Zhou half believed and half doubted her, with no means of getting to the truth.

His mind turned instead to Tang’s prolonged absence.

Was he too arranging a beauty trap?

Zhou remained on the couch, considering how to negotiate when Tang returned.

桌上一把洋刀，一个快削好了的梨，不用说，是不小心刀伤了手指。

“There are clean handkerchiefs in the drawer.

请你撕一条来。”
Tear me a strip.”

杭州话的“帕儿”就是手绢。
She used pa’er, the Hangzhou word for a handkerchief.

周少棠拉开抽斗一看，内有几方折得方方正正的各色纺绸手绢，
Zhou opened the drawer and found several in various colours of spun silk, folded into neat squares.

白色的一方在下面，
A white one lay underneath.

随手一翻，发现了薄薄的一本书。

不要看，”
Do not look!”

周少棠吓一大跳，急忙缩手，
Startled, he drew his hand back.

看到月如脸上，双颊泛红，微显窘色，
Her cheeks were flushed, and she looked slightly embarrassed.

想一想恍然大悟，那本不能看的书是什么。
After a moment he understood what sort of book it must be.

持在手上，另一只手揭开粉缸，伸两指拈了一撮粉说道：
Holding it in one hand, he opened the powder jar with the other and took a pinch between two fingers.

When she did, he put the powder on the cut, quickly bandaged it, and found a thread to tie the dressing.

“还好。”月如答说：
“Not much.

“亏得你在这里，不然血一定流得满地。”
It is lucky you were here, or I should have bled all over the floor.”

She gave a slight tug to withdraw her hand.

但周少棠不放，她也就不挣扎了。
When he would not release it, she stopped resisting.

“Really?

“比你太太怎么样？”
How do they compare with your wife’s?”

“There is no comparison.”

“你的太太很年轻吗？”
“Is your wife very young?”

“她属羊的。”
“She was born in the Year of the Sheep.

周少棠问：“你呢？”
And you?”

“我属牛。”
“The Ox.”

“她比你大多了。”
“Then she is much older than you.”

周少棠牵着她的手，回到中间方桌边，放开了手，各自落座。
Holding her hand, Zhou led her back to the square table in the middle of the room, released it, and sat down opposite her.

It is unusually large; we can share it.”

“One should not divide a pear,” Yueru said.

“你一个人慢慢吃好了。
“Take your time and eat it yourself.

梨，化痰清火，
Pears clear phlegm and internal heat.

吃烟的人，冬天吃了最好。”
They are excellent for opium smokers in winter.”

“It does not really matter whether you and I divide a pear.

“只要你同老唐不分梨就好了。”
As long as you and Old Tang do not part, all will be well.”

“梨”字谐音为“离”，
The word for pear, li, sounded like the word for parting.

彼此默喻，用以试探，
Both understood the play on words and used it to test the other.

月如抓住机会说了一句切中要害的话。
Yueru seized her chance.

“我同老唐分不分离，完全要看你周老爷，是不是阴功积德了。”

“You exaggerate.

我哪里有这么大的力量。”
How could I have such power?”

“There is no need for modesty.

我也听说了，老唐会不会吃官司，完全要看周老爷你肯不肯帮忙，
I have heard that whether Old Tang faces prosecution depends entirely on your willingness to help.

你肯帮忙，我同老唐还在一起，
If you help, we can remain together.

你不肯帮忙，我看分离分定了。”
If not, I fear we shall certainly be parted.”


周少棠这时才发现，她对唐子韶的所作所为，即使全未曾参预，定必完全了解，
Only now did Zhou realise that, even if Yueru had taken no part in Tang’s doings, she must know all about them.

而且是唐子韶安排好来眼他谈判的人。
Tang had arranged for her to negotiate with him.

然则自己就必须考虑了，要不要跟她谈，
He therefore had to decide whether to discuss the matter with her.

如果不谈，现在该是走的时候了。
If not, it was time to leave.

但一想到走，顿有不舍之意。这样就自然而然在思索，应该如何谈法？
Yet the thought of leaving immediately filled him with reluctance, and he found himself considering how to begin.

决定先了解了解情况再作道理。
He would first learn a little more before deciding.

于是他问：“阿嫂，你晓得不晓得老唐亏空了多少？”
“Sister-in-law, do you know how large Old Tang’s deficit is?”

“我想，总有三四万银子吧？”
“Thirty or forty thousand taels, I suppose?”

“不止，”
“More.”

“喔，
“Oh?

是多少呢？”
How much?”

“起码加个倍。”
“At least twice that.”

一听这话，月如发愣，怔怔地看着周少棠——
She stared at him, stunned.

不知她心里在想什么主平最凄凉的事，
Who knew what she summoned up as the most sorrowful experience of her life?

居然挤出来一副“急泪”。
Somehow she squeezed out a sudden flood of tears.

周少棠大为不忍，
Zhou could not bear it.

“阿嫂，你也不必急，
“Do not be anxious.

慢慢商量。
We can discuss it calmly.

我能帮忙，一定帮忙。”
If I can help, I certainly shall.

How much ready silver can Old Tang raise now?”

“现银？”月如想了一下说：
“Ready silver?” She thought.

“现银大概只有两三千，
“Probably only two or three thousand taels.

另外只有我的首饰。”
Apart from that, there is only my jewellery.”

“你的首饰值多少？”
“What is it worth?”

“顶多也不过两三千。
“Two or three thousand at most.”

“两个两三千，就有五六千银子了。”周少棠又问：
“Two lots of two or three thousand make five or six thousand.

What about your land by West Lake?”

“田倒值一万多银子，不过一时也寻不着买主。”
“That is worth over ten thousand, but we cannot find a buyer immediately.”

“西湖田俏得很，
“West Lake land is in great demand.

不过十天半个月，就有买主。”
Ten days or half a month should bring a buyer.”

“十天半个月来得及，来不及？”
“Would ten days or half a month be in time?”

这句话使得周少棠大为惊异，
The question astonished Zhou.

因为问到这活，就显得她很懂公事。
It showed that she understood official procedure.

所谓“来得及，来不及”，是指“马大老爷”复命而言，。
“In time” referred to Magistrate Ma’s report.

即受藩宪之委，当然要克服复命，
Having accepted the treasurer’s commission, he had to report back by the appointed deadline.

如果事情摆不平，据实呈复，唐子韶立郎便有缧绁之灾。
If matters could not be settled and he reported the facts, Tang would immediately face imprisonment.

照此看来，必是唐子韶已彻底研究过案情，想到过各种后果，预先教好了她如何进言，如何应付。
Evidently Tang had studied the case thoroughly, considered every consequence, and coached her in what to say and how to respond.

自己千万要小心，莫中圈套。
Zhou must take the greatest care not to fall into their trap.

After thinking for a moment, he asked, “What if it is in time?

来不及又怎么样？”
And what if it is not?”

“If it is, so much the better.

来不及的话，要请周老爷同马大老爷打个商量，好不好把公事压一压，先不要报上去。”
If not, would you discuss it with Magistrate Ma and ask him to hold the matter back, without reporting it yet?”

“That may be difficult.”

就在这时，周少棠已经打定主意，
By now Zhou had made up his mind.

由于发现唐子韶与月如，是打算用施之于胡雪岩的手法来对付他，因而激发了报复的念头，
Discovering that Tang and Yueru intended to use the same methods on him as they had on Hu had aroused his desire for revenge.

决定先占个便宜再说。
He would take some advantage of the situation first.

Do not think too much.

天塌下来有长人顶，
If the sky falls, there are tall people to hold it up.

I shall certainly help you.

But what do I get for helping?”

一个人帮朋友的忙，总要由心里发出来的念头，时时刻刻想到，帮忙才帮得切实。
To help a friend properly, the wish must come from the heart. One must keep thinking of it.

不然，看到想起，过后就忘记了，

这是人之常情，不是小气。”
That is human nature, not pettiness.”

There must have been something to start it.”

“因头，就象你现在一样，
“Something just like this.

你喜欢我，我就让你摸一摸，亲一亲，
You like me, so I let you touch and kiss me.

还会有啥花样？
What else could there be?

莫非你就看得我那么贱？”
Do you really think me so cheap?”

“我哪里敢？”
“How could I dare?”

周少棠坐回原处，一把拉住她，恢复原样，
Zhou sat down again and drew her back onto his lap.

但这回自觉更有把握了，
This time he felt more in control.

“好，
“Very well.

既然你说喜欢你就让我摸一摸、亲一亲，我就照你的话做。”
Since you say that if I like you, I may touch and kiss you, I shall do as you say.”

说着，一手搂过她来亲她的嘴。
He slipped an arm around her and kissed her mouth.

月如很驯顺地，毫无挣扎之意，
Yueru was quite compliant and made no attempt to resist.

让他亲了一会，将头往后一仰问道：
After letting him kiss her for a while, she leaned her head back.

“我给你的好处，够不够多？”
“Have I given you enough kindness?”

“够多。”
“Plenty.”

“那么，你呢？”
“And you?”

“我怎么？”
“What about me?”

“你答应我的事。”
“What you promised.”

“一定不会忘记。”
“I shall certainly not forget.”

“如果忘记掉呢？”月如说道：
“And if you do?

“你对着灯光菩萨罚个咒。”
Swear before the Lamp-Light Bodhisattva to accept punishment if you forget.”

赌神罚咒，在周少棠也很重视的，
Zhou took oaths invoking divine punishment seriously.

略作盘算以后说道：“阿嫂，我答应帮你的忙，暂时让马大老爷把你们的事情压一压，
After a brief calculation, he said, “Sister-in-law, I promise to help you by having Magistrate Ma hold back your case for a while.

不过压一压不是不了了之。
But a delay does not mean letting it disappear.

你不要弄错，
Do not misunderstand.

这是公事，
This is official business.

就算马大老爷是我的儿子，我也不能叫他怎么办，他也不会听我的。“
Even if Magistrate Ma were my own son, I could not order him how to deal with it, nor would he obey.”


“这一层我明白，
“I understand that.

不过，我倒要问你，你打算叫他怎么办？”
But what do you intend to ask him to do?”

“我叫他打个折扣。”
“Allow a reduction.”

“几折？”
“How much?”

“你说呢？”
“What do you say?”

“要我说，最好大事化小，小事化无。
“If it were up to me, I should want a big affair made small and a small affair made nothing.

如果你肯这样做，我再给你好处！”
If you will do that, I shall give you more kindness.”

周少棠心中一动，
Zhou was tempted.

笑嘻嘻地问道：“什么好处？”
Smiling, he asked, “What sort?”

月如不作声，灵活的眼珠不断地在转。
Yueru said nothing, her lively eyes constantly moving.

周少棠知道又有新花样了，很冷静地戒备着。
Knowing she had thought of another trick, he kept a cool watch.

突然间，楼梯上的响动打破了沉默，
Suddenly footsteps on the stairs broke the silence.

而且听得出是男人的脚步声，当然是唐子韶回来了。
They were plainly a man’s: Tang had returned.

“周老爷，”月如一本正经地说：“等下当着我们老爷，你不要说什么风话。”
“Mr Zhou,” Yueru said with perfect seriousness, “when my husband comes in, do not make any suggestive remarks.”

接着，起身迎了过去。
She rose to meet him.

这一番叮嘱，使周少棠颇有异样的感觉，
Her warning gave Zhou a peculiar feeling.

明明是他们夫妇商量好的一档把戏，
This was clearly a scheme the couple had arranged together.

何以月如又要在她丈夫面前假作正经，
Why, then, must she pretend to be proper before her husband?

而且她又何以会顾虑到他在她丈夫面前可能会说“风话”？
And why was she worried that Zhou might say something suggestive in his presence?

这都是很值得玩味的疑问，但一时却无暇细想，
These were questions worth pondering, but there was no time.

因为唐子韶已经回来了，他少不得也要顾虑到礼貌，起身含笑目迎。
Tang was already there, and courtesy required Zhou to rise and greet him with a smile.


“对不起，对不起！”唐子韶抢步上前，抱拳致歉，
“My apologies!” Tang hurried forward, saluting with clasped hands.

“累你久等，真正不好意思。”
“I am truly ashamed to have kept you waiting so long.”

“没有啥，没有啥！”
“Not at all!”

周少棠故意说风话：
Zhou deliberately made an insinuation.

“我同阿嫂谈得蛮投机的，
“Sister-in-law and I have got on very well.

削梨给我吃，还害得她手都割破了。”
She even cut her hand peeling a pear for me.”

“是啊！”唐子韶转脸看着月如：
“Yes!” Tang turned to Yueru.

“我刚刚一进门就看见了，
“I noticed as soon as I came in.

你的手怎么割破的，
How did you cut it?

要紧不要紧。”
Is it serious?”

“不要紧。”月如关切地问：
“It is nothing.

“赵先生怎么样了。”
How is Mr Zhao?”

赵先生便是公济典得急病的“头柜”。
Mr Zhao was Gongji’s chief counter appraiser, the man who had fallen suddenly ill.

唐子韶答说：“暂时不要紧了。
“Out of danger for the moment.

亏得大先生给我的那支好参，一味‘独参汤’总算扳回来了。“接下来他又说：”你赶快烧两筒烟，
Thanks to that fine ginseng Mr Hu gave me, a decoction of ginseng alone finally brought him round.” Tang continued, “Quickly prepare a couple of pipes.

我先过瘾要紧。
I must satisfy my craving first.

来，来，周先生，我们躺下来谈。
Come, Mr Zhou, let us lie down and talk.”
