Host and guest reclined on either side of the smoking tray.

月如端张小凳子坐在两人之间，开灯烧烟，
Yueru drew up a small stool between them, lit the lamp, and prepared the opium.

唐子韶便谈赵先生的病情，
Tang described Mr Zhao’s illness.

周少棠无心细听，支支吾吾地应着，很注意月如的神情，却看不出什么来。
Zhou had little interest in listening and answered vaguely, watching Yueru’s expression closely without discovering anything.

等两筒鸦片抽过，月如开口了，
After the two pipes had been smoked, she spoke.

“刚刚我同周老爷叹了你的苦经，
“I have been telling Mr Zhou about your troubles.

亏空也是没办法。”她说：
You had no choice about the deficit.

“周老爷很帮忙，
He has been very helpful.

先请马大老爷把公事压一压，我们赶紧凑一笔钱出来，了这件事。”
First he will ask Magistrate Ma to hold back the official proceedings while we hurry to raise a sum to settle the affair.”

“是啊！事情出来了，总要了的。
“Yes, once a matter has come out, it must be settled.

周先生肯帮我们的忙，就算遇到救星了。”
If Mr Zhou will help, we have found our saviour.”

“周老爷说，亏空很多，只好打个折扣来了。
“He says the deficit is large and can only be settled at a reduction.

我们那笔西湖田，周老爷说，有十天半个月就可以脱手。
He also says our West Lake land should sell in ten days or half a month.

你如今不便出面，只好请周老爷代为觅个头主。”月如又说：
Since it is inconvenient for you to appear yourself, we must ask him to find a buyer.

“当然，中人钱，我们还是要照送周老爷的。
Naturally, we shall pay him the usual intermediary’s commission.”


谈来谈去，唐子韶方面变出来一个结果，他承诺在十天之内，凑出两万四千银子，
After considerable discussion, Tang made a commitment: within ten days he would raise twenty-four thousand taels.

以出售他的西湖田为主要财源，其次是月如的首饰，唐子韶的古董，
The principal source would be the sale of his West Lake land, followed by Yueru’s jewellery and his antiques.

如果再不够，有什么卖什么，凑够了为止。
If those were insufficient, he would sell whatever else he had until the sum was complete.

现在要轮到周少棠说话了，
It was now Zhou’s turn to speak.

他一直在考虑的是，马逢时呈报顺利接收的公事一报上去，唐子韶的责任便已卸得干干净净，
He had been considering one difficulty throughout: once Ma reported that the takeover had proceeded satisfactorily, Tang would be entirely discharged from responsibility.

到时候他不认帐又将如何？
What if he then repudiated the agreement?

当然，他可以要唐子韶写张借据，
Zhou could, of course, demand an acknowledgement of debt.

但“杀人偿命”，有官府来作主，“欠债还钱”两造是可以和解的，
But whereas the authorities enforced the principle that a murderer must pay with his life, the two parties could reach a private settlement over a debt.

俗语说：“不怕讨债的凶，只怕欠债的穷。”
As the saying went, “It is not the fierce creditor one fears, but the penniless debtor.”

唐子韶有心赖债，催讨无着，反倒闹得沸沸扬扬，
If Tang deliberately refused payment, demands might prove fruitless and merely create a public scandal.

问起来“唐子韶怎么会欠你两万四千银子，
People would ask: “How did Tang come to owe you twenty-four thousand taels?

你跟庸子韶不过点头之交，
You are no more than nodding acquaintances.

倒舍得把大笔银子借给他？”
Would you really lend him so large a sum?”

那时无言以对，
Zhou would have no answer.

势必拆穿真相。变成“羊肉没有吃，先惹一身骚”，
The truth would inevitably emerge, and he would acquire all the stink of mutton without having tasted a morsel.

太犯不着了。
It was not worth it.

由于沉吟不语的时间太久，唐子韶与月如都慢慢猜到了他的心事。
His silence lasted so long that Tang and Yueru gradually guessed his concern.

唐子韶决定自己先表示态度。
Tang decided to state his position first.

“周先生，你一定是在想，空口讲白话，对马大老爷不好开口，
“Mr Zhou, you must be thinking that empty words give you nothing to put before Magistrate Ma.

是不是？”
Is that it?”

既然他猜到了，周少棠不必否认，
Since he had guessed, Zhou need not deny it.

“不错，”他说：
“Exactly.

“我是中间人，
I am the intermediary.

两面都要交代。”
I must answer to both sides.”


“这样子，我叫月如先把首饰检出来，
“Then let me have Yueru sort out her jewellery first.

刚才看过的汉玉，也请你带了去，请你变价。
Please take the Han jades you saw earlier too, and sell them for us.

至于西湖田，也请你代觅买主，我把红契交了给你。”
As for the West Lake land, I shall ask you to find a buyer and give you the red deed.”

凡是缴过契税，由官府铃了印的，称为“红契”。
A deed on which the transfer tax had been paid and the official seal impressed was called a “red deed.”

但这不过是上手的原始凭证，
But it was only the original evidence of the previous acquisition.

收到了不致另生纠葛，根本上买卖还是要订立契约，
Obtaining it prevented certain later complications; fundamentally, a fresh contract was still required for a sale.

没有卖契，光有红契，不能凭以营业，
Without a deed of sale, the red deed alone could not authorise a transaction.

而况唐子韶可用失窃的理由挂失，原有的红契等于废纸。
Moreover, Tang could report it stolen and have it invalidated, reducing the original to wastepaper.

唐子韶很机警，看周少棠是骗不倒的内行，立即又补上一句：“当然，要抵押给你，请老杨做中。”
Quick-witted as he was, Tang saw that Zhou understood too much to be deceived and promptly added, “Naturally, I shall mortgage it to you, with Old Yang as intermediary.”

周少棠心中一动，
Zhou was struck by an idea.

想了一下说道：“这样吧，明天上午，我同老杨一起到公济来看你，商量一个办法出来。”
After considering, he said, “Let us do this: tomorrow morning I shall come to Gongji with Old Yang, and we can work out an arrangement.”

“好，好！
“Very good.

我等候两位大驾。”
I shall await you both.”

“辰光不早，
“It is late.

再谈下去要天亮了。”
If we go on talking, dawn will be here.”

周少棠起身说道：
Zhou rose.

“多谢，多谢！
“Thank you for everything.

明朝会。
Until tomorrow.”

““这一盒玉器，你带了去。”
“Take this box of jades with you.”

“不，不！”周少棠双手乱摇，坚决不受。
“No, no!” Waving both hands, Zhou firmly refused.

然后向月如说道：
He then turned to Yueru.

“阿嫂，真正多谢，
“Sister-in-law, thank you indeed.

今天这顿饭，比吃鱼翅席还要落胃。”
This meal has suited my stomach better than a shark’s-fin banquet.”

“哪里，哪里。
“You are too kind.

周老爷有空尽管请过来，
Come whenever you have time.

我还有几样拿手菜，烧出来请你尝尝。”
I have a few more special dishes I should like you to try.”

“好极，好极！”
“Excellent!

一定要来叨扰。“
I shall certainly trouble you again.”



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第八章（上）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Eight, Part One
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第八章 赠妾酬友｜CHAPTER EIGHT: A CONCUBINE AS A GIFT TO A FRIEND


由于有事，回到家只睡了一会儿，周少棠便已醒来，匆匆赶到杨家，
With business on his mind, Zhou Shaotang woke after only a little sleep at home and hurried to Yang’s house.

杨书办正要出门。
Clerk Yang was just going out.

“你到哪里去？”
“Where are you off to?”

“想到城隍山去看个朋友……”
“I thought I would visit a friend on City God Hill…”

“不要去了。”同少棠不等他话完，便即打断，
“Do not go.” Zhou interrupted him before he could finish.

“我有要紧事同你商量。”
“I have something urgent to discuss with you.”

“于是就在杨家密谈。
They held their private conference at Yang’s house.

周少棠将昨夜的经过情形，细细告诉了杨书办，问他的意见。
Zhou gave a detailed account of the previous night and asked for his opinion.

“卖田他自己去卖好了，
“Let him sell his own land.

月如为啥说唐子韶不便出面？”
Why did Yueru say Tang Zishao could not appear in the transaction himself?”

“对！
“Exactly!

我当时倒忘记问她了。”
I forgot to ask her that.”

“这且不言。”
“Leave that aside for now.

杨书办问道：“现在马大老爷那里应该怎么办？”
What should we do about Magistrate Ma?”

“我正就是为这一点要来同你商量。
“That is precisely what I came to discuss.

月如打的是如意算盘，希望先报出去，顺利接收，
Yueru has it all nicely worked out: she hopes we shall first report that the takeover went smoothly.

那一来唐子韶一点责任都没有了。
Then Tang will be free of all responsibility.

不过，要等他凑齐了银子再报，不怕耽误日子？
But if we wait until he has raised the silver before submitting the report, will we not hold things up?

如今我倒有个办法，”周少棠突然问道：“你有没有啥路子，能借一笔大款子？”
I do have an idea, though.” Zhou suddenly asked, “Do you know anyone who could arrange a substantial loan?”

“现在银根紧。”杨书办问：
“Money is tight at present.

“你想借多少？”
How much do you want to borrow?”

“不是我借。
“It is not for me.

我想叫唐子韶先拿他的西湖田抵押一笔款子出来，
I want Tang to raise a loan against his West Lake fields.

我们先拿到了手，有多少算多少。”
Let us get the money into our hands first, however much it is.”

杨书办沉吟了好一会说：
Yang thought for some time.

“这是出典。
“That means putting the land in pledge.

典田不如买田，
Taking land in pledge is less attractive than buying it outright.

这种主顾不多，而且，手续也很麻烦，
There are not many people willing to do it, and the formalities are troublesome.

不是三两无能办好的。”
It cannot be settled in two or three days.”


周少棠爽然若失，
Zhou looked crestfallen.

“照此看来，”他说：“一只煮熟的鸭子，只怕要飞掉了。”
“Then it seems our cooked duck may fly away after all.”

“这也不见得。
“Not necessarily.

如果相信得过，不妨先放他一马。”
If we can trust him, we might give him some leeway first.”

“就是因为相信不过。”
“The trouble is that we cannot trust him.

周少棠说：“你想他肯拿小老婆来陪我……”
Think of it: he was willing to let his concubine entertain me…”

周少棠自知泄漏了秘密，要想改口，已是驷不及舌。
Zhou realized he had let out a secret, but it was too late to call back his words.

杨书办笑笑问道：
Yang smiled.

“唷，
“Well!

你‘近水楼台先得是月’，
The tower nearest the water catches the moon first.

同月如上过阳台了？”
Have you been to bed with Yueru?”

“没有，没有。”
“No, no!”

周少棠急忙分辩：
Zhou hastened to explain.

“不过嘴巴亲一亲，胸脯摸一摸。
“Only kissed her lips and felt her breasts.

总而言之，唐子韶一定在搞鬼，
In any case, Tang must be up to something.

轻易相信他，一定会上当。
We shall certainly be taken in if we trust him too readily.”

““我晓得了。
“I see.

等我来想想。”
Let me think.”

公事上到底是杨书办比较熟悉，
Yang, after all, knew more about official procedure.

他认为有一个可进可退的办法，即是由马逢时先报一个公事，说是帐目上尚有疑义，正在查核之中，请准予暂缓结案。
He proposed a course that would leave them room to advance or retreat: Ma Fengshi should first submit a report stating that there were still doubtful points in the accounts, that they were being investigated, and that permission was requested to defer closing the case.

“唐子韶看到这样子一个活络说法，晓得一定逃不过门，会赶紧去想法子。
“Once Tang sees a report that leaves the matter open, he will know he cannot get away and will hurry to find a solution.

如果他真的想赖掉，我们就把他的毛病和盘托出。
If he really tries to evade payment, we shall disclose every one of his irregularities.

虽没有好处，至少马大老爷也办了一趟漂亮差使。”
We may gain nothing ourselves, but at least Magistrate Ma will have carried out his commission creditably.”

“好极！
“Excellent!

就是这个办法。”周少棠说：“等下我们一起到公济典，索性同唐子韶明说：马大老爷已经定规了。
That is the way.” Zhou added, “When we go to Gongji Pawnshop together, let us tell Tang outright that Magistrate Ma has already decided.

事不宜迟，
We should lose no time.

最好你现在就去通知马大老爷。”
You had better inform him now.”


“他不在家，
“He is not at home.

到梅花碑抚台衙门‘站班’去了。”
He has gone to stand in attendance at the governor’s yamen at Meihuabei.”

原来巡抚定三、八为衙参之期，
The governor held official audiences on days ending in three or eight.

接着藩臬两司及任实缺、有差使的道员，候补的知县佐杂，都到巡抚衙门前面去“站班”，
Following the provincial treasurer, the judicial commissioner and the circuit intendants holding substantive posts or special commissions, expectant county magistrates and subordinate officials would go to stand in attendance outside the governor’s yamen.

作为致敬的表示，目的是在博得好感，加深印象。
This was a show of respect intended to win favour and strengthen the impression they made.

这是小官候补的不二法门，
For minor officials awaiting appointments, it was the surest road to advancement.

有时巡抚与司道谈论公事，有个什么差使要派人，
Sometimes, while discussing business with the senior officials, the governor would need someone for a commission.

够资格保荐的司道，想起刚刚见过某人，正堪充任，
A treasurer, commissioner or intendant entitled to recommend a candidate might remember a suitable man he had just seen.

因而获得意外机缘，亦是常有之事。
Such unexpected opportunities were by no means rare.

“你同唐子韶约的是啥辰光？”
“What time did you arrange to meet Tang?”

“还早，还早。”周少棠说：
“There is plenty of time yet,” Zhou said.

“我们先到茶店里吃一壶茶再去。”
“Let us have a pot of tea at a teashop first.”

“也不必到茶店里了。
“No need to go out.

我有好六安茶，
I have some good Lu’an tea.

泡一壶你吃。”
I shall brew you a pot.”

于是泡上六安茶，又端出两盘干点心，
Yang made the tea and brought out two plates of dry pastries.

一面吃，一面谈闲天。
They ate and chatted.

杨书办问起月如，周少棠顿时眉飞色舞，
When Yang asked about Yueru, Zhou grew animated at once.

不但毫不隐瞒，而且作了许多形容。
He concealed nothing and gave a wealth of description.


杨书办津津有味地听完，
Yang listened with relish.

不由得问道：“如果有机会，月如肯不肯同你上床？”
“If you had the chance, would Yueru be willing to go to bed with you?”

“我想一定会肯。
“I am sure she would.

其实昨天晚上，只要我胆子够大，也就上手了。”
In fact, last night I could have had her if I had been bold enough.”

“你是怕唐子韶来捉你的奸，要你写‘伏辩’？”
“You were afraid Tang would catch you in the act and make you sign a confession?”

“不借。
“Exactly.

这是我们三个人的事，
This business concerns all three of us.

我不能做这种荒唐事，连累好朋友。”
I could not do anything so foolish and drag my friends into trouble.”

“少棠，你不做见色轻友的事，
“Shaotang, you would not put a pretty woman before your friends.

足见你够朋友。”
That shows what a good friend you are.

杨书办说：“我倒问你，你到底想不想同月如困一觉？”
But tell me: do you want to sleep with Yueru or not?”

“想是想，没有机会。”
“I do, but there is no opportunity.”

“我来给你弄个机会。”
“I shall make one for you.

杨书办说：“等下，我到公济典去，绊住唐子韶的身子，
When we go to Gongji, I shall keep Tang occupied.

你一个人闯到月如楼上，
You can go straight upstairs to Yueru.

我保险不会有人来捉你们的奸。”
I guarantee that no one will catch you together.”

“不必，不必！”
“No need, no need!”

周少棠心想，即令能这样顺利地真个消魂，也要顾虑到落一个话柄在杨书办手里。
Even if he could enjoy himself so easily, Zhou reflected, he would still have to consider the hold this would give Yang over him.

这种傻事决不能做，
He must never do anything so foolish.

所以又加一句：“多谢盛情。不过我的胆还不够大，
He therefore added, “Thank you for your kindness, but I am still not brave enough.

谢谢，谢谢。”
Thank you, all the same.”

杨书办倒是有心想助他成其好事，
Yang had genuinely meant to help him attain his desire.

看他态度如此坚决，也就不便再说。
Seeing him so determined, however, he could hardly press the matter.

只是付之一笑。
He merely smiled.


“不过，你倒提醒我了，
“You have reminded me of something, though.

我还是可以到月如那里去一趟，问问你提出来的那句话。”
I could still call on Yueru and ask her that question you raised.”

“这样说，仍旧我一个人到公济？”
“Then I am to go to Gongji alone?”

“不错，
“Yes.

你先去，
You go ahead.

我问完了话，随后就来。”
I shall follow as soon as I have asked her.”

“那么，”杨书办问：“我在唐子韶面前，要不要说破？”
“Should I tell Tang about it?” Yang asked.

“不必，
“No need.

你只说我随后就到便是。”
Just say I shall be along shortly.”

近午时分，两人到了公济典旁边的那条巷子，暂且分手。
Towards noon they reached the lane beside Gongji Pawnshop and parted for the moment.

周少棠来到唐家举手敲门，
Zhou went to Tang’s house and knocked.

好久没有回音，只好快快回身，
After a long wait without an answer, he turned away in disappointment.

哪知一转身便发现月如冉冉而来，后面跟着她家的丫头，手里挽个菜篮，
As he did so, he saw Yueru approaching at an unhurried pace, her maid behind her with a market basket on her arm.

主婢俩是刚从小菜场回来。
Mistress and maid had just returned from buying food.

“碰得巧！”周少棠说：
“What good timing!” Zhou said.

“如果你迟一步，或者我早来一步，就会不到面。”
“A moment later for you, or a moment earlier for me, and we should have missed each other.”

“周老爷，你也来得巧，
“You have come at just the right time too, Mr Zhou.

今天难得买得新鲜菌子，
I was lucky enough to find fresh mushrooms today.

你在我那里吃了中饭走。”
Stay for lunch.”

“不，不！
“No, no!

杨书办在公济等我。”
Clerk Yang is waiting for me at Gongji.”

“那就请杨书办一起来。”
“Then invite him too.”

“等一息再说。
“We shall see in a moment.

阿嫂，我先到你这里坐一坐，
Sister-in-Law, let me sit with you first.

我有句话想问你。”
There is something I want to ask.”

其实丫头已经去开了大门，
The maid had already opened the door.

进门就在客堂里坐。
They went in and sat in the reception room.

月如请他上楼，周少棠辞谢了，
Yueru invited him upstairs, but he declined.

因为他不想多作逗留，只说两句话就要告辞，觉得不必累人家费事。
He meant to stay only long enough for a few words and felt there was no need to put her to any trouble.


“阿嫂，我想请问你，你昨天说卖西湖田，老唐不便出面。
“Sister-in-Law, yesterday you said Old Tang could not appear in person to sell the West Lake fields.

这是啥讲究？”
Why is that?”

不想问的是这句话，
Yueru had not expected this question.

月如顿时一愣，同时也提醒她想起一件事，更加不安。
She was taken aback, and it also reminded her of something else, making her still more uneasy.

看在周少棠眼里，颇有异样的感觉，尽头不由得疑云大起。
Zhou sensed something strange in her reaction, and suspicions began to cloud his mind.

“周老爷，你请坐一坐，
“Please sit for a moment, Mr Zhou.

我是突然之间想起有句话要先交代。”接着便喊：“阿翠，
I have suddenly remembered an instruction I must give first.” She called, “A’cui!

阿翠，
A’cui!

你在做啥？
What are you doing?

客人来了也不泡茶。”
We have a guest, and you have not even made tea.”

“我在厨房里，烧开水。”阿翠高声答应着，走了出来。
“I am in the kitchen boiling water,” A’cui answered loudly, coming out.

“你到桥边去关照一声，家里有客人，
“Go to the bridge and tell him we have a guest.

要他下半天再来。”
Ask him to come this afternoon instead.”

阿翠发愣，
A’cui stared blankly.

一时想不起到“桥边”要关照什么人。
For the moment she could not think whom she was to inform at the bridge.

“去啊！”
“Go on!”

“去，去，”阿翠嗫嚅着问：
“Yes, yes,” she faltered.

“去同哪个说？”
“Whom am I to tell?”

“不是我们刚刚去过？叫他们老板马上来？”
“Did we not just go there and ask the owner to come at once?”

“喔，喔！”
“Oh, yes!

阿翠想起来了，“木器店、木器店。”
The furniture shop, the furniture shop.”

说着，转身而去。
She turned and left.

“真笨！”月如咕哝着，
“What a fool!” Yueru muttered.

转身说道，“对不起，对不起！周老爷，
Turning back, she said, “Forgive me, Mr Zhou.

你刚才要问我的那句话，我没有听清楚。”
I did not quite catch your question.”


“老唐卖田，为啥不便出面。”
“Why can Old Tang not show himself when selling the land?”

月如原来是因为唐子韶突然要卖田，风声传出去，惹人猜疑，
Yueru’s real reason was that a sudden sale by Tang would start rumours and suspicions.

莫非他要离开杭州了，
Was he leaving Hangzhou?

是不是回安徽老家？
Was he returning to his old home in Anhui?

这一来会影响他们开溜的计划，所以不便出面。
Such talk would interfere with their plans to slip away, which was why he could not appear himself.

如今的回答，当然改过了。
Naturally, she now gave a different answer.

“公济典一查封，我们老爷有亏空，大概总有人晓得，
“Since Gongji has been taken into official custody, some people probably know that our master has a shortfall in his accounts.

不晓得也会问，为啥卖田。
Even those who do not will ask why he is selling land.

如果晓得卖田是为亏空，就一定会杀价，
Once they learn that he needs the money to make good a deficit, they are bound to force down the price.

所以他是不出面的好。”
It is better for him to keep out of sight.”

理由很充分，语气亦从容，
The reason was persuasive, and her tone composed.

周少棠疑虑尽释，
Zhou’s suspicions vanished.

“到底阿嫂细心。”
“You really do think of everything, Sister-in-Law.”

他站起身来：
He stood up.

“我就是这句话，
“That was all I wanted to ask.

问清楚了要走了。”
Now I understand, I must go.”

出了唐家往公济典，走不多远，迎面遇见阿翠，甩着一条长辫子，一扭一扭地走了过来，
He had not gone far towards Gongji when he met A’cui coming back, her long plait swinging as she walked with a sway.

“周老爷，”她开口招呼：“要回去了。”
“Going home, Mr Zhou?” she greeted him.

“不，我到公济典去。”
“No, I am going to Gongji.”

“喏，”
“Look.”

阿翠回身一指，
She turned and pointed.

“这里一直过去，过一座小桥，就是公济典后门。”
“Straight along here, over a little bridge, and you are at Gongji’s back entrance.”

周少棠本来要先出巷子上了大街从公济典前门入内，
Zhou had intended to leave the lane, reach the main street and enter by the front.

现在既有捷径可通后门，落得省点气力，
A shortcut to the rear would save him some effort.

“谢谢你。”他含笑致谢：
“Thank you,” he said with a smile.

“原来还有后门。”
“So there is a back entrance too.”

“走后门要省好多路。”阿翠又加一句客气话：“周老爷有空常常来。”
“It saves a good deal of walking.” She added politely, “Do come and see us often, Mr Zhou, whenever you have time.”


见她如此殷勤，周少棠想起一件事，
Her attentiveness reminded Zhou of something.

昨夜在唐家作客，照便应该开发赏钱，
As a guest at Tang’s house the previous night, he should have given the servants a tip.

因而唤住她说：“ 阿翠你等等。”说着，
“A’cui, wait a moment,” he called.

探手入怀，皮袍子口袋中，有好几块碎银子，摸了适中的一块，约莫三四钱重，
Reaching inside his fur-lined robe, he felt among several pieces of silver in a pocket and chose one of a suitable size, weighing perhaps three or four tenths of a tael.

递向阿翠。
He held it out.

“周老爷，这作啥？”
“What is this for, Mr Zhou?”

“这个给你。
“For you.

昨天我走的时候忘记掉了。”
I forgot when I left yesterday.”

“不要，不要。”
“No, no!”

“不许说不要。”
“You must not refuse.”

周少棠故意板一板脸：
He put on a stern face.

“没规矩。”
“That would be bad manners.”

于是阿翠笑着道了谢，高高兴兴地甩着辫子回去。
A’cui smiled, thanked him and went happily on her way, swinging her plait.

周少棠便照她的指点，一直往前走，
Zhou followed her directions.

果然看到一座小石桥，
Sure enough, he came to a little stone bridge.

桥边一家旧货店，旧木器都堆到路上来了。
Beside it stood a second-hand shop, with old wooden furniture piled out into the roadway.

周少棠心中一动，
Something struck him.

站住脚细看了一会，并没有发现什么木器店。
He stopped and looked carefully around but could see no furniture shop.

不由得奇怪，莫非月如所说的木器店，即是指这家旧货店？
Could Yueru have meant this second-hand dealer?

这样想着，便上前问讯：
He went over to ask.

“老板，请问这里有家木器店在哪里？”
“Excuse me, where is the furniture shop around here?”

“不晓得。”旧货店老板诧异，
“I have no idea,” the dealer answered in surprise.

“从没有听说过这里有家木器店。
“I have never heard of one.

哪个跟你说的？
Who told you that?

骗你来‘撞木钟’。”
Someone is sending you on a fool’s errand.”

“是……”
“It was…”

周少棠疑云大起，决意弄个水落石出，
Suspicion rose again, and Zhou resolved to get to the bottom of it.

“只怕我听错了，
“Perhaps I heard wrongly.

公济典唐朝奉家说这里有家木器店，要同你买木器。”
At Master Tang’s house—the pawnbroker from Gongji—they said there was a furniture shop here and they wanted to buy some furniture from you.”

“你不是听错了，就是弄错了。
“Either you heard wrongly or you have got it wrong.

不是买木器，是要卖木器，
They want to sell furniture, not buy it.

叫我去看货估价。
They asked me to look it over and give them a price.”

““她为啥要……”
“Why does she want to…”

周少棠突然将话顿住了，
Zhou broke off.

闲事已经管得太多了，
He had meddled quite enough already.

再问下去，会惹人猜疑，
More questions would arouse suspicion.

因而笑一笑，说一声：“是我弄错了。”扬长而去。
He smiled, said, “My mistake,” and strode away.


到了公济典，只见唐子韶的神气很难看，是懊恼与忧虑交杂的神情。
At Gongji he found Tang looking very unhappy, with an expression compounded of vexation and anxiety.

可想而知，杨书办已将他们所决定的处置告诉他了。
Clearly Yang had told him what they had decided to do.

不过，看到周少棠，他仍旧摆出一副尊敬而亲热的神情，迎上前来，握着周少棠的手说，
Nevertheless, Tang greeted Zhou with a show of warmth and respect, coming forward to clasp his hand.

“老大哥，你无论如何要帮我一个忙。”
“My dear elder brother, you must help me, whatever happens.”

“啥事情？”周少棠装做不知，一面问，一面坐了下来，
“What is it?” Zhou asked, pretending ignorance as he sat down.

顺便跟杨书办交换了一个眼色，相戒谨慎。
He exchanged a glance with Yang, warning him to be cautious.

“老杨告诉我，马大老爷预备报公事，说我帐目不清。”
“Old Yang tells me Magistrate Ma intends to submit a report saying my accounts are not clear.”

唐子韶的话说得很急：
Tang spoke urgently.

“公事上怎么好这样说？”
“How can he put that in an official report?”

“这也无所谓，
“What does it matter?

你把帐目弄清楚，不就没事了吗？”
Put the accounts in order, and that will be the end of it.”

“话不是这样说，
“That is not how it works.

好比落了一个脚印在那里。
It is like leaving a footprint.

有这件案底在衙门里，我以后做人做事就难了。”
With such a record against me at the yamen, it will be difficult for me to do anything or hold up my head afterwards.”

“那么，你想怎么样呢？”
“Then what do you want?”

“咦！”唐子韶手指着说：“周先生，
“Why, Mr Zhou!” Tang pointed at him.

你不是答应我的，请马大老爷暂时把公事压一压？”
“Did you not promise to ask Magistrate Ma to hold the matter back for a while?”

“压也不过是一天半天的事。”杨书办插了一句嘴。
“Only for a day or half a day,” Yang put in.

“一两天哪里来得及？”
“What can I do in a day or two?

唐子韶说：“现在银根又紧。”
Money is so tight now.”

“好了，我晓得了。”周少棠说：
“All right, I understand,” Zhou said.

“老唐，外头做事，一定要上路，
“Old Tang, a man doing business must know how to behave.

不上路，人家要帮忙也无从帮起。
If you do not, others cannot help you even if they wish to.

这样子，你尽快去想办法，我同老杨替你到马大老爷那里讨个情，
Let us do this: find a way as quickly as you can, while Old Yang and I plead with Magistrate Ma for you.

今天晚上再同你碰头。”
We shall meet again this evening.”

说完，他已经站了起来，准备离去。“
He had already risen to leave.


“不忙，不忙！”唐子韶急忙说道：
“No hurry, no hurry!” Tang said hastily.

“我已经叫人去叫菜了，
“I have sent someone to order dishes.

吃了饭再走。”
Have lunch before you go.”

“饭不吃了。”
“We shall not stay for lunch.”

周少棠灵机一动，故意吓他一吓，
A sudden idea occurred to Zhou, and he deliberately gave Tang a fright.

“说实话，我们到你这里来，已经有人在钉梢了，
“To tell the truth, someone has been watching us since we came here.

还是早点走的好。”
We had better leave at once.”

这一下，不但唐子韶吃惊，也吓了杨书办，脸上变色，
This alarmed not only Tang but Yang, whose face changed colour.

悄悄问道：“是哪里的人？
“Whose men?” he asked quietly.

在哪里？”
“Where are they?”

“杭州府的人，
“Men from the Hangzhou prefecture.

你出去就看到了。”
You will see when you go out.”

说着，往外就走，杨书办紧紧跟在后面。
Zhou started for the door, with Yang close behind.

“两位慢慢！”
“Wait a moment, both of you!”

唐子韶追上来问：
Tang hurried after them.

“晚上怎么样碰头？”
“How shall we meet this evening?”

“我会来看你。”
“I shall come to see you.”

“好，
“Very well.

恭候大驾。”
I shall await your visit.”

于是周少棠领头扬长而去，
Zhou strode out in front.

出了公济典，不断回头看，
Once outside Gongji, he kept looking back.

杨书办神色紧张地问：“人在哪里？”
Yang asked anxiously, “Where are they?”

周少棠“噗哧”一声笑了出来，
Zhou burst out laughing.

“对不起，对不起，
“Forgive me!

害得你都受惊了。”
I have even frightened you.

他说：“我们到城隍山去吃油蓑饼，
Let us go up City God Hill for yousuobing cakes.

我详详细细告诉你。”
I shall tell you everything.”


上了城隍山，在药师间壁的酒店落座，
They climbed City God Hill and sat down in the tavern next to Yaoshi.

老板姓陈，是周少棠的熟人，也认识杨书办，
Its owner, surnamed Chen, knew Zhou well and also knew Yang.

亲自从帐桌上起身来招待。
He rose from his account desk to attend to them himself.

“这么冷的天气，两位倒有兴致上城隍山？
“What brings you up City God Hill in such cold weather?

难得、难得。”
A rare pleasure!

陈老板问：“要吃点啥？”
What would you like?”

“特为来吃油蓑饼。”
“We came especially for yousuobing.

周少棠说：“菜随便，酒要好。”
Any dishes will do, but the wine must be good,” Zhou said.

“有一坛好花雕，卖得差不多了，
“I have a jar of fine Huadiao, almost all sold.

还剩下来三斤，
Three jin remain.

够不够？”
Will that be enough?”

“中午少吃点，
“We shall drink less at noon.

够了。”
That will do.”

“我上回吃过的‘一鸡四吃’，味道不错，”杨书办说：
“Last time I had your ‘one chicken, four ways,’ and it was excellent,” Yang said.

“照样再来一回。
“Let us have it again.

鸡要肥。”
Make sure the chicken is fat.”

“杨先生放心好了。”
“Leave it to me, Mr Yang.”

于是烫上酒来，先用现成的小菜、发芽豆、茶油鱼干这类下酒。
The wine was heated, and they began with ready-made small dishes: sprouted beans, dried fish in tea-seed oil and the like.

这时周少棠告诉杨书办，根本没有人钉梢，
Zhou now told Yang that nobody had been watching them.

只是故意吓一吓唐子韶而已。
He had merely meant to frighten Tang.


“不过，有件事很奇怪，
“There is something very strange, though.

月如不晓得在搞啥花样。”
I cannot make out what Yueru is up to.”

等周少棠细说了他发现唐家要卖木器的经过，杨书办立刻下了一个判断：
Once Zhou had described his discovery that the Tangs meant to sell their furniture, Yang reached an immediate conclusion.

“唐子韶要带了他的小老婆，逃之夭夭了。”
“Tang is going to take his concubine and run away.”

周少棠也是如此看法，
Zhou thought so too.

“逃到哪里呢？”他问：
“Where would he go?

“不会逃到徽州吧？”
Surely not back to Huizhou?”

“逃回徽州，还是可以抓回来的。
“If he fled to Huizhou, they could still bring him back.

只有逃到上海，
His only chance is Shanghai.

在租界里躲了起来，只要他自己小心，不容易抓到。”
If he hides in the foreign settlements and takes care, he will not be easy to catch.

杨书办又说：“我看他用的缓兵之计，
I think he is playing for time.

卖田最快也要十天半个月，
Selling land takes ten days or half a month at the very least.

要开溜，时间上足足够用。”
That would give him more than enough time to slip away.”

“嗯，嗯。
“Yes, yes.

那么，我们应该怎么办呢？”
Then what should we do?”

杨书办亦无善策，
Yang had no good answer either.

默默地喝了一会酒，
They drank in silence for a while.

突然之间，将酒杯放下，双手靠在桌上，身上前倾，
Suddenly he set down his cup, rested both hands on the table and leaned forward.

低声说道：“我同你说实话，
In a low voice he said, “I shall be honest with you.

你刚刚开玩笑，说有人‘钉梢’，我当时心里心上八下，难过极了。
When you joked just now about someone watching us, I was in a terrible state.

俗语说得，‘日里不做亏心事，夜半敲门心不惊’。
As the saying goes, do nothing shameful by day and you need not fear a knock at midnight.

发横财也要命的，
A windfall can cost a man his life.

强求不来。
You cannot force it.

这件事，我们作成马大老爷立一场功劳，
Let us give Magistrate Ma a chance to earn some credit.

关照他据实呈报；
Tell him to report the facts.

唐子韶自作自受，不必可惜。
Tang has brought this on himself; we need not pity him.

你看如何？”
What do you say?”

周少棠想了一下，点点头：
Zhou considered, then nodded.

“我同意。
“I agree.

不过数目要打个折扣。”
But the amount must be reduced.”

“为啥？”
“Why?”

“咦！我不是同你讲过，
“Did I not tell you?

胡大先生要报月如的情，
Mr Hu wants to repay Yueru’s kindness.

我们原来预备分给他一份，他不要，
We had meant to give him a share, but he does not want it.

算是送月如。
He is making it a present to Yueru.

所以唐子韶作弊的数目不能实报。”
So we cannot report the full amount Tang has embezzled.”


这段话中的“胡大先生”四字，不知怎么让陈老板听到了，
Somehow the words “Mr Hu” reached Chen’s ears.

便踱过来打听他的消息，少不得嗟叹惋惜一番。
He strolled over to ask for news, and naturally there were sighs and expressions of regret.

周少棠他们的座位临窗，窗子是碎锦格子糊上白纸，中间嵌一方玻璃，
Zhou and Yang sat beside a window of intricate latticework covered in white paper, with a square of glass set into the middle.

望出去一株华盖亭亭的不凋松，
Through it they could see an evergreen pine, its lofty crown spreading like a canopy.

春秋佳日，树下便是极好的茶座，
On fine days in spring and autumn, the space beneath it made an excellent place for tea.

陈老板指着说道：
Chen pointed.

“那株松树下面，就是胡大先生同王抚台第一次来吃茶、吃酒的地方。
“Under that pine is where Mr Hu and Governor Wang sat the first time they came for tea and wine.

王抚台有一回来过，还特为提起，
Governor Wang mentioned it particularly on a later visit.

这句话十七八年了。”
That was seventeen or eighteen years ago.”

“王抚台如果晓得胡大先生会有今天这种下场，只怕他死不瞑目。”杨书办感慨不止，
“If Governor Wang knew how Mr Hu would end, I doubt he could rest in his grave,” Yang said with deep feeling.

“这样子轰轰烈烈的事业，说败就败，
“Such a magnificent enterprise, gone just like that!

真同年大将军一样。”
Exactly like General Nian.”

“比年大将军总要好得多。”周少棠说：
“Still, he is much better off than General Nian,” Zhou said.

“至少，性命之忧是不会有的。”
“At least his life is not in danger.”

陈老板接口说道：“就算没有性命之忧，活得也没意思了。”
“Even if his life is safe,” Chen added, “what pleasure can there be left in living?”

“是啊！”
“True.”

杨书办深深点头：
Yang nodded gravely.

“爬得高，跌得重，
“The higher you climb, the harder you fall.

还是看开点好。”
Better to take things less to heart.”


就这样一直在谈胡雪岩，直到酒醉饭饱，
They went on talking about Hu until they had eaten and drunk their fill.

相偕下山，周少棠方又提到唐子韶，
Only as they walked down the hill together did Zhou return to Tang.

“我答应过他，只算两万四千银子。”
“I promised him we would count only twenty-four thousand taels.

他说：“你同马大老爷去说，要报就报这个数目好了。”
Tell Magistrate Ma that if he submits a report, that is the figure he should use.”

“好的。”杨书办说：
“Very well,” Yang said.

“不过，你应该同胡大先生去说说清楚，
“But you ought to explain it all to Mr Hu.

现在是照他的意思，看在唐子韶小老婆分上，特为少报。
We are reducing the amount out of consideration for Tang’s concubine, just as he wished.

我们三个人是随公事。
The three of us are simply following official procedure.

不然，他只以为我们从中弄了多少好处，
Otherwise he may think we have made a fortune out of it.

岂不冤枉。”他又加了一句：“这句话请你一定要说到。”
That would be unfair to us.” He added, “Please be sure to tell him that.”

由于杨书办的态度很认真，周少棠决走到元宝街去一趟。
Yang spoke so earnestly that Zhou decided to visit Yuanbao Street.

胡雪岩已经不会客了，但对周少棠的情分不同，
Hu was no longer receiving visitors, but his affection for Zhou was different.

仍旧将他请了进去，动问来意。
He had him shown in and asked what had brought him.

“你说的那匹‘瘦马’我见过了，
“I have seen that ‘slender horse’ you spoke of.

亦就是见一见，没有别的花样。”周少棠说：
Only seen her—nothing more,” Zhou said.

“他亏空至少有八万银子，
“Tang’s deficit comes to at least eighty thousand taels.

照你的意思，打了他一个三折，
In accordance with your wishes, we have cut it to thirty per cent.

公事一报上去，当然要追。
Once the report goes in, they will of course have to recover it.

追出来抵还你的官款，
Whatever they collect can go towards repaying the government money you owe.

也不无小补。”
It will be of some help.”


一听这话，胡雪岩的眼圈发红，
Hu’s eyes reddened.

“少棠，”他说：“有你这句话就够了。
“Shaotang, those words alone are enough.

从出事到现在，再好的朋友，都是同我来算帐的，
Since my troubles began, even my closest friends have come to settle accounts with me.

顶多说是打个折扣，少还一点，
At most they offer to knock something off and let me repay a little less.

没有人说一句，我介绍来的那笔存款，不要紧，
Not one has said, ‘Never mind that deposit I brought you.

摆在那里再说，
Leave it there for now.’

帮我去弄钱来的，可以说没有。
As for helping me raise money, you could say there has been nobody.

其中只有两个人，一个是古应春，帮我凑了二三十万银子，应付上海的风潮；再一个是你。
Only two exceptions: Gu Yingchun, who helped scrape together two or three hundred thousand taels to meet the panic in Shanghai, and you.

古应春受过我的好处，大家原是有往来的，
Gu has benefited from me; we have always helped one another.

象你，该当凭你本事弄来的外款不要，移过来替我补亏空，
But you are giving up money you could rightfully earn by your own abilities and diverting it to make good my deficit.

虽说杯水车薪，无济于事，
A cup of water on a cartload of burning wood, perhaps—too little to save anything.

不过，我看来这两万四千银子，比什么都贵重。
Yet to me these twenty-four thousand taels are more precious than anything else.”

““大先生，你不要这样说。
“Mr Hu, you must not put it that way.

从前我也受过你的好处。”
I too benefited from you in the old days.”

周少棠又说：“今天中午，我们在城隍山吃油蓑饼，还提起你同王抚台的交情，
Zhou went on, “At noon today we were having yousuobing on City God Hill and spoke of your friendship with Governor Wang.

只怕他听得你有这一场风波，在阴司里都不安心。”
If he heard of this disaster, I doubt he could be at peace even in the other world.”

提到玉有龄，枨触前尘，怀念故友，
The mention of Wang Youling brought back the past and his lost friend.

胡雪岩越发心里酸酸地想哭，
Hu felt still more painfully close to tears.

“真正是一场大梦！”他说：
“It has all been one great dream,” he said.

“梦终归是梦，
“A dream is a dream.

到底是要醒的。”
In the end one has to wake.”

“一个人能够象你做这样一场梦，古往今来，只怕也不过数得出来的几个人。”
“From ancient times to the present, there can have been only a handful of men who ever dreamed a dream like yours.”


这话使得胡雪岩颇受鼓舞，
These words encouraged Hu.

忽然想到他从未想过的身后之名，
Suddenly he thought of something that had never occurred to him before: his reputation after death.

“不晓得将来说书的人，会不会说我？”
“I wonder whether storytellers will tell of me one day.

他问：“说我又是怎样子地说，
And if they do, what will they say?

是骂我自作孽，还是运气不好？”
That I brought ruin upon myself, or that my luck failed?”

“说是一定会说的，
“They certainly will tell your story.

好比年大将军一样，哪个不晓得？”
Just like General Nian—who has not heard of him?”

这使得胡雪岩想起年大将军赠妾的故事，
This reminded Hu of the story of General Nian giving away a concubine.

心中一动，
An idea stirred in him.

便笑一笑说：
He smiled.

“我哪里比得上年大将军？
“How could I compare with General Nian?

不讲这些了。老弟兄聊聊家常。
Let us leave that aside and talk of family matters, as old friends should.

少棠，你今年贵庚？”
Shaotang, how old are you this year?”

“我属老虎，
“I was born in the Year of the Tiger.

今年五十四。”
Fifty-four.”

“嫂夫人呢？”
“And your wife?”

“她属羊，”比我小五岁。
“The Year of the Sheep, five years younger.

“周少棠说：”照道理，羊落虎口，我应该克她，
In theory, with a sheep in a tiger’s jaws, my influence ought to harm her.

哪晓得她的身子比我还健旺。
Yet her health is even better than mine.”

““你也一点都不象五十几岁的人。”
“You do not look in your fifties at all.

胡雪岩说：“嫂夫人我还是年纪轻的时候见过。
I last saw your wife when we were young.

那时候，我看你就有点怕她。
I thought you were a little afraid of her then.

现在呢？”
What about now?”

“都一把年纪了，谈啥哪个怕哪个？
“At our age, what does it matter who fears whom?

而况……”
Besides…”

“怎么不说下去？”胡雪岩问。
“Why stop there?” Hu asked.

这是因为说到周少棠伤心之处了，不愿多谈，
Zhou had reached a painful subject and did not wish to speak of it.

摇摇头说：
He shook his head.

“没有啥。”
“It is nothing.”


“一定有缘故。
“There must be a reason.

少棠，你有啥苦衷，何妨同我讲一讲。”
Shaotang, if something is troubling you, why not tell me?”

“不是有啥苦衷。”
“It is not that.

周少棠说：“我们的独养儿子……”
Our only son…”

周少棠的独子，这年正好三十，
Zhou’s only son had been thirty that year.

在上海一家洋行中做事，颇得“大板”‘的器重，
He worked for a foreign firm in Shanghai and was highly valued by its chief.

当此海禁大开，洋务发达之时，可说前程如锦。
With maritime restrictions lifted and foreign business flourishing, his prospects had seemed splendid.

哪知这年二月间，一场春瘟，竟尔不治。
Then, in the second month, a spring epidemic had carried him off.

周太太哭得死去活来。
Mrs Zhou had been beside herself with grief.

周少棠本来要说的一句话是：“而况少年夫妻老来伴，
What Zhou had begun to say was, “Besides, a young husband and wife become companions in old age.

独养儿子死掉了，我同她真正叫相依为命。”
With our only son dead, she and I truly have no one but each other.”

原来是提到了这段伤心之事，所以说不下去。
It was this painful memory that had stopped him.

胡雪岩便问：“你儿子娶亲了没有呢？”
“Had your son married?” Hu asked.

“没有。”
“No.”

“怎么三十岁还不成家？”
“Why was he still unmarried at thirty?”

“那是因为他学洋派，
“He had taken to foreign ways.

说洋人都是这样的，三十岁才成家。
He said foreigners did not marry until thirty.

他又想跟他们老板到外国去学点本事，
He also wanted to go abroad with his employer and learn something useful.

成了家不方便，所以耽误下来的。
Marriage would have made that inconvenient, so he kept putting it off.

如今是连孙子都耽误了。“
Now that delay has cost us even a grandson.”


“是啊！
“Yes.

不孝有三，无后为大。”胡雪岩说：
Of the three offences against filial duty, leaving no heir is the worst,” Hu said.

“嫂夫人倒没有劝你讨个小？”
“Has your wife not urged you to take a concubine?”

“提过。
“She has.

我同她说……”
I told her…”

周少棠突然顿住，
Zhou stopped abruptly.

因为他原来的话是：“算了，算了，
What he had actually said was, “Forget it.

‘若要家不和，讨个小老婆’。”
If you want discord at home, take a concubine.”

话到嘴边，想起忌讳：
As the words reached his lips, he remembered how offensive they might be.

第一，螺蛳太太就是“小老婆”；
First, Madam Luosi was herself a concubine.

第二，胡雪岩家“十二金钗”，
Second, Hu’s household had its “Twelve Beauties.”

“小老婆”太多，或许就是落到今天这个下场的原因。
Perhaps having so many concubines was part of what had brought him to his present plight.

总之，令人刺心的话，决不可说。
In any event, words that would wound him must not be spoken.

于是他改口说道：
Zhou changed his answer.

“内人虽有这番好意，无奈一时没有合便宜的人，
“My wife meant it kindly, but I could not find a suitable woman just then.

只好敬谢不敏了。”
I could only decline with thanks.”

“这倒是实话，
“That is true enough.

要有合适的人，是顶要紧的一桩。
Finding the right woman is the most important thing.

‘若要家不合，讨个小老婆’，
‘If you want discord at home, take a concubine.’

大家总以为指大太太吃醋，
People always assume this means the principal wife grows jealous.

其实不然！
It need not be so at all!

讨小讨得不好，看大太太老实好欺侮，
Choose badly, and the concubine sees a quiet principal wife whom she can bully.

自己恃宠而骄，要爬到大太太头上。
Spoiled by her husband’s favour, she tries to climb over the wife’s head.

那一来大太太再贤惠，还是要吵架。”
Then there will be quarrels, however virtuous the wife may be.”

周少棠没有想到自己认为触犯忌讳的那句俗语，倒是胡雪岩自己说了出来。
Zhou had not expected Hu himself to quote the very saying he had thought too delicate to mention.

不过他的话也很有道理，
Yet there was much truth in his words.

螺蛳太太固然是个现成的例子；古应春纳妾的经过，他也知道。
Madam Luosi was a ready example; Zhou also knew what had happened when Gu Yingchun took a concubine.

都可以为他的话作注脚。
Both experiences could serve as footnotes to Hu’s argument.



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第八章（下，至本章结束）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Eight, Part Two (conclusion)
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


“少棠，你我相交一场，
“Shaotang, we have been friends for so long.

我有力量帮你的时候，没有帮你什么……”
When I had the means to help you, I did very little…”

“不，不！”周少棠插嘴拦住，
“No, no!” Zhou interrupted.

“你不要说这话，
“Do not say that.

你帮我的忙，够多了。”
You have helped me more than enough.”

“好！
“Very well.

我现在还要帮你一个忙，替你好好儿物色一个人。”“大先生！”周少棠笑道：
Now I want to do you another service and find a suitable woman for you.” Zhou laughed. “Mr Hu!

“你现在倒还有闲工夫来管这种闲事？”
At a time like this, you still have leisure to concern yourself with such trifles?”

“正事轮不到我管，
“My serious affairs are no longer mine to manage.

有刘抚台、德藩台替我操心，
Governor Liu and Treasurer De worry about them for me.

我就只好管闲事了。”
I can only occupy myself with trifles.”

满腹牢骚，出以自我调侃的语气，正见得他的万般无奈。
His self-mocking tone, beneath which lay so much resentment, revealed his utter helplessness.

周少棠不免兴起一种英雄末路的苍凉之感。
Zhou felt the desolation of a hero brought to the end of his road.

再谈下去，说不定会掉眼泪，
If they talked much longer, he might weep.

因而起身告辞。
He therefore rose to take his leave.

胡雪岩握着他的手臂，仿佛有话要说，
Hu grasped his arm as though he had something to say.

却两次欲言又止，
Twice he almost spoke, then stopped.

终于松开了手说：
At last he released his hold.

“再谈吧！”
“We shall talk again.”


半夜里叩中门，送进来一封信，说是藩台衙门的专差送来的。
At midnight there was a knock at the inner gate, and a letter was brought in, delivered by a special messenger from the provincial treasurer's yamen.

螺蛳太太将胡雪岩唤醒了，拿一盏水晶玻璃罩的“洋灯”，让他看信。
Madam Luosi woke Hu and held a Western lamp with a crystal-glass shade for him to read it.

看不到几行，胡雪岩将信搁下，开口说道：
Before he had gone through more than a few lines, he put it down.

“我要起来。”
“I must get up.”

于是螺蛳太太叫起丫头，点起灯火，拨旺炭盆，服侍胡雪岩起身，
She roused the maids, had the lights lit and the brazier stirred, and helped him dress.

他将德馨的信，置在桌上细看。
He laid Dexin's letter on the table for closer examination.

一张八行笺以外，另有一个抄件，字迹较小，需要戴老花眼镜，才看得清楚。
Besides the sheet of eight-column stationery, there was a copy of another document, written so small that he needed his reading spectacles.


抄件是一道上谕：“谕内阁：
It was an imperial edict: “To the Grand Secretariat.

给事中郎承修奏请，责令贪吏罚捐巨款，以济要需一折，
Supervising Censor Deng Chengxiu has memorialized, requesting that corrupt officials be ordered to make substantial compulsory contributions to meet urgent needs.

据称该给事中所开赃私最著者，如已故总督瑞麟、学政何廷谦、前任粤海关监督崇礼及俊启、学政吴宝恕、水师提督翟国彦、盐运使何兆瀛、肇难道方浚师、广州府知府冯端本、潮州府知府刘湘年、廉州府知府张丙炎、南海县知县杜凤治、顺德县知县林灼之、现任南海县知县卢乐戌，
He lists as particularly notorious for illicit gains the late Governor-General Ruilin; Education Commissioner He Tingqian; former superintendents of the Guangdong Maritime Customs, Chongli and Junqi; Education Commissioner Wu Baoshu; Naval Commander Zhai Guoyan; Salt Transport Commissioner He Zhaoying; Circuit Intendant Fang Junshi of Zhaonan; Prefect Feng Duanben of Guangzhou; Prefect Liu Xiangnian of Chaozhou; Prefect Zhang Bingyan of Lianzhou; Magistrate Du Fengzhi of Nanhai; Magistrate Lin Zhuozhi of Shunde; and the present Magistrate Lu Lexu of Nanhai.

皆自宫广东后，得有巨资，
All, he states, acquired great wealth after serving in Guangdong.

若非民膏，即是国帑等语，
Such wealth must have come either from the people's substance or from the public treasury.

着派彭玉麟将各该员在广东居官声名苦何，确切查明，据实具奏。”
Peng Yulin is hereby directed to ascertain precisely the reputations of these officials during their service in Guangdong and report the facts.”

这跟胡雪岩无关。
This did not concern Hu.


另有一个附片，就大有关系了：“另片奏：闻阜康银号关闭，协办大学士刑部尚书文煜，所存该号银数至七十余万之多，
The supplementary memorial, however, concerned him very closely: “The supplementary memorial states: ‘I hear that Fukang Bank has closed, and that Wenyu, Assistant Grand Secretary and Minister of Punishments, has more than seven hundred thousand taels deposited there.

请即查明确数，究所从来，据实参处等语，
I request an immediate investigation to ascertain the exact sum and its source, followed by a report seeking appropriate disciplinary action.’

着顺天府确查具奏。”
The Shuntian prefectural authorities are hereby ordered to investigate and report.”

接下来再看德馨的亲笔信，只有短短的两行：“事已通天，
Dexin's own letter contained only two short lines: “The affair has reached the throne.

恐尚有严旨，
Further severe orders may follow.

请速为之计。
Please make preparations without delay.

容面谈。”
We must discuss this in person.”


“你看！”
“Look!”

胡雪岩将信递了给螺蛳太太，
Hu handed the letter to Madam Luosi.

“话没有说清楚，
“He has not made himself clear.

‘容面谈’是他来，还是要我去？”
Does ‘discuss this in person’ mean he is coming here, or that I am to go to him?”

“等我来问问看。”螺蛳太太将递信进来的丫头、由镜槛阁调过来的巧珠唤了来，
“Let me find out.” She called Qiaozhu, the maid who had brought in the letter and who had been transferred from Jingjian Pavilion.

关照她到中门上传话，赶到门房去问，藩司衙门来的专差，是否还在？
Qiaozhu was to send word through the inner gate to the gatehouse and ask whether the treasurer's messenger was still there.

如果已经走了，留下什么话没有？
If he had gone, had he left any message?

这得好一陈工夫才会有回话，
It would take some time for an answer to return.

胡雪岩有点沉不住气了，
Hu could no longer sit still.

起身蹀躞，喃喃自语：“严旨，严旨！
He paced about, muttering, “Severe orders, severe orders!

是革职还是抄家？”
Dismissal from office, or confiscation of the household?”

螺蛳太太一听吓坏了，但不敢现诸形色，
Madam Luosi was terrified, but dared not show it.

只将一件大毛皮袍，一件贡缎马褂堆在椅子上，
She merely laid a heavy fur robe and a tribute-satin riding jacket on a chair.

因为不管是德馨来，还是胡雪岩去，都要换衣服，所以早早预备在那里。
Whether Dexin came to Hu or Hu went to Dexin, he would need to change, and she wanted the clothes ready.

“ ‘速为之计’，怎么‘计’法？”
“‘Make preparations without delay’—what preparations?”

胡雪岩突然住足，
Hu suddenly stopped.

“我看我应该到上海去一趟。
“I think I must go to Shanghai.”

“为啥？”
“Why?”

“至少我要把转运局的公事，弄清楚了，作个交代，
“At the very least I must put the Transport Bureau's official business in order and give a proper account.

不要牵涉到左大人，
I cannot let Lord Zuo become involved.

我就太对不起人了。”
I would never forgive myself.”

“光是为这件事，托七姐夫就可以了。”
“If that is all, you can ask Brother-in-Law Gu to do it.”

“不！
“No.

还有宓本常，
There is Mi Benchang as well.

我要当面同他碰个头，看看他把上海的帐目，清理得怎么样了。”
I must meet him face to face and see how far he has got with settling the Shanghai accounts.”

商议未定之际，只见巧珠急急来报，德馨已经微服来访。
Before they had reached a decision, Qiaozhu hurried back: Dexin had arrived in plain clothes.

胡雪岩急忙换了衣服，
Hu changed quickly.

未及下楼，已有四名丫头，持着宫灯，前引后拥地将德馨迎上楼来。
Before he could go downstairs, four maids with palace lanterns were already escorting Dexin up, some leading and others following.


胡雪岩在楼梯口迎着，作了一个揖，口中不安地说：
Hu met him at the head of the stairs and bowed.

“这样深夜，亲自劳步，真正叫我不知道怎么说了！”
“To trouble you to come in person at such an hour—I truly do not know what to say!”

“自己弟兄，
“We are brothers.

不必谈这些。”
There is no need to speak of that.”

德馨进了门，还未坐定，便即说道：“文中堂怕顶不住了。”
Dexin had scarcely entered and had not yet settled into his seat when he said, “I am afraid Lord Wen can no longer hold the line.”

“文中堂”便是文煜，现任协办大学士刑部尚书，所以称之为“中堂”。
Lord Wen was Wenyu, the current Assistant Grand Secretary and Minister of Punishments, and was therefore addressed as a grand secretary.

他是八旗中有名的殷实大户，
He was a famously wealthy man among the Eight Banners.

发财是在福州将军任上。
His fortune had been made as Fuzhou Garrison General.

海内冲要重镇，都有驻防的将军，
Garrison generals were stationed in important strategic cities throughout the empire.

位尊而权不重，亦谈不到什么入息，
Their rank was high, but their power modest, and their income generally unremarkable.

只有福州将军例外，因为兼管闽海关，
Fuzhou was the exception because its general also supervised the Fujian Maritime Customs.

五口通商以后，福州亦是洋商贸易的要地，税收激增，所以成了肥缺，
After the five treaty ports opened, Fuzhou became a major centre of foreign commerce, customs receipts rose sharply, and the appointment grew lucrative.

文煜因为是恭王的亲戚，靠山甚硬，在这个肥缺上盘踞了九年之久，
Related to Prince Gong and backed by powerful protection, Wenyu had occupied this profitable post for nine years.

及至内调进京，又几次派充崇文门监督，这也是一个日进斗金的阔差，
After his transfer to the capital, he had several times been appointed superintendent at Chongwen Gate, another office where wealth poured in by the day.

数十年宦囊所积，不下千万之多。
Over decades in office he had accumulated no less than ten million taels.

在阜康，他是第一个大存户，
At Fukang he was the largest depositor.

一方面是利害相共，休戚相关；一方面他跟胡雪岩的交情很厚，
His interests were bound up with Hu's, and their personal friendship was close.

所以从阜康出事以后，他一直在暗中支持，
Since the crisis began, he had supported Hu behind the scenes.

现在为邓承修一纸“片奏”所参，
Now Deng Chengxiu's supplementary memorial had impeached him.

纸包不住火，
The fire could no longer be wrapped in paper.

自顾不暇，当然不能再替胡雪岩去“顶”了。
Preoccupied with protecting himself, he could naturally no longer shield Hu.

“雪岩，”德馨又问：“文中堂真的有那么多款子，存在你那里？”
“Xueyan,” Dexin asked, “does Lord Wen really have so much deposited with you?”

“没有那么多。”
“Not that much.

胡雪岩答说：“细数我不清楚，大概四五十万是有的。”
I do not know the exact figure, but there must be four or five hundred thousand.”

“这也不少了。”
“That is no small sum either.”


“晓翁，”心乱如麻的胡雪岩，终于找到一句要紧话：“你看，顺天府据实奏报以后，朝廷会怎么办？”
At last Hu's confused thoughts yielded an essential question. “Mr Xiaofeng, once the Shuntian authorities have reported the facts, what do you think the court will do?”

“照定制来说，朝廷就不会听片面之词，
“Under the established procedure, the court will not listen to one side alone.

一定是要文中堂明白回奏。”
It will certainly order Lord Wen to submit a clear explanation.”

“文中堂怎么回奏呢？”
“What explanation can he give?”

“那就不知道了。”
“That I cannot say.

德馨答说：“总不会承认自己的钱，来路不明吧！”
He will hardly admit that his money comes from a dubious source.”

“他历充优差，省吃俭用，利上滚利，积成这么一个数目；
“He has held profitable posts for years, lived frugally, and let the interest accumulate.

似乎也不算多。”
A sum like that hardly seems excessive.”

“好家伙，你真是‘财神’的口吻，
“Good heavens, you really do speak like the God of Wealth!

光是钱庄存款就有四五十万，还不算多吗？”
Four or five hundred thousand in bank deposits alone, and you call it nothing excessive?”

胡雪岩无词以对，
Hu had no answer.

只是在想：文煜究竟会得到怎么一种处分？
He could think only of what punishment Wenyu might receive.

“文中堂这回怕要倒楣。”德馨说道：
“I fear Lord Wen is in for trouble,” Dexin continued.

“现在清流的气焰正盛，
“The Pure Stream group is very much in the ascendant.

朝廷为了尊重言路，只怕要拿文中堂来开刀。”
To show respect for the right of remonstrance, the court may make an example of him.”

胡雪岩一惊，
Hu started.

“怎么？”
“What?

他急急问道：“会治他的罪？”
Will he be convicted of an offence?”

“治罪是不会的。
“Not that.

只怕要罚他。”
But he may be penalized.”

“怎么罚？
“How?

罚款？”
A fine?”

“当然。
“Of course.

现在正在用兵，军需孔急，
We are at war, and military funds are urgently needed.

作兴会罚他报效饷银。
He may be ordered to contribute to the war chest as a penalty.

数目多寡就不知道了。”
I cannot say how much.”

德馨语重心长地警告：
Dexin's warning was earnest.

“雪岩，我所说的早为之计，第一步就是要把这笔款子预备好。”
“When I urged you to prepare early, Xueyan, the first thing I meant was that you must have this money ready.”

“哪笔款子？”胡雪岩茫然地问。
“Which money?” Hu asked blankly.

“文中堂的罚款啊！
“Lord Wen's fine!

只要上谕一下来，罚银多少，自然是在他的存款中提的。
Once the edict arrives, whatever sum he is required to pay will naturally be drawn from his deposit.

到那时你就变成欠官款了，而且是奉特旨所提的官款，
Then it becomes public money that you owe—and public money demanded by a special imperial order.

急如星火，
It will be as urgent as a spark in dry tinder.

想拖一拖不都不成。”
You will not be able to put it off for a moment.”


“喔！”
“Oh!”

胡雪岩心想，要还的公私款项，不下数千万，
Hu thought of the tens of millions he already owed in public and private funds.

又何在乎这一笔？
What difference could this one sum make?

但德馨的好意总是可感的，因而答说：
Still, Dexin's concern deserved gratitude.

“晓翁关爱，我很感激，
“I am very grateful for your care, Mr Xiaofeng.

这笔款子我这回一到上海，首先把它预备好，
As soon as I reach Shanghai this time, I shall make preparing this sum my first task.

上谕一到，当即呈缴。”
When the edict comes, it can be submitted at once.”

“这才是。”德馨问道：
“That is the right approach.

“你预备什么时候动身？”
When do you intend to leave?”

“明天来不及，
“I cannot manage tomorrow.

后天走。”
The day after.”

“哪天回来？”
“When will you return?”

“看事情顺手不顺手。
“That depends on how smoothly things go.

我还想到江宁去一趟，看左大人能不能帮我什么忙？”
I also want to visit Jiangning and see whether Lord Zuo can help.”

“你早就该去了。”德馨紧接着说：
“You should have gone long ago,” Dexin said at once.

“你早点动身吧！
“Leave as soon as you can.

这里反正封典当这件事正在进行，
The sequestration of the pawnshops is proceeding here.

公款也好，私款也好，大家都要看封典当清算的结果，一时不会来催。
Public and private creditors alike are waiting to see what it yields, and will not press you for the moment.

你正好趁这空档，赶紧拿丝茧脱手，
Use the interval to dispose of the silk and cocoons quickly.

‘讲倒帐’就比较容易。”
Then it will be easier to negotiate a reduced settlement.”

“讲倒帐”，便是打折扣来清偿。任何生意失败，都是如此料理。
Such a settlement meant paying debts at a discount, the usual way of dealing with a failed business.

但讲倒帐以前，先要准备好现款，
But cash had to be ready before negotiations could begin.

胡雪岩一直在等待情势比较缓和，存货就比较能卖得比较好的价钱，“讲倒帐”的折扣亦可提高。
Hu had been waiting for conditions to ease so that his stocks might fetch a better price and creditors could be offered a larger proportion of what they were owed.

但照目前的情势看，越逼越紧，
Now the pressure was tightening.

封典当以后，继以文煜这一案，接下来可能会有革职的处分，
After the seizure of the pawnshops came Wenyu's case; dismissal from office might follow.

那时候的身分，一落千丈，处事更加困难，
If Hu's standing collapsed, everything would become harder.

真如德馨所说的，亟应“速为之计”。
As Dexin said, preparations really must be made without delay.


因此，等德馨一走，胡雪岩跟螺蛳太太重作计议，
After Dexin left, Hu discussed their plans afresh with Madam Luosi.

“箭在弦上，
“The arrow is on the bowstring.

不得不发了。”他说：
It must be released,” he said.

“有句话叫做‘壮士断腕’，
“There is a saying about a brave man cutting off his wrist.

我只有自己斩掉一条膀子，
I must cut off one of my own arms.

人虽残废，性命可保。
I shall be crippled, but I shall live.

你看呢？”
What do you think?”

“都随你！”
“Whatever you decide.”

螺蛳太太噙着眼泪说：
Tears stood in her eyes.

“只要你斩膀子，
“Only cut off the arm yourself.

不叫我来动手。”
Do not ask me to do it.”

“虽不叫你来动手，只怕要你在我的刀上加一把劲，
“I shall not ask you to wield the blade, but I may need you to add your strength to mine.

不然斩不下来。
Otherwise I shall never bring myself to cut.

这一点，你一定要答应我。”
You must promise me that.”

螺蛳太太一面流泪，一面点头，然后问道：“ 这回你以上海，预备怎么办？”
Weeping, she nodded, then asked, “What do you intend to do in Shanghai this time?”

“我托应春把丝茧全部出清，款子存在汇丰银行，作为讲倒帐的准备金。
“Ask Yingchun to sell off all the silk and cocoons and put the proceeds in HSBC as a reserve for negotiating settlements.

再要到江宁去一趟。请左大人替我说说话，
Then go to Jiangning and ask Lord Zuo to speak for me.

官款即令不能打折扣，也不要追得那么紧，
Even if the public debts cannot be reduced, they need not be pressed so hard.

到底我也还有赚钱的事业，
I still have profitable businesses.

慢慢儿赚了来还，
Let them earn the money to repay gradually.

一下子都逼倒了，对公家也没有什么好处。“
Driving them all to ruin at once would do the authorities no good either.”


“怎么？”
“Do you mean…”

螺蛳太太忽有意会，定神想了一下说：
A thought struck her, and she considered it carefully.

“你是说，譬如典当，照常开门，到年底下结帐，赚了钱，拿来拉还公款，
“For example, the pawnshops would stay open, and at the year-end reckoning their profits would go towards the public debts?

等还清了，二十几家典当还是我们的？
Once those were paid, the twenty-odd pawnshops would still be ours?”

“胡雪岩失笑了，
Hu could not help laughing.

“你真是一手只如意、一只手算盘，
“You have a wish-granting sceptre in one hand and an abacus in the other!

天下世界哪里有这么好的事？”
Where could one find such a wonderful arrangement?

他说，“所谓‘慢慢儿赚了来还’，意思是赚钱的事业，先照常维持，然后再来估价抵还公款。”
By earning the money gradually, I mean keeping the profitable businesses running for the time being, then valuing them and handing them over against the public debts.”

“这有啥区别呢？
“What difference does that make?

迟早一场空。”
Sooner or later, everything is gone.”

螺蛳太太大失所望，声音非常凄凉。
Her disappointment sounded desolate.

“虽然迟早一场空，还是有区别的。
“There is a difference, even if everything must go in the end.

譬如说：这家典当的架本是二十万两，
Suppose a pawnshop has capital of two hundred thousand taels.

典当照常营业，当头有人来赎，可以照二十万两算；
If it continues trading and customers come to redeem their pledges, it can be valued at two hundred thousand.

倘或关门不做生意了，当头只好照流当价来估价，
If it closes, the pledges have to be valued at the prices they would fetch as unredeemed goods.

三文不值两文，
What should be worth three cash may not fetch two.

决不能算二十万两，不足之数，仍旧要我们来赔，
The shop certainly cannot be counted at two hundred thousand, and we must still make up the shortfall.

这当中出入很大。
That is a considerable difference.

这样子一说，你明白了吧？”
Do you understand now?”

“明白是明白。
“I understand.

不过，”螺蛳太太问道：“能不能留下一点来？”
But can we keep a little for ourselves?”

“那要看将来。
“That depends on what happens.

至少也要等我上海回来才晓得，
We shall know no sooner than my return from Shanghai.

现在言之过早。”
It is too early to say.”


螺蛳太太前前后后想了一遍，问出一番极紧要的话来：
Having considered everything, Madam Luosi asked a crucial question.

“从十月底到今天，二十天的工夫，
“From the end of the tenth month until today, it has been twenty days.

虽然天翻地覆，总当做一时的风波，
Everything has turned upside down, but we have still treated it as a passing storm.

除了拿老太太搬城外去住以外，别的排场、应酬，不过规模小了点，
Apart from moving the old lady outside the city, our display and entertaining have merely been reduced a little.

根本上是没有变。
Nothing fundamental has changed.

照你现在的打算，这家人家是非拆散不可了？”
With the course you are proposing now, must this household really be broken up?”

听得这话，胡雪岩心如刀割，
Her words cut Hu to the heart.

但他向来都是先想到人家，
Yet he always thought of others first.

将心比心，知道螺蛳太太比他还要难过，眼泪只是强忍着不让它流下来而已。
Putting himself in her place, he knew that she suffered still more and was holding back her tears by sheer effort.

这样转着念头，便觉得该先安慰螺蛳太太，
He felt that he must comfort her.

“我同你总归是拆不散的。”他说，
“You and I will never be parted,” he said.

“不但今生今世，来世还是夫妻。”
“Not only in this life—we shall be husband and wife in the next.”

螺蛳太太的强忍着的眼泪，哪禁得起他这样一句话的激荡！
How could the tears she had restrained withstand that assurance?

顿时热泪滚滚，
They poured down.

倚着胡雪岩的肩头，把他的湖绉皮袍湿了一大片。
Leaning on his shoulder, she soaked a large patch of his Huzhou-crepe fur robe.

“罗四姐，罗四姐，”
“Luo Sijie, Luo Sijie.”

胡雪岩握着她的手说：
He held her hand.

“你也不要难过。
“Do not grieve.

荣华富贵我们总算也都经过了，
We have had our share of wealth and splendour.

人生在世，喜怒哀乐，都要尝到，才算真正做过人。
To have truly lived, a person must taste joy, anger, sorrow, and pleasure alike.

闲话少说，
But enough of that.

我同你商量一件事。
There is something I must discuss with you.”

“这件事，便是遣散姬妾。
It was the dispersal of his concubines.

两个人秘密计议已定，相约决不让第三者知道，包括胡太太在内，都不能知道，
They settled the matter privately and agreed that no third person—not even Mrs Hu—was to know.

只等胡雪岩上海回来，付诸实行。
They would put the plan into effect only after Hu returned from Shanghai.


“你看，”胡雪岩突然问道：“花影楼的那个，怎么样？”
“What do you think of the one in Huaying Tower?” Hu suddenly asked.

花影楼住的是朱姨太，小名青莲，
Huaying Tower housed Mistress Zhu, whose childhood name was Qinglian.

原是绍兴下方桥朱郎中的女儿。
She was the daughter of Doctor Zhu of Xiafangqiao in Shaoxing.

朱郎中是小儿科，只为用药错误，看死了周百万家三房合一的七岁男孩，
Her father treated children, but a mistake in prescribing had killed a seven-year-old boy who was the common heir of three branches of the Zhou Millionaire's family.

以致官司缠身，家道中落。
Lawsuits followed, and the doctor's fortunes collapsed.

朱郎中连气带急，一病而亡，
Overwhelmed by anger and anxiety, he fell ill and died.

周百万家却还不放过，以至于青莲竟要落入火坑。
Even then the Zhou family would not relent, and Qinglian was on the point of being forced into prostitution.

幸而为胡雪岩看中，量珠聘来，列为第七房姬妾。
Fortunately Hu had taken a liking to her, paid a generous marriage settlement, and brought her into his household as his seventh concubine.

螺蛳太太不明白他的话，愣了一下问道：
Madam Luosi was puzzled.

“你说她什么怎么样？
“What do you mean, what do I think of her?

没头没脑，我从哪里说起？”
With no beginning or end to your question, where am I to start?”

“我是说她的为人。”
“I mean her character.”

“为人总算是忠厚的。”螺蛳太太答说：
“She is a decent, honest sort.

“到底是郎中的女儿，
A doctor's daughter, after all.

说话行事，都有分寸。”
She knows how to conduct herself and what to say.”

“你看她还会不会生？”
“Do you think she can still bear a child?”

问到这话，螺蛳太太越发奇怪，
This puzzled Madam Luosi still more.

“怎么？”
“Why?

她问：“你是不是想把她留下来？”
Are you thinking of keeping her?”

“你弄错了。”
“You have misunderstood.

胡雪岩说：“你光是说她会生不会生好了。”
Just tell me whether you think she can bear children.”

“只要你会生，她就会生。
“If you can father one, she can bear one.

圆脸、屁股大，不是宜男之相？”
A round face and broad hips—is that not the look of a woman who will bear sons?”

“好！”
“Good.

胡雪岩说：“周少棠的独养儿子，本来在洋行里做事，蛮有出息的，
Zhou Shaotang's only son worked in a foreign firm and had excellent prospects.

哪晓得还没有娶亲，一场春瘟死掉了。
But before he had even married, a spring epidemic carried him off.

周少棠今年五十四，身子好得出奇，
Shaotang is fifty-four and remarkably strong.

我想青莲如果跟了他，倒是一桩好事。“
If Qinglian went to him, I think it would be a good thing.”


“你怎么想出来的？”
“How did that occur to you?”

螺蛳太太沉吟了一会说：
Madam Luosi pondered.

“好事倒是好事，不过周太太愿意不愿意呢？”
“It might be a good thing, but would Mrs Zhou consent?”

“愿意。”胡雪岩答得非常爽脆。
“She would,” Hu answered promptly.

“你问过他？”
“Have you asked him?”

“是啊。
“Of course.

不然怎么会晓得？”
Otherwise how should I know?”

“这也许是嘴里的话。
“Perhaps that is only talk.”

“不！
“No.

我同少棠年纪轻的时候，就在一起，
Shaotang and I have known each other since we were young.

我晓得他的为人，
I know his character.

有时候看起来油腔滑调，其实倒是实实惠惠的人，对我更不说假话。”
At times he seems glib and flippant, but in fact he is a thoroughly straightforward man, and he would never lie to me.”

“那好。”
“Very well.

螺蛳太太说：“不过青莲愿不愿意，就不晓得了。
But we do not know whether Qinglian would agree.

等我来问问她看。”
Let me ask her.”

“我看不必问，
“I do not think you need to.

一问她一定说不愿。”
If you ask now, she will certainly refuse.”

胡雪岩用感慨的声音说：
Hu's voice was full of feeling.

“ ‘夫妻本是同林鸟，大限来时各自飞。’
“‘Husband and wife are birds of the same forest; when the final calamity comes, each flies away.’

夫妻尚且如此，别的不必说了，
If even spouses are like that, there is no need to speak of anyone else.

到时候，她自会愿意。”
When the time comes, she will agree of her own accord.”

Hu had already decided where he would stay in Shanghai.

哪里都不住，到城里找了一家小客栈住了下来，为的是隐藏行迹，
He went nowhere familiar, but found a small inn in the Chinese city and settled there to conceal his movements.

租界上熟人太多，
He knew too many people in the foreign settlement.

“仕宦行台”的茶房头脑，更是见多识广，岂能没有见过鼎鼎大名的“胡财神”？
The head attendants at the inns catering to officials were particularly well informed; how could they fail to have seen the celebrated God of Wealth?

所以要遮掩真相，只有隐身在远离租界的小客栈中。
His only way of hiding his circumstances was to disappear into a small inn far from the settlement.

安顿既定，派跟班去通知古应春来相会。
Once settled, he sent an attendant to fetch Gu.

古应春大出意外，但亦不难体会到胡雪岩的心境，

所以尽管内心为他兴起一种英雄末路的凄凉，但见了面神色平静，连“小爷叔为啥住在这里”这么一句话都不问。

身子好一点没有？”
Is her health any better?”

“还好。”

“She does not know.”

“不晓得？”
“Does not know?”

Hu was surprised.

“多亏瑞香，
“Thanks to Ruixiang.

想尽办法不让她晓得。
She has tried every possible means of keeping her from hearing.

顶麻烦的是报纸。
The greatest difficulty is the newspaper.

“Oh!” Hu breathed out and felt immediately easier.

他本来一直在担心的是，见了七姑奶奶的面，不知道说什么话来安慰她，
He had been worrying about what he could say to comfort the Seventh Lady when they met.

现在不必担心了。
Now that concern was lifted.


接下来便谈正事。
They turned to business.

胡雪岩首先将他所作的“壮士断腕”的决定，告诉了古应春，当然也要问问他的看法。
Hu first told Gu of his decision to sacrifice an arm to save himself, and naturally asked his opinion.

我胡某人之有今天，是天时、地利、人和，再加上两个可遇不可求、可一不可再的机会凑成功的。
What I achieved depended on favourable times, favourable circumstances, and the support of the right people, together with two opportunities that cannot be sought at will and never come twice.

Which of those advantages do I still possess?

就算占全了，也不会再有那样两个机会了。”

一个大概是西征，

还有一个呢？”
What was the other?”

现在呢？懂洋务的不晓得有多少，

同洋人打交道，做生意，不但晓得他们的行情，而且连洋人那套吃中国人的决窍都学得很精了，
In trading with foreigners, they know not only their prices but also all their tricks for exploiting Chinese people.

哪里还轮得到我来做市面？
What place is left for me?

再说，中国人做生意要靠山。
Besides, a Chinese businessman needs a powerful patron.”

Shaking his head, Hu changed the subject.

你说要替我留一笔钱，
“You say you want to save some money for me.

我只好说，盛情可感，其实是做不到的。
I can only be grateful for the thought; it cannot be done.

因为我的全部帐目都交出去了，
All my accounts have been handed over.

象丝茧两样，都有细数，
The silk and cocoons are recorded in detail.

哪里好私下留一部分？“
How could I secretly hold back a portion?”

“There are still ways,” Gu replied.

“The essential thing is that you must insist on handling the silk and cocoons yourself.”

东西虽然在我手里，主权已经不是我的了。
The goods may still be in my hands, but the right to dispose of them is no longer mine.

我们有户头，卖不卖要看刘抚台愿意不愿意，
Even with a buyer of our own, the sale depends on Governor Liu's consent.

他说价钱不好，不卖，我们没有话说。”
If he says the price is too low and refuses, we have nothing to say.”

“价钱好呢？”
“And if the price is good?”

“好到怎样的程度？”胡雪岩脱口相问，
“How good?” Hu asked at once.

看古应春不作声，方又说道：“除非价钱好到足抵我的亏空有余，我马上可以收回，自己处理。
Seeing that Gu remained silent, he continued, “Only if the price were high enough to cover my deficit with something to spare could I immediately recover control and handle matters myself.

无奈办不到，

只有请刘抚台出面来讲折扣，那就只好由他作主了。”
I can only ask Governor Liu to negotiate reduced settlements, so the decision must be his.”

“But Governor Liu may not be able to find a buyer immediately.”

“不错，
“True.

我也晓得他找不到。
I know he cannot.

我原来的打算是，他找不到，就拖在那里，
My original idea was to let the matter wait if he found none.

拖它几个月，或者局面好转了，或者洋商要货等不及了，
After a few months, conditions might improve, or the foreign merchants might become too impatient for supplies.

行情翻醒，或放我们可以翻身。
Prices could recover, and perhaps we could regain our footing.

不过照目前的情形看，再拖下去，会搞得很难看。”于是胡雪岩将言官参劾，可能由文煜的案子，牵连到他受革职处分的情形细说了一遍，接着又细谈此行的目的。
But in the present circumstances, further delay may end very badly.” He then explained in detail how the censors' impeachment of Wenyu might implicate him and lead to his own dismissal from office, before describing the purpose of his journey.

“My first business here is to find a buyer for the silk and cocoons.

你有没有？”
Have you anyone?”

“有。
“Yes.

就是价码上下，还要慢慢儿磨。”
Only the price still needs some patient bargaining.”

“No more bargaining.

我们以掮客的身分，介绍这生意。
We shall introduce the transaction as brokers.

刘抚台答应了，佣钱照样也要同他说明。”
If Governor Liu agrees, we shall also explain the commission openly.”

“那么刘抚台呢？”
“And Governor Liu?

古应春问：“佣金是不是也要分他一份？”
Is he to have a share of the commission?”

不过，这话不便同他说明，

一定要转个弯。”

“How?

Speak to Treasurer De first?”

要先同德晓峰谈。我同他的关系，你是晓得的，

“Yes.

We also agreed to use assumed names.”

“Then everything is in order.”

A wealthy French merchant named Meiya offered comparatively favourable terms.

胡雪岩听完以后，又问了付款的办法、担保的银行，
Having heard them, Hu asked about the method of payment and the bank providing the guarantee.

认为可以交易，但仍旧追问一句：
He considered the transaction acceptable, but pressed one further question.

“比梅雅好的户头还有没有？”
“Is there any buyer better than Meiya?”

“没有。”
“No.”

“好！
“Good.

就是他。”
Then he is the man.

Mine is to go into the general settlement account.”

“我的也归公帐。”
“Mine can go into it too.”

我是为了显我的诚心诚意，
I am doing it to show my sincerity.

Why should you put your money in for nothing?

如果说，折扣打下来，不足之数仍旧要在我身上追，你这样做，让我少一分负担，犹有可说，
If, after a reduced settlement, I still had to make up the balance, you could reasonably say that your sacrifice lightened my burden.

如今总归是打折了事，
But the whole matter is to be settled at a discount.

你这样做，于我没啥好处，
Your contribution would do me no good.

连我都未必见你的情。
Even I might scarcely appreciate the favour.

至于旁人，根本不晓得你不要佣金，就更不用谈了。”

“我是觉得我应该同小爷叔共患难……”
“I feel that I ought to share your hardship…”

“好了，好了！你不必再说了。”
“Enough, enough!”

胡雪岩拿他的话打断，
Hu cut him short.

“铜钱掼到水里还听个响声，
“Even a copper coin thrown into the water makes a sound.

你这样牺牲了都没有人晓得，算啥？”
If you sacrifice this money and no one knows it, what is the point?”

“好吧！”
“Very well.”

古应春另外打了主意，不必说破，只问：
Gu formed a different intention but kept it to himself.

“When shall we send the telegram?”

“Now.

你先起个稿子看。”
Draft it first and let us look at it.”

古应春点点头，凝神细想了一会说：
Gu nodded and thought carefully for a while.

“How shall I put the matter of the commission?”

你只报个价，叙明付款办法，
Give only the price and explain the terms of payment.

格外要强调的是，没有比这个价钱更好的了。
Stress that no better price can be obtained.

如果刘抚台有意思，由你到杭州同他当面接头，
If Governor Liu is interested, you can go to Hangzhou and discuss it with him in person.

那时候再谈佣金。”
That will be the time to speak of the commission.”

“Would it not be more suitable for you to go back and negotiate yourself, Little Uncle?”

“No.

第一，我要到江宁去一趟；
First, I must go to Jiangning.

第二，这件事我最好不要插手，
Second, it would be better for me to keep out of this.

看起来置身事外，德晓峰才比较好说话。”
If I appear uninvolved, De Xiaofeng will find it easier to speak.”

“好！我懂了。”于是唤茶房取来笔砚，
“I understand.” They called for the inn attendant to bring writing materials.

古应春拟好一个电报稿，与胡雪岩斟酌妥当，
Gu prepared a draft, which they considered and revised together.

然后取出密码本来，两人一起动手，翻好了重新誊正校对，
They then took out the codebook, encoded the message, copied it afresh, and checked it.

直到傍晚，方始完事。
By the time they finished, evening had come.

“我马上去发，否则，电报局要关门了。”古应春问：
“I shall send it at once, or the telegraph office will close,” Gu said.

“小爷叔是不是到我那里去吃饭，还是苦中作乐，去吃一台花酒？”
“Will you dine at my house, Little Uncle, or shall we find pleasure in adversity and have a courtesan dinner?”

“哪里有心思去吃花酒？”
“How could I be in the mood for that?

胡雪岩说：“我们一起出去逛逛，随便找个馆子吃饭，
Let us go out for a walk and find somewhere to eat.

明天再去看七姐。”
I shall see Seventh Sister tomorrow.”

“也好。”
“Very well.”

于是胡雪岩连跟班都不带，与古应春一起出了客栈，先到电报局发了密电，安步当车，闲逛夜市。
Leaving even Hu's attendant behind, they went out together, first sent the confidential telegram at the telegraph office, and then walked leisurely through the night market.

Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Nine (complete)

第九章 少年绮梦｜CHAPTER NINE: YOUTHFUL DREAMS OF LOVE


走过一家小饭馆，胡雪岩止住了脚，古应春亦跟着停了下来。
Passing a small restaurant, Hu Xueyan stopped, and Gu Yingchun stopped with him.

那有饭馆的金字招牌，烟熏尘封，已看不清是何字号，
Smoke and dust had so obscured the gold lettering on its sign that the name was no longer legible.

进门炉灶，里面是一间大厅，摆着二三十张八仙桌，
The cooking range stood just inside the entrance; beyond it was a large room containing twenty or thirty square tables.

此时已将歇市，
The restaurant was about to close.

冷冷清清的，只有两桌客人，灯火黯淡，益显萧瑟。
Only two tables were occupied, and the dim lights made the deserted room seem still more forlorn.

古应春忍不住说：“小爷叔，换一家吧，
“Little Uncle, let us try somewhere else,” Gu said.

或者到租界上去，好好找家馆子。
“Or go to the settlement and find a proper restaurant.

这家要打烊了。”
This one is closing.”

“问问看。”
“Let us ask.”

说着，举步踏了进去。
Hu stepped inside.

跑堂的倒很巴结，古应春亦就不好意思打断人家的生意了。
The waiter was so eager to oblige that Gu could hardly deprive him of their custom.

“两位客人请坐，
“Please sit down, gentlemen.

吃饭还是吃酒。”
Will you be eating or drinking?”

“饭也要，酒也要。”
“Both.

胡雪岩问道：“你们这家招牌，是不是叫老同和？”
Is this place called Laotonghe?” Hu asked.

“是的。
“Yes, sir.

老同和。”
Laotonghe.”

“老板呢？”胡雪岩问：
“Where is the proprietor?

“我记得他左手有六个指头。”
I remember he had six fingers on his left hand.”

“那是我们老老板，
“That was our old proprietor.

去世多年了。”
He died years ago.”

“现在呢？
“And now?

小开变老板了？”
Has the young master taken over?”

“老老板没有儿子，只有一个女儿，
“He had no son, only a daughter.

现在是我们的老板娘。”
She is our mistress now.”

“啊！”
“Ah!”

胡雪岩突然双眼发亮，
Hu's eyes suddenly brightened.

“你们老板娘的小名是不是叫阿彩？”
“Was her childhood name A’cai?”

“原来你这位客人，真正是老客人了。”
“You really are an old customer!

跑堂的说道：“现在叫得出我们老板娘名字的，没有几个人。”
Very few people still know our mistress's name.”

接着，便回过去，高声喊道：“老板娘，老板娘！”
The waiter turned and shouted for her.

看看没有回音，古应春便拦住他说：
When there was no answer, Gu stopped him.

“不必喊了。
“Never mind calling.

有啥好东西，随意配几样来，烫一斤酒。”
Bring us a few of whatever dishes are good, and warm a jin of wine.”


等跑堂离去，胡雪岩不胜感慨地说：“二十多年了！
When the waiter had gone, Hu said with deep feeling, “More than twenty years!

我头一回到上海，头一顿饭就是在这里吃的。”
The first meal I ever ate in Shanghai was here.”

“小爷叔好象很熟嘛！
“You seem to know the place well, Little Uncle.

连老板女儿的小名都叫得出来。”
You even remember the proprietor's daughter's childhood name.”

“不但叫得出来……”
“More than remember it...”

胡雪岩摇摇头，没有再说下去。
Hu shook his head and said no more.

这种欲言双止的神态，又关涉到一个“女小开”，很容易今人想到，其中必有一段故事。
His hesitation, involving a young heiress to a business, readily suggested a story.

如此寒夜，如此冷店，听这段故事，或者可以忘忧消愁。
On such a cold night, in such a chilly, empty restaurant, hearing it might help them forget their cares.

就这样一转念间，古应春便觉得兴致好得多了。
The thought lifted Gu's spirits.

等跑堂端来“本帮菜”的白肉、乌参，一个“糟钵头”的火锅，
The waiter brought boiled pork and dark sea cucumber, both local specialties, and a hotpot flavored with wine lees.

看到熊熊的青焰，心头更觉温暖，
Its vigorous blue flame warmed Gu's heart as well.

将烫好的酒为胡雪岩斟上一杯，开口说道：
He poured Hu a cup of the heated wine.

“小爷叔，你是什么都看得开的，
“You have always been able to take things in your stride, Little Uncle.

吃杯酒，谈谈当年在这里的情形。”
Have a drink and tell me what happened here in those days.”

正落入沉恩中的胡雪岩，啜了一口酒，夹了一块白肉送入口中，咀嚼了一会说：
Lost in thought, Hu sipped his wine, put a slice of pork into his mouth, and chewed it for a while.

“不晓得是当年老板的手艺好，还是我的胃口变过了，
“I cannot tell whether the old proprietor was a better cook or my appetite has changed.

白肉的味道，大不如前。”
This pork tastes nothing like as good.”

“说不定两个原因都有。”古应春笑道：
“Perhaps both,” Gu said, smiling.

“还说不定有第三个原因。”
“There may even be a third reason.”

“第三个？”
“A third?”

“是啊！当年还有阿彩招呼客人。”
“A’cai was here to wait on you then.”

“她不管招呼，
“She did not wait on customers.

坐帐台。
She sat at the accounts desk.

那时我在杭州钱庄里的饭碗敲破了，到上海来寻生意，
I had lost my job at a bank in Hangzhou and came to Shanghai to look for work.

城里有家钱庄，字号叫做源利，有个得力的伙计是我一起学生意的师兄弟，
A capable assistant at Yuanli Bank, here in the city, had served his apprenticeship with me.

我到上海来投奔他，哪晓得为他兄弟的亲事，他回绍兴去了，
I came to ask his help, only to find that he had gone home to Shaoxing for his brother's marriage.

源利的人说就要回上海的，我就住在一家小客栈里等。
The people at Yuanli said he would soon be back, so I took a room in a small inn and waited.

一等等了十天，人没有等到。
Ten days passed without a sign of him.

盘缠用光了，只好在小客栈里‘孵豆芽’。”
My traveling money ran out, and I could do nothing but ‘sprout beans’ in the inn.”


囊底无钱，一筹莫展，只好杜门不出，上海的俗语叫做“孵豆芽”。
To have an empty purse and no way out, and therefore stay shut indoors, was what Shanghai people called “sprouting beans.”

但客栈钱好欠，饭不能不吃，
His lodging bill could wait, but he had to eat.

他每天到老同和来吃饭，先是一盘白肉、一碗大血汤，再要一样素菜，
He had been coming to Laotonghe every day, ordering a plate of boiled pork, a bowl of blood soup, and a vegetable dish.

后来减掉白肉，一汤一素菜，
First he gave up the pork, keeping only the soup and vegetables.

再后来大血汤变为黄豆汤，
Then soybean soup replaced the blood soup.

最后连黄豆汤都吃不起了，买两个烧饼，弄碗白开水便算一顿。
Finally, unable to afford even soybean soup, he made a meal of two baked flatbreads and a bowl of hot water.

“这种日子过了有七、八天，过不下去了。
“After seven or eight days of that, I could stand it no longer.

头昏眼花，还在其次，
The dizziness and blurred eyesight were the least of it.

心里发慌，好象马上要大祸临头，
What was worse was the panic, as though some terrible disaster were about to fall on me.

那种味道不是人受的。
It was more than a man could bear.

这天发个狠，拿一件线春夹袍子当掉后，
One day I steeled myself and pawned a lined spring robe.

头一件事就是到老同和来‘杀馋虫’，
The first thing I did was come here to satisfy my cravings.

仍旧是白肉、大血汤，吃饱惠帐，回到小客栈，
I had the pork and blood soup as before, ate my fill, paid, and went back to the inn.

一摸袋袋，才晓得当票弄掉了……”
Only when I felt in my pocket did I discover that I had lost the pawn ticket.”

“掉在老同和了？”古应春插嘴问说。
“Here at Laotonghe?” Gu interrupted.


“当时还不晓得。
“I did not know that then.

不过，也无所谓，
Nor did I particularly care.

掉了就掉了，有钱做新的。”
Let it be lost; when I had money, I could have a new robe made.”

胡雪岩停下来喝口酒，又喝了两勺汤，
Hu paused for a drink of wine and a couple of spoonfuls of soup.

方又说道：“到第二天，出了怪事，
“The next day, something extraordinary happened.

有个十二三岁的伢儿，手里捧个包裹，找到我住的那间房，开口说道：”
A boy of twelve or thirteen appeared at my room with a bundle.

客人，客人，你的夹袍子在这里。
‘Sir, here is your lined robe!’

‘一看，这个伢儿是老同和小徒弟。
I recognized him as the apprentice here.

我问他：“哪个叫你送来的？’
‘Who sent you?’ I asked.

他说：”客人，你不要问。
‘Do not ask, sir.

到我们店里去吃饭，也不要讲我送衣服来给你。
And when you come to eat at our shop, do not say that I brought it.’

‘我说：“为啥？’
‘Why not?’

他说：”你不要问，你到店里也不要说。
‘Please do not ask or say anything.

你一定要听我的话，不然有人会打死我。
You must do as I say, or someone will beat me to death.’”

‘““有这样怪事！”古应春兴味盎然地问：
“Extraordinary!” Gu said, enthralled.

“小爷叔，你总要逼他说实话罗！”
“You must have made him tell you the truth.”

“当然。”
“Of course.”

胡雪岩的声音也很起劲了，
Hu's voice grew animated.

“我当时哄他，同他说好话，他就是不肯说，
“I coaxed him and spoke nicely, but he would not tell me.

逼得我没法子，只好耍无赖，
Finally I had to turn bully.

我说：我不说，我也要打死你，
‘If you do not tell me, I shall beat you to death myself.

还要拿你当小偷，送你到县衙门去打屁股，
I shall call you a thief and take you to the county yamen to have your backside beaten.

你说了实话，我到你店里吃饭，一定听你的话，什么话都不说。
Tell me the truth, and when I come to your shop I promise to do as you ask and say nothing.

两条路，随你自己挑。”
Those are your two choices.’”


“这一来，便把实话逼出来了？”
“And that brought out the truth?”

“当然。
“Naturally.

那个小徒弟叫阿利，
The apprentice was called A’li.

是阿彩的表弟，我的夹袍子，就是阿彩叫他送来的。
He was A’cai's younger cousin, and she had sent him with the robe.

原来……”
It turned out...”

原来胡雪岩掏钱惠帐时，将当票掉落在地上，
When Hu had taken out his money to pay, the pawn ticket had fallen to the floor.

至晚打烊，阿利扫地发现，送交帐台。
A’li found it while sweeping up at closing time and brought it to the accounts desk.

阿彩本就在注意胡雪岩，
A’cai had already been watching Hu.

见他由大血汤吃到黄豆汤，而忽然又恢复原状，但身上却变了“短打”，
She had seen his descent from blood soup to soybean soup and his sudden return to his former order, but now he wore a short jacket instead of a long robe.

便知长袍已送入当铺。
She understood that the robe had gone to the pawnshop.

于是，就悄悄赎了出来，关照阿利送回。
Quietly she redeemed it and told A’li to take it back.

特为交代，要守秘密，亦望胡雪岩不必说破，倒不是怕她父亲知道，是怕有人当笑话去讲。
Her particular instructions to keep the matter secret, and her hope that Hu would not mention it, came not from fear of her father finding out, but from fear of being made a subject of joking gossip.

“照此说来，阿彩倒真是小爷叔的红粉知己了。”古应春问道：
“Then A’cai was a sympathetic friend indeed,” Gu said.

“小爷叔见了她，有没有说破？”
“When you saw her, did you say anything?”

“从那天起，我就没有看见她。”胡雪岩说：
“I never saw her again after that day.

“当时我脸皮也很薄，
I was thin-skinned then.

见了她又不能还她钱，尴尬不尴尬？
How could I face her when I could not repay her?

我同阿利说：请你代我谢谢你表姐。
I told A’li, ‘Please thank your cousin for me.

她替我垫的钱，我以后会加利奉还。”
I shall return what she advanced, with interest.’”

不道此一承诺竟成虚愿。
Yet that promise had remained unfulfilled.

大约一年以后，胡雪岩与杨昌浚重逢，开始创业，
About a year later, Hu met Yang Changjun again and began his career.

偶然想到其事，写信托上海的同业，送了一百两银子到老同和，不道竟碰了一个钉子。
Remembering the incident one day, he wrote to a colleague in the Shanghai banking trade, asking him to deliver a hundred taels to Laotonghe, only to be met with a flat refusal.

“那次是怪我的信没有写对。”胡雪岩解释其中的缘故：
“The fault was in my letter,” Hu explained.

“信上我当然不便说明缘故，
“Naturally I could not explain the reason.

又说要送给阿利或者女小开阿彩，
I merely said to give it to A’li or to the proprietor's daughter, A’cai.

人家不知道是啥花佯，自然不肯收了。”
They had no idea what was behind it and naturally refused the money.”


“那么，以后呢？
“And afterward?

小爷叔一直在上海，
You were in Shanghai all that time.

莫非自己就不可以来一趟？”
Could you not have come yourself?”

“是啊！
“Yes.

有一回我想起来了，用个红封袋包好一张五百两银子的银票，正要出门，接到一个消息，
Once I remembered, put a draft for five hundred taels into a red envelope, and was just going out when a piece of news arrived.

马上把什么要紧的事，都掼在脑后了。”
Everything else, however urgent, went clean out of my head.”

“什么消息？”
“What news?

古应春猜测着：“不是大坏，就是大好。”
It must have been either very bad or very good.”

“大好！”胡雪岩脱口答说：
“Very good!” Hu answered at once.

“杭州光复了。”
“Hangzhou had been recaptured.”

“那就怪不得了。
“Then one can hardly blame you.

以后呢？
But afterward?

以后没有再想到过？”
Did you never think of it again?”

“当然想到过。
“Of course I did.

可惜，不是辰光不对，就是地方不对。”
Unfortunately, it was always either the wrong time or the wrong place.”

“这话怎么说。”
“What do you mean?”

“譬如半夜里醒过来，在枕头上想到了，
“Suppose I woke in the middle of the night and remembered it while lying on my pillow.

总不能马上起床来办这件事，这是辰光不对；
I could hardly get up and attend to it immediately: the wrong time.

再譬如在船上想到了，
Or suppose I remembered while aboard a boat.

也不能马上回去办，这是地方不对。
I could not turn straight back: the wrong place.

凡是这种时候，这种地方想到了，总觉得日子还长，一定可以了心愿。
Whenever it came to mind at such a time or in such a place, I felt there was plenty of life ahead and that I would surely fulfill my wish.

想是这样想，想过忘记，等于不想。
That was what I thought, but once I had thought it, I forgot it, which was as good as never having thought it at all.

到后来日子一长，这件事就想了起来，也是所谓无动于衰了。
Eventually, so much time had passed that even remembering it no longer stirred me.”

“古应春深深点着头，
Gu nodded deeply.

“人就是这样子，
“That is human nature.

什么事都要讲机会。
Everything depends on opportunity.

明明一定办得到的事，阴错阳差，叫你不能如愿。”
Something that ought to be perfectly possible may still be frustrated by one accident after another.”

他心里在想胡雪岩今日的遭遇，也是一连串阴错阳差的累积，
His thoughts turned to Hu's present misfortunes, themselves the accumulation of a series of unhappy accidents.

如果不是法国构衅，如果不是左宗棠出军机，如果不是邵友濂当上海道，如果不是宓本常亏空了阜康的款子……
If the French had not provoked a conflict; if Zuo Zongtang had not left the Grand Council; if Shao Youlian had not become Shanghai Circuit Intendant; if Mi Benchang had not left that deficit in Fukang's funds...

这样一直想下去，竟忘了身在何地了。
Following these thoughts, he quite forgot where he was.


“应春！”
“Yingchun!”

古应春一惊，定定神问道：
Gu started and collected himself.

“小爷叔，你说啥？”
“What did you say, Little Uncle?”

“我想，今天的辰光、地方都对了，
“I think both the time and the place are right today.

这个机会决不可以错过。”
I must not let the opportunity pass.”

“啊，啊！”
“Ah, yes!”

古应春也兴奋了，
Gu too grew excited.

“小爷叔你预备怎么样来补这个情？”
“How do you intend to repay the kindness?”

“等我来问问看。”
“Let me make some inquiries.”

当下招一招手，将那伙计唤了来，先问：
Hu beckoned the waiter over.

“你叫啥名字？”
“What is your name?”

“我叫孙小毛。”
“Sun Xiaomao.”

“喔，”
“I see.”

胡雪岩向古应春问道：
Hu turned to Gu.

“你身上有多少洋钱？”
“How many silver dollars have you with you?”

“要多少？”
“How many do you need?”

“十块。”
“Ten.”

“有。”
“I have them.”

古应春掏出十块鹰洋，摆在桌上。
Gu took out ten Mexican eagle dollars and laid them on the table.

“孙小毛，”胡雪岩指着洋钱说：“除了惠帐，另外的是你的。”
Pointing to them, Hu said, “Sun Xiaomao, whatever is left after the bill is yours.”

“客人！”
“Sir?”

孙小毛睁大了眼，一脸困惑，
Sun's eyes widened in bewilderment.

“你说啥？”“这十块洋钱，”古应春代为回答，“除了正帐，
“What did you say?” Gu answered for Hu. “Take the price of our meal out of these ten dollars.

都算小帐。”
The rest is your tip.”

“喔唷唷！
“Oh, my goodness!

太多，太多，太多了！”
It is far too much, far too much!”

孙小毛仍旧不敢伸手。
Sun still dared not reach for the money.

“你不要客气！”胡雪岩说：
“Do not stand on ceremony,” Hu said.

“你先把洋钱拿了，
“Take it first.

我还有话同你说。”
There is something I want to ask you.”

“这样说，我就谢谢了。
“Then thank you very much, sir.

客人贵姓？”
May I ask your name?”

“我姓胡。”
“Hu.”

“胡老爷，”孙小毛改了称呼：“有啥事体，尽管吩咐。”
“Master Hu,” Sun said, changing his form of address, “whatever you wish, you have only to say.”


“你们老板娘住在哪里？”
“Where does your mistress live?”

“就在后面。”
“Just behind the shop.”

“我托你去说一声，
“Would you take her a message?

就说有个还是二十多年前的老老板的朋友，想同她见个面。”
Tell her that a friend of her father's from more than twenty years ago would like to see her.”

“胡老爷，我们老板在这里。”
“Our master is here, Master Hu.”

“也好！
“Very well.

先同你们老板谈一谈。”
Let me speak to him first.”

孙小毛手捧十块鹰洋，转身而去，
Sun went off carrying the ten eagle dollars.

来了这么一个阔客，老板当然忙不迭地来招呼，
With so lavish a customer in the shop, the proprietor naturally hurried over.

等走近一看，两个人都有些发愣，因为彼此都觉得面善，却记不起在哪里见过。
As he drew close, both men stared: each found the other's face familiar, yet neither could remember where he had seen it.

“你不是阿利？”
“Are you not A’li?”

“你这位胡老爷是……”
“Master Hu, you are...?”

“我就是当年你表姐叫你送夹袍子的……”
“The man your cousin sent you to with the lined robe.”

“啊，啊！”
“Ah, of course!”

阿利想起来了，
A’li remembered.

“二十多年的事了。
“More than twenty years ago!

胡老爷一向好？”
Have you been well, Master Hu?”

“还好，还好！
“Quite well, quite well.

你表姐呢？”
