And your cousin?

胡雪岩问道：“你是老板，你表姐是老板娘，这么说，你娶了你表姐？”
If you are the proprietor and she is the mistress, you must have married her.”

“不是。”阿利不好意思地说：
“Not exactly,” A’li said bashfully.

“是入赘。”
“I married into her family.”

“入赘也好，娶回去也好，总是夫妻，
“Whether you joined her family or brought her into yours, you are husband and wife.

恭喜，恭喜！”
Congratulations!

胡雪岩又问：“有几个伢儿？”
How many children?”

“一男一女。”
“A boy and a girl.”

“一男一女一盆花，
“A boy and a girl make a perfect flowering pair.

好极、好极！”
Excellent!”

胡雪岩转脸向古应春说道：
Hu turned to Gu.

“我这个把月，居然还遇到这样巧的一件事，
“After the month or so I have had, to encounter such a coincidence!

想想倒也有趣。”
There is something rather delightful about it.”


看他满脸笑容，古应春也为之一破愁颜，
Hu's beaming face dispelled Gu's gloom as well.

忽然想到两句诗，也不暇去细想情况是否相似，便念了出来：“山穷水尽疑无路，
Two lines of poetry came to him, and without stopping to consider whether they quite suited the occasion, he recited them: “Mountains end, streams run dry; surely there is no road ahead.

柳暗花明又一村。”
Then, beyond dark willows and bright blossoms, another village.”

这时孙小毛远远喊道：“老板，
At that moment Sun called from a distance, “Master!

老板你请过来。”
Please come here!”

“啥事体，
“What is it?

我在陪客人说话。”
I am talking to our guests.”

“要紧事体，
“Something important.

你请过来，我同你说一句话。”
Come here and let me tell you.”

阿利只好说一声，“对不起，
A’li could only excuse himself.

我去去就来。”
“I shall be right back.”

等他去到帐台边，孙小毛又好奇又兴奋地说：“老板你晓得这位胡老爷是啥人？
At the accounts desk, Sun said, full of excitement and curiosity, “Do you know who this Master Hu is?

他就是胡财神。”
He is Hu, the God of Wealth.”

“胡雪岩？”
“Hu Xueyan?”

“是啊！”
“Yes!”

“哪个说的？”
“Who told you?”

阿利不信，
A’li was incredulous.

“胡财神多少威风，出来前前后后跟一大班人，
“The God of Wealth goes everywhere in great style, with a whole crowd before and behind him.

会到我老同和来吃白肉？”
Would he come to Laotonghe for boiled pork?”

“是一个刚刚走的客人说的。
“A customer who just left told me.

我在想就是因为老同和，他才进来的。”
I think he came precisely because this is Laotonghe.

孙小毛又说：“你倒想想看，正帐不过两把银子，小帐反倒一出手八、九两。
Think of it: the meal costs only a small sum, yet he gives eight or nine taels as a tip.

不是财神，哪里会有这样子的阔客？
Who but the God of Wealth would be so lavish?”

““啊！啊！
“Ah!

这句话我要听。”
There is something in that.”

阿利转身就走，回到原处，赔笑说道：
A’li went straight back, smiling apologetically.

“胡老爷，我有眼不识泰山，
“Master Hu, I failed to recognize greatness when I saw it.

原来你老人家就是胡财神。”
So you are the God of Wealth himself!”

“那是从前，
“I used to be.

现在是‘赤脚财神’了。”
Now I am the Barefoot God of Wealth.”

“财神总归是财神。”阿利非常高兴地说：
“The God of Wealth is still the God of Wealth!” A’li said joyfully.

“今天是冬至，财神临门。
“Today is the winter solstice, and he has come to my door.

看来明年房了翻造，老同和老店新开，我要翻身了。
Next year, when we rebuild and reopen Laotonghe, my fortunes are going to change.

“他又加了一句：”我们老丈人的话要应验了。
What my father-in-law said is coming true.”

““呃！”
“Oh?

胡雪岩随口问说：“你老丈人怎么说？”
What did he say?” Hu asked casually.

“我老丈人会看相，
“He could read faces.

他说我会遇贵人，四十岁以后会得发，
He said I would meet a benefactor and prosper after forty.

明年我就四十岁了。”
I shall be forty next year.”


胡雪岩算了一下，
Hu made a quick calculation.

他初见阿利是在二十七年前，照此算来，那里的阿利只有十三岁，而阿彩至少有十六七岁，
He had first met A’li twenty-seven years earlier, which meant that A’li had been only thirteen then and A’cai at least sixteen or seventeen.

记得她长得并不丑，
He remembered her as by no means plain.

何以会嫁一个十三岁的小表弟？
Why had she married a little cousin of thirteen?

一时好奇心起，便即问：“你表姐比你大几岁？”
Curious, he asked, “How much older than you is she?”

“大四岁。”
“Four years.”

阿利似乎猜到了胡雪岩的心思，
A’li seemed to guess what was in Hu's mind.

“阿彩眼界高，
“A’cai set her sights high.

高不成，低不就，
Those above her were out of reach; those below she would not accept.

一直到二十七岁，老姑娘的脾气怪，
By the time she was twenty-seven, she had developed an old maid's temper.

人人见了都怪她，
Everyone found her difficult.

只有……”
Only...”

他不好意思地笑一笑不肯再说下去了。
He smiled bashfully and stopped.

“只有你不怕？”
“Only you were not afraid of her?”

“不是我不怕。
“It was not that I was unafraid.

我是从小让她呼来喝去惯了的，
She had ordered me about since I was a child.

脾气好是这样，脾气坏也是这样，无所谓。”
Whether she was in a good temper or a bad one, it was all the same to me.”

阿利停了一下又说：
He paused.

“后来我老丈人同我说：我把阿彩嫁给你，
“Later my father-in-law said, ‘I shall give you A’cai.

你算我女婿，也算我儿子。
You will be my son-in-law and my son as well.

你嫌不嫌阿彩年纪大？”
Would you mind her being older?’”

“你老丈人倒很开通，很体恤。”胡雪岩问道：
“An enlightened and considerate man, your father-in-law.

“你怎么回答他呢？”
What did you say?”

“我说，只要阿彩不嫌我年纪小就好了。”
“I said it would be all right so long as A’cai did not mind my being younger.”

胡雪岩与古应春都哈哈大笑，
Hu and Gu both burst out laughing.

“妙，妙！”胡雪岩说，
“Excellent!” Hu said.

“再烫壶酒来。”
“Warm another pot of wine.”


“胡老爷，我看，你如果不嫌委屈，请你同这位古老爷，到我那里坐坐。
“Master Hu, if you would not find it too humble, why not come to our house with Master Gu?

今天做冬至，
It is the winter-solstice festival.

阿彩自己做了几样菜，
A’cai has cooked several dishes herself.

你倒尝尝看。
You could try them.”

“胡雪岩还未有所表示，古应春已拦在前面，
Before Hu could answer, Gu spoke.

“多谢，多谢！”他说：“辰我晚了，我们还有事，
“Thank you very much, but it is getting late and we still have business to attend to.

就在这里多谈一息好了。”
Let us stay and talk here a little longer.”

这话矛盾，既然有事，何以又能多谈？
This was inconsistent: if they had business elsewhere, how could they stay and talk?

阿利听不出话中的漏洞。胡雪岩却明白，
A’li missed the flaw, but Hu understood.

因为他们以前同洋人谈生意、办交涉是合作惯了的，经常使用这种暗带着机关的话，当面传递信息。
In their long partnership negotiating and doing business with foreigners, they had often conveyed messages to one another in such apparently innocent phrases.

胡雪岩虽不知道他的本意何在，但暗示必须谢绝，却是很明白的，
Hu did not know Gu's exact purpose, but the hint that he must decline was unmistakable.

因而顺着他的语气说：
He therefore followed Gu's lead.

“不错，
“Quite right.

我们还有要紧事情，
We still have something important to do.

明天再说吧！”
Let us leave it until tomorrow.”

“那么，明天一定请过来。”
“Then you must come tomorrow.

阿利又说：“我回去告诉了阿彩，她一定也想见一见胡老爷。”
Once I tell A’cai, she will certainly want to see you.”

“好，好！”
“Yes, yes!”

胡雪岩将话题宕开，
Hu turned the conversation aside.

“你们的房子要翻造了？”
“You are going to rebuild?”

“是的。
“Yes.

要造马路了。
They are putting a road through.

房子前面要削掉一半。不过，地价有补贴的，
Half the front of the building has to go, though there will be compensation for the land.

左邻右舍大家合起来，平房翻造楼房，
All the neighbors are joining together to replace the single-story houses with upper stories.

算起来不大吃亏。”
On balance, we shall not lose much.”

“翻造楼房还要下本钱？”
“But you will still need money for the rebuilding?”

“ 是啊！
“Yes.

就是这一点还要想法子。”
That is the difficulty we have to solve.”


“翻造要花多少钱？”
“How much will it cost?”

“那要看情形。
“That depends.

如果拿后面的一块地皮买下来，方方正正成个格局，总要用到一千五百银子。”
If we buy the plot behind us and make the premises a proper, regular shape, it will take fifteen hundred taels.”

“你翻造了以后，做啥用场？
“And what will you do with the new building?

老店新开，扩大营业？”
Reopen the old shop on a larger scale?”

“想是这样想，要看有没有人合股。”
“That is the idea, if we can find someone to invest.

阿利又说：“老店新开，重起炉灶，
Reopening the old shop means starting afresh.

一切生财都要新置，这笔本钱不小。”
We shall need all new equipment, and that takes quite a sum.”

“要多少？”
“How much?”

“总也要一千五百银子。”
“Another fifteen hundred taels.”

“那么，你股东寻着了没有？”
“Have you found any partners?”

“倒有两三个在谈，不过谈不拢。”
“We have been talking to two or three, but we cannot come to terms.”

“为啥？”
“Why?”

“合伙做生意，总要合得来才好。”
“Partners in business have to get along.”

阿利停了一下说：
A’li paused.

“阿彩不愿意。
“A’cai does not want them.

她说，店小不要紧，
She says a small shop does not matter.

自己做老板，自己捏主意，
When you are your own master, you make your own decisions.

高兴多做，不高兴少做，
You can work more when you please and less when you do not.

苦是苦一点，人是自由的。
It is hard work, but you are free.

一合了伙，大家意见不合，到后来连朋友都没得做了。
Once you take partners, disagreements come, and in the end you may not even remain friends.”

““不错！”
“Quite right!”

胡雪岩深深点头，
Hu nodded emphatically.

“阿彩的话你要听。”
“You should listen to A’cai.”

“是啊，
“Yes.

没办法，
There is nothing else for it.

只好听她的话。”
I have to listen to her.”


“听她的话才有办法。”古应春接口说了一句，
“Listening to her is precisely what will give you a way forward,” Gu put in.

举杯复又放下，从大襟中探手进去，从夹袄表袋中掏出金表，
He lifted his cup, set it down again, and reached inside the overlapping front of his coat for the gold watch in his padded jacket's watch pocket.

打开表盖来看了看说：
Opening the cover, he glanced at it.

“小爷叔，辰光到了。”
“Little Uncle, it is time.”

在看表的这个动作中，胡雪岩便已得到暗示：
Hu had understood the signal even while Gu was taking out the watch.

此时便顺着他的语气对阿利说：“今天晚上我们还有事，
Following his lead, he told A’li, “We still have business this evening.

辰光到了，
It is time we went.

明天再来。”
We shall come again tomorrow.”

“明天来吃中饭。”古应春订了后约：
“For lunch,” Gu added, making the arrangement definite.

“请你留张桌子。”
“Please keep us a table.”

“有，有！”阿利一叠连声地答应，
“Certainly, certainly!” A’li agreed eagerly.

“胡老爷、古老爷，想吃点啥，
“What would you gentlemen like?

我好预备。”
I can have it ready.”

“我要吃碗‘带面’。”胡雪岩兴高采烈地说：
“I want a bowl of ‘dai noodles,’” Hu said with delight.

“拣瘦、去皮、轻面、重洗、盖底、宽汤、免青。”
“Lean meat, no skin, fewer noodles, extra topping, meat at the bottom, plenty of broth, no greens.”

“所谓”带面“便是大肉面，
These “dai noodles” were noodles with a large piece of pork.

吃客有许多讲究，便是”拣瘦“云云的一套”切口“。
Their devotees had a whole vocabulary of special instructions, such as “lean meat” and the rest.

胡雪岩并不是真想吃这样一碗面，
Hu did not particularly want such a bowl.

不过回忆当年贱时的乐事，自然而然地说了出来，而且颇以还记得这一套”切口“而兴起一种无可言喻的愉快。
Memories of the pleasures of his humble days had brought the words naturally to his lips, and remembering the entire string of terms gave him an inexpressible pleasure.


顺路买了四两好茶叶，古应春陪胡雪岩在小客栈住夜长谈。
They bought four liang of good tea on the way, and Gu accompanied Hu back to the little inn for a long conversation that night.

他们都同意，这是此时此地，为胡雪岩排遣失意无聊的最好法子。
Both agreed that, in his present circumstances, this was the best way to relieve Hu's dejection and listlessness.

“应春，你为啥不愿意到阿彩那里去吃饭？”
“Yingchun, why did you not want to eat at A’cai's house?”

古应春原以为他能默喻他的深意，
Gu had expected Hu to grasp his deeper meaning without explanation.

不想他还是问了出来，那就不能不提醒他了。
Since he had asked, however, Gu must point it out.

“小爷叔，阿彩为啥‘高不成，低不就’？
“Why do you suppose A’cai could find no husband good enough for her?

你想想他替你赎那件夹袍子，
Think of her redeeming your robe.

还不明白？”
Do you still not understand?”

胡雪岩一愣，
Hu was taken aback.

回想当时情景，恍然大悟，
Recalling the circumstances, he suddenly saw it.

低徊久久，才说了句：“看起来是‘落花有意，流水无情’。”
After dwelling on the thought for a long time, he said, “It seems the falling blossom had feelings, but the flowing water had none.”

古应春很少听到胡雪岩这种“文绉绉”的语意说话，不由得笑了，
Gu rarely heard such literary language from him and could not help smiling.

“小爷叔，”他故意开玩笑：“如果你当时娶了阿彩，现在就是老同和的老板，
“If you had married A’cai then,” he teased, “you would be the proprietor of Laotonghe now.

不晓得是不是还有后来的一番事业。”
Who knows whether you would ever have built your later enterprises?”

“那就不晓得了。
“Who knows?

不过，”胡雪岩加重了语气说，“ 如果我是老同和的老板，我一定也会把它弄成上海滩上第一家大馆子。”
But,” Hu added emphatically, “if I had become Laotonghe's proprietor, I would certainly have made it the finest restaurant in Shanghai.”

“这话我相信。”
“That I believe.”

胡雪岩多日无聊，此时突然心中一动，想小施手段，
After so many dispiriting days, Hu suddenly felt an impulse to show a little of his old skill.

帮阿得来“老店新开”，要轰动一时，稍抒胸中的块垒。
He would help A’li reopen the old shop with a sensation that would relieve some of the frustration in his heart.

但念头一转到阜康，顿时如滚汤沃雪，
But the moment he thought of Fukang, the idea melted like snow under boiling water.

自觉是可笑的想法。
He saw how ridiculous it was.


看他眼神闪烁、脸上忽热忽冷，古应春大致也能猜到他心里，
Watching the flicker in Hu's eyes and the changing expression on his face, Gu could roughly guess his thoughts.

此时此地，心思决不可旁骛，
At such a time, he must not let his mind stray.

因而决定提醒他一番。
Gu decided to remind him.

“小爷叔，我刚才的话没有说完，
“I had not quite finished explaining, Little Uncle.

其实到阿彩那里去吃一顿饭，看起来也是无所谓的事，
A meal at A’cai's house might seem harmless enough.

不过，我怕阿彩冷了多少年的一段旧情，死灰复燃，
But I feared that feelings which had lain cold for years might flare up again.

而小爷叔你呢，一个人不得意的时候，最容易念旧，
As for you, a man in adversity is especially prone to dwell on old affections.

就算不会有笑话闹出来，总难免分你的心。
Even if nothing happened to set tongues wagging, it could hardly help distracting you.

是不是呢？”
Is that not so?”

“是的。”
“Yes.”

胡雪岩深深点头。
Hu nodded deeply.

“还有，看样子当初阿彩也是不得意才嫁阿利，
“And it seems that disappointment was what led her to marry A’li in the first place.

她总有看得阿利不如意的地方，
There must have been things about him that dissatisfied her.

事隔多年，老夫老妻，也忘记掉了。
Years have passed; as an old married couple, they have forgotten them.

不过，‘人比人，气煞人’，
But comparisons can be maddening.

有小爷叔你一出现，阿利的短处，在阿彩面上又看得很清楚了。”
Once you appear, all A’li's shortcomings may become plain to her again.”

“啊，啊！”
“Ah!”

胡雪岩很不安地说：
Hu looked uneasy.

“亏得你想到，
“Thank goodness you thought of that.

万一害他们夫妇不和，我这个孽就作得大了。”
If I caused trouble between them, I should have a great deal to answer for.”

他停了一下又问：
He paused.

“应春，你说我现在应该怎么办？”
“What do you think I ought to do now?”

古应春想了一下说：
Gu considered.

“我明白你的意思，要送阿利三千银子。
“I know you want to give A’li three thousand taels.

我来替你料理妥当。
Leave it to me to arrange properly.

不过，小爷叔，你明天要搬地方，省得纠缠。”
But you must move tomorrow, to avoid complications.”

“搬到哪里？”
“Where?”

“还是搬到我那里去住，
“Come and stay at my house.

一切方便。”
It will be more convenient in every way.”

“好！”胡雪岩很爽快地答应下来。
“Good!” Hu readily agreed.


于是古应春回去安排，约定第二天上午来接。
Gu went home to make the arrangements, promising to collect him the next morning.

胡雪岩静下来想一想，三千两银子了却当年的一笔人情债，是件很痛快的事，
Left alone, Hu reflected that settling an old debt of kindness with three thousand taels would be a deeply satisfying thing to do.

所以这一夜很难得地能够恬然人梦。
For once he fell asleep in peace.

一觉醒来，漱洗甫毕，古应春倒已经到了。
When he awoke and had barely finished washing, Gu arrived.

“你倒早。”
“You are early.”

“想陪小爷叔去吃碗茶。”古应春问道：
“I thought I would take you out for tea.

“昨天晚上睡得好不好。”
Did you sleep well?”

“交关好，
“Extremely well.

一觉到天亮。”
Straight through until daylight.”

“大概是路上辛苦了的缘故。”
“You must have been tired from the journey.”

“也不光是这一点。”
“It was more than that.

胡雪岩说：“实在说，是你提醒了我，这笔人情债能够了掉，而且干干净净，没有啥拖泥带水的麻烦，
The truth is, you showed me how to settle this debt of kindness cleanly, with no troublesome entanglements.

我心里很痛快，自然就睡得好了。”
That made me happy, and naturally I slept well.”

“银票我带来了。”
“I have brought the payment.

古应春又说，“我这么早来，一半也是为了办这件事。
That is part of the reason I came so early.

请吧，我们吃茶去。”
Come, let us have tea.”

城里吃茶，照常理说，自然是到城隍庙，
Normally, a man seeking tea in the Chinese city would go to the City God Temple.

但胡雪岩怕遇见熟人，古应春亦有这样的想法，
But Hu wished to avoid acquaintances, and Gu felt the same way.

所以走到街上，找到一家比较干净的茶馆，也不看招牌，便进去挑张桌子，坐了下来。
They found a reasonably clean teahouse on the street and went in without even looking at its sign.

哪知“冤家路窄”，
Yet chance would not leave them alone.

刚刚坐走便看到阿利进门。
They had barely sat down when A’li entered.

吃他们这行饭的，眼睛最尖不过，满面堆笑地前来招呼：
People in his line of business had exceptionally sharp eyes, and he came over beaming.

“胡老爷！
“Master Hu!

古老爷！”
Master Gu!”

“倒真巧！”古应春说：
“What a coincidence!” Gu said.

“请坐，请坐，
“Sit down.

我本来就要来看你。”
I was just going to see you.”

“不敢当，不敢当！
“You are too kind.

古老爷有啥吩咐？”
What can I do for you?”

古应春看着胡雪岩问：
Gu looked at Hu.

“小爷叔，是不是现在就谈？”
“Shall we discuss it now, Little Uncle?”

“稍微等一等。”
“Let us wait a moment.”

阿利自然不知道他们在谈些什么，
A’li had no idea what they meant.

只很兴奋地告诉胡雪岩：阿彩得知昨夜情形以后，说是“做梦都没有想到”。二十多年前，当掉夹袍子来吃白肉的客人，竟然就是天下无人不知的“胡财神”。
Excitedly he told Hu that, on hearing what had happened the night before, A’cai had said she could never have dreamed of it: the customer who had pawned his lined robe to eat boiled pork more than twenty years ago had become the universally famous God of Wealth.

真是太不可恩议了。
It was simply beyond belief.


“胡老爷，”阿利又说：“阿彩今天在店里，她是专门来等你老人家，
“A’cai is at the shop today especially to wait for you,” A’li continued.

她说她要看看胡老爷比起二十多年前，有啥不同的地方？”
“She says she wants to see how you have changed in more than twenty years.”

“有啥不同？”胡雪岩笑道：
“How have I changed?” Hu laughed.

“头发白了，皮肤皱了，肚皮鼓起来了。”阿利忽然笑了，笑得很稚气，“胡老爷，”他说：
“My hair has turned gray, my skin has wrinkled, and my belly has grown.” A’li suddenly laughed too, with an almost childish air.

“你不是说你自己，是在说阿彩，
“You are describing A’cai, not yourself.

头发白了，
Gray hair?

不多；
A little.

皮肤皱了，
Wrinkles?

有一点；
A few.

肚皮鼓起来了，那比胡老爷要大得多。”
But as for her belly, it is much bigger than yours!”

“怎么？”
“What?

胡雪岩说：“她有喜了？”
Is she expecting?”

“七个月了。”
“Seven months.”

阿利不好意思地笑一笑，得意之情，现于辞色。
A’li smiled bashfully, his pride plain in both voice and face.

“恭喜，恭喜！
“Congratulations!

阿利，你明年又添丁、又发财，
Next year you will have another child and prosper in business.

好好儿做。”
Work hard, A’li.”

胡雪岩站起身来说：
Hu rose.

“我到街上逛一逛，等下再来。”
“I shall take a walk and come back presently.”

古应春知道他的用意，
Gu understood his purpose.

将为了礼貌起身送胡雪岩的阿利拉了一把，
As A’li stood out of politeness to see Hu off, Gu caught his arm.

“你坐下来！”
“Sit down.

他说，“我有话同你说。”
I have something to tell you.”

“是！”
“Yes, sir.”

“啊利，遇见‘财神’是你的运气来了！
“Meeting the God of Wealth means your luck has turned, A’li.

可惜，稍为晚了一点，
Only it is a little late.

如果是去年这时候你遇见胡老爷，运气还要好。”
Had you met Master Hu this time last year, your luck would have been even better.”

说着，他从身上掏出皮夹子，取出一张花花绿绿的纸头，伸了过来，
Taking out his wallet, Gu drew forth a brightly printed slip of paper and held it out.

“阿利，你捏好，
“Keep this safely.

胡老爷送你的三千两银子。”
Master Hu is giving you three thousand taels.”


啊利愣住了！
A’li was stunned.

首先是不相信有人会慷慨到萍水相逢，便以巨款相赠的事，
At first he could not believe that anyone would give such an immense sum merely upon a chance meeting.

不过，“胡财神”的名声，加上昨夜小帐一赏八九两银子，可以改变他原来的想法。
Yet the fame of the God of Wealth, together with the eight or nine taels he had casually given as a tip the night before, could overturn A’li's previous assumptions.

但疑问又来了，
Then another doubt arose.

这位“财神”是真是假？
Was this God of Wealth genuine?

到底是不是胡雪岩？
Was he really Hu Xueyan?

会不会有什么言人的阴谋诡计在内？
Could there be some trap behind the gift?

这最后的一种想法，便只有上海人才有，
That last suspicion was particularly a Shanghai man's thought.

因为西风东渐以来，上海出现了许多从未见过的花样，
Since Western influences had reached the city, it had seen all sorts of previously unknown schemes.

譬如保险、纵火烧屋之外，人寿保险亦有意想不到的情节，而且往往是在穷人身上打主意，
Insurance had brought not only arson but unforeseen complications in life insurance as well, often involving the poor.

有人认丐作父，迎归奉养，保了巨额的寿险，然后设计慢性谋杀的法子，致之于死，骗取赔偿。
Someone might adopt a beggar as his father, bring him home and support him, insure his life for a vast sum, and then arrange his gradual murder to collect the money.

这种“新闻”已数见不鲜，所以阿利自然而然会有此疑虑。
Such stories were no longer unusual, and A’li naturally felt apprehensive.

不过，再多想一想，亦不至于，因为自问没有什么可以令人凯觎的。
On reflection, however, he could see no reason for it: he possessed nothing anyone would covet.

但最后的一种怀疑，却始终难释，
One final doubt remained.

这张花花绿绿的纸头，是啥名堂？何以能值三千两银子？
What was this gaudy piece of paper, and how could it be worth three thousand taels?

原来古应春带来的是一张汇丰银行的支票，
Gu had brought a cheque drawn on HSBC.

上面除了行名是中国字以外，其余都是蟹行文。
Apart from the bank's name, everything on it was written in the foreign script that ran sideways like a crab.

阿利知道钱庄的庄票，却从未见过外国银行的支票，
A’li knew Chinese bank drafts but had never seen a foreign bank cheque.

自然困惑万分。
No wonder he was bewildered.

古应春当然能够了解他呆若木鸡的原因。
Gu understood his stupefaction perfectly.

事实是最好的说明，
Facts would explain best.

“阿利！”他说，“我们现在就到外滩去一趟，
“Let us go to the Bund now.

你在汇丰照了票，叫他们开南市的庄票给你。”
Present it at HSBC and ask them to give you a draft on a bank in the Southern City.”

南市是上海县城，有别于北面的租界的一种称呼。
The Southern City meant the Chinese county town of Shanghai, distinguishing it from the settlements to the north.


原来是外国银行的支票，
So it was a cheque on a foreign bank.

阿利又惭愧，又兴奋，
A’li felt both embarrassed and excited.

但人情世故他也懂，总要说几句客气话，才是做人的道理，
But he knew enough of social propriety to realize that some polite demurral was necessary.

想一想答道：“古老爷，这样大的一笔数目，
After a moment he said, “It is such an enormous sum, Master Gu.

实在不敢收。
I really dare not accept it.

请古老爷陪了老爷一起来吃中饭，
Please come to lunch with Master Hu.

等阿彩见过了胡老爷再说。”
Let A’cai see him first, and then we can discuss it.”

“谢谢你们。胡老爷今天有事，恐怕不能到你们那里吃饭。
“Thank you, but he has business today and may not be able to come.

你先把支票收了，
Take the cheque first.

自己不去提，托钱庄代收也可以。”古应春问道：
If you do not wish to collect it yourself, a Chinese bank can do so for you.

“你们是同哪一家钱庄往来的？”
Which bank do you use?”

“申福。”
“Shenfu.”

“喔，申福，
“Shenfu?

老板姓朱，
Its proprietor is Mr Zhu.

我也认识的。
I know him too.

你把这张票子轧到申福去好了。”
Deposit the cheque there.”

这一下越见到其事真实，毫无可疑。
This made the gift's reality clearer than ever.

但老同和与申福往来，最多也不过两三百两银子，
Yet Laotonghe's dealings with Shenfu had never exceeded two or three hundred taels.

突然轧进一张三千两的支票，事出突兀，
A sudden cheque for three thousand would be extraordinary.

倘或申福问到，这张票子怎么来的？应该如何回答？
What could he say if they asked where it had come from?

“怎么？”古应春看到他阴阳怪气的神情，有些不大高兴，“阿利，莫非你当我同你开玩笑？”
Seeing his peculiar expression, Gu began to feel annoyed. “Surely you do not think I am joking?”

“不是，不是！
“No, no!

古老爷，你误会了，
You misunderstand.

说实话，我是怕人家会问。”
The truth is, I am afraid people will ask questions.”

这一下倒提醒了古应春。
That brought something home to Gu.

原来他替胡雪岩与洋人打交道，购买军火，以及他自己与洋商有生意往来，支付货款，都开外国银行的支票，
When buying arms from foreigners for Hu, or paying foreign firms in his own business, he used foreign bank cheques.

在钱庄里的名气很大，
He was well known among the Chinese banks.

他的英文名字叫William ，昵称Billy ，那些喜欢“寻开心”的“洋行小鬼”，连他的姓在内，替他起了个谐音的外号叫“屁股”。申福钱庄如果问到这张支票的来历，阿利据实回答，传出去说胡雪岩的钱庄倒了人家的存款，自己依旧大肆挥霍，三千两银子还一个人情债，
His English name was William, shortened to Billy; the mischievous young Chinese clerks in foreign firms had joined this to his surname, Gu, and given him the teasing nickname pigu, “buttocks.” If Shenfu asked about this cheque and A’li answered truthfully, word would spread that Hu's bank had defaulted on people's deposits while he himself continued to squander money, spending three thousand taels to repay a personal kindness.

简直毫无心肝。
People would call him utterly heartless.

这对胡雪岩非常不利，不能不慎重考虑。
This would be extremely damaging to Hu and required careful consideration.


情势有点尴尬，
The situation was awkward.

古应春心里在想：人不能倒霉，倒起霉来，有钱都会没法子用。
Gu reflected that a man must not fall on bad times: once he did, he could not spend even the money he still had.

为今之计，只有先把阿利敷衍走了，再作道理。
For the moment, Gu could only put A’li off and think of another solution.

于是他说：“阿利，你先把这张支票拿了。
“Take the cheque first,” he said.

回头我看胡老爷能不能来？
“I shall see whether Master Hu can come.

能来，一起来，不能来，我一个人一定来。
If he can, we shall both come; if not, I shall certainly come myself.

支票是轧到申福，还是到汇丰去提现，等我来了再说。
We can decide then whether to deposit it at Shenfu or collect cash at HSBC.”

““古老爷，”阿利答说：“支票我决不敢收，
“I really dare not accept it, Master Gu.

胡老爷一定请了来，不然我回去要‘吃排头’。”
You must bring Master Hu, or I shall get a scolding when I go home.”

因为人家已经知道他怕老婆，所以他对可能会挨阿彩的骂，亦无需隐讳了。
They already knew he was afraid of his wife, so he saw no need to conceal the likelihood of being berated by A’cai.

“好！好！
“Very well.

我尽量办到。
I shall do my best.

你有事先请吧！”
Do not let me keep you from your business.”

等阿利殷殷作别而去，胡雪岩接着也回来了，
A’li took an earnest leave, and Hu returned soon afterward.

古应春半刚才的那番情形，约为提了一下，
Gu briefly explained what had happened.

表示先将胡雪岩送回家，他另外换用庄票，再单独去赴阿利之约。
He would first take Hu home, exchange the cheque for Chinese bank drafts, and then visit A’li alone.

“不必多跑一趟了。
“There is no need for the extra journey.

我带了十几张票子在那里，
I have a dozen or more drafts at the inn.

先凑了给他。
We can make up the sum from those.

我们先回客栈。”
Let us go back there first.”

到得客栈，胡雪岩打开皮包，取出一叠银票，两张一千、两张五百，凑成三千，
At the inn, Hu opened his leather bag and took out a sheaf of drafts: two for a thousand taels and two for five hundred, making three thousand in all.

交到古应春手里时，心头一酸，几乎掉泪——
As he handed them to Gu, grief struck him so sharply that he almost wept.

自己开钱庄，“阜康”这块响当当的金字招牌，如今分文不值，
He owned a bank himself; once the name Fukang had carried enormous weight, and now it was not worth a penny.

要用山西票号的银票给人家，
To give someone money, he had to use drafts issued by Shanxi remittance houses.

真正是穷途末路了。
He had truly reached the end of his road.


古应春不曾注意到他的脸色，
Gu did not notice Hu's expression.

拿起四张庄票，匆匆而去，
He took the four drafts and hurried out.

在客栈门口，跨上一辆刚从日本传来的“东洋车”，说一声“老同和”，
At the inn door he climbed into one of the “Japanese carriages” newly introduced from Japan and told the puller, “Laotonghe.”

人力车硬橡皮轮子，隆隆然地滚过石板呼，
The rickshaw's hard rubber wheels rumbled over the stone paving.

拉到半路，听见有人在叫：“古老爷，古老爷！”
Halfway there, he heard someone calling, “Master Gu!”

一听声音，古应春心想，幸而是来替人还人情，倘或是欠了人家的债，冤家路窄，
Recognizing the voice, Gu thought how fortunate it was that he was repaying another man's kindness rather than a debt of his own.

一上午遇见两次，真是巧了。
To meet the same man twice in one morning: what a coincidence!

“停停，停停！”
“Stop!”

等东洋车在路边停了下来，阿利也就迎上来了。
When the rickshaw drew up at the roadside, A’li came over.

“车钱到老同和来拿。”
“Collect your fare at Laotonghe.”

车夫是阿利认识的，
He knew the puller.

关照了这一句，他转脸对古应春说：“古老爷，我家就在前面弄堂里，
Turning to Gu, he said, “My house is just ahead, in the lane.

请过去坐一坐。
Please come and sit a while.

胡老爷呢？”
Where is Master Hu?”

“他有事情不来了。”
“He has business and cannot come.

古应春问：“你太太呢？”
Where is your wife?”

“现在还在家，
“Still at home.

等一下就要到店里去了。”
She will go to the shop presently.”

古应春心想，在他店里谈件事，难免惹人注目，
Discussing the matter at the restaurant might attract attention, Gu thought.

倒不如去他家的好，
Their house would be better.

于是连连点头：
He nodded readily.

“好！好！
“Very well.

我到你家里去谈。”
Let us talk at your house.”

于是阿利领路走不多远，便已到达。他家是半新不旧的弄堂房子，
A’li led him a short distance to a lane house, neither new nor particularly old.

进石库门是个天井，
Inside its stone-framed gateway was a small courtyard.

阿利仰脸喊道：“客人来了！”
A’li looked up and called, “We have a guest!”

语声甫毕，楼窗中一个中年妇人，探头来望，
A middle-aged woman leaned out of an upstairs window.

想必就是阿彩了。
She must be A’cai.

古应春不暇细看，随着阿利踏进堂屋，楼梯上已有响声了。
Gu had no time to look closely before following A’li into the main room, where they could already hear footsteps on the stairs.

“阿彩，赶紧泡茶！”
“A’cai, make some tea!”

“是你太太？”
“That is your wife?”

“叫她阿彩好了。”
“Just call her A’cai.”

阿彩下楼，从堂屋后面的一扇门，挺着个大肚子闪了出来，
She came through a doorway at the back of the room, her pregnant belly prominent.

她穿得整整齐齐，脸上薄施脂粉，含笑问道：
Neatly dressed and lightly powdered, she smiled.

“这位想来是古老爷？”
“You must be Master Gu.”


“不敢当。”
“You are too kind.”

“胡老爷呢？”
“Where is Master Hu?”

“有事情不来了。”是阿利代为回答。
“He has business and cannot come,” A’li answered for him.

阿彩脸上浮现出的失望神色，便如许了孩子去逛城隍庙，看变把戏，吃南翔馒头、酒酿圆子，新衣服都换好了，却突然宣布，有事不能去了那样，
The disappointment on A’cai's face was like that of a child promised an outing to the City God Temple to watch tricks and eat Nanxiang steamed buns and sweet fermented-rice dumplings, already dressed in new clothes, only to be told that something had come up and the outing was canceled.

直可谓之惨不忍睹，以至于古应春不能不将视线避了开去。
It was so painful to witness that Gu had to look away.

不过阿彩仍旧能若无其事地尽她做主妇的道理，
Yet she continued to perform her duties as hostess as though nothing had happened.

亲自捧来细瓷的盖碗茶，还开了一罐虽已传到上海，但平常人家很少见的英国“茄力克”纸烟。
She personally brought tea in fine porcelain covered cups and opened a tin of English “Jialike” cigarettes, already available in Shanghai but seldom seen in an ordinary household.

显然，她是细心安排了来接待胡雪岩的。
Clearly she had prepared with great care to receive Hu.

但如说她是“接财神”，古应春便觉得毫无歉意，
If all she wanted, however, was to welcome the God of Wealth, Gu need feel no regret.

探手入杯，将一把银票捏在手里，开口问道：
Reaching inside his coat, he took the drafts in his hand.

“阿利老板，你贵姓？”
“May I ask your surname, Mr A’li?”

“小姓是朱。”
“Zhu.”

“喔，”
“Ah.

古应春叫一声：“朱太太，听说你们房子要翻造，扩充门面，
Mrs Zhu, I hear you intend to rebuild and enlarge your premises.

胡老爷很高兴，
Master Hu was delighted.

他有三千两银子托我带来送你们。”
He has asked me to bring you three thousand taels as a gift.”


其实阿彩亦非薄漂母而不为，
It was not that A’cai scorned the washerwoman who had once fed the impoverished Han Xin and later accepted his reward.

而是“千金”与“韩信”之间，更看重的是后者。
But between the thousand pieces of gold and Han Xin himself, she valued the man more.

从前一天晚上，得知有此意外机缘之后，她就有种无可言喻的亢奋，
Ever since hearing of the unexpected encounter the night before, she had felt an indescribable excitement.

絮絮不断地跟阿利说，当时她是如何看得胡雪岩必有出息，
Over and over she told A’li how she had recognized Hu's promise all those years ago.

但也承认，做梦也没有想到他会创这么一番大事业，
Even so, she admitted that she had never dreamed he would build so great an enterprise.

而这番大事业又会垮于旦夕之间，因而又生了一种眼看英雄末路的怜惜。
And to see that enterprise collapse overnight awakened her pity for a hero brought to the end of his fortunes.

这些悲喜交集的复杂情绪夹杂在一起，害得她魂梦不安了一夜。
These mingled feelings of joy and sorrow had disturbed her dreams all night.

及至这天上午，听阿利谈了他在茶馆中与胡雪岩、古应春不期而遇的经过，以及他对那张汇丰银行支票的困惑，阿彩便嗔怪他处理不当，
That morning, when A’li described his chance meeting with the two men and his bewilderment over the HSBC cheque, she reproached him for handling it badly.

照她的意思是，这笔巨款尽可不受，
They need not accept the enormous gift.

但不妨照古应春的意思，先到汇丰银行照一照票，等证实无误，却不必提取，将古应春请到老同和或家里来，
But he could have followed Gu to HSBC and had the cheque verified, without collecting the money, and then invited Gu to Laotonghe or home.

只要缠住了古应春，自然而然地也就拉住了胡雪岩。
Once they held on to Gu, Hu would naturally be drawn in as well.

她的判断不错，古应春一定会来，
She was right that Gu would certainly come.

但胡雪岩是否见得到，却很难说，
Whether she could see Hu was another matter.

因而患得患失地坐立不安，
Torn between hope and fear, she could not sit still.

到此刻她还不肯死心，
Even now she refused to give up.

心里有句话不便说出来：“你三千两银子除非胡老爷亲手送给我我不会收。”
There was something she could not say aloud: “Unless Master Hu puts the three thousand taels into my own hands, I shall not accept them.”

就因为有这样一种想法，所以她并未表示坚辞不受，
For that reason, her refusal was not absolute.

彼此推来让去，古应春渐渐发觉她的本意，
As they exchanged offers and demurrals, Gu gradually understood her real purpose.

但当着阿利，他亦不便说得太露骨，只好作个暗示。
In A’li's presence, however, he could only hint.

“朱太太，”他说：“胡老爷是我的好朋友，他的心境我很清楚，
“Mrs Zhu, Master Hu is a close friend, and I know his state of mind.

如果早些日子，他会很高兴来同你谈谈当年落魄的情形，
A little earlier, he would gladly have come to talk about those poor days.

现在实在没有这种心情，也没有工夫。
Now he has neither the heart nor the time.

你收了这笔银子，让他了掉一桩心事，
Accept this money and let him settle something that weighs on him.

就是体谅他，帮他的忙；
That would show consideration and help him.

等他的麻烦过去，你们老同和老店新开的时候，我一定拉了他来道喜，好好儿吃一顿酒。”
Once his troubles are over and Laotonghe reopens, I shall certainly bring him to congratulate you, and we shall have a good meal together.”


“是的，是的。”阿彩口中答应着，双眼却不断眨动，
“Yes, yes,” A’cai murmured, blinking repeatedly.

显然只是随口附和，心中别有念头，
She was plainly agreeing only out of politeness, with other thoughts in her mind.

等古应春说完，她看着她丈夫说：
When Gu finished, she turned to her husband.

“你到店里去一趟，叫大司务把菜送了来，
“Go to the shop and tell the head cook to send the dishes here.

请古老爷在家里吃饭。”
Master Gu will eat with us at home.”

“不必，不必！”
“No, please!”

古应春连连摇手，
Gu waved his hands.

“我有事。
“I have business.

多谢！多谢！”
Thank you all the same.”

“去啊！”阿彩没有理他的话，管自己催促阿利。
A’cai ignored him. “Go!” she urged A’li.

阿利自然奉命唯谨，说一声：“古老爷不必客气。”掉头就走。
Obedient as ever, he said, “You must not stand on ceremony, Master Gu,” and went out.

这是阿彩特意遣开丈夫，有些心里的话要吐露，
She had deliberately sent her husband away so that she could speak her heart.

“古老爷，”她面色深沉地说：“我实在没有想到，今生今世，还会遇见二十几年前的老客人；
“Master Gu,” she said gravely, “I never imagined I would meet that old customer again in this life, after more than twenty years.

更没有想到，当年当了夹袍来吃饭的客人，就是名气这样子大的胡财神。
Still less could I have imagined that the man who pawned his robe for a meal was the famous God of Wealth.

古老爷，不瞒你说，我昨天晚上一夜没有睡着，
To tell you the truth, I did not sleep all night.

因为这桩事情，想起来想不完。”
There seemed no end to the thoughts it brought me.”

说着，将一双眼睛低了下去，
She lowered her eyes.

眼角微显晶莹，似乎泪水要流出来。
Moisture glimmered at their corners, as though tears were about to fall.

古应春当然能体会她的心情，故意不答，
Gu understood her feelings, but deliberately said nothing.

他觉得既不能问，更不能劝慰，只要有这样一句话，她的眼泪就会忍不住，
He must neither question nor console her: a single word might release her tears.

惟有保持沉默，才能让她静静地自我克制。
Only silence would allow her to regain control in peace.

果然，停了一会，阿彩复又抬眼，平静地说道：
After a while, she raised her eyes and spoke calmly.

“古老爷，请你告诉胡老爷，我决不能收他这笔钱，
“Please tell Master Hu I cannot accept his money.

第一，他现在正是为难的时候，
First, he is in difficulties himself.

我收了他的这笔钱，于心不安；
My conscience would trouble me if I took it.

第二，我收了他的这笔钱，变成我亏欠他了，
Second, if I accepted it, I should become the one indebted to him.

也没有啥好想的了。”
There would be nothing left to cherish in my thoughts.”


古应春觉得事态严重了，比他所想象的还要严重，
Gu felt that matters had become serious, more serious than he had imagined.

这三千两银子，可能会引起他们夫妇之间的裂痕。
The three thousand taels might open a breach between husband and wife.

转念到此，颇为不安，也深悔自己多事。
This troubled him, and he deeply regretted involving himself.

细细想去，要割断她这一缕从云外飘来的情丝，还是得用“泉刀”这样的利器，于是他说：
On reflection, the sharp blade of money remained the best means of severing this thread of affection that had drifted down from distant clouds.

“朱太太，我说一句不怕你见气的话，
“Mrs Zhu, I hope you will not take offense.

如果说，胡老爷现在三千两银子部花不起，你未免太小看他了。
If you think Master Hu can no longer afford three thousand taels, you underestimate him.”

朱太太，”古应春将声音压得低低地，同时两眼逼视着她，“我有两句肺腑之言，
Lowering his voice and looking straight into her eyes, he continued, “There are a couple of things I should like to say from the heart.

不晓得你要不要听？”
Are you willing to hear them?”

“当然要听。”
“Of course.”

“只怕我说得太直。”
“I am afraid I may speak too plainly.”

“不要紧，
“It does not matter.

没有旁人在这里。”
There is nobody else here.”

这表示连阿利不能听的话都能说，
That meant he might say even what A’li must not hear.

古应春便不作任何顾忌了，
Gu put aside his remaining scruples.

“朱太太，”他说：“三千两银子，不是一个小数日，而况是号称财神的胡老爷送你的，更何况人家是为了完当年的一笔人情债，
“Three thousand taels is no small sum, Mrs Zhu, especially when it is a gift from the man known as the God of Wealth, given to repay an old kindness.

送的人光明正大，受的人正大光明。
The giver has nothing to conceal, and neither has the recipient.

朱老板如果问一句：你为啥不收？请问你怎么同他说？
If your husband asks why you will not accept it, what are you going to tell him?”

“阿彩根本没有想到阿利，
A’cai had not considered A’li at all.

如今古应春提出来一问，才发现自己确有难以交代之处。
Only now did she realize that she would have difficulty explaining herself.

见她语塞，古应春知道“攻心”已经生效，便穷追猛打地又钉一句：
Seeing her at a loss for words, Gu knew he had struck home and pressed the point.

“莫非你说，我心里的那段情，万金不换，
“Will you say, ‘All the gold in the world could not buy the feeling I cherish.

三千两算得了什么？”
What are three thousand taels to me?’”

“我当然有我的说法。”
“Naturally I shall have my own explanation.”

这是遁词，
It was an evasion.

古应春觉得不必再追，可以从正面来劝她了。
Gu felt there was no need to press further; he could now appeal to her directly.


“不管你怎么说，朱老板嘴里不敢同你争，心里不会相信的。
“Whatever you say, your husband may not dare argue, but in his heart he will not believe you.

这样子，夫妇之间，就有一道裂痕了。
That will open a breach between you.

二十几年的夫妇，你肚皮里还有个老来子，
You have been married more than twenty years; you are carrying another child in your later years.

有这三千两银子，将老同和老店新开，扩充门面，兴兴旺旺做人家，
With these three thousand taels, you can rebuild Laotonghe, expand the business, and make a prosperous home.

连你们死掉的老老板，在阴世里都会高兴。
Even your late father would be pleased in the world below.

这种好日子不过，要自寻烦恼，害得一家人家可能会拆散，何苦？
Why throw away such good days, seek out trouble, and risk breaking up your family?

再说，胡老爷现在的环境，几千银子还不在乎，精神上经不起打击，
Besides, in Master Hu's present circumstances, a few thousand taels do not matter so much, but emotionally he cannot bear another blow.

他因为能先还笔人情债，心里很高兴，
He was delighted that he could settle this old debt of kindness first.

昨天晚上睡了个把月以来从没有睡过的好觉。
Last night he slept better than at any time in the past month or more.

倘或晓得你有这种想法，他心里一定不安，他现在经不起再加什么烦恼了。
If he knew what was in your mind, it would trouble him, and he cannot stand any further worries now.

总而言之，你收了这笔银子，让他了掉一桩心事，就是帮他的忙。
In a word, accepting the money and relieving him of this concern will help him.

不然，说得不客气一点，等于存心害他！
Otherwise, to speak bluntly, it is as though you were deliberately trying to hurt him.

朱太太，你不是十七八岁的姑娘了，
You are no longer a girl of seventeen or eighteen, Mrs Zhu.

而且有儿有女，
You have a son and a daughter.

闹出笑话来，不好听。”
It would not sound well if people began talking.”

这长篇大套一番话，将想得到的道理都说尽了，
This long speech exhausted every argument he could think of.

阿彩听得惊心动魄，
A’cai listened, deeply shaken.

终于如梦方醒似地说了一句：“我收！
At last, as though waking from a dream, she said, “I shall take it.

请古老爷替我谢谢胡老爷。”
Please thank Master Hu for me.”

“对啊！”
“That is right!”

古应春大为欣慰，少不得乘机恭维她几句：
Greatly relieved, Gu could not resist adding some compliments.

“我就晓得你是有见识、讲道理、顾大局的人。
“I knew you were a woman of judgment and reason, who could see the larger picture.

朱太太，照你的面相，真所谓‘地角方圆’，是难得的福相，
Your face, with its broad, well-rounded lower contours, is the very image of good fortune.

走到一步帮夫运，着实有一番后福好享。”
When you enter a period that brings prosperity to your husband, there will be a great deal of happiness waiting for you in later life.”


说着，他将捏在手里的一把银票摊开来，三张“蔚丰厚”，一张“百川通”，
He spread out the drafts in his hand: three issued by Weifenghou and one by Baichuantong.

这两家票号在山西帮中居领袖地位，联号遍布南北，商场中无人不知的。
Both were leading Shanxi remittance houses, with branches throughout the north and south, known to everyone in commerce.

“朱太太，你收好。”
“Keep these safely, Mrs Zhu.”

“古老爷，其实你给我阜康的票了好了。”
“You could really have given me Fukang drafts instead.”

阿彩也知道阜康已经在清理，票款能收到几成，尚不可知，
A’cai knew that Fukang was already settling its affairs and that no one yet knew what proportion of a draft's value would be paid.

所以如此说法，亦依旧是由于一种不愿接受赠款的心理。
Her remark still sprang from a reluctance to accept the gift.

古应春明白这一点，却正好借此道出胡雪岩的心境。
Gu understood, and took the opportunity to explain Hu's feelings.

“朱太太，这四张银票，是胡老爷身上摸出来的。
“These four drafts came out of Master Hu's own pocket.

不过一个多月以前，阜康的名气比蔚丰厚、百川通响亮得多，
Only a little more than a month ago, Fukang's name stood higher than either Weifenghou's or Baichuantong's.

而现在，只好用人家的票子了。
Now he has to use other people's paper.

你倒想，换了你是他，
Imagine yourself in his place.

还人啥心思回想当初当了夹袍子来吃白肉的情形？”
Would you have any heart to recall the days when you pawned your lined robe for a plate of boiled pork?”

阿彩爽然若失，
A’cai felt a blank sense of loss.

慢条斯理地一面理银票，一面说道：“胡老爷自然不在乎这三千银子，
Slowly arranging the drafts, she said, “Of course he does not mind the three thousand taels.

不过在我来说，总是无功受禄。”
But for me, it is still a reward I have done nothing to deserve.”

“不是，不是！
“Not at all!

我想你们在城隍庙听说书，总听过韩信的故事，
Surely you have heard storytellers at the City God Temple tell the story of Han Xin.

一饭之恩，千金以报，
He repaid a single meal with a thousand pieces of gold.

没有哪个说漂母不应该收。”
No one ever said the washerwoman should have refused.”


“那，我就算漂母好了，
“Then I shall be the washerwoman.

人家问起来……”
If people ask...”

“喔，喔，”
“Ah!”

古应春被提醒了，急急打断她的话说：
Reminded of something, Gu hastily interrupted.

“朱太太，有件事，请你同朱老板一定要当心，
“There is one thing you and your husband must be very careful about.

千万不好说：胡财神送了你们三千两银子。
Never say that the God of Wealth gave you three thousand taels.

那一来，人家会说闲话。
People would gossip.

这一点关系重大，切切不可说出去。
This is extremely important: you must not tell anyone.

千万，千万。”
Please, whatever you do, remember that.”

见他如此郑重叮嘱，阿彩自然连连点头，表示充分领会。
His insistence made A’cai nod repeatedly, showing that she understood completely.

“古老爷，”阿彩说道：“我晓得你事情忙，不留你吃饭了。
“I know you are busy, Master Gu, so I shall not keep you to lunch.

不过，古老爷，你要把府上的地址告诉我，
But you must give me your address.

改天我要给古太太去请安。”
Another day I should like to call and pay my respects to your wife.”

“请安不敢当。
“There is no need for ceremony.

内人病在床上，
My wife is ill in bed.

几时你来陪她谈谈，我们很欢迎。”
Whenever you can come and talk with her, you will be very welcome.”

古应春留下了地址，告辞出门，
Gu left his address and took his leave.

回想经过，自觉做了一件很潇洒的事，胸怀为之一宽。
Looking back over what had happened, he felt he had handled the matter with some elegance, and his heart grew lighter.



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第十章（全章）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Ten (complete)
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第十章 不堪回首｜CHAPTER TEN: THE PAST TOO PAINFUL TO RECALL


见了七姑奶奶，彼此都有隔世之感，
When Hu Xueyan met the Seventh Lady, both felt as though a lifetime had passed.

两人对望着，忍不住心酸落泪——
Looking at one another, they could not keep back their tears.

一个月不见，头上都添了许多白发，
In a month apart, each had acquired many more white hairs.

但自己并不在意，要看了对方，才知道忧能伤人，
Neither had thought much of their own; only on seeing the other did they understand how worry could ravage a person.

尤其是胡雪岩，想到病中的七姑奶奶，为他的事焦忧如此，真忍不往想放声一恸。
Hu, above all, felt like weeping aloud at the thought that the Seventh Lady, already ill herself, had been so distressed on his account.

每一回见了面，七姑奶奶第一个要问的是胡老太太，
Whenever they met, her first inquiry was usually after Old Madam Hu.

只有这一次例外，因为她怕一问，必定触及胡雪岩伤心之处，所以不敢问。
This time alone she made an exception, afraid that the question would touch his deepest sorrow.

但螺蛳太太却是怎么样也不能不问的。
But she could not avoid asking about Madam Luosi.

“罗四姐呢？
“And Sister Luo?

只怕也老了好多。”
She must have aged a great deal too.”

“怎么不是！
“Indeed she has!

如今多亏她。”
I depend on her now.”

胡雪岩接下来谈了许多人情冷暖的境况。
Hu went on to describe many instances of the warmth and coldness of human relations.

七姑奶奶的眼圈红红的，不时有泪珠渗出来。
The Seventh Lady’s eyes were red, and tears kept gathering.

“息一息吧！”瑞香不时来打岔，希望阻断他们谈那些令人伤感的事，
“Rest a little,” Ruixiang interrupted from time to time, hoping to stop these distressing conversations.

最后终于忍不住了，
At last she could bear it no longer.

用命令的语气说：“要吃药睡觉了。”
“It is time for your medicine and sleep,” she ordered.

“喔，喔！”
“Yes, yes!”

胡雪岩不免歉疚，
Hu felt guilty.

“七姐，你好好儿息一息，心放宽来，
“Rest properly, Seventh Sister, and do not worry.

有应春帮我，难关一定过得去。”
With Yingchun helping me, I shall certainly get through.”

于是古应春陪着胡雪岩下楼，
Gu accompanied him downstairs.

刚在书房中坐定，听差来报，有客相访，递上名片一看，是电报局译电房的一个领班沈兰生。
They had just settled in the study when a servant brought a visitor’s card: Shen Lansheng, a shift supervisor in the telegraph bureau’s decoding room.

“大概是杭州有复电来了。”古应春将名片递给胡雪岩，
“Probably a reply from Hangzhou,” Gu said, handing Hu the card.

“此人是好朋友，
“He is a good friend.

小爷叔要不要见一见？”
Would you like to meet him?”

“不罗！”
“No.

胡雪岩说，“我还是不露面的好。”
I had better stay out of sight.”

“也好！”
“Very well.”

古应春点点头，出书房到客厅去会沈兰生。
Gu went to receive him in the drawing room.


书房与客厅只是一墙之隔，房门未关，所以古、沈二人交谈的声音，清晰可闻。
Only a wall separated the drawing room from the study, and the door stood open, so Hu could hear their conversation clearly.

“有两个电报，跟胡观察有关，
“There are two telegrams concerning Circuit Intendant Hu.

我特为抄了一份送来。”
I made copies specially and brought them over.”

是陌生的声音，当然是沈兰生。
The unfamiliar voice must be Shen’s.

接下来便没有声音了。
Silence followed.

胡雪岩忍不住从门缝中张望，
Unable to restrain himself, Hu peered through the gap in the door.

原来没有声音是因为古应春正在看电报。
Gu was reading the messages.

“承情之至。”古应春看完电报对沈兰生说：
“I am deeply obliged,” he said when he had finished.

“如果另外有什么消息，不分日夜，务必随时见告。
“If there is any further news, please let me know immediately, day or night.

老兄这样子帮忙，我转告胡观察，
I shall tell Intendant Hu of your help.

一定会有酬谢。”
He will certainly show his gratitude.”

“谈不到此。
“There is no question of that.

我不过是为胡观察不平，
I merely feel he has been unjustly treated.

能效绵薄，聊尽我心而已。”
If I can do a little to help, it will satisfy my conscience.”

“是，是。
“Yes, indeed.

胡观察这两天也许会到上海来，
He may be coming to Shanghai in the next day or two.

到时候我约老兄见兄面。”
I shall arrange for you to meet him then.”

“好，好！
“Very good.

我告辞了。”
I shall take my leave.”

等古应春送客出门，回到书房时，只见他脸色凝重异常，
After seeing his visitor out, Gu returned to the study with an unusually grave expression.

显然的，那两个电报不是什么好消息。
Plainly the two telegrams contained bad news.

“应春，”胡雪岩泰然地问。“电报呢？怎么说？”
“Yingchun,” Hu asked calmly, “what do they say?”

“竞想不到的事。”
“Something entirely unexpected.”

古应春将两份电报递给了他。
Gu handed him the copies.


这两份电报是《申报》驻北京的访员发来的两道上谕，
They contained two imperial decrees telegraphed by the Shenbao’s Beijing correspondent.

第一道先引述顺天府府尹周家楣，以及管理顺天府的大臣，左都御史毕道远的复奏，
The first began by citing the report of Zhou Jiamei, prefect of Shuntian, and Left Censor-in-Chief Bi Daoyuan, the senior official supervising the prefecture.

说奉旨彻查协办大学士刑部尚书文煜在阜康福存款的经过，指出有一笔存银四十六万两，
Ordered to investigate the Fukangfu deposits of Assistant Grand Secretary and Minister of Punishments Wenyu, they had discovered a deposit of 460,000 taels.

其中十万两为前江西藩司文辉所有，而据文辉声称，系托文煜经手代存；
Of this, 100,000 belonged to Wenhui, formerly provincial treasurer of Jiangxi, who said he had entrusted Wenyu with depositing it for him.

另外三十六万两，帐簿上只注“文宅”字样，是否文煜所有，不得而知。
The remaining 360,000 appeared in the books merely under “Wen Household”; whether it belonged to Wenyu could not be determined.

象这样的案子，照例“着由文煜明白回奏”。
In such cases the usual instruction was to “order Wenyu to submit a clear explanation.”

文煜倒说得很坦白，
His answer had been frank enough.

他在这二十年中，曾获得多次税差，自福建内调后，又数蒙派充“崇文门监督”，
During the past twenty years he had received numerous revenue appointments; since his transfer from Fujian to the capital, he had repeatedly served as superintendent of the Chongwen Gate customs.

廉傣所积，加上平日省俭，故在阜康福存银三十六万两。
His accumulated official pay and allowances, together with habitual economy, accounted for the 360,000 taels deposited at Fukangfu.

上谕认为他“所称尚属实情”，不过“为数稍多”，责成他捐出十万一两，以充公用。
The decree accepted his explanation as “substantially truthful,” but considered the amount “somewhat large” and ordered him to contribute 100,000 taels for public use.

这十万两银子，由顺天府自阜康福提出，解交户部。
Shuntian prefecture was to withdraw the money from Fukangfu and remit it to the Ministry of Revenue.

“应春，”胡雪岩看完这一个电报以后说：“托你跟京号联络一下，
“Yingchun,” Hu said after reading this message, “contact our Beijing branch.

这十万两银子，一定要马上凑出来，
Those hundred thousand taels must be assembled immediately.

最好不等顺天府来催，自己送到户部。”
Better to send them to the Ministry ourselves before Shuntian presses us.”

“小爷叔，”古应春另有意见，“我看要归入整个清理案去办，
“I think this should be dealt with as part of the general liquidation,” Gu objected.

我们似乎可以观望观望。”
“Perhaps we can wait and see.”

“不！
“No.

这是一文都不能少的，
Not a single coin can be withheld.

迟交不如早交。”
Better to pay early than late.”

“好！
“Very well.

既然小爷叔这么说，我就照你的意思办好了。”
I shall do as you wish.

古应春又说：“请先看了第二个电报再说。”
But read the second telegram first.”


一看第二个电报，胡雪岩不觉色变，但很快地恢复如常，
Hu’s expression changed when he read it, though he quickly recovered.

“这是给左大人出了一个难题。”
“This gives Lord Zuo a difficult problem.”

他沉吟了一会问：“左大人想来已接到‘廷寄’了？”
After a moment he asked, “He will have received the court dispatch already, I suppose?”

“当然。”
“Of course.”

“这里呢？”
“And here?

胡雪岩说：“明天《申报》一登出来，大家都晓得了。”
Once it appears in tomorrow’s Shenbao, everyone will know.”

“明天还不会，
“Not tomorrow.

总要后天才会见报。”
It will not appear until the day after.”

胡雪岩紧闭着嘴沉吟了好一会：
Hu remained silent for some time, his lips firmly closed.

“这件事不能瞒七姐。”
“We cannot hide this from Seventh Sister.”

“是的。”
“No.”

古应春停了一下又说：
Gu paused.

“她说过，就怕走到这一步。”
“She said she feared it would come to this.”

“她说过？”
“She said that?”

“说地。”
“Yes.”

古应春还能说出准确的日期，
Gu could give the exact date.

“四天以前跟我说的。”
“Four days ago.”

“好！”
“Good!”

胡雪岩矍然而起：
Hu rose abruptly.

“七姐能看到这一步，她一定替我想过，
“If she could foresee this, she must have been considering what I ought to do.

有四天想下来，事情看得很透彻了。
Four days will have given her time to think it through.

我们去同她商量。”
Let us consult her.”

于是古应春陪着他复又上楼。
Gu accompanied him upstairs again.

脚步声惊动了瑞香，蹑着足迎了出来，先用两指撮口，示意轻声。
Hearing their steps, Ruixiang came softly out and held two fingers to her lips.

“刚睡着。”
“She has just fallen asleep.”

古应春还未答话，胡雪岩已拉一拉他的衣服，放轻脚步踏下楼梯。
Before Gu could answer, Hu tugged at his clothes and began quietly descending the stairs.

回到书房的胡雪岩，似乎已胸有成竹，说话不再是瞻顾踌躇的神气了。
Back in the study, he seemed to have formed a plan; his manner was no longer hesitant.

“应春，你替我去跟沈兰生打个招呼，
“Go and speak to Shen Lansheng for me.

看要怎么谢他，请你做主。
You decide how we should thank him.

顶要紧的是务必请他不要张扬。”
Above all, ask him not to spread the news.”

“我刚才已经关照他了。”
“I told him that already.”

“再钉一钉的好。
“Better to impress it on him again.

顺便到集贤里去一趟，
And call at Jixian Lane on the way.

告诉老宓，我住在这里。”
Tell Old Mi that I am staying here.

胡雪岩又说：“我趁七姐现在休息，好好儿想一想，
While Seventh Sister rests, I shall think everything over.

等你回来，七姐也醒了，我们再商量。”
By the time you return she should be awake, and we can discuss it together.”


卧室中只有三个人，连瑞香亦不得其闻。
There were only three people in the bedroom; even Ruixiang was excluded.

七姑奶奶果然心理上早有准备，
The Seventh Lady had indeed prepared herself for the news.

当胡雪岩拿电报给她看时，她平静地问：“是不是京里打来的？”
When Hu handed her the telegram, she asked calmly, “Has it come from Beijing?”

“是军机处的一道上谕。”古应春说：
“It is an imperial decree sent through the Grand Council,” Gu answered.

“让你说中了。”
“You predicted correctly.”

“我变成乌鸦嘴了。”
“Then I have become a crow croaking misfortune.”

她问她丈夫说：“上谕不是啥七个字一句的唱本，
Turning to her husband, she said, “A decree is no songbook in seven-character lines.

我句子都读不断，总还有不认识的字，
I cannot even tell where its sentences end, and there will be characters I do not know.

你念给我听！”
Read it to me.”

于是古应春缓慢地念道：“现在阜康商号闭歇，亏欠公项及多处存款，为数甚巨。
Gu read slowly: “Fukang has now closed, owing very large sums in public funds and deposits from many quarters.

该号商江西候补道胡光墉，着先行革职；
Its proprietor, Hu Guangyong, expectant circuit intendant for Jiangxi, is hereby dismissed from office forthwith.

即着左宗棠饬提该员，严行追究，勒令将亏欠多处公私等，赶紧逐一清理。
Zuo Zongtang is ordered to have him brought before him for rigorous investigation and compel him promptly to settle, one by one, the public and private liabilities outstanding in various places.

倘敢延不完缴，即行从重治罪。
Should he dare delay full payment, he is to be severely punished without further ado.

并闻胡光墉有典当二十余处，分设各省，茧丝若干包值银数百万两，存置浙省。
It is also reported that Hu Guangyong owns more than twenty pawnshops in various provinces, as well as quantities of cocoons and silk worth several million taels stored in Zhejiang.

着该督咨行该省督抚一一查明办理，
The governor-general is to communicate officially with the governors-general and governors concerned, directing them to investigate and deal with each item.

将此谕令知之。”
Let him be informed of this decree.”

念完问道：
Gu looked up.

“听明白没有？”
“Did you understand?”

“这还听不明白？”
“How could I not?”

七姑奶奶抬眼说道：
The Seventh Lady raised her eyes.

“小爷叔，恭喜、恭喜！
“Little Uncle, congratulations!

比我原来所想的好得多。
It is much better than I expected.”

“胡雪岩一愣，古应春亦觉突兀，
Hu stared; Gu too found this startling.

脱口问道：“喜从何来？”
“What is there to congratulate him on?”

“朝廷里把小爷叔的案子交给左大人来办，
“The court has entrusted Little Uncle’s case to Lord Zuo.

还不是一喜？”
Is that not one reason?

七姑奶奶说：“这是有人在帮小爷叔的忙。”
Someone is helping him.”

这一说，胡雪岩首先领悟，
Hu understood first.

“真是旁观者清。”
“How clearly an onlooker sees!

他说：“如说有人帮忙，一定是文中堂，
If someone has helped, it must be Grand Secretary Wen.

他同恭王是亲戚。”
He is related to Prince Gong.”


“嗯、嗯。”
“Yes, yes.”

古应春问他妻子：
Gu turned to his wife.

“你说比你原来所想的好得多，
“You say it is much better than you expected.

你原来怎么想的？”
What had you expected?”

“事情过去了，
“It is past now.

不必再说。”
There is no need to say.”

“不！”胡雪岩的声音很坚决，
“No,” Hu replied firmly.

“到了这步田地了，而且还要同你彻底商量，
“We have reached this point and must discuss everything thoroughly.

有话不必忌讳。”
You need not spare my feelings.”

“我原来以为革职之外，还要查抄。
“I thought that, besides dismissal, there would be confiscation.

现在只左大人‘严行追究’，
Now Lord Zuo is merely to ‘investigate rigorously.’

而且不是勒令完清，是勒令‘清理’，
Nor is the command to pay everything off outright, but to arrange the settlement.

后面又说要左大人去公事给各省督抚，查明办理。
Then it tells him to send official communications to the provincial authorities for investigation and action.

照这样子看浙江刘抚台要听左大人的指挥，要他查才查，不要他查就不查。
As I read it, Governor Liu in Zhejiang must follow Lord Zuo’s instructions: investigate if told to, refrain if not.

这个出入关系很大。”经七姑奶奶一说破，胡雪岩领悟到，其中大有关系。
That makes an enormous difference.” Once she explained, Hu saw the significance.

因为目前负清理全责的浙江巡抚刘秉璋，
Zhejiang’s governor, Liu Bingzhang, currently bore full responsibility for the liquidation.

他虽出身淮军，但本人也是翰林，所以不愿依附李鸿章。
Although his career was associated with the Huai Army, he was also a Hanlin scholar and did not wish to attach himself to Li Hongzhang.

话虽如此，由于与淮军的关系根深，不免间接会受李鸿章的影响。
Nevertheless, his deep Huai Army connections made him indirectly susceptible to Li’s influence.

胡雪岩既为李鸿章认作左宗棠的羽翼，必须加以翦除，
Li regarded Hu as one of Zuo’s supporting wings, which must be clipped.

那么期望刘秉璋能加以额外的援手，便等于缘木求鱼了。
To expect Liu to offer special assistance was therefore like climbing a tree to catch fish.

如今朝廷将阜康所欠公私各款交左宗棠逐一清理，左宗棠便可直接指挥德馨办理，
Now the court had entrusted settlement of Fukang’s public and private debts to Zuo, who could direct Dexin himself.

这一来对胡雪岩自然非常有利。
This was naturally much more favourable to Hu.

“七姐，你是一语点醒梦中人。
“Seventh Sister, one word from you has awakened a dreamer.

如今该怎办，
Tell us what to do.

请你这位女诸葛发号施令。”
You are our female Zhuge Liang; give your orders.”

“小爷叔不要这么说。
“Do not say that, Little Uncle.

我出几个主意，大家商量，
I shall suggest a few things for us to discuss.

第一，应该打个电报给德藩台，让他心里有数；
First, telegraph Treasurer De so that he understands the position.

刘抚台管不到那么多了。”
Governor Liu no longer has so much control.”

“不错，
“Exactly.

这个电报马上要打。”
That telegram must go at once.”


“左大人那里当然要赶紧联络。”七姑奶奶问：
“We must also contact Lord Zuo without delay,” the Seventh Lady continued.

“小爷叔，你是自己去一趟呢？还是让应春去面真一切？”
“Will you go yourself, Little Uncle, or have Yingchun explain everything in person?”

“我看我去好了。”古应春自告奋勇，
“I had better go,” Gu volunteered.

“小爷叔没有顶戴不方便。”
“It would be inconvenient for Little Uncle now that he has lost his official cap.”

这话在胡雪岩是正中下怀。
This was precisely what Hu wanted.

奉旨革职的人，当然只能穿便衣，
A man dismissed by imperial decree could wear only ordinary clothes.

这对左宗棠来说，倒是无所谓的事，但江宁是全国候补道最多的地方，
That would not matter to Zuo, but Jiangning contained more expectant circuit intendants than anywhere else in the country.

为人戏称“群盗如毛”，
People joked that “thieves were thick as hairs,” playing on the shared sound of dao, their rank and the word for thief.

一到华灯初上，城南贡院与秦淮河房一带，碰来碰去的称号都是“某观察”，
Once the lamps were lit, around the examination compound and the Qinhuai river houses in the south of the city, everyone one met was addressed as “Intendant So-and-so.”

人家当然还是照旧相呼，
They would naturally continue to address Hu in the same way.

但胡雪岩不知是默受，还是要声明，已是一介平民。
He would not know whether to accept it silently or explain that he was now a commoner.

这里尴尬的情势，能避免自然求不得。
He was only too glad to avoid such embarrassment.

因此，他即时说道：“对！应春请你辛苦一趟。
“Yes, Yingchun, please undertake the journey.

见了左大人，你是第三者的地位，比较好说话。”
As a third party, you can speak to Lord Zuo more freely.”

“是！
“Very well.

我明天一早就走。
I shall leave first thing tomorrow.

还有啥话要交代？”
What else should I tell him?”

“你特别要为德晓峰致意，
“Convey De Xiaofeng’s particular respects.

他很想走左大人的路子。
He is very eager to establish a connection with Lord Zuo.

左大人能在封疆大吏中，多一个帮手，也是好的。”
Another supporter among the provincial leaders would be useful to His Excellency too.”

古应春也知道，德馨对升巡抚一事，非常热中，
Gu knew how keen Dexin was to become a governor.

如果能找机会为他进言，并取得左宗棠的承诺，保他更上层楼，那一来德馨自然就会更加出力来帮胡雪岩的忙。
If he could speak for him and obtain Zuo’s promise of a recommendation for advancement, Dexin would naturally work still harder on Hu’s behalf.


“不过，德藩台的复电，今天不到，明天一定会到，
“But Treasurer De’s reply will arrive tomorrow if not today,” Gu said.

洋人那面，接不上头，似乎不大好。”
“It may be unwise to lose contact with the foreign buyers.

古应春说：“丝能脱手，到底是顶要紧的一件大事。”
Selling the silk is, after all, our most important business.”

“现在情形不同了，
“The position is different now,” Hu replied.

归左大人清理，
“Lord Zuo is responsible for the settlement.

这批丝能不能卖，就要听他的了。”
Whether the silk may be sold is for him to decide.

胡雪岩紧接着说：“此所以你到江宁去最好，可以当面跟左大人谈。”
That is why it is best for you to go to Jiangning: you can discuss it with him in person.”

“如果备藩台复电来了，说可以卖呢？”
“Even if the treasurer’s reply says we may sell?”

“那也要听左大人的。”
“We must still follow Lord Zuo’s wishes.”

“事情不是这样办的。”七姑奶奶忍不住开口，
The Seventh Lady could not keep silent. “That is no way to conduct business.

“如今是洋人这面重要，
The foreigners are what matters now.

价钱谈不拢不必谈，
If you cannot agree on a price, there is nothing to discuss.

谈拢了又不能卖，要请示左大人，时间上耽误了，洋人或许会变卦。”
But if you agree and then cannot sell because you must seek Lord Zuo’s instructions, the delay may make them change their minds.”

“七姐的话不错。”
“You are right.”

胡雪岩马上作了决定，
Hu immediately decided.

“丝是一定要脱手的，
“The silk must be sold.

现在不过价钱上有上落，日子也要宽几天。
It is only a question of the price and allowing a few more days.

应春，你明天先把买主去稳住，
Yingchun, secure the buyer tomorrow morning.

你同他说，交易一定做得成，请他等几天。
Tell him the transaction will certainly go through, and ask him to wait a few days.

现在洋人也晓得了，一牵涉到官场，做事情一定要有耐心，
Foreigners understand by now that patience is necessary whenever officials are involved.

几天的工夫不肯等，根本就没有诚意，这种户头，放弃了也没有什么可惜。”
If he refuses to wait even a few days, he cannot be sincere, and there is nothing to regret in abandoning such a customer.”

“好！
“Very well.

我明天一早去，去了回来就动身。”
I shall call on him first thing and set out as soon as I return.”

古应春忽然发觉：
Gu suddenly noticed something.

“咦，老宓怎么还不来？”
“Why has Old Mi still not come?”


原来古应春去看沈兰生时，照胡雪岩的嘱咐，顺道先转到集贤里，
On his way to Shen Lansheng, Gu had followed Hu’s instructions and first called at Jixian Lane.

阜康虽已闭歇，宓本常与少数伙计，还留守在那里。
Although Fukang was closed, Mi Benchang and a few clerks remained there.

宓本常听说胡雪岩来了，即时表示，马上就会到古家来“同大先生碰头”。
On hearing that Hu had arrived, Mi had immediately said he would come to Gu’s house to “meet Mr Hu.”

这句话到此刻，将近三个钟头了，
Nearly three hours had passed since then.

何以踪影不见？
Why was there still no sign of him?

“丑媳妇总要见公婆面，
“An ugly daughter-in-law must meet her parents-in-law eventually.

他会来的，
He will come,” the Seventh Lady said.

小爷叔吃消夜等他。”七姑奶奶说：
“Little Uncle, have supper while we wait.

“消夜不晓得预备好了没有？”
I wonder whether it is ready.”

“早就预备好了。”瑞香在外面起坐间中，高声回答，
“It has been ready for some time,” Ruixiang called from the outer sitting room.

接着进了卧室，将坐在轮椅上的七姑奶奶推了出去。
She entered the bedroom and wheeled the Seventh Lady out.

消夜仍旧很讲究，而且多是胡雪岩爱吃的食物，
Supper was still elaborate, with many of Hu’s favourite dishes.

时值严寒，自然有火锅，是用“糟钵头”的卤汁，加上鱼圆、海参、冬笋，以及名为“胶菜”的山东大白菜同煮。
In the bitter weather there was naturally a hotpot, made with the wine-lees broth of zaobotou, fish balls, sea cucumber, winter bamboo shoots, and the Shandong cabbage known as jiaocai.

这使得胡雪岩想起了老同和。
It reminded Hu of Laotonghe.

““应春，”他问，“你看见阿彩了？”
“Yingchun, did you see A’cai?”

“看见了。”
“Yes.”

“哪个阿彩？”七姑奶奶问：
“Who is A’cai?” the Seventh Lady asked.

“好象是女人的名字。”
“That sounds like a woman’s name.”

胡雪岩与古应春相视而笑。
Hu and Gu exchanged a smile.

由于胡雪岩现在的心境，倒反而因为京里来的消息而踏实了，所以古应春觉得谈谈这段意外的韵事，亦自不妨，当即开玩笑地说：
The news from Beijing had, paradoxically, steadied Hu’s spirits, and Gu felt there was no harm in recounting this unexpected romantic episode.

“小爷叔如果当时再跟阿彩再一面，说不定现在是老同和的老板。”
“If Little Uncle had met A’cai just once more in those days, he might now be the proprietor of Laotonghe.”

以这句笑谈作为引子，古应春由昨夜在老同和进餐，谈到这天上午与阿彩的对话，
Beginning with that joke, he told the story from the previous night’s meal to his conversation with A’cai that morning.

其问胡雪岩又不时作了补充，
Hu added details from time to time.

这段亘时二十余年的故事，近乎传奇。
Stretching over more than twenty years, it was almost a legend.

七姑奶奶与瑞香都听得津津有味。
The Seventh Lady and Ruixiang listened with fascination.

胡雪岩借此也了解了许多他以前不知道、甚至想象不到的情节，
Hu too learned much that he had never known or even imagined.

尤其是阿彩如此一往情深，大出他的意料，
A’cai’s enduring affection particularly surprised him.

因而极力追忆阿彩当年的模样，但只有一个淡淡的、几乎不成形的影子，
He tried hard to recall her appearance then, but could summon only a faint, almost formless image.

唯一记得清楚的是，纤瘦与一双大眼睛。
All he remembered clearly was a slender figure and a pair of large eyes.

这顿消夜，吃到午夜方罢。
Supper did not end until midnight.

宓本常始终未来。
Mi never appeared.

“算了！”胡雪岩说：
“Never mind,” Hu said.

“明天早上再说，
“We shall deal with it tomorrow.

睡觉要紧。”
Sleep comes first.”


这一夜睡得不很舒适，
Hu slept badly.

主因是古家新装了一个锅炉，热汽由铅管通至各处，
The chief reason was a newly installed boiler in Gu’s house, which carried steam through lead pipes to the rooms.

这是西洋传来的新花样，上海人称之为“热水汀”，
This Western novelty was known in Shanghai as hot-water heating.

胡雪岩元宝街的住宅虽讲究，却尚无此物。
Elaborate though Hu’s Yuanbao Street residence was, it had nothing of the kind.

但虽说“一室如春”，胡雪岩却不不甚习惯，
The room might be “as warm as spring,” but he was unused to it.

盖的又是丝绵被，半夜里出汗醒了好几次，迫不得已起床，自己动手，在柜子里找到两条毛毯来盖，
Under a silk-floss quilt he woke sweating several times, until he had to get up and find two woollen blankets in a cupboard.

才能熟睡。
Only then did he sleep soundly.

醒来时，红日满窗。
When he woke, sunlight filled the windows.

瑞香听得响动，亲自来伺候漱洗，
Hearing him stir, Ruixiang came to attend to his washing.

少不得要问到胡家上下，胡雪岩只答得一句：“都还好。”便不愿多谈，
Naturally she asked after the Hu household, but he answered only, “Everyone is well,” and showed no wish to discuss it.

瑞香也就知趣不再下去了。
She tactfully let the subject drop.

上楼去看七姑奶奶时，已经摆好早餐在等他了，照例有一碗燕窝粥。
Upstairs, breakfast was waiting with the Seventh Lady, including the customary bowl of bird’s-nest porridge.

胡雪岩说道：“谢谢！七姐你吃吧。”
“Thank you, Seventh Sister. You have it.”

“为啥不吃？”
“Why will you not eat it?

七姑奶奶说：“小爷叔，你不要作贱自己。”
Do not treat yourself badly, Little Uncle.”

“不是作贱自己。
“It is not that.

我享福享过头了，
I have enjoyed more good fortune than I deserved.

现在想想，应该惜福。”
Now I feel I should treasure what I have.”

七姑奶奶未及答言，只听楼梯上的脚步声，异常匆遽，仿佛是奔了上来的。
Before she could answer, hurried footsteps sounded on the stairs, as though someone were running up.

大家都定睛去看，
Everyone looked.

是古应春回来了。
It was Gu.

“小爷叔，”他说：“老宓死掉了！”
“Little Uncle—Old Mi is dead!”

“死掉了！”
“Dead?

胡雪岩问：“是中风？”
Was it a stroke?”

“不是，
“No.

自己寻的死路，吞鸦片死的。”古应春沮丧地说：
He took his own life with opium,” Gu said dejectedly.

“大概我走了以后就吞了几个烟泡，
“He probably swallowed a few pellets after I left.

今天早上，一直不开房门，
This morning he did not open his door.

阿张敲门不应，从窗子里爬进去一看，身子都僵了。”
A’zhang knocked without getting an answer, climbed through the window, and found his body already stiff.”

阿张是阜康的伙计。
A’zhang was a Fukang clerk.

“是为啥呢？”
“Why?”

胡雪岩摇摇头，
Hu shook his head.

“犯不着！”
“There was no need for that.”


“小爷叔，你真正厚道。”七姑奶奶说：
“You are truly kindhearted,” the Seventh Lady said.

“他总觉得祸都是他闯出来的，没有脸见你。
“He always felt the disaster was entirely his doing and could not face you.

他来过两回，
He came here twice.

一谈起来唉声叹气，怨他自己不该到宁波去的。
Whenever he spoke of it, he sighed and blamed himself for going to Ningbo.

那时候……
At that time...”

“七姑奶奶突然住声不语，
She abruptly stopped.

胡雪岩便问：“七奶，你说下去啊。”
“Go on, Seventh Sister,” Hu urged.

七姑奶奶没有答他的话，只问她丈夫：“你怎么晓得你一走了，他就吞了几个烟泡。”
Instead of answering, she asked her husband, “How do you know he swallowed the opium as soon as you left?”

“他们告诉我，昨天我一走，他就关房门睡觉了，
“They told me that after I went, he shut his door and went to bed.

那时候只有八点钟，大家都还没有睡。”
It was only eight o’clock; everyone else was still up.”

“那么，”七姑奶奶紧接着问：“大家倒没有奇怪，他为啥这样子早就上床？”
“Did nobody wonder why he was going to bed so early?”

“奇怪是奇怪，没有人去问他。”
“They did, but no one asked him.

古应春答说：“阿张告诉我，他当时心里就在想，不是说要去看大先生，怎么困了呢？
A’zhang told me he wondered why Mi was sleeping after saying he would go to see Mr Hu.

他本来想进去看一看，只为约了朋友看夜戏，
He meant to look in, but he had arranged to see the evening opera with friends.

中轴子是杨月楼的‘八大锤带说书’，怕来不及，匆匆忙忙就走了。
A featured item was Yang Yuelou’s Eight Great Hammers with the Storytelling Scene, and he was afraid of being late, so he hurried off.

看完夜戏吃消夜，回来就上床，
After the performance they had supper, and he went straight to bed on returning.

一直到今天早上起来去敲门，才晓碍出了事。”
Only when he knocked this morning did he discover what had happened.”

七姑奶奶不作声了，但脸上的神色，却很明显表示出，她另有看法。
The Seventh Lady fell silent, though her expression clearly showed she had another interpretation.

“阜康的人也还有好几个，
“There were still several people at Fukang,” Hu said.

当时就没有一个人会发现？”
“Did not one of them notice?

胡雪岩又说：“吞鸦片不比上吊，
Opium is different from hanging.

要死以前，总会出声，
A man would make some sound before dying.

莫非就没有一个人听见？”
Did nobody hear?”

“我也这么问他们，
“I asked the same thing.

有的说一上床就睡着了，没有听见，
Some said they fell asleep as soon as they lay down and heard nothing.

有的说逛马路去了，根本不知道。”
Others had gone out strolling and knew nothing about it.”

“这也是命中注定。”
“Then it was fate.”

七姑奶奶终于忍不住开口：
The Seventh Lady could no longer restrain herself.

“不是人死了，我还说刻薄话，照我看是弄假成真。”
“I do not mean to speak cruelly of the dead, but I think a pretence became reality.”

“你是说，他是假装寻死？”古应春问。
“You mean he only pretended to try to die?” Gu asked.

“你又不是不晓得，他随身的好个明角盒子里，摆了四个烟泡，
“You know he carried four opium pellets in that translucent horn box.

在人面前亮过不止一回。”
He showed it to people more than once.”

“喔，”
“Oh?”

胡雪岩很注意地问：
Hu listened closely.

“他是早有寻死的意思了。”
“Had he been thinking of suicide for some time?”


“是啊！”
“Yes.”

七姑奶奶看着古应春说：
She looked at Gu.

“我不晓得你听他说过没有？我是听他说过的。”
“I do not know whether he told you, but he told me.”

“他怎么说？”胡雪岩问。
“What did he say?” Hu asked.

“他说：我实在对不起胡大先生，
“‘I have wronged Mr Hu terribly.

只有拿一条命报答他。”
I can repay him only with my life.’”

“七姐，你倒没有劝他，不要起这种念头？”
“Did you not tell him to abandon such thoughts?”

“怎么没有。我说：
“Of course I did.

古人舍命救主的事有，不过赔了性命，要有用处。
I said that men in old stories had sacrificed their lives to save their masters, but the sacrifice had to serve a purpose.

没有用处，白白送了一条命，对胡大先生一点好处都没有。
Throwing away his life uselessly would do Mr Hu no good.”

““他又怎么说呢？”
“And what did he answer?”

“他说，不是这样子，我对胡大先生过意不去。”
“He said, ‘Unless I do that, I cannot face what I have done to him.’

七姑奶奶又说：“他如果真的是这样想老早就该寻死了。
But if that was truly his intention, he should have done it long ago.

迟不死，早不死，偏偏等到要同你见面了，去寻死路。
Why wait until he had to meet you?

照我想，他是实在没有话好同小爷叔你说，只好来一条苦肉计。
I think he simply had nothing he could say and resorted to making a show of suffering.

大凡一个人直的不想活了，就一定会想到千万不要死不成，
Someone genuinely determined to die would be concerned above all not to fail.

所以要挑挑地方，还要想想死的法子，要叫人不容易发现，一发现了也死不成，
He would choose the place and the means so that he would not easily be discovered; once discovered, he might be saved.

他身上的烟泡，照我想，阜康的伙计总也见过的，
Surely the Fukang clerks had seen the pellets he carried.

莫非他们就没有想到？
Would they not think of them?

说了要来看大先生，忽然之间关了大门睡觉，
Having said he was coming to see you, he suddenly shut himself in and went to bed.

人家自然会起疑心，自然会来救他。
Naturally he expected people to grow suspicious and rescue him.

这样子一来，天大的错处，人家也原谅他了，他也不必费心费力说多少好话来赔罪了。
After that, however great his wrongdoing, they would forgive him, and he would be spared all the effort of explaining and apologising.

哪晓得偏偏人家留心不到此，
Who could have foreseen that nobody would notice?

看戏的看戏，逛马路的逛马路，睡觉的睡觉，这都是他想不到的。
They went to the theatre, strolled about, or went to sleep—things he had never counted on.

小爷叔你也不必难过，
Little Uncle, you need not grieve too much.

他这样子一死，不必再还来生债，
By dying, he has escaped having to repay his debts in another life.

对他也是有好处的。”
That is something in his favour too.”

“死了，死了，死了一切都了掉了。”胡雪岩说：
“Dead and done with; death ends everything,” Hu said.

“他的后事，要有人替他料理。
“But someone must arrange his funeral.

应春，我晓得他对你不大厚道，
Yingchun, I know he did not treat you very well.

不过朋友一场，
Still, you were friends.

你不能不管。”
You cannot leave it unattended.”


“是的。
“Of course.

我已经叫阜康的伙计替他去买棺材了。
I have already told the Fukang clerks to buy a coffin.

尽今天一天工夫，我把他的后事料理好，明天动身。”
I shall spend today settling his affairs and leave tomorrow.

古应春又问：“是不是先打个电报给左大人？”
Should we telegraph Lord Zuo first?”

“应该。”
“Yes.”

于是古应春动笔拟了个由胡雪岩具名、致左宗棠的电报稿说：“顷得京电，知获严谴，
Gu drafted a message in Hu’s name: “I have just received news from the capital and learned of the severe imperial censure.

职谨回杭待命，
I am returning to Hangzhou to await orders.

一闻电谕，即当真到。
Upon receiving a telegraphed command, I shall come in person.

兹先着古君应春赴宁，禀陈一切。”
Meanwhile, I am sending Mr Gu Yingchun to Jiangning to report everything.”

胡雪岩原执有左宗棠给他的一个密码本，
Hu possessed a codebook Zuo had given him.

为了表示光明磊落，一切尊旨办理，特别交代古应春用明码拍发。
But to show that he was acting openly and obeying the decree in every respect, he expressly instructed Gu to send this message in plain code.

“洋人那里呢？”胡雪岩又问：
“And the foreign buyer?” he asked.

“谈妥了？”
“Is everything arranged?”

“好！”胡雪岩向七姑奶奶征询：
“Good,” Hu continued, turning to the Seventh Lady.

“七姐，你看我是不是今天就动身？”
“Do you think I should leave today?”

“要这样子急吗？”
“Must you hurry so much?”

“我是由宓本常寻死联想到杭州，
“Mi’s suicide has made me think of Hangzhou.

《申报》的消息一登，一定有人会着急，
Once the news appears in the Shenbao, someone is bound to panic.

不晓得会出什么意外。
Who knows what might happen?

所以我要赶回去，
I must get back.

能在《申报》运到这前，赶回杭州最好。”
It would be best to reach Hangzhou before the newspaper does.”

“说得一点不错。”
“Quite right.

七姑奶奶答说：“昨天晚上我们光是谈了公事，
Last night we discussed only public affairs.

本来今天我还想同小爷叔谈谈家务。现在小爷叔已经想到了，就不必我再说。
I had meant to speak about your household today, but since you have thought of it already, I need say no more.

赶紧去定船吧。
Arrange a boat at once.”

““我来办。”古应春说：
“I shall see to it,” Gu said.

“定好了，我马上回来通知。”
“As soon as it is ready, I shall return.”

等古应春一走，胡雪岩又跟七姑奶奶秘密商量，一直到中午，
After he left, Hu and the Seventh Lady continued their private discussion until noon.

古应春回来，说船已定好，
Gu then returned to say the boat was arranged.

花三百两银子雇了一只小火轮拖带，两天工夫可以回杭州。
For three hundred taels he had hired a small steamer to tow it; Hu could reach Hangzhou in two days.


胡雪岩专用的官船，大小两号，
Hu had two official boats for his own use, one large and one small.

这回坐的是吃水浅的小号，
This time he took the smaller, shallow-draught vessel.

小火轮拖带着，宛如轻车熟路，畅顺无比，
Towed by the steamer, it travelled as smoothly as a light carriage on a familiar road.

黄昏过了海宁直隶州，进入杭州府境界，当夜到达省城，
At dusk it passed Haining Independent Department and entered Hangzhou prefecture, reaching the provincial capital that night.

在望仙桥上岸，雇了一乘小轿，悄然到家。
Hu landed at Wangxian Bridge, hired a small sedan chair, and quietly returned home.

“这么快就回来了？”螺蛳太太惊讶地问，
“Back so soon?” Madam Luosi asked in surprise.

“事情顺手不顺手？”
“Did things go smoothly?”

“一时也说不尽。”胡雪岩问：
“It is too much to explain at once.

“老太太身子怎么样？”
How is my mother?”

“蛮好。
“Very well.

就是记挂你。”“唉！”胡雪岩微喟着，黯然无语。
She is only worrying about you.” Hu sighed softly and fell into a sad silence.

“我叫他们预备饭，
“I shall have food prepared.

你先息一息。”螺蛳太太唤着阿云说：
Rest a little first.” Madam Luosi called A’yun.

“你去告诉阿兰，叫她禀报太太，说老爷回来了。
“Tell A’lan to inform Madam that the master has returned.”

“这是她守着嫡庶的规矩，但胡雪岩却拦住了，
She was observing the proper distinction between principal wife and concubine, but Hu stopped her.

“不必，不必！”
“No, not yet.

他说：“等我们谈妥当了，再告诉她。”
Let us finish our discussion first.”

这一谈谈到四更天，胡雪岩方始归寝。
They talked until the fourth watch before Hu finally went to bed.

螺蛳太太却不曾睡，
Madam Luosi did not sleep.

一个人盘算了又盘算，到天色微明时，带着阿云去叩梦香楼的房门，
She considered matters again and again, then, at the first light of dawn, took A’yun to knock at the door of Mengxiang Tower.

与胡太太谈了有半个时辰，方始回来，唤醒胡雪岩，伺候他漱洗完毕，开上早饭来，依旧食前方丈。
After speaking with Mrs Hu for about an hour, she returned, woke Hu, attended to his washing, and had breakfast served—a lavish spread as usual.

“从明天起，不能再这样子摆排场了。”螺蛳太太急忙解释：“原是因为你头一天回来，
“From tomorrow, we cannot put on a display like this.” She explained hastily, “It is only because this is your first morning home.

小厨房特别巴结。”
The private kitchen wanted to please you.”

“小厨房从明天起，也可以撤消了。”
“The private kitchen can be closed from tomorrow too.”

“我晓得。”
“I understand.

螺蛳太太说：“这些事我会料理，
I shall arrange these things.

你就不必操这份心吧！”
You need not trouble yourself about them.”


胡雪岩不作声了，
Hu said no more.

朝餐桌上看了一下说：“到大厨房去拿两根油炸桧来。”
Looking over the table, he asked, “Fetch two sticks of ‘fried Hui’ from the main kitchen.”

古来奸臣无数，杭州人最恨的是害死岳飞的秦桧，
There had been countless treacherous ministers, but Hangzhou people most hated Qin Hui for causing Yue Fei’s death.

所以将长长的油条称之为“油炸桧”，意思是他在十八层地狱下油锅，
They therefore called the long fried dough sticks youzha Hui—“deep-fried Hui”—imagining him in an oil cauldron in the eighteenth level of hell.

又写做“油灼脍”。
The name was also written youzhuo kuai.

胡家下人多，每天大厨房里自己打烧饼、炸油条，
With so many servants, the Hu household made its own sesame flatbreads and fried dough every morning in the main kitchen.

从来不尝的胡雪岩，
Hu had never eaten them.

忽然想到此物，无非表示今后食贫之意，
His sudden request was merely a declaration that he would live humbly from now on.

螺蛳太太觉得大委屈了他，
Madam Luosi thought it too great a humiliation.

也怕下人加油添酱当作新闻去传说，或者还有人会骂他做作，
She also feared the servants would embroider the incident and spread it as news; some might even accuse him of putting on a performance.

所以当面虽未拦阻，却向阿云使个眼色。
Without openly objecting, she gave A’yun a look.

这俏黠丫头，自能会意，到外面转了一圈回来说：
The clever maid understood, went outside for a while, and returned.

“已经歇火不炸了，
“They have put out the fire and stopped frying.

冷油条最难吃，我没有要。”
Cold dough sticks are dreadful, so I did not bring any.”

“没有要就不要了。”螺蛳太太说道：
“Then never mind,” Madam Luosi said.

“老爷也快吃好了。”
“The master has nearly finished.”

胡雪岩不作声，吃完粥站起。
Hu said nothing and rose after his porridge.

恰好钟打八下，
The clock struck eight.

便点点头说：
He nodded.

“是时候了。”“阿云！”螺蛳太太开始发号施令：“你叫人把福生同老何妈去叫来。
“It is time.” Madam Luosi began giving orders. “A’yun, have Fusheng and Old Mother He called.

随后通知各房姨太太，到二厅上会齐，
Then tell all the concubines to assemble in the second hall.

老爷有话交代，
The master has instructions for them.

再要告诉阿兰，请太太也到二厅上，“她说一句，阿云应一句。
Tell A’lan to ask Madam to come too.” A’yun acknowledged each command.

不一会，男女总管福生与老何妈应召而至，
Soon the male and female head servants arrived.

螺蛳太太吩咐福生，在二厅上升火盆，然后将老何妈唤到一边，秘密交代了好些话。
Madam Luosi told Fusheng to light a brazier in the hall, then drew Old Mother He aside for a lengthy private briefing.


胡家这十来年，“夜夜元宵，朝朝寒食”，
For the past ten years and more, every night in the Hu household had been like the Lantern Festival, every morning like a holiday.

各房姨太太此时有的刚刚起身，正在漱洗，有的还在床上。
Some concubines were only just getting up and washing; others remained in bed.

其中有两个起得早的，都从丫头口中，得知胡雪岩已于昨夜到家。
Two early risers had already heard from their maids that Hu had returned during the night.

这两位姨太太，一个素性懒散，听过丢开，
One, indolent by nature, gave the news no further thought.

只关心她的一架鹦鹉，一缸金鱼，
She cared only about her parrot and bowl of goldfish.

天气太冷，金鱼冻死了两条，令人不怡；
The cold had killed two fish, leaving her out of sorts.

另一个性情淳厚，服事胡雪岩，总是处处想讨他的欢心，
The other was goodhearted and always tried to please Hu.

深知胡雪岩喜欢姬妾修饰，所以梳洗以后，插戴得珠翠满头，换了一件簇新的青缎皮袄，
Knowing that he liked his women carefully adorned, she arranged pearls and jade all over her hair and put on a brand-new fur-lined coat of dark satin.

打算着中午必能见到胡雪岩——每逢他远道归家，必定召集十二房姨太太家宴，
She expected to see him at noon: whenever he returned from a distant journey, he invariably gathered his twelve concubines for a family meal.

如今虽非昔比，她认为老规矩是不会改的。
Times had changed, but she assumed the old custom would remain.

因为如此，等丫头一来传唤，她是首先到达二厅的。
Thus, when summoned, she was first to reach the second hall.

胡雪岩觉得眼前一亮，
Hu’s eyes brightened.

“唷！”他说，“你一大早就打扮得花枝招展，
“Why, dressed like a flower so early!

好象要赶到哪里去吃喜酒，是不是？”
Are you hurrying off to a wedding feast?”

宋姑娘在胡家姬妾中排行第五。
Miss Song ranked fifth among the concubines.

胡雪岩一向喜欢她柔顺，加以性情豁达，虽遭挫折，未改常度，
He had always liked her gentleness and her generous, easygoing nature, which had remained unchanged despite their reverses.

所以这样跟她开玩笑地说。
That was why he joked with her.

宋姑娘却不慌不忙地先向胡太太与螺蛳太太行礼招呼过了，方始含笑答说：“听说老爷回来了，总要穿戴好了，才好来见你。”
Unhurriedly, she first greeted Mrs Hu and Madam Luosi, then answered with a smile, “When I heard you were home, I had to dress properly before seeing you.”

“对，对！”
“Quite right.

胡雪岩说：“你穿戴得越多越好。”
The more you wear, the better.”

一句刚完，螺蛳太太重重地咳嗽了一声，仿佛怪他说错了话似的。
Madam Luosi coughed heavily, as though reproaching him for saying too much.

宋姑娘当然不会想到他话中另有深意，
Miss Song could not suspect his hidden meaning.

一眼望见人影说道：“福建姨太来了。”
Catching sight of someone, she said, “The Fujian lady is here.”

福建姨太姓杨，家常衣服，
Mistress Yang, the Fujian concubine, wore everyday clothes.

虽梳好了头，却连通草花都不戴一朵，
Her hair was arranged, but without even a pith flower.

进得厅来，——行礼，心里还在惦念着她那两条死掉的金鱼，脸上一点笑容都没有。
She greeted everyone in turn, still thinking about her two dead goldfish and without a smile.

接着其余各房姨太太陆续而来。
The others arrived gradually.

螺蛳太太看看是时候了，便向胡雪岩说一句：“都到齐了。”
At last Madam Luosi said, “Everyone is here.”

于是胡雪岩咳嗽一声，
Hu coughed.

里里外外，静得连针掉在地上都听得见。
The entire place grew so quiet that a dropped needle could have been heard.

但胡雪岩却怔怔地看看这个，看看那个，好久都无法开口，而且眼角晶莹，含着泪珠了。
Yet he could only stare from one woman to another, unable to begin, tears glistening at the corners of his eyes.


他此时的心境，别人不知道，胡太太跟螺蛳太太都很清楚。
No one else knew what he felt, but Mrs Hu and Madam Luosi understood perfectly.

这十一个姨太太，都是他亲自选中的，或者量珠以聘，或者大费周折，
He had chosen all eleven women himself, winning some with lavish betrothal gifts and others only after many difficulties.

真所谓来之不易。何况一个有一个的长处，
Each had truly been hard to obtain, and each had her own attractions.

不管他在官场、商场、洋场遭遇了什么拂逆之事，一回到家，总有能配合他的心情、让他暂时抛开烦恼的人相伴，
Whatever reverses he suffered among officials, merchants, or foreigners, at home there was always someone suited to his mood who could help him forget his troubles for a while.

想到一旦人去楼空，如何狠得下这个心来？
How could he harden himself to see these rooms emptied?

螺蛳太太当机立断，
Madam Luosi acted decisively.

“请太太跟大家说吧！”
“Let Madam speak to everyone.”

接着便想吩咐站在胡太太身后的阿兰，将胡雪岩扶了进去，
She was about to tell A’lan, standing behind Mrs Hu, to help him inside.

但一眼瞥见行七的朱姨太，灵机一动，改口说道：
Then she noticed Mistress Zhu, who ranked seventh, and changed her mind.

“七妹，你送老爷到后头去。”
“Little Sister Seven, take the master to the back.”

朱姨太心知别有深意，答应着来扶胡雪岩。
Understanding that there was a purpose behind this, Mistress Zhu came to assist him.

他一言不发，摇摇头，掉转身子往里就走。不过朱姨太还是抢上两步，扶着他的手臂。
He shook his head without a word and turned to go, but she hurried after him and supported his arm.


“老爷是昨天晚上回来的。”胡太太说道：
“The master returned last night,” Mrs Hu began.

“消息交关不好，
“The news is very bad.

我也不必细说，
I need not give the details.

总而言之一句话，树倒猢狲散，
In a word, when the tree falls, the monkeys scatter.

只好各人自己作打算了。”
Each of you must make your own arrangements.”

此言一出，里外一阵轻微的骚动。
A slight commotion passed through the hall.

胡太太重重咳嗽一声，等大家静了下来，正是再往下说，不过有人抢在她前面开了口。
She coughed sharply and waited for silence, but someone spoke before she could continue.

此人是排行第二的戴姨太太，
It was Mistress Dai, the second concubine.

“我今年四十岁了。”
“I am forty this year.

她说，“家里没有人，没有地方好去，
I have no family and nowhere to go.

我仍旧跟太太，有饭吃饭，有粥吃粥。
I shall stay with you, Madam—rice if there is rice, porridge if there is porridge.

我跟老爷、太太亨过福，如今吃苦也是应该的。”
I have shared your good fortune; it is only right to share your hardship.”

“戴姨太，你不要这样说……”
“Mistress Dai, do not say...”

说到这里，胡太太发觉螺蛳太太拉了她一把，便即停了下来，转眼等她开口。
Mrs Hu stopped as Madam Luosi tugged at her, then turned to let her speak.

螺蛳太太是发觉对戴姨太要费一番唇舌，如果说服不了她，事情便成了僵局，
The latter saw that persuading Dai would take time; if she refused to be persuaded, everything might come to a standstill.

所以轻声说道：“太太，我看先说了办法，
“Explain the arrangement first,” she said quietly.

一个一个来问，
“Ask them one by one.

不愿意走的，另外再说。”
Those who wish to stay can be discussed separately.”

胡太太听她的话，开口说道：
Mrs Hu resumed.

“老爷这样做，也叫做没奈何。
“The master has no choice.

现在老爷已经革职了，不晓得还有啥罪名，
He has been dismissed from office, and we do not know what further charges may follow.

为了不忍大家一起受累，所以只好请大家各自想办法。
Rather than let everyone suffer with him, he must ask you to provide for yourselves.

老爷想办法凑了一点现银，每人分五百两去过日子。
He has managed to assemble some ready silver: five hundred taels apiece for your living expenses.

大家也不必回自己房里去了，
There is no need to return to your rooms.

‘将军休下马，各自奔前程’，
‘Generals, do not dismount; each ride on towards your own future.’

就在这里散了吧！”
We must part here.”


一听这话，第一个是福建籍的杨姨太太，
Mistress Yang was the first to move.

扶着一个丫头的肩，急急奔出厅去，到了花园门口，
Leaning on a maid’s shoulder, she hurried from the hall to the garden entrance.

只见园门紧闭，挂了一把大锁，老何妈守在那里。
The gate was shut and secured with a large lock; Old Mother He stood beside it.

“开门！开门！”
“Open it!

杨姨太说：“我要回去拿东西。”
I must get my things.”

“杨姨太，进不去了，
“You cannot go in, Mistress Yang.

没有钥匙。”
I have no key.”

“钥匙在哪里？”
“Where is it?”

“在老爷身上。”
“With the master.”

“我不相信。”
“I do not believe you.”

“不相信也没有办法。”老何妈说：
“Then there is nothing I can do.

“杨姨太，算了吧！”
Let it go.”

“我，我，”杨姨太哭着说：“我的鹦鹉、金鱼还没有喂。”
“My parrot and goldfish have not been fed,” Yang said through tears.

“你请放心。”
“Do not worry.

老何妈说：“自有人养，
Someone will look after them.

不会死的。”
They will not die.”

杨姨太还要争执，但老何妈寒着脸不开腔，
Yang wanted to argue, but Old Mother He remained silent and stony-faced.

看看无法可想，只好委委屈屈地重回二厅。
Seeing no way around her, she returned miserably to the hall.

二厅上聚讼纷坛，
There everyone was talking at once.

有的在商谈归宿，有的在默默恩量，有的自怨自艾，早知如此，该学宋姑娘，将所有的首饰都带在身上。
