Some discussed where to go, some considered in silence, and others reproached themselves: had they known, they would have followed Miss Song’s example and worn all their jewellery.

当然，表情亦各有不同，
Their expressions varied too.

有的垂泪，不忍遽别，有的茫然，恍如锑羽，亦有欣然色喜，等一开了笼子，就要振翅高飞了。
Some wept at the prospect of parting; some looked bewildered, as though their wings had been clipped; others were visibly delighted, ready to fly as soon as the cage opened.

厅外聚集的男女仆人，表情就更复杂了，
The male and female servants gathered outside showed still more complicated feelings.

大多是三三两两，聚在一起交头接耳地窃窃私议，
Most stood in little groups whispering.

有人脸上显得兴奋而诡异，那就不难窥见他们的内心了，都是想捡个现成便宜，
Excitement and slyness on certain faces made their thoughts easy to guess: they hoped to pick up a ready-made advantage.

尤其是年纪较轻而尚未成家的男仆，仿佛望见一头天鹅，从空而降，就要到嘴似的，
Young, unmarried male servants, in particular, seemed to see a swan descending from the sky straight towards their mouths.

这种人财两得的机会，是做梦都不曾想到的。
A chance to acquire both a woman and her money was beyond their wildest dreams.

乱过一阵，大致定局，
After a period of confusion, matters were largely settled.

除了戴姨太坚持不走，决定送她去陪老太太以外，
Mistress Dai alone insisted on staying and was to go and keep Old Madam Hu company.

其余五个回娘家，四个行止未定，或者投亲，或者在外赁屋暂住，一共是九个人。
Five would return to their parents’ homes; four remained undecided, intending either to seek relatives or rent temporary accommodation—nine in all.

胡太太当即交代总管，回娘家或者投亲的雇车船派人护送；
Mrs Hu instructed the head servants to hire transport and provide escorts for those going to family.

赁屋暂住的，大概别有打算，亦自有人照料，就不必管了。
Those renting rooms probably had plans of their own and someone to attend to them, so the household need not intervene.


此外就只剩有一个朱姨太了。她是由胡雪岩亲自在作安排，
That left only Mistress Zhu, whose arrangements Hu Xueyan was making himself.

“老七，”他说：“你是好人家的女儿，
“Seven,” he said, “you come from a respectable family.

所以我对你一向另眼看待，
That is why I have always treated you with particular consideration.

你自己也晓得的。”
You know that yourself.”

“我晓得。”朱姨太低着头说；
“I know,” she answered, lowering her head.

“在我这回去上海以前，罗四姐跟你谈过周少棠，
“Before I went to Shanghai this time,” he continued, “Sister Luo spoke to you about Zhou Shaotang.

你的意思怎么样？”
What do you think?”

“我根本没有想过。”朱姨太说，
“I have never really thought about it.

“我只当她在说笑话。”
I took it as a joke.”

“不是笑话，”胡雪岩很委婉地说：
“It was no joke,” Hu said as gently as he could.

“我也晓得你不愿意出去，不过时势所限，真叫没法。
“I know you do not want to leave, but circumstances give us no choice.

俗语说得是：”夫妻本是同林鸟，大限来时各自飞‘，
As the saying goes, husband and wife are birds of the same wood: when disaster comes, each must fly its own way.

你要想开一点。
You must try to accept it.”

““哪里想得开？
“How can I?

我跟老爷八年，穿罗着缎，首饰不是珍珠，就是悲翠，
I have been with you for eight years, wearing silks and satins, with pearls and jade for my jewels.

这样的福享过，哪里还能够到别人家去过日子。”
After enjoying such comforts, how can I go and live in someone else’s house?”

口气是松动了。
Her resistance was beginning to soften.

胡雪岩象吃了萤火虫似的，肚子里雪亮，
Hu saw through her as clearly as though he had swallowed a firefly that lit up his insides.

略想一想，低声说道：
After a moment’s thought, he lowered his voice.

“我同太太她们定规的章程是，每人送五百两银子，不必再回自己房间里去了，
“The arrangement I made with my wife and the others is to give each woman five hundred taels, without letting her return to her room.

对你，当然是例外。”
In your case, of course, there will be an exception.”

朱姨太心里一块石头落地，
A great weight lifted from her heart.

当即盈盈下拜：
She immediately sank into a graceful bow.

“谢谢老爷。”
“Thank you, Master.”

“起来，起来。”
“Get up, get up.

胡雪岩问道：“你有多少私房？”
How much money have you put aside?”

“没有仔细算过。
“I have never counted it carefully.

而且老爷赏我的都是首饰，也估不出价钱。”
Besides, your gifts to me have all been jewelry, and I cannot value them.”

“现银呢？”
“What about silver?”

“我有两万多银子，摆在钱庄里。”
“I have more than twenty thousand taels in the bank.”


胡家的姨太太，都有私房存在阜康生息。
All the concubines in the Hu household kept private savings at Fukang to earn interest.

阜康一倒，纷纷提存，胡雪岩亦曾关照，这些存款，都要照付。
When the bank failed, they had hurried to withdraw them, and Hu had instructed that all these deposits were to be paid.

不过朱姨太还存着两万多银子，不免诧异。
He was therefore surprised that Mistress Zhu still had more than twenty thousand taels there.

“怎么？
“What?

你没有把你的款了提出来？”
You have not withdrawn your money?”

“我不想提。”
“I did not want to.”

“为啥？”
“Why?”

“老爷出了这种事，我去提那两万多银子，也显得太势利了。”
“With this happening to you, it would have looked far too mercenary if I had gone to withdraw my twenty thousand taels.”

“好！
“Good!

好！
Good!

不在我跟罗四姐对你另眼相看。”
Sister Luo and I have not been wrong to think so highly of you.”

胡雪岩停了一下问：“你的存折呢？”
He paused, then asked, “Where is your passbook?”

“在房间里。”
“In my room.”

“等一下你交给我，
“Give it to me later.

我另外给你一笔钱。”
I shall give you another sum of money.”

“不要啦！”朱姨太说：
“Please do not,” she said.

“老爷自己都不得了在那里。”
“You have more than enough trouble of your own.”


接下来，胡雪岩便谈到周少棠，说他从年纪轻时，就显得与众不同，
Hu then spoke of Zhou Shaotang: even as a young man he had stood out from the crowd.

一张嘴能言善道，似乎有些油滑，但做事却实实在在，
His ready tongue might make him seem a little slippery, but in practical matters he was thoroughly dependable.

又谈周太太如何贤惠，朱姨太嫁了过去，一家能够和睦相处。
Hu went on to describe Mrs Zhou’s good character; if Mistress Zhu married into that household, they could all live together in harmony.

朱姨太却一直保持着沉默，
She remained silent throughout.

甚至是不是在倾听，都成疑问，因为她不是低着头，便是望着窗外，仿佛在想自己的心事似的。
Whether she was even listening was doubtful, for she either hung her head or gazed out of the window, apparently absorbed in her own thoughts.

这使得胡雪岩有些不大放心了，
This began to worry Hu.

“你的意思到底怎么样？”他问。
“What do you really think?” he asked.

“我，”朱姨太答说：“我想问问我哥哥。”
“I—I should like to ask my elder brother.”

“初嫁由父，再嫁由己。
“A father decides a first marriage; a woman decides her own remarriage.

你老子去世了，
Your father is dead.

你哥哥怎么管得到你。”
What right has your brother to interfere?”

朱姨太沉吟未答。
She hesitated without replying.

就这时候听得房门轻轻推开，出现在门口的是螺蛳太太。
Just then the door opened softly, and Madam Luosi appeared.

“都弄好了？”胡雪岩问。
“Is everything settled?” Hu asked.

“只有戴姨太，一定不肯去，
“Only Mistress Dai absolutely refuses to go.

情愿去服侍老太太。”
She is willing to serve Old Madam instead.”

“喔。”
“Oh.”

胡雪岩无可无不可地点点头：
Hu nodded without committing himself.

“宋姑娘呢？”
“And Miss Song?”

“她回娘家。”
“She is going back to her parents.

螺蛳太太说：“她要进来给你磕头，我说见了徒然伤心，不必了。”
She wanted to come in and kowtow to you, but I said seeing you would only make her sad, so there was no need.”

“她倒也是有良心的。”
“She does have a conscience.”

胡雪岩又指着朱姨太说：“她有两万多银子存在阜康，
Pointing to Mistress Zhu, he added, “She has more than twenty thousand taels at Fukang.

上个月人家都去提存，她没有提。”
Everyone else withdrew their deposits last month, but she did not.”

“喔。”螺蛳太太没有再说下去。
“Oh,” said Madam Luosi, and went no further.


就这时只听有人叩门，
At that moment someone knocked.

求见的是福生，只为拿进来一份刚送到的《申报》。
It was Fusheng, bringing in a newly delivered copy of the Shenbao.

报上登着胡雪岩革职，交左宗棠查办的新闻，
The paper carried news of Hu’s dismissal and of the order placing his case in Zuo Zongtang’s hands.

还有一段“本埠讯”：“本埠英租界集贤里内，胡雪岩观察所开设之阜康庄号执事人宓本常，因亏空避匿，致庄倒闭等因，已刊前报。
There was also an item under “Local News”: “Previous issues have reported that Mi Benchang, the manager of the Fukang establishment opened by Circuit Intendant Hu Xueyan in Jixian Lane in the British Settlement, went into hiding following a shortage in the accounts, causing the bank to close.

兹悉宓本常初至原籍宁波，继到杭州，然未敢谒胡观察，今仍来沪。
We now learn that Mi first returned to his native Ningbo, then went to Hangzhou, where he did not venture to seek an audience with Intendant Hu, and subsequently returned to Shanghai.

胡观察于日前至沪，约见宓本常，
Intendant Hu arrived here a few days ago and arranged to meet him.

不意宓于当夜眼毒身死。
Unexpectedly, Mi took poison and died that same night.

至前日清晨，始被人发现，已寻短见，
Only on the morning of the day before yesterday was his suicide discovered.

惟察其肚腹膨弯，且有呕血之痕迹，疑吞西国药水身死。”
His swollen abdomen and traces of vomited blood suggest that he died after swallowing a Western medicinal fluid.”


宓本常如何身死，已无足关心，
How Mi had died no longer mattered to Hu.

胡雪岩所关心的是，另外一篇夹叙夹议的文章，题目叫做《胡财神因奢而败》。
What concerned him was another article combining anecdote with comment, entitled “The God of Wealth Hu Ruined by Extravagance.”

其中有一段说：“胡在上海、杭州各营大宅，
One passage read: “Hu built great residences in both Shanghai and Hangzhou.

其杭宅尤为富丽，皆规禁制，仿西法，屡毁屡造。
The Hangzhou mansion was particularly magnificent, following imperial patterns and Western designs, repeatedly demolished and rebuilt.

厅事间四壁皆设尊罍，略无空隙，皆秦汉物，每值于金，
Ancient ritual wine vessels covered the walls of the reception halls, with scarcely an empty space: all were Qin or Han antiquities, each worth a fortune.

以碗沙捣细涂墙，扪之有棱，可以百年不朽。
The walls were coated with finely crushed pottery grit, rough to the touch and capable of lasting a hundred years without decay.

园内仙人洞状如地窖，几榻之类，行行整列。
In the garden was an Immortals’ Grotto resembling a cellar, its tables and couches arranged in orderly rows.

六七月胡御重裘偃卧其中，不知世界内，尚有炎尘况味。”
In the sixth and seventh months Hu would lie there wrapped in heavy furs, unaware that anywhere in the world there was such a thing as oppressive summer heat.”

看以这里，胡雪岩笑出声来，
At this Hu laughed aloud.

螺蛳太太与朱姨太围了拢来，听他讲了那段文章，
Madam Luosi and Mistress Zhu drew close, and he explained the passage to them.

螺蛳太太问道：“什么叫‘重裘’？
“What does ‘heavy furs’ mean?” Madam Luosi asked.

是不是皮袍子？”
“A fur robe?”

“就算不是皮袍子，至少也是夹袄。
“Even if not a fur robe, it would mean at least a lined jacket.

假山洞里比较凉快是有的，何至于六七月里要穿夹袄。
It is certainly cooler inside the rockery, but how could anyone need a lined jacket there in the sixth or seventh month?

我来看看是哪个胡说八道？”
Let me see who is talking such nonsense.”

仔细一看，这篇文章有个总题目，叫做“南亭笔记”；作者名为李伯元。
Looking more carefully, he found that the article appeared under the general heading “Nanting Notes,” and that its author was Li Boyuan.


又有一段说：“胡尝衣敝衣过一妓家，妓慢之不为礼，
Another passage read: “Once, in shabby clothes, Hu visited a courtesan, who treated him with contempt and offered no courtesies.

一老妪殷殷讯问，
An old woman, however, inquired after him attentively.

胡感其诚，坐移时而去。
Touched by her sincerity, he sat for a while before leaving.

明日使馈老妪以薄包，
The next day he sent the old woman a small packet.

启视之，粲粲然金叶也。
When she opened it, gleaming gold leaf lay within.

妓大悔，复使老妪踵其门，请胡命驾，
Deeply regretting her conduct, the courtesan sent the old woman to his door to ask him to visit again.

胡默然无一语，但拈须微笑而已。
Hu said nothing, merely stroking his beard and smiling.

胡尝过一成衣铺，有女倚门而立，颇苗条，
On another occasion he passed a tailor’s shop, where a slender young woman stood in the doorway.

胡注目观之，女觉，乃阖门而入。
He stared at her; noticing him, she went inside and shut the door.

胡恚，使人说其父，欲纳之为妾，
Angered, Hu sent someone to her father to propose taking her as a concubine.

其父靳而不予。
Her father held out and would not consent.

胡许以七千圆，遂成议。
Hu offered seven thousand dollars, and an agreement was reached.

择期某日，燕宾客，酒罢入洞房，开尊独饮，
On the chosen day he entertained guests, then entered the bridal chamber and continued drinking alone.

醉后令女裸卧于床，
When drunk, he ordered the woman to lie naked on the bed.

仅擎巨烛侍其旁，胡回环审视，
A great candle was held beside her while he walked around examining her.

轩髯大笑曰：“汝前日不使我看，
Throwing back his beard, he laughed aloud: ‘The other day you would not let me look at you.

今竟何为？‘”看到这里，胡雪岩复又大笑，
What can you do now?’” Hu laughed again.

“你们看，这个李伯元，
“Listen to this Li Boyuan!

说我一把大胡子。”
He gives me a great big beard.”

接着将那段笔记，连念带讲地告诉了她们。
He read and explained the passage to the two women.

“嚼舌头！”螺蛳太太说：
“Malicious gossip!” Madam Luosi exclaimed.

“哪里有这种事！”
“Nothing of the sort ever happened!”

“而且前言不搭后语。”朱姨太是医生的女儿，略通文墨，指出李伯元的矛盾：
“And he contradicts himself,” said Mistress Zhu, who, as a doctor’s daughter, had some literary education.

“一会‘拈须微笑’，一会‘轩髯大笑’，
“First it is ‘stroking his beard and smiling,’ then ‘throwing back his beard and laughing aloud.’

造谣言造得自己都忘其所以了。”
He invents so many rumors that he loses track of them himself.”

“不错。”
“Quite right.

胡雪岩说：“不过后面这一段倒有意思，
But the next passage is rather interesting.

好象晓得有今天这样的收场结果似的。”
It is almost as though he knew things would end as they have today.”

“喔，”
“Oh?

螺蛳太太问：“他怎么说？”
What does he say?” Madam Luosi asked.

“他说；‘已而匆匆出宿他所。
“He says: ‘Shortly afterward, Hu hurried away to sleep elsewhere.

洁旦遣妪告于女曰：房中所有悉将去，可改嫁他人，此间固无从位置也。
At dawn he sent an old woman to tell her: Take everything in this room and marry someone else; there is no place for you here.

女如言获二万余金归诸父，遂成巨富。’”
She did as instructed and took property worth more than twenty thousand taels back to her father, making him immensely rich.’”


“这个人眼孔也太小了。”朱姨太说：
“This man has a very narrow idea of the world,” Mistress Zhu said.

“两万多银子，就好算巨富了？”
“Does having twenty thousand taels make someone immensely rich?”

胡雪岩不作声。
Hu said nothing.

螺蛳太太问道：“你说，要多少才好算巨富？”
“How much would you say it takes?” Madam Luosi asked.

朱姨太将自己的话回味了一下，才发觉自己的无心之言，已经引起螺蛳太太的猜疑了，
Turning her own words over in her mind, Mistress Zhu realized that her unguarded remark had aroused suspicion.

想了一下答说：“我是笑他这个姓李的眼孔比我还小，
After a moment she answered, “I was laughing at this Mr Li for having an even narrower outlook than mine.

他把两万多银子看得大得不得了，
He thinks twenty thousand taels an enormous amount.

我有两万多银子，情愿不要。”
I have more than twenty thousand taels myself, and I am willing to give it up.”

那是指她的那笔阜康存款而言，再一次表示放弃。
She meant her deposit at Fukang, once again declaring that she would forgo it.

当然，她不妨说漂亮话，
She was free, of course, to make generous speeches.

而胡雪岩认为不需认真分辨，只要照自己的办法去做就是。
Hu saw no need to argue seriously with her; he had only to proceed as he intended.

螺蛳太太更觉不便多说什么，
Madam Luosi felt it still less appropriate to say anything more.

不过朱姨太不想多争财货的本心，却已皎然可见，因而对她又添了几分好感。
But Mistress Zhu’s lack of desire to fight for a larger share of the property was now plain to see, and Madam Luosi liked her the better for it.


这时厅上已经静了下来，只是螺蛳太太与胡太太，照预定的计划，还有遣散男女佣仆的事要安排，所以仍是朱姨太陪着胡雪岩闲坐。
The hall had fallen quiet, but Madam Luosi and Mrs Hu still had to arrange the dismissal of the male and female servants according to their plan, so Mistress Zhu continued to keep Hu company.

“我们进去吧！”胡雪岩说：
“Let us go inside,” he said.

“这里太冷。”
“It is too cold here.”

“园子门还不能开，
“They cannot open the garden gate yet.

老爷再坐一息，
Sit a little longer, Master.

我去叫人再端一个火盆来。”
I shall have another brazier brought.”

一去去了好半天，没有人来理胡雪岩，
She was away a long time, and nobody came to attend to him.

想喝杯茶，茶是冷的，想找本书看，翻遍抽屉，只有一本皇历，
When he wanted tea, it was cold; when he searched the drawers for a book, he found only an almanac.

不由得想起一句俗语：“年三十看皇历，好日子过完了”。
A saying came to mind: “Reading the almanac on New Year’s Eve—all the good days are over.”

朱姨太终于回来了。
Mistress Zhu eventually returned.

原来当十一房姨太太，奉召至二厅时，由老何妈与阿云，随即将多处房门上锁，丫头、使女都被集中到了下房待命。
As soon as the eleven concubines had answered the summons to the second hall, Old Mother He and A’yun had locked a number of doors and assembled the maids and serving women in the servants’ quarters to await instructions.

朱姨太的一个大丫头春香也在其中，便先找到春香，由春香四处去寻觅，
Mistress Zhu had first found her senior maid Chunxiang among them, then sent her searching everywhere.

好不容易才找到了一篮木炭，这一下耽误的工夫便大了。
Only after considerable difficulty had Chunxiang found a basket of charcoal, which accounted for the long delay.

火盆上续了火炭，坐上铜挑子烧开了水。
Fresh charcoal was added to the brazier, and water was boiled in a copper kettle over it.

胡雪岩有了热茶，身上也不冷了，但腹中咕噜噜一阵响，便即问道：
With hot tea and warmth restored, Hu suddenly heard his stomach rumble.

“在哪儿吃饭？”
“Where are we eating?”

“只好在这里。”朱姨太关照春香：“你到小厨房去交代，老爷的饭开到这里来。”
“It will have to be here.” Mistress Zhu told Chunxiang, “Tell the private kitchen to serve the Master’s meal here.”

“我去交代没有用。”
“It is no use my telling them.

春香答说：“有规矩的，小厨房要螺蛳太太的人才算数。”
Under the rules, the private kitchen only takes orders from Madam Luosi’s people.”

“那你去找阿云。”
“Then find A’yun.”

春香答应着去了，不一会回来复命：
Chunxiang went and soon returned.

“小厨房我同阿云一起去的。
“A’yun and I went together.

刘妈说，小厨房今天不开伙。
Mother Liu says the private kitchen is not cooking today.

老爷已经回来了也不晓得，没有预备。
She did not even know the Master was back, so nothing has been prepared.

不过，她没有事做，把明天要吃的腊八粥，倒烧好了，
But having nothing else to do, she has cooked tomorrow’s Laba porridge.

问老爷要不要吃？”
She asks whether the Master would like some.”


“为啥今天小厨房不开伙？”胡雪岩问。
“Why is the private kitchen not cooking today?” Hu asked.

“这当然是螺蛳太太交代的。”朱姨太答说。
“That must have been Madam Luosi’s instruction,” Mistress Zhu answered.

胡雪岩会意了，这也是螺蛳太太迫不得已的下策，伙食断绝，大家自然非即时离去不可。
He understood: cutting off the food was another expedient she had been driven to adopt, since it would force everyone to leave at once.

胡雪岩大不以为然，摇摇头说：
He strongly disapproved and shook his head.

“这也太过分了。
“This goes too far.

出去的人说一句：我是饥了肚子出胡家大门的！
Suppose someone says after leaving, ‘I went out through the Hu family gates on an empty stomach!’

你们想，这话难听不难听？”
Think how that would sound.”

“没法子的事。
“It cannot be helped.

老爷也不要怪螺蛳太太。”
Please do not blame Madam Luosi.”

“我不怪她，
“I do not blame her.

我只怪我自己，
I blame myself.

我应该想到的。”
I should have thought of it.”

朱姨太不再作声，
Mistress Zhu fell silent.

等刘妈带着人来开饭，居然还能摆出四盘四碗来，不过都是现成材料凑付，
When Mother Liu arrived with helpers to serve the meal, she actually managed to produce four plates and four bowls, though everything had been thrown together from ingredients at hand.

而且还有一个人锅，当然是十锦火锅。
There was even an assorted hotpot.

世家大族一到年头，不断有应时的食品，
At the turn of the year, great old households enjoyed a succession of seasonal delicacies.

而况胡家已是钟鸣鼎食之家，兼以胡老太太信佛，所以每年这顿腊八粥，非常讲究，
The Hu family, accustomed to lavish dining, took particular care over the porridge served on the eighth day of the twelfth month, since Old Madam Hu was a Buddhist.

共分上中下三等，
It came in three grades.

中下两等，为执事人等及下人所用，由大厨房预备；
The main kitchen prepared the middle and lowest grades for employees and servants.

上等的由小厨房特制，除了“上头人”以外，只有宾客与少数“大伙”，才能享用。
The best was specially made in the private kitchen, and apart from the family’s superiors, only guests and a few senior employees were allowed it.

这腊八粥的讲究，除了甜的有松仁、莲子、桂圆、红枣等等干果，咸的有香菌、笋干等等珍品以外，
The sweet version contained pine nuts, lotus seeds, dried longan, red dates, and other dried fruits; the savory version had fine mushrooms, dried bamboo shoots, and other delicacies.

另外还加上益中补气的药材。
Medicinal ingredients reputed to nourish and strengthen the body were added as well.

今日之下，艳姬散落如云，满目败落的景象，只有这两种腊八粥，依然如昔。
Today, with the beautiful concubines scattered like clouds and decline visible everywhere, only these two kinds of Laba porridge remained as they had always been.

这便又引起胡雪岩的感慨，但也是一种安慰，
The thought stirred Hu’s sorrow, but also comforted him.

因而很高兴地说：“甜的、咸的我都要。”
“I shall have both sweet and savory,” he said with pleasure.

“先吃咸的，后吃甜的。”朱姨太说：
“Savory first, sweet afterward,” Mistress Zhu advised.

“先吃了甜的，再吃咸的就没有味道了。”
“If you eat the sweet first, the savory will have no taste.”

“对！”胡雪岩说：
“Quite right,” he replied.

“要后头甜。”
“Let the sweetness come afterward.”


等盛了粥来，
The porridge was served.

刚扶起筷子，忽然想起一件事，立即将筷子又放了下来。
Hu had just picked up his chopsticks when something occurred to him, and he immediately put them down again.

“怎么？”
“What is it?”

“老太太那里送去了没有？”
“Has any been sent to Old Madam?”

“这，倒还不知道。”朱姨太急忙喊道：“刘妈，
“I do not know.” Mistress Zhu hastily called, “Mother Liu!

刘妈！”
Mother Liu!”

在外待命的刘妈，应声而进，
Mother Liu, waiting outside, came in at once.

等朱姨太一问，刘妈愣住了，
At the question she stood bewildered.

“螺蛳太太没有交代。”她嗫嚅着说。
“Madam Luosi gave no instructions,” she stammered.

胡雪岩从阜康出事以来，一直没有发过怒，
Hu had not once lost his temper since Fukang’s troubles began.

这时却忍不住了，
Now he could no longer restrain himself.

蓦地将桌子一拍，
He brought his hand down on the table.

“没有交代，你就不管了！”他咆哮着，
“No instructions, so you do nothing!” he roared.

“你们就不想想，老太太平时待你们多少好！
“Have you forgotten how well Old Madam has always treated you?

她不在家，你们就连想都想不到她了，
Because she is away, you cannot even remember her!

忘恩负义，简直不是人！”
Such ingratitude—you are scarcely human!”

一屋的人，都没有见他发过这么大的脾气。
Nobody in the room had ever seen him so angry.

朱姨太见机立即跪了下来，她一跪，其余的人自然也都矮了半截。
Mistress Zhu promptly knelt, and the others naturally followed her example.

“老爷不要生气。
“Please do not be angry, Master.

今天是初七。”
Today is the seventh.”

“今天是初七，明天不是腊八，
“Today is the seventh, so is tomorrow not the eighth?

你以为可以耽误到啥辰光？”
How long do you think you can put it off?”

朱姨太无缘无故挨了骂，自然觉得委屈，但不敢申辩，更不敢哭，
Unjustly scolded, she felt hurt, but dared neither defend herself nor cry.

只是要言不烦地说：“马上就送上山去，
She answered briefly, “It will be sent up the hill at once.

我亲自送。”
I shall take it myself.”

有了这句话，胡雪岩方始解怒，但却忍不住伤心，
Only then did his anger abate, though grief remained.

回想往事，哪一回不是腊月初七先试煮一回，请胡老太太尝过认可，方始正式开煮。
In former years, had they not always made a trial batch on the seventh and sought Old Madam’s approval before preparing the proper batch?

如今连她人在何处，都没有人关心了！
Now nobody even cared where she was.

他这做儿子的，怎不心如刀绞？
How could her son’s heart not feel as though a knife were cutting through it?


其时螺蛳太太已经得报，说是“老爷为了没有替老太太送腊八粥去，大发雷霆”，
Meanwhile Madam Luosi had been told that the Master was furious because no Laba porridge had been sent to Old Madam.

自知疏忽，急急赶了来料理。
Knowing she had been careless, she hurried over to deal with it.

事实上等她赶到，风波已经过去，但胡雪岩心里气尚未消，是她所想象得到的。
By the time she arrived, the storm had passed, but she could imagine that Hu’s anger had not wholly subsided.

好在刘妈平日受她的好处很多，不妨委屈委屈她，来消胡雪岩的余怒。
Fortunately Mother Liu had received many favors from her; she could be made to endure a little injustice to draw off his remaining anger.

因此，她一到便摆脸色给刘妈看，
Madam Luosi therefore confronted her sternly.

“今天腊月初七，不是吃腊八粥的日子，”她问：
“Today is the seventh, not the day for Laba porridge.

“你把腊八粥端出来作啥？”
Why did you serve it?”

“我是问阿兰，腊八粥烧好了，老爷要不要尝一碗。”刘妈嗫嚅着说：
“I asked A’lan whether the Master would like a bowl, since it was ready,” Mother Liu faltered.

“不是我自己要端出来的。”
“I did not bring it on my own initiative.”

“你还要嘴强！”螺蛳太太大喝一声：
“Still arguing!” Madam Luosi shouted.

“你烧好了，自然要吃，
“Once you have cooked it, naturally it must be eaten.

不吃莫非倒掉。
Otherwise are we to throw it away?

哪年的腊八粥，都是晚上一交子时才下锅，
Every year the porridge goes into the pot only when the zi hour begins, around midnight.

你为啥老早烧出来？”
Why did you cook it so early?”

“我是因为今天不开伙……”“哪个跟你讲今天不开伙？”
“Because there was to be no cooking today—” “Who told you that?”

螺蛳太太抢着责问：
Madam Luosi cut in.

“不开伙，难道老爷就不吃饭了？
“Was the Master to go without food?

我怎么关照你的，
What did I tell you?

我说今天有事，乱糟糟的，老爷只怕不能安心吃饭，迟一点再开，
I said there would be business and confusion today, and the Master might not be able to eat in peace, so the meal should be served later.

几时说过今天不开伙！”
When did I ever say there would be no cooking?”

声音越来越高，仿佛动了真气似的，
Her voice rose as though she were truly furious.

刘妈不敢作声。
Mother Liu dared not answer.

胡雪岩倒有点过意不去，正想开口解劝时，不道螺蛳太太却越骂越起劲了。
Hu was beginning to feel uncomfortable and was about to intervene, but Madam Luosi only grew more vehement.


“还有，常年旧规你不是不晓得，每年腊八粥总要请老太太先尝了再煮。
“And you know our old custom perfectly well: Old Madam always tastes the trial porridge before the main batch is cooked.

今年老太太住在山上，
This year she is staying on the hill.

我还打不定主意，腊八粥是送了去，还是带了材料到山上去煮？
I had not decided whether to send it up or take the ingredients there and cook it on the spot.

你就自作主张，不到时候就煮好了。
Yet you went ahead and cooked it before the proper time!”

“说着，螺蛳太太将桌子使劲一拍：”
She struck the table hard.

你好大胆！
“How dare you!”

“到了这个地步，胡雪岩不但余怒全消，
By now Hu’s anger had entirely vanished.

而且深感内疚，自悔不该为这件小事认真，因而反来解劝螺蛳太太，安慰刘妈。
Feeling deeply guilty, he regretted making so much of a small matter and began soothing Madam Luosi and comforting Mother Liu.

“好了，好了！
“Enough, enough!

你也犯不着生这么大的气，
There is no need to be so angry.

总怪我不好。”他又对刘妈说：“你没有啥错。
It is all my fault.” To Mother Liu he added, “You have done nothing wrong.

螺蛳太太说你两句，你不要难过。”
Do not take Madam Luosi’s scolding to heart.”

“我不敢。”
“I would not dare.”

朱姨太与阿兰也来打圆场，一个亲自倒了茶来，一个绞了手巾，服侍螺蛳太太。
Mistress Zhu and A’lan also helped make peace, one pouring tea and the other wringing out a towel to attend to Madam Luosi.

一场风波，霎时间烟消云散。
In an instant the storm dissolved.


“粥还不坏。”胡雪岩说道：
“The porridge is not bad,” Hu said.

“你也尝一碗。”
“Have a bowl yourself.”

“我不饿。”螺蛳太太脸色如常地说：
“I am not hungry,” Madam Luosi replied, her expression quite composed.

“等我去料理完了，同太太一起去看老太太。”
“Once I have finished making the arrangements, I shall go with Madam to see Old Madam.”

“你们两个人都要去？”
“Are you both going?”

“怎么不要？
“Of course.

家里这么一件大事，莫非不要禀告她老人家？”
Surely she must be told about such a great change in the family?

螺蛳太太又说：“戴姨太一去，老太太自然也晓得了，心里会记挂。”
Once Mistress Dai arrives, she will find out anyway and begin to worry.”

这一下提醒了胡雪岩，此是家庭中极大的变故，
This reminded Hu how momentous the upheaval was.

按规矩应该禀命而行，
By the rules of the family, he ought to have sought his mother’s instructions before acting.

如果老母觉得他过于专擅，心里不甚舒服，自己于心何安？
If she thought he had taken too much upon himself and felt hurt, how could he be at peace?

转念到此，便即说道：“我也去。”
“I shall go too,” he said.

“你怎么能去？”
“How can you?

螺蛳太太说，“如果有啥要紧信息，不但没有人作主，
If urgent news comes, there will be nobody to decide what to do.

而且大家都上山，会接不上头。”
With everyone up on the hill, they will not know where to reach us.”

“这倒也是。”
“True enough.

胡雪岩接着又说：“我是怕老太太会怪我，这么大一件事，说都不跟她说一声。”
But I am afraid she will blame me for not saying a word to her about something so important.”

“不要紧！
“Do not worry.

我有话说。”
I know what to say.”

“你预备怎么说法？”
“What will you tell her?”

螺蛳太太看朱姨太不在眼前，只有阿兰在，但也不宜让她听见，便即问道：
Mistress Zhu was out of sight, and only A’lan remained, but Madam Luosi did not want even her to hear.

“刘妈呢？”
“Where is Mother Liu?”

“回小厨房去了。”
“Back in the private kitchen.”

“你叫她来一趟。”
“Ask her to come.”

“是。”
“Yes.”

等阿兰走远了，螺蛳太太方始开口，
Only when A’lan was well away did Madam Luosi speak.

“我打算跟老太太这么说：这件事如果来请示，老太太心里一定不忍，事情就做不成功了。
“I shall tell Old Madam that if we had asked her beforehand, her kind heart would never have allowed it, and nothing could have been done.

倒不如下说，让太太跟我两个人来做恶人。”她接着又说：“倒是纱帽没有了这一层，我不晓得要不要告诉老太太？
It was better to say nothing and let Madam and me be the villains.” She added, “What I do not know is whether to tell her that you have lost your official position.”

“提起这一层，胡雪岩不免难过，
The subject saddened Hu.

“你说呢？”他问。
“What do you think?”

螺蛳太太想了个折衷的说法，不言革职，只道辞官。
Madam Luosi devised a compromise: she would say he had resigned, without mentioning dismissal.

胡雪岩无可无不可地同意了。
He acquiesced without enthusiasm.


其时只见阿云悄悄走了来，低声说了一句：“差不多了。”
A’yun now came quietly up and whispered, “Nearly finished.”

“喔，”
“Oh?

螺蛳太太问道：“太太呢？”
Where is Madam?” Madam Luosi asked.

“肝气又发了，
“Her liver-qi trouble has come on again.

回楼上去了。”
She has gone upstairs.”

“要紧不要紧？”
“Is it serious?”

“不要紧。
“No.

太太自己说，是太累了之故，歇一歇就会好的，
Madam says she is simply too tired and will be better after a rest.

到‘开房门’的时候再会请她？”
Shall we fetch her when it is time to open the rooms?”

“人都走了？”
“Has everyone left?”

螺蛳太太所说的“人”，是指遣散的男女佣仆。
By “everyone,” Madam Luosi meant the dismissed servants.

人数太多，有的在帐户中领取加发的三个月工钱，有的在收拾行李，还有的要将经的的事务，交代给留用的人，
There were so many of them: some were collecting their extra three months’ wages from the accounts office, others were packing, and others still had to hand over their duties to those who would remain.

总要到傍晚才能各散。
It would be evening before they had all dispersed.

不过，这与“开房门”不生影响，因为花园中自成天地。
This did not, however, prevent the rooms from being opened, since the garden formed a separate domain.

螺蛳太太考虑了一会，发觉一个难题，
After thinking for a moment, Madam Luosi discovered a difficulty.

皱着眉问：“有没有人学过铜匠手艺？”
“Has anyone learned the coppersmith’s trade?” she asked with a frown.

一直不曾开口的胡雪岩，诧异地问道：
Hu, who had been silent, looked surprised.

“要铜匠作啥？”
“What do you need a coppersmith for?”

“开锁啊！”
“To open the locks.”

胡雪岩不作声了，
He said no more.

阿云亦能会意：
A’yun understood too.

“在门房里打杂的贵兴，原来是学铜匠生意的。
“Guixing, who does odd jobs in the gatehouse, used to be apprenticed to a coppersmith.

不过，他也是要走的人，”
But he is leaving as well.

她问，“要不要去看看，如果还没有走，留他下来。”
Shall I see whether he is still here and keep him back?”

“要走的人，就不必了。”
“Not if he is leaving.”

“那么去叫个铜匠夹。”
“Then shall we call in a coppersmith?”

“更加不妥当。”
“Still less suitable.”

螺蛳太太沉吟了一下，断然决然地说：“你叫福生预备斧头、钉锤！
Madam Luosi thought, then said decisively, “Tell Fusheng to get axes and hammers.

劈坏几口箱子算什么。”
What does it matter if a few chests are broken?”

原来这天一早，各房姨太太与她们的丫头，一出了园子，房门随即上锁，
That morning, as soon as the concubines and their maids had left the garden, their rooms had been locked.

开房门有钥匙，房间里锁住的箱了，却无钥匙，需要找铜匠来开。
There were keys to the room doors, but none for the locked chests inside, which was why a coppersmith was needed.

但用这样的手段来豪夺下堂妾的私蓄，这话传出去很难听，
Yet word that they were forcibly seizing the private savings of discarded concubines would sound very ugly.

所以螺蛳太太考虑再三，决定牺牲箱子。
After weighing it repeatedly, Madam Luosi decided to sacrifice the chests instead.


“老爷，”螺蛳太太说：“你可以进去了。”
“Master,” Madam Luosi said, “you can go inside now.”

人去楼空，还要劈箱子搜索财物，
The rooms stood empty of their occupants, and their chests were about to be broken open in a search for valuables.

其情难堪。
It was too painful.

胡雪岩摇摇头说：
Hu shook his head.

“我想出去走走。”
“I should like to go out for a walk.”

“预备到哪里？”
“Where do you mean to go?

螺蛳太太建议：“要不去看看德藩台？”
Why not visit Treasurer De?”

照道理说，早该去看德馨了。
By rights he should already have called on Dexin.

但一去要谈正事，胡雪岩心力交瘁，不敢接触严肃的话题，
But such a visit would mean discussing business, and he was so exhausted in mind and spirit that he shrank from serious subjects.

所以摇摇头不答。
He merely shook his head.

“要不去看看她亲家老爷。”
“Or perhaps visit your new relation by marriage?”

螺蛳太太是指他的新亲家“王善人”。
She meant Philanthropist Wang.

胡雪岩想，这一去，必是客气非凡，那些繁文缛节实在吃不消。
Hu reflected that the visit would involve endless courtesies, and all that ceremony was more than he could bear.

“我懒得应酬。”胡雪岩说：
“I cannot face social calls,” he said.

“顶好寻个清静地方，听人讲讲笑话。”
“I should like somewhere quiet where I can listen to people telling jokes.”

“那就只好去寻周少棠了。”
“Then you can only go to Zhou Shaotang.”

“对！”
“Yes!”

胡雪岩望然而起，
Hu rose at once.

“去寻少棠。”
“I shall go and see Shaotang.”

“慢点！”螺蛳太太急忙说道：
“Wait!” Madam Luosi said hastily.

“我们先谈一谈。
“Let us talk first.”



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第十一章（全章）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Eleven (complete)
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第十一章 人去楼空｜CHAPTER ELEVEN: THE PEOPLE GONE, THE TOWERS EMPTY


两人并坐低声谈了好一会方始结束。
The two sat side by side and talked in low voices for a long time before they finished.

胡雪岩戴了一顶风帽，帽檐压得极低，带了一个叫阿福的伶俐小厮，
Hu put on a hooded winter cap, pulling its brim very low, and took a quick-witted servant called A’fu with him.

打开花园中一道很少开启的便门，出门是一条长巷，
They opened a seldom-used side gate in the garden and stepped into a long lane.

巷子里没有什么行人，就是有，亦因这天冷得格外厉害，而且西北风很大，都是低头疾行，
Few people were about, and those who were kept their heads down and hurried along: the cold was unusually severe, with a strong northwesterly wind.

谁也没有发觉。这位平时出门，前呼后拥的胡财神，竞会踽踽凉凉地只带一个小厮步行上街。
Nobody noticed that the God of Wealth, ordinarily surrounded by attendants whenever he went out, was trudging forlornly through the streets with only a single servant.

“阿福，”胡雪岩问道：“周老爷住在哪里，你晓得不晓得？”
“A’fu, do you know where Mr Zhou lives?”

“怎么不晓得？
“Of course.

他住在龙舌嘴。”
At Longshezui.”

“对！龙知嘴。”胡雪岩说：
“Yes, Longshezui.

“你走快一点，通知他我要去。”
Go ahead and tell him I am coming.”

“是。”
“Yes, sir.

阿福问道：“如果他不在家呢？”
What if he is not at home?”

“这么冷的天，他不会出门的。”
“He will not have gone out in weather like this.

胡雪岩又说：“万一不在，你留句话，回来了到城隍山药王庙旁边的馆子里来寻我。”
But if he has, leave word that when he returns he should come and find me at the restaurant beside Yaowang Temple on City God Hill.”

阿福答应一声，迈开大步往前走。
A’fu strode ahead.

胡雪岩安步当车，缓缓行去。
Hu followed slowly on foot.

刚进了龙舌嘴，只见阿福已经走回头路了，
He had barely entered Longshezui when he saw A’fu coming back.

发现主人，急急迎了上来。
Catching sight of his master, the servant hurried towards him.

“怎么样，
“Well?

不在家？”
Is he out?”

“在！”
“No!”

阿福回头一指：
A’fu pointed behind him.

“那不是！”
“There he is!”

原来周少棠特为赶了来迎接。
Zhou had come out specially to meet him.

见了面，胡雪岩摇摇手，使个眼色。
Hu waved a hand and gave him a warning look.

周少棠会意，他是怕在声招呼，惊动了路人，所以见了面，低声问道，“你怎么会来的？”
Understanding that he feared a loud greeting would attract passers-by, Zhou asked quietly, “What brings you here?”


这话问得胡雪岩无以为答，
Hu could find no answer.

笑笑答说：
He smiled.

“你没有想到吧？”
“You did not expect me, did you?”

“真是没有想到，”
“Certainly not.”

胡雪岩发觉已经有人在注意了，便放快了脚步，反而走在周少棠前面，
Noticing that people were already looking, Hu quickened his pace and went ahead of Zhou.

一直到巷口才停住步，抬头看了一下说：
Only at the mouth of the lane did he stop and look up.

“你府上有二十年没有来过了。
“It is twenty years since I visited your house.

我记得是坐南朝北第五家。”
I remember: the fifth house, facing north.”

“搬到对面去了，
“We moved to the other side.

坐北朝南第四家。”
The fourth house, facing south.”

“不错，不错！
“Of course!

你后来买了你对面的房子，
You bought the house opposite.

不过，我还是头一回来。”
This will be my first visit there.”

“这房子风水不好。”
“The house has bad feng shui.”

何以风水不好？
Why bad?

胡雪岩一时无法追问，因为已到了周家。
Hu had no chance to ask, for they had arrived.

周少棠的妻子，胡雪岩还是二十几年前见过，
He had last seen Mrs Zhou more than twenty years before.

记得很清楚的是，生得非常富态，
What he remembered most clearly was her substantial figure.

如今更加发福，一双小足撑持着水牛般的身躯，行动非常艰难，
She had grown still stouter: a pair of tiny bound feet supported a body as large as a buffalo, making movement difficult.

但因胡雪岩“降尊纡贵”，在她便觉受宠若惊，满脸堆笑，非常殷勤。
Yet she was overwhelmed that Hu should condescend to visit, and attended to him with a face full of smiles.


“不敢当，不敢当！”
“Please, please!”

胡雪岩看亲自来敬茶，摇摇晃晃，脚步不稳，真担心她会摔交，
Watching her sway unsteadily as she brought tea herself, Hu genuinely feared she might fall.

所以老实说道：“周大嫂，不要招呼，
“Sister-in-Law Zhou, do not trouble yourself.

你法身太重，掼一交不是当耍的。”
You are too heavy to risk a tumble. It would be no laughing matter.”

“是不是！
“Exactly!

你真好省省了。
Do sit down,” Zhou said.

胡大先生肯到我们这里来，是当我们自己人看待，
“Mr Hu comes here because he treats us as his own people.

你一客气，反而见外了。”
All this ceremony only makes him an outsider.

周少棠又说：“有事叫阿春、阿秋来做。”
Let A’chun and A’qiu do whatever needs doing.”

原来周少棠从受了胡雪岩的提携，境遇日佳，
Since Hu had helped him advance, Zhou’s circumstances had steadily improved.

他又喜欢讲排场，老夫妇两口，倒有四个佣人，
Fond of display, he kept four servants for the elderly couple alone.

阿春、阿秋是十年前买来的两个丫头，如今都快二十岁了。
A’chun and A’qiu had been bought ten years earlier and were now nearly twenty.

“恭敬不如从命。”
“Better to obey than insist on ceremony.”

周太太气喘吁吁地坐了下来，跟胡雪岩寒暄：
Mrs Zhou sat down, panting, and asked after his family.

“老太太精神倒还健旺？”
“Is the old lady still strong?”

“托福，托福。”
“Very well, thank you.”

“胡太太好？”
“And Mrs Hu?”

“还好。”
“Well enough.”

看样子还要问螺蛳太太跟姨太太。
She seemed about to ask after Madam Luosi and the other concubines.

周少棠已经知道了胡家这天上午发生了什么事，
Zhou already knew what had happened in Hu’s household that morning.

怕她妻子过于罗嗦，再问下去会搞得场面尴尬，所以急忙打岔，
Afraid she would keep questioning him and make matters awkward, he hastily intervened.

“胡大先生在我们这里吃饭。”
“Mr Hu will dine with us.

他说：“自己预备来不及了，
There is no time to prepare everything ourselves.

我看只有叫菜来请客。”
We shall have to order some dishes.”


“少棠，”胡雪岩开口了：“你听我说，
“Shaotang, listen.

你不要费事！
Do not put yourself to any trouble.

说句老实话，山珍海味我也吃厌了，
To tell the truth, I have had my fill of rare delicacies.

尤其是这个时候，你弄好了，我也吃不下。
Especially now, I could not eat them however well you prepared them.

我今天来，是想到我们从前在一起的日子，吃得落，困得着，逍遥自在，真同神仙一样，
I came because I remembered our old days together, when we could eat heartily, sleep soundly and live without a care, like immortals.

所以，此刻我不觉得自己是在做客人，
I do not feel that I am a guest here.

你一客气，就不是我来的本意了。
If you treat me ceremoniously, it defeats the purpose of my visit.

你懂不懂我的意思？”
Do you understand?”

“本来不懂，你一说我自然就懂了。”
“I did not before, but now you have explained, naturally I do.”

周少棠想了一下说：
Zhou thought for a moment.

“可惜，张胖子死掉了，
“What a pity Fat Zhang is dead.

不然邀他来一起吃‘木榔豆腐’，听他说荤笑话，
Otherwise we could invite him for mulang tofu and listen to his dirty jokes.

哪怕外头下大雪，都不觉得冷了。”
Even if it were snowing hard outside, we would not feel cold.”

提起张胖子，胡雪岩不免伤感，怀旧之念，亦就越发炽烈，
The mention of Fat Zhang saddened Hu and sharpened his longing for the past.

“当年的老朋友还有哪几个？”
“Which of our old friends are still around?

他说：“真想邀他们来叙一叙。”
I should love to gather them for a talk.”

“这也是改天的事了。”周少棠说：
“That will have to wait for another day.

“我倒想起一个人，
But I can think of one man.

要不要邀他来吃酒？”
Shall we invite him for a drink?”

“哪个？”
“Who?”

“乌先生。”
“Mr Wu.”


胡雪岩想了一下，欣然同意：
After a moment, Hu gladly agreed.

“好的、好的。”
“Yes, yes.

他说：“我倒又想起一个人，郑俊生。”
And I have thought of another: Zheng Junsheng.”

这郑俊生是安康名家——杭州人称滩簧为“安康”，生旦净末丑，五个人坐着弹唱，而以丑为尊，称之为“小花脸”，
Zheng was a celebrated performer of an’kang, the Hangzhou name for tanhuang: five seated performers sang and played the male, female, painted-face, older-male and comic roles, with the comic performer, known as the Little Painted Face, taking precedence.

郑俊生就是唱小花脸的。
That was Zheng’s role.

此人亦是当年与胡雪岩、周少棠一起凑份子喝酒的朋友。
In the old days he had often pooled money with Hu and Zhou for wine.

只为胡雪岩青云直上，身分悬殊，郑俊生自惭形秽，不愿来往，
But as Hu rose swiftly in the world, the gulf between their positions had made Zheng feel inferior, and he had withdrawn.

胡家有喜庆堂会，他亦从不承应。
He never even accepted engagements at Hu’s household celebrations.

胡雪岩一想起这件事，便觉耿耿于怀，这一天很想弥补这个缺憾。
This had always troubled Hu, and today he wanted to make amends.

周少棠知道他的心事，点点头说：
Understanding his feelings, Zhou nodded.

“好的，我同他有来往，
“I still see him.

等我叫人去请他。”当即将他用了已经十年的佣人贵生叫了来吩咐：
Let me send for him.” He called Guisheng, a servant of ten years’ standing.

“你到安康郑先生家去一趟，
“Go to Mr Zheng, the an’kang performer.

说我请他来要有要紧事谈，
Say I need to speak to him about something important.

回头再去请乌先生来吃酒。
Then invite Mr Wu to drink with us.

喔，你到了郑先生那里，千万不要说家里有客。”
And when you are at Zheng’s, be sure not to mention that I have a guest.”

这是怕郑俊生知道胡雪岩在此不肯来，特意这样叮嘱。
He feared Zheng would refuse to come if he knew Hu was there.


交代完了，周少棠告个罪，又到后面跟周太太略略商量如何款客。
After giving these instructions, Zhou excused himself and went to the back to discuss the meal briefly with his wife.

然后在堂屋里坐定了陪胡雪岩围炉闲话。
Then he returned to sit with Hu by the brazier in the main hall.

“你今天看过《申报》了？”客人先开口。
“Have you read Shenbao today?” his guest asked first.

“大致看了看。”
“Glanced through it.

周少棠说：“八个字的考语：加油添酱，胡说八道。
My verdict is simple: embroidered stories and utter nonsense.

你不要理他们。
Pay no attention.”

““我不在乎。
“I do not care.

你们看是骂我；我自己看，是他们捧我。”
You see it as abuse; I see it as praise.”

“你看得开就好。”
“As long as you can take it lightly.

周少棠说：“有句话，叫做‘百足之虫，死而不僵’。
There is a saying: a hundred-legged insect does not fall stiff even when dead.

你只要看得开，着实还有几年快活日子过。
If you can take things as they come, you still have several comfortable years ahead.”

““看得开，也不过是自己骗自己的话。
“Taking things lightly is only a way of deceiving oneself.

这一个多月，我常常会有个怪念头，哪里去寻一种药，吃了会叫人拿过去忘记掉。”
For more than a month I have often had a strange thought: where could I find a medicine that would make me forget the past?

胡雪岩又说：“当然不能连自己的时辰八字、父母兄弟都忘记掉，
Of course, I must not forget my own birth date and hour, my parents or my brothers.

顶好能够把日子切掉一段。”
It would be best if I could cut out a stretch of my life.”

“你要切哪一段呢？”
“Which stretch?”

“从我认识王有龄起，到今天为止，
“From the day I met Wang Youling until now.

这段日子切掉，回到我们从前在一起的辰光，
Cut that out and return to the days when we were together.

那就象神仙一样了。
That would be like living among immortals.”

“周少棠的心情跟他不同，
Zhou did not share his feelings.

觉得说回到以前过苦日子的辰光象神仙一样，未免言过其实。
To describe a return to their former hardships as an immortal’s life seemed a considerable exaggeration.

所以笑笑不作声。
He merely smiled and said nothing.


“少棠，”胡雪岩又问：“你道我现在这种境况，要做两年什么事，才会觉得做人有点乐趣？”
“Shaotang, in my present circumstances, what could I do over the next couple of years to find some pleasure in being alive?”

周少棠想了好一会儿，而且是很认真地在想，但终于还是苦笑着摇摇头说：
Zhou considered for a long time, quite earnestly, but could only shake his head with a bitter smile.

“说老实话，我想不出，
“Honestly, I cannot think of anything.

只有劝你看开点。”
I can only advise you to take things less to heart.”

“我自己倒想得一样。”
“I have thought of something myself.”

“喔！”
“Oh?”

周少棠倒是出自衷心地想与胡雪岩同甘苦，
Zhou sincerely wished to share Hu’s fortunes, good or bad.

只是身分悬殊，谈不到此，但心情是相同的，
Their unequal positions had put that beyond his reach, but the feeling was there.

所以一听胡雪岩的话，很兴奋地催促着：“快！快说出来听听。
He urged him eagerly, “Quick, tell me!”

““你不要心急，
“Do not hurry me.

我先讲一桩事情你听。”
First let me tell you something that happened.”

他讲的就是在老同和的那一番奇遇。讲完了又谈他的感想：
He related his unexpected encounter at Laotonghe, then explained what it had made him think.

“我年年夏天施茶、施药，冬天施粥、施棉袄，
“Every summer I have given away tea and medicine; every winter, congee and padded coats.

另外施棺材，办育婴堂，
I have provided coffins and supported an infant foundling home.

这种好事做是在做，心里老实说一句，叫做无动于衷，
I did all these good works, yet honestly, they left my heart unmoved.

所谓‘为善最乐’这句话，从没有想到过。
The saying that doing good brings the greatest happiness never occurred to me.

少棠，你说，这是啥道理？”
Why do you think that was?”

“我想！”周少棠说：“大概是因为你觉得这是你应该做的，
“Probably because you considered it your duty.

好比每天吃饭一样，例行公事无所谓乐不乐。”
Like eating every day: a matter of routine, with no question of happiness or unhappiness.”

“不错，
“Exactly.

发了财，就应该做这种好事，
A man who has made a fortune ought to do these things.

这是钱用我，不是我用钱，
That meant money was using me, instead of my using money.

所以不觉得发财之可贵……”
So I never understood the true value of being rich…”

“啊，啊！我懂了。”周少棠插嘴说道：
“Ah, I see!” Zhou interrupted.

“要你想做一件事，没有钱做不成，
“You must first want to do something that lack of money prevents.

到有了钱能够如愿，那时候才会觉得发财之可贵。”
When you have the money and can fulfil your wish, you appreciate its value.”

“你这话说对了一半。
“That is only half the answer.

有钱可用，还要看机会，
Even with money available, you must have the opportunity.

机会要看辰光，还要看人。”
That depends on the time—and on the person.”


“怎么叫看人？”
“What do you mean, on the person?”

“譬如说，你想帮朋友的忙，无奈力不从心，
“Suppose you want to help a friend but cannot afford it.

忽然中了一张彩票，而那个朋友又正在为难的时候，
Suddenly you win a lottery prize, just when your friend is in trouble.

机会岂不是很好。
Could there be a better opportunity?

哪知道你把钱送了去，人家不受。
Yet when you take him the money, he refuses.

这就是看人。”
That is what I mean.”

“为啥呢？”周少棠说：
“Why would he refuse?

“正在需要的时候，又是好朋友，
He needs it, and you are a good friend.

没有不受的道理。”
There is no reason.”

“不受就是不受，
“Refusal is refusal.

没有道理好讲的。”
Reason has nothing to do with it.”

“那，”周少棠不住摇头，“这个人一定多一根筋，脾气古怪，不通人情。”
Zhou shook his head repeatedly. “Then he must have something wrong with him—an eccentric who understands nothing of human kindness.”

“换了你呢？”
“What if it were you?”

“换了我，一定受。”
“I should certainly accept.”

“好！”
“Good!”

胡雪岩笑着一指，
Hu pointed at him with a smile.

“这话是你自己说的，
“Those are your own words.

到时候你不要赖！”
Do not go back on them when the time comes.”

周少棠愕然，
Zhou stared.

“我赖啥？”
“Go back on what?

他说：“胡大先生，你的话说得我莫名其妙。”
Mr Hu, you have completely baffled me.”

胡雪岩笑笑不答，只问：“乌先生不是住得很近吗？”
Hu only smiled and asked, “Does Mr Wu not live quite nearby?”

原来乌先生本来住在螺蛳门外。
Mr Wu had originally lived outside Luosi Gate.

当年螺狮太太进胡家大门，周少棠帮忙办喜事，认识了乌先生，
When Madam Luosi entered Hu’s household, Zhou had helped with the wedding arrangements and met him.

两人气味相投，结成至交。
They had taken to each other and become close friends.

螺蛳太太当乌先生“娘家人”，劝他搬进城来住，有事可以就近商量。
Madam Luosi regarded Wu as one of her own family and urged him to move inside the city, where she could consult him more readily.

乌先生便托周少棠觅屋，在一条有名曲折的十三弯巷买的房子，
He asked Zhou to find him a house and bought one in Shisanwan Lane, famous for its many turns.

两家不远，不时过从，乌太太与周太太还结拜成了姐妹。
Their homes were close, they visited frequently, and Mrs Wu and Mrs Zhou had even become sworn sisters.

胡雪岩是因为周少棠提议邀他来喝酒，触机想起一件事，正好跟他商量，因而有此一问。
Zhou’s suggestion of inviting Wu had reminded Hu of something he could discuss with him, which prompted his question.


“快来了，快来了，”
“He will be here soon.”

果不其然，不多片刻，乌先生来了，
Sure enough, Wu arrived before long.

发现胡雪岩在座，顿感意外，殷勤致候，但却不便深谈。
Surprised to find Hu there, he greeted him warmly, but it was not convenient to talk at length.

“少棠，”胡雪岩说：“我要借你的书房一用，
“Shaotang, may I borrow your study?

跟乌先生说几句话。”
I should like a few words with Mr Wu.”

啊唷，胡大先生，你不要笑我了，
“Oh, Mr Hu, do not make fun of me!

我那个记记帐的地方，哪里好叫书房？
How can my little bookkeeping room be called a study?”

““只要有书，就是书房。”
“Where there are books, there is a study.”

“书是有的，时宪书。”时宪书便是历本。
“There is one book: the imperial almanac.”

虽然周少棠这样自嘲地说，但他的书房却还布置得并不算太俗气，
Despite Zhou’s self-mockery, his study was not badly furnished.

又叫阿春端来一个火盆，也预备了茶，然后亲自将房门关上，好让他们从容密谈？
He told A’chun to bring a brazier and prepare tea, then shut the door himself so that the two could speak privately at ease.

“乌先生，我家里的事，你晓不晓得？”
“Mr Wu, do you know what has happened in my household?”

“啥事情？
“What is it?

我一点都不晓得。”
I know nothing.”

乌先生的神情显得有些紧张不安。
Wu looked rather anxious.

“我把她们都打发走了。”
“I have sent them all away.”

“呃，”
“Ah.”

乌先生想了一下问：“几位？”
After a moment Wu asked, “How many?”

“一共十个人。”
“Ten altogether.”

胡雪岩的花园中，有名的“十二楼”，
Hu’s garden was famous for its Twelve Chambers.

遣走十个，剩下两个，
Ten sent away meant two remaining.

当然有螺蛳太太，此外还有一个是谁呢？
One must be Madam Luosi; who was the other?


他这样思索着尚未开口，胡雪岩却换了个话题，谈到周少棠了。
Before Wu could put the question, Hu changed the subject to Zhou Shaotang.

“少棠的独养儿子死掉了。
“Shaotang has lost his only son.

不孝有三，无后为大，
Of the three offences against filial duty, leaving no heir is the worst.

有没有另外纳妾的意思？”
Has he thought of taking a concubine?”

何以问到这话？乌先生有些奇怪，照实答道：
Wondering why Hu should ask, Wu answered truthfully.

“我问过他，
“I asked him.

他说一时没有适当的人。”
He said he could not find a suitable woman just then.”

“他这两个丫头，不都大了吗？”
“Are those two maids not grown up now?”

“他都不喜欢。”
“He likes neither of them.

乌先生说：“他太太倒有意拿阿春收房，劝过他两回，他不要。”
His wife wanted him to take A’chun into his chamber and urged him twice, but he refused.”

“他要怎样的人呢？”
“What sort of woman does he want?”

“这很难说，
“It is hard to say.

不过，看样子，他倒象袁子才。”
But he seems rather like Yuan Zicai.”

“袁子才？”
“Yuan Zicai?

胡雪岩不解，“袁子才怎么样？”
In what way?”

“袁子才喜欢年纪大一点的，不喜欢黄毛丫头。”
“Yuan preferred women a little older, not immature young things.”

乌先生又念了一句诗：“徐娘风味胜雏年。”
Wu quoted a line: “A mature woman’s charm surpasses youthful bloom.”

乌先生与周少棠相知甚深，
He knew Zhou very well.

据他说，在周少棠未有丧明之痛以前，贤惠得近乎滥好人的周太太，因为自己身躯臃肿不便，劝周少棠纳妾来照应起居，
Even before their son died, Mrs Zhou, so kindhearted that she was almost indiscriminate, had urged her husband to take a concubine to look after his daily needs, since her own bulk made it difficult for her.

打算在阿春、阿秋二人中，由他挑一个来收房，周少棠便一口拒绝，原因很多。
She meant him to choose either A’chun or A’qiu, but he refused outright for several reasons.

“他的话，亦不能说没有道理。”乌先生说，
“His argument is not unreasonable,” Wu said.

“老周这个人，做事不光是讲实际，而且表里兼顾，
“He considers both practical matters and appearances.

他说，他平时嘴上不大饶人，所以他要讨小纳妾，人前背后一定会有人臭他，说他得意忘形，
He says he is ordinarily so sharp-tongued that if he takes a concubine, people will certainly abuse him to his face and behind his back, saying prosperity has gone to his head.

如果讨了个不三不四，拿不出去的人，那就更加会笑他了。
If he chooses some unsuitable woman he cannot present in company, they will laugh all the more.

既然担了这样一个名声，总要真的享享艳福，
Since he must bear that reputation anyway, he should at least enjoy a real beauty.

才划算得来。
Only then is it worthwhile.

只要人品真的好，辰光一长，笑他骂他的人，倒过来羡慕他、佩服他，
If she is truly an admirable woman, the people who mock and abuse him will eventually envy and respect him instead.

那才有点意思。”
That would mean something.”


“那么，他要怎么样的人呢？”
“Then what exactly does he require?”

“第一，当然是相貌，
“First, looks, naturally.

娇妻美妾，说都说死了，
‘A lovely wife and a beautiful concubine’—the saying settles it.

不美娶什么妾；
Why take a concubine who is not beautiful?

第二，脾气要好，不会欺侮周太太。”
Second, a good temper: she must not bully Mrs Zhou.”

胡雪岩点点头赞一声：
Hu nodded approvingly.

“好！
“Good!

少棠总算是有良心的。”
Shaotang has a conscience.”

“现在情形又不同了。”
“Now things have changed again.

乌先生接着又说：“讨小纳妾是为了传宗接代，那就再要加个第三：要宜男之相。
The purpose of taking a concubine is to continue the family line, so a third requirement must be added: she should have the look of a woman who will bear sons.”

““那么，我现在说个人，你看怎么样？我那个老七，姓朱的。”
“Then tell me what you think of someone: my seventh, the one surnamed Zhu.”

乌先生愣住了，好一会才说：
Wu stared at him for a long moment.

“大先生，你想把七姨太，送给老周？”
“Mr Hu, you mean to give your seventh concubine to Old Zhou?”

“是啊！”
“Why not?

胡雪岩说：“年大将军不是做过这样的事？”
Did General Nian not do the same?”

“也不光是年大将军。
“Not only General Nian.

赠妾，原是古人常有的事。
Giving away concubines was common in former times.

不过，从你们府上出来的，眼界都高了。
But anyone from your household will be accustomed to a great deal.

大先生，这件事，你还要斟酌。”
Mr Hu, you should consider this carefully.”

“你认为哪里不妥当？”
“What do you think is wrong with it?”

“第一，她会不会觉得委屈；
“First, would she feel wronged?

第二，吃惯用惯，眼界高了，跟老周的日子过得来过不来？”
Second, with the food and comforts she is used to, could she adapt to life with Old Zhou?”

“不会过不来。”
“She could.

胡雪岩答说：“我老实跟你说吧，我不但叫罗四姐问过她，今天早上我同她当面都提过，
To tell you the truth, I not only had Luo Sijie ask her; I spoke to her myself this morning.

不会觉得委屈。
She will not feel wronged.

再说，她到底是郎中的女儿，也知书识字，
Besides, she is a doctor’s daughter, educated and able to read.

见识跟别人到底不同，
Her understanding is different from other women’s.

跟了少棠，亦就象罗四姐跟了我一样。
With Shaotang, she would be like Luo Sijie with me.

她也知道，我们都是为她打算。”
She knows we are thinking of her welfare.”


“那好。
“Very well.

不过老周呢？
But what about Old Zhou?

你同他谈过没有。”
Have you discussed it with him?”

“当然谈过。”
“Of course.”

“他怎么说？”
“What did he say?”

胡雪岩笑一笑说：
Hu smiled.

“再好的朋友，遇到这种事，嘴上推辞，总是免不了的。”
“However close the friendship, in a matter like this there must always be some polite refusal.”

“这话我又不大敢苟同。”
“I am not entirely convinced.

乌先生说：“老周这个人外圆内方，
Old Zhou may be accommodating on the outside, but he has firm principles within.

他觉得做不得的事，决不会做。”
If he thinks something wrong, he will never do it.”

“他为啥不会做，
“Why should he refuse?

你所说的三项条件，她都有的。”
She meets all three of your requirements.

胡雪岩又说：“ 至于说朋友的姨太太，他不好意思要，这就要看旁人了，
If he feels awkward about taking a friend’s concubine, that depends on the people around him.

你们劝他，他会要，你们不以为然，他就答应不下。
Encourage him and he will accept; disapprove and he will not be able to agree.

今天你同郑俊生要好好敲一敲边鼓。
You and Zheng Junsheng must give him a little encouragement today.

还有件事，我要托你，也只有你能办。”
There is something else I want to ask of you, and only you can do it.”

“好！大先生你说。”
“Please tell me.”

“要同周太太先说好。”
“Settle matters with Mrs Zhou first.”

“这！”乌先生拍拍胸脯：
Wu patted his chest.

“包在我身上，
“Leave that to me.

君子成人之美，
A gentleman helps bring others’ good intentions to fulfilment.

我马上就去。”
I shall go at once.”

“好的！
“Good.

不过请你私下同周太太谈，
But speak to her privately.

而且最好不要先告诉少棠，也不要让第三个人晓得，
It would be best not to tell Shaotang beforehand, or let anyone else know.

千万千万。”
Please be very careful.”

“是了！”乌先生答说：
“Understood.

“回头我会打暗号给你。”
I shall give you a signal afterwards.”


于是一个往前，一个往后。
They went in opposite directions, Hu towards the front and Wu towards the back.

往前的胡雪岩走到厅上，恰好遇见郑俊生进门，
As Hu reached the hall, Zheng Junsheng was coming in.

他从亮处望暗处，看不真切，一直上了台阶，听见胡雪岩开口招呼，方始发觉。
Looking from the light into the shade, Zheng could not see clearly; only after climbing the steps and hearing Hu greet him did he recognize him.

“原来胡大先生在这里！”
“So Mr Hu is here!”

他在“安康”中是唱丑的，练就了插科打诨、随机应变的本事，
His comic role in an’kang had trained him to improvise and turn anything into a joke.

所以稍为愣了一下，随即笑道：
After a moment’s surprise he smiled.

“怪不得今天一早起来喜鹊对我叫，
“No wonder the magpies called to me this morning.

遇见财神，我的运气要来了。”
Meeting the God of Wealth must mean my luck is coming.”

胡雪岩本来想说：财神倒运了。
Hu was about to say that the God of Wealth had lost his luck.

转念一想，这不等于说郑俊生运气不好，偏偏遇见正在倒媚的人？
But would that not imply that Zheng too was unlucky, encountering a man in misfortune?

因而笑一笑改口说道：
He smiled and changed his answer.

“不过财神赤脚了。”
“Only the God of Wealth has gone barefoot.”

“赤脚归赤脚，财神终归是财神。”
“Barefoot or not, the God of Wealth is still the God of Wealth.”

“到底是老朋友，还在捧我。”
“An old friend indeed, still flattering me.”

胡雪岩心中一动，他这声“财神”不应该白叫，
Hu felt that this title ought not to be bestowed on him for nothing.

看看有什么可以略表心意之处。
He began considering how he might show his appreciation.

正这样转着念头，只听做主人的在说：
The host interrupted his thoughts.

“都请坐！
“Please sit down, both of you.

难得胡大先生不忘记者朋友，
How good of Mr Hu to remember his old friends!

坐下来慢慢儿谈。”
Let us sit and talk.”

“我们先谈一谈。”郑俊生问道：“你有啥事情要夫照我，”
“First tell me,” Zheng asked, “what business did you want to discuss?”

“没有别的，专诚请你来陪胡大先生。”
“Nothing except asking you here to keep Mr Hu company.”

“喔，
“Oh?

你挑陪客挑到我，有没有啥说法？”
Was there any particular reason for choosing me?”

“是胡大先生念旧，想会会当年天天天一起的朋友。”
“He is thinking of old times and wanted to see friends who used to be with him every day.”

“还有啥人？”
“Who else is coming?”

“今天来不及了，
“There was no time today.

就邀了你，还有者乌。”
I invited only you and Old Wu.”

周少棠突然想起：
Zhou suddenly remembered.

“咦！老乌到哪里去了。”
“Where has Old Wu gone?”

山来了，来了。
“Here I am!”

“乌先生应声从屏风后面闪了出来，”
Wu emerged from behind the screen.

我在后面同阿嫂谈点事，
“I was talking to Sister-in-Law in the back.”

““谈好了没有？”胡雪岩问。
“Have you settled it?” Hu asked.

“谈好了。”
“Yes.”

就在这一句话的交换之间，传递了信息，
Those few words conveyed their message.

周少棠懵揍不觉，郑俊生更不会想到他们的话中暗藏着玄机，
Zhou noticed nothing, and Zheng had no idea that anything lay beneath them.

胡雪岩当然亦是不动声色，只在心里盘算。
Hu likewise showed no outward sign, merely continuing his private calculations.


“老爷！”阿春来请示：“菜都好了，
“Master,” A’chun came to ask, “the dishes are ready.

是不是现在就开饭？”
Shall we serve?”

“客都齐了。
“Everyone is here.

开吧！”
Go ahead.”

于是拉开桌子，摆设餐具。
The table was opened out and the places laid.

菜很多，有“宝饭儿”叫来的，也有自己做的，
There were many dishes, some ordered from Baofan’er and some cooked at home.

主菜是鱼头豆腐，杭州人称之为“木榔豆腐”，木榔是头的歇后语，
The principal dish was fish-head tofu, called mulang tofu in Hangzhou, mulang being an allusive expression for a head.

此外有两样粗的菜，一样是肉片、豆腐衣、青菜杂烩，名为“荤素菜”，再一样，是虾油、虾子，加几粒虾仁白烧的“三虾豆腐”。
There were also two simple dishes: a mixture of sliced pork, bean-curd skin and greens, called “meat and vegetables,” and “three-shrimp tofu,” cooked in a pale sauce with shrimp oil, shrimp roe and a few shelled shrimps.

这是周少棠与胡雪岩寒微之时，与朋友们凑份子吃夜饭常点的菜，
These were dishes Hu and Zhou had often ordered when pooling their money with friends for an evening meal in their poor days.

由于胡雪岩念切怀旧，所以周少棠特为点了这两样菜来重温旧梦。
Since Hu longed so deeply for the past, Zhou had ordered them specially to revive those memories.

家厨中出来的菜，讲究得多，
The home-cooked dishes were far more elaborate.

一个硕大无朋的一品锅，是火腿煮肥鸡，另外加上二十个鸽蛋，
An enormous yipin pot held a fat chicken cooked with ham, with twenty pigeon eggs added.

再是一条糟蒸白鱼，
There was also a whitefish steamed with wine lees.

光是这两样菜，加上鱼头豆腐，就将一张方桌摆满了。
Those two dishes and the fish-head tofu alone filled the square table.

“请坐，胡大先生请上座。”
“Please, Mr Hu, take the seat of honour.”

“不！不！
“No, no.

今天应该请乌先生首座，俊生其次，第三才是我。”
Today Mr Wu should sit first, Junsheng next, and I third.”

“没有这个道理。”乌先生说：
“That cannot be right,” Wu said.

“我同俊生是老周这里的常客，
“Junsheng and I are regular visitors here.

你难得来，
You seldom come.

应该上座。”
The place of honour is yours.”

“不！乌先生，你们先坐了，
“Please sit first.

我有一番道理，等下再说，
I have my reasons and shall explain them later.

说得不对，你们罚我酒，
If they are wrong, you may make me drink a penalty cup.

好不好。”
Will that do?”

乌先生听出一点因头来了，点点头说：
Wu caught a hint and nodded.

“恭敬不如从命。
“Better to obey than insist on ceremony.

俊生，我们两个人先坐。”
Junsheng, let us sit.”

坐定了斟酒，
Once they were seated, wine was poured.

烫热了的花雕，糟香扑鼻。
The warmed Huadiao gave off a rich fermented fragrance.

郑俊生贪杯，道声：“好酒！”
Fond of his drink, Zheng exclaimed, “Excellent wine!”

先干了一杯，笑笑说道：“春天不是读书天，夏日炎炎正好眠，
He drained a cup and recited with a smile: “Spring is no season for studying books; summer’s heat is best for sleep.

待得秋天冬已到，一杯老酒活神仙。”
By the time autumn comes, winter is here—a cup of old wine makes an immortal of me.”


大家都笑了，
They all laughed.

胡雪岩便说：“俊生，你今天要好好儿唱一段给我听听。”
“Junsheng, you must perform something for me today,” Hu said.

“一句话，你喜欢听啥？
“Only say what you want to hear.

可惜没有带只三弦来，只有干唱了。”
A pity I did not bring a sanxian; I shall have to sing without accompaniment.”

“你的拿手活儿是‘马浪荡，，说多于唱，
“Your speciality is Ma the Rake, and there is more talking than singing in that.

没有三弦也不要紧。”
The sanxian will hardly matter.”

“三弦家伙我有地方借，
“I know where to borrow one.

不要紧！”
No difficulty!”

周少棠高高举杯，
Zhou raised his cup high.

“来、来，
“Come, come.

酒菜都要趁热。”
Wine and food should both be taken hot.”

有的浅尝一口，有的一吸而尽，
Some sipped; others drained their cups.

郑俊生于了杯还照一照，口中说道：
Zheng finished his and displayed the empty bottom.

“说实话，我实在没有想到，今天会在这里同胡大先生一淘吃酒。”
“To tell the truth, I never expected to be drinking here with Mr Hu today.”

这句话听起来有笑胡雪岩“落魄”的意味，
It could sound as though he were mocking Hu’s fall.

作主人的周少棠，为了冲淡可能会发生的误会，接口说道：“我也没有想到胡大先生今天会光降，
To dispel any possible misunderstanding, Zhou quickly said, “Nor did I expect the honour of his visit.

难得的机会，
Such a rare gathering deserves a proper drinking session.

不醉无归。”
Nobody goes home sober.”

“难得老朋友聚会，我有一句心里话要说。”
“Since old friends have so seldom met, there is something I want to say from the heart.”

胡雪岩停了下来，视线扫了一周，最后落在郑俊生身上：
Hu paused, looked round and let his gaze settle on Zheng.

“俊生，你这一向怎么样？”
“Junsheng, how have things been with you lately?”

郑俊生不知他问这句话的用意，想一想答说：“还不是老样子，
Unsure what lay behind the question, Zheng thought, then answered, “Much as always.

吃不饱、饿不杀。”
Never enough to fill me, never so little as to starve.”

“你要怎样才吃得饱？”
“What would it take to fill you?”

从来没有人问过他这话，他自己也没有想过这一点。
Nobody had ever asked him that, and he had never considered it himself.

他愣了一下，
He hesitated.

忽然想到曾一度想过、而自以为是胡思乱想、旋即丢开的念头，
Then he remembered an idea he had once entertained and immediately dismissed as a foolish dream.

随即说出口来。
He spoke it aloud.

“我自己能弄它一个班子就好了。”
“If only I could start a troupe of my own.”


“喔，”
“Oh?

胡雪岩紧接着问：“怎么个弄法？”
How would you go about it?”

“有钱马上就弄起来了。”
“With money, I could start at once.”

“你说！”
“Tell me.”

这一来，周少棠与乌先生部知道胡雪岩的用意了，
By now Zhou and Wu both understood Hu’s intention.

一起用眼色怂恿郑俊生快说。
They urged Zheng on with their eyes.

郑俊生当然也明白了，胡雪岩有资助他的意思，
Zheng understood too: Hu meant to help finance him.

心里不免踌躇，
Yet he hesitated.

因为一直不愿向胡雪岩求助，
He had always refused to ask Hu for assistance.

而当他事业失败之时，反而出此一举，自然是件不合情理之事。
To do so now, after Hu’s business had failed, would hardly be reasonable.

“你说啊！”周少棠催他：
“Go on!” Zhou urged.

“你自己说的，胡大先生虽然赤脚，到底是财神，
“You said it yourself: Mr Hu may be barefoot, but he is still the God of Wealth.

帮你千把银子弄个班子起来的忙，还是不费吹灰之力。”
Helping you with a thousand taels or so to start a troupe would be no effort at all.”

“却之下恭，受之有愧。
“To refuse would be disrespectful; to accept leaves me ashamed.

而且自己觉得有点于心不甘。
And I feel a little regret besides.

此话怎讲？”
Why?

郑俊生自问自答地说：“想想应该老早跟胡大先生开口的，
I ought to have spoken to Mr Hu long ago.

那就不止一千两银子了。
Then it would have been more than a thousand taels.

不过，”他特别提高了声音，下个转语：“我要早开口，胡大先生作兴上万银子帮我，
But”—Zheng raised his voice to make his turn—“had I asked earlier, he might have given me ten thousand.

那是锦上添花，
That would have been flowers added to brocade.

不如现在雪中送炭的一千两银子，情意更重。”
A thousand now is charcoal brought through snow, and the kindness is greater.”

周少棠听他的话，先是一愣，然后发笑，
Zhou stared, then laughed.

“熟透了的两句成语，锦上添花，雪中送炭，
“Two expressions everybody knows—flowers on brocade and charcoal in snow.

你这样拿来用，倒也新鲜。”
You have found a novel way of using them.”

“不过，”乌先生接口道：“细细想一想，他也并没有用错，
“Yet, when one thinks about it, he has not used them wrongly,” Wu said.

胡大先生自己在雪地里，还要为人家送炭，
“Mr Hu is himself out in the snow and still brings charcoal to others.

自然更加难得，
That makes it all the more remarkable.

来、来，干一杯，但愿俊生的班子，有一番轰轰烈烈的作为。”
Come, let us drink, and wish Junsheng’s troupe a splendid future.”

“谢谢金口。”
“Thank you for those auspicious words.”

郑俊生喝干了酒，很兴奋地说：“我这个班子，要就不成功，要成功了的话，你们各位看在那里好了，一定都是一等一的好角色。”
Zheng drained his cup and said excitedly, “Either this troupe will come to nothing, or, if it succeeds, you will see: every performer will be first-rate.”

“不错！我也是这样子在想，
“Exactly what I think.

凡事要么不做，要做就要象个样子。
Either do not undertake something, or do it properly.

俊生，你放手去干，
Junsheng, go ahead without hesitation.

钱，不必发愁，
Do not worry about money.

三五千银子，我还凑得出来。”
I can still raise three or five thousand taels.”


郑俊生点点头，双眼乱眨着，似乎心中别有盘算。
Zheng nodded, blinking rapidly, as though some other calculation occupied him.

就这时，阿秋走来，悄悄在周少棠耳际说了句，“太太请，”
Just then A’qiu came and whispered in Zhou’s ear, “Madam would like to see you.”

“啥事情？”
“What about?”

“不晓得，
“I do not know.

只说请者爷抽个空进去，
She only asks you to spare a moment.

太太有话说。”
She has something to say.”

“好！”
“Very well.”

周少棠站起身来说：
Zhou stood.

“暂且失陪。
“Excuse me.

我去去就来。”
I shall be back shortly.”

等他一走，郑俊生欲言又止，
Once he had gone, Zheng seemed about to speak, then stopped.

踌躇了一会，方始开口，但却先向乌先生使个眼色，示意他细听。
After hesitating, he finally began, first giving Wu a look that asked him to listen carefully.

“胡大先生，我有个主意，
“Mr Hu, I have an idea.

你算出本钱，让我去立个班子，
You provide the capital, and I shall start a troupe.

一切从宽计算，充其量两千银子。
Even allowing generously for everything, two thousand taels would be the most it could cost.

不过你要给我五千，
But give me five thousand.

另外三千备而不用。”
I shall keep the other three thousand in reserve.”

说着，他又抛给乌先生一个眼色，“这回是示意他搭腔。
He cast Wu another glance, inviting him to join in.

乌先生是极细心、极能体会世情的人，
Wu was observant and understood the ways of the world.

知道郑俊生的用意，这三千银子，胡雪岩随时可以收回，
He recognized the purpose: Hu could reclaim the three thousand at any time.

亦隐隐然有代为寄顿之意——
It also hinted at keeping money safe for him.

中国的刑律，自有”籍没“，亦就是俗语所说的抄家这一条以来，便有寄顿资财于至亲好友之家的办法，
Ever since confiscation had entered Chinese criminal law, people had placed property with close relatives and friends to preserve it.

但往往由于受托是犯法的行为，受托者每有难色；
But accepting such property was itself an offence, so those asked often hesitated.

至于自告奋勇、愿意受寄者，百不得一。
Fewer than one in a hundred volunteered.

乌先生相信郑俊生是见义勇为，决无趁火打劫之意，
Wu believed Zheng was acting courageously out of friendship, with no intention of profiting from Hu’s distress.

但对胡雪岩来说，这数目太小了，不值一谈，
To Hu, however, the sum would be too small to discuss.

所以乌先生佯作不知，默然无语。
Wu therefore pretended not to understand and remained silent.

其实，郑俊生倒确是一番为胡雪岩着想的深刻用心，
Zheng’s concern was in fact far-reaching.

他是往最坏的方面去想，设想胡雪岩在革职以后会抄家，一家生活无着，
Imagining the worst, he feared that dismissal would be followed by confiscation, leaving Hu’s family without a livelihood.

那时候除了这三千两银子以外，还有由他的资本而设置的一个班子，所人亦可维生，
Then, besides the three thousand taels, there would be a troupe established with Hu’s capital, whose earnings could support them.

郑俊生本人只愿以受雇的身分，领取一份薪水而已。
Zheng himself would be content to draw a salary as an employee.

胡雪岩自是全然想不到此，
None of this occurred to Hu.

只很爽快地答应：
He readily agreed.

“好！
“Good.

我借你五千银子。
I shall lend you five thousand.

只要人家说一声：听滩簧一定要郑俊生的班子。我这五千银子就很值了。
If people say, ‘For tanhuang, you must hear Zheng Junsheng’s troupe,’ my five thousand will have been well spent.”

“胡雪岩接着又对乌先生说：“你明天到我这里来一趟，
Turning to Wu, he added, “Come to my house tomorrow.

除了俊生这件事以外，我另外还有话同你说。”
Besides Junsheng’s business, there is something else I want to discuss.”


谈到这里，只见周少棠去而复回，入席以后亦不讲话，只是举怀相劝，
Zhou returned and resumed his seat without speaking, merely raising his cup to his guests.

而他自己却有些心不在焉的模样，引杯及唇，却又放下，一双筷子宕在半空中，仿佛不知从何下著。
He seemed distracted: his cup reached his lips and was set down again; his chopsticks hovered in the air as though he could not decide where to begin.

这种情形，胡雪岩、乌先生看在眼里，相视微笑，
Hu and Wu exchanged knowing smiles.

郑俊生却莫名其妙。
Zheng was puzzled.

“怎么搞的？”
“What has happened?

他问：“神魂颠倒，好象有心事。”
You seem quite bewildered, as though something were on your mind.”

“是有心事，从来没有过的。”
“There is—something quite unprecedented.”

周少棠看着胡雪岩说：
Zhou looked at Hu.

“胡大先生，你叫我怎么说？”
“Mr Hu, what am I to say?”

原来刚才周太太派丫头将周少棠请了进去，就是谈胡雪岩赠妾之事。
Mrs Zhou had summoned him to discuss Hu’s gift of a concubine.

周太太实在很贤惠，乐见这一桩好事，
She was truly a considerate wife and delighted at the prospect.

虽然乌先生照胡雪岩的意思，关照她先不必告诉周少棠，但她怕周少棠不明了她的心意，人家一提这桩好事，他一定会用“我要先问问内人的意思”的话来回答。
Although Wu, following Hu’s instructions, had asked her not to tell Zhou beforehand, she feared that her husband, uncertain of her feelings, would answer any proposal with, “I must consult my wife first.”

那一来徒费周折，
That would only create needless complications.

不知直截了当先表朋态度。
Better to make her position clear at once.

在周少棠有此意外的姻缘，自然喜不自胜，但就做朋友的道理来说，少不得要惺惺作态一番。
Zhou was naturally overjoyed by this unexpected marriage, but friendship required a show of reluctance.

这时候就要旁人来敲边鼓了，
Now someone else must encourage him.

乌先生在胡雪岩的眼色授意之下，便向郑俊生说道：“我们要吃老周的喜酒了。”
At a glance from Hu, Wu told Zheng, “We shall be drinking at Old Zhou’s wedding.”

“喔，喔，好啊！”
“Oh, excellent!”

郑俊生见多识广，看到周少棠与胡雪岩之间那种微妙的神情，已有所觉，
Experienced in the world, Zheng had noticed the subtle expressions passing between Zhou and Hu and guessed something of the truth.

“大概是胡大先生府上的哪个大姐，要变成周家姨太太了。”
“One of the young ladies in Mr Hu’s household is to become a concubine in the Zhou family, I suppose?”

“大姐”是指丫头，
By “young ladies” he meant maids.

乌先生答说：“你猜到了一半，
“You are half right,” Wu answered.

不是赠婢是赠妾。
“It is a concubine being given, not a maid.

我们杭州，前有年大将军，后有胡大先生。“接着便将经过情形说了一遍，大大地将朱姨太太夸赞了一番。
Hangzhou had General Nian in the past; now it has Mr Hu.” He explained the circumstances and praised Mistress Zhu warmly.

“恭喜，恭喜！
“Congratulations!

又是一桩西湖佳话。”郑俊生说：
Another fine West Lake story,” Zheng said.

“谈到年大将军，他当初拿姨太太送人是有用意的，
“But General Nian had a purpose when he gave away concubines.

不比胡大先生一方面是为了朋友传宗接代，一方面是为了姨太太有个好归宿，
Mr Hu wants both to continue a friend’s family line and to find a good home for the woman.

光明正大，义气逼人。
It is an open, honourable act of extraordinary generosity.

这桩好事，要把官维持到底，照我看，要有个做法。”
To keep this a good thing to the end, however, I think there is a precaution we should take.”


“喔，”胡雪岩很注意地问：“请你说，要怎么做？”
“Please explain. What should we do?” Hu asked attentively.

“我先说当初年大将军，拿姨太太送人，也不止在杭州的一个，
“First let me tell you that General Nian gave away more than one concubine, and not only in Hangzhou.

而且他送人的姨太太，都是有孕在身的……”
Every woman he gave away was pregnant…”

原来年羹尧的祖先本姓严，安徽怀远人，
In Zheng’s account, Nian Gengyao’s ancestors had originally borne the surname Yan and came from Huaiyuan in Anhui.

始祖名叫严富，两榜及第中了进士，
The founder of the line was Yan Fu, who passed the examinations and became a jinshi.

写榜时，误严为年。
When the list of successful candidates was written, his surname Yan was mistakenly written as Nian.

照定例是可以请求礼部更正的，但那一来便须办妥一切手续后，方能分发任官，
Under the regulations he could have requested a correction from the Ministry of Rites, but all the formalities would have had to be completed before he could receive an appointment.

未免耽误前程，因而将错就错，改用榜名年富。
Rather than delay his career, he accepted the error and used the name Nian Fu.

年富入仕后，被派到辽东当巡按御史，子孙便落籍在那里。
On entering office he was sent to Liaodong as inspecting censor, and his descendants settled there.

及至清太祖起兵，辽东的汉人，被俘为奴，称为“包衣”。
When the Qing founder Taizu took up arms, the Han Chinese of Liaodong were captured and made bondservants, called booi.

包衣有“上三旗”、“下五旗”之分，
They were divided between the Upper Three and the Lower Five Banners.

上三旗的包衣隶属内务府，下五旗的包衣则分隶诸王门下。
Those of the Upper Three came under the Imperial Household Department; those of the Lower Five served the princes.

年羹尧的父亲年遐龄、长兄年希尧及他本人，在康熙朝皆为雍亲王门下，雍亲王便是后来的雍正皇帝，
During the Kangxi reign, Nian Gengyao’s father Nian Xialing, his elder brother Nian Xiyao and Nian Gengyao himself all belonged to the household of Prince Yong, the future Yongzheng Emperor.

年羹尧的妹妹，原是雍亲王的侧福晋，以后封为贵妃。
Nian Gengyao’s younger sister had been the prince’s secondary consort and later became a Noble Consort.

包衣从龙入关后，一样也能参加考试，
After following their rulers through the passes into China, bondservants could also sit the examinations.

而且因为有亲贵奥援，飞黄腾达，往往是指顾间事。
With powerful imperial relatives to support them, advancement could come in the twinkling of an eye.


年遐龄官至湖广巡抚，年希尧亦是二品大员，
Nian Xialing rose to be governor of Huguang; Nian Xiyao too became a senior official of the second rank.

年羹尧本人是康熙三十九年的翰林，
Nian Gengyao entered the Hanlin Academy in the thirty-ninth year of Kangxi.

由于雍亲王的推荐，出任四川总督。
Recommended by Prince Yong, he became governor-general of Sichuan.

其实，这是雍亲王为了夺嫡布下的一着棋。
This was actually a move in the prince’s struggle for the succession.

原一为康熙晚年已经选定了皇位继承人，即是雍亲王的同母弟、皇十四子恂郡王胤祯，
In his later years, Kangxi had already chosen an heir: Prince Yong’s full brother, the fourteenth imperial son Yinzhen, Prince Xun.

当他奉命以大将军出征青海时，特许使用正黄旗县，暗示代替天子亲征，亦即暗示天命有归。
When ordered to campaign in Qinghai as commander-in-chief, he was specially permitted to use the Plain Yellow Banner, implying that he represented the emperor on campaign and that Heaven’s mandate would pass to him.

恂郡玉将成为未来的皇帝，是一个心照不宣的公开秘密。
His future accession was an open secret.

询郡王征青海的主动助手便是年羹尧。
Nian Gengyao was his chief support in the Qinghai campaign.

及至康熙六十一年冬天，皇帝得病，势将不起，急召恂郡王来京时，却为手握重兵的年羹尧所钳制，
In the winter of Kangxi’s sixty-first year, the emperor fell gravely ill and urgently summoned Prince Xun to the capital, but Nian, commanding powerful forces, held him back.

因此，雍亲王得以勾结康熙皇帝的亲信、后来为雍正尊称为“舅舅”的隆科多，巧妙地夺得了皇位。
Prince Yong was thus able to collude with Kangxi’s confidant Longkodo, whom he later honoured as “Uncle,” and skilfully seize the throne.

雍正的城府极深，
Yongzheng concealed his intentions deeply.

在夺位不久，便决定要杀隆科多与年羹尧灭口。
Soon after taking power, he decided to kill both Longkodo and Nian to silence them.

因此，起初对年羹尧甘言蜜语，笼络备至，养成他的骄恣之气。
At first he flattered Nian and showed him every favour, encouraging his arrogance.

年羹尧本来就很跋扈，自以为皇帝有把柄在他手里，无奈其何，
Already overbearing, Nian believed he held the emperor’s secret and was therefore untouchable.

越发起了不臣之心，种种作为都显出他是吴三桂第二。
His disloyal ambitions grew until his conduct resembled that of a second Wu Sangui.

但时势不同，
But circumstances had changed.

吴三桂尚且失败，年羹尧岂有幸理。
Even Wu Sangui had failed; what hope had Nian?

雍正用翦除他的羽翼以及架空他的兵权的手法，双管齐下，
Yongzheng simultaneously stripped away his supporters and emptied his military authority of substance.

到他乞饶不允，年羹尧始知有灭门之祸，
Only when his pleas for mercy were refused did Nian realize that his whole family faced destruction.

因而以有孕之妾赠人，希望留下自己的骨血。
He therefore gave away pregnant concubines in the hope of preserving his own bloodline.


郑俊生的这番话，在座的人都是闻所未闻，
None of those present had heard this account before.

“那么，”乌先生问：“年羹尧有没有留下亲骨血呢？”
“Then did Nian leave any descendants?” Wu asked.

“有。”
“Yes.

郑俊生答说：“有个怪姓，就是我郑俊生的生字。
There is an unusual surname, Sheng—the last character of my own name, Zheng Junsheng.

凡姓生的，就是年羹尧的后代。”
Everyone surnamed Sheng is descended from Nian Gengyao.”

“为什么要取这么一个怪姓。”
“Why choose such an odd surname?”

“这也是有来历的，
“There is a story behind that too.

年字倒过来，把头一笔的一撇移到上面，
Turn the character Nian upside down and move its first slanting stroke to the top.

看起来不就象生字？”郑俊生说：“闲话表过，
Does it not look like Sheng?” Zheng continued, “But enough of the digression.

言归正传。
Back to our business.

我是想到，万一朱姨太太有孕在身，
Suppose Mistress Zhu is already pregnant.

将来两家乱了血胤，不大好。”
If the bloodlines of the two families become confused, that will be unfortunate.”

“啊，啊！”
“Ah!”

乌先生看着胡雪岩说：
Wu looked at Hu.

“这要问大先生自己了。”
“We must ask Mr Hu about that.”

“这也难说得很。”
“It is hard to be certain.”

胡雪岩沉吟了一会说：
Hu thought for a while.

“老郑的话很不错，
“Old Zheng has a point.

本来是一桩好事，将来弄出误会来倒不好了，
What begins as a good thing should not lead to misunderstanding.

为了保险起见，我倒有个办法，
To be safe, I have a plan.

事情我们就说定了。
Let us settle the match now.

请少棠先找一处地方，让她一个人住两个月，
Shaotang can first find a place where she can live alone for two months.

看她一切如常再圆房。
Once it is clear that everything is normal, they can consummate the marriage.

你们看好不好？”
What do you think?”

“对，对！”
“Yes, yes!”

郑俊主与乌先生不约而同地表示赞成。
Zheng and Wu agreed together.

“那么，两位就算媒人。
“Then you two shall be the matchmakers.

怎么样安排，还要请两位费心。
I must trouble you to see to the arrangements.”


原来请乌先生跟郑俊生上坐的缘故在此。
So that was why Hu had insisted that Wu and Zheng take the places of honour.

事到如今，周少棠亦就老老脸皮，不再说假惺惺的话，
Matters had gone this far; Zhou now put aside embarrassment and empty protestations.

逐一敬酒，头一个敬胡雪岩。
He offered toasts to each in turn, beginning with Hu.

“胡大先生，我什么话都用不着说，
“Mr Hu, there is nothing I need say.

总而言之，路遥知马力，日久见人心。
Distance tests a horse’s strength; time reveals a person’s heart.

倘若我能不绝后，我们周家的祖宗，在阴世都会给胡大先生你磕头。”
If my family line can be preserved, all our Zhou ancestors in the other world will kowtow to you.”

“失言，失言！”胡雪岩说：
“A slip of the tongue!” Hu said.

“你怎么好说这样的话，
“How can you say such a thing?

罚酒。”
Drink a penalty.”

“是，是，罚酒。”
“Yes, a penalty.”

周少棠干了第二杯酒以后，又举杯敬乌先生。
After finishing a second cup, Zhou raised another to Wu.

“应该先敬他。”
“You should toast him first.”

乌先生指着郑俊生说：
Wu pointed at Zheng.

“不是他看得透，说不定弄出误会来，蛮好的一桩事情。变得糟不可言，
“Without his foresight, there might have been a misunderstanding that turned a fine affair into a dreadful mess.

那就叫人哭不出来了。”
We should have been beyond tears.”

“不错！”胡雪岩接口，
“Quite right,” Hu said.

“提到这一层，我都要敬一敬老郑。”
“For that thought, I must drink to Old Zheng myself.”

“不敢当，不敢当。”
“You are too kind.”

三个人都干了酒，
All three drained their cups.

最后轮到乌先生。
Finally it was Wu’s turn.

“老周，”他自告奋勇，“你的喜事，我来替你提调。”
“Old Zhou, let me manage the wedding for you.”

“那就再好都没有。
“Nothing could be better.

拜托拜托！”
I leave it in your hands.”

这一顿酒，第一个醉的是主人，
The host was the first to become drunk.

胡雪岩酒量不佳，不敢多喝，清醒如常，
Hu, who had little capacity for wine, drank cautiously and remained as clearheaded as ever.

散席后邀乌先生到家里作长夜之谈。
When the meal ended, he invited Wu home for a long night’s conversation.

乌先生欣然同意。
Wu gladly agreed.

两人辞谢主人，又与郑俊生作别，带着小厮安步回元宝街。
They thanked their host, said goodbye to Zheng, and set off on foot for Yuanbao Street with the servant.


走到半路，发现迎面来了一乘轿子，前后两盏灯笼，既大且亮。
Halfway home they saw a sedan chair approaching, preceded and followed by two large, bright lanterns.

胡雪岩一看就知道了，
Hu recognized it at once.

拉一拉乌先生，站在石板路正中不动。
He tugged Wu’s sleeve and stopped in the middle of the stone-paved road.

走近了一看，果然不错，大灯笼上，扁宋字一面是“庆余堂”，一面是个“胡”字。
As it drew nearer, he saw that he was right: each large lantern bore “Qingyu Hall” on one side and “Hu” on the other, in broad, flattened Song-style lettering.

问起来才知道螺蛳太太不放心，特意打发轿子来接。
On inquiry, he learned that Madam Luosi, worried about him, had sent the chair to fetch him.

但主客二人，轿只一乘，
But there were two men and only one chair.

好在家也近了，胡雪岩吩咐空轿抬回，他仍旧与乌先生步行而归。
Since they were close to home, he ordered it carried back empty and continued walking with Wu.

一进了元宝街，颇有陌生的感觉，
Yuanbao Street felt strangely unfamiliar.

平时如果夜归，自街口至大门，都有灯笼照明，
Ordinarily, when he returned at night, lanterns lit the whole way from the street entrance to his gate.

这天漆黑一片，
Tonight it was black.

遥遥望去，一星灯火，只是角门上点着一盏灯笼。
In the distance only a single lantern burned at the side gate.

但最凄凉的却是花园里，
Most desolate of all was the garden.

楼台十二，暗影沉沉，
Its twelve towers and pavilions stood in dark shadow.

只有百狮楼中，灯火通明，却反而显得凄清。因为相形之下，格外容易使人兴起人去楼空的沧桑之感。
Hundred Lions Tower alone was brightly lit, yet its light made the scene seem lonelier, sharpening the sense of a world changed, its people gone and buildings empty.

这时阿云已经迎了上来，
A’yun came to meet them.

一见前有客人，定睛细看了一下，
Noticing the guest, she looked closely.

惊讶地说：“原来是乌先生。”
“Why, it is Mr Wu!”

“乌先生今天住在这里。”胡雪岩说，
“Mr Wu will stay here tonight.

“你去告诉螺蛳太太。
Tell Madam Luosi.”

阿云答应着，返身而去。
She hurried back.

等他们上了百狮楼，螺蛳太太已亲自打开门帘在等，
By the time they reached Hundred Lions Tower, Madam Luosi herself was holding the door curtain aside.

一见乌先生，不知如何，悲从中来，
For some reason, the sight of Wu suddenly overwhelmed her with grief.

眼泪忍不住夺眶而出，
Tears sprang from her eyes.

赶紧背过身去，拭一拭眼泪，再回过身来招呼。
She turned away, wiped them quickly, and turned back to greet him.

“请用茶！”
“Please have some tea.”

螺蛳太太亲自来招待乌先生。
She attended to him herself.

“不敢当，
“You are too kind.

谢谢！”
Thank you.”

乌先生看她神情憔悴，不免关心，
Seeing how worn she looked, Wu was concerned.

“罗四姐，”他说，“你现在责任更加重了，
“Luo Sijie, your responsibilities are greater than ever now.

千万要自己保重。”
You must take care of yourself.”

“唉！”螺蛳太太微喟着，
“Ah!” she sighed.

“真象一场梦。”
“It really is like a dream.”

“嘘！”乌先生双指撮唇，示意她别说这些颓丧的话。
Wu raised two fingers to his lips, warning her away from such dispiriting talk.


“听说你们是走回来的？
“I hear you walked back.

这么大的西北风，脸都冻红了。”螺蛳太太喊道：“阿云，赶快打洗脸水来！”
With that fierce northwesterly wind, your faces are red with cold.” Madam Luosi called, “A’yun, bring hot water for them to wash!”

“脸上倒还不太冷，脚冻僵了。”
“My face is not too cold, but my feet are frozen.”

螺蛳太太回头看了一眼，见胡雪岩与阿云在说话，便即轻声问道：
Glancing back, she saw Hu talking to A’yun and lowered her voice.

“今天的事，你晓得了？”
“Have you heard about today?”

“听说了。”
“Yes.”

“你看这样做，对不对呢？”
“Do you think we did right?”

“对！
“Yes.

提得起，放得下，
If one can take something up, one must be able to put it down.

应该这么做。”
It was the right thing.”

“提得起，放不下，
“He could take it up, but could not put it down.

今天是提不动，不得不放手。”
Today he had to let go because he could no longer carry it.

螺蛳太太说：“乌先生，换了你，服不服这口气？”
Mr Wu, if it were you, could you accept such a defeat?”

“不服又怎么样？”
“What good would refusing to accept it do?”

胡雪岩在另一方面接口。
Hu put in from the other side of the room.

乌先生不作声。
Wu said nothing.

螺蛳太太停了一下才说：“我是不服这口气。
After a pause, Madam Luosi answered, “I will not accept it.

等一下，好好儿商量商量。“她又问道：”乌先生饿不饿？
We must discuss it properly later.” She asked Wu, “Are you hungry?”

““不饿，不饿。
“No, not at all.”

“不饿就先吃酒，再开点心。”
“Then wine first, and refreshments afterwards.”

螺蛳太太回身跟胡雪岩商量：“乌先生就住楼下书房好了？”
Turning to Hu, she asked, “Shall Mr Wu sleep in the downstairs study?”

“好！”
“Yes.

胡雪岩说：“索性请乌先生到书房里去吃酒谈天。”
Let us go down there to drink and talk.”

这表示胡雪岩与乌先生要作长夜之谈。
This meant that their conversation would last well into the night.

螺蛳太太答应着，带了阿云下楼去安排。
Madam Luosi agreed and took A’yun downstairs to make arrangements.

乌先生看在眼里，不免感触，更觉关切，
Watching her, Wu felt more deeply moved and concerned.

心里有个一直盘桓着的疑团，急于打破。
A question that had long troubled him now demanded an answer.


“大先生，”他说：“我现在说句老话：无官一身轻。
“Mr Hu, let me repeat an old saying: without office, a man is free of burdens.

你往后作何打算？”
What are your plans?”

“你的话只说对了一半，
“You are only half right.

‘无官’不错，‘一身轻’则不见得。”
Without office, yes; free of burdens, scarcely.”

“不轻要想法子来轻。”
“Then we must find a way to lighten them.

他问：“左大人莫非就不帮你的忙？”
Will Lord Zuo not help?”

“他现在的力量也有限了。”
“His powers are limited now too.

胡雪岩说：“应春到南京去了。
Yingchun has gone to Nanjing.

等他来了，看是怎么个说法？”
We shall see what he has to say when he returns.”

乌先生沉吟了好一会，终于很吃力地说了出来：“朝廷还会有什么处置？
Wu pondered for a long time before he could bring himself to ask, “What further action will the court take?

会不会查抄？
Will your property be confiscated?”

““只要公款还清，就不会查抄。”
“Not if the public debts are repaid.

胡雪岩又说：“公款有查封的典当作抵，慢慢儿还，
The pawnshops taken into official custody can be set against them and repay them gradually.

我可以不管，
I need not concern myself with those.

就是私人的存款，将来不知道能打几折来还。
It is the private deposits: I do not know what proportion I shall eventually be able to repay.

一想到这一层，我的肩膀上就象有副千斤重担，压得我直不起腰来。
Whenever I think of that, it is like a thousand-jin burden on my shoulders, bending me double.”

““其实，这是你心里不轻，不是身上不轻。
“Then it is your heart that is burdened, rather than your person.

你能不能看开一点呢？”
Can you not take things more lightly?”

“怎么个看开法？”
“How?”

“不去想它，”
“Stop thinking about them.”

胡雪岩笑笑不作声，然后顾左右而言他地说，
Hu smiled without answering and changed the subject.

“乌先生，你不要忘记少棠的事，
“Mr Wu, do not forget Shaotang’s business.

回头同罗四姐好好谈一谈。”
Discuss it properly with Luo Sijie later.”

“唉！”乌先生摇摇头，
Wu shook his head.

“你到这时候，还只想到人家的闲事。”
“Even now, you think only of other people’s private affairs.”

“只有这样子，我才会不想我自己的事。
“Only that lets me stop thinking about my own.

我自己的事管不了，只好管人家的闲事，
I cannot manage my affairs, so I occupy myself with other people’s.

管好人家的闲事，心里有点安慰，
If I manage theirs well, it gives me some comfort.

其实也就是管我自己的事。”
In that sense I am attending to my own affairs too.”

“这就是为善最乐的道理。
“That is the meaning of finding happiness in doing good.

可惜，今年……”
A pity that this year…”


“我懂，我懂！”
“I understand.

胡雪岩接口说道：“我亦正要同你商量这件事。今天去看少棠，去也是走路去的，西北风吹在脸上发痛，
That is exactly what I wanted to discuss.” Hu continued, “I walked to Shaotang’s today, and the northwesterly wind stung my face.

我心里就在想，身上狐皮袍子，头上戴的是貂帽，
I thought: here I am in a fox-fur robe and a sable cap.

脚下棉鞋虽是旧的，不过鞋底上黑少白多，也同薪的一样。
My padded shoes may be old, but their soles show more white than black and are as good as new.

这样子的穿戴还觉得冷，连件棉袄都没有的人，怎么样过冬？
If I am cold dressed like this, how will people without even a padded coat survive the winter?

我去上海之前，老太太还从山上带口信下来，说今年施棉衣、施粥，应该照常。
