Better buy another house to live in than rebuild that one.”

“就是这话罗！”
“That is just what I mean!”

朱家驹急转直下地说：
Jiaju abruptly brought the conversation to his point.

“培利，我成家在先，要我成了家，才能帮你成家。
“I must establish my home first, then I can help you establish yours.

所以我现在就想买房子，或者典一处，
I want to buy a house now, or take one in pledge.

你看怎么样？”
What do you think?”

“这是好事，
“It is a good thing.

我没有不赞成之理。”
Why should I object?”

“好！”
“Good!”

朱家驹非常高兴地说：
Jiaju was delighted.

“这才是患难弟兄。”
“That is what I call a brother through hardship.”

王培利点点头，想了一会说：“你买房子要多少钱？”
Wang nodded, thought a while, and asked how much he needed.

“目前当然只好将就，够两个人住就可以了。
“For now I must make do with somewhere just large enough for two.

培利，我想这样办，我们先提出一笔款子，专门为办‘正经事’之用；另外的钱，分开来各自存在钱庄里，归自己用。
Here is my idea: we set aside a sum solely for our ‘proper business,’ then divide the rest and deposit it separately for our own use.

当然，我不够向你借，你不够向我借，
Of course, if either is short, he can borrow from the other.

还是好商量的。”
That can always be discussed.”


王培利考虑了一下，同意了。
After consideration, Wang agreed.

带来一万银子，还剩下九千五；
Of the ten thousand taels he had brought, ninety-five hundred remained.

提出四千五作为“公款”，开户用两个图章。
They set aside forty-five hundred as their common fund, opening an account that required two seals.

剩下五千，各分两千五，自行处置。
The remaining five thousand was divided equally for their individual use.

这一谈妥当了，彼此都有以逸待劳之感，
With this settled, both felt that they could now wait at ease.

所以当天晚上跟孙四杯酒言欢时，王培利从容还价，
Over wine with Sun Four that evening, Wang bargained calmly.

而孙四是中间人的地位，只很客气地表示，尽力跟房主去交涉，能把房价压得越低越好。
As intermediary, Sun courteously promised to do his utmost with the owner and secure the lowest possible price.

在这样的气氛之下，当然谈得十分投机，尽欢而散。
In such an atmosphere they naturally got on well and parted in high spirits.

等孙四告辞，王培利回了客栈，朱家驹将他与王培利的协议，向干爹干妈，和盘托出。
After Sun left and Wang returned to the inn, Jiaju told his adoptive parents the whole arrangement.

朱宝如有了这个底子，便私下去进行他的事，
Armed with that information, Zhu Baoru privately pursued his own business.

托辞公事派遣到苏州，实际上是到上海走了一趟，打着胡雪岩的招牌，见到了严进士，谈到典房的事。
Claiming an official errand to Suzhou, he actually went to Shanghai and used Hu Xueyan’s name to obtain a meeting with the jinshi and discuss taking his house in pledge.

严进士一口应承，写了一封信，让他回杭州跟他的一个侄子来谈细节。
Yan readily agreed and gave him a letter directing a nephew in Hangzhou to settle the details.

一去一回，花了半个月的工夫。
The round trip took half a month.

朱家驹与王培利买刘家房子的事，亦已谈妥，三千四百两银子，
Meanwhile, the purchase of the Liu house had also been agreed at thirty-four hundred taels.

先付零数，作为定洋，余下三千，在阜康钱庄立个折子，户名叫“朱培记”，
The four hundred was to be paid as earnest money; the remaining three thousand was put in a Fukang passbook account named Zhupei.

现刻一颗图章，由王培利收执，存折交朱家驹保管。
A new seal was cut for Wang to keep, while Jiaju held the passbook.

草约亦已拟好，三个月之内交屋，逾期一天，罚银十两；如果超过一个月，合约取消，另加倍退还定洋。
A draft agreement was ready: possession within three months; a penalty of ten taels for each day of delay; and, if the delay exceeded a month, cancellation of the contract and repayment of twice the earnest money.


“干爹，”朱家驹说：“只等你回来立契约。
“Father,” Jiaju said, “we have only been waiting for you to return before signing the contract.

对方催得很急，
The other side is pressing us.

是不是明天就办了它？”
Shall we do it tomorrow?”

“不忙，不忙！
“No hurry.

契约要好好看，立契也要挑好日子。”
The contract must be examined carefully, and we must choose an auspicious day to sign.”

事实上，是三套连环计耍第二套了。
In fact, it was time for the second of the three linked stratagems.

朱宝如刚刚回来，需要好好布置一番。
Zhu Baoru had only just returned and needed to make his arrangements.

这样拖延了四天，终于在一个宜于立契买产的黄道吉日，订了契约。
After four more days of delay, the contract was finally signed on a day deemed favorable for deeds and property purchases.

王培利亦已决定搬至朱家来往。
Wang Peili had also decided to move into the Zhu home.

哪知就在将要移居的第一天，王培利为团练局的巡防队所捕，
But on the day just before he was to move, a patrol from the militia bureau arrested him.

抓到队上一问，王培利供出朱家驹与朱宝如，
Under questioning at their headquarters, he named Jiaju and Zhu Baoru.

结果这义父子二人亦双双被捕。
The adoptive father and son were consequently arrested as well.



胡雪岩
《烟消云散》第十三章（全章）
Vanishing into Thin Air — Chapter Thirteen (complete)
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


第十三章 烟消云散｜CHAPTER THIRTEEN: VANISHING INTO THIN AIR


胡雪岩谈朱宝如夫妇的故事，话到此处，忽然看着乌先生问道：
At this point in his story of Zhu Baoru and his wife, Hu Xueyan suddenly looked at Mr Wu.

“你晓不晓得，是哪个抓的朱宝如？”
“Do you know who had Zhu Baoru arrested?”

“不是团练局的巡防队吗？”
“Was it not the militia bureau's patrol?”

“不是。
“No.

是他自己。
He did it himself.

这是一条苦肉计，巡防队的人是串出来的。”
It was a scheme to win sympathy by suffering along with them; the patrolmen were his accomplices.

胡雪岩说，“朱宝如一抓进去，问起来在我善后局做事，巡防队是假模假样不相信。”
When he was taken in and said that he worked at my Reconstruction Bureau, they pretended not to believe him.

“朱宝如就写了张条子给我，我当然派人去保他。
He wrote me a note, and naturally I sent someone to stand surety for him.

等他一保出来，戏就有得他唱了。”
Once he was out, he could stage the rest of his performance.”

据胡雪岩说，他释放之前，向朱家驹、王培利，拍胸担保，全力营救。
According to Hu, before his release Zhu had solemnly promised Jiaju and Wang Peili that he would do everything possible to rescue them.

其时这两个人，已由防巡队私设的“公堂”问过两回，还用了刑，
By then they had been questioned twice in the patrol's unauthorized courtroom and tortured.

虽不是上“夹棍”或者“老虎凳”，但一顿“皮巴掌”打下来，满嘴喷血，牙齿打掉了好几颗，当然出言恫吓，不在话下——
They had not suffered the leg press or the tiger bench, but blows from a leather slapping paddle had left their mouths streaming blood and knocked out several teeth, to say nothing of the threats.

朝廷自平洪杨后，虽有“胁从不问”的恩诏，
After suppressing the Taiping rebellion, the court had issued a merciful decree exempting those coerced into joining it.

但太平军的零散败兵，除非投诚有案，倘为私下潜行各处，地方团练，抓到了仍送官处治。
But unless scattered former soldiers had formally surrendered and been registered, local militias could still arrest them as they slipped secretly from place to place and hand them over for punishment.

因此，朱家驹、王培利惊恐万状，一线生机，都寄托在朱宝如身上，
Terrified, the two men placed their only hope of survival in Zhu Baoru.

朝夕盼望，
They waited day and night.

盼到第三夭盼到了。
On the third day he finally came.


朱宝如告诉他们，全力奔走的结果，可以办个递解回籍的处分，不过要花钱。
Zhu told them that, after all his efforts, he could arrange for them to be sent under escort to their native place, but it would cost money.

朱家驹、王培利原有款子在阜康钱庄，存折还在。
They still had their own funds at Fukang and their passbooks.

朱宝如说，这笔存款不必动，他们回到上海仍可支取。
Those deposits need not be touched; they could withdraw them when they reached Shanghai.

至于刘家的房子，出了这件事以后，眼前已经没有用处，
The Liu house, however, was of no immediate use after what had happened.

不如牺牲定洋，设法退掉，存在阜康的三千银子提出来，
Better to forfeit the deposit, cancel the purchase, and withdraw the three thousand taels held at Fukang for it.

在团练局及钱塘、仁和两县，上下打点，大概也差不多了。
That should be about enough to pay everyone who mattered in the militia bureau and the Qiantang and Renhe county offices.

好在宝藏埋在刘家，地图在他们身边，
Fortunately, the treasure remained buried at the Liu house and they still had the map.

等这场风波过去，再回杭州，仍旧可以发财。
Once the trouble had passed, they could return to Hangzhou and make their fortune.

到此境界，朱家驹、王培利只求脱却螺绁，唯言是从。
Desperate only to escape their bonds, they agreed to everything.

但朱宝如做事，显得十分稳重，
Yet Zhu proceeded with great apparent caution.

带着老婆天天来探监送牢饭，谈到释放一节，总说对方狮子大开口，要慢慢儿磨，
He and his wife visited daily with food, saying that those who could release them were making outrageous demands which must be bargained down.

劝他们耐心等待。
They must wait patiently.

这样，过了有十天工夫，才来问他们两人，说谈妥当了，一切使费在内，两千八百两银子，剩下二百两还可以让他们做路费，
About ten days passed before he announced an agreement: all expenses included, twenty-eight hundred taels, leaving two hundred for their journey.

问他们愿意不愿意。
Would they agree?


“你们想，”胡雪岩说：“岂有不愿之理。
“How could they refuse?” Hu said.

存折的图章在王培利身边，交给朱宝如以后，第二天就‘开笼子’放人了。
“Wang Peili handed over the seal for the bank account, and the next day the cage was opened.

不过，两个人还要具一张甘结，回籍以后，安分守已，做个良民，
But both had to sign an undertaking: after returning home, they would live quietly as law-abiding subjects.

如果再潜行各地，经人告发，甘愿凭官法办。”
If they again traveled about in secret and were reported, they agreed to submit to official punishment.”

“好厉害！”乌先生说，
“Ruthless!” Mr Wu said.

“这是绝了他们两个人的后路，
“That cut off their retreat.

永远不敢再到杭州。”
They would never dare return to Hangzhou.

“手段是很厉害，不过良心还不算太黑。”
Still, his conscience was not entirely black.

乌先生又说：“那两个人，叫天天不应，叫地地不灵，
Those two had nobody to appeal to.

如果要他们把存折拿出来，五千银子全数吞没，亦未尝不可。”
He could have demanded their passbooks and swallowed the entire five thousand taels as well.”

“不然！
“No.

朱宝如非要把那张合约收回不可，否则会吃官司。
He had to recover the purchase contract or risk a lawsuit.

为啥呢？因为从头到底都是骗局，
The whole thing was fraudulent.

那家的房主，根本不姓刘，孙四也不是‘瓦摇头’，
The owner was not named Liu, and Sun Four was no property broker.

完全是朱宝如串出来的。
Zhu had arranged it all.

如果这张合约捏在他们两个人手里，可以转给人家，
With that contract, the two men could transfer their rights to someone else.

到了期限，依约付款营业，西洋镜拆穿，
When the time came to pay and take possession, the fraud would be exposed.

朱宝如不但要吃官司，也不能做人了。”
Zhu would face a lawsuit and lose all standing.”

“啊，啊！”
“Ah!”

乌先生深深点头，
Mr Wu nodded deeply.

“这个人很高明。
“Very clever.

不吞他们的五千银子，放一条路让人家走，才不会出事。”
Leaving them their five thousand and a way to live kept him out of trouble.”

“不但不会出事，
“More than that.

那两个人还一直蒙在鼓里，梦想发财。”
They remained completely in the dark, still dreaming of a fortune.”


“对了！”乌先生问：“严进士家的房子呢？”
“And the jinshi's house?” Mr Wu asked.

“我先讲他骗了多少？”
“Let me first tell you how much Zhu got.”

胡雪岩扳着手指计算：
Hu counted on his fingers.

“房价一共三千四百两，
“The price was thirty-four hundred taels.

付定洋四百两是孙四的好处，
Sun Four took the four-hundred-tael deposit as his reward.

整数三千两听说巡防队分了一千，朱宝如实得二千两，
Of the remaining three thousand, I heard the patrol took one thousand and Zhu kept two thousand.

典严家的房子够了。”
That was enough to take Mr Yan's house in pledge.”

“典了房子开粥厂？”
“And open a soup kitchen there?”

“是啊！
“Yes.

朱宝如来同我说，他看中严家房子的风水，想买下来，不过现在力量不足，
He came to tell me he liked the house's feng shui and wanted to buy it, but could not yet afford to.

只好先典下来，租给善后局办粥厂。
He would take it in pledge first, then rent it to the Reconstruction Bureau as a soup kitchen.

他说：”做事情要讲公道，
‘We must be fair,’ he said.

粥厂从第一年十一月办到第二年二月，一共四个月，
‘The kitchen will operate from the eleventh month through the second month of the following year, four months altogether.

租金亦只收四个月，每个月一百两。
I shall charge rent only for those four months, a hundred taels a month.’

‘我去看了房子，告诉他说，’这样子的房子，租金没有这种行情，
I inspected the house and told him, ‘That is above the going rate.

五十两一个月都勉强。
Even fifty a month would be generous.

善后局的公款，我不能乱做人情。
I cannot use public funds to do you favors.

不过，我私人可以帮你的忙。
But I can help you personally.’

“承他的情，一定不肯用我的钱。
To his credit, he refused my money.

不过办粥厂当然也有好处。”
Of course, running the soup kitchen had advantages of its own.”

“那么，掘藏呢？
“And the treasure?

掘到了没有？”
Did he find it?”

“这就不晓得了。
“That I do not know.

这种事，只有他们夫妇亲自动手，不能让外人插手的。
Only he and his wife could have dug for it; they could not let outsiders take part.

不过，朱宝如后来发了财，是真的。“
But he certainly became rich afterward.”


“大先生！”乌先生提出一大疑问：“这些情形，你是怎么知道的呢？”
“Mr Hu, how did you learn all this?” Mr Wu asked.

“有些情形是孙四告诉我的。
“Some of it came from Sun Four.

他只晓得后半段，严家房子的事，他根本不清楚。”
He knew only the latter part, nothing at all about the Yan house.”

谈到这里，胡雪岩忽然提高了声音说：
Hu suddenly raised his voice.

“若要人不知，除非己莫为。
“If you do not want a thing known, do not do it!

过了有四、五年，有一回我在上海，到堂子里去吃花酒，遇见一个江西人，姓王，
Four or five years later I was at a courtesan banquet in Shanghai when I met a man from Jiangxi named Wang.

他说：胡大先生，我老早就晓得你的大名了，
‘I have known your great name for years,’ he said.

我还是你杭州阜康钱庄的客户。”
‘I was even a customer of your Fukang Bank in Hangzhou.’”

“不用说，这个人就是王培利了？”
“Wang Peili, of course?”

“不错。
“Exactly.

当时他跟我谈起朱宝如，又问起万安桥刘家的房子。
He mentioned Zhu Baoru and asked about the Liu house at Wan’an Bridge.

我同他说：朱宝如，我同他沾点亲，万安桥刘家，我就不清楚了。”
I told him Zhu was a distant relative, but I knew nothing of that house.

胡雪岩接着又说：“堂子里要谈正经事，都是约到小房间里，躺在烟铺上，清清静静私下谈，
In such places, serious matters are discussed privately in a small room, lying on the opium couch.

席面上豁拳闹酒，还要唱戏，哪里好谈正事？
With drinking games, noisy toasts, and singing at the banquet, how can anyone discuss business?

所以我说了一句：有空再变。
So I said, ‘We can talk another time.’

原是敷衍的话。
It was merely a polite way of putting him off.

哪晓得……
Who would have thought...”

““他真的来寻你了？”乌先生接口问说。
“He really came to see you?”

“不是来寻我，是请我在花旗总会吃大菜。
“He invited me to a Western meal at the American Club.

帖子上写得很恳切，说有要紧事情请教，又说并无别客。
His note was very earnest: an important matter on which he sought my advice, and no other guests.

你想想，我应酬再忙，也不能不去……”
Busy as I was with engagements, I could hardly refuse.”

胡雪岩说，他准时赴约，
Hu arrived punctually.

果然只有王培利一个人。开门见山他说他做过太平军，曾经与朱宝如一起被捕。
Wang was indeed alone and began directly by saying that he had served in the Taiping army and been arrested with Zhu Baoru.

这下胡雪岩才想起他保释过朱宝如的往事，顿时起了戒心。
Only then did Hu remember having secured Zhu's release, and immediately grew wary.

王培利似乎知道胡雪岩在浙江官场的势力，要求胡雪岩设法，能让他回杭州。
Wang seemed aware of his influence among Zhejiang officials and asked him to find a way for him to return to Hangzhou.

“你答应他没有呢？”乌先生插嘴发问。
“Did you agree?” Mr Wu interrupted.

“没有。
“No.

事情没有弄清楚，我不好做这种冒失的事。”
I could not act so rashly before understanding the matter.

胡雪岩说，“我同他说，你自己具了结的，
I told him, ‘You signed an undertaking yourself.

我帮不上忙，
I cannot help with that.

不过，你杭州有啥事情，我可以替你办。他叹口气说，这件事非要我自己去办不可。
But if you have business in Hangzhou, I can attend to it for you.’ He sighed and said he must do it himself.

接下来就把掘藏的事告诉我。
Then he told me about the treasure.

我一面听，一面在想，朱宝如一向花样很多，他老婆更是个厉害角色……”
As I listened, I thought of Zhu's many tricks and his still more formidable wife...”


说到这里，乌先生突然发觉螺蛳太太神色似乎不大对劲，便打断了胡雪岩的话问，
Mr Wu suddenly noticed that Madam Luosi looked unwell and interrupted.

“罗四姐，你怎么样，
“Sister Luo, what is wrong?

人不舒服？”
Are you ill?”

“不是，不是！”
“No, no!”

螺蛳太太摇着手说：
She waved her hands.

“你们谈你们的。”
“Go on talking.”

她看着胡雪岩问：“后来呢？”
Turning to Hu, she asked, “What happened next?”

“后来，他同我说，如果我能想法子让他回杭州掘了藏，愿意同我平分。
“He offered me half if I could get him back to Hangzhou to dig up the treasure.

这时候我已经想到，朱宝如怎么样发的财，恐怕其中大有文章。
By then I suspected there was a good deal behind Zhu's fortune.

王培利一到杭州，说不定是要去寻朱宝如算帐，
If Wang returned, he might seek a reckoning with Zhu.

可是，这笔帐一定算不出名堂，到后来说不定会出人命。
But he could never obtain satisfaction that way; someone might end up dead.”

““出人命？”
“Dead?”

乌先生想了一下说：
Mr Wu considered.

“你是说，王培利吃了哑巴亏，会跟朱宝如动刀子？”
“You mean that, unable to obtain redress, Wang might take a knife to him?”

“这是可以想得到的事。
“It was easy to imagine.

或者朱宝如先下手为强，先告王培利也说不定。
Or Zhu might strike first and report him to the authorities.

总而言之，如果把他弄到杭州，是害了他，所以我一口拒绝。
In any event, bringing him to Hangzhou would harm him, so I refused outright.

我说我不想发财，
I said, ‘I have no wish to make a fortune this way.

同时也要劝你老兄，事隔多年，犯不上为这种渺茫的事牵肠挂肚，
And I advise you to stop worrying over such an uncertain prospect after all these years.

如果你生活有困难，我可以帮你忙，替你寻个事情做。
If you are in difficulties, I can find you work.’

他说，他现在做洋广杂货生意，境况过得去，谢谢我，不必了。
He thanked me but declined. He was trading in foreign and Cantonese sundries and doing reasonably well.

总算彼此客客气气，不伤感情。
At least we remained courteous, with no hard feelings.”

““这王培利死不死心呢？”
“Did Wang give up?”

“大概死心了。
“Probably.

据说他的洋广杂货生意，做得不错。
I heard his trade was doing well.

一个人只要踏上正途，勤勤恳恳去巴结，自然不会有啥发横财的心思。”
Once a man finds an honest livelihood and works diligently at it, he naturally stops dreaming of windfalls.

胡雪岩说：“你们几时见过生意做得象个样子的人，会去买白鸽票？”
Have you ever seen a man with a respectable business buying White Pigeon lottery tickets?”

“这倒是很实惠的话。”
“A very practical observation.”

乌先生想了一下，好奇地问：“你倒没有把遇见王培利的事，同朱宝如谈一谈？”
After a moment, Mr Wu asked curiously, “Did you never mention meeting Wang to Zhu?”

“没有。”
“No.”

胡雪岩摇摇头，
Hu shook his head.

“我从不挖人的痛疮疤的。”
“I never reopen people's old sores.”


“你不挖人家，人家要挖你。”
“You do not reopen theirs, but they will reopen yours.”

一直默默静听的螺蛳太太开口了，
Madam Luosi, who had listened silently all this time, spoke at last.

“ 如果你同朱宝如谈过就好了。”
“It would have been better if you had mentioned it to Zhu.”

这一说，即使是乌先生都不懂她的意思。
Neither Mr Wu nor Hu understood.

连胡雪岩也用困惑的眼光催促她解释。螺蛳太太却无视于此，只是怨责地说：“我们这么多年，这些情形，你从来都没有跟我谈过。”
Both looked at her for an explanation, but she ignored their questioning eyes and continued reproachfully, “After all these years, you have never told me any of this.”

“你这话埋怨得没有道理，
“That is an unfair complaint.

朱宝如的事跟我毫不相干，
Zhu's affairs had nothing to do with me.

我同你谈它作啥？”
Why should I have told you?

胡雪岩又说：“就是我自己的事，大大小小也不知经历过多少，
Even of my own experiences, great and small, there have been more than I can count.

有些事已经过去了，连我自己都记不得，
Some are so far in the past that I have forgotten them myself.

怎么跟你谈？
How could I tell you?

而况，也没有工夫。
Besides, there was never time.

一个人如果光是谈过去，我看，这个人在世上的光阴，也就有限了。”
A man who does nothing but talk about the past, I think, has little time left in this world.”

“着！”
“Exactly!”

乌先生击案称赏：
Mr Wu struck the table approvingly.

“这句话，我要听。
“That is what I like to hear.

我现在要劝胡大先生的，就是雄心壮志，不可消沉。
What I want to tell you now is not to let your ambition die.

你的精力还蛮旺的，
You still have plenty of energy.

东山再起，为时未晚。”
It is not too late to make a fresh start.”

胡雪岩笑笑不作声。
Hu smiled without answering.

就这时听得寺院中晨钟已动，
Just then the temple's morning bell sounded.

看自鸣钟上，短针指着四时，已是寅正时分了。
The clock's short hand pointed to four: the midpoint of the yin watch.

“再不睡要天亮了！”胡雪岩说，
“It will be daylight if we do not go to bed,” Hu said.

“明天再谈吧。”
“We can talk tomorrow.”

于是等丫头们收拾干净，胡雪岩与螺蛳太太向乌先生道声“明朝会”，相偕上楼。
When the maids had tidied the room, he and Madam Luosi said, “See you tomorrow,” to Mr Wu and went upstairs together.


到了楼上，螺蛳太太还有好些话要跟胡雪岩谈，
Upstairs, Madam Luosi still had much to discuss.

顶要紧的一件是，十二楼中各房姨太太的私房，经过一整天的检查，
Most important was the result of a full day's search through the concubines' private possessions in the Twelve Chambers.

收获极丰，现款、金条、珠宝等等，估计不下二三十万银子之多。
The yield was considerable: cash, gold bars, jewels, and other valuables estimated at no less than two or three hundred thousand taels.

她问胡雪岩，这笔款子，作何处置？
What did Hu want done with it?

“我没有意见。”
“I have no opinion.

胡雪岩说：“现在已经轮不到我作主了。”
It is no longer for me to decide.”

这句话听起来象牢骚，不过螺蛳太太明了他的本意，
It sounded like a complaint, but she understood his real meaning.

“你也不要这样说，
“Do not say that.

现在你还可以作主。”
You can still decide now.

她说：“过两三天，就难说了。”
In two or three days, it may be another matter.”

“你说我现在还可以作主，那么，请你替我作个主看。”
“If I still can, make the decision for me.”

“要我作主，我现在就要动手。”
“Then I would act immediately.”

“怎么动法？”
“How?”

“趁天不亮，请乌先生把这些东西带出去。”
“Have Mr Wu take everything away before daylight.”

螺蛳太太指着一口大箱子说：
She pointed to a large chest.

“喏，东西都装在里面。”
“It is all in there.”

“喔！”
“Oh!”

胡雪岩有些茫然，定定神说：
Hu looked bewildered, then collected himself.

“你刚才怎么不提起？”
“Why did you not mention it just now?”

“现在也还不迟。”
“It is not too late.”

胡雪岩重新考虑下来，认为不妥，
Considering the matter again, Hu felt it would be wrong.

此举有欠光明磊落，于心不安，
Such concealment lacked the openness and integrity he valued; his conscience would not allow it.

因而很歉疚地表示不能同意。
Apologetically, he refused.

“罗四姐，”他说，“我手里经过一百个二三十万都不止，
“Sister Luo, more than a hundred times two or three hundred thousand taels has passed through my hands.

如果要想留下一点来，早就应该筹划了，而且也决不止二三十万。
If I wanted to keep something back, I should have planned it long ago, and it would have been far more than this.

算了，算了，
Let it go.

不要做这种事。
We must not do such a thing.”

螺蛳太太大失所望，
She was deeply disappointed.

同时听出胡雪岩根本反对将财物寄顿他处，这就使得她担心的一件事，亦无法跟他谈了。
His fundamental objection to leaving valuables elsewhere for safekeeping also made it impossible for her to tell him of another matter that troubled her.


“我真的困了。”胡雪岩说：
“I really am sleepy,” Hu said.

“明天起码睡到中午。”
“Tomorrow I must sleep until noon at least.”

“你尽管睡。
“Sleep as long as you like.

没有人吵醒你。”
Nobody will disturb you.”

螺蛳太太等他吃了炖在“五更鸡”上的燕窝粥，服侍他上床，放下帐子，移灯他处，
Madam Luosi waited while he ate the bird's-nest porridge kept warm on the little “fifth-watch cock” stove, helped him into bed, lowered the curtains, and moved the lamp elsewhere.

胡雪岩奇怪地问：“你怎么不睡？”
“Why are you not coming to bed?” he asked in surprise.

“我还有两笔帐要记。
“I still have a couple of accounts to enter.

你先睡。”
You sleep first.”

“我眼睛都睁不开了！
“I can barely keep my eyes open.

随你，不管你了。”
Do as you please; I shall leave you to it.”

果然，片刻之后，帐子里鼾声渐起，
Soon snores came from behind the curtains.

螺蛳太太虽也疲乏不堪，可是心里有事，就是不想上床。
Exhausted though she was, Madam Luosi had too much on her mind to go to bed.

当然也不是记什么帐，
Nor was she entering accounts.

靠在火盆旁边红丝绒安乐椅上，迷迷糊糊中突然惊醒，只觉一身冷汗。
She leaned back in a red-velvet armchair beside the brazier, drifted into a doze, and suddenly woke with a start, drenched in cold sweat.

到得清晨，只听房门微响，
At dawn the door sounded softly.

她睁开酸涩的眼睛，看是阿云蹑着脚走进来。
Opening her tired, stinging eyes, she saw A’yun tiptoeing in.

“怎么？”阿云诧异地问，“不上床去睡？”
“Why have you not gone to bed?” the maid asked in surprise.

“啥辰光了？”螺蛳太太问。
“What time is it?”

“七点还不到。”
“Not quite seven.”

“乌先生起来了没有？”
“Is Mr Wu up?”

“还没有。”
“Not yet.”

“你留心，
“Watch for him.

等乌先生起来，伺候他吃了早饭，你请他等一等，上来叫我。”
When he gets up, see that he has breakfast, ask him to wait, and come and call me.”

“晓得了。”
“Yes, Madam.”

阿云取床毛毯为她盖上，随即下楼而去。
A’yun covered her with a blanket and went downstairs.


一半是累了，一半是想到乌先生，浮起了解消心事的希望，螺蛳太太居然蜷缩在安乐椅上，好好睡了一觉，
Partly from exhaustion, partly because thinking of Mr Wu had given her hope of relief, Madam Luosi finally slept well, curled in the armchair.

直到十点钟方由阿云来将她唤醒。
It was ten before A’yun woke her.

“乌先生起来一个钟头了。”
“Mr Wu has been up for an hour.

阿云告诉她说：“他说尽管请你多睡一会，他可以等。
He said to let you sleep longer; he could wait.

我想想，让他多等也不好意思。”
But I thought it would be rude to keep him much longer.”

“不错。”
“Quite right.”

螺蛳太太转过身来让阿云看她的发髻“我的头毛不毛？”
She turned so that A’yun could inspect her hair. “Is it untidy?”

“还好。”
“Not very.”

“那就不必重新梳头了，
“Then there is no need to dress it again.

你打盆脸水来，我洗了脸就下去。”
Bring water for my face, and I shall go down.”

话虽如此，略事修饰，也还花了半个钟头，
Even these few preparations took another half-hour.

到得楼下，先问乌先生睡得如何，又问阿云，早饭吃的什么？
Downstairs, she asked Mr Wu how he had slept and A’yun what he had eaten for breakfast.

寒暄了一会，使个眼色，让阿云退了出去，方始移一移椅子，向乌先生倾诉心事。
After some civilities, she dismissed the maid with a glance, moved her chair closer, and confided her trouble.

“朱宝如同我们大先生是”一表三千里，的表叔，
“Zhu Baoru is a very distant cousin of one of Mr Hu's parents.

他太太，我记得你见过的？
I think you have met his wife?”

““见过，也听说过，
“I have met her and heard of her.

生得慈眉善目，
Such a kindly face.

大家都说她精明能干，做事情同场面上的男人一样，很上路。”
Everyone says she is shrewd and capable, as experienced in handling matters as a man of affairs.

乌先生紧接着说：“昨天晚上听大先生谈起，才晓得她是好厉害的一个角色。”
Only from last night's story did I learn how formidable she really is.”

“我昨天听他一谈，心里七上八下。”
“That story left me terribly uneasy.”

螺蛳太太迟疑了好一会，放低了声间说：
Madam Luosi hesitated for some time, then lowered her voice.

“乌先生，我有件事，只同你商量。
“There is something I can discuss only with you.

我不晓得朱太太会不会起黑心，吞没我的东西？”
I wonder whether Mrs Zhu might have the wickedness to swallow up something of mine.”

乌先生问，“你寄放在她那里的是啥东西？”
“What have you left with her?”

“是一个枕头。”
“A pillow.”


当然，枕头里面有花样，
Naturally, there was more to the pillow than appeared.

第一样是各色宝石，不下四五十枚，
First, it contained at least forty or fifty precious stones of various colors.

原来胡雪岩是有一回在京里听人谈起，乾隆年间的权相和珅，一早起来，取一盘五色宝石要看好些辰光，名为“养眼”。
Hu had once heard in Beijing that Heshen, the powerful minister of the Qianlong era, would spend a long time every morning looking at a tray of multicolored gemstones, calling it “nourishing the eyes.”

回家以后，如法炮制，
On returning home, Hu had copied him.

这一盘宝石，起码要值十万银子。
That tray alone was worth at least a hundred thousand taels.

第二样是螺蛳太太顶名贵的两样首饰，一双钻镯、一个胸饰，中间一枚三十多克拉重的火油钻镯，周围所镶十二粒小钻，每粒最少亦有两克拉，
Next came Madam Luosi's two most valuable pieces of jewelry: a pair of diamond bracelets and a breast ornament with a central “oil diamond” weighing more than thirty carats, surrounded by twelve smaller diamonds of at least two carats each.

是法国宫廷中流出来的珍品，胡雪岩买它时，就花了二十五万银子。
A treasure that had come out of the French court, it had cost Hu two hundred and fifty thousand taels.

第三样的价值便无法估计了，是十枚“东珠”，此珠产于黑龙江与松花江合流的混同江中，
The third item's value could not be reckoned: ten Eastern Pearls, produced in the Huntong River where the Heilong and Songhua rivers met.

大如桂圆，匀圆莹白，向来只供御用，
Large as longans, evenly round and lustrous white, they had always been reserved for imperial use.

采珠的珠户，亦由吉林将军严密管制，
The pearl-gathering households were strictly controlled by the General of Jilin.

民间从无买卖，所以并无行情。
Since the pearls were never traded privately, there was no market price.

这十枚“东珠”据说是火烧圆明园时，为英国兵所盗取，辗转落入一个德国银行家手中。
These ten were said to have been stolen by British soldiers during the burning of the Old Summer Palace and passed eventually into the hands of a German banker.

由于胡雪岩为“西征”借外债，这个银行家想作成这笔生意，特意以此为酬，
When Hu sought foreign loans for the western campaign, the banker offered them as a reward for arranging the business.

以后胡雪岩就没有再收他的佣金。
Hu subsequently took no further commission from him.

乌先生体会到此事如果发生纠纷，对螺蛳太太的打击是如何沉重。
Mr Wu understood how devastating a dispute over these things would be for Madam Luosi.

因此，他认为首先要做的一件事，便是慰抚。
His first task, he thought, was to comfort her.


“罗四姐，世事变化莫测，
“The world is unpredictable, Sister Luo.

万一不如意，你要看得开。”
If things go badly, you must try to bear it.

他紧接着：“这不是说，这件事已经出毛病了，
I do not mean that anything has gone wrong already.

不过做要往最好的地方去做，想要往最坏的地方去想。
But while working for the best, we must prepare our minds for the worst.

你懂不懂我的意思？”
Do you understand?”

螺蛳太太心里很乱，“乌先生，”她答非所问地说：
In her confusion, she answered beside the point.

“我现在只有你一个人可以商量。”
“You are the only person I can discuss this with.”

“那么，我现在有几句话要问你，
“Then let me ask a few questions.

第一，这件事是你自己托朱太太的，还是她劝你这么做的？”
First, did you ask Mrs Zhu to keep it, or did she persuade you?”

“是我自己托她的。
“I asked her.

不过，她同我说过，不怕一万，只怕万一，
But she had told me that even a remote possibility must be guarded against.

意思是我自己要有个打算。”
She meant I ought to make some provision for myself.”

“嗯嗯！”
“I see.

乌先生又问：“你把东西交给她的时候，有没有人看见？”
Did anyone see you hand it over?”

“这种事怎么好让人看见？”
“How could I let anyone see such a thing?”

“坏就坏在这里！”乌先生在心里想。
That was precisely the trouble, Mr Wu thought.

“你交给她的时候，”他问：“有什么话交代？”
“What instructions did you give?”

“我说：枕头里面有点东西，寄放在你这里，我随时会来拿。”
“I said there were a few things inside the pillow, that I would leave it with her, and that I might come for it at any time.”

“她怎么说呢？”
“And she?”

“她说：我也不管枕头里是什么东西，
“She said, ‘I shall not concern myself with what is inside.

你交给我，我不能不替你存好，
Since you have entrusted it to me, I must keep it safely.

随便你什么时候来拿。
Come for it whenever you please.

不过，我收条是不打的。”
But I shall give no receipt.’”

“当然，
“Naturally.

这种事，哪有打收条之理？”乌先生说：
How could there be a receipt for such a thing?

“现在瞎猜也没有用，
Guessing is useless now.

你不放心，把它去拿回来就是。”
If you are worried, simply fetch it back.”

“我……”
“I...”

螺蛳太太很吃力地说：
She struggled to speak.

“我怕她不肯给我。”
“I am afraid she may refuse.”

“你说她会不认帐？”
“You think she might deny having it?”

“万一这样子，我怎么办？”说着，螺蛳太太叹了口气，
“What could I do if she did?” She sighed.

“我真怕会见她。”
“I really dread seeing her.”

不是怕见朱太太，是怕朱太太不认帐，她当时就会承受不住。
It was not Mrs Zhu herself she feared, but a denial she might be unable to bear.

既然如此，乌先生自觉义不容辞了。
Mr Wu felt he could not refuse to help.


“我陪你去，或者，我代你去，看她怎么说？”
“I could go with you, or go on your behalf and see what she says.”

“对，
“Yes.

你代我去，
Go for me.

看她怎么说。”螺蛳太太说：“你带两样东西给她，她就晓得你是我请去的，会跟你说实话。”螺蛳太太随即唤了阿云来，命她去开药箱，取来两个锦盒，
Take two things, and she will know I sent you and speak frankly.” Madam Luosi called A’yun and told her to open the medicine chest and bring two brocade boxes.

一个内贮一支吉林老山人参，
One contained an old mountain-grown Jilin ginseng root.

是当年山西遇到百年未有的大旱，胡老太太特捐巨款助赈，
During the drought in Shanxi, the worst in a hundred years, Old Madam Hu had given a vast sum for relief.

山西巡抚曾国荃专折请奖，蒙慈禧太后颁赐一方“乐善好施”的御笔匾额，及四两人参，
Governor Zeng Guoquan had submitted a special memorial asking that she be rewarded, and Empress Dowager Cixi had bestowed a plaque inscribed “Delighting in Good Works and Generous in Giving,” together with four liang of ginseng.

由于出自天家，格外珍贵，
Coming from the imperial household, it was particularly precious.

这是螺蛳太太为了结好，自动送朱太太的。
Madam Luosi had offered this root to cultivate Mrs Zhu's friendship.

另外一个锦盒中，只残存了两粒蜡丸，
The other box held only two wax-sealed pills.

这是朱太太特为跟她索取的。
Mrs Zhu had repeatedly asked for them.

“我们家大少奶奶、二小姐，各用了一个，
“Our eldest daughter-in-law and our second daughter each used one.

还剩下两个舍不得送人。
Only two were left, and I could not bear to give them away.

朱太太跟我要了几回，
Mrs Zhu asked several times.

我说不知道放在哪里了，等找出来送她。
I said I could not remember where I had put them and would send them when I found them.

如今也说不得了，
Now I have no choice.

舍不得也要舍得。”
Reluctant or not, I must part with them.

螺蛳太太又说：“但愿她想到，要为子孙修修福，阴功积德，才不会绝后。”
I only hope she remembers to earn blessings for her descendants, accumulating hidden merit so that her line does not die out.”

原来还有这样深意在内，螺蛳太太真可说是用心良苦。
There was a deeper purpose here as well; Madam Luosi had indeed taken great pains.

乌先生点点头说：
Mr Wu nodded.

“我拿这两样东西去给她，等于是信物，
“These gifts will serve as credentials.

她会相信，我可以做你的‘全权代表’。
She will believe that I have full authority to represent you.

好，
Very well.

我今天就会。”
I shall see her today.”


“乌先生，我还有件事跟你商量。”
“There is something else.”

螺蛳太太要商量的，便是从各房姨太太住处查寻到的私房，
She described the concubines' private valuables.

本来装一只大箱子，想托乌先生寄顿，胡雪岩虽不赞成，螺蛳太太心却未死，想检出最值钱的一部分，打成一个不惹人注目的小包裹，交付给乌先生，
Though Hu had rejected her plan to send the large chest away, she still hoped to select the most valuable objects, make up an inconspicuous little bundle, and entrust it to Mr Wu.

问他意下如何？
What did he think?

“既然大先生不赞成，我不能做。”乌先生又说：
“If Mr Hu objects, I cannot do it.

“不但我自己不做，罗四姐，我劝你也不要做。
Nor should you.

我说句不客气的话，今天朱太太那面的事，就是你没有先跟大先生商量，自己惹出来的烦恼。
To speak plainly, this trouble with Mrs Zhu arose because you acted without consulting him.

如果你再这样私下自作主张，将来不但我同大先生没有朋友做，连你，他都会起误会。”
If you continue making secret arrangements, you may ruin my friendship with him and make him misunderstand you as well.”

螺蛳太太接受了他的劝告，
She accepted his advice.

但这一来便只有将全部希望寄托在乌先生身上了，
Now all her hopes rested on him.

谆谆叮嘱，务必好好花点心思，将寄放在朱太太处的那个“宝枕”能收了回来。
Repeatedly she begged him to give careful thought to recovering the precious pillow.


乌先生不敢怠慢，
Mr Wu did not take the commission lightly.

回家好好休息了一夜，
He went home and rested well for a night.

第二天起身破例不上茶馆，
The following morning, unusually, he did not visit a teahouse.

在家吃了早餐，泡上一壶上好龙井，一面品茗，一面细想螺蛳太太所托之事，假设了好几种情况，也想好了不同的对策。
After breakfast at home, he brewed a pot of excellent Longjing and considered Madam Luosi's business as he drank, imagining several possible situations and preparing a response to each.

到得九点多钟，带一个跟班，坐轿直到朱家。
A little after nine he took a servant and went by sedan chair to the Zhu house.

跟班上前投帖，朱家的门房挡驾，
The servant presented his card, but the gatekeeper refused admission.

“老爷出去了。”
“The master is out.

他说：“等我们老爷回来，我请我们老爷去回拜。”
When he returns, I shall ask him to call on you.”

其时，乌先生已经下了轿，
Mr Wu had already stepped from his chair.

他已估计到朱宝如可能不在家，所以不慌不忙地说：“我是胡家托我来的。
He had anticipated Zhu's absence and answered calmly, “The Hu household sent me.

你家老爷不在，不要紧，
If your master is out, it does not matter.

我看你家太太。
I wish to see your mistress.

有两样胡家螺蛳太太托我送来的东西，
Madam Luosi has asked me to bring two things.

连我的名帖一起送进去，你家太太就知道了。”
Take them in with my card, and she will understand.”

门房原知主母不是寻常不善应付男客的妇道人家，听得此一说，料知定会延见，
Knowing that his mistress was no ordinary woman at a loss when receiving male callers, the gatekeeper felt certain she would see him.

当时想了一下，哈着腰说：
After a moment he bowed.

“本来要请乌老爷到花厅里坐，只为天气太冷，花厅没有生炉子，
“I should normally invite you into the reception hall, but it is cold and there is no fire there.

乌老爷不嫌委屈，请到门房里来坐一坐，
If you do not mind, please wait in the gatehouse.

比外面暖和。”
It is warmer than outside.”

“好，好，多谢，多谢。”
“Thank you.”

坐得不久，门房回出来说：
Soon the man returned.

“我家太太说，乌老爷不是外人，又是螺蛳太太请来的，
“My mistress says you are no stranger, and Madam Luosi has sent you.

请上房里坐。“
Please come to the inner rooms.”


上房在三厅上，
These were in the third hall.

进了角门，堂屋的屏门已经开了在等，
Beyond the side entrance, the screen doors stood open to receive him.

进门便是极大的一个雪白铜炭盆，火焰熊熊，一室生春。
A huge, gleaming white-copper charcoal brazier filled the room with warmth.

门房将乌先生交给一个十七八岁的丫头，关上屏门，管自己走了。
The gatekeeper handed him over to a maid of seventeen or eighteen and left, closing the doors.

“阿春！”朱太太在东面那间屋子里，大声说道：
“A’chun!” Mrs Zhu called from the east room.

“你问一问乌老爷，吃了点心没有，
“Ask Master Wu whether he has eaten.

如果没有，马上关照厨房预备。”
If not, tell the kitchen to prepare something at once.”

“吃过，吃过。”
“I have eaten.

乌先生对阿春说：“谢谢你们太太，不必费心。”
Thank your mistress; she need not trouble.”

他的话刚完，门帘掀处，朱太太出现了，
As he finished, the curtain lifted and Mrs Zhu appeared.

穿一件灰鼠皮袄，
She wore a gray-squirrel-fur coat.

花白头发，梳得一丝不乱，小小一个发髻上，一面插一支碧玉挖耳，一面佩一朵红花，
Her graying hair was impeccably arranged in a small knot, with a green-jade ear scoop on one side and a red flower on the other.

脸上还薄薄地搽一层粉，双眼明亮，身材苗条，是个“老来俏”。
Lightly powdered, bright-eyed, and slender, she was still a beauty in her later years.


“乌老爷，老久不见了，
“Master Wu, it has been a long time.

乌太太好？”
Is your wife well?”

她一面说，一面挽手为礼。
She greeted him with clasped hands.

“托福，托福！”
“Very well, thank you.”

乌先生作揖还礼，
He returned her greeting with a bow.

“宝如兄不在家？”
“Brother Baoru is out?”

“天不亮，去料理施粥去了。”
“He went before daylight to attend to the soup kitchens.”

朱宝如多少年来都是善堂的董事，公家有何赈济贫民的惠政，都有他一份。
For years Zhu had been a director of charitable institutions; whenever the authorities organized relief for the poor, he had a part in it.

“可佩，可佩！”
“Admirable!

乌先生说：“积善之家，必有余庆。”
A family that accumulates good deeds will surely leave blessings to its descendants.”

“这也难说。”
“That is hard to say.”

朱太太停了一下，未毕其词，先尽礼节，
Before continuing, she remembered her duties as hostess.

“请坐，请坐！”
“Please sit.”

接着又在茶几上望了一下，已有一碗盖碗茶在，便不作声了。
A glance at the side table showed her that a covered cup of tea was already there.

“朱太太，我今天是螺蛳太太托我来的。
“Madam Luosi has sent me,” Mr Wu began.

昨天我去，她正好把你要的药找到了，顺便托我送来。
“When I visited yesterday, she had just found the medicine you wanted and asked me to bring it.

另外有一支人参，就算送年礼了。”
The ginseng is a New Year gift.”

“正是！”
“Indeed!”

朱太太不胜歉然的，
Mrs Zhu looked deeply apologetic.

“胡大先生出了这种事，她还要为我的这点小事情操心，又送这么一支贵重的人参，
“With such a calamity upon Mr Hu, she still worries over this little matter of mine, and sends so valuable a root as well.

我受是受了，心里实在说不出的，
I have accepted it, but I cannot tell you how I feel.

怎么说呢，
How shall I put it?

只好说，实在是说不出的难过。”
I can only say I am deeply distressed.”

“彼此至交，总有补情的时候。
“Close friends always have another opportunity to repay a kindness.

喔，还有件事，
There is one other thing.

螺蛳太太说有一个枕头寄放在你这里。”
Madam Luosi says she left a pillow with you.”

说到这里，乌先生很用心地注视她的反应，
He watched her closely.

直到她点了头，他一颗心才放了下去。
Only when she nodded did his heart settle.

“有的。”
“Yes.

她问：“怎么样？”
What about it?”

“螺蛳太太说：这个枕头，她想拿回去。”
“She would like it back.”

“好极！”朱太太很快地答了这两个字，
“Excellent!” Mrs Zhu answered at once.

然后又说：“乌老爷，说实话，当初她带了一个枕头来，说要寄放在我这里。她没有多说，我也没有多问，
“To tell you the truth, when she brought it, she said little, and I asked no questions.

明晓得是犯法的，我也只好替她挺。
I knew it was against the law, but I had to stand by her.

挺是挺了，心里是一直七上八下，担心会出事。
All the same, I have been anxious ever since.

现在要拿回去，在我实在是求之不得。
Nothing could suit me better than returning it.

乌老爷，你请稍为坐一坐，
Wait a moment.

我马上拿出来，请你带回去。”
I shall fetch it for you to take.”

说着，起身便走。
She rose and went inside.


这一番话，大出乌先生的意料，
This went far beyond Mr Wu's expectations.

在他设想的情况中，最好的一种是：朱太太承认有此物，说要收回，毫无异议，但不是她亲自送去，便是请螺蛳太太来，当面交还。
The best outcome he had imagined was that Mrs Zhu would acknowledge the pillow and agree to return it, either delivering it personally or asking Madam Luosi to collect it in person.

不过她竟是托他带了回去。
Instead, she meant to entrust it to him.

要不要带呢？
Should he take it?

他很快地作了一个决定：不带。
He decided at once that he should not.

因为中间转了一手，倘或有何差错，无端卷入是非，太不划算了。
If anything proved wrong after it had passed through another pair of hands, he would be drawn needlessly into a dispute.

因此，他急忙向刚掀帘入内的朱太太说道：“朱太太，你不必拿出来，
“Please do not fetch it,” he called as she lifted the curtain.

我请螺蛳太太自己来领回。”
“I shall ask Madam Luosi to collect it herself.”

于是朱太太走了回来，
Mrs Zhu came back.

等乌先生将刚才的话，复又说了一遍，她平静地答说：“也好！
After he repeated his words, she answered calmly, “Very well.

那就请乌老爷告诉螺蛳太太，请她来拿。
Tell her to come for it.

不晓得啥时候来？”
When will that be?”

“那要问她。”
“I must ask her.”

朱太太想了一下说：
She considered.

“这样，她如果有空，今天下午就来，在我这里便饭。
“If she is free, let her come this afternoon and have a simple meal here.

胡大先生的事，大家都关心，
We are all concerned about Mr Hu.

想打听打听，又怕这种时候去打搅，变成不识相，
I have wanted to inquire, but feared that disturbing them now would be tactless.

既然她要来，我同她谈谈心，
Since she must come, we can have a heart-to-heart talk.

说不定心里的苦楚吐了出来，也舒服些。
Perhaps speaking of her troubles will ease them a little.”

“情意如此深厚，言语如此恳挚，乌先生实在无法想象她会是如胡雪岩所形容的，那种阴险的妇人。
Such affection and sincerity made it difficult for Mr Wu to imagine her as the sinister woman Hu had described.

然而，胡雪岩的知人之明是有名的，
Yet Hu was famous for his understanding of people.

莫非竟会看走了眼？
Could he really have misjudged her?


这个内心的困扰，一时没工夫去细想，
For the moment, Mr Wu had no time to pursue the puzzle.

他所想到的，只是赶紧要将这个好消息去告诉螺蛳太太，
His only thought was to take the good news to Madam Luosi at once.

因而起身说道：
He rose.

“朱太太，我不打搅了。”
“I shall not trouble you any longer.”

“何不吃了便饭去？
“Why not stay for a simple meal?

宝如也快回来了，你们可以多谈谈。”
Baoru will soon be back, and you can talk.”

“改天！改天。”
“Another day.”

“那么，”
“Then...”

朱太太沉吟了一会说：
She hesitated.

“螺蛳太太送我这么贵重的东西，照规矩是一定要‘回盘’的。
“Madam Luosi has sent such valuable gifts that custom requires me to send something in return.

不过，一则不敢麻烦乌老爷，再则，我同螺蛳太太下半天就要见面的，当面同她道谢。
But I would rather not trouble you to carry it, and I shall see her this afternoon and thank her myself.

请乌老爷先把我的意思说到。”
Please explain that to her.”

馈赠仪物，即时还礼，交送礼的人带回，称为“回盘”。
An immediate return gift carried back by the person who delivered the original was called “returning the tray.”

朱太太礼数周到，越使乌先生觉得胡雪岩的话，与他的印象不符。
Her punctilious courtesy further convinced Mr Wu that Hu's account did not match his own impression.

坐在轿子里一直在想这件事，最后获得一个折衷的结论，
He pondered it throughout the ride and finally reached a compromise.

胡雪岩看人不会错，自己的印象也信得过，
Hu's judgment could not be wrong, nor could his own experience be dismissed.

“仓廪实而知礼节”，这朱太太从前是那种人，现在发了财要修修来世，已经回心向善了。
With full granaries came knowledge of propriety: Mrs Zhu had once been that sort of woman, but now that she was wealthy and wished to earn blessings for the next life, she had turned toward goodness.

他不但心里这样在想，而且也把他的想法告诉了螺蛳太太。
He not only thought this but told Madam Luosi.

她当然很高兴，
Naturally she was delighted.

使得胡雪岩很奇怪，因为她那种喜形于色的样子，在他已感觉到很陌生了。
Hu was puzzled: her openly joyful expression had become almost unfamiliar to him.

“有啥开心的事情？”
“What has made you so happy?”

螺蛳太太觉得事到如今，不必再瞒他了，
She felt there was no need for further concealment.

“我同你老实说了吧！
“I shall tell you frankly.

我有一个枕头寄放在朱太太那里。现在可以拿回来了……”她将整个经过情形，细说了一遍。
I left a pillow with Mrs Zhu, and now I can have it back.” She explained everything.

胡雪岩不作声，只说了一句：“好嘛，
Hu offered no comment beyond, “Very well.

你去拿了回来再说。”
Go and fetch it, and we shall see.”

“对，
“Yes.

拿了回来，我们再商量。”她想了一下说：
Once I have it, we can discuss what to do.

“或者拿到手不拿回家，就寄放在乌先生那里，
Or perhaps I should leave it with Mr Wu instead of bringing it home.

你赞成不赞成。”
Would you agree?”

“赞成。”胡雪岩一口答应。
“Yes,” Hu answered readily.

他对这个枕头是否能顺利收回，将信将疑，
He was uncertain whether she would recover it without difficulty.

倘或如愿以偿，当然以寄存在乌先生处为宜。
If she did, leaving it with Mr Wu would naturally be best.


带着阿云到了朱家，螺蛳太太在大厅檐前下轿。
Accompanied by A’yun, Madam Luosi reached the Zhu house and alighted beneath the eaves of the main hall.

朱太太已迎在轿前，
Mrs Zhu was waiting beside the chair.

执手问讯，她凝视了好一会：
Taking her hands, she looked at her for some time.

“你瘦了点！”
“You have grown thinner!”

接着自语似地说：“怎么不要瘦？
Then, almost to herself, “How could you not?

好比天塌下来一样，
It is as though the sky had fallen.

大先生顶一半，你顶一半。
Mr Hu bears half the weight, and you the other half.”

“就这句话，螺蛳太太觉得心头一暖，对朱太太也更有信心了。
That one remark warmed Madam Luosi's heart and increased her confidence.

到得上房里，盖碗茶，高脚果盘，摆满一桌，
In the inner rooms a table was covered with tea cups and tall fruit stands.

朱太太又叫人陪阿云，招呼得非常周到。
Mrs Zhu even arranged company for A’yun, attending to every detail.

乱过一阵，才能静静谈话。
Only after the bustle subsided could they talk quietly.

“天天想去看你，总是想到你事情多，心乱。”
“Every day I have wanted to visit you, but I kept thinking how busy and upset you must be.

朱太太又说：“你又能干好客，礼数上一点不肯错的，
You are such a capable hostess and never neglect a courtesy.

我去了，只有替你添麻烦，
My visit would only add to your troubles.

所以一直没有去，你不要怪我。”
Do not blame me for staying away.”

“哪里的话！
“How could I?

这是你体恤我，
You were being considerate.

我感激都来不及。”
I am grateful.”

“我是怕旁人会说闲话，
“I fear what others may say.

平时那样子厚的交情，现在倒象素不往来似的。”
We were such close friends, and now it looks as though we never knew one another.”

“你何必去管旁人，
“Why mind other people?

我们交情厚，自己晓得。”螺蛳太太又加一句：“交情不厚，我也不会把那个枕头寄放在这里了。”
We know our friendship.” Madam Luosi added, “If we were not close, I should never have entrusted the pillow to you.”

“是啊！”
“Indeed.

朱太太紧接着她的话说：“你当初把那个枕头寄放在我这里，我心里就在想，总有点东西在里头。
When you brought it, I thought there must be something inside.

不过你不说，我也不便问。
But you did not say, and I could hardly ask.

今天早晨，乌老爷来说，你要拿了回去，再好没有，
When Master Wu told me this morning that you wanted it back, I could not have been more pleased.

我也少背多少风险。
It will relieve me of so much risk.

喔，”她似乎突然想起，“你送我这么贵重的一支参，
Oh, and that precious ginseng root!

实在不敢当。
I scarcely feel I can accept it.

螺蛳太太，我说实话，大先生没有出事的时候，不要说一支，送我十支，我也老脸皮收得下，
Before Mr Hu's troubles, I would have had the effrontery to accept ten, let alone one.

如今大不同了，我……”
But now...”

“你不要说了。”
“Say no more.

螺蛳太太打断她的话，“我明白你的意思。
I understand.

不过，我也要老实说：俗话说的是，‘穷虽穷，家里还有三担铜’，
But let me be equally frank: as the saying goes, however poor, we still have three loads of copper at home.

送你一支参当年礼，你不必客气。”
You need not hesitate over a root of ginseng for New Year.”

“既然你这样说，我就安心了。
“Then my mind is easier.

不过我‘回盘’没有啥好东西。”
Only I have nothing fine to give in return.”

“你不要客气！”
“Do not stand on ceremony.”

螺蛳太太心里在想，拿那个枕头“回盘”，就再好都没有了。
Privately, Madam Luosi thought that no return gift could be better than the pillow.


就这时丫头来请示：“是不是等老爷回来再开饭？”
A maid came to ask whether dinner should wait until the master returned.

“老爷回来了，也是单独开饭。”朱太太说：
“When he comes, he will eat separately,” Mrs Zhu said.

“菜如果好了，就开吧！”
“If the dishes are ready, serve them.”

这倒提醒了螺蛳太太，不提一声朱宝如，似乎失礼，
This reminded Madam Luosi that it was hardly polite not to have mentioned Zhu Baoru.

便即问说：“朱老爷出去了？”
“Has Master Zhu gone out?” she asked.

接下来便是闲话家常，
They moved on to household matters.

光是胡家遣散各房姨太太这件事，便谈不完，只是螺蛳太太有事在心，只约略说了些。
The dispersal of Hu's concubines alone could have supplied endless conversation, but with the pillow on her mind, she gave only a brief account.

然后吃饭，饭罢略坐一坐，便该告辞了。
They ate, sat a little afterward, and it was time to leave.

“现在只有你一个人了，
“You are the only one left now.

大先生一定在等，我就不留你了。
Mr Hu must be waiting, so I shall not detain you.

等我把东西去拿出来。”
Let me fetch your things.”

朱太太说完，回到后房。
Mrs Zhu went into the back room.

没有多久，由丫头捧出来一个包裹，一个托盘，
Soon a maid brought out a bundle and a tray.

盘中是一顶貂帽，一只女用金表，
On the tray lay a sable hat and a lady's gold watch.

包裹中便是螺蛳太太寄存的枕头，连蓝布包袱，都是原来的。
In the bundle was the pillow, still in its original blue-cloth wrapping.

“ ‘回盘’没有啥好东西，
“Nothing very fine as a return gift.

你不要见笑。”
Please do not laugh at it.”

“自己人。”螺蛳太太说：
“We are old friends.

“何必说客气话。”
There is no need for such politeness.”

“这是你的枕头。”
“Here is your pillow.

朱太太说：“说实话，为了你这个枕头，我常常半夜里睡不着，
To tell the truth, it has often kept me awake at night.

稍为有点响动，我马上会惊醒，
The slightest sound would wake me.

万一贼骨头来偷了去，我对你怎么交代，”
If a thief stole it, how could I answer to you?”

“真是！”螺狮太太不胜歉疚地，“害你受累，真正过意不去。”
“I am so sorry to have put you to such trouble.”

“我也不过这么说说。
“It is merely a remark.

以我们的交情，我同宝如当然要同你们共患难的。”
With our friendship, Baoru and I must naturally share your adversity.”

这句话使得螺蛳太太自然而然地想到了朱家驹与王培利，
That made Madam Luosi think of Zhu Jiaju and Wang Peili.

他们不也是跟他们夫妇共患难的吗？
Had they not shared adversity with this couple too?

这样转着念头，接枕头时便迫不及待地要想知道其中的内容，但也只有掂一掂分量——
Eager to know what remained inside, she could only weigh the pillow in her hands.

很大的一个长方枕头，亮纱枕套，内实茶叶，
It was a large rectangular one with a sheer gauze cover, stuffed with tea leaves.

但中间埋藏着一个长方锡盒，珍藏都在里面。
At its center was a rectangular tin box containing the treasures.

她接枕头时，感觉到中间重、两头轻，足证锡盒仍在，
The middle still felt heavy and the ends light: the box was plainly still there.

不由得宽心大放。
Her relief was immense.


“多谢，多谢！”
“Thank you!”

螺蛳太太将枕头交了给阿云，
She handed the pillow to A’yun.

看朱太太的丫头在包貂帽与金表时，微笑着说：
Seeing the maid wrap the hat and watch, she smiled.

“这顶貂帽，我来戴戴看。”
“Let me try the hat.”

是一顶西洋妇子戴的紫貂帽，一旁还饰着一支红蓝相间、十分鲜艳的羽毛。
It was a sable hat of the sort Western women wore, with a bright red-and-blue feather at one side.

她是心情愉快，一时好玩，
In her happy mood, she felt playful.

亲自动手拔去首饰。将貂帽戴在头上。
Removing her hair ornaments, she put it on.

朱太太的丫头，已捧过来一面镜子，
The maid brought a mirror.

她左顾右盼了一番，自己都觉得好笑。
She turned her head this way and that, amused by her own appearance.

“象出塞的昭君。”朱太太笑着说：
“Like Zhaojun leaving for the frontier,” Mrs Zhu laughed.

“这种帽子，也只有你这种漂亮人物来戴，
“Only a beauty like you could wear that hat.

如果戴在我头上，变成老妖怪了。”
On my head it would make an old monster of me.”

就这样说说笑笑，满怀舒畅地上了轿，照预先的约走，直到乌家。
Still talking and laughing, Madam Luosi entered her chair in excellent spirits and went straight to Mr Wu's house, as arranged.

胡雪岩已经先到了，
Hu had arrived before her.

乌太太已由丈夫关照，有要紧事要办，所以只跟螺蛳太太略略寒暄了几句，便退了出去，同时将下人亦都遣在，
Mrs Wu, told by her husband that there was important business to settle, exchanged only a few greetings before withdrawing and sending the servants away.

堂屋里只剩下主客三人。
The three were left alone.

“拿回来了。”
“I have it back.”

螺蛳太太将貂帽取了下来，
Madam Luosi removed the hat.

“还送了我这么一顶帽子，一个金表。”
“She gave me this too, and a gold watch.”

胡雪岩与乌先生都很沉着地点点头，默不作声，
Both men nodded calmly without speaking.

螺蛳太太便解开了蓝布包袱，拿起桌上的剪刀准备动手时，
She unwrapped the blue cloth and took up a pair of scissors from the table.

乌先生开口了。“先仔细看一看。”
“Examine it carefully first,” Mr Wu said.

看是看外表，有没有动过手脚，
They inspected the outside for signs of interference.

如果拆过重缝，线脚上是看得出来的，
If it had been opened and sewn up again, the stitches should reveal it.

前后左右上下都仔细检查了，看不出拆过的痕迹。
They looked over every side and could find no sign of opening.

“剪吧！”
“Cut it.”


剪开枕头，作为填充枕头的茶叶，落了一桌，螺蛳太太捧起锡盒，
She cut the pillow open, spilling tea leaves over the table, and lifted out the tin box.

入手脸色大变，
Her face changed at once.

“分量轻浮多了！”
“It is much lighter!”

她的声音已经发抖。
Her voice was trembling.

“你不要慌！”胡雪岩依旧沉着，
“Do not panic,” Hu said, still calm.

“把心定下来。”
“Steady yourself.”

螺蛳太太不敢开盒盖，将锡盒放在桌上，自己坐了下来，扶着桌沿说：
Afraid to lift the lid, she set the box on the table and sat down, gripping its edge.

“你来开！”
“You open it.”

“你有点啥东西在里头？”胡雪岩问说。
“What did you have in it?”

“你那盘‘养眼’的宝石，我的两样金刚钻的首饰、镯子同胸花。还有，那十二颗东珠。”
“Your tray of gemstones for ‘nourishing the eyes,’ my diamond bracelets and breast ornament, and those twelve Eastern Pearls.”

胡雪岩点点头，拿起锡盒，有意无意地估一估重量，
Hu nodded and picked up the box, seeming almost casually to weigh it in his hands.

沉吟了一下说：“罗四姐，你不要看了好不好？”
After a moment he said, “Would it not be better not to look, Sister Luo?”

“为啥？”
“Why?”

螺蛳太太刚有些泛红的脸色，一下子又变得又青又白了。
The faint color that had returned to her face vanished again.

“不看，东西好好儿在里面，你的心放得下来……”
“If you do not look, you can think of everything as safely inside and be at peace.”

“看了，”螺蛳太太抢着说：“我就放不下心？”
“And if I look,” she broke in, “I shall have no peace?”

“不是这话。”
“That is not what I mean.

胡雪岩说：“钱财是身外之物，
Wealth is something outside ourselves.

生不带来，死不带去。
We bring none when we are born and take none when we die.

这一次栽了这么大的一个跟斗，我总以为你也应该看开了。
After so great a fall, I thought you too might have learned to let it go.”

““怎么？”
“What?”

螺蛳太太哪里还能平心静气听他规劝，
She could no longer calmly listen to persuasion.

双手往前一伸，鼓起勇气说道：“就算她黑良心，我总也要看明白了才甘心。”
Stretching out her hands and gathering her courage, she said, “Even if she has betrayed me, I must see it clearly before I can accept it.”


说着，捏住盒盖，使劲往上一提。
She grasped the lid and pulled hard.

这个锡盒高有两寸，盒盖、盒底其实是两个盒子套在一起，
The box was two cun deep, its top and bottom really two boxes fitted one inside the other.

急切间哪里提得起来，
It would not come apart so readily.

螺蛳太太心急如焚，双手一提，提得盒子悬空，接着使劲抖了两下，想将盒底抖了下来。
In desperation she lifted it clear of the table and shook it twice, trying to dislodge the bottom.

“慢慢，慢慢！”
“Slowly!”

乌先生急忙拦阻，
Mr Wu stopped her.

“盒底掉下来，珠子会震碎。
“If the bottom falls, the pearls may break.

等我来。”
Let me.”

于是乌先生坐了下来，双手扶着盒盖，一左一右地交替着往上提拔，慢慢地打开了。
Sitting down, he held the lid with both hands and eased it upward, first on one side and then the other, until it came free.

盒子里塞着很多皮纸，填塞空隙，
Much bark paper filled the empty spaces inside.

螺蛳太太不取皮纸，先用手一按，立即有数，
Without removing it, Madam Luosi pressed down with her hand and knew at once.

“我的钻镯没有了！”
“My diamond bracelets are gone!

她说：“珠子也好象少了。”
There seem to be fewer pearls too.”

乌先生帮她将皮纸都取了出来，
Mr Wu helped take out the paper.

预期的“火油钻”闪烁出来的炫目的光芒，丝毫不见，
None of the expected dazzling fire of the “oil diamond” appeared.

不但钻镯已失，连胸饰也不在了。
Not only the bracelets but the breast ornament was missing.

螺蛳太太直瞪着盒子，手足冰冷，
She stared into the box, her hands and feet cold.

好一会才说了句：“承她的情，还留了六颗东珠在这里。”
After a long time she said, “How kind of her to leave six Eastern Pearls.”

“宝石也还在。”胡雪岩揭开另一个小木盒，拿掉覆盖的皮纸说。
“The gemstones are here too,” Hu said, opening a little wooden box and lifting off the covering paper.

“什么还在？”螺蛳太太气紧败坏地说：
“What is here?” she cried in fury.

“好东西都没有了。”
“Everything good is gone!”

“你不要气急……”
“Do not upset yourself...”

“我怎么能不气急。”
“How can I help it?”

螺蛳太太“哇”地一声哭了出来，旋即警觉，用手硬掩住自己的嘴，不让自己出声，
She burst into tears, then suddenly remembered herself and clapped a hand over her mouth to stifle the sound.

但眼泪已流得衣襟上湿了一大片。
Tears had already soaked a broad patch of her clothes.

任凭胡雪岩与乌先生怎么劝，都不能让她把眼泪止住。
Neither man could console her.

最后胡雪岩说了句：“罗四姐，你不是光是会哭的女人，是不是？”
At last Hu said, “You are not a woman who can do nothing but cry, are you?”

这句话有意想不到的效果，
The effect was unexpected.

顿时住了眼泪，伸手进入袖中去掏手绢拭泪。
Her tears stopped at once, and she reached into her sleeve for a handkerchief.

窗外的阿云早就在留意，而且已找乌家的丫头，预备了热手巾在那里，
A’yun had been watching outside the window and had already asked a maid of the Wu household to prepare a hot towel.

见此光景，推门闪了进来，将热毛巾送到她手里，
Seeing her mistress's movement, she slipped in and handed it over.

螺蛳太太醒鼻子，抹涕泪，然后将手巾交回阿云，
Madam Luosi blew her nose, wiped her face, and returned it.

轻轻说了句：“你出去。”
“Go outside,” she said softly.


等阿云退出堂屋，乌先生说道：
When A’yun had left, Mr Wu spoke.

“罗四姐，你的损失不轻，
“Your loss is heavy, Sister Luo.

不过，你这笔帐，如果并在大先生那里一起算，也就无所谓了。”
But set beside Mr Hu's losses, it need not weigh so much.”

“事情不一样的。
“It is different.

做生意有赚就有赔，没有话说。
In business there are profits and losses; one cannot complain.

我这算啥？
But what is this?

我一口气咽不落。”
I cannot swallow it.

螺蛳太太又说：“从前，大家都说我能干，
People used to call me capable.

现在，大家都会说我的眼睛是瞎的；
Now they will say I was blind.

从前，大家都说我有帮夫运，
They used to say I brought my husband good fortune.

现在大家都会说，我们老爷最倒霉的时候，还要帮个倒忙，是扫帚星。
Now they will say that, at his worst moment, I made matters worse—that I am an unlucky star.

乌先生，你说，我怎样咽得落这口气？”
Tell me how I can bear that.”

乌先生无话可答，
Mr Wu had no answer.

好半天才说了句：“罗四姐你不要输到底！”
At last he said, “Do not let this defeat you completely.”

“乌先生，你是要我认输？”
“You want me to admit defeat?”

“是的。”
“Yes.”

“我不认！”
“I will not!”

罗四姐的声音又快又急，带着些负气的意味。
Her answer was quick, sharp, and defiant.

“你不认！”胡雪岩问：“预备怎么样呢？”
“Then what do you intend to do?” Hu asked.

“我一直不认输的。
“I have never admitted defeat.

前天晚上，你劝我同七姐夫合伙买地皮、造弄堂房子，又说开一家专卖外国首饰、衣料、家具的洋行，
The night before last, you suggested that I buy land and build lane houses with Brother-in-Law Gu, or open a firm selling foreign jewelry, cloth, and furniture.

我的心动了，
I was tempted.

自己觉得蛮有把握，
I felt sure I could do it.

你倒下去了，有我来顶，
If you have fallen, I can take your place.

这是我罗四姐出人头地的一个机会。”螺蛳太太加重了语气说：“千载难逢的机会。
This is my chance to distinguish myself—a chance in a thousand years!” She emphasized every word.

有你在场面上，我天大的本事，也不能抛头露面，
“While you stood at the center of affairs, I could never have come forward, however able I was.

现在有了机会，
Now I have a chance.

这个机会是怎么来的？
What bought it?

是你上千万银子的家当，一夜工夫化为灰尘换来的。
Your fortune of over ten million taels, turned to ashes overnight.

好难得噢！”
Think how precious it is!”

原来她是持着这种想法，胡雪岩悄然大悟，
Only now did Hu understand her thinking.

心中立刻想到，从各房姨太太那里搜集到的“私房”，本要寄顿在乌先生处而为他所反对的，
Immediately he remembered the private valuables collected from the concubines, which he had refused to leave with Mr Wu.

此刻看起来是要重新考虑。
That decision must be reconsidered.

“有机会也要有预备，
“An opportunity is useless without preparation.

我是早预备好的。
I had prepared long ago.”

螺蛳太太指着那个锡盒说：”
She pointed to the tin box.

这一盒东西至少值五十万。
“What was in here was worth at least five hundred thousand taels.

现在呢，
Now?

东珠一时未见得能脱手，
The Eastern Pearls may not sell readily.

剩下来的这些宝石，都是蹩脚货，不过值个一两万银子。
The remaining stones are inferior ones, worth only ten or twenty thousand.

机会在眼前，抓不住，
The opportunity is before me, and I cannot seize it.

你们说，我咽得落咽不落这个气。
How can I bear that?”

““机会还是有的。”胡雪岩说：
“There is still opportunity,” Hu said.

“只要你不认输，总还有办法。”
“So long as you refuse to give up, there will be a way.”


“什么办法？”
“What way?”

螺蛳太太摇摇头，
She shook her head.

“无凭无据，你好去告她？”
“Without proof, can we sue her?”

“不是同她打官司，
“I do not mean a lawsuit.

我另有办法。”
I have another idea.

胡雪岩说：“我们回去吧！不要打搅乌先生了。”
Let us go home; we must not trouble Mr Wu any longer.”

“打搅是谈不到。”乌先生接口说道：
“It is no trouble,” Mr Wu put in.

“不过，你们两位回去，好好儿商量商量看，是不是有啥办法，可以挽回？
“But go home and discuss whether anything can be done to recover the situation.

只要用得着我的地方，我唯命是听。”
If there is any way I can help, you have only to ask.”

“多谢，多谢！”
“Thank you.”

胡雪岩加重了语气说：
Hu spoke emphatically.

“一定会有麻烦乌先生的地方，
“There will certainly be something I must ask of you.

明天我再请你来谈。”
I shall invite you over tomorrow.”

“是，是！明天下午我会到府上去。”于是，螺蛳太太将阿云唤了进来，收拾那个锡盒，告辞回家。
“I shall come in the afternoon.” Madam Luosi called A’yun to pack the tin box, and they took their leave.

一上了百狮楼，抽抽噎噎地哭个不停，
Back at Hundred Lions Tower, she began sobbing again and could not stop.

胡雪岩无从解劝，
Hu could find no way to comfort her.

阿云虽约略知道是怎么回事，但关系太大，不敢胡乱开口，
A’yun knew roughly what had happened, but the matter was too grave for her to speak carelessly.

只是一遍一遍地绞了热手巾让她擦眼泪。
She could only keep wringing out hot towels for her mistress's tears.

终于哭声渐住，胡雪岩亦终于打定了主意，
At last the sobbing subsided, and Hu reached a decision.

“我明白你的心里的意思，
“I understand.

你不肯认输，
You will not admit defeat.

还想翻身，弄出一个新的局面来，
You want to recover and build something new.

就算规模不大，总是证明了我们不是一蹶不振。
Even on a modest scale, it would prove that we have not fallen beyond recovery.

既然如此，我倒还有一个办法，
There is one way.

不过，”他停了一下说：“你要有个‘以前种种，譬如昨日死；以后种种，譬如今日生’的想法。”
But you must think of everything before today as having died yesterday, and everything to come as being born today.”

“ ‘以后种种，譬如今日生’？”
“‘Everything to come as being born today’?

螺蛳太太问说：“生路在哪里？”
Where is this new life to be found?”

“喏！”
“There.”

胡雪岩指着那口存贮各房姨太太私房的箱子说：
Hu pointed to the chest of the concubines' private valuables.

“如今说不得了，
“We have no choice now.

只好照你的主意，寄放在乌先生那里。
We must follow your plan and leave it with Mr Wu.

你同应春炒地皮也好，开洋行也好，一笔合伙的本钱有了。”
Whether you speculate in land with Yingchun or open a foreign-goods firm, you will have capital for the partnership.”

螺蛳太太不作声，心里却在激动，
Madam Luosi said nothing, but her heart stirred.

“以前种种，譬如昨日死”的觉悟，虽还谈不到，
She could not yet think of the past as dead.

而“以后种种，譬如今日生”的念头，油然而生，
The idea of a new life beginning today, however, arose naturally within her.

配合她那不认输的性格，心头逐渐浮起了“柳暗花明又一村”的憧憬。
With her refusal to surrender, it gradually brought a vision of another village beyond the dark willows and bright blossoms.


“现在也只好这样子了！”
“There is nothing else for it now!”

螺蛳太太咬咬牙说：
Madam Luosi clenched her teeth.

“等我们立直了，再来同朱家老婆算帐。”
“Once we are back on our feet, we shall settle accounts with that Zhu woman.”

“好了！
“Enough.

睡觉了。
Time for bed.

身子要紧，”胡雪岩说：
Your health matters,” Hu said.

“留得青山在，不怕没柴烧。”
“While the green hills remain, there will always be firewood.”

“阿云！”
“A’yun!”

螺蛳太太的声音，又显得很有力、很有权威了，
Her voice had regained its strength and authority.

“等老爷吃了药酒，服侍老爷上床，老爷睡楼下。”
“When the master has had his medicinal wine, help him to bed downstairs.”

“为什么叫我睡楼下？”胡雪岩问。
“Why must I sleep downstairs?” Hu asked.

“我要理箱子，
“I have to sort the chest.

声音响动，会吵得你睡不着。”
The noise would keep you awake.

螺蛳太太又说：“既然托了乌先生了，不必一番手续两番做，
Since Mr Wu has agreed to help, there is no point in doing the same work twice.

值得拿出去的东西还多，
There are other things worth taking away.

我要好好儿理一理。”
I must sort them carefully.”

“理一只箱子就可以了！”
“One chest is enough.

胡雪岩说：“多了太显眼，
More would attract attention.

传出风声去，会有麻烦。”
If word gets out, there will be trouble.”

“我懂，
“I understand.

你不必操心。”
You need not worry.”


第二天下午，乌先生应约而至，
Mr Wu arrived the next afternoon as promised.

刚刚坐定，还未谈到正题，门上送进来一封德馨的信，
He had barely sat down, and they had not yet come to their business, when a letter from Dexin was brought in.

核桃大的九个字：“有要事奉告，乞即命驾。”
Nine characters, each as large as a walnut, said: “Important news to impart; please come at once.”

下面只署了“两浑”二字，没有上款也没有下款，
Below stood only the two characters “Lianghun,” without formal address or closing.

授受之间，心照不宣。
Sender and recipient understood one another.

“大概京里有信息。”胡雪岩神色凝重地说：
“Probably news from Beijing,” Hu said gravely.

“你不要走，
“Do not go.

等我回来再谈。”
We shall talk when I return.”

“是，是。”
“Of course.

乌先生答说：“我不走，我不走。”
I shall wait.”

这时螺蛳太太得报赶了来，忧心忡忡地问：
Madam Luosi hurried in, anxious.

“说德藩台请你马上去，
“They say Treasurer De wants you at once.

为啥？”
Why?”

“还不晓得。”
“I do not know yet.”

胡雪岩尽力放松脸上的肌肉，
Hu made an effort to relax his face.

“不会有啥要紧事的，
“It cannot be anything very serious.

等我回来再说。”
We shall talk when I get back.”

说完，匆匆下楼，坐轿到了藩司衙门，
He went quickly downstairs and took a chair to the provincial treasury yamen.

在侧门下轿，听差领人签押房，
Alighting at a side entrance, he was led to the private office.

德馨正在抽大烟，
Dexin was smoking opium.

摆一摆手，示意他在烟榻上躺了下来。
With a wave, he indicated that Hu should lie on the couch beside him.

抽完一筒烟，德馨拿起小茶壶，嘴对嘴喝了两口热茶，又闭了一会眼睛，方始张目说道：
Finishing a pipe, he took a small teapot, drank two mouthfuls of hot tea directly from its spout, and closed his eyes for a while before speaking.

“雪岩，有人跟你过不去。”
“Xueyan, someone is making trouble for you.”

“喔。”
“Oh.”

胡雪岩只答了这么一个字，等他说下去。
Hu waited.

“今儿中午，刘中丞派人来请我去吃饭，
“Governor Liu invited me to lunch today.

告诉我说，你有东西寄放在别处，问我知道不知道？”
He said you had left valuables elsewhere and asked whether I knew about it.”

这件事来得太突然了！
The news was utterly unexpected.

是不是朱宝如夫妇在捣鬼？
Were Zhu Baoru and his wife behind it?

胡雪岩心里很乱，一时竟不知如何回答。
Hu's thoughts were in such confusion that for a moment he could not answer.


“雪岩，”德馨又说：“以咱们的交情，没有什么话不好说的。”
“Between friends like us,” Dexin continued, “there is nothing you cannot say.”

胡雪岩定一定神，
Hu steadied himself.

想到刘秉璋手中不知握有什么证据？话要说得活络，
He did not know what evidence Liu held and must leave room to maneuver.

“晓翁，你晓得的，我决不会做这种事。”他说：
“Mr Xiaofeng, you know I would never do such a thing.

“是不是小妾起了什么糊涂心思，要等我回去问了才明白。”
Whether one of my concubines has had some foolish idea, I shall have to ask when I get home.”

“也许是罗四姐私下的安排。”
“Perhaps Sister Luo has made a private arrangement.”

德馨踌躇了一下说：
Dexin hesitated.

“刘中丞为此似乎很不高兴，
“The governor seems very displeased.

交代下来的办法，很不妥当。
His instructions are most unsuitable.

为了敷衍他的面子，我不能不交代杭州府派两个人去，
To satisfy him, I have had to ask the Hangzhou prefecture to send two men.

只当替你看门好了。”
Think of them simply as gatekeepers.”

很显然的，刘秉璋交代的办法，一定是派人监守，甚至进出家门都要搜查。
Clearly, Liu had ordered a watch on the house, perhaps even searches of everyone entering or leaving.

果然如此，这个台坍不起。
Such a humiliation would be unbearable.

到此地步，什么硬话都说不起，
Yet Hu could no longer speak defiantly.

只有拱拱手说：
He merely clasped his hands.

“请晓翁成全，维持我的颜面。”
“Please help me preserve my dignity.”

“当然，当然。
“Naturally.

你请放心好了。
Do not worry.

不过，雪岩，请你也要约束家人，特别要请罗四姐看破些。”
But you too must restrain your household, especially Sister Luo. Ask her to learn to let go.”

“是，是。
“Certainly.

谨遵台命。”
I shall follow your instructions.”

“你请回吧！
“Go home now.

吴知府大概就会派人去，
Prefect Wu will probably send the men shortly.

接不上头，引起纷扰，面子上就不好看了。”胡雪岩诺诺连声，告辞上轿，只催脚夫快走。
If nobody receives them properly and a disturbance follows, it will be embarrassing.” Hu agreed repeatedly, took his leave, and urged his bearers to hurry.

赶回元宝街，问清门上，杭州府或者仁和县尚未派人来过，方始放下心来。
Back at Yuanbao Street, he questioned the gatekeeper and was relieved to learn that neither the prefecture nor Renhe county had sent anyone yet.

“如果有人来，请在花厅里坐，马上进来通报。”
“If anyone comes, ask them to wait in the reception hall and inform me immediately.”

交代完了，仍回百狮楼，
He returned to Hundred Lions Tower.

螺蛳太太正陪着乌先生在楼下闲谈，
Madam Luosi was talking with Mr Wu downstairs.

一见了他，都站起身来，以殷切询问的眼光相迎。
Both rose at his appearance, their eyes full of urgent questions.


想想是决瞒不过的事，胡雪岩决定将经过情形和盘托出，
Knowing he could not conceal what had happened, Hu decided to tell them everything.

但就在要开口之际，想到还有机会，
Just as he was about to speak, he realized that there was still an opportunity.

因而毫不迟疑地对螺蛳太太说：“你赶快寻个皮包，或者帽笼，
Without hesitation he told Madam Luosi, “Find a leather bag or a hat case at once.

检出一批东西来，请乌先生带走。”
Choose some things for Mr Wu to take away.”

“为啥？”
“Why?”

“没有工夫细说，
“There is no time to explain.

越快越好。”
As quickly as possible.”

螺蛳太太以为抄家的要来了，吓得手软心跳，
Thinking that officials were coming to confiscate the house, she was so frightened that her hands went weak and her heart pounded.

倒是阿云还镇静，一把拉住她说：
A’yun remained calm and took her arm.

“我扶你上楼。”
“I shall help you upstairs.”

“对！
“Yes.

阿云去帮忙，
Help her, A’yun.

能拿多少是多少，要快。”
Take as much as you can, but hurry.”

螺蛳太太咬一咬牙，挺一挺胸，对阿云说道：“拿个西洋皮包来。”
Madam Luosi clenched her teeth, straightened her back, and told the maid, “Bring a Western leather bag.”

说完，首先上楼。
Then she led the way upstairs.

“怎么？”乌先生问：
“What is it?” Mr Wu asked.

“是不是京里有消息？”
“News from Beijing?”

“不是。
“No.

十之八九，是朱宝如去告的密，说罗四姐有东西寄放在外面。
Most likely Zhu Baoru has informed on us, saying that Sister Luo has left valuables elsewhere.

刘中丞交代德晓峰，要派人来……
Governor Liu has told De Xiaofeng to send men...”

“一句话未完，门上来报，仁和县的典史林子祥来了。
Before he could finish, the gatekeeper announced Lin Zixiang, the chief clerk of Renhe county.

“有没有带人来？”
“Has he brought anyone?”

“四个。”
“Four men.”


胡雪岩提示了一个警戒的眼色，随即由门房引领着，来到接待一般客人的大花厅。
Hu gave Mr Wu a warning glance and followed the gatekeeper to the large reception hall used for ordinary visitors.

林子祥跟胡雪岩极熟，远远地迎了上来，捞起衣襟打了个千，
Lin knew him well and came forward eagerly, lifting the front of his robe to salute on one knee.

口中仍旧是以往见面的称谓：
He used the same address as always.

“胡大人！”
“Your Excellency!”

“不敢当，不敢当！四者爷。”
“Please, Fourth Master, I do not deserve it.”

县衙门的官位，典史排列第四，所以通称“四老爷”。
The chief clerk ranked fourth among the county yamen's officials, hence the customary title “Fourth Master.”

胡雪岩一面拱手还礼，一面说道：“现在我是一品老百姓了，
Returning the greeting with clasped hands, Hu said, “I am now a first-rank commoner.

你千万不要用这个称呼。”
You must not address me that way.”

“胡大人说哪里话，
“What are you saying?

指日官复原职，仍旧戴红顶子。
You will soon be restored to office and wear the red button again.

我现在改了称呼，将来还要改回来，
If I change how I address you now, I shall only have to change it back.

改来改去麻烦，倒不如一仍旧惯。
Better to keep the old custom and save the trouble.”

““四老爷口才，越来越好了。
“Your eloquence improves all the time.

请坐。”
Please sit.”

揖客升炕，林子祥不肯上坐，甚至不肯坐炕床，
Hu invited him to the kang, but Lin would take neither the seat of honor nor even a place on the couch.

谦让了好一会，才在下首坐下，胡雪岩坐在炕旁一张红木太师椅上相陪。
After much polite insistence, he finally took the lower seat, while Hu occupied a grand rosewood chair beside it.

“今天德藩台已经跟我谈过了，说会派人来，
“Treasurer De told me today that men would be sent.

四老爷有啥吩咐，我好交代他们照办。”
Whatever instructions you have, let me know so that I can have them carried out.”

“不敢，不敢！
“I would not presume.

上命差遣，身不由己，
I am here on orders, with no choice in the matter.

县大老爷交代，我们仁和县托胡大人的福，公益事情办得比钱塘县来得风光，
The magistrate said that, thanks to you, Renhe's charitable undertakings have outshone Qiantang's.

叫我不可无礼。”
He told me not to be discourteous.

林子祥紧接着说：“其实县大老爷是多交代的，
But he need hardly have said it.

我带人到府上来，同做客人一样，
Coming here with my men is like coming as your guest.

怎么好无礼！”
How could I be rude?”

这话使得胡雪岩深感安慰。
Hu found this deeply comforting.

每年他捐出去“做好事”的款子不少，仁和县因为是“本乡本土”，捐款独多。
Every year he had donated large sums to good causes, and Renhe, his own home county, had received an especially generous share.

如今听县官的话，可见好歹还是有人知道的。
The magistrate's words showed that someone still remembered.


“多谢县大老爷的美意。”
“Thank the magistrate for his kindness.

胡雪岩说：“今年我出了事，现在所有的一切，等于都是公款，
Since this year's disaster, everything I possess is effectively public money.

我也不敢随便再捐，心里也蛮难过的。”
I dare not make donations as I please, and that troubles me.”

“其实也无所谓，做好事嘛！”林子样说：
“Surely it does not matter if it is for charity,” Lin said.

“哪怕抚台晓得了，也不会说话的。”
“Even the governor would raise no objection.”

“是，是！”
“Yes, yes.”

胡雪岩不知如何回答。
Hu did not know what else to say.

“现在辰光还来得及。”林子祥说：
“There is still time,” Lin continued.

“今年时世不好，又快过年了，
“Times are hard, and New Year is coming.

县大老爷想多办几个粥厂，经费还没有着落。”
The magistrate wishes to open more soup kitchens, but the funds have not been found.”

“好！
“Very well.

我捐。”胡雪岩问：
I shall contribute.

“你看要捐多少？”
How much do you suggest?”

“随便胡大人，
“Whatever you please.

捐一箱银子好了。”
A chest of silver would do.”

胡雪岩只觉得“一箱银子”这句话说得很怪，
Hu found “a chest of silver” an odd expression.

同时一心以为县官索贿，却没有想到人家是暗示，可以公然抬一个箱子出去，
Assuming that the magistrate wanted a bribe, he missed the hint: a chest could openly be carried out as a donation.

箱子之中有夹带，如何转移，那是出了胡家大门的事。
If something was hidden inside, how it was transferred afterward was a matter to be arranged beyond the Hu family gates.

“现银怕不多，
“I may not have much silver in cash.

我来凑几千两外国银行的票子。
I shall make up a few thousand taels in foreign bank paper.

等一息，请四老爷回去。”
Wait a little, and you can take it back.”

林子祥苦于不便明言，正在思索着如何点醒胡雪岩，只见胡家的听差进来说道：
Unable to speak plainly, Lin was wondering how to make him understand when a servant entered.

“仁和县的差人请四老爷说话。”
“A Renhe runner wishes to speak to Fourth Master.”

差人就在花厅外面，从玻璃窗中望得见。
The man stood outside the hall, visible through the glass window.

林子祥怕胡雪岩疑心他暗中弄鬼，为示坦诚，随即说道：
Afraid that Hu might suspect secret maneuvering, Lin wanted to show his openness.

“烦管家叫他进来说。”
“Please ask him to come in and speak here.”

这一进来反而坏事，
That made matters worse.

原来乌先生拎着着一个皮包，想从侧门出去，不道林子祥带来的差人，已经守在那里，
Mr Wu had tried to leave by a side gate carrying a leather bag, only to find one of Lin's men already stationed there.

乌先生有些心虚，往后一缩，
Uneasy, Wu had drawn back.

差人拦住盘问，
The runner stopped him to question him.

虽知是胡家的客人，但那个皮包却大有可疑，
Though he knew Wu was a guest, the bag looked highly suspicious.

所以特来请示，是否放行？
He had therefore come to ask whether he should let him pass.


“当然放。”
“Of course you should!”

林子祥没有听清楚，
Lin had not listened carefully.

大声说道：“胡大人的客人，为啥盘问？”
“Why question a guest of His Excellency?”

这官腔打得那差人大起反感，
His official bluster thoroughly antagonized the runner.

“请四老爷的示，”
“May I have your instructions, Fourth Master?

他问：“是不是带东西出去，也不必盘查。”
Are we to make no inquiries even if he is taking things out?”

“带什么东西？”
“What things?”

“那位乌先生带了个大皮包，拎都拎不动。”
“Mr Wu has a leather bag so heavy he can barely carry it.”

这一说，胡雪岩面子上挂不住，
Hu could not hide his embarrassment.

林子祥也发觉自己在无意中弄成一个僵局，只好继续打官腔：
Lin realized that he had unwittingly created a deadlock, but could only continue in his official manner.

“你不会问一问是啥东西。”
“Could you not ask what is in it?”

“我问过了，
“I did.

那位乌先生结结巴巴说不出来。”见此光景，胡雪岩暗暗叹气。
Mr Wu stammered and could not answer.” Hu sighed inwardly.

他知道林子祥的本意是要表明他在他心目中，尊敬丝毫不减，
He knew Lin meant to show that his respect remained undiminished.

但形禁势恪，今非昔比，
But circumstances had changed, and he was constrained by them.

要帮他的忙，只有在暗中调护，
Any help must be given discreetly.

林子祥将差人唤进来问话，便是一误，而开口便打官腔，更是大错特错，
Calling the runner in had been one mistake; meeting him with official bluster had been worse.

事到如今，再任令他们争辩下去，不仅于事无补，而且越来越僵，面子上会弄得很难看。
Further argument would accomplish nothing and only deepen the impasse, making the humiliation greater.

转念到此，他以调人的口吻说道：
Hu intervened in a conciliatory tone.

“四老爷，你不要怪他，
“Do not blame him, Fourth Master.

他也是忠于职守，并没有错。
He is doing his duty and has done nothing wrong.

那皮包里是我送我朋友的几方端砚，
The bag contains a few Duan inkstones I gave my friend.

不过也不必去说他了，
But let us say no more about it.

让我的朋友空手回去好了。”
My friend can go home empty-handed.”

“不要紧，不要紧！”
“There is no need!

林子祥说：“几方端砚算啥，
What do a few inkstones matter?

让令友带回去。”
Let him take them.”

胡雪岩心想，如果公然让乌先生将那未经查看的皮包带出去，那差人心里一定不服，
Hu thought that allowing Wu openly to leave with the unexamined bag would certainly leave the runner resentful.

风声传出去，不仅林子祥会有麻烦，连德馨亦有不便，而刘秉璋说不定采取更严厉的措施，
If word spread, Lin would be in trouble, Dexin would be embarrassed, and Liu might impose even stricter measures.

面子难看且不说，影响到清理的全局，所失更大。
Apart from the loss of face, the whole settlement of Hu's affairs might suffer.

因此，他断然地答一声：“不必！
“No,” he answered firmly.

公事公办，大家不错。”随即吩咐听差：“你去把乌先生的皮包拎进去。”
“Let official business be handled properly, and nobody will be at fault.” He told the servant, “Bring Mr Wu's bag back inside.”


林子祥老大过意不会，
Lin felt deeply apologetic.

“令友乌先生在哪里？”
“Where is your friend?

他说：“我来替他赔个不是。”
Let me apologize.”

对这一点，胡雪岩倒是不反对，
Hu had no objection to that.

“应该我来赔。”
“It is I who should apologize.”

说着，也出了花厅。林子祥跟在后面，
He left the hall, followed by Lin.

走近侧门，不见乌先生的踪影，
At the side gate Wu was nowhere to be seen.

问起来才知道已回到百狮楼楼下了。
They learned that he had returned to the ground floor of Hundred Lions Tower.

结果还是将乌先生请了出来，林子祥再三致歉以后，方始辞去。
In the end he was invited out, and Lin apologized repeatedly before leaving.

面子是有了，里子却丢掉了。
Appearances had been preserved, but their attempt had failed.

乌先生一再引咎自责，自嘲是“贼胆心虚”。
Wu blamed himself again and again, ruefully calling it a thief's guilty conscience.

螺蛳太太连番遭受挫折，神情沮丧。
After repeated setbacks, Madam Luosi looked utterly dejected.

胡雪岩看在眼中，痛在心里，而且还有件事，不能不说，
The sight hurt Hu, and there was still something he had to tell her.

踌躇再四，方始出口。
He hesitated for a long time before speaking.

“还要凑点钱给仁和县。
“We must raise some money for Renhe county as well.

快过年了，仁和县还想添设几座粥厂，
New Year is near, and they want to open more soup kitchens.

林子祥同我说，县里要我帮忙，
Lin said the county wanted my help.

我已经答应他了。”
I have already agreed.”

螺蛳太太先不作声，过了一会才问：“要多少？”
She was silent at first, then asked, “How much?”

“他要我捐一箱银子。
“He asked for a chest of silver.

我想……”
I thought...”

“慢点！”螺蛳太太打断他的话问：
“Wait!” she interrupted.

“他说啥？
“What did he say?

‘一箱银子’？”
‘A chest of silver’?”

“不错，他是说一箱银子。”
“Exactly.”

“箱子有大有小，
“Chests come in different sizes.

一箱是多少呢？”
How much is a chest?”

“是啊！”胡雪岩说：
“Yes,” Hu said.

“当时我也觉得他的话很怪。”
“I thought it sounded odd at the time.”


“大先生。”一直未曾开口的乌先生说：
Mr Wu, who had said nothing, now spoke.

“请你把当时的情形，说一遍看。”
“Tell us exactly what happened.”

“我来想想看。”
“Let me think.”

胡雪岩思索当时交谈的经过，将记得起来的情形，都说了出来。
Hu recalled as much of the conversation as he could.

一面回想，一面已渐有领悟。
In retelling it, he gradually began to understand.

“莫非他在‘豁翎子’？”乌先生说。“豁翎子”是杭州俗语，暗示之意。
“Could he have been dropping a hint?” Mr Wu asked, using a Hangzhou expression, huo lingzi, for hinting.

暗示什么呢？
A hint of what?

螺蛳太太明白了，
Madam Luosi understood.

“现在也还来得及。”
“There is still time.

她说：“趁早把林四老爷请了回来，
Send for Fourth Master Lin at once.

请乌先生同他谈，打开天窗说亮话好了。”
Let Mr Wu speak to him frankly.”

乌先生不作声，只看着胡雪岩，等候他的决定，
Mr Wu said nothing, merely looking to Hu for his decision.

而胡雪岩却只是摇头。
Hu only shook his head.

“事情未见得有那么容易。
“It may not be so easy.

箱子抬出去，中间要有一个地方能够耽搁，把东西掉包掉出来，
After the chest leaves, there must be somewhere along the way to stop and switch the contents.

做得不妥当，会闯大祸。”
If it is mishandled, there could be terrible trouble.”

他停了一下，顿一顿足说：
He paused, then stamped his foot.

“算了！
“Let it go.

一切都是命。”
Everything is fate.”


这句话等于在濒临绝望深渊的螺蛳太太身后，重重地推了一把，也仿佛将她微若游丝的一线生机，操刀一割。
Those words were like a heavy push from behind as Madam Luosi stood at the brink of despair, or a blade severing her last thread of hope, already thin as gossamer.

从那一刻开始，她的神思开始有些恍惚了，
From that moment, her thoughts began to grow confused.

但只有一件事，也是对一个人的记忆是清楚的，那就是朱宝如的老婆。
Only one thing, one person, remained clear in her memory: Zhu Baoru's wife.

“阿云，”她说：“佛争一柱香，人争一口气，
“A’yun,” she said, “a Buddha needs his incense, and a person needs her dignity.

一口气咽不下，艮在喉咙口，
This indignation sticks in my throat.

我会发疯。
It will drive me mad.

我只有想到一件事，心里比较好过些，
Only one thought gives me any relief.

我要叫起黑心吞没我活命的东西，还狠得下去，到巡抚衙门去告密的人，一辈子会怕我。”
The woman who stole what I needed to live, and was cruel enough to inform on us at the governor's yamen—I shall make her fear me for the rest of her life.”

阿云愕然，
A’yun stared.

“怕点啥？”她怯怯地问。
“Fear what?” she asked timidly.

“怕我到阎罗大王那里告状告准了，无常鬼会来捉她。”
“That my complaint before the King of Hell will be upheld, and the underworld’s messengers will come to seize her.”

“太太，你，”
“Madam, you...”

阿云急得流眼泪，
A’yun was weeping in alarm.

“你莫非要寻死？”
“Surely you are not thinking of ending your life?”

螺蛳太太不作声，
Madam Luosi did not answer.

慢慢地闭上眼，
Slowly she closed her eyes.

嘴角挂着微笑，安详地睡着了。
A smile lingered at the corners of her mouth as she fell peacefully asleep.

这一睡再没有醒了。
She never woke again.

事后检查，从广济医院梅藤更医生那里取来的一小瓶安神药，只剩了空瓶子了。
When they looked afterward, the little bottle of sedative obtained from Dr Mei Tenggeng at Guangji Hospital was empty.



胡雪岩
后记及底本附载声明
Afterword and Notice Appended to the Source
逐句中英对照
原著：高阳


后记｜AFTERWORD


写完《灯火楼台》最后一章，真有如释重负之感。
Having finished the last chapter of Towers of Light, I truly feel as though a great weight has been lifted from me.

《胡雪岩》、《红顶商人》等作自连载未几，即谬承读者奖饰有加；
Almost from the beginning of their serialization, Hu Xueyan and The Red-Topped Merchant received more generous praise from readers than they deserved.

单行本出版后，行销遍及世界各地的华人社会；
Once published in book form, they circulated among Chinese communities throughout the world.

甚至还有许多外国读者，他们不识中文，特为请他们的中国朋友讲解。
There were even many foreign readers who, unable to read Chinese, specially asked Chinese friends to explain the books to them.

但说来让我有些啼笑皆非，这些外国读者是想从拙作中，学得胡雪岩的经商技巧；
Yet something about this leaves me not knowing whether to laugh or cry: these readers hoped to learn Hu Xueyan's business techniques from my modest work.

实力始料所不及。
That was something I had never anticipated.


《胡雪岩》三部曲的写作过程，跟小女的年龄相仿佛。
The writing of the Hu Xueyan trilogy has taken about as long as my daughter has been alive.

在这十余年之间，台湾经济发展的情势，使得我在写作中途，不断产生新的感慨。
Over these ten years and more, the course of Taiwan's economic development has continually prompted new reflections as I wrote.

其中最深刻的是：第一，胡雪岩失败的主要原因是，当英国瓦特发明蒸汽机，导致工业革命后，手工业之将没落是时间的问题。
Of the reflections that have struck me most deeply, the first is this: the principal cause of Hu's failure was that, once Britain's Watt invented the steam engine and set the Industrial Revolution in motion, the decline of handicraft production became only a matter of time.

胡雪岩非见不及此，
Hu was not blind to this.

但为了维持广大江南农村养蚕人家的生计，不愿改弦易辙；
But to preserve the livelihoods of the many silkworm-raising households in the Jiangnan countryside, he refused to change course.

亦不甘屈服于西洋资本主义国家雄厚的经济力量之下，
Nor was he willing to submit to the formidable economic power of the Western capitalist countries.

因而在反垄断的狐军奋斗之下，导致了周转不灵的困境。
His solitary struggle against their monopoly consequently led him into a crisis of cash flow.

胡雪岩是不折不扣的民族资本家；
Hu was a national capitalist in the fullest sense.

如果在现代一定会获得政府的支持，但当时的当政者并无此种意识。
In modern times, he would certainly have received government support; the authorities of his own day had no such understanding.

所以他的失败，可说是时代的悲剧。
His failure may therefore be called a tragedy of his age.


第二，胡雪岩失败后，态度光明磊落，不愧为我乡的“杭铁头”。
Second, after his failure, Hu remained open and honourable, worthy of the name “Hangzhou Ironhead” from my native region.

看到近年来不断发生的经济犯罪事件，我不知道会不会有人从胡雪岩身上记取若干警惕与感化？
Looking at the economic crimes that have occurred so frequently in recent years, I wonder whether anyone might find in Hu Xueyan something to warn them and move them towards a better course.


第三个浓重的感慨，胡雪岩是李鸿章与左宗棠争夺政治权力、争议发展路线下的牺牲者。
My third deeply felt reflection is that Hu was a victim of the struggle between Li Hongzhang and Zuo Zongtang for political power and over the course of development.

从事投资，要看投资环境，而其间最重要的一个因素是：政治稳定。
Anyone making an investment must consider the investment environment, and one of its most important factors is political stability.

这应该是拙作的另一个始料所不及的贡献。
This may be another contribution of my work that I had not foreseen.
